Ngɔɔ tso ɔ kɛ fia tɛ sa a, nɛ nyu maa je mi kɛ ba ha ma a nɛ a nu.” Nɛ Mose pee ja ngɛ Israel ma nimeli ɔmɛ a hɛ mi.
7Mose wo lejɛ ɔ biɛ ke Masa kɛ Meriba, nɛ e de ke, “I wo kikɛmɛ a biɛ nɛ ɔ, ejakaa lejɛ ɔ nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ pia Yawɛ ngɛ, nɛ lejɛ ɔ nɔuu a ka lɛ ngɛ benɛ a bi ke, ‘Anɛ Yawɛ ngɛ wa kpɛti, aloo e be?’ ɔ.”
Israel kɛ Amalek hwu ta
8Benɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ ngɛ Refidim ɔ, Amalek bi ɔmɛ hia ta ba tua mɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. 9Mose de Yoshua ke, “Moo hla nyumu ɔmɛ ekomɛ, nɛ hwɔɔ a kɛ Amalek bi ɔmɛ ya hwu. Imi lɛɛ ma ya da yoku ɔ yi mi kɛ Mawu tso ɔ ngɛ ye dɛ mi.” 10Yoshua pee kaa bɔ nɛ Mose de lɛ ɔ, nɛ e ho nɛ e kɛ Amalek bi ɔmɛ ya hwu. Nɛ Mose, Aaron, kɛ Hur kuɔ yoku ɔ kɛ ho e yi mi ya. 11Nɛ e ba mi kaa ke Mose wo e nine nɔ pɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ a nine gu Amalek bi ɔmɛ a nɔ. Ke e nine ba si pɛ kɛkɛ Amalek bi ɔmɛ a nine bɔni Israel bi ɔmɛ a he ngɔmi. 12Se Mose kɔni ba gbo, nɛ Aaron kɛ Hur ya hla tɛ ba wo sisi. Nɔ kake da e kasa nya hiɛ, nɛ nɔ kake hu da e kasa nya hiɛ, nɛ a hɛɛ e kɔni ɔmɛ a mi ngɛ hiɔwe kɛ ya si pu nɔ si. 13Nɛ Yoshua ye Amalek bi ɔmɛ a nɔ butuu.
14 Yawɛ de Mose ke, “Ngmaa nɔ nɛ ɔ kɛ wo womi mi nɛ e pee kaimi nɔ́. Ha nɛ e su Yoshua kaa ma kpata Amalek bi ɔmɛ a hɛ mi, nɛ a be mɛ kaie hu ngɛ zugba a nɔ.” 15Mose ma bɔ sami la tɛ ko nɛ e wo lɛ ke, “Yawɛ ji ye we aflangaa.” 16E de ngɔ piɛ he ke, “Yawɛ hɛɛ e we aflangaa a ngɛ e dɛ mi. Yawɛ kɛ Amalek bi ɔmɛ maa hwu kɛ maa ya neneene!”

Title: MOSE II, 18
Content:
Yetro ba slaa Mose
1Mose ngatsɛ Yetro, Midian osɔfo ɔ nu níhi tsuo nɛ Mawu pee ha Mose kɛ e ma Israel ɔ he, kɛ bɔ nɛ Yawɛ je mɛ kɛ je Egipt. 2 Benɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ na we nɛ a ba a, Mose wo e yo Zipora blɔ kɛ ho e ngatsɛ Yetro ngɔ ya. 3 E kɛ e binyumuwi enyɔ ɔmɛ ho. A tsɛɛ nɔ kake ke Gershon; e sisi ji, “I ya to nubwɔ ngɛ ma se.” 4Nɔ kake hu biɛ ji Eliezer; e sisi ji “Tsaatsɛ e Mawu nɛ doo ha mi; lɛ nɛ je mi kɛ je Farao ɔ ta a nya.” 5Mose ngatsɛ Yetro kpaka Mose yo ɔ, kɛ e binyumuwi enyɔ ɔmɛ kɛ ba nga a nɔ he nɛ Mose ba to si ngɛ ɔ, ngɛ Mawu yo ɔ he. 6Nɛ e tsɔ ya de lɛ ke, “Imi, o ngatsɛ Yetro, kɛ o yo ɔ, kɛ o binyumuwi enyɔ ɔmɛ wa ma o ngɔ.” 7Mose je kpo nɛ e kɛ e ngatsɛ ɔ ya kpe; e ba e he si nɛ e fua lɛ atuu. Nɛ benɛ a nga a he ta a, a sɛ bo tsu ɔ mi. 8Mose bɔ e ngatsɛ ɔ a blɔ hiami ɔ mi sanehi tsuo: níhi nɛ Yawɛ pee Farao ɔ kɛ Egipt bi ɔmɛ nɛ e kɛ kpɔ Israel bi ɔmɛ, a blɔ hiami ɔ mi pɔtɔ kɛ dengme, kɛ bɔ nɛ Yawɛ je mɛ kɛ je kulaa mi. 9Benɛ Yetro nu kpakpa nɛ Yawɛ pee Israel bi ɔmɛ, kɛ bɔ nɛ e he a yi wami kɛ je Egipt bi ɔmɛ a dɛ mi ɔ, e bua jɔ e he nɛ e nya, 10nɛ e de ke, “A je Yawɛ, nɔ nɛ je nyɛ kɛ je Farao ɔ kɛ Egipt bi ɔmɛ a dɛ mi ɔ yi. 11Kpaako loko i ná le paa kaa Yawɛ kle pe mawu ɔmɛ kulaa; ejakaa e he ma a yi wami kɛ je Egipt bi ɔmɛ a dɛ mi, benɛ a ngɛ mɛ nisɛ ní pee ɔ.” 12Mose ngatsɛ Yetro ngɔ sami bɔ, kɛ bɔ kpa komɛ ba ha Yawɛ, nɛ Aaron kɛ Israel ma nimeli ɔmɛ tsuo ba, nɛ a kɛ Mose ngatsɛ ɔ ba bla kɛ ye bɔ sami ní ɔ ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi, nɛ a kɛ ja Mawu.
A hla kojoli komɛ
(Mose V, 1.9-18)
13E nɔ jena a, Mose he sɛ, nɛ a kɛ ma sanehi ba e hɛ mi nɛ e kojo. E kojo kɛ je mɔtu kɛ ya si du bubui nɛ ni ɔmɛ daa si. 14Benɛ Mose ngatsɛ ɔ na níhi tsuo nɛ Mose ngɛ tsue ngɛ ma a mi ɔ, e bi lɛ ke, “Mɛni o ngɛ pee nɛ ɔ? Mɛni he je o ngɔ ní tsumi nɛ ɔ ngɔ fɔ mo nɔ kake too o nɔ, nɛ ma a tsuo daa si ngɛ o kuɛ nɔ mɔtumɔtu kɛ ya si du bubui kikɛ nɛ ɔ?”
15Mose he nɔ ke, “Ye ní tsumi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ, ejakaa ma a baa ye ngɔ ba biɔ Mawu ga womi. 16Ke nɔ ko kɛ e nyɛmi na sane ɔ, a kɛ baa ye ngɔ nɛ i hyɛɛ mi, nɛ i tsɔɔ mɛ Mawu kita amɛ, kɛ Mawu blɔ nya tomi ɔmɛ.”
17Kɛkɛ nɛ Mose ngatsɛ ɔ de lɛ ke, “O blɔ nya tomi ɔ piɛ bɔɔ. 18Pɔ maa tɔ o kɛ ma a tsuo; ejakaa ma a tlomi ɔ jiɔ tsɔ, nɛ mo nɔ kake o be nyɛe tloomi. 19Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, moo bu mi tue nɛ ma wo mo ga; Mawu nɛ piɛ o he. Moo lɛɛ moo da ma a nane mi ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi, nɛ o ngɔ a sane ɔmɛ kɛ ba fɔ Mawu hɛ mi. 20Moo lɛɛ moo tsɔɔ mɛ Mawu mlaa amɛ, kɛ e suɔmi nya ní ɔmɛ. Moo tsɔɔ mɛ bɔ nɛ sa nɛ a ba a je mi, kɛ níhi nɛ sa nɛ a peeɔ. 21Se ngɛ enɛ ɔmɛ a se ɔ, o kɛ o hɛngmɛ nɛ wo ma a mi nɛ o hla nihi nɛ a nine si wa kɛ ní tsumi, nihi nɛ ye ɔ Mawu gbeye, nihi nɛ yeɔ anɔkuale, nɛ a sume nyɔ mi ní. Ngɔɔ kikɛmɛ a nimli ngɔ to ma a nya. Ni komɛ nɛ a hyɛ nimli nyɔngma nɔ; ni komɛ nɛ a hyɛ nimli nyingmi enuɔ nɔ; ni komɛ nɛ a hyɛ nimli lafa nɔ, konɛ ni komɛ hu nɛ a hyɛ nimli akpe nɔ. 22Ha nɛ mɛɛ a pee kojoli ngɛ ma a mi. Sanehi nɛ a he wa pe mɛ ɔ, ha a kɛ ba o hɛ mi; se sane tsɔwitsɔwihi lɛɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a ye. Ke o pee jã a, lɛɛ a maa kpee mo kɛ tloo ma a tlomi ɔ, nɛ pɔ be mo tɔe tsɔ. 23Ke o pee enɛ ɔ kaa bɔ nɛ Mawu fa mo ɔ, lɛɛ pɔ be mo tɔe, nɛ ni ɔmɛ tsuo maa kpale kɛ ho a wehi a mi ya kɛ tue mi jɔmi.”
24Mose bu e ngatsɛ ɔ ga womi ɔ tue, nɛ e pee kaa bɔ nɛ e de lɛ ɔ. 25Mose hla nyumuhi nɛ a nine si wa kɛ je Israel bi ɔmɛ a kpɛti, nɛ e wo mɛ nikɔtɔmahi ngɛ ma a nya. Ni komɛ hyɛɛ nimli nyɔngma nɔ, ni komɛ hyɛɛ nimli nyingmi enuɔ nɔ; ni komɛ hyɛɛ nimli lafa nɔ, nɛ ni komɛ hu hyɛɛ nimli akpe nɔ. 26Mɛ ji ni nɛmɛ nɛ kojoɔ ma a sanehi daa be tsuaa be. Mɛ nitsɛmɛ nɛ a buá sane tsɔwitsɔwihi a he; se sanehi nɛ a he wa lɛɛ a kɛ baa Mose ngɔ.
27Pee se ɔ, Mose wo e ngatsɛ ɔ blɔ, nɛ Yetro kpale kɛ ho e ma mi ya.

Title: MOSE II, 19
Content:
Israel bi ɔmɛ ngɛ Sinai yo ɔ nɔ
1-2Nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ je Egipt ɔ se nyɔhiɔ etɛne ɔ kekleekle ligbi ɔ, a je Refidim kɛ ho Sinai nga a nɔ ya, nɛ a ya to si ngɛ Sinai yo ɔ sisi. 3Mose kuɔ yo ɔ kɛ ho Mawu ngɔ ya.
Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ tsɛ Mose ngɛ yo ɔ mi, nɛ e de lɛ ke e ya nɛ e ya de Israel bi ɔmɛ, nɛ ji Yakob nina a ke, 4“Nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ na nɔ́ nɛ i pee Egipt bi ɔmɛ, kɛ bɔ nɛ i kɛ he wami je nyɛ kɛ je Egipt kaa nɔ́ nɛ kɔle pɛli nɔ nɛ nyɛ hii si ngɛ, nɛ i ngɔ nyɛ kɛ ba imi nitsɛ ye ngɔ. 5 Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke nyɛ maa bu ye gbi tue, nɛ nyɛ maa ye ye somi ɔ nɔ ɔ, lɛɛ nyɛ maa pee imi nitsɛ ye ma titli pe ma amɛ kulaa; ejakaa je ɔ tsuo ye nɔ́ ji mɛ. 6 Se nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ maa pee ye ma klɔuklɔu, nɛ nyɛ ma sɔmɔ mi kaa osɔfohi. Sɛ gbi nɛ ɔ, mo de Israel bi ɔmɛ.” 7Mose kple si kɛ ba nɛ e ba tsɛ ma nimeli ɔmɛ, nɛ e ngɔ Yawɛ sɛ gbi ɔ ngɔ ha mɛ. 8Nɛ ma a tsuo he nɔ nɛ a de ke, “Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ de ɔ, wa maa pee.” Mose kpale ya bɔ Yawɛ bɔ nɛ ma a de ɔ.
9Yawɛ de Mose ke, “Hyɛ, i ma o ngɔ ngɛ bɔku kpii mi, konɛ ke ma a nu nɛ i kɛ mo ngɛ munyu tue ɔ, a he mo nɛ a ye kɛ ya neneene.”
Mose ho nɛ e ya bɔ Yawɛ heto nɛ ma a ha lɛ ɔ. 10Nɛ Yawɛ de Mose ke, “Yaa nɛ o ya tsukɔ ma a he mwɔnɛ ɔ kɛ hwɔɔ. Ha nɛ a fɔ a tadehi a he, 11nɛ benɛ e maa su ligbi nɛ ji etɛ ɔ, a dla a he; ejakaa hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ ligbi nɛ ji etɛ ɔ, imi Yawɛ, ma kple si kɛ ba Sinai yo ɔ nɔ, nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ maa na mi. 12 Poo piɛ kɛ bɔle yo ɔ, nɛ o wo ma a si nɛ a hyɛ saminya nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko kó kuɔ yo ɔ, loo e hɛ lɛ kɛ su he po. Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa ta yo ɔ he ɔ, a gbe lɛ! 13Nɔ ko nɔ ko nine nɛ ko sa nɔ ɔ he, se mohu a fia lɛ tɛ, loo a tsɛ̃ lɛ kɛ̃ɛ̃; lohwe ji lɛ jio, nɔmlɔ ji lɛ jio, e ko hi je mi. Ke titimati ɔ pɛ wawɛɛ nɛ e se kɛ ɔ, loko ma a nɛ kuɔ yo ɔ kɛ ba.”
14Mose kple si kɛ je yo ɔ nɔ kɛ ba ma a ngɔ, nɛ e ha ni ɔmɛ tsukɔ a he, nɛ a fɔ a tade ɔmɛ a he. 15E de ma a ke, “Nyɛ dla nyɛ he ha hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ ligbi nɛ ji etɛ ɔ; nɔ ko nɔ ko kó ta yo he.”
16 Ligbi nɛ ji etɛ ɔ mɔtu ɔ, a nu hiɔmi simi, oslabai gbami, kɛ titimati pɛmi wawɛɛ ngɛ yo ɔ nɔ; bɔku kpii hu wo ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Sawale nu ma a tsuo ngɛ a sito he ɔ, nɛ a he kpokpo. 17Kɛkɛ nɛ Mose nyɛɛ ma a hɛ mi kɛ je sito he ɔ kɛ je kpo konɛ a kɛ Mawu nɛ ya kpe; nɛ a ho ya da si ngɛ yo ɔ sisi. 18Sinai yo ɔ tsuo hyi kɛ la su ku; ejakaa Yawɛ kple si kɛ ba yo ɔ nɔ ngɛ la mi. La su ku ɔ ngɛ si tee kɛ ngɛ hiɔwe yae kaa buɛsa he la su ku, nɛ yo ɔ tsuo mimiɛ wawɛɛ nitsɛ. 19Benɛ bɛ pɛmi ɔ nya wa a, Mose tu munyu, nɛ Mawu ha lɛ heto kɛ hiɔwe simi. 20Yawɛ kple si kɛ ba Sinai yo ɔ nɔ nɛ e tsɛ Mose, nɛ Mose kuɔ kɛ ho yo ɔ yi mi ya. 21Nɛ Yawɛ de lɛ ke, “Kple si nɛ o ya tu munyu ngɔ tsɔɔ ma a, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko kó de ke e ngɛ piɛ ɔ gbae kɛ ma mi hyɛmi, nɛ́ nihi babauu a hɛ mi ko ba kpata. 22Jã kɛ̃, osɔfo ɔmɛ nɛ mɛɛ a nyɛɔ suu ye he ɔ, mɛ hu hyɛ nɛ a tsukɔ a he, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ Yawɛ ko ba kpata a hɛ mi.”
23Mose de Yawɛ ke, “Ma a be nyɛe maa kuɔ Sinai yo ɔ; ejakaa mo nitsɛ nɛ o wo mlaa ke waa po piɛ kɛ wo he kɛ tsɔɔ kaa yo ɔ ngɛ klɔuklɔu.”
24Yawɛ de Mose ke, “Kple si nɛ o ya ngɔ Aaron kɛ ba. Se osɔfo ɔmɛ, kɛ ma a lɛɛ ko ha nɛ a gba piɛ ɔ nɛ a kuɔ kɛ ba ye ngɔ, nɛ ma ko ba gbla a tue.” 25Kɛkɛ nɛ Mose kple si nɛ e ya bɔ ma a nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ de lɛ ɔ.

Title: MOSE II, 20
Content:
Mlaa nyɔngma amɛ
(Mose V, 5.1-21)
1Mawu tu munyu, nɛ e de ke, 2“Imi ji Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ nɛ je mo kɛ je Egipt zugba a nɔ kɛ je nyɔguɛ yemi mi ɔ nɛ.
3“Ko ja mawu ko kɛ piɛ ye he.
4 “Koo puɛ amaga, loo nɔ́ ko nɛ ngɛ kaa nɔ́ ko nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe, loo nɔ́ ko nɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ, loo nɔ́ ko nɛ ngɛ nyu mi ngɛ zugba a sisi. 5 Ko kpla si ha mɛ, nɛ ko ja mɛ hulɔ; ejakaa imi Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ, a kɛ mi plee we nɔ́ he. I gblaa ni nɛmɛ nɛ nyɛɛ mi ɔ, kɛ a bimɛ, kɛ a bibimɛ a tue hluu kɛ yaa si yi nɔ etɛne kɛ eywiɛne bimɛ a nɔ. 6Se nihi akpe abɔ nɛ suɔ mi, nɛ a yeɔ ye mlaa amɛ a nɔ ɔ, mɛɛ i naa mɛ mɔbɔ.
7 “Ko tsɛ Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ biɛ yaka gu; ejakaa nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ peeɔ ja a, Yawɛ kɛ e he be lɛ kee.
8 “Mo kai Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ, nɛ o ye lɛ ngɛ mumi mi he tsɔmi mi. 9 Ngɔɔ ligbi ekpa kɛ tsu nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ o ngɛ tsumi. 10Ligbi nɛ ji kpaago ɔ ji Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ Hejɔɔmi ligbi. Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, ko tsu nɔ́ ko kulaa; mo nitsɛ jio, o binyumu jio, o biyo jio, o tsɔlɔ nyumu jio, o mawayo jio, o lohwe jio, nubwɔ nɛ ngɛ o ma a mi jio; 11 ejakaa ligbi ekpa Yawɛ ngɔ kɛ pee hiɔwe, zugba, kɛ wo kɛ a mi nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́, nɛ ligbi nɛ ji kpaago ɔ, e jɔɔ e he. Enɛ ɔ he je nɛ e gbaa Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ, nɛ e pee lɛ klɔuklɔu ɔ nɛ.
12 “Moo bu o tsɛ kɛ o nyɛ, konɛ o se nɛ kɛ ngɛ zugba nɛ Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ ngɔ ha mo ɔ nɔ.
13 “Koo gbe nɔmlɔ.
14 “Ko puɛ gba.
15 “Koo ju.
16 “Koo ye lakpa odase kɛ si o nyɛmi.
17 “O hɛ ko kɔ o nyɛmi we nɔ; o hɛ ko kɔ o nyɛmi e yo, aloo e tsɔlɔ nyumu, aloo e mawayo, aloo e na, aloo e teji, aloo e nɔ́ kpa ko nɔ.”
Ma a ye gbeye
(Mose V, 5.22-33)
18 Benɛ ma a tsuo nu hiɔwe simi ɔ, kɛ titimati pɛmi ɔ, nɛ a na oslabai la a, kɛ la su ku nɛ je ngɛ yo ɔ mi ɔ, a ye gbeye, nɛ a je ya da si ngɛ se banee. 19Nɛ a de Mose ke, “Mo nitsɛ o kɛ wɔ nɛ tu munyu nɛ waa nu; ko ha nɛ Mawu kɛ wɔ nɛ tu munyu nɛ wa ba gbo.”
20Mose de ma a ke, “Nyɛ ko ye gbeye; kami kɛkɛ Mawu ma nyɛ kami konɛ nyɛɛ ye lɛ gbeye nɛ nyɛ ko pee yayami.” 21Se ma a daa si ngɛ se lokoo, nɛ Mose pɛ nɛ e hɛ lɛ kɛ su diblii kpii ɔ he ngɛ he nɛ Mawu ngɛ ɔ.
Bɔ sami la tɛhi a he mlaahi
22Yawɛ fa Mose ke e ya de Israel bi ɔmɛ ke, “Nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ na kaa hiɔwe nɛ i kɛ nyɛ tu munyu kɛ je ɔ nɛ. 23Nyɛ ko ngɔ sika hiɔ, loo sika tsu kɛ pee mawuhi ha nyɛ he nɛ nyɛ ja kɛ piɛ ye he. 24Nyɛɛ ngɔ zu kɛ puɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ha mi, nɛ nyɛɛ ngɔ jijɔ, kɛ na kɛ pee sami bɔ, kɛ tue mi jɔmi bɔ ngɛ nɔ. He tsuaa he nɛ i fa nyɛ ke nyɛ ja mi ngɛ ɔ, ma ba lejɛ ɔ nɛ ma ba gbaa nyɛ. 25 Ke nyɛ maa puɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ha mi kɛ tɛ ɔ, nyɛ ko ngɔ tɛ nɛ a gba kɛ pee; ejakaa ke nyɛ ngɔ ní tsumi dade kɛ ta tɛ ɔ he pɛ nyɛ ble tɛ ɔ. 26Nyɛ ko pee kpoku kɛ kuɔ kɛ ya ye bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he, konɛ a ko na nyɛ he nɛ fɔɔ si.”

Title: MOSE II, 21
Content:
Bɔ nɛ á hɛɛ nyɔguɛhi ha
(Mose V, 15.12-18)
1“Jehanɛ, mlaahi nɛ o maa wo Israel bi ɔmɛ ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ. 2 Ke mo nɔ ko o he Hebri no nyɔguɛ ɔ, e ma sɔmɔ mo jeha ekpa. Jeha nɛ ji kpaago ɔ, e ye e he nɛ o ko he nɔ́ ko ngɛ e dɛ. 3Ke lɛ nɔ kake nɛ ba a, lɛ nɔ kake ɔ nɔuu nɛ kpale kɛ ho. Se ke e kɛ e yo ba a, lɛɛ e kɛ e yo ɔ nɛ ho. 4Ke e nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ha lɛ yo, nɛ e fɔ binyumuhi, loo biyihi ha lɛ ɔ, yo ɔ kɛ e bimɛ ɔmɛ maa pee e nyɔmtsɛ ɔ níhi; nɛ lɛ nɔ kake too e maa ho. 5Se ke nyɔguɛ ɔ ha a nu sisi kaa e suɔ e nyɔmtsɛ ɔ, kɛ yo nɛ a ha lɛ ɔ, kɛ e bimɛ ɔmɛ, nɛ lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e be suɔe nɛ e ye e he ɔ, 6lɛɛ e nyɔmtsɛ ɔ maa ngɔ lɛ kɛ ba Mawu hɛ mi. E kɛ lɛ ma ba da sinya a nya, loo sinya tso ɔ he ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, nɛ e maa ngɔ tue gbumi nɔ́ kɛ gbu e tue ha lɛ. Kɛkɛ e ma tsa nɔ ma sɔmɔ kɛ yaa si lɛ, nyɔguɛ ɔ ma gbo.
7“Ke nyumu ko jua e biyo kaa nyɔguɛ, nɛ he yemi be ɔ su ɔ, a ko ngmɛɛ e he kaa bɔ nɛ a peeɔ nyumu nyɔguɛhi. 8Ke e nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nɛ to kaa e maa ngɔ lɛ ɔ sume lɛ ɔ, lɛɛ e ha nɛ yo ɔ tsɛ nɛ fɔ lɛ ɔ ba kpɔ lɛ. E be he blɔ nɛ e juaa yo ɔ kɛ haa ma se no, ejakaa e sisi lɛ. 9Ke nyɔguɛtsɛ ɔ ngɔ lɛ ngɔ ha e binyumu ɔ, lɛɛ e hɛɛ lɛ kaa lɛ nitsɛ e biyo. 10Ke e binyumu nɛ ɔ ya ngɔ yo kpa kɛ piɛ nɔ kaketsɛ ɔ he ɔ, e ha kekle yo ɔ e tsu nya yo blɔ nya nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ pɛpɛɛpɛ; eko nɛ ko je nɔ. E he bo, e nya mi ngma, kɛ e yogbayo blɔ nya nɛ ko bɔ lɛ. 11Ke e pee we ní etɛ nɛ ɔmɛ ha lɛ ɔ, lɛɛ yo ɔ ngɛ he blɔ nɛ e jee faa nɛ hiɔ wowoe ko be mi.
Mlaahi nɛ kɔɔ awi yemi he
12 “Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa fia nɔ ko nɔ́ nɛ nɔ ɔ ma gbo ɔ, a gbe lɛ. 13 Ke e nine ya kpa ngɛ nɔ ɔ nɔ tlukaa, se pi kaa e je blɔ pee ɔ, lɛɛ ma tsɔɔ mo he nɛ e tu fo kɛ ya. 14Se ke nɔ ko mi mi fu nɛ e dɔ ya tua e nyɛmi nɛ e gbe lɛ ɔ, lɛɛ ke e tu fo ya sa we ngɛ ye bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he po, a nu lɛ nɛ a gbe lɛ.
15“Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa fia e tsɛ, aloo e nyɛ nɔ́ ɔ, a gbe lɛ.
16 “Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa ju nɔmlɔ nɛ e maa jua, loo a maa na lɛ ngɛ e dɛ ɔ, a gbe lɛ.
17 “Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa gbiɛ e tsɛ, loo e nyɛ ɔ, a gbe lɛ.
18“Ke ni enyɔ pɛ, nɛ nɔ kake fia e nyɛmi tɛ, loo kɔ, nɛ nɔ ɔ tlɔ sa mi, se e gbo we ɔ, 19nɔ nɛ fia tɛ ɔ maa ye e he. Ke nɔ ɔ na he wami nɛ e je kpo, nɛ e hɛɛ tso kɛ ngɛ nyɛɛe ɔ, nɔ nɛ fia lɛ tɛ ɔ nɛ wo nɔ ɔ be nɛ e puɛ ha lɛ ɔ kɛkɛ he hiɔ, nɛ e hyɛ nɛ e tsa lɛ kɛ pi si.
20“Ke nɔ ko ngɔ tso kɛ fia e nyɔguɛ nyumu, loo yo, nɛ e gbo ngɛ e dɛ mi ɔ, a gbla e tue. 21Se ke e gbo we amlɔ, nɛ ligbi kake, loo ligbi enyɔ be loko e gbo ɔ, a ko gbla nyɔmtsɛ ɔ tue; ejakaa nyɔguɛ ɔ gbenɔ ɔ ngɛ kaa nyɔguɛtsɛ ɔ sika nɛ laa.
22“Ke nyumuhi ngɛ kunɔ nɔe nɛ a ya fia yohɔyo ko nɔ́ nɛ e muklii ɔ sane, se nɔ́ yobu kpa ko nyɛɛ we se ɔ, a bɔ nɔ nɛ plaa lɛ ɔ hiɔ. Yo ɔ huno ɔ nɛ tsɔɔ hiɔ ɔ, konɛ kojoli ɔmɛ nɛ a buá he. 23Se ke yo ɔ plaa a, tue gblami ɔ ji a plaa nɔ nɛ plaa lɛ ɔ kɛ to nane mi. Ke e gbo, 24 loo e hɛngmɛ pɛ, loo e lungu hia, loo e nine, loo e nane plaa, 25loo e he ko sã, loo pa ba e he, loo e he ko kpɔ ɔ, a pee nɔ ɔ ja nɔuu kɛ to nane mi.
26“Ke nyumu ko fia e nyɔguɛ nyumu, loo nyɔguɛ yo hɛngmɛ nɔ́ nɛ hɛngmɛ ɔ pɛ ɔ, hɛngmɛ ɔ he je ɔ, e ngmɛɛ nyɔguɛ ɔ he nɛ e ho. 27Ke e fia e nyɔguɛ nyumu, loo nyɔguɛ yo nɔ́, nɛ e lungu hia a, lungu ɔ he je ɔ, e ngmɛɛ nyɔguɛ ɔ he nɛ e ho.
Nɔtsɛmɛ a níhi a nɔ hyɛmi
28“Ke na si nɔ ko koli, nyumu jio, yo jio, nɛ nɔ ɔ gbo ɔ, a fia na a tɛ nɛ e gbo, se a ko ye lo ɔ; natsɛ ɔ nitsɛ lɛɛ e yi fɔ. 29Se ke na a pɔɔ nihi koli simi, nɛ a tu munyu tsɔɔ natsɛ ɔ, se kɛ̃ e hyɛ we nɛ a wo na a tsu mi, nɛ e ba mi kaa e ya si nɔ ko koli nɛ e gbe nɔ ɔ, nyumu jio, yo jio, a fia na a tɛ nɛ e gbo, nɛ natsɛ ɔ hu a gbe lɛ. 30Se ke a ngmɛ natsɛ ɔ blɔ kaa e kpɔ e he ɔ, lɛɛ e sa kaa e wo hiɔ tsuaa hiɔ nɛ a maa bu ha lɛ ɔ, konɛ e kɛ he e yi wami. 31Ke na a ya gbe nɔ ko binyumu, loo biyo ɔ, a kɛ lɛ nɛ ye ngɛ kikɛmɛ a mlaa nɛ ɔ nɔuu nya. 32Ke na a ya gbe nyɔguɛ nyumu, loo nyɔguɛ yo ko ɔ, natsɛ ɔ nɛ wo nyɔguɛtsɛ ɔ hiɔ sika hiɔ yi nyingmi etɛ; na a nitsɛ lɛɛ a fia lɛ tɛ nɛ e gbo.
33“Ke nɔ ko si muɔ ngɔ fɔ si nɛ e hɛ́ nya, aloo e ya tsua muɔ nɛ e bu we nya, nɛ na, loo teji ya nɔ mi ɔ, 34nɔ nɛ tsua muɔ ɔ nɛ wo lohwetsɛ ɔ hiɔ, konɛ e ngɔ lohwe gbogboe ɔ. 35Ke nɔ ko na ku ya gbe e nyɛmi na a, natsɛmɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ nɛ a jua na hɛngmengmletsɛ ɔ, nɛ a gba sika a fiee; lohwe gbogboe ɔ hu a dla lɛ fiee. 36Se ke a ná le kaa na a pɔɔ nɔ koli simi, se natsɛ ɔ hyɛ we nɛ a wo na a tsu mi ɔ, lɛɛ nɔ nɛ e na nɛ ya si na koli ɔ nɛ ngɔ na hɛngmengmletsɛ ɔ kɛ to na gbogboe ɔ nane mi ha e nyɛmi ɔ, konɛ lohwe gbogboe ɔ nɛ pee e nɔ.

Title: MOSE II, 22
Content:
Mlaahi nɛ kɔɔ nane mi tomi he
1-4“Ke nɔ ko ya ju na nɛ e gbe, loo e jua a, a ma he lɛ na enuɔ kɛ to na kake ɔ nya; ke to ɔ, lɛɛ a ma he lɛ to eywiɛ kɛ to to kake ɔ nya. Ke a na lohwe ɔ nɛ e ju ɔ ngɛ e dɛ hɛ ngmengmle ɔ, na jio, teji jio, to jio, lohwe kake he ɔ, e wo lohwe enyɔ nya hiɔ. Ke nɔ́ ko be e dɛ ɔ, a jua lɛ kaa nyɔguɛ nɛ a kɛ wo nɔ́ nɛ e ju ɔ he hiɔ.
“Nyɔ mi ke a nu julɔ nɛ ngɛ we ko mi sɛe, nɛ a fia lɛ nɔ́ nɛ a gbe ɔ, nɔ nɛ gbe lɛ ɔ yi fɔ kaa e gbe nɔmlɔ. Se ke piani nɛ e ba mi ja a, lɛɛ nɔ nɛ gbe julɔ ɔ yeɔ fɔ kaa e gbe nɔmlɔ.
5“Ke nɔ ko ngmɛɛ e lohwe he nɛ e ya ye ní ngɛ nɔ kpa e ngmɔ nɔ, aloo e wai abɔɔ mi ɔ, lohwetsɛ ɔ maa ngɔ e ngmɔ, loo abɔɔ mi ní nɛ hi pe kulaa kɛ to nane mi.
6“Ke nɔ ko tsɔ la nɛ la a sã pú kɛ ya sɛ nɔ kpa ngmɔ mi, nɛ e sã níhi nɛ a du ɔ, kɛ ngmɔ gba a kɛ e mi níhi, kɛ ngmɔ ɔ tsuo ɔ, a maa bu ní abɔ nɛ la a puɛ ɔ nya ha nɔ nɛ tsɔ la a nɛ e wo.
7“Ke nɔ ko ha e nyɛmi sika, loo ní titli komɛ si tomi nɛ a ba ju ɔ, ke a nu julɔ ɔ, hiɔ nɛ ba a, a ku kɛ bɔ he si enyɔ nɛ e wo. 8Se ke a nɛ julɔ ɔ, lɛɛ a ngɔ nɔ nɛ a ha nɔ́ si tomi ɔ kɛ ba Mawu hɛ mi, loo kojoli ɔmɛ a hɛ mi, nɛ e ba ka kita kaa e nine tɛ e nyɛmi ɔ ní ɔmɛ a he.
9“Ke na, loo teji, loo to, loo heha ní, loo nɔ́ kpa ko laa, nɛ nihi enyɔ ngɛ he plee ɔ, a ngɔ mɛ kɛ ba Mawu hɛ mi. A ti nɔ nɛ Mawu maa bu fɔ ɔ maa wo nɔ́ nɛ a ngɛ he plee ɔ he hiɔ ngwɔhe enyɔ kɛ ha nɔtsɛ ɔ.
10“Ke nɔ ko ngɔ e teji, loo na, loo to, loo lohwe kpa ko ngɔ ha e nyɛmi si tomi, nɛ lohwe ɔ gbo, aloo a plaa lɛ, aloo nihi ba po lohwe ɔ kɛ je nɛ nɔ ko nɛ ɔ, 11nɔ nɛ a ha lɛ nɔ́ si tomi ɔ nɛ ya ka Yawɛ kita ha e nyɛmi ɔ kaa e nine tɛ lohwe ɔ he. Ke e pee ja a, kɛkɛ lɛɛ e sa nɛ lohwetsɛ ɔ nɛ kplɛɛ nɔ kaa e nyɛmi ɔ be nane mi ko nɛ e toɔ. 12Se ke jumi a ju ngɛ e dɛ ɔ, lɛɛ é to nɔtsɛ ɔ nane mi. 13Jehanɛ hu, ke nga mi lohwehi nɛ tsɔtslɔɔ e mi ɔ, e ngɔ nɔ́ nɛ piɛ ɔ kɛ ba ye odase. Ke e ba ja a, kɛkɛ lɛɛ nane mi tomi ko be nɛ e maa to ha nɔtsɛ ɔ hu.
14“Ke nɔ ko ya ba lohwe ngɛ e nyɛmi dɛ nɛ lohwe ɔ plaa, aloo e gbo, be mi nɛ nɔtsɛ ɔ be lejɛ ɔ, é to nɔtsɛ ɔ nane mi sisiisi. 15Ke nɔtsɛ ɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ jamɛ a be ɔ, lɛɛ e ko to lɛ nane mi. Ke apaa yemi lohwe ɔ, apaa hiɔwo ɔ woɔ lohwe ɔ he hiɔ.
Ní komɛ nɛ a hiɔ ɔ a he mlaahi
16 “Ke nɔ ko mlɔɔ yomiyo ko nɛ e kɛ lɛ hwɔ ɔ, e ya pee e he ní nɛ e ngɔ lɛ. 17Se ke yomiyo ɔ tsɛ kua ke e kɛ lɛ be nyumu ɔ hae ɔ, lɛɛ bitsɛ ɔ nɛ he yo he ní peemi nya sika ngɛ nyumu ɔ nɛ puɛ e biyo ɔ dɛ.
18 “Yo tsuaa yo nɛ tsuɔ kunya a, a gbe lɛ.
19 “Nɔmlɔ nɛ e kɛ lohwe ma na yo kɛ nyumu bɔmi ɔ, a gbe lɛ.
20 “Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa sã bɔ kɛ ha mawu kpa ko, se pi imi Yawɛ ɔ, a kpata e hɛ mi.
21 “Koo pee nubwɔ yayami, nɛ koo wa lɛ yi mi; ejakaa nyɛ hu nyɛ ya to nubwɔ ngɛ Egipt zugba a nɔ. 22Nyɛ ko wa yalɔyo, aloo awusa yi mi. 23Ke nyɛ wa mɛ yi mi, nɛ a fo ya kɛ tsɛ mi ɔ, niinɛ, ma bu a ya fomi ɔ tue, 24nɛ ye mi mi ma fu wawɛɛ, nɛ ma gbe nyɛ ngɛ ta mi. Nyɛ yi ɔmɛ maa pee yalɔyihi, nɛ nyɛ bimɛ ɔmɛ maa pee awusahi.
25 “Ke o pa sika ha ye ma mi bi ɔmɛ a ti ohiatsɛ ko nɛ kɛ mo ngɛ ɔ, mo ko he lɛ hekpa kaa sika palɔ peeɔ. 26 Ke nɔ ko ngɔ e bo kɛ ba to mo awaba a, kpale ya ha lɛ loko pu nɛ nɔ si, 27ejakaa lɔ ɔ pɛ ji e heha nɔ́ nɛ e kɛ maa tsi fĩɛ; mɛni hu ngɛ e dɛ nɛ e maa ha kɛ hwɔ si? Ke nyɛ pee we ja, nɛ e fo ya kɛ tsɛ mi ɔ, ma bu lɛ tue; ejakaa mɔbɔ nalɔ ji mi.
28 “Ko jɛ Mawu; nɛ koo gbiɛ o matsɛ.
29“Ngɔɔ ngma, wai, kɛ oliv nu nɛ je o ngmɔ ɔmɛ a mi ɔ kɛ ba sã bɔ ha mi ngɛ be nɛ sa mi.
“Ngɔɔ o bitɛte ɔmɛ kɛ ba ha mi. 30Ngɔɔ o na amɛ, kɛ o to ɔmɛ a kekleekle bi ku ɔmɛ hu ba ha mi. Ke a fɔ mɛ se ɔ, ha nɛ a hi a nyɛmɛ a kasa nya ligbi kpaago; ligbi nɛ ji kpaanyɔ ɔ, ngɔɔ mɛ kɛ ba sã bɔ ha mi.
31 “Ye ni klɔuklɔuhi ji nyɛ; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, lohwe ko nɛ nga mi lohwehi tsɔtslɔɔ mi ɔ, nyɛ ko ye; nyɛ sake ngɔ fɔ he ha gbehi.

Title: MOSE II, 23
Content:
Dami sane yemi kɛ nɔ́ nɛ da peemi
1 “Nɔ́ nɛ o nɛ, loo o nui ɔ, ko de. Koo piɛ dikalɔ he kɛ ye lakpa odase. 2Koo nyɛɛ nihi fuu a se kɛ pee nɔ́ yaya; nɛ koo piɛ a he kɛ ye lakpa odase kɛ plɛ dami sane hɛ mi kɛ bu si. 3 Ko dla ohiatsɛ sane he ha lɛ ngɛ kojomi he.
4 “Ke o na o he nyɛlɔ e na, loo e teji nɛ laa blɔ ɔ, mo kpaka lohwe ɔ kɛ ya ha lɛ. 5Ke o na o futsɛ teji nɛ tlɔ zugba kɛ e se mi tlomi nɛ jiɔ pe lɛ ɔ, koo be e he nɛ o je; mohu wa o futsɛ ɔ, konɛ lohwe ɔ nɛ te nɛ e da e nane nɔ ekohu.
6 “Ko plɛ ohiatsɛ sane hɛ mi ngɔ bu si ngɛ kojomi he. 7Koo po sane ngɔ fɔ nɔ nɔ, nɛ nɔ nɛ pee we nɔ́ yaya ko ɔ, koo gbe lɛ; ejakaa nɔ nɛ peeɔ yayami kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ, i kɛ e he be lɛ kee. 8Ko he nyɔ mi ní; ejakaa nyɔ mi ní hemi yuɔ tsɔli a hɛngmɛ, nɛ a plɛɔ dali a sane hɛ mi ngɔ buɔ si.
9 “Koo wa nubwɔ yi mi; nyɛ le bɔ nɛ nubwɔ si himi ngɛ ha, ejakaa nyɛ ya hi si kaa nibwɔhi ngɛ Egipt.
Jeha kpaagone ɔ kɛ ligbi kpaagone ɔ
10 “Du ní ngɛ o ngmɔ ɔ mi nɛ o kpa jeha ekpa. 11Se jeha nɛ ji kpaago ɔ lɛɛ ngmɛɛ ngmɔ ɔ he nɛ e fɔ si gu nɛ e jɔɔ e he, nɛ o ko ya kpa e nɔ ní, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ o ma a mi ohiatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a ye e nɔ ní, konɛ nɔ́ nɛ maa piɛ ɔ, pu mi lohwehi hu nɛ a ye. O wai ngmɔ ɔmɛ kɛ oliv abɔɔ ɔmɛ hu, mo tsu a mi ní jã kɛ̃.
12 “Ligbi ekpa o kɛ tsu ní ngɛ otsi mi, se ligbi nɛ ji kpaago ɔ lɛɛ mo ko tsu nɔ́ ko, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ o na amɛ, o teji ɔmɛ, o nyɔguɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ o nibwɔ ɔmɛ nɛ tsuɔ ní ha mo ɔ nɛ a jɔɔ a he.
13“Nyɛɛ bu níhi tsuo nɛ imi Yawɛ, i de nyɛ ɔ tue saminya nɛ nyɛɛ ye nɔ. Nyɛ ko fa kue ha mawu kpa komɛ, nɛ a ko nu a biɛhi tete po ngɛ nyɛ nya.
Nyami ligbi ngua etɛ
(Mose II, 34.18-26; Mose V, 16.1-17)
14“Moo ye nyami be slɔɔto etɛ ha mi ngɛ jeha mi. 15 Kekleekle nɔ́ ji Abolokplolo nyami be. Kaa bɔ nɛ i fa mo ɔ, o maa ye nyami be nɛ ɔ daa jeha ngɛ kekleekle nyɔhiɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ Abib ɔ mi; ejakaa jamɛ a be ɔ mi nɛ o je Egipt ɔ nɛ. O maa ye abolo kplolo ligbi kpaago, nɛ nɔ ko kó ba ye hɛ mi kɛ e dɛ gu.
16 “Nyami be enyɔne ɔ ji Ngmakpami nyami be. Ngɔɔ níhi nɛ o du ngɛ o ngmɔ mi ɔ kekleekle yiblii kɛ ba sã bɔ kɛ ye Ngmakpami nyami be.
“Nyami be etɛne nɛ ɔ ji Gbasisihimi nyami be. O maa ye nyami be nɛ ɔ jeha a nyagbe, benɛ o ngɛ o ngmɔ nɔ ní ɔmɛ a nya buae. 17Daa jeha a, o ma a mi nyumu ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ a ba bua si etɛ ngɛ imi Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ, ye hɛ mi.
18“Koo ngɔ masa nɔ́ ko kɛ piɛ bɔ sami muɔ ko he kɛ ba ye hɛ mi; lohwe zɔ nɛ a kɛ sã bɔ ha mi nyami be ɔ, ko ha je nɛ na yi.
19 “Daa jeha a, ngɔɔ o zugba a nɔ kekleekle yiblii kɛ ba imi Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ, ye we ɔ.
“Koo hoo apletsi bi ngɛ e nyɛ nyɔ nyu mi.
Siwohi kɛ slɔmihi
20“Hyɛ, i ngɛ bɔfo ko tsɔe kɛ nyɛɛ o hɛ mi, nɛ e bu o he ngɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ hluu kɛ yaa si he nɛ i dla ngɔ to mo ɔ. 21Moo bu lɛ, nɛ o nu e gbi, nɛ o ko tsɔ e hɛ mi atuã; ejakaa imi nɛ i tsɔ lɛ, nɛ e kɛ nyɛ tɔmi ɔmɛ be nyɛ pae. 22Se ke o bu lɛ tue kɛ pi si, nɛ o pee nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ i fa mo ke o pee ɔ, lɛɛ i kɛ o he nyɛli ɔmɛ, kɛ o futsɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsuo maa to ní. 23Ye bɔfo ɔ maa nyɛɛ o hɛ mi kɛ yaa su Amor bi, Hit bi, Periz bi, Kanaan bi, Hiv bi, kɛ Yebus bi ɔmɛ tsuo a zugba a nɔ; nɛ ma kpata a hɛ mi. 24Ko kpla si ha a mawu ɔmɛ; ko ja mɛ, nɛ a jami kusumi ní ɔmɛ hu koo pee. Se mohu, o ywia a mawu ɔmɛ, nɛ o ku a wɔ titima amɛ dukuduku kɛ pue si. 25O ma ja imi Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ, nɛ ma gbaa mo kɛ nya mi ngma, kɛ nyu, nɛ o be hiɔ nue. 26Yo ko mi be sanee, nɛ yo ko hu be yosa pee ngɛ zugba a nɔ. Ma ha o wami se maa kɛ.
27“Ma tsuaa ma nɛ o ma pã nɔ ɔ, ma ha sawale maa nu ma mi bi ɔmɛ tsuo. Ni nɛmɛ nɛ maa te si kɛ wo mo ɔ, ma ha a kpɛti maa pee basabasa; nɛ ma ha o he nyɛli ɔmɛ tsuo maa tu o nya fo. 28Ma ha nɛ adodongmatsihi maa nyɛɛ o hɛ mi, nɛ a maa fie Hiv bi, Kanaan bi, kɛ Hit bi ɔmɛ kɛ je o blɔ ɔ nɔ. 29I be mɛ fiee kɛ je zugba a nɔ ngɛ jeha kake mi, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ zugba a nɛ ko fɔ si gu, nɛ nga mi lohwehi ko ba hiɛ tsɔ ha mo. 30I ma hi mɛ fie bɔɔ bɔɔ bɔɔ kɛ je o blɔ nɔ kɛ yaa si be nɛ nyɛ he maa hiɛ, nɛ nyɛ nine maa su zugba a nɔ. 31Ma bli o huzu ɔmɛ a mi kɛ je Wo Tsu ɔ nya kɛ ya su Mediterenia wo ɔ nya; jehanɛ hu, kɛ je nga a nɔ kɛ ya pi Yufrate pa a. Ma ngɔ zugba a nɔ bi ɔmɛ kɛ wo o dɛ mi, nɛ o maa fie mɛ kɛ je o blɔ nɔ. 32O kɛ mɛ, loo a mawu ɔmɛ ko so somi ko. 33Ko ha nɛ a hi o zugba a nɔ; ke o pee ja a, a ma ha nɛ o maa pee yayami kɛ si mi; ejakaa ke o ya sɔmɔ a mawu ɔmɛ pɛ kɛkɛ lɔ ɔ plɛ pee klama nɛ a tsɔ mo.”

Title: MOSE II, 24
Content:
Somi ɔ nya sɔumi
1Yawɛ de Mose ke, “O kɛ Aaron, Nadab, Abihu, kɛ Israel ma nimeli ɔmɛ a kpɛti ni nyingmi kpaago nɛ kuɔ kɛ ba ye ngɔ. Be nɛ nyɛ ngɛ tsitsaa lokoo kɛ ma a, nyɛ kpla si nɛ nyɛ ja mi. 2Mo Mose nɔ kake pɛ lɛ o hɛ mo kɛ su ye he; ni nɛmɛ nɛ piɛ ɔ, mɛɛ lɛɛ a ko su ye he tsɔ. Ma a hu nɛ ko kuɔ yo ɔ.”
3Mose ba nɛ e ba bɔ ma a nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ de lɛ ɔ, kɛ mlaa amɛ tsuo nɛ e wo ɔ. Ma a tsuo nya sɔ nɛ a de ke, “Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ de wɔ ke waa pee ɔ, wa maa pee.” 4Mose ngma níhi tsuo nɛ Yawɛ de lɛ ɔ. E nɔ jena makɛ ɔ, e ya puɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ngɛ yo ɔ sisi, nɛ e ma titima nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ngɛ Israel wɛtso nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ a nya. 5Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e tsɔ nihewi ɔmɛ ekomɛ nɛ a kɛ nahi ya sã sami bɔ, kɛ tue mi jɔmi bɔ kɛ ha Yawɛ. 6Mose kɛ muɔ ɔ fa wo kahi a mi; nɛ fa a nɛ piɛ ɔ, e tsɛ̃ ngɔ pue bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ. 7Kɛkɛ nɛ e ngɔ somi womi ɔ, nɛ e kane kɛ ha ma a tsuo. Ma a he nɔ nɛ a de ke, “Wa maa bu Yawɛ tue; nɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ e fa wɔ ke wa pee ɔ, wa maa pee.”
8 Jehanɛ Mose ngɔ muɔ ɔ kɛ fĩa ma a nɔ, nɛ e de ke, “Somi nɛ Yawɛ kɛ nyɛ so ɔ, e nya sɔumi muɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ, kaa bɔ nɛ a ngma ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ mi ɔ.”
9Kɛkɛ nɛ Mose, Aaron, Nadab, Abihu, kɛ Israel ma nimeli nyingmi kpaago ɔmɛ kuɔ yo ɔ, 10nɛ a na Israel Mawu ɔ. Ngɛ e nane si ɔ, a na nɔ́ ko kaa kpoku nɛ e mi tɛ̃ heii kaa hiɔwe, kaa nɔ́ nɛ tɛ nɛ a tsɛɛ safiro ɔ nɛ a kɛ pee lɛ. 11Israel ma nimeli nɛ ɔmɛ na Mawu, se mohu Mawu kpataa we a hɛ mi. Nɛ a bla kɛ ye ní nɛ a nu ní.
Mose ngɛ Sinai yo ɔ nɔ
12Yawɛ de Mose ke, “Moo kuɔ yo ɔ kɛ ba ye ngɔ nɛ o ba mlɛ, nɛ ma ngɔ tɛ tɛtlɛɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ kɛ a nɔ mlaa amɛ nɛ i ngma nɛ a kɛ tsɔse ma a ngɔ ha mo.” 13Mose kɛ e tsɔlɔ Yoshua dla a he, konɛ a kuɔ Mawu yo ɔ. 14Mose de nikɔtɔma amɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ mlɛ wɔ ngɛ hiɛ ɔ kɛ yaa si wa maa kpale kɛ ba nyɛ ngɔ ekohu. Aaron kɛ Hur kɛ nyɛ maa hi hiɛ ɔ; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke nɔ ko ngɛ sane ko ɔ, e ya na mɛ.”
15Kɛkɛ nɛ Mose kuɔ yo ɔ, nɛ bɔku ko ba ha yo ɔ nɔ. 16-18 Yawɛ hɛ mi nyami ɔ kple Sinai yo ɔ nɔ, nɛ bɔku ɔ ha yo ɔ nɔ ligbi ekpa. Ligbi nɛ ji kpaago ɔ, Yawɛ tsɛ Mose kɛ je bɔku ɔ mi. Benɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ na Yawɛ hɛ mi nyami ɔ, e pee mɛ kaa la nɛ ngɛ tsoe ngɛ yo ɔ yi mi. Mose hi lejɛ ɔ nyɔ kɛ pia nyɔ kɛ pia ligbi nyingmi eywiɛ.

Title: MOSE II, 25
Content:
Níhi a nya buami kɛ ha he klɔuklɔu ɔ
(Mose II, 35.4-9)
1Yawɛ de Mose ke, 2“De Israel bi ɔmɛ ke a ba ke mi ní. Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ e tsui ma gbo nɔ kaa e maa ke nɔ́ ko ɔ, nyɛ he. 3Nike ní ɔmɛ nɛ a pee sika tsu, sika hiɔ kɛ akɔblee; 4kpa bluu, kpa tsu, kpa nɛ hɛɛ alamua tu su, kpa hiɔ kpakpa nɛ a tslɔ, apletsi he bwɔmi, 5agbosu he womi nɛ a wo lɛ kɔbɛi, lohwe he womi nɛ a je blɔ pee, tso nɛ a tsɛɛ ke akasia, 6nu nɛ a kɛ woɔ kane mi, tsopa nɛ a kɛ peeɔ nɔ pɔmi nu kɛ tsopa kɛ e he via, 7tɛ nɛ a tsɛɛ shoham, kɛ tɛhi nɛ a he jua wa nɛ a kɛ maa wo tade nɛ a tsɛɛ efɔd ɔ kɛ gugue tade ɔ a he. 8Ha nɛ a ma he klɔuklɔu ko ha mi, konɛ ma hi a kpɛti. 9A pee sihi he nɛ ɔ kɛ e mi dlami ní ɔmɛ ngɛ henɔhi a nya pɛpɛɛpɛ kaa bɔ nɛ ma tsɔɔ mo ɔ.
Somi daka a
(Mose II, 37.1-9)
10“Ha nɛ a ngɔ akasia tso kɛ kpɛ daka mimi pɔtɛɛ ko nɛ e kami ji nine mi blimi enuɔ, e blimi ji nine mi blimi etɛ, nɛ e mi kuɔmi ji nine mi blimi etɛ. 11Ngɔɔ sika tsu ngmingmiingmi kɛ ha daka a mi, kɛ e he tsuo, nɛ o kɛ sika tsu ɔ eko nɛ wo zã kɛ bɔle e he ɔ kulaa. 12Moo pee sika tsu ga eywiɛ, nɛ o ka kɛ wo daka a nane eywiɛ ɔmɛ a he; ga enyɔ nɛ hi kasa hiɛ, nɛ enyɔ hu nɛ hi kasa hiɛ. 13Moo hlɔ akasia tsohi nɛ o ngɔ sika tsu kɛ ha a he. 14Ngɔɔ tso ɔmɛ kɛ hɔ ga amɛ a mi ngɛ daka a he, nɛ́ a pɛtɛ a he kɛ hɛɛ daka a. 15Tso ɔmɛ nɛ a hi ga amɛ a mi daa; a ko je mɛ ngɛ a mi. 16Somi womi ɔ nɛ ma ngɔ ha mo ɔ, ngɔɔ kɛ wo daka a mi.
17 “Ngɔɔ sika tsu ngmingmiingmi kɛ pee daka a nya nɔ́ nɛ e kami ji nine mi blimi enuɔ, nɛ e mi blimi ji nine mi blimi etɛ. 18Ngɔɔ sika tsu nɛ a si nɔ tɛtlɛɛ kɛ pee bɔfohi nɛ a tsɛɛ kerub ɔ enyɔ kɛ ma nya nɔ́ ɔ nɔ ngɛ daka a kami mi hiɛ kɛ hiɛ. 19Kerub kake nɛ hi hiɛ, nɛ kake hu nɛ hi hiɛ. Moo pee kerub enyɔ ɔmɛ nɛ a kɛ daka a nya nɔ́ ɔ nɛ tsa. 20Kerub ɔmɛ nɛ a gbɛ a pɛlihi a mi kɛ ya hiɔwe nɛ a kɛ ha daka a nya nɔ́ ɔ he. A plɛ a hɛ mi ngɔ kpee a sibi, nɛ a hi nya nɔ́ ɔ nɔ hyɛe. 21Ngɔɔ somi womi ɔ nɛ ma ha mo ɔ kɛ wo daka a mi, nɛ o ngɔ nya nɔ́ ɔ ngɔ bu nya. 22Lejɛ ɔ ji he nɛ i kɛ mo maa kpe ngɛ; nɛ mlaahi tsuo nɛ ma wo Israel ma a kɛ gu o nɔ ɔ, ma da kerub enyɔ ɔmɛ a kpɛ kɛ de mo.
Okplɔɔ ɔ nɛ Mawu we abolo klɛdɛɛ ɔ maa ma nɔ ɔ
(Mose II, 37.10-16)
23“Ngɔɔ akasia tso nɛ o kɛ kpɛ okplɔɔ; e kami nɛ pee nine mi blimi eywiɛ, e blimi nɛ pee nine mi blimi enyɔ, nɛ e si temi nɛ pee nine mi blimi etɛ. 24Ngɔɔ sika tsu ngmingmiingmi kɛ ha he, nɛ o ngɔ sika tsu ɔ eko kɛ wo e nya amɛ kɛ kpe. 25Moo pee kla maa pee dɛ mi blimi kake kɛ wo okplɔɔ ɔ he kɛ kpe. Ngɔɔ sika tsu kɛ wo zã dɛɛ kɛ bɔle kla a. 26Moo pee sika tsu ga eywiɛ ngɔ mɛtɛ okplɔɔ ɔ nane eywiɛ ɔmɛ a he ngɛ kɔ nya eywiɛ ɔmɛ. 27Ga amɛ nɛ a maa ngɔ tso ɔmɛ nɛ a kɛ maa hɛɛ okplɔɔ ɔ ngɔ hɔ a mi ɔ, a hi tso kla a kasa nya tutuutu. 28Moo hlɔ akasia tsohi nɛ a kɛ maa hɛɛ okplɔɔ ɔ, nɛ o ngɔ sika tsu kɛ ha a he. 29Ngɔɔ sika tsu ngmingmiingmi kɛ pee plɛɛtehi kɛ kahi nɛ a kɛ maa sã tsopa kɛ e he via, kɛ kpluhi, kɛ likɔkɔhi nɛ a kɛ maa sã wai bɔ. 30 Nɛ o ngɔ abolo klɛdɛɛ ɔ nɛ a kɛ maa ma ye hɛ mi daa a kɛ ma okplɔɔ ɔ nɔ.
Kane tso ɔ
(Mose II, 37.17-24)
31“Ngɔɔ sika tsu ngmingmiingmi kɛ pee kane tso. Kane tso ɔ sisi je kɛ e kpɛti tso ɔ lɛɛ ngɔɔ sika tsu nɛ a si nɔ tɛtlɛɛ kɛ pee. Moo pee mɔmɔhi: ní nɛmɛ nɛ blɛkee we lolo, kɛ ní nɛmɛ nɛ blɛke, nɛ a kɛ kane tso ɔ nɛ tsa mluguduu kake. 32Kɔni ekpa nɛ hi kane tso ɔ he; etɛ ngɛ kasa hiɛ, kɛ etɛ hu ngɛ kasa hiɛ. 33Kane tso ɔ he kɔni ekpa amɛ ɔ, mɔmɔ etɛ kɛ a yi pɛɛ nɛ hi eko tsuaa eko nɔ. 34Kpɛti kane tso ɔ lɛɛ mɔmɔ eywiɛ kɛ a yi pɛɛ nɛ hi nɔ. 35Kane tso tso gblaa etɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, mɔmɔ kpɔ nɛ hi kɔni enyɔɔnyɔ ɔmɛ a kpe he ɔmɛ a sisi tutuutu. 36Kpɔ ɔmɛ, tso gblaa amɛ, kɛ kpɛti kane tso ɔ tsuo nɛ tsa; a ngɔ sika tsu ngmingmiingmi nɛ a si nɔ tɛtlɛɛ kɛ pee lɛ tsuo. 37Jehanɛ, moo pee kane kpaago kɛ ma kane tso ɔ nɔ, konɛ a la a nɛ kpɛ kɛ ya hlami. 38Kane ɔ sumi kɛ e gbemi nɔ́ ɔ, kɛ nɔ́ nɛ a kɛ maa muɔ la zu ɔ hu a ngɔ sika tsu ngmingmiingmi kɛ pee. 39A ngɔ sika tsu ngmingmiingmi nɛ e jiimi peeɔ kilo nyingmi etɛ kɛ enuɔ kɛ pee kane tso ɔ kɛ e he ní ɔmɛ tsuo. 40 Hyɛ nɛ o pee mɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ kaa henɔhi nɛ i ngɛ mo tsɔɔe ngɛ yo ɔ nɔ ɔ.

Title: MOSE II, 26
Content:
Yawɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ
(Mose II, 36.8-38)
1“Jehanɛ, kpe he bo tsu ɔ, ngɔɔ bo popoe nyɔngma kɛ pee; a ngɔ kpa bluu, kpa tsu, kɛ kpa nɛ hɛɛ alamua tu su kɛ lo bo nɛ ɔ, nɛ a kadi kerub saminyawiiwi kɛ wo mi. 2Bo ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ a sɔ fiee; bo kake kami nɛ pee nine mi blimi nyingmi enuɔ kɛ ekpa, nɛ e blimi nɛ pee nine mi blimi kpaanyɔ. 3Moo kpɛ bo ɔ enuɔ kɛ tsa a sibi a nya, nɛ o kpɛ enuɔ kpa amɛ hu ja nɔuu. 4Bo enuɔ ɔmɛ nɛ a tsa a; ngɔɔ kpa bluu kɛ pee gahi kɛ wo a nyagbe nɔ́ enyɔ ɔmɛ a ti kake he; bo kaketsɛ ɔ hu o pee lɛ ja nɔuu. 5Bo ga nyingmi enuɔ nɛ hi bo kake nɛ ɔ nya, nɛ nyingmi enuɔ nɛ hi bo kaketsɛ ɔ hu nya; ga amɛ tsuo nɛ a nyɛɛ a sibi a hanɔ. 6Moo pee sika tsu gbowe nyingmi enuɔ, nɛ o kɛ gbowe ɔmɛ nɛ hɔɔ ga amɛ a mi, konɛ bo ɔ tsuo nɛ pee bo tsu mluku kake.
7“Jehanɛ, ngɔɔ apletsi he bwɔmi kɛ lo bo nyɔngma kɛ kake, nɛ o kɛ lɛ tsuo nɛ pee heha nɔ́ ha kpe he bo tsu ɔ. 8Bo ɔ kake kami nɛ pee nine mi blimi nyingmi ekpa; e blimi nɛ pee nine mi blimi kpaanyɔ. Bo nyɔngma kɛ kake ɔmɛ ɔ, eko tsuaa eko kɛ e nyɛmi nɛ sɔ fiee. 9Moo kpɛ bo ɔ enuɔ kɛ tsa a sibi a nya, nɛ o kpɛ ekpa nɛ piɛ ɔ hu kɛ tsa a sibi a nya. Bo ekpane ɔ nɛ maa ha bo tsu ɔ nya a lɛɛ dɔɔ mi enyɔ. 10Bo enuɔ ɔmɛ nɛ a tsa a, moo pee ga nyingmi enuɔ kɛ wo nyagbe nɔ́ enyɔ ɔmɛ a ti kake he; ekpane ɔ hu o pee lɛ ja nɔuu. 11Moo pee akɔblee gbowe nyingmi enuɔ, nɛ o ngɔ mɛ kɛ la ga amɛ a mi, konɛ bo enyɔ ɔmɛ nɛ a pee heha nɔ́ kake. 12Kpe he bo tsu ɔ he hami bo fa a nɛ piɛ ngɛ se ɔ, ha nɛ e kpla si ngɛ bo tsu ɔ se je. 13Jehanɛ, kpe he bo tsu ɔ he bo ɔ nine mi blimi enyɔ nɛ piɛ ngɛ e kami mi kasa kake nɛ ɔ, kɛ nine mi blimi enyɔ hu nɛ piɛ ngɛ kasa kpa a, e kpla si ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ nya hiɛ kɛ hiɛ nɛ e kɛ ha tsu ɔ nya.
14“Jehanɛ, o maa kpɛ bo kpa enyɔ kɛ ha kpe he bo tsu ɔ he; ngɔɔ agbosu he womi nɛ a wo lɛ kɔbɛi kɛ pee kekleekle nɔ́ ɔ, nɛ o ngɔ apletsi he womi nɛ a je blɔ pee kɛ pee enyɔne ɔ.
15“Ngɔɔ akasia tso kɛ pee sima tso ha kpe he bo tsu ɔ. 16Sima tso kake kami nɛ pee nine mi blimi nyingmi enyɔ, e blimi hu nɛ pee nine mi blimi etɛ. 17Bɔ nɛ o maa pee kpe he bo tsu ɔ he sima tso ɔmɛ tsuo ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: a pee nane enyɔ kɛ wo sima tso tsuaa sima tso he, konɛ a nyɛ nɛ a kɛ sima tso ɔmɛ nɛ tsa a sibi a nya. 18Moo ma sima tso nyingmi enyɔ ngɛ leneyi je, 19nɛ o pee sika hiɔ nɔ dami nɔ́ nyingmi eywiɛ kɛ wo sima tso nyingmi enyɔ ɔmɛ a sisi; nɔ dami nɔ enyɔ nɛ hi sima tso tsuaa sima tso sisi kɛ ha nane enyɔ ɔmɛ. 20Kpe he bo tsu ɔ we omleyi je ɔ, sima tso nyingmi enyɔ nɛ hi lejɛ ɔ, 21kɛ mɛ hu a sika hiɔ nɔ dami nɔ́ nyingmi eywiɛ; nɔ dami nɔ́ enyɔ ngɛ sima tso tsuaa sima tso sisi. 22Kpe he bo tsu ɔ se ngɛ bonyoku je ɔ, sima tso ekpa nɛ hi lejɛ ɔ, 23konɛ o ma sima tso kpa enyɔ ha kpe he bo tsu ɔ kɔ nya amɛ nɛ ngɛ se je ɔ. 24Kɔ nya sima tso nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, a tsa mɛ ngɛ yi kpɛti ɔ ngɛ kekleekle ga a he; sisi ɔ lɛɛ a ko ngɔ kɛ tsa. A pee kɔ nya sima tso ɔmɛ tsuo kikɛ nɛ ɔ. 25Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, o maa pee sima tso kpaanyɔ kɛ sika hiɔ nɔ dami nɔ́ nyɔngma kɛ ekpa: sika hiɔ nɔ dami nɔ́ enyɔ maa hi sima tso tsuaa sima tso sisi.
26“Ngɔɔ akasia tso kɛ pee mani womi tso nyɔngma kɛ enuɔ ha kpe he bo tsu ɔ: enuɔ ha sima tso ɔmɛ ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ kasa hiɛ, 27enuɔ ha sima tso ɔmɛ ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ kasa hiɛ, kɛ enuɔ hu ha sima tso ɔmɛ ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ se, ngɛ bonyoku je. 28Mani ɔ nɛ nyɛɛ sima tso ɔmɛ a kpɛti ɔ lɛɛ e fɔ si kɛ je kpe he bo tsu ɔ kasa kake kɛ ya si kasa kake. 29Ngɔɔ sika tsu kɛ ha sima tso ɔmɛ a he, nɛ o pee sika tsu gahi kɛ wo a he, konɛ a kɛ mani ɔmɛ nɛ hɔɔ a mi. Mani ɔmɛ nitsɛ hu, ngɔɔ sika tsu kɛ ha a he. 30O pee kpe he bo tsu nɛ ɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ kaa henɔ nɛ i tsɔɔ mo ngɛ yo ɔ nɔ ɔ.
31“Tsu mi pomi bo ɔ, moo gbɔ kpa bluu, kpa tsu, kɛ kpa nɛ hɛɛ alamua tu su, nɛ a kɛ lo, nɛ á je blɔ nɛ a kadi kerub saminyawiiwi kɛ wo mi. 32Ngɔɔ kɛ kpla akasia tso eywiɛ a he; tso nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, ngɔɔ sika tsu kɛ ha a he, nɛ a kɛ sika tsu gbowe nɛ kɔ a nya loko a ngɔ mɛ kɛ ma sika hiɔ nɔ dami nɔ́ eywiɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ. 33 Ngɔɔ tsu mi pomi bo ɔ kɛ bɛ gbowe ɔmɛ a nya kɛ kpla si, nɛ o ngɔ daka a nɛ somi womi ɔ ngɛ mi ɔ kɛ ba ma e se blɔ, konɛ tsu mi pomi bo ɔ nɛ po he klɔuklɔu ɔ, kɛ he klɔuklɔu pe kulaa a kpɛti ha nyɛ. 34Daka a nɛ somi womi ɔ ngɛ mi ɔ, ngɔɔ e nya nɔ́ ɔ kɛ bu daka a nya ngɛ he klɔuklɔu pe kulaa a. 35Ngɔɔ okplɔɔ ɔ kɛ ma tsu mi pomi bo ɔ hɛ mi ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ we omleyi je, konɛ kane tso ɔ lɛɛ e ya je leneyi je, ngɛ okplɔɔ ɔ hanɔ tutuutu.
36“Kpe he bo tsu ɔ sinya a nya bo ɔ, ngɔɔ kpa bluu, kpa tsu, kɛ kpa nɛ hɛɛ alamua tu su kɛ lo; nɛ a kɛ abui nɛ kadi ní kɛ wo mi. 37Ngɔɔ akasia tso enuɔ nɛ a kɛ sika tsu ha a he, kɛ a nya sika tsu gbowehi, nɛ o kɛ pee titimahi ha tsu nya bo ɔ. Jehanɛ hu, moo sɔ̃ akɔblee nɔ dami nɔ́ enuɔ ha tso ɔmɛ.

Title: MOSE II, 27
Content:
Bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ
(Mose II, 38.1-7)
1“Ngɔɔ akasia tso kɛ pee bɔ sami la tɛ. E hi kɔ nya eywiɛ; e kami nɛ pee nine mi blimi nyɔngma, e blimi nine mi blimi nyɔngma, kɛ e si temi nine mi blimi ekpa. 2Moo pee kolihi ngɛ e kɔ nya eywiɛ ɔmɛ, nɛ a kɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɛ tsa. A ngɔ akɔblee kɛ ha he. 3Moo pee e he ngɛyuhi nɛ a kɛ muɔ la zu, sofihi, kahi, gbowehi, kɛ la jemi ngɛyuhi. Ngɔɔ akɔblee kɛ pee ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo. 4Jehanɛ, ngɔɔ akɔblee nɛ o kɛ lo ya kɛ wo bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he. Moo pee akɔblee ga eywiɛ kɛ wo ya a kɔ nya eywiɛ ɔmɛ. 5Ngɔɔ ya a kɛ bɔle bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ ngɛ e sisi je, konɛ e hiɔwe yami nɛ ya ta bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ kpɛti tutuutu. 6Moo hlɔ akasia tso komɛ nɛ o kɛ akɔblee nɛ ha a he. 7Á kɛ tso ɔmɛ nɛ hɔɔ ga amɛ a mi ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ kasa enyɔ ɔmɛ hiɛ kɛ hiɛ nɛ a kɛ hɛɛ lɛ. 8Ngɔɔ gbegbeli kɛ kpɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ; nɛ o ha blɔ nɛ hi mi kaa bɔ nɛ i tsɔɔ mo ngɛ yo ɔ nɔ ɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Kpe he bo tsu ɔ he piɛ ɔ
(Mose II, 38.9-20)
9“Jehanɛ moo po piɛ kɛ wo kpe he bo tsu ɔ he. Bo nɛ a kɛ kpa hiɔ kpakpa nɛ a tslɔ lo nɛ hi piɛ ɔ leneyi je; e kami nɛ pee nine mi blimi lafa enyɔ. 10Akɔblee titima nyingmi enyɔ, kɛ nɔ dami nɔ́ nyingmi enyɔ nɛ hi piɛ ɔ he; se e he gbowe ɔmɛ, kɛ mani ɔmɛ lɛɛ a kɛ sika hiɔ nɛ pee mɛ. 11Ja nɔuu bo ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ piɛ ɔ we omleyi je ɔ, a kami nɛ pee nine mi blimi lafa enyɔ. Mɛ hu a hi akɔblee titima nyingmi enyɔ, kɛ a nɔ dami nɔ́ nyingmi enyɔ; nɛ a he gbowe ɔmɛ, kɛ mani ɔmɛ hu a kɛ sika hiɔ nɛ pee mɛ. 12Bo ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ piɛ ɔ bonyoku je ɔ, a blimi nɛ pee nine mi blimi lafa, kɛ a he titima nyɔngma, kɛ nɔ dami nɔ́ nyɔngma. 13Ja nɔuu piɛ ɔ he nɛ kpee beleku je ɔ, e blimi nɛ pee nine mi blimi lafa. 14Tsu nya bohi nɛ kplaa si ngɛ agbo ɔ nya kasa kake ɔ, a kami nɛ pee nine mi blimi nyingmi etɛ, kɛ a he titima etɛ, kɛ nɔ dami nɔ́ etɛ. 15Kasa kake ɔ hu tsu nya bohi nɛ hi lejɛ ɔ. Mɛ hu a kami nɛ pee nine mi blimi nyingmi etɛ ɔ kɛ̃, kɛ a he titima etɛ, kɛ nɔ dami nɔ́ etɛ. 16Piɛ ɔ nya nitsɛ nya bo ɔ lɛɛ e kami nɛ pee nine mi blimi nyingmi eywiɛ. Á ngɔ kpa bluu, kpa tsu, kɛ kpa nɛ hɛɛ alamua tu su kɛ lo; nɛ a kɛ abui nɛ kadi ní saminyayoo ngɔ wo mi. Titima eywiɛ, kɛ nɔ dami nɔ́ eywiɛ nɛ hi he. 17Titima amɛ tsuo nɛ bɔle piɛ ɔ kɛ kpe ɔ, a pee akɔblee nɔ dami nɔ́ kɛ ha mɛ. Jehanɛ, a kɛ sika hiɔ nɛ pee a mani womi tso ɔmɛ, nɛ a pee sika hiɔ gbowehi kɛ wo a he. 18Piɛ ɔ kami nɛ pee nine mi blimi lafa enyɔ, e blimi nine mi blimi lafa, kɛ e si temi nine mi blimi nyɔngma. Bo ɔmɛ nɛ a pee bo kpakpahi; nɔ dami ní ɔmɛ hu a kɛ akɔblee nɛ pee. 19Ní ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ a kɛ ma sɔmɔ ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ mi, kpe he bo tsu ɔ he plɛɛko ɔmɛ, kɛ piɛ ɔ hu he plɛɛko ɔmɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ ɔ, a ngɔ akɔblee kɛ pee.
Kane ɔ nɔ hyɛmi
(Mose III, 24.1-4)
20“Fa Israel bi ɔmɛ nɛ a ba ha mo oliv nu kpakpa nɛ mi tsɔ ngleinglei nɛ o kɛ wo kane ɔ mi, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ a su kane ɔ daa. 21Aaron kɛ kane ɔ nɛ ma kpe he bo tsu ɔ mi, ngɛ tsu mi pomi bo ɔ nɛ haa somi daka a hɛ mi ɔ hɛ mi. Aaron kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ nɛ a hyɛ kane ɔ nɔ ngɛ ye hɛ mi daa kɛ je gbɔkuɛ kɛ yaa si mɔtu. Enɛ ɔ maa pee mlaa nɛ fɔɔ si kɛ yaa neneene kɛ ha Israel bi ɔmɛ, kɛ a nina tsuo.

Title: MOSE II, 28
Content:
Osɔfo ɔmɛ a tadehi
(Mose II, 39.1-7)
1“Moo tsɔ ya ngɔ o nyɛminyumu Aaron kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ nɛ ji Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, kɛ Itamar kɛ ba. Mo ha nɛ a tsɔ a he kɛ je Israel bi kpa amɛ a he, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ a ba sɔmɔ mi kaa osɔfohi. 2Moo kpɛ osɔfo tadehi ha o nyɛminyumu Aaron nɛ sa lɛ saminyayoo, nɛ bu nɛ ba e he. 3Mo tsɛ nihi tsuo nɛ i kɛ ga ní tsumi he juɛmi dloo mɛ ɔ, nɛ o ha a kpɛ Aaron tade ɔmɛ kɛ pee lɛ klɔuklɔu, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ e ye osɔfo kɛ sɔmɔ mi. 4Tadehi nɛ á kpɛ ɔ ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ: gugue tade, efɔd, tade klɔii, hiɔwe tade nɛ a lo, pɛɛ, kɛ mi mi fimi nɔ́. Á kpɛ tade klɔuklɔu nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ ha o nyɛminyumu Aaron, kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ, konɛ a sɔmɔ mi kaa osɔfohi. 5Níhi nɛ a maa ngɔ kɛ kpɛ tade ɔmɛ ji sika tsu kpa, kpa bluu, kpa tsu, kpa nɛ hɛɛ alamua tu su, kɛ kpa hiɔ kpakpa nɛ a tslɔ.
6“Efɔd ɔ lɛɛ níhi nɛ a maa ngɔ kɛ pee lɛ ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ: sika tsu kpa, kpa bluu, kpa tsu, kpa nɛ hɛɛ alamua tu su, kɛ kpa kpakpa nɛ a tslɔ, nɛ a kadi ní wo mi. 7A pee konɔ kpa enyɔ kɛ wo he, nɛ́ a nyɛ kɛ muɔ lɛ ngɛ hɛ mi kɛ se tsuo. 8Mi mi fimi nɔ́ ɔ hu, a je blɔ nɛ a lo lɛ kɛ tsa efɔd ɔ, kɛ jamɛ a ga a, kɛ jamɛ a ní ɔmɛ nɔuu nɛ ji sika tsu kpa, kpa bluu, kpa tsu, kpa nɛ hɛɛ alamua tu su, kɛ kpa hiɔ kpakpa nɛ a tslɔ ɔ. 9Yaa hla shoham tɛ enyɔ, nɛ o ngma Yakob binyumu ɔmɛ a biɛhi ngɛ a nɔ 10ngɛ a fɔmi nya; biɛ ekpa ngɛ tɛ kake nɔ, kɛ ekpa nɛ piɛ ɔ hu ngɛ tɛ kpa nɔ. 11Mo kpɛ́ Yakob bimɛ ɔmɛ a biɛhi ngɛ tɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ june he ní tsulɔ peeɔ ɔ, nɛ o sile sika tsu kɛ bɔle tɛ ɔmɛ kɛ kpe. 12Jehanɛ, moo fi tɛ ɔmɛ kɛ wo efɔd ɔ konɔ kpa amɛ a he, konɛ a pee tɛhi nɛ a kɛ ma kai Yakob binyumu ɔmɛ; Aaron ma kpla biɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ e konɔ enyɔ ɔmɛ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ imi Yawɛ, ma kai ye ma a daa. 13Moo pee sika tsu he bɔlemi nɔ́ enyɔ, 14kɛ sika tsu ngmingmiingmi kɔsɔkɔsɔ enyɔ nɛ a tslɔ mɛ kaa kpa. Ngɔɔ kɔsɔkɔsɔ kpa amɛ kɛ la he bɔlemi ní ɔmɛ a mi.
Gugue tade ɔ
(Mose II, 39.8-21)
15“Gugue tade ɔ nɛ a kɛ leɔ ye yi mi ɔ, moo pee lɛ ngɛ ga mi; bɔ nɛ o pee efɔd ɔ, ja nɔuu o pee lɛ. Níhi nɛ ó ngɔ kɛ pee enɛ ɔ hu ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ: sika tsu kpa, kpa bluu, kpa tsu, kpa nɛ hɛɛ alamua tu su, kɛ kpa kpakpa nɛ a tslɔ. 16A dɔ gugue tade ɔ mi enyɔ, nɛ a pee lɛ kɔ nya eywiɛ; e kami nɛ pee nine mi blimi kake, nɛ e blimi hu nɛ pee nine mi blimi kake. 17Moo ma tɛhi nɛ a he jua wa kɛ wo zã eywiɛ mi; zã tsuaa zã a, tɛ etɛ nɛ hi mi. Kekleekle zã a mi tɛ ɔmɛ ji sardio, topasion, kɛ smaragdo. 18Zã nɛ ji enyɔ ɔ mi ní ɔmɛ ji karfungkle, safiro, kɛ sardoniki. 19Zã etɛne ɔ mi ní ɔmɛ ji hiakinto, agate, kɛ ametisto. 20Zã eywiɛne ɔ mi ní ɔmɛ ji krisolito, shoham, kɛ yaspi. A sile sika tsu kɛ bɔle tɛ ɔmɛ. 21Tɛ ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ a pee nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ; nɛ Yakob binyumu ɔmɛ a biɛhi nɛ hi a nɔ kakaaka. Wɛtso nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ ɔ, a kpɛ́ eko tsuaa eko biɛ ngɛ tɛ kake nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ a ngmaa ní ngɛ nguɛ ga nɔ ɔ. 22Ngɔɔ sika tsu ngmingmiingmi kɛ pee kɔsɔkɔsɔ nɛ a tslɔ kaa kpa kɛ wo gugue tade ɔ he. 23Moo pee sika tsu ga enyɔ kɛ wo gugue tade ɔ hiɔwe kɔ nya enyɔ ɔmɛ a he, 24konɛ o ngɔ sika tsu kɔsɔkɔsɔ enyɔ ɔmɛ kɛ hɔɔ sika tsu ga enyɔ ɔmɛ a mi. 25Kɔsɔkɔsɔ enyɔ ɔmɛ nɛ a tslɔ kaa kpa a, mɛ hu a nya enyɔ ɔmɛ nɛ piɛ ɔ, ngɔɔ kɛ la nɔ́ mi hɔmi nɔ́ enyɔ ɔmɛ a mi, nɛ o fi kɛ wo efɔd ɔ konɔ kpa amɛ a he ngɛ hɛ mi. 26Moo pee sika tsu ga enyɔ kɛ wo gugue tade ɔ kɔ nya enyɔ ɔmɛ a mi mi je ngɛ efɔd ɔ kasa nya. 27Jehanɛ, moo pee sika tsu ga kpa enyɔ kɛ wo efɔd ɔ kɔni enyɔ kpa amɛ a nya ngɛ sisi blɔ, kɛ yaa e hɛ mi ngɛ tsami he kake ɔ hanɔ, ngɛ efɔd mi mi fimi nɔ́ ɔ nɛ a lo saminyayoo ɔ yi mi. 28Ngɔɔ kpa bluu kɛ fi gugue tade ɔ he ga amɛ kɛ wo efɔd ɔ he ga amɛ a he ngɛ mi mi fimi nɔ́ ɔ hiɔwe je, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ gugue tade ɔ nɛ ko kpɔ kɛ je efɔd ɔ he.
29“Be tsuaa be nɛ Aaron ma ya sɛ he klɔuklɔu ɔ, e hɛɛ Yakob bimɛ ɔmɛ a biɛhi ngɛ kojomi gugue tade ɔ mi ngɛ e tsui nya; konɛ imi Yawɛ, ma kɛ kai ye ma a daa. 30 Ngɔɔ ní ɔmɛ nɛ a kɛ leɔ ye yi mi, nɛ a tsɛɛ Urim kɛ Tumim ɔ kɛ wo gugue tade ɔ mi, nɛ Aaron nɛ hɛɛ mɛ ngɛ e gugue nya be tsuaa be nɛ e ma ye hɛ mi. Kɛkɛ ɔ, daa be tsuaa be ke Aaron ma he klɔuklɔu ɔ, níhi nɛ ma gu nɔ kɛ je ye yi mi tomi kpo kɛ tsɔɔ Israel bi ɔmɛ ɔ, e hɛɛ mɛ momo ngɛ e gugue nya.
Osɔfo ɔmɛ a tade kpahi
(Mose II, 39.22-31)
31“Tade klɔii ɔ nɛ a woɔ ngɛ efɔd ɔ sisi ɔ, a lo lɛ kɛ kpa bluu sɔuu. 32A je kuɛ mi puɔ ngɛ he, nɛ a fia nya nɛ e ti kɛ kpe, konɛ e ko hía. 33-34A ngɔ kpa bluu, kpa tsu, kɛ kpa nɛ hɛɛ alamua tu su kɛ lo ní kloohi kaa tso yiblii nɛ a ma kɛ wo tade ɔ nya fiami ɔ mi, konɛ sika tsu ngmlɛhi nɛ hɔɔ tso yiblii ɔmɛ a mi kɛ kpe. Ke sika tsu ngmlɛ kake ba, kɛkɛ nɔ́ kokloo kaa tso yiblii ɔ hu kake ba, ja sɔuu kɛ bɔle tade klɔii ɔ nya fiami ɔ mi. 35Ke Aaron ngɛ sɔmɔe ɔ, e wo tade nɛ ɔ, konɛ a nu ngmlɛ ɔmɛ a pɛmi be mi nɛ e ngɛ he klɔuklɔu ɔ sɛe kɛ ba ye hɛ mi, kɛ be mi nɛ e ngɛ lejɛ ɔ sie konɛ e ko gbo.
36“Jehanɛ, ngɔɔ sika tsu ngmingmiingmi kɛ pee dade pɛtɛpɛtɛ, nɛ o ngma ngɛ nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ june he ní tsulɔ ngmaa ní ngɛ nguɛ ga nɔ ɔ ke, ‘Klɔuklɔu ha Yawɛ.’ 37Ngɔɔ kpa bluu kɛ fi lɛ kɛ wo pɛɛ ɔ hɛ mi. 38E hi Aaron hɛ nya daa, kɛkɛ ɔ, ke Israel bi ɔmɛ ngɔ a nike ní klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ kɛ ba ha mi, nɛ tɔmi ko ba ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ peemi mi po ɔ, imi Yawɛ, i be nike ní ɔmɛ kuae, se mohu ma ngɔ.
39“Hiɔwe tade ɔ, a ngɔ kpa hiɔ kpakpa kɛ lo, nɛ a kadi ní kɛ wo mi. Pɛɛ ɔ hu ngɔɔ kpa hiɔ kpakpa a nɔuu kɛ kpɛ, konɛ a lo ní kɛ wo mi mi fimi nɔ́ ɔ mi.
40“Jehanɛ, Aaron bimɛ ɔmɛ hu o kpɛ hiɔwe tadehi, kɛ mi mi fimi níhi, kɛ pɛɛhi ha mɛ nɛ e sa mɛ, nɛ bu nɛ hi a he. 41Ngɔɔ tade nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ wo o nyɛminyumu Aaron kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ, nɛ o pɔ mɛ nu, nɛ o wo mɛ osɔfo, nɛ o tsukɔ a he, konɛ a sɔmɔ mi kaa osɔfohi. 42Ngɔɔ bo nɛ a ngɔ kpa hiɔ kpakpa kɛ lo kɛ kpɛ fiɔ mi tade ha mɛ, nɛ a wo kɛ ha a he kɛ je a mlɛ mi kɛ yaa si a fiɔ mi. 43Aaron kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ nɛ a wo fiɔ mi tade nɛ ɔmɛ be tsuaa be nɛ a ma kpe he bo tsu ɔ mi ɔ, aloo ke a ma sɔmɔmi ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he ngɛ he klɔuklɔu ɔ. Ke pi ja a, musu maa tloo mɛ nɛ a ma gbo. Enɛ ɔ nɛ pee mlaa nɛ fɔɔ si kɛ yaa neneene kɛ ha Aaron kɛ e weku kɛ nina.

Title: MOSE II, 29
Content:
Aaron kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ a we osɔfo womi
(Mose III, 8.1-36)
1“Enɛ ɔ ji nɔ nɛ ó pee nɛ o kɛ tsukɔ Aaron kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ a he nɛ a sɔmɔ mi kaa ye we osɔfohi. Ngɔɔ na niheyo kake, kɛ agbosu enyɔ nɛ kpa be a he. 2Ngɔɔ ngma mamu nɛ masa be mi kɛ pee nɔ́ etɛ nɛ ɔmɛ: abolo kplolo nɛ zɔ ngɛ mi, abolo kplolo nɛ a wui mi zɔ, kɛ akpɔɔnɔɔ nɛ a kɛ nu kpa hɛ mi, 3nɛ o ngɔ mɛ kɛ wo kusii mi nɛ o hɛɛ kɛ ba, kɛ na a, kɛ agbosu enyɔ ɔmɛ.
4“Ngɔɔ Aaron kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ kɛ ba kpe he bo tsu ɔ sinya a nya, nɛ o ngɔ nyu kɛ du a he ha mɛ. 5Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, wo tade ɔmɛ ha Aaron; hiɔwe tade ɔ, tade klɔii ɔ nɛ ngɛ efɔd ɔ nɔ ɔ, efɔd ɔ nitsɛ, kɛ gugue tade ɔmɛ, konɛ o ngɔ efɔd ɔ mlɛ mi fimi nɔ́ ɔ nɛ a je blɔ lo lɛ saminyayoo ɔ kɛ fi e mlɛ mi. 6Jehanɛ ɔ, bu lɛ pɛɛ ɔ, nɛ o fi jlasi klɔuklɔu kɛ wo pɛɛ ɔ he. 7Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, plɛ nu nɛ a kɛ pɔɔ nɔ ɔ kɛ pue e yi mi, nɛ o kɛ pɔ lɛ nu.
8“Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, ngɔɔ e binyumu ɔmɛ kɛ ba nɛ o ba wo mɛ hiɔwe tadehi. 9Fi mlɛ mi fimi níhi kɛ wo a mlɛ mi, nɛ o bu mɛ pɛɛ. Bɔ nɛ o maa wo Aaron kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ osɔfo ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. Kɛkɛ ɔ, osɔfo ní tsumi ɔ maa pee a nɔ́; nɛ enɛ ɔ maa pee mlaa nɛ fɔɔ si kɛ yaa neneene.
Osɔfo womi bɔ samihi
10“Ngɔɔ na ku ɔ kɛ ba kpe he bo tsu ɔ hɛ mi, konɛ Aaron kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ nɛ a ngɔ a nine kɛ pue e yi mi. 11Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, moo gbe na ku ɔ ngɛ imi Yawɛ, ye hɛ mi, ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ sinya a nya. 12Ngɔɔ na muɔ ɔ eko nɛ o ngɔ o nine nguɛ kɛ sɔ mi nɛ o kɛ kpa bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ koli ɔmɛ a he. Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, mo plɛ muɔ ɔ nɛ piɛ ɔ tsuo kɛ pue bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ sisi. 13Jehanɛ, mo je zɔ nɛ ha mi ní ɔmɛ a he ɔ, ko ɔ, se tso mi ngmɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ, kɛ zɔ nɛ bɔle mɛ ɔ; nɛ o sã enɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ. 14Se na lo ɔ, e he womi ɔ, kɛ e mi ní ɔmɛ lɛɛ o sã ngɛ sito he ɔ se; ejakaa bɔ nɛ a sãã kɛ jeɔ osɔfo ɔmɛ a he yayami ji lɔ ɔ nɛ.
15“Jehanɛ, yaa nu agbosu ɔ kake, nɛ Aaron kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ nɛ a ngɔ a nine kɛ pue e yi mi. 16Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, moo gbe to ɔ, nɛ o tsɛ̃ e muɔ ɔ kɛ pue bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ kɔ nya eywiɛ ɔmɛ tsuo. 17Moo po to ɔ mi kpɔ nya kpɔ nya, nɛ o fɔ e mi ní ɔmɛ, kɛ e se nane ɔmɛ a he, nɛ o kɛ pue e yi ɔ, kɛ lo kpɔ nya kpɔ nya amɛ a nɔ. 18 Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, moo sã to ɔ tsuo ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ. E ji sami bɔ nɛ jee via saminya, nɛ sa imi Yawɛ, ye hɛ mi.
19“Jehanɛ, yaa nu agbosu kaketsɛ ɔ hulɔ, nɛ Aaron kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ nɛ a ngɔ a nine kɛ pue e yi mi. 20Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, moo gbe to ɔ, nɛ o ngɔ e muɔ ɔ eko kɛ kpa Aaron kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ a hiɔ nɔ tue nya lo ɔmɛ, a hiɔ nine gɔleku ɔmɛ, kɛ a hiɔ nane gɔleku ɔmɛ a he. Muɔ nɛ piɛ ɔ lɛɛ mo kpa kɛ pue bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ kɔ nya eywiɛ ɔmɛ tsuo. 21Ngɔɔ muɔ nɛ ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ eko, kɛ nu nɛ a kɛ pɔɔ nɔ ɔ hu eko, nɛ o fĩa kɛ pue Aaron kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ, kɛ a tade ɔmɛ a nɔ. Enɛ ɔ maa pee Aaron kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ, kɛ a tade ɔmɛ tsuo klɔuklɔu ha mi.
22“Akɛnɛ osɔfo womi bɔ sami to ji agbosu ɔ he je ɔ, mo je e he zɔ ɔ, e hlemi nɛ wo zɔ ɔ, kɛ zɔ nɛ ha e mi ní ɔmɛ a he ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ ha e ko ɔ he ɔ, se tso mi ngmɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ kɛ a he zɔ ɔ, kɛ e hiɔ fiɔ ɔ. 23Yaa ngɔ abolo mamɛ kake nɛ a futu mi nu, abolo mamɛ kake nɛ a futuu we mi nu, kɛ akpɔɔnɔɔ kake ngɛ kusii ɔ nɛ a kɛ abolo klɛdɛɛ ɔ woɔ mi kɛ maa si ngɛ imi Yawɛ, ye hɛ mi daa a mi. 24Ngɔɔ ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ngɔ wo Aaron kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ a dɛ, nɛ a fɔ ngɛ hiɔwe kɛ ya kɛ ba ngɛ ye hɛ mi kɛ tsɔɔ kaa a tsukɔ a he kɛ ha imi Yawɛ. 25Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, hé ní ɔmɛ ngɛ a dɛ, nɛ o sã ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ kɛ piɛ sami bɔ ɔ he. E ji sami bɔ nɛ jee via, nɛ sa imi Yawɛ, ye hɛ mi.
26“Jehanɛ, agbosu ɔ nɛ a kɛ sã bɔ kɛ wo Aaron osɔfo ɔ, o je e gugue, nɛ o fɔ ngɛ hiɔwe kɛ ya kɛ ba ngɛ imi Yawɛ, ye hɛ mi kɛ tsɔɔ kaa a tsukɔ he kɛ ha mi. Lohwe ɔ gugue ɔ maa pee mo hu o blɔ nya nɔ́.
27“Ke a wo nɔ ko osɔfo ɔ, agbosu nɛ a kɛ tsu ní ɔ, a tsukɔ e gugue ɔ, kɛ e fiɔ ɔ he kaa nike ní klɛdɛɛ ha mi, nɛ a kɛ ha osɔfo ɔmɛ kaa a blɔ nya ní. 28Ní nɛ ɔmɛ maa pee Aaron kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ a blɔ nya ní; ejakaa e ji mlaa nɛ fɔɔ si kɛ yaa neneene kaa ke Israel bi ɔmɛ ba sã bɔ ɔ, lohwe ɔ gugue, kɛ e fiɔ ɔ nɛ pee osɔfo ɔmɛ a nɔ́. Enɛ ɔ ji nike ní nɛ ma a kɛ ba ke Yawɛ.
29“Ke Aaron gbo ɔ, a pɔ e binyumu ɔmɛ nu nɛ a wo mɛ osɔfo, nɛ a ngɔ e tade klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ ngɔ ha mɛ nɛ a wo. 30Aaron binyumu nɛ maa ye osɔfo ngɛ e tsɛ se, nɔ nɛ maa sɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ mi nɛ e ya sɔmɔ ngɛ he klɔuklɔu ɔ, e wo tade ɔmɛ ligbi kpaago.
31“Osɔfo womi bɔ sami agbosu ɔ, moo hoo lo ɔ ngɛ he ko nɛ ngɛ klɔuklɔu. 32Aaron kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ nɛ a ye lo ɔ, kɛ niye ní ɔ nɛ ngɛ kusii ɔ mi ɔ ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ sinya a nya a. 33Mɛ pɛ lɛ á ye osɔfo womi kusumi kpatami ní nɛ ɔ; nɔ ko nɛ pi osɔfo ji lɛ ɔ, e ko ye eko, ejakaa e ji ní klɔuklɔu. 34Ke osɔfo womi bɔ sami lo ɔ, aloo abolo ɔ eko piɛ nɛ je na yi ɔ, sãã; a ko ye ejakaa e ji nɔ́ klɔuklɔu.
35“Aaron kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ a osɔfo womi kusumi ɔ, moo pee lɛ ligbi kpaago kaa bɔ nɛ i fa mo ɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ. 36Daa ligbi ɔ, o maa ngɔ na ku kake kɛ sã bɔ kɛ ha yayami pami. Enɛ ɔ maa tsukɔ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he, nɛ́ e pee klɔuklɔu. 37Moo pee enɛ ɔ daa ligbi kɛ yaa su ligbi nɛ ji kpaago ɔ. Kɛkɛ ɔ, bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ maa pee klɔuklɔu, nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ, aloo nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ he maa sa he ɔ hɛ mi ma kpata.
Daa ligbi bɔ sami
(Mose IV, 28.1-8)
38“Jehanɛ ɔ, daa ligbi ɔ, o maa ngɔ jijɔ enyɔ nɛ ye jeha kakaaka kɛ sã bɔ ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ. 39Ngɔɔ jijɔ kake kɛ sã bɔ mɔtu, nɛ o kɛ kake hu nɛ sã bɔ gbɔkuɛ. 40Ngɔɔ ngma mamu tsimi kake nɛ o kɛ nu nɛ a si tɔ kake futu mi ɔ kɛ piɛ kekleekle jijɔ ɔ he nɛ o kɛ sã bɔ ɔ, konɛ o ngɔ wai tɔ kake kɛ sã wai bɔ. 41Gbɔkuɛ ɔ, ngɔɔ jijɔ enyɔne ɔ kɛ sã bɔ, konɛ o ngɔ mamu kɛ wai nɛ a kɛ maa sã wai bɔ ɔ hu kɛ piɛ he kaa mɔtu nɔ́ ɔ kɛ̃. E ji sami bɔ nɛ jee via saminya nɛ sa imi Yawɛ, ye hɛ mi. 42Kikɛmɛ a sami bɔ nɛ ɔ nɛ pee bɔ ko nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ nina maa sã daa ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ sinya a nya, ngɛ imi Yawɛ, ye hɛ mi. Lejɛ ɔ i kɛ nyɛ maa kpe ngɛ, nɛ lejɛ ɔ i kɛ nyɛ maa tu munyu ngɛ. 43Lejɛ ɔ ji he nɛ i kɛ Israel ma a maa kpe ngɛ, nɛ ye hɛ mi nyami kpɛmi maa pee lejɛ ɔ klɔuklɔu. 44Ma tsukɔ kpe he bo tsu ɔ, kɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he. Aaron kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ hu ma tsukɔ a he, konɛ a sɔmɔ mi kaa osɔfohi. 45Ma hi Israel bi ɔmɛ a kpɛti, nɛ ma pee a Mawu. 46A ma na maa le kaa imi ji Yawɛ, a Mawu ɔ, nɔ nɛ je mɛ kɛ je Egipt zugba a nɔ ɔ, konɛ ma hi a kpɛti. Imi ji Yawɛ, a Mawu ɔ nɛ.

Title: MOSE II, 30
Content:
Tsopa kɛ e he via sami la tɛ ɔ
(Mose II, 37.25-28)
1“Ngɔɔ akasia tso kɛ pee bɔ sami la tɛ, nɛ a sã tsopa kɛ e he via ngɛ nɔ. 2A pee la tɛ ɔ nɛ e hi kɔ nya eywiɛ; e kami nɛ pee nine mi blimi enyɔ, e blimi hu nine mi blimi enyɔ, kɛ e si temi nine mi blimi eywiɛ. E kɛ e koli ɔmɛ ngɛ kɔ nya eywiɛ ɔmɛ nɛ tsa. 3Ngɔɔ sika tsu ngmingmiingmi kɛ ha e he tsuo: e yi mi, e kasa nya amɛ, kɛ e koli ɔmɛ, nɛ o kɛ sika tsu ɔ kɛ̃ nɛ wo zã dɛɛ kɛ bɔle lɛ kɛ kpe. 4Moo pee sika tsu ga enyɔ kɛ wo he ngɛ sika tsu zã a sisi. Tsohi nɛ a kɛ maa hɛɛ la tɛ ɔ, a kɛ hɔɔ ga nɛ ɔmɛ a mi. Ga enyɔ nɛ hi kasa hiɛ, nɛ enyɔ hu nɛ hi kasa hiɛ ngɛ a sibi a hanɔ. 5Ngɔɔ akasia tso kɛ hlɔ tso nɛ ɔmɛ, konɛ o ngɔ sika tsu kɛ ha a he. 6Ngɔɔ bɔ sami la tɛ nɛ ɔ kɛ ma tsu mi pomi bo ɔ se ngɛ daka a nɛ somi womi ɔ ngɛ mi ɔ hɛ mi. Lejɛ ɔ ji he nɛ i kɛ nyɛ maa kpe ngɛ. 7Daa mɔtu ke Aaron ma kane ɔmɛ a he ní tsumi ɔ, e sã tsopa kɛ e he via ngɛ nɔ. 8Daa gbɔkuɛ hu ke e ma kane ɔmɛ sumi ɔ, e pee ja nɔuu. A sã tsopa kɛ e he via nɛ ɔ daa ngɛ imi Yawɛ, ye hɛ mi. A pee nɔ́ nɛ ɔ yi nɔ tsuaa yi nɔ. 9Nyɛ ko sã tsopa kɛ e he via kpa ko, aloo sami bɔ, aloo niye ní bɔ ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ nɛ ɔ nɔ; nyɛ ko sã wai bɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ hulɔ. 10Daa jeha a, Aaron nɛ pee kusumi kɛ tsukɔ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he. Lohwe ɔ nɛ a kɛ ba sã yayami pami bɔ ɔ, e ngɔ e muɔ ɔ ngɔ pue bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ koli eywiɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ. A pee nɔ́ nɛ ɔ daa jeha, yi nɔ tsuaa yi nɔ. Bɔ sami la tɛ nɛ ɔ maa pee klɔuklɔu nitsɛnitsɛ kɛ ha imi Yawɛ.”
Kpe he bo tsu ɔ he tó tsumi
11Yawɛ de Mose ke, 12“Ke o kane Israel bi ɔmɛ nɛ o na a hiɛmi ɔ, a ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ maa ngɔ nɔ́ nɛ e kɛ ma kpɔ e klaa kɛ ba ha mi, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ gbenɔ hiɔ kó ba sɛ a kpɛti be mi nɛ a ngɛ ni ɔmɛ kanee. 13 Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ a maa kane lɛ ɔ, e maa wo hiɔ nɛ ɔ kaa bɔ nɛ a po fɔ si ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ mi. Nɔ tsuaa nɔ maa wo hiɔ nɛ ɔ kaa nike ní ko nɛ e ngɔ kɛ ba ha imi Yawɛ. 14Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ye kɛ je jeha nyingmi enyɔ kɛ yaa a, ke a kane lɛ pɛ e ngɔ nike ní nɛ ɔ ba ha mi. 15Ke nyɛ ngɔ nyɛ klaa kpɔmi hiɔwo nike ní nɛ ɔ kɛ ma imi Yawɛ, ye hɛ mi ɔ, ohiatsɛ kɛ niatsɛ tsuo nɛ a wo kaa bɔ nɛ a po fɔ si ɔ; ohiatsɛ nɛ ko ha fa, nɛ niatsɛ hu nɛ ko ha kɛ be nɔ. 16Mo he sika nɛ ɔ ngɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ a dɛ, nɛ o kɛ wo kpe he bo tsu ɔ sɔmɔmi kpɛɛ ɔ mi. Tó nɛ ɔ maa pee nɔ́ nɛ a kɛ ma kpɔ a klaa, konɛ imi Yawɛ, ma kai nɛ ma bu a he.”
Akɔblee kã a
17Yawɛ de Mose ke, 18 “Moo pee akɔblee kã kɛ e sisi akɔblee kla. Ngɔɔ kɛ ma kpe he bo tsu ɔ kɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ a kpɛti, nɛ o yɛ nyu kɛ wo mi. 19-21Ke Aaron kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ maa sɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ mi ɔ, a ngɔ nyu ɔ kɛ fɔ a dɛ kɛ a nane he, konɛ a ko gbo. Ja nɔuu a fɔ a dɛ kɛ a nane he loko a ya bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he nɛ a ya sã bɔ ha imi Yawɛ bɔ nɛ pee nɛ a ko gbo. Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ maa pee mlaa nɛ fɔɔ si kɛ ha Aaron kɛ e nina kɛ yaa neneene.”
Nɔ pɔmi nu ɔ
22 Yawɛ de Mose ekohu ke, 23“Yaa nɛ o ya hla tsopa kɛ e he via kpakpa nɛ ɔmɛ: mire nyu kilo ekpa, sinamon nɛ jeɔ via ja hiɛmi fa, nɛ ji kilo etɛ, kalamo nɛ jeɔ via kilo etɛ, 24kasia kilo ekpa, kaa bɔ nɛ a ngmɛɛ ní ngɛ kpe he ɔ, kɛ oliv nu lita eywiɛ. 25Ngɔɔ tsopa nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ pee nɔ pɔmi nu klɔuklɔu, nɛ e hi kaa nɔ́ nɛ tsopa kɛ e he via he ní tsulɔ nitsɛ pee. E maa pee nɔ pɔmi nu klɔuklɔu. 26Ngɔɔ nu nɛ ɔ kɛ pɔ kpe he bo tsu ɔ, daka a nɛ somi womi ɔ ngɛ mi ɔ, 27okplɔɔ ɔ kɛ e he ní ɔmɛ tsuo, kane tso ɔ kɛ e he ní ɔmɛ, la tɛ ɔ nɛ a sãã tsopa kɛ e he via ngɛ nɔ ɔ, 28la tɛ ɔ nɛ a sãã sami bɔ ngɛ nɔ ɔ kɛ e he ní ɔmɛ tsuo, kɛ nyu kã a kɛ e sisi kla a. 29Moo tsukɔ ní nɛ ɔmɛ a he, kɛkɛ ɔ, a maa pee klɔuklɔu nitsɛnitsɛ; nɔ tsuaa nɔ, aloo nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ he maa sa a he ɔ hu maa pee klɔuklɔu. 30Jehanɛ moo pɔ Aaron kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ nu, nɛ o tsukɔ a he, konɛ a sɔmɔ mi kaa osɔfohi. 31Mo de Israel bi ɔmɛ ke, ‘Enɛ ɔ maa pee ye nɔ pɔmi nu klɔuklɔu nɛ a kɛ ma tsu kusumi ní yi nɔ tsuaa yi nɔ. 32A ko ngɔ kɛ pɔ nɔ saisaa, nɛ a ko pee nu ɔ ekpa ko nɛ ngɛ kaa jã kɛ̃. E ji nɔ klɔuklɔu, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ ha nɛ e hi klɔuklɔu. 33Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa pee nu ɔ eko nɛ ngɛ kaa lɔ ɔ, aloo nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa ngɔ nu nɛ ɔ eko kɛ pɔ nɔ ko nɛ pi osɔfo ji lɛ ɔ, á je lɛ we, nɛ a ko bu lɛ ngɔ si ye ma mi bi ɔmɛ a nɔ hu.’ ”
Tsopa kɛ e he via a
34Yawɛ de Mose ke, “Moo ngmɛ tsopa kɛ e he via nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a jiimi nɛ pee fiee: stakte, onitsa, galbanum, kɛ mimɛ ngmingmiingmi. 35Ngɔɔ ní nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ pee tsopa kɛ e he via kpakpa. E hi kaa nɔ́ nɛ tsopa kɛ e he via he ní tsulɔ nitsɛ pee, nɛ o ngɔ ngo kɛ wo mi, konɛ e mi nɛ tsɔ, nɛ e pee klɔuklɔu. 36Moo wɛɛ eko nɛ e pee bukɔbukɔ kaa mamu, nɛ o ngɔ eko kɛ ya ma daka a nɛ somi womi ɔ ngɛ mi ɔ hɛ mi ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ mi he nɛ i kɛ nyɛ maa kpe ngɛ ɔ. Nyɛɛ hɛɛ tsopa kɛ e he via nɛ ɔ kaa nɔ́ ko klɔuklɔu nitsɛnitsɛ. 37Tsopa kɛ e he via nɛ nyɛ maa pee nɛ ɔ, nyɛ ko hyɛ bɔ nɛ a futu ní ɔmɛ nɛ nyɛ kɛ pee eko ha nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ he. Nyɛɛ ngɔ lɛ kaa e ji nɔ́ klɔuklɔu nitsɛnitsɛ kɛ ha imi Yawɛ. 38Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa pee nu nɛ ɔ eko nɛ e ma kpa a, a je lɛ we, nɛ a ko bu lɛ ngɔ si ye ma mi bi ɔmɛ a nɔ hu.”

Title: MOSE II, 31
Content:
Ga ní tsuli ɔmɛ
(Mose II, 35.30—36.1)
1Yawɛ de Mose ke, 2“Hyɛ, i je blɔ hla Uri binyumu Bezalel, Hur bibi ɔ kɛ je Yuda wɛtso ɔ mi, 3nɛ i ngɔ mumi mi nike ní babauu ngɔ ha lɛ. I dloo lɛ ga ní tsumi he juɛmi, kɛ nile ha ga ní tsumi slɔɔtohi tsuo, 4bɔ nɛ e nyɛɔ nɛ e ngɔɔ sika tsu, sika hiɔ, kɛ akɔblee kɛ peeɔ ga níhi; 5nɛ e nine nya da kɛ tɛhi nɛ a he jua wa a he ní tsumi, tso hlɔmi, kɛ ga ní tsumi slɔɔtohi tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ a tsumi. 6Nɛ hyɛ, i hla Ahisamak bi Oholiab kɛ je Dan wɛtso ɔ mi, konɛ e piɛ e he kɛ tsu ní ɔ. Jehanɛ, gali kpa amɛ hu i dloo mɛ ga ní tsumi he juɛmi klɛdɛɛ, konɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ i fa mo ke o pee ɔ, a nyɛ nɛ a pee: 7kpe he bo tsu ɔ, daka a nɛ a kɛ somi womi ɔ maa wo mi ɔ kɛ e nya nɔ́ ɔ, bo tsu ɔ he ní ɔmɛ tsuo, 8okplɔɔ ɔ kɛ e he ní ɔmɛ, kane tso ɔ nɛ a kɛ sika tsu ngmingmiingmi pee ɔ kɛ e he ní ɔmɛ tsuo, tsopa kɛ e he via sami la tɛ ɔ, 9bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ kɛ e he ní ɔmɛ tsuo, nyu kã a kɛ e sisi kla a, 10osɔfo tade saminyawiiwi ɔmɛ nɛ Aaron kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ maa wo be mi nɛ a ngɛ osɔfo ní tsumi tsue ɔ, 11nɔ pɔmi nu ɔ, kɛ tsopa kɛ e he via kɛ ha he klɔuklɔu ɔ. A pee nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ pɛpɛɛpɛ kaa bɔ nɛ i fa mo ɔ.”
Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ he mlaahi
12Yawɛ kɛ Mose tu munyu ekohu, 13nɛ e fa lɛ nɛ e de Israel bi ɔmɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ ye ye Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ; ejakaa Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ ji neneene somi nɛ ngɛ i kɛ nyɛ wa kpɛti ɔ he okadi, konɛ nyɛ na nɛ nyɛɛ le kaa imi Yawɛ, lɛ i hla nyɛ kɛ pee ye ma. 14Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ ye Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ, ejakaa e ji ligbi klɔuklɔu. Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ma ble Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ, a gbe lɛ; nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ma tsu ní Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ, a je jamɛ a nɔ ɔ we, nɛ a ko bu lɛ ngɔ si ye ma mi bi ɔmɛ a nɔ hu. 15 Ligbi ekpa a kɛ tsu ní; se ligbi nɛ ji kpaago ɔ lɛɛ e ji imi Yawɛ, ye Hejɔɔmi ligbi nɛ ngɛ klɔuklɔu. Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ma tsu ní ngɛ Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ nɔ ɔ, a gbe lɛ. 16Enɛ ɔ he ɔ, Israel bi ɔmɛ nɛ a ye Hejɔɔmi ligbi nɛ ɔ kɛ a nina tsuo kaa somi ɔ he okadi. 17 E ji okadi ngɛ i kɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ wa kpɛti kɛ yaa neneene; ejakaa imi Yawɛ, i ngɔ ligbi ekpa kɛ pee hiɔwe kɛ zugba, nɛ ligbi nɛ ji kpaago ɔ, i kpa ní tsumi, nɛ i jɔɔ ye he.”
18Benɛ Mawu kɛ Mose tu munyu gbe nya ngɛ Sinai yo ɔ nɔ ɔ, Mawu ngɔ tɛ tɛtlɛɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ nɛ lɛ nitsɛ e ngma mlaa amɛ ngɛ nɔ ɔ kɛ ha Mose.

Title: MOSE II, 32
Content:
Sika tsu na bi ɔ
(Mose V, 9.6-29)
1 Benɛ ma a na kaa Mose se ya fia si ngɛ yo ɔ nɔ, nɛ e kple we si kɛ bɛ ɔ, ma a bua a he nya kɛ ba na Aaron, nɛ a ba de lɛ ke, “Kikɛmɛ a Mose nɛ ɔ nɛ je wɔ kɛ je Egipt zugba a nɔ ɔ, wa li sane nɛ ya ba e nɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, moo pee mawu ha wɔ nɛ e nyɛɛ wa hɛ mi.”
2Aaron de mɛ ke, “Nyɛ je sika tsu tue nya ní ɔmɛ ngɛ nyɛ yi ɔmɛ, kɛ nyɛ binyumu ɔmɛ, kɛ nyɛ biyi ɔmɛ a tue mi kɛ ba ha mi.” 3Kɛkɛ nɛ ma a tsuo je sika tsu tue nya ní ɔmɛ ngɛ a tue mi, nɛ a ngɔ kɛ ba ha Aaron. 4 E he tue nya ní ɔmɛ ngɛ a dɛ nɛ e sile, nɛ e plɛ sika tsu nyu ɔ kɛ wo tso nɛ a kpɛ́ mi, nɛ e kɛ pee sika tsu na bi. Kɛkɛ nɛ ma a de ke, “Israel, o mawu ɔ nɛ je mo kɛ je Egipt zugba a nɔ ɔ, lɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ!”
5Benɛ Aaron na nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, e puɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ngɛ sika tsu na bi ɔ hɛ mi, nɛ e fiɛ ke, “Hwɔɔ ɔ, a maa ye nyami ligbi ha Yawɛ.” 6 E nɔ jena makɛ mla a, ma a te si nɛ a sã sami bɔhi, nɛ a kɛ tue mi jɔmi bɔhi hu ba. Ma a pue si, nɛ a ye ní, nɛ a nu ní; nɛ lɔ ɔ se ɔ, a fiɛ yo kɛ nyumu yakayaka fiɛmihi.
7Yawɛ de Mose ke, “Mo kple si esɔesɔ; ejakaa o ma nɛ ji ni ɔmɛ nɛ o kpaka kɛ je Egipt zugba a nɔ kɛ ba a, a ble a he. 8Blɔ nɛ i fa mɛ ke a nyɛɛ nɔ ɔ, a gba kɛ je nɔ momo; a puɛ na bi amaga nɛ a ja lɛ, nɛ a sã bɔ ha lɛ nɛ a de ke, ‘Israel, o mawu ɔ nɛ je mo kɛ je Egipt zugba a nɔ ɔ, lɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ!’ ” 9Yawɛ ya nɔ nɛ e de Mose ke, “I kpa si nɛ i na kaa ma nɛ ɔ ji nimli komɛ nɛ a kuɛ wa saminya! 10Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, moo hɛ mo kɛ ya se; i kɛ mɛ maa to ní nɛ ma kpata a hɛ mi; se moo lɛɛ ma ha o kɛ o weku kɛ nina maa bɔ kɛ pee ma kpetekpleenyɛ.”
11 Se Mose kpa Yawɛ, e Mawu ɔ pɛɛ, nɛ e de ke, “Yawɛ, mɛni he je o mi mi fu o ma a nɛ o kɛ he wami kpetekpleenyɛ, kɛ kɔni si wami kpaka mɛ kɛ je Egipt zugba a nɔ ɔ? 12Mɛni he je nɛ o ma ha nɛ Egipt bi ɔmɛ ma de ke, ‘E to yi mi yaya kaa e ma kpata e ma a hɛ mi ngɛ yo ɔmɛ a nɔ; lɔ ɔ he je nɛ e ya je mɛ kɛ je Egipt ɔ nɛ.’ Ha nɛ o mi mi fumi ɔ nya nɛ ba si, nɛ o kpale o nya se ngɛ yayami nɛ jinɛ o to kaa o maa pee o ma a he. 13 Mo kai o tsɔli Abraham, Isak, kɛ Yakob. Mo kai mo nitsɛ o kita nɛ o ka ke, ‘Ma ha nɛ nyɛ nina maa hiɛ babauu kaa hiɔwe dodoehi, nɛ ma ngɔ zugba nɛ ɔ tsuo nɛ i wo nyɛ e he si ɔ kɛ ha mɛ, nɛ e maa pee a nɔ kɛ ya neneene ɔ.’ ” 14Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ kpale e nya se, nɛ yayami nɛ jinɛ e to kaa e maa ba ma a nɔ ɔ bɛ a nɔ hu.
15Kɛkɛ nɛ Mose plɛ e he nɛ e kple si kɛ je yo ɔ nɔ kɛ ma, nɛ e hɛɛ tɛ tɛtlɛɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ nɛ a ngma mlaa amɛ ngɔ fɔ a nɔ ɔ ngɛ e dɛ mi; a ngma mlaa amɛ ngɛ hɛ mi kɛ se tsuo. 16Mawu nitsɛ nɛ kpɛ́ tɛ tɛtlɛɛ ɔmɛ; nɛ mlaa amɛ nɛ a ngma ngɛ a nɔ ɔ hu, Mawu nitsɛ nɛ ngma.
17Benɛ ma a hwɔ lele nɛ Yoshua nu he ɔ, e de Mose ke, “Moo bu tue! A ngɛ ta hwue ngɛ ma a sito he ɔ.”
18Se Mose he nɔ nɛ e de ke, “Dɛbi, pi ni nɛmɛ nɛ ye manye ngɛ ta mi a lele hwɔmi, nɛ pohu pi ni nɛmɛ nɛ a ye a nɔ a bubuubui, kɛ ngmlaa ji nɛ ɔ; se mohu lali a gbi i ngɛ nue nɛ ɔ nɛ.”
19Benɛ Mose miɔ nɛ e maa su ma a sito he ɔ, nɛ́ e na na bi ɔ, kɛ ni ɔmɛ nɛ a ngɛ doe ɔ, e mi mi fu; nɛ e kɛ tɛ tɛtlɛɛ ɔmɛ nɛ e hɛɛ ngɛ e dɛ mi ɔ fia si ngɛ yo ɔ sisi, nɛ e ywia mɛ. 20E wo na bi ɔ nɛ a pee ɔ, nɛ e mɛ he la, nɛ e sile. Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e wɛɛ lɛ nɛ e pee mamu bukɔbukɔ, nɛ e ngɔ fĩa nyu hɛ mi, nɛ e ngɔ ha Israel bi ɔmɛ nɛ a nu. 21Mose bi Aaron ke, “Mɛni ma nɛ ɔ pee mo loko o ha nɛ a pee yayami agbo kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ?”
22Aaron he nɔ ke, “Ye nyɔmtsɛ, o mi mi nɛ ko fu mi. Mo nitsɛ o le nimli nɛ ɔmɛ kaa nɔ́ yaya peemi he a nyaa. 23Mɛ nitsɛmɛ nɛ a ba de mi ke, ‘Moo pee mawu ha wɔ nɛ e nyɛɛ wa hɛ mi; ejakaa kikɛmɛ a Mose nɛ ɔ nɛ je wɔ kɛ je Egipt zugba a nɔ ɔ, wa li nɔ́ nɛ ya ba e nɔ.’ 24I de mɛ ke, ‘Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ngɛ sika tsu ɔ, e ngɔ kɛ ba.’ A ngɔ kɛ ba, nɛ i sake kɛ fɔ la mi, nɛ nɔ́ nɛ je mi kɛ ba ji kikɛmɛ a na bi nɛ ɔ nɛ!”
25Benɛ Mose na kaa Aaron nine kpi ma a he, nɛ ma a ngɛ basabasa pee kɛ ngɛ a hɛ mi si puee ngɛ a he nyɛli ɔmɛ a hɛ mi ɔ, 26e ho nɛ e ya da si ngɛ ma a sito he ɔ agbo ɔ nya, nɛ e de ke, “Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ngɛ Yawɛ se ɔ, nɔ ɔ nɛ ba ye ngɔ!” Kɛkɛ nɛ Levi bi ɔmɛ tsuo bua a he nya ngɛ he kake, nɛ a bu kɛ ba e ngɔ. 27Nɛ e de mɛ ke, “Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ de ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: ‘Nyɛ ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ mia kɛ klaate, nɛ nyɛɛ kpa ma a sito he ɔ tsuo kɛ ya kɛ ba; kɛ je agbo kake nya kɛ yaa si agbo kpa nya, nɛ nyɛɛ gbe nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ nyɛ maa na; nyɛmi jio, huɛ jio, nɔ lele jio!’ ” 28Levi bi ɔmɛ pee kaa bɔ nɛ Mose fa mɛ ɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ; nɛ jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, a gbe nimli maa pee akpe etɛ. 29Mose de mɛ ke, “Mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ, nyɛ je nyɛ he ngɔ to kaa Yawɛ sɔmɔli, ejakaa nyɛ ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ gbe lɛ nitsɛ e binyumu, kɛ lɛ nitsɛ e nyɛminyumu. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yawɛ hu maa gbaa nyɛ.”
He piami
30E nɔ jena a, Mose de ma a ke, “Nyɛ pee yayami agbo. Se kɛ̃, ma kuɔ yo ɔ kɛ ya Yawɛ ngɔ, kaa alini e maa nu ye gbi, nɛ e maa ngɔ nyɛ he yayami ɔ ngɔ pa nyɛ lo.” 31Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Mose kpale e se kɛ ho Yawɛ ngɔ ya nɛ e ya de lɛ ke, “Anɔkuale, ma nɛ ɔ pee yayami agbo kaa a ngɔ sika tsu kɛ pee mawu kɛ ha a he. 32 Ke e maa hi ɔ, moo ngɔ a he yayami ɔ ngɔ pa mɛ. Se ke o kɛ a he yayami ɔ be mɛ pae ɔ, lɛɛ i kpa mo pɛɛ nɛ o gbe ye biɛ ngɛ womi ɔ nɛ o ngmaa o ni ɔmɛ a biɛ ngɛ mi ɔ mi mɔ.”
33Yawɛ he nɔ ke, “Nihi nɛ pee yayami kɛ si mi ɔ, mɛ pɛ a biɛ ma gbe ngɛ ye womi ɔ mi ɔ nɛ. 34Moo lɛɛ yaa nɛ o ya kpaka ye ma a kɛ ya he nɛ i de mo ɔ. Ye bɔfo ɔ maa nyɛɛ o hɛ mi. Se be ma nɛ ma wo ma a hiɔ ngɛ a he yayami ɔ he.”
35Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yawɛ kɛ gbenɔ hiɔ gbla ma a tue; ejakaa a nyɛ Aaron nɔ nɛ e pee sika tsu na bi ha mɛ.

Title: MOSE II, 33
Content:
Yawɛ fa Israel bi ɔmɛ ke a si Sinai yo ɔ
1 Yawɛ de Mose ke, “Ma a nɛ o kpaka kɛ je Egipt zugba a nɔ ɔ, o kɛ mɛ nɛ je hiɛ ɔ kɛ ho zugba a nɛ i wo Abraham, Isak, kɛ Yakob si ke ma ngɔ kɛ ha a nina a nɔ ya. 2Ma tsɔ bɔfo ko kɛ nyɛɛ o hɛ mi, nɛ ma fie Kanaan bi, Amor bi, Hit bi, Periz bi, Hiv bi, kɛ Yebus bi ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ je blɔ ɔ nɔ, 3nɛ bɔfo ɔ ma kpaka nyɛ kɛ ya zugba nɛ hi, nɛ baa ní saminya hulɔ ɔ nɔ. Imi nitsɛ lɛɛ i kɛ nyɛ be yae, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ ma ko ya kpata nyɛ hɛ mi ngɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ, ejakaa ma nɛ kuɛ wa ji nyɛ.”
4Benɛ ma a nu munyu yobu nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, a ye kɔmɔ, nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko wui june ní hu. 5Yawɛ fa Mose ke e de ma a ke, “Ma nɛ kuɛ wa ji nyɛ; ke i kɛ nyɛ nyɛɛ hɛngmɛfia po, ma kpata nyɛ hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ je nyɛ june ní ɔmɛ ngɛ nyɛ he, konɛ ma hyɛ bɔ nɛ ma pee nyɛ ha.” 6Kɛkɛ nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ kplɔ a he june ní ɔmɛ, nɛ kɛ je Horeb yo ɔ he kɛ yaa a, a ti nɔ ko nɔ ko wui june ní hu.
Kpe he bo tsu ɔ
7Be tsuaa be nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ ma ya to si ngɛ he ko ɔ, Mose maa ngɔ bo tsu nɛ ɔ nɛ e wo lɛ biɛ ke kpe he bo tsu ɔ kɛ ya ma ma sito he ɔ se tsitsaa. Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ suɔ kaa e ma ya bi ní ngɛ Yawɛ ngɔ ɔ maa ya kpe he bo tsu ɔ mi ngɛ ma a sito he ɔ se tsitsaa a.
8Ke e ba mi kaa Mose yaa sɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ mi ɔ, nɔ tsuaa nɔ maa da si ngɛ lɛ nitsɛ e bo tsu sinya nya, nɛ e maa hi Mose kuɛ se hyɛe kɛ yaa si e maa sɛ bo tsu ɔ mi. 9Ke Mose sɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ mi pɛ kɛkɛ bɔku titima a kple si kɛ ba da kpe he bo tsu ɔ sinya a nya. Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, Yawɛ kɛ Mose maa tu munyu. 10Ke ma a na bɔku titima a nɛ daa si ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ sinya a nya pɛ mɛ tsuo a maa te si, nɛ a ma ja Mawu. 11Yawɛ kɛ Mose maa tu munyu hɛ mi kɛ hɛ mi kaa bɔ nɛ nɔ kɛ e huɛ tuɔ munyu ɔ. Ke Mose kpale e se kɛ ba ma a sito he ɔ, e tsɔlɔ niheyo wayoo nɛ ji Nun binyumu Yoshua lɛɛ e ji kpe he bo tsu ɔ mi.
Yawɛ wo e ma a si
12Mose de Yawɛ ke, “Mo kai kaa o de mi ke ma kpaka ma a kɛ ho, se o tsɔɔ we mi nɔ nɛ o maa tsɔ kɛ piɛ ye he. Mo nɔuu nɛ o de ke o le mi saminya, nɛ o bua jɔ ye he. 13Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i kpa mo pɛɛ, ke niinɛ nɛ o ngɛ ye he bua jɔmi ɔ, lɛɛ moo tsɔɔ mi o blɔ ɔ, konɛ ma le mo saminya, nɛ ma pee o suɔmi nya ní. Mo kai hu kaa kikɛmɛ a nimli nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, mo nitsɛ o ma ji mɛ.”
14Yawɛ he nɔ ke, “Imi nitsɛ i kɛ mo maa nyɛɛ kɛ ya fiafiaafia.”
15Mose de lɛ ke, “Ke mo nitsɛ o kɛ wɔ be yae ɔ, lɛɛ mo ko ha nɛ waa je hiɛ ɔ. 16Ke o kɛ wɔ yɛ ɔ nɛɛ, kɛ a maa pee kɛ na kaa o ngɛ i kɛ o ma a wa he suɔmi kɛɛ? Ke o kɛ wɔ nyɛɛ ɔ, lɔ ɔ loko i kɛ o ma a maa je muno ngɛ zugba a nɔ je ma amɛ tsuo a he.”
17Yawɛ de Mose ke, “Nɔ́ nɛ o bi nɛ ɔ hu ma pee ha mo; ejakaa i le mo saminya, nɛ i ngɛ o he bua jɔmi.”
18Kɛkɛ nɛ Mose de ke, “I kpa mo pɛɛ, ha ma na o hɛ mi nyami ɔ.”
19 Yawɛ de Mose ke, “Ma ha ye hɛ mi nyami ɔ tsuo maa be ngɛ o hɛ mi, nɛ ye biɛ nɛ ji Yawɛ ɔ hu ma wo nɔ ta ngɛ o hɛ mi. Nihi nɛ sa dloomi ɔ, ma dloo mɛ; nɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ sa mɔbɔ nami ɔ, ma na mɛ mɔbɔ.” 20E ya nɔ nɛ e de ke, “Se ye hɛ mi lɛɛ i be hae nɛ o na; ejakaa nɔmlɔ adesa ko be nyɛe nɛ e na ye hɛ mi nɛ e yi ma na wami.” 21Yawɛ de lɛ ke, “Hyɛ, blɔ ngɛ ye kasa nya ngɛ hiɛ ɔ nɛ o maa da tɛ sa nɔ. 22Ke be nɛ ye hɛ mi nyami ɔ bee ɔ, ma ngɔ mo ngɔ wo tɛ puɔ mi ngɛ tɛ sa nɛ ɔ mi. I kɛ ye nine maa ha o nɔ kɛ yaa si ma be. 23Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, ma je ye nine ngɛ o nɔ, nɛ o maa na ye kuɛ se, se pi ye hɛ mi.”

Title: MOSE II, 34
Content:
Mlaa tɛ tɛtlɛɛ enyɔne ɔmɛ
(Mose V, 10.1-5)
1Yawɛ de Mose ke, “Mo kó tɛ tɛtlɛɛ enyɔ kaa kekle ní ɔmɛ, konɛ ma ngma munyuhi nɛ ngɛ kekle tɛ ɔmɛ nɛ o ywia a a nɔ ɔ kɛ fɔ nɔ. 2Dla o he nɛ hwɔɔ mɔtu ɔ o kuɔ Sinai yo ɔ kɛ ba, nɛ o kɛ mi ba kpe ngɛ yo ɔ yi mi.
3“Nɔ ko nɔ ko nɛ ko piɛ o he kɛ ba; a ko na nɔ ko ngɛ yo ɔ nɔ he ko, nɛ to, loo na kó ba ye ní ngɛ yo ɔ sisi.” 4Kɛkɛ nɛ Mose kó tɛ tɛtlɛɛ enyɔ kaa kekle ní ɔmɛ. E te si mɔtu mla, nɛ e ngɔ tɛ tɛtlɛɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ ngɔ ma e dɛ, nɛ e kuɔ kɛ ho Sinai yo ɔ nɔ ya kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa lɛ ɔ. Benɛ e yaa a, e hɛɛ tɛ tɛtlɛɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ ngɛ e dɛ mi.
5Yawɛ kple si kɛ ba ngɛ bɔku mi nɛ e ba da si ngɛ Mose kasa nya, nɛ e pale lɛ nitsɛ e biɛ nɛ ji Yawɛ ɔ. 6 Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, Yawɛ ba be ngɛ Mose hɛ mi, nɛ e de kɛ gbi wawɛɛ ke, “Imi Yawɛ ɔ, Mawu mɔbɔ nalɔ, kɛ dloolɔ ji mi; ye mi mi fu we mla, nɛ ye suɔmi kɛ anɔkuale yemi hiɛ babauu. 7I yeɔ ye si womi nɔ kɛ haa nimli akpeakpe, nɛ i ngɔɔ a he yayami kɛ tɔmi ngɔ paa mɛ. Se kɛ̃ i gblaa bimɛ kɛ bibimɛ a tue hluu kɛ ya siɔ yi nɔ etɛne kɛ eywiɛne bimɛ ngɛ a tsɛmɛ kɛ a nɛmɛ a yayamihi a he.”
8Mose kɛ he sɔmi kpla si nɛ e ja Mawu. 9E de ke, “Yawɛ, ke niinɛ nɛ o ngɛ ye he bua jɔmi ɔ, lɛɛ i kpa mo pɛɛ nɛ o kɛ wɔ nɛ ya. E ngɛ mi kaa ma nɛ ɔ kuɛ wa mohu, se moo ngɔ wa tɔmi ɔmɛ, kɛ wa he yayami ɔmɛ kɛ pa wɔ, nɛ o ngɔ wɔ kɛ pee mo nitsɛ o ma.”
A pee somi ɔ ehe ekohu
(Mose II, 23.14-19; Mose V, 7.1-5; 16.1-17)
10Yawɛ de Mose ke “Hyɛ i kɛ Israel ma a ngɛ soe. Ma pee nyakpɛ níhi ngɛ a kpɛti nɛ eko bɛ hyɛ ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi he ko he ko, aloo ngɛ ma ko ma ko mi. Je ma amɛ tsuo nɛ bɔle mo ɔ maa na ní nguahi nɛ imi Yawɛ, i ngɛ tsue; ejakaa nɔ́ nɛ i yaa pee ha mo ɔ he ngɛ gbeye. 11Mlaa nɛ i ngɛ mo woe mwɔnɛ ɔ, moo ye nɔ. Ma fie Amor bi, Kanaan bi, Hit bi, Periz bi, Hiv bi, kɛ Yebus bi ɔmɛ kɛ je blɔ mi ha mo. 12Hyɛ saminya nɛ o kɛ ma he nɛ nyɛ yaa a mi bi ɔmɛ kó so somi ko, nɛ lɔ ɔ ba plɛ klama nɛ a tsɔ mo. 13 Dɛbi, nyɛɛ hule a bɔ sami la tɛ ɔmɛ; nyɛɛ gbɛ a wɔ piɛ ɔmɛ, nɛ nyɛɛ ywia a yo wɔ ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Ashera a we amaga amɛ.
14“Mo ko ja mawu kpa ko, ejakaa imi Yawɛ Mawu ɔ, a kɛ mi plee we nɔ́ he. 15O kɛ nihi nɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ ɔ kó so somi ko. Ke pi ja a, ke a ngɛ a mawu ɔmɛ jae nɛ a ngɛ bɔ sãe kɛ ngɛ mɛ hae ɔ, a ti nɔ ko kɛ̃ ma tsɛ mo ní yemi, nɛ o ma ya ye ní nɛ a kɛ sã bɔ ha a mawu ɔmɛ ɔ eko. 16Jehanɛ hu, nyɛ ma ya ngɔ a biyi ɔmɛ ekomɛ ba ha nyɛ binyumu ɔmɛ. Nɛ ke a biyi ɔmɛ ngɛ a mawu ɔmɛ jae ɔ, a maa gbla nyɛ binyumu ɔmɛ kɛ ya piɛ a he kɛ ja a mawu ɔmɛ.
17 “Mo ko ngɔ nɔ́ ko nɛ a sile kɛ pee mawu nɛ o ja.
18 “Moo ye Abolokplolo nyami be ɔ. Kaa bɔ nɛ i fa mo ɔ, moo ye abolo kplolo ligbi kpaago ngɛ Abib nyɔhiɔ ɔ mi be nɛ a to ɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ; ejakaa Abib nyɔhiɔ ɔ mi o je Egipt kɛ ba a nɛ.
19 “Bitɛte tsuaa bitɛte, kɛ o we mi lohwehi a kpɛti kekleekle eku tsuaa eku ɔ, ye nɔ ji lɛ; na jio, to jio. 20 O teji kekleekle bi ɔ, o maa ngɔ jijɔ kɛ dani lɛ. Ke o be suɔe nɛ o dani lɛ ɔ, lɛɛ o maa ku e kuɛ. O ma dani o bitɛte tsuaa bitɛte. Nɔ ko nɔ ko nɛ ko ba ye hɛ mi kɛ e dɛ gu.
21 “Mo tsu ní ligbi ekpa, se ligbi nɛ ji kpaago ɔ lɛɛ moo jɔɔ o he; ní gbami be tete jio, ní kpami be tete jio.
22 “Moo ye Ngmakpami be ɔ be mi nɛ a ngɛ kpokploku kpɔe; nɛ o ye Gbasisihimi nyami be ɔ jeha a nyagbe.
23“Daa jeha a, o ma a mi nyumu ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ a ba bua si etɛ ngɛ imi Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ, ye hɛ mi. 24Ma fie je ma amɛ kɛ je o blɔ ɔ nɔ, nɛ ma bli o huzu ɔmɛ a mi. Nɛ ke o ba Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ hɛ mi si etɛ ngɛ jeha mi ɔ, nɔ ko hɛ be o zugba a nɔ kɔe.
25 “Koo ngɔ abolo nɛ a kɛ masa sã a ngɔ piɛ lohwe nɛ o kɛ ngɛ bɔ sãe ha mi ɔ he. Lohwe nɛ a gbe Hetsɔmi nyami be ɔ hu, je nɛ ko na yi.
26 “Daa jeha a, ngɔɔ o zugba a nɔ kekleekle yiblii kɛ ba imi Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ, ye we ɔ. Koo hoo apletsi bi ngɛ e nyɛ nyɔ nyu mi.”
27Yawɛ de Mose ke, “Ngmaa munyu nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ fɔ si; ejakaa somi nɛ i kɛ mo, kɛ Israel ngɛ soe ɔ daa si ngɛ kikɛmɛ a munyu nɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ.” 28Mose kɛ Yawɛ hi lejɛ ɔ nyɔ kɛ pia ligbi nyingmi eywiɛ; e yi nɔ́ ko ɔ, nyu hu e nui. Nɛ e ngma somi munyu ɔmɛ nɛ ji mlaa nyɔngma amɛ ngɔ fɔ tɛ tɛtlɛɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ.
Mose kple si kɛ je Sinai yo ɔ nɔ
29 Benɛ Mose kple si kɛ je Sinai yo ɔ nɔ kɛ ma a, e hɛɛ tɛ tɛtlɛɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ nɛ mlaa amɛ ngɛ a nɔ ɔ ngɛ e dɛ mi. E hɛ mi ngɛ kpɛe, ejakaa e kɛ Yawɛ ya tu munyu; se mohu lɛ nitsɛ e li enɛ ɔ. 30Aaron kɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ tsuo na kaa Mose hɛ mi ngɛ kpɛe, nɛ a ye gbeye kaa a maa su e he. 31Se Mose tsɛ mɛ, nɛ Aaron kɛ ma nikɔtɔma amɛ tsuo ba e ngɔ, nɛ Mose kɛ mɛ tu munyu. 32Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, Israel ma mluku ɔ tsuo hɛ mɛ kɛ ba e ngɔ, nɛ e wo mɛ mlaa amɛ tsuo nɛ Yawɛ ha lɛ ngɛ Sinai yo ɔ nɔ ɔ. 33Benɛ Mose kɛ mɛ tu munyu gbe nya a, e ngɔ nɔ́ kɛ ha e hɛ mi. 34Be tsuaa be nɛ Mose ma ya sɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ mi nɛ e kɛ Yawɛ ma ya tu munyu ɔ, e jeɔ hɛ mi hami nɔ́ ɔ ngɛ e hɛ mi kɛ ya siɔ be nɛ e miɔ nɛ e maa je kpo. Ke e je kpo kɛ ba nɛ e ba de Israel bi ɔmɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ fa lɛ ke e de ɔ, 35a naa kaa e hɛ mi ngɛ kpɛe. Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, Mose kpaleɔ ngɔɔ nɔ́ kɛ haa e hɛ mi kɛ ya siɔ be nɛ e maa ya nɛ e kɛ Yawɛ ma ya tu munyu ekohu.

Title: MOSE II, 35
Content:
Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ he mlaahi
1Mose bua Israel ma a tsuo nya nɛ e de mɛ ke, “Mlaahi nɛ Yawɛ wo nɛ nyɛɛ ye nɔ ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ. 2 Ligbi ekpa nyɛ kɛ tsu ní, se ligbi nɛ ji kpaago ɔ lɛɛ nyɛɛ ye lɛ kaa Hejɔɔmi ligbi klɔuklɔu ha imi Yawɛ. Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ma tsu ní jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, a gbe lɛ. 3Nyɛ ko slɛ la po ngɛ nyɛ we ɔmɛ a mi ngɛ Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ nɔ.”
Bɔ sami ngɛ bo tsu ɔ mi
(Mose II, 25.1-9)
4Mose de Israel ma a tsuo ke, “Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. 5Nyɛ ba ke imi Yawɛ ní. Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ngɛ he tsui kaa e maa ke nɔ́ ko ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ e ngɔ kɛ ba ji sika tsu, sika hiɔ, kɛ akɔblee; 6kpa bluu, kpa nɛ hɛɛ alamua tu su, kpa tsu, kɛ kpa hiɔ kpakpa nɛ a tslɔ; apletsi he bwɔmi, 7agbosu he womi nɛ a wo lɛ kɔbɛi; apletsi he womi nɛ a je blɔ pee; akasia tso; 8kane mi nu; tsopa nɛ a kɛ peeɔ nɔ pɔmi nu, kɛ tsopa kɛ e he via; 9tɛ nɛ a tsɛɛ shoham, kɛ tɛhi nɛ a he jua wa nɛ a maa ma kɛ wo efɔd ɔ kɛ gugue nya nɔ́ ɔ mi ɔ.
Níhi nɛ a kɛ maa pee kpe he bo tsu ɔ
(Mose II, 39.32-43)
10“Ga ní tsuli ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti ɔ, mɛ tsuo a ba nɛ a ba tsu ní tsumi nɛ Yawɛ fa nyɛ ke nyɛ tsu ɔ. 11Kpe he bo tsu ɔ, e he hami ní ɔmɛ, kɛ e nɔ hami ní ɔmɛ, e gbowe ɔmɛ kɛ e sima tso ɔmɛ, e mani tso ɔmɛ, e titima amɛ kɛ e nɔ dami ní ɔmɛ; 12somi daka a, e he tso ɔmɛ, nya nɔ́ ɔ, kɛ tsu mi pomi bo ɔ nɛ a kɛ tsiɔ somi daka a hɛ mi ɔ; 13okplɔɔ ɔ, e he tso ɔmɛ, kɛ e he níhi tsuo, kɛ abolo klɛdɛɛ ɔ nɛ a kɛ maa Yawɛ hɛ mi ɔ; 14kane tso ɔ hu nɛ a suɔ la kɛ maa nɔ ɔ, kɛ e he níhi; kane ɔmɛ kɛ nu nɛ a kɛ woɔ a mi ɔ; 15bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɛ a sãã tsopa kɛ e he via ngɛ nɔ ɔ, kɛ e tso ɔmɛ; nɔ pɔmi nu ɔ, tsopa kɛ e he via a; kpe he bo tsu ɔ sinya a nya bo ɔ, 16bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɛ a sãã sami bɔ ngɛ nɔ ɔ, e he akɔblee piɛ ɔ, e tso ɔmɛ, kɛ e he níhi tsuo; nyu kã a kɛ e he kla a; 17bo ɔmɛ nɛ kplaa si ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ piɛ ɔ he ɔ, e titima amɛ kɛ a nɔ dami ní ɔmɛ; piɛ ɔ nya bo ɔ; 18kpe he bo tsu ɔ he plɛɛko ɔmɛ, piɛ ɔ he plɛɛko ɔmɛ, kɛ a tangme ɔmɛ; 19kɛ tade saminyawiiwi ɔmɛ nɛ osɔfo Aaron kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ maa wo kɛ sɔmɔ ngɛ he klɔuklɔu ɔ.”
Ma a kɛ bɔ sami ní ɔmɛ ba
20Kɛkɛ nɛ Israel ma a tsuo je Mose he kɛ ho. 21Nɔ tsuaa nɔ ngɔ e nike ní ba ha Yawɛ, konɛ a kɛ ma kpe he bo tsu ɔ kɛ e mi sɔmɔmi ní ɔmɛ tsuo, kɛ tade klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ. Nɔ tsuaa nɔ ha kɛ je e tsui mi kaa bɔ nɛ mumi ɔ fa lɛ ɔ. 22Nyumuhi kɛ yihi tsuo nɛ ngɛ he tsui ɔ ngɔ gugue nya gahi, tue nya ní, nguɛ ní, kuɛ ní, kɛ sika tsu june ní kpakpa babauu ba ke Yawɛ. 23Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ngɛ kpa bluu, aloo kpa nɛ hɛɛ alamua tu su, aloo kpa tsu, aloo kpa hiɔ kpakpa, aloo apletsi he bwɔmi, aloo agbosu he womi nɛ a wo lɛ kɔbɛi, aloo apletsi he womi nɛ a je blɔ pee ɔ ngɔ kɛ ba. 24Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ma nyɛ ha sika hiɔ, loo akɔblee ɔ ngɔ kɛ ba ha Yawɛ; nɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ akasia tsohi nɛ hi kɛ ha ní tsumi ɔ, mɛ hu a ngɔ kɛ ba. 25Yihi tsuo nɛ ga ngɛ a hɛ mi ɔ tslɔ kpa bluu, kpa nɛ hɛɛ alamua tu su, kpa tsu, kɛ kpa hiɔ kpakpa kɛ ba. 26Mɛ kɛ̃ a ngɔ apletsi he bwɔmi kɛ tslɔ kpa kɛ ba. 27Nikɔtɔma amɛ ngɔ shoham tɛhi, kɛ tɛ kpahi nɛ a he jua wa nɛ a maa ma kɛ wo efɔd ɔ, kɛ gugue nya nɔ́ ɔ mi ɔ kɛ ba; 28kɛ tsopa kɛ e he via, kane mi nu, nɔ pɔmi nu, kɛ nu nɛ a kɛ peeɔ tsopa kɛ e he via. 29Israel ma a tsuo, nyumuhi kɛ yihi, kɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ e ta e tsui mi kaa e ha nɔ́ ko nɛ a kɛ tsu ní tsumi slɔɔtohi nɛ Yawɛ fa Mose ke a tsu ɔ je a tsui mi faa ngɔ a nike ní ɔmɛ kɛ ba ba ha Yawɛ.
Ga ní tsuli ɔmɛ
(Mose II, 31.1-11)
30Mose de Israel bi ɔmɛ ke, “Nyɛ na, Yawɛ je blɔ hla Uri binyumu Bezalel, Hur bibi ɔ kɛ je Yuda wɛtso ɔ mi, 31nɛ e ngɔ mumi mi nike ní babauu ngɔ ha lɛ. Yawɛ dloo lɛ ga ní tsumi he juɛmi, kɛ nile ha ga ní tsumi slɔɔtohi tsuo. 32E nyɛɔ nɛ e ngɔɔ sika tsu, sika hiɔ, kɛ akɔblee kɛ peeɔ ga níhi. 33E nine nya da kɛ tɛhi nɛ a he jua wa a he ní tsumi, kɛ tso hlɔmi, kɛ ga ní tsumi slɔɔtohi tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ a tsumi. 34Yawɛ ha e kɛ Oholiab, Ahisamak binyumu ɔ nɛ je Dan wɛtso ɔ mi ɔ ga ní tsumi he juɛmi nɛ a kɛ tsɔɔ ni kpahi ga ní tsumi slɔɔto ɔmɛ. 35E dloo mɛ ga ní tsumi tsuaa ga ní tsumi he juɛmi, kɛ nile babauu kɛ ha tso, aloo tɛ, aloo dade mi kpɛmi, kɛ ga ní tɛnimi kɛ ní kadimi nɛ a ngɔɔ kpa bluu, kpa nɛ hɛɛ alamua tu su, kpa tsu, kɛ kpa hiɔ kpakpa nɛ a tslɔ kɛ peeɔ ɔ. A nyɛɔ nɛ a tsuɔ ga ní tsumi tsuaa ga ní tsumi, nɛ a peeɔ ga ní tɛnimi hulɔ.

Title: MOSE II, 36
Content:
1“Bezalel, Oholiab, kɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ Yawɛ dloo lɛ ga ní tsumi he juɛmi, kɛ nile nɛ a kɛ ma tsu he klɔuklɔu ɔ mami ní tsumi ɔ, mɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ a ba nɛ a ba tsu ní ɔ kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa mɛ ɔ.”
Ma a kɛ nike ní babauu ba
2Mose tsɛ Bezalel, Oholiab, kɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ Yawɛ dloo lɛ ga nile, nɛ jehanɛ e ngɛ ní tsumi ɔ he suɔmi ɔ kɛ ba ní tsumi ɔ he. 3Mose ngɔ nike níhi nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ je a tsui mi kɛ ba nɛ a kɛ tsu he klɔuklɔu ɔ he ní ɔ tsuo ngɔ wo a dɛ. Se loloolo ɔ, Israel ma a kɛ a nike ní ɔmɛ ngɛ bae ba ngɛ Mose hae daa mɔtu. 4Kɛkɛ nɛ ga ní tsuli ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ ní tsue ngɛ he klɔuklɔu ɔ tsuo je ní tsumi ɔ he kɛ ba 5ba de Mose ke, “Ní ɔmɛ nɛ ma a kɛ ngɛ bae nɛ a kɛ tsu ní kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa wɔ ɔ hiɛ kulaa tsɔ pe ní tsumi ɔ.”
6Enɛ ɔ he ɔ, Mose ha nɛ a fiɛ ngɛ ma a sito he ɔ tsuo ke, “Nyumu jio, yo jio, nɔ ko nɔ ko nɛ ko ngɔ nike ní ko kɛ ba kɛ ha he klɔuklɔu ɔ he ní tsumi ɔ hu!” Kɛkɛ nɛ ma a jɔɔ ní ɔmɛ kɛ bami. 7Ní ɔmɛ nɛ a ngɔ kɛ ba momo ɔ hiɛ ha ní tsumi ɔ tsuo tsumi, nɛ tete po eko maa piɛ.
Kpe he bo tsu ɔ mami
(Mose II, 26.1-37)
8Ní tsuli ɔmɛ a kpɛti ni nɛmɛ nɛ a hɛ mi ngɛ ga saminya a ngɔ bo popoe nyɔngma kɛ pee kpe he bo tsu ɔ. A ngɔ kpa bluu, kpa tsu, kɛ kpa nɛ hɛɛ alamua tu su kɛ lo bo ɔmɛ, nɛ a kadi kerub saminyawiiwi ngɔ wo a mi. 9Bo ɔmɛ tsuo sɔ fiee; bo kake kami ji nine mi blimi nyingmi enuɔ kɛ ekpa, nɛ e blimi ji nine mi blimi kpaanyɔ. 10A kpɛ bo enuɔ kɛ tsa a sibi a nya, nɛ a kpɛ enuɔ kpa amɛ hu ja nɔuu. 11A kɛ kpa bluu pee gahi kɛ wo bo kake nya ngɛ tsami he ɔ; bo kpa a hu ja nɔuu a pee lɛ. 12A pee bo ga nyingmi enuɔ kɛ wo bo kake nya, nɛ a pee bo ga nyingmi enuɔ kɛ wo bo kaketsɛ ɔ hu nya; ga amɛ tsuo nyɛɛ a sibi a hanɔ. 13A pee sika tsu gbowe nyingmi enuɔ nɛ a kɛ gbowe ɔmɛ tsa bo ɔmɛ kɛ pee kpe he bo tsu mluku kake.
14Jehanɛ a kɛ apletsi he bwɔmi kpɛ bo popoe nyɔngma kɛ kake nɛ a kɛ lɛ tsuo pee heha nɔ́ ha kpe he bo tsu ɔ. 15Bo popoe kakaaka nyɔngma kɛ kake ɔmɛ tsuo sɔ; bo kake kami ji nine mi blimi kpaanyɔ. 16A kpɛ bo enuɔ kɛ tsa a sibi a nya, nɛ a kpɛ ekpa hu kɛ tsa a sibi a nya. 17Bo enuɔ ɔmɛ nɛ a tsa a, a pee ga nyingmi enuɔ kɛ wo nyagbe nɔ́ enyɔ ɔmɛ a ti kake he; ekpa nɔ́ ɔ hu a pee lɛ ja nɔuu. 18Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, a pee akɔblee gbowe nyingmi enuɔ, nɛ a kɛ gbowe ɔmɛ la ga amɛ a mi; nɛ bo enyɔ ɔmɛ pee heha nɔ́ kake. 19A kpɛ bo kpa enyɔ kɛ ha kpe he bo tsu ɔ he; a kɛ agbosu he womi nɛ a wo lɛ kɔbɛi kpɛ kekleekle nɔ́ ɔ, nɛ a kɛ apletsi he womi nɛ a je blɔ pee kpɛ enyɔne ɔ.
20Jehanɛ, a kɛ akasia tso pee sima tso ha kpe he bo tsu ɔ. 21Sima tso kake kami ji nine mi blimi nyingmi enyɔ, nɛ e blimi ji nine mi blimi etɛ. 22Sima tso tsuaa sima tso ngɛ nane enyɔ, nɛ a kɛ mɛ tsa a sibi a nya; bɔ nɛ a pee kpe he bo tsu ɔ he sima tso ɔmɛ tsuo ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. 23A pee sima tso nyingmi enyɔ ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ leneyi je, 24nɛ a pee sika hiɔ nɔ dami nɔ́ nyingmi eywiɛ kɛ wo sima tso nyingmi enyɔ ɔmɛ a sisi; nɔ dami nɔ́ enyɔ ngɛ sima tso tsuaa sima tso sisi kɛ ha e nane enyɔ ɔmɛ. 25Kpe he bo tsu ɔ kasa kake ɔ hu nɛ ji omleyi je ɔ, a ma sima tso nyingmi enyɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, 26kɛ mɛ hu a sika hiɔ nɔ dami nɔ́ nyingmi eywiɛ, nɔ dami nɔ́ enyɔ ngɛ sima tso tsuaa sima tso sisi. 27Kpe he bo tsu ɔ se ngɛ bonyoku je ɔ, a ma sima tso ekpa ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. 28A ma sima tso kpa enyɔ hu ha kpe he bo tsu ɔ kɔ nya enyɔ ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ se ɔ. 29Kɔ nya sima tso nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, a tsa mɛ ngɛ yi kpɛti ɔ ngɛ kekleekle ga a he, se sisi ɔ lɛɛ a tsa we; a pee kɔ nya sima tso enyɔ ɔmɛ tsuo kikɛ nɛ ɔ. 30Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, sima tso ɔmɛ tsuo a yibɔ ji kpaanyɔ, kɛ sika hiɔ nɔ dami nɔ́ nyɔngma kɛ ekpa; sika hiɔ nɔ dami nɔ́ enyɔ ngɛ sima tso tsuaa sima tso sisi.
31A kɛ akasia tso pee mani womi tso nyɔngma kɛ enuɔ kɛ ha kpe he bo tsu ɔ: enuɔ ha sima tso ɔmɛ ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ kasa hiɛ, 32enuɔ ha sima tso ɔmɛ ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ kasa hiɛ, kɛ enuɔ hu ha sima tso ɔmɛ ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ se, ngɛ bonyoku je. 33Mani ɔ nɛ nyɛɛ sima tso ɔmɛ a kpɛti ɔ lɛɛ e fɔ si kɛ je kpe he bo tsu ɔ kasa kake kɛ ya si kasa kake. 34A ngɔ sika tsu kɛ ha sima tso ɔmɛ a he. Jehanɛ hu, a pee sika tsu gahi kɛ wo a he, nɛ a kɛ mani ɔmɛ hɔɔ a mi. Mani ɔmɛ nitsɛ hu a ngɔ sika tsu kɛ ha a he.
35A kɛ kpa nɛ hɛɛ alamua tu su, kɛ kpa tsu lo tsu mi pomi bo ɔ. A je blɔ kadi kerub saminyawiiwi kɛ wo mi. 36A kɛ akasia tso pee titima eywiɛ kɛ ha tsu mi pomi bo ɔ. A ngɔ sika tsu kɛ ha a he, nɛ a kɛ sika tsu gbowehi hɔ a nya. Jehanɛ, a pee sika hiɔ nɔ dami nɔ́ eywiɛ ha mɛ. 37A kɛ kpa bluu, kpa nɛ hɛɛ alamua tu su, kɛ kpa tsu lo kpe he bo tsu ɔ sinya a nya bo ɔ; nɛ a kadi ní kɛ wo mi. 38A pee titima enuɔ kɛ ha tsu nya bo nɛ ɔ, kɛ mɛ hu a he gbowehi. A kɛ sika tsu ha a yi mi, kɛ a kpɛti kla amɛ a he; se a nɔ dami nɔ́ enuɔ ɔmɛ lɛɛ akɔblee a kɛ pee.

Title: MOSE II, 37
Content:
Somi daka a
(Mose II, 25.10-22)
1Bezalel ngɔ akasia tso kɛ kpɛ somi daka a. E kami ji nine mi blimi enuɔ, e blimi ji nine mi blimi etɛ, nɛ e mi kuɔmi hu nine mi blimi etɛ. 2E kɛ sika tsu ngmingmiingmi ha daka a mi kɛ e he tsuo, nɛ e kɛ sika tsu ɔ eko kɛ̃ wo zã kɛ bɔle e he ɔ kulaa. 3E pee sika tsu ga eywiɛ, nɛ e ka mɛ kɛ wo daka a nane eywiɛ ɔmɛ a he; ga enyɔ ngɛ kasa hiɛ, nɛ enyɔ hu ngɛ kasa hiɛ. 4E hlɔ akasia tsohi, nɛ e kɛ sika tsu ha a he. 5E kɛ tso ɔmɛ hɔɔ ga amɛ nɛ ngɛ daka a he ɔ a mi, nɛ́ a pɛtɛ a he kɛ hɛɛ daka a. 6Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e ngɔ sika tsu ngmingmiingmi kɛ pee daka a nya nɔ́; e kami ji nine mi blimi enuɔ, nɛ e blimi ji nine mi blimi etɛ. 7E ngɔ sika tsu nɛ a si nɔ tɛtlɛɛ kɛ pee kerub enyɔ kɛ ma nya nɔ́ ɔ nɔ ngɛ daka a kami mi hiɛ kɛ hiɛ. 8Kerub kake ngɛ hiɛ, nɛ kerub kake hu ngɛ hiɛ. E pee kerub enyɔ ɔmɛ nɛ a kɛ daka a nya nɔ́ ɔ tsa. 9Kerub ɔmɛ gbɛ a pɛlihi a mi kɛ ya hiɔwe nɛ a kɛ ha nya nɔ́ ɔ he. A plɛ a hɛ mi ngɔ kpee a sibi, nɛ a ngɛ nya nɔ́ ɔ nɔ hyɛe.
Okplɔɔ ɔ kpɛmi
(Mose II, 25.23-30)
