10Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e kɛ akasia tso kpɛ okplɔɔ ɔ; e kami ji nine mi blimi eywiɛ, e blimi ji nine mi blimi enyɔ, nɛ e si temi ji nine mi blimi etɛ. 11E ngɔ sika tsu ngmingmiingmi kɛ ha he, nɛ e kɛ sika tsu ɔ eko wo zã kɛ bɔle e he ɔ kulaa. 12E hlɔ tso maa pee dɛ mi blimi, nɛ e kɛ pee kla kɛ wo okplɔɔ ɔ he kɛ kpe. E kɛ sika tsu wo zã dɛɛ kɛ bɔle kla a. 13E pee sika tsu ga eywiɛ kɛ mɛtɛ okplɔɔ ɔ nane eywiɛ ɔmɛ a he ngɛ kɔ nya eywiɛ ɔmɛ. 14Ga amɛ nɛ a maa ngɔ tso ɔmɛ nɛ a kɛ maa hɛɛ okplɔɔ ɔ kɛ hɔɔ a mi ɔ ngɛ tso kla a kasa nya tutuutu. 15E ngɔ akasia tso kɛ hlɔ tso ɔmɛ nɛ a kɛ maa hɛɛ okplɔɔ ɔ; nɛ e kɛ sika tsu ha a he. 16E ngɔ sika tsu ngmingmiingmi kɛ pee ní nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a kɛ maa ma okplɔɔ ɔ nɔ ɔ: plɛɛtehi, kahi nɛ a kɛ tsopa kɛ e he via maa wo a mi, kpluhi, kɛ likɔkɔhi nɛ a kɛ maa sã wai bɔ.
Kane tso ɔ peemi
(Mose II, 25.31-40)
17Jehanɛ, e kɛ sika tsu ngmingmiingmi pee kane tso ɔ. Kane tso ɔ sisi je, kɛ e kpɛti tso ɔ lɛɛ e kɛ sika tsu nɛ a si nɔ tɛtlɛɛ pee. E pee mɔmɔhi: ní nɛmɛ nɛ blɛkee we lolo, kɛ ní nɛmɛ nɛ blɛke, nɛ a kɛ kane tso ɔ tsa mluguduu kake.
18Kɔni ekpa ngɛ kane tso ɔ he; etɛ ngɛ kasa hiɛ, nɛ etɛ hu ngɛ kasa hiɛ. 19Kane tso ɔ he kɔni ekpa amɛ ɔ, mɔmɔ etɛ kɛ a yi pɛɛ ngɛ eko tsuaa eko nɔ. 20Kpɛti kane tso ɔ lɛɛ mɔmɔ eywiɛ kɛ a yi pɛɛ ngɛ nɔ. 21Kane tso ɔ tso gblaa etɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, mɔmɔ kpɔ ngɛ kɔni enyɔɔnyɔ ɔmɛ a kpe he ɔmɛ a sisi tutuutu. 22Kpɔ ɔmɛ, tso gblaa amɛ, kɛ kpɛti kane tso ɔ tsuo tsa; a ngɔ sika tsu ngmingmiingmi nɛ a si nɔ tɛtlɛɛ kɛ pee lɛ tsuo. 23Jehanɛ, e pee kane kpaago kɛ ma kane tso ɔ nɔ; nɛ e kɛ sika tsu ngmingmiingmi pee kane ɔ sumi kɛ e gbemi nɔ́ ɔ, kɛ nɔ́ nɛ a kɛ maa muɔ la zu. 24E ngɔ sika tsu ngmingmiingmi kilo nyingmi etɛ kɛ enuɔ kɛ pee kane tso ɔ kɛ e he ní ɔmɛ tsuo.
Tsopa kɛ e he via sami la tɛ ɔ peemi
(Mose II, 30.1-5)
25Tsopa kɛ e he via sami la tɛ ɔ, e ngɔ akasia tso kɛ pee. E pee lɛ kɔ nya eywiɛ; e kami ji nine mi blimi enyɔ, e blimi ji nine mi blimi enyɔ, nɛ e si temi ji nine mi blimi eywiɛ. E kɛ e koli ɔmɛ ngɛ kɔ nya eywiɛ ɔmɛ tsa. 26E ngɔ sika tsu ngmingmiingmi kɛ ha e he tsuo: e yi mi, e kasa nya amɛ, kɛ e koli ɔmɛ; nɛ e kɛ sika tsu ɔ eko wo zã dɛɛ kɛ bɔle lɛ kɛ kpe. 27E pee sika tsu ga enyɔ kɛ mɛtɛ la tɛ ɔ he ngɛ zã a sisi ngɛ kɔ nya enyɔ ɔmɛ, konɛ a ngɔ tsohi nɛ a kɛ maa hɛɛ la tɛ ɔ kɛ hɔɔ a mi. 28Akasia tsohi ji tso ɔmɛ nɛ e hlɔ ɔ nɛ, nɛ e kɛ sika tsu ha a he.
Nɔ pɔmi nu ɔ kɛ tsopa kɛ e he via a
(Mose II, 30.22-38)
29 Jehanɛ, e pee nɔ pɔmi nu klɔuklɔu, ɔ kɛ tsopa kɛ e he via ngmingmiingmi ɔ hulɔ. E futu tsopa amɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ kaa nɔ́ nɛ tsopa kɛ e he via he ní tsulɔ nitsɛ lɛ pee.

Title: MOSE II, 38
Content:
Bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ peemi
(Mose II, 27.1-8)
1E kɛ akasia tso pee bɔ sami la tɛ; e ngɛ kɔ nya eywiɛ. E kami ji nine mi blimi nyɔngma, e blimi ji nine mi blimi nyɔngma, nɛ e si temi ji nine mi blimi ekpa. 2E pee kolihi ngɛ kɔ nya eywiɛ ɔmɛ, nɛ e kɛ akɔblee ha a he; koli ɔmɛ kɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ tsa. 3E pee bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he ní ɔmɛ tsuo: ngɛyuhi, sofihi, kahi, gbowehi, kɛ la jemi ngɛyuhi. E ngɔ akɔblee kɛ pee ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo. 4Jehanɛ, e ngɔ akɔblee kɛ lo ya ngɔ wo bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he kɛ je e sisi blɔ kɛ ya ta e kpɛti tutuutu. 5E sɔ̃ ga eywiɛ kɛ wo akɔblee ya a kɔ nya eywiɛ ɔmɛ a he, konɛ a kɛ tsohi nɛ wo a mi. 6Akasia tsohi ji tso ɔmɛ nɛ e hlɔ ɔ nɛ, nɛ e ngɔ akɔblee kɛ ha a he. 7E kɛ tso ɔmɛ hɔɔ ga amɛ a mi ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ kɔ nya eywiɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a kɛ hɛɛ lɛ. E kɛ gbegbeli kpɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ, nɛ blɔ ngɛ mi.
Akɔblee kã a
(Mose II, 30.18)
8E pee akɔblee kã kɛ e sisi kla; e ná akɔblee ahuhuɛ ɔmɛ nɛ e kɛ pee ɔ kɛ je yi ɔmɛ nɛ sɔmɔɔ ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ sinya a nya a a dɛ.
Kpe he bo tsu ɔ he piɛ ɔ
(Mose II, 27.9-19)
9Jehanɛ, e po piɛ kɛ wo kpe he bo tsu ɔ he. Bo nɛ ngɛ piɛ ɔ leneyi je ɔ, a lo kɛ kpa hiɔ kpakpa nɛ a tslɔ; e kami ji nine mi blimi lafa enyɔ. 10E kɛ akɔblee pee titima nyingmi enyɔ ɔmɛ, kɛ nɔ dami nɔ́ nyingmi enyɔ ɔmɛ; se titima amɛ a he gbowe ɔmɛ, kɛ mani ɔmɛ lɛɛ sika hiɔ a kɛ pee. 11Bo ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ omleyi je ɔ hu a kami ji nine mi blimi lafa enyɔ. Mɛ hu akɔblee a ngɔ kɛ pee a titima nyingmi enyɔ ɔmɛ, kɛ nɔ dami nɔ́ nyingmi enyɔ ɔmɛ; se titima amɛ a he gbowe ɔmɛ, kɛ mani ɔmɛ lɛɛ sika hiɔ a kɛ pee. 12Bo ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ piɛ ɔ bonyoku je ɔ, a kami ji nine mi blimi lafa. A ngɛ titima nyɔngma, kɛ nɔ dami nɔ́ hu nyɔngma; titima amɛ a he gbowe ɔmɛ, kɛ mani ɔmɛ ɔ, sika hiɔ a kɛ pee. 13Bo ɔmɛ nɛ kpee beleku je ɔ, a kami ji nine mi blimi lafa. 14Tsu nya bohi nɛ kplaa si ngɛ sinya a nya kasa kake ɔ, a kami ji nine mi blimi nyingmi etɛ, kɛ a he titima etɛ, kɛ nɔ dami nɔ́ etɛ. 15Kasa kaketsɛ ɔ hu ja nɔuu; tsu nya bohi nɛ kplaa si ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, a kami ji nine mi blimi nyingmi etɛ, kɛ mɛ hu a he titima etɛ, kɛ nɔ dami nɔ́ etɛ. 16Bo ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ kplaa si ngɛ piɛ ɔ he ɔ, a lo mɛ kɛ kpa hiɔ kpakpa nɛ a tslɔ. 17A kɛ akɔblee pee titima amɛ a nɔ dami ní ɔmɛ; se a he gbowe ɔmɛ, kɛ mani ɔmɛ lɛɛ sika hiɔ a kɛ pee. A ngɔ sika hiɔ kɛ ha titima amɛ a yi mi. Titima amɛ tsuo nɛ ngɛ piɛ ɔ he ɔ, a kɛ sika hiɔ tsa mɛ ngɛ a kpɛti. 18Piɛ ɔ nya bo ɔ, a ngɔ kpa bluu, kpa nɛ hɛɛ alamua tu su, kpa tsu, kɛ kpa hiɔ kpakpa nɛ a tslɔ kɛ kadi ní saminyayoo ngɔ wo mi. E kami ji nine mi blimi nyingmi eywiɛ, nɛ e blimi ji nine mi blimi nyɔngma, kaa piɛ ɔ he bo ɔmɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ. 19Titima eywiɛ hɛɛ piɛ ɔ nya bo ɔ, kɛ a nɔ dami nɔ́ eywiɛ nɛ a kɛ akɔblee pee ɔ, se a he gbowe ɔmɛ lɛɛ sika hiɔ a kɛ pee. A kɛ sika hiɔ ha a yi mi, nɛ a kɛ sika hiɔ nɔuu poo a kpɛti. 20Kpe he bo tsu ɔ he plɛɛko ɔmɛ, kɛ piɛ nɛ bɔle lɛ ɔ he ní ɔmɛ tsuo akɔblee a kɛ pee.
Níhi nɛ a kɛ pee kpe he bo tsu ɔ
21Ní slɔɔtohi nɛ a kɛ pee kpe he bo tsu ɔ, he nɛ a ngɔ tɛ tɛtlɛɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ nɛ a ngma mlaa amɛ ngɛ a nɔ ɔ ngɔ to ɔ ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ. Mose ji nɔ nɛ fa kaa a bua ní nɛ ɔmɛ a nya, nɛ osɔfo Aaron binyumu Itamar ji nɔ nɛ to blɔ nya ha Levi bi ɔmɛ nɛ a kɛ tsu ní ɔ.
22Uri bi Bezalel, nɛ peeɔ Hur nɛ je Yuda wɛtso ɔ mi ɔ bibi ɔ, ji nɔ nɛ pee nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ fa Mose ke e pee ɔ nɛ. 23E he piɛlɔ ji Ahisamak nɛ je Dan wɛtso ɔ mi ɔ bi Oholiab. Oholiab nɛ ɔ, nɔ́ mi kpɛ́lɔ, galɔ, kɛ bo lolɔ ji lɛ; nɛ e ngɔɔ kpa bluu, kpa nɛ hɛɛ alamua tu su, kpa tsu, kɛ kpa hiɔ kpakpa nɛ a tslɔ kɛ loɔ bo.
24Sika tsu tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ nɛ a kɛ tsu ní ngɛ he klɔuklɔu ɔ, nɛ ji sika tsu nɛ a ngɔ kɛ ba sã bɔ ɔ, e jiimi ji kilo akpe ngɛ he klɔuklɔu ɔ susumi nɔ́ ɔ nya. 25 Sika hiɔ nɛ a ná kɛ je ma a dɛ mi benɛ a ngɛ ni ɔmɛ kanee ɔ, e jiimi ji ngɛ kilo 3,430 he klɔuklɔu ɔauaumi nɔ́ ɔ nya. 26 Nɔ tsuaa nɔ ha ngɛ he klɔuklɔu ɔ susumi nɔ́ ɔ nya. Nyumu tsuaa nyumu nɛ ye kɛ je jeha nyingmi enyɔ kɛ yaa, nɛ a kane lɛ ɔ, ha kikɛmɛ a sika nɛ ɔ. Nyumuhi abɔ nɛ a ngma a biɛ benɛ a ngɛ ni ɔmɛ kanee ɔ, a yibɔ ji nimli akpe lafa ekpa kɛ etɛ, kɛ e nya lafa enuɔ kɛ nyingmi enuɔ. 27A ngɔ sika hiɔ nɛ ɔ mi kilo 3,400 kɛ sɔ̃ nɔ dami nɔ́ lafa kɛ ha he klɔuklɔu ɔ, kɛ tsu mi pomi bo ɔ; kilo 34 kɛ ha nɔ dami nɔ́ kake. 28Sika hiɔ kilo nyingmi etɛ nɛ piɛ ɔ, Bezalel ngɔ eko kɛ pee titima a he gbowehi. E ngɔ eko hu kɛ ha titima amɛ a yi mi, nɛ e kɛ eko poo a mi. 29Akɔblee ɔ nɛ a ngɔ kɛ ba ke Yawɛ ɔ, e nya ji kilo 2,425. 30Lɔ ɔ ji nɔ nɛ e ngɔ kɛ pee kpe he bo tsu ɔ nya sinya a nɔ dami ní ɔmɛ, akɔblee bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ kɛ e he akɔblee ya a, bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he ní ɔmɛ tsuo, 31nɔ dami ní ɔmɛ nɛ bɔle piɛ ɔ kɛ piɛ ɔ we agbo ɔ nɔ dami ní ɔmɛ, kpe he bo tsu ɔ he plɛɛko ɔmɛ tsuo, kɛ piɛ nɛ bɔle kpe he bo tsu ɔ hu he plɛɛko ɔmɛ tsuo.

Title: MOSE II, 39
Content:
Osɔfo ɔmɛ a tade ɔmɛ a kpɛmi
(Mose II, 28.1-14)
1A ngɔ kpa bluu, kpa nɛ hɛɛ alamua tu su, kɛ kpa tsu kɛ kpɛ tade saminyawiiwi nɛ osɔfo ɔmɛ maa wo kɛ sɔmɔ ngɛ he klɔuklɔu ɔ. A kpɛ tade klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ kɛ ha Aaron kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa Mose ɔ.
Efɔd ɔ peemi
2A ngɔ sika tsu kpa, kpa bluu, kpa tsu, kpa nɛ hɛɛ alamua tu su, kɛ kpa hiɔ kpakpa nɛ a tslɔ kɛ pee efɔd ɔ. 3A si sika tsu ɔ nɔ tɛtlɛɛ, nɛ a poo lɛ dlɛɛdlɛɛ kaa kpa loko a ngɔ kɛ futu kpa bluu, kpa nɛ hɛɛ alamua tu su, kpa tsu, kɛ kpa hiɔ kpakpa nɛ a tslɔ ɔ. 4A pee konɔ kpa enyɔ kɛ wo efɔd ɔ he, nɛ a kɛ fi lɛ ngɛ hɛ mi kɛ se tsuo. 5Mi mi fimi nɔ́ ɔ nɛ a je blɔ lo kɛ wo efɔd ɔ he nɛ a kɛ fi lɛ ɔ, lɛ hu jamɛ a ga a, kɛ jamɛ a ní ɔmɛ nɔuu a ngɔ kɛ pee mɛ kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa Mose ɔ. Mɛ ji sika tsu kpa, kpa bluu, kpa nɛ hɛɛ alamua tu su, kpa tsu, kɛ kpa hiɔ kpakpa nɛ a tslɔ. 6A pee shoham tɛ ɔmɛ, nɛ a ngɔ mɛ kɛ hɔɔ sika tsu gahi a mi; nɛ a kpɛ́ Yakob binyumu ɔmɛ a biɛhi ngɛ a nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ june he ní tsulɔ ngmaa ní ngɛ nguɛ ga nɔ ɔ. 7Kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa Mose ɔ, a fi mɛ kɛ wo efɔd konɔ kpa amɛ a he kaa kaimi tɛhi nɛ daa si kɛ ha Yakob binyumu ɔmɛ.
Gugue nya nɔ́ ɔ peemi
(Mose II, 28.15-30)
8Gugue nya nɔ́ ɔ, a pee lɛ kɛ ya; bɔ nɛ a pee efɔd ɔ, ja nɔuu a pee lɛ. Níhi nɛ a ngɔ kɛ pee lɛ ji sika tsu kpa, kpa bluu, kpa nɛ hɛɛ alamua tu su, kpa tsu, kɛ kpa hiɔ kpakpa nɛ a tslɔ. 9A dɔ gugue nya nɔ́ ɔ mi enyɔ, nɛ a pee lɛ kɔ nya eywiɛ; e kami ji nine mi blimi kake, nɛ e blimi hu nine mi blimi kake. 10A ma tɛhi nɛ a he jua wa kɛ wo zã eywiɛ mi. Kekleekle zã a mi tɛ ɔmɛ ji sardio, topasion, kɛ smaragdo. 11Zã nɛ ji enyɔ ɔ mi ní ɔmɛ ji karfungkle, safiro, kɛ sardoniki. 12Zã etɛne ɔ mi ní ɔmɛ ji hiakinto, agate, kɛ ametisto. 13Zã eywiɛne ɔ mi ní ɔmɛ ji krisolito, shoham, kɛ yaspi. A sile sika tsu kɛ bɔle tɛ ɔmɛ. 14Tɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a hiɛmi ji nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ, nɛ a kpɛ́ Yakob binyumu ɔmɛ a biɛhi ngɛ a nɔ kakaaka. Wɛtso nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ ɔ, a kpɛ́ eko tsuaa eko biɛ ngɛ tɛ kake nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ a ngmaa ní ngɛ nguɛ ga nɔ ɔ. 15A kɛ sika tsu ngmingmiingmi pee kɔsɔkɔsɔ nɛ a tslɔ kaa kpa kɛ wo gugue nya nɔ́ ɔ he. 16A pee sika tsu nɔ́ mi hɔmi nɔ enyɔ, kɛ sika tsu ga hu enyɔ, nɛ a kɛ ga enyɔ ɔmɛ wo gugue nya nɔ́ ɔ hiɔwe kɔ nya enyɔ ɔmɛ a he. 17A kɛ sika tsu kɔsɔkɔsɔ enyɔ ɔmɛ hɔɔ ga enyɔ ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ gugue nya nɔ́ ɔ hiɔwe kɔ nya enyɔ ɔmɛ a mi. 18A ngɔ kɔsɔkɔsɔ enyɔ ɔmɛ a nya enyɔ ɔmɛ kɛ la nɔ́ mi hɔmi nɔ́ enyɔ ɔmɛ a mi, nɛ a fi kɛ wo efɔd ɔ konɔ kpa amɛ a he ngɛ hɛ mi. 19Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, a pee sika tsu ga enyɔ kɛ wo gugue nya nɔ́ ɔ kɔ nya enyɔ ɔmɛ a mi mi je ngɛ efɔd ɔ kasa nya. 20Jehanɛ, a pee sika tsu ga kpa enyɔ kɛ wo efɔd ɔ kɔni enyɔ kpa amɛ a nya, ngɛ sisi blɔ kɛ yaa e hɛ mi, ngɛ tsami he kake ɔ hanɔ, ngɛ efɔd ɔ mi mi fimi nɔ́ ɔ nɛ a lo saminyayoo ɔ yi mi. 21Nɛ kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa Mose ɔ, a ngɔ kpa bluu kɛ fi gugue nya nɔ́ ɔ he ga amɛ kɛ wo efɔd ɔ he ga amɛ a he ngɛ mi mi fimi nɔ́ ɔ hiɔwe je, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ gugue nya nɔ́ ɔ nɛ kó kpɔ kɛ je efɔd ɔ he.
Osɔfo ɔmɛ a tade kpa amɛ a kpɛmi
(Mose II, 28.31-43)
22Bo ɔ nɛ a ngɔ kɛ kpɛ efɔd ɔ he tade klɔii ɔ, kpa bluu sɔuu a kɛ lo. 23A je kuɛ mi puɔ ngɛ he, nɛ a fia nya nɛ e ti kɛ kpe konɛ e ko hía. 24-26A ngɔ kpa hiɔ kpakpa, kpa bluu, kpa nɛ hɛɛ alamua tu su, kɛ kpa tsu kɛ lo ní kokloohi kaa tso yiblii nɛ a ma kɛ wo tade ɔ nya fiami ɔ mi, nɛ sika tsu ngmlɛhi hɔɔ tso yiblii ɔmɛ a mi kɛ kpe. Ke sika tsu ngmlɛ kake ba, kɛkɛ nɔ́ kokloo kaa tso yiblii ɔ hu kake ba ja sɔuu kɛ bɔle tade klɔii ɔ nya fiami ɔ mi kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa Mose ɔ.
27A ngɔ kpa hiɔ kpakpa kɛ lo hiɔwe tadehi ha Aaron, kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ; 28a kɛ kpa hiɔ kpakpa nɛ ɔ kɛ̃ kpɛ osɔfo pɛɛ nguaa a kɛ pɛɛ wawi ɔmɛ. A kɛ kpa hiɔ kpakpa nɛ a tslɔ kpɛ fiɔ mi tade ɔmɛ. 29Mi mi fimi nɔ́ ɔ hu, a ngɔ kpa hiɔ kpakpa nɛ a tslɔ, kpa bluu, kpa nɛ hɛɛ alamua tu su, kɛ kpa tsu kɛ pee, nɛ a kadi ní wo mi kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa Mose ɔ. 30A kɛ sika tsu ngmingmiingmi pee jlasi klɔuklɔu ɔ hɛ mi plɛɛte pɛtɛpɛtɛ ɔ, nɛ a ngma ní ngɛ nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ june he ní tsulɔ ngmaa ní ngɛ nguɛ ga nɔ́ ɔ ke, “Klɔuklɔu ha Yawɛ.” 31Nɛ a kɛ kpa bluu fi lɛ kɛ wo pɛɛ nguaa a he kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa Mose ɔ.
A gbe ní tsumi ɔ nya
(Mose II, 35.10-19)
32Jehanɛ ɔ, a gbe kpe he bo tsu ɔ he ní tsumi ɔ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ nya. Israel bi ɔmɛ tsu ní ɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa Mose ɔ. 33Nɛ a ngɔ kpe he bo tsu ɔ, kɛ e he ní ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ ba Mose ngɔ; e he gbowe ɔmɛ, sima tso ɔmɛ, mani tso ɔmɛ, titima amɛ, kɛ nɔ dami ní ɔmɛ; 34he hami bo ɔ nɛ a kɛ agbosu he womi nɛ a wo lɛ kɔbɛi kpɛ ɔ; he hami bo ɔ nɛ a kɛ apletsi he womi nɛ a je blɔ pee kpɛ ɔ; tsu mi pomi bo ɔ nɛ a kɛ tsiɔ somi daka a hɛ mi ɔ; 35somi daka a nɛ mlaa amɛ ngɛ mi ɔ, e he tso ɔmɛ kɛ e nya nɔ́ ɔ; 36okplɔɔ ɔ, e he ní ɔmɛ tsuo, kɛ abolo klɛdɛɛ ɔ nɛ a kɛ maa Yawɛ hɛ mi ɔ; 37kane tso ɔ nɛ a ngɔ sika tsu ngmingmiingmi kɛ pee ɔ, kane ɔmɛ nɛ a kɛ ma nɔ ɔ, e he ní ɔmɛ tsuo, kɛ kane mi nu ɔ; 38sika tsu bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ; nɔ pɔmi nu ɔ; tsopa kɛ e he via a; kpe he bo tsu ɔ nya bo ɔ; 39akɔblee bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ, e he akɔblee ya a, e he tso ɔmɛ, kɛ e he ní ɔmɛ tsuo; nyu kã a kɛ e he kla a; 40bo ɔmɛ nɛ kplaa si ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ piɛ ɔ he ɔ, e titima amɛ kɛ e nɔ dami ní ɔmɛ, piɛ ɔ nya bo ɔ, e he tangme ɔmɛ kɛ e he plɛɛko ɔmɛ, kɛ níhi tsuo nɛ a ngɔ kɛ tsu ní ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ mi ɔ; 41tade saminyawiiwi ɔmɛ nɛ osɔfo ɔmɛ maa wo kɛ sɔmɔ ngɛ he klɔuklɔu ɔ, nɛ ji osɔfo Aaron kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ a tade klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ. 42Israel bi ɔmɛ tsu ní tsumi ɔ tsuo kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa Mose ɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ. 43Mose ya nɛ e ya hyɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́, nɛ e na kaa a tsu ní ɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa lɛ ɔ. Nɛ Mose gbaa mɛ.

Title: MOSE II, 40
Content:
A tsukɔ kpe he bo tsu ɔ he
1Yawɛ de Mose ke, 2“Kekleekle nyɔhiɔ ɔ we kekleekle ligbi ɔ nɔ ɔ, ngɔɔ kpe he bo tsu ɔ kɛ ma si. 3Ngɔɔ somi daka a nɛ mlaa amɛ ngɛ mi ɔ kɛ ma mi, konɛ o ngɔ tsu mi pomi bo ɔ kɛ tsi daka a hɛ mi. 4Ngɔɔ okplɔɔ ɔ kɛ ba ma kpe he bo tsu ɔ mi nɛ o to ní ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ ma nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ. Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, ngɔɔ kane tso ɔ hu kɛ ba mi, nɛ o ngɔ kane ɔmɛ kɛ ma nɔ. 5Ngɔɔ sika tsu bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɛ a kɛ maa sã tsopa kɛ e he via a kɛ ma somi daka a hɛ mi, nɛ o wo bo ngɔ kpla si ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ sinya a nya. 6Ngɔɔ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɛ a sãã sami bɔ ngɛ nɔ ɔ kɛ ma kpe he bo tsu ɔ sinya a nya. 7Ngɔɔ nyu kã a kɛ ma kpe he bo tsu ɔ kɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ a kpɛti, nɛ o yɛ nyu kɛ wo mi. 8Moo po piɛ kɛ bɔle he klɔuklɔu, nɛ o wo bo ngɔ kpla si ngɛ piɛ ɔ sinya a nya.
9“Jehanɛ, ngɔɔ nɔ pɔmi nu ɔ kɛ pɔ kpe he bo tsu ɔ kɛ e mi ní ɔmɛ tsuo, nɛ o tsukɔ a he; kɛkɛ a maa pee klɔuklɔu. 10Moo pɔ sami bɔ la tɛ ɔ kɛ e he ní ɔmɛ tsuo nu nɛ o tsukɔ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he; kɛkɛ e maa pee klɔuklɔu kɛ pi si. 11Nyu kã a kɛ e sisi kla a hu o pɔ mɛ nu nɛ o kɛ tsukɔ a he ja nɔuu.
12“Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, ngɔɔ Aaron kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ kɛ ba kpe he bo tsu ɔ sinya a nya, nɛ o ngɔ nyu kɛ fɔ a he. 13Ngɔɔ tade klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ kɛ wo Aaron, nɛ o pɔ lɛ nu, nɛ o julaa lɛ, nɛ e sɔmɔ mi kaa osɔfo. 14Ngɔɔ e binyumu ɔmɛ hu kɛ ba, nɛ o wo mɛ hiɔwe tade ɔmɛ. 15Moo pɔ mɛ hu nu kaa bɔ nɛ o pɔ a tsɛ ɔ nu ɔ, konɛ mɛ hu a sɔmɔ mi kaa osɔfohi. Kikɛmɛ a nu pɔmi nɛ ɔ maa pee mɛ kɛ a nina tsuo osɔfohi kɛ maa ya neneene.”
16Mose pee kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa lɛ ɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ. 17Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a we Egipt jemi jeha nɛ ji enyɔ ɔ kekleekle nyɔhiɔ ɔ kekleekle ligbi ɔ, a ma kpe he bo tsu ɔ si. 18Mose ji nɔ nɛ ma kpe he bo tsu ɔ si. E ka nɔ dami ní ɔmɛ, nɛ e kɛ sima tso ɔmɛ ma si. Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e fi mani ɔmɛ kɛ wo a he, nɛ e kɛ titima amɛ ma si. 19E ma bo tsu ɔ si, nɛ e ngɔ kpe he bo tsu ɔ heha nɔ́ ɔ ngɔ ha he kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa lɛ ɔ. 20E ngɔ mlaa amɛ kɛ wo somi daka a mi. E kɛ tso ɔmɛ hɔɔ daka a he ga amɛ a mi, nɛ e ngɔ daka a nya nɔ́ ɔ ngɔ bu nya. 21Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e kɛ daka a ba ma kpe he bo tsu ɔ mi, nɛ e kɛ tsu mi pomi bo ɔ kpla si, nɛ e kɛ tsi somi daka a nɛ mlaa amɛ ngɛ mi ɔ hɛ mi kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa lɛ, Mose ɔ.
22Mose kɛ okplɔɔ ɔ ma kpe he bo tsu ɔ we omleyi je, ngɛ tsu mi pomi bo ɔ hɛ mi, 23nɛ e to abolo klɛdɛɛ ɔ nɛ a kɛ maa Yawɛ hɛ mi ɔ kɛ ma nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa lɛ ɔ. 24E ngɔ kane tso ɔ kɛ ma kpe he bo tsu ɔ mi ngɛ okplɔɔ ɔ hanɔ, ngɛ leneyi je, 25nɛ e su kane ɔmɛ kɛ ma nɔ ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa lɛ ɔ. 26E ngɔ sika tsu bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ kɛ ma kpe he bo tsu ɔ mi, ngɛ tsu mi pomi bo ɔ hɛ mi, 27nɛ e sã tsopa kɛ e he via ngɛ nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa lɛ ɔ. 28Mose kɛ bo ɔ ha kpe he bo tsu ɔ sinya a nya. 29E ngɔ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɛ a sãã sami bɔ ngɛ nɔ ɔ kɛ ma kpe he bo tsu ɔ sinya a nya, nɛ e sã sami bɔ, kɛ niye ní bɔ ngɛ nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa lɛ ɔ. 30E kɛ nyu kã a ma kpe he bo tsu ɔ kɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ a kpɛti, nɛ e yɛ nyu kɛ wo mi. 31-32Nɛ kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa lɛ ɔ, be tsuaa be nɛ lɛ, Mose ɔ, kɛ Aaron kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ maa sɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ mi, aloo a maa ya bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ hɛ mi ɔ, a kɛ nyu ɔ ma fɔ a dɛ kɛ a nane he. 33Mose po piɛ kɛ bɔle kpe he bo tsu ɔ, kɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he, nɛ e wo bo ngɔ kpla piɛ ɔ sinya a nya. Mose gbe ní tsumi ɔ tsuo nya.
Bɔku ɔ ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ he
(Mose IV, 9.15-23)
34 Kɛkɛ nɛ bɔku ɔ ba ha kpe he bo tsu ɔ nɔ, nɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi nyami hyi lejɛ ɔ. 35Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, Mose nyɛ we nɛ e sɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ mi. 36Ngɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ a blɔ nyɛɛmi ɔ tsuo mi ɔ, ke bɔku ɔ wo e he nɔ kɛ je kpe he bo tsu ɔ he pɛ kɛkɛ a pue blɔ. 37Ke bɔku ɔ wo we e he nɔ ɔ, lɔ ɔ lɛɛ a hiɛ blɔ kɛ yaa si ligbi nɛ e ma wo e he nɔ. 38Ngɛ Israel ma a blɔ nyɛɛmi ɔ tsuo mi ɔ, Yawɛ jeɔ e he kpo tsɔɔ mɛ ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ yi mi; piani ɔ, a naa lɛ kaa bɔku, nɛ nyɔ mi lɛɛ a naa lɛ kaa la nɛ ngɛ tsoe.

Title: MOSE III, NYA TSƆƆMI
Content:
NYA TSƆƆMI
Blema Israel bi ɔmɛ a Mawu jami, kɛ kusumihi a he mlaahi nɛ ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ mi. Womi nɛ ɔ ngɛ kɛ ha osɔfo ɔmɛ, nɛ mɛɛ lɛɛ a ní tsumi ji kaa a hyɛ nɛ a ye mlaa amɛ a nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Womi nɛ ɔ mi munyu titli ji Mawu ngɛ klɔuklɔu. Jehanɛ, womi ɔ gbaa wɔ bɔ nɛ Israel ma a maa pee kɛ ja Mawu, kɛ bɔ nɛ a maa ba a je mi, konɛ a kɛ “Israel Mawu Klɔuklɔu” ɔ nɛ hi si saminya be tsuaa be.
Munyuhi nɛ a le pe kulaa ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ mi ɔ ngɛ yi 19.18 ɔ; nɛ lɔ ɔ ji nɔ́ nɛ Yesu tsɛ ke mlaa enyɔne nɛ he hia, nɛ deɔ ke, “Moo suɔ o nyɛmi nɔmlɔ kaa bɔ nɛ o suɔ mo nitsɛ o he ɔ.”
Bɔ nɛ a dla womi ɔ mi ha
Mlaahi nɛ kɔɔ nike ní, kɛ bɔ sami he 1.1—7.38
A wo Aaron kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ osɔfo 8.1—10.20
Mlaahi nɛ tsɔɔ kaa kusumi nya a, nɔ ko he tsɔ, loo e he tsɔ we 11.1—15.33
Kpatami ligbi ɔ 16.1-34
Mlaahi nɛ kɔɔ klɔuklɔu peemi ngɛ wami si himi kɛ jami mi 17.1—27.34

Title: MOSE III, 1
Content:
Bɔhi nɛ a sãã lohwe ɔ tsuo kulaa
1Yawɛ tsɛ Mose nɛ e kɛ lɛ tu munyu kɛ je kpe he bo tsu ɔ mi, nɛ e de lɛ ke, 2e de Israel bi ɔmɛ ke, a kpɛti nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa ngɔ lohwe nane eywiɛtsɛ kɛ maa sã bɔ ha lɛ, Yawɛ ɔ, e ngɔ na, loo to kɛ ba.
3Ke na nɔ ɔ kɛ ma sami bɔ sami ɔ, é ngɔ na ku nɛ kpa ko be e he kɛ ba. E kɛ na a nɛ ba kpe he bo tsu ɔ sinya a nya, konɛ e sa Yawɛ hɛ mi nɛ e ngɔ. 4Nɔ ɔ nɛ ngɔ e nine ngɔ fɔ lohwe ɔ yi mi. A maa ngɔ ngɛ nɔ ɔ nane mi kaa bɔ nɛ e kɛ kpata Yawɛ. 5Jehanɛ, e gbe na ku ɔ ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi, nɛ Aaron binyumu ɔmɛ, nɛ ji osɔfo ɔmɛ kɛ muɔ ɔ nɛ ba; lɔ ɔ se ɔ, a tsɛ̃ muɔ ɔ ngɔ pue bɔ sami la tɛ nɛ ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ sinya a nya a he kɛ kpe. 6E saa lohwe ɔ, nɛ e poo lɛ kpɔ nya kpɔ nya; 7lɔ ɔ se ɔ, osɔfo Aaron binyumu ɔmɛ nɛ a to lɛ́ ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ, nɛ a slɛ la. 8Jehanɛ, a ngɔ lo nɛ a saa a, e yi ɔ, kɛ e zɔ ɔ ngɔ pue lɛ́ ɔ nɔ ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ; 9se e mi ní ɔmɛ, kɛ e nane ɔmɛ lɛɛ nɔ nɛ ma bɔ sami ɔ nɛ fɔ a he; nɛ osɔfo ɔ nɛ sã lɛ tsuo ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ kaa sami bɔ. Enɛ ɔ ji bɔ nɛ a kɛ la sãã nɛ jee via ha Yawɛ.
10Se ke to nɛ nɔ ɔ kɛ ma sami bɔ sami ɔ, é pee agbosu, aloo akpakpo nɛ kpa ko be e he. 11É gbe lɛ ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ we omleyi je, konɛ Aaron binyumu ɔmɛ nɛ ji osɔfo ɔmɛ nɛ a tsɛ̃ muɔ ɔ ngɔ pue bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he kɛ kpe. 12Nɔ ɔ nɛ poo lo ɔ kpɔ nya kpɔ nya, nɛ osɔfo ɔ nɛ to lo ɔ, kɛ yi ɔ, kɛ zɔ ɔ tsuo ngɔ pue la a nɔ ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ. 13E mi ní ɔ kɛ e nane ɔmɛ lɛɛ nɔ nɛ ma bɔ sami ɔ nɛ fɔ a he, nɛ osɔfo ɔ nɛ sã lɛ tsuo ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ. Enɛ ɔ ji sami bɔ, bɔ nɛ a kɛ la sãã nɛ jee via ha Yawɛ.
14Ke lohwe pɛlitsɛ nɔ ɔ kɛ ma sami bɔ sami ha Yawɛ ɔ, e pee lahuɛ, loo beleku lahuɛ. 15Osɔfo ɔ nɛ ngɔ ngɛ nɔ ɔ dɛ kɛ ba bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he. É kika lohwe pɛlitsɛ ɔ kuɛ, nɛ e tsɔ e yi ngɛ nya; e sã yi ɔ ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ; nɛ e tsle muɔ ɔ ngɔ pue bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he. 16É je lohwe ɔ kã a kɛ e mi ní ɔmɛ, nɛ́ e sake mɛ ngɔ pue bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ beleku je, he nɛ a ngɔɔ la zu ngɔ pueɔ ɔ. 17É pɛtɛ pɛli ɔmɛ a he, nɛ́ e fɛ lohwe ɔ mi, se e ko kplɔ pɛli ɔmɛ ngɛ he; lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e sã lohwe ɔ tsuo ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ. Enɛ ɔ ji sami bɔ, bɔ nɛ a kɛ la sãã, nɛ jeɔ via ha Yawɛ.

Title: MOSE III, 2
Content:
Niye ní bɔhi
1Ke nɔ ko ngɔ niye ní kɛ ma bɔ sami ha Yawɛ ɔ, é wɛɛ lɛ bukɔbukɔ kɛ pee mamu. E pue nɔ oliv nu, kɛ tsopa kɛ e he via, 2nɛ e ngɔ kɛ ba ha Aaron bimɛ ɔmɛ nɛ ji osɔfo ɔmɛ. Osɔfo ɔ nɛ piti mamu bukɔbukɔ kɛ e nɔ nu, kɛ tsopa kɛ e he via a tsuo e dɛ kɔkɔ kake, nɛ e sã ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ. Enɛ ɔ daa si kaa okadi ngɛ bɔ ɔ nɛ nɔ ɔ kɛ ba a tsuo nane mi kɛ ha Yawɛ. Enɛ ɔ ji bɔ nɛ a kɛ la sãã, nɛ jee via ha Yawɛ. 3Mamu nɛ piɛ ngɛ niye ní bɔ sami ɔ se ɔ, peeɔ osɔfo Aaron kɛ e bimɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ́; ejakaa bɔhi nɛ a kɛ la sãã ha Yawɛ ɔ mi nɔ́ klɔuklɔu pe kulaa ji lɔ ɔ nɛ.
4Ke niye ní nɛ a sã ngɛ flɔɔnɔɔ mi nɔ ko ngɔ kɛ ma bɔ sami ɔ, é pee keeki nɛ a kɛ mamu bukɔbukɔ nɛ a wo mi nu sã, loo e pee akpɔɔnɔɔ nɛ a pɔ he nu.
5Ke niye ní nɛ a sã ngɛ ngɛyu mi nɔ ko kɛ ma bɔ sami ɔ, é pee nɔ́ nɛ a kɛ kplolo mamu bukɔbukɔ nɛ a kɛ nu futu mi lɛ pee. 6É ku niye ní ɔ mi tsɔwitsɔwi, nɛ́ e plɛ nu ngɔ pue nɔ; niye ní bɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
7Jehanɛ, ke niye ní nɛ a hoo ngɛ buɛ mi nɔ ko ngɔ kɛ ma bɔ sami ɔ, e pee mamu bukɔbukɔ nɛ a wo mi nu. 8A sã jio, a si jio, e ngɔ kɛ ba kaa niye ní bɔ nɛ a kɛ ma ha Yawɛ. É ngɔ kɛ ba ha osɔfo ɔ, konɛ osɔfo ɔ hu nɛ ngɔ kɛ ya bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ hɛ mi. 9Osɔfo ɔ nɛ ngɔ bɔbɔyoo ko kɛkɛ kaa okadi ngɛ niye ní ɔ tsuo nane mi. É sã nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ. Enɛ ɔ ji bɔ nɛ a kɛ la sãã, nɛ jee via ha Yawɛ. 10Nɔ́ nɛ maa piɛ ngɛ se ɔ peeɔ osɔfo Aaron kɛ e bimɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ́; ejakaa bɔhi nɛ a kɛ la sãã ha Yawɛ ɔ mi nɔ́ klɔuklɔu pe kulaa ji lɔ ɔ nɛ.
11A kɛ masa nɔ́ ko kó pee niye ní bɔ ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ a kɛ ba haa Yawɛ ɔ eko; nyɛ ko sã masa nɔ́ ko loo hwo kaa bɔ nɛ a kɛ la sãã ha Yawɛ. 12Nyɛ ma nyɛ maa ngɔ masa, loo hwo kɛ ba ha Yawɛ kaa ngmɔ nɔ kekleekle niba ní, se nyɛ ko sã ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ jee via. 13Nyɛɛ wo nyɛ niye ní bɔ ɔmɛ tsuo a mi ngo; ejakaa ngo ji somi nɛ ngɛ nyɛɛ kɛ Mawu nyɛ kpɛti; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ngo nɛ piɛ niye ní bɔ ɔmɛ tsuo a he. 14Ke nɔ ko ngɔ e ngmɔ nɔ kekleekle niba ní kɛ ma bɔ sami ha Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ kaa niye ní bɔ ɔ, é pee kpokploku nɛ a hluɛ, nɛ a sĩ, loo blɛfo nɛ a wɛɛ kplolo. 15A wo mi nu, nɛ a kɛ tsopa kɛ e he via nɛ pue nɔ. Niye ní bɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. 16Osɔfo ɔ nɛ ngɔ niye ní bɔ nɛ ɔ bɔbɔyoo kɛkɛ kaa okadi ngɛ niye ní bɔ ɔ tsuo nane mi. É sã nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, kɛ tsopa kɛ e he via a tsuo kaa bɔ nɛ a kɛ la sãã ha Yawɛ.

Title: MOSE III, 3
Content:
Tue mi jɔmi bɔ sami
1Ke nɔ ko ngɔ na kɛ ma tue mi jɔmi bɔ sami ha Yawɛ ɔ, eku jio, eyo jio, e pee na nɛ kpa ko be e he. 2Nɔ ɔ nɛ ngɔ e nine kɛ fɔ lohwe ɔ yi mi, nɛ e gbe lɛ ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ sinya a nya, konɛ Aaron bimɛ ɔmɛ nɛ ji osɔfo ɔmɛ nɛ a tsɛ̃ muɔ ɔ kɛ pue bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he kɛ kpe. 3Á je lohwe ɔ nɛ a kɛ maa sã tue mi jɔmi bɔ ɔ he ní nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ sã bɔ nɛ a kɛ la sãã ha Yawɛ: zɔ ɔ tsuo nɛ ha mi ní ɔmɛ a he ɔ, 4lohwe ɔ se tso mi ngmɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ kɛ a he zɔ ɔ, kɛ fafali ɔ he nɛ hi pe kulaa a. 5Osɔfo ɔmɛ nɛ a sã ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ sami bɔ ɔ ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ. Enɛ ɔ ji bɔ nɛ a kɛ la sãã, nɛ jee via ha Yawɛ.
6Ke nɔ ko ngɔ jijɔ, loo apletsi kɛ ma tue mi jɔmi bɔ sami ha Yawɛ ɔ, eku jio, eyo jio, e pee lohwe nɛ kpa ko be e he. 7Ke jijɔ nɔ ɔ kɛ ba a, 8é ngɔ e nine kɛ fɔ lohwe ɔ yi mi, nɛ e gbe lɛ ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ hɛ mi. Osɔfo ɔmɛ nɛ a tsɛ̃ muɔ ɔ kɛ pue bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he kɛ kpe. 9Jehanɛ, lohwe ɔ nɛ a kɛ maa sã tue mi jɔmi bɔ ɔ, a ngɔ e he ní nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ sã bɔ nɛ a kɛ la sãã ha Yawɛ: zɔ ɔ kɛ e hlemi ɔ kulaa nɛ a je kɛ je e se tso ɔ he ɔ, zɔ ɔ tsuo nɛ ha e mi ní ɔmɛ a he ɔ, 10e se tso mi ngmɛ ɔmɛ kɛ a he zɔ ɔ, kɛ fafali ɔ he nɛ hi pe kulaa a. 11Osɔfo nɛ ngɛ ní tsue jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ nɛ sã enɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ kaa niye ní bɔ nɛ a kɛ la sãã ha Yawɛ.
12Ke nɔ ko kɛ apletsi ba bɔ sami ɔ, 13é ngɔ e nine kɛ fɔ lohwe ɔ yi mi, nɛ e gbe lɛ ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ hɛ mi. Osɔfo ɔmɛ nɛ a tsɛ̃ muɔ ɔ ngɔ pue bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he kɛ kpe. 14Jehanɛ, á je lohwe ɔ he ní nɛ ɔmɛ, nɛ á ngɔ kɛ sã bɔ nɛ a kɛ la sãã ha Yawɛ: zɔ ɔ tsuo nɛ ha mi ní ɔmɛ a he ɔ, 15se tso mi ngmɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ kɛ a he zɔ ɔ, kɛ fafali ɔ he nɛ hi pe kulaa a. 16Osɔfo ɔmɛ nɛ a sã enɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ, kaa niye ní bɔ nɛ a kɛ la sãã nɛ jee via. Zɔ ɔ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ ɔ, Yawɛ nɔ́. 17Israel fɔfɔɛ ko nɛ kó ye zɔ, loo muɔ. Enɛ ɔ ji mlaa nɛ fɔɔ si kɛ yaa neneene ha nyɛ yi nɔhi tsuo ngɛ nyɛ hi he ɔmɛ.

Title: MOSE III, 4
Content:
Yayami pami bɔ sami
1Yawɛ de Mose 2ke e de Israel bi ɔmɛ ke, ke a ti nɔ ko pee nɔ́ ko nɛ a nyɛ nɛ e kɛ tɔ̃ Yawɛ mlaa amɛ eko nɔ, nɛ pi kaa nɔ ɔ je blɔ tɔ̃ ɔ, a ye blɔ nya tomi nɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ.
3Ke osɔfo nɛ a pɔ lɛ nu nɛ tɔ̃, nɛ lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e gbla musu kɛ ba ma a nɔ ɔ, e ngɔ na ku nɛ kpa ko be e he kɛ ba sã yayami pami bɔ ha Yawɛ. 4É ngɔ na ku ɔ kɛ ba kpe he bo tsu ɔ sinya a nya, nɛ e ngɔ e nine ngɔ fɔ lohwe ɔ yi mi, nɛ e gbe lɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi. 5Jehanɛ, osɔfo nɛ a pɔ lɛ nu ɔ nɛ ngɔ na ku ɔ muɔ ɔ eko kɛ ya kpe he bo tsu ɔ mi. 6É ngɔ e nine nguɛ ngɔ sɔ muɔ ɔ mi, nɛ é fĩa ngɛ tsu mi pomi bo klɔuklɔu ɔ hɛ mi si kpaago. 7Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e ngɔ muɔ ɔ eko kɛ kpa la tɛ ɔ nɛ a sãã tsopa kɛ e he via ngɛ nɔ ɔ koli ɔmɛ a he ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ mi. É tsɛ̃ muɔ nɛ piɛ ɔ ngɔ pue bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɛ ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ sinya nya a sisi. 8Jehanɛ, na ku ɔ nɛ a kɛ ba sã yayami pami bɔ ɔ, é je e mi zɔ ɔ, kɛ zɔ nɛ ha e mi ní ɔmɛ a he ɔ tsuo. 9É je e se tso mi ngmɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ a he zɔ ɔ, kɛ fafali ɔ he nɛ hi pe kulaa a hulɔ. 10Osɔfo ɔ nɛ sã zɔ nɛ ɔ ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɛ a sãã sami bɔ ngɛ nɔ ɔ nɔ. Ke a gbe lohwe nɛ a kɛ maa sã tue mi jɔmi bɔ ɔ, kikɛ nɛ ɔ nɔuu osɔfo ɔ jeɔ e mi ní ɔmɛ. 11Se na ku ɔ he womi ɔ, e lo ɔ, e yi ɔ, e nane ɔmɛ, kɛ e mi ní ɔmɛ, kɛ e fĩ ɔ tsuo lɛɛ 12é ngɔ lɛ tsuo kɛ je ma sito he ɔ kɛ ya he ko nɛ tsɔ, he nɛ a plɛɔ la zu ngɔ pueɔ ɔ. É ngɔ mɛ kɛ pue lɛ́ nɔ nɛ e sã ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.
13Ke e ba mi kaa Israel ma a tsuo tɔ̃ Yawɛ mlaa a eko nɔ, nɛ pi kaa a je blɔ tɔ̃ ɔ, 14ke a na le kaa a tɔ̃ ɔ, ma a nɛ ngɔ na ku kake kɛ ba sã yayami pami bɔ. Á ngɔ lohwe ɔ kɛ ba kpe he bo tsu ɔ hɛ mi. 15Ma nimeli ɔmɛ nɛ á ngɔ a nine ngɔ pue lohwe ɔ yi mi, nɛ á gbe lɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi. 16Osɔfo nɛ a pɔ lɛ nu ɔ nɛ ngɔ na ku nɛ ɔ muɔ ɔ eko kɛ ya kpe he bo tsu ɔ mi. 17É ngɔ e nine nguɛ kɛ sɔ muɔ ɔ mi, nɛ e fĩa si kpaago ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi ngɛ tsu mi pomi bo ɔ hɛ mi. 18Jehanɛ, é ngɔ muɔ ɔ eko kɛ kpa la tɛ ɔ nɛ a sãã tsopa kɛ e he via ngɛ nɔ ɔ koli ɔmɛ a he ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ mi. Muɔ nɛ maa piɛ ɔ, é tsɛ̃ kɛ pue bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɛ ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ sinya a nya a sisi. 19É je na ku ɔ mi zɔ ɔ tsuo, nɛ é sã lɛ tsuo ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ. 20É pee na ku nɛ ɔ kaa bɔ nɛ e pee nɔ́ nɛ a kɛ ba sã yayami pami bɔ ɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ. Bɔ nɛ osɔfo ɔ maa pee nɛ e kɛ kpata Mawu ha ma a, nɛ a kɛ a he yayami maa pa mɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. 21Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, é ngɔ na ku nɛ ɔ hu kɛ je ma sito he ɔ, nɛ é ya sã lɛ kaa bɔ nɛ a tsɔɔ kaa a pee kaketsɛ ɔ. Enɛ ɔ ji yayami pami bɔ kɛ ha ma a tsuo.
22Ke nɔ yelɔ ko li e he be nɛ e tɔ̃ Yawɛ, e Mawu ɔ mlaa amɛ eko nɔ, 23nɛ a ha nɛ e na e tɔmi ɔ, é ngɔ akpakpo nɛ kpa ko be e he kɛ ba sã bɔ. 24É ngɔ e nine kɛ fɔ akpakpo ɔ yi mi, nɛ e gbe lɛ ngɛ he nɛ a gbee lohwe nɛ a kɛ ba sãã sami bɔ ngɛ ɔ, ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi. E ji yayami pami bɔ. 25Jehanɛ, osɔfo ɔ nɛ ngɔ e nine nguɛ kɛ sɔ muɔ ɔ mi, nɛ e kɛ kpa la tɛ ɔ nɛ a sãã sami bɔ ngɛ nɔ ɔ koli ɔmɛ a he. É tsɛ̃ muɔ nɛ piɛ ɔ ngɔ pue bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ sisi. 26Se e zɔ ɔ tsuo lɛɛ, é sã ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ. Lohwehi nɛ a gbee nɛ a kɛ sãã tue mi jɔmi bɔ ɔ, kikɛ nɛ ɔ nɔuu nɛ a sãã a zɔ ɔ nɛ. Bɔ nɛ osɔfo ɔ maa pee kɛ kpata Mawu ha nɔ yelɔ ɔ, konɛ a kɛ e he yayami nɛ pa lɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
27 Ke nyɛ kpɛti nɔ gu ko tɔ̃ Yawɛ mlaa amɛ eko nɔ, nɛ pi e yi mi nɛ e to kɛ pee yayami ɔ, 28ke a ha e na kaa e tɔ̃ ɔ, é ngɔ apletsi yo nɛ kpa ko be e he kɛ ba sã yayami pami bɔ. 29É ngɔ e nine ngɔ fɔ lohwe ɔ yi mi, nɛ é gbe lɛ ngɛ he nɛ a gbee lohwehi nɛ a kɛ ba sãã sami bɔ ngɛ ɔ. 30Osɔfo ɔ nɛ́ ngɔ e nine nguɛ kɛ sɔ muɔ ɔ mi, nɛ e kɛ kpa la tɛ ɔ nɛ a sãã sami bɔ ngɛ nɔ ɔ koli ɔmɛ a he, nɛ e tsɛ̃ muɔ nɛ piɛ ɔ kɛ pue bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ sisi. 31É je zɔ ɔ tsuo kaa bɔ nɛ a jeɔ zɔ ngɛ lohwe nɛ a gbe kɛ ha tue mi jɔmi bɔ sami ɔ mi pɛpɛɛpɛ. Osɔfo ɔ nɛ sã lɛ tsuo ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ, nɛ́ é je via ha Yawɛ. Bɔ nɛ osɔfo ɔ maa pee kɛ sã bɔ, nɛ e kɛ ma kpata Mawu ha nɔ ɔ, konɛ a kɛ e he yayami nɛ pa lɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
32Ke jijɔ nɔ ko kɛ ma yayami pami bɔ sami ɔ, e ngɔ jijɔ yo nɛ kpa ko be e he kɛ ba. 33É ngɔ e nine ngɔ fɔ lohwe ɔ yi mi, nɛ é gbe lɛ ngɛ he nɛ a gbee lohwehi nɛ a kɛ ba sãã sami bɔ ngɛ ɔ. 34Jehanɛ, osɔfo ɔ nɛ ngɔ e nine nguɛ kɛ sɔ muɔ ɔ mi, nɛ e kɛ kpa la tɛ ɔ nɛ a sãã sami bɔ ngɛ nɔ ɔ koli ɔmɛ a he, nɛ e tsɛ̃ muɔ nɛ piɛ ɔ ngɔ pue bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ sisi. 35É je e zɔ ɔ tsuo kaa bɔ nɛ a jeɔ zɔ ngɛ jijɔ nɛ a gbee kɛ sãã tue mi jɔmi bɔ he ɔ. Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, osɔfo ɔ nɛ sã zɔ ɔ kɛ piɛ bɔ nɛ a kɛ la sãã ha Yawɛ ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ he. Bɔ nɛ osɔfo ɔ maa pee kɛ kpata Mawu ha nɔ ɔ, konɛ a kɛ e he yayami nɛ pa lɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.

Title: MOSE III, 5
Content:
Sanehi nɛ hia yayami pami bɔ sami
1Ke a tsɛ nɔ ko ke e ba ye odase ngɛ sane yemi he, nɛ nɔ ɔ de we nɔ́ nɛ e na, loo e le ngɛ munyu ɔ he ɔ, e pee yayami; a gbla e tue.
2Ke nɔ ko li e he be, nɛ e ya ta nɔ́ ko nɛ he tsɔ we he, we mi lohwe gbogboe jio, nga mi lohwe gbogboe jio, lohwe tsɔwi a gbogboe jio, nɔ́ nɛ e pee ɔ woɔ e he mu nɛ, e yeɔ fɔ.
3Ke nɔ ko li e he be, nɛ e ya ta nɔ́ ko nɛ he tsɔ we he, nɔ́ nɛ jeɔ nɔmlɔ mi jio, nɔ́ nɛ jeɔ e he jio, ke e ba na le nɔ́ nɛ e pee ɔ, e yeɔ fɔ.
4Ke nɔ ko ka kita nya mi gu kaa e maa pee nɔ́ ko, kpakpa jio, yaya jio, nɛ e li e he be ɔ, ke e ba na le ɔ, e yeɔ fɔ.
5Ke nɔ ko na le kaa e ye fɔ ngɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ eko mi ɔ, é jaje e tɔmi ɔ ngɔ tsɔɔ; 6nɛ é ngɔ jijɔ yo, loo apletsi yo kɛ ba sã yayami pami bɔ ha Yawɛ. Osɔfo ɔ nɛ sã bɔ ɔ ha lɛ ngɛ e yayami ɔ he.
7Ke nɔ ko be nyɛe ma ha jijɔ ɔ, é ngɔ lahuɛ enyɔ, loo beleku lahuɛ enyɔ kɛ ba ha Yawɛ kaa e yayami nɛ e pee ɔ he bɔ. Á ngɔ kake kɛ pee yayami pami bɔ, nɛ enyɔne ɔ, a kɛ pee sami bɔ. 8Nɔ ɔ nɛ ngɔ lahuɛ ɔmɛ kɛ ba ha osɔfo ɔ; nɛ lɛ hu e tsu yayami pami bɔ ɔ he ní kekle. É ku lahuɛ ɔ kuɛ, se e ko tsɔ e yi ngɛ nya, 9nɛ é ngɔ muɔ ɔ eko kɛ fia bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he. É tsle muɔ nɛ maa piɛ ɔ kɛ pue bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ sisi. Yayami pami bɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. 10Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, é ngɔ lohwe enyɔne ɔ kɛ sã sami bɔ kaa bɔ nɛ a to ke a pee ɔ. Bɔ nɛ osɔfo ɔ maa pee kɛ kpata Mawu ha nɔ ɔ, konɛ a kɛ e he yayami nɛ pa lɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
11Se ke nɔ ɔ be nyɛe ma ha lahuɛ enyɔ, loo beleku lahuɛ enyɔ ɔ, lɛɛ é ngɔ mamu bukɔbukɔ kilo kake kɛ ba kaa yayami pami bɔ. E ko ngɔ nu, loo tsopa kɛ e he via kɛ pue nɔ, ejakaa e ji yayami pami bɔ. 12E ngɔ kɛ ba ha osɔfo ɔ, nɛ osɔfo ɔ nɛ ngɔ mamu ɔ e dɛ kɔkɔ kake kaa bɔ ɔ tsuo nane mi dami okadi. Osɔfo ɔ nɛ sã enɛ ɔ tsuo kaa bɔ nɛ a kɛ la sãã ha Yawɛ ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ. Yayami pami bɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. 13Bɔ nɛ osɔfo ɔ maa pee kɛ kpata Mawu ha nɔ ɔ, konɛ a kɛ e he yayami nɛ pa lɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. Mamu nɛ piɛ ɔ peeɔ osɔfo ɔ nɔ́ kaa bɔ nɛ e ngɛ ngɛ niye ní bɔ sami he ɔ.
Fɔ yemi bɔ sami
14Yawɛ de Mose ke, 15ke nɔ ko li e he be nɛ e pee yayami kɛ si Mawu, lɔ ɔ ji kaa e ha we Yawɛ ní klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ nɛ sa nɛ e ha lɛ sisiisi ɔ, é ngɔ agbosu nɛ kpa ko be e he kɛ ba. Lohwe ɔ jua nɛ pee bɔ nɛ he klɔuklɔu ɔ mlaa a tsɔɔ ɔ. Fɔ yemi bɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. 16Ní klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ nɛ e ha we sisiisi, nɛ́ ba pee hiɔ nɛ ɔ, é wo. Jehanɛ, é ngɔ hiɔ ɔ mi dlami enuɔ mi kake kɛ bɔ he kɛ ba ha osɔfo ɔ. Osɔfo ɔ maa ngɔ agbosu ɔ kɛ sã fɔ yemi bɔ, nɛ e kɛ ma kpata Mawu ha nɔ ɔ, konɛ a kɛ e he yayami ɔ nɛ pa lɛ.
17Ke nɔ ko li e he be, nɛ e pee yayami, nɛ e tɔ̃ Yawɛ mlaa amɛ eko nɔ ɔ, e yeɔ fɔ, nɛ e sa nɛ a gbla e tue. 18É ngɔ agbosu nɛ kpa ko be e he, loo nɔ́ ko nɛ he jua kɛ lɛ sɔ kɛ ba ha osɔfo ɔ kaa fɔ nɛ e ye ɔ he bɔ. Osɔfo ɔ maa ngɔ kɛ sã bɔ kɛ kpata Yawɛ ha lɛ, nɛ a kɛ e he yayami ɔ maa pa lɛ. 19E ji fɔ yemi bɔ, ejakaa e pee yayami kɛ si Yawɛ.

Title: MOSE III, 6
Content:
1 Yawɛ de Mose ke, 2ke Israel fɔfɔɛ ko kɛ nɔ́ ko ba da e se, nɛ e nyɛmi ɔ kpale we nɔ́ ɔ kɛ ba ha we lɛ, loo e ju lɛ, loo e sisi lɛ ɔ, e pee yayami kɛ si Yawɛ. 3Jã kɛ̃, ke nɔ́ ko laa, nɛ nɔ ko na, se e to lakpa, nɛ e ka kita ke e nɛ ɔ, lɛ hu e pee yayami kɛ si Yawɛ. 4-5Ke nɔ ko pee yayami nɛ ɔmɛ eko ɔ, bɔ tsuaa bɔ nɛ ji ɔ, e to nane mi sisiisi ha nɔ nɛ e tɔ̃ e nɔ ɔ. Ligbi nɛ a maa bu lɛ fɔ ɔ, e wo nɔ ɔ hiɔ ɔ sisiisi, nɛ e ngɔ nɔ́ ɔ jua a mi dlami enuɔ mi kake kɛ bɔ he ha nɔ ɔ. 6Jehanɛ hu, é ngɔ agbosu nɛ kpa ko be e he, loo nɔ́ ko nɛ he jua kɛ lɛ sɔ kɛ ba ha osɔfo ɔ, nɛ e kɛ sã bɔ ha Yawɛ kaa yayami nɛ e pee ɔ nane mi tomi nɔ́. 7Osɔfo ɔ maa sã bɔ ɔ kɛ kpata Yawɛ ha lɛ, nɛ a kɛ e he yayami tsuo nɛ e pee ɔ maa pa lɛ.
Bɔhi nɛ a sãã lohwe ɔ tsuo kulaa
8Yawɛ de Mose ke 9e de Aaron kɛ e bimɛ ɔmɛ ke, mlaahi nɛ kɔɔ sami bɔ he ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ. Sami bɔ ɔ nɛ hi bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ kɛ ya si mɔtu; la a nɛ ko gbo ngɛ sisi. 10Osɔfo ɔ nɛ wo e yi nɔ tade ɔ, kɛ e sisi tade ɔ nɛ a kɛ kploba kpɛ ɔ, konɛ e je la zu ɔ kɛ ma bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ kasa nya. 11Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e je e tade ɔmɛ, nɛ e wo tade kpahi, konɛ e ngɔ la zu ɔ kɛ je ma sito he ɔ kɛ ya pue he ko nɛ tsɔ. 12Á ha nɛ la a nɛ hi tsoe ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ, nɛ e ko gbo. Daa mɔtu ɔ, osɔfo ɔ nɛ to lɛ́ kɛ wo bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ mi. É to sami bɔ ɔ ngɔ pue lɛ́ ɔ nɔ, nɛ e sa zɔ ɔ nɛ a kɛ ma tue mi jɔmi bɔ sami ɔ. 13La nɛ hi bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ daa; e ko gbo gblegbleegble.
Niye ní bɔ sami
14Niye ní bɔ sami he mlaahi ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ. Aaron bimɛ ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake nɛ ji osɔfo nɛ ngɔ niye ní bɔ ɔ kɛ ba ha Yawɛ ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ hɛ mi. 15É piti mamu bukɔbukɔ, kɛ nu ɔ, kɛ tsopa kɛ e he via nɛ ngɛ niye ní bɔ ɔ nɔ ɔ tsuo e dɛ kɔkɔ kake, nɛ e sã ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ, konɛ e je via liliili, nɛ e pee kaimi nɔ ha Yawɛ. 16-17Mamu nɛ piɛ ɔ peeɔ Aaron kɛ e bimɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ́. A kɛ sã abolo kplolo nɛ a ye ngɛ he ko nɛ ngɛ klɔuklɔu, ngɛ kue ɔ nɛ ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ mi ɔ mi. Bɔ ɔmɛ nɛ a kɛ la sãã kɛ haa Yawɛ ɔ, Yawɛ ngɔ fa nɛ ɔ kɛ ha osɔfo ɔmɛ kaa a blɔ fa mi nɔ́. E ngɛ klɔuklɔu saminya kaa bɔ nɛ yayami pami, kɛ fɔ yemi bɔ ɔmɛ ngɛ ɔ. 18Aaron binyumu ɔmɛ pɛ nɛ a ngɛ he blɔ nɛ a yeɔ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ eko kaa niye ní bɔ nɛ a kɛ ba ha Yawɛ ɔ, mɛɛ a blɔ fa mi nɔ́.
19Mlaahi nɛ Yawɛ wo Mose, nɛ kɔɔ 20bɔ nɛ a maa wo Aaron binyumu ko osɔfo ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ. Ligbi ɔ nɛ a maa wo lɛ osɔfo ɔ, e ngɔ mamu bukɔbukɔ kilo kake kaa daa ligbi niye ní bɔ kɛ ba. É ngɔ fa kɛ sã bɔ mɔtu, nɛ é ngɔ fa hu kɛ sã bɔ gbɔkuɛ. 21E kɛ nu nɛ si ngɛ ngɛyu mi, nɛ nu nɛ sɛ mi saminya, nɛ e ku mi tsɔwitsɔwi, konɛ e kɛ ba sã bɔ kaa niye ní bɔ nɛ jee via ha Yawɛ. 22Kɛ je be nɛ ɔ mi kɛ yaa a, Aaron nina tsuo nɛ ma ba sɔmɔ kaa osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma a, e sã bɔ nɛ ɔ. E sã lɛ tsuo kɛ ha Yawɛ. 23Niye ní bɔ tsuaa niye ní bɔ nɛ osɔfo ɔ maa sã a, a ko ye ekoeko; a sã lɛ tsuo.
Yayami pami bɔhi
24Yawɛ fa Mose ke 25e wo Aaron kɛ e bimɛ ɔmɛ mlaa nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ kɔɔ yayami pami bɔ he. Lohwe nɛ a kɛ maa sã yayami pami bɔ ɔ, á gbe lɛ ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi ngɛ he nɛ a gbeɔ lohwehi nɛ a kɛ sãã sami bɔ ngɛ ɔ. Bɔ klɔuklɔu pe kulaa ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. 26Jehanɛ, osɔfo ɔ nɛ maa sã lohwe ɔ, e ye ngɛ he ko nɛ ngɛ klɔuklɔu ngɛ kue ɔ nɛ ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ mi ɔ mi. 27Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ he maa sa lo nɛ ɔ he ɔ ma plɛ pee nɔ́ klɔuklɔu; ke e muɔ nɛ a fĩa a eko sɛ tade mi ɔ, a fɔ tade ɔ he ngɛ he ko nɛ ngɛ klɔuklɔu. 28Á ywia buɛ tsuaa buɛ nɛ a hoo lo nɛ ɔ ngɛ mi ɔ; se ke akɔblee nɔ́ mi nɛ a hoo ngɛ ɔ, lɛɛ a sa mi saminya, nɛ a kɛ nyu nɛ jale mi. 29Nyumu tsuaa nyumu ngɛ osɔfo ɔmɛ a weku ɔ mi ma nyɛ maa ye bɔ nɛ ɔ eko; e ji bɔ klɔuklɔu pe kulaa. 30Se lohwe nɛ a kɛ maa sã yayami pami bɔ, nɛ a kɛ e muɔ maa ba kpe he bo tsu ɔ mi kɛ ba pee kpatami ngɛ he klɔuklɔu ɔ, a ko ye e lo ɔ; a sã.

Title: MOSE III, 7
Content:
Fɔ yemi bɔ
1Fɔ yemi bɔ sami he mlaahi ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ. E ji bɔ nɛ ngɛ klɔuklɔu pe kulaa. 2He nɛ a gbee lohwe nɛ a kɛ sãã sami bɔ ngɛ ɔ, á gbe lohwe nɛ a kɛ maa sã fɔ yemi bɔ ɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ kɛ̃. A tsɛ̃ e muɔ ɔ ngɔ pue bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he tsuo. 3A ngɔ e zɔ ɔ tsuo kɛ sã bɔ ɔ: e hlemi ɔ, zɔ nɛ ngɛ e mi ní ɔmɛ a he ɔ, 4e se tso mi ngmɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ kɛ a he zɔ nɛ ngɛ e mi si ɔ, kɛ e fafali ɔ he nɛ hi pe kulaa a. 5Osɔfo ɔ nɛ sã ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ a kɛ la sãã kɛ ha Yawɛ; fɔ yemi bɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. 6Nyumu tsuaa nyumu ngɛ osɔfo ɔmɛ a weku ɔ mi ma nyɛ maa ye. Se a ye lɛ ngɛ he ko nɛ ngɛ klɔuklɔu ejakaa e ji bɔ nɛ ngɛ klɔuklɔu pe kulaa.
7Yayami pami bɔ ɔ ngɛ kaa fɔ yemi bɔ ɔ kɛ̃. Mlaa kake lɛ ngɛ ha mɛ tsuo; osɔfo nɛ maa sã bɔ ɔ kɛ pee kpatami ɔ, e nɔ́ ji lo ɔ nɛ. 8Lohwe nɛ a kɛ sã sami bɔ ɔ he womi ɔ peeɔ osɔfo nɛ sã bɔ ɔ nɔ́. 9Niye ní bɔ tsuaa niye ní bɔ nɛ a sã ngɛ flɔɔnɔɔ mi, aloo nɔ́ nɛ a si ngɛ kutu mi, loo ngɛ ngɛyu mi ɔ, osɔfo ɔ nɛ sã bɔ ɔ nɔ́ ji lɔ ɔ nɛ. 10Se niye ní bɔ saisaa nɛ a futu mi nu, loo a futuu we mi nu ɔ, osɔfo Aaron binyumu ɔmɛ tsuo a nɔ́ ji lɔ ɔ nɛ; a dla lɛ fiee.
Tue mi jɔmi bɔhi
11Tue mi jɔmi bɔhi nɛ a kɛ ba haa Yawɛ ɔ a he mlaahi ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ. 12Ke nɔ ko ma bɔ ɔ sami nɛ e kɛ na Yawɛ si ɔ, e ngɔ ní nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ piɛ e lohwe nɛ e kɛ ma bɔ sami ɔ he kɛ ba: abolo kplolo nɛ a wo mi nu, akpɔɔnɔɔ nɛ a kɛ kplolo sã nɛ a kpa he nu, kɛ akpɔɔnɔɔ nɛ a kɛ mamu bukɔbukɔ nɛ a wo mi nu saminya sã. 13E ngɔ abolo nɛ a wo mi masa kɛ piɛ ní ɔmɛ nɛ e kɛ ma tue mi jɔmi bɔ sami kɛ na Yawɛ si ɔ a he kɛ ba. 14Níhi nɛ a kɛ ma bɔ sami ɔ, e je mi kakaaka kɛ pee nike ní pɔtɛɛ kɛ ha Yawɛ. Osɔfo ɔ nɛ maa tsɛ̃ muɔ ɔ kɛ pue bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he ɔ, enɛ ɔ maa pee e nɔ́. 15A ye lohwe ɔ nɛ a kɛ ba sã bɔ ɔ jamɛ a ligbi ɔ nɔuu; a ko si eko nɛ je nɛ e na yi.
16Ke nɔ ko ba sã tue mi jɔmi bɔ ɔ; nɔ́ ko nɛ e wo he si jio, nɔ́ nɛ je e tsui mi faa jio, a ma nyɛ ye lo ɔ ligbi ɔ nɛ e kɛ ba a. Ke eko piɛ ɔ, a ye e nɔ jena. 17Ligbi etɛne ɔ, ke lo ɔ eko piɛ ɔ, á sã. 18Ke nɔ ko ye lo nɛ ye ligbi etɛ ɔ eko ɔ, Mawu be e bɔ sami ɔ he tsui nae, nɛ a be bue ha lɛ kaa e sã bɔ hulɔ. A hiɔ; nɔ nɛ maa ye eko ɔ, e musu maa tloo lɛ. 19Ke nɔ́ ko nɛ he tsɔ we he sa lo nɛ ɔ he ɔ, á ko ye; á sã.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ he tsɔ ngɛ he blɔ kaa e maa ye lo nɛ a kɛ ba sã bɔ ɔ eko. 20Se nɔ nɛ he tsɔ we nɛ maa ye eko ɔ, á je lɛ we; á ko bu lɛ ngɔ si Mawu ma a mi bi ɔmɛ a nɔ hu. 21Jehanɛ hu, nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa ta nɔ́ ko nɛ he tsɔ we he, nɔmlɔ jio, lohwe jio, bɔ nɔ́ ko jio, nɛ e maa ye lo nɛ a kɛ sã tue mi jɔmi bɔ ha Yawɛ ɔ, á je lɛ we, á ko bu lɛ ngɔ si Mawu ma a mi bi ɔmɛ a nɔ hu.
22Yawɛ wo Mose mlaa nɛ ɔ ke 23e de Israel bi ɔmɛ ke, á ko ye zɔ, na zɔ jio, jijɔ zɔ jio, apletsi zɔ jio. 24Ke lohwe ko gbo lɛ nitsɛ e gbenɔ, aloo lohwe awi yelɔ ko tsɔtslɔɔ e mi ɔ, a ko ye e zɔ ɔ; a ma nyɛ kɛ tsu nɔ́ kpa ko. 25Ke a kɛ lohwe ko ba sã bɔ nɛ a kɛ la sãã ha Yawɛ ɔ, nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa ye e zɔ ɔ, á je lɛ we, nɛ á ko bu lɛ ngɔ si Mawu ma a mi bi ɔmɛ a nɔ hu. 26 Jehanɛ hu, nɔ ko nɔ ko kó ye lohwe pɛlitsɛ, loo nane eywiɛtsɛ ko muɔ ngɛ nyɛ hi he ɔmɛ. 27Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa ye muɔ ɔ, á je lɛ we; a ko bu lɛ ngɔ si Mawu ma a mi bi ɔmɛ a nɔ hu.
28Yawɛ de Mose ke 29e de Israel bi ɔmɛ ke, nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa sã tue mi jɔmi bɔ ɔ, lɛ nitsɛ e ngɔ bɔ ɔmi eko kaa sina pɔtɛɛ kɛ ba ha Yawɛ. 30Lɛ nitsɛ e hɛɛ ngɛ e dɛ mi kɛ ba kaa bɔ nɛ a kɛ la sãã kɛ ha Yawɛ. É ngɔ zɔ ɔ kɛ piɛ lohwe ɔ gugue ɔ he kɛ ba kaa bɔ nɛ á fɔɔ kɛ yaa kɛ baa ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi. 31Osɔfo ɔ nɛ sã zɔ ɔ tsuo ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ, se gugue ɔ lɛɛ, e maa pee Aaron, kɛ e bimɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ́. 32-33Á ngɔ lohwe ɔ hiɔ fiɔ ɔ kɛ ha osɔfo ɔ nɛ ngɔ muɔ kɛ zɔ ɔ kɛ sã tue mi jɔmi bɔ ɔ kaa nike ní pɔtɛɛ ko. E blɔ nya nɔ́ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. 34Lohwe ɔ gugue, kɛ e hiɔ nɔ fiɔ ji nike ní pɔtɛɛ nɛ Yawɛ he ngɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ a dɛ kɛ ha osɔfo ɔmɛ. Nike ní nɛ ɔ ji nɔ́ nɛ sa nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ nɛ ha osɔfo ɔmɛ be tsuaa be. 35Bɔhi nɛ a kɛ la sãã ha Yawɛ ɔ, Aaron kɛ e bimɛ ɔmɛ a blɔ fa mi nɔ́ nɛ a gbaa nɔ kɛ ha mɛ kɛ je be nɛ a wo mɛ osɔfo ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. 36Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ nɛ Yawɛ pɔ mɛ nu ɔ nɛ e fa Israel bi ɔmɛ ke a ngɔ bɔ nɛ a sãã a mi fa nɛ ɔ ngɔ ha mɛ. E ji mlaa nɛ fɔɔ si ha Israel bi ɔmɛ kɛ a nina tsuo kulaa yi nɔhi tsuo.
37Mlaahi nɛ ngɛ kɛ ha sami bɔ, niye ní bɔ, yayami pami bɔ, fɔ yemi bɔ, osɔfo womi bɔ, kɛ tue mi jɔmi bɔ ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ. 38Yawɛ wo Mose mlaa nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ Sinai yo ɔ nɔ ngɛ nga a nɔ. Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ nɛ Yawɛ de Israel bi ɔmɛ ke a ngɔ a nike ní kɛ ba ha lɛ ɔ nɛ.

Title: MOSE III, 8
Content:
Aaron kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ a we osɔfo womi
(Mose II, 29.1-37)
1Yawɛ de Mose ke, 2“Ngɔɔ Aaron kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ, a tade ɔmɛ, nɔ pɔmi nu ɔ, na ku ɔ nɛ a kɛ maa sã yayami pami bɔ ɔ, agbosu enyɔ ɔmɛ, kɛ kusii kɛ e mi abolo kplolo ɔ kɛ ba kpe he bo tsu ɔ sinya a nya; 3nɛ o kpee ma a tsuo kɛ ba lejɛ ɔ.”
4Mose pee kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa lɛ ɔ, nɛ benɛ ma a tsuo ba kpe ɔ, 5e de mɛ ke, “Nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ fa ke a pee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.”
6Mose ngɔ Aaron kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ kɛ ba nɛ e ba du a he ha mɛ. 7E ngɔ yi nɔ tade ɔ ngɔ wo Aaron, nɛ e kɛ mlɛ mi fimi nɔ́ fi e mlɛ mi, nɛ e wo lɛ tade klɔii ɔ. Jehanɛ e ngɔ tade nɛ a tsɛɛ efɔd ɔ ngɔ wo lɛ, nɛ e kɛ efɔd ɔ he kpa nɛ a lo lɛ saminyayoo ɔ fi efɔd ɔ nɔ. 8Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e ngɔ hiɔwe tade ɔ nɛ Urim kɛ Tumim ngɛ mi ɔ ngɔ wo lɛ. 9E bu lɛ pɛɛ kɛ e hɛ mi sika tsu june nɛ ji jlasi klɔuklɔu kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa lɛ Mose ɔ.
10Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, Mose ngɔ nɔ pɔmi nu ɔ kɛ pɔ kpe he bo tsu ɔ, kɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ mi ɔ kɛ pee mɛ klɔuklɔu. 11E kɛ nu ɔ eko fĩa bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ si kpaago kɛ pɔ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ kɛ e he ní ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ kã a kɛ e sisi kla a nu, nɛ e kɛ tsukɔ a he. 12E plɛ nɔ pɔmi nu ɔ eko kɛ pue Aaron yi mi kɛ pɔ lɛ nu kɛ tsukɔ e he. 13Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Mose ngɔ Aaron binyumu ɔmɛ kɛ ba, nɛ e ngɔ hiɔwe tadehi kɛ wo mɛ, nɛ e kɛ mlɛ mi fimi níhi fi a mlɛ mi ha mɛ, nɛ e bu mɛ pɛɛ kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa lɛ ɔ.
14Jehanɛ, Mose ngɔ na ku ɔ nɛ a kɛ maa sã yayami pami bɔ ɔ kɛ ba, nɛ Aaron kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ ngɔ a nine kɛ pue lohwe ɔ yi mi. 15Mose gbe lohwe ɔ, nɛ e ngɔ e nine nguɛ kɛ sɔ muɔ ɔ mi, nɛ e kɛ kpa bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ koli ɔmɛ a he. Kɛkɛ nɛ e tsɛ̃ muɔ ɔ kɛ pue bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ sisi. Blɔ nɔ nɛ a gu kɛ tsukɔ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. 16Mose ngɔ zɔ ɔ tsuo nɛ ngɛ mi ní ɔmɛ a he ɔ, kɛ fafali ɔ he nɛ hi pe kulaa a, kɛ se tso mi ngmɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ kɛ mɛ hu a he zɔ ɔ tsuo, nɛ e sã ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ. 17Se lohwe ɔ he womi ɔ, e lo ɔ, kɛ e mi fĩ ɔmɛ lɛɛ, e ya sã ngɛ ma si tomi he ɔ se kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa lɛ ɔ.
18Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Mose ngɔ agbosu ɔ nɛ a kɛ maa sã sami bɔ ɔ kɛ ba, nɛ Aaron kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ ngɔ a nine ngɔ pue lohwe ɔ yi mi. 19Mose gbe lohwe ɔ, nɛ e tsɛ̃ muɔ ɔ kɛ pue bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he tsuo kɛ kpe. 20-21Jehanɛ, e saa agbosu ɔ, nɛ e poo lɛ kpɔ nya kpɔ nya, nɛ e fɔ e mi ní ɔmɛ, kɛ e nane ɔmɛ a he. Nɛ kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa a, Mose sã e yi ɔ, zɔ ɔ, kɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ. Niye ní bɔ nɛ jee via ha Yawɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
22Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Mose ngɔ agbosu enyɔne ɔ nɛ a kɛ maa pee kusumi kɛ wo osɔfo ɔ hu kɛ ba, nɛ Aaron kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ ngɔ a nine ngɔ pue e yi mi. 23Mose gbe lɛ, nɛ e ngɔ e muɔ ɔ eko kɛ sa Aaron hiɔ nɔ tue nya lo ɔ he, nɛ e kɛ eko sa e hiɔ nine nguɛ gɔleku ɔ kɛ e hiɔ nane nguɛ gɔleku ɔ he. 24Jehanɛ Mose ngɔ Aaron binyumu ɔmɛ hu kɛ ba nɛ e kɛ muɔ ɔ eko sa a hiɔ tue nya lo ɔmɛ, a hiɔ nine gɔleku ɔmɛ, kɛ a hiɔ nane gɔleku ɔmɛ hu a he; lɔ ɔ se ɔ, Mose tsɛ̃ muɔ nɛ piɛ ɔ kɛ pue bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he tsuo kɛ kpe. 25Jehanɛ, e ngɔ zɔ ɔ kɛ e hlemi ɔ, kɛ zɔ ɔ tsuo nɛ ngɛ mi ní ɔmɛ a he ɔ, fafali ɔ he nɛ hi pe kulaa a, se tso mi ngmɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ kɛ a he zɔ ɔ, kɛ hiɔ nɔ fiɔ ɔ. 26E je abolo kplolo kake, kɛ abolo nɛ a futu mi nu, kɛ akpɔɔnɔɔ kake kɛ je abolo kplolo nɛ ngɛ kusii nɛ maa si ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi ɔ mi kɛ pue zɔ ɔ, kɛ hiɔ nɔ fiɔ ɔ a nɔ. 27E ngɔ ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ngɔ wo Aaron kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ a dɛ mi, nɛ a wo nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ a fɔɔ kɛ yaa kɛ baa ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi. 28Mose he ní nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ a dɛ mi, nɛ e sã mɛ kɛ piɛ sami bɔ ɔ he ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ. Osɔfo womi bɔ nɛ a kɛ la sãã, nɛ jee via ha Yawɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. 29Mose wo agbosu ɔ gugue ɔ nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ a fɔɔ kɛ yaa kɛ baa ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi. Kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa Mose ɔ, ke a gbe agbosu kɛ pee kusumi kɛ wo osɔfo ɔ, Mose lɛɛ e blɔ fa mi nɔ́ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
30Jehanɛ Mose ngɔ nɔ pɔmi nu ɔ eko, kɛ muɔ nɛ ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ hu eko, nɛ e kɛ fĩa Aaron kɛ e tade ɔmɛ a nɔ, kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ kɛ mɛ hu a tade ɔmɛ a nɔ. Mose pee enɛ ɔmɛ kɛ tsukɔ Aaron kɛ e tade ɔmɛ, kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ kɛ mɛ hu a tade ɔmɛ a he.
31Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Mose de Aaron kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ ke, “Nyɛ ya hoo lo ɔ ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ sinya a nya, nɛ nyɛɛ ye ngɛ lejɛ ɔ; nyɛɛ ngɔ abolo ɔ nɛ ngɛ kusii nɛ osɔfo womi bɔ sami ní ɔmɛ ngɛ mi ɔ kɛ ye kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa ke Aaron kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ pɛ nɛ a ye ɔ. 32Lo, loo abolo nɛ maa piɛ ɔ lɛɛ nyɛɛ sã. 33Nyɛɛ hi kpe he bo tsu ɔ sinya a nya ligbi kpaago. Nyɛ ko je lejɛ ɔ kɛ yaa su ligbi nɛ nyɛ maa gbe osɔfo womi kusumi ɔ nya. Ejakaa ligbi kpaago nɛ a kɛ maa wo nyɛ osɔfo. 34Nɔ́ nɛ a pee mwɔnɛ nɛ ɔ, ja nɛ Yawɛ fa ke a pee, konɛ a kɛ je nyɛ he yayami. 35Nyɛɛ hi kpe he bo tsu ɔ sinya a nya nyɔ kɛ pia ligbi kpaago kɛ tsu ní tsumi nɛ Yawɛ kɛ wo nyɛ dɛ ɔ; ke pi ja a, nyɛ ma gbo. Bɔ nɛ a fa mi ke ma de ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.” 36Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Aaron kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ pee nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ fa Mose ke a pee ɔ.

Title: MOSE III, 9
Content:
Aaron sã bɔhi
1Ligbi kpaanyɔne ɔ nɔ ɔ, Mose tsɛ Aaron kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ, kɛ Israel ma nikɔtɔma amɛ kɛ ba e ngɔ, 2nɛ e de Aaron ke, “Ngɔɔ na niheyo, kɛ agbosu nɛ kpa ko be a he kɛ ba sã bɔ ha Yawɛ. Ngɔɔ na niheyo ɔ kɛ sa yayami pami bɔ, nɛ o ngɔ agbosu ɔ kɛ sã sami bɔ. 3De Israel bi ɔmɛ ke a ngɔ akpakpo kɛ ba sã yayami pami bɔ, nɛ a ngɔ na bi nɛ ye jeha kake, kɛ jijɔ nɛ ye jeha kake, nɛ kpa ko be a he kɛ ba sa sami bɔ. 4Á ngɔ na ku, kɛ agbosu kɛ ba sã tue mi jɔmi bɔ ha Yawɛ kɛ piɛ niye ní bɔ nɛ a futu mi nu ɔ he. Á pee nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, ejakaa Yawɛ ma je e he kpo kɛ tsɔɔ mɛ mwɔnɛ ɔ.”
5A ngɔ ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ ba kpe he bo tsu ɔ hɛ mi kaa bɔ nɛ Mose fa mɛ ɔ. Kɛkɛ nɛ ma a tsuo bua a he nya ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi. 6Mose de mɛ ke, “Enɛ ɔ ji nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ fa ke nyɛɛ pee konɛ nyɛɛ na Yawɛ hɛ mi nyami ɔ.” 7 Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Mose de Aaron ke, “Yaa bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he, nɛ o ya sã yayami pami bɔ, kɛ sami bɔ kɛ je o kɛ ma a tsuo nyɛ he yayami ɔmɛ. Sãã bɔ nɛ ɔ nɛ o kɛ je ma a he yayami ɔmɛ kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa a.”
8Aaron hɛ lɛ kɛ su bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he, nɛ e gbe na niheyo ɔ nɛ e kɛ maa sã yayami pami bɔ kɛ ha lɛ nitsɛ e he ɔ. 9E binyumu ɔmɛ ngɔ muɔ ɔ kɛ ya ha lɛ, nɛ e ngɔ e nine nguɛ kɛ sɔ mi, nɛ e kɛ kpa bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ koli ɔmɛ a he. Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e tsɛ̃ muɔ ɔ ngɔ pue bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ sisi. 10Jehanɛ, e sã zɔ ɔ kɛ se tso mi ngmɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ, kɛ fafali ɔ he nɛ hi pe kulaa a ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa Mose ɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ. 11Se lohwe ɔ lo ɔ kɛ e he womi ɔ lɛɛ e ya sã mɛ ngɛ ma sito he ɔ se.
12Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, e gbe lohwe ɔ nɛ e kɛ maa sã sami bɔ kɛ ha lɛ nitsɛ e he ɔ. E binyumu ɔmɛ ngɔ muɔ ɔ kɛ ba ha lɛ, nɛ e tsɛ̃ ngɔ pue bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he kɛ kpe. 13A ngɔ lohwe ɔ yi ɔ, kɛ lo ɔ nɛ a poo kpɔ nya kpɔ nya a kɛ ha lɛ, nɛ e sã ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ. 14Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e fɔ mi ní ɔmɛ, kɛ nane ɔmɛ a he, nɛ e ngɔ mɛ ngɔ pue sami bɔ ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ e sã mɛ ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ.
15Jehanɛ, e sã bɔ kɛ ha ma a. E nu akpakpo ɔ nɛ a kɛ maa sã yayami pami bɔ kɛ ha ma a, nɛ e gbe lɛ, nɛ e kɛ sã bɔ kaa bɔ nɛ e pee lohwe ɔ nɛ e kɛ sã bɔ kɛ ha lɛ nitsɛ e he yayami pami ɔ. 16Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e ngɔ lohwe ɔ nɛ a kɛ maa sã sami bɔ ɔ hu kɛ ba sã bɔ kaa bɔ nɛ blɔ nya tomi ɔ ngɛ ɔ. 17Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, e sã niye ní bɔ ɔ. E piti ngma a e dɛ kɔkɔ kake, nɛ e sã ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ kɛ piɛ mɔtu sami bɔ ɔ he. 18 E gbe na ku ɔ, kɛ agbosu ɔ kɛ sã tue mi jɔmi bɔ kɛ ha ma a. E binyumu ɔmɛ ngɔ muɔ ɔ kɛ ba ha lɛ, nɛ e tsɛ̃ kɛ pue bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he kɛ kpe. 19Na ku ɔ zɔ ɔ, agbosu ɔ zɔ ɔ, kɛ hlemi ɔ, kɛ se tso mi ngmɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ fafali ɔ he nɛ hi pe kulaa a, 20Aaron ngɔ mɛ ngɔ pue lohwe ɔmɛ a gugue ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ e ya sã mɛ ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ. 21Kaa bɔ nɛ Mose fa ke a pee ɔ, gugue ɔmɛ, kɛ hiɔ nɔ fiɔ ɔ lɛɛ Aaron wo a nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ a fɔɔ kɛ yaa kɛ baa ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi.
22 Benɛ Aaron sã yayami pami bɔ ɔ, sami bɔ ɔ, kɛ tue mi jɔmi bɔ ɔ gbe nya a, e wo e nine nɔ ngɛ ma a nɔ nɛ e gbaa mɛ. Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e kple si kɛ je he nɛ e sã bɔ ɔmɛ ngɛ ɔ. 23Jehanɛ, Mose kɛ Aaron sɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ mi, nɛ benɛ a je kpo ɔ, a gbaa ma a. Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi nyami ɔ je kpo, nɛ ma a tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ na. 24Tlukaa a, Yawɛ ha nɛ la ba, nɛ e ba sã sami bɔ ɔ, kɛ zɔ ɔ nɛ ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ. Benɛ ni ɔmɛ tsuo na nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, a he ose, nɛ a kɛ a hɛ mi bu si.

Title: MOSE III, 10
Content:
Nadab kɛ Abihu pee yayami
1Aaron binyumuhi, Nadab kɛ Abihu a ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ ngɔ e ngɛyu, nɛ e je la ngɔ wo mi, nɛ e ngɔ tsopa kɛ e he via ngɔ pue nɔ, nɛ e kɛ ba Yawɛ hɛ mi; se la nɛ ɔ he tsɔ we, ejakaa Yawɛ fa we mɛ ke a pee ja. 2Tlukaa a, la je Yawɛ ngɔ ba sã mɛ, nɛ a gbo ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. 3Kɛkɛ nɛ Mose de Aaron ke, “Enɛ ɔ ji nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ de ɔ nɛ. E ke, ‘Nihi nɛ hɛ mɛ kɛ su ye he ɔ, ma tsɔɔ mɛ bɔ nɛ i ngɛ klɔuklɔu ha, nɛ a maa wo ye hɛ mi nyami ngɛ ma a tsuo hɛ mi.’ ” Se Aaron de we nɔ́ ko.
4Mose tsɛ Aaron tsɛ nyɛminyumu Uziel bimɛ, Mishael kɛ Elzafan kɛ ba, nɛ e de mɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ ba hiɛ ɔ nɛ nyɛ ba muɔ nyɛ nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ kɛ je he klɔuklɔu ɔ kɛ ho ma a sito he ɔ se ya.” 5A ba muɔ mɛ kɛ a he tade ɔmɛ kɛ ho ma sito he ɔ se ya kaa bɔ nɛ Mose de mɛ ɔ.
6Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, Mose de Aaron kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ, Eleazar kɛ Itamar ke, “Nyɛ ko ngmɛɛ nyɛ yi bwɔmi he kɛ pue nyɛ nɔ, nɛ nyɛ ko hía nyɛ tadehi ngɛ nyɛ he hulɔ kɛ tsɔɔ kaa nyɛ ngɛ kɔmɔ yee. Ke nyɛ pee ja a, nyɛ ma gbo, nɛ Yawɛ mi mi ma fu ma a tsuo. Se nyɛ nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ Israel we ɔ tsuo kulaa ma nyɛ maa ye kɔmɔ nɛ a nyɛ ya ha gbogboe ɔmɛ nɛ Yawɛ la sã a. 7Nyɛ ko je kpe he bo tsu ɔ sinya a nya kɛ ya he ko. Ke nyɛ pee ja a, nyɛ ma gbo; ejakaa a kɛ Yawɛ nu pɔ nyɛ.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a pee kaa bɔ nɛ Mose de ɔ.
Mlaa nɛ a wo osɔfo ɔmɛ
8Yawɛ kɛ Aaron tu munyu, nɛ e de lɛ ke, 9“O kɛ o binyumu ɔmɛ nyɛ ti nɔ ko nɔ ko kó nu wai, loo dã nɛ nya wa kɛ ya kpe he bo tsu ɔ mi. Ke nyɛ pee ja a, nyɛ ma gbo. Enɛ ɔ maa pee mlaa nɛ fɔɔ si ha nyɛ kɛ yaa neneene. 10Nyɛɛ le slɔɔto nɛ ngɛ nɔ́ klɔuklɔu, kɛ nɔ́ gu a kpɛti, nɔ́ nɛ he tsɔ, kɛ nɔ́ nɛ he tsɔ we. 11Nyɛɛ tsɔɔ Israel bi ɔmɛ mlaa amɛ tsuo kulaa nɛ́ imi Yawɛ, i wo mɛ kɛ gu Mose nɔ ɔ.”
12 Jehanɛ, Mose de Aaron kɛ e binyumuhi enyɔ ɔmɛ nɛ piɛ, nɛ ji Eleazar kɛ Itamar ke, “Niye ní bɔhi nɛ a kɛ la sãã ha Yawɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ ngɔ nɔ́ nɛ piɛ ɔ; nyɛ ko wo mi masa nɛ nyɛɛ ye ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ kasa nya, ejakaa e he tsɔ saminya. 13Nyɛɛ ye ngɛ he ko nɛ ngɛ klɔuklɔu, ejakaa bɔhi nɛ a kɛ la sãã kɛ haa Yawɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ nyɛ blɔ fami nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ to ji lɔ ɔ nɛ. 14 Se lohwe ɔ gugue nɛ a fɔɔ, kɛ fiɔ ɔ nɛ a woɔ nɔ́ ɔ, o kɛ o binyumu ɔmɛ, kɛ o biyi ɔmɛ nɛ ye ngɛ he ko nɛ tsɔ; ejakaa tue mi jɔmi bɔ ɔmɛ nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ ba sãã a, o kɛ o bimɛ ɔmɛ nyɛ blɔ fa mi nɔ́ ji lɔ ɔ nɛ. 15Fiɔ ɔ, kɛ gugue ɔ nɛ a fɔɔ kɛ yaa kɛ baa ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi ɔ, á ngɔ kɛ piɛ zɔ ɔ nɛ a kɛ la sãã a he kɛ ba kaa bɔ nɛ a fɔɔ kɛ yaa kɛ baa ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi. Fiɔ ɔ, kɛ gugue ɔ maa pee o kɛ o binyumu ɔmɛ nyɛ nɔ́ kɛ yaa neneene kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa a.”
16Enɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a se ɔ, Mose hla mi fitsofitso konɛ e le nɔ́ ko ngɛ apletsi ɔ nɛ a kɛ maa sã yayami pami bɔ ɔ he. Benɛ e na le kaa a sã lɛ momo ɔ, e mi mi fu Eleazar kɛ Itamar, Aaron bimɛ ɔmɛ nɛ piɛ ɔ, nɛ e bi mɛ ke, 17 “Mɛni he je nɛ nyɛ yi yayami pami bɔ ɔ ngɛ he klɔuklɔu ɔ? Nyɛ li kaa e ji nɔ́ ko nɛ ngɛ klɔuklɔu, nɛ Mawu kɛ ha nyɛ nɛ nyɛ kɛ je ma a he yayami kɛ kpata Yawɛ kɛ ha mɛ lo? 18Nɛ nyɛ ngɔɛ e muɔ ɔ kɛ yɛ he klɔuklɔu ɔ, jinɛ e sa kaa nyɛɛ ye bɔ sami ní ɔ ngɛ he klɔuklɔu ɔ kɛkɛ kaa bɔ nɛ i fa nyɛ ɔ.”
19Aaron he nɔ ke, “O nɛ, mwɔnɛ ɔ, ma a ngɔ a he yayami pami bɔ ɔ, kɛ a sami bɔ ɔ ba ha Yawɛ, nɛ nɔ́ nɛ ba ye nɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ! Kaa i ye yayami pami bɔ nɛ ɔ eko mwɔnɛ ɔ, e ko sa Yawɛ hɛ mi lo?” 20Benɛ Mose nu munyu nɛ ɔ, munyu ɔ da ha lɛ.

Title: MOSE III, 11
Content:
Lohwehi nɛ á ye
(Mose V, 14.3-21)
1Yawɛ wo mlaa nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ gu Mose kɛ Aaron nɔ kɛ ha 2Israel bi ɔmɛ. Lohwe nane eywiɛɛywiɛtsɛmɛ nɛ nyɛ ma nyɛ maa ye ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ. 3Lohwe tsuaa lohwe nɛ a gba e nane koklotohi a mi, nɛ e gɔleɔ nɔ́ nɛ e ye ɔ nɛ e kpaleɔ taa ekohu ɔ, nyɛ ma nyɛ maa ye. 4-6Se nyɛ ko ye enɛ ɔmɛ: afukpɔngɔ, tɛ sa nɔ kpi, kɛ alɔngɔ, ejakaa a gɔleɔ nɔ́ nɛ a ye ɔ nɛ a kpaleɔ taa ekohu lɛɛ, se a gba we a nane kokloto mi, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a he tsɔ we. 7Nyɛ ko ye kpotoo, e he tsɔ we, ejakaa a gba e nane kokloto mi lɛɛ, se e gɔle we nɔ́ nɛ e ye ɔ nɛ e ta ekohu. 8Nyɛ ko ye lohwe nɛ ɔmɛ, nɛ nyɛ ko ta a gbogboe he hulɔ; a he tsɔ we.
9Nyɛ ma nyɛ maa ye lo nɛ ɔmɛ: lo tsuaa lo nɛ ngɛ se ngmo kɛ toto. 10Se nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ wami ngɛ e mi ngɛ wo loo pa mi, nɛ e be se ngmo kɛ toto ɔ, nyɛ ko ye. 11A he tsɔ we; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ ko ye, nɛ nyɛ ko ta a gbogboe he hulɔ. 12Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ nyu mi nɛ wami ngɛ e mi, se e be se ngmo kɛ toto ɔ, nyɛ ko ye; a he tsɔ we.
13-19Nyɛ ko ye lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ kɛ a henɔ nɛ ɔmɛ: kɔle, okpoku, pa nɔ kɔle, kayo, kɔɔkɔmite, duguma, anuma, nyɔ mi kayo, klomi, nga mi kpakpahe, pa nɔ kayo, omiɔhɔɔ, kpokukpoku, godo, kɔne, loo apani.
20Nyɛ ko ye lohwe tsɔwi nane eywiɛtsɛmɛ nɛ tee, 21ja ní nɛmɛ nɛ tuu ɔ. 22Nyɛ ma nyɛ maa ye baalɛ, apã, adodo, kɛ a henɔ ɔmɛ. 23Se lohwe tsɔwi nane eywiɛtsɛmɛ nɛ tee kpahi ɔ, nyɛ ko ye; a he tsɔ we.
24-28Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa ta lohwe nɛ ɔmɛ eko gbogboe he ɔ, e he be tsɔe kɛ yaa si du ma bu: lohwehi tsuo nɛ a gba we a nane kokloto mi, nɛ a gɔle we nɔ́ nɛ a ye ɔ nɛ a ta ekohu, kɛ lohwe nane eywiɛɛywiɛtsɛmɛ nɛ be kokloto, se a nyɛɛ ngɛ a nine a nɔ ɔ, mɛ tsuo a he tsɔ we. Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa ta eko gbogboe he ɔ bleɔ e he. Ke nɔ ko ble e he ja a, é fɔ e tade ɔmɛ a he; se kɛ ɔ, e he be tsɔe kɛ yaa si du ma bu.
29Lohwehi nɛ sãã si ngɛ zugba a nɔ nɛ a he tsɔ we ha nyɛ ji kɔkɔbo, kɔkue, ve, kɛ e henɔ ɔmɛ, 30tsunyɛ, nyaka, akɔtɔku, angmlɔ, kɛ akpasi. 31A he tsɔ we, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa ta eko gbogboe he ɔ, e he be tsɔe kɛ yaa si du ma bu. 32Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ lohwe nɛ ɔmɛ eko gbogboe maa sa he ɔ, e he be tsɔe; tso a kɛ pee nɔ ɔ jio, bo jio, lohwe he womi jio, kotoku jio, nɔ́ saisaa jio. Á kɛ nyu nɛ fɔ he, se nɔ́ ɔ he be tsɔe kɛ yaa si du ma bu. 33Ke lohwe nɛ ɔmɛ eko gbogboe ko ya nɔ buɛ mi ɔ, e bleɔ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ buɛ ɔ mi ɔ; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, á ywia buɛ ɔ. 34Ke buɛ nɛ ɔ mi nyu ɔ eko pue niye ní ko nɔ ɔ, niye ní ɔ he be tsɔe. Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ a nuu nɛ ngɛ kikɛmɛ a buɛ ɔ mi ɔ he be tsɔe. 35Jehanɛ, nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ kikɛmɛ a lohwe nɛ ɔmɛ eko gbogboe maa nɔ nɔ ɔ, nɔ́ ɔ he be tsɔe, la tɛ jio, flɔɔnɔɔ jio, á ywia nɔ́ ɔ wɔtsɔwɔtsɔ. 36Ke lohwe nɛ ɔmɛ eko gbogboe ya nɔ nyu hɛngmɛ, loo nyu nɔ́ ko mi ɔ, nyu ɔ he tsɔ; se nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ maa sa a gbogboe he ɔ he tsɔ we. 37Ke lohwe gbogboe ɔ he ko nɔ wu nɛ a yaa du nɔ ɔ, e be wu ɔ blee, 38se ke a wo wu ɔ nyu nɛ lohwe gbogboe nɔ nɔ ɔ, e bleɔ lɛ.
39Jehanɛ, ke lohwehi nɛ a yeɔ ɔ eko gbo ɔ, nɔ nɛ maa ta e gbogboe ɔ he ɔ, e he be tsɔe kɛ yaa si du ma bu. 40Ke nɔ ko ye lo nɛ ɔ eko ɔ, é fɔ e tade ɔmɛ a he. Se lɛ nitsɛ lɛɛ e he be tsɔe kɛ yaa si du ma bu. Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa kɛ̃ e gbogboe ɔ bleɔ e he; ke nɔ ko ble e he ja a, nɔ ɔ nɛ fɔ e tade ɔmɛ a he, se e he be tsɔe kɛ yaa si du ma bu.
41Lohwehi nɛ sãã si ɔ, a he tsɔ we; nyɛ ko ye. 42Ke a sãã si ngɛ a mi nɔ jio, a nane eywiɛ nɔ jio, a nane babauu nɔ jio, nyɛ ko ye; a he tsɔ we. 43Nyɛ ko ta lohwehi nɛ sãã si ɔ eko he. Ke nyɛ pee ja a, nyɛ bleɔ nyɛ he, nɛ nyɛ he tsɔ we. 44 Imi ji Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ nɛ. Nyɛɛ pee nyɛ he klɔuklɔu; ejakaa Nɔ Klɔuklɔu ji mi. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, lohwehi nɛ sãã si ɔ, nyɛ ko ngɔ ekoeko kɛ ble nyɛ he. 45Imi ji Yawɛ. Imi nɛ I je nyɛ kɛ je Egipt zugba a nɔ, konɛ ma ba pee nyɛ Mawu. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ pee nyɛ he klɔuklɔu; ejakaa Nɔ Klɔuklɔu ji mi.
46Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, lohwe nane eywiɛɛywiɛtsɛmɛ, lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ, kɛ adebɔ níhi tsuo nɛ ngɛ nyu mi, kɛ adebɔ níhi tsuo nɛ sãã si ngɛ zugba a nɔ ɔ, mlaa nɛ kɔɔ a he ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ. 47Mlaa nɛ ɔ tsɔɔ slɔɔto nɛ ngɛ lohwehi nɛ a he tsɔ, kɛ lohwehi nɛ a he tsɔ we a kpɛti, kɛ slɔɔto nɛ ngɛ lohwehi nɛ a yeɔ, kɛ lohwehi nɛ a yi a kpɛti.

Title: MOSE III, 12
Content:
Yihi a he tsukɔmi ngɛ fɔmi se
1Mlaahi nɛ Yawɛ wo 2Israel bi ɔmɛ kɛ gu Mose nɔ ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ. Ke yo ko ngɔ hɔ nɛ e fɔ binyumu ɔ, e he be tsɔe ligbi kpaago, kaa bɔ nɛ e he be tsɔe, ke e ku nine ɔ. 3 Ke binyumu ɔ ye ligbi kpaanyɔ ɔ, á po lɛ. 4Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, bi nyɛ ɔ he be tsɔe kɛ yaa si ligbi nyingmi etɛ kɛ etɛ se loko e he ma tsɔ. Be nɛ ɔ mi tsuo ɔ, e ko ta nɔ́ ko nɛ ngɛ klɔuklɔu he, nɛ e ko ya he klɔuklɔu ɔ hulɔ, kɛ yaa si be nɛ e maa tsukɔ e he kɛ gbe nya, ngɛ muɔ nɛ be ngɛ e he ɔ he.
5Se ke biyo e fɔ ɔ, lɛɛ e he be tsɔe otsi enyɔ, kaa bɔ nɛ e he be tsɔe, ke e ku nine ɔ. E he be tsɔe kɛ yaa si ligbi nyingmi ekpa kɛ ekpa nɛ e maa tsukɔ e he kɛ gbe nya.
6Ke yo ɔ gbe e he tsukɔmi ɔ nya ngɛ binyumu, loo biyo fɔmi se ɔ, e ngɔ jijɔ nɛ ye jeha kake, kɛ lahuɛ, loo beleku lahuɛ kake kɛ ba ha osɔfo ɔ ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ sinya a nya. Osɔfo ɔ nɛ ngɔ jijɔ ɔ kɛ sã sami bɔ. Lahuɛ, loo beleku lahuɛ ɔ lɛɛ e kɛ sã yayami pami bɔ. 7Osɔfo ɔ nɛ ngɔ ní nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ ba ha Yawɛ, nɛ e pee kusumi kɛ tsukɔ yo ɔ he; kɛkɛ ɔ, e he ma tsɔ. Enɛ ɔ ji mlaa nɛ fɔɔ si ha yihi tsuo nɛ ma fɔ binyumu, loo biyo.
8 Ke yo ɔ be nyɛe nɛ e kɛ jijɔ bi ma ba sã bɔ ɔ, lɛɛ e ngɔ lahuɛ enyɔ, loo beleku lahuɛ enyɔ kɛ ba. E ngɔ kake kɛ ba sã sami bɔ, nɛ e ngɔ kake hu kɛ ba sã yayami pami bɔ. Osɔfo ɔ nɛ pee kusumi kɛ tsukɔ yo ɔ he; kɛkɛ ɔ, e he ma tsɔ.

Title: MOSE III, 13
Content:
He womi nɔ hiɔ yaya he mlaahi
1Yawɛ wo Mose kɛ Aaron mlaa nɛ ɔmɛ. 2Ke nɔfu nɔ́ ko, aloo pa, loo loholoho ba nɔ ko he, nɛ́ ma nyɛ maa pee he womi nɔ hiɔ yaya a, a ngɔ hiɔtsɛ ɔ kɛ ba osɔfo ɔ, nɛ ji Aaron nina a ngɔ. 3Osɔfo ɔ nɛ hyɛ e he womi ɔ he nɛ hiɔ ɔ ngɛ ɔ. Ke bwɔmi nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ tsake pee futaa, nɛ lejɛ ɔ lo ɔ hu nɔ mi ɔ, lɛɛ e ji he womi nɔ hiɔ yaya. Ke osɔfo ɔ hyɛ lɛ ta a, e ma ha nɛ a le kaa nɔ ɔ he tsɔ we. 4Se ke he womi ɔ nɔ he nɛ hiɔ ɔ ngɛ ɔ ngɛ futaa, nɛ ke a hyɛ ɔ, e nɔɛ lo mi, nɛ pohu bwɔmi ɔ be futaa hulɔ ɔ, osɔfo ɔ nɛ tsi hiɔtsɛ ɔ nya ligbi kpaago. 5Ligbi kpaagone ɔ nɔ ɔ, osɔfo ɔ nɛ hyɛ lɛ ekohu. Ke osɔfo ɔ hyɛ nɛ e na kaa hiɔ ɔ hɛ́ si, se he kake ɔ kɛ̃ nɛ e ngɛ ɔ, e tsi e nya ligbi kpaago ekohu. 6Ligbi nɛ ji kpaago ɔ, e hyɛ lɛ ekohu. Ke e na kaa he nɛ hiɔ ɔ ngɛ ɔ yu, nɛ hiɔ ɔ hɛ́ si ngɛ hiɔtsɛ ɔ he womi nɔ ɔ, osɔfo ɔ nɛ ha nɛ a le kaa hiɔtsɛ ɔ he tsɔ; ejakaa e ji nɔfu nɔ́ kɛkɛ. Hiɔtsɛ ɔ nɛ fɔ e tade ɔmɛ a he, kɛkɛ e he ma tsɔ. 7Se ke osɔfo ɔ hyɛ lɛ nɛ e ha a le kaa e he tsɔ, nɛ pee se ɔ, nɔfu nɔ́ ɔ bɔni si hami ɔ, hiɔtsɛ ɔ nɛ ngɔ e he ba tsɔɔ osɔfo ɔ ekohu. 8Ke osɔfo ɔ hyɛ lɛ, nɛ e na kaa nɔfu nɔ́ ɔ ha si ɔ, e ha nɛ a le kaa e he tsɔ we; he womi nɔ hiɔ yaya e ngɛ nue ɔ nɛ.
9Ke nɔ ko ngɛ he womi nɔ hiɔ yaya nue ɔ, a ngɔ lɛ kɛ ba ha osɔfo ɔ, 10nɛ e hyɛ lɛ. Ke e na nɔfu nɔ́ ko ngɛ e he womi nɔ, nɛ bwɔmi nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ pee futaa, nɛ bua ba nɔfu nɔ́ ɔ mi ɔ, 11lɛɛ he womi nɔ hiɔ yaya nɛ se kɛ nɔ ɔ ngɛ nue ɔ nɛ. Osɔfo ɔ nɛ ha nɛ a nu sisi kaa e he tsɔ we. A ko tsi e nya; ejakaa e fɔɔ si paa kaa e he tsɔ we. 12Ke osɔfo ɔ na kaa hiɔ ɔ je kpo ngɛ e he womi nɔ, nɛ e ha hiɔtsɛ ɔ he womi nɔ kulaa kɛ je e yi je kɛ ya pue e nanewɛɛ ɔ, 13e hyɛ lɛ ekohu. Ke e na nɔ́ ɔ kaa e ha e nɔmlɔ tso ɔ tsuo he ɔ, e ha nɛ hiɔtsɛ ɔ nɛ le kaa e he tsɔ. Ke e he womi ɔ tsuo pee futaa a, e he tsɔ ji lɔ ɔ nɛ. 14Se ke pa he je kpo ngɛ e he womi ɔ nɔ ɔ, lɛɛ e he tsɔ we. 15Osɔfo ɔ nɛ hyɛ nɔ ɔ pa he ɔ, e ha nɛ nɔ ɔ nɛ le kaa e he tsɔ we. Pa he ɔ nɛ je kpo ɔ tsɔɔ kaa he womi nɔ hiɔ yaya e ngɛ nue ɔ nɛ; nɔ ɔ he tsɔ we. 16Ke pa a gbo, nɛ e he womi lo ɔ pee futaa ekohu ɔ, hiɔtsɛ ɔ nɛ kpale ba na osɔfo ɔ. 17Osɔfo ɔ nɛ hyɛ lɛ ekohu. Ke e na kaa hiɔtsɛ ɔ he womi ɔ pee futaa a, e ha nɛ e le kaa e he tsɔ. E he tsɔ niinɛ.
18Ke tslɔɔ pa doku ngɛ nɔ ko he womi nɔ, 19nɛ nɔfu nɔ́ futaa, loo nɔ́ futaa nɛ tsutsuu su bɔɔ ngɛ mi je kpo ngɛ pa doku ɔ mi ɔ, e kɛ ya tsɔɔ osɔfo ɔ. 20Ke osɔfo ɔ hyɛ, nɛ e na kaa lejɛ ɔ nɔ lo mi, nɛ bwɔmi nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ pee futaa a, e ha nɛ e le kaa e he tsɔ we; he womi nɔ hiɔ yaya nɛ́ je kpo ngɛ tslɔɔ mi nɔ ɔ ngɛ nue ɔ nɛ. 21Se ke osɔfo ɔ hyɛ lɛ, nɛ e na kaa bwɔmi nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ pee we futaa, nɛ e nɔɛ lo mi hulɔ, se nɔ́ ɔ fani ɔ, lɛɛ e tsi hiɔtsɛ ɔ nya ligbi kpaago. 22Ke nɔfu nɔ́ ɔ ha si ngɛ e he womi ɔ nɔ ɔ, lɛɛ hiɔ ɔ e ngɛ nue ɔ nɛ; osɔfo ɔ nɛ ha nɛ e le kaa e he tsɔ we. 23Se ke nɔfu nɔ́ ɔ ngɛ he kake, nɛ e hɛ́ si ɔ, lɛɛ e ji tslɔɔ pa doku kɛkɛ; osɔfo ɔ nɛ ha nɛ nɔ ɔ nɛ le kaa e he tsɔ.
24Ke la sã nɔ ko nɛ e pee pa, nɛ pa a pee loholoho futaa, loo futaa nɛ tsutsuu bɔɔ ngɛ mi ɔ, 25osɔfo ɔ nɛ hyɛ lɛ. Ke e na kaa lejɛ ɔ nɔ lo mi, nɛ bwɔmi nɛ ngɛ loholoho ɔ mi ɔ pee futaa a, lɛɛ he womi nɔ hiɔ yaya lɛ je e he kpo ngɛ la pa a mi ɔ nɛ; osɔfo ɔ nɛ ha nɛ e le kaa e he tsɔ we. 26Ke osɔfo ɔ hyɛ nɔ ɔ, nɛ e na kaa bwɔmi nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ pee we futaa, nɛ lejɛ ɔ nɔɛ lo mi hulɔ, se e fani ɔ, osɔfo ɔ nɛ tsi e nya ligbi kpaago. 27Osɔfo ɔ nɛ hyɛ lɛ ekohu ligbi kpaagone ɔ, nɛ ke e na kaa nɔ́ ɔ ngɛ si hae ngɛ e he womi ɔ nɔ ɔ, lɛɛ e ha nɛ e le kaa e he tsɔ we; ejakaa he womi nɔ hiɔ yaya e ngɛ nue ɔ nɛ. 28Ke nɔ́ ɔ ngɛ he kake, nɛ e hɛ́ si ngɛ e he womi ɔ nɔ, se e fani mohu ɔ, lɛɛ nɔfu nɔ́ nɛ je kpo ngɛ pa a mi ji lɔ ɔ nɛ. Osɔfo ɔ nɛ ha nɛ e le kaa e he tsɔ, ejakaa e ji la pa doku kɛkɛ.
29Ke nɔ́ ko pue nyumu ko, loo yo ko yi mi, loo e kpɛni he ɔ, 30osɔfo ɔ nɛ hyɛ. Ke he nɛ hiɔ ɔ ngɛ ɔ nɔ lo mi, nɛ bwɔmi nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ hɛɛ kungwɔ zɔ su, nɛ e pee dleledlele ɔ, osɔfo ɔ nɛ ha nɛ e le kaa yi mi, loo kpɛni mi he womi nɔ hiɔ yaya nɛ plɛɛ nɔ e ngɛ nue ɔ nɛ; e he tsɔ we. 31Se ke osɔfo ɔ hyɛ hiɔ ɔ, nɛ e na kaa lejɛ ɔ nɔɛ lo mi, nɛ bwɔmi yumu hu be mi ɔ, lɛɛ osɔfo ɔ nɛ tsi hiɔtsɛ ɔ nya ligbi kpaago. 32Ligbi nɛ ji kpaago ɔ, e hyɛ hiɔtsɛ ɔ ekohu. Ke hiɔ ɔ hɛ́ si, nɛ bwɔmi nɛ hɛɛ kungwɔ zɔ su be mi, nɛ lejɛ ɔ hu nɔɛ lo mi ɔ, 33lɛɛ hiɔtsɛ ɔ nɛ sɛ lejɛ ɔ bwɔmi ɔ pɛ kɛ bɔle nɔ́ ɔ nɛ ngɛ lɛ plɛe ɔ. Osɔfo ɔ nɛ tsi hiɔtsɛ ɔ nya ligbi kpaago ekohu. 34Ligbi nɛ ji kpaago ɔ, osɔfo ɔ nɛ hyɛ hiɔ ɔ ekohu. Ke hiɔ ɔ hɛ́ si, nɛ e nɔɛ lo mi hulɔ ɔ, osɔfo ɔ nɛ ha nɛ hiɔtsɛ ɔ nɛ le kaa e he tsɔ. Hiɔtsɛ ɔ nɛ fɔ e tade ɔmɛ a he, kɛkɛ ɔ, e he ma tsɔ. 35Ke benɛ a ha nɛ e le kaa e he tsɔ se nɛ hiɔ ɔ bɔni si hami ɔ, 36osɔfo ɔ nɛ hyɛ lɛ ekohu. Ke e na kaa hiɔ ɔ ha si ɔ, osɔfo ɔ ko hao e he kaa e ma pa hla bwɔmi nɛ hɛɛ kungwɔ zɔ su nɛ e na; e fɔɔ si paa kaa hiɔtsɛ ɔ he tsɔ we. 37Se ke osɔfo ɔ ma nɔ mi kaa hiɔ ɔ ta, nɛ bwɔmi yumu puɛ ngɛ mi ɔ, lɛɛ hiɔ ɔ jɔ niinɛ, nɛ hiɔtsɛ ɔ he tsɔ. Osɔfo ɔ nɛ ha nɛ hiɔtsɛ ɔ nɛ le kaa e he tsɔ.
38Ke ngmo pue nyumu ko, loo yo ko he, nɛ e he womi ɔ pee huataa a, 39osɔfo ɔ nɛ hyɛ lɛ. Ke ngmo ɔ su ngɛ kaa la zu huataa a, lɛɛ e ji kó kɛkɛ nɛ je kpo ngɛ e he womi nɔ; nɔ ɔ he tsɔ.
40Ke bwɔmi ta nyumu yi mi ɔ, e yi mi kɛkɛ lɛ kpa; se e he tsɔ. 41Ke bwɔmi ta nyumu hɛ nya a, e hɛ nya kɛkɛ lɛ kpa; se e he tsɔ. Ke nɔ́ ɔ tsuɔ, loo e hɛɛ ba mumu su ɔ, lɛɛ he womi nɔ hiɔ yaya lɛ pue e yi ɔ he nɛ kpa a nɛ. 42Se ke nɔ́ ko futaa nɛ tsutsuu bɔɔ fia mi pue nɔ ɔ yi mi, loo e hɛ nya he nɛ kpa a, lɛɛ he womi nɔ hiɔ yaya lɛ je kpo ngɛ e yi ɔ mi, kɛ e hɛ nya he nɛ kpa a nɛ. 43Osɔfo ɔ nɛ hyɛ lɛ. Ke e na kaa nɔ́ nɛ pue nɔ ɔ yi mi, loo e hɛ nya a ngɛ futaa nɛ tsutsuu bɔɔ fia mi ɔ, 44osɔfo ɔ nɛ ha nɛ e le kaa e he tsɔ we; ejakaa he womi nɔ hiɔ yaya lɛ ngɛ e yi mi ɔ nɛ.
45Ke nɔ ko ngɛ he womi nɔ hiɔ yaya nue ɔ, é wo tade gbagbɛ, é ngmɛɛ e yi bwɔmi he kɛ pue e nɔ, e ha e nya nɔ, nɛ e hi ngmlaa kpae ke, “Ye he tsɔ we oo, ye he tsɔ we!” 46E he be tsɔe kɛ yaa si be nɛ e hiɔ ɔ maa ta; nɛ lɛ nɔ kake nɛ e maa hi si ngɛ ma sito he ɔ se.
Mlaahi nɛ kɔɔ nɔ́ nɛ fu ja he
47Ke he hami nɔ́ ko fu ja a, kuutu jio, kploba jio, 48bo nɛ a kɛ kuutu kpa, loo kploba kpa lo jio, lohwe he womi, loo nɔ́ ko nɛ a kɛ lohwe he womi pee jio, 49ke nɔ́ fu ja a tsuɔ, loo e hɛɛ ba mumu su ɔ, e maa pee kaa nɔ́ yaya lɛ ngɛ ja fue ngɛ he hami nɔ́ ɔ mi ɔ nɛ; a ngɔ kɛ ya tsɔɔ osɔfo ɔ. 50Osɔfo ɔ nɛ hyɛ nɔ́ ɔ, nɛ e tsi heha nɔ́ ɔ nya ligbi kpaago. 51Ligbi kpaagone ɔ, osɔfo ɔ nɛ hyɛ nɔ́ ɔ ekohu. Ke nɔ́ fu ja a ha si ngɛ he hami nɔ́ ɔ mi ɔ lɛɛ e ji nɔ fu ja yaya, e he tsɔ we. 52Osɔfo ɔ nɛ sã he hami nɔ́ ɔ. Hiɔ yaya ji nɔ́ nɛ sɛ nɔ́ ɔ mi ɔ nɛ; e hia kaa a sã.
53Se ke osɔfo ɔ hyɛ nɔ́ ɔ, nɛ e na kaa nɔ́ fu ja a hɛ́ si ngɛ he hami nɔ́ ɔ mi ɔ, 54e ha nɛ a fɔ he, nɛ e tsi nya ligbi kpaago ekohu. 55Osɔfo ɔ nɛ hyɛ nɔ́ ɔ; ke nɔ́ fu ja a su tsakee we, nɛ e hɛ́ si hulɔ ɔ, nɔ́ ɔ he tsɔ we; nyɛɛ sã. Nɔ́ ɔ hɛ mi nɛ fu ja a jio, e se mi jio, á sã.
56Se ke a fɔ nɔ́ ɔ he se, nɛ osɔfo ɔ hyɛ ekohu nɛ e na kaa nɔ́ nɛ sɛ mi ɔ ngɛ laae ɔ, e hia he nɛ fu ja a kɛ je nɔ́ ɔ he, he hami nɔ́ jio, lohwe he womi jio. 57Jehanɛ, ke nɔtsɛ ɔ na kaa nɔ́ ɔ ngɛ ja fue kɛ ngɛ si hae ngɛ he hami nɔ́, loo lohwe he womi ɔ mi kɛ mwɔɔ ɔ, a sã nɔ́ ɔ. 58Ke e fɔ nɔ́ ɔ he, nɛ e na kaa nɔ́ yaya a je mi pɛsɛɛ ɔ, e fɔ he ekohu si enyɔne, kɛkɛ ɔ, nɔ́ ɔ he ma tsɔ kulaa.
59Mlaa nɛ ɔ ngɛ kɛ ha nɔ́ fu ja ngɛ he hami ní nɛ ɔmɛ a mi: he hami nɔ́ nɛ a kɛ kuutu, loo kploba pee jio, bo nɛ a kɛ kuutu, loo kploba kpa lo jio, lohwe he womi, loo nɔ́ ko nɛ a kɛ lohwe he womi pee jio. Enɛ ɔ nɛ maa tsɔɔ kaa nɔ́ ɔ he tsɔ, loo e he tsɔ we.

Title: MOSE III, 14
Content:
He womi nɔ hiɔ yaya numi se he tsukɔmi
1-2 Yawɛ wo Mose mlaa nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ tsɔɔ kusumi nɛ a pee kɛ tsukɔ nɔ ko nɛ nu he womi nɔ hiɔ yaya nɛ a tsa lɛ ɔ he. Ligbi nɛ a ma ha nɛ e le kaa e he tsɔ ɔ, a kɛ lɛ nɛ ba osɔfo ɔ ngɔ. 3Osɔfo ɔ nɛ ngɔ lɛ kɛ je ma sito he ɔ, nɛ e ya hyɛ lɛ. Ke e na kaa hiɔ ɔ ta ngɛ nɔ ɔ he ɔ, 4e fa nɛ a kɛ lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ nɛ a he tsɔ enyɔ, seda tso, kɔjai, kɛ nga nɛ a fi kɛ bla kaa bɛ nɛ ba. 5Osɔfo ɔ nɛ fa nɛ a gbe lohwe pɛlitsɛ ɔ kake ngɛ zu buɛ nɛ nyu mua ngɛ mi nɔ, 6konɛ e ngɔ lohwe pɛlitsɛ hɛngmengmletsɛ ɔ, seda tso ɔ, kɔjai ɔ, kɛ nga nɛ a fi kɛ bla kaa bɛ ɔ, nɛ e kɛ sɔ lohwe pɛlitsɛ nɛ a gbe ɔ ngɛ nyu mua nɔ ɔ muɔ ɔ mi. 7Jehanɛ, é fĩa muɔ ɔ si kpaago kɛ pue nɔ nɛ nu he womi nɔ hiɔ yaya nɛ ma e he tsukɔmi ɔ nɔ, nɛ é ha nɛ e le kaa e he tsɔ. Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, é ngmɛɛ lohwe hɛngmengmletsɛ ɔ he nɛ é te kɛ ho nga mi ya. 8Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, nɔ nɛ ma e he tsukɔmi ɔ nɛ fɔ e tade ɔmɛ a he, nɛ é sɛ e he bwɔmi tsuo, nɛ é du e he; kɛkɛ e he ma tsɔ. E ma nyɛ maa ba ma sito he ɔ, se e be e bo tsu ɔ mi hwɔe; e maa hi e bo tsu ɔ se ligbi kpaago. 9Ligbi kpaagone ɔ, nɔ ɔ nɛ sɛ e yi kpalokpalo; é sɛ e kpɛni kɛ e hɛngmɛ se bwɔmi, kɛ e he bwɔmi tsuo kulaa. Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, é fɔ e tade ɔmɛ a he, nɛ é du e he, kɛkɛ e he ma tsɔ.
10Ligbi nɛ ji kpaanyɔ ɔ, é ngɔ agbosu enyɔ nɛ kpa ko be a he, kɛ jijɔ yo nɛ ye jeha kake, nɛ lɛ hu kpa ko be e he, kɛ níye ní bɔ mamu bukɔbukɔ kilo etɛ nɛ a kɛ nu futu mi, kɛ nu lita fa kɛ ba. 11Osɔfo ɔ nɛ maa tsukɔ nɔ ɔ he ha lɛ ɔ nɛ ngɔ lɛ, kɛ e ní ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ ba Yawɛ hɛ mi ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ sinya a nya. 12Osɔfo ɔ nɛ ngɔ agbosu enyɔ ɔmɛ a ti kake kɛ piɛ nu lita fa a he kɛ ba kaa fɔ yemi bɔ, nɛ e ngɔ mɛ kɛ ba kaa bɔ nɛ a fɔɔ kɛ yaa kɛ baa ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi. 13É gbe agbosu ɔ ngɛ he klɔuklɔu ɔ, he nɛ a gbee lohwe nɛ a kɛ sãã yayami pami bɔ, kɛ sami bɔ ngɛ ɔ. Ejakaa yayami pami bɔ ɔ, osɔfo ɔmɛ a nɔ́ kaa bɔ nɛ fɔ yemi bɔ ɔ ngɛ ɔ; e ngɛ klɔuklɔu saminya. 14Osɔfo ɔ nɛ ngɔ lohwe nɛ a kɛ ba sã fɔ yemi bɔ ɔ e muɔ eko kɛ kpa nɔ nɛ ma e he tsukɔmi ɔ hiɔ nɔ tue nya lo, kɛ e hiɔ nine nguɛ gɔleku, kɛ e hiɔ nane nguɛ gɔleku he. 15Jehanɛ, osɔfo ɔ nɛ plɛ nu ɔ eko kɛ wo lɛ nitsɛ e muɔ dɛ kɔkɔ mi. 16É kɛ e hiɔ nine nguɛ kake nɛ sɔ nu ɔ mi, nɛ é fĩa si kpaago ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi. 17É ngɔ nu ɔ nɛ ngɛ e dɛ mi ɔ eko nɛ e kɛ kpa nɔ nɛ ma e he tsukɔmi ɔ hiɔ nɔ tue nya lo, hiɔ nine nguɛ gɔleku, kɛ e hiɔ nane nguɛ gɔleku he. E ngɔ lohwe ɔ nɛ a kɛ ba sã fɔ yemi bɔ ɔ hu muɔ kɛ pee ja nɔuu. 18Nu ɔ nɛ maa piɛ ngɛ osɔfo ɔ dɛ mi ɔ, e kɛ pue nɔ nɛ ma e he tsukɔmi ɔ yi mi. Ke nɔ ko nu he womi nɔ hiɔ yaya a, kusumi nɛ osɔfo ɔ maa pee kɛ kpata Yawɛ ha lɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
19Jehanɛ, osɔfo ɔ nɛ sã yayami pami bɔ kɛ kpata Yawɛ ha nɔ nɛ ma e he tsukɔmi ɔ. Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, é gbe lohwe ɔ nɛ a kɛ maa sã sami bɔ ɔ. 20Osɔfo ɔ nɛ ngɔ sami bɔ ɔ, kɛ niye ní bɔ ɔ, nɛ e sã mɛ ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ. Kusumi nɛ osɔfo ɔ maa pee kɛ kpata Yawɛ ha lɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ, kɛkɛ ɔ, e he ma tsɔ.
21Ke ohiatsɛ ji nɔ ɔ, nɛ e be ní ɔmɛ tsuo nyɛe ma ha a, e ngɔ agbosu kake pɛ kɛ pee fɔ yemi bɔ, nɛ a fɔ kɛ ya kɛ ba ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi. Níhi nɛ e ngɔ kɛ piɛ he ji mamu bukɔbukɔ kilo kake, nɛ a kɛ nu futu mi ha niye ní bɔ, nu tɔ kake, 22kɛ lahuɛ enyɔ, aloo beleku lahuɛ enyɔ. Kake maa pee yayami pami bɔ, nɛ kake hu maa pee sami bɔ. 23E he tsukɔmi be ɔ, ligbi kpaanyɔne ɔ nɔ ɔ, e ngɔ ní nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ ba ha osɔfo ɔ ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ sinya a nya. 24Osɔfo ɔ nɛ ngɔ agbosu ɔ nɛ a kɛ maa sã fɔ yemi bɔ ɔ, kɛ nu ɔ kɛ ba kaa bɔ nɛ a fɔɔ kɛ yaa kɛ baa ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi. 25Jehanɛ, é gbe agbosu ɔ, nɛ é ngɔ e muɔ ɔ eko kɛ kpa nɔ nɛ ma e he tsukɔmi ɔ hiɔ nɔ tue nya lo, kɛ e hiɔ nine nguɛ gɔleku, kɛ e hiɔ nane nguɛ gɔleku he. 26Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, osɔfo ɔ nɛ plɛ nu ɔ eko kɛ wo lɛ nitsɛ e muɔ nine dɛ kɔkɔ mi, 27nɛ e ngɔ e hiɔ nine nguɛ kake kɛ sɔ nu ɔ mi nɛ e fĩa si kpaago ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi. 28Osɔfo ɔ nɛ ngɔ nu nɛ ngɛ e dɛ mi ɔ eko kɛ kpa nɔ nɛ ma e he tsukɔmi ɔ hiɔ nɔ tue nya lo, e hiɔ nine nguɛ gɔleku, kɛ e hiɔ nane nguɛ gɔleku ɔmɛ a he kaa bɔ nɛ e kɛ muɔ ɔ pee ɔ. 29Nu nɛ maa piɛ ngɛ osɔfo ɔ dɛ mi ɔ, e kɛ pue nɔ ɔ nɛ a ngɛ e he tsukɔe ɔ yi mi. Kusumi nɛ osɔfo ɔ maa pee kɛ kpata Yawɛ ha lɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. 30Jehanɛ e ngɔ lahuɛ ɔ kake, loo beleku lahuɛ ɔ kake 31kɛ ba sã yayami pami bɔ, nɛ a kɛ kake ɔ hu nɛ sã sami bɔ kɛ piɛ niye ní bɔ ɔ he. Kusumi nɛ osɔfo ɔ maa pee kɛ kpata Yawɛ ha nɔ nɛ ma e he tsukɔmi ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. 32Nɔ nɛ ngɛ he womi nɔ hiɔ yaya nue, nɛ be nyɛe ma ha ní ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ a kɛ maa pee kusumi kɛ tsukɔ e he ɔ, mlaa nɛ fɔɔ si ha lɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Wehi nɛ a he fu ja
33Yawɛ ha Mose kɛ Aaron 34mlaa nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ kɔɔ wehi nɛ a he fu ja a he. Ke Israel bi ɔmɛ ya su zugba a nɛ Yawɛ ngɔ ha mɛ kaa a weto ní ɔ nɔ ɔ, mlaa nɛ sa kaa a ye nɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. 35Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa na nɔ́ ko nɛ fu ja ngɛ e we he ɔ, e ha nɛ osɔfo nɛ le. 36Osɔfo ɔ nɛ fa nɛ a je nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ kpo, loko e ya hyɛ he nɛ fu ja a, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ a ko bu nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ we ɔ mi ɔ kaa e he tsɔ we. Ke a je ní ɔmɛ kpo ta a, osɔfo ɔ nɛ ya we ɔ mi 37nɛ e ya hyɛ he nɛ fu ja a. Ke e na nɔ́ tsu, loo nɔ́ nɛ hɛɛ ba mumu su nɛ ha si ngɛ gli ɔ he ɔ, 38osɔfo ɔ nɛ je lejɛ ɔ, nɛ e ha nɛ a nga we ɔ nya ligbi kpaago. 39Ligbi kpaagone ɔ, osɔfo ɔ nɛ kpale ya hyɛ ekohu. Ke e na kaa nɔ́ ɔ ha si ngɛ gli ɔ he ɔ, 40e fa nɛ a je tɛhi nɛ nɔ́ ɔ ngɛ a he ɔ kɛ je gli ɔ mi, nɛ a ya sake mɛ ngɔ pue kuku nɔ ngɛ ma a se. 41Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, osɔfo ɔ nɛ ha nɛ a ngmla gli ɔ tsuo he ngɛ tsu ɔmɛ a mi, nɛ a bua zu ɔ nya kɛ ya pue he ngɛ kuku nɔ ngɛ ma a se. 42Jehanɛ, á ngɔ tɛ kpahi kɛ tsi puɔ ɔmɛ, nɛ́ a ngɔ zu kpa kɛ kã gli ɔmɛ a he.
43Se ke a tsake tɛ ɔmɛ, nɛ a ngmla gli ɔ he, nɛ a kpale kã gli ɔmɛ a he, nɛ lɔ ɔ se a na kaa lejɛ ɔ fu ja ekohu ɔ, 44osɔfo ɔ nɛ kpale ya hyɛ ekohu. Ke e na kaa nɔ́ ɔ ha si ngɛ gli ɔ he ɔ, lɛɛ e ji nɔ́ yaya nɛ maa ye awi; we ɔ he tsɔ we. 45Osɔfo ɔ nɛ ha nɛ a ku we ɔ kɛ pue si nɛ a muɔ tɛ ɔmɛ, tso ɔmɛ, kɛ zu ɔ kɛ je ma a mi kɛ ya pue kuku nɔ. 46Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa sɛ we ɔ mi, be mi nɛ a nga we ɔ nya a, e he be tsɔe kɛ yaa si du ma bu. 47Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa hwɔ we ɔ mi, loo e maa ye ní ngɛ we ɔ mi ɔ, é fɔ e tade ɔmɛ a he.
48Se ke a kɛ zu kpa kã gli ɔ he, nɛ lɔ ɔ se osɔfo ɔ ba hyɛ, nɛ e nɛ nɔ́ ko ngɛ he ɔ, e ha nɛ a le kaa we ɔ he tsɔ; ejakaa a je nɔ́ nɛ fu ja a tsuo kɛ je gli ɔ mi. 49Osɔfo ɔ nɛ ngɔ lohwe pɛlitsɛ enyɔ, seda tso, kɔjai, kɛ nga nɛ a fi kɛ bla kaa bɛ kɛ ba, konɛ a kɛ julaa we ɔ. 50É gbe lohwe pɛlitsɛ ɔmɛ a ti kake ngɛ zu buɛ nɛ nyu mua ngɛ mi nɔ. 51Jehanɛ, é ngɔ seda tso ɔ, nga nɛ a fi kɛ bla kaa bɛ ɔ, kɔjai ɔ, kɛ lohwe pɛlitsɛ hɛngmengmletsɛ ɔ, nɛ e kɛ sɔ lohwe pɛlitsɛ nɛ a gbe ɔ muɔ ɔ, kɛ nyu mua a mi, nɛ e kɛ fĩa we ɔ he si kpaago. 52Bɔ nɛ e kɛ lohwe pɛlitsɛ ɔ muɔ, nyu mua a, lohwe pɛlitsɛ hɛngmengmletsɛ ɔ, seda tso ɔ, nga nɛ a fi kɛ bla kaa bɛ ɔ, kɛ kɔjai ɔ maa julaa we ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. 53Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, osɔfo ɔ nɛ ngmɛɛ lohwe pɛlitsɛ hɛngmengmletsɛ ɔ he nɛ e te kɛ ya nga mi. Kusumi nɛ e maa pee kɛ julaa we ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. Kɛkɛ ɔ, we ɔ he ma tsɔ.
54Mlaa nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ kɛ ha he womi nɔ hiɔ yaya, 55-56sakpa, loo nɔfu nɔ́, loo tslɔɔ, he hami nɔ́ nɛ fu ja, loo we nɛ hiɔ yaya nɛ ɔ sɛ gli ɔ mi. 57Mlaa nɛ ɔmɛ tsɔɔ be mi nɛ nɔ́ ko he tsɔ we kɛ be mi nɛ nɔ́ ɔ he tsɔ.

Title: MOSE III, 15
Content:
Nyu yaya nɛ bee ngɛ nɔmlɔ he
1Mlaahi nɛ Yawɛ wo Mose kɛ Aaron 2kɛ ha Israel bi ɔmɛ ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ. Ke nyu ngɛ bee ngɛ nyumu ko he ɔ, nyu ɔ nɛ ngɛ bee ɔ ha nyumu ɔ he tsɔ we. 3Ke nyu yaya a ngɛ bee jio, e ha e nyumu tso mi tsi jio, nɔ ɔ he tsɔ we. 4Sa tsuaa sa nɛ nyumu nɛ nyu yaya ngɛ bee ngɛ e he ɔ maa hwɔ nɔ, loo nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ e maa hi nɔ ɔ, nɔ́ ɔ he tsɔ we. 5Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa ta sa a he ɔ, é fɔ e tade ɔmɛ a he, nɛ e du e he. E he be tsɔe kɛ yaa si du ma bu. 6Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa hi nɔ́ ko nɛ nɔ nɛ nyu yaya ngɛ bee ngɛ e he ɔ hi nɔ ɔ nɔ ɔ, é fɔ e tade ɔmɛ a he, nɛ é du e he. E he be tsɔe kɛ yaa si du ma bu. 7Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa ta nɔ nɛ nyu ngɛ bee ngɛ e nyumu tso mi ɔ he ɔ, é fɔ e tade ɔmɛ a he, nɛ e du e he. E he be tsɔe kɛ yaa si du ma bu. 8Ke nɔ nɛ nyu ngɛ bee ngɛ e he ɔ la lada pue nɔ ko nɛ he tsɔ nɔ ɔ, nɔ ɔ nɛ fɔ e tade ɔmɛ a he, nɛ e du e he. E he tsɔ we kɛ yaa si du ma bu. 9Lohwe se mi sɛ nɛ nɔ nɛ nyu yaya ngɛ bee ngɛ e he ɔ maa hi nɔ ɔ he be tsɔe. 10Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa ta nɔ́ ko nɛ nɔ ɔ hi nɔ he ɔ, e he be tsɔe kɛ yaa si du ma bu, nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa tloo jamɛ a nɔ́ ɔ, é fɔ e tade ɔmɛ a he, nɛ e du e he. E he be tsɔe kɛ yaa si du ma bu. 11Ke nyu yaya ngɛ bee ngɛ nɔ ko he, nɛ e fɔ we e dɛ, nɛ e ta nɔ ko he ɔ, nɔ ɔ nɛ e ta e he ɔ nɛ fɔ e tade ɔmɛ a he, nɛ e du e he. E he be tsɔe kɛ yaa si du ma bu. 12Zu buɛ saisaa nɛ nɔ nɛ nyu ngɛ bee ngɛ e he ɔ maa ta he ɔ, a ywia lɛ, se tso sowe nɛ e maa ta he lɛɛ a fɔ he.
13Ke nɔ nɛ nyu yaya ngɛ bee ngɛ e he ɔ hiɔ ɔ ta a, e mlɛ ligbi kpaago loko e tsukɔ e he, nɛ e fɔ e tade ɔmɛ a he. Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e ya du e he ngɛ pa mi, kɛkɛ e he ma tsɔ. 14Ligbi nɛ ji kpaanyɔ ɔ, e ngɔ lahuɛ enyɔ, loo beleku lahuɛ enyɔ kɛ ba Yawɛ hɛ mi ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ sinya a nya, nɛ e ngɔ mɛ kɛ ha osɔfo ɔ. 15Osɔfo ɔ maa ngɔ kake kɛ sã yayami pami bɔ, nɛ e maa ngɔ kake hu kɛ sã sami bɔ kɛ kpata Yawɛ ha lɛ ngɛ nyu yaya nɛ be ngɛ e he ɔ he. 16Ke nyumu ko he nyu be ngɛ e he ɔ, e du e nɔmlɔ tso ɔ kulaa he. E he be tsɔe kɛ yaa si du ma bu. 17Sa nɔ bo, loo nɔ́ ko nɛ a kɛ lohwe he womi pee, nɛ nyumu ɔ he nyu nɛ ɔ ma pue nɔ ɔ, á fɔ he. E he be tsɔe kɛ yaa si du ma bu. 18Ke nyumu kɛ yo na bɔmi nɛ nyumu ɔ he nyu be ɔ, mɛ ni enyɔ ɔmɛ tsuo a du a he. A he be tsɔe kɛ yaa si du ma bu.
19Ke yo ko ku nine ɔ, e he be tsɔe ligbi kpaago; nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa ta e he ɔ, e he be tsɔe kɛ yaa si du ma bu. 20Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ e maa hi nɔ, loo e maa hwɔ nɔ be mi nɛ e ku nine ɔ, nɔ́ ɔ he be tsɔe. 21-23Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa ta sa, loo nɔ́ ko nɛ yo nɛ ɔ hi nɔ ɔ he ɔ, é fɔ e tade ɔmɛ a he, nɛ é du e he. E he be tsɔe kɛ yaa si du ma bu. 24Ke nyumu ko kɛ yo nɛ ɔ na bɔmi be mi nɛ e ku nine ɔ, jamɛ a nyumu ɔ ble e he, nɛ e he be tsɔe ligbi kpaago. Sa tsuaa sa nɛ e maa hwɔ nɔ ɔ hu he be tsɔe.
25Ke muɔ be ngɛ yo ko he be saii, be mi nɛ e nine kumi be sui lolo, aloo ke e be ɔ su, nɛ muɔ ɔ be kɛ be nɔ ɔ, e he be tsɔe ligbi ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ muɔ ɔ ngɛ bee ɔ, kaa bɔ nɛ e he be tsɔe, be mi nɛ e ku nine ɔ. 26Sa tsuaa sa nɛ e maa hwɔ nɔ, kɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ e maa hi nɔ be nɛ ɔ mi ɔ he be tsɔe. 27Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa ta ní nɛ ɔmɛ a he ɔ, e he be tsɔe. Nɔ ɔ nɛ fɔ e tade ɔmɛ a he, nɛ e du e he. E he be tsɔe kɛ yaa si du ma bu. 28Ke muɔ ɔ nɛ ngɛ bee ngɛ yo nɛ ɔ he ɔ se po ɔ, e maa hi si ligbi kpaago loko e he ma tsɔ. 29Ligbi kpaanyɔne ɔ, yo ɔ nɛ ngɔ lahuɛ enyɔ, loo beleku lahuɛ enyɔ kɛ ba ha osɔfo ɔ ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ sinya a nya. 30Osɔfo ɔ maa ngɔ kake kɛ sã yayami pami bɔ, nɛ e maa ngɔ kake ɔ hu kɛ sã sami bɔ. Kusumi nɛ osɔfo ɔ maa pee kɛ kpata Yawɛ ha yo ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
31Yawɛ de Mose ke e slɔ Israel bi ɔmɛ ngɛ a he nɛ tsɔ we ɔ he, konɛ a ko ble Yawɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ ngɛ ma a sito he ɔ. Ke pi ja a, a ma gbo.
32Enɛ ɔmɛ ji mlaahi nɛ fɔɔ si kɛ ha nyumu nɛ nyu yaya, loo nyumu he nyu ngɛ bee ngɛ e he, nɛ haa e he tsɔ we ɔ, 33kɛ yo hu nɛ ku nine, loo nyumu nɛ e kɛ yo na bɔmi be mi nɛ yo ɔ ku nine, nɛ e he tsɔ we ɔ.

Title: MOSE III, 16
Content:
Kpatami ligbi ɔ
1Benɛ Aaron binyumu enyɔ ɔmɛ ngɔ la nɛ he tsɔ we kɛ ya Yawɛ hɛ mi nɛ a gbo se ɔ, Yawɛ kɛ Mose tu munyu. 2 E de lɛ ke, “De o nyɛminyumu Aaron ke e ko ya he klɔuklɔu pe kulaa a ngɛ tsu mi pomi bo ɔ se be saisaa, konɛ e ko gbo. Ejakaa lejɛ ɔ ji he nɛ i jeɔ ye he kpo ngɛ ngɛ bɔku mi, ngɛ somi daka a nya nɔ́ ɔ nɔ. 3 E ma nyɛ maa ya he klɔuklɔu pe kulaa a ke e hɛɛ na niheyo kɛ ha yayami pami bɔ sami, nɛ e hɛɛ agbosu hu kɛ ha sami bɔ.”
4Jehanɛ Yawɛ wo mlaa nɛ ɔmɛ. Be tsuaa be nɛ Aaron maa sɛ he klɔuklɔu pe kulaa a, é du e he, nɛ é wo osɔfo tade klɔuklɔu nɛ ɔmɛ: kploba yi nɔ tade klɔuklɔu ɔ, sisi tade ɔmɛ, kɛ kploba mlɛ mi fimi nɔ́ ɔ, nɛ é bu kploba pɛɛ ɔ.
5Aaron nɛ he akpakpo enyɔ nɛ a kɛ maa sã yayami pami bɔ, kɛ agbosu kake nɛ a kɛ maa sã sami bɔ ngɛ Israel ma a tsuo dɛ. 6É sã na ku ɔ kaa yayami pami bɔ kɛ ha lɛ nitsɛ e he, nɛ é kpata Yawɛ ha lɛ nitsɛ kɛ e we ɔ. 7Jehanɛ, é ngɔ akpakpo enyɔ ɔmɛ kɛ ba Yawɛ hɛ mi ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ sinya a nya. 8É fɔ a nɔ sɔ. Yawɛ nɔ́ kake, kɛ Azazel nɔ́ kake. 9Nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ sɔ ɔ je ɔ, a kɛ sã yayami pami bɔ. 10Nɔ́ nɛ Azazel nɔ́ ɔ je ɔ, a kɛ ba Yawɛ hɛ mi hɛ ngmengmle, nɛ a kɛ ba kpata Yawɛ ha ma a. Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, a je lɛ we kɛ ho nga a nɔ ya kɛ ya ha Azazel.
11Ke Aaron maa sã na ku ɔ kaa yayami pami bɔ kɛ ha lɛ nitsɛ e he kɛ e we ɔ, 12e ngɔ ngɛyu kɛ je la ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ, nɛ e piti tsopa kɛ e he via nɛ a wɛɛ lɛ bukɔbukɔ dɛ kɔkɔ enyɔ, nɛ e kɛ sɛ he klɔuklɔu pe kulaa a. 13E ngɔ tsopa kɛ e he via a ngɔ pue la a mi ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi, nɛ e wo la su ku nɛ mi ti kɛ tsi somi daka nya nɔ́ ɔ nɔ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ Aaron ko na somi daka nya nɔ́ ɔ, nɛ e ba gbo. 14É ngɔ na ku ɔ muɔ eko, nɛ e kɛ e nine nguɛ nɛ sɔ mi nɛ e kɛ fĩa somi daka nya nɔ ɔ hɛ mi. É kɛ muɔ ɔ nɛ fĩa somi daka nitsɛ hu hɛ mi si kpaago.
15 Jehanɛ, é gbe akpakpo ɔ nɛ a kɛ ma yayami pami bɔ sami ha ma a. É ngɔ muɔ ɔ kɛ ba he klɔuklɔu pe kulaa a, nɛ e ya fĩa kɛ pue somi daka a nya nɔ́ ɔ nɔ, kɛ somi daka a he kɛ kpe kaa bɔ nɛ a kɛ na ku ɔ muɔ ɔ pee ɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ. 16É pee kusumi nɛ ɔ kɛ kpata Yawɛ ngɛ he klɔuklɔu pe kulaa a ngɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ a musuhi nɛ a bɔ, mlaahi a nɔ nɛ a tɔ, kɛ yayamihi nɛ a pee ɔ tsuo kulaa he. É pee kusumi nɛ ɔ kɛ ha kpe he bo tsu ɔ hulɔ; ejakaa e ngɛ ma sito he ɔ he nɛ a ble ɔ. 17Kɛ je be nɛ Aaron maa sɛ he klɔuklɔu pe kulaa a nɛ e ya pee kusumi nɛ ɔ, kɛ yaa si e maa je kpo ɔ, nɔ ko nɔ ko nɛ ko ya bo tsu ɔ mi. Ke e pee kusumi nɛ e kɛ kpata Yawɛ kɛ ha lɛ nitsɛ e he kɛ e we ɔ, kɛ ma a tsuo gbe nya a, 18é je kpo kɛ ya bɔ sami la tɛ nɛ ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi ɔ he, nɛ e ya kpata Yawɛ kɛ ha la tɛ ɔ. É ngɔ na ku ɔ muɔ ɔ eko, kɛ akpakpo ɔ hu muɔ ɔ eko kɛ kpa bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ koli ɔmɛ a he. 19É ngɔ e nine nguɛ kɛ fĩa muɔ ɔ eko kɛ pue bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ si kpaago. É tsukɔ he, nɛ é pee lɛ klɔuklɔu ngɛ yayamihi nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ pee kɛ ble la tɛ ɔ he.
Musu kpami to
20Ke Aaron pee kusumi ɔ kɛ tsukɔ he klɔuklɔu pe kulaa a, kpe he bo tsu ɔ, kɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he gbe nya a, é ngɔ akpakpo hɛngmengmletsɛ ɔ kɛ ba Yawɛ hɛ mi. 21É ngɔ e nine enyɔ ɔmɛ tsuo ngɔ pue akpakpo ɔ yi mi, nɛ e jaje kaa Israel bi ɔmɛ pee yayami, a tɔ mlaa, nɛ a gbo tue. Aaron nɛ ngɔ yayami nɛ ɔmɛ ngɔ pue akpakpo ɔ nɔ. Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e ngɔ akpakpo ɔ kɛ ha nɔ ko nɛ a hla kɛ to, nɛ e fie lɛ kɛ ho nga nɔ ya, nɛ e ya ngmɛɛ e he ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. 22Akpakpo ɔ maa tloo Israel bi ɔmɛ a he musu tsuo kɛ maa ho zugba nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be nɔ ɔ nɔ ya.
23 Jehanɛ, Aaron nɛ sɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ mi, nɛ é je e we osɔfo tade ɔmɛ nɛ e wo kɛ ya sɛ he klɔuklɔu pe kulaa kɛ pue lejɛ ɔ. 24É du e he ngɛ he ko nɛ tsɔ, nɛ é wo lɛ nitsɛ e tade ɔmɛ. Jehanɛ, é je kpo nɛ e ya sã sami bɔ kɛ kpata Yawɛ ha lɛ nitsɛ e he, kɛ ma a hulɔ. 25Lohwe ɔ nɛ a kɛ ma yayami pami bɔ ɔ sami ɔ, e sã e zɔ ɔ ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ. 26Nɔ ɔ nɛ fie to ɔ kɛ ya ha Azazel ngɛ nga a nɔ ɔ nɛ fɔ e tade ɔmɛ nɛ e wo ɔ a he, nɛ e du e he loko e ba ma sito he ɔ. 27 Na ku ɔ, kɛ akpakpo ɔ nɛ a kɛ ba sã yayami pami bɔ, nɛ a kɛ a muɔ ɔ ba kpata Yawɛ ngɛ he klɔuklɔu pe kulaa a, a ngɔ mɛ kɛ je ma sito he ɔ, nɛ a ya sã mɛ. A sã lohwe he womi ɔmɛ, lo ɔ, kɛ a fĩ ɔ tsuo. 28Nɔ nɛ maa sã ní nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, é fɔ e tade ɔmɛ a he, nɛ é du e he loko é ba ma sito he ɔ.
Kpatami ligbi ɔ yemi
29 Enɛ ɔ maa pee mlaa nɛ fɔɔ si kɛ yaa neneene. Nyɔhiɔ kpaagone ɔ we ligbi nɛ ji nyɔngma a, Israel fɔfɔɛ, kɛ nibwɔhi nɛ ngɛ a kpɛti tsuo maa ha hwɔ, nɛ a be nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko tsue. 30Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, a maa pee kusumi kɛ kpata Yawɛ ha mɛ kɛ tsukɔ a he kɛ je a he yayami ɔmɛ tsuo kulaa mi, konɛ a he nɛ tsɔ. 31Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ maa pee Hejɔɔmi ligbi nɛ a be nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko tsue; nɔ tsuaa nɔ maa ha hwɔ. Mlaa nɛ ɔmɛ fɔɔ si ha mɛ kɛ yaa neneene. 32Osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa nɛ a pɔ lɛ nu, nɛ a tsukɔ e he, nɛ a wo lɛ osɔfo ngɛ e tsɛ nane mi ɔ nɛ wo osɔfo tade ɔmɛ, nɛ é pee kpatami kusumi ɔmɛ. 33E maa tsukɔ he klɔuklɔu pe kulaa a, kpe he bo tsu ɔ, bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ, osɔfo ɔmɛ, kɛ ma kpekpemi ɔ tsuo a he. 34Á ye mlaa nɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ kɛ ya neneene. Daa jeha a, a maa pee kusumi nɛ ɔ si kake kɛ kpata Mawu ha Israel bi ɔmɛ ngɛ a he yayami ɔmɛ a he.
Mose pee kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa lɛ ɔ.

Title: MOSE III, 17
Content:
Mlaahi nɛ kɔɔ muɔ he
1Yawɛ de Mose ke 2e de Aaron, kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ, kɛ Israel ma a tsuo ke mlaahi nɛ Yawɛ wo mɛ ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ. 3-4Ke Israel fɔfɔɛ ko gbe na, loo jijɔ, loo apletsi ngɛ he kpa ko nɛ pi kpe he bo tsu ɔ sinya a nya, nɛ e kɛ ba sã bɔ ha Yawɛ ɔ, e tɔ mlaa. Jamɛatsɛ ɔ pue muɔ si. Á je lɛ we, nɛ a ko bu lɛ ngɔ si ye ma a mi bi ɔmɛ a nɔ hu. 5Mlaa nɛ ɔ tsɔɔ kaa jehanɛ lɛɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ nɛ a ngɔ lohwe ɔmɛ nɛ a gbee ngɛ nga nɔ ɔ kɛ ba ha osɔfo ɔ ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ sinya a nya. Á gbe lohwe ɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ kɛ sã tue mi jɔmi bɔ ha Yawɛ. 6Osɔfo ɔ nɛ fĩa muɔ ɔ kɛ pue Yawɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ sinya a nya, konɛ é sã zɔ ɔ kaa bɔ nɛ jee via ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi. 7Enɛ ɔ ma ha Israel bi ɔmɛ maa jɔɔ bɔ sami ha mumi yayamihi nɛ hɛɛ apletsi su nɛ a jee Mawu se nɛ a ya jaa a.
