Enɛ ɔ maa pee mlaa nɛ fɔɔ si ha mɛ, kɛ a nina kɛ yaa neneene.
8Jehanɛ hu, de mɛ ke, ke Israel fɔfɔɛ, aloo nɔ ko nɛ ba to mɛ nubwɔ maa sã sami bɔ, loo bɔ kpa ko kɛ ha Yawɛ, nɛ e ngɔɛ kɛ bɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ sinya a nya a, 9jamɛ a nɔ ɔ, a je lɛ we, nɛ a ko bu lɛ ngɔ si ye ma a mi bi ɔmɛ a nɔ hu.
10 Ke Israel fɔfɔɛ ko, aloo nɔ ko nɛ ba to nyɛ nubwɔ ye muɔ ɔ, ye hɛ maa dɔ kɛ wo jamɛ a nɔ ɔ. Ma je lɛ we, nɛ a ko bu lɛ ngɔ si ye ma a mi bi ɔmɛ a nɔ hu. 11 Muɔ ji nɔ́ nɛ haa he lo tsuaa he lo wami. Lɔ ɔ he nɛ Yawɛ fa ke a ngɔ muɔ kɛ pue bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ nɛ a kɛ kpa musu ɔ nɛ. Muɔ ji nɔ́ nɛ a kɛ kpaa musu, ejakaa wami ngɛ mi. 12Enɛ ɔ he je nɛ i de Israel bi ɔmɛ ke a ko ye muɔ ɔ nɛ; mɛ jio, nɔ ko nɛ ba to mɛ nubwɔ jio.
13Ke Israel fɔfɔɛ, loo nɔ ko nɛ ba to mɛ nubwɔ ya da de nɛ e gbe lohwe nane eywiɛtsɛ, loo pɛlitsɛ nɛ a yeɔ ɔ, é dɛ muɔ ɔ kɛ pue si, nɛ e ngɔ zu ngɔ pue nɔ. 14Ejakaa muɔ ji nɔ́ nɛ haa he lo tsuaa he lo wami. Lɔ ɔ he nɛ Yawɛ de Israel bi ɔmɛ ke a ko ye muɔ ɔ nɛ. Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa pee ja a, á je lɛ we, nɛ a ko bu lɛ ngɔ si ye ma a mi bi ɔmɛ a nɔ hu.
15Israel no tsuaa Israel no, loo nubwɔ kó ye lohwe ko nɛ lɛ nitsɛ e gbo, aloo nɔ́ nɛ nga mi lohwe tsɔtslɔɔ e mi. Ke e ba mi kaa nɔ ko tɔ mlaa nɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ, é fɔ e tade ɔmɛ a he, nɛ é du e he. E he be tsɔe kɛ yaa si du ma bu; lɔ ɔ se loko e he ma tsɔ. 16Ke e fɔ we e tade ɔmɛ a he, nɛ́ e du e he ɔ, e musu maa tloo lɛ.

Title: MOSE III, 18
Content:
Nyumu kɛ yo bɔmi nɛ a hĩɔ
1Yawɛ de Mose ke 2e de Israel bi ɔmɛ ke, “Imi ji, Yawɛ nyɛ Mawu ɔ nɛ. 3Egipt bi ɔmɛ nɛ nyɛ hi a zugba a nɔ ɔ, kɛ Kanaan bi ɔmɛ nɛ i ngɔ nyɛ kɛ yaa a zugba a a nɔ ɔ, nyɛ ko pee a kusumi níhi. 4Nyɛɛ pee ye suɔmi nya ní, nɛ nyɛɛ ye ye mlaa amɛ a nɔ. Imi ji Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ nɛ. 5 Mlaahi nɛ i wo nyɛ, kɛ blɔ nyahi nɛ i to ha nyɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ ye a nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ. Ke nyɛ pee ja a, nyɛ yi ma na wami. Imi ji Yawɛ.”
6Yawɛ wo mlaa nɛ ɔmɛ. Nyɛ ti nɔ ko nɔ ko kɛ lɛ nitsɛ e nyɛmi tutuutu kó na nyumu kɛ yo bɔmi. Imi ji Yawɛ. 7Nɔ ko kɛ e nyɛ kó na nyumu kɛ yo bɔmi nɛ e ba pue e tsɛ hɛ mi si. Kó pue mo nitsɛ o nyɛ hɛ mi si. 8 O kɛ o tsɛ e yo kpa ko kó na nyumu kɛ yo bɔmi nɛ o ba pue o tsɛ hɛ mi si. 9 O kɛ o nyɛmiyo kó na nyumu kɛ yo bɔmi, o nyɛbi ji lɛ jio, o tsɛbi ji lɛ jio, nɔ nɛ a fɔ lɛ ngɛ we jio, nɔ nɛ a fɔ lɛ ngɛ ma se jio. 10O kɛ o bibi kó na nyumu kɛ yo bɔmi, o binyumu bi ji lɛ jio, o biyo bi ji lɛ jio; e ji hɛ mi si puemi nɔ́ kɛ ha nyɛ tsuo. 11O kɛ o tsɛ yo e biyo kó na nyumu kɛ yo bɔmi, ejakaa lɛ hu o nyɛmi ji lɛ. 12 O kɛ o nyɛko kó na nyumu kɛ yo bɔmi, ejakaa o tsɛ nitsɛ nyɛmiyo ji lɛ. 13O kɛ o nyɛwayo, loo o nyɛngua kó na nyumu kɛ yo bɔmi, ejakaa lɛ hu e ngɛ kaa o nyɛ kɛ̃. 14O kɛ o tsɛngua, loo o tsɛwayo e yo kó na nyumu kɛ yo bɔmi, ejakaa o nyɛnyua, loo o nyɛwayo ji lɛ. 15 O kɛ o binyumu e yo kó na nyumu kɛ yo bɔmi, ejakaa o nganyɛ ji lɛ. 16 O kɛ o nyɛminyumu e yo kó na nyumu kɛ yo bɔmi, ejakaa e ji hɛ mi si puemi ha o nyɛminyumu ɔ. 17 O kɛ yo kɛ e biyo tsuo kó na nyumu kɛ yo bɔmi. O kɛ yo ɔ e bibi hu kó na nyumu kɛ yo bɔmi, e binyumu biyo jio, e biyo ɔ biyo jio. Ke o pee ja a, o bɔ musu, ejakaa nyɛmimɛ tutuutu ji mɛ. 18Koo ngɔ nɔ kɛ e nyɛmi nɛ a ba pee huno yihi, be mi nɛ e nyɛmi ɔ ngɛ je mi kɛ mwɔɔ.
19 “O kɛ yo nɛ ku nine kó na nyumu kɛ yo bɔmi, ejakaa e he tsɔ we. 20 O kɛ o nyɛmi e yo kó na nyumu kɛ yo bɔmi nɛ o kó ba ble o he. 21 Koo ngɔ o bimɛ ɔmɛ eko kɛ ha nɛ a sã ha mawu ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Molek ɔ. Ke o pee ja a, o gbe Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ he guɛ. 22 Nyumu kɛ nyumu kó na bɔmi kaa yo kɛ nyumu; a hĩɔ. 23 O kɛ lohwe kó na bɔmi nɛ o ba ble o he. Yo hu kɛ lohwe kó hwɔ nɛ e ba ble e he ja nɔuu. A hĩɔ.
24“Je ma amɛ nɛ i ngɛ fiee kɛ ngɛ nyɛ blɔ mi jee ɔ, níhi nɛ a pee nɛ a kɛ ble a he, 25nɛ a kɛ ble zugba a hulɔ ɔ ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ. Lɔ ɔ he je nɛ i ngɛ zugba a tue gblae, nɛ zugba a hu ngɛ ni ɔmɛ fiee ɔ nɛ. 26Se nyɛ nitsɛmɛ, kɛ nibwɔhi nɛ ba to nyɛ ɔ lɛɛ nyɛɛ ye ye mlaa amɛ, kɛ ye blɔ nya tomi ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ nyɛ ko pee níhi nɛ a hĩɔ nɛ ɔ eko. 27Nihi nɛ hi hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ loko nyɛ ba a bɔ musu nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ ble zugba a. 28Ke nyɛ hu nyɛ pee ní nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ ble zugba a, zugba a maa fie nyɛ kaa bɔ nɛ e fie nihi nɛ hi lejɛ ɔ loko nyɛ ba a. 29Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa pee níhi nɛ a hĩɔ nɛ ɔ eko ɔ, a je lɛ we, nɛ a ko bu lɛ ngɔ si ye ma a mi bi ɔmɛ a nɔ hu.”
30Yawɛ de kɛ gbe nya ke, “Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ ye ye mlaa amɛ a nɔ. Musu bɔmi níhi nɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ hi zugba a nɔ kekle ɔ pee ɔ, nyɛ ko pee nɛ nyɛ ba ble nyɛ he. Imi ji Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ nɛ.”

Title: MOSE III, 19
Content:
Mlaahi nɛ kɔɔ klɔuklɔu peemi kɛ dami sane yemi he
1Yawɛ de Mose ke 2 e de Israel ma kpekpemi ɔ tsuo ke, “Nyɛɛ pee nyɛ he klɔuklɔu, ejakaa imi Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ, i ngɛ klɔuklɔu. 3 Nyɛ ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ bu e nyɛ kɛ e tsɛ; nɛ e ye Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ kaa bɔ nɛ i fa nyɛ ɔ. Imi ji Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ nɛ.
4 “Nyɛ ko je ye se nɛ nyɛ ya ja amagahi; nɛ nyɛ ko pee dade mawuhi ha nyɛ he. Imi ji Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ nɛ.
5“Ke nyɛ gbe lohwe nɛ a kɛ maa sã tue mi jɔmi bɔ ha imi Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ, mlaahi nɛ i wo nyɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ ye a nɔ, konɛ e sa ye hɛ mi. 6Á ye lo ɔ ligbi nɛ a maa gbe lohwe ɔ, aloo e nɔ jena. Ke eko piɛ nɛ ye ligbi etɛ ɔ, á sã, 7Ke kaa nɔ ko ye eko ligbi etɛne ɔ, i be e bɔ ngɔe, ejakaa a hĩɔ. 8Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa ye eko ɔ, a gbla e tue, ejakaa e ble Yawɛ nɔ́ klɔuklɔu ɔ. A ma je lɛ we, nɛ a be lɛ bue ngɔ si ye ma a mi bi ɔmɛ a nɔ hu.
9 “Ke nyɛ ngɛ nyɛ ngmɔ ní kpae ɔ, nyɛ ko kpa ní ɔ kɛ ya su ngmɔ ɔ tue haa. Nyɛ ko muɔ nɔ́ nɛ ma pue si ngɛ ní kpami ɔ se hulɔ. 10Wai ngmɔtsɛ kó kpa wai yiblii ɔmɛ tsuo ngɛ e wai tso ɔmɛ a nɔ. Wai yiblii nɛ maa nɔɔ si ngɛ wai ngmɔ ɔ mi ɔ hu e ko ya kukuɔ. E si ha ohiatsɛmɛ, kɛ nibwɔhi. Imi ji Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ nɛ.
11 “Nyɛ ko ju; nyɛ ko sisi nɔ, nɛ nyɛ ko ye nyɛ sibi lakpa.
12 “Nyɛ ko ngɔ ye biɛ kɛ ka lakpa kita kɛ wo ye biɛ he mu. Imi ji Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ nɛ.
13 “Koo fia o nyɛmi ojo, nɛ koo ju e nɔ́ ko hulɔ. Ke o ya bɔ nɔ ko apaa ke e ba tsu ní ha mo ɔ, wo lɛ hiɔ loko je nɛ na nɔ. 14 Koo gbiɛ tue kpokutsɛ, nɛ koo fɔ hɛ yuyuilɔ blɔ mi tso. Ye o Mawu ɔ gbeye. Imi ji Yawɛ.
15 “Nyɛɛ ye dami sane ngɛ kojomi mi; nyɛ ko hyɛ nɔ ko hɛ mi, ohiatsɛ ji lɛ jio, niatsɛ ji lɛ jio. 16Koo pee o he sieku yelɔ kɛ hi yae kɛ hi bae ngɛ o ma mi bi ɔmɛ a kpɛti. Koo ye lakpa odase kɛ si o nyɛmi, nɛ́ a pue e muɔ si yaka gu. Imi ji Yawɛ.
17 “Koo nyɛ o nyɛmi ngɛ o tsui mi. Ke sane ko ba a, o kɛ lɛ nɛ hla mi, konɛ e he ɔ, mo mohu o ko ba pee yayami. 18 Koo ye mo nitsɛ o he lue, nɛ koo nyɛ o ma a mi bi ɔmɛ a ti nɔ ko nɔ ko; se mohu, moo suɔ o nyɛmi nɔmlɔ kaa bɔ nɛ o suɔ mo nitsɛ o he ɔ. Imi ji Yawɛ.
19 “Nyɛɛ ye ye mlaa amɛ a nɔ. Nyɛ ko ha nɛ nyɛ we mi lohwehi nɛ kuɔ henɔ kpahi nɛ a kɛ mɛ nɛ fɔ. Nyɛ ko du wu munomuno enyɔ ngɛ ngmɔ kake mi; nɛ nyɛ ko wo tade nɛ a kɛ nɔ́ slɔɔto enyɔ lo bo ɔ.
20“Ke nyumu ko kɛ nyɔguɛ yo ko nɛ a bi e si ha nyumu kpa na bɔmi be mi nɛ a kpɔ̃ we lɛ, loo e yi e he lolo ɔ, a hla munyu ɔ mi. A ko gbe mɛ, ejakaa nyɔguɛ ɔ yi e he lolo. 21Se nyumu ɔ lɛɛ lɛ nitsɛ e ngɔ agbosu kɛ ba ha Yawɛ ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ sinya a nya, nɛ a kɛ ba sã fɔ yemi bɔ. 22Osɔfo ɔ nɛ ngɔ agbosu ɔ nɛ a kɛ ma fɔ yemi bɔ ɔ sami ɔ kɛ ya Yawɛ hɛ mi, nɛ e kɛ ya pee kusumi kɛ kpata Yawɛ ngɛ yayami nɛ nɔ ɔ pee ɔ he, nɛ Mawu kɛ maa pa lɛ.
23“Ke nyɛ ya su Kanaan zugba a nɔ, nɛ nyɛ du tso slɔɔtoslɔɔtohi nɛ woɔ yiblii slɔɔtoslɔɔtohi nɛ a yeɔ ɔ, nyɛɛ bu a yiblii ɔmɛ kaa níhi nɛ a tsi nya kekleekle jeha etɛ ɔmɛ; jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, nyɛ ko ye eko. 24Jeha eywiɛne ɔ mi ɔ, nyɛɛ ngɔ yiblii ɔmɛ tsuo ngɔ pee sina bɔ klɛdɛɛ ha imi Yawɛ. 25Jeha enuɔne ɔ mi lɛɛ nyɛ ma nyɛ maa ye a yiblii ɔmɛ. Ke nyɛ pee ní nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, tso ɔmɛ maa wo yiblii babauu ha nyɛ. Imi ji Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ nɛ.
26 “Nyɛ ko ye lo nɛ muɔ ngɛ mi kɛ mwɔɔ. Nyɛ ko klaa, nɛ nyɛ ko ye kunya hulɔ. 27 Nyɛ ko po huɛ ngɛ nyɛ yi kpɛti, nɛ nyɛ ko sua nyɛ kpɛni hulɔ. 28Ke nɔ ko gbo ɔ, nyɛ ko po nyɛ he ha, nɛ nyɛ ko ngmaangmaa nyɛ he kɛ ye kɔmɔ. Imi ji Yawɛ.
29 “Ko ha nɛ o biyo nɛ pee e he yaholɔ, nɛ e ba puɛ. Ke e pee ja a, yahomi kɛ musu bɔmi ma ba hiɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ. 30 Nyɛɛ ye ye Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔmɛ, nɛ nyɛɛ ngɔ bu kɛ ha ye he klɔuklɔu ɔ; imi ji Yawɛ.
31 “Nyɛ ko ya bi ní ngɛ klaali, kɛ kunya yeli a ngɔ; ke nyɛ pee ja a, nyɛ ma ble nyɛ he. Imi ji Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ nɛ.
32“Buu nɔkɔtɔma, nɛ o wo e hɛ mi nyami. Ye mi gbeye. Imi ji Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ nɛ.
33 “Ke nɔ ko ba to nyɛ nubwɔ ngɛ zugba a nɔ ɔ, nyɛ ko pee lɛ yayami. 34Ke nɔ ko ba to nyɛ nubwɔ ɔ, nyɛɛ bu lɛ kaa ma a mi no nɔuu. Moo suɔ lɛ kaa bɔ nɛ o suɔ mo nitsɛ o he ɔ; ejakaa nyɛ hu nyɛ ya to nubwɔ hyɛ ngɛ Egipt zugba a nɔ. Imi ji Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ nɛ.
35 “Nyɛ ko sisi nɔ ngɛ nɔ́ ko kami, e jiimi, loo e hiɛmi kalemi mi. 36Nyɛɛ ngɔ sɛnihi, sɛni tɛhi, kɛ susumi níhi nɛ da kɛ tsu ní. Imi ji Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ nɛ je nyɛ kɛ je Egipt zugba a nɔ ɔ nɛ. 37Nyɛ hɛ nɛ hi ye mlaa amɛ, kɛ ye blɔ nya tomi ɔmɛ tsuo nɔ, konɛ nyɛɛ ye a nɔ. Imi ji Yawɛ.”

Title: MOSE III, 20
Content:
Tue gbomi he tue gblami
1Yawɛ de Mose ke 2e de Israel bi ɔmɛ ke, “Ke nyɛ ti nɔ ko, loo nubwɔ ko nɛ ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti ngɔ e bi kɛ ha nɛ a kɛ ja mawu ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ Molek ɔ, ma a tsuo nɛ fia lɛ tɛ nɛ e gbo. 3Ke nɔ ko ngɔ e bi kɛ ha Molek, nɛ e kɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ble ye bo tsu klɔuklɔu ɔ, nɛ e kɛ puɛ ye biɛ klɔuklɔu ɔ, ye hɛ maa dɔ kɛ wo jamɛ a nɔ ɔ, nɛ ma je lɛ we; a be lɛ bue ngɔ si ye ma a mi bi ɔmɛ a nɔ hu. 4Ke nɔ ko ngɔ e bi ha Molek, nɛ ma a mi bi ɔmɛ ku a hɛ ngɔ fɔ nɔ, nɛ a gbi lɛ ɔ, 5imi nitsɛ ye hɛ maa dɔ kɛ wo jamɛ a nɔ ɔ, kɛ e weku li, kɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ piɛ e he kɛ ya sɔmɔ Molek ɔ. Ma je mɛ we, nɛ a be mɛ bue ngɔ si ye ma a mi bi ɔmɛ a nɔ hu.
6“Ke nɔ ko je ye se nɛ e ya bi ní ngɛ klaali, kɛ kunya yeli a ngɔ ɔ, imi Mawu ɔ, ye hɛ maa dɔ kɛ wo lɛ, nɛ ma je lɛ we; a be lɛ bue ngɔ si ye ma a mi bi ɔmɛ a nɔ hu. 7Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ tsukɔ nyɛ he nɛ nyɛɛ pee klɔuklɔu, ejakaa imi ji Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ nɛ. 8Nyɛ hɛ nɛ hi ye mlaa amɛ a nɔ, nɛ nyɛɛ ye a nɔ. Imi ji Yawɛ nɛ peeɔ nyɛ klɔuklɔu ɔ nɛ.”
9 Yawɛ wo mlaa nɛ ɔmɛ hulɔ. Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa gbiɛ e tsɛ, loo e nyɛ ɔ, á gbe lɛ; e gbenɔ ɔ sa lɛ nitsɛ.
10 Ke Israel no ko kɛ e nyɛmi Israel no e yo na bɔmi ɔ, a puɛ gba; á gbe nyumu ɔ kɛ yo ɔ tsuo. 11 Ke nɔ ko kɛ e tsɛ e yo na bɔmi ɔ, e pue e tsɛ ɔ hɛ mi si. Á gbe nyumu ɔ kɛ yo ɔ tsuo. A gbenɔ ɔ sa mɛ nitsɛmɛ. 12 Ke nyumu ko kɛ e binyumu e yo na bɔmi ɔ, á gbe mɛ ni enyɔ ɔmɛ tsuo. A bɔ musu; lɔ ɔ he ɔ a gbenɔ ɔ sa mɛ nitsɛmɛ. 13 Ke nyumu kɛ nyumu na bɔmi kaa nyumu kɛ yo bɔɔ ɔ, mɛ ni enyɔ ɔmɛ tsuo a bɔ musu. Á gbe mɛ; a gbenɔ ɔ sa mɛ nitsɛmɛ. 14 Ke nyumu ko ngɔ nɔ kɛ e bi tsuo ɔ, e bɔ musu; a sã mɛ ni etɛ ɔmɛ tsuo, konɛ nɔ ko kó tsu musu ní nɛ ɔ eko ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti hu. 15 Ke nyumu ko kɛ lohwe na bɔmi ɔ, á gbe e kɛ lohwe ɔ tsuo. 16Ke yo ko ngɔ e he ngɔ ha lohwe ko, nɛ e kɛ lɛ na bɔmi ɔ, á gbe yo ɔ kɛ lohwe ɔ tsuo. A gbenɔ ɔ sa mɛ nitsɛmɛ.
17 Ke nyumu ko kɛ e nyɛmiyo na bɔmi ɔ, e tsɛbi ji lɛ jio, e nyɛbi ji lɛ jio, a tsu zo ní. A je mɛ we; a ko bu mɛ ngɔ si Mawu ma a mi bi ɔmɛ a nɔ hu. E nyɛmiyo e kɛ na bɔmi ɔ nɛ, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyumu ɔ musu tloo lɛ nitsɛ. 18 Ke nyumu ko kɛ yo ko na bɔmi be mi nɛ yo ɔ ku nine ɔ, a je mɛ ni enyɔ ɔmɛ tsuo we; a ko bu mɛ ngɔ si Mawu ma a mi bi ɔmɛ a nɔ hu; a tɔ mlaa nɛ kɔɔ he tsɔmi ngɛ nine kumi be mi ɔ nɔ.
19 Ke nyumu ko kɛ e nyɛ nyɛmiyo, loo e tsɛ nyɛmiyo na nyumu kɛ yo bɔmi ɔ, musu tloo mɛ, ejakaa nyɛmimɛ ji mɛ. 20Ke nyumu ko kɛ e tsɛ nyɛminyumu e yo na bɔmi ɔ, e pue e tsɛ nyɛminyumu ɔ hɛ mi si. E kɛ yo ɔ tsuo a musu tloo mɛ; a be fɔe kɛ yaa si a gbenɔ be. 21 Ke nɔ ko ngɔ e nyɛminyumu e yo ɔ, a be fɔe kɛ yaa si a gbenɔ be. Nyumu ɔ bɔ musu, nɛ e pue e nyɛminyumu ɔ hɛ mi si.
22Yawɛ de ke, “Nyɛ hɛ nɛ hi ye mlaa amɛ, kɛ ye blɔ nya tomi ɔmɛ tsuo a nɔ, nɛ nyɛɛ ye a nɔ, konɛ nyɛɛ hi Kanaan zugba a nɛ i kɛ nyɛ yaa nɔ ɔ nɔ; ke pi ja a, zugba a maa fie nyɛ kɛ je lejɛ ɔ. 23Nyɛ ko pee nihi nɛ i ngɛ mɛ fiee kɛ je zugba a nɔ ɔ a kusumi níhi. Mɛɛ lɛɛ a pee musu níhi nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ a he mlaa woe nɛ ɔ, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i hla we mɛ saasaa. 24Se nyɛɛ lɛɛ i wo nyɛ si ke, ma ngɔ zugba kpakpa nɛ baa ní saminya nɛ ɔ kɛ ha nyɛ nɛ e pee nyɛ weto ní. Imi ji Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ nɛ; imi nɛ i hla nyɛ kɛ je je ma amɛ a mi kɛ to ɔ nɛ. 25Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ le slɔɔto nɛ ngɛ lohwe nane eywiɛɛywiɛtsɛmɛ, lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ, níhi nɛ sãã si nɛ a he tsɔ, kɛ ní nɛmɛ nɛ a he tsɔ we ɔ a kpɛti. Nyɛ ko ye lohwehi nɛ a he tsɔ we. Ke nyɛ ye níhi nɛ i de ke a he tsɔ we ɔ, nyɛ ble nyɛ he. 26Nyɛɛ pee nyɛ he klɔuklɔu, ejakaa imi Yawɛ ɔ, i ngɛ klɔuklɔu. I hla nyɛ kɛ je je ma amɛ a kpɛti, konɛ nyɛɛ pee ye ma.
27“Nyumu tsuaa nyumu, loo yo tsuaa yo nɛ hiaa, loo a biɔ ní ngɛ e ngɔ ɔ, a fia lɛ tɛ nɛ e gbo; e gbenɔ ɔ sa lɛ nitsɛ.”

Title: MOSE III, 21
Content:
Osɔfo ɔmɛ a he tsɔmi
1Yawɛ fa Mose ke e de Aaron bimɛ ɔmɛ nɛ ji osɔfo ɔmɛ ke, “Ke nyɛ ma a mi bi ko gbo ɔ, nyɛ ti nɔ ko nɔ ko kó ya gbogboe ɔ he nɛ́ e ba ble e he, 2ja e he nɔ kɔklɔɔ kaa e nyɛ, e tsɛ, e binyumu, e biyo, loo e nyɛminyumu, 3loo e nyɛmiyo nɛ li nyumu. Akɛnɛ e nyɛmiyo ɔ be huno ɔ, e ma nyɛ ble e he ngɛ e he. 4Osɔfo ko kó ble e he ngɛ e yo weku no ko nɛ gbo ɔ he.
5 “Osɔfo ko po huɛ ngɛ e yi kpɛti, loo e sua e kpɛni he. E ko po e he ha, loo e ngmaa e he kɛ tsɔɔ kaa e ngɛ kɔmɔ yee. 6Osɔfo tsuaa osɔfo nɛ pee e he klɔuklɔu, nɛ e ko pue ye hɛ mi si; ejakaa lɛ nɛ sãã niye ní bɔ ɔ haa imi Yawɛ, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e sa nɛ e pee e he klɔuklɔu. 7Osɔfo ko kó ngɔ yo yaholɔ, aloo yo nɛ nɔ ko puɛ lɛ. E ko ngɔ yo nɛ e kɛ e huno be hu, ejakaa lɛ osɔfo ɔ, nɔ klɔuklɔu ji lɛ. 8Ma a nɛ bu osɔfo kaa nɔ klɔuklɔu, ejakaa lɛ nɛ e ngɔɔ niye ní bɔ ɔmɛ kɛ ba haa mi ɔ nɛ. Imi ji Yawɛ; i ngɛ klɔuklɔu, nɛ i peeɔ ye ma a klɔuklɔu. 9Ke osɔfo ko biyo pee e he yaholɔ ɔ, e pue e tsɛ hɛ mi si. A sã lɛ nɛ e gbo.
10“Nɔ nɛ ji osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa ngɛ e nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ a kpɛti, nɛ a pɔ lɛ nu, nɛ a pee lɛ klɔuklɔu ɔ, ke e wo osɔfo tade ɔ, e ko ha nɛ e yi bwɔmi nɛ gbɛ kɛ pue e yi nɔ, nɛ e ko hía e he tade ɔmɛ kɛ tsɔɔ kaa e ngɛ kɔmɔ yee. 11-12Osɔfo nɛ a pɔ lɛ nu ɔ, e ngɛ klɔuklɔu ha mi. E ko si ye bo tsu he klɔuklɔu ɔ kɛ ya he nɛ gbogboe ko ngɛ, nɛ e ba ble e he, kɛ he klɔuklɔu ɔ tsuo. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e ko ya gbogboe ko he, e tsɛ nɛ gbo jio, e nyɛ nɛ gbo jio. Imi ji Yawɛ. 13Osɔfo nɛ ngɔ yo nɛ li nyumu. 14E ko ngɔ yalɔyo, aloo yo nɛ e kɛ e huno be hu, loo yo nɛ nɔ ko puɛ lɛ, loo yaholɔ. É ngɔ yo nɛ li nyumu kɛ je lɛ nitsɛ e weku mi. 15Ke pi ja a, e bimɛ nɛ sa kaa a peeɔ klɔuklɔu ɔ, a he be tsɔe. Imi ji Yawɛ; imi nɛ i hla lɛ ngɔ to kaa osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma a nɛ.”
16Yawɛ ya nɔ nɛ e fa Mose ke 17e de Aaron ke, “Ngɛ yi nɔ ɔmɛ tsuo a mi ɔ, o nina ko nɛ kpa ngɛ e he ko hla kaa e maa ngɔ Yawɛ niye ní bɔ kɛ ba ha mi. 18Nɔ ko nɛ kpa ngɛ e he be he blɔ kaa e baa e Mawu ɔ hɛ mi haa, hɛ yuyuilɔ ji lɛ jio, libɔɔ ji lɛ jio, nɔ nɛ hɛ mi plaa hyɛ jio, nɔ nɛ kpa ko ngɛ e nane he jio, 19nɔ ko nɛ e nine, loo e nane ku jio, 20kpotsɛ jio, akɔtia jio, nɔ nɛ hɛngmɛ hiɔ ngɛ e he jio, nɔ nɛ he womi nɔ hiɔ yaya ngɛ e he jio, nɔ nɛ sungmɛ mi wu ywia jio. 21Osɔfo Aaron nina ko nɛ kpa ngɛ e he be he blɔ kaa e ngɔɔ niye ní bɔ kɛ ba haa Yawɛ. 22E ma nyɛ maa ye bɔ sami nike ní nɛ a kɛ ba haa mi ɔ eko, niye ní klɔuklɔu ɔ jio, klɔuklɔu pe kulaa a eko jio. 23Se akɛnɛ kpa ngɛ e he he je ɔ, e ko hɛ lɛ kɛ su tsu mi pomi bo ɔ, loo bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he. E ko ba ble ní klɔuklɔu nɛ ɔmɛ. Imi ji Yawɛ; imi nɛ i peeɔ mɛ klɔuklɔu ɔ nɛ.”
24Níhi nɛ Mose de Aaron, kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ, kɛ Israel ma a tsuo ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ.

Title: MOSE III, 22
Content:
Bɔ ɔmɛ a he tsɔmi
1Yawɛ fa Mose ke 2e de Aaron kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ ke, “Ní klɔuklɔuhi nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ tsukɔ he kɛ ha mi ɔ, nyɛɛ hyɛ a nɔ saminya, konɛ nyɛ ko pue ye biɛ klɔuklɔu ɔ hɛ mi si. Imi ji Yawɛ. 3Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ e he tsɔ we, nɛ e maa hɛ lɛ kɛ su ní klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ nɛ Israel ma a tsukɔ he kɛ ha imi Yawɛ ɔ a he ɔ, a je lɛ we; e ko sɔmɔ ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he ngɛ ye hɛ mi hu. Mlaa nɛ ɔ fɔɔ si kɛ ha yi nɔhi tsuo nɛ maa ba a. Imi ji Yawɛ.
4“Aaron nina ko nɛ ngɛ he womi nɔ hiɔ yaya nue, aloo nɔ ko nɛ nyu yaya ngɛ bee ngɛ e he ɔ, e ko ye ní klɔuklɔu ɔ eko kɛ yaa si be nɛ e he ma tsɔ. Osɔfo tsuaa osɔfo nɛ maa ta nɔ́ ko nɛ he tsɔ we he ɔ, nɔ gbogboe he jio, nyumu nɛ nyu yaya ngɛ bee ngɛ e he he jio, 5nɔ́ ko nɛ sãã si nɛ he tsɔ we he jio, loo nɔmlɔ nɛ he tsɔ we he jio, e he be tsɔe. 6Osɔfo tsuaa osɔfo nɛ maa ta ní nɛ ɔmɛ a he ɔ, e he be tsɔe kɛ yaa si du ma bu. E ko ye ní klɔuklɔu ɔ eko, ja e du e he. 7Ke pu nɔ si kɛkɛ e he tsɔ, kɛkɛ ɔ, e ma nyɛ maa ye ní klɔuklɔu ɔ eko, ejakaa enɛ ɔ ji nɔ́ nɛ e yeɔ. 8E ko ye lohwe ko nɛ lɛ nitsɛ e gbo, loo lohwe ko nɛ lohwe kpa ko tsɔtslɔɔ e mi; ke e ye ɔ, e ble e he. Imi ji Yawɛ.
9“Osɔfo ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ a ye ye blɔ nya tomi ɔmɛ a nɔ. A ko ble a he. Ke a pee ja a, a pee yayami, nɛ a ma gbo. Imi ji Yawɛ nɛ tsukɔɔ a he ɔ nɛ.
10“Nɔ ko nɛ ji osɔfo weku mi ɔ, e ko ye ní klɔuklɔu ɔ eko. Osɔfo we nubwɔ, loo e we apaatsɛ po e ko ye ní klɔuklɔu ɔ eko. 11Se nyɔguɛ nɛ osɔfo ɔ he kɛ lɛ nitsɛ e sika a ma nyɛ maa ye ní klɔuklɔu ɔ eko. Nyɔguɛhi a bimɛ nɛ a fɔ ngɛ osɔfo ɔ we mi hu ma nyɛ maa ye ní klɔuklɔu ɔ eko. 12Ke osɔfo biyo ya gba nɔ ko nɛ pi osɔfo ji lɛ ɔ, biyo nɛ ɔ ko ye bɔ sami ní klɔuklɔu ɔ eko. 13Se ke osɔfo ɔ biyo ya pee yalɔyo, loo e gba puɛ nɛ e be bi, nɛ e kpale kɛ ba e tsɛ we mi, nɛ e tsɛ ɔ ngɛ e nɔ hyɛe kaa sa a, e ma nyɛ maa ye e tsɛ ní ɔ eko. Nɔ ko nɛ ji osɔfo weku mi be he blɔ nɛ e yeɔ eko.
14“Ke nɔ ko li e he be nɛ e ye ní klɔuklɔu ɔ eko ɔ, é wo nɔ́ ɔ he hiɔ sisiisi, nɛ e ngɔ nɔ́ ɔ jua a mi dlami enuɔ mi kake ngɔ piɛ he kɛ to nane mi kɛ ha osɔfo ɔ. 15Nɔ ko nɔ ko ko ble ní klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ ngɔ kɛ ba ha Yawɛ ɔ; 16a ko ha nɔ ko nɛ sɛ́ nɛ ye eko. Ke a pee ja a, nɔ ɔ tɔ, nɛ a maa gbla e tue. Imi ji Yawɛ nɛ tsukɔɔ bɔ ɔmɛ a he ɔ nɛ.”
17Jehanɛ, Yawɛ fa Mose ke, 18e de Aaron, kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ, kɛ Israel ma a tsuo ke, “Ke Israel fɔfɔɛ, loo nubwɔ ko nɛ ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti maa sã sami bɔ ha imi Yawɛ ɔ, bɔ nɛ e wo he si jio, bɔ nɛ je tsui mi faa jio, 19lohwe nɛ a kɛ maa sã bɔ ɔ nɛ pee lohwe ku nɛ kpa ko be e he, na ku, loo agbosu, loo akpakpo. 20 A ko ngɔ lohwe ko nɛ kpa ngɛ e he kɛ ba, ejakaa imi Yawɛ, i be ngɔe. 21Ke nɔ ko maa sã tue mi jɔmi bɔ ha imi Yawɛ ɔ, bɔ nɛ e wo he si jio, bɔ nɛ je tsui mi faa jio, lohwe nɛ a kɛ maa sã bɔ ɔ, e pee lohwe nɛ kpa ko be e he, na jio, to jio. 22Nyɛ ko ngɔ lohwehi kaa enɛ ɔmɛ kɛ ba sã bɔ ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ ha Yawɛ: nɔ́ nɛ hɛngmɛ yu, nɔ́ nɛ nane ku, nɔ́ nɛ plaa, nɔ́ nɛ pa nyu ngɛ fofoe ngɛ e he, loo nɔ́ nɛ je sakpa. 23Na ku, loo jijɔ bi nɛ e nine, loo e nane ka tsɔ ɔ, a ma nyɛ kɛ ba kaa bɔ nɛ je tsui mi faa. Se ke a kɛ ba kaa bɔ nɛ a wo he si ɔ, lɛɛ a be ngɔe. 24Lohwe tsuaa lohwe nɛ e sungmɛ plaa, loo e sungmɛ mi wu ywia, loo a ta lɛ ɔ, a ko ngɔ kɛ ba sã bɔ ha Yawɛ; a ko pee ja ngɛ nyɛ zugba a nɔ.
25“Nyɛ ko he kikɛmɛ a lohwe nɛ ɔmɛ eko kɛ je nibwɔhi a dɛ kɛ ba sã niye ní bɔ ha nyɛ Mawu ɔ; akɛnɛ kpa ngɛ a he ɔ, a be mɛ ngɔe.
26-27“Ke a fɔ na, loo jijɔ, loo apletsi ɔ, e hi e nyɛ ɔ ngɔ ligbi kpaago. Kɛ je ligbi kpaanyɔne ɔ kɛ yaa a, a ma nyɛ kɛ ba sã niye ní bɔ ha Yawɛ. 28Nyɛ ko gbe na kɛ e bi, loo to kɛ e bi tsuo ligbi kake. 29Nyɛɛ sã sina bɔ ha Yawɛ ngɛ mlaa a nya, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ a he nyɛ bɔ ɔ. 30Nyɛɛ ye ní ɔ ligbi ɔ kɛ̃; je nɛ ko na yi. Imi ji Yawɛ.
31“Nyɛ hɛ nɛ hi ye mlaa amɛ a nɔ, nɛ nyɛɛ ye a nɔ. Imi ji Yawɛ. 32Nyɛ ko ble ye biɛ klɔuklɔu ɔ, se mohu Israel ma a tsuo nɛ yɔse kaa i ngɛ klɔuklɔu. Imi ji Yawɛ nɛ tsukɔɔ nyɛ he ɔ nɛ. 33I je nyɛ kɛ je Egipt zugba a nɔ, konɛ ma pee nyɛ Mawu. Imi ji Yawɛ.”

Title: MOSE III, 23
Content:
Jami mi nyami be ɔmɛ
1-2Yawɛ fa Mose ke e de Israel bi ɔmɛ ke, nyami behi nɛ a maa ye kɛ wo ye hɛ mi nyami ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ. 3 Nyɛ tsu ní ligbi ekpa, se ligbi kpaagone ɔ ji Hejɔɔmi ligbi. Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, nyɛ maa jɔɔ nyɛ he. Nyɛ ma bua nyɛ he nya, nɛ nyɛ ma ja Mawu. Nɔ ko nɛ ko tsu ní jamɛ a ligbi ɔ; ejakaa e ji he jɔɔmi ligbi ha Yawɛ ngɛ nyɛ sihi he ɔmɛ tsuo kulaa. 4Nyɛɛ fiɛ nyami ligbi nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ a be ɔmɛ a mi pɛpɛɛpɛ kɛ ha ma a.
Hetsɔmi kɛ Abolokplolo nyami be ɔmɛ
(Mose IV, 28.16-25)
5 Kekleekle nyɔhiɔ ɔ we ligbi nyɔngma kɛ eywiɛne ɔ gbɔkuɛ ji Hetsɔmi ɔ nɛ a kɛ woɔ Yawɛ hɛ mi nyami ɔ sisije. 6 Jamɛ a nyɔhiɔ ɔ nɔuu we ligbi nyɔngma kɛ enuɔne ɔ ji Abolokplolo nyami be ɔ sisije ɔ nɛ. Nyɛɛ ye abolo kplolo ligbi kpaago. 7Nyɛ bua nyɛ he nya nɛ nyɛ ja Mawu nyɔhiɔ ɔ we kekleekle ligbi ɔ. Nyɛ ko tsu ní tsumi kpakpataa ko. 8Nyɛɛ ngɔ niye ní bɔ nɛ a kɛ la sãã kɛ ba ha Yawɛ ligbi kpaago. Ligbi kpaagone ɔ, nyɛ bua nyɛ he nya ekohu nɛ nyɛ ja Mawu; nyɛ ko tsu ní tsumi kpakpataa ko.
9-10Ke nyɛ ba su zugba a nɛ Yawɛ ma ha nyɛ ɔ nɔ nɛ nyɛ kpa ní ɔ, nyɛɛ ngɔ niba ní ɔ kekleekle nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ bua nya kɛ ba ha osɔfo ɔ. 11Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ nɔ jena a, osɔfo ɔ nɛ ngɔ kɛ ba Yawɛ hɛ mi kaa bɔ nɛ a fɔɔ kɛ yaa kɛ baa, konɛ Mawu nɛ he nyɛ sina a. 12Ligbi ɔ nɛ nyɛ maa ngɔ nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ bua nya a kɛ ha Yawɛ kaa nike ní ɔ, nyɛɛ ngɔ jijɔ nɛ ye jeha kake, nɛ kpa ko be e he kɛ ba sã sami bɔ ha Yawɛ. 13Nyɛɛ ngɔ mamu bukɔbukɔ nɛ a futu mi nu kilo enyɔ hu kɛ piɛ he kɛ ba sã niye ní bɔ. Enɛ ɔ ji bɔ nɛ jee via saminya, nɛ saa Yawɛ hɛ mi. Á ngɔ wai lita kake ngɔ piɛ he. 14Nyɛ ko ye blɛfo kpokploku, loo blɛfo nɛ a sã, loo abolo kɛ yaa si be nɛ nyɛ maa ngɔ nyɛ Mawu ɔ bɔ kɛ ba ha lɛ. Enɛ ɔ ji mlaa nɛ maa fɔ si kɛ ha nyɛ yi nɔ ɔmɛ tsuo ngɛ nyɛ hi he ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ yaa neneene.
Ngmakpami nyami be ɔ
(Mose IV, 28.26-31)
15 Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ we jena a nɛ nyɛ maa ngɔ bɔ nɛ a fɔɔ kɛ yaa kɛ baa a kɛ ba a we otsi kpaago, 16aloo ligbi nyingmi enuɔne nɛ ji Hejɔɔjmi ligbi kpaagone ɔ we jena a, nyɛɛ ngɔ kpokploku kɛ ba sã niye ní bɔ ha Yawɛ. 17We puɔ nya tsuaa we puɔ nya nɛ ngɔ abolo bɔbɔɛ enyɔ kɛ ba ha Yawɛ kaa bɔ nɛ a fɔɔ kɛ yaa kɛ baa. Abolo bɔbɔɛ tsuaa abolo bɔbɔɛ ɔ, a ngɔ mamu bukɔbukɔ kilo enyɔ nɛ a wo mi masa kɛ pee. A ngɔ enɛ ɔ kɛ sã bɔ ha Yawɛ kaa kekleekle niba ní bɔ. 18Nyɛɛ ngɔ jijɔ ku kpaago nɛ a ye jeha kakaaka, kɛ na niheyo kake, kɛ agbosu enyɔ nɛ kpa ko be a he kɛ piɛ abolo ɔ he kɛ ba sã sami bɔ ha Yawɛ. Nyɛɛ ngɔ niye ní bɔ, kɛ e he wai bɔ hu kɛ piɛ he. Enɛ ɔ ji bɔ nɛ a kɛ la sãã nɛ jee via ha Yawɛ. 19Jehanɛ, nyɛɛ ngɔ akpakpo kake kɛ ba sã yayami pami bɔ, kɛ jijɔ ku enyɔ nɛ a ye jeha kakaaka kɛ ba sã tue mi jɔmi bɔ. 20Osɔfo ɔ nɛ ngɔ abolo ɔ, kɛ jijɔ enyɔ ɔmɛ kɛ ba Yawɛ hɛ mi kaa bɔ nɛ a fɔɔ kɛ yaa kɛ baa. Bɔ nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ klɔuklɔu ha Yawɛ kɛ ha osɔfo ɔmɛ. 21Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, nɔ ko nɔ ko kó tsu ní tsumi kpakpataa ko, se nyɛ bua nyɛ he nya, nɛ nyɛ ja Mawu. Enɛ ɔ ji mlaa nɛ maa fɔ si kɛ maa ya neneene ha nyɛ yi nɔ ɔmɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ ngɛ nyɛ sihi he ɔmɛ tsuo.
22 Ke nyɛ kpa nyɛ zugba a nɔ ní ɔ, nyɛ ko kpa ngmɔ ɔ mi kɛ ngmɔ ɔ nya ní ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ pi si; nɔ́ nɛ ma pue si, loo e maa piɛ ɔ hu, nyɛ ko kpale nyɛ se kɛ ya kpɛte. Nyɛ si ha ohiatsɛmɛ kɛ nibwɔhi. Imi ji Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ nɛ.
Jehahe nyami be
(Mose IV, 29.1-6)
23-24Nyɔhiɔ kpaagone ɔ we kekleekle ligbi ɔ, nyɛɛ pee kpoo, nɛ nyɛɛ jɔɔ nyɛ he. Ke nyɛ nu nɛ titimati ɔmɛ pɛ ɔ, nyɛ bua nya he nya, nɛ nyɛ ja Mawu. 25Nyɛ ko tsu ní tsumi kpakpataa ko. Nyɛɛ ngɔ niye ní bɔ nɛ a kɛ la sãã kɛ ba ha Yawɛ.
Kpatami ligbi ɔ
(Mose IV, 29.7-11)
26 Yawɛ de Mose ke, 27nyɔhiɔ kpaagone ɔ we ligbi nɛ ji nyɔngma a ji kpatami ligbi ɔ nɛ. Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, nyɛɛ bua nyɛ he nya nɛ nyɛ ja Mawu. Nyɛɛ ha hwɔ, nɛ nyɛɛ sã bɔ nɛ a kɛ la sãã ha Yawɛ. 28Nyɛ ko tsu nɔ́ ko ngɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ nɔ, ejakaa e ji ligbi nɛ a maa pee kusumi kɛ kpata Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ ha nyɛ. 29Nɔ nɛ be hwɔ hae ngɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ, a je lɛ we, nɛ a ko bu lɛ ngɔ si ye ma a mi bi ɔmɛ a nɔ hu. 30Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ma tsu nɔ́ ko ngɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ, imi nitsɛ ma kpata e hɛ mi. 31Nyɛ ko tsu nɔ́ ko ngɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ nɔ. Enɛ ɔ ji mlaa nɛ fɔɔ si kɛ ha nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ nina ngɛ nyɛ hi he ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ yaa neneene. 32Kɛ je nyɔhiɔ ɔ we ligbi nɛ ji nɛɛ ɔ we gbɔkuɛ ke pu nɔ si, kɛ yaa si ligbi nyɔngmane ɔ we gbɔkuɛ ke pu nɔ si ekohu ɔ nɛ pee he jɔɔmi be pɔtɛɛ kɛ ha nyɛ; jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, nyɛɛ ha hwɔ.
Gbasisihimi nyami be
(Mose IV, 29.12-40)
33-34 Nyɛɛ ye Gbasisihimi nyami be ɔ ligbi kpaago. Nyɛɛ je sisi ngɛ nyɔhiɔ kpaagone ɔ we ligbi nyɔngma kɛ enuɔne ɔ nɔ. 35Kekleekle ligbi ɔ, nyɛ bua nyɛ he nya, nɛ nyɛ ja Mawu. Nyɛ ko tsu ní tsumi kpakpataa ko jamɛ a ligbi ɔ. 36Daa ligbi ɔ, nyɛɛ sã niye ní bɔ nɛ a kɛ la sãã. Nyɛɛ pee enɛ ɔ ligbi kpaago. Ligbi nɛ ji kpaanyɔ ɔ, nyɛ bua nyɛ he nya ekohu nɛ nyɛ ja Mawu, nɛ nyɛɛ ngɔ niye ní bɔ nɛ a kɛ la sãã kɛ ba ha Yawɛ. E ji jami ligbi; nyɛ ko tsu ní tsumi kpakpataa ko jamɛ a ligbi ɔ.
37Nyami behi nɛ a kɛ jaa Yawɛ ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ. Níhi nɛ nyɛɛ pee ji nɛ ɔmɛ: nyɛ bua nyɛ he nya nɛ nyɛ ja Mawu. Nyɛɛ ngɔ nyɛ niye ní bɔ ɔmɛ nɛ a kɛ la sãã a, sami bɔ ɔmɛ, ngma bɔ ɔmɛ, kɛ a he wai bɔ ɔmɛ kɛ ba ha Yawɛ kaa bɔ nɛ a to ha ligbi slɔɔtoslɔɔto ɔmɛ. 38Nyami be nɛ ɔmɛ piɛ Yawɛ daa Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ he. Nike ní, kɛ bɔhi nɛ a maa sã kɛ piɛ nyɛ bɔhi nɛ nyɛ wo he si ɔ, kɛ bɔhi nɛ je tsui mi faa a a he ɔ, nyɛɛ sã mɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ kɛ ha Yawɛ.
39Ke nyɛ kpa nyɛ ngmɔ ní ɔmɛ gbe nya a, nyɛɛ ye nyami be ha Yawɛ ligbi kpaago, kɛ je nyɔhiɔ kpaagone ɔ we ligbi nyɔngma kɛ enuɔne ɔ. Kekleekle ligbi ɔ, kɛ ligbi kpaanyɔne ɔ nɛ a pee he jɔɔmi ligbihi ha nyɛ. 40Kekleekle ligbi ɔ, nyɛɛ ngɔ tso yiblii kpakpahi, tã bahi, kɛ tso kusuuhi a kɔnihi kɛ a he ba nɛ nyɛ kɛ nya ligbi kpaago kɛ wo Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ hɛ mi nyami. 41Nyɛ nya ligbi kpaago ngɛ nyɔhiɔ kpaagone ɔ mi; enɛ ɔ ji mlaa nɛ fɔɔ si kɛ ha nyɛ nina kɛ yaa neneene. 42Israel fɔfɔɛ tsuo nɛ hi gbahi a sisi ligbi kpaago, 43konɛ nyɛ nina nɛ na nɛ a le kaa gbahi a sisi nɛ Yawɛ ha nyɛ nɛmɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ hi, benɛ i kpaka mɛ kɛ je Egipt ɔ. Imi ji Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ nɛ.
44Bɔ nɛ Mose wo Israel ma a mlaa kaa a ye nyami behi kɛ wo Yawɛ hɛ mi nyami ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.

Title: MOSE III, 24
Content:
Kane ɔmɛ a nɔ hyɛmi
(Mose II, 27.20-21)
1Yawɛ fa Mose ke 2e de Israel bi ɔmɛ nɛ a ngɔ oliv nu nɛ a si mi nɛ e mi tsɔ ngleinglei kɛ ba, nɛ a kɛ ba wo kane ɔmɛ a mi ngɛ bo tsu ɔ mi, konɛ la nɛ hi tsoe be tsuaa be ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. 3Aaron nɛ ya su kane ɔmɛ daa gbɔkuɛ, nɛ a hi tsoe ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi kɛ yaa si mɔtu. E kɛ ma tsu mi pomi bo ɔ nɛ tsi somi daka a hɛ mi ɔ se, ngɛ he klɔuklɔu pe kulaa a. Enɛ ɔ ji mlaa nɛ maa fɔ si kɛ ha nyɛ yi nɔhi tsuo kulaa kɛ yaa neneene. 4Aaron nɛ to kane ɔmɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ ngɛ kane tso nɛ a kɛ sika tsu ngmingmiingmi ha he ɔ nɔ, nɛ e hyɛ nɛ a hi tsoe daa ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi.
Abolo nɛ a kɛ maa Yawɛ hɛ mi ɔ
5 Ngɔɔ mamu bukɔbukɔ kilo nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ kɛ sã abolo bɔbɔɛ nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ. 6Nyɛɛ to abolo ɔmɛ ngɛ za enyɔ mi kɛ pue okplɔɔ nɛ a kɛ sika tsu ngmingmiingmi ha he ɔ nɔ ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi. Abolo ɔ ekpa nɛ hi za kake mi. 7Nyɛɛ ngɔ tsopa kɛ e he via ngɔ pue abolo ɔmɛ a nɔ ngɛ za enyɔ ɔmɛ tsuo a mi, konɛ e pee abolo ɔ nane mi okadi kaa bɔ nɛ a kɛ la sãã ha Yawɛ. 8Daa Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ, Aaron nɛ da Israel bi ɔmɛ a nane mi, nɛ e ngɔ abolo ɔ kɛ ma Yawɛ hɛ mi. Enɛ ɔ maa pee Israel bi ɔmɛ a ní tsumi kɛ yaa neneene. 9 Abolo nɛ ɔ maa pee Aaron kɛ e nina a nɔ́. A ye ngɛ he ko nɛ ngɛ klɔuklɔu, ejakaa niye ní nɛ a kɛ ba sãã bɔ ha Yawɛ ɔ peeɔ osɔfo ɔmɛ a nɔ́; e ji nɔ́ klɔuklɔu.
Tue gblami nɛ da
10-11Nyumu ko hi si nɛ e tsɛ ɔ Egipt no, se e nyɛ lɛɛ Israel no. E nyɛ ɔ, Dibri nɛ je Dan wɛtso ɔ mi ɔ biyo ji lɛ; nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Shelomit. Nyumu nɛ ɔ kɛ Israel no ko pɛ ngɛ ma sito he ɔ. Benɛ a ngɛ pɛe ɔ, nyumu ɔ gbiɛ Mawu; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a nu lɛ kɛ ya ha Mose. 12Mose ha a tsi e nya kɛ yaa si be nɛ Yawɛ nitsɛ maa tsɔɔ mɛ nɔ́ nɛ a pee lɛ.
13Yawɛ de Mose ke, 14“Jé nyumu ɔ nɛ bɔ musu ɔ kpo kɛ je ma sito he ɔ. Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ nu e musu bɔmi munyu ɔ, é ngɔ e nine ngɔ pue nyumu ɔ yi mi, konɛ ma a tsuo nɛ fia lɛ tɛ. 15Jehanɛ, de Israel ma a tsuo ke, nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa gbiɛ Mawu ɔ, e musu tloo lɛ; 16e sa nɛ a gbe lɛ. Israel fɔfɔɛ, loo nubwɔ nɛ maa bɔ musu kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ, ma a tsuo nɛ fia lɛ tɛ nɛ e gbo.
17 “Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa gbe nɔmlɔ ɔ, lɛ hu a gbe lɛ. 18Ke nɔ ko gbe nɔ ko lohwe ɔ, e to nane mi. A ngɔ wami kɛ to wami nane mi.
19“Ke nɔ ko plaa nɔ ko ɔ, a pee lɛ ja kɛ to nane mi. 20 Ke nɔ ko ku nɔ ko wu ɔ, lɛ hu a ku e wu; ke e pɛ nɔ ko hɛngmɛ ɔ, lɛ hu a pɛ e hɛngmɛ; ke e hia nɔ ko lungu ɔ, lɛ hu a hia e lungu; bɔ nɛ e maa plaa nɔ ko ha a, lɛ hu a plaa lɛ ja kɛ to nane mi. 21Ke nɔ ko gbe lohwe ko ɔ, e to nane mi. Se ke e gbe nɔmlɔ ɔ, lɛ hu a gbe lɛ. 22 Nubwɔ jio, ma a mi no jio, mlaa kake nɛ ngɛ ha nyɛ tsuo. Imi ji Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ nɛ.”
23Benɛ Mose kɛ Israel ma a tu munyu nɛ ɔ gbe nya a, a ngɔ nyumu ɔ nɛ bɔ musu ɔ kɛ je ma sito he ɔ, nɛ a ya fia lɛ tɛ nɛ e gbo. Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa Mose ɔ, ja pɛpɛɛpɛ Israel ma a pee ɔ nɛ.

Title: MOSE III, 25
Content:
Jeha kpaagone ɔ
(Mose V, 15.1-11)
1 Yawɛ kɛ Mose tu munyu ngɛ Sinai yo ɔ nɔ nɛ e fa lɛ 2ke e wo Israel bi ɔmɛ mlaa nɛ ɔmɛ. Ke nyɛ su zugba nɛ Yawɛ ma ha nyɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ, nyɛ ha nɛ zugba a nɛ jɔɔ e he kɛ wo Yawɛ hɛ mi nyami. 3Jeha ekpa nyɛ du ní nɛ nyɛ sua wai tso ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ nyɛ wai ngmɔ ɔmɛ a mi ɔ a he, nɛ nyɛ bua wai yiblii ɔmɛ a nya. 4Se jeha kpaagone ɔ lɛɛ nyɛ ha nɛ zugba a nɛ jɔɔ e he kulaa; e pee jeha nɛ a kɛ maa wo Yawɛ hɛ mi nyami. Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, nyɛ ko du ní; nɛ nyɛ ko sua nyɛ wai tso ɔmɛ a he. 5Blɛfo nɛ lɛ nitsɛ e puɛ ngɛ ní kpami se po, nyɛ ko kpɔ; nɛ wai yiblii nɛ wo ngɛ wai tso nɛ a sua we e he ɔ nɔ ɔ hu nyɛ ko bua nya; jamɛ a jeha kulaa a, zugba a maa jɔɔ e he. 6E ngɛ mi kaa jamɛ a jeha a, a hu we zugba a lɛɛ, se kɛ̃ e maa ba ní ha nyɛ, nyɛ nyɔguɛ nyumuhi, nyɛ nyɔguɛ yihi, apaa yeli nɛ tsuɔ ní ha nyɛ, nibwɔhi nɛ ba to nyɛ ɔ, 7nyɛ we mi lohwehi kɛ pu mi lohwehi tsuo. Zugba a mi niba ní tsuo maa pee niye ní ha nyɛ.
Ngwɔhe tomi jeha
8Nyɛɛ kane jeha kpaago totoe kpaago; lɛ tsuo peeɔ jeha nyingmi eywiɛ kɛ nɛɛ. 9Jehanɛ, nyɔhiɔ kpaago ɔ nɔ ligbi nyɔngma a nɛ ji kpatami ligbi ɔ, nyɛɛ tsɔ nɛ a ya kpa titimati wawɛɛ kɛ kpa zugba a tsuo nɔ. 10Bɔ nɛ nyɛ maa pee jeha nɛ ji nyingmi enuɔ ɔ klɔuklɔu ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. Nyɛɛ fiɛ kɛ ha zugba a nɔ bi ɔmɛ tsuo ke Heyemi be ɔ su oo. E maa pee nyami jeha ha nyɛ. Jamɛ a jeha a, weto ní tsuaa weto ní nɛ nɔ ko kɛ to awaba a, a kpale kɛ ha nɔtsɛ ɔ, loo e nina. Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ a kɛ lɛ ya to awaba a, e kpale e se kɛ ya e nɔ́ mi, kɛ e weku li a ngɔ ekohu. 11Nyɛ ko du ní, nɛ nyɛ ko kpa ní; nɔ́ nɛ lɛ nitsɛ e puɛ hu nyɛ ko kpa. Jã kɛ̃ wai yiblii nɛ wo ngɛ wai tso nɛ nyɛ sua we e he ɔ nɔ ɔ, nyɛ ko bua nya. 12Jeha a tsuo maa pee klɔuklɔu ha nyɛ. Nyɛɛ ye niba ní nɛ nyɛ ma na ngɛ zugba a nɔ ɔ pɛ.
13Heyemi jeha nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, weto ní tsuo nɛ a jua a, a kpale kɛ ha nɔtsɛ. 14Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke o jua zugba ko kɛ ha o nyɛmi Israel fɔfɔɛ, loo o he zugba ngɛ e dɛ ɔ, nyɛ ko sisi nyɛ sibi. 15Ke o maa wo zugba ko he jua ha o nyɛmi ɔ, moo kane jeha abɔ nɛ piɛ nɛ a ma du ní ngɛ zugba a nɔ loko a maa ye Heyemi jeha a. 16Ke jeha nɛ piɛ ɔ hiɛ fuu ɔ, lɛɛ jua a maa ya hiɔwe, se ke jeha nɛ piɛ ɔ pi ɔ, lɛɛ jua a maa ba si; ejakaa niba ní nɛ a ma na kɛ maa je ngmɔ ɔ mi ɔ, lɔ ɔ a ngɛ juae ɔ nɛ. 17Nyɛ ko sisi nyɛ sibi Israel fɔfɔɛhi, se mohu nyɛɛ ye Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ gbeye.
Jeha kpaagone ɔ mi haomi komɛ
18Enɛ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ hɛ nɛ hi Yawɛ mlaa amɛ, kɛ e blɔ nya tomi ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ nyɛɛ ye a nɔ, konɛ nyɛɛ hi zugba a nɔ ngɛ he jɔmi mi. 19Zugba a maa ba ní, nɛ nyɛ maa ye ní nɛ nyɛ maa tɔ; nɛ nyɛ maa hi zugba a nɔ ngɛ he jɔmi mi.
20Nɔ ko ma bi ke, “Jeha kpaagone ɔ nɛ wa du we ní, nɛ wa kpa we ní hulɔ ɔ, mɛni wa maa ye mɔ.” 21Yawɛ maa gbaa zugba a, nɛ niye ní babauu maa ba ngɛ jeha ekpane ɔ mi, nɛ nyɛ ma na jeha etɛ nya niye ní jamɛ a jeha a. 22Be nɛ nyɛ ngɛ ní due ngɛ jeha kpaanyɔne ɔ mi ɔ, nyɛ maa hi ngmɔ niba ní momo ɔ yee kɛ yaa si nyɛ ma kpa ní nɛ nyɛ du jamɛ a jeha a.
Weto ní se kpalemi
23Zugba a, nyɛ ko jua nɛ e ba plɛ pee nɔ ko nɔ́ kulaa. Zugba a, Mawu nɔ́, pi nyɛ nɔ́. Nyɛɛ lɛɛ Mawu nibwɔhi nɛ ba ngɛ ní tsue ngɛ zugba a nɔ kɛkɛ ji nyɛ.
24Zugba a nɔ he tsuaa he nɛ nyɛ maa hi ɔ, ke a jua zugba a, a to blɔ nya kɛ ha zugba a kpɔmi hwɔɔ se. 25Ke e fi Israel fɔfɔɛ ko nɛ e jua e zugba ko ɔ, e nyɛmi tutuutu nɛ yeɔ e ní ɔ nɛ kpɔ zugba a. 26Ke e be nɔ ko nɛ ma kpɔ zugba nɛ a jua nɛ ɔ, lɛɛ ke pee se nɛ níhi a mi hi ha lɛ ekohu ɔ, e ma nyɛ nɛ lɛ nitsɛ e kpɔ e ní. 27Ke e ba mi ja a, e bu akɔtaa; jeha abɔ nɛ e jua zugba a, kɛ jeha nɛ piɛ loko jeha a nɛ a maa kpale weto ní se kɛ ha nɔtsɛmɛ ɔ maa su, konɛ e wo jeha abɔ nɛ piɛ ɔ he hiɔ nɛ e ya ngɔ e ní. 28Se ke nɔ nɛ jua zugba a be nɔ́ ko nɛ e kɛ ma kpɔ e weto ní nɛ ɔ, lɛɛ nɔ nɛ he zugba a maa pee nɔtsɛ kɛ yaa si weto ní se kpalemi jeha kpa maa su. Jamɛ a jeha a loko a maa kpale zugba a kɛ ha zugbatsɛ ɔ.
29Ke nɔ ko jua e we ngɛ ma ko nɛ a fia gbogbo kɛ wo he mi ɔ, e ma nyɛ ma kpɔ we ɔ nɛ e jua a ngɛ kekleekle jeha a mi; e ngɛ jeha kake sɔuu nɛ e kɛ ma kpɔ e we nɛ e jua nɛ ɔ. 30Ke e nyɛ we nɛ e kpɔ ngɛ jeha kake mi ɔ, we ɔ maa pee nɔ nɛ he ɔ, kɛ e nina a nɔ́ kulaa. Weto ní se kpalemi jeha a mi ɔ, nɔ nɛ he we ɔ be he ngmɛɛe. 31Se wehi nɛ ngɛ kɔpehi nɛ gbogbo be a he ɔ a mi ɔ lɛɛ a bu mɛ kaa ngmɔ kɛkɛ. A ma nyɛ ma kpɔ mɛ; ke weto ní se kpalemi jeha a su ɔ, nyɛɛ ngmɛɛ a he ha nitsɛmɛ ɔmɛ. 32Levi bi ɔmɛ lɛɛ a wehi nɛ ngɛ a ma amɛ a mi ɔ, a ngɛ he blɔ nɛ a kpɔɔ mɛ be tsuaa be. 33Ke Levi no ko jua e we ngɛ ma ko mi, nɛ e kpɔ we e we ɔ kɛ ya su weto ní se kpalemi jeha a mi po ɔ, a kpale e we ɔ kɛ ha lɛ; ejakaa Levi bi ɔmɛ a we ɔmɛ peeɔ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a weto ní kulaa ngɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ a kpɛti. 34Lohwe lɛmi zugbahi nɛ bɔle Levi bi ɔmɛ a ma amɛ hu peeɔ Levi bi ɔmɛ a weto ní; a ko jua eko.
Sika nɛ a paa ha ohiatsɛmɛ
35 Ke e fi o nyɛmi Israel fɔfɔɛ, nɛ e dɛ mi ta, nɛ e nyɛ we nɛ e hyɛ e he nɔ hu ɔ, moo hyɛ e nɔ. O kɛ lɛ nɛ hi si kaa nubwɔ nɛ ba to mo, konɛ e nyɛ nɛ e hi o ngɔ. 36Ke o pa nɔ́ ko ha o nyɛmi ɔ, ko he nɔ́ ko kɛ bɔ he; ye o Mawu ɔ gbeye, konɛ o ha nɛ o nyɛmi ɔ nɛ hi o kasa nya. 37 Ke o pa lɛ sika a, ko he hekpa. Ke niye ní nɛ o jua ha lɛ ɔ, jua a nɛ ko pe niye ní ɔ jua. 38Mlaa nɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ ngɛ nyɛ woe ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ je nyɛ kɛ je Egipt zugba a nɔ, konɛ e ngɔ Kanaan zugba a ngɔ ha nyɛ, nɛ e pee nyɛ Mawu.
Nyɔguɛhi a he ngmɛɛmi
39 Ke e fi o nyɛmi Israel fɔfɔɛ ko nɛ o kɛ lɛ ngɛ, nɛ e jua e he ha mo ɔ, ko ha nɛ e sɔmɔ mo kaa nyɔguɛ. 40Ha nɛ e hi o ngɔ kaa apaa yelɔ, loo nubwɔ, nɛ e tsu ní ha mo kɛ yaa si Heyemi jeha a maa su. 41Ke Heyemi jeha a su ɔ, lɛ, kɛ e bimɛ tsuo nɛ a ngɛ o ngɔ ɔ ma nyɛ ma si mo kɛ ho mɛ nitsɛmɛ a weku li a ngɔ ya ngɛ a nɛmɛ a nɔ́ mi. 42Israel bi ɔmɛ ɔ, Yawɛ tsɔli ji mɛ. Lɛ nitsɛ nɛ e je mɛ kɛ je Egipt zugba a nɔ. Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, a ko jua mɛ kaa nyɔguɛhi. 43Nyɛ ko wa mɛ yi mi, se mohu nyɛɛ ye nyɛ Mawu ɔ gbeye. 44Ke nyɛ ngɛ nyɔguɛ nyumuhi kɛ nyɔguɛ yihi hlae ɔ, nyɛ ma nyɛ ma he mɛ kɛ je mahi nɛ bɔle nyɛ ɔ a mi. 45Jehanɛ hu, nyɛ ma nyɛ ma he nibwɔhi nɛ ba to nyɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ ɔ a bimɛ nɛ a fɔ ngɔ wo nyɛ kpɛti ɔ, nɛ a maa pee nyɛ weto ní. 46Nyɛ ma nyɛ ma si mɛ kaa gbosi ní ha nyɛ bimɛ, nɛ a ma sɔmɔ mɛ a wami be ɔ tsuo. Se nyɛ sɔuu nyɛ kpɛti kaa Israel fɔfɔɛhi ɔ, nyɛ ko wa nyɛ sibi yi mi.
47Waa ngɔ lɛ kaa nubwɔ ko nɛ ba to mo ɔ ná ní, be mi nɛ o nyɛmi Israel no ko nɛ ngɛ o kasa nya a pee ohiatsɛ, nɛ e jua e he kɛ ha jamɛ a nubwɔ niatsɛ ɔ, aloo e nyɛmi ko. 48Ke e jua e he se ɔ, he blɔ ngɛ kaa e kpɔ e he ekohu. E nyɛminyumu ko, 49loo e tsɛ nyɛminyumu, loo e tsɛ nyɛminyumu bi, loo e weku no pɔtɛɛ ko ma nyɛ ma kpɔ lɛ. Ke lɛ nitsɛ po e he ba hi ekohu ɔ, e ma nyɛ ma kpɔ e he. 50E kɛ nɔ nɛ he lɛ ɔ nɛ bu akɔtaa kɛ je be nɛ e jua e he ngɔ ha lɛ ɔ, kɛ ya si be nɛ Heyemi jeha a maa su, konɛ e na jeha abɔ nɛ ngɛ mi, nɛ e da nɔ nɛ e kɛ na sika nɛ e kɛ ma kpɔ e he ɔ. Á bu nɔ́ nɛ ɔ kaa bɔ nɛ a buu apaa yelɔ hiɔwo. 51Ke jeha nɛ piɛ loko Heyemi jeha a maa su ɔ hiɛ ɔ, sika nɛ a kɛ ma kpɔ lɛ ɔ maa hiɛ jã kɛ̃, 52se ke jeha nɛ piɛ loko Heyemi jeha maa su ɔ pi ɔ, e kɛ nɔ nɛ he lɛ ɔ nɛ bu akɔtaa. Á hyɛ jeha abɔ nɛ e kɛ ma tsu ní ha e nyɔmtsɛ ɔ, konɛ a je hiɔwo ɔ kɛ je sika nɛ a ma ha lɛ ɔ mi, nɛ e wo hiɔ nɛ maa piɛ ɔ. 53E kɛ hiɔ̃tsɛ ɔ si himi ɔ nɛ pee kaa nyɔmtsɛ kɛ apaa yelɔ si himi; nɛ e wo lɛ hiɔ daa jeha. Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nɛ ko wa lɛ yi mi. 54Ke a nyɛ we nɛ a kpɔ lɛ kɛ gu blɔ nɛ ɔmɛ eko nɔ ɔ, lɛɛ ja Heyemi jeha kpa su loko a maa ngmɛɛ e kɛ e bimɛ ɔmɛ a he. 55Israel fɔfɔɛ be nyɛe maa pee nɔ ko nyɔguɛ daa, ejakaa Israel bi ɔmɛ ɔ, Yawɛ nitsɛ nyɔguɛhi ji mɛ. Lɛ nitsɛ nɛ e je mɛ kɛ je Egipt zugba a nɔ. Lɛ ji Yawɛ, a Mawu ɔ nɛ.

Title: MOSE III, 26
Content:
Gbaamihi nɛ tue bumi kɛ maa ba
(Mose V, 7.12-24; 28.1-14)
1 Yawɛ de ke, “Nyɛ ko puɛ amagahi, nɛ nyɛ ko pee tɛ amagahi, loo titimahi kɛ ma si; nyɛ ko ja mɛ hulɔ; ejakaa imi ji Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ nɛ. 2Nyɛ hɛ nɛ hi Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ nyɛɛ bu ye he klɔuklɔu ɔ, he nɛ a jaa mi ngɛ ɔ; imi ji Yawɛ.
3 “Ke nyɛ bu ye gbi tue nɛ nyɛ ye ye blɔ nya tomi ɔmɛ, kɛ ye mlaa amɛ a nɔ ɔ, 4ma ha hiɔmi maa nɛ ngɛ e be mi; zugba a maa ba ní babauu, nɛ tso ɔmɛ maa wo yiblii. 5Nyɛ ngmɔ ɔmɛ maa ba ní saminya; nyɛ maa hi blɛfo kpɔe hluu kɛ yaa si wai yiblii nya buami be; nɛ nyɛ maa hi wai yiblii nya buae hluu kɛ maa su blɛfo dumi be ekohu. Nyɛ maa ye ní, nɛ nyɛ maa tɔ; nyɛ maa hi si ngɛ tue mi jɔmi mi ngɛ zugba a nɔ.
6“Ma ha nyɛ tue mi maa jɔ nyɛ ngɛ nyɛ zugba a nɔ. Nyɛ maa hwɔ mahe fuaa, nɛ nyɛ be nɔ ko gbeye yee. Ma je lohwe dikali kɛ je zugba a nɔ, nɛ a be ta hwue ngɛ zugba a nɔ hu. 7Nyɛ maa fie nyɛ he nyɛli ɔmɛ, nɛ nyɛ maa gbe mɛ. 8Nyɛ ti ni enuɔ maa fie nyɛ he nyɛli lafa, nɛ nihi lafa maa fie nyɛ he nyɛli akpe nyɔngma; nyɛ maa ye mɛ tsuo a nɔ kunimi. 9Ma gbaa nyɛ, nɛ ma ha nyɛ ma fɔ bimɛ babauu. Somi nɛ i kɛ nyɛ so ɔ, ma ye nɔ. 10Nyɛ ma kpa ní babauu nɛ́ maa hi si hluu kɛ yaa su ní kpami be ekohu; nyɛ ma je niba ní momo nɛ piɛ ɔ ngɔ pue he, konɛ nyɛ na blɔ ha ehe nɛ nyɛ ma kpa a. 11Ma pee ye sihi he ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti; i be nyɛ siee. 12 I kɛ nyɛ maa hi si. Ma pee nyɛ Mawu, nɛ nyɛ hu nyɛ maa pee ye ma. 13Imi ji Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu nɛ je nyɛ kɛ je Egipt zugba a nɔ, konɛ nyɛ ko pee nyɔguɛhi hu ɔ nɛ. I je nyɛ kɛ je yi mi wami sisi, nɛ i ha nyɛ ye nyɛ he.”
Tue gbomi he tue gblami
(Mose V, 28.15-68)
14Yawɛ ke, “Ke nyɛ be mi tue bue, nɛ nyɛ be ye mlaa amɛ tsuo a nɔ yee, 15ke nyɛ be ye mlaa amɛ, blɔ nya tomi ɔmɛ, kɛ somi nɛ i kɛ nyɛ so ɔ a nɔ yee ɔ, 16lɛɛ ma ngɔ amanehlu gbeyegbeye nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ gbla nyɛ tue: hiɔ nɛ be tsa ba, kɛ asla nɛ puɛɔ nɔ hɛngmɛ, nɛ haa nɔ peeɔ hiɔtsɛ kulaa. Nyɛ ma du ní, se nɔ́ kpakpa ko be mi jee; ejakaa nyɛ he nyɛli maa ye nyɛ nɔ, nɛ mɛ mohu a ma ba ye ní ɔmɛ nɛ nyɛ du ɔ. 17Ye hɛ maa dɔ kɛ wo nyɛ, nɛ nyɛ he nyɛli ɔmɛ maa fia nyɛ ní nɛ a gbe; a maa ye nyɛ nɔ wawɛɛ, nɛ ke nɔ ko nyɛɛ we nyɛ se po nyɛ maa hi fo nɔ pulɛpulɛ.
18“Ke ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo na ba mi, se nyɛ bui ye munyu ɔ kɛ sa a, ma gbla nyɛ tue kɛ bɔ he si kpaago ngɛ nyɛ yayami ɔmɛ a he. 19Ma ku nyɛ he nɔ womi, kɛ kuɛ mi timi ɔ nya; hiɔmi be nɛe; nyɛ zugba a ma gbli, nɛ e he maa wa kaa dade. 20Nyɛ ma gbo yaka dengme; ejakaa nyɛ zugba a be ní bae, nɛ e nɔ tso ɔmɛ hu be yiblii woe.
21“Ke nyɛ tsɔ ye hɛ mi atuã, nɛ nyɛ bui mi kɛ mwɔɔ ɔ, ma kpale gbla nyɛ tue totoe kpaago ekohu. 22Ma ngmɛɛ pu mi lohwe dikali a he ngɔ pue nyɛ nɔ, nɛ a maa gbe nyɛ bimɛ; a ma kpata nyɛ we mi lohwehi a hɛ mi, nɛ ma ha nyɛ nɔ ma gbɔ, nɛ nimli be hiɛe ngɛ blɔ ɔmɛ a nɔ hu.
23“Ke tue gblami nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a se ɔ, nyɛ bui mi tue, se mohu nyɛ ya nɔ tsɔ atuã kɛ mwɔɔ ɔ, 24lɛɛ imi Yawɛ hu i kɛ nyɛ maa to ní; imi nitsɛ ma gbla nyɛ tue kɛ bɔ he totoe kpaago ngɛ nyɛ he yayami ɔmɛ a he. 25Ma ha ta ma ba tua nyɛ; ma ngɔ ta a kɛ gbla nyɛ tue. Ke nyɛ bua nyɛ he nya kɛ laa nyɛ he ngɛ ma amɛ a mi ɔ, ma ha hiɔ nɛ be tsa ba maa sɛ nyɛ kpɛti; ma ngɔ nyɛ ngɔ wo nyɛ he nyɛli ɔmɛ a dɛ mi. 26Ma ha nɛ nyɛ niye ní se maa po kulaa. Niye ní he maa hia bɔ nɛ abolo tsuo nɛ nyɛ maa ye ɔ, yihi nyɔngma pɛ maa sã ngɛ flɔɔnɔɔ kake mi. A maa ngmɛ abolo ɔ ngɛ sɛni tɛ nɔ ha nyɛ, nɛ ke nyɛ ye ɔ nyɛ be tɔe.
27“Ke ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a se, nɛ nyɛ be mi tue bue, se nyɛ maa ya nɔ ma tsɔ ye hɛ mi atuã a, 28lɛɛ ye mi mi ma fu nyɛ, nɛ ma je nyɛ se. Imi nitsɛ ma gbla nyɛ tue kɛ bɔ he totoe kpaago ngɛ nyɛ he yayami ɔmɛ a he. 29Hwɔ maa ye nyɛ wawɛɛ nitsɛ; nɛ e maa ba mi kaa nyɛ maa ye nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ bimɛ. 30Ma puɛ nyɛ jami he ɔmɛ ngɛ yo ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ ma ywia nyɛ tsopa kɛ e he via bɔ sami la tɛ ɔmɛ; ma ngɔ nyɛ gbogboe ɔmɛ ngɔ pue nyɛ we amaga amɛ nɛ i ywia a a nɔ. Nyɛ maa pee nɔ́ nɛ a hiee ha mi. 31Ma kpata nyɛ ma nguangua amɛ a hɛ mi kɛ yaa si a ma plɛ pee ma dokuhi. Nyɛ jami he ɔmɛ hu ma puɛ mɛ, nɛ i be nyɛ bɔ ɔmɛ hee hu. 32Ma kpata nyɛ zugba a hɛ mi bɔ nɛ ke nyɛ he nyɛli ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ na a, a he mi maa po. 33Ma ha ta maa nyɛɛ nyɛ se, nɛ ma gbɛ nyɛ ngɔ fĩa je ma amɛ tsuo a mi. Nyɛ maa je zugba a nɔ, nɛ ma amɛ ma plɛ ma dokuhi. 34Kɛkɛ ɔ, jeha abɔ nɛ sa kaa zugba a nɛ jɔɔ e he nɛ nyɛ ngmɛ́ blɔ ɔ, jehanɛ lɛɛ e ma na. 35Zugba a maa fɔ si gu, nɛ e maa jɔɔ e he, be mi nɛ nyɛ lɛɛ nyɛ ya je nyɛ he nyɛli a zugba nɔ.
36“Nyɛ nihi nɛ maa piɛ, nɛ a maa nuu kɛ ya ma se ɔ, ma ha sawale maa nu nyɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Ke kɔɔhiɔ sɛ ba mi huu nɛ nyɛ nu ɔ, lɔ ɔ po maa wo nyɛ fo. Nyɛ maa tu fo pulɛpulɛ kaa nɔ́ nɛ ta nyɛɛ nyɛ se. Nyɛ maa hi si nɔe, be mi nɛ nɔ ko nyɛɛ we nyɛ se. 37Nyɛ maa nɔɔ nyɛ sibi a nɔ kaa nɔ́ nɛ ta nya fo nyɛ ngɛ tue, pohu nɔ ko nyɛɛ we nyɛ se. Nyɛ be nyɛe maa da nyɛ he nyɛli ɔmɛ a nya. 38Nyɛ hɛ mi ma kpata ngɛ je ma amɛ a kpɛti, nɛ nyɛ he nyɛli ɔmɛ a zugba a maa mii nyɛ. 39Nyɛ nihi bɔɔ nɛ maa piɛ ngɛ nyɛ he nyɛli ɔmɛ a zugba a nɔ ɔ maa ta he lo ngɛ nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ a he yayami ɔmɛ a he.
40“Se nyɛ nina maa jaje a he yayami ɔmɛ, kɛ a nɛmɛ a he yayami kaa a pee yi wu tso níhi kɛ si mi, nɛ jehanɛ a ya nɔ tsɔ ye hɛ mi atuã; 41nɛ lɔ ɔ he nɛ imi hu i je a se, nɛ i ngmɛɛ a he kɛ ha a he nyɛli, nɛ a kɛ mɛ ho ma se ya a nɛ. Se ke jehanɛ lɛɛ nyɛ nina tsake a tsui, nɛ a ba a he si, nɛ a kpa yayami peemi ɔ, 42 lɛɛ imi hu ma kai somi ɔmɛ nɛ i kɛ Yakob, Isak, kɛ Abraham so ɔ. Kɛkɛ ɔ, si nɛ i wo kaa ma ngɔ zugba a ngɔ ha ye ma a, ma ti mi ekohu. 43Kekleekle ɔ, ja a je zugba a nɔ, nɛ zugba a jɔɔ e he kulaa. Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, ja a kplɛ, nɛ a gbla a tue saminya kaa a kua ye mlaa amɛ, kɛ ye blɔ nya tomi ɔmɛ. 44Se kɛ̃ ɔ, be mi nɛ a ngɛ a he nyɛli ɔmɛ a zugba nɔ kɛ mwɔɔ ɔ po, i be mɛ kuae, nɛ i be a hɛ mi kpatae pɛsɛpɛsɛ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ somi nɛ i kɛ mɛ so ɔ se ko po. Imi ji Yawɛ, a Mawu ɔ nɛ. 45A he ɔ, ma kai somi nɛ i kɛ a nɛmɛ ɔmɛ so, benɛ i je ye he wami kpo kɛ tsɔɔ je ma amɛ, benɛ i je mɛ kɛ je Egipt zugba a nɔ, konɛ ma pee a Mawu ɔ. Imi ji Yawɛ.”
46Mlaahi, kɛ blɔ nya tomihi nɛ Yawɛ ngɔ ha Mose ngɛ Sinai yo ɔ nɔ nɛ e kɛ ha Israel ma a ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ.

Title: MOSE III, 27
Content:
Níhi nɛ a kɛ maa ke Yawɛ a he mlaahi
1Yawɛ de Mose ke 2e de Israel bi ɔmɛ ke, ke nɔ ko wo si kaa e maa ngɔ nɔ ko ngɔ ha Yawɛ ɔ, blɔ nɔ nɛ a maa gu kɛ kpɔ nɔ ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
3-7Kaa bɔ nɛ jua a ngɛ ɔ, nyumu nɛ ye kɛ je jeha nyingmi enyɔ kɛ yaa si nyingmi ekpa a, e he jua ji sika hiɔ yi nyingmi enuɔ. Yo hu nɔ́ ji sika hiɔ yi nyingmi etɛ. Niheyo nɛ ye kɛ je jeha enuɔ kɛ ya si nyingmi enyɔ ɔ, e he jua ji sika hiɔ yi nyingmi enyɔ. Yiheyo he jua ji sika hiɔ yi nyɔngma. Bimwɔyo nɛ ye kɛ je nyɔhiɔ kake kɛ yaa si jeha enuɔ ɔ, nyumuyo jua ji sika hiɔ yi enuɔ, yoyo nɔ́ ji sika hiɔ yi etɛ. Nɔ nɛ ye jeha nyingmi ekpa kɛ se ɔ, nyumu he jua ji sika hiɔ yi nyɔngma kɛ enuɔ, nɛ yo nɔ ji sika hiɔ yi nyɔngma.
8Ke nɔ nɛ wo si ɔ ya pee ohiatsɛ nɛ be nyɛe nɛ e ma ha sika a kaa bɔ nɛ a tsɔɔ ɔ, lɛɛ e ngɔ nɔ ɔ kɛ ba ha osɔfo ɔ, nɛ osɔfo ɔ nɛ wo jua bɔ nɛ nɔ nɛ wo si ɔ ma nyɛ ma ha.
9Ke lohwe nɛ a kɛ sãã bɔ ji nɔ́ nɛ nɔ ɔ wo si kaa e ma ha Yawɛ ɔ, lɛɛ lohwe tsuaa lohwe kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ nɛ a wo si ɔ peeɔ klɔuklɔu. 10Nɔ nɛ wo si ɔ kó kpale e nya se. Jehanɛ se hu, e ko tsake lɛ kɛ lohwe kpa. E ko ngɔ lohwe kpakpa kɛ tsake lohwe yaya, nɛ e ko ngɔ lohwe yaya hu kɛ tsake lohwe kpakpa. Ke e pee ja a, kekle lohwe ɔ, kɛ nɔ́ nɛ ji enyɔ ɔ tsuo maa pee Yawɛ níhi. 11Ke lohwe ɔ he tsɔ we kaa lohwe nɛ a ngmɛ blɔ kaa a kɛ sã bɔ ha Yawɛ ɔ, lɛɛ nɔ nɛ wo si ɔ kɛ lohwe ɔ nɛ ba osɔfo ɔ ngɔ. 12Osɔfo ɔ nɛ hyɛ lohwe ɔ kaa e hi, loo e hí, konɛ e wo e he jua; bɔ nɛ osɔfo ɔ ma de ɔ, ja a maa ngɔ lɛ. 13Se ke nɔ ɔ ngɛ hlae nɛ e kpɔ lohwe ɔ, lɛɛ e wo hiɔ sisiisi nɛ e ngɔ e he jua a mi dlami enuɔ mi kake kɛ piɛ sika a he.
14Ke nɔ ko gbaa e we nɔ kɛ ha Yawɛ ɔ, osɔfo ɔ nɛ hyɛ kaa we ɔ hi, loo e hí, konɛ e wo he jua. Jua nɛ osɔfo ɔ maa tsɔɔ ɔ, lɔ ɔ ji nɔ́ nɛ a maa ngɔ. 15Jehanɛ, ke nɔ ɔ ngɛ hlae nɛ e kpɔ e we ɔ, e ngɔ e we ɔ he jua a mi dlami enuɔ mi kake kɛ piɛ jua a he, kɛkɛ ɔ, we ɔ maa pee e nɔ́ ekohu.
16Ke nɔ ko gbaa e zugba mi fa ko nɛ ji e weto ní nɔ kɛ ha Yawɛ ɔ, a da ní abɔ nɛ a duɔ ngɛ zugba a mi ɔ hiɛmi nɔ, konɛ a kɛ wo he jua. Ngma nɛ maa su kilo nyingmi enyɔ ɔ, a he sika hiɔ yi nyɔngma ngɛ he. 17Ke Heyemi jeha a se pɛ nɛ nɔ ko gbaa e zugba nɔ kɛ ha Yawɛ ɔ e wo jua nɛ a tsɔɔ ɔ sisiisi. 18Se ke e ngɔ e zugba a kɛ ha pee se ɔ, lɛɛ osɔfo ɔ nɛ bu be nɛ piɛ loko Heyemi jeha kpa a maa su, konɛ e je nɔ. 19Ke nɔ nɛ ngɔ e zugba ngɔ ha a suɔ kaa e ma kpɔ e zugba a, lɛɛ e ngɔ zugba a he jua a mi dlami enuɔ mi kake kɛ piɛ jua a he, kɛkɛ zugba a maa pee e nɔ ekohu. 20Ke e kpɔ we zugba a kɛ ji Yawɛ dɛ, nɛ e jua zugba a kɛ ha nɔ kpa a, lɛɛ e be nyɛe ma kpɔ hu. 21Se ke a ngmɛɛ zugba a he ngɛ Heyemi jeha kpa a mi ɔ, e peeɔ klɔuklɔu ha Yawɛ kaa zugba nɛ a gbaa nɔ kɛ ke; zugba nɛ ɔ maa pee osɔfo ɔmɛ a nɔ́ kulaa.
22Ke nɔ ko he zugba, se pi lɛ nitsɛ e weto ní, nɛ e gbaa nɔ kɛ ha Yawɛ ɔ, 23osɔfo ɔ nɛ bu e he jua a kɛ ya si Heyemi jeha a, konɛ nɔ ɔ nɛ wo hiɔ ɔ jamɛ a ligbi ɔ nɔuu; sika a peeɔ Yawɛ nɔ́. 24Ke Heyemi jeha a su ɔ, a kpale zugba a ngɔ ha nɔtsɛ ɔ, loo e nina.
25Jua amɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ nɛ a maa wo ɔ, a pee kaa bɔ nɛ he klɔuklɔu ɔ mlaa a tsɔɔ ɔ.
26Lohwe tsuaa lohwe ɔ, e kekleekle bi ɔ, e ji Yawɛ nɔ́ momo, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ ko kó ngɔ kɛ ba ha Yawɛ kaa bɔ nɛ je nɔ tsui mi faa, na jio, jijɔ jio. 27Se ke lohwe ɔ he tsɔ we lɛɛ; a wo he jua ha nɔtsɛ ɔ, nɛ e kɛ e jua a mi dlami enuɔ mi kake nɛ piɛ he. Ke a be lohwe ɔ kpɔe ɔ, lɛɛ e jua lɛ kaa bɔ nɛ a wo he jua a.
28 Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ nɔ ko dɛ, nɛ a je he gbi kaa a kpata e hɛ mi kɛ ha Yawɛ ɔ, nɔmlɔ jio, lohwe nane eywiɛtsɛ jio, aloo gbosi ní kaa zugba a peeɔ klɔuklɔu kɛ ha Yawɛ; a ko jua, nɛ a ko kpɔ hulɔ. 29Ke a je nɔmlɔ adesa he gbi kaa á kpata e hɛ mi ɔ, á ko kpɔ lɛ, á gbe lɛ.
30 Zugba a nɔ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ mi dlami nyɔngma mi kake, wu nɛ a ma du jio, tso yiblii jio, peeɔ Yawɛ nɔ́; e ngɛ klɔuklɔu kɛ ha Yawɛ. 31Ke nɔ ko suɔ kaa e ma kpɔ eko ɔ, é wo hiɔ ɔ kaa bɔ nɛ a tsɔɔ ɔ, nɛ é ngɔ jua a mi dlami enuɔ mi kake ngɔ piɛ he. 32Na amɛ, kɛ to ɔmɛ a mi dlami nyɔngmanyɔngma mi kakaaka a peeɔ Yawɛ níhi. Ke a ngɛ lohwe ɔmɛ kanee ɔ, kake ngɛ nyɔngma tsuaa nyɔngma mi peeɔ Yawɛ nɔ́. 33Nɔ ko kó bi kaa lohwe ɔ hi, loo e hí; nɛ a ko tsake eko hulɔ. Ke a ma tsake eko ɔ, lohwe nɛ a tsake ɔ, kɛ nɔ́ nɛ a kɛ ngɛ tsakee ɔ tsuo maa pee klɔuklɔu; a be kpɔe.
34Mlaahi nɛ Yawɛ ngɔ ha Mose ngɛ Sinai yo ɔ nɔ nɛ e kɛ ha Israel ma a ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ.

Title: MOSE IV, NYA TSƆƆMI
Content:
NYA TSƆƆMI
Womi nɛ ɔ gbaa wɔ bɔ nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ hia blɔ kɛ je Sinai yo ɔ he, kɛ nyɛɛ nga kplanaa a nɔ maa pee jeha nyingmi eywiɛ, kɛ ya su zugba nɛ Mawu wo si ke e ma ha mɛ ɔ huzu ɔ nɛ ngɛ beleku je ɔ nya. Sane titli nɛ ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ mi ji bɔ nɛ Mose kane Israel bi ɔmɛ ngɛ Sinai yo ɔ he loko a je lejɛ ɔ, kɛ bɔ nɛ e kane mɛ ekohu pee se ngɛ Moab, ngɛ Yordan pa a beleku je. Israel bi ɔmɛ a kanemi ɔ nɔ a da kɛ ha womi nɛ ɔ biɛ Numeri ɔ nɛ. Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, Israel bi ɔmɛ ya su Kadesh Barnea ngɛ Kanaan zugba a leneyi je huzu ɔ nya; se a nyɛ we nɛ a gu lejɛ ɔ kɛ ya zugba a nɛ a wo mɛ si ke a ma ha mɛ ɔ nɔ. A hi lejɛ ɔ jeha babauu loko a hia kɛ ho zugba nɛ ngɛ Yordan pa a beleku je ɔ nɔ ya. Benɛ a ya su lejɛ ɔ, a ti ni komɛ mia, nɛ a po pa a kɛ ho Kanaan zugba a nɔ ya; se ni komɛ hu tlɔ lejɛ ɔ.
Mose Womi Eywiɛne ɔ gbaa wɔ bɔ nɛ ke haomi ba Israel bi ɔmɛ a nɔ kɛkɛ nɛ sawale nuɔ mɛ nɛ a kɔni mi jeɔ wu, bɔ nɛ a tsɔɔ atuã kɛ woɔ Mawu, kɛ Mose, nɔmlɔ nɛ Mawu hla ke e nyɛɛ a hɛ mi ɔ. Sane nɛ ɔ tsɔɔ wɔ bɔ nɛ Mawu hyɛ e ma Israel ɔ nɔ saminya, be mi nɛ mɛɛ a bui lɛ tue fɛɛ, nɛ a peeɔ yayami slɔɔtoslɔɔtohi mohu kɛ siɔ lɛ. Nyagbe ɔ, wa naa ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ mi kaa be komɛ Mose tsui fiaa lɛɛ, se kɛ̃ ɔ, e fi si kɛ sɔmɔ Mawu, kɛ e ma Israel ɔ anɔkuale mi.
Bɔ nɛ a dla womi ɔ mi ha
Israel bi ɔmɛ mia nɛ a maa hia kɛ je Sinai yo ɔ he 1.1—9.23
a. A kane ma a kekleekle nɔ́ 1.1—4.49
b. Mlaa slɔɔtoslɔɔtohi 5.1—8.26
d. Hetsɔmi enyɔne ɔ 9.1-23
Kɛ je Sinai yo ɔ he kɛ ya Moab 10.1—21.35
Sanehi nɛ ba ngɛ Moab 22.1—32.42
Kɛ je Egipt kɛ ya Moab 33.1-49
Mlaahi nɛ a wo loko a po Yordan pa a 33.50—36.13

Title: MOSE IV, 1
Content:
A kane Israel ma a kekleekle nɔ́
1 Benɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ je Egipt zugba a nɔ se jeha nɛ ji enyɔ ɔ, nyɔhiɔ enyɔne ɔ we kekleekle ligbi ɔ, Yawɛ kɛ Mose tu munyu ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ mi ngɛ Sinai nga a nɔ, nɛ e de lɛ ke, 2“O kɛ Aaron nɛ kane Israel ma kpekpemi ɔ tsuo weku nya weku nya, kɛ we puɔ nya we puɔ nya. 3Nyumu tsuaa nyumu nɛ ye kɛ je jeha nyingmi enyɔ kɛ yaa, nɛ e ma nyɛ maa ya ta a, nyɛɛ ngma e biɛ, nɛ nyɛ gba mɛ tabo nya tabo nya. 4Wɛtso tsuaa wɛtso nɛ hla nɔ kake kɛ ba piɛ nyɛ he.” 5-16Kikɛmɛ a nikɔtɔma nɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ wɛtsohi nɛ a je a mi ɔ ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ:
WƐTSO WƐTSO NƆKƆTƆMA
Ruben Elizur, Shedeur bi ɔ
Simeon Shelumiel, Zurishadai bi ɔ
Yuda Nashon, Aminadab bi ɔ
Isakar Netanel, Zuar bi ɔ
Zebulun Eliab, Helon bi ɔ
Efraim Elishama, Amihud bi ɔ
Manase Gamaliel, Pedazur bi ɔ
Benyamin Abidan, Gideoni bi ɔ
Dan Ahiezer, Amishadai bi ɔ
Asher Pagiel, Okran bi ɔ
Gad Eliasaf, Deuel bi ɔ
Naftali Ahira, Enan bi ɔ.
17-18Mose kɛ Aaron fɔ̃ nihi nɛ a tsɔɔ a biɛ nɛ ɔ nine. Nyɔhiɔ enyɔne ɔ we kekleekle ligbi ɔ, a bua Israel ma kpekpemi ɔ nya nɛ a kane mɛ kakaaka, weku nya weku nya, kɛ we puɔ nya we puɔ nya. A kane nyumuhi tsuo nɛ ye jeha nyingmi enyɔ, kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ ye pe ja kakaaka, 19nɛ Mose ngma a biɛ ngɛ Sinai nga a nɔ, kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa lɛ ɔ.
20-46A ngma nyumuhi tsuo nɛ ye jeha nyingmi enyɔ, kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ ye pe ja, nɛ a su ta yami ɔ a biɛ weku nya weku nya, kɛ we puɔ nya we puɔ nya. A ngma biɛ ɔ kɛ je Yakob bitɛte Ruben nɔ. Bɔ nɛ e ba lɛ ha ji nɛ ɔ nɛ:
WƐTSO NI ƆMƐ A HIƐMI
Ruben 46,500
Simeon 59,300
Gad 45,650
Yuda 74,600
Isakar 54,400
Zebulun 57,400
Efraim 40,500
Manase 32,200
Benyamin 35,400
Dan 62,700
Asher 41,500
Naftali 53,400
Lɛ tsuo peeɔ 603,550.
47Se Levi bi ɔmɛ lɛɛ a kane we mɛ ngɔ piɛ we a bi ɔmɛ a he kaa bɔ nɛ a kane wɛtso kpa amɛ ɔ, 48ejakaa Yawɛ de Mose ke, 49“Levi wɛtso ɔ pɛ lɛɛ koo kane mɛ, nɛ koo bu a hiɛmi ngɔ piɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ a he. 50Levi bi ɔmɛ lɛɛ ngɔɔ kpe he bo tsu ɔ, kɛ e he ní ɔmɛ, kɛ e mi ní ɔmɛ tsuo a nɔ hyɛmi ní tsumi ɔ kɛ wo a dɛ. Mɛ nɛ a maa hɛɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ kɛ e he ní ɔmɛ. Mɛ nɛ a maa hyɛ nɔ; nɛ bo tsu ɔ he ji he nɛ a maa hi. 51Be tsuaa be nɛ nyɛ maa hia a, Levi bi ɔmɛ ji ni nɛmɛ nɛ maa gbɛ bo tsu ɔ. Nɛ ke a maa ma lɛ ekohu ɔ, Levi bi ɔmɛ nɔuu lɛ a maa ma. Ke nɔ kpa ko hɛ lɛ kɛ su he ɔ, a gbe lɛ. 52Israel ma nɛ piɛ ɔ tsuo maa to si ngɛ a tabo ɔmɛ a nya, nɔ tsuaa nɔ ngɛ e wɛtso aflaangaa sisi. 53Se Levi bi ɔmɛ lɛɛ a ma pue si kɛ bɔle kpe he ɔ, nɛ a maa bu he, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ imi Yawɛ, ye we abofu nɛ ko kple Israel ma kpekpemi ɔ nɔ.” 54Israel ma a pee kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa Mose ke e pee ɔ.

Title: MOSE IV, 2
Content:
Wɛtso ɔmɛ a si puemi
1Yawɛ de Mose kɛ Aaron ke, 2“Be tsuaa be nɛ Israel ma a maa to si ngɛ he ko ɔ, á pue si weku nya weku nya ngɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ weku aflaangaa sisi kɛ bɔle kpe he bo tsu ɔ kɛ kpe, nɛ a plɛ a hɛ mi kɛ tsɔɔ kpe he ɔ.
3-4“Yuda wɛtso ɔ ma pue si kɛ yaa beleku je tabo nya tabo nya. A nyatsɛ ji Aminadab bi Nashon, nɛ a hiɛmi ji nimli akpe nyingmi kpaago kɛ eywiɛ kɛ e nya lafa ekpa.
5-6“Isakar wɛtso ɔ ma pue si kɛ tsa Yuda nɔ. A nyatsɛ ji Zuar bi Netanel, nɛ a hiɛmi ji nimli akpe nyingmi enuɔ kɛ eywiɛ kɛ e nya lafa eywiɛ.
7-8“Zebulun wɛtso ɔ ma pue si kɛ tsa Isakar nɔ. A nyatsɛ ji Helon bi Eliab, nɛ a hiɛmi ji nimli akpe nyingmi enuɔ kɛ kpaago kɛ e nya lafa eywiɛ. 9Nihi tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ nɛ ma pue si tabo nya tabo nya, ngɛ Yuda ta a mi ɔ a hiɛmi ji nimli akpe lafa kɛ nyingmi kpaanyɔ kɛ ekpa kɛ e nya lafa eywiɛ. Mɛ lɛ a maa hia ta kɛ nyɛɛ hɛ mi.
10-11“Ruben wɛtso ɔ ma pue si kɛ yaa leneyi je, tabo nya tabo nya. A nyatsɛ ji Shedeur bi Elizur, nɛ a hiɛmi ji nimli akpe nyingmi eywiɛ kɛ ekpa kɛ e nya lafa enuɔ.
12-13“Simeon wɛtso ɔ ma pue si kɛ tsa Ruben nɔ. A nyatsɛ ji Zurishadai bi Shelumiel, nɛ a hiɛmi ji nimli akpe nyingmi enuɔ kɛ nɛɛ kɛ e nya lafa etɛ.
14-15“Gad wɛtso ɔ ma pue si kɛ tsa Simeon nɔ. A nyatsɛ ji Deuel bi Eliasaf, nɛ a hiɛmi ji nimli akpe nyingmi eywiɛ kɛ enuɔ kɛ e nya lafa ekpa kɛ nyingmi enuɔ. 16Nihi tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ nɛ ma pue si tabo nya tabo nya ngɛ Ruben ta a mi ɔ, a hiɛmi ji nimli akpe lafa kɛ nyingmi enuɔ kɛ kake kɛ e nya lafa eywiɛ kɛ nyingmi enuɔ. Mɛ ji tabo enyɔne nɛ maa hia ta.
17“Jehanɛ, Levi bi ɔmɛ maa tloo kpe he bo tsu ɔ kɛ maa hia; mɛ ji Israel ta a tsuo a kpɛti tabo. Bɔ nɛ ma a to si ɔ, ja a maa nyɛɛ, nɔ tsuaa nɔ ngɛ e ngwɔhe, kɛ e we aflaangaa sisi.
18-19“Efraim wɛtso ɔ ma pue si kɛ yaa bonyoku je, tabo nya tabo nya. A nyatsɛ ji Amihud bi Elishama, nɛ a hiɛmi ji nimli akpe nyingmi eywiɛ kɛ e nya lafa enuɔ.
20-21“Manase wɛtso ɔ ma pue si kɛ tsa Efraim nɔ. A nyatsɛ ji Pedazur bi Gamaliel, nɛ a hiɛmi ji nimli akpe nyingmi etɛ kɛ enyɔ kɛ e nya lafa enyɔ.
22-23“Benyamin wɛtso ɔ ma pue si kɛ tsa Manase nɔ. A nyatsɛ ji Gideoni bi Abidan, nɛ a hiɛmi ji nimli akpe nyingmi etɛ kɛ enuɔ kɛ e nya lafa eywiɛ. 24Nihi tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ nɛ ma pue si tabo nya tabo nya, ngɛ Efraim ta a mi ɔ, a hiɛmi ji nimli akpe lafa kɛ kpaanyɔ kɛ e nya lafa kake. Mɛ ji tabo etɛne nɛ maa hia ta.
25-26“Dan wɛtso ɔ ma pue si kɛ yaa omleyi je, tabo nya tabo nya. A nyatsɛ ji Amishadai bi Ahiezer, nɛ a hiɛmi ji nimli akpe nyingmi ekpa kɛ enyɔ kɛ e nya lafa kpaago.
27-28“Asher wɛtso ɔ ma pue si kɛ tsa Dan nɔ. A nyatsɛ ji Okran bi Pagiel, nɛ a hiɛmi ji nimli akpe nyingmi eywiɛ kɛ kake kɛ e nya lafa enuɔ.
29-30“Naftali wɛtso ɔ ma pue si kɛ tsa Asher nɔ. A nyatsɛ ji Enan bi Ahira, nɛ a hiɛmi ji nimli akpe nyingmi enuɔ kɛ etɛ kɛ e nya lafa eywiɛ. 31Nihi tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ nɛ ma pue si tabo nya tabo nya ngɛ Dan ta a mi ɔ, a hiɛmi ji nimli akpe lafa kɛ nyingmi enuɔ kɛ kpaago kɛ e nya lafa ekpa. Mɛ ji ni nɛmɛ nɛ maa hia ta nyagbe ngɛ a we aflaangaa amɛ a sisi.”
32Israel ma a tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ nɛ a kane mɛ weku nya weku nya kɛ tabo nya tabo nya ngɛ ta amɛ a mi ɔ, a hiɛmi ji nimli akpe lafa ekpa kɛ etɛ kɛ e nya lafa enuɔ kɛ nyingmi enuɔ. 33Se kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa Mose ɔ, Levi bi ɔmɛ lɛɛ a kane we mɛ kɛ piɛ we Israel bi ɔmɛ a he.
34Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa Mose ɔ, ja pɛpɛɛpɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ pee. Ke ma a to si ɔ, a pueɔ si tabo nya tabo nya ngɛ wɛtso nya wɛtso nya, kɛ we puɔ nya we puɔ nya; nɛ ke a hia a, a nyɛɔ ja nɔuu.

Title: MOSE IV, 3
Content:
Aaron binyumu ɔmɛ
1Be mi nɛ Yawɛ kɛ Mose tu munyu ngɛ Sinai yo ɔ nɔ ɔ, Mose kɛ Aaron powu mi bimɛ ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ. 2 Aaron ngɛ binyumuhi eywiɛ. Tɛte ɔ biɛ ji Nadab, nɛ e senihi ji Abihu, Eleazar, kɛ Itamar. 3A pɔ mɛ nu, nɛ Aaron ngɔ mɛ ngɔ wo osɔfo yemi ní tsumi ɔ mi. 4 Se Nadab, kɛ Abihu lɛɛ a gbo benɛ a ngɔ la nɛ he tsɔ we kɛ ba Yawɛ hɛ mi ngɛ Sinai nga a nɔ ɔ. Akɛnɛ mɛɛ a be bimɛ he je ɔ, Eleazar kɛ Itamar pɛ lɛ a sɔmɔ kaa osɔfohi ngɛ a tsɛ Aaron wami be mi.
A hla Levi bi ɔmɛ
5Yawɛ de Mose ke, 6“Moo kpee Levi bi ɔmɛ kɛ ba, nɛ o ngɔ mɛ ngɔ ha osɔfo Aaron nɛ a piɛ e he kɛ tsu ní. 7A ma sɔmɔ ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ he, nɛ a ma tsu Aaron, kɛ ma a tsuo a ní tsumi ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. 8Mɛ lɛ a maa hyɛ níhi nɛ ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ he, kɛ e mi tsuo a nɔ, nɛ mɛ lɛ a ma tsu ní ngɛ lejɛ ɔ ngɛ Israel ma a tsuo a nane mi. 9A je blɔ hla Levi bi ɔmɛ ngɛ Israel ma a kpɛti, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ngɔɔ mɛ kɛ ha Aaron nɛ a sɔmɔ lɛ, kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ. 10Ngɔɔ osɔfo ní tsumi ɔ ngɔ wo Aaron, kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ pɛ a dɛ mi; nɔ kpa ko nɛ maa hɛ lɛ kɛ su ní tsumi nɛ ɔ he ɔ, a gbe lɛ.”
11Yawɛ de Mose ke, 12-13 “Jehanɛ, Levi bi ɔmɛ maa pee ye níhi. Benɛ i gbe Egipt bi ɔmɛ a bitɛte ɔmɛ tsuo ɔ, i tsukɔ Israel bi ɔmɛ a bitɛte tsuaa bitɛte, kɛ a lohwehi hu a kekleekle bihi a he kɛ pee ye níhi. Jehanɛ lɛɛ i hla Levi bi ɔmɛ kɛ to Israel bitɛte ɔmɛ a nane mi; a maa pee ye níhi. Imi ji Yawɛ.”
Levi bi ɔmɛ a kanemi
14Yawɛ de Mose ngɛ Sinai nga a nɔ ke, 15“Moo kane Levi bi ɔmɛ weku nya weku nya, kɛ we puɔ nya we puɔ nya, nɛ o ngma nyumu tsuaa nyumu nɛ ye kɛ je nyɔhiɔ kake kɛ yaa a e biɛ.” 16Mose pee kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa lɛ ɔ. 17-20Levi ngɛ binyumuhi etɛ: Gershon, Kohat, kɛ Merari. Mɛ ji a we puɔ nyatsɛmɛ. Gershon ngɛ binyumuhi enyɔ: Libni, kɛ Shimei. Kohat ngɛ binyumuhi eywiɛ: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, kɛ Uziel. Merari ngɛ binyumuhi enyɔ: Mahli, kɛ Mushi. Mɛ ji a weku ɔmɛ a nyatsɛmɛ.
21Wekuhi nɛ peeɔ Gershon we puɔ nya ji Libni kɛ Shimei. 22Nyumuhi nɛ a ngma a biɛ, kɛ je ni nɛmɛ nɛ ye nyɔhiɔ kake kɛ yaa a, mɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ a hiɛmi ji nimli akpe kpaago kɛ e nya lafa enuɔ. 23Gershon we puɔ nya a maa to si ngɛ kpe he ɔ se, kɛ yaa bonyoku je. 24A nyatsɛ ji Lael bi Eliasaf. 25Kpe he bo tsu ɔ he níhi nɛ a tu kɛ wo a dɛ mi ji: kpe he ɔ, bo tsu ɔ kɛ e nɔ hami nɔ́ ɔ, bo tsu ɔ sinya a nya bo ɔ, 26kue ɔ nɛ bɔle kpe he ɔ, kɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he bo ɔmɛ, kɛ kue ɔ nitsɛ nya bo ɔ kɛ e he tangme kpa amɛ. Ní tsumi tsuaa ní tsumi nɛ kɔɔ ní nɛ ɔmɛ a he ɔ, mɛ lɛ a ma tsu.
27Wekuhi nɛ peeɔ Kohat we puɔ nya ji Amram, Izhar, kɛ Hebron, kɛ Uziel. 28Nyumuhi nɛ a ngma a biɛ, kɛ je ni nɛmɛ nɛ ye hlami kake kɛ yaa a, mɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ a hiɛmi ji nimli akpe kpaanyɔ kɛ e nya lafa ekpa; mɛ ji nimli nɛ tsuɔ ní ngɛ he klɔuklɔu ɔ. 29Kohat we puɔ nya a maa to si ngɛ kpe he ɔ leneyi je. 30A nyatsɛ ji Uziel bi Elizafan. 31Ní tsumi nɛ a tu kɛ wo a dɛ mi ji: ní tsumi tsuaa ní tsumi nɛ kɔɔ somi daka a he, okplɔɔ ɔ, kane tso ɔ, bɔ sami la tɛ ɔmɛ, níhi nɛ osɔfo ɔmɛ kɛ sɔmɔɔ ngɛ he klɔuklɔu ɔ, kɛ tsu mi pomi bo ɔ.
32Levi bi ɔmɛ a nyatsɛ ji osɔfo Aaron bi Eleazar. Lɛ ji nɔ nɛ hyɛɛ nihi nɛ tsuɔ ní ngɛ he klɔuklɔu ɔ a nɔ.
33Wekuhi nɛ peeɔ Merari we puɔ nya a ji Mahli, kɛ Mushi. 34Nyumuhi nɛ a ngma a biɛ, kɛ je ni nɛmɛ nɛ ye nyɔhiɔ kake kɛ yaa a, mɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ a hiɛmi ji nimli akpe ekpa kɛ e nya lafa enyɔ. 35A nyatsɛ ji Abihail bi Zuriel. Mɛɛ a maa to si ngɛ kpe he ɔ we omleyi je. 36Ní tsumi nɛ a tu kɛ wo Merari binyumu ɔmɛ a dɛ mi ji ní tsumi tsuaa ní tsumi nɛ kɔɔ kpe he ɔ he plai ɔmɛ, mani ɔmɛ, titima amɛ kɛ a nɔ dami ní ɔmɛ, kɛ a he ní ɔmɛ tsuo a he. 37Mɛ kɛ̃ a ní tsumi ji kue ɔ mi tso ɔmɛ, a nɔ dami ní ɔmɛ, plɛɛko ɔmɛ, kɛ tangme kpa amɛ a nɔ hyɛmi.
38Ni nɛmɛ nɛ maa to si ngɛ kpe he ɔ hɛ mi kɛ yaa beleku je ji Mose, Aaron, kɛ Aaron binyumu ɔmɛ. Mɛ ji nihi nɛ ma tsu kusumi ní tsumihi tsuo ngɛ he klɔuklɔu ɔ kɛ ha Israel ma a nɛ. Nɔ kpa ko nɛ maa hɛ lɛ kɛ su ní tsumi nɛ ɔ he ɔ, a gbe lɛ. 39Levi bi ɔmɛ a kpɛti nyumuhi tsuo nɛ ye kɛ je hlami kake kɛ yaa, nɛ Mose kɛ Aaron ngma a biɛ we puɔ nya we puɔ nya kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa mɛ ɔ, mɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ a hiɛmi ji nimli akpe nyingmi enyɔ kɛ enyɔ.
Levi bi ɔmɛ ba da bitɛte ɔmɛ a nane mi
40-41Yawɛ de Mose ke, “Israel bitɛte ɔmɛ ɔ, ye níhi ji mɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, moo kane Israel bitɛte tsuaa bitɛte nɛ ye kɛ je nyɔhiɔ kake kɛ yaa a, nɛ o ngma e biɛ. Se i ngɔ Levi bi ɔmɛ tsuo ngɔ to Israel bitɛte ɔmɛ a nane mi. Imi ji Yawɛ! Jehanɛ se, i ngɔ Levi bi ɔmɛ a we mi lohwehi a kekleekle bi ɔmɛ hu ngɔ to Israel bi ɔmɛ a we mi lohwehi a nane mi.” 42Mose kane Israel bi ɔmɛ a bitɛte ɔmɛ tsuo kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa lɛ ɔ. 43Benɛ a ngma bitɛtehi nɛ ye kɛ je nyɔhiɔ kake kɛ yaa a a biɛ ɔ, mɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ a hiɛmi ji nimli akpe nyingmi enyɔ kɛ enyɔ kɛ e nya lafa enyɔ kɛ nyingmi kpaago kɛ etɛ.
44Yawɛ de Mose ke, 45“Jehanɛ, moo hla Levi bi ɔmɛ ngɔ to ha mi ngɛ Israel bitɛte ɔmɛ tsuo a nane mi, kɛ a we mi lohwehi hu ngɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ a we mi lohwehi tsuo a kekleekle bi ɔmɛ a nane mi. Imi ji Yawɛ! 46Akɛnɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ a bitɛte ɔmɛ hiɛ pe Levi bi ɔmɛ kɛ nimli lafa enyɔ kɛ nyingmi kpaago kɛ etɛ he je ɔ, á kpɔ bimɛ nɛ be nɔ ɔ. 47Bi tsuaa bi ɔ, á ngɔ sika hiɔ yi enuɔ kɛ kpɔ lɛ kaa bɔ nɛ he klɔuklɔu jua nɛ a po ɔ ngɛ ɔ. 48Ngɔɔ sika nɛ a kɛ ba kpɔ nihi nɛ be nɔ ɔ kɛ ha Aaron, kɛ e bimɛ ɔmɛ.” 49Mose he kpɔmi sika a nɛ a ha ngɛ Israel bitɛte abɔ nɛ a kɛ hiɛ pe Levi bi ɔmɛ a he ɔ. 50Sika nɛ a ha ngɛ Israel bitɛte ɔmɛ a he, nɛ e nine su nɔ ji sika hiɔ yi akpe, kɛ e nya lafa etɛ kɛ nyingmi ekpa kɛ enuɔ kaa bɔ nɛ he klɔuklɔu ɔ jua nɛ a po ɔ ngɛ ɔ. 51Mose ngɔ kpɔmi sika a kɛ ha Aaron, kɛ e bimɛ ɔmɛ kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa lɛ ɔ.

Title: MOSE IV, 4
Content:
Kohat bi ɔmɛ a ní tsumi
1Yawɛ de Mose kɛ Aaron ke, 2“Nyɛɛ kane Kohat bi nɛ ngɛ Levi bi ɔmɛ a kpɛti ɔ weku nya weku nya, kɛ we puɔ nya we puɔ nya, nɛ nyɛɛ ngma nyumu ɔmɛ a biɛ, 3kɛ je nɔ nɛ ye jeha nyingmi etɛ nɔ, kɛ yaa si nɔ nɛ ye jeha nyingmi enuɔ nɔ, nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ma nyɛ tsu ní ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ mi. 4Kohat bi ɔmɛ ji ni nɛmɛ nɛ ma tsu níhi nɛ ngɛ klɔuklɔu pe kulaa ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ mi ɔ a he ní.
5“Ke be nɛ ma a maa hia kɛ je a sito he ɔ, Aaron kɛ e bimɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a ya sɛ bo tsu ɔ mi, nɛ a je tsu mi pomi bo ɔ nɛ ngɛ somi daka a nɛ somi womi ɔ ngɛ mi ɔ hɛ mi ɔ kɛ ha daka a he. 6Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, a ngɔ apletsi he womi nɛ a je blɔ pee kɛ ha he, nɛ a ngɔ bo bluu hu kɛ ha lɔ ɔ nɔ, loko a ngɔ tsohi nɛ a kɛ maa hɛɛ daka a kɛ hɔɔ a blɔ hehi.
7“Okplɔɔ ɔ nɛ a kɛ abolo klɛdɛɛ nɛ a kɛ maa Yawɛ hɛ mi ɔ maa nɔ ɔ, á ngɔ bo bluu kɛ ha nɔ loko a ngɔ plɛɛtehi, kahi nɛ a kɛ tsopa kɛ e he via kɛ bɔhi woɔ a mi ɔ, kɛ kpluhi nɛ a kɛ wai bɔhi woɔ a mi ɔ kɛ ma nɔ. 8A ngɔ bo tsu kɛ ha ní nɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ a ngɔ apletsi he womi nɛ a je blɔ pee hu kɛ ha he, loko a ngɔ tsohi nɛ a kɛ maa hɛɛ okplɔɔ ɔ kɛ hɔɔ a blɔ hehi.
9“Kane tso ɔ kɛ e he kane ɔmɛ, abɛɛle ɔmɛ, kɛ nu tɔ ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ a kɛ nu woɔ a mi ɔ, a ngɔ bo bluu kɛ ha a he. 10A ngɔ apletsi he womi nɛ a je blɔ pee kɛ ha kane tso ɔ, kɛ e he ní ɔmɛ tsuo a he, nɛ a ngɔ kɛ wo tlɔɔke mi.
11“Sika tsu bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ hu a ngɔ bo bluu kɛ ha he, nɛ a ngɔ apletsi he womi nɛ a je blɔ pee kɛ ha lɔ ɔ hu nɔ, loko a ngɔ tsohi nɛ a kɛ maa hɛɛ lɛ ɔ kɛ hɔɔ a blɔ hehi. 12Ní ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ a kɛ sɔmɔɔ ngɛ he klɔuklɔu ɔ, a je mɛ nɛ a fi kɛ wo bo bluu mi, nɛ a ngɔ apletsi he womi nɛ a je blɔ pee kɛ ha a he, loko a kɛ wo tlɔɔke ɔ mi. 13A muɔ la zu ɔ ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ, nɛ a ngɔ bo he jua wawɛ nɛ hɛɛ alamua tu su kɛ ha he. 14Jehanɛ, a ngɔ ní ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ a kɛ sɔmɔɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ kɛ ma nɔ: ngɛyuhi, sofihi, gbowehi, kɛ kahi. Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, a ngɔ apletsi he womi nɛ a je blɔ pee kɛ ha he, loko a ngɔ tsohi nɛ a kɛ maa hɛɛ lɛ ɔ kɛ hɔɔ a blɔ hehi. 15Ke be nɛ ma a maa hia kɛ je a sito he ɔ, Aaron kɛ e bimɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a ha ní klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ kɛ a he ní ɔmɛ tsuo a he, loko Kohat bi ɔmɛ nɛ a ba nɛ a ba tloo kɛ ho. Kohat bi ɔmɛ kó ta ní klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ a he, konɛ a ko gbo. Kpe he bo tsu ɔ he níhi nɛ Kohat bi ɔmɛ maa tloo be tsuaa be nɛ ma a maa hia ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ.
16“Osɔfo Aaron bi Eleazar lɛɛ e ní tsumi ji kaa e hyɛ kane mi nu ɔ, tsopa kɛ e he via a, daa niye ní bɔ sami ɔ, kɛ nɔ pɔmi nu ɔ a nɔ. Lɛ ji nɔ nɛ maa hyɛ kpe he ɔ, e mi ní klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ, kɛ e he ní ɔmɛ tsuo a nɔ.”
17Yawɛ de Mose kɛ Aaron ke, 18“Nyɛ ko ha nɛ Kohat bi ɔmɛ a hɛ mi ba kpata ngɛ Levi bi ɔmɛ a kpɛti. 19Bɔ nɛ pee nɛ ke a ba su níhi nɛ ngɛ klɔuklɔu pe kulaa a he nɛ a ko gbo, se mohu a yi nɛ na wami he je ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ nyɛɛ pee ha mɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: Aaron kɛ e bimɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a ya nɛ a ya tsɔɔ nɔ tsuaa nɔ e ní tsumi, kɛ e tlomi nɛ e maa tloo. 20Kohat bi ɔmɛ lɛɛ ke a sɛ bo tsu ɔ mi ɔ, a ko hyɛ ní klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ hɛngmɛfia po. Ke a pee ja a, a ma gbo.”
Gershon bi ɔmɛ a ní tsumi
21Yawɛ de Mose ke, 22“Moo kane Gershon bi nɛ ngɛ Levi bi ɔmɛ a kpɛti ɔ hu weku nya weku nya, kɛ we puɔ nya we puɔ nya, nɛ o ngma nyumu ɔmɛ a biɛ, 23kɛ je nɔ nɛ ye jeha nyingmi etɛ nɔ kɛ yaa si nɔ nɛ ye jeha nyingmi enuɔ nɔ, nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ma nyɛ tsu ní ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ mi. 24Gershon bi ɔmɛ a ní tsumi ji 25a maa tloo kpe he ɔ he bo ɔmɛ, bo tsu ɔ kɛ e he hami nɔ́ ɔ, e yi bumi nɔ́ ɔ nɛ a ngɔ apletsi he womi nɛ a je blɔ pee kɛ kpɛ ɔ, kpe he bo tsu sinya a nya bo ɔ, 26kue ɔ nɛ bɔle kpe he ɔ he bo ɔmɛ, kue ɔ nya bo ɔ, bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ, kɛ a he tangme kpa amɛ, kɛ a he ní tsumi ní ɔmɛ tsuo. Ní nɛ ɔmɛ a he ní tsumi tsuo nɛ sa tsumi ɔ, a tsu. 27Aaron kɛ e bimɛ ɔmɛ maa hyɛ Gershon bi ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɔ́ nɛ a ma tsu, kɛ níhi nɛ a maa tloo. Nyɛɛ dla tlomihi nɛ a maa tloo ɔ ngɔ ha mɛ kakaaka. 28Ní tsumihi nɛ Gershon bi ɔmɛ ma tsu ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ mi ɔ ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ, nɛ nɔ nɛ maa hyɛ a nɔ ji osɔfo Aaron bi Itamar.
Merari bi ɔmɛ a ní tsumi
29“Merari bi ɔmɛ hu o kane mɛ weku nya weku nya, kɛ we puɔ nya we puɔ nya, nɛ o ngma nyumu ɔmɛ a biɛ, 30kɛ je nɔ nɛ ye jeha nyingmi etɛ nɔ, kɛ yaa si nɔ nɛ ye jeha nyingmi enuɔ nɔ, nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ma nyɛ tsu ní ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ mi. 31Ní tsumi nɛ mɛɛ a ma tsu ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ mi ji a maa muɔ kpe he ɔ he plai ɔmɛ, mani ɔmɛ, titima amɛ kɛ a nɔ dami ní ɔmɛ, 32kue ɔ nɛ bɔle si ɔ mi tso ɔmɛ, a nɔ dami ní ɔmɛ, kɛ plɛɛko ɔmɛ kɛ a he tangme kpa amɛ, kɛ a he ní ɔmɛ tsuo. Moo dla tlomihi nɛ a maa tloo ɔ ngɔ ha mɛ kakaaka. 33Ní tsumihi nɛ Merari bi ɔmɛ ma tsu ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ mi ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ; nɛ nɔ nɛ maa hyɛ a nɔ ji osɔfo Aaron bi Itamar.”
A kane Levi bi ɔmɛ
34-48Kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa a, Mose kɛ Aaron, kɛ ma nimeli ɔmɛ ya kane nihi ngɛ Levi wɛtso ɔ we puɔ nya etɛ ɔmɛ a mi. Mɛ ji Kohat, Gershon, kɛ Merari. A ngma nyumuhi tsuo nɛ ye kɛ je jeha nyingmi etɛ kɛ ya si ni nɛmɛ nɛ ye jeha nyingmi enuɔ, nɛ a ma nyɛ tsu ní ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ mi ɔ a biɛ. Bɔ nɛ e ba lɛ ha ji nɛ ɔ nɛ:
WE PUƆ NYA NI ƆMƐ A HIƐMI
Kohat 2,750
Gershon 2,630
Merari 3,200
Lɛ tsuo peeɔ 8,580
49A ngma nɔ tsuaa nɔ biɛ kakaaka kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa Mose ɔ, nɛ a dla ní tsumi slɔɔto ɔmɛ, kɛ tlomi ɔmɛ a tloomi ngɔ ha mɛ, nɔ tsuaa nɔ kɛ e nɔ́. Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa Mose ke e pee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.

Title: MOSE IV, 5
Content:
Nihi nɛ a he tsɔ we
1Yawɛ de Mose ke, 2“Wo Israel bi ɔmɛ mlaa, nɛ a fie nimli nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ je ma sito he ɔ: nihi nɛ he womi nɔ hiɔ yaya ngɛ a he; nihi nɛ a he nyu ngɛ bee, kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ ya ta nɔ gbogboe he kɛ ble a he. 3Nyɛ je nimli nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ je nyɛ kpɛti, nyumuhi jio, yihi jio, konɛ a ko ble ma sito he ɔ, he nɛ i hii ngɛ ye ma a a kpɛti ɔ.” 4Israel bi ɔmɛ pee kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa Mose ɔ, nɛ a fie jamɛatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ kɛ je ma sito he ɔ.
Yayami nane mi tomi
5 Yawɛ de Mose ke, 6“De Israel bi ɔmɛ ke, ke nyumu ko, loo yo ko pee nɔ ko yayami nɛ e kɛ tɔ Yawɛ nɔ, nɛ a bu lɛ fɔ ɔ, 7e jaje yayami nɛ e pee ɔ, nɛ e to e yayami ɔ nane mi sisiisi. Jehanɛ, e ngɔ nane mi tomi nɔ́ ɔ mi dlami enuɔ mi kake kɛ bɔ he ha nɔ nɛ nɔ nɛ e tɔ ɔ. 8Se ke nɔmlɔ nɛ ɔ be je mi, nɛ e be weku no pɔtɛɛ ko nɛ a kɛ nane mi tomi ní ɔmɛ ma ha lɛ ɔ, lɛɛ nane mi tomi ní ɔmɛ maa pee Yawɛ nɔ, nɛ a kɛ ma ha osɔfo ɔ. Slo nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ngɛ agbosu ɔ nɛ a kɛ peeɔ kusumi kɛ tsukɔɔ nɔ ko nɛ tɔ ɔ he ɔ. 9Jehanɛ se hu, nike ní klɛdɛɛ nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ maa ngɔ kɛ ba ha Yawɛ ɔ, e maa pee osɔfo ɔ nɔ. 10Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ nɔ ko maa ngɔ kɛ ba ha osɔfo ko ɔ, jamɛ a nɔ́ ɔ maa pee osɔfo ɔ nɔ.”
Nyumuhi nɛ a yi mi tɛ̃ mɛ ngɛ a yihi a he
11Yawɛ de Mose ke, 12“Mo de Israel bi ɔmɛ ke, ke nyumu ko yo je e se, nɛ e ya tɔ e nɔ, 13nɛ e ya hwɔ nyumu kpa se kɛ ble e he, nɛ e kɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ laa e huno ɔ, nɛ anɔkuale ɔ ji kpo, ejakaa odase ko be he, nɛ a nui yo ɔ hulɔ, 14aloo ke hunga jemi mumi te si ngɛ nyumu nɛ ɔ mi, nɛ e yi mi tɛ̃ lɛ ngɛ e yo nɛ ya ble e he niinɛ, aloo nɔ nɛ ya pee we ja po he ɔ, 15nyumu nɛ ɔ nɛ ngɔ e yo ɔ kɛ ba osɔfo ɔ ngɔ. Nyumu ɔ nɛ hɛɛ ngma mamu kilo kake, nɛ ji bɔ ɔ nɛ e maa sã ngɛ yo ɔ he ɔ kɛ ba. E ko plɛ oliv nu kɛ pue nɔ, nɛ e ko ngɔ mimɛ hu kɛ fɔ nɔ; ejakaa hunga niye ní bɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ; bɔ nɛ nyumu nɛ yi mi tɛ̃ e yo he ba sã, konɛ a kɛ hla anɔkuale ɔ.
16“Osɔfo ɔ nɛ ngɔ yo ɔ kɛ ba Yawɛ hɛ mi. 17Osɔfo ɔ nɛ yɛ nyu klɔuklɔu ɔ eko kɛ wo buɛ mi, nɛ e piti tabo zu ngɛ kpe he ɔ kɛ wo nyu ɔ mi. 18Osɔfo ɔ nɛ pɛne yo ɔ yi bwɔmi. Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e ngɔ niye ní bɔ ɔ, nɛ ji hunga niye ní bɔ ɔ nɛ a kɛ hlaa anɔkuale ɔ ngɔ wo yo ɔ dɛ mi. Osɔfo ɔ nitsɛ lɛɛ e hɛɛ nyu nɛ dooɔ, nɛ kɛ gbiɛmi baa nɔ nɔ ɔ ngɛ e dɛ mi. 19Jehanɛ, osɔfo ɔ nɛ ka kita ngɔ pue yo ɔ nɔ, nɛ e de ke, ‘Ke o ya hwɔ we nyumu ko se, aloo ke o ji o huno ɔ se ya wui o he mu ɔ, lɛɛ gbiɛmi nɛ nyu nɛ dooɔ nɛ ɔ kɛ baa nɔ nɔ ɔ, o he nɛ je mi.’ 20Se ke o je o huno ɔ se ya hwɔ nyumu kpa se, nɛ o ya ble o he ɔ, lɛɛ…! 21Osɔfo ɔ nɛ ka kita nɛ e kɛ gbiɛ yo ɔ, nɛ e de lɛ ke, ‘Yawɛ nɛ ha nɛ o plɛ pee gbiɛmi, kɛ nɔ́ nɛ a kɛ ma ka kita ngɛ o ma mi bi ɔmɛ a kpɛti. Yawɛ nɛ ha nɛ o mi nɛ fu nɛ o mi si nɛ nɔ mi. 22Nyu nɛ ɔ nɛ kɛ gbiɛmi baa nɔ nɔ ɔ, e sɛ o mi mi, nɛ e ha nɛ o mi nɛ fu, nɛ o mi si nɛ nɔ mi.’ Kɛkɛ, yo ɔ ma he nɔ ke, ‘E ba mi! E ba mi!’
23“Jehanɛ, osɔfo ɔ nɛ ngma gbiɛmi ɔ kɛ wo womi mi, nɛ e fɔ kɛ wo nyu nɛ dooɔ ɔ mi. 24Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e ngɔ nyu nɛ dooɔ ɔ kɛ ha yo ɔ nɛ e nu. Ke nyu nɛ ɔ sɛ yo ɔ mi mi ɔ, e maa hao e mi mi ɔ. 25Se loko osɔfo ɔ maa pee nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, e he ngma niye ní bɔ ɔ, nɛ ji hunga bɔ ɔ ngɛ yo ɔ dɛ. E fɔ̃ ngma niye ní bɔ ɔ kɛ ya kɛ ba ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi. Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e ngɔ kɛ ba bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he. 26Osɔfo ɔ nɛ ti niye ní bɔ ɔ dɛ mamɛ kake kɛkɛ kaa okadi, nɛ e sã lɔ ɔ ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ. 27Ke yo ɔ tɔ e huno ɔ nɔ niinɛ, nɛ e ya ble e he ɔ, lɛɛ ke a kɛ nyu ɔ ha lɛ nɛ e nu ɔ, nyu nɛ kɛ gbiɛmi baa nɔ nɔ nɛ ɔ ma ha nɛ e mi mi maa kɔɔ lɛ. E mi maa fu nɛ e mi si maa nɔ mi, nɛ e ma plɛ pee gbiɛmi ngɛ e ma mi bi ɔmɛ a kpɛti. 28Se ke yo ɔ ya ble we e he, nɛ e he tsɔ ɔ, lɛɛ e maa ye e he, nɛ e ma nyɛ ma fɔ bimɛ.
29“Mlaa nɛ kɔɔ hunga jemi he ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. Ke yogbayo ko je e huno se ya ble e he, 30aloo ke hunga jemi mumi te si ngɛ nyumu ko mi, nɛ e yi mi tɛ̃ lɛ ngɛ e yo he ɔ, nyumu ɔ nɛ ngɔ yo ɔ kɛ ba Yawɛ hɛ mi, konɛ osɔfo ɔ nɛ pee kikɛmɛ a mlaa nɛ ɔ he kusumi ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ ha lɛ. 31A be nyumu ɔ fɔ ko bue; se ke yo ɔ ye fɔ ɔ, sɔ̃ ɔ maa tloo lɛ yo ɔ.”

Title: MOSE IV, 6
Content:
Mlaahi kɛ ha Nazir no peemi
1Yawɛ de Mose ke, 2“Mo de Israel bi ɔmɛ ke, ke nyumu ko, loo yo ko je blɔ ka Nazir no peemi kita, nɛ e wo si kaa e maa ngɔ e he ngɔ ha Yawɛ ɔ, 3 e yu e he kɛ je wai, kɛ dã nɛ nya wa a he. E ko nu wai, aloo dã kpa ko nɛ kuã. E ko nu nɔ́ ko nɛ a kɛ wai yiblii pee; wai yiblii mumu, loo gbigbli hu e ko ye. 4Ligbi abɔ nɛ Nazir no ji lɛ ɔ, e ko ye nɔ́ ko nɛ a kɛ wai tso he nɔ́ ko pee; wai tso yiblii ɔ mi wu ɔ jio, e he toto jio, e ko ye.
5“Ligbi abɔ nɛ e ngɛ Nazir no si womi nɛ ɔ sisi ɔ, e ko sã e yi nɔ. E ngmɛɛ e yi bwɔmi he nɛ e ka gagaaga; nɛ e pee e he klɔuklɔu. 6-7E yi bwɔmi ji okadi nɛ tsɔɔ kaa e ngɔ e he ngɔ ha Yawɛ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke nɔ ko gbo ɔ, e ko ya nɔ gbogboe ɔ he nɛ e ko ba ble e he, e tsɛ jio, e nyɛ jio, e nyɛminyumu jio, e nyɛmiyo jio. 8Ligbi abɔ nɛ Nazir no ji lɛ ɔ, a tsukɔ e he kɛ ha Yawɛ.
9“Ke e ba mi kaa nɔ ko gbo tlukaa ngɛ e kasa nya, nɛ lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e ble e yi bwɔmi ɔ nɛ a tsukɔ he kɛ ha Yawɛ ɔ, e sɛ e yi ɔ kpalokpalo ngɛ e he tsukɔmi ligbi ɔ we ligbi kpaago se. 10Ligbi kpaanyɔne ɔ, e ngɔ lahuɛ enyɔ, aloo beleku lahuɛ tsɔwi enyɔ kɛ ba ha osɔfo ɔ ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ sinya a nya. 11Osɔfo ɔ maa ngɔ kake kɛ sã yayami pami bɔ, nɛ e maa ngɔ kake hu kɛ sã sami bɔ kɛ tsukɔ nɔ ɔ he; ejakaa e pee yayami kaa e hyɛ nɔ gbogboe hɛ mi. Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ nɔuu ɔ, nyumu nɛ ɔ maa tsukɔ e yi bwɔmi ɔ he ekohu, 12nɛ e maa kpale je sisi maa ngɔ e he ngɔ ha Yawɛ ekohu kaa Nazir no. Be nɛ be ɔ pee yaka, ejakaa e ble e yi bwɔmi nɛ a tsukɔ he ɔ. E maa ngɔ jijɔ bi kake nɛ ye jeha kake kɛ ba sã bɔ kaa e tɔ.
13 “Ke Nazir no ko si womi ligbi ɔmɛ a nya ta a, á ngɔ lɛ kɛ ba kpe he bo tsu ɔ sinya a nya, 14nɛ e ba sã bɔ ha Yawɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. É ngɔ jijɔ ku kake nɛ ye jeha kake, nɛ kpa ko kpa ko be e he kɛ ba sã sami bɔ. É ngɔ jijɔ yo kake nɛ ye jeha kake, nɛ kpa ko kpa ko be e he kɛ ba sã yayami pami bɔ; nɛ e ngɔ agbosu kake hu nɛ kpa ko kpa ko be e he kɛ ba sã tue mi jɔmi bɔ. 15Jehanɛ se hu, e ngɔ abolo kplolo kusii kake, kɛ keeki nɛ a kɛ mamu bukɔbukɔ nɛ a futu mi nu pee, kɛ akpɔɔnɔɔ nɛ a wui mi masa, se a ngɔ nu kɛ kpa hɛ mi kɛ piɛ niye ní bɔ ɔ, kɛ dã nɛ a kɛ maa sã bɔ ɔ a he kɛ ba.
16“Osɔfo ɔ nɛ ngɔ ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ ba Yawɛ hɛ mi, nɛ́ e sã yayami pami bɔ ɔ, kɛ sami bɔ ɔ. 17Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e ngɔ agbosu ɔ kɛ sã tue mi jɔmi bɔ ha Yawɛ, nɛ e ngɔ abolo kɛ kusii ɔ ngɔ piɛ he. E ngɔ niye ní bɔ ɔ, kɛ dã nɛ a kɛ maa sã bɔ ɔ hu kɛ ba. 18Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, Nazir no ɔ nɛ sɛ e yi ɔ kpalokpalo ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ sinya a nya. E muɔ e yi bwɔmi ɔ kɛ wo la a nɛ a kɛ ngɛ tue mi jɔmi bɔ ɔ sãe ɔ mi.
19“Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, osɔfo ɔ nɛ je keeki nɛ a wui mi masa kake, kɛ akpɔɔnɔɔ nɛ a wui mi masa kake ngɛ kusii ɔ mi kɛ piɛ agbosu ɔ nɛ a hoo ɔ kɔni kake he, nɛ e kɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ ha Nazir no ɔ. 20Nyagbe ɔ, osɔfo ɔ nɛ fɔ ní ɔmɛ kɛ ya kɛ ba ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi kaa bɔ nɛ a fɔɔ kɛ yaa kɛ baa. Mlaa nya a, ní nɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ agbosu ɔ gugue, kɛ fiɔ ɔ peeɔ osɔfo ɔ nike ní klɔuklɔu. Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Nazir no ɔ ngɛ he blɔ nɛ e nuɔ dã faa.
21“Mlaahi nɛ ngɛ kɛ ha Nazir no nɛ wo Yawɛ si ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ. Bɔ hu nɛ e maa sã ha Yawɛ ngɛ e Nazir no peemi si womi ɔ nya a ji nɛ ɔ nɛ; slo nɔ́ nɛ e ma nyɛ ha ngɛ enɛ ɔ se. Ke Nazir no ko wo si ɔ, e pee ja pɛpɛɛpɛ ngɛ mlaa a nya, be mi nɛ e ngɔ e he ngɔ ha Yawɛ.”
Osɔfo ɔ nɛ gbaa ma a
22Yawɛ de Mose ke, 23“De Aaron kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ ke, bɔ nɛ nyɛɛ gbaa Israel ma a ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. Nyɛ de ke,
24Yawɛ nɛ gbaa nyɛ,
nɛ e hyɛ nyɛ;
25Yawɛ nɛ ha e hɛ mi
nɛ kpɛ ngɛ nyɛ nɔ,
nɛ e dloo nyɛ;
26Yawɛ nɛ wo e hɛ mi nɔ ngɛ nyɛ nɔ,
nɛ e ha nyɛ he jɔmi.
27“Ke a tsɛ ye biɛ ngɔ pue Israel ma a nɔ kikɛ nɛ ɔ, ma gbaa mɛ.”

Title: MOSE IV, 7
Content:
Ma nimeli ɔmɛ ba sã bɔ
1Ligbi ɔ nɛ Mose gbe kpe he ɔ mami nya a, e pɔ kpe he ɔ nu, nɛ e tsukɔ he kɛ e he ní ɔmɛ tsuo, kɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ kɛ e he ní ɔmɛ tsuo. 2Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, Israel wɛtso nikɔtɔma amɛ nɛ da wɛtso ɔmɛ a nya, be mi nɛ a kane ni ɔmɛ ɔ, 3ngɔ a nike ní ba ha Yawɛ ngɛ kpe he ɔ. Ní ɔmɛ ji tlɔɔkehi nɛ a kɛ nɔ́ ha a he ekpa, kɛ na ku nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ. Ni enyɔ tsuaa ni enyɔ kɛ tlɔɔke kake ba, se na amɛ lɛɛ a ngɔ kakaaka kɛ ba. 4Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ de Mose ke, 5“Mo he nike ní nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ a dɛ, nɛ a kɛ tsu kpe he bo tsu ɔ he ní; moo dla ngɔ ha Levi bi ɔmɛ ngɛ a ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ ní tsumi nya.” 6Mose he ní ɔmɛ, nɛ e ngɔ tlɔɔke ɔmɛ, kɛ na ku ɔmɛ ngɔ ha Levi bi ɔmɛ. 7E ha Gershon bi ɔmɛ tlɔɔke enyɔ, kɛ na eywiɛ ngɛ a ní tsumi nya, 8nɛ e ha Merari bi ɔmɛ tlɔɔke eywiɛ, kɛ na kpaanyɔ ngɛ mɛ hu a ní tsumi nya. Mɛ tsuo a nɔ hyɛlɔ ji osɔfo Aaron bi Itamar. 9Se Kohat bi ɔmɛ lɛɛ Mose ha we mɛ nɔ́ ko; ejakaa ní klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ nɛ a kɛ ha mɛ nɛ a hyɛ nɔ ɔ, a konɔ a kɛ maa fɔ.
10Ligbi ɔ nɛ a pɔ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nu, nɛ a tsukɔ he ɔ, ma nimeli ɔmɛ ngɔ nike ní kɛ ba bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ hɛ mi ekohu. 11Yawɛ de Mose ke, “Ha nɛ ma nimeli ɔmɛ nɛ a ngɔ a nike ní ɔmɛ kɛ ba kakaaka, nɛ a kɛ tsukɔ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he. Daa ligbi ɔ, nɔ kake nɛ ngɔ e nɔ́ kɛ ba.”
12-83Bɔ nɛ a ngɔ nike ní ɔmɛ kɛ ba ha ji nɛ ɔ nɛ:
LIGBI WƐTSO WƐTSO NƆKƆTƆMA
Kekleekle Yuda Nashon, Aminadab bi ɔ
Enyɔne Isakar Netanel, Zuar bi ɔ
Etɛne Zebulun Eliab, Helon bi ɔ
Eywiɛne Ruben Elizur, Shedeur bi ɔ
Enuɔne Simeon Shelumiel, Zurishadai bi ɔ
Ekpane Gad Eliasaf, Deuel bi ɔ
Kpaagone Efraim Elishama, Amihud bi ɔ
Kpaanyɔne Manase Gamaliel, Pedazur bi ɔ
Nɛɛne Benyamin Abidan, Gideoni bi ɔ
Nyɔngmane Dan Ahiezer, Amishadai bi ɔ
Nyɔngma kɛ Asher Pagiel, Okran bi ɔ kakene
Nyɔngma kɛ enyɔne Naftali Ahira, Enan bi ɔ.
Nike ní mi mi kake too nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ ngɔ kɛ ba. Nike ní ɔmɛ ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ: sika hiɔ plɛɛte kake nɛ e jiimi ji kilo kake kɛ fa, kɛ sika hiɔ kã kake nɛ e jiimi ji gram lafa kpaanyɔ ngɛ he klɔuklɔu ɔ jiimi nya. Ní enyɔ nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo hyi tɔ kɛ ngma mamu bukɔbukɔ nɛ a ngɔ nu kɛ futu mi kɛ ha niye ní bɔ sami. Enɛ ɔmɛ hu piɛ he: sika tsu kã kake nɛ e jiimi ji gram lafa kɛ nyɔngma nɛ tsopa kɛ e he via nɛ a sãã hyi lɛ tɔ, na niheyo kake, agbosu kake, kɛ jijɔ ku kake nɛ ye jeha kake, nɛ a kɛ maa sã sami bɔ, kɛ akpakpo kake nɛ a kɛ maa sã yayami pami bɔ. Enɛ ɔmɛ lɛɛ a kɛ maa sã tue mi jɔmi bɔ: na ku enyɔ, agbosu enyɔ, akpakpo enuɔ, kɛ jijɔ ku enuɔ nɛ a ye jeha kakaaka.
84-88Ligbi ɔ nɛ a pɔ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nu ɔ, nike ní nɛ Israel wɛtso nikɔtɔma amɛ ngɔ kɛ ba a tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ a hiɛmi ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ:
- Sika hiɔ plɛɛte nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ, kɛ sika hiɔ kã nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ nɛ a jiimi ji kilo nyingmi enyɔ kɛ kpaago kɛ se.
- Sika tsu kã nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ nɛ tsopa kɛ e he via hyi mɛ tɔ ɔ tsuo a jiimi ji kilo kɛ se.
- Na ku nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ, agbosu nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ, jijɔ ku nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ nɛ a ye jeha kakaaka, kɛ niye ní bɔ ɔ nɛ piɛ he nɛ a kɛ maa sã sami bɔ ɔ.
- Akpakpo nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ nɛ a kɛ maa sã yayami pami bɔ ɔ.
- Na ku nyingmi enyɔ kɛ eywiɛ, agbosu nyingmi ekpa, akpakpo nyingmi ekpa, kɛ jijɔ ku nyingmi ekpa nɛ a ye jeha kakaaka nɛ a kɛ maa sã tue mi jɔmi bɔ ɔ.
89Benɛ Mose ya sɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ mi, konɛ e kɛ Yawɛ nɛ ya tu munyu ɔ, e nu Yawɛ gbi nɛ e kɛ lɛ ngɛ munyu tue kɛ je somi daka a nya nɔ́ ɔ yi mi, ngɛ kerub enyɔ ɔmɛ a kpɛti.

Title: MOSE IV, 8
Content:
Kane ɔmɛ a si mamɛ
1 Yawɛ de Mose ke, 2“Mo de Aaron ke, ke e ngɔ kane kpaago ɔmɛ kɛ ma si mami ɔ, e hyɛ nɛ mɛ tsuo a tso kɛ ya kane tso ɔ hɛ mi.” 3Aaron pee kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa Mose ɔ. E ngɔ kane ɔmɛ kɛ ma si, konɛ a tso kɛ ya kane tso ɔ hɛ mi. 4Bɔ nɛ a pee kane tso ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: a ngɔ sika tsu nɛ a fia nɔ tɛtlɛɛ kɛ pee kane tso ɔ kɛ je e nane kɛ ya si e mɔmɔ ɔmɛ a he, kaa bɔ nɛ nɔ hyɛmi nɔ́ ɔ nɛ Yawɛ kɛ tsɔɔ Mose ɔ ngɛ ɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
A hla Levi bi ɔmɛ ngɔ to
5Yawɛ de Mose ekohu ke, 6“Je Levi bi ɔmɛ kɛ je Israel bi ɔmɛ a kpɛti, nɛ o tsukɔ a he. 7Bɔ nɛ o maa pee kɛ tsukɔ a he ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: ngɔɔ nyu ɔ nɛ a kɛ jeɔ yayami ɔ ngɔ fĩa a nɔ. Ha nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ngɔ asoyi kɛ sɛ bwɔmi tsuo ngɛ e nɔmlɔ tso ɔ he, nɛ a fɔ a tade ɔmɛ a he. Ke a pee ja a, a he ma tsɔ. 8Jehanɛ, ha nɛ a ngɔ na niheyo kake, kɛ niye ní bɔ ɔ, nɛ ji mamu bukɔbukɔ nɛ a futu mi nu ɔ kɛ ba. Ngɔɔ na niheyo kpa nɛ o kɛ sã yayami pami bɔ. 9Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, o maa kpee Israel ma mluku ɔ tsuo kɛ ba, nɛ o kɛ Levi bi ɔmɛ ma ba da si ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ sinya a nya. 10Ke o ngɔ Levi bi ɔmɛ kɛ ba imi Yawɛ, ye hɛ mi ɔ, Israel bi ɔmɛ maa ngɔ a nine kɛ pue Levi bi ɔmɛ a yi mi. 11Kɛkɛ Aaron maa pee kusumi klɛdɛɛ ko kɛ tsɔɔ kaa a hla Levi bi ɔmɛ kɛ ha imi Yawɛ, kaa Israel ma mluku ɔ a nike ní klɛdɛɛ, konɛ a sɔmɔ mi. 12Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Levi bi ɔmɛ maa ngɔ a nine kɛ pue na ku enyɔ ɔmɛ a yi mi. O kɛ kake maa sã yayami pami bɔ, nɛ o maa ngɔ kake hu kɛ sã sami bɔ, nɛ o kɛ kpata Yawɛ ha Levi bi ɔmɛ.
13“Ngɔɔ Levi bi ɔmɛ ngɔ ha mi kaa nike ní klɛdɛɛ, konɛ a hi Aaron kɛ e bimɛ ɔmɛ a nine nɔ. 14O maa pee enɛ ɔ kɛ je Levi bi ɔmɛ kɛ je Israel ma a he nɛ a ba pee ye níhi. 15Ke o tsukɔ Levi bi ɔmɛ a he, nɛ o hla mɛ ngɔ to ɔ, lɔ ɔ se loko a ma nyɛ maa ya kpe he bo tsu ɔ mi nɛ a ya sɔmɔ mi ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. 16I ngɔ mɛ ngɔ to bitɛtehi tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ ngɛ Israel ɔ a nane mi; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ye níhi ji mɛ. 17 Ligbi ɔ nɛ i kpata Egipt bi ɔmɛ a kekleekle bimɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a hɛ mi ɔ, i tsukɔ Israel bi ɔmɛ lɛɛ a bitɛte ɔmɛ, kɛ a lohwe ɔmɛ hu a kekleekle bi ɔmɛ a he, nɛ i kɛ mɛ pee imi nitsɛ ye níhi. 18I hla Levi bi ɔmɛ ngɛ Israel bitɛtehi tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ a nane mi. 19I ngɔ mɛ ngɔ ha Aaron kɛ e bimɛ ɔmɛ kaa Israel ma a tsuo a nike ní. A ma sɔmɔ ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ mi, nɛ a ma kpata Yawɛ ha ma a, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ ke alini ma a hɛ mɛ kɛ su he klɔuklɔu ɔ he tsɔ ɔ, gbenɔ hiɔ kó sɛ a kpɛti.”
20Mose kɛ Aaron, kɛ Israel ma kpekpemi ɔ tsukɔ Levi bi ɔmɛ a he, nɛ a hla mɛ ngɔ to kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa Mose ɔ. 21Benɛ Levi bi ɔmɛ tsukɔ a he kɛ je a yayami ɔmɛ a he, nɛ a fɔ a tade ɔmɛ a he ta a, Aaron ngɔ mɛ kɛ ba ha Yawɛ kaa nike ní klɛdɛɛ. E pee kusumi kɛ kpata Yawɛ ha mɛ nɛ e kɛ tsukɔ a he. 22Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Levi bi ɔmɛ ya sɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ mi, nɛ a sɔmɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ ngɛ Aaron kɛ e bimɛ ɔmɛ a sisi. Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa Mose ke a pee ha Levi bi ɔmɛ ɔ, ja pɛpɛɛpɛ nɛ a pee ha mɛ.
23Yawɛ de Mose ke, 24“Mlaa nɛ kɔɔ Levi bi ɔmɛ a he ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: Levi no tsuaa Levi no nɛ ye kɛ je jeha nyingmi enyɔ kɛ enuɔ kɛ yaa a, e ma sɔmɔ ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ mi. 25Ni nɛmɛ nɛ ye kɛ je jeha nyingmi enuɔ kɛ yaa a, mɛɛ a ma kpa ní tsumi. 26Kɛ je jamɛ a be ɔ kɛ yaa a, a ní tsumi ji kaa a maa piɛ a nyɛmimɛ Levi bi ɔmɛ a he kɛ sɔmɔ ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ mi, se mɛ nitsɛmɛ lɛɛ a be ní tsumi pɔtɛɛ ko tsue. Bɔ nɛ o maa to ní tsumi ɔ he blɔ nya kɛ ha Levi bi ɔmɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.”

Title: MOSE IV, 9
Content:
Hetsɔmi enyɔne ɔ
1 Benɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ je Egipt zugba a nɔ ɔ se jeha enyɔne ɔ we kekleekle nyɔhiɔ ɔ, Yawɛ kɛ Mose tu munyu ngɛ Sinai nga a nɔ, nɛ e de lɛ ke, 2“Ha nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ nɛ a ye Hetsɔmi ɔ ngɛ be nɛ a to ɔ mi. 3Nyɔhiɔ nɛ ɔ ligbi nɛ ji nyɔngma kɛ eywiɛ ɔ we gbɔkuɛ nya si ji be nɛ a to ke nyɛɛ ye Hetsɔmi ɔ nɛ. Nyɛɛ ye lɛ ngɛ mlaa amɛ, kɛ blɔ nya tomi ɔmɛ tsuo a nya.” 4Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Mose de Israel bi ɔmɛ ke a ye Hetsɔmi ɔ. 5Nɛ a ye Hetsɔmi ɔ ngɛ Sinai nga a nɔ gbɔkuɛ nya si ngɛ kekleekle nyɔhiɔ ɔ we ligbi nɛ ji nyɔngma kɛ eywiɛ ɔ nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa Mose ɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
6Se ni komɛ ngɛ a kpɛti nɛ a ble a he, ejakaa a ta nɔ gbogboe he; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, mɛɛ a nyɛ we nɛ a ye Hetsɔmi ɔ jamɛ a ligbi ɔ. Kikɛmɛ a nimli nɛ ɔmɛ ba Mose kɛ Aaron a ngɔ jamɛ a ligbi ɔ nɔuu, 7nɛ a ba de ke, “E ngɛ mi kaa wa ya ta nɔ gbogboe he nɛ wa he tsɔ we, se mɛni he je nɛ a tsiɔ wa nya kaa wɔɔ lɛɛ wa ko piɛ Israel bi kpa amɛ a he, nɛ́ waa ngɔ wa nike ní kɛ ba ha Yawɛ ngɛ be nɛ a to ɔ mi?”
8Mose de mɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ mlɛ kɛ yaa si ma nu nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ ma fa mi ke ma de nyɛ.”
9Yawɛ de Mose 10ke e de Israel bi ɔmɛ ke, “Ke nyɛ ti nɔ ko, aloo nyɛ nina ko ya ta nɔ gbogboe he nɛ e kɛ ble e he, aloo e hia blɔ kɛ ho ma se lokoo ya a, jamɛ a nɔ ɔ ma nyɛ maa ye Yawɛ Hetsɔmi ɔ faa. 11Se mohu ɔ, e ye lɛ gbɔkuɛ nya si nyɔhiɔ kake se, ngɛ nyɔhiɔ enyɔne ɔ ligbi nɛ ji nyɔngma kɛ eywiɛ ɔ nɔ. A ngɔ abolo kplolo, kɛ pui doodooe kɛ ye. 12 A ko si eko nɛ je nɛ na yi, nɛ á ko ywia lohwe ɔ wu ko hulɔ; a ye Hetsɔmi ɔ kaa bɔ nɛ mlaa a tsɔɔ ɔ. 13Se nɔmlɔ nɛ he tsɔ, nɛ e hiɛ blɔ hulɔ, nɛ e kua Hetsɔmi ɔ yemi ɔ, jamɛ a nɔ ɔ lɛɛ a je lɛ we kɛ je e ma mi bi ɔmɛ a kpɛti; ejakaa e kɛ Yawɛ nike ní ɔ bɛ be nɛ a to ɔ. Nɔmlɔ nɛ ɔ, lɛ nitsɛ e musu maa tloo lɛ.
14“Ke nubwɔ ko ba ngɛ nyɛ ma a mi nɛ e suɔ kaa e maa ye Hetsɔmi ɔ, e ye ngɛ Yawɛ blɔ nya tomi ɔ nya. Mlaa kake nɛ ɔ ngɛ kɛ ha nɔ tsuaa nɔ, nubwɔ jio, zugba a nɔ bi fɔfɔɛ jio.”
La bɔku ɔ
(Mose II, 40.34-38)
