15-16Ligbi ɔ nɛ a ma kpe he ɔ, bɔku ɔ ba ha he. Kɛ je gbɔkuɛ kɛ ya si je na a, bɔku ɔ ngɛ kpɛe kaa la. 17Be tsuaa be nɛ bɔku ɔ ma wo e he nɔ kɛ je bo tsu ɔ he pɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ maa hia nyɛɛmi. He tsuaa he nɛ bɔku ɔ maa da si ngɛ ɔ, lejɛ ɔ nɔuu ji he nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ hu maa to si ngɛ. 18Ke Yawɛ fa Israel bi ɔmɛ kɛkɛ a hia; ke e fa mɛ ekohu kɛkɛ a to si. Ligbi abɔ nɛ bɔku ɔ daa si ngɛ kpe he ɔ yi mi ɔ, Israel bi ɔmɛ hu hii si ngɛ sito he ɔ. 19Ke e ba mi kaa bɔku ɔ se kɛ ngɛ kpe he ɔ yi mi ligbi babauu po ɔ, Israel bi ɔmɛ buɔ Yawɛ tue, nɛ a hiɛ blɔ. 20Be komɛ hu bɔku ɔ hii kpe he ɔ yi mi ligbi bɔɔ pɛ. Bɔ tsuaa bɔ nɛ pee ɔ, ke Israel bi ɔmɛ maa hi sito he ɔ jio, aloo a maa hia blɔ jio, ja Yawɛ fa mɛ. 21Be komɛ po bɔku ɔ hii lejɛ ɔ kɛ jeɔ gbɔkuɛ kɛ ya siɔ mɔtu; nɛ ke e wo e he nɔ pɛ a hia blɔ; piani jio, nyɔ mi jio, be tsuaa be nɛ bɔku ɔ ma wo e he nɔ ɔ, kɛkɛ a hia blɔ. 22Ke ligbi enyɔ, aloo nyɔhiɔ kake, aloo be nɛ kɛ pe ja po nɛ bɔku ɔ daa si ngɛ kpe he ɔ yi mi ɔ, Israel bi ɔmɛ hii sito he ɔ nɛ a hiɛ blɔ; ja bɔku ɔ wo e he nɔ loko a maa hia blɔ. 23Israel bi ɔmɛ buɔ Yawɛ tue. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke a maa to si jio, a maa hia nyɛɛmi jio, ja Yawɛ fa mɛ kɛ gu Mose nɔ.

Title: MOSE IV, 10
Content:
Sika hiɔ titimati ɔmɛ
1Yawɛ de Mose ke, 2“Ngɔɔ sika hiɔ nɛ a fia nɔ tɛtlɛɛ kɛ pee titimati enyɔ, konɛ ke a ma bua ma kpekpemi ɔ nya, aloo ke ma a maa hia blɔ ɔ, a kpa. 3Ke a kpa titimati enyɔ ɔmɛ tsuo ɔ, ma kpekpemi ɔ tsuo kɛ mo ma ba kpe ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ sinya a nya. 4Se ke a kpa kake pɛ lɛɛ Israel ma nimeli, nɛ ji wɛtsoyi ɔmɛ pɛ lɛ a kɛ mo ma ba kpe. 5Ke titimati ɔ pɛ, nɛ a he ose ɔ, ma a nɛ pueɔ si ngɛ beleku je ɔ maa hia. 6Ke titimati ɔ pɛ, nɛ a he ose si enyɔne ɔ, ma a nɛ ngɛ omleyi je ɔ maa hia. Be tsuaa be nɛ a maa hia blɔ ɔ, a kpa titimati ɔ, nɛ a he ose. 7Ke a ma bua ma kpekpemi ɔ nya a, lɛɛ a kpa titimati ɔ kɛkɛ, se a ko he ose. 8Aaron bimɛ ɔmɛ, nɛ ji osɔfo ɔmɛ ji ni nɛmɛ nɛ ma kpa titimati ɔmɛ.
“Mlaa nɛ maa fɔ si kɛ ha yi nɔhi tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ kɛ yaa neneene ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. 9Ke he nyɛli ba tua nyɛ ngɛ nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ zugba nɔ, nɛ e ba mi kaa nyɛ gba ta kɛ fa nyɛ he ɔ, nyɛ kpa titimati ɔmɛ, nɛ nyɛ he ose. Kɛkɛ ɔ, Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ ma kai nyɛ, nɛ e ma kpɔ nyɛ kɛ je nyɛ he nyɛli ɔmɛ a dɛ mi. 10Jehanɛ, ngɛ nyɛ nyami ligbihi, kɛ ligbi kpahi nɛ a to ɔ, kɛ Nyɔhiɔhe nyami be ɔmɛ hu nyɛ kpa titimati ɔmɛ be mi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ sami bɔ ɔmɛ, kɛ tue mi jɔmi bɔ ɔmɛ sãe. Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ma ha nɛ nyɛ Mawu ɔ ma kai nyɛ. Imi ji Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ nɛ.”
Israel bi ɔmɛ hia kɛ je Sinai
11Benɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ je Egipt ɔ se jeha nɛ ji enyɔ ɔ, nyɔhiɔ enyɔne ɔ we ligbi nɛ ji nyingmi enyɔ ɔ, bɔku ɔ wo e he nɔ kɛ je kpe he ɔ he nɛ mlaa womi ɔ ngɛ ɔ. 12Kɛkɛ nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ hia kɛ je Sinai nga a nɔ, nɛ a tsa a nyɛɛmi ɔ nɔ hluu kɛ ya si bɔku ɔ ya da si ngɛ Paran nga a nɔ.
13Benɛ Yawɛ fa mɛ kɛ gu Mose nɔ, nɛ a maa hia nyɛɛmi kekleekle ɔ, 14Yuda bi ɔmɛ kɛ a wɛtso aflaangaa a hia kekle tabo nya tabo nya. A nyatsɛ ji Aminadab bi Nashon. 15Zuar bi Netanel ji Isakar bi ɔmɛ a nyatsɛ. 16Zebulun bi ɔmɛ hu a nyatsɛ ji Helon bi Eliab.
17Kɛkɛ nɛ a gbɛ bo tsu ɔ; nɛ Gershon bi ɔmɛ, kɛ Merari bi ɔmɛ nɛ tloo bo tsu ɔ hia nyɛɛmi.
18Ruben bi ɔmɛ nyɛɛ a se tabo nya tabo nya kɛ a wɛtso aflaangaa. A nyatsɛ ji Shedeur bi Elizur. 19Zurishadai bi Shelumiel ji Simeon bi ɔmɛ a nyatsɛ. 20Deuel bi Eliasaf hu ji Gad bi ɔmɛ a nyatsɛ.
21Jehanɛ, Kohat bi ɔmɛ nɛ tloo ní klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ hu hia; nɛ benɛ a ke a suu sito he kpa a, a na kaa a kɛ bo tsu ɔ ma si ngɛ lejɛ ɔ momo.
22Efraim bi ɔmɛ nyɛɛ Kohat bi ɔmɛ a se tabo nya tabo nya kɛ a wɛtso aflaangaa. A nyatsɛ ji Amihud bi Elishama. 23Pedazur bi Gamaliel ji Manase bi ɔmɛ a nyatsɛ. 24Gideoni bi Abidan hu ji Benyamin bi ɔmɛ a nyatsɛ.
25Nyagbe ɔ, Dan bi ɔmɛ hia tabo nya tabo nya kɛ a wɛtso aflaangaa. Mɛ ji Israel ta a tsuo a se tabo, nɛ a nyatsɛ ji Amishadai bi Ahiezer. 26Okran bi Pagiel ji Asher bi ɔmɛ a nyatsɛ. 27Enan bi Ahira hu ji Naftali bi ɔmɛ a nyatsɛ. 28Ke Israel ma a maa hia blɔ ɔ, bɔ nɛ a plɛɔ kɛ nyɛɛɔ tabo nya tabo nya ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
29Kɛkɛ nɛ Mose de e ngatsɛ Yetro, Midian no ɔ bi Hobab ke, “Wa ngɛ hiae kɛ yaa he nɛ Yawɛ de to ke e ma ha wɔ ɔ. Yawɛ nitsɛ wo Israel ní kpakpahi a he si. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ha waa ho nɛ waa kɛ mo ya ye wa kplɔkɔtɔ ɔ.”
30Se Hobab de lɛ ke, “Dɛbi; i be yae; ma kpale kɛ ya imi nitsɛ ye ma mi, kɛ imi nitsɛ ye nyɛmimɛ a ngɔ mohu.”
31Mose ya nɔ nɛ e de lɛ ke, “I kpa mo pɛɛ, ko si wɔ. Mo lɛ o le nga a nɔ hehi nɛ hi nɛ wa maa to si ngɛ; mo ji nɔ nɛ maa tsɔɔ wɔ blɔ. 32Ke o kɛ wɔ ya a, nɔ́ kpakpa tsuaa nɔ́ kpakpa nɛ Yawɛ kɛ maa gbaa wɔ ɔ, waa kɛ mo maa dla.”
33Kɛkɛ nɛ ma a hia kɛ je Yawɛ yo ɔ he, nɛ a nyɛɛ ligbi etɛ. Yawɛ somi daka a nyɛɛ a hɛ mi kɛ hla sito he ha mɛ. 34Be tsuaa be nɛ a maa hia kɛ je a sito he ɔ, Yawɛ bɔku ɔ ma ba da a yi mi piani.
35 Be tsuaa be nɛ somi daka a maa hia a, Mose ma de ke,
“Yawɛ, tee si!
Gbɛɛ o he nyɛli ɔmɛ ngɔ fĩa;
nɛ o ha ni nɛmɛ nɛ sume mo ɔ
nɛ a tu fo ngɛ o hɛ mi!”
36Be tsuaa be nɛ somi daka a maa da si ɔ, e ma de ke,
“Yawɛ, kpale o se!
Kpale kɛ ba Israel bi akpeakpe abɔ ɔ a ngɔ!”

Title: MOSE IV, 11
Content:
Tabera
1Ma a tu munyu huitihuiti ngɛ a haomihi a he. Benɛ Yawɛ nu ɔ, e mi mi fu, nɛ e ha la tso ngɛ ni ɔmɛ a kpɛti; nɛ la a kpata níhi a hɛ mi ngɛ a sito he ɔ kasa fa kake. 2Ma a kpa ngmlaa kɛ tsɛ Mose, nɛ Mose hu kpa Yawɛ pɛɛ; kɛkɛ nɛ la a gbo. 3Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, a wo lejɛ ɔ biɛ ke Tabera, nɛ a de ke, “Wa wo kikɛmɛ a biɛ nɛ ɔ, ejakaa Yawɛ la sã ní ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.”
Mose hla nikɔtɔmahi nyingmi kpaago
4E ba mi kaa de lo ba bɔni futufututsɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ a kpɛti ɔ jlomi. Israel bi ɔmɛ nitsɛ hu wo yana ekohu nɛ a bi ke, “Ao, wa be de lo nae maa ye lo? 5Nyɛɛ hyɛ bɔ nɛ lo pueɔ si ngɛ Egipt nɛ a pee we he nɔ́ ko, nɛ wa yeɔ bɔ nɛ wa suɔ. Nyɛɛ hyɛ jamatlɛ ɔmɛ, atlɛ ɔmɛ, pui ɔ, kɛ sabola amɛ! 6Se jehanɛ lɛɛ wa he wami nɔ gbɔ, nɛ wa na we nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko kulaa kaa ja mana nɛ ɔ kɛkɛ.”
7 Mana ngɛ kaa nya mi saalɔ, nɛ e su ngɛ kaa hlɔɔba nyu nɛ je tso he toto mi pue si. 8Ke ni ɔmɛ ya bua mana nya kikɛ nɛ ɔ, a wɛɛɔ ngɛ wɛ nɔ, aloo a gbeeɔ ngɛ fufui tso mi. Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, a hooɔ ngɛ buɛ mi, nɛ a kɛ peeɔ keeki; e ngɔɔ kaa keeki nɛ a ngɔ nu kɛ sã. 9 Ke bɔ́ nɛ ngɛ sito he ɔ nyɔ mi kɛkɛ mana a hu pue si.
10Mose nu nɛ ma a tsuo wo yana ngɛ a we puɔ nya ngɛ a bo tsu sinya amɛ a nya. Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ mi mi fu wawɛɛ nitsɛ, nɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ngɔɛ Mose nya kulaa. 11Mose bi Yawɛ ke, “Mɛni he je nɛ o ye imi, o tsɔlɔ sane yayami kikɛ nɛ ɔ? Mɛni he je nɛ o ná ye he abofu, nɛ o ngɔ ma nɛ ɔ tsuo yi tlomi ngɔ tloo mi ɔ? 12Imi lɛ i ngɔ nimli nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a hɔ? Imi lɛ i fɔ mɛ, loko o deɔ mi ke ma hɛɛ mɛ ngɛ ye mi si kaa bimɛanyɛ hɛɛɔ bimwɔyo, kɛ ya zugba nɛ o ka kita ke o maa ngɔ kɛ ha a tsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ? 13Jije ma ná de lo ngɛ kɛ ha ma nɛ ɔ tsuo? Ejakaa a wo yana kɛ wo mi, nɛ a ngɛ mi dee ke ma ha mɛ de lo nɛ a ye. 14Imi nɔ kake too pɛ i be nyɛe ma hɛɛ ma nɛ ɔ; tlomi ɔ jiɔ tsɔ ha mi. 15Ke kikɛ nɛ ɔ o kɛ mi maa ye ɔ, lɛɛ ke o ngɛ ye he suɔmi ɔ, gbee mi amlɔ mohu, konɛ ma ko na nɔ́ kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ ngɛ o dɛ mi ekohu.”
16Yawɛ de Mose ke, “Yaa nɛ o ya hla nikɔtɔmahi nɛ bu ngɛ a he nyingmi kpaago kɛ je Israel bi ɔmɛ a kpɛti. A pee nikɔtɔmahi nɛ mo nitsɛ o le kaa a hɛɛ blɔ nya ngɛ ma a mi. Ngɔɔ mɛ kɛ ba ye ngɔ ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ mi, nɛ a ba da si ngɛ o kasa nya ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. 17Ma kple si, nɛ i kɛ mo ma ba tu munyu ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Ma je mumi nɛ ngɛ o mi ɔ eko kɛ ha mɛ. A maa kpee mo kɛ tloo ma a tlomi ɔ, nɛ mo nɔ kake too pɛ o be tlooe hu. 18Jehanɛ, mo de ma a ke, ‘Nyɛɛ tsukɔ nyɛ he kɛ ha hwɔɔ; ejakaa nyɛ maa ye de lo. Benɛ de lo jlo nyɛ, nɛ nyɛ fo he ya, nɛ nyɛ de ke nyɛ he mi jɔ nyɛ ngɛ Egipt zugba a nɔ mohu ɔ, Yawɛ nu. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yawɛ ma ha nyɛ de lo nɛ nyɛɛ ye. 19Pi ligbi kake, loo ligbi enyɔ, loo ligbi enuɔ, loo ligbi nyɔngma, loo ligbi nyingmi enyɔ kɛkɛ nɛ nyɛ maa ye. 20Se mohu, nyɛ maa ye de lo nyɔhiɔ mluku kɛ yaa si be nɛ e maa je kpo ngɛ nyɛ gugwɔ puɔ mi, nɛ e maa gbe nyɛ nya. Ejakaa nyɛ kua Yawɛ nɛ ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti ngɛ hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ, nɛ nyɛ wo yana nɛ nyɛ bi ke mɛni he je nɛ a ha nyɛ je Egipt mɔ?’ ”
21Mose de Yawɛ ke, “Ma a nɛ i hɛɛ ɔ, a kpɛti nyumuhi kɛkɛ a hiɛmi ji akpe lafa ekpa. Nɛ o deɔ ke o ma ha mɛ de lo nɛ a ye nyɔhiɔ mluku! 22Anɛ a ma na tohi kɛ nahi maa gbe nɛ maa su mɛ? Aloo ke a bua wo mi lohi tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ a nya a, e maa su mɛ?”
23Yawɛ bi Mose ke, “Anɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ pe Yawɛ, nɛ e be nyɛe maa pee lo? Si nɛ i wo ɔ, e maa ba mi jio, e be mi bae jio, o maa na piɔ.”
24Mose je kpo, nɛ e ya bɔ ma a nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ de lɛ ɔ. E ya bua ma nimeli nyingmi kpaago a nya, nɛ e ngɔ mɛ ba da si kɛ bɔle bo tsu ɔ. 25Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ kple si kɛ je bɔku mi kɛ ba, nɛ e kɛ Mose ba tu munyu. E je mumi nɛ ngɛ Mose mi ɔ eko kɛ ha ma nimeli nyingmi kpaago ɔmɛ. Benɛ mumi ɔ ba a nɔ ɔ, a bɔni ngmlaa kpami kaa gbali; se nɔ́ nɛ ɔ se kɛ we.
26Ma nimeli nyingmi kpaago ɔmɛ nɛ a ngma a biɛ ɔ, a ti ni enyɔ tlɔ sito he ɔ, nɛ mɛɛ a na we nɛ a ya bo tsu ɔ mi. Nɔ kake biɛ ji Eldad, nɛ nɔ kake hu biɛ ji Medad. Benɛ a ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, mumi ɔ ba a nɔ, nɛ mɛ hu a bɔni ngmlaa kpami kaa gbali. 27Kɛkɛ nɛ niheyo ko gbɔ fo ya de Mose ke, “Eldad kɛ Medad ngɛ gbae ngɛ sito he ɔ.”
28Kɛkɛ nɛ Nun binyumu Yoshua, nɛ ji Mose sɔmɔlɔ kɛ je e nihe mi ɔ tu munyu nɛ e de ke, “Ye nyɔmtsɛ Mose, ha nɛ a kpa nɔ́ nɛ a ngɛ pee ɔ!”
29Se Mose he nɔ ke, “Imi lɛ o ngɛ hunga jee ha nɛ ɔ? I na jinɛ Yawɛ ngɔ e mumi ɔ ngɔ ha e ma a tsuo, nɛ mɛ tsuo a kpa ngmlaa kaa gbali!” 30Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Mose kɛ Israel ma nimeli nyingmi kpaago ɔmɛ tsuo kpale a se kɛ ho sito he ɔ ya.
Bebeehi
31Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ ha kɔɔhiɔ fia, nɛ kɔɔhiɔ nɛ ɔ muɔ bebeehi kɛ je wo ɔ mi ba pue si maa pee ligbi kake blɔ nyɛɛmi kɛ bɔle sito he ɔ tsuo kɛ kpe. Bebee ɔmɛ te kɛ mimla sito he ɔ haa maa pee kaa nine mi blimi eywiɛ kɛ je zugba. 32Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ tsuo, piani, nyɔ mi, kɛ jena nɔ ɔ, ma a tsuo ho nɛ a ya bua bebeehi a nya; nɔ nɛ na we pe kulaa po na kilo akpe. A ka bebee ɔmɛ tsɛtsɛ kɛ bɔle sito he ɔ kɛ kpe. 33Benɛ a ngɛ lo ɔ yee, nɛ e na we nɛ e ta a, Yawɛ mi mi fu ma a, nɛ e ha gbenɔ hiɔ ba sɛ a kpɛti. 34Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, a wo lejɛ ɔ biɛ ke, “Jiklɔɔtsɛmɛ a Yɔkɔhi.” Ejakaa nihi nɛ pee de lo he jiklɔɔ ɔ, lejɛ ɔ a pu mɛ ngɛ.
35Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, ma a hia kɛ je lejɛ ɔ kɛ ho Hazerot ya, nɛ a ya to si ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.

Title: MOSE IV, 12
Content:
A gbla Miriam tue
1Mose ya ngɔ Kush yo ko, nɛ Miriam kɛ Aaron tu munyu kɛ si Mose ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ he. 2A bi ke, “Anɛ Mose nɔ kake too nɔ Yawɛ gu kɛ tu munyu lo? Anɛ wɔɔ lɛɛ e gui wa nɔ kɛ tu we munyu lo?” Yawɛ nu nɔ́ nɛ a de ɔ. 3Mose nɛ ɔ, nɔmlɔ nɛ he jɔ ji lɛ; niinɛ e he jɔ pe nimli adesahi tsuo nɛ a ngɛ zugba a nɔ ɔ.
4Tlukaa a, Yawɛ de Mose, Miriam, kɛ Aaron ke, “Nyɛ ni etɛ ɔmɛ tsuo nyɛɛ ba kpe he bo tsu ɔ mi.” A ho, 5nɛ Yawɛ kple si ngɛ bɔku titima ko mi ba da bo tsu sinya a nya. E tsɛ Aaron kɛ Miriam, nɛ a je kpo kɛ ba. 6Yawɛ de mɛ ke, “Jehanɛ, nyɛɛ bu mi tue! Ke gbalɔ ko ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti ɔ, ní nami mi nɛ imi Yawɛ, i jeɔ ye he si kɛ tsɔɔ lɛ ngɛ. Nlami mi nɛ i kɛ lɛ tuɔ munyu ngɛ. 7 Ye tsɔlɔ Mose lɛɛ e slo lɛ! Lɛɛ i ngɔ lɛ ngɔ to ye ma Israel tsuo nya. 8Lɛɛ i kɛ lɛ tuɔ munyu hɛ mi kɛ hɛ mi paa; se pi ngɛ abɛ gbi mi. Ye su nitsɛ po lɛɛ e na hyɛ. Mɛni he je mɔ nɛ nyɛ yi gbeye, nɛ nyɛ tu munyu kɛ si ye tsɔlɔ Mose?” 9Yawɛ mi mi fu mɛ wawɛɛ nitsɛ. Nɛ benɛ e si mɛ, 10nɛ bɔku ɔ je bo tsu ɔ yi mi ɔ, he womi nɔ hiɔ yaya pue Miriam he, nɛ e pee sakoo kaa snoo. Benɛ Aaron plɛ hyɛ Miriam nɛ e na kaa he womi nɔ hiɔ yaya lɛ ngɛ e he ɔ, 11e de Mose ke, “Ye nyɔmtsɛ, i kpa mo pɛɛ, koo gbla wa tue ngɛ kuasia nɛ wa je, kɛ yayami nɛ wa pee nɛ ɔ he. 12Ko ha nɛ Miriam nɛ pee kaa nɔ ko nɛ gbo ngɛ e nyɛ muklii mi, nɛ benɛ a fɔ lɛ ɔ, e he womi ɔ fa pɔtɔ momo.”
13Mose kpa ngmlaa kɛ tsɛ Yawɛ, nɛ e de ke, “Mawu lee, i kpa mo pɛɛ nɛ o tsa lɛ!”
14 Se Yawɛ de Mose ke, “Ke Miriam tsɛ su lada pue e hɛ mi ɔ, anɛ e kɛ zo be e he lae ligbi kpaago lo? A je lɛ kɛ je sito he ɔ, nɛ a ya tsi e nya ligbi kpaago loko a ngɔ lɛ kɛ ba ekohu.” 15Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a je Miriam kɛ je sito he ɔ, nɛ a ya tsi e nya otsi. Ma a hiɛ blɔ kɛ ya si a kpale ngɔ lɛ kɛ ba ekohu. 16Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, ma a hia kɛ je Hazerot, nɛ a ya to si ngɛ Paran nga a nɔ.

Title: MOSE IV, 13
Content:
Slaali nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ
(Mose V, 1.19-33)
1Yawɛ de Mose ke, 2“Moo hla nyumu nɔkɔtɔma kake kɛ je wɛtso tsuaa wɛtso mi, nɛ o tsɔ mɛ nɛ a ya slaa Kanaan zugba a nɛ i ngɔ kɛ ngɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ hae ɔ.” 3-15Mose tsɔ Israel ma nimeli ɔmɛ kɛ je Paran nga a nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa lɛ ɔ. A biɛhi, kɛ wɛtsohi nɛ a je mi ɔ ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ:
WƐTSO WƐTSO NƆKƆTƆMA
Ruben Shamua, Zakur bi ɔ
Simeon Shafat, Hori bi ɔ
Yuda Kaleb, Yefune bi ɔ
Isakar Igal, Yosef bi ɔ
Efraim Hoshea, Nun bi ɔ
Benyamin Palti, Rafu bi ɔ
Zebulun Gadiel, Sodi bi ɔ
Manase Gadi, Susi bi ɔ
Dan Amiel, Gemali bi ɔ
Asher Setur, Mikael bi ɔ
Naftali Nabi, Vofsi bi ɔ
Gad Geuel, Maki bi ɔ.
16Nyumuhi nɛ Mose tsɔ ke a ya slaa zugba a, a biɛhi ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ. Se Nun bi Hoshea lɛɛ Mose tsake e biɛ kɛ pee Yoshua.
17Benɛ Mose tsɔ mɛ ke a ya slaa Kanaan zugba a, e de mɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ gu omleyi je kɛ ya kuɔ yoku ɔmɛ. 18Nyɛɛ hyɛ bɔ nɛ zugba a ngɛ ha, kɛ nimli nɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ ɔ, kaa nimli ɔmɛ a he wa, loo a he wɛ, kaa a hiɛ, loo a he pi. 19Zugba a nɛ ni ɔmɛ ngɛ nɔ ɔ, nyɛɛ hyɛ kaa e hi, loo e hí. Nyɛɛ hyɛ kaa mahi nɛ a ngɛ mi ɔ, ma tsɔwitsɔwihi, loo mahi nɛ a fia gbogbo kɛ wo a he. 20Nyɛɛ hyɛ kaa zugba a baa ní, loo e bɛ ní, kaa tsohi ngɛ nɔ, loo tsohi be nɔ. Nyɛɛ bɔ mɔde nɛ nyɛɛ ngɔ zugba a nɔ tso yiblii komɛ kɛ ba.” Jamɛ a be ɔ ji kekleekle wai yiblii fumi be.
21Nyumu ɔmɛ pue nɔ kɛ ho, nɛ a ya slaa zugba a, kɛ je Zin nga a nɔ kɛ ya si Rehob, he nɛ a guu kɛ yaa Hamat ɔ. 22A nyɛɛ kɛ gu leneyi je hluu kɛ ya si Hebron. Lejɛ ɔ ji Ahiman, Sheshai, kɛ Talmai nɛ ji Anak bi ɔmɛ a hi he. (A po Hebron ma a jeha kpaago loko a po Zoan ngɛ Egipt). 23Benɛ a su Eskol kɔ̃ ɔ mi ɔ, a po wai tso kɔni kake kɛ e nɔ wai yiblii sau kake ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, nɛ a kpɛti ni enyɔ wo lɛ tso nɛ a kpla ngɛ a konɔ. A kɛ tso yiblii ko kaa akutu kɛ ngmɔkɔ hu ba. 24Nɛ a wo lejɛ ɔ biɛ ke Eskol kɔ̃, ngɛ wai yiblii sau ɔ nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ po ngɛ lejɛ ɔ he.
25A slaa zugba a ligbi nyingmi eywiɛ, nɛ lɔ ɔ se ɔ, a kpale a se 26kɛ ba na Mose, kɛ Aaron, kɛ Israel ma kpekpemi ɔ tsuo ngɛ Paran nga a nɔ, ngɛ Kadesh. A gba mɛ nɔ́ nɛ a ya na ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, nɛ a ngɔ zugba a nɔ tso yiblii komɛ hu ba tsɔɔ mɛ. 27A de Mose ke, “Wa ya slaa zugba a nɛ o tsɔ wɔ e nɔ ɔ; niinɛ, wa na kaa e ji zugba kpakpa nɛ baa ní. Zugba a nɔ tso yiblii komɛ po ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ. 28Se mohu, nimli nɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ ɔ kɛkɛ lɛ a he wa. A ma amɛ hu kle agboagbo nitsɛ, nɛ a fia gbogbo ngɔ wo a he. Enɛ ɔmɛ a se ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ wo wa he gbeye pe kulaa ji oblai komɛ nɛ wa na ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. 29Amalek bi ngɛ zugba a leneyi je; Hit bi, Yebus bi, kɛ Amor bi ngɛ yoku ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ Kanaan bi ngɛ wo ɔ nya, kɛ Yordan pa a he.”
30Kɛkɛ nɛ Kaleb kuɛ wo ma a ngɛ Mose hɛ mi, nɛ e de mɛ ke, “Nyɛ ha waa ya esɔesɔ nɛ wa ya ngɔ zugba a; ejakaa wa ma nyɛ ngɔ faa.”
31Se nyumu ɔmɛ nɛ kɛ lɛ ya slaa zugba a de ke, “Wa be nyɛe maa da nimli ɔmɛ a hɛ mi, ejakaa a he wa pe wɔ.” 32Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a gba Israel bi ɔmɛ zugba a nɛ a ya slaa a he sane yaya, nɛ a de ke, “Zugba a nɛ wa ya slaa a, e ji zugba nɛ ngɛ lɛ nitsɛ e nɔ bi a yi tanee, ejakaa zugba a hí. Jehanɛ, nimli nɛ wa ya na ngɛ zugba a nɔ ɔ hu, nyumu oblaihi sɔuu ji mɛ. 33 Benɛ wa na oblai agboagbo ɔmɛ, nɛ ji Anak bi ɔmɛ, nɛ wa ngɔ wa he ngɔ to a he ɔ, wa pee tsɔwitsɔwi kaa adodohi; nɛ jã kɛ̃ wa ngɛ ngɛ mɛ hu a hɛ mi.”

Title: MOSE IV, 14
Content:
Ma a tu munyu huitihuiti
1Jamɛ a nyɔ ɔ mi ɔ, ma a tsuo wo yana, nɛ a kɛ aywilɛho kpa huhui. 2Israel ma mluku ɔ tsuo hɔɔ nya si ngɔ wo Mose kɛ Aaron a he, nɛ a de ke, “Wa ná nɛ jinɛ wa gbo ngɛ Egipt zugba a nɔ, loo ngɛ nga nɛ ɔ nɔ po! 3Mɛni he je Yawɛ kpaka wɔ kɛ yaa zugba nɛ ɔ nɔ, nɛ wa ya gbo ngɛ klaate nya, nɛ a ngɔ wa yihi, kɛ wa bimɛ nyɔguɛ ɔ? Anɛ e be hie mohu kaa waa kpale wa se kɛ ho Egipt ya lo?” 4Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a de a he ke, “Nyɛ ha waa hla wa nyatsɛ nɛ waa kpale kɛ ho Egipt ya.”
5Kɛkɛ nɛ Mose kɛ Aaron ngɔ a hɛ mi ngɔ bu si ngɛ Israel ma mluku ɔ tsuo a hɛ mi. 6Nun bi Yoshua, kɛ Yefune bi Kaleb, nɛ ji slaali ɔmɛ a ti nihi enyɔ hía a he tadehi, 7nɛ a de Israel ma mluku ɔ tsuo ke, “Zugba a nɛ wa ya kpa nɔ nɛ wa slaa lɛ ɔ, e ji zugba nɛ hi saminya. 8Ke Yawɛ ngɛ wa he tsui ɔ, e ma kpaka wɔ kɛ ya lejɛ ɔ; nɛ e maa ngɔ zugba nɛ hi, nɛ baa ní nɛ ɔ ngɔ ha wɔ. 9 Se, nyɛ ko tsɔ Yawɛ hɛ mi atuã. Nimli nɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ hu, nyɛ ko ye mɛ gbeye; wa maa ye a nɔ kunimi hɛngmɛfia. A he wami nya ba si, se wɔɔ lɛɛ Yawɛ kɛ wɔ ngɛ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ ko ye mɛ gbeye.” 10Kɛkɛ nɛ ma mluku ɔ tsuo de ke a fia mɛ tɛ. Se tlukaa a, Yawɛ hɛ mi nyami ɔ ba je e he kpo kɛ tsɔɔ Israel ma a tsuo ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ he.
Mose fa kue ha ma a
11Yawɛ bi Mose ke, “Kɛ yaa si mɛni be ma nɛ ɔ ma kua mi? Kɛ yaa si mɛni be loko a ma he mi maa ye ngɛ okadihi babauu nɛ i pee ngɛ a kpɛti ɔ he? 12Ma ngɔ gbenɔ hiɔ kɛ fɔ a nɔ, nɛ ma kpata a hɛ mi. Se moo lɛɛ ma pee mo ma nguaa; ma nɛ kle pe mɛ, nɛ he wa pe mɛ hulɔ.”
13 Se Mose de Yawɛ ke, “O ngɔ o kɔni si wami kɛ je ma nɛ ɔ kɛ je Egipt. Ke Egipt bi ɔmɛ nu nɔ́ nɛ o pee o ma a, 14a maa sɛɛ ha zugba nɛ ɔ nɔ bi. Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ nu momo kaa mo Yawɛ, o ngɛ wa kpɛti. Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ nu momo kaa mo Yawɛ, o bɔku ɔ ba daa si ngɛ wa yi mi, nɛ a naa mo paa hɛ mi kɛ hɛ mi. A nu momo kaa piani ɔ, o nyɛɛɔ wa hɛ mi ngɛ bɔku titima mi, nɛ nyɔ mi lɛɛ o nyɛɛɔ wa hɛ mi ngɛ la titima mi. 15Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke o gbe o ma nɛ ɔ tsuo ɔ, je ma amɛ nɛ nu o biɛ ɔ he ɔ ma de ke, 16‘Yawɛ kpata ma nɛ ɔ hɛ mi ngɛ nga a nɔ, ejakaa e nyɛ we nɛ e kpaka mɛ kɛ ya su zugba a nɛ e wo si ke e maa ngɔ kɛ ha mɛ ɔ nɔ.’ 17Enɛ ɔ he ɔ, i kpa mo pɛɛ, Yawɛ, mo je o he wami kpo kɛ tsɔɔ wɔ, nɛ o ye o si womi ɔ nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ o de wɔ ɔ ke 18 ‘Imi, Yawɛ, ye mi mi fu we mla, nɛ ye mɔbɔ nami hiɛ babauu; i ngɔɔ tɔmi kɛ yayami ngɔ paa. Se kɛ̃, i ha we nɛ yayami peeli yeɔ a he; mohu i kɛ tsɛmɛ a tɔmihi a he hiɔwo ɔ gblaa bimɛ kɛ bibimɛ a tue hluu kɛ ya siɔ yi nɔ etɛne, kɛ eywiɛne bi a nɔ.’ 19I kpa mo pɛɛ, ngɔɔ ma nɛ ɔ he yayami ɔmɛ kɛ pa mɛ ngɛ o mɔbɔ nami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ nya, kaa bɔ nɛ o ngɔ a he yayami ɔmɛ kɛ pa mɛ kɛ je Egipt hluu kɛ ba si amlɔ nɛ ɔ.”
20Yawɛ he nɔ nɛ e de ke, “I ngɔ kɛ pa mɛ kaa bɔ nɛ o bi ɔ. 21 Se anɔkuale, ligbi abɔ nɛ ye hɛ ngɛ, nɛ imi Yawɛ, ye hɛ mi nyami ma hyi zugba a tsuo tɔ ɔ, 22nihi tsuo nɛ na ye hɛ mi nyami, kɛ okadihi nɛ i pee ngɛ Egipt kɛ nga a nɔ, se kɛ̃ a ka mi si nyɔngma sɔuu, nɛ a bui ye gbi tue ɔ, 23nimli nɛ ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake po be zugba a nɛ i ka kita ke ma ha a nɛmɛ ɔmɛ ɔ nae. Ni nɛmɛ nɛ kua mi ɔ, a ti nɔ ko nɔ ko be zugba a nae. 24 Se ye tsɔlɔ Kaleb lɛɛ slo e mumi; lɛɛ e bu mi tue kɛ ya si nyagbe. Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, i kɛ lɛ maa su zugba a nɛ a ya slaa a nɔ, nɛ e se bimɛ a nine maa su nɔ. 25Se amlɔ nɛ ɔ, akɛnɛ Amalek bi ɔmɛ, kɛ Kanaan bi ɔmɛ ngɛ kɔ̃ ɔmɛ a mi he je ɔ, hwɔɔ ɔ, nyɛɛ kpale nyɛ se kɛ ya gu blɔ nɛ ngɛ Wo Tsu ɔ he ɔ kɛ ya nga a nɔ.”
Yawɛ gbla ma a tue
26Yawɛ de Mose kɛ Aaron ke, 27“Mɛni be ma yiwutsotsɛmɛ nɛ ɔmɛ maa hɔɔ nya si kɛ wo mi kɛ yaa si? Munyu huitihuiti nɛ Israel ma a ngɛ tue kɛ ngɛ mi sie ɔ, i nu. 28Nyɛ de mɛ ke imi Yawɛ, i ke, ‘Ligbi abɔ nɛ ye hɛ ngɛ nɛ ɔ, ma pee ha nyɛ kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ bi ɔ. 29 Nyɛ ma gbo pue si ngɛ nga nɛ ɔ nɔ. Nihi tsuo nɛ a ye kɛ je jeha nyingmi enyɔ kɛ yaa, nɛ a ngma a biɛ, nɛ a hɔɔ nya si kɛ wo mi ɔ, 30a ti nɔ kake be zugba a nɛ i ka kita ke i kɛ ma ha nyɛ nɛ nyɛɛ hi nɔ ɔ nae, ja Yefune bi Kaleb, kɛ Nun bi Yoshua pɛ. 31Nyɛ bi tsɔwitsɔwi ɔmɛ nɛ nyɛ de ke a maa ngɔ mɛ nyɔguɛ ɔ, i kɛ mɛ maa su zugba a nɛ nyɛ kua a nɔ, nɛ e maa pee a nɔ. 32Se nyɛ lɛɛ nyɛ ma gbo tlɔ nga nɛ ɔ nɔ. 33 Nyɛ bimɛ maa wo lalaalo ngɛ nga a nɔ jeha nyingmi eywiɛ, nɛ a maa na nɔ́ ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi nɛ nyɛ be ɔ he, kɛ yaa si be nɛ nyɛ nyagbe nɔ ɔ ma gbo fɔ si ngɛ nga a nɔ. 34Nyɛ slaa zugba a ligbi nyingmi eywiɛ, se nyɛ ma na nyɛ yayami ɔmɛ a he tue gblami jeha nyingmi eywiɛ; ligbi kake ma plɛ pee jeha ha nyɛ. Nɛ nyɛ maa na kaa i je nyɛ se. 35I ngɛ kita kae kaa nyɛ nimli kpekpemi yiwutsotsɛmɛ nɛ nyɛ tsɔ atuã wo mi ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ ma pee nyɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. Nyɛ tsuo nyɛ ma gbo tlɔ nga a nɔ ngɛ hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ. Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de.’ ”
36Nyumu ɔmɛ nɛ Mose tsɔ ya slaa zugba a, nɛ a ba gba Israel ma kpekpemi ɔ zugba a he sane yayami, nɛ lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ma a hɔɔ nya si kɛ wo Mose ɔ, 37Yawɛ ha gbenɔ hiɔ ba fia mɛ nɛ a gbo. 38Nyumu ɔmɛ nɛ ya slaa zugba a, Nun bi Yoshua, kɛ Yefune bi Kaleb pɛ ji ni nɛmɛ nɛ a yi na wami.
A ka zugba a ngɔmi
(Mose V, 1.41-46)
39Benɛ Mose ya bɔ Israel bi ɔmɛ tsuo sane nɛ ɔ, a ye kɔmɔ wawɛɛ nitsɛ. 40A te si mɔtu kpla, nɛ a kuɔ yoku ɔ kɛ ho e yi mi ya tɔɔ, nɛ a de ke “Jehanɛ wa dla wa he; wa maa ya he nɛ Yawɛ wo wɔ si ɔ. Kpaako wa na kaa wa pee yayami.”
41Se Mose de ke, “Mɛni he je nyɛ pa ngɛ Yawɛ fami ɔ nɔ tue gboe ɔ? Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ be hie. 42Nyɛ ko ya, ejakaa Yawɛ be nyɛ se. Ke nyɛ ya a, nyɛ he nyɛli ɔmɛ maa fia nyɛ ní kɛ pue si. 43Ke nyɛɛ kɛ Amalek bi ɔmɛ, kɛ Kanaan bi ɔmɛ ya bua a, nyɛ maa nɔ ngɛ klaate nya. Yawɛ be nyɛ he piɛe, ejakaa nyɛ kua lɛ.”
44Se kɛ̃ ɔ, a si a gugue, nɛ a kuɔ yoku ɔ kɛ ho e yi mi ya, be mi nɛ Yawɛ somi daka a, kɛ Mose na we nɛ a je sito he ɔ. 45Kɛkɛ nɛ Amalek bi, kɛ Kanaan bi nɛ ngɛ jamɛ a yoku ɔ nɔ ɔ ba tua mɛ, nɛ a ye a nɔ; nɛ a fie mɛ kɛ ya si Horma tɔɔ.

Title: MOSE IV, 15
Content:
Bɔ sami he mlaahi
1Yawɛ de Mose ke, 2“De Israel bi ɔmɛ ke, ke nyɛ ya su zugba a nɛ i ngɔ kɛ ngɛ nyɛ hae nɛ nyɛɛ hi nɔ ɔ nɔ, 3nɛ nyɛ suɔ kaa nyɛɛ kɛ na, loo to maa sã bɔ nɛ je via ha mi ɔ, sami bɔ jio, si womi nɔ yemi bɔ jio, bɔ nɛ je nyɛ tsui mi faa jio, aloo bɔ nɛ a sãã ngɛ ligbi nguahi nɛ a to ɔ eko nɔ jio, 4-5nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ma ba sã kikɛmɛ a bɔ ha Yawɛ ɔ, e ngɔ niye ní bɔ ngɔ piɛ he. Lɔ ɔ ji ngma mamu bukɔbukɔ kilo kake nɛ a futu lɛ kɛ nu lita kake. 6Se ke agbosu lɛ nyɛɛ kɛ ba sã bɔ ɔ, lɛɛ nyɛɛ ngɔ ngma mamu bukɔbukɔ kilo enyɔ nɛ a futu lɛ kɛ nu lita kake kɛ fa kɛ pee niye ní bɔ, 7nɛ nyɛɛ ngɔ wai lita kake kɛ fa ngɔ piɛ he kɛ sã bɔ ɔ, konɛ e je via kɛ ha Yawɛ. 8Ke nyɛɛ kɛ na ku ma sami bɔ, loo si womi nɔ yemi bɔ, loo tue mi jɔmi bɔ sami ha Yawɛ ɔ, 9niye ní bɔ nɛ á kɛ piɛ na ku ɔ he kɛ ba ji, ngma mamu bukɔbukɔ kilo etɛ nɛ a futu lɛ kɛ nu lita enyɔ, 10kɛ wai lita enyɔ. Enɛ ɔ ji bɔ nɛ a kɛ la sãã, nɛ jeɔ via kɛ haa Yawɛ.
11“Be tsuaa be nɛ nyɛ maa ngɔ na ku, aloo agbosu, aloo jijɔ bi, aloo apletsi bi kɛ ba sã bɔ ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ kɛ piɛ he ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. 12Ke lohwe ɔ hiɛ pe kake ɔ, bɔ ɔ nɛ maa piɛ he ɔ, lɔ ɔ hu e hiɛ ja nɔuu. 13Israel no tsuaa Israel no nɛ pee nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, ke e kɛ e niye ní bɔ ɔ ba; e ji bɔ nɛ jeɔ via kɛ haa Yawɛ. 14Ke nubwɔ ko ba to nyɛ be kuku, aloo ke e ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti daa, nɛ e suɔ kaa e maa ngɔ niye ní bɔ nɛ jeɔ via haa Yawɛ kɛ ba a, lɛ hu e pee kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ peeɔ ɔ nɔuu. 15Mlaa kake too maa pee mlaa ha ma a, kɛ nibwɔhi nɛ ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti ɔ kɛ yaa neneene. Ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi ɔ, 16 nyɛɛ kɛ nibwɔ ɔmɛ tsuo maa ye mlaa kake, kɛ blɔ nya tomi kake nɔ.”
17Yawɛ de Mose ke, 18“De Israel bi ɔmɛ ke, ke nyɛ ya su zugba a nɛ i kɛ nyɛ yaa nɔ ɔ nɔ, 19nɛ nyɛ bɔni zugba a nɔ ní yemi ɔ, nyɛɛ ngɔ eko ba ha Yawɛ kaa nyɛ nike ní klɛdɛɛ. 20Nyɛɛ ngɔ nyɛ kekleekle ma a kɛ sã abolo, nɛ nyɛɛ ngɔ kɛ ba Yawɛ hɛ mi kaa nike ní klɛdɛɛ. Bɔ nɛ nyɛ ngɔɔ blɛfo he nɛ nyɛ kpɔ ba haa Yawɛ kaa nike ní klɛdɛɛ ɔ, ja nɔuu nyɛɛ pee enɛ ɔ hulɔ. 21Ngɛ nyɛ yi nɔhi tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ ɔ, nyɛ maa ngɔ nyɛ kekleekle ma nɛ ɔ mi eko kɛ ba ha Yawɛ kaa nyɛ nike ní klɛdɛɛ.
22“Alini mlaa amɛ tsuo nɛ Yawɛ ngɔ kɛ ha Mose ɔ, nyɛ ma ya tɔ ekomɛ a nɔ. 23Alini mlaa amɛ tsuo nɛ Yawɛ wo nyɛ kɛ gu Mose nɔ ɔ, yi nɔhi nɛ maa ba ngɛ nyɛ se ɔ be mlaa amɛ a nɔ yee. 24Ke e ba mi kaa ma mluku nɛ ɔ li a he be nɛ a ya tɔ ɔ, lɛɛ ma a tsuo maa ngɔ na niheyo kake kɛ ba sã sami bɔ nɛ jee via ha Yawɛ. A ngɔ niye ní bɔ, kɛ dã nɛ a kɛ maa sã bɔ ɔ ngɔ piɛ he kaa bɔ nɛ kusumi ɔ ngɛ ɔ. Jehanɛ, a kɛ akpakpo kake hu ba sã yayami pami bɔ. 25Osɔfo ɔ maa da Israel ma kpekpemi ɔ tsuo nane mi, nɛ e maa pee kusumi kɛ kpata Yawɛ. A maa ngɔ a he yayami ɔmɛ ngɔ pa mɛ; ejakaa a li nɛ a pee. Enɛ ɔ he hu lɛ a ngɔ yayami pami bɔ ɔ, kɛ niye ní bɔ ɔ kɛ ba ha Yawɛ kaa a li nɛ a pee. 26A kɛ Israel ma mluku ɔ tsuo, kɛ nibwɔhi nɛ ba to mɛ ɔ a he yayamihi maa pa mɛ; ejakaa mɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ a tɔ.
27 “Ke nɔ kake ko li be nɛ e ya tɔ ɔ, e ngɔ apletsi yo kake nɛ ye jeha kake kɛ ba sã yayami pami bɔ. 28Osɔfo ɔ maa pee kusumi kɛ kpata Yawɛ ha lɛ; nɛ a kɛ e he yayami ɔ maa pa lɛ. 29Mlaa kake ɔ nɔuu ngɛ kɛ ha nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ li e he be nɛ e ya pee yayami ko, Israel fɔmi bi jio, nɔ kpa ko nɛ ba to nyɛ nubwɔ jio.
30“Se ke nɔ ko je blɔ pee yayami ko ɔ, zugba a nɔ fɔmi bi ji lɛ jio, nubwɔ ji lɛ jio, nɔ ɔ bɔ Yawɛ ahlua; a je lɛ kɛ je e ma mi bi ɔmɛ a kpɛti. 31Akɛnɛ e bui Yawɛ munyu ɔ tue, nɛ e ya tɔ e mlaa a nɔ he je ɔ, a je lɛ we pɛsɛpɛsɛ; e musu nɛ tloo lɛ.”
Nyumu ɔ nɛ ble Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ
32Benɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ ngɛ nga a nɔ ɔ, e ba mi kaa a ya na nyumu ko nɛ ngɛ lɛ́ lɛe Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ. 33Ni nɛmɛ nɛ ya na nyumu ɔ nɛ ngɛ lɛ́ ɔ lɛe ɔ ngɔ lɛ kɛ ba Mose, kɛ Aaron, kɛ ma a tsuo a hɛ mi. 34A tsi e nya ngɛ tsu mi, ejakaa a na we nɛ a tsɔɔ nɔ́ pɔtɛɛ nɛ sa kaa a pee lɛ. 35Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ de Mose ke, “A gbe nyumu ɔ; ma a tsuo nɛ ya fia lɛ tɛ ngɛ ma sito he ɔ se!” 36Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ma a tsuo gbla lɛ kɛ ho ma sito he ɔ se ya, nɛ a ya fia lɛ tɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ kɛ ya si e gbo kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa Mose ɔ.
Tadehi a he dekehi
37Yawɛ de Mose ke, 38 “De Israel bi ɔmɛ ke a kpɛ deke ngɔ wo a tade ɔmɛ a nya ngɛ yi nɔhi tsuo; nɛ a ngɔ kpa bluu kɛ fi deke ɔmɛ kɛ wo tade ɔmɛ a nya. 39Deke nɛ ɔmɛ maa pee kaimi nɔ́ kɛ ha nyɛ. Ke nyɛ hyɛ mɛ pɛ nyɛ ma kai Yawɛ mlaa amɛ tsuo, nɛ nyɛ maa ye a nɔ, konɛ nyɛ ko je ye se kɛ ya nyɛɛ basabasa kɛ pee nyɛ suɔmi nya ní. 40Deke ɔmɛ ma ha nyɛ ma kai ye mlaa amɛ tsuo, nɛ nyɛ maa ye a nɔ, konɛ nyɛɛ pee nyɛ he klɔuklɔu kɛ ha nyɛ Mawu ɔ. 41Imi ji Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ nɛ; i je nyɛ kɛ je Egipt zugba a nɔ, konɛ ma ba pee nyɛ Mawu. Imi ji Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ nɛ.”

Title: MOSE IV, 16
Content:
Kora kɛ Datan kɛ Abiram tsɔ atuã
1-2 Ligbi ko ɔ, Izhar binyumu Kora, nɛ je Kohat we puɔ nya ngɛ Levi wɛtso ɔ mi ɔ, ya dɔ nihi ngɔ piɛ e he, nɛ a te si ngɔ wo Mose. Ni ɔmɛ a kpɛti nyumuhi etɛ je Ruben wɛtso ɔ mi. Mɛ ji Eliab binyumuhi Datan, kɛ Abiram, kɛ Pelet binyumu On. Israel bi kpahi lafa enyɔ kɛ nyingmi enuɔ piɛ a he. Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ ji ma nimeli nɛ a le mɛ saminya, nɛ ma a hla mɛ. 3A kpe kɛ wo Mose kɛ Aaron a he, nɛ a de mɛ ke, “Nyɛ ngɛ nɔ́ ko pee tsɔ. Ma kpekpemi nɛ ɔ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ nimli klɔuklɔuhi ji mɛ; nɛ Yawɛ ngɛ a kpɛti. Mɛni he je mɔ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ nyɛ he nɔ woe ngɛ Yawɛ ma kpekpemi ɔ nɔ ɔ?”
4Benɛ Mose nu nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, e kɛ e hɛ mi bu si, 5nɛ e de Kora kɛ e se nyɛɛli ɔmɛ ke, “Hwɔɔ mɔtu ɔ, Yawɛ nitsɛ maa tsɔɔ wɔ nɔmlɔ nɛ ji e nɔ, kɛ nɔ nɛ ji nɔ klɔuklɔu. Nɔmlɔ nɛ ji e nɔ nɛ e maa hla a, Yawɛ ma ha nɛ e hɛ lɛ kɛ ba e ngɔ. 6Bɔ nɛ nyɛɛ pee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: mo Kora, kɛ o se nyɛɛli ɔmɛ tsuo nyɛ ya hla ngɛyuhi. 7Hwɔɔ mɔtu ɔ, nyɛɛ je la kɛ wo ngɛyu ɔmɛ a mi. Nyɛɛ ngɔ tsopa kɛ e he via kɛ pue la a nɔ, nɛ nyɛɛ ngɔ kɛ ba Yawɛ hɛ mi. Nɔmlɔ nɛ Yawɛ nitsɛ maa hla a, lɛ ji nɔ klɔuklɔu ɔ nɛ. Nyɛ Levi bi, nyɛ ngɛ nyɛ he nɔ woe tsɔ!”
8Mose ya nɔ nɛ e de Kora ke, “Nyɛɛ bu mi tue, nyɛ Levi bi; 9anɛ e pi ha nyɛ kaa Israel Mawu ɔ hla nyɛ kɛ je Israel ma kpekpemi ɔ mi konɛ nyɛɛ ba e ngɔ, nɛ nyɛ ba tsu ní ngɛ Yawɛ kpe he ɔ, nɛ nyɛɛ da ma kpekpemi ɔ nya kaa a sɔmɔli lo? 10Mawu ha mo, kɛ o nyɛmimɛ Levi bi ɔmɛ tsuo kikɛmɛ a blɔ nya nɛ ɔ. Nɛ jehanɛ lɛɛ nyɛ pa ngɛ osɔfo yemi ɔ hu hlae lo. 11Hyɛ, Yawɛ yi nɔ nɛ o kɛ o se nyɛɛli ɔmɛ tsuo ngɛ soe ɔ nɛ. Jehanɛ, Aaron ɔ lɛɛ mɛni e pee nyɛ loko nyɛ ngɛ nya si hɔɔe kɛ ngɛ lɛ woe ɔ?”
12Mose tsɔ ke a ya tsɛ Datan, kɛ Abiram, Eliab bimɛ ɔmɛ kɛ ba. Se a de ke, “Wa be bae! 13O kpaka wɔ kɛ je zugba nɛ hi, nɛ baa ní nɔ, nɛ́ o ba gbe wɔ ngɛ nga nɛ ɔ nɔ. Anɛ enɛ ɔ pi ha mo, nɛ o pa ngɛ hlae nɛ o ye ganɔ ngɛ wa nɔ? 14Jehanɛ ɔ hu, o kɛ wɔ yɛ zugba nɛ hi, nɛ baa ní ko nɔ; ngmɔhi, kɛ wai abɔɔhi hu o ha we wɔ. Anɛ e peeɔ mo kaa o ma nyɛ nimli kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ maa sisi lo? Dɛbi, wa be bae!”
15Mose mi mi fu wawɛɛ nitsɛ, nɛ e de Yawɛ ke, “Ko he bɔ ɔmɛ nɛ a ba sã a! I he we teji kake po ngɛ a dɛ, nɛ i yi a ti nɔ ko nɔ ko sane yayami ko hulɔ.”
16Mose de Kora ke, “Hwɔɔ ɔ, o kɛ o se nyɛɛli ɔmɛ tsuo kulaa nyɛɛ ba Yawɛ hɛ mi; Aaron hu maa ba lejɛ ɔ. 17O se nyɛɛli lafa enyɔ kɛ nyingmi enuɔ ɔmɛ ɔ, a ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ngɔ lɛ nitsɛ e ngɛyu, nɛ e kɛ tsopa kɛ e he via wo mi, nɛ e kɛ ba Yawɛ hɛ mi.” 18Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ tsuaa nɔ ho ya ngɔ ngɛyu, nɛ e je la kɛ wo mi, nɛ e ngɔ tsopa kɛ e he via kɛ pue nɔ, nɛ e ba da si ngɛ kpe he bo tsu sinya a nya ngɛ Mose kɛ Aaron a kasa nya. 19Kora ya kpee ma kpekpemi ɔ tsuo kɛ ba kpe he bo tsu sinya a nya, nɛ a plɛ a hɛ mi ngɔ kpee Mose kɛ Aaron. Tlukaa a, Yawɛ hɛ mi nyami ɔ ba je e he kpo kɛ tsɔɔ ma kpekpemi ɔ tsuo. 20Yawɛ de Mose kɛ Aaron ke, 21“Nyɛɛ hɛ nyɛ kɛ je ma nɛ ɔ he kɛ ya se, nɛ ma kpata a hɛ mi hɛngmɛfia.”
22Se Mose kɛ Aaron ngɔ a hɛ mi ngɔ bu si, nɛ a de ke, “Mawu lee, mo nɛ o ji adesahi tsuo a mumi. Anɛ ke nɔ kake pee yayami ɔ, o mi mi ma fu ma a tsuo lo?”
23Yawɛ de Mose ke, 24“De ma a ke a hɛ mɛ kɛ je Kora, kɛ Datan, kɛ Abiram a bo tsu ɔmɛ a he.”
25Kɛkɛ nɛ Mose te si, nɛ e kɛ Israel ma nimeli ɔmɛ pue nɔ kɛ ho Datan, kɛ Abiram a ngɔ ya. 26E de ma a ke, “Nyɛɛ hɛ nyɛ kɛ je nimli yiwutsotsɛmɛ nɛ ɔmɛ a bo tsu ɔmɛ a he. Ke pi ja a, a ma kpata nyɛɛ kɛ mɛ tsuo nyɛ hɛ mi ngɛ a he yayami ɔmɛ a he.” 27Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a hɛ mɛ kɛ je Kora, kɛ Datan, kɛ Abiram a bo tsu ɔmɛ a he.
Datan kɛ Abiram je kpo ba da si ngɛ a bo tsu sinya amɛ a nya; a kɛ a binyumu ɔmɛ, kɛ a bimɛ tsɔwitsɔwi ɔmɛ. 28Mose de ke, “Nɔ́ nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ maa le kaa Yawɛ nitsɛ lɛ tsɔ mi ke ma ba tsu ní nɛ ɔmɛ, se pi imi nitsɛ ye yi mi tomi nya ji 29ke nimli nɛ ɔmɛ gbo mɛ nitsɛmɛ a gbenɔ, aloo a gbo ngɛ oslaa nya kaa bɔ nɛ nimli adesahi tsuo gboɔ ɔ, lɛɛ tsa pi Yawɛ nɛ tsɔ mi. 30Se ke Yawɛ pee nɔ́ ko nɛ bɛ hyɛ, nɛ zugba bli e nya mi nɛ e mii mɛ kɛ ho yɔkɔ mi ya hɛ ngmengmle, kɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ a ngɛ ɔ, lɛɛ nyɛ maa le kaa nimli nɛ ɔmɛ kua Yawɛ niinɛ.”
31Mose nya nɛ e ke e nɔɔ si kikɛ nɛ ɔ kɛkɛ nɛ zugba a mi gba enyɔ ngɛ a sisi, 32nɛ e mii mɛ kɛ a we mi bimɛ, kɛ nihi tsuo nɛ nyɛɛ Kora se ɔ, kɛ mɛ hu a níhi tsuo. 33Mɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ a ho gbeje ya hɛ ngmengmle, kɛ a nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́. Zugba a sa a yi, nɛ a hɛ mi kpata. 34Israel bi tsuo nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ tu fo benɛ a nu ni ɔmɛ a ngmlaa kpami ɔ. A de ke, “Nyɛ ha waa tu fo, ke pi ja a wɔ hu zugba a maa mii wɔ!”
35Kɛkɛ nɛ la je Yawɛ ngɔ ba sã nimli lafa enyɔ kɛ nyingmi enuɔ ɔmɛ nɛ a ngɔ tsopa kɛ e he via a kɛ ba a.
Ngɛyu ɔmɛ
36Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, Yawɛ de Mose ke, 37“De osɔfo Aaron bi Eleazar nɛ e ya je ngɛyu ɔmɛ kɛ je la a mi, nɛ e gbɛ la a kɛ ya se lokoo; ejakaa ngɛyu ɔmɛ a he tsɔ. 38Benɛ a ngɔ ngɛyu ɔmɛ kɛ ya Yawɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he pɛ kɛkɛ nɛ a pee ní klɔuklɔuhi. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nimli nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a gbe mɛ ngɛ a he yayami he ɔ, mo de Eleazar nɛ e ya je a ngɛyu ɔmɛ nɛ a fiaa nɔ tɛtlɛɛ, nɛ a kɛ ha bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he. Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ maa pee kɔkɔ bɔmi nɔ́ kɛ ha Israel ma a.” 39Kɛkɛ nɛ osɔfo Eleazar ya kukuɔ akɔblee ngɛyu ɔmɛ, nɛ e ha a fia a nɔ tɛtlɛɛ, nɛ a kɛ pee bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he hami nɔ́, 40kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa Eleazar kɛ gu Mose nɔ ke e pee ɔ. Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ba pee kɔkɔ bɔmi nɔ́ ko kɛ ha Israel bi ɔmɛ, kaa nɔ ko nɛ pi osɔfo ji lɛ, nɛ e pi Aaron weku ɔ mi no hulɔ ɔ, e be he blɔ nɛ e sãã tsopa kɛ e he via ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ kɛ haa Yawɛ. Ke nɔ ko pee ja a, a ma kpata e hɛ mi kaa bɔ nɛ a pee Kora kɛ e se nyɛɛli ɔmɛ ɔ.
Aaron he ma a yi wami
41E nɔ jena a, Israel ma a tsuo hɔɔ nya si kɛ wo Mose kɛ Aaron, nɛ a de ke, “Nyɛ lɛ nyɛ gbe Yawɛ ni ɔmɛ ɔ nɛ.” 42Se benɛ ma a tsuo nya bua ngɔ wo Mose kɛ Aaron he ɔ, a plɛ kɛ kpee kpe he bo tsu ɔ, nɛ a na kaa bɔku ɔ ba ma lejɛ ɔ, nɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi nyami ɔ je e he kpo. 43Kɛkɛ nɛ Mose kɛ Aaron ho ya da si ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ hɛ mi, 44nɛ Yawɛ de Mose ke, 45“Nyɛɛ hɛ nyɛ kɛ je ma nɛ ɔ he kɛ ya se nɛ ma kpata a hɛ mi ngɛ hɛngmɛfia mi!”
Se Mose kɛ Aaron kpla si nɛ a ngɔ a hɛ mi kɛ bu si, 46nɛ Mose de Aaron ke, “Ngɔɔ ngɛyu ɔ, nɛ o je la ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ kɛ wo mi. Ngɔɔ tsopa kɛ e he via kɛ pue nɔ, nɛ o hɛɛ kɛ ya ma a ngɔ esɔesɔ, nɛ o ya kpata Yawɛ ha mɛ. Yawɛ mi mi fu, nɛ gbenɔ hiɔ ɔ je sisi.” 47Kaa bɔ nɛ Mose de lɛ ɔ, Aaron ngɔ e ngɛyu ɔ, nɛ e tu fo kɛ ya sɛ ma a kpɛti benɛ a bua a he nya. Benɛ e na kaa gbenɔ hiɔ ɔ bɔni ní puɛmi momo ngɛ ni ɔmɛ a kpɛti ɔ, e kɛ tsopa kɛ e he via a pue la a nɔ, nɛ e pee kusumi kɛ kpata Yawɛ ha ma a. 48E ya da si ngɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ gbo ɔ, kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ a hɛ ngɛ ɔ a kpɛti, kɛkɛ nɛ gbenɔ hiɔ ɔ se po. 49Nimli nɛ gbenɔ hiɔ ɔ gbe ɔ, a hiɛmi ji akpe nyɔngma kɛ eywiɛ kɛ e nya lafa kpaago; slo ni nɛmɛ nɛ gbo ngɛ Kora sane ɔ nɛ ba a mi. 50Benɛ gbenɔ hiɔ ɔ se po ɔ, Aaron kpale e se kɛ ba Mose ngɔ ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ sinya a nya.

Title: MOSE IV, 17
Content:
Aaron dɛma tso ɔ
1Yawɛ de Mose ke, 2“De Israel bi ɔmɛ nɛ a kɛ dɛma tso nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ nɛ ba; wɛtsoyi tsuaa wɛtsoyi nɛ ngɔ dɛma tso kake kɛ ba. Ngmaa nɔ tsuaa nɔ biɛ ngɛ e tso he. 3Ngmaa Aaron biɛ ngɛ Levi tso ɔ he; ejakaa wɛtsoyi tsuaa wɛtsoyi ma na tso kake. 4Muɔ tso ɔmɛ ya pue somi daka a hɛ mi ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ mi he nɛ i kɛ mo kpee ngɛ ɔ. 5Nɔ nɛ ma hla a, e tso ɔ ma tsɛ̃ mɔmɔ; nɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ma ha nɛ munyu huitihuiti nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ tuɔ kɛ siɔ nyɛ ngɛ ye he ɔ se maa po.”
6Mose kɛ Israel ma a ya tu, nɛ wɛtsoyi ɔmɛ tsuo ngɔ dɛma tso kakaaka kɛ ba; lɛ tsuo peeɔ nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ, nɛ Aaron tso ɔ hu piɛ he. 7Mose muɔ tso ɔmɛ tsuo ya pue Yawɛ somi daka a hɛ mi ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ mi.
8 E nɔ jena a benɛ Mose ya bo tsu ɔ mi he nɛ somi womi ɔ ngɛ ɔ, e na kaa Aaron tso ɔ nɛ daa si ha Levi wɛtso ɔ tsɛ̃ tso hɛngmɛ he, e pɛ mɔmɔ, nɛ e wo ngmɛ́hi nɛ fu. 9Mose muɔ tso ɔmɛ tsuo ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi kɛ je kpo ya tsɔɔ Israel ma a tsuo. Benɛ a na nɔ́ nɛ ba a, wɛtsoyi ɔmɛ tsuo ho ya ngɔ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a tso ɔmɛ. 10Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, Yawɛ de Mose ke, “Kpale Aaron dɛma tso ɔ ya fɔ daka a nɛ somi womi ɔ ngɛ mi ɔ hɛ mi ekohu, nɛ e hi lejɛ ɔ kaa kɔkɔ bɔmi nɔ́ kɛ ha atuã tsɔli ɔmɛ bɔ nɛ pee nɛ a munyu huitihuiti ɔmɛ nɛ a tuɔ kɛ siɔ mi ɔ se nɛ po. Ke pi ja a, a ma gbo.” 11Mose pee kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa lɛ ke e pee ɔ.
12Kɛkɛ nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ de Mose ke, “Wa yi ta! Wa gbe nya! Wɔ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ wa yi ta! 13Ke nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa hɛ lɛ kɛ su Yawɛ kpe he ɔ he ma gbo ɔ, lɛɛ tse wɔ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ wa hɛ mi ma kpata mɔ!”

Title: MOSE IV, 18
Content:
Osɔfo ɔmɛ kɛ Levi bi ɔmɛ a ní tsumi
1Yawɛ de Aaron ke, “O kɛ o bimɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ o tsɛ we ɔ, nyɛ ji ni nɛmɛ nɛ he klɔuklɔu ɔ he sɔ tloo, se nɔ́ nɛ kɔɔ osɔfo yemi ní tsumi ɔ he ɔ lɛɛ o kɛ o bimɛ ɔmɛ kɛkɛ nyɛ sane ji lɔ ɔ. 2O nyɛmimɛ Levi bi ɔmɛ, nɛ ji o tsɛ weku li ɔmɛ ɔ, ha nɛ mɛ hu a ba piɛ o kɛ o bimɛ ɔmɛ a he, be mi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ sɔmɔe ngɛ bo tsu ɔ mi. 3A ma sɔmɔ mo, nɛ a ma tsu bo tsu ɔ he ní tsumihi tsuo. Se mohu, á hyɛ nɛ a ko ta bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ, loo ní ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ he klɔuklɔu ɔ a he, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ a kɛ nyɛ tsuo nyɛ ko gbo. 4A maa piɛ nyɛ he kɛ tsu ní tsumi tsuaa ní tsumi ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ mi; nɔ kpa ko nɛ ko ba nyɛ kasa nya. 5He klɔuklɔu ɔ, kɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ, o kɛ o bimɛ ɔmɛ pɛ nyɛ tsu ní ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, konɛ ye mi mi nɛ ko fu Israel bi ɔmɛ ekohu. 6Imi nitsɛ lɛ i hla nyɛ nyɛmimɛ Levi bi ɔmɛ kɛ je Israel bi ɔmɛ a kpɛti, nɛ i ngɔ mɛ kɛ ha nyɛ kaa nike ní. A hla mɛ ngɔ to ha mi, konɛ a nyɛ nɛ a tsu ní ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ mi. 7Se o kɛ o bimɛ ɔmɛ pɛ ji ni nɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ he blɔ kaa nyɛ tsuɔ osɔfo ní tsumihi nɛ kɔɔ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ, kɛ he klɔuklɔu pe kulaa a a he. Enɛ ɔmɛ ji nyɛ ní tsumi; ejakaa imi lɛ i kɛ osɔfo yemi ní tsumi ɔ ke nyɛ. Nɔ kpa ko nɛ maa hɛ lɛ kɛ su ní klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ a he ɔ, a gbe lɛ.”
Osɔfo ɔmɛ a blɔ fa mi nɔ
8Yawɛ de Aaron ke, “O nɛ, imi nitsɛ i ngɔ Israel bi ɔmɛ a nike ní klɛdɛɛ ɔ nɛ a kɛ ba ha mi ɔ kɛ ngɛ o dɛ woe. I ngɔ mɛ kɛ ngɛ mo, kɛ o bimɛ tsuo hae kaa nyɛ blɔ nya nɛ fɔɔ si kɛ yaa neneene. 9Ní klɔuklɔu pe kulaa nɛ a sɛ̃ ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ, a kpɛti enɛ ɔmɛ maa pee o níhi: niye ní bɔ, yayami pami bɔ, kɛ fɔ yemi bɔ. Nike ní klɔuklɔu tsuaa nike ní klɔuklɔu nɛ a kɛ ba ha mi ɔ maa pee o kɛ o bimɛ nyɛ nɔ. 10Nyɛɛ ye ngɛ he ko nɛ ngɛ klɔuklɔu; nyumuhi pɛ lɛ a ye. E ji niye ní klɔuklɔu ha nyɛ.
11“Jehanɛ, nike ní klɛdɛɛ kpa komɛ nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ kɛ baa a, lɔ ɔmɛ hu maa pee o nɔ. I ngɔ mɛ kɛ ha mo, kɛ o binyumu ɔmɛ, kɛ o biyi ɔmɛ, kaa nyɛ blɔ fa mi nɔ́ kɛ yaa neneene. O we mi bimɛ tsuo nɛ a he tsɔ ɔ, a ye eko.
12“Jehanɛ, nu, wai he, kɛ blɛfo kpokploku, nɛ ji kekleekle yiblii nɛ a kɛ ba haa imi Yawɛ ɔ, lɔ ɔmɛ hu i ngɔ kɛ ha mo. 13Jã kɛ̃, nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ puɛɔ ngɛ a zugba a nɔ ɔ, a kekleekle yiblii nɛ a kɛ ba haa mi ɔ maa pee o nɔ. O we mi bimɛ tsuo nɛ a he tsɔ ɔ, a ye eko.
14 “Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ ngɛ Israel nɛ a hla ngɔ to ha mi ɔ maa pee o nɔ.
15“Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ bliɔ muklii nya, nɛ a kɛ ba ha Yawɛ ɔ maa pee o nɔ, nɔmlɔ jio, we mi lohwe jio. Se nɔmlɔ adesa e kekleekle bi, kɛ lohwe nɛ he tsɔ we e kekleekle bi lɛɛ o ha nɛ a kpɔ mɛ. 16Níhi nɛ a ma kpɔ ɔ, ke a ye nyɔhiɔ kake pɛ a kpɔ mɛ. Jua nɛ a po fɔ si kɛ ha a kpɔmi ji sika hiɔ yi enuɔ, kaa bɔ nɛ he klɔuklɔu ɔ jua nɛ a po ɔ ngɛ ɔ. 17Na, loo jijɔ, loo apletsi kekleekle bi lɛɛ a ko kpɔ; ejakaa mɛɛ a he tsɔ. Ngɔɔ a muɔ ɔ kɛ fĩa bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ, nɛ o sã a zɔ ɔ kaa bɔ nɛ jeɔ via ha Yawɛ. 18A lo ɔ maa pee o nɔ, kaa bɔ nɛ bɔ nɛ a fɔɔ kɛ yaa kɛ baa a gugue ɔ, kɛ e hiɔ fiɔ ɔ peeɔ o nɔ ɔ.
19“Nike ní klɔuklɔu nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ kɛ ba haa Yawɛ ɔ, i ngɔ mɛ tsuo kɛ ha mo, kɛ o binyumu ɔmɛ, kɛ o biyi ɔmɛ kaa nyɛ blɔ fa mi nɔ nɛ fɔɔ si daa. Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ji somi ko nɛ i kɛ mo, kɛ o nina so, nɛ a be mi poe gblegbleegble.”
20Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Yawɛ de Aaron ke, “O be weto ní ko nae ngɛ Israel zugba a nɔ, nɛ blɔ fa mi nɔ ko hu o be nae. Imi ji o blɔ fa mi nɔ, kɛ o weto ní ngɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ a kpɛti.”
Levi bi ɔmɛ a blɔ fa mi nɔ
21 Yawɛ de ke, “Levi bi ɔmɛ lɛɛ i ngɔ Israel níhi tsuo a mi dlami nyɔngmanyɔngma mi kakaaka kɛ ngɛ mɛ hae kaa a weto ní, ngɛ ní nɛ a tsuɔ ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ mi ɔ he. 22Kɛ je mwɔnɛ ɔ kɛ yaa a, Israel bi kpa amɛ ko hɛ mɛ kɛ su kpe he bo tsu ɔ he hu, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ a ko ba pee yayami nɛ a ba gbo. 23Levi bi ɔmɛ pɛ ji ni nɛmɛ nɛ ma tsu ní ngɛ kpe he ɔ; ke sane ko ba a, mɛ lɛ a ma bi. Enɛ ɔ ji mlaa nɛ fɔɔ si daa kɛ ha nyɛ bimɛ; se weto ní ko lɛɛ a be nae ngɛ Israel, 24ejakaa Israel bi ɔmɛ a níhi a mi dlami nyɔngmanyɔngma mi kakaaka nɛ a kɛ ba haa Yawɛ ɔ, i ngɔ mɛ tsuo ngɔ ha Levi bi ɔmɛ kaa a weto ní. Enɛ ɔ he je nɛ i de mɛ ke a be weto ní kpa ko nae ngɛ Israel ɔ nɛ.”
Mi dlami nyɔngma mi kake
25Yawɛ fa Mose ke 26e de Levi bi ɔmɛ ke, “Ke nyɛ nine su Israel bi ɔmɛ a níhi a mi dlami nyɔngmanyɔngma mi kakaaka a nɛ Yawɛ kɛ ha nyɛ kaa nyɛ weto ní ɔ nɔ ɔ, nyɛ hu nyɛɛ ngɔ mi dlami nyɔngma mi kake nɛ ɔ hu mi dlami nyɔngma mi kake kɛ ba ha mi kaa nike ní klɛdɛɛ. 27Yawɛ maa ngɔ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ kaa ngma nɛ je nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ ngma mi sami he, loo wai he nɛ je nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ wai muɔ mi. 28Blɔ nɔ nɛ nyɛ maa gu nɛ nyɛ hu nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ nike ni klɛdɛɛ ma ba ha Yawɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. Níhi a mi dlami nyɔngmanyɔngma mi kakaaka nɛ nyɛ na kɛ je Israel bi ɔmɛ a dɛ mi, nɛ ji Yawɛ nike ní klɛdɛɛ ɔ, nyɛ maa ngɔ kɛ ha osɔfo Aaron. 29Nike níhi tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ nɛ nyɛ na a, nyɛɛ ngɔ e mi nɔ́ nɛ hi pe kulaa, nɛ ji nɔ́ klɔuklɔu ɔ kɛ ba ha Yawɛ. 30Ke nyɛɛ kɛ nɔ́ nɛ hi pe kulaa a ba ha Yawɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ ngɔ nɔ́ nɛ piɛ ɔ kɛ to, kaa bɔ nɛ ke ngmɔ hulɔ ya sã bɔ nɛ e ngɔɔ nɔ́ nɛ piɛ ɔ kɛ toɔ ɔ. 31Nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ we mi bimɛ nɛ ye nɔ́ nɛ piɛ ɔ ngɛ he tsuaa he; ejakaa ní tsumi nɛ nyɛ tsuɔ ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ mi ɔ, e he hiɔwo ji lɔ ɔ nɛ. 32Ke nyɛ ngɔ nɔ́ nɛ hi pe lɛ tsuo ɔ kɛ ba ha Yawɛ ɔ, tue gblami ko be nyɛ nɔ bae. Se nyɛɛ hyɛ nɛ nyɛ ko ble Israel bi ɔmɛ a nike ní klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ, nɛ a ko gbe nyɛ.”

Title: MOSE IV, 19
Content:
Na yo tsu la zu ɔ
1Yawɛ de Mose kɛ Aaron ke, 2“Mlaa nɛ Yawɛ wo ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: nyɛ de Israel bi ɔmɛ nɛ a ngɔ na yo tsu nɛ nye, loo kpa ko be e he, nɛ a kɛ kuɛpã hu wui lɛ hyɛ kɛ ba 3osɔfo Eleazar ngɔ. A kpaka na a kɛ ya sito he ɔ se, nɛ a ya gbe lɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, ngɛ osɔfo ɔ hɛ mi. 4Osɔfo Eleazar nɛ ngɔ e nine nguɛ kɛ sɔ muɔ ɔ mi, nɛ e fĩa muɔ ɔ eko kɛ ya kpe he bo tsu ɔ hɛ mi si kpaago. 5A sã na yo ɔ, e he womi ɔ, e lo ɔ, e muɔ ɔ, kɛ e mi ní ɔmɛ tsuo ngɛ osɔfo Eleazar hɛ mi. 6Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, osɔfo ɔ nɛ hla seda tso, kɛ nga nɛ a fi kaa bɛ, kɛ kpa tsu, nɛ e sake mɛ ngɔ pue la a nɛ a ngɛ na yo ɔ sãe ngɛ nɔ ɔ mi. 7Osɔfo ɔ nɛ fɔ e tade ɔmɛ a he, nɛ e du e he loko e kpale kɛ ba sito he ɔ; se kɛ̃ ɔ, e he tsɔ we kɛ yaa si gbɔkuɛ. 8Nɔ nɛ sã na yo ɔ, lɛ hu e fɔ e tade ɔmɛ a he, nɛ e du e he ja nɔuu; lɛ hu e he tsɔ we kɛ yaa si gbɔkuɛ. 9 Nyagbe ɔ, nɔ ko nɛ he tsɔ nɛ ya muɔ na yo ɔ la zu ɔ kɛ ya pue he ko nɛ tsɔ ngɛ sito he ɔ se. A ngɔ la zu nɛ ɔ ngɔ to lejɛ ɔ, konɛ a kɛ futu nyu mi, nɛ a ngɔ nyu nɛ ɔ kɛ du Israel ma kpekpemi ɔ a he, nɛ a kɛ je a he yayami ɔmɛ. 10Nɔ nɛ muɔ na yo ɔ la zu ɔ, lɛ hu e fɔ e tade ɔmɛ a he; se kɛ̃ ɔ, e he tsɔ we kɛ yaa si gbɔkuɛ. Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ maa pee mlaa nɛ fɔɔ si daa kɛ ha Israel bi, kɛ nibwɔhi nɛ ba to mɛ ɔ.
Nɔ gbogboe he kɔhi
11“Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa ta nɔ gbogboe he ɔ, e ble e he; nɛ e he tsɔ we kɛ yaa si ligbi kpaago. 12Loko e he ma tsɔ ɔ, e ngɔ nyu nɛ a kɛ fɔɔ nɔ he yayami ɔ kɛ julaa e he ngɛ ligbi etɛne ɔ, kɛ ligbi kpaagone ɔ a nɔ. Ke e kɛ nyu ɔ fɔ we e he ngɛ ligbi nɛ ji etɛ ɔ kɛ ligbi nɛ ji kpaago ɔ a nɔ ɔ, e he be tsɔe. 13Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa ta nɔ gbogboe he, nɛ e kɛ nyu nɛ a kɛ fɔɔ nɔ he yayami nɛ ɔ be e he julaae ɔ, e he tsɔ we; mu ngɛ e he. Ke e ba mi ja a, nɔ ɔ ble Yawɛ kpe he ɔ. A ma je lɛ we, nɛ a be lɛ bue ngɔ si Mawu ma mi bi ɔmɛ a nɔ hu.
14“Ke nɔ ko gbo ngɛ bo tsu mi ɔ, mlaa nɛ ngɛ he ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: nihi tsuo nɛ ngɛ bo tsu ɔ mi jamɛ a be ɔ mi, aloo nihi tsuo nɛ ma ba sɛ mi ɔ, a he tsɔ we kɛ yaa si ligbi kpaago. 15Jehanɛ, buɛ tsuaa buɛ nɛ nya fɔɔ si gu, aloo buɛ nɛ nya nɔ be nya a, jamɛ a buɛ ɔ hu he tsɔ we. 16Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa ta nɔ gbogboe he ngɛ nga nɔ ɔ, e he tsɔ we kɛ yaa si ligbi kpaago, nɔ nɛ a kɛ klaate gbe lɛ jio, nɔ nɛ gbo lɛ nitsɛ e gbenɔ jio. Jã kɛ̃ nɔ nɛ maa ta nɔ gbogboe wu, aloo yɔkɔ ko he ɔ, lɛ hu e he tsɔ we kɛ yaa si ligbi kpaago.
17“Ke nɔ ko ble e he kikɛ nɛ ɔ, bɔ nɛ a plɛ kɛ tsu e he ní ji na yo ɔ nɛ a sã kɛ je yayami ɔ, a ngɔ e la zu ɔ eko kɛ wo buɛ mi, nɛ a yɛ nyu mua kɛ pue nɔ. 18Kekleekle ɔ, nɔ ko nɛ he tsɔ nɛ ngɔ nga nɛ a fi kaa bɛ kɛ sɔ nyu ɔ mi, nɛ e kɛ fĩa bo tsu ɔ, kɛ e mi ní ɔmɛ tsuo, kɛ nimli tsuo nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ a nɔ. Jehanɛ, nɔ nɛ ya ta nɔ gbogboe wu, loo yɔkɔ, loo nɔ ko nɛ a gbe lɛ, loo nɔ ko nɛ gbo lɛ nitsɛ e gbenɔ he ɔ, nɔ nɛ he tsɔ ɔ nɛ ngɔ nyu ɔ kɛ fĩa e nɔ. 19Nɔ nɛ he tsɔ nɛ ɔ nɛ fĩa nyu ɔ kɛ pue nɔ nɛ he tsɔ we ɔ nɔ, ngɛ ligbi nɛ ji etɛne ɔ kɛ ligbi nɛ ji kpaagone ɔ a nɔ. Ke a julaa nɔmlɔ nɛ ɔ ngɛ ligbi nɛ ji kpaago ɔ nɔ se ɔ, e fɔ e tade ɔmɛ a he, nɛ e yɛ nyu nɛ e du e he; kɛkɛ ɔ, ke pu nɔ si ɔ, e he ma tsɔ ekohu.
20“Nɔmlɔ nɛ ble e he, se e julaa we e he ɔ, mu ngɛ e he, nɛ e he tsɔ we; ejakaa a kɛ nyu nɛ a kɛ fɔɔ nɔ he yayami ɔ pue we e nɔ. Ke e ba mi ja a, nɔ ɔ ble Yawɛ kpe he ɔ. A ma je lɛ we, nɛ a be lɛ bue ngɔ si Mawu ma mi bi ɔmɛ a nɔ hu. 21Mlaa nɛ fɔɔ si daa kɛ ha mɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. Nɔ nɛ fĩaa nyu nɛ a kɛ fɔɔ nɔ he yayami ɔ ngɔ pueɔ nihi a nɔ ɔ, lɛ hu e fɔ e tade ɔmɛ a he; nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ nyu nɛ ɔ eko ma pue e nɔ ɔ, lɛ hu e he tsɔ we kɛ yaa si gbɔkuɛ. 22Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ nɔ ko nɛ he tsɔ we maa ta he ɔ, e ble nɔ́ ɔ; ke nɔ ko ta jamɛ a nɔ́ ɔ he ɔ, lɛ hu e he tsɔ we kɛ yaa si gbɔkuɛ.”

Title: MOSE IV, 20
Content:
Níhi nɛ ya nɔ ngɛ Kadesh
(Mose II, 17.1-7)
1Israel ma kpekpemi ɔ tsuo ba Zin nga a nɔ kekleekle nyɔhiɔ ɔ, nɛ a ba to si ngɛ Kadesh. Benɛ a ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, Miriam ba gbo, nɛ a pu lɛ.
Nyu hwɔ
2Nyu be he nɛ ma a ya to si ngɛ ɔ; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ni ɔmɛ tsɛ kpe ngɔ wo Mose kɛ Aaron a he, 3nɛ a kɛ Mose pɛ, nɛ a de ke, “Wa ná nɛ wa piɛ wa nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ a he kɛ gbo ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi. 4Mɛni he je nɛ o ngɔ wɔ, Yawɛ ma kpekpemi ɔ, kɛ wa lohwehi tsuo kɛ ba nga nɛ ɔ nɔ nɛ wa ba gbo ngɛ hiɛ ɔ? 5Mɛni he je nɛ o kpaka wɔ kɛ je Egipt kɛ ba zugba yaya nɛ bɛ ní nɛ ɔ nɔ? Blɛfo be ɔ, ngmɔkɔ be; wai be ɔ, akutu hu be. Nyu nunui kpamakpa hu be hiɛ ɔ!” 6Kɛkɛ nɛ Mose kɛ Aaron hɛ mɛ kɛ je gua a he kɛ ya da kpe he bo tsu ɔ sinya a nya, nɛ a ngɔ a hɛ mi ngɔ bu si; nɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi nyami ɔ je e he kpo kɛ tsɔɔ mɛ.
7Yawɛ de Mose ke, 8“Yaa ngɔ tso ɔ nɛ ngɛ somi daka a hɛ mi ɔ, nɛ o kɛ o nyɛmi Aaron ya bua ma kpekpemi ɔ tsuo nya. Mo fa tɛ sa a ngɛ mɛ tsuo a hɛ mi, kɛkɛ nyu maa je mi kɛ ha ma kpekpemi ɔ, kɛ lohwe ɔmɛ nɛ a nu.” 9Mose ya ngɔ tso ɔ kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa lɛ ɔ.
10Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, Mose kɛ Aaron ho nɛ a ya bua ma mluku ɔ nya ngɛ tɛ sa a hɛ mi; nɛ Mose de mɛ ke, “Nyɛ atuã tsɔli, nyɛɛ bu mi tue! Anɛ e he hia kaa wa je nyu ngɛ tɛ sa nɛ ɔ mi kɛ ha nyɛ lo?” 11Kikɛ nɛ ɔ nɛ Mose de pɛ kɛkɛ nɛ e wo e nine nɔ, nɛ e kɛ e tso ɔ fia tɛ sa a si enyɔ, nɛ nyu babauu je mi babaaba ha ma kpekpemi ɔ, kɛ a lohwe ɔmɛ nɛ a nu.
12Se Yawɛ de Mose kɛ Aaron ke, “Akɛnɛ hemi kɛ yemi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ kɛ ha mi ɔ pi, bɔ nɛ nyɛ ma nyɛ maa ye ye he wami klɔuklɔu ɔ he odase kɛ tsɔɔ Israel bi ɔmɛ he je ɔ, nyɛ be ma kpekpemi nɛ ɔ hɛ mi nyɛɛe kɛ ya su zugba nɛ i ngɔ ha mɛ ɔ nɔ.”
13Sane nɛ ɔ ba ngɛ Meriba. Lejɛ ɔ ji he nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ kɛ Yawɛ pɛ ngɛ; nɛ lejɛ ɔ nɛ e je e he kpo ngɔ tsɔɔ mɛ ngɛ kaa Mawu klɔuklɔu.
Israel kɛ Edom
14Mose tsɔ nihi kɛ je Kadesh ke a ngɔ sɛ gbi ya ha Edom matsɛ, nɛ a de lɛ ke, “Bɔ nɛ o nyɛmimɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ de ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: mo nitsɛ o le amanehluhi nɛ wa na; 15bɔ nɛ wa nɛmɛ ya Egipt, nɛ e ba mi kaa wɔ hu wa ya hi lejɛ ɔ be babauu; bɔ nɛ Egipt bi ɔmɛ wa wa nɛmɛ ɔmɛ yi mi, kɛ bɔ nɛ a wa wɔ hu yi mi; 16bɔ nɛ wa kpa ngmlaa kɛ tsɛ Yawɛ, nɛ e nu wa gbi, nɛ e tsɔ bɔfo kɛ ba kpaka wɔ kɛ je Egipt. Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, wa ba su Kadesh, nɛ ji ma nɛ kɛ o zugba a wo huzu ɔ nɔ. 17Wa kpa mo pɛɛ, ha nɛ waa gu o zugba a nɔ kɛ be. Wa be ngmɔ, loo wai abɔɔ ko mi gue; wa be vu ko vu ko mi nyu nue. Matsɛ gbɛjegbɛ ɔ nɔ kɛkɛ wa maa nyɛɛ tɛɛ kɛ yaa si wa maa po mi ngɛ o zugba a nɔ.”
18Se Edom bi ɔmɛ he nɔ ke, “Dɛbi, nyɛ be wa zugba a nɔ gue! Ke nyɛ li peemi nɛ nyɛ ba wa zugba a nɔ ɔ, wa maa hia ta kɛ ba tua nyɛ.”
19Israel bi ɔmɛ de ke, “Gbɛjegbɛ ɔ nɔ kɛkɛ wa maa nyɛɛ; nɛ ke e ba mi kaa wɔ, loo wa lohwe ɔmɛ nu nyɛ nyu ɔ eko ɔ, wa maa wo he hiɔ. Moo lɛɛ moo ngmɛ wɔ blɔ nɛ waa gu o zugba a nɔ kɛ be kɛkɛ; enɛ ɔ pɛ wa ngɛ bie.”
20Se Edom bi ɔmɛ he nɔ ke “Dɛbi! Nyɛ be wa zugba a nɔ gue.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Edom ta buli babauu je kpo kɛ ba, konɛ a ba tua Israel bi ɔmɛ. 21Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, akɛnɛ Edom bi ɔmɛ ngmɛ́ blɔ nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ nɛ gu a zugba a nɔ ɔ, mɛ hu a kpale a se ya gu he kpa.
Aaron gbenɔ
22Israel ma kpekpemi ɔ tsuo hia kɛ je Kadesh kɛ ba Hor yo ɔ he, 23ngɛ Edom huzu ɔ nya. Lejɛ ɔ Yawɛ de Mose kɛ Aaron ke, 24“Aaron ma gbo, nɛ e nane enyɔ be zugba a nɛ i ngɔ ha Israel ma a nɔ mae; ejakaa nyɛ ni enyɔ ɔmɛ nyɛ tsɔ atuã wo mi ngɛ Meriba nyu ɔ he. 25Ngɔɔ Aaron kɛ e bi Eleazar kɛ ba Hor yo ɔ nɔ, 26nɛ o je Aaron tade ɔmɛ ngɛ e he kɛ wo e bi Eleazar. Aaron ma gbo ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.” 27Mose pee kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa lɛ ɔ. A kuɔ Hor yo ɔ ngɛ ma kpekpemi ɔ tsuo a hɛ mi, 28 nɛ Mose je Aaron he tade ɔmɛ kɛ wo e bi Eleazar. Nɛ Aaron gbo ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, ngɛ yo ɔ yi mi, nɛ Mose kɛ Eleazar kple si kɛ ba. 29Benɛ Israel ma kpekpemi ɔ tsuo ná le kaa Aaron gbo ɔ, a nyɛ ya ha lɛ ligbi nyingmi etɛ.

Title: MOSE IV, 21
Content:
A ye Kanaan bi ɔmɛ a nɔ kunimi
1 Benɛ Kanaan matsɛ ɔ nɛ ngɛ Arad, ngɛ Kanaan leneyi je ɔ nu kaa Israel bi ɔmɛ gu Atarim blɔ kɛ ma a, e kɛ mɛ ya hwu ta; nɛ e ngɔ a ti ni komɛ nyɔguɛ. 2Kɛkɛ nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ wo Yawɛ si, nɛ a de ke, “Ke o maa ngɔ nimli nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ wo wa dɛ mi ɔ, wa maa pee a ma amɛ butuu.” 3Yawɛ bu Israel bi ɔmɛ a gbi tue, nɛ e ngɔ Kanaan bi ɔmɛ kɛ wo a dɛ mi; nɛ a kpata a kɛ a ma amɛ a hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a wo lejɛ ɔ biɛ ke Horma.
Akɔblee sinɔ ɔ
4 Benɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ si Hor yo ɔ, a ya gu Wo Tsu ɔ nya blɔ, konɛ a kɛ tsɔ Edom zugba a he. Se a tsui si tomi ya ta ngɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ, 5 nɛ a tu munyu kɛ si Mawu kɛ Mose ke, “Mɛni he je nɛ nyɛ kpaka wɔ kɛ je Egipt nɛ wa ba gbo ngɛ nga nɛ ɔ nɔ, he nɛ niye ní, loo nyu ko be ɔ? Kikɛmɛ a niye ní gbogboe nɛ ɔ lɛɛ wa sume oo, wa sume!” 6Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ ha sinɔhi nɛ a duɔ nya wa ba sɛ ma a kpɛti; nɛ a kɔɔ mɛ, nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ a ti nihi babauu gbo. 7Kɛkɛ nɛ ma a ba Mose ngɔ, nɛ a ba de ke, “Wa pee yayami kaa wa tu munyu kɛ si Yawɛ, kɛ mo hulɔ. Mo kpa Yawɛ pɛɛ nɛ e ba je sinɔ ɔmɛ kɛ je wa kpɛti.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Mose kpa pɛɛ ha ma a, 8nɛ Yawɛ de Mose ke, “Moo pee akɔblee sinɔ nɛ o ngɔ kɛ kpla tso he. Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ sinɔ maa kɔ lɛ, nɛ e maa hyɛ akɔblee sinɔ nɛ ɔ, e yi ma na wami.” 9 Mose pee akɔblee sinɔ, nɛ e kɛ kpla tso he; nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ sinɔ kɔ lɛ, nɛ e hyɛ akɔblee sinɔ ɔ, e yi na wami niinɛ.
A ba Moab kɔ̃ ɔ mi
10Israel bi ɔmɛ tsa a blɔ hiami ɔ nɔ, nɛ a ya to si ngɛ Obot. 11Nɛ́ a je Obot ɔ, a ya to si ngɛ Abarim, ngɛ nga a nɔ ngɛ Moab hanɔ, kɛ yaa beleku je. 12Nɛ́ a hia kɛ je lejɛ ɔ, a ya to si ngɛ Zered kɔ̃ ɔ mi. 13Nɛ́ a je lejɛ ɔ, a ya to si ngɛ Arnon pa a omleyi je ngɛ nga a nɔ kɛ yaa Amor bi ɔmɛ a huzu ɔ nya. (Arnon pa a ji huzu nɛ ngɛ Moab bi ɔmɛ, kɛ Amor bi ɔmɛ a kpɛti). 14Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, a deɔ ngɛ Yawɛ Tahi Womi ɔ mi ke,
“Wa ya be ngɛ Waheb ngɛ Sufa,
kɛ Arnon nyu dɔ ɔmɛ a he,
15kɛ nyu dɔ ɔmɛ a si kplemi he ɔ
nɛ maa e yi si kɛ yaa
he nɛ Ar fɔɔ si ngɛ ɔ,
ngɛ Moab huza amɛ a nɔ.”
16Nɛ́ a je lejɛ ɔ, a pue nɔ kɛ ho Beer ya. Beer ji vu nɛ Yawɛ de Mose ngɛ he ke, “Bua ma a nya nɛ a ha mɛ nyu nɛ a nu” ɔ nɛ. 17Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, Israel bi ɔmɛ la la nɛ ɔ:
“Vu, ha o nyu ɔ nɛ ba,
konɛ wa la kɛ kpee lɛ.
18Vu nɛ ganɔhi tsua,
nɛ ma nimeli ngɔ matsɛ tso,
kɛ dɛma tso kɛ je mi.”
Benɛ a hia kɛ je nga a nɔ ɔ, a pue nɔ kɛ ho Matana ya. 19Nɛ́ a je Matana a, a ho Nahaliel ya; nɛ́ a je Nahaliel ɔ, a ho Bamot ya. 20Nɛ́ a je Bamot ɔ, a ya gu kɔ̃ ɔ mi ngɛ Moab bi ɔmɛ a zugba a nɔ, kɛ ho Pisga yo ɔ nɛ hyɛɛ nga kplanaa a nɔ ɔ yi mi ya.
A ye Matsɛ Sihon kɛ Matsɛ Og a nɔ
(Mose V, 2.26—3.11)
21Kɛkɛ nɛ Israel ma a tsɔ nihi ke a ya de Amor matsɛ, Sihon ke, 22“Wa kpa mo pɛɛ, ha nɛ waa gu o zugba a nɔ kɛ be. Wa be ngmɔ, loo wai abɔɔ ko mi gue; wa be vu ko vu ko mi nyu nue. Matsɛ gbɛjegbɛ ɔ nɔ kɛkɛ wa maa nyɛɛ tɛɛ kɛ yaa si wa maa po mi ngɛ o zugba a nɔ.” 23Se Sihon ha we nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ nɛ gu e zugba a nɔ. Mohu ɔ, e bua e ta a tsuo nya kɛ ho Yahaz ya, nɛ e kɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ ya hwu ta ngɛ nga a nɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. 24Se Israel bi ɔmɛ kɛ klaate tane a yi, nɛ a ngɔ a zugba a kɛ je Arnon pa a nya kɛ ya pue Yabok pa a nɛ ji Amon bi ɔmɛ a huzu ɔ nya, ejakaa Amon bi ɔmɛ a huzu ɔ, a fia gbogbo ngɛ nɔ. 25Israel bi ɔmɛ ngɔ Amor bi ɔmɛ a ma ngua amɛ tsuo, kaa Heshbon kikɛ nɛ ɔ; nɛ a hi Amor bi ɔmɛ a ma ngua amɛ, kɛ kɔpe ɔmɛ tsuo a mi. 26Heshbon ji Amor matsɛ, Sihon matsɛ ma. Sihon nɛ ɔ ji nɔ nɛ e kɛ kekle Moab matsɛ ɔ hwu ta nɛ e ngɔ e zugba a tsuo ngɛ e dɛ kɛ ba si Arnon pa a nya a nɛ. 27Enɛ ɔ he je nɛ asilɛte ɔmɛ laa nɛ a deɔ ke,
“Nyɛɛ ba Matsɛ Sihon ma Heshbon!
Nyɛ ha nɛ a fia ma a, nɛ a dla lɛ ekohu.
28 Heshbon ma nɛ ɔ mi Sihon tabo ɔ je,
nɛ a ya kpata Ar nɛ ngɛ Moab,
kɛ Arnon yo ɔmɛ a nɔ nyɔmtsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a hɛ mi
kaa la nɛ ngɛ tsoe kpataa nɔ hɛ mi ɔ nɛ.
29Moab bi, due ha nyɛ!
Nyɛ Kemosh jali, nyɛ hɛ mi kpata!
Nyɛ mawu ɔ ha nyɛ binyumu ɔmɛ pee ko bɔli;
nɛ nyɛ biyi ɔmɛ hu pee Amor matsɛ,
Sihon nyɔguɛhi.
30Se piɔ lɛɛ a kpata a nina hɛ mi
kɛ je Heshbon kɛ ya si Dibon tɔɔ,
kɛ je Nashim kɛ ya si Nofa,
ngɛ Medeba kasa nya.”
31Bɔ nɛ pee nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ ya to si ngɛ Amor bi ɔmɛ a zugba a nɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. 32Mose tsɔ nihi ya slaa Yazer ma a. Israel bi ɔmɛ ngɔ ma a, kɛ kɔpehi nɛ bɔle lɛ ɔ tsuo; nɛ a fie Amor bi ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.
33Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, Israel bi ɔmɛ kpale a se ya gu Bashan blɔ ɔ nɔ. Bashan matsɛ, Og kɛ e tabo ɔ tsuo hia ta, nɛ a kɛ mɛ ba bua ngɛ Edrei, nɛ a hwu ta. 34Se Yawɛ de Mose ke, “Koo ye lɛ gbeye; ejakaa i ngɔ lɛ kɛ e ma a, kɛ e zugba a tsuo ngɔ wo o dɛ mi. Bɔ nɛ o pee Amor bi ɔmɛ a Matsɛ Sihon nɛ ye tsɛ ngɛ Heshbon ɔ, ja nɔuu o pee lɛ.” 35Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Israel bi ɔmɛ gbe Og, kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ, kɛ e ma mi bi ɔmɛ tsuo; nɔ kake ngmelu po píɛ. Nɛ a ngɔ zugba a.

Title: MOSE IV, 22
Content:
Balak kɛ Balaam
1Israel bi ɔmɛ pue nɔ, nɛ a ya to si ngɛ Moab nga kpataa a nɔ ngɛ Yordan pa a se, ngɛ Yeriko hanɔ.
2Benɛ Moab matsɛ, Balak, Zipor binyumu ɔ na Israel bi ɔmɛ a hiɛmi, kɛ bɔ nɛ a pee Amor bi ɔmɛ ɔ, 3e kɛ e ma a tsuo ye Israel bi ɔmɛ gbeye wawɛɛ nitsɛ. 4Moab bi ɔmɛ ya de Midian ma nimeli ɔmɛ ke, “E be kɛe nɛ ta nɛ ɔ ma kpata nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ bɔle wɔ ɔ hɛ mi kaa bɔ nɛ na ku kpeɔ nga ngɛ nga nɔ ɔ.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Matsɛ Balak 5 tsɔ nihi kɛ ho Petor ya, ngɛ Yufrate pa a kasa nya, ngɛ Amaw bi ɔmɛ a zugba a nɔ, nɛ́ a ya kpee Beor binyumu Balaam kɛ ba. E sɛ gbi ji, “I ngɛ hae nɛ o le kaa ma ko je Egipt kɛ ba, nɛ a ha zugba a tsuo nɔ. Amlɔ nɛ ɔ po a su ye ngɔ ta. 6Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i kpa mo pɛɛ, ba nɛ o ba gbiɛ ma nɛ ɔ ha wɔ kaa, alini wa maa ye a nɔ, nɛ wa maa fie mɛ kɛ je zugba a nɔ lo; ejakaa a hiɛ pe wɔ. I le kaa ke o gbaa nɔ ko ɔ, kɛkɛ a gbaa lɛ; nɛ ke o gbiɛ nɔ ko ɔ, kɛkɛ a gbiɛ lɛ.”
7Moab ma nimeli ɔmɛ, kɛ Midian ma nimeli ɔmɛ pue nɔ kɛ ho Balaam ngɔ ya. A hɛɛ sika nɛ a kɛ maa wo nɔ gbiɛmi ɔ he hiɔ ngɛ a dɛ, nɛ benɛ a ya su ɔ, a ngɔ Balak sɛ gbi ɔ ngɔ ha Balaam. 8Balaam de mɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ hwɔ hiɛ ɔ nyɔ nɛ ɔ mi, konɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ ma de mi ɔ, ma ha nɛ nyɛɛ le.” Nɛ Moab ma nimeli ɔmɛ hwɔ Balaam ngɔ.
9Mawu ba Balaam ngɔ, nɛ e ba bi lɛ ke, “Nyumu ɔmɛ nɛ ba to mo ɔ, mɛnɔmɛ ji mɛ?”
10Balaam ha heto ke, “Moab matsɛ, Balak, Zipor binyumu ɔ, lɛ nɛ e tsɔ mɛ ke a ba de mi ke 11ma a nɛ je Egipt kɛ ba a, ha zugba a tsuo nɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e ngɛ hlae nɛ ma ba gbiɛ mɛ ha lɛ, konɛ e nyɛ nɛ e kɛ mɛ nɛ hwu ta, nɛ e fie mɛ kɛ je zugba a nɔ.”
12Mawu de Balaam ke, “O kɛ mɛ ko ya, nɛ koo gbiɛ Israel ma a hulɔ; ejakaa a gbaa mɛ.”
13Balaam te si mɔtu nɛ e ya de Balak nimeli ɔmɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ kpale kɛ ho nyɛ ma mi ya; ejakaa Yawɛ kplɛɛ we kaa i kɛ nyɛ nɛ ya.” 14Kɛkɛ nɛ Moab ma nimeli ɔmɛ kpale a se kɛ ho Balak ngɔ ya, nɛ a ya de lɛ ke, “Balaam kplɛɛ we kaa e kɛ wɔ maa ba.”
15Balak kpale tsɔ ma nimeli kpahi kɛ ho; ni nɛ ɔmɛ hiɛ pe kekle ni ɔmɛ, nɛ a hɛ mi hu ngɛ nyami pe mɛ. 16A ya Balaam ngɔ nɛ a ya de lɛ ke, “Bɔ nɛ Balak, Zipor binyumu ɔ de ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: i kpa mo pɛɛ, ko ha nɛ nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko nɛ tsi mo ye ngɔ bami blɔ! 17Ma wo o hɛ mi nyami babauu, nɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ o ma de mi ɔ, ma pee. I kpa mo pɛɛ, ba nɛ o ba gbiɛ kikɛmɛ a ma nɛ ɔ ha mi.”
18Se Balaam he nɔ nɛ e de Balak tsɔli ɔmɛ ke, “Ke Balak ha mi sika hiɔ, loo sika tsu tsuo nɛ ngɛ e we ɔ mi po, i be nyɛe nɛ ma pee nɔ́ ko agbo, loo nyafii kɛ si nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ, ye Mawu ɔ de mi ɔ. 19Se kɛ̃, nyɛ hu nyɛɛ hwɔ hiɛ ɔ nyɔ nɛ ɔ mi, konɛ ma hyɛ kaa Yawɛ ngɛ nɔ́ kpa ko nɛ e ma de mi lo.”
20Jamɛ a nyɔ ɔ mi ɔ, Mawu ba Balaam ngɔ, nɛ e ba de lɛ ke, “Ke nimli nɛ ɔmɛ ba nɛ́ a ba kpee mo kɛ ho ɔ, tee si nɛ o kɛ mɛ nɛ ya. Se mohu, nɔ́ nɛ ma de mo ɔ, lɔ ɔ o pee.” 21Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Balaam te si mɔtu, nɛ e wo e teji yo ɔ nɔ ní; nɛ e kɛ Moab ma nimeli ɔmɛ pue nɔ kɛ ho.
Balaam kɛ e teji yo ɔ
22Se Mawu mi mi fu kaa Balaam ho. Benɛ Balaam hi e teji yo ɔ nɔ nɛ e kɛ e tsɔli enyɔ ɔmɛ yaa a, Yawɛ bɔfo ɔ ya po lɛ ngɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ. 23Benɛ teji yo ɔ na bɔfo ɔ nɛ e hia klaate kɛ daa si ngɛ blɔ ɔ mi ɔ, e gba kɛ je blɔ ɔ nɔ kɛ ho nga a mi ya. Balaam fia teji yo ɔ nɔ́, konɛ e kɛ dɔ e yi kɛ ba blɔ ɔ nɔ ekohu. 24Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ bɔfo ɔ ya da si ngɛ nane blɔ ko mi ngɛ wai ngmɔ enyɔ komɛ a kpɛti; nɛ gbogbo ngɛ hiɛ kɛ hiɛ. 25Benɛ teji yo ɔ na Yawɛ bɔfo ɔ, e ngɔ e he ya kpasa gbogbo ɔ, nɛ e mia Balaam nane kɛ wo gbogbo ɔ he. Balaam fia lɛ nɔ́ ekohu. 26Yawɛ bɔfo ɔ ya e hɛ mi ekohu, nɛ e ya da si ngɛ he ko tokofii, he nɛ blɔ ko blɔ ko be nɛ a kɛ plɛɔ he kɛ yaa nɔ hiɔ nɔ, loo nɔ muɔ nɔ. 27Benɛ teji yo ɔ na Yawɛ bɔfo ɔ ekohu ɔ, e kpla si ngɛ Balaam sisi. Balaam mi mi fu, nɛ e ngɔ e dɛma tso ɔ kɛ fia teji yo ɔ. 28Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ bli teji yo ɔ nya, nɛ e bi Balaam ke, “Mɛni i pee mo loko o fia mi nɔ́ si etɛ sɔuu kikɛ nɛ ɔ?”
29Balaam he nɔ nɛ e de teji yo ɔ ke, “Ejakaa o pee mi kuasia. I hɛɛ klaate jinɛ i gbe mo momo.”
30Teji yo ɔ ya nɔ nɛ e bi Balaam ke, “Anɛ pi mo nitsɛ o teji yo ji mi, nɛ o hii ye nɔ daa nɛ ɔ kɛ ba si mwɔnɛ ɔ lo? Anɛ i pee mo nɔ́ ko kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ hyɛ lo?” Balaam ha lɛ heto ke, “Dɛbi.”
31Jehanɛ ɔ, Yawɛ bli Balaam hɛngmɛ, nɛ e na Yawɛ bɔfo ɔ nɛ hɛɛ klaate kɛ daa si ngɛ blɔ ɔ mi. Kɛkɛ nɛ Balaam ma e yi si, nɛ e kɛ e hɛ mi bu si. 32Yawɛ bɔfo ɔ bi Balaam ke, “Mɛni he je nɛ o fia o teji yo ɔ nɔ́ si etɛ sɔuu kikɛ nɛ ɔ? O nɛ, pe i ba nɛ ma ba tsi mo blɔ; ejakaa blɔ nɛ o hia nɛ ɔ ngɔɛ ye nya. 33Teji yo ɔ na mi nɛ e yu e he kɛ je ye hɛ mi si etɛ sɔuu. Niinɛ, kaa e pee we ja jinɛ i gbe mo, nɛ i he teji yo ɔ yi wami.”
34Balaam de Yawɛ bɔfo ɔ ke, “I pee yayami; i li kaa mo lɛ o ba po mi ngɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke blɔ nɛ i hia nɛ ɔ dɛ ha mo ɔ, lɛɛ ma kpale ye se mɔ.”
35Se Yawɛ bɔfo ɔ de Balaam ke, “O kɛ nyumu ɔmɛ nɛ ya kɛkɛ; se mohu, munyu nɛ ma ngɔ kɛ wo o nya ke o tu ɔ, lɔ ɔ pɛ o de.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Balaam kɛ Balak tsɔli ɔmɛ pue nɔ kɛ ho.
Balak ba kpee Balaam
36Benɛ Balak nu kaa Balaam ma a, e ho nɛ e ya kpee lɛ ngɛ Ar tɔɔ. Ma nɛ ɔ ji ma ko nɛ ngɛ Arnon pa a nya, ngɛ Moab huzu ɔ nyagbe. 37Balak bi Balaam ke, “Anɛ i sɛ́ ke a ba de mo ke o ba nɛ o ba na mi dãã lo? Mɛni he je o bɛ nɛ o ba na mi ɔ? Anɛ o susuɔ kaa i be nyɛe ma wo o hɛ mi nyami lo?”
38Balaam de lɛ ke, “O nɛ mi; i ba! Imi nitsɛ lɛɛ i be he wami nɛ ma kɛ de nɔ́ ko. Nɔ́ nɛ Mawu ke ma de ɔ, lɔ ɔ ji nɔ́ nɛ ma de ɔ nɛ.” 39Kɛkɛ nɛ Balak kɛ Balaam pue nɔ kɛ ho Kiriat Huzot ya. 40Balak ngɔ nahi, kɛ tohi kɛ sã bɔ, nɛ e kɛ lo ɔ eko ha Balaam, kɛ ma nimeli nɛ piɛ e he ɔ.
Balaam kekleekle gbami
41E nɔ jena a, Balak ngɔ Balaam kɛ ho Bamot Baal ya, nɛ Balaam na Israel ma a fa ko kɛ je lejɛ ɔ.

Title: MOSE IV, 23
Content:
1Balaam de Balak ke, “Moo puɛ bɔ sami la tɛ kpaago ha mi ngɛ hiɛ ɔ, nɛ o ya hla na ku kpaago, kɛ agbosu kpaago kɛ ba.”
2Balak pee bɔ nɛ Balaam de lɛ ɔ, nɛ e kɛ Balaam sã na ku kake, kɛ agbosu kake ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ tsuaa bɔ sami la tɛ nɔ. 3Balaam de Balak ke, “Da si ngɛ o sami bɔ ɔ he, nɛ imi nɔ kake ma ya, kaa alini Yawɛ kɛ mi ma ba kpe lo. Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ e ma je tsɔɔ mi ɔ, ma ba de mo.” Kɛkɛ nɛ e pue nɔ kɛ ho yoku kpataa ko nɔ ya, 4nɛ Mawu kɛ lɛ ya kpe ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Balaam de Mawu ke, “I puɛ bɔ sami la tɛ kpaago ɔmɛ, nɛ i sã na ku kake, kɛ agbosu kake ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ tsuaa bɔ sami la tɛ nɔ.”
5Yawɛ tsɔɔ Balaam nɔ́ nɛ e de Balak, ne e ha nɛ e kpale e se, konɛ e ngɔ sɛ gbi nɛ ɔ ya ha Balak. 6Benɛ e kpale kɛ ho ɔ, e na kaa Balak daa si ngɛ e sami bɔ ɔ he kɛ mwɔɔ; lɛ, kɛ Moab ma nimeli ɔmɛ tsuo.
7Kɛkɛ nɛ gba gbi nɛ ɔ je Balaam nya, nɛ e de ke,
“Moab matsɛ, Balak ya kpee mi
kɛ je Aram tɔɔ.
E kpee mi kɛ je beleku yo ɔmɛ a nɔ,
nɛ e de mi ke,
‘Ba nɛ o ba gbiɛ Yakob ha mi,
nɛ o tu munyu kɛ si Israel!’
8Kɛ ma pee kɛɛ nɛ ma gbiɛ nihi
nɛ Mawu lɛɛ e gbíɛ mɛ;
loo ma tu munyu kɛ si nihi
nɛ Mawu lɛɛ e mi mi fu we mɛ?
9I da tɛ sa amɛ a nɔ kɛ hyɛ mɛ;
i na mɛ kɛ je yoku ɔmɛ a yi mi.
O nɛ, ma kake mi bi ji mɛ;
a kɛ a he bɔɛ ma je li ɔmɛ a he!
10Yakob nina ngɛ kaa bunyuku;
a he hiɛ babauu,
nɛ nɔ ko be nyɛe maa kane mɛ.
Ha nɛ ye nyagbe nɛ pee
kaa Mawu bi ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake.
Ha nɛ ma gbo ngɛ tue mi jɔmi mi kaa dalɔ.”
11Kɛkɛ nɛ Balak de Balaam ke, “Akuanyɛ! Mɛni o pee mi nɛ ɔ? I ngɔ mo kɛ ba hiɛ ɔ nɛ o ba gbiɛ ye he nyɛli ha mi, se gbaami mohu o ba gbaa mɛ.”
12E he nɔ ke, “Anɛ ma nyɛ ma de nɔ́ kpa ko pe nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ ke ma de ɔ lo?”
Balaam gbami nɛ ji enyɔ
13Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Balak de Balaam ke “Ha waa ya he kpa, he nɛ o maa na ma a fa ko kɛkɛ ngɛ, se pi mɛ tsuo, konɛ o gbiɛ mɛ ha mi ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.” 14E ngɔ lɛ kɛ ho Zofim nga a nɔ ya, ngɛ Pisga yo ɔ yi mi. Lejɛ ɔ hu e puɛ bɔ sami la tɛ kpaago, nɛ e sã na ku kake, kɛ agbosu kake ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ tsuaa bɔ sami la tɛ nɔ.
15Balaam de Balak ke, “Da si ngɛ o sami bɔ ɔ he ngɛ hiɛ ɔ, konɛ i kɛ Yawɛ ya kpe ngɛ hɛ mi ɔ.”
16Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ kɛ Balaam ba kpe. E tsɔɔ lɛ nɔ́ nɛ e de Balak, nɛ e ha nɛ e kpale e se, konɛ e ngɔ sɛ gbi nɛ ɔ ya ha Balak. 17Benɛ e kpale kɛ ho ɔ, e na kaa Balak daa si ngɛ e sami bɔ ɔ he kɛ mwɔɔ; lɛ, kɛ Moab ma nimeli ɔmɛ tsuo. Balak bi lɛ ke, “Kɛ Yawɛ de kɛɛ?” 18Kɛkɛ nɛ gba gbi nɛ ɔ je Balaam nya ke,
“Zipor bi Balak, moo bu
nɔ́ nɛ ma de mo ɔ tue!
19Mawu ɔ, pi nɔmlɔ ji lɛ nɛ e ngɔɔ nya,
pi nɔmlɔ ji lɛ nɛ e tsakeɔ e yi mi tomi.
Anɛ ke e de nɔ́ ko ɔ, e pee we lo?
Aloo e woɔ si nɛ e yi nɔ lo?
20Hyɛ, gbaami a fa mi ke ma ba gbaa.
Lɛɛ e gbaa momo; imi lɛɛ i be nyɛe ma kpale se.
21Mawu nɛ́ Yakob he yayami ko;
Mawu nɛ́ Israel he hiami ko.
Yawɛ, a Mawu ɔ kɛ mɛ ngɛ;
Yawɛ ji a matsɛ.
22Mawu ji nɔ nɛ je mɛ kɛ je Egipt.
Israel he wami ngɛ kaa na ku he wami.
23Kunya ko kunya ko be Yakob nyɛe,
Israel ɔ, klaami he wami ko be lɛ nyɛe.
Lɛɛ a ma de ngɛ Yakob, loo Israel he ke,
‘Nyɛɛ hyɛ nyakpɛ níhi nɛ Mawu tsu ha mɛ!’
24Israel ma a ngɛ kaa jata katsɛ;
e bu we si, nɛ e jɔɔ we e he,
ja e ye de lo ɔ tsuatsuaatsua,
nɛ e nu lohwe nɛ e gbe ɔ muɔ lolo.”
25Kɛkɛ nɛ Balak de Balaam ke, “Ke o be mɛ gbiɛe ɔ, lɛɛ koo gbaa mɛ mɔ.”
26Balaam he nɔ ke, “Anɛ i de we mo ke nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ de mi ke ma pee ɔ, lɔ ɔ pɛ ma pee lo?”
Balaam gbami nɛ ji etɛ
27Balak ya nɔ nɛ e de Balaam ke, “Ha nɛ wa pa ya he kpa, kaa alini jehanɛ lɛɛ Mawu maa kplɛɛ kaa o gbiɛ mɛ ha mi ngɛ lejɛ ɔ lo.” 28Nɛ Balak ngɔ Balaam kɛ ho Peor yo ɔ nɔ ya, he nɛ ke o ngɛ nɛ o hyɛɛ nga a nɔ ɔ. 29Balaam de Balak ke, “Moo puɛ bɔ sami la tɛ kpaago ha mi ngɛ hiɛ ɔ, nɛ o ya hla na ku kpaago kɛ agbosu hu kpaago kɛ ba.” 30Balak pee kaa bɔ nɛ Balaam de lɛ ɔ, nɛ e sã na ku kake, kɛ agbosu kake ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ tsuaa bɔ sami la tɛ nɔ.

Title: MOSE IV, 24
Content:
1Benɛ Balaam na kaa Yawɛ suɔ kaa e gbaa Israel ma a, e yɛ nɛ e ya bi Yawɛ ní kaa bɔ nɛ e pee sa a. Mohu, e plɛ e hɛ mi kɛ kpee nga a nɔ blɔ, 2nɛ e na Israel ma a nɛ a pueɔ si wɛtso nya wɛtso nya. 3Kɛkɛ nɛ Mawu mumi ɔ ba e nɔ, nɛ gba gbi nɛ ɔ je e nya ke,
“Beor binyumu Balaam sɛ gbi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Nyumu ɔ nɛ hyɛɛ nɔ́ saminya a
sɛ gbi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
4Nɔ nɛ nuɔ Mawu gbi,
Nɔ nɛ Mawu Ope ɔ jeɔ ninahi kɛ tsɔɔ lɛ,
Nɔ nɛ ke e hɛli po ɔ,
e hɛngmɛhi fɔɔ si paa.
5Yakob lee, o bo tsu ɔmɛ ngɛ fɛu;
Israel lee, o sito he ɔmɛ ngɛ fɛu.
6A ngɛ kaa dɔhi nɛ a gba kɛ yaa tsitsaa,
aloo abɔɔhi ngɛ pa tue.
A ngɛ kaa tso kɛ e he via nɛ Yawɛ du;
A ngɛ kaa seda tsohi ngɛ pa tue.
7Bɔ́ maa nɛ kɛ je e tso kɔni ɔmɛ a mi,
nɛ e ngmɛdu maa hi zugba kpakpa nɔ.
E matsɛ yemi ɔ maa kle pe Agag nɔ ɔ;
E nɔ yemi he ɔ yi ma bli.
8Benɛ Mawu je lɛ kɛ je Egipt kɛ ma a,
e he wami ngɛ kaa pu mi na ku he wami.
Ma je li ɔmɛ nɛ ji e he nyɛli ɔmɛ ɔ,
e maa ye mɛ tsuatsuaatsua;
e maa ywia a wu ɔmɛ mɔnyɔmɔnyɔ,
nɛ e kɛ e kɛ̃ɛ̃ mi bi ɔmɛ
maa gbɔ a mi mi kɛ ya pa si.
9 E bua e he nya, nɛ e buu si
kaa jata ku;
Ee e buu si kaa jata yo.
Mɛnɔ ma nyɛ maa tsɛɛ lɛ?
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ gbaa mo ɔ,
a maa gbaa lɛ;
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ gbiɛɛ mo ɔ,
a maa gbiɛ lɛ.”
10Kɛkɛ nɛ Balak mi mi fu Balaam wawɛɛ, nɛ e gba e dɛ mi ma, nɛ e de Balaam ke, “I kpee mo kɛ ba nɛ o ba gbiɛ ye he nyɛli ha mi; se si etɛ sɔuu ji nɛ ɔ nɛ o ngɛ mɛ gbaae mohu. 11Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, moo je hiɛ ɔ nɛ o ho esɔesɔ! I wo mo si kaa ma wo o hɛ mi nyami, se Yawɛ tsi o hɛ mi nyami womi ɔ nya.”
12Balaam ha Balak heto ke, “Anɛ i de we tsɔli ɔmɛ nɛ o tsɔ kɛ ba ye ngɔ ɔ ke, 13Ke Balak ngɔ sika hiɔ, loo sika tsu tsuo nɛ ngɛ e we ɔ mi kɛ ha mi po ɔ, i be nyɛe nɛ ma to ye yi mi nɛ ma pee nɔ́ ko nɛ kɛ fami nɛ Yawɛ fa mi ɔ yɛ, kpakpa jio, yayami jio, kaa ja nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ ke ma de ɔ, lɔ ɔ pɛ ma de ɔ lo?”
Balaam gbami nɛ ji eywiɛ
14“Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, piɔ lɛɛ i kpale kɛ yaa imi nitsɛ ye ma mi. Se loko ma je ɔ, ma suɔ nɛ ma wo o tue nɔ ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ kikɛmɛ a ma nɛ ɔ maa pee mo nitsɛ o ma mi bi ɔmɛ hwɔɔ se ɔ he.” 15Kɛkɛ nɛ gba gbi nɛ ɔ ba e nya, nɛ e de ke,
“Beor binyumu Balaam sɛ gbi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Nyumu ɔ nɛ hyɛɛ nɔ́ saminya a
sɛ gbi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
16Lɛ nɛ e nuɔ Mawu gbi;
Lɛ nɛ Mawu Ope ɔ jeɔ ninahi kɛ tsɔɔ;
Lɛ nɛ ke e hɛli po
e hɛngmɛhi fɔɔ si paa.
17I na lɛ, se e he kɛ;
I ngɛ lɛ hyɛe, se e sui hiɛ ɔ lolo.
Dodoe ko maa je Yakob mi kɛ ba;
Matsɛ tso ko maa je Israel;
E maa fia Moab ma nimeli ɔmɛ ní,
nɛ e ma kpata Set bi ɔmɛ a hɛ mi.
18E maa ye e he nyɛli ɔmɛ a nɔ ngɛ Edom;
nɛ e maa ngɔ a zugba a;
Israel maa ye kunimi daa.
19Yakob maa ye matsɛ,
nɛ e ma kpata ni nɛmɛ nɛ piɛ ɔ a hɛ mi.”
20Kɛkɛ nɛ Balaam na Amalek bi ɔmɛ ngɛ nina mi, nɛ gba gbi nɛ ɔ ba e nya, nɛ e de ke,
“Sa a, Amalek ji ma nɛ a he wa
pe je ma amɛ tsuo.
Se nyagbenyagbe ɔ, a ma kpata a hɛ mi.”
21Jehanɛ, e na Ken bi ɔmɛ ngɛ nina mi, nɛ gba gbi nɛ ɔ ba e nya, nɛ e de ke,
“Nyɛ sihi he ɔmɛ ngɛ he wami,
nɛ nyɛ ma nyɛ tsu ɔmɛ ngɛ tɛ sahi a nɔ.
22Se kɛ̃, Ken bi!
Asiria bi ma ba ngɔ nyɛ nyɔguɛ,
nɛ a ma kpata nyɛ hɛ mi.”
23Kɛkɛ nɛ gba gbi nɛ ɔ hu ba Balaam nya, nɛ e de ke,
“Akuanyɛ! Mɛnɔ maa hi hɛ ngmengmle
benɛ Mawu ngɛ enɛ ɔ pee ɔ?
24Lɛhi maa je Kipro wo nya kɛ ba,
nɛ a maa hao Asiria, kɛ Eber.
Nɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ hu a hɛ mi ma kpata!”
25Kɛkɛ nɛ Balaam dla e he nɛ e kpale kɛ ho e je he ya; nɛ Balak hu wo e blɔ.

Title: MOSE IV, 25
Content:
Israel bi ɔmɛ ngɛ Peor
1Benɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ ngɛ Shitim ɔ, a kɛ Moab yi ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ bɔni nyumu kɛ yo yakayaka fiɛmi fiɛmi. 2Yi nɛ ɔmɛ kpeeɔ mɛ kɛ yaa niye ní nɛ a kɛ ba sã bɔ ha a mawu ɔmɛ ɔ a he. A yeɔ ní ɔ, nɛ a jaa mawu ɔmɛ hulɔ. 3Kɛ gu enɛ ɔ peemi mi ɔ, Israel bi ɔmɛ kɛ a he ya wo Baal nɛ ngɛ Peor ɔ jami sisi. Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ha Yawɛ mi mi fu ma a, 4nɛ e de Mose ke, “Ngɔɔ ma nimeli ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ ya nɛ o ya sɛu mɛ ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi piani katakata; kɛkɛ ɔ, ye mi mi fumi nɛ nya wa a maa je Israel nɔ.” 5Mose de Israel ma kojoli ɔmɛ ke, “Nyɛ ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ gbe lɛ nitsɛ e he nihi nɛ a kɛ a he ya mɛtɛ Baal nɛ ngɛ Peor he ɔ.”
6Benɛ Mose kɛ Israel ma kpekpemi ɔ bua a he nya, nɛ a wo yana ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ sinya a nya a, Israel bi ɔmɛ a kpɛti nyumu ko ya wo Midian yo ko kɛ ba sɛ e bo tsu mi, ngɛ Mose kɛ ma a tsuo a hɛ mi paa. 7Benɛ Eleazar bi Finehas, nɛ ji osɔfo Aaron bibi ɔ na nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, e te si kɛ je gua a mi. E ya kɛ̃ akplɔ, 8nɛ e nyɛɛ Israel no ɔ se kɛ ya sɛ e se tsu mi; nɛ e kɛ akplɔ nɛ e hɛɛ ɔ gbɔ nyumu ɔ kɛ yo ɔ tsuo kɛ ya pa si. Kɛkɛ nɛ gbenɔ hiɔ ɔ se po ngɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ a kpɛti. 9Se kɛ̃ nimli nɛ gbenɔ hiɔ ɔ gbe ɔ, a hiɛmi ji akpe nyingmi enyɔ kɛ eywiɛ.
10Yawɛ de Mose ke, 11“Nɔ́ nɛ Eleazar binyumu Finehas, osɔfo Aaron bibi ɔ pee nɛ ɔ ha nɛ ye mi mi nɛ fu Israel ma a nya ba si. E je hunga ha mi, nɛ enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, i be ye ma a hɛ mi kpatae hu. 12Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, mo de lɛ ke, i kɛ lɛ ngɛ he jɔmi somi soe. 13E maa pee lɛ, kɛ e nina tsuo a nɔ́, nɛ a maa da nɔ kɛ ye osɔfo kɛ maa ya neneene. Ejakaa e kplɛɛ we nɛ nihi kɛ mi nɛ plee nɔ́ he, nɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ha nɛ a kɛ Israel ma a he yayami pa mɛ.”
14Israel no ɔ nɛ a gbe e kɛ Midian yo ɔ, lɛ ji Salu binyumu Zimri. Wɛtsoyi ji lɛ ngɛ Simeon bi ɔmɛ a wɛtso ɔ mi. 15Moab yo ɔ nɛ a gbe ɔ, lɛ hu e biɛ ji Kozbi. E tsɛ Zur ɔ, lɛ hu Midian bi a wɛtso kake nyatsɛ ji lɛ.
16Yawɛ de Mose ke, 17“Jehanɛ, nyɛɛ ya nɛ nyɛ ya tua Midian bi ɔmɛ, nɛ nyɛ kpata a hɛ mi, 18ejakaa a gu sisimi blɔ nɔ nɛ a kɛ nyɛ wo haomi mi. A ha nɛ nyɛ ya ja Baal nɛ ngɛ Peor ɔ, nɛ nyɛ kɛ tɔtɔ nyɛ nane. Midian wɛtsoyi ɔ biyo Kozbi, nɔ nɛ a gbe benɛ gbenɔ hiɔ ɔ ngɛ ní tsue ɔ, e sane ɔ yeɔ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ he odase.”

Title: MOSE IV, 26
Content:
Nihi a kanemi enyɔne ɔ
1 Gbenɔ hiɔ ɔ se ɔ, Yawɛ de Mose kɛ osɔfo Aaron bi Eleazar ke, 2“Nyɛɛ kane Israel ma kpekpemi ɔ tsuo we puɔ nya we puɔ nya, kɛ je ni nɛmɛ nɛ ye jeha nyingmi enyɔ kɛ yaa, nɛ a ma nyɛ ya ta a nɔ.” 3Mose kɛ osɔfo Eleazar ya nɛ a kɛ ma a ya tu munyu ngɛ Moab nga kplanaa a nɔ, ngɛ Yordan pa a nya, ngɛ Yeriko hanɔ; 4nɛ a ngma ni nɛmɛ nɛ a ye kɛ je jeha nyingmi enyɔ kɛ yaa a a biɛ kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa Mose ɔ.
Israel ma a nɛ je Egipt kɛ ba a ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
5Ruben wɛtso ɔ (Ruben ji Yakob kekleekle binyumu): wekuhi nɛ ngɛ Ruben wɛtso ɔ mi ji Hanok weku ɔ, kɛ a nyatsɛ Hanok; Palu weku ɔ, kɛ a nyatsɛ Palu; 6Hezron weku ɔ, kɛ a nyatsɛ Hezron; Karmi weku ɔ, kɛ a nyatsɛ Karmi. 7A hiɛmi ji 43,730. 8Palu bi ji Eliab, 9nɛ Eliab bimɛ ji Nemuel, Datan, kɛ Abiram. (Datan kɛ Abiram nɛ ɔ ji gua mi bimɛ nɛ ma kpekpemi ɔ hla. Mɛ ji ni nɛmɛ nɛ hyɛ Mose kɛ Aaron hɛ mi, nɛ pee se ɔ, a ya piɛ Kora kɛ e we bi ɔmɛ a he kɛ tsɔ Yawɛ hɛ mi atuã a nɛ. 10Zugba mi gba enyɔ ngɛ a sisi, nɛ e mii a kɛ Kora tsuo; nɛ a gbo. Nyumuhi lafa enyɔ kɛ nyingmi enuɔ ɔmɛ lɛɛ la sã mɛ, nɛ a plɛ pee kɔkɔ bɔmi okadi kɛ ha ma a. 11Se Kora bimɛ ɔmɛ lɛɛ a gbo we.)
12Simeon wɛtso ɔ: wekuhi nɛ ngɛ mi ji Nemuel weku ɔ, kɛ a nyatsɛ Nemuel; Yamin weku ɔ, kɛ a nyatsɛ Yamin; Yakin weku ɔ, kɛ a nyatsɛ Yakin; 13Zera weku ɔ, kɛ a nyatsɛ Zera; Shaul weku ɔ, kɛ a nyatsɛ Shaul. 14A hiɛmi ji 22,200.
15Gad wɛtso ɔ: wekuhi nɛ ngɛ mi ji Zefon weku ɔ, kɛ a nyatsɛ Zefon; Hagi weku ɔ, kɛ a nyatsɛ Hagi, Shuni weku ɔ, kɛ a nyatsɛ Shuni; 16Ozni weku ɔ, kɛ a nyatsɛ Ozni; Eri weku ɔ, kɛ a nyatsɛ Eri; 17Arod weku ɔ, kɛ a nyatsɛ Arod; Areli weku ɔ, kɛ a nyatsɛ Areli. 18A hiɛmi ji 40,500.
19-21Yuda wɛtso ɔ: wekuhi nɛ ngɛ mi ji Shela weku ɔ, kɛ a nyatsɛ Shela; Perez weku ɔ, kɛ a nyatsɛ Perez; Zera weku ɔ, kɛ a nyatsɛ Zera; Hezron weku ɔ, kɛ a nyatsɛ Hezron; Hamul weku ɔ, kɛ a nyatsɛ Hamul (Yuda binyumuhi ji Er kɛ Onan, se mɛɛ a gbo ngɛ Kanaan zugba a nɔ.) 22A hiɛmi ji 76,500.
23Isakar wɛtso ɔ: wekuhi nɛ ngɛ mi ji Tola weku ɔ, kɛ a nyatsɛ Tola; Puva weku ɔ, kɛ a nyatsɛ Puva. 24Yashub weku ɔ, kɛ a nyatsɛ Yashub; Shimron weku ɔ, kɛ a nyatsɛ Shimron. 25A hiɛmi ji 64,300.
26Zebulun wɛtso ɔ: wekuhi nɛ ngɛ mi ji Sered weku ɔ, kɛ a nyatsɛ Sered; Elon weku ɔ, kɛ a nyatsɛ Elon; Yahleel weku ɔ, kɛ a nyatsɛ Yahleel. 27A hiɛmi ji 60,500.
28Yosef ngɛ binyumuhi enyɔ: Manase kɛ Efraim.
29Manase wɛtso ɔ: Manase binyumu Makir ɔ, e bi ji Gilead, nɛ weku nɛ ɔmɛ je Gilead mi: 30Yazer weku ɔ, kɛ a nyatsɛ Yazer; Helek weku ɔ, kɛ a nyatsɛ Helek; 31Asriel weku ɔ, kɛ a nyatsɛ Asriel; Shekem weku ɔ, kɛ a nyatsɛ Shekem; 32Shemida weku ɔ, kɛ a nyatsɛ Shemida; Hefer weku ɔ, kɛ a nyatsɛ Hefer. 33Hefer binyumu Zelofehad lɛɛ e be binyumu; biyihi pɛ lɛ a fɔ ha lɛ. Zelofehad biyi ɔmɛ a biɛhi ji Mahla, Noa, Hogla, Milka, kɛ Tirza. 34Manase wɛtso ɔ mi bimɛ tsuo a hiɛmi ji 52,700.
35Efraim wɛtso ɔ: wekuhi nɛ ngɛ mi ji Shutela weku ɔ, kɛ a nyatsɛ Shutela; Beker weku ɔ, kɛ a nyatsɛ Beker; Tahan weku ɔ, kɛ a nyatsɛ Tahan. 36Shutela bimɛ ji Eran weku ɔ, kɛ a nyatsɛ Eran. 37Efraim wɛtso ɔ mi bi tsuo a hiɛmi ji 32,500.
Wekuhi nɛ je Yosef mi ji lɔ ɔmɛ nɛ.
38Benyamin wɛtso ɔ: wekuhi nɛ ngɛ mi ji Bela weku ɔ, kɛ a nyatsɛ Bela; Ashbel weku ɔ, kɛ a nyatsɛ Ashbel; Ahiram weku ɔ, kɛ a nyatsɛ Ahiram; 39Shefufam weku ɔ, kɛ a nyatsɛ Shefufam; Hufam weku ɔ, kɛ a nyatsɛ Hufam. 40Ard kɛ Naaman weku ɔmɛ je Bela weku ɔ mi. 41Benyamin wɛtso ɔ mi bi tsuo a hiɛmi ji 45,600.
42Dan wɛtso ɔ: weku nɛ ngɛ Dan wɛtso ɔ mi ji Shuham weku ɔ, kɛ a nyatsɛ Shuham, 43nɛ a hiɛmi ji 64,400.
44Asher wɛtso ɔ: wekuhi nɛ ngɛ mi ji Imna weku ɔ, kɛ a nyatsɛ Imna; Ishvi weku ɔ, kɛ a nyatsɛ Ishvi; Beria weku ɔ, kɛ a nyatsɛ Beria; 45Heber weku ɔ, kɛ a nyatsɛ Heber; Malkiel weku ɔ, kɛ a nyatsɛ Malkiel. 46Asher ngɛ biyo ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Sera. 47Asher wɛtso ɔ mi bi a hiɛmi ji 53,400.
48Naftali wɛtso ɔ: wekuhi nɛ ngɛ mi ji Yazeel weku ɔ, kɛ a nyatsɛ Yazeel; Guni weku ɔ, kɛ a nyatsɛ Guni; 49Yezer weku ɔ, kɛ a nyatsɛ Yezer; Shilem weku ɔ kɛ a nyatsɛ Shilem. 50Naftali wɛtso ɔ mi bi ahiɛmi ji 45,400.
51Israel bi ɔmɛ a kpɛti nyumuhi nɛ a ngma a biɛ ɔ, mɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ a hiɛmi ji 601,730.
Zugba a dlami
52 Yawɛ de Mose ke, 53“Dla zugba a kɛ ha wɛtso ɔmɛ ngɛ a hiɛmi nya, konɛ e pee a nɔ. 54-56Wɛtso nya dali ɔmɛ nɛ a fɔ sɔ kɛ dla zugba a. Wɛtso nɛ mi bimɛ hiɛ ɔ, a na zugba agbo; se wɛtso nɛ mi bimɛ a he pi lɛɛ a na zugba bɔbɔyoo.”
57Levi wɛtso ɔ, wekuhi nɛ ngɛ mi ji Gershon weku ɔ, kɛ a nyatsɛ Gershon; Kohat weku ɔ, kɛ a nyatsɛ Kohat; Merari weku ɔ, kɛ a nyatsɛ Merari. 58Levi wɛtso ɔ mi weku komɛ hu ji Libni, Hebron, Mahli, Mushi, kɛ Kora. Kohat bi ji Amram. 59Amram yo ji Yokebed, Levi biyo ɔ nɛ e fɔ ngɛ Egipt ɔ. Amram kɛ lɛ fɔ Aaron, Mose, kɛ a nyɛmiyo Miriam. 60 Aaron bimɛ ji Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, kɛ Itamar. 61 Se Nadab, kɛ Abihu gbo benɛ a ngɔ la nɛ he tsɔ we kɛ sã bɔ ha Yawɛ ɔ. 62Nyumuhi nɛ ngɛ Levi wɛtso ɔ mi, nɛ a ye kɛ je nyɔhiɔ kake kɛ yaa, nɛ a ngma a biɛ ɔ, a hiɛmi ji 23,000. A kane we mɛ kɛ piɛ we Israel bi kpa amɛ a he; ejakaa mɛɛ lɛɛ a ha we mɛ weto ní ko ngɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ a kpɛti.
63Ni nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ji nihi nɛ Mose kɛ osɔfo Eleazar ngma a biɛ, benɛ a kane Israel ma a ngɛ Moab nga kplanaa a nɔ, ngɛ Yordan pa a se, ngɛ Yeriko hanɔ ɔ. 64Se nihi nɛ Mose kɛ osɔfo Aaron ngma a biɛ, benɛ a kane Israel ma a ngɛ Sinai nga a nɔ ɔ, jamɛatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake ngmelu be ni nɛ ɔmɛ a kpɛti. 65 Yawɛ de to kaa mɛ tsuo kulaa a ma gbo ngɛ nga a nɔ. Nɛ niinɛ, Yefune binyumu Kaleb, kɛ Nun binyumu Yoshua pɛ ji a ti ni nɛmɛ nɛ piɛ.

Title: MOSE IV, 27
Content:
Zelofehad biyi ɔmɛ
1-2Ligbi ko ɔ, Zelofehad biyi enuɔ ɔmɛ ngɔ a hiami sane ko kɛ ba fɔ Mose, osɔfo Eleazar, ma nimeli ɔmɛ, kɛ Israel ma kpekpemi ɔ tsuo a hɛ mi ngɛ kpe he bo tsu ɔ sinya a nya. Yi nɛ ɔmɛ a biɛhi ji Mahla, Noa, Hogla, Milka kɛ Tirza, nɛ a je Yosef binyumu Manase wɛtso fa a mi. A nɛ̃ biɛ ji Hefer, nɛ a nɛnɛkasowa ji Gilead, Makir binyumu ɔ. A we amaniɛ ji, 3“Wa tsɛ gbo ngɛ nga a nɔ. Lɛɛ e piɛ we Kora se nyɛɛli ɔmɛ nɛ te si ngɔ wo Yawɛ ɔ a he; lɛ nitsɛ e yayami nɛ gbe lɛ. Se e be binyumu. 4Ke wa tsɛ be binyumu ɔ, kɛkɛ e sa kaa e biɛ nɛ laa ngɛ Israel lo? Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ ha wɔ hu weto ní ɔ eko kaa wa tsɛ nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ.”
5Mose ngɔ a sane ɔ kɛ ya fɔ Yawɛ hɛ mi, 6nɛ Yawɛ de Mose ke, 7 “Zelofehad biyi ɔmɛ a sane ɔ da. Ha mɛ hu weto ní ɔ eko kaa a tsɛ nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ; ngɔɔ a tsɛ zugba a kɛ ha mɛ. 8Jehanɛ, de Israel bi ɔmɛ ke, ke nyumu ko gbo nɛ e be binyumu ɔ, e biyo nɛ ye e ní. 9Ke e be biyo ɔ, a ngɔ gbosi ní ɔ kɛ ha e nyɛminyumuhi. 10Ke e be nyɛminyumuhi ɔ, a ngɔ gbosi ní ɔ kɛ ha e tsɛ nyɛminyumuhi. 11Ke e tsɛ ɔ hu be nyɛminyumuhi ɔ, lɛɛ a ngɔ gbosi ní ɔ kɛ ha e he nɔ pɔtɛɛ ko ngɛ weku ɔ mi. Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ maa pee mlaa kɛ ha Israel bi ɔmɛ, kaa bɔ nɛ imi Yawɛ, i fa mo ɔ.”
A hla Yoshua ke e ye Mose se
(Mose V, 31.1-8)
12 Yawɛ de Mose ke, “Yaa nɛ o ya kuɔ Abarim yo ɔ, nɛ o kɛ o hɛngmɛ nɛ hyɛ zugba a nɛ i ngɔ kɛ ha Israel ma a. 13Ke o hyɛ ta a, mo hu o ma gbo kaa bɔ nɛ o nyɛminyumu Aaron gbo ɔ; 14ejakaa nyɛ ni enyɔ ɔmɛ tsuo nyɛ tsɔ ye hɛ mi atuã ngɛ Zin nga a nɔ. Benɛ Israel ma a te si ngɔ wo mi ngɛ Meriba a, nyɛ je we ye he wami klɔuklɔu ɔ kpo kɛ tsɔɔ we mɛ kaa bɔ nɛ i fa nyɛ ɔ.” (Meriba ji taku ko ngɛ Kadesh ngɛ Zin nga a nɔ.)
15Mose fa kue ha Yawɛ ke, 16“Yawɛ, mo nimli adesahi tsuo a Mawu, i kpa mo pɛɛ nɛ mo nitsɛ o hla nyumu ko kɛ da ma kpekpemi nɛ ɔ nya, 17 nɔ nɛ maa nyɛɛ a hɛ mi, nɛ e ma kpaka mɛ kɛ ya kɛ ba, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ mo Yawɛ, o ma kpekpemi ɔ nɛ ko pee kaa tohi nɛ be hyɛlɔ.”
18 Yawɛ de Mose ke, “Yaa ngɔ Nun binyumu Yoshua, nɛ o kɛ o nine pue e yi mi. Nɔmlɔ nɛ ɔ, ye mumi ɔ ngɛ e mi, nɛ e ma nyɛ ma tsu ní ɔ. 19Ha nɛ e ba da si ngɛ osɔfo Eleazar, kɛ ma kpekpemi ɔ tsuo a hɛ mi, nɛ o to lɛ si kaa o se yelɔ. 20Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, ngɔɔ mo nitsɛ o he wami ɔ eko ngɔ wo e dɛ, konɛ ma kpekpemi ɔ tsuo nɛ bu lɛ. 21 É ba e he si ha osɔfo Eleazar, konɛ osɔfo Eleazar hu nɛ ngɔ Urim kɛ Tumim kɛ bi Yawɛ ga womi ha lɛ. Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ ma de Eleazar a, lɔ ɔ Yoshua, kɛ Israel ma kpekpemi ɔ tsuo maa pee.” 22Mose pee kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa lɛ ɔ. E ngɔ Yoshua ba da si ngɛ osɔfo Eleazar, kɛ ma kpekpemi ɔ tsuo a hɛ mi. 23 Nɛ, kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa lɛ ɔ, Mose ngɔ e nine kɛ pue Yoshua yi mi; nɛ e ngɔ he wami ɔ ngɔ wo e dɛ kaa e se yelɔ.

Title: MOSE IV, 28
Content:
Bɔhi nɛ sa kaa a sã
(Mose II, 29.38-46)
1Yawɛ de Mose ke, 2“Mo fa Israel bi ɔmɛ ke, ‘Ye nike ní nɛ ji ye niye ní bɔ nɛ o kɛ la sãã, nɛ jeɔ via ha mi ɔ, nyɛ hɛ nɛ hi nɔ nɛ nyɛɛ ngɔ kɛ ba ha mi ngɛ be nɛ sa mi.’
3“Mo de mɛ ke, sami bɔ nɛ nyɛɛ sã kɛ ha Yawɛ ji, daa ligbi ɔ, jijɔ ku enyɔ nɛ a ye jeha kakaaka, nɛ kpa ko kpa ko be a he. 4O kɛ jijɔ ku kake nɛ sã bɔ mɔtu, nɛ o kɛ kake hu nɛ sã bɔ gbɔkuɛ. 5Ngɔɔ ngma bɔ ngɔ piɛ he; lɔ ɔ ji ngma mamu bukɔbukɔ kilo kake nɛ a kɛ nu kpakpa lita kake futu mi. 6Enɛ ɔ ji daa sami bɔ nɛ a to sisi ngɛ Sinai yo ɔ he; bɔ nɛ a kɛ la sãã, nɛ jeɔ via ha Yawɛ. 7A ngɔ wai lita kake kɛ piɛ kekleekle lohwe ɔ he, nɛ a kɛ sã bɔ ngɛ he klɔuklɔu ɔ kɛ ha Yawɛ. 8Jijɔ ku kake ɔ hu nɛ a kɛ maa sã bɔ gbɔkuɛ ɔ, lɛ hu a ngɔ ngma bɔ, kɛ wai bɔ kɛ piɛ he kaa mɔtu nɔ́ ɔ kɛ̃, konɛ e pee bɔ nɛ a kɛ la sãã, nɛ jeɔ via ha Yawɛ.
Hejɔɔmi ligbi bɔ sami
9“Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ, nyɛɛ ngɔ jijɔ ku enyɔ nɛ a ye jeha kakaaka, nɛ kpa ko kpa ko be a he kɛ sã bɔ. Nyɛɛ ngɔ ngma mamu bukɔbukɔ kilo enyɔ nɛ a kɛ nu futu mi kɛ pee ngma bɔ, kɛ e he wai bɔ, nɛ nyɛ kɛ piɛ lohwe ɔ he. 10Daa Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ, a sã sami bɔ nɛ ɔ; slo daa sami bɔ ɔ, kɛ e he wai bɔ ɔ.
Nyɔhiɔhe bɔ sami
11“Daa nyɔhiɔ sisije ɔ, nyɛɛ ngɔ na niheyo enyɔ, agbosu kake, kɛ jijɔ ku kpaago nɛ a ye jeha kakaaka, nɛ kpa ko kpa ko be a he kɛ sã sami bɔ kɛ ha Yawɛ. 12Nyɛɛ ngɔ ngma mamu bukɔbukɔ kilo etɛ nɛ a futu lɛ kɛ nu, nɛ a kɛ pee ngma bɔ kɛ piɛ na ku fɛɛ na ku he. Nyɛɛ ngɔ ngma mamu bukɔbukɔ kilo enyɔ nɛ a futu lɛ kɛ nu, nɛ a kɛ pee ngma bɔ kɛ piɛ agbosu kake ɔ he. 13Nyagbe ɔ, nyɛɛ ngɔ ngma mamu bukɔbukɔ kilo kake nɛ a futu lɛ kɛ nu, nɛ a kɛ pee ngma bɔ kɛ piɛ jijɔ ku ɔmɛ eko fɛɛ eko he. Enɛ ɔ ji sami bɔ nɛ a kɛ la sãã, nɛ jeɔ via ha Yawɛ. 14Wai bɔ nɛ a kɛ maa piɛ he ji wai kilo enyɔ kɛ ha na ku kake, wai lita kake kɛ fa kɛ ha agbosu ɔ, kɛ wai lita kake kɛ ha jijɔ ku kake ɔ. Sami bɔ he mlaa kɛ ha nyɔhiɔ tsuaa nyɔhiɔ ngɛ jeha kake mi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. 15Jehanɛ, ngɛ daa sami bɔ ɔ, kɛ e he wai bɔ ɔ se ɔ, a ngɔ apletsi ku kake kɛ sã yayami pami bɔ kɛ ha Yawɛ.
Abolokplolo nyami be bɔ sami
(Mose III, 23.5-14)
16 “Kekleekle nyɔhiɔ ɔ we ligbi nɛ ji nyɔngma kɛ eywiɛ ɔ ji Yawɛ Hetsɔmi nyami be ɔ nɛ. 17 Kikɛmɛ a nyɔhiɔ nɛ ɔ nɔuu we ligbi nɛ ji nyɔngma kɛ enuɔ ɔ, nyɛ maa je nyami be nguaa ko yemi sisi; nɛ a maa ye lɛ otsi sɔuu. A ye abolo kplolo pɛ jamɛ a otsi ɔ. 18Kekleekle ligbi ɔ, a bua he nya nɛ a ja Mawu; se a ko tsu ní tsumi ko nɛ he wa. 19A ngɔ lohwe nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ sã sami bɔ ha Yawɛ: na ku enyɔ, agbosu kake, kɛ jijɔ ku kpaago nɛ a ye jeha kakaaka, nɛ kpa ko kpa ko be a he. 20Ngma bɔ nɛ a kɛ piɛ lohwe ɔmɛ a he ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ: na ku kake nɔ́ ji ngma mamu bukɔbukɔ kilo etɛ nɛ a kɛ nu futu lɛ. Agbosu ɔ nɔ́ ji ngma mamu bukɔbukɔ kilo enyɔ nɛ a kɛ nu futu lɛ. 21Jijɔ ku kpaago ɔmɛ ɔ, eko fɛɛ eko nɔ́ ji ngma mamu bukɔbukɔ kilo kake nɛ a kɛ nu futu lɛ. 22Jehanɛ, a ngɔ akpakpo kake kɛ sã yayami pami bɔ, nɛ a kɛ kpata Yawɛ ha ma a. 23A sã bɔ nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ piɛ mɔtu sami bɔ ɔ he. 24Ja nɔuu, a sã niye ní bɔ ligbi kpaago kɛ ha Yawɛ. Enɛ ɔ ji bɔ nɛ a kɛ la sãã, nɛ jeɔ via saminya ha Yawɛ; slo enɛ ɔ ngɛ daa sami bɔ ɔ, kɛ e he wai bɔ ɔ he. 25Ligbi nɛ ji kpaago ɔ, nyɛ bua nyɛ he nya, nɛ nyɛ ja Mawu; nyɛ ko tsu ní tsumi ko nɛ he wa.
Ngmakpami nyami be bɔ sami
(Mose III, 23.15-22)
26 “Ngmakpami nyami be kekleekle ligbi ɔ, benɛ nyɛ maa ngɔ ngma he kɛ ba sã bɔ ha Yawɛ ɔ, nyɛ bua nyɛ he nya, nɛ nyɛ ja Mawu; nyɛ ko tsu ní tsumi ko nɛ he wa. 27Nyɛɛ ngɔ lohwe nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ sã sami bɔ nɛ jee via saminya, nɛ saa Yawɛ hɛ mi: na ku niheyo enyɔ, agbosu kake, kɛ jijɔ ku kpaago nɛ a ye jeha kakaaka. 28Ngma bɔ nɛ nyɛɛ ngɔ kɛ piɛ lohwe ɔmɛ a he ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: na ku kake ɔ nɔ́ ji ngma mamu bukɔbukɔ kilo etɛ nɛ a kɛ nu futu lɛ. Agbosu ɔ nɔ́ ji ngma mamu bukɔbukɔ kilo enyɔ nɛ a kɛ nu futu lɛ. 29Jijɔ ku kpaago ɔmɛ ɔ, eko fɛɛ eko nɔ́ ji ngma mamu bukɔbukɔ kilo kake nɛ a kɛ nu futu lɛ. 30Jehanɛ, nyɛɛ ngɔ akpakpo kake kɛ sã yayami pami bɔ, nɛ a kɛ kpata Yawɛ ha ma a. 31Nyɛɛ sã bɔ nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ a he wai bɔ ɔ kɛ piɛ daa ligbi sami bɔ ɔ, kɛ niye ní bɔ ɔ a he. Nyɛɛ hyɛ nɛ kpa ko kpa ko kó hi bɔ sami lohwe ɔmɛ a he.”

Title: MOSE IV, 29
Content:
Jehahe nyami be bɔhi
(Mose III, 23.23-25)
1Nyɔhiɔ nɛ ji kpaago ɔ we kekleekle ligbi ɔ, nyɛ bua nyɛ he nya nɛ nyɛ ja Mawu; nyɛ ko tsu ní tsumi ko nɛ he wa. Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, nyɛ kpa titimati ɔmɛ, 2nɛ nyɛɛ ngɔ lohwe nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ sã sami bɔ nɛ jee via saminya, nɛ saa Yawɛ hɛ mi: na ku kake, agbosu kake, kɛ jijɔ ku kpaago nɛ a ye jeha kakaaka, nɛ kpa ko kpa ko be a he. 3Ngma bɔ nɛ nyɛɛ ngɔ kɛ piɛ lohwe ɔmɛ a he ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: na ku ɔ nɔ́ ji ngma mamu bukɔbukɔ kilo etɛ nɛ a kɛ nu futu lɛ. Agbosu ɔ nɔ́ ji ngma mamu bukɔbukɔ kilo enyɔ nɛ a kɛ nu futu lɛ. 4Jijɔ ku kpaago ɔmɛ ɔ, eko fɛɛ eko nɔ́ ji ngma mamu bukɔbukɔ kilo kake nɛ a kɛ nu futu lɛ. 5Jehanɛ, nyɛɛ ngɔ akpakpo kake kɛ sã yayami pami bɔ, nɛ a kɛ kpata Yawɛ ha ma a. 6Nyɛɛ sã bɔ nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ piɛ daa Nyɔhiɔhe kekleekle ligbi sami bɔ ɔ, kɛ ngma bɔ ɔ a he; slo daa sami bɔ ɔ, kɛ e he ngma bɔ ɔ, kɛ e he wai bɔ ɔ ngɛ a blɔ nya blɔ nya. Enɛ ɔmɛ maa pee bɔhi nɛ a kɛ la sãã, nɛ jee via, nɛ saa Yawɛ hɛ mi.
Kpatami ligbi bɔ sami
(Mose III, 23.26-32)
7 “Nyɔhiɔ nɛ ji kpaago ɔ we ligbi nɛ ji nyɔngma a, nyɛ bua nyɛ he nya nɛ nyɛ ja Mawu. Nyɛɛ ha hwɔ, nɛ nyɛ ko tsu ní tsumi ko. 8Nyɛɛ ngɔ lohwe nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ sã sami bɔ nɛ jee via saminya, nɛ saa Yawɛ hɛ mi: na ku kake, agbosu kake, kɛ jijɔ ku kpaago nɛ a ye jeha kakaaka, nɛ kpa ko kpa ko be a he. 9Ngma bɔ nɛ nyɛɛ ngɔ kɛ piɛ lohwe ɔmɛ a he ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: na ku kake ɔ nɔ́ ji ngma mamu bukɔbukɔ kilo etɛ nɛ a kɛ nu futu lɛ. Agbosu ɔ nɔ́ ji ngma mamu bukɔbukɔ kilo enyɔ nɛ a kɛ nu futu lɛ. 10Jijɔ ku kpaago ɔmɛ ɔ, eko fɛɛ eko nɔ́ ji ngma mamu bukɔbukɔ kilo kake nɛ a kɛ nu futu lɛ. 11Jehanɛ, nyɛɛ ngɔ akpakpo kake kɛ ba sã yayami pami bɔ. Nyɛɛ sã bɔ nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ piɛ yayami pami bɔ nɛ a kɛ kpataa a, kɛ daa sami bɔ ɔ, kɛ e he ngma bɔ ɔ, kɛ a he wai bɔ ɔmɛ a he.
Gbasisihimi nyami be bɔ sami
(Mose III, 23.33-44)
