12“Nyɔhiɔ nɛ ji kpaago ɔ we ligbi nɛ ji nyɔngma kɛ enuɔ ɔ, nyɛ bua nyɛ he nya nɛ nyɛ ja Mawu; nyɛ ko tsu ní tsumi ko nɛ he wa, se mohu nyɛɛ ye nyami be nɛ ɔ ligbi kpaago nɛ nyɛ kɛ wo Yawɛ hɛ mi nyami. 13Kekleekle ligbi ɔ, nyɛɛ ngɔ lohwe nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ sã sami bɔ nɛ a kɛ la sãã nɛ jee via saminya, nɛ saa Yawɛ hɛ mi: na ku nyɔngma kɛ etɛ, agbosu enyɔ, jijɔ ku nyɔngma kɛ eywiɛ nɛ a ye jeha kakaaka, nɛ kpa ko kpa ko be a he. 14Ngma bɔ nɛ nyɛɛ ngɔ kɛ piɛ lohwe ɔmɛ a he ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: na ku nyɔngma kɛ etɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, eko fɛɛ eko nɔ́ ji ngma mamu bukɔbukɔ kilo etɛ nɛ a kɛ nu futu lɛ. Agbosu enyɔ ɔmɛ ɔ, eko fɛɛ eko nɔ́ ji ngma mamu bukɔbukɔ kilo enyɔ nɛ a kɛ nu futu lɛ. 15Jijɔ ku nyɔngma kɛ eywiɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, eko fɛɛ eko nɔ́ ji ngma mamu bukɔbukɔ kilo kake nɛ a kɛ nu futu lɛ. 16Jehanɛ, nyɛɛ ngɔ to akpakpo kake kɛ ba sã yayami pami bɔ kɛ piɛ daa sami bɔ ɔ, kɛ e he ngma bɔ ɔ, kɛ e he wai bɔ ɔ he.
17“Ligbi nɛ ji enyɔ ɔ, nyɛɛ ngɔ na niheyo nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ, agbosu enyɔ, kɛ jijɔ ku nyɔngma kɛ eywiɛ nɛ a ye jeha kakaaka, nɛ kpa ko kpa ko be a he kɛ ba sã bɔ. 18Nyɛɛ ngɔ ngma bɔ ɔmɛ, kɛ wai bɔ ɔmɛ kɛ piɛ lohwe ɔmɛ a he kaa bɔ nɛ mlaa a ngɛ kɛ ha na kuhi, agbosuhi, kɛ jijɔhi ngɛ a hiɛmi nya a. 19Jehanɛ, nyɛɛ ngɔ akpakpo kake kɛ ba sã yayami pami bɔ kɛ piɛ daa sami bɔ ɔ, kɛ e he ngma bɔ ɔ, kɛ a he wai bɔ ɔmɛ a he.
20“Ligbi nɛ ji etɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ ngɔ na ku nyɔngma kɛ kake, agbosu enyɔ, kɛ jijɔ ku nyɔngma kɛ eywiɛ nɛ a ye jeha kakaaka, nɛ kpa ko kpa ko be a he kɛ ba sã bɔ. 21Nyɛɛ ngɔ ngma bɔ ɔmɛ, kɛ wai bɔ ɔmɛ kɛ piɛ lohwe ɔmɛ a he kaa bɔ nɛ mlaa a ngɛ kɛ ha na kuhi, agbosuhi, kɛ jijɔhi ngɛ a hiɛmi nya a. 22Jehanɛ, nyɛɛ ngɔ to akpakpo kake kɛ ba sã yayami pami bɔ kɛ piɛ daa sami bɔ ɔ, kɛ e he ngma bɔ ɔ, kɛ e he wai bɔ ɔ he.
23“Ligbi nɛ ji eywiɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ ngɔ na ku nyɔngma, agbosu enyɔ, kɛ jijɔ ku nyɔngma kɛ eywiɛ nɛ a ye jeha kakaaka, nɛ kpa ko kpa ko be a he kɛ ba sã bɔ. 24Nyɛɛ ngɔ ngma bɔ ɔmɛ, kɛ wai bɔ ɔmɛ kɛ piɛ lohwe ɔmɛ a he kaa bɔ nɛ mlaa a ngɛ kɛ ha na kuhi, agbosuhi, kɛ jijɔhi ngɛ a hiɛmi nya a. 25Jehanɛ, nyɛɛ ngɔ to akpakpo kake kɛ ba sã yayami pami bɔ kɛ piɛ daa sami bɔ ɔ, kɛ e he ngma bɔ ɔ, kɛ e he wai bɔ ɔ he.
26“Ligbi nɛ ji enuɔ ɔ, nyɛɛ ngɔ na ku nɛɛ, agbosu enyɔ, kɛ jijɔ ku nyɔngma kɛ eywiɛ nɛ a ye jeha kakaaka, nɛ kpa ko kpa ko be a he kɛ ba sã bɔ. 27Nyɛɛ ngɔ ngma bɔ ɔmɛ, kɛ wai bɔ ɔmɛ kɛ piɛ lohwe ɔmɛ a he kaa bɔ nɛ mlaa a ngɛ kɛ ha na kuhi, agbosuhi, kɛ jijɔ hi ngɛ a hiɛmi nya a. 28Jehanɛ, nyɛɛ ngɔ to akpakpo kake kɛ ba sã yayami pami bɔ kɛ piɛ daa sami bɔ ɔ, kɛ e he ngma bɔ ɔ, kɛ e he wai bɔ ɔ he.
29“Ligbi nɛ ji ekpa a, nyɛɛ ngɔ na ku kpaanyɔ, agbosu enyɔ, kɛ jijɔ ku nyɔngma kɛ eywiɛ nɛ a ye jeha kakaaka, nɛ kpa ko kpa ko be a he kɛ ba sã bɔ. 30Nyɛɛ ngɔ ngma bɔ ɔmɛ, kɛ wai bɔ ɔmɛ kɛ piɛ lohwe ɔmɛ a he, kaa bɔ nɛ mlaa a ngɛ kɛ ha na kuhi, agbosuhi, kɛ jijɔhi ngɛ a hiɛmi nya a. 31Jehanɛ, nyɛɛ ngɔ to akpakpo kake kɛ ba sã yayami pami bɔ kɛ piɛ daa sami bɔ ɔ, kɛ e he ngma bɔ ɔ, kɛ e he wai bɔ ɔ he.
32“Ligbi nɛ ji kpaago ɔ, nyɛɛ ngɔ na ku kpaago, agbosu enyɔ, kɛ jijɔ ku nyɔngma kɛ eywiɛ nɛ a ye jeha kakaaka, nɛ kpa ko kpa ko be a he kɛ ba sã bɔ. 33Nyɛɛ ngɔ ngma bɔ ɔmɛ, kɛ wai bɔ ɔmɛ kɛ piɛ lohwe ɔmɛ a he kaa bɔ nɛ mlaa a ngɛ kɛ ha na kuhi, agbosuhi, kɛ jijɔhi ngɛ a hiɛmi nya a. 34Jehanɛ, nyɛɛ ngɔ to akpakpo kake kɛ ba sã yayami pami bɔ kɛ piɛ daa sami bɔ ɔ, kɛ e he ngma bɔ ɔ, kɛ e he wai bɔ ɔ he.
35“Ligbi nɛ ji kpaanyɔ ɔ, nyɛ bua nyɛ he nya nɛ nyɛ ja Mawu; nyɛ ko tsu ní tsumi ko nɛ he wa. 36Nyɛɛ ngɔ lohwe nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ sã sami bɔ nɛ jeɔ via saminya, nɛ saa Yawɛ hɛ mi: na ku kake, agbosu kake, kɛ jijɔ ku kpaago nɛ a ye jeha kakaaka, nɛ kpa ko kpa ko be a he. 37Nyɛɛ ngɔ ngma bɔ ɔmɛ, kɛ wai bɔ ɔ mɛ kɛ piɛ lohwe ɔmɛ a he kaa bɔ nɛ mlaa a ngɛ kɛ ha na kuhi, agbosuhi, kɛ jijɔhi ngɛ a hiɛmi nya a. 38Jehanɛ, nyɛɛ ngɔ to akpakpo kake kɛ ba sã yayami pami bɔ kɛ piɛ daa sami bɔ ɔ, kɛ e he ngma bɔ ɔ, kɛ e he wai bɔ ɔ he.
39“Mlaahi nɛ a wo nɛ kɔɔ sami bɔ, ngma bɔ, wai bɔ, kɛ tue mi jɔmi bɔ nɛ nyɛɛ sã ha Yawɛ ngɛ nyɛ nyami be ɔmɛ a mi he ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ. Slo enɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ si womi bɔhi, kɛ bɔhi nɛ nyɛ sãã kɛ jeɔ nyɛ tsui mi faa a a he.”
40Mose de Israel bi ɔmɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ fa lɛ Mose ɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.

Title: MOSE IV, 30
Content:
Si womi he mlaahi
1Mose de Israel wɛtsoyi ɔmɛ ke, “Mlaahi nɛ Yawɛ wo ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ. 2 Ke nyumu ko wo Yawɛ si, aloo e ka e he kita kaa e maa nyɛ nɔ́ ko ɔ, e ko kpale e nya se; nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ e kɛ e nya de ɔ, e pee.
3“Ke yo ko wo Yawɛ si, aloo ke e ka e he kita kaa e maa nyɛ nɔ́ ko ngɛ e yihe mi be mi nɛ e ngɛ e tsɛ we ɔ, 4ke e tsɛ ɔ nu he, se e de we lɛ nɔ́ ko ɔ, lɛɛ yiheyo nɛ ɔ nɛ ye nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ e wo he si, loo e ka he kita a nɔ. 5Se ke ligbi nɛ e tsɛ ɔ nu he, nɛ e de ke e kplɛɛ we nɔ ɔ, lɛɛ e si womi ɔ, kɛ kita nɛ e ka e he ɔ tsuo maa pee yaka. Ke e ba mi ja a, Yawɛ kɛ e he maa ke lɛ; ejakaa e tsɛ lɛ kplɛɛ we nɔ.
6“Se ke pi yogbayo ji lɛ be mi nɛ e wo si ɔ, aloo e kɛ nya blɛblɛ tu munyu kɛ fi e he ɔ, 7nɛ lɔ ɔ se e ba gba nɛ e huno ɔ nu he, se e de we lɛ nɔ́ ko ɔ, lɛɛ e si womi ɔ, kɛ kitahi nɛ e ka kɛ fi e he ɔ, e ye lɛ tsuo nɔ. 8Ke ligbi nɛ e huno ɔ nu he, nɛ e de ke e kplɛɛ we nɔ ɔ, lɛɛ e si womi ɔ, kɛ munyu nɛ e kɛ e nya blɛblɛ tu kɛ fi e he ɔ tsuo maa pee yaka. Ke e ba mi ja a, Yawɛ kɛ e he maa ke lɛ.
9“Yalɔyo, aloo yo nɛ e huno fie lɛ ɔ, lɛɛ e sa kaa e yeɔ e si womi, aloo nɔ́ ko nɛ e pee nɛ e kɛ fi e he ɔ nɔ.
10“Ke yogbayo ko wo si, aloo e ka e he kita kaa e maa nyɛ nɔ́ ko be mi nɛ e ngɛ gba we, 11nɛ e huno ɔ nu he, se e de we lɛ nɔ́ ko, nɛ e kua we hulɔ ɔ, lɛɛ e si womi ɔ, kɛ kitahi nɛ e ka nɛ e kɛ fi e he ɔ, e ye lɛ tsuo nɔ. 12Se ke ligbi nɛ e huno ɔ nu he ɔ, e kplɛɛ we nɔ ɔ, lɛɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ e kɛ e nya de, nɛ kɔɔ e si womi ɔmɛ a he, kɛ nɔ́ nɛ e kɛ fi lɛ nitsɛ e he ɔ maa pee yaka. Akɛnɛ e huno ɔ ji nɔ nɛ kplɛɛ we nɔ he je ɔ, Yawɛ kɛ e he maa ke lɛ. 13Si womi, aloo kita ko nɛ e ma ka e he, nɛ́ e kɛ hi ngma kɛ pi e he ɔ, e huno ɔ ngɛ he blɔ nɛ e kplɛɛɔ nɔ, loo e kuaa. 14Se ke ligbi kake be, nɛ e huno ɔ de we lɛ nɔ́ ko kulaa a, lɛɛ e kplɛɛ e si womi ɔmɛ, kɛ kita amɛ tsuo nɛ e ka e he ɔ a nɔ. Ligbi ɔ nɛ e nu ní ɔmɛ a he, nɛ e de we e yo ɔ nɔ́ ko pɛ, e tsɔɔ kaa e kplɛɛ nɔ. 15Se ke e nu ní nɛ ɔmɛ a he, nɛ be ko se loko e kplɛɛ we nɔ ɔ, lɛɛ yo ɔ musu maa tloo nyumu ɔ.”
16Enɛ ɔmɛ ji si womi he mlaahi nɛ Yawɛ wo Mose, nɛ kɔɔ nyumu kɛ e yo, aloo e bi yiheyo nɛ ngɛ e we ɔ mi ɔ a he.

Title: MOSE IV, 31
Content:
Midian bi ɔmɛ a hɛ mi kpatami
1Yawɛ de Mose ke, 2“Yaa nɛ o ya gbla Midian bi ɔmɛ a tue ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ a pee Israel bi ɔmɛ ɔ he. Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, o ma gbo.”
3Mose de ma a ke, “Nyɛɛ mia kɛ nyɛ ta yami ní ɔmɛ, nɛ nyɛ ya tua Midian kɛ ye Yawɛ he lue. 4Nyɛɛ hla nyumuhi akpe kɛ je Israel wɛtso tsuaa wɛtso mi kɛ ya ta a.”
5Nyumuhi tsuo nɛ a hla kɛ je Israel nimli akpeakpe abɔ a kpɛti, nɛ ji ni nɛmɛ nɛ mia kɛ ha ta yami ɔ ji akpe nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ; wɛtso tsuaa wɛtso ha nimli akpe kake. 6Mose wo mɛ blɔ, nɛ osɔfo Eleazar bi Finehas kɛ mɛ ho ta a ya. Lɛ ji nɔ nɛ hɛɛ ní klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ, kɛ titimati ɔmɛ nɛ a kɛ ma hwɔ lele ɔ. 7Nɛ kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa Mose ɔ, a ya tua Midian bi ɔmɛ, nɛ a gbe nyumu ɔmɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ, 8kɛ Midian matsɛmɛ enuɔ ɔmɛ. Mɛ ji Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur, kɛ Reba. A gbe Beor binyumu Balaam ɔ hulɔ.
9Israel bi ɔmɛ nuu Midian yi ɔmɛ, kɛ jokuɛwi ɔmɛ nyɔguɛ. A ha a na amɛ, a to ɔmɛ, kɛ a he níhi tsuo, 10nɛ a kɛ la sã a ma amɛ, kɛ a hi he ɔmɛ tsuo. 11Nɛ a ngɔ ta yibu ní ɔmɛ kulaa nɛ ji nimli, lohwehi, kɛ níhi nɛ a ha a tsuo. 12A ngɔ ta yibu ní ɔmɛ tsuo, nyɔguɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ lohwe ɔmɛ nɛ a ha a kɛ ba Mose, osɔfo Eleazar, kɛ Israel ma kpekpemi ɔ a ngɔ ngɛ ma sito he ɔ, ngɛ Moab nga kplanaa a nɔ, ngɛ Yordan pa a se ngɛ Yeriko.
Ta buli ɔmɛ kpale kɛ ba
13Benɛ ta buli ɔmɛ ma a, Mose, osɔfo Eleazar, kɛ ma nimeli ɔmɛ tsuo ho ya kpee mɛ ngɛ ma sito he ɔ se. 14Mose mi mi fu asafoatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ nɛ ji akpe akpe kɛ lafa lafa a nyatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ nɛ je ta a kɛ ba a. 15Mose bi mɛ ke, “Mɛni he je nɛ nyɛ he yi ɔmɛ tsuo a yi wami ɔ? 16 Nyɛ kai kaa yi nɛ ɔmɛ nɔuu lɛ a ya bu Balaam ga womi tue, nɛ a puɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ a juɛmi, nɛ a kɛ pee yayami kɛ si Yawɛ ngɛ Peor jamɛ a ligbi ɔ nɛ. Enɛ ɔ he je nɛ gbenɔ hiɔ ba Yawɛ ma a nɔ ɔ nɛ. 17Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ gbe nyumuyo tsuaa nyumuyo, kɛ yo tsuaa yo nɛ le nyumu. 18Se yihewi nɛ li nyumu ɔ, mɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ ha nɛ a yi nɛ na wami, konɛ nyɛɛ ngɔ mɛ. 19Jehanɛ, nyɛ nitsɛmɛ hu nyɛ maa hi ma sito he ɔ se ligbi kpaago. Nyɛ ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ gbe nɔ ko, aloo e ta nɔ ko nɛ gbo ngɛ ta a mi he ɔ, jamɛ a nɔ ɔ nɛ tsukɔ e he ligbi etɛne ɔ, kɛ ligbi kpaagone ɔ, nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ nyɔguɛ ɔmɛ tsuo. 20Jehanɛ, nyɛɛ tsukɔ heha ní tsuo a he, kɛ níhi tsuo nɛ a ngɔ lohwe he womi, aloo to akpakpo he bwɔmi kɛ pee, aloo níhi nɛ a kɛ tso kpɛ.”
21Osɔfo Eleazar de ta buli ɔmɛ nɛ je ta kɛ ba a ke, “Mlaa nɛ Yawɛ wo Mose ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. 22-23Níhi tsuo nɛ la be nyɛe maa sã, kaa sika tsu, sika hiɔ, akɔblee, dade, sanyla, loo sumui ɔ, nyɛɛ ngɔ kɛ wo la mi, konɛ a he nɛ tsɔ. Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, nyɛɛ ngɔ yayami fɔmi nyu ɔ kɛ fɔ a he. Se nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ kɛ la yi ɔ, lɛɛ nyɛɛ kɛ yayami fɔmi nyu ɔ nɛ fɔ he. 24Nyɛ fɔ nyɛ tade ɔmɛ a he ngɛ ligbi kpaagone ɔ nɔ, konɛ nyɛ he nɛ tsɔ ekohu. Lɔ ɔ se loko nyɛɛ ba ma sito he ɔ.”
Ta yibu ní ɔ dlami
25Yawɛ de Mose ke, 26“O kɛ osɔfo Eleazar, kɛ ma kpekpemi ɔ we wɛtsoyi ɔmɛ nɛ kane ta yibu níhi nɛ a ha, nɛ ji nyɔguɛhi, kɛ lohwehi nɛ a nuu ɔ tsuo. 27Dla ta yibu ní ɔmɛ a mi fiee enyɔ; ngɔɔ fa kɛ ha tabo ɔmɛ nɛ ya hwu ta a, nɛ o ngɔ fa hu kɛ ha ma kpekpemi ɔ tsuo. 28-29Ta yibu ní ɔ nɛ ji tabo ɔmɛ nɛ ya hwu ta a a blɔ fa mi nɔ ɔ, ngɔɔ eko kɛ ha Yawɛ. Nimli adesahi jio, nahi jio, tejihi jio, tohi jio, Yawɛ nɔ ji lafa enuɔ tsuaa lafa enuɔ mi kake. Ngɔɔ ní nɛ ɔmɛ ngɔ ha osɔfo Eleazar kaa nike ní klɛdɛɛ ha Yawɛ. 30Fa a nɛ ji Israel ma a nɛ piɛ ɔ a nɔ ɔ, nimli, nahi, tejihi tohi, kɛ we mi lohwehi tsuo ɔ, ngɔɔ kakaaka ngɛ nyingmi enuɔ tsuaa nyingmi enuɔ mi kɛ ha Levi bi ɔmɛ nɛ tsuɔ Yawɛ kpe he ɔ he ní ɔ.” 31Mose kɛ osɔfo Eleazar pee bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa Mose ɔ.
32-35Ta yibu ní ɔ nɛ tabo ɔmɛ ha, kɛ nɔ́ nɛ a si kɛ ha mɛ nitsɛmɛ a he ɔ tsuo ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ: to 675,000, na 72,000, teji 61,000, yihewi nɛ a li nyumu 32,000. 36-40Fa a nɛ ji ni nɛmɛ nɛ ya hwu ta a a nɔ ɔ, lɛ ji to 337,500, nɛ tohi nɛ a tsu kɛ ha Yawɛ ji 675; na 36,000, nɛ nahi nɛ a tsu kɛ ha Yawɛ ji 72; teji 30,500, nɛ tejihi nɛ a tsu kɛ ha Yawɛ ji 61; yihewi nɛ li nyumu 16,000; nɛ yihewi nɛ a tsu kɛ ha Yawɛ ji 32. 41Nɛ kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa Mose ɔ, Mose ngɔ nimli ɔmɛ, kɛ lohwe ɔmɛ nɛ a tsu ɔ ngɔ ha osɔfo Eleazar kaa nike ní klɛdɛɛ ko ha Yawɛ.
42-46Fa a nɛ ji Israel ma a nɔ nɛ Mose he ngɛ ta buli ɔmɛ nɛ ya hwu ta a a dɛ kɛ ha ma kpekpemi ɔ, ji to 337,500, na 36,000, teji 30,500, kɛ yihewi 16,000. 47Mose ngɔ nimli, kɛ lohwe nyingmi enuɔ tsuaa nyingmi enuɔ mi kakaaka kɛ je fa a nɛ ji Israel ma a nɔ ɔ mi kɛ ha Levi bi ɔmɛ nɛ tsuɔ Yawɛ kpe he ɔ he ní ɔ, kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa lɛ ɔ.
48Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, asafoatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ nimli akpehi, kɛ lafahi a nya a ba Mose ngɔ, 49nɛ a ba de lɛ ke, “Wɔ o tsɔli ɔmɛ ɔ, wa kane ta buli nɛ wa hɛɛ ɔ, nɛ a kpɛti nɔ kake po laa we. 50Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, wa ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ hɛɛ e dɛ mi nɔ́ ko kɛ ba nɛ a kɛ kpata Yawɛ ha wɔ. Ní ɔmɛ ji sika tsu junehi, kɔni si gahi, nine si gahi, nguɛ gahi, tue nya níhi, kɛ muɛhi.” 51Mose kɛ osɔfo Eleazar he sika june ɔmɛ tsuo ngɛ a dɛ. 52Sika tsu tsuo nɛ asafoatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ngɔ kɛ ba ha Yawɛ ɔ, e jiimi maa pee kilo lafa enyɔ. 53Se ta buli gu ɔmɛ lɛɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ ngɔ nɔ́ nɛ e na a kɛ to. 54Mose kɛ osɔfo Eleazar he sika tsu ɔ ngɛ asafoatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a ngɛ nihi akpehi, kɛ lafahi a nya a a dɛ; nɛ a ngɔ kɛ ba kpe he bo tsu ɔ mi kaa Israel ma a kaimi nɔ́ ko ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi.

Title: MOSE IV, 32
Content:
Wɛtso ɔmɛ ngɛ Yordan pa a beleku je
(Mose V, 3.12-22)
1Ruben bi ɔmɛ, kɛ Gad bi ɔmɛ ngɛ lohwehi babauu nitsɛ. Benɛ a na kaa Yazer zugba a, kɛ Gilead zugba a hi ha lohwe lɛmi ɔ, 2a ya de Mose, osɔfo Eleazar, kɛ ma nimeli ɔmɛ ke, 3“Atarot, Dibon, Yazer, Nimra, Heshbon, Eleale, Sibma, Nebo, kɛ Beon, 4nɛ ji mahi nɛ Yawɛ piɛ Israel ma kpekpemi ɔ he kɛ kpɔ ɔ, zugba a hi ha lohwe lɛmi; nɛ wɔ o tsɔli ɔmɛ hu, wa ngɛ lohwehi babauu. 5Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, wa kpa mo pɛɛ, ha nɛ waa ngɔ zugba nɛ ɔ, nɛ e pee wa nɔ; koo ngɔ wɔ kɛ po Yordan pa a.”
6Mose de Gad bi ɔmɛ, kɛ Ruben bi ɔmɛ ke, “Anɛ nyɛ nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a ya nɛ a ya hwu ta, konɛ nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛɛ hi hiɛ ɔ? 7Mɛni he je nɛ nyɛ ngɛ hlae nɛ nyɛɛ wo Israel bi ɔmɛ a kɔni mi nyu, nɛ a ko po pa a kɛ ya zugba a nɛ Yawɛ ngɔ ha mɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ? 8 Kikɛ nɛ ɔ nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ pee, benɛ i tsɔ mɛ kɛ je Kadesh Barnea nɛ a ya slaa zugba a nɛ. 9A nyɛɛ hluu kɛ ya su Eskol kɔ̃ ɔ mi, nɛ a ya na zugba a. Se mohu a se kpalemi mi ɔ, a ba wo Israel bi ɔmɛ a kɔni mi nyu nɛ a ko ya zugba a nɛ Yawɛ ngɔ ha mɛ ɔ nɔ. 10 Jamɛ ligbi ɔ, Yawɛ mi mi wo la; nɛ e de ke, 11‘Nyumuhi nɛ a je Egipt kɛ ba, nɛ a ye kɛ je jeha nyingmi enyɔ kɛ yaa a, akɛnɛ a nyɛɛ we ye se kɛ pi si he je ɔ, i ngɛ kita kae kaa ke a ti nɔ ko na zugba a nɛ i wo si ke ma ngɔ kɛ ha Abraham, Isak, kɛ Yakob ɔ fii! 12Ja Yefune bi Kaleb, Ken no ɔ, kɛ Nun bi Yoshua pɛ; ejakaa mɛɛ a nyɛɛ Yawɛ se kɛ pi si.’ 13Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yawɛ mi mi fu Israel, nɛ e ha a wo lalaalo ngɛ nga a nɔ jeha nyingmi eywiɛ, kɛ ya si be mi nɛ jamɛ a yi nɔ bi ɔmɛ nɛ pee nɔ́ nɛ dɛ ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi ɔ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ gbo ta. 14Nɛ hyɛ, yayami peeli a nina, nyɛ hu nyɛ ba wo nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ a nane, nɛ nyɛ ngɛ pee, konɛ Yawɛ mi mi fumi nɛ nya wa a nɛ pa ba Israel nɔ ekohu! 15Nyɛ Ruben bi, kɛ Gad bi, ke nyɛ je Yawɛ se ɔ, lɛ hu e maa ngmɛɛ ma nɛ ɔ he ngɛ nga a nɔ ekohu; nɛ ke ma a hɛ mi kpata a, nyɛ lɛ nyɛ pee.”
16Se a hɛ mɛ kɛ su Mose he, nɛ a de lɛ ke, “Nɔ́ nɛ wa ngɛ hlae kɛkɛ ji waa ma lohwe tsuhi kɛ ha wa lohwe ɔmɛ, nɛ waa po mahi kɛ ha wa bimɛ tsɔwi ɔmɛ. 17Wɔ nitsɛmɛ lɛɛ wa maa mia kɛ nyɛɛ Israel ma a hɛ mi kɛ ya su a su he. Se zugba a nɔ bi ɔmɛ a he je ɔ, wa bimɛ tsɔwi ɔmɛ maa hi mahi nɛ a fia gbogbo kɛ wo a he ɔ a mi. 18Wa be wa se kpalee kɛ ba wa we ɔmɛ a mi, kɛ yaa si Israel bi ɔmɛ a ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ nine maa su e blɔ fa mi nɔ́ nɔ. 19Jehanɛ, ke wɔɔ wa nine su wa blɔ fa mi nɔ́ ɔ nɔ ngɛ Yordan beleku je ngɛ hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ, waa kɛ mɛ be weto ní ko he plee hu ngɛ Yordan pa a se.”
20Mose ha mɛ heto ke, “Ke nyɛ maa ye nyɛ si womi ɔ nɔ, nɛ nyɛ maa mia kɛ nyɛɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi kɛ ya ta a, 21nɛ ta buli ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti ɔ maa po Yordan pa a kɛ nyɛɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi kɛ yaa si e maa fie he nyɛli ɔmɛ, 22nɛ e ma kpɔ zugba a, lɛɛ ke nyɛ kpale nyɛ se kɛ ba a, nyɛ maa ye bemi ngɛ Yawɛ kɛ Israel ma a hɛ mi; nɛ zugba nɛ ɔ maa pee nyɛ blɔ fa mi nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ ngɔ ha nyɛ. 23Se ke nyɛ yi nyɛ si womi ɔ nɔ ɔ, lɛɛ nyɛ na nɛ nyɛɛ le kaa nyɛ pee yayami kɛ si Yawɛ; nɛ bɔ tsuaa bɔ nɛ pee ɔ, nyɛ ma na nyɛ yayami ɔ he tue gblami. 24Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ po mahi kɛ ha nyɛ bimɛ tsɔwi ɔmɛ, nɛ nyɛɛ ma lohwe tsuhi kɛ ha nyɛ lohwe ɔmɛ, konɛ nyɛɛ ye nyɛ si womi ɔ hu nɔ.”
25Gad bi ɔmɛ, kɛ Ruben bi ɔmɛ de Mose ke, “Wa nyɔmtsɛ, wa maa pee kaa bɔ nɛ o fa wɔ ɔ. 26Wa bimɛ tsɔwi ɔmɛ, wa yi ɔmɛ, kɛ wa to ɔmɛ, kɛ wa lohwe kpa amɛ maa hi Gilead ma amɛ a mi ngɛ hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ; 27se wɔ o tsɔli ɔmɛ lɛɛ wa maa mia kɛ po pa a kɛ ya hwu ta ha Yawɛ, kaa bɔ nɛ mo, wa nyɔmtsɛ ɔ, o fa wɔ ɔ.”
28 Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Mose wo osɔfo Eleazar, Nun bi Yoshua, kɛ Israel ma nimeli ɔmɛ mlaa ngɛ a he, 29nɛ e de mɛ ke, “Ke Gad bi ɔmɛ, kɛ Ruben bi ɔmɛ mia kɛ nyɛɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi, nɛ a kɛ nyɛ po Yordan pa a kɛ ya ngɔ zugba a, nyɛɛ kɛ Gilead zugba a ma ha mɛ kaa a blɔ fa mi nɔ́. 30Se ke a mia we nɛ a kɛ nyɛ nɛ po pa a kɛ ya a, lɛɛ a ma na a blɔ fa mi nɔ́ ɔ ngɛ Kanaan zugba a nɔ kaa nyɛ kɛ̃.”
31Gad bi ɔmɛ, kɛ Ruben bi ɔmɛ he nɔ nɛ a de ke, “Wa maa pee kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa wɔ ɔ. 32Wa maa mia kpɛii kɛ po pa a kɛ nyɛɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi kɛ ya Kanaan zugba a nɔ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ weto ní ɔ nɛ wa na ngɛ Yordan pa a se ɔ nɛ tlɔ wa dɛ.”
33Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Mose ngɔ Amor matsɛ, Sihon nɔ yemi he ɔ, Bashan matsɛ, Og nɔ yemi he ɔ, mahi nɛ ngɛ huza amɛ a nɔ ɔ, kɛ zugbahi tsuo nɛ bɔle mɛ ɔ ngɔ ha Gad bi ɔmɛ, kɛ Ruben bi ɔmɛ, kɛ Yosef bi Manase wɛtso fa a. 34Gad bi ɔmɛ kpale po Dibon, Atarot, Aroer, 35Atrot Shofan, Yazer, Yogbeha, 36Bet Nimra, kɛ Bet Haran, nɛ ji mahi nɛ a fia gbogbo kɛ wo a he ɔ ehe ekohu; nɛ a ma lohwe tsuhi hulɔ. 37Ruben bi ɔmɛ hu kpale po Heshbon, Eleale, Kiriataim, 38Nebo, Baal Meon (a tsake biɛ nɛ ɔ), kɛ Sibma. Nɛ a wo mahi nɛ a po ɔ biɛ kpahi.
39Manase binyumu Makir bimɛ ɔmɛ pue nɔ kɛ ho Gilead ya nɛ a ya ngɔ zugba a, nɛ a fie Amor bi ɔmɛ kɛ je lejɛ ɔ. 40Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Mose ngɔ Gilead ngɔ ha Manase binyumu Makir bimɛ ɔmɛ, nɛ a hi lejɛ ɔ. 41Yair nɛ je Manase wɛtso ɔ mi ɔ hu ya tua kɔpe komɛ, nɛ e ngɔ mɛ, nɛ e wo mɛ biɛ ke Havot Yair (e sisi ji Yair kɔpehi). 42Noba hu ya tua Kenat kɛ kɔpehi nɛ bɔle lɛ ɔ, nɛ e kɛ lɛ nitsɛ e biɛ Noba a wo ma a.

Title: MOSE IV, 33
Content:
Kɛ je Egipt kɛ ya Moab
1Sane nɛ ɔ gbaa wɔ he slɔɔtohi nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ to si ngɛ benɛ Mose kɛ Aaron ngɔ mɛ wɛtso nya wɛtso nya kɛ je Egipt ɔ. 2Mose ngma hehi nɛ a hia kɛ je ɔ, kɛ hehi nɛ a to si ngɛ ɔ tsuo a biɛ kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa lɛ ɔ.
3Israel bi ɔmɛ je Egipt ngɛ kekleekle nyɔhiɔ ɔ we ligbi nyɔngma kɛ enuɔne nɛ ji kekleekle Hetsɔmi ligbi ɔ we jena nɔ. A kɛ manye hia kɛ je ma nɛ a tsɛɛ Rameses ɔ, ngɛ Egipt bi ɔmɛ tsuo a hɛ mi paa. 4Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, Egipt bi ɔmɛ ngɛ a bitɛte ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ Yawɛ gbe kɛ pueɔ si ɔ pue. Yawɛ pee nɔ́ nɛ ɔ kɛ tsɔɔ kaa e he wa kulaa pe Egipt mawu ɔmɛ.
5Israel bi ɔmɛ hia kɛ je Rameses, nɛ a ya to si ngɛ Sukot. 6A hia kɛ je Sukot, nɛ a ya to si ngɛ Etam, ngɛ nga a nya. 7Benɛ a hia kɛ je Etam ɔ, a dɔ a yi kɛ ho Pi Hahirot ya, ngɛ Baal Zefon beleku je, nɛ a ya to si ngɛ Migdol kasa nya. 8Jehanɛ, a hia kɛ je Pi Hahirot kɛ ya po Wo Tsu ɔ, kɛ ho Shur nga a nɔ ya. A nyɛɛ Etam nga a nɔ ligbi etɛ blɔ nyɛɛmi, nɛ a ya to si ngɛ Mara. 9Nɛ́ a hia kɛ je Mara a, a ya to si ngɛ Elim. Elim nɛ ɔ, vu nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ, kɛ tã nyingmi kpaago ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.
10A hia kɛ je Elim, nɛ a ya to si ngɛ Wo Tsu ɔ nya. 11A hia kɛ je Wo Tsu ɔ nya, nɛ a ya to si ngɛ Sin nga a nɔ. 12Nɛ́ a je Sin nga a nɔ ɔ, a ya to si ngɛ Dofka. 13A hia kɛ je Dofka, nɛ a ya to si ngɛ Alus. 14Nɛ́ a hia kɛ je Alus ɔ, a ya to si ngɛ Refidim, he nɛ ma a nɛ́ nyu nɛ a nu ngɛ ɔ.
15A hia kɛ je Refidim, nɛ a ya to si ngɛ Sinai nga a nɔ. 16A hia kɛ je Sinai nga a nɔ, nɛ a ya to si ngɛ Kibrot Hataawa. 17A hia kɛ je Kibrot Hataawa, nɛ a ya to si ngɛ Hazerot. 18A hia kɛ je Hazerot, nɛ a ya to si ngɛ Ritma. 19A hia kɛ je Ritma, nɛ a ya to si ngɛ Rimon Perez. 20A hia kɛ je Rimon Perez, nɛ a ya to si ngɛ Libna. 21A hia kɛ je Libna, nɛ a ya to si ngɛ Risa. 22A hia kɛ je Risa, nɛ a ya to si ngɛ Kehelata. 23A hia kɛ je Kehelata, nɛ a ya to si ngɛ Shefer yo ɔ nɔ. 24A hia kɛ je Shefer yo ɔ nɔ, nɛ a ya to si ngɛ Harada. 25A hia kɛ je Harada, nɛ a ya to si ngɛ Makelot. 26A hia kɛ je Makelot, nɛ a ya to si ngɛ Tahat. 27A hia kɛ je Tahat, nɛ a ya to si ngɛ Tera. 28A hia kɛ je Tera, nɛ a ya to si ngɛ Mitka. 29A hia kɛ je Mitka, nɛ a ya to si ngɛ Hashmona. 30A hia kɛ je Hashmona, nɛ a ya to si ngɛ Moserot. 31A hia kɛ je Moserot, nɛ a ya to si ngɛ Bene Yaakan. 32A hia kɛ je Bene Yaakan, nɛ a ya to si ngɛ Hor Hagidgad. 33A hia kɛ je Hor Hagidgad, nɛ a ya to si ngɛ Yotbata. 34A hia kɛ je Yotbata, nɛ a ya to si ngɛ Abrona. 35A hia kɛ je Abrona, nɛ a ya to si ngɛ Ezeon Geber. 36A hia kɛ je Ezeon Geber, nɛ a ya to si ngɛ Zin nga a nɔ (nɛ ji Kadesh). 37A hia kɛ je Kadesh, nɛ a ya to si ngɛ Hor yo ɔ he, ngɛ Edom zugba a huzu ɔ nya.
38-39 Osɔfo Aaron kuɔ Hor yo ɔ kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa lɛ ɔ, nɛ e ya gbo ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Benɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ je Egipt se ɔ, jeha nyingmi eywiɛne ɔ we nyɔhiɔ nɛ ji enuɔ ɔ we kekleekle ligbi ɔ nɛ Aaron gbo ngɛ Hor yo ɔ nɔ.
40 Arad matsɛ ɔ nɛ ngɛ Kanaan zugba a leneyi je ɔ nu kaa Israel bi ɔmɛ ma.
41Jehanɛ, Israel bi ɔmɛ hia kɛ je Hor yo ɔ he, nɛ a ya to si ngɛ Zalmona. 42A hia kɛ je Zalmona, nɛ a ya to si ngɛ Punon. 43A hia kɛ je Punon, nɛ a ya to si ngɛ Obot. 44A hia kɛ je Obot, nɛ a ya to si ngɛ Abarim ma doku ɔ mi, ngɛ Moab zugba a nɔ. 45A hia kɛ je ma doku nɛ ɔ mi, nɛ a ya to si ngɛ Dibon Gad. 46A hia kɛ je Dibon Gad, nɛ a ya to si ngɛ Almon Diblataim. 47A hia kɛ je Almon Diblataim, nɛ a ya to si ngɛ Abarim yo ɔmɛ a nɔ, ngɛ Nebo yo ɔ kasa nya. 48A hia kɛ je Abarim yo ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ a ya to si ngɛ Moab nga kplanaa a nɔ, ngɛ Yordan pa se, ngɛ Yeriko hanɔ. 49A to si ngɛ Moab nga a nɔ, ngɛ Yordan pa a tue, kɛ je Bet Yesimot kɛ ya si Abel Shitim.
Mlaahi nɛ a wo Israel loko a po Yordan pa a
50Jehanɛ, Yawɛ kɛ Mose tu munyu ngɛ Moab nga kplanaa a nɔ, ngɛ Yordan pa a se, ngɛ Yeriko hanɔ, nɛ e de lɛ ke, 51“De Israel bi ɔmɛ ke, ke nyɛ po Yordan pa a kɛ ho Kanaan zugba a nɔ ya a, 52nyɛɛ fie zugba a nɔ bi ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ je lejɛ ɔ. Nyɛɛ ywia a we amaga amɛ tsuo nɛ a ngɔ tɛ, loo nɔ́ ko nɛ a sile kɛ pee ɔ; a jami he ɔmɛ hu nyɛɛ gbɛ mɛ. 53Nyɛɛ ngɔ zugba a, nɛ nyɛɛ hi nɔ; ejakaa i ngɔ kɛ ha nyɛ nɛ e pee nyɛ nɔ. 54 Nyɛɛ fɔ sɔ kɛ dla zugba a wɛtso nya wɛtso nya, kɛ weku nya weku nya. Wɛtso nɛ a he hiɛ ɔ, a ha mɛ zugba agbo; wɛtso nɛ a he pi ɔ, a ha mɛ bɔɔ pɛ. 55Se ke nyɛ fie we zugba a nɔ bi ɔmɛ kɛ ji zugba a nɔ ɔ, lɛɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ maa tlɔ si ɔ maa pee kaa zezle mio nɛ gbɔ nyɛ hɛngmɛ mi, loo ha tso mio nɛ gbɔ nyɛ kasa nya; a maa hao nyɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ he nɛ nyɛ ngɛ ɔ. 56Ke e ba mi ja a, lɛɛ bɔ nɛ i to ke ma pee mɛ ɔ, ma pee nyɛ hu ja nɔuu.”

Title: MOSE IV, 34
Content:
Zugba a huzu ɔmɛ
1Yawɛ de Mose ke 2e wo Israel bi ɔmɛ mlaa nɛ ɔ, “Ke nyɛ su Kanaan zugba a nɛ i ngɔ kɛ ngɛ nyɛ hae ɔ nɔ ɔ, nyɛ huzu ɔmɛ maa pee enɛ ɔmɛ. 3Leneyi je zugba a maa je Zin nga a nɔ, kɛ nyɛɛ Edom huzu ɔ nya; nɛ nyɛ huzu ɔ ngɛ leneyi je ɔ maa je Ngo wo ɔ nya, ngɛ beleku je. 4E maa lɔgɔ si kɛ gu Akrabim yo kpɛ blɔ ɔ leneyi je, nɛ e maa po mi kɛ be ngɛ Zin, hluu kɛ ya gu Kadesh Barnea leneyi je. E ma tsa nɔ kɛ je lejɛ ɔ kɛ ya Hazar Adar, nɛ e maa po mi kɛ ya Azmon. 5Jehanɛ, huzu ɔ maa dɔ e yi kɛ je Azmon kɛ ba Egipt pa a he, nɛ e nya maa sɛ Mediterenia wo ɔ mi.
6“Nyɛ huzu ɔ ngɛ bonyoku je ɔ maa pee Mediterenia wo ɔ.
7“Jehanɛ, ke nyɛ wo za kɛ je Mediterenia wo ɔ nya kɛ ya si Hor yo ɔ he ɔ, lɔ ɔ maa pee nyɛ huzu ɔ ngɛ omleyi je. 8Nyɛ ma tsa nɔ kɛ je Hor yo ɔ he, kɛ ya be ngɛ Hamat kasa nya, kɛ ya si Zedad. 9Kɛ je lejɛ ɔ, huzu ɔ ma tsa nɔ kɛ ya Zifron, nɛ e maa gbe nya ngɛ Hazar Enan.
10“Nyɛ maa wo nyɛ huzu ɔ nɛ ngɛ beleku je ɔ kɛ maa je Hazar Enan, kɛ ya si Shefam. 11Kɛ je Shefam ɔ, huzu ɔ ma kple si kɛ ya Ribla, ngɛ Ain beleku je, nɛ e maa nyɛɛ ja hluu kɛ ya pi Kineret wo ɔ nya, ngɛ beleku je. 12Kɛ je lejɛ ɔ, huzu ɔ ma tsa nɔ kɛ nyɛɛ Yordan pa a he, kɛ yaa si e nya maa pi Ngo wo ɔ.
“Enɛ ɔ maa pee nyɛ zugba a, kɛ huzu ɔmɛ nɛ bɔle lɛ kɛ kpe ɔ.”
13 Mose de Israel bi ɔmɛ ke, “Zugba a nɛ nyɛ maa fɔ sɔ kɛ dla ha nyɛ he ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ; enɛ ɔ ji zugba a nɛ Yawɛ wo si kaa e maa ngɔ kɛ ha wɛtso nɛɛ kɛ fa amɛ ɔ a nɛ. 14Ruben wɛtso ɔ, Gad wɛtso ɔ, kɛ Manase wɛtso fa a, mɛɛ lɛɛ a na a blɔ fa mi nɔ́ we puɔ nya we puɔ nya momo. 15Wɛtso enyɔ kɛ fa amɛ na a blɔ fa mi nɔ́ ɔ ngɛ Yordan pa a se, ngɛ Yeriko hanɔ, ngɛ beleku je.”
Nikɔtɔmahi nɛ maa dla zugba a
16Yawɛ de Mose ke, 17“Osɔfo Eleazar, kɛ Nun binyumu Yoshua ji ni nɛmɛ nɛ maa dla zugba a kɛ ha ma a nɛ. 18Moo hla nikɔtɔmahi kakaaka kɛ je wɛtso tsuaa wɛtso mi ngɔ piɛ a he nɛ a kɛ dla zugba a.” 19-28Nihi nɛ Yawɛ hla, kɛ wɛtsohi nɛ a je a mi ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ:
WƐTSO WƐTSO NƆKƆTƆMA
Yuda Kaleb, Yefune bi ɔ
Simeon Shelumiel, Amihud bi ɔ
Benyamin Elidad, Kislon bi ɔ
Dan Buki, Yogli bi ɔ
Manase Haniel, Efod bi ɔ
Efraim Kemuel, Shiftan bi ɔ
Zebulun Elizafan, Parnak bi ɔ
Isakar Paltiel, Azan bi ɔ
Asher Ahihud, Shelomi bi ɔ
Naftali Pedahel, Amihud bi ɔ.
29Ni nɛ ɔmɛ ji nihi nɛ Yawɛ fa ke a dla Kanaan zugba a kɛ ha Israel ma a nɛ.

Title: MOSE IV, 35
Content:
Mahi nɛ a dla kɛ ha Levi bi ɔmɛ
1 Yawɛ kɛ Mose tu munyu ngɛ Moab nga kplanaa a nɔ, ngɛ Yordan pa a se, ngɛ Yeriko hanɔ; nɛ e de lɛ ke, 2“De Israel bi ɔmɛ ke, weto ní ɔ nɛ a nine su nɔ ɔ, a ha Levi bi ɔmɛ ma amɛ ekomɛ, kɛ a he lohwe lɛmi hehi nɛ mɛ hu a hi lejɛ ɔ. 3Ma nɛ ɔmɛ maa pee Levi bi ɔmɛ a sihi he; nɛ zugbahi nɛ bɔle ma amɛ hu maa pee a we mi lohwehi, kɛ a lohwe kpahi a ní yemi he. 4Lohwe lɛmi zugba a nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ ma ha Levi bi ɔmɛ ɔ, e maa je gbogbo nɛ a fia kɛ wo ma a he ɔ he, kɛ ya se gugue 250 kɛ bɔle si. 5Kɛ je ma a nya a, nyɛ ma susu gugue 500 kɛ ya beleku je, gugue 500 kɛ ya leneyi je, gugue 500 kɛ ya bonyoku je, kɛ gugue 500 kɛ ya omleyi je, nɛ ma a maa hi kpɛti. Enɛ ɔ maa pee lohwehi a lɛmi he kɛ ha ma amɛ. 6Nyɛ ma ha Levi bi ɔmɛ ma ekpa nɛ a ngɔ to kaa wesa hehi nɛ nɔ ko ma nyɛ tu fo kɛ ya laa e he ngɛ, ke e li e he be nɛ e nine ya kpa ngɛ nɔ ko nɔ tlukaa a. Jehanɛ, nyɛ ma ha mɛ ma kpa nyingmi eywiɛ kɛ enyɔ. 7Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, mahi tsuo nɛ nyɛ ma ha Levi bi ɔmɛ ɔ, e pee nyingmi eywiɛ kɛ kpaanyɔ, kɛ a he lohwe lɛmi zugba amɛ tsuo. 8Mahi nɛ o maa ngɔ ngɛ Israel wɛtso slɔɔto ɔmɛ a dɛ kɛ ha Levi bi ɔmɛ ɔ, bɔ nɛ o maa pee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: wɛtsohi nɛ a he hiɛ ɔ, o he fuu ngɛ a dɛ, se wɛtsohi nɛ a he pi ɔ, o he bɔɔ pɛ ngɛ a dɛ.”
Wesa he mahi kɛ nɔ gbemi he sane
(Mose V, 19.1-13; Yoshua 20.1-9)
9Yawɛ de Mose ke, 10“De Israel bi ɔmɛ ke, ke nyɛ po Yordan pa a kɛ ya Kanaan zugba a nɔ ɔ, 11nyɛɛ hla ma komɛ kɛ to kaa wesa hehi nɛ nɔ ko ma nyɛ tu fo kɛ ya laa e he ngɛ, ke e ba mi kaa e li e he be nɛ e nine ya kpa ngɛ nɔ ko nɔ tlukaa a. 12Ma nɛ ɔmɛ maa pee wesa hehi ha nyɛ kɛ maa je muɔ he lue yelɔ ɔ dɛ mi. Ke nɔ ko nine ya kpa ngɛ nɔ ko nɔ tlukaa a, a ko gbe lɛ kɛ yaa si a kɛ lɛ ma ba da ma kpekpemi ɔ hɛ mi, nɛ a maa kojo lɛ lolo. 13Nyɛɛ hla ma ekpa kɛ pee wesa he nɛ ɔmɛ, 14ma etɛ ngɛ Yordan se, kɛ etɛ hu ngɛ Kanaan zugba a nɔ. 15Ma ekpa nɛ ɔmɛ maa pee wesa hehi kɛ ha Israel bi, nibwɔhi, kɛ blɔ nyɛɛli tsuo. Ke e ba mi kaa nɔ ko li e he be nɛ e nine ya kpa ngɛ nɔ ko nɔ tlukaa a, e ma nyɛ maa tu fo kɛ ya sa we ngɛ ma nɛ ɔmɛ eko mi.
16-18“Se ke nɔ ko ngɔ awi yemi nɔ́ ko kaa dade, loo tɛ, loo tso kɛ fia nɔ, nɛ nɔ ɔ gbo ɔ, e gbe nɔmlɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, lɛ hu ja a gbe lɛ. 19Nɔ nɛ a gbe ɔ nyɛmi tutuutu ji muɔ he lue yelɔ ɔ nɛ. Be tsuaa be nɛ e maa na nɔ nɛ gbe e nyɛmi ɔ, e gbe lɛ.
20“Ke nɔ ko nyɛ nɔ ko, nɛ e gbɔ lɛ ha, aloo e ya wo lɛ ka, nɛ e fɔ̃ nɔ́ ko kɛ ya na lɛ nɛ e gbo, 21aloo ke e ngɔ abofu kɛ gba lɛ ma, nɛ e nɔ si, nɛ e gbo ɔ, nɔmlɔ gbelɔ ji lɛ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, lɛ hu ja a gbe lɛ. Be tsuaa be nɛ muɔ he lue yelɔ ɔ, kɛ nɔmlɔ gbelɔ nɛ ɔ maa kpe ɔ, e gbe lɛ.
22“Se ke nɔ ko li e he be, nɛ e ya gbɔ nɔ ko ha, nɛ pi kaa nyɛmi nya, aloo e fɔ̃ nɔ́ ko kɛ ya na lɛ, nɛ pi kaa e wo lɛ ka, 23aloo e fɔ̃ tɛ nɛ ma nyɛ gbe nɔmlɔ kɛ ya na lɛ, nɛ e gbo, be mi nɛ e hyɛ we lɛ, be mi nɛ pi e he nyɛlɔ ji lɛ; nɛ pohu pi kaa e ngɛ lɛ yayami hlae ɔ, 24lɛɛ ma kpekpemi ɔ nɛ kojo nɔ nɛ fia nɔ nɔ́ ɔ, kɛ muɔ he lue yelɔ ɔ ngɛ kikɛmɛ a mlaa nɛ ɔmɛ a nya. 25Ke e ba mi ja a, ma kpekpemi ɔ nɛ kpɔ nɔ nɛ gbe nɔmlɔ ɔ kɛ je muɔ he lue yelɔ ɔ dɛ mi, nɛ a kpale lɛ kɛ ya ma a mi he nɛ e tu fo kɛ ya sa we ngɛ ɔ. E ya hi lejɛ ɔ kɛ yaa si be mi nɛ osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa a (nɛ a pɔ lɛ nu klɔuklɔu ɔ) ma gbo. 26Se ke nɔmlɔ nɛ ya gbe nɔ ɔ ya hane huzu ɔ ngɛ ma mi he nɛ e tu fo kɛ ya sa we ngɛ ɔ, 27nɛ e ba mi kaa muɔ he lue yelɔ nɛ ɔ ya na lɛ ngɛ e wesa he ma a huzu ɔ se, nɛ e gbe lɛ ɔ, a be lɛ gbenɔ fɔ bue. 28E sa kaa nɔmlɔ nɛ ɔ nɛ hi ma nɛ e ya sa we ngɛ mi ɔ mi kɛ yaa si osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa a ma gbo. Osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa a gbenɔ se loko e ngɛ he blɔ nɛ e kpaleɔ kɛ yaa lɛ nitsɛ e zugba nɔ ekohu. 29Enɛ ɔmɛ ji mlaahi, kɛ blɔ nya tomihi nɛ fɔɔ si ha nyɛ, ngɛ yi nɔhi tsuo ngɛ he tsuaa he nɛ nyɛ ngɛ.
30 “Ke nɔ ko gbe nɔ ko ɔ, a da odase yeli enyɔ, loo nɔ́ a nya mi munyu nɔ nɛ a kɛ kojo lɛ loko a gbe lɛ; a ko da odase yelɔ kake pɛ nya mi munyu nɔ kɛ gbe nɔ ko. 31Jehanɛ, nyɛ ko he wami kpɔmi nɔ́ ko ngɛ nɔ ko nɛ je blɔ gbe nɔ ɔ dɛ; ja a gbe lɛ. 32Jehanɛ se hu, ke nɔ ko tu fo kɛ ya sa we ngɛ ma ko mi ɔ, nyɛ ko he wami kpɔmi nɔ́ ko ngɛ e dɛ; konɛ e ko kpale kɛ ba hi lɛ nitsɛ e zugba nɔ, be mi nɛ osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa a na we nɛ e gbo lolo ɔ. 33Ke nyɛ pee ja a, nyɛ ble zugba a nɛ nyɛ ngɛ nɔ ɔ. Muɔ bleɔ zugba, nɛ kpatami nɔ́ ko be kɛ ha zugba nɛ a pue muɔ si ngɛ nɔ kaa ja nɔ nɛ pue muɔ si ɔ nɔuu e muɔ. 34Nyɛ ko ble zugba nɛ nyɛ ngɛ nɔ ɔ, he nɛ imi hu i hii ɔ; ejakaa imi ji Yawɛ, nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ a kpɛti lɛ i hii.”

Title: MOSE IV, 36
Content:
Yigbayihi a gbosi ní he blɔ nya tomi
1Nikɔtɔmahi nɛ ngɛ Makir binyumu Gilead, nɛ ji Yosef binyumu Manase bibi ɔ weku ɔ mi ɔ ba Mose, kɛ Israel ma nimeli ɔmɛ a ngɔ; 2 nɛ a ba de mɛ ke, “Yawɛ fa mo, wa nyɔmtsɛ ɔ, ke o fɔ sɔ kɛ dla zugba a ha Israel bi ɔmɛ. Jehanɛ se hu, Yawɛ fa mo ke o ngɔ wa nyɛminyumu Zelofehad gbosi ní ɔ ngɔ ha e biyi ɔmɛ. 3Se mohu, ke a ya gba nyumuhi ngɛ Israel wɛtso kpa amɛ a mi ɔ, tse a weto ní ɔ nɛ ji wɔɔ wa nɛmɛ a gbosi ní ɔ ma ya pee wɛtso nɛ a ya dumɔ ɔ a nɔ lo? Ke e ba ja a, lɛɛ tse wɔɔ wa gbosi ní ɔ nɔ ma gbɔ mɔ! 4Ke Heyemi jeha a su, nɛ a kpale gbosi níhi tsuo ngɔ ha nɔtsɛmɛ ɔ, a maa ngɔ Zelofehad biyi ɔmɛ a gbosi ní ɔ ngɔ piɛ wɛtso nɛ a ya dumɔ ɔ a nɔ ɔ he. Kɛkɛ ɔ, wɔɔ lɛɛ wa nɛmɛ a weto ní ɔ nɔ ma gbɔ.”
5Kɛkɛ nɛ Mose wo Israel bi ɔmɛ mlaa nɛ ɔ, kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa lɛ ɔ ke, “Sane nɛ Yosef binyumu Manase wɛtso ɔ kɛ ba a, sane ɔ da. 6Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yawɛ ke, Zelofehad biyi ɔmɛ ngɛ he blɔ nɛ a gbaa nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ a suɔ; se mohu a gba ngɛ a tsɛmɛ a wɛtso ɔ mi pɛ, 7bɔ nɛ pee nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ a gbosi ní nɛ ko je wɛtso kake mi kɛ ya wɛtso kpa mi; se mohu, Israel no tsuaa Israel no nɛ ye gbosi ní ngɛ e tsɛ wɛtso mi. 8Biyo tsuaa biyo nɛ yeɔ gbosi ní ngɛ Israel wɛtso ko mi ɔ, e gba e we puɔ nya no ko ngɛ e wɛtso ɔ mi, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ Israel no tsuaa Israel no nɛ ye e tsɛ gbosi ní, 9nɛ gbosi ní kó je wɛtso kake mi kɛ ya wɛtso kpa mi, se mohu Israel wɛtso tsuaa wɛtso nɛ pɛtɛ lɛ nitsɛ e weto ní he.”
10-11Zelofehad biyi ɔmɛ, Mahla, Tirza, Hogla, Milka, kɛ Noa pee kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa Mose ɔ, nɛ a gba a tsɛ nyɛminyumuhi a binyumuhi 12ngɛ Yosef binyumu Manase weku ɔ mi. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a gbosi ní ɔmɛ tlɔ a tsɛ wɛtso ɔ mi.
13Mlaahi nɛ Yawɛ wo Israel bi ɔmɛ, kɛ blɔ nya tomihi nɛ e ha mɛ kɛ gu Mose nɔ, ngɛ Moab nga kplanaa a nɔ, ngɛ Yordan pa a se, ngɛ Yeriko hanɔ ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ.

Title: MOSE V, NYA TSƆƆMI
Content:
NYA TSƆƆMI
Mose kɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ nyɛɛ nga kplanaa a nɔ hluu kɛ ya su blɔ ɔ nyagbe he ngɛ Moab zugba a nɔ, kɛ yaa ngɔ Kanaan zugba a. Munyuhi nɛ Mose tu kɛ tsɔɔ Israel bi ɔmɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, a to nya pɛpɛɛpɛ, nɛ a ngma kɛ wo Mose Womi Enuɔne ɔ mi.
Sanehi nɛ a he hia wawɛɛ nɛ a naa ngɛ womi ɔ mi ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ: (1) Mose de Israel bi ɔmɛ ke a kai ní nguanguahi nɛ Mawu pee ha mɛ ngɛ jeha nyingmi eywiɛ nɛ be ɔ mi, bɔ nɛ e kpaka mɛ kɛ gu nga kplanaa a nɔ, konɛ a bu Mawu tue, nɛ a ye lɛ anɔkuale. (2) Mose ti mlaa nyɔngma amɛ a mi, nɛ e tsɔɔ kekleekle mlaa a sisi saminya, konɛ ma a nɛ kpá a yi mi kɛ ja Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nɔ kake pɛ. Jehanɛ, mlaa slɔɔtoslɔɔtohi nɛ maa hɛɛ Israel ma a ngɛ zugba nɛ a wo mɛ he si ɔ nɔ ɔ, Mose ti mi ha mɛ ekohu. (3) Somi nɛ Mawu kɛ e ma a so ɔ, Mose kpale tsɔɔ mɛ sisi ekohu. E de kɛ piɛ he ke, níhi nɛ mlaa a ngɛ hlae nɛ a pee ɔ, ma a nɛ hyɛ nɛ a pee pɛpɛɛpɛ. (4) A ha Yoshua blɔ nya kaa Mose se ɔ, e nyɛɛ Mawu ma a hɛ mi. Mose la kɛ je Mawu yi kaa e ye mɛ anɔkuale. Mose gbaa Israel wɛtso ɔmɛ, nɛ lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e gbo ngɛ Moab zugba a nɔ ngɛ Yordan pa a beleku je.
Munyu tso nɛ ngɛ womi ɔ mi ji kaa Mawu he e ma a yi wami; lɛ nitsɛ nɛ e hla mɛ; e gbaa mɛ, nɛ e suɔ mɛ saminya. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e ma a nɛ kai anɔkuale nɛ ɔ, konɛ mɛ hu a suɔ Mawu, nɛ a bu lɛ tue, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ a yi nɛ na wami, nɛ Mawu nɛ gbaa mɛ daa.
Womi ɔ mi munyu komɛ nɛ a he hia saminya ji nɔ́ nɛ a ngma ngɛ 6.4-6. Munyu nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, nɛ́ pee se ɔ, Yesu ba tsɔɔ kaa lɔ ɔ ji mlaa nɛ he hia pe kulaa a ji, “Suɔ Nyɔmtsɛ o Mawu ɔ kɛ o tsui tsuo, kɛ o klaa tsuo, kɛ o he wami tsuo.”
Bɔ nɛ a dla womi ɔ mi ha
Mose kɛ ma a kekleekle ní sɛɛmi 1.1—4.49
Mose kɛ ma a ní sɛɛmi enyɔne 5.1—26.19
a. Mlaa nyɔngma amɛ 5.1—10.22
b. Mlaahi, blɔ nya tomihi, kɛ kɔkɔ bɔmihi 11.1—26.19
Blɔ nyahi nɛ a to kɛ ha Kanaan zugba a mi sɛmi 27.1—28.68
A pee somi ɔ ehe 29.1—30.20
Nyagbe munyuhi nɛ Mose tu 31.1—33.29
Mose gbo 34.1-12

Title: MOSE V, 1
Content:
1Munyuhi nɛ Mose tu kɛ tsɔɔ Israel ma a ngɛ nga kplanaa a nɔ ngɛ Yordan pa a beleku je ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ. Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, Israel ma a ngɛ Yordan kɔ̃ ɔ mi, ngɛ Suf hanɔ ngɛ Paran, kɛ ma nɛ ɔmɛ, Tafel, Laban, Hazerat, kɛ Dizahab a kpɛti. 2Kɛ je Sinai yo ɔ he kɛ gu Edom yo ɔ nɔ kɛ yaa Kadesh Barnea a peeɔ ligbi nyɔngma kɛ kake blɔ nyɛɛmi. 3Se jeha nyingmi eywiɛne ɔ, nyɔhiɔ nɛ ji nyɔngma kɛ kake ɔ we kekleekle ligbi ɔ loko Mose tu munyuhi tsuo nɛ Yawɛ fa lɛ ke e de Israel ma a kɛ tsɔɔ mɛ. 4 Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, Yawɛ gbe Amor bi ɔmɛ a matsɛ, Sihon nɛ hi Heshbon ɔ, kɛ Bashan matsɛ, Og nɛ hi Ashtarot ngɛ Edrei ɔ momo. 5Benɛ ma a ba su Yordan pa a beleku je ngɛ Moab zugba a nɔ ɔ, Mose bɔni mɛ mlaa amɛ a sisi tsɔɔmi.
Nɛ e de ke, 6“Bɔ nɛ nyɛ hi yo nɛ ɔ he ɔ hiɛ; 7nyɛɛ hia nɛ nyɛɛ ya nyɛ hɛ mi. Nyɛɛ ya Amor bi ɔmɛ a yo zugba amɛ, kɛ zugbahi nɛ bɔle mɛ ɔ tsuo a nɔ. Nyɛɛ ya Yordan kɔ̃ ɔ mi, yo nɔ zugba amɛ, zugba kpataa amɛ, kɛ leneyi je zugba a nɔ, kɛ ya su Mediterenia wo ɔ nya. Nyɛɛ ya Kanaan bi ɔmɛ a zugba a nɔ, kɛ Lebanon yo ɔmɛ a nɔ, kɛ ya su pa ngua a nɛ a tsɛɛ Yufrate ɔ nya. 8Zugba nɛ ɔ tsuo nɛ imi Yawɛ, i wo nyɛ nɛmɛ Abraham, Isak, kɛ Yakob si ke ma ngɔ ha mɛ, kɛ a nina a nɛ. Nyɛɛ ya nɛ nyɛ ya ngɔ zugba a tsuo kulaa.”
Mose wo ma nya dali komɛ
(Mose II, 18.13-27)
9Mose de Israel ma a ke, “Jamɛ a be ɔ mi, benɛ wa ngɛ Sinai yo ɔ he ɔ, i de nyɛ ke, ‘Imi nɔ kake, i be nyɛ nɔ nyɛe ma hyɛ hu; 10Yawɛ nyɛ Mawu ɔ ha nɛ amlɔ nɛ ɔ nyɛ he hiɛ babauu kaa dodoehi ngɛ hiɔwe. 11Yawɛ, nyɛ nɛmɛ a Mawu ɔ ma ha nyɛ maa hiɛ pe bɔ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ nɛ ɔ si akpe abɔ; nɛ e maa gbaa nyɛ kaa bɔ nɛ e wo si ɔ. 12Kɛ ma pee kɛɛ nɛ imi nɔ kake too ma tloo ma tlomi nɛ jiɔ nɛ ɔ? Kɛ ma pee kɛɛ nɛ imi nɔ kake ma nyɛ hyɛ nyɛ munyu tsɔwitsɔwi ɔmɛ a mi ha nyɛ? 13Nyɛɛ hla nyumuhi nɛ le ní, nɛ a ngɛ juɛmi, nɛ a ngɛ biɛ kpakpa hulɔ ngɛ nyɛ wɛtso ɔmɛ a nya, konɛ ma ngɔ mɛ kɛ to ma a nya.’ 14Nyɛ ha heto ke bɔ nɛ i de ɔ hi, nɛ nyɛ maa pee ja. 15Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i ngɔ wɛtsoyihi nɛ ji nyumuhi nɛ le ní, nɛ a ngɛ juɛmi, nɛ a ngɛ biɛ kpakpa nɛ nyɛ hla a ngɔ to ma a nya. Ni komɛ hyɛ nimli nyɔngma nɔ, ni komɛ hyɛ nimli nyingmi enuɔ nɔ, ni komɛ hyɛ nimli lafa nɔ, nɛ ni komɛ hu hyɛ nimli akpe nɔ. Jehanɛ i hla nɔ hyɛli kpa komɛ kɛ je nyɛ wɛtso ɔmɛ tsuo a mi.”
16“Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, i wo ma nya dali ɔmɛ mlaa ke, ‘Sanehi nɛ nyɛ nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ kɛ maa ba nyɛ hɛ mi ɔ, nyɛɛ hyɛ a mi. Nyɛɛ kojo ngɛ blɔ nɛ da nɔ, nyɛ nyɛmimɛ Israel bi sɔuu a kpɛti sane jio, a ti nɔ ko kɛ nibwɔhi nɛ ngɛ nyɛ ngɔ a kpɛti sane jio. 17Nyɛ ko hyɛ nɔ hɛ mi ngɛ sane yemi mi; nyɛɛ bu nɔ tsuaa nɔ tue pɛpɛɛpɛ. Nyɛ ko ye nɔmlɔ adesa hɛ mi gbeye; ejakaa Mawu ji nɔ nɛ buáá sane he. Se ke sane ko pa nyɛ ɔ, lɛɛ nyɛ kɛ ba ye hɛ mi, konɛ imi nitsɛ ma hyɛ mi.’ 18Jamɛ a be ɔ mi nɔuu ɔ, i wo nyɛ níhi tsuo nɛ sa kaa nyɛɛ pee ɔ a he mlaa.
A tsɔ slaali kɛ je Kadesh Barnea
(Mose IV, 13.1-33)
19“Kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ, wa Mawu ɔ fa wɔ ɔ, wa hia kɛ je Sinai yo ɔ he, kɛ gu nga kplanaa nɛ nɔ ngɛ gbeye ɔ nɔ, kɛ ya be ngɛ Amor bi ɔmɛ a yo zugba amɛ a nɔ. 20-21Benɛ wa ba su Kadesh Barnea a, i de nyɛ ke, ‘Jehanɛ lɛɛ nyɛ su Amor bi ɔmɛ a yo zugba nɛ Yawɛ, wa nɛmɛ a Mawu ɔ kɛ ngɛ wɔ hae ɔ nɔ. Nyɛɛ ya nɛ nyɛ ya ngɔ kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa wɔ ɔ. Nyɛ ko to tsle, nɛ nyɛ ko ye gbeye.’
22“Se nyɛ tsuo nyɛ ba ye ngɔ, nɛ nyɛ ba de mi ke, ‘Waa tsɔ nyumuhi kɛ sɛ hlami kɛ ya slaa zugba a, nɛ́ a ba tsɔɔ wɔ blɔ nɛ wa maa gu nɔ ɔ, nɛ́ a de wɔ mahi nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ a he nɔ́ ko.’
23“Ga nɛ nyɛ wo ɔ, i na kaa e hi, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i hla nyɛ kpɛti nihi nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ, nɔ kakaaka ngɛ nyɛ wɛtso ɔmɛ a nya. 24I wo mɛ blɔ, nɛ a gu yo nɔ je kɛ ya su Eshkol kɔ̃ ɔ mi tɔɔ; nɛ a slaa lejɛ ɔ. 25A ngɔ zugba a nɔ tso yiblii ɔ eko kɛ kple si kɛ ba bɔ wɔ amaniɛ ke, ‘Zugba nɛ Yawɛ, wa Mawu ɔ ngɛ wɔ hae nɛ ɔ, e ji zugba kpakpa.’
26 “Se nyɛ tsɔ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ hɛ mi atuã; nyɛ bui e fami ɔ fɛɛ; nyɛ kua yo ɔ kuɔmi; 27nɛ nyɛ tu munyu huitihuiti ke, ‘Akɛnɛ Yawɛ sume wa sane he je ɔ, e je wɔ kɛ je Egipt zugba a nɔ kɛ ba ha Amor bi ɔmɛ, konɛ a kpata wa hɛ mi. 28Jije wa maa ya? Wa nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ ha wa tsui po. A ke nihi nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ je oblai; a he wa, nɛ a ka pe wɔ. A ke mahi nɛ a ngɛ mi ɔ, ma nguanguahi nɛ a fia gbogbohi nɛ ya hiɔwe ploplooplo ngɔ wo a he. Jehanɛ hu, mɛ nitsɛmɛ a na oblai nɛ ɔmɛ paa kɛ a hɛngmɛ!’
29“Se i de nyɛ ke, ‘Nyɛ ko nu sawale, nɛ nyɛ ko ye mɛ gbeye. 30Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ nɛ nyɛɛ nyɛ hɛ mi ɔ, lɛ nitsɛ e maa hwu ha nyɛ kaa bɔ nɛ e pee ha nyɛ ngɛ Egipt, 31 kɛ nga kplanaa a nɔ nɛ nyɛ na kɛ nyɛ hɛngmɛ ɔ. Nyɛ na bɔ nɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ hɛɛ nyɛ fiafiaafia hluu kɛ ba hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ, kaa bɔ nɛ tsɛ hɛɛɔ e bi ɔ.’ 32 Se nɛ i de nyɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ se po, nyɛ he we Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ yi, 33be mi nɛ lɛɛ daa nɛ ɔ e nyɛɛ nyɛ hɛ mi kɛ ngɛ sito he hlae ha nyɛ. Nyɔ mi ɔ, e nyɛɛ nyɛ hɛ mi kɛ la titima, nɛ piani ɔ, e nyɛɛ nyɛ hɛ mi ngɛ bɔku titima mi kɛ tsɔɔ nyɛ blɔ.
Yawɛ gbla Israel tue
(Mose IV, 14.20-45)
34 “Benɛ Yawɛ nu nyɛ munyu ɔmɛ ɔ, e mi mi wo la, nɛ e ka kita ke, 35‘Ke kikɛmɛ a yi nɔ yaya bi nɛ ɔmɛ a ti nɔ ko na zugba kpakpa nɛ i ka he kita ke ma ngɔ ha nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ ɔ fii! 36Yefune bi Kaleb pɛ lɛ maa na zugba a. Lɛɛ e ye mi anɔkuale, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ma ngɔ zugba nɛ e ya slaa a ngɔ ha lɛ kɛ e nina.’ 37Nyɛ he ɔ, Yawɛ mi mi fu imi hulɔ, nɛ e de ke, ‘Mo Mose po, o be lejɛ ɔ sue. 38Nun bi Yoshua, o sɔmɔlɔ ɔ lɛɛ e ma ya su lejɛ ɔ. Wo lɛ he wami, ejakaa lɛ nɛ e maa nyɛɛ Israel ma a hɛ mi kɛ ya ngɔ zugba a.’
39“Jehanɛ Yawɛ de wɔ tsuo ke, ‘Nyɛ bimɛ tsɔwi ɔmɛ nɛ na we nɛ a le slɔɔto nɛ ngɛ kpakpa kɛ yayami a kpɛti lolo, nɛ́ nyɛ de ngɛ a he ke he nyɛli ma ba nuu mɛ ɔ, mɛ ma ngɔ zugba a kɛ ha nɛ a hi nɔ. 40Se nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛɛ kpale nyɛ se kɛ gu nga kplanaa a nɔ kɛ ho Wo Tsu ɔ he ya.’
41“Nyɛ he nɔ ke, ‘Wa tɔ̃ Yawɛ nɔ. Jehanɛ lɛɛ wa maa ya nɛ wa ya hwu ta a kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ, wa Mawu ɔ fa wɔ ɔ.’ Kɛkɛ nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ wo e ta hwumi ní; nyɛ ngɔ lɛ kaa plasee nɔ́ ko kaa nyɛ ma ya tua yo nɔ ma a.
42“Se Yawɛ de mi ke, ‘De mɛ ke a ko hia ta, nɛ a ko hwu ta; ejakaa i be a he piɛe. Ke a hia ta a, a he nyɛli ɔmɛ maa ye a nɔ.’ 43Bɔ nɛ i de nyɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ; se nyɛ bui tue. Nyɛ tsɔ Yawɛ hɛ mi atuã; nyɛ si nyɛ gugue, nɛ nyɛ kuɔ kɛ ho yo ɔ nɔ ya. 44Kɛkɛ nɛ Amor bi ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ Edom yo ɔmɛ a nɔ ɔ je kpo kɛ ba kaa hwo bihi, nɛ a kɛ nyɛ ba kpe. A fie nyɛ hluu kɛ ya su Horma, nɛ a ye nyɛ nɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, ngɛ Edom yo zugba a nɔ. 45Nyɛ kpale kɛ ba nɛ nyɛ ba wo yana ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi; se Yawɛ bui nyɛ tue, nɛ e he we nyɛ nɔ hulɔ.
Jehahi nɛ a ye ngɛ nga kplanaa a nɔ
46“Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, wa hi Kadesh be babauu.

Title: MOSE V, 2
Content:
1 “Nyagbe ɔ, wa kpale hia kɛ gu Wo Tsu ɔ nya blɔ kɛ ho nga a nɔ ya kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa wɔ ɔ. Wa wo lalaalo be babauu ngɛ Edom yo zugba a nɔ.
2“Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, Yawɛ de mi ke, 3‘Bɔ nɛ nyɛ wo lalaalo ngɛ yo zugba a nɔ ɔ, e hiɛ; nyɛ plɛ kɛ ya omleyi je. 4 De ma a tsuo ke nyɛ yaa be ngɛ nyɛ nyɛmimɛ Esau bi ɔmɛ a zugba a nɔ kɛ ho. Mɛɛ lɛɛ Edom yo ɔ he a hii. A maa ye nyɛ gbeye. 5Se nyɛɛ hyɛ saminya nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ mɛ ko hwu ta. I be nyɛ a zugba a ekoeko hae; nane mami he kake po be nyɛ nɔ́ pee; ejakaa i ngɔ Edom yo ɔ ngɔ ha Esau nina kaa a weto ní. 6Nyɛ ma he niye ní nɛ nyɛ maa wo he hiɔ kɛ nyu ngɛ a dɛ.’
7“Nyɛ na bɔ nɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ gbaa nyɛ ngɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ mi, nɛ e baa nyɛ yi ngɛ nga kplanaa tilaa nɛ ɔ nɔ. Jeha nyingmi eywiɛ sɔuu ji nɛ ɔ nɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ hyɛ nyɛ nɔ, nɛ nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko hia we nyɛ.
8“Kɛkɛ nɛ wa pue nɔ; wa si blɔ nɛ yaa Elat kɛ Eziongeber ma amɛ a mi ɔ, nɛ wa gu Ngo wo ɔ nya blɔ. Jehanɛ, wa plɛ kɛ gu omleyi je, kɛ beleku je a kpɛti blɔ kɛ yaa Moab nga a nɔ. 9 Yawɛ de mi ke, ‘Koo hao Moab bi ɔmɛ nɛ ji Lot nina a. I ngɔ Ar ma a ngɔ ha mɛ. I be mo a zugba a eko hae.’ ”
10Oblai komɛ nɛ a tsɛɛ mɛ Emim bi hu hi Ar sa a; nɛ e mi nihi hiɛ. Oblai nɛ ɔmɛ ka kaa Anak bi ɔmɛ. 11A tsɛɛ mɛ ke Refaim hulɔ; se Moab bi ɔmɛ tsɛɛ mɛ Emim bi. 12Hor bi ɔmɛ hu hi Edom sa a; se Esau nina a ba fie mɛ, nɛ a kpata a hɛ mi, nɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a hi lejɛ ɔ, kaa bɔ nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ hu ba fie a he nyɛli ɔmɛ kɛ je zugba nɛ ji weto ní nɛ Yawɛ ngɔ ha mɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ.
13“Jehanɛ, wa ya po Zered pa a kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa wɔ ɔ. 14 Be nɛ e ngɔ wɔ kɛ nyɛɛ kɛ je Kadesh Barnea kɛ ba su be nɛ wa po Zered pa a pee jeha nyingmi etɛ kɛ kpaanyɔ. Jamɛ a yi nɔ bi ta buli ɔmɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ gbo kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ ka mɛ kita a. 15Anɔkuale mi ɔ, Yawɛ kɛ mɛ to ní kɛ ya si mɛ tsuo a hɛ mi kpata.
16“Benɛ ta buli ɔmɛ tsuo a hɛ mi kpata se ɔ, 17Yawɛ de wɔ ke, 18‘Mwɔnɛ ɔ, nyɛ yaa gu Moab huzu nya ngɛ Ar kasa nya. 19 Ke nyɛ ya su Amon bi ɔmɛ nɛ ji Lot nina a a zugba a huzu nya a, nyɛ ko hao mɛ, nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ mɛ ko hwu ta hulɔ; ejakaa i be nyɛ a zugba a ekoeko hae.’ ”
20(A buu zugba nɛ ɔ hu kaa oblaihi nɛ a tsɛɛ mɛ Refaim ɔ a zugba; mɛ lɛ a hi lejɛ ɔ sa a; se Amon bi ɔmɛ tsɛɛ mɛ Zamzum bi. 21Ma nɛ ɔ kle, nɛ e he wa; e mi ni ɔmɛ ka gagaaga kaa Anak bi. A hiɛ babauu, se Yawɛ kpata a hɛ mi. Amon bi ɔmɛ ya ngɔ a zugba a, nɛ a hi lejɛ ɔ. 22Yawɛ pee Edom bi ɔmɛ nɛ ji Esau nina a jã nɔuu. E kpata Hor bi ɔmɛ a hɛ mi, nɛ Edom bi ɔmɛ ya ngɔ a zugba a, nɛ a hi lejɛ ɔ. A ngɛ lejɛ ɔ kɛ mwɔɔ. 23Nihi nɛ je pa kpɔ Kreta nɔ ɔ, hi Mediterenia wo nya zugba a nɔ be ko. Mɛ lɛ a gbe Avim bi ɔmɛ nɛ hi lejɛ ɔ sa a, nɛ a ngɔ a zugba a tsuo nɛ ngɛ leneyi je ɔ kɛ ya su Gaza tɔɔ.)
24“Benɛ wa nyɛɛ Moab zugba a nɔ kɛ be se ɔ, Yawɛ de mi ke, ‘Nyɛ pue blɔ nɛ nyɛ ya po Arnon pa a. I ngɔ Amor matsɛ, Sihon nɛ je Heshbon kɛ e zugba a ngɔ wo nyɛ dɛ. Nyɛ ya tua lɛ, nɛ nyɛɛ ngɔ e zugba a. 25Kɛ je mwɔnɛ nɛ ɔ kɛ yaa a, ma ha nihi nɛ ngɛ je ɔ mi tsuo maa ye nyɛ gbeye. Ke a wo nyɛ ta a, sawale maa nu nɔ tsuaa nɔ.’
Israel ye Matsɛ Sihon nɔ
(Mose IV, 21.21-30)
26“Jehanɛ, i tsɔ nihi kɛ je Kedemot nga kplanaa a nɔ kɛ ho Heshbon matsɛ, Sihon ngɔ ya kɛ he jɔmi munyu ke, 27‘Mo ha nɛ waa gu o huzu ɔ nya kɛ be; wa maa nyɛɛ blɔ tɛɛ kɛ ho. Wa be blɔ ɔ nɔ jee. 28Niye ní nɛ wa maa ye, kɛ nyu hu nɛ wa maa nu ɔ, wa ma he kɛ sika. Ha nɛ waa nyɛɛ kɛ be kɛkɛ. 29Kaa bɔ nɛ Esau nina a nɛ ngɛ Edom yo ɔ nɔ, kɛ Moab bi ɔmɛ hu nɛ ngɛ Ar ɔ pee ha wɔ ɔ, mo hu ngmɛɛ wɔ blɔ kɛ ya si wa ma ya po Yordan pa a, kɛ ya zugba nɛ Yawɛ, wa Mawu ɔ ha wɔ ɔ nɔ.’
30“Se Heshbon matsɛ, Sihon kplɛɛ we nɛ waa gu e zugba a mi kɛ be. Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ kplii e tsui, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ waa ye e nɔ, nɛ́ wa kpɔ e zugba a ngɛ e dɛ. Jamɛ a zugba a nɔ wa ngɛ kɛ sá.
31“Jehanɛ, Yawɛ de mi ke, ‘Hyɛ, i jɔɔ Matsɛ Sihon kɛ e zugba a he ha nyɛ. Nyɛ ya ngɔ e zugba a, nɛ nyɛɛ hi nɔ.’ 32Kɛkɛ nɛ Matsɛ Sihon kɛ e ma a tsuo je kpo nɛ a kɛ wɔ ba hwu ta ngɛ Yahaz. 33Yawɛ, wa Mawu ɔ ngɔ lɛ wo wa dɛ, nɛ wa gbe e kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ, kɛ e we bi ɔmɛ tsuo. 34Jamɛ a be ɔ mi nɔuu nɛ wa ngɔ e ma amɛ tsuo, nɛ wa kpata mɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ a hɛ mi. Wa gbe nɔ tsuaa nɔ, nyumuhi, yihi, kɛ jokuɛwi tsuo; wa si we nɔ kake po. 35Wa ngɔ we mi lohwe ɔmɛ, nɛ wa ha níhi ngɛ ma amɛ a mi. 36Kɛ je Aroer nɛ ngɛ Arnon kɔ̃ ɔ nya kɛ ya su Gilead ɔ, ma ko ma ko be nɛ wa nyɛ we lɛ; Yawɛ, wa Mawu ɔ ngɔ mɛ tsuo wo wa dɛ. 37Hehi nɛ Yawɛ, wa Mawu ɔ fa wɔ ke wa ko ya a pɛ nɛ wa yɛ; mɛ ji Amon bi ɔmɛ a zugba a, Yabok pa a nya hiɛ kɛ hiɛ, kɛ a ma amɛ nɛ ngɛ yo nɔ ɔ, kɛ he kpa komɛ hulɔ.

Title: MOSE V, 3
Content:
Israel ye Matsɛ Og nɔ
(Mose IV, 21.31-35)
1“Jehanɛ, wa dɔ wa yi kɛ gu Bashan blɔ, nɛ Bashan matsɛ, Og kɛ e ma a tsuo je kpo konɛ a kɛ wɔ ba hwu ta ngɛ Edrei. 2Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ de mi ke, ‘Koo ye lɛ gbeye, ejakaa i ngɔ e kɛ e ma a, kɛ e zugba a tsuo ngɔ wo o dɛ nɛ o pee lɛ kaa bɔ nɛ o pee Amor bi ɔmɛ a matsɛ, Sihon nɛ hi Heshbon ɔ.’
3“Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yawɛ ngɔ Bashan matsɛ, Og hu kɛ e ma a mi bi ɔmɛ tsuo ngɔ wo wa dɛ; wa gbe mɛ tsuo kulaa; nɔ ko nɔ ko píɛ. 4Wa kpɔ a ma amɛ tsuo ngɛ be kake nɔuu mi; e píɛ ekoeko nɛ wa kpɔ we. Mahi tsuo nɛ wa kpɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ ji nyingmi ekpa, nɛ ji Argob zugba a tsuo, he nɛ Matsɛ Og nɛ je Bashan ɔ yeɔ tsɛ ngɛ ɔ. 5Ma nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ji mahi nɛ a fia gbogbo gojogojoo ngɔ wo a he, kɛ a nya agbohi kɛ a se lami dade níhi. E slo kɔpehi babauu nɛ a fiɛ gbogbo ngɔ wui a he. 6Wa kpata mɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ a hɛ mi. Bɔ nɛ wa pee Heshbon matsɛ, Sihon ɔ, ja nɔuu wa pee ma tsuaa ma kɛ e mi nyumu ɔmɛ, yi ɔmɛ, kɛ jokuɛwi ɔmɛ. 7Se lohwe ɔmɛ tsuo lɛɛ wa ngɔ, nɛ wa ha níhi ngɛ ma amɛ a mi.
8“Jamɛ a be ɔ mi kɛ̃ ɔ, wa kpɔ zugba a nɛ ngɛ Yordan pa a beleku je ɔ kɛ je matsɛmɛ enyɔ nɛ ɔmɛ a dɛ, kɛ je Arnon pa a nya kɛ ya si Hermon yo ɔ he. 9(Sidon bi ɔmɛ tsɛɔ Hermon yo ɔ ke Sirion, se Amor bi ɔmɛ tsɛɔ lɛ Senir.) 10Wa ngɔ Matsɛ Og nɛ je Bashan ɔ e zugba a tsuo, mahi nɛ ngɛ yo nɔ zugba kpataa a, kɛ Gilead, kɛ Bashan zugba amɛ a nɔ ɔ, hluu kɛ ya su Saleka kɛ Edrei nɛ ji mahi nɛ ngɛ beleku je ɔ.”
11Bashan matsɛ, Og pɛ ji oblaihi nɛ a tsɛɛ mɛ Refaim ɔ a ti nɔ nɛ piɛ. E dade sa tso ngɛ Amon bi ɔmɛ a ma nɛ a tsɛɔ Raba a kɛ mwɔɔ. Sa tso ɔ kami ji gugue enyɔ kɛ nine mi blimi enyɔ, nɛ e blimi ji gugue kake kaa bɔ nɛ níhi a susumi mlaa a ngɛ ɔ.
Wɛtsohi nɛ hi Yordan pa a beleku je
(Mose IV, 32.1-42)
12“Benɛ wa ngɔ zugba a, i ha Ruben kɛ Gad wɛtso ɔmɛ zugba nɛ ngɛ Aroer ma a omleyi je ngɛ Arnon pa a kasa nya, kɛ Gilead yo zugba a fa, kɛ e nɔ ma amɛ. 13Manase wɛtso fa a hu, i ha mɛ Gilead zugba nɛ piɛ ɔ, kɛ Bashan tsuo, he nɛ Og ye tsɛ ngɛ ɔ; lɔ ɔ ji Argob zugba a tsuo.”
Sa a, a tsɛɛ Bashan ke oblaihi a zugba. 14Yair nɛ je Manase wɛtso ɔ mi ɔ ngɔ Argob zugba nɛ a tsɛɛ Bashan ɔ tsuo kɛ ya su Geshur bi ɔmɛ, kɛ Maaka bi ɔmɛ a huzu ɔ nya. E ngɔ e biɛ ngɔ wo kɔpe ɔmɛ; nɛ kɛ ba si mwɔnɛ ɔ, a tsɛɛ mɛ ke Yair kɔpehi.
15“I ngɔ Gilead ngɔ ha Makir nɛ je Manase wɛtso ɔ mi ɔ. 16I ngɔ zugba a nɛ ngɛ kɛ je Gilead kɛ ya na Arnon pa a ngɔ ha Ruben kɛ Gad wɛtso ɔmɛ. Pa a kpɛti pee a huzu ngɛ leneyi je; nɛ a huzu nɛ ngɛ omleyi je ji Yabok pa a nɛ e fa peeɔ Amon bi ɔmɛ a huzu ɔ. 17Jehanɛ, ngɛ beleku je ɔ, a zugba a huzu ya su Yordan pa a nya. E je Galilea wo ɔ nya ngɛ omleyi je kɛ ya na Ngo wo ɔ ngɛ leneyi je, ngɛ Pisga yo ɔ he ngɛ beleku je.
18 “Jamɛ a be ɔ mi nɔuu ɔ, i fa nyɛ ke, ‘Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ ngɔ zugba nɛ ɔ ngɔ ha nyɛ kaa nyɛ weto ní. Nyɛ nihi nɛ nyɛ su ta yami ɔ, nyɛɛ mia kɛ ta hwumi ní kɛ nyɛɛ nyɛ nyɛmimɛ Israel wɛtso kpa amɛ a hɛ mi kɛ ya po Yordan pa a, nɛ nyɛɛ piɛ a he nɛ ngɔ a zugba a. 19Nyɛ yi ɔmɛ, nyɛ bimɛ tsɔwi ɔmɛ, kɛ nyɛ na amɛ lɛɛ a hi ma amɛ nɛ i ngɔ ha nyɛ ɔ a mi. I le kaa nyɛ ngɛ lohwehi babauu. 20Nyɛɛ piɛ nyɛ nyɛmimɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ a he kɛ ya si a maa ngɔ zugba a nɛ Yawɛ ngɛ mɛ hae ngɛ Yordan pa a bonyoku je ɔ; nɛ Yawɛ ma ha mɛ hu a maa hi nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ e pee ha nyɛ ɔ. Lɔ ɔ se loko nyɛɛ kpale kɛ ba zugba nɛ i ngɔ ha nyɛ ɔ nɔ.’
21“Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, i fa Yoshua ke, ‘Nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ na nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ pee matsɛmɛ enyɔ nɛ ɔmɛ; jã kɛ̃ Yawɛ maa pee matsɛmɛ kpa amɛ nɛ nyɛ ma ya gu a zugba amɛ a nɔ ɔ. 22Nyɛ ko ye mɛ gbeye, ejakaa Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ maa hwu ha nyɛ.’ ”
A ngmɛ́ Mose blɔ nɛ e ya Kanaan
23 Mose tsa nɔ ke, “I kpa Yawɛ pɛɛ kɛ hɛdɔ jamɛ a be ɔ mi ke, 24‘Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ lee, i le kaa ní nguanguahi, kɛ nyakpɛ níhi nɛ o maa pee ɔ a sisije kɛkɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ; ejakaa mawu ko mawu ko be hiɔwe, loo zugba a nɔ nɛ ma nyɛ ní nguanguahi nɛ o tsu nɛ ɔ ma tsu! 25Yawɛ, i kpa mo pɛɛ, ha nɛ ma po Yordan pa a, nɛ ma ya na zugba kpakpa nɛ ngɛ pa a se ɔ, yo zugba nɛ ngɛ fɛu ɔ, kɛ Lebanon yo ɔmɛ!’
26“Nyɛ he ɔ, Yawɛ mi mi fu mi, nɛ e bui mi tue. Yawɛ de mi ke, ‘E hiɛ! Koo wo nɔ́ nɛ ɔ nɔ ta hu! 27Kuɔ ɔ kɛ ya Pisga yo ɔ yi mi, konɛ o hyɛ kɛ o hɛngmɛ kɛkɛ, kɛ je beleku je kɛ ya bonyoku je, jehanɛ kɛ je omleyi je kɛ ya leneyi je. Hyɛ he tsuaa he saminya; ejakaa o be Yordan pa nɛ ɔ poe kɔkɔɔkɔ. 28Wo Yoshua mlaa, nɛ o wo lɛ kã kɛ he wami; ejakaa lɛ ji nɔ nɛ maa nyɛɛ ma a hɛ mi kɛ po pa a kɛ ya ngɔ zugba a nɛ o ngɛ hyɛe ɔ.’
29“Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, wa tlɔ kɔ̃ nɛ ngɛ Betpeor ma a hanɔ ɔ mi.”

Title: MOSE V, 4
Content:
Mose de Israel ma a ke a ye mlaa amɛ a nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ
1Jehanɛ Mose de Israel ma a ke, “Nyɛɛ bu mlaa amɛ nɛ ma tsɔɔ nyɛ ɔ tue, nɛ nyɛɛ ye a nɔ, konɛ nyɛ yi nɛ na wami, nɛ́ nyɛ ya ngɔ zugba a nɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ nɛmɛ a Mawu ɔ kɛ ngɛ nyɛ hae ɔ. 2 Nyɛ ko ngɔ nɔ́ ko kɛ piɛ mlaa nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ woe nɛ ɔ he; nɛ nyɛ ko je nɔ́ ko kɛ je mi; nyɛɛ ye Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ mlaa amɛ nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ woe nɛ ɔ a nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ. 3 Nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ na nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ pee ngɛ Peor yo ɔ he. Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ya nyɛɛ Baal se ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ kpata e hɛ mi. 4Se nyɛ nihi tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ nɛ nyɛ mɛtɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ ngɛ wami mi kɛ mwɔɔ.
5“I tsɔɔ nyɛ mlaa amɛ tsuo kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ, ye Mawu ɔ fa mi ke ma pee ɔ; nyɛɛ ye a nɔ ngɛ zugba nɛ nyɛ yaa ngɔ ɔ nɔ. 6Nyɛɛ ye a nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ, konɛ ma amɛ tsuo nɛ maa nu blɔ nya tomi nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a he ɔ, a de ke, ‘Niinɛ, ma kpetekpleenyɛ nɛ le ní, nɛ ngɛ juɛmi saminya ji nɛ ɔ nɛ!’
7“Ma kpetekpleenyɛ te nɛ ngɛ nɛ e mawuhi baa e kasa nya kikɛ nɛ ɔ, kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ, wa Mawu ɔ baa wa ngɔ be tsuaa be nɛ wa tsɛ lɛ ɔ? 8Jehanɛ hu, ma kpetekpleenyɛ te nɛ ngɛ nɛ e mlaahi da kaa ní nɛmɛ tsuo nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ tsɔɔe mwɔnɛ nɛ ɔ? 9Nyɛɛ hyɛ saminya! Nyɛ hɛ nɛ hi nyɛ he nɔ ngɛ níhi nɛ nyɛ na kɛ nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ hɛngmɛ ɔ a he. Nyɛ hɛ ko je nɔ ligbi ko ligbi ko nyɛ wami be tsuo. Nyɛɛ tsɔɔ nyɛ bimɛ, kɛ nyɛ bibimɛ nɛ a le, 10kaa ligbi ɔ nɛ nyɛ da si ngɛ Sinai yo ɔ he ngɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ hɛ mi ɔ, Yawɛ de mi ke, ‘Bua ma a nya. Ha nɛ a bu nɔ́ nɛ ma de mɛ ɔ tue, konɛ a ye mi gbeye a wami be tsuo; nɛ a tsɔɔ a bimɛ, nɛ mɛ hu a ye mi gbeye.’
11 “Nyɛ de nyɛ bimɛ bɔ nɛ nyɛ ba da si ngɛ yo ɔ sisi, kɛ bɔ nɛ yo ɔ ngɛ tsoe, nɛ la a ya hiɔwe ploplooplo, nɛ bɔku wo diblii kpii kɛ bɔle yo ɔ. 12Jehanɛ, nyɛ de mɛ bɔ nɛ Yawɛ kɛ nyɛ tu munyu kɛ je la a mi. Nyɛ nu munyu ɔmɛ, se nyɛ nɛ́ lɛ nitsɛ e su ko kulaa; gbi ɔ kɛkɛ nɛ nyɛ nu nɛ ngɛ munyu ɔmɛ tue. 13 E tsɔɔ nyɛ bɔ nɛ nyɛ maa pee kɛ ye somi nɛ e kɛ nyɛ so ɔ nɔ; lɔ ɔ ji kaa nyɛ maa ye mlaa nyɔngma amɛ nɛ e ngma ngɛ tɛ tɛtlɛɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ a nɔ ɔ a nɔ. 14 Yawɛ de mi jamɛ a be ɔ mi ke ma tsɔɔ nyɛ mlaa amɛ tsuo nɛ nyɛ maa ye a nɔ ngɛ zugba a nɛ nyɛ yaa ngɔ ɔ nɔ ɔ.
A bɔ ma a kɔkɔ ngɛ amaga jami he
15“Benɛ Yawɛ kɛ nyɛ tu munyu kɛ je la a mi ngɛ Sinai yo ɔ nɔ ɔ, nyɛ nɛ́ su ko su ko. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ hyɛ nyɛ he nɔ saminya, 16 konɛ nyɛ ko ya ye sane yaya, nɛ nyɛ ya pee amaga ko ha nyɛ he, nɛ ngɛ kaa nyumu, loo yo, 17 loo lohwe ko nɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ, loo lohwe pɛlitsɛ nɛ tee ngɛ kɔɔhiɔ mi, 18loo nɔ́ ko nɛ waa, loo lo. Nyɛ ko pee ekoeko henɔ ko kulaa. 19Nyɛ ko ha níhi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ hyɛe ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ, pu, nyɔhiɔ, kɛ dodoehi babauu nɛ ha si ngɛ hiɔwe nɛ ɔ nɛ gbla nyɛ juɛmi kɛ ya ja mɛ, nɛ nyɛ sɔmɔ mɛ. Ejakaa Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ ngɔ mɛ ngɔ ha ma amɛ tsuo nɛ ngɛ je ɔ mi ɔ. 20 Se nyɛɛ lɛɛ, Yawɛ kpɔ̃ nyɛ kɛ je Egipt yi mi wami wawɛɛ ɔ sisi. E je nyɛ konɛ e pee nyɛ lɛ nitsɛ e ma kulaa, kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ ji mwɔnɛ nɛ ɔ. 21 Nyɛ he ɔ, Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ mi mi fu mi, nɛ e ka kita ke i be Yordan pa a poe kɛ ya zugba kpakpa a nɛ e ngɔ kɛ ngɛ nyɛ hae ɔ nɔ. 22Imi lɛɛ ma gbo ngɛ hiɛ ɔ, ngɛ zugba nɛ ɔ nɔ, nɛ i be Yordan pa a poe; se nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ maa po pa a kɛ ya ngɔ zugba kpakpa a. 23Nyɛɛ hyɛ nɛ hi, konɛ nyɛ hɛ ko je somi nɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ kɛ nyɛ so ɔ nɔ. Mlaa nɛ e wo nyɛ ke nyɛ ko pee amaga ko ɔ, nyɛɛ ye nɔ. 24 Ejakaa Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ ngɛ kaa la nɛ ngɛ tsoe plamplam; a kɛ lɛ plee we nɔ́ he.
25“Ke nyɛ se kɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ, nɛ nyɛ ná bimɛ, kɛ bibimɛ ɔ, nyɛ ko pee yayami kaa nyɛ maa puɛ amaga ko nɛ ngɛ su ko kulaa ha nyɛ he. E ji yayami agbo ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi nɛ ma ha e mi mi maa wo la. 26I tsɛ hiɔwe kɛ zugba odase kaa ke nyɛ bui mi tue ɔ, nyɛ hɛ mi ma kpata ngɛ zugba a nɔ. Lɛɛ zugba a nɛ nyɛ yaa ngɔ ngɛ Yordan pa a se ɔ, nyɛ se be kɛe ngɛ nɔ. A ma kpata nyɛ hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ. 27 Yawɛ maa gbɛ nyɛ ngɔ fĩa je ma kpa amɛ a mi, nɛ nyɛ ti nihi bɔɔ pɛ nɛ a yi ma na wami. 28Nyɛ ma ya sɔmɔ mawuhi nɛ a kɛ nɔmlɔ adesa nine pee ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, mawuhi nɛ a kɛ tso pee, mawuhi nɛ a kɛ tɛ pee, mawuhi nɛ hyɛ we nɔ́, nɛ a nui nɔ́, kɛ mawuhi nɛ a yi ní, nɛ a nui nɔ́ he fu. 29 Nyɛ ma hla Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Ke nyɛ hla lɛ kɛ nyɛ tsui tsuo ɔ, nyɛ maa na lɛ. 30Ke nyɛ ngɛ amanehlu mi, nɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ba nyɛ nɔ ɔ, lɔ ɔ loko nyɛ maa kpale kɛ ba Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ ngɔ, nɛ nyɛ maa bu lɛ tue. 31Akɛnɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ, mɔbɔ nalɔ ji lɛ he je ɔ, e be nyɛ kuae, nɛ e be nyɛ hɛ mi kpatae; e hɛ be somi nɛ e kɛ nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ so ɔ nɔ jee.
32“Jehanɛ, nyɛ bi ngɛ je ɔ mi tsuo kulaa kaa kɛ je blema lokoo loko a fɔ nyɛ, kɛ je be nɛ Mawu bɔ nɔmlɔ ngɛ zugba a nɔ ɔ, anɛ sane nguaa ko kaa enɛ ɔ eko ba hyɛ, loo a nu eko hyɛ lo? 33Anɛ ma ko nu mawu ko gbi hyɛ nɛ e kɛ mɛ tu munyu kɛ je la mi nɛ a gbo we, se a ngɛ hɛ ngmengmle kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ nɛ ɔ lo? 34Anɛ mawu ko ka hyɛ kaa e ma ya je je ma ko kɛ je je ma kpa ko mi kɛ pee lɛ nitsɛ e ma, kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ pee ha nyɛ ngɛ Egipt ɔ lo? Nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ na kɛ nyɛ hɛngmɛ, bɔ nɛ e je e he wami, kɛ e nyɛmi kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ kpo; e kɛ gbenɔ hiɔhi, kɛ ta ba; e pee okadihi, kɛ nyakpɛ níhi; nɛ e ha gbeye ní nguanguahi ba. 35 Nyɛɛ lɛɛ Yawɛ ha nyɛ na ní nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ tsɔɔ nyɛ kaa Yawɛ ɔ, lɛ nɔ kake pɛ ji Mawu; nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be hu, ja lɛ pɛ. 36E ha nyɛ nu e gbi kɛ je hiɔwe, konɛ e kɛ tsɔse nyɛ; nyɛ na e la klɔuklɔu ɔ ngɛ zugba a nɔ, nɛ e kɛ nyɛ tu munyu kɛ je mi. 37Akɛnɛ e suɔ nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ he je ɔ, e hla nyɛ, nɛ lɛ nitsɛ e kɛ e he wami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ je nyɛ kɛ je Egipt. 38E fie je mahi nɛ a he wa kɛ je nyɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ, nɛ e ngɔ a zugba a ngɔ ha nyɛ. Lejɛ ɔ nyɛ ngɛ kɛ mwɔɔ. 39Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, mwɔnɛ ɔ, nyɛ na nyɛɛ le, nɛ nyɛ hɛ ko je nɔ gblegbleegble kaa Yawɛ ji Mawu ngɛ hiɔwe kɛ zugba; e se ɔ, nɔ ko be. 40Nyɛɛ ye e mlaa amɛ tsuo nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ woe mwɔnɛ ɔ a nɔ, konɛ e hi ha nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ nina. Ke nyɛ ye a nɔ ɔ, nyɛ maa hi zugba nɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ kɛ ngɛ nyɛ hae ɔ nɔ daa.”
A to wesa he mahi ngɛ Yordan pa a beleku je
41 Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Mose hla ma etɛ ngɛ Yordan pa a beleku je ngɔ to, 42konɛ ke nɔ ko li e he be nɛ e nine ya kpa ngɛ e nyɛmi nɔ tlukaa nɛ pi ninyɛ nya a, e tu fo kɛ ya sa we ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Ke e tu fo kɛ ho ma nɛ ɔmɛ eko mi ya a, e yi ma na wami; nɛ a be lɛ gbee. 43E hla Bezer nɛ ngɛ nga a nɔ ngɛ zugba kpataa a nɔ ha Ruben wɛtso ɔ, Ramot ngɛ Gilead ha Gad wɛtso ɔ, kɛ Golan nɛ ngɛ Bashan ɔ ha Manase wɛtso ɔ.
Munyuhi nɛ sɛ mlaa hami ɔ hɛ mi
44Mawu mlaa amɛ nɛ Mose ngɔ ha Israel bi ɔmɛ ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ. 45-46Benɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ je Egipt, nɛ a ba su kɔ̃ ɔ nɛ ngɛ Yordan pa a beleku je ngɛ Betpeor hanɔ ɔ, nɛ e ha mɛ mlaa nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ nɛ. Sa a, Amor bi ɔmɛ a matsɛ, Sihon nɛ je Heshbon ɔ nɛ ye zugba nɛ ɔ nɔ. Se Mose kɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ ba ye e nɔ, benɛ a je Egipt kɛ ma a. 47A ngɔ e zugba a, kɛ Amor matsɛ kpa ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Og nɛ hi Bashan nɛ ngɛ Yordan pa a beleku je ɔ hu e zugba a. 48Zugba nɛ ɔ huzu ji kɛ je Aroer ma a mi kɛ ya su Arnon pa a nya, kɛ ya na Sirion yo ɔ ngɛ leneyi je; lɔ ɔ ji Hermon yo ɔ nɛ. 49Zugba tsuo nɛ ngɛ Yordan pa a beleku je kɛ ya su Ngo wo ɔ nya, kɛ Pisga yo ɔ sisi hu piɛ he.

Title: MOSE V, 5
Content:
Mlaa nyɔngma amɛ
(Mose II, 20.1-17)
1Mose bua Israel ma a tsuo nya, nɛ e de mɛ ke, “Israel bi, nyɛɛ bu mlaa nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ woe mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ tue. Nyɛɛ kase mɛ nɛ nyɛɛ hyɛ nɛ nyɛɛ ye a nɔ. 2Yawɛ, wa Mawu ɔ kɛ wɔ so ngɛ Sinai yo ɔ he. 3Pi e kɛ wa nɛmɛ ɔmɛ kɛkɛ, se wɔ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ nɛ wa ngɛ je mi mwɔnɛ ɔ. 4Yawɛ kɛ nyɛ tu munyu hɛ mi kɛ hɛ mi kɛ je la mi, ngɛ yo ɔ nɔ. 5I da si ngɛ nyɛɛ kɛ Yawɛ nyɛ kpɛti jamɛ a be ɔ, konɛ ma de nyɛ nɔ́ nɛ e ngɛ dee ɔ, ejakaa nyɛ ngɛ la a gbeye yee.
“Nɛ nyɛ kuɛ yo ɔ. 6Nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ de ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: ‘Imi ji Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ nɛ je mo kɛ je Egipt zugba a nɔ, kɛ je nyɔguɛ yemi mi ɔ nɛ.
7“ ‘Ko ja mawu ko kɛ piɛ ye he.
8 “ ‘Koo puɛ amaga ko, loo nɔ́ ko nɛ ngɛ kaa nɔ́ ko nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe, loo nɔ́ ko nɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ, loo nɔ ko nɛ ngɛ nyu mi ngɛ zugba a sisi. 9 Ko kpla si ha mɛ, nɛ ko ja mɛ hulɔ; ejakaa imi Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ, a kɛ mi plee we nɔ́ he. I gblaa ni nɛmɛ nɛ nyɛɛɔ mi ɔ, kɛ a bimɛ, kɛ a bibimɛ a tue hluu kɛ ya siɔ yi nɔ etɛne kɛ eywiɛne bimɛ a nɔ; 10se nihi akpe abɔ nɛ suɔ mi, nɛ a yeɔ ye mlaa amɛ a nɔ ɔ, mɛɛ lɛɛ i naa mɛ mɔbɔ.
11 “ ‘Ko tsɛ Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ biɛ yaka gu, ejakaa nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ peeɔ ja a, Yawɛ kɛ e he be lɛ kee.
12 “ ‘Mo kai Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ, nɛ o ye lɛ ngɛ mumi mi he tsɔmi mi, kaa bɔ nɛ imi Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ fa mo ɔ. 13 Ngɔɔ ligbi ekpa kɛ tsu nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ o ngɛ tsumi. 14Ligbi nɛ ji kpaago ɔ ji Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ Hejɔɔmi ligbi. Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, ko tsu nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko kulaa, mo nitsɛ jio, o binyumu jio, o biyo jio, o tsɔlɔ nyumu jio, o mawayo jio, o lohwe jio, nubwɔ nɛ ngɛ o ma a mi jio. Ha o tsɔlɔ nyumu, kɛ o mawayo hu nɛ a jɔɔ a he kaa bɔ nɛ mo hu o maa jɔɔ o he ɔ. 15Kai kaa mo hu o ya ye nyɔguɛ ngɛ Egipt, nɛ imi Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ kɛ kɔni si wami, kɛ nyɛmi kpɔ mo kɛ je lejɛ ɔ. Lɔ ɔ he nɛ i wo mo mlaa ke o ye Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ nɛ.
16 “ ‘Moo bu o tsɛ kɛ o nyɛ, kaa bɔ nɛ imi Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ fa mo ɔ, konɛ e hi ha mo, nɛ o se nɛ kɛ ngɛ zugba nɛ Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ ngɛ mo hae ɔ nɔ.
17 “ ‘Koo gbe nɔmlɔ.
18 “ ‘Ko puɛ gba.
19 “ ‘Koo ju.
20 “ ‘Koo ye lakpa odase kɛ si o nyɛmi.
21 “ ‘O hɛ ko kɔ̃ o nyɛmi e yo nɔ; o hɛ ko kɔ̃ o nyɛmi e we, aloo e zugba, aloo e tsɔlɔ nyumu, aloo e mawayo, aloo e na, aloo e teji, aloo e nɔ́ kpa ko nɔ.’
22 “Benɛ nyɛ bua nyɛ he nya ngɛ yo ɔ he ɔ, mlaahi nɛ Yawɛ ngɔ ha nyɛ tsuo ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ. Benɛ e wo gbi kɛ je la, kɛ bɔku kpii ɔ mi ɔ, jamɛ be ɔ mi nɛ e ha nyɛ mlaa nɛ ɔmɛ, nɛ ekpa ko piɛ we he. Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e ngma mɛ ngɛ tɛ tɛtlɛɛ enyɔ nɔ, nɛ e ngɔ mɛ ngɔ ha mi.
Israel bi ɔmɛ ye gbeye
(Mose II, 20.18-21)
23“Benɛ yo ɔ tsuo ngɛ tsoe kɛ la, nɛ nyɛ nu gbi ɔ kɛ je diblii ɔ mi ɔ, nyɛ wɛtsoyi ɔmɛ tsuo, kɛ nyɛ nikɔtɔma amɛ ba ye ngɔ, ba de ke, 24‘Hyɛ kaa Yawɛ, wa Mawu ɔ ha nɛ wa na e we agboje, kɛ e hɛ mi nyami ɔ, benɛ wa nu e gbi nɛ e tu munyu kɛ je la a mi ɔ! Mwɔnɛ ɔ, wa na kaa ke Mawu kɛ nɔmlɔ adesa tu munyu po nɔmlɔ adesa ma nyɛ maa hi je mi hɛ ngmengmle. 25Mɛni he je e sa nɛ wa wo wa he kɛ wo gbenɔ mi ekohu? La gegeege ɔ ma ngla wɔ pɛsɛpɛsɛ. Ke wa nu Yawɛ, wa Mawu ɔ gbi ekohu ɔ, wa ma gbo. 26Anɛ nɔmlɔ adesa ko kɛ Mawu tu munyu kɛ je la mi nɛ e hi je mi hɛ ngmengmle hyɛ kaa bɔ nɛ wa na nɛ ɔ lo? 27Mose, moo kpale kɛ ho nɛ o ya bu nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ ma de mo ɔ tue, konɛ o ba de wɔ nɔ́ nɛ e de mo ɔ. Wa maa bu mo tue, nɛ wa maa ye nɔ.’
28“Yawɛ nu munyu ɔmɛ, benɛ nyɛɛ kɛ mi ngɛ munyu ɔmɛ tsuo tue ɔ; nɛ Yawɛ de mi ke, ‘I nu munyu ɔmɛ nɛ ma a de mo ɔ; anɔkuale ɔ sisiisi a de ɔ nɛ. 29I ná nɛ ma a na juɛmi daa kikɛ nɛ ɔ, nɛ a wo ye hɛ mi nyami be tsuaa be, nɛ a ye ye mlaa amɛ tsuo a nɔ, konɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ hi ha mɛ kɛ a nina kɛ ya neneene!’ 30Yaa nɛ o ya de mɛ ke, ‘Nyɛɛ kpale kɛ ho nyɛ bo tsu ɔmɛ a mi ya. 31Se mo Mose lɛɛ, hii hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ ngɛ ye ngɔ, nɛ ma ha mo mlaa amɛ, kɛ fami ɔmɛ tsuo. O tsɔɔ ma a, nɛ a ye nɔ ngɛ zugba nɛ i ngɛ mɛ hae ɔ nɔ.’
32“Israel ma, i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke nyɛɛ hyɛ saminya, nɛ nyɛɛ ye nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ ngɛ nyɛ fae ke nyɛɛ pee ɔ nɔ. Nyɛ ko gbo e mlaa amɛ ekoeko tue. 33Nyɛɛ ye nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ fa nyɛ ɔ tsuo nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ, konɛ nyɛɛ hi je mi, nɛ níhi a mi nɛ hi ha nyɛ; lɔ ɔ loko nyɛ se maa kɛ ngɛ zugba a nɛ nyɛ yaa ngɔ ɔ nɔ.

Title: MOSE V, 6
Content:
Mlaa ngua a
1“Mlaahi nɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ fa mi ke ma tsɔɔ nyɛ ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ. Nyɛɛ ye a nɔ ngɛ zugba a nɛ nyɛ yaa ngɔ nɛ nyɛɛ hi nɔ ɔ nɔ. 2Nyɛɛ ye Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ gbeye, nɛ nyɛɛ ye e mlaa amɛ nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ woe, kɛ e blɔ nya tomi ɔmɛ nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ hae nɛ ɔ a nɔ. A ngɛ kɛ ha nyɛ nitsɛmɛ, nyɛ bimɛ, kɛ nyɛ nina nyɛ wami be tsuo. Nyɛɛ ye a nɔ, konɛ nyɛ se nɛ kɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ. 3Israel ma, nyɛɛ bu tue, nɛ nyɛɛ ye mlaa amɛ a nɔ. Lɔ ɔ loko níhi a mi maa hi ha nyɛ, nɛ nyɛ maa pee ma ngua, nɛ nyɛ maa hi zugba kpakpa nɛ baa ní ɔ nɔ, kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ, wa nɛmɛ a Mawu ɔ wo si ɔ.
4 “Israel ma, nyɛ hɛ nɛ hi nɔ kaa Yawɛ, wa Mawu ɔ, lɛ pɛ ji Mawu. 5 Nyɛɛ suɔ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ kɛ nyɛ tsui tsuo, kɛ nyɛ klaa tsuo, kɛ nyɛ he wami tsuo. 6 Mlaahi nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ woe mwɔnɛ ɔ, nyɛ hɛ nɛ hi a nɔ. 7Nyɛɛ tsɔɔ nyɛ bimɛ. Nyɛɛ sɛɛ he ní be nɛ nyɛ ngɛ we mi, be nɛ nyɛ hia blɔ, be nɛ nyɛ hwɔɔ si, kɛ be nɛ nyɛ te si. 8Nyɛɛ fi kɛ wo nyɛ kɔni si, kɛ nyɛ hɛ nya kaa kaimi nɔ́. 9Nyɛɛ ngma ngɔ wo nyɛ sinya tso ɔmɛ a he, kɛ nyɛ agbo ɔmɛ a nya.
Tue gbomi he kɔkɔ bɔmi
10 “Kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ wo nyɛ nɛmɛ Abraham, Isak, kɛ Yakob si ke e ma ha nyɛ zugba ko kɛ e nɔ mahi nɛ pi nyɛ nɛ nyɛ po, 11wehi kɛ a mi ní kpakpahi babauu nɛ pi nyɛ nɛ nyɛ wo a mi ní ɔmɛ, nyu vuhi nɛ pi nyɛ nɛ nyɛ tsua, wai ngmɔhi, kɛ oliv tsohi nɛ pi nyɛ nɛ nyɛ du ɔ, ke nyɛ na ní nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ nyɛ ye, nɛ nyɛ tɔ ɔ, 12nyɛɛ hyɛ nɛ hi, nɛ nyɛ hɛ ko je Yawɛ nɔ. Ejakaa lɛ nɛ je nyɛ kɛ je Egipt zugba a nɔ, he nɛ a ye nyɛ nyɔguɛ ngɛ ɔ. 13 Nyɛɛ ye Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ gbeye; nyɛ ja lɛ pɛ; nɛ e biɛ nyɛ kɛ ka kita. 14Nyɛ ko ya nyɛɛ je ma amɛ nɛ bɔle nyɛ ɔ a mawu ɔmɛ a se. 15Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ nɛ kɛ nyɛ nyɛɛ ɔ, a kɛ lɛ plee we nɔ́ he. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke nyɛ ya nyɛɛ mawu kpahi a se ɔ, e mi mi ma fu nyɛ, nɛ e ma kpata nyɛ hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ kaa bɔ nɛ la sãã nɔ́ ɔ.
16 “Nyɛ ko ka Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ pee ngɛ Masa a. 17Mlaa amɛ tsuo nɛ a ha nyɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ hyɛ nɛ nyɛɛ ye a nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ. 18Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ de ke e da, loo e hi ɔ, nyɛɛ pee. Ke nyɛ pee ja a, e maa hi ha nyɛ, nɛ nyɛ ma nyɛ ya ngɔ zugba kpakpa a nɛ Yawɛ wo nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ si ke e ma ha mɛ ɔ; 19e maa fie nyɛ he nyɛli ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ je nyɛ blɔ nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ e wo si ɔ.
20“Hwɔɔ se ko ke nyɛ bimɛ bi nyɛ ke, ‘Mɛni he je Yawɛ, wa Mawu ɔ fa wɔ ke waa ye mlaa amɛ tsuo a nɔ ɔ?’ 21nyɛ de mɛ ke, ‘Sa a, Egipt matsɛ nyɔguɛhi ji wɔ, nɛ Yawɛ kɛ kɔni si wami je wɔ kɛ je Egipt. 22Yawɛ ha okadihi, kɛ nyakpɛ ní nguanguahi nɛ ngɛ gbeye ba Egipt bi ɔmɛ, kɛ a matsɛ ɔ, kɛ e we ɔ tsuo nɔ ngɛ wɔ tsuo wa hɛ mi. 23Se wɔɔ lɛɛ e je wɔ kɛ je lejɛ ɔ, nɛ e ngɔ zugba nɛ e ka wa nɛmɛ ɔmɛ kita ngɛ he ɔ ngɔ ha wɔ. 24Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yawɛ fa wɔ ke waa ye mlaa nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a nɔ, nɛ waa ye lɛ gbeye, konɛ e hi ha wɔ nitsɛmɛ, nɛ wa yi nɛ na wami daa kaa bɔ nɛ e ngɛ mwɔnɛ ɔ. 25Ke wa ye nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ, wa Mawu ɔ fa wɔ ɔ nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ ɔ, e bua maa jɔ wa he.’

Title: MOSE V, 7
Content:
Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nitsɛ e ma
(Mose II, 34.11-16)
1 “Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ maa ngɔ nyɛ kɛ ya su zugba a nɛ nyɛ yaa ngɔ ɔ nɔ, nɛ e maa fie je mahi babauu kɛ je zugba a nɔ ha nyɛ. Je ma kpaago nɛ a he hiɛ, nɛ a he wa kulaa pe nyɛ Yawɛ maa fie ngɛ nyɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ: Hit bi, Girgash bi, Amor bi, Kanaan bi, Periz bi, Hiv bi, kɛ Yebus bi. 2Ke be ɔ su nɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ je mɛ ngɔ wo nyɛ dɛ, nɛ nyɛ ye a nɔ ɔ, nyɛ kpata mɛ tsuo a hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ. Nyɛɛ kɛ ma ko ma ko kó so nɛ nyɛɛ pee kake; nyɛ ko na mɛ mɔbɔ. 3Nyɛ ko ngɔ nyɛ biyi ɔmɛ ngɔ ha a binyumu ɔmɛ gba; nɛ nyɛ ko ha nyɛ binyumu ɔmɛ hu ya ngɔ a biyi ɔmɛ. 4Ejakaa a ma kpaka nyɛ bimɛ ɔmɛ kɛ je Yawɛ he kɛ ya ja mawu kpahi. Ke e ba mi ja a, Yawɛ mi mi ma fu, nɛ e ma kpata nyɛ hɛ mi amlɔ. 5 Bɔ nɛ nyɛɛ pee mohu ji kaa nyɛɛ ku a bɔ sami la tɛ ɔmɛ; nyɛɛ ywia mɛ dukuduku, nɛ nyɛɛ ywia a yo mawu nɛ a tsɛɛ Ashera a we amaga a, nɛ nyɛɛ sã wɔ ɔmɛ. 6 Nyɛɛ pee ja, ejakaa Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ hla nyɛ kɛ je nihi tsuo nɛ ngɛ je ɔ mi ɔ a kpɛti, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ nyɛɛ pee lɛ nitsɛ e ma pɔtɛɛ.
7“Pi hiɛmi nɛ nyɛ he hiɛ pe ma kpa amɛ he je nɛ Yawɛ suɔ nyɛ nɛ e hla nyɛ ɔ; nyɛ mohu ji nihi nɛ a he pi pe kulaa ngɛ ma amɛ a kpɛti. 8Suɔmi mohu Yawɛ suɔ nyɛ; nɛ kita nɛ e ka nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, e suɔ kaa e maa ye nɔ. Enɛ ɔ he je nɛ Yawɛ kɛ kɔni si wami je nyɛ, nɛ e kpɔ̃ nyɛ kɛ je nyɔguɛ yemi mi kɛ je Egipt matsɛ ɔ dɛ mi ɔ nɛ. 9 Nyɛ na nɛ nyɛɛ le kaa Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ, lɛ pɛ ji Mawu, nɛ e yeɔ anɔkuale. E maa ye e somi nɔ, nɛ e ma je e suɔmi nɛ ngɛ daa a kpo kɛ tsɔɔ yi nɔhi akpe abɔ nɛ suɔ lɛ, nɛ a yeɔ e mlaa amɛ a nɔ ɔ, 10se ni nɛmɛ nɛ sume lɛ ɔ, e maa gbla a tue amlɔ. 11Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ ye níhi nɛ a tsɔɔ nyɛ ɔ a nɔ; nyɛɛ ye mlaa amɛ tsuo nɛ i wo nyɛ mwɔnɛ ɔ a nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Gbaami jeɔ tue bumi mi
(Mose V, 28.1-14)
12 “Ke nyɛ bu mlaa nɛ ɔmɛ tue, nɛ nyɛ ye a nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ ɔ, lɛɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ maa ye somi nɛ e kɛ nyɛ so ɔ nɔ, nɛ e ma je e suɔmi nɛ ngɛ daa a kpo kɛ tsɔɔ nyɛ kaa bɔ nɛ e wo nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ si ɔ; 13e maa suɔ nyɛ, nɛ e maa gbaa nyɛ. E ma ha nyɛ he maa hiɛ, nɛ nyɛ ma fɔ bimɛ babauu. E maa gbaa nyɛ ngmɔ ɔmɛ, nɛ nyɛ ma na blɛfo, wai, kɛ oliv nu. E maa gbaa nyɛ, nɛ nyɛ na amɛ kɛ to ɔmɛ maa bɔ. Gbaami nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo e kɛ maa gbaa nyɛ ngɛ zugba nɛ e ka nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ kita ke e ma ngɔ ha nyɛ ɔ nɔ. 14Ma ko ma ko be je ɔ mi nɛ a maa gbaa mɛ babauu kaa nyɛ. A be nyumu ko, loo yo ko nae ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti nɛ be fɔe; nɛ nyɛ lohwe ɔmɛ hu ja nɔuu. 15Yawɛ be hae nɛ hiɔ nɛ nu nyɛ; nɛ Egipt hiɔ yaya amɛ nɛ nyɛ le ɔ ekoeko be nyɛ he sae; nyɛ he nyɛli mohu lɛ a maa nu hiɔ yaya nɛ ɔmɛ. 16Ma tsuaa ma nɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ ma je ngɔ wo nyɛ dɛ ɔ, nyɛ kpata a hɛ mi; nyɛ ko na mɛ mɔbɔ. Nyɛ ko ja a mawu ɔmɛ. Ke nyɛ pee ja a, nyɛ hɛ mi ma kpata.
17“Nyɛ ko de nyɛ he ke, ‘Ni ɔmɛ a he hiɛ pe wɔ, nɛ kɛ wa maa pee kɛ fie mɛ kɛɛ?’ 18Nyɛ ko ye mɛ gbeye; nyɛ kai nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ pee Egipt bi ɔmɛ tsuo, kɛ a matsɛ ɔ. 19Nyɛ kai gbenɔ hiɔhi nɛ a nya wa nɛ nyɛ na kɛ nyɛ hɛngmɛ ɔ. Nyɛ kai okadihi, kɛ nyakpɛ níhi nɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ kɛ kɔni si wami pee kɛ kpɔ̃ nyɛ ɔ. Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ kpata Egipt bi ɔmɛ a hɛ mi ɔ, jã kɛ̃ e maa pee je ma amɛ tsuo nɛ nyɛ ngɛ mɛ gbeye yee ɔ. 20Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ ma ha sawale maa nu mɛ; nɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ tu fo ngɛ nyɛ nya ya laa a he ɔ hu a hɛ mi ma kpata. 21Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ ko ye nyɛ he nyɛli ɔmɛ gbeye. Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ kɛ nyɛ ngɛ; e ji Mawu kpetekpleenyɛ nɛ sa nɛ a ye lɛ gbeye. 22Nyɛ maa na kaa bɔɔbɔɔ ɔ, Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ maa fie je ma amɛ kɛ maa je nyɛ blɔ nɔ ha nyɛ. Nyɛ be mɛ tsuo a hɛ mi nyɛe ma kpata si kake too; ke nyɛ pee ja a, nga mi lohwe awi yeli ɔmɛ maa hiɛ tsɔ, nɛ a maa hao nyɛ. 23Se kɛ̃ ɔ, Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ maa ngɔ nyɛ he nyɛli ɔmɛ ngɔ wo nyɛ dɛ; sawale maa nu mɛ, nɛ a ma jija kɛ yaa si be nɛ a hɛ mi ma kpata pɛsɛpɛsɛ. 24E maa ngɔ a matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ngɔ wo nyɛ dɛ. Nyɛɛ gbe mɛ nɛ a biɛ nɛ laa kulaa. Nɔ ko nɔ ko be nyɛ hɛ mi nyɛe maa da; nyɛ ma kpata nɔ tsuaa nɔ hɛ mi. 25Nyɛɛ sã a we amaga amɛ. Nyɛ hɛ ko kɔ̃ a sika hiɔ, loo sika tsu nɔ; nyɛ ko ngɔ ekoeko. Ke nyɛ ngɔ eko ɔ, e maa pee gbenɔ ha nyɛ; ejakaa Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ sume amaga jami. 26Nyɛ ko ngɔ amaga nɛ ɔ eko kɛ ba nyɛ we ɔmɛ a mi; ke nyɛ pee ja a, gbiɛmi nɛ ngɛ amaga amɛ a nɔ ɔ maa ba nyɛ nɔ. Nyɛɛ nyɛ, nɛ nyɛɛ hie amaga amɛ, ejakaa Yawɛ gbiɛmi ngɛ a nɔ.

Title: MOSE V, 8
Content:
Zugba kpakpa a
1“Nyɛɛ ye mlaa amɛ tsuo nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ woe mwɔnɛ ɔ a nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ, konɛ nyɛ yi nɛ na wami, nɛ nyɛ he nɛ hiɛ, nɛ nyɛ ya ngɔ zugba a nɛ Yawɛ wo nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ si ke e ma ha mɛ ɔ. 2Nyɛ kai kaa Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ kpaka nyɛ ngɛ blɔ gagaa nɛ ɔ nɔ kɛ gu nga kplanaa a nɔ jeha nyingmi eywiɛ sɔuu. E ha hɛdo níhi kɛ nyɛ kpe kɛ ka nyɛ hyɛ, konɛ e kɛ le nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ nyɛ tsui mi, kaa nyɛ maa ye e mlaa amɛ a nɔ, loo nyɛ be a nɔ yee. 3 E ha hwɔ ye nyɛ, nɛ e ha nyɛ abolo nɛ je hiɔwe nɛ nyɛ nɛmɛ nɛ hyɛ ɔ nɛ nyɛ ye. E pee enɛ ɔ, konɛ nyɛ na nɛ nyɛɛ le kaa pi abolo pɛ nɛ haa nɔmlɔ yi naa wami, se mohu munyu tsuaa munyu nɛ jeɔ Yawɛ nya mi ɔ nɛ haa nɔ yi naa wami. 4Jeha nyingmi eywiɛ nɛ ɔ tsuo mi ɔ, nyɛ tade gba we ngɛ nyɛ he, nɛ nyɛ nanehi hu fuu we. 5Nyɛ na nɛ nyɛɛ le kaa bɔ nɛ tsɛ tsɔseɔ e bi ɔ, ja Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ ngɛ nyɛ tsɔsee ɔ nɛ. 6Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ pee bɔ nɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ fa nyɛ ɔ; nyɛɛ ye e mlaa amɛ a nɔ, nɛ nyɛɛ ye lɛ gbeye. 7Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ kɛ nyɛ yaa zugba nɛ baa ní saminya ko nɔ. Pahi, kɛ nyu hɛngmɛhi ngɛ nɔ, nɛ jehanɛ nyu pãã si kɛ jee zu mi nɛ e suɔ kɛ pueɔ yoku ɔmɛ a nɔ, kɛ kɔ̃ ɔmɛ a mi. 8E ji zugba nɛ ngma, blɛfo, wai yiblii, ngmɔkɔ, tso nɛ yiblii ngɔɔ, oliv tso, kɛ hwo ngɛ nɔ. 9Hwɔ be nyɛ yee, nɛ nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko be nyɛ hiae. Tɛ nɛ ngɛ zugba a mi ɔ, dade ngɛ mi. Yo ɔmɛ a mi hu akɔblee ngɛ nɛ nyɛ ma nyɛ maa tsua. 10Nyɛ ma na ní maa ye maa tɔ; nɛ nyɛ maa na Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ si ngɛ zugba nɛ baa ní saminya nɛ e ha nyɛ ɔ he.
A bɔ ma a kɔkɔ ke a hɛ ko je Mawu nɔ
11 “Nyɛɛ hyɛ nɛ hi nɛ nyɛ hɛ ko je Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ nɔ. Nyɛ hɛ nɛ hi mlaa amɛ nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ woe mwɔnɛ ɔ a nɔ, nɛ nyɛɛ ye a nɔ. 12Ke nyɛ ná ngma nɛ nyɛ ye nɛ nyɛ tɔ, nɛ nyɛ ma tsuhi nɛ ngɛ fɛu nɛ nyɛ ngɛ mi; 13jehanɛ, ke nyɛ na amɛ kɛ to ɔmɛ, nyɛ sika hiɔ kɛ sika tsu, kɛ ní kpa amɛ tsuo ba hiɛ babauu ɔ, 14nyɛɛ hyɛ saminya nɛ nyɛ ko wo nyɛ he nɔ, nɛ nyɛ hɛ ba je Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ nɔ. Lɛ nɛ je nyɛ kɛ je Egipt, he nɛ a ye nyɛ nyɔguɛ ngɛ ɔ. 15Lɛ ji nɔ nɛ kpaka nyɛ kɛ gu nga kplanaa gbajaa nɛ nɔ ngɛ gbeye ɔ nɔ ɔ nɛ. Lejɛ ɔ nɛ a naa sinɔhi nɛ a duɔ nya wa, kɛ nyingmogblakotohi ngɛ ɔ nɛ. Jehanɛ, ngɛ nga kplanaa a nɔ he nɛ nyu be ɔ, e je nyu kɛ je tslɛbo tɛ sa mi ha nyɛ. 16Ngɛ nga a nɔ ɔ, e ha nyɛ mana, niye ní nɛ nyɛ nɛmɛ yi hyɛ, nɛ nyɛ ye. E ha nyɛ na hɛdo ní, nɛ e kɛ ka nyɛ hyɛ, konɛ lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e gbaa nyɛ kɛ ní kpakpahi. 17E pee ja, konɛ nyɛ ko susu kaa nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ he wami nya nɛ nyɛ na ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo. 18Nyɛ kai kaa Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ ji nɔ nɛ haa nyɛ he wami nɛ nyɛ kɛ naa ní. E ngɛ enɛ ɔmɛ pee, ejakaa e ngɛ anɔkuale yee kɛ mwɔɔ ngɛ somi nɛ e kɛ nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ so ɔ he. 19Nyɛ hɛ ko je Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ nɔ kɔkɔɔkɔ; nyɛ ko nyɛɛ mawu kpahi a se; nyɛ ko ya ja mɛ, nɛ nyɛ ko sɔmɔ mɛ. Ke nyɛ pee ja a, lɛɛ i ngɛ nyɛ kɔkɔ bɔe mwɔnɛ ɔ kaa a ma kpata nyɛ hɛ mi. 20Ke nyɛ bui Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ tue ɔ, lɛɛ e ma kpata nyɛ hɛ mi kaa bɔ nɛ e ngɛ je ma amɛ a hɛ mi kpatae ngɛ nyɛ blɔ nɔ ɔ.

Title: MOSE V, 9
Content:
Israel bi ɔmɛ gbo tue
1“Nyɛɛ bu tue, Israel bi; mwɔnɛ ɔ, nyɛ maa po Yordan pa a, konɛ nyɛ ya fie je ma amɛ nɛ kle, nɛ a he wa pe nyɛ ɔ. A fia gbogbo nɛ ya hiɔwe ploplooplo ngɔ wo a ma amɛ a he. 2Oblaihi gojogojoo nɛ nyɛ nu nɛ a de ke nɔ ko nɔ ko nyɛ we mɛ ɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. 3Se mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ, nyɛ ma na maa le kaa Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ ji nɔ nɛ nyɛɛ nyɛ hɛ mi kɛ yaa kaa bɔ nɛ la tsoɔ gegeege kɛ sãã nɔ́ ɔ nɛ. E maa ye a nɔ ha nyɛ; e ma ha nyɛ maa fie mɛ, nɛ nyɛ ma kpata a hɛ mi amlɔ kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ wo nyɛ si ɔ.
4“Ke Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ fie mɛ ha nyɛ ɔ, nyɛ ko susu nɛ nyɛ de nyɛ he ke, ‘Wa dami nɛ wa da he je nɛ Yawɛ kɛ wɔ ba nɛ wa ba ngɔ zugba nɛ ɔ.’ Pi ja, se mohu je ma nɛ ɔmɛ a yi mi nɛ wa a he je nɛ Yawɛ ngɛ mɛ fiee ha nyɛ ɔ nɛ. 5Pi kaa nyɛ hi, loo nyɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da he je nɛ Yawɛ ha nyɛ yaa ngɔ a zugba a. Mohu ɔ, a yi mi nɛ wa a he je nɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ ngɛ mɛ fiee ha nyɛ ɔ nɛ. Jehanɛ hu, Yawɛ pee ja, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ e ye si nɛ e wo nyɛ nɛmɛ, Abraham, Isak, kɛ Yakob ɔ nɔ. 6Nyɛ na nɛ nyɛɛ le kaa anɔkuale mi ɔ, pi nyɛ dami nɛ nyɛ da he je nɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ kɛ zugba nɛ baa ní saminya nɛ ɔ ngɛ nyɛ hae. Dɛbi, ma nɛ kuɛ wa ji nyɛ.
7“Nyɛ hɛ ko je nɔ kɔkɔɔkɔ, bɔ nɛ nyɛ wo Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ mi mi la ngɛ nga kplanaa a nɔ. Kɛ je ligbi ɔ nɛ nyɛ je Egipt zugba a nɔ kɛ ba si be nɛ nyɛ ba su hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ, Yawɛ hɛ mi atuã sɔuu nyɛ ngɛ tsɔe. 8Ngɛ Sinai yo ɔ he po nyɛ wo Yawɛ mi mi la; nɛ bɔ nɛ e mi mi fu ha a, e sa nɛ e kpata nyɛ hɛ mi. 9 Imi nɛ i kuɔ yo ɔ, nɛ i ya he tɛ tɛtlɛɛhi nɛ a ngma somi nɛ Yawɛ kɛ nyɛ so ɔ ngɛ a nɔ ɔ kɛ ba. I hi yo ɔ nɔ nyɔnyɔɔnyɔ kɛ piapiaapia ligbi nyingmi eywiɛ; nɛ́ i yi ní ɔ, i nui nyu hulɔ. 10Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, Yawɛ ngɔ tɛ tɛtlɛɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ ngɔ ha mi. Lɛ nitsɛ nɛ e ngɔ e nine nguɛ kɛ ngma munyu ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ e kɛ nyɛ tu kɛ je la a mi ngɛ yo ɔ nɔ jamɛ a ligbi ɔ nɛ nyɛ bua nyɛ he nya ngɛ yo ɔ sisi ɔ ngɔ fɔ tɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ. 11Nyɔnyɔɔnyɔ kɛ piapiaapia ligbi nyingmi eywiɛ se loko Yawɛ ngɔ tɛ tɛtlɛɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ nɛ e ngma mlaa amɛ ngɛ a nɔ ɔ ngɔ ha mi.
12“Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ de mi ke, ‘Kple si kɛ je yo ɔ nɔ esɔ; o ma a nɛ o ya je kɛ je Egipt ɔ tla blɔ momo, nɛ a pee yayami. Amlɔ nɛ ɔ nɔuu ɔ, a gba kɛ je nɔ́ nɛ i fa mɛ ke a pee ɔ he; a puɛ amaga, nɛ a ngɛ lɛ jae.’
13“Jehanɛ, Yawɛ de mi ke, ‘I le kaa ma nɛ ɔ kuɛ wa. 14Ha mi blɔ nɛ ma kpata a hɛ mi, nɛ́ nɔ ko nɔ ko kó kai mɛ gblegbleegble hu. Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, ma pee mo tsɛ ha ma ko nɛ kle, nɛ e he wa pe mɛ.’
15“Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ye he sɔ kɛ kple si kɛ je yo ɔ nɔ kɛ ye somi dɛ mi tɛ tɛtlɛɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ nɛ Yawɛ ngma somi munyu ɔmɛ ngɛ a nɔ ɔ. Jamɛ a be ɔ, la ngɛ tsoe plamplam kɛ ngɛ yo ɔ mi jee. 16I na kaa mlaa a nɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ wo nyɛ ɔ, nyɛ tɔ̃ nɔ mo. Nyɛ pee yayami kɛ si Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ. Nyɛ ngɔ dade kɛ ya sɔ̃ amaga nɛ ngɛ kaa na bi. 17Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ hɛ mi nɔuu nɛ i ngɔ tɛ tɛtlɛɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ nɛ i hɛɛ ɔ ngɔ fia si nɛ a ywia wɔtsɔwɔtsɔ. 18Jehanɛ, i ho ya kpla si ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi ekohu nyɔnyɔɔnyɔ kɛ piapiaapia ligbi nyingmi eywiɛ; nɛ́ i yi ní ɔ, i nui nyu hulɔ. I pee ja ngɛ yayami nɛ nyɛ pee kɛ si Yawɛ kɛ wo e mi mi la a he. 19 I ye Yawɛ mi mi la a gbeye, ejakaa e gli wawɛɛ nitsɛ, nɛ e ko kpata nyɛ hɛ mi. Se Yawɛ bu mi tue ekohu. 20Aaron hu Yawɛ mi mi fu lɛ wawɛɛ, nɛ e piɛ bɔɔ pɛ nɛ e ko gbe lɛ; se i kpa pɛɛ ha Aaron hu jamɛ a be ɔ mi kɛ̃. 21Jehanɛ, jamɛ a nɔ́ yaya a nɛ nyɛ sɔ̃, nɛ ji na bi ɔ, i ngɔ, nɛ i sã ngɛ la mi. Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, i ywia lɛ wɔtsɔwɔtsɔ nɛ i wɛɛ lɛ bɔdɔbɔdɔ; e pee kaa tabo zu, nɛ i ya hɛ lɛ ngɔ pue pa a nɛ je yo ɔ nɔ kɛ ngɛ bee ɔ mi.
22 “Nyɛ wo Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ mi mi la ngɛ Tabera, Masa, kɛ Kibrot hulɔ. 23 Jehanɛ, benɛ e wo nyɛ blɔ kɛ je Kadesh Barnea, nɛ e fa nyɛ ke nyɛ ya ngɔ zugba nɛ e kɛ ngɛ nyɛ hae kaa nyɛ weto ní ɔ, jamɛ a be ɔ mi po, nyɛ tsɔ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ hɛ mi atuã: nyɛ he we lɛ yi, nɛ nyɛ bui lɛ tue. 24Kɛ je be nɛ i le nyɛ ɔ, Yawɛ hɛ mi atuã sɔuu nyɛ ngɛ tsɔe.
25“Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i ya kpla si ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi nyɔnyɔɔnyɔ kɛ piapiaapia ligbi nyingmi eywiɛ sɔuu kɛ kpa pɛɛ ha nyɛ; ejakaa i le kaa Yawɛ to kaa e ma kpata nyɛ hɛ mi. 26I kpa pɛɛ ke, ‘Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, mo ko kpata mo nitsɛ o ma a hɛ mi; ma nɛ ɔ, mo nitsɛ lɛ o kpɔ̃ mɛ, nɛ o je mɛ kɛ je Egipt kɛ o kɔni si wami. 27Mo kai Abraham, Isak, kɛ Yakob, o sɔmɔli ɔmɛ; nɛ o ko di ma nɛ ɔ tue wami, a yi mi wami, kɛ yayami ɔmɛ.’ 28Ke pi ja a, Egipt bi ɔmɛ ma de ke, ‘Nyɛɛ hyɛ, a Mawu ɔ nyɛ we nɛ e kɛ mɛ ya su zugba nɛ e wo si ke e ma ha mɛ ɔ nɔ. A ma de ke o je o ma a kɛ ho nga kplanaa a nɔ ya, nɛ o ya gbe mɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ; ejakaa o sume a sane. 29O le kaa ma nɛ mo nitsɛ o hla ha o he, nɛ o kɛ kɔni si wami kpetekpleenyɛ je kɛ je Egipt ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.’

Title: MOSE V, 10
Content:
Mose ya ngɔ mlaa amɛ ekohu
(Mose II, 34.1-10)
1“Jehanɛ, Yawɛ de mi ke, ‘Kó tɛ tɛtlɛɛ enyɔ kaa kekle ní ɔmɛ, nɛ o kpɛ tso daka nɛ a kɛ tɛ ɔmɛ maa wo mi. Ngɔɔ kɛ kuɔ yo ɔ kɛ ba ye ngɔ, 2konɛ ma ngma munyu ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ kekle tɛ ɔmɛ nɛ o ywia a a nɔ ɔ kɛ wo tɛ tɛtlɛɛ nɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ, konɛ o ngɔ mɛ ngɔ wo daka a mi.’
3“Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i ngɔ akasia tso kɛ kpɛ daka, nɛ i kó tɛ tɛtlɛɛ enyɔ kaa kekle ní ɔmɛ, nɛ i hɛɛ mɛ ngɛ ye dɛ mi kɛ kuɔ yo ɔ. 4Jehanɛ, Yawɛ ngma munyu ɔmɛ nɛ e ngma ngɛ kekle tɛ tɛtlɛɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ a nɔ ɔ ngɔ wo tɛ tɛtlɛɛ ehe nɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ. Munyu nɛ ɔmɛ ji mlaa nyɔngma amɛ nɛ a ngma ha nyɛ, benɛ e tu munyu kɛ je la a mi ligbi ɔ nɛ nyɛ bua nyɛ he nya ngɛ yo ɔ he ɔ. Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ ngɔ tɛ tɛtlɛɛ ɔmɛ ngɔ ha mi; 5nɛ i kple si kɛ je yo ɔ nɔ. Jehanɛ, kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa mi ɔ, i ngɔ tɛ ɔmɛ ngɔ wo daka nɛ i kpɛ ɔ mi; tɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ daka a mi kɛ mwɔɔ.”
6 (Israel ma a hia kɛ je Yaakan bi ɔmɛ a nyu vu ɔmɛ a he kɛ ho Mosera ya. Lejɛ ɔ Aaron gbo ngɛ, nɛ lejɛ ɔ kɛ̃ a pu lɛ ngɛ; nɛ e binyumu Eleazar ye e se kaa osɔfo. 7A je lejɛ ɔ kɛ ho Gudgoda ya; nɛ a tsa nɔ kɛ ho he ko nɛ nyu hiɛ saminya ngɛ ya; a tsɛɛ lejɛ ɔ Yotbata. 8 Benɛ a ngɛ yoku ɔ he ɔ, Yawɛ hla Levi wɛtso ɔ mi nyumuhi, konɛ a hyɛ somi daka a nɔ, nɛ a sɔmɔ kaa osɔfohi, nɛ́ a ngɔ Yawɛ biɛ kɛ gbaa ma a. A blɔ nya ní tsumihi ji enɛ ɔmɛ kɛ mwɔɔ. 9Lɔ ɔ he je nɛ Levi wɛtso ɔ na we zugba ko kaa bɔ nɛ wɛtso kpa amɛ na a nɛ. Blɔ nya nɛ Levi bi ɔmɛ na ji kaa a pee Yawɛ osɔfohi kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ wo si ɔ.)
10 “I hi yo ɔ nɔ nyɔnyɔɔnyɔ kɛ piapiaapia ligbi nyingmi eywiɛ kaa bɔ nɛ i pee kekle ɔ. Yawɛ bu mi tue ekohu; e kplɛɛ kaa e be nyɛ hɛ mi kpatae. 11Jehanɛ, Yawɛ de mi ke, ‘Yaa nɛ o ya nyɛɛ ma a hɛ mi kɛ ya ngɔ zugba a nɛ i ka a nɛmɛ ɔmɛ kita ngɛ he ke ma ngɔ ha mɛ ɔ.’
Nɔ́ nɛ Mawu ke Israel ma a nɛ pee
12“Jehanɛ, Israel bi, nyɛɛ bu nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ ngɛ hlae kaa nyɛɛ pee ɔ tue. Nyɛ ja Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ, nɛ nyɛɛ ye e mlaa amɛ tsuo a nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ. Nyɛɛ suɔ lɛ, nɛ nyɛ sɔmɔ lɛ kɛ nyɛ tsui tsuo, kɛ nyɛ klaa tsuo. 13Nyɛɛ ye e mlaa amɛ tsuo nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ woe mwɔnɛ ɔ a nɔ, konɛ e hi ha nyɛ. 14Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ nɔ́ ji hiɔwe ploplooplo ɔ tsuo, zugba a, kɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ ɔ. 15Se akɛnɛ suɔmi nɛ Yawɛ ngɛ kɛ ha nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ nya wa wawɛɛ he je ɔ, e hla nyɛ nɛ ji a nina a mohu ngɛ je ma kpa amɛ a mi; nɛ kɛ ba si mwɔnɛ ɔ hu, nyɛ ji e ma nɛ e hla. 16Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, kɛ je mwɔnɛ ɔ kɛ yaa a, nyɛɛ bu Yawɛ tue, nɛ nyɛ ko wa tue hu. 17 Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ ji Mawu nɛ pe mawuhi tsuo kulaa, nɛ e he wami se be. E ji Mawu nɛ kle, nɛ e he wa; nɛ e sa nɛ a ye lɛ gbeye. E hyɛ we nɔ hɛ mi, nɛ e he we nyɔ mi ní. 18E hyɛɛ kaa a ye awusahi, kɛ yalɔyihi a sane pɛpɛɛpɛ ha mɛ. E suɔ nihi nɛ ba to wɔ nibwɔ ɔ, nɛ e haa mɛ a niye ní, kɛ a heha ní. 19Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ suɔ nibwɔ ɔmɛ a sane; ejakaa nyɛ hu nyɛ ya to nubwɔ hyɛ ngɛ Egipt. 20Nyɛɛ bu Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ tue, nɛ nyɛ ja lɛ nɔ kake pɛ. Nyɛɛ ye lɛ anɔkuale, nɛ nyɛɛ wo si ngɛ e biɛ mi pɛ. 21Nyɛ je e yi; lɛ ji nyɛ Mawu ɔ nɛ. Lɛ ji nɔ nɛ tsu ní nguanguahi nɛ ngɛ gbeye, nɛ nyɛ na kɛ nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ hɛngmɛ ɔ nɛ. 22 Benɛ nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ yaa Egipt ɔ, mɛ nimli nyingmi kpaago pɛ nɛ a ho, se amlɔ nɛ ɔ, Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ ha nyɛ he hiɛ babauu kaa dodoehi ngɛ hiɔwe.

Title: MOSE V, 11
Content:
Yawɛ ji ngua
1“Nyɛɛ suɔ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ, nɛ nyɛɛ ye e mlaa amɛ tsuo a nɔ daa. 2Nyɛ kai mwɔnɛ ɔ, níhi nɛ nyɛ kase ngɛ Yawɛ he, bɔ nɛ nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ kpa lɛ si ha. Tsa pi nyɛ bimɛ, se nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nɛ nyɛ kpa ní nɛ ɔmɛ a si ɔ lɛ e ngɛ dee ɔ nɛ. Nyɛ na kaa Yawɛ kle, e kɔni si wa; e nyɛɔ peeɔ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́, 3 kɛ nyakpɛ níhi hulɔ. Nyɛ na nɔ́ nɛ e pee Egipt matsɛ ɔ, kɛ e zugba a tsuo kulaa a. 4 Nyɛ na bɔ nɛ Yawɛ kpata Egipt ta a, kɛ a okpɔngɔ ɔmɛ, kɛ a ta zugba lɛ ɔmɛ a hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ ɔ. E ha Wo Tsu ɔ mi nyu ɔ mii Egipt ta a tsuo, benɛ a nyɛɛ nyɛ se ɔ. 5Nyɛ le níhi nɛ e pee ha nyɛ ngɛ nga kplanaa a nɔ kɛ ba su hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ. 6 Nyɛ kai nɔ́ nɛ e pee Ruben wɛtso ɔ mi no Eliab binyumu ɔmɛ nɛ a tsɛɛ mɛ Datan kɛ Abiram ɔ. Nyɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ nyɛ hɛ mi nɛ zugba a mi gba nɛ e mii mɛ kɛ a weku li, kɛ a lohwehi tsuo. 7Niinɛ, nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ na ní nguanguahi tsuo nɛ Yawɛ tsu ɔ kɛ nyɛ hɛngmɛ.
Gbaamihi nɛ ngɛ zugba nɛ a wo he si ɔ nɔ
8“Nyɛɛ ye mlaa amɛ tsuo nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ woe mwɔnɛ nɛ ɔ a nɔ. Lɔ ɔ loko nyɛ ma nyɛ maa po pa a kɛ ya ngɔ zugba a nɛ nyɛ yaa sɛ mi ɔ. 9Ke nyɛ pee ja a, nyɛ se maa kɛ ngɛ zugba kpakpa nɛ baa ní saminya nɛ Yawɛ wo si ke e ma ngɔ ha nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ kɛ a nina a nɔ. 10Zugba nɛ nyɛ yaa nɛ nyɛ ya ngɔ ɔ be kaa Egipt zugba a, he nɛ nyɛ je ɔ. Lejɛ ɔ, ke o du ní ɔ, ja o gbo dengme kɛ pue ní ɔmɛ a nɔ nyu ngɛ ngmɔ ɔ mi; 11se zugba nɛ nyɛ yaa ngɔ nɛ ɔ, e ji yo nɔ zugba kɛ e mi kɔ̃hi. Hiɔmi nɛɛ saminya ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. 12Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ baa zugba nɛ ɔ yi, nɛ e buu he jeha a mi tsuo.
13 “Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ ye mlaa amɛ nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ woe mwɔnɛ ɔ a nɔ; nyɛɛ suɔ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ, nɛ nyɛ ja lɛ kɛ nyɛ tsui tsuo. 14Ke nyɛ pee ja a, e ma ha hiɔmi maa nɛ ngɛ e be mi gbo kɛ gbiɛ tsuo, nɛ nyɛ ma na blɛfo, wai, kɛ nu. 15Nyɛ ma na nga hu kɛ ha nyɛ na amɛ, nɛ nyɛ maa ye ní nɛ nyɛ maa tɔ. 16Nyɛɛ hyɛ nɛ hi kɛkɛ, konɛ a ko mlɔɔ nyɛ kɛ je Yawɛ he kɛ ya ja mawu kpahi, nɛ nyɛ sɔmɔ mɛ. 17Ke nyɛ pee ja a, Yawɛ mi mi ma fu nyɛ. E be hae nɛ hiɔmi maa nɛ hu, nɛ zugba a ma gbli, nɛ e be ní bae hu. Kɛkɛ ɔ, e be kɛe nɛ hwɔ ma kpata nyɛ hɛ mi ngɛ zugba kpakpa nɛ Yawɛ kɛ ngɛ nyɛ hae nɛ ɔ nɔ.
18“Nyɛ hɛ nɛ hi mlaa nɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ nyɛ susu a he saminya. Nyɛɛ fi kɛ wo nyɛ kɔni si, kɛ nyɛ hɛ nya kaa kaimi nɔ́. 19Nyɛɛ tsɔɔ nyɛ bimɛ. Nyɛɛ sɛɛ he ní be nɛ nyɛ ngɛ we mi, be nɛ nyɛ hia blɔ, be nɛ nyɛ hwɔɔ si, kɛ be nɛ nyɛ te si. 20 Nyɛɛ ngma ngɔ wo nyɛ sinya tso ɔmɛ a he, kɛ nyɛ agbo ɔmɛ a nya. 21Lɔ ɔ loko nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ bimɛ ɔmɛ nyɛ se maa kɛ ngɛ zugba kpakpa nɛ Yawɛ wo si ke e ma ngɔ ha nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ ɔ nɔ. Nyɛ maa hi lejɛ ɔ daa kɛ yaa si je mi nyagbe.
22“Nyɛɛ hyɛ nɛ nyɛɛ ye mlaa amɛ nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ woe nɛ ɔ a nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ. Nyɛɛ suɔ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ, nɛ nyɛɛ pee nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ i fa nyɛ ke nyɛɛ pee ɔ, nɛ nyɛɛ ye lɛ anɔkuale. 23Kɛkɛ ɔ, Yawɛ maa fie jamɛ a je ma amɛ tsuo nɛ a he wa pe nyɛ ɔ kɛ je zugba amɛ a nɔ ha nyɛ. 24 Zugba a he nɛ nyɛ maa nyɛɛ kɛ gu ɔ tsuo maa pee nyɛ nɔ́. Nyɛ huzu maa je nga kplanaa a nɔ ngɛ leneyi je kɛ yaa su Lebanon yo ɔmɛ a nɔ ngɛ omleyi je; jehanɛ e maa je Yufrate a pa nya ngɛ beleku je kɛ yaa su Mediterenia wo ɔ nya ngɛ bonyoku je. 25He tsuaa he nɛ nyɛ maa ya ngɛ jamɛ a zugba a nɔ ɔ, Yawɛ ma ha ni ɔmɛ maa ye nyɛ gbeye kaa bɔ nɛ e wo si ɔ, nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be nyɛ nyɛe.
26“Mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ, i ngɔ gbaami kɛ gbiɛmi kɛ ngɛ nyɛ hɛ mi fɔe konɛ nyɛɛ hla nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ suɔ. 27E maa pee gbaami ha nyɛ, ke nyɛ ye Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ mlaa amɛ nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ woe mwɔnɛ ɔ a nɔ; 28se e maa pee gbiɛmi, ke nyɛ yi mlaa nɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ nyɛ kpale kɛ ya ja mawu kpahi nɛ nyɛ ja we mɛ hyɛ ɔ. 29 Ke Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ kɛ nyɛ ya su zugba nɛ nyɛ yaa ngɔ ɔ nɔ ɔ, nyɛ de gbaami munyu ɔmɛ kɛ je Gerizim yo ɔ nɔ, kɛ gbiɛmi munyu ɔmɛ hu kɛ je Ebal yo ɔ nɔ. 30(Yo enyɔ nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ Yordan pa a bonyoku je ngɛ Kanaan bi ɔmɛ a zugba a nɔ, ngɛ Yordan kɔ̃ ɔ mi. A ngɛ bonyoku je, nɛ a kɛ tso ngua amɛ nɛ ngɛ More kɛ Gilgal ɔ a he kɛ we kulaa.) 31E su be nɛ nyɛ maa po Yordan pa a, nɛ nyɛ ma ya ngɔ zugba a nɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ kɛ ngɛ nyɛ hae ɔ nɛ nyɛɛ hi nɔ. Ke nyɛ ya ngɔ zugba a, nɛ nyɛ ngɛ nɔ ɔ, 32nyɛɛ hyɛ saminya konɛ mlaa amɛ nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ woe mwɔnɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ ye mɛ tsuo a nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.

Title: MOSE V, 12
Content:
Mawu to he kake nɛ a ja lɛ ngɛ
1“Mlaahi nɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ nɛmɛ a Mawu ɔ ngɛ nyɛ hae nɛ nyɛɛ ye a nɔ nyɛ wami be tsuo nɛ nyɛ maa hi zugba nɛ nyɛ yaa ngɔ ɔ nɔ ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ. 2Hehi nɛ je ma amɛ nɛ nyɛ yaa fie ɔ jaa a mawu ɔmɛ ngɛ, ngɛ yo gaga amɛ a nɔ, yoku ɔmɛ a nɔ, kɛ tso kusuu ɔmɛ a sisi ɔ, nyɛ kpata a hɛ mi. 3 Nyɛɛ ku a bɔ sami la tɛ ɔmɛ, nɛ nyɛɛ ywia a wɔ titima amɛ wɔtsɔwɔtsɔ. Nyɛɛ sã a yo wɔ Ashera a, nɛ nyɛɛ poo a mawu ɔmɛ a we amaga amɛ pue he. Nyɛ kpata a hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ, konɛ a ko ja mɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔmɛ hu.
