4“Nyɛ ko ja Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ ngɛ he saisaa kaa bɔ nɛ a peeɔ ɔ. 5Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ maa hla he kake ngɛ nyɛ wɛtso ɔmɛ tsuo a mi, nɛ e maa ngɔ e biɛ kɛ wo lejɛ ɔ kaa e si himi he nɛ a ja lɛ ngɛ. 6Nyɛ ya sã nyɛ sami bɔ ɔmɛ, bɔ kpa amɛ, nyɛ níhi a mi dlami nyɔngmanyɔngma mi kakaaka amɛ, kɛ nyɛ bɔ ɔmɛ tsuo ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Nike ní nɛ nyɛ wo si ke nyɛ ma ha Yawɛ, kɛ nike ní nɛ je nyɛ tsui mi faa, nyɛ na amɛ, kɛ nyɛ to ɔmɛ a kekleekle bi ɔmɛ hu nyɛɛ ngɔ kɛ ya lejɛ ɔ. 7Nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ we ɔmɛ tsuo maa ye ní ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, nɛ nyɛ bua maa jɔ niba ní kpakpahi nɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ kɛ gbaa nyɛ dengme gbomi nɔ ha nyɛ ɔ a he.
8“Ke jamɛ a be ɔ su ɔ, nyɛ ko pee kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ pee amlɔ nɛ ɔ. Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, nyɛ tsuo nyɛ ngɛ Mawu jae bɔ nɛ nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ suɔ, 9ejakaa zugba a nɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ kɛ ngɛ nyɛ hae nɛ nyɛ maa hi si ngɛ nɔ ngɛ tue mi jɔmi mi ɔ, nyɛ sui nɔ lolo. 10Ke nyɛ po Yordan pa a, Yawɛ ma ha nyɛ maa ngɔ zugba a nɛ nyɛɛ hi nɔ. E ma ha nyɛ tue mi maa jɔ nyɛ kɛ je nyɛ he nyɛli tsuo nɛ bɔle nyɛ kɛ kpe ɔ a dɛ mi. 11Yawɛ maa hla he ko pɔtɛɛ nɛ a ja lɛ ngɛ. Nyɛɛ ngɔ bɔ sami ní ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ a he mlaa woe nɛ ɔ kɛ ya sã bɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ: nyɛ sami bɔ ɔmɛ, nike ní ɔmɛ, nyɛ mi dlami nyɔngmanyɔngma mi kakaaka amɛ, kɛ bɔ pɔtɛɛ ɔmɛ nɛ nyɛ wo si ke nyɛ ma ha Yawɛ ɔ. 12Nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ bimɛ ɔmɛ, nyɛ tsɔli nyumu ɔmɛ, nyɛ mawayi ɔmɛ, kɛ Levi bi ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ nyɛ ma amɛ a mi ɔ tsuo nyɛ nya ngɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ hɛ mi; nyɛ kai kaa Levi bi ɔmɛ lɛɛ a be zugba ko nae kaa mɛ nitsɛmɛ a nɔ́. 13Nyɛɛ hyɛ saminya nɛ nyɛ ko ya sã nyɛ sami bɔ ɔmɛ ngɛ he saisaa nɛ nyɛ suɔ. 14Nyɛɛ sã bɔ ɔmɛ ha Yawɛ ngɛ he kake nɛ lɛ nitsɛ e maa to ngɛ nyɛ wɛtso ɔmɛ a kpɛti kake zugba mi ɔ pɛ. Lejɛ ɔ pɛ nyɛɛ sã nyɛ bɔ ɔmɛ nɛ nyɛ maa sã a, nɛ nyɛɛ pee ní kpa amɛ tsuo nɛ i fa nyɛ ke nyɛɛ pee ɔ ngɛ.
15“Se kɛ̃ ɔ, nyɛ ma nyɛ maa gbe nyɛ lohwe ɔmɛ nɛ nyɛɛ ye ngɛ nyɛ hi he ɔmɛ. Nyɛɛ ye bɔ nɛ nyɛ suɔ, kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu dloo nyɛ ɔ. Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ye; ke ngɛ kɔ nya a, nɔ ɔ he tsɔ jio, e he tsɔ we jio, e ye kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ yeɔ bayelɔ, loo avugbɛ lo ɔ. 16 Se muɔ lɛɛ, kaa niye ní ɔ, nyɛ ko ye; nyɛɛ tsɛ̃ pue zugba kaa nyu. 17Nyɛ ko ye níhi nɛ nyɛ kɛ ke Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ ekoeko ngɛ nyɛ hi he ɔmɛ, nyɛ blɛfo mi dlami nyɔngmanyɔngma mi kakaaka a jio, nyɛ wai jio, nyɛ oliv nu jio, loo nyɛ na amɛ kɛ to ɔmɛ a kekleekle bi ɔmɛ eko jio, nike níhi nɛ nyɛ wo si kaa nyɛɛ kɛ ma ha Yawɛ ɔ eko jio, nɔ́ nɛ je nyɛ tsui mi faa jio, loo bɔ kpa komɛ jio. 18Nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ bimɛ ɔmɛ, nyɛ sɔmɔli ɔmɛ, kɛ Levi bi ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ nyɛ ma amɛ a mi ɔ, nyɛɛ ye bɔ sami ní nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ hɛ mi pɛ, ngɛ he kake ɔ nɛ e to nɛ a ja lɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ ngɛ ɔ. Nyɛɛ kɛ bua jɔmi nɛ pee nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ ngɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ hɛ mi ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. 19Jehanɛ hu, nyɛɛ hyɛ nɛ hi, konɛ nyɛ hɛ ko je Levi bi ɔmɛ a nɔ be abɔ nɛ nyɛ maa hi nyɛ zugba a nɔ ɔ.
20“Ke Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ bli nyɛ huzu ɔmɛ a mi kaa bɔ nɛ e wo si ɔ, nyɛ ma nyɛ maa ye de lo be tsuaa be nɛ nyɛ suɔ. 21Se ke he nɛ a to kaa a ja Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ ngɛ ɔ kɛ tsɔ ɔ, nyɛ ma nyɛ maa gbe nyɛ na, loo to nɛ Yawɛ kɛ dloo nyɛ ɔ eko, nɛ nyɛɛ ye lɔ ɔ ngɛ nyɛ we mi kaa bɔ nɛ i de nyɛ momo ɔ. 22Nɔ tsuaa nɔ ngɛ he blɔ nɛ e yeɔ lo ɔ eko; nɔ ɔ he tsɔ jio, nɔ ɔ he tsɔ we jio, e ye kaa bɔ nɛ e maa ye bayelɔ, loo avugbɛ lo ɔ. 23 Lo kɛ e mi muɔ lɛɛ nyɛ ko ye kɔkɔɔkɔ; ejakaa wami ngɛ muɔ ɔ mi, nɛ e sɛ kaa nyɛ yeɔ lo kɛ e mi wami ɔ tsuo. 24Nyɛ ko ngɔ muɔ kɛ pee niye ní; mohu nyɛɛ tsɛ̃ pue zugba kaa nyu. 25Ke nyɛ ye mlaa nɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ, Yawɛ bua maa jɔ, nɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ maa hi ha nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ nina tsuo. 26Nyɛɛ ngɔ nyɛ bɔ ɔmɛ nɛ a sãã a, kɛ nike ní klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ nɛ nyɛ wo si ɔ kɛ ya he kake ɔ nɛ Yawɛ to ke a ja lɛ ngɛ ɔ. 27Nyɛɛ sã nyɛ sami bɔ ɔmɛ, lo kɛ muɔ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ ngɛ Yawɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ. Nyɛ bɔ kpa amɛ lɛɛ nyɛ kpa muɔ ɔ ngɔ pue bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ, nɛ nyɛɛ ye lo ɔ. 28Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ i fa nyɛ ke nyɛɛ pee, nɛ i wo nyɛ mlaa ngɛ he ɔ, nyɛɛ ye nɔ fitsofitso; kɛkɛ ɔ, níhi a mi maa hi ha nyɛ kɛ nyɛ nia tsuo kɛ maa ya neneene; ejakaa ke nyɛ pee ja a, nyɛ ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ da, kɛ nɔ́ nɛ saa Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ hɛ mi pee.
Amaga jami he kɔkɔ bɔmi
29“Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ ma kpata je ma amɛ nɛ nyɛ yaa ngɔ a zugba a a hɛ mi, nɛ nyɛ maa hi lejɛ ɔ kulaa. 30Ke Yawɛ kpata jamɛ a je ma amɛ a hɛ mi se ɔ, nyɛɛ hyɛ saminya nɛ nyɛ ko ya nyɛɛ a we amaga jami ní peemi ní ɔmɛ a se, ejakaa e maa pee gbenɔ ha nyɛ. Nyɛ ko hla a mawu ɔmɛ a se blɔ, nɛ nyɛ ko bi ke, ‘Kɛ jamɛ a ni ɔmɛ jaa a mawu ɔmɛ kɛɛ, konɛ wɔ hu waa pee ja!’ 31Nyɛ ko ja Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ kaa a jaa a mawu ɔmɛ; ejakaa ngɛ a mawu ɔmɛ a jami mi ɔ, a peeɔ níhi nɛ a hĩɔ, nɛ́ Yawɛ sume ɔ tsuo. A bimɛ po a sãã ngɛ la mi ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ.
32 “Nyɛɛ hyɛ saminya nɛ nyɛɛ ye mlaa amɛ tsuo nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ woe nɛ ɔ a nɔ fitsofitso. Nyɛ ko je nɔ́ ko kɛ je mi ɔ, nyɛ ko ngɔ nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko kɛ piɛ he hulɔ.

Title: MOSE V, 13
Content:
1“Ke gbalɔ ko, loo nlami sisi tsɔɔlɔ ko wo si ke e maa pee okadi ko, loo nyakpɛ nɔ́ ko, 2bɔ nɛ pee nɛ e kpaka nyɛ kɛ ya ja Mawu kpahi, nɛ pohu nyɛ ja we mɛ hyɛ ɔ, ke kaa níhi nɛ e wo a he si ɔ ba mi tete po ɔ, 3nyɛ ko bu lɛ tue fɛɛ. Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ gu nɔ́ nɛ ɔ nɔ kɛ ngɛ nyɛ kae nɛ e hyɛ kaa nyɛ suɔ lɛ, Yawɛ ɔ saminya ngɛ nyɛ tsui mi lo. 4Nyɛɛ nyɛɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ se, nɛ nyɛɛ ye lɛ pɛ gbeye; nyɛɛ bu lɛ tue, nɛ nyɛɛ ye e mlaa amɛ a nɔ; nyɛ ja lɛ, nɛ nyɛɛ ye lɛ anɔkuale. 5Se gbalɔ, loo nlami sisi tsɔɔlɔ ko nɛ maa wo nyɛ yi mi ke nyɛɛ te si kɛ si Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ nɛ je nyɛ kɛ je Egipt zugba a nɔ, he nɛ nyɛ ye nyɔguɛ ngɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ gbe lɛ. Kikɛmɛ a nɔmlɔ ɔ, e ji nɔmlɔ yayami nɛ ngɛ nyɛ kae kaa e maa mlɔɔ nyɛ kɛ je si himi kpakpa nɛ Yawɛ fa nyɛ ke nyɛɛ hi ɔ he. Nyɛɛ gbe lɛ, konɛ nɔ́ yayami nɛ ɔ ko hi nyɛ kpɛti hu.
6“O nyɛminyumu nɛ ji o nyɛ muklii mi bi, loo o binyumu, loo o biyo, loo o yo nɛ o suɔ lɛ, loo o huɛ nɛ nyu bi ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti po ma nyɛ maa mlɔɔ mo nɛ o ma ya ja mawu kpahi nɛ mo, loo o nɛmɛ ja we hyɛ. 7A ti nɔ ko ma nyɛ maa mlɔɔ mo nɛ o ma ya ja nihi nɛ ngɛ nyɛ kasa nya, aloo nihi nɛ ngɛ tsitsaa a mawu ɔmɛ ekomɛ. 8Koo kplɛɛ, nɛ koo bu lɛ tue tete po. Koo na lɛ mɔbɔ; koo baa e yi; koo laa e nɔ. 9Gbee lɛ! Mo kekle o fia lɛ tɛ, nɛ lɔ ɔ se ɔ, nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ fiaa lɛ tɛ ɔ eko. 10Á fiaa lɛ tɛ nɛ e gbo! E hla kaa e ma puɛ o tue ngɛ Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ nɛ kpɔ̃ mo kɛ je Egipt, he nɛ o ya ye nyɔguɛ ngɛ ɔ he. 11Ke e ba mi ja a, Israel ma a tsuo maa nu sane ɔ he; a maa ye gbeye, nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be nɔ́ yayami kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ pee hu.
12“Ke nyɛ ngɛ ma amɛ nɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ ha nyɛ ɔ a mi, nɛ nyɛ nu kaa 13yakayaka nimli komɛ nɛ ji Israel fɔfɔɛhi puɛ ma a mi bi ɔmɛ a tue nɛ a ya ja mawu kpahi nɛ nyɛ ja we hyɛ ɔ, 14nyɛ bi nɛ nyɛɛ na nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ nu ɔ mi fitsofitso. Ke sane ɔ ngɛ mi niinɛ kaa a pee nɔ́ yayami nɛ ɔ, 15lɛɛ nyɛɛ gbe jamɛ a ma a mi bi ɔmɛ tsuo, kɛ a lohwe ɔmɛ tsuo. Nyɛɛ ngɔ klaate kɛ kpata ma a hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ. 16Nyɛ bua ma a mi bi ɔmɛ a níhi nɛ a ngɛ ɔ tsuo a nya glekugleku ngɛ ma nɔ. Jehanɛ, nyɛɛ sã ma a, kɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ mi ɔ kaa sami bɔ kɛ ha Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ. Ma a nɛ pee ma doku, nɛ e ko bɔ hu gblegbleegble. 17Nyɛ ko ngɔ níhi nɛ a ma kpata a hɛ mi ɔ eko kɛ to ha nyɛ he. Kɛkɛ ɔ, Yawɛ mi mi nɛ fu nyɛ wawɛɛ ɔ nya maa ba si, nɛ e maa na nyɛ mɔbɔ. E maa na nyɛ mɔbɔ, nɛ e ma ha nyɛ he maa hiɛ babauu kaa bɔ nɛ e wo nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ si ɔ. 18Ke nyɛ ye e mlaa amɛ tsuo nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ woe mwɔnɛ ɔ a nɔ, nɛ nyɛ pee nɔ́ nɛ e ngɛ hlae ɔ, Yawɛ maa pee ní nɛ ɔmɛ ha nyɛ.

Title: MOSE V, 14
Content:
Nɔ́ ko nɛ a hiɔ ngɛ ya peemi mi
1 “Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ ma ji nyɛ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke nɔ ko gbo nɛ nyɛ ngɛ ya nyɛe ɔ, nyɛ ko poo nyɛ he ha, nɛ nyɛ ko je nyɛ hɛ nya kaa bɔ nɛ je ma kpa amɛ peeɔ ɔ. 2 Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ níhi ji nyɛ. E hla nyɛ kɛ je je ma amɛ tsuo nɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ ɔ a mi kɛ pee lɛ nitsɛ e ma.
Lohwehi nɛ a he tsɔ kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ a he tsɔ we
(Mose III, 11.1-47)
3“Nɔ́ ko nɛ Yawɛ ke e he tsɔ we ɔ, nyɛ ko ye. 4Lohwehi nɛ nyɛ ma nyɛ maa ye ji na, jijɔ, apletsi, 5odabɔ, anagla, bayelɔ, kɛ nga mi gbe, loo asisã. 6Nyɛ ma nyɛ maa ye lohwe tsuaa lohwe nane eywiɛtsɛ nɛ a gba e nane kokloto mi, nɛ e gɔleɔ nɔ́ nɛ e yeɔ, nɛ e kpale taa ekohu. 7Se kɛ̃ ɔ, lohwehi nɛ gɔleɔ nɔ́ nɛ a yeɔ, nɛ a kpale taa ekohu, nɛ́ ngɛ nane kokloto nɛ nyɛ ko ye ji afukpɔngɔ, alɔngɔ, kɛ tɛ sa nɔ kpi. A gɔleɔ nɔ́ nɛ a yeɔ nɛ a kpale taa ekohu lɛɛ, se a gba we a nane kokloto mi; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a he tsɔ we. 8Nyɛ ko ye kpotoo. E he tsɔ we; ejakaa a gba e nane kokloto mi lɛɛ, se e gɔle we nɔ́ nɛ e yeɔ nɛ e taa ekohu. Nyɛ ko ye lohwe nɛ ɔmɛ a lo, nɛ nyɛ ko ta a gbogboe he hulɔ.
9“Nyɛɛ ye nyu mi lo nɛ ngɛ se mi mio, nɛ toto ha e he, 10se nyu mi lo nɛ be se mi mio, nɛ toto hɛ e he ɔ, nyɛ ko ye; e he tsɔ we.
11“Nyɛɛ ye lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ nɛ a he tsɔ ɔ tsuo. 12-18Se nyɛ ko ye lohwe pɛlitsɛ nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ a henɔ ɔmɛ: kɔle, klomi, kayo, osansa, alɔɔ, okpoku, kɔɔkɔmite, duguma, anuma, nyɔ mi kayo, nga mi kpakpahe, omiɔhɔɔ, pa nɔ kayo, kpokukpoku, godo, kɔne, kɛ apani.
19“Lohwe tsɔwi nɛ tee ɔ tsuo a he tsɔ we; nyɛ ko ye. 20Nyɛɛ ye lohwe tsɔwi nɛ a he tsɔ.
21 “Nyɛ ko ye lohwe ko nɛ lɛ nitsɛ e gbo. Nyɛ kɛ ha nibwɔhi nɛ ba to nyɛ ɔ nɛ a ye, loo nyɛɛ jua ha ni kpahi. Nyɛɛ lɛɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ nihi ji nyɛ; nyɛ ji e ma. Nyɛ ko hoo jijɔ bi, loo apletsi bi ngɛ e nyɛ nyɔ nyu mi.
Mi dlami nyɔngma mi kake he mlaa
22 “Nyɛ je nyɛ ngmɔ niba ní mi mi dlami nyɔngma mi kake kɛ to daa jeha. 23Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, nyɛɛ ya he kake ɔ nɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ to nɛ a ja lɛ ngɛ ɔ. Nyɛɛ ye nyɛ blɛfo, wai, kɛ oliv nu mi dlami nyɔngmanyɔngma mi kakaaka a, kɛ nyɛ na amɛ, kɛ to ɔmɛ a kekleekle bi ɔmɛ ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi. Nyɛɛ pee enɛ ɔ kɛ kase bɔ nɛ nyɛ maa ye Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ gbeye nyɛ wami be tsuo. 24Ke nyɛ we mi kɛ jami he ɔ kɛ tsɔ, nɛ nyɛ be nyɛe maa tloo ní ɔmɛ a mi dlami nyɔngmanyɔngma mi kakaaka a kɛ ya a, 25lɛɛ nyɛɛ jua ní ɔmɛ, nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ sika a nɛ ya he kake ɔ nɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ to nɛ a ja lɛ ngɛ ɔ. 26Nyɛɛ ngɔ sika a kɛ he nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ suɔ, na, wai, loo dã nɛ nya wa, konɛ nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ weku li nɛ ye ní, nɛ nyɛ bua nɛ jɔ nyɛ he saminya ngɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ hɛ mi.
27“Nyɛ ko si Levi bi ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ nyɛ ma amɛ a mi ɔ se; mɛɛ lɛɛ a be weto ní ko ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti. 28Jeha etɛ tsuaa jeha etɛ nyagbe ɔ, nyɛ bua nyɛ ngmɔ niba ní ɔmɛ a mi dlami nyɔngmanyɔngma mi kakaaka a tsuo nya kɛ ba to ngɛ nyɛ ma amɛ a mi. 29Levi bi ɔmɛ a niye ní ji nɛ ɔ nɛ, ejakaa mɛɛ lɛɛ a be weto ní ko. Nibwɔhi, awusahi, kɛ yalɔyihi hu nɛ ngɛ nyɛ ma amɛ a mi ɔ, nyɛ ha nɛ a ye eko nɛ a tɔ. Ke nyɛ pee ja a, Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ maa gbaa nyɛ ngɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ tsue ɔ mi.

Title: MOSE V, 15
Content:
Jeha kpaagone ɔ
(Mose III, 25.1-7)
1“Jeha kpaagone tsuaa jeha kpaagone se ɔ, ke nɔ ko hɛɛ mo hiɔ ɔ, kɛ ke lɛ. 2Bɔ nɛ o maa pee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ pa Israel fɔfɔɛ ko sika a, e kɛ ke lɛ; e ko je hiɔ ɔ hu. Yawɛ nitsɛ nɛ de ke a kɛ hiɔ ɔ nɛ ke. 3Ke nubwɔ ɔ, lɛɛ jee lɛ hiɔ; se mo nitsɛ o ma mi no lɛɛ koo je lɛ hiɔ ɔ. 4Ohiatsɛ be nyɛ kpɛti hie; ejakaa Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ maa gbaa mo ngɛ zugba a nɛ e ngɔ kɛ ngɛ mo hae kaa o weto ní ɔ nɔ. 5Ke o maa bu Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ gbi tue, nɛ o maa ye nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ mo he mlaa woe mwɔnɛ ɔ nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ ɔ, o be ohia yee. 6Yawɛ maa gbaa mo kaa bɔ nɛ e wo si ɔ. O maa pa sika kɛ ha mahi babauu, se moo lɛɛ o be sika pae ngɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko dɛ; o maa ye je mahi babauu a nɔ, se moo lɛɛ je ma ko je ma ko be o nɔ yee.
7 “Ke Israel fɔfɔɛ ko dɛ mi ba ta ngɛ ma amɛ a mi ngɛ zugba a nɛ Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ ngɔ kɛ ngɛ mo hae ɔ nɔ ɔ, koo pee kpɛle nɛ o nyɛ lɛ nɔ́ he. 8Bli o dɛ mi ha nɔ nɛ e fi lɛ ɔ, nɛ o pa lɛ bɔ nɛ maa su lɛ. 9Ke jeha nɛ a kɛ hiɔ kee nɔ ɔ su ta po, ko kua kaa o maa pa lɛ nɔ́ ko. Ko ha susumi yaya kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ nɛ ba o yi mi. Ke o kua lɛ nɔ́ nɛ hia lɛ ɔ hami, nɛ e fa kue ha Yawɛ kɛ si mo ɔ, a maa bu mo fɔ. 10Ha lɛ nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ lɛ hiae ɔ faa nɛ kpɛle peemi be mi. Ke o pee ja a, Yawɛ maa gbaa mo ngɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ o ngɛ tsue ɔ mi. 11 Be tsuaa be ɔ, ohiatsɛmɛ komɛ maa hi nyɛ nyɛmimɛ Israel fɔfɔɛ ɔmɛ a kpɛti nɛ e fi mɛ kɛ̃; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i ngɛ mo fae ke o bli o dɛ mi ha mɛ.
Bɔ nɛ á hɛɛ nyɔguɛhi ha
(Mose II, 21.1-11)
12 “Ke o nyɛmi Hebri no, nyumu jio, yo jio, jua e he kɛ ha mo kaa nyɔguɛ ɔ, ha nɛ e sɔmɔ mo jeha ekpa; nɛ jeha kpaagone ɔ, é ye e he. 13Se ke o ngmɛɛ e he ɔ, ko ha nɛ e ya dɛ gu. 14Ngɔɔ níhi nɛ Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ kɛ gbaa mo ɔ, to, blɛfo, kɛ wai ɔ eko kɛ ha lɛ faa, nɛ o kɛ wo lɛ blɔ. 15Kai kaa nyɛ hu nyɛ ya ye nyɔguɛ hyɛ ngɛ Egipt zugba a nɔ, nɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ ha nyɛ ye nyɛ he; lɔ ɔ he nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ mlaa nɛ ɔ woe mwɔnɛ ɔ nɛ.
16“Se ke nyɔguɛ ɔ sume nɛ e si mo, akɛnɛ e suɔ o kɛ o we ɔ nyɛ sane ngɛ bɔ nɛ o kɛ lɛ hi si saminya a he je ɔ, 17lɛɛ ngɔɔ tue gbumi nɔ́ kɛ gbu e tue ngɛ o we ɔ sinya a he; kɛkɛ ɔ, e maa pee o nyɔguɛ e wami be tsuo. Ke yo ji lɛ hu, o pee lɛ jã kɛ̃. 18E ko wa ha mo kaa o maa ngmɛɛ nyɔguɛ ko he nɛ e ye e he. Ke o maa bu nya a, e sɔmɔ mo jeha ekpa sɔuu, nɛ apaatsɛ hiɔwo fa pɛ o puɛ ngɛ e he. Pee bɔ nɛ i ngɛ mo dee nɛ ɔ, nɛ Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ maa gbaa o nine nya ní tsumi tsuo nɔ.
Na, loo to kekleekle bi
19 “Moo hla o na amɛ, kɛ o to ɔmɛ a kekleekle bi ku ɔmɛ nɛ a ma fɔ ɔ ngɔ to ha Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ; koo ngɔ na nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ tsu nɔ́ ko, nɛ jijɔ bi ɔmɛ hu ko sã a he bwɔmi. 20Daa jeha a, o kɛ o weku li nɛ ye mɛ ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi ngɛ he nɛ e to nɛ a ja lɛ ngɛ ɔ. 21Ke lohwe ɔmɛ a nane kplɔ ngɛ a sisi, loo a hɛngmɛ yu, loo sakpa ko ngɛ a he ɔ, koo ngɔ mɛ kɛ sã bɔ ha Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ. 22O ma nyɛ maa ye mɛ ngɛ we mi. Nyɛ tsuo, ni nɛmɛ nɛ a he tsɔ, kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ a he tsɔ we ma nyɛ maa ye kaa bɔ nɛ a yeɔ batslɔɔ, loo nga mi gbe ɔ. 23 Se a muɔ lɛɛ nyɛ ko ye; nyɛɛ tsɛ̃ ngɔ pue si kaa nyu.

Title: MOSE V, 16
Content:
Hetsɔmi ɔ
(Mose II, 12.1-20)
1 “Nyɛɛ ye Hetsɔmi nyami be ɔ ngɛ nyɔhiɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ Abib ɔ mi kɛ wo Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ hɛ mi nyami. Nyɔ ko mi ngɛ jamɛ a nyɔhiɔ ɔ mi nɛ e kpɔ̃ nyɛ kɛ je Egipt ɔ nɛ. 2Nyɛɛ ya he nɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ to nɛ a ja lɛ Mawu ngɛ ɔ, nɛ nyɛ ya gbe nyɛ to, loo na amɛ eko kɛ ye Hetsɔmi ɔ kɛ wo Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ hɛ mi nyami. 3Nyɛ ko ye masa nɔ́ ko ligbi kpaago, se mohu nyɛɛ ye abolo kplolo, nɛ ji nɔ́ nami niye ní nɛ nyɛ ye benɛ nyɛɛ kɛ he hiami tu fo kɛ je Egipt ɔ. Nyɛɛ ye abolo kplolo nɛ ɔ, konɛ nyɛ wami be mi tsuo ɔ, nyɛ kɛ kai bɔ nɛ nyɛ je Egipt, he nɛ nyɛ na nɔ́ ngɛ ɔ. 4Ligbi kpaago nɛ ɔmɛ a mi ɔ, a ko na masa nɔ́ ko ngɛ we ko we ko mi ngɛ nyɛ zugba a nɔ. Lohwe nɛ a gbe kekleekle ligbi ɔ gbɔkuɛ nya si hu, á ye lo ɔ tsuo ligbi ɔ kɛ̃; je ko na yi.
5-6“Nyɛɛ gbe lohwe nɛ a kɛ maa ye Hetsɔmi ɔ ngɛ he nɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ to nɛ a ja lɛ ngɛ ɔ pɛ; nyɛ ko gbe ngɛ he saisaa ngɛ zugba a nɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ ngɔ ha nyɛ kaa nyɛɛ hi nɔ ɔ nɔ. Nyɛ tsu nɔ́ nɛ ɔ gbɔkuɛ nya si be nɛ pu yaa nɔ si ejakaa jamɛ a be mi nɛ nyɛ je Egipt ɔ nɛ. 7Nyɛɛ hoo lo ɔ, nɛ nyɛɛ ye ngɛ he nɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ to nɛ a ja lɛ ngɛ ɔ; e nɔ jena mɔtu loko nyɛɛ kpale kɛ ya we mi. 8Nyɛɛ ye abolo kplolo ligbi ekpa, nɛ ligbi nɛ ji kpaago ɔ, nyɛ bua nyɛ he nya kɛ ja Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ; nyɛ ko tsu ní tsumi ko jamɛ a ligbi ɔ.
Ngmakpami nyami be ɔ
(Mose II, 34.22; Mose III, 23.15-21)
9 “Nyɛɛ kane otsi kpaago kɛ je be nɛ nyɛ ma bɔni ngma kpami, 10nɛ nyɛɛ ye Ngmakpami nyami be ɔ kɛ wo Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ hɛ mi nyami. Nyɛɛ ngɔ nyɛ suɔmi nya nike ní, ngɛ bɔ nɛ Mawu gbaa nyɛ nɛ nyɛ na a nya kɛ ba sã bɔ ha Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ. 11Nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ bimɛ ɔmɛ, nyɛ mawa amɛ, Levi bi ɔmɛ, kɛ yalɔyi ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ nyɛ ma amɛ a mi ɔ nyɛ bua nɛ jɔ, nɛ nyɛ nya ngɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ hɛ mi. Nyɛɛ pee enɛ ɔ ngɛ he kake nɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ to nɛ a ja lɛ ngɛ ɔ. 12Nyɛɛ hyɛ saminya nɛ nyɛɛ ye mlaa nɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ; nyɛ hɛ ko je nɔ kaa nyɛ hu nyɛ ye nyɔguɛ ngɛ Egipt.
Gbasisihimi nyami be
(Mose III, 23.33-43)
13 “Ke nyɛ hluɛ nyɛ blɛfo tsuo ta, nɛ nyɛ nga nyɛ wai yiblii tsuo gbe nya a, nyɛɛ ye Gbasisihimi nyami be ɔ ligbi kpaago. 14Nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ bimɛ ɔmɛ, nyɛ sɔmɔli ɔmɛ, Levi bi ɔmɛ, nibwɔ ɔmɛ, awusa amɛ, kɛ yalɔyi ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ nyɛ ma amɛ a mi ɔ tsuo nyɛɛ ye nyami be nɛ ɔ. 15Nyɛ bua nɛ jɔ kɛ wo Yawɛ hɛ mi nyami ligbi kpaago ngɛ he kake ɔ nɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ to nɛ a ja lɛ ngɛ ɔ. Nyɛ bua nɛ jɔ saminya, ejakaa Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ gbaa nyɛ ngmɔ niba ní, kɛ nyɛ nine nya ní tsumi tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ nɔ.
16“Israel ma a mi nyumu ɔmɛ tsuo kulaa nɛ a bua a he nya si etɛ ngɛ jeha mi ngɛ he kake ɔ nɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ to nɛ a ja lɛ ngɛ ɔ. Be ɔmɛ ji Hetsɔmi nyami be, Ngmakpami nyami be, kɛ Gbasisihimi nyami be. Nɔ ko nɔ ko nɛ ko ba nyami nɛ ɔ kɛ e dɛ gu. 17Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ha bɔ nɛ e ma nyɛ, kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ gbaa lɛ ɔ.
Dami sane yemi
18“Nyɛɛ wo kojoli kɛ tsɔli ngɛ nyɛ wɛtso ɔmɛ a mi ngɛ ma amɛ tsuo nɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ ngɛ nyɛ hae ɔ a mi. Mɛɛ a ní tsumi ji kaa a maa hyɛ nɛ dami sane yemi nɛ ma si. 19 A ko ye tue kpɛkpɛɛ sane; nɛ a ko hyɛ nɔ hɛ mi. A ko he nyɔ mi ní; ejakaa nyɔ mi ní hemi yuɔ ní leli po a hɛngmɛ, nɛ e haa a plɛɔ munyu hɛ mi buɔ si. 20Nyɛɛ pee nɔ nɛ sa, nɛ nyɛɛ ye dami sane daa. Ke nyɛ pee ja a, nyɛ maa su zugba nɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ ngɛ nyɛ hae ɔ nɔ, nɛ nyɛ maa hi lejɛ ɔ daa.
21 “Ke nyɛ ma bɔ sami la tɛ ha Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ, nyɛ ko ngɔ yo Ashera a mawu we amaga nɛ a kɛ tso kpɛ kɛ ma e kasa nya. 22 Jehanɛ hu, nyɛ ko ngɔ tɛ kɛ ma si nɛ nyɛ ja; Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ hiɔ ní nɛ ɔmɛ.

Title: MOSE V, 17
Content:
1“Nyɛ ko ngɔ na, loo to nɛ kpa, loo nɔ́ ko yayami ngɛ e he kɛ sã bɔ ha Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ; Yawɛ hiɔ jamɛ a bɔ.
2“Alini, nyɛ maa nu ngɛ nyɛ ma amɛ nɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ ngɔ kɛ ngɛ nyɛ hae ɔ ekomɛ a mi kaa nyumu ko, loo yo ko pee yayami kɛ si Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ; e ya yi Yawɛ somi ɔ nɔ, nɛ e tɔ̃; 3 lɔ ɔ ji kaa e ya ja mawu kpahi, pu, nyɔhiɔ kɛ dodoehi, nɛ e sɔmɔ mɛ, nɛ e kɛ tɔ̃ Yawɛ mlaa a nɔ. 4Ke nɔ ko ba sɛɛ ha nyɛ ɔ, nyɛ bi nɛ nyɛ hla mi fitsofitso kaa sane ɔ ngɛ mi niinɛ lo. Ke e ngɛ mi niinɛ kaa a tsu nɔ́ yayami nɛ ɔ ngɛ Israel ɔ, 5lɛɛ nyɛɛ ngɔ nɔ ɔ kɛ je ma a mi, nɛ nyɛ ya fiaa lɛ tɛ, nɛ e gbo, nyumu jio, yo jio. 6 Se kɛ̃ ɔ, odase yeli enyɔ, loo nihi nɛ hiɛ pe jã a we odase nɔ a maa da kɛ bu lɛ fɔ, loko a gbe lɛ; a ko nu odase yelɔ kake pɛ nya mi munyu. 7 Odase yeli ɔmɛ nɛ a fiaa lɛ tɛ ɔ kekle, konɛ ma a tsuo nɛ fiaa nɔ ɔ tɛ ɔ; nyɛɛ pee ja kɛ je nɔ́ yayami nɛ ɔ kɛ je nyɛ kpɛti.
8“E ma nyɛ maa ba mi kaa sane komɛ a yemi kɛ he buámi nya maa wa tsɔ ha ma amɛ eko mi kojoli, kaa weto ní blɔ nya he pleemi sane komɛ kikɛ, loo kaa a plaa nɔ ko, loo sane komɛ nɛ a ngɛ mi hlae, konɛ a na kaa pe a je blɔ gbe nɔ ko nɛ e gbo ɔ, loo a li be nɛ a fia lɛ nɔ́ nɛ e gbo. Ke e ba lɛ ja a, nyɛɛ ya he kake ɔ nɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ to nɛ a ja lɛ ngɛ ɔ. 9Nyɛɛ ngɔ nyɛ sane ɔ kɛ ya pue osɔfo ɔmɛ nɛ ji Levi bi ɔmɛ, kɛ kojolɔ nɛ ngɛ ní tsue jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ a hɛ mi, konɛ a buá he. 10Mɛ ji ni nɛmɛ nɛ maa ma munyu ɔ nya si. Nyɛɛ pee bɔ nɛ a ma de nyɛ ɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ. 11Nyɛɛ kplɛɛ bɔ nɛ a maa ma munyu ɔ nya si ɔ; nɛ nyɛɛ ye blɔ nya tomi ɔmɛ nɛ a maa tsɔɔ nyɛ ɔ a nɔ fitsofitso. 12Se nɔ nɛ ma tsɔ atuã kɛ si kojolɔ, loo osɔfo ɔ nɛ ngɛ sɔmɔe jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, nyɛɛ gbe lɛ; kikɛmɛ a blɔ nɛ ɔ nɔ nyɛɛ gu kɛ je yayami kɛ je Israel ma a mi. 13Enɛ ɔ ma ha ma a tsuo maa nu sane nɛ ɔ he, nɛ a maa ye gbeye; kɛkɛ ɔ, nɔ ko nɔ ko be nlae kaa e maa pee ja hu.
Blɔ nya tomi nɛ kɔɔ matsɛ he
14 “Ke nyɛ ya ngɔ zugba a nɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ ngɛ nyɛ hae ɔ, nɛ e ba pee nyɛ nɔ ɔ, nyɛ ma de ke nyɛ maa wo matsɛ kaa bɔ nɛ ma amɛ nɛ bɔle nyɛ ɔ tsuo pee ɔ. 15Nyɛɛ hyɛ saminya, konɛ nɔ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ hlae kaa e ye matsɛ ɔ, e pee nɔ nɛ Yawɛ hla. E pee nyɛ ma mi no; nyɛ ko ngɔ nubwɔ kɛ to matsɛ nɛ e ye nyɛ nɔ. 16 Matsɛ ɔ ko hi ta okpɔngɔhi babauu; nɛ e ko tsɔ kɛ ya he okpɔngɔhi ngɛ Egipt; ejakaa Yawɛ de ke e ma a ko kpale kɛ ya lejɛ ɔ gblegbleegble. 17 Matsɛ ɔ ko ngɔ yihi fuu; ejakaa ke e pee ja a, e tsui maa je Yawɛ he. E ko bua sika hiɔ kɛ sika tsu babauu nya ha e he. 18Ke matsɛ ɔ ba hi sɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ é pee mohu ji e ha nɛ a ngma Mawu mlaa amɛ, kɛ tsɔɔmi ɔmɛ kɛ je mlaa womi ɔ nitsɛ mi kɛ wo womi mi. Mlaa womi ɔ nitsɛ ɔ, Levi bi ɔmɛ nɛ ji osɔfo ɔmɛ a dɛ e hii. 19Womi nɛ ɔ nɛ hi matsɛ ɔ kasa nya. E kane be tsuaa be e wami be tsuo, konɛ e ye Yawɛ gbeye, nɛ e ye mlaa amɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ nɛ a ngma ngɛ womi ɔ mi ɔ a nɔ. 20Enɛ ɔ ma ha nɛ e be susue kaa e hi pe e nyɛmimɛ Israel fɔfɔɛ ɔmɛ; nɛ e maa ye Yawɛ mlaa amɛ a nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ. Lɔ ɔ loko e matsɛ yemi ɔ se maa kɛ, nɛ e bimɛ, kɛ e nina maa ye Israel nɔ be babauu.

Title: MOSE V, 18
Content:
Osɔfo ɔmɛ a blɔ nya ní
1“Osɔfo ɔmɛ a weku, nɛ ji Levi weku ɔ, a ko ná zugba nɛ a dla kɛ ha Israel ma a eko. Mɛɛ lɛɛ nɔ́ nɛ a kɛ maa lɛ a he ji nike níhi, kɛ bɔhi nɛ a sãã ha Yawɛ ɔ. 2 A be zugba nae kaa a weto ní kaa bɔ nɛ wɛtso kpa amɛ na a; a blɔ nya ji kaa a pee Yawɛ we osɔfohi kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ wo si ɔ.
3“Be tsuaa be nɛ a maa gbe na, loo to kɛ sã bɔ ɔ, a je lohwe ɔ gugue, e tsitsa, kɛ e mi mi kotoku ɔ kɛ ha osɔfo ɔmɛ. 4Jehanɛ hu, ke ní nɛ ɔmɛ bɔni bami ɔ, kekleekle ní ɔmɛ maa pee osɔfo ɔmɛ a nɔ́: blɛfo, wai, oliv nu, kɛ to he bwɔmi. 5Levi bi ɔmɛ a wɛtso ɔ lɛ Yawɛ hla ngɛ wɛtso ɔmɛ tsuo a mi nɛ a sɔmɔ lɛ daa kaa osɔfohi.
6“Levi no saisaa ma nyɛ maa je Israel ma amɛ eko fɛɛ eko mi kɛ ba he kake ɔ nɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ to nɛ a ja lɛ ngɛ ɔ. 7E ma nyɛ ma ba ja nɛ e sɔmɔ Yawɛ, e Mawu ɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ kaa bɔ nɛ Levi bi kpa amɛ nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ peeɔ ɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ. 8E kɛ osɔfo kpa amɛ nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ nɛ a na niye ní blɔ nya sɔsɔɛ; se nɔ́ nɛ e weku li maa mane lɛ ɔ lɛɛ e pee lɛ nɔ kake e nɔ́.
Wɔ jami kusumi he kɔkɔ bɔmi
9“Ke o ya su zugba a nɛ Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ ngɛ mo hae ɔ nɔ ɔ, mo ko pee je ma amɛ nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ a ní hiɔmi ní ɔmɛ. 10 Mo ko sã o bimɛ ngɛ o bɔ sami la tɛ nɔ; jehanɛ hu, nyɛ ti nɔ ko kó klaa, e ko pee nyakpɛ ní, e ko nu wɔ, e ko tsu kunya, 11 e ko fi kablɛ, e ko tsɛ kpade, nɛ e ko bi ní hulɔ. 12Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ sume nihi nɛ tsuɔ níhi nɛ a hiɔ nɛ ɔ; lɔ ɔ he nɛ e ngɛ je ma amɛ fiee kɛ je zugba a nɔ ngɛ o blɔ nɔ ɔ nɛ. 13 Moo ye Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ anɔkuale kɛ pi si.”
A wo si kaa gbalɔ ko maa ba
14Jehanɛ, Mose de ke, “Je ma amɛ nɛ o yaa ngɔ a zugba a buɔ nihi nɛ klaa, kɛ kunya tsuli tue; nyɛɛ lɛɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ kplɛɛ we nɛ nyɛɛ pee ja. 15 Se mohu, Yawɛ nyɛ Mawu ɔ ma je gbalɔ ko nɛ ngɛ kaa imi kɛ je nyɛ nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ a kpɛti ha nyɛ, nɛ lɛ tue nyɛɛ bu.
16“Ligbi ɔ nɛ nyɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ nyɛ bua nyɛ he nya ngɛ Sinai yo ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ kpa pɛɛ ke ma ko ha nɛ nyɛɛ nu Yawɛ munyu nɛ e ngɛ tue ɔ hu, loo nɛ nyɛɛ na bɔ nɛ e je e he kpo ngɛ la hleei ɔ mi ɔ; ejakaa nyɛ ye gbeye kaa nyɛ ma gbo. 17Lejɛ ɔ nɛ Yawɛ de mi ke, ‘Nɔ́ nɛ a bi ɔ da saminya. 18Ma je gbalɔ ko nɛ ngɛ kaa mo kɛ je mɛ nitsɛmɛ a kpɛti; ma tsɔɔ lɛ nɔ́ nɛ e de, nɛ lɛɛ e ma de ma a nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ i fa lɛ ɔ. 19 E maa tu munyu ngɛ ye biɛ mi, nɛ ke nɔ ko bui lɛ ɔ, imi nitsɛ ma gbla nɔ ɔ tue. 20Se ke gbalɔ ko te si nɛ e gba ngɛ ye biɛ mi, nɛ pi imi nɛ i fa lɛ ɔ, á gbe lɛ; á gbe gbalɔ saisaa nɛ gbaa ngɛ mawu kpahi a biɛ mi ɔ jã kɛ̃.’
21“O ma bi o he ke, ‘Kɛ ma pee kɛ le kaa gbalɔ ko sɛ gbi ji Yawɛ ngɔ kɛɛ?’ 22Ke gbalɔ ko gba ngɛ Yawɛ biɛ mi, nɛ nɔ́ nɛ e de ɔ bɛ mi ɔ, sɛ gbi ɔ ji Yawɛ ngɔ. Jamɛ a gbalɔ ɔ nitsɛ e nya mi munyu ji lɔ ɔ nɛ; koo ye lɛ gbeye.

Title: MOSE V, 19
Content:
Wesa he ma amɛ kɛ nɔ gbemi he sane
(Mose IV, 35.9-28; Yoshua 20.1-9)
1“Ke Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ kpata je ma amɛ a hɛ mi, nɛ e ngɔ a zugba a kɛ ha mo, nɛ o ba ye a nane mi ngɛ a ma amɛ, kɛ a we ɔmɛ a mi ɔ, 2-3moo dla zugba a mi etɛ, eko fɛɛ eko kɛ e mi ma ngua ko nɛ blɔ kpiti ngɛ kɛ yaa mi. Kɛkɛ ɔ, ke nyɛmi ko nine ya kpa ngɛ nɔ ko nɔ ɔ, e ma nyɛ maa tu fo kɛ ya sa we ngɛ eko mi. 4Ke nɔ ko gbe nɔ tlukaa nɛ pi e he nyɛlɔ ɔ, e ma nyɛ maa tu fo kɛ ya ma nɛ ɔmɛ eko mi nɛ e ya sa we. 5Waa ngɔ lɛ kaa nihi enyɔ ho pu mi ya nɛ a ya po tso. Benɛ nɔ kake ngɛ tso ɔ poe ɔ, e gbiɛ nɛ e wo nɔ ɔ dade ɔ hia kɛ je tso ɔ nya ya fia e nyɛmi ɔ, nɛ e gbo. Ke e ba mi ja a, nɔ ɔ nɛ tu fo kɛ ya ma nɛ ɔmɛ eko mi nɛ e ya sa we ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. 6Ke wesa he ma kake pɛ nɛ a to ɔ, eko ɔ, lejɛ ɔ maa kɛ tsɔ, nɛ lue yelɔ ɔ nine maa su nɔ ɔ nɔ; nɛ e kɛ mi mi la maa gbe nɔ ko nɛ pee we nɔ́ ko yaka gu. Nyumu nɛ ɔ, e nine nɛ ya kpa ngɛ e nyɛmi ɔ nɔ tlukaa, se pi kaa e to e yi mi kaa e maa pee lɛ yayami ko. 7Enɛ ɔ he je nɛ i fa mo ke o to wesa he ma etɛ ɔ nɛ.
8“Ke Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ ha nɛ o zugba a ba kle kaa bɔ nɛ e de o nɛmɛ ɔmɛ ke e maa pee ɔ, nɛ e ngɔ zugba a tsuo ngɔ ha mo ɔ, 9to wesa he ma etɛ kɛ piɛ kekle ní ɔmɛ a he. Niinɛ, ke o maa ye mlaa a tsuo nɛ i ngɛ mo woe mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ nɔ, nɛ o maa suɔ Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ, nɛ o maa ba o je mi ngɛ e tsɔɔmi ɔmɛ a nya a, e maa ngɔ zugba nɛ ɔ kɛ ha mo. 10Pee bɔ nɛ i ngɛ mo tsɔɔe nɛ ɔ, konɛ a ko pue nihi a muɔ si yaka, nɛ́ a ko bu mo fɔ kaa o tane nihi a yi yaka ngɛ zugba nɛ Yawɛ ngɔ kɛ ngɛ mo hae ɔ nɔ.
11“Se ke nɔ ko ngɛ e nyɛmi nyɛe, nɛ e ya wo lɛ ka, nɛ e fia lɛ nɔ nɛ e gbe, nɛ e tu fo kɛ ya sa we ngɛ wesa he ma nɛ ɔmɛ eko mi ɔ, 12lɔ ɔ lɛɛ e ma a mi nimeli ɔmɛ nɛ a tsɔ nɛ a ya ngɔ lɛ kɛ ba ha e nyɛmi lue yelɔ ɔ nɛ e gbe lɛ. 13Koo na lɛ mɔbɔ kulaa. Koo ngmɛ blɔ nɛ nɔ gbelɔ nɛ ɔ nɛ hi hɛ ngmengmle ngɛ Israel hu; kɛkɛ ɔ, níhi a mi maa hi ha mo.
Blema huzu ɔmɛ
14 “Koo hia o nyɛmi e huzu nɛ nimeli wo blema a kɛ je he nɛ e ngɛ ɔ, ngɛ zugba a nɛ Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ ngɔ ha mo ɔ nɔ.
Nɔ́ nɛ kɔɔ odase yeli a he
15 “Nɔ kake pɛ ko ye odase kɛ si nɔ ko nɛ pee yayami ko. Loko a maa bu nɔ ko fɔ ɔ, a nu odase yeli enyɔ, loo nihi nɛ hiɛ pe ja a nya mi munyu. 16Ke nɔ ko ya po nɔ ko nya yaka gu nɛ e kɛ puɛ nɔ ɔ, 17mɛ ni enyɔ ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ a ngɔ a sane ɔ kɛ ya he nɛ a jaa Mawu ngɛ ɔ, kɛ ya ha osɔfo ɔmɛ kɛ kojoli ɔmɛ nɛ a ngɛ ní tsue jamɛ a be ɔ. 18Kojoli ɔmɛ nɛ a hyɛ munyu ɔ mi fitsofitso. Ke a na kaa lakpa odase nɔ ɔ ba ye kɛ si e nyɛmi Israel fɔfɔɛ ɔ, 19a gbla e tue sisiisi kaa bɔ nɛ e susu kaa a ko pee e nyɛmi ɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ. Nyɛɛ pee jã kɛ je nɔ́ yayami nɛ ɔ kɛ je nyɛ kpɛti. 20Ha nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ nu sane ɔ, konɛ a ye gbeye, nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko kó pee yayami nɛ ɔ eko hu gblegbleegble. 21 Koo na mɔbɔ kulaa ngɛ kikɛmɛ a sanehi a mi; to nane mi pɛpɛɛpɛ. Tue gblami ɔ ji kaa ke nɔ ko gbe nɔ ko ɔ, a gbe lɛ kɛ to nya; ke nɔ ko pɛ́ nɔ ko hɛngmɛ, loo e ku e lungu, loo e po nɔ ɔ nine, loo e nane ɔ, a pee lɛ jã nɔuu kɛ to nane mi.

Title: MOSE V, 20
Content:
Níhi nɛ kɔɔ ta hwumi he
1“Ke o hia ta, nɛ o kɛ o he nyɛli yaa hwu, nɛ o na kaa he nyɛli ɔmɛ ngɛ zugba ta lɛhi, okpɔngɔhi, kɛ ta buli babauu pe mo ɔ, koo ye mɛ gbeye. Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ nɛ kpɔ mo kɛ je Egipt zugba a nɔ ɔ kɛ mo ngɛ. 2Loko o ma bɔni ta a hwumi ɔ, osɔfo nɛ ba da ma a hɛ mi, nɛ e de tabo ɔ ke, 3‘Nyɛɛ bu tue, Israel bi! Mwɔnɛ ɔ, nyɛ su ta nya. Nyɛ ko ye nyɛ he nyɛli ɔmɛ gbeye, nyɛ kã nɛ ko ta, nɛ nyɛ ko nu sawale. 4Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ nitsɛ kɛ nyɛ yaa, nɛ e ma ha nyɛ maa ye kunimi.’
5“Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, asafoatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a de ta buli ɔmɛ ke, ‘Anɛ nɔ ko ngɛ hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ nɛ po we he, se e gbaa we nɔ lolo kɛ ha Yawɛ lo? Ke nɔ ko kaa ja ngɛ hiɛ ɔ, e kpale kɛ ho we mi ya. Ke pi ja a, ke e ba mi kaa e ya nɔ ta a, nɔ kpa ma ba gbaa we ɔ nɔ. 6Anɛ nɔ ko ngɛ hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ nɛ pee wai ngmɔ he, se e na we nɛ e kpa wai yiblii ɔ lolo lo? Ke nɔ ko kaa ja ngɛ hiɛ ɔ, e kpale kɛ ho we mi ya. Ke pi ja a, ke e ba mi kaa e ya nɔ ta a, nɔ kpa ma ba ye ngmɔ ɔ mi wai yiblii ɔ. 7Anɛ nɔ ko ngɛ hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ nɛ ya bi yo si, se e na we nɛ ngɔ lɛ lolo lo? Ke nɔ ko kaa ja ngɛ hiɛ ɔ, e kpale kɛ ho we mi ya. Ke pi ja a, ke e ba mi kaa e ya nɔ ta a, nɔ kpa maa ngɔ yo nɛ e ya bi si ɔ.’
8“Jehanɛ asafoatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a de ta buli ɔmɛ ke, ‘Anɛ nɔ ko ngɛ hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ nɛ sawale nu lɛ, nɛ e ngɛ gbeye yee lo? Ke nɔ ko kaa ja ngɛ hiɛ ɔ, e kpale kɛ ho we mi ya. Ke pi ja a, e ma ha fɔ̃ maa sɛ e nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ a mi.’ 9Ke asafoatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ tu munyu nɛ ɔmɛ gbe nya a, á to tatsɛmɛ nɛ maa da kuu tsuaa kuu nya.
10“Ke o yaa tua ma ko ɔ, moo ngmɛ jamɛ a ma a mi bi ɔmɛ blɔ nɛ a ha yi. 11Ke ni ɔmɛ bli ma agbo ɔmɛ, nɛ a ha yi ɔ, mɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ a ma ba pee o nyɔguɛhi nɛ o maa nyɛ a nɔ nɛ a ma tsu ní kpakpataa ha mo. 12Ke jamɛ a ma a mi bi ɔmɛ sume nɛ a ha yi, se a suɔ ta mohu ɔ, ha nɛ o tabo ɔ nɛ sa a yi. 13Kɛkɛ ɔ, Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ ma ha o maa ngɔ ma a, nɛ o maa gbe nyumu tsuaa nyumu nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. 14Yi ɔmɛ, jokuɛwi ɔmɛ, we mi lohwe ɔmɛ, kɛ níhi tsuo nɛ ngɛ ma a mi ɔ, o ma nyɛ maa ngɔ kɛ pee o nɔ. O he nyɛli ɔmɛ a tabo ɔ mi ní ɔmɛ tsuo maa pee o nɔ́. Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ nɛ ngɔ ha mo. 15Ma amɛ nɛ a kɛ zugba a, he nɛ o yaa hi ɔ a kpɛti kɛ saminya a, jã ji bɔ nɛ o maa pee mɛ.
16“Se ke o ngɔ ma amɛ nɛ Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ ngɔ kɛ ngɛ mo hae ngɛ zugba a nɔ ɔ, gbee a mi nimli ɔmɛ tsuo. 17Mo kpata ni ɔmɛ tsuo a hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ fa mo ke o pee ɔ; mɛ ji Hit bi, Amor bi, Kanaan bi, Periz bi, Hiv bi, kɛ Yebus bi. 18Gbee mɛ, konɛ a ko ba tsɔɔ mo a musu ní ɔmɛ nɛ a peeɔ nɛ a kɛ jaa mawu kpahi ɔ, nɛ o kɛ enɛ ɔ ba pee yayami kɛ si Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ.
19“Ke o hɛ dɔ kɛ ngɛ ma ko tuae ɔ, koo poo tsohi nɛ woɔ yiblii nɛ a yeɔ nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ ngɔ pue he. Ke be nɛ o kɛ sá ma a yi kɛ kaa mɛni po, koo pee ja. Moo ye tso yiblii ɔmɛ, se o ko kpata tso ɔmɛ a hɛ mi. Tsa pi tso ɔmɛ ji o he nyɛli ɔmɛ nɛ o kɛ ná a. 20Se tsohi nɛ o le kaa a yi a yiblii ɔ, o ma nyɛ ma kɛ pee níhi nɛ a maa da nɔ kɛ sá ma a yi kɛ ya si be nɛ o maa ngɔ ma a.

Title: MOSE V, 21
Content:
Nɔ ko nɛ a gbe, se a nɛ́ e gbelɔ ɔ
1“Ke a na nɔ ko nɛ a gbe lɛ fɔ si ngɛ nga mi ngɛ zugba a nɛ Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ ma ngɔ ha mo ɔ nɔ, nɛ a li nɔ nɛ gbe lɛ ɔ, 2lɔ ɔ lɛɛ ma nimeli ɔmɛ, kɛ kojoli ɔmɛ nɛ a je kpo nɛ a ya susu kɛ je he nɛ a na nɔ gbogboe ɔ ngɛ ɔ, kɛ ya su ma amɛ nɛ bɔle lɛ ɔ a mi. 3Jehanɛ, ma nimeli ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ ma nɛ kɛ lejɛ ɔ kɛ we pe kulaa mi ɔ nɛ a hla na zangmayo nɛ a kɛ lɛ tsu we nɔ́ ko hyɛ. 4Nimeli ɔmɛ nɛ a kpaka lohwe ɔ kɛ ya kɔ̃ ko nya, he nɛ nyu bee ngɛ daa, he ko nɛ a hu we, nɛ a du we ní ngɛ hyɛ. Á ku lohwe ɔ kuɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. 5E hia kaa Levi bi ɔmɛ, nɛ ji osɔfo ɔmɛ hu nɛ a ya lejɛ ɔ; ejakaa mɛ lɛ a hyɛɛ mlaa sane tsuaa mlaa sane nɛ kɔɔ pɛ nɛ gbenɔ jeɔ mi ɔ mi, nɛ a buá he. Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ nitsɛ nɛ hla mɛ, nɛ́ a sɔmɔ lɛ, nɛ́ a ngɔ e biɛ kɛ gbaa. 6Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, ma nimeli ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ je ma nɛ kɛ he nɛ a na nɔ nɛ a gbe ɔ ngɛ ɔ kɛ we pe kulaa a nɛ á fɔ a dɛ kɛ pue na a nɔ, 7nɛ a de ke, ‘Pi wɔ nɛ wa gbe nyumu nɛ ɔ; wa li nɔ nɛ gbe lɛ. 8Yawɛ, wa kpa mo pɛɛ, moo na o ma, Israel nɛ o kpɔ kɛ je Egipt ɔ mɔbɔ. Moo na wɔ mɔbɔ; nɛ koo ngɔ nɔ nɛ a gbe yaka nɛ ɔ musu kɛ tloo wɔ.’ 9Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, moo pee kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ ngɛ hlae kaa o pee ɔ, nɛ a be gbenɔ nɛ ɔ he musu woe kɛ tloo mo.
Yihi nɛ a nuu ngɛ ta mi
10“Ke Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ ha o ye o he nyɛli ɔmɛ a nɔ ngɛ ta mi, nɛ o nuu nihi ɔ, 11eko ɔ, o maa na yo nɛ he ngɛ fɛu, nɛ o maa suɔ nɛ o ngɔ lɛ nɛ e pee o yo. 12Ke e ba mi ja a, mo kpaka lɛ kɛ ya o we mi, nɛ o ha nɛ e sɛ e yi bwɔmi, nɛ e je e nine nguɛ nya, 13nɛ é tsake e tade ɔmɛ ngɛ e he. É hi o we ɔ mi, nɛ é ye kɔmɔ nyɔhiɔ kake ha e fɔli. Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, o ma nyɛ maa ngɔ lɛ nɛ e pee o yo. 14Pee se, ke o sume lɛ hu ɔ, lɛɛ ha nɛ e ye e he kulaa. Akɛnɛ pi e suɔmi nya nɛ o ta e he ɔ, o be he blɔ nɛ o peeɔ lɛ kaa nyɔguɛ nɛ o juaa lɛ.
Bitɛte weto ní blɔ nya
15“Waa ngɔ lɛ kaa nyumu ko ngɛ yihi enyɔ, nɛ e suɔ nɔ kake saminya, se e sume nɔ kake sane tsɔ, nɛ e kɛ mɛ ni enyɔ ɔmɛ tsuo fɔ binyumuhi, se yo ɔ nɛ e sume lɛ tsɔ ɔ bi ji bi nɔkɔtɔma. 16Lɔ ɔ lɛɛ ke be su nɛ e maa dla weto ní ha e binyumu ɔmɛ ɔ, nyumu ɔ be he blɔ kaa e ngɔɔ yo nɛ e suɔ lɛ saminya a bi ɔ ngɔ peeɔ bi nɔkɔtɔma ngɛ yo nɛ e sume lɛ ɔ bi ɔ nane mi. 17E ha e bi nɔkɔtɔma ɔ nɔ́ nɛ e ma ha e bi kaketsɛ ɔ totoe enyɔ. Ejakaa bi nɔkɔtɔma nɛ ɔ ji nyumu ɔ kekleekle binyumu nɛ a fɔ ha lɛ.
Binyumu tue gbolɔ
18“Waa ngɔ lɛ kaa nyumu ko ngɛ binyumu atuã tsɔlɔ nɛ e tue wa, bi nɛ bui e fɔli, nɛ ke a gbla e tue po e bui.
19“Ke bi ko ngɛ kaa ja a, e fɔli ɔmɛ nɛ a ngɔ lɛ kɛ ya ha ma nimeli ɔmɛ ngɛ ma a mi he nɛ e ngɛ ɔ, nɛ a kojo lɛ. 20A de ma nimeli ɔmɛ ke, ‘Tue gbolɔ kɛ atuã tsɔlɔ ji wa bi nɛ ɔ; e bui wa gbi tue; ní puɛlɔ kɛ dã delɔ ji lɛ.’ 21Jehanɛ, ma a mi nyumu ɔmɛ nɛ a fiaa lɛ tɛ nɛ e gbo; kɛkɛ ɔ, o ma je yayami nɛ ɔ kɛ je nyɛ kpɛti. Nɔ tsuaa nɔ ngɛ Israel maa nu nɔ́ nɛ ba a, nɛ a maa ye gbeye.
Mlaa munomunohi
22“Ke a gbe nɔ ko nɛ pee yayami ko, nɛ a kɛ e gbogboe ɔ bɛle si ngɛ tso nɔ ɔ, 23 ko ha nɛ e hi tso ɔ nɔ nɛ je nɛ na yi. A pu lɛ jamɛ a ligbi ɔ kɛ̃; ejakaa nɔ gbogboe nɛ bɛle si ngɛ tso nɔ ɔ kɛ Mawu gbiɛmi baa zugba a nɔ. Moo pu gbogboe ɔ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ o ko ble zugba a nɛ Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ ngɛ mo hae ɔ.

Title: MOSE V, 22
Content:
1 “Ke o na o nyɛmi Israel fɔfɔɛ e na, loo to nɛ laa blɔ ɔ, koo be e he, se mohu mo kpaka lɛ kɛ ya ha o nyɛmi ɔ. 2Ke o kɛ o nyɛmi ɔ he kɛ, loo o li lohwetsɛ ɔ, lɛɛ mo kpaka lɛ kɛ ya mo nitsɛ o we mi. Ke nɔtsɛ ɔ ba bi si ɔ, ngɔɔ e ní kɛ ha lɛ. 3Jã kɛ̃ o pee, ke o na o nyɛmi Israel fɔfɔɛ e teji, loo e tade, loo e nɔ́ kpa ko nɛ laa a.
4“Ke o na o nyɛmi Israel no teji, loo na nɛ nɔ si ɔ, koo je e he, se mohu wa o nyɛmi ɔ, konɛ lohwe ɔ nɛ te nɛ e da e nane nɔ ekohu.
5“Yo kó wo nyumu tade, nɛ nyumu hu kó wo yo tade; Yawɛ o Mawu ɔ sume nihi nɛ peeɔ jamɛ a níhi.
6“Ke o na lohwe pɛlitsɛ tsu ngɛ tso nɔ, loo ngɛ zugba, nɛ lohwe nyɛ ɔ buu si ngɛ e hlui ɔmɛ, aloo e bi ɔmɛ a nɔ ɔ, koo nu lohwe nyɛ ɔ. 7Moo nu bi ɔmɛ, nɛ o ngmɛɛ a nyɛ ɔ he, konɛ níhi a mi nɛ hi ha mo, nɛ o wami se nɛ kɛ, nɛ o plɔke.
8“Ke o po we he ɔ, moo hyɛ nɛ o wo o tsu yi bumi ɔ he aklabatsa kɛ bɔle lɛ kɛ kpe. Ke o pee ja a, lɛɛ ke nɔ ko sane kɛ je tsu ɔ yi mi kɛ ba nɔ si nɛ e gbo ɔ, tɔmi ɔ ji mo.
9 “Ko du nɔ́ kpa ko ngɛ ngmɔ mi he nɛ o du wai ngɛ ɔ; ke o pee ja a, o be he blɔ kaa o yeɔ wai yiblii ɔ, loo nɔ́ kpa a nɛ o du ɔ.
10“Ko bla na kɛ teji kɛ wo kuɛpã kake he kɛ hu.
11“Koo wo tade nɛ a bla to he bwɔmi, kɛ doti kɛ lo.
12 “Moo kpɛ deke kɛ wo bo nɛ o haa a nya eywiɛ ɔmɛ tsuo.
Nyumu kɛ yo bɔmi nɛ he tsɔ we he mlaahi
13“Waa ngɔ lɛ kaa nyumu ko ya ngɔ yiheyo ko, nɛ benɛ e kɛ lɛ ya hwɔ ɔ, e sume lɛ hu. 14Enɛ ɔ he ɔ, e po sanehi nɛ be mi kɛ fɔ yiheyo ɔ nɔ ke pi yomiyo ji lɛ, ejakaa e nɛ lɛ ngɛ we benɛ e kɛ lɛ ya hwɔ ɔ.
15“Ke nɔ́ ko kaa ja ba mi ɔ, yiheyo ɔ fɔli nɛ a ngɔ sa nɔ bo hiɔ kɛ e mi muɔ nɛ ayɛflo ɔ kɛ e huno ɔ hwɔ nɔ kpeemi ligbi ɔ kɛ ya tsɔɔ ma nimeli ɔmɛ ngɛ kojomi he ɔ. Enɛ ɔ a kɛ maa na anɔkuale ɔ, kaa niinɛ yomiyo ji a bi ɔ nɛ. 16Yiheyo ɔ tsɛ ma de nimeli ɔmɛ ke, ‘Nyumu nɛ ɔ ba bi ye biyo si, nɛ e kɛ lɛ sɛ gba si himi mi; se jehanɛ e sume lɛ hu, 17lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e po he guɛ gbemi munyu kɛ fɔ e nɔ ke biyo ɔ pi yomiyo benɛ e ngɔ lɛ ɔ. Se okadi nɛ tsɔɔ kaa ye biyo ɔ yomiyo ji lɛ ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.’ Bitsɛ ɔ nɛ bli sa nɔ bo ɔ mi kɛ tsɔɔ ma nimeli ɔmɛ. 18Kɛkɛ ɔ, ma nimeli ɔmɛ nɛ a nu yiheyo ɔ huno ɔ, nɛ a fiaa lɛ kpa. 19A ma he lɛ sika hiɔ yi lafa, aloo susumi nɔ́ nɛ a tsɛɛ kilo ɔ kake kɛ piɛ he kɛ ha yiheyo ɔ tsɛ ɔ; ejakaa nyumu ɔ wo Israel yomiyo he ní. Jehanɛ hu a ha nɛ e ngɔ yo ɔ; e be he blɔ kaa e fieɔ lɛ kɛ yaa si e ma gbo.
20“Se ke sane ɔ ngɛ mi niinɛ, nɛ okadi nɔ́ ko be nɛ tsɔɔ kaa e huno ɔ na lɛ ngɛ we ɔ, 21lɛɛ a kɛ yiheyo ɔ nɛ ba e tsɛ we ɔ agbo ɔ nya, nɛ́ e ma a mi nyumu ɔmɛ nɛ a fiaa lɛ tɛ nɛ e gbo. E tsu zo ní ngɛ wa ma mi bi ɔmɛ a kpɛti, kaa e le nyumu be mi nɛ e ngɛ e tsɛ we mi loko a ba ngɔ lɛ. Pee jã kɛ je yayami nɛ ɔ kɛ je nyɛ kpɛti.
22“Ke a nu nyumu ko nɛ e kɛ nɔ kpa e yo ngɛ hwɔe ɔ, á gbe mɛ ni enyɔ ɔmɛ tsuo. Pee jã kɛ je yayami nɛ ɔ kɛ je nyɛ kpɛti.
23“Waa ngɔ lɛ kaa a nu nyumu ko nɛ e kɛ yiheyo nɛ a bi e si ha nɔ ko ya na bɔmi ngɛ ma a mi. 24A kɛ mɛ ni enyɔ ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ je ma a mi, nɛ a ya fiaa mɛ tɛ nɛ a gbo. A gbe yiheyo ɔ, ejakaa ma a mi he nɛ a tsu zo ní nɛ ɔ ngɛ ɔ, kaa e kpa ngmlaa jinɛ ni komɛ maa nu, nɛ a ma ba je ngmlaa ha lɛ. Nyumu ɔ hu, á gbe lɛ, ejakaa e kɛ yiheyo nɛ nɔ ko bi e si ya na bɔmi. Pee jã kɛ je yayami nɛ ɔ kɛ je nyɛ kpɛti.
25“Se ke nga mi nɛ nyumu ko ya nu yiheyo ko nɛ a bi e si ngɛ, nɛ e kɛ lɛ na bɔmi ɔ, lɔ ɔ lɛɛ á gbe nyumu ɔ pɛ, 26a ko pee yiheyo ɔ nɔ́ ko, ejakaa e pee we nɔ́ ko nɛ sa gbenɔ. Munyu nɛ ɔ ngɛ kaa bɔ nɛ nɔ ko woɔ nɔ ká nɛ e ya gbee lɛ ɔ pɛ. 27Nyumu ɔ ya nu yiheyo nɛ a bi e si ɔ ngɛ nga mi, nɛ eko ɔ e kpa ngmlaa lɛɛ, se nɔ ko be nɛ ma ba je ngmlaa ha lɛ.
28 “Ke nyumu ko na yomiyo nɛ a bi we e si, nɛ e nu lɛ kã nya nɛ e kɛ lɛ na bɔmi, nɛ a nu mɛ ɔ, 29nyumu ɔ nɛ wo yomiyo ɔ tsɛ ɔ sika hiɔ yi nyingmi enuɔ nɛ ji yo se ní ɔ; nɛ a ha nɛ e ngɔ yo ɔ, ejakaa e puɛ lɛ. E ko ngmɛɛ yo ɔ he kɛ yaa si e ma gbo.
30 “Nɔ ko kó pue e tsɛ hɛ mi si kaa e kɛ e tsɛ ɔ yo ma na bɔmi.

Title: MOSE V, 23
Content:
Nihi nɛ a ko futu Yawɛ ma a
1“Nyumu nɛ a ta lɛ, loo e sungmɛ ywia, loo a po e nyumu tso ngɛ e he ɔ, e ko futu Yawɛ ma a mi bi ɔmɛ a kpe mi.
2“Ke nyumu kɛ yo tsu we gba si himi kusumi, nɛ a fɔ bi ɔ, bi nɛ ɔ be he blɔ nɛ e futuu Yawɛ ma a mi bi ɔmɛ a kpe mi kɔkɔɔkɔ. Yi nɔhi nɛ maa ba ngɛ e se kɛ yaa si nyɔngmane ɔ po be he blɔ.
3 “Amon no, loo Moab no kó futu Yawɛ ma mi bi ɔmɛ a kpe mi kɔkɔɔkɔ. Yi nɔhi nɛ maa ba ngɛ a se kɛ yaa si nyɔngmane ɔ po be he blɔ. 4 Benɛ o je Egipt kɛ ma a, mɛ nɛ a kua mo niye ní kɛ nyu hami ɔ nɛ. Lɔ ɔ se hu, a ya bɔ Beor bi, Balaam nɛ je Petor ma a mi ngɛ Mesopotamia a apaa ke e ba gbiɛ mo. 5 Se akɛnɛ Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ suɔ mo he je ɔ, e bui Balaam tue; mohu e plɛ gbiɛmi ɔ kɛ pee gbaami ha mo. 6Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ligbi abɔ nɛ o ngɛ je mi nɛ ɔ, koo piɛ a he kɛ tsu nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko nɛ ma ha nɛ a ma na a he, loo a ma plɔke.
7“Koo hie Edom no; ejakaa o nyɛmi ji lɛ. Koo hie Egipt no; ejakaa o ya hi e zugba a nɔ hyɛ. 8Bimɛ nɛ a ma fɔ ha mɛ, kɛ je yi nɔ nɛ ji etɛ ɔ kɛ yaa a, mɛɛ lɛɛ a ma nyɛ ma futu Yawɛ ma mi bi ɔmɛ.
Ta nga nɔ he tsɔmi
9“Ke o hia ta nɛ o kɛ o he nyɛli yaa kpe ɔ, moo hyɛ saminya nɛ o ko pee nɔ́ ko nɛ ma ble mo. 10Ke nyumu ko ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti nɛ e he nyu be ngɛ e he nyɔ mi ngɛ e sa mi, nɛ lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e he tsɔ we ɔ, é ya ta sito he ɔ se, nɛ e hi lejɛ ɔ. 11Kɛ yaa gbɔkuɛ nya si ɔ, e du e he; nɛ ke pu nɔ si ɔ, e kpale kɛ ba ta sito he ɔ.
12“Tó he ko ngɛ ta sito he ɔ se, nɛ e pee he nɛ o maa ya nane nɔ ngɛ. 13Moo hɛɛ tso kɛ piɛ o ta hwumi ní ɔmɛ a he, konɛ ke o mi mi sá mo ɔ, o kɛ tso ɔ nɛ tsua si, nɛ o kɛ tso ɔ kɛ̃ nɛ tsi muɔ ɔ. 14Ha nɛ o ta sito he ɔ nɛ pee klɔuklɔu; ejakaa Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ kɛ mo ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, konɛ e baa o yi, nɛ o ye o he nyɛli ɔmɛ a nɔ kunimi. Koo pee afa nɔ́ ko nɛ ma ha nɛ Yawɛ maa je o he.
Mlaa munomunohi
15“Ke nyɔguɛ ko kú kɛ je e nyɔmtsɛ ngɔ, nɛ e ba po mo ɔ, koo kpale lɛ kɛ ya ha e nyɔmtsɛ ɔ. 16É hi o ngɔ ngɛ ma amɛ eko nɛ e suɔ mi kɛkɛ; koo wa lɛ yi mi.
17 “Ke nyɛ ngɛ Mawu jae ɔ, Israel no ko kó pee e he yaholɔ; nyumu jio, yo jio. 18Jehanɛ hu, hiɔ nɛ a woɔ yaholɔ, loo nyumu nɛ e kɛ e nyɛmi nyumu hwɔɔ ɔ, a ko ngɔ kɛ ba Yawɛ hɛ mi kaa siwo nɔ yemi bɔ. Yawɛ hiee nihi nɛ tsuɔ ní nɛ ɔmɛ.
19 “Ke o pa sika, loo niye ní, loo nɔ́ kpa ko ngɔ ha o nyɛmi Israel fɔfɔɛ ɔ, ko he lɛ hekpa. 20Se ke o pa nɔ́ ko ha nɔ nɛ pi Israel no ji lɛ ɔ, o ma nyɛ ma he lɛ hekpa. Ke o ye mlaa nɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ, Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ maa gbaa nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ o ma tsu ngɛ zugba a nɛ o yaa ngɔ ɔ nɔ ha mo.
21 “Ke o wo Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ si ɔ, ye nɔ; koo to tsle. Yawɛ hyɛɛ blɔ kaa o ye o siwo ɔ nɔ; nɛ ke o pee we ja a, e ji tɔmi. 22Ke o wui Yawɛ si kulaa a, e pi tɔmi. 23Se ke o je mo nitsɛ o tsui mi nɛ o wo si ɔ, ye nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
24“Ke o ya sɛ o nyɛmi wai ngmɔ mi ɔ, o ma nyɛ maa ye wai yiblii ɔ bɔ nɛ o suɔ nɛ o tɔ; se koo ngɔ eko kɛ wo o níhi a mi kɛ je. 25Ke o ya sɛ o nyɛmi ngma ngmɔ mi ɔ, o ma nyɛ maa ku eko nɛ o kpe; se koo dɔ ngma kpami ha ngɔ fɔ o nyɛmi ɔ ngma a nɔ.

Title: MOSE V, 24
Content:
Gba mi pomi, kɛ gba mi sɛmi ekohu
1 “Waa ngɔ lɛ kaa nyumu ko ngɔ yo, nɛ pee se ɔ, e sume lɛ hu; ejakaa e na nɔ́ yayami ko ngɛ yo ɔ he. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e ngma gba mi pomi womi nɛ e ngɔ wo e dɛ; nɛ e ha e je e we ɔ mi. 2Jehanɛ, waa ngɔ lɛ ekohu kaa yo ɔ ya gba nyumu kpa, 3nɛ nyumu nɛ ɔ hu sume lɛ, nɛ e ngma gba mi pomi womi nɛ e ngɔ wo e dɛ, nɛ e ha e je e we ɔ mi. Aloo waa ngɔ lɛ kaa nyumu nɛ e ya gba sekpɛ nɛ ɔ gbo. 4Ke e ba mi ja a, nyumu nɛ e kɛ hi si kekleekle ɔ ko kpale ngɔ lɛ kɔkɔɔkɔ; ejakaa yo ɔ ble e he. Yawɛ hiɔ kaa e maa kpale ngɔ lɛ ekohu. Ko tsu musu ní kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ ngɛ zugba nɛ Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ ngɔ kɛ ngɛ mo hae ɔ nɔ.
Mlaa munomunohi
5“Ke nyumu ko kpee yo he ɔ, a ko ha nɛ nyumu ɔ nɛ ya ta, nɛ a ko ha lɛ ma ní tsumi ko hu nɛ e tsu. A ha nɛ e hi si gu jeha kake, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ e hi we mi, nɛ e kɛ e yo ɔ tsuo a bua nɛ jɔ a he.
6“Ke o pa nɔ́ ko ha nɔ ko ɔ, koo ngɔ e wɛ, kɛ e wɛ mi bi nɛ e kɛ gblɛɔ blɛfo ɔ kɛ to awaba. Ke o pee ja a, níhi nɛ e kɛ ma na e nya mi ngma nɛ o kpɔ ngɛ e dɛ ɔ nɛ.
7 “Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa ju e nyɛmi Israel no, nɛ e maa pee lɛ nyɔguɛ, aloo e maa jua lɛ ɔ, á gbe lɛ. Bɔ nɛ o maa pee kɛ je yayami nɛ ɔ kɛ je nyɛ kpɛti ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
8 “Ke o ngɛ he womi nɔ hiɔ yaya ko nue ɔ, hyɛ nɛ o pee bɔ nɛ Levi bi ɔmɛ nɛ ji osɔfo ɔmɛ ma de mo ke o pee ɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ kaa bɔ nɛ i fa mo ɔ. 9 Kai nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ pee Miriam ngɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ, benɛ nyɛ je Egipt kɛ ma a.
10 “Ke o pa nɔ́ ko ha nɔ ko ɔ, koo nyɛɛ e se kɛ ya e we mi ke e ha mo e bo nɛ e ma kɛ to awaba ha mo ɔ. 11Dá si ngɛ e we ɔ se, nɛ lɛ nitsɛ e ngɔ kɛ ba ha mo. 12Ke ohiatsɛ ji nɔ ɔ, lɛɛ nɔ́ nɛ e kɛ ba to awaba a, je ko jɔ yi ngɛ o ngɔ. 13Daa gbɔkuɛ ɔ, kpale kɛ ha lɛ, konɛ e kɛ hwɔ si. Kɛkɛ ɔ, e maa na mo si, nɛ Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ bua maa jɔ o he.
14 “Koo sisi apaatsɛ ohiatsɛ nɛ e fi lɛ ɔ, o nyɛmi Israel no jio, nubwɔ nɛ ngɛ o ma amɛ eko mi jio. 15Daa ligbi, loko pu maa nɔ si ɔ, wo lɛ nɔ́ nɛ e tsu jamɛ a ligbi ɔ he hiɔ. Sika a he ngɛ lɛ hiae, nɛ e ngɔ e hɛ ngɔ fɔ nɔ. Ke o wui lɛ hiɔ ɔ, nɛ e fa kue ha Yawɛ ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ o pee nɛ ɔ he ɔ, a maa bu mo fɔ kaa o pee yayami.
16 “A ko gbe fɔli ngɛ a bimɛ a tɔmihi a he; nɛ á ko gbe bimɛ hu ngɛ a fɔli a tɔmihi a he. A gbe nɔ ngɛ lɛ nitsɛ e tɔmi he pɛ.
17 “Ko plɛ nubwɔ nɛ ba ngɛ o ma a mi, kɛ awusa a sane hɛ mi kɛ bu si; nɛ ko he yalɔyo he ha nɔ́ kaa awaba tomi nɔ́. 18Mo kai kaa o ye nyɔguɛ ngɛ Egipt, nɛ Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ ha o ye o he, lɔ ɔ he nɛ i ngɛ mo mlaa nɛ ɔ woe ɔ nɛ.
19 “Ke o bua o ngmɔ niba ní nya, nɛ e piɛ blɛfo nɛ o kpɔ pue si ɔ eko nɛ o ngɔɛ kɛ bɛ we mi ɔ, koo kpale ya kukuɔ; mo si ha nibwɔhi, awusahi, kɛ yalɔyihi, konɛ Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ nɛ gbaa nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ o ngɛ tsue nɔ ha mo. 20Ke o ya kplɔ o we oliv tso ɔmɛ a yiblii ɔ, koo kpale o se kɛ ya tso kɔni ɔmɛ nɛ o kpa ni ngɛ a nɔ mo ɔ a he ekohu. Ha nɛ nɔ nɛ piɛ ngɛ nɔ ɔ nɛ hi si ha nibwɔhi, awusahi, kɛ yalɔyihi. 21Ke o bua o wai yiblii ɔmɛ a nya si kake ɔ, koo kpale o se nɛ o ya bua nya si enyɔne ngɛ he kake ɔ kɛ̃; si wai yiblii nɛ piɛ ɔ ha nibwɔhi, awusahi, kɛ yalɔyihi. 22O hɛ ko je nɔ gblegbleegble kaa o ye nyɔguɛ ngɛ Egipt, lɔ ɔ he nɛ i wo mo mlaa nɛ ɔ nɛ.

Title: MOSE V, 25
Content:
1“Waa ngɔ lɛ kaa Israel bi enyɔ ngɛ pɛe, nɛ a ba kojomi he ɔ, konɛ a hyɛ a sane ɔ mi ha mɛ. Nɔ nɛ nɔ́ dɛ ɔ, á bu lɛ fɔ; nɔ nɛ nɔ́ da a, á wo lɛ nguɔ. 2Ke nɔ nɛ ye fɔ ɔ sa kpa a, kojolɔ ɔ nɛ hyɛ nɛ a bu lɛ si, nɛ á fia lɛ kpa. Kpa abɔ nɛ a maa fia lɛ ɔ maa je bɔ nɛ e tɔmi ɔ kle ha. 3 A ko fia nɔ kpa nɛ pe si nyingmi eywiɛ; ke e pe ja a, lɛɛ o pue o nyɛmi ɔ hɛ mi si ngɛ ma hɛ mi.
4 “Na nɛ ngɛ ngma gblɛe ha mo ɔ, koo fi e nya.
Nyɛminyumu nɛ gbo e yalɔyo ngɔmi
5 “Ke nyɛminyumuhi enyɔ hi si, nɛ a ti nɔ kake gbo nɛ e be bi nyumu ɔ, nɔ nɛ gbo ɔ yo ɔ ko ya gba nɔ ko ngɛ weku kpa mi; e ji e huno ɔ nyɛminyumu ɔ blɔ nya kaa e ngɔ lɛ. 6Kekleekle binyumu nɛ e ma fɔ ɔ, é ye nyɛminyumu nɛ gbo ɔ nane mi, konɛ e biɛ ko laa ngɛ Israel. 7 Se ke nyumu ɔ sume kaa e maa ngɔ e nyɛminyumu ɔ yalɔyo ɔ, lɛɛ yo ɔ nɛ e ya ma agbo ɔ nya, nɛ ya de ma nimeli ɔmɛ ke, ‘Ye huno ɔ nyɛminyumu ɔ kplɛɛ we kaa e ma tsu e blɔ nya ní: e sume kaa e ma ha e nyɛminyumu ɔ ma na ngmɛdu ngɛ Israel.’ 8Ke e ba mi ja a, ma nimeli ɔmɛ nɛ a tsɛ nyumu ɔ, nɛ á tu munyu kɛ tsɔɔ lɛ. Ke e ma nɔ mi kaa e be yo ɔ ngɔe ɔ, 9lɛɛ e nyɛmi ɔ yalɔyo ɔ nɛ ya nyumu ɔ ngɔ ngɛ ma nimeli ɔmɛ a hɛ mi. A je nyumu ɔ tokota kake ngɛ e nane, nɛ e su lada kɛ pue nyumu ɔ hɛ mi, nɛ é de ke, ‘Bɔ nɛ a peeɔ nɔ nɛ sume nɛ e wo nina ha e nyɛminyumu ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.’ 10Biɛ nɛ a ma kɛ tsɛ nyumu nɛ ɔ weku ngɛ Israel ji, ‘Nɔ nɛ a je e tokota ngɛ e nane ɔ weku.’
Mlaa kpahi
11“Ke nyumuhi enyɔ ngɛ kunɔ nɔe, nɛ nɔ kake e yo ba piɛ e huno ɔ he, nɛ e nu nɔ kpa a nyumu tso kɛ e sungmɛ ɔ, 12poo yo ɔ nine; koo na lɛ mɔbɔ kulaa.
13-14 “Ke o ngɛ nɔ́ jiimi ngmɛe, loo o ngɛ nɔ́ kami susue ɔ, koo sisi nɔ. 15O sɛni tɛhi, kɛ susumi kpa tsuo nɛ su pɛpɛɛpɛ, konɛ o se nɛ kɛ ngɛ zugba a nɛ Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ ngɛ mo hae ɔ nɔ. 16Ejakaa Yawɛ sume nihi nɛ sisiɔ nɔ.
A fa ke á gbe Amalek bi ɔmɛ
17 “Mo kai nɔ́ nɛ Amalek bi ɔmɛ pee mo ngɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ, benɛ o je Egipt kɛ ma a. 18Akɛnɛ a yi Mawu gbeye he je ɔ, a tua o se ta a, benɛ pɔ tɔ ta buli ɔmɛ, nɛ peepee ta a he ɔ; nɛ a gbe ni nɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ didaae ngɛ se ɔ tsuo. 19Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ ngɔ zugba a ngɔ ha mo, nɛ e je mo kɛ je o he nyɛli tsuo nɛ bɔle mo kɛ kpe ɔ a dɛ mi ɔ, hyɛ nɛ o gbe Amalek bi ɔmɛ tsuo, konɛ nɔ ko kó kai mɛ hu. O hɛ ko je nɔ kɔkɔɔkɔ!

Title: MOSE V, 26
Content:
Ngmakpami be bɔ sami
1“Ke e ba mi kaa o ya su zugba nɛ Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ ngɔ ha mo ɔ nɔ, nɛ e pee o nɔ́ nɛ o ngɛ nɔ ɔ, 2 nyɛ ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ngɔ kekleekle niba ní nɛ e kpa ngɛ zugba a nɔ ɔ eko kɛ wo kusii mi, nɛ é ngɔ kɛ ya he nɛ Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ to nɛ a ja lɛ ngɛ ɔ. 3Ngɔɔ kɛ ya osɔfo nɛ ngɛ sɔmɔe jamɛ a be ɔ ngɔ, nɛ o de lɛ ke, ‘Mwɔnɛ ɔ, i ngɛ odase yee ngɛ Yawɛ, ye Mawu ɔ hɛ mi kaa i ba su zugba a nɛ Yawɛ wo wa nɛmɛ si ke e kɛ ma ha wɔ ɔ nɔ.’
4“Jehanɛ, osɔfo ɔ nɛ he kusii ɔ ngɛ o dɛ kɛ ma Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ hɛ mi. 5Mo de ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi ke, ‘Aram no si kpalɔ ji ye nɛ̃. E kɛ nihi bɔɔ pɛ nɛ ho Egipt ya; e ya to nubwɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, se a ba pee ma agbo nɛ he wa saminya. 6Egipt bi ɔmɛ pee wɔ yayami; a wa wɔ yi mi, nɛ a ye wɔ nyɔguɛ wawɛɛ. 7Kɛkɛ nɛ wa fa kue kɛ tsɛ Yawɛ, wa nɛmɛ a Mawu ɔ, nɛ e bu wa gbi tue. E na wa haomi kɛ dengme gbomi, kɛ yi mi nɛ a ngɛ wɔ wae ɔ. 8Yawɛ ngɔ e he wami kɛ kɔni si wami nɛ ngɛ gbeye kɛ je wɔ kɛ je Egipt. E pee okadihi, kɛ nyakpɛ níhi babauu. 9Jehanɛ, e kɛ wɔ ba su hiɛ ɔ, nɛ e ha wɔ zugba nɛ hi, nɛ baa ní saminya nɛ ɔ. 10Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i ngɔ zugba nɛ mo, Yawɛ ngɔ ha mi ɔ mi kekleekle niba ní ɔ eko kɛ ba.’
“Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, ngɔɔ kusii ɔ kɛ ma Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ hɛ mi, nɛ o ja Yawɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. 11Mo nya ngɛ ní kpakpahi nɛ Yawɛ ha o kɛ o we ɔ he. Ha nɛ Levi no, kɛ nubwɔ nɛ kɛ mo ngɛ ɔ nɛ a piɛ o he kɛ nya.
12 “Jeha etɛ tsuaa jeha etɛ ɔ, ngɔɔ o niba ní mi dlami nyɔngma mi kake kɛ ha Levi bi, nibwɔhi, awusahi, kɛ yalɔyihi, konɛ mɛ tsuo a na niye ní nɛ a ye nɛ a tɔ ngɛ ma a mi he tsuaa he nɛ a ngɛ ɔ. Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, 13de Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ ke, ‘I je ní klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ je ye we ɔ mi, nɛ i ngɔ ha Levi bi, nibwɔhi, awusahi, kɛ yalɔyihi ngɛ mlaa nɛ o wo mi ɔ nya; i tɔ̃ we ekoeko, nɛ ye hɛ ji eko nɔ hulɔ. 14Benɛ i ngɛ kɔmɔ yee ɔ, i yi mi dlami nyɔngma mi kake ɔ eko; benɛ ye he tsɔ we ɔ, i ngɔɛ eko kɛ ji ye we ɔ mi; jehanɛ hu, i kɛ eko sɛ̃ bɔ ha gbogboe ko. Niinɛ, Yawɛ, ye Mawu, i bu mo tue. Mlaahi tsuo nɛ o wo mi nɛ kɔɔ mi dlami nyɔngma mi kake ɔ he ɔ, i ye nɔ. 15Moo je o hi he klɔuklɔu ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ nɛ o hyɛ, nɛ o gbaa o ma Israel. Moo gbaa zugba nɛ hi, nɛ baa ní saminya, nɛ o ngɔ ha wɔ nɛ ɔ nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ o wo wa nɛmɛ ɔmɛ si ɔ.’
Yawɛ nitsɛ e ma
16“Mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ, Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ ngɛ mo fae ke o ye e mlaa amɛ tsuo a nɔ; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ye a nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ kɛ o tsui tsuo. 17Mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ, e je o nya mi nɛ o de ke Yawɛ ji o Mawu. O wo si kaa o maa bu lɛ tue; o wo si kaa o maa ye e mlaa amɛ tsuo a nɔ; nɛ o wo si hu kaa nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ e fa mo ke o pee ɔ, o maa pee. 18 Mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ, Yawɛ hu he mo atuu kaa lɛ nitsɛ e ma, kaa bɔ nɛ e wo si ɔ. E ngɛ mo fae ke o ye e mlaa amɛ tsuo a nɔ. 19E ma ha nɛ o pee ma ngua a pe ma amɛ tsuo. O ma je e yi, nɛ o maa wo e hɛ mi nyami. Nɛ o maa pee lɛ Yawɛ, o Mawu klɔuklɔu ɔ nitsɛ, e ma kaa bɔ nɛ e wo si ɔ.”

Title: MOSE V, 27
Content:
A ngma Mawu mlaa amɛ ngɛ tɛhi a nɔ
1Jehanɛ, Mose kɛ Israel ma a tu munyu, nɛ ma nimeli ɔmɛ tsuo fi e se. Mose de ma a ke, “Nyɛɛ bu níhi nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ dee mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ tue. 2 Ligbi ɔ nɛ nyɛ maa po Yordan pa a kɛ ya su zugba a nɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ kɛ ngɛ nyɛ hae ɔ nɔ ɔ, nyɛɛ ngɔ tɛ agboagbohi kɛ ma si, nɛ nyɛ kpa a he kalo. 3Ke nyɛ po pa a pɛ, nyɛɛ ngma mlaa nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ngɛ tɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ. Zugba nɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ nɛmɛ a Mawu ɔ wo si ke e ma ngɔ ha nyɛ ngɛ pa a se ɔ, zugba a hi, nɛ e baa ní saminya. 4Ke nyɛ su zugba nɛ ɔ nɔ ngɛ Yordan pa a se ɔ, nyɛɛ ngɔ tɛ nɛ ɔmɛ ngɔ ma si ngɛ Ebal yo ɔ nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ fae mwɔnɛ ɔ, nɛ nyɛ kpa a he kalo. 5 Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, nyɛɛ ngɔ tɛhi nɛ a kɛ dade kó we nɛ ma bɔ sami la tɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. 6Ke nyɛ maa ma bɔ sami la tɛ ko ha Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ, nyɛɛ ngɔ tɛhi nɛ a kɛ dade kó we nɛ ma. Nyɛɛ sã nyɛ sami bɔ ɔmɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. 7Jehanɛ hu, nyɛɛ sã nyɛ tue mi jɔmi bɔ ɔmɛ, nɛ nyɛ bla nyɛɛ ye ní. Nyɛɛ na Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ si ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. 8Nyɛɛ ngma mlaa nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ngɛ tɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a kɛ kalo kpa a he ɔ a nɔ; nɛ nyɛ ha nɛ ningma a nɛ je si paa.”
9Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, Mose kɛ osɔfo ɔmɛ nɛ ji Levi bi ɔmɛ tu munyu kɛ tsɔɔ Israel ma kpekpemi ɔ tsuo ke, “Nyɛɛ pee dii nɛ nyɛɛ bu mi tue. Israel bi, mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ, nyɛ pee Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ ma. 10Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ bu Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ gbi tue, nɛ nyɛɛ ye e mlaa amɛ tsuo nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ woe mwɔnɛ ɔ a nɔ.”
Tue gbomi kɛ e he gbiɛmi
11Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, Mose de Israel ma a ke, 12 “Ke nyɛ po Yordan pa a, wɛtso nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a da si ngɛ Gerizim yo ɔ nɔ benɛ a ngɛ ma a gbaae: Simeon, Levi, Yuda, Isakar, Yosef, kɛ Benyamin. 13Wɛtso nɛ ɔmɛ hu nɛ a da si ngɛ Ebal yo ɔ nɔ benɛ a ngɛ gbiɛmi munyu ɔmɛ dee: Ruben, Gad, Asher, Zebulun, Dan, kɛ Naftali. 14Levi bi ɔmɛ ma wo a gbi nɔ, nɛ a ma de Israel ma a tsuo ke,
15 “ ‘Mawu maa gbiɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ngɔɔ tɛ, loo tso, loo dade kɛ peeɔ amaga ko, nɛ e jaa lɛ ngɛ laami mi. Yawɛ hiɔ wɔ jami.’ Ma a tsuo ma he nɔ ke, ‘Amen!’
16 “ ‘Mawu maa gbiɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ pueɔ e tsɛ, loo e nyɛ hɛ mi si.’
“Ma a tsuo ma he nɔ ke, ‘Amen!’
17 “ ‘Mawu maa gbiɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ tsɛ̃ɛ̃ e nyɛmi buna kɛ yaa se.’
“Ma a tsuo ma he nɔ ke, ‘Amen!’
18 “ ‘Mawu maa gbiɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ tsɔɔ hɛ yuyuilɔ blɔ yayami.’
“Ma a tsuo ma he nɔ ke, ‘Amen!’
19 “ ‘Mawu maa gbiɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ plɛɔ nibwɔhi, awusahi, kɛ yalɔyihi a sane hɛ mi buɔ si.’
“Ma a tsuo ma he nɔ ke, ‘Amen!’
20 “ ‘Mawu maa gbiɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ e kɛ e tsɛ yo naa bɔmi nɛ e kɛ pueɔ e tsɛ ɔ hɛ mi si.’
“Ma a tsuo ma he nɔ ke, ‘Amen!’
21 “ ‘Mawu maa gbiɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ e kɛ lohwe naa bɔmi.’
“Ma a tsuo ma he nɔ ke, ‘Amen!’
22 “ ‘Mawu maa gbiɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ e kɛ e nyɛmiyo, e tsɛbiyo jio, e nyɛbiyo jio naa bɔmi.’
“Ma a tsuo ma he nɔ ke, ‘Amen!’
23 “ ‘Mawu maa gbiɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ e kɛ e nganyɛ naa bɔmi.’
“Ma a tsuo ma he nɔ ke, ‘Amen!’
24“ ‘Mawu maa gbiɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ gbee e nyɛmi ngɛ laami mi.’
“Ma a tsuo ma he nɔ ke, ‘Amen!’
25“ ‘Mawu maa gbiɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ heɔ nyɔ mi ní, nɛ e kɛ pueɔ nɔ ko nɛ pee we nɔ́ ko muɔ si.’
“Ma a tsuo ma he nɔ ke, ‘Amen!’
26 “ ‘Mawu maa gbiɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ bui Mawu mlaa nɛ ɔmɛ, nɛ e yi a nɔ hulɔ.’
“Ma a tsuo ma he nɔ ke, ‘Amen!’

Title: MOSE V, 28
Content:
Tue bumi kɛ e he gbaami
(Mose III, 26.3-13; Mose V, 7.12-24)
1 “Ke nyɛ bu Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ gbi tue, nɛ nyɛ ye e mlaa amɛ tsuo nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ woe mwɔnɛ ɔ a nɔ ɔ, lɛɛ e ma wo nyɛ nɔ gojoo pe je ma amɛ tsuo. 2Nyɛɛ bu Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ gbi tue, konɛ gbaami nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a pee nyɛ nɔ́.
3“Yawɛ maa gbaa nyɛ ma amɛ, kɛ nyɛ ngmɔ ɔmɛ.
4“Yawɛ ma ha nyɛ ma fɔ bimɛ babauu; nyɛ zugba a maa ba ní, nɛ nyɛ we mi lohwehi, nɛ ji nyɛ na amɛ, kɛ nyɛ to ɔmɛ hu maa bɔ.
5“Yawɛ maa gbaa nyɛ niba ní, kɛ niye ní nɛ nyɛ peeɔ kɛ jeɔ mi ɔ.
6“Yawɛ maa gbaa nyɛ, nyɛ ba we mi jio, nyɛ hia blɔ jio.
7“Yawɛ maa ye nyɛ he nyɛli ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ maa te si kɛ wo nyɛ ɔ a nɔ. Ke a gu he kake kɛ ba tua nyɛ ɔ, a maa gu he slɔɔto kpaago kɛ gbɛ fĩa.
8“Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ maa gbaa nyɛ ní tsumi nɔ, nɛ nyɛ gba amɛ ma hyi tɔtɔɔtɔ. E maa gbaa nyɛ ngɛ zugba a nɛ e kɛ ngɛ nyɛ hae ɔ nɔ.
9“Ke nyɛ bu Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ gbi tue, nɛ nyɛ ye mlaa amɛ nɛ e ngɛ nyɛ woe ɔ tsuo a nɔ ɔ, e maa pee nyɛ lɛ nitsɛ e ma, kaa bɔ nɛ e wo si ɔ. 10Lɔ ɔ loko je ma amɛ tsuo maa na kaa Yawɛ hla nyɛ nɛ nyɛɛ pee lɛ nitsɛ e ma, nɛ a maa ye nyɛ gbeye. 11Yawɛ ma ha nyɛ bimɛ, we mi lohwehi, kɛ ngmɔ niba ní babauu ngɛ zugba nɛ e wo nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ si ke e maa ngɔ kɛ ha nyɛ ɔ nɔ. 12Yawɛ ma ha hiɔmi maa nɛ ngɛ e be mi; e maa gbaa nyɛ ní tsumi tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ. Mahi babauu ma ba pa ní ngɛ nyɛ dɛ, se nyɛɛ lɛɛ e be nyɛ hiae kaa nyɛ ya pa nɔ́ ko ngɛ ma ko ma ko dɛ. 13Yawɛ maa pee nyɛ je ma amɛ tsuo a hɛ mi nyɛɛlɔ; ma amɛ maa nyɛɛ nyɛ se; pi nyɛ nɛ nyɛ maa hi se. Ke nyɛ maa bu Mawu mlaa amɛ tue, nɛ nyɛ maa ye a nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ, nɛ nyɛ maa pee bɔ nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ fae mwɔnɛ ɔ, Mawu ma ha nyɛ maa ya nɔ ngɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ mi, nɛ nyɛ be se yae kɔkɔɔkɔ. 14Nyɛ ko kpale kɛ je mlaa nɛ ɔmɛ a he kɔkɔɔkɔ; nyɛ ko ya ja mawu kpahi, nɛ nyɛ ko sɔmɔ mɛ hulɔ.
Tue gbomi kɛ e se sane
(Mose III, 26.14-46)
15“Se ke nyɛ bui Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ gbi tue, nɛ nyɛ yi e fami ɔmɛ, kɛ e mlaa amɛ tsuo nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ woe mwɔnɛ ɔ a nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ ɔ, gbiɛmi nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo maa ba nyɛ nɔ.
16“Yawɛ maa gbiɛ nyɛ ma amɛ, kɛ nyɛ ngmɔ ɔmɛ.
17“Yawɛ maa gbiɛ nyɛ niba ní, nɛ nyɛ be nyɛe maa pee niye ní kɛ je mi.
18“Yawɛ maa gbiɛ nyɛ bimɛ, nɛ a he be hiɛe. E maa gbiɛ nyɛ na amɛ, kɛ to ɔmɛ; a be bɔe, nɛ nyɛ zugba a hu ma gbo; nyɛ be nɔ́ kpakpa ko nae ngɛ mi.
19“Yawɛ maa gbiɛ nyɛ, nyɛ ba we mi jio, nyɛ hia blɔ jio.
20“Ke nyɛ kua Yawɛ, nɛ nyɛ ya pee yayami ɔ, lɔ ɔ lɛɛ e kɛ gbiɛmi nɛ ɔmɛ maa ba nyɛ nɔ: nyɛ ma didaa; nyɛ maa pee basaa, nɛ nyɛ maa bɔ ahlua ngɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ ma tsu mi. E ma tsa nɔ ja kɛ yaa si nyɛ hɛ mi ma kpata tlukaa. 21Yawɛ ma ha hiɔ nɛ gbee nɔ maa ba nyɛ nɔ nɔtonɔto kɛ yaa si e ma kpata nɔ tsuaa nɔ hɛ mi ngɛ zugba a nɛ nyɛ yaa ngɔ ɔ nɔ. 22Yawɛ ma ha hiɔ nɛ sãã nɔ kaa gugue hiɔ maa ba; e ma ha nɛ aslã kɛ fuumi hiɔ maa ba. Jehanɛ, nyu hwɔ maa ye, pu maa tso, nɛ je mi maa dɔ la wawɛɛ; kɛkɛ ɔ, nyɛ ngmɔ mi níhi a hɛ mi ma kpata. Haomi nɛ ɔmɛ be tae kɛ yaa si nyɛ gbenɔ be. 23Hiɔmi be nɛe, nɛ zugba a he maa wa kaa dade. 24Yawɛ ma ha bunyuku, kɛ zia maa je hiɔwe kɛ ba pue nyɛ nɔ kɛ yaa si nyɛ hɛ mi ma kpata.
25“Yawɛ ma ha nyɛ he nyɛli ɔmɛ maa ye nyɛ nɔ. Nyɛ maa gu he kake kɛ ya tua mɛ, se a maa gbɛ nyɛ ngɔ fĩa basaa, nɛ zugba a nɔ matsɛ yemi ɔmɛ tsuo maa ye gbeye ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ ba nyɛ nɔ ɔ he. 26Ke nyɛ gbo ɔ, lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ ma ba ye nyɛ, nɛ a be nɔ ko nae nɛ maa fie mɛ ngɛ nyɛ gbogboe ɔ he. 27Yawɛ ma ha tslɔɔ maa fuu nyɛ kaa bɔ nɛ e pee Egipt bi ɔmɛ ɔ. Nyɛ maa hia pa, nɛ sakpa kɛ ngmo nɛ be tsa ba ma pue nyɛ nɔ. 28Yawɛ ma ha nyɛ maa fo godo, nyɛ hɛngmɛhi ma yu, nɛ nyɛ juɛmi maa pee basaa. 29Nyɛ maa hi si tataae piani katakata kaa nɔ nɛ hyɛ we nɔ́, nɛ nyɛ be blɔ nae. Nyɛ nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko be nɔ yae? A maa wa nyɛ yi mi, nɛ a maa fia nyɛ ojo be tsuaa be; se nyɛ be nɔ ko nae nɛ maa je ngmlaa ha nyɛ.
30“Nyɛ ma bi yo si, se nyumu kpa maa ngɔ lɛ; nyɛ maa ma tsu, se nyɛ be mi hie; nyɛ ma hu wai ngmɔ, se nyɛ be e mi wai yiblii ɔ eko yee. 31A maa gbe nyɛ na ngɛ nyɛ hɛ mi paa, se nyɛ be e lo ɔ eko nae maa ye. Nyɛ hɛ mi paa nɛ a ma kpɔ̃ nyɛ tejihi pani nya kɛ je kɛ ho, nɛ a be kpalee kɛ ba ha nyɛ hu. A maa ngɔ nyɛ tohi kɛ ha nyɛ he nyɛli, nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be ngmlaa jee ha nyɛ. 32Nyɛ hɛ mi paa nɛ a maa ngɔ nyɛ binyumu ɔmɛ kɛ yi ɔmɛ kɛ ha ma je li. Daa ligbi ɔ, nyɛ maa hi nyɛ bimɛ blɔ hyɛe wawɛɛ kaa a maa kpale kɛ ba lo, se lɛ tsuo maa pee yaka. 33Nyɛ zugba a nɔ niba ní nɛ nyɛ gbo he dengme ɔ hu, je ma ko nɛ nyɛ li ma ba ye lɛ tsuo; nyɛ be nɔ́ kpakpa ko nae, se a maa wa nyɛ yi mi, nɛ a maa pee nyɛ posoo kaa zugba zu. 34Hɛdo ní nɛ nyɛ maa na a, ma ha nyɛ maa fo godo. 35Yawɛ ma ha nyɛ maa hia pa yeyee nɛ be tsa ba ngɛ nyɛ nane he. Tslɔɔ maa fuu nyɛ kɛ je nyɛ yi mi kɛ ya si nyɛ nane si.
36“Yawɛ maa ngɔ nyɛ, kɛ nyɛ matsɛ ɔ kɛ ya ma se he nɛ nyɛ li, he nɛ nyɛ nɛmɛ tete hí hyɛ; nyɛ ma ya sɔmɔ mawuhi nɛ a kɛ tso kɛ tɛ pee ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. 37Ma amɛ, he nɛ Yawɛ maa ngɔ nyɛ kɛ ya a, a mi bi ɔmɛ maa ye gbeye ngɛ nyakpɛ nɔ́ nɛ ba nyɛ nɔ nɛ ɔ he; a maa muɔ nyɛ, nɛ a maa ye nyɛ he fɛu.
38“Nyɛ ma du ní babauu ngɛ nyɛ ngmɔ mi, se ní bɔɔ pɛ nyɛ ma kpa; ejakaa baalɛ maa ye nyɛ niba ní ɔmɛ. 39Nyɛ maa pee wai ngmɔ, nɛ nyɛ ma gbo dengme kɛ hyɛ nɔ saminya, se nyɛ be wai yiblii ɔ kpae, nɛ nyɛ be wai ɔ hu eko nae maa nu; ejakaa gɔgɔ maa ye wai tso ɔmɛ. 40Oliv tsohi maa puɛ ngɛ nyɛ zugba a nɔ he tsuaa he, se nyɛ be nu ɔ eko nae; ejakaa oliv tso ɔmɛ a yiblii ɔ ma kplɔ pue si. 41Nyɛ ma fɔ binyumuhi kɛ yihi lɛɛ, se a be nyɛ bimɛ pee; ejakaa a maa nuu mɛ nyɔguɛ ngɛ ta mi kɛ je. 42Baalɛ maa sɛ nyɛ tso ɔmɛ a mi, nɛ a ma puɛ niba ní ɔmɛ.
43“Jehanɛ, nibwɔhi nɛ ngɛ nyɛ zugba a nɔ ɔ maa ya nɔ ma plɔke; se nyɛɛ lɛɛ si kɛkɛ nyɛ maa hi gbee. 44A ma na ní, nɛ a maa pa nyɛ eko, se nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ be ní nae nɛ nyɛ maa pa mɛ eko. Nyagbe mi ɔ, mɛ lɛ a maa ye nyɛ nɔ.
45“Haomi nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo maa ba nyɛ nɔ, nɛ e ma tsa nɔ jã kɛ̃ kɛ yaa su be nɛ nyɛ hɛ mi ma kpata pɛsɛpɛsɛ; ejakaa nyɛ bui Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ gbi tue, nɛ nyɛ yi e mlaa amɛ tsuo nɛ i wo nyɛ ɔ a nɔ. 46Haomi ɔmɛ maa pee okadi, kɛ kɔkɔ bɔmi nɛ je Mawu ngɔ ha nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ nina kɛ maa ya neneene. 47Yawɛ gbaa nyɛ ngɛ blɔ tsuaa blɔ nɔ, se nyɛ sume nɛ nyɛ sɔmɔ lɛ kɛ bua jɔmi, kɛ nyami nɛ je tsui mi. 48Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ ma sɔmɔ nyɛ he nyɛli ɔmɛ nɛ Yawɛ ma ha nɛ a te si kɛ wo nyɛ ɔ. Hwɔ kɛ kuma maa ye nyɛ; nyɛ maa hɛɛ nyɛ he gu, nɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ maa hia nyɛ. Nyɛ he nyɛli maa wa nyɛ yi mi wawɛɛ kɛ yaa si a ma kpata nyɛ hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ. 49Yawɛ ma ha je ma ko nɛ nyɛ nui a gbi maa je zugba a nyagbe he ɔmɛ nɛ a kɛ nyɛ ba hwu. A ma ba tua nyɛ tlukaa kaa bɔ nɛ kɔle gblɔɔ nɔ́ ɔ. 50Ma nɛ ɔ yi mi maa wa; a be nɔkɔtɔma bue, nɛ jokuɛyo hu a be lɛ mɔbɔ nae. 51A maa ye nyɛ we mi lohwe ɔmɛ, kɛ nyɛ ngmɔ niba ní ɔmɛ tsuo; se nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ ma gbo kɛ hwɔ. He nyɛli ɔmɛ be ngma, loo wai, loo nu, loo na, loo to piɛe ha nyɛ; nɛ nyɛ ma gbo. 52A ma ba tua nyɛ ngɛ ma amɛ tsuo nɛ ngɛ zugba a nɛ Yawɛ ngɛ nyɛ hae ɔ nɔ, hluu kɛ yaa si be nɛ gbogbo gojogojoo ɔmɛ nɛ nyɛ ngɔ nyɛ hɛ kɛ fɔ a nɔ ɔ tsuo maa hule pue si.
53“Ke nyɛ he nyɛli ɔmɛ ngɛ nyɛ ma amɛ a yi sae, nɛ nyɛ yi fi, nɛ hwɔ bɔni nyɛ yemi wawɛɛ ɔ, nyɛ maa ye nyɛ nitsɛ nyɛ mi mi bimɛ nɛ ji nyɛ binyumu ɔmɛ, kɛ nyɛ biyi ɔmɛ nɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ ngɔ ha nyɛ ɔ a lo. 54-55Ke a ba sá ma a yi kikɛ nɛ ɔ, nyumu nɛ ji odehe mi odehe nɛ mi mi jɔ po yi ma fi, nɛ e maa ye lɛ nitsɛ e bimɛ ɔmɛ ekomɛ; ejakaa e nɛ niye ní kpa ko. E be e nyɛminyumu, loo lɛ nitsɛ e yo nɛ e suɔ lɛ saminya, loo e bimɛ ɔmɛ nɛ piɛ ɔ lo ɔ eko hae. 56-57 Yo odehe mi odehe nɛ na ní kpɔtɔɔ, nɛ e hia we lɛ kaa e nyɛɛ kɛ ya he ko po maa pee jã kɛ̃. Ke he nyɛli ɔmɛ ba sá ma a yi ɔ, lɛ hu e yi ma fi ngɛ niye ní blɔ fa mi; e maa ye bimwɔyo he nɛ lɛ nitsɛ e fɔ ɔ ngɛ laami mi, nɛ e maa ye fɔmi se ɔ hulɔ. Lɛ nɔ kake e maa laa maa ye, nɛ e be e huno nɛ e suɔ lɛ saminya a, loo e bimɛ ɔmɛ eko hae.
58“Ke nyɛ bui Mawu tsɔɔmi ɔmɛ tsuo, nɛ́ nyɛ pee bɔ nɛ a ngma ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ mi, nɛ nyɛ wui Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ biɛ nɛ ngɛ nyakpɛ kɛ gbeye ɔ hɛ mi nyami ɔ, 59e ma ha hiɔhi nɛ be tsa ba, kɛ gbenɔ hiɔ nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be nya nyɛe maa tsi maa nu nyɛɛ, kɛ nyɛ nina tsuo. 60E ma ha haomihi nɛ ngɛ gbeye nɛ ba ngɛ Egipt ɔ maa ba nyɛ nɔ, nɛ nyɛ be nyɛ zu nɔ bae kɔkɔɔkɔ. 61Jehanɛ, e ma ha hiɔ munomunohi, kɛ gbenɔ hiɔ yayamihi nɛ a wui a nɔ ta ngɛ Mawu womi ɔ nɛ a ngma mlaa amɛ, kɛ tsɔɔmi ɔmɛ ngɛ mi ɔ maa ba nyɛ nɔ, nɛ nyagbe ɔ, a ma kpata nyɛ hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ. 62E ngɛ mi kaa nyɛ ma ba fɔ babauu nɛ nyɛ he maa hiɛ kaa dodoehi ngɛ hiɔwe lɛɛ, se nyɛ ti nihi bɔɔ pɛ nɛ a yi ma na wami; ejakaa nyɛ bui Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ gbi tue. 63Kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ bua jɔ nyɛ he, nɛ e ha nyɛ plɔke, nɛ nyɛ he hiɛ babauu ɔ, jã kɛ̃ e bua maa jɔ e he, nɛ e ma kpata nyɛ hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ. A maa fie nyɛ kɛ je zugba nɛ nyɛ yaa ngɔ ɔ nɔ.
64“Yawɛ maa gbɛ nyɛ ngɔ fĩa je ma amɛ tsuo a mi, kɛ maa je je ɔ nyagbe he kake kɛ maa ya nyagbe he kake, nɛ lejɛ ɔ nyɛ ma sɔmɔ mawuhi nɛ a kɛ tso kɛ tɛ pee, mawuhi nɛ nyɛ, loo nyɛ nɛmɛ ja we hyɛ. 65Nyɛ be tue mi jɔmi nae ngɛ he ko he ko; he ko be nɛ nyɛ ma tsɛ ke nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ nɔ́; Yawɛ ma ha nyɛ tsui maa hi poe; nyɛ hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi maa ta, nɛ nyɛ nine mi maa je wu. 66Daa nɛ ɔ, nyɛ maa hi gbenɔ muɔ nya. Nyɛ tsui maa hi poe nyɔ kɛ pia; e maa pee nyɛ kaa nyɛ ma gbo tlukaa. 67Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ hɛngmɛ maa na a maa wo nyɛ he gbeye, nɛ nyɛ tsui maa po. 68E ngɛ mi kaa Yawɛ de ke nyɛ be kpalee kɛ ya Egipt gblegbleegble lɛɛ, se e maa wo nyɛ lɛ, nɛ e maa kpale nyɛ kɛ ya lejɛ ɔ. Nyɛ ma hla kaa nyɛ maa jua nyɛ he kaa nyɔguɛ ha nyɛ he nyɛli ɔmɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, se a be nɔ ko nae nɛ ma he nyɛ.”

Title: MOSE V, 29
Content:
Yawɛ kɛ Israel so ngɛ Moab zugba a nɔ
1Somi nɛ Yawɛ fa Mose ke e kɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ nɛ a so ngɛ Moab zugba a nɔ ɔ mi munyu komɛ ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ. E slo somi nɛ Yawɛ nitsɛ kɛ Israel ma a so ngɛ Sinai yo ɔ he ɔ.
2Mose tsɛ Israel ma a tsuo kɛ kpe, nɛ e de mɛ ke, “Nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ na nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ pee Egipt matsɛ ɔ, e tsɔli ɔmɛ, kɛ e zugba a tsuo. 3Nyɛ na gbenɔ hiɔ gbeyegbeye ɔmɛ, okadi ɔmɛ, kɛ nyakpɛ ní nguangua amɛ nɛ Yawɛ pee ɔ. 4Se kɛ ba si mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ, e ha we nɛ nyɛɛ nu níhi nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ kpe ɔ a sisi lolo. 5Jeha nyingmi eywiɛ sɔuu Yawɛ kpaka nyɛ kɛ gu nga kplanaa a nɔ; nyɛ heha ní gba we ngɛ nyɛ he, nɛ nyɛ tokota amɛ hu tsɔ we. 6Nyɛ na we abolo nɛ nyɛɛ ye, nɛ nyɛ na we wai, loo dã nɛ nya wa ko nɛ nyɛɛ nu; se Yawɛ ha nyɛ nyɛ hiami ní ɔmɛ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ e kɛ tsɔɔ nyɛ kaa lɛ ji nyɛ Mawu ɔ nɛ. 7 Jehanɛ, benɛ wa ba su hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ, Heshbon matsɛ, Sihon, kɛ Bashan matsɛ, Og hia ta kɛ kpee wɔ. Se wa ye a nɔ, 8 nɛ wa ngɔ a zugba a, nɛ wa dla mi ngɔ ha Ruben wɛtso ɔ, Gad wɛtso ɔ, kɛ Manase wɛtso fa a. 9Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ ye somi ɔ mi munyu ɔmɛ tsuo a nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ nyɛɛ ye manye ngɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ maa pee mi.
10“Mwɔnɛ ɔ, nyɛ tsuo nyɛ daa si ngɛ Yawɛ nyɛ Mawu ɔ hɛ mi. Nyɛ, nyɛ ma nimeli, tsɔli, nyumuhi, 11yihi, jokuɛwi, kɛ nyɛ nibwɔhi nɛ gbaa lɛ́, nɛ a yaa pa ha nyɛ ɔ tsuo ngɛ hiɛ ɔ. 12Nyɛ ba hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ, konɛ nyɛɛ fua ngɔ fɔ somi nɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ kɛ nyɛ ngɛ soe ɔ nɔ, nɛ nyɛɛ pɛtɛ níhi nɛ sa nɛ nyɛ tsu ngɛ mi ɔ a he. 13Nyɛ ngɛ enɛ ɔ pee konɛ Yawɛ kɛ nyɛ nɛ da si kaa lɛ nitsɛ e ma, nɛ e pee nyɛ Mawu, kaa bɔ nɛ e wo nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ nɛmɛ Abraham, Isak, kɛ Yakob si ɔ. 14Somi nɛ ɔ, pi nyɛ kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ kɛ ngɛ soe, nɛ e mi ní tsumi ɔmɛ hu, pi nyɛ kɛkɛ nɛ a ngɛ kɛ ha. 15Se e kɛ wɔ tsuo nɛ ngɛ soe ɔ nɛ; wɔ ni nɛmɛ nɛ wa daa si ngɛ e hɛ mi mwɔnɛ ɔ, kɛ wa nina nɛ a fɔ we mɛ lolo ɔ tsuo.
16“Nyɛ kai bɔ nɛ wa hi Egipt zugba a nɔ, kɛ bɔ nɛ wa nyɛɛ kɛ gu je ma amɛ a zugba a nɔ. 17Nyɛ na a musu ní hiemi ní ɔmɛ, amagahi nɛ a kɛ tso, kɛ tɛ, kɛ sika hiɔ, kɛ sika tsu pee ɔ. 18 Nyɛ nɛ nyɛ daa si ngɛ hiɛ ɔ mwɔnɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ hyɛ saminya nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko kó je Yawɛ, wa Mawu ɔ se kɛ ya ja ma je li a mawu ɔmɛ, nyumu jio, yo jio, weku jio, wɛtso jio. Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ngɛ kaa tso sipoku nɛ maa wa, nɛ maa ngɔ e duɔ kɛ gbla haomi kɛ ba nyɛ nɔ. 19Nyɛɛ hyɛ saminya nɛ nyɛ nihi tsuo nɛ nyɛ ngɛ somi munyu nɛ ɔmɛ nue mwɔnɛ ɔ ngɛ hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ, nyɛ ti nɔ ko kó mlɔɔ e he kaa ke e pee lɛ nitsɛ e tsui wami nya ní ɔ, e maa hi ha lɛ ligbi ko. Ke nɔ ko pee ja a, nyɛ tsuo nyɛ hɛ mi ma kpata, nɔ kpakpa, kɛ nɔ yayami tsuo nɛ slɔɔto ko be mi. 20Yawɛ be nɔ nɛ tue wa nɛ ɔ he yayami ngɔe kɛ pa lɛ. Niinɛ, Yawɛ mi mi ma fu wawɛɛ kɛ wo lɛ, nɛ gbiɛmihi tsuo nɛ a ngma ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ mi ɔ maa ba e nɔ kɛ yaa si Yawɛ ma kpata e hɛ mi kulaa kɛ pi si. 21Yawɛ ma je e hɛ kɛ pi lɛ, nɛ e maa gbla e tue. Gbiɛmihi tsuo nɛ a ngma ngɛ Yawɛ mlaa womi nɛ ɔ mi, nɛ a to kɛ ha nihi nɛ ma tɔ̃ somi nɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ maa ba e nɔ.
22“Hwɔɔ se yi nɔ bi nɛ ji nyɛ nina, kɛ nibwɔhi nɛ je ma se zugbahi a nɔ tsuo maa na haomihi, kɛ amanehluhi nɛ Yawɛ kɛ ba nyɛ zugba a nɔ ɔ. 23 La zu, kɛ ngo maa ha ngmɔ ɔmɛ tsuo a nɔ. Nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko be hie dumi ngɛ nɔ hu, nɛ nga po be puɛe ngɛ nɔ. Nyɛ zugba a maa pee kaa Sodom kɛ Gomora, kɛ Adma kɛ Zeboiim nɛ Yawɛ kpata a hɛ mi benɛ e mi mi fu wawɛɛ ɔ. 24Ke e ba mi ja a, je ɔ tsuo ma bi si ke, ‘Mɛni he je nɛ Yawɛ pee e zugba a kikɛ nɛ ɔ? 25Mɛni he je e mi mi fu wawɛɛ kikɛ nɛ ɔ?’ Heto nɛ a ma na ji, ‘Nɔ́ he je nɛ e ba ja a ji kaa Yawɛ ma a yi somi nɛ a kɛ lɛ, a nɛmɛ a Mawu ɔ so ɔ nɔ. Lɛ ji nɔ nɛ kpaka mɛ kɛ je Egipt ɔ nɛ. 26A ya sɔmɔ mawu kpahi nɛ a ja we hyɛ, mawuhi nɛ Yawɛ wo mɛ mlaa ke a ko ja kɔkɔɔkɔ ɔ. 27Enɛ ɔ he nɛ Yawɛ mi mi fu e ma a, nɛ e kɛ haomi ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ a ngma ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ mi ɔ ba a nɔ ɔ nɛ. 28Yawɛ mi mi wo la wawɛɛ nitsɛ, nɛ e kɛ mi mi la nɛ nya wa nɛ ɔ hia mɛ kɛ je a zugba a nɔ, nɛ e sake mɛ ngɔ pue ma se zugba ko nɔ, nɛ lejɛ ɔ a ngɛ kɛ mwɔɔ.’
29“Laami ní komɛ ngɛ nɛ Yawɛ, wa Mawu ɔ je we kpo ngɔ tsɔɔ wɔ, se e je e mlaa a kpo ngɔ ha wɔ kɛ wa nina, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ waa ye nɔ kɛ ya neneene.

Title: MOSE V, 30
Content:
Wami, loo gbenɔ
1“Jehanɛ, i ngɔ gbaami kɛ gbiɛmi ngɔ pue nyɛ hɛ mi, nɛ́ nyɛɛ hla mi nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ suɔ. Ke ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ba nyɛ nɔ, nɛ nyɛ ya je ma je li a kpɛti, he nɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ gbɛ nyɛ ngɔ fĩa a, nyɛ ma kai níhi nɛ i ngɔ pue nyɛ hɛ mi ɔ. 2Ke nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ nina maa kpale kɛ ba Yawɛ ngɔ, nɛ nyɛ maa je nyɛ tsui mi tsuo kɛ bu e gbi tue, nɛ nyɛ maa ye e mlaa amɛ tsuo nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ woe mwɔnɛ ɔ a nɔ ɔ, 3lɛɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ maa na nyɛ mɔbɔ. E maa kpale nyɛ kɛ je ma je li ɔmɛ a zugba a nɔ, he nɛ e gbɛ nyɛ ngɔ fĩa a; nɛ e ma ha nyɛ ma na ní kpɔtɔɔ ekohu. 4Ke kaa je ɔ nyagbe he tɔɔ po nɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ gbɛ nyɛ ngɔ fĩa a, e ma bua nyɛ nya, nɛ e maa kpale nyɛ kɛ ba, 5konɛ nyɛ ba ngɔ zugba a he nɛ nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ hi ɔ, nɛ e pee nyɛ nɔ́ ekohu. Jehanɛ, e ma ha nɛ nyɛ ma na ní, nɛ nyɛ he maa hiɛ babauu pe nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ po. 6Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ ma ha nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ nina tsui kpakpa nɛ buɔ tue, konɛ nyɛɛ suɔ lɛ kɛ nyɛ tsui tsuo, nɛ nyɛɛ hi jamɛ a zugba a nɔ. 7Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ ma ha gbiɛmi nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo maa ba nyɛ he nyɛli nɛ sume nyɛ, nɛ a waa nyɛ yi mi ɔ a nɔ. 8Nyɛ maa bu Yawɛ tue ekohu, nɛ nyɛ maa ye e mlaa amɛ tsuo nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ woe mwɔnɛ ɔ a nɔ. 9Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ ma ha nyɛ maa ye manye ngɛ nyɛ nine nya ní tsumihi tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ mi. Nyɛ bimɛ, kɛ nyɛ we mi lohwehi maa hiɛ babauu, nɛ nyɛ ngmɔ ɔmɛ maa ba ní saminya. Yawɛ bua maa jɔ nyɛ he, nɛ e ma ha nyɛ ma plɔke kaa bɔ nɛ e pee nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ ɔ. 10Nɔ́ nɛ hia ji kaa nyɛ maa bu e gbi tue, nɛ nyɛ maa ye e mlaa amɛ tsuo nɛ a ngma ngɛ mlaa womi nɛ ɔ mi ɔ a nɔ. E hia kaa nyɛɛ kpale kɛ ba Yawɛ ngɔ kɛ nyɛ tsui tsuo.
11“Mlaa amɛ nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ woe mwɔnɛ ɔ, a he wɛ tsɔ ha nyɛ, nɛ e be tsitsaa he ko hulɔ. 12 E be hiɔwe, nɛ́ nyɛ ma bi ke, ‘Mɛnɔ maa kuɔ kɛ ya nɛ e ya ngɔ kɛ ba ha wɔ, konɛ waa nu nɛ waa ye nɔ?’ 13E be wo se hulɔ nɛ nyɛ ma bi ke, ‘Mɛnɔ maa po wo, nɛ e ya ngɔ kɛ ba, konɛ waa nu, nɛ waa ye nɔ?’ 14Dɛbi, e ngɛ nyɛ ngɔ hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ. Nyɛ le, nɛ nyɛ ma nyɛ ma de, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, jehanɛ, ye nɔ.
15“Mwɔnɛ ɔ, i ngɔ kpakpa kɛ yayami ngɔ fɔ nyɛ hɛ mi; nyɛɛ ngɔ wami, aloo gbenɔ. 16Ke nyɛ maa ye Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ mlaa amɛ nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ woe mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ a nɔ, nɛ nyɛ maa suɔ lɛ, nɛ nyɛ maa bu lɛ tue, nɛ nyɛ maa nyɛɛ e blɔ ɔmɛ tsuo a nɔ ɔ, lɛɛ nyɛ yi ma na wami, nɛ nyɛ he maa hiɛ; Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ maa gbaa nyɛ ngɛ zugba a nɛ nyɛ yaa ngɔ ɔ nɔ. 17Se, ke nyɛ gbo tue, nɛ nyɛ ha a mlɔɔ nyɛ kɛ ya ja mawu kpahi ɔ, 18lɛɛ i ngɛ nyɛ dee mwɔnɛ ɔ ke ma kpata nyɛ hɛ mi. Zugba nɛ ngɛ Yordan pa a se nɛ nyɛ yaa ngɔ ɔ, nyɛ se be kɛe ngɛ nɔ. 19Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i ngɔ wami kɛ gbenɔ kɛ ngɛ nyɛ hɛ mi fɔe; i ngɔ Mawu gbaami kɛ gbiɛmi hu kɛ ngɛ nyɛ hɛ mi fɔe; nɛ i ngɛ hiɔwe kɛ zugba odase tsɛe ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ maa hla a he. Nyɛɛ ngɔ wami. 20 Nyɛɛ suɔ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ; nyɛɛ bu lɛ tue, nɛ nyɛ pee e suɔmi nya ní pɛpɛɛpɛ. Ke nyɛ pee ja a, zugba a nɛ e wo nyɛ nɛmɛ Abraham, Isak, kɛ Yakob si ke e kɛ ma ha mɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ nina maa hi nɔ.”

Title: MOSE V, 31
Content:
Yoshua ba ye Mose se
1Mose tsa e munyu ɔ nɔ, nɛ e de Israel ma a ke, 2 “Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, i ye jeha lafa kɛ nyingmi enyɔ, nɛ i be nyɛe ma pee nyɛ hɛ mi nyɛɛlɔ hu. Jehanɛ hu, Yawɛ de mi ke, i be Yordan pa a poe. 3Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ ma kpaka nyɛ, nɛ e ma kpata ma amɛ nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ a hɛ mi, konɛ nyɛ nyɛ nɛ nyɛɛ ngɔ zugba a; nɛ Yoshua maa pee nyɛ hɛ mi nyɛɛlɔ kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ de ɔ. 4 Yawɛ maa pee je ma amɛ kaa bɔ nɛ e pee Amor matsɛmɛ, Sihon kɛ Og, kɛ a zugba a; e ma kpata a hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ. 5Yawɛ ma ha nɛ nyɛɛ ye nyɛ he nyɛli ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ́ nyɛɛ pee mɛ kaa bɔ nɛ i de nyɛ ɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ. 6Nyɛ he nɛ wa nɛ nyɛɛ pee kã. Nyɛ ko ye mɛ gbeye. Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ nitsɛ kɛ nyɛ maa hi si. E be nyɛ sie, nɛ e be nyɛ kuae hulɔ.”
7Jehanɛ, Mose tsɛ Yoshua nɛ e de lɛ ngɛ Israel ma kpekpemi ɔ hɛ mi ke, “O he nɛ wa, nɛ o pee kã; mo ji nɔ nɛ maa nyɛɛ Israel ma a hɛ mi kɛ ya ngɔ zugba a nɛ Yawɛ wo a nɛmɛ si ke e kɛ ma ha mɛ ɔ nɛ. 8 Yawɛ nitsɛ ma kpaka mo, nɛ e kɛ mo maa hi si. E be mo sie, nɛ e be mo kuae hulɔ; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, koo nu sawale; nɛ koo ye gbeye.”
A kane mlaa a daa jeha kpaago
9Mose ngma Mawu mlaa a ngɔ wo womi mi, nɛ e ngɔ ha osɔfo ɔmɛ nɛ ji Levi bi ɔmɛ nɛ hyɛɛ somi daka a nɔ ɔ, kɛ Israel ma nimeli ɔmɛ tsuo. 10 E fa mɛ ke, “Daa jeha kpaagone ɔ, ke e su be nɛ a kɛ hiɔhi maa ke ɔ, nyɛɛ kane mlaa nɛ ɔ wawɛɛ nɛ a nu ngɛ Gbasisihimi nyami be ɔ. 11Ke Israel ma a tsuo ba bua a he nya ngɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ hɛ mi ngɛ he nɛ a to nɛ a ja lɛ ngɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ kane mlaa nɛ ɔ nɛ a nu. 12Moo kpee Israel ma a tsuo kɛ ba: nyumuhi, yihi, jokuɛwi, kɛ nibwɔhi nɛ ngɛ nyɛ ma amɛ a mi ɔ, konɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ba nu, nɛ e wo Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ hɛ mi nyami; nɛ a ye mlaa womi nɛ ɔ mi munyu ɔmɛ tsuo a nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ. 13Ke e pee ja a, nyɛ bimɛ nɛ nui Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ mlaa a hyɛ ɔ maa nu, nɛ a maa bu Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ; nɛ a maa ye lɛ gbeye a wami ligbi tsuo nɛ́ a maa hi zugba a nɛ nyɛ yaa ngɔ ngɛ Yordan pa a se ɔ nɔ.”
Nyagbe munyu nɛ Yawɛ kɛ Mose tu
14Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Yawɛ de Mose ke, “O gbenɔ be su ta. Mo tsɛ Yoshua nɛ o kɛ lɛ nɛ ba bo tsu ɔ mi, konɛ ma tsɔɔ lɛ bɔ nɛ e pee.” Mose kɛ Yoshua ya bo tsu ɔ mi. 15Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ je e he kpo ngɔ tsɔɔ mɛ ngɛ bɔku titima nɛ ba da bo tsu ɔ sinya a nya a mi.
16Yawɛ de Mose ke, “E be kɛe nɛ o ma gbo; nɛ o gbenɔ se ɔ, Israel ma a be mi anɔkuale yee hu; a be somi nɛ i kɛ mɛ so ɔ nɔ yee. A maa je ye se ya ja ma se mawuhi nɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ he nɛ a yaa a. 17Ke e ba mi ja a, ye mi mi ma fu. I ma kua mɛ, nɛ a hɛ mi ma kpata. Haomihi nɛ ngɛ gbeyegbeye maa ba a nɔ, nɛ lɔ ɔ loko a ma kpa si kaa ní nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ a nɔ bae, ejakaa imi a Mawu ɔ, i kua mɛ. 18Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, i be a he piɛe hu; ejakaa a pee yayami kaa a ya ja mawu kpahi.
19“Jehanɛ, ngmaa la nɛ ɔ, nɛ o tsɔɔ Israel ma a, konɛ e pee odase kɛ si mɛ. 20I ma kpaka mɛ kɛ ya zugba kpakpa nɛ baa ní saminya nɛ ɔ nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ i wo a nɛmɛ ɔmɛ si ɔ. A ma na niye ní bɔ nɛ a ngɛ hlae ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. A maa ye ní nɛ a maa tɔ, nɛ a ma na bua jɔmi. Se kɛ̃ ɔ, a maa je ye se kɛ ya ja mawu kpahi. A ma kua mi, nɛ a be somi nɛ i kɛ mɛ so ɔ nɔ yee, 21nɛ haomi gbeyegbeye babauu maa ba a nɔ. Jamɛ a be ɔ mi tsuo ɔ, a maa hi la nɛ ɔ lae, nɛ e maa pee odase kɛ si mɛ. Amlɔ nɛ ɔ po nɛ i kɛ mɛ sui zugba nɛ i wo si ke ma ha mɛ ɔ nɔ lolo ɔ, i le a yi mi.”
22Mose ngma la a, nɛ e tsɔɔ Israel ma a jamɛ a ligbi ɔ nɔuu.
23 Jehanɛ, Yawɛ to Nun bi Yoshua si, nɛ e de lɛ ke, “Pee kã, nɛ o he nɛ wa. Mo nɛ o ma kpaka Israel ma a kɛ ya zugba a nɛ i wo mɛ e he si ɔ nɔ. I kɛ mo maa hi si.”
24Mose ngma Mawu mlaa a fitsofitso kɛ wo womi ko mi; e si we nɔ́ ko. 25Benɛ e gbe nya a, e de Levi bi ɔmɛ nɛ ji osɔfo ɔmɛ nɛ hyɛɛ Yawɛ somi daka a nɔ ke, 26“Nyɛɛ ngɔ Mawu mlaa womi nɛ ɔ nɛ nyɛ ngɔ to Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ somi daka a kasa nya, nɛ e hi lejɛ ɔ, nɛ e ye odase kɛ si ma a. 27I le kaa a kuɛ wa, nɛ a tsɔɔ atuã. Be mi nɛ i ngɛ je mi ɔ, a tsɔ Yawɛ hɛ mi atuã, nɛ ke i gbo lɛɛ kɛ e ma ba hi kɛɛ? 28Nyɛɛ kpee nyɛ wɛtsoyi ɔmɛ, kɛ tsɔli ɔmɛ kɛ ba, konɛ ma de mɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ. I ma tsɛ hiɔwe kɛ zugba nɛ a ye odase kɛ si mɛ. 29I le paa kaa ye gbenɔ se ɔ, nyɛ ma puɛ nyɛ he kulaa, nɛ nyɛ maa je blɔ nɛ i tsɔɔ nyɛ ɔ nɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e be kɛe nɛ nyɛ maa na amanehlu; ejakaa nyɛ maa pee yayami kɛ si Yawɛ. Nyɛ ní peepee maa wo e mi mi la.”
Mose la a
30Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Mose kane la a mi munyu ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ tsɔɔ Israel ma a, nɛ mɛ tsuo a bu tue kɛ ya si nyagbe:

Title: MOSE V, 32
Content:
1“Hiɔwe kɛ zugba lee,
nyɛ ba bu mi tue;
nyɛ ba bu nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ dee ɔ tue saminya.
2Ma tsɔɔ nyɛ ní kaa bɔ nɛ hiɔmi nɛɛ blɛuu kɛ pueɔ zugba nɔ nɛ e peeɔ kaa bɔ́ ɔ.
Ma tu nyɛ munyu kaa bɔ nɛ hiɔmi fĩaa kɛ pueɔ tso bihi a nɔ, aloo kaa bɔ nɛ hiɔmi nɛɛ blɛuu kɛ pueɔ nga nɔ ɔ.
3Ma wo Yawɛ biɛ ta kɛ je e yi, nɛ e ma a maa wo e hɛ mi nyami.
4“Yawɛ ji nyɛ yi baalɔ nɛ se be;
e hi kɛ pi si,
nɛ e da ngɛ blɔ tsuaa blɔ nɔ.
Nyɛ Mawu ɔ yeɔ e siwo nɔ;
yayami ko be e he;
nɔ́ nɛ da, kɛ nɔ́ nɛ sa pɛ e peeɔ.
5Se nyɛɛ lɛɛ, nyɛ yi nyɛ siwo nɔ,
nɛ nyɛ sɛ kulaa kaa nyɛ peeɔ e ma.
Ma nɛ peeɔ yayami,
nɛ sisiɔ nɔ ji nyɛ.
6Bɔ nɛ sa kaa nyɛ peeɔ Yawɛ ji nɛ ɔ lo,
ma kuasia nɛ be juɛmi?
Lɛ ji nyɛ tsɛ kɛ nyɛ bɔlɔ;
lɛ nɛ e ha nyɛ pee e ma.
7“Nyɛ susu blema lokoo ɔ he;
nyɛ bi nyɛ nɛmɛ, kɛ nimeli ɔmɛ
nɛ a gba nyɛ blema sane.
8 Nɔ nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe lokoo ɔ,
nɔ nɛ dla zugba a ha je ma amɛ,
nɛ e to ma tsuaa ma hi he ɔ,
lɛ nɛ e ha je ma tsuaa je ma e mawu.
9Se Yakob nina lɛɛ,
Yawɛ hla lɛ kaa lɛ nitsɛ e ma.
10“E na lɛ ngɛ nga kplanaa a nɔ,
he nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be.
E bu e he, nɛ e hyɛ e nɔ saminya
kaa bɔ nɛ nɔ hyɛɛ e bi kpakpa nɛ e suɔ lɛ nɔ.
11Bɔ nɛ kɔle buu e tsu he,
nɛ e tee kɛ bɔleɔ e bimɛ,
nɛ e bliɔ e pɛli mi,
nɛ e ngɔɔ e bimɛ ngɔ fɔɔ nɔ
kɛ tee kɛ yaa hiɔwe ɔ,
ja Yawɛ hɛɛ Israel.
12Yawɛ, lɛ nɔ kake lɛ e kpaka e ma a;
ma se mawu ko piɛ we e he.
13“E ha e ma a ye yo nɔ zugba amɛ a nɔ,
nɛ a ye ngmɔ ɔmɛ a mi niba ní.
E ma a ná hwo kɛ je tɛ sa mi;
nɛ oliv tso ɔmɛ hu plɔke
ngɛ zugba nɛ tɛ ngɛ mi ɔ nɔ.
14Na amɛ, kɛ to ɔmɛ ha nyɔ nyu babauu;
e ha ma a jijɔ, apletsi, kɛ na kpakpahi;
a ye ní kpakpa, nɛ a nu dã kpakpa.
15“Yawɛ ma a na ní kpɔtɔɔ;
kɛkɛ nɛ a tsɔ atuã;
a ye ní kpakpa nɛ a tɔ saminya.
Se a je Mawu nɛ ji a bɔlɔ ɔ he,
nɛ a kua a yi wami helɔ nɛ se be ɔ.
16A kɛ mawuhi nɛ a li ye e tsui,
nɛ a ngɔ ní hiemi nihi kɛ wo e mi mi la.
17 Ma a sã bɔ kɛ ha mumi yayamihi,
kɛ mawuhi nɛ a he be se nami,
mawuhi nɛ a nɛmɛ po li,
mawuhi nɛ Israel sɔmɔ we hyɛ.
18A Mawu ɔ nɛ baa a yi, nɛ́ he a yi wami ɔ,
a hɛ je a nɔ.
19“Benɛ Yawɛ na nɔ́ nɛ ɔ,
e mi mi wo la,
nɛ e kua e ma a;
ejakaa a binyumu ɔmɛ, kɛ a biyi ɔmɛ wo e mi mi la.
20E de ke, ‘Jehanɛ, i be a he piɛe hu;
ma hyɛ nɔ́ nɛ maa ba a nɔ;
nihi nɛ a tue mi ti,
nɛ a yi a siwo nɔ.
21 A kɛ a we amagahi wo ye mi mi la.
A kɛ a yaka mawu ɔmɛ ye ye tsui.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ma ngɔ ma gu ko kɛ wo a mi mi la;
ma ngɔ ma kɛ e mi kuasiahi sɔuu kɛ ye a tsui.
22Ye mi mi fumi nya maa wa wawɛɛ
kaa la nɛ ngɛ tsoe;
e maa sã nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ ngɛ je ɔ mi
kɛ ya su gbeje tɔɔ;
e maa sã yo ɔmɛ a sisi tomi ɔmɛ hulɔ.
23“ ‘Ma ha haomihi maa ba a nɔ nɔtonɔto;
ma tsɛ̃ mɛ ye kɛ̃ɛ̃ ɔmɛ tsuo.
24Hwɔ kɛ aslã maa gbe mɛ,
nɛ hiɔhi nɛ ngɛ gbeyegbeye
ma kpata a hɛ mi.
Ma ha nga mi lohwe awi yeli ma ba tua mɛ,
nɛ sinɔ duɔtsɛmɛ maa kɔɔ mɛ.
25Ta ma kpata nihi a hɛ mi
ngɛ gbɛjegbɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ,
nɛ sawale maa nu nihi ngɛ a we ɔmɛ a mi.
Nihewi kɛ yihewi ma gbo;
bimwɔwi kɛ nyumu nikɔtɔmahi hu be a he yee.
26Jinɛ i ko kpata mɛ tsuo a hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ,
nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be mɛ kaie hu.
27Se i be blɔ ngmɛe
nɛ a he nyɛli ɔmɛ nɛ a fĩa
ke mɛ lɛ a ye ye ma a nɔ,
be mi nɛ imi, Yawɛ nitsɛ
nɛ i kpata a hɛ mi.’
28“Ma ko nɛ be juɛmi ji Israel;
a li nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko.
29A nyɛ we nɛ a na nɔ́ he je nɛ a ye a nɔ ɔ;
a nui nɔ́ nɛ ba a sisi.
30Kɛ pee kɛɛ nɛ nɔ kake maa fie
nihi akpe?
Kɛ pee kɛɛ nɛ nihi enyɔ pɛ maa wo
nihi akpe nyɔngma fo?
Yawɛ, a Mawu ɔ kua mɛ;
a Mawu ngua a ngmɛɛ a he.
31He nyɛli ɔmɛ le kaa a mawu ɔmɛ be he wami ko
kaa Israel Mawu ɔ.
32He nyɛli ɔmɛ puɛ kaa Sodom kɛ Gomora;
a ngɛ kaa wai tso nɛ woɔ yiblii doodooe
nɛ gbee nɔ,
33aloo wai nɛ a wo mi sinɔ duɔ.
34“Ke he nyɛli ɔmɛ pee Israel nɔ́ ko ɔ,
Yawɛ hɛ ji nɔ;
e mlɛɛ blɛuu kɛ ya siɔ be nɛ sa
loko e gblaa a tue.
35 Yawɛ maa ye lue kokooko.
E maa gbla he nyɛli ɔmɛ a tue.
A maa sane nɔ si amlɔ nɔuu.
E be kɛe kulaa nɛ e ma kpata a hɛ mi.
A nyagbe ma tlukaa.
36 Yawɛ ma kpɔ e ma a
kɛ je he nyɛli a dɛ mi
be mi nɛ e na kaa a he wami tsuo ta.
Nihi nɛ sɔmɔɔ lɛ ɔ lɛɛ
ke e na bɔ nɛ peepee ta a he ha a,
e maa na mɛ mɔbɔ.
37Kɛkɛ ɔ, Yawɛ ma bi e ma a ke, ‘Mawu ngua amɛ
nɛ nyɛ ngɔ nyɛ hɛ kɛ fɔ a nɔ ɔ,
jije a ngɛ?
38Nyɛ lɛ mɛ kɛ lohwehi nɛ wo zɔ,
nɛ nyɛ ngɔ dã kɛ sã bɔ ha mɛ.
Lɛɛ, nyɛ ha nɛ a je ngmlaa ha nyɛ;
nyɛ ha nɛ a he nɛ sɔ
kɛ ba kpɔ nyɛ koo!’
39“Nyɛ na nɛ nyɛɛ le kaa,
‘Imi nɔ kake too ji Mawu;
ye se ɔ, mawu ko mawu ko be!
Imi nɛ i gbee nɔ,
imi kɛ̃ nɛ i haa nɔ wami;
imi nɛ i plaa nɔ,
nɛ imi nɛ i tsaa nɔ.
Nɔ ko nɔ ko be nɛ maa tsi ye nya.
40Be abɔ nɛ imi ji Mawu
nɛ ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene nɛ ɔ,
i wo ye nine nɔ, nɛ i ngɛ kita kae kaa
41ma duɔ ye klaate nɛ kpɛɔ nylamnylam ɔ nya,
nɛ ma hyɛ nɛ a ye dami sane.
Ma ye lue ngɛ he nyɛli ɔmɛ a nɔ;
nihi nɛ sume mi ɔ, ma gbla a tue.
42Muɔ ma tsle ngɛ ye kɛ̃ɛ̃ mi bi ɔmɛ a he kɛ pue si;
nɛ ye klaate ɔ maa gbe nihi nɛ teɔ si woɔ mi ɔ.
Nihi nɛ kɛ mi na ta a,
a ti nɔ ko nɔ ko be e he yee;
nihi nɛ plaa, kɛ nihi nɛ a nuu
ngɛ ta mi po, ma gbe mɛ!’
43 “Je mahi lee, nyɛ je Yawɛ ma a yi;
nihi tsuo nɛ gbee e ma a,
Yawɛ gblaa a tue.
E yeɔ lue ngɛ e he nyɛli ɔmɛ a nɔ,
nɛ e kɛ e ma a he yayami paa mɛ.”
44Mose kɛ Nun bi, Yoshua kane la nɛ ɔ mi munyu ɔmɛ saminya kɛ tsɔɔ Israel ma a, nɛ mɛ tsuo a nu.
Mose nyagbe slɔmi
45Benɛ Mose kane Mawu mlaa amɛ kɛ tsɔɔ Israel ma a gbe nya a, 46e slɔ mɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ hyɛ saminya nɛ nyɛɛ ye mlaa nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ woe mwɔnɛ ɔ a nɔ. Nyɛɛ tsɔɔ nyɛ bimɛ ɔmɛ, konɛ a ye Mawu mlaa amɛ tsuo a nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ. 47Mlaa nɛ ɔmɛ pi munyu guhi; nyɛ wami daa si ngɛ a nɔ. Nyɛɛ ye a nɔ, konɛ nyɛ se nɛ kɛ ngɛ zugba a nɛ ngɛ Yordan se nɛ nyɛ yaa ngɔ ɔ nɔ.”
48 Yawɛ kɛ Mose tu munyu jamɛ a ligbi ɔ kɛ̃, nɛ e de lɛ ke, 49“Yaa Abarim yo ɔmɛ a nɔ ngɛ Moab zugba a mi, ngɛ Yeriko ma a hanɔ; kuɔɔ Nebo yo ɔ, nɛ o hyɛ Kanaan zugba a nɛ i ngɔ kɛ ngɛ Israel ma a hae ɔ. 50O ma gbo ngɛ lejɛ ɔ kaa bɔ nɛ o nyɛminyumu Aaron hu gbo ngɛ Hor yo ɔ nɔ ɔ, 51ejakaa nyɛ ni enyɔ ɔmɛ tsuo nyɛ bui mi tue; nyɛ pue ye hɛ mi si ngɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ a hɛ mi. Nyɛ pue ye hɛ mi si ngɛ Meriba pa a nya, ngɛ Kadesh ma a kasa nya, ngɛ Zin nga kplanaa a nɔ. Nyɛ bui mi kaa nɔ klɔuklɔu ngɛ Israel ma a hɛ mi. 52O maa na zugba a nɛ i ngɔ kɛ ngɛ Israel ma a hae ɔ ngɛ se lokoo; se zugba a nitsɛ lɛɛ o be nɔ yae.”

Title: MOSE V, 33
Content:
Mose gbaa Israel wɛtso ɔmɛ
1Gbaami munyuhi nɛ Mawu nɔmlɔ, Mose kɛ gbaa Israel bi ɔmɛ loko e gbo ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ.
2Yawɛ kple si kɛ je Sinai yo ɔ nɔ
kaa pu nɛ gba ngɛ Edom yo ɔ nɔ,
nɛ e tso ha e ma a kɛ je Paran yo ɔ he.
Mawu bɔfohi akpe nyɔngma piɛ e he;
a ngɛ kaa la nɛ ngɛ tsoe plamplam ngɛ e hiɔ nɔ.
3Yawɛ suɔ e ma a;
nihi nɛ ji e ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ ɔ,
e baa a yi.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, wa kplaa si ngɛ e nane nya;
wa jaa lɛ, nɛ wa yeɔ e mlaa amɛ a nɔ.
4Wa yeɔ mlaa nɛ Mose wo wɔ ɔ nɔ;
ejakaa wa ma a weto ní nitsɛnitsɛ
ji Mawu mlaa a nɛ.
5Benɛ Israel wɛtso ɔmɛ, kɛ nikɔtɔma amɛ tsuo
ba bua a he nya a,
Yawɛ ba pee a matsɛ.
6Bɔ nɛ Mose gbaa Ruben wɛtso ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ:
“E ngɛ mi kaa Ruben bi ɔmɛ a he pi lɛɛ,
se a yi nɛ na wami nɛ a ko gbo.”
7Bɔ nɛ e gbaa Yuda wɛtso ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ:
“Yawɛ, moo bu Yuda bi ɔmɛ a kue fami tue.
Mo bua a kɛ wɛtso kpa amɛ a nya,
nɛ o pee mɛ kake.
Yawɛ, moo hwu a ta a ha mɛ,
nɛ a ye a he nyɛli ɔmɛ a nɔ.”
8 Jehanɛ, Mose gbaa Levi wɛtso ɔ hulɔ ke,
“Yawɛ, mo je o suɔmi kpo
kɛ gu Tumim kɛ Urim a nɔ.
Ní nɛ ɔmɛ ji níhi nɛ Levi bi ɔmɛ,
nɛ ji sɔmɔli nɛ yeɔ mo anɔkuale ɔ
kɛ biɔ mo gbi ɔ nɛ.
O ka Levi wɛtso ɔ ngɛ Masa,
nɛ o kɛ mɛ pɛ
ngɛ Meriba pa a nya.
9A ngmɛɛ we o he,
se mohu a kua a fɔli,
kɛ a nyɛminyumu ɔmɛ, kɛ a bimɛ.
A bu o gbi tue,
nɛ a ye o somi ɔ nɔ.
10A maa tsɔɔ Israel bi ɔmɛ o mlaa a,
konɛ a ye nɔ.
A maa sã bɔ ɔmɛ ngɛ o bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ.
11Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yawɛ, moo gbaa Levi bi ɔmɛ,
nɛ a he nɛ wa.
Ha nɛ a pee nɔ́ nɛ maa sa o hɛ mi.
Moo ku a he nyɛli ɔmɛ tsuo a mi kɛ pue si,
nɛ a ko te si gblegbleegble.”
12Bɔ nɛ Mose gbaa Benyamin wɛtso ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ:
“Yawɛ suɔ Benyamin bi ɔmɛ a sane,
nɛ e baa a yi.
E buu a he daa ligbi,
nɛ e kɛ mɛ ngɛ.”
13Bɔ nɛ e gbaa Yosef wɛtso ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ:
“Mawu nɛ gbaa a zugba a;
hiɔmi nɛ nɛ kɛ pue nɔ,
nɛ a ná nyu kɛ je zugba a mi hulɔ.
14A gbaa zugba a;
tso yiblii nɛ fu ngɛ nɔ;
tso yiblii kpakpahi babauu
nɛ ba ngɛ a be mi.
15Tso yiblii ngɔngɔɛhi nɛ ha blema yo ɔmɛ a nɔ.
16A na ní kpakpahi ngɛ a zugba a nɔ.
Yawɛ nɛ gbaa ní ɔmɛ a nɔ.
Lɛ nɔ nɛ e tu munyu kɛ je mio tso
nɛ ngɛ tsoe mi ɔ,
é gbaa Yosef wɛtso ɔ kɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo.
Ejakaa lɛ ji e nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ a hɛngmɛ.
17Yosef he wa kaa na ku;
se e tsuɔ ní kaa na yo
nɛ hɛ mi wo la.
E he wami ɔ bɔbɔyoo pɛ lɛ ngɛ Manase;
se hiɛhiɛɛ ɔ ngɛ Efraim.
Yosef buaa a nya kɛ fieɔ a he nyɛli ɔmɛ
kɛ yaa se lokoo
kaa bɔ nɛ na kɛ e kolihi siɔ nɔ ɔ.”
18Bɔ nɛ Mose gbaa Zebulun kɛ Isakar wɛtso ɔmɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ:
“Zebulun nɛ ya nɔ saminya
ngɛ wo nɔ jua yemi mi.
Isakar nɛ na ní,
nɛ e pee kplɔkɔtɔtsɛ ngɛ we.
19A maa kpee nibwɔhi kɛ ba a yo ɔmɛ a nɔ,
nɛ a maa sã bɔ nɛ sa ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.
A ma na ní kɛ je wo mi,
nɛ a ma na ní kɛ je wo nya zia hu mi.”
20Bɔ nɛ Mose gbaa Gad wɛtso ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ:
“Á je Mawu yi;
lɛ nɛ bli Gad zugba a huzu mi.
Gad woɔ ká kaa jata
nɛ kplɔ lohwe ko kɔni,
loo e tsɔ e yi ngɛ nya.
21Benɛ Israel ma nimeli ɔmɛ ba bua a he nya a,
Gad bi ɔmɛ ngɔ zugba a he nɛ hi pe kulaa a
ngɔ ha a he.
A ná nɔkɔtɔma blɔ nya.
A bu Yawɛ gbi tue,
nɛ a ye e mlaa amɛ a nɔ.”
22Bɔ nɛ Mose gbaa Dan wɛtso ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ:
“Dan ngɛ kaa jata bi;
e hii tuue ngɛ Bashan yo ɔ nɔ.”
23Bɔ nɛ Mose gbaa Naftali wɛtso ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ:
“Yawɛ mi mi jɔ ha Naftali bi ɔmɛ;
e ha mɛ ní kpakpahi;
e ha mɛ zugba kɛ je wo ɔ nya kɛ ya su leneyi je.”
24Bɔ nɛ Mose gbaa Asher wɛtso ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ:
“Asher ji wɛtso nɛ a gbaa pe kulaa
ngɛ wɛtso ɔmɛ tsuo a kpɛti.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Asher nɛ ba pee kaa bi
nɛ a suɔ lɛ pe bimɛ ɔmɛ tsuo,
nɛ́ oliv tso babauu nɛ ba a zugba a nɔ.
25Á ma a ma amɛ a nya dade agbohi,
konɛ a na he wami daa.”
26Nyagbe ɔ, bɔ nɛ Mose gbaa Israel ma a tsuo ji nɛ ɔ nɛ:
“Israel ma, mawu ko mawu ko be kaa
nyɛ Mawu ɔ nɛ nyɛɛɔ kɔɔhiɔ mi kɛ agboje
kɛ jee hiɔwe kɛ ba jee ngmlaa ha nyɛ ɔ.
27Mawu nɛ ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene ɔ ji nyɛ wesa he.
Lɛ ji nɔ nɛ baa nyɛ yi daa.
Lɛ ji nɔ nɛ fie nyɛ he nyɛli ɔmɛ ngɛ nyɛ hɛ mi,
nɛ e de nyɛ ke nyɛ kpata mɛ tsuo a hɛ mi ɔ nɛ.
28Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yakob nina maa hi si
ngɛ tue mi jɔmi mi;
a nine maa su zugba kpakpa nɔ,
he nɛ bɔ́ nɛɔ ngɛ,
nɛ́ blɛfo kɛ wai baa saminya ngɛ.
29A gbaa nyɛ, Israel ma.
Ma ko ma ko be kaa nyɛ
