68We puɔ nya dali nɛ kpale kɛ ba a, a ti ni komɛ nɛ ba Yawɛ we ɔ ngɛ Yerusalem ɔ je a tsui mi faa ke ní amlɔ nɔuu, konɛ a kɛ ma Yawɛ we ɔ ekohu ngɛ he nɛ e ma sa a.
69A ha bɔ nɛ a ma nyɛ, konɛ a kɛ tsu ní ɔ. Bɔ nɛ a ha ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: sika tsu kilo 500 sika hiɔ kilo 2,800 osɔfohi a tade 100.
70 Osɔfo ɔmɛ, Levi bi ɔmɛ, kɛ ni kpa komɛ hi Yerusalem kɛ kɔpehi nɛ bɔle ma a; lali ɔmɛ, Yawɛ we ɔ he buli ɔmɛ, kɛ we ɔ he ní tsuli ɔmɛ hi mɛ nitsɛmɛ a ma amɛ a mi. Israel bi nɛ piɛ ɔ, mɛɛ lɛɛ mahi nɛ a nɛmɛ hi mi ɔ, lejɛ ɔmɛ ji he nɛ a hi.

Title: EZRA 3
Content:
A bɔni Mawu jami ekohu ngɛ Yerusalem
1Nyɔhiɔ kpaagone ɔ, benɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ kpale ba he si ngɛ a ma amɛ a mi ɔ, ma a tsuo ba bua a he nya ngɛ Yerusalem. 2 Yehozadak bi Yoshua, e nyɛmimɛ osɔfo ɔmɛ, kɛ Sheatiel bi Zerubabel, kɛ e weku li ɔmɛ ba ma Israel Mawu ɔ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ ekohu, konɛ a sã sami bɔhi ngɛ nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ Mawu nɔmlɔ Mose mlaa a tsɔɔ ɔ. 3 Ni ɔmɛ nɛ kpale kɛ je ma se kɛ ba a ngɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ loko a ba a gbeye yee, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a ma bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ ngɔ ma sisi tomi momo ɔ nɔ, nɛ a bɔni sami bɔhi sami ngɛ nɔ daa ligbi mɔtu kɛ gbɔkuɛ. 4 A ye Gbasisihimi nyami ɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ. Daa ligbi ɔ, a sãã sami bɔhi nɛ a to kɛ ha jamɛ a ligbi ɔ kaa bɔ nɛ mlaa tsɔɔ ɔ. 5 A sãã bɔ pɔtɛɛ nɛ ɔmɛ hulɔ: sami bɔhi nɛ a sãã nyami be kaa Nyɔhiɔhe nyami be mi, bɔhi nɛ a sãã daa ke ma a ba bua a he nya nɛ a ma ja Yawɛ kikɛ nɛ ɔ, kɛ bɔhi tsuo nɛ nihi jeɔ a tsui mi faa nɛ a kɛ ba haa Yawɛ. 6Kɛ je nyɔhiɔ kpaagone ɔ we klekleekle ligbi ɔ, a bɔni sami bɔ sami kɛ ha Yawɛ. Se Mawu we ɔ sisi tomi ɔ nitsɛ lɛɛ a na we nɛ a fia.
A bɔni Mawu we ɔ mami ekohu
7Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, ma a ha sika nɛ a kɛ wo tɛ gbali ɔmɛ, kɛ tso he ní tsuli ɔmɛ hiɔ, nɛ a ha niye ní, dã, kɛ oliv nu, nɛ a kɛ ya he seda tso ngɛ Tiro kɛ Sidon ngɛ Lebanon zugba a nɔ. A kɛ tso ɔmɛ gu wo nɔ kɛ ba Yopa. Persia matsɛ, Sirus lɛ ngmɛ blɔ kaa a pee ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo. 8Benɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ ba su Yerusalem, he nɛ Mawu we ɔ hi ɔ, jeha enyɔne ɔ we nyɔhiɔ nɛ ji enyɔ ɔ mi ɔ, a je Yawɛ we ɔ mami sisi. Shealtiel bi Zerubabel, Yozadak bi Yoshua, kɛ ma a nɛ a wo ní tsumi ɔ nɔ. Osɔfo ɔmɛ, Levi bi ɔmɛ, kɛ nihí tsuo nɛ kpale kɛ je ma se kɛ ba a hu piɛ a he. A ngɔ Levi bi, nihi nɛ ye jeha nyingmi enyɔ, aloo ni nɛmɛ nɛ ye pe ja ngɔ to ní tsumi ɔ nya konɛ a hyɛ nɔ. 9Yeshua, Levi no ɔ, e bimɛ ɔmɛ, e weku li, kɛ Kadmiel kɛ lɛ hu e bimɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a je Yuda we puɔ ɔ nya a ngɔ fɔ a nɔ kaa a maa hyɛ Mawu we ɔ mami ní tsumi ɔ nɔ. (Levi bi nɛ je Henadad we puɔ nya a piɛ a he).
10 Benɛ tsu mali ɔmɛ bɔni Mawu we ɔ sisi tomi ɔ fiami ɔ, osɔfo ɔmɛ kɛ a he tade ɔmɛ kɛ a dɛ mi titimati ya da a blɔ hehi. Levi bi nɛ je Asaf we puɔ ɔ nya a hu hɛɛ gɔgɔhi ngɛ a dɛ kɛ ya da si ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. A je Yawɛ yi kaa bɔ nɛ Matsɛ David to blɔ nya ha mɛ kɛ je blema a. 11 Ma kpekpemi ɔ la yi jemi la, kɛ sina la kɛ ha Yawɛ; nɛ munyu nɛ a kɛ heɔ la a nɔ ɔ, a ti mi si abɔ ke,
“Yawɛ hi, nɛ e suɔmi nɛ e kɛ suɔ Israel ɔ ngɛ kɛ
yaa neneene.”
Jehanɛ benɛ a fia Yawɛ we ɔ sisi tomi ɔ ta a, ma kpekpemi ɔ tsuo hwɔ lele nɛ a je Mawu yi. 12Benɛ osɔfo ɔmɛ ekomɛ, Levi bi ɔmɛ ekomɛ, we puɔ nya dali ɔmɛ ekomɛ, kɛ nimeli nɛ le bɔ nɛ Mawu we ɔ ngɛ sa a, na Mawu we ɔ sisi tomi nɛ ɔ fiami kikɛ nɛ ɔ, a wo yana boboobo. Se ni kpa amɛ nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ lɛɛ ose ɔ kɛkɛ a ngɛ hee wawɛɛ kɛ ngɛ nyae. 13Nɛ́ e ba mi ja a, ma mi bi ɔmɛ li slɔɔto nɛ ngɛ lele nɛ a ngɛ hwɔe, kɛ yana nɛ a wo ɔ a kpɛti; ejakaa bubuubui nɛ a ngɛ kpae ɔ nya wa wawɛɛ nitsɛ, nɛ a ngɛ he nue ngɛ se lokoo.

Title: EZRA 4
Content:
He nyɛli te si kɛ si Mawu we ɔ mami
1Benɛ Yuda bi ɔmɛ, kɛ Benyamin bi ɔmɛ a he nyɛli ɔmɛ nu kaa nihi nɛ kpale kɛ je ma se kɛ ba a ba bɔni Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ we ɔ mami ekohu ɔ, 2 a ba na Zerubabel, kɛ we puɔ nya dali ɔmɛ, nɛ a de mɛ ke, “Nyɛ ha nɛ waa piɛ nyɛ he kɛ ma Mawu we ɔ, ejakaa Mawu kake ɔ nɛ nyɛ jaa a, lɛ wɔ hu wa jaa. Kɛ je Asiria matsɛ, Esarhadon nɛ ngɔ wɔ kɛ ba hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ yi nɔ ɔ, lɛ ji Mawu nɛ wa jaa nɛ wa sãã bɔ kɛ haa.”
3Se Zerubabel, Yoshua, kɛ Israel we puɔ nya dali ɔmɛ tsuo de mɛ ke, “Ke wa ngɛ Yawɛ, wa Mawu ɔ we mae ha lɛ ɔ, e kɔ we nyɛ he nɔ́ ko kulaa. Wɔ nitsɛmɛ wa maa ma wa ní kaa bɔ nɛ Persia matsɛ, Sirus fa wɔ ɔ.”
4Se nihi nɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ ɔ wo Yuda bi ɔmɛ a he gbeye, konɛ a nine mi nɛ je wu, nɛ a ko nyɛ Mawu we ɔ nɛ a ma. 5Zugba a nɔ bi ɔmɛ ya konɛ a ya tsi ní tsumi ɔ nya. A bɔ mɔde kaa a maa tsi ni tsumi nya be mi nɛ Matsɛ Sirus ngɛ tsɛ yee ɔ hluu kɛ ya su Matsɛ Darius yi nɔ.
He nyɛli te si kɛ si Yerusalem ma a pomi
6 Benɛ Ahazuerus bɔni tsɛ yemi pɛ kɛkɛ nɛ Yuda kɛ Yerusalem bi ɔmɛ a he nyɛli ngma womi kɛ ya po a nya.
7Benɛ Persia matsɛ, Artaherhes ngɛ tsɛ yee ɔ hu Bishlam, Mitredat, kɛ Tabeel kɛ a huɛmɛ ɔmɛ nɛ piɛ ɔ, ngma womi kɛ ya ha matsɛ ɔ. A ngma ngɛ Aram gbi mi, nɛ a tsɔɔ sisi ha matsɛ ɔ.
8Amlaalo Rehum, kɛ Shimshai, ma pɛdiyo ɔ hu ngma Yerusalem ma a he womi ya ha Matsɛ Artaherhes.
9Nihi nɛ piɛ amlaalo Rehum, kɛ Shimshai a he kɛ ngma womi ɔ ji a huɛmɛ, kojoli, kɛ ma ní tsuli kpahi tsuo nɛ je Erek, Babilon, kɛ Susa ngɛ Elam zugba a nɔ, 10kɛ nihi nɛ je ma kpahi babauu a nɔ. Matsɛ ngua Ashurbanipal lɛ nuu nimli nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ je a mahi a mi kɛ ba Samaria, kɛ he kpahi nɛ ngɛ Yufrate pa a se.
11Womi nɛ a ngma a mi munyu ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “O tsɔli nɛ ngɛ Yufrate pa a se ɔ nɛ a ngɛ mo, Matsɛ Artaherhes womi nɛ ɔ ngmae. 12Nɛnɛ, wa ngɛ hae nɛ o le kaa Yuda bi ɔmɛ nɛ je o ngɔ kɛ ba a ba to si ngɛ Yerusalem, nɛ a bɔni jamɛ a atuã tsɔli, kɛ yiwutsotsɛmɛ a ma a mami ekohu. A bɔni gbogbo ɔmɛ fiami, nɛ e be kɛe kulaa nɛ a maa po ma a kɛ gbe nya. 13Nɛnɛ, ná nɛ o le kaa ke a po ma a gbe nya a, a be tó, loo sika ko woe hu, nɛ sika be matsɛ nito he ɔ bae bɔ nɛ sa. 14Nɛnɛ, akɛnɛ wa ngɛ o nɔ yemi ɔ sisi, nɛ wa sume kaa o hɛ mi nɛ pue si he je ɔ, wa ngɛ hae nɛ o le nɔ́ nɛ ɔ. 15Ha nɛ a hyɛ o nɛmɛ ɔmɛ a yi nɔ sanehi womi ɔmɛ a mi fitsofitso. Ke o pee ja a, o maa na kaa ma nɛ ɔ, kɛ je blema a, atuã pɛ a tsɔɔ; a nɔ yemi yee. A matsɛmɛ, kɛ nihi nɛ yeɔ kpokpa amɛ a nɔ ɔ, a dooɔ a nya. Enɛ ɔ he je nɛ a kpata ma a hɛ mi ɔ nɛ. 16Nɛnɛ, wa ngɛ hae nɛ o na nɛ o le kaa ke a fia gbogbo ɔmɛ gbe nya, nɛ a po ma a ekohu ɔ, ma amɛ nɛ ngɛ Yufrate pa a se ɔ be o nɔ yemi he pee hu.”
17Matsɛ ɔ ha mɛ womi ɔ heto ke, “Amlaalo Rehum, ma pɛdiyo Shimshai, kɛ nyɛ huɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ Samaria, kɛ nihi nɛ ngɛ kpokpa amɛ a nɔ ngɛ Yufrate pa a se, nyɛ he manye! 18Womi nɛ nyɛ ngma a, a kane ha mi, nɛ i nu sisi saminya. 19I fa, nɛ a hla níhi a mi fitsofitso. I ná le kaa kɛ je blema a, Yerusalem ma teɔ si kɛ woɔ matsɛmɛ. Niinɛ, a tsɔɔ atuã, nɛ a puɛɔ ma mi bi a tue. 20Jehanɛ hu, a na kaa matsɛ nguahi hi Yerusalem sa a, nɛ a ye ma a nɔ kɛ ya pue Yufrate pa a se tsuo; nɛ Yerusalem he tó, kɛ sika kpahi ngɛ ma amɛ a dɛ. 21Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ fa nimli ɔmɛ nɛ a kpa ma a pomi kɛ yaa si be nɛ gbi maa je imi nitsɛ ye nya. 22Nyɛɛ tsi a nya esɔ nɛ a ko ba puɛ ní ha mi.”
23Benɛ Rehum, Shimshai, kɛ a huɛmɛ ɔmɛ nu womi nɛ Artaherhes ngma a mi munyu ɔ, a pue nɔ amlɔ nɔuu kɛ ho Yerusalem ya, nɛ a ya nyɛ Yuda bi ɔmɛ a nɔ nɛ a kpa ní tsumi ɔ.
A je Mawu we ɔ mami sisi ekohu
24 Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Mawu we ɔ nɛ ngɛ Yerusalem he ní tsumi ɔ tlɔ fã jã hluu kɛ ya su Persia matsɛ, Darius yi nɔ jeha enyɔne ɔ.

Title: EZRA 5
Content:
1Jehanɛ gbali enyɔ, Hagai kɛ Ido bi Zakaria ba bɔni fiɛmi ngɛ Yuda kɛ Yerusalem ngɛ Israel Mawu ɔ nɛ hyɛɔ a nɔ ɔ biɛ mi. 2 Kɛkɛ nɛ Shealtiel bi Zerubabel, kɛ Yehozadak bi Yoshua ya bɔni Mawu we ɔ mami ekohu, nɛ Mawu gbali ɔmɛ piɛ a he kɛ tsu ní ɔ.
3Jamɛ a be ɔ mi kɛ̃ ɔ, amlaalo Tatenai nɛ ngɛ Yufrate pa a se ɔ, kɛ Sheta Bozenai, kɛ a nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ ba Yerusalem, nɛ a ba bi ke, “Mɛnɔ ha nyɛ he wami ke nyɛɛ ma Mawu we ɔ, nɛ nyɛɛ fia gbogbo ɔ?” 4A ya nɔ bi ke, “Nyɛɛ tsɔɔ wɔ nihi nɛ ngɛ we ɔ mae ɔ a biɛhi.” 5Se Mawu piɛ Yuda ma nimeli ɔmɛ a he, nɛ Persia bi ɔmɛ tsi we ní tsumi ɔ nya ha mɛ. Mohu ɔ, Persia bi ɔmɛ to a yi mi kaa a maa ngma womi ya ha Darius, nɛ a maa mlɛ kɛ yaa si a nine maa su heto nɔ. 6Womi nɛ amlaalo Tatenai, kɛ Sheta Bozenai, kɛ a nyɛmimɛ tsɔli nɛ ngɛ Yufrate pa a se ɔ ngma ya ha Matsɛ Darius ji nɛ ɔ nɛ:
7“Matsɛ Darius, o yi nɔ nɛ jɔ!
8“Nɛnɛ, wa ngɛ hae nɛ o le kaa wa ya Yuda, he nɛ Mawu kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ we ɔ ngɛ ɔ. Wa na kaa a ngɔ tɛ agboagbohi kɛ ngɛ gbogbo ɔ fiae, nɛ a ngɛ tso toe kɛ ngɛ nɔ puee. Ni ɔmɛ ngɛ ní tsumi ɔ tsue kɛ hɛdɔ, nɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ ngɛ nɔ yae bɔ nɛ sa.
9“Wa bi Yuda ma nimeli ɔmɛ ke a tsɔɔ wɔ nɔ nɛ ha mɛ he wami kaa a ma Mawu we ɔ ekohu, nɛ a fia gbogbo ɔ. 10Wa bi a biɛhi hulɔ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ wa ha nɛ o le ní tsumi ɔ nya dali.
11“Heto nɛ a ha wɔ ji, ‘Hiɔwe kɛ zugba Mawu ɔ tsɔli ji wɔ. We nɛ Israel matsɛ nguaa ko ma nɛ e gbe nya blema lokoo ɔ, lɔ ɔ wa ngɛ mae ekohu. 12 Akɛnɛ wa nɛmɛ ɔmɛ wo hiɔwe Mawu ɔ mi mi la he je ɔ, e ngɔ mɛ ngɔ wo Babilonia matsɛ, Nebukadnezer, Kaldea no ɔ dɛ mi. Nebukadnezer ba ku Mawu we ɔ ngɔ pue si, nɛ e nuu ni ɔmɛ nyɔguɛ kɛ ho Babilonia ya. 13 Pee se, benɛ Matsɛ Sirus ba ngɛ tsɛ yee ngɛ Babilonia a, kekleekle jeha a mi ɔ, e fa ke a ma we ɔ ekohu. 14Sika tsu, kɛ sika hiɔ níhi nɛ Nebukadnezer ba muɔ ngɛ Mawu we ɔ ngɛ Yerusalem kɛ ya wo lɛ, Nebukadnezer lɛɛ e mawu ɔ we ɔ ngɛ Babilon ɔ, matsɛ ɔ ngɔ ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ngɔ ha Sheshbazar. Matsɛ Sirus wo nyumu nɛ ɔ amlaalo ngɛ Yuda. 15Matsɛ ɔ de lɛ ke e ngɔ ní ɔmɛ kɛ ya Mawu we ɔ ngɛ Yerusalem, nɛ e ya ma Mawu we ɔ ekohu ngɛ he nɛ we ɔ hi kekle ɔ. 16Kɛkɛ nɛ Sheshbazar ba nɛ e ba fia we ɔ sisi tomi ɔ ngɛ Yerusalem. Kɛ je jamɛ a be ɔ hluu kɛ ba su amlɔ nɛ ɔ, a ngɛ we ɔ he ní tsue, se a gbi nya lolo!’
17“Nɛnɛ, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke o suɔ ɔ, ha nɛ a hyɛ matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a yi nɔ sanehi womi ɔmɛ a mi ngɛ Babilon kaa e ngɛ mi niinɛ kaa Matsɛ Sirus fa ke a ma Mawu we ɔ ekohu ngɛ Yerusalem lo. Ke o na anɔkuale ɔ, konɛ o ha nɛ waa le bɔ nɛ o susu ngɛ sane nɛ ɔ he.”

Title: EZRA 6
Content:
A ya na mlaa nɛ Matsɛ Sirus wo ɔ
1Kɛkɛ nɛ Matsɛ Darius fa, nɛ a ya kpa matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a yi nɔ sanehi womihi nɛ ngɛ Babilon ɔ a mi fitsofitso. 2Se Ekbatana nɛ ji ma ngua nɛ ngɛ Media kpokpa a nɔ ɔ loko a ya na womi kpo ko ngɛ. Nɔ́ nɛ a ngma ngɛ mi ji, “Sane ko nɛ ba!
3“Benɛ Matsɛ Sirus ngɛ tsɛ yee ɔ, kekleekle jeha a mi ɔ, e fa ke a ya ma Mawu we ɔ ngɛ Yerusalem ekohu, konɛ a sã bɔhi, kɛ sami bɔhi ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Mawu we ɔ hiɔwe yami nɛ pee gugue nyɔngma kɛ enuɔ, nɛ e blimi hu nɛ pee gugue nyɔngma kɛ enuɔ. 4Ke a ngɔ tɛ agboagbohi kɛ wo zã etɛ ɔ, kɛkɛ á ngɔ tso hu kɛ wo zã kake hu kɛ fɔ nɔ. Á ngɔ sika ngɛ matsɛ ɔ nito he ɔ kɛ wo ní tsumi ɔ tsuo he hiɔ. 5Jehanɛ hu, sika tsu, kɛ sika hiɔ níhi nɛ Matsɛ Nebukadnezer ya muɔ ngɛ Mawu we ɔ ngɛ Yerusalem kɛ ba Babilon ɔ, á ngɔ ya to a blɔ hehi pɛpɛɛpɛ ngɛ Mawu we ɔ ngɛ Yerusalem.”
Darius fa ke a tsa ní tsumi ɔ nɔ
6Kɛkɛ nɛ Matsɛ Darius tsɔ kɛ heto nɛ ɔ kɛ mane ke,
“Mo amlaalo Tatenai, kɛ Sheta Bozenai, kɛ nyɛ nyɛmimɛ tsɔli nɛ nyɛ ngɛ Yufrate pa a se!
“Nyɛ je nyɛ nine ngɛ ní tsumi ɔ he. 7Nyɛ ko tsi Mawu we ɔ mami nya. Nyɛɛ ngmɛɛ Yuda amlaalo ɔ, kɛ Yuda ma nimeli ɔmɛ a he nɛ a ma Mawu we ɔ ngɛ he nɛ e hi sa a. 8Jehanɛ, nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ fae nɛ nyɛɛ pee ha Yuda ma nimeli ɔmɛ ngɛ ní tsumi ɔ he ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. Tó nɛ a ma na kɛ je Yufrate pa a se kɛ wo matsɛ nito he ɔ, hiɔ nɛ a maa bɔ ngɛ ní tsumi ɔ he ɔ, a jé tó ɔ mi eko kɛ ha Yuda ma nimeli ɔmɛ nɛ a kɛ wo hiɔ ɔ tsuo ngɛ be nɛ sa mi. 9Níhi tsuo nɛ maa hia nɛ osɔfo ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ Yerusalem ɔ ma bi kɛ maa sã sami bɔ ha hiɔwe Mawu ɔ, na kuyo, agbosu, jijɔ, ngma, ngo, dã, loo oliv nu ɔ, nyɛ ha mɛ daa ligbi nɛ nyɛ ko po mi. 10Nyɛɛ pee jã, konɛ a nyɛ nɛ a sã bɔhi nɛ maa sa Mawu nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ hɛ mi, nɛ a kpa pɛɛ ha imi nitsɛ, kɛ ye bimɛ ɔmɛ nɛ wa yi nɛ na wami. 11I ngɛ fae hulɔ ke nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ma tɔ̃ mlaa nɛ ɔ, a hia e tsu yi mi plai kake kɛ ma si nɛ a sɛu lɛ ngɛ nɔ; nɛ e we ɔ hu nɛ plɛ pee kuku. 12Matsɛ tsuaa matsɛ, loo ma tsuaa ma nɛ maa te si kɛ si mlaa nɛ ɔ, nɛ́ ma hla kaa a kpata Mawu we ɔ hɛ mi ɔ, Mawu ɔ nɛ hla Yerusalem ngɔ to kaa e hi he ɔ nɛ kpata a hɛ mi. Imi Darius nɛ i ngɛ mlaa nɛ ɔ woe. Á ye nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.”
A bli Mawu we ɔ nya
13Tatenai, amlaalo nɛ ngɛ Yufrate pa a se ɔ, kɛ Sheta Bozenai, kɛ a nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ pee bɔ nɛ Matsɛ Darius fa mɛ ke a pee ɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ. 14 Munyuhi nɛ gbalɔ Hagai kɛ Zakaria, Ido bi ɔ tu ɔ, wo Yuda ma nimeli ɔmɛ he wami nɛ a kɛ tsa ní tsumi ɔ nɔ kɛ ya si a gbe nya. A ma Mawu we ɔ gbe nya pɛpɛɛpɛ kaa bɔ nɛ Israel Mawu ɔ, kɛ Persia matsɛmɛ, Sirus, Darius, kɛ Artaherhes fa mɛ ke a pee ɔ. 15Benɛ Matsɛ Darius ngɛ tsɛ yee ɔ, jeha ekpane ɔ we nyɔhiɔ enyɔne ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ Adar a, jamɛ a be ɔ nɛ a gbe Mawu we ɔ mami nya. 16Kɛkɛ nɛ Israel ma a tsuo, osɔfo ɔmɛ, Levi bi ɔmɛ, kɛ nihi tsuo nɛ kpale kɛ je ma se kɛ ba a, ye Mawu we ɔ nya blimi nyami ligbi ɔ kɛ bua jɔmi. 17Benɛ a ngɛ Mawu we ɔ nya blie ɔ, Israel ma a ngɔ na ku lafa, agbosu lafa enyɔ, kɛ jijɔ lafa eywiɛ kɛ ba sã bɔ ha Mawu. A ngɔ akpakpo nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ hu kɛ ba sã yayami pami bɔ ngɛ Israel wɛtso nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ a nya. 18A to osɔfo ɔmɛ, kɛ Levi bi ɔmɛ ngɛ a we asafo kuu ɔmɛ a nya kɛ ha Mawu we ɔ sɔmɔmi ní tsumi ɔmɛ ngɛ Yerusalem, kaa bɔ nɛ a ngma ngɛ Mose mlaa womi ɔ mi ɔ.
Hetsɔmi nyami ligbi ɔ
19 Ma a tsuo nɛ kpale kɛ je ma se kɛ ba a, ye Hetsɔmi ɔ kekleekle nyɔhiɔ ɔ we ligbi nyɔngma kɛ eywiɛne ɔ. 20Jamɛ a be ɔ, osɔfo ɔmɛ, kɛ Levi bi ɔmɛ tsuo tsukɔ a he nɛ mɛ tsuo a he tsɔ. Lohwehi nɛ a kɛ maa pee kusumi kɛ ye Hetsɔmi ɔ, Levi bi ɔmɛ lɛ a gbe. A gbe lohwe nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ ha ma a tsuo nɛ kpale kɛ je ma se kɛ ba a, kɛ osɔfo ɔmɛ, kɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ hulɔ. 21Nihi nɛ ye ní nɛ ɔ ji Israel bi tsuo nɛ kpale kɛ je ma se kɛ ba a, kɛ nihi tsuo nɛ kpa wɔ jami, kɛ lejɛ ɔ zugba a mi bi ɔmɛ a kusumi yayami ɔmɛ, nɛ́ ba, konɛ a ba ja Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ. 22A kɛ bua jɔmi ye Abolokplolo nyami be ɔ ligbi kpaago. A bua jɔ saminya kaa Yawɛ ha Asiria matsɛ ɔ ná a he bua jɔmi, nɛ e piɛ a he nɛ a kɛ ma Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ we ɔ.

Title: EZRA 7
Content:
Ezra ba su Yerusalem
1Ní nɛ ɔmɛ a se benɛ Artaherhes ngɛ tsɛ yee ngɛ Persia zugba a nɔ ɔ, nyumu ko ba hi si. E biɛ ji Ezra. E tsɔɔ e weku kpa hluu kɛ ya pi osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma Aaron kikɛ nɛ ɔ: Ezra tsɛ ji Seraya, Seraya tsɛ ji Azaria, Azaria tsɛ ji Hilkia. 2Hilkia tsɛ ji Shalum, Shalum tsɛ ji Zadok, nɛ Zadok hu tsɛ ji Ahitub. 3Ahitub tsɛ ji Amaria, Amaria tsɛ ji Azaria, nɛ lɛ hu e tsɛ ji Merayot. 4Merayot tsɛ ji Zerahia, Zerahia tsɛ ji Uzi, nɛ Uzi tsɛ ji Buki. 5Buki tsɛ ji Abishua, Abishua tsɛ ji Finehas, Finehas tsɛ ji Eleazar, nɛ Eleazar tsɛ ji Aaron.
6-7Ezra nɛ ɔ, womi ngmalɔ ji lɛ, nɛ mlaa a nɛ Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ ngɔ ha Mose ɔ, e le lɛ tsuo fitsofitso. Akɛnɛ Yawɛ, Mawu ɔ nɛ Ezra jaa lɛ ɔ, gbaa Ezra he je ɔ, e nine su nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ e bi matsɛ ɔ nɔ. Matsɛ Artaherhes tsɛ yemi ɔ we jeha kpaagone ɔ mi ɔ, Ezra kɛ Israel bi komɛ hia blɔ kɛ je Babilonia kɛ ba Yerusalem. Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ ji osɔfohi, Levi bi, Mawu we ɔ lali, Mawu we ɔ buli, kɛ ní tsuli. 8-9A je Babilonia kekleekle nyɔhiɔ ɔ we kekle ligbi ɔ, nɛ Mawu dloomi nya a, a ba su Yerusalem nyɔhiɔ enuɔne ɔ we kekle ligbi ɔ. 10Ezra ngɔ e wami tsuo ngɔ ha kaa e maa kase Yawɛ mlaa a nɛ e tsu he ní. E suɔ hu kaa e maa tsɔɔ Israel ma a Mawu mlaa a, kɛ blɔ nya tomi ɔmɛ tsuo.
Matsɛ Artaherhes ha Ezra womi ko
11Womi nɛ Matsɛ Artaherhes ngɔ ha Ezra nɛ ji osɔfo, kɛ womi ngmalɔ nɛ le Yawɛ mlaa amɛ, kɛ blɔ nya tomi ɔmɛ fitsofitso kɛ ha Israel ma a ní tsɔɔmi ɔ mi munyu ji nɛ ɔ nɛ:
12“Osɔfo Ezra, mo womi ngmalɔ nɛ o le Mawu nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ mlaa a saminya; imi Matsɛ Artaherhes nɛ i ngɛ mo womi nɛ ɔ ngmae. Mo he manye!
13“Israel bi nɛ ngɛ ye nɔ yemi he ɔmɛ tsuo, a we osɔfohi, kɛ Levi bi nɛ a suɔ kaa a maa ya Yerusalem ɔ, i ngɛ fae ke a kɛ mo nɛ ya faa. 14I kɛ ye ga woli kpaago ɔmɛ wa ngɛ mo tsɔe kɛ yaa Yerusalem kɛ Yuda nɛ o ya slaa lejɛ ɔmɛ, konɛ o Mawu ɔ mlaa nɛ ngɛ o dɛ ɔ, o hyɛ bɔ nɛ a ngɛ nɔ yee ha. 15Sika tsu, kɛ sika hiɔ nike ní nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, ngɔɔ kɛ ya. Nike ní nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, i kɛ ye ga woli ɔmɛ wa je wa tsui mi faa wa ngɔ ke Israel Mawu ɔ nɛ e hi he ji Yerusalem ɔ. 16Ngɔɔ ní nɛ ɔmɛ hu kɛ piɛ he: sika hiɔ, sika tsu tsuo nɛ o ma bua nya ngɛ Babilonia zugba a nɔ, kɛ nike níhi nɛ Israel ma a, kɛ osɔfo ɔmɛ wo si kaa a ma ha kɛ je a tsui mi faa a; nɛ o ngɔ lɛ tsuo kɛ ya Mawu we ɔ nɛ ngɛ Yerusalem ɔ.
17“Hyɛ sika nɛ ɔ nɔ saminya, konɛ o kɛ he na kuhi, agbosuhi, jijɔhi, blɛfo, kɛ wai, nɛ o kɛ ya sã bɔ ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ ngɛ nyɛ Mawu ɔ we ɔ ngɛ Yerusalem. 18Sika tsu, kɛ sika hiɔ nɛ maa piɛ ngɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ a hemi se ɔ, nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ sa o kɛ o nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ nyɛ hɛ mi kaa nyɛɛ kɛ maa pee, nɛ maa sa Mawu hɛ mi ɔ, nyɛɛ pee. 19Níhi tsuo nɛ a ngɔ ha mo nɛ a kɛ sɔmɔ ngɛ O Mawu we ɔ, ngɔɔ kɛ ya ha Mawu ngɛ Yerusalem. 20Enɛ ɔmɛ a se ke ní kpa komɛ a he maa hia nɛ a kɛ ma tsu ní ngɛ o Mawu ɔ we ɔ, yaa ngɔ sika ngɛ matsɛ ɔ nito he ɔ nɛ a kɛ pee.
21“Imi Matsɛ Artaherhes, i ngɛ nyɛ matsɛ nito he ɔ nɔ hyɛli tsuo nɛ ngɛ Yufrate pa a se ɔ mlaa woe ke nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ osɔfo Ezra, Mawu nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ mlaa tsɔɔlɔ ɔ ma bi nyɛ ɔ, nyɛ ha lɛ esɔ. 22Níhi nɛ e ma bi nyɛ ɔ, nyɛ ha lɛ kɛ yaa su kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ: sika hiɔ kilo 3,400; ngma kilo 10,000; wai tɔ nyingmi enuɔ oliv nu tɔ nyingmi enuɔ kɛ ngo bɔ tsuaa bɔ.
23“Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ Mawu nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ ma fa nyɛ ke nyɛ tsu ngɛ we ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ pee pɛpɛɛpɛ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ e mi mi ko ba fu imi, loo nihi nɛ ma ba ye tsɛ ngɛ ye se ɔ. 24I ngɛ hae nɛ nyɛɛ le hu kaa mlaa ngmɛ́ blɔ kaa nyɛ heɔ tó ko kulaa ngɛ nimli nɛ ɔmɛ a dɛ: osɔfohi, Levi bi, Mawu we ɔ lali, agbo nya buli, sɔmɔli ngɛ Mawu we ɔ, loo tsɔli kpahi ngɛ Mawu we ɔ.
25“Mo Ezra, ngɔɔ nile nɛ Mawu ha mo ɔ kɛ tsu nɔ́ nɛ ɔ; moo hla ma a nɔ hyɛli, kɛ kojoli, nihi nɛ le o Mawu ɔ mlaa a, nɛ́ a hyɛ ye nɔ yemi he ɔ nɔ ngɛ pa a se. Ni nɛmɛ nɛ li mlaa a, tsɔɔ mɛ. 26Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ma tɔ̃ o Mawu ɔ mlaa a, aloo imi matsɛ, ye mlaa a, a gbla e tue nɔuu; a gbe lɛ, loo a je lɛ we, loo a kpɔ e níhi ngɛ e dɛ, aloo a wo lɛ tsu.”
Ezra je Mawu yi
27Ezra la kɛ je Mawu yi ke, “Á je Yawɛ, wa nɛmɛ a Mawu ɔ yi. Lɛ nɛ e kɛ susumi kpakpa wo matsɛ ɔ yi mi kaa e pee nɔ́ ko kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ kɛ wo Mawu we ɔ nɛ ngɛ Yerusalem ɔ hɛ mi nyami. 28Mawu dloomi nya a, matsɛ ɔ, kɛ e ga woli ɔmɛ, kɛ e ma ní tsuli kpanaa amɛ tsuo ná ye he bua jɔmi. Yawɛ, ye Mawu ɔ wo mi kã, nɛ i bua Israel ma nimeli ɔmɛ a nya, konɛ i kɛ mɛ tsuo waa kpale kɛ ya Yerusalem.”

Title: EZRA 8
Content:
Nihi nɛ kpale kɛ je ma se kɛ ba
1We puɔ nya dali nɛ kɛ Ezra kpale kɛ je Babilonia kɛ ba Yerusalem ngɛ Matsɛ Artaherhes yi nɔ ɔ ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ:
2-14Gershom, Finehas we puɔ nya.
Daniel, Itama we puɔ nya.
Shekania bi Hatush, David we puɔ nya.
Zakaria, kɛ nihi 150, Parosh we puɔ nya
(womihi ngɛ nɛ tsɔɔ a powu).
Zerahia bi Eliehoenai, kɛ nihi 200, Pahat Moab we puɔ nya.
Yahaziel bi Shekania kɛ nihi 300, Zatu we puɔ nya.
Yonatan Ebed, kɛ nihi 50, Adin we puɔ nya.
Atalia bi Yeshaya, kɛ nihi 70, Elam we puɔ nya.
Mikael bi Zebadia, kɛ nihi 80, Shefatia we puɔ nya.
Yehiel bi Obadia, kɛ nihi 218, Yoab we puɔ nya.
Yosifia bi Shelomit, kɛ nihi 160, Bani we puɔ nya.
Bebai bi Zakaria, kɛ nihi 28, Bebai we puɔ nya.
Hakatan bi Yohanan, kɛ nihi 110, Azgad we puɔ nya
Elifelet, Yeuel, Shemaya, kɛ nihi 60, Adonikan we puɔ nya (mɛɛ lɛɛ pee se loko a kpale kɛ ba).
Utai, Zakur, kɛ nihi 70, Bigvai we puɔ nya.
Ezra hla Levi bi nɛ a sɔmɔ ngɛ Mawu we ɔ
15I bua ni ɔmɛ tsuo a nya kɛ ho pa nɛ bee kɛ yaa Ahava ma a mi ɔ nya ya. Wa hi lejɛ ɔ ligbi etɛ. I na osɔfohi ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, se Levi bi ɔmɛ lɛɛ a ti nɔ ko nɔ ko be a kpɛti. 16Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i tsɔ nɛ a ya tsɛ ma nimeli nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ ba: Eliezer, Ariel, Shemaya, Elnatan, Yarib, Elnatan, Natan, Zakaria, kɛ Meshulam. Yoyarib kɛ Elnatan nɛ a juɛmi mi kuɔ saminya a hu piɛ a he. 17I tsɔ mɛ Yuda bi ɔmɛ a nyatsɛ Ido ngɔ ngɛ Kasifia ma a mi. Sɛ gbi nɛ i ha mɛ kɛ ho ji kaa a ya de lɛ, Ido ɔ, kɛ e nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ nɛ tsuɔ ní ngɛ Mawu we ɔ ke a ha wɔ sɔmɔli nɛ a ba tsu ní ngɛ Mawu we ɔ ngɛ Yerusalem. 18Mawu dloomi nya a, a ha wɔ Sherebia, nyumu ko nɛ hɛ mi ka si. E je Mahli we puɔ nya. E tsɛ ji Levi, nɛ e nɛ̃ biɛ ji Israel. E kɛ e binyumuhi, kɛ e nyɛminyumuhi nɛ piɛ e he kɛ ba a, a yibɔ ji nyɔngma kɛ kpaanyɔ. 19A ha wɔ Hashabia, kɛ jehanɛ Yeshaya nɛ je Merari we puɔ nya a hulɔ, nɛ a nyɛmimɛ kɛ a bimɛ nyingmi enyɔ kɛ mɛ ba. 20Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ a se ɔ, Mawu we ɔ ní tsuli lafa enyɔ kɛ nyingmi enyɔ hu ba. Matsɛ David kɛ e tsɔli ɔmɛ nɛ a hla nimli nɛ ɔmɛ ngɔ to kaa a piɛ Levi bi ɔmɛ a he kɛ sɔmɔ. Nɛ a wo mɛ tsuo a biɛ ta ngɛ womi ɔ mi.
Ezra kɛ ma a ha hwɔ nɛ a fa kue
21Benɛ wa ngɛ Ahava pa a nya a, i fa ke nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ha hwɔ, nɛ́ wɔ tsuo waa ba wa he si ngɛ wa Mawu ɔ hɛ mi, konɛ waa fa kue ha lɛ ke e fia blɔ mi tso ha wɔ, nɛ́ e baa wɔ, wa bimɛ, kɛ wa weto ní tsuo yi. 22Kaa pe i ya bi matsɛ ɔ ke e ha wɔ ta buli nɛ hi okpɔngɔhi a nɔ nɛ a bu wa he kɛ je he nyɛli a dɛ mi ngɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ ɔ, jinɛ e ko pee mi zo; ejakaa i ha nɛ e nu sisi momo kaa nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ngɔɔ e hɛ ngɔ fɔɔ wa Mawu ɔ nɔ ɔ, e gbaa lɛ; se nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ kuaa lɛ wa Mawu ɔ, lɛ hu e bua jɔɛ jamɛatsɛ he; e gblaa nɔ ɔ tue wawɛɛ mohu. 23Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, wa ha hwɔ, nɛ wa fa kue kɛ tsɛ wa Mawu ɔ ke e bu wa he, nɛ niinɛ, e bu wa kue fami ɔ tue.
Níhi nɛ a kɛ ke Mawu we ɔ
24I hla Sherebia, Hashabia, kɛ a nyɛmimɛ nyɔngma kɛ je osɔfo ɔmɛ a hɛ mi nyɛɛli ɔmɛ a kpɛti. 25Kɛkɛ nɛ i ngmɛ sika tsu ɔ, sika hiɔ ɔ, kɛ ní ɔmɛ nɛ matsɛ ɔ, kɛ e ga woli ɔmɛ, e tsɔli ɔmɛ, kɛ Israel ma a tsuo ngɔ kɛ ba ke ɔ; lɔ ɔ se ɔ, i ngɔ ní ɔmɛ tsuo ngɔ wo osɔfo ɔmɛ a dɛ, konɛ a kɛ tsu ní ngɛ Mawu we ɔ. 26-27Níhi nɛ i ngɔ ha mɛ ɔ ji:
sika hiɔ nɛ jiimi ji tɔn 22
sika hiɔ kplu lafa nɛ jiimi ji kilo 70
sika tsu nɛ jiimi ji kilo 3,400
sika tsu kã nyingmi enyɔ nɛ jiimi ji kilo 8.4
kã enyɔ nɛ a kɛ akɔblee kpakpa pee, se a he jua wa kaa nɔ́ nɛ sika tsu a kɛ pee.
28I de nihi nɛ i hla a ke, “Yawɛ, nyɛ nɛmɛ a Mawu ɔ nimli klɔuklɔuhi ji nyɛ. Sika tsu, kɛ sika hiɔ kpluhi nɛ ma a kɛ ba ha Mawu kaa nike ní nɛ je a tsui mi faa a, lɔ ɔmɛ hu ngɛ klɔuklɔu jã nɔuu. 29Nyɛɛ hyɛ ní ɔmɛ a nɔ saminya kɛ ya su Mawu we ɔ ngɛ Yerusalem. Ke nyɛ su lejɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ ngmɛ ní ɔmɛ ngɛ osɔfo ɔmɛ a tsu ɔ mi ngɛ osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ, Levi bi ɔmɛ, kɛ Israel ma nimeli ɔmɛ a hɛ mi, konɛ nyɛɛ tu ngɔ wo a dɛ.” 30Kɛkɛ nɛ osɔfo ɔmɛ, kɛ Levi bi ɔmɛ muɔ sika tsu, sika hiɔ, kɛ ní ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ a ngɔ wo wa dɛ mi ɔ, konɛ a hyɛ nɔ kɛ ya su Mawu we ɔ ngɛ Yerusalem.
Wa kpale kɛ ba Yerusalem
31Kekleekle nyɔhiɔ ɔ we ligbi nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔ, wa je Ahava pa a nya, nɛ wa pue nɔ kɛ yaa Yerusalem. Wa Mawu ɔ piɛ wa he, nɛ he nyɛli, kɛ nihi nɛ wo wɔ ká tsuo nyɛ we nɛ a pee wɔ nɔ́ ko. 32Benɛ wa ba su Yerusalem ɔ, wa jɔɔ wa he ligbi etɛ. 33Ligbi eywiɛne ɔ, wa ya Mawu we ɔ, nɛ wa ya ngmɛ sika tsu ɔ, sika hiɔ ɔ, kɛ ní kpa amɛ; nɛ wa tu mɛ kɛ wo osɔfo Meremot, Uria bi ɔ dɛ. Nihi nɛ piɛ e he ji Finehas bi Eleazar, kɛ Levi bi enyɔ, Yozabad, Yeshua bi ɔ, kɛ Noadia, Binui bi ɔ. 34A kane ní ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ a ngmɛ, nɛ a ngma kɛ fɔ si.
35Jamɛ a be ɔ, nihi tsuo nɛ a nuu mɛ nyɔguɛ kɛ ho ma se ya nɛ kpale kɛ ba a ba sã sami bɔ ha Israel Mawu ɔ. A sã na ku nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ngɛ Israel ma a tsuo nane mi, nɛ a sã agbosu nyingmi nɛɛ kɛ ekpa, kɛ jijɔ nyingmi kpaago kɛ kpaago hulɔ. Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, a sã akpakpo nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ kɛ kpa mɛ nitsɛmɛ a he yayamihi a he pɛɛ.
36Jehanɛ se hu, a ngɔ matsɛ ɔ nine nya womi ba ha amlaalo ɔmɛ, kɛ ma nimeli nɛ a ngɛ Yufrate pa a se ɔ. Nɛ enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, a piɛ ma a he, nɛ a tsu Mawu we ɔ ní tsumi hulɔ.

Title: EZRA 9
Content:
Ezra na le kaa Yuda bi kɛ ni kpahi sɛ gba si himi mi
1Ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a se ɔ, ma nimeli ɔmɛ a ti ni komɛ ba ye ngɔ nɛ a ba de mi ke, “Israel ma a, osɔfo ɔmɛ, kɛ Levi bi ɔmɛ tsɔ we a he kɛ ji nihi nɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ ɔ a he. Ní hiemi níhi nɛ a ngɛ peeɔ, a kɛ mɛ lɛ peeɔ. Kikɛmɛ a zugba amɛ, kɛ ma amɛ ji Kanaan, Hit, Periz, Yebus, Amon, Moab, Egipt, kɛ Amor. 2Yuda nyumuhi kɛ a binyumuhi tsuo ya ngɔ zugba a nɔ yihi; nɛ Mawu ma klɔuklɔu ɔ kɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ble a he. Ma tsɔli kɛ ma ní tsuli titli ji nihi nɛ yeɔ fɔ ngɛ kikɛmɛ a nɔ́ nɛ ɔ mi.” 3Benɛ i nu nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, i hía ye he tade sisi nɔ́, kɛ nɔha nɔ́ ɔ tsuo. I bɔni ye yi bwɔmi, kɛ ye kpɛni fami, nɛ i pee basaa kɛ hii si. 4Nɔ́ nɛ Israel Mawu ɔ de ngɛ yayami nɛ nihi nɛ kpale kɛ je ma se kɛ ba a pee ɔ he ɔ, nihi babauu nu he. A kɛ he domi blibliibli ba bɔle mi kɛ kpe be mi nɛ i pee basaa kɛ hii si ɔ, hluu kɛ ya si gbɔkuɛ nya si bɔ sami be.
5Gbɔkuɛ bɔ sami be ɔ, i gbe ye hwɔ hami ɔ nya, nɛ i te si ngɛ zugba kɛ ye he tade sisi nɔ́ ɔ, kɛ nɔha nɔ́ ɔ nɛ i hía a. I kplã si, nɛ i wo ye nine nɔ kɛ ha Yawɛ, ye Mawu ɔ. 6I fa kue ke, “Ye Mawu lee, ye hɛ mi pue si; e ngɛ mi zo pee kaa ma wo ye yi nɔ nɛ ma hyɛ mo. Wa he yayami pee kaa tlomi nɛ a to glegleegle kɛ be wa yi he kɛ ya su hiɔwe lokoo. 7Kɛ je wa nɛmɛ a yi nɔ kɛ ba su mwɔnɛ ɔ, wɔ o ma a, wa pee yayami gbegbeegbe. Wa yayami ɔmɛ a he ɔ, ma je li ɔmɛ a matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ba nuu wɔ, wa matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ wa osɔfo ɔmɛ tsuo. A gbe wɔ, a kpɔ wa níhi ngɛ wa dɛ, nɛ a nuu wɔ kɛ ho ma se ya ngɛ pã mi kaa nyɔguɛhi. A ha wa hɛ mi pue si kulaa; nɛ wa ngɛ zo ɔ mi kɛ mwɔɔ. 8Jehanɛ Yawɛ, wa Mawu, pee se ɔ, o na wɔ mɔbɔ, nɛ wa ti ni komɛ kɛ̃ ngɛ je mi, nɛ o ha wa ba ngɛ o ma klɔuklɔu ɔ mi, konɛ wa hɛ mi nɛ tsɔ wɔ nɛ waa ye wa he kɛ je nyɔguɛ yemi mi. 9A pee wɔ nyɔguɛhi, se ngɛ wa nyɔguɛ si himi ɔ mi ɔ, o je o suɔmi nɛ ngɛ daa a kpo kɛ tsɔɔ wɔ. O ngmɛɛ we wa he, nɛ o ha Persia matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ na wɔ mɔbɔ, nɛ a ha wa nɔ gbagba te ekohu, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ Mawu we ɔ nɛ ku kɛ pue si ɔ, waa ma lɛ ekohu, nɛ waa hi hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ ngɛ Yuda kɛ Yerusalem ngɛ tue mi jɔmi mi.
10“Mawu, jehanɛ lɛɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a se ɔ, mɛni ma kpale de? Mlaahi nɛ o wo wɔ ɔ, wa tɔ̃ lɛ tsuo. 11O de wɔ kɛ gu gbali nɛ ji o tsɔli ɔmɛ a nɔ ke zugba a nɛ wa yaa ngɔ kɛ pee wa nɔ́ ɔ, a ble zugba a. Bɔ nɛ e ba ji kaa nihi nɛ hi zugba a nɔ ɔ, yayami sɔuu a peeɔ. A pee níhi nɛ a hiee babauu ngɛ zugba a nɔ tsuo, kɛ je zugba a nyagbe he kake kɛ ya si e nyagbe he kake. 12 Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, wa kó ha wa biyi ɔmɛ ya gba ma je li ɔmɛ a binyumu ɔmɛ, nɛ wa kó ngɔ a biyi ɔmɛ kɛ ha wa binyumu ɔmɛ. Wa ko ha mɛ tue mi jɔmi, nɛ wa ko ngmɛ mɛ blɔ nɛ a plɔke kɔkɔɔkɔ. Kɛkɛ wa ma na he wami; wa maa ye zugba a nɔ niba ní, nɛ wa ma si ha wa nina kɛ maa ya neneene. 13Níhi nɛ ba wa nɔ ɔ ji yayami nɛ wa pee, kɛ tɔmihi nɛ wa tɔ̃ ɔ a he tue gblami. Se kɛ̃ ɔ, wa na kaa o na wɔ mɔbɔ; o gbla we wa tue bɔ nɛ sa wɔ, nɛ o ha wa ti ni komɛ ngɛ je mi kɛ mwɔɔ. 14Anɛ wa ma gbo tue ekohu nɛ waa kɛ nihi nɛ peeɔ musu bɔmi ní nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ sɛ gba si himi mi lo? Anɛ o mi mi be la woe wawɛɛ kɛ yaa si o ma kpata wɔ tsuo wa hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ nɛ nɔ kake po be piɛe lo? 15Yawɛ, Israel Mawu, moo lɛɛ dalɔ ji mo, se kɛ̃, o ha wa yi na wami kɛ ba si mwɔnɛ ɔ. Wa ngɛ jajee ngɛ o hɛ mi kaa wa yeɔ fɔ, nɛ e sɛ́ kulaa kaa waa ba o hɛ mi.”

Title: EZRA 10
Content:
A to ga nɛ a kɛ maa gu futufutu gba si himi
1Jehanɛ Ezra ya Mawu we ɔ hɛ mi. E fa kue ha Mawu, nɛ e jaje Israel ma a he yayami. Jamɛ a be ɔ tsuo ɔ, e ngɛ ya foe, nɛ e ngɔ e he kɛ ngɛ si fiae. Kɛkɛ nɛ Israel bi babauu, nyumihi, yihi, kɛ jokuɛwi ba bua a he nya ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, nɛ a wo yana. 2Kɛkɛ nɛ Elam we puɔ nya no ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Yehiel ɔ bi Shekania de Ezra ke, “Niinɛ, wa ya ngɔ ma se yihi, nɛ wa yi wa Mawu ɔ anɔkuale, se kɛ̃, hɛ nɔ kami ngɛ ha Israel. 3Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, jehanɛ, nyɛ ha wa ka wa Mawu ɔ kita kaa wa maa wo kikɛmɛ a yi nɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ a bimɛ ɔmɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ blɔ. Nɔ́ nɛ mo, ye nyɔmtsɛ, kɛ nihi tsuo nɛ yeɔ Mawu mlaa a gbeye ma de ɔ, wa maa pee. Ee, wa maa ye Mawu mlaa a nɔ. 4Tee si; o ní tsumi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ; wa ngɛ o se kpɛii. Pee kã, nɛ o tsu.”
5Kɛkɛ nɛ Ezra te si, nɛ e ha nɛ osɔfo ɔmɛ a hɛ mi nyɛɛli ɔmɛ, Levi bi ɔmɛ, kɛ Israel ma a tsuo ka kita kaa a maa pee nɔ́ nɛ Shekania de ɔ. 6Jehanɛ, Ezra je Mawu we ɔ hɛ mi, nɛ e ya sɛ Eliashib bi Yehohanan se tsu mi. E hi lejɛ ɔ nyɔ mi tsuo; e yi nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko, nɛ e nui nyu hulɔ; kɔmɔ sɔuu e ngɛ yee, ejakaa Israel bi nɛ je ma se kɛ ba a yi Mawu anɔkuale.
7A fiɛ ngɛ Yerusalem kɛ Yuda tsuo kaa nihi tsuo nɛ je ma se kɛ ba a, a ba kpe ngɛ Yerusalem. 8Ligbi etɛ se, ke nɔ ko bɛ́ kaa bɔ nɛ ma tsɔli ɔmɛ, kɛ ma nimeli ɔmɛ fa ke a pee ɔ, á kpɔ e níhi tsuo ngɛ e dɛ; lɛ nitsɛ lɛɛ a ko bu lɛ ngɔ si e ma mi bi ɔmɛ a nɔ hu. 9Ligbi etɛne ɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ ɔ, Yuda, kɛ Benyamin bi tsuo ba bua a he nya ngɛ Yerusalem. Nyɔhiɔ nɛɛne ɔ we ligbi nyingmi enyɔ ji jamɛ a ligbi ɔ nɛ. Ma a tsuo ba pue si ngɛ magbɛ mi ngɛ Mawu we ɔ hɛ mi, nɛ a he ngɛ doe blibliibli ngɛ sane nɛ ɔ, kɛ jehanɛ hiɔmi nɛ ngɛ nɛe wawɛɛ ɔ he.
10Kɛkɛ nɛ osɔfo Ezra te da si, nɛ e de mɛ ke, “Nyɛ tɔ̃; ejakaa nyɛ ya ngɔ ma se yihi; nɛ enɛ ɔ ha nɛ Israel he yayami ɔ ba hiɛ pe sa a. 11Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ jaje nyɛ he yayami ɔmɛ kɛ ha Yawɛ, nyɛ nɛmɛ a Mawu ɔ, nɛ nyɛɛ pee nɔ́ nɛ sa e hɛ mi. Nyɛ tsɔ nyɛ he kɛ je nibwɔ ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ wa zugba a nɔ ɔ a he; nyɛɛ ngmɛɛ nyɛ ma se yi ɔmɛ a he.”
12Kɛkɛ nɛ ma a tsuo he nɔ kɛ ngmlaa ke “Saminya! Bɔ nɛ o de ɔ, wa maa pee jã.” 13A ya nɔ nɛ a de ke, “Ni ɔmɛ a he hiɛ tsɔ, nɛ hiɔmi hu lɛ ngɛ nɛe wawɛɛ nɛ ɔ nɛ. Wa be nyɛe maa da si ngɛ magbɛ mi kikɛ nɛ ɔ. Sane nɛ ɔ, pi nɔ́ nɛ a ma nyɛ maa gbe nya ligbi kake, loo ligbi enyɔ pɛ; ejakaa wɔ nihi nɛ wa he ngɛ sane yobu nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, wa he hiɛ. 14Ha nɛ wa ma tsɔli ɔmɛ nɛ a da ma a tsuo nane mi ngɛ Yerusalem hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ. Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ngɔ ma se yo ɔ, ha nɛ e ba hiɛ ɔ be nɛ a maa to lɛ ɔ. E kɛ e ma mi he nɛ e je ɔ ma nimeli, kɛ kojoli nɛ ba. A pee enɛ ɔ hluu kɛ yaa si Mawu mi mi fumi nɛ nya wa ngɛ sane nɛ ɔ he je ɔ se maa po ngɛ wa nɔ.” 15Asahel bi Yonatan, kɛ Tikva bi Yazeya pɛ lɛ a te si kɛ si blɔ nya tomi nɛ ɔ; nɛ Meshulam, kɛ Levi no, Shabetai pi a se.
16Nihi nɛ je ma se kɛ ba a kplɛɛ blɔ nya tomi ɔ, nɛ osɔfo Ezra hla nihi kɛ je we puɔ nya dali ɔmɛ a kpɛti we puɔ nya we puɔ nya ngɛ a biɛhi a nya. Nyɔhiɔ nyɔngmane ɔ we kekleekle ligbi ɔ, a he sɛ, nɛ a bɔni sane ɔmɛ a mi hyɛmi; 17nɛ kekleekle nyɔhiɔ ɔ we kekleekle ligbi ɔ, a hyɛ nihi tsuo nɛ ngɔ ma se yihi a sane ɔmɛ a mi kɛ gbe nya.
Nihi nɛ ngɔ ma se yihi
18Nihi nɛ ngɔ ma se yihi a biɛhi ji nɛ ɔmɛ.
Osɔfo ɔmɛ ngɛ a we puɔ nya:
Yehozadak binyumu Yoshua kɛ e nyɛminyumu ɔmɛ: Maaseya, Eliezer, Yarib, kɛ Gedalia. 19A wo si ke a maa ngmɛɛ a yi ɔmɛ a he; nɛ a ngɔ agbosu kake kɛ sã bɔ, konɛ a ngɔ a he yayami ɔmɛ kɛ pa mɛ.
20Imer we puɔ nya: Hanani kɛ Zebadia.
21Harim we puɔ nya: Maaseya, Eliya, Shemaya, Yehiel, kɛ Uzia.
22Pashur we puɔ nya: Elioenai, Maaseya, Ishmael, Netanel, Yozabad, kɛ Elasa.
23
Levi bi ɔmɛ:
Yozabad, Shimei, Kelaya (e biɛ kpa ji Kelita), Petahia, Yuda, kɛ Eliezer.
24
Mawu we ɔ lali:
Eliashib
Mawu we ɔ buli:
Shalum, Telem, kɛ Uri
25
Ni kpahi:
Parosh we puɔ nya: Ramia, Izia, Malkiya, Miyamim, Eleazar, Malkiya, kɛ Benaya.
26Elam we puɔ nya: Matania, Zakaria, Yehiel, Abdi, Zeremot, kɛ Eliya.
27Zatu we puɔ nya: Elioenai, Eliashib, Matania, Yeremot, Zabad, kɛ Aziza.
28Bebal we puɔ nya Yehohanan, Hanania, Zabai, kɛ Atlai.
29Bani we puɔ nya: Meshulam, Maluk, Adaya, Yashub, Sheal, kɛ Yeremot.
30Pahat Moab we puɔ nya: Adna, Kelai, Benaya, Maaseya, Matania, Bezalel, Binui, kɛ Manase.
31-32Harim we puɔ nya: Eliezer, Ishiya, Malkiya, Shemaya, Shimeon, Benyamin, Maluk, kɛ Shemaria.
33Hashum we puɔ nya: Matenai, Matata, Zabad, Elifelet, Yeremai, Manase, kɛ Shimei.
34-37Bani we puɔ nya: Maadai, Amram, Uel, Benaya, Bedeya, Keluhi, Vania, Meremot, Eliashib, Matania, Matenai, kɛ Yaasu.
38-42Binui we puɔ nya: Shimei, Shelemia, Natan, Adaya, Maknadebai, Shashai, Sharai, Azarel, Shelemia, Shemaria, Shalum, Amaria, kɛ Yosef.
43Nebo we puɔ nya: Yeyel, Matitia, Zabad, Zebina, Yadai, Yoel, kɛ Benaya.
44Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ngɔ ma se yihi. A wo a yi ɔmɛ, kɛ a bimɛ ɔmɛ tsuo blɔ.

Title: NEHEMIA NYA TSƆƆMI
Content:
NYA TSƆƆMI
Nehemia womi ɔ hɛɛ mi dlami eywiɛ: (1) Nehemia kpalemi kɛ ya Yerusalem be nɛ Persia matsɛ ɔ ha lɛ he blɔ kaa e ya ye Yuda zugba a nɔ ɔ. (2) Yerusalem gbogbo ɔmɛ a fiami ekohu. Nehemia nɛ hyɛ ní tsumi nɛ ɔ nɔ. (3) Bɔ nɛ ma a bu tue kom nɛ Ezra kane Mawu mlaa a, kɛ bɔ nɛ ma a jaje a he yayami. (4) Ní kpahi hu nɛ Nehemia tsu be nɛ e ngɛ amlaalo yee ngɛ Yuda a.
Su ko nɛ jeɔ kpo saminya ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ mi ji nɔ́ nɛ a ngma ngɛ Nehemia he ke e ngɔ e hɛ ngɔ fɔ Mawu nɔ wawɛɛ nitsɛ, nɛ e sɔleɔ kɛ tsɛɔ lɛ kpitikpiti ɔ.
Bɔ nɛ a dla womi ɔ mi ha
Nehemia kpale kɛ ho Yerusalem ya 1.1—2.20
A fia Yerusalem gbogbo ɔmɛ ekohu 3.1—7.73
A kane mlaa a, nɛ a so ekohu 8.1—10.39
Ní kpahi nɛ Nehemia tsu 11.1—13.31

Title: NEHEMIA 1
Content:
1Nɔ́ nɛ Hakalia bi Nehemia tsu he sane ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Yerusalem he sane ha Nehemia hɛ dɔ
Benɛ Artaherhes ngɛ matsɛ yee ngɛ Persia a, jeha nyingmi enyɔne ɔ we nyɔhiɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ Kislev ɔ mi ɔ, imi Nehemia, i ngɛ matsɛ ma nɛ a tsɛɛ Susa a. 2Hanani nɛ ji ye nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ a kpɛti nɔ kake, kɛ ni komɛ nɛ je Yuda zugba a nɔ ba hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ. I bi mɛ Yerusalem he sane, kɛ bɔ nɛ wa nyɛmimɛ Yuda bi nɛ a nuu we mɛ kɛ yɛ nyɔguɛ yemi mi ɔ ngɛ ha. 3A de mi ke nihi nɛ piɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ, nɛ mɛɛ lɛɛ a nuu we mɛ nyɔguɛ ɔ, a ngɛ nɔ́ nami, kɛ ahlua bɔmi nguaa mi. A de hu ke Yerusalem gbogbo ɔmɛ nɛ a hule pue si ɔ, kɛ agbo ɔmɛ nɛ a sã a tsuo ngɛ ja. 4Benɛ i nu amaniɛ nɛ ɔ, i hi si nɛ i fo ya.
I ye kɔmɔ ligbi babauu, nɛ i ha hwɔ. I sɔle nɛ i tsɛ Mawu ke, 5“Yawɛ Mawu nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe lee! O kle, nɛ o he ngɛ gbeye. O yeɔ anɔkuale, nɛ o yeɔ o siwo nɔ. Nihi nɛ suɔ mo, nɛ a peeɔ níhi nɛ o fa ke a pee ɔ, o naa mɛ mɔbɔ. 6Yawɛ, moo hyɛ mi, nɛ o ba o tue si ha mi. Kue nɛ i ngɛ fae ha mo nyɔ kɛ pia kɛ ha o tsɔli ɔmɛ nɛ ji Israel bi ɔmɛ ɔ, moo bu tue. I ngɛ jajee ke wɔ Israel ma a, wa pee yayami. I kɛ ye nɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsuo wa pee yayami. 7Wa pee yi kpɛti wami níhi kɛ si mo, nɛ wa yi o mlaa amɛ a nɔ. Mlaahi, kɛ blɔ nya tomihi nɛ o kɛ ha wɔ kɛ gu o tsɔlɔ Mose nɔ ɔ, wa yi nɔ. 8 I kpa mo pɛɛ nɛ o kai nɔ́ nɛ o de Mose ke, ‘Ke nyɛ, Israel ma a, nyɛ yi mi anɔkuale ɔ, ma gbɛ nyɛ ngɔ fĩa je ma kpa amɛ a mi. 9 Se ke nyɛ kpale kɛ ba ye ngɔ, nɛ nyɛ ye ye mlaa amɛ a nɔ ɔ, ke je ɔ nyagbe he nɛ a gbɛ nyɛ ngɔ fĩa po, ma kpaka nyɛ kɛ ba he nɛ i to nɛ a ja mi ngɛ ɔ.’
10“Nyɔmtsɛ, o tsɔli ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ, nɛ mo nitsɛ o ma ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. O kɛ o he wami nguaa kɛ nyɛmi kpɔ mɛ. 11I kpa mo pɛɛ Nyɔmtsɛ, moo ba o tue si nɛ o nu ye kue fami, kɛ tsɔli ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ suɔ kaa a maa wo o biɛ ɔ hɛ mi nyami ɔ a kue fami ɔmɛ. Ha ma ye manye mwɔnɛ ɔ, nɛ o ha matsɛ ɔ nɛ na mi mɔbɔ.”
Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, imi ji matsɛ ɔ dã wolɔ.

Title: NEHEMIA 2
Content:
Nehemia ya Yerusalem
1Nyɔhiɔ eywiɛ se, ligbi ko benɛ Matsɛ Artaherhes ngɛ ní yee ɔ, i ngɔ wai ya ma e hɛ mi, nɛ i wo dã a ha lɛ. E nɛ ye hɛ mi nɛ pee mɔbɔmɔbɔ kaa ja hyɛ, 2lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e bi mi ke, “Mɛni he je o hɛ mi pee mɔbɔmɔbɔ kikɛ nɛ ɔ? Pi hiɔ nɛ o ngɛ nue; i na kaa o bua jɔɛ.”
Kɛkɛ nɛ sawale nu mi, 3 nɛ i he nɔ ke, “Nɛnɛ, o yi nɛ na wa daa! Mɛni he je e sɛ kaa ye hɛ mi nɛ pee mɔbɔmɔbɔ, be mi nɛ ma nɛ a pu ye nɛmɛ ngɛ mi ɔ ku kɛ pueɔ si, nɛ la sã agbo ɔmɛ ɔ?”
4Matsɛ ɔ bi mi ke, “Mɛni ji nɔ́ nɛ o ngɛ hlae?”
I sɔle nɛ i bi Mawunɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ gbi, 5kɛkɛ nɛ i de matsɛ ɔ ke, “Nɛnɛ, ke e sa o hɛ mi, nɛ o suɔ kaa o ma ha mi nɔ́ nɛ ma bi mo ɔ, lɛɛ ha ma ya Yuda zugba a nɔ ngɛ ma mi he nɛ a pu ye nɛmɛ ngɛ ɔ, konɛ ma ya ma ma a ekohu.”
6Matsɛ ɔ kplɛɛ nɔ́ nɛ i bi lɛ ɔ nɔ; jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, manyɛ ɔ hii si ngɛ e kasa nya. Matsɛ ɔ bi mi be nɛ ma ya ye, kɛ be nɛ ma kpale kɛ ba; nɛ i de lɛ.
7Jehanɛ i kpale bi matsɛ ɔ ke e ha mi womi kɛ ya ha amlaalo ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ Yufrate pa a bonyoku je zugba a nɔ ɔ, konɛ a ha mi blɔ kɛ gu a zugba amɛ a nɔ kɛ ya Yuda zugba a nɔ. 8I bi hu ke a ha mi womi kɛ ya ha Asaf, nɔ nɛ hyɛɛ matsɛ ɔ hue ɔmɛ a nɔ ɔ, konɛ e ha mi tso nɛ ma kɛ kpɛ agbohi ha mɔ ɔ nɛ ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ kasa nya a, kɛ gbogbo nɛ a fia kɛ bɔle ma a, kɛ imi nitsɛ ye we nɛ ma hi mi ɔ. Mawu ngɛ ye se, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, matsɛ ɔ ha mi níhi nɛ i bi lɛ ɔ tsuo.
9Matsɛ ɔ ha mi asafoatsɛmɛ, kɛ okpɔngɔ ta buli komɛ nɛ a bu ye he kɛ hia blɔ kɛ ya Yufrate pa a bonyoku je. Benɛ wa su lejɛ ɔ, i ngɔ matsɛ ɔ womi ɔmɛ ngɔ ha amlaalo ɔmɛ. 10Se benɛ Sanbalat nɛ je Bet Horon, kɛ Tobia, ma ní tsulɔ ko nɛ je Amon zugba a nɔ ɔ nu kaa nɔ ko ba nɛ e ba ngɛ nɔ́ kpakpa hlae ha Israel bi ɔmɛ ɔ, e dɔ mɛ wawɛɛ nitsɛ.
11I ya su Yerusalem, nɛ i ye ligbi etɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. 12Se i de we nɔ ko nɔ ko nɔ́ nɛ Mawu ngɔ wo ye mi ke ma pee ɔ. Nyɔ mi kɔ̃kɔ̃ɔ̃kɔ̃ ɔ, i te si, nɛ i kɛ ye nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ bɔɔ pɛ je kpo. Wa ngɔɛ lohwe ko kɛ yɛ, ja teji nɛ i hi nɔ ɔ pɛ. 13Nyɔ mi ɔ nɔuu ɔ, i gu Kɔ̃ Agbo ɔ nɛ ngɛ bonyoku je ɔ mi kɛ je kpo kɛ gu Ogbetee Vu ɔ nya kɛ ya su Dwɔmi Agbo ɔ he. I hyɛ bɔ nɛ Yerusalem gbogbo ɔmɛ ngɛ ha, bɔ nɛ a ku kɛ pueɔ si, kɛ bɔ nɛ a kɛ la sã agbo ɔmɛ. 14Jehanɛ, i po mi kɛ je ma a beleku je kɛ gu omleyi je ngɛ he nɛ Nyu Vu Agbo ɔ, kɛ Matsɛ Taku ɔ ngɛ ɔ. Akɛnɛ lohwe ɔ nɛ i hi nɔ ɔ nɛ́ blɔ nɛ e kɛ be ngɛ lejɛ ɔ he je ɔ, 15i gu Kidron pa a kɔ̃ ɔ mi kɛ ya hyɛ ma a gbogbo ɔ. Kɛkɛ nɛ i kpale ye se kɛ gu jamɛ a blɔ ɔ kɛ̃ kɛ gu Kɔ̃ Agbo ɔ mi kɛ ba ma a mi.
16Ma ní tsuli ɔmɛ ekoeko li kaa i je kpo kɛ ya pee nɔ́ ko. Kɛ ba su be nɛ ɔ mi tsuo ɔ, i de we nɔ ko nɔ ko nɔ́ ko. Ye nyɛmimɛ Yuda bi ɔmɛ, osɔfo ɔmɛ, ma nimeli ɔmɛ, ma ní tsuli ɔmɛ, kɛ nihi nɛ ma tsu ní ɔ li nɔ́ nɛ ya nɔ nɛ ɔ he nɔ́ ko. 17Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, jehanɛ i de mɛ ke, “Nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ na haomi mi nɛ wa ngɛ, bɔ nɛ Yerusalem pee ma doku, nɛ a sã agbo ɔmɛ! Nyɛ ha nɛ waa fia Yerusalem gbogbo ɔmɛ ekohu, konɛ wa zo ɔ nɛ je.” 18Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, i sɛɛ mɛ bɔ nɛ Mawu nyɛɛ ye se, nɛ́ e piɛ ye he, kɛ nɔ́ nɛ matsɛ ɔ de mi ɔ.
A he nɔ ke, “Nyɛ ha nɛ wa bɔni gbogbo ɔ fiami!” Kɛkɛ nɛ a je ní tsumi kpakpa nɛ ɔ sisi nɔuu.
19Se benɛ Sanbalat nɛ je Bet Horon, Tobia, ma ní tsulɔ ɔ nɛ je Amon zugba a nɔ, kɛ Arabia no ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Geshem ɔ nu he ɔ, a muɔ wɔ, nɛ a ye wa he fɛu, nɛ a de ke, “Mɛni sane nyɛ ngɛ yee nɛ ɔ? Nyɛ ma tsɔ matsɛ ɔ hɛ mi atuã lo?”
20I he nɔ ke, “Mawu nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ ma ha wa maa ye manye. E tsɔli ji wɔ, nɛ wa ma bɔni gbogbo ɔ fiami. Nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ be blɔ nya ko, loo weto ní, loo kaimi nɔ́ ko ngɛ Yerusalem.”

Title: NEHEMIA 3
Content:
A fia Yerusalem gbogbo ɔ ekohu
1Bɔ nɛ a pee kɛ fia Yerusalem gbogbo ɔ ekohu ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. Osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa Eliashib, kɛ e nyɛmimɛ osɔfo ɔmɛ ya ma To Agbo ɔ ekohu, nɛ a tsukɔ he; nɛ a ma agbo ɔmɛ ngɛ a blɔ hehi. A tsukɔ gbogbo ɔ he kɛ ya su Lafa Mɔ ɔ kɛ Hananel Mɔ ɔ a he.
2Yeriko nyumu ɔmɛ fia kɛ tsa nɔ, nɛ Imri binyumu Zakur hu fia kɛ tsa a nɔ́ ɔ nɔ.
3Hasenaa binyumu ɔmɛ ma Lo Agbo ɔ, nɛ a kɛ tso sɛu nɔ, nɛ a ma sinya amɛ, nɛ a dadehi kɛ a se lami níhi wo a nya.
4Hakoz binyumu Uria binyumu Meremot ɔ fia gbogbo ɔ kɛ tsa nɔ. Nɔ nɛ fia kɛ tsa nɔ ji Meshezabel binyumu Berekia e binyumu Meshulam. Baana binyumu Zadok ji nɔ nɛ fia kɛ tsa nɔ.
5Gbogbo ɔ he nɛ tsa nɔ ɔ, Tekoa bi nɛ fia. Se Tekoa ma nimeli ɔmɛ lɛɛ, ní tsumi nɛ a nɔ hyɛli ɔmɛ ha mɛ ke a tsu ɔ, a kua tsumi.
6Pasea binyumu Yoyada, kɛ Besodeya binyumu Meshulam dla agbo nɛ a tsɛɛ Agbo Momo ɔ. A kɛ tso sɛu nɔ, nɛ a ma sinya amɛ nɛ a wo dadehi a nya nihi kɛ a se lami.
7Melatia nɛ je Gibeon, Yadon nɛ je Meronot, Gibeon bi ɔmɛ, kɛ Mizpa bi ɔmɛ fia gbogbo ɔ he nɛ tsa nɔ ɔ. A fia kɛ ya su he nɛ amlaalo ɔ nɛ hyɛɛ Yufrate pa a bonyoku je ɔ hii ɔ.
8Harhaya binyumu Uziel, sika tsu ga ní tsulɔ ɔ fia gbogbo ɔ nɔ tsami ɔ. Hanania, nu kɛ e he via peelɔ ɔ fia gbogbo ɔ kɛ tsa nɔ kɛ ya su he nɛ a tsɛɛ Gbogbo Gbajaa a he.
9Hur bi Refaya nɛ hyɛɛ Yerusalem zugba a mi dlami fa nɔ ɔ fia gbogbo ɔ he nɛ tsa nɔ ɔ.
10Harumaf binyumu Yedaya fia gbogbo ɔ kɛ tsa nɔ ngɛ e we ɔ kasa nya. Hashabneya binyumu Hatush fia gbogbo ɔ kɛ tsa nɔ.
11Harim binyumu Malkiya, kɛ Pahat Moab binyumu Hashub fia gbogbo ɔ fa a nɛ tsa nɔ ɔ, kɛ Flɔɔnɔɔ Mɔ ɔ.
12Halohesh binyumu Shalum, Yerusalem zugba a mi dlami fa nɔ yelɔ ɔ fia gbogbo ɔ kɛ tsa nɔ. (E biyi ɔmɛ piɛ e he kɛ tsu ní ɔ.)
13Hanun kɛ Zanoa ma mi bi ɔmɛ dla Kɔ̃ Agbo ɔ. A ma sinya amɛ, nɛ a wo a nya dadehi kɛ a se lami níhi dadehi. A fia gbogbo ɔ gugue lafa enyɔ kɛ nyingmi enuɔ kɛ ya su Dwɔmi Agbo ɔ he tɔɔ.
14Rekab binyumu Malkiya nɛ yeɔ Bet Hakerem zugba a nɔ ɔ dla Dwɔmi Agbo ɔ. E fia ekohu, nɛ e ma sinya amɛ, nɛ e wo a nya dadehi kɛ a se lami níhi.
15Kolhoze binyumu Shalum, Mizpa zugba a nɔ yelɔ ɔ dla Nyu Vu Agbo ɔ. E fia ekohu, nɛ e tsi e yi mi ɔ. E ma sinya amɛ, nɛ e wo a nya dadehi kɛ a se lami níhi. Gbogbo ɔ nɛ tsa matsɛ abɔɔ ɔ nɔ ngɛ Shela Taku ɔ he ɔ, lɛ kɛ̃ nɛ e fia jamɛ a gbogbo ɔ kɛ ya su kpoku ɔmɛ nɛ a kɛ kpleɔ si kɛ jee David ma a mi ɔ a he.
16Azbuk binyumu Nehemia, Betzur zugba a kasa fa nɔ yelɔ ɔ fia gbogbo nɛ tsa nɔ ɔ kɛ je David yɔkɔ ɔmɛ a hanɔ kɛ ya na taku ɔ, kɛ ta buli ɔmɛ a hi he ɔ.
Levi bi nɛ fia gbogbo ɔ
17Levi bi nɛ fia gbogbo ɔ hehi babauu ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ.
Bani binyumu Rehum fia fa ko nɛ tsa nɔ ɔ.
Hashabia, Keila zugba a mi dlami fa nɔ yelɔ ɔ da e nɔ yemi he ɔ nane mi, nɛ e fia gbogbo ɔ eko kɛ tsa nɔ.
18Henadad binyumu Bavai, Keila zugba a mi dlami fa nɛ piɛ ɔ nɔ yelɔ ɔ hu fia gbogbo ɔ nɔ tsami ɔ.
19Yeshua binyumu Ezer, Mizpa zugba a nɔ yelɔ ɔ fia gbogbo ɔ fa nɛ ngɛ he nɛ a guu kɛ kuɔɔ kɛ yaa ta hwumi níhi a to he ɔ hanɔ ɔ; e fia gbogbo ɔ kɛ ya su kɔ̃ ɔ nya.
20Zabai binyumu Baruk fia gbogbo ɔ nɔ tsami ɔ kɛ ya su osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa Eliashib we ɔ nya blɔ tɔɔ.
21Uria binyumu Meremot, Hakoz bibi ɔ fia gbogbo ɔ he nɛ tsa nɔ ɔ kɛ ya su osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa Eliashib we ɔ nyagbe he ɔ tɔɔ.
Osɔfohi nɛ fia gbogbo ɔ
22Osɔfohi nɛ fia gbogbo ɔ mi dlami slɔɔtohi nɛ tsa nɔ ɔ ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ.
Osɔfohi nɛ je hehi nɛ bɔle Yerusalem ɔ fia gbogbo ɔ fa ko.
23Benyamin kɛ Hashub fia e nɔ tsami ɔ nɛ ngɛ a we ɔmɛ a hanɔ ɔ.
Jehanɛ Anania binyumu Maaseya bi Azaria fia gbogbo ɔ he nɛ ngɛ e we ɔ hɛ mi ɔ.
24Henadad binyumu Binui fia he nɛ tsa nɔ ɔ, kɛ je Azaria we ɔ nya kɛ ya su gbogbo ɔ kɔ nya.
25-26Uzai binyumu Palal fia gbogbo ɔ he nɛ tsa nɔ ɔ, kɛ je gbogbo ɔ kɔ nya kɛ yiti mɔ yi mi pinoo ɔ nɛ ngɛ buli ɔmɛ a kue ɔ hanɔ ɔ.
Parosh binyumu Pedaya fia kɛ tsa nɔ kɛ ya ta he ko ngɛ Nyu Agbo ɔ, kɛ mɔ ɔ nɛ ngɛ sɔlemi we ɔ a hanɔ ɔ. (Hiɛ ɔ kɛ ma a he nɛ a tsɛɛ Ofel ɔ kɛ we. Lejɛ ɔ nɛ Yawɛ we ɔ he ní tsuli ɔmɛ hii.)
Ni kpahi nɛ fia gbogbo ɔ
27Tekoa bi ɔmɛ fia gbogbo ɔ fa ko nɛ tsa nɔ ɔ. A fia fa enyɔne ɔ nɛ a ha mɛ ɔ, kɛ je mɔ ngua a nɛ ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ hanɔ ɔ he, kɛ ya gbogbo ɔ nɛ ngɛ Ofel kasa nya a tɔɔ.
28Osɔfo ɔmɛ a kuu ko fia gbogbo ɔ nɔ tsami ɔ, kɛ je Okpɔngɔ Agbo ɔ nya kɛ ya omleyi je; nɔ tsuaa nɔ fia gbogbo nɛ ngɛ lɛ nitsɛ e we hanɔ ɔ.
29Imer binyumu Zadok fia gbogbo ɔ nɛ ngɛ e we ɔ hanɔ ɔ.
Shekania binyumu Shemaya nɛ buu Beleku Agbo ɔ nya a fia gbogbo ɔ he nɛ tsa nɔ ɔ.
30Shelemia binyumu Hanania, kɛ Zalaf binyumu ekpane ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ Hanun ɔ fia gbogbo ɔ he nɛ tsa nɔ ɔ; enɛ ɔ ji he enyɔne nɛ a fia.
Berekia binyumu Meshulam fia e nɔ tsami nɛ ngɛ e we ɔ hanɔ ɔ.
31Sika tsu ga ní tsuli ɔmɛ a ti nɔ ko nɛ a tsɛɛ Malkiya hu fia gbogbo ɔ kɛ tsa nɔ. E fia kɛ ya gu ɔmɛ, kɛ jua yeli ɔmɛ hii ngɛ Buli Agbo ɔ hanɔ hluu kɛ ya su hiɔwe tsu ɔ nɛ ngɛ gbogbo ɔ kɔ nya a he.
32Sika tsu ga ní tsuli ɔmɛ kɛ jua yeli ɔmɛ fia gbogbo ɔ nyagbe mi dlami ɔ; a fia kɛ je hiɔwe tsu ɔ nɛ ngɛ kɔ nya a he kɛ ya su To Agbo ɔ nya tɔɔ.

Title: NEHEMIA 4
Content:
Nehemia ye he nyɛli ɔmɛ a nɔ
1Benɛ Sanbalat nu kaa wɔ Yuda bi ɔmɛ, wa bɔni gbogbo ɔmɛ fiami ɔ, e mi mi fu wawɛɛ nitsɛ, nɛ e ye wa he fɛu. 2E de ngɛ e nyɛmimɛ, ɔmɛ kɛ Samaria ta buli ɔmɛ a hɛ mi ke, “Mɛni Yuda bi wudɔwudɔ nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ pee nɛ ɔ? Ma a gbogbo ɔmɛ nɛ a to a yi mi kaa a maa fia ekohu lo? Anɛ a susu kaa bɔ ɔmɛ nɛ a ngɛ sãe ɔ ma ha a maa ngɔ ligbi kake pɛ kɛ gbe ní tsumi ɔ nya lo? Anɛ a ma nyɛ ma ha gli kokoehi nɛ sã pueɔ si nɛ ɔ ma plɛ pee tsu mami tɛhi lo?”
3Amon no ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ Tobia, nɛ daa si ngɛ e ngɔ ɔ hu bi ke, “Mɛni gbogbo a ma nyɛ maa fia?” E ya nɔ nɛ e de ke, “Tsia, kɔkɔbo tete po ma nyɛ ma tsitsɛɛ a gbogbo ɔ ngɔ ko si!”
4I sɔle ke, “Wa Mawu lee, moo bu bɔ nɛ a ngɛ wa he fɛu yee ɔ tue. Ha nɛ zo nɛ gbe mɛ ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ a pee ɔ he. Ha nɛ a kpɔ a nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ ngɛ a dɛ; nɛ a nuu mɛ nyɔguɛ kɛ ya ma se. 5Koo ngɔ yayami nɛ a pee nɛ ɔ ngɔ pa mɛ, nɛ o hɛ ko je a tɔmi ɔmɛ a nɔ; ejakaa be mi nɛ wa hɛ dɔ kɛ ngɛ gbogbo ɔ fiae ɔ, mɛɛ lɛɛ a ngɛ wɔ ahlua bɔe.”
6Wa ya nɔ wa fia gbogbo ɔ ekohu. E kɛ we kulaa nɛ wa fia kɛ ta gbogbo ɔ kpɛti; ejakaa ma a hɛ dɔ kɛ wo ní tsumi ɔ he.
7Sanbalat, Tobia, Arabia bi ɔmɛ, Amon bi ɔmɛ, kɛ Ashdod bi ɔmɛ nu kaa wa ngɛ Yerusalem gbogbo ɔ fiae mlamlaamla, nɛ wa ngɛ puɔ ɔmɛ tsie. Kɛkɛ nɛ a mi mi fu wawɛɛ nitsɛ. 8Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, mɛ tsuo a so kaa a kɛ Yerusalem maa hwu ta nɛ a gudu lejɛ ɔ. 9Se wɔɔ lɛɛ wa sɔle nɛ wa tsɛ wa Mawu ɔ, nɛ wa ha nihi bu nyɔ kɛ pia kɛ huɔ mɛ.
10Yuda bi ɔmɛ a nya nygɛ nɔ ngɛ dee ke,
“Pɔ tɔ wɔ kɛ nɔ́ tloomi.
Ní kokoe ɔmɛ nɛ wa ma je ɔ hiɛ tsɔ.
Kɛ wa ma pee kɛ fia gbogbo ɔ kɛɛ?”
11Wa he nyɛli ɔmɛ susu kaa wa be mɛ nae, loo wa be nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ nɔ yae ngɛ a kpɛti ɔ lee kɛ yaa si be nɛ a ma ba tua wɔ tlukaa, nɛ a maa gbe wɔ, konɛ ní tsumi ɔ se nɛ po. 12Se be tsuaa be ɔ, Yuda bi nɛ kɛ wa he nyɛli ɔmɛ ngɛ he kake ɔ ba woɔ wa tue nɔ ngɛ gahi nɛ he nyɛli ɔmɛ ngɛ toe ɔ a he. 13Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i ngɔ nihi nɛ hɛɛ klaatehi, akplɔhi, kɛ kɛ̃ɛ̃hi ngɔ to gbogbo ɔmɛ a se hehi nɛ a gbi a fiami nya lolo ɔ. I ha buli nɛ ɔmɛ ya da si weku nya weku nya.
14Jehanɛ, i na kaa ni ɔmɛ hao; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i de ma nimeli ɔmɛ, ma ní tsuli ɔmɛ, kɛ ma a tsuo ke, “Nyɛ ko ye wa he nyɛli ɔmɛ gbeye. Nyɛ kai kaa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ kle, nɛ e he ngɛ gbeye, konɛ nyɛɛ hwu ha nyɛ nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ, nyɛ bimɛ ɔmɛ, nyɛ yi ɔmɛ, kɛ nyɛ we ɔmɛ.” 15Wa he nyɛli ɔmɛ ba na kaa wa le nɔ́ nɛ a ngɛ susue kaa a maa pee ɔ; a kpá si kaa Mawu puɛ a yi mi tomi ɔmɛ. Kɛkɛ nɛ wɔ tsuo wa kpale kɛ ya tsa gbogbo ɔ fiami ɔ nɔ.
16Kɛ je jamɛ a ligbi ɔ kɛ yaa a, i dla ye we bi ɔmɛ a mi enyɔ; be nɛ ni fa ngɛ gbogbo ɔ fiae ɔ, ni fa hu mia kɛ gbaja, nɛ a hɛɛ akplɔhi, tsɛ̃ihi, kɛ kɛ̃ɛ̃hi kɛ daa si, ngɛ bue. Wa ma nimeli ɔmɛ tsuo fí Yuda ma a se kpɛii. 17Nihi nɛ ngɛ gbogbo ɔ fiae, kɛ nihi nɛ ngɛ tɛhi kɛ níhi tlooe ɔ, nɔ tsuaa nɔ kɛ e nine kake ngɛ ní ɔ tsue, nɛ e kɛ e nine kake hu hɛɛ ta hwumi níhi. 18Ní tsuli ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ ngɛ gbogbo ɔ he ní tsue ɔ fi klaate ngɛ a mlɛ mi. Titimati kpalɔ ɔ ngɛ ye kasa nya. 19I de ni ɔmɛ, ma nimeli ɔmɛ, kɛ ma ní tsuli ɔmɛ ke, “Ní tsumi ɔ yi bli kɛ ya se lokoo, nɛ e ha waa kɛ wa sibi wa kpɛti kɛ tsɔ ngɛ gbogbo ɔ nɔ. 20Ke nyɛ nu titimati ɔ pɛmi pɛ, nyɛ bua nyɛ he nya kɛ ba wa ngɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Wa Mawu ɔ maa hwu ha wɔ.” 21Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, bɔ nɛ wa tsu ní ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. Daa ligbi ɔ, kɛ je makɛ futɛfutɛ kɛ ya si gbɔkuɛ be nɛ dodoe ɔmɛ maa je kpo ɔ, wa ti ni fa hii gbogbo ɔ fiae, nɛ ni fa hu hɛɛ akplɔhi kɛ daa si kɛ ngɛ bue.
22Jamɛ a be ɔ, i de ní tsumi ɔ nɔ hyɛli ɔmɛ ke a kɛ ní tsuli ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ a ba hi Yerusalem, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ waa bu ma a he nyɔ mi, nɛ ke je na a, wa tsu ní. 23Enɛ ɔ he ɔ, i kɛ ye nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ, ye we bi ɔmɛ, kɛ ye he buli ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ ye se ɔ, wa je we wa tade ɔmɛ ngɛ wa he; mohu nɔ tsuaa nɔ hɛɛ e tahwu ní ngɛ e dɛ.

Title: NEHEMIA 5
Content:
A wa ohiatsɛmɛ yi mi
1Be ko se ɔ, ma mi bi ɔmɛ ekomɛ, nyumuhi kɛ yihi tsuo ba bɔni ngmlaa kpami kɛ ngɛ a nyɛmimɛ Yuda bi ɔmɛ woe. 2Ni komɛ de ke, “Waa kɛ wa binyumu ɔmɛ, kɛ wa biyi ɔmɛ wa he hiɛ ngɛ wa we ɔmɛ a mi. Nyɛ ha wɔ blɛfo nɛ maa su wa nya, konɛ wa yi nɛ na wami.”
3Ni komɛ hu de ke, “Hwɔ nɛ ba a he je ɔ, wa ngɔ wa zugba amɛ, wa wai ngmɔ ɔmɛ, kɛ wa we ɔmɛ kɛ to awaba, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ wa na blɛfo nɛ waa ye.”
4Ni komɛ hu ke, “Wa pa sika kɛ wo wa zugba amɛ, kɛ wa wai ngmɔ ɔmɛ a he tó ha nɔ yeli ɔmɛ. 5Waa kɛ Yuda bi ɔmɛ tsuo ɔ, ni kake ji wɔ. Anɛ wa bimɛ tsɔwi ɔmɛ kɛ mɛ hu a bimɛ tsɔwi ɔmɛ sɔɛ lo? Se fimi nya a, e hia kaa waa jua wa bimɛ ɔmɛ kaa nyɔguɛhi. Wa jua wa biyi ɔmɛ ekomɛ momo kaa nyɔguɛhi, nɛ wa be nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko hu; ejakaa a kpɔ wa zugba amɛ, kɛ wai ngmɔ ɔmɛ ngɛ wa dɛ.”
6Benɛ i nu ní nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a ngɛ mɛ pee ɔ, ye mi mi fu wawɛɛ, 7 nɛ i to ye yi mi kaa ma pee he nɔ́ ko amlɔ. I kuɛ wo ma nimeli ɔmɛ, kɛ ma ní tsuli ɔmɛ, nɛ i kã a hɛ mi ke, “Nyɛ ngɛ nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ yi mi wae!”
Jehanɛ i tsɛ ma a kpe, konɛ waa hyɛ munyu nɛ ɔ mi. 8I de ke, “Wɔɔ lɛɛ wa ngɛ mɔde bɔe kaa wa ma kpɔ wa nyɛmimɛ Yuda bi ɔmɛ nɛ hiami nya a, a jua a he ngɔ ha nibwɔhi ɔ. Se nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ ngɛ nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ nyɛe kaa a jua a he ngɔ ha nyɛ a nyɛmimɛ Yuda bi!” Ma nimeli ɔmɛ pee kɔ̃; ejakaa a be nya jemi ko.
9Kɛkɛ nɛ i ngɔ pi a hɛ mi ke, “Nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ pee ɔ dɛ! E sa kaa nyɛɛ ye Mawu gbeye, nɛ nyɛɛ pee nɔ́ nɛ da. Ke nyɛ pee nɔ́ nɛ da a, wa he nyɛli ɔmɛ, nɛ ji ma je li ɔmɛ be nɔ́ ko nae nɛ a maa da nɔ kɛ bɔ wɔ ahlua. 10Imi nitsɛ i ha nɛ ma a pa sika kɛ blɛfo ngɛ ye dɛ, nɛ ye he piɛli ɔmɛ kɛ ye ní tsuli ɔmɛ hu pee ja. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ ha nɛ waa ngɔ hiɔ ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ ke mɛ. 11Hiɔhi tsuo nɛ a hɛɛ nyɛ ɔ, nyɛ ngɔ ke mɛ: sika jio, blɛfo jio, wai jio, oliv nu jio; nɛ nyɛɛ kpale a ngmɔ ɔmɛ, a wai ngmɔ ɔmɛ, oliv abɔɔ ɔmɛ kɛ a we ɔmɛ kɛ ha mɛ amlɔ!”
12Ma nimeli ɔmɛ kplɛɛ, nɛ a de ke, “Wa maa pee bɔ nɛ o de ɔ. Wa maa kpale nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ kɛ ha mɛ. Wa be nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko hee ngɛ a dɛ.”
Kɛkɛ nɛ i tsɛ osɔfo ɔmɛ kɛ ba, nɛ i ha ma nimeli ɔmɛ ka kita kɛ fɔ nɔ ngɛ a hɛ mi kaa a maa pee bɔ nɛ a wo si ɔ. 13Jehanɛ hu i je ye mlɛ mi fimi nɔ́ nɛ i huanya, nɛ i de mɛ ke, “Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ be si womi nɛ ɔ nɔ yee ɔ, bɔ nɛ Mawu ma huanya lɛ kɛ je e we, kɛ e ní tsumi he ji nɛ ɔ nɛ; Mawu ma kpɔ nyɛ we ɔmɛ, kɛ nyɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ ngɛ nyɛ dɛ, nɛ nyɛ maa pee pasaa.”
Ni ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ kpe ngɛ lejɛ ɔ de ke, “Amen”, nɛ a je Mawu yi. Ma nimeli ɔmɛ ye a siwo ɔ nɔ.
Nehemia pee we kpɛle
14Imi Nehemia, i ye amlaalo ngɛ Yuda zugba a nɔ jeha nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ, ngɛ Persia matsɛ, Artaherhes yi nɔ. Kɛ je e matsɛ yemi jeha nyingmi enyɔne ɔ mi kɛ ya si nyingmi etɛ kɛ enyɔne ɔ mi nɛ i ye amlaalo ɔ nɛ. Jamɛ be ɔ mi tsuo ɔ, i kɛ ye we bi ɔmɛ wa yi amlaalo blɔ nya niye ní ɔ. 15Amlaalo ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ hi sɛ ɔ nɔ loko e ba su ye nɔ ɔ ngɔ tlomi agbo ngɔ fɔ ni ɔmɛ a nɔ. A biɔ, nɛ a haa mɛ niye ní, kɛ wai kɛ piɛɔ sika hiɔ nyingmi eywiɛ he daa ligbi. A tsɔli ɔmɛ hu waa ma a yi mi. Se imi lɛɛ i pee we ja; ejakaa i yeɔ Mawu gbeye. 16I ngɔ ye he wami tsuo kɛ wo gbogbo fiami ní tsumi ɔ mi, nɛ i he we zugba ko ha ye he. Imi nitsɛ ye tsɔli po, i haa mɛ tsuo a ba fiaa gbogbo ɔ. 17Jehanɛ, Yuda bi ɔmɛ kɛ a hɛ mi nyɛɛli ɔmɛ a kpɛti nihi lafa kɛ nyingmi enuɔ yeɔ ní ngɛ ye okplɔɔ he daa ligbi; slo nihi babauu nɛ jeɔ je ma amɛ nɛ bɔle wɔ ɔ a mi kɛ baa ye ngɔ ɔ. 18Daa ligbi ɔ, i gbee na ku kake, to nɛ wo zɔ ekpa, kɛ kungwɔhi fuu, nɛ daa ligbi nyɔngma se ɔ, i haa wai he hu babauu. Se kɛ̃ ɔ, enɛ ɔmɛ tsuo mi ɔ, i bi we amlaalo blɔ nya niye ní ɔ si, ejakaa tó nɛ a ngɛ ma a he ɔ nya wa tsɔ ha mɛ.
19Mawu lee, i ngɛ mo pɛɛ kpae, mo kai nɛ o gbaa mi ngɛ níhi tsuo nɛ i pee kɛ ha ma nɛ ɔ he.

Title: NEHEMIA 6
Content:
A so ngɔ wo Nehemia he
1Sanbalat, kɛ Tobia, kɛ Geshem, Arabia no ɔ, kɛ wa he nyɛli ɔmɛ nɛ piɛ a he ɔ nu kaa wa gbe gbogbo ɔ fiami nya, nɛ wa tsi hehi nɛ ku ɔ tsuo; pohu jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, wa mɛ sinya amɛ ngɛ agbo ɔmɛ a nya lolo. 2Kɛkɛ nɛ Sanbalat kɛ Geshem tsɔ kɛ ba ye ngɔ ke i kɛ mɛ ba kpe ngɛ kɔpe ko mi ngɛ Ono nga a nɔ. A yi mi tomi ji a nine maa su ye nɔ, konɛ a ye mi awi. 3I tsɔ ya de mɛ ke, I ngɛ ní tsumi nɛ he hia tsue, nɛ i be nyɛe ma ba. “I be ní tsumi kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ he ngmɛɛe kɛ fɔ si, nɛ ma ba na nyɛ!”
4A tsɔ kɛ sɛ gbi nɛ ɔ nɔuu kɛ ba si eywiɛ, nɛ imi hu i ha mɛ heto nɛ ɔ nɔuu si eywiɛ ɔmɛ tsuo.
5Jehanɛ, Sanbalat tsɔ kɛ ba si enuɔne. Tsɔlɔ ɔ hɛɛ sɛ gbi nɛ a ngma ngɛ womi nɛ a sɔu we nya mi kɛ ba. 6Bɔ nɛ a ngma ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Geshem ba de ke huitihuiti ngɛ pɛe ngɛ je ma amɛ a mi kaa o kɛ Yuda bi ɔmɛ to nɛ nyɛ ma tsɔ atuã, nɛ enɛ ɔ he je nɛ o ngɛ gbogbo ɔ fiae ɔ nɛ. E de hu ke o to o yi mi kaa o maa wo o he matsɛ, 7nɛ jehanɛ, o hla gbali komɛ ngɔ to nɛ a fiɛ ngɛ Yerusalem ke mo ji matsɛ ngɛ Yuda zugba a nɔ. Akɛnɛ bɔ tsuaa bɔ matsɛ ɔ nitsɛ maa nu munyu nɛ ɔ he je ɔ, i suɔ kaa o kɛ mi ba kpe, konɛ wa susu he.”
8I ha heto kɛ mane lɛ ke, “Nɔ́ nɛ o ngɛ dee ekoeko be mi. Mo nitsɛ lɛ o po de.”
9Mɛ tsuo a susu kaa a maa wo wa he gbeye, konɛ wa nine mi nɛ jɔ̃, nɛ wa kpa ní ɔ tsumi. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i sɔle ke, “Jehanɛ Mawu, moo wo mi he wami koo!”
10Jamɛ a be ɔ mi nɔuu nɛ i ya slaa Delaya binyumu Shemaya, Mehetabel bibi ɔ nɛ lɛɛ e tlɔ we mi ɔ. E de mi ke, “I kɛ mo wa ya laa ngɛ sɔlemi we ɔ he klɔuklɔu ɔ, nɛ waa ngmɛ sinya amɛ ngɔ wo wa yi, ejakaa a ma nɛ a ba gbe mo. Nyɔ nɛ ɔ mi nɛ a ma ba gbe mo ɔ nɛ.”
11I he nɔ ke, “Nɔmlɔ nɛ tuu fo ya laa e he ji mi lo? Imi nɛ ɔ, ma ya laa ye he ngɛ sɔlemi we ɔ kɛ he ye yi wami lo? Dɛbi, i be yae.”
12Benɛ i susu he bɔɔ ɔ, i na kaa Mawu tsɔ we Shemaya ke e ba de mi nɔ́ ko, se mohu Tobia kɛ Sanbalat nɛ a bɔ lɛ apaa ke e ba wo ye he gbeye ja. 13A bɔ lɛ apaa ke e wo ye he gbeye, konɛ ma pee nɔ́ ko nɛ dɛ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ a puɛ ye biɛ, nɛ a bɔ mi ahlua.
14I sɔle ke, “Mawu, i kpa mo pɛɛ nɛ o kai nɔ́ nɛ Tobia kɛ Sanbalat pee ɔ, nɛ o gbla a tue. Mo kai jamɛ a gbalɔyo Nodia, kɛ gbali kpa amɛ nɛ a ka kaa a maa wo ye he gbeye ɔ.”
A gbe ní tsumi ɔ nya
15Ligbi nyingmi enuɔ kɛ enyɔ se ɔ, a gbe gbogbo ɔ tsuo fiami nya. A gbe nya ngɛ nyɔhiɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ Elul ɔ ligbi nyingmi enyɔ kɛ enuɔne ɔ nɔ. 16Benɛ wa he nyɛli nɛ ngɛ je mahi nɛ bɔle wɔ kɛ kpe ɔ a mi ɔ nu enɛ ɔ, a ye gbeye, nɛ a nini je a nɔ; ejakaa mɛ tsuo a le kaa wa Mawu ɔ piɛ wa he kɛ tsu ní ɔ.
17Jamɛ a be ɔ mi tsuo ɔ, Yuda nikɔtɔma amɛ kɛ Tobia hii a sibi womi ngmae. 18Yuda bi ɔmɛ babauu ngɛ Tobia se, ejakaa Ara binyumu Shekania ngatsɛ ji lɛ. Tsa pi lɔ ɔ he kɛkɛ, se e binyumu Yehohanan hu ngɔ Berekia binyumu Meshulam biyo. 19Ni komɛ hu ba sɛɛɔ Tobia he ní kpakpa kɛ haa mi, nɛ a ya deɔ lɛ níhi nɛ i deɔ ɔ. Lɔ ɔ he e ngmaa mi womi, konɛ e kɛ wo ye he gbeye.

Title: NEHEMIA 7
Content:
1Jehanɛ, wa fia gbogbo ɔ gbe nya, nɛ wa ma agbo ɔmɛ a nya sinya amɛ. Wa to agbo nya buli, nɛ wa hla nihi nɛ ma la ngɛ he klɔuklɔu ɔ. Levi bi nɛ piɛ ɔ hu, wa ngɔ a ní tsumi ɔmɛ ngɔ wo a dɛ. 2I ngɔ nihi enyɔ ngɔ to Yerusalem kaa ma a nɔ hyɛli. Mɛ ji ye nyɛmi Hanani, kɛ Hanania, mɔ nɔ hyɛlɔ nɔkɔtɔma a. Hanania yeɔ anɔkuale, nɛ e yee Mawu gbeye pe nihi tsuo. 3I de mɛ ke ke pee a ko bli Yerusalem agbo ɔmɛ ngɔ fɔ si, se a mlɛ saii kɛ yaa si be nɛ pu maa te si loko a bli. I de mɛ ke, a nga agbo ɔmɛ, nɛ a la a se dade ɔmɛ loko pu nɛ nɔ si be mi nɛ buli ɔmɛ kpa we lolo. I de mɛ hulɔ ke, a hla buli kɛ je Yerusalem ma mi bi ɔmɛ a kpɛti, nɛ a ngɔ ní tsumi pɔtɛɛ komɛ ngɔ wo a dɛ. Jehanɛ hu, á to ni kpahi nɛ maa bu hehi nɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a we ɔmɛ ngɛ ɔ.
Nihi nɛ kpale kɛ je ma se ɔ a biɛhi
(Ezra 2.1-70)
4Yerusalem ji ma ngua lɛɛ, se nihi nɛ ngɛ ma a mi ɔ, a he pi, nɛ a na we nɛ a ma wehi fuu ngɛ mi lolo. 5Mawu ha nɛ i bua ma nimeli ɔmɛ, kɛ ma ní tsuli ɔmɛ tsuo a nya, nɛ i hyɛ a weku womi ɔmɛ a mi. I ya na womi ko nɛ tsɔɔ nihi abɔ nɛ kpale kɛ je ma se kɛ ba kekleekle ɔ a weku kpa. Nɔ́ nɛ i na ngɛ womi ɔ mi ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
6Nihi nɛ Matsɛ Nebukadnezar nuu kɛ ho Babilonia ya a, a kpɛti ni komɛ kpale kɛ ba Yerusalem kɛ Yuda; nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ ho lɛ nitsɛ e ma mi ya. 7A nɔ hyɛli nikɔtɔmahi nɛ kɛ mɛ ba a ji Zerubabel, Yoshua, Nehemia, Azaria, Raamia, Nahamani, Mordekai, Bilshan, Misperet, Bigvai, Nehum, kɛ Baana.
8-25Israel bi a wekuhi nɛ kpale kɛ je ma se kɛ ba a, a hiɛhi kɛ a yibɔ ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ:

63-64Jã kɛ̃ osɔfohi a weku nɛ ɔmɛ hu a biɛ be womi ko mi nɛ tsɔɔ a weku kpa: Hobaya, Hakoz, kɛ Barzilai. Akɛnɛ a nɛ womi nɛ tsɔɔ a sipoku saminya he je ɔ, a bui mɛ ngɔ si osɔfo ɔmɛ a nɔ. 65 Yuda nɔ yelɔ ɔ de mɛ ke a be he blɔ kaa a yeɔ niye ní nɛ a kɛ sã bɔ ha Mawu kɛ yaa su be nɛ a ma na osɔfo nɛ maa ngɔ Urim kɛ Tumim kɛ bi Mawu gbi ha mɛ.

73 Osɔfo ɔmɛ, Levi bi ɔmɛ, buli ɔmɛ, lali ɔmɛ, ma mi bi ɔmɛ saii, sɔlemi we ɔ he ní tsuli ɔmɛ, kɛ Israel ma a tsuo ba hi Yuda ma amɛ a mi.

Title: NEHEMIA 8
Content:
Ezra kane mlaa a ha ma a
1Nyɔhiɔ kpaago ɔ mi ɔ, Israel bi ɔmɛ ba he si ngɛ a ma amɛ a mi. Jamɛ a nyɔhiɔ ɔ kekleekle ligbi ɔ, ma a tsuo ba bua a he nya ngɛ Yerusalem, ngɛ ma kpe he ɔ, ngɛ Nyu Agbo ɔ nya. A de osɔfo Ezra, mlaa tsɔɔlɔ ɔ ke e ngɔ womi ɔ nɛ mlaa a nɛ Yawɛ ha Israel kɛ gu Mose nɔ ɔ ngɛ mi ɔ kɛ ba. 2Kɛkɛ nɛ Ezra ya ngɔ mlaa womi ɔ kɛ ba he nɛ ma a kpe ngɛ ɔ. Nihi babauu nitsɛ nɛ ba kpe: nyumuhi, yihi, kɛ jokuɛwi nɛ hɛ mi fa bɔ nɛ a maa nu nɔ́ sisi. 3Ezra kane mlaa a kɛ ha mɛ ngɛ ma kpe he ɔ, ngɛ Nyu Agbo ɔ nya kɛ je mɔtu ma kɛ ya si piani. Ma a tsuo bu tue saminya.
4Mlaa tsɔɔlɔ Ezra ya da si ngɛ kpoku ko nɔ. Kpoku nɛ ɔ, a je blɔ nɛ a kɛ tso pee kɛ ha kpe ɔ peemi. Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, Matitia, Shema, Anaya, Uria, Hilkia, kɛ Maaseya hiɔ daa si ngɛ e hiɔ nɔ, nɛ Pedaya, Mishael, Malkiya, Hashum, Hashbadana, Zekaria kɛ Meshulam daa si ngɛ e muɔ nɔ.
5Benɛ Ezra ya daa si ngɛ kpoku ɔ nɔ ɔ, e ya hiɔwe pe ma a tsuo nɛ pueɔ si ɔ. Kɛkɛ nɛ e bli womi ɔ nya, nɛ ma a tsuo te da si. 6Jehanɛ Ezra de ke, “Nyɛ je Yawɛ Mawu kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ yi!”
Ma a tsuo wo a nine nɔ nɛ a he nɔ ke, “Amen! Amen”. Kɛkɛ nɛ a kpla si nɛ a kɛ a hɛ mi bu si nɛ a ja Yawɛ.
7Jehanɛ, a te da si ngɛ he nɛ a ngɛ ɔ, nɛ Levi bi nɛ ɔmɛ tsɔɔ mɛ mlaa a sisi fitsofitso. Mɛ ji Yeshua, Bani, Sherebia, Yamin, Akub, Shabetai, Hodia, Maaseya, Kelita, Azaria, Yozabad, Hanan, kɛ Peleya. 8A je blɔ kane Mawu mlaa a, nɛ a tsɔɔ sisi fitsofitso, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ ma a tsuo nɛ nu sisi.
9Benɛ ma a tsuo nu mlaa a mi munyu ɔmɛ ɔ, a wo yana. Se Nehemia, amlaalo ɔ, kɛ osɔfo Ezra, mlaa tsɔɔlɔ ɔ, kɛ Levi bi ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ mlaa a sisi tsɔɔe ɔ de ma a tsuo ke, “Mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ ji ligbi klɔuklɔu ha Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ ko ye kɔmɔ, nɛ nyɛ ko wo yana. 10Mohu nyɛɛ ya nyɛ we ɔmɛ a mi, nɛ nyɛ ya ye ní kpakpa, nɛ nyɛɛ nu wai ngɔngɔɛ. Nyɛ nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a be eko ɔ, nyɛ ha mɛ eko. Mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ ji ligbi klɔuklɔu ha Yawɛ nyɛ Mawu ɔ, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ ko pee mɔbɔmɔbɔ. Bua jɔmi nɛ Yawɛ ngɛ nyɛ hae ɔ ma ha nɛ nyɛ ma na he wami.”
11Levi bi ɔmɛ kpa ní ɔmɛ tsuo a nɔ kɛ wo mɛ bua, nɛ a de mɛ ke a ko pee a ní mɔbɔmɔbɔ ngɛ ligbi klɔuklɔu kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ nɔ. 12Kɛkɛ nɛ ma a tsuo ho a we ɔmɛ a mi ya. A ya ngmɛ okplɔɔ nɛ a kɛ a sibi ye ní kɛ bua jɔmi, ejakaa a nu nɔ́ nɛ a kane ha mɛ ɔ sisi saminya.
Gbasisihimi nyami be ɔ
13E nɔ jena a, we puɔ nyatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ, osɔfo ɔmɛ kɛ Levi bi ɔmɛ ba bua a he nya ngɛ Ezra, mlaa tsɔɔlɔ ɔ ngɔ, nɛ a kase mlaa a. 14 A na kaa mlaa a nɛ Yawɛ wo kɛ gu Mose nɔ kɛ ha Israel bi ɔmɛ ɔ tsɔɔ kaa a hi gbahi a sisi kɛ ye nyami be nɛ ɔ. 15Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a fa nɛ a tsɔ kɛ ya Yerusalem, kɛ ma kpa amɛ a mi, nɛ a ya de nɔ tsuaa nɔ ke, “Nyɛɛ je kpo kɛ ya yoku ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ nyɛ ya poo oliv tso, ayɔ nu tso, mɔmɔ tso, tã, kɛ tso kpahi nɛ bɔ kusuu a kɔnihi, nɛ nyɛ kɛ ba ma gbahi kaa bɔ nɛ mlaa a tsɔɔ ɔ.”
16Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ni ɔmɛ ya poo tso, nɛ a ba ma gbahi ngɛ a tsu ɔmɛ a yi mi, kɛ a we ɔmɛ a mi, kɛ Mawu we ɔ kpo ɔ nɔ, kɛ ma kpe he ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ Nyu Agbo ɔ kɛ Efraim Agbo ɔ, nya a. 17Ni ɔmɛ nɛ kpale kɛ je ma se kɛ ba a tsuo ma gbahi nɛ a hi a sisi. Kɛ je Nun bi Yoshua yi nɔ kɛ ba su jamɛ a be ɔ, a pee we nɔ́ nɛ ɔ eko hyɛ; enɛ ɔ ji kekleekle gbahi, nɛ a ma. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, mɛ tsuo a nɔ gbagba te, nɛ a bua jɔ wawɛɛ. 18Kɛ je kekleekle ligbi ɔ nɔ kɛ ya si be nɛ a gbe nyami be ɔ nya a, a kaneɔ Mawu mlaa a fa ko daa ligbi. A ye Gbasisihimi nyami be nɛ ɔ ligbi kpaago, nɛ ligbi kpaanyɔne ɔ, a pee nyagbe kpe kaa bɔ nɛ mlaa a tsɔɔ ɔ.

Title: NEHEMIA 9
Content:
Ma a jaje a he yayami ɔmɛ
1-2Jamɛ a nyɔhiɔ ɔ ligbi nyingmi enyɔ kɛ eywiɛne ɔ nɔ ɔ, Israel bi ɔmɛ ba kpe konɛ a ha hwɔ, nɛ a pia a he ngɛ a yayami ɔmɛ a he. Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, Israel bi ɔmɛ tsɔ a he kɛ je nibwɔ ɔmɛ tsuo a he momo. Israel bi ɔmɛ bu kpekpe ya bo, nɛ a ngɔ bunyuku ngɔ pue a yi mi kɛ ye kɔmɔ. Jehanɛ, a da si nɛ a bɔni mɛ nitsɛmɛ, kɛ a nɛmɛ ɔmɛ a he yayamihi nɛ a pee ɔ jajemi. 3A kane Yawɛ, a Mawu ɔ mlaa a ngmlɛfia etɛ, nɛ ngmlɛfia etɛ nɛ tsa nɔ ɔ, a jaje a he yayami ɔmɛ, nɛ a ja Yawɛ, a Mawu ɔ.
4A pee kpoku ko ha Levi bi ɔmɛ, nɛ lɔ ɔ nɔ nɛ Yeshua, Bani, Kadmiel, Shebania, Buni, Sherebia, Bani, kɛ Kenani da si ngɛ. A sɔle boboobo kɛ ha Yawɛ, a Mawu ɔ.
5Levi bi nɛ ɔmɛ ji ni nɛmɛ nɛ nyɛɛ ma a hɛ mi kɛ sɔle ha Mawu: Yeshua, Kadmiel, Bani, Hashabneya, Sherebia, Hodia, Shebania, kɛ Petahia. Bɔ nɛ a de ji nɛ ɔ nɛ,
“Nyɛɛ te si nɛ nyɛ je Yawɛ,
nyɛ Mawu ɔ yi.
Nyɛ je e yi daa kɛ daa.
Mawu lee, ha nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ je o biɛ ɔ yi.
Nɔmlɔ adesa yi jemi pi ha mo lɛɛ,
se ha nɛ wa je o yi kɛ̃.”
Yayami jajemi
6Nɛ a sɔle ke,
“Yawɛ,
mo nɔ kake pɛ ji Yawɛ,
mo nɛ o pee hiɔwe ɔ,
kɛ dodoe ɔmɛ ngɛ kɔɔhiɔ mi.
Mo nɛ o pee zugba kɛ wo,
kɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ a mi,
nɛ o ha mɛ tsuo wami.
Hiɔwe ta a kplaa si haa mo,
nɛ a jaa mo.
7 Yawɛ Mawu, mo nɛ o hla Abram,
nɛ o kpaka lɛ kɛ je Ur ngɛ Babilonia;
o tsake e biɛ ngɔ pee Abraham.
8 O na kaa e ye mo anɔkuale,
lɔ ɔ he ɔ, o kɛ lɛ so.
O wo lɛ si ke o maa ngɔ
Kanaan,
Hit, Amon,
Periz, Yebus,
kɛ Girgash bi ɔmɛ a zugba a
kɛ ha e nina.
O ye o siwo ɔ nɔ,
ejakaa o yeɔ anɔkuale.
9 “O na bɔ nɛ wa nɛmɛ ɔmɛ na amanehlu ngɛ Egipt,
o nu a kue fami ɔ ngɛ Wo Tsu ɔ nya.
10 O pee okadihi, kɛ nyakpɛ níhi ngɛ Farao ɔ,
kɛ e ma ní tsuli ɔmɛ,
kɛ e ma a tsuo a hɛ mi,
ejakaa o le bɔ nɛ a wa o ma a yi mi.
O he biɛ kɛ je jamɛ a be ɔ mi tɔɔ
kɛ ba su mwɔnɛ ɔ.
11 O je blɔ kɛ gu wo ɔ mi kɛ ha o ma a,
nɛ o kpaka mɛ kɛ nyɛɛ wo ɔ mi
ngɛ zugba gbigbli nɔ.
Nihi nɛ nyɛɛ a se ɔ gbo tlɔ nyu nɛ mi kuɔ ɔ sisi,
kaa bɔ nɛ tɛ muɔ kɛ yaa wo nɛ gli sisi ɔ.
12 O ngɔ bɔku kɛ tsɔɔ mɛ blɔ piani;
se nyɔ mi lɛɛ o ha mɛ la nɛ a kɛ hyɛ a blɔ mi.
13 O kple si kɛ je hiɔwe kɛ ba Sinai yo ɔ nɔ,
nɛ o kɛ o ma a ba tu munyu;
o ha mɛ mlaa kpakpahi,
kɛ ní tsɔɔmi nɛ hi kɛ pi si.
14O tsɔɔ mɛ kaa a ye Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ klɔuklɔu,
nɛ o gu o tsɔlɔ Mose nɔ kɛ ha mɛ o mlaa amɛ.
15 “Benɛ hwɔ ye mɛ ɔ,
o ha mɛ niye ní kɛ je hiɔwe,
nɛ benɛ kuma ye mɛ ɔ,
o ha mɛ nyu kɛ je tɛ sa mi.
O de mɛ ke zugba a nɛ o wo si ke o ma ha mɛ ɔ,
a ya ngɔ nɛ a hi nɔ.
16 Se wa nɛmɛ ɔmɛ ba wo a he nɔ nɛ a wa tue,
nɛ a yi o mlaa amɛ a nɔ.
17 A kplɛɛ we nɛ a bu mo tue;
a hɛ je níhi tsuo nɛ o pee ɔ a nɔ,
nyakpɛ níhi tsuo nɛ o pee ha mɛ ɔ, a hɛ je nɔ.
Ngɛ a he nɔ womi ɔ mi ɔ, a hla hɛ mi nyɛɛlɔ
konɛ e kpale mɛ kɛ ya Egipt nyɔguɛ yemi ɔ mi.
Se moo lɛɛ Mawu nɛ ngɔɔ tɔmi ngɔ paa ji mo;
dloolɔ kɛ mɔbɔ nalɔ ji mo,
nɛ o mi mi fu we mla.
O mɔbɔ nami ɔ kle;
o kua we o ma a.
18 Benɛ a puɛ amaga ko nɛ ngɛ kaa na ku,
nɛ a de ke amaga nɛ ɔ nɛ kpaka mɛ kɛ je
Egipt kɛ ba a,
a bɔ musu babauu kɛ si mo Yawɛ.
19 Jamɛ a be ɔ mi po,
o ngmɛɛ we a he ngɛ nga kplanaa a nɔ;
ejakaa o naa mɔbɔ saminya.
O je we bɔku ɔ nɛ tsɔɔ mɛ blɔ piani ɔ, kɛ la a hu
nɛ tsɔɔ mɛ blɔ nyɔ mi ɔ kɛ ji a he.
20O ha nɛ o mumi kpakpa a tsɔɔ mɛ ní,
nɛ o ha mɛ a nya mi ngma, kɛ nyu nɛ a nu.
21Jeha nyingmi eywiɛ sɔuu nɛ a nyɛɛ nga kplanaa a nɔ ɔ,
o ha mɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ he hia mɛ:
a tadehi gba we ngɛ a he,
nɛ a nanehi hu fuu we.
22 “O ha a ye je mahi, matsɛ yemihi, kɛ
zugbahi nɛ bɔle mɛ ɔ a nɔ.
A ye Heshbon zugba a, kɛ Bashan zugba a tsuo nɔ.
Heshbon ji he nɛ Sihon ye matsɛ ngɛ,
nɛ Bashan ji he nɛ Og ye matsɛ ngɛ.
23 O ha nɛ a bimɛ ɔmɛ hu a he hiɛ babauu
kaa dodoehi ngɛ hiɔwe;
nɛ zugba a nɛ o de a nɛmɛ ɔmɛ ke a ya ngɔ ɔ,
o kpaka mɛ kɛ ya lejɛ ɔ.
24 Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a bimɛ ɔmɛ ya nɛ a ya ngɔ zugba a.
O jɔɔ Kanaan bi ɔmɛ a he,
nɛ o ngɔ mɛ, a matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ zugba a tsuo
ngɔ wo o ma a dɛ,
konɛ a pee mɛ bɔ nɛ a suɔ.
25 A ngɔ ma nguahi nɛ a fia gbogbo ngɔ wo a he ɔ
zugba nɛ baa ní,
kɛ wehi nɛ hyi tɔ kɛ ní kpakpahi tsuo;
a ngɔ nyu vuhi nɛ a tsua momo,
oliv tsohi, tsohi nɛ woɔ yiblii,
kɛ wai ngmɔhi.
A ye ní ɔmɛ nyamanyama;
a tɔ nɛ a plɔke.
Ní kpakpa amɛ nɛ o ha mɛ ɔ, a nya he.
26 “Se enɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a se ɔ, o ma a tsɔ o hɛ mi atuã,
nɛ a bui mo tue;
a sake o mlaa a ngɔ fɔ a tue se.
A gbe gbali ɔmɛ nɛ ka a hɛ mi,
nɛ de mɛ ke a kpale kɛ ba o ngɔ ɔ;
kɛ nɔ a bɔ musu babauu.
27Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, o ha a he nyɛli ba ye a nɔ,
nɛ a hao mɛ.
Ngɛ a fimi be ɔ mi ɔ, a fa kue kɛ tsɛ mo,
nɛ o bu mɛ tue kɛ je hiɔwe.
O mɔbɔ nami babauu ɔ nya a,
o ha mɛ hɛ mi nyɛɛli nɛ kpɔ mɛ kɛ je a he nyɛli a dɛ.
28Benɛ a na tue mi jɔmi ɔ, a pee yayami ekohu;
kɛkɛ nɛ o je a se,
nɛ a he nyɛli ɔmɛ ba ye a nɔ ekohu.
Se benɛ a tsake a tsui,
nɛ a fa kue kɛ tsɛ mo ekohu ɔ,
o bu mɛ tue kɛ je hiɔwe;
nɛ o na mɛ mɔbɔ, nɛ o kpɔ mɛ si abɔ.
29 O wo mɛ ga ke a ye o mlaa amɛ a nɔ,
se a ya wo a he nɔ mohu,
nɛ a yi mlaa amɛ a nɔ.
A ye o mlaa amɛ a nɔ jinɛ
a yi ko na wami.
Se akɛnɛ a kuɛ wa, nɛ
a bui nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko he je ɔ,
a kua mlaa amɛ a nɔ yemi.
30 O to o tsui si,
nɛ o bɔ mɛ kɔkɔ jeha babauu.
O ngɔ o mumi ɔ ngɔ wo o gbali ɔmɛ a mi,
konɛ a tu munyu ngɔ tsɔɔ mɛ;
se o ma a wa tue.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, o ngmɛɛ a he ha ma kpahi
nɛ a ye a nɔ.
31O kua we mɛ; o na mɛ mɔbɔ,
nɛ o kpataa we a hɛ mi hulɔ.
Ejakaa Mawu mɔbɔ nalɔ kɛ dloolɔ ji mo!
32 “Wa Mawu, mo Mawu kpetekpleenyɛ,
mo nɛ o he ngɛ gbeye,
nɛ o kɔni si wa.
Moo lɛɛ o yeɔ o somi, kɛ si womi ɔmɛ a nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Kɛ je benɛ Asiria matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ bɔni wɔ haomi
kɛ ba su mwɔnɛ ɔ,
moo hyɛ amanehlu sɔuu nɛ wa na!
Wa matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ, wa ma nimeli ɔmɛ,
wa osɔfo ɔmɛ, gbali ɔmɛ, wa nɛmɛ ɔmɛ,
kɛ wa ma kpekpemi ɔ tsuo na nɔ́ tsɔ.
Mo kai wɔ, ejakaa wa we amanehlu ɔ hiɛ tsɔ!
33O ye dami sane
kaa o gbla wa tue,
ejakaa o ye anɔkuale,
be nɛ wɔɔ lɛɛ wa pee yayami.
34Wa nɛmɛ ɔmɛ, wa matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ,
wa ma nimeli ɔmɛ,
kɛ osɔfo ɔmɛ yi o mlaa a nɔ.
A bui o mlaa; nɛ ke o ka a hɛ mi hu,
e pue we a tsui nɔ.
35O gbaa matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ nɛ ye o ma a nɔ ɔ,
kɛ zugba kpakpa nɛ baa ní saminya a.
Se kɛ̃ ɔ, a kpa we yayami peemi ɔ,
konɛ a ba sɔmɔ mo.
36Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, wa zugba nɛ o ngɔ ha wa nɛmɛ ɔmɛ,
konɛ a ye e nɔ niba ní kpakpahi ɔ,
wa ba pee nyɔguɛhi ngɛ zugba a nɔ.
37Zugba a baa ní babauu
ha matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a ngɔ to wa nya a mohu,
se akɛnɛ wa pee yayami kɛ si mo ɔ,
a pee wɔ nimli ɔmɛ, kɛ wa lohwe ɔmɛ yayami
bɔ nɛ a suɔ,
nɛ wa yi fi wawɛɛ nitsɛ!”
A ngma biɛhi ngɔ wo somi womi ɔ sisi
38Enɛ ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ ba wa nɔ he je ɔ, wɔ Israel ma a, wa ngɛ si woe veveeve ke wa ma sɔmɔ Yawɛ pɛ. Wa ngma nɔ́ nɛ ɔ kɛ wo womi mi, nɛ wa ma nimeli ɔmɛ, Levi bi ɔmɛ, kɛ wa osɔfo ɔmɛ ngma a biɛhi kɛ wo sisi kɛ sɔu nya.

Title: NEHEMIA 10
Content:
1Kekleekle nɔ nɛ ngma e biɛ ji ɔ, Hakalia bi Nehemia, amlaaho ɔ. Nɔ nɛ nyɛɛ e se ji Zedekia.
2-8
Osɔfohi nɛ ngma a biɛhi ji:
Seraya, Azaria, Yeremia,
Pashur, Amaria, Malkiya,
Hatush, Shebania, Haluk,
Harim, Meremot, Obadia,
Daniel, Gineton, Baruk,
Meshulam, Abiya, Miyamin,
Maazia, Bilgai, kɛ Shemaya.
9-13
Levi bi nɛ ngma a biɛhi ji:
Azania bi Yeshua,
Hanadad weku ɔ mi no Binui,
Kadmiel, Shebania, Hodia,
Kelita, Pelaya, Hanan,
Mika, Rehob, Hashabia,
Zakur, Sherebia, Shebania,
Hodia, Bani, kɛ Beninu.
14-27Jehanɛ, ma nimeli nɛ ɔmɛ hu ngma a biɛhi:
Parosh, Pahat Moab,
Elam, Zatu, Bani,
Buni, Azgad, Bebai,
Adoniya, Bigvai, Adin,
Ater, Hezekia, Azur,
Hodia, Hashum, Bezai,
Harif, Anatot, Nebai,
Magpiash, Meshulam, Hezir,
Meshezabel, Zadok, Yadua,
Pelatia, Hanan, Anaya,
Hoshea, Hanania, Hashub,
Halohesh, Pilha, Shobek,
Rehum, Hashabna, Maaseya,
Ahia, Hanan, Anan,
Maluk, Harim, Baana.
Somi munyu ɔmɛ
28Wɔ, Israel ma a, osɔfo ɔmɛ, Levi bi ɔmɛ, sɔlemi we ɔ he buli ɔmɛ, sɔlemi we ɔ lali ɔmɛ, sɔlemi we ɔ ní tsuli ɔmɛ, kɛ ni kpa amɛ tsuo nɛ Mawu mlaa a nɔ yemi he ɔ, a tsɔ a he kɛ je nibwɔhi nɛ ngɛ wa zugba a nɔ ɔ a he ɔ, wa yihi, kɛ wa bimɛ tsuo nɛ hɛ mi fa nɛ nuɔ nɔ sisi ɔ, 29wa piɛ wa ma nimeli ɔmɛ a he kɛ ngɛ kita kae ke gbiɛmi nɛ ba wa nɔ ke wa tɔ kita a. Wa ngɛ kita kae ke Mawu mlaa a nɛ e wo wɔ kɛ gu e tsɔlɔ Mose nɔ ɔ, wa maa ye nɔ. Wa ngɛ kita kae ke níhi tsuo kulaa nɛ Yawɛ, wa Mawu ɔ fa wɔ ke waa pee ɔ, wa maa pee. Wa ngɛ kita kae ekohu ke wa maa ye e mlaa amɛ, kɛ blɔ nya tomi ɔmɛ tsuo a nɔ.
30 Waa kɛ wa biyi ɔmɛ be nibwɔhi nɛ ngɛ wa zugba a nɔ ɔ gba hae, nɛ wa binyumu ɔmɛ hu be a biyi ɔmɛ ngɔe.
31 Ke nibwɔhi ba jua niye ní, loo nɔ́ kpa ko ha wɔ ngɛ Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ nɔ, loo nyami be kpa ko mi ɔ, wa be hee.
Daa jeha kpaago ɔ, wa be ngmɔ hue. Jehanɛ hu, hiɔhi nɛ nihi hɛɛ wɔ ɔ tsuo wa be jee hu; wa maa ngɔ kɛ ke mɛ.
32 Wa ngɛ si woe hu ke daa jeha a, wa ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ ma tsu sika hiɔ yi kake mi dlami etɛ mi kake, nɛ a kɛ wo wa Mawu ɔ we ɔ he hiɔ ɔmɛ.
33Wɔ tsuo wa maa ngɔ ní nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ ba nɛ a kɛ sɔmɔ ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ: abolo klɔuklɔu ɔ, niye ní bɔ nɛ a sãã daa ligbi ɔ, lohwehi nɛ a kɛ sãã bɔ daa ligbi ɔ, bɔ klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ nɛ a sãã Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔmɛ ɔ, kɛ Nyɔhiɔhe nyami be ɔ, kɛ nyami be kpa amɛ a nɔ ɔ. Wa ma ha níhi nɛ a kɛ sãã bɔ klɔuklɔu kpa amɛ hulɔ kaa yayami pami bɔ nɛ a kɛ kpataa Yawɛ ha Israel kikɛ nɛ ɔ, kɛ nɔ́ ko saisaa nɛ he hia nɛ a kɛ ma sɔmɔ ngɛ wa Mawu ɔ we ɔ.
34Jehanɛ hu, wa ngɛ si woe ke daa jeha a, wɔ ma a, kɛ osɔfo ɔmɛ, waa kɛ Levi bi ɔmɛ maa fɔ sɔ kɛ na wekuhi nɛ maa ngɔ lɛ́ kɛ ba nɛ a kɛ sã bɔhi ha Yawɛ, wa Mawu ɔ kaa bɔ nɛ mlaa a tsɔɔ ɔ.
35 Wa ngɛ si woe hu ke daa jeha a, wa maa ngɔ blɛfo, kɛ kekleekle tso yiblii nɛ wa ma na a kɛ maa ba lɛ, Yawɛ e we ɔ.
36 Wa ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ maa ngɔ e kekleekle binyumu kɛ ba osɔfo ɔmɛ a ngɔ ngɛ wa Mawu ɔ we ɔ, konɛ a pee mɛ klɔuklɔu kɛ ha Mawu kaa bɔ nɛ mlaa a tsɔɔ ɔ. Jehanɛ, wa maa ngɔ wa na amɛ, kɛ wa to ɔmɛ a kekleekle bihi hu kɛ ba.
37 Daa jeha a, wa maa ngɔ ma nɛ a pee kɛ je blɛfo he mi kɛ ba ha osɔfo ɔmɛ ngɛ wa Mawu ɔ we ɔ. Nike ní kpahi nɛ maa piɛ he ji wai, oliv nu, kɛ tso yiblii nɛ a yeɔ slɔɔtohi tsuo.
Levi bi nɛ tsuɔ ngmɔ nɔ niba níhi a mi dlami nyɔngmanyɔngma mi kakaaka ngɛ kɔpe ɔmɛ a mi ɔ hu, wa ma ha mɛ ngmɔ nɔ niba ní mi dlami nyɔngmanyɔngma mi kakaaka. 38 Osɔfohi nɛ ji Aaron nina a, ke benɛ Levi bi ɔmɛ ngɛ mi dlami nyɔngmanyɔngma mi kakaaka amɛ tsue ɔ, a kɛ mɛ nɛ hi lejɛ ɔ. Levi bi ɔmɛ nɛ a ngɔ mi dlami nyɔngmanyɔngma mi kakaaka amɛ nɛ a bua nya a tsuo a mi dlami nyɔngma mi kake kɛ to ngɛ wa Mawu we ɔ nito he ɔmɛ. 39Israel ma a, kɛ Levi bi ɔmɛ a blɔ nya ji kaa a ngɔ blɛfo, dã, kɛ oliv nu nɛ a tsu ngɛ ni ɔmɛ a dɛ ɔ kɛ ba nito he ɔmɛ ngɛ Mawu we ɔ. Lejɛ ɔ a toɔ níhi nɛ a kɛ sɔmɔɔ ɔ ngɛ. Osɔfohi nɛ ngɛ ní tsue, buli, kɛ lali ɔmɛ hu lejɛ ɔ nɔuu ji he nɛ a hii.
Wa maa hyɛ wa Mawu ɔ we ɔ nɔ saminya.

Title: NEHEMIA 11
Content:
Nihi nɛ hi Yerusalem ɔ
1Ma nimeli ɔmɛ hi Yerusalem ma klɔuklɔu ɔ mi, nɛ ma a mi bi ɔmɛ nɛ piɛ ɔ fɔ sɔ kɛ hla nɔ kake ngɛ ni nyɔngma a kpɛti kɛ piɛ ma nimeli ɔmɛ a he; se nihi nɛ piɛ ɔ lɛɛ a ya hi ma kpa amɛ kɛ kɔpe ɔmɛ a mi. 2Ni kpahi nɛ a si a gugue ke a maa hi Yerusalem ɔ, Israel ma a je a yi saminya. 3 Israel ma a, osɔfo ɔmɛ, Levi bi ɔmɛ, sɔlemi we ɔ ní tsuli ɔmɛ, kɛ Salomo tsɔli ɔmɛ a nina amɛ lɛɛ a hi mɛ nitsɛmɛ a zugba nɔ, ngɛ a ma amɛ kɛ kɔpe ɔmɛ a mi.
Yuda zugba a nɔ ma nimeli nɛ hi Yerusalem ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ. 4Yuda wɛtso ɔ mi bimɛ: Uzia bi Ataya, Zakaria bibi ɔ. E nɛmɛ kpahi ji Amaria, Shefatia, kɛ Mahalalel. Yuda bi Perez nina ji mɛ tsuo.
5Baruk bi Maaseya, Kolhoze bibi ɔ. E nɛmɛ kpahi ji Hazaya, Adaya, Yoyarib, kɛ Zakaria. Yuda bi Shela nina ji mɛ tsuo.
6Perez nina nɛ hi Yerusalem a yibɔ ji 468. Katsɛmɛ ji mɛ tsuo.
7Benyamin wɛtso ɔ mi bimɛ: Meshulam bi Salu, Yoed bibi ɔ. E nɛmɛ kpahi ji Pedaya, Kolaya, Maaseya, Itiel, kɛ Yeshaya.
8Gabai kɛ Salai; a weku no pɔtɛɛ ji Salu.
Benyamin bi tsuo nɛ hi Yerusalem ɔ a hiɛmi ji 928. 9A nyatsɛ ji Zikri bi Yoel; nɛ Hasenua bi Yuda ji ma a nɔ hyɛlɔ ɔ setsɔ. 10Osɔfo ɔmɛ: Yoyarib bi Yedaya kɛ Yakin.
11Hilkia bi Seraya, Meshulam bibi ɔ. E nɛmɛ ji Zadok, Merayot, kɛ osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa Ahitub. 12Nihi tsuo nɛ je we puɔ nya nɛ ɔ nɛ a sɔmɔɔ ngɛ sɔlemi ɔ we ɔ, a hiɛmi ji 822.
Yeroham bi Adaya, Pelalia bibi ɔ. E nɛmɛ ji Amzi, Zakaria, Pashur, kɛ Malkiya. 13Nihi nɛ je we puɔ nya nɛ ɔ ji 242, nɛ mɛ tsuo we puɔ nyatsɛmɛ ji mɛ.
Azarel bi Amashsai, Azai bibi ɔ. E nɛmɛ ji Meshilemot, kɛ Imer. 14Nihi 128 je we puɔ nya nɛ ɔ, nɛ ta hwuli kpanakpanaa ji mɛ. A nyatsɛ ji Hagedolim bi Zabdiel. 15Levi bi ɔmɛ:
Hashub bi Shemaya, Azrikam bibi ɔ. E nɛmɛ ji Hashabia kɛ Buni.
16Shabetai kɛ Yozabad ji Levi bi nɛ hyɛɛ Mawu we ɔ kpo nɔ je ní tsumi ɔ nɔ.
17Mika bi Matania, Asaf nina ko nɛ a tsɛɛ Zabdi ɔ bibi ɔ. Lɛ ji nɔ nɛ jeɔ la nɛ a kɛ jeɔ si nami sɔlemi sisi.
Bakbukia, Matania setsɔ ɔ, kɛ Shamua bi Abda, Yedutun nina Galal bibi ɔ.
18Levi bi tsuo nɛ hi Yerusalem ma klɔuklɔu ɔ mi ɔ, a yibɔ ji 284.
19
Agbo nya buli:
Akub, kɛ Talmon, kɛ a weku li. Mɛ tsuo a yibɔ ji 172.
20Israel ma nɛ piɛ ɔ, a kɛ osɔfo ɔmɛ, kɛ Levi bi nɛ piɛ ɔ hi mɛ nitsɛmɛ a zugba nɔ ngɛ Yuda ma kpa amɛ a mi. 21Sɔlemi we ɔ he ní tsuli ɔmɛ hi Yerusalem he ko nɛ a tsɛɛ Ofel ɔ, nɛ a nyatsɛmɛ ji Ziha kɛ Gishpa.
22Nɔ nɛ hyɛɛ Levi bi nɛ ngɛ Yerusalem ɔ a nɔ ji Bani bi Uzi, Hashabia bibi ɔ. E nɛmɛ ji Matania kɛ Mika. E je Asaf we puɔ nya. We puɔ nya nɛ ɔ blɔ nya ji kaa e hyɛ la nɛ a laa kɛ sɔmɔɔ ngɛ Mawu we ɔ nɔ saminya. 23Matsɛ David wo mlaa nɛ tsɔɔ bɔ nɛ lali ɔmɛ maa hi a sibi tsakee kɛ lami, kɛ hiɔwo nɛ sa nɛ a haa mɛ daa ligbi.
24Meshezabel bi Petahia nɛ je Zera we puɔ nya, kɛ Yuda we puɔ nya a, daa Israel ma a nya ngɛ ma a sane yemihi a mi.
Nihi nɛ hi ma kpa amɛ a mi
25Israel bi ɔmɛ babauu hi a kɔpe ɔmɛ a mi ngɛ ngmɔ si. Yuda wɛtso ɔ mi bi ɔmɛ hi Kiriat Arba, Dibon, Yekabzeel, kɛ a he kɔpe ɔmɛ a mi. 26Ni ɔmɛ ekomɛ hi Yeshua, Molada, Betpelet, 27Hazarshual, Beersheba, kɛ a he kɔpe ɔmɛ a mi. 28A hi Ziklag, Mekona, kɛ a he kɔpe ɔmɛ, 29kɛ Enrimon, Zora, Yarmut, 30Zanoa Adulam, kɛ a he kɔpe ɔmɛ a mi. A hi Lakish kɛ ngmɔ ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ e kasa nya a a nɔ, kɛ Azeka, kɛ e he kɔpe ɔmɛ a mi. E nya tsɔɔmi ji Yuda bi ɔmɛ hi zugba nɛ ngɛ kɛ je Beersheba ngɛ leneyi je kɛ ya si Hinon kɔ̃ ɔ mi ngɛ omleyi je ɔ nɔ.
31Benyamin wɛtso ɔ mi bi ɔmɛ hi Geba, Mikmash, Ai, Betel, kɛ a he kɔpe ɔmɛ a mi. 32Ma kpahi a mi nɛ a hi ji Anatot, Nob, Anania, 33Hazor, Rama, Gitaim, 34Hadid, Zeboyim, Nebalat, 35Lod, Ono, kɛ ga ní tsuli a kɔ̃ ɔ mi. 36Levi bi ɔmɛ ekomɛ nɛ hi Yuda zugba a nɔ ɔ kɛ Benyamin bi ɔmɛ ya hi si.

Title: NEHEMIA 12
Content:
Osɔfohi kɛ Levi bi a biɛhi
1Osɔfohi kɛ Levi bi nɛ kpale kɛ je ma se kɛ ba a, a kɛ Shaeltiel bi Zerubabel, kɛ osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa nɛ a tsɛɛ Yoshua a nɛ ba. A biɛhi ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ:
Osɔfo ɔmɛ:
2-7Seraya, Yeremia, Ezra,
Amaria, Maluk, Hatush,
Shekania, Rehum, Meremot,
Ido, Ginetoi, Abiya,
Miyamin, Maadia, Bilga,
Shemaya, Yoyarib, Yedaya,
Salu, Amok, Hilkia, kɛ Yedaya.
Mɛ ji a nyɛmimɛ osɔfo ɔmɛ tsuo a nya dali ngɛ
Yoshua yi nɔ.
8Levi bi:
Nihi nɛ hyɛɛ nɛ a la sina lahi ji Yeshua, Binui, Kadmiel, Sherebia, Yuda, kɛ Matania.
9Lali a kuu nɛ heɔ la nɔ ji Bakbukia, Uno, kɛ e nyɛmimɛ Levi bi ɔmɛ.
Osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa Yoshua nina
10Yoshua bi ji Yoyakim; Yoyakim bi ji Eliashib, nɛ Eliashib hu bi ji Yoyada. 11Yoyada bi ji Yonatan, nɛ Yonatan bi ji Yadua.
Osɔfo weku ɔmɛ a nyatsɛmɛ
12-21Osɔfo weku ɔmɛ a nyatsɛmɛ ngɛ osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa Yoyakim yi nɔ ɔ, a biɛhi ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ:
Osɔfo Weku
Meraya Seraya
Hanania Yeremia
Meshulam Ezra
Yehohanan Amaria
Yonatan Maluki
Yosef Shebania
Adna Harim
Helkai Merayot
Zakaria Ido
Meshulam Gineton
Zikri Abiya
… Miniamin
Piltai Moadia
Shamua Bilga
Yehonatan Shemaya
Matenai Yoyarib
Uzi Yedaya
Kalai Salai
Eber Amok
Hashabia Hilkia
Netanel Yedaya
Osɔfo ɔmɛ kɛ Levi bi ɔmɛ a wekuhi a he sane
22A ngma Levi bi ɔmɛ a weku ɔmɛ a nyatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ osɔfo ɔmɛ a weku ɔmɛ a nyatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ hu a biɛhi ngɔ wo womi mi ngɛ osɔfo nikɔtɔma pe kulaa nɛ ɔmɛ a wami be mi: Eliashib, Yoyada, Yonatan, kɛ Yadua. A ya nɔ ngma biɛ nɛ ɔmɛ hluu kɛ ya si Persia matsɛ, Darius yi nɔ.
23Levi bi ɔmɛ a weku ɔmɛ a nyatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a biɛ ɔmɛ lɛɛ a ngma kɛ wo Blema Sanehi Womi ɔ mi kɛ ba su Eliashib bibi Yonatan be ɔ mi pɛ.
Bɔ nɛ a dla sɔlemi we ɔ mi ní tsumi ɔmɛ
24A dla Levi bi ɔmɛ a mi ngɔ wo kuuhi a mi. A nyatsɛmɛ ji Hashabia, Sherebia, Yeshua, Binui, kɛ Kadmiel. Kuu enyɔ ya buaa a he nya si kake kɛ laa kɛ jeɔ Mawu yi. Kuu kake jeɔ la a, nɛ enyɔne ɔ heɔ nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ Matsɛ David, Mawu nɔmlɔ ɔ to blɔ nya ha mɛ ke a pee ɔ.
25Buli nɛ ɔmɛ ji nihi nɛ buu ngɛ nito hehi nɛ ngɛ sɔlemi we ɔ agbo ɔmɛ a nya: Matania, Bakbukia, Obadia, Meshulam, Talmon, kɛ Akub.
26Nihi nɛ a wo a ta nɛ ɔ hi si ngɛ Yeshua bi Yoyakim, Yehozadak bibi ɔ yi nɔ. Jamɛ a be ɔ kɛ̃ nɛ Nehemia ye amlaalo, nɛ osɔfo Ezra hu ji mlaa tsɔɔlɔ ɔ nɛ.
Nehemia julaa ma a gbogbo ɔ
27Benɛ a maa julaa Yerusalem gbogbo ɔ, a ya kpee Levi bi ɔmɛ kɛ je hehi tsuo nɛ a ngɛ ɔ kɛ ba. A ba piɛ Yerusalem ma mi bi ɔmɛ a he, nɛ a fia gɔgɔ, kɛ saku, nɛ a la sina lahi nɛ a kɛ ye nyami ligbi ɔ. 28A bua lali ɔmɛ hu a nya kɛ je Yerusalem kpo ɔ mi kɛ kɔpehi nɛ bɔle Netofa, 29Betgilgal, Geba, kɛ Azmavet kɛ ba. 30Osɔfo ɔmɛ, kɛ Levi bi ɔmɛ pee kusumi kɛ julaa mɛ nitsɛmɛ a he. A julaa ma a, kɛ agbo ɔmɛ, kɛ ma gbogbo ɔ hulɔ.
31Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, i bua Yuda ma nimeli ɔmɛ a nya ngɛ gbogbo ɔ nɔ, nɛ i ngɔ mɛ ngɔ to kuu agboagbo enyɔ a nya, konɛ a hyɛ nɛ a to kɛ nyɛɛ, nɛ a la Mawu yi jemi lahi kɛ bɔle ma a.
Kekleekle kuu ɔ nyɛɛ hiɔ nɔ, ngɛ gbogbo ɔ nɔ, kɛ yaa Dwɔmi Agbo ɔ nya. 32Hoshaya nyɛɛ lali ɔmɛ a se, nɛ Yuda ma nimeli ɔmɛ fa nyɛɛ e se. 33-35Osɔfo nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ bɛhi kpae kɛ nyɛɛ a se: Azaria, Ezra, Meshulam, Yuda, Benyamin, Shemaya, kɛ Yeremia. Jehanɛ, Yonatan bi Zakaria, Shemaya bibi ɔ ba. E nɛmɛ ɔ ekomɛ ji Matania, Mikaya, kɛ Zakur nɛ je Asaf weku ɔ mi ɔ. 36Ni kpahi nɛ je e weku ɔ mi nɛ nyɛɛ e se ji Shemaya, Azarel, Milalai, Gilalai, Maai, Netanel, Yuda, kɛ Hanani. Sakuhi nɛ Matsɛ David, nɛ a pɔɔ lɛ tsɛmi ke Mawu nɔmlɔ ɔ fiaa a, ni nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo hɛɛ jamɛ a saku ɔmɛ ekomɛ. Mlaa tsɔɔlɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ Ezra a, nyɛɛ kuu nɛ to ɔ a hɛ mi. 37A gu Nyu Vu Agbo ɔ nya kɛ kuɔ kpoku ɔmɛ nɛ yaa David ma a mi ɔ, kɛ ya be ngɛ David mɔ ɔ he, kɛ kpale kɛ ba Nyu Agbo ɔ nya, ngɛ ma a beleku je.
38Kuu enyɔne ɔ nyɛɛ muɔ nɔ ngɛ gbogbo ɔ nɔ, nɛ i kɛ ma a fa nyɛɛ a se. Wa to kɛ nyɛɛ kɛ ya gu Flɔɔnɔɔ Mɔ ɔ nɔ, kɛ ya su Gbogbo Gbajaa he. 39Wa tsa nɔ kɛ ya gu Efraim Agbo ɔ nɔ, Yeshana Agbo ɔ nɔ, Lo Agbo ɔ nɔ, Hananel Mɔ ɔ he, kɛ Lafa Mɔ ɔ he, hluu kɛ ya su To Agbo ɔ nɔ. Wa ba gbe nya ngɛ Buli Agbo ɔ nya.
40Kɛkɛ ɔ, lali a kuu enyɔ ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ ngɛ lae kɛ ngɛ Mawu si nae ɔ ba bua ngɛ Mawu we ɔ.
I kɛ ma nimeli nɛ nyɛɛ ye se ɔ hu ya su lejɛ ɔ, 41kɛ osɔfo nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ a bɛ ɔmɛ kpae: Eliakim, Maaseya, Miniamin, Mikaya, Elioenai, Zakaria, kɛ Hanania. 42Ni nɛ ɔmɛ hu tsa nɔ: Maaseya, Shemaya, Eleazar, Uzi, Yehohanan, Malkiya, Elam, kɛ Ezer. Lali ɔmɛ, kɛ a nyatsɛ Yezrahia la wawɛɛ.
43A sã bɔhi babauu jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, nɛ ma a nyá saminya; ejakaa Mawu ha nɛ a bua jɔ wawɛɛ nitsɛ. Yi ɔmɛ, kɛ jokuɛwi ɔmɛ hu piɛ he kɛ ye nyami ligbi ɔ; nɛ a nu ngmlaa a he ngɛ se lokoo.
A ke ní nɛ a kɛ sɔmɔ ngɛ sɔlemi we ɔ
44Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, nito hehi nɛ ngɛ sɔlemi we ɔ, nɛ a toɔ nike níhi ngɛ a mi ɔ, a ngɔ ni komɛ ngɔ to a nya, nɛ́ a hyɛ mi dlami nyɔngmanyɔngma mi kakaaka ɔmɛ, kɛ jeha mi kekleekle blɛfo ɔ, kɛ kekleekle tso yiblii nɛ fu ɔ a nɔ. Ni nɛ ɔmɛ a ní tsumi ji kaa a hyɛ nɛ a bua nike ní ɔmɛ a nya ngɛ ngmɔ ɔmɛ nɛ bɔle ma amɛ a nɔ, nɛ a kɛ ba ha osɔfo ɔmɛ, kɛ Levi bi ɔmɛ kaa bɔ nɛ mlaa a tsɔɔ ɔ. Yuda ma a tsuo bua jɔ osɔfo ɔmɛ, kɛ Levi bi ɔmɛ a he saminya; 45 ejakaa a pee he julaami, kɛ kusumi kpahi nɛ Mawu fa ke a pee ɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ. Jã kɛ̃, sɔlemi we ɔ lali ɔmɛ, kɛ buli ɔmɛ hu tsu a blɔ nya ní tsumi ɔmɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ kaa bɔ nɛ Matsɛ David kɛ e bi Salomo tsɔɔ kaa a pee ɔ. 46Lali a kuu nɛ laa yi jemi, kɛ sina lahi kɛ haa Mawu ɔ, Matsɛ David, kɛ la polɔ Asaf be ɔ mi tɔɔ nɛ a to nikɔtɔmahi ngɛ a nya. 47Zerubabel yi nɔ, kɛ Nehemia be ɔ mi ɔ, Israel ma a tsuo ngɔɔ nike ní kɛ ba haa nɛ a kɛ hyɛ sɔlemi we ɔ lali ɔmɛ, kɛ buli ɔmɛ a nɔ daa ligbi. Ma a ngɔɔ bɔ klɔuklɔu kɛ ba haa Levi bi ɔmɛ, nɛ mɛ hu a ngɔɔ bɔ ɔ mi fa, nɛ ji osɔfo ɔmɛ a blɔ nya a kɛ haa osɔfo ɔmɛ.

Title: NEHEMIA 13
Content:
A je nibwɔ ɔmɛ kɛ je a kpɛti
1 Benɛ a ngɛ mlaa a kanee, nɛ ma a tsuo ngɛ tue bue ɔ, a na he nɛ a ngma ngɛ ke a ko ngmɛ Amon no, loo Moab no ko blɔ nɛ e ba futu Mawu ma a mi bi ɔmɛ kɔkɔɔkɔ ɔ. 2 A wo mlaa nɛ ɔ, ejakaa benɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ je Egipt kɛ ma a, Amon bi ɔmɛ, kɛ Moab bi ɔmɛ ha we mɛ niye ní nɛ a ye; nyu tete po a ha we mɛ nɛ a nu. Nɔ́ nɛ a pee mohu ji kaa a ya bɔ Balaam apaa ke e ba gbiɛ Israel. Se wa Mawu ɔ plɛ gbiɛmi ɔ kɛ pee gbaami. 3Benɛ ma a nu mlaa a nɛ a kane ɔ, a je nibwɔ ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ je Israel bi ɔmɛ a kpɛti.
Nehemia tsake níhi
4Osɔfo Eliashib, nɔ nɛ hyɛɛ wa Mawu ɔ we ɔ nito he tsu ɔmɛ a nɔ ɔ, e huɛ ji Tobia. 5Eliashib dla tsu agbo ko ngɔ to Tobia. Jinɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ pɛ nɛ a toɔ ngɛ tsu ɔ mi: niye ní bɔ, mimɛ, níhi nɛ a kɛ tsuɔ ní ngɛ Mawu we ɔ, bɔhi nɛ a haa osɔfo ɔmɛ, blɛfo mi dlami nyɔngmanyɔngma mi kakaaka amɛ, wai, kɛ oliv nu nɛ a kɛ haa Levi bi ɔmɛ, kɛ Mawu we ɔ lali ɔmɛ, kɛ buli ɔmɛ ɔ. 6Be nɛ ɔ mi tsuo ɔ, i be Yerusalem; ejakaa Babilonia matsɛ, Artaherhes yi nɔ jeha nyingmi etɛ kɛ enyɔne ɔ mi ɔ, i ya e ngɔ nɛ i ya bɔ lɛ amaniɛ. Pee se ɔ, e ngmɛ mi blɔ, 7nɛ i kpale kɛ ba Yerusalem. Lejɛ ɔ nɛ i ya na yayami nɛ Eliashib pee kaa e je Mawu we ɔ tsu kake he gbi ha Tobia. Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ha nɛ ye mi mi fu wawɛɛ nitsɛ, 8nɛ i kɛ hɛdɔ ya je Tobia ní ɔmɛ tsuo kpo ngɔ hɛ pue he. 9I fa ke a sá tsu ɔmɛ a mi saminya, nɛ a ngɔ níhi nɛ a kɛ tsuɔ ní ngɛ Mawu we ɔ, kɛ ngma bɔ ɔmɛ, kɛ mimɛ ɔ kɛ ya to a hi hehi.
10 I na le hu kaa Mawu we ɔ lali ɔmɛ, kɛ Levi bi kpa amɛ je Yerusalem kɛ ho a ngmɔhi a mi ya; ejakaa niye ní nɛ a to kaa a ha mɛ ɔ, a ha we mɛ. 11I ka ma ní tsuli ɔmɛ a hɛ mi wawɛɛ kaa a hyɛ we Mawu we ɔ nɔ bɔ nɛ sa. Jehanɛ, i kpale Levi bi ɔmɛ, kɛ lali ɔmɛ kɛ ba to a ní tsumi ɔmɛ a nya ngɛ Mawu we ɔ ekohu. 12 Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, Israel ma a tsuo ngɔ a blɛfo, wai, kɛ oliv nu mi dlami nyɔngmanyɔngma mi kakaaka amɛ kɛ ba nito he ɔmɛ ekohu. 13I ngɔ nimli nɛ ɔmɛ ngɔ to nito he tsu ɔmɛ a nya: osɔfo Shelemia, mlaa tsɔɔlɔ Zadok, kɛ Levi no ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ Pedaya a. A he piɛlɔ ji Zakur bi Hanan, Matania bibi ɔ. I le mɛ kaa anɔkuale yeli nɛ a ní tsumi ji kaa a maa dla niye ní ɔ ha a sibi ní tsuli ɔmɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
14Mawu, i kpa mo pɛɛ, mo kai ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ i pee ɔ. Ni kpakpahi tsuo nɛ i pee kɛ ha o we ɔ, kɛ bɔ nɛ i sɔmɔ mo ɔ, o hɛ ko je nɔ.
15 Jamɛ a be ɔ, i na ni komɛ ngɛ Yuda nɛ a ngɛ wai yiblii ngae ngɛ Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ nɔ. Ni komɛ hu ngɛ tlomi fie kɛ ngɛ a tejihi a nɔ woe kɛ yaa Yerusalem. Tlomi ɔmɛ ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ: blɛfo, wai, wai yiblii, ngmɔkɔ, kɛ ní kpa komɛ. I bɔ mɛ kɔkɔ ke Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ, a ko jua ní. 16Tiro bi komɛ nɛ ngɛ Yerusalem ɔ, mɛ hu a ngɔɔ pa mi lo, kɛ nijua ní slɔɔtoslɔɔtohi babauu kɛ baa ma a mi, nɛ a ba juaa kɛ haa wa nyɛmimɛ Yuda bi ɔmɛ ngɛ Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ nɔ. 17I ka Yuda ma nimeli ɔmɛ a hɛ mi, nɛ i de mɛ ke, “Nɔ́ yayami nyɛ ngɛ pee nɛ ɔ nɛ!
