Nyɛ ngɛ Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ blee. 18Pi níhi nɛ nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ pee, nɛ Mawu gbla nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ Yerusalem ma a tue ɔ ji nɛ ɔmɛ lo? Mɛni he je mɔ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ blee kɛ mwɔɔ ɔ? Anɛ nyɛ li kaa nɔ́ nɛ ɔ kɛ Mawu mi mi fumi nɛ nya wa maa ba Israel nɔ lo?”
19Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i fa ke ke pu yaa nɔ si nɛ a maa je Hejɔɔmi ligbi tsuaa Hejɔɔmi ligbi yemi sisi ɔ, a nga ma agbo ɔmɛ, nɛ a ko bli kɛ yaa si Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ maa be. I ngɔ ye tsɔli ɔmɛ ekomɛ ngɔ to agbo ɔmɛ a nya, konɛ a hyɛ nɛ a ko ngɔ tlomi ko kɛ ba ma a mi Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ. 20Jua yeli nɛ juaa ní slɔɔtoslɔɔtohi ba hwɔ ma a gbogbo ɔmɛ a se Soha nyɔ mi si kake loo si enyɔ. 21I bɔ mɛ kɔkɔ, nɛ i de mɛ ke, “Nyɛ ko ba hwɔ gbogbo ɔ se kɛ mlɛ kɛ yaa si je maa na hu. Ke nyɛ pee ja ekohu ɔ, ma ha a maa nuu nyɛ!” Kɛ je lɔ ɔ se ɔ, a bɛ lejɛ ɔ Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ hu. 22Kɛkɛ nɛ i fa Levi bi ɔmɛ ke a tsukɔ a he, nɛ a ya bu agbo ɔmɛ a nya, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ a ye Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ klɔuklɔu.
Ye Mawu lee, mo kai mi ngɛ enɛ ɔ hu he, nɛ o baa ye yi ngɛ o suɔmi agbo nɛ ngɛ daa a he.
23 Jamɛ a be ɔ mi kɛ̃ nɛ i ná le kaa Yuda bi ɔmɛ babauu ya ngɔ yihi ngɛ Ashdod, Amon, kɛ Moab. 24A bimɛ ɔmɛ fa tuɔ Ashdod gbi, loo gbi kpa ko, nɛ a tu we Yuda gbi ɔ. 25Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i ka nyumu ɔmɛ a hɛ mi, nɛ i gbiɛ mɛ; i fia ni komɛ ní, nɛ i hiaa a yi bwɔmi. Jehanɛ, i ha a kɛ Mawu biɛ ka kita ke mɛ nitsɛmɛ, kɛ a binyumu ɔmɛ be nibwɔhi a biyi ɔmɛ ngɔe, nɛ a biyi ɔmɛ hu be nibwɔhi gbae kɔkɔɔkɔ hu. 26 I de ke, “Pi ma se yihi nɛ ha nɛ Matsɛ Salomo pee yayami ɔ? Matsɛ Salomo ji matsɛ nguaa pe je ma amɛ a matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsuo. Mawu suɔ e sane, nɛ e wo lɛ Israel tsuo nɔ matsɛ; se kɛ̃ ɔ, ma se yi ɔmɛ ha nɛ lɛ po e pee yayami. 27Anɛ waa nyɛɛ nyɛ se, nɛ wa ya ngɔ ma se yihi, nɛ wa tɔ Mawu nɔ lo?”
28 Osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa Eliashib bi ji Yoyada; se Yoyada bimɛ ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake ya ngɔ Sanbalat nɛ je Bet Horon ɔ biyo. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i fie Yoyada kɛ je Yerusalem.
29Ye Mawu, mo kai bɔ nɛ jamɛ a ni ɔmɛ ble osɔfo yemi, kɛ somi nɛ o kɛ osɔfo ɔmɛ, kɛ Levi bi ɔmɛ so ɔ hulɔ.
30Bɔ nɛ i pee kɛ tsukɔ ma a he kɛ je ma se níhi a he ji nɛ ɔ nɛ; i to osɔfo ɔmɛ, kɛ Levi bi ɔmɛ a ní tsumi ɔ hanɔhanɔ, nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ hɛɛ e ní tsumi nɛ e ngɛ tsue. 31I to blɔ nya, konɛ a ngɔ lɛ́ nɛ a kɛ maa sã bɔ ɔ kɛ ba ngɛ be nɔ. I to be hu nɛ a maa ngɔ a kekleekle ngmɔ niba ní ɔmɛ kɛ ba.
Ye Mawu, mo kai ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo, nɛ o ha nɛ e hi ha mi.

Title: ESTER NYA TSƆƆMI
Content:
NYA TSƆƆMI
Sane nɛ ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ mi ɔ ba mi ngɛ he nɛ Persia matsɛ ɔ ya yeɔ fĩɛ be ngɛ ɔ. Sane ɔ kɔɔ Yuda yo ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Ester he. Yo nɛ ɔ kɛ e ma he dɔmi pee kã wawɛɛ nitsɛ kɛ he e ma a yi wami kɛ je a he nyɛli a dɛ mi. Ke pi ma he dɔlɔ, kɛ kã peelɔ Ester nɛ ɔ he ɔ, jinɛ a he nyɛli ɔmɛ kpata Yuda ma a hɛ mi butuu. Womi ɔ tsɔɔ Yuda bi a nyami be nɛ a tsɛɛ Purim ɔ sisi, kɛ nɔ́ he je nɛ a yeɔ jamɛ a nyami be ɔ.
Bɔ nɛ a dla womi ɔ mi ha
Ester ba pee manyɛ 1.1—2.23
Ga yayahi nɛ Haman to 3.1—5.14
A gbe Haman 6.1—7.10
Yuda bi ɔmɛ ye a he nyɛli ɔmɛ a nɔ 8.1—10.3

Title: ESTER 1
Content:
Manyɛ Vashti wo e he ha Matsɛ Ahasuerus
1-2 Be ko ɔ, Persia matsɛ ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Ahasuerus ɔ ba ye tsɛ. E matsɛ ma biɛ ji Susa. Matsɛ nɛ ɔ ye ma 127 sɔuu a nɔ kɛ je India kɛ ya su Sudan tɔɔ.
3Benɛ e ngɛ tsɛ yee ɔ, jeha etɛne ɔ, e tsɛ e ganɔ ɔmɛ, kɛ e tsɔli ɔmɛ tsuo ní yemi. E kpee Persia kɛ Media tabo ɔmɛ, amlaalo ɔmɛ, kɛ odehe ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ ba. 4E jé e matsɛ we ɔ mi afɛu níhi, kɛ hɛ mi nyami, kɛ agboje babauu kpo kɛ tsɔɔ ni ɔmɛ nyɔhiɔ ekpa sɔuu.
5Pee se ɔ, matsɛ ɔ tsɛ Susa ma a mi bi ɔmɛ tsuo ní yemi, niatsɛmɛ kɛ ohiatsɛmɛ tsuo. A ye ní nɛ a nu ní ngɛ abɔɔ ɔ mi ngɛ matsɛ we ɔ mi otsi. 6Bɔ nɛ a dla lejɛ ɔ ha ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: a kɛ bo bluu, kɛ bo futaa kpla lejɛ ɔ, nɛ a kɛ kpa hiɔ nɛ ngɛ fɛu, kɛ kpa nɛ hɛɛ kɔbɛi su fi sika hiɔ gahi ngɔ wo titimahi nɛ a kɛ tɛ hiɔ pee ɔ a he. Sɛhi nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ hu sika tsu, kɛ sika hiɔ a kɛ pee mɛ. Zugba a nɛ sɛ ɔmɛ maa si ngɛ nɔ ɔ hu, a kɛ tɛ kpakpa nɛ ɔmɛ ka: tɛ hiɔ, tɛ tsu, tɛ nɛ he jua wa nɛ ngɛ kpɛe, kɛ tɛ bluu. 7A wo dã ha ni ɔmɛ ngɛ sika tsu kplu slɔɔtoslɔɔtohi a mi; nɛ matsɛ ɔ dã a hiɛ bɔ nɛ sa. 8Dã nɛ a nu ɔ hiɛ babauu nitsɛ; ejakaa matsɛ ɔ wo e tsɔli ɔmɛ mlaa ke a ha nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ nu dã a bɔ nɛ e suɔ.
9Jamɛ a be ɔ mi nɔuu ɔ, Manyɛ Vashti hu tsɛ yi ɔmɛ ní yemi ngɛ matsɛ we ɔ mi.
10Ligbi nɛ ji kpaago ɔ, benɛ matsɛ ɔ nu dã nɛ e bua jɔ saminya a, e tsɛ e he buli kpaago ɔmɛ nɛ a puɛ mɛ ɔ. Mɛ ji Mehunan, Bizta, Habona, Bigta, Abagta, Zeta, kɛ Kakas. 11E fa mɛ ke a ya ngɔ Manyɛ Vashti kɛ ba kɛ e yi jlasi ɔ. Manyɛ Vashti he ngɛ fɛu saminya; nɛ matsɛ ɔ ngɛ hlae nɛ ganɔ ɔmɛ, kɛ ni ɔmɛ nɛ e kpee kɛ ba a tsuo nɛ a na bɔ nɛ manyɛ ɔ he ngɛ fɛu ha. 12Se benɛ tsɔli ɔmɛ ya de Manyɛ Vashti ke matsɛ ɔ ke a ba ngɔ lɛ kɛ ba a, e kua bami. Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ha matsɛ ɔ mi mi fu wawɛɛ nitsɛ.
13Ke sane kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ ba a, matsɛ ɔ tsɛɔ ga woli nɛ a woɔ lɛ ga. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e tsɛ e ga woli nɛ le a mlaa amɛ, kɛ kusumi ɔmɛ saminya a, konɛ a tsɔɔ lɛ nɔ́ nɛ sa nɛ e pee. 14E he nihi nɛ e pɔɔ tsɛmi ji Kashena, Shetar, Admata, Tarshish, Meres, Marsena, kɛ Memukan. Nimli kpaago nɛ ɔmɛ ji Persia kɛ Media nɔ yemi ɔ mi ganɔhi nɛ hɛɛ blɔ nya nguaa pe kulaa. 15E de mɛ ke, “Imi Matsɛ Ahasuerus, i tsɔ nihi ke a ya ngɔ Manyɛ Vashti kɛ ba a, e kua bami. Wa mlaa a nya a, kɛ wa maa pee lɛ kɛɛ?”
16Kɛkɛ nɛ Memukan de matsɛ ɔ, kɛ ganɔ ɔmɛ nɛ pueɔ si ɔ ke, “Pi mo matsɛ ɔ kɛkɛ o nɔ nɛ Manyɛ Vashti tɔ̃, se mohu e tɔ̃ ganɔ ɔmɛ tsuo a nɔ. Anɔkuale mi ɔ, e tɔ̃ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɔ ngɛ o nɔ yemi he ɔ! 17Yihi tsuo nɛ ngɛ o nɔ yemi he ɔ ma ba nu nɔ́ nɛ Manyɛ Vashti pee nɛ ɔ, nɛ a be a hunomɛ bue hu. A ma de ke, ‘Matsɛ Ahasuerus nitsɛ po fa ke a ya ngɔ Manyɛ Vashti kɛ ba, nɛ e kua bami’. 18Ke matsɛ ɔ ganɔhi nɛ ngɛ Persia kɛ Media a a yi ɔmɛ nu nɔ́ nɛ manyɛ ɔ pee nɛ ɔ, a ma ya sɛɛ ha a hunomɛ mwɔnɛ ɔ loko du ma bu. Jehanɛ, yigbayihi ngɛ he tsuaa he be a hunomɛ bue hu; nɛ nyumu ɔmɛ hu a mi mi ma fu a yi ɔmɛ wawɛɛ. 19Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɛnɛ, ke e sa o hɛ mi ɔ, wo mlaa ngɛ o he wami ɔ nya ke Vashti kó ba matsɛ ɔ hɛ mi gblegbleegble hu. Fa nɛ a ngma ngɔ wo Persia kɛ Media mlaa amɛ a mi, konɛ a ko tsake mlaa nɛ ɔ kɔkɔɔkɔ. Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, ngɔɔ e blɔ nya kaa manyɛ ɔ ngɔ ha yo kpa nɛ ngɛ subai kpakpa pe lɛ. 20Ke o wo mlaa nɛ ɔ, nɛ a fiɛ kɛ kpa o nɔ yemi he nguaa nɛ ɔ tsuo ɔ, yigbayihi tsuo maa bu a hunomɛ, nimli nguahi jio, nimli wawi jio.”
21Ga nɛ Memukan wo nɛ ɔ sa matsɛ ɔ, kɛ ganɔ ɔmɛ a hɛ mi, nɛ matsɛ ɔ pee ja. 22E tsɔ nɛ a kɛ womihi ya matsɛ ɔ nɔ yemi he ɔmɛ tsuo; a ngma munyu ɔmɛ ngɛ zugba tsuaa zugba e ningma kɛ e gbi mi ke nyumu tsuaa nyumu nɛ pee wetsɛ, nɛ ke e de nɔ́ ko ɔ, nɔ ko nɔ ko kó de nɔ́ kpa ko hu.

Title: ESTER 2
Content:
Ester ba ye manyɛ
1Pee se, benɛ matsɛ ɔ tsui jɔ ɔ, e kai nɔ́ nɛ Vashti pee ɔ, kɛ mlaa nɛ e wo ngɛ e he ɔ. 2Kɛkɛ nɛ e ga woli kpakpa amɛ a ti ni komɛ de lɛ ke, “Nɛnɛ, ha nɛ a hla yihewi komɛ nɛ a he ngɛ fɛu ba ha mo. 3Ha nɛ a to nihi ngɛ o nɔ yemi he ɔmɛ tsuo, nɛ a bua yihewi nɛ a he ngɛ fɛu nɛ ɔ a nya kɛ ba matsɛ yi ɔmɛ a hi he ɔ, ngɛ matsɛ we ɔ ngɛ Susa. Ha nɛ Hegai, nyumu nɛ a puɛ lɛ, nɛ hyɛɛ o yi ɔmɛ a nɔ ɔ nɛ hyɛ a nɔ. Ha nɛ a pɔ mɛ nu kɛ dla mɛ saminya. 4Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, ngɔɔ yiheyo nɛ o suɔ pe kulaa ngɛ a kpɛti, nɛ o wo lɛ manyɛ ngɛ Vashti nane mi.”
Ga nɛ a wo nɛ ɔ sa matsɛ ɔ hɛ mi, nɛ e pee ja.
5Yuda no ko hi Susa ma a mi nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Mordekai. E je Benyamin wɛtso ɔ mi. E tsɛ biɛ ji Yair, e nɛ̃ ji Simei, nɛ e nɛnɛkasowa ji Kish. 6 Benɛ Babilon matsɛ, Nebukadnezar ba nuu Yuda matsɛ, Yehoyakin, kɛ ni komɛ ngɛ Yerusalem kɛ ho ɔ, Mordekai hu piɛ he. 7Mordekai tsɛ nyɛminyumu ngɛ bi yiheyo ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Ester; e Hebri biɛ ji Hadasa. E ji yiheyo nɛ he ngɛ fɛu, nɛ zangma pue e nɔ. Benɛ e tsɛ kɛ e nyɛ gbo ɔ, Mordekai ngɔ lɛ kaa lɛ nitsɛ e bi nɛ e hyɛ lɛ.
8Benɛ matsɛ ɔ mlaa a je kpo ɔ, a ngɔ yihewi babauu kɛ ba Susa; nɛ Ester hu piɛ a he kɛ ba matsɛ we ɔ. A kɛ lɛ wo Hegai nɛ hyɛɛ matsɛ yi ɔmɛ a nɔ ɔ dɛ, nɛ́ e hyɛ e nɔ. 9Hegai suɔ Ester sane, nɛ e na e he bua jɔmi. E yi be ko nɛ e ha a bɔni lɛ nu pɔmi nɛ a kɛ dla lɛ; a ha lɛ niye ní kpakpa hulɔ. Hegai ngɔ Ester ya to he ko nɛ hi pe kulaa ngɛ matsɛ yi ɔmɛ a hi he ɔ, nɛ e je blɔ hla yihewi kpaago kɛ je matsɛ we ɔ, nɛ́ a sɔmɔ lɛ.
10Be nɛ ɔ mi tsuo ɔ, kaa bɔ nɛ Mordekai wo lɛ ga a, Ester ha we nɛ a le kaa Yuda no ji lɛ. 11Daa ligbi ɔ, Mordekai ya slaa si ngɛ kue ɔ nɛ ngɛ matsɛ yi ɔmɛ a hi he ɔ hɛ mi, nɛ e kɛ hyɛɔ kaa Ester ngɛ saminya, aloo sane ko ba e nɔ lo.
12Bɔ nɛ a peeɔ kɛ dlaa yi ɔmɛ a he nɛ a he peeɔ fɛu ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: a pɔɔ mɛ nu, nɛ a kpaa mɛ mimɛ nyɔhiɔ ekpa; nɛ a pɔɔ mɛ nu kɛ e he via nyɔhiɔ ekpa ekohu; lɛ tsuo peeɔ jeha kake. Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, a toɔ be ha yihewi ɔmɛ, nɛ a kɛ mɛ yaa Matsɛ Ahasuerus ngɔ kakaaka. 13Ke e su be nɛ yiheyo ko maa je yi ɔmɛ a hi he ɔ kɛ ya matsɛ we ɔ, a ma ha lɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ e suɔ nɛ e kɛ dla e he. 14E maa ya matsɛ we ɔ gbɔkuɛ, nɛ ke je na mɔtu ɔ, a kɛ lɛ maa ya matsɛ yi ɔmɛ a hi he kpa, ya ha Shaashgaz. Shaashgaz nɛ ɔ ji nyumu nɛ a puɛ lɛ nɛ hyɛɛ matsɛ plã amɛ a nɔ. Yiheyo nɛ ɔ be matsɛ ɔ ngɔ yae hu, ja matsɛ ɔ ná e he bua jɔmi, nɛ e wo e biɛ ta, nɛ e tsɔ ke a ya ngɔ lɛ kɛ ba ekohu.
15E ba su Ester nɔ kaa e ya matsɛ ɔ ngɔ. Mordekai tsɛ nyɛminyumu Abihail biyo ji Ester. Mordekai nɛ hyɛ Ester nɔ kaa lɛ nitsɛ e biyo. Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa na Ester a suɔ e sane. Benɛ e maa ya matsɛ ɔ ngɔ ɔ, Ester dla e he kɛ nɔ́ nɛ Hegai wo lɛ ga ke e kɛ dla e he ɔ pɛ; e bi we nɔ́ ko kɛ piɛ we he. Hegai nɛ ɔ ji nyumu nɛ a puɛ lɛ nɛ hyɛɛ matsɛ yi ɔmɛ a nɔ. 16Benɛ Matsɛ Ahasuerus ngɛ tsɛ yee ɔ we jeha kpaagone ɔ we nyɔhiɔ nyɔngmane ɔ nɛ a kɛ Ester ba e ngɔ ngɛ matsɛ we ɔ nɛ. Nyɔhiɔ nɛ ɔ biɛ ji Tebet. 17Matsɛ ɔ suɔ Ester pe yihewi kpa amɛ tsuo, nɛ e bua jɔ Ester he pe mɛ tsuo. Matsɛ Ahasuerus ngɔ jlasi ɔ ngɔ bu Ester, nɛ e wo lɛ manyɛ ngɛ Vashti nane mi. 18Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, matsɛ ɔ tsɛ e ganɔ ɔmɛ, kɛ e tsɔli ɔmɛ ní yemi ko nɛ sɔ saminya, nɛ e kɛ wo Manyɛ Ester hɛ mi nyami. E ha a fiɛ ngɛ e nɔ yemi he ɔmɛ tsuo ke a jɔɔ a he; nɛ e dla nike ní bɔ nɛ sa matsɛ ngɔ ha mɛ.
Mordekai he matsɛ ɔ yi wami
19Benɛ a ma bua yihewi ɔmɛ a nya si enyɔne ɔ, jamɛ a be ɔ, matsɛ ɔ ha Mordekai ba pee tsɔlɔ nɔkɔtɔma. 20Mordekai wo Ester ga ke e ko ha nɛ nɔ ko nɛ le kaa Yuda no ji lɛ. Ester hu bu lɛ tue kaa bɔ nɛ e peeɔ benɛ e ji jokuɛyo nɛ Mordekai ngɛ e nɔ hyɛe ɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, kɛ ba su be nɛ ɔ mi tsuo ɔ, nɔ ko nɔ ko li kaa Yuda no ji lɛ.
21Benɛ Mordekai ba pee nɔkɔtɔma ngɛ matsɛ we ɔ, ligbi ko ɔ, matsɛ we ɔ agbo nya buli enyɔ komɛ a mi mi fu matsɛ ɔ, nɛ a so ke a maa gbe lɛ. Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ ji nyumuhi nɛ a puɛ, nɛ a tsuɔ ní ngɛ matsɛ we ɔ. Nɔ kake biɛ ji Bigtana, nɛ nɔ kake hu biɛ ji Teresh. 22Mordekai nu nɔ́ nɛ ɔ he, nɛ e ya sɛɛ ha Manyɛ Ester, nɛ lɛ hu e ya de matsɛ ɔ nɔ́ nɛ Mordekai ba de lɛ ɔ. 23Benɛ a hla sane ɔ mi ɔ, a na kaa sane ɔ ngɛ mi niinɛ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a sɛu ni enyɔ nɛ ɔmɛ. Matsɛ Ahasuerus fa nɛ a ngma sane nɛ ɔ ngɔ wo e yi nɔ sanehi womi ɔ mi.

Title: ESTER 3
Content:
Haman to ga nɛ a kpata Yuda bi ɔmɛ a hɛ mi
1Enɛ ɔmɛ a se ɔ, Matsɛ Ahasuerus wó nyumu ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Haman nɔ, nɛ e pee lɛ e ganɔ ɔmɛ a nɔkɔtɔma. Hamedata bi Haman ɔ, Agag nina ji lɛ. 2Matsɛ ɔ fa e tsɔli ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ ngɛ e sisi ɔ ke a bu Haman, nɛ a kpla si kɛ ha lɛ. Ni ɔmɛ tsuo peeɔ ja, se Mordekai kpla we si ha lɛ fɛɛ! 3Tsɔli kpa amɛ nɛ a ngɛ matsɛ ɔ ní tsumi ɔ mi ɔ bi Mordekai nɔ́ he je nɛ e pee we nɔ́ nɛ matsɛ ɔ fa ke a pee ɔ. 4Daa nɛ ɔ, a nyɛɛ e nɔ ke e ye mlaa nɛ matsɛ ɔ wo ɔ nɔ kɛkɛ, se nɔ́ nɛ e deɔ ji, “Yuda no ji mi, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i be nyɛe ma kpla si ha Haman.” A ya sɛɛ nɔ́ nɛ Mordekai de ɔ ha Haman, nɛ a ngɛ hyɛe nɔ́ nɛ e maa pee Mordekai. 5Benɛ Haman kpá si kaa Mordekai bui lɛ, nɛ e kpla we si ha we lɛ ɔ, e hɛ dɔ; 6nɛ benɛ e na le kaa Yuda no ji Mordekai ɔ, e to ga kaa e be Mordekai nɔ kake pɛ e tue gblae, se mohu e ma kpata Yuda bi tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ a hɛ mi ngɛ Ahasuerus nɔ yemi he ɔmɛ tsuo.
7Matsɛ Ahasuerus tsɛ yemi be ɔ mi jeha nyɔngma kɛ enyɔne ɔ we kekleekle nyɔhiɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ Nisan ɔ, Haman fa ke a fɔ sɔ, konɛ a kɛ na ligbi nɔ, kɛ nyɔhiɔ mi nɛ sa kaa a tsu nɔ́ nɛ e to ga kaa a pee ɔ. Sɔ ɔ tsɔɔ kaa nyɔhiɔ nyɔngma kɛ enyɔne ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ Adar a we ligbi nyɔngma kɛ etɛ ɔ ji be nɛ sa; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a ngɔ jamɛ a ligbi ɔ. (A tsɛɛ sɔ fɔmi ngɛ Hebri gbi mi ke “Purim”.)
8Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, Haman ya de Matsɛ Ahasuerus ke, “Nɛnɛ, ma ko ngɛ nɛ e mi bi gbɛ fĩa ma amɛ tsuo a mi ngɛ o nɔ yemi he ɔmɛ tsuo. Mɛɛ lɛɛ e slo a kusumihi ngɛ je ma kpa amɛ tsuo a ní ɔmɛ a he. Jehanɛ hu, nɛnɛ, a yi o mlaa amɛ a nɔ, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e he be se nami ko ha mo kaa o maa pee kɔ maa hi mɛ hyɛe kikɛ nɛ ɔ. 9Nɛnɛ, ke e sa o hɛ mi ɔ, lɛɛ fa nɛ a ngma, nɛ a fiɛ ke a kpata a hɛ mi. Ke o pee ja a, i ngɛ si woe ke ma ha sika hiɔ nɛ jiimi pe kilo 340,000, nɛ a kɛ to matsɛ sika tomi he ɔ, konɛ a kɛ tsu ma ní.”
10Kɛkɛ nɛ matsɛ ɔ je e nine nguɛ ga, nɛ e kɛ ha Agag nina, Hamedata bi Haman, Yuda bi ɔmɛ a he nyɛlɔ ɔ. Ga nɛ ɔ a kɛ sɔuɔ matsɛ ɔ mlaahi nɛ a wo ɔ a nya kɛ tsɔɔ kaa matsɛ ɔ kplɛɛ níhi nɛ a ngma a nɔ. 11Matsɛ ɔ de Haman ke, “O sika a nɛ hi si. Jamɛ a ma a kɛ e mi bi ɔmɛ ngɛ o dɛ mi; pee mɛ bɔ nɛ sa o hɛ mi.”
12Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, kekleekle nyɔhiɔ ɔ ligbi nyɔngma kɛ etɛne ɔ nɔ ɔ, Haman tsɛ matsɛ womi ngmali ɔmɛ nɛ e tsɔɔ mɛ nɔ́ nɛ a ngma. A ngma ngɛ zugba tsuaa zugba e ningma, kɛ e gbi mi; nɛ a kɛ mane nɔ yeli ɔmɛ, amlaalo ɔmɛ, kɛ ganɔ ɔmɛ tsuo. A ngma ngɛ Matsɛ Ahasuerus biɛ mi, nɛ a kɛ matsɛ ɔ nguɛ ga a sɔu nya. 13Tsɔli nɛ a he sɔɔ saminya ngɔ womi nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ ya he tsuaa he ngɛ e nɔ yemi he ɔ. Bɔ nɛ a ngma ngɛ womi ɔmɛ a mi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: nyɔhiɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ ke Adar a we ligbi nyɔngma kɛ etɛne ɔ, jamɛ a ligbi ɔ nɔ tutuutu ɔ, á kpata Yuda bi tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ a hɛ mi; jokuɛwi, nikɔtɔmahi, nyumuhi, kɛ yihi. Á kɛ yi mi wami nɛ kpata mɛ tsuo a hɛ mi, nɛ́ a ha a níhi. 14Á fiɛ womi nɛ ɔ mi munyu ɔmɛ ngɛ zugba a tsuo nɔ. Ke a nu mlaa nɛ ɔ, ma amɛ tsuo nɛ a dla a he kɛ to jamɛ a ligbi ɔ.
15Matsɛ ɔ ha nɛ a fiɛ mlaa nɛ ɔ ngɛ matsɛ ma Susa a mi. Kɛkɛ nɛ a ha tsɔli nɛ a he sɔɔ saminya pue nɔ oya kɛ mlaa nɛ ɔ kɛ ho e nɔ yemi he ɔmɛ ya. Jamɛ a be ɔ, matsɛ ɔ, kɛ Haman hii si nɛ a ngɛ dã nue, se Susa ma a mi lɛɛ e pee basabasa.

Title: ESTER 4
Content:
Mordekai bi Ester ke e piɛ Yuda bi ɔmɛ a he
1Benɛ Mordekai na le níhi tsuo nɛ a pee ɔ, e kɛ hía e tade ɔmɛ ngɛ e he. E ha kpekpe ya bo, nɛ e muɔ la zu ngɔ pue e yi mi; kɛkɛ nɛ e je kpo kɛ nyɛɛ ma a mi kɛ ya boboobo, hluu 2kɛ ya su matsɛ we ɔ agbo ɔ nya tɔɔ. E sɛ́ we ɔ mi; ejakaa nɔ ko nɔ ko be he blɔ kaa e haa kpekpe kɛ yaa lejɛ ɔ. 3He tsuaa he nɛ a fiɛ matsɛ ɔ mlaa a kɛ ya su ɔ, Yuda bi ɔmɛ nyaa awe, nɛ a yeɔ kɔmɔ. A haa hwɔ, nɛ a woɔ yana kɛ ngmlaa. Nihi babauu nitsɛ ha kpekpe ya bo, nɛ a hwɔ la zu mi.
4Benɛ Ester mawayi ɔmɛ, kɛ nihi nɛ a puɛ mɛ ɔ ba sɛɛ nɔ́ nɛ Mordekai ngɛ pee ɔ ha lɛ ɔ, Ester hao wawɛɛ. E tsɔ nɛ a ya ngɔ tadehi kɛ ba, konɛ a kɛ ya wo Mordekai, nɛ́ e je kpekpe ɔ ngɛ e he. Se Mordekai he we tade ɔmɛ. 5Kɛkɛ nɛ e tsɛ Hatak. Hatak nɛ ɔ ji nihi nɛ a puɛ mɛ ɔ a ti nɔ kake nɛ a to nɛ sɔmɔɔ Ester ngɛ matsɛ we ɔ. Ester tsɔ lɛ Mordekai ngɔ, konɛ e ya bi lɛ sane nɛ ba, kɛ nɔ́ he je loko e ngɛ e ní pee kaa jã a. 6Kɛkɛ nɛ Hatak ho ya na Mordekai ngɛ ma a kpe he ɔ, ngɛ matsɛ we ɔ agbo ɔ nya. 7Mordekai de lɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ ba e nɔ, kɛ sika bɔ nɛ Haman wo si ke e ma ha nɛ a kɛ ya to matsɛ sika tomi he ɔ, ke a kpata Yuda bi ɔmɛ tsuo a hɛ mi ɔ. 8Jehanɛ, e ha Hatak womi ɔ nɛ a ngma mlaa a ngɔ wo mi, nɛ́ je kpo ngɛ Susa ma a mi ke a kpata Yuda bi ɔmɛ a hɛ mi ɔ eko. Mordekai de lɛ ke e ngɔ womi ɔ kɛ ya ha Ester, nɛ́ e tsɔɔ lɛ sane ɔ mi fitsofitso; nɛ e de lɛ ke e ya fa kue ha matsɛ ɔ, nɛ́ e kpa lɛ pɛɛ nɛ e na e ma mi bi ɔmɛ mɔbɔ. 9Hatak ba bɔ Ester nɔ́ nɛ Mordekai de lɛ ɔ. 10Nɛ Ester ngɔ sɛ gbi nɛ ɔ ngɔ ha lɛ ke e kɛ ya ha Mordekai ke, 11“Ke nɔ ko, nyumu jio, yo jio ba na matsɛ ɔ ngɛ kue ɔ nɛ ngɛ we ɔ kpɛti ɔ mi, nɛ pi kaa a tsɛ lɛ ke e ba a, jamɛ a nɔ ɔ, a maa gbe lɛ. Bɔ nɛ mlaa a ngɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. Nɔ tsuaa nɔ, kɛ je matsɛ ɔ ga woli ɔmɛ a nɔ kɛ ya si ni ɔmɛ nɛ a ngɛ nɔ yemi he ɔmɛ tsuo le nɔ́ nɛ ɔ. Ja matsɛ ɔ wo e matsɛ tso nɛ a kɛ sika tsu pee ɔ nɔ kɛ tsɔɔ nɔ ɔ, loko nɔ ɔ yi ma na wami. Kɛ je be nɛ i ya matsɛ ɔ ngɔ ba nɛ ɔ, nyɔhiɔ kake ji nɛ ɔ, nɛ e na we nɛ e tsɛ mi lolo.”
12Benɛ Mordekai nine su Ester sɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ, 13e tsɔ kɛ ya bɔ lɛ kɔkɔ ke, “Mo ko susu kaa nɛ o ngɛ matsɛ ɔ we mi he je ɔ, o ye o he. O ngɛ kaa Yuda bi kpa amɛ kɛ̃. 14Ke o de we nɔ́ ko ngɛ be kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, yi wami hemi maa je he kpa ko kɛ ba ha Yuda bi ɔmɛ; se moo lɛɛ, o ma gbo, nɛ o tsɛ we ɔ biɛ maa laa pɛsɛpɛsɛ. Se mɛnɔ maa le? Eko ɔ, be nɛ ngɛ kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ he nɛ a wo mo manyɛ ngɛ ɔ nɛ!”
15Ester hu tsɔ kɛ ya ha Mordekai heto ke, 16“Yaa bua Yuda bi ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ ngɛ Susa ma a mi ɔ a nya, nɛ nyɛɛ ha hwɔ ha mi. Nyɛ ko ye ní, nɛ nyɛ ko nu nyu hulɔ nyɔ kɛ pia ligbi etɛ. Imi nitsɛ, kɛ ye mawa amɛ hu wa maa pee ja. Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, ma ya matsɛ ɔ ngɔ. E ngɛ mi kaa mlaa a nya a, i be jamɛ a he blɔ ɔ lɛɛ, se ke e hia kaa ma gbo ngɛ enɛ ɔ mi ɔ, ma gbo.”
17Kɛkɛ nɛ Mordekai ho nɛ e ya pee nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ Ester de lɛ ke e pee ɔ.

Title: ESTER 5
Content:
Ester tsɛ matsɛ ɔ kɛ Haman ní yemi
1Ester nitsɛ ha hwɔ. Ligbi etɛne ɔ, Ester wo e manyɛ tade ɔ, nɛ e be kɛ ho matsɛ we ɔ ya. E ya da si ngɛ kue nɛ ngɛ matsɛ we ɔ kpɛti ɔ mi. Kue nɛ ɔ ngɛ tsu nɛ matsɛ sɛ ɔ ngɛ mi ɔ hanɔ. Jamɛ a be ɔ, matsɛ ɔ hii si ngɛ e sɛ ɔ nɔ, nɛ e hɛ mi kpee sinya a nya blɔ. 2Benɛ e na Manyɛ Ester nɛ daa si ngɛ kpo ɔ nɔ ɔ, e na e he bua jɔmi, nɛ e wo e matsɛ tso nɛ a kɛ sika tsu pee ɔ nɔ kɛ tsɔɔ lɛ. Kɛkɛ nɛ manyɛ ɔ ba matsɛ ɔ ngɔ, nɛ e kɛ e nine ba ta matsɛ tso ɔ he ngɛ e yi je. 3Matsɛ ɔ bi lɛ ke, “Manyɛ Ester, mɛni sane? Mɛni o ngɛ hlae nɛ ma pee ha mo? Ke ye nɔ yemi he ɔ mi fa po o ngɛ hlae ɔ, de mi, nɛ ma ha mo.”
4Ester he nɔ ke, “I dla niye ní kɛ to nɛnɛ mwɔnɛ ɔ. I ngɛ pɛɛ kpae kaa ke e sa nɛnɛ hɛ mi ɔ, ma suɔ kaa nɛnɛ kɛ Haman nɛ ba, konɛ nyɛɛ kɛ mi ba ye ní.”
5Matsɛ ɔ fa ke a tsɛ Haman kɛ ba esɔesɔ, konɛ a ya nɛ a kɛ Manyɛ Ester ya ye ní. Kɛkɛ nɛ matsɛ ɔ kɛ Haman ho nɛ á ya ye ní. 6Benɛ a ngɛ dã nue ɔ, matsɛ ɔ bi manyɛ ɔ ke, “Manyɛ Ester, mɛni ji o sane ɔ? Mɛni o ngɛ hlae? Ke ye nɔ yemi he ɔ mi fa po o ngɛ hlae ɔ, de mi, nɛ ma ha mo.”
7Ester he nɔ ke, “Nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ bie ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. 8Ke e sa nɛnɛ hɛ mi kaa nɛnɛ ma ha mi nɔ́ nɛ ma bi lɛ ɔ, lɛɛ nɛnɛ kɛ Haman kɛ mi nɛ ba ye ní ekohu hwɔɔ. Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, ma tsɔɔ nɛnɛ nɔ nɛ i ngɛ hlae.”
Haman to ga nɛ e kɛ maa gbe Mordekai
9Benɛ Haman je ní yemi he ɔ, e bua jɔ e he saminya. Se benɛ e na Mordekai ngɛ matsɛ we ɔ agbo ɔ nya, nɛ Mordekai bui lɛ, nɛ e ti si ha lɛ ɔ, Haman mi mi fu wawɛɛ nitsɛ. 10Se e nu e tsui, nɛ e ho e we mi ya. Kɛkɛ nɛ e ya tsɛ e huɛmɛ kɛ ba e we ɔ mi, nɛ e tsɛ e yo Zeresh kɛ piɛ a he. 11E fĩa kɛ tsɔɔ mɛ bɔ nɛ e na ní kpɔtɔɔ ha, binyumuhi abɔ nɛ e ngɛ, bɔ nɛ matsɛ ɔ wó e nɔ gojoo ngɛ nɔ yemi he ɔ, kɛ bɔ nɛ e he hia pe matsɛ ɔ ganɔ ɔmɛ, kɛ tsɔli kpa amɛ tsuo. 12Haman ya nɔ nɛ e de ke, “Nyɛɛ hyɛ, nɛ́ Manyɛ Ester ma tsɛ Matsɛ Ahasuerus ní yemi ɔ, e tsɛ we nɔ ko nɔ ko kɛ piɛ we e he, pe imi Haman pɛ. Hwɔɔ hu, Manyɛ Ester kpale tsɛ imi kɛ̃ kɛ matsɛ ɔ ní yemi ekohu. 13Se ní nɛ ɔmɛ ekoeko ha we mi bua jɔmi, be abɔ nɛ i ngɛ jamɛ a Yuda no ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Mordekai ɔ hyɛe nɛ e hii si ngɛ matsɛ we ɔ agbo ɔ nya a.”
14Kɛkɛ nɛ e yo Zeresh kɛ e huɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsuo de lɛ ke, “Ha nɛ a pee tso nɛ a maa sɛu nɔ ngɛ nɔ: e hiɔwe yami nɛ pee gugue nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ kɛ fa. Hwɔɔ mɔtu ɔ, de matsɛ ɔ nɛ e ha nɛ a sɛu Mordekai ngɛ nɔ. Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, o kɛ matsɛ ɔ nɛ ya ní yemi nɛ a tsɛ nyɛ ɔ kɛ bua jɔmi.”
Ga nɛ a wo Haman ɔ sa e hɛ mi saminya; nɛ e ha a pee tso nɛ a maa sɛu nɔ ngɛ nɔ ɔ.

Title: ESTER 6
Content:
Matsɛ ɔ wo Mordekai hɛ mi nyami
1Jamɛ a nyɔ ɔ mi ɔ, matsɛ ɔ nyɛ we nɛ e hwɔ mahe; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e fa ke a ya ngɔ yi nɔ sanehi womi ɔ kɛ ba, nɛ a ba kane ha lɛ. 2 Nɔ́ nɛ a kane ɔ tsɔɔ bɔ nɛ be ko ɔ, Bigtana kɛ Teresh so wo matsɛ ɔ he, konɛ a gbe lɛ, kɛ bɔ nɛ Mordekai je a sisi kpo. Bigtana kɛ Teresh ji matsɛ we ɔ he buli enyɔ komɛ nɛ a puɛ mɛ. 3Kɛkɛ nɛ Matsɛ Ahasuerus bi ke, “Nɛ́ Mordekai tsu kikɛmɛ a ní tsumi nɛ ɔ, anɛ wa wo e hɛ mi nyami, aloo wa ha lɛ blɔ nya ko lo?”
E tsɔli ɔmɛ he nɔ ke, “A pee we nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko ha we lɛ.”
4Matsɛ ɔ bi si ke, “Anɛ ma ní tsuli ɔmɛ ekomɛ ngɛ matsɛ we ɔ mi lo?”
Jamɛ a be ɔ, Haman ba matsɛ we ɔ agbo nya kue ɔ mi. E ba nɛ e ba de matsɛ ɔ nɛ e ha a ya sɛu Mordekai ngɛ tso nɛ lɛ, Haman ɔ pee kɛ ha Mordekai ɔ nɔ. 5Kɛkɛ nɛ tsɔli ɔmɛ ba de matsɛ ɔ ke, “Haman ba hiɛ ɔ, nɛ e suɔ kaa e maa na mo.”
Matsɛ ɔ de ke, “Nyɛ ha nɛ e ba.”
6Benɛ Haman ba e ngɔ ɔ, matsɛ ɔ de lɛ ke, “Nyumu ko ngɛ nɛ i suɔ wawɛɛ kaa ma wo e hɛ mi nyami. Mɛni sa kaa ma pee ha lɛ?”
Haman bi e he ke, “Mɛnɔ po matsɛ ɔ maa suɔ kaa e maa wo e hɛ mi nyami kikɛ nɛ ɔ? Nɔ́ jemi ko kulaa be he kaa imi ji jamɛ a nɔ ɔ nɛ.”
7-8Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, heto nɛ e ha matsɛ ɔ ji, “Nɛnɛ, fa nɛ a ngɔ ablade tade, tade nɛ mo nɛnɛ nitsɛ o woɔ, kɛ ba ha nyumu nɛ ɔ. Ha nɛ a ya ngɔ okpɔngɔ nɛ nɛnɛ nitsɛ hii nɔ ɔ kɛ ba, nɛ a kɛ nɛnɛ jlasi nɛ fɔ nɔ. 9Jehanɛ, ha nɛ ganɔ ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake nɛ hɛ mi ngɛ nyami babauu nɛ ngɔ ablade tade ɔ kɛ wo nyumu ɔ, nɛ a ha e hi okpɔngɔ ɔ nɔ, nɛ a kɛ lɛ nɛ po si ngɛ ma nɔ. Ganɔ ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake nɛ hi fiɛe kɛ nyɛɛ e hɛ mi ke, ‘Bɔ nɛ matsɛ ɔ suɔ kaa e maa wo nɔ nɛ e suɔ ɔ hɛ mi nyami ji nɛ ɔ nɛ!’ ”
10Kɛkɛ nɛ matsɛ ɔ de Haman ke, “Ngɔɔ ablade tade ɔ, kɛ okpɔngɔ ɔ esɔ, nɛ o ya pee ní nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ wo Yuda no ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Mordekai ɔ hɛ mi nyami. Pee kaa bɔ nɛ o de ɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ ha lɛ. O maa na lɛ nɛ hii si ngɛ matsɛ we ɔ agbo ɔ nya.”
11Haman ya ngɔ ablade tade ɔ, kɛ okpɔngɔ ɔ, nɛ e kɛ tade ɔ ya wo Mordekai. Mordekai hi okpɔngɔ ɔ nɔ, nɛ Haman nyɛɛ e hɛ mi nɛ e kɛ lɛ po si ngɛ ma nɔ. Benɛ a yaa a tsuo, Haman ngɛ fiɛe ke, “Bɔ nɛ matsɛ ɔ suɔ kaa e maa wo nɔ nɛ e suɔ ɔ hɛ mi nyami ji nɛ ɔ nɛ!”
12Jehanɛ, Mordekai kpale kɛ ba matsɛ we ɔ agbo ɔ nya ekohu, se Haman lɛɛ e ha e yi nɔ, nɛ e ho e we mi ya mlamlaamla kɛ zo kpɔtɔɔ. 13E de e yo, Zeresh, kɛ e huɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsuo níhi nɛ ba e nɔ ɔ. Kɛkɛ nɛ e yo ɔ, kɛ e huɛmɛ ní leli ɔmɛ de Haman ke, “Mordekai bɔni o he wami kpɔmi. Yuda no ji lɛ, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, o be lɛ nyɛe. Bɔ tsuaa bɔ nɛ pee ɔ, e maa ye o nɔ.”
A gbe Haman
14Benɛ a ngɛ munyu ɔ tue kɛ mwɔɔ ɔ, matsɛ tsɔli ɔmɛ nɛ a puɛ mɛ ɔ ba kplakplaakpla, nɛ a ba ngɔ Haman kɛ ho, konɛ e kɛ Manyɛ Ester ya ye ní.

Title: ESTER 7
Content:
1Kɛkɛ nɛ matsɛ ɔ, kɛ Haman ho konɛ a kɛ Manyɛ Ester ya ye ní 2si enyɔne. Benɛ a ngɛ dã nue ɔ, matsɛ ɔ bi Ester ekohu ke, “Manyɛ Ester, jehanɛ, mo de mi koo. Mɛni o ngɛ hlae? Ke ye nɔ yemi ɔ mi fa po o ngɛ hlae ɔ, ma ha mo.”
3Manyɛ Ester he nɔ ke, “I kpa nɛnɛ pɛɛ, ke e sa nɛnɛ hɛ mi kaa e ma ha mi nɔ́ nɛ i kɛ he si bami ngɛ lɛ bie ɔ, lɛɛ nɛnɛ, nɔ́ nɛ i suɔ ji kaa ye yi nɛ na wami, nɛ ye ma mi bi ɔmɛ hu a yi nɛ na wami. 4A jua i kɛ ye ma mi bi ɔmɛ ngɔ ha, konɛ a kpata wa hɛ mi. Kaa nyɔguɛ yemi mi kɛkɛ nɛ a jua wɔ kɛ ho ɔ, i ko de we nɔ́ ko, nɛ i ko gba we nɛnɛ nya; se a miɔ nɛ a ma kpata wa hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ!”
5Kɛkɛ nɛ Matsɛ Ahasuerus bi Manyɛ Ester ke, “Mɛnɔ po nɛ e to e yi mi kaa e maa pee nɔ́ ko kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ? Jije jamɛatsɛ ɔ ngɛ?”
6Manyɛ Ester he nɔ ke, “Wa he nyɛlɔ, kɛ nɔ nɛ ngɛ wɔ yi mi wae ɔ ji yiwutsotsɛ nɛ ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Haman ɔ!”
Haman kɛ sawale hyɛ matsɛ ɔ, kɛ manyɛ ɔ a hɛ mi gaa. 7Matsɛ ɔ hɛ dɔ, nɛ e je kpo kɛ ho abɔɔ ɔ nɛ ngɛ matsɛ we ɔ mi ya. Haman na kaa matsɛ ɔ to e yi mi kaa e ma kpata e hɛ mi ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ he; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, lɛ Haman ɔ lɛɛ e mlɛ ngɛ se, konɛ e kpa Manyɛ Ester pɛɛ nɛ a ngɔ e wami kɛ ke lɛ. 8Benɛ e ya bu si ngɛ Manyɛ Ester sɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ, matsɛ ɔ kpale e se kɛ je abɔɔ ɔ mi kɛ ba tsu ɔ mi. Benɛ matsɛ ɔ na nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, e kpa ngmlaa ke, “Anɛ nyumu nɛ ɔ ngɛ hlae nɛ e tua manyɛ ɔ ngɛ hiɛ ɔ, ngɛ ye hɛ mi, ngɛ imi nitsɛ ye we mi lo?”
Matsɛ ɔ nya nɔɛ si tete nɛ nihi nɛ a puɛ mɛ ɔ kɛ nɔ́ ko ba ha Haman hɛ mi. 9A kpɛti nɔ kake nɛ a tsɛɔ lɛ Habona a de ke, “Nɛnɛ, Haman pee sɛumi tso gagaaga ko po ngɛ e we ɔ mi, konɛ e sɛu Mordekai, nɔ nɛ he o yi wami ɔ ngɛ nɔ. Sɛumi tso ɔ hiɔwe yami ji gugue nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ kɛ fa!”
Matsɛ ɔ fa ke, “Nyɛ ya sɛu Haman ngɛ nɔ!”
10Nɛ a ya sɛu Haman ngɛ tso nɛ e pee kɛ ha Mordekai ɔ nɔ. Kɛkɛ nɛ Matsɛ ɔ mi mi fumi ɔ se po.

Title: ESTER 8
Content:
A de Yuda bi ɔmɛ ke a fa a he
1Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ nɔuu ɔ, Matsɛ Ahasuerus ngɔ Yuda bi ɔmɛ a he nyɛlɔ, Haman weto ní tsuo ngɔ ha Manyɛ Ester. Akɛnɛ Ester de matsɛ ɔ ke e weku no ji Mordekai he je ɔ, kɛ je jamɛ a be ɔ kɛ yaa a, a ngmɛɔ Mordekai blɔ nɛ e baa matsɛ ɔ ngɔ. 2Matsɛ ɔ ngɔ e nine nguɛ ga nɛ womi nya sɔumi nɔ́ ngɛ nɔ ɔ ngɔ ha Mordekai, (Jinɛ Haman nɛ hyɛɛ nɔ). Ester ngɔ Mordekai ngɔ to Haman ní ɔmɛ a nya.
3Ester kɛ matsɛ ɔ tu munyu. E kpla si kɛ e hɛ mi vo nyu ngɛ matsɛ ɔ nane nya, nɛ e kpa lɛ pɛɛ ke e pee nɔ́ ko kɛ tsi yi mi tomi yaya nɛ Agag nina Haman to ngɛ Yuda bi ɔmɛ a he ɔ nya. 4Matsɛ ɔ kɛ matsɛ tso nɛ a kɛ sika tsu pee ɔ tsɔɔ manyɛ ɔ, kɛkɛ nɛ e te da si, nɛ e de lɛ ke, 5“Ke nɛnɛ suɔ ye sane, nɛ e sa nɛnɛ hɛ mi, nɛ e da ha lɛ ɔ, lɛɛ i kpa nɛnɛ pɛɛ, nɛ e ha nɛ a fiɛ kɛ tsi mlaa yaya nɛ Agag nina, Hamedata bi Haman wo ɔ nya. Mlaa a ke a kpata Yuda bi tsuo a hɛ mi ngɛ nɛnɛ nɔ yemi he ɔmɛ tsuo. 6Ke amanehlu nɛ ɔ ba ma a nɔ, nɛ́ a ma kpata imi nitsɛ ye nyɛmimɛ a hɛ mi ɔ, kɛ ma pee kɛɛ?”
7Kɛkɛ nɛ Matsɛ Ahasuerus de Manyɛ Ester kɛ Mordekai, Yuda no ɔ ke, “Nyɛɛ hyɛ, i ha a sɛu Haman ngɛ yi mi yaya nɛ e to ngɔ wo Yuda bi ɔmɛ a he ɔ he, nɛ i ngɔ e weto ní ngɔ ha Manyɛ Ester. 8Se ke a ngma fiɛmi ko ngɛ matsɛ ɔ biɛ mi, nɛ a sɔu nya kɛ matsɛ ɔ womi nya sɔumi nɔ́ ɔ, a kpale we se, ja a ye nɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke nyɛ suɔ ɔ, nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛɛ ngma Yuda bi ɔmɛ womi ngɛ ye biɛ mi, nɛ nyɛ de nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́, konɛ nyɛɛ ngɔ ye womi nya sɔumi nɔ́ ɔ kɛ sɔu nya.”
9Nyɔhiɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ Sivan, nɛ ji nyɔhiɔ etɛne ɔ we ligbi nɛ ji nyingmi enyɔ kɛ etɛ ɔ nɔ sane nɛ ɔ ba a nɛ. Mordekai tsɛ matsɛ womi ngmali ɔmɛ, nɛ e tsɔɔ mɛ nɔ́ nɛ a ngma; nɛ a ngma ja pɛpɛɛpɛ. A ngma womi ɔ kɛ ya ha Yuda bi ɔmɛ, amlaalo ɔmɛ, ma nɔ hyɛli ɔmɛ, kɛ ganɔ ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ ngɛ e nɔ yemi he lafa kɛ nyingmi enyɔ kɛ kpaago ɔmɛ, kɛ je India kɛ ya su Sudan ɔ. A ngma womi ɔmɛ ngɛ zugba tsuaa zugba e gbi, kɛ e ningma mi. 10Mordekai hyɛ nɛ a ngma womi ɔmɛ ngɛ Matsɛ Ahasuerus biɛ mi, nɛ a sɔu nya kɛ matsɛ ɔ womi nya sɔumi ga a. Tsɔli nɛ hi okpɔngɔhi nɛ le fo tumi saminya a nɔ ya dla womi ɔmɛ kɛ fo. A hla okpɔngɔ ɔmɛ kɛ je matsɛ ɔ nitsɛ we okpɔngɔ tsu ɔmɛ a mi.
11A ngma ngɛ womi nɛ ɔmɛ a mi ke matsɛ ɔ ngmɛ Yuda bi ɔmɛ blɔ ngɛ ma tsuaa ma mi kaa á to blɔ nya kɛ plee a wami he. Ke ta buli ba tua mɛ ɔ, á da si nɛ a kɛ he nyɛli ɔmɛ nɛ hwu, nɛ́ a kpata a hɛ mi. Á kpata a yi ɔmɛ, kɛ a bimɛ ɔmɛ hu a hɛ mi, nɛ́ e ko piɛ nɔ kake po; nɛ́ a ha a níhi. 12Ligbi ɔ nɛ a to nɛ a kpata Yuda bi ɔmɛ a hɛ mi ngɛ Matsɛ Ahasuerus nɔ yemi he ɔmɛ tsuo ɔ, jamɛ a ligbi ɔ nɔuu mlaa nɛ ɔ ma bɔni ní tsumi. Ligbi nɛ ɔ ji nyɔhiɔ nyɔngma kɛ enyɔne ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ Adar a we ligbi nɛ ji nyɔngma kɛ etɛ ɔ. 13Mlaa a tsɔɔ kaa á fiɛ blɔ nya tomi nɛ ɔ ngɛ nɔ yemi he ɔmɛ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ Yuda bi ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ a dla a he kɛ to, konɛ ke be ɔ su ɔ, a kɛ a he nyɛli ɔmɛ nɛ hwu, nɛ a kɛ ye a he lue. 14Kaa bɔ nɛ matsɛ ɔ fa a, tsɔli nɛ a he sɔɔ kuɔ okpɔngɔhi esɔesɔ kɛ ho ma amɛ a nɔ ya. A fiɛ mlaa nɛ ɔ ngɛ matsɛ ma Susa a hulɔ.
15Benɛ Mordekai je matsɛ we ɔ kɛ ma a, e wo ablade tade bluu kɛ futaa, nɛ sika tsu jlasi ngɛ e yi. E wo ablade tade wuyaa nɛ a kɛ kɔbɛi kpa kpakpa lo hulɔ. Kɛkɛ nɛ a he ose ngɛ Susa ma a mi; nɛ blɔ ɔmɛ tsuo a nɔ pee hoo kɛ bua jɔmi. 16Yuda bi ɔmɛ a bua jɔ kaa a je haomi mi, nɛ a nya ejakaa a hɛ mi ba nyami. 17Ma tsuaa ma mi, ngɛ nɔ yemi he ɔmɛ tsuo, he nɛ a maa kane matsɛ ɔ fiɛmi ɔ ngɛ ɔ, Yuda bi ɔmɛ tsuo a bua jɔɔ a he, nɛ a yeɔ nyami ligbi; a tsɛɔ ní yemi, nɛ a nyaa wawɛɛ. Anɔkuale mi ɔ, ni kpahi babauu ba pee a he Yuda bi, ejakaa jehanɛ lɛɛ, a ngɛ Yuda bi ɔmɛ gbeye yee.

Title: ESTER 9
Content:
Yuda bi ɔmɛ kpata a he nyɛli ɔmɛ a hɛ mi
1Nyɔhiɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ Adar a we ligbi nyɔngma kɛ etɛne ɔ ba su. Kikɛmɛ a ligbi nɛ ɔ ji be nɛ a to nɛ a kɛ mlaa nɛ matsɛ ɔ wo nɛ a fiɛ ha ma a ma bɔni ní tsumi. Ligbi nɛ ɔ kɛ̃ ji ligbi nɛ Yuda bi ɔmɛ a he nyɛli ɔmɛ to kaa a ma kpata Yuda bi ɔmɛ a hɛ mi ɔ nɛ. Se nɔ́ nɛ ba mohu ji kaa Yuda bi ɔmɛ ye a he nyɛli ɔmɛ a nɔ kunimi. 2Yuda bi ɔmɛ bua a he nya ngɛ ma amɛ a mi ngɛ nɔ yemi he ɔ he tsuaa he nɛ a ngɛ ɔ, nɛ a dla a he, konɛ a kɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa ka kaa e maa ta a he, aloo e maa pee mɛ yayami ko ɔ nɛ to ní. Se nɔ ko nɔ ko nyɛ we nɛ e te si kɛ wo mɛ, ejakaa a he sawale nu ma amɛ tsuo. 3Anɔkuale mi ɔ, nɔ yemi he ɔmɛ a ganɔ ɔmɛ tsuo, amlaalo ɔmɛ, ma nɔ hyɛli ɔmɛ, kɛ tsɔli nɛ ngɛ nɔ yemi he ɔmɛ piɛ Yuda bi ɔmɛ a he; ejakaa Mordekai he sawale nu mɛ tsuo. 4Mordekai ba pee nɔmlɔ ngua ngɛ matsɛ we ɔ, nɛ e biɛ pɛ ngɛ nɔ yemi he ɔmɛ tsuo; ejakaa blɔ nya nɛ e hɛɛ ɔ ngɛ nɔ kuɔe, nɛ e nɔ gbɔ we gblee. 5Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yuda bi ɔmɛ pee a he nyɛli ɔmɛ bɔ nɛ a suɔ. A ya tua mɛ, nɛ a kɛ klaate kpata a hɛ mi.
6Ngɛ matsɛ ma nɛ a tsɛɛ ke Susa a kɛkɛ mi ɔ, Yuda bi ɔmɛ gbe nihi lafa enuɔ. 7-10Yuda bi ɔmɛ a he nyɛlɔ nɛ ji Hamedata bi Haman ɔ, bimɛ nyɔngma amɛ piɛ nihi nɛ a gbe ɔ a he. A biɛhi ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ: Parshandata, Dalfon, Aspata, Porata, Adalia, Aridata, Parmashta, Arisai, Aridai, kɛ Vaizata. A kpata ni ɔmɛ a hɛ mi mohu, se a hɛ ní.
11Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, benɛ matsɛ ɔ na le nihi abɔ nɛ a gbe ngɛ matsɛ ma nɛ a tsɛɛ Susa a mi ɔ, 12e de Manyɛ Ester ke, “Yuda bi ɔmɛ gbe nihi lafa enuɔ ngɛ Susa nɛ ji ma ngua a kɛkɛ mi; a gbe Haman binyumu nyɔngma amɛ hulɔ. Ke a nyɛ tsu kikɛmɛ a ní nɛ ɔ ngɛ Susa ma nɛ ɔ pɛ mi ɔ, lɛɛ ye nɔ yemi he kpa amɛ lɛɛ kɛ níhi maa hi kɛɛ?” Matsɛ Ahasuerus ya nɔ nɛ e bi manyɛ ɔ ke, “Mɛni o ngɛ hlae ekohu? Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ o ngɛ hlae ngɛ enɛ ɔ se ɔ, de mi, nɛ ma ha mo.”
13Ester he nɔ ke, “Nɛnɛ, i kpa mo pɛɛ, nɔ́ nɛ a ha Yuda bi ɔmɛ pee mwɔnɛ ɔ, ha nɛ a pee ja ekohu hwɔɔ. Jehanɛ, fa nɛ a sɛu Haman binyumu nyɔngma amɛ ngɛ sɛumi tsohi a nɔ.” 14Matsɛ ɔ fa ke a pee nɔ́ nɛ ɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a wo mlaa nɛ a fiɛ ngɛ Susa ma a mi. Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, a sɛu Haman bimɛ nyɔngma amɛ ngɛ sɛumi tsohi a nɔ. 15Nyɔhiɔ ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ Adar a we ligbi nyɔngma kɛ eywiɛne ɔ nɔ ɔ, Yuda bi ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ Susa a bua a he nya ekohu, nɛ a gbe ma a mi bi lafa etɛ kɛ piɛ nihi nɛ a gbe kekle ɔ a he. Se kaa bɔ nɛ a pee kekle ɔ, hɛ ní.
16Yuda bi nɛ ngɛ nɔ yemi he ɔmɛ hu to blɔ nya kɛ plee a wami he. Bɔ nɛ pee nɛ a je a he nyɛli ɔmɛ a dɛ mi, nɛ a he nɛ jɔ mɛ ɔ, a gbe nihi nɛ sume mɛ ɔ akpe nyingmi kpaago kɛ enuɔ. Se a hɛ ní. 17Nyɔhiɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ Adar a we ligbi nyɔngma kɛ etɛne ɔ nɔ nɛ a tsu nɔ́ nɛ ɔ nɛ. E nɔ jena nɛ ji nyɔhiɔ ɔ ligbi nyɔngma kɛ eywiɛne ɔ nɔ ɔ, a kpataa we nɔ ko hɛ mi, se mohu a tsɛ ní yemi; a ye ní nɛ a nu ní, nɛ a nya jamɛ a ligbi ɔ. 18Yuda bi ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ Susa a, mɛɛ lɛɛ a kɛ ligbi nyɔngma kɛ enuɔne ɔ pee a nyami ligbi, nɛ a jɔɔ a he. Ejakaa ligbi nyɔngma kɛ etɛne ɔ, kɛ nyɔngma kɛ eywiɛne ɔ, a hɛ dɔ kɛ ngɛ a he nyɛli ɔmɛ a hɛ mi kpatae. 19Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, Yuda bi nɛ ngɛ ma wawi a mi ɔ yeɔ nyɔhiɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ Adar a we ligbi nɛ ji nyɔngma kɛ eywiɛ ɔ kaa a nyami ligbi, nɛ a bua jɔɔ a he. A yeɔ ní nɛ a nuɔ ní, nɛ a kee a sibi niye ní.
Nyami be nɛ a tsɛɛ Purim ɔ
20Mordekai ha nɛ a ngma sane nɛ ɔ nɛ ba a ngɔ fɔ si; nɛ e ngma womi kɛ mane Yuda bi ɔmɛ tsuo ngɛ Matsɛ Ahasuerus nɔ yemi he ɔmɛ tsuo, nihi nɛ a he kɛ, kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ kpo nya a tsuo. 21E de mɛ ke, daa jeha a, á ye ligbi nyɔngma kɛ eywiɛne ɔ, kɛ nyɔngma kɛ enuɔne ɔ ngɛ nyɔhiɔ Adar a mi kaa he jɔɔmi ligbihi. 22Ligbi nɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ nɛ Yuda bi ɔmɛ kpata a he nyɛli ɔmɛ a hɛ mi ɔ nɛ. Jinɛ nyɔhiɔ nɛ ɔ maa pee aywilɛho kɛ kɔmɔ yemi be, se e ba plɛ pee bua jɔmi kɛ nyami be mohu. Bɔ nɛ a tsɔɔ mɛ ke a ye nyami ligbi nɛ ɔmɛ ji a tsɛ nihi ní yemi, nɛ a nya; a ke a sibi, kɛ ohiatsɛmɛ niye ní, kɛ ohiatsɛmɛ hu ní kpakpahi. 23Yuda bi ɔmɛ pee bɔ nɛ Mordekai tsɔɔ mɛ kaa a pee ɔ, nɛ nyami be nɛ ɔ ba plɛ pee kusumi ko nɛ a peeɔ daa jeha.
24 Hamedata bi Haman, Agag nina a ji Yuda bi ɔmɛ tsuo a he nyɛlɔ. E so Yuda bi ɔmɛ a yi nɔ nɛ e ma kpata mɛ tsuo a hɛ mi. E fɔ sɔ konɛ e na ligbi pɔtɛɛ nɛ a ma tsu yi wu tso ní nɛ ɔ. (A tsɛɔ sɔ fɔmi ke Purim ngɛ Hebri gbi mi.) 25Se Ester ba na matsɛ ɔ, nɛ matsɛ ɔ ngma womi kɛ tsi ga yaya nɛ Haman to kɛ ha Yuda bi ɔmɛ ɔ nya. Bɔ nɛ e ya ba ha ji kaa nɔ́ nɛ e hla kaa e maa pee Yuda bi ɔmɛ ɔ, a kɛ pee lɛ nitsɛ mohu. Lɔ ɔ ji kaa a sɛu lɛ kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ tsuo. 26Enɛ ɔ he je nɛ a tsɛɔ nyami ligbi nɛ ɔmɛ ke Purim ɔ nɛ. 27Yuda bi ɔmɛ wo mlaa nɛ fɔɔ si daa kɛ ha mɛ nitsɛmɛ, kɛ a nina, kɛ nɔ ko nɛ ma ba pee Yuda no ɔ tsuo, kaa daa jeha, ngɛ be nɛ a to ɔ mi tutuutu ɔ, a ye ligbi enyɔ nɛ ɔmɛ kaa bɔ nɛ Mordekai ngma a pɛpɛɛpɛ. 28A fua fɔ nɔ kaa Yuda bi a weku tsuo, ngɛ yi nɔhi nɛ maa ba a a mi, ngɛ nɔ yemi he ɔmɛ tsuo, kɛ ma amɛ tsuo a mi ɔ, a kai nɛ a ye Purim ligbi nɛ ɔmɛ daa.
29Jehanɛ, Manyɛ Ester, Abihail biyo ɔ hu ngma womi, nɛ e kɛ e he wami tsuo pi nɔ́ nɛ Mordekai ngma momo nɛ kɔɔ Purim he ɔ se kpɛii. 30A ngma womi nɛ ɔ kɛ ya ha Yuda bi ɔmɛ tsuo ngɛ nɔ yemi he lafa kɛ nyingmi enyɔ kɛ kpaago nɛ ngɛ Matsɛ Ahasuerus nɔ yemi ɔ mi ɔ. Womi ɔ tsɔɔ kaa Yuda bi ɔmɛ na tue mi jɔmi, kɛ he jɔmi. 31E tsɔɔ hu kaa mɛ nitsɛmɛ, kɛ a nina tsuo a ye Purim ligbi ɔmɛ ngɛ a be ɔ mi tutuutu kaa bɔ nɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a wo mlaahi kɛ ha hwɔ hami, nɛ a to behi nɛ a kɛ yeɔ kɔmɔ ɔ. Bɔ nɛ Mordekai kɛ Manyɛ Ester tsuo fa ke a pee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. 32Mlaa nɛ Manyɛ Ester wo nɛ ɔ ma Purim blɔ nya tomi ɔmɛ a nɔ mi. Nɛ a ngma kɛ wo womi mi.

Title: ESTER 10
Content:
Matsɛ Ahasuerus kɛ Mordekai
1Matsɛ Ahasuerus ha nɛ nihi nɛ ngɛ e nɔ yemi he ɔ ngɛ wo nya je, kɛ hue mi je tsuo tsu ní kpakpataa. 2Ní nguahi, kɛ nyakpɛ níhi tsuo nɛ e pee, kɛ sanehi tsuo nɛ kɔɔ bɔ nɛ e wo Mordekai nɔ nɛ e pee lɛ nɔkɔtɔma a, a ngma ngɛ Persia kɛ Media matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a yi nɔ sanehi womi ɔmɛ a mi. 3Yuda no, Mordekai ji Matsɛ Ahasuerus nitsɛ e se yelɔ. E hɛɛ blɔ nya nguaa ngɛ ma, Yuda bi ɔmɛ a kpɛti, nɛ a suɔ lɛ saminya. E hlaa kaa e ma mi bi ɔmɛ nɛ a ya nɔ, nɛ e daa mi ha mɛ konɛ níhi a mi nɛ hi ha mɛ.

Title: HIOB NYA TSƆƆMI
Content:
NYA TSƆƆMI
Sane nɛ ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ mi ɔ tsɔɔ wɔ bɔ nɛ nyumu ko nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi na amanehlu babauu. Nyumu nɛ ɔ bimɛ tsuo ba gbo si kake too; e weto ní tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ hɛ mi kpata, nɛ lɛ nitsɛ hu e ba nu hiɔ yaya ko. Nɔ nɛ ngma womi ɔ tsɔɔ bɔ nɛ Hiob kɛ e huɛmɛ etɛ komɛ sɛɛ Hiob haomi ɔ he ní si etɛ sɔuu. (A ngma ní sɛɛmi nɛ ɔ ngɛ asilɛ gbi mi). Ní sɛɛmi ɔ nyagbe ɔ, Mawu nitsɛ ba je e he kpo kɛ tsɔɔ Hiob. Hiob kɛ e huɛmɛ ɔmɛ a ní sɛɛmi ɔ mi oti pɔtɛɛ ji bɔ nɛ Mawu kɛ nɔmlɔ adesa si himi ngɛ.
Hiob huɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsɔɔ kaa yayami nɛ Hiob pee, nɛ lɔ ɔ he nɔ́ lɛ e ngɛ nae ɔ nɛ. A ngɔ jami nɛ ngɛ jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ kɛ tsɔɔ nya kaa Mawu gblaa yayami peelɔ tue, se nɔmlɔ kpakpa lɛɛ e woɔ lɛ nguɔ. Hiob kplɛɛ we nɔ kaa yayami ko nɛ e pee ɔ he nɛ a ngɛ e tue gblae. E susu kaa e da kɛ pi si, nɛ sé ko be e he. E nui sisi kaa lɛ nɛ e peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a, Mawu maa ngmɛ blɔ nɛ tue gblami kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ nɛ ba e nɔ. Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ha Hiob kɛ hɛdɔ bi Mawu munyuhi babauu. Pi kaa Hiob hemi kɛ yemi ta, se pe e suɔ kaa a wo lɛ nguɔ ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi kaa nɔmlɔ nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da, konɛ e kpale na e hɛ mi nyami ɔ ekohu.
Munyuhi nɛ Hiob bi Mawu ɔ, Mawu ha we lɛ heto, se e buaa he ha lɛ. Nɔ́ nɛ Mawu pee ji kaa e je e he kpo tsɔɔ Hiob kaa lɛ Mawu ɔ, e he wami kle, nɛ e nile hu mi kuɔ. Hiob ba kpa si kaa niinɛ, Mawu kle, nɛ e nile hu mi kuɔ. E kɛ he si bami pia e he; e ye pɔpu kaa abofu ha nɛ e kɛ Mawu tu munyu basabasa.
Nyagbe ɔ, womi nɛ ɔ deɔ wɔ ke Hiob kpale na e he ekohu; a gbaa lɛ kɛ níhi babauu pe kekle ɔ po. Mawu ka Hiob huɛmɛ ɔmɛ a hɛ mi wawɛɛ nitsɛ kaa a nyɛ we nɛ a nu Hiob we amanehlu ɔ sisi. Hiob pɛ lɛ nu sisi saminya kaa Mawu kle pe bɔ nɛ jami nɛ ngɛ jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ tsɔɔ ɔ.
Bɔ nɛ a dla womi ɔ mi ha
Sisije munyuhi 1.1—2.13
Hiob kɛ e huɛmɛ ɔmɛ 3.1—31.40
a. Hiob po Mawu nya 3.1-26
b. Kekleekle ní sɛɛmi 4.1—14.22
d. Ní sɛɛmi enyɔne 15.1—21.34
e. Ní sɛɛmi etɛne 22.1—27.23
ɛ. Nile yi jemi la 28.1-28
f. Hiob nyagbe munyuhi 29.1—31.40
Elihu tu munyu 32.1—37.24
Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ha Hiob heto 38.1—42.6
Nyagbe munyuhi 42.7-17

Title: HIOB 1
Content:
Satan ba ka Hiob
1Nyumu ko hi si ngɛ Uz zugba a nɔ; e biɛ ji Hiob. E jaa Mawu, nɛ e yeɔ lɛ anɔkuale. Nyumu nɛ ɔ, nɔmlɔ kpakpa ji lɛ; e pee we nɔ́ nɛ dɛ blɔ kɔkɔɔkɔ. 2Hiob ngɛ binyumuhi kpaago, biyihi etɛ, 3kɛ tsɔli babauu. E ngɛ lohwe nɛ ɔmɛ hulɔ: to akpe kpaago, afukpɔngɔ akpe etɛ, na akpe, kɛ teji yo lafa enuɔ. Lɛ ji nɔmlɔ ngua pe kulaa ngɛ beleku je ma amɛ a mi.
4Ke pee ɔ, Hiob binyumu ɔmɛ tsɛɔ ní yemi kakaaka ngɛ a we ɔmɛ a mi, nɔ tsuaa nɔ kɛ e be, nɛ a kpeeɔ a nyɛmimɛ yi etɛ ɔmɛ kɛ baa ní yemi ɔ. 5Ke a gbe ní yemi ɔ tsuo nya kikɛ nɛ ɔ, jena mɔtu ɔ, Hiob maa te si mla nɛ e maa sã sami bɔ kɛ ha e bimɛ ɔmɛ kakaaka, nɛ e kɛ maa pee mɛ klɔuklɔu. Hiob peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ daa, ejakaa e susuɔ kaa eko ɔ, e bimɛ ɔmɛ pee yayami kaa a jɛ Mawu nɛ a li a he be.
6 Ligbi ko ɔ, Mawu bimɛ ɔmɛ ba bua a he nya ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi, nɛ Satan hu piɛ a he kɛ ba. 7Yawɛ bi Satan ke, “Jije o je?”
Satan he nɔ ke, “I ya kpa je ɔ mi tsuo kɛ ya kɛ ba.”
8Yawɛ bi lɛ ke, “Anɛ o to ye tsɔlɔ Hiob he hɛ kaa nɔ ko nɔ ko be je ɔ mi nɛ da, nɛ yeɔ anɔkuale kɛ lɛ sɔ lo? E jaa mi, nɛ e pee we nɔ́ nɛ dɛ blɔ kɔkɔɔkɔ.”
9 Satan he nɔ ke, “O susuɔ kaa yaka gu lɛ Hiob yeɔ mo gbeye ɔ? 10O baa Hiob yi, kɛ e we mi bimɛ, kɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ e ngɛ, nɛ nɔ́ ko hia we lɛ. O gbaa e ní tsumi, nɛ o wo lɛ ní babauu ngɛ zugba a nɔ. 11Moo lɛɛ mo he ní ɔmɛ ngɛ e dɛ kaa e be mo gbiɛe ngɛ o hɛ mi lo!”
12Yawɛ de Satan ke, “Saminya! Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ Hiob dɛ ɔ, i ngɔ kɛ wo o dɛ. Se lɛ nitsɛ e nɔmlɔ tso ɔ lɛɛ o nine ko ta he.” Kɛkɛ nɛ Satan je Mawu he.
Hiob bimɛ ɔmɛ kɛ e níhi tsuo a hɛ mi kpata
13Ligbi ko benɛ Hiob binyumu ɔmɛ, kɛ e biyi ɔmɛ ngɛ ní yee nɛ a ngɛ ní nue ngɛ a nyɛminyumu nɔkɔtɔma a we ɔ mi ɔ, 14tsɔlɔ ko gbɔ fo kɛ ba Hiob ngɔ, nɛ e ba de lɛ ke, “Na amɛ ngɛ hue, nɛ teji yi ɔmɛ ngɛ ní yee ngɛ a kasa nya. 15Tlukaa a, Sabea bi ɔmɛ ba yu a nɔ, nɛ a muɔ lohwe ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ ho. A gbe o tsɔli ɔmɛ tsuo; imi nɔ kake too lɛ i je mi, nɛ i ba konɛ ma ba bɔ mo amaniɛ.”
16Benɛ e ngɛ munyu ɔ tue kɛ mwɔɔ ɔ, tsɔlɔ kpa ba nɛ e ba de ke, “Oslabai gba pue to ɔmɛ kɛ to hyɛli ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ e gbe mɛ tsuo. Imi nɔ kake too lɛ i je mi, nɛ i ba konɛ ma ba bɔ mo amaniɛ.”
17E nya na we nɛ e nɔ si nɛ tsɔlɔ kpa ba nɛ e ba de ke, “Kaldea ní hali a kuu etɛ ba tua wɔ. A gbe o tsɔli ɔmɛ tsuo, nɛ a ngɔ afukpɔngɔ ɔmɛ kɛ je. Imi nɔ kake too lɛ i je mi, nɛ i ba konɛ ma ba bɔ mo amaniɛ.”
18Benɛ lɛ hu e ngɛ munyu ɔ tue kɛ mwɔɔ ɔ, tsɔlɔ kpa ba nɛ e ba de ke, “O binyumu ɔmɛ, kɛ o biyi ɔmɛ ngɛ ní yee nɛ a ngɛ ní nue ngɛ a nyɛminyumu nɔkɔtɔma a we ɔ mi. 19Tlukaa a, kɔɔhiɔ nɛ nya wa hia kɛ je nga a nɔ blɔ kɛ ba na tsu ɔ kɔ nya eywiɛ ɔmɛ tsuo, nɛ tsu ɔ hule ngɔ pue nihewi ɔmɛ, kɛ yihewi ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ mɛ tsuo a gbo. Imi nɔ kake too lɛ i je mi, nɛ i ba konɛ ma ba bɔ mo amaniɛ.”
20Kɛkɛ nɛ Hiob te da si, nɛ e kɛ aywilɛho hía tade ɔmɛ ngɛ e he, nɛ e sã e yi nɔ. E kpla si, nɛ e ngɔ e hɛ mi ngɔ bu si, nɛ e ja Mawu. 21Hiob de ke, “Maa fɔ mi kɛ ba he gu, nɛ ma kpale kɛ ya he gu. Yawɛ lɛ ha, nɛ Yawɛ lɛ ba ngɔ kɛ ho. A je Yawɛ biɛ ɔ yi!”
22Enɛ ɔ tsuo mi ɔ, Hiob pee we yayami ko; e pia we Mawu.

Title: HIOB 2
Content:
Satan ba ka Hiob ekohu
1Ligbi ko benɛ Mawu bimɛ ɔmɛ ba bua a he nya ekohu ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi ɔ, Satan piɛ a he kɛ ba. 2Yawɛ bi Satan ke, “Jije o je?”
Satan he nɔ ke, “I ya kpa je ɔ mi tsuo kɛ ya kɛ ba.”
3Yawɛ bi lɛ ke, “Anɛ o to ye tsɔlɔ Hiob he hɛ kaa nɔ ko be je ɔ mi nɛ da, nɛ yeɔ anɔkuale kɛ lɛ sɔ lo? E jaa mi, nɛ e pee we nɔ́ nɛ dɛ blɔ kɔkɔɔkɔ. O ba nyɛ ye nɔ ke ma ha mo blɔ nɛ o ya hao lɛ, be mi nɛ e pee we yayami ko kulaa. Se kɛ ba si piɔ ɔ, Hiob ngɛ anɔkuale yee kɛ mwɔɔ.”
4Satan he nɔ ke, “Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ nɔ ko dɛ ɔ, e ma nyɛ ngɔ kɛ ha, ke e yi ma na wami kɛkɛ ɔ. 5Moo lɛɛ moo ye e nɔmlɔ tso ɔ awi kaa e be mo gbiɛe ngɛ o hɛ mi lo!”
6Yawɛ de Satan ke, “Saminya! E ngɛ o dɛ mi; e hɛ mi kɛkɛ nɛ o ko kpata.”
7Kɛkɛ nɛ Satan si Yawɛ, nɛ e ya ha nɛ tslɔɔ fuu Hiob nɔmlɔ tso ɔ tsuo, kɛ je e nane sisi kɛ ya si e yi mi. 8Hiob ho ya hi la zu mi, nɛ e ngɔ ngɛyu kɛ ngɛ e he hluae. 9Jehanɛ, e yo ɔ de lɛ ke, “Tse o ngɛ anɔkuale ɔ yee kɛ mwɔɔ! Gbiɛ Mawu, nɛ o gbo!”
10Hiob he nɔ ke, “O ngɛ munyu tue kaa bɔ nɛ yihi kuasia amɛ a ti nɔ ko maa tu munyu pɛ. Ke Mawu ha wɔ nɔ́ kpakpa a, tse wa heɔ. Lɛ ke e ha wɔ nɔ́ yaya a, wa ko ngɔ lo?” Enɛ ɔ tsuo mi ɔ, Hiob pee we yayami; e de we nɔ́ ko kɛ si we Mawu.
Hiob huɛmɛ ɔmɛ
11Amanehlu nɛ ba Hiob nɔ ɔ, e huɛmɛ etɛ komɛ nu he, nɛ a je he slɔɔtohi kɛ ba konɛ a ba ye lɛ kɔmɔ nɛ a wo lɛ bua. Huɛmɛ ɔmɛ ji Elifaz nɛ je Teman ma a mi, Bildad nɛ je Shua zugba a nɔ, kɛ Zofar nɛ je Naama zugba a nɔ. 12Benɛ a ma ngɛ tsitsaa a, a na Hiob, se a yo we lɛ. Benɛ a ba yo lɛ ɔ, a wo yana nɛ a nya awe. A kɛ aywilɛho hía tade ɔmɛ ngɛ a he, nɛ a fĩa bunyuku kɛ ho hiɔwe ya kɛ pue a yi mi. 13Kɛkɛ nɛ a ba hi si ngɛ e kasa nya ngɛ zugba nyɔ kɛ pia ligbi kpaago sɔuu. Nɔ ko nɔ ko kɛ lɛ tu we munyu jamɛ a be ɔ tsuo, ejakaa a na kaa e ngɛ nɔ́ nae wawɛɛ nitsɛ.

Title: HIOB 3
Content:
Hiob kɛ Mawu tu munyu kɛ hɛdɔ
1 Jehanɛ, Hiob wo e nya nɔ nɛ e gbiɛ ligbi ɔ nɛ a fɔ lɛ ɔ.
Hiob
2-3Á gbiɛ ligbi ɔ nɛ a fɔ mi ɔ;
á gbiɛ nyɔ ɔ nɛ a wo ye hɔ ɔ.
4Mawu nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe,
ko kai jamɛ a ligbi ɔ hu gblegbleegble.
Ha nɛ je ɔ mi nɛ wo diblii,
nɛ pu ko tso hu.
5Ha nɛ e pee mɔbɔ ligbi,
nɛ je ɔ mi nɛ wo diblii kpii.
Ha nɛ bɔku tuu
ba ha pu ɔ hɛ mi.
6Gbee jamɛ a nyɔ ɔ kɛ je jeha a mi;
nɛ ke a ngɛ nyɔhiɔ ɔmɛ kanee ɔ,
a ko kane jamɛ a nyɔ ɔ.
7Ha nɛ jamɛ a nyɔ ɔ nɛ pee nyɔ ku;
bua jɔmi la ko nɛ ko pɛ.
8Nyɛ de nɔ gbiɛli ɔmɛ,
kɛ wo mi lohwe ngua a hɛ mi la woli ɔmɛ
ke a gbiɛ jamɛ a ligbi ɔ.
9Ha nɛ nɔkɔ ɔ nɛ wo diblii;
je mi nɛ ko tsɔ,
nɛ je hu ko na.
10Á gbiɛ jamɛ a nyɔ ɔ nɛ a fɔ mi ɔ,
kaa e kɛ mi wo haomi kɛ aywilɛho mi.
11Mɛni he je i gbo we ngɛ maa mi mi?
Mɛni he je i gbo we be nɛ a fɔ mi ɔ pɛ?
12Mɛni he je maa ngɔ mi kɛ fɔ e tɛ nɔ?
Mɛni he je lɛ e ha mi nyɔ?
13I gbo kpoo jamɛ a be ɔ mi,
jinɛ amlɔ nɛ ɔ, ye he mi jɔ mi.
14Jinɛ i kɛ matsɛmɛ, kɛ nɔ yeli
nɛ ma mɔhi blema ko ɔ
hwɔɔ si mwɔnɛ ɔ.
15Jinɛ i kɛ ganɔhi nɛ bua sika tsu kɛ sika hiɔ
nya tɔtɔɔtɔ ngɛ a wehi a mi ɔ
hwɔɔ si mwɔnɛ ɔ.
16Mɛni he je i gbo we ngɛ muɔ nɔ,
nɛ i ko nɛ́ pu la a?
17Ngɛ gbeje ɔ, yiwutsotsɛmɛ jɔɔ nɔ haomi,
nɛ nihi nɛ pɔ tɔ mɛ ɔ, jɔɔ a he.
18Lejɛ ɔ, pamitsɛmɛ po naa he jɔmi;
nɔ ko tu we mɛ munyu basabasa hu;
nɔ ko ke we a yi hulɔ.
19Nimli wawi kɛ nimli nguahi tsuo ngɛ lejɛ ɔ,
nɛ nyɔguɛ hu ye e he.
20Mɛni he je nimli adesahi
maa hi haomi mi kɛ mwɔɔ?
Mɛni he je e sa kaa nihi nɛ ngɛ aywilɛho yee ɔ
a yi nɛ na wami?
21 A hyɛɛ gbenɔ blɔ, se gbenɔ bɛ;
a hlaa yɔkɔ mohu se blɔ pe juetli.
22Ja a gbo nɛ a pu mɛ,
loko a naa bua jɔmi.
23Mɛni he je e sa kaa a fɔ nɔ ko
nɛ e ba na nɔ́ yaka,
be mi nɛ níhi nɛ maa ba e nɔ hwɔɔ se ɔ,
Mawu ngɔ kɛ laa lɛ?
24I haoɔ loko i yeɔ ní,
nɛ ke i ngɛ kɛmɛe ɔ,
e ngɛ kaa nyu nɛ a kpa pue si.
25Níhi nɛ i yee gbeye ɔ,
lɔ ɔmɛ i kɛ kpee;
níhi nɛ i hla we ma na a,
lɔ ɔmɛ i naa.
26I be tue mi jɔmi; i be he jɔmi;
ye haomi ɔmɛ a se pui gblegbleegble.

Title: HIOB 4
Content:
Kekleekle ní sɛɛmi
(4.1—14.22)
Elifaz
1-2Hiob, anɛ ke i bi mo munyu ɔ,
o mi mi ma fu lo?
I nyɛ we nɛ ma ma ye nya
nɛ ma pee dii hu.
3O tsɔɔ nihi babauu ní.
Ni nɛmɛ nɛ a nine mi je wu hu,
o wo mɛ he wami.
4Nɔ nɛ miɔ nɛ e maa nɔ si ɔ,
o munyu ɔ nuɔ lɛ kɛ daa si ekohu.
Nakutsohi nɛ gbɔjɔ ɔ,
o woɔ mɛ he wami,
nɛ a teɔ si ekohu.
5Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, haomi ba o nɔ nɛ o jija,
nɛ o nyɛ we nya nɛ o da.
6Tse o jaa Mawu!
Anɛ lɔ ɔ wui mo bua lo?
O peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da blɔ!
Anɛ lɔ ɔ ha we mo hɛ nɔ kami lo?
7Susu o yi mi!
Anɛ o le nɔ ko nɛ pee we yayami
nɛ e hɛ mi kpata lo?
Anɛ o le dalɔ ko
nɛ a gbe lɛ yaka gu lo?
8Nɔ́ nɛ imi i le ji kaa
nihi nɛ huɔ yayami ngmɔ,
nɛ a duɔ yayami wu ɔ,
yayami yiblii lɛ a kpaa.
9Mawu ngɔɔ abofu kɛ kpataa a hɛ mi
kaa bɔ nɛ ahumi puɛɔ ní ɔ.
10Yiwutsotsɛmɛ huãã, nɛ a pɛɛ kaa jata,
se Mawu jɔɔ a he nɛ e kũɔ a lunguhi.
11A gboɔ kaa jata nɛ nɛ lohwe
nɛ e gbe nɛ e ye,
nɛ a bimɛ ɔmɛ tsuo gbɛɛ kɛ fĩaa.
12Nɔ ko ju si ba tu mi munyu ko zaa
ngɛ ablɛgbi mi be ko.
13 Munyu nɛ ɔ he susumi ha nɛ dekla nu mi,
nɛ i hwɔ we mahe nyɔ ɔ mi tsuo.
14I ye gbeye, nɛ i kpokpo,
nɛ ye kpɔhi a nya tsuo do blibliibli.
15Kɛkɛ nɛ mumi ko ba po ye hɛ mi fli,
nɛ gbeye sɔuu ha nɛ fĩɛ ngmangu pue ye nɔ.
16I na kaa nɔ́ ko daa si ngɛ lejɛ ɔ;
i hyɛ, se i li nɔ́ nɛ ji.
Lejɛ ɔ pee dii;
kɛkɛ nɛ i nu nɛ gbi ko pɛ ke,
17“Anɛ nɔmlɔ adesa maa da
ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi lo?
Anɛ nɔmlɔ adesa he ma tsɔ
ngɛ e bɔlɔ ɔ hɛ mi lo?
18Mawu tsɔli ɔmɛ ngɛ hiɔwe tete po
Mawu he we mɛ yi.
E bɔfo ɔmɛ nitsɛnitsɛmɛ po,
e naa tɔmi ngɛ a he.
19Nɛ mo nɛ tabo zu lɛ a kɛ puɛ mo,
nɛ o ngɛ kaa bunyuku kɛkɛ!
Mo nɛ a ma nyɛ maa naa o nɔ
kaa bɔ nɛ a naa wɔyewɔye nɔ ɔ,
moo lɛɛ o susu kaa
Mawu ma he mo maa ye lo?
20Mɔtu ɔ, nɔ ko maa hi hɛ ngmengmle.
Se loko du ma bu ɔ, e gbo momo
nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko li.
21Ke a he e he wami tsuo ngɛ e dɛ ɔ,
kɛkɛ ɔ, e gbo be mi nɛ e li nɔ́ ko.”

Title: HIOB 5
Content:
1Hiob, mo kpa kuu kaa nɔ ko ma he nɔ lo!
Ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ a ti mɛnɔ ngɔ o maa ya?
2Niinɛ, mi mi la gbeɔ kuasia.
Nɔ nɛ hɛ mi tɛ̃ ɔ,
hunga gbeɔ lɛ.
3I na kuasiahi nɛ a pee kaa a na a he;
kɛkɛ nɛ i gbiɛ a hi he amlɔ nɔuu.
4A bimɛ ɔmɛ be he jɔmi nae.
Ke a kɛ mɛ ya kojomi he ɔ,
nɔ ko nɔ ko be a he fae.
5Kuasiahi a ngmɔ ní ɔ,
ke mio mi e ngɛ po,
nihi nɛ hwɔ ngɛ mɛ yee
ma ya ye.
A juetli he kuma maa
ye nihi.
6Amanehlu ɔ, pi bunyuku mi nɛ e jeɔ;
haomi hu pi zu mi nɛ e puɛɔ kɛ jeɔ.
7Nɔmlɔ adesa nitsɛ lɛ hlaa haomi kɛ haa e he
kaa bɔ nɛ la lilɛ tee kɛ yaa hiɔwe ɔ.
8Imi ji mo jinɛ i ko hla Mawu se blɔ,
nɛ ma tu ye sane ɔ kɛ wo e dɛ mi.
9Lɛ ji nɔ nɛ peeɔ ní nguanguahi
nɛ wa juɛmi sui he,
kɛ nyakpɛ ní hu babauu.
10Lɛ nɛ e haa nɛ hiɔmi nɛɔ kɛ pueɔ zugba;
nɛ e haa nɛ ngmɔ ɔmɛ naa nyu.
11Ee, nihi nɛ baa a he si ɔ, Mawu woɔ a nɔ;
lɛ nɛ e woɔ kɔmɔ yeli a bua.
12Lɛ nɛ e tsakeɔ nɔ sisili a yi mi tomi,
nɛ níhi nɛ a so kaa a maa pee ɔ,
a nyɛ we nɛ a peeɔ.
13 Ke ní leli tsɔ nihi klama a,
lɛ nɛ e haa klama amɛ fɛɔ yaka
nɛ a puɛ we ní.
14Piani nɛ la ngɛ po, a hii si tataae
kaa nɔ́ nɛ diblii mi lɛ a ngɛ nyɛɛe.
15Se Mawu heɔ ohiatsɛ yi wami
kɛ jeɔ gbenɔ mi.
E jeɔ nɔ nɛ e fí lɛ ɔ
kɛ jeɔ yiwutsotsɛ dɛ mi.
16E haa ohiatsɛ hɛ nɔ kami,
nɛ yiwutsotsɛ maa e nya.
17 A gbaa nɔ nɛ Mawu kaa e hɛ mi ɔ.
Ke Mawu Ope ɔ ngɛ o hɛ mi kae ɔ,
koo ngɔ lɛ kaa nɔ́ ko nyafii.
18 Ke Mawu plaa mo ɔ, e fiɔ pa a nɔ;
ke e fia mo nɔ́ ɔ, e tsaa mo.
19E ma je mo kɛ je haomihi tsuo a mi,
nɛ nɔ́ ko be o he sae.
20Hwɔ be mi, kɛ ta be mi tsuo
e ma he o yi wami.
21Mawu ma je mo kɛ je he guɛ gbeli a dɛ mi;
ke hɛ mi kpatami ma a,
e ma he o yi wami.
22Hɛ mi kpatami kɛ hwɔ a he maa pee mo muɔ,
nɛ o be pu mi lohwehi hu gbeye yee.
23Ejakaa ngmɔhi nɛ o ma hu ɔ,
tɛ be a nɔ hie;
pu mi lohwehi hu be mo haoe.
24O maa hi si ngɛ o bo tsu ɔ mi
ngɛ tue mi jɔmi mi.
Ke o hyɛ o to tsu ɔ mi ɔ,
o maa na kaa nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ ngɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
25O bimɛ maa hiɛ babauu
kaa nga ngɛ zugba a nɔ.
26O maa bwɔ kotokoto loko o ma gbo,
kaa bɔ nɛ ngma waa saminya loko a kpaa a.
27Hiob, nɔ nɛ wa kpa si nɛ wa na ji nɛ ɔ nɛ!
E ji anɔkuale.
Mo hu moo bu tue nɛ o le,
konɛ e hi ha mo.

Title: HIOB 6
Content:
Hiob
1-2I ná nɛ a ngmɛ ye haomi ɔ,
kɛ ye aywilɛho ɔ ngɛ sɛni nɔ,
3jinɛ a ko jiɔ pe wo nya zia.
Enɛ ɔ he je nɛ i ngɛ munyu tue basabasa a nɛ.
4Mawu Ope ɔ tsɛ̃ mi kɛ̃ɛ̃,
nɛ duɔ ɔ ngɛ nyɛɛe ngɛ ye he womi mi tsuo.
Mawu ní gbeyegbeye ɔmɛ
gba ta kɛ wo mi.
5Ke nga mi teji ngɛ nga kpee ɔ,
anɛ e pa hii pɛe lo?
Ke na ngɛ ní yee ɔ,
anɛ e hii pɛe kɛ mwɔɔ lo?
6Anɛ a yeɔ ní muɛtɛ nɛ a nɛ ngo lo?
Kungwɔ hlui mi ehiɔ ɔ,
mɛni ngɔmi lɛ ngɛ mi?
7Niye ní kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ jlo we mi;
ke i ye kɛkɛ e peeɔ mi kaa ma vie.
8Mɛni he je Mawu ha we mi nɔ́ nɛ i bi lɛ ɔ?
Mɛni he je e bui ye kue fami ɔ tue ɔ?
9Lɛɛ tse e ko ngɔ e nine kɛ fia mi nɔ́ nɛ e gbe nyɔngloo!
10Jinɛ ma hlu kɛ bua jɔmi,
nɛ i be haomi ɔ nitsɛ po he nue.
Mawu Nɔ Klɔuklɔu ɔ mlaa amɛ ɔ,
i tɔ̃ we a nɔ hyɛ.
11Mɛni he wami i ngɛ
nɛ ma kɛ hi je mi kɛ mwɔɔ?
Mɛni he je ma hi je mi kɛ mwɔɔ,
be mi nɛ i be hɛ nɔ kami ko?
12Anɛ tɛ ji mi nɛ i nui nɔ́ he lo?
Ye he womi ɔ, akɔblee lo?
13Anɔkuale mi ɔ, ye he wami ta!
He ko he ko be
nɛ ma na yemi kɛ buami kɛ je.
14I kua Mawu jio, i kua we lɛ jio,
ngɛ haomi kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ mi ɔ,
e hia mi huɛmɛ nɛ ma he mɛ ma ye.
15Se nyɛ ye nyɛmimɛ, nyɛ sisiɔ mi
kaa pa nɛ gbli, be mi nɛ hiɔmi nɛ́.
16Snoo kɛ nyu tɛ hyiɔ pa tɔtɔɔtɔ,
17se ke je mi dɔ, kɛkɛ a laa,
be mi nɛ nyu dɔ ɔ fɔɔ si gu nɛ e gbli.
18Blɔ nyɛɛli gbaa kɛ jeɔ a blɔ nɔ
kaa a ma na nyu maa nu lo.
Se a nɛ nyu nɛ a nu,
nɛ a gboɔ ngɛ nga a nɔ.
19Blɔ nyɛɛli nɛ je Sheba kɛ Tema
ba hlaa nyu nɛ a nu.
20Se ke a ba su pa
nɛ e mi nyu mii ta a he kikɛ nɛ ɔ,
a kɔni mi jɔɔ,
ejakaa lɔ ɔ nɔ a ngɔ a hɛ kɛ fɔ.
21Nyɛ ngɛ kaa jamɛ a pa a
nɛ e mi nyu mii ta a pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Nyɛ ba na mi ngɛ haomi si himi mi,
kɛkɛ nɛ nyɛ ye gbeye.
22Anɛ i de nyɛ ke nyɛ ba ke mi ní,
aloo nyɛ ya ha nɔ ko nyɔ mi ní ha mi lo?
23Anɛ i de nyɛ ke nyɛ ba je mi kɛ je
he nyɛlɔ, loo yiwutsotsɛ ko dɛ mi lo?
24Yoo, nyɛɛ kɛ mi nɛ tu munyu.
Nyɛɛ tsɔɔ mi nɔ́ nɛ i pee nɛ dɛ;
ma pee dii nɛ ma bu nyɛ tue.
25Anɔkuale munyuhi gbɔɔ nɔ tsui mi;
se ye hɛ mi nɛ nyɛ ba ngɛ kae nɛ ɔ
lɛɛ yaka kɛkɛ.
26Nyɛ susuɔ kaa nyɛɛ lɛɛ
nyɛ ngɛ juɛmi munyuhi tue,
se imi nɛ ye nine mi je wu ɔ,
ye munyu ɔmɛ peeɔ kɔɔhiɔ;
pi ja?
27Anɛ nyɛ ma nyɛ maa fɔ awusa bi nɔ sɔ lo?
Anɛ nyɛ ma nyɛ maa wo nyɛ huɛ he jua lo?
28Nyɛɛ hyɛ ye hɛ mi saminya!
Anɛ ma nyɛ ma ye nyɛ lakpa lo?
29Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i kpa nyɛ pɛɛ,
nyɛ ko susu nɔ́ yayami ha mi kɛ ya tsitsaa.
Nyɛ ko bu mi fɔ; i yeɔ nguɔ.
30Se nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ susuu kaa i ngɛ lakpa yee.
Nyɛ susuu kaa i li kpakpa kɛ yayami a kpɛti
slɔɔto lo?

Title: HIOB 7
Content:
1Nɔmlɔ adesa wami si himi ngɛ kaa ta;
nɔmlɔ ngɛ kaa apaa yelɔ ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi.
2Nɔmlɔ ngɛ kaa nyɔguɛ
nɛ ngɛ hɔ̃ hlae nɛ e hi mi.
E ngɛ kaa apaa yelɔ
nɛ ngɛ e hiɔwo blɔ hyɛe.
3Bɔ nɛ ye sane ɔ ngɛ pɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ:
nyɔhiɔhi babauu ji nɛ ɔ nɛ i hii si kɛkɛ;
daa nyɔ mi ɔ, dekla sɔuu.
4Ke i ya hwɔ si ɔ, i biɔ ye he ke,
“Mɛni be je maa na nɛ ma te si?”
Ke nyɔ ɔ se kɛ ɔ,
kikɛ nɛ ɔ i hii plɛe ngɛ sa mi
hluu kɛ ya siɔ mɔtu.
5Ye he womi pɔtɔ, nɛ e wo gɔgɔ.
Ye he tsuo pee pa, nɛ e foɔ nyu.
6Ye ligbi ɔmɛ ngɛ bee mlamlaamla;
a he ngɛ sɔe kulaa pe bo lolɔ kplɛ.
Ligbi ɔmɛ ngɛ tae,
se i be hɛ nɔ kami ko.
7Nyɛ kai kaa ye wami ngɛ kaa kɔɔhiɔ kɛkɛ;
ye bua jɔmi ɔ se po.
8Nɛ́ nyɛ ngɛ mi hyɛe nɛ ɔ,
nyɛ be mi nae hu.
Nyɛ maa hi mi hyɛe kikɛ nɛ ɔ
kɛkɛ i si nyɛ.
9Ke nɔ ko gbo nɛ e ho gbeje ya a,
e kpale we kɛ bɛ hu
kaa bɔ nɛ bɔku laa
nɛ a nɛ lɛ hu ɔ.
10Nɔ ɔ kpale we kɛ bɛ e we mi hu,
nɛ nihi nɛ le lɛ ɔ, a hɛ jee e nɔ.
11Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, imi hu i be ye nya mae.
I hao, nɛ aywilɛho nu mi.
Ja i tu munyu kɛ̃!
12Mɛni he je nyɛ ba ngɛ ye he bue?
Anɛ nyɛ susuɔ kaa wo mi lohwe ngua a ji mi lo?
13Ke i susu kaa ke i hwɔ si nɛ ma na bua jɔmi,
nɛ ke i hwɔ mahe nɛ ye kɔmɔ yemi se maa po ɔ,
14nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛɛ kɛ nlamihi, kɛ ninahi
woɔ ye he gbeye.
15I na nɛ a mia ye kuɔ si nɛ i gbo mohu,
pe nɔ́ nɛ ma hi je mi wuhiwuhi kikɛ nɛ ɔ.
16Je mi si himi pee we mi akɔnɔ hu;
i be si hie kɛ maa ya neneene.
Nyɛɛ ngmɛɛ ye he nɛ nyɛɛ ho;
ye wami ɔ ngɛ kaa kɔɔhiɔ kɛkɛ.
17 Mɛnɔ ji nɔmlɔ adesa,
loko e he hia mo kikɛ nɛ ɔ?
Mɛnɔ ji lɛ,
loko o susuɔ e he kikɛ nɛ ɔ?
18O ba slaa lɛ daa mɔtu,
nɛ o kaa lɛ kpitikpiti.
19O be o hɛ jee kɛ je ye he bɔɔ
nɛ ma mi ye kuɔ mi nyu po lo?
20Ke i pee yayami ɔ, i plaa mo lo?
Mo nɛ o hyɛɛ nimli adesahi a tsui mi ɔ,
mɛni he je o je hɛ ngɔ pi mi ɔ?
Anɛ i plɛ pee tlomi nɛ jiɔ tsɔ ha mo lo?
21Mɛni he je o kɛ ye he yayami ɔmɛ pɛ mi ɔ?
Mɛni he je o je we ye he yayami
ɔmɛ kɛ ji o hɛ mi kɛ mwɔɔ ɔ?
Jehanɛ lɛɛ tabo zu mi lɛ ma hwɔ;
ke o ngɛ mi hlae ɔ, o be mi nae hu.

Title: HIOB 8
Content:
Bildad
1-2O maa hi munyu nɛ ɔmɛ tue
kɛ yaa si mɛni be?
Munyu nɛ ngɛ kpo jee ngɛ o nya mi
kaa kɔɔhiɔ nɛ ngɛ fiae vuguvugu nɛ ɔ,
mɛni be o ma kpa tumi?
3Anɛ Mawu plɛɔ sane hɛ mi ngɔ buɔ si lo?
Mawu Ope ɔ,
anɛ e tsakeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da kɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ dɛ lo?
4O bimɛ ɔmɛ pee yayami kɛ si Mawu,
nɛ lɔ ɔ he nɛ e gbla a tue bɔ nɛ sa mɛ ɔ nɛ.
5Lɛɛ mo nitsɛ mo hla Mawu Ope ɔ se blɔ
nɛ o fa kue ha lɛ.
6Ke o he tsɔ, nɛ o peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a,
Mawu ma tsɔ e hɛ mi ha mo,
nɛ e ma ha mo sihi he kpakpa.
7Hwɔɔ se ɔ,
Mawu ma ha mo ní babauu
nɛ maa hiɛ kulaa pe kekle nɔ́ ɔ.
8Lɔ ɔ he ɔ,
i kpa mo pɛɛ,
hla blema nile se blɔ,
nɛ o hyɛ anɔkuale nɛ wa nɛmɛ ɔmɛ kase ɔ.
9Wa wami be ɔ ngɛ kpiti;
wa li nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko;
wa ngɛ kaa nini kɛkɛ nɛ bee ngɛ je ɔ mi.
10Nyɛ ha nɛ blema ní leli nɛ tsɔɔ nyɛ ní;
nyɛɛ bu a nya mi munyu ɔmɛ tue:
11“Anɛ ngɔwu puɛɔ ngɛ he nɛ mɔsɔ be lo?
Anɛ ke ngɔwu nɛ nyu ɔ,
e ma nyɛ maa wa lo?
12Ke nyu ta a he pɛ
mɛ ji kekleekle tsohi nɛ a gboɔ.
Jamɛ a be ɔ, a wɛ lolo
nɛ a maa po mɛ kɛ pee nɔ́ ko.
13Nimlihi nɛ a hɛ je Mawu nɔ ɔ,
a ngɛ kaa ngɔwu nɛ ɔmɛ pɛ.
Ke o li Mawu ɔ,
o be hɛ nɔ kami ko.
14Nimli nɛ li Mawu ɔ,
a hemi kɛ yemi ngɛ kaa anani ya;
a yi mi tomi ɔmɛ tsuo maa laa.
15A maa ngɔ a hɛ kɛ fɔ weku kɛ nina nɔ,
se e be hie ha mɛ.
A maa ngɔ a he kɛ mɛtɛ mɛ kpɛii,
se nɔ́ kpakpa ko be mi jee.”
16Nimli yayamihi bɔɔ kaa nga ngɛ pu nɔ;
a bɔɔ kaa nga nɛ ha ngmɔ nɔ.
17A sipoku ɔmɛ ngɔɔ a he ya blaa tɛ sahi,
nɛ a mɛtɛɛ tɛ sa amɛ a he.
18Se ke a hɛ mi kpata kikɛ nɛ ɔ,
nɔ ko nɔ ko be lee kaa a hi lejɛ ɔ hyɛ po.
19Niinɛ, bua jɔmi tsuo nɛ
nimli yayamihi naa ji nɛ ɔ nɛ;
kɛkɛ ɔ, ni kpahi baa ba ngɔɔ a blɔ he ɔmɛ.
20Nɔ nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a,
Mawu be lɛ kuae.
Mawu be nimli yayamihi a he piɛe kɔkɔɔkɔ.
21Mawu ma ha nɛ o maa muɔ,
nɛ o ma hwɔ lele ekohu.
22Ni nɛmɛ nɛ nyɛɛ mo ɔ,
zo maa gbe mɛ;
yiwutsotsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a wehi maa laa.

Title: HIOB 9
Content:
Hiob
1-2 Niinɛ, i le kaa e ngɛ mi ja.
Se kɛ nɔmlɔ adesa maa pee kɛɛ
nɛ e maa ye nguɔ ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi?
3Mɛnɔ ma nyɛ nɛ e kɛ Mawu maa hua nɔ́ he?
Ke Mawu bi lɛ munyu akpe ɔ,
anɛ e ma nyɛ kake po heto ma ha lo?
4Mawu ɔ, e le ní, nɛ e he wa.
Mɛnɔ lɛ te si kɛ si Mawu hyɛ nɛ e hi ha lɛ?
5E hiaa yohi tlukaa
nɛ e wui nɔ ko si;
nɛ ke e mi mi fu ɔ,
e kpataa a hɛ mi.
6E haa nɛ zugba mimiɛɔ,
nɛ titimahi nɛ hɛɛ zugba a mimiɛɔ.
7E nyɛɔ faa nɛ pu ti si,
nɛ dodoehi hu kpɛ we.
8Benɛ Mawu maa gbla hiɔwe mi,
nɛ e maa naa wo mi lohwe ngua a nɔ ɔ,
nɔ ko piɛ we e he.
9 Dodoehi nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe:
Je kpaago, Huɛ etɛ,
Kungwɔ kɛ e bimɛ,
kɛ leneyi je dodoe ɔmɛ ɔ,
Mawu lɛ pee mɛ tsuo.
10E peeɔ ní nguahi
nɛ nimli adesahi a juɛmi sui he.
E nyakpɛ ní ɔmɛ hiɛ babauu
nɛ a li nya.
11Hyɛ, Mawu bee ngɛ ye hɛ mi
kɛ yaa kɛ baa, se i nɛ lɛ.
12Nɔ́ nɛ e suɔ ɔ,
kɛkɛ e gblɔ kɛ je.
Mɛnɔ ma nyɛ maa tsi e nya?
Mɛnɔ ma nyɛ ma bi lɛ ke,
“Mɛni o ngɛ pee nɛ ɔ?”
13Mawu mi mi fumi se pui.
E he nyɛli ɔmɛ nɛ te si wo lɛ ɔ,
e kpata a hɛ mi.
Mɛ lɛ a ya piɛ wo mi lohwe ngua a
nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Rahab ɔ he ɔ nɛ.
14Lɛɛ jije ma na munyu ngɛ
kɛ ha Mawu heto nɛ sa?
15E ngɛ mi kaa i pee we yayami ko lɛɛ,
se i be nyɛe nɛ ma ha Mawu heto.
Pɛɛ kɛkɛ lɛ ma kpa Mawu, ye kojolɔ ɔ,
konɛ e na mi mɔbɔ.
16Ke i tsɛ lɛ nɛ e he nɔ pohu,
i he we yi kaa ke i tu munyu
nɛ e maa bu mi tue.
17E haa nɛ kɔɔhiɔ nɛ nya wa
fiaa mi basabasa yaka gu,
nɛ i plaa wawɛɛ nitsɛ.
18E ha we nɛ ma wo mumi kulaa;
ye wami si himi ɔ, doomi sɔuu.
19Ke a ngɛ nɔ nɛ he wa hlae ɔ,
lɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Ke e ba lɛ dami sane yemi hu,
mɛnɔ kɛ lɛ maa ba kojomi he ɔ?
20Ke i ke dalɔ ji mi ɔ,
imi nitsɛ ye nya mi munyu maa bu mi fɔ.
Ke i ke tɔmi ko be ye he ɔ,
e maa tsɔɔ mi kaa i yeɔ fɔ.
21Ke i yeɔ nguɔ kulaa po,
e hia we kaa ma susu lɔ ɔ he;
ye wami si himi pee we mi akɔnɔ hu.
22O yeɔ fɔ jio, o yeɔ nguɔ jio,
lɛ tsuo nɔ́ kake too.
Mawu ma kpata wɔ tsuo wa hɛ mi.
23Ke nɔ nɛ pee we yayami gbo tlukaa a,
Mawu muɔɔ.
24Mawu ngɔ je ɔ kɛ wo nimli yayamihi a dɛ mi.
E ngɔ nɔ́ ngɔ ha kojoli ɔmɛ a hɛ mi.
Ke pi Mawu nɛ pee ɔ, lɛɛ mɛnɔ lɛ pee?
25Ye ligbi ɔmɛ ngɛ bee mlamlaamla;
a he ngɛ sɔe kulaa pe nɔ ko nɛ ngɛ fo tue.
Se nɔ́ kpakpa ko be a mi.
26Ye ligbi ɔmɛ ngɛ bee kɛ fo
kaa lɛ nɛ he sɔɔ saminya;
aloo kaa kɔle nɛ maa ho lohwe sami ya.
27-28Ke i ke ma muɔ
nɛ ye hɛ nɛ je ye haomi ɔmɛ a nɔ ɔ,
haomi ɔmɛ tsuo kpaleɔ kɛ baa
nɛ a ba woɔ ye he gbeye.
I le kaa Mawu be mi nguɔ woe kɔkɔɔkɔ.
29A maa bu mi fɔ kɛ̃;
mɛni he je mɔ lɛ ma gbo dengme yaka?
30Jale ko jale ko be
nɛ ma nyɛ ma fɔ ye he yayami ɔmɛ.
31Mawu ma sake mi kɛ wo muɔ mi,
nɛ ye he zo maa pee imi nitsɛ ye tadehi.
32Nɔmlɔ adesa ji Mawu kaa imi
jinɛ i ko ha lɛ heto,
jinɛ i kɛ lɛ ko ya kojomi he ɔ
nɛ wa ya hla munyu ɔ mi.
33Se sane he buálɔ ko be;
nɔ ko be nɛ maa kojo Mawu kɛ nɔmlɔ a kpɛti.
34Mawu nɛ jɔɔ ye tue gblami;
e kpa ye he gbeye womi.
35I yi lɛ gbeye.
Ma tu munyu,
ejakaa i le bɔ nɛ ye tsui mi ngɛ.

Title: HIOB 10
Content:
1Je mi himi ba gbe ye nya;
jehanɛ, bu ye sane ɔ tue.
2Mawu, koo bu mi fɔ.
Mɛni i pee,
loko o kɛ mi ngɛ sane yee kikɛ nɛ ɔ?
3Imi nɔmlɔ nɛ mo nitsɛ o bɔ ɔ,
anɛ e da ha mo kaa o wa mi yi mi,
nɛ o hie mi kikɛ nɛ ɔ,
konɛ yiwutsotsɛmɛ a yi mi tomi yayami ɔmɛ lɛɛ
o bua nɛ jɔ he lo?
4Anɛ nimli adesahi a hɛngmɛ lɛ ngɛ o dɛ?
Anɛ o hyɛɛ nɔ́ kaa nɔmlɔ lo?
5Anɛ o wami be ɔ ngɛ
kpiti kaa nɔmlɔ nɔ́ lo?
6Mɛni he je mɔ lɛ o ngɛ ye tɔmi ɔmɛ,
kɛ ye yayami ɔmɛ a se die kikɛ nɛ ɔ?
7O le kaa i yi fɔ,
nɛ nɔ ko hu be nɛ ma kpɔ mi kɛ je o dɛ mi.
8O ninehi nɛ o kɛ bɔ mi ɔ,
amlɔ nɛ ɔ, o ngɔ jamɛ a nine ɔmɛ nɔuu
kɛ ngɛ ye hɛ mi kpatae.
9Kai kaa tabo zu lɛ o kɛ bɔ mi.
Anɛ o ma ha nɛ ma plɛ pee zu ekohu lo?
10O ha tsaatsɛ he wami nɛ e kɛ fɔ mi;
o ha nɛ i wa ngɛ maa mi mi.
11O kɛ wu kɛ pani pee ye nɔmlɔ tso ɔ,
nɛ o ngɔ lo, kɛ he womi kɛ ha he.
12O dloo mi wami, o hyɛɛ ye nɔ daa,
nɛ o suɔmi ɔ se pui gblegbleegble.
13Se amlɔ nɛ ɔ, i le kaa
o ngɔ ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ngɔ to o yi mi;
nɛ daa nɛ ɔ o ngɛ ga toe
nɛ o kɛ ye mi awi.
14Ke i pee yayami ko ɔ, kɛkɛ o ngma kɛ to,
nɛ o kɛ be mi pae kɔkɔɔkɔ.
15Ke i pee yayami ɔ, musu tloo mi.
Ke i pee nɔ́ nɛ da tete po,
haomi kɛ zo ha we nɛ ma nyɛ ma wo ye yi nɔ.
16Ke níhi a mi hi ha mi bɔɔ ɔ,
o nyɛɛɔ ye se kaa jata.
O guu nyakpɛ blɔhi a nɔ,
nɛ o kɛ yeɔ mi awi.
17Daa nɛ ɔ,
o yeɔ odase kɛ siɔ mi.
Daa nɛ ɔ,
o mi mi fuɔ mi wawɛɛ nitsɛ,
nɛ daa nɛ ɔ,
o toɔ ga he nɛ o kɛ ye mi awi.
18Mawu, mɛni he je kulaa lɛ o ha nɛ a fɔ mi ɔ?
I na nɛ i plɛ ye se
ngɛ muɔ nɔ.
19Kaa a ngɔ mi kɛ je maa mi mi ya wo
yɔkɔ mi amlɔ nɔuu ɔ,
jinɛ e ngɛ kaa nɔ́ nɛ a fɔ we mi kɛ̃.
20Ye wami ligbi ɔmɛ ɔ,
pi bɔɔ pɛ nɛ piɛ lo?
Ngmɛɛ ye he
nɛ ma na bua jɔmi bɔɔ!
21Ma hia blɔ be kpiti mi kɛ ya he ko
nɛ i be kpalee kɛ ba hu.
I yaa ma ko nɔ;
lejɛ ɔ wo diblii kpii,
nɛ e ngɛ gbeyegbeye.
22Lejɛ ɔ ngɛ gbeyegbeye, kɛ basabasa;
nɛ piani po woɔ diblii kaa nyɔ mi.

Title: HIOB 11
Content:
Zofar
1-2Nɔ ko be munyuhi babauu nɛ ɔmɛ a heto hae lo?
Anɛ munyu tumi babauu woɔ nɔ nguɔ lo?
3Hiob, munyuhi nɛ o ngɛ tue putɛputɛɛ ɔ,
o susu kaa jamɛ munyu ɔmɛ
ma ha nɛ wa ma wa nya lo?
Ke o ngɛ nihi a he fɛu yee ɔ,
nɔ ko nɛ ko pue o hɛ mi si lo?
4O deɔ ke anɔkuale munyuhi o ngɛ tue ɔ nɛ;
o deɔ ke dalɔ ji mo ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi.
5I na nɛ Mawu pa e nya mi
nɛ e ha mo heto.
6Jinɛ Mawu maa tu mo nile mi laami munyuhi;
e ma de mo ke níhi babauu ngɛ je mi
nɛ nɔmlɔ adesa juɛmi sui he.
Na nɛ o le kaa Mawu gbla we o tue bɔ nɛ sa mo;
o yayami ɔmɛ hiɛ kulaa pe tue gblami ɔ.
7Anɛ o ma nyɛ maa na Mawu níhi
nɛ a mi kuɔ a nya kɛ pi si lo?
Anɛ o ma nyɛ maa na Mawu Ope ɔ
nya tami he lo?
8Mawu ngɛ hiɔwe se lokoo,
se moo lɛɛ hiɔwe ɔ po o juɛmi sui he.
Mawu le gbogboehi a je,
se moo lɛɛ o li lejɛ ɔ.
9Ke a susu Mawu he wami
kaa bɔ nɛ a kɛ kpa susuɔ nɔ́ ɔ,
Mawu he wami ka pe je ɔ,
nɛ e bli pe wo.
10Ke Mawu ba nu mo
nɛ e kɛ mo ba kojomi he ɔ,
mɛnɔ maa tsi e nya?
11Mawu le yaka nimli.
Ke e na ní yayamihi nɛ a ngɛ pee ɔ,
anɛ e be a tue gblae lo?
12Ke nga mi tejihi a hɛ mi ba si ɔ,
kuasiahi maa le nɔ.
13Hiob, tsake o tsui,
nɛ o bua o nine nya
nɛ o fa kue ha Mawu.
14Mo nitsɛ mo kpa yayami peemi,
nɛ o hyɛ nɛ a ko pee yi wu tso
ní ngɛ o we ɔ mi.
15Ke yayami ko be o he nɛ ma ble mo ɔ,
lɔ ɔ loko o maa pi si ngɛ Mawu mi,
nɛ o be nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko gbeye yee.
16Kɛkɛ ɔ, o haomi ɔmɛ tsuo a se maa po
kaa pa nɛ hia kɛ ba be be ko;
nɛ o be mɛ kaie hu.
17O wami he ma tsɔ heii pe piani;
diblii be po maa hi kaa mɔtu.
18O maa hi si ngɛ tue mi jɔmi, kɛ hɛ nɔ kami mi;
Mawu maa baa o yi,
nɛ e ma ha mo he jɔmi.
19Ke o hwɔ si ɔ, o be gbeye yee;
nihi babauu ma ba bi yemi
kɛ buami ngɛ o dɛ.
20Se yayami peeli lɛɛ a maa na kaa a yi ta pɛ;
he ko he ko be nɛ a maa tu fo kɛ ya.
Nɔ́ nɛ blɔ nɛ a maa hyɛ kɛkɛ ji gbenɔ.

Title: HIOB 12
Content:
Hiob
1-2Niinɛ, nyɛ ji ma a nɛ.
Ke nyɛ gbo kɛkɛ nile hu gbo.
3Se imi hu i ngɛ juɛmi kaa nyɛ nɔuu;
nyɛ pi mi kɛ nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko;
níhi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ dee nɛ ɔ, mɛnɔ lɛ li?
4I plɛ pee muɔ nɔ́ kɛ ha ye huɛmɛ;
a ngɛ mi muɔe,
pohu dalɔ ji mi; tɔmi be ye he.
Be ko nɛ be ɔ, ke i fa kue ha Mawu ɔ,
e buɔ mi tue.
5Nyɛ ngɛ ye he fɛu yee,
ejakaa nyɛɛ lɛɛ haomi ko be nyɛ nɔ.
Nɔmlɔ nɛ miɔ nɛ maa nɔ si ɔ,
nyɛ ngɛ lɛ nɔ́ fiae.
6Ojo fiali, kɛ nihi nɛ woɔ Mawu mi mi la a,
a ngɛ tue mi jɔmi si himi mi;
mɛ po nɛ a he wami ji a mawu ɔ.
7Nyɛɛ ya lohwe nane eywiɛɛywiɛtsɛmɛ a ngɔ;
nyɛɛ ya lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ a ngɔ,
nɛ a maa tsɔɔ nyɛ ní.
8Adebɔ níhi nɛ ngɛ wo mi kɛ zugba a nɔ ɔ,
nyɛɛ ya nɛ nyɛ ya bi mɛ nile.
9Mɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ a ti mɛnɔ lɛ li
kaa Mawu lɛ pee enɛ ɔ lo?
10Níhi nɛ ngɛ hɛ ngmengmle tsuo,
Mawu lɛ ha mɛ wami;
nimli adesahi tsuo a wami ngɛ Mawu dɛ mi.
11Se kaa bɔ nɛ tue hyɛɛ munyu mi,
nɛ lilɛ hu saa niye ní nya hyɛɛ ɔ,
12nimeli ngɛ nile;
nihi nɛ a wami se kɛ ɔ,
a ngɛ juɛmi.
13Se Mawu lɛɛ e nɔ́ ji nile, kɛ he wami;
e ngɛ juɛmi, kɛ nɔ́ sisi numi.
14Ke Mawu ku nɔ́ ko kɛ pue si ɔ,
mɛnɔ ma nyɛ maa ma ekohu?
Ke e nga nɔ ko yi kɛ wo tsu mi ɔ,
mɛnɔ ma nyɛ ma bli lɛ?
15Ke Mawu tsi hiɔmi nya, kɛkɛ zugba gbli;
ke e bli nyu nya,
kɛkɛ pa hia lalaala ngɛ zugba a nɔ.
16Mawu he wa, nɛ e le ní;
nɔ sisilɔ, kɛ nɔ nɛ a sisi lɛ tsuo e níhi ji mɛ.
17E kpɔɔ nile ngɛ ga woli a dɛ,
nɛ e haa kojoli plɛɔ peeɔ kuasiahi.
18E kpaa matsɛmɛ,
nɛ e haa nɛ a plɛɔ peeɔ pamitsɛmɛ.
19E baa osɔfohi si,
nɛ e butuu ni nɛmɛ nɛ he wami ngɛ a dɛ.
20Nihi nɛ a buu ɔ,
e kpɔɔ munyu tumi he wami ngɛ a dɛ;
nimeli hu e kpɔɔ a nile ɔ ngɛ a dɛ.
21E pueɔ ganɔhi a hɛ mi si,
nɛ e haa a he wami ɔ se poɔ.
22E jeɔ nyakpɛ níhi kpo kɛ jeɔ laami hehi,
nɛ e haa la tsoɔ ngɛ hehi nɛ wo diblii kpii.
23E haa je mahi he wami,
nɛ e kpaleɔ kpataa a hɛ mi.
E haa nɛ mahi bɔɔ,
nɛ e kpaleɔ gbɛɛ mɛ ngɔ fĩaa.
24E haa je ma amɛ a hɛ mi nyɛɛli jeɔ kuasia,
nɛ a ya woɔ lalaalo ngɛ nga nɔ
he nɛ blɔ ko blɔ ko be.
25A hii dedee, nɛ a hii si tataae ngɛ diblii mi
kaa nihi nɛ tɔ dã.

Title: HIOB 13
Content:
1-2Ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ nyɛ ngɛ dee ɔ,
i na, nɛ i nu hyɛ; i nu lɛ tsuo sisi.
Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ le ɔ, imi hu i le;
nyɛ pi mi.
3Imi lɛɛ Mawu Ope ɔ lɛ i kɛ na, se pi nyɛ;
ma suɔ nɛ i kɛ lɛ wa hla níhi a nya.
4Nyɛɛ lɛɛ pe nyɛ poɔ sane deɔ;
nyɛ tsuo nyɛ ngɛ kaa tsopatsɛmɛ
nɛ a he be se nami.
5I na nɛ nyɛ ma nyɛ nya mohu,
jinɛ a ko tsɛ nyɛ ní leli.
6Nyɛɛ bu ye sane ɔ tue,
konɛ nyɛɛ na bɔ nɛ ma je ye nya ha.
7Mɛni he je nyɛ ngɛ lakpa yee?
Nyɛ susu kaa nyɛ lakpa a he maa ba se nami ha Mawu lo?
8Mawu he lɛ nyɛ ngɛ pɛe ɔ?
Nyɛ maa ye e sane ɔ ha lɛ lo?
9Ke Mawu ke e ma hla nyɛ níhi a mi fitsofitso ɔ,
anɛ e maa hi ha nyɛ lo?
Anɛ nyɛ susu kaa nyɛ maa sisi Mawu
kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ sisiɔ nimli adesahi lo?
10Ke nyɛ hyɛɛ nimli a hɛ mi ngɛ laami mi ɔ,
e ma ka nyɛ hɛ mi kɛ̃.
11E he wami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ maa wo nyɛ he gbeye,
nɛ sawale maa nu nyɛ.
12Abɛhi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ bue ɔ,
a he be se nami ko;
munyuhi nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ ngɛ Mawu he fae ɔ
ngɛ kaa kɔɔhiɔ kɛkɛ.
13Nyɛɛ pee dii nɛ ma tu munyu,
konɛ nɔ́ nɛ maa ba ye nɔ nɛ ba.
14E wɛ ha mi kaa ma ngɔ ye wami kɛ ha
ngɛ enɛ ɔ he.
15Bɔ tsuaa bɔ nɛ pee ɔ,
e maa gbe mi sa;
i be hɛ nɔ kami ko.
Se kɛ̃ ɔ, ma fa ye he ngɛ e hɛ mi.
16Enɛ ɔ nɔuu ma he ye yi wami,
ejakaa yayami peelɔ ko be
nyɛe maa ba Mawu hɛ mi.
17Nyɛɛ bu mi tue saminya,
konɛ nɔ́ nɛ ma de ɔ nɛ sɛ nyɛ tue mi.
18Jehanɛ, i dla ye he konɛ ma jaje ye sane ɔ,
ejakaa i le kaa i yeɔ nguɔ.
19Mɛnɔ lɛ ma ye nya pomi ɔ?
Mo Mawu lo?
Ke ja a,
lɛɛ ma pee dii nɛ ma gbo mohu.
20Ha nɛ ma bi mo nɔ́ enyɔ pɛ, nɛ o ha mi,
kɛkɛ i be ye he laae ngɛ o hɛ mi.
21Kpa ye tue gblami, kɛ ye he gbeye womi.
22Mawu, moo tu munyu kekle, konɛ ma he nɔ;
aloo ke o suɔ ɔ, imi ma de kekle,
konɛ moo o he nɔ.
23Mɛni ji ye he yayami ɔmɛ?
Mɛni tɔmihi nɛ i pee?
Tsɔɔ mi ye yayami ɔmɛ, kɛ ye tɔmi ɔmɛ.
24Mɛni he je o kɛ o hɛ mi laa mi ɔ?
Mɛni he je o kɛ mi ngɛ
ní toe kaa o he nyɛlɔ ɔ?
25O ngɛ hlae nɛ o wo ye he gbeye lo?
Imi lɛɛ i ngɛ kaa ba kɛkɛ;
tsakati gbigbli se lɛ o ngɛ nyɛe ɔ nɛ.
26O po ye nya wawɛɛ nitsɛ;
yayamihi nɛ i pee ye nihe be mi hu
o ngɔ kɛ piɛ he.
27 O ngɔ ye nanehi kɛ wo pã mi.
Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ pee ɔ,
o ngɛ hyɛe;
ye nane nya po o hyɛɛ fitsofitso.
28I pee kaa tso nɛ sa, nɛ hule nɔ si,
aloo bo nɛ wɔyewɔye ye.

Title: HIOB 14
Content:
1Nɔmlɔ adesa wami be ngɛ kpiti kɛkɛ,
se e mi haomi hiɛ babauu.
2Nɔmlɔ waa esɔesɔ, nɛ e gboɔ tlukaa
kaa bɔ nɛ mɔmɔ hu puɛɔ nɛ e nglaa a.
E ngɛ kaa nini; bɔɔ kɛkɛ e laa nɛ a nɛ lɛ hu.
3Anɛ o kɛ imi, nɔ kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ
maa ye sane lo?
4Anɛ nɔmlɔ adesa ko ngɛ nɛ
he tsɔ kɛ pi si lo?
Dɛbi! Nɔ ko be.
5Nɔmlɔ adesa wami se kɛmi,
kɛ hlami abɔ nɛ e maa ye ngɛ je mi ɔ,
a to ngɔ fɔ si momo.
Mo nitsɛ o ma nɔ́ nɛ ɔ nya si momo,
nɛ e be hie tsakemi.
6Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, je o hɛ ngɛ e he
nɛ e na he jɔmi.
Ha nɛ e na bua jɔmi bɔ nɛ e ma nyɛ
ngɛ e si himi nɛ he wa nɛ ɔ mi.
7Ke a po tso ngɔ fɔ si ɔ,
hɛ nɔ kami ngɛ kaa e ma tsɛ̃ ekohu;
ejakaa e hɛngmɛ ɔmɛ lɛɛ a gbo we.
8Ke sipoku ɔmɛ a se kɛ ngɛ zu mi,
nɛ tso ku ɔ sa tete po,
9ke tso ɔ na nyu ɔ, e ma tsɛ̃ ekohu,
nɛ e ma gba kɔni kaa tso nɛ a du ehe.
10Se nɔmlɔ lɛɛ ke e gbo ɔ,
e nyagbe ji lɔ ɔ nɛ.
Ke nɔmlɔ adesa gbo ɔ,
jije o maa na lɛ ngɛ ekohu?
11Kaa bɔ nɛ taku mi nyu taa,
nɛ pa mi nyu miiɔ nɛ e gbliɔ ɔ,
12jã kɛ̃ nɔmlɔ adesa hwɔɔ mahe,
nɛ e ti si hu.
E be si tee hu,
nɛ kɛ yaa si be mi nɛ hiɔwe be hu ɔ,
a be lɛ tsɛ̃ɛ̃e hu kɔkɔɔkɔ.
13I na nɛ o ngɔ mi ya laa ngɛ gbeje
kɛ yaa si o mi mi fumi ɔ se maa po;
nɛ lɔ ɔ se ɔ, o maa to be nɛ a kɛ ma kai mi.
14Ke nɔmlɔ gbo ɔ,
e kpaleɔ kɛ baa ekohu jinɛ
i ko mlɛ kɛ yaa si ye haomi be nɛ ɔ se maa po,
nɛ be kpakpa ma ba na mi.
15Jinɛ o ma tsɛ mi, nɛ ma he nɔ,
nɛ o ma na imi,
nɔmlɔ nɛ o bɔ ɔ,
ye he bua jɔmi.
16Jinɛ o maa hyɛ ye nyɛɛmi,
nɛ o be ye he yayami ɔmɛ a se die.
17O kɛ ye he yayami ɔmɛ maa pa mi,
nɛ o maa ngmɛɛ he kulaa.
Tɔmihi babauu nɛ i pee ɔ,
o maa gbe lɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ.
18Se, kaa bɔ nɛ yohi tete po huleɔ kɛ nɔɔ si,
nɛ tɛ sahi jeɔ a blɔ hehi;
19kaa bɔ nɛ nyu haa tɛ yeɔ,
nɛ pa nɛ hia muɔɔ tabo zu kɛ yaa a,
jã nɛ o haa nɛ nɔmlɔ adesa hɛ nɔ kami peeɔ yaka.
20Ke o fia lɛ nɔ́, kɛkɛ e hɛ mi tsake;
kɛkɛ a wo lɛ blɔ, nɛ e be bae hu gblegbleegble.
21Ke e gbo ɔ, e bimɛ a hɛ mi ba nyami jio,
e bimɛ a hɛ mi pue si jio, e li.
22Lɛ nitsɛ e he lo ɔ kɛkɛ nɛ e nuu he kaa
e ngɛ lɛ yee; nɛ e yeɔ kɔmɔ.

Title: HIOB 15
Content:
Ní sɛɛmi enyɔne
(15.1—21.34)
Elifaz
1-2Ní lelɔ pee we nya puu!
Ní lelɔ ha we sane heto kikɛ nɛ ɔ.
3Ní lelɔ tu we munyu kaa
bɔ nɛ o ngɛ munyu tue ɔ.
Ní lelɔ fa we e he kɛ munyu
nɛ he be se nami.
4E je mo nɔ kake o he jinɛ
nɔ ko nɔ ko be Mawu gbeye yee hu;
jinɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be kue fae ha lɛ hu.
5Nɔ́ nɛ o ngɛ dee ɔ
yeɔ o he yayami ɔmɛ a he odase;
lakpa sɔuu lɛ o ngɛ yee ɔ nɛ.
6Mo nitsɛ o nya mi munyu ngɛ mo fɔ bue;
mo nitsɛ o lilɛ ngɛ odase yee kɛ ngɛ mo sie,
se pi imi.
7Mo ji kekleekle nɔmlɔ nɛ a fɔ lo?
A fɔ mo loko Mawu pee yoku ɔmɛ lo?
8O nu Mawu laami sanehi hyɛ lo?
Mo pɛ ji ní lelɔ lo?
9Mɛni o le nɛ wɔɔ lɛɛ wa li?
Mɛni o kpa si nɛ wɔɔ lɛɛ wa juɛmi sui he?
10Nihi nɛ a yi mi je mua, kɛ nikɔtɔmahi ngɛ wa kpɛti
nɛ a wa kulaa pe o tsɛ.
11Bua jɔmi nɛ Mawu ha mo ɔ,
e pi ha mo lo?
Bɔ nɛ e kɛ mo tuɔ munyu blɛuu ɔ,
lɔ ɔ sɛ́ o hɛ mi lo?
12Mɛni he je o mi mi fu kikɛ nɛ ɔ?
Mɛni he je o hɛ dɔ kikɛ nɛ ɔ?
13Mɛni he je o mi mi fu Mawu,
nɛ o ha nɛ munyuhi kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ je o nya mi?
14 Anɛ nɔmlɔ ko ngɛ nɛ e he tsɔ lo?
Nɔmlɔ nɛ yo fɔ lɛ ɔ,
anɛ dalɔ ji lɛ ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi lo?
15Hyɛ, Mawu bɔfo klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ po
e kɛ e hɛ fɔ we a nɔ;
mɛ nitsɛmɛ tete po a he tsɔ we ngɛ e hɛ mi.
16Nɛ mo, nɔmlɔ adesa
nɛ o sa, nɛ se nami be o he ɔ!
Mo nɛ o peeɔ yayami kaa bɔ nɛ a nuu nyu kumakuma a,
kɛ maa pee kɛɛ nɛ moo o he ma tsɔ ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi?
17Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Hiob, bu tue
nɛ ma sɛɛ mo nɔ́ nɛ i le.
Ha ma tsɔɔ mo nɔ́ nɛ i kase
kɛ je ní leli a ngɔ.
18I kase anɔkuale nɛ ɔ kɛ je ní leli a ngɔ.
Mɛ hu a kase kɛ je a tsɛmɛ a ngɔ;
a laa we nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko nɔ.
19Mɛ pɛ lɛ a ngɔ zugba a ngɔ ha;
nubwɔ ko nubwɔ ko be a kpɛti.
20Yiwutsotsɛ, nɔ nɛ waa nihi yi mi ɔ,
e maa na nɔ́ e wami be ɔ tsuo.
21E tue mi maa hi ngmlɛ fiae kɛ wo e he gbeye.
Be mi nɛ e susu kaa e ngɛ he jɔmi mi ɔ,
ojo fiali ma ba tua lɛ tlukaa.
22Hɛ nɔ kami ko be ha lɛ kaa
e maa tu fo kɛ je diblii ɔ mi;
ejakaa klaate ji nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ lɛ mlɛe nɛ e gbe lɛ,
23nɛ okpokuhi hu ngɛ mlɛe nɛ a ye lɛ.
Nɔmlɔ kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ le kaa
e hɛ mi kpatami be ɔ su ta.
24Fimi kɛ amanehlu woɔ e he gbeye.
E le kaa ní nɛ ɔmɛ maa ba e nɔ tlukaa
kaa matsɛ ngua ko nɛ mia kɛ ha ta.
25Nɔmlɔ nɛ teɔ si kɛ siɔ Ope ɔ,
nɛ hiaa kɔ̃ kɛ woɔ Mawu he ɔ,
nɔ́ nɛ maa ba e nɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
26-27Jamɛ a nɔmlɔ ɔ,
he nɔ wolɔ, kɛ atuã tsɔlɔ ji lɛ;
e kɛ he nɔ womi woɔ e tsɛ̃i nɔ,
nɛ e he sɔɔ nɛ e kɛ Mawu ya hwu ta.
28Jamɛ a nɔmlɔ ɔ ya ngɔ mahi, kɛ wehi
nɛ nɔtsɛmɛ tu fo kɛ je a mi.
Se a de to kaa ta ma kpata
jamɛ a ma amɛ, kɛ we ɔmɛ a hɛ mi.
29E ní nami ɔ se be kɛe;
e nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ hɛ mi ma kpata.
Lɛ nitsɛ e nini tete po maa laa,
30nɛ diblii maa wo lɛ.
E maa pee kaa tso nɛ la sã e kɔnihi,
nɛ kɔɔhiɔ muɔ e mɔmɔ ɔmɛ kɛ ho.
31Ke e ya sisi e he,
nɛ e ngɔ e hɛ ngɔ fɔ níhi nɛ a he be se nami a nɔ ɔ,
e maa je mi dɛ gu.
32Loko e nyagbe ɔ maa su ɔ,
e ma na e hiɔwo sisiisi;
e maa pee kaa tso
nɛ ba mumu be e yi mi.
33E maa pee kaa wai tso
nɛ e yi mi wai yiblii ngmlikiti kplɔ pue si,
aloo oliv tso nɛ e mɔmɔhi kplɔ pue si.
34Nimli nɛ li Mawu ɔ,
a be ngmɛdu woe.
Wehi nɛ a he nyɔ mi ní nɛ a kɛ ma mɛ ɔ,
la maa sã mɛ pue si.
35Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ ji ni nɛmɛ nɛ toɔ ga yaya,
nɛ a peeɔ yayami;
sisimi hyi a tsui mi tɔtɔɔtɔ.

Title: HIOB 16
Content:
Hiob
1-2I nu munyuhi babauu kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ hyɛ;
ye bua nɛ nyɛ ke nyɛ ma womi ɔ,
haomi mohu lɛ nyɛ ba ngɛ mi haoe.
3Nyɛ maa hi yaka munyu nɛ ɔmɛ tue
nɛ nyɛ be kpae lo?
Mɛni hiɔ lɛ nyɛ ngɛ nue
nɛ nyɛ maa hi munyu tue kpamisa kikɛ nɛ ɔ?
4Níhi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ dee nɛ ɔ,
imi hu i ko de ja nɔuu.
I ko mimiɛ ye yi,
nɛ ma ha nyɛ munyu nguahi.
5Jinɛ ma wo nyɛ ga,
nɛ ma tu munyu kɛ wo nyɛ bua.
6Se amlɔ nɛ ɔ, i tu munyu jio,
i ma ye nya jio,
haomi kake too ɔ mi lɛ i ngɛ kpamisa.
7Mawu, jehanɛ lɛɛ o ha nɛ pɔ tɔ mi;
o gbe ye he nihi tsuo ta.
8O ha nɛ ye he womi tsuo hlũɛ, nɛ i ta he lo,
nɛ enɛ ɔmɛ yeɔ odase kɛ siɔ mi.
9Mawu mi mi fu mi, nɛ e tsɔtslɔɔ ye mi.
E kpɔ lungu ngɔ wo mi,
nɛ e muɔ e hɛngmɛ ngɔ pue ye nɔ
kaa a peeɔ nɔ he nyɛlɔ.
10Nihi yeɔ ye he fɛu.
A buaa kɛ woɔ ye he, nɛ a gbaa ye tue mi ma.
Nɛ a bɔɔ mi ahlua.
11Mawu ngɔ mi ngɔ ha nihi nɛ li Mawu;
e ngɔ mi ngɔ wo yiwutsotsɛmɛ a dɛ mi.
12Jinɛ i ngɛ he mi jɔmi,
se Mawu tsɔtslɔɔ ye mi.
Mawu nu ye kuɛ, nɛ e ku mi dukuduku.
E je hɛ pi mi kaa nɔ́ ko
nɛ e kɛ maa kase dɛ nya dami.
13E tsɛ̃ɔ mi kɛ̃ɛ̃ kɛ jeɔ he tsuaa he.
Kɛ̃ɛ̃ mi bi ɔmɛ sɛɛ ye he womi mi, nɛ a plaa mi;
se Mawu nɛ mi mɔbɔ.
14E he sɔɔ kɛ ba tuaa mi nɔtonɔto,
nɛ e plaa mi kaa tatsɛ nɛ hɛ dɔ.
15I kpɛ kpekpe ngɔ ha ye he,
nɛ i hii si ngɛ zugba kɛ
ngɛ kɔmɔ yee.
16I fo ya hluu kɛ ya si ye hɛngmɛ ɔmɛ fuu
nɛ a pee kɔu kaa nɔ́ nɛ nɔ́ ko ha a nɔ.
17Se i yi nɔ ko amimi;
i faa kue haa Mawu kɛ jeɔ ye tsui mi.
18Zugba, yayamihi nɛ a pee mi ɔ, koo ha a nɔ!
Ngmlaa nɛ i ngɛ kpae kaa a ye dami sane ha mi ɔ,
ko ha nɛ ngmlaa a nya nɛ ba si!
19 Amlɔ nɛ ɔ tete po,
ye we odase ngɛ hiɔwe;
nɔ nɛ ma fa ye he ɔ
ngɛ hiɔwe lokoo.
20Ye huɛmɛ ɔmɛ yeɔ ye he fɛu,
se i faa kue haa Mawu kɛ vo nyu.
21I na nɛ nɔ ko ma fa ye he ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi
kaa bɔ nɛ nɔmlɔ adesa faa e nyɛmi he ɔ.
22Jehahi bɔɔ komɛ a se ɔ,
ma hia blɔ kɛ ya he ko
nɛ i be kpalee kɛ ba hu.

Title: HIOB 17
Content:
1Ye wami be ɔ ta; i nyɛ we nɛ i ngɛ mumi woe.
Amlɔ nɛ ɔ lɛɛ nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ mi mlɛe ji yɔkɔ.
2He fɛu yeli bɔle mi kɛ kpe;
niinɛ, i naa mɛ nɛ a hii ye he fɛu yee.
3Mawu, anɔkualetsɛ ji mi;
mo he mi nɛ o ye.
Nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ dee ɔ,
nɔ kpa ko be nɛ ma fi se.
4O ha nɛ nimli adesahi biɛ,
nɛ a susuu we a yi mi;
lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ko ha nɛ a ye ye nɔ.
5Nimeli ke, “Nɔ nɛ tsɔɔ e huɛmɛ a se blɔ,
nɛ e nine suu a weto ní nɔ ɔ,
e bimɛ a hɛngmɛ ma yu.”
6Mwɔnɛ ɔ, i plɛ pee abɛ bumi nɔ́ ha nihi,
nɛ a laa lada kɛ pueɔ ye hɛ mi.
7Aywilɛho sɔuu ha nɛ ye hɛngmɛ nɔ pee kɔu,
nɛ ye kɔnihi, kɛ ye nanehi pee legelege kaa nini.
8Ke dali na nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, a he mi jɔ̃ɔ̃,
nɛ a tuɔ a hɛ mi kɛ woɔ nihi nɛ li Mawu.
9Se bɔ tsuaa bɔ nɛ pee ɔ,
dalɔ hii e blɔ nɔ kɛ̃.
Nɔmlɔ nɛ yayami ko be e he ɔ,
e naa he wami he ekohu.
10Se nyɛɛ lɛɛ, i nɛ ní lelɔ kake ngmelu
ngɛ nyɛ tsuo nyɛ kpɛti.
11Ye ligbi ɔmɛ ta; ye yi mi tomi ɔmɛ puɛ;
ye hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi ɔ ta.
12Se ye huɛmɛ ɔmɛ ngɔɔ nyɔ kɛ peeɔ piani.
La a nɛ a ngɛ dee ɔ hu ngɛ kaa diblii.
13Ye hɛ nɔ kami kɛkɛ ji gbeje;
lejɛ ɔ ji he nɛ ma hwɔ ngɛ diblii mi.
14Ma tsɛ yɔkɔ ɔ ke tsaatsɛ;
gɔgɔhi nɛ maa ye mi ɔ,
ma tsɛ mɛ maa, kɛ ye nyɛmiyihi.
15Jije hɛ nɔ kami pa ngɛ ha mi?
Mɛnɔ lɛ maa na jamɛ a hɛ nɔ kami ɔ?
16Anɛ hɛ nɔ kami kɛ mi maa ya gbeje lo?
Anɛ e kɛ mi maa ya zu mi lo?

Title: HIOB 18
Content:
Bildad
1-2Hiob, mɛni be lɛ o maa hi munyu tue kɛ yaa si?
Ke o pee dii ɔ, waa kɛ mo maa tu munyu.
3Mɛni he je a buɔ wɔ kaa lohwehi ɔ?
Mɛni he je o susuɔ kaa wa be juɛmi ɔ?
4Nɛ o ngɔ abofu kɛ ngɛ mo nitsɛ o he tsɔtslɔɔe ɔ nɛɛ!
Ke o mi mi fu ɔ, enɛ ɔ tsɔɔ kaa
nihi nɛ a je je ɔ mi lo?
Aloo o ngɛ hlae nɛ a hia tɛ sahi
kɛ je a blɔ hehi lo?
5 Ee, yayami peelɔ kane ɔ ma gbo,
nɛ e la a be kpɛe hu gblegbleegble.
6E kane ɔ ma gbo ngɛ e kasa nya,
nɛ e bo tsu ɔ mi maa wo diblii.
7Bɔ nɛ e hiaa nane kam, kam, kam be ko nɛ be ɔ,
amlɔ nɛ ɔ lɛɛ e hii si tɛe;
lɛ nitsɛ e yi mi tomi maa tsɛ̃ lɛ kɛ nɔ si.
8Lɛ nitsɛ e maa ngɔ e nane kɛ ya du ya;
lɛ nitsɛ e maa nyɛɛ kɛ ya nɔ muɔ mi.
9E nane se ja ma ya sɛ klama mi,
nɛ klama a maa nu lɛ.
10A maa tsɔ̃ lɛ klama kɛ laa ngɛ zugba;
a maa tsɔ̃ lɛ klama ngɛ e blɔ mi.
11Gbeye níhi maa bɔle lɛ kɛ kpe,
nɛ daa nɛ ɔ, e maa hi fo nɔ kpla, kpla, kpla!
12Hwɔ maa ye lɛ hluu kɛ yaa si e he wami maa ta.
Amanehlu maa tsɛ̃ lɛ kɛ fɔ si bum!
13Hiɔ yaya maa ha e he womi tsuo nɔ,
nɛ e kɔnihi, kɛ e nanehi maa sa ngɛ e he.
14E bo tsu ɔ nɛ e ngɔ e hɛ ngɔ fɔ nɔ ɔ,
a maa gbla lɛ kɛ je lejɛ ɔ
kɛ ba he ko nɛ ngɛ gbeyegbeye.
15Nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko be piɛe
ngɛ e sihi he ɔ.
La nɛ ngɛ tsoe plamplam maa sã e bo tsu ɔ.
16E sipoku ma gbli ngɛ e sisi,
nɛ e kɔnihi maa ylɔ.
17E biɛ maa laa ngɛ ma a mi, kɛ ma se tsuo,
nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be lɛ kaie hu.
18A maa fie lɛ kɛ je je ɔ mi,
kɛ je la he kɛ ya diblii mi.
19E be bi, loo nina ngɛ e ma mi bi ɔmɛ a kpɛti;
he nɛ e hi be ko ɔ, e nina ko be lejɛ ɔ.
20Kɛ je beleku je kɛ yaa si bonyoku je ɔ;
nihi nɛ maa nu e haomi ɔmɛ a he ɔ,
mɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ a he mi maa po.
21Yayami peelɔ, aloo nɔmlɔ nɛ li Mawu ɔ,
nɔ́ nɛ maa ba e nɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.

Title: HIOB 19
Content:
Hiob
1-2Mɛni be nyɛ maa ngɔ munyuhi
kɛ hao mi kɛ yaa si?
3Kpamisa nɛ ɔ,
jɛmi kɛkɛ nyɛ ngɛ mi jɛe.
Anɛ e pee we nyɛ zo kaa
nyɛ ngɛ mi nisɛ ní pee lo?
4Ke e ngɛ mi tete po kaa i pee yayami ɔ,
mɛni enɛ ɔ kɔɔ ngɛ nyɛ he?
5Nyɛ woɔ nyɛ he nɔ,
nɛ nyɛ susuɔ kaa nyɛ hi pe mi.
Nyɛ deɔ ke ye yayami ɔmɛ
a he hiɔ lɛ a ngɛ mi woe ɔ nɛ.
6Se nyɛ li kaa Mawu lɛ pee nɔ́ nɛ ɔ lo?
Lɛ nɛ tsɔ klama kɛ bɔle mi kɛ kpe.
7Hyɛ, i kpaa ngmlaa nɛ i deɔ ke Mawu ngɛ mi awi yee,
se nɔ ko nɔ ko he we nɔ.
Ngmlaa nɛ i ngɛ kpae ke a ye dami sane ha mi ɔ,
nɔ ko nɔ ko nui.
8Mawu tsi mi blɔ nɛ i nyɛ we ma be;
e ha nɛ diblii wo ngɛ ye blɔ nɔ.
9E je ye hɛ mi nyami ɔ ngɛ ye he,
nɛ e kpɔ ye jlasi ɔ ngɛ ye yi mi.
10E kpata ye hɛ mi,
nɛ e kɛ mi gbe nya pɛsɛpɛsɛ.
I pee kaa tso nɛ a hia lɛ kɛ e sipoku tsuo;
ye hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi ta.
11Mawu mi mi fu mi wawɛɛ nitsɛ,
nɛ e buɔ mi e he nyɛlɔ.
12E ta buli babauu ba tua mi;
a bɔle mi kɛ kpe,
nɛ a sa ye yi kɛ wo ye sihi he ɔ.
13Mawu ha nɛ ye nyɛmimɛ kua mi;
i plɛ pee nubwɔ ngɛ nihi
nɛ i le mɛ ɔ a kpɛti.
14Ye weku li je ye he,
nɛ ye huɛ kpakpahi a hɛ je ye nɔ.
15Nibwɔhi nɛ ngɛ ye we mi ɔ,
a hɛ je ye nɔ;
i plɛ pee nubwɔ, loo ma se no
ngɛ ye mawayihi a hɛ mi.
16Ke i tsɛ ye tsɔlɔ ɔ, e he we nɔ;
ke i kpa lɛ pɛɛ tete po, e bui.
17Ye nya mi mumi jeɔ fu kɛ haa ye yo;
imi nitsɛ ye nyɛ mi mi bimɛ
bɛ ye kasa nya.
18Jokuɛwi tete po hiee mi;
ke a na mi pɛ,
kɛkɛ a bɔni ye he munyu tumi.
19Ye huɛmɛ kpakpahi tsuo ngɛ mi hiee;
ni nɛmɛ nɛ i suɔ mɛ saminya po te si wo mi.
20I ta he lo nɛ i pee kanyakanya;
i kɛ gbenɔ wa kpɛti kɛ we kulaa.
21Nyɛɛ na mi mɔbɔ;
ye huɛmɛ nyɛɛ na mi mɔbɔ,
ejakaa Mawu nine sa ye he.
22Mɛni he je nyɛ ngɛ mi yi mi wae
kaa bɔ nɛ Mawu peeɔ mi ɔ?
Bɔ nɛ nyɛ hao mi ɔ,
e pi ha nyɛ lo?
23Níhi nɛ i ngɛ dee ɔ,
i na nɛ nɔ ko kai
nɛ e ngma kɛ wo womi mi!
24I ná nɛ a kɛ dade kpɛ́ ye munyu
ɔmɛ ngɛ tɛ sa mi,
nɛ a kɛ sumui wo mi,
konɛ a hi lejɛ ɔ daa.
25Ejakaa i le kaa nɔ ko ngɛ hiɔwe
nɛ nyagbenyagbe ɔ,
e ma ba kpɔ mi.
26Ke ye he womi hɛ mi kpata kikɛ nɛ ɔ,
nɛ he lo ko be ye he po,
ma na Mawu.
27Imi nitsɛ na lɛ paa kɛ ye hɛngmɛ.
Imi nitsɛnitsɛ,
se pi nɔ kpa ko.
Ye tsui ta!
28Benɛ nyɛ bi ke,
“Kɛ wa maa pee kɛɛ kɛ wa lɛ yi mi?” ɔ,
nyɛ hla nɔ ko nyɛ da nɔ,
nɛ nyɛ ba tua mi.
29Nyɛ na nɛ nyɛɛ le
kaa tue gblami fɔɔ si ha nyɛ.
A maa gbla nyɛ tue ngɛ nyɛ he yayami ɔmɛ a he,
konɛ nyɛɛ le kaa kojolɔ ko ngɛ.

Title: HIOB 20
Content:
Zofar
1-2Hiob, o ha nɛ ye yi mi pee basaa,
enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, ma ha mo heto nɔuu.
3Jɛmi munyuhi lɛ o tu ɔ nɛ,
se mumi ɔ tsɔɔ mi bɔ nɛ ma ha mo heto ha.
4I heɔ yeɔ kaa o le nɔ́ nɛ ɔ,
kaa kɛ je blema lokoo nɛ a
bɔ nɔmlɔ kɛ wo je ɔ mi ɔ,
5yiwutsotsɛ hɛ mi nyami ɔ,
e se kɛ we;
nɛ nɔmlɔ nɛ li Mawu ɔ,
e bua jɔmi peeɔ kuku kɛkɛ.
6Ke e nɔ kuɔ kɛ ya su hiɔwe,
nɛ e yi ya pi bɔku po,
7e hɛ mi ma kpata
kɛ maa ya neneene
kaa lɛ nitsɛ e fĩ.
Nihi nɛ le lɛ ɔ ma bi ke,
“Jije e ngɛ?”
8E maa laa kaa nlami,
aloo nina nɛ a na nyɔ mi;
nɛ nɔ ko be lɛ nae hu.
9Nɔ ko nɔ ko be lɛ nae hu;
e sihi he ɔ maa fɔ si gu.
10Níhi nɛ e ju ngɛ ohiatsɛmɛ a dɛ ɔ,
e bimɛ maa kpale kɛ ha mɛ ekohu.
11Nɔmlɔ tso kɛ e he nihe nyu tsuaa a
ma plɛ pee zu.
12-13Yayami ngɔɔ e nya.
E ngɛ kaa dɔkɔdɔkɔ nɔ́ ko
nɛ e ngɔ kɛ laa ngɛ e lilɛ kuɔ si.
E hii he gbugbɔe,
nɛ e sume kaa e ma je ngɛ e nya mi.
14Se niye ní nɛ ɔ plɛɔ peeɔ sinɔ duɔ
nɛ nya wa ngɛ e mi mi.
15Ní kpakpahi nɛ yayami peelɔ mi ɔ,
e vieɔ kɛ pueɔ si ekohu.
Mawu nitsɛ jeɔ ní ɔmɛ
kɛ jeɔ e mi mi.
16Nɔ́ nɛ yayami peelɔ gbugbɔ ɔ
ngɛ kaa sinɔ duɔ;
e maa gbe lɛ kaa
nɔ́ nɛ sinɔ duɔtsɛ nɛ kɔ lɛ.
17E be je mi hie nɛ́ e maa na
nyɔ nyu, kɛ hwo nɛ ngɛ bee kaa paa.
18Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ e gbo he dengme
nɛ e na a maa je e dɛ,
nɛ e be e mi ngɔɔmi ko yee.
E be bua jɔmi ko nae kɛ je e ní nɛ e na a mi.
19Ejakaa e wa ohiatsɛmɛ yi mi,
nɛ e kua mɛ;
wehi nɛ nihi ma a,
e kpɔ ngɛ a dɛ pani nya.
20Akɛnɛ e li tɔ biɛ he je ɔ,
nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ e na a,
e yeɔ tsuatsuaatsua.
21Ke e ye ní ɔ,
eko kulaa píɛ ngɛ se.
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ,
ní nami ɔ se maa po.
22Be mi nɛ e na e he ɔ,
jamɛ a be ɔ,
haomi nɛ nya wa maa ba e nɔ tlukaa.
23Mawu ma ha e mi mi la nɛ nya wa a ma kple e nɔ
kaa niye ní nɛ e ye nɛ e tɔ.
24Ke e ka kaa e maa tu fo kɛ je dade nya a,
a ma tsɛ̃ lɛ akɔblee kɛ̃ɛ̃ kɛ fɔ si.
25A maa gbla kɛ̃ɛ̃ mi bi kɛ je e nɔmlɔ tso mi.
Muɔ maa dɛ kɛ je kɛ̃ɛ̃ mi bi ɔ nya piɔpiɔ
nɛ ngɛ kpɛe ɔ he kɛ pue si,
nɛ gbeye maa nu lɛ.
26E juetli tsuo hɛ mi ma kpata.
La, nɛ pi nɔmlɔ nɛ slɛ maa sã lɛ,
nɛ e we mi nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ hɛ mi ma kpata.
27Hiɔwe ma je nyumu nɛ ɔ yayami ɔ kpo,
nɛ zugba maa ye odase kɛ si lɛ.
28Ligbi ɔ nɛ Mawu mi mi ma fu ɔ,
a ma kpata nɔmlɔ nɛ ɔ weto ní tsuo hɛ mi
kaa bɔ nɛ pa muɔɔ níhi kɛ yaa a.
29Enɛ ɔ ji yayami peelɔ blɔ fa mi nɔ́;
gbosi ní nɛ Mawu to
kɛ ha yayami peelɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.

Title: HIOB 21
Content:
Hiob
1-2Nyɛɛ bu nɔ́ nɛ ma de nɛ ɔ tue saminya;
ke nyɛ pee ja a,
e ngɛ kaa nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ ba jɔɔ ye bua.
3Nyɛɛ ngmɛ mi blɔ nɛ imi hu ma tu munyu;
ke i de nɔ́ nɛ ma de ɔ ta a,
nyɛ ma nyɛ maa ye ye he fɛu faa.
4Imi ɔ, tsa pi nɔmlɔ adesa nɛ i kɛ na;
i kɛ Mawu lɛ na.
Mɛni he je e sɛ kaa ye susuma haoɔ mɔ?
5Nyɛɛ hyɛ mi ha! Anɛ bɔ nɛ i ngɛ nɛ ɔ
ha we nɛ nyɛ he mi nɛ po,
nɛ nyɛɛ pee dii lo?
6Nɔ́ nɛ ba ye nɔ nɛ ɔ,
ke i susu he ɔ,
ye he mi poɔ,
nɛ ye nɔmlɔ tso ɔ doɔ blibliibli.
7Mɛni he je yayami peeli a se kɛɔ ngɛ je mi?
Mɛni he je a peeɔ nimli nguahi,
nɛ a bwɔɔ kotokoto loko a gboɔ ɔ?
8A hii je mi kɛ ya siɔ a bimɛ,
kɛ a bibimɛ waa ba naa mɛ.
9Mawu ngɔɛ haomi ko kɛ bɛ a wehi a mi;
nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko wui a he gbeye.
10Niinɛ, a na ku ɔmɛ, kɛ na yi ɔmɛ naa bɔmi pɛpɛɛpɛ,
nɛ na yi ɔmɛ fɔɔ nɛ nɔ́ ko pee we mɛ.
11A bi tsɔwitsɔwihi jeɔ kpo babauu
nɛ a hii hlue kaa to bihi.
12A fiɛɔ do, a fiaa saku,
nɛ a laa kɛ toɔ he;
nɛ a naa bua jɔmi bɔ nɛ sa.
13A yeɔ a be ɔ ngɛ kplɔkɔtɔ mi,
nɛ a gboɔ ngɛ tue mi jɔmi mi.
14Yayami peeli deɔ Mawu ke e je a nɔ,
ejakaa a hla we e blɔ ɔmɛ nɛ a le.
15A biɔ ke,
“Mɛnɔ ji Ope ɔ
nɛ saa kaa wa sɔmɔɔ lɛ ɔ?
Ke wa fa kue ha lɛ ɔ,
mɛni se wa ma na?”
16A deɔ ke,
“Tsa pi nɔ ko nɛ wo wɔ ní;
wɔ nitsɛmɛ lɛ wa tsu nɛ wa na.”
Se a susumi nɛ ɔ,
imi i ngɔɛ.
17Anɛ yayami peelɔ ko kane gbo hyɛ lo?
Anɛ haomi ba a ti nɔ ko nɔ hyɛ lo?
Anɛ Mawu kɛ abofu gbla yayami peelɔ ko tue hyɛ lo?
18Anɛ Mawu muɔ yayami peeli kɛ ho hyɛ
kaa bɔ nɛ kɔɔhiɔ muɔɔ bunyuku,
aloo bɔ nɛ ahumi muɔɔ tsakati kɛ yaa a lo?
19Nyɛ deɔ ke Mawu gblaa bimɛ a tue
ngɛ a tsɛmɛ a he yayamihi a he.
Dɛbi! Ha nɛ Mawu ɔ nɛ gbla yayami peeli ɔmɛ
nitsɛmɛ a tue,
konɛ a na kaa a he yayami
ɔmɛ a he lɛ a ngɛ a tue gblae ɔ nɛ.
20Ha nɛ yayami peeli ɔmɛ nitsɛmɛ
nɛ a ná a tue gblami ɔ.
Ha nɛ Mawu Ope ɔ we abofu ɔ
nɛ kple mɛ nitsɛmɛ a nɔ.
21Ke nɔ ko gbo ɔ,
anɛ e pa susuɔ
bimɛ nɛ e si ngɛ se ɔ a he lo?
22Mawu nɛ tsɔɔ nimli nguahi po nile ɔ,
anɛ nɔ ko ma nyɛ maa kojo lɛ lo?
23-24Ni komɛ hii nɔmlɔ tso he wami
hluu kɛ ya siɔ a gbenɔ be.
A plɔkeɔ nɛ a peeɔ tɔfutɔfu,
nɛ a gboɔ kɛ bua jɔmi ngɛ tue mi jɔmi mi.
25Ni komɛ hu gboɔ kɛ aywilɛho
nɛ a na we bua jɔmi ko hyɛ.
26Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo gboɔ,
nɛ a puɔ mɛ ngɛ zu mi,
nɛ gɔgɔ ba haa mɛ tsuo a nɔ.
27Hyɛ, i le nyɛ juɛmi ɔmɛ!
Ga nɛ nyɛ to nɛ nyɛɛ
