kɛ maa wa mi yi mi ɔ, i le.
28Nyɛ biɔ ke,
“Jehanɛ lɛɛ jije ganɔ ɔ we ɔ ngɛ?
Jije yiwutsotsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a sihi he ɔmɛ ngɛ?”
29Anɛ nyɛɛ kɛ blɔ hiali sɛɛ we ní lo?
Níhi nɛ a ba deɔ nyɛ ɔ,
nyɛ ngɔɛ lo?
30Anɛ nyɛ li kaa ke
amanehlu ba a, yiwutsotsɛmɛ
lɛɛ a jeɔ mɛ kɛ jeɔ mi,
nɛ a yeɔ a he lo?
31Mɛnɔ lɛ ma ka yiwutsotsɛ hɛ mi?
Níhi nɛ e peeɔ ɔ,
mɛnɔ lɛ maa pee lɛ kɛ to nane mi?
32Benɛ a hɛɛ lɛ kɛ yaa gɔ ɔ mi ɔ,
jamɛ a be ɔ, nihi daa si
nɛ a ngɛ e yɔkɔ ɔ he bue.
33Nimli babauu nyɛɛɔ e hɛ mi,
nɛ babauu hu nyɛɛɔ e se;
tabo zu ɔ po peeɔ huyɛhuyɛ ngɛ e nɔ.
34Nɛ nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛɛ
kɛ munyu gu ba ngɛ ye bua jɔɔe!
Hetohi nɛ nyɛ ha mi ɔ, lakpa sɔuu;
anɔkuale kake ngmelu be mi.

Title: HIOB 22
Content:
Ní sɛɛmi etɛne
(22.1—27.23)
Elifaz
1-2 Anɛ nɔmlɔ adesa ko he ngɛ se nami ha Mawu lo?
Ní lelɔ ɔ,
lɛ nitsɛ e nile ɔ he se lɛ e naa.
3Ke o peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a,
anɛ Ope ɔ naa bua jɔmi ko ngɛ lɔ ɔ he lo?
Ke sé ko be o he ɔ,
anɛ Mawu naa nɔ́ ko ngɛ mi lo?
4O susu kaa Mawu gbeye nɛ o yeɔ ɔ,
lɔ ɔ he lɛ e ngɛ o hɛ mi kae,
nɛ e ngɛ o tue gblae ɔ lo?
5Dɛbi, a ngɛ o tue gblae,
ejakaa o he yayami ɔmɛ hiɛ tsɔ;
o he yayami ɔ, a li nya.
6Ke o nyɛmi hɛɛ mo hiɔ
nɛ e nyɛ we nɛ e wo mo ɔ,
o kpaa bo ngɛ e he,
nɛ o haa nɛ e hɛɛɔ e he gu.
7Nihi nɛ pɔ tɔ mɛ ɔ,
o ha we mɛ nyu nɛ a nu;
ni nɛmɛ nɛ hwɔ ngɛ mɛ yee ɔ,
o ha we mɛ ní nɛ a ye.
8Pohu o ngɔ o he wami,
kɛ bu nɛ a buu mo ɔ
kɛ kpɔ zugba a tsuo.
9O fieɔ yalɔyihi kɛ jeɔ o ngɔ
kɛ a dɛ mi gu,
nɛ awusahi hu o waa mɛ yi mi.
10Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ,
a tsɔ mo klama kɛ bɔle si,
nɛ amlɔ nɛ ɔ,
sawale nu mo.
11Diblii kpii wo mo,
nɛ o hyɛ we nɔ́ hu;
nyu kpekpemi bɔle mo kɛ kpe.
12Niinɛ, Mawu ngɛ hiɔwe lokoo!
Se dodoehi nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe lokoo ɔ,
anɛ Mawu lɛɛ e hyɛ we mɛ
kaa nɔ́ nɛ zugba lɛ a ngɛ lo?
13Se kɛ̃ ɔ, o biɔ ke,
“Mawu ɔ, mɛni e le?
Nɔ nɛ bɔku kpii ha e hɛ mi ɔ,
kɛ e maa pee
kɛ kojo wɔ kɛɛ?”
14O susuɔ kaa ke Mawu ngɛ nyɛɛe
ngɛ je ɔ, kɛ hiɔwe a kpe he ɔ,
e hyɛ we nɔ́ ngɛ bɔku kpii ɔ mi lo?
15Blɔ nɛ yiwutsotsɛmɛ nyɛɛɔ nɔ ɔ,
o maa nyɛɛ jamɛ a blɔ ɔ nɔ kɛ mwɔɔ lo?
16Loko jamɛatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a be maa su ɔ,
pa nɛ hia kɛ bee ba sa mɛ
kɛ a sipoku tsuo kɛ ho momo.
17Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ ji nihi nɛ kua Mawu,
nɛ a biɔ a he ke,
“Mɛni Ope ɔ ma nyɛ maa pee wɔ?”
18Se Mawu ɔ nɔuu lɛ haa
a wehi hyi ɔ kɛ ní kpakpahi.
Anɔkuale mi ɔ,
yiwutsotsɛmɛ a yi mi tomi ɔ,
imi lɛɛ i sume saasaa!
19Ke a ngɛ yiwutsotsɛmɛ a tue gblae ɔ,
nimli kpakpahi a bua jɔɔ,
nɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ pee we yayami ko ɔ yeɔ a he fɛu.
20Yiwutsotsɛmɛ a níhi
tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ a hɛ mi kpataa,
nɛ nɔ́ nɛ piɛ ɔ, la ba sãã.
21Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Hiob,
yaa nɛ o kɛ Mawu ya pee kake
nɛ o na tue mi jɔmi.
Blɔ nɔ nɛ o maa gu
nɛ e maa hi ha mo ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
22Moo kplɛɛ nɛ Mawu nɛ tsɔɔ mo ní,
nɛ o ngɔ e munyu ɔmɛ kɛ to o tsui mi.
23Ee, ba o he si nɛ o kpale
kɛ ya Mawu ngɔ.
Yayamihi tsuo nɛ a peeɔ
ngɛ o we ɔ mi ɔ, a kpa peemi.
24Mo sake o sika tsu ngɔ fɔ he;
o sika tsu kpakpa a,
hɛɛ ngɔ pue pa mi,
ngɛ tɛhi a kpɛ.
25Ha nɛ Mawu Ope ɔ nɛ pee o sika tsu;
ha nɛ e pee o sika hiɔ kpakpa.
26Ngɔɔ o hɛ kɛ fɔ Mawu Ope ɔ nɔ daa,
nɛ o maa na kaa e ma ha mo bua jɔmi.
27Ke o fa kue ha lɛ ɔ,
e ma he nɔ,
nɛ o maa ye o siwo ɔ nɔ.
28Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ o to o yi mi ke o maa pee ɔ,
e maa ba mi ja pɛpɛɛpɛ ha mo,
nɛ la ma kpɛ ngɛ o blɔ mi.
29Nɔ nɛ woɔ e he nɔ ɔ,
Mawu baa lɛ si,
se nɔ nɛ baa e he si ɔ,
Mawu heɔ e yi wami.
30Nihi nɛ pee we yayami ko ɔ,
Mawu heɔ a yi wami.
Mo hu ke o he tsɔ ɔ,
Mawu ma he o yi wami ja nɔuu.

Title: HIOB 23
Content:
Hiob
1-2Mwɔnɛ ɔ hu i kɛ Mawu na ekohu;
i ngɛ kɛmɛe,
se e ngɛ ye tue gblae kɛ mwɔɔ.
3I na nɛ i le he nɛ ma na lɛ ngɛ;
i na nɛ i le bɔ nɛ ma pee kɛ ya lejɛ ɔ.
4Jinɛ ma ngɔ ye sane ɔ kɛ ya fɔ e hɛ mi,
nɛ ma je ye nya bɔ nɛ ma nyɛ.
5Ma suɔ nɛ ma le nɔ́ nɛ e ma de,
kɛ bɔ nɛ e ma ha mi heto ha.
6Anɛ Mawu kɛ mi maa to ní
ngɛ e he wami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ nya lo?
Dɛbi, e maa bu mi tue kɛ̃.
7Anɔkualetsɛ ji mi;
i kɛ Mawu ma hla níhi a nya;
nyagbe ɔ, e maa wo mi nguɔ kɛ̃.
8I hla Mawu ngɛ beleku je,
se e be lejɛ ɔ;
i ba bonyoku je hu, i nɛ lɛ.
9I hla lɛ ngɛ omleyi je, se i nɛ lɛ;
i kpale kɛ ba leneyi je hu,
i nɛ lɛ ja nɔuu.
10Se Mawu le blɔ nɛ i nyɛɛɔ nɔ ɔ;
ke e ka mi ɔ,
e maa na kaa ye he tsɔ kaa sika tsu.
11Mawu blɔ ɔ,
lɔ ɔ nɔ i nyɛɛɔ daa nɛ;
i gba we kɛ yɛ muɔ nɔ,
loo hiɔ nɔ.
12Nɔ́ nɛ Mawu fa mi ke ma pee ɔ,
lɔ ɔ i peeɔ.
I pee we imi nitsɛ ye suɔmi nya ní;
Mawu suɔmi nya ní lɛ i peeɔ.
13Mawu ɔ,
bɔ nɛ e ngɛ ɔ, jã kɛ̃ e ngɛ; e tsakee we.
Nɔ́ nɛ e suɔ ɔ,
lɔ ɔ e peeɔ.
Mɛnɔ ma nyɛ ma tsake e yi mi tomi?
14Nɔ́ nɛ e to ha mi ɔ,
lɔ ɔ e ngɛ pee ɔ nɛ;
níhi kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ babauu hu ngɛ e yi mi.
15Ke i susu ní nɛ ɔmɛ a he ɔ,
i yeɔ Mawu gbeye,
nɛ ye he doɔ blibliibli ngɛ e hɛ mi.
16Mawu ha nɛ ye nine mi jɔ̃;
Ope ɔ wo ye he gbeye.
17Ejakaa diblii bɔle mi kɛ kpe;
diblii kpii ha ye hɛ mi.

Title: HIOB 24
Content:
1Mɛni he je lɛ Ope ɔ to we be
nɛ a kɛ maa kojo nihi?
Mɛni he je lɛ e ngɔ be ɔ kɛ laa
nihi nɛ sɔmɔɔ lɛ po?
2Nihi hiaa ni komɛ a bunahi kɛ yaa se,
konɛ mɛɛ a zugba a nɛ e kle.
A juɔ nihi a tohi nɛ a lɛɛ.
3A kpɔɔ awusahi a tejihi ngɛ a dɛ,
nɛ yalɔyihi lɛɛ a ngɔɔ a na amɛ kɛ toɔ awaba.
4A fieɔ ohiatsɛmɛ kɛ jeɔ a blɔ nɔ,
nɛ ohiatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ya buaa
a he nya nɛ a laa a he.
5Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ,
ohiatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ya hlaa niye ní
ngɛ nga kplanaa a nɔ kɛ haa a bimɛ,
kaa bɔ nɛ nga mi tejihi ya nuɔ lohwe
ngɛ pu mi ba haa a bimɛ ɔ.
6Ke nihi kpa ní ta a, ohiatsɛmɛ
ya kukuɔɔ bibliwi ngɛ wai ngmɔ ɔmɛ a nɔ.
A ya kukuɔɔ wai yiblii
ngɛ yiwutsotsɛmɛ po a wai ngmɔhi a nɔ.
7Nyɔ ɔ mi tsuo a hwɔɔ si kɛ a he gu
nɛ bo be a he;
fĩɛ be hu nɔ́ ko be nɛ a kɛ maa ha a he.
8Hiɔmi nɛɛ mɛ ngɛ yo ɔmɛ a nɔ,
nɛ a pɔɔ kpanyaa.
Akɛnɛ a be hi he ko he je ɔ,
a hɔɔ tɛ sahi a kpɛ.
9Nimli yayami komɛ kpɔɔ bimwɔwi nɛ be tsɛmɛ
pani nya ngɛ a nyɛmɛ a nyɔ nya.
A kɛ bimwɔwi nɛ ɔmɛ toɔ a tsɛmɛ ɔmɛ
a hiɔhi a nya.
10Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ haa
nɛ ohiatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ hɛɛɔ a he gu
nɛ bo be a he;
a haa nɛ a kɛ mi mi hwɔ
tsuɔ ní ngɛ ngmɔ nɔ.
11A naa nu kɛ jeɔ oliv tso mi,
nɛ a ngaa wai kɛ jeɔ wai yiblii mi.
Se mɛ nitsɛmɛ lɛɛ kuma yeɔ mɛ.
12O maa nu nɛ nihi ngɛ kɛmɛe ngɛ ma a mi;
o maa nu nɛ nihi nɛ plaa a ngɛ ngmlaa kpae,
nɛ a ngɛ yemi kɛ buami hlae.
Se Mawu bui mɛ tue fɛɛ.
13Nimli yayamihi ji ni nɛmɛ nɛ kua la a nɛ;
a nui la a sisi,
nɛ he nɛ la a ngɛ kpɛe ngɛ hu,
a be lejɛ ɔ.
14Awi yelɔ teɔ si mɔtu kpla
konɛ e gbe ohiatsɛ,
aloo nɔ nɛ be nɔ́ ko.
Nyɔ mi kɛkɛ e pee e he julɔ.
15Gba puɛlɔ hu hii mlɛe konɛ du nɛ bu.
E deɔ e he ke, “Nɔ ko be mi nae,”
kɛkɛ e ngɔ nɔ́ kɛ ha e hɛ mi.
16Ke diblii wo ɔ,
juli ya sɛɛ nihi a wehi a mi ya juɔ.
Piani lɛɛ a laa a he,
nɛ a sume nɛ a baa la hɛ mi.
17Ejakaa a yeɔ piani la a gbeye;
diblii kpii ɔ mohu wui a he gbeye.
Zofar
18Yiwutsotsɛ ɔ,
pa nɛ hia ba ngɔɔ lɛ kɛ yaa.
A gbiɛ e weto ní
nɛ ji e zugba a,
nɛ e be ní tsue ngɛ e wai ngmɔ ɔ mi hu.
19Gbeje ngɔɔ yayami peelɔ kɛ yaa
kaa bɔ nɛ sapu kɛ latsa miiɔ nyu ɔ.
20E nyɛ po hɛ maa je e nɔ.
Gɔgɔ maa ye lɛ,
nɛ e hɛ mi ma kpata
kaa tso nɛ ku pue si.
Nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be lɛ kaie hu.
21Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ maa ba e nɔ,
ejakaa e wa yosahi yi mi;
yalɔyihi hu e nɛ́ mɛ mɔbɔ.
22Se kɛ̃ ɔ,
Mawu kɛ e he wami haa nɛ
nɔmlɔ nɛ he wa a yaa nɔ.
E tee si be mi
nɛ e hɛ be wami ko nɔ hu.
23Mawu ma ha nɛ e maa hi si
ngɛ tue mi jɔmi mi,
se daa nɛ ɔ, e hɛngmɛ ngɛ e he.
24Yayami peelɔ yaa nɔ nɛ e plɔkeɔ;
se be bɔɔ se ɔ, e be hu.
E hɛ mi kpataa kaa bɔ nɛ
nimlihi tsuo a hɛ mi kpataa a,
nɛ e peeɔ kaa blɛfo tso nɛ a po.
25Ke ní nɛ ɔmɛ be mi ɔ,
mɛnɔ ma nyɛ maa tsɔɔ kaa
i ngɛ lakpa yee?
Anɛ nɔ ko ma nyɛ maa tsɔɔ kaa
munyu gu lɛ i ngɛ tue ɔ lo?

Title: HIOB 25
Content:
Bildad
1-2Mawu kle, nɛ e he ngɛ gbeye.
E hiɔwe ma a lɛɛ
tue mi jɔmi sɔuu ji lejɛ ɔ.
3Bɔfohi nɛ sɔmɔɔ Mawu ɔ,
nɔ ko ma nyɛ maa kane mɛ lo?
E la a nɛ́,
ni komɛ ngɛ nɛ e tsui ha mɛ lo?
4Lɛɛ kɛ a maa pee kɛ bu nɔmlɔ dalɔ
ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi kɛɛ?
Nɔmlɔ nɛ yo fɔ lɛ ɔ,
kɛ e maa pee kɛɛ nɛ e he ma tsɔ?
5Nyɔhiɔ tete kpɛ we ha Mawu,
nɛ dodoehi po a hɛ mi tsɔ we ha lɛ.
6Nɔmlɔ nɛ ngɛ kaa aklɔku,
aloo gɔgɔ ɔ,
kɛ lɛɛ e maa pee
kɛ sa Mawu hɛ mi kɛɛ?

Title: HIOB 26
Content:
Hiob
1-2Balɔ kpakpa!
Mo lɛ o piɛ ye he.
Imi nɛ i gbɔjɔ!
Imi nɛ ye he wami ta!
3Imi kuasia
nɛ i li nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko ɔ,
o wo mi ga,
nɛ o tu nile munyu kpakpahi
kɛ tsɔɔ mi!
4Mɛnɔ lɛ piɛ o he nɛ o
kɛ tu munyu nɛ ɔmɛ?
Mɛnɔ mumi lɛ je o mi ɔ?
Bildad
5Kpade ɔmɛ a he mi ngɛ mɛ hiae
ngɛ zu mi ngɛ nyu ɔ sisi.
6Gbeje fɔɔ si paa ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi.
He hami nɔ́ be he
nɛ maa tsi lɛ blɔ.
7Mawu gbla omleyi je hiɔwe ɔ mi,
nɛ e ngɔ je ɔ ngɔ kpla si
nɛ nɔ́ ko hɛɛ we lɛ.
8Mawu lɛ e kɛ nyu woɔ bɔku kpii ɔmɛ a mi;
lɛ nɛ e fii bɔku ɔmɛ a nya,
nɛ e ha we nɛ a pɛ́.
9Mawu lɛ e ngɔɔ nyɔhiɔ
kɛ laa ngɛ bɔku ɔmɛ a se.
10E po huzu ngɛ wo hɛ mi
kɛ gba piani kɛ nyɔ a kpɛti.
11Ke e kuɛ́ ɔ,
titimahi nɛ hɛɛ hiɔwe ɔ hosoɔ,
nɛ a he wami taa.
12E kɛ e he wami jɔɔ wo ɔ he,
nɛ e kɛ juɛmi kpata
wo mi lohwe ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ Rahab ɔ hɛ mi.
13E mumi ɔ lɛ ha nɛ hiɔwe tsɔ,
nɛ e pee saminyayoo.
E nine lɛ e kɛ tsɔtslɔɔ
wo mi lohwe ngua a mi.
14Mawu blɔ ɔmɛ a he níhi bɔɔ kɛkɛ
nɛ́ wa nu kɛ wa tue ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ.
E he wami kpetekpleenyɛ nitsɛnitsɛ ɔ lɛɛ
mɛnɔ ma nyɛ maa le?

Title: HIOB 27
Content:
Hiob
1-2I na Mawu Ope nɛ hɛ ngɛ ɔ,
nɔ nɛ kua dami sane yemi ha mi,
nɛ e ha nɛ i na amanehlu kikɛ nɛ ɔ,
3kaa be abɔ nɛ i ngɛ wami mi,
nɛ Mawu mumi ngɛ ye mi nɛ ɔ,
4lakpa munyu be ye nya mi jee gblegbleegble;
i kɛ ye lilɛ hu be nɔ ko sisie kɔkɔɔkɔ.
5I be kplɛɛe kɔkɔɔkɔ kaa nɔ́
nɛ nyɛ ngɛ dee ɔ ngɛ mi;
kɛ yaa si ye gbenɔ ligbi ɔ,
nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ dee kɛkɛ ji i yi fɔ.
6Nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ dee ke
i pee we nɔ́ ko nɛ dɛ blɔ ɔ,
jamɛ a munyu kake too ɔ i ngɛ tue;
ye he nile bui mi fɔ ligbi ko ligbi ko.
7Ye he nyɛlɔ ɔ,
á gbla e tue kaa yiwutsotsɛ;
nɔ nɛ teɔ si kɛ woɔ mi ɔ,
á gbla e tue kaa yayami peelɔ.
8Ke yayami peelɔ be su,
nɛ Mawu ba ngɔ lɛ ɔ,
mɛni hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi pa ngɛ ha lɛ?
9Ke haomi ba e nɔ, nɛ e fa kue ha Mawu ɔ,
anɛ Mawu maa nu e kue fami ɔ lo?
10Anɛ e náá Ope ɔ he bua jɔmi lo?
Anɛ e faa kue kɛ haa lɛ daa lo?
11Nyɛ ha nɛ ma tsɔɔ nyɛ bɔ nɛ Mawu kle ha;
nɔ́ nɛ Mawu Ope ɔ to ke e maa pee ɔ,
i be nyɛ ba laae ngɛ he.
12Se tse nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ na
ní nɛ ɔmɛ momo kɛ nyɛ hɛngmɛ.
Lɛɛ mɛni he je lɛ nyɛ tsuo nyɛ ngɛ
munyuhi nɛ a he be se nami tue kikɛ nɛ ɔ mɔ?
Zofar
13Bɔ nɛ Mawu gblaa yayami peelɔ tue ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Hiɔwo nɛ yiwutsotsɛ naa
kɛ jeɔ Ope ɔ dɛ mi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
14E ma fɔ bimɛ babauu,
se mɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ a ma gbo ngɛ ta mi;
e bimɛ na we niye ní
nɛ suu a nya gblegbleegble.
15Nihi nɛ a he maa je mi ɔ,
gbenɔ hiɔ maa gbe mɛ,
nɛ a yalɔyi ɔmɛ be ya nyɛe ha mɛ.
16Yayami peelɔ ma bua sika hiɔ babauu nya kaa bunyuku
nɛ be hie kanemi;
e ma bua he hami níhi babauu nya
kaa tabo zu.
17Se nɔmlɔ kpakpa ko lɛ ma ba ha bo ɔmɛ;
nɔ kpakpa ko lɛ ma ba wo tade ɔmɛ,
nɛ e maa ngɔ sika hiɔ ɔ.
18Yayami peelɔ we nɛ e po ɔ
ngɛ kaa anani ya,
aloo tsu wayoo nɛ bulɔ pee.
19E ma ya hwɔ si kaa niatsɛ;
se ke e te si ɔ,
e maa na kaa e sika a tsuo ta.
20Sawale maa nu lɛ kaa pa nɛ hia kɛ bee.
Kɔɔhiɔ nɛ nya wa maa fia lɛ kɛ ho nyɔ mi.
21Beleku kɔɔhiɔ maa fia lɛ kɛ ho;
e maa bɛɛ lɛ kɛ je he nɛ e hii ɔ.
22Mawu ma ha nɛ beleku kɔɔhiɔ maa fia lɛ wawɛɛ nitsɛ;
nɛ e be lɛ mɔbɔ nae kulaa,
be mi nɛ e ngɛ mɔde bɔe kaa e maa tu fo kɛ je nya.
23Kɔɔhiɔ nɛ nya wa nɛ ɔ ma kpa fiifii
kɛ nyɛɛ e se kɛ fo
kɛ wo e he gbeye.
E maa pee lɛ kaa nihi lɛ a ngɛ a dɛ fiae
kɛ ngɛ lɛ fiee kɛ je he nɛ e hii ɔ.

Title: HIOB 28
Content:
Nile yi jemi la
1Niinɛ, muɔhi ngɛ nɛ a tsuaa sika hiɔ ngɛ a mi.
Sika tsu he tsumi hehi hu ngɛ.
2A tsuaa dade ngɛ zu mi,
nɛ a sileɔ tɛ, nɛ a jeɔ akɔblee kɛ jeɔ mi.
3Nihi suɔ kane ngɛ diblii mi,
nɛ a kɛ hlaa tɛ kpakpahi
ngɛ zugba a sisi hehi nɛ wo diblii kpii,
kɛ hehi nɛ ngɛ gbeye.
4Kɔ̃ mi hehi nɛ nimli be,
hehi nɛ blɔ hiali nyɛɛ we ɔ,
lejɛ ɔ sika tsuali ya tsuaa muɔ ngɛ.
O maa na mɛ nɛ a kplaa si ngɛ kpahi a he,
nɛ a ngɛ asɛkɛ wue kɛ ngɛ yae kɛ ngɛ bae.
5Niye ní jeɔ zu mi,
se zu ɔ sisi lɛɛ e pee kaa nɔ́ nɛ la sã.
6Tɛhi nɛ ngɛ zu ɔ mi ɔ,
safiro ngɛ mi.
Bibliwi ɔmɛ hu, sika tsu sɔuu.
7Blɔ nɛ yaa sika muɔ ɔmɛ a mi ɔ,
kayo ko hɛngmɛ nɛ hyɛ;
okpoku ko hu ti kɛ ya bi ngɛ lejɛ ɔ hyɛ.
8Jata, loo lohwe awi yelɔ ko
bi ngɛ jamɛ a blɔ ɔ nɔ.
9Nimli adesahi tsuaa tɛ sahi nɛ a he wa,
a hiaa yokuhi kɛ jeɔ a hi hehi.
10Ke a ngɛ tɛ sa amɛ a mi kpɛe ɔ,
a naa tɛhi nɛ a he jua wa.
11A tsuaa pa mi kɛ yaa pa a je he tɔɔ,
nɛ níhi nɛ a kɛ laa ngɛ lejɛ ɔ,
a ngɔɔ kɛ baa la hɛ mi.
12Se nile lɛɛ jije a maa na lɛ ngɛ?
Juɛmi ɔ, jije e hii?
13A nɛ nile ngɛ nimli a kpɛti.
Nɔ ko nɔ ko li bɔ nɛ e he jua wa ha.
14Muɔ voovoo ɔmɛ ke nile be a ngɔ;
wo hu ja nɔuu lɛ e ngɛ dee.
15Nile ɔ,
a ngɔɛ sika tsu, loo sika hiɔ kɛ he we.
16E he jua a,
sika tsu, loo juetli kpakpa po sui nya.
17E he jua wa pe sika tsu,
e he jua wa pe sika tsu kplu,
aloo ahuhuɛ kpakpa.
18Nile he jua wa pe huazi, loo kɔli,
loo adiagba.
19Etiopia topasion tɛ,
aloo sika tsu ngmingmiingmi kɛ nile sɔɛ.
20Lɛɛ jije a naa nile ngɛ mɔ?
Jije ji juɛmi hi he?
21A ngɔ kɛ laa nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ hɛ ngɛ.
Lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ ngɛ hiɔwe po,
a li he nɛ nile ngɛ.
22Gbenɔ kɛ hɛ mi kpatami po de ke,
“Oo, e biɛ kɛkɛ lɛ wa nu kɛ wa tue.”
23He nɛ nile ngɛ,
kɛ blɔ nɛ a maa gu kɛ ya na lɛ ɔ,
Mawu pɛ lɛ le.
24Ejakaa lɛɛ e hɛngmɛ hyɛɛ nɔ́
kɛ yaa je mi nyagbe he ɔmɛ tɔɔ;
e naa níhi tsuo nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe sisi.
25Benɛ Mawu susu kɔɔhiɔ jiimi,
kɛ he nɛ wo ɔ yi ma bli kɛ ya su ɔ,
26benɛ Mawu to he nɛ hiɔmi maa nɛ ngɛ,
kɛ he nɛ hiɔwe ma si kɛ ya be ngɛ ɔ,
27jamɛ a be ɔ mi nɛ e na nile, nɛ e wo nɔ ta.
E hla mi fitsofitso, nɛ e to lɛ sisi.
28 Mawu de nɔmlɔ ke,
“Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ gbeye yemi ɔ, lɔ ɔ ji nile;
yayami he jemi ɔ, lɔ ɔ ji juɛmi.”

Title: HIOB 29
Content:
Hiob je e nya nyagbe nɔ́
1Hiob tsa e munyu ɔ nɔ nɛ e de ke,
2I na nɛ i ngɛ kaa bɔ nɛ i ngɛ sa a
nɛ Mawu buɔ ye he ɔ.
3Jamɛ a be ɔ, Mawu kɛ mi ngɛ saminya,
nɛ ke i ngɛ diblii mi nyɛɛe ɔ, e haa mi la.
4Jamɛ a be ɔ, ye he hi,
nɛ Mawu kɛ mi ngɛ kaa nɔ kɛ e huɛ.
5Jamɛ a be ɔ, Ope ɔ kɛ mi ngɛ,
nɛ ye bimɛ bɔle mi kɛ kpe.
6Jamɛ a be ɔ,
ye na amɛ, kɛ to ɔmɛ haa mi nyɔ nyu babauu;
nɛ hehi nɛ tɛ sa hiɛ ngɛ po,
i naa oliv tsohi babauu nɛ haa mi nu bɔ nɛ sa.
7Be tsuaa be nɛ ma nimeli ma bua a he nya
ngɛ ma agbo ɔ nya, nɛ ma ho ya hi
ye blɔ he ngɛ lejɛ ɔ,
8ke nihewi na mi pɛ kɛkɛ a gba ha mi;
nikɔtɔmahi maa te nɛ a maa da si ha mi.
9Ganɔ ɔmɛ maa jɔɔ munyu tumi,
nɛ a kɛ a nine maa wo a nya mi.
10Odehehi tete a lilɛ maa mɛtɛ a nya mi,
nɛ a maa pee dii.
11Ke nihi nu ye he ɔ,
a jeɔ ye yi,
nɛ ke a na mi ɔ,
a tuɔ ye he munyu kpakpa.
12Ejakaa ke ohiatsɛmɛ kpa ngmlaa
kɛ tsɛ balɔ ɔ, i jeɔ mɛ;
awusahi hu i piɛɔ a he ja nɔuu.
13I je nihi kɛ je haomi mi,
nɛ a gbaa mi;
nɛ i ha nɛ yalɔyihi na bua jɔmi.
14Be tsuaa be ɔ, i yeɔ dami sane,
nɛ i peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da.
15I plɛ pee hɛngmɛ ha hɛ yuyuili,
kɛ nane ha glɔtsɛmɛ.
16I pee kaa tsɛ kɛ ha dɛgutsɛmɛ,
nɛ nihi nɛ i li mɛ po,
i ye a sane ha mɛ.
17I ku yiwutsotsɛmɛ a tsitsa,
nɛ i kpɔ nihi nɛ a ngɛ yi mi wae ɔ
kɛ je a nya mi.
18I hyɛ blɔ kaa ye wami ligbi ɔmɛ
maa hiɛ babauu kaa zia,
nɛ ma gbo ngɛ we,
ngɛ he jɔmi mi.
19I ngɛ kaa tso nɛ sipoku naa nyu be tsuaa be,
nɛ bɔ́ pɔɔ e kɔnihi a he daa.
20Nihi tuɔ ye he munyu kpakpa daa,
nɛ be tsuaa be ɔ,
i naa he wami he.
21Ke i ngɛ nihi ga woe ɔ,
a peeɔ dii nɛ a buɔ nɔ́
nɛ i ngɛ dee ɔ tue.
22Ke i tu munyu gbe nya a,
nɔ ko de we nɔ́ ko hu;
ejakaa a nuɔ ye munyu ɔmɛ a sisi saminya.
23Ke pee ɔ,
a hyɛɛ mi blɔ nɛ ma ba tu mɛ munyu
kaa bɔ nɛ nihi nɛ nyu he hia mɛ
hyɛɛ gbo hiɔmi nɛmi blɔ ɔ.
24Ke a ngɛ a tsui yee ɔ,
kɛkɛ i muɔ hɛlii ha mɛ.
Ke i tsɔ ye hɛ mi ha mɛ ja
kɛkɛ a nɔ gbagba te.
25I kɛ mɛ hi si kaa a hɛ mi nyɛɛlɔ;
nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ hia kaa a pee ɔ, i tsɔɔ mɛ.
I kɛ mɛ hi si kaa matsɛ ngɛ e ta buli a kpɛti,
aloo bua wolɔ ngɛ kɔmɔ yeli a kpɛti.

Title: HIOB 30
Content:
1Se mwɔnɛ ɔ,
nihi nɛ i wa pe mɛ po ngɛ mi muɔe.
Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ a tsɛmɛ nɛ fɔ mɛ ɔ,
i bui mɛ fɛɛ;
gbehi nɛ buu ye tohi a he pohu
i kɛ mɛ be gbe ɔmɛ futue.
2Nimli nɛ a he wami tsuo ta nɛ ɔ,
mɛni se ma na ngɛ a he?
3Ohia kɛ hwɔ ha nɛ a ta he lo,
nɛ a pee kanyakanya;
sa a, tso sipoku gbigbli lɛ
a kpeɔ ngɛ nga kplanaa nɔ.
4Tso sipoku, kɛ ba ji a niye ní.
5A fie mɛ kɛ je nimli a kpɛti;
a huɔ mɛ kaa a huɔɔ julɔ.
6A hi hehi ji muɔhi,
tɛ sahi, kɛ dɔhi a mi.
7A ya buaa a he nya ngɛ mio tsohi a sisi ngɛ pu mi,
nɛ a hii huãe kaa lohwe awi yeli.
8Yakayaka nimli, kɛ ni guhi ji mɛ tsuo,
nihi nɛ a fia a nane si tu kɛ je ma a mi.
9Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, a ba konɛ a ba muɔ mi;
i plɛ pee a nya mi la.
10A hɛ mɛ kɛ je ye kasa nya;
a hiee mi.
Ke a hyɛ mi kɛkɛ a la lada pue ye nɔ.
11Akɛnɛ Mawu gbla ye tue nɛ i gbɔjɔ
he je ɔ, a bui mi fɛɛ;
nɔ́ nɛ a suɔ lɛ a peeɔ mi.
12Yakayaka nimli nɛ ɔmɛ ba tuaa mi basabasa,
nɛ a hlaa kaa a ma kpata ye hɛ mi.
13A tsi mi blɔ nɛ ma ko ma fo;
a bɔ mɔde kaa a ma kpata ye hɛ mi,
nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko tsi we a nya.
14A hiɛ babauu kɛ ba tua mi
kaa nɔ́ nɛ puɔ agbo ko mi lɛ a gu kɛ ba.
15Sawale nu mi; ye hɛ mi nyami laa mi
kaa kɔɔhiɔ muɔɔ ní kɛ yaa.
Ye ní nami ɔ se po kaa bɔku.
16Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, ye gbenɔ be su ta;
jehanɛ lɛɛ, ye haomi ɔ nya ba wa tsɔ.
17Nyɔ mi ɔ,
ye wuhi a mi kpeɔ mi wawɛɛ nitsɛ
nɛ he jɔmi be mi.
18E ngɛ kaa nɔ́ nɛ
Mawu mia ye yi nɔ tade ɔ
kɛ wo ye kuɛ kpɛii
nɛ mumi womi he be mi.
19Mawu tsitsɛɛ mi kɛ wo mɔsɔ mi,
nɛ i pee kaa tabo zu,
aloo la zu.
20Mawu, ke i tsɛ mo ɔ, o he we nɔ;
ke i fa kue ha mo ɔ,
o bui mi tue.
21O ngɛ mi yi mi wae;
o kɛ nine si wami ngɛ mi yi mi wae wawɛɛ nitsɛ.
22O wo ye nɔ nɛ o fɔ mi
kɛ ya kɔɔhiɔ mi.
Kɔɔhiɔ nɛ nya wa a fia mi
kɛ ya kɛ ba.
23Niinɛ, i le kaa o ngɔ mi kɛ yaa gbeje,
he nɛ a to kɛ ha nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ hɛ ngɛ ɔ.
24Se kɛ̃ ɔ,
imi nɛ ye he wami ta,
imi nɛ i nyɛ we nɔ́ ko peemi,
nɛ pɛɛ kɛkɛ i ngɛ mo kpae
ke o na mi mɔbɔ ɔ,
mɛni he je lɛ o kɛ mi
ye sane kikɛ nɛ ɔ?
25Anɛ i fo we ya ha nihi nɛ
ngɛ haomi mi lo?
Anɛ ohiatsɛmɛ a sane pee we mi mɔbɔ lo?
26Se benɛ i ngɛ nɔ́ kpakpa blɔ hyɛe ɔ,
nɔ́ yayami mohu lɛ ba na mi.
Benɛ i ngɛ la blɔ hyɛe ɔ,
diblii mohu lɛ ba.
27Ye tsui ngɛ fiae wawɛɛ ngɛ ye mi mi;
ye haomi ligbi ɔmɛ hiɛ tsɔ.
28I ngɛ kaa nɔ ko nɛ ngɛ diblii mi nyɛɛe
nɛ e nɛ pu hɛ mi.
I teɔ si ngɛ gua mi,
nɛ i biɔ yemi kɛ buami.
29I plɛ pee nga mi gbehi
a nyɛmi, kɛ klomihi a huɛ.
30Ye he womi pee tuu,
nɛ ye wuhi a he dɔ la.
31Ye gbi nɛ jijeɔ kaa saku, aloo bɛ ɔ,
mwɔnɛ ɔ, e pɛɛ kaa nihi nɛ a wo yana kɛ ngɛ kɔmɔ yee.

Title: HIOB 31
Content:
1I ka kita kaa i kɛ akɔnɔ hɛngmɛ
be zangmayo ko hyɛe gblegbleegble.
2Mɛni hiɔwo lɛ ma na kɛ je Mawu
nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ dɛ mi?
Mɛni weto ní lɛ ma na
kɛ je Ope ɔ dɛ mi?
3Anɛ e kpataa we yiwutsotsɛmɛ a hɛ mi lo?
Anɛ e gbla we yayami peeli a tue lo?
4Mawu le nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ i peeɔ;
e le ye blɔ ɔmɛ tsuo.
5I ngɛ kita kae kaa i yi nɔ ko lakpa;
i sisi we nɔ ko hulɔ.
6Mawu nɛ́ ngmɛ mi ngɛ sɛni nɛ da nɔ,
nɛ e maa na kaa i pee we yayami ko.
7Ke i je blɔ kpakpa a nɔ
kɛ ya nyɛɛ níhi nɛ ye tsui suɔ a se,
nɛ i kɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ peemi ble ye he ɔ,
8lɛɛ níhi nɛ i du ɔ,
ni kpahi nɛ a ba ye;
aloo ní ɔmɛ a hɛ mi nɛ kpata.
9Ke ye nyɛmi ko e yo he pee mi akɔnɔ hyɛ,
nɛ i ya wo lɛ ka ngɛ ye nyɛmi
nɛ ɔ sinya se ɔ,
10lɛɛ ye yo nɛ e hoo gba ní ha nɔ kpa,
nɛ nyumu kpa kɛ lɛ nɛ hwɔ.
11Yayami kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ, e ji zo;
e sa kaa kojoli
nɛ a gbla nɔ tue ngɛ he.
12E ngɛ kaa la nɛ sãã nɔ́ kɛ yaa tsitsaa;
e ma kpata ye nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ hɛ mi.
13Ke ye tsɔlɔ nyumu,
aloo ye mawayo ko kɛ mi na sane ɔ,
i yeɔ sane ɔ ngɛ blɔ nɛ da nɔ.
14Ke i pee we ja a,
kɛ ma pee kɛ da Mawu hɛ mi kɛɛ?
Ke Mawu ba nɛ́ e ba kojo mi ɔ,
kɛ ma de kɛɛ?
15Mawu ɔ nɛ bɔ mi ɔ,
lɛ kɛ̃ lɛ e bɔ ye tsɔli nyumu ɔmɛ,
kɛ ye mawayi ɔmɛ.
16Ke nɔ́ ko hia ohiatsɛ ɔ,
i haa lɛ; yalɔyihi hu,
i ha we nɛ a hɛngmɛ nɔ daa nyu.
17Ke i ngɛ ní yee ɔ,
i ha we nɛ hwɔ yeɔ awusahi.
18I hyɛɔ awusahi a nɔ kaa a tsɛ ye wami be ɔ tsuo.
I ye bua yalɔyihi kɛ je ye nihe mi.
19Ke i na nɔ ko nɛ yi fi,
nɛ nɔ́ ko be e dɛ
nɛ e kɛ ma he bo nɛ e ha,
ke i na dɛgutsɛ ko kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ,
20i haa lɛ he hami nɔ́
nɛ a kɛ imi nitsɛ ye to he bwɔmi pee.
Ke e he dɔ la a,
kɛkɛ e maa na mi si babauu.
21Ke i ya ye awusa ko amimi,
ejakaa i le kaa bɔ tsuaa bɔ nɛ pee ɔ,
a maa wo mi nguɔ ngɛ kojomi he ɔ,
22lɛɛ ye nine nɛ ku;
ye kɔni nɛ kplɔ kɛ je kɔni wu ɔ he.
23Se akɛnɛ i yeɔ Mawu Hewamitsɛ ɔ
tue gblami ɔ gbeye he je ɔ,
i be nyɛe ma pee nɔ́ ko kaa ja.
24I ngɔɛ ye hɛ fɔ we sika nɔ.
25Ní babauu nɛ i na a,
i fĩa we ngɔ fɔ nɔ.
26Pu nɛ tsoɔ saminyayoo,
kɛ nyɔhiɔ nɛ kpɛɔ saminyayoo nɛ ɔ,
i ja we mɛ hyɛ.
27Nɔ́ ko mlɔɔ we mi hyɛ
kaa ma fiɔ ye nine he
kɛ wo a hɛ mi nyami.
28Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ hu maa pee yayami
nɛ sa kaa kojoli
nɛ a gbla nɔ tue ngɛ he.
Ke i pee ja a,
kɛkɛ i kua Mawu nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ.
29Ke haomi ba ye he nyɛlɔ nɔ,
aloo ye he nyɛlɔ hɛ mi kpata a,
i nya we.
30I sɔle we hyɛ ke ye he nyɛli nɛ a gbo,
nɛ́ enɛ ɔ ba pee yayami ha mi.
31Nihi tsuo nɛ tsuɔ ní ha mi ɔ
le kaa hwɔ yi a ti nɔ ko hyɛ.
32I ha we nɛ nibwɔhi hwɔɔ gbɛjegbɛ nɔ;
mohu ɔ, i ngɔɔ mɛ kɛ baa we mi.
33I laa we ye yayamihi a nɔ
kaa bɔ nɛ Adam pee ɔ.
34I yi nihi babauu a hɛ mi gbeye.
Ke ye weku li muɔ mi ɔ,
e pee we mi nɔ́ ko
nɛ lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ma pee dii
nɛ ma ko je kpo.
35Anɛ nɔ ko be nɔ́ nɛ
i ngɛ dee ɔ tue bue lo?
I ngɛ kita kae kaa anɔkuale sisiisi lɛ
i ngɛ tue ɔ nɛ.
Mawu Ope ɔ nɛ ha mi heto.
Sanehi nɛ ye nya polɔ ɔ kɛ fɔ ye nɔ ɔ,
a ngma sane nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ wo womi mi jinɛ
36i kɛ maa fɔ ye konɔ,
nɛ ma fi kɛ wo ye yi kaa jlasi.
37Jinɛ ma nyɛɛ kam kam kaa ganɔ kɛ ya Mawu ngɔ,
nɛ ma ya bɔ lɛ nihi tsuo nɛ i pee ɔ.
38Ke ye zugba a,
aloo ngmɔ nɛ i pee
ngɛ zugba a nɔ ɔ maa po ye nya
39kaa i ye zugba a nɔ niba ní yaka
nɛ i wui he hiɔ,
aloo kaa i gbe zugbatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ,
konɛ ye nine nɛ su a zugba amɛ a nɔ ɔ,
40lɛɛ ngma nane mi ɔ,
mio nɛ puɛ;
akoko nane mi ɔ,
nga nɛ puɛ.
Hiob munyu ɔmɛ a nyagbe ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.

Title: HIOB 32
Content:
Elihu tu munyu
(32.1—37.24)
1Jehanɛ lɛɛ nyumuhi etɛ nɛ ɔmɛ ha we Hiob e munyu ɔmɛ a heto hu, ejakaa a na kaa e buu e he kaa nɔmlɔ nɛ da. 2Kɛkɛ nɛ Elihu mi mi fu Hiob wawɛɛ nitsɛ kaa e pia Mawu, nɛ e wo lɛ nitsɛ e he nguɔ. (Elihu nɛ ɔ, Buz no ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Barakel ɔ binyumu ji lɛ. E je Ram weku ɔ mi, nɛ lɛɛ e bee ngɛ lejɛ ɔ kɛkɛ.) 3Elihu mi mi fu Hiob huɛmɛ etɛ ɔmɛ hulɔ, ejakaa a bu Hiob fɔ, be mi nɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a nɛ heto kpakpa ko nɛ a ha lɛ. 4E mlɛ kɛ ya si ni ɔmɛ tsuo tu munyu gbe nya loko e kɛ Hiob tu munyu, ejakaa lɛ ji a kpɛti nɔ wayoo pe kulaa. 5Benɛ Elihu na kaa nyumuhi etɛ nɛ ɔmɛ pa nyɛ we nɛ a ha Hiob e sane ɔmɛ a heto hu ɔ, e mi mi wo la, 6nɛ e tu munyu.
Elihu
Niheyo kɛkɛ ji mi;
nyɛɛ lɛɛ nikɔtɔmahi ji nyɛ.
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, i ya ye gbeye, nɛ i nyɛ we
nɛ ma de nyɛ bɔ nɛ imi hu i susu ha.
7I de ngɛ ye yi mi ke,
nyɛ lɛ e sa kaa nyɛɛ tu munyu;
nyɛ nimeli ɔmɛ lɛ
e sa kaa nyɛ je nyɛ juɛmi kpo.
8Se, Mawu Ope mumi ɔ
nɛ ngɛ nɔmlɔ adesa mi ɔ,
lɛ nɛ e haa nɔmlɔ nile.
9Pi wami nɛ peeɔ nɔ ní lelɔ;
pi bwɔmi nɛ haa nɛ nɔ leɔ nɔ́ nɛ da.
10Lɔ ɔ he ɔ,
i kpa nyɛ pɛɛ nɛ nyɛɛ bu mi tue,
konɛ imi hu ma je ye juɛmi kpo.
11Benɛ nyɛ ngɛ ní sɛɛe,
nɛ nyɛ ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ
ngɛ mɔde bɔe kaa
e maa tu nile munyu ɔ, i ngmɛ dii,
nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ tue bue.
12Nɛ́ i bu nyɛ tue hluu ɔ,
i na kaa nyɛ ti nɔ ko nɔ ko nyɛ we
nɛ e ha Hiob munyu ɔmɛ a heto bɔ nɛ sa.
13Nyɛɛ hyɛ saminya nɛ
e ko pee nyɛ kaa nyɛ le ní.
Mawu lɛ maa bu Hiob fɔ,
se pi nɔmlɔ adesa.
14Hiob ɔ, pi imi nɛ e kɛ ngɛ munyu tue.
Kaa imi lɛ e kɛ ngɛ munyu tue ɔ, jinɛ
bɔ nɛ nyɛ ha lɛ heto ɔ,
imi lɛɛ pi ja nɛ ma de lɛ.
15Hiob hyɛ, ní leli ɔmɛ pee yaa;
a pee dii, a pa be nɔ́ ko nɛ a ma de hu.
16I mlɛ hluu kaa a ma pa de nɔ́ ko lo;
i mlɛ kaa a ma ha mo heto kpa ko lo.
Se a daa si dii kɛkɛ.
17Lɔ ɔ he ɔ,
imi hu ma de ye nɔ́;
ma je imi hu ye juɛmi kpo.
18I ngɛ níhi babauu nɛ ma de.
Mumi nɛ ngɛ ye mi ɔ ngɛ ye yi se tsitsɛɛe.
19Ke i na we he blɔ nɛ ma tu munyu ɔ,
lɛɛ ma pɛ́ kaa wai tɔ
nɛ wai he hyi lɛ tɔtɔɔtɔ.
20Ma tu munyu, konɛ ma na he jɔmi;
ma pa ye nya mi,
nɛ ma ha mo o munyu ɔmɛ a heto.
21I be nɔ ko hɛ mi hyɛe kɛ tu munyu;
nɛ i be munyu dɔkɔdɔkɔ tue ngɛ nɔ ko he.
22I li munyu dɔkɔdɔkɔ tumi.
Ke i pee ja a,
ye bɔlɔ ɔ maa gbla ye tue amlɔ.

Title: HIOB 33
Content:
1Jehanɛ Hiob, i kpa mo pɛɛ
nɛ o bu nɔ́ nɛ ma de mo ɔ tue saminya.
2I pee klaalo nɛ i kɛ mo maa tu munyu,
nɛ nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ ye nya mi ɔ, ma de mo.
3Anɔkuale ɔ nɛ i le ɔ,
lɔ ɔ ma de mo
kɛ je ye tsui mi faa.
4Mawu mumi ɔ lɛ pee mi;
Ope ɔ mumi ɔ lɛ ha mi wami.
5Ke o ma nyɛ ɔ, ha mi heto.
Moo pee klaalo kɛ o munyu ɔmɛ,
konɛ o kɛ mi nɛ kpe.
6Bɔ nɛ o ngɛ ɔ,
ja nɔuu imi hu i ngɛ ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi.
Imi hu tabo zu ɔ kɛ̃ lɛ a kɛ puɛ mi.
7Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, koo ye mi gbeye;
pi nɔmlɔ nɛ ke e daa si ngɛ o hɛ mi
nɛ o tsui maa po ji mi.
8Munyu nɛ o tu
nɛ i nu kɛ ye tue ji,
9“Ye he tsɔ; i pee we nɔ́ ko nɛ dɛ blɔ.
I yeɔ nguɔ; yayami ko be ye he.
10Se kɛ̃, Mawu bu mi kaa e he nyɛlɔ,
nɛ e ngɛ tɔmihi hlae ngɛ ye he.
11 E bɔ ye nane pã,
nɛ e hɛ ngɛ ye he be tsuaa be.”
12Hyɛ, nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ mo dee ji o nɔ́ be mi;
Mawu kle pe nɔmlɔ adesa.
13Mɛni he je mɔ lɛ o kɛ lɛ ngɛ pɛe
kaa e bui níhi nɛ e ngɛ pee ɔ ekoeko
he akɔtaa kɛ tsɔɔ we nɔ ko?
14Mawu ngɛ munyu tue daa be tsuaa be,
se nɔmlɔ adesa bui nɔ́ nɛ e ngɛ dee ɔ tue.
15 Nyɔ mi benɛ nimli adesahi hwɔ mahe vii ngɛ sa nɔ ɔ,
Mawu kɛ mɛ tuɔ munyu
kɛ guu nlamihi, kɛ ninahi a mi.
16Jamɛ a be ɔ, e bliɔ nimli adesahi a tue,
konɛ a nu nɔ́ nɛ e ngɛ mɛ dee ɔ.
Ke e bɔ mɛ kɔkɔ ɔ, a yeɔ gbeye.
17Mawu kɛ nimli adesahi tuɔ munyu
bɔ nɛ pee nɛ a kpa yayami peemi,
nɛ a ko wo a he nɔ.
18E hla we kaa a hɛ mi nɛ kpata;
e heɔ a yi wami kɛ jeɔ gbenɔ mi tete.
19Nɔmlɔ kaseɔ ní ngɛ hiɔ sa nɔ,
be mi nɛ e wuhi a mi ngɛ lɛ kpee
nɛ he jɔmi be mi.
20Ke e ba lɛ ja kɛkɛ e nya mi gbo,
nɛ e pee we lɛ kaa e ye nɔ́ ko hu;
niye ní ngɔngɔɛ tete po jlo we lɛ.
21E tãã he lo kanyakanya nɛ hi hyɛmi;
nɛ e wuhi nɛ a nɛ be ko nɛ be ɔ jeɔ kpo.
22Lɔ ɔ ji e miɔ nɛ e ma gbo ɔ nɛ.
23Alini, Mawu bɔfo akpe ɔmɛ
nɛ tsɔɔ nimli adesahi nɔ́ nɛ da a,
a ti nɔ kake ma ba je lɛ.
24Mawu bɔfo ɔ maa na lɛ mɔbɔ.
E ma de ke, “Nyɛɛ ngmɛɛ e he;
e be gbeje yae!
Nɔ́ nɛ a kɛ ma kpɔ lɛ konɛ
e ye e he ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.”
25E ma tsake maa pee niheyo ekohu,
nɛ e he womi maa pee tlotlootlo
kaa jokuɛyo he womi.
26Ke e fa kue ha Mawu ɔ,
Mawu ma he nɔ.
E ma sɔmɔ Mawu kɛ bua jɔmi,
nɛ Mawu ma ha nɛ níhi a mi maa hi ha lɛ ekohu.
27E kɛ bua jɔmi ma de ngɛ ma hɛ mi ke,
“I pee yayami.
I pee we nɔ́ nɛ da blɔ,
se kɛ̃ ɔ,
Mawu na mi mɔbɔ.
28Mawu kplɛɛ we nɛ ma ya gbeje,
nɛ i ngɛ je mi kɛ mwɔɔ.”
29Nɔ́ nɛ Mawu peeɔ ha nɔmlɔ si abɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ:
30e heɔ nɔmlɔ yi wami,
nɛ e haa lɛ bua jɔmi ngɛ je mi.
31Hiob, jehanɛ bu nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ mo dee ɔ tue;
pee dii konɛ ma tu munyu.
32Ke o ngɛ nɔ́ ko nɛ o ma de ɔ,
de nɛ ma nu;
ma suɔ kaa ma wo mo nguɔ.
33Se ke o be nɔ́ ko nɛ o ma de ɔ,
lɛɛ pee dii, nɛ o bu mi tue,
nɛ ma tsɔɔ mo nile.

Title: HIOB 34
Content:
1-2Nyɛ ní leli, nyɛɛ bu mi tue.
3 Munyu kpakpa, loo munyu yaya a,
tue nɛ leɔ,
kaa bɔ nɛ lilɛ hu leɔ niye ní
nɛ ngɔɔ, kɛ nɔ́ nɛ ngɔɛ ɔ.
4Nyɛ ha nɛ waa hyɛ sane ɔ mi,
nɛ waa na anɔkuale ɔ.
5Hiob ngɛ tsɔɔe kaa dalɔ ji lɛ,
se Mawu mohu lɛ yi dami sane ha lɛ.
6E ke e pee we nɔ́ ko nɛ dɛ blɔ,
se a bu lɛ lakpatsɛ.
E ngɛ mi kaa a plaa lɛ yeyee mohu,
se e le kaa e pee we yayami ko.
7Anɛ nyɛ na nyumu ko hyɛ kaa Hiob lo?
Nɔmlɔ nɛ bɔɔ musu bɔ nɛ e suɔ
kaa bɔ nɛ a nuu nyu ɔ.
8E kɛ nimli yayamihi lɛ bɔɔ.
9E deɔ ke e he be se nami
kaa nɔ ko nɛ pee Mawu suɔmi nya ní.
10Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ bu mi tue,
nyɛ juɛmitsɛmɛ!
Anɛ Mawu maa pee yi wu tso ní lo?
Anɛ Ope ɔ maa pee nɔ́ nɛ dɛ blɔ lo?
11 Mawu lɛɛ nɔ́ nɛ o tsu ɔ,
lɔ ɔ he hiɔ lɛ e woɔ mo;
Mawu woɔ nɔ tsuaa nɔ hiɔ bɔ nɛ sa lɛ.
12Niinɛ, Mawu pee we nɔ́ nɛ dɛ blɔ;
Ope ɔ plɛ we nɔ ko sane hɛ mi ngɔ bu si.
13Mɛnɔ nɛ ha Mawu e he wami ɔ?
Mɛnɔ nɛ tu je ɔ tsuo kɛ wo e dɛ mi?
14Ke Mawu kpɔ mumi nɛ haa nɔ wami ngɛ nɔmlɔ dɛ ɔ,
15nimli adesahi tsuo ma gbo,
nɛ a ma plɛ pee tabo zu ekohu.
16Lɔ ɔ he ɔ,
ke ní leli ji nyɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ bu mi tue.
17Nɔ nɛ he wa nɛ e yeɔ dami sane ɔ,
o maa bu lɛ fɔ,
konɛ nɔ nɛ sume dami sane yemi ɔ mohu
nɛ ye tsɛ lo?
18Mɛnɔ lɛ deɔ matsɛ ke, “Yaka nɔmlɔ ji mo!”
Mɛnɔ lɛ deɔ odehehi ke, “Yiwutsotsɛmɛ ji nyɛ!”
19Mawu hyɛ we ganɔhi a hɛ mi.
E bui niatsɛmɛ pe ohiatsɛmɛ;
ejakaa lɛ nɛ e bɔ mɛ tsuo.
20Nɔmlɔ gboɔ tlukaa,
Mawu fiaa nimli adesahi nɔ́
nyɔ mi kɛkɛ a hɛ mi kpata.
Nimli nguahi po Mawu gbeɔ mɛ
nɛ adesa nine be mi.
21E hɛ ngɛ nɔmlɔ he be tsuaa be.
E náá e ní peemi níhi tsuo.
22Diblii ko be nɛ nya tsa
bɔ nɛ yayami peeli maa laa a he ngɛ mi.
23E hia we kaa Mawu nɛ to be ha nimli adesahi
nɛ a ba e ngɔ loko e kojo mɛ.
24E jeɔ nimli nguahi kɛ jeɔ a blɔ hehi,
nɛ e ngɔɔ ni kpahi kɛ daa a nane mi;
e hia we kaa e hla a sane ɔmɛ a mi.
25Akɛnɛ Mawu le nɔ́ nɛ a tsuɔ he je ɔ,
e ba tuaa mɛ nyɔ mi, nɛ e kpataa a hɛ mi.
26Mawu gblaa yayami peeli a tue ngɛ ma hɛ mi,
27ejakaa a kpa e se nyɛɛmi,
nɛ e mlaa amɛ hu a yi ekoeko nɔ.
28A ha nɛ ohiatsɛmɛ kpa ngmlaa
kɛ ba Mawu yemi kɛ buami,
nɛ Mawu nu nɔ́ nali ɔmɛ a kue fami ɔ.
29Ke Mawu pee dii ɔ,
mɛnɔ maa pa e nya mi?
Ke e ngɔ e hɛ mi kɛ laa a,
mɛnɔ maa na lɛ; ma ko loo,
aloo nɔmlɔ adesa ko?
30Lɔ ɔ lɛɛ ma ko be nyɛe maa pee nɔ ko,
konɛ nɔmlɔ yayami ko ye tsɛ
nɛ e ba kpata e ma a hɛ mi.
31Hiob, anɛ o jaje o yayami ɔmɛ kɛ tsɔɔ Mawu lo?
Anɛ o wo lɛ si kaa o be yayami pee hu lo?
32Anɛ o fa kue ha Mawu
ke e tsɔɔ mo o tɔmi ɔmɛ lo?
Anɛ o kplɛɛ kaa o ma kpa yayami peemi lo?
33Nɛ́ o kua Mawu ɔ,
o ngɛ lɛ blɔ hyɛe
kaa e pee moo o suɔmi nya ní ha mo lo?
Mo lɛ o ma ha munyu nɛ ɔ heto; pi imi.
Kɛ o susuɔ kɛɛ?
34Nihi nɛ ngɛ juɛmi,
kɛ ní leli tsuo
nɛ ngɛ mi tue bue ɔ,
nɔ́ nɛ a ma de ji,
35“Munyuhi nɛ Hiob ngɛ tue ɔ,
juɛmi be mi;
e li nɔ́ nɛ e ngɛ dee ɔ.”
36E je imi nɔ kake ye he jinɛ
a ko gbla Hiob tue wawɛɛ nitsɛ
ngɛ munyu yayahi nɛ e tu kɛ si Mawu ɔ he.
37Hiob tsɔ atuã kɛ piɛ e yayami ɔmɛ a he,
nɛ e tu munyuhi babauu ngɛ wa hɛ mi
kɛ si Mawu.

Title: HIOB 35
Content:
1-2Hiob, e sɛ kaa o deɔ ke
o pee we yayami ko ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi.
3E sɛ po kaa o biɔ Mawu ke,
“Ke i pee yayami ɔ,
mɛni lɔ ɔ kɔɔ ngɛ o he?
Mɛni se i naa kaa i pee we yayami ko?”
4Ma ha mo heto,
mo kɛ o huɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsuo.
5Hyɛ hiɔwe; hyɛ bɔ nɛ o
kɛ bɔku ɔmɛ a he kɛ ha!
6 Ke o pee yayami ɔ,
kɛ lɔ ɔ saa Mawu he kɛɛ?
Aloo ke o pee yayami nɔtonɔto ɔ,
mɛni lɔ ɔ peeɔ ha Mawu?
7Ke o pee nɔ́ nɛ da a,
mɛni ji nɔ́ nɛ o pee kɛ ha Mawu?
Mɛni ji nɔ́ nɛ Mawu ma na ngɛ o dɛ?
8Ke o pee yayami ɔ,
o nyɛmi nɔmlɔ adesa lɛ naa nɔ́;
ke o pee kpakpa a,
o nyɛmi nɔmlɔ adesa lɛ naa he se.
9Ke a ngɛ nimli adesahi yi mi wae ɔ,
a kpaa ngmlaa kɛ tsɛɔ balɔ.
10Se Mawu nɛ bɔ mɛ ɔ,
nɔ nɛ baa a yi nyɔ mi tete po ɔ,
lɛɛ nɔ ko hla we e se blɔ.
11Mawu ɔ nɛ pee wɔ ní leli pe lohwehi tsuo ɔ,
a hla we e se blɔ.
12A kpaa ngmlaa kɛ tsɛɔ balɔ,
se Mawu bui mɛ tue;
ejakaa he nɔ woli, kɛ yayami peeli ji mɛ.
13Niinɛ, Mawu bui yaka ngmlaa tue;
Mawu Ope ɔ bui he akɔtaa.
14Hiob, mo lɛ o ke o be Mawu nae ɔ?
O sane ɔ ngɛ e hɛ mi;
moo hyɛ lɛ blɔ.
15Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, o susuɔ kaa Mawu gbla we nɔ tue,
nɛ ke nɔ pee yayami hu e di se tsɔ.
16Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ,
mo Hiob, o paa o nya mi
nɛ o tuɔ munyu bɔ nɛ o suɔ.
O tuɔ munyuhi babauu nɛ juɛmi be mi.

Title: HIOB 36
Content:
1-2Moo to o tsui si nɛ o bu mi tue!
Níhi nɛ i ngɛ mo dee ngɛ Mawu nane mi ɔ,
i gbi nya lolo.
3Ma ngɔ ye nile nɛ hiɛ babauu ɔ
kɛ tsɔɔ mo kaa Mawu
nɛ bɔ mi ɔ, dalɔ ji lɛ.
4Anɔkuale i ngɛ tue ɔ nɛ, pi lakpa;
ní lelɔ kpanaa lɛ daa si ngɛ o hɛ mi ɔ nɛ.
5Mawu kle! E nyɛ́ nɔ.
Nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko be nɛ e juɛmi sui he.
6E ha we nɛ yayami peeli a se kɛɛ ngɛ je mi;
e yeɔ ohiatsɛmɛ a sane kɛ haa mɛ.
7Mawu hɛngmɛ ngɛ dali a he be tsuaa be.
E hyɛɛ a nɔ kaa matsɛmɛ,
nɛ e woɔ a hɛ mi nyami daa.
8Se ke a bɔ nihi pã,
nɛ a ngɛ nɔ́ nae
ngɛ nɔ́ ko nɛ a pee he ɔ,
9Mawu tsɔɔ mɛ a nɔ́ nami ɔ sisi,
kaa a wo a he nɔ,
nɛ a pee yayami.
10E kaa a hɛ mi saminya,
nɛ e deɔ mɛ ke a kpa yayami peemi.
11Ke a bu Mawu tue nɛ a sɔmɔ lɛ ɔ,
a ma na tue mi jɔmi, kɛ kplɔkɔtɔ.
12Se ke a bui tue ɔ,
lɛɛ a ma gbo ngɛ klaate nya kaa nihi nɛ li nɔ́.
13Nihi nɛ li Mawu ɔ,
mɛɛ lɛɛ a woɔ a mi mi la kɛ yaa nɔ.
Ke a gbla a tue po,
a fa we kue kɛ tsɛ balɔ.
14A gboɔ ngɛ a nihe mi,
ejakaa a hyɛ we a nɔmlɔ tso ɔ nɔ saminya.
A gbenɔ peeɔ hɛ mi si puemi.
15Mawu tsɔɔ nihi ní kɛ guu nɔ́ nami mi;
e ngɔɔ amanehlu kɛ bliɔ nihi a hɛngmɛ.
16Mawu je mo kɛ je amanehlu mi,
nɛ e ha mo tue mi jɔmi,
kɛ niye ní kpakpa.
17Se, jehanɛ lɛɛ
a ngɛ o tue gblae bɔ nɛ sa mo.
18Hyɛ saminya nɛ o mi mi nɛ fu ɔ
kó ha nɛ o ya gbe Mawu he guɛ.
Ko ha ní nami nɛ je o juɛmi kɛ je Mawu he.
19Ke o fa kue kɛ tsɛ balɔ hu, yaka gu;
o he wami tsuo be nyɛe ma tsu nɔ́ ko.
20Ko de ke o na nɛ e su nyɔ mi,
be mi nɛ nihi a hɛ mi ma kpata.
21Hyɛ saminya nɛ o ko ya nyɛɛ yayami se.
A kɛ amanehlu nɛ ɔ ba o nɔ,
konɛ o ko pee yayami.
22Na nɛ o le kaa Mawu ngɛ he wami;
e kle pe tsɔɔli tsuo.
23Mɛnɔ lɛ maa tsɔɔ Mawu nɔ́ nɛ sa nɛ e pee?
Mɛnɔ lɛ maa po e nya ke e pee yayami?
24Nihi ngɛ Mawu yi jee
ngɛ e ní tsumi kpetekpleenyɛ ɔmɛ a he;
mo hu mo je e yi koo.
25Níhi nɛ Mawu tsuɔ ɔ, nɔ tsuaa nɔ naa,
se nɔ ko nɔ ko nui sisi.
26Hyɛ, Mawu kle! Wa li lɛ kulaa;
jeha nɛ e ye hu wa juɛmi sui he.
27Mawu lɛ gblaa nyu kɛ jeɔ zugba,
nɛ e haa nɛ e plɛɔ peeɔ hiɔmi nɛ nɛɛ.
28E haa nɛ hiɔmi nɛɛ babauu kɛ jeɔ bɔku mi
kɛ pueɔ si ha nimli adesahi tsuo.
29Bɔ nɛ bɔku haa si,
kɛ bɔ nɛ hiɔwe siɔ
ngɛ lɛ Mawu ɔ e hi he ɔ,
mɛnɔ lɛ le?
30E haa nɛ oslabai gbaa ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ tsuo,
se wo ɔ sisi lɛɛ e ngɛ diblii mi.
31Bɔ nɛ Mawu peeɔ kɛ hyɛɛ e ma a nɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ:
e haa mɛ niye ní babauu.
32E kɛ e nine nuɔ oslabai,
nɛ he tsuaa he nɛ e fa lɛ ke e ya a,
kɛkɛ e gba kɛ ya lejɛ ɔ.
33Ke hiɔwe si ɔ,
lɔ ɔ tsɔɔ kaa kɔɔhiɔ
nɛ nya wa ma ngɛ se.
Lohwehi tete po le enɛ ɔ.

Title: HIOB 37
Content:
1Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ha ye tsui po, nɛ e ngɛ fiae kplakplaakpla.
2Nyɛɛ bu tue! Mawu wo gbi, nyɛɛ bu tue;
nyɛɛ bu hoo nɛ ngɛ pɛe kɛ je e nya mi ɔ tue.
3E haa oslabai gbaa ngɛ hiɔwe,
nɛ e kpɛɔ ngɛ je ɔ kɔ nya he tsuaa he.
4Kɛkɛ ɔ, hiɔwe siɔ wawɛɛ kɛ nyɛɛɔ se.
Jamɛ a be ɔ tsuo oslabai ɔ ngɛ la pae plamplam.
5Ke Mawu wo gbi kikɛ nɛ ɔ,
e peeɔ ní nguahi nɛ wa juɛmi sui he.
6E faa ke snoo nɛ nɛ ngɔ pue zugba a nɔ,
nɛ e haa nɛ hiɔmi nɛ nya wa hu nɛɔ ja nɔuu.
7Ke e ba kikɛ nɛ ɔ,
nimli adesahi kpaa ní tsumi,
konɛ nimli adesahi ngɛ je ɔ mi tsuo
nɛ a na e he wami ɔ.
8Kɛkɛ ɔ, nga mi lohwehi beɔ kɛ yaa a hi hehi.
9Kɔɔhiɔ nɛ nya wa fiaa kɛ jeɔ leneyi je,
nɛ fĩɛ nɛ nya wa jeɔ omleyi je kɛ baa.
10Mumi nɛ jeɔ Mawu gugwɔ mi ɔ
haa nɛ nyu babauu ɔ wluaa gaganii kaa tɛ.
11Mawu haa bɔku ɔmɛ hyi ɔ kɛ nyu.
Oslabai hii la pae ngɛ bɔku ɔmɛ a mi,
12be mi nɛ a ngɛ nyɛɛe nɛ a ngɛ Mawu ní tsue ɔ.
Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ Mawu fa mɛ ke a pee
ngɛ je ɔ mi tsuo kɛ bɔle si ɔ,
a peeɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
13Mawu haa hiɔmi nɛɛ, konɛ nyu nɛ
ba zugba a nɔ;
e haa hiɔmi nɛɛ
nɛ e kɛ gblaa nimli adesahi a tue,
aloo nɛ e kɛ naa mɛ mɔbɔ.
14Hiob, bu tue!
Da si dii nɛ o susu Mawu nyakpɛ ní ɔmɛ a he.
15Anɛ o le bɔ nɛ Mawu faa,
nɛ e haa oslabai gbaa kɛ jeɔ bɔku mi lo?
16Bɔ nɛ bɔkuhi plɛɔ kɛ beɔ kɛ a he sɔmi
ngɛ nyakpɛ blɔ nɔ ɔ, anɛ o le lo?
Ee, ní lelɔ kpanaa a,
e ní tsumi ji lɔ ɔ nɛ.
17Ke leneyi je kɔɔhiɔ ngɛ fiae,
nɛ je mi ngmɛ dii ɔ,
anɛ o le bɔ nɛ peeɔ loko moo o he mi dɔɔ la lo?
18Hiɔwe ɔ nɛ he wa kpakpataa
kaa ahuhuɛ nɛ a sile,
nɛ a puɛ ngɔ ma si ɔ,
anɛ o ma nyɛ maa gbla mi
kaa bɔ nɛ lɛ
Mawu ɔ, e pee ɔ lo?
19Hiob, moo tsɔɔ wɔ nɔ́ nɛ wa ma de Mawu.
Wɔɔ lɛɛ wa juɛmi mi wo diblii,
nɛ nɔ́ ko be wa nya mi nɛ wa ma de.
20I be suɔe nɛ i kɛ Mawu nɛ tu munyu.
Ke i pee ja a,
ye hɛ mi ma kpata.
21Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, la nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ
ngɛ kpɛe nylamnylam nɛ e hi hyɛmi,
ejakaa kɔɔhiɔ muɔ bɔku ɔmɛ kɛ ho.
22Je mi tsɔ hleii kaa sika tsu ngɛ omleyi je;
Mawu hɛ mi nyami ɔ ngɛ gbeye.
23Mawu Ope ɔ loo, wa be nyɛe maa su e he.
E ngɛ he wami, e yeɔ dami sane,
nɛ e pee we nɔ́ nɛ dɛ kɔkɔɔkɔ.
24Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, nihi tsuo yeɔ lɛ gbeye;
ni nɛmɛ nɛ mɛɛ a buɔ a he ní leli ɔ,
Mawu lɛɛ e bui mɛ fɛɛ.

Title: HIOB 38
Content:
Yawɛ ha Hiob heto
1Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ kɛ Hiob tu munyu
kɛ je kɔɔhiɔ nɛ nya wa mi.
Yawɛ
2Mɛnɔ ji mo nɛ o kɛ munyu puu nɛ juɛmi be mi
biɔ mi ye nile he sane?
3Da si kaa nyumu, nɛ o ha mi
sanehi nɛ ma bi mo ɔ a heto.
4Benɛ i to je ɔ sisi ɔ,
jije o ngɛ?
Ke o le ɔ, ha mi heto.
5Je ɔ kami kɛ e blimi ɔ,
mɛnɔ lɛ tsɔɔ?
Mɛnɔ lɛ fɔ kpa kɛ susu?
Tse o ma nyɛ ma ha heto!
6Mɛni nɔ a fia e sisi tomi ɔmɛ kɛ ma?
Mɛnɔ lɛ to kɔ nya tɛ ɔ?
7Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ mɔtu ɔ,
dodoe ɔmɛ tsuo la,
nɛ Mawu bimɛ ɔmɛ tsuo hwɔ lele.
8 Benɛ wo ɔ hia kɛ ma babaaba
kaa nɔ́ nɛ zugba a nitsɛ mi mi lɛ e je ɔ,
mɛnɔ lɛ nga sinya a kɛ tsi wo ɔ nya?
9Imi lɛ i ngɔ bɔku kɛ ha wo ɔ he;
imi lɛ i ngɔ diblii kpii kɛ blaa lɛ.
10Imi lɛ i po huzu kɛ wo wo ɔ he,
nɛ i ma nya agbo kɛ e se dade.
11I de wo ɔ ke,
“Moo fia kɛ ba su hiɛ ɔ pɛ;
koo be he!
O we oslɔke ngua amɛ ɔ,
he nɛ a ma ba ta ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.”
12Hiob, o wami be ɔ tsuo mi ɔ,
anɛ o fa hyɛ ke je nɛ na,
nɛ je na lo?
13Anɛ o fa hyɛ ke mɔtu la a nɛ nu je ɔ
kɛ yaa si a ma huanya yiwutsotsɛmɛ
kɛ je a laami hehi lo?
14Piani la haa nɛ a naa yoku ɔmɛ, kɛ kɔ̃ ɔmɛ saminya
kaa bɔ nɛ a naa zahi ngɛ bo mi,
aloo nya sɔumi nɔ́ ngɛ tabo zu mi ɔ.
15Piani la nya wa tsɔ ha yayami peeli.
E tsiɔ mɛ blɔ nɛ a nyɛ we nɛ a tsuɔ yi wu tso ní.
16Pahi nɛ ngɛ wo ɔ sisi ɔ,
anɛ o ya a kasa nya hyɛ lo?
O nyɛɛ ngɛ muɔ voo ɔ
nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ mi hyɛ lo?
17Agbohi nɛ ngɛ ni gbogboehi a je,
he nɛ wo diblii kpii ɔ,
anɛ nɔ ko bli nya kɛ tsɔɔ mo hyɛ lo?
18Anɛ o le je ɔ blimi lo?
Ke o le ɔ, ha mi heto.
19Jije a guu kɛ yaa la hi he?
Diblii hu jije e hi he ngɛ?
20Anɛ o ma nyɛ maa tsɔɔ mɛ a huzu nya,
nɛ o kpale mɛ kɛ ba a hi he ekohu lo?
21Ee, o ma nyɛ; nɔkɔtɔma ji mo.
Jamɛ a be ɔ, tse a fɔ mo!
22Hehi nɛ i toɔ snoo, kɛ gbiɛ ngo ngu ngɛ ɔ,
o ya lejɛ ɔmɛ hyɛ lo?
23I ngɔ mɛ ngɔ to lejɛ ɔ
ngɛ haomi, loo ta nɛ maa ba he.
24Jije a guu kɛ yaa he nɛ pu jeɔ kɛ baa,
aloo he nɛ beleku kɔɔhiɔ fiaa kɛ jeɔ?
25Mɛnɔ lɛ gba nyu dɔ
kɛ ha hiɔmi nɛ nɛɛ piapiaapia a?
Mɛnɔ lɛ je blɔ
ha hiɔwe simi, kɛ oslabai gbami?
26Mɛnɔ lɛ haa nɛ hiɔmi nɛɛ ngɛ zugba nɔ he nɛ
nɔmlɔ adesa ko be
kaa nga kplanaa nɔ kikɛ nɛ ɔ?
27Zugba nɛ gbo,
aloo zugba nɛ pee nga kplanaa a,
mɛnɔ lɛ haa lɛ nyu loko nga puɛɔ ngɛ nɔ?
28Hiɔmi nɛ nɛɛ ɔ,
e ngɛ tsɛ lo?
Bɔ́ hu, mɛnɔ lɛ fɔ lɛ?
29Mɛnɔ muklii mi nyu tɛ je?
Hiɔwe bɔ́ ɔ, mɛnɔ lɛ fɔ lɛ?
30Nyu ɔ wluaa gaganii,
nɛ e he waa kaa tɛ.
31 Dodoehi nɛ a tsɛɛ ke Kungwɔ
kɛ e bimɛ ɔ,
anɛ o ma nyɛ maa fi mɛ kɔsɔkɔsɔ lo?
Huɛ etɛ ɔ, o ma nyɛ maa pɛne
e mi mi fimi nɔ́ ɔ lo?
32Anɛ o ma nyɛ maa tsɔɔ dodoehi blɔ
ngɛ a be mi lo?
O ma nyɛ maa tsɔɔ Je kpaago kɛ
e bimɛ ɔmɛ blɔ lo?
33Anɛ o le mlaahi nɛ a kɛ tsuɔ ní ngɛ hiɔwe lo?
O ma nyɛ ma ha jamɛ a mlaa amɛ
nɛ tsu ní ngɛ zugba a nɔ lo?
34Anɛ o ma nyɛ maa wo gbi
nɛ nyu babauu maa je bɔku ɔmɛ a mi ba pɔ mo lo?
35Anɛ o ma nyɛ ma fa oslabai ke e gba,
nɛ e ma he nɔ ke,
“Ma pee kaa bɔ nɛ o fa mi ɔ” lo?
36Mɛnɔ lɛ ha nɔmlɔ adesa nile?
Mɛnɔ kɛ juɛmi wo nɔmlɔ yi mi?
37Mɛnɔ lɛ le ní bɔ nɛ sa
nɛ e ma nyɛ maa kane bɔkuhi ngɛ hiɔwe?
Mɛnɔ ma nyɛ ma plɛ nyu buɛ mi bɔku ɔmɛ
a nya ngɔ ka si,
38nɛ tabo zu ɔ ma pɔtɔ maa pee mɔsɔ;
nɛ lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e maa pee zu kpɔ longolongohi?
39Mo lɛ o haa jata niye ní nɛ e yeɔ lo?
Mo lɛ o haa jata bimɛ ní nɛ a yeɔ nɛ a tɔɔ,
40be mi nɛ a buu si ngɛ tɛ puɔhi a mi,
loo a wo ka ngɛ a muɔhi a mi?
41Mɛnɔ lɛ haa kuakualabite niye ní?
Ke hwɔ ngɛ kuakualabite bimɛ yee,
nɛ a ngɛ niye ní hlae kɛ bee,
nɛ a kpa ngmlaa tsɛ mi ɔ,
mɛnɔ lɛ haa mɛ niye ní?

Title: HIOB 39
Content:
1Anɛ o le be nɛ pu mi apletsihi fɔɔ lo?
O na odabɔ nɛ ngɛ fɔe hyɛ lo?
2Anɛ o le nyɔhiɔ abɔ nɛ a hɛɛɔ mi lo?
O le be nɛ a fɔɔ lo?
3O le bɔ nɛ a buɔ si, nɛ a fɔɔ,
nɛ a haomi ɔmɛ jeɔ a nɔ lo?
4A bimɛ ɔmɛ waa saminya ngɛ nga a nɔ;
a jeɔ a nyɛmɛ ɔmɛ a he,
nɛ a kpale we kɛ bɛ hu.
5Nga mi teji ɔmɛ ɔ,
mɛnɔ lɛ ha nɛ a ye a he?
Mɛnɔ lɛ ngmɛɛ a he loko a ngɛ kpae ɔ?
6Imi lɛ i ha mɛ nga kplanaa a,
nɛ a kɛ pee a hi he,
kɛ ngo zugba a hulɔ,
konɛ a hi lejɛ ɔ.
7A sume ma nguahi a mi he nɛ huhui ngɛ;
a hla we nɛ nɔ ko nɛ jɔɔ a kã he
nɛ a tsu ní ha lɛ.
8Yo ɔmɛ a nɔ ji a ní yemi he;
a yeɔ ba mumu tsuaa ba mumu ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.
9Anɛ pu mi okpɔngɔ maa suɔ nɛ e tsu ní ha mo lo?
Anɛ e maa suɔ nɛ e hwɔ o lohwehi a ní yemi he lo?
10Anɛ o ma nyɛ maa wo pu mi okpɔngɔ kpa
nɛ e hu ha mo lo?
Anɛ o ma nyɛ ma ha nɛ e gbla dade kpakplaa
kɛ hu o ngmɔ mi lo?
11Anɛ o maa ngɔ o hɛ ngɔ fɔ e he wami ɔ nɔ,
konɛ e tsu o ní tsumi kpakpataa a ha mo lo?
12Anɛ o heɔ yeɔ kaa e ma kpa ní ha mo,
nɛ e kɛ o blɛfo ɔ ma ba wo blɛfo gba mi ha mo lo?
13Mo lɛ o ha pu mi klakumi e pɛli saminyayoo ɔ lo?
Duguma tsɛli, kɛ e pɛli ɔmɛ nɛɛ,
mo lɛ o ha lɛ?
14Duguma siɔ e hluihi ngɛ zugba,
konɛ la nɛ jeɔ zu mi ɔ
nɛ ha a he nɛ dɔ la.
15E hɛ jeɔ nɔ kaa nane ko ma nyɛ maa ywia mɛ,
loo pu mi lohwe ko ma ba naa nɔ.
16E waa e bimɛ ɔmɛ yi mi kaa nɔ́
nɛ pi e bimɛ ji mɛ.
E hia we lɛ tete kaa e gbo yaka dengme.
17Imi Mawu lɛ i pee lɛ kuasia,
nɛ i ha nɛ nile bɔ lɛ kikɛ nɛ ɔ nɛ.
18Se ke e bɔni fo tumi kikɛ nɛ ɔ,
e muɔɔ okpɔngɔ kɛ e nɔ hilɔ.
19Mo Hiob lɛ o ha okpɔngɔ e he wami ɔ lo?
Mo lɛ o ha lɛ bwɔmi gagaa ngɛ e kuɛ he ɔ lo?
20Mo lɛ o haa nɛ e tuɔ kaa baalɛ ɔ lo?
Mo lɛ o haa nɛ e fliɔ e gugwɔ mi wawɛɛ
kɛ woɔ nɔ he gbeye ɔ lo?
21E kɛ bua jɔmi siɔ si glɛi glɛi glɛi ngɛ kɔ̃ ɔ mi,
nɛ e kɛ e he wami tsuo gbɔɔ fo kɛ yaa ta.
22E li nɔ́ nɛ a tsɛɛ ke fɔ̃;
e tui klaate nya fo.
23Kɛ̃ɛ̃ mi bihi hii a sibi a he hae ngɛ e se mi;
akplɔ kɛ tsɛ̃i hii kpɛe nylamnylam.
24Ke titimati ɔ pɛ kikɛ nɛ ɔ,
e dɛ si dii;
e kɛ hɛdɔ kɛ mi mi fumi nɛ nya wa
gbɔɔ fo kɛ yaa ta.
25Ke titimati ɔ pɛ kɛkɛ e fli e gugwɔ mi wawɛɛ.
E nuɔ ta he fu ngɛ tsitsaa lokoo.
E nuɔ nɛ asafoatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ gbi woe,
nɛ ose ngɛ pɛe ngɛ ta a mi.
26Mo lɛ o tsɔɔ kayo temi
loko e gbɛɛ e pɛlihi a mi,
nɛ e teɔ kɛ yaa leneyi je ɔ lo?
27Mo lɛ o deɔ kɔle loko e ya peeɔ e tsu
ngɛ hiɔwe lokoo ɔ lo?
28Tɛ sa mi e hiiɔ; lejɛ ɔ ji e we;
tɛ sa kɛ e nya piɔpiɔɔpiɔ ɔ ji e mɔ.
29Ke e ngɛ lejɛ ɔ,
e hɛngmɛ hyɛɛ nɔ́
kɛ yaa tsitsaa
kaa e maa na lohwe ko
nɛ e ye lo.
30 Ke e na lohwe gbogboe ko kikɛ nɛ ɔ,
e ya maa si ngɛ lejɛ ɔ,
nɛ e bimɛ ɔmɛ nuɔ muɔ.

Title: HIOB 40
Content:
1-2Hiob, o ke o kɛ Mawu Ope ɔ maa hua munyu he.
Anɛ o ma ha yi,
aloo o maa ya nɔ?
Ha mi heto!
Hiob
3-4I kpa mo pɛɛ,
pi nɔ ko kulaa ji mi.
Mɛni heto ma ha mo?
I be munyu tue hu.
5I tu munyu pe bɔ nɛ sa nɛ ma tu;
i pa be nɔ́ ko dee hu.
6Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ kɛ Hiob tu munyu ekohu
kɛ je kɔɔhiɔ nɛ nya wa mi.
Yawɛ
7Jehanɛ, da si kaa nyumu!
Ma bi mo sane, nɛ o ha mi heto.
8Anɛ o ngɛ hlae nɛ o bu mi fɔ kaa i yi dami sane,
konɛ moo lɛɛ o wo o he nguɔ kaa o nɔ́ da lo?
9Anɛ o ngɛ he wami kaa imi Mawu ɔ lo?
Anɛ o ma nyɛ maa wo gbi kaa imi lo?
10Ke ja a, dla o he,
nɛ o he nɛ pee fɛu.
Wo ablade tade saminyayoo,
konɛ o hɛ mi nɛ ba nyami.
11Hyɛ he woli!
O mi mi nɛ fu mɛ nɛ o ba mɛ si.
12Ee, hyɛ mɛ nɛ o ba mɛ si.
Moo naa yiwutsotsɛmɛ a nɔ ngɛ a hi he ɔmɛ.
13Moo pu mɛ tsuo ngɛ tabo zu mi,
nɛ o fi a hɛ mi ngɛ gbeje.
14Ke o pee ja a, lɛɛ imi hu ma je o yi,
nɛ ma de ke o ma nyɛ ma he mo nitsɛ o yi wami.
15Hyɛ pa mi suɔ!
I bɔ lɛ, kɛ mo tsuo.
E kpeɔ nga kaa na.
16Se hyɛ bɔ nɛ e nɔmlɔ tso ɔ he wa ha;
hyɛ bɔ nɛ e pani ɔmɛ ti ha!
17E hlemi ngɛ tlɔmɔɔ kaa seda tso.
Panihi nɛ hɛɛ e fiɔ ɔmɛ ɔ a he wa saminya.
18E wuhi a he wa kaa akɔblee,
nɛ e nanehi ngɛ kaa dade.
19Lɛ ji ye nibɔ ní ɔmɛ a kpɛti
nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ nyakpɛ pe mɛ tsuo.
E bɔlɔ ɔ pɛ ji nɔ nɛ ma nyɛ maa ye e nɔ.
20E naa niye ní ngɛ yo ɔmɛ a nɔ;
lejɛ ɔ lɛ pu mi lohwehi tsuo ya fiɛɔ ngɛ.
21E buɔ si ngɛ mio tsohi a sisi,
nɛ e laa e he ngɛ ngɔwuhi a kpɛti ngɛ pa mi.
22Mio tso ɔmɛ peeɔ hɔ̃ kɛ haa lɛ,
nɛ ngɔwu ɔmɛ bɔleɔ lɛ kɛ kpeɔ ngɛ nyu ɔ mi.
23Ke pa a he wa tete po, e yi gbeye.
Ke Yordan pa a nitsɛ fia kɛ ba pue e hɛ mi pohu,
e bui tete.
24Anɛ nɔ ko ma nyɛ maa nu lɛ kɛ gbowe lo?
Anɛ nɔ ko ma nyɛ maa wo e gugwɔ mi ga lo?

Title: HIOB 41
Content:
1 Anɛ o ma nyɛ ma sá nyaka kɛ gbowe lo?
Anɛ o ma nyɛ maa ngɔ kpa kɛ fi
e lilɛ kɛ muɔ si lo?
2Anɛ o ma nyɛ maa ngɔ tangme
kɛ wo e gugwɔ mi lo?
Anɛ o ma nyɛ maa ngɔ gbowe
kɛ wo e tsitsa mi lo?
3Anɛ e ma kpa mo pɛɛ ke o ngmɛɛ e he lo?
Anɛ e maa fa kue ha mo ke o na lɛ mɔbɔ lo?
4Anɛ e kɛ mo maa so
kaa e ma sɔmɔ mo daa lo?
5Anɛ o kɛ lɛ ma fiɛ kaa
a kɛ lohwe pɛlitsɛ fiɛɔ,
aloo o maa fi lɛ ha o mawayi ɔmɛ
nɛ a kɛ lɛ nɛ fiɛ lo?
6Anɛ jua yeli ma nyɛ maa wo e he jua lo?
Anɛ a maa poo lɛ kpɔ nya kpɔ nya
nɛ a jua ha jua yeli lo?
7Anɛ o ma nyɛ ma tsɛ̃ kɛ̃ɛ̃hi babauu
kɛ wo e he womi mi lo?
Anɛ o ma nyɛ maa ngɔ akplɔ
kɛ gbɔ e yi mi lo?
8Moo ta e he si kake nɛ o hyɛ,
nɛ e be mo jloe kaa o ta e he si enyɔne;
o hɛ be nɔ jee gblegbleegble.
9Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa na nyaka kikɛ nɛ ɔ,
sawale maa nu lɛ,
nɛ e maa nɔ si bum ngɛ zugba.
10Katsɛ ko katsɛ ko be
nɛ ma nyɛ maa wo e hɛ mi la.
Ke ja a, lɛɛ mɛnɔ lɛ ma nyɛ
maa da imi ye hɛ mi?
11Mɛnɔ lɛ e kɛ nyaka ya kpe kunɔ hyɛ
nɛ e he je mi?
Dɛbi! Je ɔ mi tsuo ɔ,
nɔ ko nɔ ko be!
12Nyaka a, tsa pi fiɛmi lohwe ji lɛ;
a je blɔ bɔ lɛ,
nɛ e ngɛ he wami saminya.
E nɔmlɔ tso ɔ he níhi, e nanehi,
kɛ e kpɔhi yeɔ ní nɛ ɔmɛ a he odase.
13Mɛnɔ ma nyɛ ma kpɔ e he toto ɔ?
E he womi ɔ nɛ ngɛ kaa gbaja nɛ e kpla a,
mɛnɔ ma nyɛ maa hɛ lɛ nɔ́ nɛ maa gbu lɛ kɛ je kpo?
14E nya kɛ e mi lunguhi gbeyegbeye ɔ,
mɛnɔ ma nyɛ ma bli?
15E he toto saminyawiiwi ɔmɛ ngɛ kaa tsɛ̃ihi
nɛ a fi ngɔ bla,
nɛ a to mɛ za nɔ za nɔ.
A he wa pe tɛ.
16A tsa a sibi a nya pɛpɛɛpɛ,
bɔ nɛ kɔɔhiɔ po be nyɛe maa gu a kpɛti.
17A tsa, nɛ a mɛtɛ a sibi a he saminya,
bɔ nɛ nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko be nyɛe ma gba mi.
18Ke e tsile kɛkɛ la kpɛ;
e hɛngmɛhi ngɛ hleii kaa mɔtu pu la.
19La hii tsoe ngɛ e nya mi,
nɛ la lilɛhi tuɔ kɛ jeɔ mi pueɔ si.
20La su ku jeɔ e gugwɔ puɔhi a mi
kaa lamuɔ nɛ jeɔ buɛ,
loo kutu nɛ ngɛ fiae mi.
21Ke e wo mumi kikɛ nɛ ɔ,
e haa nɛ hã tsɛ̃ɔ,
nɛ la lilɛhi tuɔ kɛ jeɔ e nya mi.
22E kuɛ ngɛ kpakpataa;
ke o kɛ lɛ kpe ɔ,
ja sawale nu mo.
23E he womi he wa kpɛkpɛtɛɛ;
e be bɔdɔbɔdɔ,
nɛ e be tsuãã hulɔ.
24E tsui he wa kaa tɛ!
Ee, e tsui he wa kaa wɛ.
25Ke e wó e he nɔ kikɛ nɛ ɔ,
katsɛmɛ tete po yeɔ gbeye;
sawale nuɔ mɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ.
26Klaate ko klaate ko be nɛ maa plaa lɛ.
Akplɔ, loo kɛ̃ɛ̃ ko be nɛ maa ye lɛ awi.
27Dade ngɛ kaa nga ha lɛ;
akɔblee hu ngɛ kaa tso nɛ sa kɛkɛ.
28Kɛ̃ɛ̃ mi bi ko be nyɛe maa wo lɛ fo;
amlami tɛ ngɛ kaa nga ha lɛ.
29Tsokpoti ngɛ kaa nga ha lɛ,
nɛ ke akplɔ ngɛ pɛe kɛ ma a, e muɔɔ.
30Totohi nɛ ngɛ e mi si ɔ
ngɛ kaa buɛ kokoehi nɛ a nya ba.
E ngmlãã si ngɛ mɔsɔ mi
kaa nɔ́ nɛ blɛfo lɛ e ngɛ gblɛe.
31E haa nɛ wo fiaa kaa nyu ngɛ buɛ mi,
nɛ e fiaa hwɔli kaa nu ngɛ tɔ mi.
32Ke e be kikɛ nɛ ɔ,
e jeɔ blɔ ngɛ e se futaa.
Bɔ nɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ hii kpɛe ha a,
o ma de ke wo ɔ puɛ mua.
33Nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko be je nɛ ɔ mi
nɛ ngɛ kaa lɛ;
e li nɔ́ nɛ a tsɛɛ ke fɔ̃.
34E bui lohwe ko lohwe ko;
lohwe nɛ kle kaa mɛni po, e bui.
Lohwehi nɛ a he ngɛ gbeye tsuo
a matsɛ ji lɛ.

Title: HIOB 42
Content:
1Kɛkɛ nɛ Hiob he nɔ nɛ e kɛ Yawɛ tu munyu.
Hiob
2Yawɛ, i le kaa he walɔ kpetekpleenyɛ ji mo;
o nyɛɔ nɛ o peeɔ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ o suɔ.
3 O bi ke kɛ peeɔ kɛɛ nɛ i biɔ sane
nɛ kɔɔ mo o nile he,
be mi nɛ imi lɛɛ i li nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko ɔ?
I tu níhi nɛ i nui sisi a he munyu;
nyakpɛ níhi nɛ ye juɛmi sui a he.
4 O de mi ke ma bu mo tue nɛ o tu munyu,
konɛ ma ha mo sanehi nɛ o ma bi mi ɔ a heto.
5Jamɛ a be ɔ,
níhi nɛ nihi de mi
ngɛ o he kɛkɛ lɛ i le,
se amlɔ nɛ ɔ lɛɛ
i na mo paa kɛ imi nitsɛ ye hɛngmɛ.
6Nɔ́ nɛ i pee ɔ dɔ mi.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ,
i kɛ tabo zu kɛ la zu to okadi
kaa i pia ye he niinɛ.
Nyagbe
7Benɛ Yawɛ kɛ Hiob tu munyu ta a, Yawɛ de Elifaz, Teman no ɔ ke, “Ye mi mi fu o kɛ o huɛmɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ tsuo; ejakaa nyɛ tu we ye he anɔkuale munyu kaa bɔ nɛ ye tsɔlɔ Hiob pee ɔ. 8Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, nyɛɛ ngɔ na ku kpaago, kɛ agbosu kpaago kɛ ya ye tsɔlɔ Hiob ngɔ, nɛ nyɛ ya sã sami bɔ ha nyɛ he ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Hiob maa fa kue ha nyɛ. Ma bu e kue fami ɔ tue, nɛ i be nyɛ tue gblae bɔ nɛ sa nyɛ kaa nyɛ je kuasia. Ee, nyɛ tu we ye he anɔkuale munyu kaa bɔ nɛ ye tsɔlɔ Hiob pee ɔ.”
9Elifaz, Teman no ɔ, Bildad, Shua no ɔ, kɛ Zofar, Naamat no ɔ ho nɛ a ya pee kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ de mɛ ke a pee ɔ. Nɛ Yawɛ bu Hiob kue fami ɔ tue.
10 Jehanɛ, benɛ Hiob fa kue ha Yawɛ ngɛ e huɛmɛ etɛ ɔmɛ a he se ɔ, Yawɛ wo lɛ ní ekohu. Níhi tsuo nɛ Hiob hi sa a, Yawɛ bɔ he totoe enyɔɔnyɔ kɛ ha lɛ. 11Hiob nyɛminyumuhi, e nyɛmiyihi, kɛ nihi nɛ le lɛ sa a tsuo ba slaa lɛ nɛ a kɛ lɛ ba ye ní ngɛ e we ɔ mi. A ye lɛ kɔmɔ nɛ a jɔɔ e bua ngɛ haomihi tsuo nɛ Yawɛ kɛ ba e nɔ ɔ a he. A ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ ke lɛ sika, kɛ sika tsu ga.
12Yawɛ gbaa Hiob ngɛ nyagbe be nɛ ɔ mi kulaa pe bɔ nɛ e gbaa lɛ kekle ɔ. Hiob ba na to akpe nyɔngma kɛ eywiɛ, afukpɔngɔ akpe ekpa, na blablɛ akpe kɛ teji akpe. 13Jehanɛ e kpale fɔ binyumuhi kpaago kɛ biyihi etɛ. 14E wo e biyo nɔkɔtɔma a biɛ ke Yemima. Enyɔne ɔ biɛ ji Kezia, nɛ etɛne ɔ biɛ ji Keren Hapuk. 15Ngɛ je ɔ mi tsuo ɔ, a nɛ yihi nɛ a he ngɛ fɛu kaa Hiob biyi ɔmɛ. A tsɛ ɔ ha mɛ weto ní kaa bɔ nɛ e ha a nyɛminyumu ɔmɛ ɔ.
16Ní nɛ ɔmɛ a se ɔ, Hiob kpale ye jeha lafa kɛ nyingmi eywiɛ ekohu. E na bimɛ, kɛ bibimɛ hluu kɛ ya si yi nɔ nɛ ji eywiɛ 17loko e gbo. Jamɛ a be ɔ, e bwɔ kotokoto.

Title: LA NYA TSƆƆMI
Content:
NYA TSƆƆMI
Baiblo ɔ mi lahi, kɛ sɔlemihi lɛ ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ mi. Ni munomunohi lɛ a ngma la amɛ, kɛ sɔlemi ɔmɛ ngɛ be slɔɔtohi a mi. Israel bi ji ni nɛmɛ nɛ bua la amɛ, kɛ sɔlemi ɔmɛ a nya kɛ ha a Mawu jami. Pee se ɔ, a ngɔ la amɛ kɛ piɛ a ngmami ɔmɛ a he.
Mawu jami asilɛ nɛ ɔmɛ kɔɔ ní munomunohi a he: Mawu yi jemi, kɛ Mawu jami lahi, kue fami kɛ ha yemi kɛ buami, yi baami, kɛ yi wami hemi. Ní komɛ hu nɛ asilɛ ɔmɛ kɔɔ a he ji yayami he pɛɛ kpami, sina ngɛ Mawu gbaami he, kɛ kue fami kɛ ha he nyɛli a tue gblami. Kue fami nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ kɛ ha ni kakaaka, kɛ ma a tsuo. Ekomɛ jeɔ ni kakaaka a tsui mi sanehi kpo, nɛ ekomɛ hu daa si ha Mawu ma a tsuo a hiami níhi, kɛ a tsui mi sanehi.
Yesu ngɔ la amɛ kɛ tsu ní. Somi He ɔ ngmali ɔmɛ ekomɛ hu wo la amɛ a ta. Nɛ kɛ je sisije ɔ, La Womi ɔ ba pee jami womi pɔtɛɛ kɛ ha Kristo asafo ɔ.
Ngmami ɔ sisi tsɔɔmi komɛ ngma munyunyu “Sela” ngɛ La amɛ ekomɛ a mi. A li munyunyu nɛ ɔ sisi tutuutu. Se nya tsɔɔmi ko deɔ ke e maa pee kaa la gbi he blɔ nya tomi ko kɛ ha la tsɔɔlɔ ɔ. A tsu we munyunyu nɛ ɔ he ní ngɛ Dangme Baiblo ɔ mi.
Bɔ nɛ a dla womi ɔ mi ha
A dla la lafa kɛ nyingmi enuɔ nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ wo kuu, aloo womi enuɔ mi.

Title: LA 1
Content:
KEKLEEKLE WOMI
(La 1—41)
Bua jɔmi kpakpa
1A gbaa nɔ nɛ bui
nimli yayamihi a ga womi tue,
nɔ nɛ kɛ yayami peeli bɔɛ,
nɛ e hí he fɛu yeli a hi he;
2se mohu e bua jɔɔ Yawɛ mlaa a he,
nɛ e susuɔ he nyɔ kɛ pia.
3 E ngɛ kaa tso nɛ a du ngɛ pa tue,
nɛ woɔ yiblii ngɛ be nɛ sa mi.
E bahi gbli we gblegbleegble.
E yeɔ manye ngɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ mi.
4Se yayami peeli lɛɛ pi ja nɛ a ngɛ;
mɛɛ a ngɛ kaa jakati
nɛ kɔɔhiɔ muɔɔ kɛ yaa.
5Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a maa gbla yayami peeli a tue,
nɛ a kɛ mɛ be dali futue.
6Ejakaa Yawɛ buu dali a he,
se yayami peeli lɛɛ
a hɛ mi ma kpata.

Title: LA 2
Content:
Matsɛ ɔ nɛ Mawu hla a
1 Mɛni ba nɛ je ma amɛ
ngɛ basabasa pee?
Mɛni he je lɛ a ngɛ soe
yaka gu kikɛ nɛ ɔ?
2Zugba a nɔ matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ pee kake.
Nɔ yeli ɔmɛ so ngɔ wo Yawɛ,
kɛ matsɛ ɔ nɛ e hla a a he.
3A ke, “Nyɛ ha wa kpɔ wa he kɛ je a dɛ mi
nɛ waa ye wa he.”
4Nɔ nɛ hii si ngɛ hiɔwe lokoo ɔ
ngɛ mɛ muɔe.
Ee, Yawɛ ngɛ a he fɛu yee.
5Jehanɛ, Yawɛ kɛ abofu
ma kple a nɔ.
E hɛ maa dɔ;
6nɛ e ma de mɛ ke, “Imi Yawɛ nitsɛ
lɛ i ngɔ ye matsɛ ɔ ngɔ to Zion,
ye yoku klɔuklɔu ɔ nɔ.”
7 Matsɛ ɔ ke,
“Nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ de mi ɔ,
ma sɛɛ nɛ nyɛɛ nu.
Yawɛ de mi ke,
‘Ye bi ji mo;
mwɔnɛ ɔ, i fɔ mo.
8Bi mi, nɛ ma ha mo je ma amɛ tsuo;
zugba a tsuo ma ba pee o weto ní.
9 O kɛ dade tso maa gbla a tue.
O maa ywia mɛ wɔtsɔwɔtsɔ
kaa a ywiaa buɛ?’ ”
10Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ matsɛmɛ, nyɛɛ kase ní;
nyɛ, zugba a nɔ yeli,
nyɛɛ bu ga womi tue.
11Nyɛ sɔmɔ Yawɛ kɛ gbeye yemi.
12Nyɛ he nɛ do blibliibli,
nɛ nyɛ kpla si ngɛ e hɛ mi.
Ke pi jã a, e mi mi ma fu nyɛ si kake too,
nɛ nyɛ hɛ mi ma kpata.
Nihi tsuo nɛ ba saa we
ngɛ Yawɛ ngɔ ɔ
ma na bua jɔmi.

Title: LA 3
Content:
Mɔtu kue fami kɛ ha yemi kɛ buami
1 Yawɛ, hyɛ bɔ nɛ ye he nyɛli hiɛ ha!
Hyɛ kaa nihi babauu te si kɛ wo mi!
2Nɔ́ nɛ a ngɛ dee ji,
“Oo, Mawu be e he piɛe fɛɛ!”
3Se mo Yawɛ, o ngɛ kaa tsɛ̃i
nɛ buɔ ye he daa.
O woɔ mi mumi mi he wami,
nɛ o woɔ ye hɛ mi nyami.
4Ke i kpa ngmlaa kɛ tsɛ Yawɛ ɔ,
e heɔ nɔ ngɛ e yoku klɔuklɔu ɔ nɔ.
5I hwɔɔ si nɛ i hwɔɔ mahe,
nɛ i teɔ si ekohu,
ejakaa Yawɛ buɔ ye he.
6Ke nimli akpeakpe abɔ
ba sa ye yi kɛ kpe po,
i yi mɛ gbeye.
7Yawɛ, ye Mawu,
ba he ye yi wami koo!
Ejakaa mo lɛ o ma nyɛ
maa fia ye he nyɛli ɔmɛ tsuo ní.
Mo lɛ o ma nyɛ maa gbla a tue
nɛ a be nyɛe maa pee mi nɔ́ ko.
8Yawɛ, mo ji wa yi wami helɔ;
moo gbaa o ma a koo!

Title: LA 4
Content:
Gbɔkuɛ kue fami kɛ ha yemi kɛ buami
1Ye Mawu nɛ faa ye he,
moo bu ye kue fami ɔ tue koo!
Be ko nɛ ye yi fi ɔ,
mo lɛ o ba je mi.
Naa mi mɔbɔ koo,
nɛ o bu ye pɛɛ kpami ɔ tue.
2Nyɛ nimli adesahi,
mɛni be nyɛ ma pue ye hɛ mi si kɛ yaa si?
Nyɛ suɔ níhi nɛ a he be se nami,
nɛ lakpa munyuhi a se nyɛ dii.
Kɛ yaa si mɛni be nɛ nyɛ maa hi enɛ ɔ pee?
3Se nyɛ ná nɛ nyɛɛ le kaa
Yawɛ hla nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ nɛ da kɛ ha e he;
nɛ ke i tsɛ lɛ ɔ, e nuɔ.
4 Ke nyɛ mi mi fu ɔ,
nyɛ ko pee yayami.
Ke nyɛ hwɔɔ si ɔ, nyɛɛ pee dii,
nɛ nyɛɛ ya nyɛ yi mi.
5Nyɛɛ sã bɔ nɛ sa ha Yawɛ;
nyɛɛ ngɔ nyɛ hɛ kɛ fɔ e nɔ.
6Nihi babauu biɔ ke,
“Mɛnɔ po maa dloo wɔ nɔ́ ko?
Yawɛ, naa wɔ mɔbɔ koo!”
7Se imi lɛɛ o ha mi bua jɔmi babauu.
Ke nimli nɛ ɔmɛ a blɛfo kɛ wai ba saminya po,
a na we bua jɔmi kaa imi.
8Ma hwɔ si nɛ ma hwɔ mahe
ngɛ tue mi jɔmi mi.
Ejakaa mo, Yawɛ pɛ
lɛ o haa nɛ ye he mi jɔɔ mi.

Title: LA 5
Content:
Yawɛ, moo bu ye he
1Yawɛ, bu ye munyu ɔmɛ tue,
nɛ huu nɛ i ngɛ faeɔ, o pee he nɔ́ ko ha mi.
2Ye matsɛ kɛ ye Mawu!
I ngɛ mo tsɛe!
Bu mi tue koo!
3Yawɛ, mɔtu ɔ, o nuɔ ye gbi.
Ee, mɔtu ɔ, i faa kue kɛ haa mo,
nɛ i mlɛɔ, konɛ o he nɔ.
4Ejakaa pi Mawu nɛ náa
nɔ́ yayami he tsui ji mo;
yayami kɛ mo hí si.
5He nɔ woli be nyɛe maa ba o hɛ mi;
o sume nihi nɛ peeɔ yayami.
6Mo Yawɛ,
o kpataa lakpatsɛmɛ a hɛ mi.
Muɔ si pueli, kɛ nɔ sisili lɛɛ
o hiee mɛ kulaa.
7Se imi lɛɛ,
o mɔbɔ nami, kɛ o dloomi ɔ he je ɔ,
ma nyɛ ma ba o we klɔuklɔu ɔ;
ma ja mo ngɛ lejɛ ɔ kɛ gbeye yemi.
8Yawɛ ye he nyɛli ɔmɛ a he je ɔ,
piɛ ye he, konɛ ma pee nɔ nɛ da.
Tsɔɔ mi o blɔ ɔ saminya
nɛ ma nyɛɛ nɔ.
9 Ejakaa ye he nyɛli ɔmɛ tu we anɔkuale;
yayami hyi a tsui mi tɔ.
A tuɔ munyu dɔkɔdɔkɔ,
se lɛ tsuo kɛ gbenɔ ba a.
10Mawu, buu mɛ fɔ, nɛ o gbla a tue.
Ha nɛ a yi mi tomi yayami ɔmɛ
nɛ kpa kɛ bu mɛ nitsɛmɛ a nɔ.
Fie mɛ kɛ je o hɛ mi,
ejakaa a pee yayamihi gbegbeegbe kɛ si mo,
nɛ a tsɔ o hɛ mi atuã.
11Se nihi tsuo nɛ ba saa we ngɛ o ngɔ ɔ,
ha nɛ a nya, nɛ a la kɛ bua jɔmi daa.
Ni nɛmɛ nɛ suɔ mo ɔ, buu a he,
konɛ a na bua jɔmi ngɛ o mi.
12Yawɛ, o gbaa nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da,
nɛ o kɛ o suɔmi ɔ buu a he kaa tsɛ̃i.

Title: LA 6
Content:
Yemi kɛ buami ngɛ amanehlu mi
1 Yawɛ, koo ngɔ abofu kɛ ka ye hɛ mi;
koo ngɔ mi mi la kɛ gbla ye tue.
2Yawɛ naa mi mɔbɔ,
ejakaa ye he wami ta.
Yawɛ, tsa mi koo,
ejakaa i be he wami,
3nɛ imi nɔmlɔ ɔ tsuo i hao.
Yawɛ, mɛni be o maa mlɛ kɛ yaa si
loko o ma ba he mi?
4Yawɛ, ba he ye yi wami koo!
Naa mi mɔbɔ nɛ o kpɔ mi,
ejakaa o suɔmi ɔ be nyagbe.
5Nɔ ko kaii we mo ngɛ gbeje;
mɛnɔ lɛ ma je o yi ngɛ lejɛ ɔ?
6Kɔmɔ yemi sɔuu ha nɛ i gbɔjɔ;
daa nyɔ mi ɔ, ye sa pɔɔ kɛ vo nyu sɔuu;
daa nyɔ mi ɔ, i foɔ ya kɛ pɔɔ ye sɔne.
7Ye he nyɛli ɔmɛ haoɔ mi.
Kɔmɔ yemi sɔuu puɛ ye hɛngmɛ,
nɛ i hyɛ we nɔ́ kpakpa ko hu.
8 Nyɛ yayami peeli,
nyɛɛ je ye nɔ kɛ ya se,
ejakaa Yawɛ nu ye ya fomi ɔ.
9Yawɛ nu ye kue fami ɔ;
Yawɛ maa pee ye hiami ní ɔmɛ ha mi.
10Ha nɛ zo nɛ gbe ye he nyɛli ɔmɛ tsuo,
nɛ a hao wawɛɛ nitsɛ.
Ha nɛ a kɛ zo kpɔtɔɔ
nɛ kpale kɛ ho esɔ!

Title: LA 7
Content:
Dami sane yemi he kue fami
1Yawɛ, ye Mawu!
I ba sa we ngɛ o ngɔ.
Mo kpɔ mi kɛ je nihi tsuo
nɛ ngɛ mi yi mi wae ɔ a dɛ mi,
nɛ o he ye yi wami.
2Ke pi ja a, a maa gbla mi kɛ ya
he nɛ nɔ ko be nɛ maa je ngmlaa ha mi.
Lejɛ ɔ lɛ a ma ya tsɔtslɔɔ mi ngɛ
kaa bɔ nɛ jata peeɔ ɔ.
3-4Yawɛ, ye Mawu!
Ke i pee nɔ ko yayami,
aloo i wa ye he nyɛlɔ yi mi yaka gu,
ke i pee nɔ́ ko kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ,
5ha nɛ ye he nyɛli ɔmɛ nɛ
a nyɛɛ ye se nɛ a nu mi.
Ha nɛ a fia mi nɔ nɛ a gbe mi,
nɛ a si mi ngɛ zugba.
6Yawɛ, ye he nyɛli ɔmɛ te si kɛ wo mi;
tee si nɛ o kɛ mɛ nɛ kpe ha mi.
O mi mi nɛ fu mɛ;
ejakaa dami sane yemi ji nɔ́ nɛ o suɔ.
7Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ha nɛ a bua
je ma amɛ tsuo a nya kɛ bɔle mo,
nɛ o je hiɔwe kɛ ye a nɔ.
8Yawɛ, mo ji je ɔ tsuo kojolɔ.
Moo ye ye sane ha mi;
o le kaa i pee we nɔ́ ko nɛ dɛ.
9 Mawu nɛ yeɔ dami sane ji mo;
o le nimli a tsui mi, kɛ a juɛmi mi.
Ha nɛ nimli yayamihi nɛ jɔɔ yayami peemi,
konɛ nimli kpakpahi lɛɛ
o pee mɛ bɔ nɛ sa.
10Mawu ji ye he bulɔ.
Nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a,
e heɔ a yi wami.
11Mawu ji kojolɔ nɛ yeɔ dami sane;
daa nɛ ɔ, e mi mi fu yayami peeli.
12Ke a tsakee we a tsui ɔ,
Mawu maa duɔ e klaate ɔ nya.
E pee e kɛ̃ɛ̃ ɔ klaalo momo,
13nɛ e kɛ kɛ̃ɛ̃ mi bi nɛ nya ba hɔ nya.
E dla awi yemi ní kpahi hu
ngɔ to.
14Ke yiwutsotsɛ ngɛ nɔ́ yayami susue ɔ,
e hii nɔ́ ɔ plɛe ngɛ e yi mi kpamisa
kaa bɔ nɛ bimwɔyo hii plɛe
ngɛ yohɔyo mi mi ɔ.
Nyagbe ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ jeɔ kpo ji lakpa.
15E tsuaa muɔ kɛ haa ni kpahi;
se muɔ ɔ nɛ e tsua a,
lɛ nitsɛ nɛ e maa nɔ mi.
16E musu maa tloo lɛ nitsɛ;
lɛ nitsɛ e yayami ɔ maa ye lɛ awi.
17Ma na Yawɛ si;
ejakaa e yeɔ dami sane.
Ma la kɛ je Yawɛ Hiɔwe No ɔ yi.

Title: LA 8
Content:
David la
1Yawɛ, wa Nyɔmtsɛ!
Hyɛ kaa o biɛ pɛɛ ngɛ je ɔ mi tsuo,
nɛ a woɔ o hɛ mi nyami ngɛ hiɔwe lokoo!
2 O haa jokuɛwi, kɛ bimwɔwi he wami
nɛ a laa kɛ jeɔ o yi.
O he nyɛli ɔmɛ maa a nya,
nɛ a nyɛ we nɛ a peeɔ nɔ́ ko.
3Ke i susu níhi nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe a he,
nyɔhiɔ kɛ dodoehi,
ke i hyɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ
nɛ o kɛ o nine pee ɔ,
4 i biɔ ke,
“Mɛni ji nɔmlɔ adesa, nɛ o susuɔ e he?
Mɛni ji nɔmlɔ bi, nɛ o hyɛɛ e nɔ?”
5Nɛ́ o bɔ nɔmlɔ ɔ, nɔ́ ko bɔɔ pɛ
lɛ mo, Mawu ɔ o ngɔ kɛ pe lɛ.
Se o wo e hɛ mi nyami babauu.
6 O pee lɛ níhi tsuo nɛ o bɔ ɔ
a nɔ yelɔ.
O ngɔ ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ngɔ wo e dɛ mi:
7tohi, nahi, pu mi lohwehi,
8lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ, lohi,
kɛ nibɔ níhi tsuo nɛ ngɛ wo mi.
9Yawɛ, wa Nyɔmtsɛ!
Hyɛ kaa o biɛ pɛɛ ngɛ je ɔ mi tsuo.

Title: LA 9
Content:
Mawu sina la
1Yawɛ, ma na mo si kɛ ye tsui tsuo;
ma sɛɛ nyakpɛ níhi nɛ o pee ɔ.
2Mawu Ope, o he ɔ, ma la kɛ bua jɔmi;
ma la kɛ je o yi.
3Benɛ ye he nyɛli ɔmɛ kpale a se ɔ,
a nɔɔ si nɛ a gbo ngɛ o hɛ mi.
4Ejakaa o kojoɔ ngɛ dami kɛ anɔkuale nya;
o ye ye sane ɔ ha mi, nɛ o wo mi nguɔ.
5O ka je ma amɛ a hɛ mi.
O kpata yayami peeli a hɛ mi,
nɛ a biɛ laa pɛsɛpɛsɛ.
6Wa he nyɛli ɔmɛ a hɛ mi kpata;
a ma amɛ hu a hɛ mi kpata,
nɛ nɔ́ ko be nɛ a kɛ ma kai mɛ hu.
7Se Yawɛ lɛɛ e ngɛ daa;
e hii si ngɛ e kojomi sɛ ɔ nɔ.
8Nɛ e kɛ anɔkuale, kɛ dami sane yemi
maa kojo je ɔ, kɛ e mi nimli ɔmɛ.
9Yawɛ ji wesa he
kɛ ha nihi nɛ a waa mɛ yi mi.
Haomi be mi ɔ, e ngɔ lɛ a naa he jɔmi ngɛ.
10Yawɛ, nihi nɛ le mo ɔ,
a ngɔɔ a hɛ kɛ fɔɔ o nɔ.
Ejakaa ni nɛmɛ nɛ hla o se blɔ ɔ,
mo Yawɛ, o kua we mɛ.
11Nyɛ la kɛ je Yawɛ yi;
Yawɛ nɛ ngɛ Zion ɔ, nyɛ je e yi.
Nyɛɛ sɛɛ níhi nɛ e pee ɔ
kɛ ha je ma amɛ tsuo.
12Mawu kaiɔ nɔ́ nali,
nɛ e yeɔ a he lue.
Ke nɔ́ nali fa kue ha Mawu ɔ,
e nuɔ; e hɛ ji a nɔ.
13Yawɛ, mo nɛ o jeɔ mi
kɛ jeɔ gbenɔ dɛ mi.
Hyɛ bɔ nɛ ye he nyɛli ngɛ mi haoe ha
nɛ o na mi mɔbɔ,
14konɛ ma na bua jɔmi
nɛ ma je o yi
ngɛ Yerusalem bi ɔmɛ a hɛ mi;
nɛ ma nya kɛ tsɔɔ kaa
o he ye yi wami.
15Muɔ ɔ nɛ je ma amɛ tsua a,
mɛ nitsɛmɛ a nɔ mi.
Klama a nɛ a tsɔ kɛ laa a,
mɛ nitsɛmɛ a nane ya du lɛ.
16Yawɛ je e he kpo;
e ye dami sane,
nɛ yayami peeli a nane
ya du klama a nɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a tsɔ ɔ.
17Nimli yayamihi, kɛ mahi tsuo
nɛ a hɛ je Mawu nɔ ɔ,
a nyagbe ji gbenɔ.
18Ejakaa pi daa
nɛ hɛ maa je dɛgutsɛmɛ a nɔ;
ohiatsɛmɛ a hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi be yaka pee.
19Yawɛ, tee si;
ko ha nɛ nɔmlɔ adesa nɛ ye o nɔ!
Ha nɛ a kojo je ma amɛ ngɛ o hɛ mi.
20Yawɛ, wo je ma amɛ a he gbeye,
konɛ a le kaa nimli adesahi kɛkɛ ji mɛ.

Title: LA 10
Content:
Dami sane yemi he kue fami
1Yawɛ, mɛni hɛ mo
kɛ ya se tsitsaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ?
Mɛni he je o ya laa o he
ngɛ wa haomi be nɛ ɔ mi ɔ?
2Yayami peeli ngɛ a he nɔ woe,
nɛ a ngɛ ohiatsɛmɛ yi mi wae.
Ha nɛ ga yayamihi nɛ a to ɔ
nɛ kpa bu mɛ nitsɛmɛ a nɔ.
3Yayami peelɔ fĩaa kɛ fɔɔ
níhi nɛ e tsui suɔ a nɔ.
Nɔmlɔ nɛ hɛ kɔɔ nɔ́ nɔ ɔ,
e gbiɛɛ Yawɛ, nɛ e kuaa lɛ.
4Yayami peelɔ ɔ he nɔ womi
ha we nɛ e hlaa Mawu se blɔ.
E susumi tsuo ji “Mawu ko be.”
5Yayami peelɔ yeɔ manye ngɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ mi.
E nɛ kaa Mawu tue gblami ko ngɛ ha lɛ.
E he nyɛli lɛɛ, pe e yeɔ a he fɛu.
6E deɔ ngɛ e yi mi ke,
“Nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko be mi pee;
haomi ko be ye nɔ bae gblegbleegble.”
7 Munyuhi nɛ jeɔ e nya ji gbiɛmi kɛ sisimi,
kɛ níhi nɛ woɔ nɔ susuma he gbeye.
E he sɔɔ kɛ tuɔ yakayaka munyuhi,
kɛ munyuhi nɛ kɛ nɔ woɔ haomi mi.
8E woɔ ka ngɛ laami hehi ngɛ kɔpehi a mi,
nɛ e gbee nihi nɛ pee we nɔ́ ko yaka gu.
Daa nɛ ɔ, e ngɛ nihi
nɛ a ní ngɛ mɔbɔ dae.
9E buɔ si ngɛ e laami he ɔ
kaa jata ngɛ e muɔ mi.
E woɔ ka nɛ e nuu
nihi nɛ a ní ngɛ mɔbɔ.
Ke e nine su a nɔ
kɛkɛ e gbla mɛ kɛ ho.
10E kɛ e he wami tsuo fiaa
nihi nɛ a ní ngɛ mɔbɔ nɔ́
nɛ a nɔɔ si.
11Nɔ́ nɛ yiwutsotsɛ nɛ ɔ
deɔ ngɛ e yi mi ji,
“Oo, Mawu hɛ je nɔ;
Mawu má e hɛngmɛ;
e hyɛ we mi tete po!”
12Yawɛ Mawu,
gbla yayami peeli a tue,
nɛ o hɛ ko je nɔ́ nali a nɔ.
13Mɛni he je yayami peelɔ ma kua Mawu?
Mɛni he je lɛ e ma de ngɛ e yi mi ke,
“Oo, e tsa be mi nɔ́ ko pee” ɔ?
14Se moo lɛɛ o ngɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ hyɛe.
Niinɛ, o ngɛ haomi ɔ, kɛ aywilɛho ɔ hyɛe,
nɛ o maa pee he nɔ́ ko kɛ̃.
Nɔ nɛ e fi lɛ ɔ,
o nɔ lɛ e ngɔɔ e hɛ kɛ fɔɔ.
Mo ji awusahi a he piɛlɔ.
15Moo ku yiwutsotsɛmɛ, kɛ yayami peeli
a he wami nya, nɛ o gbla a tue
kɛ yaa si yayami peemi se maa po.
16Yawɛ ji matsɛ
kɛ je neneene kɛ yaa neneene.
Je ma amɛ gbo ta e zugba a nɔ.
17Yawɛ, hiami níhi nɛ
nɔ́ nali kɛ ba fɔ o hɛ mi ɔ, o le.
Moo pee a hiami ní ɔmɛ ha mɛ,
konɛ a ná he wami he.
18Moo ye awusahi, kɛ nɔ́ nali a sane ha mɛ,
konɛ nɔmlɔ adesa kó wo a he gbeye hu.

Title: LA 11
Content:
I ngɔ ye hɛ kɛ fɔ Yawɛ nɔ
1I ba sa we ngɛ Yawɛ ngɔ.
Mɛni he je lɛ nyɛ deɔ mi ke,
“Tee kaa lohwe pɛlitsɛ
kɛ ya yo ɔmɛ a nɔ.
2Hyɛ, yayami peeli dɔ a kɛ̃ɛ̃ ɔmɛ;
a pee a kɛ̃ɛ̃ mi bi ɔmɛ klaalo
nɛ́ a ma tsɛ̃ dali ngɛ diblii mi.
3Be mi nɛ mlaa gbo, nɛ blɔ nya tomi kpakpa be hu ɔ,
mɛni dalɔ ma nyɛ maa pee?”
4Yawɛ ngɛ e we klɔuklɔu ɔ;
e matsɛ sɛ ɔ, hiɔwe lɛ e ngɛ.
E hɛngmɛ ngɛ nimli adesahi hyɛe ngɛ he tsuaa he;
e le níhi nɛ a ngɛ pee.
5Yawɛ kaa dali.
Se yayami peeli, kɛ yiwutsotsɛmɛ lɛɛ
e sume mɛ kulaa.
6Yawɛ ma ha
la nɛ ngɛ tsoe gegeege maa je hiɔwe
ba pue yayami peeli a nɔ;
nɛ kɔɔhiɔ nɛ mi dɔ la maa fia kɛ wo mɛ.
7Ejakaa Yawɛ ɔ, dalɔ ji lɛ;
e suɔ kaa a pee níhi nɛ da.
Dali maa na e hɛ mi.

Title: LA 12
Content:
Kue fami kɛ ha yemi kɛ buami
1Yawɛ, moo piɛ wa he,
ejakaa nɔmlɔ kpakpa be hu;
anɔkualetsɛmɛ ta zugba a nɔ.
2Nɔ tsuaa nɔ ngɛ e nyɛmi lakpa yee.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ kɛ munyu ngɔngɔɛ
ngɛ e nyɛmi sisie.
3Yawɛ, nihi nɛ tuɔ munyu dɔkɔdɔkɔ,
kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ fĩaa a,
mo kpata mɛ tsuo a hɛ mi.
4A deɔ ke, “Wa ngɔɔ wa nya mi munyu
kɛ naa nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ wa ngɛ hlae.
Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ wa suɔ kaa wa ma de ɔ,
wa ma de. Mɛnɔ ma nyɛ maa tsi wa nya?”
5Se Yawɛ ke,
“Akɛnɛ a ngɛ ohiatsɛmɛ yi mi wae,
nɛ dɛgutsɛmɛ ngɛ kɛmɛe he je ɔ,
jehanɛ lɛɛ ma te si, nɛ ma ha mɛ
he jɔmi nɛ a ngɛ hlae ɔ.”
6Yawɛ siwo ɔmɛ ɔ, anɔkuale sɔuu.
A ngɛ kaa sika hiɔ nɛ a tsu he
si kpaago ngɛ flɔɔnɔɔ mi.
7-8Nimli yayamihi ngɛ he tsuaa he,
nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ ngɛ nɔ́ yayami yi jee.
Yawɛ, wa kpa mo pɛɛ!
Mo je wɔ ngɛ kikɛmɛ a nimli a dɛ mi.
Nɛ o bu wa he
kɛ je yi nɔ nɛ ɔ kɛ ya neneene.

Title: LA 13
Content:
Kue fami kɛ ha yemi kɛ buami
1Yawɛ, kɛ yaa si mɛni be nɛ
o hɛ maa je ye nɔ?
Kɛ yaa neneene lo?
Mɛni be o maa laa mi kɛ yaa si?
2Mɛni be ma na nɔ́ kɛ yaa si?
Aywilɛho ma hyi ye tsui mi daa ligbi
kɛ yaa si mɛni be?
Ye he nyɛli ma ná ye he blɔ daa nɛ
kɛ yaa si mɛni be?
3Yawɛ, ye Mawu!
Moo hyɛ mi, nɛ o ha mi heto.
Ha mi nɔmlɔ tso he wami,
konɛ ma ko gbo.
4Ke pi ja a, ye he nyɛli ɔmɛ ma de ke,
“Wa ye e nɔ.”
A ma nya kaa a nine su ye nɔ.
5Se imi lɛɛ, o suɔmi nɛ ngɛ daa a,
lɔ ɔ nɔ lɛ i ngɔ ye hɛ kɛ fɔ.
Ma ná bua jɔmi,
ejakaa o ma he ye yi wami.
6Ma la kɛ je mo Yawɛ o yi,
ejakaa o pee ye hiami ní ɔmɛ ha mi.

Title: LA 14
Content:
Nɔmlɔ adesa yi mi wa
(La 53)
1 Kuasiahi a susumi ji, “Mawu ko be.”
Mɛ tsuo a puɛ; ní yayamihi sɔuu lɛ a peeɔ;
nɔ ko nɔ ko be nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da.
2Yawɛ hyɛɛ nimli adesahi
ngɛ zugba kɛ jeɔ hiɔwe.
E hyɛɛ kaa e maa na nɔ ko nɛ le nɔ́,
nɛ hlaa lɛ Mawu ɔ se blɔ lo.
3Se mɛ tsuo a laa blɔ;
mɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ a puɛ.
Nɔ ko nɔ ko be nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da;
dɛbi, nɔ kake ngmelu po be.
4Yawɛ ngɛ bie ke,
“Yayami peeli nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, anɛ a be juɛmi lo?
A ní tsumi kɛkɛ ji kaa a fia ye ma a ojo,
se imi, Yawɛ lɛɛ a tsɛ we ye biɛ.”
5Sawale nɛ nya wa maa nu mɛ;
ejakaa nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a,
Mawu kɛ mɛ ngɛ.
6Ke yayami peeli ha nɛ
ohiatsɛmɛ a yi mi tomi pee basaa a,
a ma ya sa we ngɛ Yawɛ ngɔ kɛ̃.
7Mɛnɔ maa je Zion ba he Israel yi wami?
Yawɛ ma a nɛ a nuu kɛ ho ɔ,
ke lɛ, Yawɛ ɔ kpale mɛ kɛ ba ekohu ɔ,
Israel ma na bua jɔmi, nɛ Yakob ma nya.

Title: LA 15
Content:
Nɔ́ nɛ Mawu suɔ
1Yawɛ, mɛnɔ maa hi o bo tsu ɔ mi?
O yoku klɔuklɔu ɔ nɔ ɔ, mɛnɔ maa hi lejɛ ɔ?
2Nɔ nɛ piami ko be e he,
nɛ e peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da.
Nɔ nɛ tuɔ anɔkuale sisiisi,
3nɛ e yi nɔ he sieku.
Nɔ nɛ tu we nɔ he munyu,
nɛ e pee we e nyɛmi yayami.
4Nɔ nɛ tuɔ munyu kɛ siɔ yayami peeli,
nɛ e woɔ nihi nɛ yeɔ Yawɛ gbeye ɔ a hɛ mi nyami.
Nɔ nɛ ke e
ka kita, nɛ e kpale we e nya se,
ke ji kaa lɔ ɔ maa pee haomi ha lɛ po.
5Nɔ nɛ ke e pa sika ha nihi ɔ,
e he we hekpa.
Nɔ nɛ he we nyɔ mi ní
nɛ e kɛ ye odase ngɔ si nihi nɛ yi fɔ.
Nɔ nɛ peeɔ ní nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ,
nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko be e he sae.

Title: LA 16
Content:
Ngɔɔ o hɛ ngɔ fɔ Mawu nɔ
1Mawu, moo bu ye he,
ejakaa i ngɔ ye hɛ kɛ fɔ o nɔ.
2I de Yawɛ ke,
“Yawɛ, ye Nyɔmtsɛ ji mo;
o se ɔ, i pa be nɔ́ kpakpa ko hu.”
3Hyɛ bɔ nɛ Yawɛ e ni klɔuklɔuhi
nɛ ngɛ je ɔ mi ɔ a hɛ mi ngɛ nyami ha!
Mɛ ji ni nɛmɛ nɛ i naa a he bua jɔmi.
4Nihi nɛ a he sɔɔ kɛ ya nyɛɛɔ
mawu kpahi a se ɔ,
a haomi maa hiɛ babauu.
I be mɛ futue kɛ pee a tɛlimi kusumi ɔmɛ;
i be a biɛ ta woe tete.
5Yawɛ ji ye nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́;
lɛ nɛ e haa mi nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ hia mi.
Nɔ́ nɛ maa ba ye nɔ hwɔɔ se hu,
Yawɛ dɛ mi lɛ e ngɛ.
6O ke mi ní kpakpahi babauu;
niinɛ, i ngɛ weto ní kpakpahi.
7Ma je Yawɛ yi,
ejakaa e ha mi juɛmi.
Nyɔ mi po, ye he nile kɛ mi tuɔ munyu.
8 I susuɔ Yawɛ he daa.
Nɛ́ Yawɛ ngɛ ye kasa nya nɛ ɔ,
nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko be mi pee.
9Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, imi nɔmlɔ ɔ tsuo,
i na bua jɔmi, kɛ he jɔmi.
10 Ejakaa o maa bu ye he,
nɛ gbenɔ he wami be ye he blɔ nae.
Nɔ nɛ o suɔ lɛ ɔ,
o be e he ngmɛɛe nɛ e hɛ mi nɛ kpata.
11O maa tsɔɔ mi blɔ ɔ nɛ yaa wami mi ɔ.
Lejɛ ɔ, ngɛ o hɛ mi ɔ,
ma na bua jɔmi nitsɛnitsɛ,
bua jɔmi nɛ se be poe kɛ maa ya neneene.

Title: LA 17
Content:
David fa kue ha Mawu
1Yawɛ, moo piɛ ye he koo!
Hyɛ kaa i yeɔ anɔkuale, nɛ i sisi we nɔ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i kpa mo pɛɛ nɛ o bu
kue nɛ i ngɛ fae kɛ hɛdɔ nɛ ɔ tue.
2Mo nɛ́ o yeɔ dami sane,
moo wo mi nguɔ koo!
3Ke o hyɛ ye tsui mi,
ke o ba slaa mi nyɔ mi nɛ o ka mi ɔ,
o be yayami ko nae ngɛ ye he.
Ye munyu peeɔ anɔkuale; nɔ́ ko piɛ we he.
4I yeɔ o mlaa amɛ a nɔ,
nɛ i kɛ basabasa peeli bɔɛ.
5O blɔ ɔ nɔ lɛ i nyɛɛɔ daa;
i sane we kɛ ji nɔ hyɛ gblegbleegble.
6Mawu, i ngɛ kue fae kɛ ngɛ mo hae,
ejakaa i le kaa o maa pee ye hiami ní ɔmɛ ha mi.
Lɛɛ mo plɛ o hɛ mi kɛ kpee mi mɔ,
konɛ o nu ye munyu ɔmɛ.
7Mo je o nyakpɛ suɔmi nɛ ngɛ daa a kpo
kɛ tsɔɔ nihi nɛ ngɔɔ a hɛ kɛ fɔɔ o nɔ ɔ;
nɛ o kpɔ mɛ kɛ je ni nɛmɛ nɛ teɔ si
kɛ woɔ mɛ ɔ a dɛ mi.
8Moo baa ye yi kaa bɔ nɛ nɔ baa
lɛ nitsɛ e hɛngmɛ yi ɔ.
Ngɔɔ mi kɛ laa ngɛ o pɛli hɔ̃ ɔ sisi,
9kɛ je yiwutsotsɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ mi
yi mi wae ɔ a dɛ mi,
kɛ je ye he nyɛli nɛ bɔle mi ɔ a dɛ mi.
10Mɔbɔ nami ko be a mi;
he nɔ womi munyuhi lɛ jeɔ a nya.
11Jehanɛ lɛɛ a sa ye yi;
a ngɔ a hɛ ngɔ ká mi,
konɛ a tsɛ̃ mi kɛ fɔ si.
12A ngɛ kaa jatahi nɛ ya wo mi ká;
a ngɛ mlɛe nɛ a tsɔtslɔɔ mi.
13Yawɛ, yaa nɛ o kɛ mɛ ya kpe
nɛ o ye a nɔ.
Ngɔɔ o klaate ɔ kɛ kpɔ mi
kɛ je yiwutsotsɛmɛ a dɛi.
14Jé mi kɛ je nihi nɛ ná je nɛ ɔ mi
níhi tsuo nɛ a ngɛ hlae ɔ a dɛ mi.
Ngɔɔ haomihi nɛ o ngɔ to ha mɛ ɔ kɛ gbla a tue.
Ha nɛ a bimɛ ba na haomi ɔ bɔ nɛ sa,
nɛ eko nɛ piɛ ha a bibimɛ.
15Se imi lɛɛ ma na o hɛ mi,
ejakaa i pee we yayami ko.
Nɛ ke ye hɛ tsɛ ɔ, ma ná bua jɔmi babauu
kaa i na mo hɛ mi kɛ hɛ mi.

Title: LA 18
Content:
David manye la
(Samuel II, 22.1-51)
1Yawɛ, i suɔ mo!
Mo ji ye yi baalɔ.
2Yawɛ ji nɔ nɛ heɔ ye yi wami;
ye tɛ sa, kɛ ye mɔ nguaa.
Lɛ ji ye Mawu, kɛ ye wesa he.
Yawɛ ngɛ kaa tsɛ̃i kɛ ha mi;
e buɔ ye he, nɛ e haa nɛ i yeɔ ye he.
3Ma tsɛ Yawɛ,
nɛ e ma je mi kɛ maa je ye he nyɛli a dɛ mi.
A je Yawɛ yi!
4Gbenɔ oslaa bɔle mi kɛ kpe;
niinɛ, nimli yayamihi babauu bɔle mi
kaa pa nɛ hia kɛ bee.
5Gbeje kpa amɛ fi mi,
nɛ gbenɔ tsɔ mi klama.
6Ngɛ ye haomi be ɔ mi ɔ,
i tsɛ Yawɛ.
I tsɛ ye Mawu,
nɛ i de lɛ ke e piɛ ye he.
E nu ye gbi ngɛ e we klɔuklɔu ɔ,
nɛ e bu ye kue fami ɔ tue.
7Kɛkɛ nɛ zugba mimiɛ,
nɛ yo ɔmɛ a sisi tomi ɔmɛ hɛ mɛ
kɛ je a blɔ hehi, nɛ a mimiɛ,
ejakaa Yawɛ mi mi fu.
8La su ku hia kɛ je e gugwɔ puɔhi a mi;
la nɛ ngɛ tsoe je e nya mi,
nɛ hã nɛ tsɛ̃ je e mi.
9E ha nɛ hiɔwe nya ba si, nɛ e kple si;
nɛ diblii kpii ngɛ e nane sisi.
10E hi kerub nɔ kɛ te;
e he sɔ kɛ nyɛɛ kɔɔhiɔ mi kɛ ba.
11E ngɔ diblii kɛ ha e he kaa bo,
nɛ bɔku kpii kɛ e mi nyu gbagbaagba ha e yi nɔ.
12Gbiɛ ngo ngu, kɛ la
je oslabai mi ngɛ e hɛ mi
kɛ gblee bɔku kpii ɔ mi kɛ be.
13Jehanɛ Yawɛ ha hiɔwe si;
Hiɔwe No ɔ wo gbi;
gbiɛ ngo ngu nɛ, nɛ oslabai gba.
14Ee, e tsɛ̃ e kɛ̃ɛ̃ mi bi ɔmɛ,
nɛ e he nyɛli ɔmɛ gbɛ fĩa.
E ha nɛ oslabai gba, nɛ a pee basaa.
15Yawɛ, benɛ o ké o he nyɛli ɔmɛ a yi,
nɛ o kɛ abofu wo gbi ɔ,
nyu dɔ ɔmɛ je kpo,
nɛ je ɔ sisi tomi ɔmɛ fɔɔ si paa.
16Yawɛ sɔ́le e nine kɛ je hiɔwe;
e nu mi, nɛ e gbla mi kɛ je nyu babauu ɔ mi.
17E kpɔ mi kɛ je ye he nyɛli ɔmɛ a dɛ mi;
e je mi kɛ je nihi tsuo nɛ nyɛɛ mi ɔ a dɛ mi.
Niinɛ, a he wa pe mi.
18A ba tua mi ngɛ ye haomi ligbi ɔ nɔ,
se Yawɛ hede ha mi.
19E ngɔ mi kɛ ba he nɛ he jɔmi ngɛ.
E he ye yi wami, ejakaa e suɔ mi.
20Yawɛ wo mi hiɔ bɔ nɛ sa,
ejakaa i peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da.
Yawɛ gbaa mi,
ejakaa ye he tsɔ.
21I ye Yawɛ mlaa amɛ a nɔ,
nɛ i pee we yayami ko kɛ puɛ
i kɛ ye Mawu ɔ wa kpɛti.
22I ye e mlaa amɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ a nɔ;
i tɔ̃ we ekoeko.
23Yayami ko yayami ko be ye he;
i yi fɔ ngɛ nɔ́ ko mi.
24Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, Yawɛ gbaa mi;
ejakaa ye he tsɔ, nɛ i peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da.
25Yawɛ, nihi nɛ yeɔ anɔkuale ɔ,
o jeɔ o he si kɛ tsɔɔ mɛ kaa anɔkualetsɛ.
Nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a,
o jeɔ o he si kɛ tsɔɔ mɛ kaa dalɔ.
26Nihi nɛ a he tsɔ ɔ,
o jeɔ o he si kɛ tsɔɔ mɛ kaa o he tsɔ.
Se yiwutsotsɛmɛ lɛɛ
o ha we mɛ hɛ mi kulaa.
27Nihi nɛ baa a he si ɔ,
o heɔ a yi wami.
Se ni nɛmɛ nɛ woɔ a he nɔ lɛɛ
o baa mɛ si.
28Ejakaa mo Yawɛ, ye Mawu ɔ,
mo lɛ o haa mi la.
Mo lɛ o fieɔ diblii kɛ jeɔ ye he.
29Mo Mawu, o he wami nya a,
ma nyɛ ma tu gbogbo kɛ ya tua ye he nyɛli,
nɛ ma ye a nɔ.
30Mawu nɛ ɔ loo!
E ní peemi níhi hi kɛ pi si.
Ke e wo si ɔ, e baa mi.
Nihi tsuo nɛ ya saa we ngɛ e ngɔ ɔ,
e buu a he.
31Se mɛnɔ ji Mawu ngɛ Yawɛ se?
Mɛnɔ ji tɛ sa? Pi wa Mawu ɔ lo?
32Lɛ ji Mawu nɛ haa mi he wami;
lɛ nɛ haa ye blɔ daa mi.
33 Lɛ nɛ haa nɛ ye nane nya sɔɔ
kaa odabɔ nane nya.
E ngɔ mi ngɔ to yo ɔmɛ a nɔ
ngɛ he jɔmi mi.
34E tsɔɔ mi ta hwumi níhi a he ní tsumi;
akɔblee kɛ̃ɛ̃ po ma nyɛ ma tsɛ̃.
35Yawɛ, o bu ye he, nɛ o he ye yi wami;
o hyɛ ye nɔ saminya, nɛ i pee nɔmlɔ.
O pɛtɛ ye he wawɛɛ,
nɛ lɔ ɔ ha nɛ i ye ye he.
36O ha we nɛ ye he nyɛli a nine nɛ su ye nɔ;
i nɔɛ si hyɛ gblegbleegble.
37I nyɛɛ ye he nyɛli ɔmɛ a se kɛ fo
kɛ ya si i nuu mɛ.
I kpale we ye se kɛ ya si i kpata a hɛ mi.
38I fia mɛ ní, nɛ a nɔɔ si ngɛ ye nane nya;
a be nyɛe maa te si hu.
39Mo lɛ o ha mi he wami nɛ i kɛ hwu ta;
mo lɛ o ha nɛ i ye ye he nyɛli ɔmɛ a nɔ.
40Mo lɛ o ha nɛ ye he nyɛli ɔmɛ tu fo.
Nihi nɛ nyɛɔ mi ɔ, mo lɛ o ha nɛ i kpata a hɛ mi.
41A kpa ngmlaa kaa nɔ ko ma ba piɛ a he lo,
se nɔ ko ji ngmlaa ha mɛ.
A tsɛ Yawɛ, se e pui a nya mi.
42I wɛɛ mɛ mɔnyɔmɔnyɔ
kaa bunyuku nɛ kɔɔhiɔ sɛ mi.
I naa a nɔ kaa blɔ nɔ mɔsɔ.
43O je mi kɛ je atuã tsɔli a dɛ mi,
nɛ o pee mi je ma amɛ a nyatsɛ.
Ma nɛ i li mɛ po ma ba sɔmɔ mi.
44Nibwɔhi ma ba kpla si ha mi;
ke a nu ye he pɛ a maa bu mi tue.
45Nibwɔ ɔmɛ a tsui maa po, nɛ a kɛ he domi
maa je a mɔ nguangua amɛ a mi kɛ ba.
46Yawɛ hɛ ngɛ! A je ye he bulɔ ɔ yi!
Mawu ɔ nɛ heɔ ye yi wami ɔ,
a wo e hɛ mi nyami.
47Mawu nɛ ɔ lɛ gbla ye he nyɛli ɔmɛ a tue;
lɛ nɛ ngɔ je ma amɛ kɛ wo ye sisi,
48nɛ e je mi kɛ je ye he nyɛli ɔmɛ a dɛ mi.
Yawɛ, mo lɛ o ha nɛ i ye ye he nyɛli ɔmɛ a nɔ,
nɛ o je mi kɛ je yiwutsotsɛmɛ a dɛ mi.
49 Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, ma je o yi ngɛ je ma amɛ a hɛ mi;
ma la kɛ je mo, Yawɛ o yi.
50Mawu haa nɛ David yeɔ kunimi daa.
Matsɛ ɔ nɛ lɛ, Mawu ɔ pɔ nu ɔ,
e naa lɛ mɔbɔ daa;
lɛ, kɛ e bimɛ, kɛ e nina tsuo.

Title: LA 19
Content:
Adebɔ níhi woɔ Mawu hɛ mi nyami
1Mawu nibɔ níhi nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe
ngɛ e yi jee, nɛ a ngɛ e nine nya ní tsumi kpo jee.
2Daa ligbi ɔ, mɔtu jio, gbɔkuɛ jio,
nibɔ ní nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ Mawu he ní sɛɛe.
3Munyu ko ji a nya a,
nɔ ko nɔ ko nui a gbi hulɔ.
4 Se kɛ̃ ɔ, a nuɔ a he ngɛ je ɔ mi tsuo;
a munyu ɔ pɛɛ kɛ yaa je mi nyagbe he tɔɔ.
Mawu pee sihi he ha pu ngɛ hiɔwe.
5Ke pu gba hleii saminyayoo kɛ ma kikɛ nɛ ɔ,
e ngɛ kaa ayɛflo huno nɛ je kpo ngɛ tsu mi kɛ ma,
aloo fo tulɔ kpanaa nɛ yaa tu fo kɛ bua jɔmi.
6Pu jeɔ ngɛ hiɔwe nyagbe he kake;
e bɔleɔ si kɛ yaa hiɔwe nyagbe he kake,
nɛ e la a, nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko nyɛ we nya dami.
Yawɛ mlaa a
7Yawɛ mlaa a hi kɛ pi si;
e haa nɔ naa he wami he.
Yawɛ mlaa a, anɔkuale sɔuu,
e haa nɛ kuasia leɔ ní.
8Yawɛ mlaa amɛ da pɛpɛɛpɛ;
nihi nɛ yeɔ nɔ ɔ, a naa bua jɔmi.
Yawɛ mlaa a he tsɔ;
e haa nɛ nɔ nuɔ níhi a sisi.
9Yawɛ gbeye yemi ɔ hi;
e ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene.
Ke Yawɛ kojo ɔ, anɔkuale sɔuu;
niinɛ, e yeɔ dami sane be tsuaa be.
10A he ngɛ akɔnɔ pe sika tsu ngmingmiingmi;
a ngɔɔ pe hwo,
hwo nɛ je hwo gbaku mi pue si.
11Ke i ye mlaa amɛ a nɔ ɔ,
imi o tsɔlɔ ɔ, i naa nile,
kɛ se nami kpahi babauu.
12Mɛnɔ ma nyɛ maa na lɛ nitsɛ e tɔmihi?
Yawɛ, tɔmihi nɛ i pee ngɛ laami mi ɔ,
ngɔɔ kɛ pa mi!
13Yawɛ, moo bu ye he,
nɛ ma ko jé ye hɛ mi paa kɛ pee yayami;
ko ha nɛ jamɛ a yayami ɔmɛ nɛ a ye ye nɔ.
Ja jã loko ye he ma tsɔ kɛ pi si,
nɛ i be ye he ngɔe kɛ wo yayami nguahi a mi.
14Yawɛ, ye wesa he, kɛ ye kpɔlɔ!
Ha nɛ ye nya mi munyu, kɛ ye tsui mi susumi
nɛ sa o hɛ mi.

Title: LA 20
Content:
Kue fami kɛ ha manye yemi
1Ke o ngɛ haomi mi, nɛ o tsɛ Yawɛ ɔ,
Yawɛ nɛ bu mo tue.
Yakob Mawu ɔ nɛ bu o he.
2É je e we klɔuklɔu ɔ nɛ e piɛ o he;
é wo mo he wami kɛ je Zion yo ɔ nɔ.
3Yawɛ ma kai o nike ní ɔmɛ tsuo,
nɛ e ma he o sami bɔ ɔmɛ hulɔ.
4E ma ha mo níhi nɛ o ngɛ hlae ɔ,
nɛ níhi tsuo nɛ o to ke o maa pee ɔ maa ba mi.
5Ke o ye kunimi ɔ, wa ma hwɔ lele.
Wa ma wo aflangaa nɔ ngɛ wa Mawu ɔ hɛ mi
kɛ tsɔɔ kaa wa bua jɔ.
Yawɛ nɛ ha mo níhi tsuo nɛ o fa a he kue ɔ.
6Jehanɛ lɛɛ i le kaa Yawɛ ma he
nɔ nɛ e pɔ lɛ nu ɔ yi wami.
E maa bu lɛ tue kɛ maa je e hiɔwe klɔuklɔu ɔ;
e maa piɛ e he kɛ ye kunimi nguanguahi.
7Ni komɛ fĩaa kɛ fɔɔ a ta zugba lɛhi a nɔ;
ni komɛ hu fĩaa kɛ fɔɔ a we okpɔngɔhi a nɔ;
se wɔɔ lɛɛ Yawɛ, wa Mawu ɔ
biɛ mi wa fĩaa ngɛ.
8Mɛɛ a ma tɛ nɔ, nɛ a maa nɔɔ si,
se wɔɔ lɛɛ wa maa te kɛ da si kɛ he wami.
9Yawɛ, mo he matsɛ ɔ yi wami;
ke wa tsɛ mo ɔ, bu wɔ tue.

Title: LA 21
Content:
Kunimi yemi sina la
1Yawɛ, matsɛ ɔ bua jɔ e he,
ejakaa o ha lɛ he wami.
Matsɛ ɔ ngɛ nyae,
ejakaa o ha nɛ e ye kunimi.
2O ha lɛ nɔ́ nɛ e ngɛ hlae ɔ;
nɔ́ nɛ e bi mo ɔ hu, o kua we.
3O gbaa lɛ kɛ ní kpakpahi babauu;
o fi lɛ jlasi nɛ a kɛ sika tsu ngmingmiingmi pee.
4E bi mo ke o ha nɛ e wami se nɛ kɛ,
nɛ o kplɛɛ nɔ ha lɛ.
O ha lɛ be babauu nitsɛ nɛ nyagbe be he.
5O piɛ e he, nɛ e hɛ mi ba nyami;
o ha nɛ e ná biɛ, kɛ agboje.
6Niinɛ, o gbaa lɛ saminya kɛ yaa neneene;
o haa nɛ e naa bua jɔmi ngɛ o hɛ mi.
7Matsɛ ɔ ngɔ e hɛ kɛ fɔ
mo Yawɛ, Hiɔwe No ɔ, o nɔ.
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko be lɛ pee;
ejakaa o suɔmi ɔ ngɛ daa.
8Matsɛ, o nine maa su o he nyɛli ɔmɛ tsuo a nɔ.
Nihi tsuo nɛ sume mo ɔ, o nine maa su a nɔ.
9Ke o je o he kpo ɔ, a hɛ mi ma kpata
kaa nɔ́ nɛ flɔɔnɔɔ kɛ e mi la mi a ngɛ.
Mo Yawɛ, o mi mi ma fu mɛ.
O maa mii mɛ, nɛ la hu maa sã mɛ.
10A bimɛ, loo a nina ko he be mi jee;
matsɛ ɔ ma kpata mɛ tsuo a hɛ mi.
11Ke a so e yi nɔ,
aloo a to yi mi yaya ngɔ wo e he po,
a nine be e nɔ sue.
12E ma ka mɛ kɛ̃ɛ̃ ɔ kaa nɔ́ nɛ e ma tsɛ̃ mɛ,
nɛ a maa kpale a se kɛ fo.
13Yawɛ, wa ngɛ o yi jee
ngɛ o he wami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ he.
Wa ma la kɛ je o yi,
ejakaa o he wa wawɛɛ nitsɛ!

Title: LA 22
Content:
Awe nyami kɛ yi jemi la
1 Ye Mawu, ye Mawu,
mɛni he je o kua mi?
Mɛni he je i ngɛ awe nyae
nɛ o daa si ngɛ se,
nɛ o bɛ nɛ o ba je ngmlaa ha mi ɔ?
2Ye Mawu, ke i tsɛ mo piani ɔ,
o he we mi nɔ.
Ke i tsɛ mo nyɔ mi hu, ja nɔuu.
Mɛni he je?
3Se kɛ̃ ɔ, mo ji Mawu klɔuklɔu ɔ
nɛ hii si ngɛ matsɛ sɛ ɔ nɔ.
Mo, o yi lɛ Israel jeɔ.
4Wa nɛmɛ ɔmɛ ngɔ a hɛ kɛ fɔ o nɔ.
A ngɔ a hɛ kɛ fɔ o nɔ, nɛ o he a yi wami.
5A fa kue ha mo, nɛ o he a yi wami.
A ngɔ a hɛ kɛ fɔ o nɔ,
nɛ a pia we a he kaa a pee ja.
6Se imi lɛɛ, pi nɔmlɔ ji mi hu;
i ngɛ kaa gɔgɔ.
Nihi tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ hiee mi, nɛ a bɔɔ mi ahlua.
7 Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa na mi ɔ, e yeɔ ye he fɛu.
A plɛɔ a nya, nɛ a mimiɛɔ a yi.
8 A deɔ ke,
“Tse e ke e ngɔ e hɛ kɛ fɔ Yawɛ nɔ?
Yawɛ nɛ he e yi wami koo?
Ke Yawɛ suɔ lɛ ɔ,
mɛni he je e ba píɛ we e he?”
9Se, mo lɛ o je mi kɛ je maa muklii mi;
nɛ o hyɛ ye nɔ kɛ je
be mi nɛ i ngɛ nyɔ nya tɔɔ.
10Kɛ je be mi nɛ maa fɔ mi tɔɔ
lɛ i ngɔ ye hɛ ngɔ fɔ o nɔ.
Mo nɔ kake too ji ye Mawu.
11Koo je ye he;
ejakaa i miɔ nɛ ma sɛ haomi mi,
nɛ nɔ ko be nɛ maa je ngmlaa ha mi.
12He nyɛli kpanakuhi babauu bɔle mi kɛ kpe;
a he ngɛ gbeye kaa na kuhi
nɛ je Bashan zugba a nɔ.
13A gbɛɔ a nya mi hatoo kɛ woɔ mi
kaa jata nɛ ngɛ huãe
nɛ e hɛ mi pee klamaklama.
14Ye he wami ta kaa nyu nɛ kpa pue si.
Ye wuhi je a blɔ hehi, nɛ ye tsui
pee kaa hwo gbaku nɛ sile.
15Ye kuɔ si gbli kaa ngɛyu kokoe mi,
nɛ ye lilɛ mɛtɛ ye nya mi.
O si mi ngɛ tabo zu mi kaa nɔ nɛ gbo.
16Nimli yayamihi ba bɔle mi kɛ kpe kaa gbehi,
nɛ a ngɛ ye nine kɛ ye nane tsɔtslɔɔe.
17Ye wuhi tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ je kpo.
Nimli yayami ɔmɛ muɔ a hɛngmɛ ngɔ pue ye nɔ,
nɛ a ngɛ ye he fɛu yee.
18 A dla ye tade ɔmɛ ngɔ ha a he,
nɛ ye bo ɔ lɛɛ a fɔ nɔ sɔ.
19Yawɛ, koo je ye he!
Ba esɔ nɛ o ba piɛ ye he,
ejakaa mo lɛ o haa mi he wami.
20Mo je mi kɛ je klaate nya.
Mo he ye yi wami kɛ je gbe nɛ ɔmɛ a dɛ mi.
21Mo je mi kɛ je jata nɛ ɔmɛ a nya mi;
i be pu mi na ku nɛ ɔmɛ a nya nyɛe ma da.
22 Ma wo o biɛ ta ngɛ ye nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ a hɛ mi.
Nɛ ma je o yi ngɛ a he nya buami he ɔ.
23Nyɛ nɛ nyɛ yeɔ Yawɛ gbeye,
nyɛ je e yi.
Nyɛ Yakob nina tsuo,
nyɛɛ wo e hɛ mi nyami.
Nyɛ Israel ma, nyɛɛ ye lɛ gbeye.
24Ejakaa, e kua we nɔ́ nali;
e hɛ ji a nɔ hulɔ.
Ke a fa kue ha lɛ ɔ, e nuɔ;
e laa we mɛ.
25Ma je o yi ngɛ ma kpekpemi ɔ a hɛ mi.
Ma ye ye siwo ɔ nɔ
ngɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ yeɔ mo gbeye ɔ a hɛ mi.
26Ohiatsɛmɛ maa ye ní nɛ a maa tɔ.
Nihi nɛ hlaa Yawɛ se blɔ ɔ ma je e yi;
a bua maa jɔ a he kɛ maa ya neneene.
27Je mahi tsuo ma kai Yawɛ;
a maa je he tsuaa he kɛ ba e ngɔ
ba ja lɛ.
28Yawɛ ji matsɛ;
lɛ nɛ e yeɔ je ma amɛ a nɔ.
29He nɔ woli tsuo ma ba kpla si ha lɛ.
Niinɛ, nimli adesahi tsuo ma ba kpla si
ngɛ e nane nya.
30Yi nɔhi nɛ maa ba hwɔɔ se ɔ ma sɔmɔ lɛ.
Nihi maa sɛɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ he ní
kɛ ha hwɔɔ se bimɛ.
31Bimɛ nɛ a na we
nɛ a fɔ mɛ lolo po, a maa sɛɛ ha mɛ ke,
“Yawɛ he e ma a yi wami.”

Title: LA 23
Content:
Yawɛ, wa hyɛlɔ
1Yawɛ ji ye hyɛlɔ;
nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko he hia we mi.
2 E haa nɛ i jɔɔ ye he ngɛ nga mumu nɔ,
nɛ e ngɔɔ mi kɛ yaa takuhi
kɛ a mi nyu jɔjɔɛ he.
3E haa nɛ i naa he wami he.
E ngɔɔ mi kɛ guu blɔhi nɛ da a nɔ
kaa bɔ nɛ e wo si ke e maa pee ɔ.
4Ke i nyɛɛ diblii kpii mi po, i yi gbeye;
ejakaa mo Yawɛ, o ngɛ ye kasa nya haa.
O to tsɔ̃mi tso ɔ, kɛ o dɛma tso ɔ
ji níhi nɛ woɔ mi he wami.
5O ngmɛɔ mi okplɔɔ ngɛ he nɛ
ye he nyɛli tsuo maa na mi.
O pɔɔ ye yi mi nu, nɛ o woɔ ye kplu ɔ nɛ e hyiɔ banebane.
6Niinɛ, i le kaa ye wami be ɔ tsuo
o maa na mi mɔbɔ, nɛ o maa pee mi kpakpa sɔuu.
Nɛ mo Yawɛ, o we ɔ ji he nɛ ma hi daa.

Title: LA 24
Content:
Matsɛ ngua
1 Je ɔ, Yawɛ nɔ́.
Zugba a, kɛ e mi ní,
kɛ nimli nɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ ɔ,
Yawɛ níhi ji mɛ tsuo.
2Lɛ nɛ bɔ je ɔ kɛ fɔ wo ɔ nɔ;
lɛ nɛ to je ɔ sisi ngɛ pahi a nɔ.
3Mɛnɔ lɛ ngɛ he blɔ nɛ e kuɔɔ Yawɛ yoku ɔ?
Mɛnɔ maa ya e we klɔuklɔu ɔ?
4 Nɔ nɛ pee we yayami, nɛ e tsui mi tsɔ.
Nɔ nɛ ja we yakayaka níhi,
nɛ e ka we kita kɛ sisi nɔ.
5Yawɛ maa gbaa kikɛmɛ a nɔmlɔ ɔ.
Mawu maa wo lɛ nguɔ, nɛ e ma he e yi wami.
6Nihi kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ ji ni nɛmɛ nɛ hlaa Mawu se blɔ ɔ nɛ;
mɛ lɛ a baa Yakob Mawu ɔ hɛ mi.
7Nyɛ bli agbo ɔmɛ ngɔ fɔ si gbajaa.
Nyɛ bli blema agbo ɔmɛ ngɔ fɔ si,
konɛ matsɛ ngua a nɛ ba.
8Mɛnɔ ji matsɛ ngua nɛ ɔ?
Lɛ ji Yawɛ; e ngɛ he wami.
Katsɛ kɛ tatsɛ kpanaa ji lɛ.
9Nyɛ bli agbo ɔmɛ ngɔ fɔ si gbajaa.
Nyɛ bli blema agbo ɔmɛ ngɔ fɔ si,
konɛ matsɛ ngua a nɛ ba.
10Mɛnɔ ji kikɛmɛ a matsɛ ngua nɛ ɔ?
Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ,
lɛ tutuutu ji matsɛ ngua a nɛ!

Title: LA 25
Content:
Yawɛ, moo bu ye he
1Yawɛ, mo lɛ i ngɛ kue fae kɛ ngɛ hae.
2Ye Mawu, i ngɔ ye hɛ kɛ fɔ o nɔ.
Ko ha nɛ ye hɛ mi nɛ pue si;
ko ha nɛ ye he nyɛli nɛ ye ye hɛ fɛu.
3Nihi nɛ ngɔ a hɛ kɛ fɔ o nɔ ɔ,
ko ha nɛ zo nɛ gbe mɛ.
Ha nɛ nimli yayamihi, kɛ yakayaka nimli mohu
a hɛ mi nɛ pue si.
4Yawɛ, tsɔɔ mi o blɔ ɔmɛ;
Yawɛ, ha nɛ ma le o blɔ ɔmɛ.
5Tsɔɔ mi nɛ ma hi si ngɛ o we anɔkuale ɔ nya,
ejakaa mo Mawu ɔ ji ye yi wami helɔ.
Daa nɛ ɔ, o nɔ lɛ i ngɔɔ ye hɛ kɛ fɔɔ.
6Yawɛ, kai kaa o mɔbɔ nami,
kɛ o suɔmi nɛ be nyagbe ɔ
ngɛ kɛ je blema lokoo.
7Yawɛ, yayamihi nɛ i pee,
kɛ tɔmihi nɛ i tɔ ngɛ ye nihe mi ɔ, ko kai hu.
Mohu ɔ, o suɔmi nɛ ngɛ daa, kɛ kpakpa nɛ o peeɔ
he je ɔ, o hɛ ko je ye nɔ.
8Akɛnɛ Yawɛ hi, nɛ e da he je ɔ,
e tsɔɔ yayami peeli
blɔ nɛ sa kaa a nyɛɛ nɔ.
9Nihi nɛ baa a he si ɔ,
Yawɛ tsɔɔ mɛ e blɔ ɔ,
kɛ bɔ nɛ sa kaa a ba a je mi ha.
10Nihi tsuo nɛ yeɔ Yawɛ somi ɔ,
kɛ e mlaa amɛ a nɔ ɔ,
Yawɛ naa mɛ mɔbɔ, nɛ e yeɔ mɛ anɔkuale.
11Yawɛ, ye o siwo ɔ nɔ,
nɛ o ngɔ ye yayami ɔmɛ kɛ pa mi;
ejakaa ye yayami ɔmɛ hiɛ babauu.
12Nihi tsuo nɛ yeɔ Yawɛ gbeye ɔ,
Yawɛ maa tsɔɔ mɛ blɔ nɛ a nyɛɛ nɔ.
13A he mi maa jɔ mɛ,
nɛ a nina maa ngɔ zugba a kaa a weto ní.
14Nihi nɛ yeɔ Yawɛ gbeye ɔ,
Yawɛ kɛ mɛ maa nu huɛ;
nɛ si nɛ e wo ɔ, e ma je kpo ngɔ tsɔɔ mɛ.
15I hyɛɛ Yawɛ yemi kɛ buami blɔ daa;
ejakaa lɛ nɛ jeɔ mi kɛ jeɔ haomi mi.
16Yawɛ, ba nɛ o ba na mi mɔbɔ;
ejakaa nɔ ko be mi, nɛ ye ní ngɛ mɔbɔ.
17Mo je mi kɛ je ye haomi ɔmɛ a mi;
ha nɛ ma jɔɔ tsui yemi.
18Hyɛ ye haomi ɔ, kɛ ye nɔ́ nami ɔ,
nɛ o ngɔ ye he yayami ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ pa mi.
19Hyɛ ye he nyɛli a hiɛmi babauu!
