Hyɛ kaa a ngɛ mi nyɛe kadikadi.
20Bu ye he, nɛ o he ye yi wami.
Ko ha nɛ ye hɛ mi nɛ pue si,
ejakaa o ngɔ nɛ i ba sa we ngɛ.
21I ngɔ ye hɛ kɛ fɔ o nɔ, nɛ́ o bu ye he.
Ha nɛ ye he nɛ tsɔ, nɛ ma ye anɔkuale kɛ pi si.
22Mawu, mo je o ma Israel
kɛ je a haomi ɔmɛ tsuo a mi.

Title: LA 26
LA 27
Content:
I ngɔ ye hɛ kɛ fɔ Mawu nɔ
1Yawɛ ji ye la;
lɛ ji ye yi wami helɔ.
lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i yi nɔ ko nɔ ko gbeye.
Yawɛ ji ye he wami
nɛ buu ye he;
mɛnɔ gbeye ma ye mɔ?
2Ke ye he nyɛli, yayami peeli
ba tua mi nɛ́ a gbe mi ɔ,
a ma tɛ nɔ, nɛ a maa nɔɔ si.
3Ke ta ba tua mi,
nɛ tabohi ba sa ye yi po,
i be gbeye yee.
Mawu nɔ kɛkɛ lɛ ma ngɔ ye hɛ kɛ fɔ.
4Nɔ́ kake kɛkɛ lɛ i bi Yawɛ;
nɔ́ kake pɛ lɛ i ngɛ hlae ngɛ e dɛ.
Lɔ ɔ ji kaa ma hi Yawɛ we ɔ
ye wami be ɔ tsuo;
ma na Yawɛ he fɛu ɔ,
nɛ ma fa kue ngɛ e we ɔ.
5Haomi be mi ɔ, e maa ngɔ mi kɛ laa
ngɛ laami he ɔ, ngɛ e we ɔ;
e maa ngɔ mi kɛ da tɛ sa nɔ.
6Kikɛ nɛ ɔ ma pee kɛ ye ye he nyɛli tsuo
nɛ bɔle mi ɔ a nɔ kunimi.
I kɛ bua jɔmi maa sã bɔ ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ,
nɛ ma la kɛ je e yi.
7Yawɛ lee, ke i tsɛ mo ɔ, moo bu tue.
Naa mi mɔbɔ, nɛ o he mi nɔ.
8O de ke, “Nyɛɛ ba ye ngɔ.”
Imi hu i kɛ bua jɔmi he nɔ ke,
“Yawɛ, i ma;
9koo laa mi.”
Koo ngɔ abofu kɛ fie imi, o tsɔlɔ ɔ.
Mawu, mo ji ye yi wami helɔ;
mo lɛ o piɛɔ ye he.
Koo je ye he; ko kua mi.
10Ke tsaatsɛ kɛ maa kua mi po,
Yawɛ maa hyɛ ye nɔ.
11Yawɛ, tsɔɔ mi nɔ́ nɛ o ngɛ hlae nɛ ma pee,
nɛ o kpaka mi kɛ gu blɔ nɛ da nɔ,
ejakaa i ngɛ he nyɛli babauu.
12Koo ngmɛɛ ye he kɛ ha ye he nyɛli,
ejakaa lakpa odasehi, kɛ yiwutsotsɛmɛ
te si kɛ wo mi.
13I heɔ yeɔ kaa ma hi je mi kɛ yaa si
ma na Yawɛ mi mi himi ɔ
ngɛ wami nɛ ɔ mi.
14Ngɔɔ o hɛ kɛ fɔ Yawɛ nɔ.
Na tsui; o kɔni mi ko jɔ̃,
nɛ e maa wo mo he wami.
Ee, ngɔɔ o hɛ kɛ fɔ Yawɛ nɔ.

Title: LA 28
Content:
Kue fami kɛ ha yemi kɛ buami
1Yawɛ, mo nɛ o faa ye he;
i ngɛ mo tsɛe, moo bu mi tue koo!
Ke o pui ye nya mi ɔ, lɛɛ ma pee kaa
nihi nɛ ngɛ gbeje ɔ a ti nɔ kake.
2Ke i wo ye nine nɔ kɛ tsɔɔ o we klɔuklɔu ɔ,
nɛ i fa kue kɛ bi mo yemi kɛ buami ɔ,
moo bu mi tue.
3Koo bu mi fɔ kɛ si yiwutsotsɛmɛ,
kɛ yayami peeli a nɔ.
Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ a nyɛmimɛ tuɔ munyu ngɛ he jɔmi mi.
Se a tsui mi hyi kɛ yayami.
4 Gbla a tue ngɛ a ní peemi ní ɔmɛ a he;
gbla a tue ngɛ a yi wu tso ní ɔmɛ a he;
wo mɛ hiɔ bɔ nɛ sa mɛ pɛ.
5Akɛnɛ a bui níhi nɛ Yawɛ tsu,
kɛ níhi nɛ e pee ɔ he je ɔ,
Yawɛ ma kpata a hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ,
nɛ e be mɛ mɔbɔ nae hu.
6A je Yawɛ yi,
ejakaa e bu ye kue fami ɔ tue.
7Yawɛ ji ye he bulɔ, kɛ ye yi baalɔ;
e nɔ lɛ i ngɔ ye hɛ kɛ fɔ.
E piɛɔ ye he, nɛ e haa mi bua jɔmi.
Ma la kɛ je e yi.
8Yawɛ buɔ e ma a he.
Nɔ nɛ e pɔ lɛ nu ɔ, e faa e he,
nɛ e baa e yi.
9Yawɛ, he o ma a yi wami;
moo gbaa o nina a.
Moo hyɛ mɛ kɛ ya neneene
kaa bɔ nɛ to hyɛlɔ hyɛɛ e tohi.

Title: LA 29
Content:
Mawu ngɛ ahumi nɔ he wami
1 Nyɛ, Mawu bimɛ,
nyɛ je Yawɛ yi,
nɛ nyɛɛ wo e hɛ mi nyami.
2Nyɛɛ wo Yawɛ hɛ mi nyami bɔ nɛ sa lɛ.
Nyɛ ja Yawɛ ngɛ klɔuklɔu peemi mi.
3Yawɛ gbi ngɛ pɛe ngɛ wo ɔ mi.
Mawu nɛ e hɛ mi ngɛ nyami ɔ wo gbi,
nɛ e pɛ ngɛ wo ɔ nɔ he tsuaa he.
4Yawɛ gbi ɔ, he wami ngɛ mi.
Yawɛ gbi ɔ, hɛ mi nyami ngɛ mi.
5Yawɛ gbi ɔ kuɔ seda tsohi.
Ee, Lebanon seda tsohi po Yawɛ kuɔ mɛ.
6Yawɛ haa nɛ Lebanon yo ɔmɛ tuɔ kaa na bihi,
nɛ e haa nɛ Hermon yo ɔ tuɔ kaa na ku bi.
7Yawɛ gbi ɔ haa nɛ oslabai gbaa.
8Yawɛ gbi ɔ haa nɛ nga mimiɛɔ;
e gbi ɔ haa nɛ Kadesh nga a mimiɛɔ.
9Yawɛ gbi ɔ haa nɛ odabɔ fɔɔ bi;
e haa nɛ ba kplɔɔ ngɛ tsohi a yi.
Nihi tsuo nɛ ngɛ e we ɔ deɔ ke,
“Hɛ mi nyami ha Mawu!”
10Yawɛ ngɛ matsɛ yee
ngɛ nyu babauu ɔ nɔ kɛ yaa neneene.
11Yawɛ nɛ́ ha e ma a he wami.
Yawɛ nɛ́ gbaa e ma a,
nɛ́ e ha mɛ tue mi jɔmi.

Title: LA 30
Content:
Sina la
1Ma je o yi Yawɛ,
ejakaa o he ye yi wami.
O ha we nɛ ye he nyɛli nɛ nya;
o ngmɛ́ mɛ blɔ nɛ a ye ye he fɛu.
2Yawɛ, ye Mawu,
i fa kue ha mo, nɛ o tsa mi.
3O je mi kɛ je gbenɔ dɛ mi.
Yawɛ, jinɛ i miɔ nɛ ma gbo,
se o ha nɛ i na he wami ekohu.
4Nyɛ, Yawɛ ni klɔuklɔuhi,
nyɛ la kɛ je Yawɛ yi.
Nyɛ kai níhi nɛ nɔ klɔuklɔu ɔ tsu,
nɛ nyɛɛ na lɛ si.
5E mi mi fuɔ be kuku kɛkɛ;
se e mɔbɔ nami lɛɛ e ngɛ daa.
O maa wo ya nyɔ mi,
se ke je na pɛ bua jɔmi ba.
6I susu kaa i ngɛ he jɔmi mi,
nɛ i de ngɛ ye yi mi ke,
“Nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko be mi pee!”
7Yawɛ, o na mi mɔbɔ
nɛ o bu ye he kaa yo nguaa ko.
Se o ba laa mi, nɛ i ye gbeye.
8Yawɛ, i fa kue ha mo;
i kpa mo pɛɛ ke o na mi mɔbɔ.
9Ke i gbo nɛ a pu mi ɔ, mɛni se o ma na?
Anɛ zu ma nyɛ ma je o yi lo?
O we anɔkuale yemi ɔ, anɛ zu ma nyɛ
maa ye he odase lo?
10Yawɛ, moo bu mi tue nɛ o na mi mɔbɔ!
Yawɛ, moo piɛ ye he!
11O ha nɛ i kpa kɔmɔ yemi
nɛ i bɔni domi.
O je kpekpe ya bo ɔ ngɛ ye he,
nɛ o ha mi bua jɔmi.
12Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, i be ye nya mae;
se mohu ma la kɛ je o yi.
Yawɛ, ye Mawu,
ma na mo si daa.

Title: LA 31
Content:
I ngɔ ye hɛ kɛ fɔ Mawu nɔ
1Yawɛ, i ba sa we ngɛ o ngɔ;
ko ha nɛ zo nɛ gbe mi.
Mo he ye yi wami, ejakaa dalɔ ji mo.
2Moo bu mi tue koo! Mo he ye yi wami esɔ!
Moo pee ye tɛ sa, nɛ o bu ye he!
Moo pee ye mɔ, nɛ o he ye yi wami!
3Ee, ye wesa he, kɛ ye mɔ ji mo.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, moo nyɛɛ ye hɛ mi, nɛ o tsɔɔ mi blɔ
kaa bɔ nɛ o wo si ɔ.
4Mo ji ye wesa he;
jé mi kɛ je klama nɛ a tsɔ mi ɔ mi.
5 Yawɛ, Mawu anɔkualetsɛ;
i ngɔ ye he kɛ ha mo.
Mo lɛ o ma he ye yi wami.
6Yawɛ, o sume nihi nɛ jaa lakpa mawuhi saasaa;
se imi lɛɛ i ngɔ ye hɛ kɛ fɔ o nɔ.
7Ma nya, nɛ ma na bua jɔmi
ngɛ o suɔmi nɛ be nyagbe ɔ he.
O na ye nɔ́ nami ɔ;
benɛ i ngɛ haomi mi ɔ, o hyɛ ye nɔ.
8O ngɔɛ mi kɛ wui he nyɛli a dɛ mi;
o ha mi he jɔmi, nɛ i yaa he tsuaa he nɛ i suɔ.
9Yawɛ, naa mi mɔbɔ, ejakaa i ngɛ haomi mi.
Aywilɛho sɔuu ha nɛ ye hɛngmɛhi fuu;
ye nɔmlɔ tso ɔ hu gbɔjɔ.
10Kɔmɔ yemi babauu ha nɛ ye he wami ta.
Ya fomi po ye wami be ɔ nɔ kpiti.
Ye he yayami ɔmɛ ha nɛ i gbɔjɔ,
nɛ ye wuhi tete po pee hiɔ.
11I plɛ pee ahlua nɔ́ ko kɛ ha ye he nyɛli;
i pee muɔ nɔ́ kɛ ha ye nyɛmimɛ,
nɛ ye huɛmɛ lɛɛ i plɛ pee gbeye lohwe ha mɛ.
Ke nihi na mi ngɛ gbɛjegbɛ nɔ kɛkɛ pui a tu fo!
12Nɔ tsuaa nɔ hɛ je ye nɔ;
nɔ ko nɔ ko kaii we mi hu.
I pee kaa nɔ nɛ gbo, aloo buɛ nɛ ywia.
13I nu nɛ nihi babauu ngɛ ye biɛ puɛe;
gbeye níhi bɔle mi kɛ kpe.
A ngɛ ye yi nɔ soe, konɛ a gbe mi.
14Se imi lɛɛ i ngɔ ye hɛ kɛ fɔ mo, Yawɛ o nɔ.
I de ke, “Mo pɛ ji ye Mawu”.
15I ngɛ o dɛ mi be tsuaa be.
Mo je mi kɛ je ye he nyɛli a dɛ mi;
mo je mi kɛ je nihi nɛ waa mi yi mi ɔ a dɛ mi.
16Naa imi, o tsɔlɔ ɔ mɔbɔ!
Mo he ye yi wami ngɛ o suɔmi nɛ ngɛ daa a he.
17Yawɛ, i ngɛ mo tsɛe;
ko ha nɛ zo nɛ gbe mi.
Ha nɛ yiwutsotsɛmɛ mohu a hɛ mi nɛ pue si,
nɛ a ma a nya kɛ ya gbeje.
18Lakpatsɛmɛ, kɛ he nɔ woli, kɛ nɔ he guɛ gbeli
nɛ tuɔ munyu yaya kɛ siɔ dali ɔ,
ha nɛ mɛ tsuo a ma a nya.
19Nihi nɛ yeɔ mo gbeye ɔ,
hyɛ ní kpakpahi babauu nɛ o dla kɛ to ha mɛ!
Ni nɛmɛ nɛ ba saa we ngɛ o ngɔ ɔ,
hyɛ ni nguanguahi babauu nɛ o pee ha mɛ.
O peeɔ ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ngɛ ma hɛ mi paa.
20O ngɔɔ mɛ kɛ laa ngɛ o laami he ɔ,
konɛ nihi kó nyɛ nɛ a so a yi nɔ.
O ngɔɔ mɛ kɛ toɔ o laami he ɔ,
konɛ nihi kó na a he blɔ nɛ a fia mɛ lilɛ.
21A je Yawɛ yi!
Ejakaa benɛ he nyɛli, nɛ a sa ba tua mi ye yi ɔ,
e je e suɔmi ɔ kpo kɛ tsɔɔ mi ngɛ nyakpɛ blɔ nɔ.
22Ye tsui po, nɛ i susu kaa
e je e juɛmi kɛ je ye nɔ.
Se benɛ i fa kue ha lɛ ɔ,
e bu mi tue.
23Nyɛɛ suɔ Yawɛ, nyɛ e ni klɔuklɔuhi tsuo!
Yawɛ baa nihi tsuo nɛ yeɔ lɛ anɔkuale ɔ a yi,
se he nɔ woli lɛɛ e gblaa a tue bɔ nɛ sa mɛ.
24Nyɛ nihi tsuo nɛ nyɛ ngɔɔ nyɛ hɛ kɛ fɔɔ Yawɛ nɔ ɔ,
nyɛ wlua nyɛ!
Yawɛ ma ha nyɛ he wami.

Title: LA 32
Content:
Yayami jajemi kɛ pami
1 A gbaa nɔ nɛ a ngɔ e tɔmihi,
kɛ e he yayamihi ngɔ pa lɛ.
2A gbaa nɔ nɛ Yawɛ nɛ yayami ko ngɛ e he;
nɔ nɛ sisi we nɔ.
3Benɛ i laa ye yayami ɔmɛ a nɔ
nɛ i jaje we ɔ,
daa nɛ ɔ, kɛmɛmi kɛkɛ i hii kɛmɛe;
nɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ha nɛ ye nɔmlɔ tso ɔ gbɔjɔ.
4Mo Yawɛ, o gbla ye tue nyɔ kɛ pia,
nɛ ye he wami tsuo ta
kaa bɔ nɛ nyu taa pa mi latsa be mi ɔ.
5Kɛkɛ nɛ i jaje ye he yayami ɔmɛ kɛ ha mo;
i laa we ye tɔmi ɔmɛ a nɔ.
I de ke, “Ma jaje ye tɔmi ɔmɛ kɛ ha Yawɛ”,
nɛ mo hu o ngɔ ye he yayami ɔmɛ kɛ pa mi.
6Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e sa kaa
o ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ a fa kue ha mo
ngɛ a fimi behi a mi.
Ke haomi ba babauu kaa nyu nɛ ywia nga po,
e be a he sae.
7Mo ji ye laami he;
o jeɔ mi kɛ jeɔ haomi mi.
Mo lɛ o po piɛ kɛ bɔle mi kɛ kpe,
nɛ o ha nɛ i ye ye he.
8Yawɛ ke,
“Ma tsɔɔ mo blɔ nɛ o nyɛɛ nɔ.
Ma tsɔɔ mo ní, nɛ ma wo mo ga.
9Nyɛ ko pee nyɛ he kaa okpɔngɔ, aloo teji
nɛ ja a ngɔ dade kɛ e he kpa wo e nya mi
loko a ma nyɛ maa hɛɛ lɛ ɔ.”
10Yayami peeli maa na nɔ́ wawɛɛ.
Se nihi nɛ ngɔɔ a hɛ kɛ fɔɔ Yawɛ nɔ ɔ,
mɛɛ lɛɛ Yawɛ maa na mɛ mɔbɔ daa.
11Nyɛ dali, nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ pee ha nyɛ ɔ he je ɔ,
nyɛ nya nɛ nyɛ bua nɛ jɔ nyɛ he.
Nyɛ nihi nɛ nyɛ buɔ lɛ tue,
nyɛ hwɔ lele.

Title: LA 33
Content:
Yi jemi la
1Nyɛ dali tsuo, nyɛ hwɔ lele
ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ pee ha nyɛ ɔ he.
Nyɛ nihi tsuo nɛ nyɛ buɔ lɛ tue,
nyɛ je e yi.
2Nyɛɛ fia saku kɛ je Yawɛ yi.
Nyɛɛ fia kpa saku, nɛ nyɛ la
kɛ je Yawɛ yi.
3Nyɛ la la he kɛ ha lɛ.
Nyɛɛ fia kpa saku ɔ saminya,
nɛ nyɛ hwɔ lele.
4Ejakaa Yawɛ munyu ɔ, anɔkuale sɔuu;
e peeɔ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
5Yawɛ suɔ nɔ́ nɛ da;
e yeɔ dami sane.
E suɔmi nɛ be nyagbe ɔ
hyi zugba a nɔ tɔ.
6Fami kɛkɛ lɛ Yawɛ fa
nɛ e kɛ pee hiɔwe.
Munyu kɛkɛ lɛ je e nya
nɛ pu, kɛ nyɔhiɔ, kɛ dodoehi ba.
7E bua wo nyu ɔ nya glekugleku;
nɛ e ngɔ nyu babauu ɔ kɛ to ngɛ nito hehi.
8Je ɔ tsuo, nyɛɛ ye Yawɛ gbeye!
Nyɛ nimli adesahi tsuo, nyɛɛ wo e hɛ mi nyami!
9Ejakaa munyu kɛkɛ lɛ e tu
nɛ e kɛ bɔ je ɔ.
Fami kɛkɛ lɛ e fa nɛ níhi tsuo ba.
10Ke je ma amɛ so kikɛ nɛ ɔ,
Yawɛ tsakeɔ a yi mi tomi ɔmɛ,
nɛ a nyɛ we nɛ a kɛ tsuɔ ní.
11Se Yawɛ yi mi tomi ɔmɛ ngɛ daa;
e susumi ɔmɛ ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene.
12A gbaa ma nɛ a Mawu ji Yawɛ.
A gbaa ma nɛ Yawɛ hla kaa lɛ nitsɛ e ma a.
13Yawɛ jeɔ hiɔwe kɛ hyɛɛ
nimli adesahi tsuo ngɛ zugba.
14Yawɛ hyɛɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ ngɛ zugba a nɔ
kɛ jeɔ he nɛ e kojoɔ ngɛ ɔ.
15Lɛ nɛ haa nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ susuɔ e yi mi;
e le nɔ́ nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ ngɛ pee.
16Pi ta buli babauu nɛ haa matsɛ yeɔ kunimi;
ta bulɔ be nyɛe maa ngɔ e kã
kɛ he lɛ nitsɛ e yi wami.
17Ke o ngɔ o hɛ ngɔ fɔ ta okpɔngɔ nɔ ɔ,
e maa pee yaka.
Ta okpɔngɔ kɛ e he wami babauu ɔ
be nyɛe ma he o yi wami.
18Nihi nɛ yeɔ Yawɛ gbeye;
nihi nɛ ngɔɔ a hɛ ngɔ fɔɔ e nɔ kaa e na mɛ mɔbɔ ɔ,
Yawɛ buu a he.
19E jeɔ mɛ kɛ jeɔ gbenɔ mi;
e haa a yi naa wami ngɛ hwɔ be mi.
20Wa ngɔ wa hɛ ngɔ fɔ Yawɛ nɔ;
lɛ ji wa yi baalɔ nɛ piɛɔ wa he.
21Niinɛ, wa bua jɔ wa he,
ejakaa wa ngɔ wa hɛ ngɔ fɔ e nɔ.
22Yawɛ, o suɔmi nɛ be nyagbe ɔ
kɛ wɔ nɛ hi si daa;
ejakaa wa ngɔ wa hɛ ngɔ fɔ o nɔ.

Title: LA 34
Content:
Mawu sina la
1 Ma na Yawɛ si daa;
ma la kɛ je e yi be tsuaa be.
2Ma fĩa kɛ fɔ Yawɛ nɔ;
nɔ́ nali maa nu he, nɛ a ma nya.
3Nyɛ ha nɛ wɔ tsuo waa wo
Yawɛ hɛ mi nyami
nɛ wa je e yi.
4I fa kue ha Yawɛ, nɛ e bu mi tue;
e ha nɛ i jɔɔ gbeye yemi.
5Nihi nɛ ngɔɔ a hɛ kɛ fɔɔ e nɔ ɔ,
a naa bua jɔmi; zo gbi mɛ gblegbleegble.
6Nɔ́ nalɔ nɛ ɔ fa kue ha Yawɛ;
Yawɛ bu lɛ tue,
nɛ e je lɛ kɛ je e haomi ɔmɛ tsuo a mi.
7Yawɛ bɔfo ɔ buɔ
nihi nɛ yeɔ Yawɛ gbeye ɔ a he,
nɛ e heɔ a yi wami.
8 Nyɛɛ ka Yawɛ nɛ nyɛɛ hyɛ,
nɛ nyɛ maa na kaa e hi.
A gbaa nɔ nɛ ngɔɔ e hɛ kɛ fɔɔ e nɔ ɔ.
9Nyɛ, Yawɛ ni klɔuklɔuhi,
nyɛɛ ye lɛ gbeye.
Ejakaa nihi nɛ yeɔ lɛ gbeye ɔ,
nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko hia we mɛ.
10Jata bihi po e fiɔ mɛ nɛ hwɔ yee mɛ.
Se nihi nɛ hlaa Yawɛ se blɔ ɔ,
nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko hia we mɛ.
11Ye bimɛ, nyɛɛ ba nɛ nyɛ ba bu mi tue,
nɛ ma tsɔɔ nyɛ nɛ nyɛɛ ye Yawɛ gbeye.
12 Mɛnɔ lɛ suɔ kaa e na bua jɔmi ngɛ je mi?
Mɛnɔ lɛ suɔ kaa e se nɛ kɛ ngɛ je mi,
nɛ e fiɛ e yi nɔ?
13Hyɛ nɛ o ko tu munyu nɛ sɛ́!
Hyɛ nɛ o ko ye lakpa!
14Jɔɔ yayami peemi, nɛ o pee kpakpa.
Hla tue mi jɔmi, nɛ o nyɛɛ se.
15Yawɛ hɛngmɛ ngɛ dali a he,
nɛ e buɔ a kue fami tue.
16Yayami peeli lɛɛ Yawɛ jeɔ e hɛ kɛ piɔ mɛ,
nɛ ke a gbo ɔ, e kɛ we kɛkɛ hɛ je a nɔ.
17Ke dali fa kue ha Yawɛ ɔ, e nuɔ,
nɛ e jeɔ mɛ kɛ jeɔ a haomihi tsuo a mi.
18Nihi nɛ a kɔni mi jɔ̃,
kɛ nihi nɛ a be hɛ nɔ kami ɔ,
Yawɛ hii a kasa nya,
konɛ e wo mɛ he wami.
19Nɔ nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a,
haomi babauu baa e nɔ;
se Yawɛ jeɔ lɛ kɛ jeɔ lɛ tsuo mi.
20 Yawɛ hyɛɛ e nɔ saminya;
e wu kake ngmelu po ku we
ngɛ e wu ɔmɛ tsuo a kpɛti.
21Yayami peelɔ ɔ, yayami kɛ̃ lɛ maa gbe lɛ.
Nihi nɛ nyɛɛ dali ɔ, a maa gbla a tue.
22Yawɛ ma he e sɔmɔli a yi wami.
Nihi nɛ ba saa we ngɛ e ngɔ ɔ,
a ti nɔ ko nɔ ko hɛ mi be kpatae.

Title: LA 35
Content:
Yawɛ, ba piɛ ye he
1Yawɛ, nihi nɛ kɛ mi ná a,
tee si kɛ wo mɛ.
Nihi nɛ kɛ mi ngɛ hwue ɔ,
o kɛ mɛ nɛ hwu.
2Ngɔɔ o tsɛ̃i, kɛ o ta hwumi níhi,
nɛ o ba je ngmlaa ha mi.
3Moo gbla akplɔ, kɛ gbiɛ kɛ wo
nihi nɛ ngɛ ye se nyɛɛe ɔ a he.
De mi ke o ma he ye yi wami.
4Nihi nɛ ngɛ hlae nɛ a gbe mi ɔ,
ha nɛ zo nɛ gbe mɛ,
nɛ a yi mi tomi ɔ nɛ bɔ mɛ.
Ni nɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ ye yi nɔ soe ɔ,
ha nɛ basabasa nɛ sɛ a kpɛti,
nɛ a kpale a se.
5Ha nɛ a pee kaa tsakati ngɛ kɔɔhiɔ nya.
Ha nɛ Yawɛ bɔfo ɔ
nɛ fie mɛ kɛ ho.
6Ha nɛ a blɔ ɔ nɔ nɛ wo diblii, nɛ e sane.
Ha nɛ Yawɛ bɔfo ɔ
nɛ nyɛɛ a se.
7Ejakaa a tsɔ mi klama,
nɛ a tsua muɔ ngɔ to ha mi yaka gu.
8Ha nɛ a hɛ mi nɛ kpata tlukaa
be mi nɛ a li a he be.
Klama a nɛ a tsɔ mi ɔ,
ha nɛ e du mɛ.
Muɔ ɔ nɛ a tsua kɛ to ha mi ɔ,
ha nɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a nɔ mi.
9Kɛkɛ ɔ, Yawɛ he ɔ, ma na bua jɔmi.
Ye bua maa jɔ, ejakaa e he ye yi wami.
10Ma de kɛ je ye tsui mi tɔɔ ke,
“Yawɛ, mɛnɔ lɛ e kɛ mo sɔ?
Mo lɛ o jeɔ nɔ nɛ he wɛ
kɛ jeɔ nɔ nɛ he wa pe lɛ ɔ dɛ mi.
Mo lɛ o jeɔ dɛgutsɛ kɛ jeɔ
nɔ nɛ waa lɛ yi mi ɔ dɛ mi.”
11Lakpa odasehi teɔ si kɛ woɔ mi;
a poɔ ye nya, nɛ a deɔ níhi
nɛ i li he nɔ́ ko kɛ siɔ mi.
12A peeɔ mi yayami kɛ toɔ kpakpa nane mi,
nɛ a woɔ mi ka, konɛ a gbe mi.
13Se imi lɛɛ benɛ a be he wami ɔ, i bu kpekpe ya bo.
I ha hwɔ nɛ i kɛ wa ye nɔmlɔ tso ɔ yi mi.
I fa kue wawɛɛ ngɛ ye yi mi
14kaa bɔ nɛ ma fa kue ha ye huɛ, aloo ye nyɛmi.
I ma ye yi si dii, nɛ i ye kɔmɔ
kaa nɔ ko nɛ e nyɛ gbo nɛ e ngɛ ya nyɛe.
15Se benɛ haomi ba ye nɔ ɔ, a nya
nɛ a bua a he nya, konɛ a ye ye he fɛu.
He guɛ gbeli ba bɔle mi nɛ i li;
a gbe ye he guɛ nɛ he jɔɔmi be mi.
16A kɛ ma mi yaka nimli ɔmɛ ya pee kake.
A plɛ a nya wo mi, nɛ a ye ye he fɛu.
17Yawɛ, o maa hi nɔ́ nɛ ɔ hyɛe
kɛ yaa si mɛni be!
Jé mi kɛ je kikɛmɛ a ogbetee nɛ ɔmɛ a dɛ mi!
Ko ha nɛ a kpata ye hɛ mi!
18Ma na mo si, nɛ ma je o yi
ngɛ o ma kpekpemi ɔ tsuo a hɛ mi.
19 Ko ha nɛ ye he nyɛli lakpatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a nya.
Nihi nɛ nyɛɔ mi yaka gu ɔ,
ko ha nɛ a kpɛ mi.
20A tu we he jɔmi munyu gblegbleegble.
Nɔ́ nɛ a peeɔ ji nihi nɛ suɔ tue mi jɔmi ɔ,
lakpa sɔuu a yeɔ ngɛ a he.
21A gbɛɔ a nya mi hatoo kɛ woɔ mi,
nɛ a deɔ ke, “Ɛhɛɛ, wa na lɛ paa
kɛ wɔ nitsɛmɛ wa hɛngmɛ.”
22Yawɛ, tse o ngɛ hyɛe?
Ko ma o nya!
Nyɔmtsɛ, koo je ye he!
23Ye Mawu kɛ ye Nyɔmtsɛ,
tee si nɛ o fa ye he!
Tee si nɛ o ye ye sane ɔ ha mi koo!
24Yawɛ, ye Mawu,
mo nɛ o yeɔ dami sane.
Moo wo mi nguɔ koo!
Ko ha nɛ ye he nyɛli nɛ muɔ mi.
25Ko ha nɛ a de ke,
“Ɛhɛɛ, wa nine gbe lɛ!
Nɔ́ nɛ wa ngɛ hlae ɔ pɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ!”
26Nihi nɛ hii nyae be mi nɛ i ngɛ nɔ́ nae ɔ,
ha nɛ zo nɛ gbe mɛ, nɛ a pee basabasa.
Ni nɛmɛ nɛ susuɔ kaa mɛɛ a hi pe mi ɔ,
ha nɛ zo nɛ gbe mɛ kpɔtɔɔ, nɛ a hɛ mi nɛ pue si.
27Se nihi tsuo nɛ maa suɔ kaa a wo mi nguɔ ɔ,
ha nɛ a hwɔ lele, nɛ a de si abɔ ke,
“Yawɛ kle! E bua jɔ e he
kaa e tsɔlɔ ɔ ye manye.”
28Ma jaje kaa Mawu nɛ yeɔ dami sane ji mo,
nɛ ma je o yi daa.

Title: LA 36
Content:
Adesa yi mi wa
1 Yayami kɛ yiwutsotsɛ
tuɔ munyu ngɛ e tsui mi tɔɔ.
Mawu gbeye yemi ko kulaa be e mi.
2E buɔ e he ní lelɔ, nɛ e susuɔ kaa
a be e he yayami ɔ nae,
nɛ a be e tue gblae hulɔ.
3Munyu yaya, kɛ lakpa sɔuu lɛ jeɔ e nya mi.
E li nɔ́ hu; e pa pee we kpakpa hu.
4Ke e hwɔ si ɔ, nɔ́ yayami he ga lɛ e toɔ.
E kpa we yayami peemi ɔ,
e pee we nɔ́ kpakpa hulɔ.
Mawu mi mi himi
5Yawɛ, o suɔmi nɛ be nyagbe ɔ
kle agbo kaa hiɔwe ɔ tsuo.
O we anɔkuale yemi ɔ
ya suu bɔku ɔmɛ a he tɔɔ.
6O kpakpa peemi ɔ kle kaa yo nguangua amɛ;
o dami sane yemi mi kuɔ kaa wo.
Yawɛ, mo lɛ o baa nimli, kɛ lohwehi tsuo a yi.
7Yawɛ, hyɛ bɔ nɛ o mɔbɔ nami ɔ he jua wa ha!
Adesahi tsuo ba saa we
ngɛ o pɛli ɔmɛ a sisi.
8O lɛɔ wɔ kɛ o we ɔ ní kpakpahi.
O haa wɔ nyu kɛ jeɔ
o pa nɛ ngɛ akɔnɔ ɔ mi lɛ wa nuɔ.
9O mi lɛ wami tsuo jeɔ kɛ baa.
O la a lɛ haa wɔ la.
10Nihi nɛ le mo ɔ, naa mɛ mɔbɔ daa.
Nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a,
mo hu moo pee mɛ kpakpa daa.
11Ko ha nɛ he nɔ woli nɛ naa ye nɔ;
ko ha nɛ yayami peeli nɛ nyɛɛ ye se kɛ fo.
12Hyɛ, yayami peeli ɔmɛ nɔ si!
A tsɛ̃ mɛ ngɔ ko si,
nɛ a nyɛ we nɛ a te si hu.

Title: LA 37
Content:
Kpakpa maa ye yayami nɔ kunimi
1Koo ye o tsui ngɛ yayami peeli a he;
o hɛ ko kɔ nihi nɛ peeɔ yayami a nɔ.
2E be kɛe nɛ a maa laa kaa nga gbigbli;
a ma gbo tlukaa kaa ba nɛ ngla.
3Ngɔɔ o hɛ ngɔ fɔ Yawɛ nɔ
nɛ o pee kpakpa,
konɛ o hi zugba a nɔ ngɛ he jɔmi mi.
4Mo na Yawɛ he bua jɔmi,
nɛ e ma ha mo níhi nɛ o tsui suɔ.
5Ngɔɔ o he kɛ ha Yawɛ;
ngɔɔ o hɛ kɛ fɔ e nɔ, nɛ e maa piɛ o he.
6E maa ye dami sane ha mo;
e maa wo mo nguɔ.
Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ maa je kpo paa kaa pu la,
nɛ nihi tsuo maa na.
7Pee dii ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi;
too o tsui si, nɛ o hyɛ lɛ blɔ.
Koo ye o tsui ngɛ nihi nɛ ná a he ɔ a he;
nihi nɛ pee yayami nɛ a kɛ ná a he ɔ,
koo ye o tsui ngɛ a he.
8O mi mi ko fu hu; koo ye o tsui hu.
Ní nɛ ɔmɛ haa nɛ nɔ peeɔ yayami.
9Ejakaa a ma kpata yayami peeli a hɛ mi.
Se ni nɛmɛ nɛ ngɔɔ a hɛ kɛ fɔɔ Yawɛ nɔ ɔ,
mɛɛ lɛɛ a nine maa su zugba a nɔ.
10E piɛ bɔɔ nɛ o be yayami peeli nae hu;
o ma hla mɛ ngɛ a hi he ɔmɛ,
se o be mɛ nae.
11 Nihi nɛ a he jɔ ɔ, mɛɛ a maa hi zugba a nɔ
ngɛ kplɔkɔtɔ, kɛ tue mi jɔmi mi.
12Yayami peelɔ soɔ kpakpa peelɔ yi nɔ;
e hyɛɛ lɛ too kɛ ninyɛ hɛngmɛ.
13Se Yawɛ lɛɛ e muɔɔ yayami peeli,
ejakaa e le kaa e be kɛe nɛ a ma kpata a hɛ mi.
14Yayami peeli hiaa klaate, nɛ a dɔɔ a kɛ̃ɛ̃ ɔmɛ,
konɛ a gbe ohiatsɛmɛ, kɛ dɛgutsɛmɛ;
konɛ a kpata nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a a hɛ mi.
15Se a kɛ a klaate ɔmɛ maa gbe mɛ nitsɛmɛ a he,
nɛ a kɛ̃ɛ̃ ɔmɛ tsuo maa ku.
16Nɔ́ ko bɔbɔyoo nɛ ngɛ dalɔ dɛ ɔ
hi pe yayami peeli babauu a ní nɛ a na.
17Ejakaa Yawɛ ma ha nɛ
yayami peeli a he wami maa ta.
Se ni nɛmɛ nɛ peeɔ kpakpa lɛɛ
e maa bu a he.
18Nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a,
Yawɛ maa bu a he daa;
nɛ a maa hi zugba a nɔ kɛ maa ya neneene.
19Ke haomi ba a, a hɛ mi be si puee.
Hwɔ be mi ɔ, mɛɛ lɛɛ a maa tɔ.
20Se yayami peeli lɛɛ a hɛ mi ma kpata.
Yawɛ he nyɛli ɔmɛ maa pee kaa nga nɔ mɔmɔ.
A maa ta si kake too
kaa bɔ nɛ la su ku se poo ɔ.
21Ke nɔmlɔ yayami pa sika a, e wui hiɔ;
dalɔ lɛɛ e naa mɔbɔ, nɛ e haa nɔ nɔ́.
22Nihi nɛ Yawɛ gbaa mɛ ɔ,
a nine maa su zugba a nɔ.
Se ni nɛmɛ nɛ e gbiɛ mɛ ɔ,
mɛɛ lɛɛ a ma kpata a hɛ mi.
23Yawɛ lɛ tsɔɔ nɔ blɔ nɛ sa nɛ e nyɛɛ nɔ.
Nɛ ke o pee saminya a,
e naa o he bua jɔmi.
24Ke o nɔ si tete po, o be zugba tlɔe;
ejakaa Yawɛ ma wo o nɔ ekohu.
25Kɛ je ye nihe be mi kɛ ba si ye wami si nɛ ɔ,
i nɛ kaa Yawɛ kua nɔ ko
nɛ peeɔ nɔ nɛ da.
E bimɛ hu, i nɛ kaa a ngɛ ní bae.
26Nɔmlɔ nɛ yeɔ Mawu gbeye ɔ,
daa nɛ ɔ, e naa mɔbɔ.
E haa nɔ nɔ́; e paa nihi sika,
nɛ e bimɛ peeɔ gbaami.
27Kpa yayami peemi, nɛ o pee kpakpa,
kɛkɛ ɔ, o nina maa hi zugba a nɔ daa;
28ejakaa Yawɛ suɔ nɔ́ nɛ da;
nihi nɛ yeɔ lɛ anɔkuale ɔ, e kua we mɛ.
Yawɛ maa bu dali a he daa;
se yayami peeli a nina lɛɛ a hɛ mi ma kpata.
29Nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a,
zugba a maa pee a nɔ́
nɛ a maa hi nɔ daa.
30Dalɔ nya mi munyu ɔ, nile sɔuu;
daa nɛ ɔ, e suɔ kaa a ye dami sane.
31E ngɔɔ e Mawu ɔ mlaa a kɛ toɔ e tsui mi,
nɛ e si we se gblegbleegble.
32Yayami peelɔ hii nɔmlɔ kpakpa dae,
nɛ e hlaa kaa e maa gbe lɛ.
33Se Yawɛ be dalɔ he ngmɛɛe
kɛ wo yayami peelɔ dɛ mi kɔkɔɔkɔ.
Ke a ngɔ dalɔ kɛ ba kojomi he hu,
Yawɛ be blɔ ngmɛe nɛ a bu lɛ fɔ.
34Ngɔɔ o hɛ ngɔ fɔ Yawɛ nɔ,
nɛ o ye e mlaa amɛ a nɔ;
nɛ e ma ha nɛ o nine maa su zugba a nɔ.
Ke a ngɛ yayami peeli a hɛ mi kpatae ɔ,
o hɛngmɛ kɛkɛ o kɛ maa hyɛ mɛ.
35Yiwutsotsɛ kpanaku ko hi si; i le lɛ.
E nɔ kuɔ kaa Lebanon seda tso.
36Be ko se ɔ, i ya gu he nɛ e hii ɔ,
se e be lejɛ ɔ.
I hla lɛ, se i nɛ lɛ.
37Moo to nɔmlɔ kpakpa he hɛ;
hyɛ dalɔ saminya,
nɔmlɔ nɛ he jɔ ɔ,
hwɔɔ se ɔ, e maa hi si ngɛ tue mi jɔmi mi.
38Se yayami peeli lɛɛ
a ma kpata a kɛ a nina tsuo a hɛ mi.
39Yawɛ heɔ dali a yi wami;
e buɔ a he ngɛ amanehlu be mi.
40Yawɛ piɛɔ a he;
e jeɔ mɛ kɛ jeɔ yayami peeli a dɛ mi,
nɛ e heɔ a yi wami.
Ejakaa a ba saa we ngɛ e ngɔ.

Title: LA 38
Content:
Nɔ́ nalɔ ko kue fami
1Yawɛ, koo ngɔ abofu kɛ ka ye hɛ mi!
Koo gbla ye tue kɛ mi mi fumi.
2O ngɔ o kɛ̃ɛ̃ mi bi ɔmɛ kɛ plaa mi;
o tsɛ̃ mi ngɔ fɔ si.
3Akɛnɛ o mi mi fu mi he je ɔ,
i na we he jɔmi ko kulaa.
Ye yayami ɔmɛ a he je ɔ, ye he mi tsɔ we mi.
4Ye yayami ɔmɛ pee kaa tlomi nɛ i tloo;
a pee kaa tlomi nɛ jiɔ tsɔ, nɛ ngɛ mi gbee.
5Ye pa amɛ sa, nɛ a he fu;
ejakaa i je kuasia.
6Ye mi dɔ kɔmɔɔ, nɛ i ma ye yi si;
daa nɛ ɔ, kɔmɔ kɛkɛ i ngɛ yee.
7Ye se fɛ, nɛ e ngɛ mi sããe hɛii kaa la;
ye he mi tsuo puɛ.
8Imi nɔmlɔ ɔ tsuo i gbɔjɔ, nɛ i ku;
ye tsui ngɛ fiae, nɛ i ngɛ kɛmɛe.
9Nyɔmtsɛ, o le ye hiami ní ɔmɛ tsuo;
ye kɛmɛmi ɔ hu o le.
10Ye tsui ngɛ fiae kpla, kpla!
Ye he wami ta,
nɛ ye hɛngmɛ hu miɔ nɛ e ma yu.
11Ye hiɔ ɔ he je ɔ, ye suɔli, kɛ ye huɛmɛ
bɛ ye kasa nya.
Ye nyɛmimɛ tete po, se lokoo a daa.
12Nihi nɛ ngɛ mi hlae nɛ a gbe ɔ tsɔɔ mi klama.
Ni nɛmɛ nɛ hlaa kaa a ye mi awi ɔ,
daa nɛ ɔ, a ngɛ lakpa yee,
nɛ a ngɛ ye he guɛ gbee kɛ ngɛ nyɛɛe.
13Se imi lɛɛ i pee kaa otokuno; i nui nɔ́!
I pee kaa mumui, i tu we munyu.
14Ee, i pee kaa nɔ ko nɛ nui nɔ́;
i pee kaa nɔ ko nɛ lilɛ kpa tsɔ
nɛ́ nyɛ we munyu tumi.
15Se i ngɔ ye hɛ ngɔ fɔ mo, Yawɛ o nɔ.
Mo Yawɛ, ye Mawu;
mo lɛ o maa pee ye hiami ní ɔmɛ ha mi.
16Ye kue fami kɛkɛ ji,
“Ko ha nɛ ye he nyɛli ɔmɛ nɛ a na bua jɔmi;
ko ha nɛ a ye ye hɛe fɛu
ngɛ ye nɔ́ nami be nɛ ɔ mi.”
17I miɔ nɛ ma nɔ si,
ejakaa daa nɛ ɔ, nɔ́ kɛkɛ i ngɛ nae.
18I ngɛ jajee kaa i pee yayami;
ye he yayami ɔmɛ ngɛ mi dɔe.
19Ye he nyɛli ɔmɛ ngɛ kpakpataa, nɛ a he wa.
Nihi nɛ nyɛɔ mi yaka gu ɔ, a he hiɛ babauu.
20Nihi nɛ ngɔɔ yayami kɛ toɔ kpakpa nane mi ɔ,
jamɛatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ba pee ye he nyɛli;
ejakaa imi lɛɛ i hlaa kaa ma pee nɔ́ nɛ da.
21Yawɛ, ko kua mi;
ye Mawu, koo je ye he.
22Nyɔmtsɛ, ye yi wami helɔ,
ba esɔ nɛ o ba piɛ ye he.

Title: LA 39
Content:
Adesa wami ngɛ kpiti
1I de ke, “Ma hyɛ ye he nɔ saminya,
konɛ i kɛ ye lilɛ ko pee yayami.
Be abɔ nɛ i ngɛ yayami peeli a kpɛti ɔ,
ma ma ye nya.”
2I ma ye nya, nɛ i pee dii kaa mumui;
nɔ́ nɛ sa kaa ma de po, i de we.
Se mohu ɔ, ye nɔ́ nami ɔ nya ba wa kulaa pe kekle ɔ,
3kɛ ya si i pa li bɔ nɛ ma pee ha.
Si abɔ nɛ i ngɛ ye yi mi susue ɔ,
si abɔ nɛ i ngɛ haoe.
Jehanɛ lɛɛ i ba tu munyu nɛ i de ke,
4“Yawɛ, ma hi wami nɛ ɔ mi
kɛ yaa si mɛni be?
Mɛni be ma gbo?
De mi, konɛ ma le kaa ye wami se be kɛe kulaa.”
5Hyɛ kaa o pee ye wami be ɔ kpiti!
Ye wami be ɔ tsuo pi nɔ́ ko kulaa ngɛ o hɛ mi.
Niinɛ, adesa tsuo ngɛ kaa kɔɔhiɔ!
6Ee, nɔmlɔ adesa ngɛ kaa nini;
yaka dengme kɛkɛ lɛ e ngɛ gboe.
E buaa níhi a nya,
se e li nɔ nɛ ma ba ye.
7Nyɔmtsɛ, lɛɛ mɛni i pa ngɛ blɔe mɔ?
Mo, o nɔ lɛ i ngɔ ye hɛ kɛ fɔ.
8Jé mi kɛ je ye yayami ɔmɛ tsuo a mi;
ko ha nɛ kuasiahi nɛ a muɔ mi.
9Ma ma ye nya nɛ ma pee dii,
ejakaa mo lɛ o ha nɛ i na nɔ́ kikɛ nɛ ɔ nɛ.
10Koo gbla ye tue hu; ye he wami ta!
Bɔ nɛ o fiaa mi ní ɔ, e hiɛ!
11Ke o ka adesa hɛ mi, nɛ o gbla e tue
ngɛ e he yayamihi a he
pɛ o kpata e nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ
kaa bo nɛ wɔyewɔye ye.
Niinɛ, nɔmlɔ adesa ngɛ kaa kɔɔhiɔ kɛkɛ.
12Yawɛ, i ngɛ kue fae kɛ ngɛ mo hae;
i ngɛ mo tsɛe kɛ ngmlaa, kɛ ya;
moo bu mi tue koo!
Imi hu pe i ba to nubwɔ be kpiti kɛkɛ
kaa ye nɛmɛ ɔmɛ nɔuu.
13Ngmɛɛ ye he nɛ ma na bua jɔmi,
loko ma je hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ
nɛ i pa be wami nɛ ɔ mi hie hu ɔ.

Title: LA 40
Content:
Yi jemi la
1I to ye tsui si kɛ hyɛ blɔ
kaa Yawɛ ma ba piɛ ye he lo.
Niinɛ, e bu mi tue, nɛ e nu ye kue fami ɔ.
2E gbla mi kɛ je muɔ nɛ mi ngɛ gbeye ɔ mi;
e je mi kɛ je mɔsɔ nɛ mi ti ɔ mi.
E ngɔ mi kɛ ma tɛ sa nɔ,
nɛ e ha nɛ ye nane ma si ekohu.
3E tsɔɔ mi la he
nɛ ma la kɛ je wa Mawu ɔ yi.
Nihi babauu maa na nɔ́ nɛ ɔ;
a maa ye gbeye, nɛ a maa ngɔ
a hɛ kɛ fɔ Yawɛ nɔ.
4A gbaa nɔ nɛ ngɔɔ e hɛ kɛ fɔɔ Yawɛ nɔ,
nɔ nɛ ya nyɛɛ we he nɔ woli a se,
nɔ nɛ ya piɛ we amaga jali a he
kɛ ja we lakpa mawuhi.
5Yawɛ, ye Mawu! O tsu nyakpɛ ní babauu ha wɔ;
o to yi mi kpakpa babauu ngɛ wa he;
mɛnɔ po kɛ mo sɔ?
Ke i ke ma tu ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a he munyu ɔ,
i be nyɛe; ejakaa a he hiɛ tsɔ.
6 O hla we bɔ, nɛ o hla we nike ní hulɔ.
O bi we ke a sã sami bɔ,
loo yayami pami bɔ ha mo.
Mohu ɔ, o bli ye tue, konɛ ma nu o gbi.
7Kɛkɛ nɛ i de ke, “O nɛ mi; i ba;
a ngma ye he sane ngɛ womi kpo ɔ mi.
8Ye Mawu, i suɔ kaa ma pee o suɔmi nya ní;
o mlaa a, a ngma ngɛ ye tsui mi.”
9Yawɛ, i gba kɛ tsɔɔ o ma a tsuo
kaa o he wa yi wami.
O le kaa i be ye nya mae kɔkɔɔkɔ.
10Kikɛmɛ a yi wami hemi munyu nɛ ɔ,
i ngɔɛ kɛ to we imi nɔ kake too ye yi mi.
Daa nɛ ɔ, i jajeɔ ke o yeɔ anɔkuale;
i deɔ ke o heɔ nɔ yi wami.
O suɔmi, kɛ o we anɔkuale yemi ɔ,
i ngɔɛ kɛ laa we o ma kpekpemi ɔ.
11Yawɛ, naa mi mɔbɔ daa;
o kɛ o suɔmi ɔ, kɛ o we anɔkuale ɔ nɛ bu ye he.
Kue fami kɛ ha yemi kɛ buami
(La 70)
12Haomi babauu nɛ hí kaiemi
bɔle mi kɛ kpe.
Ye yayami ɔmɛ ba pe mi,
nɛ i pa hyɛ we nɔ́ hu.
Ye yayami ɔmɛ hiɛ kulaa pe ye yi bwɔmi;
ye mumi nya ta!
13Yawɛ, mo he ye yi wami koo!
Yawɛ, ba piɛ ye he esɔ!
14Nihi nɛ hlaa kaa a maa gbe mi ɔ,
ha nɛ zo nɛ gbe mɛ
nɛ a hɛ mi nɛ pee mɛ yaa.
Ni nɛmɛ nɛ nyaa be mi nɛ i ngɛ nɔ́ nae ɔ,
ha nɛ a kpale a se kɛ zo.
15Nihi hu nɛ yeɔ ye he fɛu, nɛ a deɔ ke, “Yiɛ, yiɛ” ɔ,
ha nɛ zo nɛ gbe mɛ
nɛ a hɛ mi nɛ pee mɛ yaa.
16Se nihi tsuo nɛ hlaa o se blɔ ɔ,
ha nɛ a nya, nɛ a na bua jɔmi.
Ni nɛmɛ nɛ suɔ kaa o he a yi wami ɔ,
ha nɛ a de daa ke, “Yawɛ kle!”
17E fi mi, nɛ ye ní ngɛ mɔbɔ;
se Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ hɛ ngɛ ye nɔ.
Ye Mawu, mo ji ye he piɛlɔ;
mo ji ye kpɔlɔ.
Moo ba ye ngɔ esɔ, koo to tsle!

Title: LA 41
Content:
Hiɔtsɛ ko kue fami
1A gbaa nɔ nɛ susuɔ nihi nɛ a ní ngɛ mɔbɔ a he;
ke haomi ba e nɔ ɔ, Yawɛ maa piɛ e he.
2Yawɛ maa bu e he, nɛ e yi ma na wami.
Yawɛ maa gbaa lɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ,
nɛ e be e he ngmɛɛe kɛ ha e he nyɛli.
3Ke e be he wami ɔ, Yawɛ maa piɛ e he,
nɛ e ma tle lɛ si ngɛ e hiɔ sa nɔ.
4I de ke, “Yawɛ, i pee mo yayami;
naa mi mɔbɔ, nɛ o tsa mi.”
5Ye he nyɛli ɔmɛ tuɔ ye he munyu yaya.
A deɔ ke, “Mɛni be po e ma gbo
nɛ e biɛ maa laa?”
6Nihi nɛ ba slaa mi ɔ,
kɔmɔ nɛ a kɛ mi ba yeɔ ɔ,
kɔmɔ ɔ ji a tsui mi.
Ke a ba a, ye he sane yaya a ba hlaa,
nɛ ke a kpale a se ɔ, a ya sɛɛɔ.
7Nihi tsuo nɛ sume mi ɔ,
a kɛ a sibi tuɔ ye he munyu kusikusi.
A susuɔ ye he yayami.
8A deɔ ke, “Hiɔ yaya ko nu lɛ;
si nɛ e nɔ nɛ ɔ, e pa be si tee hu.”
9 Ye huɛ nitsɛnitsɛ nɛ i heɔ lɛ yeɔ,
nɛ i kɛ lɛ yeɔ ní ɔ,
lɛ po e te si wo mi.
10Se mo Yawɛ, moo na mi mɔbɔ!
Ha ma na he wami ekohu,
konɛ ma wo mɛ hiɔ ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ a pee mi ɔ he.
11Ye he nyɛli ɔmɛ be ye nɔ yee;
nɛ enɛ ɔ maa tsɔɔ mi kaa
o ngɛ ye he bua jɔmi.
12O maa piɛ ye he,
ejakaa i peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da.
O kɛ mi maa hi si daa.
13 A je Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ yi!
A je e yi mwɔnɛ nɛ ɔ;
a je e yi daa. Amen!

Title: LA 42
Content:
WOMI ENYƆNE
(La 42—72)
Nɔ ko nɛ a nu lɛ kɛ ho ma se ya e kue fami
1Mawu lee, ye tsui ngɛ sue kɛ ngɛ mo hlae wawɛɛ
kaa bɔ nɛ odabɔ tsui suu kɛ hlaa nyu ɔ.
2Mawu hɛngmengmletsɛ,
o he kuma ngɛ mi yee.
Mɛni be po ma ba su o ngɔ
nɛ ma ja mo?
3Ya sɔuu i ngɛ foe nyɔ kɛ pia.
Ye vo nyu ba pee ye niye ní;
ejakaa nihi ngɛ mi bie kpamisa ke,
“Jije o Mawu ɔ ngɛ?”
4Ke i kai
bɔ nɛ nyami be ɔmɛ a mi ɔ,
i nyɛɛɔ nihi babauu a hɛ
kɛ poo si kɛ yaa Mawu we ɔ,
nɛ i kɛ ma kpekpemi ɔ tsuo wa hwɔɔ lele,
nɛ wa laa sina lahi
kɛ jeɔ mo Mawu, o yi ɔ,
ye tsui yeɔ wawɛɛ.
5Mɛni he je i pee vii kikɛ nɛ ɔ?
Mɛni he je i ngɛ haoe kikɛ nɛ ɔ?
Ma ngɔ ye hɛ kɛ fɔ Mawu nɔ,
nɛ ma je e yi ekohu;
lɛ ji ye kpɔlɔ; lɛ ji ye Mawu.
6-7Ye tsui ngɛ yee ngɛ ye mi
ngɛ ma se hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ;
lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ye juɛmi tsuo ngɛ Mawu nɔ.
Kɔmɔ sɔuu ɛ e ha i ngɛ yee kpamisa;
hɛ mi kpatami ma mi nami
kaa nyu kpekpemi
nɛ pee hamahama kɛ ngɛ si puee babaaba,
kɛ ngɛ Hermon kɛ Mizar yo ɔmɛ a nɔ jee
kɛ ngɛ Yordan kɔ̃ ɔ mi puee.
8Piani ɔ, Yawɛ maa na mi mɔbɔ,
konɛ nyɔ mi ɔ, ma la nɛ ma fa kue ha lɛ Mawu,
ye yi baalɔ ɔ.
9Ma bi Mawu, ye he bulɔ ɔ ke,
“Mɛni he je o hɛ je ye nɔ?
Mɛni he je ma hi nɔ́ nae kpamisa?
Mɛni be o ma je mi kɛ je he nyɛli
nɛ ngɛ mi haoe ɔ a dɛ mi?”
10Ye he nyɛli ɔmɛ yeɔ ye he fɛu
nɛ a biɔ mi daa ke,
“Jije o Mawu ɔ ngɛ?”
I nuɔ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ he ngɛ ye mi
kaa pa nɛ miɔ nɛ maa gbe mi.
11Mɛni he je nɛ i pee vii kikɛ nɛ ɔ?
Mɛni he je nɛ i ngɛ haoe kikɛ nɛ ɔ?
Ma ngɔ ye hɛ kɛ fɔ Mawu nɔ,
nɛ ma je e yi ekohu;
lɛ ji ye kpɔlɔ kɛ ye Mawu.

Title: LA 43
Content:
Nɔ ko nɛ a nu lɛ kɛ ho ma se ya e kue fami
(La 42 nɔ tsami)
1Mawu lee! Hyɛ ye sane ɔ mi ha mi,
nɛ o wo mi nguɔ.
Jé mi kɛ je ma nɛ li mo ɔ a dɛ mi.
Kpɔ mi kɛ je lakpatsɛmɛ, kɛ yayami peeli a dɛ mi oo!
2Ejakaa mo Mawu ji ye wesa he.
Mɛni he je nɛ o kua mi?
Mɛni he je nɛ yayami peeli maa hi mi yi mi wae,
nɛ ma hi kɔmɔ yee kpamisa?
3Ha nɛ o la a, kɛ o we anɔkuale ɔ
nɛ ba esɔesɔ;
ha nɛ a ba tsɔɔ mi blɔ,
nɛ a kpaka mi kɛ ya Zion yo klɔuklɔu ɔ nɔ;
a kpaka mi kɛ ya mo nitsɛ o we ɔ
he nɛ o hii ɔ.
4Kɛkɛ ɔ, ma ya su o bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he,
ngɛ mo Mawu, ye bua wolɔ nitsɛnitsɛ ɔ o ngɔ.
Ma fia kpa saku kɛ je o yi,
mo Mawu, ye Mawu.
5Mɛni he je nɛ i pee vii kikɛ nɛ ɔ?
Mɛni he je nɛ i ngɛ haoe kikɛ nɛ ɔ?
Ma ngɔ ye hɛ kɛ fɔ Mawu nɔ!
Ma je e yi ekohu.
Lɛ ji ye kpɔlɔ; lɛ ji ye Mawu.

Title: LA 44
Content:
Kue fami kɛ ha yi baami
1Mawu lee, wa nɛmɛ ɔmɛ sɛɛ ha wɔ;
nɛ wɔ nitsɛmɛ hu wa nu kɛ wa tue.
A gba wɔ ke blema a,
o tsu ní nguanguahi ha mɛ.
2Wa na le kaa o ngɔ o he wami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ
kɛ fie je ma amɛ kɛ ya se,
nɛ o to o ma a sisi ngɛ zugba a nɔ.
O gbla je ma amɛ a tue,
se o ma a lɛɛ o ha nɛ a ye a he.
3Ejakaa pi a klaate nɛ a kɛ ngɔ zugba a;
pi a he wami nya nɛ a ye kunimi ɔ,
se o he wami, kɛ o mɔbɔ nami nya;
ejakaa o ngɛ o ma a he bua jɔmi.
4Mo ji ye matsɛ kɛ ye Mawu;
mo lɛ o haa nɛ o ma a yeɔ kunimi.
5Mo lɛ o haa nɛ wa yeɔ wa he nyɛli ɔmɛ a nɔ.
Nihi nɛ teɔ si kɛ woɔ wɔ ɔ,
o biɛ waa kɛ jɔɔ a he.
6Ejakaa i ngɔɛ ye hɛ kɛ fɔɛ ye kɛ̃ɛ̃ nɔ;
klaate be ye yi wami nyɛe ma he.
7Se mohu, mo ji nɔ nɛ he wa yi wami.
O he wa yi wami kɛ je wa he nyɛli a dɛ mi,
nɛ o ha nɛ zo gbe ni nɛmɛ nɛ sume wɔ ɔ.
8Mawu, mo o nɔ wa fĩaa kɛ fɔɔ daa.
Wa maa na mo si kɛ maa ya neneene.
9Se jehanɛ lɛɛ o kua wɔ;
o ha wa he guɛ gbo,
nɛ o piɛ we wa he kɛ yɛ ta hu.
10O ha wa tu fo ngɛ ta nya,
nɛ wa he nyɛli ɔmɛ ha wa níhi.
11O ngɔ wɔ ngɔ ha kaa tohi nɛ a yaa gbe.
O gbɛ wɔ ngɔ fĩa je ma amɛ a mi.
12O jua o ma a, nɛ o he nɔ́ ko nyafii kɛkɛ,
kaa nɔ́ nɛ o ma a he be se nami ko kulaa.
13O ha nihi nɛ bɔle wɔ kɛ kpe ɔ na wa we ahlua a;
a ye wa he fɛu, nɛ a muɔ wɔ.
14O ha wa plɛ pee abɛ bumi nɔ́ ha je ma amɛ;
Wa pee muɔ nɔ́ ha mɛ.
15-16Daa nɛ, ke ye he nyɛli na mi kikɛ nɛ ɔ,
yaka jɛmi tɛ̃ a nya mi;
ye he guɛ sɔuu a hii gbee,
nɛ zo gbeɔ mi kpɔtɔɔ.
17Ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ba wa nɔ,
se kɛ̃ ɔ, wa hɛ ji o nɔ,
nɛ somi nɛ o kɛ wɔ so ɔ hu
wa tɔ̃ we nɔ.
18Wa kua we mo,
nɛ o mlaa a hu, wa tɔ̃ we nɔ.
19Se o ngmɛɛ wa he
ngɔ wo lohwe dikali a dɛ mi,
nɛ wa tlɔ diblii kpii mi.
20Kaa pe wa hɛ je mo, wa Mawu ɔ o nɔ,
nɛ wa ya ja ma se mawu ko ɔ,
21anɛ mo, Mawu ɔ, o ko nɛ lo?
Ejakaa o le níhi tsuo
nɛ nɔmlɔ ngɔɔ kɛ laa ngɛ e tsui mi.
22 O he ɔ, a gbeɔ wɔ be tsuaa be;
a buɔ wɔ kaa tohi nɛ a yaa gbe.
23Nyɔmtsɛ, o hɛ nɛ tsɛ!
Tee si nɛ o hyɛ wɔ;
ko kua wɔ kulaa!
24Mɛni he je o ngɔ o hɛ mi kɛ laa wɔ ɔ?
Mɛni ba loko o hɛ je nɔ
kaa a ngɛ wɔ yi mi wae,
nɛ wa ngɛ nɔ́ nae ɔ?
25Hyɛ kaa wa hule kɛ pue si,
nɛ wa tlɔ zugba.
26Nyɔmtsɛ, tee si nɛ o ba piɛ wa he;
ba nɛ o ba he wa yi wami.
Ejakaa o mɔbɔ nami ɔ ngɛ daa.

Title: LA 45
Content:
Suɔmi la
1Benɛ i ngɛ la nɛ ɔ poe kɛ ha matsɛ ɔ,
munyu kpakpa sɔuu lɛ ba ye yi mi.
La a ba ye nya amlɔ nɔuu
kaa bɔ nɛ ní ngmalɔ kpakpa
ngɔɔ e ningma tso kɛ ngmaa ni esɔesɔ ɔ.
2O he ngɛ fɛu pe nɔ tsuaa nɔ.
O nya mi tsɔ kɛ munyu tumi.
Mawu gbaa mo kɛ yaa neneene.
3Matsɛ nguaa, moo ngɔ o klaate ɔ kɛ wo o fiɔ he,
konɛ a na o hɛ mi nyami,
kɛ o we agboje ɔ tsuo.
4Yaa! Hii okpɔngɔ nɔ kɛ ya ye kunimi,
nɛ o kɔsɔ.
Yaa nɛ o ya fa anɔkuale, kɛ dami sane he!
Ngɔɔ o he wami ɔ kɛ tsu nyakpɛ ní nguanguahi!
5O kɛ̃ɛ̃ mi bi ɔmɛ a nya ba;
a guu o he nyɛli ɔmɛ a tsui mi
kɛ yeɔ je ma amɛ a nɔ kunimi.
6 Matsɛ sɛ klɔuklɔu ɔ maa hi si kɛ maa ya neneene.
O matsɛ tso ɔ ji dami sane yemi he okadi.
7O suɔ nɔ́ nɛ da, se yayami lɛɛ o hĩɔ;
enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, o Mawu ɔ wo mo matsɛ,
nɛ e ha mo bua jɔmi
pe matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsuo.
8O tadehi a mi jeɔ via liliili kɛ tsopa kɛ e he via:
mire, aloe, kɛ kasia.
Kpa sakuhi a fiaa kɛ haa o bua jɔɔ o he
ngɛ o mɔ ɔmɛ a mi;
suɔ wu a kɛ ma mɔ nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo.
9O yi kpakpa amɛ ɔ, matsɛmɛ a bimɛ ngɛ mi;
manyɛ ɔ dla e he kɛ sika tsu kpakpa
kɛ daa si ngɛ o hiɔ nine nɔ.
10Biyo, bu nɔ́ nɛ ma de mo nɛ ɔ tue;
o hɛ nɛ je mo nitsɛ o ma mi bi ɔmɛ,
kɛ o weku li ɔmɛ tsuo a nɔ;
11kɛkɛ o he fɛu ɔ maa pee matsɛ ɔ akɔnɔ;
lɛ ji o nyɔmtsɛ,
lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ba o he si ha lɛ.
12Tiro ma mi bi ɔmɛ maa ngɔ nike ní
kɛ ba sa o hɛ mi.
13Niatsɛmɛ tete po maa ngɔ nike ní kɛ ba.
A wo matsɛ biyo ɔ ní saminyayoo ngɛ e tsu ɔ mi.
Bo nɛ e bu ɔ, sika tsu kpa a kɛ lo.
14Bo nɛ a lo ní saminyawiiwi kɛ wo mi
nɛ e bu kɛ ba matsɛ ɔ ngɔ.
E mawa amɛ nɛ a kpaka lɛ kɛ ba;
e he biali, kɛ e huɛmɛ nyɛɛ e se yuu.
15A ngɔ mɛ kɛ ba matsɛ we ɔ
kɛ bua jɔmi, kɛ nyami.
16Mo matsɛ, o ma na nina babauu
nɛ ma ba ye ganɔ
ngɛ o nɛmɛ ɔmɛ a nane mi,
nɛ o ma ha a maa ye tsɛ
ngɛ je ɔ mi tsuo.
17Ma ha nɛ a ma kai mo yi nɔhi tsuo,
nɛ ma amɛ tsuo ma je o yi daa
kɛ maa ya neneene.

Title: LA 46
Content:
Mawu kɛ wɔ ngɛ
1Mawu ji wa wesa he, kɛ wa he wami.
Wa fimi behi tsuo a mi ɔ,
e ngɛ wa kasa nya.
2Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke zugba mimiɛ,
nɛ yohi hia kɛ ya pue wo mi po,
wa be gbeye yee.
3Ke wo ɔ gli, nɛ oslɔke ɔmɛ ku kɛ ngmlaa hoo,
nɛ e ha yo ɔmɛ mimiɛ po,
wa be gbeye yee.
4Pa ko ngɛ nɛ e kɔni ɔmɛ haa
Mawu ma a bua jɔɔ a he.
Hiɔwe no ɔ hi he ɔ ngɛ klɔuklɔu.
5Mawu ngɛ jamɛ a ma a mi,
lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ma a hɛ mi be kpatae kɔkɔɔkɔ.
Loko haomi maa ba a nɔ ɔ,
Mawu je ngmlaa ha mɛ momo.
6Je ma amɛ a mi mi fuɔ, nɛ a peeɔ hoo;
se ke Mawu wo gbi ɔ,
zugba a he jɔɔ.
7Yawɛ, Tabohiatsɛ ɔ kɛ wɔ ngɛ;
Yakob Mawu ɔ ji wa wesa he.
8Nyɛɛ hyɛ níhi nɛ Yawɛ tsu,
bɔ nɛ e kpata níhi a hɛ mi
ngɛ zugba a nɔ.
9E haa ta se poɔ ngɛ je ɔ mi tsuo;
e kuɔ kɛ̃ɛ̃hi, kɛ akplɔhi a mi,
nɛ e kɛ la sãã ta zugba lɛhi!
10Mawu ke, “Nyɛɛ pee dii,
nɛ nyɛ na nyɛɛ le kaa
imi ji Mawu ɔ nɛ.
Je ma amɛ tsuo a kpɛti ɔ, nɔ ko nɔ ko be nɛ kɛ mi sɔ.
Je ɔ mi hu nɔ ko pi mi.”
11Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ kɛ wɔ ngɛ;
Yakob Mawu ɔ ji wa wesa he.

Title: LA 47
Content:
Matsɛ kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ
1Je ma amɛ tsuo, nyɛɛ fia nyɛ dɛ mi!
Nyɛɛ kɛ bua jɔmi nɛ he ose kɛ je Mawu yi!
2Yawɛ, nɔ nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe lokoo ɔ
he ngɛ gbeye.
Matsɛ kpetekpleenyɛ nɛ yeɔ je ɔ tsuo nɔ ji lɛ.
3E jɔɔ ma amɛ a he ha wɔ,
konɛ waa ye a nɔ.
4Lɛ nitsɛ nɛ e ngɔ zugba nɛ wa ngɛ nɔ nɛ ɔ
ngɔ ha wɔ.
E ngɔ weto ní kpakpa nɛ ɔ ngɔ ha e ma
Yakob nɛ e suɔ saminya a.
5Mawu ho hiɔwe ya,
nɛ a he ose!
Yawɛ ho hiɔwe ya,
nɛ titimati pɛ, benɛ e yaa hi e sɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ!
6Nyɛ la kɛ je Mawu yi!
Nyɛ la kɛ je wa matsɛ ɔ yi!
Nyɛ la kɛ je e yi.
7Ejakaa Mawu ji matsɛ nɛ yeɔ je ɔ tsuo nɔ.
Nyɛ la yi jemi la ha lɛ.
8Mawu hii si ngɛ e matsɛ sɛ klɔuklɔu ɔ nɔ!
E ngɛ je ma amɛ tsuo a nɔ yee.
9Je ma amɛ a ganɔ ɔmɛ bua a he nya kɛ ba,
konɛ a ba pee Abraham Mawu ɔ ma.
E he wa pe je nɛ ɔ mi tabo ɔmɛ tsuo.
Matsɛ kpetekpleenyɛ ji lɛ.

Title: LA 48
Content:
Zion, Mawu ma a
1Yawɛ kle,
nɛ e sa kaa a je e yi saminya.
A je e yi ngɛ wa Mawu ɔ ma a mi
ngɛ yo klɔuklɔu ɔ nɔ.
2 Zion yo ɔ nɛ ngɛ omleyi je lokoo ɔ,
lɔ ɔ ji matsɛ kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ ma.
Yo klɔuklɔu ɔ nɛ maa si glouu kɛ e he fɛu ɔ,
lɔ ɔ lɛ haa je ɔ tsuo bua jɔmi.
3Mawu je e he kpo ngɛ e mɔ ɔmɛ a mi
kaa wesa he nitsɛnitsɛ ji lɛ.
4Matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ bua a he nya babauu,
konɛ a ba tua Zion yo ɔ.
5Se benɛ a ba na a, a nya kpɛ a he;
sawale nu mɛ, nɛ a wo fo pulɛpulɛ kɛ je.
6A he do blibliibli, nɛ a he hia mɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ
kaa yo nɛ nu kɔɔmi.
7O ha beleku kɔɔhiɔ fia huu!
Nɛ e ywia Spania lɛ ɔmɛ.
8Wa nu kaa Mawu tsu nyakpɛ níhi ba be;
jehanɛ lɛɛ wa na nyakpɛ níhi nɛ e tsu ɔ
ngɛ Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ, wa Mawu ɔ ma a mi.
E ma ha ma a maa ma si kpɛii
kɛ maa ya neneene.
9Mawu, ngɛ o we ɔ, wa susu o suɔmi nɛ ngɛ daa a he.
10Mawu, dami sane pɛ o yeɔ; nɛ kaa bɔ nɛ o biɛ ngɛ
pɛe ɔ, a ngɛ o yi jee ngɛ je ɔ mi tsuo.
11Ha nɛ Zion ma a nɛ nya,
nɛ Yuda ma amɛ a bua nɛ jɔ;
ejakaa o kojoɔ bɔ nɛ sa pɛ.
12Mawu ma, nyɛɛ nyɛɛ kɛ bɔle Zion kɛ kpe,
nɛ nyɛɛ kane mɔhi nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ;
13nyɛɛ slaa gbogbo ɔmɛ,
nɛ nyɛɛ to mɔ ɔmɛ a he hɛ saminya;
bɔ nɛ pee nɛ nyɛɛ sɛɛ ha yi nɔ
nɛ nyɛɛ nyɛ se ɔ ke,
14“Mawu nɛ ɔ ji wa Mawu.
Lɛ ji wa Mawu kɛ yaa neneene.
Lɛ nɔuu nɛ e maa tsɔɔ wɔ blɔ
kɛ maa ya neneene.”

Title: LA 49
Content:
Koo ngɔ hɛ kɛ fɔ ní nami nɔ
1Je ɔ mi nihi tsuo, nyɛɛ bu mi tue.
Nyɛ ta tue saminya ha mi!
2Ni nguahi kɛ ni wawi,
niatsɛmɛ kɛ ohiatsɛmɛ,
nyɛ tsuo nyɛ ta tue!
3Munyu nɛ maa je ye nya a,
nile munyu sɔuu.
Munyuhi nɛ a mi kuɔ saminya
a he ma susu.
4Ma bu tue nɛ ma nu abɛ ko,
nɛ ma fia kpa saku kɛ tsɔɔ nya.
5Ke he nyɛli bɔle mi kɛ kpe,
nɛ a ngɛ mi nisɛ ní pee po,
mɛni he je ma ye gbeye?
6He nyɛli ɔmɛ ɔ, pi ní nɛ a na a
nɔ nɛ a ngɔɔ a hɛ kɛ fɔɔ?
Pi ní babauu nɛ a na a nɔ
nɛ a fĩaa kɛ fɔɔ lo?
7Niinɛ, nɔ ko nɔ ko be lɛ nitsɛ e he nyɛe ma kpɔ;
nɔ ko nɔ ko be nyɛe maa wo Mawu hiɔ
nɛ maa su e wami nya.
8Nɔmlɔ adesa wami he jua wa saminya,
nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be Mawu hiɔ nyɛe maa wo
nɛ maa su nya,
9konɛ e hi je mi daa,
nɛ e ko gbo.
10Nɔ tsuaa nɔ le nɔ́ nɛ ɔ:
ni lelɔ po gboɔ,
nɛ kuasia nɛ be juɛmi hu gboɔ ja nɔuu.
Mɛ tsuo a siɔ a ní ɔmɛ kɛ haa ni kpahi.
11A susuɔ kaa a we ɔmɛ, kɛ a zugba amɛ
maa hi si daa;
nɛ a kɛ a biɛhi woɔ zugba amɛ,
se gbeje mohu ya peeɔ a hi he
kɛ yaa yi nɔhi tsuo.
12Nɔmlɔ adesa gboɔ
kaa bɔ nɛ lohwehi tsuo gboɔ ɔ;
e hɛ mi nyami ɔ kɛ lɛ hí si
kɛ yɛ neneene.
13Nihi nɛ ngɔɔ a hɛ kɛ fɔɔ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a he nɔ,
kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ ní nami se pɛ a dii ɔ,
bɔ nɛ a nyagbe maa ba ji nɛ ɔ nɛ:
14a ma gbo kaa to gboɔ;
gbenɔ maa ngɔ mɛ kɛ ya gbeje tɔɔ.
Se ni nɛmɛ nɛ peeɔ nɔ nɛ da a
maa ye yayami peeli a nɔ;
yayami peeli a nɔmlɔ tso ɔ ma puɛ kulaa,
nɛ gbeje maa pee a hi he.
15Se imi lɛɛ Mawu ma kpɔ mi
kɛ je gbenɔ dɛ mi.
E maa ngɔ mi kɛ ba e ngɔ.
16Ke yayami peelɔ ná ní babauu kɛ be nɔ,
nɛ e we mi hyi tɔ kɛ afɛu níhi ɔ,
koo ye o tsui ngɛ he.
17Ejakaa ke e gbo ɔ,
e be ní nɛ ɔmɛ ekoeko ngɔe kɛ ya gbeje.
18Ke e na bua jɔmi saminya, benɛ e na ní,
nɛ nihi je e yi kaa e bɔ mɔde tete po ɔ,
19e ma ya piɛ e nɛmɛ nɛ gbo blema a a he;
nɛ lejɛ ɔ, e be la nae gblegbleegble hu.
20Nɔmlɔ adesa gboɔ
kaa bɔ nɛ lohwehi tsuo gboɔ ɔ,
e we agboje ɔ kɛ lɛ hí si
kɛ yɛ neneene.

Title: LA 50
Content:
Anɔkuale jami
1Yawɛ Mawu Ope ɔ ngɛ munyu tue.
E ngɛ je ɔ tsuo tsɛe;
e ke a je beleku je, kɛ bonyoku je kɛ ba.
2Mawu hɛ mi nyami ɔ ngɛ kpɛe saminyayoo;
Zion, ma nɛ ngɛ fɛu kɛ pi si ɔ mi
e ngɛ kpɛe kɛ ngɛ jee.
3Wa Mawu ɔ ma oo, e pee we di,
se mohu la gegeege nɛ puɛɔ nɔ́
ngɛ e hɛ mi kɛ ma,
nɛ ahumi ngɛ fiae kɛ ngɛ lɛ bɔlee.
4E maa kojo e ma a;
lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e ngɛ hiɔwe kɛ zugba odase tsɛe.
5Bɔ nɛ e ngɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ:
“Ye ni klɔuklɔuhi nɛ i kɛ mɛ so
kɛ gu bɔ sami mi ɔ,
nyɛ bua a nya kɛ ba ha mi.”
6Hiɔwe tsuo ngɛ dee ke
Mawu ɔ, dalɔ kɛ kojolɔ ji lɛ.
7“Ye ma, nyɛ ta tue saminya,
konɛ nyɛɛ nu nɔ́ nɛ ma de
kɛ si nyɛ, Israel ma.
Imi ji nyɛ Mawu ɔ nɛ.
8Bɔhi, kɛ sami bɔhi nɛ nyɛ kɛ baa ye hɛ mi ɔ,
pi lɔ ɔmɛ a he nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ hɛ mi kae ngɛ.
9Pohu i hla we nɛ nyɛɛ ngɔ na
kɛ je nyɛ ngmɔ mi,
loo to akpakpo kɛ je nyɛ to tsu mi
kɛ ba ha mi.
10Ejakaa pu mi lohwehi, kɛ lohwehi
nɛ ngɛ yokuhi tsuo a nɔ ɔ,
ye níhi ji mɛ.
11I le nga mi lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ tsuo,
pu mi lohwehi hu ye níhi.
12“Ke hwɔ ngɛ mi yee ɔ,
i be nyɛ dee,
ejakaa ye nɔ́ ji je ɔ kɛ e mi nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́.
13Anɛ i yeɔ na lo,
aloo i nuɔ to akpakpo muɔ?
14Nyɛɛ sã bɔ nɛ nyɛ kɛ na Mawu si,
konɛ si nɛ nyɛ wo Hiɔwe No ɔ,
nyɛɛ ye nɔ.
15Ke nyɛ yi fi ɔ, nyɛ tsɛ mi;
ma je nyɛ,
konɛ nyɛɛ wo ye hɛ mi nyami.”
16Se yayami peelɔ ɔ, bɔ nɛ Mawu ngɛ lɛ dee ji,
“Mɛnɔ ha mo he blɔ ke o kane ye mlaa amɛ
blɛblɛɛblɛ, loo o tu ye somi ɔ he munyu?
17O sume tsɔsemi,
nɛ ye munyu hu o sake ngɔ fɔ o tue se.
18Ke o na julɔ ɔ, o kɛ lɛ tsɔɔ huɛ,
nɛ gba puɛli o kɛ bɔɔ.
19“O he sɔɔ kɛ tuɔ munyu yaya be tsuaa be;
nɛ lakpa jeɔ o nya puu.
20O yeɔ o nyɛmimɛ a he sieku,
nɛ o nyɛbi po o puɛɔ e biɛ.
21O pee ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo;
se akɛnɛ i de we nɔ́ ko he je ɔ,
o susu kaa i ngɛ kaa mo.
Jehanɛ lɛɛ i ngɛ o hɛ mi kae;
i ngɔ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ kɛ ngɛ o hɛ mi mae paa.
22“Nyɛ nihi tsuo nɛ nyɛ hɛ je imi Mawu, ye nɔ ɔ,
nyɛ susu nɔ́ nɛ ɔ he saminya.
Ke pi ja a, ma tsɔtslɔɔ nyɛ,
nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be nɛ ma kpɔ nyɛ.
23Nɔ nɛ ba sãã bɔ kɛ naa mi si ɔ,
e ngɛ ye hɛ mi nyami woe.
Nɔ nɛ peeɔ nɔ nɛ da a,
imi Mawu hu ma he e yi wami.”

Title: LA 51
Content:
Kue fami kɛ ha yayami pami
1 Mawu, naa mi mɔbɔ
ngɛ o suɔmi nɛ ngɛ daa a he;
nɛ ngɛ o mɔbɔ nami nɛ be nyagbe ɔ he ɔ,
tsu ye he yayami ɔmɛ.
2Du ha mi
konɛ ye mu ní ɔmɛ,
kɛ yayami ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ a je ye he kulaa.
3Ye tɔmi ɔmɛ ɔ, imi nitsɛ i le,
nɛ ye hɛ ngɛ ye yayami ɔmɛ a nɔ daa.
4 Mo, o nɔ nɛ i tɔ̃,
mo pɛ nɛ i pee yayami nɛ ɔ kɛ si.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, fɔ nɛ o bu mi ɔ,
e sa mi.
Piami ko piami ko be o he.
5Kɛ je be nɛ a fɔ mi ɔ, yayami peelɔ ji mi.
Loko ye nyɛ ngɔ mi hɔ po, yayami ngɛ ye he.
6O suɔ nɛ ma ye mo anɔkuale kɛ pi si;
lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ngɔɔ o nile kɛ wo ye mi tɔ.
7Ngɔɔ nga nɛ a fi kɛ bla kaa bɛ kɛ tsu ye he,
konɛ ye he nɛ tsɔ.
Du ye he ha mi saminya,
nɛ ma hiɛ futaa pe sinoo.
8Ha ma nu lele hwɔmi, kɛ bua jɔmi he.
E ngɛ mi kaa a gbla ye tue wawɛɛ lɛɛ,
se ha nɛ ma na bua jɔmi ekohu.
9Koo hyɛ ye yayami ɔmɛ,
se mohu tsu mɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ.
10Mawu, bɔɔ tsui nɛ he tsɔ ha mi;
ngɔɔ mumi nɛ yeɔ mo anɔkuale kɛ wo ye mi.
11Koo fie mi kɛ je o hɛ mi,
nɛ ko je o Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ kɛ je ye mi.
12Ha ma na bua jɔmi ekohu
kaa mo ji ye yi wami helɔ;
nɛ́ o ha nɛ ma bu mo tue daa.
13Kɛkɛ ɔ, ma tsɔɔ yayami peeli o mlaa a,
konɛ a kpale kɛ ba o ngɔ.
14Mawu, koo bu mi fɔ kaa muɔ si puelɔ,
konɛ ma la kɛ bua jɔmi
kɛ je o yi.
15Nyɔmtsɛ, bli ye nya,
konɛ ma la kɛ je o yi.
16O hla we bɔhi,
jinɛ ma ngɔ kɛ ba;
sami bɔ hu, o sume.
17Bɔ nɛ saa mo Mawu o hɛ mi ji he piami.
Ke nɔ ko pia e he, nɛ e tsake e tsui ɔ,
o kua we lɛ.
18Mawu, naa Zion mɔbɔ, nɛ o piɛ e he koo;
nɛ o fia Yerusalem gbogbo ɔmɛ ekohu.
19Lɔ ɔ loko o bua maa jɔ bɔhi nɛ sa a he;
sami bɔ ɔ, o bua maa jɔ he;
a maa sã na kuhi
ngɛ o bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ.

Title: LA 52
Content:
Mawu kojomi kɛ e dloomi
1 Mo katsɛ, o ngɛ dalɔ yayami pee
nɛ o ngɛ fĩae.
Mɛni he je?
Mawu suɔmi ɔ ngɛ daa.
2Nihi a hɛ mi kpatami he sɔuu
o ngɛ soe be tsuaa be.
O lilɛ ngɛ kaa asoyi nɛ nya ba,
mo lakpatsɛ, nɔ sisilɔ.
3O suɔ yayami pe kpakpa,
nɛ o suɔ lakpa munyu hu pe anɔkuale.
4Munyuhi nɛ kpataa nɔ hɛ mi sɔuu he o susuɔ;
lakpatsɛ nitsɛnitsɛ ji mo.
5Mawu hu maa ngɔ mo ngɔ fia si ja nɔuu
kɛ maa ya neneene.
E ma sá mo kɛ je o we ɔ mi;
e ma je mo kɛ je hɛ kali a zugba a nɔ.
6Nihi nɛ yeɔ dami sane maa na o nyagbe ɔ,
nɛ a maa ye gbeye.
A maa muɔ mo, nɛ a ma de ke,
7“Hyɛ, nyumu nɛ ɔ ngɔɛ e hɛ kɛ fɔɛ Mawu nɔ
kaa e he bulɔ,
mohu ɔ, ní babauu nɛ e na a
nɔ e ngɔ e hɛ kɛ fɔ,
nɛ yi wu tso níhi nɛ e pee ɔ nɛ wo lɛ he wami.”
8Se imi lɛɛ i ngɛ kaa oliv tso ngɛ Mawu we ɔ.
I ngɔ ye hɛ kɛ fɔ Mawu mɔbɔ nami nɔ;
e mɔbɔ nami ɔ be nyagbe.
9Mawu, ma na mo si daa,
ma na mo si kɛ maa ya neneene
ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ o pee ɔ he.
Ma na mo si ngɛ o ma a hɛ mi.
Ma wo o biɛ ta, nɛ ma je o yi.

Title: LA 53
Content:
Adesa yi mi wa
(La 14)
1 Kuasia lɛ deɔ ke,
“Mawu ko be.”
Mɛni he je ɔ mɛ tsuo a puɛ.
Yayamihi nɛ a ngɛ pee ɔ ngɛ he mi nyɛɛmi saminya.
Nɔ ko nɔ ko be nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da.
2Mawu nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ ngɛ nimli adesahi tsuo hyɛe;
e ngɛ hyɛe kaa e maa na nɔ ko nɛ le nɔ́;
nɔ ko nɛ jaa lɛ Mawu ɔ lo.
3Se mɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ a tla blɔ,
mɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ a puɛ.
Nɔ ko nɔ ko be nɛ peeɔ nɔ nɛ da;
dɛbi; nɔ kake ngmelu po be!
4Mawu ngɛ bie ke,
“Ni nɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ yayami pee ɔ, a li nɔ́ lo?
A ngɔ ojo fiami kɛ pee a nyangma.
Se imi, a Mawu ɔ lɛɛ a ja we mi.”
5Hyɛ mɛ nɛ sawale nu mɛ momo;
nɔ́ ko kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ bɛ hyɛ.
Ejakaa Mawu ma sake yayami peeli a wuhi kɛ pue he,
nɛ zo maa gbe mɛ kpɔtɔɔ.
Mawu ma kua mɛ;
6I ná nɛ a je Zion ba he Israel yi wami.
Ke Mawu ha nɛ a kpale na a he ekohu ɔ,
Yakob ma na bua jɔmi,
nɛ Israel ma nya!

Title: LA 54
Content:
He bumi kɛ je he nyɛli a dɛ mi he kue fami
1 Mawu, ngɔɔ o he wami ɔ kɛ kpɔ mi.
Ngɔɔ o he wami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ kɛ wo mi nguɔ!
2Mawu, bu ye kue fami ɔ tue,
nɛ o nu ye munyu ɔmɛ!
3Ejakaa ma je li ma mi tuami.
Yiwutsotsɛmɛ ngɛ hlae nɛ a kpata ye hɛ mi;
mɛɛ lɛɛ pi a he sane ko ji mo Mawu.
4Se mo Mawu ji ye he piɛlɔ;
Yawɛ, mo ji ye yi baalɔ.
5Yayami nɛ ye he nyɛli ɔmɛ ngɛ hlae ha mi ɔ,
Mawu, ha nɛ e kpale kɛ ba na mɛ nitsɛmɛ.
Anɔkualetsɛ ji mo,
lɔ ɔ he ɔ, kpata yayami peeli nɛ ɔmɛ a hɛ mi.
6Ma je ye tsui mi faa ma sã bɔ ha mo Yawɛ;
ejakaa e hi kaa ma pee ja
kɛ na mo si.
7O je mi kɛ je ye haomi ɔ tsuo mi,
nɛ i na bɔ nɛ o ye ye he nyɛli ɔmɛ
a nɔ kunimi.

Title: LA 55
Content:
Nɔ ko nɛ e huɛ tsɔɔ e se blɔ e kue fami
1Mawu, bu ye kue fami ɔ tue;
kue nɛ i ngɛ fae ha mo ɔ, koo tsi o tue.
2Bu mi tue koo, nɛ o he nɔ ha mi;
ye haomi ɔmɛ ba pe mi.
3Ye he nyɛli ɔmɛ ngɛ ye he gbeye woe.
Yiwutsotsɛmɛ ngɛ mi yi mi wae.
A ngɛ mi haoe, nɛ a mi mi fu mi wawɛɛ
kɛ ngɛ mi nyɛe yaka.
4I ngɛ gbeye yee wawɛɛ.
Gbenɔ he fɔ̃ nu mi.
5Gbeye sɔuu ha ye he ngɛ doe blibliibli,
nɛ tsuipo ha sawale nu mi.
6Bɔ nɛ i ngɛ dee ji,
“I na nɛ i ngɛ pɛli kaa lahuɛ,
jinɛ i ko te kɛ je nɛ i ya jɔɔ ye he.
7Niinɛ, i ko te kɛ ya tsitsaa,
nɛ i ko ya hi nga kplanaa a nɔ tɔɔ.
8I ko te mla kɛ ya laa ye he
kɛ je kɔɔhiɔ vuduvudu, kɛ ahumi nɛ ɔ nya.”
9Nyɔmtsɛ, ha nɛ ye he nyɛli ɔmɛ a yi mi tomi ɔmɛ
nɛ pee yaka.
Mo tsaka a gbi ɔ, nɛ o ko ha nɛ a nu a sibi sisi.
Ejakaa yi mi wami, kɛ pɛ hyi ma a mi tɔ.
10Nyɔ kɛ pia tsuo gbogbo ɔmɛ a nɔ ma mi bi ɔmɛ
hii nyɛɛe kɛ hii ma a bɔlee,
nɛ a ha yayami peemi, kɛ haomi sɔuu
hyi ma a mi.
11Nihi a hɛ mi sɔuu a ngɛ kpatae ngɛ ma a mi;
gbɛjegbɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ hu,
yi mi wami, kɛ amimi yemi sɔuu
lɛ ngɛ nɔ yae.
12Kaa ye he nyɛlɔ nɛ ngɛ mi ahlua nɛ ɔ bɔe ɔ,
i ko de we nɔ́ ko;
nɛ kaa ye futsɛ lɛ ngɛ e he nɔ woe
ngɛ ye nɔ ɔ,
i ko ngɔ ye he kɛ laa lɛ.
13Se e ya pee mo, ye juã,
ye he nɔ, kɛ ye huɛ kpakpa.
14Wa sɛɛɔ wa yi mi ní ngɔngɔɛ kɛ haa wa sibi,
nɛ wa blaa kɛ ya jaa Mawu
ngɛ e we ɔ.
15Ha nɛ ye he nyɛli ɔmɛ nɛ a gbo tlukaa;
ha nɛ a hi a nane nya kɛ ya gbeje!
Ejakaa yayami ngɛ a we ɔmɛ a mi,
kɛ a tsui mi.
16Se imi lɛɛ Yawɛ Mawu ɔ nitsɛ i ngɛ tsɛe,
nɛ e ma he ye yi wami.
17Mɔtu, piani, kɛ nyɔ mi tsuo
i ngɛ kɔmɔ yee, nɛ i ngɛ kɛmɛe;
e maa bu mi tue kɛ̃.
18Ta nɛ i kɛ ye he nyɛli babauu ɔ ngɛ hwue ɔ,
e ma kpɔ mi kɛ je mi,
nɛ ma ye ye he.
19Mawu nɛ ngɛ matsɛ yee kɛ je teteete ɔ
maa nu ye kue fami ɔ;
e maa ye a nɔ kunimi
ejakaa a kua a tsui tsakemi,
nɛ a yi Mawu gbeye.
20Ye he nɔ ya tua e huɛ;
somi nɛ e kɛ mi so ɔ, e yi nɔ.
21E tuɔ munyu dɔkɔbii,
se ta mohu he e ngɛ susue.
E munyuhi a he jɔ bɔdɔɔ pe nu po,
se afani klaatehi nɛ a hia kɛ je kpo mi.
22Ngɔɔ o haomi ɔmɛ kɛ ha Yawɛ,
nɛ e maa bu o he.
Nɔ nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a,
Mawu be blɔ ngmɛe kɔkɔɔkɔ
nɛ he nyɛlɔ nɛ ye e nɔ kunimi.
23Se mo Mawu, o ma sake mɛ kɛ fɔ muɔ voo ɔ mi;
muɔ si pueli, kɛ lakpatsɛmɛ
be a wami be ɔ fa tete po yee ngɛ je mi.
Se imi lɛɛ ma ngɔ ye hɛ kɛ fɔ o nɔ.

Title: LA 56
Content:
Ngɔɔ hɛ kɛ fɔ Mawu nɔ
1 Mawu lee, naa mi mɔbɔ,
ejakaa nimli adesahi ngɛ mi yi mi wae;
ye futsɛmɛ ngɛ mi haoe daa ligbi.
2Daa nɛ ɔ, yi mi sɔuu ye he nyɛli ngɛ mi wae;
ni nɛmɛ nɛ te si kɛ wo mi ɔ, a he hiɛ babauu.
3Ke i ngɛ gbeye yee kikɛ nɛ ɔ,
mo Hiɔwe no ɔ pɛ o nɔ i ngɔɔ ye hɛ kɛ fɔɔ.
4I ngɔ ye hɛ kɛ fɔ Mawu nɔ,
lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i yi gbeye.
I ngɛ Mawu yi jee ngɛ si nɛ e wo mi ɔ he.
Mɛni nɔmlɔ adesa ma nyɛ maa pee mi?
5Daa nɛ ɔ, ye he nyɛli ɔmɛ ngɛ ye munyu hɛ mi tsakee;
yayami pɛ lɛ a hii susue ha mi.
6A buaa a he nya, nɛ a huɔɔ mi, kɛ ye ní peepee,
konɛ a na ye he blɔ nɛ a gbe mi.
7Mawu, ngɔɔ o mi mi la kɛ gbla kikɛmɛ a nimli nɛ ɔmɛ a tue
ngɛ a yi wu tso ní ɔmɛ a he!
8O le bɔ nɛ i ngɛ haoe ha;
ye vo nyu ma hyi o tɔ ɔ.
Tse o kadi lɛ tsuo ngɔ wo o womi ɔ mi?
9Ligbi ɔ nɛ ma fa kue ha mo pɛ
ye he nyɛli ɔmɛ maa kpale a se.
I le kaa Mawu kɛ mi ngɛ.
10Yawɛ Mawu yeɔ e siwo nɔ,
lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e yi i ngɛ jee.
11I ngɔ ye hɛ kɛ fɔ Mawu nɔ,
lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i yi gbeye.
Mɛni nɔmlɔ adesa ma nyɛ maa pee mi?
12Mawu, si nɛ i wo mo ɔ, ma ye nɔ;
ma ngɔ sina bɔ kɛ ba ha mo.
13Ejakaa o he ye yi wami kɛ je gbenɔ mi.
O ha we nɛ ma tɛ nɔ nɛ ma nɔ si,
bɔ nɛ pee nɛ ma nyɛɛ ngɛ o hɛ mi
he nɛ o la kpɛɔ ngɛ kɛ haa
hɛ kali ɔ.

Title: LA 57
Content:
Ba piɛ ye he
1 Mawu, naa mi mɔbɔ oo,
naa mi mɔbɔ!
Ejakaa o ngɔ lɛ i saa we ngɛ.
Ma laa ye he ngɛ o pɛli ɔmɛ a sisi ngɛ hɔ̃ ɔ mi
kɛ yaa si hɛ mi kpatami nɛ nya wa nɛ ɔ
se maa po.
2Mawu nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe lokoo,
Mawu nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ hi ha mi ɔ,
lɛ i ngɛ tsɛe ɔ nɛ.
3E maa tsɔ kɛ je hiɔwe kɛ ba he ye yi wami;
nɛ nihi nɛ ngɛ mi yi mi wae ɔ,
zo maa gbe mɛ.
Mawu, o maa tsɔɔ mi kaa
o mɔbɔ nami ngɛ daa kɛ ha mi,
nɛ o yeɔ anɔkuale daa jã kɛ̃.
4He nyɛli bɔle mi kɛ kpe
kaa jatahi nɛ yeɔ nɔmlɔ lo;
a lunguhi ngɛ kaa akplɔhi, kɛ kɛ̃ɛ̃ mi bihi;
a lilɛhi a nya ba kaa klaate
nɛ a duɔ nya saminya.
5Mawu, ha nɛ o he wami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ nɛ je kpo
ngɛ hiɔwe lokoo ɔ,
konɛ a na o hɛ mi nyami ɔ ngɛ je ɔ mi tsuo.
6Ye he nyɛli ɔmɛ tsɔ mi klama;
nɛ ye ní pee mɔbɔ kulaa.
A tsua muɔ ngɛ ye blɔ ɔ mi,
se mɛ nitsɛmɛ mohu a ya nɔ mi.
7Mawu, i ngɔ ye hɛ kɛ fɔ mo pɛ o nɔ;
ma la kɛ je o yi!
8Makɛ mla a, ma te si,
nɛ ma fia saku, kɛ kpa saku.
9Nyɔmtsɛ, ma na mo si ngɛ je ma amɛ a hɛ mi.
Ma la kɛ je o yi ngɛ je ma amɛ a hɛ mi.
10Ejakaa o suɔmi nɛ ngɛ daa a kle kɛ su hiɔwe lokoo,
nɛ o we anɔkuale yemi ya su bɔku mi tɔɔ.
11Mawu, ha nɛ o he wami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ nɛ je kpo
ngɛ hiɔwe lokoo,
konɛ a na o hɛ mi nyami ɔ ngɛ je ɔ mi tsuo.

Title: LA 58
Content:
Gbla yiwutsotsɛmɛ a tue
1Nyɛ, hɛ mi nyɛɛli,
anɛ nyɛ woɔ mlaahi nɛ da lo?
Anɛ nyɛ kojoɔ nimli adesahi bɔ nɛ sa lo?
2Dɛbi! Yayami nɛ nyɛ maa pee he nyɛ susuɔ,
nɛ yi wu tso níhi nyɛ peeɔ ngɛ zugba a nɔ.
3Yiwutsotsɛmɛ peeɔ yayami a wami be tsuo;
kɛ je a fɔmi be ɔ, lakpa sɔuu a yeɔ.
4Duɔ nɛ hyi a mi ɔ ngɛ kaa sinɔ duɔ.
A tsiɔ a tue kaa sanga tuekpokutsɛ
5nɛ nui kunya yelɔ ɔ gbi,
loo e la ngɔngɔɛ ɔmɛ.
6Yawɛ Mawu, nimli nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ kaa jata awi yeli pɛ;
ku a nya mi lungu ɔmɛ tsuo ngɔ pue he.
7Ha nɛ a laa kaa pa nɛ ngɛ fae;
ha nɛ a naa a nɔ kaa a naa nga gbigbli nɔ.
8Ha nɛ a gbo kaa ahua nɛ ngɛ mɔsɔ wue kɛ bee.
Ha nɛ a gbo kaa bi nɛ e fɔmi be sui nɛ a fɔ lɛ,
nɛ e nɛ pu hɛ mi.
9Loko a hɛ maa ba a he nɔ ɔ,
a poo mɛ ngɔ pue he kaa nga.
Mawu maa ngɔ e mi mi la a
kɛ bɛɛ mɛ kɛ ho
be mi nɛ a ngɛ hɛ ngmengmle.
10Ke a gbla yayami peelɔ tue bɔ nɛ sa lɛ ɔ,
ndalɔ a ma nya,
nɛ e maa nyɛɛ yayami peelɔ ɔ muɔ mi kɛ be.
11Bɔ nɛ nimli adesahi ma de ji,
“Niinɛ, ni nɛmɛ nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a,
a naa hiɔwo kpakpa.
Niinɛ, Mawu ngɛ,
nɛ e kojoɔ je ɔ tsuo.”

Title: LA 59
Content:
Mawu, moo bu ye he
1 Ye Mawu, mo je mi kɛ je ye he nyɛli a dɛ mi,
moo bu ye he,
konɛ nihi nɛ te si wo mi ɔ, a ko nyɛ mi.
2Je mi kɛ je yiwutsotsɛmɛ a dɛ mi;
ko ha nɛ muɔ si pueli a nine nɛ su ye nɔ.
3Yawɛ, hyɛ kaa dikali bua a he nya, konɛ a kpata ye hɛ mi,
pohu i pee we yayami ko.
4A he sɔ, nɛ a dla kɛ wo ye he,
pohu i pee we mɛ yayami ko.
Tee si, ba piɛ ye he.
Hyɛ kaa ye yi fi.
5Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ Mawu,
mo ji Israel Mawu ɔ nɛ!
Tee si nɛ o ba gbla je ma amɛ a tue.
Yiwutsotsɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ yi mi yaya toe ɔ,
koo na mɛ mɔbɔ.
6Daa gbɔkuɛ ɔ, a kpaleɔ kɛ baa
kɛ ngmlaa kaa gbehi
kɛ ba kpaa ma a mi tsuo.
7Mɛ lɛ a ngɛ ngmlaa kpae hoo ngɛ lejɛ ɔ nɛ;
a ngɛ huãe kɛ ngɛ pɛe ke,
“Mɛnɔ maa nu wa he?”
8Se mo Yawɛ, o ngɛ mɛ muɔe;
o ngɛ je ma amɛ tsuo a he fɛu yee.
9Ma la kɛ je o yi,
mo ji ye he wami;
mo Mawu ji ye wesa he.
10Ye Mawu nɛ e suɔmi be nyagbe ɔ
ma ba kpee mi.
Ye Mawu ɔ ma ha nɛ ma na ye he nyɛli ɔmɛ
nɛ a gbe mɛ kɛ pueɔ si.
11Nyɔmtsɛ, wa yi baalɔ,
koo gbe mɛ;
ke o pee ja a, e be kɛe nɛ ye ma a hɛ maa je nɔ,
a hɛ maa je nɔ́ nɛ o pee nɛ ɔ nɔ.
Ngɔɔ o he wami ɔ kɛ ha nɛ a didaa,
nɛ o ngɔ mɛ kɛ fiaa si.
12Munyuhi nɛ jeɔ a nya a, yayami sɔuu,
nɛ a hlaa kaa a wo a he nɔ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ba mɛ si!
Akɛnɛ a gbiɛɛ nɔ, nɛ a yeɔ lakpa he je ɔ,
ha nɛ a he nɔ womi ɔ nɛ pee klama
nɛ du mɛ.
13Ngɔɔ mi mi la kɛ kpata a hɛ mi;
ee, mo kpata a hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ,
konɛ nimli adesahi tsuo nɛ a na nɛ a le kaa
Mawu ngɛ matsɛ yee ngɛ Israel,
nɛ e matsɛ yemi ɔ ngɛ kɛ yaa su
je mi nyagbe he tɔɔ.
14Daa gbɔkuɛ ɔ, ye he nyɛli ɔmɛ kpaleɔ kɛ baa
kɛ ngmlaa kaa gbehi,
nɛ a ba kpaa ma a mi tsuo.
15A kpaa si kɛ hlaa niye ní;
nɛ ke a na we ní nɛ a ye nɛ a tɔ ɔ,
a kpaa ngmlaa kaa gbehi.
16Se imi lɛɛ ma la kɛ je o yi,
ejakaa o he wa.
Daa mɔtu ɔ, ma la wawɛɛ kɛ je o yi,
ejakaa o suɔmi ɔ ngɛ daa.
Be nɛ i ngɛ amanehlu mi ɔ,
mo lɛ o bu ye he,
nɛ o baa ye yi.
17Mawu, mo o nɔ ma ngɔ ye hɛ kɛ fɔ,
ejakaa mo Mawu ji ye wesa he.
Ma la kɛ je o yi,
ejakaa mo, Mawu lɛ o naa mi mɔbɔ daa.

Title: LA 60
Content:
Mo he ye yi wami
1 Mawu lee, o sake wɔ kɛ pue he.
O mi mi fu wɔ,
nɛ o gbɛ wɔ ngɔ fĩa.
Se kpale wɔ kɛ ba wa glɛ nɔ ekohu koo!
2O ha zugba a mimiɛ,
nɛ e mi gba hatoo;
moo tsi e hehi nɛ wo muɔ ɔ,
ejakaa e ngɛ gbɛe kulaa.
3O ha o ma a na amanehlu nɛ nya wa;
wa ngɛ didaae kaa nihi nɛ de dã.
4O si aflangaa ko ha ni nɛmɛ nɛ yee mo gbeye ɔ,
konɛ a bua a he nya kɛ ba o ngɔ
nɛ a hɛ mi ko kpata.
5Ngɔɔ o he wami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ kɛ he wa yi wami.
Bu wa kue fami ɔ tue,
konɛ ma nɛ mo nitsɛ o suɔ ɔ yi nɛ na wami.
6Mawu de ngɛ e he klɔuklɔu ɔ ke,
“Ma hwɔ lele kɛ gba Shekem mi;
nɛ ma dla Sukot kɔ̃ ɔ mi kɛ ha ye ma a.
7Ye mahi ji Gilead, kɛ Manase.
Efraim ji ye dade pɛɛ,
nɛ Yuda ji ye matsɛ tso.
8Moab ji ye hedu buɛ.
Ma sake ye tokota kɛ pue Edom nɔ
kɛ tsɔɔ kaa a ye e nɔ.
Ma he ose kɛ ye Filistia nɔ kunimi.”
9Mɛnɔ maa ngɔ mi kɛ ya
ma nɛ a fia gbogbo kɛ wo he ɔ mi?
Mɛnɔ ma ya sɛ mi Edom?
10Mawu, anɛ pi mo nɛ o kua wɔ ɔ lo?
Mawu, o kɛ wa tabo ɔ tsa yɛ ta!
11Piɛ wa he, konɛ waa kɛ he nyɛlɔ ɔ nɛ kpe.
Ejakaa nɔmlɔ adesa he wami pí nɔ́ ko!
12Nɛ́ Mawu kɛ wɔ ngɛ nɛ ɔ,
wa maa ye kunimi.
Lɛ ji nɔ nɛ maa ye wa he nyɛli ɔmɛ a nɔ ha wɔ.

Title: LA 61
Content:
Kue fami kɛ ha he bumi
1Mawu, bu ye ngmlaa a tue;
moo nu ye kue fami ɔ.
2Ye mumi nya ngɛ tae.
I ngɛ mo tsɛe kɛ je tsitsaa lokoo
ngɛ je ɔ nyagbe he ɔ tɔɔ.
Ngɔɔ mi kɛ ba mo, Mawu ɔ o ngɔ,
konɛ ma na he jɔmi.
3Ejakaa mo ji ye wesa he,
ye mɔ nɛ he wa,
he nɛ he nyɛlɔ ɔ nine be ye nɔ sue ngɛ.
4Ha ma hi o we klɔuklɔu ɔ daa.
Ma na he jɔmi ngɛ lejɛ ɔ
kaa bɔ nɛ lohwe pɛlitsɛ kɛ e pɛli
haa e bimɛ a nɔ ɔ.
5Mawu, si nɛ i wo mo ɔ, nu,
nɛ nihi nɛ yee mo gbeye ɔ
a weto ní ɔ,
o ngɔ kɛ ha mi.
6Ha nɛ matsɛ ɔ wami se nɛ kɛ,
nɛ e hi je mi kɛ yaa si yi nɔhi babauu.
7Ha nɛ e ye tsɛ ngɛ mo Mawu ɔ o hɛ mi daa.
Ngɔɔ o suɔmi nɛ be nyagbe ɔ, kɛ o we anɔkuale ɔ
kɛ bu e he daa.
8Kɛkɛ ɔ, imi hu ma la kɛ je o biɛ ɔ yi daa,
nɛ ma ye ye siwo ɔmɛ a nɔ daa ligbi.

Title: LA 62
Content:
Hɛ kɛ Mawu nɔ fɔmi
1Mawu pɛ nɔ i ngɔ ye hɛ kɛ fɔ;
lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i pee dii kɛ ngɛ lɛ blɔ hyɛe,
konɛ e ba he ye yi wami.
2Lɛ pɛ ji ye wesa he,
ye yi wami helɔ, kɛ ye he bulɔ,
nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be mi nyɛe.
3Kɛ yaa su mɛni be nyɛ tsuo nyɛ ma bla
kɛ hao nɔ kake too kikɛ nɛ ɔ,
nɔ nɛ ngɛ kaa gbogbo nɛ ku,
nɛ miɔ nɛ e maa nɔ si ɔ?
4E yi nɔ sɔuu a ngɛ soe,
konɛ a gbla lɛ kɛ je e blɔ he nguaa a
kɛ ba nɔ si.
Munyu kpakpa jeɔ a nya,
se a tsui mi hyi kɛ yayami sɔuu.
5Mawu pɛ nɔ i ngɔ ye hɛ kɛ fɔ;
lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i pee dii kɛ ngɛ lɛ blɔ hyɛe,
konɛ e ba he ye yi wami.
6Lɛ pɛ ji ye wesa he,
ye yi wami helɔ, kɛ ye he bulɔ,
nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be mi nyɛe.
7Mawu pɛ ji nɔ nɛ he ye yi wami.
Lɛ pɛ lɛ e maa wo ye hɛ mi nyami.
Mawu ji ye he wami kpetekpleenyɛ.
Lɛ ji ye wesa he.
8Be tsuaa be ɔ, nyɛɛ ngɔ nyɛ hɛ kɛ fɔ Mawu nɔ
kɛ nyɛ tsui tsuo.
Mawu ji wɔ tsuo wa wesa he.
9Nimli adesahi tsuo ngɛ kaa mumi nɛ a woɔ;
nimli nguahi jio, nimli wawi jio,
mɛ tsuo a pi nɔ́ ko kulaa.
Ke a ngmɛ mɛ ngɛ sɛni mi ɔ, a ngɛ wojowojo kulaa,
nɛ a jiimi sui mumi nɛ a woɔ.
10Nyɛ ko ngɔ nyɛ hɛ kɛ fɔ amimi yemi nɔ;
nyɛ ko hyɛ blɔ kaa nyɛ ma na nɔ́ kpakpa ko
kɛ je ojo fiami mi.
Ke nyɛ ba na ní babauu po,
nyɛ ko ngɔ nyɛ hɛ kɛ fɔ nɔ.
11Pi si kake pɛ nɛ Mawu tu munyu nɛ ɔ;
e de si abɔ ke, he wami ɔ, lɛ Mawu ɔ
e ngɔ e jee.
12 E de hu ke lɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ,
e suɔmi ɔ ngɛ daa.
Ee, mo Nyɔmtsɛ nitsɛ lɛ o woɔ nɔ tsuaa nɔ hiɔ
bɔ nɛ sa e ní tsumi.

Title: LA 63
Content:
Mawu se blɔ hlami
1 Mawu lee, niinɛ, mo ji ye Mawu;
i ngɛ mo hlae kɛ ye tsui tsuo nɛ ma na;
o he kuma ngɛ mi yee
kaa zugba nɛ gbli kadokado
nɛ ngɛ nyu hlae!
2Lɔ ɔ he i ngɛ mo blɔ hyɛe ngɛ he klɔuklɔu ɔ,
kaa ma na o he wami ɔ,
kɛ o hɛ mi nyami ɔ!
3O suɔmi nɛ se pui gblegbleegble ɔ
hi pe wami nitsɛnitsɛ;
lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ma je o yi.
4Ma na mo si ye wami be ɔ tsuo;
ma wo ye nine nɔ, nɛ ma fa kue ha mo.
5Ma ná bua jɔmi kaa nɔ nɛ ye niye ní kpakpa,
kɛkɛ ɔ, ma la kɛ bua jɔmi kɛ je o yi.
6Ke i kai mo ngɛ ye sa nɔ kikɛ nɛ ɔ,
o he sɔuu i susuɔ nyɔ ɔ mi tsuo.
7Be tsuaa be ɔ, mo nɔuu lɛ o piɛɔ ye he;
lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ma la kɛ bua jɔmi
ngɛ hɔ̃ mi ngɛ o pɛli ɔmɛ a sisi.
8I mɛtɛ o he kpɛii,
ejakaa o kɛ kɔni si wami hɛɛ mi.
9Ni nɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ hlae nɛ a kpata ye hɛ mi ɔ
ma ya su tsitsaa gbeje tɔɔ.
10A maa nɔ ngɛ ta mi,
nɛ nga mi gbehi maa ye a gbogboe.
11Se matsɛ ɔ ma nya saminya;
ejakaa Mawu haa e yeɔ kunimi.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ kɛ Mawu biɛ kaa kita a
ma je Mawu yi boboobo,
se lakpatsɛmɛ lɛɛ a ma ma a nya.

Title: LA 64
Content:
Kue fami kɛ ha he bumi
1Mawu lee, moo bu mi tue;
hyɛ kaa i sɛ haomi mi!
Ba he ye yi wami;
ba kpɔ mi kɛ je ye he nyɛli a dɛ mi.
2Yiwutsotsɛmɛ ngɛ ye yi nɔ soe.
Kpɔ mi kɛ je yayami peeli babauu ɔ a dɛ mi.
3A duɔ a lilɛhi a nya kaa klaate;
a munyu yaya amɛ ngɛ kaa kɛ̃ɛ̃ mi bihi
4nɛ a kɛ tsɛ̃ɔ nɔ ko nɛ pee we yayami ko
ngɛ diblii mi.
A tsɛ̃ɔ lɛ tlukaa, nɛ a yi gbeye.
5A peeɔ yi wu tso ní nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ laami mi;
a tsɔɔ klamahi babauu;
a woɔ a sibi he wami, nɛ a deɔ ke,
“Mɛnɔ maa na wɔ?”
6A toɔ ga, konɛ a kɛ pee nɔ yayami,
nɛ a deɔ ke,
“Mɛnɔ ma nyɛ ma kpa wa ga nɛ ɔ si?
Wa gbe nya! Wa to ga nɛ nɔ be!”
Nɔmlɔ adesa yi mi, kɛ e tsui mi kuɔ!
7Se Mawu ma tsɛ̃ mɛ e kɛ̃ɛ̃ ɔmɛ,
nɛ e maa plaa mɛ tlukaa.
8E ma kpata a hɛ mi tlukaa
ngɛ munyuhi nɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a tu ɔ he.
Nihi tsuo nɛ maa na mɛ ɔ ma mimiɛ a yi.
9Nɔ tsuaa nɔ maa ye gbeye.
A maa sɛɛ nyakpɛ níhi nɛ Mawu tsu,
nɛ a ma susu a he saminya.
10Nihi tsuo nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a, a nya,
nɛ a ngɔ a he kɛ ha Yawɛ.
Nihi tsuo nɛ a tsui mi tsɔ ɔ,
a wo e hɛ mi nyami.

Title: LA 65
Content:
Yi jemi kɛ sina
1Mawu, e sa kaa a je o yi ngɛ Zion,
nɛ sihi nɛ a wo mo ɔ, a ye nɔ.
2Ee, mo pɛ lɛ o buɔ kue fami tue.
O ngɔ adesahi tsuo maa ba,
3nɛ a ba bu akɔtaa ngɛ a yayami ɔmɛ a he.
Ke wa he yayami ɔmɛ ngɛ wɔ haoe ɔ,
mo lɛ o kɛ paa wɔ.
4A gbaa nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ mo nitsɛ o hla lɛ,
nɛ o ngɔ lɛ kɛ ba o we ɔ.
Wa ma na ní kpakpahi nɛ ngɛ o we klɔuklɔu ɔ
a he bua jɔmi.
O bu wa kue fami ɔ tue.
5O pee ní gbeyegbeyehi kɛ he wa yi wami.
Niinɛ, Mawu, mo ji wa yi wami helɔ.
Nihi tsuo nɛ ngɛ je ɔ mi he tsuaa he,
zugba a nyagbe he ɔmɛ,
kɛ wo se tsitsaa lokoo ɔ tsuo,
mo o nɔ a ngɔ a hɛ kɛ fɔ.
6Mo nɔuu nɛ o ngɔ yo gojogojoo ɔmɛ ngɔ ma si kpɛii
ngɛ o he wami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ nya.
7Ke wo gli, nɛ oslɔke ɔmɛ pee hamahama a,
mo lɛ o jɔɔ a he lɛ a peeɔ dii kulaa.
Nimli adesahi nɛ ngɛ basabasa hu
mo nɔuu lɛ o jɔɔ a he.
8Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, nyakpɛ níhi nɛ o pee ɔ,
ha je ɔ tsuo ngɛ gbeye yee.
A hwɔɔ lele kɛ jeɔ zugba a nyagbe he kake
kɛ ya siɔ nyagbe he kake.
9O slaa zugba a,
o haa lɛ nyu,
nɛ e baa ní babauu.
Ke o ha pa a hyi kikɛ nɛ ɔ,
ngmɔ ɔmɛ baa ní saminya.
Bɔ nɛ o peeɔ lɛ ha ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
10O haa hiɔmi nɛɛ babauu
kɛ pueɔ ngmɔ ɔmɛ nɛ a hu ɔ mi.
Ngmɔ ɔmɛ tsuo a mi hyiɔ kɛ nyu ɔ.
Zu ɔ mi jɔɔ ha ní ɔmɛ nɛ a du ɔ,
nɛ o haa ní ɔmɛ baa saminya.
11O ha ní kpakpahi babauu baa ngɛ jeha a mi.
He tsuaa he nɛ o be ngɛ ɔ
kɛkɛ ní ba babauu.
12Lohwehi babauu ngɛ lohwe lɛmi he ɔmɛ ngɛ nga a nɔ.
13Nga a nɔ pee fɛu kɛ tohi babauu,
nɛ dɔ ɔmɛ a mi hyi kpɛkpɛɛkpɛ kɛ blɛfo;
nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ ngɛ lele hwɔe,
nɛ a ngɛ lae kɛ bua jɔmi.

Title: LA 66
Content:
Yi jemi kɛ sina la
1Nyɛ je ɔ tsuo, nyɛ hwɔ lele
kɛ je Mawu yi!
2Nyɛ la kɛ je e yi.
Nyɛɛ wo e hɛ mi nyami saminya!
3Nyɛ de Mawu ke,
“Bɔ nɛ o peeɔ níhi ɔ ngɛ gbeye loo!
O he wami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ nya a,
o he nyɛli ɔmɛ ba a he si ha mo.
4Nihi tsuo nɛ ngɛ je ɔ mi jaa mo,
a laa kɛ jeɔ o yi,
a jeɔ o biɛ ɔ yi!”
5Nyɛɛ ba, nyɛ ba hyɛ níhi nɛ Mawu pee,
nyakpɛ níhi nɛ e tsu kɛ ha nimli adesahi.
6 E ha wo ɔ plɛ pee zugba gbigbli;
nɛ nimli adesahi kɛ a nane po wo ɔ.
Wa nyá ngɛ lejɛ ɔ
ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ o pee ha wɔ ɔ he.
7E ngɛ tsɛ yee kɛ he wami kɛ yaa neneene.
E hɛngmɛ ngɛ je ma amɛ a he;
atuã tsɔli kó wo a he nɔ.
8Nyɛ je ma amɛ tsuo, nyɛ je wa Mawu ɔ yi!
Nyɛ je e yi wawɛɛ nɛ a nu;
9lɛ ji nɔ nɛ haa wa yi naa wami,
nɛ e ha we nɛ waa sane nɔ si.
10Mo Mawu, o ka wɔ hyɛ ha,
o tsu wa he kaa bɔ nɛ a tsuɔ sika hiɔ he ɔ.
11O ngɔ wɔ ya wo klama mi, nɛ wa du.
O ngɔ tlomi nɛ jiɔ ngɔ tloo wɔ.
12O ha wa he nyɛli ye wa nɔ;
wa gu la mi,
nɛ wa gu nyu mi hulɔ,
se o je wɔ slɔkee
kɛ ba he nɛ kplɔkɔtɔ ngɛ.
13Ma ngɔ sami bɔ kɛ ba o we ɔ,
ma ye ye siwo ɔmɛ a nɔ ha mo.
14Níhi nɛ je ye nya nɛ i de be nɛ e fi mi ɔ,
ma pee.
15Ma ngɔ lohwe nɛ tu zɔ kɛ ba sã sami bɔ ha mo;
ma sã agbosuhi ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ.
Na kuhi, kɛ apletsihi ma kɛ sã bɔ,
konɛ a je la su ku kɛ ya hiɔwe.
16Nyɛ nihi tsuo nɛ yee Mawu gbeye,
nyɛɛ ba nɛ nyɛ ba bu tue,
nɛ ma gba nyɛ nɔ́ nɛ e pee ha mi.
17I kpa ngmlaa kɛ tsɛ lɛ;
kɛkɛ nɛ i la kɛ je e yi.
18Kaa pe i suɔ yayami,
nɛ i ngɔ kɛ laa ngɛ ye tsui mi ɔ,
Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ko bui mi tue.
19Se niinɛ, Mawu bu mi tue,
e ta tue ha mi,
nɛ e he ye kue fami ɔ nɔ.
20Ma je Mawu yi,
ejakaa e sakee we ye kue fami ɔ
kɛ fɔɛ e tue se;
nɛ e ha we nɛ mɔbɔ nɛ e naa mi daa a
se nɛ po.

Title: LA 67
Content:
Sina la
1Mawu, naa wɔ mɔbɔ, nɛ o gbaa wɔ,
nɛ o na wa he bua jɔmi,
2konɛ je ɔ nɛ le o suɔmi nya ní,
nɛ je ma amɛ tsuo nɛ a yo o he wami
nɛ o kɛ heɔ yi wami ɔ.
3Mawu, ha nɛ je ma amɛ nɛ a je o yi;
ha nɛ je ma amɛ tsuo nɛ a je o yi!
4Ha nɛ je ma amɛ a bua nɛ jɔ
nɛ a la kɛ bua jɔmi,
ejakaa o kojoɔ je ma amɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ
nɛ nɔ hɛ mi hyɛmi be mi.
Mo lɛ o tsɔɔ ma amɛ tsuo blɔ ngɛ je ɔ mi.
5Mawu, ha nɛ je ma amɛ nɛ a je o yi;
ha nɛ je ma amɛ tsuo nɛ a je o yi!
6Zugba a ba ní saminya.
Mawu gbaa wɔ, wa Mawu ɔ gbaa wɔ.
7Mawu gbaa wɔ;
je ɔ tsuo nɛ a ye lɛ gbeye!

Title: LA 68
Content:
Ma kunimi yemi la
1Mawu nɛ te si koo!
Á gbɛ e he nyɛli ɔmɛ ngɔ fĩa koo!
Nihi nɛ sume lɛ ɔ, ha nɛ a tu fo ngɛ e nya.
2Fie mɛ kɛ ya se lokoo
kaa bɔ nɛ kɔɔhiɔ ngɔɔ la su ku kɛ yaa a.
Yiwutsotsɛmɛ a hɛ mi nɛ kpata ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi
kaa bɔ nɛ hwo gbaku sileɔ ngɛ la he ɔ.
3Se nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ nɛ da a,
mɛɛ lɛɛ a nya, nɛ a la
kɛ bua jɔmi ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi.
4Nyɛ la ha Mawu;
nyɛ la kɛ je e biɛ ɔ yi.
Nɔ nɛ hii si ngɛ bɔku ɔmɛ a nɔ kɛ ngɛ nyɛɛe ɔ,
nyɛ la kɛ je e yi.
Yawɛ ji e biɛ;
nyɛ la kɛ bua jɔmi ngɛ e hɛ mi.
5Awusahi a tsɛ, kɛ yalɔyihi a he bulɔ ɔ,
lɛ ji Mawu nɛ ngɛ e he klɔuklɔu ɔ nɛ.
6Nihi nɛ nɔ ko be mɛ ɔ,
Mawu haa mɛ we nɛ a hii mi.
E jeɔ pamitsɛmɛ kɛ jeɔ tsu mi,
nɛ e haa a bɔɔ.
Se atuã tsɔli lɛɛ
e haa a hii zugba gbogboe
nɛ bɛ ní nɔ.
7Mawu, be nɛ o nyɛɛ o ma a hɛ mi,
be nɛ o kɛ mɛ gu nga kplanaa a nɔ ɔ,
8 mo Yawɛ Israel Mawu ɔ,
o ha zugba mimiɛ, nɛ hiɔmi nɛ
ngɛ mo Mawu ɔ o hɛ mi.
Sinai yo ɔ tete mimiɛ ngɛ mo Mawu,
Israel Mawu ɔ, o hɛ mi.
9Mawu, o ha hiɔmi nɛ babaaba
kɛ ha zugba a tsuo nɔ;
kɛkɛ nɛ zugba nɛ gbo ɔ
ba ní saminya ekohu.
10O ha o ni ɔmɛ po ma ngɛ zugba a nɔ.
Mawu, mɔbɔ nalɔ,
o haa nɔ́ nali a hiami níhi.
11Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ wo gbi,
nɛ nihi babauu ngɔ sɛ gbi ɔ kɛ ho ke,
12“Matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ a tabo ɔmɛ tu fo oo!
A tu fo kɛ je ta a nya oo!”
Yihi nɛ a si ngɛ se ɔ dla ta yibu ní ɔ ha a he.
13Mɛɛ lɛɛ to tsu ɔmɛ a kasa nya kɛkɛ a ngɛ,
se a he pee fɛu kaa lahuɛhi
nɛ sika hiɔ ha a he,
kaa lahuɛ tsɛlihi kɛ a he sika tsu ngmingmiingmi.
14Benɛ Mawu Ope ɔ gbɛ matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ngɔ fĩa a,
e pee kaa nɔ́ nɛ snoo ngɛ nɛe ngɛ Zalmon yo ɔ nɔ.
15Mo Bashan yo, yo kpetekpleenyɛ,
mo Bashan yo, yo gojogojoohi nɛ tsa!
16Yo nɛ Mawu hla ha e he ɔ,
mɛni he je nyɛ yo gojogojoohi nyɛ hɛ ngɛ e nɔ kɔ̃e?
Ee, lejɛ ɔ Yawɛ maa hi kɛ maa ya neneene!
17Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ kple si kɛ je Sinai yo ɔ nɔ
kɛ ba e he klɔuklɔu ɔ.
E kɛ e ta zugba lɛ babauu nitsɛ lɛ ba.
18 O kuɔ yo gagaa a,
nɛ o kpaka nihi nɛ a nuu mɛ ta nyɔguɛ
kɛ nyɛɛ o se yuu.
O he nike ní kɛ je nimli adesahi tsuo a dɛ;
o he ngɛ atuã tsɔli tete po a dɛ,
konɛ mo Yawɛ ɔ o hi a kpɛti ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.
19Nyɛ je Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ yi.
Daa nɛ ɔ, e yeɔ wa sane haa wɔ.
Lɛ Mawu ɔ nɔuu ji nɔ nɛ heɔ wa yi wami.
20Wa Mawu ɔ, Mawu nɛ heɔ nɔ yi wami ji lɛ;
Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ɔ,
lɛ nɛ e jeɔ nɔ kɛ jeɔ gbenɔ mi.
21Mawu maa ywia e he nyɛli ɔmɛ a yi;
níhi nɛ ji yayami peeli a
hɛ mi nyami ɔ,
Mawu ma kpata lɔ ɔmɛ tsuo a hɛ mi.
22Bɔ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ngɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ:
“Ma kpaka mɛ kɛ je Bashan kɛ ba ekohu;
ma je mɛ kɛ je wo ɔ sisi tɔɔ kɛ ba,
23konɛ o nane nɛ naa muɔ mi kɛ be,
nɛ o gbe ɔmɛ hu a lilɛ nɛ na
o he nyɛli ɔmɛ a he nɔ́ ko nɛ a lɔ.”
24Mawu, ni ɔmɛ tsuo na bɔ nɛ o je kpo kɛ agbo jemi.
Ye Mawu, kɛ ye matsɛ, a na bɔ nɛ a to
kɛ nyɛɛ o se yuu kɛ ba o we klɔuklɔu ɔ.
25Lali nyɛɛ hɛ mi,
yihewi fao fiali nyɛɛ a se,
nɛ saku fiali gbe nya.
A ngɛ dee ke,
26“Nyɛ ma kpekpemi ɔ, nyɛ je Mawu yi!
Nyɛ Yakob nina tsuo, nyɛ je Yawɛ yi!”
27Benyamin, wɛtso ɔmɛ a kpɛti wayoo pe kulaa a,
lɛ nɛ nyɛɛ hɛ mi ha mɛ.
Yuda ganɔ ɔmɛ, kɛ e we asafoatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ nyɛɛ se;
Zebulun ganɔ ɔmɛ tsa nɔ,
nɛ Naftali ganɔ ɔmɛ gbe nya.
28Mawu, je o he wami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ kpo;
he wami nɛ o kɛ tsu ní ha wɔ sa a,
Mawu, ha nɛ a na.
29Yawɛ, o we ɔ nɛ ngɛ Yerusalem he je ɔ,
matsɛmɛ ngɔɔ nike ní kɛ ba haa mo.
30Egipt, lohwe dikalɔ nɛ hii gla mi ɔ,
ka e hɛ mi;
je ma amɛ, na kuhi, kɛ a na bihi tsuo,
ka a hɛ mi hluu
kɛ yaa si mɛ tsuo a ma ba kpla si,
nɛ a maa ngɔ a sika kɛ ba ha mo.
Mahi nɛ ta pɛ a suɔ ɔ,
gbɛɛ mɛ ngɔ fĩa.
31Ha nɛ a ngɔ akɔblee kɛ je Egipt kɛ ba,
nɛ Sudan bi a he nɛ sɔ kɛ wo a nine nɔ
kɛ ha mo Mawu.
32Nyɛ je nɛ ɔ mi matsɛ yemihi tsuo,
nyɛ la kɛ ha Mawu.
Nyɛ la kɛ je Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ yi;
33nɔ nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe lokoo
kɛ je blema teteete ɔ, nyɛ je e yi.
Nyɛɛ bu e gbi nguaa nɛ ngɛ pɛe hoo ɔ tue.
34Nyɛɛ fiɛ Mawu he wami ɔ;
e ngɛ he wami ngɛ Israel nɔ;
e ngɛ hiɔwe nɔ he wami hulɔ.
35Mawu, Israel Mawu ɔ he ngɛ gbeye
ngɛ e hi he klɔuklɔu ɔ.
E haa e ma a he wami, kɛ nyɛmi.
A je Mawu yi.

Title: LA 69
Content:
A fa kue kɛ tsɛ balɔ
1Mawu, mo he ye yi wami!
Nyu ɔ ba su ye kuɛ mi;
2i ngɛ pue ngɛ mɔsɔ nɛ mi kuɔ mi,
nɛ si dami he ko kulaa be ha mi.
I ya su nyu nɛ mi kuɔ mi,
nɛ nyu ɔ miɔ nɛ e laa ye yi.
3I kpa ngmlaa kɛ tsɛ balɔ hluu
nɛ pɔ tɔ mi, nɛ ye kuɔ si kpɔ;
i hyɛ blɔ hluu kɛ ya si ye hɛngmɛ se gbo.
4 Nihi nɛ ye he ngɛ mɛ tsɛ̃e yaka gu ɔ,
a he hiɛ babauu pe ye yi bwɔmi.
Ye he nyɛli lakpatsɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ
ye hɛ mi hlae nɛ a kpata a,
yiwutsotsɛmɛ kpanakuhi ji mɛ.
Anɛ níhi nɛ pi ojo nɛ i ye kɛ na a,
lɔ ɔmɛ hu ma ngɔ kɛ ha lo?
5Mawu, o le kaa i je kuasia,
nɛ ye tɔmi ɔmɛ ngɛ o hɛ mi paa.
6Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ,
nihi nɛ ngɔɔ a hɛ kɛ fɔɔ o nɔ ɔ,
ko ha nɛ a pee nɔ́ ko nɛ ba ha nɛ zo nɛ gbe mɛ.
Israel Mawu, ni nɛmɛ nɛ jaa mo ɔ,
ko ha nɛ ye ní peemi ba ha nɛ a hɛ mi nɛ pue si.
7Ejakaa o he ɔ, a ngɛ mi ahlua bɔe,
nɛ zo gbe mi kpɔtɔɔ.
8I plɛ pee nubwɔ ha ye nyɛmimɛ;
i plɛ pee nɔ kpa ngɛ ye weku li a kpɛti.
9 Ejakaa ye hɛ dɔ wawɛɛ ngɛ o we ɔ he;
nɛ ahlua nɛ ni ɔmɛ ngɛ mo bɔe ɔ
ba pue ye nɔ.
10Ke i ngɛ kɔmɔ yee nɛ i ngɛ hwɔ hae ɔ,
ahlua mohu nɛ nihi bɔɔ mi.
11Ke i ha kpekpe ya bo ɔ,
kɛkɛ i plɛ pee blakpa fiami nɔ́ ha mɛ.
12Nihi nɛ hii si ngɛ agbo nya a,
ye he munyu sɔuu a hii tue,
nɛ dã deli ɔmɛ hu imi la a hii woe.
13Yawɛ Mawu, imi lɛɛ pɛɛ i ngɛ mo kpae;
be nɛ sa o hɛ mi ɔ,
he mi nɔ ngɛ o suɔmi babauu
nɛ be nyagbe ɔ he.
14Moo lɛɛ o yeɔ anɔkuale daa;
jé mi kɛ je mɔsɔ ɔ mi,
konɛ ma ko pu ngɛ mi.
Kpɔ mi kɛ je ye he nyɛli ɔmɛ a dɛ mi;
nɛ o je mi kɛ je nyu nɛ mi kuɔ ɔ mi.
15Ko ha nɛ nyu kpekpemi ɔ nɛ sa mi kɛ ho,
loo ma tlɔ nyu ɔ sisi,
loo ma ya sɛ muɔ voo ɔ mi,
nɛ e ba ma e nya
nɛ e mi mi.
16Yawɛ, he mi nɔ koo;
ejakaa o suɔmi nɛ ngɛ daa a hi saminya;
o mɔbɔ nami nɛ hiɛ babauu ɔ he ɔ,
mo plɛ nɛ o hyɛ mi.
17Koo ngɔ o hɛ mi kɛ laa imi, o tsɔlɔ ɔ;
ejakaa i ngɛ haomi mi;
pee esɔ nɛ o ba je mi.
18Hɛɛ mo kɛ su ye he, konɛ o ba kpɔ mi.
Ba kpɔ mi kɛ je ye he nyɛli ɔmɛ a dɛ mi.
19O le bɔ nɛ a bɔ mi ahlua,
bɔ nɛ a gbe mi zo,
kɛ bɔ nɛ a ha ye hɛ mi pue si.
O le ye he nyɛli ɔmɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ.
20Ahlua nɛ a bɔ mi ɔ ha i ye ye tsui kɛ be nɔ,
nɛ ye kɔni mi jɔ.
I nɛ́ nɔ ko nɔ ko nɛ maa na mi mɔbɔ,
loo nɛ e maa jɔɔ ye bua;
i hyɛ blɔ yaka gu.
21 A ha mi duɔ ngɛ niye ní nane mi;
nɛ benɛ kuma ngɛ mi yee ɔ,
a ha mi dã nɛ kuã ke ma nu.
22 Ke a tsɛ ní yemi, loo a sã bɔ ngɛ nyami ligbi nɔ ɔ,
ha nɛ e plɛ pee klama
nɛ ma kpata a hɛ mi.
23Ha nɛ a hɛngmɛ nɛ yu, konɛ a ko hyɛ nɔ́ hu!
Ha nɛ a se tso nɛ kpɛ.
24O mi mi nɛ fu mɛ wawɛɛ;
o mi mi la nɛ nya wa nɛ ɔ
nɛ ba a nɔ tlukaa.
25 Ha nɛ a hi he nɛ pee ma doku;
nɔ ko nɔ ko kó hi a bo tsu ɔmɛ a mi hu.
26Ejakaa nihi nɛ o gbla a tue ɔ,
a waa mɛ yi mi;
nihi nɛ o plaa mɛ ɔ,
a pa amɛ a he ní a sɛɛɔ.
27Gbla a tue sisiisi ngɛ a tɔmi ɔmɛ a he;
koo ngɔ ekoeko kɛ pa mɛ kɔkɔɔkɔ.
28 Ha nɛ a gbe a biɛ ngɛ
nihi nɛ ngɛ je mi kɛ mwɔɔ ɔ a womi ɔ mi,
nɛ a ko ngma a biɛ
kɛ piɛ nihi nɛ peeɔ
nɔ́ nɛ da a he.
29Se imi lɛɛ ye ní ngɛ mɔbɔ;
i ngɛ nɔ́ nae.
Mawu, wo ye nɔ,
nɛ o he ye yi wami!
30Ma la kɛ je Mawu yi,
ma na lɛ si,
nɛ ma tsɔɔ kaa lɛ ji ngua.
31Lɔ ɔ maa sa Yawɛ hɛ mi
pe na niheyo, loo na ku a tsɛ
nɛ a kɛ maa sã bɔ ha lɛ.
32Ke nɔ́ nali na a, a bua maa jɔ.
Nyɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ Mawu se blɔ hlae ɔ,
nyɛ nɔ gbagba nɛ te.
33Ejakaa Yawɛ buɔ dɛgutsɛmɛ tue,
nɛ lɛ nitsɛ e nihi nɛ a wo mɛ tsu ɔ,
e hɛ ji a nɔ.
34Hiɔwe kɛ zugba, nyɛ je Mawu yi.
Wo kɛ e mi nibɔ níhi tsuo,
nyɛ je Mawu yi!
35Ejakaa Mawu ma he Yerusalem yi wami,
e maa pee Yuda ma amɛ ehe ekohu.
E tsɔli ɔmɛ maa hi lejɛ ɔ,
nɛ zugba a maa pee a nɔ́.
36E tsɔli ɔmɛ a nina maa ngɔ zugba a kɛ pee a gbosi ní,
nɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ suɔ lɛ ɔ maa hi lejɛ ɔ.

Title: LA 70
Content:
Kue fami kɛ ha yemi kɛ buami
(La 40.13-17)
1Mawu, mo he ye yi wami koo!
Yawɛ, ba piɛ ye he esɔ!
2Nihi nɛ hlaa kaa a maa gbe mi ɔ,
ha nɛ zo nɛ gbe mɛ
nɛ a hɛ mi nɛ pee mɛ yaa.
Ni nɛmɛ nɛ nyaa be mi nɛ i ngɛ nɔ́ nae ɔ,
ha nɛ a kpale a se kɛ zo.
3Nihi hu nɛ yeɔ ye he fɛu nɛ a deɔ ke, “Yiɛ Yiɛ!” ɔ,
ha nɛ zo nɛ gbe mɛ,
nɛ a hɛ mi nɛ pee mɛ yaa.
4Se nihi tsuo nɛ hlaa o se blɔ ɔ,
ha nɛ a nya, nɛ a na bua jɔmi.
Ni nɛmɛ nɛ suɔ kaa o he a yi wami ɔ,
ha nɛ a de daa ke, “Mawu kle!”
5Ye yi fi nɛ ye ní ngɛ mɔbɔ.
Mawu, moo ba ye ngɔ esɔ!
Yawɛ, mo ji ye he piɛlɔ;
mo ji ye kpɔlɔ. Koo to tsle!

Title: LA 71
Content:
Nɔmo ko kue fami
1Yawɛ, o ngɔ nɛ i ba sa we ngɛ nɛ ɔ nɛ;
ko ha nɛ ye hɛ mi nɛ pue si kɔkɔɔkɔ.
2Akɛnɛ dalɔ ji mo he je ɔ,
je mi kɛ je haomi mi;
kpɔ mi kɛ je he nyɛli a dɛ mi.
I kpa mo pɛɛ, bu mi tue,
nɛ o he ye yi wami.
3Ye wesa he, kɛ ye he falɔ,
moo bu ye he daa
kaa tɛ sa, kɛ mɔ nɛ he wa.
4Ye Mawu, mo kpɔ mi
kɛ je yiwutsotsɛmɛ a dɛ mi;
mo he mi kɛ je yayami peeli, kɛ yi mi wali a dɛ mi.
5Nyɔmtsɛ, i ngɔ ye hɛ kɛ fɔ o nɔ.
Yawɛ, kɛ je ye nihe mi tɔɔ ɔ,
mo, o nɔ i ngɔ ye hɛ kɛ fɔ.
6Kɛ je be nɛ a fɔ mi ɔ,
mo, o nɔ i ngɔ ye hɛ kɛ fɔ.
Mo lɛ o je mi kpo
kɛ je ye nyɛ mi mi tɔɔ.
Ma je o yi daa.
7Mo ji ye wesa he nɛ he wa;
enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, i ba pee nɔ hyɛmi nɔ́
kɛ ha nihi babauu.
8Ma je o yi, nɛ ma wo o hɛ mi nyami
ligbi ɔ tsuo.
9Ko sake mi kɛ fɔ he ngɛ ye bwɔmi mi,
be nɛ ye he wami ta nɛ ɔ.
10Ye he nyɛli ɔmɛ tuɔ ye he munyu yaya,
a ya kpee nɛ a soɔ ye yi nɔ;
11a deɔ ke, “Mawu je e se;
waa fie lɛ nɛ waa nu lɛ,
ejakaa nɔ ko nɔ ko be nɛ ma kpɔ lɛ
ngɛ wa dɛ.”
12Mawu, ko ha nɛ i kɛ mo wa kpɛti nɛ kɛ.
Ye Mawu, pee esɔ nɛ o ba piɛ ye he!
13Ha nɛ zo nɛ gbe ye he nyɛli ɔmɛ,
nɛ a hɛ mi nɛ kpata pɛsɛpɛsɛ.
Nihi nɛ a ngɛ hlae nɛ a pee mi yayami ɔ,
ha nɛ zo nɛ gbe mɛ,
nɛ ahlua hu nɛ bɔ mɛ.
14Se imi lɛɛ ma ngɔ ye hɛ
kɛ fɔ o nɔ be tsuaa be.
Ma je o yi daa kɛ daa.
15Ligbi mluku ɔ tsuo ma wo o ta kaa o yeɔ dami sane;
ma de daa ke yi wami helɔ ji mo.
Pohu níhi nɛ o peeɔ ɔ hiɛ babauu
pe bɔ nɛ ye juɛmi maa su he hulɔ.
16He wami ní nguanguahi nɛ mo, Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ o tsu ɔ,
ma gba kɛ tsɔɔ.
Ma je o yi ke mo pɛ lɛ o peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da.
17Mawu, kɛ je ye nihe mi tɔɔ
nɛ o tsɔɔ mi ní,
nɛ amlɔ nɛ ɔ hu
i ngɛ o nyakpɛ ní tsumi ɔmɛ
a he odase yee.
18Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, amlɔ nɛ ɔ nɛ i bwɔ,
nɛ ye yi mi hiɛ futaa kɛ mua a,
Mawu, ko kua mi!
O kɛ mi nɛ hi si
kɛ yaa si ma sɛɛ
nyakpɛ ní nguanguahi nɛ o tsu ɔ
kɛ ha yi nɔhi nɛ maa ba ngɛ se ɔ.
19Mawu, bɔ nɛ o he wa,
kɛ bɔ nɛ o yeɔ dami sane ɔ,
nɔ ko nɔ ko be nyɛe maa kale.
O tsu nyakpɛ níhi babauu.
Mawu, mɛnɔ kɛ mo sɔ?
20Mo lɛ o ha nɛ i na amanehlu babauu,
mo nɔuu lɛ o ma ha ye yi ma na wami ekohu.
O maa kpale mi kɛ je gbeje
kɛ ba je mi ekohu.
21O maa wo ye hɛ mi nyami babauu,
nɛ o ma ha ye bua maa jɔ ekohu.
22Mawu, imi hu ma fia kpa saku kɛ je o yi
ngɛ anɔkuale nɛ o yeɔ daa a he.
Ma la kɛ to saku ɔ he kɛ je o yi,
kɛ je mo, Israel Nɔ Klɔuklɔu ɔ o yi.
23Ma hwɔ lele, nɛ ma la kɛ je o yi;
ma je o yi, ejakaa o he ye yi wami.
24Ma ye odase daa ke o yeɔ dami sane.
Ejakaa nihi nɛ hlaa kaa a maa gbe mi ɔ,
zo gbe mɛ, nɛ ahlua hu bɔ mɛ.

Title: LA 72
Content:
A fa kue ha matsɛ
1Mawu, ngɔɔ o dami sane yemi mumi
kɛ wo matsɛ ɔ mi,
konɛ o bi, odehe ɔ nɛ kojo pɛpɛɛpɛ!
2É ngɔ dami sane yemi kɛ hyɛ o ma a nɔ;
nɛ é ye nɔ́ nali a sane ha mɛ!
3Zugba a nɛ ba ní saminya,
nɛ á ye dami sane ngɛ he tsuaa he.
4Matsɛ ɔ nɛ ye ohiatsɛmɛ a sane ha mɛ.
E piɛ dɛgutsɛmɛ a he,
se yiwutsotsɛmɛ lɛɛ e kɛ mɛ nɛ to ní.
5Be abɔ nɛ pu kɛ nyɔhiɔ ngɛ nɛ ɔ,
ha nɛ matsɛ ɔ yi nɛ na wami
kɛ ya neneene.
6Ha nɛ matsɛ ɔ yi nɔ nɛ jɔ
kaa hiɔmi nɛ nɛɛ pueɔ ngmɔ nɔ
nɛ haa zugba a nyu ɔ.
7Á ye dami sane saminya ngɛ e yi nɔ;
e yi nɔ nɛ jɔ kulaa ngɛ he tsuaa he
hluu kɛ yaa su be nɛ nyɔhiɔ be hu!
8 É ye tsɛ kɛ je wo nya hiɛ
kɛ ya su wo nya hiɛ,
kɛ je Yufrate pa a nya
kɛ ya su je ɔ nyagbe he ɔmɛ!
9Nga kplanaa a nɔ bi ɔmɛ nɛ
a ba kpla si ngɛ e hɛ mi,
nɛ e he nyɛli ɔmɛ nɛ a ngɔ a hɛ mi
kɛ bu si.
10Matsɛmɛ nɛ je Spania,
kɛ zugbahi nɛ wo bɔle mɛ ɔ a nɔ ɔ,
á tsu to kɛ ba ha lɛ,
nɛ Sheba, kɛ Seba matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ
nɛ a ba ke lɛ ní!
11Matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ a ba kpla si ngɛ e hɛ mi,
nɛ je ma amɛ tsuo nɛ a sɔmɔ lɛ!
12Ke ohiatsɛ, loo nɔ nɛ e fi lɛ,
loo nɔ nɛ be nɔ ko tsɛ lɛ ɔ,
e buɔ lɛ tue.
13Nihi nɛ gbɔjɔ, kɛ nihi nɛ e fi mɛ ɔ,
e naa mɛ mɔbɔ.
Nihi nɛ e fi mɛ ɔ, e heɔ a yi wami.
14E heɔ a yi wami kɛ jeɔ
yi mi wami, kɛ awi yemi mi;
ejakaa nɔ tsuaa nɔ muɔ he jua wa ngɛ e hɛ mi.
15Matsɛ ɔ yi nɛ na wami!
Á ngɔ Arabia sika tsu kɛ ba ha lɛ!
A kpa Mawu pɛɛ kɛ ha lɛ be tsuaa be,
nɛ a bi gbaami ha lɛ daa ligbi!
16Zugba a nɛ ba ní saminya,
nɛ a na blɛfo babauu
ngɛ yo ɔmɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ a nɔ.
Á na tso yiblii saminya
kaa bɔ nɛ a naa ngɛ Lebanon ɔ.
Ma amɛ a mi nɛ hyi tɔ
kɛ nimli adesahi kaa nga.
17Matsɛ ɔ biɛ nɛ hi si kɛ ya neneene.
E biɛ nɛ pɛ be abɔ nɛ pu ngɛ nɛ ɔ.
Mawu nɛ gbaa je ma amɛ tsuo,
nɛ a ha matsɛ ɔ bua jɔmi.
18A je Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ yi;
lɛ nɔ kake too lɛ e peeɔ nyakpɛ níhi!
19A je e biɛ klɔuklɔu ɔ yi kɛ ya neneene!
A wo e hɛ mi nyami ngɛ je ɔ mi tsuo!
Amen! Amen!
20David, Isai bi ɔ kue fami ɔmɛ a
nyagbe ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.

Title: LA 73
Content:
WOMI ETƐNE
(La 73—89)
Mawu yeɔ dami sane
1Niinɛ, Mawu hi ha Israel;
e hi ha ni nɛmɛ nɛ a tsui mi tsɔ.
2Se imi lɛɛ, e piɛ bɔɔ jinɛ i laa blɔ;
e piɛ bɔɔ nɛ ye hemi kɛ yemi ta.
3Ejakaa ye hɛ kɔ he nɔ woli, kɛ yayami peeli a nɔ
benɛ i na kaa a ngɛ nɔ yae ngɛ je mi ɔ.
4A he ko he ko yi mɛ ɔ,
a ngɛ he wami; a ngɛ kpakpataa.
5Haomi bɛ a nɔ
kaa bɔ nɛ e baa ni kpahi a nɔ ɔ.
A nɛ nɔ́ kaa bɔ nɛ ni kpahi naa nɔ́ ɔ.
6Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, he womi ji kuɛ ní
nɛ a kɛ fɔ a kuɛ.
Yi mi wami ji bo nɛ mɛɛ a haa.
7Yayami hyi a tsui mi;
daa nɛ ɔ, a ngɛ ga yaya toe.
8A yeɔ nɔ he fɛu,
nɛ a tuɔ nɔ he munyu yaya.
A woɔ a he nɔ, nɛ a toɔ gahi
nɛ a kɛ waa nihi yi mi.
9A tuɔ munyu kɛ siɔ Mawu ngɛ hiɔwe.
A sibi nimli adesahi lɛɛ
a kɛ mɛ tuɔ munyu basabasa bɔ nɛ a suɔ.
10Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ma a ya nyɛɛ a se,
ejakaa a nɛ nɔ́ ko nɛ dɛ ngɛ a he.
11Nɔ́ nɛ a deɔ ji, “Oo, Mawu be lee! Hiɔwe No ɔ,
kɛ e maa pee kɛ le kɛɛ?”
12Hyɛ, bɔ nɛ yayami peeli ngɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Mɛɛ lɛɛ daa nɛ ɔ, a ngɛ he jɔmi mi,
nɛ a ngɛ ní nae kɛ ngɛ he bɔe.
13Hyɛ kaa i tsu ye he nɛ mu ko be ye he!
Hyɛ kaa i pee ye he klɔuklɔu!
Lɛɛ tse enɛ ɔ tsuo peeɔ yaka?
14Mawu, o haa nɛ i naa nɔ́ ligbi ɔ tsuo;
o gblaa ye tue daa mɔtu.
15Se ke i de nɔ́ ko kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ,
lɛɛ i tɔ, nɛ i pee we ye ní
kaa o ma mi no.
16I hla bɔ nɛ ma pee nɛ ma kɛ nu nɔ́ nɛ ɔ sisi,
se ye juɛmi sui he.
17Kɛkɛ nɛ i ya mo Mawu ɔ, o we klɔuklɔu ɔ,
nɛ i ya na bɔ nɛ yayami peeli
a nyagbe maa ba ha ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.
18Ee, o maa ngɔ mɛ kɛ to hehi nɛ saneɔ;
o maa tsɛ̃ mɛ kɛ fia si
nɛ a hɛ mi ma kpata.
19Ee, a hɛ mi ma kpata si kake too;
a nyagbe maa pee gbeye.
20A ngɛ kaa nlami nɛ nɔ ko nla;
mɔtu kɛkɛ e se po.
Nyɔmtsɛ, ke o te si ɔ, a maa laa.
21Benɛ i hao, nɛ i ngɛ tsui yee ɔ,
22i je kuasia; i li nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko;
i pee kaa lohwe ngɛ o hɛ mi.
23Se kɛ̃ ɔ, ma hi o kasa nya daa;
o maa pɛtɛ ye he.
24O maa wo mi ga, nɛ o maa tsɔɔ mi blɔ.
Nyagbe ɔ, o ma he mi atuu,
nɛ o maa wo ye hɛ mi nyami.
25Mɛnɔ i pa ngɛ ngɛ hiɔwe pe mo?
O se ɔ, nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko hia we mi
ngɛ zugba nɛ ɔ nɔ hu.
26Ke ye nɔmlɔ tso ɔ gbɔjɔ, nɛ ye tsui ta a,
Yawɛ maa wo mi he wami,
ejakaa lɛ ji ye nɔ́ fɛɛ nɔ́,
nɛ e kɛ mi maa hi si daa.
27Nihi nɛ kua mo ɔ, a hɛ mi ma kpata.
Ni nɛmɛ nɛ yi mo anɔkuale ɔ,
o ma kpata mɛ tsuo a hɛ mi.
28Se imi lɛɛ
e hi kaa ma hɛ mi kɛ su Mawu he.
Ma ya sa we ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ngɔ,
nɛ ma sɛɛ níhi nɛ e pee ɔ tsuo.

Title: LA 74
Content:
Ma a fa kue ha Mawu
1Mawu, mɛni he je lɛ o hɛ wɔ ngɔ fɔ he ɔ?
Anɛ o mi mi ma fu mo nitsɛ o ma a
daa kikɛ nɛ ɔ lo?
2Mo kai mo nitsɛ o ma
nɛ o he kɛ je blema lokoo ɔ.
Mo kai nihi nɛ o je kɛ je nyɔguɛ si himi mi,
nɛ o pee mɛ mo nitsɛ o ma a.
Mo kai Zion yo ɔ, he nɛ o hi sa a.
3Moo nyɛɛ kɛ ya he nɛ plɛ pee we doku ɔ;
he nyɛli ɔmɛ kpata níhi tsuo a hɛ mi ngɛ o we ɔ.
4O he nyɛli ɔmɛ ya he ose ngɛ o he klɔuklɔu ɔ.
A ngɔ a we aflangaa amɛ ya to lejɛ ɔ
kɛ tsɔɔ kaa a ye kunimi.
5A ngɛ kaa ni komɛ nɛ ngɔ gbiɛ
kɛ ngɛ tso hɛɛe ngɛ pu mi.
6A ngɔ gbiɛ kɛ hamle kɛ ku
tsohi nɛ a kpɛ ɔ tsuo a mi dukuduku.
7A hule o we klɔuklɔu ɔ, nɛ a mɛ he la.
He nɛ a jaa mo ngɛ ɔ, a ble lejɛ ɔ.
8A to kaa a ma kpata wa hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ.
Zugba a nɔ hehi nɛ a kpee ngɛ
nɛ a jaa Mawu ɔ, a mɛ lɛ tsuo he la.
9Wa pa nɛ okadi ko hu;
gbalɔ ko gbalɔ ko be hu.
Nɔ ko nɔ ko hu li
be nɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ se maa po.
10Mawu, kɛ yaa si mɛni be
lɛ wa he nyɛli ɔmɛ maa muɔ mo?
Anɛ a maa gbe o biɛ ɔ he guɛ
kɛ maa ya neneene lo?
11Mɛni he je lɛ o bɛ nɛ o ba piɛ wa he?
Mɛni he je lɛ o bua o nine nya?
12Se Mawu, kɛ je blema lokoo ɔ, mo ji wa matsɛ;
o he wa yi wami be babauu.
13 O kɛ o he wami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ gba wo ɔ mi,
nɛ o ywia wo mi lohwe gbeyegbeye ɔmɛ a yi.
14 Lohwe ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ Leviatan ɔ,
mo lɛ o ywia e yi, nɛ o ngɔ e he lo ɔ
ngɔ ha nga nɔ lohwehi nɛ a ye.
15O ha nɛ pa tsɔwitsɔwihi hia kɛ be,
nɛ pa nguahi lɛɛ a mi nyu mii ta.
16Mo lɛ o bɔ nyɔ kɛ pia,
nɛ o ngɔ pu kɛ hlami ngɔ to a blɔ hehi.
17Mo lɛ o to huzu kɛ ha je ɔ;
o pee latsa be kɛ fĩɛ be.
18Se Yawɛ mo kai kaa o he nyɛli ɔmɛ muɔɔ mo;
nimli nɛ li Mawu ngɛ o biɛ he guɛ gbee.
19Koo ngmɛɛ o ma nɛ a ní ngɛ mɔbɔ ɔ he
kɛ ha a he nyɛli yiwutsotsɛmɛ ɔmɛ.
O ma nɛ a ngɛ yi mi wae ɔ,
o hɛ ko je a nɔ.
20Mo kai somi nɛ o kɛ wɔ so ɔ.
Zugba a nɔ hehi nɛ wo diblii ɔ,
yi wu tso níhi lɛ a peeɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔmɛ.
21Nihi nɛ a ngɛ mɛ yi mi wae ɔ,
ko ha zo nɛ gbe mɛ.
Ha nɛ nɔ́ nali, kɛ ohiatsɛmɛ tsuo nɛ
a je o yi.
22Mawu, wo o he nɔ
nɛ o kɛ wa he nyɛli ɔmɛ nɛ to ní.
Mo kai kaa nihi nɛ li mo Mawu ɔ,
a yeɔ o he fɛu daa nɛ.
23Munyuhi nɛ o he nyɛli ɔmɛ tuɔ kɛ siɔ mo ɔ,
o hɛ ko je nɔ.
Nihi nɛ teɔ si kɛ woɔ mo ɔ,
ngmlaa nɛ a kpaa kɛ woɔ o yi ɔ,
daa nɛ ɔ, pe ngmlaa a ngɛ nɔ yae.

Title: LA 75
Content:
Mawu ji kojolɔ
1Mawu lee, wa naa mo si.
Wa naa mo si!
Wa ngɛ o biɛ ta woe, nɛ wa ngɛ
nyakpɛ níhi nɛ o pee ɔ jajee.
2Mawu ke, “I to be nɛ ma kojo je ɔ;
ke be ɔ su ɔ, ma ye dami sane.
3Je ɔ kɛ e mi níhi tsuo ma mimiɛ;
se imi ma ha je ɔ sisi tomi ɔmɛ
maa ma si kpɛii.
4I ngɛ he nɔ woli dee ke,
‘Nyɛ ko fĩa!’
I ngɛ yiwutsotsɛmɛ dee ke,
‘Nyɛ ko wo nyɛ he nɔ!’
5Nyɛ ko wo nyɛ he nɔ kɛ si Hiɔwe No ɔ;
nyɛ ko wo nyɛ kuɛ nɔ kɛ tu he nɔ womi munyu.”
6Ejakaa, ke a ma ha nɔ ko blɔ nya,
aloo a ma wo e nɔ ɔ,
he wami nɛ ɔ, pi beleku je, loo bonyoku je,
loo omleyi je nɛ e je.
7Mawu ji kojolɔ;
e woɔ ni komɛ a nɔ, nɛ e baa ni komɛ si.
8Yawɛ hɛɛ kplu ko ngɛ e dɛ mi,
nɛ dã kpakpa nɛ nya wa hyi lɛ tɔ.
E maa po dã nɛ ɔ ha nimli yayamihi tsuo,
nɛ a maa hi nue hluu kɛ yaa si dã a sisi tɔɔ.
9Se imi lɛɛ ma ye Yakob Mawu ɔ
he odase kɛ maa ya neneene;
ma la kɛ je e yi daa.
10E maa ba nimli yayamihi a he wami ɔ si;
se nimli kpakpahi lɛɛ
e ma ha nɛ a na he wami kɛ bɔ he.

Title: LA 76
Content:
Mawu ye kunimi
1A le Mawu ngɛ Yuda,
a woɔ e biɛ ɔ hɛ mi nyami ngɛ Israel.
2E we ngɛ Yerusalem,
Zion ji he nɛ e hii.
3Lejɛ ɔ lɛ e ku he nyɛli ɔmɛ
a ta hwumi ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ngɛ:
kɛ̃ɛ̃ mi bi, kɛ tsɛ̃i, kɛ klaate.
4Hyɛ bɔ nɛ o hɛ mi ba nyami;
hyɛ bɔ nɛ o he ngɛ gbeye
benɛ o gbe he nyɛli ɔmɛ,
nɛ o je yo ɔmɛ a nɔ kɛ ma a.
5He nyɛli ɔmɛ a ta buli katsɛmɛ ɔmɛ
nyɛ we nɛ a da ta a nya kulaa.
A gbo kɛ pueɔ si kaa nihi nɛ hwɔ mahe
nɛ a kpakpaa a he níhi tsuo.
6Benɛ mo Yakob Mawu ɔ wo gbi ɔ,
okpɔngɔ ɔmɛ, kɛ okpɔngɔ nɔ hili ɔmɛ tsuo
gbo kɛ pue si.
7Niinɛ, o he ngɛ gbeye!
Ke o mi mi fu ɔ,
mɛnɔ ma nyɛ o hɛ mi maa da?
8O kojo, nɛ a nu he kɛ je hiɔwe tɔɔ;
je ɔ ye gbeye, nɛ e pee dii.
9Mo Mawu ɔ, o gbla yayami peeli a tue,
nɛ je nɛ ɔ mi ni nɛmɛ nɛ a ní ngɛ mɔbɔ ɔ,
mɛɛ lɛɛ o fa a he.
10Edom bi nɛ a mi mi fu ɔ,
niinɛ, a ma je o yi kɛ̃.
Nɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ maa piɛ ngɛ Harmat ɔ
maa ye o nyami be ɔmɛ.
11Nyɛɛ wo Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ si,
nɛ nyɛɛ ye siwo ɔmɛ a nɔ.
Nyɛ nihi tsuo nɛ nyɛ bɔle Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ,
nɔ nɛ he ngɛ gbeye ɔ,
nyɛɛ ngɔ nike ní ba ha lɛ.
12Ganɔhi nɛ woɔ a he nɔ ɔ, e baa mɛ si;
e woɔ matsɛmɛ nguanguahi hu a he gbeye.

Title: LA 77
Content:
Bua womi ngɛ haomi be mi
1I fa kue boboobo ha Mawu;
i fa kue ha Mawu, nɛ e nu ye gbi.
2Benɛ i ngɛ haomi mi ɔ,
i hla Nyɔmtsɛ se blɔ.
Nyɔ mi ɔ, i wo ye nine nɔ
kɛ ya hiɔwe, nɛ i sɔle
nɛ ye kɔni gbo we.
I na we bua jɔmi ko kulaa.
3Benɛ ye hɛ ba Mawu nɔ,
nɛ i bɔni ye yi mi susumi ɔ,
ye susuma hao, nɛ i fa huu.
4Nyɔ ɔ mi tsuo i hwɔ we mahe,
kikɛ nɛ ɔ ye hɛngmɛ fɔɔ si paa.
I hao tsɔ, nɛ i nyɛ we ma tu munyu.
5Ye juɛmi ya su blema lokoo,
nɛ i kai jehahi nɛ be kɛ ho.
