6Nyɔ mi tsuo i susu ye yi mi wawɛɛ nitsɛ,
nɛ ye susuma pee vii.
I de ngɛ ye yi mi ke,
7“Anɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ma kua wɔ daa nɛ lo?
Anɛ e pa be wa he bua jɔmi nae hu lo?
8Anɛ e mɔbɔ nami ɔ se po jehanɛ lo?
Anɛ e pa be e si womi ɔmɛ a nɔ yee hu lo?
9Anɛ Mawu hɛ je nɔ kaa e maa na mɔbɔ lo?
Anɛ jehanɛ lɛɛ abofu ba da mɔbɔ nami nane mi lo?”
10Kɛkɛ nɛ i kɛ hɛdɔ bi ke,
“Anɛ Mawu hiɔ nine ɔ tsu we ní hu lo?
Anɛ Hiɔwe No ɔ pa be he wami ko hu lo?”
11Se kɛ̃, Yawɛ, i kai níhi nɛ o tsu blema a;
ee, i kai nyakpɛ ní nguahi nɛ o pee ɔ.
12Ma susu níhi tsuo nɛ o pee ɔ a he;
nyakpɛ níhi nɛ o pee blema a, ma kai.
13Mawu, o níhi tsuo ngɛ klɔuklɔu!
Te Mawu nɔ́ nɛ pa kle kaa mo, wa Mawu ɔ nɛ?
14Mawu nɛ tsuɔ nyakpɛ ní ji mo;
o je o he wami kpo ngɔ tsɔɔ je ɔ tsuo.
15O ngɔ o he wami ɔ kɛ he o ma a yi wami;
ee, o he Yakob kɛ Yosef a bimɛ ɔmɛ a yi wami.
16Mawu, benɛ pa a na mo ɔ, e ye gbeye,
nɛ wo ɔ sisi mimiɛ.
17Hiɔmi nɛ kɛ je bɔku ɔmɛ a mi pue si.
Hiɔwe si, nɛ oslabai gba kɛ bɔle si.
18Hiɔwe si kplala-la-la kɛ po si
kaa lasiogblee nɛ bee.
Oslabai la a ha nɛ je ɔ mi pee heii,
nɛ zugba a mimiɛ.
19O nyɛɛ kɛ gu wo ɔ mi;
o po wo nɛ mi kuɔ ɔ kɛ be,
se o nane mami he ɔmɛ lɛɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko li.
20O ngɔ Mose kɛ Aaron ngɔ to o ma a nya,
nɛ o kpaka mɛ kaa to hyɛlɔ tsɔɔ to.

Title: LA 78
Content:
Mawu kɛ e ma a
1Ye ma, nyɛɛ bu nɔ́ nɛ ma tsɔɔ nyɛ nɛ ɔ tue;
nyɛɛ bu ye nya mi munyu ɔmɛ tue.
2 Ma tu munyu ngɛ abɛ gbi mi;
ma gba nyɛ blema nyakpɛ sanehi:
3níhi nɛ wa le, nɛ wa nu,
níhi nɛ wa nɛmɛ ɔmɛ de wɔ.
4Wa be ní nɛ ɔmɛ ngɔe kɛ laa wa bimɛ.
Yi nɔhi nɛ maa ba ngɛ se ɔ,
ní nguanguahi nɛ Yawɛ tsu,
nyakpɛ níhi nɛ e pee,
kɛ he wami kpetekpleenyɛ nɛ e ngɛ ɔ,
wa maa gba mɛ.
5E ha Israel bi ɔmɛ mlaa;
ee, e ngɔ e munyu ɔ kɛ ha Yakob nina a.
E fa wa nɛmɛ ɔmɛ ke
a tsɔɔ a bimɛ ɔmɛ mlaa a,
6konɛ yi nɔhi nɛ maa ba ngɛ se ɔ
nɛ kase, nɛ mɛ hu a tsɔɔ a bimɛ.
7Kɛkɛ ɔ, mɛ hu a maa ngɔ
a hɛ kɛ fɔ Mawu nɔ.
Níhi nɛ e tsu ha mɛ ɔ, a hɛ be nɔ jee,
nɛ a maa ye e mlaa amɛ a nɔ daa;
8konɛ a ko ba wa tue, nɛ a ko ba tsɔ atuã
kaa bɔ nɛ a nɛmɛ ɔmɛ pee ɔ.
Mɛɛ a ngɔɛ a hɛ kɛ fɔɛ Mawu nɔ kɛ pi si;
anɔkuale hu a yi lɛ bɔ nɛ sa.
9Efraim bi ɔmɛ mia, nɛ a hɛɛ kɛ̃ɛ̃,
se benɛ ta hwumi be ɔ su ɔ,
a ma fo kɛ je ta a nya.
10Somi nɛ Mawu kɛ mɛ so ɔ, a yi nɔ;
e mlaa a hu a kua nɔ yemi.
11Níhi nɛ e tsu ha mɛ,
kɛ nyakpɛ níhi nɛ e pee nɛ a na a,
a hɛ je lɛ tsuo nɔ.
12 Mawu pee nyakpɛ ní babauu
ngɛ a nɛmɛ ɔmɛ a hɛ mi,
ngɛ Zoan nga kplanaa a nɔ,
ngɛ Egipt zugba a mi.
13 E gba wo ɔ mi, nɛ nyu ɔ da si
glekugleku ngɛ hiɔ nɔ kɛ muɔ nɔ;
nɛ e ha nɛ e ma a gu mi kɛ be.
14 Piani ɔ, e kɛ bɔku tsɔɔ mɛ blɔ,
nyɔ mi lɛɛ e haa mɛ la nɛ hii kpɛe.
15 E gba tɛ sahi a mi ngɛ nga a nɔ,
nɛ e ha mɛ nyu babauu nɛ a nu.
16E ha nɛ nyu je tɛ sa mi babaaba
kaa pa nɛ hia kɛ bee.
17Se kɛ̃, a ya nɔ pee yayami kɛ si Mawu;
a tsɔ atuã kɛ si Hiɔwe No ɔ
ngɛ nga kplanaa a nɔ.
18 A bi Mawu ke e ha mɛ niye ní
nɛ mɛɛ a ngɛ hlae ɔ,
nɛ a kɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ peemi ka Mawu.
19A tu munyu kɛ si Mawu, nɛ a bi ke,
“Anɛ Mawu ma nyɛ ma ha wɔ niye ní
ngɛ nga a nɔ lo?
20Niinɛ, e fia tɛ sa a nɔ́
nɛ nyu je mi kɛ be babaaba
kaa pa nɛ hia.
Se anɛ e ma nyɛ ma ha e ma a
abolo, kɛ lo hu lo?”
21Benɛ Yawɛ nu nɔ́ nɛ ɔ,
e mi mi fu wawɛɛ nitsɛ.
E ngɔ la kɛ gbla e ma a tue;
e mi mi fumi ɔ nya bɛ si kulaa.
22Ejakaa a ngɔɛ a hɛ kɛ fɔɛ Mawu nɔ;
a he we yi kaa e ma he a yi wami.
23Se kɛ̃, e fa,
nɛ hiɔwe sinya amɛ bli.
24 E ha mɛ ngma kɛ je hiɔwe;
ee, e ha mɛ mana nɛ a ye.
25Mawu ha mɛ niye ní babauu;
ee, adesahi na Mawu bɔfohi a niye ní lɛ a ye.
26E ha nɛ beleku kɔɔhiɔ fia ngɛ hiɔwe,
nɛ e kɛ e he wami kpaka
leneyi kɔɔhiɔ kɛ ba.
27E ha nɛ lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ je hiɔwe ba,
lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ babauu kaa wo nya zia.
28Lohwe ɔmɛ ba nɔɔ si ngɛ ma sito he ɔ,
ngɛ a bo tsu ɔmɛ a he
kɛ bɔle lejɛ ɔ tsuo.
29Mawu ha ma a niye ní nɛ a tsui suɔ,
nɛ a ye, nɛ a tɔ saminya.
30Se benɛ a ngɛ ní ɔ yee kɛ mwɔɔ ɔ,
nɛ a na we nɛ a gbe nya a,
31Mawu mi mi fu mɛ wawɛɛ nitsɛ,
nɛ e gbe a kpɛti katsɛmɛ ɔmɛ
nɛ ji Israel nihewi kpakpa amɛ.
32Ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a se ɔ,
ma a ya nɔ pee yayami.
Nyakpɛ níhi tsuo nɛ e pee ɔ a se ɔ,
a he we lɛ yi.
33Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, e po a wami be ɔ nɔ kpiti,
nɛ dengme, kɛ nɔ́ nami sɔuu lɛ ngɛ mi.
34Be tsuaa be nɛ e maa gbe a ti ni komɛ ɔ,
ni nɛmɛ nɛ piɛ ɔ ma hla e se blɔ.
A ma pia a he, nɛ a maa fa kue ha lɛ.
35A ma kai kaa Mawu ji a he bulɔ;
a ma kai kaa Mawu, Hiɔwe No ɔ
ji nɔ nɛ heɔ a yi wami.
36Se munyuhi nɛ jeɔ a nya a, lakpa sɔuu;
a de we nɔ́ ko kɛ ji a tsui mi.
37A yi lɛ anɔkuale ɔ,
somi nɛ e kɛ mɛ so ɔ hu a yi nɔ.
38Se akɛnɛ mɔbɔ nalɔ ji Mawu he je ɔ,
e ngɔ a he yayami ɔ ngɔ pa mɛ,
nɛ e kpataa we a hɛ mi.
Behi fuu ke e mi mi miɔ nɛ e ma fu,
kɛkɛ e tsi nya amlɔ.
39E kaiɔ kaa adesahi kɛkɛ ji mɛ;
a ngɛ kaa kɔɔhiɔ nɛ fia kɛ be
nɛ kpale we e se kɛ bɛ hu.
40Hyɛ bɔ nɛ a tsɔ e hɛ mi atuã
si abɔ ngɛ nga a nɔ!
Hyɛ bɔ nɛ a pee lɛ nidɔ ní
si abɔ ngɛ nga kplanaa a nɔ!
41A ka Mawu nɔtonɔto;
a wo Israel nɔ klɔuklɔu ɔ mi mi la.
42A kaii we e he wami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ hu;
ligbi ɔ nɛ e je mɛ kɛ je a he nyɛli ɔmɛ
a dɛ mi ɔ hu a hɛ je nɔ.
43Jamɛ a be ɔ, e pee nyakpɛ níhi
ngɛ Zoan nga kplanaa a nɔ ngɛ Egipt.
44 E ha nɛ pa amɛ plɛ pee muɔ,
nɛ Egipt bi ɔmɛ nɛ nyu nɛ a nu.
45 E ha nɛ pwɔlwɔɛ ba babauu,
nɛ a ba hao ma mi bi ɔmɛ.
Ovɔnɔhi babauu hu ba jã kɛ̃,
nɛ a ba puɛ ní ngɛ zugba a nɔ.
46 E ngɔ a ngmɔ ní ɔmɛ ngɔ ha baalɛhi;
a tsu ní ha baalɛhi nɛ a ye.
47 E kɛ gbiɛ ngo ngu gbe a wai tso ɔmɛ;
a ngmɔkɔ tso ɔmɛ lɛɛ,
e kɛ fiɛ nɛ nya wa gbe mɛ.
48E kɛ gbiɛ ngo ngu gbe a na amɛ;
a to ɔmɛ lɛɛ e kɛ oslabai gbe mɛ.
49E mi mi fu mɛ wawɛɛ nitsɛ;
nɛ abofu nɛ ɔ ngɔ haomi babauu kɛ ba a nɔ
kaa Mawu bɔfohi kpataa nɔ hɛ mi.
50E mi mi la a nya bɛ si;
e ngɔɛ a he kɛ ki mɛ hulɔ.
Se mohu e kɛ gbenɔ hiɔ kpata a hɛ mi.
51 E gbe bitɛtehi tsuo ngɛ we tsuaa we mi
ngɛ Egipt zugba a nɔ.
52 Se lɛ nitsɛ e ma a lɛɛ e nyɛɛ a hɛ mi,
nɛ e kpaka mɛ kɛ gu nga kplanaa a nɔ
kaa to hyɛlɔ tsɔɔ to.
53 E hɛɛ mɛ dɔdɔɔdɔ nɛ a yi gbeye.
Se a he nyɛli ɔmɛ lɛɛ
wo ɔ ku kɛ pue a nɔ.
54 E ngɔ mɛ kɛ ba e yoku klɔuklɔu ɔ nɔ.
E kɛ mɛ ba yo ɔ nɛ lɛ nitsɛ
e ngɔ e he wami kɛ kpɔ ɔ nɔ.
55 E fie ma je li ɔmɛ kɛ je Israel bi ɔmɛ a blɔ mi.
E dla a zugba a ngɔ ha e ma a,
nɛ lejɛ ɔ ba pee a weto ní, kɛ a hi he.
56 Se a ka Mawu, Hiɔwe No ɔ;
a tsɔ e hɛ mi atuã,
nɛ a yi e mlaa amɛ a nɔ.
57A je Mawu se; a yi lɛ anɔkuale kɛ pi si
kaa a nɛmɛ ɔmɛ nɔuu.
A gba kɛ je e blɔ ɔ nɔ kaa kɛ̃ɛ̃ nɛ mi dɔ
nɛ nyɛ we nɛ e ya e hɛ mi tɛɛ.
58A kɛ a jami he ɔmɛ wo e mi mi la,
nɛ a we amaga amɛ ha nɛ e pee kaa hunga jelɔ.
59Benɛ Mawu na nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, e mi mi fu,
nɛ e kua e ma a pɛsɛpɛsɛ.
60 E si e sihi he ɔ nɛ ngɛ Shilo ɔ,
bo tsu ɔ nɛ e hi mi ngɛ e ma a kpɛti ɔ.
61 E ngmɛ blɔ nɛ wa he nyɛli ɔmɛ
ba ngɔ somi daka a kɛ ho ma se ya.
E he wami ɔ, kɛ e hɛ mi nyami ɔ we okadi
ji kikɛmɛ a somi daka nɛ ɔ nɛ.
62E mi mi fu lɛ nitsɛ e ma a wawɛɛ nitsɛ,
nɛ e ngɔ mɛ ngɔ ha a he nyɛli
nɛ a gbe mɛ kɛ klaate.
63La kpata nihewi ɔmɛ a hɛ mi,
nɛ yihewi ɔmɛ nɛ nyumuhi nɛ a gba.
64Osɔfo ɔmɛ gbo ngɛ klaate nya,
nɛ a yalɔyi ɔmɛ yi kɔmɔ ha mɛ.
65Kɛkɛ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ te si pam
kaa nɔ ko nɛ je mahe mi,
aloo oblai nɛ nu dã, nɛ ngɛ huhui kpae.
66E wo e he nyɛli ɔmɛ fo kɛ ho kɛ zo;
e bɔ mɛ ahlua kɛ yaa neneene.
67E kua Yosef nina a;
e hlɛ Efraim wɛtso ɔ.
68Mohu ɔ, e hla Yuda wɛtso ɔ,
kɛ Zion yo ɔ nɛ e suɔ saminya a.
69Lejɛ ɔ lɛ e ma e we klɔuklɔu ɔ ngɛ.
We nɛ ɔ ngɛ he wami, nɛ e maa hi si daa
kaa bɔ nɛ hiɔwe kɛ zugba ngɛ ɔ pɛ.
70 E hla e tsɔlɔ David hulɔ;
e je lɛ kɛ je to lɛmi he ɔ.
71E je lɛ kɛ je to yihi, kɛ a bi tsɔwitsɔwihi a se.
E wo lɛ matsɛ ngɛ Israel,
konɛ e hyɛ lɛ, Mawu ɔ e ma a nɔ
kaa bɔ nɛ to hyɛlɔ tsɔɔ to ɔ.
72David hyɛ ma a nɔ bɔ nɛ sa.
E nyɛɛ a hɛ mi, nɛ e kpaka mɛ bɔ nɛ sa.
Ga, kɛ anɔkuale yemi lɛ e kɛ tsu nɔ́ nɛ ɔ.

Title: LA 79
Content:
Kue fami kɛ ha ma a yi wami hemi
1 Mawu, ma je li ɔmɛ ba tua o zugba a.
A ble o we klɔuklɔu ɔ,
nɛ a pee Yerusalem ma doku.
2A ngɔ o tsɔli ɔmɛ a gbogboe ɔmɛ
kɛ ha lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ nɛ a ye.
A ngɔ o ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ a he lo
kɛ ha pu mi lohwehi.
3A pue o ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ a muɔ si babauu;
muɔ be ngɛ Yerusalem kaa nyu,
nɛ nɔ ko be nɛ maa pu gbogboe ɔmɛ.
4Je ma amɛ nɛ bɔle wɔ ɔ bɔ wɔ ahlua;
a muɔ wɔ, nɛ a ye wa he fɛu.
5Yawɛ, mɛni be o mi mi ma fu wɔ kɛ yaa si?
O mi mi ma fu wɔ kɛ maa ya neneene lo?
Anɛ o mi mi fumi ɔ ma tsa nɔ
kaa la nɛ ngɛ tsoe nɛ gbo we lo?
6Je mahi nɛ li mo,
kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ ja we mo ɔ,
o mi mi nɛ fu mɛ.
7Ejakaa a gbe o ma mi bi ɔmɛ,
nɛ a kpata o zugba a hɛ mi.
8Koo ngɔ wa nɛmɛ ɔmɛ a he yayami ɔmɛ
kɛ gbla wa tue.
Pee esɔ nɛ o na wɔ mɔbɔ,
ejakaa wa kɔni mi jɔ̃.
9Mawu, piɛ wa he nɛ o he wa yi wami.
Mo he wɔ, nɛ o ngɔ wa he yayami kɛ pa wɔ
kɛ wo mo nitsɛ o biɛ ɔ hɛ mi nyami.
10Mɛni he je lɛ je ma amɛ ma bi wɔ ke,
“Jije nyɛ Mawu ɔ ngɛ?”
Je mahi nɛ pue o tsɔli ɔmɛ a muɔ si ɔ,
gbla a tue nɛ waa na kɛ wa hɛngmɛ.
11Yawɛ, pamitsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ kɛmɛe; bu tue!
Ni nɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ gbenɔ nya mi ɔ,
ngɔɔ o he wami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ kɛ kpɔ mɛ.
12Nyɔmtsɛ, je mahi tsuo nɛ ye o he fɛu ɔ,
gbla a tue si kpaago kɛ to nɔ́ nɛ a pee ɔ nya.
13Ke o pee ja a, wɔ, o ma a, o to kuu ɔ,
wa maa na mo si, nɛ wa ma je o yi daa.

Title: LA 80
Content:
Kue fami kɛ ha ma a si tomi ekohu
1 Israel to hyɛlɔ, mo nɛ o nyɛɛɔ Israel hɛ mi
kaa bɔ nɛ to hyɛlɔ tsɔɔ to ɔ,
moo bu wɔ tue koo!
Mo nɛ o hii si ngɛ hɛ kali a nɔ ɔ,
2je o he kpo kɛ tsɔɔ Efraim, Benyamin,
kɛ Manase wɛtso ɔmɛ.
Je o he wami ɔ kɛ tsɔɔ wɔ;
ba nɛ o ba he wa yi wami!
3Mawu, kpale wɔ kɛ ba o ngɔ ekohu.
Naa wɔ mɔbɔ, konɛ wa yi nɛ na wami.
4Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ Mawu!
O ma mi bi ɔmɛ a kue fami ɔ
maa wo o mi mi la kɛ yaa si mɛni be?
5Ngma nɛ o haa wɔ nɛ wa yeɔ wa tɔɔ,
kɛ nyu hu nɛ wa nuɔ kɛkɛ ji vo nyu.
6Je mahi nɛ bɔle wɔ ɔ, o haa nɛ
a kɛ wɔ ba pleeɔ wa zugba a he,
nɛ wa he nyɛli ɔmɛ muɔɔ wɔ bɔ nɛ a suɔ.
7Mawu Tabohiatsɛ, kpale wɔ kɛ ba o ngɔ ekohu.
Naa wɔ mɔbɔ, konɛ wa yi nɛ na wami.
8O ngɔ wai tso kɛ je Egipt kɛ ba.
O fie je ma amɛ kɛ je a zugba a nɔ,
nɛ o ma wai tso ɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.
9O dla zugba a saminyayoo; o ha nɛ
tso ɔ tsɛ̃ sipoku kɛ ya zu mi tsitsaa,
nɛ wai tso ɔ ha zugba a nɔ tsuo.
10E hɔ̃ ɔ ha yo ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ e kɔni ɔmɛ
hu ha seda tso nguangua amɛ a nɔ.
11E gba kɔni kɛ ya na Mediterenia wo ɔ,
ee, kɛ ya su Yufrate pa a he tɔɔ.
12Mɛni he je mɔ lɛ o gbɛ piɛ ɔ ngɛ e he?
Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ bee ngɛ lejɛ ɔ
gbaa ya tsɔɔ wai yiblii ɔ eko.
13Nga mi kpotoohi ngɛ wai yiblii ɔ hɛ mi kpatae,
nɛ pu mi lohwehi tsuo ngɛ yee.
14Mawu Tabohiatsɛ! Wa kpa mo pɛɛ
nɛ o kpale kɛ ba wa ngɔ ekohu.
Moo ma o yi si ngɛ hiɔwe, nɛ o hyɛ!
Moo hyɛ wai tso bɔbɔyoo nɛ ɔ.
15Wai tso bɔbɔyoo ɔ nɛ mo nitsɛ o ma,
nɛ o hyɛ nɔ saminya kɛ ya si e bɔ kikɛ nɛ ɔ,
ba nɛ o ba he e yi wami.
16Wa he nyɛli ɔmɛ mɛ wai tso ɔ he la
nɛ a po lɛ ngɔ fɔ si.
O mi mi nɛ fu mɛ, nɛ o kpata a hɛ mi.
17Ma nɛ mo nitsɛ o je blɔ hla mɛ,
nɛ o ha nɛ a he wa kikɛ nɛ ɔ,
moo bu a he, nɛ o baa a yi.
18Wa be o se jee hu kɔkɔɔkɔ.
Ha nɛ wa yi nɛ na wami,
nɛ wa ma je o yi daa.
19Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ Mawu!
Moo kpale wɔ kɛ ba o ngɔ ekohu.
Naa wɔ mɔbɔ, konɛ wa yi nɛ na wami!

Title: LA 81
Content:
Nyami la
1Nyɛ wo nyɛ gbi nɔ kɛ la ha Mawu, wa he bulɔ ɔ.
Nyɛ hwɔ lele kɛ je Yakob Mawu ɔ yi.
2Nyɛ je la, nɛ nyɛɛ fia gɔgɔ.
Nyɛɛ fia saku nɛ gbi ngɔɔ,
nɛ nyɛɛ fia miɛ kɛ piɛ he.
3 Nyɛ kpa titimati wa nyami ligbi ɔmɛ tsuo,
be mi nɛ nyɔhiɔ da, kɛ be mi nɛ nyɔhiɔ ɔ wa.
4Mlaa nɛ ngɛ Israel ji nɛ ɔ nɛ;
Yakob Mawu ɔ lɛ wo.
5Mawu wo Israel bi ɔmɛ mlaa nɛ ɔ,
benɛ e ya puɛ ní ngɛ Egipt zugba a nɔ ɔ.
I nu nɛ nɔ ko nɛ i li lɛ ngɛ dee ke,
6“I je nyɛ tlomi ɔmɛ kɛ je nyɛ nɔ;
i ha nɛ nyɛ ngmɛɛ nyɛ kusii ɔmɛ a he.
7 Benɛ nyɛ ngɛ haomi mi ɔ, nyɛ tsɛ mi.
I he nɔ kɛ je ye laami he ɔ,
he nɛ hiɔwe siɔ kɛ jee ɔ,
nɛ i he nyɛ yi wami.
Jehanɛ se hu, i ka nyɛ ngɛ Meriba nyu ɔ he.
8Ye ma, nyɛɛ bu tue nɛ ma wo nyɛ ga.
Israel bi, i na nɛ nyɛ bu mi tue!
9 Nyɛ ko ha nɛ a na mawu kpahi ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti;
nyɛ ko ja ma se mawuhi.
10Imi ji Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ,
nɔ nɛ je nyɛ kɛ je Egipt zugba a nɔ ɔ nɛ.
Nyɛɛ pa nyɛ nya mi hatoo,
nɛ ma lɛ nyɛ.
11“Se ye ma a bui mi tue;
Israel bi ɔmɛ bui mi.
12Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, i ngmɛɛ a je mi he ngɔ ha mɛ,
konɛ a pee nɔ́ nɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a tsui suɔ.
13I na nɛ ye ma a bu mi tue;
i na nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ nyɛɛ ye se!
14Jinɛ i ba a he nyɛli ɔmɛ si momoomo;
jinɛ i kpata a hɛ mi kɛ.
15Jinɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ sume imi, Yawɛ ɔ,
a kpla si ngɛ ye hɛ mi, nɛ a ngɛ a
tue gblae kɛ yaa neneene.
16Se nyɛɛ lɛɛ ma lɛ nyɛ kɛ ngma kpakpa.
Ma ha nyɛ hwo babauu kɛ je tɛ sa mi
nɛ nyɛ maa ye.”

Title: LA 82
Content:
Mawu, matsɛ kpetekpleenyɛ
1Mawu daa si ngɛ hiɔwe gua nguaa a mi.
E ngɛ kojoli ɔmɛ a hɛ mi kae ke,
2“Kɛ yaa si mɛni be lɛ nyɛ maa hyɛ
nimli a hɛ mi kɛ kojo?
Kɛ yaa si mɛni be lɛ nyɛ ma fi nimli yayamihi a se?
3Nyɛɛ ye ohiatsɛmɛ, kɛ awusahi a sane ha mɛ.
Nyɛɛ tu munyu ha nɔ́ nali, kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ be nɔ́ ko.
4Nyɛ je ohiatsɛmɛ, kɛ nihi nɛ e fi mɛ ɔ
kɛ je nimli yayamihi a dɛ mi.
5“Nyɛ li nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko fɛɛ! Nyɛ be juɛmi!
Diblii mi kɛkɛ lɛ nyɛ ngɛ nyɛɛe.
Dami sane yemi se po ngɛ je ɔ mi.
6 I ke, ‘Mawuhi ji nyɛ;
nyɛ tsuo Hiɔwe No ɔ bimɛ ji nyɛ.’
7Se nyɛ ma gbo kaa bɔ nɛ nimili adesahi tsuo gboɔ ɔ.
Nyɛ wami se maa po
kaa bɔ nɛ ganɔhi hu a wami se poɔ ɔ.”
8Mawu, ba nɛ o ba kojo je ɔ,
ejakaa je ma amɛ tsuo o níhi ji mɛ.

Title: LA 83
Content:
Kue fami ngɛ ma a he hiami be mi
1Mawu, ko ma o nya;
koo pee dii, koo pee kɔ̃!
2Hyɛ, o he nyɛli ɔmɛ ngɛ basabasa pee;
nihi nɛ sume mo ɔ tsɔ o hɛ mi atuã.
3A ngɛ ga yaya toe kɛ ngɛ o ma a he woe;
nihi nɛ o ngɛ a he bue ɔ,
o he nyɛli ɔmɛ ngɛ a yi nɔ soe.
4A ngɛ dee ke,
“Nyɛ ha nɛ wa kpata ma a hɛ mi,
konɛ biɛ Israel ɔ, nɔ ko kó kai hu.”
5Ee, a pee kake kɛ wo o he;
mɛ tsuo a so kɛ wo o he:
6Edom bi, kɛ Ishmael bi;
Moab bi, kɛ Hagrit bi;
7Gebal bi, Amon bi, Amalek bi,
Filistia bi, kɛ Tiro bi.
8Asiria hu ba piɛ a he.
Lot bimɛ ɔmɛ a kɔni nguaa kake ji mɛ.
9 Pee mɛ kaa bɔ nɛ o pee Midian bi ɔmɛ.
Pee mɛ kaa bɔ nɛ o pee Sisera kɛ Yabin
ngɛ Kishon pa a nya a.
10O kpata a hɛ mi ngɛ Endor,
nɛ a gbogboe ɔmɛ sa ngɛ zugba.
11 Pee a we odehe ɔmɛ
kaa bɔ nɛ o pee Oreb kɛ Zeeb ɔ.
A ganɔ ɔmɛ hu, pee mɛ
kaa bɔ nɛ o pee Zeba kɛ Zalmuna a.
12Mɛ lɛ a de ke, “Nyɛ ha waa ngɔ
Mawu zugba a kɛ pee wa nɔ.”
13Ye Mawu, gbɛɛ mɛ ngɔ fĩa
kaa bunyuku nɛ lasiogblee muɔ kɛ bee,
aloo jakati nɛ kɔɔhiɔ sɛ mi.
14Kaa bɔ nɛ la sãã hue,
nɛ la lilɛ haa yokuhi sãã a,
15nyɛɛ a se ja nɔuu kɛ o we ahumi ɔ,
nɛ o ngɔ o kɔɔhiɔ nɛ nya wa a
kɛ wo a he gbeye.
16Yawɛ, ha nɛ zo nɛ gbe mɛ kpɔtɔɔ
kɛ yaa si a maa na o he wami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ.
17Ha nɛ a hɛ mi nɛ pue si
nɛ a ye gbeye daa.
Ha nɛ a hao, nɛ a hɛ mi nɛ kpata,
18konɛ a le kaa mo Yawɛ,
mo nɔ kake too lɛ o ngɛ he wami
pe nɔ tsuaa nɔ ngɛ je ɔ mi tsuo.

Title: LA 84
Content:
Mawu we ɔ
1Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ,
i suɔ o we ɔ saminya!
2I na nɛ i ba lejɛ ɔ!
Ye hɛ ngɛ jae ngɛ mo Yawɛ o we ɔ he.
Imi nɔmlɔ ɔ tsuo i ngɛ lae kɛ bua jɔmi
kɛ ngɛ Yawɛ yi jee.
3Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ, ye matsɛ, kɛ ye Mawu!
Otokliihi, kɛ mawubitɛtehi po maa tsu
ngɛ o bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ kasa nya,
nɛ a lɛɛ a bimɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.
4Nihi nɛ hii o we ɔ mi,
nɛ laa daa kɛ jeɔ o yi ɔ,
a gbaa mɛ.
5Nihi nɛ naa a he wami kɛ jeɔ o mi,
nɛ a hlaa kaa a maa hia blɔ
kɛ ya Zion yo ɔ nɔ ɔ, a gbaa mɛ.
6Ke a ya gu ya fomi kɔ̃ ɔ mi kɛ be
kɛkɛ lejɛ ɔ plɛ pee pa
nɛ gbiɛ nyu hyi lɛ tɔ.
7Pɔ tɔɛ mɛ; mohu ɔ, a naa he wami he,
nɛ a nyɛɛɔ kɛ ya suu Mawu hɛ mi tɔɔ ngɛ Zion.
8Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ Mawu,
bu ye kue fami ɔ tue!
Yakob Mawu, moo bu mi tue koo!
9Mawu, wa kpa mo pɛɛ nɛ o gbaa wa matsɛ ɔ,
nɔ nɛ mo nitsɛ o pɔ lɛ nu ɔ.
10Ligbi kake nɛ nɔ ko maa ye ngɛ o we ɔ
hi pe ligbi akpe nɛ e maa ye ngɛ he kpa ko.
Ma suɔ nɛ ma pee agbo nya bulɔ
ngɛ ye Mawu ɔ we ɔ mohu,
pe kaa ma hi yayami peeli a we mi.
11Yawɛ Mawu ji wa pu kɛ wa tsɛ̃i.
E naa wɔ mɔbɔ, nɛ e woɔ wa hɛ mi nyami.
Nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a,
e ha we nɛ nɔ́ ko hiaa mɛ.
12Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ lee,
nihi nɛ ngɔɔ a hɛ kɛ fɔɔ o nɔ ɔ,
a gbaa mɛ!

Title: LA 85
Content:
Kue fami kɛ ha ma a nɔ yami
1Yawɛ, o na wa zugba a mɔbɔ,
nɛ o ha nɛ Israel ná e he ekohu.
2O ngɔ o ma a tɔmi ɔmɛ,
kɛ a he yayami ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ pa mɛ.
3O mi mi la nɛ nya wa a se po,
nɛ o mi mi fu we wɔ hu.
4Mawu, wa yi wami helɔ,
kpale wɔ kɛ ba o ngɔ ekohu.
O mi mi ko fu wɔ hu!
5Anɛ o mi mi ma fu wɔ daa lo?
Anɛ o mi mi fumi ɔ ma tsa nɔ
kɛ ya yi nɔhi tsuo lo?
6Ha nɛ waa ba nɔ ekohu,
konɛ wɔ, o ma a, wa je o yi.
7Yawɛ, naa wɔ mɔbɔ
nɛ o he wa yi wami.
8Nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ Mawu ngɛ dee ɔ, i nu.
E ngɛ wɔ, e ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ dee ke
e ma ha wɔ tue mi jɔmi,
se wa ko kpale ya je kuasia hu.
9Niinɛ, Mawu pee klaalo kɛ ma he
nihi nɛ jaa lɛ ɔ a yi wami;
konɛ hɛ mi nyami nɛ hi wa zugba a mi.
10Mɔbɔ nami, kɛ anɔkuale kpe hɛ mi kɛ hɛ mi;
dami kɛ tue mi jɔmi fua a sibi atuu.
11Adesa we anɔkuale ɔ maa je zugba kɛ ya hiɔwe;
nɛ Mawu dami ɔ maa hyɛ zugba a
kɛ je hiɔwe.
12Niinɛ, Yawɛ ma ha wɔ ní kpakpahi,
nɛ wa zugba a maa ba ní bɔ nɛ sa.
13Dami maa nyɛɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi,
nɛ e ma dla blɔ ngɔ to lɛ.

Title: LA 86
Content:
Kue fami kɛ ha yemi kɛ buami
1Yawɛ, moo bu ye kue fami ɔ tue,
nɛ o pee ye hiami ní ɔmɛ ha mi;
ejakaa ye yi fi wawɛɛ nitsɛ.
2Mo he ye yi wami,
ejakaa i yeɔ mo anɔkuale.
Ye Mawu, mo he mi; ejakaa o tsɔlɔ ji mi,
nɛ i ngɔ ye hɛ kɛ fɔ o nɔ.
3Nyɔmtsɛ, naa mi mɔbɔ;
ejakaa mo lɛ i faa kue kɛ haa daa ligbi.
4Nyɔmtsɛ, ha nɛ o tsɔlɔ ɔ nɛ na bua jɔmi,
ejakaa mo lɛ i faa kue kɛ haa.
5Nyɔmtsɛ, o hi, nɛ o kɛ yayami paa nɔ.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ faa kue kɛ haa mo ɔ,
o naa lɛ mɔbɔ.
6Yawɛ, moo bu ye kue fami ɔ tue.
Pɛɛ nɛ i ngɛ mo kpae ɔ, moo nu ha mi koo!
7Ligbi ɔ nɛ e ma fi mi ɔ, ma tsɛ mo;
ejakaa i le kaa o maa pee ye hiami ní ɔmɛ ha mi.
8Nyɔmtsɛ, mawu ko mawu ko be nɛ kɛ mo sɔ;
níhi nɛ o pee ɔ hu,
nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko be nɛ a kɛ maa to a he.
9 Nyɔmtsɛ, je ma amɛ tsuo nɛ o bɔ ɔ
ma ba kpla si ngɛ o hɛ mi,
nɛ a ma je o he wami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ yi.
10Ejakaa o kle, nɛ o tsuɔ nyakpɛ níhi.
Mo nɔ kake too ji Mawu.
11Yawɛ, tsɔɔ mi nɔ́ nɛ o suɔ kaa ma pee,
nɛ ma ye mo anɔkuale sisiisi.
Ha nɛ ma ngɔ ye he wami tsuo kɛ sɔmɔ mo.
12Nyɔmtsɛ, ye Mawu, ma je o yi kɛ ye tsui tsuo,
nɛ o he wami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ,
ma wo ta daa.
13O na mi mɔbɔ be babauu;
gbeje tete po lɛ o je mi kɛ je.
14Mawu, he woli, yiwutsotsɛmɛ,
kɛ nihi nɛ li mo te si wo mi,
nɛ a ngɛ hlae nɛ a gbe mi.
15Se mo Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ,
Mawu mɔbɔ nalɔ, kɛ Mawu nɛ suɔ nɔ ji mo.
O toɔ o tsui si ha wɔ;
o dlooɔ nɔ, nɛ o yeɔ nɔ anɔkuale daa.
16Plɛ o hɛ mi ha mi, nɛ o na mi mɔbɔ.
Wo imi, o tsɔlɔ ɔ he wami, nɛ o kpɔ mi.
Ejakaa bɔ nɛ maa, o mawayo ɔ sɔmɔ mo ɔ,
jã kɛ̃ lɛ i ngɛ mo sɔmɔe ɔ nɛ.
17Yawɛ, tsɔɔ mi o mɔbɔ nami ɔ he okadi ko,
konɛ ye he nyɛli ɔmɛ nɛ a na, nɛ zo nɛ gbe mɛ
kaa o piɛ ye he, nɛ o jɔɔ ye bua.

Title: LA 87
Content:
Yerusalem yi jemi la
1Yawɛ to e ma a sisi
kɛ ma e yo klɔuklɔu ɔ nɔ.
2E suɔ Yerusalem pe hehi tsuo ngɛ Israel.
3Mawu ma, bu tue!
Yawɛ ngɛ ní kpakpahi dee ngɛ o he:
4“Ma tsɛ Egipt, kɛ Babilonia
kɛ piɛ ye huɛmɛ ɔmɛ a he.
Yerusalem ma mi bi ɔmɛ hu
ma tsɛ Filistia, Tiro, kɛ Sudan kɛ piɛ a he.”
5A ma tsɛ Zion ke je ma amɛ tsuo a nyɛ,
ejakaa Hiɔwe No ɔ nitsɛ maa to lɛ si.
6Yawɛ maa ngma ni ɔmɛ tsuo a biɛ,
nɛ a ma tsɛ mɛ ke Yerusalem ma a mi bi.
7A maa do, nɛ a ma la ke,
“Zion lɛ wa gbaami ɔmɛ tsuo jeɔ.”

Title: LA 88
Content:
Kue fami kɛ ha yemi kɛ buami
1Yawɛ Mawu, ye yi wami helɔ!
Nyɔ kɛ pia tsuo i foɔ ya ngɛ o hɛ mi.
2Moo bu ye kue fami ɔ tue koo,
nɛ o pee ye hiami ní ɔmɛ ha mi.
3Haomi babauu ba ye nɔ,
nɛ i kɛ gbenɔ he kɛ we saasaa.
4A bu mi ngɔ piɛ nihi tsuo
nɛ a miɔ nɛ a ma gbo ɔ a he.
Ye he wami ta.
5I pee kaa nɔ ko nɛ a hɛ lɛ ngɔ fɔ
ni gbogboehi a kpɛti,
nihi nɛ nɔ ta, nɛ a hwɔɔ si ngɛ yɔkɔ mi,
nihi nɛ o kaii we mɛ hu,
nɛ yemi kɛ buami ko be ha mɛ.
6O sake mi kɛ fɔ yɔkɔ ɔ mi
he nɛ kuɔ pe kulaa a.
O sake mi kɛ fɔ muɔ voo
kɛ e mi diblii kpii ɔ mi.
7O we abofu ɔ nya wa tsɔ ha mi;
e ngɛ kaa oslɔke nɛ ngɛ kue kɛ ngɛ
ye nɔ puee kpamisa.
8O ha nɛ ye huɛmɛ kua mi;
o ha nɛ ye he tsɛ̃ mɛ.
I pee kaa nɔ ko nɛ a sa e yi,
nɛ e li he nɛ e maa ya.
9Aywilɛho sɔuu ha nɛ ye hɛngmɛ nɔ ha.
Yawɛ, i tsɛɔ mo daa nɛ;
i woɔ ye nine nɔ, nɛ i faa kue
kɛ haa mo daa.
10Anɛ ni gbogboehi lɛ o peeɔ nyakpɛ ni kɛ haa lo?
Anɛ gbogboehi maa te si, nɛ a ma je o yi lo?
11O suɔmi nɛ be nyagbe ɔ,
anɛ yɔkɔ mi lɛ a maa wo nɔ ta ngɛ lo?
O we anɔkuale yemi ɔ, hɛ mi kpatami he ɔ a maa sɛɛ
ngɛ lo?
12O nyakpɛ ní ɔmɛ ɔ,
anɛ diblii mi lɛ a maa na ngɛ lo?
Zugba a, he nɛ nihi a hɛ jee níhi a nɔ ngɛ ɔ,
lejɛ ɔ lɛ a maa na o dami ɔ ngɛ lo?
13Se Yawɛ, imi lɛɛ mo i ngɛ tsɛe!
Daa mɔtu ɔ, i faa kue kɛ haa mo.
14Yawɛ, mɛni he je lɛ o kua mi?
Mɛni he je lɛ o ngɔ o hɛ mi kɛ laa mi?
15Kɛ je ye nihe mi hluu kɛ ba si piɔ ɔ,
amanehlu sɔuu lɛ i ngɛ nae,
nɛ i miɔ nɛ ma gbo.
O gbla ye tue nɛ ye he wami ta.
16O mi mi fu mi wawɛɛ nitsɛ;
o wo ye he gbeye hluu kɛ ya si
ye hɛ mi miɔ nɛ e ma kpata.
17Daa ligbi ɔ, gbeye níhi bɔle mi kɛ kpe
kaa pa nɛ hia kɛ bee;
a po klaangma kɛ wo ye he.
18O ha nɛ ye huɛmɛ kpakpahi tsuo kua mi,
nɛ diblii ba pee ye huɛ.

Title: LA 89
Content:
Ma a we amanehlu be la
1 Yawɛ, ma la daa kɛ tsɔɔ
kaa o suɔmi ɔ be nyagbe.
Ma sɛɛ ha yi nɔhi tsuo ke
anɔkuale yelɔ ji mo.
2I le kaa o suɔmi ɔ maa hi si daa.
O we anɔkuale yemi ɔ hu be nyagbe;
e ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene kaa bɔ nɛ hiɔwe ngɛ ɔ.
3O de ke, “I kɛ nɔ nɛ i hla lɛ ɔ
so somi ko.
I ka ye tsɔlɔ David kita ke,
4 ‘Ma ha nɛ o nina maa ye matsɛ daa;
o matsɛ yemi ɔ maa hi si kɛ maa ya neneene.’ ”
5Yawɛ, hiɔwe ma je nyakpɛ níhi
nɛ o ngɛ pee ɔ a yi;
a ma la kɛ je o yi kaa o yeɔ anɔkuale.
6Yawɛ, mɛnɔ lɛ ngɛ hiɔwe nɛ ngɛ kaa mo?
Hiɔwe nibɔ ní ɔmɛ te nɔ́ nɛ kɛ mo sɔ?
7A buu mo ngɛ ni klɔuklɔuhi a kpe ɔ mi;
mɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ a yeɔ mo gbeye.
8Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ Mawu!
Mɛnɔ lɛ ngɛ he wami kaa mo Yawɛ?
O yeɔ anɔkuale ngɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ mi.
9Ke wo gli, nɛ oslɔke ngɛ fiae ɔ,
mo lɛ o jɔɔ he.
10Rahab, wo mi lohwe ɔ nɛ he ngɛ gbeye ɔ,
mo lɛ o kpata e hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ.
O kɛ o he wami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ
ye o he nyɛli ɔmɛ a nɔ kunimi.
11O níhi ji hiɔwe ɔ kɛ zugba a tsuo;
mo lɛ o bɔ je ɔ kɛ e mi níhi tsuo.
12O bɔ omleyi je, kɛ leneyi je.
Tabor yo ɔ, kɛ Hermon yo ɔ ngɛ lae kɛ ngɛ o yi jee.
13He walɔ kpetekpleenyɛ ji mo;
o he wami ɔ kle!
14O matsɛ yemi ɔ, dami sane yemi nɔ
a to lɛ sisi kɛ fɔ.
Suɔmi kɛ anɔkuale yemi jeɔ kpo
ngɛ o nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ peemi mi.
15A gbaa nihi nɛ le bɔ nɛ a laa kɛ jaa mo.
Mo Yawɛ, o maa na mɛ mɔbɔ daa.
16Mo o he ɔ, a bua jɔɔ a he daa nɛ;
a jeɔ o yi, ejakaa o hi.
17Mo lɛ o haa nɛ a yeɔ kunimi nguahi.
Mo lɛ o naa wɔ mɔbɔ loko wa yeɔ manye.
18Yawɛ, mo lɛ o hla wa he falɔ ɔ kɛ ha wɔ;
mo, Israel Mawu klɔuklɔu ɔ, mo lɛ o ha wɔ wa matsɛ.
Mawu wo David si
19Be ko ɔ, o kɛ o tsɔli klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ
tu munyu ngɛ nina mi, nɛ o de mɛ ke,
“I fi katsɛ ko jlasi.
I ngɔ matsɛ sɛ ɔ kɛ ha nɔ ko
nɛ i hla kɛ je ma mi bi ɔmɛ a kpɛti.
20 I ngɔ ye nu klɔuklɔu ɔ kɛ pɔ
ye tsɔlɔ David, nɛ i wo lɛ matsɛ.
21Ye nine maa hi e he be tsuaa be,
nɛ ma wo lɛ he wami.
22E he nyɛli a nine be e nɔ sue;
yayami peeli be nyɛe maa ye e nɔ.
23Ma kpata e he nyɛli a hɛ mi;
ni nɛmɛ nɛ nyɛɔ lɛ ɔ, ma gbe mɛ tsuo.
24Ma suɔ lɛ, ma ye lɛ anɔkuale,
nɛ ma ha e maa ye kunimi daa.
25Ma ha nɛ e matsɛ yemi ɔ ma blɛke
kɛ je Mediterenia wo ɔ nya
kɛ ya su Yufrate pa a he.
26E ma tsɛ mi ke,
‘Tsaatsɛ, ye Mawu, ye he bulɔ, kɛ ye yi wami helɔ.’
27 Imi hu ma ngɔ lɛ kɛ pee ye bitɛte;
ma pee lɛ matsɛ nɛ kle
pe je nɛ ɔ mi matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsuo.
28Ma suɔ lɛ, nɛ ma na lɛ mɔbɔ daa;
somi nɛ i kɛ lɛ so ɔ se be poe gblegbleegble.
29E weku kpa se be poe gblegbleegble;
e maa hi kaa bɔ nɛ hiɔwe ngɛ ɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Daa nɛ ɔ, e nina ko maa hi sɛ ɔ nɔ.
30“Se ke e nina ya yi ye mlaa amɛ a nɔ,
nɛ́ a bɛ a je mi kaa bɔ nɛ i fa mɛ ke a pee ɔ,
31ke a kua ye blɔ nya tomi ɔmɛ,
nɛ a yi ye mlaa amɛ a nɔ ɔ
32lɛɛ ma gbla a tue ngɛ a yayami ɔmɛ a he,
nɛ ma ha a maa na nɔ́.
33Se kɛ̃ ɔ, suɔmi nɛ i ngɛ kɛ ha mɛ ɔ,
jamɛ a suɔmi ɔ be tae gblegbleegble;
si ko nɛ i wo David ɔ hu,
i be ye nya se kpalee.
34Somi ɔ nɛ i kɛ lɛ so ɔ, i be se jee;
si nɛ i wo lɛ ɔ, i be tsakee.
35“I kɛ ye biɛ klɔuklɔu ɔ wo si
kaa i be David lakpa yee gblegbleegble.
36E nina maa hi si kɛ maa ya neneene.
Ma bu e matsɛ yemi ɔ he
be abɔ nɛ pu ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ.
37E matsɛ yemi ɔ maa hi si daa
kaa nyɔhiɔ, jamɛ a anɔkuale odase ɔ nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ.”
Aywilɛho la, benɛ a ye matsɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ
38Se nɔ nɛ o pɔ lɛ nu ɔ, o mi mi fu lɛ;
o kua lɛ, nɛ o hɛ lɛ ngɔ fɔ he.
39Somi nɛ o kɛ o tsɔlɔ ɔ so ɔ, o je se;
o sake e matsɛ pɛɛ ɔ ngɔ fɔ zugba,
nɛ o ble lɛ.
40Gbogbo nɛ a fia kɛ wo ma a he ɔ,
o ku lɛ tsuo pue si,
nɛ mɔ ɔmɛ plɛ pee ní kokoehi.
41Nihi tsuo nɛ guu lejɛ ɔ, juɔ e níhi;
e plɛ pee muɔ nɔ́ ha e he nihi po.
42O ha nɛ e he nyɛli ɔmɛ ye kunimi,
nɛ mɛ tsuo a na bua jɔmi.
43Ee, o ha nɛ e ta hwumi ní ɔmɛ pee yaka,
nɛ e nyɛ we ta a nya nɛ e da.
44O he e hiɔ ɔ ngɛ e dɛ,
nɛ o sake e matsɛ sɛ ɔ ngɔ fɔ zugba.
45O po e nihe mi be ɔ nɔ kpiti,
nɛ o ha nɛ e hɛ mi pue si.
Kue fami
46Yawɛ, mɛni be o maa laa o he kɛ ya si?
O maa laa o he kɛ maa ya neneene lo?
O mi mi fumi nɛ ngɛ kaa la nɛ ngɛ tsoe ɔ,
mɛni be lɛ e se maa po?
47Mo kai kaa ye wami be ɔ ngɛ kuku.
Mɛni he je lɛ o bɔ nɔmlɔ adesa yaka gu ɔ?
48Te nɔmlɔ nɛ ngɛ je mi, nɛ lɛɛ e be gboe?
Mɛnɔ ma nyɛ ma je e he kɛ je gbenɔ dɛ mi?
49Nyɔmtsɛ, suɔmi nɛ o je kpo blema a,
jije jamɛ a suɔmi ɔ ngɛ?
Níhi nɛ o wo David si ke o maa pee ɔ,
jije ní ɔmɛ ngɛ?
50Nyɔmtsɛ, ahlua nɛ a ngɛ o tsɔli ɔmɛ bɔe ɔ,
o hɛ ko je nɔ.
Jɛmihi tsuo nɛ a ngɛ mi jɛe ɔ,
i ma ye nya ngɔ to nɔ.
51Yawɛ, nɔmlɔ nɛ o pɔ lɛ nu ɔ,
hyɛ kaa o he nyɛli ɔmɛ ngɛ lɛ ahlua bɔe!
He tsuaa he nɛ e gu, kɛkɛ jɛmi nyɛɛ e se.
52A je Yawɛ yi daa.
Amen! Amen!

Title: LA 90
Content:
WOMI EYWIƐNE
(La 90—106)
Mawu kɛ adesa
1Nyɔmtsɛ, mo ji wa wesa he
ngɛ yi nɔhi tsuo a mi.
2Benɛ o na we nɛ o bɔ yo ɔmɛ;
benɛ o na we nɛ o bɔ je ɔ,
mo ji Mawu nɛ ngɛ
kɛ je neneene kɛ yaa si neneene.
3O deɔ adesa ke, “Kpale kɛ ya o je he!”
Kɛkɛ ɔ, nɔmlɔ plɛɔ peeɔ tabo zu.
4 Moo lɛɛ jeha akpe ngɛ kaa ligbi kake ha mo;
e ngɛ kaa hiɛmɛ a je hiɛ nɛ be momo,
aloo be bɔɔ kɛkɛ ngɛ nyɔ mi.
5O ngɔɔ wɔ kɛ yaa
kaa bɔ nɛ pa muɔɔ níhi kɛ yaa a;
wa wami be ɔ tsuo ngɛ kaa mahe nɛ a hwɔ.
Wa ngɛ kaa hu nɛ puɛɔ flɔflɔɔflɔ mɔtu.
6Mɔtu ɔ, e blɛkeɔ saminyayoo,
se gbɔkuɛ ɔ, e nglaa, nɛ e gboɔ.
7O mi mi la a kpataa wa hɛ mi;
o mi mi la a woɔ wa he gbeye.
8O ngɔ wa he yayami ɔmɛ ngɔ pue o hɛ mi;
wa diblii mi yayami ɔmɛ tsuo ngɛ o hɛ mi paa.
9Ke o mi mi fu wɔ ɔ,
o poɔ wa wami be ɔ nɔ kpiti
kaa a woɔ mumi.
10Wa wami be ɔ tsuo ji jeha nyingmi kpaago.
Ke wa ngɛ he wami ɔ, wa naa nyingmi kpaanyɔ,
se lɛ tsuo peeɔ haomi kɛ aywilɛho sɔuu.
Wa wami se poɔ tlukaa; nɛ wa bee kɛ yaa
kaa lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ nɛ te kɛ bee.
11Mɛnɔ lɛ le bɔ nɛ o mi mi fumi ɔ nya wa ha?
Bɔ nɛ o he ngɛ gbeye ɔ,
ja lɛ o mi mi fumi ɔ ngɛ.
12Ha nɛ waa na kaa wa wami se kɛ we kulaa,
konɛ waa le ní.
13Mɛni be o mi mi fumi ɔ se maa po?
Yawɛ, naa wɔ, o tsɔli ɔmɛ mɔbɔ!
14Naa wɔ mɔbɔ daa mɔtu,
konɛ wa na bua jɔmi wa wami be ɔ tsuo.
15Bɔ nɛ o ha nɛ wa na amanehlu wawɛɛ
jeha komɛ nɛ be ɔ,
ha nɛ wa na bua jɔmi, nɛ wa nya ja nɔuu
ngɛ be nɛ wa ngɛ mi nɛ ɔ mi.
16Ha nɛ wɔ, o tsɔli ɔmɛ, waa na o ní tsumi ɔmɛ.
Ha nɛ wa bimɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a na
o he wami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ.
17Nyɔmtsɛ, wa Mawu, naa wɔ mɔbɔ!
Ha nɛ wa ní tsumi nɛ ya nɔ!
Ee, ha nɛ wa ní tsumi nɛ ya nɔ!

Title: LA 91
Content:
Mawu ji wa he bulɔ
1Nɔ nɛ hii Hiɔwe No ɔ laami he ɔ,
Ope ɔ nitsɛ maa baa e yi.
2E ma de Yawɛ ke,
“Mo ji ye wesa he, kɛ ye he bulɔ.
Mo ji ye Mawu; i ngɔ ye hɛ kɛ fɔ o nɔ.”
3E ma je mo kɛ je klamahi
nɛ a tsɔ mo ɔ tsuo mi.
E ma je mo kɛ je gbenɔ hiɔ hu mi ja nɔuu.
4E maa bu o he, nɛ o yi ma na wami
kaa lohwe pɛlitsɛ bi ngɛ e nyɛ pɛli sisi.
Si nɛ e wo ke e maa ye mo anɔkuale ɔ
maa pee kaa tsɛ̃i, kɛ dama nɛ ma fa o he.
5O be nyɔ mi ní yayamihi,
loo piani oslaa kaa kɛ̃ɛ̃ mi bi kikɛ nɛ ɔ
gbeye yee.
6Gbenɔ hiɔ nɛ puɛɔ ní ngɛ diblii mi ɔ,
o be lɛ gbeye yee.
Piani hu o be hiɔ nɛ kpataa nɔ hɛ mi gbeye yee.
7Nimli akpe ma gbo ngɛ o kasa nya;
akpe nyɔngma ma gbo kɛ bɔle mo kɛ kpe,
se moo lɛɛ nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko be o he sae.
8O hɛngmɛ kɛkɛ lɛ o kɛ maa hyɛ
bɔ nɛ a maa gbla yayami peeli a tue ha.
9Akɛnɛ o ngɔ Yawɛ, Hiɔwe No ɔ
kɛ pee o he bulɔ, kɛ o wesa he he je ɔ,
10nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko be o he sae;
o we ɔ mi hu, haomi ko be lejɛ ɔ bae.
11 Mawu ma ha nɛ e bɔfo ɔmɛ
maa bu o he ngɛ he tsuaa he nɛ o maa ya.
12 A maa hɛɛ mo ngɛ kɔɔhiɔ mi,
bɔ nɛ pee nɛ o ko tɛ nɔ.
13 O maa naa jata, kɛ sanga nɔ;
o maa naa jata bi kɛ sinɔ nɔ.
14Bɔ nɛ Mawu ngɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ:
“Nɔ nɛ suɔ mi, nɛ e le ye biɛ Yawɛ ɔ,
ma he e yi wami, nɛ ma bu e he.
15Ke e tsɛ mi ɔ, ma he nɔ;
ke haomi ba e nɔ ɔ, ma piɛ e he.
Ma je lɛ, nɛ ma wo e hɛ mi nyami.
16Kpakpa nɛ ma pee lɛ ji,
ma ha nɛ e wami se maa kɛ,
nɛ ma he e yi wami.”

Title: LA 92
Content:
Yi jemi la kɛ ha Hejɔɔmi ligbi
1Yawɛ, e hi kaa a na mo si.
E hi kaa a la kɛ je
mo, Hiɔwe No ɔ o yi.
2Daa mɔtu ɔ, á tu o suɔmi nɛ ngɛ daa a he munyu;
daa nyɔ mi hu, á fiɛ kaa o yeɔ anɔkuale.
3A fia kpa saku, kɛ saku kpahi
nɛ a la kɛ to he.
4Yawɛ, o ní tsumi ɔmɛ haa mi bua jɔmi;
Ma la kɛ bua jɔmi
ngɛ o nine nya ní tsumi ɔmɛ a he.
5Yawɛ, bɔ nɛ o ní tsumi ɔmɛ kle ɔ,
ja nɔuu o juɛmi hu mi kuɔ.
6Nɔ nɛ biɛ be enɛ ɔ lee;
kuasia hu be sisi nue.
7Yiwutsotsɛmɛ maa bɔ flɔflɔɔflɔ kaa nga;
yayami peeli ma plɔke, nɛ a ma na a he,
se nyagbe ɔ, a hɛ mi ma kpata kɛ̃.
8Se mo Yawɛ, moo lɛɛ o maa ye tsɛ daa.
9Hyɛ, mo Yawɛ, o he nyɛli ɔmɛ
tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ a hɛ mi ma kpata.
A maa gbɛ yiwutsotsɛmɛ tsuo ngɔ fĩa.
10O ha nɛ i na he wami
kaa pu mi na.
O gbaa mi kɛ bua jɔmi babauu.
11Ye he nyɛli ɔmɛ a hɛ mi kpata,
nɛ i na kɛ ye hɛngmɛ.
I nu hulɔ kɛ ye tue
kaa nihi nɛ te si wo mi ɔ nɔ si.
12Dali ma plɔke kaa tã;
a maa wa kaa seda tso ngɛ Lebanon.
13A ngɛ kaa tsohi nɛ a du ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ,
tsohi nɛ bɔ ngɛ wa Mawu ɔ kue ɔmɛ a mi.
14A ngɛ kaa tsohi nɛ woɔ yiblii
ngɛ a bwɔmi be mi tete po,
tsohi nɛ ngɛ flɔflɔɔflɔ,
nɛ́ nyu tɛ a mi gblegbleegble.
15Enɛ ɔ tsɔɔ kaa Yawɛ da.
Nɔ nɛ buɔ ye he ɔ, yayami ko be e he.

Title: LA 93
LA 94
Content:
Mawu ji adesahi tsuo a kojolɔ
1Yawɛ, mo Mawu nɛ o yeɔ lue,
mo je o he kpo koo!
2Mo je ɔ tsuo kojolɔ, tee si
nɛ o wo he nɔ woli hiɔ bɔ nɛ sa mɛ.
3Yawɛ, kɛ yaa si mɛni be lɛ
yayami peeli maa hi nyae?
A maa hi mle yee
kɛ yaa si mɛni be?
4Yayami peeli maa hi munyu tue puu kɛkɛ,
nɛ a maa hi fĩae kɛ yaa si mɛni be?
5Yawɛ, a ngɛ o ma a yi mi wae.
Mo nitsɛ o nihi nɛ o suɔ ɔ,
a ngɛ mɛ awi yee.
6A ngɛ yalɔyihi, kɛ awusahi gbee;
nibwɔhi nɛ ngɛ wa zugba a nɔ hu,
a ngɛ a muɔ si puee ja nɔuu.
7Nɔ́ nɛ a deɔ ji,
“Oo, Yawɛ tsa nɛ wɔ!
Israel Mawu ɔ hyɛ we!”
8Ye ma, mɛni he je lɛ nyɛ biɛ kikɛ nɛ ɔ?
Kuasiahi, mɛni be nyɛ maa le nɔ́?
9Nɔ nɛ pee wa tue ɔmɛ ɔ, e nui nɔ́ lo?
Nɔ nɛ pee hɛngmɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, e hyɛ we nɔ́ lo?
10Nɔ nɛ tsɔseɔ je ma amɛ ɔ,
anɛ e be a tue gblae lo?
Nɔ nɛ tsɔɔ adesahi tsuo ní ɔ,
anɛ e be juɛmi lo?
11 Yawɛ le bɔ nɛ adesa susuɔ e yi mi.
E le kaa nɔmlɔ juɛmi sui he ko kulaa.
12Yawɛ, nɔmlɔ nɛ o tsɔseɔ lɛ,
nɛ o tsɔɔ lɛ o mlaa a,
a gbaa lɛ.
13Haomi be mi tete po, o haa lɛ he jɔmi
hluu kɛ ya siɔ be nɛ o tsuaa muɔ
ha yayami peelɔ nɛ e ba nɔ mi.
14Yawɛ be e ma a he ngmɛɛe kɔkɔɔkɔ;
nihi nɛ e je blɔ hla mɛ ɔ, e be mɛ kuae.
15A maa ye dami sane ngɛ kojomi he ɔmɛ ekohu;
nɛ dali tsuo ma nya he.
16Mɛnɔ maa piɛ ye he
nɛ waa te si kɛ wo yiwutsotsɛmɛ?
Mɛnɔ maa piɛ ye he,
nɛ waa kɛ yayami peeli ya to ní?
17Ke pi Yawɛ nɛ piɛ ye he ɔ,
jinɛ be nɛ ɔ mi i su gbeje momo.
18Benɛ i de ke, “I miɔ nɛ ma sane nɔ si ɔ,”
mo Yawɛ, o suɔmi nɛ be nyagbe ɔ
wo ye nɔ.
19Ke yi mi susumi tsɔ
ha nɛ i pee basaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ,
mo lɛ o haa mi bua jɔmi,
nɛ ye nɔ gbagba tee ekohu.
20Kojoli nɛ yi dami sane,
kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ woɔ mlaa yaya a,
anɛ o kɛ mɛ maa bɔ lo?
21A soɔ dali a yi nɔ,
nɛ nihi nɛ pee we nɔ́ ko ɔ,
a buu mɛ gbenɔ fɔ.
22Se Yawɛ faa ye he;
ee, ye Mawu ɔ buu ye he.
23Yawɛ ma ha nɛ a ní yayami ɔmɛ
ma bu mɛ nitsɛmɛ a nɔ.
E ma kpata a hɛ mi ngɛ a yayami ɔmɛ a he;
Yawɛ, wa Mawu ɔ ma kpata a hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ.

Title: LA 95
Content:
Yi jemi la
1Nyɛɛ ba nɛ wa la kɛ je Yawɛ yi;
nyɛ ha nɛ wa he ose kɛ ha Mawu,
nɔ nɛ buu wa he ɔ.
2Nyɛ ha nɛ waa ba e hɛ mi kɛ sina,
nɛ wa he ose, nɛ wa la yi jemi lahi.
3Ejakaa Yawɛ ɔ, Mawu kpetekpleenyɛ ji lɛ;
lɛ ji mawu ɔmɛ tsuo a matsɛ nguaa.
4E yeɔ je ɔ tsuo nɔ,
kɛ je je ɔ sisi he nɛ kuɔ pe kulaa
kɛ ya siɔ yohi a yi mi piɔpiɔɔpiɔ.
5E níhi ji wo ɔ, kɛ zugba a tsuo;
ejakaa lɛ nitsɛ lɛ e pee mɛ.
6Nyɛɛ ba nɛ waa ngɔ wa hɛ mi kɛ bu si,
nɛ wa ja lɛ.
Nyɛ ha nɛ wa kpla si
ngɛ Yawɛ, wa bɔlɔ ɔ nane nya.
7 Ejakaa wa Mawu ji lɛ!
Wɔ ji e ma a nɛ;
lɛ nɛ hyɛɛ wa nɔ;
wa ngɛ kaa tohi nɛ e ngɛ tsɔe.
Mwɔnɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ bu e gbi ɔ tue:
8 “Nyɛ ko kplii nyɛ tsui
kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ pee ligbi ko
ngɛ Masa nga a nɔ ngɛ Meriba a.
9Nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ na níhi nɛ i pee ha mɛ.
Se kɛ̃ a tsɔ̃ ye nya, nɛ a ka mi ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.
10I ná yi nɔ bi nɛ ɔmɛ a he abofu
jeha nyingmi eywiɛ sɔuu.
I de ke, ‘Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ je ye se;
a kua ye mlaa amɛ a nɔ yemi’
11 Ye mi mi wo la, nɛ i ka kita ke,
‘He nɛ i to nɛ a ya jɔɔ a he ngɛ ɔ,
ke a nane ma lejɛ ɔ fii!’ ”

Title: LA 96
Content:
Mawu, matsɛ kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ
(Kronika I, 16.23-33)
1Nyɛ la la he ha Yawɛ!
Nyɛ je ɔ tsuo, nyɛ la ha Yawɛ!
2Nyɛ la ha Yawɛ; nyɛ je e yi!
Nyɛɛ fiɛ sane kpakpa a daa ligbi
ke Yawɛ he wa yi wami.
3Nyɛɛ fiɛ nɛ je ma amɛ tsuo nɛ a nu
kaa Yawɛ hɛ mi ngɛ nyami,
kaa e tsuɔ ní nguanguahi.
4Yawɛ kle agbo;
e sa nɛ a je e yi wawɛɛ nitsɛ.
E sa nɛ a wo e hɛ mi nyami
pe mawu ɔmɛ tsuo.
5Je ma kpa amɛ a mawu ɔmɛ ɔ,
amagahi kɛkɛ ji mɛ.
Yawɛ lɛɛ lɛ nɛ e bɔ hiɔwe.
6Hɛ mi nyami kɛ agboje bɔle lɛ kɛ kpe;
he wami, kɛ afɛu ní hyi e we ɔ.
7 Nyɛ je ma amɛ tsuo, nyɛ je Yawɛ yi.
Nyɛ je e hɛ mi nyami, kɛ e he wami ɔ yi.
8Nyɛ je Yawɛ biɛ klɔuklɔu ɔ yi;
nyɛɛ ngɔ nike ní kɛ ba e we ɔ.
9Nyɛɛ pee klɔuklɔu nɛ nyɛ ja Yawɛ;
nyɛ je ɔ tsuo, nyɛ he nɛ do blibliibli ngɛ e hɛ mi.
10Nyɛ de je ma amɛ tsuo ke,
“Yawɛ ngɛ matsɛ yee!
A ngɔ je ɔ ngɔ ma si ngɛ e hi he,
nɛ nɔ ko be nyɛe ma mimiɛ lɛ.
E maa kojo je ma amɛ ngɛ dami nya.”
11Hiɔwe, kɛ zugba, nyɛ nya!
Wo, kɛ o mi níhi tsuo, nyɛɛ wo gbi.
12Ngmɔhi, kɛ nyɛ a nɔ níhi tsuo, nyɛ nya!
Pu mi tsohi tsuo ma hwɔ lele
13ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi, ejakaa e ma!
Ee, Yawɛ ma nɛ e ba kojo je ɔ.
Yawɛ maa kojo je ɔ
ngɛ dami kɛ anɔkuale nya.

Title: LA 97
Content:
Mawu, ma nɔ yelɔ kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ
1Yawɛ ngɛ matsɛ yee!
Mo je, mo nya koo!
Nyɛ zugbahi tsuo nɛ wo bɔle nyɛ,
nyɛ bua nɛ jɔ, nɛ nyɛ nya!
2Bɔku kɛ diblii kpii bɔle lɛ kɛ kpe.
Matsɛ ji lɛ;
anɔkuale, kɛ dami sane e yeɔ.
3La jeɔ ngɛ e hɛ mi,
nɛ e sãã e he nyɛli nɛ bɔle lɛ ɔ.
4E we oslabai ɔ haa nɛ je mi tsɔɔ.
Je ɔ naa, nɛ e hosoɔ.
5Yohi sileɔ kaa wo gbaku
ngɛ Yawɛ, je ɔ tsuo Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ hɛ mi.
6Hiɔwe ngɛ fiɛe kɛ ngɛ dee ke,
“Yawɛ ɔ, dalɔ ji lɛ!”
Je ma amɛ tsuo na e hɛ mi nyami ɔ.
7Amaga jali, kɛ nihi tsuo
nɛ fĩaa kɛ fɔɔ yakayaka wɔhi a nɔ,
nyɛ hɛ mi pue si pɛ!
Nyɛ mawuhi tsuo,
nyɛ kpla si ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi.
8Mawu, Zion ma mi bi ɔmɛ,
kɛ Yuda ma amɛ nu o dami sane yemi ɔ he,
nɛ a bua jɔ a he, nɛ a nya.
9Yawɛ, je ɔ tsuo nɔ yelɔ ji mo;
o kle; mawu ko mawu ko kɛ mo sɔɛ.
10Yawɛ suɔ nihi tsuo nɛ hiee yayami.
E baa e ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ a yi,
nɛ e jeɔ mɛ kɛ jeɔ yiwutsotsɛmɛ a dɛ mi.
11La kpɛɔ kɛ haa dali;
nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a, a naa bua jɔmi.
12Nyɛ dali, nyɛ bua nɛ jɔ nyɛ he
ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ pee ɔ he.
Nyɛ kai nɔ́ nɛ Mawu klɔuklɔu ɔ pee ha nyɛ ɔ
nɛ nyɛɛ na lɛ si.

Title: LA 98
Content:
Mawu ji je ɔ nɔ yelɔ
1Nyɛ la la he ha Yawɛ,
ejakaa e pee nyakpɛ níhi.
E ngɔ lɛ nitsɛ e he wami kpetekpleenyɛ nɛ ngɛ klɔuklɔu ɔ
kɛ ye kunimi ha e he.
2Yawɛ je e he kpo
kaa Mawu nɛ heɔ nɔ yi wami.
E ha nɛ je ma amɛ le faii
kaa dami sane yelɔ ji lɛ.
3Si ko nɛ e wo Israel ma a, e ye nɔ;
e ye mɛ anɔkuale, nɛ e na mɛ mɔbɔ babauu.
Nihi ngɛ je ɔ mi he tsuaa he
na kaa wa Mawu ɔ ye kunimi.
4Je ɔ tsuo, nyɛ hwɔ lele kɛ ha Yawɛ.
Nyɛ he ose, nɛ nyɛ la kɛ bua jɔmi
kɛ je e yi.
5Nyɛ la, nɛ nyɛɛ fia kpa saku kɛ to he
nɛ nyɛ kɛ je Yawɛ yi.
6Nyɛ kpa titimati, kɛ koli,
nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ bua jɔmi hwɔ lele
kɛ ha Yawɛ, wa matsɛ ɔ.
7Wo, kɛ o mi níhi tsuo, nyɛɛ wo gbi!
Je ɔ, kɛ níhi tsuo nɛ ngɛ mi, nyɛ la!
8Nyɛ pahi, nyɛɛ fia nyɛ dɛ!
Nyɛ yokuhi tsuo, nyɛ nya ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi,
9ejakaa e ma nɛ e ba kojo je ɔ.
Yawɛ maa kojo je ɔ
ngɛ dami, kɛ anɔkuale nya.

Title: LA 99
Content:
Mawu, matsɛ kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ
1 Yawɛ ngɛ matsɛ yee;
je ma amɛ a he ngɛ doe blibliibli.
E hii si ngɛ e sɛ ɔ nɔ
ngɛ kerub ɔmɛ a nɔ,
nɛ zugba ngɛ mimiɛe.
2Yawɛ he biɛ ngɛ Zion wawɛɛ nitsɛ;
e kle pe je ma amɛ tsuo.
3Nihi tsuo ma je e biɛ kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ yi;
a ma je e biɛ nɛ he ngɛ gbeye ɔ yi.
E ngɛ klɔuklɔu!
4Matsɛ kpetekpleenyɛ, mo nɛ o suɔ nɔ́ nɛ da!
O to anɔkuale, kɛ dami sane yemi si
ngɛ Israel.
5Nyɛ je Yawɛ, wa Mawu ɔ yi!
Nyɛ kpla si ngɛ e matsɛ sɛ ɔ hɛ mi
nɛ nyɛ ja lɛ.
Mawu klɔuklɔu ji lɛ!
6E we osɔfohi ji Mose, kɛ Aaron.
Nihi nɛ fa kue ha lɛ ɔ, Samuel piɛ a he.
Mɛ tsuo a fa kue ha lɛ,
nɛ e bu mɛ tue.
7 E kɛ mɛ tu munyu ngɛ bɔku titima mi.
A ye mlaahi nɛ e wo mɛ,
kɛ famihi nɛ e fa mɛ ɔ tsuo nɔ.
8Yawɛ, wa Mawu!
O ma a fa kue ha mo, nɛ o bu mɛ tue.
O kɛ mɛ hi si kaa Mawu
nɛ ngɔɔ a he yayami kɛ paa mɛ;
se ke a tɔ̃ ɔ, o gblaa a tue kɛ̃.
9Nyɛ je Yawɛ, wa Mawu ɔ yi;
nyɛ ja lɛ ngɛ e yo klɔuklɔu ɔ nɔ.
Yawɛ, wa Mawu ɔ ngɛ klɔuklɔu.

Title: LA 100
LA 101
Content:
Matsɛ siwo
1Yawɛ, ma la kɛ je o yi
kɛ tsɔɔ kaa mɔbɔ nalɔ, kɛ dami sane yelɔ ji mo.
2Ma ba ye je mi saminya,
konɛ a ko na piami ko ngɛ ye he.
Mɛni be po lɛ o maa ba ye ngɔ?
Ma hi si ngɛ mumi mi he tsɔmi mi
ngɛ ye we ɔ mi.
3I be yi wu tso níhi a he susue.
Nihi nɛ kua Mawu ɔ,
i kɛ mɛ be bɔe.
A ní peemi níhi muɛ ye hɛ.
4I be amimi yee,
nɛ i kɛ yayami peeli hu be bɔe.
5Nɔ nɛ gbeɔ e nyɛmi he guɛ
ngɛ laami mi ɔ, ma kpata e hɛ mi.
Nɔ nɛ ngɛ gegeege, nɛ e woɔ e he nɔ ɔ,
i kɛ lɛ be bɔe.
6Nihi nɛ yeɔ Mawu anɔkuale ɔ,
ma ná a he bua jɔmi,
nɛ i kɛ mɛ maa hi si.
Ni nɛmɛ nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a,
mɛ lɛ a ma sɔmɔ mi.
7Nɔ sisilɔ ko be ye we mi hie;
lakpatsɛ ko hu be ye hɛ mi bae.
8I kɛ yayami peeli be bɔe kɔkɔɔkɔ
kɛ yaa si ma fie mɛ tsuo
kɛ je Yawɛ ma a mi.

Title: LA 102
Content:
Niheyo nɔ́ nalɔ ko kue fami
1Yawɛ, i ngɛ mo tsɛe nɛ o ba piɛ ye he.
Moo bu ye kue fami ɔ tue koo!
2Ke i ngɛ haomi mi ɔ, koo je ye he.
Ke i tsɛ mo ɔ, he nɔ esɔ,
nɛ o pee ye hiami ní ɔmɛ ha mi.
3Ye wami ligbi ɔmɛ ngɛ bee kaa la su ku,
nɛ ye nɔmlɔ tso ɔ dɔ la hɛii kaa flɔɔnɔɔ ɔ mi.
4I pee kaa nga gbigbli nɛ a gbee nɔ,
nɛ niye ní pa jlo we mi hu.
5Daa nɛ ɔ, kɛmɛmi kɛkɛ lɛ i ngɛ kɛmɛe.
Enɛ ɔ ha nɛ ye wuhi tsuo je kpo,
nɛ i pee kanyakanya.
6I pee kaa okpoku ngɛ nga nɔ,
loo klomi ngɛ we doku mi.
7I hwɔ we mahe; i pee kaa ohwe pɛlitsɛ
kake too nɛ maa si
ngɛ tsu yi mi.
8Daa ligbi ɔ, jɛmi kɛkɛ
ye he nyɛli hii mi jɛe.
Ni nɛmɛ nɛ yeɔ ye he fɛu ɔ
ngɔɔ ye biɛ kɛ gbiɛɛ ni kpahi.
9Ye niye ní ɔ, la zu sɔuu;
nɔ nɛ i nuɔ ɔ, vo nyu futu mi,
10ejakaa o mi mi fu mi wawɛɛ nitsɛ.
O wo ye nɔ, nɛ o sake mi kɛ fɔ he.
11Ye wami ligbi ɔmɛ ngɛ kaa hɔhɔmi
nɛ bee kɛ yaa.
I pee kaa nga gbigbli.
12Se mo Yawɛ, moo lɛɛ matsɛ ji mo kɛ yaa neneene;
yi nɔhi tsuo ma kai mo.
13O maa te si, nɛ o maa na Zion mɔbɔ.
Be ɔ su nɛ o maa na lɛ mɔbɔ;
be ɔ nɛ a to ɔ su.
14Ejakaa o tsɔli ɔmɛ suɔ Zion tɛ ɔmɛ;
nɛ lejɛ ɔ zu ɔ po, a mi mi sãã mɛ ngɛ he.
15Je ma amɛ tsuo maa ye Yawɛ gbeye.
Zugba a nɔ matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsuo
maa ye e hɛ mi nyami ɔ gbeye.
16Yawɛ kpale ma Zion ekohu;
e ma je e he wami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ kɛ tsɔɔ.
17E maa bu e nihi nɛ e kua mɛ ɔ
a kue fami ɔ tue,
nɛ e maa pee a hiami ní ɔmɛ ha mɛ.
18A maa ngma nɔ́ nɛ ɔ kɛ to
ha yi nɔ bi nɛ maa ba ngɛ se,
konɛ nihi nɛ a na we nɛ a fɔ mɛ lolo ɔ
nɛ a ba je Yawɛ yi.
19Yawɛ hyɛ zugba a kɛ je
e he klɔuklɔu ɔ ngɛ tsitsaa lokoo.
E hyɛ zugba a kɛ je hiɔwe,
20konɛ e nu pamitsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a kɛmɛmi ɔ he,
nɛ nihi nɛ a bu mɛ gbenɔ fɔ ɔ,
e ha nɛ a ye a he.
21Kɛkɛ ɔ, a maa wo Yawɛ biɛ ta
ngɛ Zion; a ma je e yi ngɛ Yerusalem.
22Jamɛ a be ɔ, je ma amɛ,
kɛ matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ma ba bua a he nya
nɛ a ma ja Yawɛ.
23Yawɛ ha nɛ i gbɔjɔ
be mi nɛ i ngɛ he wami mi kɛ mwɔɔ.
E po ye wami be ɔ nɔ kpiti.
24Ye Mawu, mo nɛ o ngɛ daa!
Koo ngɔ mi kɛ ho amlɔ nɛ ɔ,
be mi nɛ i wɛ lolo.
25 Blema lokoo nɛ o bɔ je ɔ;
mo nitsɛ o nine o kɛ pee hiɔwe ɔ.
26Ní nɛ ɔmɛ a hɛ mi ma kpata;
se moo lɛɛ o ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene.
Ee, mɛ tsuo a ma ba pee momo
kaa bɔ nɛ bo he ba peeɔ bo momo ɔ.
O ma sake mɛ kɛ fɔ he
kaa bɔ nɛ a sakeɔ bo momo kɛ fɔɔ he ɔ.
Nɛ a maa laa kulaa.
27Se moo lɛɛ, bɔ nɛ o ngɛ ɔ,
ja ko lɛ o ngɛ.
O wami be ɔ be nyagbe.
28Wɔ, o tsɔli ɔmɛ,
wa bimɛ ɔmɛ a yi ma na wami,
nɛ a nina kɛ mo maa hi si ngɛ he jɔmi mi.

Title: LA 103
Content:
Mawu suɔmi
1Ma je Yawɛ yi!
Ma je e biɛ klɔuklɔu ɔ yi kɛ ye tsui tsuo.
2Ma je Yawɛ yi!
Ní kpakpahi nɛ e peeɔ ha mi ɔ,
ye hɛ be nɔ jee gblegbleegble.
3E kɛ ye he yayamihi tsuo paa mi,
nɛ e tsaa ye he hiɔhi tsuo.
4E heɔ ye yi wami,
konɛ ye hɛ mi ko kpata.
E jeɔ e suɔmi ɔ kpo kɛ tsɔɔ mi,
nɛ e naa mi mɔbɔ daa.
5E haa mi ní kpakpahi babauu,
nɛ daa nɛ ɔ, i naa he wami he
kaa kɔle.
6Nihi tsuo nɛ a yeɔ mɛ amimi ɔ,
Yawɛ yeɔ a sane kɛ haa mɛ.
7E tsɔɔ Mose e blɔ ɔmɛ,
nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ hu na
ní nguanguahi nɛ e pee ɔ.
8 Yawɛ naa mɔbɔ; e mi mi hi.
E muklii mi fu we mla,
se e mɔbɔ nami ɔ mohu hiɛ babauu.
9E hɛɛ we pɛ munyu kake mi kpamisa.
Ke e mi mi fu ɔ, e kɛ we kulaa
kɛkɛ e tsui he jɔ ekohu.
10E gbla we wa tue bɔ nɛ sa wɔ;
wa yayami ɔmɛ hu
e wui wɔ a he hiɔ bɔ nɛ sa wɔ.
11Se mohu ɔ, nihi nɛ yeɔ lɛ gbeye ɔ,
e naa mɛ mɔbɔ babauu nɛ hi kalemi
kaa bɔ nɛ hiɔwe kɛ zugba
a kpɛti blɔ ɔ hí kalemi ɔ.
12E jeɔ wa he yayami ɔmɛ kɛ yaa tsitsaa lokoo
kaa bɔ nɛ beleku kɛ bonyoku
a kpɛti blɔ ɔ kɛ ɔ.
13Bɔ nɛ tsɛ mi mi sãã lɛ ngɛ e bimɛ a he ɔ,
ja lɛ Yawɛ hu mi mi sãã lɛ
ngɛ nihi nɛ yeɔ lɛ gbeye ɔ a he.
14Ejakaa e le wa bɔ su;
e le kaa zu kɛkɛ ji wɔ.
15Nɔmlɔ adesa ngɛ kaa nga pɛ;
e bɔɔ saminyayoo kaa nga nɔ mɔmɔ.
16Ke kɔɔhiɔ fia kɛ be ngɛ lejɛ ɔ,
kɛkɛ e hɛ mi kpata
nɛ nɔ ko pa li lɛ hu.
17Se Yawɛ suɔmi nɛ be nyagbe ɔ
ngɛ kɛ ha nihi nɛ yeɔ lɛ gbeye.
A weku kɛ nina hu
Yawɛ maa pee mɛ kpakpa daa,
18kɛ jehanɛ hu nihi tsuo nɛ yeɔ e somi ɔ nɔ,
kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ yeɔ e mlaa amɛ a nɔ sisiisi ɔ.
19Yawɛ ngɔ e matsɛ sɛ ɔ
kɛ ma si ngɛ hiɔwe,
nɛ e ngɛ tsɛ yee ngɛ je ɔ tsuo nɔ.
20Nyɛ, Yawɛ Mawu bɔfohi,
nyɛ katsɛmɛ nɛ nyɛ buɔ lɛ,
nɛ nyɛ yaa tsɔmi ha lɛ;
nyɛ je Yawɛ yi!
21Nyɛ, Yawɛ tabo ɔ tsuo,
nyɛ, e sɔmɔli tsuo
nɛ nyɛ peeɔ e suɔmi nya ní,
nyɛ je Yawɛ yi!
22Nyɛ, Yawɛ nibɔ níhi
ngɛ hehi nɛ e ngɛ tsɛ yee ngɛ ɔ tsuo,
nyɛ je Yawɛ yi!
Imi nitsɛ hu ma je Yawɛ yi!

Title: LA 104
Content:
A je bɔlɔ ɔ yi
1Ma je Yawɛ yi!
Yawɛ ye Mawu, o kle!
O hɛ mi nyami, kɛ o he wami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ
ngɛ kaa bo nɛ o kɛ ha o he.
2O ngɔ la kɛ ha o he kaa bo;
o blɛke hiɔwe mi kaa bo tsu.
3O ma o we ɔ ngɔ fɔ
nyu nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ nɔ.
O ngɔ bɔku kɛ pee o lɛ,
nɛ kɔɔhiɔ mi o nyɛɛɔ.
4 O ngɔ kɔɔhiɔ kɛ pee o tsɔlɔ,
nɛ oslabai la a pee o sɔmɔlɔ.
5O ngɔ je ɔ ngɔ ma
e sisi tomi ɔ nɔ kpɛii,
nɛ a be jee ngɛ lejɛ ɔ gblegbleegble.
6O ngɔ nyu kɛ ha je ɔ he kaa bo;
nyu ha yo ɔmɛ a yi mi tsuo.
7Benɛ o wo gbi, nɛ hiɔwe si ɔ,
a he sɔ kɛ je lejɛ ɔ.
8Nyu ɔ hia kɛ be ngɛ yo ɔmɛ a nɔ
kɛ ya pue kɔ̃ ɔmɛ a mi
he nɛ o to ha mɛ ɔ.
9O to huzu ha nyu ɔ nɛ e ko be he,
konɛ e ko kpale ba ha je ɔ nɔ hu.
10O haa nɛ pahi hiaa ngɛ kɔ̃hi a mi,
nɛ a mi nyu ɔ ya guu yohi a kpɛ.
11Pu mi lohwehi tsuo náa nyu nɛ a nuɔ.
Nga mi tejihi nuɔ nyu hluu
kɛ ya siɔ kuma yi mɛ hu.
12Lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ peeɔ a tsuhi
ngɛ tso kɔnihi a nɔ ngɛ pa tue,
nɛ a hii lae ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.
13O haa nɛ nyu nɛɛ kɛ jeɔ hiɔwe
kɛ pueɔ yo ɔmɛ a nɔ;
nɛ je ɔ mi hyi tɔ kɛ o gbaami sɔuu.
14O haa nɛ nga puɛɔ ha lohwehi;
o haa nɔmlɔ adesa tsohi nɛ e du,
konɛ e ná niye ní kɛ je zu mi.
15O haa lɛ dã nɛ ma ha lɛ bua jɔmi,
nu nɛ ma ha nɛ e he womi nɔ ma tsɔ,
kɛ niye ní nɛ maa wo lɛ he wami.
16Lebanon seda tso ɔmɛ naa nyu babaaba.
Yawɛ nitsɛ e tsohi nɛ e du
ji lɔ ɔmɛ nɛ.
17Lejɛ ɔ lɛ lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ peeɔ a tsuhi ngɛ;
sɛsɛo ɔ mi lɛ aklawa peeɔ e tsu ngɛ.
18Yo gaga amɛ a nɔ lɛ pu mi apletsihi hiɔ;
nyu mi kpihi lɛɛ a hi he ji tɛ sahi a kpɛ.
19O pee nyɔhiɔ, nɛ o kɛ tsɔɔ be slɔɔtohi;
pu hu le be nɛ e kɛ nɔɔ si.
20O haa nɛ je jɔɔ, kɛkɛ ke diblii wo ɔ,
pu mi lohwehi tsuo jeɔ kpo.
21Jata bimɛ huãã nɛ a daa de
ke a ngɛ niye ní hlae
kɛ je mo Mawu o dɛ mi.
22Ke pu te si ɔ, a kpaleɔ a se
ya buɔ si ngɛ a laami he ɔmɛ.
23Kɛkɛ ɔ, nimlihi jeɔ kpo kɛ yaa
a ní tsumi hehi ya tsuɔ ní
kɛ ya siɔ gbɔkuɛ.
24Yawɛ, hyɛ kaa o pee níhi babauu!
Nile o kɛ pee lɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ.
O nibɔ níhi hyi je ɔ mi tɔ.
25Wo ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ; e kle nɛ e bli,
kɛ e mi lohwe nguanguahi kɛ wawi
nɛ a be nyɛe maa kane.
26 Lɛ ɔmɛ ji nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ wo ɔ nɔ.
Nɛ wo nɛ ɔ mi nɛ lohwe kɛ e he gbeyegbeye
nɛ o bɔ ɔ fiɛɔ ngɛ.
27Ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo hyɛɛ mo blɔ
kaa o ma ha mɛ a niye ní
ngɛ be nɛ sa mi.
28Ke o ha mɛ niye ní ɔ, a yeɔ;
o lɛɔ mɛ nɛ a tɔɔ kɛ ní kpakpahi sɔuu.
29Ke o kua mɛ ɔ, a haoɔ.
Ke o ngɔ a mumi ɔ, a gboɔ
nɛ a kpaleɔ kɛ yaa zu mi he nɛ a je ɔ.
30O ngɔɔ o mumi ngɔ woɔ a mi, nɛ a peeɔ nibɔ níhi.
Kɛkɛ o haa je ɔ peeɔ ehe ekohu.
31Yawɛ hɛ mi nyami ɔ maa hi si daa!
Níhi nɛ Yawɛ pee ɔ,
e ma na a he bua jɔmi.
32Ke Yawɛ hyɛ je ɔ,
kɛkɛ je ɔ mimiɛ.
Ke e ta yo ɔmɛ a he
kɛkɛ a je la su ku.
33Ma la kɛ je Yawɛ yi
ye wami be ɔ tsuo.
Be mi nɛ i ngɛ je mi kɛ mwɔɔ ɔ,
ma la kɛ je ye Mawu ɔ yi.
34Susumi kpakpa nɛ i ngɛ ngɛ e he ɔ,
i na nɛ lɛ tsuo sa e hɛ mi,
ejakaa lɛ ji nɔ nɛ haa mi bua jɔmi.
35Yayami peeli tsuo a hɛ mi nɛ kpata,
konɛ yiwutsotsɛmɛ ko hi je ɔ mi hu.
Ma je Yawɛ yi.
Ee, nyɛ je Yawɛ yi.

Title: LA 105
Content:
Mawu kɛ e ma a
(Kronika I, 16.8-22)
1Nyɛɛ na Yawɛ si;
nyɛɛ wo e biɛ ta;
nyɛ ha je ma amɛ nɛ a le
e ní peemi ní ɔmɛ.
2Nyɛ la kɛ je Yawɛ yi,
nyɛɛ sɛɛ nyakpɛ níhi nɛ e pee ɔ.
3Nyɛ ha nɛ wa bua nɛ jɔ wa he
kaa Yawɛ níhi ji wɔ;
nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ jaa lɛ ɔ, e nya!
4Nyɛ hla Yawɛ se blɔ,
konɛ e ha nyɛ he wami;
nyɛ ja lɛ daa.
5-6Nyɛ, Mawu tsɔlɔ Abraham nina!
Yakob nina, nyɛ nɛ Mawu hla!
Nyɛ kai nyakpɛ níhi nɛ Mawu pee,
kɛ bɔ nɛ e kojo je ma amɛ.
7Yawɛ ji wa Mawu;
e woɔ e mlaa kɛ haa je ɔ tsuo.
8E kaiɔ e somi ɔ daa.
Si ko nɛ e wo ɔ, e yeɔ nɔ
yi nɔhi tsuo.
9 Somi nɛ e kɛ Abraham so ɔ, e kaiɔ;
kita nɛ e ka Isak hu e maa ye nɔ.
10 Yawɛ kɛ Yakob so,
nɛ somi nɛ ɔ ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene.
11E ke, “Ma ngɔ Kanaan zugba a kɛ ha mo,
nɛ zugba a ma ba pee o weto ní.”
12Jamɛ a be ɔ, Israel bi ɔmɛ a he pi;
a be blɔ nya ko kulaa,
nɛ nibwɔhi ji mɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ.
13A nyɛɛɔ kɛ jeɔ ma kake mi
kɛ yaa ma kake mi.
A woɔ lalaalo kɛ jeɔ nɔ yemi he kake
kɛ yaa nɔ yemi he kake.
14 Se Mawu ngmɛ́ blɔ nɛ nɔ ko nɛ hao mɛ;
a he ɔ, e je blɔ de matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ke,
15“Ye nihi nɛ i pɔ mɛ nu ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ;
nyɛ ko ye mɛ awi!
Ye gbali ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ, nyɛ ko ta a he.”
16 Jehanɛ, Yawɛ ha nɛ hwɔ ba zugba a nɔ,
nɛ Kanaan bi ɔmɛ a niye ní tsuo ta.
17 Se e tsɔ nɔ ko kɛ nyɛɛ a hɛ mi momo;
lɛ ji Yosef nɛ a jua lɛ kaa nyɔguɛ ɔ.
18 A wo e nane kɔsɔkɔsɔ,
nɛ a kɛ e kuɛ wo dade pã mi
19kɛ ya si nɔ́ nɛ e de to ɔ ba mi.
Yawɛ munyu ɔ wo lɛ nguɔ.
20 Kɛkɛ nɛ Egipt matsɛ ɔ tsɔ nɛ a ya je lɛ;
je ma amɛ a nɔ yelɔ ɔ ha e ye e he.
21 Matsɛ ɔ pee lɛ nɔkɔtɔma ngɛ e we ɔ,
kɛ e nɔ yemi he ɔ tsuo nɔ yelɔ,
22konɛ e tsɔse e ganɔ ɔmɛ bɔ nɛ sa,
nɛ e tsɔɔ e ma nimeli ɔmɛ nile.
23 Kɛkɛ nɛ Yakob pue nɔ kɛ ho Egipt ya
ya to nubwɔ ngɛ jamɛ a zugba a nɔ.
24 Yawɛ ha nɛ e ma a bɔ,
nɛ a he hiɛ babauu.
E ha a he hu wa kulaa pe a he nyɛli ɔmɛ.
25E puɛ Egipt bi ɔmɛ a juɛmi ngɛ Israel he;
a nyɛ mɛ, nɛ a pee mɛ nisɛ níhi.
26 Kɛkɛ nɛ e tsɔ e tsɔlɔ Mose,
kɛ Aaron nɛ e hla mɛ ɔ.
27Mawu ha nɛ a pee okadihi,
kɛ nyakpɛ níhi ngɛ Egipt zugba a nɔ.
28 Mawu ha nɛ diblii wo ngɛ zugba a nɔ.
Se nɔ́ nɛ e fa Egipt bi ɔmɛ
ke a pee ɔ, a bui fɛɛ.
29 E ha nɛ a pa amɛ tsuo plɛ pee muɔ,
nɛ a mi lo ɔmɛ tsuo gbo.
30 Ovɔnɔhi babauu ba zugba a nɔ;
matsɛ we ɔ mi pohu ovɔnɔhi hyi lejɛ ɔ tɔtɔɔtɔ.
31 Mawu tu munyu, nɛ pwɔlwɔɛ munomunohi babauu
ba zugba a tsuo nɔ.
32 E ha nɛ gbiɛ ngo ngu nɛ ngɛ hiɔmi nane mi,
nɛ oslabai gba ngɛ zugba a nɔ tsuo.
33E kpata wai tsohi, ngmɔkɔ tsohi,
kɛ tso kpahi tsuo a hɛ mi
ngɛ zugba a nɔ.
34 E tu munyu, nɛ baalɛhi ba babauu,
baalɛ nguahi kɛ wawi nɛ hí kanemi.
35Baalɛ ɔmɛ ye ngmɔ si níhi,
kɛ ba mumu tsuo ngɛ zugba a nɔ.
36 Jehanɛ, e gbe bitɛtehi
nɛ ji Egipt nyumuhi a kekleekle ngmɛduhi
tsuo ngɛ zugba a nɔ.
37 Kɛkɛ nɛ e kpaka Israel bi ɔmɛ kɛ je;
nɔ tsuaa nɔ hɛɛ sika hiɔ, kɛ sika tsu.
Nɔ ko nɔ ko be a kpɛti nɛ ji hiɔtsɛ;
mɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ a ngɛ kpakpataa.
38Benɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ je ɔ,
Egipt bi ɔmɛ na bua jɔmi wawɛɛ nitsɛ;
ejakaa a ye Israel bi ɔmɛ gbeye.
39 Mawu ha nɛ bɔku ba ha Israel bi ɔmɛ a he;
e ha mɛ la, nɛ a kɛ hyɛ nɔ́ nyɔ mi.
40 A bi lɛ niye ní, nɛ e ha mɛ hɔne.
E ha mɛ niye ní kɛ je hiɔwe,
nɛ a ye nɛ a tɔ.
41 E bli tɛ sa nya, nɛ nyu je mi pue si;
nyu ɔ be lalaala ngɛ nga a nɔ kaa pa.
42E kai e tsɔlɔ Abraham, kɛ si nɛ e wo lɛ ɔ.
43Kɛkɛ nɛ e kpaka e ma nɛ e hla a kɛ je;
a la, nɛ a hwɔ lele.
44 Mawu ngɔ ma je li ɔmɛ a zugba a kɛ ha mɛ;
nɛ nɔ́ nɛ ni kpahi gbo he dengme ɔ
ba plɛ pee a nɔ́.
45E pee enɛ ɔ, konɛ a kai
e mlaa amɛ, nɛ a ye nɔ.
A je Yawɛ yi!

Title: LA 106
Content:
Yawɛ hi
1 Nyɛ je Yawɛ yi!
Nyɛɛ na Yawɛ si, ejakaa e hi;
e naa mɔbɔ kɛ yaa neneene!
2Ní nguanguahi tsuo nɛ Yawɛ pee ɔ,
mɛnɔ ma nyɛ ma de?
Mɛnɔ ma nyɛ ma je e yi bɔ nɛ sa?
3A gbaa nihi nɛ yeɔ dami sane,
nɛ a peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da be tsuaa be.
4Yawɛ, ke o ngɛ o ma a mɔbɔ nae ɔ,
mo kai imi hulɔ;
ke o ngɛ a yi wami hee ɔ,
ngɔɔ imi hu ngɔ piɛ a he.
5Ha nɛ ma na bɔ nɛ
o ma mi bi ɔmɛ a he mi jɔ mɛ ha,
konɛ bua jɔmi nɛ ba ma a mi ɔ,
imi hu ma piɛ a he kɛ nya.
6Wa pee yayami kaa wa nɛmɛ ɔmɛ nɔuu.
Wa pee níhi nɛ sɛ; wa wa nihi yi mi.
7 Nyakpɛ níhi nɛ Hiɔwe No ɔ pee ngɛ Egipt ɔ,
wa nɛmɛ ɔmɛ nui sisi.
Suɔmi babauu nɛ e je kpo kɛ tsɔɔ mɛ ɔ,
a kaii we.
Mohu ɔ, a te si wo lɛ
ngɛ Wo Tsu ɔ nya.
8Se kɛ̃ ɔ, e he a yi wami
kaa bɔ nɛ e wo si ɔ;
nɛ e kɛ tsɔɔ e he wami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ.
9 E nga Wo Tsu ɔ yi, nɛ nyu ɔ mii,
nɛ e kɛ mɛ nyɛɛ kɛ be
kaa nɔ́ nɛ nga nɔ lɛ a ngɛ nyɛɛe.
10E kpɔ mɛ ngɛ nihi nɛ nyɛɛ mɛ ɔ a dɛ mi;
e je mɛ kɛ je a he nyɛli ɔmɛ a dɛ mi.
11Se nyu ɔ ba ha a he nyɛli ɔmɛ a nɔ,
nɛ a ti nɔ kake ngmelu po ji mi.
12 Kɛkɛ nɛ e ma a he e munyu ɔmɛ ye,
nɛ a la kɛ je e yi.
13Se e kɛ we kulaa nɛ a hɛ je
níhi tsuo nɛ e pee ha mɛ ɔ nɔ;
nɛ a bui e ga womi tue hu.
14 A ya di jiklɔɔ níhi a se ngɛ nga a nɔ;
a pee enɛ ɔ kɛ ka Mawu.
15Mawu ha mɛ níhi nɛ a bi lɛ ɔ tsuo;
se e ngɔ hiɔ nɛ haa nɛ nɔ flaa
kɛ gbla a tue.
16 Ngɛ nga a nɔ ɔ, ni ɔmɛ a hɛ kɔ̃ Mose nɔ,
kɛ jehanɛ Aaron, Yawɛ tsɔlɔ klɔuklɔu ɔ.
17Kɛkɛ nɛ zugba a gba, nɛ e mii Datan;
e mii Abiram, kɛ nihi nɛ piɛ e he ɔ hulɔ.
18La je ngɛ ni ɔmɛ a kpɛti,
nɛ e sã yiwutsotsɛmɛ ɔmɛ.
19 A pee na bi ngɛ Horeb,
nɛ a sɔmɔ jamɛ a amaga a nɛ a puɛ ɔ.
20A ngɔ amaga nɛ a pee kaa na nɛ yeɔ nga a
kɛ tsake Mawu nitsɛ hɛ mi nyami ɔ.
21Mawu, a kpɔlɔ ɔ nɛ tsu ní tsumi
nguanguahi ngɛ Egipt ɔ,
a hɛ je e nɔ.
22Hyɛ nyakpɛ níhi nɛ e tsu ngɛ lejɛ ɔ!
Hyɛ ní nguanguahi nɛ e pee ngɛ Wo Tsu ɔ nya!
23Benɛ Mawu de ke e ma kpata
e ma a hɛ mi ɔ,
e tsɔlɔ Mose nɛ e hla a
nɛ da mi ha ma a.
Mose lɛ jɔɔ Mawu abofu ɔ he,
loko e kpataa we ma a hɛ mi ɔ nɛ.
24 Wa nɛmɛ ɔmɛ tu we zugba saminyayoo ɔ he munyu kpakpa,
ejakaa si nɛ Mawu wo mɛ ɔ, a he we yi.
25A tu munyu huitihuiti
ngɛ a bo tsu ɔmɛ a mi;
nɛ a bui Yawɛ tue.
26Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, e wo e nine nɔ
nɛ e ka mɛ kita kaa
e ma kpata a hɛ mi ngɛ nga a nɔ,
27 nɛ e ma ha a nina maa gbɛ ngɔ fĩa
je ma amɛ a mi ngɛ je ɔ mi tsuo.
28 Jehanɛ, Mawu ma a ya piɛ je ma amɛ a he
nɛ a kɛ mɛ ja Baal nɛ ngɛ Peor ɔ.
Bɔhi nɛ a sã ha a ni gbogboe ɔmɛ hu
a kɛ mɛ ye.
29A kɛ a ní peemi ní ɔmɛ wo Yawɛ
mi mi la, nɛ gbenɔ hiɔ ba sɛ a kpɛti.
30Se Finehas te si, nɛ e gbla
yayami peeli ɔmɛ a tue,
kɛkɛ nɛ gbenɔ hiɔ ɔ se po.
31Kɛ je jamɛ a be ɔ,
a kaiɔ nɔ́ kpakpa nɛ e pee nɛ ɔ;
nɛ a maa ya nɔ ma kai daa.
32 Ma a wo Yawɛ mi mi la
ngɛ Meriba pa a nya.
A kɛ Mose wo haomi mi
ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ a pee ɔ he.
33Mose mi mi fu ma a wawɛɛ nitsɛ,
nɛ e tu munyu basabasa.
34 A kpataa we je ma amɛ a hɛ mi
kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa mɛ ke a pee ɔ.
35Mohu ɔ, a ya futu je ma amɛ,
nɛ a kase a ní peemi ní ɔmɛ.
36A sɔmɔ a we amaga amɛ,
nɛ enɛ ɔ ha nɛ a kpa Mawu se nyɛɛmi.
37 A kɛ a binyumuhi, kɛ a biyihi sã bɔ ha wɔhi.
38 A pue nihi nɛ pee we yayami a muɔ si;
mɛ nitsɛmɛ a binyumuhi, kɛ a biyihi po
a ngɔ mɛ kɛ sã bɔ ha Kanaan wɔhi;
nɛ a kɛ muɔ ble zugba a.
39A kɛ a ní peemi ble mɛ nitsɛmɛ a he,
nɛ Mawu hu a yi lɛ anɔkuale.
40 Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, Yawɛ mi mi fu
lɛ nitsɛ e ma a, nɛ e kua mɛ.
41E ngɔ mɛ ngɔ wo je mahi a dɛ mi;
nɛ a he nyɛli ɔmɛ ye a nɔ.
42A he nyɛli ɔmɛ ye a nɔ kɛ kɔni si wami;
a wa mɛ yi mi, nɛ a ha nɛ a sɔmɔ mɛ.
43Yawɛ je e ma a kɛ je
a haomihi a mi si abɔ.
Se pee se ɔ, a tsɔɔ e hɛ mi atuã
nɛ a ya peeɔ yayamihi nɛ pe kekle
ní ɔmɛ po.
44Se kɛ̃, benɛ e nu nɛ a ngɛ ngmlaa kpae ɔ
a ní pee lɛ mɔbɔ.
45E kai somi nɛ e kɛ mɛ so ɔ,
nɛ e suɔmi babauu ɔ he je ɔ,
e ngɔ a he kɛ ke mɛ.
46E ha nɛ a ní pee nihi tsuo
nɛ nuu mɛ nyɔguɛ ɔ mɔbɔ.
47 Yawɛ wa Mawu!
Mo kpɔ wɔ kɛ je je ma amɛ a dɛ mi,
nɛ o kpale wɔ kɛ ba ekohu,
konɛ waa na mo si,
nɛ wa je o biɛ klɔuklɔu ɔ yi.
48Nyɛ je Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ yi;
nyɛ je e yi kɛ je neneene kɛ ya neneene.
Nyɛ ha nɛ ma a tsuo nɛ de ke, “Amen!”
Nyɛ je Yawɛ yi.

Title: LA 107
Content:
WOMI ENUƆNE
(La 107—150)
A je Mawu yi, ejakaa e hi
1 “Nyɛɛ na Yawɛ si,
ejakaa e hi,
nɛ e suɔmi ɔ ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene!”
2Nyɛ nihi tsuo nɛ Yawɛ he nyɛ yi wami,
nɛ e kpɔ nyɛ kɛ je nyɛ he nyɛli a dɛ mi ɔ,
nyɛɛ hi enɛ ɔ dee kpamisa,
nɛ nyɛ kɛ je e yi.
3E ngɔ nyɛ kɛ je ma se kɛ ba
kɛ je beleku je, kɛ bonyoku je,
kɛ je omleyi je, kɛ leneyi je.
4Ni komɛ wo lalaalo ngɛ nga kplanaa nɔ;
a nɛ blɔ ko blɔ ko nɛ a kɛ ya ma a mi
nɛ a ya hi lejɛ ɔ.
5Hwɔ ye mɛ, nɛ kuma ye mɛ hluu
kɛ ya si a mumu nya ta.
6Kɛkɛ nɛ a kpa ngmlaa kɛ tsɛ Yawɛ,
nɛ e je mɛ kɛ je a haomi ɔ mi.
7E ngɔ mɛ kɛ gu blɔ tlɔmɔɔ nɔ hluu
kɛ ya su ma ko mi
he nɛ a maa hi.
8E sa kaa nimli nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a na Yawɛ si;
ejakaa e tsu nyakpɛ níhi ha mɛ;
e suɔmi ɔ ngɛ daa.
9Nihi nɛ kuma ye mɛ ɔ,
e ha mɛ nyu nɛ a nu;
ni nɛmɛ nɛ hwɔ ye mɛ ɔ,
e ha mɛ ní nɛ a ye nɛ a tɔ.
10Ni komɛ hi si ngɛ diblii, kɛ mɔbɔ si himi mi;
a wo mɛ tsu;
a kpla mɛ kɔsɔkɔsɔ,
nɛ a na nɔ́;
11ejakaa a tsɔ Hiɔwe No Mawu ɔ hɛ mi atuã,
nɛ a bui e munyu, kɛ e ga womi ɔmɛ fɛɛ.
12A tsu ní kpakpataa hluu kɛ ya si pɔ tɔ mɛ.
Ke a nɔ si ɔ, nɔ ko be nɛ woɔ a nɔ.
13Kɛkɛ nɛ a kpa ngmlaa kɛ tsɛ Yawɛ,
nɛ e je mɛ kɛ je a haomi ɔ mi.
14E je mɛ kɛ je diblii, kɛ mɔbɔ si himi ɔ mi,
nɛ e kplɔ kɔsɔkɔsɔ ɔmɛ
ngɛ a he ngɔ pue si.
15E sa kaa nimli nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a na Yawɛ si,
ejakaa e tsu nyakpɛ níhi ha mɛ;
e suɔmi ɔ ngɛ daa.
16E ku akɔblee agbo ɔmɛ,
nɛ e poo agbo se lami dade ɔmɛ a mi.
17Ni komɛ ya je kuasia, nɛ a blɔ yayami ɔmɛ,
kɛ yayamihi nɛ a pee ɔ ha nɛ a na nɔ́.
18Niye ní ko niye ní ko pee we mɛ akɔnɔ;
a su gbenɔ muɔ nya haa.
19Kɛkɛ nɛ a kpa ngmlaa kɛ tsɛ Yawɛ,
nɛ e je mɛ kɛ je a haomi ɔ mi.
20E ngɔ e munyu ɔ kɛ tsa mɛ.
E je mɛ kɛ je hɛ mi kpatami
nɛ ko ba a nɔ ɔ mi.
21E sa kaa nimli nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a na Yawɛ si,
ejakaa e tsu nyakpɛ níhi ha mɛ;
e suɔmi ɔ ngɛ daa.
22E sa kaa a sã bɔhi kɛ na lɛ si;
a kɛ bua jɔmi nɛ la nyami la
kɛ gba níhi nɛ e tsu ɔ.
23Nihi kɛ lɛ ye jua ngɛ wo hɛ mi,
nɛ a kɛ na a nya mi ngma.
24A na níhi nɛ Yawɛ tsu;
a na nyakpɛ níhi nɛ e tsu ngɛ wo ɔ nɔ ɔ.
25E fa nɛ ahumi fia,
nɛ wo oslɔkehi te si.
26Oslɔke ɔmɛ wo lɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ
kɛ ya hiɔwe kɛ ba si,
kɛ ya wo ɔ sisi tɔɔ.
Haomi nɛ ba a nɔ ngɛ lɛ ɔ mi ɔ
ha a kã nya ta.
27Nɛ e pee ja a, a ngɛ kpae, nɛ a ngɛ si tɛe
kaa dã deli,
nɛ a pa li bɔ nɛ a maa pee hu.
28Kɛkɛ nɛ a kpa ngmlaa kɛ tsɛ Yawɛ,
nɛ e je mɛ kɛ je a haomi ɔ mi.
29E tsi ahumi ɔ nya nɛ e kpa fiami;
oslɔke ɔmɛ a he jɔ, nɛ wo ɔ ngmɛ dii.
30Ni ɔmɛ a bua jɔ a he jehanɛ,
ejakaa nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nya ba si.
Yawɛ kɛ mɛ ba su lɛsimuɔ he ɔ
nɛ a yaa a fiafiaafia.
31E sa kaa nimli nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a na Yawɛ si,
ejakaa e tsu nyakpɛ níhi ha mɛ;
e suɔmi ɔ ngɛ daa.
32A je e yi; ma kpekpemi ɔ tsuo nɛ je e yi;
á je e yi ngɛ ma nimeli a kpe ɔ mi hulɔ.
33Yawɛ ha pahi mii kulaa,
nɛ nyu hɛngmɛhi tsi, nɛ a bɛ hu.
34Zugba nɛ baa ní saminya a
plɛ pee ngo zɔ zugba;
ejakaa nihi nɛ hi lejɛ ɔ,
yayami sɔuu a pee.
35Yawɛ ha nga kplanaa plɛ pee taku
kɛ e mi nyu babaaba;
nɛ zugba gbigbli plɛ pee he nɛ
nyu hɛngmɛhi hia si ngɛ.
36Ni nɛmɛ nɛ hwɔ ye mɛ ɔ,
e ha a to si ngɛ lejɛ ɔ;
nɛ a po ma, nɛ a hi lejɛ ɔ.
37A hu zugba a, nɛ a du wai yiblii ngɛ nɔ;
nɛ a kpa ní babauu.
38Yawɛ gbaa e ma a;
e ha nɛ a he ba hiɛ babauu nitsɛ;
a lohwehi hu e ha we nɛ a nɔ nɛ gbɔ́.
39Benɛ a he nyɛli ba ye Mawu ma a nɔ,
nɛ a wa mɛ yi mi,
nɛ a pee mɛ nisɛ ní babauu ɔ,
40Mawu hu kɛ a ganɔ ɔmɛ to ní saminya,
nɛ e ha nɛ a ya wo lalaalo ngɛ nga kplanaa nɔ
he nɛ blɔ ko blɔ ko be.
41Se nihi nɛ e fi mɛ ɔ,
e je mɛ kɛ je a haomihi a mi;
nɛ e ha a ngmɛdu he ba hiɛ babauu kaa tohi.
42Nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ nɛ da a naa nɔ́ nɛ ɔ,
nɛ a bua jɔɔ he;
se yayami peeli lɛɛ a maa a nya.
43Nɔ nɛ ji ní lelɔ ɔ, e susu ní nɛ ɔmɛ a he.
Nihi tsuo nɛ a susu
Yawɛ suɔmi nɛ ngɛ daa a he.

Title: LA 108
Content:
Mawu, jé mi kɛ je he nyɛli a dɛ mi
(La 57.7-11; 60.5-12)
1Mawu, i ngɔ ye hɛ kɛ fɔ mo pɛ o nɔ;
ma la kɛ je ye tsui mi kɛ je o yi.
2Makɛ mla a, ma te si
nɛ ma fia saku kɛ je o yi.
3Nyɔmtsɛ, ma na mo si ngɛ je ma amɛ a hɛ mi;
ma la kɛ je o yi ngɛ je ma amɛ a hɛ mi.
4Ejakaa o suɔmi nɛ ngɛ daa a kle kɛ su hiɔwe lokoo,
nɛ o we anɔkuale yemi ya su bɔku mi tɔɔ.
5Mawu, ha nɛ o he wami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ nɛ je kpo
ngɛ hiɔwe lokoo ɔ,
konɛ a na o hɛ mi nyami ɔ ngɛ je ɔ mi tsuo.
6Ngɔɔ o he wami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ kɛ he wa yi wami.
Bu wa kue fami ɔ tue,
ejakaa mo nitsɛ o ma nɛ o suɔ lɛ ji wɔ.
7Mawu de ngɛ e he klɔuklɔu ɔ ke,
“Ma hwɔ lele kɛ gba Shekem mi,
nɛ ma dla Sukot kɔ̃ ɔ mi kɛ ha ye ma a.
8Ye mahi ji Gilead kɛ Manase.
Efraim ji ye dade pɛɛ,
nɛ Yuda ji ye matsɛ tso.
9Moab ji ye hedu buɛ.
Ma sake ye tokota kɛ pue Edom nɔ
kɛ tsɔɔ kaa a ye e nɔ.
Ma he ose kɛ ye Filistia nɔ kunimi.”
10Mɛnɔ maa ngɔ mi kɛ ya
ma nɛ a fia gbogbo kɛ wo he ɔ mi?
Mɛnɔ ma ya sɛ mi Edom?
11Mawu, anɛ pi mo nɛ o kua wɔ ɔ lo?
Mawu, o kɛ wa tabo ɔ tsa yɛ ta!
12Piɛ wa he, konɛ waa kɛ he nyɛlɔ ɔ nɛ to ní.
Ejakaa nɔmlɔ adesa he wami pi nɔ́ ko!
13Nɛ́ Mawu kɛ wɔ ngɛ nɛ ɔ,
wa maa ye kunimi.
Lɛ ji nɔ nɛ maa ye wa he nyɛli ɔmɛ a nɔ ha wɔ.

Title: LA 109
Content:
Nɔ ko nɛ ngɛ haomi mi e kue fami
1Mawu, i ngɛ o yi jee;
koo pee dii.
2Yiwutsotsɛmɛ, kɛ lakpatsɛmɛ te si kɛ wo mi;
lakpa munyu sɔuu a ngɛ tue ngɛ ye he.
3A te si kɛ wo mi,
nɛ a ngɛ nɔ́ yayami dee ngɛ ye he kɛkɛ.
4I suɔ mɛ, nɛ i faa kue kɛ haa mɛ,
se mɛɛ lɛɛ a poɔ ye nya yaka gu.
5A ngɔɔ yayami kɛ toɔ kpakpa nɛ i peeɔ mɛ ɔ nane mi.
A nyɛɛ mi ngɛ suɔmi nɛ i suɔ mɛ ɔ nane mi.
6A deɔ ke, ha nɛ yiwutsotsɛ ko kɛ lɛ
nɛ to ní;
lɛ nitsɛ e he nyɛlɔ nɛ ya po e nya
ngɛ sane yemi he.
7Ke a kojo lɛ ɔ, ha nɛ a bu lɛ fɔ;
e kue fami ɔ hu, a bu kaa yayami.
8 E wami se ko kɛ;
e blɔ nya nɛ ba pee nɔ kpa nɔ́!
9E bimɛ nɛ a ye awusa,
nɛ́ e yo ba pee yalɔyo!
10E bimɛ nɛ a kpa si, nɛ a ba ní,
nɛ a we doku nɛ a ngɛ mi po,
a fie mɛ kɛ je lejɛ ɔ!
11E hiɔtsɛmɛ nɛ a ba kpɔ e níhi tsuo ngɛ e dɛ;
nɛ níhi tsuo nɛ e gbo dengme kɛ na a,
nibwɔhi nɛ a ba ha.
12Nɔ ko nɔ ko kó na lɛ mɔbɔ;
awusa bimɛ nɛ e ma si ɔ,
nɔ ko nɔ ko kó hyɛ a nɔ.
13E ngmɛdu hɛ mi nɛ kpata pɛsɛpɛsɛ;
nɛ yi nɔ nɛ maa nyɛɛ se ɔ ko le e biɛ tete po.
14Yawɛ mo kai yayamihi nɛ e nɛmɛ ɔmɛ pee ɔ,
nɛ e nyɛ he yayami po a ko ngɔ kɛ pa lɛ.
15Yawɛ nɛ kai a he yayami ɔmɛ daa nɛ,
se mɛ nitsɛmɛ lɛɛ a ko kai mɛ gblegbleegble
ngɛ zugba a nɔ.
16Jamɛ a nɔmlɔ ɔ nlɛ hyɛ kaa e maa na nɔ ko mɔbɔ,
se ohiatɛmɛ, dɛgutsɛmɛ, kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ
a ní ngɛ mɔbɔ ɔ,
e wa mɛ yi mi hluu kɛ ya si a gbenɔ mi po.
17E suɔ nɔ gbiɛmi,
lɛ hu á gbiɛ lɛ ja nɔuu.
E sume gbaami,
lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ ko nɔ ko kó gbaa lɛ.
18Gbiɛmi pee e he nɔ́ kaa tade nɛ e woɔ,
lɔ ɔ he ɔ, lɛ nitsɛ e gbiɛmi ɔ nɛ sɛ e nɔmlɔ tso ɔ
mi kaa nyu, kɛ e wuhi a mi kaa nu!
19Gbiɛmi nɛ pee kaa bo nɛ e kɛ haa e he,
kɛ mlɛ mi fimi nɔ́ nɛ e kɛ fii e mlɛ mi daa nɛ.
20Yawɛ, ye he nyɛli, kɛ nihi tsuo nɛ tuɔ munyu kɛ siɔ mi ɔ,
wo mɛ hiɔ kikɛ nɛ ɔ nɔuu.
21Se mo Yawɛ, ye Nyɔmtsɛ,
pee ha mi kaa bɔ nɛ o wo si ɔ;
he ye yi wami,
ejakaa o suɔmi ɔ hi, nɛ e ngɛ daa.
22Ohiatsɛ ji mi; ye ní ngɛ mɔbɔ,
nɛ ye tsui ngɛ mi yee ngɛ ye mi mi tɔɔ.
23I laa kulaa kaa bɔ nɛ nini laa gbɔkuɛ nya si;
a hu mi ngɔ fɔ he kaa a fieɔ baalɛ.
24I ha hwɔ hluu kɛ ya si ye nakutsohi a mi gbɔjɔ,
nɛ i ta he lo kanakana.
25 I pee ahlua bɔmi nɔ́ ha ye nya poli ɔmɛ.
Ke a na mi kikɛ nɛ ɔ,
a mimiɛɔ a yi kɛ yeɔ ye he fɛu.
26Yawɛ ye Mawu, ba piɛ ye he koo!
He ye yi wami
ngɛ o suɔmi nɛ ngɛ daa a he!
27Ha nɛ ye he nyɛli ɔmɛ nɛ a le
kaa nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, o nine ngɛ mi;
mo Yawɛ nitsɛ lɛ o tsu.
28Ye he nyɛli ɔmɛ nɛ a gbiɛ mi faa;
moo lɛɛ o maa gbaa mi sa.
Nihi nɛ te si kɛ wo mi ɔ,
zo nɛ gbe mɛ,
konɛ imi, o tsɔlɔ ɔ, ma na bua jɔmi.
29Zo nɛ gbe ye he nyɛli ɔmɛ kpɔtɔɔ.
Zo nɛ ha a he kaa bo.
30Ma pa ye nya mi ma la kɛ na Yawɛ si saminya.
Ma je e yi ngɛ ma kpekpemi ɔ hɛ mi.
31Ejakaa e yeɔ dɛgutsɛ sane ha lɛ.
Nihi nɛ buɔ dɛgutsɛ gbenɔ fɔ ɔ,
e jeɔ lɛ kɛ jee a dɛ mi.

Title: LA 110
Content:
Yawɛ kɛ matsɛ nɛ e hla a
1 Yawɛ de ye nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ke,
“Hii si ngɛ ye hiɔ nɔ
kɛ yaa si be nɛ ma ngɔ o he nyɛli ɔmɛ
kɛ pee nɔ́ nɛ o kɛ o nane maa nɔ.”
2Yawɛ ma ha mo he wami kpetekpleenyɛ
kɛ je Zion.
E ma de mo ke,
“Ye o he nyɛli ɔmɛ a nɔ.”
3Ligbi ɔ nɛ o maa hia ta kɛ wo o he nyɛli ɔmɛ ɔ,
o ma mi bi ɔmɛ maa ngɔ a he kɛ ha
ngɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a suɔmi nya.
Nihewi babauu ma ba pue si
ngɛ yo klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ a nɔ kaa makɛ bɔ́.
4 Yawɛ ka kita nɛ ɔ,
nɛ e be e nya se kpalee,
“Osɔfo ji mo kɛ yaa neneene
kaa Melkizedek pɛ.”
5Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ngɛ o hiɔ nɔ;
ligbi ɔ nɛ e mi mi maa wo la a,
e ma kpata matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a hɛ mi.
6E maa gbla je ma amɛ a tue;
nɛ ma amɛ a mi ma hyi tɔ
kɛ ni gbogboehi.
E ma kpata matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a hɛ mi
ngɛ je ɔ mi tsuo.
7Matsɛ ɔ maa nu pa nɛ ngɛ blɔ ɔ he ɔ mi nyu,
lɔ ɔ maa wo lɛ he wami, nɛ e maa ye kunimi.

Title: LA 111
Content:
A je Yawɛ yi
1A je Yawɛ yi!
Ma na Yawɛ si kɛ ye tsui tsuo
ngɛ nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ nɛ da a gua a mi.
2Yawɛ tsuɔ ní nguanguahi.
Nihi nɛ nyaa ní nɛ ɔmɛ a he ɔ
hlaa kaa a maa nu a sisi saminya.
3E tsuɔ ní kɛ hɛ mi nyami kɛ agboje.
E yeɔ dami sane daa.
4Yawɛ haa nɛ a kaiɔ
e nyakpɛ ní tsumi ɔmɛ.
E mi mi jɔ, nɛ e naa mɔbɔ.
5Nihi nɛ yeɔ lɛ gbeye ɔ, e lɛɔ mɛ.
E hɛ ngɛ e somi ɔ nɔ kɛ yaa neneene.
6E ngɔ ma je li a zugba a kɛ ha e ma a
kɛ tsɔɔ e ma a kaa e ngɛ he wami.
7E yeɔ anɔkuale kɛ dami sane
ngɛ níhi tsuo a mi;
nɛ e mlaa amɛ ɔ, anɔkuale sɔuu.
8Mlaa amɛ ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene;
anɔkuale kɛ dami mi a pee mɛ ngɛ.
9E ha e ma a ye a he,
nɛ e kɛ mɛ so somi nɛ ngɛ daa.
E he tsɔ, nɛ e he ngɛ gbeye!
10 Ke o ngɛ hlae nɛ o na nile ɔ,
ye Yawɛ gbeye.
Nihi tsuo nɛ peeɔ ja a, a nuɔ nɔ́ sisi saminya.
A je Yawɛ yi daa!

Title: LA 112
Content:
Bua jɔmi nɛ nɔmlɔ kpakpa naa
1A je Yawɛ yi!
A gbaa nɔ nɛ yeɔ Yawɛ gbeye,
nɛ e naa e mlaa amɛ a he bua jɔmi
saminya a.
2E nina maa pee ni nguanguahi
ngɛ zugba a nɔ.
Nɔ nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a,
a maa gbaa e ngmɛdu.
3E we ɔ maa pee niatsɛ we
he nɛ kplɔkɔtɔ ngɛ,
nɛ e maa bɔ kɛ maa ya neneene.
4La kpɛɔ ngɛ diblii mi kɛ haa nimli kpakpahi,
nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ nɛ da, nihi nɛ naa mɔbɔ,
kɛ nihi nɛ a mi mi jɔ.
5Nɔmlɔ nɛ e mi mi jɔ,
nɔ nɛ paa nɔ nɔ́,
nɛ e yeɔ anɔkuale ngɛ
e ní tsumi mi ɔ,
á gbaa lɛ.
6Nɔ nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a,
nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko be lɛ pee;
a ma kai lɛ daa.
7E yi sane yobu ko nɛ maa ba a gbeye;
nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko pue we e tsui nɔ,
ejakaa e ngɔ e hɛ kɛ fɔ Yawɛ nɔ.
8E yi tsui, nɛ e yi gbeye hulɔ.
E hɛ ngɛ nɔ kaa e maa ye e he nyɛli ɔmɛ
a nɔ kunimi kɛ̃.
9 E keɔ ohiatsɛmɛ ní kɛ jeɔ e tsui mi faa.
E naa mɔbɔ daa.
E hɛ mi maa ba nyami,
nɛ a maa bu lɛ.
10Ke yiwutsotsɛ na kikɛ nɛ ɔ,
e dɔɔ lɛ;
e kpeɔ e lungu nya,
nɛ e jeɔ lejɛ ɔ dii.
Yiwutsotsɛ yi mi tomi peeɔ yaka.

Title: LA 113
Content:
Mawu yi jemi la
1A je Yawɛ yi!
Nyɛ Yawɛ tsɔli, nyɛ je e yi;
nyɛ je Yawɛ biɛ ɔ yi!
2A je Yawɛ biɛ ɔ yi
kɛ je be nɛ ɔ mi kɛ ya neneene.
3Nihi nɛ ngɛ beleku je, kɛ bonyoku je tsuo,
e sa kaa nyɛ je e yi.
4Yawɛ lɛ yeɔ je ma amɛ tsuo a nɔ,
nɛ e hɛ mi nyami ɔ kle kɛ be hiɔwe po he.
5Nɔ ko be nɛ ngɛ kaa Yawɛ, wa Mawu ɔ
nɛ hii si ngɛ hiɔwe,
6nɛ e ma e yi si
kɛ ngɛ hiɔwe, kɛ zugba tsuo hyɛe ɔ.
7E woɔ humi bi nɔ kɛ jeɔ zu mi;
e woɔ ohiatsɛ nɔ kɛ jeɔ kuku nɔ,
8nɛ e haa nɛ a kɛ lɛ nitsɛ e ma a mi
ganɔ ɔmɛ hii si.
9E haa yosa fɔɔ bi;
e plɛɔ peeɔ bimɛ a nyɛ,
nɛ e bua jɔɔ e he saminya.
A je Yawɛ yi.

Title: LA 114
Content:
Hetsɔmi nyami be la
1 Benɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ je Egipt,
ee, benɛ Yakob nina a je ma se zugba a nɔ ɔ,
2Yuda ba pee Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ma klɔuklɔu,
nɛ Israel ba pee e nɔ yemi he.
3 Wo Tsu ɔ na mɛ, nɛ e tu fo;
Yordan pa a hu se po.
4Yo ɔmɛ tuu kaa agbosuhi,
yoku ɔmɛ tuu kaa jijɔhi.
5Mo wo, mɛni ba nɛ o tu fo ɔ?
Yordan, mɛni ha o se po ɔ?
6Nyɛ yohi, mɛni ba
nɛ nyɛ ngɛ tuue kaa agbosuhi ɔ?
Nyɛ yokuhi, mɛni ha nɛ nyɛ ngɛ tuue
kaa jijɔhi ɔ?
7Zugba lee, mo mimiɛ ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ hɛ mi;
mimiɛ ngɛ Yakob Mawu ɔ hɛ mi koo;
8 lɛ nɛ haa tɛ sa plɛɔ peeɔ taku
kɛ e mi nyu buɛii,
nɛ nyu paa si kɛ jeɔ tslɛbo mi.

Title: LA 115
Content:
Anɔkuale Mawu kake too ɔ
1Yawɛ, pi wɔ oo, pi wɔ,
se mo nɛ o sa hɛ mi nyami;
ejakaa o suɔmi ngɛ daa,
nɛ o we anɔkuale yemi hu be nyagbe.
2Mɛni he je je ma amɛ ma bi ke,
“Jije a Mawu ɔ ngɛ” ɔ?
3Wa Mawu ɔ, hiɔwe e ngɛ;
nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ e suɔ ɔ,
lɔ ɔ e peeɔ.
4 Se ni ɔmɛ a we amaga amɛ lɛɛ
sika hiɔ, kɛ sika tsu ji mɛ,
níhi nɛ nimli adesahi ngɔ a nine kɛ pee kɛkɛ.
5A ngɛ nya, se a tu we munyu;
a ngɛ hɛngmɛ, se a hyɛ we nɔ́.
6A ngɛ tue, se a nui nɔ́;
a ngɛ gugwɔ, se a fu we nɔ́.
7A ngɛ nine, se a pɛtɛ we nɔ́ he;
a ngɛ nane, se a nyɛɛ we;
a kuɛ si po a kpɛ we.
8Nihi nɛ pee mɛ ɔ ngɛ kaa amaga amɛ nɔuu.
Ni nɛmɛ nɛ ngɔɔ a hɛ kɛ fɔɔ a nɔ ɔ,
jã kɛ̃ a ngɛ.
9Israel ma, nyɛɛ ngɔ nyɛ hɛ kɛ fɔ
Yawɛ nɔ.
Lɛ ji nyɛ he piɛlɔ, kɛ nyɛ yi baalɔ.
10Aaron nina, nyɛɛ ngɔ nyɛ hɛ kɛ fɔ
Yawɛ nɔ.
Lɛ ji nyɛ he piɛlɔ, kɛ nyɛ yi baalɔ.
11Nyɛ nihi nɛ nyɛ yeɔ Yawɛ gbeye,
nyɛɛ ngɔ nyɛ hɛ kɛ fɔ Yawɛ nɔ.
Lɛ ji nyɛ he piɛlɔ, kɛ nyɛ yi baalɔ.
12Yawɛ hɛ ngɛ wa nɔ, nɛ e maa gbaa wɔ;
ee, e maa gbaa Israel ma a;
e maa gbaa Israel osɔfo ɔmɛ a nina a.
13 E maa gbaa nihi tsuo nɛ yeɔ lɛ Yawɛ ɔ gbeye,
ni wawihi kɛ ni nguahi tsuo.
14Yawɛ nɛ ha nyɛɛ bɔ saminya,
nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ bimɛ tsuo.
15Yawɛ nɛ bɔ hiɔwe kɛ zugba a,
é gbaa nyɛ.
16Hiɔwe ɔ tsuo e nɔ́,
se zugba a lɛɛ e ngɔ kɛ ha nimli adesahi.
17Ni gbogboehi je we Yawɛ yi;
nɔ ko je we Yawɛ yi ngɛ gbeje.
18Se wɔɔ lɛɛ wa ma je Yawɛ yi
kɛ je be nɛ ɔ mi kɛ ya neneene.
A je Yawɛ yi!

Title: LA 116
Content:
Nɔ ko nɛ a he e yi wami je Yawɛ yi
1I suɔ Yawɛ, ejakaa e nuɔ ye kue fami ɔ,
nɛ e buɔ mi tue.
2Akɛnɛ e buɔ mi tue he je ɔ,
ma tsɛ lɛ ye wami be tsuo.
3Gbenɔ klama amɛ bɔle mi kɛ kpe,
gbeje nɔ́ nami ɔmɛ wo ye he gbeye;
ye ní pee mɔbɔ, nɛ i hao wawɛɛ.
4Kɛkɛ nɛ i kpa ngmlaa kɛ tsɛ Yawɛ ke,
“Yawɛ, i kpa mo pɛɛ, he ye yi wami!”
5Dloolɔ, kɛ dalɔ ji Yawɛ;
ee, wa Mawu ɔ, mɔbɔ nalɔ ji lɛ.
6Nihi nɛ peepee ta a he ɔ, Yawɛ baa a yi;
benɛ i gbɔjɔ ɔ, lɛ nɛ e he ye yi wami.
7Ye nɔ gbagba maa te, nɛ ye bua maa jɔ ekohu;
ejakaa Yawɛ dloo mi babauu.
8Gbenɔ mi nitsɛ nɛ Yawɛ je mi kɛ je;
ye hɛngmɛhi loloo we kɛ vo nyu hu,
nɛ ye nanehi tɛ we si hu.
9Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ma ba ye je mi bɔ nɛ sa
ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi,
ngɛ hɛ kali a zugba a nɔ.
10 Benɛ i de ke,
“Ye hɛ mi miɔ nɛ e kpata pɛsɛpɛsɛ” ɔ,
jamɛ a be ɔ mi po, i hɛɛ ye hemi kɛ yemi ɔ mi.
11Benɛ ye tsui po hu i de ke,
“E sɛ kaa a ngɔɔ hɛ
kɛ fɔɔ nɔmlɔ adesa ko kulaa nɔ.”
12Mɛni ma kɛ na Yawɛ si
ngɛ kpakpa tsuo nɛ e pee mi ɔ he?
13Ma ngɔ wai kɛ sã bɔ kɛ na Yawɛ si;
ejakaa e he ye yi wami.
14Ma ye ye siwo nɔ ha Yawɛ
ngɛ ma kpekpemi ɔ tsuo hɛ mi.
15Yawɛ ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ
a gbenɔ dɔɔ lɛ wawɛɛ.
16Yawɛ, o tsɔlɔ ji mi;
mo lɛ i sɔmɔɔ
kaa bɔ nɛ ye nyɛ pee ɔ pɛ.
O je mi kɛ je gbenɔ mi.
17Ma sã bɔ kɛ na mo si;
mo Yawɛ ma fa kue ha.
18-19Ma ye ye siwo ɔ nɔ ha mo
ngɛ mo Yawɛ, o we klɔuklɔu ɔ ngɛ Yerusalem,
ngɛ ma kpekpemi ɔ tsuo a hɛ mi.
A je Yawɛ yi!

Title: LA 117
Content:
A je Yawɛ yi
1 Nyɛ je mahi tsuo, nyɛ je Yawɛ yi.
Nyɛ je ɔ mi nihi tsuo, nyɛ je e yi.
2Ejakaa suɔmi nɛ Yawɛ kɛ suɔ wɔ ɔ,
suɔmi ɔ kle,
nɛ e yeɔ anɔkuale daa.
A je Yawɛ yi!

Title: LA 118
Content:
Kunimi yemi he sina
1 Nyɛɛ na Yawɛ si;
ejakaa e hi,
nɛ e suɔmi ɔ ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene.
2Israel ma a nɛ de ke,
“E suɔmi ɔ ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene.”
3Israel osɔfo ɔmɛ nɛ a de ke,
“E suɔmi ɔ ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene.”
4Nihi nɛ yeɔ Yawɛ gbeye ɔ, a de ke,
“E suɔmi ɔ ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene.”
5Benɛ i ngɛ amanehlu mi ɔ,
i tsɛ Yawɛ;
Yawɛ he mi nɔ, nɛ e je mi.
6 Nɛ Yawɛ kɛ mi ngɛ nɛ ɔ,
i yi gbeye;
mɛni adesa ma nyɛ maa pee mi.
7Yawɛ kɛ mi ngɛ.
Lɛ nɔuu lɛ e maa piɛ ye he.
Nihi nɛ sume mi ɔ,
ye hɛngmɛ kɛkɛ ma kɛ na
kaa i ye a nɔ kunimi momo.
8E hi kaa o sa we ngɛ Yawɛ ngɔ,
pe nɔ́ nɛ o maa ngɔ o hɛ kɛ fɔ nɔmlɔ nɔ.
9E hi kaa o sa we ngɛ Yawɛ ngɔ,
pe nɔ́ nɛ o maa ngɔ o hɛ kɛ fɔ ganɔhi a nɔ.
10He nyɛli babauu ba bɔle mi kɛ kpe;
se ngɛ Yawɛ he wami nya a,
i kpata a hɛ mi!
11A bɔle mi kɛ kpe; a sa ye yi,
se ngɛ Yawɛ he wami nya a,
i kpata a hɛ mi!
12A buble mi kaa hwo;
se a ngla kaa mio tso mi la.
Yawɛ he wami nya a,
i kpata a hɛ mi!
13A ba tua mi kɛ hɛdɔ,
nɛ a miɔ nɛ a maa ye ye nɔ,
se Yawɛ piɛ ye he.
14 Yawɛ lɛ woɔ mi he wami;
ma la kɛ je e yi,
ejakaa e he ye yi wami.
15Nyɛɛ bu tue, kunimi la ngɛ pɛe
ngɛ dali ɔmɛ a bo tsu ɔmɛ a mi ke,
“Yawɛ kɛ e he wami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ
tsu ní nguanguahi!
16Yawɛ nine ho hiɔwe ya;
Yawɛ kɛ e hɛ mi nyami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ
tsu ní nguanguahi!”
17I be gboe, se mohu ma hi je mi,
nɛ ma jaje níhi nɛ Yawɛ pee ɔ kɛ tsɔɔ.
18Yawɛ gbla ye tue wawɛɛ mohu,
se e ha we nɛ ma gbo.
19Nyɛ bli Yawɛ we ɔ agbo ɔmɛ ha mi;
ma sɛ mi nɛ ma ya na Yawɛ si!
20Yawɛ we agbo ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ;
nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a,
mɛ pɛ nɛ a maa sɛ mi.
21Yawɛ, o nɔ́ ji sina;
ejakaa o bu mi tue,
nɛ o he ye yi wami.
22 Tɛ ɔ nɛ tsu fiali ɔmɛ sake fɔ he ɔ,
lɔ ɔ nɔuu ba pee kɔ nya tɛ.
23Yawɛ dɛ mi enɛ ɔ je;
hyɛ bɔ nɛ e ngɛ nyakpɛ ha!
24Yawɛ kunimi yemi ligbi ji mwɔnɛ ɔ;
nyɛ ha nɛ wa nya, nɛ wa na bua jɔmi.
25 Yawɛ, wa kpa mo pɛɛ,
he wa yi wami koo!
Yawɛ, wa kpa mo pɛɛ,
ha nɛ waa ye kunimi koo!
26 A gbaa nɔ nɛ ma ngɛ Yawɛ biɛ mi ɔ!
Wa ngɛ mo gbae kɛ je Yawɛ we ɔ.
27Yawɛ ji Mawu;
e ha wɔ la.
Nyɛɛ hɛɛ tã kuɔmi ngɛ nyɛ dɛ,
nɛ nyɛɛ bɔ sala kɛ ya bɔle
bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ koli ɔmɛ.
28Mo ji ye Mawu; ma na mo si.
Mo ji ye Mawu; ma wo o hɛ mi nyami.
29Nyɛɛ na Yawɛ si;
ejakaa e mi mi hi,
nɛ e suɔmi ɔ ngɛ daa.

Title: LA 119
Content:
Yawɛ mlaa a
1A gbaa ni nɛmɛ nɛ piami ko be a he
ngɛ a si himi mi,
nihi nɛ baa a je mi ngɛ Yawɛ mlaa a nya.
2A gbaa nihi nɛ yeɔ e mlaa amɛ a nɔ,
ni nɛmɛ nɛ kɛ a tsui tsuo hlaa e se blɔ,
3nihi nɛ pee we nɔ́ nɛ dɛ,
se mohu a baa a je mi
kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ suɔ ɔ.
4Yawɛ, o wo o mlaa amɛ,
konɛ a ye nɔ sisiisi.
5I na nɛ i nyɛ ye o mlaa amɛ a nɔ sisiisi.
6Ke i hyɛ saminya, nɛ i ye o mlaa amɛ tsuo a nɔ ɔ,
lɛɛ zo be mi gbee.
7Ke i kase o mlaa kpakpa nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ,
ma je o yi kɛ tsui nɛ mi tsɔ.
8Ma ye o mlaa amɛ a nɔ;
ko kua mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ!
Ye Yawɛ mlaa a nɔ
9Ke niheyo ngɛ hlae nɛ e ba e je mi bɔ nɛ sa a,
kɛ e maa pee kɛɛ?
Bɔ nɛ e maa pee ji e maa ye o mlaa amɛ a nɔ.
10I suɔ kaa ma nyɛɛ o se kɛ ye tsui tsuo,
ko ha nɛ ma je o mlaa amɛ a he.
11I ngɔ o munyu ɔ kɛ to ye tsui mi tɔɔ,
konɛ ma ko pee yayami kɛ si mo.
12Yawɛ, ma je o yi;
tsɔɔ mi o mlaa amɛ.
13Mlaahi tsuo nɛ je o nya a,
imi hu ma fiɛ.
14Ye bua jɔɔ o mlaa amɛ a he
pe ní nami babauu.
15Ma susu o mlaa amɛ a he,
nɛ o blɔ ɔmɛ maa hi ye hɛ mi daa.
16Ye bua jɔɔ o mlaa amɛ a he;
ye hɛ be o munyu ɔmɛ a nɔ jee.
Yawɛ mlaa a haa nɔ bua jɔmi
17O tsɔlɔ ji mi, naa mi mɔbɔ;
ha nɛ ye yi nɛ na wami,
konɛ ma ye o mlaa a nɔ.
18Bli ye hɛngmɛ, konɛ ma na
nyakpɛ níhi nɛ ngɛ o mlaa a mi.
19Nubwɔ ji mi ngɛ je ɔ mi;
koo ngɔ o mlaa a kɛ laa mi.
20Daa nɛ ɔ, i ngɛ ye tsui yee
kaa ma le o mlaa amɛ.
21O kaa he woli a hɛ mi;
á gbiɛ nihi nɛ tlaa blɔ kɛ jee o mlaa amɛ a he.
22Mo je mi kɛ je a we ahlua bɔmi,
kɛ he guɛ gbemi mi;
ejakaa i ye o mlaa amɛ a nɔ.
23Ke ganɔhi ya kpe nɛ a ngɛ ye yi nɔ soe tete po,
imi, o tsɔlɔ lɛɛ o mlaa amɛ a he pɛ ma susu.
24O mlaa amɛ jɔɔ ye bua;
mɛ nɔuu ji ye ga woli.
Yé Yawɛ mlaa a nɔ
25I tlɔ zugba mɔbɔmɔbɔ;
ha nɛ ma na he wami ekohu
kaa bɔ nɛ o wo si ɔ.
26I jaje níhi nɛ i pee ɔ tsuo kɛ tsɔɔ mo,
nɛ o he mi nɔ;
tsɔɔ mi o mlaa amɛ.
27Ha nɛ ma nu o mlaa amɛ a sisi,
konɛ ma susu nyakpɛ níhi nɛ o pee ɔ a he.
28Kɔmɔ yemi sɔuu ha nɛ i pee vii.
Wó mi he wami ekohu
kaa bɔ nɛ o wo si ɔ.
29Je mi kɛ je yayami peemi mi.
Naa mi mɔbɔ, konɛ o tsɔɔ mi o mlaa a.
30I pee ye yi mi ke anɔkuale pɛ ma ye;
i ngɔ o mlaa amɛ kɛ to ye hɛ mi.
31Yawɛ, i pɛtɛ o mlaa amɛ a he wawɛɛ;
ko ha zo nɛ gbe mi.
32Ma ye o mlaa amɛ a nɔ kɛ gɛjɛmi;
ejakaa o ha nɛ i nu mlaa amɛ
a sisi saminya.
Ha nɛ ma nu mlaa a sisi
33Yawɛ, tsɔɔ mi o mlaa amɛ a sisi,
konɛ ma ye a nɔ sisiisi.
34Ha nɛ ma nu mlaa a sisi,
konɛ ma ye nɔ kɛ ye tsui tsuo.
35Ha nɛ ma ye mlaa a nɔ;
ejakaa e haa mi bua jɔmi.
36Ha nɛ ma suɔ o mlaa amɛ mohu
pe kaa ma na ní kpɔtɔɔ.
37Níhi nɛ a he be se nami ɔ, ko ha ma hyɛ.
Mo ha ye yi nɛ na wami kaa bɔ nɛ o wo si ɔ.
38Si nɛ o wo nihi nɛ buɔ mo tue ɔ,
ha nɛ e ba mi ha imi, o tsɔlɔ ɔ hulɔ.
39Ahlua nɛ i ngɛ gbeye yee kaa a maa bɔ mi ɔ,
ha nɛ e tsɔ ye he kɛ ho,
ejakaa o mlaa amɛ hi.
40Hyɛ kaa i suɔ o mlaa amɛ;
ha mi wami he,
ejakaa o peeɔ nɔ nɛ da.
Ngɔɔ hɛ kɛ fɔ Yawɛ mlaa a nɔ
41Yawɛ, je o we anɔkuale suɔmi nɛ ngɛ daa a kpo kɛ tsɔɔ mi,
nɛ o he ye yi wami
kaa bɔ nɛ o wo si ɔ.
42Kɛkɛ ɔ, ma na heto ma ha ni nɛmɛ
nɛ ngɛ mi ahlua bɔe ɔ,
ejakaa i ngɔ ye hɛ kɛ fɔ o munyu ɔ nɔ.
43Ha nɛ ma nyɛ ma tu anɔkuale be tsuaa be;
ejakaa i ngɔ ye hɛ kɛ fɔ o mlaa amɛ a nɔ.
44Ma ye o mlaa a nɔ daa;
ma ye nɔ kɛ maa ya neneene;
45nɛ ma hi si ngɛ he jɔmi mi;
ejakaa o mlaa nɔ i hlaa kaa ma ye.
46Matsɛmɛ a hɛ mi tete po ma fiɛ o mlaa a,
nɛ e be mi zo pee.
47I naa o mlaa amɛ a he bua jɔmi,
ejakaa i suɔ o mlaa amɛ.
48I buu o mlaa amɛ, nɛ i suɔ mɛ hulɔ;
o mlaa amɛ a he ma susu.
Ngɔɔ hɛ kɛ fɔ Yawɛ mlaa a nɔ
49Mo kai si nɛ o wo imi, o tsɔlɔ ɔ;
ejakaa i ngɔ ye hɛ kɛ fɔ nɔ.
50Benɛ i ngɛ nɔ nae pohu ye bua jɔ,
ejakaa o wo mi si ke o ma he ye yi wami.
51Nihi nɛ woɔ a he nɔ ye ye he fɛu hluu,
se kɛ̃ ɔ, i ngmɛɛ we o mlaa a he.
52Yawɛ, nyakpɛ níhi nɛ o tsu blema lokoo ɔ,
ke i susu a he ɔ, ye bua jɔɔ saminya.
53Se ke i na yiwutsotsɛmɛ nɛ a ngɛ o mlaa a tɔ̃e ɔ,
ye mi mi woɔ la wawɛɛ nitsɛ.
54O mlaa amɛ plɛ pee lahi nɛ i laa
ngɛ ye wami be kpiti nɛ ɔ mi ngɛ je ɔ mi.
55I kaiɔ mo Yawɛ nyɔ mi,
nɛ i susuɔ o mlaa a he.
56I ye o mlaa amɛ a nɔ,
nɛ o gbaa mi.
Pɛtɛ Yawɛ mlaa a he saminya
57Yawɛ, mo pɛ i suɔ;
i ngɛ si woe ke ma ye o mlaa amɛ a nɔ.
58I ngɛ mo pɛɛ kpae kɛ ye tsui tsuo
ke o na mi mɔbɔ
kaa bɔ nɛ o wo si ɔ.
59I susu ye je mi bami he,
nɛ i ngɛ si woe ke
ma ye o mlaa amɛ a nɔ.
60I ngɛ esɔ hee nɛ ma ye o mlaa amɛ a nɔ;
tsle tomi be mi ha mi.
61Yiwutsotsɛmɛ tsɔ mi klamahi lɛɛ,
se ye hɛ ji o mlaa a nɔ.
62Nyɔ mi kpɛti i teɔ si
nɛ i naa mo si,
ejakaa o mlaa amɛ da saminya.
63O tsɔli ɔmɛ nɛ sɔmɔɔ mo,
kɛ nihi nɛ yeɔ o mlaa amɛ a nɔ ɔ,
ye huɛmɛ ji mɛ tsuo.
64Yawɛ, o suɔmi nɛ ngɛ daa a hyi je ɔ tɔ;
moo tsɔɔ mi o mlaa amɛ.
Yawɛ mlaa he jua wa
65Yawɛ, o ye o siwo ɔ nɔ,
o kɛ imi, o tsɔlɔ ɔ ye saminya.
66Ha mi juɛmi, kɛ nile;
ejakaa i he o mlaa a ye.
67Loko o gbla ye tue ɔ,
i pɔɔ blɔ tlami,
se jehanɛ lɛɛ i yeɔ o munyu ɔ nɔ.
68O hi, nɛ o peeɔ kpakpa saminya!
Moo tsɔɔ mi o mlaa amɛ.
69Nihi nɛ woɔ a he nɔ ɔ
tuɔ lakpa munyuhi kɛ siɔ mi;
se imi lɛɛ i kɛ ye tsui tsuo yeɔ o mlaa amɛ a nɔ.
70Mɛɛ lɛɛ a nui nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko sisi,
se imi lɛɛ i naa o mlaa a he bua jɔmi.
71E hi ha mi kaa o gbla ye tue,
konɛ ma kase o mlaa amɛ.
72O mlaa a nɛ o ha mi ɔ hi ha mi
pe je nɛ ɔ mi sika tsu, kɛ sika hiɔ babauu.
Yawɛ mlaa a da
73Mo nitsɛ lɛ o bɔ mi, nɛ o baa ye yi.
Ha mi juɛmi nɛ kɔɔ nɔ́ se,
konɛ ma kase o mlaa amɛ.
74Nihi nɛ yee mo gbeye ɔ maa na mi,
nɛ a bua maa jɔ a he;
ejakaa i ngɔ ye hɛ kɛ fɔ o munyu ɔ nɔ.
75Yawɛ, i le kaa o ye dami sane,
nɛ o gbla ye tue bɔ nɛ sa mi,
ejakaa moo lɛɛ anɔkuale pɛ o yeɔ.
76Ha nɛ o suɔmi nɛ ngɛ daa a nɛ jɔɔ ye bua
kaa bɔ nɛ o wo imi, o tsɔlɔ ɔ si ɔ.
77Naa mi mɔbɔ, konɛ ye yi nɛ na wami,
ejakaa ye bua jɔɔ o mlaa a he.
78Nihi nɛ woɔ a he nɔ ɔ,
ha zo nɛ gbe mɛ;
ejakaa a po ye nya yaka gu;
se imi lɛɛ o mlaa amɛ a he pɛ ma susu.
79Ha nɛ nihi tsuo nɛ suɔ mo nɛ ɔ a ba ye ngɔ,
konɛ a ba kase o mlaa amɛ.
80Ha nɛ ma ye o mlaa amɛ a nɔ sisiisi,
konɛ zo ko gbe mi!
Ba kpɔ mi
81Yawɛ, i hyɛ mo blɔ hluu kaa o ma ba kpɔ mi,
nɛ pɔ tɔ mi jehanɛ;
se i ngɔ ye hɛ kɛ fɔ o siwo ɔ nɔ.
82Ye hɛngmɛ tlɔ blɔ;
i hyɛ blɔ hluu kaa o maa ye o siwo ɔ nɔ lo.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i ngɛ bie ke,
“Mɛni be po nɛ o ma ha ye bua maa jɔ?”
83Ejakaa ye he be se nami hu
kaa wai tɔ nɛ a je se;
se kɛ̃ ɔ, ye hɛ ji o mlaa amɛ a nɔ.
84Mɛni be o tsɔlɔ ɔ ma pa to e tsui si kɛ ya su?
Nihi nɛ ngɛ mi yi mi wae ɔ,
mɛni be po o maa gbla a tue ha mi?
85Nihi nɛ woɔ a he nɔ tsua muɔhi
kɛ tsɔ mi klama, konɛ a nine nɛ su ye nɔ.
86A ngɛ lakpa toe kɛ ngɛ mi yi mi wae gu.
Se o mlaa amɛ maa si kpɛii,
lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ba he mi!
87E piɛ nguɛ nya nɛ a ko gbe nya ha mi ngɛ je ɔ mi;
se kɛ ɔ, i kua we o mlaa amɛ.
88O naa mɔbɔ; he ye yi wami,
konɛ ma ye o mlaa amɛ a nɔ.
Wo hɛ kɛ fɔ Yawɛ mlaa a nɔ
89Yawɛ, o munyu ɔ maa hi si daa;
e ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene ngɛ hiɔwe lokoo.
90O we anɔkuale yemi maa gblee yi nɔhi tsuo a mi.
Mo lɛ o ngɔ zugba a kɛ ma si
nɛ e maa si kpɛii nɛ ɔ nɛ.
91Níhi tsuo ngɛ kaa bɔ nɛ o fa mɛ ɔ kɛ ba su mwɔnɛ ɔ,
ejakaa o tsɔli ji mɛ tsuo.
92Ke pi o mlaa a nɛ haa mi bua jɔmi ɔ,
jinɛ ye hɛ mi kpata momo
ngɛ ye amanehlu ɔ mi.
93Ye hɛ be o mlaa amɛ a nɔ jee gblegbleegble,
ejakaa a nɔ o gu kɛ he ye yi wami.
94O nɔ́ ji mi, he ye yi wami;
ejakaa i bɔ mɔde kaa ma ye o mlaa amɛ a nɔ.
95Yiwutsosɛmɛ woɔ mi ka
nɛ a kpata ye hɛ mi;
se imi lɛɛ o mlaa amɛ a he mohu i susuɔ.
96I na le kaa sé ngɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ he,
se o mlaa a lɛɛ tɔmi ko kulaa be he.
I suɔ Yawɛ mlaa a
97I suɔ o mlaa a kaa nɔ́ ko!
Ke je na kikɛ nɛ ɔ, e he pɛ i susuɔ.
98I le ní pe ye he nyɛli tsuo,
ejakaa o mlaa a kɛ mi ngɛ daa.
99I nuɔ nɔ́ sisi pe ye tsɔɔli ɔmɛ tsuo,
ejakaa o mlaa amɛ a he i susuɔ.
100I kɔɔ munyu se pe nikɔtɔmahi po;
ejakaa i yeɔ o mlaa amɛ a nɔ.
101I kpa je mi bami yayami ɔmɛ tsuo;
ejakaa i suɔ kaa ma ye o mlaa amɛ a nɔ.
102I ji o munyu ɔmɛ a he;
ejakaa mo lɛ o tsɔɔ mi ní.
103O mlaa a ngɔɔ loo!
E ngɔɔ pe hwo tete po.
104O mlaa a jeɔ nile ha mi,
lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i hiee je mi bami yaya.
Yawɛ mlaa a ji la
105O munyu ɔ ji kane nɛ i kɛ hyɛɔ ye nane nya;
o munyu ɔ ji la nɛ haa ye blɔ mi tɛ̃ɔ.
106O mlaa amɛ da saminya,
lɔ ɔ he ɔ, imi hu i ngɛ mo si woe veveeve
ke ma ye a nɔ sisiisi.
107Yawɛ, mo he ye yi wami
kaa bɔ nɛ o wo si ɔ,
se ye we amanehlu ɔ nya wa nitsɛnitsɛ.
108Yawɛ, mo he ye bɔ nɛ i kɛ ngɛ mo si nae ɔ,
nɛ o tsɔɔ mi o mlaa amɛ.
109I dla ye he kɛ to ha gbenɔ be tsuaa be,
se kɛ̃ ɔ, i je we ye hɛ kɛ ji o mlaa a he.
110Yiwutsotsɛmɛ tsɔɔ mi klama mohu,
se i tɔ̃ we o mlaa amɛ a nɔ.
111O mlaa amɛ ji ye weto ní kɛ yaa neneene.
O mlaa amɛ haa ye tsui nɔɔ ye mi fuaa.
112I to ye yi mi kaa ma ye o mlaa amɛ a nɔ daa;
ma ye a nɔ kɛ yaa si ye gbenɔ ligbi.
Yawɛ mlaa a baa nɔ yi
113Nihi nɛ suɔ mo fa kɛ fa a, i sume mɛ;
i suɔ o mlaa amɛ mohu.
114Mo ji ye he bulɔ, kɛ ye yi baalɔ;
i ngɔ ye hɛ kɛ fɔ o siwo ɔ nɔ.
115Nyɛ yayami peeli, nyɛɛ je ye nɔ kɛ ya se!
Ye Mawu ɔ mlaa amɛ a nɔ ma ye.
116Wo mi he wami
kaa bɔ nɛ o wo mi si ɔ;
ha nɛ ye yi nɛ na wami.
I ngɔ ye hɛ kɛ fɔ o nɔ kulaa;
koo gbe mi zo.
117Pɛtɛ ye he, konɛ ye yi nɛ na wami,
nɛ ye hɛ maa hi o mlaa amɛ a nɔ daa.
118Nihi tsuo nɛ yi o mlaa amɛ a nɔ ɔ,
niinɛ, o bui a he akɔtaa;
ga yayahi nɛ a kɛ sisiɔ nɔ ɔ peeɔ yaka.
119Yiwutsotsɛmɛ tsuo nɛ ngɛ je mi ɔ,
o buu mɛ kaa kuku nɔ dade.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, o mlaa amɛ pɛ lɛ i suɔ.
120O he sawale nu mi,
nɛ ye he ngɛ doe blibliibli;
ejakaa o kojomi ɔmɛ ngɛ gbeye.
Bu Yawɛ mlaa a tue
121Nɔ́ nɛ da, kɛ nɔ́ nɛ sa lɛ i peeɔ,
lɔ ɔ he ɔ, koo ngmɛɛ ye he
ha nihi nɛ ngɛ mi yi mi wae ɔ.
122Moo da mi ha o tsɔlɔ ɔ, nɛ e hi ha lɛ.
Ko ha nɛ he nɔ woli nɛ wa mi yi mi.
123I hyɛ blɔ hluu kaa o ma ba he ye yi wami,
kaa o maa ye o siwo ɔ nɔ;
se jehanɛ ye hɛ se gbo.
124Mo nɛ o suɔmi be nyagbe,
naa imi, o tsɔlɔ ɔ mɔbɔ,
nɛ o tsɔɔ mi o mlaa amɛ.
125O tsɔlɔ ji mi, ha mi nile,
konɛ ma nu o mlaa amɛ a sisi.
126Yawɛ, nihi ngɛ o mlaa a tɔ̃e;
be su nɛ o maa pee he nɔ́ ko.
127Imi lɛɛ i suɔ o mlaa amɛ pe sika tsu,
ee, pe sika tsu ngmingmiingmi.
128Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i buɔ o mlaa amɛ tsuo,
se blɔhi nɛ dɛ ɔ lɛɛ i sume.
Ye Yawɛ mlaa a nɔ
129O mlaa amɛ ngɛ nyakpɛ;
lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i yeɔ a nɔ kɛ ye tsui tsuo.
130Ke a tsɔɔ o mlaa a sisi ɔ, e ngɛ kaa la,
nɛ e haa kuasia po leɔ ní.
131I paa ye nya mi hatoo
kaa nɔ nɛ nɔ́ ko ngɛ lɛ jloe
kɛ hyɛɛ o mlaa amɛ blɔ.
132Mo plɛ nɛ o hyɛ mi nɛ o na mi mɔbɔ
kaa bɔ nɛ o peeɔ kɛ haa nihi tsuo nɛ suɔ mo ɔ.
133Moo ye o siwo ɔ nɔ;
ko ha nɛ ma nɔ si;
ko ha nɛ yayami nɛ ye ye nɔ.
134Mo kpɔ mi kɛ je nihi nɛ waa mi yi mi ɔ a dɛ mi,
konɛ ma ye o mlaa a nɔ.
135Mo je o he si, nɛ o na imi, o tsɔlɔ ɔ mɔbɔ,
nɛ o tsɔɔ mi o mlaa amɛ.
136Ye hɛngmɛ tslaa nyu babaaba
kaa pa nɛ ngɛ bee,
ejakaa nimli adesahi yi o mlaa amɛ a nɔ.
Yawɛ mlaa a da
137Yawɛ, dalɔ ji mo,
nɛ o mlaa amɛ hu da pɛpɛɛpɛ!
138Mlaa amɛ nɛ o wo ɔ, a da,
anɔkuale sɔuu.
139Ye mi mi ngɛ mi sããe kaa la,
ejakaa ye he nyɛli ɔmɛ bui o mlaa amɛ.
140Ke o wo si ɔ, o yeɔ nɔ sisiisi;
lɔ ɔ he ɔ, imi, o tsɔlɔ ɔ, i suɔ o siwo ɔ tsɔ!
141Imi lɛɛ nɔ wayoo nɛ a bui ha nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko ji mi,
se ye hɛ ji o mlaa amɛ a nɔ.
142Dalɔ ji mo, nɛ ja o ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene;
o mlaa a, anɔkuale sɔuu.
143Ke i ngɛ haomi mi, nɛ i ngɛ kɔmɔ yee ɔ,
o mlaa amɛ lɛɛ a haa nɛ ye bua jɔɔ saminya.
144O mlaa amɛ da kɛ yaa neneene.
Ha mi juɛmi nɛ kɔɔ nɔ́ se,
bɔ nɛ pee nɛ ye yi nɛ na wami.
Ba he ye yi wami
145I ngɛ ngmlaa kpae kɛ ngɛ mo tsɛe kɛ ye tsui tsuo.
Yawɛ, mo ha nɛ ma ye o mlaa amɛ a nɔ.
146Mo i ngɛ tsɛe ɔ nɛ;
mo he ye yi wami,
nɛ ma ye o mlaa amɛ a nɔ.
147I teɔ si makɛ mla,
nɛ i kpaa ngmlaa kɛ tsɛɔ mo ke o ba piɛ ye he.
I ngɔ ye hɛ kɛ fɔ o siwo ɔ nɔ.
148Nyɔ mi tsuo i hwɔ we mahe;
o siwo ɔ he i hii susue.
149Bu ye gbi tue koo;
ejakaa o suɔmi ɔ be nyagbe.
Yawɛ, moo lɛɛ nɔ́ nɛ da pɛ o peeɔ;
naa mi mɔbɔ, nɛ o baa ye yi.
150Nihi nɛ ngɛ mi yi mi wae
nɛ bui o mlaa a,
a ngɛ hɛe kɛ ngɛ ye he sue.
151Se Yawɛ, o ngɛ ye kasa nya haa,
nɛ o mlaa amɛ tsuo maa si kpɛii.
152I le kɛ je blema lokoo
kaa o wo mlaa amɛ nɛ a hi si kɛ ya neneene.
Ba piɛ ye he
153Hyɛ amanehlu nɛ i ngɛ nae nɛ ɔ,
nɛ o ba je mi kɛ je mi,
ejakaa ye hɛ ji o mlaa a nɔ.
154Ba ye ye sane ɔ ha mi, nɛ o kpɔ mi.
He ye yi wami
kaa bɔ nɛ o wo si ɔ.
155A be yiwutsotsɛmɛ a yi wami hee;
