ejakaa a bui o mlaa amɛ.
156Se Yawɛ, mo nɛ o naa mɔbɔ babauu,
nɛ o peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da;
mo he ye yi wami.
157Nihi nɛ waa mi yi mi, kɛ ye he nyɛli ɔmɛ
a he hiɛ babauu,
se kɛ̃ ɔ, ye hɛ ji o mlaa a nɔ.
158Ke i na nihi nɛ yi mo anɔkuale kikɛ nɛ ɔ,
a he peeɔ mi tãi;
ejakaa a yi o mlaa amɛ a nɔ.
159Yawɛ, i suɔ o mlaa amɛ kaa nɔ́ ko!
O suɔmi nɛ ngɛ daa a he ɔ,
mo he ye yi wami.
160O munyu ɔ tsuo, anɔkuale sisiisi;
o mlaa amɛ da, nɛ eko tsuaa eko maa si
kpɛii kɛ yaa neneene.
I suɔ Yawɛ mlaa a kɛ ye tsui tsuo
161Ganɔhi waa mi yi mi yaka,
se kɛ̃ ɔ, i buɔ o mlaa amɛ.
162O munyu ɔ ngɔɔ ye nya.
Ye bua jɔɔ kaa nɔ ko nɛ e nine ya su
ta yibu ní nɛ he jua wa nɔ.
163I sume lakpa kulaa, i hiee lɛ;
se o mlaa lɛɛ i suɔ.
164I jeɔ o yi si kpaago daa ligbi,
ejakaa o mlaa amɛ da.
165Nihi nɛ suɔ o mlaa amɛ ɔ, a naa he jɔmi nitsɛnitsɛ,
nɛ nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko be hae nɛ a maa tla blɔ.
166Yawɛ, mo o nɔ ye hɛ ngɛ,
ba he ye yi wami;
i peeɔ níhi nɛ o mlaa a tsɔɔ ɔ.
167I yeɔ o mlaa amɛ a nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ;
i suɔ o mlaa amɛ kɛ ye tsui tsuo.
168I yeɔ o mlaa amɛ, kɛ blɔ nya tomi ɔmɛ tsuo
a nɔ; o le ye yami kɛ bami mi fitsofitso.
Ba piɛ ye he
169Yawɛ, ngmlaa nɛ i ngɛ kpae kɛ ngɛ mo tsɛe ɔ,
bu tue koo!
Ha nɛ ma nu nɔ́ sisi
kaa bɔ nɛ o wo si ɔ!
170Moo bu ye kue fami ɔ tue
nɛ o ba kpɔ mi
kaa bɔ nɛ o wo si ɔ!
171Ma je o yi daa;
ejakaa o tsɔɔ mi o mlaa amɛ.
172Ma la o mlaa a he la;
ejakaa o mlaa amɛ tsuo da saminya.
173Pee klaalo nɛ o ba piɛ ye he;
ejakaa i yeɔ o mlaa amɛ a nɔ.
174Yawɛ, i ngɛ mo blɔ hyɛe;
ba he ye yi wami koo!
O mlaa a pɛ lɛ haa ye bua jɔɔ ye he.
175Ha nɛ ye yi nɛ na wami,
konɛ ma je o yi;
ha nɛ o mlaa amɛ nɛ a tsɔɔ mi blɔ.
176I ngɛ lalaalo woe kaa to nɛ laa;
mo hla imi, o tsɔlɔ ɔ koo!
Ejakaa i je we ye hɛ ngɛ o mlaa amɛ a nɔ.

Title: LA 120
Content:
Ba piɛ ye he
1Benɛ i ngɛ haomi mi ɔ,
i kpa ngmlaa kɛ tsɛ Yawɛ, nɛ
e bu mi tue.
2Yawɛ, je mi kɛ je lakpatsɛmɛ,
nihi nɛ sisiɔ a sibi a dɛ mi.
3Nyɛ lakpatsɛmɛ, mɛni nyɛ ngɛ hlae
nɛ a ha nyɛ?
Mɛni po nɛ nyɛ pa ngɛ hlae
nɛ a pee ha nyɛ?
4Nyɛ hɛɛ kɛ̃ɛ̃ mi bihi nɛ a nya ba,
kɛ la ngu hɛuu kɛ ma
kaa ta buli.
5Ye yi fi pɛ!
Hyɛ kaa i ba to nubwɔ ngɛ Meshek;
nɛ i ngɛ Kedar bi a ma mi!
6Ye se ba kɛ tsɔ ngɛ
nihi nɛ sume tue mi jɔmi ɔ a kpɛti.
7Imi lɛɛ he jɔmi nɔmlɔ ji mi,
se ke i tu munyu kɛkɛ
mɛɛ lɛɛ a hia ta!

Title: LA 121
Content:
Yawɛ ji wa he bulɔ
1Ke i wo ye yi nɔ nɛ i hyɛ yoku ɔmɛ ɔ,
i biɔ ke jije balɔ maa je kɛ ba?
2Yawɛ, nɔ nɛ bɔ hiɔwe kɛ zugba a,
lɛ ji nɔ nɛ piɛɔ ye he.
3E be hae nɛ o sane kɛ nɔ si.
O he bulɔ ɔ, e de we kɔnɔɛ gblegbleegble.
4O nɛ, Israel he bulɔ ɔ de we kɔnɔɛ,
nɛ e hwɔ we mahe hulɔ.
5Yawɛ ji o yi baalɔ.
E ngɛ o kasa nya, konɛ e bu o he.
6Piani ɔ, pu be mo sããe,
nɛ nyɔ mi hu nyɔhiɔ be mo nɔ́ ko pee.
7Yawɛ maa bu o he kɛ je
yayami tsuo mi;
e maa baa o yi.
8Ke o je kpo jio;
o kpale kɛ ma we mi jio,
Yawɛ maa bu o he.
E maa bu o he kɛ je be nɛ ɔ mi
kɛ maa ya neneene.

Title: LA 122
Content:
Yerusalem yi jemi la
1Ye bua jɔ ye he wawɛɛ nitsɛ
benɛ a de mi ke,
“Waa ho Yawɛ we ɔ ya.”
2Yerusalem, jehanɛ lɛɛ
wa ba sɛ o we agbo ɔmɛ a mi!
3Yerusalem ji ma nguaa saminyayoo
nɛ a to lɛ si kɛ e mi nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́
ngɛ hanɔhanɔ.
4Lejɛ ɔ nɛ Yawɛ wɛtso ɔmɛ yaa
ya naa Yawɛ si
kaa bɔ nɛ a fa Israel ma a
ke a pee ɔ.
5Lejɛ ɔ nɛ Israel matsɛmɛ nɛ ji
David nina a hi kɛ kojo ma a.
6Nyɛɛ fa kue nɛ tue mi jɔmi nɛ ba Yerusalem.
Nyɛ de ke, “Nihi nɛ suɔ mo Yerusalem ɔ,
níhi a mi nɛ hi ha mɛ oo!
7Tue mi jɔmi nɛ ba ma a mi;
he jɔmi nɛ hi mɔ ɔmɛ a mi.”
8Ye nyɛmimɛ, kɛ ye huɛmɛ ɔmɛ a he ɔ,
ma de Yerusalem ke,
“Tue mi jɔmi nɛ hi o mi!”
9Yawɛ wa Mawu ɔ we ɔ he je ɔ,
ma hla o nɔ yami.

Title: LA 123
Content:
Naa wɔ mɔbɔ
1Yawɛ mo i wo ye yi nɔ kɛ ngɛ hyɛe;
mo nɛ́ o hii si ngɛ o matsɛ sɛ ɔ nɔ
ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ,
mo i ngɛ hyɛe ɔ nɛ!
2O nɛ, bɔ nɛ tsɔli hyɛɛ a nyɔmtsɛ blɔ,
nɛ mawayo hu hyɛɛ e wenyɛ blɔ ɔ,
ja nɔuu wɔ hu wa ngɛ
Yawɛ, wa Mawu ɔ blɔ hyɛe
kɛ yaa su be nɛ e maa na wɔ mɔbɔ.
3Naa wɔ mɔbɔ;
Yawɛ, naa wɔ mɔbɔ;
ejakaa a pee wɔ nisɛ ní babauu tsɔ.
4Nihi nɛ a he mi jɔ mɛ ɔ ye wa he fɛu babauu,
nɛ he nɔ woli hu gbe wa he guɛ hluu
kɛ ya si wa mumu nya ta.

Title: LA 124
Content:
Mawu ji e ma a he bulɔ
1Ke pi Yawɛ nɛ piɛ wa he ɔ nɛɛ?
Israel ha heto koo!
2“Ke pi Yawɛ nɛ piɛ wa he
be mi nɛ wa he nyɛli te si kɛ wo wɔ ɔ,
3jinɛ bɔ nɛ a mi mi fu wɔ wawɛɛ nɛ ɔ,
a ko mii wɔ hɛ ngmengmle;
4jinɛ nyu babauu ɔ ko sá wɔ kɛ ho
nɛ e ha wa nɔ;
5nɛ nyu hamahama a ko kpata wa hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ.”
6Nyɛ ha waa na Yawɛ si;
ejakaa e ha we nɛ wa plɛ pee
wa he nyɛli ɔmɛ a lungu nya lo!
7Wa je a dɛ mi kaa bɔ nɛ lohwe pɛlitsɛ jee ya mi;
ya a gba, nɛ wa je mi slɔkee.
8Yawɛ, hiɔwe kɛ zugba bɔlɔ ɔ
ji nɔ nɛ piɛɔ wa he.

Title: LA 125
Content:
Mawu ma a naa tue mi jɔmi
1Nihi nɛ ngɔɔ a hɛ kɛ fɔɔ Yawɛ nɔ ɔ,
a ngɛ kaa Zion yo ɔ.
E maa si kpɛii kɛ yaa neneene,
nɛ nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko be nyɛe ma mimiɛ lɛ.
2Bɔ nɛ yohi bɔle Yerusalem kɛ kpe ɔ,
ja Yawɛ he wami ɔ bɔle e ma a kɛ kpe
kɛ je be nɛ ɔ mi kɛ yaa neneene tsuo.
3Yiwutsotsɛmɛ be nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a
a zugba nɔ yee daa,
ke pi ja a, dali po maa pee yayami.
4Yawɛ, nihi nɛ peeɔ kpakpa,
kɛ nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da
kɛ je a tsui mi ɔ,
ha nɛ e hi ha mɛ.
5Nihi nɛ a blɔ ɔmɛ dɛ ɔ,
Yawɛ maa gbla a kɛ yayami peeli tsuo a tue.
He jɔmi nɛ hi Israel.

Title: LA 126
Content:
Ba kpɔ mi
1Benɛ Yawɛ kpale wɔ
kɛ je ma se kɛ ba Zion ekohu ɔ,
e pee wɔ kaa pe wa ngɛ nlae.
2Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, wa muɔ jɛɛ,
nɛ wa la bua jɔmi la boboobo.
Je ma amɛ hu de a sibi ke,
“Yawɛ tsu ní nguanguahi ha mɛ.”
3Niinɛ, Yawɛ tsu nyakpɛ níhi ha wɔ,
lɔ ɔ he nɛ wa bua jɔ wa he
nɛ wa ngɛ nyae ɔ nɛ!
4Yawɛ, moo kpale wɔ kɛ ba
wɔ nitsɛmɛ wa zugba nɔ
kaa bɔ nɛ hiɔmi nɛɛ
nɛ zugba gbigbli naa nyu babaaba
ekohu ɔ.
5Nihi nɛ du ní kɛ vo nyu ɔ
ma kpa ní kɛ bua jɔmi.
6Nɔ nɛ vo nyu hii e hɛ mi kɛ ya duɔ ní ɔ,
e maa tloo niba ní kɛ ba we mi
kɛ bua jɔmi.

Title: LA 127
Content:
A je Mawu yi, ejakaa e hi
1Ke pi Yawɛ nɛ maa tsu ɔ,
tsu mali gboɔ yaka dengme.
Ke pi Yawɛ nɛ buɔ ma he ɔ,
bulɔ fɔɔ nyɔ yaka gu
kɛ buɔ ma he.
2Yaka gu nyɛ teɔ si makɛ mla,
nɛ gbɔkuɛ hu nyɛ ya hwɔ we si mla.
Nyɛ gboɔ dengme loko nyɛ naa nɔ́ ko bɔɔ pɛ nyɛ yeɔ,
se nɔ nɛ Mawu suɔ e sane ɔ,
e haa e hwɔɔ mahe bɔ nɛ sa.
3Bimɛ ji weto ní nɛ Yawɛ haa nɔ;
bimɛ ji nike ní nɛ e kɛ dlooɔ nɔ.
4Nihe mi bimɛ nɛ a fɔɔ ɔ
ngɛ kaa ta bulɔ dɛ mi kɛ̃ɛ̃ mi bihi.
5Nɔ nɛ kotoku ɔ hyi kɛ kɛ̃ɛ̃ mi bihi kikɛ nɛ ɔ,
a gbaa lɛ.
Ke e kɛ e he nyɛli kpe ngɛ kojomi he ɔ,
zo be lɛ gbee.

Title: LA 128
Content:
Hiɔwo kpakpa jeɔ Yawɛ tue bumi mi
1A gbaa nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ yee Yawɛ gbeye,
nɛ́ e yeɔ e mlaa amɛ a nɔ.
2O ma na o nya mi ngma bɔ nɛ sa
kɛ je ní nɛ o tsuɔ ɔ mi;
o bua maa jɔ,
nɛ e maa hi ha mo.
3O yo maa pee kaa wai tso
nɛ woɔ yiblii saminyayoo
ngɛ o we ɔ mi;
nɛ o bimɛ maa bɔle o we okplɔɔ ɔ afɛu mi
kaa oliv tsohi nɛ tsɛ̃ kɛ ma.
4Nyumu nɛ yeɔ Yawɛ gbeye ɔ,
niinɛ, bɔ nɛ a maa gbaa lɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
5Yawɛ nɛ gbaa mo kɛ je Zion.
O wami be ɔ tsuo ɔ,
o na bɔ nɛ Yerusalem ma plɔke ha.
6O wa, nɛ o na o bibimɛ.
Tue mi jɔmi nɛ ba Israel ma a mi!

Title: LA 129
Content:
A fa kue kɛ si Israel he nyɛli
1Israel, jehanɛ de,
“Kɛ je ye jokuɛwi a si tɔɔ ɔ,
ye he nyɛli wa mi yi mi wawɛɛ nitsɛ!”
2“Kɛ je ye jokuɛwi a si tɔɔ ɔ,
ye he nyɛli wa mi yi mi wawɛɛ nitsɛ,
se kɛ̃ ɔ, a nyɛ we mi.
3A plaa ye se mi wawɛɛ,
ye se mi pee kaa ngmɔ
nɛ a kɛ kpakplaa hu.
4Yawɛ lɛɛ nɔ́ nɛ da lɛ e peeɔ;
e je mi kɛ je yiwutsotsɛmɛ a dɛ mi.”
5Nihi tsuo nɛ sume Zion ɔ,
zo nɛ gbe mɛ
nɛ a kpale a se!
6A pee kaa nga nɛ ngɛ puɛe ngɛ tsu yi mi;
benɛ e na we nɛ e wa, kɛkɛ e gbli momo.
7Nga nɛ ɔ, nɔ ko fa we,
nɛ a fi we nɛ a tloo kɛ je.
8Nihi nɛ bee ɔ kó de ke,
“Yawɛ nɛ gbaa nyɛ!
Wa ngɛ nyɛ gbaae
ngɛ Yawɛ biɛ mi!”

Title: LA 130
Content:
Kue fami kɛ ha yemi kɛ buami
1Yawɛ, i ngɛ kue fae ha mo,
ejakaa ye yi fi wawɛɛ nitsɛ.
2Nyɔmtsɛ, bu mi tue;
bu ye pɛɛ kpami ɔ tue.
3Ke mo Mawu o ke o maa kane yayamihi ɔ,
Yawɛ, mɛnɔ maa ye e he.
4Se o ngɔɔ yayami kɛ paa,
konɛ a ye mo gbeye.
5I ngɛ Yawɛ blɔ hyɛe;
e munyu ɔ nɔ i ngɔ ye hɛ kɛ fɔ.
6Ee, Yawɛ blɔ pɛ i ngɛ hyɛe.
I ngɛ lɛ blɔ hyɛe
pe bɔ nɛ ma he buli huɔɔ nyɔnyɔɔnyɔ
kɛ ya suu mɔtu ɔ.
7Israel, ngɔɔ o hɛ kɛ fɔ Yawɛ nɔ,
ejakaa Yawɛ suɔmi ɔ be nyagbe;
lɛ nɛ e heɔ wa yi wami.
8 Lɛ nɔuu lɛ e ma kpɔ Israel
kɛ je a he yayamihi tsuo a mi.

Title: LA 131
Content:
Ngɔɔ hɛ kɛ fɔ Mawu nɔ kulaa
1Yawɛ, i wo we ye he nɔ, konɛ ye
hɛngmɛhi nɛ hi hiɔwe níhi pɛ hyɛe;
pohu ní nguanguahi, kɛ níhi nɛ ngɛ nyakpɛ tsɔ
ha mi ɔ, i nyɛɛ we a se.
2Anɔkuale mi ɔ, i ba ye he si,
nɛ i pee kpoo kaa bi nɛ a tsɔ lɛ nyɔ ngɛ e nyɛ kasa nya;
ye klaa pee kpoo ngɛ ye mi kaa bi nɛ a tsɔ lɛ nyɔ.
3Israel, ngɔɔ o hɛ kɛ fɔ Yawɛ nɔ
kɛ je be nɛ ɔ mi kɛ ya neneene.

Title: LA 132
Content:
Yawɛ we ɔ yi jemi la
1Yawɛ, mo kai amanehlu tsuo
nɛ David na a.
2E ka mo Yawɛ kita,
nɛ e wo mo Yakob Mawu Ope ɔ si ke,
3“I be ye we mi yae,
nɛ i ya be si hwɔe hulɔ.
4I be ye hɛ se jee,
nɛ i be kɔnɔɛ tete dee
5kɛ yaa si be nɛ ma na he ko ha mo Yawɛ,
Yakob Mawu Ope ɔ,
konɛ lejɛ ɔ nɛ pee o hi he!”
6 Wa nu somi daka a he ngɛ Betlehem,
nɛ wa ya na ngɛ Yearim ngmɔ ɔmɛ a mi.
7Wa de ke, “Nyɛ ha waa ya Yawɛ we ɔ
nɛ wa ya kpla si ngɛ e matsɛ sɛ ɔ hɛ mi!”
8Yawɛ, mo wo o he nɔ,
nɛ o ba o he jɔɔmi he ɔ;
ngɔɔ somi daka a nɛ ji o he wami okadi ɔ hu kɛ ba.
9Ha nɛ o we osɔfo ɔmɛ nɛ a pee nɔ́ nɛ da be tsuaa be,
nɛ o ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ nɛ a hwɔ lele!
10Yawɛ, mo nitsɛ lɛ o wo o tsɔlɔ David si,
nɛ o wo lɛ matsɛ,
lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ko kua lɛ.
11 Yawɛ, kita nɛ o ka David
nɛ o be o nya se kpalee ji,
“Ma wo o bimɛ ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake matsɛ,
nɛ e maa ye tsɛ ngɛ o se.
12Ke o bimɛ ɔmɛ maa ye ye somi ɔ nɔ,
nɛ ye mlaa amɛ nɛ ma wo mɛ ɔ hu
a maa ye a nɔ ɔ,
lɛɛ a bimɛ hu ma ba hi o sɛ ɔ nɔ
kɛ maa ya neneene.”
13Yawɛ nitsɛ lɛ suɔ nɛ e hla Zion
kaa lejɛ ɔ nɛ e maa hi.
14E de ke, “Hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ ma hi kɛ maa ya neneene;
hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ ma jɔɔ ye he ngɛ;
ejakaa i suɔ hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ.
15Ma ha Zion ma na niye ní babauu,
ma a mi ohiatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ maa ye ní maa tɔ.
16Ma gbaa osɔfo ɔmɛ a ní tsumi nɔ,
nɛ ma a mi bi ɔmɛ ma hwɔ lele!
17 Ma pee David nina kake matsɛ agbo
ngɛ hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ;
ma to lɛ si kaa nɔ nɛ imi nitsɛ i hla, nɛ i wo lɛ matsɛ.
18Ma ha zo maa gbe e he nyɛli ɔmɛ kpɔtɔɔ,
se e tsɛ yemi ɔ maa bɔ,
nɛ e ma he biɛ saminya.”

Title: LA 133
Content:
Nyɛmi suɔmi la
1Hyɛ bɔ nɛ e hi, bɔ nɛ e ngɛ fɛu,
ke nyɛmimɛ pee kake kɛ hi si!
2Nyɛmimɛ a kake peemi ngɛ kaa nu nɛ he jua wa
nɛ a kɛ pɔ Aaron yi mi,
nɛ ngɛ dɛe kɛ ngɛ e kpɛni mi puee
hluu kɛ ba su e tade klɔii ɔ nya tɔɔ!
3Nyɛmimɛ a kake peemi ngɛ kaa bɔ́ ngɛ Hermon yo ɔ nɔ;
e ngɛ kaa bɔ́ nɛ ngɛ nɛe ngɛ Zion yo ɔmɛ a nɔ.
Lejɛ ɔ nɛ Yawɛ wo si ngɛ
ke e maa gbaa e ma a
kɛ maa ya neneene.

Title: LA 134
Content:
A je Mawu yi
1Nyɛ Yawɛ tsɔli tsuo, nyɛɛ ba;
nyɛ je Yawɛ yi!
Nyɛ nɛ nyɛ sɔmɔɔ Yawɛ
ngɛ e we ɔ nyɔnyɔɔnyɔ,
nyɛ je e yi
2Nyɛ wo nyɛ nine nɔ ngɛ he klɔuklɔu ɔ,
nɛ nyɛ je Yawɛ yi.
3Yawɛ, nɔ nɛ pee hiɔwe kɛ zugba a,
é gbaa nyɛ kɛ je Zion.

Title: LA 135
Content:
Yi jemi la
1Nyɛ je Yawɛ yi!
Nyɛ je Yawɛ biɛ ɔ yi!
Nyɛ Yawɛ tsɔli tsuo,
nyɛ je e yi!
2Nyɛ nihi nɛ nyɛ daa si ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ,
ngɛ wa Mawu ɔ he klɔuklɔu ɔ,
nyɛ je e yi!
3Nyɛ je Yawɛ yi, ejakaa Yawɛ hi;
nyɛ la kɛ je e biɛ ɔ yi,
ejakaa e mi mi hi.
4Yawɛ nitsɛ lɛ hla Yakob kɛ ha e he;
e hla Israel kɛ pee e ma.
5Imi lɛɛ i le kaa Yawɛ kle;
Yawɛ kle pe mawu ɔmɛ tsuo kulaa.
6Hiɔwe ɔ jio, zugba a nɔ jio,
wo ɔ mi jio,
muɔ voovoo ɔmɛ a mi jio,
nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ́ Yawɛ suɔ ɔ, lɔ ɔ e peeɔ.
7Lɛ nɛ e haa bɔku teɔ si ngɛ je ɔ nyagbe he;
e pee oslabai kɛ ha hiɔmi,
nɛ e jeɔ kɔɔhiɔ kpo kɛ jee e to he ɔmɛ.
8Lɛ nɛ e gbe kekleekle bimɛ tsuo ngɛ Egipt,
nimli adesahi a bimɛ, kɛ lohwehi a bimɛ.
9Lɛ nɛ tsu nyakpɛ ní nguanguahi
kɛ gbla Egipt matsɛ ɔ, kɛ e tsɔli ɔmɛ a tue.
10Lɛ nɛ kpata je mahi babauu a hɛ mi,
nɛ e gbe matsɛmɛ nguangua nɛ ɔmɛ:
11Sihon, Amor bi a matsɛ ɔ,
Og, Bashan matsɛ ɔ,
kɛ Kanaan matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsuo;
12nɛ e ngɔ a zugba a kɛ ha e ma, Israel
kaa a weto ní.
13Yawɛ, o biɛ ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene;
Yawɛ, yi nɔhi tsuo ma kai mo.
14Yawɛ ma fa e ma a he;
e maa na e tsɔli ɔmɛ mɔbɔ.
15 Je ma amɛ a we amaga amɛ ɔ,
sika hiɔ kɛ sika tsu sɔuu,
nimli adesahi a nine nya ní tsumi ji mɛ.
16A ngɛ nya, se a tu we munyu;
a ngɛ hɛngmɛ, se a hyɛ we nɔ́.
17A ngɛ tue, se a nui nɔ́;
mumi ko hu be a gugwɔ mi nɛ a woɔ.
18I ná nɛ nihi nɛ pee mɛ,
kɛ nihi nɛ ngɔ a hɛ kɛ fɔ a nɔ ɔ tsuo
pee kaa amaga amɛ nɛ a pee ɔ nɔuu!
19Nyɛ Israel ma, nyɛ je Yawɛ yi!
Nyɛ Mawu we osɔfohi, nyɛ je Yawɛ yi!
20Nyɛ Levi bi, nyɛ je e yi;
nyɛ nihi tsuo nɛ nyɛ yee Yawɛ gbeye,
nyɛ je e yi!
21Nyɛ je Yawɛ yi ngɛ Zion;
nyɛ je e yi ngɛ e we ɔ mi ngɛ Yerusalem.
Nyɛ je Yawɛ yi!

Title: LA 136
LA 137
Content:
Israel bi ɔmɛ ye kɔmɔ ngɛ ma se.
1Babilon pa amɛ a tue wa hi si ngɛ nɛ wa wo yana,
benɛ wa kai Zion ɔ.
2Wa ngɔ wa kpa saku ɔmɛ ngɔ
kpla tsohi a he ngɛ pa a tue.
3Ejakaa nihi nɛ nuu wɔ
kɛ ho ma se ya a de wɔ ke wa la ha mɛ.
Nihi nɛ ngɛ wɔ haoe ɔ suɔ kaa wa je a hɛja;
a de wɔ ke, “Nyɛ la Zion la amɛ eko ha wɔ!”
4Mɛni he je wa ma la Yawɛ la ngɛ ma se?
5Ke ye hɛ je mo Yerusalem, o nɔ ɔ,
lɛɛ ye hiɔ nine nɛ gbo.
6Ke i kaii we mo Yerusalem,
nɛ ke i bui mo kaa
nɔ nɛ haa mi bua jɔmi pe kulaa a,
lɛɛ ye lilɛ nɛ mɛtɛ ye nya mi.
7Yawɛ, mo kai nɔ́ nɛ Edom bi ɔmɛ
pee Yerusalem ligbi ko ɔ.
Edom bi ɔmɛ de ke,
“Nyɛɛ ku ma a kɛ pue si;
nyɛɛ ku lɛ pue si
kɛ ya su e sisi tomi ɔmɛ tɔɔ!”
8 Mo Babilon, ja a kpata o hɛ mi kokooko!
A gbaa nɔ nɛ maa pee mo kɛ to nane mi
kaa bɔ nɛ o pee wɔ ɔ.
9A gbaa nɔ nɛ maa ngɔ o bimɛ
tsɔwitsɔwi ɔmɛ kɛ fiaa tɛ sa.

Title: LA 138
Content:
Sina
1Yawɛ, i ngɛ mo si nae kɛ ye tsui tsuo.
I ngɛ lae kɛ ngɛ o yi jee ngɛ
Mawu kpa amɛ a hɛ mi po.
2I ngɔ ye hɛ mi kɛ bu si
kɛ kpee sɔlemi we klɔuklɔu ɔ;
nɛ i ngɛ mo si nae
kaa o suɔmi ɔ ngɛ daa,
nɛ o yeɔ anɔkuale jã kɛ̃.
Jehanɛ hu o ha nɛ a na kaa
o biɛ kle pe biɛ tsuaa biɛ,
nɛ o munyu hu he jua wa
pe nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́.
3Ligbi ɔ nɛ i tsɛ mo ɔ, o he nɔ.
O wo mi kã, nɛ ye nɔ gbagba te.
4Yawɛ, matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ ngɛ je ɔ
mi ɔ ma je o yi,
ejakaa munyu nɛ je o nya a, a nu.
5A ma la kɛ gba nyakpɛ níhi nɛ o pee ɔ;
a ma la ma de ke o hɛ mi nyami ɔ kle.
6Yawɛ ngɛ hiɔwe lokoo mohu,
se nɔ nɛ baa e he si ɔ,
e hɛ hii e nɔ;
nɔ nɛ woɔ e he nɔ ɔ lɛɛ
e he sane ko pi Yawɛ sane.
7Ke i ngɛ amanehlu mi ɔ,
mo lɛ o jeɔ mi kɛ jeɔ mi.
Ke ye he nyɛli kɛ abofu ba na mi ɔ,
o kɛ mɛ kpee,
nɛ o kɛ o he wami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ
heɔ ye yi wami.
8Yawɛ, yi mi nɛ o to ha mi ɔ,
o maa ye nɔ,
ejakaa Yawɛ, o suɔmi ɔ ngɛ
kɛ yaa neneene.
Ní tsumi nɛ o je sisi ɔ,
koo ngmɛɛ he.

Title: LA 139
Content:
Mawu le nɔ tsuaa nɔ, nɛ e baa wa yi
1Yawɛ, o hyɛ ye mi tsuo,
nɛ o le bɔ nɛ i ngɛ.
2Ye si himi, kɛ ye si temi tsuo o le,
ye yi mi tomi tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ, o le momo.
3Ke i ma blɔ ɔ, o le
nɛ ke i hwɔ si hu o le;
ee, ye ní peemi níhi tsuo o le.
4Loko ma pa ye nya mi ke ma de nɔ́ ko ɔ,
mo Yawɛ, o le lɛ tsuo momo.
5O ngɔ o he wami kɛ bɔle mi kɛ kpe,
nɛ o buɔ ye he.
6Bɔ nɛ o le mi fitsofitso ɔ ngɛ nyakpɛ tsɔ.
Nile nɛ ɔ mi kuɔ pe bɔ nɛ
ma nyɛ ma nu sisi.
7Jije ma je o mumi ɔ hɛ mi kɛ maa ya?
Jije ma ya laa ye he ngɛ
nɛ o be mi nae?
8Ke i kuɔ kɛ ya hiɔwe ɔ,
ne mo ngɛ lejɛ ɔ;
nɛ ke i ya hwɔ si ngɛ gbeje hu
ne mo ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.
9Waa ngɔ lɛ kaa lohwe pɛlitsɛ ji mi,
nɛ i te papaapa kɛ je beleku je
kɛ ya ma bonyoku je se lokoo;
10lejɛ ɔ tete po mo lɛ o maa tsɔɔ mi blɔ,
nɛ o hiɔ nine maa su ye nɔ.
11Ke i de ke diblii ba ha ye nɔ,
loo pu la nɛ bɔle mi ɔ nɛ plɛ pee diblii ɔ,
12lɔ ɔ lɛɛ yaka gu, ejakaa diblii pee we diblii ha mo,
nɛ nyɔ mi tsɔɔ heii kaa piani nɔuu;
diblii jio, la jio, lɛ tsuo kake ha mo.
13Ye nɔmlɔ tso ɔ mi níhi tsuo ɔ,
mo lɛ o pee.
O puɛ mi ngɛ ye nyɛ muklii mi tɔɔ.
14I ngɛ o yi jee,
ejakaa bɔ nɛ o plɛ kɛ bɔ mi ɔ,
e ngɛ gbeye,
nɛ e ngɛ nyakpɛ hulɔ.
Níhi nɛ o pee ɔ ngɛ nyakpɛ loo!
O le mi fitsofitso.
15Benɛ a ngɛ mi puɛe ngɛ laami mi,
nɛ wu ɔmɛ ngɛ wae ngɛ ye nyɛ muklii mi tɔɔ ɔ,
i fɔɔ si paa ngɛ o hɛ mi.
16Benɛ a na we nɛ a fɔ mi lolo po ɔ,
a ngma ye wami be ɔ tsuo
ngɛ o womi ɔ mi momo.
17Mawu, yi mi tomi nɛ o ngɛ ha mi ɔ
he jua wa wawɛɛ nitsɛ.
Ní kpakpahi nɛ o susuɔ ha mi ɔ,
a he hiɛ babauu.
18Ke i ke ma kane mɛ ɔ,
i be nyɛe,
ejakaa a he hiɛ babauu pe zia.
Loko ye hɛ maa tsɛ po
o ngɛ ye he susue momo.
19Mawu, i na nɛ o gbe yiwusotsɛmɛ,
konɛ ma ye ye he
kɛ je muɔ si pueli nɛ ɔmɛ a dɛ mi.
20Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ tuɔ musu bɔmi munyu,
nɛ a teɔ si kɛ woɔ mo.
21Nihi nɛ bui mo ɔ, anɛ imi lɛɛ i buɔ mɛ lo?
Nihi nɛ tsɔɔ o hɛ mi atuã a,
anɛ i suɔ mɛ lo?
22Dɛbi, i sume mɛ saasaa;
i buɔ mɛ ye he nyɛli.
23Mawu, hyɛ ye tsui mi
nɛ o le mi.
Kaa mi nɛ o hyɛ,
nɛ o na níhi nɛ ngɛ ye juɛmi mi.
24Hyɛ kaa yayami ko pa ngɛ ye mi lo,
nɛ o ngɔ mi kɛ fɔ blɔ
nɛ kɛ nɔ yaa neneene wami mi ɔ nɔ.

Title: LA 140
Content:
Kue fami kɛ ha yi baami
1Yawɛ, mo he ye yi wami;
jé mi kɛ je yiwutsotsɛmɛ a dɛ mi.
2Mɛɛ lɛɛ yayami he pɛ a susuɔ.
Daa nɛ ɔ, pɛ kɛkɛ a ngɛ woe.
3 A lilɛ ngɛ kaa sinɔ duɔtsɛ nɔ́.
A munyu ngɛ kaa sanga duɔ.
4Yawɛ, bu ye he;
jé mi kɛ je yiwutsotsɛmɛ a dɛ mi;
ejakaa a to a yi mi kaa a maa tsɛ̃ mi kɛ fia si.
5He nɔ woli tsɔ klamahi ngɛ blɔ ɔmɛ a tue.
A tsɔ mi klama, konɛ a du mi.
6I deɔ Yawɛ ke, “Mo ji ye Mawu!”
Yawɛ, moo bu ye kue fami ɔ tue!
7Ye Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, ye yi wami helɔ kpanaa,
ta be mi ɔ, mo nɔuu lɛ o baa ye yi.
8Yawɛ, koo ngmɛ yayami peeli blɔ nɛ a pee nɔ́ nɛ a suɔ;
ko ha nɛ a yi mi tomi yaya amɛ nɛ ba mi.
9Nihi nɛ bɔle mi kɛ kpe ɔ ngɛ ye he gbeye woe.
Ha nɛ ga yaya nɛ a ngɛ toe ngɛ ye he ɔ
nɛ kpata mɛ nitsɛmɛ a hɛ mi.
10Ha nɛ la ngu hɛuu ba pue a nɔ!
A ya nɔ muɔ mi
nɛ a ko nyɛ kpo nɛ a je gblegbleegble.
11Ko ha lakpatsɛmɛ nɛ gbeɔ nɔ he guɛ
nɛ a plɔke ngɛ zugba a nɔ.
Ha nɛ yayami peeli a hɛ mi nɛ kpata amlɔ nɔuu.
12Yawɛ, i le kaa nihi nɛ a ní ngɛ mɔbɔ ɔ,
mo lɛ o hyɛɛ a nɔ,
nɛ o yeɔ ohiatsɛmɛ a sane ha mɛ.
13Niinɛ, nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a
maa na mo si;
kpakpa peeli kɛ mo maa hi si daa.

Title: LA 141
Content:
Kue nɛ a faa gbɔkuɛ
1Yawɛ, mo i ngɛ tsɛe;
o he nɛ sɔ ha mi;
mo i ngɛ tsɛe boboobo ɔ nɛ,
bu mi tue koo!
2 Ha nɛ ye kue fami ɔ nɛ je via
kaa tsopa kɛ e he via ngɛ o hɛ mi;
nɛ ye nine nɛ i wo nɔ kɛ ya hiɔwe ɔ,
e pee kaa bɔ nɛ i ngɛ sãe
gbɔkuɛ nya si ha mo.
3Yawɛ, moo to bulɔ nɛ hyɛ ye nya nɔ,
konɛ e hyɛ ye munyu tumi nɔ.
4Piɛ ye he, konɛ ma ko na yayami peemi he bua jɔmi;
piɛ ye he, konɛ i kɛ yayami peeli ko bɔ;
nɛ ko ha ma ya ye a niye ní
ngɔngɔɛ ɔ eko.
5Ha nɛ dalɔ nɛ gba mi ma,
nɛ e ngɔ e mi mi himi ɔ kɛ ka ye hɛ mi;
se ko ha nɛ yayami peeli nɛ a je ye yi;
ejakaa be tsuaa be ɔ, i faa kue
kɛ siɔ a yayami ɔmɛ.
6Ke a ngɔ a matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ kɛ wo nihi
nɛ ma kpata a hɛ mi a dɛ mi ɔ,
ma a ma na maa le kaa
Yawɛ munyu ɔ, anɔkuale sisiisi.
7Ke a ngɛ tɛ sa gbae ɔ,
bɔ nɛ tɛ ɔ gbɛɛ kɛ fĩaa zugba a
tsuo nɔ ɔ,
ja a ma sake a wuhi
kɛ pue gbeje agbo ɔ nya.
8Se mo Yawɛ ye Nyɔmtsɛ i ngɛ hyɛe;
mo ji ye wesa he;
koo ngmɛɛ ye he kulaa kɛ fɔ si;
bu ye he.
9Je mi kɛ je klama nɛ he nyɛli
tsɔ mi ɔ mi.
Je mi kɛ je yayami peeli a klama mi.
10Ha nɛ yiwutsotsɛmɛ tsuo
nɛ a ya nɔ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a klamahi a mi,
se imi lɛɛ ha ma je a mi slɔkee.

Title: LA 142
Content:
Kue fami kɛ ha yemi kɛ buami
1 Yawɛ i ngɛ tsɛe wawɛɛ
ke e ba piɛ ye he ɔ nɛ.
I wo ye gbi nɔ wawɛɛ kɛ ngɛ lɛ pɛɛ kpae.
2I ngɔ ye kɔmɔ ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ ba e hɛ mi;
i de lɛ ye haomi ɔmɛ tsuo.
3Benɛ ye nine mi miɔ nɛ e wo nyu ɔ,
moo lɛɛ o le ye hiami ɔ mo.
Ye he nyɛli ɔmɛ tsɔ mi klama
ngɛ ye blɔ ɔ mi.
4Ke i hyɛ ye hiɔ nɔ ɔ,
nɔ ko nɔ ko be nɛ maa je ngmlaa ha mi;
wesa he ko kulaa be ha mi,
nɔ ko nɔ ko bui ye he akɔtaa.
5Yawɛ, mo i ngɛ tsɛe ɔ nɛ.
I ngɛ dee ke
mo pɛ ji ye wesa he ngɛ je ɔ mi.
6Moo bu ye kue fami ɔ tue koo,
ejakaa peepee ta ye he kulaa.
Kpɔ mi kɛ je yiwutsotsɛmɛ a dɛ mi.
7Ye yi fi; ejakaa a he wa pe mi.
Je mi, konɛ ma na mo si
ngɛ nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a hɛ mi;
ejakaa kpakpa nitsɛnitsɛ o maa pee mi ɔ nɛ.

Title: LA 143
Content:
Kue fami kɛ ha yemi kɛ buami
1Yawɛ bu ye kue fami ɔ tue;
mo ta tue ha pɛɛ nɛ i ngɛ mo kpae ɔ.
Akɛnɛ o yeɔ anɔkuale, nɛ o peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a,
bu mi tue nɛ o he nɔ ha mi koo!
2 O kɛ imi, o tsɔlɔ ɔ kó ye sane;
ejakaa nɔmlɔ adesa ko adesa ko be nguɔ yee
ngɛ o hɛ mi.
3Ye he nyɛlɔ ɔ nyɛɛ ye se
nɛ e ma kpata ye hɛ mi.
E fia mi nɔ́ wawɛɛ,
nɛ e tsɛ̃ ye yi se ngɔ wo diblii kpii mi;
i pee kaa nɔ ko nɛ gbo momoomo.
4Ye mumu nya ta jehanɛ,
nɛ peepee ta ye he!
5I kaii sa blema a,
nɛ i susuɔ níhi tsuo nɛ o tsu ɔ a he;
i susuɔ níhi nɛ o pee ɔ a he.
6I woɔ ye nine nɔ kɛ yaa hiɔwe kɛ faa kue.
Bɔ nɛ zugba gbigbli hlaa nyu kɛ jɔɔ e he ɔ,
ja o he kuma ngɛ mi yee.
7Yawɛ, he mi nɔ esɔ koo!
Ye hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi tsuo miɔ nɛ e ta.
Koo ngɔ o he kɛ laa mi;
ke pi ja a, i kɛ gbogboe ɔmɛ ngɛ gbeje maa sɔ.
8Mɔtu ɔ, ha ma kai bɔ nɛ o mi mi hi ha;
ejakaa o nɔ i ngɔɔ ye hɛ kɛ fɔɔ.
Ha nɛ ma le he nɛ ma gu;
ejakaa mo pɛ o nɔ i ngɔ ye hɛ kɛ fɔ.
9Yawɛ, jé mi kɛ je ye he nyɛli ɔmɛ a dɛ mi.
O ngɔ i ba sa we ngɛ.
10Moo tsɔɔ mi nɛ ma pee nɔ́ nɛ o suɔ;
ejakaa mo ji ye Mawu.
Ha nɛ o mumi kpakpa a nɛ tsɔɔ mi blɔ nɛ hi,
nɛ e nɔ jɔ.
11Yawɛ, mo he ye yi wami kaa bɔ nɛ o wo si ɔ.
O peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da, lɔ ɔ he ɔ,
mo je mi kɛ je haomi mi.
12O suɔmi nɛ be nyagbe ɔ he je ɔ,
moo gbe ye he nyɛli ɔmɛ;
nɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ mi haoe ɔ,
mo kpata a hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ;
ejakaa o tsɔlɔ ji mi.

Title: LA 144
Content:
Matsɛ ko ye kunimi nɛ e na Mawu si
1Nyɛ je Yawɛ yi,
lɛ ji ye yi baalɔ.
E tsɔɔ mi bɔ nɛ a gbaa ta,
kɛ bɔ nɛ a miaa kɛ hwuu ta.
2Lɛ ji ye yi baalɔ, ye wesa he nitsɛnitsɛ, kɛ ye kpɔlɔ;
lɛ ji ye tsɛ̃i, nɛ e ngɔ i ya saa we ngɛ.
Lɛ ji nɔ nɛ baa ma a si kɛ woɔ ye sisi.
3 Yawɛ, mɛnɔ kulaa ji nɔmlɔ
nɛ o peeɔ e he akɔtaa,
loo nɔmlɔ adesa nɛ o susuɔ e he ɔ?
4Nɔmlɔ adesa ngɛ kaa mumu nɛ a woɔ ɔ;
e ligbi ɔmɛ ngɛ kaa hɔ̃ nɛ bee kɛ yaa.
5Yawɛ, ha nɛ hiɔwe ɔ nɛ ba si,
nɛ o kple si kɛ ba.
Moo ta yo ɔmɛ a he,
konɛ a je la su ku.
6Ha nɛ oslabai nɛ gba,
nɛ o gbɛ o he nyɛli ɔmɛ ngɔ fĩa;
tsɛ̃ o kɛ̃ɛ̃ mi bi ɔmɛ,
nɛ o wo mɛ fo.
7Kpa o nine mi kɛ je hiɔwe, nɛ o sá mi;
jé mi kɛ je nyu babauu ɔ mi;
jé mi kɛ je nibwɔhi a dɛ mi;
8a nya mi munyu ɔ, lakpa sɔuu,
nɛ a yeɔ lakpa kɛ kaa kita po.
9Mawu, ma la la he ha mo,
ma fia kpa saku nɛ hɛɛ kpa nyɔngma
kɛ je o yi.
10Mo lɛ o haa matsɛmɛ yeɔ kunimi,
nɛ o heɔ o tsɔlɔ David yi wami.
11He mi kɛ je klaate nɛ yeɔ awi ɔ nya,
mo kpɔ mi kɛ je nibwɔhi a dɛ mi,
nihi nɛ a nya mi munyu ɔ, lakpa sɔuu,
nɛ kita po a yeɔ lakpa kɛ kaa a.
12Ha nɛ wa binyumuhi nɛ ngɛ nihe mi ɔ,
a he nɛ wa kaa tso nɛ maa si saminya.
Ha nɛ wa biyihi nɛ a pee kaa tɛ titima
kɛ ha matsɛ mɔ fiami.
13Wa blɛfo gba amɛ nɛ a hyi tɔ kɛ ngma,
nɛ a na niye ní slɔɔtoslɔɔtohi ngɛ lejɛ ɔ;
wa to ɔmɛ hu nɛ a fɔ babauu akpeakpe abɔ ngɛ kɔpe ɔmɛ a mi.
14Wa na amɛ hu nɛ a fɔ babauu ja nɔuu;
a mi ko sane;
nɛ a ko nu bubuubui ko
ngɛ wa gbɛjegbɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ.
15Nihi nɛ a gbaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ, a bua maa jɔ.
Nihi nɛ Yawɛ ji a Mawu ɔ,
a bua maa jɔ.

Title: LA 145
Content:
Yi jemi la
1Ye Mawu kɛ ye matsɛ,
ma wo o hɛ mi nyami,
nɛ ma na mo si daa.
2Ma na mo si daa ligbi,
nɛ ma je o yi kɛ maa ya neneene.
3Yawɛ kle, nɛ e sa kaa a je e yi wawɛɛ nitsɛ.
E kle pe bɔ nɛ adesa juɛmi ma nyɛ maa su he.
4Yi nɔ kake ma je níhi nɛ o tsu ɔ a yi
kɛ tsɔɔ yi nɔ nɛ nyɛɛ se ɔ;
nɛ he wami níhi nɛ o tsu ɔ,
a maa sɛɛ kɛ ha mɛ.
5O hɛ mi nyami, o we agboje,
kɛ nyakpɛ níhi nɛ o tsu ɔ,
ma susu a he saminya.
6Nihi maa fiɛ nyakpɛ ní, kɛ ní nguanguahi
nɛ o pee ɔ,
nɛ imi hu ma fiɛ ke o kle niinɛ.
7A ma de ke o mi mi hi saminya.
A ma la boboobo ke daa nɛ ɔ,
nɔ́ nɛ da pɛ o peeɔ.
8Dloolɔ kɛ mɔbɔ nalɔ ji Yawɛ;
e mi mi fu we mla,
nɛ e suɔmi hiɛ babauu.
9Yawɛ peeɔ nɔ tsuaa nɔ kpakpa,
nɛ e nuɔ nɔ́ he ha níhi tsuo nɛ e bɔ ɔ.
10Yawɛ, níhi nɛ o pee ɔ tsuo maa na mo si,
nɛ o ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ ma je o yi!
11A maa sɛɛ o matsɛ yemi ɔ
hɛ mi nyami ɔ he ní,
nɛ a ma de ke o kle saminya.
12Kɛkɛ ɔ, nihi tsuo maa le ní nguanguahi nɛ o pee,
kɛ o matsɛ yemi ɔ we agboje.
13O matsɛ yemi ɔ ngɛ daa,
nɛ o nɔ yemi ɔ ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene.
Yawɛ yeɔ e siwo nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ,
nɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ e peeɔ ɔ hi saminya.
14Nihi nɛ ngɛ haomi mi ɔ, e piɛɔ a he,
nɛ nihi nɛ nɔ si ɔ, e woɔ a nɔ
kɛ daa si ekohu.
15Bɔ níhi tsuo nɛ wami ngɛ a mi ɔ,
mo pɛ nɛ a ngɛ blɔ hyɛe;
ejakaa mo lɛ o haa mɛ a niye ní
ngɛ be nɛ sa mi.
16O bliɔ o dɛ mi,
nɛ o haa nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ hɛ ngmengmle tɔɔ.
17Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ peeɔ ɔ da;
e naa mɔbɔ be tsuaa be.
18Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ tsɛɔ Yawɛ
ngɛ anɔkuale mi ɔ,
Yawɛ hɛɛ lɛ kɛ suu e he.
19Nihi nɛ yee lɛ gbeye ɔ,
e peeɔ a hiami ní kɛ haa mɛ.
E buu a kue fami ɔmɛ hu tue,
nɛ e heɔ a yi wami.
20Nihi tsuo nɛ suɔ Yawɛ ɔ,
e baa a yi;
se yiwutsotsɛmɛ lɛɛ
e ma kpata a hɛ mi.
21Ma je Yawɛ yi,
nɛ ma ha nimli adesahi tsuo ma je e yi
kɛ maa ya neneene.

Title: LA 146
Content:
Nyɛ je Mawu, yi wami helɔ ɔ yi
1Nyɛ je Yawɛ yi!
Imi hu ma je Yawɛ yi!
2Be abɔ nɛ ye hɛ ngɛ nɛ ɔ,
ma je Yawɛ yi!
Ligbi abɔ nɛ i ngɛ wami mi nɛ ɔ,
ma la kɛ je ye Mawu ɔ yi!
3Nyɛ ko ngɔ nyɛ hɛ kɛ fɔ ganɔ ko,
loo nɔmlɔ adesa ko nɔ,
ejakaa e be he wami nɛ e ma he nyɛ yi wami.
4Ke nɔmlɔ gbo ɔ,
e kpaleɔ kɛ yaa zu mi ekohu,
jamɛ a ligbi ɔ nɔuu e yi mi tomi ɔmɛ tsuo a se poɔ.
5Nɔ nɛ Yakob Mawu ɔ ji e he piɛlɔ,
nɛ e ngɔɔ e hɛ kɛ fɔɔ Yawɛ e Mawu ɔ nɔ ɔ,
a gbaa lɛ.
6 Mawu nɛ pee hiɔwe, zugba, wo,
kɛ a mi níhi tsuo,
nɛ e yeɔ e siwo nɔ daa.
7Nihi nɛ a waa mɛ yi mi ɔ,
e yeɔ a sane kɛ haa mɛ.
Nihi nɛ hwɔ ngɛ mɛ yee ɔ,
e haa mɛ niye ní.
Nihi nɛ a wo mɛ tsu ɔ,
e jeɔ mɛ.
8Yawɛ bliɔ hɛ yuyuili a hɛngmɛ;
Yawɛ woɔ ni nɛmɛ nɛ nɔ si a nɔ;
Yawɛ suɔ ni nɛmɛ nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da.
9Yawɛ baa nibwɔhi a yi;
e yeɔ yalɔyihi, kɛ awusahi a sane kɛ haa mɛ;
se yiwutsotsɛmɛ lɛɛ
e haa a yi mi tomi peeɔ yaka.
10Yawɛ maa ye tsɛ daa.
Zion, o Mawu ɔ maa ye matsɛ
kɛ maa ya neneene.
Nyɛ je Yawɛ yi!

Title: LA 147
Content:
Nyɛ je Mawu Ope ɔ yi
1Nyɛ je Yawɛ yi!
E hi kaa a la kɛ je wa Mawu ɔ yi;
ejakaa dloolɔ ji lɛ,
nɛ e sa kaa a la kɛ je e yi.
2Yawɛ ngɛ Yerusalem sisi toe ekohu;
e ngɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ nɛ gbɛ fĩa a
a nya buae kɛ ba.
3Ni nɛmɛ nɛ a tsui ku ɔ, e ngɛ mɛ tsae,
nɛ e ngɛ a pa amɛ a nɔ fie.
4E le dodoe ɔmɛ tsuo a yibɔ,
nɛ e kɛ a biɛhi tsɛɔ mɛ kakaaka.
5Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ kle;
e ngɛ he wami babauu,
nɛ e nile hu a li nya.
6Yawɛ piɛɔ nihi nɛ a waa mɛ yi mi a he;
se yiwutsotsɛmɛ lɛɛ
e sakee mɛ ngɔ fiaa si.
7Nyɛ la sina la ha Yawɛ;
nyɛɛ fia saku nɛ nyɛ la kɛ je wa Mawu ɔ yi!
8Lɛ nɛ e ngɔɔ bɔku kɛ haa hiɔwe,
nɛ e haa hiɔmi nɛɛ kɛ pueɔ zugba a nɔ,
nɛ nga mumu puɛɔ ngɛ yo ɔmɛ a nɔ.
9Lɛ nɛ e haa nga mi lohwehi niye ní,
nɛ ke kuakualabite bihi ngɛ pɛe hu,
lɛ nɛ e haa mɛ ní.
10Okpɔngɔ nɛ he wa tete po e bui;
fo tulɔ kpanaa hu pi nɔ́ ko kulaa ngɛ e hɛ mi.
11Se nihi nɛ yeɔ lɛ gbeye,
nɛ ngɔɔ a hɛ kɛ fɔɔ e nɔ
kaa e maa na mɛ mɔbɔ daa a,
mɛɛ e naa a he bua jɔmi.
12Yerusalem, mo je Yawɛ yi!
Zion, mo je o Mawu ɔ yi!
13Ejakaa e peeɔ o we agbo ɔmɛ a se lami ní ɔmɛ kpɛii,
nɛ e gbaa o bimɛ ɔmɛ.
14E haa tue mi jɔmi baa o zugba a nɔ,
nɛ niye ní buu tɔ.
15Ke e wo gbi ɔ, a nuɔ ngɛ zugba a nɔ,
nɛ a yeɔ nɔ nɔuu.
16E haa nɛ snoo nɛɔ kaa doti,
nɛ e gbɛɔ bɔ́ nɛ fi ɔ kɛ fĩaa kaa la zu.
17E haa gbiɛ ngo ngu nɛɔ kaa dongo tɛ.
Mɛnɔ ma nyɛ maa da e fĩɛ ɔ nya?
18Ke e fa a, gbiɛ ngo ngu ɔmɛ sileɔ;
e haa kɔɔhiɔ fiaa, kɛkɛ nyu ɔ bɔni nyɛɛmi.
19E wo Israel mlaa,
nɛ e tsɔɔ mɛ bɔ nɛ a ja Mawu ha.
20E pee we kikɛ nɛ ɔ ha we ma ko ma ko hyɛ,
nɛ e mlaa amɛ hu, ma kpa ko li.
Nyɛ je Yawɛ yi!

Title: LA 148
Content:
Je ɔ tsuo nɛ je Mawu yi
1Nyɛ je Yawɛ yi!
Nyɛ je Yawɛ yi kɛ je hiɔwe.
Nyɛ je e yi ngɛ hiɔwe lokoo!
2Nyɛ Mawu bɔfohi tsuo, nyɛ je e yi!
Nyɛ e ta a tsuo, nyɛ je e yi!
3Pu, kɛ nyɔhiɔ, nyɛ je e yi!
Nyɛ dodoehi tsuo nɛ kpɛɔ, nyɛ je e yi!
4Nyɛ hiɔwe tsuo, nyɛ je e yi!
Nyu nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe yi mi, mo je e yi!
5Ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ a je Yawɛ yi;
ejakaa lɛ nɛ e fa
nɛ a bɔ mɛ.
6E ngɔ mɛ ngɔ ma si kɛ yaa neneene.
E wo huzu ha mɛ, nɛ a be hanee.
7Nyɛ nihi nɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ tsuo,
nyɛ je Yawɛ yi!
Nyɛ wo mi lo nguanguahi, kɛ muɔ voovoohi tsuo,
nyɛ je e yi!
8La, gbiɛ ngo ngu, snoo, bɔ nɛ fi,
kɛ ahumi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ Yawɛ tsɔmi nɔ,
nyɛ je e yi!
9Yo nguanguahi, kɛ yo wawi tsuo,
tsohi nɛ woɔ yiblii, kɛ seda tsohi tsuo,
10nga mi lohwehi, kɛ we mi lohwehi tsuo,
lohwehi nɛ sãã si, kɛ lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ,
nyɛ je e yi!
11Zugba a nɔ matsɛmɛ, kɛ ma amɛ tsuo,
ganɔhi, kɛ ma nɔ yeli tsuo,
12nihewi kɛ yihewi tsuo,
nikɔtɔmahi kɛ jokuɛwi tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ,
nyɛ je e yi!
13Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ a je Yawɛ yi,
ejakaa lɛ nɔ kake too lɛ ngɛ biɛ nɛ kle agbo;
e hɛ mi nyami ha zugba a nɔ tsuo
kɛ be hiɔwe tete he.
14E to e ma a sisi kɛ he wami saminya.
lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e ma a tsuo ngɛ e yi jee;
e ma a ji Israel,
nɛ e he jua wa ha lɛ kaa nɔ́ ko.
Nyɛ je Yawɛ yi!

Title: LA 149
Content:
Yi jemi la
1Nyɛ je Yawɛ yi!
Nyɛ la la he kɛ ha Yawɛ.
Nyɛ je e yi ngɛ ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ a kpe ɔ mi!
2Israel, nya o bɔlɔ ɔ he.
Zion bi, nyɛ nya nyɛ matsɛ ɔ he.
3Á do nɛ a kɛ je e yi.
Á la nɛ a fiɛ do, nɛ a fia saku
kɛ je e yi.
4Ejakaa Yawɛ naa e ma a he bua jɔmi.
E haa nihi nɛ baa a he si yeɔ kunimi.
5Ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ nɛ a hwɔ lele
kɛ tsɔɔ kaa a ye kunimi niinɛ,
nɛ a la kɛ bua jɔmi nyɔ mi tsuo.
6Á la kɛ he wami kɛ je Mawu yi.
Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, á hɛɛ klaate nya enyɔtsɛ
ngɛ a dɛ mi,
7konɛ a kɛ gbla je ma amɛ a tue
ngɛ yayami nɛ a pee ɔ he.
8Á wo a matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ kɔsɔkɔsɔ,
nɛ a we ablade ɔmɛ ɔ,
a bɔ mɛ dade pã;
9a gbla je ma amɛ a tue
kaa bɔ nɛ a ngma kɛ to ɔ.
Mawu ma a tsuo ye kunimi!
Nyɛ je Yawɛ yi!

Title: LA 150
Content:
Nyɛ je Yawɛ yi
1Nyɛ je Yawɛ yi!
Nyɛ je Mawu yi ngɛ e he klɔuklɔu ɔ;
nyɛ je e yi ngɛ e bɔku kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ mi!
2Nyɛ je e yi ngɛ he wami níhi nɛ e tsu ɔ a he;
nyɛ je e yi, ejakaa e kle agbo.
3Nyɛ kpa titimati kɛ je e yi,
nyɛ je e yi kɛ saku, kɛ kpa saku!
4Nyɛɛ fia miɛ, nɛ nyɛɛ do kɛ je e yi;
nyɛ je e yi kɛ kpa saku, kɛ bɛ!
5Nyɛ je e yi kɛ gɔgɔ nɛ nya wa;
nyɛ je e yi kɛ gɔgɔ nɛ jijeɔ!
6Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ woɔ mumi ɔ,
e je Yawɛ yi!
Nyɛ je Yawɛ yi.

Title: ABƐ NYA TSƆƆMI
Content:
NYA TSƆƆMI
Munyuhi nɛ ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ mi ji tsɔɔmihi nɛ kɔɔ je mi bami kpakpa, kɛ Mawu jami he. A ngma munyu ɔmɛ ngɛ abɛbu mi, nɛ babauu kɔɔ níhi nɛ yaa nɔ daa ligbi a he. Kekleekle ɔ, munyu ɔmɛ deɔ wɔ ke, “Ke o suɔ nɛ o na nile ɔ, ja o ye Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ gbeye.” Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, pi kaa Mawu mlaa amɛ a nɔ yemi sisiisi kɛkɛ nɛ he hia nɔmlɔ adesa. Se á na ngɛ e ní peepee mi kaa e juɛmi mi kuɔ, nɛ e baa e je mi bɔ nɛ sa. Juɛmi, kɛ ga nɛ blema Israel tsɔɔli ɔmɛ kɛ tsu ní ɔ, jeɔ kpo ngɛ abɛ munomuno kpitikpiti nɛ ɔmɛ fuu a mi. Ke sane ko ba je ní lelɔ blɔ mi tlukaa a, bɔ nɛ e plɛɔ kɛ tsuɔ he ní ɔ, yeɔ munyu nɛ ɔ he odase. E ma nyɛ pee weku sane, ní tsumi blɔ nya tomi sane, bu nɛ sa nɛ e hi nyɛmi kɛ nyɛmi a kpɛti, loo he nɔ yemi. Abɛ ɔmɛ deɔ wɔ níhi babauu ngɛ subai kpakpa nɛ ɔmɛ a he: humi si himi, tsui si tomi, bu nɛ sa kaa waa ngɔ kɛ ha ohiatsɛmɛ, kɛ anɔkuale yemi ngɛ huɛmɛ a kpɛti.
Bɔ nɛ a dla womi ɔ mi ha
A je nile yi 1.1—9.18
Salomo abɛhi 10.1—29.27
Agur munyuhi 30.1-33
Munyu kpa komɛ 31.1-31

Title: ABƐ 1
Content:
Abɛhi a he se nami
1 Israel matsɛ, Salomo, David bi ɔ abɛhi ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ.
2Abɛ nɛ ɔmɛ ma ha nɛ o maa le ní; a maa wo mo ga kpakpa, nɛ a ma ha nɛ o maa nu sanehi nɛ a mi kuɔ a sisi. 3Abɛ ɔmɛ maa tsɔɔ mo anɔkuale yemi, dami sane yemi, kɛ nɔ́ nɛ da peemi. 4Nɔ nɛ li nɔ́ ɔ, abɛ ɔmɛ ma ha nɛ e nɔ bɔ ma tsɔ; se niheyo lɛɛ e ma na juɛmi, kɛ hɛ mi si kami. 5Ke ní lelɔ nu abɛ nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, e nile ɔ maa hiɛ kɛ pue nɔ; juɛmitsɛ hu e juɛmi ɔ mi ma blɛke pe kekle ɔ, 6konɛ a nyɛ nɛ a nu abɛhi, kɛ ní leli a munyuhi nɛ a mi kuɔ ɔ a sisi saminya.
A wo nihewi ga
7 Loko o ma na nile ɔ, ja o ye Yawɛ gbeye. Kuasiahi bui nile, nɛ slɔmi gbi hu a sume.
8Ye bi, ke o tsɛ ngɛ mo tsɔsee ɔ, bu tue! Ke o nyɛ hu ngɛ mo ní tsɔɔe ɔ, ko kua! 9Ejakaa lɔ ɔmɛ nɛ ma dla mo nɛ o ba o je mi saminya, kaa bɔ nɛ duku kpakpa, loo kuɛ ní haa nɔ he peeɔ fɛu ɔ.
10Ye bi, ke yayami peeli ngɛ mo mlɔɔe ɔ, koo nyɛɛ a se. 11Ke a de mo ke, “Ha nɛ waa ho nɛ wa ya hla nɔ ko waa gbe! Ha wa ya wo nɔ ko nɛ pee we nɔ́ ko ka, nɛ waa gbe lɛ yaka gu! 12Waa mii mɛ hɛ ngmengmle kaa a yaa gbeje; waa ngɔ mɛ kaa yɔkɔ ngɔɔ gbogboe, be mi nɛ a ngɛ kpakpataa! 13Wa ma na ní kpakpahi nɛ a he jua wa babauu, nɛ wa we ɔmɛ ma hyi tɔtɔɔtɔ kɛ níhi nɛ wa ha. 14Ba piɛ wa he. Ke wa ná nɔ́ ko ɔ, wɔ tsuo wa maa dla lɛ fiee!”
15Ye bi, o kɛ kikɛmɛ a nimli ko bɔ. Koo nyɛɛ a se. 16A he sɔɔ kɛ yayami peemi; a he sɔɔ kɛ pueɔ muɔ si. 17Ke lohwe pɛlitsɛ ngɛ mo hyɛe nɛ o tsɔ lɛ klama a, o tsu yaka ní. 18Se nimli kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔmɛ lɛɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a he klama a tsɔ ɔ nɛ; mɛ nitsɛmɛ lɛ a maa du klama a, nɛ a ma gbo. 19Nihi tsuo nɛ guu awi yemi mi kɛ naa ní ɔ, bɔ nɛ a nyagbe ya baa ji nɛ ɔ nɛ; awi yemi mi nɔuu a gboɔ ngɛ.
Nile wo gbi
20 Nile ngɛ ngmlaa kpae boboobo ngɛ gbɛjegbɛ nɔ, kɛ jua mi. 21E ngɛ kpae boboobo ngɛ ma agbo ɔmɛ a nya, kɛ hehi tsuo nɛ nihi buaa a he nya ngɛ. E ngɛ dee ke,
22“Kuasiahi! Mɛni be nyɛ maa biɛ kɛ yaa si? Fɛu yeli! Mɛni be nyɛ maa ye fɛu kɛ yaa si? Anɛ nyɛ be ní kasee? 23Nyɛɛ bu tue nɛ ma ka nyɛ hɛ mi. Ma wo nyɛ ga kpakpa, nɛ i kɛ nyɛ maa tu nile munyu. 24I hla nyɛ se blɔ, nɛ i tsɛ nyɛ si abɔ ke nyɛɛ ba ye ngɔ. Se nyɛ bui fɛɛ. 25Ga tsuo nɛ i wo nyɛ ɔ, nyɛ ngɔɛ, nɛ nyɛ kplɛɛ we kaa ma kua nɔ́ ha nyɛ. 26Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke haomi ba nyɛ nɔ ɔ, imi hu ma muɔ nyɛ. Ke nyɛ hɛ dɔ ɔ, ma ye nyɛ he fɛu. 27Ke haomi ba nyɛ nɔ kaa nɔ́ nɛ kɔɔhiɔ nɛ nya wa lɛ ngɛ fiae, nɛ amanehlu ba na nyɛ kaa lasiogblee, nɛ nyɛ ngɛ nyɛ tsui yee ɔ, 28jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, nyɛ ma tsɛ mi, se i be nɔ hee. Nyɛ ma hla ye se blɔ kɛ hɛdɔ, nɛ nyɛ be mi nae. 29Ejakaa nyɛ bui nile he akɔtaa; Yawɛ hu, nyɛ yi lɛ gbeye. 30Nyɛ sume ga womi; nɛ ke i ka nyɛ hɛ mi hu, nyɛ kplɛɛ we. 31Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ tsu ɔ, lɔ ɔ he hiɔwo nyɛ ma na; nyɛ ní yaya amɛ nɔuu maa hao nyɛ. 32Kuasiahi gboɔ, ejakaa a bui nile; a heɔ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a he yeɔ, nɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ kpataa a hɛ mi. 33Se nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ buɔ mi tue ɔ, e maa hi si ngɛ he jɔmi mi, nɛ e be gbeye yee kaa haomi ko maa ba e nɔ.”

Title: ABƐ 2
Content:
Nile he se namihi
1Ye bi, bu ye munyu ɔmɛ tue, nɛ o pɛtɛ ye mlaa amɛ a he saminya. 2Bu nile munyu tue, nɛ o bɔ mɔde kaa o maa nu sisi lo. 3Ee, moo fa kue nɛ a ha mo nile; kpa pɛɛ nɛ a ha mo nɔ́ sisi numi. 4Hla e se blɔ kaa bɔ nɛ a hlaa sika hiɔ, loo juetli nɛ a ngɔ kɛ laa. 5Ke o pee ja loko o maa nu Yawɛ gbeye yemi sisi, nɛ o maa kase Mawu he nile. 6Yawɛ lɛ haa nɔ nile; lɛ nɛ e tsɔɔ nɔ nile, kɛ nɔ́ sisi numi. 7Nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da, nɛ a yeɔ anɔkuale ɔ, Yawɛ piɛɔ a he, nɛ e baa a yi. 8Yawɛ buu dami sane yeli a he, nɛ e baa e ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ a yi.
9Ke o bu mi tue ɔ, o maa le nɔ́ nɛ hi, kɛ blɔ nɔ́ nɛ da. O maa le nɔ́ nɛ sa mo peemi. 10O maa le ní, nɛ nile ɔ ma ha mo bua jɔmi. 11O he nile, kɛ o nɔ́ sisi numi maa bu o he, 12nɛ a be hae nɛ o pee nɔ́ nɛ dɛ. A ma je mo kɛ je nimli yayamihi a dɛ mi: nihi nɛ a kɛ a lilɛ puɛɔ nɔ, 13nihi nɛ gba kɛ je blɔ nɛ da nɔ kɛ ya ngɛ diblii blɔhi a nɔ nyɛɛe, 14nihi nɛ nyaa yayami peemi he, nɛ a naa bua jɔmi ke a ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ dɛ pee, 15kɛ nihi nɛ a blɔhi dɛ, nɛ a kɛ hɛ fɔ we a nɔ.
16Ke o bu mi tue ɔ, lɛɛ yo yaholɔ ko nɛ ma hla kaa e kɛ e nya mi munyu ngɔngɔɛ ma puɛ o tue ɔ, ma je mo kɛ je e dɛ mi: 17yo nɛ kua e yihe mi huno, nɛ si nɛ e wo e Mawu ɔ hu e yi nɔ. 18Ke o ya e we mi ɔ, gbenɔ blɔ nɔ o ngɛ nyɛɛe ɔ nɛ. Ke o ya lejɛ ɔ lɛɛ o su gbeje ta. 19Nɔ ko ya slaa we lɛ, nɛ e kpale kɛ ba hyɛ. Ke nɔ ko ya su lejɛ ɔ, e kpale we e se kɛ bɛ wami blɔ ɔ nɔ hu. 20Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, moo kase nimli kpakpahi a ní peepee, konɛ o pee nɔ́ nɛ da. 21Dali, kɛ nimli kpakpahi ji ni nɛmɛ nɛ maa hi zugba nɛ ɔ nɔ. 22Se yiwutsotsɛmɛ, kɛ yayami peeli lɛɛ Mawu ma kpata a hɛ mi kaa bɔ nɛ a hiaa tso ngɛ zu mi kɛ fɔɔ si ɔ.

Title: ABƐ 3
Content:
A wo nihewi kɛ yihewi ga
1Ye bi, níhi nɛ i tsɔɔ mo ɔ, o hɛ ko je a nɔ; o hɛ nɛ hi mlaahi nɛ i wo mo ɔ a nɔ be tsuaa be. 2Ke o pee ja a, o wami se maa kɛ, nɛ o ma na he jɔmi, kɛ kplɔkɔtɔ. 3Koo ngmɛɛ si himi kpakpa, kɛ anɔkuale yemi he. Fi kɛ wo o kuɛ, nɛ o ngma kɛ fɔ o tsui nɔ. 4 Ke o pee ja a, o hɛ mi maa ba nyami, nɛ Mawu, kɛ nimli adesahi tsuo ma na o he bua jɔmi.
5Ngɔɔ o hɛ ngɔ fɔ Yawɛ nɔ kulaa. Koo ngɔ o hɛ ngɔ fɔ nɔ́ nɛ moo o susu kaa o le ɔ nɔ. 6Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ mi ɔ, mo kai Yawɛ, nɛ e maa tsɔɔ mo blɔ nɛ da. 7 Koo bu o he ní lelɔ; moo ye Yawɛ gbeye, nɛ o tu yayami nya fo. 8Ke o pee ja a, e ngɛ kaa tsopa kpakpa nɛ ma tsa mo, nɛ ma ha o he mi maa jɔ mo. 9Ngɔɔ o ní babauu ɔ kɛ wo Yawɛ hɛ mi nyami; ngɔɔ o niba ní tsuo mi kekleekle nɔ́ kɛ sã bɔ ha lɛ. 10Ke o pee ja a, o blɛfo gba a ma hyi tɔtɔɔtɔ kɛ blɛfo; o wai hu maa ba babauu nɛ o nine be he kpee.
11 Ye bi, ke Yawɛ ngɛ mo tsɔsee ɔ, e ko pee mo tai; ke e ngɛ o hɛ mi kae ɔ, o ko de ke e ngɛ mo haoe. 12 Nihi nɛ Yawɛ suɔ mɛ ɔ, a hɛ mi e kaa, kaa bɔ nɛ tsɛ peeɔ e bi nɛ e suɔ ɔ. 13Nɔmlɔ nɛ le ní, nɛ e nuɔ nɔ́ sisi ɔ, a gbaa lɛ saminya. 14Ejakaa e he ngɛ se nami pe sika tsu, kɛ sika hiɔ. 15Nile he ngɛ se nami kulaa pe june; nɔ́ ko be nɛ o suɔ saminya nɛ a kɛ maa to nile he. 16Nile haa nɔ wami se kɛɔ ngɛ je mi; e haa nɔ naa ní, nɛ e haa nɔ hɛ mi baa nyami. 17Nile haa nɔ bua jɔmi, kɛ tue mi jɔmi. 18Nihi nɛ le ní ɔ, a naa bua jɔmi; nile haa mɛ wami.
19Nile Yawɛ kɛ bɔ je ɔ.
Ga lɛ e kɛ ngɔ hiɔwe ngɔ to e blɔ he.
20E nile ɔ nɛ ha nɛ pa amɛ hia;
lɛ nɛ ha nyu je bɔku ɔmɛ a mi pue zugba.
21Ye bi, ngɔɔ nile nitsɛnitsɛ,
kɛ juɛmi ngɔ to saminya; ko ha nɛ a je o dɛ.
22A ma ha mo he wami, nɛ o ma na bua jɔmi. 23Kɛkɛ ɔ, o maa nyɛɛ tɛɛ ngɛ he jɔmi mi, nɛ o be nɔ́ tɛe. 24Ke o hwɔ si ɔ, o be gbeye yee; o maa hwɔ mahe vii nyɔ mi tsuo. 25Haomihi nɛ baa yiwutsotsɛmɛ a nɔ tlukaa kaa kɔɔhiɔ nɛ nya wa a, lɔ ɔmɛ be o he gbeye woe. 26Yawɛ maa bu o he. E be blɔ ngmɛe nɛ o ya du klama.
27Be tsuaa be nɛ o ma nyɛ ɔ, nihi nɛ e hia kaa a pee mɛ kpakpa a, pee mɛ kpakpa. 28Ke nɔ́ ko ngɛ o dɛ nɛ o ma nyɛ kɛ pee o nyɛmi kpakpa a, ko de lɛ ke e ya nɛ e ba hwɔɔ loko o ha lɛ. 29O nyɛmi nɛ o kɛ lɛ ngɛ, nɛ e ngɔ e hɛ kɛ fɔ o nɔ ɔ, koo to ga yayami kɛ wo e he. 30O kɛ nɔ ko nɛ ko pɛ yaka gu be mi nɛ e pee we mo nɔ́ yaya ko. 31O hɛ ko kɔ̃ yiwutsotsɛmɛ a nɔ; níhi nɛ a peeɔ hu, ko hla kaa o maa pee. 32Ejakaa Yawɛ sume nimli yayamihi; nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da lɛ e kɛ bɔɔ. 33Yawɛ gbiɛmi ngɛ yiwutsotsɛmɛ a wehi a nɔ, se nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a, mɛɛ a hi he ɔ, gbaami sɔuu. 34 Yawɛ kɛ he nɔ woli bɔɛ; se nihi nɛ baa a he si lɛɛ e naa mɛ mɔbɔ. 35Ní leli a hɛ mi maa ba nyami, se kuasiahi lɛɛ a hɛ mi ma pue si.

Title: ABƐ 4
Content:
Nile he se namihi
1Ye bimɛ, nyɛɛ bu nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ tsɛ ngɛ nyɛ tsɔɔe ɔ tue saminya, konɛ nyɛɛ le ní. 2Nɔ́ kpakpa lɛ i ngɛ nyɛ tsɔɔe ɔ nɛ; nyɛ ko ngmɛɛ he. 3Tsaatsɛ kɛ maa a bi kake too ji mi. Benɛ jokuɛyo bɔbɔyoo kɛkɛ ji mi ɔ, 4tsaatsɛ tsɔɔ mi ní. Nɔ́ nɛ e pɔɔ mi demi ji, “Mo kai níhi nɛ i de mo ɔ, nɛ o hɛ ko je a nɔ gblegbleegble. Moo ye mlaa nɛ i wo mo ɔ nɔ, konɛ o yi nɛ na wami. 5Moo le ní, nɛ o nu ní a sisi. Níhi nɛ i de mo ɔ, o hɛ ko je a nɔ. 6Ko si nile se kɔkɔɔkɔ. Suɔ nile, konɛ e baa o yi, nɛ e bu o he. 7Nile ji nɔ́ nɛ he hia pe kulaa. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, hla nile se blɔ. Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ o ma ná a, kɛ hla ní a sisi numi. 8Bu nile, nɛ e maa pee mo nɔmlɔ ngua; fua lɛ atuu, nɛ e maa wo o hɛ mi nyami. 9E maa pee kunimi yemi jlasi nɛ a kɛ fi o yi.”
10Ye bi, bu mi tue. Munyuhi nɛ i tu mo ɔ, moo ngɔ, konɛ o se nɛ kɛ ngɛ je mi. 11I tsɔɔ mo nile, kɛ blɔ nɛ da nɛ sa nɛ o nyɛɛ nɔ. 12Ke o ngɛ nyɛɛe ɔ, o be nɔ́ tɛe; ke o ngɛ fo tue ɔ, o be si nɔe. 13Kai slɔmi gbi nɛ a ha mo ɔ daa; koo ngmɛɛ he. Lɔ ɔ ji o wami. 14Koo ya he nɛ yayami peeli ngɛ. Ko ya nyɛɛ yiwutsotsɛmɛ a se. 15Ee, moo yu o he; koo ya lejɛ ɔ! Gba blɔ nɛ o be kɛ ho. 16Ke yiwutsotsɛmɛ pee we nɔ́ yayami ko ɔ, a nyɛ we nɛ a hwɔɔ mahe. Mahe jeɔ a hɛ mi kɛ ya siɔ be nɛ a yeɔ nɔ ko awi loko a hwɔɔ mahe. 17Yayami peemi ji abolo nɛ a yeɔ, nɛ basabasa ji wai nɛ a nuɔ.
18Blɔ nɛ dali nyɛɛɔ nɔ ɔ ngɛ kaa mɔtu pu la nɛ ngɛ kpɛe hluu kɛ yaa si piani. 19Yayami peeli lɛɛ a blɔ nɔ woɔ diblii kpii kaa nyɔ mi. A tɛɔ nɔ́ nɛ a nɔɔ si, se a li nɔ́ nɛ ji.
20Ye bi, bu ye munyu ɔmɛ tue, nɛ o nu nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ mo dee ɔ saminya. 21O hɛ ko je munyu ɔmɛ a nɔ. Ngɔɔ kɛ to o tsui mi tɔɔ. 22Nɔ nɛ nuɔ munyu nɛ ɔmɛ a sisi ɔ, e naa wami nɛ e hii nɔmlɔ tso he wami saminya be tsuaa be. 23Susu o yi mi saminya loko o pee nɔ́ ko, ejakaa lɔ ɔ nɔ o wami daa si ngɛ. 24Nɔ́ ko nɛ pi anɔkuale ɔ, ko de. Lakpa munyu, kɛ níhi nɛ ngɛ kaa ja kó je o nya mi. 25Hyɛ o hɛ mi tɛɛ. Ko plɛ o yi kɛ ya hiɛ, loo hiɛ. 26 Ke o maa pee nɔ́ ko ɔ, susu he saminya. Ja o pee ja loko o blɔhi maa da mo. 27Koo pee yayami. Ko gba kɛ je blɔ nɛ da nɔ; yaa o hɛ mi tɛɛ.

Title: ABƐ 5
Content:
Ko puɛ gba
1Ye bi, i kɛ mo maa tu munyu nɛ mi kuɔ; i kɛ mo maa tu juɛmi munyu sɔuu. Bu tue, 2konɛ o hyɛ o he nɔ saminya, nɛ o munyu tumi nɛ tsɔɔ kaa ní lelɔ ji mo. 3Ke yo yaholɔ fiɔ o nya he ɔ, e lilɛ ngɔɔ pe hwo; e nya mi munyu hu ngɛ ngleinglei kaa nu. 4Nɔ́ nɛ jeɔ mi kɛ baa a dooɔ pe agba, nɛ e puɛɔ nɔ́ pe klaate nya enyɔtsɛ. 5Blɔ nɔ nɛ e ngɛ nyɛɛe ɔ kɛ nɔ yaa gbeje. E maa ngɔ mo kɛ ya tɔɔ. 6Blɔ nɛ kɛ nɔ yaa wami mi ɔ, e susuu we he; e ya nyɛɛɔ blɔ gɔdɔgɔdɔhi a nɔ nɛ lɛ nitsɛ e li tete.
7Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ye bimɛ, nyɛɛ bu tue, nɛ nyɛ hɛ ko je munyuhi nɛ i kɛ nyɛ ngɛ tue ɔ a nɔ. 8Hɛɛ mo kɛ je yo kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ he; e tsu nya tete po koo ya. 9Ke pi ja a, o hɛ mi nyami ɔ ma ba pee ni kpahi a nɔ, nɛ yiwutsotsɛmɛ ma kpata o hɛ mi ngɛ nihe mi. 10Niinɛ, nibwɔhi ma ba ngɔ ní nɛ o na a tsuo, nɛ nɔ́ ko nɛ o gbo he dengme ɔ ma ba pee nɔ kpa nɔ́. 11Nyagbe ɔ, be mi nɛ o hwɔɔ si ngɛ gbenɔ sa nɔ, nɛ o he lo, kɛ o nɔmlɔ tso ɔ tsuo hɛ mi ngɛ kpatae ɔ, o maa hi kɛmɛe, 12nɛ o maa hi dee ke, “Mɛni he je i kplɛɛ we nɛ a tsɔse mi ɔ? Mɛni he je i ngmɛ́ blɔ nɛ a ka ye hɛ mi ɔ? 13I bui ye tsɔɔli fɛɛ, nɛ ma de ke i ngɛ nihi nɛ tuɔ mi slɔmi munyuhi tue bue po. 14Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, pe ye hɛ mi miɔ nɛ e ma pue si ngɛ ma hɛ mi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.”
15Ye mo nitsɛ o yo anɔkuale, nɛ o kɛ o suɔmi tsuo ha lɛ pɛ. 16Anɛ e sa kaa o wo ngmɛdu ngɛ gbɛjegbɛ nɔ ngɛ je ɔ mi tsuo kɛ bɔle si lo? 17Ha o bimɛ nɛ pee mo nɔ kake too o níhi, se pi o kɛ nibwɔhi a bimɛ. 18Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ha o yo bua jɔmi. O nihe mi yo kpeekpee ɔ, na e he bua jɔmi. 19E he ngɛ fɛu saminyayoo kaa odabɔ. Ha e he nɛ pee mo akɔnɔ, nɛ e suɔmi ɔ nɛ fi mo kɛ mɛtɛ e he daa. 20Ye bi, mɛni he je lɛ yo ajuama haa o yi mi plɛɔ kikɛ nɛ ɔ? Mɛni ha o fua nɔ kpa e yo kɛ wo o gugwe mi ɔ? 21Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ o ngɛ pee ɔ fɔɔ si paa ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi. He tsuaa he nɛ o gu ɔ, e ngɛ mo hyɛe. 22Yiwutsotsɛ ɔ, lɛ nitsɛ e he yayamihi nɔuu lɛ maa du lɛ klama; e he yayami kpa amɛ nɔuu a kɛ maa fi lɛ. 23Akɛnɛ e kplɛɛ we tsɔsemi he je ɔ, e ma gbo; e kuasia jemi ma kpata e hɛ mi.

Title: ABƐ 6
Content:
Kɔkɔ bɔmi kpahi
1Ye bi, anɛ o ya da nɔ ko se lo? Anɛ o wo si kaa o maa da nɔ ko nɛ o li lɛ e hiɔ nya ha lɛ lo? 2Anɛ o kɛ o nya mi munyu fi mo nitsɛ o he lo? Anɛ o ya yi o siwo ɔ nɔ, nɛ e plɛ pee klama ha mo nɛ o du lo? 3Ye bi, ke ja ji sane ɔ, lɛɛ o nyɛmi ɔ nine su o nɔ. Bɔ nɛ o maa pee nɛ o maa ye o he ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. Yaa o nyɛmi ɔ ngɔ esɔ. Yaa ba o he si ha lɛ, nɛ o kpa lɛ pɛɛ. 4Koo hwɔ mahe; ko de ke o ngɛ o he jɔɔe hulɔ. 5Je o he kɛ je sane nɛ ɔ mi esɔ kaa bɔ nɛ odabɔ, aloo lohwe pɛlitsɛ tuɔ detsɛ nya fo ɔ.
6Hejɔtsɛ, yaa tatu ngɔ. Yaa kase bɔ nɛ e toɔ e níhi a blɔ nya ha, nɛ o le ní. 7Lɛ, nɛ hɛ mi nyɛɛlɔ, loo matsɛ, loo nɔ yelɔ ko be lɛ ɔ, 8latsa be mi ɔ, e hlaa niye ní nɛ e buaa nya kɛ toɔ ha fĩɛ be. 9Mɛni be mo hejɔtsɛ o maa hwɔ si kɛ yaa si? Mɛni be po o maa te si? 10 Nɔ́ nɛ o deɔ ji, “Oo, ma hwɔ mahe bɔɔ pɛ; ma je ye hɛ se bɔɔ; ma bua ye nine nya nɛ ma jɔɔ ye he bɔɔ.” 11Se benɛ o hwɔɔ si ɔ, ohia ma ba na mo tlukaa kaa bɔ nɛ ojo fialɔ ba tuaa nɔ, nɛ o yi ma fi kaa nɔ nɛ ta bulɔ mia kɛ ba tua lɛ.
12Yakayaka nɔmlɔ, loo yiwutsotsɛ hii lakpa yee kɛ hii nyɛɛe. 13E kɛ e hɛngmɛ, kɛ e nane, kɛ e nine nguɛ tuɔ munyu, nɛ e peeɔ okadi kɛ sisiɔ nɔ. 14Be nɛ ɔ mi tsuo ɔ, ní yaya sɔuu lɛ e hii susue; e hii pɛ woe ngɛ he tsuaa he. 15Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, haomi maa ba e nɔ tlukaa. Be mi nɛ e li e he be ɔ, e hɛ mi ma kpata pɛsɛpɛsɛ.
16-19Ní kpaago komɛ nɛ Yawɛ hiee, nɛ e sume saasaa ji:
Hewo,
Lakpa yemi,
Nɔ nɛ pee we nɔ́ ko e muɔ si puemi,
Ga yayami tomi,
He sɔmi kɛ yayami peemi,
Lakpa odase yelɔ, kɛ
Nɔ nɛ woɔ e nyɛmimɛ a kpɛti pɛ.
Gba puɛmi he kɔkɔ bɔmi
20Ye bi, mlaa nɛ o tsɛ wo mo ɔ, ye nɔ; nɔ́ nɛ o nyɛ tsɔɔ mo ɔ, o hɛ ko je nɔ gblegbleegble. 21Ngmaa kɛ fɔ o tsui nɔ; nɛ o fi kɛ wo o kuɛ. 22Ke o hia blɔ ɔ, munyuhi nɛ o fɔli tuɔ kɛ tsɔɔ mo ɔ maa tsɔɔ mo blɔ; nyɔ mi ke o hwɔɔ si ɔ, a maa bu o he, nɛ ke o te si ɔ, a maa wo mo ga. 23Mlaahi nɛ a wo mo, kɛ nihi nɛ a tsɔɔ mo ɔ tsuo ngɛ kaa la ha mo. O hɛ mi nɛ a ka, aloo o tue nɛ a gbla a, lɔ ɔ maa tsɔɔ mo bɔ nɛ o maa hi si ngɛ je mi ha. 24Ní nɛ ɔmɛ ma je mo kɛ je yo yaholɔ ɔ dɛ mi, nɛ yo gba puɛlɔ be nyɛe nɛ e kɛ munyu ngɔngɔɛ ma puɛ o tue. 25Ko ya di e he fɛu ɔ se; ko ha nɛ e we ajuama hɛngmɛ ɔ nɛ nu mo. 26Nyumu ma nyɛ ma ya su yo yaholɔ, nɛ e ma ha lɛ abolo bɔbɔyoo ko kɛkɛ. Se ke e ya ta yogbayo he ɔ, lɛɛ pe e hɛ mi kpata pɛsɛpɛsɛ ji lɔ ɔ nɛ.
27Anɛ nɔ ko maa je la kɛ pue e gugue mi, nɛ e tadehi be sãe ngɛ e he lo? 28Anɛ nɔ ko maa naa la ngu nɔ, nɛ e nane be sãe lo? 29Nɔ nɛ kɛ e nyɛmi e yo ya hwɔɔ si ɔ, e sane ɔ ngɛ kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ nɔuu. Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ tsuɔ kikɛmɛ a ní nɛ ɔ, e be e he yee ligbi ko ligbi ko. 30Ke hwɔ ngɛ nɔ ko yee, nɛ e ya ju niye ní nɛ e ye ɔ, a gbi e he guɛ. 31Ke a nu lɛ ɔ, e maa ngɔ e weto ní tsuo tete kɛ to nane mi ha nɔtsɛ ɔ totoe kpaago kɛ bɔ he. 32Se nyumu nɛ puɛɔ gba a, e be juɛmi; lɛ nitsɛ e hɛ mi lɛ e ngɛ kpatae. 33A maa plaa lɛ; a ma pue e hɛ mi si, nɛ zo maa gbe lɛ kpɔtɔɔ. 34Ke nyumu ngɛ hunga jee ɔ, e mi mi fuɔ wawɛɛ nitsɛ. Jamɛ a be ɔ, ke e yaa ye e he lue ɔ, e nɛ mɔbɔ. 35E be kpatami nɔ́ ko hee ngɛ o dɛ; ke o ke lɛ ní babauu po, e bua be jɔe.

Title: ABƐ 7
Content:
1Ye bi, kai munyuhi nɛ i tu mo ɔ; mlaahi nɛ i wo mo ɔ, o hɛ nɛ hi a nɔ. 2Mlaahi nɛ i wo mo ɔ, ye a nɔ, konɛ o yi nɛ na wami. Moo ye ye munyu ɔmɛ a nɔ fitsofitso kaa bɔ nɛ o baa mo nitsɛ o hɛngmɛ yi ɔ. 3Munyuhi nɛ i tu mo ɔ, moo fi kɛ wo o nine nguɛ he; nɛ o ngma kɛ fɔ o tsui nɔ. 4O kɛ nile nɛ hi si kaa bɔ nɛ o kɛ o nyɛmiyo maa hi si ɔ; ha nɛ o juɛmi nɛ pee o huɛ kpakpa. 5Ke o pee ja a, a ma je mo kɛ je yo yaholɔ dɛ mi, nɛ yo gba puɛlɔ kɛ e nya mi dɔkɔɔ be o he blɔ nae.
Yo yaholɔ
6Ligbi ko be nɛ i ngɛ saflɛ mi hyɛe ngɛ ye we ɔ mi ɔ, 7i na nihewi babauu nɛ a be juɛmi. Nɔ kake nɛ i to e he hɛ saminya a, lɛɛ e pa biɛ pe mɛ tsuo. 8E nyɛɛ kɛ ya be ngɛ gbɛjegbɛ ɔ kɔ nya he ko, he nɛ yo ko hii ɔ. 9Jamɛ a be ɔ, je jɔ, nɛ du bu. 10Tlukaa a, yo ko kɛ lɛ ba kpe. Yo ɔ dla e he kaa yaholɔ nɛ ngɛ nyumu hlae. 11Yo nɛ ɔ, jamɛatsɛ ji lɛ; e ngɛ gegeege, zo ko zo ko be e hɛ mi, nɛ e hí we mi hulɔ. 12Ke o ke o hyɛɔ ɔ, lɛ nɛ ngɛ gbɛjegbɛ nɔ ɔ nɛ; ke o ke o hyɛɔ ɔ, e su jua nɔ momo. Ngɛ kɔ nya tsuaa kɔ nya a, o maa na lɛ nɛ e wo ka kɛ daa si. 13Kɛkɛ nɛ yo ɔ nu niheyo ɔ, nɛ e fua lɛ atuu. E hyɛ niheyo ɔ hɛ mi gaa nɛ́ zo pee we lɛ, nɛ e de ke, 14“I wo si ke ma sã bɔ ko; nɛ mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ, i ye ye siwo ɔ nɔ. 15Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i je kpo, konɛ ma ba hla mo nɛ ma na mo, nɛ i kɛ mo ba bua nɛ ɔ nɛ. 16I ngɔ Egipt kploba kpakpa kɛ ha ye sa a nɔ saminyayoo. 17I kɛ tsopa kɛ e he via nɛ ɔmɛ wo sa a mi: mimɛ, aloe, kɛ sinamon. 18Ha waa ho nɛ wa ya hwɔ. Ha nɛ wa ya fiɛ nɛ wa na bua jɔmi nyɔ ɔ mi tsuo kɛ yaa si mɔtu. 19Hyɛ, ye huno be; e hia blɔ kɛ ho tsitsaa ya. 20E hɛɛ sika fuu kɛ to dɛ, nɛ e maa ye otsi enyɔ loko e maa kpale kɛ ba.” 21Yo nɛ ɔ kɛ e nya mi munyu ngɔngɔɛ ɔ gbe niheyo ɔ yi mi hluu kɛ ya si e nine su niheyo ɔ nɔ. 22Kɛkɛ nɛ niheyo ɔ nyɛɛ e se kɛ ho kaa na nɛ a yaa gbe, aloo odabɔ nɛ hlu kɛ yaa sɛ klama mi, 23he nɛ kɛ̃ɛ̃ mi bi ma ya gbɔ e tsui mi ngɛ. Ee, niheyo nɛ ɔ nyɛɛ yo ɔ se kɛ ho kaa lohwe pɛlitsɛ nɛ he sɔ kɛ yaa sɛ klama mi; e li tete kaa e hɛ mi miɔ nɛ e ma kpata.
24Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ye bimɛ, nyɛɛ bu tue! Nyɛ ta tue nɛ nyɛɛ nu nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ dee ɔ. 25Nyɛ ko ha nɛ yo kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ ba gbe nyɛ yi mi nɛ nyɛ ya nyɛɛ e se. Nyɛ ko tla kɛ ya be ngɛ e blɔ mi tete po. 26Ejakaa nimli babauu ji nihi nɛ e ye mɛ awi; nimli kpekpemi nitsɛnitsɛ ji ni nɛmɛ nɛ e kpata a hɛ mi. 27Ke o su e we ɔ mi ɔ, lɛɛ blɔ kpiti nɛ a guu kɛ yaa gbeje ɔ, e nɔ lɛ o ngɛ kɛ yaa a nɛ.

Title: ABƐ 8
Content:
Nile yi jemi la
1 Nyɛɛ bu tue! Nile ngɛ ngmlaa kpae.
Nyɛɛ bu tue! Juɛmi gbi ngɛ pɛe.
2Nile daa si ngɛ blɔ gbla amɛ a nya,
ngɛ blɔ he, kɛ yokuhi a yi mi.
3E ngɛ ngmlaa kpae gegeege ngɛ ma a nya;
e ngɛ kpae ngɛ ma a agbo ɔmɛ a nya ke,
4“Nyɛ nimli adesahi lee! I ngɛ nyɛ tsɛe oo!
Nyɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ, nyɛɛ bu mi tue!
5Nyɛ nɛ nyɛ be juɛmi ko juɛmi ko, nyɛɛ le ní;
nyɛ kuasiahi, nyɛ na juɛmi.
6Nyɛɛ bu tue
nɛ ma tu nyɛ munyuhi nɛ a he hia.
7Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ ma de nyɛ ɔ, anɔkuale sɔuu;
i be nyɛ munyu kpa ko tue pe anɔkuale.
Lakpa lɛɛ i hiee.
8Ye nya mi munyuhi tsuo da;
ekoeko be nɛ kpɛ̃;
ekoeko be nɛ ji lakpa.
9Ye nya mi munyu ɔmɛ fɔɔ si paa
kɛ ha nihi tsuo nɛ nuɔ nɔ́ sisi.
Munyu ɔmɛ a mi tsɔ heii
kɛ ha nihi tsuo nɛ le ní.
10Nyɛ hla ye tsɔsemi ɔ se blɔ pe sika hiɔ;
nyɛ hla nile pe sika tsu kpakpa.
11“Nile hi pe june;
níhi nɛ adesa suɔ pe kulaa a,
ekoeko be nɛ a kɛ maa to nile he.
12Imi nile, i ngɛ hɛ mi si kami.
I ngɛ juɛmi, kɛ nɔ́ sisi numi hulɔ.
13Ke nɔ ko ke e yeɔ Yawɛ gbeye ɔ,
e sa kaa e kua yayami.
Hewo, he tsɔɔmi, je mi bami yaya,
kɛ lakpa a, i sume.
14I le ní saminya, nɛ i woɔ nɔ ga;
i nuɔ nɔ́ sisi, nɛ i ngɛ he wami hulɔ.
15I piɛɔ matsɛmɛ a he kɛ hyɛɛ ma nɔ;
i piɛɔ nɔ yeli a he kɛ woɔ mlaa kpakpahi.
16Ganɔhi kɛ odehehi tsuo,
imi lɛ i piɛɔ a he kɛ tsuɔ ní.
17Nihi nɛ suɔ mi ɔ, imi hu i suɔ mɛ;
nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ hlaa ye se blɔ ɔ, e maa na mi.
18Ní nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ ye dɛ nɛ ma dla;
sika, hɛ mi nyami, kplɔkɔtɔ, kɛ nɔ yami.
19Nɔ́ nɛ o ma na kɛ je ye dɛ mi ɔ,
e hi pe sika tsu ngmingmiingmi;
e hi pe sika hiɔ ngmingmiingmi hulɔ.
20Dami blɔ nɔ lɛ i nyɛɛɔ;
dami sane lɛ i yeɔ.
21Nihi nɛ suɔ mi ɔ, i peeɔ mɛ niatsɛmɛ;
i haa a wehi a mi hyiɔ tɔ kɛ june.
22 “Imi nile lɛ Yawɛ bɔ kekleekle;
e bɔ mi loko e je e ní tsumi ɔmɛ a sisi blema lokoo.
23Blema lokoo, benɛ a na we nɛ a bɔ je ɔ,
imi lɛ a bɔ kekleekle.
24Benɛ wo be, nɛ nyu vuhi hu be ɔ,
jamɛ a be ɔ, imi lɛɛ a fɔ mi momo.
25Benɛ a na we nɛ a ngɔ yo ɔmɛ, kɛ yoku ɔmɛ
kɛ ma a blɔ hehi lolo ɔ,
jamɛ a be ɔ, imi lɛɛ a fɔ mi momo.
26Benɛ Mawu na we nɛ e pee je ɔ,
kɛ nga, kɛ tabo zu ɔ,
jamɛ a be ɔ, imi lɛɛ a fɔ mi momo.
27Benɛ e ngɔ hiɔwe kɛ to e blɔ he,
nɛ e pee hiɔwe kɛ zugba a kpe he ɔ,
jamɛ a be ɔ, i ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.
28Benɛ e ngɔ bɔku ɔmɛ ngɔ to hiɔwe,
nɛ e kɛ nyu vu ɔmɛ hu to a blɔ hehi ngɛ wo ɔ mi ɔ,
jamɛ a be ɔ, i ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.
29Benɛ e fa wo ɔ ke wo nyu ɔ
ko be e huzu ɔ he ɔ, i ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.
Benɛ e to je ɔ sisi ɔ,
jamɛ a be ɔ, i ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.
30I ngɛ e kasa nya kaa ga ní tsulɔ kpanaa,
nɛ e bua jɔɔ ye he daa nɛ;
i fiɛɔ ngɛ e hɛ mi be tsuaa be.
31I náá je ɔ nɛ e bɔ ɔ,
kɛ nimli adesahi tsuo a he bua jɔmi.
32“Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nihewi, nyɛɛ bu mi tue!
Nyɛɛ pee bɔ nɛ i de nyɛ ɔ,
nɛ nyɛ ma na bua jɔmi.
33Nyɛɛ bu nɔ́ nɛ a ngɛ nyɛ tsɔɔe ɔ tue
nɛ nyɛɛ le ní.
Nyɛ ko kua tsɔsemi.
34Nɔ nɛ buɔ mi tue,
nɛ e hii si ngɛ ye sinya nya daa ligbi,
nɛ e hii mlɛe ngɛ ye agbo nya a,
e naa bua jɔmi.
35Nɔ nɛ hlaa mi ɔ, e yi ma na wami;
nɛ Yawɛ ma na e he bua jɔmi.
36Se nɔ nɛ hla we mi ɔ,
lɛ nitsɛ e he awi lɛ e ngɛ yee.
Nihi tsuo nɛ nyɛɔ mi ɔ, a suɔ gbenɔ.”

Title: ABƐ 9
Content:
Nile kɛ biɛmi
1Nile ma tsu, nɛ e ma titima kpaago kɛ ha tsu ɔ. 2E gbe lohwe; e futu wai, nɛ e ngmɛ okplɔɔ. 3E tsɔ e mawayi ɔmɛ ke a ya da ma a mi he nɛ ya hiɔwe pe kulaa a, nɛ a kpa ngmlaa ke, 4“Nyɛ nihi tsuo nɛ nyɛ be juɛmi ɔ, nyɛ gba hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ!” Nɔ́ nɛ e ngɛ kuasia hu dee ji, 5“Ba nɛ o ba ye ye ní ɔ eko, nɛ o nu wai nɛ i futu ɔ hu eko! 6Kpa bɔmi kɛ nihi nɛ be juɛmi, nɛ o yi nɛ na wami. Hla nile se blɔ!”
7Ke o ka he fɛu yelɔ hɛ mi ɔ, mo lɛ a ma jɛ; ke o ka yiwutsotsɛ hɛ mi ɔ, mo mohu o he lɛ o plaa. 8Ko ka he fɛu yelɔ hɛ mi, nɛ e ba nyɛ mo; ka ní lelɔ mohu hɛ mi nɛ e maa suɔ mo. 9Tsɔɔ ní lelɔ ní, nɛ e nile ɔ mi ma blɛke kɛ ya nɔ; tsɔɔ dalɔ ní, nɛ e maa kase nɔ́ ko kɛ je mi kɛ piɛ nɔ́ nɛ e le momo ɔ he.
10 Loko o ma na nile ɔ, ja o ye Yawɛ gbeye; ke o na le Nɔ Klɔuklɔu ɔ pɛ o na juɛmi. 11Ejakaa nile ma ha nɛ a fɔ o ligbi ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ o wami se maa kɛ. 12Ke o le ní ɔ, o le ha o he. Nɛ ke o sake nile ngɔ fɔ he ɔ, mo nitsɛ lɛ o maa na nɔ́.
13Yo kuasia ngɛ gegeege; zo ko zo ko be e hɛ mi, nɛ e li nɔ́ ko hulɔ. 14Daa nɛ ɔ, e hii si ngɛ e sinya nya, loo ma a mi he nɛ ya hiɔwe pe lɛ tsuo. 15Ke nihi ngɛ a nyɛɛmi nɔ kɛ bee, nɛ a ngɛ yi mi kpakpa susue ɔ, e ma kpa ngmlaa ke, 16“Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ be juɛmi ɔ, e ba hiɛ ɔ!” Nyumu kuasia hu, nɔ́ nɛ e deɔ lɛ ji, 17“Nyu jujui ngɔɔ. Niye ní nɛ a ye ngɛ laami mi ɔ, e ngɔɔ.” 18Nihi nɛ yo nɛ ɔ naa a he blɔ ɔ, a li tete kaa ke o na ya sɛ e we ɔ mi pɛ o plɛ pee nɔ gbogboe. A li tete kaa nihi tsuo nɛ ya sɛ e we ɔ mi ɔ, a wuhi a he je momo ngɛ gbeje.

Title: ABƐ 10
Content:
Salomo abɛhi
1Salomo abɛhi ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ: Bi ní lelɔ haa e tsɛ bua jɔmi; bi kuasia yeɔ e nyɛ tsui.
2Ke o gu blɔ yaya nɔ kɛ na ní ɔ, e he be se nami bae ha mo. Se ke o ye anɔkuale ɔ, o yi ma na wami.
3Yawɛ be hae nɛ hwɔ nɛ ye nimli kpakpahi; nimli yayamihi lɛɛ e maa tsi mɛ blɔ, konɛ a nine ko su nɔ́ nɛ a ngɛ hlae ɔ nɔ.
4Nɔ nɛ peeɔ hejɔ ɔ, e yeɔ ohia; se nɔ nɛ tsuɔ ní lɛɛ e naa ní.
5Bi nɛ buaa nɔ́ nya latsa be ɔ, bi ní lelɔ ji lɛ; bi nɛ hwɔɔ si ní kpami be ɔ, bi nɛ woɔ nɔ zo ji lɛ.
6Nɔ nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a, a maa gbaa lɛ babauu. Se yiwutsotsɛ lɛɛ e nya mi munyu puɛɔ nɔ́.
7E ji gbaami kaa a ma kai nimli kpakpahi daa; yayami peeli lɛɛ e kɛ we nɛ hɛ jeɔ a nɔ.
8Ní lelɔ yeɔ mlaa nɔ; se kuasia nɛ tuɔ munyu puu ɔ, lɛɛ e hɛ mi ma kpata.
9Nɔ nɛ yeɔ anɔkuale ɔ, e he mi jɔɔ lɛ. Nɔ nɛ yi anɔkuale lɛɛ nine maa gbe lɛ.
10Ke nɔ ko na nɔ́ nɛ dɛ, nɛ e ku e hɛ ngɔ fɔ nɔ ɔ, haomi lɛ e kɛ baa. Se nɔ nɛ kaa nɔ hɛ mi nɛ e yi gbeye ɔ, tue mi jɔmi lɛ e kɛ baa.
11Nɔmlɔ kpakpa nya mi munyu ngɛ kaa nyu vu nɛ haa nɔ wami; nɔmlɔ yayami lɛɛ e nya mi munyu puɛɔ nɔ́.
12 Ninyɛ woɔ pɛ; se suɔmi haa tɔmihi tsuo a nɔ.
13Ní leli tuɔ juɛmi munyu; kuasiahi lɛɛ e sa nɛ a gbla a tue.
14Ní leli tu we munyu fuu. Kuasiahi lɛɛ a tuɔ munyu puu, nɛ lɔ ɔ kɛ mɛ woɔ haomi mi.
15Niatsɛmɛ a ní nɛ a na a buɔ a he; se ohiatsɛmɛ lɛɛ a ohia a kpataa a hɛ mi.
16Nɔ nɛ peeɔ kpakpa a, e yi ma na wami. Se nɔ nɛ peeɔ yayami ɔ, yayami ɔ kɛ̃ a kɛ maa wo lɛ hiɔ.
17Nihi nɛ ke a tu mɛ munyu nɛ a nuɔ ɔ, a yi ma na wami. Se ni nɛmɛ nɛ kplɛɛ we nɛ a kaa a hɛ mi ɔ, mɛɛ lɛɛ a laa blɔ.
18Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ nyɛɛ nɔ ngɛ laami mi ɔ, lakpatsɛ ji lɛ. Nɔ nɛ tuɔ nihi a he munyu kɛ puɛɔ mɛ ɔ, kuasia ji lɛ.
19Nɔ nɛ tuɔ munyu babauu ɔ, e kɛ we nɛ e peeɔ yayami. Ní lelɔ lɛɛ e hyɛɛ e lilɛ nɔ saminya.
20Nɔmlɔ kpakpa nya mi munyu he jua wa kaa sika hiɔ ngmingmiingmi; se yiwutsotsɛ juɛmi lɛɛ nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko be mi.
21Nimli kpakpahi a nya mi munyu he baa se nami ha nihi babauu. Kuasiahi lɛɛ a hɛ mi kpataa, ejakaa a be juɛmi.
22Mawu gbaami lɛ peeɔ nɔ niatsɛ; dengme gbomi kɛ nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko piɛ we he ha nɔ.
23Kuasia ngɛ nɛ ɔ, yayami peemi peeɔ lɛ bua jɔmi; juɛmitsɛ lɛɛ nile ji nɔ́ nɛ haa lɛ bua jɔmi.
24Nɔ́ nɛ yayami peelɔ ngɛ gbeye yee ɔ, lɔ ɔ ji nɔ́ nɛ maa ba e nɔ. Nɔ nɛ peeɔ kpakpa lɛɛ nɔ́ nɛ e ngɛ hlae ɔ, lɔ ɔ a ma ha lɛ.
25Ke kɔɔhiɔ nɛ nya wa te ɔ, e fiaa yayami peeli kɛ nɔɔ si nɛ a gboɔ. Se nihi nɛ peeɔ kpakpa lɛɛ nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko sɛ a he.
26Koo tsɔ hejɔtsɛ kɔkɔɔkɔ. Ke o tsɔ lɛ ɔ, o he mi maa hia mo wawɛɛ nitsɛ; e maa pee mo kaa nɔ́ nɛ pe o ye kpɛte nɛ o lungu fĩa, aloo la su ku sɛ o hɛngmɛ mi.
27Yawɛ gbeye yemi haa nɔ wami se kɛɔ; se yayami peeli lɛɛ a wami se kɛ we kulaa.
28Nihi nɛ peeɔ kpakpa a, a hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi ya peeɔ bua jɔmi. Se yayami peeli lɛɛ a hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi maa pee yaka.
29Nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a, Yawɛ buu a he; yayami peeli lɛɛ e kpataa a hɛ mi.
30Nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a, a maa ye a he daa, se yayami peeli lɛɛ a yi be wami nae ngɛ zugba a nɔ.
31Nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a, a tuɔ juɛmi munyu. Se lilɛ nɛ yeɔ lakpa a, a maa po lɛ kɛ fɔ he.
32Nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a, a le nɔ́ nɛ sa nɛ a de. Se yayami peeli lɛɛ munyu nɛ puɛɔ nɔ́ lɛ a tuɔ.

Title: ABƐ 11
Content:
1Susumi ní yayahi nɛ a kɛ sisiɔ nɔ ɔ, Yawɛ sume. Nɔ́ nɛ e suɔ ji nɔ́ susumi ní kpakpahi.
2Hɛ mi si puemi nyɛɛɔ he nɔ womi se. Nɔ nɛ baa e he si ɔ, e le nɔ́.
3Nɔ́ nɛ hɛɛɔ nimli kpakpahi, nɛ tsɔɔ mɛ blɔ ngɛ je mi ji anɔkuale nɛ a yeɔ ɔ. Se ni nɛmɛ nɛ yi anɔkuale lɛɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a ní peemi ní yayamihi lɛ kpataa a hɛ mi.
4Ní babauu nɛ nɔ ko na a be nyɛe ma he e yi wami ngɛ kojomi ligbi ɔ nɔ. Nɔ́ nɛ ma nyɛ he e yi wami ji anɔkuale nɛ e yeɔ ɔ.
5Nɔ nɛ pee we nɔ́ ko nɛ dɛ ɔ, anɔkuale nɛ e yeɔ he je ɔ, e je mi si himi daa lɛ. Se yiwutsotsɛ lɛɛ lɛ nitsɛ e ní yayamihi lɛ ma kpata e hɛ mi.
6Nɔ nɛ peeɔ nɔ nɛ da a, anɔkuale nɛ e yeɔ ɔ, jeɔ lɛ kɛ jeɔ níhi a mi. Se nihi nɛ yi anɔkuale ɔ, mɛ nitsɛmɛ a jiklɔɔ lɛ kpataa a hɛ mi.
7Ke nɔmlɔ yayami gbo pɛ kɛkɛ nɔ́ ko nɛ e ngɔ e hɛ ngɔ fɔ nɔ ɔ hu laa. Nɔmlɔ nɛ li Mawu ɔ, ke e ngɛ nɔ kpakpa ko blɔ hyɛe ɔ, e peeɔ yaka.
8Nɔ nɛ peeɔ nɔ nɛ da a, a jeɔ lɛ kɛ jeɔ haomi mi, nɛ haomi ɔ baa nɔmlɔ yayami mohu nɔ.
9Nɔmlɔ nɛ li Mawu ɔ, e kɛ e nya mi munyu puɛɔ e nyɛmi. Se nɔ nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a, e juɛmi ma he e yi wami.
10Ke níhi a mi hi ha nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ nɛ da a, bua jɔmi baa ma a mi. Ke yiwutsotsɛmɛ a hɛ mi kpata a, ma a hwɔɔ lele.
11Nimli kpakpahi a ní peemi ní kpakpahi haa ma yaa nɔ. Se yiwutsotsɛmɛ a nya mi munyu haa ma hɛ mi kpataa.
12Nɔ nɛ gbeɔ e nyɛmi he guɛ ɔ, e be juɛmi; ní lelɔ ɔ, pe e maa e nya.
13Nɔ nɛ hii sieku yee kɛ hii bee ɔ, e jeɔ laami sanehi kpo. Se nɔ nɛ heɔ nɔ yeɔ ɔ laa nɔ́ nɔ.
14Ma nɛ na we ga woli kpakpa a, e ywiaa. Se ma, he nɛ ga woli kpakpa hiɛ ngɛ ɔ, tue mi jɔmi ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.
15Nɔ nɛ daa nubwɔ se ɔ, e piaa e he. Se nɔ nɛ pee we ja lɛɛ e yeɔ e he.
16Yo nɛ hɛ mi ngɛ nyami ɔ, a buu lɛ, se yo nɛ be subai ɔ lɛɛ hɛ mi si puemi e kɛ baa.
17Nɔ nɛ naa mɔbɔ ɔ, lɛ nitsɛ e he kpakpa lɛ e ngɛ pee. Se nɔ nɛ yi mi wa a, e ngɛ lɛ nitsɛ e he plaae.
18Nɔmlɔ yayami ɔ, nɔ́ ko bɔbɔyoo kɛkɛ e naa kɛ jeɔ e yi wu tso ní peemi níhi a mi. Nɔ nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da lɛɛ e nine suu hiɔwo kpakpa nɔ kɛ̃.
19Nɔ nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da kpamisa nɛ e kpa we ɔ, e yi ma na wami. Se nɔ nɛ dii yayami se ɔ, e ma gbo.
20Nihi nɛ a juɛmi mi hyi tɔ kɛ yayami ɔ, Yawɛ sume mɛ saasaa; nihi nɛ e suɔ ji ni nɛmɛ nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da.
21Anɔkuale sane ji kaa yayami peelɔ ɔ, ja a gbla e tue kokooko. Se nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a, mɛɛ lɛɛ a maa ye a he.
22Yo nɛ e he ngɛ fɛu, se e juɛmi mi kuɔ we ɔ, e ngɛ kaa sika tsu ga ngɛ kpotoo gugwɔ mi.
23Nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a, nɔ́ nɛ a suɔ ji kaa nɔ́ ko tsuaa nɔ́ ko ɔ, kpakpa pɛ nɛ je mi. Se yiwutsotsɛmɛ lɛɛ abofu kɛkɛ ji nɔ́ nɛ a hii blɔ hyɛe.
24Ni komɛ haa nɔ nɔ́, se kɛ̃ ɔ, a naa ní babauu. Ni komɛ hu, nɔ́ nɛ sa kaa a ha nɔ ɔ, a peeɔ he kpɛle, se a yeɔ ohia.
25Nɔ nɛ haa nɔ nɔ́ ɔ, e bɔɔ; nɔ nɛ haa nɛ nihi tɔɔ ɔ, lɛ nitsɛ hu e tɔɔ.
26Nɔ nɛ tsiɔ blɛfo nya a, ma a maa gbiɛ lɛ. Se nɔ nɛ juaa blɛfo lɛɛ a maa gbaa lɛ.
27Nɔ nɛ hlaa nɔ́ kpakpa se blɔ ɔ, e hɛ mi baa nyami. Nɔ nɛ dii yayami se ɔ, e kɛ yayami kpeɔ.
28Nihi nɛ ngɔɔ a hɛ kɛ fɔɔ ní nami nɔ ɔ, a hɛ mi ma kpata. Ni nɛmɛ nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a, mɛɛ lɛɛ a maa bɔ kaa ba mumu.
29Nɔ nɛ ngɔɔ haomi kɛ baa e weku li a nɔ ɔ, nyagbe ɔ, e jeɔ mi dɛ gu.
Kuasia ma sɔmɔ ní lelɔ daa.
30Nɔ́ nɛ da peemi haa nɔ wami; basabasa lɛɛ gbenɔ e kɛ baa.
31 Nɔ nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a, e naa e hiɔwo ngɛ zugba nɛ ɔ nɔ tete po. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, yiwutsotsɛmɛ, kɛ yayami peeli hu ja a gbla a tue kɛ̃.

Title: ABƐ 12
Content:
1Nɔ nɛ le ní ɔ, e suɔ nɛ ke e ngɛ nɔ́ ko pee nɛ dɛ ɔ, a de lɛ. Se kuasia lɛɛ e sume nɛ a kaa e hɛ mi.
2Yawɛ náá nɔmlɔ kpakpa he bua jɔmi. Se nɔ nɛ toɔ ga yaya lɛɛ e buɔ lɛ fɔ.
3Yayami peemi ha we nɛ nɔ yaa nɔ. Nɔ nɛ peeɔ kpakpa lɛɛ e daa si kpɛii.
4Yo kpakpa ngɛ kaa jlasi ngɛ e huno yi mi. Yo nɛ pueɔ e huno hɛ mi si lɛɛ e ngɛ kaa hiɔ ngɛ e huno wuhi a mi.
5Nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a, ní kpakpahi a he a susuɔ. Se ga nɛ yayami peeli toɔ ɔ, sisimi sɔuu.
6Yayami peeli a nya mi munyu kpataa nɔ hɛ mi. Se nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da lɛɛ a nya mi munyu heɔ nɔ yi wami.
7A ma kpata yayami peeli a hɛ mi, nɛ a be mɛ nae hu. Se nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da lɛɛ a nina maa hi si daa.
8Ke o ngɛ juɛmi ɔ, a ma je o yi. Se ke o biɛ lɛɛ a maa gbe o he guɛ.
9Nɔ nɛ nɔ́ ko be e dɛ, se e tsuɔ ní nɛ e yeɔ ɔ, e hi kulaa pe nɔ nɛ peeɔ e he agbo, nɛ e nya mi ngma po bɔɔ lɛ.
10Nɔmlɔ kpakpa hyɛɛ e lohwehi a nɔ saminya. Se nimli yayamihi lɛɛ mɔbɔ nɛ a naa a lohwehi po, yi mi wami sɔuu.
11Ngmɔ hulɔ nɛ tsuɔ ní wawɛɛ ɔ ma na niye ní babauu. Se nɔ nɛ ya nyɛɛɔ yakayaka níhi a se lɛɛ kuasia ji lɛ.
12Yayami peeli a suɔmi nya ní ji kaa a hi yayami pee kpamisa. Nimli kpakpahi lɛɛ a daa si kpɛii.
13Nɔmlɔ yayami nya mi munyuhi peeɔ klama ha lɛ nɛ e duɔ. Se nɔmlɔ kpakpa lɛɛ e he jee sane mi.
14Munyu kpakpahi nɛ jeɔ nɔ ko nya mi, kɛ níhi nɛ e tsuɔ ɔ, lɔ ɔmɛ a he hiɔwo e naa.
15Kuasia susuɔ kaa be tsuaa be ɔ, e nɔ́ da. Ní lelɔ lɛɛ e buɔ ga womi tue.
16Ke kuasia mi mi fu ɔ, e kɛ́ we nɛ a naa. Ní lelɔ lɛɛ ke o jɛ lɛ tete po, e bui.
17Ke anɔkualetsɛ ye odase ɔ, a yeɔ dami sane. Lakpa odase yelɔ lɛɛ nɔ e sisiɔ.
18Munyu nɛ a tuɔ kɛkɛ nɛ juɛmi be mi ɔ, e yeɔ nɔ awi kaa klaate. Se ní lelɔ nya mi munyu tsaa nɔ.
19Lakpa hii si be bɔɔ kɛkɛ, se anɔkuale lɛɛ e ngɛ daa.
20Nihi nɛ toɔ ga yayami ɔ, mɛ nitsɛmɛ a he lɛ a ngɛ sisie. Se nihi nɛ susuɔ nɔ́ kpakpa a, mɛɛ lɛɛ a ma na bua jɔmi.
21Nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a, nɔ́ yayami ko be a he sae. Se yiwutsotsɛmɛ lɛɛ haomi sɔuu ji nɔ́ nɛ maa ba a nɔ.
22Yawɛ hiee lakpatsɛmɛ. Se nihi nɛ yeɔ anɔkuale ɔ, mɛɛ lɛɛ e naa a he bua jɔmi.
23Ní lelɔ maa e nya kɛ toɔ e nile nɔ. Kuasia lɛɛ e tuɔ munyu puu, nɛ lɔ ɔ nihi kɛ naa kaa kuasia ji lɛ.
24Nɔ nɛ tsuɔ ní wawɛɛ ɔ, e ma na nɔkɔtɔma blɔ nya; nɔ nɛ peeɔ hejɔ lɛɛ e ma sɔmɔ.
25Tsui yemi ha we nɔ bua jɔmi, se munyu kpakpa haa nɔ bua jɔɔ e he.
26Nɔmlɔ kpakpa tsɔɔ e nyɛmi blɔ kpakpa. Se nɔmlɔ yayami ní peemi níhi haa mɛ tsuo a laa blɔ.
27Nɔ nɛ peeɔ hejɔ ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ e ngɛ hlae ɔ, e nine be nɔ sue ligbi ko ligbi ko. Se nɔ nɛ tsuɔ ní wawɛɛ lɛɛ e ma na ní babauu.
28Nɔ́ nɛ da peemi ji blɔ nɛ kɛ nɔ yaa wami mi. Nɔ nɛ nyɛɛɔ kikɛmɛ a blɔ nɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ, e be gboe.

Title: ABƐ 13
Content:
1Bi ní lelɔ buɔ e tsɛ tsɔsemi tue. Bi nɔ builɔ lɛɛ e kplɛɛ we nɛ a kaa e hɛ mi.
2Nɔmlɔ kpakpa naa munyu nɛ jeɔ lɛ nitsɛ e nya mi ɔ he se. Nɔmlɔ yayami lɛɛ nɔ́ nɛ e suɔ kɛkɛ ji yi mi wami.
3Nɔ nɛ hyɛɛ e lilɛ nɔ saminya a, e yi naa wami. Nɔ nɛ tuɔ munyu puu ɔ, e hɛ mi kpataa.
4Hejɔtsɛ ma hla kaa e na nɔ́ ko, se e nine be nɔ sue. Se nɔ nɛ tsuɔ ní lɛɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ e ngɛ hlae ɔ, e naa.
5Nɔ nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a, e sume lakpa. Se nɔmlɔ yayami lɛɛ hɛ mi si puemi níhi e peeɔ kɛ bɔɔ lɛ nitsɛ e he ahlua.
6Nɔ nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a, a yeɔ dami sane ha lɛ. Se yayami peemi kpataa yiwutsotsɛ hɛ mi.
7Ni komɛ peeɔ a he niatsɛmɛ, pohu nɔ́ ko be a dɛ. Ni komɛ hu peeɔ a he ohiatsɛmɛ, se a ngɛ ní babauu.
8Niatsɛ kɛ sika faa e he. Ohiatsɛ ɔ, a wui e he gbeye.
9Nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a, a ngɛ kaa kane nɛ ngɛ kpɛe. Se yayami peeli lɛɛ a ngɛ kaa kane nɛ miɔ nɛ e ma gbo.
10Nɔ buimi ɔ, haomi kɛkɛ e kɛ baa. Ní leli ji ni nɛmɛ nɛ buɔ ga womi tue.
11Ní nɛ a naa esɔesɔ ɔ, e taa mla. Nɔ nɛ buaa nɔ́ nya bɔɔbɔɔbɔɔ ɔ, e naa babauu.
12Ke o ngɛ nɔ́ ko blɔ hyɛe, nɛ nɔ́ ɔ se kɛ ɔ, o yeɔ o tsui. Se ke nɔ́ ɔ ba mi ɔ, o naa bua jɔmi babauu.
13Nɔ nɛ bui ga womi tue ɔ, lɛ nitsɛ e hɛ mi lɛ ma kpata. Nɔ nɛ yeɔ mlaa gbeye ɔ, e maa ye e he.
14Ní leli a tsɔɔmi ngɛ kaa nyu vu nɛ haa nɔ wami. E ma ha nɛ o maa na gbenɔ nɛ ma, konɛ o tu nya fo.
15Juɛmi nɛ mi kuɔ woɔ nɔ hɛ mi nyami. Nihi nɛ sisiɔ nɔ ɔ, mɛɛ lɛɛ hɛ mi kpatami blɔ nɔ a ngɛ.
16Ní lelɔ peeɔ e ní kɛ juɛmi, se kuasia lɛɛ e jeɔ e biɛmi kpo ngɛ ma hɛ mi.
17Tsɔlɔ nɛ yi anɔkuale kɛ nɔ woɔ haomi mi. Se tsɔlɔ anɔkualetsɛ lɛɛ tue mi jɔmi e kɛ baa.
18Nɔ nɛ sume tsɔsemi ɔ, e yeɔ ohia, nɛ e hɛ mi pueɔ si. Se nɔ nɛ kplɛɛɔ nɛ a kaa e hɛ mi ɔ, a buɔ lɛ.
19Ke o ngɛ nɔ́ ko hlae, nɛ o nine su nɔ ɔ, hyɛ bɔ nɛ o bua jɔɔ ha. Kuasia lɛɛ nɔ́ nɛ e hiɔ ji kaa e kpa yayami peemi.
20Nɔ nɛ kɛ ní leli nyɛɛɔ ɔ, e leɔ ní. Se nɔ nɛ kɛ kuasiahi bɔɔ ɔ, haomi lɛ baa e nɔ.
21Haomi nyɛɛɔ yayami peeli a se. Se nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da lɛɛ a ma na hiɔwo kpakpa.
22Nɔmlɔ kpakpa siɔ gbosi ní kɛ haa e bibimɛ. Se yayami peeli a ní ɔ, dali lɛ a bua nya ha.
23Ohiatsɛmɛ a zugba nɛ fɔɔ si gu ɔ ma nyɛ ba ní babauu. Se yayami peeli tsiɔ nya.
24Nɔ nɛ sume kaa e maa gbla e bi tue ɔ, e sume e bi ɔ. Nɔ nɛ suɔ e bi ɔ, e tsɔseɔ lɛ.
25Nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a, a yeɔ ní nɛ a tɔɔ. Se yayami peeli lɛɛ mi mi hwɔ yeɔ mɛ.

Title: ABƐ 14
Content:
1Yo ní lelɔ haa nɛ we bɔɔ, se yo kuasia ní peemi níhi ywiaa we.
2Ke o peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a, lɔ ɔ tsɔɔ kaa o yeɔ Yawɛ gbeye. Se ke o yi anɔkuale ɔ, lɔ ɔ tsɔɔ kaa o ngɛ e he guɛ gbee.
3Kuasia nya mi munyu fiaa lɛ kpa. Ní lelɔ lɛɛ e nya mi munyu jeɔ lɛ kɛ jeɔ haomi mi.
4He nɛ na be nɛ a kɛ maa gbla na kpakplaa kɛ hu ɔ, blɛfo gba mi fɔɔ si gu. Ke na ngɛ ɔ, lɔ ɔ lɛɛ gba a mi hyiɔ tɔ.
5Anɔkuale odase yelɔ ngɔɛ nya. Lakpa odase yelɔ lɛɛ lakpa pɛ e yeɔ.
6Nɔ buili hlaa kaa a maa le ní, se nile bɔɔ mɛ. Nihi nɛ nuɔ nɔ́ sisi ɔ, mɛɛ a leɔ ní mla.
7O kɛ kuasia ko bɔ; o be nile munyu ko nue kɛ je e nya mi.
8Ní lelɔ juɛmi tsɔɔ lɛ blɔ nɛ hi. Kuasiahi lɛɛ a juɛmi sisiɔ mɛ.
9Yayami gba we kuasia nya kulaa. Se nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a, mɛɛ a suɔ kaa a kɛ a he yayami nɛ pa mɛ.
10Mo nitsɛ nɛ o le o hɛdɔ be, kɛ be nɛ o naa bua jɔmi; nɔ kpa ko li.
11A maa ku yayami peeli a we kɛ pue si. Se ni kpakpahi lɛɛ a we maa bɔ.
12 Blɔ nɛ nɔmlɔ susuɔ kaa e da a, nyagbe ɔ, e kɛ nɔ yaa gbenɔ mi.
13Muɔmi haa kɔmɔ yemi nɔ; ke bua jɔmi se po ɔ, aywilɛho lɛɛ e tɛ gblegbleegble.
14A maa gbla yayami peelɔ tue ngɛ e yayamihi a he; nɔmlɔ kpakpa hu ma na e ní kpakpahi a he hiɔwo.
15Kuasia heɔ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ yeɔ. Ní lelɔ lɛɛ e le e nane nya hyɛmi.
16Ní lelɔ yeɔ sane gbeye; e hyɛɛ e he nɔ saminya nɛ e ko pee yayami. Kuasia lɛɛ e heɔ e he yeɔ, nɛ e peeɔ e níhi basabasa.
17Nihi nɛ a mi mi kɛ́ fumi peeɔ a níhi basabasa kaa kuasiahi. Se ní leli lɛɛ a toɔ a tsui si.
18Nihi nɛ be juɛmi ɔ, biɛmi ji nɔ́ nɛ a naa ngɛ a he. Juɛmitsɛmɛ lɛɛ nile haa a hɛ mi baa nyami.
19Yayami peeli ma kpla si ha ni nɛmɛ nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da, nɛ a ma bi mɛ a hiami níhi.
20Ohiatsɛ ɔ, e nyɛmi tete po sume lɛ. Se niatsɛ lɛɛ e ngɛ huɛmɛ babauu.
21Nɔ nɛ gbeɔ e nyɛmi he guɛ ɔ, yayami e ngɛ pee ɔ nɛ. Se nɔ nɛ naa ohiatsɛ mɔbɔ ɔ, a gbaa lɛ.
22Nihi nɛ toɔ ga yayami ɔ, a hɛ mi ma kpata. Se ni nɛmɛ nɛ susuɔ nɔ́ kpakpa a, a maa na mɛ mɔbɔ, nɛ a blɔ maa da mɛ.
23Ke o tsu ní ɔ, o ma na nɔ́ ko kɛ je mi. Se ke o hii si nɛ o ngɛ munyu tue puu kɛkɛ ɔ, o maa ye ohia.
24Ní lelɔ ɔ, e se nami ji ní nami; kuasia lɛɛ e hiɔwo ji biɛmi.
25Anɔkuale odase yelɔ heɔ nɔ yi wami; lakpa odase yelɔ lɛɛ nɔ se blɔ e tsɔɔ.
26Nɔ nɛ yeɔ Yawɛ gbeye ɔ, e kɛ e bimɛ tsuo hiɔ si ngɛ he jɔmi mi.
27Yawɛ gbeye yemi ngɛ kaa nyu vu nɛ haa nɔ wami; e jeɔ nɔ kɛ jeɔ gbenɔ mi.
28Matsɛ nɛ e we bihi a he hiɛ babauu ɔ, e naa biɛ. Se ganɔ nɛ be nihi ngɛ e sisi ɔ lɛɛ tsa pi nɔ ko kulaa ji lɛ.
29Nɔ nɛ mi mi fu we mla a, ní lelɔ agbo ji lɛ. Nɔ nɛ be tsui ɔ, e jeɔ kuasia.
30Tue mi jɔmi haa nɛ nɔmlɔ tso ɔ naa he wami, se kuasia jemi woɔ nɔ hiɔ.
31Nɔ nɛ waa ohiatsɛ yi mi ɔ, Mawu ɔ nɛ bɔ ohiatsɛ ɔ e ngɛ jɛe ɔ nɛ. Se nɔ nɛ naa ni nɛmɛ nɛ e fi mɛ mɔbɔ ɔ, e ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi nyami woe.
32Yayami peelɔ ɔ, lɛ nitsɛ e ní yayamihi nɛ ngɔɔ lɛ kɛ woɔ haomi mi. Se nɔmlɔ kpakpa lɛɛ gbenɔ mi tete po e ngɛ hɛ nɔ kami.
33Nɔ nɛ nuɔ nɔ́ sisi ɔ, ní lelɔ ji lɛ. Kuasia lɛɛ nɔ́ nɛ a tsɛɛ nile tete e li.
34Dami sane yemi haa nɛ ma yaa nɔ; yayami peemi ɔ, ma hɛ mi si e pueɔ.
35Tsɔlɔ nɛ le ní ɔ, matsɛ suɔ lɛ. Se tsɔlɔ nɛ tsuɔ zo ní ɔ, lɛɛ matsɛ gblaa e tue.

Title: ABƐ 15
Content:
1Ke o kɛ gbi blɛuu ha munyu heto ɔ, e tsiɔ abofu nya. Se munyu gegeege haa nɔ mi mi woɔ la.
2Ní leli a ní sɛɛmi ngɔɔ ngɛ tue mi; kuasiahi lɛɛ munyu nɛ jeɔ a nya mi ɔ, juɛmi be mi.
3Yawɛ hɛngmɛ ngɛ he tsuaa he; e naa kpakpa peeli, kɛ yayami peeli tsuo.
4Munyu blɛuu kɛ he jɔmi baa; se ke sisimi ba je mi pɛ e gbeɔ nɔ mumi.
5Kuasia kplɛɛ we nɛ e tsɛ tsɔseɔ lɛ; se bi nɛ baa e he si nɛ a tsɔseɔ lɛ ɔ, ní lelɔ ji lɛ.
6Nɔmlɔ kpakpa naa e ní he se babauu. Yiwutsotsɛ lɛɛ haomi ji nɔ́ nɛ e ní nɛ e na a kɛ baa e nɔ.
7Ní leli a nya lɛ gbɛɔ nile kɛ fĩaa; pi kuasiahi a juɛmi.
8Yayami peelɔ bɔ sami ɔ, Yawɛ sume kulaa; se ke nɔmlɔ kpakpa fa kue ɔ, e naa he bua jɔmi.
9Yayami peelɔ je mi bami sɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi kulaa; se nɔ nɛ peeɔ nɔ nɛ da a, Yawɛ suɔ lɛ.
10Nɔ nɛ pee we nɔ́ nɛ da a, a maa gbla e tue wawɛɛ; nɔ nɛ sume nɛ a ka e hɛ mi ɔ, e ma gbo.
11Gbeje kɛ e muɔ voo ɔ po fɔɔ si paa ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi; nɛ nɔmlɔ adesa tsui mi lɛɛ e be nae lo?
12He fɛu yelɔ ngɛ nɛ ɔ, e sume kaa nɔ ko kaa e hɛ mi; nɛ e ya bi we ga womi ngɛ ní leli a ngɔ hulɔ.
13Bua jɔmi haa nɔ tsɔɔ e hɛ mi; tsui yemi haa nɔ peeɔ vii.
14Ní leli hlaa kaa a maa hi ní kasee kɛ ya nɔ. Kuasiahi lɛɛ nɔ́ nɛ a suɔ ji a hi biɛmi munyu tue kpamisa.
15Ohiatsɛ wami be tsuo ɔ, haomi sɔuu; se nɔ nɛ e tsui nɔɔ e mi ɔ, daa nɛ ɔ, e ngɛ bua jɔmi.
16Nɔ́ ko bɔbɔyoo nɛ Yawɛ gbeye yemi piɛ he ɔ, e hi hluu pe weto ní babauu kɛ e mi haomi gidiglɛmɛɛ.
17E hi mohu kaa o maa ye ba flɔɔ ngɛ he nɛ suɔmi ngɛ, pe nɛ o maa ye na nɛ tu zɔ ngɛ he nɛ ninyɛ ngɛ.
18Nɔ nɛ woɔ e mi mi la a, e tleɔ pɛ si; se nɔ nɛ mi mi fu we mla a, e kpataa pɛ, nɛ tue mi jɔmi baa.
19Hejɔtsɛ kɛ haomi kpee ngɛ he tsuaa he; se nɔ nɛ yeɔ anɔkuale ɔ, e na we nyagba.
20Bi ní lelɔ haa e tsɛ naa bua jɔmi. Kuasia lɛɛ e gbeɔ e nyɛ he guɛ.
21Nɔ nɛ be juɛmi nyaa kuasia jemi he; se nɔ nɛ ngɛ juɛmi ɔ, e baa e je mi saminya.
22He nɛ ga womi be ɔ, yi mi tomi peeɔ yaka; se he nɛ ga woli hiɛ ngɛ ɔ, níhi yaa nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
23E ji bua jɔmi sane kaa a ma ha munyu heto pɛpɛɛpɛ. Munyu nɛ a tu ngɛ be nɛ sa mi ɔ, hyɛ bɔ nɛ e hi ha!
24Blɔ nɛ ní lelɔ nyɛɛɔ nɔ ɔ, e kɛ lɛ yaa wami mi. Blɔ nɛ kɛ nɔ yaa gbeje ɔ, e nyɛɛ we nɔ.
25Yawɛ kuɔɔ he woli a wehi, se e haa yalɔyo e buna maa si kpɛii.
26Yiwutsotsɛmɛ a yi mi susumi ɔ, Yawɛ sume; se nihi nɛ a tsui mi tsɔ ɔ, a munyu saa e hɛ mi.
27Nɔ nɛ peeɔ jiklɔɔ konɛ e na se yaka a, haomi mohu nya e ngɛ buae ha e weku li. Nɔ nɛ he we nyɔ mi ní ɔ, e se kɛɔ ngɛ je mi.
28Ke dalɔ ma ha munyu heto ɔ, e susuɔ he saminya. Yiwutsotsɛ lɛɛ munyu yaya lɛ jeɔ e nya mi.
29Yawɛ kɛ yayami peeli a kpɛti kɛ; se e buɔ dali a kue fami tue.
30Hɛ mi muɔ jɛɛ haa nɔ bua jɔɔ; jã kɛ̃ manye munyu haa nɔ nɔ gbagba tee.
31Nɔ nɛ buɔ ga womi tue ɔ, e kɛ ní leli maa hi si.
32Nɔ nɛ kplɛɛ we nɛ a tsɔseɔ lɛ ɔ, e ngɛ lɛ nitsɛ e he awi yee. Se nɔ nɛ buɔ tue ɔ, e naa nile.
33Yawɛ gbeye yemi ji tsɔsemi nɛ haa nɔ leɔ ní nitsɛnitsɛ. Nɔ nɛ baa e he si ɔ, a maa wo e hɛ mi nyami.

Title: ABƐ 16
Content:
1Nɔmlɔ ma nyɛ maa to nɔ́ ko he ga ngɛ e yi mi. Se kaa nɔ́ ɔ maa hi, loo e be hie ɔ, lɔ ɔ lɛɛ e ngɛ Yawɛ dɛ mi.
2Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ nɔmlɔ adesa ngɛ pee ɔ da ha lɛ; se Yawɛ lɛɛ nɔmlɔ tsui mi lɛ e hyɛɔ.
3Ke o ma tsu nɔ́ ko ɔ, ha nɛ Yawɛ nɛ gbaa o yi mi tomi ɔ nɔ. Ke o pee ja a, e maa hi ha mo.
4Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ pee ɔ, nɔ́ ko he kɛ̃ lɛ e pee ngɛ; yayami peeli tete po, a ngɛ kɛ ha hɛ mi kpatami.
5Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ woɔ e he nɔ ɔ, e he peeɔ Yawɛ tai. Bɔ tsuaa bɔ nɛ pee ɔ, ja a gbla e tue; e be e he yee.
6Naa mɔbɔ nɛ o ye anɔkuale, kɛkɛ ɔ, Mawu kɛ o he yayami maa pa mo. Ye Yawɛ gbeye, nɛ yayami ko be o he sae.
7Ke Yawɛ ná o he bua jɔmi ɔ, o he nyɛli tete po e ma ha o kɛ mɛ maa hi si ngɛ tue mi jɔmi mi.
8E hi kaa o maa ye anɔkuale nɛ o nine nɛ su nɔ́ bɔbɔyoo nɔ, pe kaa o maa ye amimi kɛ na ní babauu.
9Nɔmlɔ adesa toɔ ga ngɛ e yi mi, se Mawu ji nɔ nɛ tsɔɔ lɛ nɔ́ nɛ sa kaa e pee.
10Ke matsɛ buá sane he ɔ, tɔmi ko kulaa be he; ejakaa matsɛ ɔ, Mawu biɛ mi e tuɔ munyu ngɛ.
11Yawɛ suɔ kaa jua yeli nɛ a ngɔ sɛni, kɛ sɛni tɛ kpakpahi kɛ jua ní, konɛ a ko sisi nɔ.
12Matsɛmɛ hiɔ yayami peemi; ejakaa matsɛ sɛ ɔ, dami sane yemi nɔ lɛ a to lɛ sisi ngɛ.
13Nihi nɛ tuɔ anɔkuale ɔ, matsɛmɛ naa a he bua jɔmi; ejakaa nɔ́ nɛ matsɛmɛ suɔ ji anɔkuale.
14Ní lelɔ bɔɔ mɔde kaa e ma ha nɛ matsɛ nɛ na bua jɔmi daa; ke matsɛ mi mi fu ɔ, nɔ ko ma gbo.
15Nihi nɛ matsɛ suɔ mɛ ɔ, e naa mɛ mɔbɔ. A wami si himi peeɔ kpakpa, kaa bɔ nɛ bɔku haa nɛ gbo nyu nɛɔ pueɔ si ɔ.
16Ke o le ní ɔ, e hi hluu pe sika tsu; juɛmi hi pe sika hiɔ.
17Blɔ nɛ kɛ nɔ yɛ yayami mi ɔ, lɔ ɔ nɔ nimli kpakpahi nyɛɛɔ. Nɔ nɛ hyɛɛ e he nɔ saminya a, e he lo yi lɛ e ngɛ baae ɔ nɛ.
18Nɔ nɛ woɔ e he nɔ ɔ, e hɛ mi kpataa; nɔ nɛ tsɔɔ e he ɔ, e blɔ nya jeɔ e dɛ.
19E hi kaa o maa pee o he humi nɛ a na mo ngɛ ohiatsɛmɛ a kpɛti, pe nɔ́ nɛ a maa na mo nɛ o kɛ he nɔ woli ngɛ ní nɛ a ha dlae.
20Bu nɔ́ nɛ a ngɛ mo tsɔɔe ɔ tue, nɛ e maa hi ha mo; ngɔɔ o hɛ ngɔ fɔ Yawɛ nɔ, nɛ o ma na bua jɔmi.
21Nɔ nɛ nuɔ nɔ́ sisi ɔ, ní lelɔ ji lɛ. E kɛ munyu blɛuu gblaa nihi a juɛmi se kɛ baa anɔkuale ɔ he.
22Juɛmi ngɛ kaa vu nɛ haa nɔ wami kɛ ha ní leli, se kuasia lɛɛ lɛ nitsɛ e biɛmi ji nɔ́ nɛ gblaa e tue.
23Ní leli susuɔ a yi mi saminya loko a tuɔ munyu, nɛ ke a de nɔ́ ko ɔ, munyu ɔ taa nɔ tsui mi wawɛɛ nitsɛ.
24Munyu kpakpa ngɔɔ kaa hwo; e haa nɔmlɔ tso ɔ he wami.
25 Blɔ nɛ moo o susu kaa e da a, nyagbe ɔ, e kɛ mo yaa gbenɔ mi.
26Mi mi hwɔ nɛ yeɔ ní tsulɔ ɔ, lɔ ɔ haa e tsuɔ ní kɛ hɛdɔ, konɛ e nya mi ngma ko bɔ lɛ.
27Yakayaka nimli toɔ ga nɛ a kɛ maa ye a nyɛmimɛ awi; a nya mi munyu tete po ngɛ kaa la nɛ ngɛ nɔ́ sãe.
28Nimli yayamihi woɔ pɛ; siekutsɛmɛ puɛɔ huɛmɛ kpakpahi a kpɛti.
29Yiwutsotsɛ sisiɔ e nyɛmi, nɛ e ngɔɔ lɛ kɛ ya woɔ haomi mi.
30Nihi nɛ muɔɔ nɛ a jeɔ a lungu kpo kɛ tsɔɔ mo, nɛ a hii a hɛngmɛ fiae kɛ ha mo ɔ, ga yayami a ngɛ toe ɔ nɛ. Moo hyɛ mɛ saminya.
31Yi mi mua ngɛ kaa jlasi nɛ woɔ nɔ hɛ mi nyami; nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da lɛ a naa lɔ ɔ.
32Nɔ nɛ mi mi fu we mla a, e hi pe katsɛ; nɔ nɛ yeɔ e he nɔ ɔ, e hi pe tatsɛ nɛ ya ye ma ko nɔ kunimi.
33Nimli adesahi fɔɔ sɔ nɛ a kɛ le Mawu yi mi tomi. Se bɔ nɛ níhi ma ya ba ha a, Yawɛ pɛ lɛ e tsɔɔ.

Title: ABƐ 17
Content:
1Niye ní nya mi bɔ kake nɛ o maa ye ngɛ tue mi jɔmi mi ɔ, e hi kulaa pe okplɔɔ nguaa nɛ a tsɛ ngɛ we nɛ pɛ sɔuu lɛ ngɛ mi.
2Sɔmɔlɔ nɛ le ní maa ye bi nɛ peeɔ zo ní nɔ; nɛ e kɛ bimɛ ɔmɛ maa dla gbosi ní fiee.
3La a kɛ tsuɔ sika tsu kɛ sika hiɔ he, se Yawɛ lɛ kaa adesa tsui hyɛɔ.
4Yayami peelɔ buɔ yi wu tso níhi tue, nɛ lakpatsɛ hu buɔ lakpa munyuhi nɛ puɛɔ nɔ biɛ tue.
5Nɔ nɛ yeɔ ohiatsɛ he fɛu ɔ, ohiatsɛ ɔ bɔlɔ e ngɛ jɛe ɔ nɛ. Nɔ nɛ bua jɔɔ nɔ ko amanehlu he ɔ, e be e he yee.
6Bibimɛ ji nimowi a hɛ mi nyami, kaa bɔ nɛ bimɛ ngɛ ha fɔli ɔ.
7Munyu kpakpa sɛ́ kuasia, kaa bɔ nɛ lakpa sɛ́ ganɔ ɔ.
8Nyɔ mi ní halɔ susuɔ kaa e ma nyɛ nɛ e kɛ nyɔ mi ní ma tsu nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ bɔ nɛ e suɔ, kaa nɔ́ nɛ tɛ nɛ a kɛ tsuɔ nyakpɛ ní lɛ e hɛɛ ngɛ e dɛ mi.
9Nɔ nɛ kɛ tɔmi nɛ a tɔ̃ e nɔ paa a, a suɔ e sane; se nɔ nɛ hɛɛɔ yayami nɛ a pee lɛ mi kpamisa a, e kɛ e huɛmɛ a kpɛti puɛɔ.
10Ke a ka nɔ nɛ kɔɔ sane se hɛ mi ɔ, e naa he se babauu pe kuasia nɛ a fia e se mi kpa si lafa sɔuu.
11Nɔ́ nɛ nɔmlɔ yayami tsuɔ kɛkɛ ji kaa e tsɔ atuã. E kɛ tsɔlɔ yiwutsotsɛ lɛ ma ya kpe.
12Afani nɔ́ nɛ o kɛ osisiblisi nɛ a nuu e bimɛ maa kpe, pe nɔ́ nɛ o kɛ kuasia nɛ ngɛ biɛe maa kpe.
13Nɔ nɛ ngɔɔ yayami kɛ toɔ kpakpa nane mi ɔ, yayami be e we mi tae gblegbleegble.
14Pɛ sisi jemi ngɛ kaa nyu nɛ a bli nya nɛ́ e be; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, benɛ nya sami ɔ mi wɛ lolo ɔ, moo ngmɛɛ he.
15Nɔ nɛ woɔ yayami peelɔ nguɔ, kɛ nɔ nɛ buɔ dalɔ fɔ ɔ, Yawɛ hiɔ mɛ tsuo.
16Mɛni se kuasia ma na ke e maa hɛɛ sika kɛ ya he nile, be mi nɛ e be juɛmi?
17Huɛmɛ suɔ a he be tsuaa be, se nyɛmimɛ lɛɛ haomi be mi tete po a si we a sibi.
18Nɔ nɛ be juɛmi lɛ woɔ si nɛ e daa nɔ se kaa e maa wo e hiɔhi ha lɛ.
19Nɔ nɛ suɔ nɛ e tɔ̃ nɔ nɔ be tsuaa be ɔ, pɛ wolɔ ji lɛ; nɛ nɔ nɛ fĩaa hu, hɛ mi kpatami e ngɛ hlae ɔ nɛ.
20Nɔ nɛ nɔ́ yayami lɛ e susuɔ ɔ, e yɛ nɔ; nɔ nɛ munyu yaya jeɔ e nya mi ɔ, haomi lɛ baa e nɔ.
21Bi nɛ biɛ haa e tsɛ yeɔ e tsui; tsɛ nɛ fɔ bi kuasia a, e na we bua jɔmi.
22Ke nɔ ko bua jɔ e he be tsuaa be ɔ, e ngɛ kaa tsopa nɛ haa nɔ he wami. Se daa nɛ ke nɔ pee vii ɔ, e ngɛ lɛ nitsɛ e he gbee.
23Yiwutsotsɛ heɔ nyɔ mi ní ngɛ laami mi nɛ́ e kɛ plɛ dami sane hɛ mi ngɔ bu si.
24Ní lelɔ ngɔɔ níhi nɛ a he ngɛ se nami kɛ fɔɔ e hɛ mi; kuasia lɛɛ daa nɛ ɔ, e hɛ ngɛ je ɔ tsuo nɔ kɔe.
25Bi kuasia haa e tsɛ yeɔ tsui, nɛ e haa e nyɛ yeɔ kɔmɔ.
26Nɔ nɛ sane da a, e sɛ kaa a bɔɔ lɛ hiɔ. Odehehi hu e sɛ kaa a fiaa mɛ ní yaka.
27Nɔ nɛ tu we munyu puu ɔ, juɛmitsɛ ji lɛ. Nɔ nɛ hɛ mi ka si ɔ, e le ní. 28Kuasia tete, ke e ma e nya nɛ e tu we munyu ɔ, a buɔ lɛ ní lelɔ.

Title: ABƐ 18
Content:
1Nihi nɛ suɔ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a he ɔ, a kɛ nɔ kpa pee we nɔ́ ko. Nɔ́ ko nɛ nihi tsuo le kaa e hi ɔ, mɛɛ lɛɛ a deɔ ke e hí.
2E he hia we kuasia kaa ke e kɛ nihi ngɛ munyu tue ɔ, e bɔ mɔde kaa e maa nu nɔ́ nɛ a ngɛ dee ɔ sisi. Kuasia lɛɛ nɔ́ kake too ɔ nɛ e ngɛ dee ɔ, lɔ ɔ pɛ ji nɔ nɛ ngɔɔ ngɛ e tue mi.
3Yayami peemi kɛ he guɛ gbemi lɛ nyɛɛɔ; ke o hɛ mi pue si pɛ zo maa nyɛɛ se.
4Nile ma nyɛ je nɔmlɔ nya mi munyu mi; e mi kuɔ kaa wo, nɛ e he tsɔ kaa pa nɛ hia kɛ bee.
5Nɔ nɛ sane be mi ɔ, e sɛ kaa a hyɛɔ e hɛ mi nɛ a plɛɔ nɔ nɛ nɔ́ da mohu sane hɛ mi ngɔ buɔ si ngɛ kojomi he.
6Kuasia nya mi munyu woɔ pɛ, kunɔ lɛ nyɛɛɔ se.
7Kuasia nya mi munyu ngɛ kaa klama nɛ e tsɔ lɛ nitsɛ e he; lɔ ɔ nɔuu ji nɔ nɛ kpataa e hɛ mi.
8Sieku yelɔ munyu ngɛ kaa niye ní nɛ ngɔɔ. Nimli adesahi suɔ kaa a maa mi kɛ ya a muklii mi tɔɔ.
9Hejɔtsɛ kɛ nɔ́ puɛlɔ ɔ, nyɛmimɛ ji mɛ.
10Yawɛ ngɛ kaa mɔ nguaa, he nɛ nimli kpakpahi tuu fo kɛ ya saa we ngɛ nɛ a yi naa wami. 11Niatsɛmɛ susuɔ kaa ke a na ní ɔ, e haa mɛ bua jɔmi, kaa bɔ nɛ ke a fia gbogbo kɛ wo ma he nɛ ma mi bi ɔmɛ naa he jɔmi ɔ.
12Nɔ nɛ baa e he si ɔ, a maa wo e hɛ mi nyami; ni nɛmɛ nɛ woɔ a he nɔ ɔ, mɛɛ lɛɛ hɛ mi kpatami blɔ nɔ a ngɛ.
13Ke a ngɛ mo munyu tue ɔ, bu tue loko o ha heto. Ke o pee we ja a, a ma tsɛ mo kuasia, nɛ o hɛ mi ma pue si.
14Ke o be he wami, nɛ o na tsui to he ɔ, e maa hi ha mo. Se ke o ngɛ o tsui yee ɔ lɛɛ nɔ́ pee mo.
15Ní lelɔ ɔ, daa nɛ e pee e juɛmi, kɛ e tue klaalo kɛ ngɛ ní kasee.
16Nike ní bliɔ blɔ ha nɔ kɛ ya suu nimli nguahi a hɛ mi tɔɔ.
17Ke nɔ ko sɛ hlami kɛ jaje e sane ɔ, e peeɔ kaa nɔ́ nɛ e sane da kɛ yaa si e nyɛmi ɔ ma bɔni lɛ munyu bimi, loko anɔkuale ɔ maa je kpo.
18Ke ni nguahi enyɔ ngɛ nɔ́ he huae ɔ, ja a fɔ sɔ kɛ buá sane ɔ he, loko pɛ ɔ maa jɔ.
19Ke o kɛ o nyɛmi pɛ ɔ, e ma plɛ e se kɛ wo mo kaa bɔ nɛ ke a kɛ dade la agbo se ngɛ mɔ mi nɛ nɔ ko nyɛ we mi sɛmi ɔ.
20Ke o tu munyu ko ɔ, nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ maa ba ngɛ se ɔ, e sa kaa o pɛtɛ he; e hi jio, e hí jio.
21Munyu nɛ jeɔ nɔ nya mi ɔ, gbenɔ, loo wami lɛ e kɛ baa. Nihi nɛ suɔ munyu tumi ɔ, nɔ́ kpakpa, loo nɔ́ yaya ko nɛ maa je mi kɛ ba a, e sa mɛ.
22Ke o ngɔ yo kɛkɛ o ná nɔ́ kpakpa, nɛ Yawɛ maa gbaa mo.
23Ke ohiatsɛ maa tu munyu ɔ, e deɔ ke, “I kpa mo pɛɛ.” Se ke niatsɛ ma ha munyu heto ɔ, e kuɛɔ kɛ woɔ nɔ.
24Huɛ bɔmi komɛ a se kɛ we kulaa. Se huɛmɛ komɛ hu mɛtɛɛ a sibi a he kpɛii pe nyɛmimɛ tete po.

Title: ABƐ 19
Content:
1Ohiatsɛ nɛ yeɔ anɔkuale ɔ, e hi pe kuasia nɛ yeɔ lakpa.
2Nɔ nɛ li nɔ́ ɔ, e ní ngɛ mɔbɔ. Nɔ nɛ nane nya sɔɔ ɔ, e laa blɔ.
3Ke nɔ ko ya biɛ nɛ haomi ba e nɔ ɔ, kɛkɛ e ngɔ abofu ɔ ya kple Yawɛ mohu nɔ.
4Ke nɔ ko na ní ɔ, e naa huɛmɛ babauu; ohiatsɛ lɛɛ e huɛ kake ɔ po kuaa lɛ.
5Lakpa odase yelɔ be e he yee kɔkɔɔkɔ; nɔ nɛ yeɔ lakpa a, e he be sane mi jee.
6Nɔ nɛ mi mi jɔ ɔ, nihi fuu kɛ lɛ bɔɔ; nɔ nɛ bɔleɔ e nine ɔ, nɔ tsuaa nɔ huɛ ji lɛ.
7Ohiatsɛ lɛɛ e nyɛmimɛ tete po sume lɛ, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e be nyakpɛ kaa e huɛmɛ tsɛ̃ɔ a he kɛ jeɔ e he. Ke e hla a se blɔ kaa mɛni po, e nine sui a nɔ.
8Nɔ nɛ hlaa nile se blɔ ɔ, e suɔ lɛ nitsɛ e he; nɔ nɛ pɛtɛɔ nile he ɔ, e yaa nɔ.
9Lakpa odase yelɔ be e he yee kɔkɔɔkɔ; nɔ nɛ yeɔ lakpa a, e hɛ mi ma kpata.
10Si himi ngɔngɔɛ sɛ́ kuasia, hluu nɛ a ba de ke nyɔguɛ nɛ ye ganɔhi a nɔ.
11Nɔ nɛ ngɛ juɛmi ɔ, e mi mi fu we mla. Ke nɔ ko tɔ̃ e nɔ nɛ e pui mi ɔ, lɔ ɔ woɔ e hɛ mi nyami.
12Ke matsɛ mi mi wo la a, e ngɛ kaa jata nɛ ngɛ huae; se ke e ná nɔ he bua jɔmi ɔ, e ngɛ kaa bɔ́ ngɛ nga nɔ.
13Bi kuasia kɛ e tsɛ woɔ haomi mi. Yo nɛ suɔ pɛ ɔ, e ngɛ kaa tsu nya nyu nɛ ngɛ dɛe kɛ ngɛ si puee kɔ, kɔ, kɔ nɛ nyagbe be he.
14We kɛ sika a, tsɛmɛ a dɛ mi nɛ a naa kɛ jeɔ kaa gbosi ní, se yo nɛ le ní ɔ, Yawɛ lɛ haa nɔ.
15Pee hejɔ faa, nɛ o wɔ mahe vii bɔ nɛ o suɔ; se hwɔ maa ye mo.
16Nɔ nɛ yeɔ Mawu mlaa a nɔ ɔ, e se kɛɔ ngɛ je mi; se nɔ nɛ bui mlaa a, e ma gbo.
17Ke o na ohiatsɛ mɔbɔ ɔ, e ngɛ kaa o pa nɔ́ ko ha Yawɛ; nɛ nɔ́ nɛ o pee ɔ, e maa to nane mi ha mo.
18Tsɔse o bi ngɛ be nɛ sa mi, nɛ́ o ko ba ha nɛ e hɛ mi nɛ kpata.
19Ngmɛɛ mi mi latsɛ he nɛ e ná e tue gblami; ejakaa ke o je lɛ kɛ je haomi mi si kake ɔ, e maa hia kaa o ya je lɛ ngɛ mi ekohu.
20Bu ga womi tue, nɛ o ha a tu mo slɔmi munyu, konɛ o na nile nɛ o kɛ bu o he hwɔɔ se.
21Nɔmlɔ adesa peeɔ e juɛmi ngɛ níhi babauu a he, se Yawɛ yi mi tomi ɔ pɛ lɛ baa mi.
22Nɔ́ nɛ a ngɛ hlae ngɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ dɛ ji kaa e ye anɔkuale; dɛgutsɛ hi pe lakpatsɛ.
23Nɔ nɛ yeɔ Yawɛ gbeye ɔ, e wami se kɛɔ; e naa bua jɔmi, nɛ haomi ko haomi ko bɛ e nɔ.
24Hejɔtsɛ nine tlɔɔ kã mi; dengme loko e kpaleɔ e nine ɔ kɛ baa e nya he ekohu.
25Gbla he nɔ wolɔ tue, nɛ ni guhi maa kase nile. Ka ní lelɔ hɛ mi, nɛ e maa kase ní kɛ piɛ he.
26Bi nɛ waa e tsɛ yi mi, nɛ e fieɔ e nyɛ kɛ jeɔ e we mi ɔ, zo, kɛ ahlua e kɛ baa.
27Ye bi, ke o sume nɛ a slɔ mo ɔ, nile munyuhi ma bɔ mo.
28Lakpa odase yelɔ ɔ, dami sane yemi he fɛu e ngɛ yeɔ nɛ. Yiwutsotsɛ lɛɛ munyu yaya sɔuu lɛ jeɔ e nya mi.
29Tue gblami fɔɔ si ha he nɔ woli. Kuasiahi lɛɛ a maa fia a se mi kpa.

Title: ABƐ 20
Content:
1Wai sisiɔ nɔ; dã nɛ nya wa haa nɛ nɔ peeɔ basabasa. Nɔ nɛ ngɔɔ e he kɛ haa dã a, e li nɔ́.
2Ke matsɛ mi mi fu ɔ, ye lɛ gbeye kaa bɔ nɛ o maa ye jata nɛ ngɛ huae gbeye. Nɔ nɛ woɔ matsɛ mi mi la a, lɛ nitsɛ e wami e kɛ ngɛ fiɛe ɔ nɛ.
3Nɔ nɛ bu ngɛ e he ɔ, e yuu e he kɛ jee pɛ he. Kuasiahi lɛ a hii pɛe kpamisa.
4Hejɔtsɛ nɛ sume kaa e maa gba ní ngɛ be nɛ sa mi ɔ, ke ní kpami be su ɔ, e be nɔ́ ko nae.
5Juɛmi nɛ ngɛ nɔmlɔ adesa yi mi ɔ, e mi kuɔ kaa nyu ngɛ vu mi tsitsaa lokoo. Se ní lelɔ jeɔ juɛmi nɛ ɔ kpo ngɛ be nɛ sa mi.
6Nihi babauu maa tsɔɔ mo bɔ nɛ a mi mi jɔ ha. Se mo hla anɔkualetsɛ kake too ngɛ a kpɛti kaa o maa na lo.
7Bimɛ nɛ a tsɛ yeɔ anɔkuale, nɛ e peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a, a gbaa mɛ.
8Ke matsɛ ngɛ kojoe ɔ, e hɛngmɛ e kɛ dlaa nɔ́ yaya.
9Mɛnɔ ma nyɛ ma de anɔkuale mi ke, “Ye tsui mi tsɔ, nɛ yayami ko pa be ye he hu”?
