10Nihi nɛ ngɔɔ sɛni, kɛ sɛni tɛhi nɛ dɛ kɛ tsuɔ ní ɔ, Yawɛ sume mɛ.
11Jokuɛyo tete po e ní peemi níhi a kɛ yoɔ lɛ kaa e yeɔ anɔkuale, loo e peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da.
12Tue nɛ waa kɛ nuɔ nɔ́, kɛ hɛngmɛ nɛ waa kɛ hyɛɔ nɔ́ ɔ, Yawɛ nɛ pee mɛ tsuo ha wɔ.
13Koo suɔ mahe hwɔmi nɛ o ba ye ohia. Moo hi hɛ ngmengmle nɛ o hi o he mɔde bɔe, kɛkɛ o ma na ní babauu maa ye.
14Ke nɔ ko yaa he nɔ́ ɔ, e deɔ ke e he jua wa tsɔ. Se ke e je kɛ yaa a, e fĩaa nɛ e deɔ ke, “Enɛ ɔ lɛɛ i ná lɛ he jua jɔjɔɛ.”
15Sika tsu, kɛ tɛhi nɛ a he jua wa ngɛ babauu. Se ní lelɔ nya mi munyu ngɛ kaa june kpakpa.
16Ke nɔ ko wo si ke e maa da nubwɔ nɛ e li lɛ e se ɔ, a ngɔ nɔ nɛ wo si ɔ tade kɛ to awaba.
17Nɔ́ nɛ nɔ ko na kɛ gu sisimi blɔ nɔ ɔ, e ngɔɔ kaa bɔ nɛ niye ní kpakpa ngɔɔ ɔ. Se pee se ɔ, e ba peeɔ kaa tɛ ngmlitsa ngɛ nɔ ɔ nya mi.
18Ke o maa pee nɔ́ ko ɔ, bi ga womi, kɛkɛ e maa hi ha mo. Too ga kpakpa loko o ya hwu ta.
19Nɔmlɔ nɛ e lilɛ hwɔ we si, nɛ e hii nihi a he munyu tue kɛ hii nyɛɛe ɔ, jeɔ laami sanehi kpo. Nɔ nɛ tuɔ munyu puu kikɛ nɛ ɔ, o kɛ lɛ ko bɔ.
20Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ gbiɛɛ e tsɛ, loo e nyɛ ɔ, e nyagbe baa tlukaa kaa kane nɛ a gbe ngɛ diblii kpii mi.
21Gbosi ní nɛ o he sɔ kɛ na a, nyagbe ɔ, e pee we gbaami.
22Ke nɔ ko pee mo yayami ɔ, ko de ke mo hu o maa pee lɛ kɛ to nane mi. Ngɔɔ o sane ɔ kɛ ha Yawɛ, nɛ e maa piɛ o he.
23Yawɛ hiɔ ní ngmɛmi ní munomunohi; sɛni kɛ e mi tɛ nɛ a kɛ sisiɔ nɔ ɔ, e hí.
24Blɔ nɛ nɔ maa nyɛɛ nɔ ɔ, Yawɛ lɛ tsɔɔ. Lɛɛ kɛ nɔ ko maa pee kɛ maa le lɛ nitsɛ e blɔ kɛɛ?
25Mo susu o yi mi saminya loko o wo Mawu si, konɛ e ko ba pee klama nɛ maa du mo pee se.
26Matsɛ nɛ le ní ɔ, e hlaa yayami peeli ngɛ e ma mi bi ɔmɛ a kpɛti kaa bɔ nɛ a saa blɛfo mi, nɛ e gblaa a tue wawɛɛ.
27Nɔmlɔ he nile ngɛ kaa kane nɛ Yawɛ kɛ hyɛɛ nɔmlɔ tsui mi níhi tsuo fitsofitso.
28Matsɛ nɛ naa mɔbɔ, nɛ e yeɔ anɔkuale ɔ, e naa tue mi jɔmi, nɛ e tsɛ yemi ɔ hu yaa nɔ saminya.
29Nihewi a hɛ mi nyami ji a he wami; nimowi a he fɛu ji a yi mi mua.
30Tue gblami nɛ nya wa tsakeɔ wa ní peemi ní yayamihi.

Title: ABƐ 21
Content:
1Matsɛ juɛmi ngɛ kaa nyu dɔ ngɛ Yawɛ dɛ mi. He nɛ lɛɛ e suɔ nɛ e haa e guɔ.
2Nɔmlɔ adesa blɔ tsuo da ngɛ lɛ nitsɛ e hɛ mi; se Yawɛ lɛ hyɛɔ nɔ tsui mi.
3Pee nɔ́ nɛ sa, kɛ nɔ́ nɛ da; lɔ ɔ saa Yawɛ hɛ mi pe nɔ nɛ a maa sã bɔ ha lɛ.
4He nɔ womi, kɛ he womi nɛ yiwutsotsɛmɛ nyaa he ɔ, yayami ji lɔ ɔmɛ.
5Nɔ nɛ bɔɔ mɔde kɛ toɔ níhi a blɔ nya saminya a, e naa ní babauu; se nɔ nɛ esɔ kɛkɛ e heɔ ɔ, e be nɔ́ kpakpa ko náe pe ohia.
6Ní nɛ o gu sisimi blɔ nɔ kɛ na a, e se kɛ we kulaa; kaa bɔ nɛ la muɔ se poɔ be kuku kɛkɛ ɔ, gbenɔ lɛ nyɛɛɔ se.
7Basabasa nɛ yiwutsotsɛmɛ peeɔ ɔ, lɔ ɔ nɔuu lɛ ma kpata a hɛ mi; ejakaa a sume nɛ a peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da.
8Nɔ nɛ yeɔ fɔ ɔ, e blɔ ngɛ gɔdɔgɔdɔ, se nɔ nɛ tsui mi tsɔ ɔ, e subai hi.
9E hi kaa o ma ya hi tsu yi mi banee, pe nɔ́ nɛ o kɛ yo pɛ wolɔ maa hi we kake mi.
10Yiwutsotsɛ lɛɛ yayami peemi pɛ e suɔ; e nyɛmi ní pee we lɛ mɔbɔ.
11Ke a gbla he nɔ wolɔ tue ɔ, kuasia po kaseɔ ní kɛ jeɔ mi. Nɛ ke a tsɔɔ nɔ nɛ ngɛ juɛmi ní ɔ, e leɔ.
12Mawu ngɛ yayami peeli tsuo hyɛe ngɛ a we ɔmɛ a mi, nɛ e ma kpata a hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ.
13Nɔ nɛ tsiɔ e tue, konɛ e ko nu ohiatsɛ ngmlaa a, lɛ hu ke e kpa ngmlaa a, a be lɛ tue bue.
14Nike ní nɛ a haa ngɛ laami mi jɔɔ abofu he kaa bɔ nɛ nyɔ mi ní haa mi mi la se poɔ ɔ.
15Ke a ye dami sane ɔ, nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ nɛ da a bua jɔɔ saminya; se yayami peeli lɛɛ sawale nuɔ mɛ.
16Nɔ nɛ hɛ mi ka we si ngɛ je mi, se nɔ́ nɛ e tsui suɔ lɛ e peeɔ ɔ, gbenɔ ji nɔ nɛ fɔɔ si ha lɛ.
17Nɔ nɛ suɔ fiɛmi maa ye ohia; nɔ nɛ dã, kɛ he dlami e suɔ ɔ, e be ní nae.
18Klama nɛ yiwutsotsɛmɛ tsɔɔ nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a, nyagbe ɔ, e duɔ mɛ nitsɛmɛ mohu.
19Afani nɔ́ nɛ o ma ya hi nga kplanaa nɔ pe nɔ́ nɛ o kɛ yo pɛ wolɔ nɛ hɛ kɔɔ maa hi si.
20Ní lelɔ buaa níhi nɛ a he jua wa nya ngɔ toɔ; kuasia lɛɛ e kpataa ní ɔmɛ a hɛ mi mohu.
21Nɔ nɛ yeɔ dami sane, nɛ e naa mɔbɔ ɔ, e se kɛɛ ngɛ je mi, nɛ a maa wo e hɛ mi nyami.
22Gbogbo nɛ katsɛmɛ fiaa kɛ bɔleɔ a mɔ, nɛ lɔ ɔ nɔ a ngɔɔ a hɛ ngɔ fɔɔ ɔ, ní lelɔ kuɔɔ nɛ e kpataa ma a hɛ mi.
23Nɔ nɛ hyɛɛ e nya, kɛ e lilɛ nɔ saminya ngɛ munyu tumi mi ɔ, e yeɔ e he kɛ jeɔ amanehlu mi.
24Nɔ nɛ woɔ e he nɔ, nɛ e tsɔɔ e he, nɛ e peeɔ pupuupu ɔ, e bui nɔ́.
25Nɔ́ hiaa hejɔtsɛ hluu kɛ ya siɔ e gboɔ, ejakaa e sume nɛ e kɛ e nine tsuɔ ní. 26Nɔ nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a, e haa nɔ nɔ́, nɛ e nyɛ́ nɔ nɔ́ he; se yiwutsotsɛ lɛɛ daa nɛ ɔ, e hɛ ngɛ nɔ́ nɔ kɔe.
27Yayami peelɔ bɔ ɔ, Yawɛ sume kulaa, hluu nɛ a de ke yi mi tomi yayami piɛ bɔ ɔ he.
28Lakpa odase yelɔ hɛ mi ma kpata. Nɔ nɛ susuɔ munyu he loko e tuɔ ɔ, lɛɛ e munyu ɔ, a ngɔɔ.
29Yiwutsotsɛ toɔ e hɛ mi liliili kɛ peeɔ yayami; nɔ nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da lɛɛ e susuɔ níhi a he saminya.
30Adesa nile, loo nɔ́ sisi numi, loo ga be nyɛe maa da Yawɛ hɛ mi.
31Adesa dlaa e we okpɔngɔ he kɛ ha ta hwumi; se kunimi yemi ɔ lɛɛ Yawɛ dɛ mi e ngɛ.

Title: ABƐ 22
Content:
1Biɛ kpakpa hi pe ní nami babauu. Bu hu hi pe sika hiɔ, loo sika tsu.
2Niatsɛ, kɛ ohiatsɛ ɔ, nimli kake too ji mɛ; Yawɛ lɛ pee mɛ tsuo.
3Nɔmlɔ nɛ le nɔ́ ɔ, ke e na haomi nɛ ma a, e tuu nya fo, nɛ e ya laa e he. Nɔ nɛ be juɛmi ɔ, lɛɛ e kɛ e he ya woɔ haomi mi, nɛ e naa nɔ́.
4Nɔ nɛ baa e he si, nɛ e yeɔ Yawɛ gbeye ɔ, e naa ní, e hɛ mi baa nyami, nɛ e wami se kɛɔ.
5Mio, kɛ klama ngɛ yayami peelɔ blɔ mi. Nɔmlɔ nɛ hyɛɔ e he nɔ saminya a, e maa yu e he kɛ je ní nɛ ɔmɛ a he.
6Tsɔse jokuɛyo nɛ e le bɔ nɛ e maa ba e je mi ha, nɛ ke e wa a, e hɛ be nɔ jee.
7Niatsɛ nyɔguɛ ji ohiatsɛ. Ke o pa sika ngɛ nɔ ko dɛ kɛkɛ o plɛ pee e nyɔguɛ.
8Nɔ nɛ yi dami sane ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ maa ba e nɔ ji amanehlu. Kɛkɛ ɔ, yi mi nɛ e waa nihi ɔ tsuo se maa po.
9Nɔ nɛ mi mi jɔ ɔ, a gbaa lɛ, ejakaa e ngɔɔ e niye ní kɛ haa ohiatsɛmɛ.
10Nɔmlɔ nɛ yeɔ nɔ he fɛu ɔ, fie lɛ kɛ je o kasa nya. Kɛkɛ ɔ, huhui, pɛ, kɛ nɔ jɛmi se maa po.
11Nɔ nɛ tsui mi tsɔ, nɛ e munyu ngɛ blɛuu ɔ, e kɛ matsɛ maa bɔ.
12Yawɛ haa anɔkuale daa si, nɛ yayami peelɔ munyuhi peeɔ yaka.
13Nɔ́ nɛ hejɔtsɛ deɔ ji, “Jata ngɛ blɔ mi; ke i je kpo ɔ, e maa gbe mi.”
14Yo yaholɔ nya mi ngɛ kaa muɔ voo nɛ a tsua kɛ fɔ si. Nihi nɛ Yawɛ mi mi fu mɛ lɛ a nɔɔ muɔ nɛ ɔ mi.
15Nɔ́ nɛ jokuɛyo suɔ peemi ji kuasia jemi. Se tsɔsemi tso fieɔ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ kɛ jeɔ e he.
16Nɔ nɛ waa ohiatsɛmɛ yi mi nɛ e kɛ naa ní, aloo nɔ nɛ keɔ niatsɛmɛ ní ɔ, nyagbe ɔ, lɛ nitsɛ e ma ba ye ohia.
Nile munyu nyingmi etɛ
17Bu tue, nɛ o nu munyuhi nɛ ní leli tuɔ, nɛ o kase ní kɛ je mi. 18Ke o pee ja a, e maa hi ha mo, nɛ o ma na bua jɔmi. O ma kai munyu nɛ ɔmɛ daa, nɛ mo hu o ma nyɛ maa tu munyu nɛ ɔmɛ be tsuaa be nɛ o suɔ. 19I suɔ kaa o ngɔ o hɛ kɛ fɔ Yawɛ nɔ, lɔ ɔ he nɛ i ngɛ mo ní nɛ ɔmɛ dee mwɔnɛ ɔ nɛ. 20I ngma nile, kɛ ga womi munyu nyingmi etɛ nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ ha mo, 21konɛ o le nɔ́ nɛ ji anɔkuale tutuutu. Kɛkɛ ɔ, ke a tsɔ mo ɔ, o ma na heto kpakpa ba ha nɔ nɛ tsɔ mo ɔ.
-1-
22Ko de ke ohiatsɛ pi nɔ ko he je ɔ, o maa sisi lɛ. Nɔ nɛ e yi fi ngɛ kojomi he ɔ, koo wa lɛ yi mi. 23Yawɛ nitsɛ maa ye jamɛatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a sane ha mɛ. Ke nɔ ko wo a susuma he gbeye ɔ, Yawɛ maa wo lɛ hu e susuma he gbeye ja nɔuu.
-2-
24Nɔmlɔ nɛ be tsui ɔ, o kɛ lɛ ko bɔ. Nɔ nɛ mi mi fuɔ mla a, o kɛ lɛ ko nyɛɛ. 25Ke o kɛ lɛ bɔ ɔ, o maa kase e ní peemi níhi, nɛ enɛ ɔ maa pee klama nɛ du mo.
-3-
26Koo pee o he nɔmlɔ nɛ daa hiɔ nya ha nihi. 27Ke o nyɛ we nɛ o wo hiɔ ɔ, o sa tete po a ma kpɔ ngɛ o dɛ.
-4-
28Blema buna nɛ o nɛmɛ kɛ kadi zugba a, koo hɛ.
-5-
29Anɛ o le nɔ ko nɛ tsuɔ ní saminya lo? Jamɛ a nɔ ɔ, matsɛmɛ nɛ e ma sɔmɔ; pi ni guhi.

Title: ABƐ 23
Content:
-6-
1Ke o kɛ ma nɔ yelɔ yaa ye ní ɔ, susu nɔ nɛ hɛ mi nɛ o hii si ngɛ ɔ he saminya. 2Ke ngma yelɔ ji mo ɔ, ye o he nɔ, nɛ o ye bɔbɔyoo pɛ. 3Ko ha nɛ ma nɔ yelɔ ɔ ní ngɔngɔɛ ɔ nɛ jlo mo; ejakaa pe e kɛ ngɛ mo kae.
-7-
4Ko gbo dengme ke doo ja o na ní. Ka kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ, o hɛ mi nɛ ka si, nɛ o ye nɔ. 5Hɛngmɛfia pɛ sika a ma nyɛ laa mo; e maa pee kɔɔhiɔ nɛ e maa laa tlukaa kaa kɔle tee kɛ yaa hiɔwe.
-8-
6Ke kpɛletsɛ ha mo abolo ɔ, koo ye; ko ha nɛ e niye ní ngɔngɔɛ ɔ nɛ jlo mo. 7Jamɛatsɛ ɔ ngɛ kaa nɔ ko nɛ buɔ akɔtaa ngɛ e yi mi; e deɔ mo ke, “Ye ní, nuu ní”; se anɔkuale mi ɔ, e tsui be o he. 8E niye ní bɔbɔyoo nɛ o ye ɔ, o maa vie lɛ tsuo, nɛ o munyu ngɔngɔɛ nɛ o tu kɛ je e yi ɔ maa pee yaka.
-9-
9Koo tu munyu kɛ wo kuasia ga; ejakaa nile nɛ ngɛ o munyu ɔ mi ɔ, e maa gbe he guɛ.
-10-
10Koo hɛ blema buna kɛ ya se; nɛ ko ya sɛ awusahi a ngmɔ mi. 11Ejakaa a kpɔlɔ ɔ ngɛ he wami nɛ e kɛ mo ma na, nɛ e maa ye sane ɔ ha mɛ.
-11-
12Ke a ngɛ mo nile munyu tue ɔ, bu tue nɛ o kase ní kɛ je mi.
-12-
13Ke e hia kaa a tsɔse jokuɛ ɔ, tsɔse lɛ; ejakaa ke o fia lɛ kpa a, e be gboe. 14Ke o fia lɛ kpa a, e ma he e yi wami, nɛ e hɛ mi be kpatae.
-13-
15Ye bi, ke o le ní ɔ, imi hu ye bua maa jɔ. 16Ke i nu nɛ munyu kpakpa ngɛ o nya mi jee ɔ, ma na bua jɔmi.
-14-
17Hyɛ nɛ o hɛ ko kɔ yayami peeli a nɔ, mohu ɔ, ye Yawɛ gbeye daa. 18Niinɛ, hwɔɔ se o hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi ɔ be yaka pee.
-15-
19Ye bi, bu tue, nɛ o le ní; hyɛ o je mi bami nɔ saminya. 20Ko ya piɛ nihi nɛ nuu wai fuu tsɔ, loo nihi nɛ peeɔ de lo he jiklɔɔ a he. 21Dã deli, kɛ jiklɔɔtsɛmɛ maa ye ohia; nihi nɛ deɔ kɔnɛɛ be tsuaa be ɔ ma bu bo gbagbɛ.
-16-
22Bu o tsɛ nɛ fɔ mo ɔ tue; nɛ ke o nyɛ bwɔ ɔ, koo gbe e he guɛ.
23Anɔkuale yemi, nile, tsɔsemi, kɛ sane se kɔmi a he jua wa saminya; e sa kaa a di se nɛ a ko ngmɛɛ he.
24Bi nɛ peeɔ nɔ nɛ da a, e haa e tsɛ nyaa babauu; nɔ nɛ fɔ bi ní lelɔ ɔ, e bua jɔɔ e bi ɔ he.
25Ha nɛ o tsɛ, kɛ o nyɛ a bua nɛ jɔ; ha nɛ o nyɛ nɛ fɔ mo ɔ nɛ nya.
-17-
26Ye bi, bu mi tue saminya; ha nɛ ye je mi bami nɛ pee nɔhyɛ nɔ́ ha mo! 27Yo yaholɔ, loo yo nɛ puɛɔ gba ngɛ kaa klama nɛ a tsɔ; e kɛ nɔ yaa gbenɔ mi. 28E woɔ ka kaa ojo fialɔ, nɛ e haa nyumuhi babauu puɛɔ gba.
-18-
29Mɛnɔ naa nɔ́? Mɛnɔ haoɔ? Mɛnɔ kɛ nihi naa pɛ? Mɛnɔ hii kɔmɔ yee? Mɛnɔ naa pá ngɛ e he yaka gu? Mɛnɔ hɛngmɛhi peeɔ tsutsuutsu kɔlukɔlu? 30Jamɛatsɛmɛ ji nihi nɛ a se kɛɔ ngɛ wai numi he, nihi nɛ a ya kaa dã slɔɔtoslɔɔto nɛ a futu mi hyɛɔ ɔ!
31Koo hyɛ wai, bɔ nɛ e tsuɔ paa, bɔ nɛ e hɛ mi ngɛ fɛu ngɛ kplu mi, bɔ nɛ e bee miaa ngɛ kuɔ si, nɛ e ko ba ka mo. 32Ke pi ja a, nɔ́ nɛ maa nyɛɛ se ji o he mi tsuo maa hi mo tsɛ̃e kaa nɔ́ nɛ sinɔ duɔtsɛ lɛ kɔ mo. 33O hɛngmɛ maa na nyakpɛ níhi; o yi mi maa pee mo basaa, nɛ o maa hi ní tsuae kɛkɛ. 34O maa pee kaa nɔ ko nɛ tlɔ wo mi, aloo nɔ ko nɛ kplaa si ngɛ abalaa tso he ngɛ lɛ mi. 35O ma de ke, “A fia mi ní, se i nui he fɛɛ; a fia mi kpa, lɔ ɔ hu i nui he! Mɛni be ye hɛ maa tsɛ? Aa, ma hla dã bɔɔ nɛ ma nu ekohu!”

Title: ABƐ 24
Content:
-19-
1O hɛ ko kɔ yayami peeli a nɔ, nɛ ko hla kaa o kɛ mɛ maa bɔ hulɔ. 2Basabasa peemi kɛkɛ ji nɔ́ nɛ a suɔ; nɛ munyu yaya nɛ jeɔ a nya mi.
-20-
3Nile a kɛ poɔ we; e nɔ nɛ a maa we ɔ kɛ fɔɔ. 4Juɛmi nɛ a kɛ dlaa tsu mi, nɛ a woɔ mi ní kpakpahi, kɛ afɛu níhi.
-21-
5Ní lelɔ he wa kulaa pe nɔ nɛ́ ngɛ nɔmlɔ tso he wami kpakpataa po. Ní lelɔ he wami hiɛ babauu. 6E sa kaa o toɔ ga saminya loko o yaa ta. Ke o ngɛ ga woli babauu ɔ, o yeɔ kunimi.
-22-
7Nile munyuhi a mi kuɔ tsɔ pe bɔ nɛ kuasia maa nu sisi. Ke a ngɛ níhi nɛ a he hia he susue ɔ, e nyɛ we nɛ e paa e nya mi.
-23-
8Nɔ nɛ hii yayami peemi he ga toe kpamisa a, klama tsɔlɔ a tsɛɔ lɛ. 9Ga tsuaa ga nɛ kuasia toɔ ɔ, e peeɔ yayami. Nɔmlɔ nɛ nihi a he fɛu pɛ e yeɔ ɔ, a hiee lɛ.
-24-
10Ke haomi ba o nɔ, nɛ o pee gbedee ɔ, e tsɔɔ kaa o he wami pi saasaa.
-25-
11Ke a gbla nɔ ko kɛ yaa nɛ a ya gbe lɛ yaka gu ɔ, o he nɛ sɔ kɛ kpɔ lɛ. 12Ko de ke o li he nɔ́ ko, ejakaa Mawu nɛ naa nɔmlɔ tsui mi ɔ lɛɛ e na, nɛ e le hulɔ. Nɛ e maa wo mo hiɔ ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ o pee ɔ he.
-26-
13Ye bi, moo ye hwo, ejakaa e hi. Nɛ kaa bɔ nɛ hwo nɛ je hwo gbaku mi ngɔɔ ngɛ o lilɛ nɔ ɔ, 14jã kɛ̃ ji bɔ nɛ nile ngɛ kɛ ha o susuma. Ke o ná nile ɔ, e he maa ba se nami, nɛ hwɔɔ se ɔ, o hɛ nɔ kami be yaka pee.
-27-
15Koo pee o ní kaa yiwutsotsɛmɛ nɛ woɔ nimli kpakpahi ka nɛ a ngɔɔ a níhi, aloo a kpɔɔ a wehi ngɛ a dɛ pani nya. 16Nɔmlɔ kpakpa a, ke e nɔ si nɔtonɔto si kpaago po, e maa te si ekohu. Se nimli yayamihi lɛɛ ke haomi ba a nɔ kɛkɛ a hɛ mi kpata pɛsɛpɛsɛ.
-28-
17Ke o he nyɛlɔ tɛ nɔ́, loo e nɔ si ɔ, ko nya. 18Ke o pee ja a, Yawɛ maa na, nɛ e maa dɔ lɛ, nɛ e be o he nyɛlɔ ɔ tue gblae hu.
-29-
19Koo ye o tsui ngɛ yayami peeli a he; o hɛ ko kɔ a nɔ hulɔ. 20Ejakaa hwɔɔ se ko be ha yayami peeli; a hɛ nɔ kami maa pee yaka.
-30-
21Ye bi, ye Yawɛ gbeye, nɛ o bu matsɛ. Nihi nɛ teɔ si kɛ woɔ mɛ ɔ, o kɛ jamɛatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ko bɔ. 22Ejakaa Mawu, loo matsɛ ɔ maa gbla a tue tlukaa. Nɛ haomi nɛ maa ba a nɔ ɔ, mɛnɔ lɛ le?
Nile munyu kpa komɛ
23Ní leli a munyu komɛ hu ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ.
Ke a ngɛ kojoe ɔ, e sɛ kaa a hyɛɔ nɔ hɛ mi. 24Nɔ nɛ ma de yayami peelɔ ke e ye nguɔ ɔ, nihi tsuo maa gbiɛ lɛ, nɛ a maa nyɛ lɛ. 25Se nihi nɛ kaa yayami peeli a hɛ mi ɔ, mɛɛ lɛɛ a maa gbaa mɛ, nɛ e maa hi ha mɛ.
26Ke a bi mo munyu, nɛ o ha heto pɛpɛɛpɛ ɔ, huɛ bɔmi kpakpa he okadi ji lɔ ɔ nɛ.
27Ke o maa po we ɔ, hu o ngmɔ ɔ kekle, nɛ o na nɔ́ ko kɛ je mi kɛ to, loko o po we ɔ.
28Koo ye odase kɛ si o nyɛmi yaka gu, nɛ koo ngɔ o nya mi munyu hu kɛ sisi nɔ. 29Ko de ke, “Ma pee lɛ kaa bɔ nɛ e pee mi ɔ!” Ko de ke, “Nɔ́ nɛ e pee mi ɔ, imi hu ma pee lɛ kɛ to nya!”
30I nyɛɛ kɛ ya gu hejɔtsɛ ko ngmɔ mi; i ya be ngɛ nɔ ko nɛ be juɛmi e wai ngmɔ mi. 31Ngmɔ ɔmɛ a nɔ hɛ wawɛɛ nitsɛ; hu kɛ mio tso sɔuu. Tɛ gbogbo nɛ a fia kɛ bɔle ngmɔ ɔmɛ hu ku pueɔ si. 32I hyɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ too; i susu he, nɛ i kase ní kɛ je mi. 33 O ma nyɛ ma bua o nine nya nɛ o jɔɔ o he faa. Moo lɛɛ mo je o hɛ se bɔɔ! Moo lɛɛ moo hwɔ mahe koo! 34Se be mi nɛ o hwɔɔ si ɔ, ohia ma ba na mo tlukaa kaa bɔ nɛ ojo fialɔ ba tuaa nɔ ɔ. Nɛ o yi ma fi kaa nɔ nɛ ta bulɔ mia kɛ ba tua lɛ.

Title: ABƐ 25
Content:
Salomo Abɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ tsami
1Salomo abɛ kpahi nɛ Yuda matsɛ, Hezekia we bi ɔmɛ bua nya ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ.
2Hɛ mi nyami sa Mawu kaa e ngɔɔ níhi kɛ laa wɔ; matsɛmɛ lɛɛ bu sa mɛ, ejakaa a hyɛɔ níhi a mi fitsofitso.
3Bɔ nɛ hiɔwe kɛ zugba a kpɛti kɛ ha a, ja lɛ nɔ́ nɛ matsɛ ngɛ susue ngɛ e yi mi ɔ ngɛ; nɔ ko nɔ ko be nyɛe maa le.
4Ke sika hiɔ galɔ je sika fĩ kɛ je sika hiɔ mi loko e naa june nɛ e kɛ tsuɔ nɔ́ ko kpakpa.
5Ke a je nimli yayamihi kɛ je matsɛ ga woli a kpɛti ɔ, dami sane yemi yaa nɔ saminya ngɛ matsɛ ɔ nɔ yemi he ɔ.
6 Koo pee o he nɔ agbo ngɛ matsɛ hɛ mi; nɛ ko ya da si ngɛ nimli nguahi a da he.
7E hi kaa a ma tsɛ mo kɛ ya yimɛ a je pe nɔ́ nɛ a maa tsɛ̃ mo kɛ ya sisimɛ a je ngɛ ganɔ ɔ hɛ mi.
8Nɔ bi nya sɔɛ ngɛ sane yemi he kɛ de nɔ́ nɛ e na. Ke o nya sɔ kɛ tu munyu, nɛ nyagbe ɔ, o nyɛmi ba pue o hɛ mi si ɔ, kɛ o maa pee kɛɛ?
9Ke o kɛ o nyɛmi ngɛ pɛ ko ɔ, o kɛ lɛ pɛ nyɛ hla nya. Koo wo nɔ kpa laami sane nɔ ta. 10Ke o pee ja, nɛ nɔ ko nu he ɔ, e ma pue o hɛ mi si, nɛ o biɛ yaya a maa tlɔ o he daa.
11Munyu nɛ a tu pɛpɛɛpɛ ngɛ be nɛ sa mi ɔ, e ngɛ kaa sika tsu akutuhi nɛ a to ngɔ wo sika hiɔ nɔ́ mi.
12Ke ní lelɔ ka o hɛ mi nɛ o bu tue ɔ, e ngɛ kaa june kpakpa nɛ e ke mo.
13Tsɔlɔ nɛ yeɔ anɔkuale ɔ, e haa e nyɔmtsɛmɛ a tsui nɔɔ a mi kaa bɔ nɛ nyu nganii jɔɔ nɔ tsui he latsa be mi ke a ngɛ ní kpae ɔ.
14Nɔ nɛ fĩaa ke e maa ke nɔ nɔ́, se e yi nɔ gblee ɔ, e ngɛ kaa bɔku kɛ kɔɔhiɔ nɛ nyu be mi.
15Ke o to o tsui si nɛ o kɛ matsɛ tu munyu ɔ, o ma nyɛ tsake e yi mi tomi. Ke sane ɔ he wa kaa tɛ po, munyu blɛuu nyɛɔ jɔɔ he.
16Ke o na hwo ɔ, ye bɔ nɛ maa su o nya pɛ, konɛ e ko de mo nɛ o ba vie ngɔ pue si. 17O nane ko pɔ o huɛ we mi fiɛmi, konɛ o sane ko ba ti lɛ, nɛ́ e ba nyɛ mo.
18Nɔ nɛ yeɔ lakpa odase ngɛ e nyɛmi he ɔ, e ngɛ kaa tsokpoti, loo klaate, loo kɛ̃ɛ̃ mi bi nɛ nya ba.
19Ke hɛdɔ ba, nɛ o ngɔ o hɛ kɛ fɔ nɔmlɔ yayami nɔ ɔ, e ngɛ kaa nɔ́ nɛ o kɛ lungu yaya ngɛ nɔ́ tae, loo o kɛ nane nɛ tɔ̃ ngɛ nyɛɛe.
20Ke nɔ ko ngɛ kɔmɔ yee, nɛ moo o ngɛ bua jɔmi la lae ngɛ e kasa nya a, e ngɛ kaa nɔ́ nɛ o ngɛ kɔmɔ yelɔ ɔ bo kpae ngɛ e he fĩɛ be mi, aloo o kɛ ngo ngɛ e pá nɔ puee.
21 Ke hwɔ ngɛ o he nyɛlɔ yee ɔ, ha lɛ ní nɛ e ye; nɛ ke kuma ngɛ lɛ yee ɔ, ha lɛ nyu nɛ e nu. 22Ke o pee ja a, zo kpɔtɔɔ maa gbe lɛ, nɛ Yawɛ maa gbaa mo.
23Kɔɔhiɔ nɛ jeɔ omleyi ɔ, hiɔmi e kɛ baa kaa bɔ nɛ sieku yemi kɛ hɛ mi tumi baa a.
24E hi kaa o ma ya hi tsu yi mi banee, pe nɔ́ nɛ o kɛ yo pɛ wolɔ maa hi we kake mi.
25Ke o nu manye munyu kɛ je ma se ɔ, e ngɛ kaa nɔ́ nɛ o ná nyu nɛ mi jɔ nɛ o kɛ maa gbe kuma.
26Dalɔ nɛ ngmɛɛɔ nɔ́ he ha yayami peelɔ ɔ, e ngɛ kaa nyu nɛ a gbidi mi, loo vu nɛ e mi nyu ɔ puɛ.
27Hwo babauu yemi hí; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ko hla yi jemi kɛ be nɔ.
28Nɔ nɛ nyɛ we e he nɔ nɛ e ye ɔ, e ngɛ kaa ma nɛ a ba tua lɛ, nɛ a ku e gbogbo ɔmɛ kɛ pue si.

Title: ABƐ 26
Content:
1Hɛ mi nyami sɛ kuasia, kaa snoo ngɛ latsa be mi, aloo hiɔmi ngɛ ní kpami be mi.
2Gbiɛmi nɛ a gbiɛɛ nɔ yaka gu ɔ, e tsu we nɔ́ ko; e ngɛ kaa otoklii, aloo ngmlebitɛɛnyɛ nɛ ngɛ tee kɛ ngɛ yae kɛ ngɛ bae kɛkɛ nɛ si mami be mi.
3Okpɔngɔ ɔ, kpa a fiaa lɛ; teji ɔ, a woɔ e nya mi dade, nɛ kuasia lɛɛ e nɔ́ ji tso.
4Ke o ma ha kuasia e munyu heto ɔ, koo tu munyu kaa bɔ nɛ lɛɛ e tuɔ munyu ɔ. Ke o pee ja a, mo hu o maa je kuasia kaa lɛ nɔuu.
5Ke kuasia tu biɛmi munyu ɔ, ha lɛ heto bɔ nɛ sa lɛ pɛ. Kɛkɛ ɔ, e maa na kaa mamoo e li nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko fɛɛ.
6Ke o tsɔ kuasia a, e ngɛ kaa nɔ́ nɛ o poo mo nitsɛ o nanehi ngɔ fɔ he, aloo o nu duɔ nɔ́ nɛ kpataa nɔ hɛ mi.
7Kuasia nya mi abɛ he be se nami, kaa bɔ nɛ glɔtsɛ nanehi kplaa si gu ngɛ e he ɔ.
8Nɔ nɛ ngɛ kuasia hɛ mi nyami woe ɔ, e ngɛ kaa nɔ ko nɛ ngɛ tɛ fie kɛ ngɛ amlami mi woe.
9Ke kuasia ngɛ abɛ bue ɔ, e ngɛ kaa dã delɔ nɛ ngɛ mio hiae ngɛ e dɛ mi.
10Nɔ nɛ bɔɔ dã delɔ, aloo kuasia nɛ bee kɛkɛ apaa a, e ngɛ kaa kɛ̃ɛ̃ tsɛ̃lɔ nɛ ngɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ plaae.
11Kuasia nɛ kpaleɔ ya jeɔ kuasia si enyɔne ɔ, e ngɛ kaa gbe nɛ kpaleɔ ya yeɔ lɛ nitsɛ e vie ekohu.
12Ke nɔ ko buu e he ní lelɔ, nɛ pohu e li nɔ́ ko ɔ, hɛ nɔ kami ngɛ ha kuasia po pe lɛ.
13Nɔ́ nɛ hejɔtsɛ deɔ ji, “Jata ngɛ blɔ mi! Jata ngɛ blɔ kpɛ!”
14Hejɔtsɛ hii plɛe ngɛ sa mi kaa bɔ nɛ sinya plɛɔ e he ngɛ e se asahi a nɔ ɔ.
15Hejɔtsɛ nine tlɔɔ ka mi; dengme loko e kpaleɔ e nine ɔ kɛ baa e nya he ekohu.
16Hejɔtsɛ buu e he ní lelɔ kulaa pe juɛmitsɛmɛ kpaago.
17Nɔ nɛ kɛ e he woɔ pɛ nɛ kɔ we e he mi ɔ, e ngɛ kaa nɔ ko nɛ na gbe nɛ bee nɛ e nu gbe ɔ tue.
18-19Nɔmlɔ nɛ sisiɔ e nyɛmi, nɛ pee se ɔ, e deɔ lɛ ke, “Oo, pe i kɛ mo ngɛ fiɛe” ɔ, jamɛ a nɔ ɔ ngɛ kaa godotsɛ nɛ e kɛ la tso, loo kɛ̃ɛ̃, loo gbenɔ nitsɛ ngɛ fiɛe.
20Ke lɛ́ be la tɛ mi ɔ, la gboɔ; he nɛ siekutsɛ be ɔ, pɛ se poɔ.
21Pɛ wolɔ he sɔɔ kɛ woɔ pɛ kaa bɔ nɛ la haa nɛ hã tsɛ̃ɔ ɔ.
22Siekutsɛ munyu ngɛ kaa niye ní ngɔngɔɛ nɛ ke o ye ɔ, e yaa nɔmlɔ tso ɔ mi he tsuaa he.
23Ke nɔ ko nya mi munyu ngɔɔ, se e tsui mi lɛɛ e hí ɔ, e ngɛ kaa zu buɛ nɛ a kɛ sika hiɔ ha he.
24Nɔmlɔ nɛ nyɛɔ nɔ ɔ, e kɛ mo maa tu munyu ngɔngɔɛ, se e tsui mi lɛɛ e sume mo saasaa. 25Ke e kɛ mo tu munyu dɔkɔbii ɔ, ko he lɛ nɛ o ye, ejakaa e tsui mi hyi tɔ kɛ ninyɛ sɔuu. 26Ke e ngɔ sisimi kɛ laa e ninyɛ ɔ nɔ kaa mɛni po, e yi wu tso ní peemi ɔmɛ maa je kpo kokooko ngɛ ma hɛ mi.
27Nɔ nɛ tsuaa muɔ kɛ fɔɔ si ha nɔ ko ɔ, lɛ nɔuu lɛ e maa nɔ mi. Nɔ nɛ kpɛneɔ tɛ ɔ, lɛ nɔuu e nɔ tɛ ɔ maa nɔ.
28Lakpatsɛ nyɛɔ nihi nɛ e ye a he lakpa a. Munyu dɔkɔbii tulɔ puɛɔ nɔ́.

Title: ABƐ 27
Content:
1 Koo fĩa kɛ fɔ hwɔɔ nɔ, ejakaa kɛ je mwɔnɛ ɔ kɛ yaa si hwɔɔ ɔ, o li nɔ́ nɛ maa ba ngɛ mi.
2Ha nɛ nɔ kpa nɛ je o yi. Ha nɛ nubwɔ mohu nɛ kɔ mo; pi mo nitsɛ.
3Tɛ jiɔ, nɛ zia hu jiɔ; se haomi nɛ kuasia we abofu kɛ baa a nya wa. Ke a ke a maa ngmɛ ɔ, tɛ kɛ zia a jiimi ɔ po pi nɔ́ ko kulaa nɛ a kɛ maa to he.
4Mi mi la puɛɔ ní wawɛɛ nitsɛ; nɛ muklii mi fumi hu nɔ́ pe, se hunga jemi lɛɛ e nɔ nya hi dami.
5Ke nɔ ko ka o hɛ mi ngɛ gua mi ɔ, e hi pe nɔ́ nɛ e suɔ mo ngɛ laami tso mi.
6Ke o huɛ plaa mo ɔ, nɔ́ kpakpa ko e ngɛ hlae ha mo; se o he nyɛlɔ lɛɛ pe e maa fua mo babauu kɛkɛ.
7Nɔ nɛ tɔ ɔ, ke a ha lɛ hwo po e sume; se nɔ nɛ hwɔ ngɛ lɛ yee ɔ, lɛɛ níhi nɛ dooɔ tete po ngɔɔ e nya.
8Nyumu nɛ jeɔ e we mi nɛ e ya hii kpae ɔ, e ngɛ kaa lohwe pɛlitsɛ nɛ e tsu nya blɔ laa lɛ.
9Ke haomi ba nɔ nɔ nɛ e ná bua wolɔ ɔ, e ngɛ kaa nu je via nɛ e kpa; nɛ e naa bua jɔmi.
10O hɛ ko je mo nitsɛ o huɛ, loo o tsɛ e huɛ nɔ; ke e fi mo ɔ, ko de ke doo o maa ya o nyɛmi ngɔ; o huɛ nɛ ngɛ o kasa nya a hi pe o nyɛmi nɛ ngɛ ma se lokoo.
11Ye bi, pee o he ní lelɔ, nɛ ma na bua jɔmi, konɛ ma na nɔ́ kpakpa ko ma de nɔ nɛ ngɛ mi ahlua bɔe ɔ.
12Nɔ nɛ le ní naa yayami nɛ ma, nɛ e ya laa e he; se kuasia lɛɛ e kɛ yayami ɔ ya kpee, nɛ e naa e mi nɔ́.
13Ke nɔ ko wo si kaa e maa da nubwɔ nɛ e li lɛ se ɔ, a ngɔ nɔ nɛ wo si ɔ tade kɛ to awaba.
14Nɔ nɛ teɔ si makɛ mla nɛ e ngaa e nyɛmi kɛ ngmlaa boboobo ɔ, a buɔ lɛ kaa pe e ngɛ nɔ ɔ gbiɛe mohu.
15Yo nɛ woɔ pɛ ɔ, e ngɛ kaa hiɔmi nyu nɛ ngɛ dɛe kɔ, kɔ, kɔ kpamisa. 16O be kikɛmɛ a yo nyɛe ma kpata gblegbleegble, kaa bɔ nɛ o be nyɛe maa tsi kɔɔhiɔ nya, loo o maa yɛ nyu kɛ wo kusii mi ɔ.
17Nɔmlɔ kaseɔ nile kɛ jeɔ e nyɛmi ngɔ, kaa bɔ nɛ dade duɔɔ dade nya a.
18Nɔ nɛ hyɛɔ ngmɔkɔ tso nɔ ɔ, lɛ nɛ e yeɔ ngmɔkɔ yiblii ɔ eko; nɔ nɛ buɔ e nyɔmtsɛ he ɔ, a woɔ e hɛ mi nyami.
19Nɔmlɔ adesa nitsɛ lɛ leɔ e tsui mi níhi, kaa bɔ nɛ e naa e hɛ mi foni paa ngɛ nyu hɛ mi ɔ.
20Nɔmlɔ adesa hɛngmɛ tɔɛ gblee kɛ nɔ́ hyɛmi, kaa bɔ nɛ gbenɔ hii nɔ hɛ mi kpatae kpamisa nɛ e kpa we ɔ.
21Ní kpakpahi nɛ a deɔ ngɛ nɔ ko he ɔ, lɔ ɔmɛ a kɛ yoɔ lɛ, kaa bɔ nɛ a kɛ la kaa sika hiɔ kɛ sika tsu ɔ.
22Ke a kongo kuasia kaa bɔ nɛ a gbeeɔ blɛfo ngɛ tso mi po, e biɛmi ɔ be tae.
23Hyɛ o to, kɛ o na nɔ saminya; 24ejakaa ní nami hí si kɛ yɛ neneene. Anɛ matsɛ yemi ko ngɛ nɛ be nyagbe lo? 25Ke nga gbli, nɛ nga mumu kpale puɛ, nɛ a bua lohwehi a niye ní nya ngɛ yo ɔmɛ a nɔ ɔ, 26jijɔ ɔmɛ a bwɔmi ɔ maa pee bo, nɛ o maa jua apletsi ɔmɛ kɛ he zugba; 27o ma na apletsi nyɔ nyu bɔ nɛ maa su o kɛ o we ɔ, kɛ o mawayi ɔmɛ tsuo a nya.

Title: ABƐ 28
Content:
1Yayami peelɔ tuɔ fo be mi nɛ nɔ ko nyɛɛ we e se. Nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a, mɛɛ lɛɛ a peeɔ kã kaa jata.
2Ma nɛ peeɔ yayami ɔ, pe a hii ma nɔ yeli ɔmɛ tsakee nɔtonɔto kpamisa. Se ma nɛ ní leli, kɛ nɔ́ sisi nuli hiɛ ngɛ mi ɔ, e maa si kpɛii.
3Ohiatsɛ nɛ waa e nyɛmi ohiatsɛ yi mi ɔ, e ngɛ kaa hiɔmi nɛ nɛɔ kpatakpata tlukaa kɛ kpataa niye ní hɛ mi.
4Nɔ nɛ bui mlaa a, e kɛ nimli yayamihi lɛ bɔɔ. Se nɔ nɛ yeɔ mlaa nɔ ɔ, lɛɛ e kɛ mɛ toɔ ní.
5Yayami peeli nui dami sane yemi sisi. Ni nɛmɛ nɛ sɔmɔɔ Yawɛ ɔ, mɛɛ lɛɛ a nuɔ sisi saminya.
6Ohiatsɛ nɛ yeɔ anɔkuale ɔ, e hi pe niatsɛ nɛ peeɔ níhi nɛ dɛ.
7Bi nɛ yeɔ mlaa nɔ ɔ, ní lelɔ ji lɛ. Se nɔ nɛ kɛ jiklɔɔtsɛmɛ bɔɔ ɔ, lɛɛ e woɔ e fɔli zo.
8Nɔ nɛ paa sika ha nɔ nɛ e heɔ hekpa babauu ɔ, pe e ngɛ e juetli ɔ nya buae kɛ ha nɔ nɛ naa ohiatsɛmɛ mɔbɔ.
9Nɔ nɛ sume kaa e yeɔ mlaa nɔ ɔ, ke e fa kue ha Mawu po, e bɔ musu.
10Ke o sisi nɔ nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da, nɛ e ya pee yayami ɔ, muɔ nɛ o tsua ngɔ to ha lɛ ɔ, mo nitsɛ o maa nɔ mi.
Nɔ nɛ lɛɛ e pee we nɔ́ ko nɛ dɛ ɔ, e ma na hiɔwo kpakpa.
11Niatsɛ buɔ e he ní lelɔ. Se ohiatsɛ nɛ juɛmi ngɛ e dɛ ɔ, lɛ nɛ e le bɔ nɛ niatsɛ ɔ ngɛ ha.
12Ke nimli kpakpahi ye manye ɔ, nihi tsuo a bua jɔɔ a he. Se ke nimli yayamihi a nine ya hiɔwe ɔ, nihi tsuo laa a he.
13Nɔ nɛ laa e yayamihi a nɔ ɔ, e yɛ nɔ. Se nɔ nɛ jajeɔ e he yayami, nɛ e kpaa yayami peemi ɔ, a maa na lɛ mɔbɔ.
14A gbaa nɔ nɛ yeɔ Yawɛ gbeye daa. Se nɔmlɔ nɛ tue wa a, lɛɛ haomi maa ba e nɔ.
15Matsɛ yiwutsotsɛ nɛ ngɛ tsɛ yee ngɛ nihi nɛ a ní ngɛ mɔbɔ a nɔ ɔ, e ngɛ kaa jata nɛ ngɛ huae, aloo osisiblisi nɛ e hɛ mi wo la.
16Nɔ yelɔ nɛ be juɛmi ɔ, yiwutsotsɛ kpanaku ji lɛ. Se nɔ nɛ sume níhi nɛ a naa kɛ guu sisimi blɔ nɔ ɔ, lɛɛ e se maa kɛ ngɛ sɛ ɔ nɔ.
17Ke nɔ ko pue nɔ ko muɔ si ɔ, e maa bɔ ko, nɛ e maa hi kpae hluu kɛ yaa si e hɛ mi ma kpata. Nɔ ko nɔ ko nɛ ko na lɛ mɔbɔ.
18Nɔ nɛ yeɔ anɔkuale ɔ, a ma he e yi wami. Se nɔ nɛ ní peemi níhi dɛ ɔ, lɛɛ e maa nɔ muɔ mi tlukaa.
19Ngmɔ hulɔ nɛ kɔni si wa a ma na niye ní babauu. Se nɔ nɛ ya nyɛɛɔ yakayaka níhi a se ɔ, e we ohia maa kle.
20Nɔ nɛ yeɔ anɔkuale ɔ, a maa gbaa lɛ babauu. Se nɔ nɛ he sɔɔ kɛ naa ní ɔ, nyagbe ɔ, ja a gbla e tue kɛ̃.
21Nɔ hɛ mi hyɛmi hí. Abolo bɔbɔyoo ko nɛ o kɛ maa wo nɔ ko nya mi ɔ ma ha nɛ nɔ ɔ maa pee nɔ́ nɛ dɛ amlɔ.
22Nɔmlɔ nɛ hɛ mi sãã lɛ hlaa kaa e he maa sɔ kɛ na ní. Se e li tete kaa hwɔɔ se ɔ, e ma ba ye ohia.
23Nɔ nɛ kaa nɔ hɛ mi ɔ, pee se ɔ, e naa yi jemi kulaa pe nɔ nɛ kɛ munyu ngɔngɔɛ gbeɔ e nyɛmi yi mi.
24Nɔ nɛ juɔ e tsɛ, loo e nyɛ, nɛ e deɔ ke tsa pi yayami ji lɔ ɔ, e kɛ ojo fialɔ ɔ, slɔɔto be a kpɛti.
25Nɔ nɛ hɛ tsuɔ ɔ, pɛ wolɔ ji lɛ. Se nɔ nɛ ngɔɔ e he kɛ fɔɔ Yawɛ nɔ ɔ, níhi a mi hii ha lɛ.
26Nɔ nɛ heɔ e he yeɔ ɔ, kuasia ji lɛ. Se nɔ nɛ buɔ ní leli a munyu tue ɔ, e maa hi ha lɛ.
27Nɔ nɛ kee ohiatsɛmɛ ní ɔ, nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko be lɛ hiae. Nɔ nɛ naa ohiatsɛmɛ nɛ e maa e hɛngmɛ ɔ, nihi babauu maa gbiɛ lɛ.
28Ke yiwutsotsɛmɛ ngɛ tsɛ yee ɔ, nihi laa a he. Ke a kpa mɛ ɔ, ni kpakpahi ba yeɔ tsɛ ekohu.

Title: ABƐ 29
Content:
1Nɔ nɛ ke a ka e hɛ mi, nɛ e waa tue kɛ mwɔɔ ɔ, e maa ku kɛ pue si tlukaa, nɛ e be hie tsami.
2Ke nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ nɛ da ngɛ ma nɔ ye ɔ, ma mi bi ɔmɛ a bua jɔɔ saminya; se ke nɔ yeli ɔmɛ ya pee yiwutsotsɛmɛ ɔ, ma a yeɔ kɔmɔ wawɛɛ nitsɛ.
3Bi nɛ nyaa nile he ɔ, e haa e fɔli bua jɔmi; se nɔ nɛ kɛ yaholi ya bɔɔ ɔ, e kpataa e weto ní hɛ mi.
4Matsɛ nɛ yeɔ dami sane ɔ, e ma a yaa nɔ saminya; se nɔ nɛ heɔ nike ní pani nya ngɛ e ma mi bi a dɛ ɔ, e ywiaa ma a.
5Nɔ nɛ kɛ e nyɛmi tuɔ munyu dɔkɔbii ɔ, klama e ngɛ lɛ tsɔe ɔ nɛ.
6Nɔmlɔ yaya a, lɛ nitsɛ e ní yayamihi lɛ peeɔ klama ha lɛ nɛ e duɔ; se nɔ nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a, lɛɛ pe e laa, nɛ e nyaa.
7Nɔ nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a, e le ohiatsɛmɛ a hiami níhi, se yiwutsotsɛ lɛɛ e juɛmi sui ní nɛ ɔmɛ a he kulaa.
8Nihi nɛ yeɔ nɔ he fɛu woɔ pɛ ngɛ ma mi; se ní leli haa ma mi jɔɔ.
9Ke ní lelɔ kɛ kuasia na sane ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ kuasia peeɔ kɛkɛ ji kaa e hii kuɛe, nɛ e hii muɔe, nɛ lejɛ ɔ tsuo peeɔ hoo.
10Muɔ si pueli sume nihi nɛ pee we yayami; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a hlaa kaa a ma kpata nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ da a hɛ mi.
11Kuasia jeɔ e we abofu tsuo kpo; se ní lelɔ lɛɛ e toɔ e tsui si kɛ tsiɔ abofu nya.
12Nɔ yelɔ nɛ lakpa munyu tue e buɔ ɔ, e tsɔli tsuo peeɔ yiwutsotsɛmɛ.
13Ohiatsɛ kɛ nɔ nɛ ngɛ lɛ yi mi wae ɔ, a sɔ pɛ; mɛ tsuo ɔ, Yawɛ lɛ ha mɛ hɛngmɛ nɛ a kɛ hyɛɛ nɔ́.
14Matsɛ nɛ ngɔɔ anɔkuale yemi kɛ yeɔ dɛgutsɛmɛ a sane ɔ, e tsɛ yemi ɔ se kɛɔ.
15Ke a kɛ kpa tsɔse nɔ ɔ, e leɔ ní; se ke a ngmɛɛ jokuɛ je mi he ha lɛ ɔ, e pueɔ e nyɛ hɛ mi si.
16Ke yiwutsotsɛmɛ ngɛ nɔ yee ɔ, a peeɔ yi wu tso níhi babauu ngɛ ma a mi. Se nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da maa na yayami peeli ɔmɛ a hɛ mi si puemi ɔ.
17Tsɔse o bi saminya, nɛ o ma na yi jemi; nɛ o bua maa jɔ o he.
18Ma nɛ kɛ e hɛ fɔɛ Mawu nɔ ɔ, e níhi peeɔ basaa. Nɔ nɛ yeɔ mlaa a nɔ ɔ, a gbaa lɛ.
19Munyu babauu kɛkɛ tsɔse we tsɔlɔ; ejakaa e maa nu lɛɛ, se e be he ní tsue.
20Hɛ nɔ kami ngɛ ha kuasia pe nɔ nɛ tuɔ munyu puu.
21Nɔ nɛ haa e tsɔlɔ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ e biɔ lɛ be tsuaa be ɔ, nyagbe ɔ, tsɔlɔ ɔ mohu ba peeɔ wetsɛ.
22Nɔ nɛ woɔ e mi mi la a, e woɔ pɛ. Nɔ nɛ naa abofu peeɔ tɔmi babauu.
23Nɔ nɛ woɔ e he nɔ ɔ, a maa ba lɛ si; se nɔ nɛ baa e he si ɔ, a maa wo e hɛ mi nyami.
24Nɔ nɛ kɛ julɔ ya dlaa ju ní ɔ, e he mi jɔɛ lɛ kɔkɔɔkɔ; e nuɔ kita nɛ a ka ngɛ nɔ́ ɔ he, se e peeɔ kɔ̃, konɛ a ko nu nɔ́ ko kɛ je e nya.
25Ke o ngɛ nɔmlɔ adesa gbeye yee ɔ, o naa haomi; se ke o ngɔ o hɛ kɛ fɔ Yawɛ nɔ ɔ, nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko be o he sae.
26Nihi babauu buɔ kaa a maa sa nɔ yelɔ hɛ mi; se Yawɛ pɛ ji nɔ nɛ yeɔ dami sane ha nɔ.
27Bɔ nɛ yiwutsotsɛ sume nɔ nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da sane ɔ, jã kɛ̃ nɔ nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da hu sume yiwutsotsɛ sane.

Title: ABƐ 30
Content:
Agur munyuhi
1Yake nɛ je Masa a, e binyumu Agur sɛ gbi nɛ e ngɔ ha Itiel kɛ Ukal ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ. Nyumu ɔ ke, “Mawu lee! Peepee ta ye he oo, peepee ta ye he! Kɛ ma pee kɛɛ?
2Anɔkuale mi ɔ, i be nimlihi a kpɛti;
i pe lohwe tete po.
Juɛmi nɛ ngɛ nɔmlɔ adesa yi mi ɔ,
i be eko.
3I kase we nile;
Mawu Klɔuklɔu ɔ hu i li e he nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko.
4Mɛnɔ lɛ ya hiɔwe
nɛ e kpale kɛ ba zugba hyɛ?
Mɛnɔ lɛ bua kɔɔhiɔ nya
kɛ wo e dɛ mi hyɛ?
Mɛnɔ lɛ yɛ wo mi nyu ɔ tsuo
kɛ wo bo mi, nɛ e fi nya hyɛ?
Aloo mɛnɔ lɛ ma buna
ngɛ je ɔ mi nyagbe he ɔmɛ?
Kɛ a tsɛɔ lɛ kɛɛ?
E bi ɔ hu, mɛni ji e biɛ?
Tse o le?
5“Ke Mawu wo si ɔ, e yeɔ nɔ. Mawu ngɛ kaa tsɛ̃i kɛ ha nihi tsuo nɛ hlaa e se blɔ. 6Koo ngɔ nɔ́ ko kɛ piɛ Mawu munyu ɔmɛ a he. Ke o pee ja a, Mawu ma ka o hɛ mi, nɛ nihi tsuo maa na kaa lakpatsɛ ji mo.”
Abɛ kpa komɛ
7Mawu, nɔ enyɔ i ngɛ mo bie nɛ o ha mi loko ma gbo. 8Hyɛ nɛ ma ko ye lakpa. Ko ha nɛ ma ná ní kpɔtɔɔ, nɛ ko ha nɛ ma ye ohia hulɔ; niye ní nɛ maa su mi ɔ, lɔ ɔ pɛ o ha mi. 9Ke i na ní kpɔtɔɔ ɔ, ma kua mo, nɛ ma de ke, “Mɛnɔ kulaa ji Yawɛ nɛ ɔ?” Jã kɛ̃, ke i ye ohia a, ma ju, nɛ ma wo ye Mawu ɔ he mu.
10Koo gbe tsɔlɔ he guɛ ha e nyɔmtsɛ. Ke o pee ja a, tsɔlɔ ɔ maa gbiɛ mo, nɛ o hɛ mi ma pue si.
11Ni komɛ gbiɛɔ a tsɛmɛ, nɛ a gbaa we a nyɛmɛ.
12Ni komɛ buɔ a he kaa a he tsɔ, be mi nɛ a sɛ mu kpɔtɔɔ.
13Ni komɛ woɔ a he nɔ, nɛ a susuɔ kaa a hi tsɔ.
14Ni komɛ sisiɔ ohiatsɛmɛ, kɛ nihi nɛ a ní ngɛ mɔbɔ, nɛ a kpɔɔ níhi ngɛ a dɛ. Bɔ nɛ jamɛatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ peeɔ kɛ yeɔ ní ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
15Malɛɛ ngɛ biyiwi enyɔ; a foɔ ya nɛ a deɔ ke, “Ha mi enɛ, ha mi enɛ!” E peeɔ nɔ́ etɛ nɛ a tɔɛ gblegbleegble.
Nɔ́ eywiɛ komɛ ngɛ nɛ mɛ hu a tɔɛ gblegbleegble:
16Ni gbogboehi a je,
yo nɛ be bi,
zugba nɛ hiɔmi nɛ́ ngɛ nɔ,
kɛ la nɛ ngɛ tsoe nɛ nine kpi he.
17Nɔ nɛ gbeɔ e tsɛ he guɛ, nɛ e bui e nyɛ ɔ, kuakualabitehi nɛ ngɛ kɔ̃ ɔ mi ma ta e hɛngmɛ, nɛ okpokuhi maa ye lɛ.
18Nɔ́ etɛ kɛ yaa eywiɛ komɛ peeɔ mi nyakpɛ nɛ ye juɛmi sui he:
19Kɔle nɛ ngɛ tee ngɛ kɔɔhiɔ mi kɛ bee;
sinɔ nɛ ngɛ si sããe ngɛ tɛ sa nɔ,
lɛ nɛ ngɛ nyɛɛe ngɛ wo nɔ,
kɛ nyumu kɛ yo a bɔmi.
20Bɔ nɛ yo gba puɛlɔ ngɛ ha ji nɛ ɔ nɛ; e yeɔ ní nɛ e tsuɔ e nya he saminyayoo, nɛ e deɔ ke, “Oo, i tsa pee we yayami ko.”
21Nɔ́ etɛ kɛ yaa eywiɛ nɛ ɔmɛ ji níhi nɛ je ɔ sume saasaa, nɛ e peeɔ je ɔ kaa e mimiɛ:
22Nyɔguɛ nɛ ba ngɛ matsɛ yee,
kuasia nɛ ye ngma nɛ e tɔ,
23yo nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko sume lɛ, nɛ ba na gba,
kɛ mawayo nɛ ba kpɔ gba ngɛ e nyɛ dɛ.
24Nɔ́ eywiɛ komɛ ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi nɛ a klee we saasaa, se a le ní saminya:
25Tatuhi; a he wɛ saasaa, se a buaa niye ní nya kɛ toɔ ngɛ latsa be mi.
26Nyu mi kpihi; mɛ hu a be he wami ko, se a peeɔ a tsu ngɛ tɛ sahi a kpɛ.
27Baalɛhi; a be matsɛ, se kɛ̃ ɔ, a nyɛɛɔ ngɛ kuuhi a mi pɛpɛɛpɛ.
28Akɔtɔkuhi: o ma nyɛ nu akɔtɔku kɛ o nine, se kɛ̃ ɔ, matsɛmɛ a mɔhi a mi a naa mɛ ngɛ.
29Nɔ́ etɛ kɛ yaa eywiɛ komɛ ngɛ nɛ a nyɛɛmi ngɛ fɛu kɛ akɔnɔ:
30Jata: e he wa pe lohwehi tsuo, nɛ e yi lohwe ko lohwe ko gbeye.
31Kungwɔ ku nɛ ngɛ si sie kɛ bee; to akpakpo, kɛ matsɛ nɛ nyɛɛ e ma hɛ mi kɛ ma.
32Ke o ya je kuasia, nɛ o ya wo o he nɔ, aloo o ya to ga yayami ɔ, pee dii nɛ o susu o yi mi. 33Ejakaa ke o fia nyɔ nyu ɔ, e peeɔ bɔta. Ke o fia nɔ ko gugwɔ nɔ́ ɔ, e jeɔ muɔ. Ke o wo nɔ ko mi mi la a, pɛ lɛ nyɛɛɔ se.

Title: ABƐ 31
Content:
Munyuhi nɛ a kɛ slɔ matsɛ
1Munyuhi nɛ Matsɛ Lemuel, Masa matsɛ ɔ nyɛ kɛ tsɔse lɛ ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ:
2“Ye bi, i suɔ mo saminya. I kpa o he pɛɛ ngɛ sɔlemi mi loko i ná mo nɛ i fɔ. Mɛni munyu kpakpa sa mo pe enɛ ɔ? 3Koo ngɔ o he wami kɛ ha yihi. Matsɛmɛ tete po nɛ nyɛɛɔ yihi a se ɔ, a hɛ mi kpataa. 4Lemuel lee, anɔkuale mi ɔ, e sɛ matsɛmɛ, kɛ ma nɔ yeli kaa a nu wai, loo dã nɛ nya wa. 5Ke a nu dã a, a hɛ maa je mlaa a nɔ, nɛ a ma plɛ nɔ́ nali a sane hɛ mi kɛ bu si. 6Nyɛ ha ni nɛmɛ nɛ a hɛ mi miɔ nɛ e ma kpata a dã nɛ nya wa nɛ a nu; nɛ nyɛ ha ni nɛmɛ nɛ aywilɛho nu mɛ ɔ hu wai. 7Ke a nu ɔ, a hɛ maa je ohia nɔ, nɛ a be kɔmɔ yee hu.
8“Tu munyu kɛ fa mumui he; ye awusahi tsuo a sane ha mɛ. 9Tu munyu kɛ fa a he; ye dami sane. Hyɛ nɔ́ nali, kɛ dɛgutsɛmɛ a nɔ saminya.”
Yo kpakpa
10Yo kpakpa a, mɛnɔ ma na? E he jua wa kulaa pe june!
11E huno ngɔɔ e hɛ kɛ fɔɔ e nɔ kɛ e tsui tsuo, nɛ e huno ɔ be ohia yee gblegbleegble.
12Yo ɔ peeɔ e huno ɔ suɔmi nya ní; daa nɛ ɔ, e peeɔ lɛ kpakpa, pi yayami.
13E hlaa to he bwɔmi kɛ doti kpa, nɛ e bua jɔɔ nɔ́ nɛ e kɛ loɔ ɔ he.
14E ya ngɔɔ niye ní kɛ jee tsitsaa kɛ baa kaa bɔ nɛ jua yelɔ ya ngɔɔ tlomi kɛ jee ma se lokoo kɛ baa a.
15E teɔ si makɛ mla, nɛ e hlaa niye ní ha e we mi bimɛ, nɛ e gbaa ní tsumi ha e mawayihi.
16E hlaa zugba nɛ e heɔ. E bɔɔ apaa nɛ a peeɔ wai ngmɔ ha lɛ.
17E tsuɔ ní kpakpataa; e nine si wa kɛ ní tsumi.
18E tsuɔ ní nyɔ mi tsuo; ejakaa e le kaa e ma na he se kokooko.
19Lɛ nitsɛ nɛ e tsɛ̃ɔ doti kpa, nɛ e kɛ loɔ bo.
20E naa ohiatsɛ mɔbɔ, nɛ e bɔleɔ nine kɛ haa nɔ nɛ e fi lɛ.
21Ke fĩɛ be su ɔ, e yi tsui kaa fĩɛ maa ye e we mi bimɛ, ejakaa mɛ tsuo a ngɛ kuutu tade.
22Lɛ nitsɛ e loɔ e sa nɔ bo; nɛ e buɔ kploba nɛ ngɛ fɛu, kɛ bo nɛ hɛɛ alamua tu su.
23Ke ma nimeli kpe ɔ, a toɔ e huno ɔ he hɛ saminya ngɛ a kpɛti.
24Yo ɔ kpɛɔ kploba tade nɛ e juaa; e juaa mi mi fimi níhi hu kɛ haa je juali.
25Ke o na e he wami, kɛ e he fɛu ɔ, lɛɛ ja bo kpakpa nɛ nɔ kɛ dla e he. E yi nɔ́ nɛ maa ba hwɔɔ se gbeye.
26Nile munyu sɔuu e tuɔ, nɛ a naa ngɛ e lilɛ nɔ kaa e mi mi jɔ.
27E hyɛɔ nɛ e we mi bimɛ nɛ ba a je mi saminya; nɛ e sume hejɔ.
28E huno, kɛ e bimɛ tsuo buɔ lɛ, nɛ a gbaa lɛ. E huno ɔ jeɔ e yi ke,
29“Yihi babauu ngɛ nɛ bɔɔ mɔde mohu, se moo lɛɛ, o pe mɛ tsuo!”
30Hɛ mi nyami sisiɔ nɔ, nɛ he fɛu hu taa; se yo nɛ yeɔ Yawɛ gbeye ɔ, e sa kaa a je e yi.
31Nyɛ je e yi ngɛ níhi nɛ e tsu ɔ a he. Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ je e yi ngɛ e ní tsumi ɔmɛ a he.

Title: FIƐLƆ NYA TSƆƆMI
Content:
NYA TSƆƆMI
Fiɛlɔ nguaa ko susumihi nɛ a bua nya lɛ ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ mi. Fiɛlɔ nɛ ɔ susuɔ e yi mi wawɛɛ nitsɛ. Nɔ́ nɛ e kpa si ji nɔmlɔ adesa wami ɔ, pi kaa e se kɛ we kɛkɛ, se ní komɛ baa nɛ ke o hyɛ ɔ, a kɛ adebɔ mlaa yɛ. Hehi nɛ fiɛlɔ ɔ hyɛ blɔ kaa a maa ye dami sane ngɛ ɔ, e ya bɛ lɛ ja kulaa; e ya peeɔ nine mi wu jemi mohu. Ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ fiɛlɔ ɔ na a, nɔ́ nɛ e de kɛkɛ ji, “Wami he be se nami.” Mawu ɔ, nɛ lɛ e dɛ mi nimli adesahi tsuo a wami ngɛ ɔ, fiɛlɔ ɔ juɛmi sui e ní peemi níhi a he. Se enɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a se ɔ, ga nɛ fiɛlɔ ɔ woɔ ji kaa nɔmlɔ nɛ tsu ní wawɛɛ, konɛ níhi nɛ Mawu ha lɛ ɔ, e ye, aloo e na a he bua jɔmi bɔ nɛ sa kɛ yaa si be nɛ e suɔ.
Ke o hyɛ ɔ, kaa nɔ́ nɛ fiɛlɔ ɔ munyu ɔmɛ ekomɛ piɛ bɔɔ; munyu ɔmɛ ekomɛ haa nɛ nɔ nine mi jeɔ wu. Se e hi kaa womi nɛ ɔ hu ngɛ Baiblo ɔ mi; ejakaa e deɔ wɔ níhi babauu ngɛ nɔmlɔ adesa wami si himi he, kpakpa kɛ yayami tsuo. Nihi babauu ngɔɔ womi nɛ ɔ mi munyu ɔmɛ kɛ toɔ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a wami si himi he kaa bɔ nɛ nɔ hyɛɛ e hɛ mi ngɛ ahuhuɛ mi ɔ. Ngɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a mi ɔ, Mawu haa wɔ hɛ nɔ kami ko. E haa nɛ wa nuɔ wami nɛ ɔ sisi saminya pe bɔ nɛ wa susu kaa wa le ɔ.
Bɔ nɛ a dla womi ɔ mi ha
Anɛ se nami ko ngɛ wami he lo? 1.1—2.26
Ní komɛ nɛ a deɔ ngɛ wami he 3.1—11.8
Nyagbe ga womi 11.9—12.8
Kuku pomi 12.9-14

Title: FIƐLƆ 1
Content:
Wami he be se nami
1David bi, fiɛlɔ nguaa a nɛ ye matsɛ ngɛ Yerusalem munyuhi ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ.
2Ye juɛmi deɔ mi ke, wami nɛ ɔ, se nami ko be he; wami he be se nami. Lɛ tsuo peeɔ yaka! 3Dengme tsuo nɛ nɔmlɔ adesa gboɔ ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, mɛni se e naa? 4Yi nɔhi baa, nɛ a beɔ kɛ yaa. Se je ɔ lɛɛ, bɔ nɛ e ngɛ ɔ, jã kɛ̃ e ngɛ; jã kɛ̃ lɛ e maa hi kɛ maa ya neneene. 5Pu teɔ si nɛ e nɔɔ si, nɛ e he sɔɔ kɛ yaa he nɛ e te si kɛ je ɔ ekohu. 6Kɔɔhiɔ fiaa kɛ yaa leneyi je, nɛ e lɔgɔɔ si kɛ yaa omleyi je. Kikɛ nɛ ɔ kɔɔhiɔ hii si bɔlee hluu kɛ ya suu be nɛ e kpaleɔ kɛ baa he nɛ e fia kɛ je ɔ ekohu. 7Pahi tsuo bee kɛ ya sɛɛ wo mi, se wo hyi we gblegbleegble. Pa amɛ kpaleɔ a se kɛ yaa he nɛ a je ɔ, nɛ a bee kɛ yaa wo ɔ mi ekohu. 8Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi ɔ peeɔ pɔtɔ kɛ yaka nɛ hi kalemi; nɔ́ hyɛmi kɛ munyu tumi gbi nɔ nya. 9Nɔ́ he ko be je ɔ mi. Nɔ́ nɛ ba hyɛ ɔ, lɔ ɔ kɛ̃ maa ba ekohu. Nɔ́ nɛ a pee hyɛ ɔ, lɔ ɔ nɔuu a maa pee ekohu. 10Anɛ nɔ́ ko ngɛ nɛ a ma tsɛ lɛ nɔ́ he lo? Dɛbi! Jamɛ a nɔ́ ɔ ngɛ kɛ je blema, loko a fɔ wɔ tete po. 11Níhi nɛ be ɔ, nɔ ko nɔ ko kaii we hu. Jã kɛ̃, níhi nɛ maa ba kɛ je be nɛ ɔ mi kɛ yaa a, yi nɔhi nɛ maa ba ngɛ se ɔ, mɛ hu a be kaie.
Fiɛlɔ nguaa a kpa je mi níhi si
12Imi fiɛlɔ ɔ, i hi Yerusalem kɛ ye matsɛ ngɛ Israel ma a nɔ. 13I bɔ mɔde kaa níhi tsuo nɛ a peeɔ ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, ma ngɔ ye nile ɔ kɛ hla mi fitsofitso.
Ní tsumi nɛ Mawu ngɔ ha nɔmlɔ adesa ke e tsu ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, haomi sɔuu; pi ní tsumi nɛ ngɔɔ. 14Níhi tsuo nɛ a peeɔ ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, i na; nɛ i ngɛ dee ke lɛ tsuo yaka. E ngɛ kaa nɔ́ nɛ nɔ ko ngɛ fo tue kɛ ngɛ kɔɔhiɔ se nyɛɛe kɛkɛ. 15Nɔ́ nɛ kpɛ̃ ɔ, e hí dami; nɔ́ nɛ bé ɔ, e hí kanemi.
16 I de ngɛ ye yi mi ke, “I pee nɔmlɔ nguaa. Nihi tsuo nɛ ye Yerusalem ma a nɔ kɛ sɛ ye hlami ɔ, i le ní kulaa pe mɛ. Ee, nile ɔ, i kpa lɛ si saminya.” 17I bɔ mɔde kaa ma hla slɔɔto nɛ ngɛ nile kɛ godo, aloo nile kɛ kuasia jemi a kpɛti. Se i na kaa nɔ́ nɛ ɔ hu ngɛ kaa nɔ́ nɛ nɔ ko ngɛ fo tue kɛ ngɛ kɔɔhiɔ se nyɛɛe kɛkɛ. 18Ní lemi fuu ɔ, haomi sɔuu lɛ ngɛ mi. Ke nɔ ko le ní babauu ɔ, jã kɛ̃ lɛ e haomi hu hiɛ babauu.

Title: FIƐLƆ 2
Content:
1I to kaa ma fiɛ ye yi nɔ saminya, nɛ ma hyɛ kaa nɔ́ ko ngɛ bua jɔmi mi lo. Se i na kaa enɛ ɔ hu peeɔ yaka gu. 2I kpa si kaa muɔmi ɔ, godo, nɛ bua jɔmi hu se nami be he. 3Ngɛ ye ní lemi ɔ kulaa se ɔ, i pee ye yi mi kaa ma nu dã, nɛ ma fiɛ, konɛ ye nɔ gbagba nɛ te. I susu kaa nɔ́ nɛ hi, nɛ sa nɔmlɔ adesa peemi ngɛ je mi e wami be ɔ tsuo ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
4 I pee ní nguanguahi. I ma tsuhi, nɛ i pee wai ngmɔhi. 5I pee ngmɔhi kɛ abɔɔhi, nɛ i du tsohi nɛ woɔ yiblii slɔɔtohi ngɛ mi. 6I gba nyu dɔhi nɛ i kɛ haa tso ɔmɛ nyu. 7 I he nyɔguɛhi babauu, nyumuhi kɛ yihi tsuo; nɛ a fɔ nyɔguɛhi babauu kɛ wo ye we ɔ mi. Jehanɛ se hu, i ngɛ nahi kɛ tohi babauu pe nɔ tsuaa nɔ ngɛ Yerusalem. 8 I bua sika hiɔ kɛ sika tsu nya, nɛ i tsu tó ngɛ matsɛmɛ a dɛ, kɛ ye nɔ yemi he ɔmɛ. Nyumuhi kɛ yihi babauu la kɛ jɔɔ ye bua, nɛ i ngɔ yihi babauu bɔ nɛ ma nyɛ.
9 Niinɛ, i pee nɔmlɔ nguaa, nɛ i he biɛ kulaa pe nihi tsuo nɛ sɛ ye hlami ngɛ Yerusalem; ye nile ɔ hu se pui gblegbleegble. 10Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ hlae ɔ, i naa. Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ i suɔ kaa ma pee ɔ, i peeɔ; i tsi we ye nya kɛ ji bua jɔmi ko he. Ní tsumi nɛ he wa po, i naa he bua jɔmi. Niinɛ, kikɛmɛ a bua jɔmi nɛ ɔ pɛ ji ye se nami ngɛ dengme tsuo nɛ i gbo ɔ he. 11Jehanɛ, i susu ye nine nya ní tsumi ɔmɛ tsuo a he, kɛ dengme nɛ i gbo ngɛ a he ɔ, nɛ i na kaa lɛ tsuo peeɔ yaka. E ngɛ kaa nɔ́ nɛ nɔ ko ngɛ fo tue kɛ ngɛ kɔɔhiɔ se nyɛɛe kɛkɛ; se nami ko be he. 12Ke nɔ ko ngɛ matsɛ yee ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ nihi nɛ sɛ e hlami pee ɔ, lɔ ɔ lɛ hu e maa pee.
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, i bɔni nile, godo, kɛ kuasia jemi a he susumi saminya. 13Kɛkɛ nɛ i na kaa nile hi pe kuasia jemi kaa bɔ nɛ la hi pe diblii ɔ. 14Ní lelɔ le he nɛ e yaa; kuasia lɛɛ e li. Se kɛ̃ ɔ, amanehlu kake ɔ nɔuu lɛ baa mɛ ni enyɔ ɔmɛ tsuo a nɔ. 15I de ngɛ ye yi mi ke, “Haomi nɛ maa ba kuasia nɔ ɔ, lɔ ɔ nɔuu lɛ maa ba imi hu ye nɔ. Lɛɛ ye nile babauu ɔ, mɛni se i na ngɛ he mɔ?” I he nɔ ngɛ ye yi mi ke, “Enɛ ɔ hu ji yaka nɔ́ ko; e he be se nami.” 16Ní lelɔ ɔ, nɔ ko kaii we lɛ daa; kuasia hu, jã kɛ̃. Be bɔɔ kɛkɛ nihi a hɛ je mɛ tsuo a nɔ. Ní lelɔ gboɔ kaa bɔ nɛ kuasia gboɔ; slɔɔto be mi. 17Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, je mi si himi ba gbe ye nya, ejakaa níhi nɛ a tsuɔ ngɛ je ɔ mi ɔ, ekoeko sɛ́ ye hɛ mi. Lɛ tsuo peeɔ yaka, kaa nɔ́ nɛ nɔ ko ngɛ fo tue kɛ ngɛ kɔɔhiɔ se nyɛɛe kɛkɛ.
18Dengme babauu nɛ i gbo ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, i pa sume hu; ejakaa i le kaa níhi tsuo nɛ i bua nya a, ma si kɛ ha nɔ nɛ ma ba ye ye ní ɔ. 19Nɔmlɔ nɛ ɔ ma ba pee ní lelɔ oo, e ma ba pee kuasia oo, mɛnɔ lɛ le? Se kɛ̃ ɔ, níhi tsuo nɛ i ngɔ nile kɛ gbo a he dengme ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, lɛ nɛ ma ba ye. Enɛ ɔ hu ji yaka nɔ́ ko. 20Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i ba pia ye he kaa i tsu ní wawɛɛ kikɛ nɛ ɔ. 21Ejakaa be komɛ ɔ, nɔ ko maa ngɔ nile, kɛ ga kɛ tsu ní wawɛɛ nitsɛ. Kɛkɛ ɔ, e ma si ha nɔ ko nɛ gbo we nɔ́ ɔ he dengme ko kulaa nɛ e ba ye. Enɛ ɔ hu ji yaka dengme, kɛ yayami agbo. 22Haomi nɛ baa nɔmlɔ nɔ, kɛ dengme babauu nɛ e gboɔ ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, mɛni se lɛ e naa? 23 Níhi nɛ nɔmlɔ adesa tsuɔ e wami be ɔ tsuo peeɔ haomi kɛ kɔmɔ yemi sɔuu. Nyɔ mi po e juɛmi ha we lɛ he jɔmi. Enɛ ɔ hu ji yaka nɔ́ ko.
24 Lɛɛ nɔ́ nɛ sa adesa peemi ji kaa e ye ní, nɛ e nu ní, nɛ e na bua jɔmi kɛ je e dengme gbomi ɔ mi. Se kɛ̃ ɔ, i na kaa enɛ ɔ hu je Mawu ngɔ. 25Ke pi Mawu he ɔ, mɛnɔ maa ye ní, nɛ mɛnɔ ma na bua jɔmi? 26 Nihi nɛ peeɔ Mawu suɔmi nya ní ɔ, Mawu haa mɛ nile, ga, kɛ bua jɔmi. Se yayami peeli lɛɛ, e haa a tsuɔ ní, nɛ a buaa níhi a nya, konɛ e ngɔ ngɛ a dɛ kɛ ha ni nɛmɛ nɛ peeɔ lɛ, Mawu ɔ suɔmi nya ní. Enɛ ɔ hu ji yaka nɔ́ ko; e ngɛ kaa nɔ́ nɛ nɔ ko ngɛ fo tue kɛ ngɛ kɔɔhiɔ se nyɛɛe kɛkɛ.

Title: FIƐLƆ 3
Content:
Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ kɛ e be
1Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi ɔ ngɛ e be.
2Fɔmi be ngɛ, nɛ gbenɔ be ngɛ;
ní dumi be ngɛ, nɛ ní kpami be ngɛ.
3Be ngɛ nɛ a gbee;
nɛ be ngɛ nɛ a tsaa.
Be ngɛ nɛ a kuɔ nɔ́ pueɔ si,
nɛ be ngɛ nɛ a maa.
4Ya fomi be ngɛ, nɛ muɔmi be ngɛ.
Kɔmɔ yemi be ngɛ, nɛ domi be ngɛ.
5Be ngɛ nɛ a sakee tɛhi ngɔ pueɔ he,
nɛ be ngɛ nɛ a buaa tɛhi a nya.
Be ngɛ nɛ a fuaa nɔ atuu,
nɛ be ngɛ nɛ a fua we nɔ atuu.
6Be ngɛ nɛ a hlaa nɔ́,
nɛ be ngɛ nɛ nɔ́ laa.
Be ngɛ nɛ a baa nɔ́ yi,
nɛ be ngɛ nɛ a sakee nɔ́ kɛ fɔɔ he.
7Be ngɛ nɛ a híaa nɔ́,
nɛ be ngɛ nɛ a kpɛɔ nɔ́.
Dii peemi be ngɛ,
nɛ munyu tumi be ngɛ.
8Suɔmi be ngɛ, nɛ nɔ nyɛmi be ngɛ.
Ta be ngɛ, nɛ tue mi jɔmi be ngɛ.
9Ní tsulɔ ɔ, mɛni se e naa kɛ jee e dengme gbomi ɔ mi? 10Ní tsumi kpakpataa nɛ Mawu ha nɔmlɔ ke e tsu ɔ, i na. 11E peeɔ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ saminyayoo ngɛ e be mi. E ha nɔmlɔ juɛmi nɛ e kɛ leɔ níhi nɛ be momo, kɛ níhi nɛ maa ba hwɔɔ se. Se kɛ̃ ɔ, lɛ Mawu ɔ ní tsumi kɛ je sisije kɛ ya si nyagbe ɔ, lɔ ɔ lɛɛ nɔmlɔ juɛmi sui he. 12Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i na kaa be abɔ nɛ nɔmlɔ ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ sa lɛ peemi pɛ ji kaa e nya, nɛ e na bua jɔmi. 13E sa kaa nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ye ní, nɛ e nu ní; nɛ e na bua jɔmi kɛ je níhi nɛ e gbo a he dengme ɔ mi. Mawu nike ní ji lɔ ɔ nɛ.
14I le kaa nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ Mawu pee ɔ maa hi si kɛ ya neneene; a be nyɛe nɛ a ngɔ nɔ́ ko kɛ piɛ he, loo a je nɔ́ ko ngɛ mi. Mawu lɛ pee jã, konɛ a ye lɛ gbeye. 15Nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ amlɔ nɛ ɔ, e ba hyɛ; nɔ́ nɛ maa ba hwɔɔ se ɔ, e ba hyɛ. Nɔ́ nɛ be momo ɔ, lɔ ɔ nɔuu Mawu ngɔɔ kɛ baa ekohu.
Amimi yemi ngɛ je mi
16Jehanɛ hu, i kpa si kaa ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, he nɛ sa kaa a ye dami sane, nɛ a pee nɔ́ nɛ da ngɛ ɔ, yi wu tso níhi mohu lɛ a peeɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. 17I de ngɛ ye yi mi ke, “Mawu maa kojo dalɔ kɛ yayami peelɔ tsuo, ejakaa a to be kɛ ha nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ peemi.” 18Nɔ́ nɛ i de ngɛ ye yi mi ngɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a he ji kaa Mawu ngɛ nimli adesahi kae nɛ e kɛ tsɔɔ mɛ kaa slɔɔto be a kɛ lohwehi a kpɛti. 19Nɔ́ nɛ peeɔ nɔmlɔ adesa a, lɔ ɔ kɛ̃ lɛ peeɔ lohwe; nɔmlɔ gboɔ, nɛ lohwe hu gboɔ. Mumi kake ɔ nɔuu lɛ mɛ tsuo a muɔ. Nɔmlɔ pi lohwe ngɛ blɔ ko blɔ ko nɔ; ejakaa nɔmlɔ wami jio, lohwe wami jio, lɛ tsuo peeɔ yaka. 20Mɛ tsuo he kake ɔ lɛ a yaa; mɛ tsuo zu mi lɛ a je, nɛ zu mi lɛ mɛ tsuo a maa kpale kɛ ya. 21Mɛnɔ lɛ le kaa nɔmlɔ adesa mumi ɔ yaa hiɔwe, se lohwe lɛɛ e mumi ɔ, zu mi lɛ e yaa? 22Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i na kaa nɔ́ pɛ nɛ sa nɔmlɔ peemi ji kaa níhi nɛ e gbo a he dengme ɔ, e na a he bua jɔmi; e blɔ fa mi níhi ji lɔ ɔmɛ. Nɔ́ nɛ maa ba ngɛ nɔ ko gbenɔ se ɔ, blɔ ko be nɛ e kɛ maa le.

Title: FIƐLƆ 4
Content:
1Jehanɛ se hu, i na kaa yi mi sɔuu lɛ a ngɛ wae ngɛ je ɔ mi. Nɔ́ nali ngɛ ya foe, nɛ nɔ ko be nɛ maa jɔɔ a bua. Bua wolɔ ko be mɛ, ejakaa nihi nɛ ngɛ mɛ yi mi wae ɔ, he wami ngɛ a dɛ. 2I susu kaa nihi nɛ gbo ɔ, a nɔ́ hi pe ni nɛmɛ nɛ a hɛ ngɛ ɔ. 3Se ni enyɔ nɛ ɔmɛ po a se ɔ, nihi nɛ a nɔ́ hi pe kulaa ji ni nɛmɛ nɛ a fɔ we mɛ lolo, nɛ mɛɛ a nɛ yi wu tso níhi nɛ a ngɛ pee ngɛ je ɔ mi ɔ.
4Jehanɛ, i na kaa nɔ́ nɛ he je nɛ nihi gboɔ dengme wawɛɛ konɛ a ya nɔ ɔ ji kaa a hɛ kɔɔ a nyɛmimɛ a nɔ. Enɛ ɔ hu ji yaka nɔ́ ko; e ngɛ kaa nɔ́ nɛ nɔ ko ngɛ fo tue kɛ ngɛ kɔɔhiɔ se nyɛɛe kɛkɛ. 5Kuasia buaa e ninehi a nya kɛ woɔ e gblɛɛ mi, nɛ e gboɔ kɛ hwɔ. 6Se afani nɔ́ ko bɔbɔyoo nɛ tue mi jɔmi ngɛ he pe nɛ o kɛ o nine enyɔ ma gbo yaka dengme kaa nɔ́ nɛ nɔ ko ngɛ fo tue kɛ ngɛ kɔɔhiɔ se nyɛɛe kɛkɛ.
7I na nɔ́ kpa ko hu ngɛ je ɔ mi nɛ ji yaka dengme gbomi. 8Hyɛ kaa nɔ ko lɛ ngɛ. E be bi; e be nyɛmi ko; lɛ nɔ kake ngmelu pɛ lɛ ngɛ. Se daa nɛ ɔ, dengme nɔ kɛkɛ lɛ e ngɛ; e ní nɛ e na a pi ha lɛ. E bi we e he hyɛ ke dengme babauu nɛ e ngɛ gboe nɛ e yi e mi ngɔɔmi ko ɔ, mɛnɔ kulaa lɛ e ngɛ jamɛ a dengme ɔ gboe ha. Enɛ ɔ hu ji yaka nɔ ko; dengme gbomi gu nɛ bua jɔmi be mi.
9Ke ni enyɔ bua kɛ tsu ní ɔ, e hi pe nɔ kake nɛ ma tsu ní; ejakaa a náá a dengme gbomi ɔ he se. 10Ke nɔ kake nɔ si ɔ, nɔ kake ma wo e nɔ. Se ke nɔ kake ngmelu lɛ ngɛ, nɛ e nɔ si ɔ, kɛkɛ lɛɛ nɔ́ pee lɛ; ejakaa nɔ ko be nɛ ma wo e nɔ. 11Jehanɛ, fĩɛ be, ke ni enyɔ hwɔ si ɔ, a he mi dɔɔ la. Se nɔ kake ngmelu ɔ, kɛ lɛɛ e maa pee kɛɛ nɛ e he mi maa dɔ la? 12Ke nɔ ko ba tua ni enyɔ nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, a ma bla kɛ wo e he, nɛ a maa gbe lɛ. Se ke nɔ kake a ba tua ja a, e be nyɛe ma fa e he. Kpa nɛ a tslɔ hɛ si etɛ ɔ, e tsɔ we mla.
13-14Niheyo ohiatsɛ nɛ le ní ɔ, e hi hluu pe nɔkɔtɔma kuasia nɛ ngɛ tsɛ yee, nɛ́ jehanɛ hu e bui ga womi tue. 15I ba bɔni nihi tsuo nɛ ngɛ je ɔ mi ɔ a he susumi, nɛ i ba na niheyo ko ngɛ ni ɔmɛ tsuo a kpɛti nɛ ma ba ye matsɛ ɔ se. 16Nihi nɛ matsɛ ɔ yeɔ a nɔ ɔ, a he hiɛ babauu; a hí kanemi. Se kɛ̃ ɔ, nihi nɛ maa ba ngɛ e se ɔ, a be e yi jee. Niinɛ, enɛ ɔ hu ji yaka nɔ́ ko; e ngɛ kaa nɔ́ nɛ nɔ ko ngɛ fo tue kɛ ngɛ kɔɔhiɔ se nyɛɛe kɛkɛ.

Title: FIƐLƆ 5
Content:
O he ko sɔ kɛ wo Mawu si
1Ke o yaa Mawu we ɔ, hyɛ o he nɔ saminya. E hi kaa o ma ya kase ní ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, pe nɔ́ nɛ o ma ya sã bɔ kaa bɔ nɛ kuasiahi peeɔ ɔ; ejakaa a li kaa a ngɛ yayami pee. 2Ke o maa tu munyu ko ɔ, mo susu he; o he ko sɔ kɛ wo Mawu si. Mawu ɔ, hiɔwe lɛ e ngɛ; moo lɛɛ zugba nɛ ɔ nɔ o ngɛ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, koo tu munyu fuu. 3Haomi babauu kɛ dekla, aloo nlami basabasa baa; nɛ munyu fuu a kɛ yoɔ kuasia gbi. 4 Ke o wo Mawu si ɔ, ko ha nɛ e kɛ loko o ye nɔ; ejakaa Mawu na we kuasiahi a he bua jɔmi. Ye o siwo ɔ nɔ. 5Afani nɛ o wui si kulaa, pe kaa o maa wo si, nɛ o be nɔ yee. 6Ko ha nɛ mo nitsɛ o nya mi munyu nɛ bu mo fɔ, nɛ o ba ye pɔpu, nɛ o de Mawu we osɔfo ɔ ke o nɔ́ be mi. Mɛni he je lɛ o ma ha nɛ Mawu mi mi nɛ fu mo? Níhi nɛ o gbo a he dengme ɔ, mɛni he je o ma ha nɛ Mawu nɛ kpata a hɛ mi? 7Nlami babauu kɛ munyu fuu ɔ, nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko be mi; lɛ tsuo peeɔ yaka. Moo lɛɛ ye Mawu gbeye.
Wami he be se nami
8Ke o na nɛ a ngɛ ohiatsɛ yi mi wae, aloo a plɛ sane hɛ mi ngɔ bu si, nɛ a kojo we ngɛ blɔ nɛ da nɔ ngɛ zugba ko nɔ ɔ, e ko pee mo nyakpɛ kulaa. Tsɔli nɛ ngɛ ma a nya, kɛ je nɔ wayoo pe kulaa nɔ kɛ ya si nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa nɔ ɔ, mɛ tsuo a le nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ nɔ yae ɔ he nɔ́ ko.
9Zugba a he se nami ɔ tsuo ba peeɔ nimli nɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ́. Jehanɛ se hu, ngmɔ ko ngmɔ ko be nɛ a tsu we tó ngɛ he.
10Nɔ nɛ suɔ sika a, sika tɔɛ lɛ; nɔ nɛ suɔ nɛ e na ní ɔ, ní babauu gbi e nya. Enɛ ɔ hu ji yaka nɔ́ ko. 11He nɛ ní babauu ngɛ ɔ, ní yeli hu ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Lɛɛ se nami nɛ niatsɛ ɔ naa pɛ ji kaa e le kaa nɔ́ ko ngɛ e dɛ. 12Apaatsɛ ɔ, e ye ní bɔɔ jio, e ye fuu jio, e hwɔɔ mahe bɔ nɛ sa. Se niatsɛ lɛɛ e ní babauu ɔ ha we nɛ e hwɔɔ mahe.
13Nɔ́ yayami ko hu nɛ i na ngɛ je ɔ mi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. Nihi buaa sika babauu nya, nɛ e ba peeɔ haomi ha mɛ. 14Tlukaa a, matahu ba poɔ mɛ, nɛ sika a tsuo hɛ mi kpataa. Kɛkɛ ɔ, nɔ́ ko pa píɛ nɛ a ma si ha a bimɛ. 15 Bɔ nɛ nɔ ko je e nyɛ muklii mi kɛ ba dɛ gu ɔ, jã kɛ̃ lɛ e maa kpale kɛ ya. Dengme tsuo nɛ e ba gbo ɔ, e be nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko hɛɛe ngɛ e dɛ kɛ ya. 16Sane nɛ ɔ he wa! Bɔ nɛ nɔ ko ba a, jã e maa kpale kɛ ya. Lɛɛ mɛni se e na mɔ, kaa e ba gbo yaka dengme? 17Nɔmlɔ wami be ɔ tsuo ngɛ kaa diblii mi nyɛɛmi; kɔmɔ yemi, mi mi fumi, nine mi wu jemi, kɛ hiɔ sɔuu.
18Hyɛ, nɔ́ nɛ i na kaa e hi, nɛ e sa kɛkɛ ji kaa nɔmlɔ nɛ ye ní, nɛ e nu ní, nɛ e na bua jɔmi. Wami be bɔɔ nɛ Mawu ha nɔmlɔ ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, dengme tsuo nɛ e gbo ɔ, e ye e mi ngɔɔmi; e blɔ fa mi nɔ́ ji lɔ ɔ nɛ. 19Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ Mawu ha lɛ sika, ní babauu, he wami, kɛ bua jɔmi ɔ, e na Mawu si; e na bua jɔmi ngɛ dengme nɛ e ngɛ gboe ɔ he. Mawu nike ní ji lɔ ɔ nɛ. 20Akɛnɛ Mawu haa lɛ bua jɔmi daa he je ɔ, e pa be e he haoe kɛ kane e wami ligbi ɔmɛ hu.

Title: FIƐLƆ 6
Content:
1Nɔ́ ko nɛ i na nɛ hí, nɛ haoɔ nimli ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. 2Mawu ma ha nɔ ko sika, kɛ ní babauu, hɛ mi nyami, kɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ nɔ ɔ tsui suɔ. Se e ha we lɛ he wami nɛ e kɛ ye ngɔɔmi ɔ, nɛ nɔ kpa mohu ma ba ye. Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ji yaka dengme gbomi, kɛ he hiami. 3Ke nɔ ko fɔ bimɛ lafa, nɛ e ye jeha babauu, se e yi je mi ngɔɔmi, nɛ jehanɛ se hu, benɛ e gbo ɔ, a pu we lɛ bɔ nɛ sa a, lɛɛ afani bi nɛ gbo loko a fɔ lɛ ngɛ jamɛatsɛ ɔ he. 4Bimwɔyo nɛ ɔ fɔmi peeɔ yaka dengme; e laa ngɛ diblii mi, nɛ nihi a hɛ jeɔ e nɔ. 5E nɛ́ pu hɛ mi, nɛ nɔ́ ko hu e li. Se e ngɛ tue mi jɔmi mi 6kulaa pe nɔ nɛ ye jeha akpe enyɔ, se je mi ngɔɔmi lɛɛ e yi eko ɔ. Mɛ tsuo pi he kake ɔ ko nɛ a yaa lo?
7Dengme tsuo nɛ nɔmlɔ ngɛ gboe ɔ, e nya mi ngma kɛkɛ he lɛ e ngɛ gboe ngɛ. Se kɛ̃, e tɔɛ gblegbleegble. 8Mɛni ní lelɔ kɛ pe kuasia? Ohiatsɛ nɛ le e he nɔ hyɛmi ngɛ je mi ɔ, mɛni se lɛ e naa? 9E hi kaa o bua nɛ jɔ nɔ́ nɛ o ngɛ ɔ he, pe kaa daa nɛ ɔ, o ko suɔ nɛ o na nɔ́ kpa mohu. Enɛ ɔ hu ji yaka nɔ́ ko. E ngɛ kaa nɔ́ nɛ nɔ ko ngɛ fo tue kɛ ngɛ kɔɔhiɔ se nyɛɛe kɛkɛ.
10Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ ba a, a de to momo. Wɔ tsuo wa le kaa nɔmlɔ nɛ ngɛ nɛ ɔ, nɔ nɛ he wa pe lɛ ɔ, e kɛ lɛ nɔɛ kunɔ. 11Munyu fuu ɔ, se nami be he. 12Mɛnɔ lɛ le nɔ́ nɛ hi ha nɔmlɔ ngɛ e wami be bɔɔ nɛ ɔ mi? Nɔmlɔ wami pi nɔ́ ko kulaa; e ngɛ kaa nini nɛ bee kɛ yaa. Mɛnɔ ma nyɛ ma de nɔ ko nɔ́ nɛ maa ba ngɛ je ɔ mi ngɛ e gbenɔ se?

Title: FIƐLƆ 7
Content:
Susumi komɛ nɛ kɔɔ wami he
1 Biɛ kpakpa hi pe nu je via nɛ he jua wa. Ligbi nɛ o gbo ɔ hi pe ligbi nɛ a fɔ mo.
2E hi kaa o maa ya we mi he nɛ a ngɛ kɔmɔ yee ngɛ, pe kaa o maa ya he nɛ a tsɛ ní yemi ngɛ. Ejakaa e hia kaa nihi nɛ ngɛ wami mi kɛ mwɔɔ ɔ, a kai be tsuaa be kaa gbenɔ ji wɔ tsuo wa nyagbe.
3Kɔmɔ yemi hi pe muɔmi. Ke o hɛ mi pee mɔbɔmɔbɔ ɔ, o leɔ ní.
4Daa nɛ ɔ, ní lelɔ ngɛ gbenɔ he susue, se kuasia lɛɛ e susumi pɛ ji bua jɔmi.
5E hi kaa ní lelɔ ma ka o hɛ mi, pe kaa kuasia ma je o yi.
6Ke kuasia ngɛ muɔe ɔ, e ngɛ kaa mio nɛ ngɛ pɛe ngɛ la mi. Enɛ ɔ hu ji yaka nɔ́ ko.
7Amimi yemi haa ní lelɔ peeɔ kuasia, nɛ nyɔ mi ní hemi puɛɔ nɔ je mi bami.
8Nyagbe hi pe sisije. Tsui si tomi hi pe he nɔ womi.
9 Hyɛ nɛ o mi mi ko fu mlamlaamla, ejakaa kuasia lɛ ngɔɔ nɔ́ kɛ toɔ e tsui mi.
10Ko bi ke, “Mɛni he je blema ngɔɔ pe mwɔnɛmwɔnɛ ɔ?” Tsa pi nile gbi ji lɔ ɔ.
11Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, e sa kaa e le ní. Ejakaa nile ngɛ kaa weto ní; e he ngɛ se nami 12kaa bɔ nɛ sika ngɛ ɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ. Nile faa nɔ he kaa bɔ nɛ sika faa nɔ he ɔ. Nile haa nɛ nɔ yeɔ e he.
13Hyɛ Mawu nine nya ní tsumi! Nɔ́ nɛ Mawu ha nɛ e kpɛ̃ ɔ, mɛnɔ ma nyɛ maa pee lɛ nɛ e da? 14Ke níhi a mi hi ha mo ɔ, nya. Ke haomi ba hu, kai kaa Mawu lɛ pee bua jɔmi ɔ kɛ haomi ɔ tsuo, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ nɔmlɔ adesa nɛ ko le nɔ́ nɛ maa ba hwɔɔ se.
15Ye wami be ɔ he be se nami ko lɛɛ, se níhi tsuo nɛ ngɛ mi ɔ, i le. E pɔɔ mi bami kaa dalɔ hɛ mi kpataa, be mi nɛ yayami peelɔ mohu wami se kɛɔ. 16Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, koo pee o he dalɔ, aloo ní lelɔ tsɔ. Mɛni he je lɛ o ma kpata mo nitsɛ o hɛ mi? 17Se kɛ̃ ɔ, o yi mi ko wa tsɔ, nɛ o ko je kuasia hulɔ. Mɛni he je o ma gbo nɛ́ o be sui lolo ɔ? 18E hi kaa o maa pɛtɛ ga womi nɛ ɔ he nɛ o be he ngmɛɛe. Nɔ nɛ yee Mawu gbeye ɔ, e maa ye manye kɛ̃.
19Nile woɔ ní lelɔ he wami kulaa pe ma nɔ yeli nyɔngma nɛ ngɛ ma ko mi.
20Niinɛ, dalɔ ko dalɔ ko be zugba nɛ ɔ nɔ. Nɔ ko nɔ ko be nɛ peeɔ kpakpa daa nɛ ɔ, nɛ lɛɛ e pee we yayami gblegbleegble.
21Koo bu nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ nihi ngɛ dee ɔ tue, nɛ́ o ko ba nu kaa o tsɔlɔ ngɛ mo gbiɛe. 22Mo nitsɛ o le ngɛ o tsui mi kaa behi fuu ɔ, mo hu o gbiɛɛ ni komɛ.
23Nile lɛ i kɛ kpa ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo si. I to ye yi mi kaa ma kase ní, nɛ ma le ní. Se e ya yɛ nya. 24Kɛ nɔ ko maa pee kɛ le bɔ nɛ wami ngɛ ha kɛɛ? Mɛnɔ ma nyɛ? Wa juɛmi sui he. 25Jehanɛ, i ba bɔni ní kasemi, kɛ níhi a si kpami. I pee ye yi mi kaa ma na nile, nɛ ma na ye ní bimi ɔmɛ a heto. Nɔ́ nɛ i na ji kaa yi mi wami ɔ, e ji kuasia jemi, nɛ biɛmi hu godo.
26Nɔ́ ko hu nɛ i na nɛ dooɔ pe gbenɔ ji yo nɛ e tsui mi ngɛ kaa klama nɛ a tsɔ, aloo ya nɛ a wo nɛ a kɛ maa du nɔ. E nine ngɛ kaa kɔsɔkɔsɔ nɛ a kɛ maa wo nɔ. Nyumu nɛ peeɔ Mawu suɔmi nya ní ɔ maa je e dɛ mi. Se yayami peelɔ lɛɛ yo ɔ nine maa su e nɔ. 27-28Fiɛlɔ ɔ ke, benɛ i kpa níhi a si hluu nɛ e yɛ nya a, i ba bɔni níhi a he susumi kakaaka; nɛ nɔ́ nɛ i na ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. Ngɛ nyumuhi akpe a kpɛti ɔ, i na nɔ kake nɛ bu ngɛ e he, se yihi akpe a kpɛti lɛɛ i nɛ nɔ ko kaa jã. 29Nɔ́ nɛ i na kɛkɛ ji kaa Mawu bɔ nɔmlɔ adesa nɛ e hi si saminya, se nɔmlɔ ba kase gɔdɔgɔdɔ si himi.

Title: FIƐLƆ 8
Content:
1Mɛnɔ kɛ ní lelɔ sɔ? Mɛnɔ lɛ le níhi a sisi tsɔɔmi kɛ lɛ sɔ? Nile haa nɛ nɔ muɔɔ, nɛ e tsɔɔ e hɛ mi kɛ haa nɔ.
Bu matsɛ tue
2Ye matsɛ mlaa a nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ o ka Mawu kita ke o maa pee ɔ. 3Matsɛ ma nyɛ maa pee nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ e suɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke e mi mi fu ɔ, jee e hɛ mi esɔ! 4Ke matsɛ tu munyu ɔ, he wami ngɛ se. Mɛnɔ ma nyɛ ma de matsɛ ke, “Mɛni lɛ o pee nɛ ɔ?” 5Nɔ nɛ yeɔ mlaa nɔ ɔ, haomi bɛ e nɔ. Nɔ nɛ le ní ɔ, e le be nɛ sa, kɛ blɔ nɔ nɛ e maa gu kɛ bu tue. 6Ejakaa be nɛ sa, kɛ blɔ nɔ nɛ a kɛ peeɔ nɔ́ ngɛ. Se akɛnɛ nɔmlɔ adesa li he je ɔ, e ba peeɔ haomi ha lɛ. 7Wa ti nɔ ko nɔ ko li nɔ́ nɛ maa ba hwɔɔ se. Mɛnɔ lɛ ma nyɛ maa tsɔɔ be mi nɛ nɔ́ ko maa ba? 8Nɔmlɔ adesa be he wami ngɛ e mumi nɔ; nɛ e be he wami ngɛ e gbenɔ be nɔ. Gbenɔ ngɛ kaa ta; nɔ ko be nyɛe maa tu nya fo. Yi wu tso ní peemi be nyɛe ma he nɔ ko yi wami.
Yayami peeli kɛ dali
9I na ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo, be mi nɛ i ngɛ níhi nɛ nimli adesahi peeɔ ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi ɔ a he susue. Ni komɛ ngɔɔ blɔ nya nɛ a na a kɛ yeɔ a nyɛmimɛ awi. 10Jehanɛ, i na yayami peeli komɛ nɛ ke pee ɔ, a baa he klɔuklɔu ɔ. Benɛ a gbo nɛ a ya pu mɛ ɔ, a huɛmɛ ɔmɛ a hɛ je a yayami ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ a bɔni a yi jemi mohu ngɛ ma mi he nɛ a pee yayami ɔmɛ ngɛ ɔ. Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ hu dɛ.
11Mɛni he je lɛ nihi a he sɔɔ kɛ peeɔ yayami ɔ? Ejakaa a gbla we a tue ngɛ be nɛ sa mi. 12Yayami peelɔ peeɔ yayami si lafa, nɛ e gbo we. Se kɛ̃ ɔ, i le kaa nihi nɛ yeɔ Mawu gbeye anɔkuale mi ɔ, e hii ha mɛ. 13Yayami peeli lɛɛ e be hie ha mɛ gblegbleegble. Mɛɛ lɛɛ a wami ngɛ kaa nini. A se kɛ we ngɛ je mi, ejakaa a yi Mawu gbeye. 14Nɔ́ yayami ko nɛ yaa nɔ ngɛ je ɔ mi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. Be komɛ ɔ, a ngɔɔ yayami peeli a tue gblami kɛ haa dali, nɛ a kɛ dali a ní kpakpahi a he hiɔwo mohu haa yayami peeli. I ngɛ dee ke nɔ́ nɛ ɔ hu dɛ blɔ.
15Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i na kaa e sa kaa nɔmlɔ adesa nɛ na bua jɔmi; ejakaa nɔ́ ko pa be je nɛ ɔ mi ha lɛ, pe kaa e ye ní, nɛ e nu ní, nɛ e na bua jɔmi. Ke nɔmlɔ ngɛ dengme gboe ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi, ngɛ wami bɔɔ nɛ Mawu ha lɛ ɔ mi ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ e ma nyɛ maa pee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
16Be tsuaa be nɛ i hla kaa ma le ní, nɛ ma na níhi nɛ yaa nɔ ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, i naa kaa o ma nyɛ maa hi si nyɔ kɛ pia nɛ mahe hwɔmi be mi. 17Se ní tsumi nɛ Mawu ngɛ tsue ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi ɔ lɛɛ nɔmlɔ be nya nae gblegbleegble. Ke o gbo dengme hluu po, o be nya nae. Ní leli nɛ e peeɔ mɛ kaa mɛɛ a le ɔ, mɛ po a nɛ nya.

Title: FIƐLƆ 9
Content:
1I ba susu ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a he saminya, nɛ i na kaa níhi nɛ dali, kɛ ní leli peeɔ ɔ, Mawu le he nɔ́ ko; suɔmi kɛ nyɛmi po, nɔmlɔ adesa be a nɔ he wami. Nɔ ko nɔ ko li nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ e hɛ mi kɛ ma. 2Sane nɛ maa ba nɔ kake nɔ ɔ, lɔ ɔ kɛ̃ lɛ maa ba nɔ kpa hu nɔ; dalɔ jio, yayami peelɔ jio; nɔmlɔ kpakpa jio, nɔmlɔ yayami jio; nɔ nɛ he tsɔ jio, nɔ nɛ he tsɔ we jio; nɔ nɛ sãã bɔ jio, nɔ nɛ sɛ̃ bɔ jio; nɔ́ nɛ maa ba nɔ kake nɔ ɔ, lɔ ɔ kɛ̃ lɛ maa ba nɔ kpa hu nɔ. Nɔmlɔ kpakpa kɛ yayami peelɔ ɔ, slɔɔto be a kpɛti; kita kalɔ kɛ nɔ nɛ sume kaa e ma ka kita hu, jã nɔuu. 3Níhi nɛ dɛ ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, a kpɛti kake ji kaa haomi baa nihi tsuo a nɔ fiee nɛ slɔɔto be mi; dali jio, yayami peeli jio. Daa nɛ ɔ, yayami kɛ godo hyi nimli adesahi a tsui mi ngɛ je ɔ mi. Kɛkɛ a gbo tlukaa. 4Se nɔ nɛ piɛɔ hɛ kali a he ngɛ je ɔ mi ɔ, hɛ nɔ kami ngɛ ha lɛ. Ejakaa gbe hɛ ngmengmle hi pe jata gbogboe. 5Niinɛ, nihi nɛ a hɛ ngɛ ɔ le kaa a ma ba gbo; ni gbogboe ɔmɛ lɛɛ a li nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko. Hiɔwo kpa ko hu a be; ejakaa nihi a hɛ je a nɔ pɛsɛpɛsɛ. 6A gbo kɛ a suɔmi, ninyɛ, kɛ hɛkɔ ɔ tsuo. Níhi nɛ yaa nɔ ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, mɛɛ lɛɛ a pa be mi nɛ a peeɔ hu.
7Yaa nɛ o ya ye ní, nɛ o na bua jɔmi. Yaa nu wai, nɛ o tsui nɛ nɔ o mi; o ní tsumi ɔ sa Mawu hɛ mi momo. 8Wo tade hiɔ be tsuaa be, nɛ o ko ha nɛ nu nɛ ta o yi mi. 9Be bɔɔ nɛ Mawu ha mo ngɛ zugba nɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ, o kɛ o yo nɛ o suɔ lɛ saminya a, nyɛɛ ye e mi ngɔɔmi. Daa ligbi nɛ nɔ́ ko be mi ɔ, nyɛɛ ye mle. Ejakaa dengme tsuo nɛ o ngɛ gboe ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ o ma na kɛ je mi ji lɔ ɔ nɛ. 10Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ o ngɛ tsue ɔ, tsu kɛ o he wami tsuo. Ejakaa gbeje, he nɛ o maa ya hwɔɔ se ɔ, ní tsumi, loo yi mi susumi, loo nile, loo ga be lejɛ ɔ.
11Nɔ́ kake hu nɛ i na ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi ji: tsa pi nihi nɛ le fo tumi wawɛɛ ji nihi nɛ yeɔ kekleekle blɔ he be tsuaa be; pi katsɛmɛ ji ni nɛmɛ nɛ yeɔ kunimi ngɛ ta mi daa. Pi ní leli tsuo a dɛ nɛ niye ní ngɛ; pi juɛmitsɛmɛ tsuo ji matsɛmɛ, nɛ gali hu, pi mɛ tsuo nɛ a hɛ mi baa nyami. Haomi baa mɛ tsuo a nɔ fiee. 12Nɔmlɔ adesa li e be. Be yayami ba naa nɔ tlukaa kaa bɔ nɛ lo duɔ ya, aloo kaa bɔ nɛ lohwe pɛlitsɛ duɔ klama a.
Nile kɛ kuasia jemi
13Nɔ́ ko hu nɛ i na ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi, nɛ tsɔɔ bɔ nɛ a buu nile ha ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. 14Ma wayoo ko hi si kɛ e mi nimli bɔɔ pɛ. Be ko ɔ, matsɛ nguaa ko ba tua ma a. E sa ma a yi, nɛ e fia kpoku kɛ bɔle ma a. 15Nyumu ko ngɛ ma a mi. Nɔ́ ko be e dɛ lɛɛ, se e le ní bɔ nɛ e kɛ e nile ɔ he ma a yi wami. Se nɔ ko nɔ ko susuu we e he. 16I deɔ daa ke nile hi pe he wami. Se nɔ ko bui ohiatsɛ ní lelɔ; e nya mi munyu po a bui tue. 17Ní lelɔ munyu blɛuu ngɔɔ ngɛ tue mi pe ngmlaa nɛ nɔ yelɔ ko kpaa ngɛ kuasiahi a kpɛti. 18Nile hi pe ta hwumi níhi. Se yayami peelɔ kake kpataa ní kpakpahi babauu a hɛ mi.

Title: FIƐLƆ 10
Content:
1Anunu gbogboe haa nɛ tsopa kɛ e he via jeɔ fu. Jã kɛ̃ kuasia jemi bɔɔ gbeɔ nile kɛ hɛ mi nyami a he guɛ.
2Ní lelɔ suɔmi nya ní ji kaa e pee kpakpa daa; se kuasia lɛɛ e suɔ kaa e pee nɔ́ yayami. 3Ke kuasia ngɛ nyɛɛe ngɛ gbɛjegbɛ nɔ ɔ, e ní peepee yeɔ e he odase kɛ tsɔɔ nɔ tsuaa nɔ kaa kuasia ji lɛ.
4Ke o nɔ yelɔ mi mi fu mo ɔ, koo je o ní tsumi he ɔ; he si bami gbeɔ sanehi nɛ he wa a nya la.
5Nɔ́ ko nɛ i na ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi nɛ dɛ, nɛ matsɛmɛ kɛ nɔ yeli pɔɔ peemi ji kaa 6a haa kuasiahi blɔ he nguanguahi, nɛ niatsɛmɛ mohu hii sisi je. 7I naa tsɔli ngɛ okpɔngɔhi a nɔ, be mi nɛ ganɔhi mohu ngɛ zugba nyɛɛe.
8 Nɔ nɛ tsuaa muɔ ɔ, lɛ nɛ maa nɔ mi; nɔ nɛ gbaa piɛ ɔ, lɛ nɛ sinɔ maa kɔ. 9Nɔ nɛ ywiaa tɛ ɔ, lɛ nɛ tɛ plaa; nɔ nɛ gbaa lɛ́ ɔ, lɛ nɛ lɛ́ plaa. 10Ke o dade nya gbo, nɛ o duɔ we nya a, ja o kɛ o he wami tsu ní wawɛɛ. Se nile haa nɛ nɔ toɔ ga kpakpa. 11Ke sinɔ maa kɔ kunya yelɔ kekle loko e maa wo sinɔ ɔ hɛ mi kunya a, mɛni e ma na? 12Ní lelɔ nya mi munyu haa nɛ e hɛ mi baa nyami. Se kuasia kɛ e munyu kpataa lɛ nitsɛ e hɛ mi. 13E jeɔ sisi kɛ kuasia munyu tumi, nɛ e gbeɔ nya kɛ godo. 14Kuasia tuɔ munyu babauu. Nɔ ko nɔ ko li hwɔɔ se sane; nɔ́ nɛ maa ba ngɛ wa gbenɔ se ɔ, mɛnɔ ma nyɛ ma de?
15Kuasia gboɔ yaka dengme kɛ woɔ lɛ nitsɛ e he pɔtɔ; ejakaa e li blɔ nɛ a guu nɔ kɛ yaa ma mi.
16Ma nɛ jokuɛyo ngɛ a nɔ matsɛ yee, nɛ ganɔ ɔmɛ yeɔ ní, nɛ a nuɔ ní kpɔtɔɔ daa mɔtu ɔ, musu tloo mɛ. 17A gbaa ma nɛ a matsɛ ɔ ngɔɔ lɛ nitsɛ e juɛmi kɛ tsuɔ ní, nɛ ganɔ ɔmɛ yeɔ ní bɔ nɛ sa ngɛ be nɔ, konɛ a nimli tso ɔmɛ nɛ a na he wami; se pi kaa a maa tɔ dã.
18Hejɔtsɛ tsu yi mi kuɔ kɛ woɔ mi, nɛ tsu ɔ dungɔɔ.
19A tsɛɔ ní yemi konɛ a fiɛ nɛ a muɔ; dã haa nɔ bua jɔmi, se sika lɛ peeɔ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́.
20Koo gbiɛ matsɛ ngɛ o yi mi po; niatsɛ hu koo gbiɛ lɛ ngɛ o se tsu mi. Lohwe pɛlitsɛ ko maa ngɔ o munyu ɔ kɛ ho nɛ e ya de.

Title: FIƐLƆ 11
Content:
Ní lelɔ ní tsumi
1Mo sake o nɔ́ kpakpa ko ngɔ fɔ nyu hɛ, nɛ hwɔɔ se ko ɔ, o ma ba ná he se. 2Ngɔɔ o ní kpakpahi ngɔ to hehi munomuno; ejakaa o li matahu ko nɛ ma ba po mo ngɛ je mi.
3Ke hiɔwe yu bluublu kɛ bɔku ɔ, hiɔmi nɛɛ. He nɛ tso ku fɔ si ngɛ ɔ, leneyi je jio, omleyi je jio, lejɛ ɔ e hii. 4Nɔ nɛ slaa kɔɔhiɔ ɔ, e du we ní; nɔ nɛ hyɛɛ bɔku mi ɔ, e kpa we ní. 5Níhi nɛ Mawu pee ɔ, o juɛmi su a he lo? Ke o juɛmi sui a he ɔ, lɛɛ kɛ o maa pee kɛ le bɔ nɛ wami he jeɔ sisi ngɛ yohɔyo mi mi kɛɛ? 6Du ní mɔtu kɛ gbɔkuɛ tsuo. O li a kpɛti nɔ́ nɛ maa ba; mɔtu nɔ́ ɔ jio, gbɔkuɛ nɔ́ ɔ jio. Enyɔ ɔmɛ tsuo maa hi jio, o li.
7La ngɔɔ; ke hɛngmɛ na pu la a, e suɔ. 8Ke nɔ ko ye jeha babauu ngɛ je mi ɔ, e ná bua jɔmi daa ligbi. Se mohu, e kai kaa ke e gbo ɔ, be nɛ e maa ye ngɛ lejɛ ɔ hiɛ kulaa pe be nɛ e maa ye ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi. Níhi nɛ maa ba a tsuo ji yaka níhi.
Nihewi a slɔmi
9Nihewi, nyɛ fiɛ nyɛ yi nɔ ngɛ nyɛ nihe mi; nyɛɛ pee nyɛ suɔmi nya ní, nɛ nyɛ na bua jɔmi. Se nyɛ na nɛ nyɛɛ le kaa Mawu maa kojo nyɛ ngɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a he.
10Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ ko ye tsui, nɛ nyɛ ko hao; ejakaa jokuɛwi a si, kɛ nihe be ɔ tsuo yaka.

Title: FIƐLƆ 12
Content:
1Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, mo kai o bɔlɔ ɔ ngɛ o nihe mi, be mi nɛ ligbi yayami ɔmɛ, kɛ jeha yayami ɔmɛ na we nɛ a ba, nɛ o ma de ke, “I be bua jɔmi ngɛ je mi.” 2Jamɛ a be ɔ, pu, nyɔhiɔ, kɛ dodoehi maa pee sulii ngɛ o hɛngmɛ mi. Daa nɛ ɔ, bɔku ɔmɛ maa pee kaa nɔ́ nɛ hiɔmi yaa nɛ. 3O ninehi nɛ o kɛ buɔ o he ɔ ma bɔni kpokpomi, nɛ o nane kpakpataa amɛ a mi maa jɔ. O lunguhi be nyɛe maa ta nɔ́ hu, ejakaa a he pi. O hɛngmɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ maa ha, nɛ o be nɔ́ hyɛe saminya hu. 4Jamɛ a be ɔ, huhui nɛ ngɛ pɛe ngɛ blɔ mi ɔ, o tue be nue hu. Ke o ngɛ nɔ́ tae ɔ, o tsitsa be pɛe hu. Ke la ngɛ pɛe ɔ, pe o maa nu fã kɛ fã kɛkɛ. Makɛ, loko kungwɔ ma kpa nɔ́ ɔ, moo o te si momo. 5Nɔ́ kuɔmi maa wo o he gbeye, nɛ nyɛɛmi maa pee mo ahuto. O yi bwɔmi ma hiɛ futafuta. O maa nyɛɛ blɛuu blɛuu kaa angmɛɛtɛ nɛ ngɛ si sãe, nɛ o he mi akɔnɔ tsuo se maa po.
Wa yaa wa nyagbe he jɔɔmi he ɔ, nɛ a maa wo yana ngɛ blɔ ɔmɛ a mi. 6Jamɛ a be ɔ, sika hiɔ kpa a ma tsɔ. Sika tsu kplu ɔ maa ywia. Buɛ ɔ maa ywia ngɛ pa a nya, nɛ nyu yɛmi klama a maa ku ngɛ vu ɔ he. 7Wa nɔmlɔ tso ɔ maa kpale kɛ ya tabo zu mi he nɛ e je ɔ, nɛ mumi ɔ maa ya Mawu ngɔ. Mawu lɛ ha mumi ɔ nɛ.
8Ye juɛmi deɔ mi ke wami nɛ ɔ, se nami ko be he; lɛ tsuo peeɔ yaka.
Nyagbe
9Fiɛlɔ ɔ, pi kaa e juɛmi mi kuɔ kɛkɛ; e tsɔɔ ma a nile hulɔ. E bua abɛhi a nya. E kase abɛ ɔmɛ saminya, nɛ e hla a mi. 10E bɔ mɔde kaa e maa ngma munyuhi nɛ ngɔɔ. Nɛ níhi nɛ e ngma a, anɔkuale sɔuu. 11Ní leli a munyuhi ngɛ kaa tso kɛ e nya piɔpiɔ nɛ lohwe hyɛli kɛ tsɔ́ɔ́ a lohwehi. Abɛhi nɛ a bua nya a, a he ngɛ se nami wawɛɛ kaa plɛɛkohi nɛ a je blɔ ka kɛ wo tso mi. Wɔ tsuo wa hyɛlɔ kake too nɛ ji Mawu ɔ, lɛ nɛ e ha wɔ kikɛmɛ a abɛ nɛ ɔmɛ.
12Ye bi, ha nɛ ma wo mo ga nɛ ɔ hulɔ. Womi ngmami be nyagbe; ni kasemi fuu haa nɛ pɔ tɔɔ nɔmlɔ tso ɔ.
13Nyagbe ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ ma de kɛkɛ ji kaa moo ye Mawu gbeye, nɛ o ye e mlaa amɛ a nɔ. Ní tsumi nɛ ngɛ kɛ ha nimli adesahi tsuo ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. 14Mawu maa kojo wɔ ngɛ níhi tsuo nɛ wa pee ɔ a he. Níhi nɛ wa pee ngɛ laami mi po, e maa kojo wɔ ngɛ a he; kpakpa jio, yaya jio.

Title: LAHI NYA TSƆƆMI
Content:
NYA TSƆƆMI
Lahi nɛ a po ngɛ asilɛ munyu tumi blɔ nɔ nɛ a bua nya ngɔ wo womi nɛ ɔ mi. Munyu ɔmɛ hiɛhiɛɛ ngɛ kaa nɔ́ nɛ nyumu nɛ ngɛ yo munyu tue, nɛ yo ɔ ngɛ nɔ hee. Ni komɛ tsɛɛ womi nɛ ɔ ke Salomo Lahi,
ejakaa ngɛ Hebri gbi mi ɔ, a ngɔɔ lɛ kaa Salomo lɛ ngma.
Yuda bi ngɔɔ lɛ kaa Mawu kɛ e ma a a huɛ bɔmi ɔ, kikɛ nɛ ɔ e ngɛ; nɛ Kristo we bi hu tsɔɔ kaa la amɛ kaleɔ huɛ bɔmi nɛ ngɛ Kristo kɛ e we asafo ɔ a kpɛti.
Bɔ nɛ a dla womi ɔ mi ha
Kekleekle la 1.1—2.7
La enyɔne 2.8—3.5
La etɛne 3.6—5.1
La eywiɛne 5.2—6.3
La enuɔne 6.4—8.4
La ekpane 8.5-14

Title: LAHI 1
Content:
1 Salomo la amɛ a mi nɔ́ nɛ ngɔɔ pe kulaa ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ.
Kekleekle la
Yo ɔ
2Mo fiɔ ye nya he si abɔ nɛ o suɔ.
O suɔmi ɔ ngɔɔ pe wai dɔkɔdɔkɔ.
3O he ngɛ via jee kaa nɔ́ ko;
ke a wo o biɛ ta pɛ
a kaiɔ o he via a;
lɔ ɔ he nɛ yi ɔmɛ tsuo suɔ mo ɔ nɛ.
4Ngɔɔ mi kɛ ho esɔ.
Ye matsɛ, ngɔɔ mi kɛ ya o tsu ɔ mi.
I ngɔ ye he kɛ ha mo.
Wa bua maa jɔ wa he saminya.
O suɔmi ɔ ngɔɔ dɔkɔdɔkɔ pe wai po.
E be nyakpɛ kaa yi ɔmɛ tsuo suɔ mo!
5Nyɛ Yerusalem yihewi!
I yuɔ, nɛ ye he ngɛ fɛu saminyayoo.
I ngɛ kaa bo tsu nɛ ngɛ Kedar a.
Ye he fɛu ɔ, Matsɛ Salomo mɔ ɔ mi
tsu mi pomi bo ɔmɛ a he fɛu ɔ pɛ
a kɛ maa to he.
6Nyɛ ko hyɛ mi maa
ngɛ yumi nɛ i yu ɔ he;
pu la nɛ pee ye he womi ja.
Ye nyɛminyumu ɔmɛ a mi mi fu mi,
nɛ a ha i ya tsu ní ngɛ wai ngmɔ ɔmɛ a mi.
I na we deka ko kulaa
kɛ ha ye nɔmlɔ tso ɔ.
7Ye suɔlɔ, mo de mi.
Jije o ma tsɔ̃ o to ɔmɛ kɛ ya
nɛ a ya ye ní?
Ke pu nya wa a,
jije o maa jɔɔ o he ngɛ?
Mɛni he je nɛ ma hi si kpae
kɛ hi mo hlae
ngɛ to hyɛli kpa amɛ a to ɔmɛ a kpɛti ɔ?
Nyumu ɔ
8Mo nɛ o he ngɛ fɛu pe yihi tsuo,
o li lejɛ ɔ?
Yaa nɛ o ya nyɛɛ to ɔmɛ a se.
Yaa ha o to ɔmɛ ní
ngɛ to hyɛli ɔmɛ a bo tsu ɔmɛ
a kasa nya.
9Mo, ye afɛu yo nɛ i suɔ,
ma ngɔ mo kɛ to okpɔngɔ ku
nɛ gblaa Farao ɔ zugba lɛ he.
10O yi bwɔmi ngɛ fɛu ngɛ o tsitsa he;
bwɔmi ɔ kplaa si ngɛ o kuɛ he kaa june.
11Se kɛ̃ ɔ, wa maa pee sika tsu ga
kɛ e he sika hiɔ níhi ha mo.
Yo ɔ
12Ye matsɛ ɔ kpasa si ngɛ e we akpasa mi,
nɛ ye nu kɛ e he via a ngɛ via
jee liliili ngɛ lejɛ ɔ tsuo.
13Ye suɔlɔ ɔ ngɛ ye gugue mi;
e he ngɛ via jee kaa mimɛ.
14Ye suɔlɔ ɔ ngɛ kaa pú mi mɔmɔ
saminyayoo;
e ngɛ kaa mɔmɔhi nɛ gbaa ngɛ Engedi
wai ngmɔ ɔmɛ a mi ɔ eko.
Nyumu ɔ
15Ye afɛu yo nɛ i suɔ,
o he ngɛ fɛu.
O hɛngmɛ ngɛ dɔkɔɔ kaa lahuɛ hɛngmɛ!
Yo ɔ
16Ye suɔlɔ kpakpa pe kulaa,
hyɛ bɔ nɛ o he ngɛ bua jɔmi ha!
Nga mumu nɔ wa maa hwɔ,
17he nɛ seda tso ngua amɛ ngɛ ɔ;
nɛ sɛsɛo tso ɔmɛ maa ha wa yi nɔ.

Title: LAHI 2
Content:
1Sharon pú mi mɔmɔ kɛkɛ ji mi;
kɔ̃ mi mɔmɔ ko kɛkɛ ji mi.
Nyumu ɔ
2Ye afɛu yo nɛ i suɔ mo saminya,
bɔ nɛ nga nɔ mɔmɔ ngɛ
ngɛ miohi a mi ɔ,
jã o ngɛ kɛ ha mi
ngɛ yihi tsuo a kpɛti.
Yo ɔ
3Ke a ngɔ ye suɔlɔ ɔ ngɔ to nyumu kpa amɛ
a he ɔ, e ngɛ kaa tso nɛ yiblii ngɔɔ saminya
ngɛ pú mi tsohi a kpɛti.
I suɔ nɛ ma hi e hɔ̃ ɔ mi;
e yiblii ɔ ngɔɔ ye nya.
4E kɛ mi ba e asa a nɔ niye he ɔ;
lejɛ ɔ nɛ e je e suɔmi kpo ngɛ kɛ ha mi.
5Nyɛ ha mi wai yiblii gbigbli nɛ ma ye,
konɛ ma na he wami.
Nyɛ ha mi tso yiblii nɛ ngɔɔ saminya nɛ ma kɛ jɔɔ ye tsui he;
ejakaa suɔmi ɔ ngɛ mi gbee.
6Ye yi fɔɔ si ngɛ e muɔ kɔni nɔ,
nɛ e ngɔ e hiɔ nine kɛ fua mi.
7Yerusalem yihi, nyɛɛ wo mi si;
nyɛ ka mi kita kaa
nyɛ na odabɔ nɛ he sɔɔ, kɛ batslɔɔ
kaa nyɛ be ye suɔlɔ ɔ tsɛe
kɛ yaa si be nɛ lɛ nitsɛ e maa te si.
La enyɔne
Yo ɔ
8I nu ye suɔlɔ ɔ gbi.
E ngɛ hiie ngɛ yo ɔmɛ a nɔ kɛ ma;
e ngɛ fo tue ngɛ yoku ɔmɛ a nɔ
kɛ ma ye ngɔ.
9Ye suɔlɔ ɔ ngɛ kaa batslɔɔ;
e ngɛ kaa oflote niheyo.
O nɛ lɛ nɛ daa si ngɛ wa tsu ɔ se.
E ngɛ saflɛ ɔ mi hyɛe;
e ngɛ saflɛ puɔ ɔmɛ a mi flie.
10Ye suɔlɔ ɔ ngɛ mi nɔ́ ko dee.
Nyumu ɔ
Ye suɔlɔ, ye afɛu yo;
ba nɛ waa ho koo!
11Fĩɛ be ɔ be;
hiɔmi hu kpa nɛmi.
12Mɔmɔ ɔmɛ gba tii ngɛ nga a nɔ.
Lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ a lami be ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Lahuɛhi a la he wa ngɛ nue
ngɛ pú ɔ mi ɔ nɛ.
13Ngmɔkɔ bɔni fumi.
Kɔɔhiɔ mi hyi kɛ wai yiblii he via.
Ye suɔlɔ, ye afɛu yo;
ba nɛ waa ho koo!
14O ngɛ kaa lahuɛ nɛ ya laa e he
ngɛ tɛ sa puɔ mi.
Ha nɛ ma na o hɛ mi.
O he ngɛ fɛu loo.
Ha nɛ ma nu o gbi.
O gbi ngɔɔ loo!
15Nyɛɛ nuu kɔkɔbo ɔmɛ ha wɔ.
Nyɛɛ nuu kɔkɔbo tsɔwi ɔmɛ
nɛ puɛɔ wai ngmɔ ɔmɛ ɔ;
ejakaa wai ngmɔ ɔmɛ gba mɔmɔ.
Yo ɔ
16I ngɔ ye he ngɔ ha ye suɔlɔ ɔ,
nɛ lɛ hu e ngɔ e he ngɔ ha mi.
He nɛ nga nɔ mɔmɔhi ngɛ ɔ,
lejɛ ɔ e haa e to ɔmɛ ní ngɛ.
17E haa mɛ ní hluu
kɛ ya siɔ mɔtu kɔɔhiɔ bɔni fiami,
nɛ je mi tsɔɔ.
Kpale kɛ ba, ye suɔlɔ;
kpale kɛ ba kaa batslɔɔ,
kpale kɛ ba kaa oflote niheyo
ngɛ Beter yo ɔmɛ a nɔ.

Title: LAHI 3
Content:
1Nyɔ mi, ke i hwɔ si ɔ,
i nlaa ye suɔlɔ ɔ.
I hla kaa ma na lɛ,
se i nɛ́ lɛ.
2I hla lɛ kɛ ya kpa ma a mi
ngɛ gbɛjegbɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ,
kɛ nane blɔ ɔmɛ a nɔ.
I hla ye suɔlɔ ɔ hluu,
se i nɛ́ lɛ.
3Ma a mi buli ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ si poe
ngɛ ma a mi ɔ
kɛ mi ba kpe.
I bi mɛ ke,
“Nyɛ na ye suɔlɔ ɔ ha mi lo?”
4Benɛ i be a he bɔɔ pɛ
kɛkɛ nɛ i na lɛ,
nɛ i fua lɛ atuu;
nɛ i ngmɛɛ we e he
kɛ ya si i kɛ lɛ ya su ye we ɔ mi,
kɛ ya sɛ tsu mi he nɛ a fɔ mi ngɛ ɔ.
5Yerusalem yihi, nyɛɛ wo mi si!
Nyɛ ka mi kita kaa
nyɛ na odabɔ nɛ he sɔɔ, kɛ batslɔɔ
kaa nyɛ be ye suɔlɔ ɔ tsɛe
kɛ yaa si be nɛ lɛ nitsɛ e maa te si.
La etɛne
Nyumu ɔ
6Mɛni je nga kplanaa a nɔ kɛ ma nɛ ɔ?
Mɛni lɛ ma kaa la su ku kusuu nɛ ɔ?
Mɛni ji nɛ ɔ kɛ e he via
kaa tsopa kɛ e he via, aloo mimɛ,
aloo jua yeli a tsopa kpa komɛ
nɛ jee via a?
7Salomo ji nɔ nɛ ma a nɛ;
a tloo lɛ ngɛ tsokpo mi kɛ ma.
Israel tatsɛmɛ kpanakpanaa a kpɛti
nyingmi ekpa ji tabo nɛ ngɛ e he bue kɛ ma.
8A ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ mia kɛ klaate
nɛ e kɛ ma fa e he
ke a ma ba tua mɛ nyɔ mi.
9A tloo Matsɛ Salomo
ngɛ tsokpo saminyayoo ko mi.
Lebanon tso kpakpa a kɛ pee tsokpo ɔ.
10A ha si mami tso ɔmɛ a he sika hiɔ;
bo nɛ a kɛ sika tsu lo ní kɛ wo mi
nɛ a kɛ ha tsokpo ɔ nitsɛ he;
nɛ he nɛ a hii ɔ lɛɛ
bo he jua wawɛ nɛ hɛɛ alamua tu su a kɛ ha lejɛ ɔ.
Bo nɛ a kɛ dla tsokpo ɔ mi ɔ,
Yerusalem yi ɔmɛ lɛ a lo ní
saminyawiiwi kɛ wo mi.
11Zion yihi, nyɛɛ ba nɛ nyɛ ba hyɛ Matsɛ Salomo.
Jlasi nɛ e nyɛ bu lɛ matsɛ ɔ
yo kpeemi ligbi ɔ ngɛ e yi.
Yo kpeemi ligbi ɔ,
a nya, nɛ a bua jɔ wawɛɛ nitsɛ.

Title: LAHI 4
Content:
Nyumu ɔ
1Ye afɛu yo;
o he ngɛ fɛu saminya!
Hyɛ bɔ nɛ o hɛngmɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ kpɛe
kɛ suɔmi ngɛ o hɛ mi hami nɔ́ ɔ se.
O yi bwɔmi ngɛ doe ngɛ o yi nɔ
kaa to akpakpo kuu nɛ a ngɛ tuue
ngɛ Gilead yoku ɔmɛ a nɔ.
2O lunguhi hiɔ kaa jijɔhi
nɛ a sã a he bwɔmi,
nɛ́ a du a he ha mɛ kɛ́ we.
O lungu ɔmɛ a yibɔ su;
a kpe sioo ngɛ o nya mi.
3O nya lo ngɛ kaa kpa tsu.
Ke o pa o nya mi nɛ o maa tu munyu ɔ,
e ngɛ fɛu kɛkɛ.
O tsitsa ngɛ tsɛ̃e ngɛ o hɛ mi hami nɔ́ ɔ se.
4O kuɛ ngɛ legelege,
nɛ e ngɛ tlotlootlo;
kuɛ ní nɛ kplaa si ngɛ he ɔ
ngɛ kaa David mɔ ɔ
nɛ tsɛ̃i akpe kplaa si ngɛ he kɛ kpe.
5O nyɔ ɔmɛ ngɛ kaa batslɔhi,
loo odabɔ hawi enyɔ nɛ a ngɛ ní yee
ngɛ nga nɔ mɔmɔhi a mi.
6Ma hi yo ɔ nɔ he nɛ mimɛ ngɛ ɔ;
ma hi yoku ɔ nɔ he nɛ tsopa kɛ e he via ngɛ ɔ,
kɛ yaa su be nɛ mɔtu kɔɔhiɔ ma bɔni fiami,
nɛ je mi ma tsɔ.
7Ye afɛu yo,
o he ngɛ fɛu tsɔ;
o he ngɛ fɛu kɛ pi si!
8Ye we ayɛflo, ba nɛ wa kple si
kɛ je Lebanon yo ɔmɛ a nɔ;
ha nɛ waa je Lebanon;
waa je Amana yo ɔ yi mi;
waa je Senir kɛ Hermon yo ɔmɛ a yi mi
he nɛ jatahi kɛ ngatsɛhi hii ɔ.
9Ye nyɛmiyo, ye we ayɛflo nɛ i suɔ mo saminya;
hɛngmɛ nɛ o kɛ hyɛ mi,
kɛ o kuɛ ní nɛ o wo nɛ ɔ
gbe ye tsui kulaa.
10O suɔmi ɔ jɔɔ ye bua.
Ye tsui kpa, kɛ ye we ayɛflo nɛ i suɔ mo saminya,
o suɔmi ɔ ngɔɔ pe wai.
O nu via a he via pe tsopa kɛ e he via
slɔɔto ɔmɛ tsuo.
11Ye we ayɛflo nɛ i suɔ,
ke a fiɔ o nya he ɔ, e ngɔɔ kaa hwo,
o lilɛ ngɛ kaa nyɔ nyu kɛ hwo ha mi;
o bo mi he via kaa Lebanon he via.
12Ye nyɛmiyo, ye we ayɛflo nɛ i suɔ mo saminya,
o ngɛ kaa abɔɔ nɛ a ngmɛ nya;
o ngɛ kaa nyu vu nɛ a sɔu nya.
13Abɔɔ nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, tso slɔɔtohi nɛ bɔɔ
kaa tso nɛ yiblii ngɔɔ saminya a ngɛ lejɛ ɔ,
nɛ a woɔ yiblii kpakpahi.
Tsohi nɛ pɔ he ngɛ lejɛ ɔ ji
hena, nardo,
14safron, kalamo, kɛ sinamon,
loo tsopa kɛ e he via kpa slɔɔtoslɔɔtohi.
Mimɛ kɛ tsopa tso kpahi nɛ jee via hu
pɔ he ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.
15A bɔɔ ɔ naa nyu nɛ haa nɔ wami kɛ jee vuhi,
pahi nɛ ngɛ bee,
kɛ pa wawi nɛ jee Lebanon yo ɔ nɔ ɔ
a mi.
Yo ɔ
16Kɔɔhiɔ nɛ je omleyi je, tee si koo.
Kɔɔhiɔ nɛ je leneyi je, tee si
nɛ o fia kɛ ya gu ye we abɔɔ ɔ mi,
konɛ lejɛ ɔ tsuo nɛ je via.
Ha nɛ ye suɔlɔ ɔ nɛ ba e we abɔɔ ɔ mi,
nɛ e ba ye e mi tso yiblii
nɔ́ nɛ hi pe kulaa a.

Title: LAHI 5
Content:
Nyumu ɔ
1Ye nyɛmiyo; ye we ayɛflo nɛ i suɔ mo saminya,
i ba ye we abɔɔ ɔ mi.
I ngɛ ye tsopa kɛ e he via,
kɛ mimɛ nya buae.
I ngɛ ye hwo kɛ hwo gbaku yee.
I ngɛ ye wai kɛ nyɔ nyu nue.
Yi ɔmɛ
Huɛmɛ, nyɛɛ ye ní nɛ nyɛɛ nu ní.
Nyɛ suɔmi ɔ nɛ de nyɛ kaa dã!
La eywiɛne
Yo ɔ
2I hwɔ mahe, se i hwɔ we mahe kɛ ye tue.
Tlukaa a, ye suɔlɔ ɔ ba si sinya a.
Nyumu ɔ
Agoo, ye tsui kpa, bli sinya a ha mi.
Ye nyɛmiyo, ye lahuɛ!
Bɔ́ nɛɛ mi, nɛ ye yi, kɛ ye yi bwɔmi tsuo pɔ.
Yo ɔ
3I jé ye tade momo.
Mɛni he je ma kpale wo tade?
I fɔ ye nane he.
Mɛni he je ma wo ye nane he mu ekohu?
4Ye suɔlɔ ɔ kɛ e nine pɛtɛ sinya a he,
kɛkɛ nɛ nɔ́ ko pee mi ngɛ ye tsui mi
kaa nɔ́ nɛ e su ye he haa.
5I te si, konɛ ma bli sinya a ha ye suɔlɔ ɔ.
I kpa ye kɔni ɔmɛ a he mimɛ,
nɛ e he nyu ɔ ngɛ dɛe ngɛ ye nine nguɛ
nya kɛ ngɛ sinya a se lami nɔ́ ɔ
nɛ i pɛtɛ he ɔ nɔ puee.
6I bli sinya a ha ye suɔlɔ ɔ,
se e je momo.
Ao, nɛ́ i ko nu e gbi kɛkɛ ɔ!
I hla lɛ, se i nɛ́ lɛ.
I tsɛ lɛ, se i nui e he.
7Buli ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ si poe ngɛ ma a mi ɔ
ba na mi; a fia mi nɔ́, a plaa mi;
nɛ buli ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ gbogbo ɔ nɔ ɔ
kpɔ ye hɛ mi hami nɔ́ ɔ kɛ je.
8Yerusalem yihi, nyɛ ka mi kita kaa
ke nyɛ na ye suɔlɔ ɔ,
nyɛ ma de lɛ ke
e he suɔmi ngɛ mi gbee.
Yi ɔmɛ
9Mo nɛ o he ngɛ fɛu pe yihi tsuo,
mɛni o suɔlɔ ɔ kɛ pe suɔli kpahi?
Mɛni ngɛ nyakpɛ tsɔ ngɛ o suɔlɔ ɔ he,
nɛ o deɔ wɔ ke wa ka mo kita a?
Yo ɔ
10Ye suɔlɔ ɔ he ngɛ fɛu saminya,
nɛ e he wa hulɔ.
Ke a kane nyumuhi akpe nyɔngma
loko a ma na e nɔ nɔ kake.
11E yi ngɛ kaa sika tsu ngmingmiingmi;
e yi bwɔmi yuɔ tslitsliitsli
kaa kuakualabite,
nɛ e dɔ bɔdɔɔ kɛ pue e yi mi.
12E hɛngmɛhi ngɛ fɛu kaa lahuɛhi
nɛ du a he saminyayoo,
nɛ a he ngɛ kpɛe kaa tɛ nɛ he jua wa
kɛ daa si ngɛ pa nɛ ngɛ bee nya.
13E tsitsa ngɛ kaa abɔɔ ko
nɛ tsopa kɛ e he via ngɛ via jee
liliili ngɛ mi.
E nya lo ngɛ kaa nga nɔ mɔmɔhi
nɛ mimɛ nyu pɔ mɛ.
14Sika tsu gahi nɛ tɛ kpakpahi hɔɔ si ngɛ a mi
ngɛ e kɔnihi a he.
E nɔmlɔ tso ngɛ kaa suɔ wu nɛ a kɛ tɛ
kpakpahi nɛ hɛɛ bluu su hɔɔ si ngɛ a mi.
15E fiɔhi ngɛ kaa tɛ hiɔ titimahi
nɛ a kɛ ma sika tsu níhi a mi.
Ye suɔlɔ ɔ hɛ mi nyami ngɛ kaa
Lebanon yo ɔmɛ kɛ a nɔ seda tso
saminyawiiwi nɛ ka gagaaga.
16E nya mi munyu ngɔɔ;
e he nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ peeɔ mi akɔnɔ.
Yerusalem yihewi, ye suɔlɔ kɛ ye huɛ ɔ,
bɔ nɛ e ngɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.

Title: LAHI 6
Content:
Yi ɔmɛ
1Mo nɛ o he ngɛ fɛu pe yihi tsuo,
jije o suɔlɔ ɔ ho?
Tsɔɔ wɔ he nɛ o suɔlɔ ɔ gu,
konɛ waa piɛ o he kɛ hla lɛ.
Yo ɔ
2Ye suɔlɔ ɔ ho e abɔɔ ɔ mi ya;
lejɛ ɔ nɛ tsopa kɛ e he via tso ɔmɛ ngɛ.
E ngɛ e to ɔmɛ hyɛe ngɛ lejɛ ɔ,
nɛ e ngɛ nga mi mɔmɔhi a nya buae.
3I ngɔ ye he kɛ ha ye suɔlɔ ɔ,
nɛ lɛ hu e ngɔ e he kɛ ha mi.
E hyɛɔ e to ɔmɛ ngɛ nga nɔ
mɔmɔ ɔmɛ a mi ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.
La enuɔne
Nyumu ɔ
4Ye suɔlɔ, o he ngɛ fɛu kaa Yerusalem;
o he ngɛ akɔnɔ kaa Tirza ma a.
O nu ye tsui
kaa nɔ́ nɛ aflaangaa ngɛ tabo yi.
5Koo hyɛ ye hɛ mi;
o hɛngmɛhi ha ye he mi po.
O yi bwɔmi ngɛ doe ngɛ o yi nɔ
kaa to akpakpo kuu nɛ a ngɛ tuue
ngɛ Gilead yoku ɔmɛ a nɔ.
6O lunguhi hiɔ kaa jijɔhi nɛ a sã a he bwɔmi,
nɛ a du a he ha mɛ kɛ we.
O lungu ɔmɛ a yibɔ su;
a kpe sioo ngɛ o nya mi.
7O tsitsa ngɛ tsɛ̃e ngɛ o hɛ mi hami nɔ́ ɔ se.
8Imi matsɛ ɔ, i ngɛ yihi nyingmi ekpa,
plãhi nyingmi kpaanyɔ,
kɛ yihewi nɛ a li a yibɔ!
9Se nɔ kake pɛ i suɔ ngɛ a kpɛti;
e he ngɛ akɔnɔ kaa lahuɛ.
E nyɛ biyo nɛ e suɔ e sane saminya ji lɛ.
Sé ko kulaa be e he.
Yihi tsuo a bua jɔɔ e he,
nɛ a jeɔ e yi.
Manyɛmɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ plã amɛ tsuo jeɔ e yi.
10Mɛnɔ nɛ ma hleii kikɛ nɛ ɔ
kaa mɔtu pu nɛ gbaa?
E ngɛ fɛu kaa nyɔhiɔ,
nɛ e ngɛ kpɛe kaa pu.
E nu ye tsui
kaa nɔ́ nɛ aflaangaa ngɛ tabo yi.
11I ba ngmɛ́ tso abɔɔ ɔ mi,
konɛ ma ba hyɛ tso ɔmɛ ngɛ kɔ̃ ɔ mi
kaa wai tso ɔmɛ tsɛ̃ ba,
nɛ tso ɔmɛ nɛ a yiblii ngɔɔ hu gba mɔmɔ lo.
12Benɛ ma hɛli si ɔ,
e pee kaa nɔ nɛ i hii si
ngɛ zugba lɛ mi
ngɛ ye matsɛ ɔ kasa nya.
Yi ɔmɛ
13Shulam yo, doo koo;
doo nɛ o po o he
nɛ waa hyɛ mo.
Yo ɔ
Mɛni he je nyɛ suɔ nɛ nyɛ maa hyɛ mi
nɛ i ngɛ doe ngɛ kuu enyɔ
nɛ a to slɛnɛɛ ngɛ hiɛ kɛ hiɛ
a kpɛti ɔ?

Title: LAHI 7
Content:
Nyumu ɔ
1Matsɛbiyo, hyɛ bɔ nɛ o nane
ngɛ fɛu ngɛ tokota mi ha!
Bɔ nɛ o fiɔhi kpe ngɛ o mlɛ mi ɔ
ngɛ fɛu kaa nɔ́ ko nɛ galɔ kpanaa ko
je blɔ pee.
2O langmɔ ngɛ kaa likɔkɔ kokloo
nɛ wai nɛ a futu mi
tɛ̃ mi gblegbleegble.
O mi mi ngɛ kaa ngma nɛ a bua nya
nɛ a to nga nɔ mɔmɔ kɛ bɔle lɛ.
3O nyɔ ɔmɛ ngɛ kaa odabɔ enyɔ,
aloo batslɔɔ hawi.
4O kuɛ da si kaa mɔ
nɛ a ngɔ suɔ wu kɛ ma.
O hɛngmɛhi ngɛ kaa takuhi
ngɛ Batrabim agbo ɔ nya
ngɛ Heshbon ma a mi.
O gugwɔ ngɛ kaa Lebanon mɔ gojoo ɔ
nɛ e yi je kpo ngɛ Damasko ma a nɔ ɔ.
5O yi maa si ngɛ o kuɛ nɔ kaa Karmel yo ɔ.
O yi nɛ a gbɔ ɔ ngɛ kpɛe
kaa bo nɛ hɛɛ alamua tu su;
e peeɔ matsɛ po akɔnɔ.
6Ye weyo nɛ i suɔ,
o he ngɛ fɛu saminya;
o he ngɛ akɔnɔ kaa nɔ́ ko.
7O nɔmlɔ tso da si tsa kaa tã,
nɛ o nyɔhi ngɛ kaa tã he ywie sau.
8I ke ma kuɔ tã a
nɛ ma ya pɛtɛ e kuɔmi ɔmɛ a he.
Ha nɛ o nyɔ ɔmɛ nɛ pee kaa
wai yiblii sauhi,
nɛ o gugwɔ mi nɛ je via kaa
tso yiblii nɛ ngɔɔ.
9Ke a fiɔ o nya he ɔ,
é ngɔ kaa wai kpakpa.
Yo ɔ
Ke e ngɛ ja a, lɛɛ ha nɛ wai ɔ ya su
ye suɔlɔ ɔ,
nɛ e nu bɔ nɛ e ma nyɛ.
10Ye suɔlɔ ɔ nɔ́ ji mi;
e ngɛ ye se blɔ hlae.
11Ye suɔlɔ nɛ i suɔ mo,
ha nɛ waa ho nga a nɔ ya
nɛ wa ya hi kɔpe ɔmɛ a mi.
12Ha nɛ waa te si mɔtu mla
kɛ ya hyɛ kaa
wai tso ɔmɛ bɔni ba tsɛ̃mi,
nɛ a gba mɔmɔ lo.
Wa maa hyɛ kaa tso ɔmɛ nɛ a yiblii ngɔɔ hu
gba mɔmɔ lo.
Lejɛ ɔ, ma tsɔɔ mo ngɛ
kaa i suɔ mo saminya.
13O maa nu wai tso yiblii he via
ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.
Tso yiblii kpakpa amɛ tsuo pueɔ si
ngɛ wa sinya a nya:
tso yiblii ehehi, kɛ momohi.
Ye suɔlɔ, níhi nɛ a bua nya
kɛ to mo ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ.

Title: LAHI 8
Content:
1I ná nɛ ye nyɛminyumu ji mo.
I ná nɛ maa lɛ ha mo nyɔ.
Jinɛ ke i kɛ mo kpe ngɛ ma nɔ ɔ,
i ko fiɔ o nya he faa,
nɛ nɔ ko be nɔ́ ko dee.
2Jinɛ i ko ngɔ mo kɛ ya maa we ɔ mi,
konɛ o ya je suɔmi kpo kɛ tsɔɔ mi
ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.
I ko ha mo wai nɛ a futu mi;
ye tso yiblii nɛ ngɔɔ ɔ wai nɛ o nu.
3I ná nɛ ye yi fɔɔ si ngɛ o muɔ kɔni nɔ,
nɛ o ngɔ o hiɔ nine kɛ fua mi.
4Yerusalem yihi, nyɛɛ wo mi si
kaa nyɛ be ye suɔlɔ ɔ tsɛe
kɛ yaa si be nɛ lɛ nitsɛ e maa te si.
La ekpane
Yi ɔmɛ
5Mɛnɔ nɛ je nga kplanaa a nɔ kɛ ma,
nɛ e kɛ e nine la e suɔlɔ mi kikɛ nɛ ɔ?
Yo ɔ
Imi nɛ i ba tsɛ̃ɛ̃ mo ngɛ tso nɛ yiblii ngɔɔ saminya a sisi,
he nɛ o nyɛ nu kɔɔmi nɛ e fɔ mo ngɛ ɔ.
6Koo suɔ nɔ ko nɔ ko, ja imi pɛ;
koo la yo ko yo ko nine mi, ja imi pɛ.
Suɔmi ngɛ he wami kaa gbenɔ;
akɔnɔ hu nya wa kaa gbeje.
E mleɔ kaa la,
nɛ e tsoɔ gegeege.
7Nyu babauu be nyɛe maa gbe suɔmi;
pa nɛ hyi be nyɛe maa ha e nɔ.
Ke nɔ ko ka kaa e kɛ e weto ní tsuo
ma he suɔmi ɔ,
muɔ nɛ a maa muɔ lɛ.
Yo ɔ nyɛminyumu ɔmɛ
8Wa ngɛ nyɛmi yoyo ko;
e tui nyɔ lolo.
Ligbi nɛ nyumu ko ma ba bi e si ɔ,
mɛni wa maa pee ha lɛ?
9Gbogbo ji lɛ jinɛ waa kɛ sika hiɔ
maa ma mɔ ngɔ fɔ e nɔ.
Agbo ji lɛ jinɛ wa maa ngɔ seda tso
kɛ tsi e he kɛ kpe.
Yo ɔ
10Gbogbo ji mi,
ye nyɔ ɔmɛ ji mɔhi
ngɛ gbogbo ɔ nɔ.
Ye suɔlɔ ɔ le kaa ye bua jɔɔ ye he,
nɛ ye tue mi jɔɔ mi ngɛ e ngɔ.
Nyumu ɔ
11Salomo ngɛ wai abɔɔ ko ngɛ he ko
nɛ a tsɛɛ ke Baal Hamon.
E ngɔ kɛ ha ni komɛ apaa yemi.
Ke a kpa ní ɔ, a ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ
ma ba ha lɛ sika hiɔ yi akpe.
12Se imi nitsɛ ye wai abɔɔ ɔ lɛɛ
ke a kpa ní ɔ, mo Salomo,
o ma na sika hiɔ yi akpe,
nɛ apaatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ma na
lafa enyɔɔnyɔ.
13Ye suɔlɔ, ha nɛ ma nu o gbi
ngɛ abɔɔ ɔ mi koo!
Ye huɛmɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ mo tue bue!
Yo ɔ
14Ye suɔlɔ, ba ye ngɔ esɔ;
tuu kaa batslɔɔ kɛ ba ye ngɔ;
tuu kɛ ba kaa odabɔ niheyo tuɔ
ngɛ yo ɔmɛ a nɔ
he nɛ tsopa kɛ e he via tsohi
ngɛ ɔ.

Title: YESAYA NYA TSƆƆMI
Content:
NYA TSƆƆMI
Jeha 751-800 loko a fɔ Kristo ɔ, gbalɔ nguaa ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Yesaya hi Yerusalem. A ngɔ gbalɔ ɔ biɛ ngɔ wo womi nɛ ɔ.
Sanehi nɛ ngɛ womi ɔ mi ɔ, a dla a mi etɛ.
(1) Yi 1-39: Sanehi nɛ ba, be mi nɛ nɔ yemi nɛ ngɛ leneyi je nɛ a tsɛɛ Yuda a hɛ mi miɔ nɛ e kpata. Nɔ yemi kpa ko nɛ ngɛ e kasa nya nɛ biɛ ji Asiria a ngɛ lɛ haoe. Gbalɔ Yesaya na kaa tsa pi Asiria he wami ɔ nya kɛkɛ nɛ Yuda be nyɛe maa da, se mohu nɔ́ tutuutu nɛ miɔ nɛ kpata Yuda hɛ mi ji ma a nitsɛ pee yayami; a bui Mawu tue, nɛ a ngɔɛ a hɛ ngɔ fɔɛ e nɔ. Gbalɔ ɔ gu ninahi nɛ a se ti, kɛ ní peemi ní komɛ a nɔ kɛ tsɔɔ ma a, kɛ ma nimeli ɔmɛ kaa e hia kaa a pee nɔ́ nɛ da, nɛ a ye dami sane ngɛ a wami si himi mi. E bɔ mɛ kɔkɔ ke á bu Mawu tue, ke pi ja lɛɛ musu tloo mɛ, nɛ a hɛ mi ma kpata. Yesaya gba ke, be ko ma nɛ je ɔ tsuo ma na tue mi jɔmi; nɛ David nina ko ma ba pee matsɛ agbo.
(2) Yi 40-55: Sanehi nɛ ba, be mi nɛ a nuu Yuda ma a mi nihi babauu kɛ ho ma se ya ngɛ Babilon, nɛ a ya ye mɛ nyɔguɛ wawɛɛ, nɛ a hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi tsuo ta. Gbalɔ ɔ fiɛ ke e be kɛe kulaa nɛ Mawu ma ha a maa ngmɛɛ a he kɛ je nyɔguɛ yemi mi, nɛ lɛ nitsɛ e maa ngɔ mɛ kɛ maa ya we ngɛ Yerusalem, konɛ a ya je wami he sisi ekohu. Womi ɔ mi dlami fa nɛ ɔ mi oti pɔtɛɛ ji Mawu ji je ɔ mi sanehi tsuo a Nyɔmtsɛ, nɛ e blɔ nya tomi ɔmɛ eko ji kaa e ngɛ e ma a tsɔe kɛ yaa je ma amɛ tsuo a ngɔ. Israel mi nɛ a maa je kɛ gbaa je ma amɛ. Munyuhi nɛ a le pe kulaa ngɛ Somi Momo womi ɔmɛ a mi ɔ kɔɔ “Nyɔmtsɛ Tsɔlɔ ɔ” he.
(3) Yi 56-66: Munyuhi nɛ a tu kɛ tsɔɔ nihi nɛ kpale kɛ je ma se kɛ ba Yerusalem. A ha nɛ a nu sisi kaa Mawu wo e ma a si, nɛ e maa ye siwo ɔ nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ. Se e hia kaa ma a nɛ pee nɔ́ nɛ da, nɛ a ye dami sane. E hia hu kaa a ye Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ, nɛ a sã bɔ, nɛ a sɔle. Munyu nɛ a ngma ngɛ yi 61.1-2 ɔ he hia saminya. Lɔ ɔ ji nɔ́ nɛ Yesu kɛ je e ní tsumi sisi kɛ tsɔɔ kaa Mawu nitsɛ nɛ tsɛ lɛ kɛ ha e ní tsumi ɔ.
Bɔ nɛ a dla womi ɔ mi ha
Kɔkɔ bɔmi kɛ si womi 1.1—12.6
Je ma amɛ a tue gblami 13.1—23.18
Mawu maa kojo je ɔ 24.1—27.13
Kɔkɔ bɔmi kɛ si womi nɔ tsami 28.1—35.10
Yuda matsɛ, Hezekia kɛ Asiria bi ɔmɛ 36.1—39.8
Sɛ gbihi nɛ tsɔɔ si womi kɛ hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi 40.1—55.13
Kɔkɔ bɔmi kɛ si womi 56.1—66.24

Title: YESAYA 1
Content:
1 Sɛ gbihi nɛ kɔɔ Yuda kɛ Yerusalem a he nɛ a ngma ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ mi. Mawu je nina nɛ ɔmɛ kpo kɛ tsɔɔ Yesaya, Amoz bi ɔ, ngɛ Yuda matsɛmɛ, Uzia, Yotam, Ahaz, kɛ Hezekia a yi nɔ.
Mawu ka e ma a hɛ mi
2Yawɛ ke, “Hiɔwe kɛ zugba, nyɛɛ bu nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ dee ɔ tue! Jokuɛwi nɛ i tsɔse nɛ a wa a te si ngɔ si mi. 3Nahi le a tsɛ, nɛ tejihi hu le he nɛ a nɔ hyɛlɔ haa mɛ ní ngɛ. Se imi nitsɛ ye ma Israel ɔ, mɛɛ lɛɛ a li nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko; a juɛmi bɛ he.”
4Musu tloo nyɛ, nyɛ ma nɛ yayami sɔuu nyɛ peeɔ; nyɛ puɛ kulaa kɛ yayami peemi! Nyɛ he yayami ɔmɛ pee tlomi ha nyɛ! Nyɛ kua Yawɛ, Israel Mawu klɔuklɔu ɔ, nɛ nyɛ je e he kɛ ho se ya. 5Mɛni he je nyɛ ngɛ atuã tsɔe kɛ mwɔɔ ɔ? Nyɛ ngɛ hlae nɛ a gbla nyɛ tue fuu lo? Israel, o yi tsuo pee pa, nɛ o tsui gbɔjɔ. 6Kɛ je o yi mi kɛ ya su o nane si ɔ, pa sɔuu; he ko he ko be saminya. He komɛ kpɔ, he komɛ pee pa, pa momohi kɛ pa hehi. Pa amɛ ɔ, a tsɔɔ we; a fi we a nɔ, nɛ a to we a nɔ hulɔ.
7Nyɛ zugba a hɛ mi kpata; a sã nyɛ ma amɛ. Nibwɔhi ngɛ nyɛ zugba a ngɔe ngɛ nyɛ dɛ pani nya, nɛ a ngɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ hɛ mi kpatae. 8A si Yerusalem kɛ fɔ si mɔbɔmɔbɔ kaa ma nɛ ta sá e yi.
