E ngɛ kaa bulɔ tsu bi ko ngɛ wai ngmɔ mi, loo gba nɛ a ma ngɛ atlɛ ngmɔ mi. 9 Kaa Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ ha we nɛ wa ti ni komɛ a yi nɛ na wami ɔ, wa ko pee kaa Sodom kɛ Gomora.
10Yerusalem, nyɛ nɔ yeli ɔmɛ, kɛ nyɛ ma a mi bi ɔmɛ ngɛ kaa Sodom kɛ Gomora bi pɛ. Nyɛɛ bu nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ ngɛ nyɛ dee ɔ tue saminya. 11 Yawɛ ke, “Bɔ ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ nyɛ ngɔɔ kɛ ba haa mi ɔ, anɛ nyɛ susuɔ kaa i suɔ lo? To ɔmɛ nɛ nyɛ kɛ ba sãã bɔ, kɛ lohwe kpakpa amɛ a zɔ ɔ hiɛ tsɔ ha mi. Na kuhi, kɛ jijɔhi, kɛ akpakpohi a muɔ ba ti mi. 12Mɛnɔ de nyɛ ke ke nyɛ ma mi jami ɔ, nyɛɛ ngɔ ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ ba sã bɔ ha mi? Mɛnɔ de nyɛ ke nyɛ ba nyɛɛ ye sɔlemi we ɔ kpo ɔ nɔ? 13Se nami ko be he kaa nyɛ maa ngɔ nyɛ bɔ ɔmɛ kɛ ba hu. Nyɛ tsopa kɛ e he via nɛ nyɛ ngɛ sãe ɔ ngɛ fu jee kɛ ngɛ mi woe. I hla we nyɛ Nyɔhiɔhe nyami be ɔmɛ, nyɛ Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔmɛ, kɛ behi nɛ nyɛ peeɔ kpe kɛ jaa imi, nyɛ Mawu ɔ hu; yayamihi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ pee ɔ puɛ enɛ ɔmɛ tsuo. 14I sume nyɛ Nyɔhiɔhe nyami be ɔmɛ, kɛ Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔmɛ; enɛ ɔmɛ peeɔ haomi kɛ pɔtɔ ha mi.
15“Ke nyɛ wo nyɛ nine nɔ, nɛ nyɛ ngɛ sɔlee ɔ, i be nyɛ hyɛe; nyɛ nine he pee kɛ muɔ. 16Nyɛɛ du nyɛ he, konɛ nyɛ he nɛ tsɔ. Nyɛ kpa yayami nɛ nyɛ ngɛ pee nɛ ɔ nɛ ma jɔɔ hyɛmi. Ee, nyɛ kpa yayami peemi, 17nɛ nyɛɛ kase kpakpa peemi. Nyɛɛ ye dami sane; nihi nɛ a ngɛ mɛ yi mi wae ɔ, nyɛɛ ye a sane ha mɛ; nyɛ ha awusahi a blɔ nya níhi, nɛ nyɛɛ ye yalɔyihi a sane ha mɛ.”
18Yawɛ ke, “Jehanɛ, nyɛɛ ba nɛ wɔ tsuo wa susu he. Ke nyɛ he yayami ɔ tsu kaa mɛni po, ma ha e ma hiɛ futaa kaa snoo, loo jijɔ he bwɔmi. 19Ke nyɛ maa bu mi tue ɔ, lɛɛ nyɛ maa ye zugba a mi niba ní kpakpa. 20Se ke nyɛ kpale we, nɛ nyɛ tsɔ atuã a, lɛɛ nyɛ ma gbo ngɛ klaate nya. Imi, Yawɛ, lɛ i de.”
Ma nɛ mi hyi kɛ yayami peemi
21Ma nɛ sa a, e yeɔ anɔkuale ɔ, jehanɛ lɛɛ hyɛ, e ngɛ e ní pee kaa yaholɔ! Sa be ko ɔ, nimli nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da nɛ a hyi ma a mi tɔ, se jehanɛ lɛɛ awi yeli sɔuu lɛ piɛ ngɛ ma a mi. 22Yerusalem, mo nɛ be ko ɔ, o he jua wa kaa sika hiɔ ɔ, jehanɛ lɛɛ, o he be se nami ko kulaa; sa a, o ngɛ kaa dã kpakpa; se jehanɛ lɛɛ, o ngɛ kaa dã nɛ a tsa mi nyu. 23Atuã tsɔli ji o ganɔ ɔmɛ, nɛ juli ji o huɛmɛ; be tsuaa be ɔ, nike ní, kɛ nyɔ mi ní a ngɛ hee. A yi awusahi a sane ha we mɛ ngɛ sane yemi he, nɛ a bui yalɔyihi hu a sane tue.
24Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ta tue ha nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ, Israel Mawu, hewamitsɛ ɔ ngɛ dee ɔ: “Ma ye ye he lue ngɛ nyɛ he nyɛli ɔmɛ a nɔ, konɛ nyɛ ko ba gba ye nya hu. 25I kɛ nyɛ maa to ní. Ma tsu nyɛ he kaa a tsuɔ dade he, nɛ ma je nyɛ he mu ɔ tsuo. 26Ma ha nyɛ ma nimeli, kɛ ga woli kpakpahi kaa nihi nɛ hi si blema a. Ke enɛ ɔ ba mi ɔ, a ma tsɛ Yerusalem ke ma nɛ a yeɔ dami sane kɛ anɔkuale ngɛ mi.”
27Akɛnɛ dalɔ ji Yawɛ he je ɔ, e ma he Yerusalem yi wami, nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ nɛ ma tsake e tsui hu, a ma he e yi wami. 28Se nihi nɛ peeɔ yayami, nɛ tsɔɔ e hɛ mi atuã a, e ma kpata a hɛ mi; e maa gbe nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ kuaa lɛ ɔ.
29Nyɛ ma pia nyɛ he kaa nyɛ ya ja tso ngua amɛ, nɛ zo kpɔtɔɔ maa gbe nyɛ ngɛ abɔɔhi nɛ nyɛ po ɔ a he. 30Nyɛ ma gbo kaa tso nɛ e nɔ ba amɛ ylɔ, nɛ miɔ nɛ e gbo, loo kaa abɔɔ ko nɛ a pue we e mi ní ɔmɛ a nɔ nyu. 31Nihi nɛ a he wa a, a he yayami ɔmɛ ma kpata mɛ nitsɛmɛ a hɛ mi kaa bɔ nɛ la nɛ sɛ sulii sãã nga a. Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, nɔ ko nɔ ko be nyɛe maa tsi nya.

Title: YESAYA 2
Content:
Tue mi jɔmi nɛ maa hi si daa
(Mika 4.1-3)
1Sɛ gbi nɛ Mawu ngɔ ha Yesaya, Amoz bi ɔ, nɛ kɔɔ
Yuda kɛ Yerusalem a he ji nɛ ɔ nɛ:
2Hwɔɔ se ko ɔ, Yawɛ we ɔ maa ma yo gagaa ko yi mi;
yo nɛ ya hiɔwe gojoo pe yo ɔmɛ tsuo yi mi e maa ma.
Je ma amɛ tsuo ma bu yuu kɛ ba e he,
3nɛ a ma de ke,
“Nyɛ ha wa ya kuɔ Yawɛ yo ɔ
kɛ ya Israel Mawu ɔ sɔlemi we ɔ.
E maa tsɔɔ wɔ nɔ́ nɛ e suɔ kaa waa pee;
nɛ wa maa pee bɔ nɛ e maa tsɔɔ wɔ ɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Ejakaa Yawɛ ní tsɔɔmi ɔ, Yerusalem e jee;
e kɛ e ma a tuɔ munyu kɛ jeɔ Zion yo ɔ nɔ.”
4 Yawɛ maa hyɛ je ma amɛ a kpɛti sanehi a mi ha mɛ. E ma dla nihi babauu a kpɛti.
A kɛ a ta hwumi klaate ɔmɛ maa sɔ kpakplaahi,
nɛ a kɛ a we akplɔ ɔmɛ maa pee tso he suami hahi.
Je ma ko je ma ko be ta hwue kɔkɔɔkɔ;
a be a he dlae kɛ ha ta gblegbleegble hu.
5Jehanɛ, nyɛ Yakob nina, nyɛ ha waa nyɛɛ ngɛ la
nɛ Yawɛ ha wɔ ɔ mi!
A ma kpata he nɔ woli a hɛ mi
6Mawu lee, o kua o ma, Yakob nina a, ejakaa klaali babauu nɛ je beleku je kɛ Filistia ba futu mɛ. Ma se bi a kusumi níhi o ma a ngɛ pee. 7A zugba a nɔ hyi kɛ sika hiɔ kɛ sika tsu; a li a juetli ɔ nya. A we okpɔngɔ ɔmɛ hu hiɛ babauu, nɛ a ta zugba lɛ ɔmɛ hu a li nya. 8Amagahi hyi a zugba a nɔ; nɛ níhi nɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a ngɔ a nine kɛ pee ɔ, lɔ ɔmɛ a jaa.
9Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, moo ba a ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ si, nɛ zo nɛ gbe mɛ. Yawɛ koo ngɔ kɛ pa mɛ!
10 A ma ya laa a he ngɛ tɛ puɔhi a mi, aloo a maa tsua muɔhi, konɛ a laa a he kɛ je Yawɛ we abofu nɛ he wa a, kɛ e hɛ mi nyami ɔ nya! 11Be ma nɛ nɔmlɔ adesa he tsɔɔmi, kɛ e he nɔ womi tsuo a se maa po. Kɛkɛ ɔ, a ma wo Yawɛ pɛ nɔ gojoo. 12Jamɛ a be ɔ, Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ maa ba he walɔ tsuaa he walɔ si; e maa ba he wolɔ kɛ he nɔ wolɔ, tsuo si. 13E ma kpata Lebanon seda tso gagaa amɛ, kɛ Bashan tso ngua amɛ tsuo a hɛ mi. 14E maa ba yo gagaa amɛ, kɛ yoku tsɔwi ɔmɛ tsuo si; 15jã kɛ̃ mɔ tsuaa mɔ, kɛ gbogbo tsuaa gbogbo nɛ ngɛ mɔ ɔmɛ a he ɔ, e maa ba mɛ si. 16Spania lɛ nguaa amɛ kɛ a he fɛu ɔ tsuo e ma ha a ma mu. 17-18Nɔmlɔ adesa he tsɔɔmi, kɛ e he nɔ womi tsuo se maa po. Amagahi a se maa po kulaa; nɛ jamɛ a be ɔ, Yawɛ pɛ nɔ a ma wo gojoo.
19Nihi ma ya laa a he ngɛ tɛ puɔhi a mi ngɛ yo ɔmɛ a nɔ, aloo a maa tsua muɔhi, konɛ a laa a he ngɛ mi kɛ je Yawɛ we abofu nɛ he wa a, kɛ e hɛ mi nyami ɔ nya, ke e ba nɛ e ba mimiɛ zugba a. 20Jamɛ a be ɔ, ni ɔmɛ ma sake amaga amɛ nɛ a kɛ sika tsu kɛ sika hiɔ pee nɛ a ma ja a ngɔ hɛ fɔ he ha jesihi kɛ apanihi. 21Ke Yawɛ ba nɛ e ba mimiɛ je ɔ, nimli maa laa a he ngɛ tɛ puɔhi kɛ muɔhi a mi ngɛ yo ɔmɛ a nɔ kɛ je e abofu nɛ he wa a, kɛ e hɛ mi nyami ɔ nya.
22Nyɛ ko ngɔ nyɛ hɛ ngɔ fɔ nɔmlɔ adesa nɔ. Tlukaa kɛkɛ e mumi je e mi, nɛ e he be se nami hu.

Title: YESAYA 3
Content:
Haomi maa ba Yerusalem
1Bu tue! Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ be blɔ ngmɛe nɛ nihi nɛ a ba ye bua Yuda ma a, kɛ Yerusalem hu. E ma ha a niye ní, kɛ nyu maa ta. 2Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a hɛ mi ma kpata: katsɛmɛ, ta buli, kojoli, gbali, klaali, ma nimeli, 3asafoatsɛmɛ, nihi nɛ a hɛ mi ngɛ nyami, ma ní tsuli, kɛ kunya yeli kpanakuhi. 4Ma wo jokuɛwi nyumuwi ganɔhi ha mɛ, nɛ bimwɔwi maa ye a nɔ. 5A maa wa a sibi yi mi. Nihewi maa hyɛ nikɔtɔma hɛ mi, nɛ nihi nɛ bu be a he maa wo a he ha nihi nɛ a hɛ mi ngɛ nyami.
6Be ma, nɛ we puɔ nya ko bi maa hla a ti nɔ ko, nɛ a ma de lɛ ke, “Wa nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ hɛ mi kpata, se moo lɛɛ o ngɛ he ha nɔ́ ko, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ba pee wa tsɛ, nɛ o ye wa nɔ.”
7E ma he nɔ ke, “Kpaoo! I be nyɛe ma pee ja ha nyɛ. Imi hu, i be niye ní, nɛ i be heha ní hulɔ. Nyɛ ko wo mi nyɛ nyatsɛ!”
8Niinɛ, musu tloo Yerusalem! Yuda hɛ mi kpata! Ejakaa a deɔ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́, nɛ a peeɔ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ kɛ siɔ Yawɛ; a jee blɔ pueɔ Mawu nitsɛ hɛ mi si. 9A ní peepee yeɔ odase kɛ siɔ mɛ; ejakaa a jeɔ a hɛ mi paa kɛ peeɔ yayami kaa Sodom bi; a kɛ laa we. Musu tloo mɛ! Mɛ nitsɛmɛ nɛ a ye a he awi ɔ nɛ.
10Nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a, a bua maa jɔ, nɛ a nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ maa ya nɔ saminya. A maa ye a dengme gbomi mi ngɔɔmi. 11Se yayami peeli lɛɛ musu tloo mɛ; yayami nɛ a pee ní kpahi ɔ, jehanɛ, a ma ngɔ pee mɛ nitsɛmɛ.
12Jokuɛwi lɛ ngɛ ye ma a haoe, nɛ yihi lɛ ngɛ a nɔ yee.
Ye ma, o nɔ hyɛli ɔmɛ haa o tlaa blɔ, nɛ a tɔ̃tɔ̃ɔ̃ o nane.
Yawɛ ngɛ e ma a kojoe
13Yawɛ pee klaalo kaa e maa jaje e sane ɔ; e pee klaalo kaa e maa kojo e ma a. 14Yawɛ kɛ ma nimeli, kɛ ganɔ ɔmɛ lɛ na sane ɔ nɛ. Munyu nɛ e kɛ ba po a nya ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Nyɛ kpata wai ngmɔ ɔmɛ a hɛ mi, nɛ níhi nɛ nyɛ kpɔ ngɛ ohiatsɛmɛ a dɛ ɔ, nyɛ ngɔ kɛ to nyɛ wehi a mi. 15Nyɛ be he blɔ kulaa kaa nyɛ waa ye ma a yi mi, loo nyɛ yeɔ ohiatsɛmɛ amimi. Imi Nyɔmtsɛ Tabohiatsɛ Mawu ɔ, lɛ i de.”
A bɔ Yerusalem yi ɔmɛ kɔkɔ
16Yawɛ ke, “Hyɛ bɔ nɛ Yerusalem yi ɔmɛ ngɛ a he tsɔɔe ha! Ke a ngɛ nyɛɛe ɔ, a woɔ a hɛ mi nɔ kɛ hii kɔɔhiɔ mi fue. Basabasa peemi pɛ a suɔ be tsuaa be. A hiaa a nane bitibiti kɛ kɔsɔɔ, nɛ a nane si ga amɛ hii pɛe ngmleingmlei. 17Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ma gbla a tue. Ma ha sakpa ma pue a yi mi, nɛ a maa sɛ a yi ɔ kpalokpalo.”
18Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, afɛu níhi tsuo nɛ Yerusalem yi ɔmɛ kɛ dlaa a he: nane si ga amɛ, níhi nɛ a kɛ hɔɔ a yi mi, a kuɛ ga amɛ, 19a nine si ga amɛ, hɛ mi hami ní ɔmɛ, 20a pɛɛ ɔmɛ, sɛbɛhi nɛ a woɔ ngɛ a kɔni si kɛ a mlɛ mi ɔ, 21nine nguɛ ga amɛ, gugwɔ mi ga amɛ, 22he dlami tade ɔmɛ, tade klɔii ɔmɛ, tade gagaa amɛ, nɔha tade ɔmɛ, sika kpɛɛ ɔmɛ, 23kploba heha ní ɔmɛ, mele duku ɔmɛ, yi duku ɔmɛ, kɛ hɛ mi hami nɔ́ gagaa amɛ tsuo ɔ, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ma je ngɛ a he.
24Nu je via be hae nɛ a he maa je via hu, a he maa je fu mohu; tangme kpa titlii a kɛ maa fi a mlɛ mi, pi mlɛ mi fimi nɔ́ saminyawiiwi ɔmɛ hu; yi nɛ a hɔɔ saminyayoo ɔ maa pee kpalokpalo; a heha ní kpakpa amɛ ma plɛ pee tako piɛ; a he fɛu ɔ ma plɛ pee zo ha mɛ!
25A kɛ klaate maa gbe ma a mi nyumu ɔmɛ; a ti nihi nɛ ji katsɛmɛ tete po maa nɔ ngɛ ta mi. 26Ma a agbo ɔmɛ a nya maa pee mɔbɔmɔbɔ kɛ ya; nɛ ma a nitsɛ lɛɛ e maa pee kaa yo nɛ hɛɛ e he gu kɛ hii si ngɛ zugba.

Title: YESAYA 4
Content:
1Jamɛ a be ɔ, yihi kpaago ma ya nu nyumu kake nɛ a ma de lɛ ke, “Wa kpa mo pɛɛ, wɔ nitsɛmɛ wa maa lɛ wa he, nɛ wɔ nitsɛmɛ wa maa bɔ wa heha ní he mɔde, se ngmɛɛ wɔ blɔ nɛ wa tsɛ mo ke wa huno kɛkɛ, konɛ a ko ba bɔ wɔ ahlua hu.”
A maa fia Yerusalem ma a kɛ ma si ekohu
2Be ma, nɛ Yawɛ ma ha tso tsuaa tso ngɛ zugba a nɔ ɔ maa bɔ, nɛ e maa pee fɛu. Israel bi tsuo nɛ a yi ma na wami ɔ, a bua maa jɔ, nɛ a ma na gɛjɛmi ngɛ niba ní nɛ a ma na ngɛ zugba a mi ɔ he. 3Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa piɛ ngɛ Yerusalem, nɛ Mawu ma ha e yi ma na wami ɔ, a ma tsɛ lɛ nɔ klɔuklɔu. 4Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ kɛ e he wami maa kojo Zion biyi ɔmɛ, nɛ e maa tsu ma a he. E ma fɔ mu níhi, kɛ muɔ nɛ pue si ngɛ Yerusalem ɔ tsuo. 5 Kɛkɛ ɔ, Yawɛ maa ngɔ bɔku kɛ ba ha Zion yo ɔ, kɛ nihi tsuo nɛ ba kpe ngɛ lejɛ ɔ a nɔ; piani ɔ, Yawɛ ma ha bɔku maa wo, nɛ nyɔ mi ɔ, la su ku, kɛ la nɛ ngɛ kpɛe plamplam maa ba. Mawu hɛ mi nyami ɔ maa ha ma a tsuo nɔ. 6E hɛ mi nyami ɔ maa pee hɔ̃ ha ma a piani kɛ tsi pu la a nya, nɛ e maa pee wesa he ngɛ hiɔmi kɛ ahumi be mi.

Title: YESAYA 5
Content:
Wai ngmɔ he abɛ ɔ
1 Bu la nɛ i ngɛ lae ha mo nɛ ɔ tue;
la a kɔɔ ye huɛ ko kɛ e wai ngmɔ he.
Ye huɛ ɔ ngɛ wai ngmɔ ko
ngɛ yo zugba ko nɛ baa ní saminya nɔ.
2E hu zugba a nɔ, e je tɛhi nɛ ngɛ mi ɔ tsuo,
nɛ e du wai tso kpakpahi ngɛ mi.
E ma mɔ ko nɛ a maa hi mi kɛ bu ngmɔ ɔ he,
e tsua muɔ nɛ a maa nga wai yiblii kɛ wo mi.
E mlɛ kɛ ya si be nɛ wai yiblii ɔ fu;
se wai yiblii ɔmɛ tsuo dooɔ.
3Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ye huɛ ɔ de ke, “Nyɛ nihi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ Yerusalem kɛ Yuda, nyɛɛ hyɛ sane nɛ ngɛ i kɛ ye wai ngmɔ ɔ wa kpɛti ɔ mi ha wɔ. 4Anɛ nɔ́ ko pa ngɛ nɛ i tsu we ngɛ e he lo? Lɛɛ mɛni he je mɔ nɛ e wo yiblii nɛ dooɔ, se pi wai yiblii kpakpa nɛ i ngɛ blɔ hyɛe kaa e maa wo ɔ?
5“Bɔ nɛ ma pee ye wai ngmɔ ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: ma je piɛ ɔ, nɛ́ nga mi lohwehi nɛ ba ye wai yiblii ɔ; ma ku gbogbo nɛ bɔle lɛ ɔ, nɛ a ba naa nɔ. 6Ma ha nɛ ngmɔ ɔ mi nɛ hɛ. I be wai tso ɔmɛ a he sãe, nɛ ngmɔ ɔ mi hu i be hue. Nɔ́ nɛ ma pee mohu ji, ma ngmɛ blɔ nɛ mio tso, kɛ mio maa puɛ ngɛ ngmɔ ɔ nɔ. Pi lɔ ɔ kɛkɛ, se mohu i be hae nɛ hiɔmi nɛ nɛ ngɔ pue ngmɔ ɔ nɔ hu.”
7Israel ma a ji Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ wai ngmɔ ɔ nɛ;
Yuda bi ɔmɛ ji wai tso kpakpa amɛ
nɛ e du ɔ nɛ.
E hyɛ blɔ kaa a maa ye dami sane,
se muɔ si mohu a ngɛ puee.
E hyɛ blɔ kaa a maa pee nɔ́ nɛ da,
se amimi mohu a ngɛ ma a yee,
nɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ha ni ɔmɛ ngɛ ngmlaa kpae.
Yayamihi nɛ nimli adesahi peeɔ
8Musu tloo nyɛ! Wehi babauu, kɛ zugbahi nyɛ ngɛ hee kɛ ngɛ ní nɛmɛ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ momo ɔ a he piɛe. E be kɛe kulaa nɛ nɔ kpa ko be he ko nae maa hi hu, nɛ e maa piɛ nyɛ pɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ. 9I nu nɛ Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ de ke, “Wehi nɛ kle, nɛ a he ngɛ fɛu nɛ ɔ tsuo ma ba pee we dokuhi. 10Wai ngmɔ nɛ na nyɔngma ma hu ligbi kake ɔ ma ha wai yiblii bɔbɔyoo pɛ; nɛ wuhi nɛ a du ngɛ ngmɔ kpa nyɔngma mi ɔ, kpa kake pɛ nɔ yiblii a ma na ngɛ ngmɔ ɔ tsuo mi. A ma hu gbajaa nɛ a ma du ní fuu, se yiblii bɔbɔyoo pɛ a ma na kɛ maa je a dengme gbomi ɔ mi.”
11Musu tloo nyɛ! Nyɛ tee si makɛ mla, kɛkɛ nyɛ bɔni dã numi, nɛ gbɔkuɛ hu nyɛ hii si be fuu kɛ tɔɔ dã kpɔtɔɔ. 12Nyɛ tsɛɔ ní yemi nɛ nyɛ nuɔ dã; nyɛ fiaa saku, nɛ nyɛ nyaa; nyɛ kpaa bɛ, nɛ nyɛ hii miɛ. Se akɛnɛ nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ ngɛ pee ɔ lɛɛ nyɛ susuu we he kulaa he je ɔ, 13a maa nuu nyɛ nɛ a maa bɔ nyɛ pã kɛ ho ma se ya. Mi mi hwɔ maa gbe nyɛ ma nimeli ɔmɛ, nɛ kuma maa ye ni gu ɔmɛ kɛ yaa si a ma gbo. 14Hwɔ ngɛ gbeje yee, nɛ e gbɛ e nya mi hatoo nɛ e maa mii mɛ. E ngɛ Yerusalem odehe ɔmɛ, kɛ ni gu ɔmɛ nɛ a ngɛ hoo pee ɔ tsuo miie si kake too.
15Zo maa gbe ni ɔmɛ tsuo, nɛ a maa ba he woli tsuo si. 16Se Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ lɛɛ nɔ́ nɛ da pɛ e peeɔ kɛ tsɔɔ e we agbo jemi; nɛ e gblaa e ma a tue kɛ tsɔɔ kaa Mawu klɔuklɔu ji lɛ. 17Ke be ɔ su ɔ, jijɔhi ma kpe nga ngɛ ma doku ɔmɛ a mi, nɛ to akpakpo bihi hu ma na niye ní ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.
18Musu tloo nyɛ! Nyɛ ní yayami ɔmɛ fi nyɛ kaa kpa nɛ nyɛ nyɛ we nɛ nyɛɛ pɛne ngɛ nyɛ he. 19Nyɛ deɔ ke, “Nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ de ke e maa pee ɔ, ha nɛ e pee esɔ, konɛ waa na. Ha nɛ Israel Mawu klɔuklɔu ɔ nɛ tsu níhi nɛ e to e yi mi kaa e ma tsu ɔ; nyɛ ha nɛ waa hyɛ nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ e juɛmi mi.”
20Musu tloo nyɛ! Nyɛ tsɛɔ yayami ke kpakpa, nɛ nyɛ tsɛɔ kpakpa ke yayami. Nyɛ plɛɔ diblii kɛ peeɔ la, nɛ la hu peeɔ diblii. Nyɛ plɛɔ doomi kɛ peeɔ ngɔɔmi, nɛ nɔ́ nɛ ngɔɔ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ dooɔ.
21Musu tloo nyɛ! Nyɛ susu kaa nyɛ hɛ mi tɛ, nɛ nyɛ le ní saminya.
22Musu tloo nyɛ! Nyɛ nihi nɛ nyɛ peeɔ kã ngɛ dã tɔmi he! Ke e su dã nɛ nya wa futumi nɔ ɔ, kɛkɛ nyɛ he mi wa nyɛ. 23Nyɛ heɔ nyɔ mi ní ngɛ nihi nɛ ye fɔ a dɛ nɛ nyɛ ngmɛɔ a he; se nihi nɛ yi fɔ mohu lɛɛ nyɛ yi a sane ha we mɛ. 24Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Israel hɛ mi ma ba kpata pɛsɛpɛsɛ kaa bɔ nɛ la sãã hu kɛ nga gbigbli ɔ. Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ maa ba a nɔ, ejakaa a kua Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ mlaa amɛ. A yi Israel Mawu klɔuklɔu ɔ mlaa amɛ a nɔ. 25Yawɛ mi mi fu e ma a, nɛ e wo e nine nɔ, konɛ e gbla a tue. Yo ɔmɛ ma mimiɛ, nɛ ni gbogboehi ma pue si ngɛ blɔ ɔmɛ a nɔ kaa dwɔmi. Ke e ba ja po, Yawɛ mi mi fumi ɔ se be poe, se e nine nɛ e wo nɔ ɔ, ja e kɛ gbla a tue kokooko.
26Yawɛ pee okadi ko kɛ tsɛ ma ko kɛ je ma se lokoo. E kpa bɛ kɛ tsɛ mɛ kɛ je je ɔ nyagbe he ɔmɛ. O nɛ mɛ nɛ a ma kɛ fo esɔesɔ. 27Pɔ tɔɛ a ti nɔ ko nɔ ko he, nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko hu tɛ we si. A di kɔnɛɛ, nɛ a hwɔ we mahe. A mlɛ mi fimi níhi gbɔle we, nɛ a nane tokota kpa amɛ hu tsɔ we. 28A kɛ̃ɛ̃ mi bi ɔmɛ a nya ba, nɛ a dɔ a kɛ̃ɛ̃ ɔmɛ a mi, konɛ a tsɛ̃. A we okpɔngɔ ɔmɛ a nane kokloto ɔmɛ a he wa kaa tslɛbo, nɛ a ta zugba lɛ ɔmɛ a nane kla amɛ ngɛ a he poe kɛ fo kaa lasiogblee. 29Ta buli ɔmɛ hwɔ hoo kaa jatahi nɛ a gbe lohwe ko nɛ a ngɛ huãe ngɛ he, nɛ a kɛ yaa he nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be nyɛe ma kpɔ ngɛ a dɛ.
30Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, a ma hwɔ hoo kɛ wo Israel kaa wo nɛ gli. Ke nɔ ko hyɛ zugba a nɔ ɔ, e maa na kaa e nɔ wo diblii. E pee gbeye kɛ aywilɛho. E nɔ wo diblii kpii; la ko be.

Title: YESAYA 6
Content:
Mawu tsɛ Yesaya ke e ba pee gbalɔ
1 Jeha a nɛ Matsɛ Uzia gbo ɔ, i na Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nɛ hii si ngɛ e matsɛ sɛ gojoo ko nɔ. E tade klɔii ɔ nya wuyaa a hyi Yawɛ we ɔ tsuo. 2Serafhi bɔle lɛ. A ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ ngɛ pɛli ekpa. Eko tsuaa eko ngɔ pɛli enyɔ ngɔ ha e hɛ mi, nɛ e ngɔ enyɔ hu ngɔ ha e he, nɛ enyɔ nɛ piɛ ɔ, e kɛ te. 3 A ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ ngɛ e sibi dee boboobo ke,
“Klɔuklɔu, klɔuklɔu, klɔuklɔu!
Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ ngɛ klɔuklɔu!
E hɛ mi nyami ɔ hyi je ɔ tsuo.”
4 A gbi ɔ ha nɛ Yawɛ we ɔ sisi tomi ɔ mimiɛ, nɛ la su ku hyi Yawɛ we ɔ nitsɛ tɔ.
5Kɛkɛ nɛ i de ke, “Akuanyɛ! Ye yi ta pɛ! Ejakaa i na matsɛ ɔ nɛ ji Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ! Ye nya mi munyu he tsɔ we; nɛ nimli nɛ i ngɛ a kpɛti ɔ, mɛ hu a nya mi munyu he tsɔ we ja nɔuu!”
6Tlukaa a, seraf ɔ kake te kɛ ba ye ngɔ kɛ e dɛ mi la ngu hɛuu nɛ e kɛ abɛɛle ya kɔ ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ. 7E ngɔ la ngu hɛuu ɔ ngɔ sa ye nya he nɛ e de ke, “Hyɛ, nɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ sa o nya he nɛ ɔ, a ngɔ o he yayami ɔmɛ ngɔ pa mo, nɛ piami ko be o he hu.”
8Jehanɛ, i nu nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ bi ke, “Mɛnɔ ma tsɔ? Mɛnɔ maa ya?”
I he nɔ ke, “I ngɛ hiɛ ɔ, Moo tsɔ mi!”
9 Kɛkɛ nɛ e de mi ke ma ya nɛ ma ya de ma a ke, “Nyɛ maa bu tue, se nyɛ be sisi nue; nyɛ maa hyɛ, se nyɛ be se kɔe.” 10E ya nɔ nɛ e de mi ke,
“Ha nimli nɛ ɔmɛ a tsui nɛ ti;
a tue nɛ wa,
nɛ a hɛngmɛ hu nɛ ma,
bɔ nɛ pee nɛ a hɛngmɛ ko hyɛ nɔ́,
nɛ a tue hu ko nu nɔ́,
konɛ a ko nu nɔ́ sisi,
nɛ a ba kpale kɛ ba nɛ a tsa mɛ.”
11I bi ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, nɔ́ nɛ ɔ maa ya nɔ kɛ yaa si mɛni be?”
E he nɔ ke, “Kɛ yaa su be nɛ ma amɛ a hɛ mi ma kpata, nɛ a maa pee ma dokuhi nɛ a be nɔ ko nɔ ko nae ngɛ we ɔmɛ a mi, nɛ zugba a nitsɛ hu nɔ maa je gu. 12Ma ha a maa je zugba a nɔ kɛ ya tsitsaa he ko, nɛ zugba a tsuo nɔ maa je gu. 13Ke nɔ kake pɛ nɛ maa piɛ ngɛ ni nyɔngma mi po, lɛ hu a ma kpata e hɛ mi; e maa pee kaa tso ngua ko nɛ a po, nɛ e piɛ tso kpɔ ɔ kɛkɛ.”
(Tso kpɔ nɛ ɔ daa si ha Mawu ma he ɔ sisi jemi.)

Title: YESAYA 7
Content:
Sɛ gbi nɛ a kɛ ya ha Matsɛ Ahaz
1 Ta ba te si benɛ Uzia bibi Ahaz, Yotam bi ɔ ngɛ matsɛ yee ngɛ Yuda a. Lɔ ɔ ji kaa Siria matsɛ, Rezin kɛ Remalia bi Peka, Israel matsɛ ɔ, ba tua Yerusalem; se a nyɛ we nɛ a ngɔ ma a.
2Benɛ Yuda matsɛ ɔ nu kaa Siria ta a ba sɛ Israel zugba a mi momo ɔ, e kɛ e ma mi bi ɔmɛ tsuo ye gbeye wawɛɛ nitsɛ, nɛ a he do blibliibli kaa tsohi nɛ ngɛ mimiɛe ngɛ kɔɔhiɔ nya.
3Yawɛ de Yesaya ke, “Yaa nɛ o kɛ Matsɛ Ahaz ya kpe; ngɔɔ o bi Shear Yashub ngɔ piɛ o he kɛ ya. O maa na lɛ ngɛ gbɛjegbɛ ɔ nɔ ngɛ bo loli a ní tsumi he ɔ, he nɛ nyu dɔ nɛ gblaa nyu kɛ jee pa a nɛ ngɛ yiti je ɔ nya ya ta ngɛ ɔ. 4De lɛ ke e ko ye Matsɛ Rezin, kɛ Siria bi ɔmɛ, kɛ Matsɛ Peka gbeye. A mi mi fumi ɔ ngɛ kaa la tso enyɔ nɛ a ngɛ tsoe tikɔɔ kɛkɛ. 5Siria, Israel, kɛ Remalia bi ɔ ya so ngɔ wo o he. 6A to a yi mi kaa a ma ba tua Yuda, nɛ a maa wo ni ɔmɛ a he gbeye, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ a kɛ mɛ nɛ pee kake. Kɛkɛ ɔ, a maa wo Tabeel bi ɔ matsɛ.
7“Se imi Yawɛ, i ngɛ hae nɛ nyɛɛ le kaa enɛ ɔ be mi bae kɔkɔɔkɔ. 8Mɛni he je? Ejakaa Siria he wɛ pi Damasko nɛ ji e matsɛ ma a, nɛ Damasko he wɛ pi Rezin. Israel lɛɛ hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ jeha nyingmi ekpa kɛ enuɔ ɔ, a ma kpata e hɛ mi butuu, bɔ nɛ e be nyɛe maa da si kaa ma hu. 9Israel he wɛ pi Samaria nɛ ji e matsɛ ma a, nɛ Samaria hu he wɛ pi Matsɛ Peka.
“Ke nyɛ he we yi ɔ, nyɛ yi be wami nae.”
Yimanuel he okadi ɔ
10Yawɛ kɛ sɛ gbi kpa mane Ahaz ke, 11“Bi Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ ke e ha mo okadi ko. E ma nyɛ maa je gbeje lokoo, loo hiɔwe tsitsaa kɛ ba.”
12Se Ahaz he nɔ ke, “I be okadi ko bie. I be Yawɛ kae.”
13Yesaya he nɔ ke, “Matsɛ David nina, jehanɛ bu tue. E ji nɔ́ yayami kaa o maa hao nimli adesahi hluu kɛ yaa si a tsui si tomi maa ta. Anɛ o ngɛ hlae nɛ o hao wa Mawu ɔ hu ja kɛ yaa si e tsui si tomi maa ta lo? 14 Yoo, i nu. Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nitsɛ ma ha nyɛ okadi ko; yiheyo ko maa ngɔ hɔ, nɛ e ma fɔ binyumu, nɛ e maa wo lɛ biɛ ke, ‘Yimanuel’. 15Loko e hɛ ma fã nɛ e maa le kpakpa kɛ yayami a kpɛti slɔɔto ɔ, ma a mi bi ɔmɛ ma ná na nyɔ nyu maa nu, nɛ a ma na hwo maa ye ekohu. 16Jamɛ a be ɔ be sue tete po nɛ matsɛmɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ nyɛ he gbeye woe ɔ a zugba amɛ a nɔ maa je gu.
17“Yawɛ ma ha haomi be ko ma ba na mo, kɛ o ma mi bi ɔmɛ, kɛ matsɛ weku ɔ tsuo. Kɛ je be nɛ Israel kɛ Yuda mi gba nɛ ɔ, be yaya kaa enɛ ɔ eko bɛ hyɛ. Asiria matsɛ ɔ ji haomi nɛ Yawɛ maa ngɔ kɛ ba a nɛ.
18“Ke jamɛ a be ɔ su ɔ, Yawɛ ma kpa bɛ kɛ tsɛ Egipt kɛ Asiria bi ɔmɛ. Egipt bi ɔmɛ ma bu kɛ je pa amɛ a nya kɛ ba babauu kaa anunuhi, nɛ Asiria bi ɔmɛ hu maa je a zugba a nɔ ja nɔuu kaa hwo bihi. 19A ma ba pue si ngɛ kɔ̃ voovoo ɔmɛ, kɛ tɛ puɔ ɔmɛ a mi, nɛ a maa ha si ngɛ mio tso ɔmɛ a sisi, kɛ lohwe lɛmi he ɔmɛ tsuo.
20“Jamɛ a be ɔ, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ma ya ba asoyi ngɛ Yufrate pa a se kɛ ba. E kɛ ma ba sɛ nyɛ yi bwɔmi, kɛ nyɛ nane he bwɔmi, nɛ a maa sɛ nyɛ kpɛni hulɔ. Asiria matsɛ ɔ ji asoyi ɔ nɛ.
21“Ke jamɛ a be ɔ su ɔ, ke ngmɔ hulɔ ko ngɛ na yo kake, kɛ to enyɔ pɛ ɔ, 22e ma ná nyɔ nyu fuu nɛ maa su e hiami ní tsuo nya. Niinɛ, nihi bɔɔ nɛ a yi ma na wami, nɛ maa piɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ ɔ ma ná na nyɔ nyu maa nu, kɛ hwo nɛ a maa ye.
23“Jamɛ a be ɔ, hehi tsuo nɛ wai tso akpe hi sa a, nɛ a he jua peeɔ sika hiɔ yi akpe ɔ, lejɛ ɔ tsuo ma plɛ pee pú, kɛ mio tsohi sɔuu. 24Nihi maa hɛɛ kɛ̃ɛ̃, kɛ kɛ̃ɛ̃ mi bi kɛ ya da de ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Niinɛ, zugba a nɔ tsuo ma hyi kɛ pú, kɛ mio tsohi sɔuu. 25Yo ɔmɛ a nɔ hehi nɛ a huɔ sa a lɛɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be lejɛ ɔ yae, ejakaa hu, kɛ mio maa puɛ ngɛ nɔ. Zugba a maa pee tohi, kɛ nahi a niye he.”

Title: YESAYA 8
Content:
Yesaya binyumu maa da si kaa okadi ha ma a
1Jehanɛ, Yawɛ de mi ke, “Yaa hla nɔ́ nɛ a ngmaa ní ngɛ nɔ agbo ko, nɛ o ngma ní agbohi ngɛ nɔ. Ngmaa ke, ‘Puɛ ní esɔ; haa ní kɛ fo.’ 2Ngɔɔ nihi enyɔ nɛ a buu mɛ saminya kɛ pee odase yeli. Mɛ ji Uria, kɛ Zakaria, Yeberekia bi ɔ.”
3Pee se ɔ, i kɛ ye yo, gbalɔyo ɔ na bɔmi. E ngɔ hɔ nɛ e fɔ binyumu. Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ de mi ke, “Wo lɛ biɛ ke, ‘Puɛ ní esɔ, haa ní kɛ fo.’ 4Loko bi nɛ ɔ maa le ‘Maa’ loo ‘Tsaatsɛ’ demi ɔ, Asiria matsɛ ɔ ma ba muɔ Damasko sika tsuo, kɛ Samaria ta yibu ní tsuo kɛ ho.”
Asiria matsɛ ɔ ma
5Yawɛ kɛ mi tu munyu ekohu. 6E ke, “Akɛnɛ ma nɛ ɔ sume Shiloa pa a nɛ mi nyu ɔ bee dii ɔ, se Matsɛ Rezin kɛ Matsɛ Peka mohu he a he ngɛ doe ngɛ ɔ, 7imi Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nitsɛ, ma ngɔ Asiria matsɛ ɔ, kɛ e ta a tsuo kɛ ba tua Yuda. Ta a ma ba tua mɛ kaa bɔ nɛ Yufrate pa a hyiɔ ywiaa nga nɛ e haa zugba a nɔ ɔ. 8He nyɛli ɔmɛ ma ba gu Yuda zugba a nɔ kaa pa nɛ hyi ywia nga kɛ su nɔ konɔ tɔɔ, nɛ e ha nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɔ.”
Mawu kɛ wɔ ngɛ! E bli e pɛlihi a mi kɛ ngɛ zugba a he bue.
9Nyɛ je ma amɛ, nyɛɛ ye gbeye, nɛ nyɛ bua nyɛ he nya! Nyɛ nihi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ tsitsaa hu, nyɛɛ bu tue. Nyɛɛ mia kɛ ha ta, se kɛ̃ ɔ, nyɛɛ ye gbeye! Ee, nyɛɛ mia, se kɛ̃ ɔ, nyɛɛ ye gbeye! 10Nyɛɛ to nyɛ ga amɛ! Se a maa pee yaka. Nyɛ de nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ suɔ! Se enɛ ɔmɛ tsuo maa pee yaka, ejakaa Mawu kɛ wɔ ngɛ.
Yawɛ bɔ gbalɔ ɔ kɔkɔ
11Yawɛ kɛ hɛdɔ bɔ mi kɔkɔ ke ma ko nyɛɛ ni ɔmɛ a blɔ ɔ nɔ. E ke, 12 “Koo piɛ ni ɔmɛ a he kɛ to a ga amɛ, nɛ níhi nɛ mɛɛ a yee gbeye ɔ, koo ye gbeye. 13O hɛ nɛ hi nɔ kaa imi Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ, i ngɛ klɔuklɔu; imi ji nɔ nɛ sa kaa o ye gbeye. 14 Ma plɛ pee he ko nɛ ngɛ klɔuklɔu; ma pee tɛ nɛ maa tsi mo blɔ. Se Israel kɛ Yuda bi ɔmɛ ɔ, ma pee tɛ sa nɛ maa tsɛ̃ mɛ kɛ ko si; nɛ ma pee klama nɛ maa du nihi nɛ a ngɛ Yerusalem. 15Nihi babauu ma tɛ nɔ nɛ a maa nɔɔ si, nɛ a hɛ mi ma kpata. A maa tsɔ mɛ klama, nɛ a maa du.”
A bɔ ma a kɔkɔ ke a ko tsɛ kpade
16Sɛ gbihi nɛ Mawu ngɔ ha mi ɔ, nyɛ, ye kaseli ɔmɛ, nyɛɛ hyɛ a nɔ saminya, konɛ a hi si daa. 17 Yawɛ ngɔ e hɛ mi ngɔ laa e ma a, se imi lɛɛ i heɔ yeɔ, nɛ i ngɔ ye hɛ ngɔ fɔ e nɔ.
18 Nyɛ nɛ mi, kɛ ye bimɛ ɔmɛ nɛ Yawɛ ke mi ɔ. Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ nɛ e matsɛ sɛ ngɛ Zion yo ɔ nɔ ɔ tsɔ wɔ ke waa ngɔ sɛ gbi nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ ba ha Israel ma a.
19Se ni komɛ de nyɛ ke nyɛ ya bi ní ngɛ klaali, kɛ ní peeli nɛ kpaa nyagba, nɛ a tuɔ gugwɔ mi gbi ɔ a ngɔ. A ma de ke, “E pee we nɔ́ ko; e sa kaa a ya bi ní ngɛ mumihi a ngɔ, nɛ a nu nɔ́ ko nɛ kɔɔ hɛ ngmengmletsɛmɛ a he kɛ je kpadehi a ngɔ.”
20Ke a de nyɛ ja a, nyɛ he nɔ ke, “Nyɛɛ bu nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ ngɛ nyɛ tsɔɔe ɔ tue! Nyɛ ko bu ní peeli tue. Níhi nɛ a deɔ nyɛ ɔ, a he be se nami.”
Haomi be ko ma
21Ni komɛ maa wo lalaalo ngɛ zugba a nɔ; hwɔ maa ye mɛ, nɛ a ní maa pee mɔbɔ. Mi mi fumi, kɛ hwɔ nɛ ngɛ mɛ yee he je ɔ, a maa gbiɛ a matsɛ ɔ, kɛ a mawu ɔmɛ. A ma wo a yi nɔ kɛ hyɛ hiɔwe, 22aloo a ma kɔkɔ a yi si kɛ hyɛ zugba mi gaa, se a be nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko nae kaa ja haomi kɛ diblii kpii nɛ woɔ nɔ he gbeye nɛ a ngɛ mɛ fiee kɛ ngɛ mi woe.

Title: YESAYA 9
Content:
1 He ko he ko be nɛ a maa gu kɛ je haomi nɛ ɔ mi.
Matsɛ nɛ ma hwɔɔ se ɔ
Zebulun kɛ Naftali wɛtso ɔmɛ a zugba nɛ be ko mi a pue e hɛ mi si ɔ, hwɔɔ se ɔ, a maa wo e hɛ mi nyami ngɛ zugba nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a nɔ: kɛ je Mediterenia wo ɔ beleku je kɛ yaa su Yordan pa a se, kɛ yaa su Galilea nitsɛ, he nɛ nibwɔhi hii ɔ.
2 Ma nɛ hi diblii kpii mi ɔ
na la kpetekpleenyɛ ko.
A hi zugba ko nɛ nɔ wo diblii kpii nɔ,
se jehanɛ lɛɛ la ngɛ kpɛe ha mɛ.
3Yawɛ, o ha nɛ ma a bɔ,
nɛ o ha mɛ bua jɔmi babauu.
A ngɛ nyae ngɛ o hɛ mi
kaa nihi nɛ ngɛ ngmɔ ní kpae,
loo nihi nɛ ngɛ ta yibu ní dlae ha a he.
4Ejakaa lohwe kuɛpã tso
nɛ jiɔ kaa tlomi ngɛ a nɔ,
kɛ to tsɔ̃mi tso nɛ a kɛ fiaa a konɔ
kɛ wa mɛ yi mi ɔ, o ku a mi
kaa bɔ nɛ blema a
o pee Midian bi ɔmɛ ɔ.
5Ta buli nɛ ma wɔ tuami ɔ,
a tokota amɛ, kɛ a tade ɔmɛ
nɛ muɔ sɛ mi ɔ,
a kɛ la maa sã lɛ tsuo,
kaa lɛ́ ngɛ la mi.
6Ejakaa a fɔ bi ha wɔ!
A ha wɔ binyumuyo!
Lɛ nɛ e ma ba ye wa nɔ.
A ma tsɛ lɛ ke,
“Nyakpɛ ga wolɔ,”
“Mawu he walɔ,”
“Tsɛ nɛ ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene,”
“Ganɔ nɛ yi nɔ jɔ.”
7 E nɔ yemi ɔ ma he si, nɛ e maa bɔ;
ma a ma na tue mi jɔmi daa,
ejakaa e maa ye tsɛ kaa Matsɛ David
nitsɛ se yelɔ.
E maa pee kpakpa, nɛ e maa ye dami sane,
kɛ maa je be nɛ ɔ mi
kɛ yaa su je mi nyagbe.
Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ kɛ hɛdɔ
ma tsu ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo.
Yawɛ maa gbla Israel tue
8Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ bu Yakob nina, Israel ma a fɔ. 9Israel bi tsuo nɛ ngɛ Samaria ma a mi ɔ, a ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ ma na maa le kaa lɛ nɛ e tsu nɔ́ nɛ ɔ nɛ. Amlɔ nɛ ɔ lɛɛ, a ngɛ a he nɔ woe; a ngɛ pupuupu pee. A ngɛ dee ke, 10“Bliikisi we ɔmɛ ku pue si; wɔɔ lɛɛ wa maa ngɔ tɛ nɛ a kó kɛ maa ma ekohu. A poo sikamore tsohi ngɔ pueɔ si; se wɔɔ lɛɛ waa kɛ seda tso kpakpahi ma tsake mɛ.”
11Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, Yawɛ sú a he nyɛli ɔmɛ kɛ wo mɛ. 12Siria ngɛ beleku je, nɛ Filistia ngɛ bonyoku je. A pa a nya mi hatoo, konɛ a mii Israel. Enɛ ɔ tsuo se ɔ, Yawɛ mi mi fumi ɔ se be poe kɛ yaa si e ma kpata a hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ.
13Israel bi ɔmɛ kpale we kɛ bɛ Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ ngɔ. E ngɛ mi kaa e gbla a tue bɔ nɛ sa lɛɛ, 14lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ligbi kake too ɔ, Yawɛ gbla Israel ma a tue. E po mɛ ngɔ hɛɛ fɔ, yi kɛ hlemi tsuo. 15Nikɔtɔmahi, kɛ nihi nɛ a buu mɛ ji yi ɔ nɛ; nɛ lakpa gbali ɔmɛ ji hlemi ɔ nɛ. 16Nihi nɛ nyɛɛ ma a hɛ mi ɔ ha ma a laa blɔ, nɛ a pee basaa. 17Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ na we nihewi ɔmɛ a he bua jɔmi. Yalɔyi ɔmɛ, kɛ awusa amɛ hu e mɛ nɛ mɔbɔ; ejakaa ni ɔmɛ tsuo li Mawu; a pee a he yiwutsotsɛmɛ, nɛ munyu yaya pɛ a tuɔ. Enɛ ɔ tsuo he ɔ, Yawɛ mi mi fumi ɔ se be poe kɛ yaa si e ma kpata a hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ.
18Ma a yi wu tso ní peemi ɔ nya wa kaa la nɛ ngɛ mio tso hue, kɛ miohi sãe. E ngɛ tsoe kaa hue nɛ ngɛ sãe, nɛ la su ku ngɛ jee titiiti kɛ yaa hiɔwe. 19Akɛnɛ Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ mi mi fu he je ɔ, e tue gblami ɔ nya wa kaa la nɛ ngɛ nimli tsuo a hɛ mi kpatae ngɛ zugba a nɔ. Nɔ tsuaa nɔ ngɛ lɛ nitsɛ e wami he plee. 20O maa na nɛ nihi ngɛ ní gblɔe hiɔ kɛ muɔ, nɛ a ngɛ yee tsuatsuaatsua, se a tɔɛ gblee. Mɛ nitsɛmɛ a bimɛ po, a ngɛ yee! 21Manase bi, kɛ Efraim bi maa hwu ta, nɛ lɔ ɔ se ɔ, a ma bua kɛ wo Yuda he. Enɛ ɔ tsuo se ɔ, Yawɛ mi mi fumi ɔ se be poe kɛ yaa si e ma kpata a hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ.

Title: YESAYA 10
Content:
1Musu tloo nyɛ! Nyɛ nɛ nyɛ woɔ mlaahi nɛ dɛ, nɛ nyɛ ngmaa mlaahi nɛ nyɛ kɛ waa ye ma a yi mi. 2Jã nyɛ peeɔ kɛ kpɔɔ ohiatsɛmɛ a blɔ nya níhi ngɛ a dɛ, nɛ nyɛ yi dami sane ha we mɛ. Jã nyɛ peeɔ kɛ kpɔɔ yalɔyihi kɛ awusahi a weto ní ngɛ a dɛ. 3Ke Mawu bɔni nyɛ tue gblami ɔ, kɛ nyɛ maa pee kɛɛ? Ke e ngɔ haomi kɛ je ma se kɛ ba na nyɛ ɔ, kɛ nyɛ maa pee kɛɛ? Mɛnɔ ngɔ nyɛ ma sa fo kɛ ya ya hla yemi kɛ buami? Jije nyɛ maa ngɔ nyɛ juetli kɛ to? 4Nɔ́ nɛ maa ba nyɛ nɔ ji, nyɛ maa nɔ ngɛ ta mi, aloo a maa nuu nyɛ kɛ ho kaa pamitsɛmɛ. Enɛ ɔ tsuo se ɔ, Yawɛ mi mi fumi ɔ se be poe kɛ yaa si e ma kpata a hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ.
Mawu maa ngɔ Asiria matsɛ ɔ kɛ gbla e ma a tue
5 Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ de ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Asiria, o ngɛ kaa to tsɔmi tso ko nɛ i kɛ gblaa nihi nɛ woɔ ye mi mi la a a tue. 6I tsɔ Asiria bi ɔmɛ ke a ya tua ma ko nɛ li Mawu, ma nɛ wo ye mi mi la a. I tsɔ mɛ ke a ya ha ní, nɛ a kpɔ níhi pani nya; nɛ a naa ni ɔmɛ a nɔ kaa mɔsɔ ngɛ blɔ mi.”
7Se Asiria matsɛ ɔ lɛɛ e to yi mi kpa mohu. E to kaa e ma kpata je mahi babauu a hɛ mi. 8E fĩaa nɛ e deɔ ke, “Anɛ ye tatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, pi matsɛmɛ ji mɛ tsuo lo? 9Kalno ma a, kɛ Karkemish ma a nɛɛ, mɛni slɔɔto ngɛ a kpɛti? Anɛ Hamat ma a be kaa Arpad ma a lo? Samaria kɛ Damasko ɔ nɛɛ, slɔɔto ko ngɛ a kpɛti lo? 10Jamɛ a nɔ yemi he ɔmɛ kɛ a mi amagahi nɛ hiɛ kulaa pe amagahi tsuo nɛ ngɛ Yerusalem kɛ Samaria a, pi imi nɛ i gbla mɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ a tue lo? 11Bɔ nɛ i kpata Samaria, kɛ e we amaga amɛ tsuo a hɛ mi ɔ, anɛ i be nyɛe ma pee Yerusalem, kɛ amaga amɛ nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ hu jã lo?”
12Se Yawɛ ke, “Ke i gbe nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ tsue ngɛ Zion yo ɔ nɔ, kɛ Yerusalem ɔ nya a, ma gbla Asiria matsɛ ɔ tue ngɛ e he nɔ womi, kɛ e fiami babauu ɔ he.”
13Asiria matsɛ ɔ ngɛ fĩae nɛ e ngɛ dee ke, “Imi nitsɛ lɛ i tsu ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo. Ye he wa, i le ní, nɛ i to ga saminya. I ye zugba a tsuo nɔ, nɛ i gbɛ ma amɛ a huzu ɔmɛ tsuo ngɛ je ma amɛ a kpɛti; nɛ níhi nɛ a bua nya ngɔ to ɔ, i ngɔ. I ngɔ ye he wami nɛ i kɛ ye ma a mi bi ɔmɛ a nɔ. 14Je ma amɛ a juetli ɔ pee kaa lohwe pɛlitsɛ tsu nɛ ye nine ya su nɔ. Kaa bɔ nɛ a muɔɔ hlui nɛ a je he ɔ, ja i bua je ɔ tsuo nya. Lohwe ko fiɛ pɛli mi ɔ, i nui eko kuɛ si, loo pɛmi po.”
15Se nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ ngɛ bie ji, “Anɛ gbiɛ ma nyɛ maa fĩa ke e kle pe nɔmlɔ nɛ ngɔ lɛ kɛ ngɛ ní tsue ɔ lo? Anɛ sau ma nyɛ maa wo e he ha nɔ nɛ ngɛ lɛ gblae ɔ lo? Tsa pi dɛma tso nɛ hɛɛɔ nɔmlɔ; nɔmlɔ mohu nɛ hɛɛɔ dɛma tso. To tsɔmi tso ɔ, lɛ nitsɛ e fɔ we e he; nɔ ko nɛ fɔɔ lɛ.”
16Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ maa ngɔ hiɔ kɛ gbla ta buli nɛ je oblai ɔ tsuo a tue. A maa ta he lo. La ko ma mle ngɛ a nɔmlɔ tso mi, nɛ la nɛ ɔ maa tso wawɛɛ. 17Mawu nɛ ji la kɛ ha Israel ɔ ma mle. Mawu klɔuklɔu ha Israel ɔ ma mle kɛ la, nɛ ligbi kake too mi ɔ, e maa sã nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́; e maa sã mio ɔmɛ, kɛ mio tso ɔmɛ tsuo. 18Hue kpakpa amɛ, kɛ ngmɔhi nɛ baa ní saminya a, a hɛ mi ma kpata pɛsɛpɛsɛ kaa bɔ nɛ gbenɔ hiɔ kpataa nɔmlɔ adesa hɛ mi ɔ. 19Tsohi bɔɔ pɛ maa piɛ ngɛ hue ɔ mi, nɛ jokuɛ nɛ wɛ po ma nyɛ maa kane mɛ.
Nihi bɔbɔyoo pɛ maa kpale kɛ ba
20Jamɛ a be ɔ, Israel bi nɛ a yi na wami ɔ be a hɛ ngɔe kɛ fɔ ma a nɛ ka a hɛ mi kpatami ɔ nɔ hu. A maa ngɔ a hɛ kɛ fɔ Yawɛ, Israel Mawu klɔuklɔu ɔ nɔ kulaa. 21Israel ma a mi nihi bɔbɔyoo pɛ maa kpale kɛ ba a Mawu kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ ngɔ ekohu. 22 E ngɛ mi kaa amlɔ nɛ ɔ, Israel ma a mi bi ɔmɛ a he hiɛ babauu kaa wo nya zia lɛɛ, se nihi bɔbɔyoo pɛ nɛ maa kpale kɛ ba. A fa nɛ a kpata ma a hɛ mi, nɛ jã pɛpɛɛpɛ nɛ e sa mɛ. 23Nɔ́ jemi ko be he kaa Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ ma kpata zugba a tsuo hɛ mi kaa bɔ nɛ e de ke e maa pee ɔ.
Yawɛ maa gbla Asiria tue
24Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, bɔ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ ngɛ e ma nɛ ngɛ Zion ɔ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Nyɛ ko ye Asiria bi ɔmɛ gbeye; ke kaa a ngɛ nyɛ yi mi wae kaa bɔ nɛ Egipt bi ɔmɛ pee be ko ɔ po, nyɛ ko ye mɛ gbeye. 25Ma gbla nyɛ tue be bɔɔ ko kɛkɛ, nɛ lɔ ɔ se ɔ, ma kpata a hɛ mi. 26Imi Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ nitsɛ ma fia mɛ kpa kaa bɔ nɛ i pee Midian bi ɔmɛ ngɛ Oreb tɛ sa a he ɔ. Ma gbla Asiria tue kaa bɔ nɛ i gbla Egipt tue ɔ. 27Jamɛ a be ɔ, ma je Asiria tlomi ɔ kɛ je nyɛ nɔ, nɛ ma ku kuɛpã tso ɔ nɛ e kɛ wo nyɛ kuɛ ɔ.”
He nyɛlɔ ɔ ba tua ma amɛ
28He nyɛli ɔmɛ a ta a je Rimon ba ngɔ Ai ma a! Ta a ya gu Migron! A kɛ a tlomi ɔmɛ ya to si ngɛ Mikmash! 29A gu yo kpɛ blɔ ɔ kɛ ya hwɔ Geba nyɔ mi! Nihi nɛ a ngɛ Rama ma a mi ɔ ye gbeye, nɛ Matsɛ Saul ma, Gibea bi ɔmɛ ma fo. 30Galim bi, nyɛ kpa ngmlaa! Laisha bi, nyɛɛ bu tue! Nyɛ he nɔ koo, nyɛ Anatot bi! 31Nihi nɛ ngɛ Madmena, kɛ Gebim ma amɛ a mi ɔ ma fo kɛ je gbenɔ nya. 32He nyɛli ɔmɛ ngɛ Nob ma a mi mwɔnɛ ɔ, nɛ a ma kɔ̃ kɛ ngɛ Zion yo ɔ, kɛ Yerusalem ma a tsɔɔe.
33Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ maa ngɔ mɛ ngɔ koo si kaa bɔ nɛ tso kɔnihi nɛ a poo ngɛ tso ɔ he nɔɔ si ɔ. Ni nɛmɛ nɛ wo a he nɔ gojoo pe kulaa a, a maa poo mɛ ngɔ pue si, nɛ a hɛ mi hu ma pue si. 34Yawɛ maa poo mɛ pue si kaa bɔ nɛ a kɛ gbiɛ poo tsohi ngɛ hue mi ɔ; a maa nɔɔ si haa bum kaa bɔ nɛ Lebanon tso kpakpahi nɔɔ si ɔ!

Title: YESAYA 11
Content:
Matsɛ yemi nɛ tue mi jɔmi ngɛ mi
1 Ishai, Matsɛ David tsɛ ɔ weku kpa ngɛ kaa tso ko nɛ a po ngɔ fɔ si. Se matsɛ he maa te si ngɛ David nina a mi kaa bɔ nɛ tso kpɔ nɛ ngɛ zu mi tsɛ̃ɔ kɔni ɔ.
2Yawɛ mumi ɔ maa ba e nɔ.
E ma ha lɛ sane se kɔmi, nile, kɛ ga
nɛ e kɛ maa ye e ma a nɔ.
E maa le Yawɛ suɔmi nya ní,
nɛ e maa bu lɛ.
3E maa ye Yawɛ gbeye.
Pi nɔ́ nɛ e hɛngmɛ na,
loo e tue nu ɔ nɛ e kɛ maa kojo.
4 Se e kɛ dami sane yemi maa kojo ohiatsɛmɛ,
nɛ e maa bu nihi nɛ
a ní ngɛ mɔbɔ ɔ a he.
Ke e fa ke a gbla nɔ ko tue ɔ,
kɛkɛ a maa gbla e tue.
Ke e fa ke a gbe yayami peelɔ ko ɔ,
kɛkɛ pe a gbe lɛ ɔ nɛ.
5 Dami sane yemi, kɛ anɔkuale yemi
ji níhi nɛ e kɛ maa ye ma a nɔ.
6 Ogbetee kɛ jijɔ maa hi si ngɛ he kake,
nɛ ngatsɛ kɛ apletsi bɔbɔyoo maa bu si ngɛ he kake.
Na bi kɛ jata bi ma bla kɛ ye ní,
nɛ jokuɛ wayoo pɛ maa hyɛ a nɔ.
7Na yo kɛ osisiblisi ma bla kɛ ye ní;
a bimɛ maa bu si ngɛ he kake,
nɛ jata ma kpe nga kaa na.
8Bimwɔyo po ma fiɛ ngɛ sinɔ muɔ nya,
nɛ bi nɛ je nyɔ nya kɛ e nine maa wo
sinɔ duɔtsɛ muɔ mi.
9 Nɔ ko nɔ ko be e nyɛmi awi yee ngɛ ye yo klɔuklɔu ɔ nɔ,
nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be e nyɛmi hɛ mi kpatae.
Ejakaa zugba a tsuo maa le Yawɛ
kaa bɔ nɛ wo hyi tɔ kɛ nyu ɔ.
Nihi nɛ a nuu kɛ ho ma se ya a maa kpale kɛ ba
10 Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, matsɛ he nɛ je Ishai powu ɔ mi ɔ maa da si kaa okadi ko ha je ma amɛ. A ma bua a he nya kɛ maa ba e matsɛ ma a mi, nɛ a ma ba wo e hɛ mi nyami. 11Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ma tsu ní kɛ he wami; e maa kpale e ma mi bi ɔmɛ nɛ piɛ ngɛ zugba nɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ ɔ kɛ maa ba we ekohu. A maa je Asiria, Egipt, Patros, Sudan, Elam, Babilonia, Hamat, kɛ mahi nɛ ngɛ wo nya a kɛ ba. 12Yawɛ maa si aflangaa kɛ pee okadi kɛ tsɔɔ je ma amɛ kaa Israel, kɛ Yuda ma amɛ nɛ a gbɛ fĩa je ɔ mi tsuo ɔ, e ngɛ a nya buae ekohu, konɛ e kpale mɛ kɛ ba we. 13Israel, Efraim nina a kɛ Yuda be nɔ́ he plee hu; nɛ Yuda be Israel nya dooe hu. 14Jehanɛ lɛɛ, a maa pee kake kɛ ya tua Filisti bi ɔmɛ ngɛ bonyoku je; nɛ a maa ha nihi nɛ ngɛ beleku je ɔ a níhi. A maa ye Edom kɛ Moab bi ɔmɛ a nɔ kunimi, nɛ Amon bi ɔmɛ hu maa ba a he si ha mɛ. 15 Yawɛ ma kpata Egipt pa kɔni nɛ a tsɛɛ ke Suez ɔ hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ. E ma ha nɛ ahlabata kɔɔhiɔ maa fia ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, nɛ pa a ma gba maa pee pa tsɔwi kpaago, bɔ nɛ ke nɔ wo tokota po e ma nyɛ kɛ po. 16Gbɛjegbɛ ko maa je Asiria kɛ ha Israel ma a mi bi nɛ a ngɛ je mi kɛ mwɔɔ ɔ, konɛ a nyɛɛ nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ a nɛmɛ ɔmɛ nyɛɛ zugba gbigbli nɔ, benɛ a je Egipt zugba a nɔ kɛ ma a.

Title: YESAYA 12
Content:
Sina la
1Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, nyɛ ma la ke,
“Yawɛ i ngɛ o yi jee!
Be ko ɔ, o mi mi fu mi,
se jehanɛ lɛɛ
mo nitsɛ o ngɛ mi bua woe,
ejakaa o mi mi fumi ɔ se po.
2 Mawu ji ye yi wami helɔ;
ma ngɔ ye hɛ ngɔ fɔ e nɔ,
nɛ i be gbeye yee.
Yawɛ Mawu ɔ ji nɔ nɛ haa mi
he wami kɛ nyɛmi,
lɛ nɔuu ji ye yi wami helɔ.
3Ke Mawu he e ma a yi wami ɔ,
a bua maa jɔ kaa bɔ nɛ
ke nɔ nu nyu mua nɛ e tsui he jɔɔ ɔ.”
4Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, ma a ma la nɛ a ma de ke,
“Nyɛɛ na Yawɛ si!
Nyɛɛ wo e biɛ ta!
Nyɛ ha je ma amɛ tsuo nɛ le níhi nɛ e pee ɔ!
Nyɛ ha nɛ a le kaa Yawɛ kle!
5Nyɛ la kɛ je Yawɛ yi,
ejakaa e tsu ní nguanguahi.
Nyɛ ha je ɔ tsuo nɛ nu nɔ́ nɛ ɔ.
6Nyɛ nihi tsuo nɛ nyɛ ngɛ Zion,
nyɛ hwɔ lele nɛ nyɛ la kɛ bua jɔmi.
Ejakaa Mawu kle,
Mawu klɔuklɔu ji Israel Mawu ɔ
nɛ kɛ nyɛ ngɛ ɔ nɛ.”

Title: YESAYA 13
Content:
Mawu maa gbla Babilon tue
1 Sɛ gbi nɛ kɔɔ Babilon tue gblami he nɛ Mawu ngɔ ha Yesaya, Amoz bi ɔ, ngɛ nina mi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
2Nyɛɛ si aflangaa ngɛ yo kpataa ko nɔ. Nyɛ kpa ngmlaa kɛ tsɛ ta buli ɔmɛ; nyɛɛ fɔ mɛ nine kɛ pee okadi ha mɛ ke a ya tua odehe ɔmɛ a ma a, nɛ a sɛ agbo ɔmɛ a mi. 3Yawɛ tsɛ e ta buli katsɛmɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ e ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ, konɛ a gbla ni nɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ a he nɔ woe kɛ ngɛ e mi mi la woe ɔ a tue.
4Nyɛɛ bu tue, a ngɛ hoo pee ngɛ yo ɔmɛ a nɔ; nihi babauu lɛ a ngɛ hoo pee nɛ ɔ nɛ. Niinɛ, je mahi, kɛ nɔ yemihi ngɛ a he nya buae. Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ ngɛ e tabo ɔmɛ miae kɛ ha ta. 5A je tsitsaa je mi nyagbe he ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ ma. Yawɛ kɛ e mi mi fumi ɔ ma kpata zugba a tsuo hɛ mi.
6 Nyɛ kpa bubuubui! Yawɛ ligbi ɔ su jehanɛ. Ligbi nɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ ma kpata níhi a hɛ mi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. 7Nɔ tsuaa nɔ he mi maa po, nɛ sawale maa nu lɛ. 8A maa ye gbeye; nɛ a he mi maa hia mɛ kaa yo nɛ nu kɔɔmi. Gbeye ma ha a maa hi a sibi a hɛ mi hyɛe gaa kɛkɛ, nɛ a hɛ mi maa tsu paa kɛ zo kpɔtɔɔ. 9Yawɛ ligbi ɔ nɛ ngɛ gbeye ɔ ma; a maa na e mi mi fumi nɛ nya wa a, kɛ e hɛdɔ ɔ. Je ɔ tsuo hɛ mi ma kpata; a ma kpata yayami peelɔ tsuaa yayami peelɔ hɛ mi. 10 Dodoe tsuaa dodoe, kɛ dodoe kuu ɔmɛ nɛ a ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ be kpɛe hu. Ke pu je po, diblii maa wo, nɛ nyɔhiɔ hu be kpɛe.
11Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ ngɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Ma ha amanehlu maa ba je ɔ mi tsuo, nɛ ma gbla yiwutsotsɛmɛ tsuo a tue ngɛ a yayami ɔmɛ a he. Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ woɔ e he nɔ ɔ, ma ba lɛ si; nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ peeɔ pupuupu, aloo e yi mi wa a, ma gbla e tue. 12Nihi nɛ a yi ma na wami ɔ, a he be hiɛe kulaa; nimli adesahi a he maa hia pe sika tsu ngmingmiingmi. 13Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ nɛ imi Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ ma je ye mi mi fumi ɔ kpo kɛ tsɔɔ ɔ, ma ha hiɔwe tsuo ma mimiɛ, nɛ zugba a maa je e blɔ he.
14“Nibwɔhi nɛ ngɛ Babilon ɔ maa ma fo kɛ ho mɛ nitsɛmɛ a zugbahi a nɔ ya; a maa gbɛ fĩa kaa odabɔhi nɛ ngɛ fo tue kɛ je de dali a blɔ mi, loo kaa tohi nɛ be hyɛlɔ. 15Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ a maa nu ɔ, a kɛ dade maa gbe lɛ. 16A maa ngɔ a bimwɔwi ngɔ fiaa si, nɛ a ma gbo; a maa ha a we mi níhi, nɛ a maa pee a yi ɔmɛ basabasa ngɛ a hɛ mi paa.”
17Yawɛ ngɛ dee ke, “Ma ha nɛ Media bi ɔmɛ ma ba tua Babilon. Media bi ɔmɛ lɛɛ a bui sika hiɔ, nɛ a hɛ kɔɛ sika tsu nɔ. 18A kɛ a kɛ̃ɛ̃ ɔmɛ maa gbe nihewi. Bimwɔwi ngɛ a nyɛmɛ a mi mi po, a be mɛ mɔbɔ nae, nɛ jokuɛwi hu, a be a he bee. 19 Babilonia nɔ yemi ɔ ji nɔ yemi ko nɛ hɛ mi ngɛ nyami pe kulaa; nɛ lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e mi bi ɔmɛ fĩaa. Se imi Yawɛ, ma kpata Babilon hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ kaa bɔ nɛ i pee Sodom kɛ Gomora a! 20Nɔ ko nɔ ko be lejɛ ɔ hie hu. Arabia no nɛ ngɛ lalaalo woe po be e bo tsu mae ngɛ lejɛ ɔ gblegbleegble; nɛ to hyɛlɔ ko hu be e to ɔmɛ tsɔ̃e kɛ ya ye ní ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. 21 Se nga mi lohwehi maa bu si ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, nɛ a we ɔmɛ a mi ma hyi tɔ kɛ lohwehi nɛ ngɛ pɛe hoo. Lejɛ ɔ ji he nɛ dugumahi maa bu si ngɛ, nɛ nibɔ níhi kɛ a he gbeyegbeye: yi je kaa nɔmlɔ, kɛ a nane kaa lohwe maa do ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. 22Ogbeteehi maa hi pɛe ngɛ a mɔ ɔmɛ a mi, kɛ nga mi gbehi hu ngɛ a tsu saminyawiiwi ɔmɛ a mi. Babilon be ɔ su jehanɛ. Be bɔbɔyoo pɛ nɛ piɛ ha lɛ; e ligbi ɔmɛ a nya ta.”

Title: YESAYA 14
Content:
Ma a maa kpale kɛ je ma se kɛ ba we
1Yawɛ maa na e ma Israel mɔbɔ ekohu, nɛ e ma ná a he tsui kaa lɛ nitsɛ e ma. E maa to mɛ si ngɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a zugba nɔ. Nibwɔhi ma ba to mɛ, nɛ a kɛ mɛ maa hi si. 2Je ma amɛ maa ngɔ Israel bi ɔmɛ kɛ ba zugba nɛ Yawɛ ha mɛ ɔ nɔ ekohu, nɛ a ma ba sɔmɔ mɛ kaa nyɔguɛhi. Nihi nɛ nuu Israel nyɔguɛ sa a, jehanɛ lɛɛ Israel hu maa ye a nɔ.
Babilonia matsɛ ɔ ngɛ gbeje
3Be ma nɛ aywilɛho, haomi, kɛ ní tsumi kpakpataa nɛ a nyɛ o nɔ nɛ o tsu ɔ, Yawɛ ma ha lɛ tsuo se maa po. 4Ke Yawɛ pee enɛ ɔ, nyɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ hu nyɛ maa ye Babilonia matsɛ ɔ he fɛu ke,
“Matsɛ yiwutsotsɛ ɔ nɔ si! E be nɔ ko nɔ ko yi mi wae hu. 5Yawɛ ku nɔ yeli yaya amɛ a he wami nya la. 6Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ abofu nɛ nya wa fiaa je ma amɛ ní, nɛ a nɛ mɛ mɔbɔ kulaa; je mahi nɛ a ye a nɔ ɔ hu, a wa mɛ yi mi wawɛɛ nitsɛ nɛ he jɔɔmi ko be mi. 7Jehanɛ lɛɛ je ɔ tsuo na he jɔmi kɛ tue mi jɔmi, nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ ngɛ lae kɛ bua jɔmi. 8Tso nguaa amɛ, kɛ seda tso ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ Lebanon ɔ po ngɛ nyae ke, ‘Matsɛ ɔ kpa sɛ; nɛ nɛ́ e be nɛ ɔ, nɔ ko be nɛ ma ha nɛ a poo wɔ hu!’
9“Babilonia matsɛ, gbeje pee klaalo nɛ e ma he mo atuu. Ni nguahi nɛ hi je mi hyɛ ɔ a kpade ɔmɛ ngɛ si poe. Matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a kpade ɔmɛ ngɛ si tee ngɛ a matsɛ sɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ. 10Mɛ tsuo a ngɛ mo dee ke, ‘Jehanɛ lɛɛ mo hu o gbɔjɔ kaa wɔ! Waa kɛ mo sɔ! 11Sa a, kpa sakuhi a kɛ laa kɛ woɔ o hɛ mi nyami; se jehanɛ lɛɛ o su gbeje. Wɔyewɔyehi ji sa nɛ o hwɔɔ si ngɛ nɔ, nɛ gɔgɔhi ji kuutu nɛ ha o nɔ.’
12 “Babilonia matsɛ, mo nɛ́ o ngɛ kaa nɔkɔ nɛ kpɛɔ hleii makɛ ɔ, o je hiɔwe ba nɔ si bum! Be ko nɛ be ɔ, o ye mahi a nɔ kunimi, se jehanɛ lɛɛ a tsɛ̃ mo ko si. 13 O to o yi mi kaa o maa kuɔ kɛ ya hiɔwe lokoo nɛ o kɛ o matsɛ sɛ ɔ ya ma Mawu dodoe ɔmɛ nɛ ya hiɔwe pe kulaa a a se tɔɔ. O susu kaa o maa hi si kaa matsɛ ngɛ jamɛ a yo ɔ nɔ, ngɛ omleyi je he nɛ a kpee ngɛ ɔ. 14O de hu ke o maa kuɔ kɛ ya bɔku ɔmɛ a yi mi tɔɔ; nɛ o maa pee o he kaa Tabohiatsɛ ɔ nitsɛ. 15Se mohu ɔ, a ba mo si kɛ ho gbeje he nɛ mi kuɔ pe kulaa a ya.
16“Ni gbogboe ɔmɛ maa pa a nya mi hatoo maa hi mo hyɛe gaa. A ma bi ke, ‘Nɔ nɛ mimiɛ je ɔ, nɛ e ha nɛ nɔ yemihi a he do blibliibli ɔ, anɛ pi lɛ ji nɛ ɔ lo? 17Nɔ nɛ kpata mahi a hɛ mi, nɛ e ha je ɔ he tsuaa he plɛ pee nga kplanaa nɔ ɔ, pi lɛ ji nɛ ɔ lo?’ 18Je ma amɛ a matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsuo hwɔɔ si kɛ hɛ mi nyami ngɛ yɔkɔ agbohi a mi, 19se moo lɛɛ o be yɔkɔ ɔ eko kulaa; a sake o gbogboe ɔ ngɔ fɔ he, konɛ e sa. Nihi nɛ nɔ ngɛ ta mi ɔ, a gbogboe ɔmɛ ha o nɔ; a sake o kɛ mɛ tsuo kɛ pue tɛ muɔ ko mi kaa gbogboe nɛ a naa nɔ. 20Akɛnɛ o kpata o zugba a hɛ mi, nɛ o gbe mo nitsɛ o ma mi bi ɔmɛ he je ɔ, a be mo pue kaa matsɛmɛ kpa amɛ. Nyɛ ko ha nɛ nimli, yayami peeli nɛ ɔmɛ a nina ko yi nɛ na wami. 21Nyɛɛ hyɛ nɛ nyɛɛ gbe a bimɛ ɔmɛ; nyɛ bɔni a hɛ mi kpatami koo! Matsɛ ɔ binyumu ɔmɛ ma gbo ngɛ a nɛmɛ ɔmɛ a he yayami ɔmɛ a he. Ke pi ja a, a ma ba te si ekohu; a maa ye je ɔ nɔ, nɛ a maa po mahi ha a he.”
Mawu ma kpata Babilon hɛ mi
22Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ ke, “Ma ya tua Babilon ma a, nɛ ma kpata e hɛ mi. E biɛ maa laa. E ngmɛdu kɛ e nina tsuo a ti nɔ ko nɔ ko yi be wami nae. Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de. 23Ma ha Babilon ma plɛ pee zugba nɛ tɔ nyu, kɛ ablɛgogoehi a hi he. Ma kpata Babilon hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ. Babilon maa pee kaa ma nɛ a bɛɛ mi, nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be mi hie hu. Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de.”
Mawu ma kpata Asiria bi ɔmɛ a hɛ mi
24 Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ ka kita ke, “Nɔ́ nɛ i to kaa ma pee ɔ maa ba mi ja. Nɔ́ nɛ i to ye yi mi kaa ma tsu ɔ, ma tsu kokooko. 25Ma kpata Asiria bi ɔmɛ a hɛ mi ngɛ ye ma Israel zugba a nɔ, nɛ ma naa a nɔ ngɛ ye yo ɔmɛ a nɔ. Ma je ye ma a kuɛ kɛ je kuɛpã tso nɛ Asiria bi ɔmɛ kɛ wo lɛ ɔ mi; nɛ tlomi nɛ a ha ye ma a tloo ɔ hu, ma je ngɛ a nɔ. 26Bɔ nɛ i to ye yi mi ha je ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ, nɛ i wo ye kɔni nɔ konɛ ma gbla ma amɛ a tue.” 27Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ pee e yi mi kaa e ma tsu nɔ́ nɛ ɔ; e wo e kɔni nɔ momo ke e maa gbla a tue, nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be nyɛe maa tsi e nya.
Mawu ma kpata Filisti bi ɔmɛ a hɛ mi
28 Jeha nɛ Matsɛ Ahaz gbo ɔ nɛ a fiɛ sɛ gbi nɛ ɔ.
29 Filistia bi, nyɛ bua ko jɔ kulaa kaa tso nɛ a kɛ fiaa nyɛ ɔ mi ku. Ke sinɔ kake gbo ɔ, ekpa nɛ e duɔ nya wa pe kekle nɔ́ ɔ ba yeɔ e nane mi. Sinɔ hlui ko ma pɛ, nɛ sinɔ pɛlitsɛ maa je mi. 30Yawɛ ma ha ohiatsɛmɛ a bimɛ ɔmɛ niye ní, nɛ e ma ha nɛ nɔ́ nali maa hi si ngɛ tue mi jɔmi mi. Se nyɛ Filisti bi ɔmɛ lɛɛ e ma ha hwɔ nɛ nya wa maa ye nyɛ; hwɔ nɛ ɔ maa gbe nyɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ nɛ e be nɔ kake ngmelu po piɛe.
31Nyɛ Filisti ma amɛ tsuo, nyɛ kpa ngmlaa! Nyɛ tsuo nyɛ tsui nɛ po! Ejakaa la su ku ko je omleyi je kɛ ma. Tabo ko nɛ fɔ̃lɔ ko fɔ̃lɔ ko be mi nɛ ma a nɛ.
32Mɛni heto wa ma ha tsɔli ɔmɛ nɛ je Filistia kɛ ba a? Wa ma de mɛ ke Yawɛ to Zion sisi saminya, nɛ e ma a nɛ ngɛ amanehlu nae ɔ, a tue mi maa jɔ mɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.

Title: YESAYA 15
Content:
Mawu ma kpata Moab hɛ mi
1 Sɛ gbi nɛ kɔɔ Moab he ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. Nyɔ kake too mi ɔ, a kpata Ar kɛ Kir a hɛ mi, kɛkɛ nɛ Moab zugba a nɔ tsuo jɔ. 2Dibon bi ɔmɛ kuɔ yo ɔ, nɛ a ya wo yana ngɛ a jami he ɔmɛ. Moab bi ɔmɛ wo yana kɛ nyɛ ya ha Nebo kɛ Medeba. A sɛ a yi, kɛ a kpɛni tsuo kɛ ye kɔmɔ. 3A bu kpekpe ya bo kɛ nyɛɛ gbɛjegbɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ a wo yana ngɛ ma kpe he ɔmɛ kɛ a tsu ɔmɛ a yi mi. 4Heshbon kɛ Eleale bi ɔmɛ wo yana nɛ a fo boboobo. A nu huhui ɔ ngɛ Yahaz tɔɔ. Sawale nu Moab ta buli ɔmɛ, nɛ a he ngɛ doe blibliibli. 5Ye tsui ngɛ yee ngɛ Moab he! Ma mi bi ɔmɛ tu fo kɛ ho Zoar, kɛ Eglat Shelishiya ma amɛ a mi ya. Ni komɛ kuɔ yoku ɔ kɛ ho Luhit ya, nɛ ni komɛ hu tu fo kɛ ho Horonaim ya kɛ ya boboobo, kɛ kɔmɔ yemi babauu. 6Nimrim pa a mii ta, nɛ nga nɛ ngɛ pa a nya a gbli; nɔ́ mumu ko kulaa be lejɛ ɔ hu. 7Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ni ɔmɛ ngɔ a weto ní tsuo kɛ tu fo kɛ gu Pamploo kɔ̃ ɔ mi kɛ ho kɔ̃ ɔ se ya. 8A nu yana a boboobo ngɛ Moab huzu ɔmɛ tsuo a nɔ. A nu ngɛ Eglaim kɛ Beerelim ma amɛ a mi hulɔ. 9Dibon pa a pee tsutsuu kɛ muɔ sɔuu. Se Mawu to yayami nɛ pe enɛ ɔ po ha nihi nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Nihi nɛ a he maa je mi, nɛ maa piɛ ngɛ Moab zugba a nɔ ɔ, haomi maa ba a nɔ kaa nɔ́ nɛ jata lɛ ba tua mɛ.

Title: YESAYA 16
Content:
Moab ní pee mɔbɔ
1Moab bi ɔmɛ tsɔ nihi kɛ je Sela nga kplanaa a nɔ kɛ a dɛ mi to ke a kɛ ya ha nɔ yelɔ ɔ ngɛ Yerusalem. 2Moab bi yi ɔmɛ ya pue si ngɛ Arnon pa a pomi he ɔmɛ kaa lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ nɛ a fie mɛ kɛ je a tsuhi a mi.
3A de Yuda bi ɔmɛ ke, “Wa ngɛ nyɛ dɛ mi; nyɛɛ wo wɔ ga koo. Wa maa hi nyɛ ngɔ nɛ nyɛɛ baa wa yi kaa bɔ nɛ tso woɔ hɔ kudɔɔ ngɛ e sisi piani katakata a. Pe a fie wɔ, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ ngɔ wɔ ngɔ to; nyɛ ko tsɔɔ wa se blɔ. 4Nyɛɛ baa wa yi, nyɛ ha waa hi nyɛ ngɔ, nɛ nyɛ ko ngɔ wɔ kɛ wo nihi nɛ ngɛ hlae nɛ a kpata wa hɛ mi ɔ a dɛ mi.”
Yi mi wami, kɛ hɛ mi kpatami se maa po, nɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ a ngɛ zugba a hɛ mi kpatae ɔ be si hie hu. 5Jehanɛ David nina ko ma ba ye matsɛ. Anɔkuale yemi kɛ suɔmi e kɛ maa ye ma a nɔ. E maa pee nɔ́ nɛ da; nɛ e maa ye dami sane.
6Yuda bi ɔmɛ ma he nɔ ke, “Wa nu kaa Moab bi ɔmɛ woɔ a he nɔ wawɛɛ; a peeɔ pupuupu, nɛ a bui nɔ, se a fiami ɔ ya peeɔ nya mi gu fiami.”
7Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Moab bi ɔmɛ maa wo yana ngɛ amanehlu nɛ a maa na a he. Mɛ tsuo a maa wo yana, ke a kai niye ní kpakpa amɛ nɛ a ye be ko nɛ be ngɛ Kir Heres ɔ. Nɛ a maa pee yeyeeye. 8Ejakaa a kpata Heshbon ngmɔ ɔmɛ, kɛ Sibma wai tso ɔmɛ a hɛ mi. Je ma amɛ a nɔ yeli ɔmɛ ku tso kɔni ɔmɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ tsuo kɛ ya su Yazer, kɛ ya kpa nga kplanaa a nɔ tsuo; kɔni ɔmɛ gba kɛ ya su Ngo wo ɔ se tɔɔ. 9Amlɔ nɛ ɔ lɛɛ, i ngɛ ya foe ha Sibma wai ngmɔ ɔmɛ kaa bɔ nɛ i fo ha Yazer ɔ. Ye vo nyu ɔmɛ ngɛ si puee ngɛ Heshbon kɛ Eleale ma amɛ a he; ejakaa ngmɔ ɔmɛ a hɛ mi kpata, nɛ ní kpali a ngmlaa hoo hu se po. 10Jehanɛ lɛɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko bua jɔɛ e he ngɛ ngmɔhi nɛ baa ní saminya a a nɔ hu. Nɔ ko nɔ ko kpa we ngmlaa; nɔ ko nɔ ko la we ngɛ wai ngmɔ ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko ngɛ̃ wai kɛ ji wai yiblii mi hu. Lele hwɔmi ngɛ ngmɔ ɔmɛ a nɔ ɔ tsuo se po. 11I ngɛ ya foe kɛ ngɛ kɔmɔ yee ha Moab; nɛ ye tsui ngɛ yee ngɛ Kir Heres he. 12Moab bi ɔmɛ ngɛ dengme gboe kɛ ngɛ a jami he ɔmɛ yae ngɛ yo ɔmɛ a nɔ; a ngɛ a gba tsu ɔmɛ a mi yae ya ngɛ kue fae, se lɛ tsuo maa pee yaka.
13Sɛ gbi nɛ Yawɛ ngɔ ha momo nɛ kɔɔ Moab he ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. 14Nɛ jehanɛ lɛɛ Yawɛ ke, “Hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ jeha etɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ ɔ, ní nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ Moab ná, kɛ ma a mi nimli babauu ɔ tsuo hɛ mi ma kpata, nɛ nihi nɛ a yi ma na wami be nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko sue; pohu a ma gbɔjɔ.”

Title: YESAYA 17
Content:
Mawu maa gbla Siria kɛ Israel tue
1 Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ de ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Damasko be ma nitsɛ pee hu; e ma ba pee ma doku kulaa. 2Nimli be Siria ma amɛ a mi hie gblegbleegble hu. Lejɛ ɔmɛ maa pee tohi kɛ nahi a ní yemi he; nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be lohwe nɛ ɔmɛ fiee. 3Israel be lɛ nitsɛ e he nyɛe ma fa hu, nɛ Damasko nɔ yemi ɔ se maa po. Siria bi nɛ a yi ma na wami ɔ, zo maa gbe mɛ kaa Israel bi ɔmɛ nɔuu. Imi, Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ lɛ i de.”
4Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ de ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Be ma nɛ Israel hɛ mi nyami ɔ tsuo maa ta; sa a, a ná ní kpɔtɔɔ, se jehanɛ lɛɛ a maa ye ohia. 5Israel zugba a maa pee kaa ngmɔ nɛ a kpɔ e nɔ blɛfo tsuo ta, loo kaa bɔ nɛ Refaim kɔ̃ ɔ mi peeɔ falifali ke a kpɛte ní ta lejɛ ɔ. 6Nihi bɔɔ pɛ nɛ a yi ma na wami. Israel maa pee kaa oliv tso nɛ a kplɔ e nɔ yiblii tsuo: yiti je ɔ, yiblii enyɔ loo etɛ kɛkɛ lɛ maa hi tso kɔni ɔmɛ a he; sisi ɔ hu eywiɛ, loo enuɔ kɛkɛ. Imi Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ lɛ i de.”
7Jamɛ a be ɔ, nihi maa kpale kɛ ba a bɔlɔ, Israel Mawu klɔuklɔu ɔ ngɔ kɛ ba hla yemi kɛ buami. 8Jehanɛ lɛɛ bɔ sami la tɛhi nɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a puɛ ɔ, a be mɛ bue hu. Níhi nɛ a kɛ a nine pee, amagahi nɛ a puɛ ha yo mawu nɛ a tsɛɛ Ashera a, kɛ la tɛhi nɛ a sãã tsopa kɛ e he via ngɛ a nɔ ɔ, a be mɛ hu bue.
9Jamɛ a be ɔ, nihi nɛ a ngɛ mahi nɛ a fia gbogbo ngɔ wo a he ɔ a mi po ma si a ma amɛ ngɔ fɔ si. Ma amɛ maa pee ma dokuhi, kaa bɔ nɛ Hiv bi kɛ Amon bi tu fo kɛ je a ma amɛ a mi, benɛ a na Israel ta a nɛ ma mɛ tuami ɔ.
10Israel Mawu ɔ nɛ kpɔ mo kɛ je o he nyɛli a dɛ mi, nɛ e pee kaa tɛ sa nguaa ko ha mo ɔ, o hɛ je e nɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, o ngɛ ngmɔhi nɛ ngɛ fɛu pee, nɛ o ngɛ ma se tsohi due ngɛ a mi. 11Se ke tso ɔmɛ ma tsɛ̃, nɛ a ma gba mɔmɔ jamɛ a ligbi ɔ mɔtu ɔ kɛ̃ nɛ o du mɛ ɔ po, o be yiblii ko kulaa náe. Haomi kɛ he hiami nɛ be tsa ba mohu o ma ná.
A ye he nyɛli ɔmɛ a nɔ
12Je mahi nɛ a he wa ngɛ hoo pee kaa wo nɛ gli, nɛ oslɔke nguaa amɛ ngɛ kue bum bum kɛ ngɛ si puee. 13Je ma amɛ hia kɛ ma kaa wo oslɔke; se Mawu ku a nya la, nɛ a kpale a se kɛ yaa kaa bunyuku nɛ ngɛ tee puu ngɛ yoku he, loo kaa dwɔmi nɛ ahumi ngɔ kɛ yaa. 14Gbɔkuɛ nya si ɔ, a woɔ wa he gbeye, se benɛ mɔtu ke e suu ɔ, a be. Ni nɛmɛ nɛ ba fiaa wɔ ojo, nɛ a kpakpaa wa he ní kɛ yaa a, bɔ nɛ a nyagbe maa ba ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.

Title: YESAYA 18
Content:
Mawu maa gbla Sudan tue
1 Zugba ko ngɛ Sudan pa amɛ a se kɛ e nɔ abalaa lɛhi babauu. 2A tsɔ nihi kɛ je jamɛ a zugba a nɔ kɛ ma. A hi lɛhi nɛ a kɛ ngɔwu pee a mi kɛ gu Nilo pa a nɔ kɛ ma. Nyɛ tsɔli nɛ nyɛ he sɔɔ, nyɛɛ ngɔ sɛ gbi nɛ ɔ kɛ ya nyɛ zugba kɛ e mi pahi babauu ɔ nɔ. Nyɛɛ ngɔ kɛ ya ha nyɛ ma kɛ e mi katsɛmɛ, nimli gagaagahi kɛ a he womi nɔ tlotlootlo nɛ je ɔ tsuo yee mɛ gbeye ɔ.
3Nyɛ, nihi tsuo ngɛ je ɔ mi, nyɛɛ bu tue! Nyɛ maa na aflangaa ko nɛ a si ngɛ yo ɔmɛ a nɔ! Nyɛɛ bu tue; nyɛ maa nu nɛ a ngɛ titimati kpae! 4Ejakaa Yawɛ de mi ke, “Bɔ nɛ ngma kpami be mi je mi dɔɔ la nyɔ mi nɛ bɔ́ nɛɛ ɔ, loo bɔ nɛ ke pu tso ngmangmaangma nɛ je mi dɔɔ la, nɛ́ kɔɔhiɔ mi peeɔ kom ɔ, ja ma pee dii ngɛ hiɔwe kɛ hyɛ. 5Loko wai yiblii nya buami be maa su, be mi nɛ mɔmɔ ɔmɛ tsuo ma kplɔ pue si, nɛ wai yiblii ɔmɛ maa pee kaa a ngɛ fue ɔ, he nyɛli ɔmɛ ma kpata Sudan bi ɔmɛ a hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ kaa bɔ nɛ a ngɔɔ tso he suami dade kɛ poɔ wai tso kɔnihi. 6Ta buli nɛ maa nɔ ngɛ ta mi ɔ, a ma si a gbogboe ɔmɛ kɛ ha hiɔwe lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ, kɛ nga mi lohwehi. Latsa be ɔ, lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ maa ye, nɛ fĩɛ be ɔ, nga mi lohwehi hu maa ye.”
7Be ma nɛ Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ ma na nike ní kɛ je zugba kɛ e nɔ pahi babauu ɔ nɔ. E ma na nike ní kɛ je nimli gagaagahi kɛ a he tlotlootlo nɛ je ɔ tsuo yee mɛ gbeye ɔ a dɛ mi. A maa ba Zion yo ɔ nɔ, he nɛ a jaa Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ ngɛ ɔ.

Title: YESAYA 19
Content:
Mawu maa gbla Egipt tue
1 Sɛ gbi nɛ kɔɔ Egipt he ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. Yawɛ hi bɔku nɔ kɛ fo kɛ ma Egipt. Egipt amaga amɛ a he ngɛ doe blibliibli kaa Yawɛ ma, nɛ Egipt bi ɔmɛ hu sawale nu mɛ. 2Yawɛ ke, “Ma ha Egipt bi ɔmɛ ma gba ta kɛ wo mɛ nitsɛmɛ a he; nɔ kɛ e nyɛmi, nɔ kɛ e piɛ nine nɔ no, zugba kɛ zugba, ma kɛ ma, matsɛ kɛ matsɛ. 3Ma ha ga amɛ nɛ Egipt bi ɔmɛ to ɔ maa pee yaka, nɛ a mumu nya maa ta. A ma de amaga amɛ ke a ba piɛ a he; a ma ya bi ní ngɛ ní peeli a ngɔ, nɛ a ma bi ga womi kɛ je klamɔhi, kɛ kpade tsɛli a ngɔ. 4Ma ngɔ Egipt bi ɔmɛ ngɔ wo matsɛ yiwutsotsɛ ko dɛ mi; e maa ye a nɔ, nɛ a ma tsu ní kpakpataa ha lɛ. Imi, Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ lɛ i de.”
5Nilo pa a maa fã hluu kɛ yaa si nyu ɔ maa ta pa a mi, nɛ lejɛ ɔ ma gbli. 6Be mi nɛ nyu dɔ ɔmɛ ngɛ tae ɔ, a ma bɔni fu jemi. Ngɔwu kɛ go ma gbli; 7niba ní tsuo nɛ a du ngɛ Nilo pa a tue ɔ ma ngla, nɛ kɔɔhiɔ ma kpata a hɛ mi. 8Hɛli kɛ nihi tsuo nɛ fɔɔ gbowe ngɛ Nilo pa a mi ɔ maa ye kɔmɔ, nɛ a maa wo yana. Ya fɔli tsuo a ni maa pee mɔbɔ. 9Kpa tslɔli, kɛ kploba loli tsuo a nine mi maa je wu. 10A ma kpata ma a mi nimeli ɔmɛ tsuo a hɛ mi, nɛ apaa yeli ɔmɛ maa ye kɔmɔ.
11Ganɔ ɔmɛ nɛ a ngɛ Zoan ɔ, kuasiahi sɔuu ji mɛ! Ga woli nɛ a buu mɛ ngɛ Egipt ɔ, ga yaya mohu a woɔ! Kɛ ba kɛɛ nɛ a deɔ matsɛ ɔ ke blema womi mi leli, kɛ matsɛmɛ a bimɛ ji mɛ kɛɛ? 12Egipt matsɛ, jije o ga woli nɛ le ní saminya a ngɛ? Eko ɔ, a ma nyɛ ma de mo yi mi nɛ Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ to ngɛ Egipt he. 13Zoan kɛ Memfis ganɔ ɔmɛ ɔ, kuasiahi sɔuu ji mɛ. Mɛ nɛ́ a ko tsɔɔ ma a blɔ ɔ, mɛ mohu a ha ma a laa blɔ. 14Yawɛ ha a juɛmi tsaka, nɛ a woɔ ga yaya. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, yayami sɔuu Egipt ngɛ pee. Ma a mi bi ɔmɛ ngɛ si tataae kaa dã tɔlɔ ko nɛ ngɛ si nɔe ngɛ lɛ nitsɛ e vie mi. 15Nɔ ko nɔ ko be Egipt nɛ ma nyɛ nɔ́ kpakpa ko maa pee ha mɛ, niatsɛ jio, dɛgulɔ jio, nɔ nɛ ngɛ biɛ jio, nɔ gu jio.
Egipt ma ja Yawɛ
16Be ma nɛ Egipt bi ɔmɛ maa pee a he fɔ̃li kaa yihi. Ke a na kaa Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ miɔ nɛ e kɛ e he wami ɔ maa gbla a tue ɔ, a he ma bɔni domi blibliibli. 17Be tsuaa be nɛ a maa wo Yuda ta a, sawale maa nu Egipt bi ɔmɛ ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ to nɛ maa ba Egipt nɔ ɔ he.
18Ke jamɛ a be ɔ su ɔ, Hebri gbi ji gbi nɛ a maa tu ngɛ Egipt ma ngua enuɔ ɔmɛ a mi. Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ biɛ a kɛ ma ka kita. Nɛ a maa wo ma amɛ eko biɛ ke, “Pu ma.”
19Ke jamɛ a be ɔ su ɔ, a maa ma Yawɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ngɛ Egipt zugba a nɔ; nɛ a maa to tɛ titima ko nɛ a gbaa nɔ ha Yawɛ ngɛ Egipt huzu ɔ nya. 20Ní nɛ ɔmɛ maa da si kaa Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ nɛ ngɛ a kpɛti ngɛ Egipt zugba a nɔ ɔ he okadihi. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke nihi nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ ma kpa ngmlaa kɛ tsɛ Yawɛ ngɛ yi mi nɛ a ngɛ mɛ wae ɔ he ɔ, e maa tsɔ nɔ ko nɛ e ba kpɔ mɛ. 21Yawɛ ma je e he si kɛ tsɔɔ Egipt bi ɔmɛ, nɛ a maa le lɛ; a ma ja lɛ, nɛ a kɛ sami bɔhi, kɛ nike ní ma ba ha lɛ. A ma ka Yawɛ kita nɛ a maa ye nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ. 22Yawɛ maa fiaa Egipt bi ɔmɛ ní, se lɛ nɔuu ji nɔ nɛ ma tsa mɛ. A maa kpale kɛ ba e ngɔ; e maa bu a kue fami ɔmɛ tue, nɛ e ma tsa mɛ.
23Ke jamɛ a be ɔ su ɔ, a maa je gbɛjegbɛ ko kɛ je Egipt kɛ ya Asiria. Egipt bi ɔmɛ maa ya Asiria bi ɔmɛ a ngɔ, nɛ Asiria bi ɔmɛ hu maa ya Egipt bi ɔmɛ a ngɔ, nɛ a maa pee kake kɛ ja Mawu. 24Ke jamɛ a be ɔ su ɔ, Israel maa pee ma nɔ́ nɛ ji etɛ kɛ piɛ Egipt kɛ Asiria he, nɛ ma nɛ ɔmɛ ma ba pee gbaami ha je ɔ tsuo. 25Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ maa gbaa mɛ ke, “A gbaa mo, ye ma, Egipt, kɛ Asiria nɛ i ngɔ ye nine kɛ bɔ, kɛ Israel, ma nɛ i hla ngɔ to kaa ye weto ní.”

Title: YESAYA 20
Content:
Gbalɔ he gu hɛɛlɔ ɔ we okadi
1Asiria matsɛ, Sargon fa Asiria asafoatsɛngua a ke e ya tua Filisti bi a ma nɛ a tsɛɛ Ashdod ɔ. 2Jeha etɛ loko sane nɛ ɔ maa ba a, Yawɛ de Amoz bi Yesaya ke, “Je kpekpe ɔ ngɛ o mlɛ mi, kɛ tokota nɛ ngɛ o nane ɔ.” E bu tue, nɛ e pee ja; e hɛɛ e he gu, kɛ e nane gu. 3Benɛ a ngɔ Ashdod ma a, Yawɛ de ke, “Ye tsɔlɔ Yesaya hɛɛ e he gu, nɛ e nyɛɛ e nane gu jeha etɛ. Nɔ́ nɛ maa ba Egipt kɛ Sudan a nɔ ɔ he okadi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. 4Asiria matsɛ maa nuu nihi ngɛ ma enyɔ nɛ ɔmɛ a mi, nɛ e ma kpaka mɛ kɛ ho kɛ a he gu. Jokuɛwi kɛ nikɔtɔmahi tsuo maa nyɛɛ a nane gu, nɛ a maa hɛɛ a he gu; a supa nya tsuo maa fɔ si gu, nɛ zo maa gbe Egipt. 5Nihi nɛ ngɔ a hɛ ngɔ fɔ Sudan nɔ, nɛ a fĩa fɔ Egipt nɔ ɔ, a hɛ mi maa pee mɛ yaa, nɛ a hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi tsuo maa ta. 6Ke jamɛ a be ɔ su ɔ, nihi nɛ ngɛ Filistia wo ɔ nya a ma de ke, ‘Nihi nɛ wa ngɔ wa hɛ kɛ fɔ a nɔ kaa a ma je wɔ kɛ je Asiria matsɛ ɔ dɛ mi ɔ, hyɛ nɔ́ nɛ ba! Wɔɔ lɛɛ kɛ wa maa pee kɛɛ nɛ wa yi ma na wami?’ ”

Title: YESAYA 21
Content:
Babilon hɛ mi kpatami he nina
1Sɛ gbi nɛ kɔɔ Babilonia he ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Kaa bɔ nɛ lasiogblee bee huu ngɛ leneyi je nga kplanaa a nɔ kɛ puɛɔ ní ɔ, jã kɛ̃ hɛ mi kpatami maa je zugba ko nɛ nɔ ngɛ gbeye nɔ kɛ ba. 2I na nina ko nɛ kɔɔ yi wu tso níhi nɛ maa ba a a he; a maa ngɔ nihi kɛ wo amanehlu mi, nɛ a hɛ mi ma kpata.
Elam tabo, tee si nɛ o tua mɛ! Media tabo, wo ma amɛ a he ka! Amanehlu nɛ Babilon kɛ ba a, Mawu ma ha e se maa po.
3Nɔ́ nɛ i na, kɛ nɔ́ nɛ i nu nɛ ɔ wo ye he gbeye wawɛɛ nitsɛ, nɛ ye he mi hia mi kaa yo nɛ nu kɔɔmi. 4E pee mi kaa ye hɛ mi ngɛ mi tsitsɛɛe, nɛ ye he ngɛ doe blibliibli kɛ sawale. Jinɛ i ngɛ blɔ hyɛe kaa du nɛ bu mla, se gbeye níhi mohu nɛ je mi kɛ ba.
5I na ngɛ nina a mi kaa a tsɛ ní yemi ko; nihi hii si ngɛ kuutuhi a nɔ kɛ ngɛ ní yee, nɛ a ngɛ ní nue. Tlukaa a, a nu nɛ a fa ke, “Ganɔhi! Nyɛɛ te si, nɛ nyɛɛ pɔ nyɛ tsɛ̃i ɔmɛ a he nu!”
6Kɛkɛ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ de mi ke, “Ha nɛ nɔ ko nɛ ya da si nɛ e hi huɔe, nɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ e maa na a, e de. 7Ke e na okpɔngɔhi, kɛ okpɔngɔ ta buli nɛ a to enyɔɔnyɔ, loo nihi nɛ a hi tejihi, kɛ afukpɔngɔhi a nɔ kɛ ma a, e pee klaalo.”
8Bulɔ ɔ kpa ngmlaa ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, i daa si ngɛ ye blɔ he ɔ kɛ ngɛ bue nyɔ kɛ pia tsuo.”
9 Tlukaa a, ta zugba lɛ kɛ e mi nimli, kɛ okpɔngɔ ta buli nɛ to enyɔɔnyɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ ba hia kpo. Kɛkɛ nɛ bulɔ ɔ kpa ngmlaa ekohu ke, “Babilon hɛ mi kpata oo, e hɛ mi kpata! Amaga amɛ nɛ a ngɛ jae ɔ tsuo ku pueɔ si!”
10Ye ma Israel, mo nɛ́ be ko ɔ, a hao mo, nɛ a wa mo yi mi wawɛɛ nitsɛ kaa ngma nɛ a gbee, nɛ a sa mi ɔ, jehanɛ lɛɛ bu manye munyu tue. Manye munyu nɛ i ngɛ mo dee nɛ ɔ, i nu kɛ je Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ ngɔ.
Sɛ gbi nɛ kɔɔ Edom he
11Sɛ gbi nɛ kɔɔ Edom he ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Nɔ ko ngɛ ngmlaa kpae kɛ je Edom kɛ ngɛ bie ke, “Bulɔ, nyɔ mi mɛni be ji nɛ ɔ? Bulɔ, ngmlɛ nyɛmɛ a fia?”
12I he nɔ ke, “Je na ta, se nyɔ maa kpale ba ekohu. Ke o suɔ kaa o ma ba bi si ekohu ɔ, kpale kɛ ba nɛ o ba bi.”
Sɛ gbi nɛ kɔɔ Arabia he
13Sɛ gbi nɛ kɔɔ Arabia he ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Nyɛ Dedan blɔ hiali a kuu nɛ nyɛ ba pueɔ si ngɛ Arabia nga kplanaa a nɔ, 14nibwɔhi nɛ kuma gbe mɛ nɛ a ba nyɛ ngɔ ɔ, nyɛ ha mɛ nyu nɛ a nu. Nyɛ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ Tema zugba a nɔ, nyɛ hu nyɛ ha mɛ nɔ ko nɛ a ye. 15Ta kɛ e mi amanehlu babauu nya ni ɔmɛ tu fo kɛ je ɔ nɛ; a hia klaate kɛ wo a he, nɛ a dɔ kɛ̃ɛ̃ mi kɛ nyɛɛ a se kɛ fo.
16Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ de mi ke, “Hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ jeha kake pɛpɛɛpɛ ɔ, Kedar weku ɔmɛ a he wami ɔ se maa po. 17Kedar kɛ̃ɛ̃ tsɛ̃li ji kã peeli pe kulaa nɛ a le, se a ti nihi bɔɔ pɛ nɛ maa piɛ. Imi Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ lɛ i de.”

Title: YESAYA 22
Content:
Sɛ gbi nɛ kɔɔ Yerusalem he
1Sɛ gbi nɛ kɔɔ nina kɔ̃ ɔ he ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. Mɛni ba? Mɛni o ma a mi bi ɔmɛ tsuo kuɔ kɛ ho a tsuhi a yi mi ya ya ngɛ pee? 2Ma a mi tsuo pee hoo kɛ ngmlaa kɛ gidigidi sɔuu.
O nihi nɛ gbo nɛ ɔ, pi ta nya nɛ a nɔ ngɛ. 3O we asafoatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsuo tu fo kɛ je; a nyɛ we nɛ a tsɛ̃ kɛ̃ɛ̃ kake po, nɛ he nyɛli ɔmɛ nuu mɛ nine nya. Nihi nɛ nine su a nɔ ɔ tsuo ngɛ fo tue kɛ yaa tsitsaa loko a nuu mɛ. 4Nyɛɛ ngmɛɛ ye he nɛ ma nyɛ ya wawɛɛ ha nihi nɛ gbo ɔ. Nyɛ ko gba nyɛ he nya kaa nyɛ maa jɔɔ ye bua. 5Mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ, níhi nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ kɛ ba wa nɔ ngɛ nina kɔ̃ ɔ mi ji haomi, basabasa peemi, kɛ gidigidi peemi sɔuu. A ku ma a gbogbo ɔmɛ ngɔ pue si. Ngmlaa ngɛ pɛe ngɛ yo ɔmɛ a nɔ tsuo kɛ ngɛ balɔ tsɛe.
6Ta buli hi okpɔngɔhi a nɔ kɛ je Elam kɛ ba kɛ a dɛ mi kɛ̃ɛ̃. Ta buli nɛ je Kir hu mia kɛ tsɛ̃i ja nɔuu. 7Yuda kɔ̃ zugbahi nɛ baa ní saminya a, a mi hyi tɔ kɛ ta zugba lɛhi; ta buli nɛ hi okpɔngɔhi a nɔ daa si ngɛ Yerusalem agbo ɔmɛ a nya. 8Yuda nyɛ we he nyɛli ɔmɛ a nya nɛ e da ngɛ he ko he ko.
Benɛ e ba lɛ kikɛ nɛ ɔ, nyɛ ya sɛ nyɛ ta nito he, nɛ nyɛ je ta hwumi níhi kpo. 9-10Nyɛ hyɛ Yerusalem gbogbo ɔ hehi nɛ hia kaa a dla. Nyɛ hyɛ wehi tsuo nɛ ngɛ Yerusalem ɔ, nɛ nyɛ ku ekomɛ kɛ pue si, konɛ nyɛɛ kɛ tɛ ɔmɛ nɛ dla fia gbogbo ɔmɛ. Jehanɛ, nyɛ susu nyu he, 11nɛ nyɛ pee nyu nɔ́ agbo ko ngɛ ma a mi, konɛ nyu nɛ jee taku momo ɔ mi ɔ nɛ sɛ mi. Nyɛ pee ní nɛ ɔmɛ, se Mawu ɔ nɛ to ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a blɔ nya blema lokoo ɔ lɛɛ nyɛ hla we e se blɔ.
12Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ tsɛ ke nyɛ fo ya nɛ nyɛɛ ye kɔmɔ; nyɛɛ sɛ nyɛ yi kpalokpalo, nɛ nyɛɛ ha kpekpe ya bo, 13 se nyɛ pee we ja; nyɛ muɔ nɛ nyɛ nya mohu. Nyɛ gbe to kɛ na nɛ nyɛ ye ní, nɛ nyɛ nu ní. Bɔ nɛ nyɛ de ji, “Nyɛ ha nɛ waa ye ní nɛ waa nu ní, ejakaa hwɔɔ pɛ wa ma gbo!”
14Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ nitsɛ de mi ke, “A kɛ yayami nɛ a pee nɛ ɔ be mɛ pae a wami be ɔ tsuo. Imi, Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ lɛ i de.”
A bɔ Shebna kɔkɔ
15Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ tsɔ mi Shebna, tsɔlɔ nɔkɔtɔma nɛ hyɛɛ matsɛ we ɔ nɔ ɔ ngɔ ke ma ya de lɛ ke, 16“Kɛ o susuu ngɛ o he kɛɛ? Mɛnɔ ji mo? Mɛnɔ ha mo he blɔ kaa o kpɛ yɔkɔ ha o he ngɛ tɛ sa mi ngɛ yoku nɛ ɔ he? 17O susuu kaa nɔ ko nɛ he hia tsɔ ji mo, se bu tue, Yawɛ maa hɛ mo kɛ fɔ he. 18E ma koklo mo lokotoo kaa bɔɔlu, nɛ e maa hɛ mo ngɔ fɔ zugba agbo gbajaa ko nɔ. Lejɛ ɔ o ma gbo ngɛ ngɛ ta zugba lɛ ɔmɛ nɛ o ngɔ o hɛ ngɔ fɔ a nɔ ɔ a kasa nya. O pue o nyɔmtsɛ we ɔ hɛ mi si, mo zotsɛ! 19Yawɛ maa ba mo si; a kpɔ o blɔ nya ngɛ o dɛ.”
20Yawɛ de Shebna ke, “Ke e ba mi ja a, ma tsɛ ye tsɔlɔ Eliakim, Hilkia bi ɔ kɛ ba. 21Ma ngɔ o ní tsumi tade wuyaa a ngɔ wo lɛ, nɛ ma mia lɛ kɛ o mlɛ mi fimi nɔ́ ɔ. Nɛ blɔ nya tsuo nɛ o hɛɛ ɔ, ma ngɔ wo e dɛ, nɛ e maa pee kaa tsɛ kɛ ha Yerusalem ma a, kɛ Yuda zugba a tsuo. 22 He wami blɔ nya nɛ Matsɛ David sɛ ɔ hɛɛ ɔ, ma ngɔ kɛ ha lɛ. He wami blɔ nya nɛ ɔ ngɛ kaa safe ko. Ke e bli ɔ, nɔ ko nɔ ko be nɛ ma nga, nɛ ke e nga a, nɔ ko nɔ ko be nɛ ma bli. 23Ma to lɛ si saminya, nɛ e he maa wa wawɛɛ nitsɛ kaa tso plɛɛko nɛ e ma ba pee kaa jlasi ko kɛ wo e tsɛ we ɔ tsuo hɛ mi nyami.
24“Se e tsɛ we ɔ, e bimɛ, e nyɛmimɛ, kɛ e nina tsuo ma ba pee tlomi ngɛ e nɔ kaa kutuhi kɛ kãhi nɛ kplaa si ngɛ tso plɛɛko he! 25Ke e ba mi ja a, tso plɛɛko ɔ ma gbɔjɔ, nɛ e maa hia kɛ nɔ si. Kɛkɛ ɔ, ní ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ kplaa si ngɛ he ɔ, a hɛ mi ma kpata.” Yawɛ lɛ de.

Title: YESAYA 23
Content:
Sɛ gbi nɛ kɔɔ Fonisia he
1 Sɛ gbi nɛ kɔɔ Tiro he ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Nyɛ akua hluili ngɛ wo nɔ, nyɛ nya awe nɛ nyɛɛ ye kɔmɔ. Ejakaa nyɛ lɛsimuɔ he ngɛ Tiro ɔ, a kpata e hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ; we ɔmɛ, kɛ lɛ dami he ɔ tsuo hɛ mi kpata. Benɛ nyɛ lɛ ɔmɛ kpale kɛ je Kipro kɛ ma a nɛ nyɛ nu sane nɛ ɔ. 2Sidon jua yeli, nyɛ ma nyɛ nya! Nyɛ nɛ nyɛ tsɔɔ nihi 3kɛ poo wo kɛ ya heɔ blɛfo ngɛ Egipt, nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ je ma amɛ tsuo yeɔ jua a ji nɛ ɔ!
4Sidon ma, zo gbe mo! Bɔ nɛ wo kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ ngɛ mo dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “I fɔ we hyɛ, nɛ i lɛ́ binyumuwi kɛ biyiwi hyɛ.”
5E maa pee Egipt bi po nyakpɛ, nɛ a maa hao, ke a nu kaa a kpata Tiro hɛ mi ɔ.
6Nyɛ Fonisia bi, nyɛɛ tu fo kɛ ya Spania! 7Tiro, ma nɛ a po blema lokoo, nɛ bua jɔmi hyi lɛ tɔ ɔ, lɛ tete ji nɛ ɔ? Ma nɛ mi bi po wo kɛ ya to mahi a sisi ngɛ wo se tɔɔ ɔ, lɛ kɛ̃ ji nɛ ɔ? 8Mɛnɔ nɛ to ga kaa ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ ba Tiro nɔ ɔ? Tiro, matsɛ ma nguaa kɛ e mi jua yeli kpanakpanaa nɛ ji ganɔhi nɛ a hɛ mi ngɛ nyami saminya ngɛ je ɔ mi tsuo ɔ, mɛnɔ ha nɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ba e nɔ ɔ? 9Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ nitsɛ lɛ pee. E pee enɛ ɔ, konɛ a he nɔ womi ɔ se nɛ po, nɛ nimli nguangua amɛ hu a he guɛ nɛ gbo.
10Nyɛ Spania bi, nyɛɛ ho nɛ nyɛ ya hu. Ejakaa lɛsimuɔ he ko be hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ hu. 11Yawɛ kɛ e he wami kpata nɔ yemi ɔmɛ a hɛ mi ngɛ wo se tsitsaa lokoo. Yawɛ nɛ ku Sidon mɔ ɔmɛ. 12Sidon ma, o bua jɔmi ɔ se po, nɛ a ngɛ o ma mi bi ɔmɛ yi mi wae. Ke a tu fo kɛ ho Kipro ya tete po, lejɛ ɔ hu, a be he jɔmi nae.
13Tsa pi Asiria bi nɛ pee ní nɛ ɔmɛ; Babilonia bi mohu nɛ ha lohwe dikali ba tua Tiro ma a; mɛ nɛ a fia kpoku kɛ wo Tiro ma a he, nɛ a ku mɔ nguangua amɛ kɛ pee lɛ ma doku.
14Nyɛ Spania akua hluili ngɛ wo nɔ, nyɛɛ wo yana nɛ nyɛɛ ye kɔmɔ! Ma nɛ nyɛ ngɔ nyɛ hɛ ngɔ fɔ nɔ ɔ, a kpata e hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ.
15Be ma nɛ nihi a hɛ maa je Tiro nɔ jeha nyingmi kpaago sɔuu, nɛ ji matsɛ kake wami be tsuo. Jeha nyingmi kpaago ɔ se ɔ, Tiro maa pee kaa yo ajuama nɛ a wo lɛ la. 16Mo, yaholɔ nɛ nihi a hɛ je o nɔ, ngɔɔ o kpa saku ɔ kɛ ya kpa ma a mi! Fiaa saku ɔ, nɛ o la kɛ to he kaa sa be ko ɔ, konɛ nyumuhi nɛ a ba o ngɔ ekohu!
17Jeha nyingmi kpaago ɔ se ɔ, Yawɛ maa na Tiro mɔbɔ, nɛ e ma ha nɛ Tiro, kɛ je ma amɛ ma ya tsu ní ekohu kaa sa a; e kɛ ma amɛ tsuo ma ya ye jua. 18Sika nɛ e ma na kɛ je e jua yemi ɔ mi ɔ, e maa gbaa nɔ kɛ ha Yawɛ. E be nya buae kɛ to, se mohu nihi nɛ ma ba ja Yawɛ ɔ, a maa ngɔ sika nɛ ɔ kɛ he niye ní, kɛ heha ní nɛ hia mɛ.

Title: YESAYA 24
Content:
Yawɛ maa gbla je ɔ tue
1Yawɛ ma kpata zugba a hɛ mi, nɛ zugba a maa fɔ si gu. E ma plɛ zugba a hɛ mi bu si, nɛ nihi nɛ ngɛ nɔ ɔ, e maa gbɛ mɛ ngɔ fĩa. 2Tue gblami kake lɛ ngɛ ha nɔ tsuaa nɔ, osɔfo jio, ma a jio, nyɔguɛ jio, nyɔmtsɛ jio, ní helɔ jio, ní jualɔ jio, nɔ nɛ ngɛ nɔ pae ha nɔ jio, nɔ nɛ ya ngɛ nɔ pae jio, niatsɛ jio, dɛgulɔ jio. 3Zugba a kɛ e nɔ níhi tsuo a hɛ mi ma kpata pɛsɛpɛsɛ. Yawɛ lɛ de.
4Zugba a gbli, nɛ e pee mɔbɔmɔbɔ kaa nɔmlɔ nɛ ngɛ kɔmɔ yee; je ɔ tsuo pee kaa nɔ ko nɛ pɔ tɔ lɛ; nimli ɔmɛ tsuo gbɔjɔ. 5Ni ɔmɛ ble zugba a; nɛ a kɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ peemi tɔ Mawu mlaa amɛ a nɔ. A tsake blɔ nya tomi ɔmɛ, nɛ somi nɛ ngɛ daa a hu a yi nɔ. 6Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Mawu gbiɛ zugba a. Ni ɔmɛ ngɛ nɔ́ nae ngɛ yayami nɛ a pee ɔ he. Nihi babauu a hɛ mi kpata; nihi bɔɔ pɛ lɛ piɛ. 7Wai he be hu; ejakaa wai tso ɔmɛ gbli. Nihi tsuo nɛ a bua jɔ be ko ɔ, jehanɛ lɛɛ a ngɛ kɔmɔ yee. 8Saku kɛ miɛ, la kɛ do nɛ a kɛ nyaa a tsuo se po. 9Nihi pa nui wai nɛ a la kɛ to he hu; dã nɛ nya wa dooɔ ngɛ a nya mi. 10Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ pee basaa ngɛ ma a mi; nɛ a nga agbo ɔmɛ tsuo, konɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko nɛ ko sɛ we ɔmɛ a mi. 11Nihi ngɛ ngmlaa kpae ngɛ gbɛjegbɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ; ejakaa wai ta. Bua jɔmi ta kulaa; bua jɔmi laa kaa nɔ ko nɛ a je lɛ we. 12A ku gbogbo ɔmɛ dukuduku ngɔ pue si, nɛ ma a tsuo plɛ pee ma doku. 13Nɔ́ nɛ maa ba je ma amɛ tsuo a nɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ maa ta kaa bɔ nɛ ke a kpa ngmɔ nɔ ní ta, nɛ a kplɔɔ wai yiblii tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ taa tso ɔmɛ a nɔ nɛ wai yiblii kake po piɛ ɔ.
14Nihi nɛ a yi na wami ɔ ma la kɛ bua jɔmi. Nihi nɛ ngɛ bonyoku je ɔ ma de ke Yawɛ kle, 15nɛ nihi nɛ ngɛ beleku je ma je e yi. Nihi nɛ ngɛ wo nya je ɔ hu ma je Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ yi. 16Wa nu yi jemi lahi nɛ a ngɛ lae kɛ je je mi nyagbe he ɔmɛ kɛ ngɛ dalɔ ɔ hɛ mi nyami woe.
Se imi lɛɛ, hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi ko kulaa be ha mi! He lo kɛkɛ i ngɛ tae. Ye yi ta pɛ! Yi mi sɔuu nɛ nihi ngɛ a sibi wae kpamisa. 17Nyɛ nihi tsuo ngɛ je ɔ mi, gbeye níhi ngɛ blɔ nɔ ha nyɛ; a tsua muɔ voovoohi ha nyɛ, nɛ a tsɔ nyɛ klamahi. 18Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa ma fo kɛ je gbeye ní ɔmɛ a he ɔ maa nɔ muɔ voo mi, nɛ nɔ nɛ be muɔ voo ɔ mi nɔe ɔ maa du klama. Hiɔmi maa nɛ piapiaapia, nɛ je ɔ sisi tomi ɔmɛ ma mimiɛ. 19Je ɔ mi ma gba; e maa ku, nɛ e maa gbɛ fĩa. 20E maa hi kpae kɛ hi yae kɛ hi bae kaa dã tɔlɔ, aloo ngmɔ si tsu nɛ kɔɔhiɔ sɛ mi. Yayamihi nɛ je ɔ tloo ɔ ngɛ lɛ gbee; ke e hule pue si ɔ, e be si tee gblegbleegble hu.
21Be ma nɛ Yawɛ maa gbla hiɔwe ta a, kɛ zugba a nɔ matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a tue. 22Mawu ma bua mɛ tsuo a nya kɛ wo muɔ voo mi kaa pamitsɛmɛ. E maa wo mɛ tsu ngɛ lejɛ ɔ hluu kɛ yaa su be nɛ a maa gbla a tue. 23Nyɔhiɔ maa wo diblii, nɛ pu be tsoe hu, ejakaa Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ maa ye matsɛ. E maa ye matsɛ ngɛ Yerusalem ngɛ Zion yo ɔ nɔ, nɛ ma nimeli ɔmɛ maa na e hɛ mi nyami ɔ.

Title: YESAYA 25
Content:
Yi jemi la
1Yawɛ, mo ji ye Mawu;
ma wo o hɛ mi nyami,
nɛ ma je o biɛ ɔ yi;
ejakaa o tsu nyakpɛ níhi.
O yi mi tomi ɔmɛ nɛ o to blema lokoo ɔ,
o ye a nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
2O ha mahi plɛ pee ma dokuhi,
gbogbohi nɛ a fia wo a he ɔ,
lɛ tsuo ku kɛ pueɔ si.
Matsɛmɛ a mɔhi nɛ ma je li ɔmɛ ma a,
a kpata a hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ,
a be ekoeko nae hu gblegbleegble.
3Mahi nɛ a he wa saminya a ma je o yi;
Yiwutsotsɛmɛ ngɛ a ma amɛ a mi tsuo
maa ye mo gbeye.
4O ngɛ kaa mɔ kɛ ha ohiatsɛmɛ.
O ngɛ kaa mɔ kɛ ha nɔ́ nali.
Mo ji a wesa he ngɛ kɔɔhiɔ nɛ nya wa mi,
kɛ hɔ̃ ngɛ pu ngmangmaangma nya.
Yiwutsotsɛmɛ nɛ a yi mi wa
kaa ahumi ngɛ fĩɛ be mi po,
o jeɔ mɛ kɛ jeɔ a dɛ mi.
5Ose nɛ nibwɔ ɔmɛ ngɛ hee ɔ, o ku nya la kaa bɔ nɛ ke je mi dɔ la nɛ bɔku haa zugba jɔɔ ɔ. Nɛ yiwutsotsɛmɛ kpa a lami ɔ si kake too.
Yawɛ maa ngmɛ okplɔɔ ngua
6Yawɛ maa ngmɛ okplɔɔ ngɛ yo nɛ ɔ nɔ ha je ma amɛ tsuo. A maa ye ní kpakpa: lo nɛ tu zɔ saminya, kɛ zɔ nɛ a je kɛ je wu mi tɔɔ; nɛ a maa nu wai kpakpa. 7Haomi nɛ ba je ma amɛ a nɔ kaa nɔ́ nɛ bo lɛ a kɛ ha a nɔ ɔ, Mawu ma ha nɛ lɛ tsuo se maa po ngɛ yo nɛ ɔ nɔ. 8 Nyɔmtsɛ Mawu maa ye gbenɔ nɔ kunimi; e ma tsu nɔ tsuaa nɔ hɛ mi vo nyu, nɛ e ma je zo nɛ gbe e ma a ngɛ je ɔ mi tsuo ɔ kɛ je. Yawɛ lɛ de.
9Ke e ba mi ja a, nɔ tsuaa nɔ ma de ke, “Wa Mawu ji nɛ ɔ nɛ! Wa ngɔ wa hɛ ngɔ fɔ e nɔ, nɛ e kpɔ wɔ. Lɛ ji Yawɛ. Akɛnɛ wa ngɔ wa hɛ ngɔ fɔ e nɔ nɛ́ e he wa yi wami he je ɔ, wa bua jɔ wa he, nɛ wa ngɛ nyae.”
Mawu maa gbla Moab tue
10 Yawɛ maa bu Zion yo ɔ he, se Moab bi ɔmɛ lɛɛ, a maa naa a nɔ kaa a naa nga nɔ kɛ woɔ dwɔmi mi kɛ ya pueɔ kuku nɔ. 11A ma wo a kɔnihi a nɔ kaa nihi nɛ ngɛ mɔde bɔe kaa a maa sile ngɛ nyu mi; se Mawu maa ba a he nɔ womi ɔ si, nɛ a kɔni ɔmɛ a mi ma gbɔjɔ kulaa. 12Moab mɔ ɔmɛ nɛ a fia gbogbo gojogojoohi ngɔ wo a he ɔ, e maa ku mɛ tsuo ngɔ pue si.

Title: YESAYA 26
Content:
Mawu ma ha e ma a maa ye kunimi
1Be ma nɛ ma a ma la la nɛ ɔ ngɛ Yuda zugba a nɔ:
Wa ngɛ ma nɛ he wa!
Mawu nitsɛ lɛ buu ma a gbogbo ɔmɛ a he!
2Nyɛ bli agbo ɔmɛ,
konɛ je ma amɛ nɛ peeɔ nɔ nɛ da,
nɛ a yeɔ anɔkuale ɔ, a sɛ mi.
3Nɔ nɛ ngɔɔ e hɛ kɛ fɔɔ o nɔ,
nɛ e heɔ mo yeɔ ɔ,
o haa lɛ tue mi jɔmi.
4Nyɛɛ ngɔ nyɛ hɛ ngɔ fɔ Yawɛ nɔ daa;
ejakaa Yawɛ Mawu ɔ ngɛ kaa tɛ sa ko
nɛ ngɛ daa.
5Nihi nɛ wo a he nɔ gojoo ɔ,
e ba mɛ si;
ma nɛ he wa, nɛ he nɔ woli hi mi ɔ,
e kpata e hɛ mi;
e ku gbogbo ɔmɛ ngɔ pue bunyuku mi.
6Nihi nɛ a wa mɛ yi mi be ko ɔ,
jehanɛ lɛɛ mɛ nɛ a ngɛ nyɛɛe,
nɛ a ngɛ si sie ngɛ lejɛ ɔ nɛ.
7Nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ kpakpa a,
a blɔ da tlɔmɔɔ;
mo lɛ o ha a blɔ da ja a nɛ.
8Yawɛ, wa maa pee o suɔmi nya ní,
nɛ wa maa ngɔ wa hɛ ngɔ fɔ o nɔ;
mo pɛ wa suɔ kɛ wa tsui tsuo.
9Nyɔ mi ɔ, i hla o se blɔ kɛ ye tsui tsuo;
ke o kojo je ɔ kɛ e mi bi ɔmɛ ɔ,
loko a maa le nɔ́ nɛ ji dami sane yemi.
10E ngɛ mi kaa o naa yiwutsotsɛmɛ mɔbɔ lɛɛ,
se a kase we nɛ a pee nɔ́ nɛ da.
E ngɛ mi kaa a ngɛ nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da
a zugba nɔ lɛɛ,
se yayami mohu a ngɛ pee kpamisa;
a yɔse we kaa Mawu kpetekpleenyɛ ji mo.
11 Yawɛ, o to kaa o maa gbla he nyɛli ɔmɛ a tue,
se a li tete.
Ha nɛ zo nɛ gbe mɛ, nɛ a na nɔ́.
Gbla a tue kaa bɔ nɛ o to ha mɛ ɔ.
Ha nɛ a na kaa o suɔ o ma a sane saminya.
12Yawɛ, mo lɛ o haa wɔ tue mi jɔmi;
nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ wa ngɛ pee ɔ,
mo lɛ o peeɔ ha wɔ.
13Yawɛ, o se ɔ,
nyɔmtsɛmɛ kpahi ba ye wa nɔ lɛɛ,
se mo pɛ nɛ wa le.
14O ha a gbo pɛsɛɛ,
a be je mi hu;
a kpadehi tete be si tee,
ejakaa o gbla a tue;
o kpata a hɛ mi pɛsɛɛ,
nɔ ko nɔ ko kaii we mɛ hu.
15Yawɛ, mo lɛ o ha wa ma a he hiɛ babauu;
o bli wa huzu ɔmɛ a mi kɛ kpe,
nɛ enɛ ɔ ha o hɛ mi ba nyami.
16Yawɛ, o gbla o ma a tue;
nɛ benɛ e fi mɛ ɔ,
a fa kue kɛ tsɛ mo.
17Yawɛ, o ha nɛ waa kɛ he hiami kpa ngmlaa
kaa bɔ nɛ yo nɛ hɛɛ mi
nɛ e miɔ nɛ ma fɔ peeɔ ɔ.
18Wɔ hu wa sɛ he hiami, kɛ gbenɔ mi ja,
se nɔ́ ko ji mi kɛ bɛ.
Wa nyɛ we nɛ wa he wa zugba a yi wami;
wa nyɛ we nɔ́ ko kulaa nɛ waa pee.
19 Wa ma mi nihi nɛ gbo ɔ
ma na wami ekohu!
A gbogboe ɔmɛ maa te si.
Nihi nɛ hwɔɔ si ngɛ zu mi ɔ,
mɛ tsuo a maa te si,
nɛ a ma la kɛ bua jɔmi.
Kaa bɔ nɛ bɔ́ nyu ngleinglei
haa zugba a peeɔ ehe ekohu ɔ,
ja Yawɛ maa ngɔ wami he
ngɔ wo nihi nɛ gbo momo ɔ a mi.
Tue gblami kɛ yi wami hemi
20Ye ma, nyɛ ya sɛ nyɛ we ɔmɛ a mi, nɛ nyɛɛ ngmɛ sinya amɛ a mi ngɔ wo nyɛ yi. Nyɛɛ laa nyɛ he be kpiti ko kɛ yaa si Mawu mi mi fumi ɔ nya maa be. 21Ejakaa Yawɛ je e hi he ɔ kɛ ma je ɔ mi nɛ e ba gbla nimli adesahi a tue ngɛ a he yayami ɔmɛ a he. Nihi nɛ a gbe ngɛ laami mi ngɛ je ɔ mi ɔ, a ma je mɛ tsuo kpo nɛ a na mɛ; zugba a be jamɛ a ni ɔmɛ a nɔ laae hu.

Title: YESAYA 27
Content:
1 Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, Yawɛ kɛ e klaate kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ maa gbe wo mi sinɔ agbo langalanga a.
2Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ ma de ngɛ e wai ngmɔ saminyayoo ɔ he jamɛ a ligbi ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: 3“Imi Yawɛ nitsɛ nɛ i hyɛɛ e nɔ; i pueɔ nɔ nyu be tsuaa be. I buu e he nyɔ kɛ pia, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ nɔ ko nɛ ko ba kpata e hɛ mi. 4Ye wai ngmɔ ɔ he mi mi la ko be ye mi hu. Ke kaa miohi, kɛ mio pu kɛkɛ nɛ i kɛ gba ta a, jinɛ ma ya mɛ a he la, nɛ ma sã mɛ tsuo. 5Se ke ye ma a a he nyɛli ngɛ hlae kaa ma bu a he ɔ, lɛɛ a kɛ mi nɛ ba kpata lolo. Niinɛ, e hia kaa a kɛ mi nɛ ba kpata.”
6Hwɔɔ se ko ɔ, Israel ma nɛ ji Yakob nina a maa ma si kpɛii kaa tso nɛ sipoku sɛ zu mi; a ma gba mɔmɔ, nɛ a ma plɔke. A yiblii ma hyi je ɔ tɔ.
7Yawɛ gbla we Israel tue wawɛɛ kaa bɔ nɛ e gbla a he nyɛli ɔmɛ a tue ɔ; nɛ Israel bi nɛ nɔ ngɛ ta mi ɔ hu, a he híɛ kulaa kaa he nyɛli ɔmɛ. 8Tue gblami nɛ Yawɛ ha e ma a ji, e ha a nuu mɛ kɛ ho ma se ya. E ha beleku kɔɔhiɔ nɛ nya wa ko ba muɔ mɛ kɛ ho. 9Se bɔ nɛ Israel maa pee kɛ je a he yayami ɔmɛ konɛ a kɛ pa mɛ ji, a maa wɛɛ je ma amɛ a bɔ sami la tɛ ɔmɛ bukɔbukɔ kaa ayilɔ, nɛ yo mawu Ashera a tsopa kɛ e he via bɔ sami la tɛ ɔmɛ, loo e we amaga amɛ ekoeko be si hie hu.
10Ma nɛ a fia gbogbo ngɔ wo he ɔ ku kɛ pueɔ si. E plɛ pee ma doku kaa nga kplanaa nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be nɔ. Lejɛ ɔ plɛ pee lohwe lɛmi he, he nɛ nahi maa ye ní, nɛ a maa jɔɔ a he ngɛ. 11Tso kɔni ɔmɛ gbli, nɛ a ku kɛ pueɔ si; yi ɔmɛ ya buaa nya kaa lɛ́ nɛ a ma slɛ, ejakaa ma a nui nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko sisi. Mawu, a bɔlɔ ɔ mi mi be lɛ sãe ngɛ a he, nɛ e be mɛ mɔbɔ nae hulɔ.
12Israel bi, nyɛ na nɛ nyɛɛ le kaa jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, kɛ je Yufrate pa a nya kɛ yaa si Egipt huzu ɔ nya a, Yawɛ ma bua e ma a nya kɛ je je ma amɛ a mi kakaaka kaa nɔ ko nɛ ngɛ ngma mi sae, nɛ e ngɛ ngma nitsɛ ɔ hlae kɛ je tsakati ɔ mi.
13Ke jamɛ a ligbi ɔ su ɔ, a ma kpa titimati nguaa ko kɛ tsɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ a nuu kɛ ho ma se ya a kɛ je Asiria kɛ Egipt. A maa ba, nɛ a ma ba ja Yawɛ ngɛ Yerusalem, ngɛ yo klɔuklɔu ɔ nɔ.

Title: YESAYA 28
Content:
A bɔ omleyi je nɔ yemi ɔ kɔkɔ
1Musu tloo Efraim nina, Israel nɔ yemi ɔ. E hɛ mi nyami ɔ ngɛ tae kaa mɔmɔ jlasi nɛ ma nimeli dã tɔli ngɔ fi a yi. A wo a yi mi nu je via saminya lɛɛ, se hyɛ mɛ nɛ a tɔ dã kpɔtɔɔ kɛ pueɔ si. 2Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ngɛ he walɔ katsɛ ko nɛ ma ba tua mɛ. E maa ba kaa gbiɛ ngo ngu; e maa fo dɔ kaa hiɔmi nyu nɛ bee lalaala, nɛ haa pa hyiɔ kɛ ywiaa nga kɛ haa zugba a nɔ. 3Jamɛ a ma nimeli dã tɔli he nɔ woli ɔmɛ ɔ, a maa ba mɛ si kulaa. 4Bɔ nɛ ke nɔ ko na ngmɔkɔ nɛ fu loko e fumi be su, nɛ e tsɔɔ nɛ e yeɔ tsuatsuaatsua a, ja ma nimeli nɛ ɔmɛ a hɛ mi nyami ɔ maa laa si kake too.
5Be ma nɛ Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ maa pee kaa mɔmɔ jlasi saminyayoo kɛ ha e ma mi ni nɛmɛ nɛ a yi ma na wami ɔ. 6E ma ha kojoli maa ye dami sane, nɛ ma a agbo nya buli ɔmɛ ma na he wami, nɛ a kɛ he nyɛli nɛ ma ba tua mɛ ɔ maa kpe.
Yesaya bɔ Yuda gbali dã tɔli ɔmɛ kɔkɔ
7Gbali ɔmɛ, kɛ osɔfo ɔmɛ pohu tɔɔ dã, nɛ a tataa si. Wai kɛ dã nɛ nya wa fuu tsɔ nɛ a nuu ɔ, haa a hii si tɛe basabasa. Gbali ɔmɛ tɔɔ dã kpɔtɔɔ; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ninahi nɛ Mawu haa mɛ ɔ, a nui sisi. Osɔfo ɔmɛ hu tɔɔ dã kpɔtɔɔ ja nɔuu; mɛ hu sanehi nɛ a kɛ ba haa mɛ ɔ, a nyɛ we nɛ a hyɛɛ mi. 8Okplɔɔhi nɛ a hii a he ɔ tsuo peeɔ kpɔtɔɔ kɛ vie sɔuu; he ko he ko be nɛ tsɔ.
9A ngɛ munyu tue kɛ ngɛ mi sie ke, “Mɛnɔ ní jamɛatsɛ ɔ susu kaa e ngɛ tsɔɔe ɔ? E sɛ gbi ɔ, mɛnɔ ngɛ hlae? E sɛ gbi ɔ hi ha bimwɔwi nɛ kpaako a je nyɔ nya! 10E ngɛ mɔde bɔe kaa e maa tsɔɔ wɔ ní nyaa, ngmami okadi kakaaka, zã kakaaka, kɛ munyu tso ɔ hu kakaaka.”
11 Ke nyɛ be mi tue bue ɔ, lɛɛ Mawu maa gu nibwɔhi nɛ tuɔ ma se gbi nɛ nyɛ nui kulaa nɔ kɛ tsɔɔ nyɛ ní. 12Mawu de nyɛ ke e ma ha nyɛ he jɔmi, kɛ tue mi jɔmi, se nyɛ bui lɛ tue fɛɛ. 13Lɔ ɔ he je nɛ Yawɛ nitsɛ maa tsɔɔ nyɛ ní nyaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ nɛ: ngmami okadi kakaaka, zã kakaaka, kɛ munyu tso ɔ hu kakaaka; kɛkɛ ɔ, nane tsuaa nane nɛ nyɛ maa hia a, nyɛ ma tɛ nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ maa nɔ si. A maa plaa nyɛ; nyɛ maa du klama, nɛ a maa nuu nyɛ kɛ ho.
Zion kɔ nya tɛ ko
14Jehanɛ, nyɛ he nɔ woli nɛ nyɛ ngɛ ma nɛ ɔ nɔ yee ngɛ Yerusalem hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ bu nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ ngɛ dee ɔ tue. 15Nyɛ ngɛ fĩae ke nyɛɛ kɛ gbenɔ so, nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ gbeje pee kake. Nyɛ hɛ ngɛ nɔ kaa ke haomi ba a, e be nyɛ he sae kulaa; ejakaa nyɛ ngɔ nyɛ hɛ ngɔ fɔ lakpa, kɛ sisimi nɔ kaa nyɛ maa ye nyɛ he. 16 Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ngɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “I ngɛ sisi tomi ko nɛ he wa nɛ maa si kpɛii fiae ngɛ Zion; nɛ i ngɔ kɔ nya tɛ agbo ko kɛ ma mi. Nɔ́ nɛ a ngma ngɛ nɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: ‘Nɔ nɛ heɔ yeɔ ɔ, e toɔ e tsui si.’ 17Ma ngɔ dami sane yemi kɛ pee susumi kpa.”
Ahumi kɛ gbiɛ ngo ngu maa bɛɛ lakpa amɛ tsuo kɛ ho, nɛ pahi maa je a hi he ɔmɛ. 18Ke e ba mi ja a, somi ɔ nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ gbenɔ so ɔ, a maa po mi; nɛ a maa gbɛ kake peemi nɛ ngɛ nyɛɛ kɛ gbeje nyɛ kpɛti ɔ. Haomi nɛ maa ba a, nyɛ be nya nyɛe maa da. 19E maa ba nyɛ nɔ nɔtonɔto daa mɔtu. Nyɛ maa na amanehlu nyɔ kɛ pia. Sɛ gbi he tsuaa sɛ gbi he nɛ maa je Mawu ngɔ kɛ ba a maa wo nyɛ he gbeye wawɛɛ. 20Kaa bɔ nɛ a buu abɛ ɔ, nyɛ maa pee kaa nyumu ko nɛ ngɛ hlae nɛ e hwɔ si ngɛ sa tso kpiti ko nɔ. Sa tso ɔ ka we bɔ nɛ e ma nyɛ kpã e mi ngɛ nɔ, nɛ e nɔ hami bo ɔ hu bli we bɔ nɛ e ma nyɛ kɛ ha e he tsuo. 21 Yawɛ ma je e he wami ɔ kpo kaa bɔ nɛ e pee ngɛ Perazim yo ɔ nɔ, kɛ Gibeon kɔ̃ ɔ mi ɔ, konɛ e kɛ tsu nɔ́ nɛ e to kaa e ma tsu ɔ; níhi nɛ e ma tsu ɔ maa pee nyakpɛ níhi nɛ eko bɛ hyɛ.
22Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ dee ɔ, e ko pee nyɛ muɔ hu! Ke nyɛ kɛ pee fiɛmi ɔ, nyɛ be nɔ́ nɛ ma a nya fo nyɛe maa tu. I nu kaa Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ ke e ma kpata zugba a tsuo hɛ mi.
Mawu nile
23Nyɛɛ bu mi tue; nyɛ ta tue ha nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ dee ɔ. 24Ngmɔ hulɔ ɔ, anɛ humi kɛkɛ e hii hue daa nɛ, nɛ e du we ní lo? Pe e hii zugba a tsuae kpamisa, nɛ e hii hɛ mi dlae kɛkɛ lo? 25Ke e dla zugba a hɛ mi gbe nya a, anɛ e fĩa we pui wu, kɛ kowɛ lo? Anɛ e du we ngma zã nɔ zã nɔ, kɛ akoko hu ngɛ e blɔ he lo? Anɛ e du we ní kpahi kɛ wui huzu lo? 26E Mawu ɔ lɛ tsɔɔ lɛ ke e pee ja pɛpɛɛpɛ ɔ nɛ. 27Pui wu, kɛ kowɛ ɔ, pi tso kpoti nɛ a kɛ gbeeɔ, se tso zaayo kɛkɛ. 28Ngma nɛ a kɛ sãã abolo ɔ, a fɛ we mi. Nɔ́ nɛ ngma mi salɔ ɔ peeɔ ji e kɛ ngma mi sami nɔ́ hii ngma a mi sae hluu kɛ ya siɔ e naa ngma a bɔ nɛ sa pɛpɛɛpɛ. 29Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ hu Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ dɛ mi nɛ e je; e woɔ ga nɛ ngɛ nyakpɛ, nɛ e nile hiɛ babauu.

Title: YESAYA 29
Content:
Haomi nɛ maa ba Yerusalem nɔ
1Musu tloo Yerusalem! Yerusalem, Mawu bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ musu tloo lɛ! David ma nɛ e hi mi ɔ, musu tloo lɛ. Jeha kake, loo enyɔ komɛ kɛ a mi ní yemi, kɛ nyami ɔmɛ a se ɔ, 2ma nɛ a tsɛɛ “Mawu bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ”, Mawu ma ha e maa na amanehlu. Ma mi bi ɔmɛ maa ye kɔmɔ, nɛ a maa wo yana. Ma a tsuo maa pee kaa bɔ sami la tɛ ko nɛ a kpa muɔ ngɔ pue nɔ. 3Mawu ma ba tua ma a, nɛ e ma sa ma a yi; a maa fia kpoku gojogojoohi kɛ wo e he ka. 4Yerusalem maa pee kaa kpade ko nɛ ngɛ mɔde bɔe kaa e maa tu munyu kɛ je zu mi lokoo; e gbi ɔ maa pee kaa gugwɔ mi gbi.
5Yerusalem, o he nyɛli ɔmɛ nɛ je ma se kɛ ba tua mo ɔ, a maa bɛɛ mɛ tsuo kɛ ho kaa bunyuku, nɛ a ta buli babauu kɛ a he gbeyegbeye ɔ maa pee kaa jakati ngɛ kɔɔhiɔ nya. Tlukaa, ngɛ hɛngmɛfia mi ɔ, 6Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ ma he o yi wami. E ma ha hiɔmi ma si, zugba ma mimiɛ wawɛɛ, nɛ lejɛ ɔ tsuo maa pee hoo. Lasiogblee, ahumi, kɛ la gegeege maa ba; 7kɛkɛ ɔ, je ma amɛ a tabo ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ ba ngɛ ma nɛ a tsɛɛ Mawu bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ tuae ɔ, mɛ tsuo a maa laa kaa nina ko nɛ je kpo nyɔ mi ngɛ nlami mi kɛkɛ. 8Je ma amɛ tsuo nɛ ma ba tua Zion yo ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ maa ba a nɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. A sane maa pee kaa nyumuhi enyɔ komɛ a sane pɛ. Kekleekle nɔ ɔ ya hwɔ si kɛ e mi mi hwɔ; nɛ e nla nɛ e ngɛ ní yee. Se benɛ e hɛ tsɛ ɔ, hwɔ ngɛ lɛ yee kɛ mwɔɔ. Enyɔne ɔ hu ya hwɔ si benɛ kuma miɔ nɛ e gbe lɛ. Lɛ hu e nla nɛ e ngɛ nyu nue. Se benɛ e hɛ maa tsɛ ɔ, kuma ngɛ lɛ yee kɛ mwɔɔ.
A bui munyu ɔmɛ
9Nyɛɛ ya nɔ nɛ nyɛɛ hi biɛe, nɛ nyɛɛ pee nyɛ he nihi nɛ li nɔ́! Nyɛɛ pee nyɛ he hɛ yuyuili! Nyɛɛ pee nyɛ he dã tɔli, be mi nɛ nyɛ nui wai ko! Nyɛ tataa si kaa dã tɔli, be mi nɛ nyɛ nui dã nɛ nya wa ko! 10 Yawɛ ha mahe vii nɔ nyɛ nɔ, nɛ nyɛ hwɔ mahe kulaa. Nyɛ gbali ɔmɛ ɔ, Mawu kɛ nɔ́ bu a hɛ mi, nɛ e ha a yi nɔ. 11Gbali ɔmɛ nui a nina amɛ a sisi, konɛ a tsɔɔ nyɛ; nina amɛ pee kaa womi kpo ko nɛ a sɔu nya. Ke a ngɔ kɛ ya ha nɔ nɛ le womi kanemi ke e kane ha nyɛ ɔ, e ma de ke e be nyɛe, ejakaa a sɔu nya. 12Ke nyɛ ngɔ kɛ ya ha nɔ nɛ li womi mi ke e kane ha nyɛ ɔ, e ma de ke e li womi kanemi.
13 Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ke, “Ni nɛ ɔmɛ ke a ngɛ mi jae, se sisi numi ko be munyu ɔmɛ nɛ a ngɛ tue ɔ mi, ejakaa a tsui ngɛ he kpa kulaa. Nimli adesahi a mlaahi, kɛ blema sanehi nɛ a kase ngɔ wo a yi mi nɛ a deɔ kɛ a nya kɛkɛ ɔ ji nɔ́ nɛ a tsɛɛ ke jami. 14 Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ma pee nyakpɛ níhi, kɛ níhi nɛ ngɛ gbeyegbeye ngɛ nimli nɛ ɔmɛ a kpɛti ekohu. A ní leli ɔmɛ a nile ɔ, kɛ a ga a maa pee yaka.”
Hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi ngɛ ha hwɔɔ se
15Musu tloo nihi nɛ hlaa kaa a maa ngɔ ga nɛ a to ngɛ a yi mi ɔ kɛ laa Yawɛ. A toɔ a ga amɛ ngɛ laami mi, nɛ a susuu kaa nɔ ko nɔ ko be mɛ nae, nɛ nɔ́ nɛ a ngɛ pee ɔ hu nɔ ko nɔ ko be lee. 16 A plɛɔ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ yi ngɔ kaa si. Te nɔ́ nɛ he hia pe e nyɛmi nɛ; buɛ puɛlɔ ɔ, loo zu ɔ? Anɛ nɔ́ ko nɛ nɔmlɔ pee ɔ ma nyɛ ma de lɛ ke, “Tsa pi mo nɛ o puɛ mi!” loo e ma nyɛ de lɛ ke, “O li nɔ́ nɛ o ngɛ pee ɔ lo?”
17Kaa bɔ nɛ a deɔ ɔ, e be kɛe kulaa nɛ Lebanon hue tso ɔ ma plɛ pee ngmɔ kpakpa, nɛ zugba nɛ baa ní saminya a ma plɛ pee hue tso ekohu.
18Jamɛ a be ɔ, tuekpokutsɛ maa nu nɛ a ngɛ womi kanee, nɛ hɛ yuyuili nɛ ngɛ diblii kpii mi ɔ, a hɛngmɛ maa hyɛ nɔ ekohu. 19Nihi nɛ a he jɔ, dɛgutsɛmɛ, kɛ nihi nɛ a ní ngɛ mɔbɔ ɔ, Yawɛ Israel Mawu klɔuklɔu ɔ ma ha mɛ bua jɔmi ekohu. 20Yiwutsotsɛmɛ, nihi nɛ bui Mawu, kɛ yayami peeli tsuo a hɛ mi ma kpata. 21Mawu ma kpata nimli nɛ ɔmɛ hu a hɛ mi: nihi nɛ a kɛ a nya mi munyu poɔ nihi a nya kaa a tɔ mlaa, kɛ nihi nɛ tsɔɔ klama ha kojoli ngɛ kojomi he, nɛ a kɛ lakpa yemi haa nɛ a plɛɔ nɔ nɛ sane da a e sane hɛ mi kɛ buɔ si.
22Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, jehanɛ, bɔ nɛ Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ nɛ he Abraham yi wami kɛ je amanehlu mi ɔ ngɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Ye ma, zo be nyɛ gbee hu; a be nyɛ hɛ mi si puee hu. 23Ke o na bimɛ ɔmɛ nɛ ma ha mo ɔ, jamɛ a be ɔ mi o ma de ke niinɛ, imi ji Israel Mawu Klɔuklɔu ɔ nɛ. 24Kuasiahi maa le ní, nɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ tuɔ munyu huitihuiti ɔ maa kase ní.”

Title: YESAYA 30
Content:
Yuda ma nimeli kɛ Egipt so somi nɛ he be se nami
1Yawɛ ke, “Musu tloo Yuda ma nimeli ɔmɛ, ejakaa a kua mi. A toɔ gahi, nɛ a peeɔ níhi ngɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a dɛ he. A kɛ nihi soɔ nɛ pi ye suɔmi nya. Bɔ nɛ a peeɔ kɛ tĩaa yayami ngɔ haa a he ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. 2A yaa Egipt nɛ a ya biɔ yemi kɛ buami kɛ jeɔ Egipt matsɛ ɔ dɛ mi, be nɛ imi lɛɛ a bi we mi ga womi. 3Se yemi kɛ buami nɛ nyɛ ya biɔ ngɛ Egipt matsɛ ɔ dɛ mi ɔ ma plɛ pee zo, kɛ hɛ mi si puemi mohu ha nyɛ. 4E ngɛ mi kaa nyɛ tsɔli ɔmɛ ya su Egipt mahi nɛ a tsɛɛ Zoan kɛ Hanes momo mohu, se 5Yuda bi ɔmɛ ma pia a he; benɛ a ngɛ blɔ hyɛe kaa Egipt ma ba piɛ a he ɔ, zo kɛ hɛ mi si puemi mohu ji nɔ́ nɛ maa je mi kɛ ba.”
6Mawu sɛ gbi nɛ ɔ kɔɔ lohwe nane eywiɛɛywiɛtsɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ leneyi je nga kplanaa a nɔ ɔ a he. “Ma tsɔli ɔmɛ nyɛɛ kɛ ya gu zugba nɛ nɔ ngɛ gbeyegbeye ɔ nɔ.
