Jatahi, sinɔ duɔtsɛmɛ, kɛ nyakahi nɛ tee ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. A ngɔ nike níhi nɛ a he jua wa ngɔ pue tejihi, kɛ yomahi a nɔ ya ke ma ko nɛ be nyɛe maa piɛ a he. 7Egipt be nɔ́ kpakpa ko nyɛe maa pee. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i wo lɛ se mi biɛ ke, ‘Nyaka nɛ tee, se e he be gbeye.’ ”
Ma tue gboli
8Jehanɛ Mawu de mi ke ma ya ngma nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ngɛ tɛ tɛtlɛɛ nɔ ngɛ ma a hɛ mi. Ee, ma ngma kɛ wo womi mi, konɛ e pee odase nɛ maa hi si daa kɛ maa ya neneene. 9Ejakaa ma atuã tsɔli ji mɛ; lakpatsɛmɛ, kɛ nihi nɛ bui Yawɛ mlaa a ji mɛ. 10A deɔ gbali ɔmɛ ke, “Nyɛ ko na ní; nyɛɛ gba ní kpakpahi mohu ha wɔ. Nyɛɛ kɛ wɔ nɛ tu munyu nɛ maa ngɔ ngɛ wa tue mi; ke sisimi munyuhi pohu wa suɔ. 11Nyɛ ko nyɛɛ Yawɛ se; nyɛɛ gu he kpa! Wa hla we nɛ waa nu nyɛ, Israel Mawu klɔuklɔu ɔ he sane ko!”
12Se bɔ nɛ Israel Mawu klɔuklɔu ɔ ngɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Nyɛ bui nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ dee ɔ, nɛ nyɛ ngɔ nyɛ hɛ ngɔ fɔ basabasa peemi, kɛ sisimi nɔ. 13Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ yeɔ fɔ. Nyɛ ngɛ kaa gbogbo gojoo ko nɛ e mi gba kɛ je e yi mi kɛ ba ma si, nɛ kpa kasa, nɛ miɔ nɛ e ku kɛ pue si; tlukaa ngɛ hɛngmɛfia mi ɔ, e maa ku kɛ pue si bum! 14E maa gbɛ tsɔkɔtsɔkɔ kaa zu buɛ; e maa ywia yayaa, bɔ nɛ a be ngɛyu bɔbɔyoo po nae ngɛ mi nɛ a kɛ je la, loo nɛ a kɛ yɛ nyu ngɛ nɔ́ mi.”
15Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, Israel Mawu klɔuklɔu ɔ ngɛ ma a dee ke, “Nyɛɛ kpale kɛ ba, nɛ nyɛɛ ngɔ nyɛ hɛ ngɔ fɔ ye nɔ kpoo. Ja jã loko nyɛ he maa wa, nɛ nyɛ ma na wami.” Se nyɛ kplɛɛ we kaa nyɛ maa pee ja! 16Mohu, nyɛ to nyɛ yi mi kaa nyɛ maa hi okpɔngɔhi nɛ a he sɔɔ a nɔ kɛ tu fo kɛ je nyɛ he nyɛli ɔmɛ a he. Nɛ nyɛ nɔ́ da niinɛ; e sa kaa nyɛɛ tu fo kɛ je nyɛ he nyɛli a dɛ mi! Nyɛ susu kaa nyɛ we okpɔngɔ ɔmɛ a he sɔɔ saminya, se nihi nɛ nyɛɛ nyɛ se ɔ, a he sɔɔ kulaa pe nyɛ! 17Nyɛ he nyɛli ɔmɛ a ta bulɔ kake too maa wo nyɛ ta buli akpe fo; nɛ a nihi enuɔ pɛ maa wo nyɛ tsuo fo. Nyɛ tabo ɔ tsuo ma wo fo, nɛ nɔ́ nɛ maa piɛ ngɛ se ji aflangaa tso nɛ maa si ngɛ yoku yi mi! 18Se kɛ̃ ɔ, Yawɛ ngɛ mlɛe kaa e maa na nyɛ mɔbɔ; ejakaa nɔ́ nɛ da pɛ e peeɔ daa. Nihi nɛ ngɔɔ a hɛ ngɔ fɔɔ Yawɛ nɔ ɔ, a naa bua jɔmi.
Mawu maa gbaa e ma a
19Nyɛ Yerusalem bi, nyɛ be ya foe hu! Yawɛ ɔ, mɔbɔ nalɔ ji lɛ; ke nyɛ fa kue ha lɛ ɔ, e ma he nɔ. 20Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ma ha níhi a mi maa wa ha nyɛ lɛɛ, se lɛ nitsɛ e kɛ nyɛ maa hi si, nɛ e maa tsɔɔ nyɛ ní. E be hiae kaa nyɛ ma de ke nyɛ ma hla lɛ, nɛ nyɛ maa na lɛ hu. 21Ke nyɛ ngɛ nyɛɛe, nɛ nyɛ gba kɛ je blɔ ɔ nɔ kɛ ya hiɔ nɔ, loo muɔ nɔ ɔ, nyɛ maa nu e gbi ngɛ nyɛ se nɛ ngɛ dee ke, “Blɔ ɔ ji nɛ oo! Nyɛɛ nyɛɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ.” 22Nyɛ ma ble nyɛ we amaga amɛ; amagahi nɛ a ngɔ sika hiɔ kɛ ha a he, kɛ ní nɛmɛ nɛ a ngɔ sika tsu kɛ ha a he ɔ tsuo. Nyɛ maa hɛ mɛ kɛ fɔ he kaa ní komɛ nɛ a he tsɔ we; nyɛ ma de mɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ ho!” 23Ke nyɛ du ní ɔ, Yawɛ ma ha hiɔmi maa nɛ kɛ pue zugba a nɔ, nɛ niye ní babauu maa ba; jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, nyɛ na amɛ ma na zugba agbo nɛ a maa ye ní ngɛ nɔ. 24Nahi kɛ tejihi nɛ tsuɔ ní ngɛ nyɛ ngmɔ ɔmɛ a nɔ ɔ, a ma na niye ní kpakpa; nga nɛ a je blɔ poo nɛ a kɛ ngo futu lɛ nɛ a maa ye. 25Ligbi ɔ nɛ a ma kpata nyɛ he nyɛli ɔmɛ a hɛ mi, nɛ a maa ku a mɔ ɔmɛ kɛ pue si ɔ, nyu maa je yo gaga amɛ, kɛ yoku ɔmɛ tsuo a nɔ kɛ be babaaba. 26Nyɔhiɔ ma kpɛ kaa pu, nɛ pu la a nya maa wa wawɛɛ kaa bɔ nɛ e nya waa daa a totoe si kpaago; e maa pee kaa ligbi kpaago pu tsotsoe tsuo nɛ a bua nya ngɔ ha ligbi kake. Plaami nɛ Yawɛ plaa e ma a, e maa fi pa amɛ a nɔ ha mɛ, nɛ pa amɛ ma gbo. Ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo maa ba mi jamɛ a be ɔ mi.
Mawu maa gbla Asiria tue
27Yawɛ biɛ ngɛ pɛe ngɛ tsitsaa kɛ ma. E mi mi fu wawɛɛ nitsɛ kaa la su ku kpii nɛ ngɛ si tee. Munyuhi nɛ ngɛ e nya mi jee ɔ, abofu sɔuu kaa la nɛ puɛɔ ní. 28Ke e wo mumi ɔ, e ngɛ kaa pa nɛ hia lalaala kɛ bee nɛ hyiɔ kɛ ya taa nɔ kuɛ si tɔɔ, konɛ e sa je ma amɛ a mi nɛ e gbla a tue. Kɛkɛ ɔ, yi mi yaya nɛ a to ɔ tsuo maa pee yaka. 29Se nyɛ, Mawu ma a lɛɛ nyɛ bua maa jɔ, nɛ nyɛ ma la kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ laa kɛ ngɔɔmi ke nyɛ ngɛ nyami be klɔuklɔu yee ɔ. Nyɛ bua maa jɔ kaa nihi nɛ a ngɛ nyɛɛe kɛ yaa Yawɛ yo ɔ nɛ ji Israel tɛ sa a nɔ kɛ a dɛ mi bɛhi nɛ a ngɛ kpae kɛ ngɛ he toe.
30Nɔ tsuaa nɔ maa na e he wami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ nɛ ngɛ ní tsue, kɛ bɔ nɛ e mi mi fu wawɛɛ ɔ; la nɛ puɛɔ ní maa tso plamplam, nɛ ahumi maa fia; hiɔmi maa nɛ, nɛ gbiɛ ngo ngu ma pue si. 31Ke Yawɛ wo gbi ɔ, e maa gbla Asiria bi ɔmɛ a tue, nɛ sawale maa nu mɛ. 32Ke Yawɛ nitsɛ ngɛ mɛ ní fiae ɔ, tue gblami tsuaa tue gblami nɛ e ma ha mɛ ɔ, e ma a maa hi miɛ, nɛ a maa fia saku kɛ to he. 33Blema lokoo ɔ, a tsua muɔ ko nɛ a maa sã Asiria matsɛ ɔ ngɛ mi. Muɔ ɔ mi kuɔ, nɛ e bli, nɛ a to lɛ́ babauu kɛ wo mi. Yawɛ mumi ɔ nɛ ngɛ kaa la nɛ ngɛ tsoe plamplam ɔ maa sã lɛ.

Title: YESAYA 31
Content:
Mawu maa bu Yerusalem he
1Musu tloo nihi nɛ yaa Egipt ya biɔ yemi kɛ buami ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Musu tloo mɛ, ejakaa a ngɔɔ a hɛ kɛ fɔɔ Egipt ta zugba lɛhi, kɛ okpɔngɔ ta buli a nɔ; ejakaa a hiɛ babauu, nɛ a he wa hulɔ. Se a ngɔɛ a hɛ kɛ fɔ we Yawɛ, Israel Mawu klɔuklɔu ɔ mohu nɔ; ga womi hu a bi we lɛ. 2Yawɛ ɔ, ní lelɔ ji lɛ, nɛ e gblaa nɔ tue. Ke e de nɔ ko ɔ, e kpale we e nya se. E gblaa yayami peeli kɛ a he piɛli tsuo a tue. 3Egipt bi ɔmɛ ɔ, nimli adesahi kɛkɛ ji mɛ; tsa pi Mawu ji mɛ. A we okpɔngɔ ɔmɛ ɔ, lohwehi kɛkɛ ji mɛ, tsa pi Mawu mumi nɛ ngɛ a mi. Ke Yawɛ gba ta a, je ma ko je ma ko be nya nyɛe maa da; je ma nɛ he wa jio, je ma nɛ a ya je ngmlaa ha lɛ jio, mɛ tsuo a hɛ mi ma kpata.
4Yawɛ de mi ke, “Bɔ nɛ to hyɛli kɛ a ngmlaa babauu nyɛ we nɛ a fieɔ jata kɛ jee e de lo he ɔ, ja pɛpɛɛpɛ nɛ nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko be nyɛe maa tsi imi, Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ ye nya kaa ma bu Zion yo ɔ he. 5Bɔ nɛ lohwe pɛlitsɛ tee kɛ bɔleɔ e tsu kɛ buu e bimɛ a he ɔ, ja imi, Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ ma bu Yerusalem he, nɛ ma fa e he.”
6Yawɛ ke, “Israel ma, nyɛ pee yayami kɛ si mi, nɛ nyɛ tsɔ atuã. Se jehanɛ lɛɛ, nyɛɛ kpale kɛ ba ye ngɔ! 7Be ma nɛ nyɛ tsuo nyɛ ma sake amaga amɛ nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ pee yayami ɔ ngɔ pue he. Amaga nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ ngɔ sika tsu, kɛ sika hiɔ kɛ pee. 8A kɛ ta ma kpata Asiria hɛ mi; se pi nɔmlɔ adesa he wami nya. Asiria bi ɔmɛ maa tu fo ngɛ ta nya, nɛ a nihewi ɔmɛ ma plɛ pee nihi nɛ a nyɛɔ a nɔ kɛ tsuɔ ní tsumi nɛ nya wa. 9A matsɛ ɔ kɛ sawale maa tu fo kɛ je, nɛ ma nimeli ɔmɛ hu maa ye gbeye wawɛɛ nitsɛ, nɛ a maa ma fo kɛ je a ta aflangaa amɛ a he.” Yawɛ lɛ de. Lɛ ji Yawɛ nɛ a jaa lɛ ngɛ Yerusalem, nɛ a kɛ la sãã bɔ haa lɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ nɛ.

Title: YESAYA 32
Content:
Matsɛ nɛ yeɔ dami sane
1Be ma nɛ matsɛ ko ma ba ye tsɛ. E maa ye ma a nɔ saminya, nɛ e ganɔ ɔmɛ tsuo maa ye dami sane. 2Nɔ tsuaa nɔ maa pee kaa wesa he ngɛ kɔɔhiɔ kɛ ahumi nya, kaa pa nɛ ywia nga ngɛ zugba kpataa nɔ, aloo kaa zugba kplanaa nɔ tɛ sa sisi hɔ̃. 3Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, nɔ tsuaa nɔ hɛngmɛ maa hyɛ nɔ́ paa, nɛ e tue hu maa nu nɔ́ saminya. 4Tsui hahaahatsɛmɛ maa to a tsui si, nɛ a kɛ juɛmi kpakpa ma tsu ní, nɛ mumu hali a nya mi ma tsɔ. 5A be kuasia hɛ mi nyami woe hu, nɛ nɔ sisilɔ ɔ, a be lɛ tsɛe ke anɔkualetsɛ hu. 6Ejakaa kuasia tuɔ munyu basabasa, nɛ e toɔ ga kaa e maa pee yayami. E tuɔ munyu, nɛ e peeɔ nɔ́ basabasa kɛ siɔ Yawɛ. Nɔ nɛ hwɔ ngɛ lɛ yee ɔ, e ha we lɛ nɔ́ ko nɛ e yeɔ kɔkɔɔkɔ, nɛ nɔ nɛ kuma ngɛ lɛ yee hu e ha we lɛ nyu tete po nɛ e nuɔ. 7Nɔ sisilɔ ɔ, ní yayahi a he ga pɛ e toɔ. E yeɔ lakpa konɛ e kɛ kpata dɛgutsɛmɛ a hɛ mi. Ke a sane da po, bɔ nɛ e peeɔ mɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. 8Se nɔ nɛ hɛ mi ngɛ nyami ɔ lɛɛ ní kpakpahi a he e susuɔ, nɛ e yeɔ dami sane.
Tue gblami kɛ tue mi jɔmi maa ba
9Nyɛ yihi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ mle yee, nɛ haomi ko be nyɛ nɔ, nyɛɛ bu nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ dee ɔ tue. 10Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, nyɛ ngɛ kpɔtɔɔ mi; se nyɛ na nyɛɛ le kaa jeha kake kɛ ligbi bɔɔ komɛ a se ɔ, nyɛ maa hao; ejakaa nyɛ be wai yiblii nae ma kpa hu. 11Nyɛ yihi nɛ nyɛ he mi jɔ nyɛ, nɛ haomi ko be nyɛ nɔ, jehanɛ lɛɛ nyɛɛ ye gbeye, nɛ nyɛ he nɛ do blibliibli! Nyɛ kpa bo ngɛ nyɛ he, nɛ nyɛɛ hɛɛ nyɛ he gu. Nyɛɛ ngɔ kpekpe ya bo kɛ fi nyɛ mlɛ mi. 12Nyɛ gba nyɛ gugue ma, nɛ nyɛɛ ye kɔmɔ ngɛ ngmɔ kpakpa amɛ, kɛ wai nɛ baa saminya a he. 13Nyɛɛ ye kɔmɔ ha ye ma mi bi ɔmɛ a zugba nɛ pú, kɛ mio tso hyi nɔ tɔ ɔ. Nyɛɛ wo yana ha ma a, kɛ we ɔmɛ nɛ bua jɔmi hi a mi sa be ko ɔ. 14Mɔ ɔ po, nɔ ko nɔ ko be mi hie hu; nɛ ma nɛ hyi tɔ kɛ nimli babauu ɔ maa pee ma doku. Wehi, kɛ mɔhi nɛ bɔle mɛ kɛ kpe ɔ, a hɛ mi ma kpata kɛ maa ya neneene. Nga mi tejihi ma na bua jɔmi ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, nɛ tohi hu, lejɛ ɔ a maa ye ní ngɛ.
15Se wɔ lɛɛ, Mawu ma ha wɔ e mumi ɔ kɛ je hiɔwe ekohu, nɛ wa ma na niye ní babauu kɛ je ngmɔ ɔmɛ a mi. 16A maa ye dami sane ngɛ zugba a nɔ tsuo. 17Dami sane nɛ ɔ kɛ tue mi jɔmi maa ba, nɛ a ma na he jɔmi kɛ maa ya neneene. 18Haomi ko haomi ko be ye ma a nya gbae, nɛ tue mi jɔmi kɛ he jɔmi maa hi a we ɔmɛ a mi. 19(Se gbiɛ ngo ngu maa nɛ pue a ngmɔ ɔmɛ a mi, nɛ a ma a hɛ mi ma kpata.) 20Jamɛ a be ɔ, nihi nɛ duɔ ní ngɛ pa nɛ nyu mi tɛ gblee tue ɔ, a bua maa jɔ a he. Jã kɛ̃ nihi nɛ tsí a nahi, kɛ a teji okpɔngɔhi a nya, se a ngmɛɔ a he nɛ a ya yeɔ ní faa a, a bua maa jɔ a he.

Title: YESAYA 33
Content:
A fa kue kɛ bi yemi kɛ buami
1Musu tloo he nyɛli ɔmɛ! A fia ojo nɛ a sisi nihi; se mɛɛ lɛɛ nɔ ko fiɛ mɛ ojo, nɛ nɔ ko sisi we mɛ hulɔ. A we ojo fiami, kɛ nɔ sisimi ɔ se maa po kɛ̃, nɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ hu a maa fia mɛ ojo, nɛ a maa sisi mɛ.
2Yawɛ, wa kpa mo pɛɛ, naa wɔ mɔbɔ. Wa ngɔ wa hɛ ngɔ fɔ o nɔ. Buu wa he be tsuaa be; nɛ ke wa ngɛ amanehlu nae ɔ, kpɔ wɔ. 3Ke o hia ta, nɛ o wo gbi kaa hiɔmi simi kikɛ ɔ, je ma amɛ gbɛɛ fĩaa kɛ fo. 4A níhi plɛɔ peeɔ ta yibu ní nɛ a haa gidigidi kaa baalɛhi peeɔ a ní.
5Yawɛ kle! E ngɛ he wami ngɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɔ. E ma ha a maa ye dami sane sɔuu; anɔkuale pɛ a maa tu ngɛ Yerusalem be tsuaa be, 6nɛ ma a maa ya nɔ saminya. E buu e ma a he be tsuaa be; nɛ e haa ma mi bi ɔmɛ juɛmi kɛ nile. Yawɛ gbeye yemi ji nɔ́ ko nɛ he jua wa saminya kaa juetli agbo ha mɛ.
7Hyɛ bɔ nɛ katsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ ngmlaa kpae ngɛ gbɛjegbɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ ha. Hyɛ bɔ nɛ tsɔli ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ mɔde bɔe kaa tue mi jɔmi nɛ ba a wo yana boboobo ha. 8Gbɛjegbɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ ba gbeye, nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko nyɛɛ we a nɔ hu. A yi somihi a nɔ hu, ma kɛ ma jio, nɔ kɛ nɔ jio. Nɔmlɔ adesa pi nɔ́ ko kulaa ngɛ a hɛ mi. 9Zugba a pee mɔbɔmɔbɔ kɛ fɔɔ si. Lebanon hue ɔmɛ ta kulaa; Sharon zugba nɛ baa ní saminya a pee kaa nga kplanaa nɔ; tsohi nɛ ngɛ Bashan kɛ Karmel yo ɔ nɔ ɔ, a yi mi ba tsuo kplɔ kɛ pueɔ si.
Yawɛ bɔ e he nyɛli ɔmɛ kɔkɔ
10Yawɛ ngɛ je ma amɛ dee ke, “Jehanɛ e su be nɛ ma tsu ní. Ma tsɔɔ nyɛ kaa ye he wa. 11Nyɛ toɔ ga yayahi nɛ a he be se nami. Mumi nɛ nyɛ woɔ ɔ ngɛ kaa la nɛ ma kpata nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ hɛ mi. 12Nyɛ ta buli babauu ɔ maa sã ngɛ ta nga nɔ. A maa pee kaa la zu, loo mio tso nɛ a po kɛ pue si nɛ a mɛ he la. 13Nyɛ nihi nɛ ngɛ lokoo, kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ kpo nya tsuo, nyɛ ta tue nɛ nyɛɛ nu nɔ́ nɛ i pee ɔ he, konɛ nyɛɛ na kaa ye he wa.”
14Yayami peeli nɛ ngɛ Zion ɔ nu sawale, nɛ a he ngɛ doe blibliibli. Nɔ́ nɛ a ngɛ a he bie ji, “La nɛ ngɛ ní puɛe nɛ ɔ, wa ti mɛnɔ ma nyɛ nya maa da? La nɛ ngɛ tsoe nɛ gbo we gblegbleegble nɛ ɔ nɛ, wa ti mɛnɔ ma nyɛ nya maa da?” 15Ee, nɔ nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da, nɛ e tuɔ anɔkuale, nɔ nɛ sume kaa e maa ye nɔ ko awi nɛ e kɛ na ní, nɛ e he we nyɔ mi ní hulɔ, nɔ nɛ tsiɔ e tue nɛ e ko nu muɔ si puemi sane ko, nɛ e kɛ e hɛngmɛ hyɛ we nɔ́ yaya a, e yi ma na wami. 16Jamɛatsɛ ɔ ma ná he jɔmi kaa nɔ ko nɛ ngɛ mɔ nɛ he wa saminya mi. E ma na ní maa ye, nɛ e ma na nyu maa nu.
Be kpakpa maa ba hwɔɔ se
17Nyɛ ma ná matsɛ ko nɛ maa ye tsɛ saminyayoo ngɛ zugba a gbo tɛtlɛɛ ko nɔ ekohu. 18Nyɛ ma kai gbeye nɛ nyɛ ye blema a ngɛ tó nɛ ma se nɔ yeli tsu ngɛ nyɛ dɛ ɔ he; nɛ nyɛ ma kai nihi nɛ juɔ si ba slaa ma a hulɔ. 19Ma nɛ peeɔ nya puu, nɛ a tuɔ munyu nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko nui sisi ɔ, nyɛ be mɛ nae hu. 20Hyɛ, Zion, ma nɛ wa yeɔ wa nyami ligbi ɔmɛ ngɛ mi ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ! Yerusalem, ma nɛ tue mi jɔmi ngɛ mi ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ! Yerusalem ngɛ kaa bo tsu nɛ maa si nɛ be si nɔe gblegbleegble. Tso plɛɛkohi nɛ a ka kɛ wo zu mi ɔ ekoeko be hiae; tangme kpa amɛ hu be tsɔe. 21Yawɛ ma je e hɛ mi nyami ɔ kpo kɛ tsɔɔ wɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Pa nguahi, kɛ pa wawihi a tue wa maa hi; se wa he nyɛli ɔmɛ a lɛ wawihi nɛ a hluiɔ kɛ akɔfa be nyɛe maa ba lejɛ ɔ, lɛ nguahi hu ja nɔuu. 22-23Jamɛ a lɛ ɔmɛ a mi tso ɔmɛ a he be se nami; a be hie kɛ abalaa womi. Wa ma kpɔ he nyɛli ɔmɛ a ní kpakpa amɛ tsuo ngɛ a dɛ. Ta yibu ní babauu nɛ a ma na a, a maa dla, nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ ma na eko; glɔtsɛmɛ po ma na a blɔ fa mi nɔ́. Yawɛ nitsɛ maa pee wa matsɛ. E maa ye wa nɔ, nɛ e maa bu wa he. 24Nihi nɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ ɔ, a ti nɔ ko nɔ ko be dee hu ke, “I be he wami.” A maa ngɔ ma a tsuo a he yayami kɛ pa mɛ.

Title: YESAYA 34
Content:
Mawu maa gbla e he nyɛli ɔmɛ a tue
1Nyɛ, je ma amɛ tsuo nyɛɛ ba! Nyɛ bua nyɛ he nya kɛ ba nɛ nyɛ ba bu tue. Zugba a tsuo, kɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ngɛ je ɔ mi, nyɛɛ ba nɛ nyɛ ba bu tue. 2Yawɛ mi mi fu je ma amɛ tsuo, nɛ e hɛ dɔ kɛ wo ta buli ɔmɛ tsuo. E gbiɛ mɛ, nɛ e ngɔ mɛ ngɔ ha ke a gbe mɛ. 3A be ni nɛmɛ nɛ nɔ ɔ pue; a ma sake a gbogboe ɔmɛ kɛ pue he kɛ a he fu gbɛ̃ɛ̃; nɛ yo ɔmɛ a nɔ maa pee tsutsuutsu kɛ a muɔ ɔ sɔuu. 4 Pu, nyɔhiɔ, kɛ dodoe ma puplee maa pee kaa bunyuku. Hiɔwe ma koklo kaa womi kpo; nɛ dodoehi maa hɔle kɛ pue si kaa bɔ nɛ wai, loo ngmɔkɔ tso hɔleɔ ba kɛ pueɔ si ɔ.
5 Yawɛ pee e klaate ɔ klaalo ngɛ hiɔwe, konɛ jehanɛ e kɛ gbe Edom bi ɔmɛ nɛ e de ke a ma kpata a hɛ mi ɔ. 6E klaate ɔ he maa pee kɛ muɔ kɛ zɔ kaa jijɔhi, kɛ akpakpohi a muɔ kɛ zɔ nɛ a kɛ ngɛ bɔ sãe. Yawɛ maa sã bɔ nɛ ɔ ngɛ Bozra ma a mi; e ma pue a muɔ si nyamaa ngɛ Edom zugba a nɔ. 7Nimli ɔmɛ ma gbo kaa pu mi nahi, kɛ na ku katsɛmɛ. Zugba zu ɔ maa pee tsutsuutsu kɛ muɔ, nɛ zɔ ɔ ma futu zu ɔ tsɔfii. 8Yawɛ to be ko nɛ e ma he Zion yi wami, nɛ e maa gbla a he nyɛli ɔmɛ a tue.
9Edom pa amɛ ma plɛ pee ama, nɛ zugba a maa pee ama kala. Zugba a tsuo ma mle kɛ la kaa ama nɛ ngɛ tsoe. 10 E maa tso nyɔ kɛ pia, nɛ e be gboe. Zugba a nɔ maa je gu yi nɔhi babauu, nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be nɔ nyɛɛe hu. 11Se kayo, kɛ kɔtɔkɔ maa ngɔ lejɛ ɔ ngɔ pee a nɔ́; nɛ klomi kɛ kuakualabite maa hi lejɛ ɔ. Yawɛ ma ha zugba a nɔ maa je gu kulaa kaa bɔ nɛ e ngɛ be nɛ a bɔ je ɔ. 12Matsɛ ko be si hie nɛ maa ye ma a nɔ, nɛ ganɔ ɔmɛ tsuo maa ta. 13Mɔhi tsuo nɛ a fia gbogbo ngɔ wo a he ɔ, pú kɛ mio tso maa puɛ ngɛ a mi, nɛ nga mi gbehi, kɛ dugumahi maa hi lejɛ ɔ. 14Nga mi lohwehi, kɛ ogbeteehi ma ba kpe, nɛ nibɔ níhi kɛ a he gbeyegbeye (a yi je kaa nɔmlɔ, a nane kaa lohwe) ma ba fiɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Nyɔ mi kpadehi hu lejɛ ɔ nɔuu a ma ba jɔɔ a he ngɛ. 15Klomi ma ba pee tsu ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Lejɛ ɔ e maa ngmɛ hlui ngɛ, nɛ e ma pɛ bimɛ; nɛ e maa lɛ mɛ. Niinɛ, kayohi hu ma ba bua a he nya ngɛ lejɛ ɔ eku kɛ eyo, eku kɛ eyo.
16Nyɛ hla ngɛ Yawɛ womi ɔ mi nɛ nyɛɛ kane. Nyɛ maa na kaa nibɔ ní nɛ ɔmɛ a ti ekoeko be laae, nɛ e he piɛlɔ be lɛ bɔe. Yawɛ lɛ fa, nɛ e mumi ɔ ha e ba mi ja. 17Yawɛ nitsɛ lɛ fɔ sɔ nɛ e dla zugba a pɛpɛɛpɛ ha mɛ, nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ ná eko. Zugba a maa pee a nɔ́ kɛ maa ya neneene, nɛ lejɛ ɔ a maa hi daa.

Title: YESAYA 35
Content:
Blɔ klɔuklɔu ɔ
1Nga zugba kpataa nɛ gbli ɔ ma na bua jɔmi;
zia zugba a ma nya, nɛ mɔmɔhi maa puɛ ngɛ nɔ.
2Niinɛ mɔmɔ babauu maa puɛ ngɛ nɔ,
nɛ e kɛ bua jɔmi ma he ose ngɛ mɔmɔ ɔmɛ a he;
e maa pee fɛu kaa Lebanon yo ɔmɛ a nɔ;
e maa ba ní kaa Karmel kɛ Sharon zugba a.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ maa na Yawɛ hɛ mi nyami,
kɛ wa Mawu ɔ we agboje, kɛ e he wami ɔ.
3 Ninehi nɛ pɔ tɔ mɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ wo mɛ he wami;
nɛ nakutsohi nɛ gbɔjɔ ɔ, nyɛ ha nɛ a da si kpɛii.
4Nyɛ de nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ e tsui ngɛ poe ɔ ke,
“Wlua mo, koo ye gbeye!
Hyɛ, o Mawu ɔ ma nɛ e ba kpɔ mo!
E ma nɛ e ba gbla o he nyɛli ɔmɛ a tue.”
5 Hɛ yuyuili maa hyɛ nɔ́ ekohu,
nɛ tuekpokutsɛmɛ maa nu nɔ́.
6Glɔtsɛmɛ ma hlu kaa odabɔ,
nɛ amuɛtihi ma la kɛ bua jɔmi.
Pahi maa hia ngɛ nga kplanaa zugba a nɔ.
7Blesiblesi ma plɛ pee taku,
nɛ nyu hɛngmɛhi ma ha
zugba gbigbli ɔ maa tɔ nyu.
He nɛ nga mi gbehi hi sa a ngɛ
nga mlɔmlɔɔmlɔ mi ɔ, ngɔwu, kɛ go maa puɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.
8A maa je gbɛjegbɛ ko ngɛ lejɛ ɔ,
nɛ a ma tsɛ lɛ ke “Blɔ klɔuklɔu.”
Yayami peelɔ ko yayami peelɔ ko
be nyɛe ngɛ jamɛ a blɔ ɔ nɔ
gblegbleegble;
nɛ blɔ hialɔ kuasia ko be tlae
kɛ ba blɔ nɛ ɔ nɔ.
9Jata ko be lejɛ ɔ hie,
lohwe awi yelɔ ko hu be jamɛ a blɔ ɔ nɔ nyɛɛe.
Nihi nɛ Yawɛ he a yi wami ɔ,
mɛ a maa nyɛɛ jamɛ a blɔ ɔ nɔ.
10A maa kpale kɛ ba Yerusalem;
a ma la nɛ a ma hwɔ lele.
A be kɔmɔ kɛ aywilɛho yee gblegbleegble hu.
A bua maa jɔ kɛ maa ya neneene.

Title: YESAYA 36
Content:
Asiria wo Yerusalem he gbeye
(Matsɛmɛ II, 18.13-27; Kronika II, 32.1-19)
1Yuda matsɛ, Hezekia yi nɔ jeha nyɔngma kɛ eywiɛne ɔ, Asiria matsɛ, Senakerib ba tua Yuda mahi nɛ a fia gbogbo ngɔ wo a he ɔ, nɛ e ngɔ ma amɛ. 2Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e fa e we asafoatsɛ nɔkɔtɔma kɛ e ta buli babauu kɛ je Lakish ke a ya Yerusalem nɛ a ya de Matsɛ Hezekia ke e ha yi. Asafoatsɛ ɔ kɛ e ta a ba da si ngɛ yiti je taku ɔ nyu dɔ ɔ he, ngɛ gbɛjegbɛ ɔ nɔ kɛ yaa ní a he fɔli ɔmɛ a ní tsumi he ɔ. 3Kɛkɛ nɛ ni etɛ nɛ ɔmɛ je kpo nɛ a kɛ lɛ ba kpe: Hilkia bi Eliakim nɛ hyɛɛ matsɛ we ɔ nɔ ɔ; Shebna, matsɛ pɛdiyo ɔ; kɛ Asaf bi Yoa nɛ ngmaa sanehi kɛ toɔ ɔ. 4Asiria asafoatsɛ ɔ de mɛ ke Asiria matsɛ nguaa a tsɔ mɛ ke a ba bi Matsɛ Hezekia nɔ́ nɛ ha nɛ e yi nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko gbeye ɔ. 5E bi lɛ ke, “Anɛ o susuu kaa nya puu peemi ji ga kɛ he wami nɛ a kɛ hwuɔ ta lo? Mɛnɔ nɔ po o ngɔ o hɛ kɛ fɔ loko o tsɔ ye hɛ mi atuã a? 6 Tse o ngɛ blɔ hyɛe kaa Egipt ma ba piɛ o he? O ngɛ kaa nɔ ko nɛ e kɛ gla pee dɛma tso; gla a maa ku nɛ e maa gbɔ o dɛ mi. Egipt matsɛ ɔ ngɛ kaa gla. E gbɔɔ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ngɔɔ e he kɛ kpasaa lɛ.”
7Asiria asafoatsɛ ɔ ya nɔ nɛ e de ke, “Aloo o ma de mi ke o ngɔ o hɛ ngɔ fɔ Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ nɔ! Anɛ pi Yawɛ jami he ɔmɛ, kɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔmɛ nɛ Hezekia ywia a? Pi lɛ nɛ e de Yuda, kɛ Yerusalem ke a ya ja Mawu ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɛ ngɛ Yerusalem ɔ pɛ hɛ mi lo? 8I kɛ mo maa po nga ngɛ ye nyɔmtsɛ, Asiria matsɛ ɔ biɛ mi. Ma ha mo okpɔngɔ akpe enyɔ kaa o ma na mo nitsɛ o nihi nɛ maa hi a nɔ lo. 9O ngɛ blɔ hyɛe nɛ Egipt ba ha mo ta zugba lɛhi kɛ okpɔngɔ ta buli, be mi nɛ ye nyɔmtsɛ ɔ we asafoatsɛ nyafii pe kulaa a po o be lɛ nyɛe. 10O susu kaa loko ma ba tua ma nɛ ɔ nɛ ma kpata e hɛ mi ɔ, Yawɛ li he nɔ́ ko lo? Yawɛ nitsɛ lɛ de mi ke ma ba tua ma a, nɛ ma kpata e hɛ mi.”
11Kɛkɛ nɛ Eliakim, Shebna, kɛ Yoa de asafoatsɛ ɔ ke, “Wa kpa mo pɛɛ, kɛ wɔ nɛ tu Aram gbi. Wa nuɔ Aram gbi ɔ. Koo tu Hebri gbi; nihi tsuo nɛ ngɛ gbogbo ɔ nɔ ɔ ngɛ wɔ tue bue.”
12Se asafoatsɛ ɔ he nɔ ke, “Anɛ nyɛ susuu kaa nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ matsɛ ɔ ngɔ kɛkɛ matsɛ nguaa tsɔ mi ke ma ba de nyɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ lo? Nihi nɛ pueɔ si ngɛ gbogbo ɔ nɔ ɔ, mɛ hu munyu nɛ ɔ kɔɔ a he; a maa ye mɛ nitsɛmɛ a fĩ, nɛ a maa nu mɛ nitsɛmɛ a zami kaa nyɛ nɔuu.”
13Kɛkɛ nɛ asafoatsɛ ɔ te da si nɛ e kpa ngmlaa ngɛ Hebri gbi ɔ mi ke, “Nyɛɛ bu nɔ́ nɛ Asiria matsɛ nguaa ngɛ nyɛ dee ɔ tue. 14E ke, ‘Nyɛ ko ha nɛ Hezekia nɛ sisi nyɛ; ejakaa Hezekia be nyɛe ma kpɔ nyɛ kɛ je e dɛ mi.’ 15Nyɛ ko ha nɛ Hezekia munyu nɛ e tu ke nyɛɛ ngɔ nyɛ hɛ ngɔ fɔ Yawɛ nɔ ɔ nɛ ngɔ nyɛ nya. Nyɛ ko susu kaa Yawɛ ma he nyɛ yi wami, nɛ e be hae nɛ Asiria matsɛ ɔ nɛ ngɔ nyɛ ma a. 16Nyɛ ko bu Hezekia tue tete! Ejakaa Asiria matsɛ ɔ ngɛ nyɛ fae ke nyɛɛ ba nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ lɛ ba kpata. Kɛkɛ ɔ, nyɛ maa ye nyɛ he, nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ maa ye lɛ nitsɛ e wai, kɛ ngmɔkɔ yiblii, nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ maa nu lɛ nitsɛ e vu mi nyu, 17hluu kɛ yaa si be nɛ matsɛ nguaa a ma kpaka nyɛ kɛ ya zugba ko nɛ ngɛ kaa nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ zugba a nɔ. Wai ngmɔhi ngɛ lejɛ ɔ nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ maa pee wai; blɛfo ngɛ lejɛ ɔ nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ maa pee abolo. 18Nyɛ ko ha nɛ Hezekia nɛ mlɔɔ nyɛ ke Yawɛ ma he nyɛ yi wami. Anɛ je ma amɛ a mawu ɔmɛ eko nyɛ kpɔ e zugba kɛ je Asiria matsɛ ɔ dɛ mi hyɛ lo? 19Jije Hamat, kɛ Arpad mawu ɔmɛ ngɛ? Nɛ jije Sefarvaim mawu ɔmɛ ngɛ. Anɛ a nyɛ kpɔ Samaria kɛ je ye dɛ mi lo? 20Je ma amɛ tsuo a mawu ɔmɛ a ti eko nyɛ kpɔ e ma kɛ je Asiria matsɛ ɔ dɛ mi hyɛ lo? Lɛɛ mɛni haa nɛ nyɛ susuɔ kaa Yawɛ ma nyɛ kpɔ Yerusalem ngɛ ye dɛ mɔ?”
21Se ma a pee dii, nɛ a de we nɔ́ ko kaa bɔ nɛ Matsɛ Hezekia fa mɛ ke a pee ɔ. 22Kɛkɛ nɛ Eliakim, Hilkia binyumu ɔ nɛ hyɛɛ matsɛ we ɔ nɔ ɔ, Shebna, matsɛ pɛdiyo ɔ, kɛ Yoa, Asaf binyumu ɔ nɛ ji sanehi ngmalɔ ɔ kɛ aywilɛho hía tade ɔmɛ ngɛ a he; nɛ a ho ya bɔ Matsɛ Hezekia níhi tsuo nɛ Asiria matsɛ ɔ we asafoatsɛ ɔ de ɔ.

Title: YESAYA 37
Content:
Matsɛ Hezekia ya bi Yesaya ga womi
(Matsɛmɛ II, 19.1-7)
1Benɛ Matsɛ Hezekia nu amaniɛ ɔ, e kɛ aywilɛho hía e tade ɔmɛ ngɛ e he. E ha kpekpe ya bo, nɛ e pue nɔ kɛ ho Yawɛ we ɔ ya. 2E tsɔ Eliakim, matsɛ we ɔ nɔ hyɛlɔ ɔ, Shebna, matsɛ pɛdiyo ɔ, kɛ osɔfo ɔmɛ a nikɔtɔma amɛ kɛ ya na gbalɔ Yesaya, Amoz bi ɔ. Tsɔli ɔmɛ hu ha kpekpe ya bo. 3Sɛ gbi nɛ e ha mɛ kɛ ya ha Yesaya a ji, “Mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ, wa yi fi; a jɛ wɔ, nɛ a pue wa hɛ mi si. Wa pee kaa yo nɛ nu kɔɔmi, se e be he wami nɛ e kɛ maa kɛ̃ bi ɔ kɛ je kpo. 4Asiria matsɛ tsɔ e we asafoatsɛngua a kɛ ba jɛ Mawu hɛ kalɔ ɔ. Wa heɔ yeɔ kaa Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ nu kikɛmɛ a jɛmi ɔ, nɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ bɔ musu nɛ ɔ, e maa gbla a tue. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, moo fa kue ha Yawɛ kɛ ha wa ti ni nɛmɛ nɛ piɛ ngɛ hiɛ ɔ.”
5Benɛ Yesaya nine su Matsɛ Hezekia sɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ, 6e ngɔ Yawɛ sɛ gbi nɛ ɔ mane lɛ ke, “Munyuhi nɛ nyɛ nu nɛ Asiria matsɛ tsɔli ɔmɛ ba tu kɛ pue ye hɛ mi si ɔ, nyɛ ko ye gbeye ngɛ he. 7Hyɛ! Ma ha mumi ko maa ba e nɔ, nɛ e maa nu akeake munyu ko nɛ ma ha e maa kpale kɛ ya lɛ nitsɛ e zugba nɔ, nɛ ma ha e maa nɔ ngɛ ta mi ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.”
Asiria bi ɔmɛ tsɔ kɛ ba ekohu
(Matsɛmɛ II, 19.8-19)
8Asiria asafoatsɛngua a nu kaa Asiria matsɛ ɔ hia kɛ je Lakish, nɛ e kɛ Libna bi ya ngɛ ta hwue. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e ho nɛ e ya na lɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. 9Kɛkɛ nɛ gbi ko ba su Asiria matsɛ ɔ, kaa Sudan matsɛ, Tirhaka hia ta kɛ nyɛɛ Egipt tabo ɔ hɛ mi kɛ ma nɛ e ba tua lɛ. Benɛ Asiria matsɛ ɔ nu sane nɛ ɔ, e ngma womi, nɛ e tsɔ kɛ ya ha Yuda matsɛ, Hezekia. 10Bɔ nɛ e ngma ngɛ womi ɔ mi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Ko ha nɛ o Mawu ɔ nɛ o ngɔ o hɛ ngɔ fɔ e nɔ ɔ nɛ mlɔɔ mo ke i be nyɛe ma ngɔ Yerusalem. 11Mo nitsɛ o nu níhi nɛ Asiria matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ pee zugba amɛ; bɔ nɛ a kpata a hɛ mi butuu. Nɛ moo lɛɛ o susu kaa o maa ye o he lo? 12Benɛ nɛnɛmɛ kpata Gozan, Haran, kɛ Rezef ma amɛ a hɛ mi, nɛ a gbe Beteden bi ɔmɛ ngɛ Telasa zugba a nɔ ɔ, anɛ a mawu ɔmɛ nyɛ a yi wami he lo? 13Hamat matsɛ, Arpad matsɛ, Sefarvaim matsɛ, Hena matsɛ, kɛ Iva matsɛ ɔ, jije a ngɛ?”
14Matsɛ Hezekia he womi ɔ ngɛ tsɔli ɔmɛ a dɛ, nɛ e kane. Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e ho Yawɛ we ɔ ya, nɛ e ya bli womi ɔ mi gbajaa ngɔ pue si ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi, 15nɛ e fa kue ke, 16 “Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ Israel Mawu lee, mo nɛ o hii si ngɛ o matsɛ sɛ nɔ ngɛ kerub ɔmɛ a yi mi lokoo; mo nɔ kake too pɛ ji Mawu, nɛ je nɛ ɔ mi matsɛ yemi ɔmɛ tsuo ngɛ o sisi. Mo lɛ o bɔ hiɔwe kɛ zugba! 17Yawɛ, wa kpa mo pɛɛ jehanɛ, mo bli o hɛngmɛ nɛ o hyɛ nɔ́ nɛ a ngɛ wɔ pee! Yawɛ, mo ta tue nɛ o nu munyuhi nɛ Senakerib ngɛ tue kɛ ngɛ mo, Mawu hɛ kalɔ ɔ, o he guɛ gbee! 18Yawɛ, wɔ tsuo wa le kaa Asiria matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ kpata je mahi, kɛ a zugbahi babauu a hɛ mi, 19nɛ a sã a mawu ɔmɛ. A kpata a hɛ mi, ejakaa tsa pi mawu nitsɛnitsɛhi ji mɛ; nimli a nine nya ní tsumihi, kɛ tsohi, kɛ tɛhi kɛkɛ ji mɛ. 20Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yawɛ, wa Mawu, i kpa mo pɛɛ nɛ o kpɔ wɔ kɛ je Asiria matsɛ ɔ dɛ mi, konɛ je ma amɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ nɛ a le kaa mo Yawɛ, mo nɔ kake too ji Mawu.”
Yesaya kɛ sɛ gbi mane Hezekia
(Matsɛmɛ II, 19.20-37)
21Kɛkɛ nɛ Amoz binyumu Yesaya tsɔ ke a ya de Hezekia ke, “Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ ke, kue nɛ o fa ha lɛ ngɛ Asiria matsɛ, Senakerib he ɔ, e nu.” 22Nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ ngɛ Asiria matsɛ ɔ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ:
“Asiria matsɛ,
Zion biyo, yomiyo ɔ ngɛ mo muɔe oo!
23Mɛnɔ he fɛu o ye ɔ? Mɛnɔ ahlua o bɔ ɔ?
Mɛnɔ nɔ o wo o nya nɔ ngɛ ɔ? Mɛnɔ o bui ɔ?
Pi imi, Israel Mawu klɔuklɔu ɔ lo?
24O tsɔ o tsɔli kɛ ba ye imi
Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ye he fɛu, nɛ o de ke,
‘I ngɔ ye ta zugba lɛhi kɛ kuɔ yo ɔmɛ
kɛ ya su Lebanon tɔɔ.
I poo Lebanon seda tso gagaa amɛ,
kɛ sɛsɛo saminyawiiwi ɔmɛ ngɔ pue si.
I sɛ Lebanon hue kusuu ɔ mi
kɛ ya tsitsaa lokoo.
25I tsua vuhi
nɛ i nu ma se zugba nɔ nyu;
i ngɔ ye nane sisi kɛ naa
Egipt pa amɛ tsuo a mi nɛ nyu ɔ ta!’
26“Anɛ o nui kaa
i bɔni nɔ́ nɛ ɔ he ní tsumi kɛ je kɛ lo?
Nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ pee nɛ ɔ,
i to he ga kɛ je blema lokoo,
konɛ mahi nɛ a fia gbogbo ngɔ wo a he ɔ,
nyɛɛ pee mɛ ma dokuhi.
27Nimli nɛ ngɛ ma amɛ a mi lɛɛ
a he wami nɔ gbɔ.
A tsui po, nɛ bibi gbe mɛ.
A pee kaa nga mi tsohi.
A pee kaa nga mumu,
loo nga nɛ pu sã lɛ, nɛ e ngla
ngɛ tsu yi mi.
28“I le o he nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́,
nɔ́ nɛ o peeɔ, he nɛ o yaa,
kɛ bɔ nɛ o kɛ mi tuɔ munyu basabasa a.
29Akɛnɛ o kɛ mi tuɔ munyu basabasa,
nɛ i nu o he nɔ womi hu he he je ɔ,
ma ngɔ gbowe kɛ wo o gugwɔ mi;
ma wo o nya mi dade,
nɛ ma kpale mo kɛ gu
blɔ nɛ o gu kɛ ba a nɔ.”
30Jehanɛ, Yesaya de Matsɛ Hezekia ke, “Enɛ ɔ maa pee okadi ha mo; jeha nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, nyɛ maa ye níhi nɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a puɛ, níhi nɛ nɔ ko du we. Jeha enyɔne ɔ mi ɔ, nyɛ maa ye níhi nɛ puɛ ngɛ lɔ ɔmɛ a se. Jeha nɛ ji etɛ ɔ mi lɛɛ nyɛ ma du ní, nɛ nyɛ ma kpa ní; nyɛ maa pee wai ngmɔhi nɛ nyɛ maa ye a yiblii. 31Yuda we ɔ mi ni nɛmɛ nɛ a yi ma na wami ɔ, a ma plɔke kaa tsohi; a ma tsɛ̃ sipoku kɛ ya zu mi ekohu, nɛ a maa wo yiblii. 32Ni komɛ maa piɛ kɛ̃, nɛ a maa je Yerusalem kɛ Zion yo ɔmɛ a nɔ kɛ ya; ejakaa Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ ma tsu nɔ́ nɛ ɔ kɛ hɛdɔ.
33“Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, bɔ nɛ Yawɛ de ngɛ Asiria matsɛ ɔ he ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: ‘E be ma nɛ ɔ mi sɛe, nɛ e be kɛ̃ɛ̃ kake po tsɛ̃e kɛ ba hiɛ ɔ. Ta buli nɛ hɛɛ tsɛ̃i be ma a he sue, nɛ a be kpoku ko fiae kɛ wo ma a he. 34Blɔ nɛ e gu nɔ kɛ ba a, jamɛ a blɔ ɔ nɔ nɔuu e maa gu kɛ kpale kɛ ho; se ma nɛ ɔ mi lɛɛ e be sɛe. Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de. 35Ejakaa ma bu ma nɛ ɔ he; nɛ nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko be a he sae. Ma pee nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ngɛ ye tsɔlɔ David he kɛ wo imi nitsɛ ye hɛ mi nyami.’ ”
36Jamɛ a nyɔ ɔ mi nɔuu ɔ, Yawɛ bɔfo ko ya gbe ta buli 185,000 ngɛ Asiria ta a mi. E nɔ jena makɛ ɔ, ne mɛ nɛ a gbo kɛ pueɔ si. 37Kɛkɛ nɛ Asiria matsɛ Senakerib hia kɛ je lejɛ ɔ, nɛ e kpale kɛ ho Nineve ya. 38Ligbi ko, benɛ e ngɛ e mawu ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ Nisrok ɔ jae ngɛ e mawu ɔ we ɔ mi ɔ, e binyumuhi enyɔ, Adramelek kɛ Sharezer kɛ klaate ya gbe lɛ, nɛ a tu fo kɛ ho Ararat zugba a nɔ ya. E bi nyumu kpa nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Esarhadon ba ye matsɛ ngɛ e se.

Title: YESAYA 38
Content:
Matsɛ Hezekia ba nu hiɔ
(Matsɛmɛ II, 20.1-11; Kronika II, 32.24-26)
1Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, Matsɛ Hezekia ba nu hiɔ, nɛ e miɔ nɛ e ma gbo. Kɛkɛ nɛ gbalɔ Yesaya, Amoz binyumu ɔ ya nɛ e ya de lɛ ke, “Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ de ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: ‘Moo to o níhi blɔ nya ngɛ o we ɔ mi, ejakaa o yi be wami nae; o ma gbo!’ ”
2Hezekia plɛ e hɛ mi ngɔ wo gbogbo, nɛ e fa kue ha Yawɛ nɛ e de ke, 3“Yawɛ, i kpa mo pɛɛ nɛ o kai bɔ nɛ i ba ye je mi ngɛ o hɛ mi, bɔ nɛ i ye mo anɔkuale, bɔ nɛ i sɔmɔ mo kɛ ye tsui tsuo, kɛ bɔ nɛ i pee o suɔmi nya ní.” Nɛ Hezekia fo ya kɛ he hiami.
4Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ de Yesaya 5ke e ya nɛ e ya de Hezekia ke, “Imi Yawɛ, o nɛ̃ David Mawu ɔ, i nu o kue fami ɔ, nɛ i na o hɛ mi vo nyu ɔ. Ma ngɔ jeha nyɔngma kɛ enuɔ ngɔ piɛ o wami ligbi ɔmɛ a he ha mo. 6Ma he o kɛ Yerusalem yi wami kɛ je Asiria matsɛ ɔ dɛ mi, nɛ ma bu ma a he.”
21Yesaya de matsɛ tsɔli ɔmɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ wɛɛ ngmɔkɔ nɛ nyɛɛ ngɔ kɛ ya to e tslɔɔ ɔ nɔ, kɛkɛ e ma na he wami.” 22Kɛkɛ nɛ Hezekia hu bi Yesaya ke, “Mɛni okadi o maa to mi kaa niinɛ ma nyɛ ma ya Yawɛ we ɔ?”
7Yesaya he nɔ ke, “Yawɛ ma ha mo okadi nɛ ɔ kɛ tsɔɔ kaa si nɛ e wo mo ɔ, e maa ye nɔ. 8Ma ha nɛ nini ɔ nɛ ngɛ pu ngmlɛ nɛ Matsɛ Ahaz pee ɔ nɔ ɔ nɛ kpale kɛ ba se nane hiami nyɔngma.” E ba mi ja; niinɛ Yawɛ ha pu ɔ kpale e se, nɛ nini ɔ nɛ ngɛ pu ngmlɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ kpale e se nane hiami nyɔngma nɛ e nyɛɛ momo ɔ.
9Benɛ Yuda matsɛ Hezekia na he wami ɔ, e ngma yi jemi la nɛ ɔ.
10I de ngɛ ye yi mi ke
ye nihe be mi ma gbo ngɛ.
Ee, ye wami be nɛ piɛ ɔ,
gbeje ma ye lɛ tsuo ngɛ.
11I susu kaa i be Yawɛ nae gblegbleegble
ngɛ hɛ kali a zugba nɛ ɔ nɔ.
I susu hu kaa i be ye nyɛmimɛ adesahi
nae ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi hu.
12A po ye wami nɔ kpiti kulaa;
ye wami ɔ nya ta.
E pee kaa to hyɛlɔ bo tsu nɛ a kpa ngɔ fɔ si,
loo kaa bo nɛ bo lolɔ po nɔ ngɛ
e bo lomi tso ɔ he.
I susu kaa Mawu ha ye wami nyagbe
ma amlɔ nɔuu.
13Nyɔ mi tsuo i ngɛ kɛmɛe
kaa nɔ́ nɛ jata lɛ ngɛ ye mi wuhi kue.
I susu kaa Mawu ha ye wami nyagbe
ma amlɔ nɔuu.
14Ye gbi mia, he wami ko be hu.
I ngɛ kɛmɛe kaa beleku lahuɛ.
I hyɛ hiɔwe hluu kɛ ya si pɔ tɔ ye hɛngmɛ he.
Nyɔmtsɛ, i kpa mo pɛɛ, e fi mi;
jé mi kɛ je haomi nɛ ɔ mi.
15Kɛ ma de kɛɛ?
Bɔ nɛ e de ɔ, jã e pee ɔ nɛ.
Ye tsui ngɛ yee sɔuu,
i nyɛ we ma hwɔ mahe.
16Nyɔmtsɛ, o nɔ ji mi.
Ee, mo pɛ o nɔ i ngɔ ye hɛ kɛ fɔ.
Ha ma na he wami ekohu,
nɛ ye yi nɛ na wami.
17Niinɛ, kpakpa nɛ o ngɛ hlae ha mi
he je nɛ haomi nɛ nya wa nɛ ɔ
ba ye nɔ ɔ nɛ;
se o je mi kɛ je hɛ mi kpatami mi;
ejakaa o kɛ ye he yayami ɔmɛ tsuo pa mi.
18Ni gbogboehi be nyɛe ma je o yi.
Ee, ni gbogboehi be nyɛe maa na mo si.
Ni gbogboehi be nyɛe maa ngɔ a hɛ kɛ fɔ o nɔ
kaa o yeɔ anɔkuale be tsuaa be.
19Nihi nɛ ngɛ hɛ ngmengmle!
Ee, hɛ ngmengmletsɛmɛ nɛ a jeɔ o yi
kaa bɔ nɛ i ngɛ o yi jee mwɔnɛ nɛ ɔ.
Tsɛmɛ tsɔɔ a bimɛ ɔmɛ ke
o yeɔ anɔkuale be tsuaa be.
20Yawɛ, o he ye yi wami;
lɔ ɔ he ɔ, wa wami ligbihi tsuo ɔ,
wa ma la, nɛ wa maa fia kpa saku
kɛ to he kɛ je mo,
Yawɛ o yi,
ngɛ o we ɔ.

Title: YESAYA 39
Content:
Tsɔli nɛ je Babilonia
(Matsɛmɛ II, 20.12-19)
1Jamɛ a be ɔ, Babilonia matsɛ, Merodak Baladan, Baladan bi nyumu ɔ, nu kaa Matsɛ Hezekia ba na we he wami. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e ngma womi, nɛ e tsɔ nɛ a kɛ nike ní piɛ he ya ha lɛ. 2Matsɛ Hezekia he tsɔli ɔmɛ atuu, nɛ e ngɔ matsɛ mɔ ɔ mi ní kpakpa nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ tsɔɔ mɛ: sika tsu, sika hiɔ, tsopa kɛ e he via, nu kpakpa, e ta níhi tsuo, kɛ níhi tsuo nɛ ngɛ nito he ɔmɛ. Nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko be e we ɔ mi, loo e nɔ yemi he nito he tsu ɔmɛ a mi nɛ e kɛ tsɔɔ we mɛ. 3Kɛkɛ nɛ gbalɔ Yesaya ba Matsɛ Hezekia ngɔ, nɛ e ba bi lɛ ke, “Nyumu ɔmɛ nɛ ba o ngɔ ɔ, jije a je, nɛ mɛni a ba de mo?”
Hezekia he nɔ ke, “A je Babilonia zugba a nɔ, ngɛ tsitsaa lokoo.”
4Yesaya bi lɛ ekohu ke, “Mɛni a ba na ngɛ o we ɔ mi?”
Hezekia he nɔ ke, “A ba na ye we ɔ mi nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́; nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko be ye nito he ɔmɛ nɛ i kɛ tsɔɔ we mɛ.”
5Jehanɛ, Yesaya de Hezekia ke, “Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ ke 6be ma nɛ a ma ba muɔ o we ɔ mi nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́, kɛ níhi nɛ o nɛmɛ ɔmɛ bua nya ngɔ to kɛ ba si mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ kɛ ho Babilonia ya; a be nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko sie. Yawɛ lɛ de. 7 A maa nuu mo nitsɛ o bimɛ ɔmɛ ekomɛ po kɛ ya Babilonia; a maa puɛ mɛ, nɛ a ma ya sɔmɔ ngɛ Babilonia matsɛ we ɔ mi.”
8Se Matsɛ Hezekia susu kaa nɔ́ nɛ ɔ kɛ he jɔmi, kɛ tue mi jɔmi maa ba ngɛ lɛɛ e yi nɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e de Yesaya ke, “Yawɛ sɛ gbi nɛ o ngɔ ba ha mi ɔ hi.”

Title: YESAYA 40
Content:
Hɛ kɛ nɔ fami munyuhi
1Bɔ nɛ wa Mawu ɔ ngɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ:
“Nyɛɛ jɔɔ ye ma a bua!
Ee, nyɛɛ jɔɔ ye ma a bua!
2Nyɛɛ wo Yerusalem ma a bua.
Nyɛ de nɛ a nu kaa
jehanɛ lɛɛ a nɔ́ nami babauu ɔ se po,
nɛ a ngɔ a he yayami ɔmɛ ngɔ pa mɛ.
I gbla a tue saminya ngɛ a tɔmi ɔmɛ tsuo a he.”
3 Gbi ko ngɛ pɛe ke,
“Nyɛ dla blɔ ngɛ nga a nɔ
ha Yawɛ!
Nyɛɛ je gbɛjegbɛ tlɔmɔɔ
ngɛ nga kplanaa a nɔ
ha wa Mawu ɔ!
4Nyɛɛ tsi kɔ̃ tsuaa kɔ̃,
nyɛ ha yo tsuaa yo,
kɛ yoku tsuaa yoku nɛ ba si.
Zugba nɛ nɔ ngɛ tsakatsaka, kɛ
nɔ́ nɛ nɔ ngɛ googagooga tsuo a nɔ nɛ sɔ.
5Kɛkɛ ɔ, Yawɛ hɛ mi nyami ɔ maa je kpo paa
nɛ nimli adesahi tsuo maa na.
Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ de to ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.”
6 Gbi ko ngɛ pɛe ke,
“Moo fiɛ!”
I bi ke,
“Kɛ ma fiɛ kɛɛ?”
Moo fiɛ ke,
“Nimli adesahi tsuo ngɛ kaa nga,
nɛ a he fɛu tsuo ngɛ kaa mɔmɔ ngɛ nga nɔ.
7Ke Yawɛ kɔɔhiɔ fia kɛ gu a nɔ pɛ
nga a gbli, kɛkɛ mɔmɔ ɔ hu ngla.
Niinɛ, nɔmlɔ adesa ngɛ kaa nga kɛkɛ!
8Nga gbliɔ, nɛ mɔmɔ hu nglaa;
se wa Mawu ɔ munyu ɔ lɛɛ
e ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene.”
Ne nyɛ Mawu ɔ
9Zion, mo manye munyu fiɛlɔ!
Kuɔɔ kɛ ya yo gagaa ko nɔ,
nɛ o ya fiɛ manye munyu ɔ kɛ he wami.
Yerusalem, mo manye munyu fiɛlɔ,
wo o gbi nɔ wawɛɛ, nɛ o fiɛ;
koo ye gbeye!
De Yuda ma amɛ ke,
“Ne nyɛ Mawu ɔ!”
10 Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ma kɛ he wami;
e ngɛ tsɛ yee;
e hɛɛ e ma mi bi ɔmɛ a hiɔwo kɛ ma;
e maa wo nɔ tsuaa nɔ hiɔ
ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ e tsu he.
11 E maa lɛ e to kuu ɔ kaa to hyɛlɔ kpakpa;
e ma bua e to bi ɔmɛ a nya,
nɛ e maa hɛɛ mɛ ngɛ e bɔkɔ mi;
to nyɛ ɔmɛ hu e ma tsɔ̃ mɛ blɛuu.
Israel Mawu ɔ se be
12Mɛnɔ lɛ hɛɛ nyu tsuo nɛ ngɛ wo mi ɔ
ngɛ e dɛ kɔkɔ mi hyɛ?
Mɛnɔ lɛ ngɔ e nine mi blimi kɛ susu
hiɔwe hyɛ?
Mɛnɔ lɛ ngɔ je nɛ ɔ mi tabo zu tsuo
kɛ wo kplu mi hyɛ?
Loo e ngmɛ yo ɔmɛ, kɛ yoku ɔmɛ
ngɛ sɛni nɔ hyɛ?
13 Mɛnɔ lɛ tsɔɔ Yawɛ mumi ɔ nɔ́ nɛ e pee?
Mɛnɔ lɛ tsɔɔ lɛ ní, loo e wo lɛ ga hyɛ?
14Mɛnɔ lɛ Mawu kɛ lɛ toɔ ga,
nɛ e tsɔɔ Mawu nile, nɔ́ sisi numi,
kɛ bɔ nɛ e pee nɔ́ nɛ da?
15Je ma amɛ pi nɔ́ ko kulaa ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi.
A ngɛ kaa nyu kɔyi kake kɛkɛ nɛ dɛ
kɛ je goga mi.
Zugba kpɔ ɔmɛ nɛ wo bɔle mɛ ɔ hu ngɛ wojowojo
ngɛ Yawɛ dɛ mi
kaa bunyuku nɛ pue sɛni nɔ.
16Lebanon tso ɔmɛ tsuo a he pi
nɛ a kɛ ma slɛ la.
Lohwehi nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ hu a he pi
nɛ a kɛ maa sã sami bɔ.
17Je ma amɛ pi nɔ́ ko ngɛ e hɛ mi;
e buu mɛ kaa ní guhi
nɛ a he be se nami.
18 Mɛnɔ he nyɛ maa ngɔ Mawu kɛ to mɔ?
Nɛ mɛni subai nyɛɛ kɛ maa to e he?
19Amaga lo?
Amaga nɛ tso galɔ kpɛ,
nɛ sika galɔ ngɔ sika tsu kɛ ha he,
nɛ e ngɔ sika hiɔ kɔsɔkɔsɔ
ngɔ kpla lɛ ɔ!
20Dɛgutsɛ lɛɛ bɔ nɛ e peeɔ ji,
e ngɔɔ tso kpakpa kɛ haa tso galɔ
nɛ le ní tsumi saminya.
Tso galɔ nɛ ɔ ngɔɔ tso ɔ kɛ peeɔ amaga ha lɛ,
amaga nɛ mimiɛ we e he.
21Bɔ nɛ a plɛ kɛ to je ɔ sisi ɔ,
anɛ nyɛ li lo?
Anɛ nyɛ nui hyɛ lo?
Anɛ a de we nyɛ enɛ ɔ
kɛ je blema lokoo lo?
22Mawu ji nɔ nɛ bɔ je ɔ nɛ;
e hii si ngɛ hiɔwe lokoo,
nɛ je ɔ fɔɔ si ngɛ e sisi.
Nimli adesahi ngɛ kaa angmɛɛtɛ ngɛ je ɔ mi.
Mawu bli hiɔwe mi kaa bo,
nɛ e pee lɛ kaa bo tsu nɛ a hiɔ mi.
23Ganɔhi po e baa mɛ tsuo si,
nɛ e peeɔ nɔ yeli posoposo.
24A ngɛ kaa tso tsɔwi nɛ a du kɛ we,
nɛ́ a sipokuhi mɛ si kpakpa ko lolo.
Ke Yawɛ ha kɔɔhiɔ fia kɛ gu a nɔ
kɛkɛ a gbliɔ,
nɛ kɔɔhiɔ bɛɛɔ mɛ kɛ yaa kaa nga.
25Mɛnɔ he nyɛ maa ngɔ Mawu Klɔuklɔu ɔ kɛ to?
Mɛnɔ kɛ lɛ sɔ?
26Nyɛ wo nyɛ yi nɔ nɛ nyɛɛ hyɛ hiɔwe!
Mɛnɔ lɛ bɔ dodoe ɔmɛ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ hyɛe ɔ?
Nɔ nɛ jeɔ mɛ kpo kaa ta buli babauu,
nɛ e kɛ eko tsuaa eko biɛ tsɛɔ lɛ ɔ!
E he wami, kɛ nyɛmi kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ nya a,
kake ngmelu po laa we.
27Israel, lɛɛ mɛni he je o ngɛ dee ke
Yawɛ li kaa o ngɛ nɔ́ nae,
nɛ e bui kaa a ngɛ mo amimi yee ɔ?
28Anɛ o li lo? Anɛ o nui lolo lo?
Yawɛ ji Mawu nɛ ngɛ daa kɛ daa;
lɛ ji nɔ nɛ bɔ je ɔ tsuo.
Pɔ tɔɛ lɛ, nɛ e gbɔjɔɔ we.
Bɔ nɛ e juɛmi mi kuɔ ha a,
nɔ ko nɔ ko be nyɛe maa nu sisi.
29Ni nɛmɛ nɛ gbɔjɔ, nɛ pɔ tɔ mɛ ɔ,
e haa mɛ he wami.
30Nihewi kpakpataa po gbɔjɔɔ,
nɛ pɔ tɔɔ mɛ;
nihewi a he wami taa,
nɛ a nɔɔ si.
31Se ni nɛmɛ nɛ ngɔɔ a hɛ ngɔ fɔɔ Yawɛ nɔ ɔ,
a naa he wami he kaa kɔle nɛ ngɛ tee;
a tuɔ fo, nɛ pɔ tɔɛ mɛ,
a nyɛɛɔ, nɛ a gbɔjɔɔ we.

Title: YESAYA 41
Content:
Mawu ma e munyu nɔ mi ha Israel
1Mawu ke,
“Nyɛ, wo nya mahi,
nyɛɛ pee dii, nɛ nyɛɛ bu mi tue!
Nyɛ dla nyɛ he saminya,
konɛ waa hyɛ sane ɔ mi!
Nyɛɛ hɛ nyɛ kɛ ba, konɛ nyɛ ba je nyɛ nya,
nɛ waa hyɛ nɔ nɛ nɔ́ da.
2“Jamɛ a kunimi yelɔ ɔ nɛ yeɔ kunimi ngɛ he tsuaa he ɔ,
mɛnɔ lɛ ngɔ lɛ kɛ je beleku je kɛ ba?
Mɛnɔ haa nɛ e yeɔ matsɛmɛ, kɛ je ma amɛ a nɔ ɔ?
E kɛ e klaate peeɔ mɛ butuu kaa bunyuku,
nɛ e kɛ̃ɛ̃ ɔ gbɛɛ mɛ fĩaa
kaa nga nɛ kɔɔhiɔ muɔ kɛ yaa.
3E nyɛɛɔ a se kɛ fo wawɛɛ
kaa nɔ́ nɛ e nane ma we zugba,
nɛ e nine ya suu a nɔ kɛ̃.
4Mɛnɔ ji nɔ nɛ pee enɛ ɔ?
Mɛnɔ lɛ tsɛ yi nɔ ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ je sisije?
Sisije ɔ, imi Yawɛ, i ngɛ lejɛ ɔ;
nɛ nyagbe ɔ hu, imi Yawɛ nɔuu
ma hi lejɛ ɔ.
5“Nihi nɛ a ngɛ wo nya ma amɛ a mi ɔ
na nɔ́ nɛ i tsu ɔ, nɛ a ye gbeye;
je ɔ tsuo mimiɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, mɛ tsuo a bua a he nya
nɛ a ba.
6Nɔ tsuaa nɔ piɛɔ e nyɛmi ní tsulɔ he.
A woɔ a sibi bua, nɛ a deɔ ke,
‘Na tsui!’
7Tso galɔ deɔ sika tsu galɔ ke,
‘O bɔ mɔde, e hi!’
Nɔ nɛ kɛ hamle ngɛ amaga a he dlae ɔ
hu woɔ nɔ nɛ ngɛ ní tsue ngɛ sɔ̃ tɛ nɔ ɔ
he wami jã kɛ̃; e deɔ nɔ́ sɔ̃lɔ ɔ ke,
‘Bɔ nɛ o sɔu ɔ hi.’
Kɛkɛ ɔ, a ngɔɔ plɛɛko bihi kɛ kaa,
konɛ e ko kpɔ.
8 “Se mo, ye tsɔlɔ Israel,
mo ji ma nɛ i hla,
ye huɛ Abraham nina.
9I ngɔ mo kɛ je je ɔ nyagbe he ɔmɛ kɛ ba;
i tsɛ mo kɛ je ma se lokoo,
nɛ i de mo ke,
‘Ye tsɔlɔ ji mo.’
I kua we mo,
se mohu, i hla mo.
10Koo ye gbeye. I kɛ mo ngɛ!
Ko ha nɛ nɔ́ ko nɛ wo o he gbeye.
Imi ji o Mawu ɔ nɛ!
Ma wo mo he wami; ma piɛ o he;
Ma bu o he, nɛ ma baa o yi.
11“Hyɛ, nihi tsuo nɛ a mi mi fu mo ɔ,
zo maa gbe mɛ, nɛ a hɛ mi ma pue si.
Nihi nɛ kɛ mo ná a,
a hɛ mi ma kpata pɛsɛpɛsɛ.
12Nihi tsuo nɛ kɛ mo ná a,
o be mɛ nae hu;
nihi nɛ hia ta wo mo ɔ,
a hɛ mi ma kpata pɛsɛpɛsɛ.
13Ejakaa imi ji Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ nɛ;
imi lɛ i ngɛ mo he wami woe ɔ nɛ,
i ngɛ mo dee ke,
‘Koo ye gbeye! Ma piɛ o he!’ ”
14Yawɛ ke,
“Yakob, o ngɛ kaa gɔgɔ kɛkɛ;
o Israel, ma nɛ o he wɛ,
koo ye gbeye; ma piɛ o he.
Imi, Israel Mawu klɔuklɔu ɔ,
imi ji o yi wami helɔ.
15Hyɛ, ma pee mo kaa ngma mi sami he klama
kɛ e lunguhi nɛ a nya ba.
O maa ywia yo ɔmɛ,
nɛ o maa pee mɛ butuu;
o maa pee yoku ɔmɛ kaa jakati.
16O maa fɔ̃ mɛ kɛ ya kɔɔhiɔ mi;
nɛ kɔɔhiɔ maa muɔ mɛ kɛ ho.
Ahumi maa gbɛ mɛ kɛ fĩa;
se moo lɛɛ, o bua maa jɔ saminya;
ejakaa imi ji o Mawu ɔ nɛ.
O ma je imi! Israel Mawu Klɔuklɔu ɔ, ye yi.
17“Ke ye ma a ní pee mɔbɔ,
nɛ a nɛ nyu nɛ a nu,
a kuɔ si tsuo gbli, nɛ kuma ngɛ mɛ yee ɔ,
ke a fa kue kɛ tsɛ imi Yawɛ ɔ,
ma bu mɛ tue.
Imi Israel Mawu ɔ, i be mɛ kuae kɔkɔɔkɔ.
18Ma ha pahi maa hia ngɛ yo kpataa amɛ a nɔ,
nɛ nyu maa fo dɔ ngɛ kɔ̃ ɔmɛ a mi.
Ma ha nga kplanaa a nɔ ma plɛ pee taku,
nɛ nyu maa ba babaaba ngɛ zugba gbigbli ɔ nɔ.
19Ma ha seda tso, akasia tso, mɔmɔ tso, kɛ oliv tso
maa bɔ ngɛ nga kplanaa a nɔ.
Ma ha zugba nɛ nɔ́ ko be nɔ ɔ ma plɛ pee hue
nɛ sɛsɛo, papao, kɛ nga mi tsohi ngɛ mi.
20Mahi tsuo maa na nyakpɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ,
nɛ a maa le kaa
imi Yawɛ, Israel Nɔ Klɔuklɔu ɔ
nɛ i tsu nɔ́ nɛ ɔ nɛ.”
Yawɛ pue lakpa mawu ɔmɛ a hɛ mi si
21Yawɛ, Israel matsɛ ɔ ke,
“Nyɛ je ma amɛ, nyɛɛ jaje nyɛ sane ɔ
nɛ waa nu.
Nyɛ je nyɛ we odase ɔmɛ kpo.
22Nyɛɛ ba nɛ nyɛ ba gba níhi nɛ maa ba hwɔɔ se,
konɛ ke a ba mi ɔ,
waa le kaa ja nyɛ de ɔ nɛ.
Níhi nɛ ba momo ɔ, nyɛ gba mi kɛ tsɔɔ wɔ,
nɛ nyɛɛ tsɔɔ wɔ a sisi.
23Nyɛɛ gba níhi nɛ maa ba hwɔɔ se,
kɛkɛ wa maa na kaa mawuhi ji nyɛ niinɛ!
Nyɛɛ pee nɔ́ ko nɛ hi saminya,
aloo nyɛ ha nɛ haomi ko nɛ ba;
nyɛɛ pee nɔ́ ko nɛ maa wo wa he gbeye,
loo nɔ́ ko nɛ maa pee wɔ nyakpɛ
nɛ waa hyɛ!
24Nyɛɛ hyɛ, nyɛ pi nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko kulaa,
nɛ nyɛ ní tsumi hu nɔ ko bui fɛɛ;
nihi nɛ jaa nyɛ ɔ, nimli guhi ji mɛ;
a ngɛ kaa nyɛ kɛ̃.
25“I ha nɛ nɔ ko je beleku je kɛ ma
nɛ e kɛ nyɛ ba kpe.
E maa ba ngɛ ye biɛ mi.
E ma ba tua nyɛ kɛ je omleyi je.
E maa naa nɔ yeli a nɔ kaa a naa zu,
loo kaa buɛ puɛlɔ pɔtɔɔ zu.
26Nyɛ ti mɛnɔ gba enɛ ɔ kɛ to momo
ke bɔ nɛ e maa ba ji nɛ ɔ,
konɛ wa de ke,
‘Ja tutuutu o gba a nɛ.’
Nyɛ ti nɔ ko nɔ ko de we nɔ́ nɛ ɔ he nɔ́ ko.
Nɔ ko nɔ ko wui nɔ ta,
nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko nui hulɔ.
27Imi Yawɛ ji kekleekle nɔ nɛ bɔ Zion amaniɛ nɛ ɔ.
Imi nɛ i tsɔ nɔ Yerusalem kɛ manye munyu ke,
‘O ma mi bi ɔmɛ ma oo!
A ma we!’
28Benɛ i hyɛ ɔ,
nɔ ko nɔ ko be a mawu ɔmɛ a kpɛti
nɛ nyɛ́ de nɔ́ ko kulaa.
Ke i bi mɛ munyu hu,
nɔ ko nɔ ko nyɛ we nɛ e ha mi heto.
29Nyɛɛ hyɛ, mawu nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo pi nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko kulaa;
a nyɛ we nɔ́ ko kpakpa nɛ a tsu.
Amaga amɛ nɛ a puɛ ɔ,
a he be se nami;
a ngɛ kaa kɔɔhiɔ kɛkɛ.”

Title: YESAYA 42
Content:
Yawɛ tsɔlɔ ɔ
1 Yawɛ ke,
“Ye tsɔlɔ, nɔ nɛ i kplɛɛ we nɔ́ ngɛ e he ɔ,
lɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Nɔ nɛ i hla nɛ i suɔ e sane ɔ,
lɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
I ngɔ ye mumi ɔ kɛ wo e mi,
nɛ e maa ye dami sane
kɛ kojo je ma amɛ tsuo.
2E be ngmlaa kpae,
nɛ e be munyu tue boboobo
nɛ a nu ngɛ gbɛjegbɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ hulɔ.
3Ngɔwu nɛ mi dɔ momo ɔ, e be mi kue,
nɛ kane nɛ ngɛ tsoe sulii ɔ, e be gbee.
E maa ye dami sane kɛ maa ya neneene.
4E kɔni mi be jɔ̃e, nɛ pɔ be lɛ tɔe
kɛ yaa si dami sane yemi
ma he si ngɛ je ɔ mi tsuo.
Zugbahi nɛ ngɛ tsitsaa lokoo ɔ po
maa hyɛ lɛ blɔ nɛ e ba wo mɛ ga.”
5 Yawɛ Mawu ɔ,
lɛ nɛ bɔ hiɔwe,
nɛ e bli mi gbajaa.
Lɛ nɛ bɔ zugba a, kɛ níhi tsuo nɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ ɔ.
Lɛ nɔ nɛ ha nimli adesahi tsuo
wami kɛ mumi ɔ,
bɔ nɛ e ngɛ e tsɔlɔ ɔ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ:
6 “Imi Yawɛ lɛ i tsɛ mo;
i baa o yi, nɛ i ha mo he wami,
konɛ o hyɛ nɛ a ye dami sane
ngɛ je ɔ mi.
Ma gu o nɔ nɛ i kɛ je ma amɛ tsuo maa so,
nɛ a ma na la.
7O ma bli hɛ yuyuili a hɛngmɛ,
nɛ nihi nɛ a wo mɛ tsu,
nɛ a hii si ngɛ diblii mi ɔ,
o ma ha a maa ye a he.
8“Ye biɛ ji Yawɛ;
imi pɛ ji Mawu.
I be ye hɛ mi nyami ɔ ngɔe kɛ ha mawu kpahi,
nɛ ye yi jemi ɔ hu i be ngɔe kɛ ha amagahi.
9Nyɛɛ hyɛ koo! Níhi nɛ i de to blema a ba mi.
Jehanɛ, ma gba nyɛ níhi nɛ maa ba.
I ngɛ nyɛ dee loko a ba mi.”
Yi jemi la
10Nyɛ la la he ha Yawɛ;
nyɛ je ɔ tsuo, nyɛ la kɛ je e yi!
Nyɛ nihi nɛ nyɛ nyɛɛ wo hɛ mi, nyɛ je e yi!
Nibɔ níhi tsuo nɛ ngɛ wo ɔ mi, nyɛ je e yi!
Zugbahi ngɛ tsitsaa lokoo,
kɛ nihi tsuo nɛ ngɛ a nɔ, nyɛ je e yi!
11Nyɛ ha nga kplanaa a kɛ e nɔ ma amɛ tsuo nɛ a je Mawu yi.
Nyɛ ha Kedar bi ɔmɛ nɛ a je e yi!
Nyɛ ha nihi nɛ ngɛ Sela ma a mi
nɛ a hwɔ lele ngɛ yo ɔmɛ a nɔ!
12Nyɛ ha nihi nɛ ngɛ zugbahi a nɔ
ngɛ tsitsaa lokoo ɔ nɛ a wo Yawɛ hɛ mi nyami!
13Yawɛ hia kpo kaa ta bulɔ;
e hia kpo kaa ta bulɔ nɛ hɛ dɔ.
E ngɛ ngmlaa kpae.
E ngɛ ose hee
kɛ ngɛ e he nyɛli ɔmɛ woe
kaa e kɛ mɛ maa to ní.
Mawu wo si kaa e maa piɛ e ma a he
14Mawu ke,
“I pee kpoo hluu;
i ma ye nya, nɛ i ye ye he nɔ.
Se jehanɛ lɛɛ be ɔ su;
ma kpa ngmlaa kaa yo nɛ nu kɔɔmi,
ma kɛmɛ kaa nɔ nɛ mumi nya ngɛ tae.
15Ma kpata yo ɔmɛ, kɛ yoku ɔmɛ a hɛ mi,
nɛ ma ha a nɔ nga kɛ tsohi tsuo ma gbli.
Ma ha pa amɛ a mi nyu ɔ maa mii,
nɛ pa amɛ ma plɛ pee zugba gbigbli.
16“Ma ngɔ ye hɛ yuyuili ɔmɛ kɛ gu hehi
nɛ a nyɛɛ we hyɛ.
Ma ha a diblii ɔ ma plɛ pee la;
nɛ ma ha zugba nɛ nɔ ngɛ googagooga a
nɔ maa sɔ tɛtlɛɛ ha mɛ.
Níhi nɛ i ngɛ si woe kaa ma pee ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ;
ma ha a maa ba mi pɛpɛɛpɛ.
17Se nihi nɛ ngɔɔ a hɛ ngɔ fɔɔ amagahi a nɔ,
amagahi nɛ a kpɛ́, loo a puɛ,
nɛ a kpale deɔ ke a mawuhi ji mɛ ɔ,
a maa ba mɛ si, nɛ zo maa gbe mɛ.”
Israel kase we ní
18Yawɛ ke,
“Nyɛ tuekpokutsɛmɛ, nyɛɛ bu tue!
Nyɛ hɛ yuyuili, nyɛɛ hyɛ nɛ nyɛɛ na ní!
19Anɛ nɔ ko ngɛ nɛ e hɛ yu pe ye tsɔlɔ ɔ,
loo nɛ e tue tsi pe nɔ nɛ i tsɔ
kɛ sɛ pɔtɛɛ ɔ lo?
20Israel, o naa níhi babauu,
se o kɔ se lo?
O ngɛ tue hu nɛ o kɛ nuɔ nɔ́,
se mɛni tutuutu o nu?”
21Yawɛ ji Mawu nɛ suɔ kaa
e ma he o yi wami;
lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e wo mlaa kpakpahi,
e to blɔ nya nɛ hi saminya,
nɛ e suɔ kaa e ma a nɛ ye a nɔ.
22Se amlɔ nɛ ɔ, a fia e ma a ojo,
nɛ a nuu ni ɔmɛ kɛ ya wo tsu.
A kpɔ a níhi ngɛ a dɛ, nɛ a ha a níhi;
nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko bɛ nɛ e ba je ngmlaa ha mɛ.
23Nyɛ kpɛti mɛnɔ maa bu nɔ́ nɛ ɔ tue?
Kɛ je be nɛ ɔ kɛ yaa a, mɛnɔ ma ta tue,
konɛ e nu níhi nɛ maa ba a?
24Mɛnɔ lɛ ngɔ Yakob kɛ ha nɛ a ha e níhi,
nɛ mɛnɔ ha nɛ a fia lɛ ojo ɔ?
Yawɛ nitsɛ, nɔ nɛ wa pee yayami kɛ si ɔ,
lɛ ji nɔ nɛ ha enɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ba!
Wa bɛ wa je mi bɔ nɛ e ngɛ hlae,
nɛ mlaa amɛ nɛ e wo wɔ ɔ hu wa yi a nɔ.
25Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e ha wa nu e mi mi fumi
nɛ nya wa a he,
nɛ ta nɛ nya wa ba tua wɔ.
E mi mi la a mle kɛ wo Israel he kɛ kpe,
se a li nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ nɔ yae ɔ;
wa kase we nɔ́ ko kulaa kɛ ji mi.

Title: YESAYA 43
Content:
Mawu wo si ke e ma he e ma a yi wami
1Se jehanɛ lɛɛ Israel, Yawɛ nɛ bɔ mo ɔ ngɛ mo dee ke,
“Koo ye gbeye.
Imi nitsɛ ma he o yi wami.
O biɛ i ngɔ kɛ tsɛ mo ɔ nɛ;
ye nɔ́ ji mo.
2Ke o haomi ɔmɛ pee kaa pa nɛ o ngɛ poe po,
ma piɛ o he; o haomi ɔmɛ be nyɛe maa ye o nɔ.
Ke o nyɛɛ la mi po,
la a be mo sãe.
Haomihi tsuo nɛ maa ba o nɔ ɔ,
o maa ye a nɔ.
3Ejakaa imi Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ,
imi Israel Mawu Klɔuklɔu ɔ
lɛ he o yi wami ɔ nɛ.
Ma ngɔ Egipt ngɔ ha ngɛ o nane mi,
konɛ o ye o he.
Ma ngmɛɛ Sudan kɛ Seba hu a he.
4Akɛnɛ o he jua wa ha mi,
akɛnɛ o hɛ mi ba nyami,
nɛ i suɔ mo he je ɔ,
ma ngmɛɛ je mahi kɛ a mi bi ɔmɛ a he
ngɔ ha, konɛ ma he o yi wami.
5Koo ye gbeye, imi nitsɛ i kɛ mo ngɛ!
“Ma bua o nina nya
kɛ maa je beleku je, kɛ bonyoku je
kɛ maa ba we.
6Ma de omleyi je ke, ‘Ngmɛɛ a he nɛ a ho,’
nɛ ma de leneyi je hu ke, ‘Koo tsi a nya.
Nyɛ ha nɛ ye ma a nɛ kpale kɛ ba,
kɛ je zugba amɛ a nɔ
ngɛ tsitsaa lokoo ngɛ je ɔ mi tsuo.
7Imi nitsɛ ye ma ji mɛ;
nɛ i bɔ mɛ, konɛ a wo ye hɛ mi nyami.’ ”
Israel ji Yawɛ we odase
8Mawu ke,
“Tsɛ ye ma a kɛ ba nɛ waa kpe.
A ngɛ hɛngmɛ, se a hyɛ we nɔ́,
a ngɛ tue hulɔ, se a nui nɔ́!
9Tsɛ je ma amɛ tsuo kɛ ba,
nɛ a ba bua a he nya.
A ti mɛnɔ ma nyɛ maa sɛɛ wɔ blema níhi.
Ha nɛ a we odase yeli ɔmɛ nɛ a ba,
nɛ a ba nu, konɛ a de ke
e ngɛ mi, loo e be mi.
10“Israel ma, mo ji ye we odase.
Imi ji nɔ nɛ hla mo, konɛ o pee ye tsɔlɔ,
bɔ nɛ pee nɛ o le mi,
o he ye nɔ nɛ o ye,
nɛ o na nɛ o le kaa imi pɛ ji Mawu.
Ye se ɔ, mawu kpa ko be hu,
mawu kpa ko hi si hyɛ,
nɛ eko be bae gblegbleegble.
11“Imi nɔ kake pɛ ji Yawɛ,
imi pɛ ji nɔ nɛ ma nyɛ ma he o yi wami.
12Níhi nɛ ba a, imi Yawɛ nɔuu lɛ i de to,
nɛ i ba piɛ o he.
Ma se mawu ko pee we nɔ́ nɛ ɔ eko hyɛ;
mo ji ye we odase.
13Imi ji Mawu, nɛ i ngɛ daa.
Nɔ ko nɔ ko be nyɛe ma je e he kɛ je ye dɛ mi.
Ke i pee nɔ́ ko ɔ, mɛnɔ ma tsake?”
Israel ma a je Babilon
14Yawɛ, yi wami helɔ, Israel Mawu Klɔuklɔu ɔ, bɔ nɛ e de ji nɛ ɔ nɛ:
“Ma tsɔ nihi kɛ ya Babilon tɔɔ kɛ he o yi wami.
Ma ku agbo ɔmɛ ngɔ pue si,
nɛ lele nɛ a ngɛ hwɔe ɔ ma plɛ pee kɔmɔ yemi.
15Imi ji Yawɛ Mawu klɔuklɔu ɔ nɛ.
Israel, imi ji o bɔlɔ, kɛ o matsɛ.”
16Blema lokoo ɔ, Yawɛ je blɔ ko kɛ gu wo ɔ mi.
Blɔ ɔ gu nyu glegleegle ɔ mi.
17Ta nguaa nɛ ngɛ he wami,
nɛ je kpo kɛ e ta zugba lɛhi kɛ okpɔngɔhi babauu ɔ,
e ha mɛ tsuo a nɔ si
nɛ a nyɛ we nɛ a te si hu;
a la a gbo kaa kane mi tako, loo
kaa kane nɛ nu ta mi.
18Se Yawɛ ke,
“Blema sanehi, kɛ blema níhi nɛ be momo ɔ,
nyɛ ko ngɔ nyɛ juɛmi ngɔ fɔ a nɔ hu.
19Nɔ́ he nɛ ma pee ɔ, nyɛɛ hyɛ lɔ ɔ mohu blɔ;
nɔ́ he ɔ je sisi momo;
nyɛ bli nyɛ hɛngmɛ nɛ nyɛɛ hyɛ!
Ma je gbɛjegbɛ ko kɛ gu nga kplanaa a nɔ,
nɛ ma ha pahi maa hia ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.
20Nga mi lohwe nane eywiɛɛywiɛtsɛmɛ pohu
maa wo ye hɛ mi nyami;
nga mi gbehi, kɛ dugumahi ma je ye yi.
Ejakaa ma ha pahi maa hia kɛ be
ngɛ nga kplanaa a nɔ,
nɛ ye ma nɛ i hla a ma na nyu maa nu.
21Mɛ ji ye ma nɛ imi nitsɛ i bɔ ha ye he,
konɛ a la kɛ je ye yi!”
Yayami nɛ Israel pee
22Yawɛ ke,
“Se mo Israel, ye he sane ba ti mo;
o ja we mi hu.
23O ngɔɛ jijɔ kɛ ba sã we sami bɔ ha mi;
nɛ o ngɔɛ bɔhi kɛ ba wui ye hɛ mi nyami hulɔ.
I gba we o nya ke o ba sã bɔ ha mi,
loo o ba ha mi tsopa kɛ e he via.
24O he we tsopa kɛ e he via ha mi,
nɛ o ngɔɛ lohwehi a zɔ hu kɛ ba sã we bɔ
kɛ sa ye hɛ mi,
se mohu, o ngɔ o he yayami
kɛ ngɛ mi haoe sɔuu,
nɛ pɔ tɔ mi kɛ o tɔmi ɔmɛ.
25Se imi nɔuu ji Mawu nɛ ngɔɔ o he yayami
ngɔ paa mo.
I be o he yayami ɔmɛ kaie hu.
26“Mo kai mi, konɛ waa hla mi.
Moo jaje o sane ɔ koo,
konɛ waa hyɛ nɔ nɛ nɔ́ da!
27O nɛ̃ pee yayami,
nɛ ma nimeli ɔmɛ hu tɔ ye nɔ,
28nɛ nyɛ ganɔ ɔmɛ hu ble ye he klɔuklɔu ɔ;
lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i ha a kpata Israel hɛ mi;
i ha a pue ye ma a hɛ mi si.”

Title: YESAYA 44
Content:
Yawɛ nɔ kake too pɛ ji Mawu
1Yawɛ ke,
“Jehanɛ, mo Israel, ye tsɔlɔ, ye ma nɛ i hla,
Yakob nina, bu tue.
2Imi ji Yawɛ nɛ bɔ mo ɔ nɛ;
kɛ je be nɛ a fɔ mo kɛ ba su amlɔ nɛ ɔ,
imi lɛ i baa o yi.
Koo ye gbeye, ye tsɔlɔ ji mo,
ye ma nɛ i hla nɛ i suɔ mo.
3“Nihi nɛ kuma ngɛ mɛ yee ɔ,
ma ha mɛ nyu nɛ a nu.
Ma ha zugba gbigbli ɔ nyu,
nɛ pahi maa hia.
Ma ngɔ ye mumi ɔ kɛ wo o bimɛ ɔmɛ a mi,
nɛ ma gbaa o nina a.
4A ma plɔke kaa nga nɛ na nyu saminya,
loo tsohi ngɛ pa tue.
5“Nɔ kake ma de ke ‘Imi lɛɛ Mawu nɔ́ ji mi;’
nɔ kake ma tsɛ e he ke Yakob.
Nɔ kake hu ma kadi kɛ wo e kɔni nɔ ke,
‘Yawɛ nɔ́,’ nɛ e ma tsɛ e he ke Israel.”
6 Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ, Israel matsɛ, kɛ e kpɔlɔ,
nɛ lɛ ji Tabohiatsɛ ɔ ngɛ dee ji,
“Imi ji kekleekle no, kɛ nyagbe no.
Ye se ɔ, Mawu kpa ko be hu.
7Mɛnɔ kɛ mi sɔ?
Ha nɛ a ha heto.
Ha nɛ a je nya nɛ a de ngɛ ye hɛ mi.
Níhi nɛ ba blema a, mɛnɔ lɛ de to?
Ha nɛ a gba níhi nɛ maa ba hwɔɔ se.
8Ye ma, koo nu sawale! Koo ye gbeye!
Ye we odase ji mo.
Anɛ i de we enɛ ɔ blema lokoo lo?
Anɛ ye se ɔ, Mawu ko pa ngɛ lo?
Dɛbi, i li he wami kpa ko ngɛ ye se hu?”
A gbe amaga jami he guɛ
9Amaga puɛli ɔmɛ tsuo ji nimli guhi, nɛ amaga amɛ nɛ a buu kaa nɔ́ ko ɔ, a he be se nami ko kulaa. Nihi nɛ jaa kikɛmɛ a ní nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, a hɛngmɛ yu; a li nɔ́ ko fɛɛ; zo maa gbe mɛ. 10Mɛnɔ lɛ puɛɔ amaga nɛ he be se nami, nɛ e jaa lɛ? 11Nihi tsuo nɛ jaa kikɛmɛ a nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, zo maa gbe mɛ. Nihi nɛ puɛɔ amaga amɛ ɔ, nimli adesahi kɛkɛ ji mɛ kaa nihi nɛ jaa mɛ ɔ kɛ̃. Nyɛ ha amaga puɛli ɔmɛ kɛ e jali ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ a ba. Mɛ tsuo a tsui maa po, nɛ zo maa gbe mɛ kpɔtɔɔ.
12Sɔ̃lɔ ngɔɔ dade kɛ woɔ la mi, nɛ e dɔɔ la. E kɛ e he wami woɔ hamle nɔ kɛ fiaa dade ɔ nɛ e kɛ sɔ̃ɔ̃ nɔ́ ko. Ke e ngɛ nɔ́ ɔ sɔ̃e ɔ, hwɔ kɛ kuma yee lɛ, nɛ pɔ tɔɔ lɛ.
13Tso galɔ ngɔɔ kpa kɛ susuu tso, e ngɔɔ kadimi nɔ́ kɛ kadiɔ, nɛ e ngɔɔ ga dade kɛ hlɔɔ tso ɔ he kɛ peeɔ nɔ́ ko nɛ je nɔmlɔ; e ngɔɔ nɔ́ kɛ e he fɛu nɛ ɔ kɛ ya maa we mi. 14E ma nyɛ maa po seda kɛ pee amaga nɛ ɔ, aloo e ma hla odum, loo nga mi tso kpa ko. Ke e suɔ po, e ma du sɛsɛo, nɛ e maa mlɛ kɛ yaa si hiɔmi maa nɛ, nɛ tso ɔ maa wa saminya. 15Nɔmlɔ adesa ngɔɔ tso nɛ ɔ fa ko kɛ peeɔ lɛ́ kɛ slɛɔ la nɛ e hluiɔ; nɛ e kɛ sãã abolo hulɔ. E ngɔɔ tso ɔ fa ko hu kɛ peeɔ amaga. E kplaa si ha lɛ, nɛ e jaa lɛ. 16E ngɔɔ tso ɔ fa kɛ slɛɔ la; e kɛ la a sãã de lo, nɛ e yeɔ nɛ e tɔɔ. E hluiɔ la, nɛ e deɔ ke, “Yɛɛ, ye he dɔ la. La nɛ ɔ ngɔɔ loo!” 17Tso ɔ fa nɛ piɛ ɔ, e ngɔɔ kɛ peeɔ amaga, nɛ e kplaa si nɛ e jaa lɛ. E faa kue ha lɛ, nɛ e deɔ ke, “Mo ji ye mawu! He ye yi wami!”
18Nɔ́ nɛ a ngɛ pee ɔ, a li, nɛ a nui sisi hulɔ. A nga a hɛngmɛ, konɛ a ko hyɛ nɔ́, a tsi a juɛmi nya, konɛ a ko nu nɔ́ sisi. 19Amaga peelɔ ɔ be juɛmi, loo e kɔ we nɔ́ se nɛ e ma de ke, “Hyɛ kaa i sã tso ɔ fa kaa lɛ́; i sã abolo ngɛ la a mi; i ngɔ la a kɛ sã de lo, nɛ i ye. Anɛ nɔ́ nɛ piɛ ɔ, ma kɛ puɛ amaga lo? Anɛ ma kpla si ha tso kpoku lo?”
20E ní pee mɔbɔ kaa nɔ nɛ ngɛ la zu yee; a mlɔɔ lɛ, nɛ e laa blɔ; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e be nyɛe ma he lɛ nitsɛ e yi wami, loo nɛ e ma de ke, “Anɛ pi yaka nɔ́ nɔ nɛ i ngɔ ye hɛ ngɔ fɔ nɛ ɔ?”
Yawɛ, bɔlɔ kɛ yi wami helɔ ɔ
21Yawɛ ke,
“Israel, o hɛ ko je nɔ́ nɛ ɔ nɔ!
Kai kaa ye tsɔlɔ ji mo.
Imi lɛ i bɔ mo, konɛ o pee ye tsɔlɔ;
lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ye hɛ be o nɔ jee gblegbleegble.
22I je o tɔmi ɔmɛ kɛ je o he kɛ ho kaa bɔku.
O yayami ɔmɛ laa kaa mɔtu afua.
Kpale kɛ ba ye ngɔ,
imi lɛ i he o yi wami ɔ nɛ.”
23Nyɛ hiɔwe tsuo, nyɛ la nɛ nyɛ nya;
nyɛ zugba a sisi hehi nɛ kuɔ,
nyɛ he ose!
Nyɛ yo ɔmɛ, kɛ hue ɔmɛ kɛ a mi tso ɔmɛ tsuo,
nyɛɛ kɛ bua jɔmi nɛ he ose.
A je Yawɛ he wami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ yi;
ejakaa e he e ma Israel yi wami.
24Yawɛ, o yi wami helɔ, kɛ o bɔlɔ ɔ ngɛ dee ke,
“Imi ji Yawɛ, nihi tsuo kulaa a bɔlɔ ɔ nɛ.
Imi nɔ kake too lɛ i bli hiɔwe mi,
nɛ i ha zugba a fɔɔ si gbajaa.
Mɛnɔ ke e nine ngɛ mi?
25 Imi ji nɔ nɛ haa lakpa gbali ɔmɛ,
kɛ dodoe mi hyɛli a we okadi ɔmɛ peeɔ yaka.
Imi ji nɔ nɛ kuɔ ní leli a nya la,
nɛ i haa a nile plɛɔ peeɔ kuasia jemi.
26Ke i tsɔ ye tsɔlɔ ke
e ya je ye yi mi tomi kpo kɛ tsɔɔ ɔ,
munyu nɛ e tuɔ ɔ,
i maa nɔ mi,
nɛ gbami ɔmɛ tsuo baa mi pɛpɛɛpɛ.
I ngɛ Yerusalem dee ke,
nihi ma ba hi ma a mi ekohu;
a maa ma Yuda ma amɛ ekohu,
nɛ nimli ma ba hi a mi.
A maa to jamɛ a ma amɛ si ekohu
ngɛ ma doku ɔmɛ a nane mi.
27I faa, kɛkɛ wo miiɔ,
nɛ nyu taa pa amɛ a mi.
28 I deɔ Sirus ke,
‘Mo ji nɔ nɛ maa ye ye ma a nɔ ha mi;
nɔ́ nɛ i suɔ ɔ, lɔ ɔ sɔuu o maa pee.
O ma fa ke a ma Yerusalem ekohu,
nɛ́ a to Yawɛ we ɔ sisi.’ ”

Title: YESAYA 45
Content:
Yawɛ hla Sirus
1Yawɛ hla Sirus ke e ye matsɛ!
E hla lɛ ke e ye je mahi a nɔ;
e tsɔ lɛ, konɛ e ya kpɔ
ma amɛ a he wami tsuo ngɛ a dɛ.
Yawɛ ma bli ma a we agbo ɔmɛ a nya ha lɛ,
nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be nyɛe ma nga.
Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ ngɛ Sirus dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ:
2“Imi nitsɛ ma nyɛɛ o hɛ mi,
nɛ ma ba yo ɔmɛ tsuo si.
Ma ku akɔblee agbo ɔmɛ,
nɛ ma poo a se lami ní ɔmɛ a mi ngɔ pue he.
3Ma je juetli kpo ha mo
kɛ je diblii mi,
kɛ je hehi nɛ a ngɔ mɛ ngɔ laa ngɛ ɔ,
konɛ o na nɛ o le kaa
imi Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ, i le mo,
nɛ i kɛ o biɛ tsɛɔ mo.
4I tsɛ mo, konɛ o piɛ Israel he.
Israel nɛ ɔ ji ma nɛ imi nitsɛ i hla.
E ngɛ mi kaa o li mi lɛɛ,
se i wo o hɛ mi nyami wawɛɛ nitsɛ.
5“Imi ji Yawɛ;
ye se ɔ, mawu kpa ko be hu.
O li mi lɛɛ,
se he wami nɛ hia mo ɔ,
i ngɔ ha mo.
6I ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ pee,
konɛ nihi tsuo ngɛ je ɔ mi,
kɛ je beleku je kɛ ya si bonyoku je
nɛ a le kaa imi ji Yawɛ,
nɛ ye se ɔ, mawu kpa ko be hu.
7Imi ji nɔ nɛ bɔ la kɛ diblii tsuo.
Imi ji nɔ nɛ haa he jɔmi baa,
haomi hu imi nɔuu.
Imi Yawɛ ji nɔ nɛ peeɔ ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo.
8Hiɔwe tsuo, nyɛ ha nɛ dami sane yemi
nɛ kple si kɛ ba;
é nɛ kɛ pue si kaa bɔ.
Nyɛ ha nɛ dami sane yemi nɛ pue si
kɛ je bɔku ɔmɛ a mi;
é nɛ kɛ pue si kaa hiɔmi.
Zugba a hu nɛ bli e nya,
konɛ yi wami hemi nɛ bɔni kpo jemi;
enɛ ɔ kɛ dami sane yemi tsuo
maa je kpo paa si kake.
Imi Yawɛ lɛ i ha enɛ ɔ ba mi.”
Yawɛ nɛ bɔ je ɔ, le sanehi tsuo nɛ baa
9 Musu tloo nɔmlɔ adesa nɛ e kɛ e bɔlɔ ɔ sãã nya.
Adesa ngɛ kaa zu buɛ ngɛ buɛ puɛlɔ dɛ mi.
Anɛ zu biɔ buɛ puɛlɔ ɔ ke,
“Mɛni lɛ o ngɛ puɛe ɔ?”
aloo
“Nɔ́ nɛ o puɛ ɔ be nine lo?”
10Musu tloo bi muɔloku nɛ deɔ e tsɛ ke,
“Mɛni bi a ma fɔ ha mo?”
aloo e nyɛ ke, “Kɔɔmi nɛ o nu ɔ,
mɛni bi o ma fɔ?”
11Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ, Israel Mawu klɔuklɔu ɔ,
kɛ je ɔ bɔlɔ ɔ ngɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ:
“Anɛ nɔ ko ngɛ he blɔ kaa e deɔ nɔ́ ko
kɛ siɔ mi lo,
nɔ́ nɛ kɔɔ ye bimɛ ɔmɛ a he jio,
nɔ́ nɛ kɔɔ ye nine nya ní tsumi he jio?
12Imi nɛ i bɔ je ɔ kɛ e mi nimli adesahi.
I ngɔ ye he wami kɛ bli hiɔwe mi,
nɛ i yeɔ pu, nyɔhiɔ, kɛ dodoe ɔmɛ tsuo a nɔ.
13Imi nitsɛ nɛ i hla Sirus
nɛ i wo lɛ he wami,
konɛ e pee nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Ma ha e blɔ ɔmɛ tsuo maa da tlɔmɔɔ.
E maa ma ye ma Yerusalem ɔ ekohu,
nɛ e maa ngmɛɛ ye nyɔguɛ ɔmɛ a he
nɛ a ye a he.
Nɔ ko nɔ ko bɔɛ lɛ apaa,
nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko hu ha we lɛ nyɔ mi ní
ke e tsu nɔ́ nɛ ɔ.”
Yawɛ, Tabohiatsɛ ɔ lɛ de.
14Yawɛ de Israel ke,
“Egipt juetli, kɛ Sudan nijua ní
ma ba pee o nɔ́,
nɛ Seba bi, nimli gagahi
ma ba pee o nyɔguɛhi;
a maa bɔ mɛ pã kɛ ba o ngɔ;
a ma ba kpla si ha mo,
nɛ a ma kpa mo pɛɛ ngɛ he si bami mi ke,
‘Niinɛ, Mawu nɛ kɛ mo ngɛ ɔ,
lɛ nɔ kake too ji Mawu;
ekpa ko be hu.
15Israel Mawu ɔ nɛ heɔ e ma a yi wami ɔ,
e ji Mawu nɛ laa e he.
16Amaga puɛli a hɛ mi ma pue si;
zo maa gbe mɛ tsuo kpɔtɔɔ.
17Se Israel ma a lɛɛ Yawɛ ma he a yi wami
kɛ maa ya neneene;
e be hae nɛ a hɛ mi ma pue si kɔkɔɔkɔ.’ ”
18Yawɛ, nɔ nɛ bɔ hiɔwe kɛ zugba a,
lɛ nɔ kake too ji Mawu!
E bɔ je ɔ, nɛ e kɛ zugba a ma si saminya.
E bɔɛ lɛ ngɔ fɔɛ si gu nɛ e pee yaka;
se e pee lɛ konɛ nimli nɛ hi nɔ.
Bɔ nɛ lɛ nitsɛ e ngɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ:
“Imi ji Yawɛ; mawu kpa ko be hu.
19I tu we munyu ngɛ laami mi;
ye yi mi tomi fɔɔ si paa.
I de we Israel ma a ke
a ya hla mi ngɛ nga pã.
Imi ji Yawɛ, anɔkuale pɛ i tuɔ;
nɔ́ nɛ da a, lɔ ɔ pɛ i deɔ.”
Yawɛ, je ɔ tsɛ ɔ kɛ Babilon amaga amɛ ná
20Yawɛ ke,
“Nyɛ je ma amɛ tsuo,
nyɛ nihi nɛ nyɛ yi na wami ɔ,
nyɛ bua nyɛ he nya kɛ ba!
Nyɛ nihi nɛ hɛɛɔ tso amagahi kɛ hii nyɛɛe,
nɛ nyɛ hii sɔlee ha mawuhi
nɛ be yi wami nyɛe ma he,
nyɛ li nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko fɛɛ!
21Nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ sane ɔ nɛ ba nɛ waa hyɛ mi.
Nihi nɛ ma je a sane ɔ nya a,
nyɛ ha nɛ a ya kpe yi!
Nyɛ mawu ɔmɛ a kpɛti mɛnɔ nyɛ́ de nɔ́ ko
kɛ to blema lokoo?
Nɔ ko nɔ ko be.
Anɛ pi imi Yawɛ lo?
Anɛ pi imi Mawu nɛ da,
nɛ heɔ e ma a yi wami ɔ lo?
Ye se ɔ, Mawu kpa ko be hu.
22“Nyɛ nimli tsuo ngɛ je ɔ mi,
nyɛɛ kpale kɛ ba ye ngɔ jehanɛ,
konɛ a he nyɛ yi wami!
Ejakaa imi nɔ kake too ji Mawu;
Mawu kpa ko be.
23 I ngɛ kita kae, nɛ i be ye nya se kpalee.
I ngɛ imi nitsɛ ye he kita kae ke
je ma amɛ tsuo maa ba;
a ma ba kpla si ha mi,
nɛ a ma ka mi kita.
24“A ma de ke,
‘Yawɛ pɛ lɛ yeɔ dami sane;
lɛ pɛ lɛ e ngɛ he wami.’
Se nihi tsuo nɛ sume mi ɔ,
zo maa gbe mɛ.
25Imi Yawɛ nitsɛ ma ha Israel nina tsuo
maa ye kunimi, nɛ a maa fĩa kɛ fɔ ye nɔ.

Title: YESAYA 46
Content:
1“Babilon mawu ɔmɛ a nyagbe ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Be ko ɔ, a ja Bel kɛ Nebo.
A hɛɛɔ mɛ kɛ hii si poe.
Se jehanɛ lɛɛ a plɛ pee tlomi
ngɛ tejihi nɛ pɔ tɔ mɛ a se mi.
2Amaga amɛ nyɛ we nɛ a he
mɛ nitsɛmɛ a yi wami;
a ngɔ mɛ kɛ ho.
Babilon mawu ɔmɛ a nyagbe ji nɛ ɔ nɛ!
3“Nyɛ ye ma a mi nihi tsuo, Yakob nina
nɛ nyɛ ngɛ wami mi kɛ mwɔɔ,
nyɛɛ bu mi tue.
Imi ji nɔ nɛ baa nyɛ yi
kɛ je nyɛ fɔmi be tɔɔ.
4Imi nɔuu ji nyɛ Mawu
nɛ maa hyɛ nyɛ nɔ kɛ ya su
be nɛ nyɛ maa wa
nɛ nyɛ maa puɛ mua.
Imi lɛ i bɔ nyɛ;
ma baa nyɛ yi;
ma piɛ nyɛ he,
nɛ ma he nyɛ yi wami.
5“Yawɛ ngɛ bie ke,
‘Mɛnɔ he nyɛ maa ngɔ mi kɛ to?
Nɔ ko ngɛ nɛ kɛ mi sɔ lo?’
6Nihi jeɔ sika tsu babauu kɛ jee a kotoku mi,
nɛ a ngmɛɛ sika hiɔ ngɛ sɛni tɛ nɔ.
A bɔɔ sika tsu galɔ apaa,
nɛ e kɛ peeɔ amaga ha mɛ;
kɛkɛ ɔ, a kplaa si nɛ a jaa amaga a!
7A ngɔɔ amaga a ngɔ fɔɔ a konɔ;
a kɛ ya maa si ngɛ he ko,
nɛ e nyɛ we nɛ e mimiɛɔ e he po
kɛ je he nɛ e maa si ngɛ ɔ!
Ke nɔ ko fa kue ha lɛ ɔ,
e nyɛ we nɛ e haa lɛ heto,
nɛ e nyɛ we nɛ e jeɔ nɔ ɔ kɛ jeɔ haomi mi hulɔ.
8“Nyɛ yayami peeli, nyɛ kai nɔ́ nɛ ɔ,
nɛ nyɛ susu he.
9Nyɛ kai níhi nɛ i pee blema lokoo ɔ;
ejakaa Mawu kpa ko be nɛ kɛ mi sɔ.
10Níhi tsuo nɛ maa ba hwɔɔ se ɔ,
imi ji nɔ nɛ gba kɛ to kɛ je blema lokoo;
níhi nɛ na we nɛ a ba lolo ɔ hu,
imi lɛ i gba kɛ to.
I de ke ye yi mi tomi maa ba mi,
nɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ i suɔ ɔ,
lɔ ɔ ma pee.
11I ngɛ nɔ ko tsɛe kɛ je beleku je;
e he maa sɔ kaa kayo kɛ ba kple si,
nɛ e ma ba tsu níhi nɛ i to nɛ ma pee ɔ.
Bɔ nɛ i de ɔ, ja pɛpɛɛpɛ e maa ba mi.
12“Nyɛ ma nɛ nyɛ tue mi ti,
nɛ nyɛ susuɔ kaa kunimi yemi
ngɛ se lokoo,
nyɛɛ bu tue.
13I ha ye kunimi yemi ligbi ɔ na nyɛ haa;
e be tsitsaa lokoo kulaa.
Ye kunimi yemi ɔ be se kpɛe.
Ma he Yerusalem yi wami,
nɛ ma wo Israel hɛ mi nyami.”

Title: YESAYA 47
Content:
Babilon hɛ mi kpatami
1 Yawɛ ke,
“Babilon, mo kple si kɛ je matsɛ sɛ ɔ nɔ!
Ba hi si ngɛ zugba, ngɛ bunyuku mi!
Be ko nɛ be ɔ, o ngɛ kaa yomiyo,
se jehanɛ lɛɛ a be mo hɛɛ dɔdɔɔdɔ hu!
2Ngɔɔ wɛ tɛ kɛ ba!
Moo wɛɛ blɛfo nɛ a kɛ pee ma!
Je o hɛ mi hami nɔ́ ɔ esɔ!
Kpa bo saminyayoo ɔ ngɛ o he,
nɛ́ o nane nɛ je kpo.
Poo pa amɛ kɛ ya!
3Nihi maa na o he gu ɔ;
a maa na o zo kpɔtɔɔ ɔ.
Ma ha tue gblami maa ba,
nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be ye nya tsie.”
4Israel Mawu klɔuklɔu ɔ ha wa ye wa he.
E biɛ ji Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ.
5Yawɛ ngɛ Babilon dee ke,
“Hii si dii ngɛ diblii mi;
a be mo tsɛe ke je ma amɛ a manyɛ hu.
6Ye ma a wo ye mi mi la;
lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i bui mɛ kaa ye ma hu.
I ngɔ mɛ ngɔ wo o sisi,
nɛ o nɛ́ mɛ mɔbɔ ko kulaa;
nihi nɛ bwɔ po, o wa mɛ yi mi wawɛɛ nitsɛ.
7E pee mo kaa o maa ye manyɛ daa,
lɔ ɔ he ɔ, o susuu we ní nɛ ɔmɛ a he,
bɔ nɛ a nyagbe maa ba ha hu, o bui.
8 “Jehanɛ lɛɛ, bu tue;
mo nɛ o suɔ je mi ngɔɔmi yemi,
nɛ o hii si gbɔjɔɔ kaa nɔ nɛ he mi jɔ lɛ,
mo nɛ o fĩaa ke o kle kaa Mawu,
nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko kɛ mo sɔɛ.
O susuu hu kaa o be yalɔyo pee gblee,
nɛ o bimɛ hu be gboe kɔkɔɔkɔ.
9Se tlukaa, ligbi kake mi ɔ,
nɔ́ enyɔ nɛ ɔmɛ maa ba o nɔ;
o maa ye kunya, nɛ o maa fi kablɛ babauu,
se o huno, kɛ o bimɛ tsuo maa laa mo.
10“Yayami nɛ o ngɛ pee ɔ
peeɔ mo kaa o he mi jɔ mo.
O susu kaa nɔ ko nɔ ko be mo nae.
O ga, kɛ o nile ɔ ha o laa blɔ,
nɛ o de o he ke,
‘Imi ji imi, nɛ ye se ɔ nɔ ko be hu.’
11Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, haomi maa ba o nɔ,
nɛ o be nya nyɛe maa da.
Oslaa ma ba na mo,
se o be e nya nyɛe maa tsi.
O hɛ mi ma kpata tlukaa
be nɛ o li o he be.
12Kunya nɛ o ye, kɛ kablɛ nɛ o fi
kɛ je o jokuɛwi a si ɔ,
pɛtɛ he.
Eko piɔ, a ma ha nɛ nihi a mi maa hi ha mo,
nɛ o he nyɛli maa ye mo gbeye.
13Nihi nɛ le hiɔwe níhi a mi,
nihi nɛ kase dodoe ɔmɛ a he ní,
kɛ nihi nɛ pee hiɔwe mi dlami ɔmɛ a he foni,
nɛ a deɔ mo níhi nɛ maa ba o nɔ
nyɔhiɔ tsuaa nyɔhiɔ mi ɔ,
ha nɛ a ba nɛ a ba he o yi wami koo!
Se pɔ tɔ mo kɛ a ga womi ɔmɛ!
14“A maa pee kaa nga gbigbli,
nɛ la maa sã mɛ!
A be nyɛe ma he mɛ nitsɛmɛ a yi wami;
la lilɛ ɔmɛ maa sã mɛ.
Pi la kulɔɔ nɛ a hluiɔ ji nɛ ɔ;
pi la nɛ a hii he.
15Nihi tsuo nɛ o gbo a he dengme ɔ, se nɛ o ma na
ngɛ a he ji nɛ ɔ nɛ;
nihi nɛ kɛ mo ye jua kɛ je o jokuɛwi a si ɔ,
mɛ tsuo a maa ngmɛɛ o he;
nɔ tsuaa nɔ ma wo lɛ nitsɛ e blɔ,
nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be piɛe
nɛ ma he o yi wami.”

Title: YESAYA 48
Content:
Israel kuɛ wa
1Israel ma, Yuda nina,
nyɛɛ bu nɔ́ nɛ ɔ tue;
nyɛ nɛ nyɛ ngɔɔ Yawɛ biɛ
kɛ kaa kita, nɛ nyɛ tsiɔ Israel Mawu ɔ ta
ke nyɛ ngɛ lɛ jae,
pi anɔkuale mi, se nya mi gu.
2Nyɛ siɔ nyɛ gugue, nɛ nyɛ deɔ ke
ma klɔuklɔu ɔ mi bi ji nyɛ;
nyɛ deɔ hu ke Israel Mawu nɛ e biɛ ji
Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ
nɔ nyɛ ngɔ nyɛ hɛ ngɔ fɔ.
3Yawɛ ngɛ Israel dee ke,
“Níhi nɛ maa ba hwɔɔ se ɔ,
i gba ngɔ to blema lokoo,
nɛ tlukaa, i ha a ba mi.
4Israel bi, i le kaa nyɛ kuɛ wa;
e ngɛ kpakpataa kaa dade,
nɛ nyɛ yi wu tso ngɛ kpɛkpɛtɛɛ kaa akɔblee.
5Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i gba nɔ́ nɛ maa ba nyɛ nɔ ɔ ngɔ to blema lokoo;
i gba ní nɛ ɔmɛ ngɔ to
loko á ba mi,
bɔ nɛ pee nɛ nyɛ ko de ke
nyɛ we amaga amɛ, níhi nɛ a kpɛ́,
kɛ níhi nɛ a sɔ̃ ɔ
nɛ a ha ní ɔmɛ ba mi.
6“Jehanɛ, níhi nɛ i gba ngɔ to ɔ tsuo ba mi.
Anɛ e sɛ kaa nyɛ kplɛɛɔ nɔ kaa ja i de ɔ lo?
Jehanɛ ma gba nyɛ ní hehi nɛ maa ba hwɔɔ se,
laami mi sanehi nɛ maa ba,
nɛ i je we kpo kɛ tsɔɔ we hyɛ.
7Kpaako i ha ní nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ mi bae;
nɔ́ ko kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ bɛ hyɛ.
Ke pi ja a, nyɛ ma de ke
nyɛ le enɛ ɔ tsuo momo.
8Nyɛ nui hyɛ, nɛ nyɛ li lolo;
kɛ je blema lokoo ɔ, nyɛ tue bli we lolo!
Ejakaa i le kaa yi wu tso níhi nyɛ peeɔ;
kɛ je nyɛ fɔmi be mi tɔɔ ɔ,
atuã tsɔli a tsɛɔ nyɛ.
9“Bɔ nɛ pee nɛ a je ye biɛ yi he je ɔ,
i tsi ye mi mi la a nya;
i tsi nya, konɛ ma ko kpata nyɛ hɛ mi.
10I ngɔ amanehlu kɛ ka nyɛ
kaa bɔ nɛ a tsuɔ sika hiɔ he ngɛ flɔɔnɔɔ mi;
se i na kaa nyɛ he be se nami ko kulaa.
11Imi nitsɛ ye he i pee ha;
ee, imi nitsɛ ye he ma pee ha.
Ejakaa mɛni he je e sa kaa a puɛ ye biɛ?
I be ye hɛ mi nyami ngɔe kɛ ha nɔ kpa ko.”
Yawɛ hla Sirus kaa hɛ mi nyɛɛlɔ
12 Yawɛ ke,
“Israel, ma nɛ imi nitsɛ i hla,
nyɛɛ bu mi tue!
Imi ji Mawu, kekleekle nɔ, kɛ nyagbe nɔ;
imi nɔ kake too ji Mawu!
13Imi nitsɛ lɛ i to zugba a sisi,
nɛ i bli hiɔwe mluguduu ɔ mi.
Benɛ i tsɛ hiɔwe kɛ zugba a,
mɛ tsuo a he sɔ kɛ ba.
14“Nyɛ tsuo nyɛ ba bua nyɛ he nya
nɛ nyɛɛ bu tue!
Nyɛ mawu ɔmɛ a ti mɛnɔ gba enɛ ɔ kɛ to?
Nɔ nɛ imi Yawɛ, i suɔ lɛ ɔ,
ma ba pee nɔ́ nɛ sa imi Yawɛ ye hɛ mi,
nɛ e ma kpata Babilon hɛ mi butuu.
15Imi nitsɛ nɛ i hla lɛ.
Imi nɛ i ngɔ lɛ kɛ ba,
nɛ ní tsumi nɛ i ha lɛ ɔ,
e maa ye manye ngɛ mi.
16“Jehanɛ, nyɛɛ hɛ nyɛ kɛ ba ye ngɔ
nɛ nyɛ ba bu mi tue.
Kɛ je sisije ɔ tsuo lakpa ko be ye munyu mi,
nɛ ye munyu ɔmɛ baa mi sisiisi.”
Hɛ mi nyɛɛlɔ ɔ nɛ Yawɛ hla a he nɔ ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ngɔ e mumi ɔ ngɔ wo ye mi, nɛ e tsɔ mi.”
Yawɛ to yi mi ha e ma a
17Yawɛ, Israel Mawu Klɔuklɔu ɔ,
nɔ nɛ heɔ e ma a yi wami ɔ
ngɛ dee ke,
“Imi ji Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ nɛ.
I suɔ kaa ma tsɔse nyɛ,
nɛ ma tsɔɔ nyɛ bɔ nɛ nyɛɛ ba nyɛ je mi ha,
konɛ e hi ha nyɛ nitsɛmɛ.
18“I na nɛ nyɛ ye ye mlaa amɛ a nɔ!
Jinɛ a maa gbaa nyɛ;
nɛ nyɛ maa pee kaa pa
nɛ nyu tɛ̃ mi gblegbleegble.
Nyɛ maa ye kunimi nɔtonɔto
kaa bɔ nɛ oslɔke kuɔ kɛ pueɔ wo dɔ mi.
19Nyɛ ngmɛdu ko hiɛ babauu kaa zia,
nɛ i ko hyɛ a nɔ saminya,
konɛ a hɛ mi ko kpata gblegbleegble.”
20 Nyɛɛ je Babilon esɔesɔ; nyɛ wo fo!
Nyɛ hwɔ lele nɛ a nu ngɛ he tsuaa he ke,
“Yawɛ he e tsɔlɔ Israel yi wami!”
21Benɛ Yawɛ kɛ e ma a
nyɛɛ nga kplanaa a nɔ ɔ,
kuma yi mɛ;
ejakaa e ha nyu je tɛ sa mi ha mɛ;
tɛ sa a mi gba,
kɛkɛ nɛ nyu je mi kaa pa.
22 Yawɛ ke,
“Yayami peeli be he jɔmi nae gblegbleegble.”

Title: YESAYA 49
Content:
Israel ji kane kɛ ha je ma amɛ
1 Nyɛ wo nya mahi, nyɛɛ bu tue,
Nyɛ je mahi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ se lokoo,
nyɛ ta tue!
Yawɛ hla mi loko a fɔ mi.
Benɛ i ngɛ ye nyɛ mi mi lokoo
nɛ e wo ye biɛ ta.
2 E ha ye nya mi munyu pee kaa klaate nɛ nya ba.
E ngɔ lɛ nitsɛ e nine kɛ bu ye he.
E pee mi kaa kɛ̃ɛ̃ mi bi nɛ nya ba,
nɛ hɔɔ si ngɛ kotoku mi.
3E de mi ke, “Israel, ye tsɔlɔ ji mo.
O he ɔ, nihi maa wo ye hɛ mi nyami.”
4Se imi lɛɛ, i de ke,
“I gbo dengme yaka gu;
i puɛ ye he wami tsuo yaka;
i na we se ko.”
Se kɛ̃ ɔ, Yawɛ, ye Mawu ɔ
maa ye ye sane ɔ ha mi,
e maa pee mi kpakpa.
5Loko a fɔ mi ɔ, Yawɛ nitsɛ hla mi,
nɛ e pee mi e tsɔlɔ,
konɛ ma ya kpale e ma a kɛ ba e ngɔ;
ma kpale Israel ma a nɛ gbɛ fĩa a
kɛ ba ha lɛ.
Yawɛ woɔ ye hɛ mi nyami,
lɛ ji nɔ nɛ haa mi he wami.
6 Yawɛ de mi ke,
“Ye tsɔlɔ, i ngɛ ní tsumi agbo ko ha mo;
pi kaa o ma bua Israel bi nɛ a yi na wami
ɔ a nya kɛ pee ma ekohu kaa sa a kɛkɛ,
se mohu kaa o maa pee la
kɛ ha je ma amɛ,
bɔ nɛ pee nɛ a he je ɔ tsuo yi wami.”
7Nɔ nɛ a gbe e he guɛ wawɛɛ,
nɛ je ma amɛ sume e sane saasaa a,
nɔ yeli ɔmɛ a tsɔlɔ ɔ,
bɔ nɛ Israel yi wami helɔ,
kɛ Israel Mawu Klɔuklɔu ɔ
ngɛ dee ngɛ e he ji nɛ ɔ nɛ:
“Matsɛmɛ maa na mo,
nɛ a maa te si ha mo;
ganɔhi maa na, nɛ a ma kpla si ha mo
kɛ wo o hɛ mi nyami.”
Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ maa ba mi,
ejakaa Yawɛ nitsɛ lɛ hla e tsɔlɔ ɔ nɛ;
Israel Mawu klɔuklɔu ɔ yeɔ e siwo nɔ sisiisi.
A maa ma Yerusalem ekohu
8 Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ ngɛ e ma a dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ,
“Ke be su nɛ ma he nyɛ yi wami ɔ,
ma na nyɛ mɔbɔ;
ngmlaa nɛ nyɛ ngɛ kpae
ke ma ba piɛ nyɛ he ɔ,
ma bu tue.
Ma bu nyɛ he,
nɛ ma baa nyɛ yi,
nɛ ma gu nyɛ nɔ
nɛ i kɛ je ma amɛ tsuo maa so.
Nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ zugba nɛ hɛ mi kpata a,
ma ha nyɛ ma ba hi nɔ ekohu.
9Ma de nihi nɛ a wo mɛ tsu ɔ ke,
‘Nyɛɛ je kpo!’
nɛ ma de nihi nɛ ngɛ diblii mi ɔ ke,
‘Nyɛɛ je kpo kɛ ba la hɛ mi!’
A maa pee kaa tohi nɛ ngɛ ní yee ngɛ blɔ tue.
Yo nɔ he nɛ hue be ɔ maa pee a ní yemi he.
10 Hwɔ be mɛ yee,
nɛ kuma be mɛ yee gblegbleegble.
Pu la, kɛ nga kplanaa nɔ kɔɔhiɔ
nɛ mi dɔ la be mɛ awi yee;
ejakaa nɔ nɛ suɔ mɛ ɔ maa piɛ a he.
E maa tsɔɔ mɛ blɔ
kɛ ya nyu hɛngmɛhi a he.
11“Ma je blɔ kɛ nyɛɛ yo ɔmɛ a nɔ,
nɛ ma pee gbɛjegbɛ ha ye ma a.
12Ee, ye ma a maa je tsitsaa kɛ maa ba,
a maa je omleyi je kɛ bonyoku je,
nɛ a maa je Aswan tɔɔ
ngɛ leneyi je kɛ maa ba.”
13Nyɛ hiɔwe níhi, nyɛ la kɛ bua jɔmi!
Zugba, hwɔ lele!
Nyɛ yo ɔmɛ hu nyɛ la!
Yawɛ maa jɔɔ e ma a bua;
nihi nɛ ngɛ nɔ́ nae ɔ,
e maa na mɛ mɔbɔ.
14Se bɔ nɛ Yerusalem ngɛ dee ji,
“Yawɛ ngmɛɛ ye he ngɔ fɔ si!
E hɛ po je ye nɔ.”
15Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yawɛ he nɔ ke,
“Anɛ binyɛ hɛ maa je lɛ nitsɛ e bi
nɛ ngɛ nyɔ nya nɔ lo?
Anɛ e be suɔmi kpo jee kɛ tsɔɔ e bi ɔ lo?
Ke binyɛ hɛ maa je e bi nɔ po,
imi lɛɛ ye hɛ be o nɔ jee kɔkɔɔkɔ.
16Yerusalem, hyɛ,
i ngma o biɛ ngɛ ye dɛ mi,
ye hɛ be o nɔ jee gblegbleegble.
17“Nihi nɛ maa fia gbogbo ɔmɛ ɔ ma amlɔ nɔuu,
nɛ nihi nɛ ba kpata o hɛ mi ɔ
maa je kɛ ho.
18Hyɛ o he kɛ kpe, nɛ o maa na nɔ́ ko!
O ma mi bi ɔmɛ ngɛ a he nya buae kɛ ma we!
Ligbi abɔ nɛ imi Yawɛ i ngɛ nɛ ɔ,
ma ha o bua maa jɔ o ma a he
kaa bɔ nɛ ayɛflo bua jɔɔ
june nɛ e wo he ɔ.
19“A kpata o zugba a hɛ mi;
a pee o ma a butuu;
se jehanɛ lɛɛ, nihi nɛ ma lejɛ ɔ himi ɔ,
zugba a be mɛ sue hu.
Nihi nɛ ba pee mo butuu ɔ maa je o he
kɛ ya se lokoo.
20Jehanɛ hu, o bimɛ nɛ o fɔ ngɛ ma se ɔ,
hwɔɔ se ɔ, a ma de mo ke,
‘Zugba nɛ ɔ klee we ha wɔ;
e hia wɔ zugba nɛ kle
nɛ waa hi nɔ.’
21Kɛkɛ ɔ, o ma bi o he ke,
‘Mɛnɔ lɛ fɔ bimɛ nɛ ɔmɛ ha mi?
Nihi gbo ta ye he;
i plɛ pee nɔ ko nɛ fɔ we,
a nu mi kɛ ho ma se ya.
Hyɛ, a si imi nɔ kake too,
lɛɛ jije lɛ nimli nɛ ɔmɛ je mɔ?
Mɛnɔ nɛ lɛ mɛ?’ ”
22Bɔ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ngɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ:
“Ma fɔ̃ je ma amɛ nine;
ni ɔmɛ tsuo maa na okadi ɔ,
nɛ a maa hɛɛ nyɛ binyumu ɔmɛ ngɛ a gugue mi,
nɛ a kɛ nyɛ biyi
ɔmɛ maa fɔ a konɔ kɛ ba.
23Matsɛmɛ ma plɛ pee tsɛmɛ kɛ ha mo,
nɛ manyɛmɛ ma plɛ pee nyɛmɛ kɛ ha mo.
A ma kpla si ha mo,
nɛ a maa wo o hɛ mi nyami.
A maa ba a he si ha mo,
nɛ a maa bu mo.
Kɛkɛ ɔ,
o maa le kaa imi ji Yawɛ niinɛ.
Nihi nɛ ngɔɔ a hɛ ngɔ fɔɔ ye nɔ ɔ,
zo be mɛ gbee.”
24Katsɛ ta yibu ní ɔ,
anɛ nɔ ko ma nyɛ kpɔ ngɛ e dɛ lo?
Ke yiwutsotsɛ nu nɔ ko ɔ,
mɛnɔ ma nyɛ kpɔ lɛ ngɛ e dɛ?
25Yawɛ he nɔ ke,
“Niinɛ, katsɛ ta yibu ní ɔ,
a ma nyɛ kpɔ ngɛ e dɛ.
Ke yiwutsotsɛ nu nɔ ko po,
a ma nyɛ kpɔ lɛ ngɛ e dɛ.
I kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ kɛ mo ngɛ pɛe ɔ ma ná,
nɛ ma he o bimɛ ɔmɛ a yi wami.
26Ma ha nihi nɛ ngɛ mo haoe ɔ
maa ye mɛ nitsɛmɛ a he lo awi;
mɛ nitsɛmɛ a muɔ maa de mɛ
kaa wai.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, nimli adesahi tsuo maa le
kaa imi ji Yawɛ.
Imi ji nɔ nɛ heɔ o yi wami,
nɛ haa nɛ o yeɔ o he.
A ma na le kaa imi ji Israel Mawu
kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ nɛ.”

Title: YESAYA 50
Content:
1Yawɛ ke,
“Anɛ nyɛ susuɔ kaa
i ha ye ma a je ye he kɛ ho
kaa bɔ nɛ nyumu kɛ e yo poɔ gba mi,
nɛ e haa yo ɔ gba mi pomi womi ɔ lo?
Ke ja nyɛ susu ɔ,
jije gba mi pomi womi ɔ ngɛ mɔ?
Anɛ nyɛ susuɔ kaa i jua nyɛ kɛ ho ma se ya
kaa bɔ nɛ a juaa bimɛ kaa nyɔguɛhi lo?
Dɛbi, nyɛ yayami ɔmɛ a he
nɛ a jua nyɛ ɔ nɛ;
nyɛ mlaa tɔmi ɔmɛ a he
a fie nyɛ kɛ ho ɔ nɛ.
2“Mɛni he je lɛ benɛ i ba a,
nɔ ko be lejɛ ɔ?
Benɛ i tsɛ nyɛ ɔ,
mɛni he je nɔ ko pui mi ɔ?
Anɛ nyɛ susuɔ kaa ye nine ngɛ kuku
nɛ i be nyɛe ma kpɔ nyɛ
kɛ je he nyɛlɔ ɔ dɛ mi lo?
Ke i wo gbi ɔ, wo miiɔ,
nɛ pahi plɛɔ peeɔ nga kplanaa.
Ke nyu ɔ mii ta a,
lo gboɔ nɛ e saa.
3Imi lɛ i haa hiɔwe woɔ diblii kpii
kaa nɔ́ nɛ a kɛ kpekpe ya bo ha he.”
Yawɛ tsɔlɔ ɔ bu lɛ tue
4Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ tsɔɔ mi nɔ́ nɛ ma de,
konɛ be nɛ sa mi ɔ,
ma nyɛ ma wo nɔ nɛ pɔ tɔ lɛ ɔ he wami.
Daa mɔtu ɔ, e haa i hlaa kaa
nɔ́ nɛ e maa tsɔɔ mi ɔ, ma bu tue
kaa ní kaselɔ.
5Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ bli ye tue;
i tsɔ we atuã, i kua we lɛ.
6 I ngmɛ blɔ nɛ a fia ye se mi kpa;
a jɛ mi; a hia ye kpɛni si bwɔmi,
nɛ a su lada ngɔ pue ye hɛ mi
kɛ pue ye hɛ mi si.
7Se enɛ ɔmɛ tsuo pee we mi nɔ́ ko,
ejakaa Nyɔmtsɛ Mawu ɔ piɛ ye he, nɛ zo gbi mi.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i nu ye tsui, nɛ i wlua mi,
ejakaa i le kaa zo be mi gbee.
8 Nɔ nɛ maa wo mi nguɔ ɔ ngɛ ye kasa nya.
Mɛnɔ lɛ e kɛ mi ná a?
É ba konɛ waa kpe!
Mɛnɔ ji ye he nyɛlɔ ɔ?
É hɛ lɛ kɛ ba ye ngɔ.
9Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ
nitsɛ ngɛ ye kasa nya,
mɛnɔ maa bu mi fɔ mɔ?
Ye he nyɛli ɔmɛ tsuo maa laa,
a hɛ mi ma kpata pɛsɛpɛsɛ
kaa bo nɛ wɔyewɔye ye.
10Nyɛ ti mɛnɔ yeɔ Yawɛ gbeye,
nɛ e buɔ e tsɔlɔ ɔ gbi tue?
E tsɔlɔ nɛ ɔ,
ke e nyɛɛ ngɛ diblii kpii mi po,
e ngɔɔ e hɛ ngɔ fɔɔ Yawɛ nɔ,
nɛ e ngɔɔ e he kɛ kpasaa e Mawu ɔ.
11Nyɛ nihi tsuo nɛ nyɛ peeɔ kpe
kɛ soɔ nihi a yi nɔ,
konɛ nyɛ kpata a hɛ mi,
nyɛ yi mi tomi yaya amɛ ma kpata nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ hɛ mi.
Yawɛ nitsɛ ma ha nɔ́ nɛ ɔ maa ba mi;
nyɛ nyagbe maa pee mɔbɔ.

Title: YESAYA 51
Content:
A wo Yerusalem bua
1Yawɛ ke,
“Nyɛ nihi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ hlae
nɛ a he nyɛ yi wami,
nɛ nyɛ ba ye ngɔ, konɛ ma piɛ nyɛ he,
nyɛɛ bu mi tue.
Nyɛ susu ní nɛ ɔmɛ a he:
tɛ sa nɛ a gba nyɛ kɛ je mi ɔ,
kɛ tɛ muɔ nɛ a tsua nyɛ kɛ je mi ɔ.
2Nyɛ susu nyɛ nɛ̃, Abraham,
kɛ Sara hu nɛ fɔ nyɛ ɔ a he.
Benɛ i tsɛ Abraham ɔ, e be bi ko kulaa,
se i gbaa lɛ, nɛ i ha lɛ bimɛ;
nɛ i ha e nina hiɛ babauu.
3“Ma jɔɔ Yerusalem bua;
nihi tsuo nɛ ngɛ Yerusalem we doku ɔmɛ a mi ɔ,
ma jɔɔ a bua.
E zugba a pee nga kplanaa lɛɛ,
se ma ha e ma plɛ pee ngmɔ
kaa ngmɔ ɔ nɛ i pee ngɛ Eden ɔ.
Ma a mi bi ɔmɛ a bua maa jɔ saminya,
a ma nya nɛ a ma la
yi jemi, kɛ sina lahi.
4“Ye ma, nyɛɛ bu mi tue,
nyɛ ta tue ha nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ dee ɔ.
Ma ngɔ ye mlaa kɛ ha je ma amɛ;
nɛ lɔ ɔ maa pee kaa la ha mɛ.
5Ma ba esɔesɔ, konɛ ma ba he a yi wami.
Ye kunimi yemi be ɔ su ta.
Imi nitsɛ ma ye je ma amɛ a nɔ.
Wo nya zugba amɛ ngɛ mi mlɛe,
a ngɔ a hɛ ngɔ fɔ ye nɔ
kɛ ngɛ mi blɔ hyɛe
kaa ma ba he a yi wami.
6Nyɛ wo nyɛ yi nɔ nɛ nyɛɛ hyɛ hiɔwe,
nɛ nyɛɛ kpale hyɛ zugba mi.
Hiɔwe maa laa kaa la su ku nɛ se po;
zugba ma puplee kaa tako piɛ,
nɛ nimli nɛ ngɛ nɔ ɔ
ma gbo kaa anunuhi.
Se nyɛɛ lɛɛ ma he nyɛ yi wami daa;
ma ye kunimi ha nyɛ kɛ maa ya neneene.
7“Nyɛ nɛ nyɛ le nɔ́ nɛ da,
nɛ nyɛ suɔ ye mlaa a saminya,
nyɛ ko ye gbeye kaa nimli adesahi maa ye nyɛ he fɛu,
loo a ma jɛ nyɛ.
Ke a ngɛ nyɛ he fɛu yee ɔ,
nyɛ ko ye tsui!
8Ejakaa a hɛ mi ma kpata pɛsɛpɛsɛ
kaa bo nɛ wɔyewɔye ye,
loo kuutu nɛ gɔgɔ ye.
Ma ye dami sane ha nyɛ daa,
nɛ ma he nyɛ yi wami be tsuaa be;
ma ye kunimi ha nyɛ kɛ maa ya neneene.”
9Yawɛ, moo te si nɛ o piɛ wa he!
Ngɔɔ o he wami ɔ kɛ he wa yi wami
kaa bɔ nɛ o pee blema a.
Pi mo nɛ o gbɔ Rahab,
wo mi lo nguaa a nɔ́,
nɛ o poo e mi kpokukpoku ɔ lo?
10Mo nɔuu ji nɔ nɛ ha wo ɔ mii;
o je blɔ kɛ gu nyu ɔ mi,
konɛ nihi nɛ o he a yi wami ɔ
nɛ a nyɛ nɛ a po wo ɔ.
11Nihi nɛ mo Yawɛ, o kpɔ mɛ ɔ,
a kɛ bua jɔmi ma la kɛ ba Yerusalem.
A bua maa jɔ kɛ maa ya neneene;
aywilɛho kɛ kɔmɔ yemi tsuo se maa po.
12Yawɛ ke,
“Imi ji nɔ nɛ woɔ mo he wami.
Nɔmlɔ adesa nɛ gboɔ,
nɛ e wami se kɛmi pi kaa nga nɔ́ po ɔ,
mɛni he je o yeɔ lɛ gbeye?
13Anɛ Yawɛ, nɔ nɛ bɔ mo,
nɛ e pee hiɔwe ploplooplo,
nɛ e ngɔ zugba a sisi tomi ɔmɛ ngɔ ma si ɔ,
o hɛ je e nɔ lo?
Nihi nɛ ngɛ mo yi mi wae,
nɛ a pee klaalo kaa a ma kpata o hɛ mi ɔ,
mɛni he je o ngɛ mɛ
mohu gbeye yee ɔ?
A be nyɛe maa pee mo nɔ ko hu.
14E be kɛe kulaa nɛ nihi nɛ a wo mɛ tsu ɔ
maa ye a he.
A ma na a nya mi ngma bɔ nɛ sa,
nɛ a se maa kɛ ngɛ je mi.
15“Imi ji Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ nɛ.
Imi nɛ i haa wo gliɔ,
nɛ oslɔke ɔmɛ peeɔ hoo.
Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ji ye biɛ!
16Imi ji nɔ nɛ pee hiɔwe ploplooplo ɔ,
nɛ i ngɔ zugba a sisi tomi ɔmɛ ngɔ ma si.
Bɔ nɛ i ngɛ Yerusalem dee ji,
‘Ye ma ji mo!
I wo mo mlaa,
nɛ i ngɔ ye he wami kɛ ngɛ o he bue.’ ”
Yerusalem amanehlu ɔ se po
17 Yerusalem, tee si!
O hɛ nɛ tsɛ, nɛ o te si nɛ o da si!
Amanehlu nɛ ngɛ kaa kplu
nɛ Yawɛ kɛ abofu ngɔ ha mo
ke o nu, konɛ e kɛ gbla o tue ɔ,
o nu kɛ e sisi ɔ tsuo;
nɛ enɛ ɔ ha o ngɛ si tataae.
18Nɔ ko nɔ ko be o bimɛ ɔmɛ a kpɛti
nɛ maa tsɔɔ mo blɔ;
nɔ ko nɔ ko be bimɛ ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ o tsɔse ɔ a kpɛti
nɛ maa ta o dɛ mi kɛ nyɛɛ.
19Haomi enyɔ nɛ ɔmɛ ba o nɔ;
ta ba kpata o zugba a hɛ mi,
nɛ hwɔ nɛ nya wa ngɛ ni ɔmɛ yee.
Mɛnɔ maa jɔɔ o bua?
20O bimɛ ɔmɛ gbɔjɔ,
nɛ a hɛli kɛ pueɔ si ngɛ gbɛjegbɛ ɔ nɔ
kaa bayelɔ nɛ du klama.
Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ
gbla o tue wawɛɛ nitsɛ.
21Lɔ ɔ he ɔ,
Yerusalem, o bimɛ ɔmɛ a ní pee mɔbɔ,
nɛ a ngɛ si tataae kaa nihi nɛ tɔ dã.
22Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ
nɛ faa e ma a he ɔ,
bɔ nɛ e ngɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ:
“Kplu nɛ i ngɔ ha mo ngɛ abofu nya a,
i ngɛ hee ngɛ o dɛ.
O be dã a nue hu
konɛ o ko tataa si kaa dã tɔlɔ hu.
23O he nyɛli nɛ haoɔ mo,
nihi nɛ ha o hwɔɔ si ngɛ zugba mi,
nɛ a naa o nɔ kaa a naa gbɛjegbɛ nɔ ɔ,
mɛ a dɛ mi ma ngɔ kplu ɔ kɛ wo.”

Title: YESAYA 52
Content:
Mawu ma he Yerusalem yi wami
1 Yerusalem, tee si nɛ o pee ma nguaa ekohu!
Mawu ma klɔuklɔu, o hɛ mi nɛ ba nyami,
nɛ́ a bu mo saminya!
Ma je li be hiɛ ɔ bae hu gblegbleegble.
2Yerusalem nɛ a pee mo nyɔguɛ,
tee si nɛ o huanya bunyuku ɔ ngɔ pue si,
nɛ o hi o matsɛ sɛ ɔ nɔ!
Zion biyo nɛ a nu mo nɛ a bɔ mo pã,
je pã a ngɛ o kuɛ!
3Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ ngɛ e ma a dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Tsa pi sika nɛ a kɛ he nyɛ kɛ pee nyɛ nyɔguɛ, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a kɛ sika be nyɛ kpɔe. 4Kekle ɔ, nyɛ ya Egipt, nɛ nyɛ ya to nubwɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ; pee se ɔ, Asiria bi ɔmɛ wa nyɛ yi mi yaka gu. 5 Jehanɛ, ngɛ Babilonia hu, jamɛ a amimi ɔ nɔuu a ye nyɛ; a pee nyɛ nyɔguɛhi nɛ a wui hiɔ ko ngɛ nyɛ he. Nihi nɛ ye nyɛ nɔ ɔ fĩa, nɛ a jɛ nyɛ saminya kɛ gbe ye he guɛ. 6Be ma nɛ nyɛ maa le kaa imi ji Mawu; nyɛ maa le kaa imi lɛ i kɛ nyɛ tu munyu ɔ nɛ.”
7 Mɛni ji afɛu!
Nyɛɛ hyɛ manye munyu fiɛlɔ ko
nyɛɛ yo ɔmɛ a nɔ kɛ ma;
e hɛɛ manye munyu sɔuu;
manye munyu ɔ kɔɔ tue mi jɔmi he!
E ngɛ fiɛe ke a ye kunimi,
nɛ e ngɛ Zion dee ke,
“O Mawu ɔ ngɛ matsɛ yee!”
8Ma a he buli ɔmɛ a nya nɛ a ngɛ nue boboobo ɔ nɛ;
mɛ tsuo a kɛ bua jɔmi ngɛ lae kɛ ngmlaa!
Ejakaa mɛ nitsɛmɛ a kɛ a hɛngmɛ na
bɔ nɛ Yawɛ kpale e ma, Zion kɛ ma ekohu!
9Nyɛ Yerusalem tsu kokoehi,
nyɛ bua nɛ jɔ, nɛ nyɛ hwɔ lele!
Ejakaa Yawɛ ma he e ma a yi wami,
nɛ e maa jɔɔ e ma mi bi ɔmɛ a bua.
10Yawɛ ma je e he wami klɔuklɔu ɔ kpo;
e ma he e ma a yi wami,
nɛ je ɔ tsuo maa na.
11 Nyɛ tsuo nyɛ ba be kɛ ho; nyɛɛ je Babilonia!
Nyɛ nihi nɛ nyɛ hɛɛ Mawu we ɔ ní klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ,
nyɛɛ pee nyɛ he klɔuklɔu;
nyɛ ko ta nɔ́ ko nɛ he tsɔ we he.
12Jehanɛ lɛɛ e hia we kaa
nyɛ maa ye esɔ kɛ hia blɔ;
nyɛ be fo tue kɛ je.
Ejakaa Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ maa nyɛɛ nyɛ hɛ mi
ngɛ he tsuaa he nɛ nyɛ yaa a,
nɛ e maa bu nyɛ he.
Tsɔlɔ nɔ́ nalɔ ɔ
13Yawɛ ke,
“Ye tsɔlɔ ɔ maa ye manye ngɛ e ní tsumi mi;
a ma wo e nɔ gojoo,
nɛ a maa wo e hɛ mi nyami babauu!
14Nihi babauu nɛ na lɛ ɔ, a he mi po;
ejakaa a puɛ e nɔmlɔ tso subai ɔ kulaa;
ke o hyɛ lɛ ɔ, e slo lɛ kulaa ngɛ adesa he!
15 Se jehanɛ lɛɛ e he maa pee je mahi babauu nyakpɛ;
nɛ matsɛmɛ pohu a nya maa kpɛ a he wawɛɛ.
Ejakaa nɔ́ ko nɛ a de we mɛ hyɛ ɔ, a maa na,
nɛ nɔ́ ko nɛ a nui hyɛ ɔ,
a maa nu sisi jehanɛ.”

Title: YESAYA 53
Content:
1 Ni ɔmɛ he nɔ ke,
“Mɛnɔ ma he wa munyu nɛ ɔ maa ye?
Mɛnɔ maa le kaa Yawɛ he
ngɛ sane nɛ ɔ mi?
2Yawɛ tsɔlɔ ɔ ngɛ kaa tso wayoo ko
nɛ puɛ kɛ je zugba gbigbli mi.
Agboje ko be e he ɔ,
he fɛu hu bɔ lɛ,
lɔ ɔ he ɔ, wa bui lɛ.
Nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko be e he nɛ maa pee wɔ akɔnɔ.
3Wa gbe e he guɛ, nɛ wa kua lɛ.
E na nɔ́, nɛ e pi wawɛɛ nitsɛ.
Nɔ ko nɔ ko plɛ we nɛ e hyɛ lɛ;
wa gbe e he guɛ, nɛ wa bui lɛ saasaa.
4 “Haomi kɛ pimi nɛ ko ba wa nɔ ɔ,
lɛ mohu e ya da nya ha wɔ.
Se wɔɔ lɛɛ, wa susu kaa
Mawu lɛ ngɔ ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo
kɛ ngɛ e tue gblae.
5 A plaa lɛ ngɛ wa yayami ɔmɛ a he,
a fiaa lɛ ní ngɛ wa tɔmi ɔmɛ a he,
a gbla e tue, konɛ wa na he jɔmi,
a wo e he pa, konɛ wɔɔ lɛɛ wa na tsami.
6 Wɔ tsuo wa ngɛ kaa tohi nɛ laa blɔ;
nɔ tsuaa nɔ ngɔ lɛ nitsɛ e blɔ.
Se tue gblami nɛ sa wɔ tsuo ɔ,
Yawɛ ngɔ kɛ ha lɛ.
7 “A wa lɛ yi mi, nɛ a pi lɛ;
se e kpɛ we e kuɔ si!
A kpaka lɛ kɛ ho kaa to bi
nɛ a yaa gbe.
Nɛ bɔ nɛ jijɔ peeɔ kpoo
ngɛ e he bwɔmi salɔ hɛ mi ɔ,
ja nɔuu e kpɛ we e kuɔ si.
8A ye sane yaya kɛ bu lɛ gbenɔ fɔ,
nɛ a nu le kɛ ho.
Ejakaa a ngɔ e wami kɛ je zugba a nɔ.
Tɔmihi nɛ ye ma a tɔ ɔ,
a he a gbe lɛ ngɛ.
9 E gbo ngɛ yayami peeli a kpɛti,
nɛ a pu lɛ ngɛ niatsɛ ko yɔkɔ mi;
se anɔkuale mi ɔ, e yi nɔ ko awi hyɛ,
nɛ lakpa ko hu ji e nya hyɛ.”
10“Se e sa Yawɛ hɛ mi kaa a fiaa lɛ ní;
e ha a pi lɛ.
Ke e ngɔ e wami kɛ sã bɔ
ngɛ yayami he ɔ,
e se maa kɛ ngɛ je mi,
nɛ e ma na nina babauu.
Nɛ Yawɛ maa gu e nɔ
kɛ ye manye.
11Ke e na nɔ́ se ɔ, e ma na bua jɔmi ekohu,
nɛ e maa na kaa e nɔ́ nami pee we yaka.
Ye tsɔlɔ nɛ i suɔ lɛ ɔ, a maa gbla e tue
ngɛ nihi babauu a nane mi,
se e he ɔ, ma ngɔ a he yayami kɛ pa mɛ.
12 Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, ma ha lɛ blɔ nya nguaa ko
ngɛ ni nguanguahi a kpɛti.
E kɛ mɛ maa dla ta yibu ní ɔ.
Ejakaa e ngɔ e wami ngɔ ha
ngɛ yayami peeli babauu a nane mi;
nɛ e kpa pɛɛ nɛ a ngɔ
a he yayami kɛ pa mɛ.”

Title: YESAYA 54
Content:
Yawɛ suɔ Israel sane
1 Yerusalem, jinɛ o ngɛ kaa yosa,
se jehanɛ lɛɛ o ma nyɛ ma la
nɛ o ma hwɔ lele.
Jehanɛ lɛɛ o ma fɔ bimɛ babauu
pe yo nɛ e kɛ e huno ngɛ tsu nya daa!
2Bli o bo tsu ɔ mi;
bli bo tsu ɔ mi gbajaa,
tsa kpa amɛ a nɔ,
nɛ o ka tso plɛɛko ɔmɛ kɛ wo zu mi
nɛ a he nɛ wa!
3Ejakaa o he maa hiɛ ngɛ zugba a tsuo nɔ;
zugba a nɛ je ma kpa amɛ ngɛ nɔ amlɔ nɛ ɔ,
o nina ma ba kpɔ ngɛ a dɛ,
nɛ ma doku ɔmɛ a mi ma hyi tɔ
kɛ nimli.
4Koo ye gbeye, ejakaa zo be mo gbee!
O tsui ko po, ejakaa a be o hɛ mi si puee hu.
Zo ní nɛ o tsu ngɛ o yihe be mi ɔ,
o hɛ maa je nɔ,
nɛ si nɛ o hi mɔbɔmɔbɔ kaa yalɔyo ɔ,
o be kaie hu.
5O bɔlɔ ɔ ma ba pee o huno.
E biɛ ji Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ.
Israel Mawu Klɔuklɔu ɔ ma he o yi wami;
lɛ ji je ɔ tsuo Mawu.
6Israel, o ngɛ kaa yo
nɛ e huno je e he,
yo nɛ a je he ngɛ yihe mi,
nɛ e ngɛ kɔmɔ yee wawɛɛ.
Se Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ ngɛ mo tsɛe
kɛ ba e ngɔ ekohu,
nɛ e ngɛ dee ke,
7“Be kpiti ko kɛkɛ nɛ i je o he,
se ye mi mi ngɛ mi sããe wawɛɛ ngɛ o he;
lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ma ngɔ mo kɛ ba ye ngɔ ekohu.
8Ye mi mi fu mo wawɛɛ.
Kɛkɛ nɛ i je hɛ ngɛ o he be kuku,
se jehanɛ lɛɛ ma je ye suɔmi kpo kɛ tsɔɔ mo
kɛ maa ya neneene.”
Imi Yawɛ yi wami helɔ ɔ, nɛ i de.
9 “Noa be ɔ mi ɔ, i wo si ko;
i de ke i be hae nɛ nyu babauu
ma ba ha zugba a nɔ hu.
Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, i ngɛ mo si woe kaa
ye mi mi be mo fue hu gblegbleegble.
10Yo ɔmɛ, kɛ yoku ɔmɛ maa ywia pue si,
se suɔmi nɛ i ngɛ kɛ ha mo ɔ se be poe.
Somi nɛ i kɛ mo so kaa
ma ha o tue mi nɛ jɔ mo ɔ,
ma ye nɔ kɛ maa ya neneene.”
Imi Yawɛ, o mɔbɔ nalɔ ɔ
nɛ i de.
Yerusalem he ɔ
11 Yawɛ ke,
“Yerusalem, ma nɛ na amanehlu,
mo nɛ nɔ ko piɛ we o he
nɛ e wo mo bua.
Ma ngɔ tɛhi nɛ a he jua wa
kɛ fia o sisi tomi ɔ ekohu.
12Ma ngɔ tɛ nɛ he jua wa nɛ a tsɛɛ rubi tɛ
kɛ ma gbogbo ɔmɛ a yi mi
ngɛ saflɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ.
Ma ngɔ tɛ nɛ kpɛɔ kaa la,
nɛ a tsɛɛ karbunkle tɛ ɔ
kɛ pee agbo ɔmɛ.
Gbogbo nɛ bɔle mo ɔ,
tɛ nɛ he jua wa sɔuu ma ngɔ kɛ fia.
13 “Imi Yawɛ nitsɛ, ma tsɔɔ ye ma a ní,
nɛ ma ha a ma na ní babauu.
14Dami sane yemi, kɛ kpakpa peemi
ma ha o ma a he maa wa.
Nɔ ko nɔ ko be mo yi mi wae,
nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be o he gbeye woe.
15Ke nɔ ko ba tua mo ɔ,
pi imi nɛ i tsɔ lɛ;
nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ma ba tua mo ɔ,
jamɛ a nɔ ɔ be mo nyɛe.
16“Imi ji nɔ nɛ bɔ sɔ̃lɔ
nɛ huu la mi,
nɛ e sɔ̃ɔ̃ ta hwumi níhi.
Imi nɔuu ji nɔ nɛ bɔ ta hwulɔ ɔ
nɛ ngɔɔ ta hwumi dade kɛ kpataa nɔ hɛ mi.
17Se ta hwumi níhi nɛ a sɔ̃ nɛ ɔmɛ
ekoeko be nyɛe maa pee mo nɔ́ ko;
jehanɛ hu, nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ kɛ mo ma na sane ɔ,
a maa bu lɛ fɔ.
Ma bu ye tsɔli ɔmɛ a he,
nɛ ma ha a maa ye kunimi.”
Yawɛ lɛ de.

Title: YESAYA 55
Content:
Mawu naa mɔbɔ
1 Yawɛ ke,
“Kuuwi, nyɛ nihi tsuo nɛ kuma ngɛ nyɛ yee,
nyu babaaba ngɛ hiɛ ɔ ha nyɛ!
Nyɛ nihi nɛ nyɛ be sika hu, nyɛɛ ba;
nyɛ ba he niye ní nɛ nyɛɛ ye!
Nyɛɛ ba nyɛ ba he dã, kɛ na nyɔ nyu
e hia we sika; a jua we!
2Mɛni he je nyɛ puɛɔ sika
kɛ heɔ nɔ nɛ be nyɛ tɔe?
Mɛni he je nyɛ ngɔɔ nyɛ ní tsumi mi hiɔwo
kɛ heɔ nɔ́ nɛ tɔɛ nɔ?
Nyɛɛ bu mi tue saminya
nɛ nyɛɛ pee nɔ nɛ i ngɛ dee ɔ;
kɛkɛ nyɛ maa ye ní kpakpahi
nɛ nyɛ bua maa jɔ nyɛ he.
3 “Ye ma, nyɛ ta tue, nɛ nyɛɛ ba ye ngɔ;
nyɛɛ ba ye ngɔ, konɛ nyɛ yi nɛ na wami.
I kɛ nyɛ maa so somi ko
nɛ maa hi si kɛ maa ya neneene;
nɛ gbaami nɛ i wo David si
ke ma ha e nina a,
ma kɛ ha nyɛ.
4I wo lɛ je ma amɛ a nyatsɛ, kɛ asafoatsɛngua,
nɛ e nɔ i gu kɛ je ye he wami kpo.
5Jehanɛ lɛɛ, o ma tsɛ je mahi nɛ li mo kɛ ba;
sa a, a li mo, se jehanɛ lɛɛ
a ma wo fo kɛ ba o ngɔ!
Imi Yawɛ, Israel Mawu klɔuklɔu ɔ
ma ha ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo maa ba mi.”
6Be mi nɛ Yawɛ he kɛ we nɛ ɔ,
nyɛ hla e se blɔ
nɛ nyɛɛ fa kue ha lɛ.
7Nyɛ yiwutsotsɛmɛ,
nyɛ kpa awi yemi,
nyɛ yayami peeli,
nyɛ ko susu nɔ́ yaya hu.
Nyɛɛ kpale kɛ ba Yawɛ,
wa Mawu ɔ ngɔ.
E naa mɔbɔ,
nɛ be tsuaa be ɔ,
e kɛ nɔ tɔmi paa.
8Yawɛ ke,
“E slo bɔ nɛ i susuɔ nɔ́ he,
nɛ e slo bɔ nɛ nyɛ hu nyɛ susuɔ nɔ́ he;
jehanɛ e slo ye blɔ ɔmɛ
ngɛ nyɛ blɔ ɔmɛ a he.
9Bɔ nɛ hiɔwe kɛ zugba a kpɛti kɛ ɔ,
ja ye blɔ ɔmɛ, kɛ nyɛ blɔ ɔmɛ a kpɛti kɛ,
nɛ ja nɔuu ye susumi ɔmɛ hu pã nyɛ susumi ɔmɛ.
10 “Ye munyu ngɛ kaa snoo kɛ hiɔmi
nɛ nɛɔ kɛ jeɔ hiɔwe kɛ pueɔ zugba.
Ní nɛ ɔmɛ haa dumi níhi puɛɔ.
Wa naa wu nɛ wa duɔ,
kɛ ngma nɛ wa yeɔ.
11Munyuhi nɛ i tuɔ ɔ,
ja a maa pee.
Munyu tsuaa munyu nɛ jeɔ ye nya a,
nɔ́ nɛ i ke e pee ɔ, ja e pee
loko e maa kpale kɛ ba.
Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ i to ke e ba mi ɔ
maa ba mi kokooko.
12“Nyɛɛ kɛ bua jɔmi maa je lejɛ ɔ.
A maa ngɔ nyɛ kɛ je ngɛ tue mi jɔmi mi.
Yo ɔmɛ, kɛ yoku ɔmɛ maa hia la,
nɛ pu mi tso ɔmɛ tsuo maa fia a dɛ mi.
13Mio tso nane mi ɔ, sɛsɛo maa puɛ.
Tso kpakpa maa puɛ ngɛ mio tso nane mi.
E maa pee okadi nɛ maa hi si kɛ maa ya neneene, nɛ a kɛ
ma kai nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ tsu.”

Title: YESAYA 56
Content:
Je ma amɛ tsuo maa pee Mawu ma
