1Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ ngɛ e ma a dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Nyɛɛ pee nɔ́ nɛ da, kɛ nɔ́ nɛ sa, ejakaa e be kɛe kulaa nɛ ma ba he nyɛ yi wami. 2Nihi nɛ baa a je mi saminya, nɛ a pee we yayami, se mohu a yeɔ Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ, nɛ a ble we lɛ ɔ, ma gbaa mɛ.”
3Nubwɔ nɛ kɛ e he ba mɛtɛ Yawɛ ma a he ɔ, e ko de ke, “Yawɛ be suɔe kaa ma piɛ e ma mi bi ɔmɛ a he kɛ ja lɛ.”
Nyumu nɛ a puɛ lɛ, nɛ e be bi ɔ, e ko susu kaa Mawu be lɛ ngɔe kɛ piɛ e ma a he. 4Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ ngɛ nɔ ɔ dee ji, “Ke o yeɔ Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ, nɛ o peeɔ ye suɔmi nya ní, nɛ o yeɔ ye somi ɔ nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ ɔ, 5ye ma a ma kai o biɛ ngɛ ye we ɔ pe binyumuhi, loo biyihi nɛ o ngɛ po. Ma ha mo biɛ kpakpa nɛ a ma kai kɛ maa ya neneene.”
6Jehanɛ, nibwɔhi nɛ kɛ a he ba mɛtɛ ma a he, nɛ a suɔ Mawu sane, nɛ a jaa lɛ, nɛ a yeɔ Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ kɛ e somi ɔ nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ ɔ, bɔ nɛ Yawɛ ngɛ mɛ dee ji, 7 “Ma ngɔ nyɛ kɛ ba Zion, ye yo klɔuklɔu ɔ nɔ; ma ha nyɛ bua maa jɔ ngɛ ye sɔlemi we ɔ, nɛ bɔ ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ nyɛ maa sã ngɛ ye bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ, ma he. Ejakaa a ma tsɛ ye we ɔ je mahi tsuo a sɔlemi we.”
8Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ nɛ ngɛ e ma Israel nya buae kɛ je ma se kɛ ma we ɔ, bɔ nɛ e ngɛ dee ji, “Ma bua ni kpahi a nya kɛ piɛ nihi nɛ a bua a nya momo ɔ a he.”
A bu Israel ma nimeli ɔmɛ fɔ
9Yawɛ de je ma amɛ nɛ je ma se ɔ ke á ba kaa lohwe dikali, nɛ a ba tsɔtslɔɔ e ma mi bi ɔmɛ a mi. 10E ke, “Ma hɛ mi nyɛɛli ɔmɛ nɛ sa kaa a kaa ye ma a hɛ mi ɔ, hɛ yuyuili ji mɛ tsuo; a li nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko! A ngɛ kaa we he bumi gbehi nɛ kpa we ngmlaa; daa nɛ ɔ, mahe mi kɛkɛ a hii nɛ a hii nlae. Lɔ ɔ ji nɔ́ nɛ a suɔ! 11A ngɛ kaa gbehi nɛ li tɔ biɛ! Ma nɔ yeli nɛ ɔmɛ be juɛmi kokooko! Nɔ tsuaa nɔ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ e suɔ; mɛ nitsɛmɛ a se nami pɛ a hlaa. 12Dã tɔli nɛ ɔmɛ deɔ ke, ‘Nyɛɛ ba nɛ wa ya hla wai nɛ waa nu. Wa maa nu dã bɔ nɛ wa ma nyɛ mwɔnɛ ɔ! Hwɔɔ lɛɛ e maa pee gbeye!’ ”

Title: YESAYA 57
Content:
A bu Israel fɔ kaa e ja amaga
1Ke nɔmlɔ kpakpa gbo ɔ, nɔ ko nɔ ko susuu we he, nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko nui sisi hulɔ kaa yayami nɛ maa ba a nya Mawu ngɛ dalɔ ɔ jee kɛ je, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ ayimayi ko kó ba ye lɛ hwɔɔ se. 2Nihi nɛ baa a je mi saminya, nɛ a peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a, ke a gbo ɔ, a naa tue mi jɔmi, kɛ he jɔmi.
3Se, nyɛ yayami peeli nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ ní peeli, kɛ gba puɛli, kɛ yi yaholi tsuo sɔ ɔ, nyɛɛ ba hiɛ ɔ! 4Mɛnɔ he fɛu nyɛ ngɛ yee ɔ? Nyɛ lakpatsɛmɛ, yayami peeli a bimɛ, mɛnɔ he nyɛ pa nyɛ nya mi hatoo, nɛ nyɛ je nyɛ lilɛ kpo bilaa kɛ wo ɔ? 5Nyɛ nɛ nyɛ he mi akɔnɔ teɔ si, nɛ́ nyɛɛ kɛ bɔɔ ajuama ngɛ tso nguanguahi nɛ bɔ kusuu a sisi. Nyɛ ngɔɔ nyɛ bimɛ kɛ sãã bɔ ngɛ tɛ puɔhi a mi ngɛ kɔ̃ ɔmɛ a mi.
6Nyɛ ya ngɔɔ dongo tɛhi kɛ jeɔ kɔ̃ mi, nɛ nyɛ jaa mɛ. Nyɛ ngɔɔ wai kɛ sãã bɔ kɛ haa tɛhi; nɛ nyɛ ngɔɔ ngma hu kɛ sãã bɔ ha mɛ ja nɔuu. Ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ nyɛ peeɔ ɔ, anɛ nyɛ susuu kaa ye bua maa jɔ he? 7Nyɛ ya kuɔɔ yo gaga amɛ, ya sãã bɔ; nɛ nyɛ ya bɔɔ ajuama ngɛ lejɛ ɔmɛ. 8Nyɛ ngɔɔ nyɛ amaga amɛ ngɔ maa nyɛ tsu ɔmɛ a mi ngɛ sinya se, nɛ nyɛ jaa mɛ. Nyɛ jeɔ ye se nɛ nyɛ ya ngmɛɛ nyɛ sa amɛ, nɛ nyɛ dlaa a nɔ saminyayoo. Jehanɛ, nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ plã amɛ ya hwɔɔ si bɔ nɛ nyɛ ma nyɛ, nɛ nyɛ woɔ mɛ hiɔ sisiisi kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ mɛ yeɔ nya a. 9Nyɛ ngɔɔ nu, kɛ nu kɛ e he via fuu kɛ hiaa blɔ kɛ ya jaa mawu ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ Molek ɔ. Bɔ nɛ pee nɛ nyɛ na mawu kpahi nɛ nyɛ ja a, nyɛ tsɔɔ nihi kɛ yaa ma se tsitsaa lokoo, kɛ yaa gbeje tete po. 10Nyɛ gbaa nyɛ he nya babauu kɛ kpaa si; pɔ hu tɔɛ nyɛ nɛ nyɛ ma kpa. Nyɛ susuɔ kaa nyɛ amaga amɛ haa nyɛ he wami, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ ngmɛɛ we a he.
11Yawɛ ke, “Mɛnɔ gbeye nyɛ ya ye, loko nyɛ ye lakpa, nɛ nyɛ hɛ je ye nɔ pɛsɛɛ kikɛ nɛ ɔ? Akɛnɛ i pee dii kɛ je blema lokoo he je ɔ, nyɛ bui mi, nɛ nyɛ yi mi gbeye hulɔ, pi jã? 12Nyɛ susuɔ kaa nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ pee ɔ da, se ma ha nyɛ maa na paa kaa amaga amɛ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ a se nyɛɛe ɔ be nyɛe maa pee nɔ́ kpakpa ko ha nyɛ. 13Benɛ nyɛ ngɛ ngmlaa kpae kɛ ngɛ balɔ tsɛe ɔ, nyɛ ha nɛ nyɛ amaga babauu ɔmɛ nɛ a je ngmlaa ha nyɛ koo! Kɔɔhiɔ kɛkɛ po maa bɛɛ mɛ tsuo kɛ ho; mumi nɛ a woɔ si kake pɛ ma fli mɛ kɛ ho. Se ni nɛmɛ nɛ ngɔɔ a hɛ ngɔ fɔɔ ye nɔ ɔ, a maa hi zugba a nɔ, nɛ a ma ja mi ngɛ ye yo klɔuklɔu ɔ nɔ.”
Mawu wo si ke e maa piɛ e ma a he nɛ e ma tsa mɛ
14Yawɛ ke, “Nyɛ ha ye ma a nɛ kpale kɛ ba ye ngɔ. Nyɛ je blɔ tsimi nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ kɛ je a blɔ mi! Nyɛɛ je gbɛjegbɛ saminyayoo ha mɛ!
15“Imi ji Mawu klɔuklɔu nɛ hii hiɔwe kɛ yaa neneene ɔ nɛ. I hii he klɔuklɔu ngɛ hiɔwe lokoo; se nɔ nɛ baa e he si ngɛ e mumi mi, nɛ e tsui mi tsɔ ɔ, i kɛ lɛ hiɔ si; i woɔ e mumi kã, konɛ e ngɔ e hɛ ngɔ fɔ ye nɔ, nɛ e na wami he. 16Imi nitsɛ nɛ i ha ye ma a wami; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i kɛ mɛ be pɛe, nɛ ye mi mi hu be mɛ fue kɛ ya neneene. 17Ye mi mi fu mɛ, nɛ i gbla a tue, nɛ i kua mɛ; ejakaa a peeɔ yayami, nɛ a hɛ kɔ̃ɔ̃; se kɛ̃ ɔ, a wa tue, nɛ a ya nɔ pee níhi nɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a suɔ.
18“I na níhi nɛ a ngɛ pee ɔ, se ma tsa mɛ. Ma tsɔɔ mɛ blɔ, nɛ ma piɛ a he; nɛ ma wo kɔmɔ yeli ɔmɛ bua! 19 Nihi nɛ a ngɛ kpo nya, kɛ tsitsaa tsuo ma na tue mi jɔmi. Ma tsa ye ma a. 20Se yiwutsotsɛmɛ lɛɛ a ngɛ kaa wo nɛ gli nɛ e we oslɔke ɔmɛ ngɛ kue; a ngɛ kaa wo nɛ ngɛ mu níhi, kɛ mɔsɔ jee kɛ ngɛ he puee daa nɛ. 21 Yiwutsotsɛmɛ be he jɔmi nae gblegbleegble.” Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de.

Title: YESAYA 58
Content:
Hwɔ hami kpakpa
1Yawɛ ke, “Kpa ngmlaa boboobo bɔ nɛ o ma nyɛ; ha nɛ o nya nɛ wa wawɛɛ kaa titimati! Jaje ye ma Israel tɔmi ɔmɛ kɛ tsɔɔ mɛ! 2A deɔ ke a jaa mi daa kɛ tsɔɔ kaa a ngɛ hlae nɛ a le ye suɔmi nya ní, nɛ a ye ye mlaa amɛ a nɔ. A deɔ hu ke a ngɛ hlae nɛ ma wo mɛ mlaa kpakpahi, nɛ a suɔ kaa a ma ja mi.”
3Ye ma mi bi ɔmɛ ngɛ bie ke, “Mɛni he je ke wa ha hwɔ nɛ Yawɛ nɛ ɔ? Mɛni he je ke wa wa wa he yi mi nɛ e li ɔ?”
Yawɛ ngɛ mɛ dee ke, “Anɔkuale ɔ ji kaa be mi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ hwɔ hae ɔ, jamɛ a be ɔ mi nɔuu nyɛ tsuɔ ní kɛ hlaa nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ se nami, nɛ nyɛ waa nyɛ ní tsuli tsuo yi mi. 4Nyɛ haa hwɔ, se nyɛ peeɔ basabasa; nyɛ pɛɔ, nɛ nyɛ nɔɔ kunɔ. Nyɛ susuɔ kaa kikɛmɛ a hwɔ hami ɔ ma ha ma bu nyɛ kue fami tue lo? 5Anɛ hwɔ hami kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ i ngɛ hlae lo? Anɛ nɔ nitsɛ e he pimi kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ i suɔ lo? Ke nɔ ko ma e yi si kudɔɔ kaa ngɔwu, nɛ e ngmɛ kpekpe ngɛ la zu mi nɛ e hwɔ nɔ ɔ, enɛ ɔ nyɛ tsɛɔ hwɔ hami ɔ? Enɛ ɔ maa sa ye hɛ mi lo?
6“Hwɔ hami nɛ maa sa ye hɛ mi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. Nyɛ kpa yi wu tso ní peemi, nɛ nyɛɛ ye dami sane. Nyɛ kplɔ kuɛpã tso ngɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ mɛ yi mi wae ɔ a kuɛ, nɛ nyɛɛ ku mɛ dukuduku, konɛ ni ɔmɛ nɛ a ye a he. 7 Nɔ nɛ hwɔ ngɛ lɛ yee ɔ, nyɛ ha lɛ ní nɛ e ye, nɛ nihi nɛ be he ko nɛ a maa hi ɔ, nyɛɛ ngɔ mɛ kɛ ba nyɛ we mi. Ke nyɛ na nɔ ko nɛ hɛɛ e he gu ɔ, nyɛ ha lɛ bo; nyɛ ko pee kpɛle ngɛ nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ weku li a he.
8“Kɛkɛ ɔ, ye dloomi ɔ maa ba nyɛ nɔ kaa mɔtu pu la nɛ haa je mi tsɔɔ, nɛ nyɛ pa amɛ ma gbo mla. I kɛ nyɛ maa hi si be tsuaa be, konɛ ma he nyɛ yi wami. Ke nyɛ pee nɔ́ nɛ da a, lɔ ɔ maa je blɔ kpakpa ha nyɛ, nɛ ye hɛ mi nyami ɔ maa nyɛɛ nyɛ se, nɛ nyɛ maa ye manye. 9Ke nyɛ fa kue ha mi ɔ, ma he nɔ. Ke nyɛ tsɛ mi ɔ, nyɛ maa nu ye he.
“Ke nyɛ kpa yi wu tso ní peemi, ke nyɛ kpa nɔ nya pomi yaka gu, kɛ munyu yaya tumi; 10jehanɛ, ke hwɔ ngɛ nɔ ko yee, nɛ nyɛ ha lɛ ní, loo nɔ́ ko hia nɔ ko, nɛ nyɛ ha lɛ ɔ, lɛɛ diblii kpii nɛ bɔle nyɛ ɔ ma plɛ pee la nɛ ngɛ kpɛe hleii kaa piani. 11Imi Yawɛ nitsɛ, ma tsɔɔ nyɛ blɔ daa, nɛ ma ha nyɛ maa ye ní kpakpahi nɛ nyɛ maa tɔ daa. Ma ha nyɛ ma na nɔmlɔ tso he wami saminya. Nyɛ maa pee kaa abɔɔ kɛ e mi nyu babauu, loo kaa pa ko nɛ nyu tɛ mi gblegbleegble. 12Nyɛ maa fia gbogbo he ngɛ blema tsu kokoe ɔmɛ a nane mi. A maa fia kɛ ma sisi tomi momo ɔmɛ a nɔ. Sisi tomi ɔmɛ nɛ a to blema a, nyɛ ma tle mɛ si kɛ ma si ekohu. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a ma tsɛ nyɛ ke nihi nɛ ba fia gbogbo ɔmɛ ekohu, nihi nɛ ba dla ma doku ɔmɛ.”
Se nami nɛ ngɛ Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ yemi mi
13Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ ngɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Ke nyɛ maa ye Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ kaa ligbi klɔuklɔu, nɛ nyɛ be nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ suɔmi nya ní pee jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, ke nyɛ maa bu ye ligbi klɔuklɔu ɔ, nɛ nyɛ be blɔ hiae, nyɛ be ní tsue, nɛ nyɛ be yakayaka munyu tue ligbi nɛ ɔ, 14lɛɛ bua jɔmi nɛ a naa ngɛ imi Yawɛ ye sɔmɔmi mi ɔ, nyɛ ma na. Ma ha je ɔ tsuo maa wo nyɛ hɛ mi nyami, nɛ zugba a nɛ i ngɔ ha nyɛ nɛ̃, Yakob ɔ, ma ha nyɛ maa ye e mi ní kpakpa amɛ. Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de.”

Title: YESAYA 59
Content:
Gbalɔ ɔ pia ma a kaa a pee yayami
1Nyɛ ko susu kaa Yawɛ nine ngɛ kpoku nɛ e be nyɛe nɛ e kɛ he nyɛ yi wami, aloo e tue ywia nɛ e nui nyɛ kue fami ɔ! 2Mohu nyɛ ná nyɛɛ le kaa nyɛ he yayami ɔmɛ ji níhi nɛ gba nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ Mawu ɔ nyɛ kpɛti; nyɛ he yayami ɔmɛ tsi e hɛ mi; lɔ ɔ he nɛ ke nyɛ fa kue nɛ e nui ɔ nɛ. 3Nyɛ yeɔ fɔ, ejakaa nyɛ pueɔ muɔ si, nɛ nyɛ peeɔ yayamihi babauu. Yi wu tso níhi a he sɔuu nyɛ susuɔ, nɛ munyuhi nɛ jeɔ nyɛ nya a, lakpa sɔuu.
4Ke a kɛ nɔ ko ya kojomi he ɔ, nyɛ yi sane ɔ ha lɛ bɔ nɛ sa. Nyɛɛ kɛ mlaa tsu we ní, nɛ nyɛ yeɔ lakpa kɛ faa nyɛ he ngɛ sane yemi he. Ga yayahi nɛ kpataa nihi a hɛ mi sɔuu nyɛ toɔ. 5-6Nyɛ ga yaya amɛ ngɛ kaa sinɔ duɔtsɛ hlui. Ke hlui ɔ ywia a, sinɔ duɔtsɛ jeɔ kpo kɛ jeɔ mi! Se nyɛ ga yaya amɛ a he be se nami ko kulaa; a ngɛ kaa bo nɛ a ngɔ anani ya kɛ lo! 7 Be tsuaa be ɔ, yayami he ga sɔuu nyɛ toɔ. Nɔ nɛ ko ye bemi ɔ, nyɛ he sɔɔ kɛ pueɔ e muɔ si yaka. He tsuaa he nɛ nyɛ gu ɔ, nɔ́ puɛmi, kɛ nɔ́ hɛ mi kpatami sɔuu nyɛ siɔ ngɛ nyɛ se; 8nɔ ko nɔ ko yi e he ngɛ he nɛ nyɛ ngɛ. Nɔ́ nɛ dɛ pɛ nyɛ peeɔ. Nyɛ blɔ ɔmɛ gɔdɔ, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ nyɛɛɔ nyɛ se ɔ, e he mi jɔɛ lɛ gblegbleegble.
Ma a jaje a he yayami
9Bɔ nɛ ma a ngɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Jehanɛ lɛɛ wa na le nɔ́ he je nɛ Mawu je we wɔ kɛ ji nihi nɛ ngɛ wɔ yi mi wae ɔ a dɛ mi. Wa hyɛɛ blɔ kaa wa ma na la kɛ nyɛɛ, se wa ná we; diblii kpii mi mohu wa nyɛɛɔ; 10nɛ wa tataa si kɛ yaa gbogbo he kaa hɛ yuyuili. Wa tɛɔ si piani katakata kaa nɔ nɛ nyɔ mi. Wa peeɔ kaa ni gbogboehi ngɛ hɛ ngmengmletsɛmɛ a kpɛti. 11Wɔ tsuo wa yeɔ gbeye, nɛ wa ní peeɔ mɔbɔ. Wa hyɛɛ Mawu blɔ kaa e ma ba he wa yi wami kɛ je pimi kɛ amimi mi, se lɛ tsuo peeɔ yaka.
12“Yawɛ, wa tɔmi ɔmɛ hiɛ babauu ngɛ o hɛ mi. Wa he yayami ɔmɛ yeɔ odase kɛ siɔ wɔ. Wɔ nitsɛmɛ wa le wa nisɛ ní a ní ɔmɛ tsuo. 13Wa tɔ o nɔ; wa wa nihi yi mi, nɛ wa kua mo. Wa ja we mo hu. Ni yayahi a he wa susuɔ, nɛ lakpa pɛ wa yeɔ. 14Wa yi dami sane, nɛ nɔ́ nɛ da hu wa pee we. Wa yi anɔkuale ngɛ sane yemi he; nɛ wa susuu we nɔ́ nɛ da he kulaa. 15Nɔ ko nɔ ko yi anɔkuale hu; nɔ nɛ yuɔ e he kɛ jeɔ yayami he ɔ, a haoɔ lɛ kaa lɛ mohu ji yayami peelɔ.”
Yawɛ pee klaalo nɛ e ma kpɔ e ma a
Yawɛ na nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, nɛ e ngɔɛ e nya kaa a yi dami sane. 16 E pee lɛ nyakpɛ kaa nɔ ko nɔ ko be nɛ maa da mi ha ni nɛmɛ nɛ a ngɛ mɛ yi mi wae ɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, lɛ nitsɛ e he wami e kɛ ma he e ma a yi wami; nɛ e ma a maa ye kunimi. 17 E maa ye dami sane be tsuaa be; dami sane yemi maa pee kaa tsɛ̃i nɛ ha e he. Yi wami hemi hu maa pee e hiami nɔ́; e maa pee kaa dade pɛɛ nɛ e bu. E kɛ abofu, kɛ hɛdɔ maa gbla he nyɛli ɔmɛ a tue kɛ fa ni nɛmɛ nɛ a ngɛ mɛ amimi yee ɔ a he. 18E maa gbla a tue kaa bɔ nɛ a pee ɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ kɛ to nane mi; nɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ ma se tsitsaa po be a he yee. 19Kɛ je beleku je kɛ yaa su bonyoku je ɔ, nɔ tsuaa nɔ maa ye Yawɛ gbeye. E maa ba kaa pa nɛ hia; e maa ba kaa ahumi nɛ hia kɛ ma.
20 Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ ngɛ e ma a dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ, “Ma ba Yerusalem, nɛ nyɛ nihi tsuo nɛ nyɛ kpa yayami peemi ɔ, ma ba he nyɛ yi wami. 21I kɛ nyɛ maa so somi. I ngɔ ye he wami ɔ ngɔ ha nyɛ, nɛ ye mlaa amɛ hu maa pee nyɛ nɔ́ kɛ maa ya neneene. Kɛ je mwɔnɛ ɔ kɛ yaa a, nyɛ maa bu mi tue, nɛ nyɛ maa tsɔɔ nyɛ bimɛ, kɛ nyɛ nina tsuo, konɛ a bu mi tue kɛ ya neneene.”

Title: YESAYA 60
Content:
Yerusalem he ɔ
1Yerusalem, tee si nɛ o tso kaa pu;
Yawɛ hɛ mi nyami ɔ ngɛ kpɛe ngɛ o nɔ.
2Diblii maa ha zugba a tsuo nɔ,
je ma amɛ maa hi diblii kpii mi,
se moo lɛɛ Yawɛ ma je e he kpo ha mo;
e hɛ mi nyami ɔ ma pue o nɔ.
3Je mahi maa nyɛɛ kɛ ba o la a he,
nɛ matsɛmɛ maa ba la nɛ ngɛ kpɛe
ngɛ o nɔ ɔ he.
4Wo o yi nɔ nɛ o hyɛ o he kɛ kpe.
O nɛ, mɛ tsuo a ngɛ a he nya buae;
a ngɛ a he nya buae kɛ ma o ngɔ!
O binyumu ɔmɛ maa je ma se tsitsaa kɛ ba,
nɛ o biyi ɔmɛ lɛɛ a maa hɛɛ mɛ
kaa bimwɔwi kɛ ba.
5Ke e ba mi ja a, o bua maa jɔ;
o maa muɔ jɛɛ, nɛ o ma nya saminya;
ejakaa je ma amɛ maa ngɔ a juetli,
kɛ sika nɛ a na ngɛ wo se ɔ tsuo
kɛ ba o ngɔ.
6Afukpɔngɔhi babauu ma ba bua a he nya ngɛ o ngɔ;
a maa je Midian kɛ Efa.
Sheba bi ɔmɛ maa ngɔ sika tsu,
kɛ tsopa kɛ e he via kɛ ba,
nɛ mɛ tsuo a ma ba je Yawɛ yi
ngɛ ní kpakpahi nɛ e pee
ha mɛ ɔ he!
7A ma bua Kedar tohi tsuo a nya
kɛ ba ha mo, konɛ o kɛ sã bɔ.
A kɛ Nebayot agbosuhi ma ba sã bɔ
nɛ maa sa Yawɛ hɛ mi
ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, Yawɛ maa wo e we klɔuklɔu ɔ
hɛ mi nyami babauu pe daa a.
8Mɛnihi nɛ a ngɛ fo nɔ kɛ ma kaa bɔku,
loo kaa lahuɛhi nɛ kpale
kɛ ma a saflɛhi a mi nɛ ɔ?
9Spania lɛhi nɛ a nyɛɛ hɛ mi kɛ je tsitsaa
wo se zugbahi a nɔ kɛ ma a nɛ.
A ngɔ bimɛ kɛ ma we.
A hɛɛ sika tsu, kɛ sika hiɔ kɛ ma,
konɛ a kɛ ba ha Israel Mawu klɔuklɔu ɔ,
nɛ a kɛ wo Yawɛ hɛ mi nyami.
Ejakaa e wó e ma a nɔ gojoo
ngɛ je ma amɛ tsuo a hɛ mi.
10Yawɛ ngɛ Yerusalem dee ke,
“Nibwɔhi ma ba fia o ma a gbogbo ɔmɛ
kɛ ma si ekohu,
nɛ a matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ma sɔmɔ mo.
O wo ye mi mi la, nɛ lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i gbla o tue;
se jehanɛ lɛɛ, ma je ye suɔmi kpo ha mo,
nɛ ma na mo mɔbɔ.
11 O ma a agbo ɔmɛ maa hi blibli daa nyɔ kɛ pia,
konɛ je ma amɛ nɛ a ngɔ a ní tsuo kɛ ba be tsuaa be;
a maa nyɛɛ a matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a hɛ mi kɛ ba.
12Je ma, loo nɔ yemi nɛ be mo sɔmɔe ɔ,
a ma kpata e hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ.
13“A maa poo Lebanon tso kpakpa nɛ ɔmɛ
kɛ ba ma Yerusalem ekohu:
sɛsɛo, odum kɛ tsohi nɛ da tlɔmɔɔ ɔ tsuo.
Enɛ ɔ ma ha nɛ ye we klɔuklɔu ɔ maa pee fɛu,
nɛ ye ma a hɛ mi maa ba nyami.
14 Nihi nɛ wa mo yi mi ɔ a bimɛ ɔmɛ maa ba,
nɛ a ma ba kpla si ha mo.
Nihi nɛ gbe o he guɛ be ko ɔ,
mɛ hu a ma ba kpla si ngɛ o nane nya.
Nɛ a ma tsɛ mo ke, ‘Yawɛ ma,’
‘Zion, Israel Mawu klɔuklɔu ɔ ma.’
15“A be mo kuae, nɛ a be mo nyɛe hu
kaa sa be ko nɛ o pee ma doku
nɛ nɔ ko gui lejɛ ɔ.
Ma wo o nɔ gojoo, nɛ o he maa pee fɛu.
O maa pee he nɛ bua jɔmi maa hi daa.
16Je mahi, kɛ matsɛmɛ maa lɛ mo
kaa bɔ nɛ binyɛ haa e bi nyɔ ɔ.
O maa le jehanɛ kaa imi Yawɛ
nɛ i ha o yi na wami.
O maa le kaa imi, Israel Mawu kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ
nɛ i ha o ye o he.
17“Akɔblee nane mi ɔ, ma ngɔ sika tsu kɛ ba,
dade nane mi ɔ, sika hiɔ,
tso nane mi ɔ, akɔblee,
nɛ tɛ nane mi ɔ, dade.
O nɔ yeli ɔmɛ be mo yi mi wae hu.
Ma ha a maa ngɔ dami sane yemi,
kɛ he jɔmi kɛ hyɛ o nɔ.
18A be yi mi wami he nue
ngɛ zugba a nɔ hu;
a be ní puɛmi, kɛ hɛ mi kpatami
he nue ngɛ o huza amɛ a nɔ hu.
Ma bu o he, nɛ ma fa o he.
Ma pee kaa gbogbo ngɛ o se.
Nɛ o ma je ye yi,
ejakaa i he o yi wami.
19 “Tsa pi pu nɛ maa pee la ha mo piani hu,
jehanɛ hu tsa pi nyɔhiɔ nɛ ma ha mo la nyɔ mi.
Se mohu imi Yawɛ nitsɛ
ma pee o la kɛ maa ya neneene.
Ye hɛ mi nyami maa pee kaa la
nɛ ma kpɛ ha mo.
20O kɔmɔ yemi ligbi ɔmɛ a se maa po.
Imi Yawɛ nitsɛ ma pee la ha mo
kɛ maa ya neneene;
pu kɛ nyɔhiɔ lɛɛ a se maa po.
21O ma mi bi ɔmɛ tsuo maa pee nɔ́ nɛ da.
A maa hi zugba a nɔ kɛ maa ya neneene.
Imi lɛ i to mɛ si.
Imi lɛ i pee mɛ jã,
konɛ a kɛ wo ye hɛ mi nyami.
22Wɛtso nyafii pe kulaa ma ba pee
ma kpetekpleenyɛ.
Ke be ɔ su ɔ, imi nitsɛ ma ha
nɔ́ nɛ ɔ maa ba mi oya.
Imi ji Yawɛ!”

Title: YESAYA 61
Content:
Sɛ gbi kɛ ha nɔ́ nali
1 Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ mumi ɔ ngɛ ye nɔ;
Yawɛ pɔ mi nu, nɛ e tsɔ mi,
konɛ ma ngɔ manye munyu
ya ha nihi nɛ a ní ngɛ mɔbɔ ɔ;
nɛ ma wo kɔmɔ yeli a bua;
nɛ ma ya de
nihi nɛ a nuu mɛ nyɔguɛ ɔ
ke a he yemi be su ta,
kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ a wo mɛ tsu ɔ
ke a jémi be su ta.
2 Yawɛ ke ma ya fiɛ ke
be ko nɛ sa Yawɛ hɛ mi ma.
Be nɛ Mawu maa gbla nihi a tue,
kɛ kɔmɔ yeli a bua womi be ɔ
su ta.
3Kɛkɛ ɔ, nihi nɛ ngɛ kɔmɔ yee ngɛ Zion ɔ,
e ma bu mɛ jlasi nɛ a kɛ mɔmɔ pee, se pi la zu;
a bua maa jɔ;
a ma kpa kɔmɔ yemi,
nɛ a ma la yi jemi la.
A maa bɔ kaa tso nguaa nɛ Yawɛ nitsɛ ma.
Mɛ tsuo a maa pee nɔ́ nɛ da,
nɛ a maa wo Yawɛ hɛ mi nyami.
4Ma dokuhi tsuo nɛ pueɔ si kɛ je blema lokoo ɔ,
a maa fia mɛ kɛ ma si ekohu.
5Nibwɔhi ma ba sɔmɔ nyɛ;
a ma tsɔ̃ nyɛ to ɔmɛ;
a ma hu nyɛ ngmɔ ɔmɛ,
nɛ a maa hyɛ nyɛ wai ngmɔ ɔmɛ a nɔ.
6Se nyɛ ye ma a, a ma tsɛ nyɛ ke
Yawɛ osɔfohi,
a ma tsɛ nyɛ Mawu sɔmɔli hulɔ.
Je ma amɛ a ní ɔ, nyɛ nyɛ maa ye,
nɛ nyɛ bua maa jɔ
kaa lɛ tsuo ba pee nyɛ nɔ́.
7Zo nɛ gbe nyɛ, kɛ nyɛ hɛ mi nɛ pue si ɔ,
lɛ tsuo nya maa be.
Nyɛ maa hi nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ zugba nɔ jehanɛ;
nyɛ ma na ní babauu nitsɛ pe sa a,
nɛ nyɛ bua maa jɔ kɛ maa ya neneene.
8Yawɛ de Yerusalem bi ɔmɛ ke,
“I suɔ kaa a ye dami sane;
i sume ojo fiami, kɛ yi mi wami;
ma pee ye ma a kpakpa
bɔ nɛ sa mɛ,
nɛ i kɛ mɛ maa so somi ko
nɛ maa hi si kɛ maa ya neneene.
9A nina ma na biɛ saminya
ngɛ je ma amɛ a kpɛti.
Nihi tsuo nɛ maa na mɛ ɔ
ma de ke ma nɛ imi Yawɛ
nitsɛ i gbaa ji mɛ.”
10 Yerusalem ngɛ nyae ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ
Yawɛ Mawu pee ha lɛ ɔ he.
Yerusalem pee kaa ayɛflo nɛ wo june,
loo ayɛflo huno nɛ ngɔ mɔmɔ kɛ dla e he
kɛ yaa yo kpeemi.
Niinɛ, Mawu he Yerusalem yi wami,
nɛ e ye kunimi ha lɛ.
11Bɔ nɛ tso tsɛ̃ɔ kɛ jee zu mi,
ee, bɔ nɛ wu puɛɔ ngɛ ngmɔ mi ɔ,
ja Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ma he e ma a yi wami,
nɛ je ma amɛ tsuo maa na,
nɛ a ma je e yi.

Title: YESAYA 62
Content:
1I be ye nya mae oo! I be ye nya mae!
Yerusalem he je ɔ, i be ye nya mae
kɛ yaa si a ma he ye ma a yi wami.
Nɛ e kunimi yemi ɔ maa je kpo paa
nɛ a maa na
kaa jatɛ ngɛ diblii mi.
2Yerusalem, je ma amɛ maa na kaa o ye kunimi,
nɛ matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsuo maa na o hɛ mi nyami ɔ.
A maa wo mo biɛ he.
Biɛ nɛ Yawɛ nitsɛ maa wo mo ɔ,
lɔ ɔ a kɛ ma tsɛ mo.
3O maa pee kaa jlasi saminyayoo
ngɛ Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ dɛ mi.
4A be mo tsɛe hu ke, “Nɔ nɛ a kua lɛ,”
nɛ a be o zugba hu tsɛe ke,
“Yo nɛ a fie lɛ kɛ je gba we.”
Se a ma tsɛ mo ke, “Mawu ná e he bua jɔmi,”
nɛ o zugba a, a ma tsɛ lɛ “Ayɛflo,”
ejakaa Yawɛ bua jɔ o he,
nɛ e maa ngɔ o zugba a kɛ pee kaa e we ayɛflo.
5Kaa bɔ nɛ niheyo kpeɔ yomiyo ayɛflo ɔ,
ja nɔ nɛ bɔ mo ɔ maa ngɔ mo hulɔ.
Bɔ nɛ ayɛflo huno nyaa ayɛflo he ɔ,
ja o Mawu ɔ bua maa jɔ o he.
6Yerusalem, i ngɔ buli ngɔ to o gbogbo ɔmɛ a nɔ.
Nyɔ kɛ pia tsuo, a ko pee dii;
se mohu a hi Yawɛ kaie
ngɛ si ko nɛ e wo e ma a he,
konɛ e hɛ ko je nɔ.
7A hi lɛ kaie
kɛ yaa si e maa to Yerusalem si
saminya ekohu.
Nɛ ma a maa pee ma
nɛ je ɔ tsuo ma je e yi.
8Yawɛ ka e he kita,
nɛ bɔ nɛ e ngɛ nɔ mi mae ngɛ dee ji,
“Ye ma, i be o blɛfo ngɔe kɛ ha
o he nyɛli nɛ a ye hu,
nɛ o wai nɛ o gbo he dengme ɔ,
nibwɔhi ba be nue hu.
9Se mohu, o nihi nɛ du blɛfo nɛ a kpɔ ɔ,
mɛ lɛ a maa ye,
nɛ a ma je imi Yawɛ ye yi.
Ni nɛmɛ nɛ bua wai yiblii nya a,
mɛ lɛ a maa nu dã a
ngɛ kue ɔmɛ a mi,
ngɛ ye we klɔuklɔu ɔ.”
10Yerusalem bi, nyɛɛ je kpo;
nyɛɛ gu agbo ɔmɛ a mi kɛ je kpo!
Nyɛɛ je gbɛjegbɛ kɛ ha ma a;
nyɛ kukuɔ a nɔ tɛhi tsuo.
Nyɛɛ si aflangaa nɛ je ma amɛ nɛ a na.
11 Yawɛ ngɛ fiɛe kɛ yaa su
je mi nyagbe he ɔ tɔɔ;
e ke a de Zion biyo ɔ ke,
“Be ɔ su jehanɛ, Yawɛ ma
nɛ e ba he o yi wami.
E ngɔ nihi nɛ e kpɔ ɔ kɛ ma.”
12A ma tsɛ nyɛ ke, “Ma klɔuklɔu”,
“Ma nɛ Yawɛ kpɔ mɛ.”
A ma tsɛ Yerusalem ke,
“Ma nɛ a ya hla nɛ a na”,
“Ma nɛ Mawu kua we lɛ.”

Title: YESAYA 63
Content:
Yawɛ ye je ma amɛ a nɔ kunimi
1 “Mɛnɔ lɛ je Bozra ngɛ Edom zugba a nɔ kɛ ma nɛ ɔ? Mɛnɔ lɛ dla e he saminyayoo kɛ tade tsu, nɛ e ngɛ kɔsɔe wawɛɛ kɛ he wami kɛ ma nɛ ɔ?”
“Imi Yawɛ, kpɔlɔ nɛ nine si wa a, i ngɛ dee kɛ ngmlaa ke i ye kunimi oo, i ye kunimi.”
2“Mɛni he je nɛ e tade tsu kikɛ nɛ ɔ kaa nɔ ko nɛ ngɛ wai yiblii ngae kɛ pee dã e tade ɔ?”
3 Yawɛ he nɔ ke, “Imi nɔ kake lɛ i naa je ma amɛ a nɔ kaa a naa wai yiblii nɔ; nɔ ko nɔ ko piɛ we ye he. A wo ye mi mi la, nɛ abofu nya a, i naa a nɔ, nɛ a muɔ ɔ fĩa wo ye tade ɔ mi tsuo. 4I pee ye yi mi momo kaa ma gbla he nyɛli ɔmɛ a tue; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ma he ye ma a yi wami; ejakaa be ɔ su jehanɛ. 5 Benɛ i hyɛ ɔ, e pee mi nyakpɛ kaa nɔ ko nɔ ko bɛ nɛ e ba je ngmlaa ha mi. Se ye mi mi nɛ fu ɔ wo mi he wami, nɛ imi nɔ kake too i ye kunimi. 6I kɛ mi mi la naa je ma amɛ a nɔ basabasa, nɛ i gbɛ mɛ ngɔ fĩa. I tsɛ̃ a muɔ ngɔ pue zugba.”
Yawɛ pee Israel kpakpa
7Ma gba Yawɛ suɔmi
nɛ ngɛ daa a he sane.
Ní kpakpahi tsuo nɛ e ha wɔ ɔ he ɔ,
ma je e yi.
E gbaa Israel ma a babauu;
ejakaa Yawɛ mɔbɔ nami,
kɛ e suɔmi be nyagbe.
8Yawɛ ke, “Imi nitsɛ ye ma ji mɛ; a be mi sisie.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e ha a yi na wami 9kɛ je a haomi tsuo kulaa mi. Pi bɔfo ko nɛ e tsɔ, se lɛ nitsɛ lɛ e he a yi wami. E suɔmi, kɛ e mɔbɔ nami he je ɔ, e kpɔ mɛ, nɛ e hɛɛ mɛ saminya ngɛ blema be ɔmɛ tsuo a mi. 10Se mɛɛ lɛɛ a tsɔ atuã; a ha nɛ aywilɛho nu mɛ. Yawɛ ba plɛ pee a he nyɛlɔ, nɛ e kɛ mɛ hwu.
11Kɛkɛ nɛ ma a kai blema, Yawɛ tsɔlɔ Mose be ɔ, nɛ a bi ke, “Yawɛ nɛ́ je ma a, kɛ a hɛ mi nyɛɛli ɔmɛ kɛ je wo ɔ mi ɔ, jije e ngɛ? Jije nɔ nɛ ngɔ e mumi klɔuklɔu ɔ kɛ wo a mi ɔ ngɛ? 12-13 Nɔ nɛ ngɔ he wami kpetekpleenyɛ kɛ wo Mose mi kɛ tsu ní nguanguahi, nɔ nɛ gba wo ɔ mi ha mɛ, nɛ a nyɛɛ muɔ voovoo ɔmɛ a mi kɛ po wo ɔ nɛ e kɛ na biɛ nɛ maa hi si kɛ maa ya neneene ɔ, jije e ngɛ?”
Yawɛ nitsɛ lɛ kpaka mɛ kɛ gu muɔ voovoo ɔmɛ a mi slɔkee kaa bɔ nɛ ke okpɔngɔ ngɛ fo tue ngɛ nga kplanaa nɔ nɛ́ e tɛ we si ɔ. 14Yawɛ ha e ma a he jɔmi. Bɔ nɛ ke a kpaka na kɛ ya kɔ̃ mi nɛ e naa niye ní kpakpa nɛ e yeɔ ɔ, jã Yawɛ kpaka e ma a saminya, nɛ e kɛ na biɛ kpakpa kɛ hɛ mi nyami.
Ma a fa kue ha Mawu
15Yawɛ, moo hyɛ wɔ kɛ je hiɔwe ngɛ o hi he klɔuklɔu he nɛ hɛ mi nyami bɔle mo ngɛ ɔ. O hɛdɔ, kɛ o he wami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ, jije e ngɛ? O tsui mi sami, kɛ suɔmi babauu ɔ hu a se po. 16Mo ji wa tsɛ. Wa nɛmɛ Abraham, kɛ Yakob li wɔ, se mo Yawɛ, wa tsɛ, mo ji wa kpɔlɔ kɛ je blema lokoo. 17Yawɛ, mɛni he je o haa nɛ wa tlaa blɔ kɛ jeɔ o blɔ ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ wa kpliiɔ wa tsui, konɛ wa ko ye mo gbeye ɔ? Israel ma a, o nɔ, nɛ o tsɔli ji wɔ tsuo. Mo nitsɛ o nihi ji wɔ; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, kpale kɛ ba!
18Wɔ o ma klɔuklɔu ɔ, wa hi o he klɔuklɔu ɔ be bɔɔ, kɛkɛ nɛ wa he nyɛli ba ywia o ma a! 19Wa pee kaa nihi nɛ o hyɛ we a nɔ hyɛ, loo ni komɛ nɛ a kɛ o biɛ tsɛ we mɛ hyɛ!

Title: YESAYA 64
Content:
1I ná nɛ hiɔwe mi gba enyɔ nɛ o kple si kɛ ba! 2I ná nɛ yo ɔmɛ mimiɛ ngɛ o hɛ mi kaa bɔ nɛ lɛ́ tsɔwi la tsoo nɛ e haa nyu fiaa gudaguda ngɛ la nɔ ɔ. Ke e ba mi ja a, o he nyɛli ɔmɛ maa nu o he, nɛ je ma amɛ a he maa do blibliibli ngɛ o hɛ mi! 3Blema, benɛ o pee nyakpɛ níhi nɛ wa hyɛ we blɔ ɔ, o kple si kɛ ba; yo ɔmɛ mimiɛ ngɛ o hɛ mi! 4 Kɛ je blema lokoo ɔ, nɔ ko nui hyɛ, nɛ nɔ ko hu nɛ kaa o se ɔ, mawu kpa ko ngɛ nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ haa nihi nɛ ngɔɔ a hɛ ngɔ fɔɔ e nɔ ɔ! 5Nihi nɛ kɛ bua jɔmi peeɔ o suɔmi nya ní, nɛ blɔ nɛ o to ha mɛ ɔ, a ji nɔ ɔ, mo hu o naa a he bua jɔmi. Wa pee yayami, nɛ o mi mi fu wɔ. Kɛ je blema lokoo ɔ, yayami sɔuu wa ngɛ pee. Anɛ hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi ko pa ngɛ ha wɔ kaa a ma he wa yi wami lo? 6Wɔ tsuo wa pee yayami, nɛ wa plɛ pee nihi nɛ a he tsɔ we. Kpakpa nɛ wa peeɔ ɔ po ngɛ kaa tade sɛmusɛmu ngɛ o hɛ mi. Wa yayami ɔmɛ ha wɔ tsuo wa pee kaa ba gbigbli nɛ kɔɔhiɔ muɔ kɛ yaa. 7Nɔ ko nɔ ko be nɛ faa kue ha mo; nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko ba bi we yemi kɛ buami kɛ ji o ngɔ. O ngɔ o hɛ mi kɛ laa wɔ. Wa yayami ɔmɛ ha nɛ o kua wɔ.
8Se kɛ ɔ, Yawɛ, mo ji wa tsɛ. Wa ngɛ kaa zu, nɛ moo lɛɛ o ngɛ kaa buɛ puɛlɔ; mo lɛ o bɔ wɔ. 9Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yawɛ, wa kpa mo pɛɛ nɛ o mi mi ko fu wɔ tsɔ; ko kai wa yayami ɔmɛ kɛ ya neneene! O ma ji wɔ; naa wɔ mɔbɔ. 10O ma klɔuklɔu ɔ plɛ pee nga kplanaa. Zion plɛ pee nga nɔ, nɛ Yerusalem pee ma doku. 11Wa sɔlemi we klɔuklɔu saminyayoo, he nɛ wa nɛmɛ ɔmɛ je o yi ngɛ ɔ, a kɛ la sã, nɛ a kpata hehi nɛ ngɛ fɛu ɔ tsuo a hɛ mi. 12Yawɛ, níhi nɛ ngɛ wa nɔ bae nɛ ɔ, o be he nɔ́ ko pee ha wɔ lo? Anɛ o maa pee dii nɛ o ha waa na nɔ́ pe bɔ nɛ wa ma nyɛ nya maa da lo?

Title: YESAYA 65
Content:
Yawɛ maa gbla atuã tsɔli a tue
1 Yawɛ ke, “I pee klaalo konɛ nihi nɛ li mi ɔ nɛ a hla ye se blɔ; i pee klaalo konɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ li mi ɔ nɛ a le mi jehanɛ. Daa nɛ ɔ, i pee klaalo nɛ i ngɛ ma a dee ke, ‘I ngɛ hiɛ ɔ oo; nyɛ tsɛ mi nɛ ma piɛ nyɛ he.’ 2 Se ma a tsɛ we mi. Daa nɛ ɔ, i pee klaalo nɛ ma he ye ma a atuu; ma nɛ kplii a tsui, nɛ a peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ dɛ, kɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a suɔmi nya ní ji mɛ. 3Be tsuaa be ɔ, ma nɛ ɔ jeɔ blɔ paa nɛ a woɔ ye mi mi la; a sãã bɔhi ngɛ abɔɔhi a mi; a sãã tsopa kɛ e he via ngɛ tɛhi a nɔ; 4nyɔ mi tsuo a hii yɔkɔhi a mi, kɛ hehi nɛ e sɛ́ nɛ a na mɛ ngɛ; kpotoo lo pohu a yeɔ, kɛ flɔɔ nɛ a ngɔ níhi nɛ a hiee kɛ pee ngɛ a tsesihi a mi. 5Se bɔ nɛ mɛ mohu a deɔ ni kpahi ji, ‘Nyɛɛ hɛ nyɛ kɛ ya se; nyɛ ko ba wa kasa nya; wɔɔ lɛɛ wa he tsɔ!’ Kikɛmɛ a nimli nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ kaa la su ku nɛ ngɛ ye gugwɔ mi sɛe, kɛ la nɛ ngɛ tsoe daa ligbi!
6“I pee ye yi mi momo, nɛ i ngma ngɔ fɔ si ke i be ye nya mae hu; ma gbla a tue wawɛɛ kɛ to nane mi sisiisi 7ngɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ, kɛ a nɛmɛ ɔmɛ a he yayami ɔmɛ tsuo a he. Ejakaa a ya sãã tsopa kɛ e he via ngɛ yo ɔmɛ a nɔ. A tuɔ munyu hu kɛ siɔ mi ngɛ yoku ɔmɛ a nɔ. Enɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a he ɔ, ma gbla a tue sisiisi bɔ nɛ sa.”
8Yawɛ ke, “Nɔ ko kpataa we e wai yiblii kpakpa hɛ mi; dã mohu e kɛ peeɔ. Jã kɛ̃ i be ye ma a hɛ mi kpatae pɛsɛpɛsɛ. Ni nɛmɛ nɛ sɔmɔɔ mi ɔ, ma he a yi wami. 9Ma ha Yakob nina babauu. Ma ha Yuda bi ɔmɛ ma ba hi yo ɔmɛ a nɔ; lejɛ ɔ tsuo maa pee ye sɔmɔli nɛ i hla nɛ ɔ a nɔ́. 10 Ye ma a mi bi nɛ hlaa ye se blɔ ɔ, Sharon nga a nɔ maa pee a to lɛmi he, nɛ Haomi kɔ̃ ɔ mi ji he nɛ a nahi maa jɔɔ a he ngɛ.
11“Se nyɛ nihi nɛ kuaa imi Yawɛ, nɛ nyɛ hɛ jeɔ ye yo klɔuklɔu ɔ nɔ ɔ, nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ nɔ́ maa slo. Nyɛ nihi nɛ nyɛ ngmɛɔ okplɔɔ kɛ haa mawu nɛ haa nɔ siade, kɛ nyɛ nihi nɛ nyɛ ngɔɔ wai nɛ a futu kɛ sãã bɔ ha mawu nɛ tsɔɔ nyɛ nɔ́ nɛ maa ba nyɛ nɔ ngɛ je mi, 12nyɛɛ lɛɛ nɔ́ nɛ fɔɔ si ha nyɛ ji klaate. Nyɛ tsuo nyɛ maa nɔ basabasa ngɛ klaate nya; ejakaa benɛ i tsɛ nyɛ ɔ, nyɛ he we nɔ, nɛ benɛ i tu munyu kɛ tsɔɔ nyɛ ɔ, nyɛ bui tue. Yayami mohu nyɛ pee ngɛ ye hɛ mi; níhi nɛ i sume ɔ, lɔ ɔmɛ mohu a se nyɛ ya nyɛɛ. 13Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, i ngɛ dee ke, ni nɛmɛ nɛ buɔ mi tue, nɛ a jaa mi ɔ, a ma ná ní babauu maa ye, se nyɛɛ lɛɛ hwɔ maa gbe nyɛ; ye sɔmɔli ɔmɛ ma na nyu maa nu, se nyɛɛ lɛɛ kuma maa gbe nyɛ; ye sɔmɔli ɔmɛ ma nya, se nyɛɛ lɛɛ zo maa gbe nyɛ. 14Ye sɔmɔli ɔmɛ ma la, nɛ a bua maa jɔ a he, se nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ ma kpa huhui, nɛ nyɛ maa ye nyɛ tsui wawɛɛ; nyɛ maa ye kɔmɔ, nɛ nyɛ ma fo ya mɔbɔmɔbɔ. 15Nyɛ biɛ maa pee nɔ nɛ a kɛ gbiɛɔ ha ye ma nɛ i hla a; ejakaa imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ nitsɛ, ma kpata nyɛ hɛ mi; se ni nɛmɛ nɛ jaa mi ɔ lɛɛ ma wo mɛ biɛ he. 16Kɛkɛ ɔ, nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ma hla kaa a gbaa lɛ ɔ ma bi Mawu anɔkualetsɛ ɔ; nɛ nɔ nɛ ma ka kita ngɛ zugba a nɔ ɔ hu maa ngɔ Mawu anɔkualetsɛ ɔ biɛ kɛ ka; ejakaa blema haomi ɔmɛ maa be kɛ ho, nɛ a be kaie hu.”
Je he ɔ
17 Yawɛ ke, “I ngɛ hiɔwe he, kɛ zugba he bɔe; nɛ a be blema ní ɔmɛ kaie hu; hɛ maa je a nɔ pɛsɛpɛsɛ. 18Nyɛ nya, nɛ nyɛ bua nɛ jɔ kɛ ya neneene ngɛ níhi nɛ i ngɛ bɔe ɔ a he. Ejakaa i ngɛ Yerusalem he bɔe kaa he ko nɛ bua jɔmi sɔuu lɛ a naa ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, nɛ́ ma a mi bi ɔmɛ hu a bua jɔɔ saminya. 19 Imi nitsɛ ye bua maa jɔ Yerusalem, kɛ ma mi bi ɔmɛ tsuo a he. A be ya fomi, loo kɔmɔ yemi he nue ngɛ ma a mi hu. 20Ma he nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, bimwɔyo be gboe hu; nɔmoyo hu be gboe loko e be maa su. Ke a fɔ nɔ ko ɔ, ja e ye jeha lafa loko e ma gbo. Yayami peelɔ pɛ nɛ lɛɛ e be nae ja. 21A maa po wehi, nɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a maa hi mi; a maa pee wai ngmɔhi, nɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a maa ye a mi yiblii. 22A be wehi poe nɛ ni kpahi ba hi mi, nɛ a be ngmɔ pee nɛ ni kpahi ba ye e mi ní. Bɔ nɛ tso nguahi a se kɛɔ ɔ, ja ye ma mi bi ɔmɛ a se maa kɛ ngɛ je mi. A ma ná mɛ nitsɛmɛ a nine nya ní tsumi mi ní maa ye, nɛ a bua maa jɔ a he saminya. 23A be yaka dengme gboe; a bimɛ be kpatu gbenɔ gboe; ejakaa nihi nɛ imi Yawɛ i gbaa mɛ a nina ji mɛ; a ngmɛdu maa hi si daa. 24Loko a ma tsɛ mi ɔ, i he nɔ momo; benɛ a ngɛ kue fae ha mi nɛ a gbi nya lolo ɔ, i nu momo. 25 Ogbetee kɛ jijɔ ma bla kɛ ye ní; jata ma kpe nga kaa na; nɛ sinɔ lɛɛ zu e maa ye. Nɔ ko be e nyɛmi awi yee, nɛ nɔ ko be e nyɛmi hɛ mi kpatae ngɛ ye yo klɔuklɔu ɔ nɔ. Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de.”

Title: YESAYA 66
Content:
Yawɛ ngɛ je ma amɛ kojoe
1 Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ ngɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Hiɔwe ji ye matsɛ sɛ, nɛ zugba ji nɔ́ nɛ i kɛ ye nane maa nɔ. Mɛni tsu nyɛ maa ma ha mi mɔ, nɛ jije ye he jɔɔmi he ngɛ? 2Ye nine nya níhi ji ni nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ye níhi ji mɛ tsuo. Nihi nɛ baa a he si, nɛ a naa a he yayami nɛ a tsakeɔ a tsui, nihi nɛ yeɔ mi gbeye, nɛ a buɔ mi tue ɔ, mɛ ji nihi nɛ i suɔ.
3“Ma mi bi ɔmɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a suɔ. E si we mɛ kpu kaa a maa ngɔ na, loo nɔmlɔ adesa kɛ sã bɔ. Slɔɔto ko be mi ke a ngɔ to kɛ sã bɔ, loo a ku gbe kuɛ kɛ pee. Slɔɔto be mi ke a ngɔ ngma kɛ ba sã niye ní bɔ, aloo a ngɔ kpotoo muɔ kɛ ba. Tsopa kɛ e he via a ngɛ sãe jio, amaga nɛ a ngɛ jae jio, slɔɔto ko kulaa be mi ha mɛ. Musu ní nɛ ɔmɛ a he a nyaa. 4Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, imi hu ma ha amanehlu nɛ a ngɛ gbeye yee ɔ maa ba a nɔ. Ejakaa i tsɛ mɛ, se nɔ ko nɔ ko he we nɔ; i tu munyu, se a bui tue fɛɛ. Yayami mohu a pee ngɛ ye hɛ mi; nɛ níhi nɛ sɛ ye hɛ mi ɔ, lɔ ɔmɛ mohu a he a nya.”
5Nyɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ nyɛ yeɔ Yawɛ gbeye, nɛ nyɛ buɔ lɛ, nyɛ ta tue, “Akɛnɛ nyɛ yeɔ mi anɔkuale ɔ, nyɛ ma mi bi ɔmɛ ekomɛ nyɛɔ nyɛ, nɛ a kɛ nyɛ pee we nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko, se nyɛ he fɛu mohu a yeɔ. A deɔ ke, ‘Yawɛ nɛ je e he wami kpo nɛ e he nyɛ yi wami, konɛ waa na bɔ nɛ nyɛ ma nya ha.’ Se mɛ nitsɛmɛ a hɛ mi si mohu a ma pue! 6Nyɛɛ bu tue! Bubuubui ngɛ pɛe ngɛ ma a mi! Bubuubui ngɛ pɛe ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ. Ngmlaa nɛ ngɛ pɛe ɔ tsɔɔ kaa Yawɛ ngɛ e he nyɛli ɔmɛ a tue gblae.
7 “Ye ma klɔuklɔu ɔ ngɛ kaa yo ko nɛ kpatu fɔ binyumu be mi nɛ e nui kɔɔmi. 8Mɛnɔ nu enɛ ɔ eko hyɛ, nɛ mɛnɔ na enɛ ɔ eko hyɛ? Anɛ ligbi kake too kɛkɛ nɛ zugba nɔ hyiɔ kɛ nimli babauu? Anɛ si kake too kɛkɛ nɛ a fɔɔ je ma lo? Se Zion lɛɛ e nɛ nɔ́; benɛ kɔɔmi miɔ nɛ ta e he kɛkɛ e fɔ e binyumu ɔmɛ momo. 9Ke fɔmi su gbongu mi ɔ, anɛ ma ko ha a fɔ bi ɔ lo? Imi nɛ i haa a fɔɔ bi ɔ, anɛ ma nga muklii ɔ nya lo?” Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ lɛ de.
10Nyɛ nihi tsuo nɛ nyɛ suɔ Yerusalem ɔ,
nyɛ bua nɛ jɔ nyɛ he
nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ lɛ nɛ nya.
Nyɛ nihi tsuo nɛ nyɛ ye kɔmɔ ha lɛ ɔ,
jehanɛ lɛɛ nyɛɛ kɛ lɛ tsuo
nyɛ na bua jɔmi!
11E ní nɛ e na a, nyɛ maa ye eko,
nɛ nyɛ bua maa jɔ
kaa bimwɔyo ngɛ e nyɛ nyɔ nya!
12Yawɛ ke, “Ma ha nyɛ ma ná ní kpɔtɔɔ. Je ma amɛ a juetli ma ba hyi nyɛ ma a mi tɔ kaa pa nɛ hyi ywia nga. Nyɛ maa pee kaa bimwɔyo nɛ e nyɛ hɛɛ lɛ dɔdɔɔdɔ ngɛ e tɛ nɔ; bɔɔ kɛkɛ e kɛ lɛ to e kasa nya ngɛ lɛ nyɔ hae, kɛkɛ ɔ, e ngɔ lɛ ngɔ fɔ e tɛ nɔ ekohu. 13Bɔ nɛ binyɛ haa e bi naa bua jɔmi ɔ, jã ma ha nyɛ bua maa jɔ nyɛ he ngɛ Yerusalem. 14Ke enɛ ɔ ba mi ɔ, nyɛ ma na bua jɔmi. Nyɛ ma na he wami he. Lɔ ɔ loko nyɛ maa le kaa imi Yawɛ ɔ, nihi nɛ buɔ mi tue ɔ, i piɛɔ a he, nɛ i kɛ abofu gblaa ye he nyɛli a tue.”
15Yawɛ maa nyɛɛ la mi kɛ ba. E maa hi ta zugba lɛ nɛ ngɛ kaa lasiogblee mi kɛ ba, nɛ e ma ba kpata e he nyɛli ɔmɛ a hɛ mi. 16Nihi tsuo nɛ yeɔ fɔ ngɛ je ɔ mi ɔ, Yawɛ maa ngɔ la kɛ klaate kɛ kpata a hɛ mi. Nɛ nihi babauu ma gbo.
17Yawɛ ke, “Nihi nɛ tsukɔɔ a he, nɛ a peeɔ a he klɔuklɔu kɛ haa wɔ jami, nɛ a toɔ slɛnɛɛ kɛ yaa abɔɔhi a mi ya yeɔ kpotoo lo, kɔkue, kɛ níhi nɛ a hiee ɔ, a nyagbe maa pee gbeye. 18I le níhi nɛ a ngɛ susue, kɛ níhi nɛ a ngɛ pee. Be ma nɛ ma bua je ma amɛ tsuo, kɛ gbi slɔɔtoslɔɔto ɔmɛ tsuo a nya. Ke a ba a, a ma ba na ye hɛ mi nyami ɔ. 19Jamɛ a be ɔ loko a maa le kaa imi lɛ i ngɛ a tue gblae.
“Se ma he a ti ni komɛ a yi wami, nɛ ma tsɔ mɛ kɛ maa ya je ma amɛ a ngɔ, kɛ zugbahi a nɔ ngɛ tsitsaa lokoo, he nɛ a nui ye we agbo jemi, kɛ ye he wami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ he ngɛ lolo. Ma tsɔ mɛ Spania, Libia, Lidia he nɛ kɛ̃ɛ̃ tsɛ̃li kpakpahi ngɛ ɔ, Tubal, kɛ Hela. A ma ya fiɛ ngɛ je ma nɛ ɔmɛ a mi ke Mawu kpetekpleenyɛ ji mi. 20Jamɛ a be ɔ, a kɛ a nyɛmimɛ Israel fɔfɔɛhi tsuo nɛ ngɛ je ma amɛ a mi ɔ maa ba; a maa ngɔ mɛ ba ke imi Yawɛ kaa bɔ. A maa ngɔ mɛ kɛ ba ye yo klɔuklɔu ɔ nɔ ngɛ Yerusalem. A maa hi okpɔngɔhi, teji okpɔngɔhi, kɛ afukpɔngɔhi a nɔ kɛ ba. A maa hi ta zugba lɛhi, kɛ apakɛɛhi hu a mi. A maa hɛɛ a nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ kɛ maa ba kaa bɔ nɛ Israel bi hɛɛɔ a ngma bɔ ngɛ níhi nɛ a he tsɔ mi kɛ baa Yawɛ we ɔ. 21Ma pee a ti ni komɛ osɔfohi, nɛ ma pee a ti ni komɛ hu Levi bi.
22 “Bɔ nɛ zugba he, kɛ hiɔwe he nɛ ma pee ɔ maa hi si daa ngɛ ye he wami nya a, ja nyɛ nina, kɛ nyɛ biɛ tsuo maa hi si. 23Nyɔhiɔhe nyami be tsuaa Nyɔhiɔhe nyami be, kɛ Hejɔɔmi ligbi tsuaa Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ, nimli adesahi nɛ ngɛ je ma amɛ tsuo a mi ɔ ma ba ja mi ngɛ Yerusalem.” Yawɛ lɛ de. 24 “Ke a je hiɛ ɔ, a ma ya na nihi nɛ kua mi ɔ a gbogboehi nɛ pueɔ si. Gɔgɔ nɛ gbogboe ɔmɛ wo ɔ be gboe gblegbleegble, nɛ la nɛ ngɛ mɛ sããe ɔ hu a be nyɛe maa gbe; a maa pee he mi nyɛɛmi nɔ́ ha nimli adesahi tsuo.”

Title: YEREMIA NYA TSƆƆMI
Content:
NYA TSƆƆMI
Gbalɔ Yeremia hi si maa pee jeha lafa ekpa, loo nɔ́ loko a fɔ Kristo. E fiɛ Mawu munyu ɔ be babauu nitsɛ. E bɔ Mawu ma a kɔkɔ, nɛ e de mɛ ke yayamihi nɛ a ngɛ pee, kɛ amagahi nɛ a ngɛ jae he je ɔ, Mawu kɛ haomi maa ba ma a nɔ. Niinɛ, ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ba mi, nɛ Yeremia na kɛ lɛ nitsɛ e hɛngmɛ. Babilonia matsɛ, Nebukadnezar ba tua Yerusalem; a sã ma a kɛ Yawɛ we ɔ, nɛ a nuu Yuda matsɛ ɔ, kɛ ma mi bi ɔmɛ babauu kɛ ho Babilonia zugba a nɔ ya. Yeremia gba hu ke Yuda bi ɔmɛ nɛ a maa nuu kɛ ya Babilonia a maa kpale kɛ ba mɛ nitsɛmɛ a zugba a nɔ hwɔɔ se ko, nɛ a ma ba bɔ ma a ekohu.
A ma nyɛ maa dla Yeremia womi nɛ ɔ mi enuɔ. (1) Mawu tsɛ Yeremia ke e ba pee gbalɔ. (2) Sɛ gbihi nɛ je Mawu ngɔ kɛ ha Yuda ma a, kɛ Yuda matsɛmɛ Yosia, Yehoyakim, Yehoyakin, kɛ Zedekia. (3) Gbami slɔɔtohi, Yeremia he sane pɔtɛɛ komɛ, kɛ ní kpa komɛ nɛ Yeremia womi ngmalɔ, Baruk bua nya kɛ to. (4) Sɛ gbihi nɛ je Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ngɔ nɛ kɔɔ je ma komɛ a he. (5) Blema sane kpiti ko nɛ gbaa wɔ bɔ nɛ a plɛ kɛ kpata Yerusalem ma a hɛ mi, kɛ bɔ nɛ a nuu ma mi bi ɔmɛ kɛ ho Babilon ya.
Yeremia ji nɔ ko nɛ suɔ e ma a, nɛ e nuɔ nɔ́ he ha nɔ wawɛɛ nitsɛ. Ke ma a pee yayami kikɛ nɛ ɔ, nɛ́ e hia kaa e ngɔ Mawu sɛ gbi ya ha mɛ kaa Mawu maa gbla a tue ɔ, e haoɔ lɛ wawɛɛ nitsɛ. Ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ mi hehi fuu ɔ, wa naa bɔ nɛ Yeremia na nɔ́ ngɛ gbami ní tsumi nɛ Mawu tsɛ lɛ ke e ba tsu ɔ mi. Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ munyu ɔ ngɛ kaa la nɛ ngɛ tsoe ngɛ Yeremia tsui mi, nɛ e nya hí tsimi.
Yeremia womi nɛ ɔ mi munyu nguanguahi pe kulaa a, kɔɔ níhi nɛ maa ba ngɛ Yeremia be kɛ e mi haomi ɔ se. Munyu nɛ ɔmɛ deɔ wɔ ke hwɔɔ se ɔ, Mawu kɛ e ma a maa so somi he ko. A maa ngma somi nɛ ɔ ngɛ ni ɔmɛ a tsui mi, nɛ a maa ye nɔ. Nɛ e be hiae kaa tsɔɔlɔ ko nɛ ba kai mɛ hu (31.31-34).
Bɔ nɛ a dla womi ɔ mi ha
Mawu tsɛ Yeremia 1.1-19
Gbamihi nɛ Yeremia gba ngɛ matsɛmɛ nɛ ɔmɛ a yi nɔ: Yosia, Yehoyakim, Yehoyakin, kɛ Zedekia 2.1—25.38
Níhi nɛ ba ngɛ Yeremia wami be mi 26.1—45.5
Gbamihi nɛ Yeremia gba kɛ si je ma amɛ 46.1—51.64
A kpata Yerusalem ma a hɛ mi 52.1-34

Title: YEREMIA 1
Content:
1Yeremia, Hilkia binyumu ɔ munyuhi ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ. Osɔfohi nɛ hi Anatot ngɛ Benyamin zugba a nɔ ɔ, a ti nɔ kake ji Hilkia. 2 Yuda matsɛ Yosia, Amon binyumu ɔ yi nɔ jeha nyɔngma kɛ etɛne ɔ mi ɔ, Yawɛ kɛ Yeremia tu munyu. 3 E kɛ lɛ tu munyu ekohu be mi nɛ Yehoyakim, Yosia binyumu ɔ ngɛ matsɛ yee ngɛ Yuda ma a nɔ. Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, Yawɛ kɛ Yeremia tu munyu nɔtonɔto hluu kɛ ya si Yuda matsɛ Zedekia, Yosia binyumu ɔ yi nɔ jeha nɛ ji nyɔngma kɛ kake ɔ nyagbe. Jamɛ a jeha a we nyɔhiɔ enuɔne ɔ mi ɔ, a ba nuu Yerusalem ma mi bi ɔmɛ nyɔguɛ kɛ ho.
Yawɛ tsɛ Yeremia
4Yawɛ de mi ke, 5“Loko i puɛ mo kɛ wo muklii mi ɔ, jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, i le mo momo. Benɛ a na we nɛ a fɔ mo ɔ, jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, i hla mo ngɔ to momo nɛ́ o ba gba kɛ tsɔɔ je ma amɛ.”
6I he nɔ ke, “Ao, Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ! I li munyu tumi; niheyo kɛkɛ ji mi.”
7Se Yawɛ de mi ke, “Ko de ke niheyo kɛkɛ ji mo. Nihi tsuo a ngɔ nɛ ma tsɔ mo ɔ, yaa; nɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ ma fa mo ke o de ɔ, de. 8Koo ye mɛ gbeye, ejakaa i kɛ mo ngɛ, nɛ ma bu o he. Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de.”
9Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ juale e nine, nɛ e ta ye nya he, nɛ e de mi ke, “Hyɛ, ye munyu nɛ i ngɔ ha mo ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. 10Mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ, i ha mo he wami ngɛ je mahi, kɛ matsɛ yemihi a nɔ; o maa hia, o maa kũɔ, o ma puɛ, o ma kpata hɛ mi, o maa ma, nɛ o ma du.”
Nina enyɔ komɛ
11Jehanɛ Yawɛ bi mi ke, “Yeremia, mɛni o na?”
I he nɔ ke, “I na ngmɛ́ tso kɔni ko.”
12Yawɛ de mi ke, “Anɔkuale! O na ngmɛ́ tso kɔni tutuutu niinɛ. I ngɛ hyɛe konɛ ye munyu ɔmɛ nɛ a ba mi.”
13Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ bi mi ekohu ke, “Mɛni hu o pa na?”
I he nɔ ke, “I na buɛ ko kɛ e mi nyu nɛ ngɛ fiae kɔtɔkɔtɔ ngɛ omleyi je, nɛ buɛ ɔ nya plɛ kɛ tsɔɔ hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ je.”
14Yawɛ de mi ke, “Niinɛ, amanehlu maa fia kɛ je omleyi je kɛ ba pue zugba nɛ ɔ nɔ bi tsuo a nɔ. 15I ngɛ je ma amɛ tsuo nɛ ngɛ omleyi je ɔ kpee kɛ ma Yerusalem. Matsɛ tsuaa matsɛ kɛ e sɛ ma ba ma Yerusalem agbo ɔmɛ a nya, kɛ gbogbo ɔmɛ a he kɛ kpe. A maa pee ja nɔuu ngɛ Yuda ma kpa amɛ hu a mi. 16Ma gbla ye ma a tue, ejakaa a pee yayami: a kua mi, a sã bɔ kɛ ha mawu kpahi, nɛ a ja mɛ nitsɛmɛ a nine nya níhi nɛ a pee. 17Yeremia, moo mia! Yaa nɛ o ya de mɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ i fa mo ke o de ɔ. Koo ye gbeye; ke pi ja a, ke o ya da a hɛ mi ɔ, ma ha nɛ sawale nɛ nya wa maa nu mo. 18-19Yeremia, bu tue! Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ngɛ zugba nɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ: Yuda matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ, ganɔ ɔmɛ, osɔfo ɔmɛ, kɛ ma mi bi ɔmɛ maa te kɛ wo mo. Se mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ, i ngɛ mo he wami hae nɛ o ye a nɔ. I pee mo kaa ma nɛ a fia gbogbo ngɔ wo he, aloo dade titima, aloo gbogbo nɛ a kɛ akɔblee pee. A be mo nyɛe; ejakaa i kɛ mo ngɛ, nɛ ma je mo kɛ je a dɛ mi. Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de.”

Title: YEREMIA 2
Content:
Mawu baa Israel yi
1Yawɛ kɛ sɛ gbi nɛ ɔ ha mi, nɛ e de mi ke 2ma fiɛ ha nɔ tsuaa nɔ ngɛ Yerusalem ke,
“I kai kaa be nɛ nyɛ ngɛ nihe mi ɔ,
nyɛ ye mi anɔkuale,
nɛ nyɛ je nyɛ suɔmi kpo kɛ tsɔɔ mi
kaa bɔ nɛ ayɛflo suɔ e huno ɔ;
nyɛ nyɛɛ ye se kɛ ya gu nga kplanaa nɔ
ngɛ zugba nɛ a du we ní ngɛ nɔ ɔ nɔ.
3Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, imi nitsɛ ye nihi nɛ i hla
ji nyɛ Israel bi;
ye weto ní klɔuklɔu ji nyɛ.
Nihi tsuo nɛ pee nyɛ yayami ɔ,
i ngɔ haomi kɛ gbla a tue.
Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de.”
Israel bi a nɛmɛ ɔmɛ a he yayamihi
4Nyɛ Yakob nina, kɛ Israel wɛtsohi tsuo, nyɛɛ bu Yawɛ sɛ gbi tue. 5Yawɛ ke,
“Mɛni tɔmi nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ na ngɛ ye he
loko a tsɔ a he kɛ je ye he ɔ?
A ya nyɛɛ níhi nɛ he be se nami a se,
nɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a plɛ pee yaka nimli.
6A bi we ke, ‘Jije Yawɛ ngɛ?’
Pohu, imi lɛ i je mɛ kɛ je Egipt zugba a nɔ;
imi lɛ i kpaka mɛ kɛ gu nga kplanaa a nɔ,
zugba kɛ e mi muɔhi kɛ e mi diblii kpii,
zugba nɛ nyu be nɔ,
nɛ nɔmlɔ adesa ko be nɔ,
nɛ nɔ ko hu gui nɔ.
7I ngɔ mɛ kɛ ba zugba nɛ baa ní nɔ,
konɛ a ba ye zugba a nɔ yiblii
kɛ ní kpakpahi.
Se benɛ a ba a, a ba ble zugba a,
nɛ a ngɔ ye weto ní ngɔ pee nɔ́ nɛ a hiee.
8Osɔfo ɔmɛ bi we ke, ‘Jije Yawɛ ngɛ?’
Imi nitsɛ ye we osɔfohi po li mi.
Nɔ yeli ɔmɛ te si kɛ wo mi;
gbali ɔmɛ gba ngɛ Baal biɛ mi,
nɛ a ya nyɛɛ níhi nɛ a he be se nami a se.
Yawɛ kɛ e ma a na
9“Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, imi Yawɛ,
i kɛ ye ma a maa to ní.
I kɛ mɛ, kɛ a nina tsuo maa to ní.
10Nyɛɛ ya Kipro wo kpɔ ɔmɛ a nɔ nɛ nyɛ ya hyɛ;
nyɛɛ tsɔ kɛ ya Kedar nɛ nyɛ ya hla mi fitsofitso;
nyɛɛ hyɛ kaa nɔ́ ko kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ ba hyɛ lo!
11Anɛ je ma ko tsake e mawuhi hyɛ lo?
Je ma amɛ a mawu ɔmɛ po
tsa pi mawu nitsɛnitsɛhi ji mɛ.
Se ye ma a lɛɛ a ngɔ imi, a hɛ mi nyami ɔ
kɛ tsake mawuhi nɛ a he be se nami.
12Hiɔwe, ha nɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ nɛ pee mo nyakpɛ.
Ha nɛ sawale nɛ nu mo, nɛ o he mi nɛ po.
13Ejakaa yayami enyɔ lɛ ye ma a pee:
imi, wami nyu vu ɔ, a kua mi,
nɛ a ya kpɛ́ tɛ muɔhi ngɔ ha a he;
pohu tɛ muɔ nɛ ɔmɛ ywia,
nɛ nyu be a mi dae.
Nɔ́ nɛ je ma se mawuhi a se nyɛɛmi mi
14“Israel ɔ nɛɛ, nyɔguɛ ji lɛ lo?
Anɛ nyɔguɛ si himi mi a fɔ lɛ ngɔ wo lo?
Mɛni he je mɔ nɛ e he nyɛli ɔmɛ ngɛ e se nyɛɛe,
nɛ a ngɛ lɛ dae kikɛ nɛ ɔ?
15A ngɛ huãe kɛ ngɛ lɛ woe kaa jatahi;
a pee e zugba a kaa nga kplanaa nɔ;
e ma amɛ plɛ pee ma dokuhi,
nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be ma amɛ a mi hu.
16Ee, Memfis bi, kɛ Tapanhes bi ywia e yi kpoo!
17Israel, mɛnɔ kɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ba o nɔ?
Anɛ pi mo nitsɛ nɛ o pee lo?
Benɛ imi, Yawɛ o Mawu ɔ,
i kpaka mo kɛ ma a,
anɛ o tsɔ we ye hɛ mi atuã lo?
18Mɛni o susu kaa o ma na ngɛ Egipt
loko o ya lejɛ ɔ?
Nɛ́ o ya nu Nilo pa a mi nyu, pi ja lo?
Mɛni o susu kaa o ma na ngɛ Asiria
loko o ya lejɛ ɔ?
Nɛ́ o ya nu Yufrate pa a mi nyu, pi ja lo?
19Mo nitsɛ o ní yayami ɔmɛ maa gbla o tue;
o se yami ɔ ma ka o hɛ mi.
O ma ba na paa kaa kuami nɛ o kua
imi, Yawɛ o Mawu ɔ,
kɛ ye hɛ mi atuã nɛ o tsɔ ɔ
ji nɔ́ ko nɛ hí kulaa;
e ngɛ kaa nɔ́ ko nɛ dooɔ kaa agba.
Imi, Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ lɛ i de.”
Israel kua Mawu jami
20Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ke,
“Israel, blema lokoo lɛ o je o he
kɛ je ye he wami sisi;
o de ke o be mi jae hu fɛɛ.
O kpla si ha amagahi ngɛ yoku tsuaa yoku
nɛ ya hiɔwe nɔ,
kɛ tso tsua tso nɛ bɔ kusuu sisi.
21O ngɛ kaa wai tso saminyayoo nɛ i du;
wu kpakpa mi lɛ o puɛ kɛ je.
Se hyɛ bɔ nɛ o ba plɛ pee
kaa wai sasɛ nɛ he be se nami.
22Ke o du o he kɛ jale nɛ nya wa tete po,
ma na o tɔmi ɔmɛ kaa so ko nɛ mɛtɛ o he.
23O ma de ke o ble we o he lo?
O ma de ke o ja we Baalhi hyɛ lo?
Hyɛ bɔ nɛ o pee yayami ngɛ kɔ̃ ɔ mi;
hyɛ nɔ́ nɛ o pee.
O pee kaa afukpɔngɔ yo nɛ he mi jɔɛ lɛ,
nɛ ngɛ kpae kɛ ngɛ yae kɛ ngɛ bae.
24O ngɛ kaa nga mi teji yo
nɛ nu nyumu he fu;
mɛnɔ ma nyɛ maa tsi e nya?
E hia we kaa nyumu nɛ hao e he kɛ ya hla lɛ;
ke fiɛmi be ɔ su kɛkɛ o maa na lɛ.
25I de mo ke, Israel, kpa mawu kpahi a se nyɛɛmi,
bɔ nɛ pee nɛ o nane nɛ ko ba gbo,
nɛ kuma ba gbe mo.
Se o de ke,
‘Dɛbi! I be ye se kpalee;
i suɔ ma se mawuhi,
nɛ ma se mawuhi a se lɛ ma nyɛɛ.’ ”
Israel sa tue gblami
26Yawɛ ke, “Kaa bɔ nɛ ke a nu julɔ nɛ a pueɔ e hɛ mi si ɔ, ja nɔuu lɛ a ma pue nyɛ Israel ma a tsuo, nyɛ matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ, ganɔ ɔmɛ, nyɛ we osɔfo ɔmɛ, kɛ gbali ɔmɛ nyɛ hɛ mi si. 27A ma pue nyɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ nyɛ hɛ mi si, nyɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ nyɛ tsɛɔ tso ke nyɛ tsɛ, nɛ nyɛ deɔ ke nyɛ nyɛ ji tɛ sa a. Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ maa ba mi, ejakaa nyɛ tsɔ ye hɛ mi atuã, be mi nɛ e sa kaa nyɛ ba nyɛɛ ye se mohu. Se ke haomi ba nyɛ nɔ lɛɛ nyɛ deɔ ke ma ba he nyɛ yi wami.
28“Mawu ɔmɛ nɛ nyɛ pee ngɔ ha nyɛ he ɔ, jije a ngɛ? Ke haomi ba nyɛ nɔ ɔ, nyɛ ha nɛ a he nyɛ yi wami ke a ma nyɛ ɔ! Yuda, bɔ nɛ o ma amɛ hiɛ babauu ɔ, ja nɔuu lɛ o mawu ɔmɛ hu hiɛ. 29Mɛni he je lɛ nyɛ ngɛ ye nya poe ɔ? Nyɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ nyɛ tsɔ ye hɛ mi atuã! 30I gbla nyɛ bimɛ ɔmɛ a tue, se lɛ tsuo pee yaka; nyɛ sume tsɔsemi. Nyɛ nitsɛmɛ hu nyɛ gbe ye gbali ɔmɛ kaa bɔ nɛ jata tsɔtslɔɔ lohwe ɔ. 31Nyɛ Israel ma, nyɛɛ bu nɔ́ nɛ imi, Yawɛ i ngɛ dee ɔ tue. Anɛ i kɛ nyɛ ye sane nɛ dɛ lo? Anɛ i pee kaa nga kplanaa, aloo zugba nɛ e nɔ wo diblii kpii ha nyɛ lo? Mɛni he je mɔ nɛ nyɛ deɔ ke, ‘Jehanɛ lɛɛ wa ye wa he, wa pa be Mawu ngɔ yae hu?’ ɔ. 32Anɛ yiheyo hɛ maa je e june nɔ lo? Anɛ ayɛflo hɛ maa je e tade nɔ lo? Se ye ma a lɛɛ a hɛ je ye nɔ ligbi babauu nɛ e be hie kanemi. 33Nyɛɛ hyɛ bɔ nɛ nyɛ toɔ ga kɛ hlaa yo! Yi yaholi kpanakuhi po maa kase ní kɛ je nyɛ ngɔ. 34Ohiatsɛmɛ nɛ pee we yayami ko a muɔ ji so nɛ ngɛ nyɛ tadehi a mi; pi ojo fiali a muɔ.
“Se enɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a se ɔ, 35nyɛ deɔ ke, ‘Oo, i tsa pee we yayami ko kɛ wui Mawu mi mi la; e mi mi tsa fu we mi pohu.’ Se imi Yawɛ, ma gbla nyɛ tue kɛ̃, ejakaa nyɛ ye lakpa ke nyɛ pee we yayami ko. 36Nyɛɛ hyɛ bɔ nɛ nyɛ nane nya ngɛ sɔe kɛ ngɛ yae kɛ ngɛ bae, nɛ nyɛ ngɛ yemi kɛ buami hlae ngɛ je ma amɛ a ngɔ! Nyɛ hɛ mi ma pue si ngɛ Egipt kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ hɛ mi pue si be ko ngɛ Asiria a. 37O kɛ o nine ma kpla o yi, nɛ o maa kpale kɛ je Egipt kɛ ba kɛ zo. Nihi nɛ o ngɔ o hɛ ngɔ fɔ a nɔ ɔ, imi Yawɛ i kua mɛ; o be nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko nae kɛ je a dɛ.”

Title: YEREMIA 3
Content:
Israel yi Mawu anɔkuale
1Yawɛ ke, “Ke nyumu ko fie e yo, nɛ yo ɔ je e he nɛ e ya pee nyumu kpa e yo ɔ, nyumu nɛ ɔ be he blɔ nɛ e ya ngɔɔ lɛ ekohu. Ke e pee ja a, e ble zugba a gbidii. Se Israel, moo lɛɛ o je ye he nɛ o ya ngɔ yihi babauu. Nɛ jehanɛ lɛɛ o ngɛ hlae nɛ o kpale kɛ ba ye ngɔ! 2Wo o yi nɔ nɛ o hyɛ yoku kpataa amɛ a nɔ. Anɛ he ko ngɛ nɛ a kɛ mo hwɔɛ ngɛ lo? O ya hiɔ si ngɛ blɔ tue kɛ hii o suɔli blɔ hyɛe. Mo nɔ kake o ya hiɔ si ja, kaa Arabia no ngɛ nga kplanaa nɔ. O kɛ yahomi, kɛ ní yayamihi peemi ble zugba a. 3Enɛ ɔmɛ a he je lɛ a tsi hiɔmi nɛmi nya, nɛ gbo hiɔmi po nɛ ɔ nɛ. O ngɛ kaa yo yaholɔ nɛ e zo tɔ ywia pɛ.
4“O deɔ mi ke, ‘Tsaatsɛ, kɛ je ye jokuɛyo be mi tɔɔ lɛ o suɔ ye sane. 5Anɛ o mi mi ma fu mi daa kɛ yaa neneene lo?’ Israel, bɔ nɛ o deɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ; se kɛ̃ ɔ, o hɛ ngɛ o he nɔ nɛ o ngɛ ní yayamihi pee kɛ mwɔɔ.”
E hia kaa Israel kɛ Yuda nɛ a tsake a tsui
6 Benɛ Yosia ngɛ matsɛ yee ɔ, Yawɛ de mi ke, “Tse o na nɔ́ nɛ Israel pee? Israel je ye se nɛ e ya ja mawu kpahi ngɛ yokuhi tsuo nɛ ya hiɔwe a nɔ, kɛ tsohi tsuo nɛ bɔ kusuu a sisi. E ngɛ kaa yo yaholɔ pɛ. 7Jinɛ i susu kaa nɛ Israel pee ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo se ɔ, e maa kpale kɛ ba ye ngɔ nɛ e ba pee ye nɔ́ ekohu; se e pee we ja. Nɛ e nyɛmiyo Yuda, nɛ lɛ hu e yi anɔkuale kaa lɛ nɔuu ɔ na nɔ́ nɛ ɔ. 8Yuda na kaa i ha Israel gba mi pomi womi nɛ i fie lɛ, ejakaa e je ye se nɛ e ya bɔ ajuama. Se Yuda nɛ ngɛ kaa e nyɛmiyo Israel ɔ yi gbeye. 9E kɛ yahomi ble zugba a, nɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ si we lɛ kpu. E juɛmi ji ke e ya ja tso kɛ tɛ ɔ, tsa pi nɔ́ ko kulaa ji lɔ ɔ. 10Ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a se ɔ, Yuda, Israel nyɛmiyo yaholɔ ɔ kpale we kɛ bɛ ye ngɔ kɛ e tsui tsuo; e ní peemi níhi tsɔɔ we kaa e tsake. Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de.”
11Jehanɛ, Yawɛ de mi ke Israel tsɔ e hɛ mi atuã mohu lɛɛ, se afani lɛ kulaa ngɛ Yuda he. 12E ke ma ya de Israel ke, “Israel, yaholɔ, moo kpale kɛ ba ye ngɔ ekohu; ejakaa mɔbɔ nalɔ ji mi, nɛ i be ye hɛ mi tue kɛ wo mo. Ye mi mi be fue kɛ wo mo kɛ ya neneene. 13Moo lɛɛ moo kplɛɛ kɛkɛ kaa o ye fɔ, kaa o tsɔ Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ hɛ mi atuã. Moo jaje kaa o ngɔ o suɔmi ya ha ma se mawuhi, nɛ o ja mɛ ngɛ tsohi tsuo nɛ bɔ kusuu a sisi. Moo jaje kaa o yi ye mlaa amɛ a nɔ. Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de.
14“Atuã tsɔli! Nyɛɛ kpale kɛ ba ye ngɔ koo; ye ma ji nyɛ. Ma ngɔ nyɛ kɛ ba Zion yo ɔ nɔ ekohu: ma tsuaa ma a, ma ngɔ nɔ kake, nɛ we puɔ nya tsuaa we puɔ nya a, ma ngɔ ni enyɔ. 15Ma ha nyɛ nɔ yeli nɛ peeɔ ye suɔmi nya ní, nɛ a kɛ nile kɛ nɔ́ sisi numi maa hyɛ nyɛ nɔ. 16Pee se ke nyɛ ba fɔ babauu, nɛ nyɛ he ba hiɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ ɔ, nihi pa be ye somi daka a he ní sɛɛe hu. A pa be he susue, nɛ a be kaie hu. E he pa be mɛ hiae hu, nɛ ekpa hu a be pee. 17Ke jamɛ a be ɔ su ɔ, a ma tsɛ Yerusalem ke, ‘Yawɛ matsɛ sɛ,’ nɛ je ma amɛ tsuo ma ba bua a he nya ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, nɛ a ma ja mi. A pa be a tsui kpliie nɛ a pee mɛ nitsɛmɛ a suɔmi nya ní yayamihi hu. 18Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, Israel bi, kɛ Yuda bi maa ye a he kɛ je nyɔguɛ si himi mi ngɛ omleyi je zugba a nɔ, nɛ a ma tsa bo nya kɛ kpale kɛ ba zugba a nɛ i ngɔ kɛ ha nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ kaa a weto ni ɔ nɔ ekohu.”
Mawu ma a ja amagahi
19Yawɛ ke,
“Israel, jinɛ i susu kaa e maa pee fɛu
ke i ngɔ mo ba piɛ ye bimɛ ɔmɛ a he ngɛ hiɛ ɔ.
I to nɛ ma ha mo zugba saminyayoo ko,
zugba nɛ ngɛ fɛu pe kulaa ngɛ je ɔ mi.
I hyɛ blɔ kaa o ma tsɛ mi ke ‘Tsaatsɛ’,
nɛ i susu kaa o pa be ye hɛ mi atuã tsɔe hu.
20Se kaa bɔ nɛ yogbayo jeɔ e huno se
nɛ e kɛ nyumu kpahi ya naa bɔmi ɔ,
jã kɛ̃ lɛ mo hu o yi mi anɔkuale.
Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de.”
21Ngmlaa ko ngɛ pɛe ngɛ yoku kpataa amɛ a nɔ;
Israel bi lɛ a wo yana, nɛ a ngɛ kue fae;
ejakaa a pee yayami,
nɛ a hɛ je Yawɛ, a Mawu ɔ nɔ.
22“Nyɛ nihi tsuo nɛ nyɛ je Yawɛ se,
nyɛɛ kpale kɛ ba;
e ma tsa nyɛ yayami hiɔ ɔmɛ.”
Nyɛ ke, “Ee, wa ma Yawɛ ngɔ, ejakaa lɛ ji wa Mawu. 23Niinɛ, wɔhi nɛ wa ngɛ jae ngɛ yoku ɔmɛ a nɔ kɛ huhui bami nɛ ɔ, wa na we a he se ko. Yawɛ, wa Mawu ɔ pɛ ji Israel he piɛlɔ, kɛ yi wami helɔ. 24Baal jami kpata níhi tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ nɛ wa nɛmɛ ɔmɛ gbo dengme kɛ na ha wɔ blema a, tohi, nahi, kɛ binyumuhi kɛ yihi a hɛ mi. 25Nyɛ ha nɛ waa kɛ zo nɛ pee wa heha nɔ́ kɛ hwɔ si, ejakaa wa pee yayami kɛ si Yawɛ, wa Mawu ɔ. Wa nɛmɛ ɔmɛ pee a nɔ́, nɛ wɔ hu kɛ je wa jokuɛwi a si kɛ ba si mwɔnɛ ɔ, wa kpa we. Wa yi Yawɛ, wa Mawu ɔ mlaa amɛ a nɔ.”

Title: YEREMIA 4
Content:
Nyɛ tsake nyɛ tsui
1Yawɛ ke, “Israel bi, ke nyɛ suɔ kaa nyɛ maa kpale kɛ ba ye ngɔ ɔ, nyɛɛ ba! Ke nyɛ ma je amaga amɛ nɛ i hiee ɔ kɛ je ye hɛ mi, 2nɛ nyɛ ma ka kita ngɛ ye biɛ mi anɔkuale mi, nɛ nyɛ maa ye dami sane, nɛ nyɛ maa pee nɔ́ nɛ da a, lɛɛ je ma amɛ tsuo ma ba je ye yi, nɛ a ma de mi ke ma gbaa mɛ.”
3 Yawɛ de Yuda ma a, kɛ Yerusalem bi ɔmɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ fa hu ngɛ nyɛ tsui ngmɔ ɔmɛ nɛ hɛ ɔ a mi; nyɛ ko du ní ngɔ wo miohi a mi. 4Somi nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ imi Yawɛ, nyɛ so ɔ, nyɛɛ ye nɔ, nɛ nyɛɛ ngɔ nyɛ he kɛ ha mi, nyɛ Yuda ma, kɛ Yerusalem bi. Ke nyɛ pee we ja a, ye mi mi ma fu nyɛ ngɛ nyɛ ní yayami ɔmɛ a he. Nɛ ke ye mi mi fu ɔ, nɔ ko be nyɛe maa jɔɔ he.”
He nyɛli miɔ nɛ a ma tua Yuda
5Nyɛ kpa titimati ngɛ zugba a nɔ tsuo!
Nyɛ kpa bubuubui!
Nyɛ de Yuda ma a, kɛ Yerusalem bi ɔmɛ ke
a tu fo kɛ ya mahi nɛ a fia gbogbo
kɛ wo a he ɔ a mi.
6Esɔ nɛ nyɛ pue blɔ kɛ ya Zion!
Nyɛ ya sa we ngɛ lejɛ ɔ; nyɛ ko to tsle!
Ejakaa Yawɛ je omleyi je kɛ ma
nɛ e ba kpata nyɛ hɛ mi.
7Je ma amɛ a hɛ mi kpatalɔ ɔ ma
kaa jata nɛ hia kpo kɛ je e laami he.
E ma nɛ e ba kpata Yuda zugba a hɛ mi.
Yuda ma amɛ maa pee ma dokuhi,
nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be a mi hie hu.
8Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, nyɛ bu kpekpe ya bo;
nyɛɛ wo yana nɛ nyɛ nya awe,
ejakaa Yawɛ mi mi fumi nɛ
nya wa a ji Yuda nɔ lolo.
9Yawɛ ke, “Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, sawale maa nu matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ ganɔ ɔmɛ tsuo; osɔfo ɔmɛ a he mi ma jɔ̃, nɛ gbali ɔmɛ a hɛ mi maa pee mɛ yaa.”
10Kɛkɛ nɛ i de ke, “Ao, Nyɔmtsɛ Mawu, anɔkuale mi ɔ, o sisi Yerusalem bi ɔmɛ pɛ! Mo lɛ o wo si ke tue mi jɔmi maa ba ma a mi, se klaate mohu ji nɛ ɔ ngɛ ni ɔmɛ a kuɔ si.”
11Be ma nɛ a ma de Yerusalem bi ɔmɛ ke ahlabata kɔɔhiɔ ko maa hia kɛ je nga kplanaa a nɔ kɛ ba a ngɔ; pi kɔɔhiɔ hɛlii nɛ maa muɔ jakati kɛ ho kɛkɛ. 12Kɔɔhiɔ nɛ Yawɛ ma ha nɛ e fia nɛ ɔ nya maa wa wawɛɛ nitsɛ pe lɔ ɔ! Kɔɔhiɔ nɛ ɔ ji Yawɛ nitsɛ nɛ ma e ma a tue gblami ɔ nɛ.
He nyɛli ba sá Yuda ma a yi
13Hyɛ, he nyɛli ɔmɛ ngɛ fo nɔ kɛ ma kaa bɔku. A ta zugba lɛ ɔmɛ hia kɛ ma kaa lasiogblee, nɛ a we okpɔngɔ ɔmɛ a he sɔɔ kulaa pe kɔlehi. Akuanyɛ! Wa yi ta pɛ!
14Yerusalem, mo fɔ ní yayami ɔmɛ kɛ je o tsui mi, nɛ a he o yi wami. Kɛ yaa si mɛni be lɛ o maa hi ní yayamihi a he susue?
15Tsɔli ngɔ sɛ gbi yaya kɛ je Dan ma a mi, kɛ Efraim yo ɔ nɔ kɛ ma. 16A ma nɛ a ba ha nɛ je ma amɛ nɛ a le, nɛ Yerusalem hu nɛ e nu kaa he nyɛli komɛ je ma se tsitsaa kɛ ma nɛ a ba sá ma a yi. He nyɛli nɛ ɔmɛ ma he ose kɛ wo Yuda ma amɛ a he. 17A ma sá Yerusalem ma a yi kɛ kpe kaa bɔ nɛ buli buɔ zugba he ɔ; ejakaa ma mi bi ɔmɛ tsɔ Yawɛ hɛ mi atuã. Yawɛ lɛ de.
18Yuda, mo nitsɛ o je mi babɛ, kɛ o ni peepee lɛ ngɔ haomi nɛ ɔ kɛ ba o nɔ ɔ nɛ. E ngɛ kaa tsopa ko nɛ mo nitsɛ o nu, nɛ e doomi ɔ ya su o tsui he tɔɔ.
Yeremia ye kɔmɔ ha e ma a
19Ao! Ao! Ye mi mi! Ye mi mi!
Ye tsui! Ye tsui ngɛ fiae kpla, kpla!
I be nyɛe nɛ ma pee dii;
ejakaa i nu nɛ a ngɛ titimati kpae,
nɛ ta ose ngɛ pɛe.
20Haomi ɔmɛ ba nɔtonɔto
kɛ ya si zugba a tsuo hɛ mi kpata.
A hule wa bo tsu ɔmɛ ngɔ pue si tlukaa,
nɛ a hía bo ɔmɛ a mi dukuduku.
21Ma hi ta nɛ ɔ hyɛe kɛ yaa si mɛni be?
Ma hi titimati nɛ ɔ he nue kɛ yaa si mɛni be?
22Yawɛ ke,
“Ye ma mi bi ɔmɛ biɛ pɛ;
ye ma mi bi ɔmɛ li mi.
A ngɛ kaa jokuɛwi kuasiahi;
a be juɛmi.
A he sɔɔ kɛ peeɔ yayami,
se kpakpa peemi lɛɛ a li.”
Yeremia na hɛ mi kpatami ɔ nɛ ma a
23I hyɛ zugba a nɔ,
nɛ zugba a fɔɔ si gu nɛ nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko be nɔ.
I hyɛ hiɔwe, nɛ la ko la ko be lejɛ ɔ.
24I hyɛ yo ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ yo ɔmɛ ngɛ mimiɛe;
yoku ɔmɛ ngɛ mimiɛe kɛ ngɛ yae kɛ ngɛ bae.
25I na kaa nɔmlɔ adesa kake ngmelu be je ɔ mi;
lohwe pɛlitsɛ ɔmɛ po te kɛ je.
26Zugba nɛ baa ní saminya a
plɛ pee nga kplanaa.
Ma amɛ plɛ pee ma dokuhi,
ejakaa Yawɛ mi mi fu mɛ wawɛɛ nitsɛ.
27(Yawɛ de ke zugba a tsuo hɛ mi ma kpata mohu lɛɛ, se kɛ̃ ɔ, bɔɔ ko maa piɛ nɛ he maa je mi.)
28Zugba a maa ye kɔmɔ,
nɛ hiɔwe ma yu tuu.
Yawɛ lɛ de,
nɛ e be e nya se kpalee.
E to e yi mi momo,
nɛ e be tsakee hu.
29Ke ma a nu okpɔngɔ ɔmɛ, kɛ kɛ̃ɛ̃ tsɛ̃li ɔmɛ
a he ɔ, nɔ tsuaa nɔ maa tu fo kɛ je.
Ni komɛ ma ya sɛ pu mi,
nɛ ni komɛ ma ya kuɔ tɛ sahi.
A ma si ma amɛ tsuo ngɔ fɔ si,
nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be a mi hie hu.
30Yerusalem, o hɛ mi kpata pɛ!
Mɛni he je lɛ o bu bo tsu ɔ?
Mɛni he je lɛ o kɛ june dla o he,
nɛ o kpa o hɛngmɛ se tsopa a?
O ngɛ o he dlae yaka gu!
O suɔli ɔmɛ kua mo,
nɛ a ngɛ mo hlae nɛ a gbe.
31I nu gbi ko nɛ ngɛ pɛe kaa yo nɛ nu kɔɔmi;
i nu kɛmɛmi ko kaa yo nɛ ngɛ e kekleekle bi fɔe.
Mamoo Yerusalem nɛ e kɛ gbafa ngɛ ngmlaa kpae ɔ nɛ.
E juale e nine mi, nɛ e ngɛ dee ke,
“Akuanyɛ! Ye yi ta pɛ!
He nyɛli ɔmɛ miɔ nɛ a maa gbe mi!”

Title: YEREMIA 5
Content:
Yerusalem pee yayami
1Yerusalem bi, nyɛɛ tu fo
kɛ gu gbɛjegbɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ kɛ ya kɛ ba!
Nyɛɛ po nyɛ hɛ nɛ nyɛɛ hyɛ kɛ bɔle si!
Nyɛɛ kpa jua amɛ a nɔ nɛ nyɛ hla fitsofitso
kaa nyɛ maa na nɔ kake ngmelu
nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da,
nɔ nɛ bɔɔ mɔde kaa e maa ye Mawu anɔkuale lo?
Ke nyɛ na nɔ kake ngmelu kaa ja a,
lɛɛ Yawɛ maa ngɔ Yerusalem he
yayami ɔmɛ kɛ pa lɛ.
2Nyɛ ngɔɔ Yawɛ biɛ kɛ kaa kita,
se nyɛ ní peemi níhi slo.
3Anɛ pi anɔkuale yemi pɛ nɛ Yawɛ suɔ lo?
Yawɛ fia nyɛ ní, se nyɛ bui fɛɛ.
Yawɛ kpata nyɛ hɛ mi,
se nyɛ kase we ní kɛ ji mi.
Nyɛ kplii nyɛ tsui kaa tɛ sa,
nɛ nyɛ kpale we kɛ ji nyɛ yayami ɔmɛ a se.
4Kɛkɛ nɛ i de ke, “Nimli guhi kɛkɛ ji nimli nɛ ɔmɛ;
a be juɛmi; a biɛ.
A li Yawɛ, a Mawu ɔ blɔ ɔmɛ.
Kɛ a maa pee kɛ bu lɛ tue kɛɛ?
5Ma ya nimli ngua amɛ a ngɔ,
nɛ i kɛ mɛ ma ya tu munyu.
Niinɛ, mɛɛ lɛɛ a le nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ, a Mawu ɔ
ngɛ hlae nɛ a pee.”
Se ni nɛ ɔmɛ hu ngɛ kaa nimli gu ɔmɛ kɛ̃;
mɛ hu a tsɔ Yawɛ hɛ mi atuã,
nɛ a bui lɛ fɛɛ.
6Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, jata maa je pu mi
kɛ ba gbe mɛ;
ogbetee maa je nga nɔ
kɛ ba tsɔtslɔɔ a mi dukuduku,
nɛ ngatsɛ ma ba wo ka
ngɛ a ma amɛ a mi.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa je kpo ɔ,
a ma tsɔtslɔɔ lɛ;
ejakaa a pee yayamihi fuu,
nɛ a tsɔ Mawu hɛ mi atuã si abɔ.
7Yawɛ bi ke, “Mɛni he je lɛ ma ngɔ
ye ma a he yayami ɔmɛ kɛ pa mɛ ɔ?
Ye ma a kua mi nɛ a ya ja yaka mawuhi.
I lɛ ye ma a kɛ ya si a tɔ saminya,
se ajuama bɔmi mohu ji nɔ́ nɛ a suɔ,
nɛ yaholi a wehi a mi a naa mɛ ngɛ.
8A ngɛ kaa okpɔngɔ kuhi nɛ plɔke saminya
nɛ a he mi ngɛ mɛ ngɔɔe,
nɛ a he mi abua ngɛ nɔ́ dee ha mɛ;
nɔ tsuaa nɔ hɛ dɔ ngɛ e nyɛmi e yo se.
9Anɛ e sɛ kaa a gblaa a tue
ngɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ a he lo?
Ma nɛ ngɛ kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ,
e sɛ kaa i gblaa a tue lo?
10Ma tsɔ he nyɛli nɛ a ya poo ye ma mi bi ɔmɛ
a wai tso ɔmɛ ngɔ pue si,
se i be hae nɛ a kpata a hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ.
Ma ha nɛ a kplɔ tso kɔni ɔmɛ,
ejakaa pi imi Yawɛ,
ye níhi ji mɛ.
11Israel kɛ Yuda tsuo yi mi anɔkuale.
Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de.”
Yawɛ kua Israel
12Yawɛ ma mi bi ɔmɛ sisi mɛ nitsɛmɛ a he, nɛ a de ke, “Yawɛ loo! Mɛni e ma nyɛ maa pee? Haomi ko haomi ko be wa nɔ bae fɛɛ! Ta, loo hwɔ hu be bae.” 13-14A deɔ ke gbali ɔmɛ a munyu ɔmɛ ngɛ kaa kɔɔhiɔ kɛkɛ; Yawɛ sɛ gbi ko be mi. Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ Mawu ɔ de mi ke, “Yeremia, akɛnɛ nimli nɛ ɔmɛ tu kikɛmɛ a munyu nɛ ɔmɛ he je ɔ, ma ha nɛ ye munyu ɔmɛ maa pee kaa la ngɛ o nya mi. Ma nɛ ɔ maa pee kaa lɛ́, nɛ la a maa sã mɛ.”
15Nyɛ Israel bi, Yawɛ ha nɛ je ma ko je tsitsaa kɛ ma nɛ e ba tua nyɛ. Blema ma ji ma nɛ ɔ nɛ, nɛ ma mi bi ɔmɛ a he wa wawɛɛ nitsɛ. Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ a gbi ɔ, nyɛ li; ke a tu munyu hu nyɛ be sisi nue. 16A kɛ̃ɛ̃ tsɛ̃li ɔmɛ ɔ, ta buli katsɛmɛ sɔuu ji mɛ; a gbeɔ nɔ basabasa nɛ a hyɛ we a se. 17A maa ye nyɛ ngmɔ niba ní ɔmɛ, kɛ nyɛ niye ní ɔmɛ tsuatsuaatsua; a maa gbe nyɛ binyumu ɔmɛ, kɛ nyɛ biyi ɔmɛ. A ma tsɔtslɔɔ nyɛ to ɔmɛ, kɛ nyɛ na amɛ, nɛ a ma kpata nyɛ wai, kɛ nyɛ ngmɔkɔ ɔmɛ a hɛ mi. Nyɛ mahi nɛ a fia gbogbo ngɔ wo a he, nɛ nyɛ ngɔ nyɛ hɛ kɛ fɔ a nɔ ɔ, he nyɛli ɔmɛ a tabo ɔmɛ ma kpata jamɛ a ma amɛ a hɛ mi.
18Yawɛ ke, “Se jamɛ a be ɔ mi po, i be ye ma a hɛ mi kpatae pɛsɛpɛsɛ. 19Yeremia, ke a bi mo ke mɛni he je lɛ imi Yawɛ, a Mawu ɔ kɛ mɛ ye sane yaya kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ, de mɛ ke, kaa bɔ nɛ a je ye se nɛ a ya sɔmɔ ma se mawuhi ngɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a zugba nɔ ɔ, jã nɔuu kɛ̃ lɛ a ma ya sɔmɔ nibwɔhi ngɛ ma se zugba nɔ.”
Mawu bɔ e ma a kɔkɔ
20Yawɛ ke, “De Yakob nina nɛ ji Yuda bi ɔmɛ ke, 21 Nyɛ kuasiahi, kɛ nihi nɛ nyɛ be juɛmi! Nyɛ ngɛ hɛngmɛ, se nyɛ hyɛ we nɔ́; nyɛ ngɛ tue, se nyɛ nui nɔ́. Nyɛɛ bu tue! 22 Imi ji Yawɛ; mɛni he je lɛ nyɛ yi mi gbeye? Mɛni he je nyɛ he dui blibliibli ngɛ ye hɛ mi? Imi lɛ i ngɔ zia kɛ wo huzu ha wo, huzu nɛ ngɛ daa kɛ daa, nɛ wo be nyɛe maa hane ligbi ko ligbi ko. Ke wo gli kaa mɛni, e be nyɛe maa hane huzu nɛ ɔ. Ke oslɔkehi ngɛ kue nɛ wo ɔ pee hamahama kaa mɛni, e be nyɛe maa be huzu nɛ ɔ he gblegbleegble. 23Se nyɛ kikɛmɛ a ma nɛ ɔ lɛɛ nimli nɛ a tsui kplii, kɛ atuã tsɔli ji nyɛ; nyɛ tsɔ ye hɛ mi atuã, nɛ nyɛ kua mi. 24Nyɛ susuu we hyɛ kaa e sa kaa nyɛɛ wo imi Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ, ye hɛ mi nyami: imi nɛ i haa nɛ gbo kɛ gbiɛ nyu nɛɛ ha nyɛ ngɛ be nɛ sa mi, nɛ i haa nɛ nyɛ kpaa ní daa jeha a! 25Se nyɛ ní peemi ní yayami ɔmɛ tsake ní nɛ ɔmɛ; nyɛ yayami ɔmɛ ha nɛ ní kpakpa nɛ ɔmɛ bɔ nyɛ.
26“Yiwutsotsɛmɛ ngɛ ye ma mi bi ɔmɛ a kpɛti. A woɔ ka kaa bɔ nɛ nihi nɛ tsɔɔ lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ klama peeɔ ɔ. Se mɛɛ lɛɛ ke a tsɔ klama a, nimli lɛ a duɔ. 27Ju níhi hyi a wehi a mi tɔ kaa lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ nɛ a nuu kɛ wo kusii mi. Enɛ ɔmɛ a he je ɔ, a na ní, nɛ a pee nimli nguahi. 28A plɔke, nɛ a pee tɔfutɔfu, nɛ a yi mi wa kaa nɔ́ ko. A ha we awusahi a blɔ fa mi níhi nɛ sa, nɛ dɛgutsɛmɛ hu a yi dami sane ha we mɛ.
29“Anɛ e sɛ kaa i gblaa a tue ngɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ a he lo? Ma nɛ ngɛ kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ, e sɛ kaa i gblaa a tue lo? 30A ye sane yaya ngɛ zugba a nɔ nɛ ke o nu ɔ, ja o he mi po. 31Gbali ɔmɛ a sɛ gbi ɔ, lakpa sɔuu; nɔ́ nɛ mɛɛ a fa osɔfo ɔmɛ ke a pee ɔ, lɔ ɔ osɔfo ɔmɛ peeɔ. Nɛ ye ma a hu suɔ ja. Se nyagbe ɔ, kɛ a maa pee kɛɛ?”

Title: YEREMIA 6
Content:
He nyɛli ba sá Yerusalem ma a yi
1Nyɛ Benyamin bi, nyɛɛ tu fo nɛ nyɛ he nyɛ yi wami! Nyɛɛ tu fo kɛ je Yerusalem esɔ! Nyɛ kpa titimati ngɛ Tekoa, nɛ nyɛ slɛ la ngɛ Bet Hekerem kɛ tsɔɔ okadi! Ejakaa haomi agbo je omleyi je kɛ ma nɛ ma ba kpata ma hɛ mi. 2Zion ma, Yerusalem ɔ ngɛ fɛu kaa yiheyo saminyayoo ko. Se kɛ̃ ɔ, a ma kpata e hɛ mi. 3Matsɛmɛ ma ba pue si ngɛ Yerusalem kɛ a tabo ɔmɛ. A maa ma a bo tsu ɔmɛ kɛ bɔle ma a kɛ kpe nɔ tsuaa nɔ ngɛ e nɔ́ mi. 4A ma de ke, “Nyɛɛ mia, nɛ nyɛ gba ta kɛ wo Yerusalem he! Nyɛ dla nyɛ he! Wa ma ya tua ma a piani!” Se jamɛ a be ɔ nɔuu ɔ, a ma de ke, “Akuanyɛ! Wa yi ta pɛ! Mamoo je jɔ wɔ. Nyɛɛ hyɛ bɔ nɛ pu ɔ ha nɛ nini ɔmɛ ka gagaa ha! 5Nyɛɛ mia! Wa ma ya tua ma a nyɔ mi, nɛ wa maa ku mɔ ɔmɛ ngɛ ma a mi kɛ pue si.”
6Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ fa matsɛmɛ nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a po tso kɛ pee kpoku kɛ bɔle Yerusalem kɛ kpe, nɛ a sa ma a yi. Yawɛ de to ke, “Ma gbla ma nɛ ɔ tue, ejakaa amimi sɔuu lɛ a ngɛ yee ngɛ ma a mi. 7Kaa bɔ nɛ vu jeɔ nyu ɔ, ja pɛ lɛ Yerusalem bi ɔmɛ peeɔ yayamihi babauu. I nuɔ haomi kɛ hɛ mi kpatami he hoo ngɛ ma a mi; nihi nɛ a plaa, nɛ a pee hiɔtsɛmɛ ji ni nɛmɛ nɛ i naa. 8Nyɛ Yerusalem bi, nyɛɛ kase ní kɛ je haomi nɛ ɔmɛ a mi. Ke pi ja a, ma ngmɛɛ nyɛ he; ma ha nyɛ ma a ma plɛ pee ma doku nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be mi hie hu.”
Israel, atuã tsɔlɔ
9Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ de mi ke, “Haomi maa ba Israel bi ɔmɛ a nɔ nɔtonɔto kɛ yaa si a ma tsake. Ke wai nya bualɔ kplɔ wai ta tso mi ɔ, e ngɔɔ e nine kɛ kplaa tso ɔ mi kɛ hyɛɛ kaa wai ɔmɛ tsuo ta lo. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, he ni nɛmɛ nɛ piɛ ɔ a yi wami loko be yayami ɔ nɛ ba.”
10I he nɔ ke, “Ke i kɛ mɛ tu munyu nɛ i ka a hɛ mi ɔ, mɛnɔ maa bu mi tue? Ni ɔmɛ a tue wa, nɛ a sume kaa a maa bu o munyu ɔ tue. Ke o ha mi sɛ gbi nɛ i ya de mɛ ɔ, pe a muɔɔ mi; a nya we he. 11Yawɛ, enɛ ɔmɛ a he je ɔ, ye mi mi fu mɛ wawɛɛ nitsɛ kaa bɔ nɛ mo hu o mi mi fu mɛ ɔ pɛ; jehanɛ lɛɛ i be nyɛe tsui tomi hu.”
Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ de mi ke, “Ngɔɔ ye mi mi fumi ɔ kɛ kple jokuɛwi a nɔ ngɛ gbɛjegbɛ ɔ nɔ; ngɔɔ kɛ kple nihewi a nɔ ngɛ a he nya buami he ɔmɛ. A maa nuu nyumuhi kɛ a yihi kɛ je, nɛ nihi nɛ bwɔ kotokoto po be a he yee. 12 A wehi, a zugbahi, kɛ a yihi ma plɛ pee ni kpahi a níhi, ejakaa ma gbla zugba nɛ ɔ nɔ bi ɔmɛ a tue. 13Kɛ je nimli wawihi a nɔ kɛ ya si nimli nguahi a nɔ ɔ, nɔ tsuaa nɔ hɛ dɔ kɛ ngɛ nɔ sisie nɛ e kɛ na ní. Gbali kɛ osɔfohi po ngɛ nɔ sisie. 14 Pá nɛ ngɛ ye ma mi bi ɔmɛ a he ɔ, a tsɔɔ lɛ fa kɛ fa kɛkɛ, nɛ e peeɔ mɛ kaa pa a gbo. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a deɔ ke, ‘Wa ngɛ tue mi jɔmi, wa ngɛ tue mi jɔmi,’ be mi nɛ tue mi jɔmi ko be. 15Anɛ zo gbe mɛ benɛ a tsu musu ní nɛ ɔmɛ lo? Dɛbi, zo gbi mɛ fɛɛ; nɔ́ nɛ a tsɛɛ zo po a li. Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, mɛ hu a ma gbo kɛ piɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ a maa gbe ɔ a he. Ke i gbla a tue kɛkɛ a nyagbe ji lɔ ɔ nɛ. Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de.”
Israel kua Mawu blɔ ɔ
16 Yawɛ de e ma a ke, “Nyɛ ya da blɔ gbla nya nɛ nyɛɛ hyɛ. Nyɛ bi nɛ a tsɔɔ nyɛ blema nane blɔ kpakpa amɛ nɛ nyɛɛ nyɛɛ nɔ. Nyɛɛ pee ja, konɛ nyɛ na tue mi jɔmi.”
Se ma a he nɔ ke, “Dɛbi, wa be pee fɛɛ!” 17Jehanɛ, to Yawɛ buli ngɛ ma a mi konɛ ma a nɛ bu titimati ɔ pɛmi tue. Se a de ke, “Wa be tue bue fɛɛ!”
18Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yawɛ de ke, “Nyɛ je ma amɛ, nyɛɛ bu tue nɛ nyɛɛ nu sane nɛ maa ba ye ma a nɔ. 19Je ɔ, bu tue! Ma ngɔ haomi kɛ ba ma nɛ ɔ nɔ kaa yayamihi nɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a pee ɔ he tue gblami. Ejakaa a bui ye munyu ɔmɛ tue, nɛ ye mlaa a hu a yi nɔ. 20Tsopa kɛ e he via nɛ a kɛ jeɔ Sheba kɛ ba haa mi ɔ, mɛni ma pee he? Nu he via nɛ a kɛ jeɔ ma se lokoo kɛ ba haa mi ɔ, i hla we. I be a sami bɔ ɔmɛ ngɔe; bɔ kpa amɛ hu i sume. 21Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ma fɔ blɔ mi tso ha mɛ; a ma tɛ nɔ nɛ a maa nɔ si bum. Tsɛmɛ kɛ a bimɛ ma gbo, nɛ nihi kɛ a huɛmɛ a hɛ mi ma kpata.”
He nyɛli maa je omleyi je kɛ ba
22Yawɛ ke, “Ma ko mi bi je omleyi je kɛ ma; je ma ko nɛ a he wa saminya je tsitsaa kɛ ma nɛ a ba tua nyɛ. 23Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, yiwutsotsɛmɛ ji mɛ; mɔbɔ nami kake too be a mi. A mia kɛ kɛ̃ɛ̃ kɛ akplɔ, nɛ a hi okpɔngɔhi a nɔ kɛ ma. Okpɔngɔ ɔmɛ a nane si ngɛ pɛe glɛi glɛi glɛi kaa wo nɛ gli. A ma nɛ a ba tua Yerusalem.”
24Yerusalem bi ɔmɛ ke, “Wa nu a he, nɛ wa nine mi je wu! Wa tsui po, nɛ wa pee kaa yo nɛ nu kɔɔmi nɛ e miɔ nɛ e ma fɔ. 25Wa be nyɛe maa je kpo kɛ ya nga a nɔ, loo waa nyɛɛ ngɛ gbɛjegbɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ hu. Ejakaa he nyɛli ɔmɛ hɛɛ klaate, nɛ he tsuaa he pee gbeyegbeye.”
26Yawɛ de e ma a ke, “Nyɛ bu kpekpe ya bo, nɛ nyɛɛ ngɔ nyɛ he kɛ wuwlua si ngɛ la zu mi. Nyɛɛ wo yana nɛ nyɛɛ ye kɔmɔ kaa a yeɔ kɔmɔ kɛ haa bi kake too nɛ gbo, ejakaa ta a nɛ ma nyɛ hɛ mi kpatami ɔ ma ba tua nyɛ tlukaa. 27Kaa bɔ nɛ sika he ní tsulɔ hlaa sika nitsɛ ngɛ sika yaya kpɛti ɔ, jã kɛ̃ i hla mo Yeremia, konɛ o hyɛ ye ma mi bi ɔmɛ fitofitso kaa kɛ ji bɔ nɛ a je mi bami ngɛ kɛɛ. 28Mɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ atuã tsɔli, kɛ yakayaka nimli ji mɛ; a tue wa kaa akɔblee kɛ dade. Daa nɛ ɔ, a ngɛ nihi a sisi nyɛɛe kɛ ngɛ bee. 29La ngɛ tsoe nɛ sumui sileɔ ngɛ mi. Se e he hia we kaa a ya nɔ nɛ a tsu ye ma mi bi ɔmɛ a he hu, ejakaa nimli yayamihi nɛ ngɛ a kpɛti ɔ, a je we mɛ. 30A ma tsɛ mɛ ke dade fi, ejakaa imi Yawɛ, i kua mɛ.”

Title: YEREMIA 7
Content:
Yeremia ya fiɛ ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ
1-3Yawɛ tsɔ mi ke ma ya da sɔlemi we ɔ agbo ɔ mi, he nɛ Yuda bi ɔmɛ guu kɛ ya jaa Yawɛ ɔ. E de mi ke ma ya da lejɛ ɔ, konɛ ma ngɔ Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ Israel Mawu ɔ sɛ gbi kɛ ha mɛ ke, “Nyɛ tsake nyɛ je mi babɛ, kɛ nyɛ ní peepee, konɛ ma ha nɛ nyɛɛ hi hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ daa. 4Munyuhi nɛ nihi tuɔ nɛ a kɛ sisiɔ nyɛ ɔ, nyɛ ko he ye. A deɔ nyɛ ke, ‘Yawɛ we ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ! Yawɛ we ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ! Yawɛ we ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ!’
5“Nyɛ tsake nyɛ je mi babɛ; kɛ nyɛ ní peepee. Nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ nyɛmimɛ nɛ hi si saminya. 6Nyɛ ko wa nibwɔhi, loo awusahi, loo yalɔyihi yi mi. Nyɛ ko pue nɔ ko muɔ si yaka gu ngɛ zugba nɛ ɔ nɔ. Nyɛ ko ya nyɛɛ mawu kpahi a se; ke nyɛ pee ja a, nyɛ hɛ mi ma kpata. 7Ke nyɛ tsake ɔ, zugba nɛ ɔ nɛ i ngɔ kɛ ha nyɛ nɛmɛ blema ko ɔ, ma ha nɛ nyɛ maa hi nɔ, nɛ e maa pee nyɛ weto ní.
8“Nyɛɛ hyɛ, lakpa munyuhi nɛ a he be se nami ɔ, nyɛɛ lɛɛ lɔ ɔmɛ nyɛ heɔ yeɔ. 9Nyɛ juɔ, nyɛ pueɔ muɔ si, nyɛ puɛɔ gba, nyɛ kaa lakpa kita, nyɛ sãã tsopa kɛ e he via kɛ haa Baal, nɛ nyɛ ya nyɛɛɔ mawu kpahi nɛ nyɛ li mɛ a se. 10Ke nyɛ pee níhi nɛ i hiee nɛ ɔ ta a, nyɛ baa nɛ nyɛ ba daa si ngɛ ye hɛ mi, ngɛ imi nitsɛ ye we nɛ ɔ mi, nɛ nyɛ deɔ ke, ‘Oo, a he wa yi wami momo!’ Konɛ nyɛ ya pee musu ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ekohu lo? 11 E peeɔ nyɛ kaa ye we ɔ, juli a laami he, pi ja? Nyɛ na nɛ nyɛɛ le kaa níhi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ pee ɔ, i na kɛ ye hɛngmɛ. Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de. 12 Nyɛɛ ya Shilo, kekleekle ma, he nɛ i hla kaa a ja mi ngɛ ɔ nɛ nyɛ ya hyɛ bɔ nɛ i pee lejɛ ɔ ngɛ ye ma Israel he yayami ɔmɛ a he. 13Nyɛ pee yayami nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo, nɛ i tu munyu kɛ tsɔɔ nyɛ nɔtonɔto, se nyɛ bui tue fɛɛ. Ke i tsɛ nyɛ hu nyɛ he we nɔ. 14Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, bɔ nɛ i pee Shilo ɔ, ja nɔuu ma pee imi nitsɛ ye we nɛ nyɛ ngɔ nyɛ hɛ ngɔ fɔ nɔ nɛ ɔ. Hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ nɛ i ngɔ kɛ ha nyɛ nɛmɛ, kɛ nyɛ nitsɛmɛ ɔ, bɔ nɛ i pee Shilo ɔ, ja ma pee lɛ. 15Ma fie nyɛ kɛ je hiɛ ɔ kaa bɔ nɛ i fie nyɛ nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ tsuo, nɛ ji Efraim nina a. Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de.”
Ma a gbo tue
16Yawɛ de mi ke, “Yeremia, koo fa kue ha ma nɛ ɔ. Ko kpa mi pɛɛ ha mɛ; koo da mi ha mɛ, ejakaa i be mo tue bue. 17Níhi nɛ a ngɛ pee ngɛ Yuda ma amɛ a mi, kɛ Yerusalem gbɛjegbɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ ɔ, o hyɛ we lo? 18 Bimɛ lɛɔ lɛ́, nɛ tsɛmɛ slɛɔ la, nɛ nyɛmɛ pɔtɔɔ ma nɛ a kɛ sãã abolo kɛ haa yo mawu ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ Hiɔwemanyɛ ɔ. Jehanɛ se hu, a kɛ wai sãã bɔ kɛ haa mawu kpahi, konɛ a kɛ wo ye mi mi la. 19Se anɛ imi ye mi mi la a ngɛ woe ɔ lo? Dɛbi! Mɛ nitsɛmɛ a he lɛ a ngɛ pee; a kɛ ma kpata mɛ nitsɛmɛ a hɛ mi. 20Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, ma plɛ ye mi mi fumi nɛ nya wa kaa la nɛ ngɛ tsoe plamplam nɛ hí gbemi ɔ kɛ pue we nɛ ɔ nɔ. Ye mi mi ma fu nimli, lohwehi, tsohi, kɛ ngmɔ niba ní tsuo.
21“Ye ma, nyɛ sãã bɔ ɔmɛ ekomɛ ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ kɛ ya siɔ a nglaa, nɛ ekomɛ lɛɛ nyɛ ngɛ he blɔ nɛ nyɛ yeɔ. Se nɔ́ nɛ imi Tabohiatsɛ Israel Mawu ɔ, i ngɛ nyɛ dee ji kaa nyɛ ma nyɛ maa ye lɛ tsuo faa. 22Benɛ i je nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ kɛ je Egipt zugba a nɔ ɔ, i wui mɛ mlaa ko mlaa ko ngɛ sami bɔ, loo bɔ kpa komɛ a he. 23Mlaa nɛ i wo mɛ ji a bu mi, konɛ ma pee a Mawu, nɛ a pee ye ma. I de mɛ ke mlaa nɛ i wo mɛ ɔ, a ye nɔ, konɛ e hi ha mɛ. 24Se nɔ́ nɛ i de mɛ ɔ, a bui tue fɛɛ; nɔ́ nɛ i ke a pee ɔ hu a pee we. Mohu, nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ a juɛmi de mɛ ke a pee ɔ, lɔ ɔ a kpliiɔ a tsui nɛ hyi kɛ yayami ɔ nɛ a peeɔ. Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, a ya se, se pi hɛ mi. 25Kɛ je ligbi ɔ nɛ nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ je Egipt hluu kɛ ba si mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ, i tsɔɔ ye tsɔli gbali ɔmɛ kɛ baa nyɛ ngɔ daa be tsuaa be. 26Se nɔ ko nɔ ko bui mɛ tue; sɛ gbi ɔ hu nyɛ ngɔɛ. Nyɛ wa tue mohu, nɛ nyɛ ya nɔ pee yayami kulaa pe nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ.
27“Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yeremia, o maa tu munyu nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ tsɔɔ ye ma a, se a be mo tue bue; o ma tsɛ mɛ, se a be nɔ hee. 28De mɛ ke ma nɛ ɔ bui imi Yawɛ, a Mawu ɔ; a tue nɛ i gbla a hu a kase we ní kɛ ji mi. Anɔkuale laa pɛsɛpɛsɛ; munyu ‘anɔkuale’ ɔ po nɔ ko pa wui nɔ ta hu.
Yakayaka níhi ngɛ Hinom kɔ̃ ɔ mi
29“Nyɛ sã nyɛ yi nɔ
nɛ nyɛ sake bwɔmi ɔ pue he;
nyɛɛ wo yana nɛ nyɛɛ ye kɔmɔ ngɛ yoku kpataa amɛ a nɔ,
ejakaa imi Yawɛ ɔ,
ye mi mi fu ye ma a, nɛ i kua mɛ.
30“Yuda bi ɔmɛ pee yayami. A ngɔ a we amagahi nɛ i hiee ɔ ba to ye we ɔ nɛ a kɛ ble we ɔ. 31 A ya ma bɔ sami la tɛ ko ngɛ Hinom kɔ̃ ɔ mi, konɛ a sã a binyumu ɔmɛ, kɛ a biyi ɔmɛ ngɛ nɔ. A wo bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ biɛ ke Tofet. I wui mɛ mlaa ke a pee nɔ́ ko kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ; nɔ́ nɛ ɔ bɛ ye yi mi po hyɛ. 32Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, be ma nɛ a be lejɛ ɔ tsɛe ke Tofet, loo Hinom kɔ̃ hu, se mohu Awiyemi kɔ̃. A maa pu nihi ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, ejakaa a be he kpa ko nae hu. 33Ni gbogboe ɔmɛ maa pee lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ, kɛ nga mi lohwehi a niye ní, nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be mɛ fiee. 34 Zugba a ma plɛ pee nga kplanaa. Ma ha nɛ nyami, bua jɔmi, kɛ ayɛflo he ní peemi hoo ɔ se maa po ngɛ Yuda ma amɛ a mi, kɛ Yerusalem gbɛjegbɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ.

Title: YEREMIA 8
Content:
1“Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, a maa tsua Yuda matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ, ganɔ ɔmɛ, osɔfo ɔmɛ, gbali ɔmɛ, kɛ ni kpa amɛ nɛ hi Yerusalem ɔ a wuhi ngɛ yɔkɔ ɔmɛ a mi. 2A be wu nɛ ɔmɛ a nya buae, nɛ a be mɛ pue hulɔ; wu ɔmɛ maa pee kaa kuku ngɛ zugba a nɔ. A ma ka wu ɔmɛ ngɔ ha pu kɛ nyɔhiɔ kɛ dodoehi. Ní nɛ ɔmɛ ji níhi nɛ ma a suɔ saminya; ma a sɔmɔ mɛ, nɛ a bi ní ngɛ a ngɔ, nɛ a ja mɛ hulɔ. 3Ke e ba mi ja, ma yayami nɛ ɔ mi bi nɛ a yi ma na wami ngɛ hehi nɛ ma sake mɛ ngɔ pue ɔ, a maa suɔ kaa a ma gbo mohu pe nɔ́ nɛ a maa hi je mi. Imi, Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ lɛ i de.”
Yayami kɛ tue gblami
4Yawɛ de mi ke ma de ma a ke, “Ke nɔ ko nɔ si ɔ, anɛ e ti si ekohu lo? Ke nɔ ko laa blɔ ɔ, anɛ e kpale we e se lo? 5Ye ma! Mɛni he je mɔ lɛ nyɛ je ye se, nɛ nyɛ sume kaa nyɛ maa kpale kɛ ba a? Mɛni he je nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ he ha sisimi ní hi kikɛ nɛ ɔ, nɛ nyɛ sume kaa nyɛ maa kpale kɛ ba ye ngɔ ɔ? 6Ke i bu nyɛ ní sɛɛmi he tue keii ɔ, mɛni ji nɔ́ nɛ i nuɔ? Lakpa sɔuu! Nɔ ko nɔ ko tu we anɔkuale. Nyɛ ti nɔ ko nɔ ko he yayami dɔɛ lɛ nɛ e pia e he, nɛ́ e bi e he ke, ‘Ao, mɛni ji nɔ́ nɛ i pee nɛ ɔ?’ Nɔ tsuaa nɔ ngɛ lɛ nitsɛ e blɔ nɔ kɛ bee kaa okpɔngɔ nɛ ngɛ fo tue kitikiti ngɛ ta nga nɔ. 7Godohi tete le be nɛ a kɛ kpaleɔ a se kɛ baa we; lahuɛ, otoklii, kɛ aklawa hu le be nɛ a kɛ jeɔ he kake kɛ yaa he kake. Se ye ma, nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ li ye mlaa amɛ. 8Kɛ peeɔ kɛɛ nɛ nyɛ deɔ ke ní leli ji nyɛ, nɛ nyɛ le ye mlaa amɛ, be mi nɛ yakayaka womi ngmali tsake mlaa amɛ tsuo a hɛ mi kikɛ nɛ ɔ? 9Zo gbe nyɛ ní leli ɔmɛ; bibi gbe mɛ, nɛ a pa li nɔ́ nɛ nɔ nɛ a ngɛ hu. A kua ye munyu ɔ, lɛɛ mɛni ji ní ɔ nɛ a le ɔ mɔ? 10 Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ma ngɔ a ngmɔ ɔmɛ kɛ ha ni nɛmɛ nɛ ma ba ye a nɔ ɔ; a yi ɔmɛ hu i kɛ ma ha nyumu kpahi. Kɛ je nimli wawihi a nɔ kɛ ya si nimli nguahi a nɔ ɔ, nɔ tsuaa nɔ hɛ dɔ kɛ ngɛ nɔ sisie nɛ e kɛ na ní. Gbali kɛ osɔfohi po ngɛ nɔ sisie. 11 Pá nɛ ngɛ ye ma mi bi ɔmɛ a he ɔ, a tsɔɔ lɛ fa kɛ fa kɛkɛ, nɛ e peeɔ mɛ kaa pá a gbo. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a deɔ ke, ‘Wa ngɛ tue mi jɔmi, wa ngɛ tue mi jɔmi’, be mi nɛ tue mi jɔmi ko be. 12Anɛ zo gbe mɛ benɛ a tsu musu ní nɛ ɔmɛ lo? Dɛbi, zo gbi mɛ fɛɛ; nɔ́ nɛ a tsɛɛ ke zo po a li. Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, mɛ hu a ma gbo kɛ piɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ a maa gbe ɔ a he. Ke i gbla a tue kɛkɛ a nyagbe ji lɔ ɔ nɛ. Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de.
13“I ka kaa ma bua ye ma a nya kaa bɔ nɛ ngmɔ hulɔ buaa e ngmɔ niba ní nya a; se e hí peemi. Ye ma a ngɛ kaa wai tso nɛ wai yiblii be nɔ. A ngɛ kaa ngmɔkɔ tso nɛ ngmɔkɔ be nɔ; ba amɛ tete po ngla. Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, i ha nɛ nibwɔhi ba ngɔ a zugba a.”
14Mawu ma a mi bi ɔmɛ bi a he ke, “Mɛni he je lɛ wa hii si ngɛ hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ kɛ mwɔɔ? Nyɛ ha nɛ waa tu fo kɛ ya mahi nɛ a fia gbogbo ngɔ wo a he ɔ a mi, nɛ wa ya gbo ngɛ jamɛ a ma amɛ a mi. Yawɛ, wa Mawu ɔ bu wɔ gbenɔ fɔ, nɛ e ngɔ nyu kɛ kplu nɛ duɔ ngɛ mi ngɔ ha wɔ ke waa nu, ejakaa wa pee yayami kɛ si lɛ. 15Wa hyɛ tue mi jɔmi blɔ, se tue mi jɔmi bɛ; wa hyɛ tsami be blɔ, se gbeye mohu ji nɔ́ nɛ ba. 16Wa he nyɛli ɔmɛ ba sɛ Dan ma a mi momo. Wa ngɛ a okpɔngɔ ɔmɛ a he nue nɛ a ngɛ a gugwɔ mi flie ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Ke okpɔngɔ ɔmɛ ngɛ pɛe kikɛ nɛ ɔ, kɛkɛ zugba a tsuo ngɛ mimiɛe. Wa he nyɛli ɔmɛ ba konɛ a ba kpata zugba a hɛ mi, kɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ, wa ma a, kɛ ma mi bi ɔmɛ tsuo.”
17Yawɛ ke, “Ma tsɔ sinɔhi kɛ ba nyɛ kpɛti, sangahi ma ba kɔɔ nyɛ; kunya yelɔ ko kunya yelɔ ko be nyɛe maa jɔɔ a he.”
Yeremia ye kɔmɔ ha e ma a
18Ye we aywilɛho ɔ nya wa tsɔ ha mi;
i nyɛ we hu.
Ye tsui kpa miɔ nɛ e ma tsɔ.
19Nyɛɛ bu tue!
Ngɛ zugba a tsuo nɔ ɔ,
i nu nɛ ye ma a ngɛ ngmlaa kpae
nɛ a ngɛ bie ke,
“Anɛ Yawɛ be Zion hu lo?
Zion matsɛ ɔ be ma a mi hu lo?”
Yawɛ bi ke,
“Mɛni he je lɛ nyɛ ya ja amagahi,
nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ peemi wo ye mi mi la a?
Mɛni he je lɛ nyɛ ya kpla si
ha ma se wohi?”
20Ma a he nɔ kɛ ngmlaa ke,
“Latsa be ɔ se po, nɛ a kpa ní ta,
se a he we wa yi wami lolo.”
21Bɔ nɛ ye ma mi bi ɔmɛ a he mi ngɛ mɛ hiae ɔ,
ja nɔuu imi hu ye he mi ngɛ mi hiae.
Ye ywilɛ ho ye he; gbeye kɛ sawale nu mi.
22Anɛ tsopa be Gilead lo?
Tsopatsɛ ko be lejɛ ɔ lo?
Mɛni he je mɔ nɛ a tsa we
ye ma mi bi ɔmɛ lolo ɔ?

Title: YEREMIA 9
Content:
1I ná nɛ ye yi pee kaa vu kɛ e mi nyu,
nɛ ye hɛngmɛhi plɛ pee nyu hɛngmɛ
nɛ vo nyu ngɛ mi jee babaaba.
Jinɛ i ko fo ya nyɔ kɛ pia
kɛ ha ye ma mi bi ɔmɛ nɛ a gbe ɔ.
2I ná nɛ i ngɛ hi he ko ngɛ nga a nɔ
kaa nibwɔhi a to he kikɛ nɛ ɔ;
jinɛ i ko je ye ma mi bi ɔmɛ a he kulaa
nɛ i ya hi lejɛ ɔ banee!
Ejakaa a ngɛ kaa yaholi;
nimli yayamihi ji mɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ;
a yi mi anɔkuale.
3Daa nɛ ɔ, a duɔ a lilɛ nya ngɔ to
kaa kɛ̃ɛ̃ nɛ a dɔ mi nɛ a ma tsɛ̃.
Lakpa, kɛ sisimi sɔuu ji zugba a nɔ;
anɔkuale be.
Yawɛ ke,
“Ye ma mi bi ɔmɛ peeɔ yayami nɔtonɔto;
se imi lɛɛ a li mi kaa a Mawu.”
4Nyɛ ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ hyɛ e he saminya ngɛ e nyɛmi he;
nɔ ko nɔ ko nɛ ko ngɔ e hɛ ngɔ fɔ e nyɛmi nɔ.
Ejakaa nɔ tsuaa nɔ pee e he Yakob
kɛ ngɛ e nyɛmi sisie,
nɛ jã kɛ̃ nyɛmi ngɛ e nyɛmi he guɛ gbee kɛ ngɛ bee.
5Nɔ tsuaa nɔ ngɛ e nyɛmi sisie,
nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko tu we anɔkuale.
A lilɛ be kɛ lakpa yemi,
nɛ a kplɛɛ we kaa a ma kpa yayami peemi.
6A peeɔ yi wu tso níhi nɔtonɔto;
jã kɛ̃ nɛ a sisiɔ nɔ.
Yawɛ ke e ma mi bi ɔmɛ kua lɛ.
7Enɛ ɔmɛ a he je ɔ, Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ ke,
“Ma gbla a tue,
nɛ ma ha nɛ a tsake a je mi babɛ
kaa bɔ nɛ sika galɔ tsuɔ sika he ɔ.
Ye ma mi bi ɔmɛ pee yayami.
Anɛ nɔ́ kpa ko pa ngɛ nɛ ma pee mɛ lo?
8A lilɛ ngɛ kaa kɛ̃ɛ̃ mi bi nɛ gbeɔ nɔ;
lakpa pɛ a yeɔ.
Nɔ kɛ e nyɛmi tuɔ munyu ngɛ he jɔmi mi,
se a tsui mi be ja;
klama mohu lɛ a hii a sibi tsɔe.
9Anɛ ma ko gbla a tue ngɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ a he lo?
Ma nɛ ngɛ kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ,
ma ko gbla a tue lo?
Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i ngɛ munyu tue ɔ nɛ.”
10I de ke, “Ma ye kɔmɔ ha yoku ɔmɛ,
nɛ ma fo ya ha lohwehi a lɛmi he ɔmɛ
ngɛ nga a nɔ.
Ejakaa lejɛ ɔmɛ gbli, nɛ a fɔɔ si gu;
nɔ ko nɔ ko gui lejɛ ɔmɛ hu.
A pa nui kaa na ngɛ pɛe muu muu ngɛ lejɛ ɔmɛ hu;
lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ, kɛ pu mi lohwehi tsuo tu fo kɛ je.”
11Yawɛ ke, “Ma pee Yerusalem ma doku,
kɛ nga mi gbehi a hi he.
Yuda ma amɛ maa pee ma dokuhi,
nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be a mi hie.”
12I bi ke, “Yawɛ, mɛni he je a sã zugba a, nɛ e gbli nɛ e pee kaa nga kplanaa nɔ kikɛ nɛ ɔ, nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko nyɛɛ we nɔ hu ɔ? Mɛnɔ ji ní lelɔ nɛ e maa nu nɔ́ nɛ ɔ sisi? Mɛnɔ lɛ o ngɔ sɛ gbi nɛ ɔ kɛ ha, nɛ e ma nyɛ maa fiɛ kɛ ha nihi?”
13Yawɛ he nɔ ke, “Nɔ́ nɛ he je nɛ kikɛmɛ a nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ba ji mlaa nɛ i wo ye ma mi bi ɔmɛ ɔ, a yi nɔ. A bui mi, nɛ nɔ́ nɛ i de mɛ ke a pee ɔ hu, a pee we. 14A wa tue, nɛ a ya pee mɛ nitsɛmɛ a suɔmi nya níhi mohu. A ya ja Baal amaga amɛ kaa bɔ nɛ a nɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsɔɔ mɛ ke a pee ɔ. 15Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ bu nɔ́ nɛ imi, Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ, i to kaa ma pee ɔ tue: ma gbla ye ma mi bi ɔmɛ a tue. Ma ha mɛ agba nɛ a ye, kɛ duɔ nɛ a nu. 16Ma gbɛ mɛ ngɔ fĩa je mahi nɛ a kɛ a nɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsuo nui a he hyɛ ɔ a nɔ, nɛ ma ha nɛ ta maa nyɛɛ a se hluu kɛ yaa si ma kpata a hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ.”
Yerusalem ma mi bi ɔmɛ bi yemi kɛ buami
17Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ de ke,
“Nyɛ susu nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ nɔ yae nɛ ɔ he!
Nyɛ ya kpee yihi nɛ nyɛɔ ya a kɛ ba;
nyɛ ya kpee yihi nɛ a he be ɔ kɛ ba.”
18Ma a de ke,
“Nyɛ de mɛ nɛ a pee esɔ
nɛ a ba wo yana ha wɔ,
kɛ yaa si wa hɛngmɛ ɔmɛ maa tɔ nyu,
nɛ wa hɛngmɛ se maa fuu
kɛ ya fomi sɔuu.”
19A wo yana ngɛ Zion, nɛ a ngɛ dee ke,
“Wa yi ta oo, wa yi ta!
Wa hɛ mi pue si pɛ!
Nyɛ ha nɛ waa je wa zugba a nɔ,
ejakaa a ku wa we ɔmɛ tsuo ngɔ pue si.”
20I de ke,
“Nyɛ yi ɔmɛ, nyɛɛ bu Yawɛ tue,
nɛ nyɛɛ ye e munyu ɔmɛ a nɔ.
Nyɛɛ tsɔɔ nyɛ biyi ɔmɛ kɔmɔ yemi,
kɛ nyɛ huɛmɛ ɔmɛ ya la lami.
21Gbenɔ kuɔ wa saflɛ ɔmɛ
kɛ ba sɛ wa mɔ ɔmɛ a mi,
nɛ e kpata wa nihewi ɔmɛ, kɛ wa yihewi ɔmɛ a hɛ mi;
jokuɛwi pa fiɛ we ngɛ gbɛjegbɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ hu,
nɛ nihewi kɛ yihewi ta jua amɛ a nɔ.
22A sake ni gbogboehi ngɔ pue he tsuaa he glekugleku
kaa kuku ngɛ ngmɔ nɔ,
loo blɛfo nɛ ní kpali poo pue si nɛ a je he,
blɛfo nɛ nɔ ko bua we nya.”
Sɛ gbi nɛ Yawɛ ngɔ ha mi
ke ma de ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
23Yawɛ ke,
“Ní lelɔ nɛ ko fĩa kɛ fɔ e nile nɔ,
nɔ nɛ ngɛ he wami ɔ,
e ko fĩa kɛ fɔ e he wami nɔ,
niatsɛ nɛ ko fĩa kɛ fɔ e níhi a nɔ.
24 Ke nɔ ko suɔ kaa e maa fĩa a,
e fĩa kaa e le mi saminya;
ejakaa ye suɔmi ɔ se pui gblegbleegble;
i peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da, nɛ i yeɔ dami sane.
Ní nɛ ɔmɛ ji níhi nɛ saa ye hɛ mi.
Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de.”
25-26Yawɛ ke, “Be ma nɛ ma gbla Egipt bi, Yuda bi, Edom bi, Amon bi, kɛ Moab bi a tue. Nihi nɛ ngɛ nga kplanaa a nɔ nɛ a poɔ huɛ ngɛ a hɛ se ɔ hu piɛ he. A po nimli nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ. Se somi nɛ pomi okadi nɛ ɔ daa si ha a lɛɛ a yi nɔ. Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ jio, ye ma Israel ɔ jio, nɔ ko nɔ ko yi ye somi ɔ nɔ.”

Title: YEREMIA 10
Content:
Amaga jami kɛ Mawu nitsɛnitsɛ jami
1Nyɛ Israel ma,
nyɛɛ bu sɛ gbi nɛ Yawɛ kɛ ngɛ nyɛ hae ɔ tue!
2Yawɛ ke,
“Nyɛ ko ya nyɛɛ je ma kpa amɛ a blɔ ɔmɛ a nɔ;
ke nyɛ na okadihi ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ,
nyɛ ko ye mɛ gbeye
kaa bɔ nɛ je ma kpa amɛ yeɔ gbeye ɔ.
3Je ma amɛ a kusumi ɔmɛ ɔ, lakpa sɔuu.
A ya poɔ tso ngɛ pu mi,
nɛ tso kpɛ́lɔ kɛ dade tsuɔ he ní,
4nɛ a kɛ sika hiɔ kɛ sika tsu haa he.
A kaa plɛɛko kɛ woɔ tso ɔ mi
nɛ a kɛ nuu tso ɔ ngɔ daa si
konɛ e ko nɔ si.
5Amaga amɛ ngɛ kaa lohwehi a he gbeye womi níhi
nɛ maa si ngɛ jamatlɛ ngmɔ mi;
a tu we munyu.
A nyɛɛ we hulɔ;
pe a woɔ a nɔ kɛ jeɔ he kake kɛ yaa he kake.
Nyɛ ko ye mɛ gbeye,
ejakaa a be nyɛe maa pee nyɛ yayami ko;
kpakpa ko hu a be nyɛe maa pee ha nyɛ.”
6Yawɛ, nɔ ko nɔ ko be nɛ kɛ mo sɔ;
O je agbo,
nɛ o biɛ hu kle nɛ e je agbo ja nɔuu.
7 Mo, je ma amɛ tsuo a matsɛ ɔ,
mɛnɔ lɛ be mo gbeye yee?
O sa bu.
Je ma amɛ tsuo a kpɛti ɔ,
nɔ ko be nɛ kɛ mo sɔ,
a ní leli ɔmɛ jio,
a matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ jio.
8Mɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ a biɛ,
nɛ a jeɔ kuasia.
Amagahi nɛ a kɛ tso pee ɔ,
mɛni a ma nyɛ maa kase kɛ je a dɛ?
9A kɛ sika hiɔ nɛ a si nɔ jeɔ Spania,
nɛ a kɛ sika tsu hu jeɔ Ufaz
kɛ ba haa sika ga ní tsuli,
nɛ a kɛ peeɔ amagahi.
A buɔ amaga amɛ bo hiɔ,
kɛ bo he jua wawɛ nɛ hɛɛ alamua tu su
nɛ bo loli kpakpahi lo.
10Se mo Yawɛ, Mawu nitsɛnitsɛ ji mo;
mo ji Mawu hɛ kalɔ ɔ nɛ;
neneene matsɛ ji mo.
Ke o mi mi fu ɔ, zugba mimiɛɔ,
nɛ je ma amɛ nyɛ we nya dami.
11Nyɛ de mɛ ke, jamɛ a mawu ɔmɛ nɛ a ngɛ jae, nɛ pohu pi mɛ nɛ a pee hiɔwe kɛ zugba a, a hɛ mi ma kpata. A be mɛ nae ngɛ je ɔ mi he ko he ko hu.
Mawu yi jemi la
12Yawɛ lɛ bɔ je ɔ
ngɛ e he wami nya.
Nile lɛ e kɛ bɔ je ɔ,
nɛ jamɛ a nile ɔ nɔuu e kɛ bli hiɔwe mi.
13Ke e wo gbi kikɛ nɛ ɔ,
nyu nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ keɔ wawɛɛ nitsɛ;
Yawɛ lɛ haa afua teɔ si kɛ jeɔ
zugba a nyagbe he ɔmɛ.
E haa oslabai gbaa
be mi nɛ hiɔmi ngɛ nɛe,
nɛ e jeɔ kɔɔhiɔ kpo kɛ jeɔ e nito he ɔ.
14Nimli adesahi tsuo biɛ;
a li nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko.
Sika gali a hɛ mi pue si pɛ;
ejakaa amaga amɛ nɛ a puɛɛ ɔ,
ní guhi ji mɛ;
wami ko wami ko be a mi.
15Amaga amɛ ɔ,
se nami ko be a he, muɔ ní kɛkɛ ji mɛ.
Be mi nɛ Yawɛ ma ba gbla ma a tue ɔ,
a we amaga amɛ hu a maa ku mɛ dukuduku.
16Yakob Mawu ɔ be kaa mɛ;
lɛ ji nɔ nɛ pee nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́,
nɛ e hla Israel kɛ pee lɛ nitsɛ e ma.
E biɛ ji Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ.
A ma ba nuu ni ɔmɛ nyɔguɛ
17Yerusalem bi, a sa nyɛ ma a yi oo! Nyɛ bua nyɛ níhi a nya. 18Yawɛ ke, “Jehanɛ lɛɛ ma sake nimli ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ zugba nɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ ngɔ fɔ he kaa bɔ nɛ a fɔɔ tɛ ɔ. Ma hao mɛ kɛ yaa si a maa nu he.”
19Yerusalem bi ɔmɛ kpa bubuubui ke,
“Akuanyɛ! Wa plaa pɛ!
Wa pa a be tsa ba.
Se wa susu kaa wa ma nyɛ
ma mia wa hɛ mi kɛ to nɔ.
20Wa bo tsu ɔmɛ puɛ;
kpahi nɛ fi mɛ ɔ tsɔ.
Wa bimɛ ɔmɛ tsuo je wa he;
nɔ ko nɔ ko be nɛ maa ngɔ
wa bo tsu ɔmɛ kɛ ma si ekohu ha wɔ;
nɔ ko nɔ ko be nɛ maa ngɔ
bo ɔmɛ kɛ kpla bo tsu ɔmɛ a he ekohu.”
21I he nɔ ke, “Wa nɔ yeli ɔmɛ be juɛmi;
a bi we Yawɛ ga womi.
Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, a yɛ́ nɔ;
nɛ wa ma mi bi ɔmɛ tsuo gbɛ fĩa.
22Nyɛɛ bu tue! Sɛ gbi ko ma!
Ose ko ngɛ pɛe
kɛ je omleyi je zugba a nɔ kɛ ma.
Ta nguaa ko ma nɛ e ba kpata Yuda ma amɛ a hɛ mi,
nɛ ma amɛ maa pee kaa nga mi gbehi a hi he.”
23Yawɛ, i le kaa nɔmlɔ adesa ko be he wami
ngɛ lɛ nitsɛ e wami nɔ.
Pi nɔmlɔ adesa nitsɛ he wami nya ji kaa
e maa pee kikɛ nɛ ɔ, loo kikɛ nɛ ɔ.
24Yawɛ, mo ka o ma a hɛ mi;
ka wa hɛ mi bɔ pɛ nɛ sa kɛkɛ.
Koo ngɔ abofu kɛ gbla wa tue;
ke o pee ja a, wa hɛ mi ma kpata.
25Je ma amɛ nɛ li mo ɔ, o mi mi nɛ fu mɛ;
ni nɛmɛ nɛ ja we mo ɔ, gbla a tue.
A gbe o ma mi bi nɛ ji Yakob nina a;
a kpata wa hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ,
nɛ a pee wa zugba a kaa nga kplanaa nɔ.

Title: YEREMIA 11
Content:
Yeremia kɛ somi ɔ
1Yawɛ de mi ke, 2“Bu somi munyu ɔmɛ tue. De Yuda ma a, kɛ Yerusalem ma bi ɔmɛ ke, 3nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ be somi munyu nɛ ɔmɛ tue bue ɔ, imi, Yawɛ Israel Mawu ɔ ma gbiɛ lɛ. 4Benɛ i jé a nɛmɛ ɔmɛ kɛ je Egipt ɔ, somi nɛ i kɛ mɛ so ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. Egipt zugba a ngɛ kaa flɔɔnɔɔ kɛ e mi la nɛ ngɛ tsoe gegeege. I wo mɛ mlaa ke a bu mi tue, nɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ i de mɛ ke a pee ɔ, a pee. I de mɛ ke, ke a bu mi tue ɔ, a maa pee ye ma, nɛ imi hu ma pee a Mawu. 5Kɛkɛ ɔ, si ko nɛ i wo a nɛmɛ ɔmɛ kaa ma ha mɛ zugba kpakpa nɛ baa ní ɔ, ma ye nɔ. Jamɛ a zugba a nɔ a ngɛ amlɔ nɛ ɔ nɛ.”
I he nɔ ke, “Yawɛ, ha nɛ e ba mi ja.”
6Jehanɛ Yawɛ de mi ke, “Yaa fiɛ ngɛ Yuda ma amɛ a mi, kɛ Yerusalem gbɛjegbɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ o de ni ɔmɛ ke a bu somi munyu ɔmɛ tue, nɛ a ye nɔ. 7Benɛ i je a nɛmɛ ɔmɛ kɛ je Egipt zugba a nɔ ɔ, i ka a hɛ mi saminya nɛ i de mɛ ke a bu mi tue. Kikɛ nɛ ɔ nɔuu i ngɛ ma a hɛ mi kae kɛ ba si mwɔnɛ ɔ. 8Se a bui mi tue fɛɛ; munyu nɛ i kɛ mɛ tu ɔ po, a nui. A wa tue nɛ a pee yayami kaa kekle ɔ mohu. I wo mɛ mlaa ke a ye somi ɔ nɔ, se a kua nɔ yemi. Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, i gbla a tue wawɛɛ nitsɛ kaa bɔ nɛ somi tsɔɔ ɔ.”
9Yawɛ de mi ekohu ke, “Yuda ma a, kɛ Yerusalem bi ɔmɛ tsɔ ye hɛ mi atuã. 10Yayamihi nɛ a nɛmɛ ɔmɛ pee ɔ, a kpale ya pee jamɛ a yayami ɔmɛ. A nɛmɛ ɔmɛ kplɛɛ we kaa a maa bu mi tue, nɛ a ya ja mawu kpahi. Israel ma a, kɛ Yuda ma a tsuo yi somi nɛ i kɛ a nɛmɛ ɔmɛ so ɔ nɔ. 11Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, imi Yawɛ, i ngɛ mɛ dee ke, ma ha nɛ haomi maa ba a nɔ nɛ a he be mi jee. Ke a fa kue ha mi po, i be mɛ tue bue. 12Ke e ba mi ja a, nihi nɛ ngɛ Yuda ma amɛ a mi, kɛ Yerusalem ɔ ma ya fa kue ha mawu ɔmɛ nɛ a sãã tsopa kɛ e he via kɛ haa a. Se kikɛmɛ a mawu nɛ ɔmɛ be nyɛe ma he a yi wami ngɛ jamɛ a haomi be ɔ mi. 13Bɔ nɛ Yuda ma amɛ hiɛ ɔ, jã kɛ̃ a mawu ɔmɛ hu hiɛ. Bɔ sami la tɛhi nɛ Yerusalem bi ɔmɛ ma, nɛ a sãã tsopa kɛ e he via ngɛ a nɔ kɛ haa yakayaka mawu ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ Baal ɔ, jamɛ a bɔ sami la tɛ ɔmɛ a he hiɛ babauu kaa gbɛjegbɛhi nɛ ngɛ ma a mi ɔ kɛ̃. 14Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yeremia, ko kpa pɛɛ ha kikɛmɛ a ma nɛ ɔ; koo da a nane mi nɛ o kɛ fa kue ha mi. Ke amanehlu ba a nɔ nɛ a fa kue ha mi ɔ, i be mɛ tue bue.”
15Yawɛ ke, “Nimli nɛ i suɔ saminya a, yayami sɔuu lɛ a ngɛ pee. Anɛ a ngɛ he blɔ kaa a hii ye we ɔ mi lo? Anɛ a susu kaa ke a wo mi si babauu, nɛ a ngɔ lohwehi kɛ sã bɔ ha mi ɔ, haomi ko nɛ maa ba a nɔ ɔ, a kɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ a peemi maa tsi jamɛ a haomi ɔ nya lo? Ke e ba mi ja a, anɛ a ma na bua jɔmi lo? 16Sa a, bɔ nɛ i tsɛɔ mɛ ji, ‘Oliv tso kɛ e yi mi ba kusuu saminyayoo nɛ woɔ yiblii kpakpa;’ se ma mɛ e ba amɛ a he la, nɛ ma ku tso kɔni ɔmɛ kaa bɔ nɛ ahumi tsuɔ ní ɔ.
17“Imi, Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ, imi lɛ i to Israel kɛ Yuda si kaa bɔ nɛ a duɔ tso; se jehanɛ lɛɛ ma ha nɛ amanehlu maa ba a nɔ. Nɔ nɛ ɔ je mɛ nitsɛmɛ, ejakaa a pee yayami; a ya sã tsopa kɛ e he via kɛ ha Baal, nɛ a kɛ wo ye mi mi la.”
A so ngɔ wo Yeremia he
