Zedekia tsɔ atuã kɛ wo Babilonia matsɛ, Nebukadnezar. 4 Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, Zedekia yi nɔ jeha nɛ ji nɛɛ ɔ, nyɔhiɔ nɛ ji nyɔngma a we ligbi nɛ ji nyɔngma a nɔ ɔ, Babilonia matsɛ, Nebukadnezar kɛ e tabo ɔ tsuo ba tua Yerusalem. A sa ma a yi, nɛ a fia kpokuhi kɛ bɔle ma a kɛ kpe. 5A sa ma a yi hluu kɛ ya si Matsɛ Zedekia yi nɔ jeha nɛ ji nyɔngma kɛ kake ɔ. 6Nyɔhiɔ nɛ ji eywiɛ ɔ we ligbi nɛ ji nɛɛ ɔ, benɛ hwɔ ɔ nya ba wa, nɛ ma mi bi ɔmɛ na we ní nɛ a ye ɔ, 7 a hule gbogbo ɔ nɛ a fia kɛ wo ma a he ɔ. Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, Babilonia bi ɔmɛ bɔle ma a kɛ kpe mohu, se matsɛ ɔ, kɛ ta buli ɔmɛ tsuo tu fo nyɔ ɔ mi. A gu matsɛ abɔɔ ɔ mi kɛ ya be ngɛ agbo ɔ nɛ ngɛ gbogbo enyɔ ɔmɛ a kpɛti ɔ mi, nɛ a ngɔ a yi ngɔ ka Yordan kɔ̃ ɔ mi blɔ. 8Babilonia tabo ɔ nyɛɛ Zedekia se, nɛ a ya nu lɛ ngɛ Yeriko nga a nɔ; e ta buli ɔmɛ tsuo gbɛ fĩa kɛ je e he. 9A ngɔ Zedekia ya ha Matsɛ Nebukadnezar ngɛ Ribla, ngɛ Hamat zugba a nɔ; nɛ lejɛ ɔ Nebukadnezar kojo lɛ nɛ e bu lɛ fɔ ngɛ. 10Nebukadnezar gbe Zedekia binyumu ɔmɛ ngɛ Zedekia hɛ mi ngɛ Ribla. E gbe Yuda ma nimeli ɔmɛ tsuo hulɔ. 11 Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e ta Zedekia hɛngmɛhi; e bɔ lɛ pã, nɛ e ngɔ lɛ kɛ ya Babilon, nɛ e ya wo lɛ tsu. Zedekia hi tsu ɔ mi kɛ ya si e gbenɔ ligbi.
A puɛ Yawɛ we ɔ
(Matsɛmɛ II, 25.8-17)
12Babilonia matsɛ, Nebukadnezar yi nɔ jeha nyɔngma kɛ nɛɛ ɔ mi, nyɔhiɔ nɛ ji enuɔ ɔ we ligbi nɛ ji nyɔngma a nɔ ɔ, Nebukadnezar tatsɛ, kɛ tsɔlɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Nebuzaradan ɔ ya Yerusalem. 13 E sã Yawɛ we ɔ, matsɛ we ɔ, kɛ ni nguahi tsuo nɛ ngɛ Yerusalem ɔ a wehi, 14nɛ e ta buli ɔmɛ hule gbogbo nɛ a fia kɛ wo ma a he ɔ. 15Nihi nɛ piɛ ngɛ ma a mi, ni nɛmɛ nɛ ku nigii kɛ ho Babilonia matsɛ ɔ ngɔ ya, kɛ ga ní tsuli nɛ piɛ ɔ, Nebuzaradan ngɔ mɛ tsuo kɛ ho Babilonia ya. 16Se e si ohiatsɛmɛ komɛ nɛ nɔ́ ko be a dɛ ɔ ngɛ Yuda, konɛ a tsu ní ngɛ wai abɔɔ ɔmɛ a mi, kɛ ngmɔ ɔmɛ a nɔ.
17 Babilonia bi ɔmɛ ywia akɔblee titima amɛ nɛ ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ, kɛ akɔblee nyu nɔ́ agbo ɔ kɛ e sisi daka amɛ; nɛ a muɔ akɔblee ɔ tsuo kɛ ho Babilon ya. 18A muɔ buɛ ɔmɛ, sofi ɔmɛ, la gbemi ní ɔmɛ, tsopa kɛ e he via kã amɛ, kɛ akɔblee ní ɔmɛ nɛ a kɛ sɔmɔɔ ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ hulɔ kɛ ho. 19A muɔ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ a kɛ sika tsu, aloo sika hiɔ pee ɔ, kã wawi ɔmɛ, ngɛyu ɔmɛ, kã ngua amɛ, buɛ ɔmɛ, kane tso ɔmɛ, tsopa kɛ e he via kã amɛ, kɛ likɔkɔ ɔmɛ kɛ ho. 20Akɔblee níhi nɛ Matsɛ Salomo pee kɛ wo Yawɛ we ɔ nɛ ji titima enyɔ ɔmɛ, nyu nɔ́ agbo ɔ, kɛ na ku nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ nɛ nyu nɔ́ ɔ maa si ngɛ a nɔ ɔ, kɛ a sisi daka amɛ lɛɛ a nyɛ we nɛ a ngmɛ, ejakaa a jiɔ tsɔ. 21-22Titima enyɔ ɔmɛ tsuo sɔ fiee; kake kami ji gugue eywiɛ kɛ fa, nɛ kpa gugue etɛ maa kpe he. Puɔ ngɛ titima enyɔ ɔmɛ tsuo a mi, nɛ akɔblee nɛ a kɛ pee ɔ, e timi ji nine nguɛ eywiɛ. Akɔblee kpɔ ngɛ titima amɛ eko tsuaa eko yi mi. Kpɔ kake hiɔwe yami maa pee gugue kake kɛ fa, nɛ a kɛ akɔblee pee ya kɛ e mi níhi kaa tso yiblii nɛ ngɔɔ tsɔwitsɔwihi kɛ mimlaa akɔblee kpɔ ɔmɛ. 23Níhi kaa tso yiblii nɛ ngɔɔ tsɔwitsɔwihi nɛ ngɛ akɔblee ya a eko tsuaa eko mi ji lafa, se nyingmi nɛɛ kɛ ekpa ji nɔ́ nɛ o maa na ngɛ zugba.
A ngɔ Yuda bi ɔmɛ kɛ ho Babilonia ya
(Matsɛmɛ II, 25.18-21, 27-30)
24Nebuzaradan, tatsɛ ɔ ngɔ osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma Seraya e se yelɔ, osɔfo Zefania, kɛ Yawɛ we buli etɛ ɔmɛ hu nyɔguɛ. 25Jehanɛ, nihi nɛ e ngɔ kɛ je ma a mi ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ: asafoatsɛ ɔ nɛ hyɛɛ ta buli ɔmɛ a nɔ ɔ, matsɛ ga woli kpaago nɛ ngɛ ma a mi kɛ mwɔɔ ɔ, asafoatsɛ ɔ pɛdiyo ɔ nɛ buaa ma mi bi ɔmɛ a nya kɛ yaa ta a, kɛ ma mi bi kpahi nyingmi ekpa. 26Nebuzaradan ngɔ mɛ ya ha Babilonia matsɛ ɔ ngɛ Ribla. 27Babilonia matsɛ ɔ fia mɛ ní, nɛ e gbe mɛ ngɛ Ribla, ngɛ Hamat zugba a nɔ.
Bɔ nɛ a pee kɛ ngɔ Yuda bi ɔmɛ nyɔguɛ kɛ je a zugba a nɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. 28Nihi tsuo nɛ Nebukadnezar ngɔ nyɔguɛ kɛ ho ɔ, a hiɛmi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: benɛ e ye jeha kpaago ngɛ matsɛ sɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ, e ngɔ Yuda bi 3,023 kɛ ho; 29benɛ e ye jeha nyɔngma kɛ kpaanyɔ ngɛ matsɛ sɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ, e ngɔ nihi 832 kɛ je Yerusalem kɛ ho; 30jehanɛ, benɛ Nebukadnezar ye jeha nyingmi enyɔ kɛ etɛ ngɛ matsɛ sɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ, e tatsɛ Nebuzaradan ba ngɔ Yuda bi 745 nyɔguɛ kɛ ho. Ni ɔmɛ tsuo a hiɛmi ji 4,600.
31Jeha mi nɛ Evilmerodak ba bɔni matsɛ yemi ngɛ Babilonia ma a nɔ ɔ, e na Yuda matsɛ, Yehoyakin mɔbɔ, nɛ e je lɛ kɛ je tsu mi jamɛ a jeha a nɔuu. Nyɔhiɔ nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔ we ligbi nɛ ji nyingmi enyɔ kɛ enuɔ ɔ nɔ lɛ a ngmɛɛ Yehoyakin he ɔ nɛ. Jamɛ a be ɔ, Yehoyakin na jeha nyingmi etɛ kɛ kpaago momo ngɛ nyɔguɛ si himi mi. 32Evilmerodak kɛ Yehoyakin hi si saminya, nɛ e ha lɛ blɔ nya nɛ pe bɔ nɛ e pee matsɛmɛ kpa amɛ nɛ e ngɔ mɛ nyɔguɛ kɛ piɛ e he ngɛ Babilonia a. 33Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, a ngmɛ Yehoyakin blɔ nɛ e je pã mi tade ɔmɛ ngɛ e he ngɔ pue si, nɛ e ya yeɔ ní ngɛ matsɛ okplɔɔ he daa ligbi kɛ ya si e gbenɔ be. 34Jehanɛ se hu, matsɛ ɔ haa lɛ yemi kɛ buami sika ko daa ligbi kɛ ya si e gbenɔ be.

Title: KƆMƆ YEMI NYA TSƆƆMI
Content:
NYA TSƆƆMI
Kɔmɔ yemi lahi nɛ a po ngɛ asilɛ gbi mi enuɔ nɛ́ a bua nya lɛ ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ mi. A kpata Yerusalem hɛ mi jeha 586 loko a fɔ Kristo. A pee ma a butuu, nɛ nihi nɛ ngɛ ma a mi ɔ, a nuu mɛ kɛ ho ma se ya. Enɛ ɔmɛ a he kɔmɔ asilɛte ɔ ngɛ yee. E ngɛ mi kaa la amɛ ngɛ mɔbɔ lɛɛ, se wa naa ngɛ mi kaa a ngɔ hɛ kɛ fɔ Mawu nɔ kaa hwɔɔ se ko ɔ, níhi ma ba hi ha mɛ. Ngɛ Hebri ngmami ɔ mi ɔ, asilɛte ɔ bɔ mɔde ngɔ Hebri ningma okadi ɔmɛ setsɔ setsɔ kɛ je mi dlami tsuaa mi dlami sisi ngɛ kekleekle yi eywiɛ ɔmɛ a mi.
Daa jeha a, Yuda bi haa hwɔ kɛ yeɔ kɔmɔ nɛ a laa la nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ kaiɔ amanehlu nɛ ma a na a.
Bɔ nɛ a dla womi ɔ mi ha
A ye Yerusalem he kɔmɔ 1.1-22
A gbla Yerusalem tue 2.1-22
Tue gblami kɛ hɛ nɔ kami 3.1-66
A ywia Yerusalem ma a ngɔ pue si 4.1-22
Mɔbɔ nami he kue fami 5.1-22

Title: KƆMƆ YEMI 1
Content:
A ye Yerusalem he kɔmɔ
1Yerusalem, ma nɛ sa be ko ɔ,
nihi babauu ngɛ mi ɔ,
hyɛ bɔ nɛ e mi je gu kɛ fɔɔ si ha!
Be ko nɛ be ɔ, je ma amɛ buu lɛ ma nguaa,
se jehanɛ lɛɛ e ngɛ kaa yalɔyo.
Ma nɛ ngɛ kaa matsɛ biyo
ngɛ je ma amɛ tsuo a kpɛti ɔ
ba plɛ pee je ma amɛ a nyɔguɛ.
2Ya sɔuu e ngɛ foe nyɔnyɔɔnyɔ tsuo;
nɛ vo nyu ngɛ e hɛngmɛ mi jee
kɛ ngɛ si kplee.
E suɔli ɔmɛ hu a ti nɔ ko nɔ ko be
nɛ maa jɔɔ e bua.
E huɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsuo kpa ngɛ e se,
nɛ a ba pee e he nyɛli.
3Yuda bi ɔmɛ ba plɛ pee nyɔguɛhi;
pi a suɔmi nya
nɛ a ngɔ mɛ kɛ ho ma se ya a.
A ya je zugba kpahi a nɔ,
nɛ a he mi jɔɛ mɛ.
Benɛ a ngɛ aywilɛho yee ɔ,
a he nyɛli ɔmɛ tsuo ba sa a yi.
4Zion blɔ ɔ nɔ pee mɔbɔmɔbɔ.
Nimli a nane po ngɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ;
a bɛ nɛ a ba ye nyami be ɔmɛ.
Nɔ ko nɔ ko ba gui ma a agbo ɔmɛ a mi.
Osɔfo ɔmɛ ngɛ kɛmɛe.
Yihewi ɔmɛ ngɛ nɔ́ nae.
Zion hao wawɛɛ nitsɛ.
5E he nyɛli ɔmɛ ye kunimi;
a nine su e nɔ jehanɛ.
Yawɛ lɛ ha nɛ e ngɛ nɔ́ nae
ngɛ yayami babauu nɛ e pee ɔ he.
E he nyɛli ɔmɛ nuu e bimɛ ɔmɛ nyɔguɛ kɛ ho.
6Yerusalem he fɛu ɔ pee kaa blema nɔ́ ko nɛ be kɛkɛ.
E ma nimeli ɔmɛ ngɛ kaa batslɔɔhi
nɛ hwɔ ngɛ mɛ yee,
nɛ a pee wudɔwudɔ kɛ ngɛ fo tue
ngɛ de dali a nya.
7Benɛ Yerusalem ngɛ nɔ́ nae wawɛɛ ngɛ ma se ɔ,
e kai e blema si himi, kɛ ní kpakpahi tsuo nɛ e ná a.
Benɛ he nyɛli ɔmɛ a nine su e nɔ ɔ,
nɔ ko nɔ ko ba ji ngmlaa ha lɛ.
He nyɛli ɔmɛ ye e he fɛu,
nɛ a bɔ lɛ ahlua ngɛ si nɛ e nɔ ɔ he.
8Yerusalem pee yayami wawɛɛ
kɛ pue e hɛ mi si.
E pee kaa nɔ ko nɛ hɛɛ e he gu;
nihi tsuo nɛ peeɔ e he akɔtaa a
bui lɛ hu.
Ee, e ngɛ kɛmɛe,
nɛ e ngɛ e hɛ mi laae.
9Yerusalem he yayami ɔ ngɛ fu jee gbɛɛ;
se lɛ nitsɛ lɛɛ nɔ́ nɛ ma e nɔ ɔ
pee we lɛ kɔmɔ ko kulaa.
E si nɔmi ɔ nya wa;
nɔ ko nɔ ko be nɛ maa wo lɛ bua.
E jé ngmlaa ke, “Ao! Yawɛ, moo hyɛ
nɛ o na mi mɔbɔ,
ejakaa ye he nyɛli ɔmɛ ye kunimi!”
10E he nyɛli ɔmɛ kpɔ e june ní tsuo ngɛ e dɛ.
E ngɛ he nyɛli ɔmɛ hyɛe kikɛ nɛ ɔ
nɛ a bu kɛ sɛ sɔlemi we ɔ mi nitsɛnitsɛ.
He nɛ mlaa ngmɛ́ ma je li blɔ nɛ a ya a po,
a sɛ lejɛ ɔ.
11E we bi ɔmɛ ngɛ kɛmɛe
kɛ ngɛ nɔ́ ko hlae nɛ a ye.
A ngɔ a juetli ɔmɛ kɛ tsake niye ní,
konɛ a yi nɛ na wami.
Ma a ngɛ kue fae ke,
“Yawɛ, moo hyɛ nɛ o na mi mɔbɔ,
ejakaa ye he guɛ gbo!”
12Kɔmɔ nɛ ma a ngɛ yee kɛ ngmlaa boboobo
kɛ ngɛ nihi nɛ bee ɔ tsɔɔe ji,
“Nyɛ nihi tsuo nɛ nyɛ bee,
anɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ pee we nyɛ mɔbɔ lo?
Nyɛɛ hyɛ mi ha kaa nɔ ko ye aywilɛho hyɛ
kaa ye nɔ́ nɛ ɔ lo?
Benɛ Yawɛ mi mi fu wawɛɛ ɔ,
nɛ e ngɔ kikɛmɛ a haomi nɛ ɔ kɛ ba ye nɔ.”
13“Yawɛ ha la je hiɔwe
ba sɛ ye wuhi a mi.
E tsɔ mi klama, nɛ e ha i nɔ si;
kɛkɛ nɛ e kua mi,
nɛ i ngɛ aywilɛho yee daa.
14“E ngɔ ye he yayami ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ to,
nɛ e fi kaa tlomi;
kɛkɛ nɛ e ngɔ tloo mi.
E jiɔ tsɔ ha mi; e ngɛ mi gbee!
Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ngɔ mi kɛ wo he nyɛli
nɛ a he wa pe mi a dɛ mi,
nɛ peepee ko kulaa be ye he.
15“Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ kua ye ta buli katsɛmɛ ɔmɛ.
E tsɔ tabo ko kɛ ba
nɛ a ba kpata ye nihewi ɔmɛ a hɛ mi.
Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ naa Yuda nɛ ngɛ kaa yomiyo ɔ nɔ
kaa a ngaa wai ngɛ wai muɔ mi.
16“Enɛ ɔ he i wo yana,
nɛ vo nyu ngɛ ye hɛngmɛ mi jee
kɛ ngɛ si puee.
I be bua wolɔ ko
nɛ maa wo mi he wami.
Peepee ta ye bimɛ ɔmɛ a he,
ejakaa he nyɛlɔ ɔ ye ye nɔ kunimi.
17“Imi Zion, i wo ye nine nɔ, konɛ a ye bua mi,
se balɔ ko ba ji ngmlaa ha mi.
Yawɛ ha nɛ mahi nɛ bɔle imi Yakob,
ba pee ye he nyɛli.
Yerusalem ba pee nɔ́ nɛ a hiee.
18“Yawɛ nɔ́ da.
Ejakaa imi lɛ i tsɔ atuã, nɛ i bui e munyu ɔ;
se kɛ̃ ɔ, nyɛ nihi tsuo nyɛɛ bu mi tue,
konɛ amanehlu nɛ ba ye nɔ nɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ na.
A nuu ye nihewi ɔmɛ, kɛ yihewi ɔmɛ
nyɔguɛ kɛ ho.
19“I fɔ ye huɛmɛ ɔmɛ nine, konɛ a ba piɛ ye he,
se a sisi mi.
Benɛ ye osɔfo ɔmɛ, kɛ ma nimeli ɔmɛ tsuo
ho ma a mi ya ya ngɛ niye ní hlae nɛ a ye
nɛ a yi nɛ na wami ɔ,
kɛkɛ nɛ mɛ tsuo a hɛ mi kpata.
20“Yawɛ lee, hyɛ bɔ nɛ i ngɛ haoe ha;
i ngɛ he hiami mi wawɛɛ,
nɛ ye tsui ngɛ mi yee.
I tsɔ o hɛ mi atuã.
A ngɛ nihi gbee ngɛ gbɛjegbɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ;
jã kɛ̃ nihi ngɛ gboe ngɛ we ɔmɛ a mi hulɔ.
21“Bu ye kɛmɛmi ɔ tue;
nɔ ko be nɛ maa jɔɔ ye bua.
Haomi nɛ ba ye nɔ nɛ ɔ,
ye he nyɛli ɔmɛ tsuo nu he, nɛ a bua jɔ
kaa o ha sane nɛ ɔ ba ye nɔ.
Ligbi nɛ o to ha he nyɛli ɔmɛ ɔ, ha nɛ e ba esɔ,
konɛ mɛ hu a pee kaa bɔ nɛ i ngɛ nɛ ɔ.
22“Yayami tsuo nɛ a pee ɔ,
hyɛ nɛ o kɛ mɛ nɛ to ní ngɛ he
kaa bɔ nɛ o pee imi hu
ngɛ ye yayami ɔmɛ tsuo a he ɔ.
Ye kɛmɛmi ɔ nya ba wa tsɔ,
nɛ ye he wami ta.”

Title: KƆMƆ YEMI 2
Content:
Yawɛ gbla Yerusalem tue
1Benɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ mi mi wo la a,
e ha nɛ bɔku ha Zion nɔ.
E kpɔ́ Israel he fɛu ɔ kɛ je hiɔwe kɛ ba pue zugba.
Ligbi ɔ nɛ e mi mi fu ɔ,
e kua lɛ nitsɛ e we pohu.
2Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ kpata Israel ma amɛ tsuo a hɛ mi
nɛ e nɛ mɔbɔ kulaa.
E ngɔ e mi mi la a kɛ ywia Yuda ma a nya
mɔ ngua amɛ tsuo ngɔ pue si.
E ha zo gbe nɔ yemi ɔ, kɛ e mi matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ.
3Benɛ wa he nyɛli ɔmɛ ba tua wɔ ɔ,
e piɛ we wa he,
mohu ɔ, e kɛ hɛdɔ nɛ nya wa
ku Israel he wami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ nya la.
E gli kɛ wo wɔ kaa la nɛ ngɛ tsoe plamplam
kɛ ngɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ hɛ mi kpatae.
4E ngɔ e kɛ̃ɛ̃ mi bi ɔmɛ ngɔ ka wɔ
kaa wa he nyɛlɔ.
E gbe wa suɔli kpakpa amɛ tsuo.
E kɛ e mi mi la nɛ nya wa kaa la a
kple Yerusalem nɔ.
5Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ kpata Israel hɛ mi
kaa nɔ́ nɛ e he nyɛlɔ ji lɛ.
E ywia e mɔ ɔmɛ, kɛ matsɛ we ɔmɛ ngɔ pue si.
E ha nɛ Yuda ma a ngɛ kɔmɔ yee babauu.
6Mawu we ɔ, he nɛ wa jaa lɛ ngɛ ɔ,
e ywia lɛ dukuduku ngɔ pue si.
E gu nyami be ɔmɛ, kɛ Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ.
Abofu nɛ nya wa nɛ ɔ sa matsɛmɛ, kɛ osɔfohi tsuo a he.
7Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ sume e bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ hu,
nɛ e kua sɔlemi we ɔ.
E ha he nyɛli ku mɔ ɔmɛ kɛ pue si.
A hwɔ lele ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ mi
kaa bɔ nɛ wa peeɔ
ke wa ngɛ nyami ligbi yee ɔ.
8Yawɛ to e yi mi kaa
a ku Zion gbogbo ɔmɛ ngɔ pue si.
E susu a kami kɛ blimi kɛ to,
bɔ nɛ pee nɛ a kpata nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ.
Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, mɔ ɔmɛ, kɛ gbogbo ɔmɛ tsuo
ku kɛ pueɔ si.
9Zu ha agbo ɔmɛ a nɔ;
a ku a se lami ní ɔmɛ a mi dukuduku.
A nuu matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ ganɔ ɔmɛ
kɛ ho ma se ya.
Nɔ ko tsɔɔ we mlaa a hu.
Yawɛ je we nina kɛ ha we gbali ɔmɛ hu.
10Yerusalem nimeli ɔmɛ hii si dii ngɛ zugba.
A ngɔ bunyuku ngɔ pue a yi mi,
nɛ a ha kpekpe ya bo
kɛ tsɔɔ kaa a pia a he.
Yihewi ɔmɛ ngɔ a hɛ mi kɛ bu si.
11I fo ya hluu, nɛ ye hɛngmɛ tsuo fuu.
I ngɛ he hiami mi wawɛɛ.
Ye tsui ngɛ mi yee,
ejakaa a ywia ye we bi ɔmɛ a ma a.
Jokuɛwi kɛ bimwɔwi ngɛ hɛlie
ngɛ gbɛjegbɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ ngɛ ma a mi.
12Benɛ a ngɛ awe nyae,
nɛ a ngɛ a nyɛmɛ bie ke,
“Jije wa ma na abolo ngɛ;
jije wa ma na wai ngɛ ɔ” ɔ,
a hɛliɔ kaa nihi nɛ plaa
ngɛ ma a mi gbɛjegbɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ;
nɛ a gboɔ ngɛ
a nyɛmɛ a gugue mi.
13Yerusalem, i suɔ mo!
Yerusalem, mɛni ma de ha mo?
Kɛ ma pee kɛ jɔɔ o bua kɛɛ?
Nɔ ko nɔ ko nɛ́ amanehlu hyɛ
kaa nɔ́ nɛ ba o nɔ nɛ ɔ.
O haomi ɔ kle tsɔ, nɛ e nyagbe be.
Mɛnɔ ma he o yi wami?
14O gbali ɔmɛ be nɔ́ kpakpa ko nɛ a ma de mo;
lakpa pɛ a yeɔ mo.
A fiɛɔ kɛ sisiɔ mo.
A je we o tɔmi kpo kɛ tsɔɔ mo.
A ha nɛ o susu kaa
e hia we nɛ o tsake o tsui.
15Nihi tsuo nɛ ba guu ma a nya kɛ bee ɔ,
hwɔɔ o yi; a huanyaa a yi,
nɛ a yeɔ o he fɛu.
A deɔ ke, “Jamɛ a ma kɛ e he fɛu ɔ ji nɛ ɔ?
Je ɔ tsuo fiami nɔ́ ɔ ji nɛ ɔ lo?”
16O he nyɛli ɔmɛ tsuo ngɛ munyu tue kɛ ngɛ mo sie;
a kɛ ninyɛ hyɛɛ mo gãã.
A kpɔɔ nya kɛ woɔ mo.
A deɔ ke, “E tsɔɔ mo!
Mwɔnɛ ji mwɔnɛ!
Wa nine su o nɔ jehanɛ!”
17Nɔ́ ko nɛ Yawɛ de ke e maa pee ɔ,
amlɔ nɛ ɔ, e pee.
Yawɛ kpata wa hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ
kaa bɔ nɛ e de to be ko ke e maa pee ɔ.
E ha nɛ wa he nyɛli ɔmɛ ye wa nɔ,
nɛ a bua jɔ a he
kaa wa hɛ mi kpata.
18Yerusalem lee, moo fa kue boboobo
nɛ o tsɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ!
Ha nɛ o vo nyu ɔmɛ nɛ a hi bee
kaa pa nyɔ kɛ pia.
Koo jɔɔ ya fomi, nɛ ko kpa kɔmɔ yemi hulɔ.
19Tee si nɛ o nya awe nyɔnyɔɔnyɔ ha Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ.
Moo fa kue ha lɛ kɛ o tsui tsuo,
nɛ o kpa lɛ pɛɛ nɛ e na o bimɛ ɔmɛ mɔbɔ.
Hyɛ kaa hwɔ ngɛ jokuɛwi gbee
ngɛ gbɛjegbɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a nɔ ngɛ he tsuaa he.
20Yawɛ lee, hyɛ koo!
Moo hyɛ nihi nɛ o ngɛ mɛ yi mi wae ɔ!
Yihi ngɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a muklii mi bimɛ
nɛ a suɔ ɔ yee!
Mawu we ɔ nitsɛnitsɛ mi po
a ngɛ osɔfohi, kɛ gbalihi gbee!
21Jokuɛwi kɛ nikɔtɔmahi tsuo gbo kɛ pueɔ si
ngɛ gbɛjegbɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ.
He nyɛli ɔmɛ kɛ klaate gbe nihewi, kɛ yihewi.
Ligbi ɔ nɛ o mi mi wo la a,
o gbe mɛ tsuo basabasa
nɛ o nɛ́ mɔbɔ kulaa.
22O kpee ye he nyɛli ɔmɛ kɛ ba
nɛ a ba bɔle mi
kaa nɔ́ nɛ a ngɛ nyami ligbi yee.
Ligbi ɔ nɛ o mi mi wo la a,
nɔ ko nɔ ko nyɛ we nɛ e ye e he.
Ye bimɛ nɛ i lɛ,
nɛ i suɔ mɛ ɔ,
he nyɛli ɔmɛ gbe mɛ tsuo.

Title: KƆMƆ YEMI 3
Content:
Tue gblami, tsui tsakemi, kɛ hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi
1Ke a ke Mawu gbla nɔ ko tue ɔ,
imi lɛɛ i le nɔ́ nɛ ji.
2E tsɛ̃ mi ngɔ wo diblii kpii mi,
nɛ la ko la ko be lejɛ ɔ.
3E fiaa mi ní wawɛɛ nɔtonɔto ligbi mluku ɔ tsuo.
4E ha nɛ i ta he lo,
nɛ ye he womi pee nyamanyama,
nɛ e ku ye wuhi a mi.
5Nɔ́ nami, kɛ aywilɛho sa ye yi
kaa nɔ́ nɛ pe a wo mi tsu.
6E ha nɛ i hi diblii kpii mi
kaa nihi nɛ gbo blema a a ti nɔ ko.
7E bɔ mi pã;
e po piɛ kɛ wo ye he,
konɛ ma ko na blɔ nɛ ma tu fo kɛ je.
8I kpa ngmlaa kɛ tsɛ Mawu,
konɛ e ba je mi,
se e bui mi tue.
9E ngɔ tɛ agbohi kɛ fɔ blɔ mi ha mi,
nɛ e ha nɛ ye blɔ ɔ kpɛ̃.
10E pee kaa osisiblisi nɛ wo ka,
loo jata nɛ laa e he, konɛ e nu mi.
11E ha nɛ i tla blɔ,
nɛ e tsɔtslɔɔ ye mi;
e pee mi posoposo.
12E gbla e kɛ̃ɛ̃ ɔ mi,
nɛ e ngɔ e kɛ̃ɛ̃ mi bi ɔ ngɔ ka mi.
13E tsɛ̃ e kɛ̃ɛ̃ mi bi ɔmɛ
kɛ ba sɛ ye wuhi a mi tɔɔ.
14I plɛ pee muɔ nɔ́ ha nihi tsuo.
Be tsuaa be ɔ, imi ji a nya mi la
nɛ a ngɛ lae.
15E ha nɛ i na amanehlu nɛ nya wa.
Ye we amanehlu ɔ ngɛ kaa agba ngɛ ye nya mi.
16E ha nɛ i kokloo si ngɛ zugba,
nɛ ye lungu kli kaa nɔ nɛ kpe tɛ ngmlitsa.
17I li nɔ́ nɛ a tsɛɛ tue mi jɔmi ɔ,
jehanɛ lɛɛ ye hɛ je bua jɔmi po nɔ.
18Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i de ke, “Akuanyɛ!
Ye he wami, kɛ ye hɛ nɛ i ngɔ kɛ fɔ
Yawɛ nɔ ɔ se po.”
19Ye we amanehlu, kɛ hi he ko nɛ be ye dɛ ɔ,
ke i kai ɔ,
e ngɛ kaa agba, loo duɔ nɛ nya wa ha mi.
20Be tsuaa be nɛ i ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ he susue ɔ,
e haa nɛ ye he mi jɔ̃ɔ̃.
21Se nɔ́ nɛ ke i kai
nɛ ye nɔ gbagba tee ji,
22kaa Yawɛ suɔmi se pui gblegbleegble;
e naa mɔbɔ daa.
23Ní nɛ ɔmɛ peeɔ ehe daa mɔtu.
Yawɛ we anɔkuale yemi ɔ kle.
24Yawɛ ji ye nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́;
lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i ngɔ ye hɛ kɛ fɔ e nɔ.
25Yawɛ mi mi hi ha nihi tsuo
nɛ ngɔɔ a hɛ kɛ fɔɔ e nɔ ɔ,
nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ hlaa Yawɛ se blɔ ɔ;
e peeɔ lɛ kpakpa.
26Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e sa kaa waa to wa tsui si
kɛ hyɛ Yawɛ blɔ,
konɛ e he wa yi wami.
27Wa nihe mi ji be nɛ sa kaa
waa kase tsui si tomi nɛ ɔ.
28Ke wa ngɛ amanehlu nae ɔ,
e sa kaa waa pee dii,
nɛ waa to wa tsui si.
29Waa ba wa he si,
ejakaa ke wa pee ja a,
e be yaka pee.
30Ke a ngɛ wɔ ní fiae,
loo a ngɛ wa hɛ mi si puee ɔ,
wa ha nɛ a pee kɛkɛ.
31Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ be wɔ kuae kɛ ya neneene.
32Eko ɔ, e ma ha nɛ wa maa ye aywilɛho lɛɛ,
se kɛ̃, e maa na wɔ mɔbɔ,
ejakaa e suɔmi ɔ kle,
nɛ e ngɛ daa.
33E pee we lɛ bua jɔmi
kaa e ma ha nɛ waa ye aywilɛho,
loo waa na amanehlu.
34Ke a wo wɔ tsu,
nɛ wa mumi nya ngɛ tae ɔ,
Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ le.
35Blɔ nya nɛ Hiɔwe No ɔ ha wɔ ɔ,
ke a he ngɛ wa dɛ ɔ,
e le.
36Ke a yi dami sane ngɛ sane yemi he ɔ,
Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ le.
37Ke pi Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ he wami nya a,
mɛnɔ ma nyɛ ma de nɔ́ ko
nɛ e ba mi?
38Kpakpa jio, yaya jio,
Hiɔwe No ɔ lɛ deɔ loko e baa mi.
39Nimli adesahi kɛkɛ ji wɔ.
Ke wa pee yayami
nɛ a gbla wa tue ɔ,
mɛni he je wa hii wa nya jee ɔ?
40Nyɛ ha nɛ waa hyɛ wa je mi bami mi
saminya, nɛ waa kpale kɛ ba Yawɛ ngɔ.
41Nyɛ ha nɛ wa wo wa nine nɔ nɛ waa fa kue kɛ je wa tsui mi tɔɔ
kɛ ha Mawu nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ ke,
42“Wa tɔ̃; wa tsɔ atuã,
lɔ ɔ he nɛ mo Yawɛ,
o kɛ wa yayami ɔmɛ pɛ wɔ ɔ nɛ.
43“O kɛ abofu nɛ nya wa nyɛɛ wa se,
nɛ o ba gbe wɔ;
o nɛ wɔ mɔbɔ kulaa.
44O we abofu nɛ nya wa nɛ ɔ
ngɛ kaa bɔku nɛ mi ti
nɛ o kɛ ha o he.
Enɛ ɔ he ɔ, ke wa fa kue ha mo ɔ,
e sui o ngɔ.
45O ha nɛ wa plɛ nɔ́ nɛ a hiee, kɛ dwɔmi
ha je ma amɛ tsuo.
46“Wa he nyɛli ɔmɛ tsuo ngɛ munyu tue
kɛ ngɛ wɔ sie.
47Wa hao, nɛ wa nu sawale.
Wa na amanehlu,
nɛ a kpata wa hɛ mi.
48Vo nyu ngɛ ye hɛngmɛ mi jee kɛ ngɛ si puee
kaa pa nɛ hia kɛ bee;
ejakaa a kpata ye ma a hɛ mi.
49“Ma fo ya,
nɛ ye vo nyu ɔ se be poe gblegbleegble;
50ma pee jã kɛ yaa si
Yawɛ nitsɛ maa na kɛ je hiɔwe.
51Ke i hyɛ nɔ́ nɛ ba yihewi ɔmɛ a nɔ ngɛ ma a mi ɔ,
i haoɔ wawɛɛ.
52“Ye he nyɛli nɛ nyɛɛ mi yaka a
tsɔ mi klama, nɛ i du.
53A sake mi ngɔ fɔ muɔ mi hɛ ngmengmle,
nɛ a ngɔ tɛ kɛ tsi ye yi.
54I ho nyu sisi ya,
nɛ i de ke, ‘Ye yi ta pɛ!’
55“I fa kue ha mo, Yawɛ
kɛ je muɔ ɔ sisi tɔɔ.
56Kue nɛ i fa nɛ o nu ji,
‘I kpa mo pɛɛ nɛ o ba piɛ ye he;
koo tsi o tue.’
57Benɛ i tsɛ mo ɔ, o he nɔ,
nɛ o de mi ke ma ko ye gbeye.
58“Nyɔmtsɛ, mo lɛ o je ngmlaa ha mi.
Mo lɛ o he ye yi wami.
59Yawɛ, moo ye ye sane ɔ ha mi;
yayami tsuo nɛ a pee mi ɔ, o le.
60O le bɔ nɛ ye he nyɛli ɔmɛ sume ye sane ha.
O le bɔ nɛ a so ye yi nɔ.
61“Yawɛ, ahlua nɛ a bɔ mi ɔ, o nu.
Yi mi yaya tsuo nɛ a to kɛ wo ye he ɔ, o le.
62Be tsuaa be ɔ, ye he munyu yaya sɔuu a ngɛ tue.
Jã kɛ̃ a ngɛ a ga yaya amɛ toe.
63Hyɛ! A ngɛ sihi he jio, a ngɛ si dami nya jio,
ye he fɛu sɔuu a ngɛ yee;
a ngɔ mi ngɔ pee a nya mi la.
64“Yawɛ lee, gbla a tue
ngɛ níhi nɛ a pee ɔ a he.
65Moo gbiɛ mɛ, nɛ o ha
a tsui nɛ ye mɛ
66Yawɛ lee, o kɛ mi mi la
nɛ nyɛɛ a se gidigidi,
nɛ o kpata a hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ
ngɛ je ɔ mi!”

Title: KƆMƆ YEMI 4
Content:
Yerusalem, ngɛ e tue gblami ɔ se
1Hyɛ bɔ nɛ wa sika tsu ɔ pee tuu ha!
Hyɛ bɔ nɛ sika tsu ngmingmiingmi ɔ tsake ha.
Mawu we ɔ tɛ ɔmɛ gbɛ fĩa gbɛjegbɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ tsuo.
2Zion nihewi nɛ a he jua wa ha wɔ
kaa sika tsu saminya a,
hyɛ, jehanɛ lɛɛ a buu mɛ kaa zu kplu gu
komɛ kɛkɛ nɛ buɛ puɛlɔ puɛ.
3Nga mi gbe po haa e bimɛ nyɔ
nɛ a pupɔɔ,
se ye ma a lɛɛ a yi mi wa;
a ngɛ kaa dugumahi
ngɛ nga nɔ.
4Kuma gbe bimwɔwi;
a ngɛ a nya mi lɔe kɛ ngɛ nyu hlae.
Jokuɛwi ngɛ pɛɛ kpae
ke a ha mɛ niye ní;
se nɔ ko nɔ ko ha we mɛ.
5Nihi nɛ ye ní kpakpahi be ko nɛ be ɔ,
amlɔ nɛ ɔ, a hɛ mi kpata
ngɛ gbɛjegbɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ.
Nihi nɛ a lɛ mɛ ngɛ he kpakpahi be ko nɛ be ɔ,
amlɔ nɛ ɔ, a ngɛ si kukuɔe ngɛ kuku nɔ.
6 A gbla ye ma a tue wawɛɛ pe Sodom.
Sodom lɛɛ e tue gblami ɔ ba ngɛ hɛngmɛfia mi,
nɛ adesa nine be mi.
7Sa a, wa ganɔ ɔmɛ ngɛ nyaii,
nɛ a he tsɔ pe sinoo.
A hiɛɛ pe nyɔ nyu po.
A ngɛ he wami saminya kaa kora tɛ;
a yi bwɔmi ngɛ kaa safiro.
8Se jehanɛ lɛɛ, a hɛ mi yuɔ pe kutu sisi.
A yo we mɛ ngɛ gbɛjegbɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ.
A ta he lo; a je wu,
nɛ a pee kaa tso gbigbli.
9Nihi nɛ a kɛ klaate gbe mɛ ɔ, a nɔ́ hi kulaa
pe nihi nɛ hwɔ gbe mɛ ɔ;
sekpɛtsɛmɛ ɔmɛ lɛɛ hwɔ ye mɛ bluu kɛ ya si
hwɔ ɔ gbe mɛ kakaaka.
10 Ye ma a hɛ mi kpatami ɔ ngɛ gbeye.
Binyɛmɛ nɛ suɔ a bimɛ kaa nɔ́ ko po,
hoo mɛ nitsɛmɛ a bimɛ
kaa niye ní nɛ a ye.
11Yawɛ mi mi fu wawɛɛ nitsɛ;
e je e we abofu ɔ kpo;
e mɛ Zion he la,
nɛ e sã ma a sisi tomi ɔ pɛsɛpɛsɛ.
12Je ma amɛ, kɛ a matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsuo
a ti nɔ ko nɔ ko he we yi
kaa he nyɛlɔ ko ma nyɛ ma tua Yerusalem,
nɛ e ma nyɛ sɛ ma a
agbo ɔmɛ a mi.
13Se e ba mi ja,
ejakaa gbali ɔmɛ, kɛ osɔfo ɔmɛ pee yayami;
a pue nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ nɛ da
ngɛ ma a mi ɔ a muɔ si.
14A hii nyɛɛe kɛ hii yae kɛ hii bae
ngɛ gbɛjegbɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ
kaa hɛ yuyuili.
A kɛ muɔ ble a he,
lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ ko nɔ ko nyɛ we
nɛ e ta a tade ɔmɛ a he.
15Nihi kpaa ngmlaa kɛ woɔ mɛ,
nɛ a deɔ ke,
“Nyɛɛ je hiɛ ɔ! Nyɛ nɛ nyɛ ble nyɛ he!
Nyɛ ko ta wa he!”
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a wo lalaalo
kɛ kpa ma amɛ tsuo a nɔ,
se ma ko ma ko he we mɛ.
16Yawɛ hyɛ we a nɔ hu.
Yawɛ nitsɛ nɛ e gbɛ mɛ ngɔ fĩa.
E pee we osɔfo ɔmɛ a he akɔtaa hu,
nɛ wa ma nimeli ɔmɛ hu,
e nɛ mɛ mɔbɔ.
17Wa hyɛ yemi kɛ buami blɔ hluu
kɛ ya si pɔ tɔ wa hɛngmɛ he,
nɛ e ko hu bɛ.
Wa mlɛ kaa je ma ko maa je ngmlaa ha wɔ lo,
se lɛ tsuo pee yaka;
nɔ ko nɔ ko bɛ nɛ e ba je ngmlaa ha wɔ.
18He nyɛlɔ ɔ ngɛ wa nane hiɔe,
lɔ ɔ he ɔ, wa nyɛ we nɛ waa nyɛɛ kɛ be ngɛ
wa gbɛjegbɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ tete po.
Wa nyagbe ɔ su jehanɛ;
wa ligbi ɔmɛ a nya ta;
wa hɛ mi kpata.
19He nyɛli ɔmɛ nyɛɛ wa se kɛ fo.
A he sɔɔ pe kɔlehi ngɛ kɔɔhiɔ mi.
A nyɛɛ wa se kɛ gu yo ɔmɛ a nɔ,
nɛ a wo wɔ ka
ngɛ nga kplanaa a nɔ.
20Wa matsɛ ɔ nɛ Yawɛ nitsɛ hla lɛ,
nɛ woɔ wɔ he wami,
nɛ wa ngɔ wa hɛ kɛ fɔ e nɔ
kaa e ma ba kpɔ wɔ
kɛ je he nyɛli ɔmɛ a dɛ mi ɔ
sɛ a kpa mi, nɛ a nu lɛ.
21Nyɛ Edom bi nɛ ngɛ Uz zugba a nɔ,
nyɛ nya, nɛ nyɛ bua nɛ jɔ nyɛ he
bɔ nɛ nyɛ ma nyɛ.
Se mohu nyɛ na nɛ nyɛɛ le kaa
nyɛ hu a maa gbla nyɛ tue.
Nyɛ maa hɛɛ nyɛ he gu,
nɛ nyɛ maa hi nyɛɛe kɛ zo
kaa nihi nɛ tɔ dã.
22A wo Zion he yayami ɔmɛ a he hiɔ ta,
lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yawɛ be hae
nɛ a ye wɔ nyɔguɛ ngɛ ma se hu.
Se mo Edom lɛɛ Yawɛ maa gbla o tue;
e ma ha o he yayami ɔmɛ
maa je kpo paa nɛ a na.

Title: KƆMƆ YEMI 5
Content:
Mɔbɔ nami he kue fami
1Yawɛ lee, mo kai amanehlu nɛ wa na a;
moo hyɛ bɔ nɛ zo gbe wɔ ha.
2Wa weto ní plɛ pee nibwɔhi a nɔ́.
Wa we ɔmɛ hu ma se li lɛ ngɛ a mi.
3Wa pee awusa bimɛ; wa tsɛmɛ be je mi,
nɛ wa nyɛmɛ pee yalɔyihi.
4Nyu nɛ wa nuu ɔ po
e hia kaa waa wo he hiɔ;
nɛ lɛ́ nɛ wa ma slɛ hu
ja wa he kɛ sika.
5A woɔ wɔ kuɛ pã tso,
nɛ a haa wa tsuɔ ní kpakpataa;
nɛ ke pɔ tɔ wɔ ɔ,
a ha we nɛ wa jɔɔ wa he.
6Wa ngɔ wa he ya bɔ Egipt, kɛ Asiria bi a he,
konɛ wa ná ngma nɛ waa
ye nɛ waa tɔ.
7Wa nɛmɛ ɔmɛ pee yayami,
se amlɔ nɛ ɔ, a be je mi,
nɛ wa ba ngɛ nɔ́ nae
ngɛ a yayami ɔmɛ a he.
8Nyɔguɛhi lɛ a ngɛ wa nɔ yee;
nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be
nɛ ma kpɔ wɔ kɛ je a dɛ mi.
9Wa hɛɛ wa wami ngɛ wa nguɛ nya
kɛ ngɛ wa nya mi ngma hlae kɛ bee;
ejakaa awi yeli ngɛ zugba a tsuo nɔ kpae.
10Hwɔ nɛ nya wa ha nɛ wa he womi kota
kaa nɔ́ nɛ flɔɔnɔɔ la nɛ sã wɔ.
11A nuu wa yi ɔmɛ ngɛ Zion;
nɛ a nuu wa bimɛ yihewi ɔmɛ hu ngɛ Yuda ma amɛ a mi,
nɛ a pee mɛ basabasa.
12A nuu wa ganɔ ɔmɛ nɛ a sɛu mɛ.
Wa ma nimeli ɔmɛ hu a bui mɛ fɛɛ.
13A nyɛɔ wa nihewi ɔmɛ a nɔ kaa nyɔguɛhi
nɛ a gblɛ ngma.
Wa binyumuwi ɔmɛ tlooɔ lɛ́ nɛ jiɔ,
nɛ a hii si nɔe ngɛ sisi.
14Nimowihi hí si ngɛ ma agbo nya hu,
nɛ nihewi fiɛ we do hu.
15Bua jɔmi ko be ha wɔ ngɛ je mi hu;
wa kpa domi nɛ wa ngɛ kɔmɔ yee.
16Jlasi je wa yi nɔ si.
Wa pee yayami, nɛ amlɔ nɛ ɔ,
musu tloo wɔ.
17Enɛ ɔ ha nɛ wa ngɛ wa tsui yee wawɛɛ,
nɛ wa vo nyu ɔ ha we nɛ waa hyɛ nɔ́
kpakpa ko hu;
18ejakaa Zion Yo ɔ nɔ je gu kɛ fɔɔ si,
nɛ nga mi gbehi ngɛ ma a mi
ní kokoe ɔmɛ a mi kpae.
19Se mo Yawɛ, mo ji matsɛ
kɛ yaa neneene;
yi nɔhi tsuo o maa ye tsɛ.
20Mɛni he je o hɛ je wa nɔ pɛsɛpɛsɛ ɔ?
Mɛni he je o ngmɛɛ wa he
be babauu nɛ ɔ?
21Yawɛ, moo kpale wɔ kɛ ba o ngɔ ekohu!
Yawɛ, kpale wɔ kɛ da wa da he ekohu!
Ngɔɔ wa blema hɛ mi nyami ɔ
kɛ ha wɔ ekohu.
22Aloo pe o kua wɔ kulaa?
Anɛ o we abofu ɔ nyagbe be lo?

Title: EZEKIEL NYA TSƆƆMI
Content:
NYA TSƆƆMI
Israel bi ɔmɛ a he nyɛli ba tua Yerusalem jeha 586 loko a fɔ Kristo nɛ a nuu Israel bi ɔmɛ kɛ ho ma se tsitsaa Babilonia ya. Gbalɔ ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Ezekiel piɛ a he. E fiɛ kɛ ha ni nɛmɛ nɛ a nuu kɛ ho ma se ya a, kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ Yerusalem jamɛ a be ɔ tsuo. Womi nɛ ɔ hɛɛ mi dlami ekpa: (1) Mawu tsɛ Ezekiel kaa e ba pee gbalɔ. (2) Gbalɔ ɔ bɔ ma a kɔkɔ ke Mawu maa gbla a tue; Yerusalem he wami nya maa hɛ si, nɛ a ma kpata ma a hɛ mi. (3) Sɛ gbihi nɛ je Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ngɔ kaa je ma amɛ tsuo nɛ wa e ma a yi mi, nɛ a ha e ma a tla blɔ ɔ, e maa gbla a tue. (4) Mawu wo e ma a si kaa e ma ba hi ha mɛ hwɔɔ se. (5) A gba kɛ si Gog. (6) Gbalɔ Ezekiel kale bɔ nɛ Yawɛ we ɔ, kɛ ma a ma ba bɔ hwɔɔ se.
Gbalɔ Ezekiel ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi nɛ nya wa; nɛ e ngɛ juɛmi nɛ nyɛɔ peeɔ foni ngɛ e yi mi saminya hulɔ. Bɔ nɛ pee nɛ́ a nu ninahi babauu nɛ e na a a sisi ɔ, e gu foni kalemi nɔ kɛ de e sɛ gbi ɔmɛ. Ezekiel ma nɔ mi ke e hia kaa nɔ tsuaa nɔ tsui mi nɛ tsɔ, nɛ e ná mumi he. E de hu ke nɔ tsuaa nɔ maa bu lɛ nitsɛ e yayamihi nɛ e pee ɔ a he akɔtaa. E fiɛ ke hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi ngɛ kaa ma a maa bɔ ekohu. Akɛnɛ osɔfo kɛ gbalɔ ji lɛ he je ɔ, níhi nɛ ngɛ e tsui nɔ wawɛɛ nitsɛ ji Yawɛ we ɔ, kɛ bɔ nɛ sa kaa a pee klɔuklɔu.
Bɔ nɛ a dla womi ɔ mi ha
Mawu tsɛ Ezekiel 1.1—3.27
Sɛ gbihi nɛ tsɔɔ tue gblami nɛ maa ba Yerusalem nɔ 4.1—24.27
Mawu maa gbla je ma amɛ a tue 25.1—32.32
Mawu wo e ma a si 33.1—37.28
A gba kɛ si Gog 38.1—39.29
Yawɛ we he ɔ, kɛ zugba he ɔ a he nina 40.1—48.35

Title: EZEKIEL 1
Content:
KEKLEEKLE NINA NƐ EZEKIEL NA NGƐ MAWU HE
(1.1—7.27)
Mawu matsɛ sɛ
1 Jeha nyingmi etɛne ɔ we nyɔhiɔ eywiɛne ɔ we ligbi enuɔne ɔ, imi osɔfo Ezekiel, Buzi bi ɔ, i kɛ Yuda bi ɔmɛ nɛ a nuu kɛ ho ma se ya a, wa ngɛ Kebar pa a nya ngɛ Babilonia. Hiɔwe nya bli, nɛ i na Mawu he ninahi. 2 Benɛ a nu Matsɛ Yehoyakin kɛ ho ma se ya a se jeha enuɔne ɔ we ligbi enuɔne ɔ, 3Yawɛ tu munyu, nɛ i nu. Yawɛ he wami ba ye nɔ ngɛ Kebar pa a nya ngɛ Babilonia.
4Ma wo ye yi nɔ ɔ, o nɛ ahumi nguaa ko nɛ hia kɛ je omleyi je kɛ ma. Oslabai ngɛ gbae nɔtonɔto kɛ ngɛ bɔku agbo ko mi jee. Hiɔwe ɔ nɛ bɔle bɔku ɔ tsuo ngɛ la pãe nylamnylam; nɔ́ ko ngɛ kpɛe kaa akɔblee ngɛ la a mi. 5 I na nɔ́ ko kaa hɛ kali eywiɛ ngɛ ahumi ɔ kpɛti; a ngɛ kaa nimli adesahi; 6se a ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ ngɛ hɛ mi eywiɛ kɛ pɛli eywiɛ. 7A nanehi ngɛ tlɔmɔtlɔmɔ, nɛ a nane si ngɛ kaa na nane si; nɛ a he ngɛ kpɛe hleii kaa akɔblee nɛ́ a sa he. 8Nɔmlɔ ninehi ngɛ a pɛli ɔmɛ a sisi kakaaka. 9A pɛli ɔmɛ tsa a sibi a nya, nɛ ke a ngɛ nyɛɛe ɔ, a plɛ we a he: a ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ yaa e hɛ mi tɛɛ.
10 Hɛ kali eywiɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ hɛ mi slɔɔtoslɔɔto eywiɛɛywiɛ. Bɔ nɛ a hɛ mi ɔmɛ ngɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: nɔmlɔ hɛ mi ngɛ hɛ mi, jata hɛ mi ngɛ hiɔ nɔ, na hɛ mi ngɛ muɔ nɔ, nɛ kɔle hɛ mi ngɛ se je. 11A gbɛ a pɛli ɔmɛ a mi; a wo enyɔɔnyɔ nɔ ya bua nya ngɛ hiɔwe, nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɔ́ kɛ nɔ nɛ ngɛ e kasa nya a nɔ́ tsa; nɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ nɛ piɛ ɔ, a kɛ ha a nɔmlɔ tso ɔmɛ a he. 12Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nyɛɛɔ kɛ yaa e hɛ kpɛ tɛɛ; he tsuaa he nɛ mumi ɔ suɔ kaa a ya a, mɛ tsuo a yaa kutuu nɛ́ a plɛ we a he.
13Nɔ́ ko ngɛ hɛ kali ɔmɛ a kpɛti jee kaa la ngu nɛ ngɛ tsoe. E ngɛ pãe kaa jatɛ kɛ nyɛɛ hɛ kali ɔmɛ a kpɛti kɛ ngɛ yae kɛ ngɛ bae. La a ngɛ kpɛe, nɛ oslabai ngɛ gbae kɛ ngɛ mi jee. 14Hɛ kali ɔmɛ saa fo kɛ yaa kɛ baa kaa oslabai nɛ ngɛ gbae.
15 Benɛ i ngɛ hɛ kali ɔmɛ hyɛe ɔ, tlɔɔke nane eywiɛ ba ma si ngɛ a kasa nya kakaaka. 16Tlɔɔke nane eywiɛ nɛ ɔmɛ je a sibi, nɛ a ngɛ kpɛe saminya kaa tɛ nɛ he jua wa. Bɔ nɛ a pee mɛ ɔ, tlɔɔke nane kpa hɔɔ si ngɛ eko tsuaa eko mi. 17Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, tlɔɔke nane ɔmɛ tsuo nyɛɔ yaa hɛ mi, se je, hiɔ nɔ, loo muɔ nɔ nɛ a plɛ we a he; mɛ tsuo a nyɛɛɔ fiee. 18 Gahi nɛ a ka nɛ a he ngɛ gbeye ngɛ tlɔɔke nane eywiɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a mi, nɛ hɛngmɛhi bɔle ga amɛ a he tsuo kɛ kpe. 19Ke hɛ kali ɔmɛ ngɛ nyɛɛe ɔ, tlɔɔke nane ɔmɛ hu nyɛɛɔ a kasa nya, nɛ ke hɛ kali ɔmɛ wo a he nɔ kɛ je zugba a, kɛkɛ tlɔɔke nane ɔmɛ hu wo a he nɔ. 20He tsuaa he nɛ a suɔ ɔ, lejɛ ɔ a yaa, nɛ tlɔɔke nane ɔmɛ kɛ mɛ tsuo peeɔ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ si kake too; ejakaa hɛ kali ɔmɛ a mumi lɛ hɛɛ nane ɔmɛ. 21Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, be tsuaa be nɛ hɛ kali ɔmɛ ngɛ nyɛɛe ɔ, nane ɔmɛ hu ngɛ nyɛɛe; nɛ ke a da si ɔ, mɛ tsuo a da si. Ke hɛ kali ɔmɛ wó a he nɔ kɛ je zugba a, kɛkɛ nane ɔmɛ tsuo hu pee ja, ejakaa hɛ kali ɔmɛ a mumi lɛ hɛɛ nane ɔmɛ.
22 Nɔ́ ko mluguduu nɛ ngɛ kpɛe klãiklãi kaa ahuhuɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ngɛ hɛ kali ɔmɛ a yi nɔ. 23Hɛ kali ɔmɛ bli a pɛli ɔmɛ a mi kɛ ya a sibi a ngɔ; nɔ kɛ e sibi nɛ ngɛ e kasa nya a nɔ́ kakaaka tsa. Hɛ kali ɔmɛ a ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ ngɔ pɛli enyɔ ngɔ ha e nɔmlɔ tso ɔ he. 24 Benɛ a te kɛ yaa a, i nu a pɛli ɔmɛ a he kaa wo nɛ ngɛ fiae gudaguda, loo ta buli a ngmlaa hoo, loo Mawu Ope ɔ nitsɛ e gbi. Benɛ hɛ kali ɔmɛ ya da si ɔ, a ba a pɛli ɔmɛ si, 25se gbi ko pɛ ngɛ nɔ mluguduu ɔ nɛ ngɛ a yi nɔ ɔ yi mi.
26 Ke o hyɛ ɔ, nɔ́ ko kaa matsɛ sɛ nɛ hɛɛ tɛ bluu su ngɛ nɔ́ mluguduu ɔ nɔ́, nɛ nɔ́ ko nɛ ngɛ kaa nɔmlɔ hii si ngɛ matsɛ sɛ ɔ nɔ. 27 Kɛ je e he ko nɛ a ma tsɛ ke e mlɛ mi kɛ kuɔ ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ i na a pee kaa ayawa ngɛ la mi. Kɛ je e mlɛ mi kɛ ya pue sisi ɔ tsuo ngɛ kpɛe kaa la nɛ ngɛ tsoe plamplam. 28Alale su slɔɔtohi nɛ je kpo ngɛ mi ɔ ngɛ fɛu kaa nɔ́ ko. Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi nyami ɔ kpɛmi nɛ a be nyɛe maa kale ɔ je e he kpo ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Mawu tsɛ Ezekiel ke e ba pee gbalɔ
Benɛ i na nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, i tsɔ fia si, nɛ i ngɔ ye hɛ mi ngɔ bu zugba. Kɛkɛ nɛ i nu gbi ko nɛ ngɛ mi dee ke,

Title: EZEKIEL 2
Content:
1“Nɔmlɔ adesa, tee si nɛ o da si nɛ ma de mo nɔ́ ko.” 2Benɛ e kɛ mi tu munyu ɔ kɛkɛ nɛ Mawu mumi ba sɛ ye mi, nɛ e wo ye nɔ kɛ da si. Kɛkɛ nɛ i bu nɔ́ nɛ a ngɛ mi dee ɔ tue. 3E de mi ke, “Nɔmlɔ adesa, ma tsɔ mo kɛ ya Israel bi ɔmɛ a ngɔ. A nɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsɔ atuã, nɛ a kua mi; nɛ mɛ hu a pee a he atuã tsɔli, nɛ a ngɛ ye nɔ tɔe kɛ mwɔɔ. 4Ma nɛ e mi bi a tue wa, nɛ a bui mi a ngɔ i ngɛ mo tsɔe ɔ nɛ. Yaa de mɛ nɔ́ nɛ imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ i ngɛ mɛ dee ɔ. 5Ke atuã tsɔli nɛ ɔmɛ bu mo tue jio, a bui mo tue jio, a ma na maa le kɛ̃ kaa gbalɔ ko ngɛ a kpɛti.
6“Se mo nɔmlɔ adesa, jamɛ a atuã tsɔli ɔmɛ lɛɛ koo ye mɛ gbeye; a munyu ɔmɛ hu koo bu. Ke a te si kɛ wo mo, nɛ a bui mo tue ɔ, e maa pee kaa miohi a mi o ngɛ, nɛ nyingmogblakotohi a nɔ o hii si ngɛ, se jamɛ a atuã tsɔli ɔmɛ lɛɛ koo ye mɛ gbeye; a munyu ɔmɛ hu koo bu. 7A bu mo tue jio, a bui mo tue jio, moo lɛɛ de mɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ ma de mo ke o de mɛ ɔ. Ejakaa tue gboli ji mɛ.
8“Se mo nɔmlɔ adesa, bu nɔ́ nɛ ma de mo ɔ tue; koo pee o he tue gbolɔ kaa mɛ. Pãã o nya mi, nɛ o ye nɔ́ nɛ ma ha mo nɛ ɔ.” 9 I na nine ko nɛ a juale ha mi; e hɛɛ womi kpo ko. 10E bli womi ɔ mi kɛ fɔ si. A ngma ní ngɛ womi ɔ hɛ mi, kɛ e se tsuo. Kɔmɔ yemi, huu fami, kɛ awe nyami munyuhi lɛ ngɛ mi.

Title: EZEKIEL 3
Content:
1 Mawu de mi ke, “Nɔmlɔ adesa, nɔ́ nɛ a kɛ ha mo ɔ, yé! Yé womi kpo nɛ ɔ, konɛ o kɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ nɛ ya tu munyu.”
2Kɛkɛ nɛ i pã ye nya mi, konɛ ma ye womi kpo ɔ nɛ e ngɔ kɛ ngɛ mi hae ɔ. 3E de mi ke, “Nɔmlɔ adesa, yé womi kpo nɛ i ngɔ ha mo nɛ ɔ, nɛ o mi mi nɛ hyi tɔ.” I ye, nɛ e ngɔ ngɛ ye nya mi kaa hwo.
4Jehanɛ Mawu de mi ke, “Nɔmlɔ adesa, yaa Israel bi ɔmɛ a ngɔ, nɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ ma de mo ɔ, de mɛ. 5Tsa pi nihi nɛ tuɔ gbi kpa nɛ sisi numi wa a ngɔ nɛ i ngɛ mo tsɔe, se mohu Israel ma a a ngɔ. 6Ke ma nguahi nɛ tuɔ gbi kpahi nɛ wa, nɛ o nui a gbi ɔmɛ a ngɔ nɛ i ngɛ mo tsɔe ɔ, jinɛ mɛɛ lɛɛ a maa bu mo tue. 7Se Israel ma a be suɔe kaa a maa bu mo tue, ejakaa imi tete po, a sume kaa a maa bu mi tue. Ma a tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ a tue wa, nɛ a tsɔɔ atuã. 8Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ma ha o maa wa tue, nɛ o maa kplii o tsui kɛ wo mɛ ja nɔuu. 9Ma ha nɛ o hɛ mi maa wa kaa tɛ nɛ he wa pe tslɛbo po. Koo ye mɛ gbeye, nɛ o tsui ko po ngɛ a hɛ mi; ejakaa mɛɛ lɛɛ atuã pɛ a tsɔɔ.”
10Mawu de hu ke, “Nɔmlɔ adesa, ta tue saminya, konɛ o kai nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ ma de mo ɔ. 11Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, o ma mi bi ɔmɛ nɛ a nuu kɛ ho ma se ya a, yaa a ngɔ nɛ o ya tu munyu kɛ tsɔɔ mɛ. De mɛ ke nɔ́ nɛ imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, i ngɛ mɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ, a bu tue jio, a bui tue jio.”
12Kɛkɛ nɛ Mawu mumi ɔ wo ye nɔ, nɛ i nu gbi nguaa ko nɛ ngɛ pɛe ngɛ ye se je ke, “Á je Yawɛ yi, nɛ a wo e hɛ mi nyami ngɛ hiɔwe lokoo.” 13Hɛ kali ɔmɛ a pɛli ɔmɛ ngɛ a sibi a he sae, nɛ tlɔɔke nane ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ a kasa nya a ngɛ a ní tsue. Enɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ngɛ pɛe hoo kaa nɔ́ nɛ zugba lɛ ngɛ mimiɛe. 14Yawɛ he wami ba ye nɔ wawɛɛ nitsɛ; nɛ benɛ mumi ɔ wo mi kɛ yaa a, e dɔ mi, nɛ ye bua jɔɛ kulaa. 15Kɛkɛ nɛ i ba su Tel Abib ngɛ Kebar pa a nya. Nihi nɛ a nuu kɛ ho ma se ya a, lejɛ ɔ ji he nɛ a ngɛ. I hi lejɛ ɔ ligbi kpaago sɔuu; nɛ nɔ́ nɛ i na, kɛ nɔ́ nɛ i nu ɔ wo ye he gbeye, nɛ ye he mi po.
Yawɛ pee Ezekiel bulɔ
(Ezekiel 33.1-9)
16Ligbi kpaago ɔ se ɔ, Yawɛ kɛ mi tu munyu, nɛ e de mi ke, 17“Nɔmlɔ adesa, i pee mo bulɔ kɛ ha Israel ma a; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, bu ye nya mi munyu ɔmɛ tue saminya, konɛ o kɛ bɔ mɛ kɔkɔ ha mi. 18Ke i de ke yayami peelɔ ko ma gbo, nɛ o bɔɛ lɛ kɔkɔ, nɛ o tui munyu kɛ tsɔɔ we lɛ, konɛ e tsake nɛ e he e yi wami ɔ, jamɛ a yayami peelɔ ma gbo ngɛ e yayami ɔmɛ a he lɛɛ, se ma bi e muɔ si ngɛ o dɛ. 19Se ke o bɔ yayami peelɔ ɔ kɔkɔ, nɛ e kpa we yayami peemi ɔ, e ma gbo ngɛ e yayami ɔmɛ a he, se moo lɛɛ o ma he o yi wami.
20“Jehanɛ, ke nɔmlɔ kpakpa kpa níhi nɛ da peemi, nɛ e ba bɔni yayami peemi, nɛ i fɔ̃ e blɔ mi tso ɔ, e ma gbo. Akɛnɛ o bɔɛ lɛ kɔkɔ ɔ, e ma gbo ngɛ e yayami ɔ he. Ma bi e muɔ si ngɛ o dɛ; kpakpa nɛ e pee ɔ tsuo, i be kaie. 21Se ke o bɔ dalɔ ɔ kɔkɔ ke e ko pee yayami, nɛ e bu mo tue, nɛ e pee we nɔ́ nɛ dɛ ɔ, e yi ma na wami, nɛ mo nitsɛ hu a ma he o yi wami.”
Ezekiel maa pee mumui
22I nu Yawɛ he wawɛɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, nɛ e de mi ke, “Tee si nɛ o ya kɔ̃ ɔ mi; i kɛ mo maa tu munyu ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.”
23Kɛkɛ nɛ i pue nɔ kɛ ho kɔ̃ ɔ mi ya. Lejɛ ɔ lɛ i na Yawɛ hɛ mi nyami ɔ kaa bɔ nɛ i na lɛ ngɛ Kebar pa a nya a. I ngɔ ye hɛ mi ngɔ bu zugba. 24Se Mawu mumi ɔ ba sɛ ye mi, nɛ e wo ye nɔ kɛ da si. E kɛ mi tu munyu, nɛ e de mi ke, “Yaa o we ɔ mi, nɛ o nga sinya kɛ wo o yi. 25Nɔmlɔ adesa, a kɛ kpa maa fi mo, nɛ o be kpo nyɛe maa je kɛ ya nihi a kpɛti. 26Ma ha nɛ o lilɛ maa mɛtɛ o nya mi; o ma pee mumui, nɛ o be nyɛe maa tu munyu kɛ ka atuã tsɔli nɛ ɔmɛ a hɛ mi. 27Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, i kɛ mo maa tu munyu ekohu, nɛ ke i bli o nya a, o ma de mɛ nɔ́ nɛ imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ i de mo ɔ. A ti ni komɛ maa bu mo tue, nɛ ni komɛ hu be mo tue bue; ejakaa ma atuã tsɔli ji mɛ.”

Title: EZEKIEL 4
Content:
Ezekiel pee okadi kɛ tsɔɔ kaa a sa Yerusalem ma a yi
1Mawu de mi ke, “Nɔmlɔ adesa, yaa ngɔ bliikisi nɛ o kɛ fɔ o hɛ mi; nɛ o tɛni Yerusalem ma a ngɛ nɔ. 2Moo ma mɔ, nɛ o fia gbogbo kɛ kpoku kɛ wo he. Ngɔɔ ta buli kɛ gbogbo kuɔmi níhi kɛ bɔle lɛ kɛ kpe kɛ tsɔɔ kaa a sa ma a yi. 3Ngɔɔ dade pɛtɛɛ ko nɛ o kɛ pee dade gbogbo ngɛ o kɛ ma a nyɛ kpɛti. Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, plɛ o hɛ mi kɛ kpee ma a. A sa ma a yi! Mo ji nɔ nɛ sa ma a yi ɔ nɛ. Enɛ ɔ maa pee okadi kɛ ha Israel ma a.
4-5“Jehanɛ, yaa hwɔ si ngɛ o muɔ nɔ. Ma ngɔ Israel ma a he yayami ɔmɛ ngɔ fɔ o nɔ. O maa tloo a he yayami ɔmɛ, nɛ o maa na nɔ́ ligbi lafa etɛ kɛ nyingmi nɛɛ ngɛ fɔ nɛ a ye ɔ he. Ligbi kake tue gblami daa si ha jeha kake nɔ́. 6Ke o gbe enɛ ɔmɛ a nya a, kpale nɛ o hwɔ o hiɔ nɔ, nɛ o tloo Yuda ma a hu a he yayami ɔmɛ ligbi nyingmi eywiɛ. Ligbi kake tue gblami daa si ha jeha kake nɔ́.
7“Ngɔɔ o hɛ mi kɛ ka Yerusalem ma a nɛ a sa yi ɔ. Je o nine kɛ tsɔɔ ma a. Gbaa kɛ si ma a. 8Ma fi mo kpa, nɛ o be nyɛe ma plɛ o he kɛ je kasa hiɛ kɛ ya kasa hiɛ kɛ yaa su be nɛ o ma sa ma a yi kɛ gbe nya.
9“Jehanɛ, ngɔɔ ngma, akoko, abɔtlamɔ, yɔ, blɛfo akoko, kɛ blɛfo kɛ wo nɔ́ kake mi, nɛ o kɛ pee abolo. Ligbi lafa etɛ kɛ nyingmi nɛɛ ɔ nɛ o maa hwɔ o muɔ kasa nɔ ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ o maa ye ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. 10O niye ní nɛ o maa ye ligbi kake ɔ, e jiimi maa pee kilo mi dlami eywiɛ mi kake. 11Nyu nɛ o maa nu daa ligbi maa pee nyu kɔɔpoo enyɔ. 12O maa ngɔ nɔmlɔ fĩ kɛ slɛ la; o maa sã abolo ngɛ nɔ, nɛ o maa ye ngɛ ma hɛ mi.”
13Yawɛ de mi ke, “Ja pɛpɛɛpɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ maa ye a niye ní nɛ a ble ɔ ngɛ je ma amɛ a kpɛti he nɛ ma fie mɛ kɛ maa ho ɔ.”
14Kɛkɛ nɛ i de ke, “Kpaoo, Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, i ble we ye he; kɛ je ye jokuɛwi a si hluu kɛ ba su be nɛ ɔ mi tsuo ɔ, nɔ́ ko nɛ lɛ nitsɛ e gbo, loo lohwe ko tsɔtslɔɔ mi ɔ, i yi hyɛ; jehanɛ hu, lo nɛ a hiɔ yɛ ye nya mi hyɛ.”
15Se Mawu de mi ke, “Saminya! Ma ha o maa ngɔ na fĩ kɛ sã abolo ɔ, se pi nɔmlɔ fĩ.”
16E de mi hu ke, “Nɔmlɔ adesa, ma ha nɛ niye ní he maa hia ngɛ Yerusalem. Niye ní nɛ ma mi bi ɔmɛ maa ye ɔ, a maa ngmɛ ngɛ sɛni tɛ nɔ, nɛ nyu nɛ a maa nu hu a ma susu ha mɛ. A he maa hia mɛ, nɛ a maa ye a tsui ngɛ nyu kɛ ngma he. 17Ma ha a niye ní, kɛ nyu maa ta kulaa, nɛ a maa hi a sibi a hɛ mi hyɛe mɔbɔmɔbɔ. A tue gblami ɔ ma ha a maa ta he lo kanyakanya.”

Title: EZEKIEL 5
Content:
Ezekiel sɛ e yi kɛ e kpɛni
1Yawɛ de mi ke, “Nɔmlɔ adesa, ngɔɔ klaate nɛ nya ba kɛ sɛ o yi bwɔmi, kɛ o kpɛni kaa bɔ nɛ a kɛ asoyi ngmlaa yi ɔ. Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, ngmɛɛ bwɔmi ɔ ngɛ sɛni mi, nɛ o dla mi. 2Ke a sa ma a yi se ɔ, ngɔɔ la kɛ sã bwɔmi ɔ mi dlami etɛ mi kake ngɛ ma a kpɛti. Mi dlami etɛ ɔ mi kake hu ngɔɔ klaate ɔ kɛ poo mi kɛ bɔle ma a kɛ kpe. Mi dlami etɛ ɔ mi kake nɛ maa piɛ ɔ, ngɔɔ kɛ fĩa kɔɔhiɔ mi; kɛkɛ ɔ, ma hia klaate ɔ kɛ nyɛɛ a se. 3Ngɔɔ bwɔmi nɛ ɔ mi bɔɔ ko pɛ kɛ muɔ o tade ɔ nya. 4Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, je lɔ ɔ mi eko nɛ o sake kɛ pue la a mi nɛ e sã. Enɛ ɔmɛ a mi la maa je kɛ ba ha Israel ma a tsuo.”
Nɔ́ he je nɛ a kpata Yerusalem hɛ mi
5Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ hyɛ, Yerusalem ji nɛ ɔ nɛ; i ngɔ lɛ kɛ ma je ma amɛ a kpɛti, nɛ ma kpahi bɔle lɛ kɛ kpe. 6Se Yerusalem tsɔ atuã; e yi ye mlaa amɛ a nɔ, mohu e pee yayamihi nɛ nya wa babauu pe je ma kpa amɛ nɛ bɔle lɛ ɔ. E wa tue, nɛ e bui nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko. Yerusalem yi ye mlaa amɛ a nɔ. 7Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yerusalem, bu tue; bu nɔ́ nɛ imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, i ngɛ mo dee ɔ tue. Akɛnɛ o tue gbo pe je ma amɛ nɛ bɔle mo ɔ, nɛ ye blɔ nya tomi ɔmɛ, kɛ mlaa amɛ hu, o yi a nɔ, se mohu je ma amɛ a kusumi níhi o peeɔ ɔ, 8imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ hu, i kɛ mo ná. Ma gbla o tue ngɛ je ma amɛ a hɛ mi paa. 9Ní hiemi níhi tsuo nɛ o pee he je ɔ, ma gbla o tue wawɛɛ bɔ nɛ i pee we nɔ ko hyɛ, nɛ i be pee gblegbleegble hulɔ. 10 Bɔ nɛ e maa ba ji kaa fɔli ngɛ Yerusalem maa ye mɛ nitsɛmɛ a bimɛ, nɛ bimɛ ɔmɛ hu maa ye a fɔli. Ma gbla o tue wawɛɛ; nɛ nihi nɛ a yi ma na wami ɔ, ma gbɛ mɛ ngɔ fĩa je ɔ mi tsuo.
11“Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, be a bɔ nɛ imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, i ngɛ nɛ ɔ, akɛnɛ o ngɔ tai níhi, kɛ níhi nɛ a hiee tsuo kɛ ble ye he klɔuklɔu ɔ, imi Yawɛ hu, i be mo mɔbɔ nae, nɛ i be o yi bae; mohu ma kpata o hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ. 12Gbenɔ hiɔ, kɛ hwɔ maa gbe ma mi bi ɔmɛ a mi dlami etɛ mi kake; mi dlami etɛ mi kake maa nɔ ngɛ klaate nya kɛ maa bɔle ma a kɛ kpe, nɛ mi dlami etɛ mi kake ɔ hu, ma gbɛ mɛ ngɔ fĩa je ɔ mi tsuo; nɛ ma hia ta kɛ nyɛɛ a se.
13“Ma gbla nyɛ tue wawɛɛ kɛ yaa si be nɛ ye mi mi la a se maa po, nɛ́ ye bua maa jɔ. Ke e ba mi ja a, kɛkɛ nyɛ maa le kaa imi Yawɛ, i kɛ nyɛ tu munyu kikɛ nɛ ɔ, ejakaa nyɛ yi mi anɔkuale, nɛ lɔ ɔ nɛ wo ye mi mi la a nɛ. 14Ma ha Yerusalem maa pee ma doku, kɛ ma nɛ bɔ ahlua ngɛ je ma amɛ a kpɛti. Nihi nɛ maa be ngɛ lejɛ ɔ tsuo maa hie lɛ.
15“Ke ye mi mi fu, nɛ ye hɛ dɔ, nɛ i gbla nyɛ tue kikɛ ɔ, je ma amɛ nɛ bɔle nyɛ ɔ tsuo maa ye gbeye; a maa hie nyɛ, nɛ a maa ye nyɛ he fɛu. 16Ma ha nɛ nyɛ niye ní se maa po kulaa. Hwɔ maa ye nyɛ, nɛ nyɛ maa nu hwɔ ɔ he wawɛɛ kaa nɔ́ nɛ kɛ̃ɛ̃ mi bihi kɛ a nya duɔ nɛ i ngɔ kɛ ngɛ nyɛ hɛ mi kpatae. 17 Ma ha nɛ hwɔ, kɛ lohwe awi yeli ma kpata nyɛ bimɛ ɔmɛ a hɛ mi. Ma ha gbenɔ hiɔ, kɛ ta ma ba kpata ma a hɛ mi. Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de.”

Title: EZEKIEL 6
Content:
Yawɛ sume amaga jami
1Yawɛ de mi ke, 2“Nɔmlɔ adesa, plɛ o hɛ mi kɛ kpee Israel yo ɔmɛ, nɛ o ha mɛ sɛ gbi nɛ ɔ. 3De Israel yo ɔmɛ ke a bu Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ munyu ɔ tue. De mɛ ke a nu nɔ́ nɛ imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, i ngɛ yo gagaa amɛ, yoku ɔmɛ, dɔgba amɛ, kɛ kɔ̃ ɔmɛ tsuo dee ɔ. Imi nitsɛ ma hia ta kɛ wo nyɛ; ma gbɛ nyɛ jami he ɔmɛ. 4Ma ku nyɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ nyɛ tsopa kɛ e he via bɔ sami la tɛ ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ pue si. Ma gbe ni ɔmɛ nɛ a ngɛ lejɛ ɔ ngɔ pue nyɛ we amaga amɛ a nɔ. 5Israel bi nɛ ma gbe ɔ, a gbogboe ɔmɛ ma pue si ngɛ amaga amɛ a hɛ mi; nɛ a wuhi ma fĩa kɛ bɔle bɔ sami la tɛ ɔmɛ kɛ kpe. 6Nyɛ ma amɛ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ a mi ɔ ma ba pee ma dokuhi. Nyɛ jami he ɔmɛ a hɛ mi ma kpata; kɛkɛ ɔ, nyɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ amaga amɛ maa ku dukuduku ngɔ pue si. Níhi nɛ nyɛ sãã tsopa kɛ e he via ngɛ mi ɔ maa ywia, nɛ nyɛ nine nya ní tsumi ɔmɛ tsuo a hɛ mi ma kpata. 7Nihi babauu ma gbo ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti; lɔ ɔ loko nyɛ nihi nɛ maa piɛ ɔ ma na maa le kaa imi ji Yawɛ.
8“Se kɛ̃ ɔ, ma ha ni komɛ maa piɛ. Nihi nɛ maa tu fo kɛ je gbenɔ nya a, 9a maa nuu mɛ nyɔguɛ kɛ ho ma se ya. A ma kai mi ngɛ lejɛ ɔ; nɛ a maa le kaa imi nitsɛ lɛ i gbla a tue, nɛ i pue a hɛ mi si ɔ nɛ. Ejakaa a yi mi anɔkuale kɛ ji a tsui mi; se a kua mi, nɛ a ya ja amagahi mohu. Jehanɛ lɛɛ, mɛ nitsɛmɛ a he mi maa nyɛɛ mɛ ngɛ yayamihi, kɛ ni hiemi níhi tsuo nɛ a pee ɔ a he. 10A maa le kaa imi ji Yawɛ ɔ nɛ; nɛ nɛ́ i de ke ma gbla a tue ɔ, pi nya mi nɛ i pee.”
11Bɔ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ de ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Tsɛ̃ o nguɛ nya! Ngɔɔ o nane kɛ si si! De ke akuanyɛ, musu tloo Israel ma a ngɛ yayamihi tsuo nɛ a pee ɔ he. Ta ma kpata ni komɛ a hɛ mi; mi mi hwɔ maa gbe ni komɛ; nɛ gbenɔ hiɔ maa ngɔ ni komɛ hu kɛ ho! 12Nihi nɛ ngɛ se lokoo ɔ maa nu hiɔ, nɛ a ma gbo; nihi nɛ ngɛ kpo nya a maa nɔ ngɛ ta mi; nihi nɛ maa piɛ ɔ, hwɔ maa gbe mɛ. Bɔ nɛ ye mi mi la nɛ nya wa a ma tsu ní ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. 13A maa na nihi nɛ a kpata a hɛ mi ɔ a gbogboe ɔmɛ nɛ pueɔ si ngɛ amaga amɛ, kɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔmɛ a he tsuo kɛ kpe. A maa na gbogboe ɔmɛ ngɛ yokuhi nɛ ya hiɔwe, kɛ yohi tsuo a yi mi. A maa na mɛ ngɛ tsohi tsuo nɛ bɔ kusuu, kɛ tso ngua amɛ a sisi. Hehi tsuo nɛ a sãã bɔ nɛ jeɔ via ngɛ kɛ haa a we amaga amɛ hu a maa na a gbogboe ɔmɛ nɛ pueɔ si ngɛ lejɛ ɔmɛ ja nɔuu. Lɔ ɔ loko nyɛ ma na maa le kaa imi ji Yawɛ. 14Niinɛ, ma wo ye nine nɔ ngɛ a nɔ, nɛ ma kpata zugba a hɛ mi bɔ nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be nɔ nyɛe maa hi. Kɛ je leneyi je nga kplanaa a nɔ kɛ ya su Ribla ma a he ngɛ omleyi je, hehi nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ hii ɔ, ma kpata lejɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a hɛ mi. Kɛkɛ ɔ, a ma na maa le kaa imi ji Yawɛ.”

Title: EZEKIEL 7
Content:
Israel tue gblami be ɔ su ta
1Yawɛ de mi ke, 2“Nɔmlɔ adesa, bɔ nɛ imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, i ngɛ Israel zugba a dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: O gbe nya pɛ! Israel zugba a tsuo, o nyagbe ɔ su jehanɛ!
3“Israel, o nyagbe ɔ su jehanɛ. O maa na bɔ nɛ ye mi mi wo la ha; ejakaa ma gbla o tue ngɛ níhi nɛ o pee ɔ a he. Ní hiemi níhi nɛ o tsu ɔ tsuo, ma wo mo a he hiɔ. 4I be o yi bae; i be mo mɔbɔ nae. Se ma gbla o tue mohu ngɛ ní hiemi níhi nɛ o ngɛ pee kpamisa a he. Kɛkɛ ɔ, o maa le kaa imi ji Yawɛ.”
5Bɔ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ngɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Amanehlu nyɛɛ amanehlu se kɛ ma! 6Nyagbe ɔ su oo! E ná mo jehanɛ! O yi ta pɛ! 7Nyɛ nihi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ, be nɛ a to ha nyɛ ɔ su. Jehanɛ lɛɛ be ɔ su. A be ose hee, nɛ a be nyae ngɛ jami he ɔmɛ ngɛ yo ɔmɛ a nɔ hu; ejakaa amanehlu be ɔ su jehanɛ.
8“E be kɛe kulaa nɛ ye mi mi la ma kple o nɔ. Ma kojo mo ngɛ ní hiemi níhi tsuo nɛ o pee ɔ kulaa a he. Ma gbla o tue wawɛɛ ngɛ ní hiemi níhi tsuo nɛ o pee ɔ a he. 9O be mɔbɔ nami ko kulaa nae ngɛ ye hɛngmɛ mi, nɛ i be o yi bae hulɔ; se ma gbla o tue wawɛɛ mohu ngɛ ní hiemi níhi nɛ o ngɛ pee kpamisa a he. Kɛkɛ ɔ, o maa le kaa imi Yawɛ lɛ i ngɛ o tue gblae ɔ nɛ.”
10Hyɛ, ligbi ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ! O nyagbe ɔ su! Israel, amanehlu be ɔ ba na mo. Nɔ sisimi ngɛ nɔ yae wawɛɛ kaa tso nɛ gba mɔmɔ, nɛ he womi hu nya wa kaa blɛfo nɛ je deke. 11Yi wu tso ní peemi wo wu. Kikɛmɛ a nimli nɛ ɔmɛ a ti nɔ ko nɔ ko be je mi hie hu; jã kɛ̃ a níhi nɛ a ngɛ, a juetli, kɛ a hɛ mi nyami tsuo maa laa.
12Be ɔ ma. Ligbi ɔ su jehanɛ. Ní juami, kɛ ní hemi tsuo he be se nami hu, ejakaa Mawu maa gbla nɔ tsuaa nɔ tue, nɔ́ jualɔ jio, nɔ́ helɔ jio. 13Jua yelɔ ko jua yelɔ ko be je mi tlɔe nɛ e ma ya bi nɔ́ ko nɛ e ye nya momo ɔ si; ejakaa Mawu mi mi fu ma a tsuo. Yayami peeli a yi be wami nae. 14A ma kpa titimati, nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ maa pee klaalo kɛ ha ta. Se nɔ ko nɔ ko be ta yae, ejakaa Mawu mi mi fumi maa ba nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɔ.
A maa gbla Israel tue ngɛ e yayami ɔmɛ a he
15A maa hia klaate kɛ nyɛɛ gbɛjegbɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ; nɛ gbenɔ hiɔ maa ba we ɔmɛ a mi. Nɔ nɛ ngɛ ta nga nɔ ɔ maa nɔ ngɛ ta a nya; nɔ nɛ ngɛ ma a mi ɔ, gbenɔ hiɔ, loo hwɔ ma kpata e hɛ mi. 16Ni komɛ maa tu fo kɛ ya yo ɔmɛ a nɔ ya hi lejɛ ɔ kaa lahuɛhi nɛ a fie mɛ kɛ je a hi he. Mɛ tsuo a maa ye kɔmɔ; nɔ tsuaa nɔ ma fo ya ngɛ lɛ nitsɛ e he yayamihi a he. 17Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nine mi maa je wu, nɛ nakutso tsuaa nakutso mi maa wo nyu. 18A ma bu kpekpe ya bo; sawale maa nu mɛ. A ma sã mɛ tsuo a yi nɔ ha mɛ, nɛ zo maa gbe mɛ kpɔtɔɔ. 19A ma sake a sika tsu, kɛ sika hiɔ ngɔ pue gbɛjegbɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ kaa níhi nɛ a he tsɔ we. Ligbi ɔ nɛ Yawɛ we abofu maa ba ma a nɔ ɔ, a sika hiɔ, kɛ sika tsu ɔ be nyɛe ma he a yi wami; a be nyɛe maa ye kaa niye ní nɛ a tɔ, konɛ a na bua jɔmi. Ejakaa sika tsu, kɛ sika hiɔ ji níhi nɛ ha nɛ a pee yayami ɔ nɛ. 20A ngɔ a he dlami ní saminyawiiwi nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ pee amagahi, níhi nɛ a hiee, kɛ níhi nɛ ngɛ tai. Enɛ ɔ he ɔ, Yawɛ ha nɛ a june ɔmɛ plɛ pee níhi nɛ he tsɔ we ha mɛ.
21Yawɛ ke, “Ma ha nibwɔhi ma ba kpɔ ní nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ nyɛ dɛ, nɛ yiwutsotsɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ maa ha ní, nɛ a ma ble zugba a. 22Ke a ngɛ ye we ɔ june blee po, i be a nya tsie; juli ma nyɛ maa sɛ mi ya ble lejɛ ɔ faa.
23“Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ maa pee basaa; zugba a tsuo nɔ ma hyi kɛ muɔ si puemi, nɛ ma a mi maa pee gidigidi. 24Ma ha je mahi nɛ a yi mi wa wawɛɛ ɔ maa ba, nɛ a ma ba ngɔ nyɛ we ɔmɛ. Kã peeli nɛ ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti ɔ maa je fɔ̃, nɛ he nyɛli ɔmɛ ma ba ble nyɛ he klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ. 25Nyɛ nine mi maa je wu. Jamɛ a be ɔ, nyɛ ma hla tue mi jɔmi, se nyɛ be nae. 26Amanehlu maa nyɛɛ amanehlu se; nɛ munyu yobu maa nyɛɛ munyu yobu se; nyɛ ma hla nina kɛ je gbali ɔmɛ a ngɔ, se osɔfo ɔmɛ po mlaa maa laa mɛ kulaa; nɛ nyɛ ma nimeli ɔmɛ hu be ga kpakpa ko nyɛe maa wo. 27Matsɛ ɔ maa ye kɔmɔ; ganɔ ɔ nine mi maa je wu, sawale maa nu ma a, nɛ mɛ tsuo a he maa do blibliibli. Bɔ nɛ ma gbla nyɛ tue ngɛ níhi nɛ nyɛ pee ɔ a he ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. Bɔ nɛ nyɛ kojoɔ ni komɛ ɔ, jã imi hu ma kojo nyɛ. Kɛkɛ ɔ, nyɛ maa le kaa imi ji Yawɛ.”

Title: EZEKIEL 8
Content:
MAWU HE NINA ENYƆNE NƐ EZEKIEL NA
(8.1—10.22)
A ngɛ amaga jae ngɛ Yerusalem
1Jeha ekpane ɔ we nyɔhiɔ ekpane ɔ we ligbi enunɔne ɔ, benɛ i kɛ Yuda ma nimeli ɔmɛ hii si ngɛ ye we ɔ mi ɔ, tlukaa a, Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ he wami ba ye nɔ. 2 Ma hyɛ ɔ, o nɛ nɔ́ ko nɛ ngɛ kaa nɔmlɔ. Kɛ je e mlɛ mi kɛ kple si ɔ, la sɔuu; nɛ kɛ je e mlɛ mi kɛ kuɔ ɔ ngɛ kpɛe hleii kaa akɔblee nɛ a sa he. 3E je nɔ́ ko kpo kaa nine kɛ nu ye yi bwɔmi. Kɛkɛ nɛ ngɛ nina a mi ɔ, Mawu mumi ɔ wo mi kɛ gu kɔɔhiɔ mi kɛ ya su Yerusalem. E ngɔ mi kɛ ya ma Yawɛ we ɔ we omleyi je agbo ɔ mi. Amaga ko nɛ Mawu hiee wawɛɛ ɔ maa si ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.
4 Kɛkɛ nɛ i na Israel Mawu ɔ hɛ mi nyami ɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ kaa nina nɛ i na ngɛ kɔ̃ ɔ mi ɔ. 5Mawu kɛ mi tu munyu, nɛ e de mi ke, “Nɔmlɔ adesa, hyɛ omleyi je!” I hyɛ, nɛ i na jamɛ a amaga a nɛ a hiee wawɛɛ ɔ maa si ngeɛbɔ sami la tɛ agbo ɔ we omleyi je ngɛ agbo ɔ nya.
6Mawu de mi ke, “Nɔmlɔ adesa, tse o na ní hiemi ní nguanguahi nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ peeɔ ngɛ hiɛ ɔ; a peeɔ enɛ ɔmɛ konɛ ma je ye he klɔuklɔu ɔ kɛ ya se lokoo? Se o maa na ní hiemi ní nguangua kpahi pe enɛ ɔ.”
7Jehanɛ, e kɛ mi ba kpo nɔ je kue ɔ sinya a nya, nɛ e tsɔɔ mi puɔ ko ngɛ gbogbo ɔ mi. 8E de mi ke, “Nɔmlɔ adesa, ywia gbogbo ɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.” I pee ja, nɛ i na sinya ko. 9E de mi ke, “Sɛ tsu ɔ mi, konɛ o ya na ní hiemi níhi babauu nɛ a ngɛ pee ngɛ lejɛ ɔ!” 10Benɛ i sɛ tsu ɔ mi ɔ, i na nɛ a tɛni ní nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ gbogbo ɔ he tsuo kɛ kpe: sinɔ slɔɔtohi babauu, lohwe nane eywiɛɛywiɛtsɛmɛ nɛ a hiee, kɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ a we amaga amɛ tsuo. 11Israel ma nimeli nyingmi kpaago, kɛ Yaazania, Shafan bi ɔ daa si ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. A ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ hɛɛ ngɛyu kɛ e mi tsopa kɛ e he via nɛ la su ku ngɛ mi jee kɛ yaa hiɔwe. 12Mawu bi mi ke, “Nɔmlɔ adesa, tse o na nɔ́ nɛ Israel ma nimeli ɔmɛ ngɛ pee ngɛ diblii mi! Tse o na nɔ́ nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ ngɛ tsue ngɛ lɛ nitsɛ e we amaga jami he. Se nɔ́ nɛ a ngɛ dee ji, ‘Yawɛ nɛ wɔ! Yawɛ si e zugba a ngɔ fɔ si.’ ”
13Yawɛ de mi jehanɛ hu ke, “O maa na ní hiemi ní nguangua kpahi nɛ pe nɔ́ nɛ a ngɛ pee nɛ ɔ po.” 14Kɛkɛ nɛ e kɛ mi ba Yawɛ we ɔ agbo ɔ sinya a nɛ ngɛ omleyi je ɔ nya. Lejɛ ɔ hu, ne yihi nɛ ngɛ ya nyɛe ha Tamuz.
15E de mi ke, “Nɔmlɔ adesa, anɛ o na enɛ ɔ hu lo? O maa na ní hiemi ní nguanguahi nɛ pe enɛ ɔmɛ.” 16Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e kɛ mi ba Yawɛ we ɔ kue ɔ nɛ ngɛ mi mi je ɔ mi. Nyumuhi maa pee nyingmi enyɔ kɛ enuɔ daa si ngɛ kue ɔ, kɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ a kpɛti. A plɛ a se kɛ wo Yawɛ we ɔ; a ngɔ a hɛ mi kɛ kpee beleku je, nɛ a ngɛ pu nɛ te si kɛ ma a jae.
17Jehanɛ, Yawɛ de mi ke, “Nɔmlɔ adesa, tse o na enɛ ɔ hulɔ! Anɛ ní hiemi níhi nɛ Yuda ma a ngɛ pee ngɛ hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ pi ha mɛ lolo lo? Hyɛ, a ngɛ yi wu tso níhi pee tsɔ ngɛ zugba a nɔ. Anɛ pi ye mi mi la nɛ a ngɛ woe wawɛɛ nɛ ɔ? A ngɔ ní nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ ba sɛ ye we ɔ mi nitsɛ tɔɔ! A ngɛ tsɔɔe kaa a bui mi fɛɛ, pi jã? 18Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i kɛ abofu nɛ nya wa ma kple a nɔ. A be mɔbɔ nami ko kulaa nae ngɛ ye hɛngmɛ mi, nɛ i be a yi bae hulɔ. A maa fa kue boboobo kɛ tsɛ mi, se i be mɛ tue bue.”

Title: EZEKIEL 9
Content:
A gbla Yerusalem tue
1Kɛkɛ nɛ i nu nɛ Mawu wo gbi wawɛɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ ba hiɛ ɔ, nyɛ nihi nɛ nyɛ ma kpata ma a hɛ mi. Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ hɛɛ awi yemi dade ngɛ e dɛ kɛ ba!” 2Amlɔ nɔuu ɔ, nyumuhi ekpa je yiti je agbo nɛ ngɛ omleyi je ɔ mi kɛ ba kɛ a dɛ mi awi yemi dadehi. Nɔ ko hu nɛ ha kploba, nɛ e kpla womi ngmami nɔ́ ko ngɛ e kasa nya kɛ mɛ ba. A ba da si ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ nɛ a kɛ akɔblee pee ɔ he.
3Jehanɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ hɛ mi nyami ɔ je kerub ɔ nɔ kɛ ba we ɔ kpoku ɔ nya. Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ tsɛ nyumu ɔ nɛ ha kploba, nɛ e kpla womi ngmami nɔ́ ngɛ e kasa nya a. 4 E de lɛ ke, “Yaa kpa si kɛ gu Yerusalem ma a mi tsuo. Nihi nɛ ngɛ haoe, nɛ a ngɛ kɔmɔ yee ngɛ ní hiemi níhi nɛ a ngɛ pee ɔ a he ɔ, pee okadi ngɛ a hɛ nya.”
5Se ni kpa amɛ lɛɛ nɔ́ nɛ Mawu de mɛ nɛ i nu ji, “Nyɛɛ nyɛɛ e se kɛ ya kpa ma a mi, nɛ nyɛɛ gbe ni ɔmɛ. Nyɛ ko baa nɔ ko nɔ ko yi; nyɛ ko na nɔ ko nɔ ko mɔbɔ. 6Nyɛɛ gbe ni ɔmɛ tsuo: nikɔtɔmahi, nihewi, yihewi, jokuɛwi, bimwɔwi kɛ a nyɛmɛ. Se nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ okadi ɔ ngɛ e hɛ nya a lɛɛ nyɛ ko ta e he. Nyɛɛ je sisi kɛ je ye he klɔuklɔu ɔ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ a bɔni ni ɔmɛ gbemi kɛ je ma nimeli ɔmɛ nɛ daa si ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ hɛ mi ɔ a nɔ.
7Mawu de mɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ ya nɛ nyɛ ya ble we ɔ! Nyɛ ha nɛ kue ɔmɛ a mi nɛ a hyi kɛ ni gbogboehi. Nyɛɛ je kpo!” Kɛkɛ nɛ a je kpo, nɛ a ya gbe ni ɔmɛ ngɛ ma a mi.
8Benɛ a ngɛ ni ɔmɛ gbee ɔ, e ba piɛ imi nɔ kake too nɛ a gbi mi. I ngɔ ye hɛ mi ngɔ bu si, nɛ i kpa ngmlaa ke, “Ao, Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, bɔ nɛ o ngɔ o mi mi la kɛ kple Yerusalem nɔ nɛ ɔ, anɛ o miɔ nɛ o kpata Israel bi nɛ piɛ ɔ tsuo a hɛ mi lo?”
9Mawu he nɔ ke, “Israel kɛ Yuda bi ɔmɛ pee yayami agbo; fɔ nɛ a ye ɔ kle tsɔ. Zugba a nɔ tsuo hyi tɔ kɛ muɔ si puemi; nɛ Yerusalem ma a mi hu a yi dami sane. A ngɛ dee ke imi Yawɛ, i kua zugba a, nɛ i nɛ mɛ. 10Se i be mɛ mɔbɔ nae; i be a yi bae. Bɔ nɛ a pee ni kpa amɛ ɔ, ja pɛpɛɛpɛ ma pee mɛ.”
11Jehanɛ, nyumu ɔ nɛ ha kploba, nɛ e kpla womi ngmami nɔ́ ngɛ e kasa nya a kpale kɛ ba, nɛ e ba bɔ Yawɛ amaniɛ ke, “I pee bɔ nɛ o fa mi ɔ.”

Title: EZEKIEL 10
Content:
Yawɛ hɛ mi nyami ɔ je e we ɔ
1 Benɛ ma hyɛ ɔ, nɔ́ ko kaa matsɛ sɛ ba je kpo ngɛ nɔ́ mluguduu ɔ nɔ ngɛ kerub ɔmɛ a yi mi. Sɛ ɔ ngɛ kaa tɛ kpakpa nɛ hɛɛ bluu su. 2 Kɛkɛ nɛ Mawu de nyumu ɔ nɛ ha kploba a ke, “Yaa sɛ tlɔɔke nane ɔmɛ a kpɛ ngɛ kerub ɔmɛ a sisi. Ngɔɔ o nine enyɔ ɔmɛ kɛ ya muɔ la ngu hɛuu ɔ eko nɛ o fĩa ngɔ pue ma a nɔ.”
I na nɛ́ nyumu ɔ pee ja niinɛ. 3Jamɛ a be ɔ, kerub ɔmɛ daa si ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ leneyi je. Kɛkɛ nɛ bɔku ba hyi kue ɔ nɛ ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ kpɛti ɔ tɔ. 4Yawɛ hɛ mi nyami ɔ wo e he nɔ kɛ je kerub ɔmɛ a nɔ kɛ ba da we ɔ agbo ɔ nya. Bɔku ɔ hyi we ɔ mi tɔ, nɛ kue ɔ mi tsuo ngɛ kpɛe hleii kɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi nyami ɔ. 5A nu kerub ɔmɛ a pɛli ɔmɛ a he ngɛ agbo nya kue ɔ mi tɔɔ kaa Mawu Ope ɔ nitsɛ nɛ ngɛ munyu tue.
6Benɛ Yawɛ fã nyumu ɔ nɛ ha kploba a ke e ya muɔ la ngɛ tlɔɔke ɔ nane ɔmɛ a kpɛ ngɛ kerub ɔmɛ a sisi kɛ ba a, nyumu ɔ ya nɛ e ya da si ngɛ tlɔɔke nane kake kasa nya. 7Kɛkɛ nɛ kerub ɔ kake je e nine kpo kɛ ya su la a he ngɛ kerub ɔmɛ a kpɛti, nɛ e muɔ la a eko kɛ wo nɔ nɛ ha kploba a dɛ mi. Nyumu ɔ hɛɛ la a kɛ je kpo.
8I na kaa kerub ɔmɛ eko tsuaa eko ngɛ nɔ́ ko kaa nɔmlɔ nine ngɛ e pɛli ɔmɛ a sisi. 9-10 I na tlɔɔke nane eywiɛ nɛ je a sibi ngɛ kerub ɔmɛ a he kakaaka. Tlɔɔke nane ɔmɛ ngɛ kpɛe saminya kaa tɛ nɛ hɛɛ sika tsu su. Bɔ nɛ a pee mɛ ɔ, nane kpa bɛle si ngɛ eko tsuaa eko mi; kpo nɔ je nɔ́ ɔ yaa hɛ mi kɛ se; nɛ mi mi je nɔ́ ɔ hu yaa hiɔ nɔ kɛ muɔ nɔ. 11Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, kerub ɔmɛ nyɛɔ nyɛɛɔ kɛ yaa he tsuaa he nɛ a plɛ we a he. Mɛ tsuo a nyɛɛɔ fiee kɛ yaa he tsuaa he nɛ a hɛ mi nane ɔ yaa a tɛɛ. 12 Tlɔɔke ɔmɛ a he, a se mi, a nine he, a pɛli ɔmɛ a he, kɛ tlɔɔke nane eywiɛ ɔmɛ a he tsuo hyi tɔ kɛ hɛngmɛhi. 13I nu nɛ a tsɛ tlɔɔke nane ɔmɛ ke “Tlɔɔke nanehi nɛ poo a he.”
14 Kerub ɔmɛ eko tsuaa eko ngɛ hɛ mi eywiɛ. Kekleekle hɛ mi ɔ, na ku hɛ mi; enyɔne ɔ, nɔmlɔ hɛ mi; etɛne ɔ, jata hɛ mi; nɛ eywiɛne ɔ, kɔle hɛ mi. 15Lohwe nɛ ɔmɛ nɔuu nɛ i na ngɛ nina mi ngɛ Kebar pa a nya a nɛ. Ke kerub ɔmɛ wo a he nɔ 16nɛ a bɔni nyɛɛmi ɔ, tlɔɔke nane ɔmɛ hu nyɛɛɔ a kasa nya; nɛ ke kerub ɔmɛ gbɛ a pɛlihi a mi, konɛ a kɛ maa te ɔ, tlɔɔke nane ɔmɛ plɛ we a he kɛ ji kerub ɔmɛ a kasa nya. 17Ke kerub ɔ da si, kɛkɛ tlɔɔke nane ɔmɛ hu da si; ke a te si ɔ, kɛkɛ tlɔɔke nane ɔmɛ pee ja; ejakaa kerub ɔmɛ lɛ a hɛɛ mɛ.
18Jehanɛ, Yawɛ hɛ mi nyami ɔ je we ɔ agbo ɔ nya kɛ ba da kerub ɔmɛ a nɔ. 19Kerub ɔmɛ gbɛ a pɛlihi a mi, nɛ a te kɛ je zugba; kɛkɛ nɛ tlɔɔke nane ɔmɛ hu pee ja. Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, a ba da si ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ beleku je agbo ɔ nya, nɛ Israel Mawu ɔ hɛ mi nyami ɔ ngɛ a yi nɔ. 20Kerub ɔmɛ nɛ i na ngɛ nina mi ngɛ Kebar pa a nya a, mɛ tutuutu ji Israel Mawu ɔ kerub nɛ ɔmɛ.
21Kerub tsuaa kerub ngɛ hɛ mi eywiɛ kɛ pɛli eywiɛ, kɛ nɔ́ ko kaa nɔmlɔ nine ngɛ pɛli tsuaa pɛli sisi. 22A hɛ mi ngɛ kaa ní nɛmɛ nɛ i na ngɛ Kebar pa a nya a pɛpɛɛpɛ. A ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ nyɛɛ kɛ ya e hɛ mi tɛɛ.

Title: EZEKIEL 11
Content:
A bu Yerusalem fɔ
1Jehanɛ, Mawu mumi ɔ ngɔ mi kɛ ba Yawɛ we ɔ beleku je agbo ɔ nya. I na nyumuhi nyingmi enyɔ kɛ enuɔ nɛ ganɔ nɛ ɔmɛ hu piɛ he ngɛ lejɛ ɔ: Yaazania, Azur bi ɔ, kɛ Pelatia, Benaya bi ɔ.
2Kɛkɛ nɛ Mawu de mi ke, “Nɔmlɔ adesa, nihi nɛ susuɔ ní yayahi a he, nɛ a woɔ ga yayahi ngɛ ma a mi ɔ, mɛ ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ. 3A deɔ ke, ‘E sui be nɛ wa maa ma tsuhi lolo. Ma nɛ ɔ ngɛ kaa dade kutu agbo ko; nɛ wɔ nimli ɔmɛ wa ngɛ kaa lo ngɛ kutu ɔ mi!’ 4Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔmlɔ adesa, gbaa ke musu tloo mɛ.”
5Jehanɛ, Yawɛ mumi ɔ ba ye nɔ, nɛ e de mi ke ma de ni nɛ ɔmɛ ke, “Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ ngɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. Nyɛ Israel ma, nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ susue ji nɛ ɔ? I le níhi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ susue. 6Nyɛ gbe nihi babauu, nɛ ma nɛ ɔ gbɛjegbɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a nɔ hyi tɔ kɛ a gbogboe ɔmɛ.
7“Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, bɔ nɛ imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, i ngɛ nyɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. Niinɛ, dade kutu agbo ji ma nɛ ɔ; se lo ɔ nɛɛ? Nihi nɛ nyɛ gbe ngɔ pue ma a mi gbɛjegbɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ ɔ, mɛ ji lo ɔ nɛ! Nyɛ be hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ hie hu; ma ha a ma je nyɛ kɛ je ma a mi! 8Nyɛ ngɛ klaate gbeye yee; se klaate nɔuu a kɛ ma ba tua nyɛ. 9Ma je nyɛ kɛ je ma a mi; nɛ ma ngɔ nyɛ kɛ wo nibwɔhi a dɛ mi. A kɛ klaate ma kpata nyɛ hɛ mi ngɛ nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ zugba nɔ, 10konɛ nyɛɛ le kaa imi ji Yawɛ. 11Nyɛ yi be wami nae ngɛ ma nɛ ɔ mi, kaa lo yi na we wami ngɛ dade kutu mi. He tsuaa he nɛ nyɛ maa gu ngɛ Israel zugba a mi ɔ, ma gbla nyɛ tue. 12Kɛkɛ ɔ, nyɛ maa le kaa imi ji Yawɛ; ejakaa nyɛ yi ye mlaa amɛ, kɛ blɔ nya tomi ɔmɛ a nɔ; je ma amɛ nɛ bɔle nyɛ kɛ kpe ɔ, mɛ mohu a mlaahi a nɔ nyɛ yeɔ.”
13Benɛ i ngɛ gbae kɛ mwɔɔ ɔ, Benaya binyumu Pelatia tsɔ nɔ si, nɛ e gbo. I kpla si, nɛ i ngɔ ye hɛ mi ngɔ bu si, nɛ i kpa ngmlaa ke, “Ao, Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, e ko ba mi ja! Anɛ Israel bi bɔɔ pɛ nɛ piɛ ɔ, o ma kpata mɛ tsuo a hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ lo?”
Mawu wo nihi nɛ a nuu kɛ ho ma se ya a si
14Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ kɛ mi tu munyu ekohu; e de mi ke, 15“Nɔmlɔ adesa, nihi nɛ ngɛ Yerusalem ɔ, bɔ nɛ a ngɛ o nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ nihi tsuo nɛ a nuu kɛ ho ma se ya a dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: ‘Nyɛ je Yawɛ he kɛ ho se ya tsɔ. Wɔ ji nihi nɛ a ngɔ zugba a kɛ ha kaa wa weto ní.’
16“Jehanɛ, de o nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ ke, nɔ́ nɛ imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, i ngɛ dee ji, imi nitsɛ nɛ i ha a ho je ma amɛ a zugba amɛ a nɔ ya a nɛ; i gbɛ mɛ ngɔ fĩa je ɔ mi tsuo lɛɛ, se ma bu a he be bɔɔ ko ngɛ hehi nɛ a ho ɔ tsuo.
17“De mɛ ke bɔ nɛ imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, i ngɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. Ma bua a nya kɛ maa je je ma amɛ a mi hehi nɛ a gbɛ mɛ kɛ fĩa a tsuo kɛ maa ba; nɛ ma ngɔ Israel zugba a ngɔ ha mɛ ekohu. 18Ke a ba lejɛ ɔ, a ma je ní hiemi níhi, kɛ musu ní ɔmɛ ngɔ pue he. 19 Ma ha mɛ tsui he, kɛ juɛmi he. Ma je tsui nɛ wa kaa tɛ ɔ kɛ je a mi, nɛ ma ha mɛ tsui nɛ he jɔ, tsui nɛ buɔ tue; 20bɔ nɛ pee nɛ a ye ye mlaa amɛ, kɛ ye blɔ nya tomi ɔmɛ a nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ. Kɛkɛ ɔ, a ma plɛ pee ye ma, nɛ imi hu ma pee a Mawu. 21Se nihi nɛ suɔ ní hiemi níhi, kɛ musu níhi, nɛ lɔ ɔmɛ a ngɛ pee kpamisa a, mɛɛ lɛɛ ma gbla a tue ngɛ a yayami ɔmɛ a he.” Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ lɛ de.
Mawu hɛ mi nyami ɔ je Yerusalem
22 Kɛkɛ nɛ kerub ɔmɛ gbɛ a pɛlihi a mi nɛ a te; nɛ tlɔɔke nane ɔmɛ hu nyɛɛ a se. Nɛ Israel Mawu ɔ hɛ mi nyami ɔ ngɛ kpɛe hleii ngɛ a nɔ. 23Jehanɛ, hɛ mi nyami nɛ ngɛ kpɛe hleii ɔ je ma a kpɛti kɛ ya ma yo nɛ ngɛ beleku je ɔ nɔ. 24Ngɛ nina a mi ɔ, Mawu mumi ɔ kɛ mi ba Babilonia ekohu ngɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ a nuu kɛ ho ma se ya a a ngɔ. 25Nɛ i de mɛ níhi tsuo nɛ Yawɛ je kpo tsɔɔ mi ɔ.

Title: EZEKIEL 12
Content:
Gbalɔ ɔ do ma
1Yawɛ kɛ mi tu munyu ekohu. 2 E ke, “Nɔmlɔ adesa, nimli nɛ a tue wa a kpɛti o ngɛ ɔ nɛ. A ngɛ hɛngmɛ, se a hyɛ we nɔ́; a ngɛ tue hulɔ, se a nui nɔ́; ejakaa atuã tsɔli ji mɛ.
3“Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, mo nɔmlɔ adesa, bua blɔ hiami níhi a nya, nɛ o hia blɔ piani katakata, konɛ ni ɔmɛ nɛ a na mo kaa nɔ ko nɛ ngɛ blɔ hiae kɛ yaa ma se. Eko ɔ, atuã tsɔli nɛ ɔmɛ ma kɔ se kaa o kɛ nɔ́ nɛ o ngɛ pee nɛ ɔ ngɛ tsɔɔe kaa atuã tsɔli ji mɛ. 4Je o ní ɔmɛ kpo piani benɛ mɛ tsuo a ngɛ hyɛe, nɛ gbɔkuɛ ɔ, o je ma a mi kaa nɔ ko nɛ ngɛ blɔ hiae kɛ yaa ma se, benɛ a ngɛ mo hyɛe paa. 5Benɛ a ngɛ mo hyɛe ɔ, ywia gbogbo ɔ he ko, nɛ o gu puɔ ɔ mi kɛ je kpo. 6A hɛ mi nɔuu ɔ, benɛ du bu ɔ, ngɔɔ o tlomi ɔ ngɔ fɔ o konɔ kɛ je kpo. Ngɔɔ nɔ́ kɛ ha o hɛ mi, konɛ o ko na zugba, he nɛ o ngɛ nyɛɛe kɛ yaa a. Nɔ́ nɛ o maa pee nɛ ɔ maa pee okadi kɛ ha Israel ma a.”
7Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ fa mi ke ma pee ɔ, i pee ja pɛpɛɛpɛ. Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ piani katakata a, i ngɔ ye ní ɔmɛ kɛ je kpo kaa nɔ ko nɛ miɔ nɛ e hia blɔ. Gbɔkuɛ nya si ɔ, i ywia he ko ngɛ gbogbo ɔ mi, nɛ i gu puɔ ɔ mi kɛ je kpo. Benɛ du bu ɔ, i ngɔ ye tlomi ɔ ngɔ fɔ ye konɔ kɛ hia blɔ ngɛ ni ɔmɛ a hɛ mi paa.
8E nɔ jena a, Yawɛ de mi ke, 9“Nɔmlɔ adesa, tse Israel bi tue gboli ɔmɛ ba bi mo ke mɛni o ngɛ pee nɛ ɔ lo? 10De mɛ ke nɔ́ nɛ imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, i ngɛ mɛ dee ji, nina nɛ ɔ kɔɔ Yerusalem ganɔ ɔ, kɛ nihi tsuo nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ a he. 11De mɛ ke nɔ́ nɛ i pee nɛ ɔ, e ji okadi nɛ tsɔɔ nɔ́ nɛ maa ba a nɔ. A maa pee nihi nɛ do ma, nihi nɛ a nuu mɛ nyɔguɛ. 12Ke du bu ɔ, Yerusalem ganɔ ɔ maa fi tlomi kɛ fɔ e konɔ, nɛ e maa ywia gbogbo ɔ he ko, nɛ e maa gu puɔ ɔ mi kɛ je kpo. E maa ngɔ nɔ́ kɛ ha e hɛ mi, nɛ he nɛ e yaa a, e hɛngmɛ be hyɛe. 13 Ma tsɔ lɛ klama nɛ ma du lɛ. Ma ngɔ lɛ kɛ ya Babilon ngɛ Kaldea bi ɔmɛ a zugba a nɔ. Se e ma gbo nɛ e li tete po kaa e su lejɛ ɔ. 14Ma gbɛ nihi tsuo nɛ bɔle lɛ kɛ kpe ɔ, e ga woli ɔmɛ, kɛ tabo ɔmɛ ngɔ fĩa je ɔ mi tsuo; he nyɛli a ta a maa nyɛɛ a se ngɛ he tsuaa he.
15“Ke i gbɛ mɛ ngɔ fĩa je ma amɛ, kɛ ma je li ɔmɛ a kpɛti ɔ, lɔ ɔ loko a maa le kaa imi ji Yawɛ. 16Se kɛ̃ ɔ, ma ha a ti nihi bɔɔ ko maa piɛ; mɛɛ lɛɛ ta, kɛ hwɔ, kɛ gbenɔ hiɔ be mɛ gbee. Kɛkɛ ɔ, a maa jaje ní hiemi ní ɔmɛ nɛ a pee ngɛ je ma amɛ a mi ɔ, nɛ a ma de ke a tɔ̃. Kɛkɛ ɔ, a maa le kaa imi ji Yawɛ.”
Gbalɔ ɔ he do blibliibli kɛ to okadi
17Yawɛ kɛ mi tu munyu ekohu, nɛ e de mi ke, 18“Nɔmlɔ adesa, ke o ngɛ abolo yee ɔ, o he nɛ do blibliibli; nɛ sawale nɛ nu mo ke o ngɛ nyu nue. 19De ma a tsuo ke sɛ gbi nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ kɛ ha mɛ Yerusalem bi nɛ a ngɛ Yuda zugba nɔ kɛ mwɔɔ ji, a he maa do bibliibli kɛ ye abolo, nɛ a kɛ he hiami, kɛ tsui yemi maa nu nyu. A ma kpata a zugba a nɔ bi ɔmɛ tsuo a hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ; ejakaa ma amɛ a mi bi ɔmɛ tsuo a yi mi wa. 20Mahi nɛ nihi ngɛ a mi ɔ tsuo ma plɛ pee ma dokuhi. Lɔ ɔ loko a maa le kaa imi ji Yawɛ!”
Abɛ nɛ a le saminya, kɛ sɛ gbi nɛ a sume
21Yawɛ kɛ mi tu munyu ekohu ke, 22“Nɔmlɔ adesa, nyɛ buu abɛ nɛ ɔ nɛ kɔɔ Israel zugba a he ke, ‘Be babauu ngɛ bee, se nina amɛ ekoeko bɛ mi gblee.’ Kɛ nyɛ ngɛ tsɔɔe kɛɛ ɔ? 23De mɛ ke bɔ nɛ imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, i ngɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. Abɛ nɛ ɔ, ma gu, nɛ a be bue hu ngɛ Israel zugba a nɔ. A na nɛ a le mohu kaa be ɔ su ta, nɛ nina amɛ tsuo kulaa maa ba mi pɛpɛɛpɛ!
24“Lakpa nina, loo klaami nɛ a kɛ sisiɔ nɔ ɔ, ekoeko be si hie hu ngɛ Israel ma a mi tsuo. 25Ejakaa imi Yawɛ nitsɛ, i kɛ mɛ maa tu munyu, nɛ nɔ́ nɛ ma de ɔ maa ba mi pɛpɛɛpɛ. A be be ɔ tsɛ̃e kɛ ya se hu. Nyɛ ma tue gboli, nyɛ yi nɔ nɛ ɔ nɔuu lɛ nɔ́ nɛ i de nɛ ɔ maa ba mi. Imi, Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ lɛ i de.”
26Yawɛ kɛ mi tu munyu ekohu ke, 27“Nɔmlɔ adesa, nɔ́ nɛ Israel ma a ngɛ dee ji, ‘Nina amɛ nɛ gbalɔ ɔ na a be mi bae amlɔ nɛ ɔ; hwɔɔ se lokoo he ninahi sɔuu.’ 28Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, de mɛ ke bɔ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ngɛ dee ji, ‘A be ye munyu ɔmɛ ekoeko tsɛ̃e kɛ to hu, se mohu nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ i de ɔ maa ba mi. Imi, Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ lɛ i de!’ ”

Title: EZEKIEL 13
Content:
A gba kɛ si nyumuhi lakpa gbali
1Yawɛ kɛ mi tu munyu ekohu ke, 2“Nɔmlɔ adesa, gbaa kɛ si Israel gbali ɔmɛ nɛ nɔ́ nɛ je mɛ nitsɛmɛ a yi mi kɛkɛ a gbaa a. De mɛ ke a bu Yawɛ tue!”
3Bɔ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ngɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Musu tloo gbali kuasiahi nɛ peeɔ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a suɔmi nya ní, nɛ nɔ́ nɛ a nɛ́ hu a gbaa. 4Israel ma, o gbali ɔmɛ a he be se nami; a ngɛ kaa kɔkɔbohi ngɛ ma doku mi. 5Israel ma a gbogbo ɔ hehi nɛ ku kɛ pueɔ si ɔ, a ya bui ngɛ lejɛ ɔmɛ, nɛ a dla we nɛ a fia gbogbo ɔ kɛ wo ma a he. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ma a be ta a nya nyɛe maa da ngɛ Yawɛ ligbi ɔ nɔ. 6Yakayaka ninahi a naa, nɛ lakpa sɔuu a yeɔ. A deɔ ke Yawɛ sɛ gbi a hɛɛ ɔ nɛ, pohu i tsɔ we mɛ. Se kɛ̃ ɔ, a hyɛɛ blɔ kaa níhi nɛ a de ɔ maa ba mi. 7I de mɛ ke, ‘Jamɛ a nina amɛ nɛ nyɛ naa a be mi, nɛ nyɛ gbami ɔmɛ hu lakpa sɔuu. Nyɛ deɔ ke ye sɛ gbi ji lɔ ɔmɛ, be mi nɛ i de we nyɛ nɔ́ ko!’ ”
8Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ngɛ dee ke, “Akɛnɛ yakayaka níhi nyɛ gbaa, nɛ lakpa níhi nyɛ naa he je ɔ, niinɛ, i kɛ nyɛ ná! Imi, Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ lɛ i de. 9Gbali ɔmɛ nɛ naa yakayaka níhi, nɛ lakpa níhi a klaa a, ma gbla a tue. A be ye ma mi bi ɔmɛ a kpɛti hie hu; a be a biɛhi ngmae ngɛ ye ma Israel womi ɔ mi, nɛ a be Israel zugba a hu nɔ bae gblegbleegble. Lɔ ɔ loko nyɛ maa le kaa imi ji Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ.
10 “Gbali ɔmɛ mlɔɔ ye ma a; a deɔ ke, ‘Nyɛ he manye!’ be mi nɛ tue mi jɔmi ko be kulaa; ye ma a mi bi ɔmɛ fia gbogbo ɔ, nɛ gbali ɔmɛ ngɔ kalo kɛ kpa he. 11De ni nɛmɛ nɛ ngɔ kalo kɛ ngɛ gbogbo ɔ he kpae ɔ ke gbogbo ɔ maa nɔ si oo! Hiɔmi maa nɛ wawɛɛ; gbiɛ ngo ngu agbohi ma pue si, nɛ ahumi maa fia. 12Kɛkɛ ɔ, ke gbogbo ɔ nɔ si ɔ, nihi ma bi nyɛ ke, ‘Tse nyɛ na kaa kalo ɔ nɛ nyɛ kpa gbogbo ɔ he ɔ pee yaka lo?’ ”
13Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, bɔ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ngɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Ye mi mi ma fu wawɛɛ. Ma ha ahumi maa fia, nɛ hiɔmi maa nɛ; gbiɛ ngo ngu agbohi ma pue si, nɛ gbogbo ɔ maa hule. 14Gbogbo ɔ nɛ nyɛ kpa he kalo ɔ maa ku kɛ pue si butuu; e sisi tomi ɔ tsuo maa je kpo. Ee, e maa ku kɛ pue nyɛ nɔ haa bum! Nɛ nyɛ hɛ mi ma kpata. Lɔ ɔ loko nyɛ maa le kaa imi ji Yawɛ!
15“Gbogbo ɔ, kɛ nihi nɛ ngɔ kalo kɛ kpa he ɔ tsuo be a he yee kɛ je ye mi mi la a nya. Kɛkɛ ɔ, ma de nyɛ ke gbogbo ɔ, kɛ nihi nɛ ngɔ kalo kɛ kpa he ɔ tsuo be hu oo! 16Jamɛ a gbali ɔmɛ de Yerusalem bi ɔmɛ ke sane yobu ko kulaa be a nɔ bae; mamoo haomi mohu lɛ ma!” Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ lɛ de.
A gba kɛ si yihi lakpa gbali
17Yawɛ ke, “Jehanɛ, nɔmlɔ adesa, gbaa kɛ si o ma a mi yi ɔmɛ nɛ toɔ a yi mi kɛ deɔ nɔ́ nɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a suɔ ke a ngɛ gbae ɔ. 18De mɛ ke bɔ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ngɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ:
“Nyɛ yihi nɛ nyɛ kpɛɔ bo tsɔwi kɛ haa nihi tsuo nɛ a kɛ fii a nine si, musu tloo nyɛ! Nyɛ yihi nɛ nyɛ peeɔ yi nɔ hami bohi kɛ haa nihi, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ nyɛ na a klaa amɛ a nɔ he wami, musu tloo nyɛ! Nyɛ hlaa kaa nyɛ maa mlɔɔ ye ma a, nɛ nyɛ kpata a wami hɛ mi, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ nyɛ na se. 19Akoko dɛ kɔkɔ fuu, kɛ abolo nya bɔbɔɛ bɔɔ ko he ɔ, nyɛ gbee nihi yaka gu, nɛ nyɛ heɔ nihi nɛ a sa gbenɔ ɔ mohu a yi wami. Nyɛ yeɔ lakpa kɛ haa ye ma a, nɛ mɛ hu a buɔ nyɛ tue; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ye he guɛ gbo ngɛ ye ma a hɛ mi.”
20Enɛ ɔ he ɔ, bɔ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ de ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “I kɛ nyɛ bo tsɔwi nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ fiɔ nine si ɔ na; nyɛɛ kɛ bo nɛ ɔmɛ tsɔɔ klama kɛ duɔ nɔ kaa a duɔ lohwe pɛlitsɛ. Ma tsɔ́ ní nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ je nyɛ nine si, nɛ ma ngmɛɛ ni ɔmɛ nɛ nyɛ nuu ɔ a he. 21Ma kpɔ nyɛ nɔ hami bo ɔmɛ hu ngɛ nyɛ dɛ, kɛkɛ ɔ, nyɛ be nimli ɔmɛ a nɔ he wami nae hu; nyɛ be mɛ klama tsɔe nɛ a maa du hu. Lɔ ɔ loko nyɛ ma na le kaa imi ji Yawɛ.
22“Ejakaa dalɔ nɛ i sume kaa e ye aywilɛho ɔ, nyɛ ngɔɔ nyɛ lakpa munyu ɔmɛ kɛ yeɔ e tsui. Se nyɛ woɔ yayami peelɔ mohu he wami konɛ e ko kpa yayami peemi, nɛ a ko he e yi wami. 23Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, yakayaka nina ko be kpo jee ha nyɛ hu; nɛ nyɛ be klae hu. Ma kpɔ ye ma a kɛ je nyɛ he wami sisi, nɛ nyɛ be he wami hie ngɛ a nɔ; kɛkɛ ɔ, nyɛ maa le kaa imi ji Yawɛ.”

Title: EZEKIEL 14
Content:
Mawu sume amaga jami
1Israel ma nimeli komɛ ba ye ngɔ. I ha mɛ sɛ, nɛ a hi si. 2Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ de mi ke, 3“Nɔmlɔ adesa, ni nɛmɛ nɛ ngɔ a hɛ ngɔ fɔ amagahi a nɔ kɛ a tsui tsuo, nɛ lɔ ɔ he ɔ, yayami pɛ a peeɔ ɔ, anɛ a susuɔ kaa ma ha a ba bi ní ngɛ ye ngɔ lo?
4“De mɛ ke bɔ nɛ imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, i ngɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: Israel no tsuaa Israel no nɛ ngɔ e hɛ ngɔ fɔ e we amagahi a nɔ kɛ e tsui tsuo, nɛ lɔ ɔ he ɔ, yayami pɛ e peeɔ kɛ tsiɔ lɛ nitsɛ blɔ ɔ, ke e ba bi ní ngɛ gbalɔ ɔ ngɔ ɔ, imi Yawɛ nitsɛ ma ha lɛ heto bɔ nɛ sa e we amaga babauu jami ɔ. 5Kɛkɛ ɔ, Israel ma a tsuo nɛ a kɛ amaga jami tsɔ a he kɛ je ye he ɔ, ma ha a maa kpale kɛ ba ye ngɔ ekohu kɛ a tsui tsuo.
6“Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, de Israel bi ɔmɛ ke bɔ nɛ imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, i ngɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: nyɛɛ kpale kɛ je nyɛ we amaga amɛ a se kɛ ba; nɛ nyɛɛ ngmɛɛ ni hiemi ní ɔmɛ tsuo a he.
7“Ke Israel fɔfɔɛ ko, loo nɔ ko nɛ ba to Israel bi ɔmɛ nubwɔ tsɔ e he kɛ je ye he, nɛ e ngɔ e hɛ ngɔ fɔ e we amaga amɛ a nɔ kɛ e tsui tsuo, nɛ lɔ ɔ he je yayami pɛ e peeɔ ɔ, ke e ba gbalɔ ko ngɔ nɛ e ba bi ní ɔ, imi Yawɛ nitsɛ ma ha lɛ heto. 8Ye hɛ maa dɔ kɛ wo jamɛ a nɔ ɔ wawɛɛ; ma ngɔ lɛ kɛ pee okadi gbeyegbeye, kɛ abɛ nɛ a maa bu. Ma kpata e hɛ mi kɛ je je ma amɛ a mi, konɛ nyɛɛ le kaa imi ji Yawɛ.
9“Se ke a mlɔɔ gbalɔ ko nɛ e de nɔ́ ko ɔ, lɛɛ imi Yawɛ lɛ i mlɔɔ jamɛ a gbalɔ ɔ nɛ. Ma gbla e tue; ma kpata e hɛ mi; ma je lɛ kɛ je ye ma Israel ɔ a kpɛti. 10Gbalɔ ɔ, kɛ nɔ nɛ ba bi ní ngɛ e ngɔ ɔ tsuo ma ná tue gblami kake. 11Kɛkɛ ɔ, Israel bi ɔmɛ be ye se jee kɛ ya pee yayami kɛ ble a he hu. Se mohu a maa pee ye ma, nɛ imi hu ma pee a Mawu.” Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ lɛ de.
Noa kɛ Daniel kɛ Hiob
12Yawɛ kɛ mi tu munyu ekohu ke, 13“Nɔmlɔ adesa, ke ma ko pee yayami, nɛ e yi mi anɔkuale ɔ, tue gblami nɛ e ma na ji, ma ha nɛ e niye ní se maa po, nɛ hwɔ maa ba ma a nɔ; nimlihi kɛ lohwehi tsuo a hɛ mi ma kpata. 14Ke e ba mi kaa ni etɛ nɛ ɔmɛ, Noa, Daniel, kɛ Hiob ngɛ jamɛ a zugba a nɔ tete po ɔ, a kpakpa peemi ɔ, mɛ nitsɛmɛ a yi wami pɛ e ma nyɛ he kɛ je hɛ mi kpatami ɔ mi.” Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ lɛ de.
15“Aloo ke i ha lohwe awi yeli ba kpa zugba a nɔ, nɛ a gbe e nɔ bi ɔmɛ, nɛ lejɛ ɔ pee ma doku ngɛ lohwe awi yeli ɔmɛ a he, nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko gui lejɛ ɔ hu ɔ, 16imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, i ngɛ ye he kita kae ke ke ni etɛ nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ tete po, mɛ nitsɛmɛ a bimɛ po a be nyɛe ma he a yi wami, binyumuhi jio biyihi jio, mɛ nitsɛmɛ pɛ a yi wami a ma he; nɛ zugba a nɔ maa je gu.
17“Aloo ke i ha nɛ a hwu ta ngɛ zugba a nɔ tsuo, nɛ a kpata nimlihi, kɛ lohwehi a hɛ mi ngɛ nɔ ɔ, 18imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, i ngɛ ye he kita kae ke ke ni etɛ nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ tete po, mɛ nitsɛmɛ a bimɛ po a be nyɛe ma he a yi wami, binyumuhi jio; biyihi jio; mɛ nitsɛmɛ pɛ a yi wami a ma nyɛ he.
19“Ke i ha nɛ gbenɔ hiɔ ba jamɛ a zugba a nɔ, nɛ ye mi mi la ha a pue muɔ si, nɛ a kpata nimlihi, kɛ lohwehi tsuo a hɛ mi ɔ, 20imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, i ngɛ ye he kita kae keke Noa, Daniel, kɛ Hiob ngɛ lejɛ ɔ tete po, a binyumuhi jio, a biyihi jio, a be a yi wami nyɛe ma he; mɛ nitsɛmɛ pɛ a yi wami kɛkɛ a ma nyɛ he, ejakaa mɛɛ lɛɛ a peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da.”
21 Bɔ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ngɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Ma ha tue gblami nɛ nya wa eywiɛ nɛ ɔmɛ maa ba Yerusalem nɔ: ta, hwɔ, lohwe awi yeli, kɛ gbenɔ hiɔ. Nimlihi, kɛ lohwehi tsuo a hɛ mi ma kpata ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. 22Ni komɛ maa piɛ kɛ̃ nɛ a maa je amanehlu ɔmɛ a mi. Nyɛɛ hyɛ a bimɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a kɛ maa ba nyɛ ngɔ ɔ; nyɛɛ hyɛ binyumu ɔmɛ kɛ biyi ɔmɛ a je mi bami, kɛ a ní peepee ɔmɛ. Nyɛ maa na kaa tue gblami slɔɔtoslɔɔto ɔmɛ nɛ i ngɔ kɛ ba Yerusalem nɔ ɔ sa mɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ. 23Ke nyɛ na a jemi bami, kɛ a ní peepee ɔ, nyɛ maa le kaa i pee we ní nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ yaka.” Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ lɛ de.

Title: EZEKIEL 15
Content:
Abɛ nɛ kɔɔ wai tso he
1Yawɛ kɛ mi tu munyu ekohu ke, 2“Nɔmlɔ adesa, wai tso, loo wai tso kɔni nɛ ngɛ hue mi tso ɔmɛ a kpɛti ɔ, mɛni e kɛ pe tso kpa amɛ tsuo? 3Anɛ a ngɔɔ wai tso, loo e kɔni kɛ tsuɔ nɔ́ ko; aloo a ngɔɔ eko kɛ peeɔ tso plɛɛko, konɛ a ngɔ ní slɔɔtoslɔɔtohi kɛ kpla he lo? 4Dɛbi, a ngɔɔ kɛ woɔ la mi kaa lɛ́; nɛ ke e nya hiɛ kɛ hiɛ ngla a, anɛ e kpɛti ɔ nɛ la sã he bɔɔ ɔ, mɛni se nami pa ngɛ he? 5Hyɛ kaa benɛ e ngɛ nɛ la sɛ he ɔ tete po a kɛ tsu we nɔ ko, nɛ jehanɛ lɛɛ nɛ la sã e nya nɛ e ngla a, a kɛ ma tsu nɔ́ ko lo?”
6Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, bɔ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ngɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Bɔ nɛ i haa la sãã wai tso pɛsɛpɛsɛ ngɛ hue mi ɔ, ja ma ha la ma kpata Yerusalem bi ɔmɛ a hɛ mi. 7Ja pɛpɛɛpɛ ma gbla Yerusalem bi ɔmɛ a tue. Ke a je haomi kake mi ɔ, a maa sɛ haomi kpa nɛ nya wa mi; nɛ a hɛ mi ma kpata pɛsɛpɛsɛ. Ke i gbla a tue wawɛɛ kikɛ ɔ, lɔ ɔ loko a ma na maa le kaa imi ji Yawɛ. 8Ma ha zugba a nɔ tsuo ma plɛ pee nga kplanaa nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be nɔ; ejakaa nimli ɔmɛ yi mi anɔkuale.”

Title: EZEKIEL 16
Content:
Yerusalem, ma nɛ yi anɔkuale
1Yawɛ kɛ mi tu munyu ekohu. E ke, 2“Nɔmlɔ adesa, ní hiemi níhi nɛ Yerusalem pee ɔ, ha nɛ e le. 3De Yerusalem ke bɔ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ngɛ lɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ:
“Kanaan zugba a nɔ o je; lejɛ ɔ a fɔ mo ngɛ. Amor no ji o tsɛ, nɛ o nyɛ lɛɛ Hit no ji lɛ. 4Benɛ a fɔ mo ɔ, a pui o langmɔ; a ngɔɛ nyu kɛ dui o he, konɛ o he nɛ tsɔ; a kpa we o he ngo; nɛ a ngɔɛ bo ko kulaa kɛ blaa we o he. 5Ligbi ɔ nɛ a fɔ mo ɔ, nɔ ko nɔ ko nɛ́ mo mɔbɔ nɛ e maa pee ní nɛ ɔmɛ eko ha mo. Nɔ ko nɔ ko mi mi sãã we lɛ ngɛ o he, konɛ e suɔ o sane; se mohu a sake mo ngɔ hɛ fɔ nga mi; ejakaa nɔ tsuaa nɔ hie mo.
6“Benɛ i ba gu o kasa nya kɛ bee nɛ i na mo ɔ, o ngɛ si wue ngɛ o muɔ ɔ mi. I de mo jamɛ a be ɔ mi lokoo ke, ‘O yi nɛ na wami, 7nɛ́ o pee kaa nga nɔ tso nguaa ko.’ I ha nɛ o ba wa, nɛ o he hu ba pee fɛu saminya kaa yiheyo nɛ zangma pue e nɔ. O nyɔ ɔmɛ ba kle, nɛ o yi bwɔmi ba saminyayoo; se o hɛɛ o he gu pasaa.
8“Benɛ i ba gu lejɛ ɔ ekohu ɔ, i na kaa jehanɛ lɛɛ o wa nɛ o su gbami nya. I ngɔ ye bo kɛ ha o nɔ, nɛ o he fɔ we si gu hu. I ka mo kita, nɛ i kɛ mo so; nɛ i ngɔ mo ngɔ pee ye yo.” Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ lɛ de.
9“Jehanɛ i ngɔ nyu kɛ fɔ muɔ ɔ tsuo ngɛ o he, nɛ i kpa mo nu. 10Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, i ngɔ ní nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ dla o he ha mo: tade nɛ a lo ga níhi saminyayoo kɛ wo mi, tokota kpakpa, mlɛ mi fimi nɔ́, kploba falefale, kɛ sliiki bo. 11I ngɔ he dlami ní nɛ ɔmɛ hu kɛ dla o he: nine si ga, kuɛ ní, kɔsɔkɔsɔ, 12gugwɔ mi ga, kɛ tue nya ní; nɛ i ngɔ jlasi nɛ ngɛ fɛu saminyayoo kɛ fi o yi. 13I ha mo sika hiɔ, kɛ sika tsu june nɛ o kɛ dla o he. Kploba falefale, sliiki, kɛ bo nɛ a lo ga níhi ngɔ wo mi ji tadehi nɛ o woɔ. Niye ní nɛ o yeɔ ji abolo nɛ a ngɔ mamu kpakpa kɛ sã, kɛ jehanɛ hu hwo, kɛ oliv nu. O he pee fɛu wawɛɛ nitsɛ; nɛ o ba pee manyɛ. 14O he pee fɛu kɛ pi si, nɛ o he biɛ ngɛ je ɔ mi tsuo; ejakaa imi nitsɛ lɛ i dla o he ha mo ja.” Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ lɛ de.
15“Se moo lɛɛ o ngɔ o he fɛu, kɛ biɛ nɛ o na a kɛ pee nɔ́ nɛ o kɛ maa bɔ ajuama mohu; nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ma ba be ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, o kɛ lɛ hwɔɔ si faa! 16O ngɔ o bo ɔmɛ ekomɛ kɛ ya pee jami hehi nɛ ngɛ fɛu; ajuama nɛ o kɛ mawu kpahi bɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, e hí sɛɛmi; eko bɛ hyɛ, nɛ eko hu be bae gblegbleegble. 17Lɔ ɔ se hu, o ngɔ o june kpakpa nɛ ji sika hiɔ, kɛ sika tsu nɛ imi nitsɛ i ha mo ɔ, nɛ o kɛ pee nyumu amagahi, nɛ o kɛ mɛ bɔ ajuama. 18Bo nɛ a lo ga níhi kɛ wo mi ɔ, o ngɔ kɛ ya ha amaga amɛ a he, nɛ o ngɔ ye oliv nu, kɛ ye tsopa kɛ e he via a kɛ ya ma a hɛ mi. 19I ha mo niye ní, abolo nɛ a ngɔ mamu kpakpa kɛ sã, kɛ hwo, kɛ oliv nu; se o kɛ ya sã bɔ kɛ ha amagahi mohu, konɛ e je via ha mɛ.” Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ lɛ de.
20“Jehanɛ hu o bimɛ, nyumuhi kɛ yihi nɛ o fɔ ha mi ɔ, o gbe mɛ kɛ sã bɔ kɛ ja amagahi. Anɛ anɔkuale nɛ o yi mi nɛ ɔ pi ha mo, 21nɛ lɔ ɔ he o kpale gbe ye bimɛ ɔmɛ, nɛ o ngɔ mɛ kɛ pee sami bɔ kɛ ha amagahi ɔ? 22Benɛ o ngɛ ní hiemi ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo pee, nɛ́ o ngɛ ajuama bɔe basaa a, o kaii we gblee kaa o yihe be mi ɔ, o hɛɛɔ o he gu pasaa kɛ hii si wue ngɛ o muɔ mi.”
Yerusalem ba e je mi kaa ajuama
23Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ke, “Musu tloo mo oo, musu tloo mo! Yayamihi nɛ o pee nɛ ɔ tsuo se ɔ, 24o pee jami hehi nɛ ya hiɔwe ngɛ blɔ ɔmɛ tsuo a mi kɛ ha o he. 25O ha o he fɛu saminyayoo ɔ ba pee afa kaa mɔsɔ nɛ o kpa. Nɔ ko tsuaa nɔ ko kɛkɛ nɛ o kɛ maa kpe ɔ, o ngɔ o he ngɔ ha lɛ, nɛ o bɔ ajuama basaa. 26Lɔ ɔ se hu, o kɛ Egipt bi, he lo akɔnɔtsɛmɛ ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ o kasa nya a hu bɔ ajuama ja nɔuu. O kɛ o we ajuama bɔmi babauu ɔ wo ye mi mi la.
27“Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i kɛ ye he wami gbla o tue, nɛ i po o niye ní ɔ nɔ. I ngɔ mo kɛ wo o he nyɛli Filisti bi ɔmɛ a dɛ mi. Ahlua ní kpɔtɔɔ nɛ o ngɛ pee ɔ, pee Filisti bi ɔmɛ tete po zo.
28“O ya bɔ ajuama kɛ kpa zugba a tsuo nɔ kɛ ya su Asiria bi ɔmɛ a ngɔ tɔɔ. O kɛ mɛ bɔ ajuama basaa, se lɔ ɔ tete po sui o nya. 29O bɔ ajuama hluu kɛ ya su Babilonia bi jua yeli a zugba a nɔ tɔɔ; se lɔ ɔ hu sui o nya.”
30Bɔ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ngɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Hyɛ bɔ nɛ o mumu nya ta ha! O pee o he ajuamatsɛ, nɛ e pee we mo zo ko zo ko kulaa! 31O pee jami hehi ngɛ blɔ ɔmɛ tsuo a mi kɛ ha o he. E slo mo ngɛ yaholi kpa amɛ a he; ejakaa moo lɛɛ o he we sika. 32O ngɛ kaa yo gba puɛlɔ nɛ sume lɛ nitsɛ e huno, se nibwɔhi mohu e kɛ e he haa! 33Yaholi heɔ sika kaa a hiɔwo ngɛ nyumu ɔmɛ a dɛ; se moo lɛɛ mo mohu lɛ o kee o suɔli ɔmɛ tsuo ní; o haa mɛ nyɔ mi ní, konɛ a je he tsuaa he kɛ ba nɛ a kɛ mo ba hwɔ si. 34Moo lɛɛ e slo mo kulaa ngɛ yaholi kpa amɛ a he. Nɔ ko nɔ ko ba nyɛɛ we o se, nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko ha we mo nɔ́ ko kaa hiɔwo; se mo mohu lɛ o woɔ mɛ hiɔ! Niinɛ, e slo mo kulaa ngɛ yaholi kpa amɛ tsuo a he.”
Mawu maa gbla Yerusalem tue
35Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yerusalem, mo yaholɔ! Bu nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ ngɛ mo dee ɔ tue.
36Bɔ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ngɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “O kpa o he bo, nɛ o ha o suɔli ɔmɛ na o he gu saplapaa a. O kɛ mɛ bɔ ajuama basaa, nɛ o ja o we amaga amɛ tsuo. Jehanɛ hu o gbe o bimɛ ɔmɛ ngɔ sã bɔ kɛ ha amaga amɛ. 37Zo ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ o tsu he je ɔ, ni nɛmɛ nɛ o suɔ mɛ, nɛ o kɛ mɛ fiɛ, kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ o sume a sane ɔ, ma bua mɛ tsuo a nya kɛ bɔle mo kɛ kpe; kɛkɛ ɔ, ma kpa o he bo tsuo ngɛ o he, konɛ mɛ tsuo a na o he gu saplapaa a. 38Ma bu mo fɔ kaa o puɛ gba, nɛ o pue muɔ si. Ma ngɔ abofu, kɛ hunga kɛ gbla o tue, nɛ o hɛ mi ma kpata pɛsɛpɛsɛ! 39Ma ngɔ mo ngɔ wo ni ɔmɛ a dɛ mi; nɛ a maa ku o jami he ɔmɛ. A ma kpa o he bo tsuo; a maa ngɔ o june saminyawiiwi ɔmɛ, nɛ o maa hɛɛ o he gu saplapaa.
40“A ma sa o yi; a maa fia mo tɛ, nɛ a kɛ klaate maa poo mo kpɔ nya kpɔ nya. 41A maa sã o we ɔmɛ, nɛ a maa gbla o tue ngɛ yihi babauu a hɛ mi. Ajuama nɛ o ngɛ bɔe basaa a, ma ha nɛ o kpa, nɛ o be o suɔli ɔmɛ hiɔ woe hu. 42Kɛkɛ ɔ, ye mi mi la a nya maa ba si, nɛ ye hɛ be dɔe kɛ wo mo hu. Ma pee dii, nɛ ye mi mi be fue kɛ wo mo hu. 43O kaii we nɔ́ nɛ i pee ha mo ngɛ o yihe mi ɔ, se mohu o ngɔ je mi bami yaya nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ wo ye mi mi la. Lɔ ɔ he nɛ i ha o na a he hiɔwo sisiisi ɔ nɛ. Se mɛni he je po nɛ o kpale ngɔ ajuama bɔmi basaa kɛ piɛ yayamihi nɛ o pee ɔ a he ɔ?” Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ lɛ de.
Biyo, o je o nyɛ
44Yawɛ ke, “Yerusalem, abɛ nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ maa bu kɛ si mo ji, ‘Biyo, o je o nyɛ pɛ!’ 45O nyɛ lɛ fɔ mo niinɛ; e kua e huno kɛ e bimɛ; o je o nyɛmiyi ɔmɛ; mɛ hu a kua a hunomɛ kɛ a bimɛ. Nyɛ nyɛ ɔ, Hit no ji lɛ, se nyɛ tsɛ ɔ lɛɛ Amor no.
46“O nyɛmiyo nɔkɔtɔma Samaria, kɛ e mi bi ɔmɛ ngɛ o kasa nya ngɛ omleyi je, nɛ o nyɛmiyo jokuɛyo Sodom, kɛ lɛ hu e mi bi ɔmɛ ngɛ o leneyi je. 47Pi kaa o ya wo o nyɛmiyi ɔmɛ a nane ngɛ yayamihi nɛ a pee ɔ a mi kɛkɛ, se e yi be ko kulaa nɛ o ba puɛ wawɛɛ pe mɛ ngɛ blɔ tsuaa blɔ nɔ ngɛ o je mi bami tsuo mi.”
48Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ke, “I ngɛ ye he kita kae ke o nyɛmiyo Sodom, kɛ e mi bi ɔmɛ pee we yayamihi kaa níhi nɛ mo Yerusalem, kɛ o mi bi ɔmɛ pee ɔ. 49O nyɛmiyo Sodom, kɛ e mi bi ɔmɛ woɔ a he nɔ; a ngɛ niye ní babauu, a ngɛ he jɔmi mi, nɛ a tue mi jɔ mɛ; se a yi bua ohiatsɛmɛ, kɛ nihi nɛ e fi mɛ ɔ. 50Akɛnɛ a wo a he nɔ, nɛ a pee níhi nɛ a hiee ngɛ ye hɛ mi paa he je ɔ, i kpata a hɛ mi.
51“Samaria pee we yayamihi nɛ o pee ɔ a mi fa tete po; ní yayamihi nɛ o pee ɔ hiɛ babauu pe e ní ɔmɛ. Ke a ngɔ mo kɛ to o nyɛmiyi ɔmɛ a he ɔ, ní yayamihi tsuo nɛ o pee ɔ ha nɛ e peeɔ kaa nɔ́ nɛ o nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ yeɔ nguɔ! 52O hɛ mi lɛ pue si nɛ ɔ nɛ! O ha a bu o nyɛmiyi ɔmɛ nihi nɛ da pe mo! Yayamihi nɛ o pee pe mɛ ɔ ha a da pe mo. O hɛ mi pue si; zo gbe mo kpɔtɔɔ, ejakaa o ha o nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ pee kaa nihi nɛ mɛɛ lɛɛ a da!”
Sodom kɛ Samaria maa kpale ná ní ekohu
53Yawɛ de Yerusalem ke, “Ma ha Sodom kɛ Samaria ma amɛ, kɛ a mi bi ɔmɛ maa kpale ná ní kpɔtɔɔ ekohu. Mo nitsɛ hu, ma ha o maa kpale ná ní ekohu, kaa mɛ nɔuu. 54Kɛkɛ ɔ, o hɛ mi nɛ pue si, kɛ zo nɛ gbe mo ngɛ níhi nɛ o pee ɔ a he ɔ, ma ha a maa wo a bua. 55O nyɛmiyo Sodom kɛ e mi bi ɔmɛ maa ba a zu nɔ ekohu; o nyɛmiyo Samaria kɛ e mi bi ɔmɛ hu maa ba a zu nɔ ekohu, nɛ mo Yerusalem kɛ o mi bi ɔmɛ hu nyɛ maa ba nyɛ zu nɔ ekohu. 56Be ko nɛ be ɔ, tse o wo o he nɔ ngɛ o nyɛmiyo Sodom nɔ, nɛ e pee o nya he la, 57loko yayamihi nɛ o pee ɔ tsuo ba je kpo? Jehanɛ lɛɛ o pee kaa lɛ, nɛ Edom bi, Filisti bi, kɛ ni kpa amɛ nɛ bɔle mo, nɛ a sume mo saasaa a, o ba pee ahlua bɔmi nɔ́ ha mɛ! 58Zo ní nɛ o tsu, kɛ ní hiemi níhi nɛ o pee ɔ, a he tue gblami bɔɔ ko kɛkɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.” Yawɛ lɛ de.
Somi ko nɛ ngɛ daa
59Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ke, “I kɛ mo maa to ní kaa bɔ nɛ mo hu o pee ɔ; ejakaa o bui somi ɔ, nɛ kita nɛ o ka a, o yi nɔ. 60Se kɛ̃ ɔ, imi lɛɛ ma kai si nɛ i wo mo benɛ o ji yiheyo ɔ. I kɛ mo maa kpale so somi ko nɛ maa hi si daa. 61Lɔ ɔ ma ha o ma kai o sa je mi bami ɔ, nɛ zo maa gbe mo ngɛ o nyɛmiyo nɔkɔtama Samaria, kɛ o nyɛmiyo wayoo Sodom tsuo a hɛ mi. Ma ha a maa kpale kɛ ba o ngɔ kaa biyihi nɛ imi nitsɛ i ngɔ ha mo, se pi ngɛ somi nɛ o kɛ mi so ɔ nya. 62I kɛ mo maa so somi he, konɛ o le kaa imi ji Yawɛ. 63Ma ngɔ o he yayami ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ pa mo; se kɛ̃ ɔ, o ma kai yayami ɔmɛ, nɛ zo maa gbe mo kpɔtɔɔ. Ma ngɔ tɔmi ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ pa mo, nɛ e maa pee mo nyakpɛ; o be nyɛe maa pa o nya mi tete po ngɛ zo ní nɛ o tsu ɔ he.” Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ lɛ de.

Title: EZEKIEL 17
Content:
Kɔle ɔmɛ kɛ wai tso ɔ he abɛ ɔ
1Yawɛ de mi ke, 2“Nɔmlɔ adesa, buu abɛ kɛ tsɔɔ Israel ma a, 3nɛ o de mɛ ke bɔ nɛ imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ i ngɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: Kɔle agbo ko hi si. E ngɛ pɛli agbohi, kɛ tsɛli pinopino nɛ hɛɛ asasa su. Ligbi ko ɔ, kɔle ɔ te kɛ ba Lebanon yo ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ e ba ma seda tso ko yi mi. E kplɔ tso ɔ he kɔnihi nɛ e je ɔ yi mi mlɔmlɔɔmlɔ ɔ. 4E ngɔ kɔni mumu nɛ e ku ɔ kɛ ho ma ko nɛ a yeɔ jua ngɛ mi mi ya, nɛ e ya ma tso ɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. 5Jehanɛ, e ngɔ Israel zugba a nɔ wu nɛ a duɔ ɔ eko, nɛ e ya du ngɛ zugba kpakpa ko mi he nɛ nyu ngɛ saminya, konɛ e bɔ. 6Niinɛ, tso nɛ ɔ le, nɛ e ba pee wai tso nɛ bɔ kusuu kɛ ha si. E kɔni ɔmɛ ka gagaaga, nɛ a mi dɔ kɛ ba kɔle ɔ ngɔ; nɛ e sipoku ɔmɛ sɛ zu mi saminya. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e pee wai tso nɛ gba kɔnihi kɛ a nɔ ba kusuu.
7“Kɔle agbo kpa ko hu ngɛ kɛ e pɛli nguanguahi, kɛ e tsɛli fuu. Kikɛmɛ a wai tso nɛ ɔ dɔ e sipoku ɔmɛ, kɛ e kɔni ɔmɛ kɛ ba e ngɔ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ e na nyu saminya. 8Zugba kpakpa nɛ nyu ngɛ mi bɔ nɛ sa nɔ nɛ a ma tso nɛ ɔ ngɛ, konɛ e wo yiblii, nɛ e pee wai tso kɛ e he fɛu.
9“Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ i ngɛ bie ke tso nɛ ɔ yi ma na wami lo? Anɛ kekle kɔle ɔ be tso ɔ gblae nɛ e hia e sipoku tsuo kɛ fɔ he, nɛ e ku e kɔni ɔmɛ, konɛ a gbli lo? E yi mi ba amɛ tsuo ma gbli. Pi he wami tsɔ ko, loo nihi babauu nɛ a ma na loko a maa hia tso nɛ ɔ. 10A ma tso ɔ lɛɛ, se e yi ma na wami lo? Anɛ ke ahlabata kɔɔhiɔ fia a, tso ɔ be gblie ngɛ he nɛ a ma lɛ ngɛ ɔ lo?”
A tsɔɔ abɛ ɔ sisi
11Yawɛ de mi ke, 12 “Bi ma atuã tsɔli nɛ ɔmɛ ke a nu abɛ ɔ sisi lo. De mɛ ke Babilonia matsɛ ɔ ba Yerusalem, nɛ e ba nuu ma a mi matsɛ ɔ, kɛ ganɔ ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ ho Babilonia ya. 13E ngɔ matsɛ ɔ bi ko, nɛ e kɛ lɛ so; e ha e ka lɛ kita ke e maa ye lɛ anɔkuale. Kɛkɛ nɛ e ngɔ zugba a nɔ nihi nɛ a buu mɛ ɔ kɛ ho, 14konɛ matsɛ yemi nɛ ɔ nɛ ba si kulaa, nɛ e ko nyɛ nɛ e te si gblegbleegble kaa bɔ nɛ a so ɔ. 15Se Yuda matsɛ ɔ tsɔ atuã; e tsɔ nihi kɛ ho Egipt ya, konɛ a ha lɛ okpɔngɔhi, kɛ ta buli nɛ he hiɛ. Anɛ e ma nyɛ maa ye kunimi lo? Anɛ matsɛ nɛ ɔ yi ma na wami lo? Ke e yi somi ɔ nɔ ɔ, anɛ e yi ma na wami lo?”
16Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ke, “I ngɛ ye he kita kae ke Yuda matsɛ nɛ ɔ ma gbo ngɛ Babilonia, akɛnɛ somi nɛ e kɛ Babilonia matsɛ ɔ so, kɛ si nɛ e wo lɛ ɔ, e yi nɔ ɔ. (Babilonia matsɛ ɔ lɛ wo Yuda matsɛ ɔ tsɛ). 17Ke e ba mi kaa Babilonia bi ɔmɛ fia kpokuhi, nɛ a ma mɔhi, konɛ a kɛ kpata nihi babauu a hɛ mi tete po, Egipt matsɛ ɔ kɛ e ta babauu ɔ be he nɔ́ ko nyɛe maa pee ha lɛ. 18Somi nɛ e kɛ Babilonia matsɛ ɔ so, kɛ si nɛ e wo lɛ ɔ, e yi nɔ. Enɛ ɔmɛ a he ɔ, e yi be wami nae kɔkɔɔkɔ.”
19Bɔ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ngɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “I ka ye he kita kaa ligbi abɔ nɛ ye hɛ ngɛ nɛ ɔ, akɛnɛ somi nɛ e so, kɛ si nɛ e wo ɔ, e yi nɔ fɛɛ he je ɔ, ma gbla e tue kokooko. 20Ma tsɔ lɛ klama nɛ ma du lɛ.
