Ma ngɔ lɛ kɛ ya Babilonia, nɛ ma ya gbla e tue ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, ejakaa e yi mi anɔkuale. 21E tabo ɔ mi katsɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsuo maa nɔ ngɛ ta mi, nɛ nihi nɛ maa piɛ ɔ hu a maa gbɛ mɛ kɛ fĩa je ɔ mi he tsuaa he. Kɛkɛ ɔ, nyɛ maa le kaa imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de.”
Mawu wo si ke manye maa ba
22Bɔ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ngɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ:
“Imi nitsɛ ma kplɔ seda tso gagaa a yi mi,
nɛ ma ya ma ngɛ he ko.
Ma ya ma tso nɛ ɔ ngɛ yo gagaa ko nɔ.
23Israel yo gagaa pe kulaa a nɔ ma ma ngɛ.
E ma gba kɔnihi, nɛ e maa wo yiblii;
e maa pee seda tso agbo kɛ e he fɛu.
Lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ slɔɔtoslɔɔto tsuo
ma ba hi e hɔ̃ ɔ mi.
24Zugba a nɔ tso ɔmɛ tsuo
maa le kaa
imi Yawɛ lɛ i haa tso gagaa peeɔ kpiti,
nɛ tso kpiti kaa gagaa.
Imi lɛ i haa tso mumu gbliɔ,
nɛ tso gbigbli peeɔ tso mumu ekohu.
Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de,
nɛ ma pee.”

Title: EZEKIEL 18
Content:
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ maa bu e ní tsumi he akɔtaa
1Yawɛ kɛ mi tu munyu ekohu, nɛ e de mi ke, 2 “Abɛ nɛ ɔ nɛ kɔɔ zugba a he, nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ ngɛ bue kpamisa ke, ‘Tsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ye wai yiblii ngmlikiti, nɛ bimɛ ɔmɛ mohu a lungu fĩa’ a, kɛ a ngɛ tsɔɔe kɛɛ ɔ?”
3Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ke, “I ngɛ ye he kita kae ke, nyɛ be abɛ nɛ ɔ bue ngɛ Israel zugba a nɔ hu. 4Ye níhi ji nimli ɔmɛ tsuo, tsɛ ɔ kɛ e bi ɔ, ye níhi ji mɛ tsuo; nɔ nɛ peeɔ yayami ɔ, lɛ nɔuu lɛ ma gbo.
5“Ke nɔ ko ji dalɔ ɔ, e yeɔ dami sane, nɛ e peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da. 6E ja we Israel amaga amɛ, nɛ e yi ní nɛ a kɛ sã bɔ ha mɛ ngɛ yo ɔmɛ a nɔ. Jehanɛ hu, e nyɛɛ we e nyɛminyumu e yo se nɛ e ble lɛ; nɛ e yɛ yo nɛ ku nine ngɔ. 7E wɛ nɔ ko yi mi. Ke nɔ ko kɛ nɔ́ ko ba to lɛ awaba a, e kpaleɔ kɛ haa lɛ. Ke hwɔ ngɛ nɔ ko yee ɔ, e haa lɛ niye ní; nɛ ke nɔ ko hɛɛ e he gu ɔ, e haa lɛ he ha nɔ́. 8Ke e pa sika ha nɔ ko ɔ, e he we hekpa. E yɛ he nɛ a ngɛ yayami pee ngɛ, konɛ yayami ko sã lɛ. E kojoɔ nɔ kɛ e nyɛmi a kpɛti sane anɔkuale mi. 9 Kikɛmɛ a nɔmlɔ nɛ buɔ ye gbi tue, nɛ e bɔɔ mɔde, nɛ e yeɔ ye mlaa amɛ a nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ ɔ, dalɔ ji lɛ; niinɛ, e yi ma na wami.” Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ lɛ de.
10“Jehanɛ, ke nyumu nɛ ɔ ngɛ binyumuyo ojo fialɔ nɛ pueɔ muɔ si, nɛ e 11peeɔ ní nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ e tsɛ pee we hyɛ ɔ, e yeɔ ní nɛ a kɛ sã bɔ ha amaga amɛ ngɛ yo ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ e nyɛɛɔ e nyɛmi e yo se nɛ e bleɔ lɛ, 12e waa ohiatsɛmɛ kɛ dɛgutsɛmɛ yi mi, e fiaa nihi ojo, e kpale we nɔ́ nɛ a kɛ ba to awaba kɛ ha we nɔtsɛ, e jaa amagahi, e peeɔ ní hiemi níhi, 13nɛ e paa sika kɛ haa nɔ, nɛ e heɔ hekpa a, anɛ nɔmlɔ kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ yi nɛ na wami lo? Dɛbi! E yi be wami nae kɔkɔɔkɔ! Ní hiemi ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ e pee ɔ a he ɔ, e ma gbo. E gbenɔ ɔ sa lɛ nitsɛ.
14“Jehanɛ, waa ngɔ lɛ kaa nyumu nɛ ɔ hu ngɛ binyumu ko. Binyumu nɛ ɔ na bɔ nɛ e tsɛ ɔ ngɛ, kɛ e yayamihi nɛ e ngɛ pee ɔ tsuo; se e ye gbeye, nɛ e ya wo we e tsɛ ɔ nane. 15E ja we Israel amaga amɛ, nɛ e yi ní nɛ a kɛ sã bɔ ha mɛ ngɛ yo ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ jehanɛ hu, e nyɛɛ we e nyɛminyumu e yo se nɛ e ble lɛ. 16E wɛ nɔ ko yi mi, e fiɛ ojo. Ke nɔ ko kɛ nɔ́ ko ba to lɛ awaba a, e kpaleɔ nɔ́ nɛ a kɛ ba to awaba a kɛ haa nɔtsɛ. Jehanɛ hu, ke hwɔ ngɛ nɔ ko yee ɔ, e haa lɛ niye ní, nɛ ke nɔ ko hɛɛ e he gu ɔ, e haa lɛ heha nɔ́. 17E yɛ he nɛ a ngɛ yayami pee ngɛ, konɛ yayami ko sã lɛ. Ke e pa sika ha nɔ ko ɔ, e he we hekpa. E yeɔ ye mlaa amɛ a nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ. Kikɛmɛ a binyumu nɛ ɔ be gboe ngɛ e tsɛ yayami ɔmɛ a he, se mohu, niinɛ, e yi ma na wami. 18E tsɛ ɔ lɛɛ, e waa nihi yi mi, e kpɔ̃ɔ̃ e nyɛmi nɔ́ ngɛ e dɛ, nɛ e peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ dɛ ngɛ e ma a mi; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e ma gbo ngɛ e yayami ɔmɛ a he.
19“Se nyɛ biɔ ke, Mɛni he je bi nɛ́ nɔ́ ngɛ e tsɛ yayamihi nɛ e pee ɔ a he ɔ? Ke bi ko yeɔ dami sane, nɛ e peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da, nɛ e yeɔ mlaa amɛ a nɔ ɔ, niinɛ, e yi ma na wami. 20 Nɔ nɛ peeɔ yayami ɔ, lɛ nɔuu lɛ ma gbo. Bi be nɔ́ nae ngɛ e tsɛ yayamihi a he, nɛ tsɛ hu be nɔ́ nae ngɛ yayamihi nɛ e bi pee ɔ a he. Nɔ nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a ma na hiɔwo kpakpa, se nɔ nɛ peeɔ yayami ɔ, a maa gbla e tue ngɛ yayamihi nɛ e pee ɔ a he!
21“Ke yayami peelɔ kpa yayami peemi, nɛ e yeɔ ye mlaa a nɔ, nɛ e peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a, e be gboe; niinɛ, e yi ma na wami. 22A kɛ e yayami ɔmɛ tsuo maa pa lɛ; e yi ma na wami, ejakaa e peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da.” 23Bɔ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ngɛ bie ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Anɛ i naa yayami peelɔ ɔ gbenɔ he bua jɔmi lo?” “Dɛbi, nɔ́ nɛ i suɔ mohu ji kaa e maa kpale kɛ je e blɔ yayami ɔ nɔ, nɛ e yi nɛ na wami.
24“Se ke nɔ nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da jɔɔ kpakpa peemi, nɛ e bɔni ní hiemi níhi tsuo nɛ yayami peeli peeɔ peemi ɔ, anɛ e yi ma na wami lo? Dɛbi, kpakpa nɛ e pee sa a tsuo a be ekoeko kaie hu. E ma gbo ngɛ e tɔmi nɛ e tɔ, kɛ yayamihi nɛ e pee ɔ a he.
25“Nyɛ deɔ ke, ‘Nɔ́ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ pee ɔ dɛ.’ Israel bi, nyɛɛ bu mi tue. Nyɛ susuɔ kaa bɔ nɛ i peeɔ níhi ɔ dɛ lo? Anɛ pi nyɛ mohu nɛ nyɛ ní peepee ɔmɛ dɛ lo? 26Ke nɔ nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da kpa nɔ́ nɛ da peemi, nɛ e ya pee yayami, nɛ e gbo ɔ, e gbo ngɛ e he yayami ɔ mi. 27Jehanɛ hu, ke nɔ nɛ peeɔ yayami kpa yayami peemi, nɛ e ye dami sane, nɛ e pee nɔ́ nɛ da a, e ma he e yi wami. 28Ejakaa jamɛatsɛ ɔ pia e he, nɛ e kpale kɛ je e tɔmi ɔmɛ a mi; niinɛ, e yi ma na wami, e be gboe. 29Se nyɛ Israel ma a, nyɛ deɔ ke, ‘Nɔ́ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ pee ɔ dɛ.’ Anɛ imi lɛ i pee we nɔ́ nɛ da lo? Anɛ pi nyɛ Israel ma a mohu nɛ nyɛ pee we nɔ́ nɛ da lo?
30“Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ nitsɛ ma kojo Israel ma a tsuo; nɔ tsuaa nɔ ɔ, bɔ nɛ e ba e je mi ha a nɔ ma da kɛ kojo lɛ. Nyɛ kpa yayami ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ nyɛ ngɛ pee ɔ mɔ, konɛ nyɛ yayami ɔmɛ ko kpata nyɛ hɛ mi. 31Yayamihi tsuo nɛ nyɛ pee kɛ si mi ɔ, nyɛ sake mɛ ngɔ pue he. Nyɛ tsake, nɛ́ nyɛ na juɛmi he, kɛ tsui he. Israel ma, mɛni he je nyɛ ngɛ hlae nɛ nyɛ hɛ mi nɛ kpata a? 32Imi lɛɛ i sume kaa nyɛ gbo. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ kpa yayami peemi, konɛ nyɛ yi nɛ na wami.” Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ lɛ de.

Title: EZEKIEL 19
Content:
Kɔmɔ yemi la
1Jehanɛ Yawɛ de mi ke ma la kɔmɔ yemi la ko ha Israel ma ganɔ ɔmɛ. 2La a deɔ ke,
Mɛnɔ ji o nyɛ?
O nyɛ ngɛ kaa jata yo ko
nɛ buɔ si ngɛ jata kuhi a kpɛti!
Lohwe katsɛmɛ nɛ ɔmɛ a kpɛti
nɛ e lɛɔ e bimɛ ngɛ.
3E tsɔse e bimɛ ɔmɛ a kpɛti nɔ kake
kɛ ya su be nɛ e ba wa.
E tsɔɔ lɛ de,
nɛ nimlihi tete po e nuɔ nɛ e yeɔ.
4Je ma amɛ ba nu jata bi ɔ he.
A tsua muɔ kɛ tsɔ lɛ klama;
e nɔ mi, nɛ e du.
A ngɔ gbowehi kɛ gbla lɛ
kɛ ho Egipt zugba a nɔ ya.
5Jata nyɛ ɔ mlɛ e bi nɛ ɔ hluu
kɛ ya su be nɛ hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi tsuo ta.
Kɛkɛ nɛ e kpale hla e bimɛ ɔmɛ a kpɛti nɔ kake;
e tsɔse lɛ kɛ ya su be nɛ e ba wa.
6Benɛ e ba wa a, e kɛ jata kpa amɛ nyɛɛɔ
kɛ yaa kɛ baa.
Lɛ hu e ba kase de,
nɛ nimlihi tete po e nuɔ nɛ e yeɔ.
7E ku a mɔ ɔmɛ,
nɛ e kpata a ma amɛ a hɛ mi.
Ke e wo gbi kikɛ nɛ ɔ,
sawale nuɔ nɔ tsuaa nɔ ngɛ zugba a nɔ.
8Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, je ma amɛ tsuo tsɔ lɛ klamahi
kɛ bɔle lɛ kɛ kpe.
A bli a ya a mi ngɔ pue e nɔ.
A tsua muɔ kɛ tsɔ lɛ klama;
e nɔ mi, nɛ e du.
9A ngɔ gbowehi kɛ gbla lɛ kɛ wo daka ko mi,
nɛ a kɛ lɛ ya ha Babilonia matsɛ ɔ.
A wo lɛ tsu ngɛ mɔ ɔ mi,
konɛ a ko nu e gbi
ngɛ Israel yo ɔmɛ a nɔ hu.
10O nyɛ ngɛ kaa wai tso ko
nɛ a hia ya ma ngɛ pa tue.
E ná nyu saminya,
lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e gba kɔnihi,
nɛ e wo yiblii kplanyaa.
11E kɔni kake nɛ he wa pe kulaa a
ba pee tso nɛ a kɛ peeɔ matsɛ tso;
e ka pe tso kɔni kusukusuu ɔmɛ tsuo.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ na kaa tso nɛ ɔ ka saminya,
nɛ e pee kusuu kɛ e kɔnihi babauu.
12Se a kɛ abofu hia wai tso nɛ ɔ,
nɛ a sake lɛ ngɔ fɔ si.
Ahlabata kɔɔhiɔ fia,
nɛ e ha nɛ tso ɔ gbli,
nɛ e yiblii tsuo kplɔ pue si;
tso agbo ɔ nitsɛ hu gbli,
nɛ a kɛ la sã.
13Jehanɛ lɛɛ, a hia tso ɔ, nɛ a ya ma lɛ ngɛ nga nɔ;
a ma lɛ ngɛ zugba gbigbli nɔ
he nɛ nyu ko nyu ko be.
14La ba sɛ tso kɔni ɔmɛ a mi;
e sã kɔni ɔmɛ, kɛ e yiblii ɔmɛ tsuo.
La a sã tso nɛ he wa a hulɔ.
Tso kpakpa nɛ maa si kaa tso nɛ a kɛ peeɔ
matsɛ tso ɔ be hu.
Kɔmɔ yemi la nɛ a pɔɔ lami ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.

Title: EZEKIEL 20
Content:
Mawu suɔmi nya ní, kɛ nɔmlɔ adesa we atuã tsɔmi
1Benɛ a nuu wɔ kɛ ho ma se ya a jeha kpaagone ɔ we nyɔhiɔ enuɔ ɔ we ligbi nyɔngma a, Israel ma nimeli ɔmɛ a kpɛti ni komɛ ba ye ngɔ. A ba konɛ a ba bi Yawɛ gbi. I ha mɛ sɛ, nɛ a hi si. 2Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ de mi ke, 3“Nɔmlɔ adesa, tu munyu kɛ tsɔɔ Israel ma nimeli ɔmɛ, nɛ o de mɛ ke Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ke, nɔ́ nɛ i suɔ kaa a pee ɔ, lɔ ɔ nyɛ ba nɛ nyɛ ba bi nɛ ɔ lo? I ngɛ ye he kita kae ke i be kplɛɛe nɛ nyɛ bi mi ní. Imi, Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ lɛ i de.
4“Nɔmlɔ adesa, o maa kojo mɛ lo? Ke jã a, lɛɛ ha nɛ a le ní hiemi níhi nɛ a tsɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsu. 5 De mɛ nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ dee ɔ. Benɛ i hla Israel ma a, i wo mɛ si ko. I je ye he kpo kɛ tsɔɔ mɛ ngɛ Egipt, nɛ i de mɛ ke, imi ji Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ nɛ. 6Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, i ka mɛ kita ke ma je mɛ kɛ je Egipt zugba a nɔ, nɛ ma kpaka mɛ kɛ ya zugba ko nɛ i hla ha mɛ, zugba kpakpa nɛ baa ní saminya, nɛ e ngɛ fɛu pe kulaa nɔ. 7I de mɛ ke yakayaka mawuhi nɛ a suɔ nɛ ɔ, a sake mɛ ngɔ pue he, se a ko ngɔ Egipt amagahi kɛ ble a he; ejakaa imi ji Yawɛ, a Mawu ɔ nɛ. 8Se a tsɔ ye hɛ mi atuã; a kplɛɛ we nɛ a bu mi tue; nɔ ko nɔ ko sakee we yakayaka ní ɔmɛ ngɔ pue he; a hɛɛ Egipt amaga amɛ a mi wawɛɛ. Kɛkɛ nɛ i to ye yi mi kaa ma ha nɛ a nu ye we abofu gbeyegbeye ɔ he ngɛ Egipt. 9Se i ha we nɛ e ba mi ja; ejakaa lɔ ɔ ko gbe ye biɛ he guɛ ngɛ je ma amɛ a hɛ mi. Ye ma a ngɛ je ma amɛ a kpɛti, nɛ mɛ tsuo a hɛ mi nɛ i de ngɛ ke ma je Israel bi ɔmɛ kɛ je Egipt zugba a nɔ ɔ nɛ.
10“Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i kpaka mɛ kɛ je Egipt zugba a nɔ kɛ ba nga a nɔ. 11 I wo mɛ mlaahi, nɛ i tsɔɔ mɛ blɔ nya tomihi nɛ ke a ye nɔ ɔ, a yi ma na wami. 12 Lɔ ɔ se hu, i ngɔ ye Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔmɛ ngɔ ha mɛ nɛ a ye mɛ klɔuklɔu, konɛ e pee somi nɛ ngɛ i kɛ mɛ wa kpɛti ɔ he okadi; nɛ a le kaa imi ji Yawɛ nɛ peeɔ mɛ klɔuklɔu ɔ nɛ. 13Se Israel ma a tsɔ ye hɛ mi atuã ngɛ nga a nɔ. A yi ye mlaa amɛ, kɛ blɔ nya tomi ɔmɛ a nɔ; a bui mɛ kaa níhi nɛ ke nɔmlɔ ye a nɔ ɔ, e yi ma na wami. A ble ye Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔmɛ hu kpɔtɔɔ. Kɛkɛ nɛ i to ye yi mi kaa ma ha nɛ a nu ye we abofu gbeyegbeye ɔ he ngɛ nga a nɔ, nɛ ma kpata a hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ. 14Se i ha we nɛ e ba mi ja, ejakaa je ma amɛ nɛ na bɔ nɛ i kpaka ye ma a kɛ je Egipt ɔ, ye biɛ he guɛ ma gbo ngɛ a hɛ mi. 15 Jehanɛ hu, i ka mɛ kita ngɛ nga a nɔ ke zugba kpakpa nɛ baa ní saminya, nɛ e ngɛ fɛu pe kulaa nɛ i ngɔ ha mɛ ɔ, i kɛ mɛ be lejɛ ɔ yae hu, 16ejakaa a kua ye blɔ nya tomi ɔmɛ, nɛ a yi ye mlaa amɛ a nɔ. A ble ye Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔmɛ hu kpɔtɔɔ. Ejakaa a suɔ wawɛɛ kaa a ma ja amaga amɛ mohu.
17“Se kɛ̃ ɔ, i na mɛ mɔbɔ; i kpataa we a hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ ngɛ nga a nɔ. 18Se i bɔ a bimɛ ɔmɛ kɔkɔ mohu ke, mlaahi nɛ nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ wo ɔ, nyɛ ko ye a nɔ, nɛ nyɛ ko ngɔ a we amaga amɛ kɛ ble nyɛ he. 19Imi ji Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ nɛ. Nyɛɛ ye ye mlaa amɛ, kɛ blɔ nya tomi ɔmɛ a nɔ. 20Nyɛɛ pee ye Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔmɛ klɔuklɔu, nɛ a ba pee okadi nɛ ngɛ i kɛ nyɛ wa kpɛti, konɛ nyɛɛ le kaa imi ji nyɛ Mawu ɔ nɛ.
21“Se jamɛ a yi nɔ bi ɔmɛ hu tsɔ ye hɛ mi atuã; a nyɛɛ we ye blɔ nya tomi ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ a yi ye mlaa amɛ a nɔ. A ble ye Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔmɛ hulɔ. Níhi nɛ ke nɔmlɔ pee nɛ e yi ma na wami ɔ, a pee we. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i to ye yi mi kaa ma ha nɛ a nu ye we abofu gbeyegbeye ɔ he ngɛ nga a nɔ. 22Se i ha we nɛ e ba mi ja; ejakaa je ma amɛ nɛ na bɔ nɛ i kpaka ye ma a kɛ je Egipt ɔ, ye biɛ he guɛ ma gbo ngɛ a hɛ mi. 23 Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i kpale wo si ekohu ngɛ nga a nɔ. I ka kita ke ma gbɛ ye ma a ngɔ fĩa je ma amɛ a kpɛti ngɛ je ɔ mi tsuo. 24I pee nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, ejakaa a bui ye blɔ nya tomi ɔmɛ, nɛ ye mlaa amɛ hu, a yi nɔ; jehanɛ hu, a ble ye Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔmɛ, nɛ a nɛmɛ ɔmɛ a we amaga amɛ mohu a suɔ wawɛɛ.
25“Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, imi hu i ha mɛ blɔ nya tomi yayahi, kɛ mlaahi nɛ ke nɔmlɔ ye nɔ ɔ, e yi be wami nae. 26I ha nɛ a ngɔ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a bɔhi kɛ ble a he, nɛ a ngɔ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a bitɛtehi hu kɛ sã bɔ. I ngɔ enɛ ɔ kɛ gbla a tue, konɛ a le kaa imi ji Yawɛ.
27“Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔmlɔ adesa, de Israel bi ɔmɛ ke bɔ nɛ imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, i ngɛ mɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. Enɛ ɔ mi hu nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ bɔ musu kɛ si mi; a yi mi anɔkuale. 28I ngɔ mɛ kɛ ba zugba nɛ i wo si kaa ma ha mɛ ɔ nɔ. Se he tsuaa he nɛ a na yoku gojoo, aloo tso nɛ bɔ kusuu ngɛ ɔ, kɛkɛ a ya sã bɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. A sã bɔhi nɛ jee via, kɛ wai bɔ hulɔ; a pee ní nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ wo ye mi mi la. 29I bi mɛ ke, he gojoohi nɛ nyɛ yaa a, kɛ ji e sisi kɛɛ? ‘He gojoohi’ nɛ ɔ ba pee biɛ nɛ a kɛ tsɛɔ lejɛ ɔmɛ kɛ ba su mwɔnɛ ɔ. 30Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, de Israel bi ɔmɛ ke bɔ nɛ imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, i ngɛ mɛ dee ji, mɛni he je nyɛ ngɛ nyɛ he blee kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ pee ɔ, nɛ nyɛ ngɛ ajuama bɔe kɛ ngɛ a ní hiemi níhi a se nyɛɛe ɔ? 31Amlɔ nɛ ɔ po, nyɛ ngɔɔ nike níhi kɛ ya haa amagahi, nɛ nyɛ ngɔɔ nyɛ bimɛ ngɔ haa nɛ a sã mɛ ngɛ la mi; nyɛ jaa amagahi babauu kɛ bleɔ nyɛ he. Israel bi, enɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a se ɔ, nyɛ kpale baa ke a bi mi ní ha nyɛ. I be kplɛɛe nɛ nɔ ko ba bi mi ní ha nyɛ. Imi, Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ lɛ i de. 32Nyɛ pee nyɛ yi mi momo ke nyɛ suɔ kaa nyɛ maa pee nyɛ he kaa je ma kpa amɛ. Nyɛ maa pee kaa nihi nɛ ngɛ zugba kpahi a nɔ nɛ a jaa tso kɛ tɛ ɔ. Dɛbi, dɛbi! E be mi bae ja kɔkɔɔkɔ.
Mawu gblaa nɔ tue, nɛ Mawu ngɔɔ yayami nɛ nɔ pee kɛ paa
33“Imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, i ngɛ ye he kita kae ke i ngɛ nyɛ si woe kaa ma ngɔ abofu, kɛ nine si wami tsuo kɛ ye nyɛ nɔ. 34Ma je nyɛ kɛ je je ma amɛ a kpɛti. Ma bua nyɛ nya kɛ je hehi tsuo nɛ a gbɛ nyɛ ngɔ fĩa a. Ye he wami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ, kɛ abofu nguaa ma ngɔ kɛ tsu nɔ́ nɛ ɔ. 35Ma ngɔ nyɛ kɛ ya ‘Je ma amɛ a nga a nɔ.’ Ma kojo nyɛ, nɛ ma bu nyɛ fɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ nɔuu. 36Ma kojo nyɛ nɛ ma bu nyɛ fɔ kaa bɔ nɛ i pee nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ Sinai nga a nɔ ɔ.” Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ lɛ de.
37“Ye nine si maa wa ngɛ nyɛ nɔ, nɛ ma ha nyɛ maa ye ye somi ɔ nɔ. 38Ma je atuã tsɔli ɔmɛ, kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ tɔ̃ ye nɔ ɔ kɛ je nyɛ kpɛti. A maa je zugba nɔ he nɛ a ya to nibwɔ ngɛ ɔ mohu, se a be Israel zugba a nɔ bae, konɛ nyɛɛ le kaa imi ji Yawɛ.”
39Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ke, “Amlɔ nɛ ɔ lɛɛ, nyɛ Israel bi, nyɛɛ pee nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ suɔ; nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ya sɔmɔ e we amagahi. Se pee se ɔ, nyɛ maa bu mi tue kɛ̃; nyɛ be nyɛ we amaga amɛ ngɔe kɛ ble ye biɛ klɔuklɔu ɔ hu. 40Ye yo klɔuklɔu nɛ ji Israel yo gagaa a nɔ nyɛ Israel bi tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ nɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ ma ba ja mi ngɛ. Lejɛ ɔ nɛ ma ná nyɛ he tsui ngɛ, nɛ lejɛ ɔ nyɛ maa ngɔ nike ní slɔɔtoslɔɔto ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ ba, sami bɔ ɔmɛ, nike ní kpakpa pe kulaa amɛ, kɛ bɔ klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ. 41Ke i je nyɛ kɛ je je mahi a nɔ hehi nɛ a gbɛ nyɛ ngɔ fĩa a, nɛ i ba bua nyɛ nya a, ma ná nyɛ he tsui kaa bɔ nɛ he via, nɛ je ma amɛ maa na kaa nɔ klɔuklɔu ji mi ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti. 42Zugba a nɛ i ka nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ kita ke ma ngɔ kɛ ha mɛ ɔ, ke i ngɔ nyɛ kɛ ba nɔ ɔ, kɛkɛ nyɛ ma na maa le kaa niinɛ, imi ji Yawɛ. 43Kɛkɛ ɔ, ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, nyɛ ma kai nyɛ blɔ yaya amɛ, kɛ nyɛ ní peemi ní ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ nyɛ kɛ ble nyɛ he ɔ. Nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ he maa nyɛɛ nyɛ ngɛ nyɛ ní hiemi ní ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ nyɛ pee ɔ a he. 44Nyɛ Israel bi, nyɛ maa na hu kaa ye biɛ Yawɛ ɔ, i sume kaa e puɛ. Lɔ ɔ he nɛ i kɛ nyɛ to we ní ngɛ nyɛ yayami ɔmɛ a he ɔ nɛ.” Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ lɛ de.
La ngɛ tsoe ngɛ leneyi je
45Yawɛ kɛ mi tu munyu ekohu, nɛ e de mi ke, 46“Nɔmlɔ adesa, plɛ o hɛ mi kɛ kpee leneyi je, nɛ o fiɛ kɛ si lejɛ ɔ. Gbaa kɛ si hue nɛ ngɛ leneyi je zugba a nɔ ɔ. 47De leneyi je hue ɔ ke nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ ngɛ dee ɔ, e bu tue saminya. Hyɛ, ma slɛ la ngɛ o mi, nɛ e maa sã o tso mumu, kɛ tso gbigbli ɔmɛ tsuo. Nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko be nyɛe maa gbe la nɛ ngɛ tsoe plamplam nɛ ɔ. E maa sã nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ ngɛ e blɔ ɔ mi kɛ maa je leneyi je kɛ yaa su omleyi je tɔɔ. 48Nimli adesahi tsuo maa na kaa imi Yawɛ lɛ i mɛ hue ɔ he la a nɛ, nɛ a be nyɛe maa gbe.”
49Kɛkɛ nɛ i kpa pɛɛ ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, ko ha nɛ ma tsu nɔ́ nɛ ɔ. Nɔ tsuaa nɔ ngɛ dee ngɛ ye he momo ke, nɔ nɛ ɔ lɛɛ pi abɛ kɛkɛ nɛ e buɔ.”

Title: EZEKIEL 21
Content:
Yawɛ klaate ɔ
1Yawɛ kɛ mi tu munyu ekohu, nɛ e de mi ke, 2“Nɔmlɔ adesa, plɛ o hɛ mi kɛ kpee Yerusalem. Fiɛ tsɔɔ he klɔuklɔu ɔ, nɛ o gba kɛ si Israel zugba a ke, 3imi Yawɛ, nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ dee ji i kɛ mo ná. Ma hia ye klaate kɛ je e kpo ɔ mi, nɛ ma kpata nɔ tsuaa nɔ hɛ mi, dalɔ jio, yayami peelɔ jio. 4Ma ngɔ ye klaate ɔ kɛ gbe ni ɔmɛ tsuo ngɛ zugba a nɔ, kɛ je leneyi je kɛ ya si omleyi je tɔɔ. 5Nɔ tsuaa nɔ maa le kaa imi Yawɛ nitsɛ lɛ i hia klaate kɛ je e kpo ɔ mi, nɛ i be lɛ se kpalee kɛ wo e kpo ɔ mi hu.
6“Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔmlɔ adesa, mo nya awe, nɛ o ye kɔmɔ wawɛɛ kaa nɔ́ nɛ o tsui kpa miɔ nɛ e tsɔ ngɛ ma a hɛ mi. 7Ke a bi mo nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ mo pee loko o ngɛ kɛmɛe kɛ aywilɛho wawɛɛ kikɛ nɛ ɔ, de mɛ ke sane nɛ ma a nya wa tsɔ. Nɔ tsuaa nɔ tsui maa po; nɔ tsuaa nɔ nine mi maa je wu; nɔ tsuaa nɔ maa pee vii ngɛ e mi; nɛ nakutso tsuaa nakutso mi maa jɔ kaa nyu. Be ɔ ma, e su ta, nɛ e maa ba mi amlɔ nɔuu.” Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ lɛ de.
8Yawɛ kɛ mi tu munyu ekohu, nɛ e de mi ke, 9“Nɔmlɔ adesa, gbaa nɛ o de ma a ke, bɔ nɛ imi Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ, i ngɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ:
Klaate oo klaate!
A duɔ klaate ko nya;
a sa he, nɛ e ngɛ kpɛe nylamnylam.
10A duɔ klaate ɔ nya,
konɛ a kɛ kpata nihi a hɛ mi;
a sa he, konɛ e kpɛ nylamnylam kaa oslabai.
Ye ma a be nyɛe ma nyá,
ejakaa a bui ye munyu ɔmɛ;
a tue nɛ i gbla wawɛɛ ɔ tsuo pee yaka.
11Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a sa klaate ɔ he saminya,
konɛ a kɛ tsu ní.
A duɔ klaate ɔ nya, nɛ a sa he hulɔ,
konɛ a kɛ wo awi yelɔ ko dɛ mi.
12Nɔmlɔ adesa, moo wo ya, nɛ o ye kɔmɔ,
ejakaa a ma kpata ye ma a hɛ mi;
a ma kpata Israel ganɔ ɔmɛ tsuo a hɛ mi!
A kɛ klaate maa gbe mɛ, kɛ ma a mi bi ɔmɛ tsuo;
lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ngɔɔ o nine kɛ kpla o yi,
nɛ o ye kɔmɔ!
13I ngɛ ye ma a kae ma hyɛ;
ke a kplɛɛ we kaa a tsake ɔ,
lɛɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo maa ba a nɔ.
14“Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔmlɔ adesa, gbaa nɛ o fia o dɛ mi. Fɔ̃ klaate ɔ si etɛ. Klaate nɛ gbeɔ nɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. Klaate nɛ kpataa nɔ hɛ mi lɛ ngɛ e he poe kɛ ngɛ ma a bɔlee ɔ nɛ. 15Bɔ nɛ pee nɛ sawale nɛ nu ye ma a, nɛ nihi fuu a hɛ mi nɛ kpata a, i ngɔ klaate nɛ he ngɛ kpɛe nylamnylam kaa oslabai nɛ gbee nɔ hulɔ kɛ tsɔɔ ma a. 16Klaate nɛ nya ba, poo ní kɛ ya hiɔ nɔ; jehanɛ, poo ní kɛ ya muɔ nɔ! Poo ní kɛ ya he tsuaa he nɛ o hɛ mi tsɔɔ. 17Imi hu ma fia ye dɛ, nɛ ye we abofu ɔ se maa po. Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de.”
Babilonia matsɛ ɔ klaate ɔ
18Yawɛ kɛ mi tu munyu ekohu. 19E de ke, “Nɔmlɔ adesa, tɛni gbɛjegbɛ enyɔ nɛ Babilonia matsɛ ɔ kɛ e dɛ mi klaate ɔ maa nyɛɛ nɔ kɛ ba. Ha nɛ blɔ enyɔ ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ a je zugba kake nɔ kɛ ba. Ngɔɔ okadi kɛ to blɔ enyɔ ɔmɛ a he so ngɛ ma a nya he nɛ blɔ ɔmɛ gba ngɛ ɔ. 20Okadi kake maa tsɔɔ matsɛ ɔ blɔ nɛ yaa Amon bi ɔmɛ a ma nɛ a tsɛɛ Raba a, nɛ kake hu maa tsɔɔ blɔ nɛ yaa Yerusalem, Yuda ma nɛ a fia gbogbo ngɔ wo he ɔ. 21Babilonia matsɛ ɔ ma ba da si ngɛ blɔ gbla a nya, konɛ e kla kɛ hla blɔ nɛ e maa gu. E ma huanya e kɛ̃ɛ̃ mi bi ɔmɛ; e ma bi ní ngɛ amaga amɛ a ngɔ, nɛ e maa hyɛ lohwe nɛ a gbe ɔ fafali mi. 22Kɛ̃ɛ̃ nɛ e hɛɛ ngɛ e hiɔ nine mi ɔ maa tsɔɔ Yerusalem. E maa tsɔɔ lɛ kaa e ya fia gbogbo kumi kpoku kɛ wo ma a he; e kpa ngmlaa nɛ e he ose wawɛɛ; e ngɔ gbogbo kumi níhi kɛ to agbo ɔmɛ a nya; e fia kpokuhi, nɛ e ma mɔhi. 23Se enɛ ɔ maa pee kaa yaka gbami ngɛ Yerusalem bi ɔmɛ a hɛ mi; ejakaa a so nɛ a ka kita ngɔ fɔ nɔ momo kaa huɛmɛ ji mɛ. Se kɛ̃ ɔ, gbami ɔ maa bɔ mɛ kɔkɔ ngɛ a yayami ɔmɛ a he, nɛ a maa le kaa a ma ba nuu mɛ. 24Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, bɔ nɛ imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, i ngɛ dee ji nyɛ ha a kai nyɛ tɔmi ɔmɛ; a je kpo paa ngɛ nihi tsuo a hɛ mi; mɛ tsuo a na kaa nyɛ yeɔ fɔ; nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ pee ɔ, yayami sɔuu. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ma ha nyɛ he nyɛli maa nuu nyɛ nine nya.
25“Nɛ mo, Israel ganɔ, nɔmlɔ yayami, kɛ yiwutsotsɛ, o nyagbe ji nɛ ɔ nɛ; be nɛ a maa gbla o tue wawɛɛ ɔ su jehanɛ. 26Bɔ nɛ imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, i ngɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. Pɛne o yi fimi nɔ́ ɔ, je matsɛ pɛɛ ɔ ngɛ o yi! Níhi ma tsake; bɔ nɛ a ngɛ ɔ, a be ja hie hu; nɔ́ nɛ ba si ɔ a ma wo nɔ; nɔ́ nɛ a wo nɔ ɔ, a maa ba lɛ si! Wó ni guhi nɔ yeli. Ha nɛ nɔ yeli nɛ ba pee ni guhi! 27Ma doku, ma doku oo, ma doku! Ma pee ma a ma doku! Se nɔ́ nɛ ɔ be mi bae kɛ yaa si nɔ nɛ e sa kaa e tsuɔ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ maa ba; nɛ ma ngɔ ma a kɛ wo e dɛ mi.
Klaate ko kɛ Amon bi ɔmɛ
28 “Nɔmlɔ adesa, gbaa, nɛ o fiɛ ke Amon bi ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ Israel hɛ mi si puee ɔ, imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, i ngɛ mɛ dee ke,
‘A hia klaate ko nɛ a kɛ ma kpata nihi a hɛ mi.
A sa klaate ɔ he, nɛ e ngɛ kpɛe nylamnylam
kaa oslabai, konɛ a kɛ gbe nihi.
29Ninahi nɛ nyɛ na a tsuo, lakpa sɔuu; gbamihi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ gbae ɔ hu jã kɛ̃. Nyɛ yiwutsotsɛmɛ nɛ yayami pɛ nyɛ peeɔ, nyɛ be ɔ su ta; be nɛ a maa gbla nyɛ tue ɔ ma oo! A kɛ klaate ma kpata nyɛ hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ.’
30“Nyɛ ke, ‘Kpale klaate ɔ se kɛ wo e kpo ɔ mi! Dɛbi! He nɛ a bɔ nyɛ ade ngɛ, zugba nɔ he nɛ a fɔ nyɛ ngɛ ɔ, lejɛ ɔ ma gbla nyɛ tue ngɛ. 31Nyɛ maa nu ye abofu nɛ nya wa a he, be mi nɛ ma gli kɛ wo nyɛ kaa la nɛ ngɛ tsoe plamplam. Ma ngɔ nyɛ kɛ wo dikali nɛ le ga nɛ a kɛ kpataa nɔ hɛ mi a dɛ mi. 32A kɛ la maa sã nyɛ. A ma pue nyɛ muɔ si ngɛ nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ zugba nɔ, nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be nyɛ kaie gblegbleegble.’ ” Yawɛ lɛ de.

Title: EZEKIEL 22
Content:
Yayamihi nɛ Yerusalem pee
1Yawɛ kɛ mi tu munyu ekohu, 2nɛ e de mi ke, “Nɔmlɔ adesa, anɛ o pee klaalo nɛ o maa kojo ma nɛ muɔ si pɛ a pueɔ ngɛ mi ɔ lo? Ke jã a, lɛɛ ha nɛ e le ní hiemi níhi nɛ e pee ɔ tsuo. 3De lɛ ke bɔ nɛ imi, Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ i ngɛ dee ji, mo ma nɛ o pue muɔ si babauu, nɛ o puɛ amagahi nɛ o ja mɛ kɛ ble o he, o be ɔ su ta. 4O yeɔ fɔ kaa o pue muɔ si, nɛ o puɛ amagahi, nɛ o ja mɛ kɛ ble o he. Hyɛ, o ha nɛ o nyagbe ɔ na mo haa! O be ɔ su. Lɔ ɔ he nɛ i ha je ma amɛ ngɛ mo ahlua bɔe, nɛ zugba amɛ tsuo ngɛ o he fɛu yee ɔ nɛ. 5Nihi nɛ ngɛ ma se tsitsaa, kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ kpo nya tsuo maa ye o he fɛu; ejakaa o he guɛ gbo, nɛ basabasa sɔuu a peeɔ ngɛ o mi. 6Israel ganɔ ɔmɛ a ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ ngɔ e hɛ ngɔ fɔ lɛ nitsɛ e he wami nɔ; a pueɔ muɔ si bɔ nɛ a suɔ. 7 Nɔ ko nɔ ko be ma a mi nɛ buɔ e fɔli. O yeɔ nibwɔhi amimi, nɛ o waa awusahi, kɛ yalɔyihi hu yi mi. 8 O gbeɔ ye ní klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ a he guɛ, nɛ o bleɔ ye Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔmɛ. 9Ni komɛ yeɔ lakpa ngɛ ma a mi, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ a kpata a nyɛmimɛ a hɛ mi. Ni komɛ ya yeɔ niye ní bɔhi nɛ a sã ngɛ jami hehi; nɛ ni komɛ hu dii he lo akɔnɔ se wawɛɛ. 10 Nyumu ɔmɛ ekomɛ kɛ a tsɛmɛ a yihi po hwɔɔ si; nɛ yihi nɛ ku nine po, nyumu komɛ kɛ mɛ hwɔɔ si pani nya. 11Ni komɛ kɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a nyɛmimɛ a yihi hwɔɔ si; ni komɛ kɛ a nganyɛmɛ, nɛ ni komɛ hu kɛ a tsɛmɛ a biyihi hwɔɔ nɛ́ zo pee we mɛ. 12 Nyɛ ti ni komɛ heɔ nyɔ mi ní nɛ a kɛ pueɔ muɔ si. Ni komɛ paa sika kɛ haa a nyɛmimɛ Israel fɔfɔɛhi, nɛ a heɔ hekpa fuu ngɛ a dɛ kɛ naa a he kpɔtɔɔ. Nɛ a hɛ je ye nɔ.” Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ lɛ de.
13“Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ma tsɛ̃ ye nguɛ nya ngɛ ojo nɛ a ngɛ yee, kɛ muɔ si nɛ a ngɛ puee ɔ he. 14Ke i kɛ mo ná a, anɛ o ma nyɛ maa to tsui si, nɛ o maa pee kã kɛ ya si nyagbe lo? Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de, nɛ ma pee hulɔ. 15Ma tsɛ̃ o yi se kɛ ya je ma amɛ a mi, nɛ ma gbɛ mo ngɔ fĩa zugba a nɔ tsuo. Kɛkɛ ɔ, ní yayamihi nɛ o peeɔ kɛ woɔ o he mu ɔ, ma ha o ma kpa peemi. 16O hɛ mi ma pue si ngɛ je ma amɛ a hɛ mi; se moo lɛɛ, o ma na maa le kaa imi ji Yawɛ.”
Mawu maa tsu Israel he ngɛ flɔɔnɔɔ mi
17Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ kɛ mi tu munyu. 18E ke, “Nɔmlɔ adesa, de Israel bi ɔmɛ ke, Israel ma a he be se nami ha mi! A ngɛ kaa sika fĩ nɛ jeɔ akɔblee, sika hiɔ, dade, loo sumui mi, ke a tsu he se ɔ. 19Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, i ngɛ mɛ dee ke mɛ tsuo kulaa se nami ko kulaa be a he. Ma bua a nya kɛ ba Yerusalem ma a mi. 20Kaa bɔ nɛ a buaa sika hiɔ, akɔblee, dade, kɛ sumui nya ngɔ woɔ flɔɔnɔɔ mi, nɛ a huu la kɛ woɔ he, nɛ a sileɔ ɔ, ja pɛpɛɛpɛ ma bua a nya kɛ ba ma a mi. Ma ngɔ abofu kɛ hɛdɔ kɛ sile mɛ kaa bɔ nɛ la sileɔ dade ɔ. 21Ee, ma bua a nya kɛ ba Yerusalem ma a mi; ma slɛ la kɛ wo a sisi. Ye mi mi la a ma mle mɛ, nɛ a maa sile. 22Ee, a maa sile mɛ ngɛ Yerusalem kaa a sileɔ sika hiɔ ngɛ flɔɔnɔɔ mi! Lɔ ɔ loko a maa le kaa imi Yawɛ lɛ i ngɛ a tue gblae ɔ nɛ.”
Yayamihi nɛ Israel ganɔ ɔmɛ pee
23Yawɛ kɛ mi tu munyu ekohu. 24E ke, “Nɔmlɔ adesa, de Israel bi ɔmɛ ke, ligbi ɔ nɛ ye mi mi ma fu ɔ, nyɛ maa pee kaa zugba nɛ a hu we, nɛ́ hiɔmi hu nɛ́ ngɛ nɔ. 25Nyɛ ganɔ ɔmɛ ya so, nɛ a pee a he kaa jata nɛ ngɛ huãe nɛ ngɛ lohwe nɛ e gbe mi tsɔtslɔɔe. A gbee nihi, nɛ a ngɔɔ a sika, kɛ a weto ní tsuo ngɛ a dɛ. Nyumuhi babauu nɛ a gbe ɔ ha yalɔyihi hu a he ba hiɛ ngɛ ma a mi. 26 Osɔfo ɔmɛ plɛɔ ye mlaa a hɛ mi buɔ si, nɛ a bleɔ ye ní klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ. A li slɔɔto nɛ ngɛ nɔ́ klɔuklɔu, kɛ nɔ́ gu a kpɛti. A tsɔɔ we ni ɔmɛ slɔɔto nɛ ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ he tsɔ, kɛ nɔ́ nɛ he tsɔ we a kpɛti. A kuɔ a hɛ ngɔ fɔɔ Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ nɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Israel bi ɔmɛ bui mi fɛɛ. 27Ganɔ ɔmɛ ngɛ kaa ogbeteehi nɛ ngɛ a de lo mi tsɔtslɔɔe. A gbeɔ nɔ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ a na ní yaka. 28Gbali ɔmɛ laa yayamihi a nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ a kɛ kalo saa gbogbo he. Lakpa ninahi a naa, nɛ a gbami ɔmɛ hu lakpa sɔuu. A deɔ ke Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ lɛ tsɔ mɛ, be mi nɛ imi Yawɛ, i de we mɛ nɔ́ ko kulaa. 29Zugba a nɔ bi ɔmɛ tsuo yeɔ amimi, nɛ a haa níhi; a waa dɛgutsɛ, kɛ ohiatsɛmɛ yi mi. A yeɔ nubwɔ amimi wawɛɛ nitsɛ nɛ a yɛ se. 30I hla nɔ ko nɛ maa po piɛ kɛ wo a he, loo nɛ e maa tsi puɔ ɔ nɛ ngɛ gbogbo ɔ mi ɔ ha ma a, konɛ ma ko puɛ zugba a, se i nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko. 31Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i ngɔ abofu nɛ nya wa kɛ gbla a tue. Ye mi mi la a kpata a hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ ngɛ a ní yayamihi nɛ a pee ɔ a he!” Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ lɛ de.

Title: EZEKIEL 23
Content:
Nyɛmiyi enyɔ ɔmɛ
1Yawɛ kɛ mi tu munyu ekohu. 2E de mi ke, “Nɔmlɔ adesa, be ko ɔ, yi enyɔ komɛ hi si; nɔ kɛ e senɔ, nɛ ji yo kake bimɛ. 3A puɛ kulaa kɛ ajuama bɔmi kɛ je a yihe mi tɔɔ ngɛ Egipt. Lejɛ ɔ nɛ nyumuhi fiɛ a nyɔhi a he, nɛ a puɛ mɛ ngɛ. 4Nɔkɔtɔma a biɛ ji Ohola, nɛ e senɔ ɔ biɛ ji Oholiba. I ngɔ mɛ ngɔ pee ye yihi, nɛ a fɔ bimɛ nyumuhi kɛ yihi ha mi. Biɛ Ohola a daa si ha Samaria, nɛ Oholiba hu daa si ha Yerusalem. 5Ohola je ye se ya puɛ gba. E kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ je Asiria mohu ya pee e suɔli. 6Ta buli nɛ wo tade he jua wawɛ nɛ hɛɛ alamua tu su, amlaalohi, kɛ asafoatsɛmɛ, mɛ tsuo nihewi okpɔngɔ ta buli nɛ a he ngɛ fɛu nɛ e ya su. 7Ohola kɛ Asiria nyumuhi nɛ ngɛ biɛ bɔ ajuama, nɛ e ja a we amagahi kɛ ble e he. 8Yahomi nɛ e je sisi kɛ je e yihe mi ngɛ Egipt, he nɛ a fiɛ e nyɔ he, nɛ a kɛ lɛ bɔ ajuama nɛ a puɛ lɛ ngɛ ɔ, e kpa we. 9Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, imi hu i ngɔ lɛ ngɔ wo Asiria bi ɔmɛ nɛ mɛ e suɔ wawɛɛ ɔ a dɛ mi. 10Ni nɛ ɔmɛ kpa e he bo, nɛ a ngɔ e bimɛ nyumu ɔmɛ kɛ yi ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ ho, nɛ lɛ nitsɛ lɛɛ, a kɛ klaate gbe lɛ. E tue gblami nɛ ɔ ba pee fɛu yemi nɔ́ ha yihi tsuo.
11“Oholiba na nɔ́ nɛ ba awenyɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ, se e ya nɔ nɛ e bɔ ajuama kulaa pe lɛ. 12Lɛ hu e ya nyɛɛ Asiria nyumu ɔmɛ a se, nɛ e kɛ mɛ pee e suɔli. Ta buli nɛ mia saminyayoo kɛ ta hwumi ní, amlaalohi kɛ asafoatsɛmɛ, mɛ tsuo nihewi nɛ a he ngɛ fɛu nɛ a hii okpɔngɔhi a nɔ nɛ e ya su. 13I na kaa e puɛ kulaa; nyɛmimɛ yihi enyɔ nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, slɔɔto ko be a kpɛti.
14-15“Oholiba yahomi ɔ nya wa nɛ e hí nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko peemi. Benɛ e na Babilonia ma ní tsuli a foni nɛ a tɛni ngɛ gbogbo he, bɔ nɛ a ngɔ nɔ́ tsu kɛ pee, nɛ mlɛ mi fimi níhi ngɛ a mlɛ mi, kɛ yi fimi duku gagaaga saminyawiiwi ngɛ a yi mi ɔ, e pee lɛ fɛu tsɔ. 16Amlɔ nɔuu nɛ e na a foni ɔmɛ ɔ, a he pee lɛ akɔnɔ, nɛ e tsɔ kɛ ya tsɛ mɛ ngɛ Babilonia tɔɔ. 17Babilonia nyumu ɔmɛ ba e ngɔ, nɛ a kɛ lɛ ba hwɔ bɔ nɛ a ma nyɛ. A pee lɛ basabasa, nɛ a ble lɛ kɛ ya si a he pee lɛ tai. 18Benɛ e ngɛ ajuama bɔe wawɛɛ, nɛ e ha nɔ tsuaa nɔ na le kaa yaholɔ nitsɛnitsɛ ji lɛ ɔ, imi hu e sane ba gbe ye nya jehanɛ; i sume lɛ hu, kaa bɔ nɛ i sume e nyɛmiyo nɔkɔtɔma a. 19Se kɛ̃ ɔ, e ya nɔ nɛ e bɔ ajuama a; e pee e he yaholɔ kulaa. E kai e yihe mi, benɛ e bɔ ajuama basaa ngɛ Egipt ɔ. 20E kai e suɔli nɛ a nyumu tso kle kaa tejihi a nɔ́, nɛ a he mi abua nya wa kaa okpɔngɔ kuhi a nɔ́ ɔ.” 21(Oholiba, o yihe mi zo ní nɛ o tsu benɛ Egipt bi ɔmɛ fiɛ o nyɔ he, nɛ a puɛ mo kɛ pee yaholɔ ɔ, lɔ ɔ o ngɛ hlae nɛ o tsu ekohu nɛ ɔ nɛ.)
Mawu gbla Oholiba tue
22“Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Oholiba, bɔ nɛ imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, i ngɛ mo dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: O suɔli ɔmɛ a sane ba gbe o nya nɛ o sume mɛ hu; se ma ha a maa te si kɛ wo mo; a ma ba sa o yi. 23Ma ngɔ Babilonia bi ɔmɛ tsuo, kɛ Kaldea bi ɔmɛ, nihi nɛ je Pekod, Shoa, kɛ Koa kɛ ba; Asiria bi ɔmɛ tsuo maa ba. Amlaalohi, kɛ asafoatsɛmɛ, mɛ tsuo nihewi nɛ a he ngɛ fɛu, tsɔli nikɔtɔmahi, kɛ ta buli, mɛ tsuo a maa hi okpɔngɔhi a nɔ kɛ ba. 24Ta buli kɛ a ta zugba lɛhi babauu, kɛ a tlɔɔkehi kɛ a mi tlomi maa je omleyi je kɛ ba tua mo. A kɛ tsɛ̃i agbohi, tsɛ̃i wawi, kɛ dade pɛɛ ma gba ta kɛ wo o he. Ma ha a maa kojo mo ngɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a mlaa nya. 25Akɛnɛ o wo ye mi mi la he je ɔ, a kɛ abofu maa gbla o tue. A maa poo o gugwɔ, kɛ o tuehi ngɛ o he; a kɛ klaate maa gbe ni komɛ. Ee, a maa ngɔ o binyumu ɔmɛ, kɛ o biyi ɔmɛ kɛ ho, nɛ nihi nɛ maa piɛ ɔ, a maa sã mɛ. 26A ma kplɔ o he tade, nɛ a maa ngɔ o june saminyawiiwi ɔmɛ. 27Ma ha o yahomi, kɛ ajuama bɔmi basaa nɛ o hɛɛ mi kɛ je Egipt zugba a nɔ ɔ se maa po kulaa. O be amagahi hyɛe, nɛ o be Egipt bi ɔmɛ kaie gblegbleegble hu.”
28Bɔ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ngɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Ma ngɔ mo ngɔ wo o he nyɛli a dɛ mi, nihi nɛ a he pee mo tai, nɛ o sume mɛ hu ɔ, 29a kɛ mo maa ye kaa a he nyɛlɔ. Níhi babauu nɛ o gbo he dengme ɔ tsuo a maa muɔ kɛ ho, nɛ a ma si mo ngɔ fɔ si kɛ o he gu saplapaa. Kɛkɛ ɔ, nihi maa na o yahomi, kɛ ajuama bɔmi basaa a tsuo paa. O pee o he yaholɔ, 30nɛ o kɛ je ma amɛ ya bɔ ajuama; o ya ja a we amaga amɛ kɛ ble o he. 31O ya wo o nyɛmiyo ɔ nane, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, tue gblami kplu ɔ nɛ i ha o nyɛmi ɔ, lɔ ɔ nɔuu ma ha mo.”
32Yawɛ ke,
“O nyɛmiyo ɔ kplu ɔ kle;
e mi kuɔ hulɔ.
O maa nu nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ mi ɔ tsuo.
A maa muɔ mo,
a maa ye o he fɛu,
ejakaa kplu ɔ hyi buɛii.
33E ma ha o maa pee basaa
kaa nɔ nɛ tɔ dã.
Gbeye níhi, kɛ he hiami níhi sɔuu
lɛ ngɛ o nyɛmiyo Samaria kplu ɔ mi.
34Ma ha o maa nu,
nɛ o ma lɔ kplu ɔ mi.
O kɛ he hiami maa fa o yi bwɔmi,
nɛ o kɛ kplu kokoe ɔmɛ maa plaa o nyɔ.
Imi, Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ lɛ i de.”
35Bɔ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ngɛ mo dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “O hɛ je ye nɔ, nɛ o plɛ se ngɔ wo mi; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, o maa na o yahomi, kɛ o we ajuama bɔmi ɔ mi nɔ́.”
Mawu gbla nyɛmiyi enyɔ ɔmɛ tsuo a tue
36Yawɛ de mi ke, “Nɔmlɔ adesa, anɛ o maa kojo Ohola kɛ Oholiba lo? Lɛɛ, tsɔɔ mɛ ní hiemi níhi gbegbeegbe nɛ a pee ɔ. 37A puɛ gba kɛ a we amaga jami ɔ; a pue muɔ si, nɛ binyumuwi nɛ a fɔ ha mi ɔ po a kɛ mɛ sã bɔ ha amagahi. 38Nɔ́ nɛ a pee kɛ si mi hu ji, ligbi ɔ nɛ a ble ye we klɔuklɔu ɔ, jamɛ a ligbi ɔ nɔuu a ble ye Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ. 39Ejakaa benɛ a gbe ye bimɛ ɔmɛ ha a we amaga amɛ ɔ, a ba ye he klɔuklɔu ɔ jamɛ a ligbi ɔ nɔuu, nɛ a ba ble lejɛ ɔ!
40“Be komɛ po ɔ, a maa tsɔ nihi kɛ ya tsitsaa ya tsɛ nyumuhi kɛ ba ha mɛ. Ke a ba a, nyɛmiyi enyɔ ɔmɛ maa du a he; a ma kpa a hɛ se tsopa, nɛ a kɛ june ma dla a he. 41A maa hi sɛ saminyayoo nɔ; a maa ngɔ okplɔɔ kɛ e nɔ ní kpakpahi kɛ ya ma si ngɛ a hɛ mi. Tsopa kɛ e he via, kɛ oliv nu nɛ i ha mɛ ɔ hu piɛ he. 42Kɛkɛ ɔ, hoo peemi, kɛ nyami he a nuɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. A ya ngɔɔ dã tɔli kɛ jeɔ nga a nɔ kɛ ba piɛɔ nihi babauu nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ momo ɔ a he. A ngɔɔ nine si gahi kɛ woɔ yi ɔmɛ a nine si, nɛ a ngɔɔ jlasi saminyawiiwi kɛ fiɔ a yi. 43Kɛkɛ nɛ i de ye he ke, hyɛ kaa yo nɛ bwɔ kikɛ nɛ ɔ ngɛ ajuama bɔmi mi ɔ, nyumuhi kɛ lɛ pa ngɛ si hwɔe! 44Nyumuhi ngɛ a ngɔ yae kaa bɔ nɛ a yaa yihi yaholi a ngɔ. Ee, ja pɛpɛɛpɛ a ngɛ Ohola kɛ Oholiba nɔ puee; a pee a he ajamɛatsɛmɛ! 45Nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ nɛ da maa bu mɛ fɔ kaa a puɛ gba, nɛ a pue muɔ si hulɔ; ejakaa a ngɔ yahomi kɛ pee a ní tsumi, nɛ a pue muɔ si.”
46Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ ngɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Ma ha yakayaka nimli babauu ma ba wo a he gbeye, nɛ a maa ha a níhi. 47Yakayaka nimli nɛ ɔmɛ maa fia mɛ tɛ, nɛ a ma ja mɛ klaate; a maa gbe a bimɛ, nɛ a maa mɛ a we ɔmɛ a he la. 48Ma ha yahomi se maa po ngɛ zugba a nɔ, konɛ a kɛ bɔ yihi tsuo kɔkɔ nɛ a ko tsu yahomi ní nɛ nyɛmiyi enyɔ ɔmɛ tsu ɔ gblegbleegble. 49Nɛ nyɛ, nyɛmiyi enyɔ nɛ ɔmɛ, ma gbla nyɛ tue kaa nyɛ bɔ ajuama nɛ nyɛ ya ja amagahi. Lɔ ɔ loko nyɛ maa le kaa imi ji Yawɛ.”

Title: EZEKIEL 24
Content:
Buɛ kɛ e mi kana a
1Benɛ a nuu wɔ kɛ ho ma se ya a, jeha nɛɛne ɔ we nyɔhiɔ nyɔngma a we ligbi nyɔngma a, Yawɛ kɛ mi tu munyu ekohu. 2 E fa mi ke, “Nɔmlɔ adesa, kadi mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ biɛ ngɛ womi mi kɛ to! Ejakaa mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ nɔuu Babilonia matsɛ ɔ bɔni Yerusalem he ka womi. 3Buu abɛ nɛ ɔ kɛ tsɔɔ ma tue gboli nɛ ɔmɛ; nɛ o de mɛ ke abɛ nɛ ɔ, imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ nitsɛ lɛ i ngɛ mɛ bue.
Ngɔɔ buɛ ɔ kɛ ma la a nɔ;
yɛɛ nyu kɛ wo buɛ ɔ mi.
4Ngɔɔ lo nɛ o saa a tsuo kɛ wo mi;
lo kpakpa a tsuo, kɔni ɔ kɛ fiɔ ɔ,
kɛ wu kpakpa pe kulaa a hulɔ;
ngɔɔ mɛ tsuo kɛ wo buɛ ɔ mi.
5Gbee to nɛ hi pe kulaa,
ngɔɔ e lo ɔ tsuo kɛ wo buɛ ɔ mi;
moo to lɛ́ kɛ wo sisi.
Ha nɛ e fia nɛ e be saminya;
wu ɔmɛ tete po, a be ngɛ buɛ ɔ mi.”
6Bɔ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ngɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Musu tloo ma nɛ muɔ si pɛ a pueɔ ngɛ mi ɔ! Ma a ngɛ kaa buɛ ko nɛ e mi nɔ kana, nɛ́ kana a ma ngɛ mi. A tá e mi lo ɔmɛ kakaaka ta; ekoeko piɛ ngɛ mi! 7A pue muɔ si ngɛ ma a mi. Pi zugba nɛ muɔ ɔ pue nɛ a maa ngɔ tabo zu kɛ tsi nɔ, se tɛ sa kpataa nɔ. 8Ee, i si muɔ ɔ ngɛ tɛ sa kpataa a nɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ a na paa, konɛ a kɛ abofu nɛ nya wa nɛ ye lue.”
9Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, bɔ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ngɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Musu tloo ma nɛ muɔ si pɛ a pueɔ ngɛ mi ɔ! Imi hu ma bua lɛ́ nya glegle kɛ wo e sisi! 10Ma ngɔ lɛ́ babauu kɛ ba! Ma ha la a maa tso wawɛɛ, nɛ lo ɔ maa be saminya! Hwonyu ɔ maa si, nɛ wu ɔmɛ tete ma ngla! 11Jehanɛ, ma ha buɛ ɔ mi gu maa ma la hleii ɔ nɔ, konɛ e dɔ la kɛ yaa si akɔblee ɔ maa tsu paa; kɛkɛ ɔ, e mi mu ɔ tsuo maa sile, nɛ e mi kana a tsuo maa ta pɛsɛpɛsɛ! 12Hyɛ kaa i gbo dengme yaka! Bɔ nɛ a peeɔ pɛ i pee nɛ ɔ nɛ; se kana babauu pa ngɛ buɛ ɔ mi kɛ sa; la a po nyɛ we kana a nɛ e je. 13Yerusalem, o yahomi basaa nɛ puɛ mo ɔ ji kana a nɛ. I gbo dengme kɛ bɔ o he mɔde, konɛ o he nɛ tsɔ; se mu ɔ ngɛ o he kpamisa. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, o he be tsɔe kɛ je o mu ní peemi ní ɔmɛ a mi hu kɛ yaa si be nɛ ma ngɔ mi mi la kɛ gbla o tue wawɛɛ. 14Imi, Yawɛ nitsɛ lɛ i de. Be ɔ su jehanɛ; bɔ nɛ i de ɔ, ja ma pee. I be ye nya se kpalee; i be mɔbɔ nae, nɛ i be ye he piae hulɔ. Yayamihi nɛ o pee ɔ a he ɔ, ma gbla o tue bɔ nɛ sa mo.” Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ lɛ de.
Gbalɔ ɔ yo ɔ gbenɔ
15Yawɛ kɛ mi tu munyu ekohu. 16E ke, “Nɔmlɔ adesa, tlukaa a, ma ha gbenɔ hiɔ ma ba fia o suɔlɔ pe kulaa a, nɛ e ma gbo. Ke e ba mi ja a, koo ye kɔmɔ; ko fo ya, nɛ koo nga vo nyu hulɔ. 17A ko nu o huu fami he; se fi o yi duku, nɛ o wo tokota. Koo ngɔ nɔ́ kɛ ha o nya nɔ, nɛ koo ye ya nɔ niye ní kɛ tsɔɔ kaa o ngɛ ya nyɛe.”
18Mɔtu kpla a, i kɛ ma mi bi ɔmɛ tu munyu. Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ gbɔkuɛ nɔuu nɛ ye yo ɔ gbo. E nɔ jena mɔtu ɔ, i pee kaa bɔ nɛ a de mi ke ma pee ɔ. 19Kɛkɛ nɛ ma mi bi ɔmɛ bi mi ke, “Mɛni he je o ngɛ níhi pee kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ?”
20Kɛkɛ nɛ i de mɛ ke, “Yawɛ kɛ mi tu munyu, nɛ e de mi ke 21ma ngɔ sɛ gbi nɛ ɔ kɛ ha Israel ma a, nɛ ma de mɛ ke, bɔ nɛ imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, i de ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: Ma ble ye he klɔuklɔu ɔ, he nɛ nyɛ fĩaa ngɔ fɔɔ nɔ ke nyɛ naa he wami kɛ jeɔ ɔ. We ɔ peeɔ nyɛ fɛu saminya, nɛ nyɛ suɔ kɛ nyɛ tsui tsuo kaa nyɛ maa ya lejɛ ɔ. Ma ha nyɛ bimɛ, yi ɔmɛ kɛ nyumu ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ nyɛ si ngɛ Yerusalem ɔ maa nɔ ngɛ klaate nya. 22Kɛkɛ ɔ, nyɛ maa pee kaa bɔ nɛ i pee nɛ ɔ: nyɛ be nɔ́ ngɔe kɛ ha nyɛ nya nɔ, nɛ nyɛ be ya nɔ ní hu yee. 23Nyɛ yi fimi ní ɔmɛ maa fi nyɛ yi; nyɛ tokota amɛ maa hi nyɛ nane; nyɛ be kɔmɔ yee, nɛ nyɛ be ya foe. Se yayamihi nɛ nyɛ pee ɔ ma ha nyɛ maa ta he lo, nɛ nyɛ ma kɛmɛ kɛ tsɔɔ nyɛ sibi. 24Nɛ imi Ezekiel, ma pee nɔ́ hyɛmi nɔ́ ha nyɛ; bɔ nɛ i pee ɔ, ja pɛpɛɛpɛ nyɛ maa pee. Yawɛ ke, ke nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ba mi ɔ, nyɛ maa le kaa lɛ ji Yawɛ ɔ nɛ.”
25“Nɛ mo, nɔmlɔ adesa, jamɛ a ligbi ɔ nɛ ma kpɔ a he wami ɔ ngɛ a dɛ, nɛ a bua jɔmi, a hɛ mi nyami, kɛ afɛu nɔ́, kɛ nɔ́ nɛ a suɔ kɛ a tsui tsuo ɔ maa laa mɛ ɔ, a binyumuhi, kɛ a biyihi tsuo a hɛ mi ma kpata. 26Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, nɔ ko nɛ yi na wami kɛ je hɛ mi kpatami ɔ mi ma ba bɔ mo amaniɛ. 27Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, o kɛ nɔ nɛ yi na wami ɔ maa sɛɛ ní. O maa tu munyu, nɛ o be mumui pee hu. O ma plɛ pee okadi ha mɛ, konɛ a le kaa imi ji Yawɛ.”

Title: EZEKIEL 25
Content:
A ma kpata Amon hɛ mi
1 Yawɛ kɛ mi tu munyu ekohu. 2E ke, “Nɔmlɔ adesa, plɛ o hɛ mi kɛ kpee Amon bi ɔmɛ, nɛ o de mɛ ke a ma kpata a hɛ mi. 3De Amon bi ɔmɛ ke á bu nɔ́ nɛ imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, i ngɛ mɛ dee ɔ tue. Benɛ a ble ye he klɔuklɔu ɔ, nɛ a ha Israel zugba a nɔ je gu, nɛ a nuu Yuda bi ɔmɛ kɛ ho ma se ya a, nyɛ muɔ nɛ nyɛ de ke, ‘Yiɛɛ!’ 4Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ma ngɔ nyɛ kɛ wo nihi nɛ je beleku je ɔ a dɛ mi. A maa ngɔ nyɛ zugba a kɛ pee a nɔ́. A ma ba po wehi ngɛ he nɛ nyɛ ngɛ ɔ, nɛ a kɛ nyɛ maa hi si. A maa ye nyɛ tso yiblii, nɛ a maa nu nyɛ na nyɔ nyu. 5Raba ma a ma plɛ pee nga nɔ he nɛ afukpɔngɔhi maa ye ní ngɛ. Ma ha Amon bi ɔmɛ a zugba a tsuo ma plɛ pee to lɛmi he. Lɔ ɔ loko nyɛ maa le kaa imi ji Yawɛ.
6“Bɔ nɛ imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, i ngɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: O fia o dɛ mi, nɛ o si si. O bui Israel zugba a, ejakaa o ngɛ e he juɛmi yaya. 7Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i kɛ mo ná; ma ngɔ mo ngɔ ha je ma amɛ nɛ a ha o níhi. A ma je mo ngɔ hɛ ngɔ fɔ, nɛ o hɛ mi ma kpata pɛsɛpɛsɛ kɛ maa je je ɔ mi. Kɛkɛ ɔ, o maa le kaa imi ji Yawɛ.”
A ma kpata Moab hɛ mi
8 Bɔ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ngɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Moab bi ɔmɛ de ke Yuda ngɛ kaa je ma kpa amɛ tsuo, 9lɔ ɔ he ɔ, mahi nɛ bɔle Moab zugba a kɛ kpe, nɛ fãã e he ɔ, ma ha nɛ a ma ba tua mɛ, nɛ a maa gbɛ mɛ ngɔ fĩa. A ma tua lejɛ ɔ ma nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a ngɛ fɛu pe kulaa a hulɔ: Bet Yeshimot, Baal Meon kɛ Kiriataim. 10Ma ha nihi nɛ je beleku je ma ba tua Moab, kɛ Amon bi ɔmɛ tsuo si kake. A maa ye Moab nɔ; a ma kpata e hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ, nɛ a be e biɛ tete po kaie ngɛ je ma amɛ a kpɛti hu. 11Ma gbla Moab tue wawɛɛ; kɛkɛ ɔ, a maa le kaa imi ji Yawɛ.”
A ma kpata Edom hɛ mi
12 Bɔ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ngɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Yi wu tso níhi nɛ Edom pee kɛ to níhi nɛ Yuda pee lɛ ɔ nane mi ɔ hiɛ tsɔ; e he lue nɛ e ye ɔ, e pee tɔmi agbo. 13Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i ngɛ dee ke ma gbla Edom tue wawɛɛ; ma kpata nimlihi, kɛ lohwehi tsuo a hɛ mi ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Nihi babauu maa nɔ ngɛ ta mi kɛ maa je Teman kɛ yaa si Dedan tɔɔ. Nɛ Edom zugba a ma ba pee ma doku. 14Ma ha ye ma Israel hu kɛ Edom maa to ní; nɛ Edom maa na bɔ nɛ ye we abofu nya wa ha ke i ngɛ nɔ́ ko tue gblae ɔ.” Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ lɛ de.
A ma kpata Filistia hɛ mi
15 Bɔ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ngɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Yi wu tso níhi nɛ Filistia bi ɔmɛ pee kɛ to nɔ́ nɛ a blema he nyɛli ɔmɛ pee mɛ ɔ nane mi ɔ nya wa; a kɛ ninyɛ kadikadi kpata a he nyɛli ɔmɛ a hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ. 16Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i ngɛ dee ke, i kɛ Filisti bi ɔmɛ maa to ní; ma tua mɛ, nɛ ma kpata a hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ; Keret bi ɔmɛ, kɛ nihi tsuo nɛ ngɛ wo nya ma amɛ a mi ɔ be a he yee. 17Ma gbla a tue wawɛɛ nitsɛ. Ma ngɔ abofu kɛ gbla a tue, nɛ a maa nu he. Lɔ ɔ loko a maa le kaa imi ji Yawɛ.”

Title: EZEKIEL 26
Content:
A ma kpata Tiro hɛ mi
1 Benɛ a nuu wɔ kɛ ho ma se ya a se jeha nyɔngma kɛ kakene ɔ we kekleekle ligbi ngɛ nyɔhiɔ ko mi ɔ, Yawɛ kɛ mi tu munyu. 2E ke, “Nɔmlɔ adesa, bɔ nɛ Tiro bi ɔmɛ ngɛ nyae, nɛ a ngɛ dee ngɛ Yerusalem he ji, ‘Yiɛɛ! A ku Yerusalem ngɔ pue si! E jua yemi, kɛ ní nɛ e na a tsuo ma ba je wa ngɔ.’
3“Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, bɔ nɛ imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, i ngɛ dee ji: Tiro, i kɛ mo ná. Ma ha je mahi babauu ma ba tua mo; a maa ba nɔtonɔto kaa bɔ nɛ wo oslɔkehi kuɔ kɛ baa wo dɔ mi. 4A ma kpata o ma a hɛ mi; a maa ku gbogbo ɔmɛ, kɛ mɔ gojogojo ɔmɛ kɛ pue si. Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, imi nitsɛ ma bɛɛ zu ɔ tsuo kɛ je lejɛ ɔ kɛ ho, nɛ e maa piɛ tɛ sa kpataa kɛkɛ. 5Wo hɛli ma ka a yahi ngɛ tɛ sa a nɔ, ngɛ wo ɔ kpɛti he nɛ e maa si ngɛ ɔ. Imi, Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ lɛ i de. Je ma amɛ ma ba ha ní ngɛ Tiro; 6nɛ a kɛ a klaate maa gbe nimli ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ ngɛ ma amɛ a mi ngɛ zugba a nɔ. Lɔ ɔ loko Tiro maa le kaa imi ji Yawɛ.”
7Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ya nɔ nɛ e de ke, “Ma ha Nebukadnezar, Babilonia matsɛ nguaa pe kulaa a ma ba tua Tiro. E kɛ e tabo babauu nitsɛ, nihi nɛ hi okpɔngɔhi a nɔ, nihi nɛ ngɛ ta zugba lɛhi a mi, kɛ nihi nɛ nyɛɛ nane maa je omleyi je kɛ ba. 8Nihi nɛ ngɛ o ma amɛ a mi ngɛ nga a nɔ ɔ, ma kpata a hɛ mi. Ma ha o he nyɛlɔ ɔ maa tsua muɔ kɛ bɔle mo; e maa fia kpoku kɛ wo o he, nɛ e kɛ tsɛ̃i maa ma si kaa gbogbo kɛ bɔle mo. 9E maa ngɔ e gbogbo kumi ní ɔmɛ kɛ si o gbogbo ɔmɛ, nɛ o mɔ gojogojo ɔmɛ hu, e maa ngɔ e dade ɔmɛ kɛ ku mɛ kɛ pue si. 10E we okpɔngɔhi maa hiɛ babauu nɛ a se bunyuku ɔ maa laa o nɔ. Okpɔngɔ ɔmɛ, e ní gblami tlɔɔke ɔmɛ, kɛ e ta zugba lɛ ɔmɛ maa sɛ agbo ɔmɛ a mi gidigidi kaa a sɛɔ ma ko nɛ a ye e nɔ momo mi. A hoo peemi ɔ ma mimiɛ o gbogbo ɔmɛ tete. 11Okpɔngɔ nɔ hili ɔmɛ kɛ a dɛ mi klaate maa wo okpɔngɔ ɔmɛ fo kɛ gu ma a gbɛjegbɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ. Nɔ ko nɔ ko be e he yee ngɛ a blɔ mi. A maa gbe nimli ɔmɛ tsuo; nɛ o titima amɛ nɛ a he wa a maa nɔɔ si. 12O he nyɛli ɔmɛ ma kpɔ ní nɛ o ná a ngɛ o dɛ, nɛ a maa ha o guɛ ní. A maa ku o gbogbo ɔmɛ kɛ, o we saminyawiiwi ɔmɛ. A maa muɔ tɛ ɔmɛ kɛ tso ɔmɛ, kɛ zu ɔ tsuo kɛ ya pue wo mi. 13 Ma ha o la amɛ a se maa po; a be o saku ɔmɛ a he nue hu. 14Ma pee mo tɛ sa kpataa, he nɛ wo hɛli ma ka a yahi ngɛ. A be mo dlae kɛ pee ma hu. Imi, Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ lɛ i de.”
15Bɔ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ngɛ Tiro ma a dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Benɛ a ngɛ o hɛ mi kpatae, nɛ ngmlaa ngɛ ma mi bi ɔmɛ a nya jee ɔ, nihi tsuo nɛ ngɛ wo nya ma amɛ a mi ɔ, a he maa do blibliibli. 16 Ganɔ ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ ngɛ wo nya ma amɛ a mi ɔ ma kple si kɛ je a sɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ. A ma kpa a he bo ngɔ fɔ si; nɛ a ma je a tade ɔmɛ nɛ a lo ní ngɔ wo a mi ɔ ngɛ a he. A maa hi si ngɛ zugba, nɛ a he maa do blibliibli. Gbeye ma ha a he maa hi doe blibliibli be ɔ tsuo ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ ba o nɔ ɔ he. 17A ma la mɔbɔ la kɛ nyɛ ya ha mo kikɛ nɛ ɔ:
Mo ma nɛ o he biɛ kaa wo nya ma
nɛ he wa,
a kpata o hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ kɛ je wo ɔ nɔ!
Jinɛ o kɛ o mi bi nyɛ he ngɛ gbeye
ngɛ wo ɔmɛ a nɔ;
nyɛ haa sawale nuu wo nya ma
amɛ tsuo!
18Se jehanɛ lɛɛ, ma amɛ a he maa
do blibliibli kaa mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ, a kpata o hɛ mi!
Niinɛ, wo nya ma amɛ tsuo a tsui
maa po kaa a kpata o hɛ mi
kikɛ nɛ ɔ!”
19Bɔ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ngɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Ma ha o ní maa pee mɔbɔ kaa ma doku nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be mi. O ma mu kɛ ya wo ɔ sisi tɔɔ. 20O ma kple si kɛ ya su gbeje nitsɛ, he nɛ blematsɛmɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a be je mi hu ɔ ngɛ ɔ. Lejɛ ɔ o kɛ mɛ maa hi ngɛ blema níhi nɛ a kpata a hɛ mi ɔ a mi ngɛ je ɔ sisi tɔɔ. Kɛkɛ ɔ, o be nyɛe maa pee ma nɛ nɔmlɔ adesa maa hi mi ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi hu! 21 Ma ha o nyagbe maa pee gbeye; o be je mi hie hu. Ke a bi o si ɔ, a be mo nae; o maa laa gbidii kɛ yaa neneene.” Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ lɛ de.

Title: EZEKIEL 27
Content:
La ko nɛ a kɛ nyɛ ya ha Tiro
1Yawɛ kɛ mi tu munyu, nɛ e de mi ke, 2“Nɔmlɔ adesa, la mɔbɔ la kɛ nyɛ ya ha Tiro ma a. 3Tiro ji wo nya ma nguaa, nɛ e kɛ je mahi tsuo yeɔ jua kɛ yaa wo se tsitsaa. De lɛ ke bɔ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ngɛ lɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ:
“Tiro ma, o wo o he nɔ, nɛ o fĩa ke,
‘Ye he ngɛ fɛu kɛ pi si.’
4Niinɛ, wo ɔ kpɛti tɔɔ o huzu nya ya su.
Nihi nɛ po mo kɛ ma si kaa ma a,
pee mo kɛ o he fɛu kaa pa nɔ lɛ saminyayoo.
5Lɛ ɔ nitsɛ tsuo ɔ, Hermon yo ɔ nɔ
sɛsɛo tso sɔuu a kɛ kpɛ.
O mi abalaa tso ɔmɛ ɔ,
seda tso nɛ je Lebanon a kɛ pee mɛ.
6Akɔfa amɛ lɛɛ, Bashan tso nguaa amɛ a kɛ hlɔ mɛ.
Lɛ nɔ tsu bi ɔ, nga nɔ tso tlɔmɔɔ nɛ je Kipro a kɛ pee lɛ.
A topɛ́ tso ɔ mi,
nɛ a wo mi suɔ wu.
7Kploba a kɛ pee o mi abalaa amɛ,
kploba nɛ a lo ní wo mi saminyayoo kɛ je Egipt.
A yoɔ abalaa amɛ ngɛ se lokoo.
Nɔ́ nɛ ha lɛ ɔ yi mi ɔ,
bo bluu, kɛ bo he jua wawɛ nɛ hɛɛ alamua tu su a kɛ pee.
A kɛ enɛ ɔmɛ tsuo je Kipro zugba nɛ wo bɔle lɛ ɔ nɔ.
8Sidon bi, kɛ Arvad bi ji o lɛ hluili;
mo Tiro nitsɛ o mi bi nɛ le ga
saminya ji ni nɛmɛ nɛ kudɔɔ o lɛ ɔmɛ.
9Ma nimeli, kɛ tso ga ní tsuli
nɛ ba kpɛ o lɛ ɔ mɛ ɔ,
a je blɔ tsɔse mɛ.
Mɛ tsuo ɔ, Biblos a je.
Akua hluili babauu baa kɛ a lɛhi tsuo,
nɛ a kɛ mo ba yeɔ jua.
10“Ta buli nɛ je Persia, Lidia, kɛ Libia hu ba piɛ o ta buli ɔmɛ a he. A kɛ a tsɛ̃i ɔmɛ, kɛ dade pɛɛ ɔmɛ ha nɛ o ye kunimi. 11Ta buli nɛ je Arvad bu o gbogbo ɔmɛ a he kɛ kpe, nɛ Gamad bi hu bu o mɔ ɔmɛ a he. Ni nɛ ɔmɛ ngɔ a tsɛ̃i ɔmɛ kɛ kpla o gbogbo ɔmɛ a he kɛ kpe. Mɛ lɛ a ha o he pee fɛu kɛ pi si ɔ nɛ.
12“Spania kɛ mo ye jua, ejakaa o ngɛ guɛ ní babauu, nɛ a kɛ sika hiɔ, dade, sanylaa, kɛ sumui ba tsakee o guɛ ní ɔmɛ. 13O kɛ Hela, Tubal, kɛ Meshek hu ye jua. A ngɔɔ nɔmlɔ adesa po, akɔblee níhi, okpɔngɔhi, kɛ teji okpɔngɔhi kɛ ba tsakee o guɛ ní ɔmɛ. 14Nihi nɛ je Bet Togarma kɛ okpɔngɔhi, ta okpɔngɔhi, kɛ teji okpɔngɔhi ba tsakee o guɛ ní. 15Rodo bi hu kɛ mo ye jua. A ngɔɔ suɔ wu, kɛ tɛ tso kɛ ba tsakee o guɛ ní. 16Siria bi hu ba heɔ o guɛ ní slɔɔtoslɔɔto ɔmɛ. A ngɔɔ ní nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ ba woɔ o guɛ ní ɔmɛ a he hiɔ: tɛ nɛ he jua wa nɛ hɛɛ ba mumu su, bo he jua wawɛ nɛ hɛɛ alamua tu su, bo nɛ a lo ní kɛ wo mi, kploba kpakpa, tenglɛnglɛ, kɛ tɛ nɛ he jua wa nɛ kpɛɔ kaa ahuhuɛ. 17Yuda kɛ Israel zugba amɛ hu kɛ mo ye jua. Ke a ba he ní ɔ, níhi nɛ a kɛ woɔ hiɔ ji ngma, hwo, oliv nu, kɛ tsopa kɛ e he via. 18-19Nihi je Damasko ba he o guɛ ní, kɛ o nine nya níhi nɛ o pee. Ni nɛ ɔmɛ ngɔɔ wai nɛ a na kɛ je Helbon, kɛ kuutu nɛ je Sahar kɛ woɔ ní nɛ ɔmɛ a he hiɔ. A ngɔɔ dade níhi, kɛ tsopa kɛ e he via kɛ ba tsakee o guɛ ní. 20Dedan bi ɔmɛ hu kɛ mo ye jua; a ngɔɔ okpɔngɔ nɔ himi bo kɛ ba tsakee o guɛ ní. 21Arabia bi kɛ Kedar ganɔ ɔmɛ tsuo o kɛ mɛ ye jua; mɛɛ níhi nɛ a kɛ woɔ hiɔ ji agbosuhi, jijɔhi, kɛ akpakpohi. 22Sheba kɛ Raama bi ɔmɛ lɛɛ níhi nɛ a kɛ ba tsakee o guɛ ní ɔmɛ ji juetli, sika tsu, kɛ tsopa kɛ e he via kpakpa. 23Haran, Kane, kɛ Eden ma amɛ, kɛ jehanɛ jua yeli nɛ je Sheba, Asur kɛ Kilmad ma amɛ a mi ɔ, mɛ tsuo a kɛ mo ye jua. 24A juaa a bo kpakpahi, bo he jua wawɛ nɛ hɛɛ alamua tu su, kɛ bo nɛ a lo ní kɛ wo mi. A juaa bo nɛ a kɛ haa zugba, kɛ tangme kpa kpakpahi hulɔ. 25 O guɛ ní hyiɔ lɛ agbohi babauu.
O pee kaa lɛ ngɛ wo nɔ,
lɛ nɛ a wo lɛ tlomi tɔtɔɔtɔ.
26Benɛ lɛ hluili ɔmɛ kɛ mo ya su
wo ɔ nɔ tsitsaa a,
wo nɔ kɔɔhiɔ fia kɛ ba na mo,
nɛ e kpata o hɛ mi ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.
27Tlukaa a, ligbi kake too ɔ, o hɛ mi kpata pɛsɛpɛsɛ.
Ní babauu nɛ o na a tsuo hɛ mi kpata:
guɛ ní wawi, kɛ nguangua amɛ tsuo laa.
Jã kɛ̃ nɛ o lɛ mi bi, kɛ kudɔɔ nuli,
nihi nɛ tsiɔ lɛ ɔ mi puɔhi,
o jua yeli, kɛ o ta buli tsuo,
nimli babauu nɛ ngɛ o mi ɔ,
mɛ tsuo a mu ngɛ wo ɔ kpɛti;
a ya su wo ɔ sisi tɔɔ.
28O lɛ kudɔɔ nuli ɔmɛ kpa ngmlaa wawɛɛ;
a nu ngmlaa a he ngɛ wo ɔ nya tsuo.
29“Lɛ hluili ɔmɛ tsuo je a lɛ ɔmɛ a mi:
lɛ ɔmɛ a mi bi tsuo ba kpo nɔ.
30Mɛ tsuo a ngɛ ya foe wawɛɛ ha mo;
a ngɔ zu kɛ pue a yi mi,
nɛ a ngɛ si wuwluae ngɛ la zu mi.
31A sɛ a yi kpalokpalo;
a ha kpekpe ya bo kɛ ngɛ aywilɛho yee;
a ngɛ ya nyɛe wawɛɛ ha mo.
32A la hɛdo la ko kɛ nyɛ ya ha mo:
‘Tiro nɛ e nɔ jɔ ngɛ wo kpɛti kikɛ nɛ ɔ?
Mɛnɔ he a kɛ lɛ maa to?
33Benɛ o guɛ ní ɔmɛ yaa ma se tsitsaa a,
o haa ma amɛ tɔɔ kɛ ní kpakpahi.
Matsɛmɛ ná a he kɛ je o ní nami ɔ mi.
34Jehanɛ lɛɛ o hɛ mi kpata ngɛ wo ɔ mi,
o mu kɛ ho wo ɔ sisi tɔɔ ya.
O kɛ o lɛ mi bi ɔmɛ,
kɛ o guɛ ní ɔmɛ
tsuo mu kɛ ho nyu ɔ sisi ya.’
35“Bɔ nɛ o nyagbe ba ji nɛ ɔ? E pee nihi tsuo nɛ ngɛ wo nya ma amɛ a mi ɔ nyakpɛ; a matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ po ye gbeye, nɛ a hɛ mi pee mɛ yaa. 36Sawale nu jua yeli nɛ ngɛ je ɔ mi ɔ tsuo; a ngɛ gbeye yee kaa mɛ hu a hɛ mi ma kpata ja nɔuu; o laa kɛ yaa neneene.”

Title: EZEKIEL 28
Content:
A ma kpata Tiro hɛ mi
1Yawɛ kɛ mi tu munyu ekohu. E de mi ke, 2“Nɔmlɔ adesa, de Tiro ganɔ ɔ ke, bɔ nɛ imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, i ngɛ lɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: O wo o he nɔ gojoo ke mawu ji mo. O hii si ngɛ matsɛ sɛ nɔ; nɛ wo bɔle mo. Mo nɔmlɔ adesa a, o pee o he kaa mawu ko ji mo. 3O susu kaa o le ní pe Daniel, nɛ laami sane ko kulaa be nɛ a kɛ laa mo. 4O nile, kɛ o nɔ́ sisi numi ha nɛ o ná ní kpɔtɔɔ: o bua sika tsu, kɛ sika hiɔ babauu nya kɛ to. 5O ngɛ jua yemi he juɛmi saminya, nɛ o ná ní babauu. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, o wo o he nɔ gojoo ke niatsɛ ji mo!
6“Bu tue, bɔ nɛ imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, i ngɛ dee ji, akɛnɛ o wo o he nɔ gojoo, nɛ o susu kaa o le ní kaa Mawu he je ɔ, 7ma ha nibwɔhi yiwutsotsɛmɛ kpanakuhi maa je je ma amɛ a mi ma ba tua mo. Afɛu ní babauu nɛ o gu o nile, kɛ o ga a nɔ kɛ ná a tsuo hɛ mi ma kpata. 8A maa gbe mo, nɛ a ma sake mo ngɔ fɔ gbeje ngɛ wo ɔ sisi tɔɔ. 9Ke e ba mi ja a, anɛ o ma nyɛ ma de ngɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ mo gbee ɔ a hɛ mi ke mawu ji mo lo? O maa le kaa nɔmlɔ adesa kɛkɛ ji mo. 10Nibwɔhi nɛ li imi Mawu ɔ ma kpata o hɛ mi; a maa gbe mo kaa a gbeɔ gbe. Imi, Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ lɛ i de.”
Tiro matsɛ ɔ hɛ mi kpata
11Yawɛ kɛ mi tu munyu ekohu, nɛ e de mi ke, 12“Nɔmlɔ adesa, la hɛdo la ko kɛ nyɛ ya ha Tiro matsɛ ɔ ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ maa ba e nɔ ɔ he. De lɛ nɔ́ nɛ imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, i ngɛ dee ɔ: Be ko nɛ be ɔ, ke a ke nɔ ko hi kɛ pi si ɔ, lɛɛ mo ji nɔ hyɛmi nɔ́; o nile mi kuɔ, nɛ o he ngɛ fɛu saminya! 13Eden, Mawu ngmɔ ɔ nitsɛ mi nɛ o hi. Tɛ kpakpa nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo o kɛ dla o he: rubi, daimond, topaz, beril, kanelian, yaspi, safiro, emerald, kɛ garnet. O ngɛ sika tsu he dlami níhi, kɛ heha ní babauu. Ligbi ɔ nɛ a bɔ mo ɔ, jamɛ a ligbi ɔ nɔuu lɛ a dla mo saminyayoo jã. 14I ngɔ Mawu bɔfo ko nɛ he ngɛ gbeye kɛ to lejɛ ɔ, konɛ e bu o he. O hi ye yo klɔuklɔu ɔ nɔ; o slaa si ngɛ tɛhi nɛ ngɛ kpɛe nylamnylam ɔ a kpɛti. 15Kɛ je be nɛ a bɔ mo ɔ, o ba o je mi pɛpɛɛpɛ, nɛ a nɛ́ tɔmi ko kulaa ngɛ o he kɛ ya su be ko, kɛkɛ nɛ o bɔni yayami peemi. 16Be nɛ jua yemi ba ngɛ nɔ yae ɔ, amimi yemi hu ba hyi o mi tɔ, nɛ o pee yayami. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i ha o je ye yo klɔuklɔu ɔ nɔ; nɛ Mawu bɔfo nɛ bu o he ɔ fie mo kɛ je tɛ ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ kpɛe kɛ la nylamnylam ɔ a kpɛti. 17O he fɛu ɔ he ɔ, o wo o he nɔ gojoo, nɛ o je kuasia. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i tsɛ̃ mo ngɔ fia si ngɛ zugba bum. Bɔ nɛ o nyagbe ba ha nɛ ɔ maa pee kɔkɔ bɔmi nɔ́ ha matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsuo. 18O pee yayami babauu ngɛ o jua yemi ɔ mi, nɛ o kɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ble hehi nɛ o ya jaa Mawu ngɛ ɔ. Enɛ ɔ he ɔ, i mɛ o he la, nɛ i sã mo pioo, nɛ o pee la zu ngɛ nihi tsuo a hɛ mi. 19Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, o be hu; o laa gbidii. Je mahi tsuo nɛ le mo ɔ, jehanɛ lɛɛ sawale nu mɛ. A ngɛ gbeye yee kaa mɛ hu a hɛ mi ma kpata ja nɔuu.”
A ma kpata Sidon ma a hɛ mi
20 Yawɛ kɛ mi tu munyu ekohu, nɛ e de ke, 21“Nɔmlɔ adesa, plɛ o hɛ mi kɛ kpee Sidon ma a, nɛ o gba kɛ si mɛ. 22De mɛ ke imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, i ke i kɛ mɛ ná. Je ma amɛ maa wo ye hɛ mi nyami ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ ma pee Sidon ma a he. Ma gbla Sidon tue, konɛ a na bɔ nɛ i ngɛ klɔuklɔu ha. Kɛkɛ ɔ, a maa le kaa imi ji Yawɛ. 23Ma ha gbenɔ hiɔ ma ba sɛ ma a mi; a maa ye awi ngɛ gbɛjegbɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ. A ma ba sa ma a yi, nɛ a kɛ klaate maa gbe ma a mi bi ɔmɛ. Kɛkɛ ɔ, a maa le kaa imi ji Yawɛ.”
A maa gbaa Israel
24Yawɛ ke, “Je ma amɛ nɛ bɔle Israel kɛ kpe nɛ a pue e hɛ mi si ɔ, ekoeko be e he pee kaa mio, loo mio tso kɛ plaa Israel hu. Kɛkɛ ɔ, a maa le kaa imi ji Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ.”
25Bɔ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ngɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Ma kpale ye ma Israel kɛ je je ma amɛ a kpɛti he nɛ i gbɛ mɛ kɛ fĩa a, nɛ je ma amɛ tsuo maa le kaa nɔ klɔuklɔu ji mi. Israel ma a ma ba hi mɛ nitsɛmɛ a zugba nɛ i ngɔ ha ye tsɔlɔ Yakob ɔ nɔ. 26A maa hi si ngɛ tue mi jɔmi, kɛ he jɔmi mi. A maa ma tsuhi, nɛ a ma hu wai ngmɔhi. Nihi tsuo nɛ pue Israel hɛ mi si ɔ, ma gbla a tue, nɛ Israel ma na he jɔmi, kɛ tue mi jɔmi kulaa. Lɔ ɔ loko a ma na maa le kaa imi ji Yawɛ, a Mawu ɔ nɛ.”

Title: EZEKIEL 29
Content:
A maa gbla Egipt tue
1 Benɛ a nuu wɔ kɛ ho ma se ya a, jeha nyɔngmane ɔ we nyɔhiɔ nyɔngma a we ligbi nyɔngma kɛ enyɔne ɔ, Yawɛ de mi ke, 2“Nɔmlɔ adesa, plɛ o hɛ mi kɛ kpee Egipt matsɛ ɔ, nɛ o de lɛ ke a maa gbla e kɛ e ma a tsuo a tue. 3De lɛ ke bɔ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ngɛ Egipt matsɛ ɔ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: Mo wo mi lohwe gbeyegbeye, i kɛ mo ná. O ke Nilo pa a o nɔ, nɛ mo lɛ o pee. 4Ma wo o nya mi gbowe, nɛ e maa la o tsitsa; kɛkɛ ɔ, lo ɔmɛ tsuo ngɛ pa a mi maa mɛtɛ o he toto ɔmɛ a he. Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, ma gbla mo kɛ je Nilo pa a mi, kɛ lo ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ mɛtɛ o he ɔ. 5Ma sake mo, kɛ lo ɔmɛ tsuo ngɔ fɔ nga a nɔ. O ma ya nɔ si, nɛ o ma gbo kɛ fɔ lejɛ ɔ. A be mo pue; ma ha lohwe awi yeli, kɛ lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ mohu maa ye mo. 6 Kɛkɛ ɔ, Egipt ma a tsuo maa le kaa imi ji Yawɛ.”
Yawɛ ke, “Egipt ngɛ kaa gla nɛ Israel kɛ pee dɛma tso. 7Benɛ a pɛtɛ he ɔ, e ku, nɛ e plaa a konɔ tsuo. A ke a ma kpasa lɛ ɔ, e ku nɛ e ha a nanehi hluã. 8Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, jehanɛ lɛɛ imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, i ngɛ dee ke imi nitsɛ ma ha ta ma ba tua ma a. A maa gbe nɔ tsuaa nɔ; a ma kpata lohwehi tsuo a hɛ mi. 9Nɔ ko nɔ ko be Egipt zugba a nɔ hie hu; zugba a maa pee ma doku nɛ e maa fɔ si gu. Lɔ ɔ loko a maa le kaa imi ji Yawɛ.
“Akɛnɛ o ke Nilo pa a o nɔ́, nɛ́ mo nitsɛ lɛ o pee he je ɔ, 10i kɛ mo ná, nɛ i kɛ o Nilo pa a hu ná. Ma ha Egipt zugba a tsuo nɔ maa je gu; e maa pee ma dokuhi sɔuu kɛ je Migdol ngɛ omleyi je kɛ yaa su Aswan ngɛ leneyi je, hluu kɛ ma ya su Sudan bi ɔmɛ a huzu ɔ nya tɔɔ. 11Nane ko nane ko be zugba a nɔ nyɛɛe hu, nɔmlɔ nɔ́ jio, lohwe nɔ́ jio. Lejɛ ɔ maa fɔ si gu jeha nyingmi eywiɛ sɔuu. 12Ma ha Egipt zugba a nɔ maa pee sakosako pe kulaa ngɛ je ɔ mi. Ma ha Egipt ma amɛ maa pee ma dokuhi jeha nyingmi eywiɛ sɔuu. Ma doku ko ma doku ko kɛ mɛ be sɔe. Ma fie Egipt bi ɔmɛ kɛ je a zugba a nɔ kɛ ya zugba kpahi a nɔ kɛ ya futu je ma kpahi.”
13Bɔ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ngɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Jeha nyingmi eywiɛ ɔ se ɔ, ma bua Egipt bi ɔmɛ a nya kɛ je je ma amɛ a kpɛti he nɛ i gbɛ mɛ ngɔ fĩa a. 14Ma ha a ma ba hi a hi he momo ɔ ngɛ Egipt leneyi je. A ma ba to nɔ yemi ko nɛ he wɛ kulaa sisi ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. 15E maa pee nɔ yemi nɛ he wɛ pe kulaa. Ma pee mɛ ma wayoo, bɔ nɛ a be nyɛe maa ye je ma amɛ ekoeko nɔ hu. 16Ke e ba mi ja a, e be ma nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ maa ngɔ a hɛ kɛ fɔ e nɔ pee hu. Ejakaa a ma kai kaa e ji tɔmi agbo kaa Israel ngɔ e hɛ kɛ fɔ Egipt nɔ. Kɛkɛ ɔ, Israel maa le kaa imi ji Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ.”
Matsɛ Nebukadnezar maa ngɔ Egipt zugba a
17Benɛ a nuu wɔ kɛ ho ma se ya a, jeha nyingmi enyɔ kɛ kpaagone ɔ we kekleekle nyɔhiɔ ɔ we kekleekle ligbi ɔ, Yawɛ kɛ mi tu munyu, nɛ e de mi ke, 18“Nɔmlɔ adesa, Nebukadnezar, Babilonia matsɛ ɔ ya tua Tiro. E ha e ta buli tsu ní kpakpataa ngɛ ta nɛ e kɛ Tiro ngɛ hwue ɔ he: a tloo tlomi nɛ jiɔ; nɔ tsuaa nɔ yi mi kpa, nɛ e konɔ kpɔ. Se matsɛ ɔ kɛ e tabo ɔ na we se ko kɛ ji dengme nɛ a gbo ɔ mi. 19Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, i ngɛ dee ji, i ngɔ Egipt zugba a kɛ ngɛ Matsɛ Nebukadnezar dɛ mi woe. E maa ha ní, nɛ e maa ngɔ ní babauu nɛ Egipt ngɛ ɔ tsuo kɛ ho; nɛ ní ɔmɛ maa pee e ta buli ɔmɛ a hiɔwo. 20I ngɔ Egipt zugba a kɛ ha lɛ kaa e hiɔwo; ejakaa imi lɛ e tabo ɔ tsu ní ɔ kɛ ha. Imi, Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ lɛ i de.
21“Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, ma ha Israel ma na he wami he, nɛ ma ha Ezekiel maa tu munyu wawɛɛ ngɛ ma a tsuo hɛ mi, konɛ a le kaa imi ji Yawɛ.”

Title: EZEKIEL 30
Content:
Yawɛ maa gbla Egipt tue
1Yawɛ kɛ mi tu munyu ekohu. E ke, 2“Nɔmlɔ adesa, gbaa nɛ o ha nɛ a le nɔ́ nɛ imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, i ngɛ dee ɔ. Wo yana nɛ o de ke,
Ligbi yaya! Ligbi yaya ko ma!
3Ligbi ɔ su ta.
Ligbi ɔ nɛ Yawɛ ma tsu nyakpɛ
ní ɔ maa pee aywilɛho, kɛ
amanehlu be nitsɛ kɛ ha ma amɛ.
4A maa hwu ta ngɛ Egipt;
nɛ Sudan maa hao wawɛɛ.
A maa gbe nihi babauu ngɛ Egipt;
a maa muɔ e juetli kɛ je;
nɛ ma a maa pee ma doku posoposo.
5“Gbaa ke ta buli nɛ a bɔ mɛ apaa kɛ je Sudan, Lidia, Libia, Arabia, kɛ Kub ɔ, a ma kpata mɛ tsuo a hɛ mi, nɛ imi nitsɛ ye ni ɔmɛ ekomɛ hu maa nɔ ngɛ ta a mi.”
6Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ke, “Mahi nɛ piɛɔ Egipt he kɛ je Migdol ngɛ omleyi je kɛ ya su Aswan ngɛ leneyi je ɔ, a mi bi tsuo a hɛ mi ma kpata ngɛ ta a mi. Tabo ɔ nɛ Egipt kɛ fĩaa a hɛ mi ma kpata kulaa. Imi, Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ lɛ i de. 7E zugba a maa pee pasaa kulaa ngɛ je ɔ mi, nɛ e ma amɛ ma plɛ pee ma dokuhi. 8Ke i mɛ Egipt he la, nɛ i kpata e he piɛli ɔmɛ a hɛ mi ɔ, kɛkɛ a maa le kaa imi ji Yawɛ.
9“Ke be ɔ nɛ ma kpata Egipt hɛ mi ɔ su ɔ, ma tsɔ nihi nɛ a he sɔɔ kɛ gu wo ɔ nɔ kɛ ya wo Sudan bi ɔmɛ nɛ a hɛ be a he nɔ ɔ he gbeye, konɛ sawale nɛ nu mɛ. Jamɛ a be ɔ su ta!”
10Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ke, “Ma ha Nebukadnezar, Babilonia matsɛ ɔ ma ba muɔ Egipt ma a tsuo kɛ ho. 11E kɛ e tabo yiwutsotsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ma ba kpata zugba a hɛ mi. A kɛ klaate ma ba tua Egipt. Zugba a nɔ ma hyi tɔ kɛ ni gbogboehi. 12Ma ha Nilo pa a maa mii. Ma jua Egipt zugba a tsuo kɛ ha yiwutsotsɛmɛ ɔmɛ. Ma ha nibwɔhi ma kpata zugba a, kɛ e nɔ bi tsuo a hɛ mi. Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de.”
13Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ke, “Ma kpata wɔ ɔmɛ, kɛ amaga amɛ nɛ ngɛ Memfis ɔ a hɛ mi. Ganɔ ko be Egipt zugba a nɔ yee hu; lejɛ ɔ maa pee gbeye. Ma ha nɛ sawale maa nu nɔ tsuaa nɔ. 14Ma ha Egipt leneyi je maa pee ma doku pasaa; nɛ Zoan nɛ ngɛ omleyi je ɔ, ma mɛ he la. Ma gbla Tebes ma a tue. 15Pelusium, Egipt ma a nɛ a fia gbogbo kɛ bɔle lɛ ɔ hu, ye mi mi maa wo la kɛ wo e he. Ma kpata Tebes ma a tsuo a hɛ mi. 16Ma mɛ Egipt he la, nɛ Pelusium maa hao wawɛɛ. Ma ku Tebes gbogbo ɔmɛ kɛ pue si, nɛ ma a mi ma hyi tɔ kɛ nyu. 17Heliopolis, kɛ Bubastis ma amɛ a mi nihewi ma gbo ngɛ ta mi, nɛ nihi nɛ maa piɛ ɔ lɛɛ a maa nuu mɛ nyɔguɛ. 18Ma kpɔ Egipt he wami ɔ ngɛ e dɛ, nɛ e he nɔ womi babauu ɔ se maa po; jamɛ a be ɔ, diblii maa wo ngɛ Tafanes piani katakata. Amanehlu maa pee kaa bɔku nɛ ha Egipt zugba a nɔ, nɛ a maa nuu e ma amɛ a mi bi ɔmɛ tsuo nyɔguɛ. 19Ke i gbla Egipt tue wawɛɛ kikɛ nɛ ɔ, kɛkɛ ɔ, a maa le kaa imi ji Yawɛ.”
Egipt matsɛ ɔ he wami ɔ ta
20Benɛ a nuu wɔ kɛ ho ma se ya a, jeha nyɔngma kɛ kakene ɔ we kekleekle nyɔhiɔ ɔ we ligbi kpaagone ɔ, Yawɛ kɛ mi tu munyu. 21E de mi ke, “Nɔmlɔ adesa, i ku Egipt matsɛ ɔ kɔni. Nɔ ko nɔ ko to we nɔ tsopa; a fi we hulɔ, konɛ e kɔni ɔ nɛ tsa, nɛ́ e na he wami nɛ e kɛ pɛtɛ klaate he ekohu. 22Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, bɔ nɛ imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, i ngɛ dee ji, i kɛ Egipt matsɛ ɔ ná. Ma kplɔ e kɔni enyɔ ɔmɛ tsuo. Ma ku kake ɔ kɛ piɛ nɔ́ nɛ ku momo ɔ he; kɛkɛ ɔ, e klaate ɔ maa je e dɛ kɛ nɔ si. 23Ma gbɛ Egipt bi ɔmɛ ngɔ fĩa je ɔ mi tsuo. 24Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, ma wo Babilonia matsɛ ɔ dɛ mi klaate, konɛ e na he wami ekohu. Se Egipt matsɛ ɔ lɛɛ, ma kplɔ e kɔni ɔmɛ ngɛ e he. E ma kɛmɛ ngɛ e he nyɛlɔ ɔ hɛ mi; nyagbe ɔ, e ma gbo. 25Ee, Egipt matsɛ ɔ kɔnihi ma kplɔ ngɛ e he; se Babilonia matsɛ ɔ lɛɛ, ma wo lɛ he wami. Ke i wo e dɛ mi klaate, nɛ e wo nɔ kɛ tsɔɔ Egipt blɔ ɔ, nɔ tsuaa nɔ ma ná maa le kaa imi ji Yawɛ. 26Ma gbɛ Egipt bi ɔmɛ kɛ fĩa je ɔ mi tsuo. Kɛkɛ ɔ, a ma ná maa le kaa imi ji Yawɛ.”

Title: EZEKIEL 31
Content:
Egipt ngɛ kaa seda tso
1Benɛ a nuu wɔ kɛ ho ma se ya a, jeha nyɔngma kɛ kakene ɔ we nyɔhiɔ etɛ ɔ we kekleekle ligbi ɔ, Yawɛ kɛ mi tu munyu. 2E de mi ke, “Nɔmlɔ adesa, de Egipt matsɛ ɔ, kɛ e ma kpekpemi ɔ tsuo ke: O he wa saminya! Mɛni he po ma ngɔ mo kɛ to?
3O ngɛ kaa seda tso ko nɛ bɔ kusuu ngɛ Lebanon,
e kɔni saminyawiiwi ɔmɛ pee hɔ;
e ka gagaa kɛ su bɔku mi tɔɔ.
4Nyu babaaba ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, kɛ zugba a mi tsuo;
lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e na niye ní bɔ nɛ sa.
Nyu ɔ ha tso kpa amɛ tsuo bɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.
5E na nyu babaaba, nɛ e bɔ saminya.
E ka gagaa, nɛ e nɔ kuɔ gojoo
pe tso kpa amɛ tsuo.
E gba kɔnihi kusuu;
a ti, nɛ a ka gagaaga.
6Lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ slɔɔtoslɔɔto ya pee a tsuhi
ngɛ e kɔni nguangua amɛ a nɔ.
Nga mi lohwehi tsuo ya fɔ a bimɛ
ngɛ e kɔni wawi ɔmɛ a sisi,
nɛ je ma nguanguahi tsuo
ya hii si ngɛ e sisi hɔ̃ ɔ mi.
7E he pee fɛu;
e nɔ kuɔ gojoo,
kɛ e kɔnihi gagaaga;
ejakaa e sipoku na nyu babaaba
kɛ je zu mi.
8 Mawu ngmɔ ɔ mi seda tso ɔmɛ po
a he fɛu kɛ lɛ sɔɛ.
Sɛsɛo ɔmɛ kɛ a kɔni nguangua amɛ hu
kɛ lɛ sɔɛ.
Papao ɔmɛ kɛ a kɔni wawi ɔmɛ
na we lɛ kulaa.
Niinɛ, e he fɛu ɔ nɔ be.
Tso ko tso ko be Mawu ngmɔ ɔ mi
nɛ a kɛ maa to e he.
9I ha nɛ e pee fɛu saminya
kɛ e kɔnihi babauu.
Tsohi tsuo nɛ ngɛ Mawu ngmɔ ɔ mi
ngɛ Eden ɔ, a hɛ kɔ e nɔ.
10“Jehanɛ lɛɛ, jamɛ a tso ɔ nɛ bɔ kusuu, nɛ e nɔ kuɔ gojoo kɛ su bɔku mi tɔɔ ɔ, imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ nitsɛ ma tsɔɔ mo nɔ́ nɛ maa ba e nɔ. Akɛnɛ e nɔ kuɔ gojoo he je ɔ, e wo e he nɔ nɛ e fĩa; 11lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i kua lɛ. Ma ha nubwɔ ko nine maa su e nɔ. E kɛ lɛ maa ye sisiisi; e maa pee lɛ bɔ nɛ sa lɛ ngɛ yi wu tso níhi nɛ e pee ɔ a he. 12Nibwɔhi nɛ ji je ma amɛ a kpɛti yiwutsotsɛmɛ pe kulaa maa hɛ lɛ ngɔ fɔ si, nɛ a maa je e he ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. E kɔni wawi ɔmɛ ma ya pue yo ɔmɛ a nɔ, kɛ kɔ̃ ɔmɛ a mi; nɛ e kɔni agbo ɔmɛ maa ku kɛ pue nyu dɔ ɔmɛ a mi ngɛ zugba a nɔ tsuo. Je ma amɛ nɛ ngɛ e hɔ̃ ɔ mi ɔ maa je. 13Lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ ma ba ma tso nɛ a hɛ ngɔ fɔ si ɔ nɔ, nɛ pu mi lohwehi ma ba hi e kɔni ɔmɛ a nɔ. 14Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, kɛ je mwɔnɛ ɔ kɛ yaa a, tso nɛ naa nyu saminya a ekoeko be kae kɛ ya hiɔwe ja hu, loo kaa e ma ha e yi mi ma ya su bɔku mi ploplooplo kikɛ nɛ ɔ. Mɛ tsuo a ma gbo kaa bɔ nɛ nɔmlɔ adesa gboɔ ɔ. Mɛ tsuo a ma ya piɛ nihi nɛ ho gbeje ya a a he.”
15Bɔ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ngɛ dee ji, “Ligbi ɔ nɛ tso ɔ ma ya su gbeje ɔ, ma ha pahi nɛ ngɛ zugba a sisi ɔ maa ha e nɔ; a maa pee ja kɛ tsɔɔ kaa a ngɛ ya nyɛe ha lɛ. Ma tsi pa amɛ a nya nɛ a ko be hu, nɛ pa wawi, kɛ nyu dɔ ɔmɛ maa ta. Akɛnɛ tso ɔ gbo he je ɔ, ma ha diblii maa wo ngɛ Lebanon yo ɔmɛ a nɔ; pu mi tso ɔmɛ tsuo ma ngla. 16Ma ha e maa nɔ si haa bum kɛ maa ya gbeje; nɛ je ma amɛ ma mimiɛ, ke a nu e si nɔmi ɔ. Eden ngmɔ ɔ mi tso ɔmɛ tsuo, kɛ Lebanon tsohi nɛ a je blɔ ha mɛ nyu saminya, nɛ mɛɛ lɛɛ a ho gbeje ya momo ɔ, a bua maa jɔ wawɛɛ kaa tso nɛ ɔ nɔ si. 17A ma kpaka lɛ kɛ ho gbeje ya, konɛ e ya piɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ nɔ momo ɔ a he. Nɛ mahi tsuo nɛ hi e hɔ̃ ɔ mi ɔ maa gbɛ fĩa je ɔ mi tsuo.
18“Tso nɛ ɔ daa si ha Egipt matsɛ ɔ, kɛ e ma kpekpemi ɔ tsuo. Tsohi nɛ ngɛ Eden ngmɔ ɔ mi po ka we, nɛ a he hu pee we fɛu kaa tso nɛ ɔ. Se jehanɛ lɛɛ kaa bɔ nɛ Eden ngmɔ ɔ mi tso ɔmɛ ya su gbeje ɔ, lɛ hu e maa ya lejɛ ɔ, nɛ e ma ya piɛ nihi nɛ a pui mɛ, kɛ nihi nɛ nɔ ngɛ ta mi ɔ a he. Imi, Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ lɛ i de.”

Title: EZEKIEL 32
Content:
Egipt matsɛ ɔ ngɛ kaa nyaka
1Benɛ a nuu wɔ kɛ ho ma se ya a, jeha nyɔngma kɛ enyɔne ɔ we nyɔhiɔ nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔ we kekleekle ligbi ɔ, Yawɛ kɛ mi tu munyu. 2E de ke, “Nɔmlɔ adesa, la hɛdo la nɛ o kɛ bɔ Egipt matsɛ ɔ kɔkɔ. Ngɔɔ ye sɛ gbi nɛ ɔ kɛ ha lɛ: O peeɔ o níhi kaa nɔ́ nɛ jata ji mo ngɛ je ma amɛ a kpɛti; se o ngɛ kaa nyaka nɛ ngɛ pa gudue mohu. O tuɔ kɛ sɛɛ o pa amɛ a mi tsulaoo; o kɛ o nane gbidii nyu ɔ kɛ puɛɔ pa amɛ. 3Ke je ma amɛ ba bua a he nya babauu ɔ, imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ nitsɛ ma fɔ ye ya a kɛ pue o nɔ; e maa du mo, nɛ je ma amɛ maa gbla mo kɛ ba kpo. 4Ma sake mo ngɔ fɔ zugba; nɛ lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ, kɛ nga mi lohwehi tsuo ma ba ye mo. 5Ma sake o gbogboe ɔmɛ kɛ pue yo ɔmɛ a nɔ, kɛ kɔ̃ ɔmɛ a mi. 6O muɔ ma pue si ngɛ zugba kɛ maa su benɛ yo ɔmɛ a nɔ tsuo ma pee kpɔtɔɔ, nɛ nyu dɔ ɔmɛ ma hyi kɛ o muɔ. 7 Benɛ ma kpata o hɛ mi ɔ, ma tsi hiɔwe hɛ mi; dodoe ɔmɛ maa laa. Pu maa laa e hɛ mi ngɛ bɔku ɔmɛ a se; nɛ nyɔhiɔ be kpɛe hu. 8Ma ha pu, nyɔhiɔ, kɛ dodoe ɔmɛ tsuo maa laa, nɛ diblii maa wo ngɛ je ɔ mi tsuo. Imi, Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ lɛ i de.
9“Je mahi babauu, ngɛ zugbahi a nɔ he nɛ o li tete po, ke a nu bɔ nɛ i kpata o hɛ mi ɔ, a maa ye tsui. 10Nɔ́ nɛ ma pee mo ɔ ma ha je mahi babauu a he mi maa po, nɛ sawale maa nu a matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ wawɛɛ. Bɔ nɛ ma fɔ ye klaate ɔ yami kɛ bami ngɛ a hɛ mi ɔ, ligbi ɔ nɛ o maa nɔ si ɔ, mɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ a he maa do blibliibli, kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ mɛ hu a hɛ mi ma kpata lo?”
11Bɔ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ngɛ Egipt matsɛ ɔ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Ma ha Babilonia matsɛ ɔ kɛ mo maa hwu ta. 12Ma ha o tabo kpekpemi ɔ maa nɔ ngɛ katsɛmɛ kpanakpanaa a klaate nya. O kɛ o ma a, kɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ o ngɔɔ o hɛ kɛ fɔɔ nɔ ɔ nyɛ hɛ mi ma kpata. 13Ma gbe o lohwe ɔmɛ tsuo ngɛ pa amɛ a tue, nɛ nane ko nane ko be pa a gbidie hu; nɔmlɔ jio, lohwe jio. 14Jamɛ a be ɔ, ma ha o nyu ɔ hɛ mi ma tsɔ, nɛ pa amɛ maa be kaa nu. Imi Yawɛ lɛ i de. 15Ke i kpata Egipt ma a, kɛ e mi níhi, kɛ nimli tsuo nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ a hɛ mi kikɛ ɔ, kɛkɛ a maa le kaa imi ji Yawɛ. 16Kɔkɔ nɛ a ngɛ mo bɔe nɛ ɔ ma ba pee kɔmɔ yemi la nɛ a ma la. Yihi nɛ ngɛ je ma amɛ a mi ma la la nɛ ɔ kɛ nyɛ ya ha Egipt kɛ Egipt bi tsuo. Imi, Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ lɛ i de.”
Gbeje
17Benɛ a nuu wɔ kɛ ho ma se ya a, jeha nyɔngma kɛ enyɔne ɔ we kekleekle nyɔhiɔ ɔ we ligbi nyɔngma kɛ enuɔne ɔ, Yawɛ kɛ mi tu munyu. 18E ke, “Nɔmlɔ adesa, ye kɔmɔ ha Egipt ma kpekpemi ɔ tsuo. Ngɔɔ a kɛ je ma amɛ nɛ a hɛ mi ngɛ nyami ɔ kɛ ya zugba a sisi tɔɔ kɛ ya piɛ nihi nɛ ngɛ gbeje ɔ a he. 19De mɛ ke,
“Pe nyɛ susuɔ kaa nyɛ he ngɛ fɛu pe nihi tsuo lo?
Nyɛ ma ba be kɛ ho gbeje ya,
nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ mɔmlɔtɔtsɛmɛ
ma ya hi lejɛ ɔ.
20“Egipt bi ɔmɛ, kɛ nihi nɛ nɔ ngɛ ta mi ɔ a nyagbe maa ba si kake. Ta ma ba kpata mɛ tsuo a hɛ mi. 21Katsɛmɛ kpanakpanaa, kɛ nihi nɛ piɛ Egipt tabo ɔ he kɛ hwu ta a ma he Egipt bi ɔmɛ atuu kɛ ngmlaa ngɛ gbeje ke, ‘Nihi nɛ li Mawu, nɛ a nɔ ngɛ ta mi ɔ ba su hiɛ ɔ. Mɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ!’
22“Asiria ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, e ta buli nɛ nɔ ngɛ ta mi ɔ a gbogboe ɔmɛ hu ngɛ a yɔkɔ ɔmɛ a mi; a bɔle lɛ kɛ kpe. 23Yɔkɔ nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ gbeje muɔ ɔ sisi tɔɔ. E ta buli ɔmɛ tsuo nɔ ngɛ ta mi; nɛ a yɔkɔ ɔmɛ bɔle e nɔ́ ɔ. Se be ko nɛ be ɔ, mɛ ji ni nɛmɛ nɛ wo nihi a he gbeye wawɛɛ ngɛ je ɔ mi.
24“Elam ngɛ lejɛ ɔ; e ta buli kpekpemi ɔ nɛ nɔ ngɛ ta a mi ɔ a gbogboe ɔmɛ hu ngɛ a yɔkɔ ɔmɛ a mi; a bɔle lɛ kɛ kpe. Nihi nɛ gbo ngɛ ta mi nɛ ɔ, mɛ tsuo a ho gbeje ya kɛ mɔmlɔtɔ. Benɛ a ngɛ wami mi ɔ, a wo nihi a he gbeye wawɛɛ, se jehanɛ lɛɛ a gbo kɛ fɔɔ si kɛ zo kpɔtɔɔ. 25Elam hwɔɔ si kɛ piɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ nɔ ngɛ ta mi ɔ a he. E ta buli kpekpemi ɔ a yɔkɔ ɔmɛ bɔle lɛ kɛ kpe. Ni nɛmɛ nɛ gbo ngɛ ta mi nɛ ɔ, mɛ tsuo mɔmlɔtɔtsɛmɛ ji mɛ. Benɛ a ngɛ wami mi ɔ, a wo nihi a he gbeye wawɛɛ; se jehanɛ lɛɛ a gbo kɛ fɔɔ si kɛ zo kpɔtɔɔ.
26“Meshek kɛ Tubal tsuo ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, nɛ a ta buli ɔmɛ a yɔkɔ ɔmɛ bɔle mɛ kɛ kpe. Mɛ tsuo mɔmlɔtɔtsɛmɛ ji mɛ; a gbe mɛ ngɛ ta mi. Be ko ɔ, a wo je ɔ he gbeye wawɛɛ. 27A pu we mɛ kaa bɔ nɛ a puɔ katsɛmɛ blema a. Blema a, a puɔ katsɛ kaa nɔ ko nɛ mia e ta hwumi ní kɛ yaa gbeje: a ngɔɔ e klaate kɛ hɔɔ e yi sisi, nɛ a kɛ e tsɛ̃i haa e nɔmlɔ tso ɔ he. Katsɛmɛ nɛ a wo a hɛ mi nyami kikɛ nɛ ɔ ji nihi nɛ a he sawale nuɔ je ɔ nɛ.
28“Kikɛ nɛ ɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ a maa ku Egipt bi ɔmɛ a mi kɛ pue mɔmlɔtɔtsɛmɛ nɛ nɔ ngɛ ta mi ɔ a nɔ.
29“Edom kɛ e matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ e ganɔ ɔmɛ tsuo ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Be ko ɔ, ta buli katsɛmɛ ji mɛ; se jehanɛ lɛɛ a ngɛ gbeje, nɛ a kɛ mɔmlɔtɔtsɛmɛ nɛ nɔ ngɛ ta mi ɔ tsuo ngɛ he kake.
30“Omleyi je ganɔ ɔmɛ tsuo ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Sidon bi ɔmɛ hu ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Be ko ɔ, a he wami ɔ haa sawale nuɔ je ɔ tsuo; se jehanɛ lɛɛ a kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ nɔ ngɛ ta mi ɔ, zo gbe mɛ tsuo kpɔtɔɔ. Mɛ tsuo mɔmlɔtɔtsɛmɛ ji mɛ, nɛ a ya su gbeje muɔ voo ɔ sisi tɔɔ.
31“Ke Egipt matsɛ ɔ kɛ e tabo ɔ na nihi babauu nɛ a gbe ngɛ ta a mi nɛ ɔ, a bua maa jɔ.” Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ lɛ de.
32“Imi nitsɛ lɛ i ha Egipt matsɛ ɔ hao je ɔ nɛ; se lɛ nitsɛ kɛ e tabo ɔ tsuo a hɛ mi ma kpata, nɛ a maa pu mɛ, kɛ mɔmlɔtɔtsɛmɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a gbe ngɛ ta a mi ɔ.” Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ lɛ de.

Title: EZEKIEL 33
Content:
Mawu pee Ezekiel bulɔ
(Ezekiel 3.16-21)
1Yawɛ kɛ mi tu munyu ekohu. 2E ke, “Nɔmlɔ adesa, tu munyu kɛ tsɔɔ o ma a mi bi ɔmɛ, nɛ o de mɛ nɔ́ nɛ maa ba ke i ha ta ba zugba ko nɔ ɔ. Ma a mi bi ɔmɛ maa hla a kpɛti nɔ kake kaa a ma a he bulɔ. 3Ke e na he nyɛli ɔmɛ nɛ a ma a, e ma kpa titimati kɛ wo ma a tue nɔ. 4Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa nu bɛ nɛ ɔ nɛ e be bue ɔ, ke he nyɛli ɔmɛ ba gbe lɛ ɔ, e gbenɔ ɔ sa lɛ nitsɛ. 5Ejakaa e nu titimati ɔ pɛmi, se e bui. E bu tue jinɛ e ko he lɛ nitsɛ e yi wami. 6Jehanɛ hu, ke bulɔ ɔ na he nyɛli ɔmɛ nɛ a ma, nɛ e kpa we titimati kɛ wo ma a tue nɔ ɔ, he nyɛli ɔmɛ ma ba gbe yayami peeli ɔmɛ lɛɛ, se ma bi a muɔ si ngɛ bulɔ ɔ dɛ.
7“Nɔmlɔ adesa, jehanɛ bu tue, ma pee mo Israel ma a he bulɔ. Munyuhi nɛ ma tu kɛ bɔ mɛ kɔkɔ ɔ, de mɛ lɛ tsuo. 8Ke i de ke yayami peelɔ ko ma gbo ngɛ e yayami nɛ e ngɛ pee ɔ he, se o bɔɛ lɛ kɔkɔ, konɛ e tsake kɛ je e blɔ yayami ɔ nɔ nɛ e yi nɛ na wami ɔ, e ma gbo ngɛ e yayami ɔmɛ a he lɛɛ, se ma bi e muɔ si ngɛ o dɛ. 9Ke o bɔ yayami peelɔ kɔkɔ, se e tsakee we e tsui nɛ e kpa yayami nɛ e ngɛ pee ɔ, e ma gbo ngɛ e yayami ɔ he, se moo lɛɛ o maa ye o he.”
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ maa bu e ní tsumi he akɔtaa
10Yawɛ kɛ mi tu munyu. E ke, “Nɔmlɔ adesa, bɔ nɛ Israel ma a ngɛ dee ji, ‘Wa tɔmi ɔmɛ, kɛ wa he yayami ɔmɛ pee tlomi ngɛ wa nɔ, nɛ e ha wa ngɛ he lo tae. Kɛ wa maa pee kɛ hi je mi kɛɛ?’ 11De mɛ ke imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, i ngɛ ye he kita kae ke i na we yayami peelɔ gbenɔ he bua jɔmi, se mohu i suɔ kaa e kpa yayami peemi, konɛ e yi nɛ na wami. Israel, nyɛ kpa yayami nɛ nyɛ ngɛ pee ɔ. Mɛni he je nyɛ suɔ mohu kaa nyɛ ma gbo ɔ?
12“Nɔmlɔ adesa, jehanɛ de Israel ma a ke, ke dalɔ pee yayami ɔ, kpakpa nɛ e pee be ko ɔ be nyɛe ma he e yi wami. Ke yayami peelɔ kpa yayami peemi ɔ, a be e tue gblae; nɛ ke dalɔ bɔni yayami peemi ɔ, a be e yi wami hee. 13Ke i de dalɔ ko ke bɔ tsuaa bɔ nɛ pee ɔ, e yi ma na wami, kɛkɛ nɛ e bɔni kpakpa nɛ e pee be ko ɔ he susumi kaa e hiɛ babauu, nɛ jehanɛ e bɔni yayami peemi ɔ, i be kpakpa nɛ e pee be ko ɔ kaie. Yayamihi nɛ e pee ɔ a he e ma gbo ngɛ. 14Ke i bɔ yayami peelɔ kɔkɔ kaa e ma gbo, kɛkɛ nɛ e kpa yayami peemi, nɛ e bɔni nɔ́ nɛ da peemi kɛ dami sane yemi ɔ, e be gboe; e yi ma na wami. 15Lɔ ɔ ji kaa nɔ́ ko nɛ a kɛ ba to awaba ngɛ e ngɔ ɔ, e kpale kɛ ya ha nɔtsɛ; aloo nɔ́ ko nɛ e ya ju ɔ, e kpale ya ha nɔtsɛ. Ke e kpa yayami peemi, nɛ e bɔni mlaahi nɛ haa nɔ wami ɔ a nɔ yemi ɔ, e be gboe; e yi ma na wami. 16Yayami nɛ e pee ɔ, ma ngɔ kɛ pa lɛ, nɛ e yi ma na wami; ejakaa e pee nɔ́ nɛ da, nɛ e ye dami sane.
17“Se o ma a mi bi ɔmɛ ke nɔ́ nɛ i peeɔ ɔ dɛ! Dɛbi, mɛ mohu lɛ a ní peepee ɔmɛ dɛ! 18Ke dalɔ kpale kɛ je e dami blɔ ɔ nɔ, nɛ e pee yayami ɔ, yayami ɔ he e ma gbo ngɛ. 19Ke yayami peelɔ kpa yayami peemi, nɛ e pee nɔ́ nɛ da, nɛ e ye dami sane ɔ, e he e yi wami. 20Se kɛ̃ ɔ, Israel ma, nyɛ ke nɔ́ nɛ i peeɔ ɔ dɛ. Nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ peeɔ ɔ, lɔ ɔ nɔ ma da kɛ kojo lɛ.”
A ywia Yerusalem ma a
21 Benɛ a nuu wɔ kɛ ho ma se ya a, jeha nyɔngma kɛ enyɔne ɔ we nyɔhiɔ nyɔngmane ɔ we ligbi enuɔne ɔ, nyumu ko nɛ tu fo kɛ je Yerusalem, ba bɔ mi amaniɛ ke he nyɛli ba ywia Yerusalem ma a. 22Gbɔkuɛ ɔ nɛ e nɔ jena mɔtu loko amaniɛ bɔlɔ ɔ ba a, Yawɛ he wami ɔ ma ye nya. Se mɔtu maa pee benɛ e ba a, Yawɛ bli ye nya momo, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i nyɛ tu munyu.
Ma a pee yayamihi babauu
23Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ de mi ke, 24“Nɔmlɔ adesa, nihi nɛ ngɛ ma doku ɔmɛ a mi ngɛ Israel zugba a nɔ ɔ deɔ mi ke, ‘Abraham ɔ nɛ a ngɔ zugba a tsuo ngɔ ha lɛ ɔ, nɔ kake too ji lɛ, se wɔɔ lɛɛ wa he hiɛ; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, zugba a, wɔ a kɛ ha kaa wa weto ní.’
25“De mɛ ke imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, bɔ nɛ i ngɛ dee ji, nyɛ yeɔ lo nɛ muɔ ngɛ mi. Nyɛ jaa amagahi. Nyɛ pueɔ muɔ si. Mɛni ha nɛ nyɛ susuɔ kaa nyɛ nɔ ji zugba a? 26Nyɛ hiaa klaate kɛ woɔ nyɛ sibi a he. Nyɛ tsuɔ níhi nɛ a hiee babauu; nyɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ nyɛ puɛɔ gba. Mɛni kulaa lɛ haa nyɛ susuɔ kaa nyɛ nɔ́ ji zugba a?
27“De mɛ ke imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, i ngɛ ye he kita kae ke bɔ tsuaa bɔ nɛ pee ɔ, nihi nɛ ngɛ ma doku ɔmɛ a mi ɔ, a ma kpata mɛ tsuo a hɛ mi. Nihi nɛ ngɛ nga a nɔ ɔ, nga mi lohwe awi yeli maa ye mɛ. Nɛ nihi nɛ ya laa a he ngɛ yo ɔmɛ a nɔ, kɛ tɛ muɔhi a mi ɔ, gbenɔ hiɔ maa gbe mɛ. 28Ma ha zugba a nɔ tsuo maa pee pasaa kulaa, kɛkɛ ɔ, zugba a mi he wami nɛ a ngɔ a hɛ kɛ fɔ nɔ ɔ se maa po. Yo ɔmɛ a nɔ maa je gu; lejɛ ɔmɛ maa pee gbeye, nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be lejɛ ɔmɛ gue hu. 29Ke i pee zugba a tsuo pasaa nɛ e pee ma doku ngɛ yayamihi babauu nɛ a pee ɔ a he ɔ, kɛkɛ ɔ, a maa le kaa imi ji Yawɛ.”
Nɔ́ nɛ ba ngɛ gbalɔ ɔ sɛ gbi ɔ se
30Yawɛ de mi ke, “Nɔmlɔ adesa, ke o ma a mi bi ɔmɛ ba kpe ngɛ ma a gbogbo ɔmɛ a he, loo a we agbo ɔmɛ a nya a, o he munyu sɔuu lɛ a hii tue. Bɔ nɛ a deɔ a sibi ji, ‘Nyɛɛ ba nɛ wa ya bu munyu nɛ kpale je Yawɛ ngɔ kɛ ba amlɔ nɛ ɔ tue.’ 31Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ye ma a baa o ngɔ, nɛ a ba hii si ngɛ o hɛ mi nɛ a buɔ munyu ɔmɛ tue, se nɔ́ nɛ o deɔ mɛ ke a pee ɔ, lɔ ɔ lɛɛ a pee we. Á yeɔ nɔ he fɛu, nɛ a se nami he pɛ a susuɔ. 32A buɔ mo kaa nɔ ko nɛ laa suɔmi la kɛ gbi ngɔngɔɛ, aloo nɔ ko nɛ le saku fiami saminya. A ba buɔ o munyu ɔmɛ tue lɛɛ, se a yi nɔ. 33Níhi nɛ o de mɛ ɔ tsuo maa ba mi sisiisi. Ke a ba mi ɔ, kɛkɛ a maa le kaa gbalɔ ko kɛ mɛ ba hi si hyɛ.”

Title: EZEKIEL 34
Content:
Israel to hyɛli ɔmɛ
1Yawɛ kɛ mi tu munyu ekohu. 2E ke, “Nɔmlɔ adesa, gbaa kɛ si Israel nɔ yeli ɔmɛ. De mɛ ke bɔ nɛ imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, i ngɛ mɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. Musu tloo nyɛ Israel to hyɛli! Nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ he pɛ nyɛ ngɛ lɛe; nyɛ hyɛ we to ɔmɛ a nɔ! Anɛ pi to ɔmɛ mohu nɛ to hyɛlɔ hyɛɛ lo? 3Se nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ gbeɔ to nɛ wo zɔ ɔ nɛ nyɛ yeɔ; nyɛ ngɔɔ to he womi ɔ kɛ kpɛɔ tade nɛ nyɛ woɔ, se to ɔmɛ lɛɛ nyɛ ha we mɛ ní. 4Ní nɛmɛ nɛ gbɔjɔ ɔ, nyɛ hyɛ we a nɔ bɔ nɛ sa; hiɔtsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, nyɛ tsa we mɛ; ní nɛmɛ nɛ plaa a, nyɛ fi we pa amɛ a nɔ ha mɛ; ní nɛmɛ nɛ tla blɔ ɔ, nyɛ ya kpakaa we mɛ; nɛ ní nɛmɛ nɛ laa a, nyɛ ya hla we mɛ. Se yi mi mohu nyɛ waa mɛ. 5 To hyɛlɔ ko be; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, to ɔmɛ gbɛ fĩa, nɛ lohwe awi yeli ya nuu mɛ nɛ a ye. 6Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ye to ɔmɛ wo lalaalo kɛ ya gu yo ɔmɛ, kɛ yokuhi nɛ ya hiɔwe tsuo a nɔ. A gbɛ mɛ fĩa je ɔ mi he tsuaa he. Nɔ ko nɔ ko be nɛ dii a se, loo e hlaa mɛ.
7“Jehanɛ, nyɛ to hyɛli, nyɛɛ bu imi Yawɛ tue saminya. 8Imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, i ngɛ ye he kita kae, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ ta tue. Nga mi lohwe awi yeli nuu ye to ɔmɛ, a gbe mɛ nɛ a ye nyamanyama, ejakaa to hyɛlɔ ko be; ye to hyɛli ɔmɛ dí to ɔmɛ a se. To hyɛli ɔmɛ ngɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a he lɛe; a hyɛ we to ɔmɛ a nɔ. 9Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ to hyɛli, nyɛɛ bu mi tue saminya. 10Imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, i ke i kɛ nyɛ ná. Ma kpɔ ye to ɔmɛ ngɛ nyɛ dɛ. I be hae nɛ nyɛɛ lɛ nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ he hu. Ma kpɔ ye to ɔmɛ kɛ je nyɛ dɛ; kɛkɛ ɔ, nyɛ be mɛ nae maa ye hu.
To hyɛlɔ kpakpa a
11“Imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke, imi nitsɛ ma hla ye to ɔmɛ a se blɔ, nɛ ma hyɛ a nɔ. 12Bɔ nɛ to hyɛlɔ hlaa e tohi nɛ gbɛ fĩa, nɛ e buaa a nya ekohu ɔ, jã ma hla ye to ɔmɛ a se blɔ. Ma kpaka mɛ kɛ je he tsuaa he nɛ a gbɛ fĩa ligbi ɔ nɛ jamɛ amanehlu kɔɔhiɔ yaya ba fia mɛ ɔ. 13Ma je mɛ kɛ je je ma amɛ a kpɛti; ma bua a nya kɛ ba mɛ nitsɛmɛ a zugba a nɔ. Ma lɛ mɛ ngɛ yo ɔmɛ a nɔ, pa amɛ a he, kɛ he tsuaa he nɛ nga mumu ngɛ ngɛ Israel. 14Ma ha nɛ a maa ye ní ngɛ tue mi jɔmi mi ngɛ yo ɔmɛ a nɔ, kɔ̃ ɔmɛ a mi, kɛ hehi tsuo nɛ nga mumu ngɛ ngɛ Israel zugba a nɔ. 15Imi nitsɛ ma lɛ ye to ɔmɛ; nɛ ma ha mɛ he ko nɛ a maa jɔɔ a he ngɛ. Imi, Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ lɛ i de.
16“Tohi nɛ laa a, ma ya hla mɛ; ní nɛmɛ nɛ tla blɔ ɔ, ma ya tsɔ́ mɛ kɛ ba; ní nɛmɛ nɛ plaa a, ma fi a pa amɛ a nɔ ha mɛ; hiɔtsɛmɛ ɔmɛ hu ma tsa mɛ. Se ní nɛmɛ nɛ wo zɔ, kɛ ní nɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ he wami saminya a, ma kpata a hɛ mi; ejakaa i yeɔ dami sane.
17“Jehanɛ, nyɛ ye to kuu, bɔ nɛ imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, i ngɛ nyɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: Ma kojo jijɔ kake kɛ jijɔ kake a kpɛti; ma kojo akpakpo ɔmɛ kɛ agbosu ɔmɛ a kpɛti. 18Nyɛ naa niye ní kpakpa nyɛ yeɔ. Anɛ lɔ ɔ pi ha nyɛ lo? Lɛɛ mɛni he je niye ní nɛ piɛ ngɛ nyɛ ní yemi he ɔ, nyɛ kpale ya naa nɔ nyamanyama a? Jehanɛ hu, nyɛ naa nyu nɛ mi tsɔ nɛ nyɛ nuɔ. Anɛ lɔ ɔ nɛ pi ha nyɛ he je nɛ nyɛ ngɔɔ nyɛ nane kɛ gbidiɔ nyu nɛ piɛ ɔ? 19Anɛ e sa kaa ye to ɔmɛ nɛ a ye nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ naa nɔ ɔ, nɛ a nu nyu nɛ nyɛ gbidi ɔ lo?
20“Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, jehanɛ lɛɛ tohi nɛ wo zɔ, kɛ tohi nɛ tã he lo ɔ, imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ nitsɛ ma kojo a kpɛti. 21Nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ tsitsɛɛɔ to hiɔtsɛmɛ ɔmɛ, nɛ nyɛ hɛɛ mɛ koli kɛ jee to kuu ɔ he kɛ yaa se. 22Se imi lɛɛ ma he ye to ɔmɛ a yi wami, nɛ i be blɔ ngmɛe nɛ nɔ ko nɛ wa mɛ yi mi hu. Ma kojo jijɔ kɛ jijɔ a kpɛti. 23 Ma ngɔ to hyɛlɔ kake kɛ to a nya nɛ e hyɛ a nɔ. Lɛ ji ye tsɔlɔ David. E maa hyɛ a nɔ saminya. 24 Imi Yawɛ, ma pee a Mawu, nɛ ye tsɔlɔ David maa ye ganɔ ha mɛ. Imi Yawɛ lɛ i de. 25I kɛ mɛ maa so tue mi jɔmi somi. Ma fie lohwe awi yeli tsuo kɛ je zugba a nɔ, konɛ a hi si ngɛ nga a nɔ ngɛ tue mi jɔmi mi, nɛ a hwɔ mahe fuaa.
26“Ma gbaa mɛ; nɛ ma ha a maa hi ye yo klɔuklɔu ɔ he tsuo kɛ kpe. Ma ha hiɔmi maa nɛ bɔ nɛ sa ngɛ e be mi ha mɛ. Ma gbaa mɛ kɛ hiɔmi babauu. 27Nga nɔ tso ɔmɛ maa wo yiblii, nɛ zugba a maa ba ní saminya; kɛkɛ ɔ, tue mi jɔmi maa ba zugba a nɔ. Ma kplɔ kɔsɔkɔsɔ ɔmɛ kɛ je a kuɛ mi, nɛ a ye a he kɛ je nyɔguɛ si himi mi. A ma ba hi mɛ nitsɛmɛ a zugba nɔ. Kɛkɛ ɔ, a maa le kaa imi ji Yawɛ. 28Je ma amɛ ba be mɛ haoe nɛ a ha a ní hu. Lohwe awi yeli ba be mɛ nue nɛ a ye hu. A maa hi si ngɛ tue mi jɔmi mi, nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be a he gbeye woe. 29Ma ngɔ zugba nɛ baa ní saminya kɛ ha mɛ; nɛ ma ha hwɔ se maa po kulaa ngɛ zugba a nɔ; kɛkɛ ɔ, je ma amɛ be a he guɛ gbee ngɛ je ɔ mi hu. 30A maa le kaa imi Yawɛ, a Mawu ɔ, i kɛ mɛ ngɛ. Nɛ mɛ Israel bi ɔ, ye ma ji mɛ. Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ lɛ de.
31“Nyɛ ye ma, nyɛ ji ye tohi nɛ i ngɛ lɛe, nɛ imi ji nyɛ Mawu.” Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ lɛ de.

Title: EZEKIEL 35
Content:
Mawu maa gbla Edom tue
1 Yawɛ kɛ mi tu munyu ekohu. 2E ke, “Nɔmlɔ adesa, plɛ o hɛ mi kɛ kpee Edom zugba a, nɛ o gba kɛ si lɛ. 3De lɛ ke bɔ nɛ imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, i ngɛ dee ji,
Edom, i kɛ mo ná!
Ma pee mo pasaa.
4Ma pee o ma amɛ ma dokuhi;
o zugba a tsuo maa pee pasaa;
kɛkɛ ɔ, o maa le kaa imi
ji Yawɛ.
5“O kɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ yi saasaa. Benɛ a pee yayami nɛ a ngɛ a tue gblae, nɛ a ngɛ amanehlu nae ɔ, o kɛ klaate gbe mɛ. 6Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, i ngɛ ye he kita kae ke a ma kpata o hɛ mi; o yi be wami nae kɔkɔɔkɔ. O pue muɔ si, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a ma pue mo hu o muɔ si. 7Ma pee Edom yo ɔ nɔ pasaa kulaa. Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa gu lejɛ ɔ, ma kpata e hɛ mi. 8Ma ha nɛ yo ɔmɛ a nɔ ma hyi kɛ ni gbogboehi sɔuu; nihi nɛ nɔ ngɛ ta mi ɔ, a gbogboehi babauu maa hi lejɛ ɔ, kɛ yo ɔmɛ a kpɛ, kɛ kɔ̃ ɔmɛ a mi. 9Ma pee mo pasaa kulaa. O ma amɛ maa pee ma dokuhi, nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be a mi hie hu. Kɛkɛ ɔ, o maa le kaa imi ji Yawɛ.
10“O de ke e ngɛ mi kaa imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, ye mahi ji Yuda, Israel, kɛ a he zugba amɛ lɛɛ, se o níhi ji mɛ tsuo, nɛ o maa ngɔ. 11Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i ngɛ ye he kita kae ke bɔ nɛ o mi mi fu wawɛɛ kɛ wo Israel, nɛ o hɛ hu kɔ e nɔ, nɛ o ngɛ lɛ nyɛe ɔ, jã pɛpɛɛpɛ ma pee mo. Kɛkɛ ɔ, ye ma a ma na maa le kaa i kɛ mɛ ngɛ, nɛ i ngɛ Edom tue gblae ha mɛ. 12O ma na maa le jehanɛ kaa imi Yawɛ, i nu o musu bɔmi munyu ɔmɛ nɛ o tu kɛ si Israel yo ɔmɛ ke, ‘Yo ɔmɛ a nɔ pee pasaa; a ngɔ kɛ ha wɔ nɛ waa pee mɛ bɔ nɛ wa suɔ’ ɔ. 13Pupuupu nɛ o pee, nɛ o tu musu bɔmi munyuhi babauu kɛ si mi ɔ, i nu lɛ tsuo.”
14Bɔ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ngɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Ma pee mo pasaa, konɛ je ɔ tsuo nɛ nya kaa o nɔ si! 15Benɛ ye ma Israel nɔ si nɛ e pee pasaa a, o nya. Jehanɛ lɛɛ Seir yo ɔmɛ, kɛ Edom zugba a tsuo maa pee pasaa kulaa. Kɛkɛ ɔ, nɔ tsuaa nɔ maa le kaa imi ji Yawɛ.”

Title: EZEKIEL 36
Content:
Mawu maa gbaa Israel
1Yawɛ de mi ke, “Nɔmlɔ adesa, o kɛ Israel yo ɔmɛ nɛ tu munyu, nɛ o de mɛ ke sɛ gbi nɛ imi 2Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, i ngɛ mɛ hae ɔ, a bu tue: Israel he nyɛli ɔmɛ pee pupuupu kɛ fĩa, nɛ a de ke, ‘Yiɛɛ! Blema yo ɔmɛ ba pee wa níhi.’
3“Jehanɛ, gbaa nɛ o de mɛ nɔ́ nɛ imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, i ngɛ dee ɔ. Benɛ je ma amɛ nɛ bɔle Israel ɔ ba tua lɛ, nɛ a ha e níhi ngɛ yo ɔmɛ a nɔ ɔ, je ma amɛ tsuo pue e hɛ mi si. 4Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ Israel yohi, yokuhi, nyu dɔhi, kɔ̃hi, kɛ we dokuhi kɛ nyɛ he mahi nɛ a ha nyɛ mi ní nɛ nyɛ ba pee nɔ́ nɛ a yeɔ he fɛu ha mɛ, nyɛɛ bu nɔ́ nɛ imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ i ngɛ nyɛ dee ɔ tue.
5“Imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, i kɛ hɛdɔ, kɛ abofu tu munyu kɛ si je ma amɛ, kɛ Edom zugba a tsuo. Mɛɛ lɛɛ a nya, nɛ a gbe ye ma a he guɛ; ejakaa a ngɔ ye zugba a, kɛ lohwe lɛmi he ɔmɛ ngɔ pee a weto ní.
6“Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, gbaa kɛ tsɔɔ Israel zugba a. De yo ɔmɛ, pa amɛ, kɛ kɔ̃ ɔmɛ ke imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, i kɛ hɛdɔ, kɛ abofu wawɛɛ ngɛ munyu tue, ejakaa je ma amɛ gbe nyɛ he guɛ, nɛ a pue nyɛ hɛ mi si. 7Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, i ngɛ kita kae ke ma ba mɛ si kulaa, konɛ zo nɛ gbe mɛ kpɔtɔɔ. 8Se Israel yo ɔmɛ a nɔ lɛɛ tso ɔmɛ ma gba kɔnihi, nɛ a maa wo yiblii ha nyɛ ekohu. Be nɛ nyɛ maa kpale kɛ ba we ekohu ɔ su ta. 9I kɛ nyɛ ngɛ. Ma hyɛ nɛ a ma hu nyɛ zugba amɛ ekohu, nɛ a ma du ní ngɛ a nɔ. 10Ma ha nyɛ he maa hiɛ babauu. Nyɛ maa hi ma amɛ a mi, nɛ nyɛ ma dla maa ma doku ɔmɛ mɛ ekohu. 11Nimli, kɛ lohwehi a he ma ba hiɛ babauu ngɛ zugba a nɔ; a ma plɔke, nɛ a ma fɔ bimɛ. Ma ha a maa hi zugba a nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ a hi nyɛ zugba a nɔ sa a. Ma ha nyɛ maa bɔ pe kekle ɔ po. Kɛkɛ ɔ, nyɛ maa le kaa imi ji Yawɛ. 12Ye ma Israel, ma kpale nyɛ kɛ ba zugba a nɔ, nɛ nyɛ ma ba hi lejɛ ɔ ekohu. Zugba a maa pee nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ nɔ́, nɛ nyɛ bimɛ hu i be hae nɛ a ma gbo gblegbleegble.
13“Imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, i ke e ngɛ mi niinɛ kaa nihi deɔ ke zugba nɛ yeɔ nɔmlɔ ji mo, nɛ o ha we nɛ o mi bi a yi naa wami. 14Se kɛ je amlɔ nɛ ɔ kɛ yaa a, o be nɔmlɔ yee hu; o ma a mi bi ɔmɛ ɔ, o be a hɛ mi kpatae hu. Imi, Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ lɛ i de. 15He guɛ gbemi, kɛ ahlua bɔmi munyuhi nɛ je ma amɛ tuɔ ɔ, zugba a be tue bue hu. Zugba a be e bimɛ ɔmɛ a hɛ mi kpatae hu. Imi, Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ lɛ i de.”
Israel ma na wami he
16Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ kɛ mi tu munyu ekohu. 17E ke, “Nɔmlɔ adesa, benɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ ngɛ a zugba a nɔ ɔ, a ngɔ a ní peemi níhi, kɛ a blɔ yaya amɛ kɛ ble lejɛ ɔ. A je mi bami nɛ a kɛ ble a he ɔ ngɛ kaa bɔ nɛ yo nɛ ku nine nɛ e he tsɔ we ngɛ ɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ. 18I gbla a tue wawɛɛ, ejakaa ye mi mi wo la ngɛ muɔ si nɛ a pue ngɛ zugba a nɔ, kɛ amagahi nɛ a kɛ ble lɛ ɔ a he. 19I gbla a tue, nɛ i gbɛ mɛ ngɔ fĩa zugba a nɔ tsuo ngɛ a je mi bami, kɛ a ní peemi yaya amɛ a he. 20He tsuaa he nɛ a ya a, nihi tuɔ munyu kɛ puɛɔ ye biɛ klɔuklɔu ɔ. A deɔ ke, ‘Yawɛ nitsɛ ma ji nɛ ɔ nɛ, se e fie mɛ kɛ je zugba nɛ e ha mɛ ɔ nɔ.’ 21Israel ma a puɛ ye biɛ ngɛ he tsuaa he nɛ a ya a. Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ dɔ mi wawɛɛ.
22“Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, de Israel bi ɔmɛ ke bɔ nɛ imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ i ngɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: Nɔ́ nɛ i yaa pee nɛ ɔ, pi nyɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ nyɛ he, se mohu ye biɛ klɔuklɔu ɔ nɛ nyɛ ble ngɛ ma amɛ a mi he nɛ nyɛ ya a, lɔ ɔ he je. 23Ye biɛ ɔ nɛ nyɛ ble ngɛ je ma amɛ a kpɛti ɔ, ma pee lɛ klɔuklɔu. Kɛkɛ ɔ, je ma amɛ maa le kaa imi ji Yawɛ. Imi, Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ lɛ i de. Ma gu nyɛ, ye ma a nyɛ nɔ kɛ tsɔɔ je ma amɛ kaa nɔ klɔuklɔu ji mi. 24Ma je nyɛ kɛ je je ma amɛ a kpɛti. Ma bua nyɛ nya kɛ je he tsuaa he kɛ ba nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ zugba a nɔ ekohu. 25Ma ngɔ nyu klɔuklɔu kɛ fĩa nyɛ nɔ, nɛ nyɛ he ma tsɔ. Ma tsu nyɛ he kɛ je amagahi, kɛ mu níhi tsuo nɛ nyɛ kɛ ble nyɛ he ɔ a mi. 26 Ma ha nyɛ tsui he, kɛ juɛmi he. Nyɛ tsui nɛ wlua kaa tɛ ɔ, ma je kɛ je nyɛ mi, nɛ ma ha nyɛ tsui nɛ he jɔ. 27Ma ngɔ ye mumi ɔ kɛ wo nyɛ mi, konɛ nyɛɛ bu ye mlaa amɛ tsuo tue, nɛ nyɛɛ ye a nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ. 28Jehanɛ zugba a nɛ i ngɔ ha nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, nyɛ maa hi nɔ. Nyɛ maa pee ye ma, nɛ imi hu ma pee nyɛ Mawu. 29Níhi tsuo nɛ bleɔ nyɛ ɔ, ma je nyɛ kɛ je a mi. Ma ha nɛ ngma maa ba ha nyɛ babauu, nɛ hwɔ be nyɛ yee hu. 30Ma ha tso yiblii, kɛ ngmɔ niba ní maa hiɛ babauu, konɛ hwɔ ko ye nyɛ nɛ nyɛ pue nyɛ hɛ mi si ngɛ je ma amɛ a kpɛti hu. 31Kɛkɛ ɔ, nyɛ ma kai nyɛ je mi bami yaya amɛ, kɛ zo níhi nɛ nyɛ tsu ɔ, nɛ nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ he maa nyɛɛ nyɛ ngɛ nyɛ yayami ɔmɛ, kɛ nyɛ ní hiemi ní ɔmɛ a he. 32Israel, i ngɛ hae nɛ nyɛɛ le kaa tsa pi nyɛ he nɛ ma tsu ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo. Pe i suɔ kaa zo nɛ gbe nyɛ, nɛ nyɛ hɛ mi nɛ pue si ngɛ nyɛ je mi bami yaya a he. Imi, Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ lɛ i de.”
