33Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ke, “Ke i tsu nyɛ he kɛ je nyɛ he yayami ɔmɛ tsuo a mi ɔ, ma ha nyɛ ma ba hi nyɛ ma amɛ a mi ekohu, nɛ nyɛ ma dla maa ma we doku ɔmɛ. 34Zugba a nɛ fɔɔ si gu ɔ, a maa kpale hu lɛ ekohu, nɛ nihi tsuo nɛ ba gu lejɛ ɔ sa a maa na kaa zugba a fɔ we si gu hu, se a kpale hu lɛ. 35A ma de ke zugba nɛ ɔ nɛ fɔ si gu kaa nga kplanaa a, lɔ ɔ lɛ ba pee kaa Eden ngmɔ nɛ ɔ. Ma amɛ nɛ a ku pueɔ si, nɛ a ha a mi níhi, nɛ a pee ma dokuhi ɔ, a kpale fia a gbogbo ɔmɛ ekohu, nɛ nihi ngɛ ma amɛ a mi. 36Kɛkɛ ɔ, je ma amɛ tsuo nɛ bɔle nyɛ kɛ kpe ɔ maa le kaa imi Yawɛ lɛ i dla ma we doku ɔmɛ, nɛ i du ní ngɛ zugba nɛ fɔ si gu ɔ nɔ. Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de, nɛ ma pee hulɔ!”
37Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ke, “Nɔ́ kake nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ ma bi mi nɛ ma pee ha mɛ ji, ma ha a he nɛ hiɛ babauu kaa to kuu. 38Ma ha nɛ a ma amɛ ma hyi tɔ kɛ nimli kaa tohi nɛ a kɛ ba bɔ sami, loo nimli kpekpemi nɛ ba Yerusalem nɛ a ba ye nyami be. Kɛkɛ ɔ, a maa le kaa imi ji Yawɛ.”

Title: EZEKIEL 37
Content:
Kɔ̃ kɛ e mi wu gbigblihi
1I nu Yawɛ he wami he wawɛɛ; nɛ e mumi ɔ ngɔ mi kɛ ya ma kɔ̃ ko mi. Lejɛ ɔ tsuo hyi kɛ wuhi babauu. 2E kɛ mi bɔle kɔ̃ ɔ tsuo kɛ kpe; nɛ i na kaa wuhi babauu nitsɛ pueɔ si ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, wuhi nɛ gbli kadokado sɔuu. 3Kɛkɛ nɛ e bi mi ke, “Nɔmlɔ adesa, anɛ wu nɛ ɔmɛ ma nyɛ ma na wami ekohu lo?”
I he nɔ ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, mo lɛ o le!”
4E ya nɔ, nɛ e de mi ke, “Gbaa kɛ pue wu nɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ. De wu gbigbli nɛ ɔmɛ ke á bu Yawɛ munyu ɔ tue. 5De mɛ ke imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, i ngɛ mɛ dee ke ma ngɔ mumi kɛ wo nyɛ mi, nɛ nyɛ maa ba wami mi ekohu. 6Ma ngɔ pani kɛ pue nyɛ nɔ; ma ha lo ma ba ha nyɛ he, nɛ he womi ma ba ha nyɛ he. Ma ngɔ ye mumi kɛ wo nyɛ mi, nɛ nyɛ maa ba wami mi ekohu. Kɛkɛ ɔ, nyɛ ma na maa le kaa imi ji Yawɛ.”
7Kɛkɛ nɛ i gba kaa bɔ nɛ a de mi ɔ. Benɛ i ngɛ munyu ɔ tue ɔ, i nu nɛ wu ɔmɛ bɔni a he mimiɛmi kɛ a sibi a he sami kpɛkpɛ kpɛkpɛ; nɛ wu kɛ wu tsa. 8Pani kɛ lo ba ha wu ɔmɛ a he, nɛ he womi ba ha a nɔ. Se mumi be nimli tso nɛ ɔmɛ a mi.
9Jehanɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ de mi ke, “Nɔmlɔ adesa, gbaa kɛ tsɔɔ mumi ɔ. De lɛ ke Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ke e je je ɔ kɔ nya eywiɛ ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ ba, nɛ e ba wo mumi kɛ pue gbogboe nɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ, konɛ a ba wami mi ekohu.”
10 Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i gba kaa bɔ nɛ a de mi ɔ. Kɛkɛ nɛ mumi ba gbogboe ɔmɛ a mi; a ba pee hɛ kali, nɛ a te da si ngɛ a nanehi a nɔ; a hiɛ babauu nitsɛ!
11Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ de mi ke, “Nɔmlɔ adesa, Israel ma a tsuo ngɛ kaa wu nɛ ɔmɛ. A ngɛ dee ke a gbli kadokado, nɛ a be hɛ nɔ kami ko kulaa; a kpata a hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ. 12Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, gbaa kɛ tsɔɔ ye ma Israel, nɛ o de mɛ ke imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ nitsɛ ma bli a yɔkɔ ɔmɛ a nya. Ma je mɛ kpo, nɛ ma ha a ma ba hi mɛ nitsɛmɛ a zugba nɔ ekohu. 13Ke i bli yɔkɔ ɔmɛ nɛ a pu mɛ ngɛ mi ɔ a nya, nɛ i ha a je kpo kɛ ba a, kɛkɛ ye ma a maa le kaa imi ji Yawɛ. 14Ma ngɔ ye mumi ɔ ngɔ wo a mi, nɛ ma ha a maa ba wami mi ekohu. Ma ha a ma ba hi mɛ nitsɛmɛ a zugba nɔ ekohu. Kɛkɛ ɔ, a maa le kaa imi ji Yawɛ. Imi ji nɔ nɛ wo si ɔ, nɛ ma ye nɔ sisiisi. Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de.”
Yuda kɛ Israel plɛ pee nɔ yemi kake
15Yawɛ kɛ mi tu munyu ekohu. 16E ke, “Nɔmlɔ adesa, yaa ngɔ tso, nɛ o ngma ngɛ nɔ ke, ‘Yuda nɔ yemi ɔ.’ Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, yaa ngɔ tso kpa nɛ o ngma ngɛ nɔ ke ‘Israel nɔ yemi ɔ.’ 17Jehanɛ bla tso enyɔ ɔmɛ kɛ pee kake, nɛ o hɛɛ ngɛ o dɛ mi. 18Ke o ma mi bi ɔmɛ bi mo nɔ́ nɛ ɔ sisi ɔ, 19de ke, imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, ma ngɔ tso ɔ nɛ daa si ha Israel ɔ, kɛ nɔ́ nɛ daa si ha Yuda a kɛ bla. Ma ngɔ tso enyɔ nɛ ɔmɛ ngɔ pee tso kake ngɛ ye dɛ mi.
20“Ha nɛ ma a nɛ na tso enyɔ ɔmɛ nɛ o ngma ní ngɛ a nɔ nɛ ngɛ o dɛ mi ɔ. 21De mɛ ke he tsuaa he nɛ ye ma a ngɛ ngɛ je ma amɛ a mi hehi nɛ a ho ɔ, imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, ma bua a nya, nɛ ma kpale mɛ tsuo kɛ je lejɛ ɔmɛ kɛ ba mɛ nitsɛmɛ a zugba nɔ. 22Ma pee mɛ ma kake ngɛ zugba a nɔ ngɛ Israel yo ɔmɛ a nɔ. Matsɛ kake maa ye a nɔ. A be je ma enyɔ pee hu. A mi be gbae kɛ pee nɔ yemi enyɔ hu. 23Jehanɛ a be amaga jae hu, nɛ a be ní hiemi níhi, kɛ yayami pee kɛ ble a he hu. Se yayamihi gbegbeegbe nɛ a pee kɛ si mi ɔ, ma ngɔ kɛ pa mɛ. Ma tsu a he, nɛ a maa pee ye ma, nɛ imi hu ma pee a Mawu. 24 Ye tsɔlɔ David ma ba ye matsɛ ngɛ a nɔ. Mɛ tsuo a maa hi tsɛ kake sisi, nɛ a maa ye ye mlaa amɛ a nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ. 25A maa hi zugba nɛ i ngɔ ha ye tsɔlɔ Yakob ɔ nɔ. Lejɛ ɔ lɛ a nɛmɛ ɔmɛ hi, nɛ lejɛ ɔ a bimɛ, kɛ a nina tsuo maa hi kɛ maa ya neneene. Ye tsɔlɔ David maa ye ganɔ kɛ maa ya neneene. 26I kɛ mɛ maa so he jɔmi somi. E maa pee somi nɛ maa hi si daa. Ma baa a yi saminya. Ma gbaa ma a, nɛ a he maa hiɛ babauu. Ma ma ye we klɔuklɔu ɔ ngɛ zugba a nɔ he nɛ a ngɛ ɔ, nɛ we ɔ maa hi lejɛ ɔ daa. 27 I kɛ mɛ maa hi si. Ma pee a Mawu; nɛ mɛ hu a maa pee ye ma. 28Ke i ma ye we ɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, nɛ i ngɛ a kpɛti daa kɛ yaa neneene ɔ, kɛkɛ je ma amɛ maa le kaa imi ji Yawɛ; nɛ imi nitsɛ lɛ i hla Israel kaa ye ma a nɛ.”

Title: EZEKIEL 38
Content:
Gog maa pee kaa ní tsumi dade ngɛ Mawu dɛ mi
1Yawɛ kɛ mi tu munyu ekohu. 2 E ke, “Nɔmlɔ adesa, gbaa kɛ si Gog, ganɔ ngua a nɛ ngɛ Meshek, kɛ Tubal ngɛ Magog zugba a nɔ ɔ. Gbaa kɛ si lɛ. 3De lɛ ke imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, i kɛ lɛ ná. 4Ma mlɔɔ e hɛ mi, nɛ ma ngɔ gbowe kɛ wo e tsitsa mi. Ma gbla e tabo ɔ, e we okpɔngɔ ɔmɛ, kɛ okpɔngɔ ta buli babauu nɛ a mia kɛ ha ta a kɛ je. Ta bulɔ tsuaa ta bulɔ hɛɛ tsɛ̃i, nɛ e mia kɛ klaate. 5Persia bi, Sudan bi, kɛ Libia bi piɛ a he. Ni nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo hɛɛ tsɛ̃i, nɛ a bu dade pɛɛ. 6Ta buli tsuo nɛ ngɛ Gomer, kɛ Bet Toga ma zugba amɛ a nɔ ngɛ omleyi je piɛ e he. Je ma kpahi babauu hu piɛ e he ja nɔuu. 7De lɛ ke e pee e tabo ɔ, kɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ klaalo. 8Jeha komɛ a se ɔ, ma ha e ma ya tua nihi ngɛ Israel yo ɔmɛ a nɔ. A kɛ ta kpata zugba nɛ ɔ hɛ mi be ko, nɛ a si lejɛ ɔ ngɔ fɔ si gu jeha babauu, se jehanɛ lɛɛ a bua nihi a nya ngɛ lejɛ ɔ ngɛ tue mi jɔmi mi. 9E kɛ e tabo ɔ, kɛ je mahi babauu ma ba tua lejɛ ɔ kaa ahumi; a maa ha zugba a nɔ kaa bɔku.”
10Bɔ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ngɛ Gog dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Ke jamɛ a be ɔ su ɔ, susumi slɔɔtoslɔɔtohi maa ba o yi mi, se ga yaya mohu o maa to. 11O ma de ke o ma ya tua ma ko nɛ e mi bi hii si kpoo ngɛ tue mi jɔmi, kɛ he jɔmi mi. Gbogbo be ma amɛ a he ɔ, agbo se lami dade ko hu be. 12O ma ya tua ma amɛ, nɛ o maa ha a mi ní. O ma ya tua ma doku ɔmɛ nɛ amlɔ nɛ ɔ lɛɛ a mi hyi kɛ nimli ɔ. O ma ya tua ni ɔmɛ nɛ a bua a nya kɛ je je ma amɛ a mi ɔ. Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ na, to, kɛ weto ní babauu, nɛ a ngɛ he jɔmi mi ngɛ he nɛ je ɔ tsuo nya ba kpe ngɛ. 13Sheba bi, Dedan bi, kɛ jua yeli nɛ je Spania ma ba bi ke, ‘O ma nɛ o ba fia wɔ ojo lo? Anɛ o bua o tabo ɔ nya kɛ ba nɛ o ba ha ní pani nya, nɛ o muɔ wa lohwehi, wa sika tsu, wa sika hiɔ, kɛ wa weto ní tsuo kɛ ho lo?’ ”
14Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ tsɔ mi ke ma ya de Gog ke, “Jehanɛ, benɛ ye ma Israel ngɛ tue mi jɔmi mi ɔ, o maa hia blɔ 15kɛ je omleyi je tsitsaa he nɛ o ngɛ ɔ, kɛ o ta buli kpanakpanaa nɛ hi okpɔngɔhi a nɔ kɛ je je mahi babauu a mi kɛ ba. 16O ma ba tua ye ma Israel ɔ kaa ahumi nɛ ngɛ fiae huu kɛ nyɛɛ zugba a nɔ tsuo. Ke be ɔ su ɔ, ma ha o ma ba tua ye zugba a nɔ bi ɔmɛ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ je ma amɛ nɛ a na nɔ nɛ i ji, konɛ kɛ gu nɔ́ nɛ ma pee nɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ, a na kaa nɔ klɔuklɔu ji mi. 17Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ke blema lokoo nɛ i ha ye tsɔli, Israel gbali ɔmɛ gba jehahi babauu ke be ma nɛ ma ha nɔ ko ma ba ye ye ma Israel nɔ ɔ, anɛ mo o he i de ngɛ lo?”
Mawu maa gbla Gog tue
18Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ke, “Ligbi ɔ nɛ Gog ma ba tua Israel ɔ, ye mi mi ma fu wawɛɛ. 19I ngɔ hunga, kɛ hɛdɔ kɛ ngɛ dee ke jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, Israel zugba a ma mimiɛ wawɛɛ. 20Pa mi lohi, hiɔwe lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ, pu mi lohwe nane eywiɛɛywiɛtsɛmɛ kɛ sisali, kɛ nimli adesahi ngɛ zugba a nɔ tsuo maa pee yoyooyo ngɛ ye hɛ mi. Yohi maa hule kɛ pue si, tɛ sa nguanguahi maa nɔ si, nɛ gbogbo tsuaa gbogbo maa hule kɛ pue si. 21Ma ngɔ haomi slɔɔtoslɔɔtohi babauu kɛ wo Gog he gbeye. Imi, Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ lɛ i de. A maa hwu ta gbeyegbeye ko ngɛ yo ɔmɛ a nɔ. Nimli maa hia klaate kɛ wo a sibi. 22Ma ngɔ gbenɔ hiɔ, kɛ muɔ si puemi kɛ gbla Gog tue. Ma ha hiɔmi nɛ nya wa, kɛ gbiɛ ngo ngu maa nɛ wawɛɛ, nɛ la nɛ ngɛ tsoe gegeege maa je hiɔwe ma ba kpata e kɛ e ta a, kɛ je ma amɛ nɛ piɛ e he ɔ tsuo a hɛ mi. 23Ke e ba mi kikɛ nɛ ɔ, je ma amɛ tsuo maa na kaa i kle, nɛ i ngɛ klɔuklɔu. Kɛkɛ ɔ, a maa le jehanɛ kaa imi ji Yawɛ.”

Title: EZEKIEL 39
Content:
A ye Gog nɔ
1Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ de mi ke, “Nɔmlɔ adesa, gbaa kɛ si Gog, ganɔ ngua nɛ yeɔ Meshek kɛ Tubal je ma amɛ a nɔ ɔ, nɛ o de lɛ ke, i kɛ lɛ ná. 2Ma dɔ e yi kɛ gu he kpa; ma ngɔ lɛ kɛ je tsitsaa omleyi je tɔɔ kɛ ba Israel yo ɔmɛ a nɔ. 3Kɛkɛ ɔ, kɛ̃ɛ̃ nɛ ngɛ e muɔ nine mi ɔ, ma fia lɛ nɔ́ nɛ e nɔ zugba, nɛ kɛ̃ɛ̃ mi bihi nɛ ngɛ e hiɔ nine mi ɔ ma pue si. 4Gog maa nɔ ta ngɛ Israel yo ɔmɛ a nɔ; e tabo ɔ, kɛ je ma amɛ nɛ piɛ e he ɔ tsuo a hɛ mi ma kpata. Ma ha a gbogboe ɔmɛ maa pee niye ní ha lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ nɛ yeɔ lo, kɛ nga mi lohwe awi yeli tsuo. 5A ma gbo kɛ pue nga kplanaa a nɔ. Imi, Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ lɛ i de. 6Magog zugba a, kɛ wo nya ma amɛ nɛ a mi bi a tue mi jɔ mɛ ɔ, ma mɛ mɛ tsuo a he la; nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ ma na maa le kaa imi ji Yawɛ. 7Ma ha ye ma Israel maa le ye biɛ klɔuklɔu ɔ; nɛ i be hae nɛ a ble ye biɛ nɛ he tsɔ ɔ hu. Kɛkɛ ɔ, je ma amɛ tsuo maa le kaa imi Yawɛ ji Israel Mawu Klɔuklɔu ɔ nɛ.”
8Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ke, “Ligbi ɔ nɛ i to ɔ ji kikɛmɛ a ligbi nɛ ɔ nɛ. Hyɛ, e maa ba kokooko. 9Israel ma mi bi ɔmɛ maa je kpo, nɛ a ma ya mɛ ta hwumi ní ɔmɛ a he la. A maa sã a tsɛ̃i wawi, kɛ̃ɛ̃ mi bihi, akplɔhi, kɛ tso kpokuhi babauu nɛ he nyɛli ɔmɛ si ɔ. A kɛ maa pee lɛ́ nɛ a ma slɛ jeha kpaago sɔuu. 10E be hiae kaa a ya lɛ lɛ́, loo a ya poo tso kɛ pee lɛ́. Ejakaa ta hwumi ní nɛ a bua nya a, a kɛ maa pee lɛ́ nɛ a ma slɛ. Nihi nɛ ha a níhi, nɛ a fia mɛ ojo ɔ, Israel bi ɔmɛ hu maa ha a níhi, nɛ a maa fia mɛ ojo ja nɔuu.” Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ lɛ de.
A maa pu Gog
11Yawɛ ke, “Ke ní nɛ ɔmɛ na ba mi ɔ, ma ha a maa pu Gog ngɛ Israel zugba a mi, ngɛ ‘Blɔ hiali a kɔ̃’ ɔ mi, ngɛ Ngo wo ɔ beleku je. A maa pu Gog kɛ e ta a tsuo ngɛ kɔ̃ ɔ mi, nɛ a maa wo lejɛ ɔ biɛ ke ‘Gog ta buli a kɔ̃.’ 12Israel bi ɔmɛ maa ngɔ nyɔhiɔ kpaago kɛ pu gbogboe ɔmɛ tsuo, nɛ a kɛ maa tsu zugba a he ekohu. 13Zugba a nɔ bi ɔmɛ tsuo ma bla kɛ pu mɛ. Ligbi ɔ nɛ a maa ye kunimi nɛ ɔ, a maa wo ye hɛ mi nyami. Imi, Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ lɛ i de. 14Nyɔhiɔ kpaago ɔ se ɔ, a maa hla ni komɛ nɛ maa kpa zugba a nɔ kɛ ya kɛ ba, konɛ gbogboehi nɛ piɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ ɔ, a pu mɛ, nɛ a tsu zugba a he. 15Ke a ngɛ zugba a nɔ kpae, nɛ nɔ ko ya na wu ko ɔ, e pee okadi ngɛ wu ɔ he kɛ yaa si a maa ngɔ wu ɔ ya pu ngɛ Gog ta buli a kɔ̃ ɔ mi. 16(Ma ko ngɛ lejɛ ɔ kasa nya nɛ a ngɔ tabo ɔ biɛ kɛ wo lɛ.) Bɔ nɛ a maa pee kɛ tsu zugba a he ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.”
17 Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ de mi ke, “Nɔmlɔ adesa, tsɛ lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ lohwe nane eywiɛɛywiɛtsɛmɛ ɔmɛ kɛ je he tsuaa he nɛ a ngɛ ɔ kɛ ba nɛ a ba ye ní. Ma sã bɔ nguaa ko ngɛ Israel yo ɔmɛ a nɔ ha mɛ, konɛ a ye lo, nɛ a nu muɔ. 18A maa ye katsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a lo, nɛ a maa nu zugba a nɔ ganɔ ɔmɛ a muɔ. Ni nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ngɛ kaa Bashan agbosuhi, loo jijɔhi, loo akpakpohi, loo na kuhi nɛ wo zɔ. 19Ke i gbe ni ɔmɛ kaa a gbeɔ lohwe kɛ sãã bɔ ɔ, a maa ye zɔ ɔ hluu kɛ yaa si e maa gbe a nya, nɛ a maa nu muɔ ɔ hluu kɛ yaa si a maa pee gbedee kaa nihi nɛ tɔ dã. 20Ma ngɔ okpɔngɔhi, ta zugba lɛhi, katsɛmɛ, kɛ ta buli slɔɔtoslɔɔto babauu kɛ ngmɛ mɛ okplɔɔ; a maa ye ní nɛ a maa tɔ saminya. Imi, Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ lɛ i de.”
Israel maa bɔ ekohu
21Yawɛ ke, “Ma ha je ma amɛ maa na ye hɛ mi nyami ɔ; ma tsɔɔ mɛ bɔ nɛ i gblaa ni nɛmɛ nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ dɛ ɔ a tue wawɛɛ ha. 22Nɛ kɛ je jamɛ a ligbi ɔ kɛ yaa a, Israel bi ɔmɛ maa le kaa imi ji Yawɛ, a Mawu ɔ nɛ. 23Je ma amɛ hu maa le kaa imi lɛ i ha Israel bi ɔmɛ ya hi ma se kaa nyɔguɛhi, ejakaa a pee yayami kɛ si mi. I kua mɛ, i ha a he nyɛli ba ye a nɔ ngɛ ta mi, nɛ a gbe mɛ. 24I kɛ mɛ to ní ngɛ mu ní tsumihi nɛ a tsu, kɛ yi wu tso níhi nɛ a pee ɔ a he; nɛ i kua mɛ.”
25Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ke, “Jehanɛ lɛɛ, ma na Yakob nina a mɔbɔ; ma na Israel ma a tsuo mɔbɔ, nɛ ma ha a maa bɔ ekohu. Ma pee enɛ ɔ, konɛ a na kaa nɔ klɔuklɔu ji mi. 26Ke a kpale kɛ ba mɛ nitsɛmɛ a zugba a nɔ ngɛ tue mi jɔmi, kɛ he jɔmi mi, nɛ nɔ ko wui a he gbeye ɔ, a hɛ maa je nɔ kaa a pue a hɛ mi si, nɛ a tsɔ ye hɛ mi atuã. 27Bɔ nɛ pee nɛ je ma amɛ tsuo nɛ a le kaa i ngɛ klɔuklɔu ɔ, ma kpale ye ma a kɛ je a he nyɛli a zugba amɛ tsuo a nɔ kɛ ba. 28Kɛkɛ ɔ, ye ma a maa le kaa imi ji Yawɛ, a Mawu ɔ nɛ. A maa le enɛ ɔ; ejakaa imi nitsɛ lɛ i ha a ngɔ mɛ kɛ ho ma se ya kaa nyɔguɛhi ɔ nɛ. Se jehanɛ lɛɛ i bua a nya, nɛ i kpale mɛ kɛ ba mɛ nitsɛmɛ a zugba nɔ, nɛ e píɛ a ti nɔ ko nɔ ko ngɛ ma se. 29Ma ngɔ ye mumi kɛ pue Israel ma a nɔ, nɛ i be mɛ kuae hu. Imi, Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ lɛ i de.”

Title: EZEKIEL 40
Content:
YAWƐ WE HE Ɔ HE NINA
(40.1—48.35)
A ngɔ Ezekiel kɛ ba Yerusalem
1Benɛ a nuu wɔ kɛ ho ma se ya a we jeha nyingmi enyɔ kɛ enuɔne ɔ ji jeha nyɔngma kɛ eywiɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ nɛ a kpata Yerusalem ma a hɛ mi. Jeha he ɔ we ligbi nyɔngma a, Yawɛ he wami ba ye nɔ wawɛɛ, nɛ e ngɔ mi kɛ je. 2 I na ngɛ nina a mi nɛ Mawu mumi ɔ ngɔ mi kɛ ba Israel zugba a nɔ; nɛ e ngɔ mi ya fɔ yo gagaa ko yi mi. I na nɔ́ ko kaa ma ngɛ yo ɔ nɔ ngɛ ye hɛ mi. 3 Mumi ɔ ngɔ mi kɛ ya su ma a he haa; nɛ i na nyumu ko nɛ e he ngɛ kpɛe kaa akɔblee. E hɛɛ nɔ́ susumi kpa, kɛ nɔ́ susumi tso ngɛ e dɛ mi kɛ daa si ngɛ agbo ko nya.
4E de mi ke, “Nɔmlɔ adesa, bli o hɛngmɛ nɛ o hyɛ nɔ́ saminya; ta tue nɛ o nu nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ pɛpɛɛpɛ, nɛ o ngɔ o juɛmi kɛ fɔ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ ma tsɔɔ mo ɔ nɔ; ejakaa a ngɔ mo kɛ ba hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ ma ngɔ ní nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ tsɔɔ mo. Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ o maa na a, yaa nɛ o ya de Israel ma a.”
Agbo nɛ ngɛ beleku je ɔ
5 I na Yawɛ we ɔ nɛ a fia gbogbo kɛ bɔle lɛ. Nyumu ɔ ngɔ nɔ́ susumi tso ɔ kɛ susu gbogbo ɔ. Susumi tso ɔ kami maa pee gugue kake kɛ fa. Gbogbo ɔ hiɔwe yami ji susumi tso ɔ kake, nɛ e timi hu ja nɔuu. 6Jehanɛ e ya agbo nɛ nya blɔ ngɛ beleku je ɔ he. E kuɔ kpoku ɔmɛ kɛ ya su a nyagbe, nɛ e susu agbo ɔ; kɛ je e yi mi kɛ ba sisi ɔ peeɔ susumi tso ɔ kake. 7Blɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, nɛ tsu etɛ ngɛ hiɔ nɔ, nɛ etɛ hu ngɛ muɔ nɔ. Tsu nɛ ɔmɛ a kami kɛ a blimi tsuo sɔ; eko tsuaa eko ngɛ gugue kake kɛ fa; nɛ gbogbo nɛ e timi ji gugue kake kɛ nine mi blimi enyɔ tsa tsu kɛ tsu. Tsu wawi nɛ ɔmɛ a se ɔ, blɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ; blɔ ɔ kami ji gugue kake kɛ fa. Blɔ nɛ ɔ ya sɛ asa agbo ko mi. 8-9Nyumu ɔ susu tsu nɛ ɔ hulɔ; e ná gugue enyɔ. Agbo nɛ a guu mi kɛ yaa Yawɛ we ɔ mi ɔ ngɛ hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ; nɛ agbo ɔ timi ngɛ nyagbe ɔ ji gugue fa. 10(Tsu wayowayo etɛ ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ muɔ nɔ, kɛ etɛ ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ hiɔ nɔ ɔ, mɛ tsuo a kami sɔ, nɛ gbogbo nɛ po a kpɛti ɔ hu e timi ngɛ ja nɔuu.)
11Jehanɛ, nyumu ɔ susu agbo ɔ blimi; e ná gugue etɛ kɛ nine mi blimi enyɔ; nɛ ke a bli agbo ɔ, e peeɔ gugue enyɔ kɛ fa. 12Kpoku ngɛ tsu wayo tsuaa tsu wayo nya. Kpoku ɔ hiɔwe yami ji nine mi blimi enyɔ, nɛ e nɔ blimi hu nine mi blimi enyɔ. Tsu wawi ɔmɛ a kami kɛ a blimi sɔ; eko tsuaa eko peeɔ gugue kake kɛ fa ngɛ hiɛ, kɛ gugue kake kɛ fa ngɛ hiɛ. 13Jehanɛ, e susu tsu ɔ kami kɛ gu gbogbo ɔ se; blɔ nɛ ngɛ tsu kake kɛ kake a kpɛti kami ji gugue ekpa kɛ nine mi blimi enyɔ kɛ je tsu kake sinya nya kɛ ya na tsu nɛ tsa nɔ ɔ sinya. 14A guu tsu nɛ ngɛ nyagbe ɔ mi kɛ ya jee kpo ngɛ kue kpa mi. E susu jamɛ a tsu ɔ hulɔ; e blimi ji gugue enuɔ. 15Kɛ je gbogbo ɔ he ngɛ agbo ɔ nya kɛ ya su nyagbe tsu ɔ se tsuo peeɔ gugue nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ kɛ fa. 16Saflɛ puɔ tsɔwitsɔwi ngɛ kpo nɔ je gbogbo ɔmɛ tsuo a mi; ekomɛ hu ngɛ gbogbo ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ po tsu ɔmɛ a mi ɔ a mi; nɛ tãhi nɛ a tɛni ngɛ sinya tso ɔmɛ a si mami ní ɔmɛ tsuo a he.
Kue nɛ ngɛ kpo nɔ je ɔ
17Nyumu ɔ kɛ mi ya su kue ɔ nɛ ngɛ kpo nɔ je ɔ mi. Tsu nyingmi etɛ tsa a sibi a nɔ ngɛ gbogbo ɔ he. A ka tɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ zugba a tsuo 18kɛ bɔle kue ɔ mi kɛ kpe. Kpɛti kue ɔ ya hiɔwe pe kpo nɔ je nɔ́ ɔ. 19A guu agbo nɛ ya hiɔwe ko mi ngɛ lejɛ ɔ kɛ yaa kpɛti kue ɔ mi. Nyumu ɔ susu blɔ nɛ ngɛ agbo enyɔ nɛ ɔmɛ a kpɛti, kɛ je yiti je nɔ́ ɔ he kɛ ya su sisi je nɔ́ ɔ he; nɛ e ná gugue nyingmi enyɔ kɛ enuɔ.
Agbo nɛ ngɛ omleyi je ɔ
20Jehanɛ e nyɛɛ ye hɛ mi kɛ ya omleyi je kɛ ya su kue ɔ nɛ ngɛ kpo nɔ je ɔ we agbo ɔ he. E susu e kami kɛ e blimi. 21Tsu wayowayo etɛ nɛ ngɛ muɔ nɔ kɛ etɛ nɛ ngɛ hiɔ nɔ ɔ, a klemi sɔ kaa bɔ nɛ kekle agbo ɔ ngɛ ɔ. E kami ji gugue nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ kɛ fa, nɛ e blimi ji gugue ekpa kɛ nine mi blimi enyɔ. 22Tsu agbo ɔ saflɛ ɔmɛ, e kue ɔ, kɛ tã amɛ ɔ, ke a susu mɛ ɔ, a ngɛ kaa agbo ɔ nɛ hɛ mi kpee beleku je ɔ ní ɔmɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ. A kuɔɔ kpoku kpaago kɛ yaa he; nɛ e kue ɔ ngɛ mi mi je. 23Kue ɔ nɛ ngɛ mi mi je ɔ we agbo ɔ, kɛ omleyi je nɔ́ ɔ ngɛ hanɔ kaa bɔ nɛ e kɛ leneyi je nɔ ɔ ngɛ ɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ. Nyumu ɔ susu kue enyɔ nɛ ɔmɛ a kpɛti kami, nɛ e ná gugue nyingmi enyɔ kɛ enuɔ.
Agbo nɛ ngɛ leneyi je ɔ
24Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, nyumu ɔ kɛ mi ya leneyi je; agbo ko nya ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. E susu e sinya tso ɔmɛ, kɛ e kue ɔ. E na kaa a kɛ ekpa amɛ sɔ. 25Saflɛhi ngɛ agbo ɔ, kɛ kue ɔ mi tsuo kɛ bɔle si kɛ kpe kaa ekpa amɛ nɔuu. Agbo ɔ mi blɔ ɔ kami ji gugue nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ kɛ fa, nɛ e blimi ji gugue ekpa kɛ nine mi blimi enyɔ. 26A kuɔɔ kpoku kpaago kɛ ya sɛɛ tsu agbo ko mi ngɛ nyagbe ɔ; enɛ ɔ hu nya blɔ kpee kue ɔ mi je. A tɛni tãhi ngɛ agbo ɔ mi sinya tso ɔmɛ a he; kake ngɛ hiɛ, nɛ kake hu ngɛ hiɛ. 27Agbo ko ngɛ kue ɔ mi ngɛ leneyi je. E susu kɛ je agbo kake he kɛ ya su agbo kpa nɛ ngɛ leneyi je ɔ he, nɛ e ná gugue nyingmi enyɔ kɛ enuɔ.
Kue nɛ ngɛ mi mi je ɔ: agbo nɛ ngɛ leneyi je ɔ
28Nyumu ɔ kɛ mi ya gu agbo nɛ ngɛ leneyi je ɔ mi kɛ ya su kue nɛ ngɛ mi mi je ɔ mi. E susu agbo ɔ; enɛ ɔ hu kɛ agbo ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ kpo nɔ je ɔ sɔ. 29-30Tsu wawi ɔmɛ, tsu agbo ɔ, kɛ gbogbo nɛ po a mi ɔ tsuo ngɛ kaa agbo kpa amɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ. Saflɛhi ngɛ agbo nya tsu ɔmɛ a he. E susu enɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a kami; e pee gugue ekpa kɛ nine mi blimi enyɔ, nɛ a blimi pee gugue kake kɛ nine mi blimi enyɔ. 31Tsu agbo ko nɛ hɛ mi kpee kue kaketsɛ ɔ ngɛ hiɛ ɔ. A tɛni tãhi ngɛ gbogbo ɔmɛ a he ngɛ hiɔ nɔ kɛ muɔ nɔ tsuo. A kuɔɔ kpoku kpaanyɔ kɛ yaa agbo nɛ ɔ he.
Mi mi je kue ɔ: agbo nɛ ngɛ beleku je ɔ
32Nyumu ɔ kɛ mi ya gu agbo nɛ ngɛ beleku je ɔ mi kɛ ya sɛ kue nɛ ngɛ we ɔ mi ɔ mi. E susu agbo ɔ, nɛ e ngɛ kaa ekpa amɛ nɔuu. 33Tsu wawi ɔmɛ, tsu agbo ɔ, kɛ gbogbo ɔmɛ tsuo ngɛ kaa kekle ní ɔmɛ nɔuu. Saflɛhi ngɛ kue ɔmɛ a he kɛ kpe, nɛ saflɛhi ngɛ tsu agbo ɔ hu he. Enɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a kami ji gugue nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ kɛ fa, nɛ a blimi ji gugue ekpa kɛ nine mi blimi enyɔ. 34A tɛni tãhi ngɛ gbogbo ɔmɛ a he ngɛ hiɔ nɔ kɛ muɔ nɔ tsuo. A kuɔɔ kpoku kpaanyɔ kɛ yaa agbo nɛ ɔ he.
Kue nɛ ngɛ mi mi je ɔ: agbo nɛ ngɛ omleyi je ɔ
35Jehanɛ nyumu ɔ kɛ mi ya agbo nɛ ngɛ omleyi je ɔ he. E susu enɛ ɔ hulɔ, nɛ e na kaa e kɛ ekpa amɛ sɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ. 36E ngɛ kaa ekpa amɛ; e ngɛ tsu wawi, kɛ tsu agbo nɛ a tɛni tãhi ngɛ gbogbo ɔmɛ a he; jehanɛ hu saflɛhi ngɛ tsu ɔmɛ a he kɛ kpe. Enɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a kami ji gugue nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ kɛ fa, nɛ a blimi ji gugue ekpa kɛ nine mi blimi enyɔ. 37Tsu agbo nɛ ɔ hɛ mi tsɔɔ agbo ɔ nya blɔ. A tɛni tãhi ngɛ gbogbo ɔmɛ a he ngɛ hiɔ nɔ kɛ muɔ nɔ tsuo. A kuɔɔ kpoku kpaanyɔ kɛ yaa agbo nɛ ɔ he.
Agbo nɛ ngɛ omleyi je ɔ kasa nya tsuhi
38Tsu bi ko ngɛ agbo ɔ nya nɛ a kɛ sɛɛ kue ɔ mi ngɛ omleyi je. A guu hiɛ ɔ kɛ ya sɛɛ kue nguaa a nɛ hɛ mi kpee kpo nɔ je ɔ mi. Lohwehi nɛ a gbee nɛ a kɛ lohwe ɔ tsuo sãã sami bɔ ɔ, hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ a fɔɔ a lo ɔ he ngɛ. 39Okplɔɔ eywiɛ ngɛ tsu agbo nɛ ɔ mi; enyɔ ngɛ kasa hiɛ, nɛ enyɔ hu ngɛ kasa hiɛ. Okplɔɔ nɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ a gbee lohwehi nɛ a kɛ maa sã bɔ ɔmɛ ngɛ: sami bɔhi jio, yayami pami bɔhi jio, fɔ yemi bɔhi jio. 40Tsu ɔ se hu okplɔɔ eywiɛ nɛ ngɛ kaa enɛ ɔmɛ maa si. Enyɔ ngɛ hiɔ nɔ, nɛ enyɔ hu ngɛ muɔ nɔ ngɛ omleyi je agbo ɔ nya. 41Okplɔɔ kpaanyɔ nɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ a gbeɔ lohwe ɔmɛ ngɛ; eywiɛ ngɛ tsu ɔ mi, nɛ eywiɛ hu ngɛ kpo ɔ nɔ. 42Okplɔɔ kpa eywiɛ ngɛ nɛ a sãã sami bɔ ngɛ a nɔ. Tɛ nɛ a kó a kɛ pee mɛ. Eko tsuaa eko kami ji nine mi blimi etɛ, e blimi hu nine mi blimi etɛ, kɛ e hiɔwe yami nine mi blimi enyɔ. Dadehi tsuo nɛ a kɛ gbee lohwe ɔmɛ nɛ a kɛ sãã bɔ ɔmɛ ɔ, okplɔɔ nɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ a kɛ pueɔ. 43A ka gbowehi kɛ wo okplɔɔ ɔmɛ a tue kɛ kpe, eko tsuaa eko kami ji dɛ mi blimi kake. Lo ɔ tsuo nɛ a kɛ maa sã bɔ ɔmɛ ɔ, okplɔɔ nɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ a kɛ pueɔ.
44Jehanɛ nyumu ɔ kɛ mi ba mi mi je kue ɔ mi. Tsu enyɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ nɛ a bliɔ a sinya amɛ kɛ baa we ɔ mi je; kake ngɛ omleyi je agbo ɔ nya, nɛ e hɛ mi kpee leneyi je; nɛ kake hu ngɛ leneyi je agbo ɔ nya, nɛ e hɛ mi kpee omleyi je. 45Nyumu ɔ de mi ke tsu nɛ hɛ mi kpee leneyi je ɔ, osɔfo ɔmɛ nɛ sɔmɔɔ ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ a nɔ́ ji lɔ ɔ nɛ. 46Kake ɔ hu nɛ hɛ mi kpee omleyi je ɔ, osɔfo ɔmɛ nɛ sɔmɔɔ ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he ɔ, mɛ hu a nɔ́ ji lɔ ɔ nɛ. Zadok nina ji osɔfo nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo; nɛ mɛ pɛ ji Levi bi nɛ ngɛ he blɔ kaa a ba sɔmɔɔ ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi.
Yawɛ we ɔ kɛ kue nɛ ngɛ mi mi je ɔ
47Nyumu ɔ susu kue nɛ ngɛ mi mi je ɔ. Kɔ nya eywiɛ ɔmɛ tsuo sɔ fiee; eko tsuaa eko kami ji gugue nyingmi enyɔ kɛ enuɔ; nɛ bɔ sami la tɛ maa si ngɛ we ɔ hɛ mi. 48Jehanɛ e kɛ mi ba Yawɛ we ɔ kue ɔ nya. E susu kue ɔ nya titima a; e blimi ji gugue kake kɛ nine mi blimi enyɔ, nɛ e kami ji gugue etɛ kɛ fa. Gbogbo nɛ ngɛ hiɔ nɔ, kɛ nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ muɔ nɔ ɔ, a timi sɔ, gugue fa kɛ nine mi blimi enyɔ. 49Kue ɔ kami ji gugue enuɔ, nɛ e blimi ji gugue etɛ. A kuɔɔ kpoku nyɔngma kɛ yaa sinya a nya. Titima hi maa si ngɛ lejɛ ɔ; kake ngɛ hiɔ nɔ, nɛ kake hu ngɛ muɔ nɔ.

Title: EZEKIEL 41
Content:
He klɔuklɔu pe kulaa a
1Pee se ɔ, nyumu ɔ kɛ mi ba Yawɛ we ɔ mi nitsɛ. E susu sinya a nya titima a; kɛ je hiɛ kɛ yaa a, peeɔ gugue kake kɛ fa, nɛ kɛ je hiɛ kɛ yaa hu peeɔ gugue kake kɛ fa; ja nɔuu bo tsu mi blimi peeɔ. 2Sinya a nya peeɔ gugue enyɔ kɛ fa, nɛ sinya a blimi peeɔ gugue kake kɛ nine mi blimi kake ngɛ hiɔ nɔ; nɛ muɔ nɔ hu ja nɔuu. E susu tsu ɔ nitsɛ hulɔ; e kami ji gugue nyɔngma, nɛ e blimi ji gugue enuɔ.
3Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e sɛ tsu ɔ mi, nɛ e ya susu ní nɛ ɔmɛ: titima a ngɛ gugue fa; sinya a peeɔ gugue kake kɛ fa; nɛ sinya a blimi peeɔ gugue kake kɛ fa kɛ nine mi blimi enyɔ. 4Jehanɛ e susu tsu ɔ mi nitsɛ. E ná gugue enuɔ ngɛ tsu ɔ kasa kake, nɛ e ná ja nɔuu ngɛ kasa kpa amɛ tsuo. Tsu nɛ ɔ ngɛ kpɛtikpɛti tsu ɔ se. Kɛkɛ nɛ e de mi ke, “Hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ ji he klɔuklɔu pe kulaa.”
Yawɛ we ɔ gbogbo ɔmɛ a he tsuhi
5Jehanɛ nyumu ɔ susu Yawɛ we ɔ gbogbo ɔ timi; e na gugue kake kɛ fa. Tsu wawi nɛ eko tsuaa eko blimi ji gugue kake bɔle we ɔ kɛ kpe. 6A ma tsu wawi nɛ ɔmɛ siaudo etɛɛtɛ; tsu ɔ eko ma eko yi mi, nɛ tsu nyingmi etɛ ngɛ siaudo tsuaa siaudo mi kɛ bɔle we ɔ kɛ kpe. A ma tsu ɔmɛ slɛnɛɛ kɛ wo gbogbo ɔ he kɛ kpla si, se a ma we we ɔ gbogbo ɔ nitsɛ nɔ. 7Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke a ngɛ we ɔ gbogbo ɔ hyɛe ngɛ kpo nɔ je ɔ, e ngɛ kaa nɔ́ nɛ gbogbo ɔ timi sɔ kɛ je zugba kɛ ya su e yi mi, se tsu ɔmɛ a mi bli kaa bɔ nɛ níhi nɛ hɛɛ siaudo enyɔne kɛ etɛne ɔmɛ ngɛ ɔ; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, hiɔwe tsu ɔmɛ a mi bli pe sisi ní ɔmɛ. A kuɔɔ Yawɛ we ɔ gbogbo nɛ ngɛ kpo nɔ je ɔ he atlakpe kɛ guu tsu ɔmɛ a se kɛ yaa kekleekle siaudo ɔ, kɛ enyɔne ɔ a nɔ. 8-11Tsu wawi nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ kpo nɔ je ɔ, eko tsuaa eko gbogbo timi ji gugue kake kɛ nine mi blimi enyɔ. A guu sinya ko nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ mi kɛ yaa tsu ɔmɛ a mi ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ we omleyi je, nɛ a guu kake hu mi kɛ yaa ní nɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ leneyi je ɔ a mi. I na kpoku ko nɛ e hiɔwe yami ji gugue kake kɛ nine mi blimi enyɔ kɛ bɔle Yawɛ we ɔ he tsuo kɛ kpe. E hiɔwe yami ji gugue kake kɛ fa; e yi mi ya ta tsu ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ we ɔ gbogbo ɔmɛ a he ɔ a sisi tomi ɔ nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ. He ko gbajaa ngɛ kpoku ɔmɛ, kɛ tsuhi nɛ osɔfo ɔmɛ hii mi ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ kasa nya a a kpɛti; e kami ji gugue enuɔ.
Tsu nɛ ngɛ bonyoku je ɔ
12Tsu ko ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ se ngɛ bonyoku je. Tsu nɛ ɔ kami ji gugue nyingmi enyɔ kɛ enyɔ kɛ fa; e blimi ji gugue nyɔngma kɛ kpaago kɛ fa, nɛ gbogbo nɛ bɔle lɛ kɛ kpe ɔ timi ji gugue kake kɛ nine mi blimi enyɔ.
Yawɛ we ɔ klemi
13Jehanɛ nyumu ɔ susu Yawɛ we ɔ nitsɛ; e kami ji gugue nyingmi enyɔ kɛ enuɔ; tsu ɔ se, kɛ tsu ɔ, kɛ gbogbo ɔmɛ a kami tsuo peeɔ gugue nyingmi enyɔ kɛ enuɔ; 14e blimi ngɛ beleku je kɛ kpo ɔ nɔ tsuo ji gugue nyingmi enyɔ kɛ enuɔ. 15E susu tsu ɔ kami ngɛ bonyoku je, e susu e he ablanaa amɛ hiɛ kɛ hiɛ, nɛ e na gugue nyingmi enyɔ kɛ enuɔ.
Yawɛ we ɔ he ní komɛ
Yawɛ we ɔ kpɛti tsu ɔ, he klɔuklɔu ɔ, kɛ he klɔuklɔu pe kulaa a, 16a ka tso kɛ wo lɛ tsuo he kɛ je zugba kɛ ya ta saflɛ ɔmɛ a nya. Saflɛ ɔmɛ hu a ha a he. 17A tɛni ní kɛ wo we ɔ mi gbogbo ɔmɛ a he kɛ ya si sinya a yi mi ngɛ tsu ɔ mi. 18Tãhi, kɛ kerubhi sɔuu a tɛni, nɛ tã ngɛ kerub kɛ kerub a kpɛti kɛ bɔle tsu ɔ mi tsuo. Kerub tsuaa kerub ngɛ hɛ mi enyɔ. 19Nɔmlɔ hɛ mi nɛ plɛ ngɔ kpee tã ji hɛ mi kake, kɛ jata hɛ mi nɛ plɛ ngɔ kpee tã ngɛ enyɔne ɔ. Kikɛ nɛ ɔ a tɛni ní ɔmɛ kɛ wo we ɔ gbogbo ɔ he tsuo kɛ kpe. 20A tɛni kerubhi, kɛ tãhi ngɛ gbogbo ɔ he kɛ je zugba kɛ ya ta sinya a yi mi. 21A pee Yawɛ we ɔ he klɔuklɔu ɔ sinya tso ɔmɛ kɔ nya eywiɛɛywiɛ.
Bɔ sami la tɛ nɛ a kɛ tso pee ɔ
Ngɛ he klɔuklɔu pe kulaa hɛ mi ɔ, nɔ́ ko maa si ngɛ lejɛ ɔ nɛ ngɛ kaa 22bɔ sami la tɛ nɛ a kɛ tso pee. E hiɔwe yami ji gugue fa kɛ nine mi blimi enyɔ, nɛ e kami ji gugue fa, kɛ e blimi hu gugue fa. E kɔ nya amɛ, e nane ɔmɛ, kɛ e kasa nya amɛ tsuo tso a kɛ pee. Nyumu ɔ de mi ke, “Okplɔɔ nɛ maa Yawɛ hɛ mi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.”
Sinya amɛ
23A guu sinya kake mi kɛ sɛɛ he klɔuklɔu ɔ, nɛ ngɛ tsu ɔ nyagbe ɔ, a guu sinya kpa mi kɛ sɛɛ he klɔuklɔu pe kulaa a. 24A pee sinya nɛ ɔmɛ blablɛ enyɔɔnyɔ; sinya amɛ eko tsuaa eko bliɔ ngɛ kpɛti. 25A tɛni kerubhi, kɛ tãhi ngɛ sinya amɛ a he ngɛ he klɔuklɔu ɔ kaa bɔ nɛ a pee ngɛ gbogbo ɔmɛ a he ɔ. A kɛ tso pee gba ngɛ kue ɔ hɛ mi ngɛ kpo nɔ je. 26Saflɛhi nɛ a pee puɔhi ngɛ a mi, nɛ a tɛni tãhi ngɛ a he ngɛ kue ɔ gbogbo ɔmɛ a he hiɛ kɛ hiɛ.

Title: EZEKIEL 42
Content:
Tsu enyɔ komɛ ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ kasa nya
1Jehanɛ nyumu ɔ kɛ mi je kpo kɛ ba agbo nya kue ɔ he ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ we omleyi je. Lejɛ ɔ kɛ tsu ɔ nɛ ngɛ we ɔ bonyoku je ɔ he kɛ we. 2Kue nɛ ngɛ omleyi je nɛ ɔ kami ji gugue nyingmi enyɔ kɛ enuɔ, nɛ e blimi ji gugue nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ kɛ fa. 3Blɔ nɛ ngɛ tsu nɛ ɔ, kɛ kpo ɔ nɔ je nɔ́ ɔ a kpɛti ji gugue enuɔ, nɛ tsu ɔmɛ ngɛ a sibi a hanɔ. A ka tɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ zugba a. Agbo nya tsu nɛ ɔ, a ma lɛ siaudo etɛ, nɛ ablanaa ngɛ eko tsuaa eko hɛ mi. 4Blɔ nɛ ngɛ omleyi je ɔ blimi ji gugue enyɔ kɛ fa, nɛ e kami ji gugue nyingmi enyɔ kɛ enuɔ kɛ ya na sinya nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. 5Yiti tsu ɔmɛ a mi bli we kulaa; ejakaa ablanaa amɛ hé a blɔ he ɔmɛ pe sisi ní ɔmɛ, kɛ kpɛti ní ɔmɛ. 6Tsuhi nɛ ngɛ hiɛ ɔ, a ma mɛ siaudo etɛ, se a be titimahi kaa bɔ nɛ kpo nɔ je tsu ɔmɛ a titima amɛ ngɛ ɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, tsuhi nɛ ngɛ kpɛti siaudo ɔ nɔ ɔ ya pee wayowayo pe sisi tsu ɔmɛ, nɛ tsuhi nɛ ngɛ siaudo enyɔne ɔ nɔ ɔ hu ya pee wayowayo pe kpɛti ní ɔmɛ. 7-8Tsu ɔ kami mi fa nɛ ji gugue nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ kɛ fa ngɛ zugba mi ɔ, gbogbo sɔuu kɛ ya pue; gugue nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ kɛ fa nɛ piɛ ɔ lɛɛ tsuhi ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Tsuhi ngɛ yi mi siaudo ɔ tsuo nɔ kɛ ya su nyagbe ɔ. 9-10Tsu nɛ ɔmɛ a sisi kɛ yaa beleku je, he nɛ a fia gbogbo ɔ kɛ je ɔ, blɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ kɛ yaa kpo nɔ je kue ɔ mi.
Tsu kpa ko nɛ je nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ beleku je ɔ ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ leneyi je, nɛ e kɛ enɛ ɔ he kɛ we kulaa. 11Blɔ ngɛ tsu nɛ ɔmɛ a hɛ mi kaa nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ omleyi je ɔ. E kami kɛ e blimi kɛ hehi nɛ a guu kɛ sɛɛ mi ɔ ngɛ kaa kaketsɛ ɔ nɔuu. 12Sinya ko ngɛ tsu ɔmɛ a sisi kɛ yaa beleku je, he nɛ a fia gbogbo ɔ kɛ je ɔ.
13Kɛkɛ nɛ nyumu ɔ de mi ke, “Tsu enyɔ nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ klɔuklɔu. Osɔfohi nɛ baa Yawɛ we ɔ, tsu nɛ ɔmɛ a mi a yeɔ bɔ klɔuklɔu pe kulaa a ngɛ. Tsu nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ klɔuklɔu, nɛ a mi nɛ osɔfo ɔmɛ toɔ bɔ klɔuklɔu pe kulaa nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ: niye ní bɔ, yayami pami bɔ, kɛ fɔ yemi bɔ. 14Ke osɔfo ɔmɛ sɛ he klɔuklɔu ɔ, a be kpo jee kɛ ya kpo nɔ je kue ɔ mi; mohu a ma je a tade ɔmɛ nɛ a kɛ sɔmɔ ɔ kɛ pue si, ejakaa tade ɔmɛ ngɛ klɔuklɔu. A maa wo tade kpahi loko a maa je kpo kɛ ya he nɛ ma a ngɛ ɔ.”
A susu Yawɛ we ɔ
15Benɛ nyumu ɔ susu Yawɛ we ɔ mi ta a, e kɛ mi je kpo kɛ gu agbo nɛ ngɛ beleku je ɔ mi kɛ ba kpo ɔ nɔ; nɛ e ba susu lejɛ ɔ hulɔ. 16E ngɔ e tso ɔ kɛ susu kpo ɔ nɔ tsuo kɛ kpe. E ná gugue lafa kɛ nyingmi enyɔ kɛ enuɔ ngɛ beleku je ɔ. 17-20Jehanɛ e susu omleyi je, leneyi je, kɛ bonyoku je tsuo; lɛ tsuo sɔ fiee, gugue lafa kɛ nyingmi enyɔ kɛ enuɔ. Gbogbo po he klɔuklɔu ɔ, kɛ he nɛ ji nihi tsuo a nɔ́ ɔ a kpɛti.

Title: EZEKIEL 43
Content:
Yawɛ kpale kɛ ba e we ɔ mi
1Nyumu ɔ kɛ mi ba agbo ɔ nɛ ngɛ beleku je ɔ nya. 2 Kɛkɛ nɛ i na Israel Mawu ɔ hɛ mi nyami ɔ nɛ ngɛ kpɛe plamplam kɛ je beleku je kɛ ma. Mawu gbi ngɛ pɛe hoo kɛ ma kaa wo nɛ gli; nɛ lejɛ ɔ tsuo pee hleii kɛ e hɛ mi nyami ɔ. 3Nina nɛ ɔ ngɛ kaa nina nɛ i na benɛ Mawu ba kpata Yerusalem hɛ mi, kɛ nina nɛ i na ngɛ Kebar pa a nya a. Kɛkɛ nɛ i ngɔ ye hɛ mi kɛ bu zugba. 4Yawɛ hɛ mi nyami ɔ gu agbo nɛ ngɛ beleku je ɔ mi kɛ ya sɛ Yawɛ we ɔ.
5Yawɛ mumi ɔ wo ye nɔ, nɛ e kɛ mi ya ma mi mi je kue ɔ mi. E hɛ mi nyami ɔ hyi we ɔ tɔ. 6Benɛ nyumu ɔ daa si ngɛ ye kasa nya ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, i nu nɛ Yawɛ kɛ mi tu munyu kɛ je we ɔ mi ke, 7“Nɔmlɔ adesa, ye matsɛ sɛ maa si ngɛ hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ; ma hi Israel bi ɔmɛ a kpɛti ngɛ hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ kɛ maa ya neneene. Kɛkɛ ɔ, Israel ma a jio, a matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ jio, a be ye hɛ mi si puee hu; a be mawu kpahi jae, nɛ a be a matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a gbogboe ɔmɛ pue ngɛ hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ hu. 8Matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ pee a kpoku ɔmɛ, nɛ a ma a sinya tso ɔmɛ ngɛ ye kpoku ɔmɛ, kɛ ye sinya tso ɔmɛ a kasa nya haa, nɛ gbogbo kɛkɛ lɛ po wa kpɛti. Se a ngɔ a ní hiemi níhi nɛ a pee ɔ kɛ ble ye biɛ klɔuklɔu ɔ; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i kɛ abofu kpata a hɛ mi. 9Jehanɛ lɛɛ a ma kpa mawu kpahi jami, nɛ a ma je a matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a gbogboe ɔmɛ kɛ je ye kasa nya kɛ ya se lokoo. Ke a pee ja a, ma hi a kpɛti kɛ maa ya neneene.”
10Yawɛ ya nɔ, nɛ e de mi ke, “Nɔmlɔ adesa, bɔ nɛ imi Yawɛ ye we ɔ ngɛ ha a, kale fitsofitso kɛ tsɔɔ Israel bi ɔmɛ. Ha nɛ zo nɛ gbe mɛ ngɛ yayamihi nɛ a pee ɔ a he. 11Ke a hɛ mi pue si kikɛ nɛ ɔ ngɛ a yayami ɔmɛ a he ɔ, lɛɛ ngɔɔ we ɔ he nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ kɛ tsɔɔ mɛ: e kami, e blimi, e hiɔwe yami, e blɔ nya tomi, hehi nɛ a guu kɛ sɛɛ we ɔ mi, kɛ hehi nɛ a guu kɛ jee kpo. Tsɔɔ mɛ mlaahi nɛ kɔɔ we ɔ he tsuo. Kadi ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ngɛ womi nɔ ha mɛ, konɛ a na bɔ nɛ a to ní ɔmɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ ha, bɔ nɛ blɔ nya tomi ɔmɛ, kɛ ye mlaa amɛ tsuo ngɛ, nɛ a ye a nɔ fitsofitso. 12Mlaa nɛ kɔɔ imi Yawɛ ye we ɔ he ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: yo ɔ yi mi tsuo kɛ bɔle si kɛ kpe ɔ maa pee he klɔuklɔu pe kulaa.”
Bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ
13 Nɔ́ susumi tso nɛ kami peeɔ nine mi blimi enyɔ kɛ nine kpɔmi kake nɛ nyumu ɔ kɛ susu Yawɛ we ɔ, lɔ ɔ nɔuu e kɛ susu bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ sisi ɔ. Bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ kami pee nine mi blimi enyɔ, nɛ e blimi hu nine mi blimi enyɔ; nɛ nine mi blimi kake bɔle e tue ɔ kɛ kpe. 14Kɛ je bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ mi dlami nɛ ngɛ sisi ɔ yi mi kɛ ba su zugba mi ɔ peeɔ gugue fa. Mi dlami nɛ tsa nɔ ɔ, a ha e ya se nine mi blimi enyɔ kɛ bɔle la tɛ ɔ tsuo kɛ kpe, nɛ e hiɔwe yami ji gugue kake. Mi dlami nɛ tsa enɛ ɔ hu nɔ ɔ, a ha e ya se je nine kpɔ mi kake kɛ bɔle la tɛ ɔ tsuo kɛ kpe. 15E yi mi he nɛ a sãã bɔ ɔmɛ ngɛ ɔ peeɔ gugue kake. Koli eywiɛ maa si glouu ngɛ la tɛ ɔ kɔ nya eywiɛ ɔmɛ. 16Bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ yi mi kami kɛ e blimi sɔ, gugue etɛ ngɛ hiɛ kɛ hiɛ. 17Mi dlami ɔ nɛ ngɛ kpɛti ɔ hu kami kɛ e blimi sɔ, gugue etɛ kɛ fa ngɛ hiɛ kɛ hiɛ; kla nɛ bɔle e tue kɛ kpe ɔ hiɔwe yami ji nine mi blimi kake; nɛ e sisi ɔ, nine mi blimi enyɔ bɔle la tɛ ɔ kɛ kpe. Kpokuhi nɛ a kuɔɔ kɛ yaa bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he ɔ ngɛ la tɛ ɔ beleku je.
Bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he tsukɔmi
18Mlaahi nɛ ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ngɛ dee nɛ kɔɔ he ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Ke a ma bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɛ a maa sã bɔ ngɛ nɔ, nɛ a maa ngɔ muɔ kɛ fĩa nɔ ɔ gbe nya a, 19Levi bi osɔfo ɔmɛ nɛ ji Zadok nina, nɛ mɛ pɛ lɛ a ba sɔmɔɔ mi ngɛ ye he klɔuklɔu ɔ, ha mɛ na ku nɛ a kɛ sã yayami pami bɔ. 20Bɔ nɛ o maa pee kɛ tsukɔ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he, nɛ e pee klɔuklɔu ha Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: ngɔɔ muɔ ɔ eko nɛ o kɛ kpa koli eywiɛ ɔmɛ, la tɛ ɔ kpɛti mi dlami ɔ kɔ nya eywiɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ kla nɛ bɔle la tɛ ɔ he tsuo kɛ kpe ɔ. 21Jehanɛ ngɔɔ na ku ɔ nɛ a kɛ maa sã yayami pami bɔ ɔ. Ha nɛ a sã lɛ ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ he, he nɛ a to nɛ a pee ngɛ ɔ. 22E nɔ jena a, ngɔɔ akpakpo nɛ kpa ko be e he kɛ ba sã yayami pami bɔ kɛ tsukɔ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he. 23Ke o tsukɔ la tɛ ɔ he gbe nya a, ngɔɔ na ku kɛ agbosu nɛ kpa ko be a he kɛ ba. 24Ngɔɔ mɛ kɛ ba ha Yawɛ. Osɔfo ɔmɛ maa ngɔ ngo kɛ fĩa a nɔ, nɛ a kɛ mɛ maa sã sami bɔ kɛ ha imi Yawɛ. 25Ngɔɔ akpakpo kɛ ba nɛ a kɛ sã yayami pami bɔ daa ligbi kɛ yaa si ligbi kpaago. Ngɔɔ na ku kɛ agbosu hu nɛ kpa ko kpa ko be mɛ tsuo a he kɛ ba ja nɔuu. 26A ngɔ ligbi kpaago kɛ tsukɔ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he, nɛ á gbaa nɔ kɛ ha bɔ sami. 27 Ke a gbe ligbi kpaago ní tsumi ɔ nya a, kɛ je ligbi kpaanyɔ ɔ hluu kɛ yaa a, osɔfo ɔmɛ nɛ a sã sami bɔ ɔmɛ, kɛ tue mi jɔmi bɔ ɔmɛ ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ. Kɛkɛ ɔ, ye bua maa jɔ ma a tsuo he. Imi, Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ lɛ i de.”

Title: EZEKIEL 44
Content:
Yawɛ we ɔ beleku je agbo ɔ
1Jehanɛ nyumu ɔ kpale mi kɛ ba he klɔuklɔu ɔ we agbo ɔ nɛ hɛ mi kpee beleku je ɔ nya. A nga agbo ɔ. 2Yawɛ de mi ke, “A gbo nɛ ɔ, á nga daa; a ko bli gblegbleegble. Nɔ ko nɔ ko kó gu lejɛ ɔ kɛ sɛ we ɔ mi, ejakaa imi Yawɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ nitsɛ i gu lejɛ ɔ kɛ sɛ mi. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, á nga daa. 3Ganɔ ɔ pɛ lɛ ngɛ he blɔ nɛ e yaa lejɛ ɔ. E ma nyɛ maa hi lejɛ ɔ kɛ ye ní ngɛ Yawɛ hɛ mi. É gu kue ngua a nɛ ngɛ se je ɔ mi kɛ ya, nɛ é gu lejɛ ɔ nɔuu kɛ je kpo.”
Blɔ nya tomi kɛ ha nihi nɛ maa ya Yawɛ we ɔ
4Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, nyumu ɔ kɛ mi ya gu omleyi je agbo ɔ mi kɛ ba we ɔ hɛ mi, nɛ i na Yawɛ hɛ mi nyami ɔ nɛ hyi we ɔ tɔ. I ngɔ ye hɛ mi kɛ bu si. 5Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ de mi ke, “Nɔmlɔ adesa, bli o hɛngmɛ nɛ o hyɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ pɛpɛɛpɛ; bu nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ tue saminya. Blɔ nya tomihi, kɛ mlaahi nɛ kɔɔ ye we ɔ he ɔ, kadi mɛ, konɛ o hɛ ko je a nɔ. Ná nɛ o le kaa pi nɔ tsuaa nɔ kɛkɛ nɛ yaa ye we ɔ.
6“De Israel ma atuã tsɔli nɛ ɔmɛ ke imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ i be mɛ blɔ ngmɛe nɛ a pee ní hiemi níhi nɛ a ngɛ pee ɔ hu. 7A ha nibwɔhi mɔmlɔtɔtsɛmɛ, nihi nɛ a he tsɔ we, nɛ a bui mi tue ba sɛ ye we ɔ mi, benɛ osɔfo ɔmɛ ngɔ zɔ kɛ muɔ kɛ ngɛ bɔhi sãe ha mi ɔ. Ye ma a yi ye somi ɔ nɔ, nɛ a ngɔ a ní hiemi ní nɛ ɔmɛ hu kɛ tɔ ye nɔ. 8Mɛ nitsɛmɛ a tsu we ye ní klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ a he ní ngɛ ye we ɔ, se mohu a ngɔ nibwɔhi kɛ to ní tsumi ɔmɛ a nya.
9“Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, i ngɛ dee ke nubwɔ mɔmlɔtɔtsɛ nɛ he tsɔ we, nɛ bui mi tue kó sɛ ye we ɔ mi kɔkɔɔkɔ; nibwɔhi nɛ ngɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ a kpɛti tete po a ko ya lejɛ ɔ.”
Levi bi nɛ be he blɔ kaa a tsuɔ osɔfo ní tsumi
10Yawɛ de mi ke, “Levi bi nɛ a kɛ Israel ma nɛ piɛ ɔ kua mi, nɛ a ya ja amagahi ɔ, ma gbla a tue. 11A ma sɔmɔ ngɛ ye we ɔ; a maa bu agbo ɔmɛ a nya, nɛ a ma tsu ní ngɛ we ɔ. Lohwehi nɛ a kɛ ba sãã sami bɔ, kɛ bɔ kpahi ɔ, mɛ lɛ a maa gbe lohwe ɔ, nɛ mɛ nɔuu lɛ a ma sɔmɔ nihi nɛ ba bɔ sami ɔ. 12Akɛnɛ a nyɛɛ Israel ma a hɛ mi kɛ ya ja amagahi, nɛ a ha a pee yayami kɛ si mi he je ɔ, imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ, i ngɛ ye he kita kae ke ma gbla a tue kokooko. 13A ko sã kɛ su ye he, nɛ a ko ba tsu osɔfo ní tsumi ha mi. A ko ba ta ye ní klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ a he; nɛ a ko ya he klɔuklɔu pe kulaa a hulɔ. Enɛ ɔ ji a tue gblami ngɛ ní hiemi níhi nɛ a pee ɔ a he. 14Se kɛ̃ ɔ, ma ha a maa hyɛ sɔlemi we ɔ nɔ. Sɔmɔmi ní tsumi, kɛ ní tsumi kpahi nɛ hia kaa a tsu ɔ, mɛ lɛ a ma tsu.”
Osɔfo ɔmɛ
15Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ke, “Benɛ Israel ma a nɛ piɛ ɔ tsuo kua mi ɔ, Levi weku ɔ mi osɔfohi nɛ ji Zadok nina a, mɛɛ lɛɛ a sɔmɔ mi saminya ngɛ ye we ɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, mɛ pɛ ji nihi nɛ maa ba ye hɛ mi nɛ a ba sɔmɔ mi. Mɛ ji nihi nɛ maa ngɔ zɔ, kɛ nu ɔ kɛ ba ha imi Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ. 16Mɛ pɛ ji nihi nɛ maa ba ye he klɔuklɔu ɔ. A maa ba ye we okplɔɔ ɔ he, konɛ a ba sɔmɔ mi. Mɛ ji ni nɛmɛ nɛ maa hyɛ nɛ a ja mi saminya. 17 Ke a maa ba Yawɛ we ɔ kpo nɔ je kue ɔmɛ a mi ɔ, a wo kploba tade. A ko wo kuutu nɔ́ ko kɛ ya sɔmɔ ngɛ kue ngua a nɛ ngɛ kpɛti ɔ mi; ye we ɔ nitsɛ mi hu, á pee ja kɛ. 18Bɔ nɛ pee nɛ latsa ko tsa mɛ benɛ a ngɛ sɔmɔe ɔ, a ngɔ kploba kɛ pee yi fimi nɔ́ kɛ fi a yi; nɛ a wo kploba tade ngɛ a mlɛ mi kɛ ya si nane si, se a ko fi a mlɛ mi nɔ́ ko. 19 Ke a maa je kpo kɛ ya agbo nya je kue ɔ mi, kɛ ya he nɛ ma a ngɛ ɔ, a je tade ɔmɛ nɛ a wo kɛ sɔmɔ ɔ kɛ pue tsu klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ a mi. A wo tade kpahi, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ heha ní klɔuklɔu nɛ ɔmɛ ko ye ma a awi.
20 “Osɔfo ɔmɛ ko sã a yi nɔ kpalokpalo, nɛ a ko ngmɛɛ a yi bwɔmi he nɛ e ka gagaa hulɔ. A dla a yi ɔ he bɔ nɛ sa kɛkɛ. 21 Ke osɔfo ko maa ya he klɔuklɔu ɔ, e ko nu dã. 22 Osɔfo kó ngɔ yalɔyo, loo yo nɛ e kɛ e huno be hu; e ngɔ yomiyo kɛ je e ma Israel bi ɔmɛ a kpɛti, aloo osɔfo ko nɛ be je mi ɔ e yo yalɔyo.
23 “Osɔfo ɔmɛ nɛ́ a tsɔɔ ye ma a slɔɔto nɛ ngɛ nɔ́ klɔuklɔu, kɛ nɔ́ nɛ be klɔuklɔu a kpɛti, kɛ slɔɔto nɛ ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ he tsɔ we, kɛ nɔ́ nɛ he tsɔ a kpɛti. 24Ke sane ko ba a, osɔfo ɔmɛ nɔuu nɛ a hyɛ sane ɔ mi, nɛ á kojo ngɛ ye mlaa amɛ a nya. Mlaahi, kɛ blɔ nya tomihi nɛ kɔɔ nyami be ɔmɛ tsuo a he ɔ, a hyɛ nɛ a ye a nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ, nɛ a pee Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔmɛ klɔuklɔu.
25 “Osɔfo ko kó ya gbogboe kasa nya nɛ e kɛ ba ble e he. Ke e he nɔ kɔklɔɔ kaa e tsɛ, loo e nyɛ, loo e binyumu, loo e biyo, loo e nyɛminyumu, loo e nyɛmiyo nɛ yɛ gba we kikɛ nɛ ɔ nɛ gbo lɛɛ e ma nyɛ ma ble e he faa. 26Ke e tsukɔ e he se ɔ, a kane ligbi kpaago ha lɛ, kɛkɛ ɔ, e he ma tsɔ. 27Jehanɛ, e ya Yawɛ we ɔ mi mi je kue ɔ mi, nɛ e ya sã yayami pami bɔ, konɛ e nyɛ nɛ e ya sɔmɔ mi ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ ekohu. Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de.
28 “Weto ní nɛ i ha Israel bi ɔmɛ, nɛ yi nɔ kake siɔ kɛ haa yi nɔ nɛ nyɛɛ se kɛ maa ya neneene ɔ, osɔfo ɔmɛ lɛɛ a nɔ́ ji osɔfo yemi; imi nitsɛ ji a weto ní, kɛ a nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a be weto ní kpa ko nae ngɛ Israel ma a mi. 29 Osɔfo ɔmɛ a niye ní nɛ a maa ye ji niye ní bɔ ɔmɛ, yayami pami bɔ ɔmɛ, kɛ fɔ yemi bɔ ɔmɛ; jehanɛ hu, nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ maa gbaa nɔ kɛ ke mi ɔ peeɔ osɔfo ɔmɛ a nɔ́. 30Tso yiblii tsuaa tso yiblii kekleekle nɔ́, kɛ ní slɔɔtohi nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ ma ba sã bɔ ha mi ɔ a mi nɔ́ nɛ hi pe kulaa a peeɔ osɔfo ɔmɛ a nɔ́. Jehanɛ hu, ke a sã abolo ɔ, a ngɔ kekleekle nɔ́ nɛ a bɔ ɔ kɛ ba ha osɔfo ɔmɛ, konɛ ye gbaami nɛ hi we ɔmɛ a mi. 31 Osɔfo kó ye lohwe ko nɛ lɛ nitsɛ e gbo, loo lohwe kpa ko tsɔtslɔɔ e mi kɔkɔɔkɔ, lohwe pɛlitsɛ jio, nane eywiɛtsɛ jio.”

Title: EZEKIEL 45
Content:
Zugba a fa nɛ ji Yawɛ nɔ́ ɔ
1Ke nyɛ ngɛ zugba a mi dlae kɛ ha Israel wɛtso ɔmɛ, nɛ́ e pee a weto ní ɔ, nyɛ susu fa ko, nɛ nyɛɛ gbaa nɔ kɛ ha Yawɛ. Zugba nɛ ɔ kami nɛ pee si tomi kpaanyɔ kɛ fa, nɛ e blimi hu nɛ pee si tomi ekpa kɛ fa. Lejɛ ɔ zugba a tsuo nɛ pee klɔuklɔu. 2Zugba a he nɛ Yawɛ we ɔ maa hi ɔ, e kami nɛ e pee gugue lafa kɛ nyingmi enyɔ kɛ enuɔ, kɛ e blimi hu ja nɔuu. Zugba nɛ fɔɔ si gu gugue nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ kɛ fa nɛ bɔle we ɔ kɛ kpe. 3Zugba nɛ ɔ mi fa nɛ e kami ji si tomi kpaanyɔ kɛ fa, nɛ e blimi ji si tomi etɛ kɛ fa maa pee he nɛ he klɔuklɔu pe kulaa maa hi. 4He klɔuklɔu nɛ ɔ, a kɛ ha osɔfo ɔmɛ nɛ sɔmɔɔ ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ. Hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ nɛ a maa ma a wehi, kɛ Yawɛ we ɔ nitsɛ ngɛ. 5Zugba a fa nɛ piɛ nɛ e kami ji si tomi kpaanyɔ kɛ fa, kɛ e blimi si tomi etɛ kɛ fa a maa pee Levi bi ɔmɛ nɛ sɔmɔɔ ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ a hi he. A maa po mahi ha mɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.
6Jehanɛ, ngɛ zugba klɔuklɔu nɛ ɔ hanɔ ɔ, nyɛɛ po zugba kpa nɛ maa pee Israel wɛtso ɔmɛ tsuo a nɔ́, nɛ a maa po mahi ngɛ nɔ. Zugba nɛ ɔ kami nɛ pee si tomi kpaanyɔ kɛ fa, kɛ e blimi si tomi kake kɛ fa kɛ e se nyafii ko.
Zugba nɛ á ha ganɔ nɛ ngɛ ma a nɔ yee ɔ
7Nyɛ ha ganɔ nɛ ngɛ ma a nɔ yee ɔ zugba a eko. Nyɛ ha lɛ kɛ je zugba klɔuklɔu ɔ bonyoku je huzu ɔ nya, nɛ e tsa nɔ hluu kɛ ya bonyoku je ngɛ Mediterenia wo ɔ nya. Ngɛ beleku je ɔ, huzu ɔ ya su zugba a tsuo beleku je huzu ɔ nyagbe he. Zugba nɛ ɔ kami, kɛ nɔ́ nɛ a ha Israel wɛtso ɔmɛ ɔ kami nɛ sɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ. 8Zugba nɛ ganɔ nɛ ngɛ ma a nɔ yee ɔ ma na ngɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ a kpɛti ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. Ke nyɛ pee ja a, ganɔ ɔmɛ be ye ma a blɔ nya ní kpɔe ngɛ a dɛ, se mohu a maa dla zugba a mi kɛ ha wɛtso ɔmɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Mlaahi nɛ a wo ganɔ nɛ ngɛ ma a nɔ yee ɔ
9Yawɛ ke, “Nyɛ Israel ganɔhi, e hiɛ oo e hiɛ! Nyɛ kpa amimi kɛ awi yemi! Nyɛɛ ye dami sane, nɛ nyɛɛ pee nɔ́ nɛ da. Nyɛ ko fie ye ma a kɛ je a zugba nɔ hu. Imi, Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ lɛ i de.
10 “Nyɛɛ ngɔ sɛnihi nɛ hi, kɛ susumi níhi nɛ da kɛ tsu ní.
11“Susumi nɔ́ nɛ a tsɛɛ ke efa, kɛ susumi nɔ́ nɛ a tsɛɛ ke bat ɔ, nyɛ ha nɛ a sɔ fiee; bat ɔ nyɔngma lɛ peeɔ susumi nɔ́ nɛ a tsɛɛ ke homer ɔ kake; jã kɛ̃ efa a hu nyɔngma lɛ peeɔ homer kake. Homer nɔ nyɛɛ da kɛ susu níhi.
12“Bɔ nɛ nyɛ níhi a ngmɛmi blɔ nya tomi ngɛ ha ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: Sɛni tɛ nɛ a tsɛɛ gera a nyingmi enyɔ lɛ peeɔ shekel kake. Shekel nyingmi ekpa lɛ peeɔ mina kake.
13-15“Nyɛɛ ngɔ bɔ nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ ba ha ganɔ nɛ ngɛ ma a nɔ yee ɔ:
Ngma nɛ nyɛ naa ngɛ ní kpami mi ɔ mi dlami nyingmi ekpa mi kake.
Akoko nɛ nyɛ naa ngɛ ní kpami mi ɔ mi dlami nyingmi ekpa mi kake.
Oliv nu nɛ nyɛ naa ngɛ tso ɔmɛ a nɔ ɔ mi dlami lafa
mi kake. Nyɛɛ ngɔ susumi nɔ́ nɛ a tsɛɛ ke bat ɔ kɛ
susu nu ɔ. Bat nyɔngma peeɔ kor kake.
Tohi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ lɛe ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ wo zɔ kake ngɛ lafa enyɔ mi.
“Nyɛɛ ngɔ niye ní bɔhi, sami bɔhi, kɛ tue mi jɔmi bɔhi kɛ ba, konɛ a ngɔ nyɛ he yayami ɔmɛ kɛ pa nyɛ. Imi, Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ lɛ i de.
16“Ma a tsuo nɛ ngɔ bɔ nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ ba ha ganɔ ɔ nɛ ngɛ Israel ma a nɔ yee ɔ. 17Sami bɔ ɔmɛ, niye ní bɔ ɔmɛ, kɛ wai bɔ ɔmɛ nɛ a kɛ baa Nyɔhiɔhe nyami be, Hejɔɔmi ligbi, kɛ nyami be kpa amɛ tsuo nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ yeɔ ɔ, ganɔ ɔ blɔ nya ji kaa e ha mɛ. Lɛ nɔuu lɛ e haa bɔ nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a kɛ peeɔ kusumi kɛ kpataa Yawɛ kɛ haa Israel ma a: yayami pami bɔ, niye ní bɔ, sami bɔ, kɛ tue mi jɔmi bɔ.”
Nyami behi
(Mose II, 12.1-20; Mose III, 23.33-43)
18Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ke, “Kekleekle nyɔhiɔ ɔ we kekleekle ligbi ɔ, ngɔɔ na niheyo nɛ kpa ko be e he nɛ o kɛ tsukɔ Yawɛ we ɔ he. 19Osɔfo ɔ nɛ ngɔ lohwe nɛ a kɛ maa pee kusumi kɛ kpa musu ɔ muɔ ɔ eko, nɛ e kɛ kpa we ɔ sinya tso ɔmɛ, bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ sisi kɔ nya eywiɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ we ɔ mi je kue ɔ agbo ɔ sinya tso ɔmɛ a he. 20Nyɔhiɔ ɔ we ligbi kpaago ɔ, pee jã kɛ̃ kɛ ha nɔ nɛ li e he be nɛ e tɔ̃, kɛ nɔ nɛ li kaa nɔ́ nɛ e pee ɔ peeɔ tɔmi ɔ. Blɔ nɔ nɛ o maa gu kɛ pee Yawɛ we ɔ klɔuklɔu ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
21 “Kekleekle nyɔhiɔ ɔ we ligbi nyɔngma kɛ eywiɛne ɔ, nyɛ bɔni Hetsɔmi nyami be ɔ yemi. Nyɛɛ ye abolo kplolo ligbi kpaago. 22Kekleekle ligbi ɔ, ganɔ ɔ nɛ ngɛ ma a nɔ yee ɔ nɛ ngɔ na ku nɛ e kɛ sã yayami pami bɔ kɛ ha lɛ nitsɛ e he, kɛ ma a tsuo. 23Ligbi kpaago ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ a ngɛ nyami be ɔ yee ɔ, daa ligbi ɔ, e ngɔ na ku kpaago, kɛ agbosu kpaago nɛ kpa ko be a he kɛ ba ha Yawɛ, nɛ e kɛ sã bɔ nɛ a sãã lohwe ɔ tsuo. E ngɔ to akpakpo kake hulɔ kɛ sã yayami pami bɔ daa ligbi. 24E ngɔ niye ní bɔ kɛ piɛ lohwe ɔmɛ a he: na ku kake ɔ, e ngɔ blɛfo lita nyɔngma kɛ kpaago kɛ fa, kɛ oliv nu lita etɛ, nɛ agbosu kake ɔ hu e ngɔ blɛfo lita nyɔngma kɛ kpaago kɛ fa, kɛ oliv nu lita etɛ ja nɔuu.
25 “A je Gbasisihimi nyami be ɔ yemi sisi kɛ je nyɔhiɔ kpaago ɔ we ligbi nyɔngma kɛ enuɔne ɔ. Ke be ɔ su ɔ, ganɔ ɔ nɛ ngɛ ma a nɔ yee ɔ maa sã jamɛ a bɔ ɔmɛ nɔuu daa ligbi otsi ɔ mi tsuo. A maa sã lohwe ɔ tsuo kɛ ha yayami pami; nɛ a kɛ blɛfo, kɛ oliv nu maa piɛ he.”

Title: EZEKIEL 46
Content:
Ganɔ ɔ kɛ nyami be ɔmɛ
1Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ke, “Agbo nɛ a sɛɛ mi ngɛ beleku je kɛ baa kue ɔ mi ngɛ we ɔ mi je ɔ, a nga lɛ ní tsumi ligbi ekpa amɛ tsuo; se Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ, kɛ Nyɔhiɔhe he nyami be ɔmɛ lɛɛ a bli lɛ kɛ fɔ si. 2Benɛ osɔfo ɔmɛ ngɛ yayami pami, kɛ tue mi jɔmi bɔ ɔmɛ sãe ɔ, ganɔ ɔ nɛ ngɛ ma a nɔ yee ɔ nɛ gu jamɛ a agbo ɔ mi ngɛ kue ɔ kpo nɔ je kɛ ba, nɛ e ba da si ngɛ agbo ɔ sinya tso ɔ he. E ja Mawu ngɛ agbo ɔ nya ngɛ lejɛ ɔ loko e je kpo. A ko nga agbo ɔ kɛ yaa si gbɔkuɛ. 3Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ, kɛ Nyɔhiɔhe nyami be ɔmɛ ɔ, ma a tsuo nɛ ba ja Yawɛ ngɛ agbo ɔ nya.
4“Ganɔ nɛ ngɛ ma a nɔ yee ɔ nɛ ngɔ jijɔ ekpa, kɛ agbosu kake nɛ kpa be a he kɛ ba sã sami bɔ ha Yawɛ Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ. 5E ngɔ blɛfo lita nyɔngma kɛ kpaago kɛ fa kɛ piɛ agbosu ɔ he, se jijɔ ɔmɛ lɛɛ e ngɔ blɛfo ɔ bɔ nɛ e suɔ kaa e ma ha kɛ piɛ lohwe ɔmɛ a he kɛ ba sã bɔ ɔ. Oliv nu lita etɛ nɛ piɛ blɛfo lita nyɔngma kɛ kpaago kɛ fa he kɛ ba. 6E ngɔ na niheyo kake, jijɔ ekpa, kɛ agbosu kake nɛ kpa be ekoeko he kɛ ba sã bɔ Nyɔhiɔhe nyami be ɔ. 7Blɛfo lita nyɔngma kɛ kpaago kɛ fa nɛ piɛ na ku ɔ he, nɛ lita nyɔngma kɛ kpaago kɛ fa nɛ piɛ agbosu ɔ hu he, se jijɔ ɔmɛ a nɔ́ ɔ lɛɛ e ha blɛfo ɔ bɔ nɛ e suɔ, nɛ e ngɔ oliv nu lita etɛ kɛ piɛ he kɛ ba sã niye ní bɔ. 8Ganɔ ɔ nɛ gu agbo nɛ e kɛ sɛ mi ɔ nɔuu mi kɛ je kpo.
9“Nyami be tsuaa nyami be nɛ ma a tsuo ma Yawɛ jami ɔ, nihi nɛ maa gu omleyi je agbo ɔ mi kɛ sɛ we ɔ mi ɔ, á gu leneyi je agbo ɔ mi kɛ je kpo; nɛ nihi nɛ maa gu leneyi je agbo ɔ mi kɛ sɛ mi ɔ, á gu omleyi je nɔ́ ɔ mi kɛ je kpo. Nɔ ko nɔ ko kó gu blɔ nɛ e kɛ sɛ we ɔ mi ɔ kɛ je kpo; é gu agbo nɛ ngɛ e hɛ mi tɛɛ ɔ mi kɛ je kpo. 10Ke ma a ma ja Yawɛ ɔ, ganɔ ɔ kɛ mɛ nɛ ba; ke a maa kpale kɛ ya a, e kɛ mɛ nɛ ho. 11Nyami be tsuaa nyami be nɛ a maa sã niye ní bɔ ɔ, blɛfo lita nyɔngma kɛ kpaago kɛ fa nɛ piɛ na ku kake he, nɛ lita nyɔngma kɛ kpaago kɛ fa nɛ piɛ agbosu kake he, se jijɔ ɔmɛ a nɔ́ ɔ lɛɛ a ha blɛfo ɔ bɔ nɛ a suɔ, nɛ a ngɔ oliv nu lita etɛ kɛ piɛ he kɛ ba.
12“Ke ganɔ ɔ je e tsui mi faa kɛ ma bɔ sami ha Yawɛ ɔ, bɔ nɛ e maa sã lɛ tsuo jio, sina bɔ jio, a bli agbo nɛ ngɛ beleku je ɔ ha lɛ. E sã e bɔ ɔ kaa bɔ nɛ e peeɔ Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ. Ke e gbe nya a, e je kpo, nɛ a nga agbo ɔ.”
Bɔ nɛ a sãã daa ligbi
13Yawɛ ke, “Daa mɔtu ɔ, ganɔ ɔ nɛ ngɔ jijɔ nɛ ye jeha kake nɛ kpa ko be e he kɛ ba sã sami bɔ ha imi Yawɛ. 14E ngɔ niye ní nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ piɛ he daa mɔtu kɛ sã bɔ ha imi Yawɛ: mamu kilo enyɔ, kɛ oliv nu lita kake nɛ e kɛ pɔtɔ mamu ɔ. Blɔ nya tomi nɛ kɔɔ bɔ sami nɛ ɔ he ɔ, á ye nɔ daa. 15A ngɔ jijɔ ɔ, ma a, kɛ oliv nu ɔ kɛ sã bɔ ha imi Yawɛ daa ligbi.”
Ganɔ ɔ kɛ zugba a
16Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ke, “Ke ganɔ ɔ ngɔ lɛ nitsɛ e zugba a fa ko kɛ ke e binyumu ɔmɛ a ti nɔ ko ɔ, jamɛ a zugba a maa pee bimɛ ɔmɛ a weto ní. 17 Se ke e ngɔ zugba a fa ko ngɔ ha e tsɔli ɔmɛ a ti nɔ ko ɔ, lɛɛ é hi tsɔlɔ ɔ nine nɔ kɛ yaa si Heyemi jeha nɛ a kpaleɔ níhi kɛ haa nɔtsɛmɛ ɔ maa su. A kpale kɛ ha ganɔ ɔ ekohu, konɛ e pee e nɔ́; se e bimɛ ɔmɛ lɛɛ a weto ní nɛ a na a kɛkɛ nɛ e pee mɛ hu a nɔ́ kulaa. 18Ganɔ ɔ nɛ ngɔ lɛ nitsɛ e blɔ fami nɔ́ kɛ ha e bimɛ; se ye ma mi bi ɔmɛ lɛɛ a ko kpɔ nɔ ko weto ní ngɛ e dɛ.”
Yawɛ we ɔ he kuehi
19Jehanɛ nyumu ɔ ngɔ mi kɛ ya tsu ɔmɛ nɛ a hɛ mi kpee omleyi je ɔ a nya. Tsu nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ mi mi je kue ɔ we agbo ɔ nya ngɛ leneyi je. A ma tsu klɔuklɔu nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ ha osɔfo ɔmɛ. Nyumu ɔ tsɔɔ mi he ko ngɛ tsu ɔmɛ a beleku je, 20nɛ e de mi ke, “Hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ ji he nɛ osɔfo ɔmɛ maa hoo lo nɛ a kɛ maa sã fɔ yemi, kɛ yayami pami bɔ ɔmɛ ngɛ; nɛ hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ nɔuu a maa ngɔ mamu kɛ pee abolo nɛ a kɛ maa sã niye ní bɔ ɔmɛ ngɛ. Ke a pee ja a, a be ní klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ ngɔe kɛ ya kpo nɔ je kue ɔ mi, nɛ́ ní klɔuklɔu nɛ ɔmɛ kó ba ye ma a awi.”
21-22Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e kɛ mi ya kue ɔ nɛ ngɛ kpo nɔ je ɔ mi, nɛ e tsɔɔ mi kaa kɔ nya eywiɛ ɔmɛ eko tsuaa eko ngɛ kue wayoo ko nɛ kami ji gugue nyɔngma, nɛ e blimi ji gugue kpaago kɛ fa. 23A kɛ tɛ fia gbogbo kɛ bɔle eko tsuaa eko kɛ kpe, nɛ a ma la tɛ ngɛ gbogbo ɔmɛ a he tsuo kɛ kpe. 24Nyumu ɔ de mi ke, “Bɔ ɔmɛ nɛ ma a ma ba sã a, kuehi nɛ Yawɛ we ɔ mi sɔmɔli ɔmɛ maa hoo lo ɔ ngɛ a mi ɔ ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ.”

Title: EZEKIEL 47
Content:
Nyu nɛ je Yawɛ we ɔ mi ɔ
1 Nyumu ɔ ngɔ mi kɛ ba Yawɛ we ɔ agbo ɔ nya ekohu. Nyu hia kɛ je kpoku ɔ sisi, nɛ e be kɛ yaa beleku je, he nɛ Yawɛ we ɔ plɛ e hɛ mi kɛ kpee ɔ. Nyu ɔ hia kɛ je we ɔ leneyi je kɛ ya be ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ leneyi je. 2Jehanɛ nyumu ɔ kɛ mi gu omleyi je agbo ɔ mi kɛ je kpo kɛ lɔgɔ si kɛ ba agbo ɔ nɛ hɛ mi kpee beleku je ɔ nya. Nyu ɔ ngɛ kpo jee ngɛ agbo ɔ leneyi je kɛ ngɛ bee kaa pa wayoo ko. 3Nyumu ɔ ngɔ e nɔ́ susumi kpa a kɛ susu pa a gugue lafa enyɔ kɛ nyingmi enuɔ kɛ ya beleku je, nɛ e ha i nyɛɛ e se kɛ sɛ pa a mi ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Nyu ɔ ba ta ye nane kpɔ mi. 4E susu gugue lafa enyɔ kɛ nyingmi enuɔ kɛ tsa nɔ, nɛ nyu ɔ ba ta ye nakutso nya ngɛ he nɛ wa su ɔ. E susu gugue lafa enyɔ kɛ nyingmi enuɔ ekohu. He nɛ wa su ɔ, nyu ɔ ba ta ye mlɛ mi. 5Kɛkɛ nɛ e susu gugue lafa enyɔ kɛ nyingmi enuɔ ekohu. Jehanɛ pa a mi kuɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, nɛ i nyɛ we ma ya hɛ mi. Pa a mi kuɔ tsɔ, ja a sile kɛ po. 6Kɛkɛ nɛ e de mi ke, “Nɔmlɔ adesa, to nɔ́ nɛ ɔ he hɛ saminya!”
Jehanɛ, nyumu ɔ kɛ mi nyɛɛ pa a tue kɛ kpale kɛ ba. 7I na kaa jehanɛ tsohi babauu nitsɛ maa si ngɛ pa a nya hiɛ kɛ hiɛ tsuo. 8E de mi ke, “Nyu nɛ ɔ bee ngɛ zugba a mi kɛ yaa beleku je, kɛ yaa Yordan kɔ̃ ɔ mi, nɛ e ya sɛɛ Ngo wo ɔ mi. Nyu nɛ ɔ tsakeɔ wo nyu ɔ kɛ peeɔ nyu mua. 9He tsuaa he nɛ pa nɛ ɔ maa be ngɛ ɔ, lohwe nane eywiɛɛywiɛtsɛmɛ slɔɔtoslɔɔtohi maa bɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, nɛ a ma na pa mi lo babauu. Ke e ya sɛ Ngo wo ɔ mi ɔ, Ngo wo ɔ ma plɛ pee nyu mua, nɛ wami he maa ba he tsuaa he nɛ pa nɛ ɔ maa be ngɛ ɔ. 10Kɛ je Engedi pa a nya kɛ yaa si Eneglaim pa a nya tsuo ma hyi kɛ wo hɛli nɛ a ngɛ a yahi kae ngɛ wo ɔ nya. A maa gbe lo slɔɔtoslɔɔtohi babauu ngɛ pa amɛ a mi kaa bɔ nɛ a naa ngɛ Mediterenia wo ɔ nitsɛ mi ɔ. 11Se taku ɔmɛ, kɛ mɔsɔ ɔmɛ lɛɛ a be tsakee; a maa nɔ ngo. 12 Tso slɔɔtoslɔɔtohi maa bɔ ngɛ pa a nya hiɛ kɛ pa a se tsuo. Tso ba amɛ be nglae, nɛ a yiblii ɔmɛ hu be tae. Nyɔhiɔ tsuaa nyɔhiɔ ɔ, a maa wo yiblii he; ejakaa nyu nɛ a naa a, Yawɛ we ɔ mi a naa kɛ jeɔ. Tso ɔmɛ ma ha niye ní babauu, nɛ a ba amɛ ma ba pee tsopa nɛ a kɛ ma tsa ma a.”
Zugba a huzu ɔmɛ
13Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ wo huzu nɛ ɔmɛ ha Israel wɛtso nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ. Ke nyɛ maa dla zugba a mi kɛ ha mɛ ɔ, Yosef ma na ngwɔhe enyɔ. 14I wo nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ si ke ma ngɔ zugba nɛ ɔ kɛ ha mɛ, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ dla lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ ha nyɛ he, nɛ e pee nyɛ weto ní.
15“Zugba a we omleyi je huzu ɔ je Mediterenia wo ɔ nya kɛ ya gu Hetlon blɔ kɛ ya gu Hamat yo kpɛ blɔ ɔ, kɛ muɔ Zedad, 16kɛ ya na Berota kɛ Sibraim ma amɛ nɛ ngɛ Damasko kɛ Hamat huzu ɔmɛ a kpɛti ɔ, kɛ ya na Tikon nɛ ngɛ Hauran huzu ɔ nya a. 17Huzu nɛ ngɛ omleyi je ɔ ji kɛ je Mediterenia wo ɔ nya kɛ ya na Enon ma a ngɛ Damasko huzu ɔ nya, nɛ e be lejɛ ɔ he kɛ ya gu omleyi je kɛ ya muɔ Hamat huzu ɔ.
18“Beleku je huzu ɔ je Hauran kɛ Damasko a kpɛti, kɛ Gilead kɛ Israel zugba a hu a kpɛti ngɛ Yordan pa a he kɛ ya su Tamar tɔɔ ngɛ Ngo wo ɔ nya.
19“Leneyi je huzu ɔ je Tamar, kɛ gu Kadesh Meriba nyu ɔmɛ a he kɛ ya muɔ Egipt huzu ɔ, kɛ ya pi Mediterenia wo ɔ.
20“Bonyoku je huzu ɔ je Mediterenia wo ɔ nya hluu kɛ ya su Hamat yo kpɛ blɔ ɔ he.
21“Nyɛɛ dla zugba nɛ ɔ ha nyɛ he ngɛ Israel wɛtso ɔmɛ a nya. 22Á po zugba ha nyɛ wɛtso ɔmɛ, Israel fɔfɔɛ ɔmɛ, nyɛ nibwɔhi nɛ ba to nyɛ ɔ, kɛ a bimɛ tsuo nɛ ba pee Israel bi ɔ. A hyɛ, konɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ na e blɔ nya pɛpɛɛpɛ kaa Israel fɔfɔɛ. 23Wɛtso mi he nɛ nubwɔ ko ba to ɔ, a ha lɛ weto ní ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Imi, Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ lɛ i de.”

Title: EZEKIEL 48
Content:
A dla zugba a kɛ ha wɛtso ɔmɛ
1-7Zugba a we omleyi je huzu ɔ je Mediterenia wo ɔ nya kɛ ya beleku je, hluu kɛ ya na Hetlon ma a, kɛ ya gu Hamat yo kpɛ blɔ ɔ, kɛ ya muɔ Enon, kɛ ya su Damasko kɛ Hamat a kpɛti. Nyɛ susu zugba a, nɛ nyɛɛ wo huzu kɛ je beleku je kɛ ya na Mediterenia wo ɔ ngɛ bonyoku je kɛ ha wɛtso ɔmɛ. Bɔ nɛ nyɛɛ to mɛ setsɔsetsɔ kɛ je omleyi je kɛ ya pue leneyi je ji nɛ ɔ nɛ:
Dan
Asher
Naftali
Manase
Efraim
Ruben
Yuda.
Zugba a fa ko nɛ a je blɔ si ngɛ kpɛti ɔ
8Zugba nɛ tsa Yuda nɔ ɔ nɔ ɔ, á si kɛ fɔ si ha ní tsumi pɔtɛɛ ko. E blimi nɛ pee si tomi kpaanyɔ kɛ fa kɛ je omleyi je kɛ yaa si leneyi je. E kami nɛ pee kaa wɛtso kake zugba kami pɛpɛɛpɛ kɛ je beleku je kɛ ya si bonyoku je.
9Nyɛ susu he ko pɔtɛɛ ngɛ zugba a kpɛti, nɛ nyɛɛ gbaa nɔ kɛ ha Yawɛ. E kami nɛ pee si tomi kpaanyɔ kɛ fa, nɛ e blimi nɛ pee si tomi ekpa kɛ fa. 10Zugba nɛ ɔ fa ko maa pee osɔfo ɔmɛ a nɔ́. Kɛ je beleku je kɛ yaa bonyoku je ɔ, e pee si tomi kpaanyɔ kɛ fa, nɛ kɛ je omleyi je kɛ yaa leneyi je ɔ, e pee si tomi etɛ kɛ fa. Yawɛ we ɔ maa ma zugba a kpɛti. 11Á ngɔ he klɔuklɔu nɛ ɔ kɛ ha osɔfo ɔmɛ nɛ je Zadok weku ɔ mi ɔ. Mɛɛ lɛɛ benɛ Levi bi ɔmɛ a weku ɔ mi ni komɛ ya piɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ a he kɛ pee yayami ɔ, a tsu a blɔ nya ní pɛpɛɛpɛ ha mi. 12Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, zugba pɔtɛɛ nɛ tsa Levi bi ɔmɛ a nɔ́ ɔ nɔ ɔ nɛ pee Zadok weku ɔ nɔ́. Nɛ zugba nɛ ɔ maa pee he klɔuklɔu pe kulaa. 13Nyɛ ha Levi bi ɔmɛ zugba ko ngɛ osɔfo ɔmɛ a nɔ́ ɔ leneyi je. E kami kɛ je beleku je kɛ yaa bonyoku je nɛ pee si tomi kpaanyɔ kɛ fa, nɛ e blimi kɛ je omleyi je kɛ yaa leneyi je nɛ pee si tomi etɛ kɛ fa. 14Zugba a he nɛ a gbaa nɔ kɛ ha Yawɛ ɔ ji he nɛ hi pe kulaa. Á ko jua eko; a ko tsake kɛ ha nɔ ko; ejakaa e ji zugba klɔuklɔu nɛ a gbaa nɔ kɛ ha Yawɛ.
15Zugba nɛ maa piɛ, nɛ e blimi maa pee si tomi kake kɛ fa, kɛ e kami maa pee si tomi kpaanyɔ kɛ fa a nɛ fɔ si ha ma a tsuo; a maa pee nɔ́ saisaa ngɛ lejɛ ɔ; a maa ma a hi hehi ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, nɛ he komɛ hu maa fɔ si kɛkɛ. A po ma ngɛ lejɛ ɔ; 16ma a kami kɛ e blimi tsuo nɛ sɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ, gugue akpe kɛ e nya lafa kɛ nyingmi enyɔ kɛ enuɔ ngɛ beleku je, gugue akpe kɛ e nya lafa kɛ nyingmi enyɔ kɛ enuɔ ngɛ bonyoku je, gugue akpe kɛ e nya lafa kɛ nyingmi enyɔ kɛ enuɔ ngɛ omleyi je, kɛ gugue akpe kɛ e nya lafa kɛ nyingmi enyɔ kɛ enuɔ ngɛ leneyi je. 17Á ha zugba nɛ e blimi ji gugue nyingmi ekpa kɛ enyɔ kɛ fa nɛ hi ma a he tsuo kɛ bɔle si kɛ kpe. 18Ke a po ma a, zugba nɛ maa piɛ nɛ tsa zugba klɔuklɔu ɔ nɔ ngɛ leneyi je ɔ maa pee ma a mi ní tsuli ɔmɛ a nɔ́, nɛ a maa pee a ngmɔhi ngɛ nɔ. Zugba nɛ ngɛ beleku je ɔ kami nɛ pee si tomi kake kɛ fa, kɛ e blimi hu si tomi kake kɛ fa; nɛ ngɛ bonyoku je hu, lejɛ ɔ zugba a kami nɛ pee si tomi kake kɛ fa, kɛ e blimi hu si tomi kake kɛ fa. 19Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ je Israel wɛtso ko mi ɔ ma nyɛ maa pee ngmɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.
20Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, zugba nɛ a maa gbaa nɔ kɛ ha Yawɛ, kɛ he nɛ a maa po ma a ngɛ ɔ tsuo a kami kɛ a blimi nɛ sɔ; e kami maa pee si tomi kpaanyɔ kɛ fa, nɛ e blimi hu ja nɔuu.
21-22Ke a susu zugba a he nɛ a maa ma Yawɛ we ɔ, kɛ osɔfo ɔmɛ, kɛ Levi bi ɔmɛ a hi he, kɛ he nɛ a maa po ma a ngɛ ɔ, zugba nɛ maa piɛ ngɛ beleku je, kɛ bonyoku je ɔ tsuo nɛ pee ganɔ ɔ nɔ́. Zugba nɛ ɔ nya ya taa ngɛ beleku je; Mediterenia wo ɔ ji e huzu ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Yuda zugba a ngɛ omleyi je, nɛ Benyamin nɔ ɔ ngɛ leneyi je.
Zugba nɛ a ha wɛtso kpa amɛ
23-27Nyɛ susu zugba nɛ ngɛ zugba pɔtɛɛ nɛ ɔ leneyi je ɔ, nɛ nyɛɛ wo huzu kɛ je beleku je kɛ ya na Mediterenia wo ɔ. Nyɛɛ dla kɛ ha wɛtsohi nɛ piɛ ɔ. Bɔ nɛ nyɛɛ to mɛ setsɔsetsɔ kɛ je omleyi je kɛ ya pue leneyi je ji nɛ ɔ nɛ:
Benyamin
Simeon
Isakar
Zebulun
Gad
28Leneyi je huzu ɔ maa je Tamar kɛ ya pi Meriba Kadesh nyu ɔmɛ. Huzu ɔ nɛ nyɛɛ Egipt pa a nya hluu kɛ ya na Mediterenia wo ɔ.
29Nyɔmtsɛ Yawɛ ke, “Bɔ nɛ nyɛɛ dla zugba a kɛ ha Israel wɛtso ɔmɛ kakaaka, nɛ e pee a weto ní ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.”
Yerusalem agbo ɔmɛ
30-34 Á fia gbogbo eywiɛ kɛ bɔle Yerusalem ma a. Gbogbo tsuaa gbogbo kami nɛ pee gugue akpe kɛ e nya lafa kɛ nyingmi enyɔ kɛ enuɔ. A je agbo etɛɛtɛ kɛ wo gbogbo ɔmɛ eko tsuaa eko mi. Agbo ɔmɛ eko tsuaa eko nɛ hɛɛ wɛtso ɔmɛ eko biɛ. Agbohi nɛ maa hi omleyi je ɔ, biɛhi nɛ á wo mɛ ji Ruben, Yuda, kɛ Levi; ní nɛmɛ nɛ maa hi beleku je ɔ, á tsɛ mɛ Yosef, Benyamin, kɛ Dan; agbohi nɛ maa hi leneyi je ɔ, a wo mɛ Simeon, Isakar, kɛ Zebulun, nɛ bonyoku je agbo ɔmɛ ɔ, a tsɛ mɛ Gad, Asher, kɛ Naftali. 35Gbogbo nɛ maa bɔle ma a kɛ kpe ɔ tsuo, ke a susu ɔ, é pee gugue akpe eywiɛ kɛ e nya lafa enuɔ. Kɛ je jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, biɛ nɛ a kɛ ma tsɛ ma a ji, “Yawɛ ngɛ hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ!”

Title: DANIEL NYA TSƆƆMI
Content:
NYA TSƆƆMI
A ngma womi nɛ ɔ be mi nɛ a ngɛ Yuda bi ɔmɛ haoe, nɛ a ngɛ mɛ yi mi wae wawɛɛ nitsɛ. Matsɛ nɛ ngɛ ma a nya jamɛ a be ɔ pee we Mawu suɔmi nya ní. Womi ngmalɔ ɔ wo Yuda bi ɔmɛ he wami ke a ngɔ a hɛ ngɔ fɔ Mawu nɔ; ejakaa Mawu maa ngɔ he wami ɔ ngɛ matsɛ yaya a dɛ kɛ ha Mawu ɔ nitsɛ e ma a ekohu. Womi ngmalɔ nɛ ɔ ngɔ sane tsɔwitsɔwihi kɛ ninahi kɛ tsɔɔ e munyu ɔ nya.
Womi nɛ ɔ ngɛ mi dlami pɔtɛɛ enyɔ: (1) Sanehi nɛ kɔɔ Daniel kɛ e huɛmɛ nɛ a nuu mɛ kɛ ho ma se ya a a ti ni komɛ a he. Daniel kɛ e huɛmɛ nɛ ɔmɛ a hemi kɛ yemi ngɛ Mawu mi, kɛ Mawu tue nɛ a buu he je ɔ, a ye a he nyɛli ɔmɛ a nɔ kunimi. Sane nɛ ɔmɛ ba ngɛ Babilonia kɛ Persia bi ɔmɛ a matsɛ yemi be ɔmɛ a mi. (2) Daniel na nina munomunohi nɛ ji okadihi nɛ tsɔɔ bɔ nɛ matsɛ yemi slɔɔtoslɔɔtohi maa te si, kɛ bɔ nɛ a maa nɔ si kɛ nyɛɛ a sibi a se. Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ maa je sisi kɛ maa je Babilonia matsɛ yemi ɔ nɔ. Daniel gba kɛ to ke, mahi nɛ li Mawu, nɛ a waa nihi yi mi ɔ, a hɛ mi ma kpata; se Mawu ma a lɛɛ e maa ye kunimi.
Bɔ nɛ a dla womi ɔ mi ha
Daniel kɛ e huɛmɛ ɔmɛ 1.1—6.28
Ninahi nɛ Daniel na 7.1—12.13
a. Pu mi lohwe eywiɛ ɔmɛ 7.1-28
b. Agbosu ɔ kɛ to akpakpo ɔ 8.1—9.27
d. Mawu bɔfo ɔ nɛ je hiɔwe ɔ 10.1—11.45
e. Nyagbe be ɔ 12.1-13

Title: DANIEL 1
Content:
DANIEL KƐ E HUƐMƐ ƆMƐ A HE SANE
(1.1—6.28)
Nihewi ɔmɛ ngɛ Nebukadnezar we ɔ
1 Yuda matsɛ, Yehoyakim yi nɔ jeha nɛ ji etɛ ɔ mi ɔ, Babilonia matsɛ, Nebukadnezar ba tua Yerusalem, nɛ e sá ma a yi. 2 Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ngɔ Matsɛ Yehoyakim ngɔ wo e dɛ, nɛ Nebukadnezar muɔ june nɛ ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ ekomɛ kɛ je kɛ ho. Babilon ya. June nɛ e muɔ ngɛ Mawu we ɔ e kɛ ya to e mawu ɔmɛ a nito he ɔ. 3Nebukadnezar fa matsɛ we nɔ hyɛlɔ nɔkɔtɔma nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Ashpenaz ɔ ke e ya hla nihewi komɛ ngɛ nihi nɛ a nuu kɛ je Israel kɛ ba a a kpɛti kɛ ba. E tsɔɔ nya kaa nihewi nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a pee nihi nɛ je matsɛmɛ kɛ odehehi a we mi, 4nihi nɛ a he ngɛ fɛu, nɛ a le ní hulɔ, nihi nɛ a je blɔ tsɔse mɛ, nihi nɛ a ní tsɔɔmi yi, nɛ jehanɛ hu, kpa ko be a he. Nihewi nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a hi kikɛmɛ a su nɛ ɔmɛ, konɛ a nyɛ nɛ a sɔmɔ ngɛ matsɛ we ɔ. Ashpenaz maa tsɔɔ mɛ Babilonia gbi ɔ kanemi kɛ e ngmami. 5Matsɛ Nebukadnezar fa ke daa ligbi ɔ, a ha nihewi nɛ ɔmɛ lɛ nitsɛ e niye ní kpakpa nɛ e yeɔ, kɛ wai nɛ e nuɔ ɔ eko. E fa ke a tsɔse mɛ jeha etɛ, konɛ lɔ ɔ se ɔ, a ngɔ mɛ kɛ ba lɛ, matsɛ ɔ e ngɔ. 6Nihi nɛ a hla a, a ti ni komɛ ji Daniel, Hanania, Mishael, kɛ Azaria. Mɛ tsuo a je Yuda wɛtso ɔ mi. 7Matsɛ we nɔ hyɛlɔ nɔkɔtɔma a ha nihewi ɔmɛ biɛ hehi. E wo Daniel ke Belteshazar; e wo Hanania ke Shadrak; e wo Mishael ke Meshak, nɛ Azaria lɛɛ e wo lɛ Abednego.
8Daniel muɔ e yi mi kpɔ kaa e be matsɛ ɔ niye ní ɔ yee, nɛ wai ɔ hu e be nue, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ e ko ble e he. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e kpa Ashpenaz pɛɛ ke e ko nyɛ e nɔ ke e ye níhi nɛ a tsɔɔ kaa a ye ɔ doo. 9Mawu ha nɛ Ashpenaz na lɛ mɔbɔ. 10Se akɛnɛ Ashpenaz ngɛ matsɛ ɔ gbeye yee he je ɔ, e de Daniel ke, “Matsɛ ɔ tsɔɔ niye ní nɛ nyɛɛ ye, kɛ dã nɛ nyɛɛ nu. Ke e ba na kaa nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ be nɔmlɔ tso he wami kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ juami bi nihewi kpa amɛ ngɛ ɔ, e maa gbe mi.”
11Kɛkɛ nɛ Daniel ho ya na niye ní nɔ hyɛlɔ ɔ nɛ Ashpenaz ngɔ lɛ Daniel ɔ, kɛ e huɛmɛ etɛ ɔmɛ ngɔ wo e dɛ ɔ, nɛ e de lɛ ke, 12“Moo ka wɔ nɛ o hyɛ ligbi nyɔngma. Ha wɔ pui nɛ waa ye, kɛ nyu pɛ nɛ waa nu. 13Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, nihewi ɔmɛ nɛ mɛɛ matsɛ ɔ niye ní a yeɔ ɔ, ngɔɔ wɔ ngɔ to a he nɛ o hyɛ; konɛ nɔ́ nɛ o to kaa o maa pee wɔ ɔ, o pee.”
14Ashpenaz kplɛɛ nɔ́ nɛ Daniel bi lɛ ɔ nɔ, nɛ e ka mɛ ligbi nyɔngma. 15Ligbi nyɔngma se ɔ, a na kaa Daniel, kɛ e huɛmɛ etɛ ɔmɛ plɔke, nɛ a wo lo nihewi ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ mɛɛ a yeɔ matsɛ ɔ niye ní kpakpa a. 16Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, kɛ je jamɛ a be ɔ kɛ yaa a, niye ní kpakpa kɛ dã a nɛ tsɔɔ kaa a ha mɛ ɔ, niye ní nɔ hyɛlɔ ɔ ha we mɛ hu; pui kɛkɛ ji nɔ́ nɛ e haa mɛ.
17Mawu ha nihewi eywiɛ nɛ ɔmɛ nile, kɛ juɛmi nɛ a kɛ kaseɔ womi, kɛ je mi nile. Daniel lɛɛ Mawu dloo lɛ ninahi kɛ nlamihi a sisi tsɔɔmi ngɔ piɛ he.
18Jeha etɛ ɔ nɛ matsɛ ɔ to ɔ se ɔ, Ashpenaz ngɔ nihewi ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ ba Nebukadnezar ngɔ. 19Matsɛ ɔ kɛ mɛ tsuo sɛɛ ní. Se nihewi ɔmɛ tsuo a kpɛti ɔ, nihi pɛ nɛ Matsɛ Nebukadnezar ná a he bua jɔmi ji Daniel, Hanania, Mishael, kɛ Azaria. Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, a ngɔ mɛ ngɔ piɛ matsɛ ní tsuli ɔmɛ a he. 20Be tsuaa be nɛ matsɛ ɔ ma bi a ga womi ngɛ sanehi nɛ hia yi mi susumi wawɛɛ, kɛ nɔ́ he buami nɛ nɔ́ jemi ko be he a he ɔ, e naa kaa nihewi eywiɛ nɛ ɔmɛ a juɛmi mi kuɔ si nyɔngma pe klaali kɛ kunya yeli tsuo nɛ ngɛ e matsɛ yemi he ɔmɛ tsuo. 21Daniel tsu ní kaa matsɛ ga wolɔ kɛ ya si be nɛ Persia matsɛ, Sirus ba ye Babilonia nɔ kunimi.

Title: DANIEL 2
Content:
Nebukadnezar nla
1Benɛ Nebukadnezar ngɛ matsɛ yee ɔ, jeha enyɔne ɔ mi ɔ, e nla nlami ko. Nlami nɛ ɔ wo e he gbeye wawɛɛ nitsɛ, nɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ba pee dekla ha lɛ, nɛ e ha we nɛ matsɛ ɔ nɛ hwɔ mahe. 2 Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, e tsɔ ya kpee womi mi leli ɔmɛ, klaali ɔmɛ, kunya yeli ɔmɛ, kɛ nyɔhiɔ mi hyɛli ɔmɛ kɛ ba, konɛ a ba tsɔɔ lɛ e nlami ɔ sisi. Kɛkɛ nɛ a ba nɛ a ba da si ngɛ matsɛ ɔ hɛ mi, 3nɛ e de mɛ ke, “I nla nlami ko, nɛ nlami nɛ ɔ wo ye he gbeye wawɛɛ nitsɛ. I suɔ nɛ ma le nlami ɔ sisi.”
4Nyɔhiɔ mi hyɛli ɔmɛ kɛ matsɛ ɔ tu munyu ngɛ Aram gbi mi ke, “Nɛnɛ, o yi nɛ na wami kɛ ya neneene! Wa kpa mo pɛɛ, moo sɛɛ o nlami ɔ ha wɔ, konɛ waa tsɔɔ mo sisi.”
5Matsɛ ɔ he nɔ ke, “Bɔ nɛ i to ye yi mi, nɛ́ i be tsakee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. Nlami nɛ i nla a, nyɛ lɛ nyɛ maa sɛɛ ha mi, nɛ nyɛ nɔuu nyɛ maa tsɔɔ sisi. Ke nyɛ nyɛ we nɛ nyɛɛ pee ja a, ma ha a ma tsɔtslɔɔ nyɛ mi kpɔ nya kpɔ nya, nɛ nyɛ we ɔmɛ maa pee we dokuhi. 6Se ke nyɛ sɛɛ nlami ɔ, nɛ nyɛ tsɔɔ sisi ɔ, ma ke nyɛ níhi babauu, nɛ ma wo nyɛ hɛ mi nyami. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ sɛɛ nlami ɔ, nɛ nyɛɛ tsɔɔ mi sisi.”
7A he nɔ ekohu nɛ a de ke, “Nɛnɛ, ke o ma nyɛ maa sɛɛ wɔ nlami ɔ, wɔ hu wa maa tsɔɔ mo sisi.”
8Kɛkɛ nɛ matsɛ ɔ de ke, “I na nyɛ juɛmi ɔ momo! Nyɛ ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ mi gblae nɛ nyɛ kɛ puɛ be, ejakaa nyɛ na kaa i muɔ ye yi mi kpɔ, 9kaa ke nyɛ nyɛ we nɛ nyɛɛ tsɔɔ mi nlami ɔ, tue gblami kake ma ha nyɛ tsuo. Nyɛ so kaa nyɛ maa ye mi lakpa hluu kaa alini níhi ma tsake. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ sɛɛ mi nlami ɔ. Ke nyɛ pee ja a, kɛkɛ imi hu ma le kaa nyɛ ma nyɛ maa tsɔɔ mi sisi.”
10Nyɔhiɔ mi hyɛli ɔmɛ he nɔ ke, “Nɛnɛ, nɔ́ nɛ o ngɛ hlae nɛ o le nɛ ɔ, nɔ ko nɔ ko be je nɛ ɔ mi nɛ ma nyɛ maa tsɔɔ mo. Matsɛ ko matsɛ ko hu de we e womi mi leli, aloo klaali, aloo kunya yeli hyɛ ke a tsu kikɛmɛ a nɔ́ ko ha lɛ, matsɛ wayo jio, matsɛ ngua jio. 11Nɔ́ nɛ nɛnɛ ngɛ bie ɔ, nɔ́ ɔ he wa wawɛɛ nitsɛ. Nɔ ko nɔ ko be nyɛe maa pee ha mo, ja mawu ɔmɛ pɛ. Nɛ mawu ɔmɛ hu tsa pi a hi he ji nimli adesahi a kpɛti.”
12Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ wo matsɛ ɔ mi mi la wawɛɛ nitsɛ, nɛ e fa ke a gbe ní leli ɔmɛ tsuo ngɛ Babilon. 13Kɛkɛ nɛ a fa ke a ya nuu ní leli ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ a gbe mɛ. Daniel kɛ e huɛmɛ ɔmɛ hu piɛ he.
Mawu tsɔɔ Daniel nlami ɔ sisi
14Daniel ho ya na Ariok, matsɛ tabo ɔ we asafoatsɛ ɔ nɛ a fa lɛ ke e ya gbe ni ɔmɛ ɔ. Daniel kɛ he si bami, kɛ ga 15bi Ariok nɔ́ nɛ he je nɛ matsɛ ɔ wo mlaa nɛ he wa kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ. Kɛkɛ nɛ Ariok ba je munyu ɔ kpo.
16Amlɔ nɔuu ɔ, Daniel ho ya kpa matsɛ ɔ pɛɛ nɛ e de lɛ ke e ha lɛ be bɔɔ, konɛ e ba tsɔɔ lɛ nlami nɛ e nla a sisi. 17Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, Daniel ho we mi ya nɛ e ya bɔ e huɛmɛ ɔmɛ amaniɛ. Mɛ ji Hanania, Mishael kɛ Azaria. 18E de mɛ ke a fa kue ha Mawu nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ, konɛ e na mɛ mɔbɔ nɛ e je laami sane nɛ ɔ kpo ngɔ tsɔɔ mɛ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ a ko gbe mɛ, kɛ Babilon ga woli kpa amɛ hulɔ. 19Jamɛ a nyɔ ɔ mi nɔuu ɔ, a je laami sane ɔ kpo ngɔ tsɔɔ Daniel ngɛ nina mi, nɛ e je Mawu nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ yi.
20Daniel de ke,
“A je Mawu yi kɛ ya neneene,
ejakaa ní lelɔ ji lɛ,
nɛ e ngɛ he wami hulɔ.
21Lɛ nɛ e haa be, kɛ yi nɔhi baa;
e woɔ matsɛ, nɛ e kpaa matsɛ;
lɛ nɛ e haa nɔ nile
kɛ nɔ́ sisi numi.
22Níhi nɛ a ngɔ kɛ laa,
nɛ nɔmlɔ adesa juɛmi sui he ɔ,
Mawu jeɔ mɛ kpo;
e le níhi nɛ a ngɔ kɛ laa ngɛ diblii mi;
lɛ nitsɛ lɛɛ la bɔle lɛ.
23Ye nɛmɛ a Mawu,
i ngɛ mo si nae, nɛ i ngɛ o yi jee.
O ha mi nile kɛ he wami;
o bu wa kue fami ɔ tue;
nɛ o tsɔɔ mi nɔ́ nɛ wa ma de matsɛ ɔ.”
Daniel sɛɛ nlami ɔ ngɔ ha matsɛ ɔ, nɛ e tsɔɔ sisi
24Kɛkɛ nɛ Daniel ya Ariok ngɔ nɛ e ya de lɛ ke, “Koo gbe Babilon ga woli ɔmɛ. Ngɔɔ mi kɛ ya matsɛ ɔ ngɔ nɛ ma tsɔɔ lɛ nlami ɔ sisi.” (Ariok ji nɔ nɛ matsɛ ɔ fa ke e gbe matsɛ ga woli ɔmɛ ɔ nɛ.)
25Ariok ngɔ Daniel kɛ ho Matsɛ Nebukadnezar ngɔ ya amlɔ nɔuu, nɛ e ya de matsɛ ɔ ke, “Nɛnɛ, i ya na nyumu ko ngɛ nihi nɛ a nuu kɛ je Yuda kɛ ba a a kpɛti nɛ ma nyɛ maa tsɔɔ mo o nlami ɔ sisi.”
26Matsɛ ɔ bi Daniel, nɛ a wo lɛ biɛ kpa ke Belteshazar a ke, “Anɛ o ma nyɛ maa tsɔɔ mi nlami nɛ i nla a, kɛ nlami ɔ sisi lo?”
27Daniel he nɔ ke, “Nɛnɛ, laami sane nɛ o bi nɛ ɔ, ní lelɔ, aloo klaalɔ, aloo kunya yelɔ, aloo nyɔhiɔ mi hyɛlɔ ko be nɛ ma nyɛ maa tsɔɔ mo. 28Se Mawu ko ngɛ hiɔwe nɛ jeɔ laami sanehi kpo ngɔ tsɔɔ. Mawu nɛ ɔ ji nɔ nɛ je ngɔ tsɔɔ mo Matsɛ Nebukadnezar ngɛ nlami mi, nɔ́ nɛ maa ba hwɔɔ se ɔ nɛ. Nlami nɛ o nla, kɛ nina nɛ o na, benɛ o hwɔ mahe ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
29“Nɛnɛ, benɛ o hwɔɔ si ɔ, o nla nɔ́ ko nɛ maa ba hwɔɔ se. Mawu nɛ jeɔ laami sanehi ngɔ tsɔɔ nɔ ɔ, lɛ ji nɔ nɛ ngɛ mo nɔ́ nɛ maa ba hwɔɔ se dee ɔ nɛ. 30Imi lɛɛ tsa pi ní nɛ i le tsɔ pe nɔ ko he je nɛ a je nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ngɔ tsɔɔ mi. A pee nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ nlami nɛ o nla nɛ wo o he gbeye ɔ, a tsɔɔ mo nɛ o nu sisi.
31“Nɛnɛ, o nla nɛ o na amaga kpetekpleenyɛ ko nɛ daa si ngɛ o hɛ mi. Amaga nɛ ɔ ngɛ kpɛe nylamnylam, nɛ e he ngɛ gbeye kaa nɔ́ ko. 32Amaga nɛ ɔ yi ɔ, sika tsu ngmingmiingmi a kɛ pee; e gugue kɛ e kɔnihi lɛɛ sika hiɔ a kɛ pee; a kɛ akɔblee pee e mlɛ mi kɛ e fiɔhi; 33a kɛ dade pee e nane tsohi; e nanewɛɛ lɛɛ a kɛ dade pee fa, nɛ fa nɛ piɛ ɔ hu a kɛ zu pee. 34Benɛ o ngɛ amaga a hyɛe kɛ mwɔɔ ɔ, tɛ agbo ko nɛ nɔ ko nine sɛ he, hia kɛ je yo ɔ mi ba fia amaga a nanewɛɛhi nɛ a kɛ dade kɛ zu pee ɔ. 35Amlɔ ɔ, dade ɔ, zu ɔ, akɔblee ɔ, sika hiɔ ɔ, kɛ sika tsu ɔ tsuo ywia wɔtsɔwɔtsɔ, nɛ a pee kaa bunyuku nɛ pueɔ si ngɛ ngma mi sami he ngɛ latsa be mi. Kɛkɛ nɛ kɔɔhiɔ ba muɔ mɛ kɛ je, nɛ a nɛ mɛ ngɛ he ko he ko hu. Se tɛ ɔ nɛ ba fia amaga a lɛɛ e ba pee yo agbo nɛ ha je ɔ mi tsuo.
36“Nɛnɛ, nlami ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. Jehanɛ, ma tsɔɔ mo nlami ɔ sisi. 37Nɛnɛ, mo ji matsɛ nɛ pe matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsuo. Mawu nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ wo mo matsɛ, nɛ e ha mo he wami, agboje, kɛ hɛ mi nyami. 38Mawu ngɔ nimli adesahi ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi tsuo, pu mi lohwehi, kɛ we mi lohwehi ngɔ wo o dɛ nɛ o ye a nɔ. Mo ji jamɛ yi nɛ a kɛ sika tsu pee ɔ nɛ. 39O se ɔ, matsɛ yemi kpa maa ba, se jamɛ a matsɛ yemi ɔ, kɛ o nɔ́ ɔ be sɔe. Matsɛ yemi etɛne maa ba ngɛ lɔ ɔ se. Lɛ ji amaga a mlɛ mi ɔ nɛ a kɛ akɔblee pee ɔ nɛ, nɛ e maa ye je ɔ tsuo nɔ. 40Nyagbe ɔ, matsɛ yemi eywiɛne nɛ he wa kaa dade maa ba. Nɛ kaa bɔ nɛ dade ywiaa nɔ́, nɛ e gbɛɛ nɔ́ ngɔ fĩaa a, matsɛ yemi nɛ ɔ maa ywia ní nɛmɛ nɛ nyɛɛ hɛ mi ɔ tsuo, nɛ e maa gbɛ mɛ ngɔ fĩa. 41O na hu kaa amaga a nanewɛɛhi, kɛ nane nguɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, a kɛ zu pee fa, nɛ fa hu a kɛ dade pee. Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ tsɔɔ kaa matsɛ yemi nɛ ɔ mi ma gba. Se kɛ̃ ɔ, e he fa he maa wa kaa dade, ejakaa dade kɛ zu lɛ futu ɔ nɛ. 42Bɔ nɛ a kɛ dade pee nane nguɛ ɔmɛ fa, nɛ a kɛ zu pee fa hu ɔ, tsɔɔ kaa matsɛ yemi nɛ ɔ he fa mi maa wa kaa dade, nɛ he fa hu ma gbɔjɔ kaa zu. 43Jehanɛ, o na kaa dade ɔ, a kɛ zu nɛ a pɔtɔ futu lɛ. Enɛ ɔ tsɔɔ kaa jamɛ a matsɛ yemi ɔ mi nɔ yeli ɔmɛ ma hla kaa a kɛ a sibi maa sɛ gba si himi mi, konɛ a gu lɔ ɔ peemi mi kɛ pee kake. Se, kaa bɔ nɛ dade kɛ zu hí futumi ɔ, jamɛ a kake peemi ɔ hu be hie. 44Matsɛmɛ nɛ ɔmɛ a yi nɔ ɔ, Mawu nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ maa to matsɛ yemi ko sisi, nɛ e se be poe gblegbleegble. Matsɛ yemi nɛ ɔ, nɔ ko nɔ ko be nyɛe maa ye e nɔ; e ma kpata matsɛ yemi kpa amɛ tsuo a hɛ mi, nɛ e maa hi si kɛ maa ya neneene. 45O na hu kaa tɛ ko hia kɛ je yo ɔ mi nɛ nɔ ko nine sɛ́ he; tɛ nɛ ɔ ba fia amaga a nɛ a kɛ dade, akɔblee, zu, sika hiɔ, kɛ sika tsu pee ɔ. Mawu nɛ kle agbo ɔ je nɔ́ nɛ maa ba hwɔɔ se ɔ kɛ tsɔɔ mo. I sɛɛ nlami ɔ kɛ ha mo kaa bɔ nɛ o nla a sisiisi, nɛ i tsɔɔ mo sisi pɛpɛɛpɛ.”
Matsɛ ɔ julo Daniel
46Kɛkɛ nɛ Matsɛ Nebukadnezar kpla si ngɛ Daniel hɛ mi, nɛ e kɛ e hɛ mi bu si, nɛ e fa ke a sã bɔ kɛ tsopa kɛ e he via kɛ ha Daniel. 47Matsɛ ɔ de Daniel ke, “Niinɛ, o Mawu ɔ kle pe mawu ɔmɛ tsuo; matsɛmɛ a nyɔmtsɛ ji lɛ, nɛ lɛ ji nɔ nɛ jeɔ laami sanehi kpo ngɔ tsɔɔ nɔ. I na le nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, ejakaa o nyɛ́ tsɔɔ mi laami sane nɛ ɔ sisi.” 48Kɛkɛ nɛ matsɛ ɔ ha Daniel blɔ nya agbo, nɛ e ke lɛ ní kpakpahi babauu. E wo lɛ Babilon kpokpa a nɔ nɔ yelɔ, kɛ matsɛ ga woli ɔmɛ tsuo a nɔkɔtɔma. 49Jehanɛ, matsɛ ɔ ngɔ Shadrak, Meshak kɛ Abednego ngɔ to ma ní tsumihi a nya ngɛ Babilon kpokpa a nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ Daniel wo lɛ ga ke e pee ɔ. Se Daniel lɛɛ e tsuɔ ní ngɛ matsɛ we ɔ.

Title: DANIEL 3
Content:
Nebukadnezar fa ke nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ja sika tsu amaga ko
1Be ko ɔ, Matsɛ Nebukadnezar ha nɛ a pee sika tsu amaga ko; amaga a hiɔwe yami ji gugue nyɔngma kɛ enuɔ, nɛ e blimi ji gugue kake kɛ fa. Nebukadnezar ha nɛ a kɛ amaga a ya ma Dura nga kplanaa a nɔ, ngɛ Babilon kpokpa a nɔ. 2Matsɛ Nebukadnezar tsɔ nɛ a ya kpee ma ní tsuli ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ ba. Mɛ ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ: amlaalohi kɛ ganɔhi, wɛtsoyihi kɛ ga woli; sika toli, kojoli, mlaa tsɔɔli, kɛ kpokpa amɛ a nɔ nikɔtɔmahi. A kpee mɛ kɛ ba, konɛ a ba nya amaga a nɛ Matsɛ Nebukadnezar puɛ ngɔ ma si ɔ he. 3Benɛ ma ní tsuli nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ba bua a he nya ngɛ amaga a hɛ mi, konɛ a nya amaga a he ɔ, 4ma fiɛlɔ ko de kɛ ngmlaa ke, “Nyɛ, je ma slɔɔtoslɔɔtohi, kɛ nyɛ nihi nɛ nyɛ tuɔ gbi slɔɔtoslɔɔtohi! Mlaa nɛ matsɛ ɔ wo ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. 5Be tsuaa be nɛ nyɛ maa nu nɛ titimatihi, bɛhi, saku slɔɔtoslɔɔtohi, kɛ miɛ slɔɔtoslɔɔtohi ngɛ pɛe ɔ, nyɛ kpla si nɛ nyɛ ja sika tsu amaga a nɛ Matsɛ Nebukadnezar puɛ ngɔ ma si ɔ. 6Nɔ nɛ be si kplae nɛ e ja amaga nɛ ɔ, a sake lɛ ngɔ fɔ flɔɔnɔɔ kɛ e mi la nɛ ngɛ tsoe gegeege mi.” 7Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, benɛ titimati ɔmɛ, bɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ saku slɔɔtoslɔɔto ɔmɛ bɔni pɛmi, nɛ a pue miɛ slɔɔtoslɔɔto ɔmɛ a nya pɛ je ma amɛ kɛ nihi nɛ tuɔ gbi slɔɔtoslɔɔto ɔmɛ tsuo ya kpla si nɛ a ja sika tsu amaga a nɛ Matsɛ Nebukadnezar puɛ ngɔ ma si ɔ.
A ya po Daniel huɛmɛ etɛ ɔmɛ a nya
8Amlɔ ɔ, Babilonia bi komɛ ba matsɛ ɔ ngɔ nɛ a ba po Yuda bi ɔmɛ a nya. 9A de Matsɛ Nebukadnezar ke, “Nɛnɛ, o yi nɛ na wa kɛ ya neneene! 10Nɛnɛ, mo lɛ o wo mlaa ke nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa nu nɛ titimatihi, bɛhi, saku slɔɔtoslɔɔtohi kɛ miɛ slɔɔtoslɔɔtohi ngɛ pɛe ɔ, e kpla si nɛ e ja sika tsu amaga a. 11O de hu ke nɔ nɛ be si kplae nɛ e ja amaga nɛ ɔ, a sake lɛ ngɔ fɔ flɔɔnɔɔ kɛ e mi la nɛ ngɛ tsoe gegeege mi. 12O ngɔ Yuda bi komɛ ngɔ to ma ní tsumihi a nya ngɛ Babilon kpokpa a nɔ. Mɛ ji Shadrak, Meshak, kɛ Abednego. Nɛnɛ, mlaa a nɛ o wo ɔ, nimli nɛ ɔmɛ yi nɔ; a ja we o mawu ɔmɛ, nɛ sika tsu amaga a nɛ o puɛ ma si ɔ hu, a kpla we si ha lɛ.”
13Matsɛ Nebukadnezar mi mi fu wawɛɛ nitsɛ, nɛ e fa ke a ya ngɔ Shadrak, Meshak, kɛ Abednego kɛ ba. Benɛ a ya ngɔ mɛ kɛ ba a, 14Nebukadnezar bi mɛ ke, “Shadrak, Meshak, kɛ Abednego, anɛ e ngɛ mi niinɛ kaa nyɛ kua ye mawu ɔmɛ jami lo? Anɛ e ngɛ mi niinɛ kaa sika tsu amaga a nɛ i puɛ ngɔ ma si ɔ, nyɛ kua si kplami ha lɛ lo? 15Yoo, nyɛ dla nyɛ he! Titimatihi, bɛhi, saku slɔɔtoslɔɔtohi, kɛ miɛ slɔɔtoslɔɔtohi maa pɛ. Ke nyɛ nu nɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ pɛe pɛ, nyɛ kpla si nɛ nyɛ ja amaga a nɛ i puɛ ɔ. Ke nyɛ pee ja a, e maa hi ha nyɛ. Se ke nyɛ kpla we si nɛ nyɛ ja amaga a, lɛɛ a ma sake nyɛ ngɔ fɔ flɔɔnɔɔ kɛ e mi la nɛ ngɛ tsoe gegeege mi jamɛ a ngmlɛfia a nɔuu. Anɛ nyɛ susu kaa mawu ko ngɛ nɛ ma je nyɛ kɛ je ye dɛ mi lo?”
16Shadrak, Meshak, kɛ Abednego he nɔ nɛ a de matsɛ ɔ ke, “Nɛnɛ Nebukadnezar, e hia we kaa wa ha mo kikɛmɛ a sane nɛ o bi nɛ ɔ heto, nɛ waa ka kaa wa ma fa wa he. 17Mawu nɛ ma nyɛ je wɔ kɛ je flɔɔnɔɔ kɛ e mi la nɛ ngɛ tsoe gegeege ɔ mi ɔ ji Mawu nɛ wa sɔmɔɔ ɔ nɛ; lɛ nɛ e ma je wɔ kɛ je o dɛ mi ɔ nɛ. 18Se ke wa Mawu ɔ nyɛ we nɛ e he wa yi wami tete po, nɛnɛ, na nɛ o le kaa o mawu ɔmɛ lɛɛ wa be jae oo wa be jae! Sika tsu amaga a nɛ o puɛ ngɔ ma si ɔ hu, wa be si kplae ha lɛ!”
A bu Daniel huɛmɛ etɛ ɔmɛ gbenɔ fɔ
19Jehanɛ lɛɛ Nebukadnezar mi mi fu wawɛɛ nitsɛ, nɛ e tu e hɛ mi ngɔ wo Shadrak, Meshak kɛ Abednego. E fa ke a wo flɔɔnɔɔ ɔ mi la nɛ e dɔ si kpaago pe bɔ nɛ e dɔɔ daa a. 20E fa e ta buli ɔmɛ a kpɛti oblai komɛ ke a fi Shadrak, Meshak kɛ Abednego, nɛ a sake mɛ ngɔ pue flɔɔnɔɔ kɛ e mi la nɛ ngɛ tsoe gegeege ɔ mi. 21Kɛkɛ nɛ a fi mɛ kɛ a he sisi tade ɔmɛ, a hiɔwe tade ɔmɛ, a pɛɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ tade kpa amɛ tsuo, nɛ a sake mɛ ngɔ pue flɔɔnɔɔ kɛ e mi la nɛ ngɛ tsoe gegeege ɔ mi. 22Se akɛnɛ matsɛ ɔ fa ke a wo flɔɔnɔɔ ɔ mi la nɛ e dɔ wawɛɛ he je ɔ, la lilɛ ɔmɛ sã nihi nɛ nu Shadrak, Meshak, kɛ Abednego kɛ ya wo flɔɔnɔɔ ɔ mi ɔ, nɛ a gbo. 23Shadrak, Meshak, kɛ Abednego, ni etɛ ɔmɛ ya nɔ flɔɔnɔɔ kɛ e mi la nɛ ngɛ tsoe gegeege ɔ mi kaa bɔ nɛ a fi mɛ ɔ.
24Nɔ́ ko pee Matsɛ Nebukadnezar nyakpɛ, nɛ e te da si amlɔ nɔuu. E bi e ga woli ɔmɛ ke, “Anɛ pi nihi etɛ nɛ wa fi, nɛ wa sake mɛ ngɔ pue la a mi lo?”
A he nɔ ke, “Ee, nɛnɛ, ja wa pee ɔ nɛ.”
25Matsɛ ɔ bi ekohu ke, “Lɛɛ mɛni he je i ngɛ nihi eywiɛ hyɛe nɛ a ngɛ nyɛɛe ngɛ la a mi mɔ? Nimli nɛ i ngɛ hyɛe nɛ ɔ, a fi we mɛ, nɛ pohu la a sɛ̃ mɛ. Jehanɛ, nɔ nɛ piɛ a he nɛ a pee eywiɛ ɔ lɛɛ e ngɛ kaa mawu ko.”
A je Shadrak kɛ Meshak kɛ Abednego
26Kɛkɛ nɛ Nebukadnezar hɛ lɛ kɛ ya flɔɔnɔɔ kɛ e mi la nɛ ngɛ tsoe gegeege ɔ sinya a nya, nɛ e de ke, “Shadrak, Meshak, kɛ Abednego, Mawu nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe lokoo ɔ tsɔli! Nyɛɛ je la a mi esɔ, nɛ nyɛɛ ba hiɛ ɔ!” Kɛkɛ nɛ Shadrak, Meshak kɛ Abednego je la a mi amlɔ kɛ ba. 27Matsɛ ɔ, amlaalo ɔmɛ, ganɔ ɔmɛ, wɛtsoyi ɔmɛ, kɛ ga woli ɔmɛ tsuo ba bua a he nya, konɛ a ba hyɛ ni etɛ nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ la a pee we mɛ nɔ́ ko ɔ. A na kaa a yi bwɔmi ngla we, a tade ɔmɛ sɛ̃ ngɛ a he, nɛ la su ku po ji fu ngɛ a he.
28Kɛkɛ nɛ Nebukadnezar de ke, “A je Shadrak, Meshak kɛ Abednego mɛ a Mawu ɔ yi! E tsɔ e bɔfo ɔ kɛ ba je nimli nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a sɔmɔɔ lɛ, nɛ a ngɔ a hɛ ngɔ fɔ e nɔ ɔ. A kua ye mlaa amɛ a nɔ yemi, nɛ a ngɔ a wami ngɔ ha. A pee enɛ ɔ, ejakaa a sume kaa a ma kpla si nɛ a sɔmɔ mawu kpa ko, pe a Mawu ɔ pɛ.
29“Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i ngɛ mlaa woe ke nihi tsuo nɛ je je ma slɔɔtoslɔɔtohi a nɔ, nɛ tuɔ gbi slɔɔtoslɔɔtohi nɛ maa tu Shadrak, Meshak kɛ Abednegomɛ a Mawu ɔ he munyu yaya ko ɔ, a ma tsɔtslɔɔ a mi kpɔ nya kpɔ nya, nɛ a maa pee e we ɔmɛ we doku hi. Ejakaa mawu kpa ko be nɛ ma nyɛ ma he nɔ yi wami kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ.”
30Kɛkɛ nɛ Matsɛ Nebukadnezar wó Shadrak, Meshak, kɛ Abednegomɛ a nɔ, nɛ e ha mɛ blɔ nya nguahi ngɛ Babilon kpokpa a nɔ.

Title: DANIEL 4
Content:
Nebukadnezar nlami enyɔne
1Matsɛ Nebukadnezar kɛ sɛ gbi nɛ ɔ mane je ma amɛ a nɔ bi, kɛ nihi nɛ tuɔ gbi slɔɔtoslɔɔto ɔmɛ tsuo ke,
“Nyɛ he manye! 2I suɔ kaa ma bɔ nyɛ amaniɛ ngɛ okadihi kɛ nyakpɛ níhi nɛ Mawu nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe lokoo ɔ pee kɛ tsɔɔ mi ɔ a he.
3“Mawu okadi, ɔmɛ kle!
E nyakpɛ ní ɔmɛ a he ngɛ gbeye!
Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene!
Mawu maa ye matsɛ daa.
4“Imi Nebukadnezar, i ngɛ ye mɔ ɔ nɔ ngɛ tue mi jɔmi mi, nɛ i plɔke. 5Se ligbi ko benɛ i hwɔ mahe ɔ, i nla nlami ko, nɛ i na nina ko nɛ wo ye he gbeye. 6I fa ke a ya kpee matsɛ ga woli ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ ngɛ Babilon ɔ kɛ ba, konɛ a ba tsɔɔ mi nlami ɔ sisi. 7Kɛkɛ nɛ womi mi leli ɔmɛ, klaali ɔmɛ, kunya yeli ɔmɛ, kɛ nyɔhiɔ mi hyɛli ɔmɛ ba ye ngɔ, nɛ i bɔ mɛ ye nlami ɔ; se a nyɛ we nɛ a tsɔɔ mi sisi. 8Pee se ɔ, Daniel hu ba (Daniel biɛ kpa ji Belteshazar; ye mawu ɔ biɛ a kɛ wo lɛ ɔ nɛ). Daniel nɛ ɔ, Mawu klɔuklɔu ɔ mumi ɔ ngɛ e mi. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i bɔ lɛ nlami ɔ nɛ i nla a. I de lɛ ke, 9‘Belteshazar, mo klaali a nɔkɔtɔma, i le kaa Mawu klɔuklɔu ɔ mumi ɔ ngɛ o mi, nɛ laami sane ko be nɛ o li. Nlami nɛ i nla ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. Moo tsɔɔ mi sisi.’
10“Benɛ i hwɔ mahe ɔ, i na nina ko. I na nɛ tso ngua ko ba ma si ngɛ zugba a kpɛti. 11Tso ɔ ba wa agbo nɛ e ka gagaa kɛ ya su hiɔwe, nɛ a na lɛ ngɛ je ɔ mi he tsuaa he. 12E ba amɛ ngɛ fɛu, nɛ e wo yiblii kplanyaa nitsɛ, bɔ nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi ɔ maa ye eko. Pu mi lohwehi buu si ngɛ e hɔ ɔ mi; lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ pee tsu ngɛ tso kɔni ɔmɛ a mi, nɛ je nɛ ɔ mi nimlihi, kɛ lohwehi tsuo ba ye e yiblii ɔ.
13“Benɛ i ngɛ nina a he susue ɔ, i na Mawu bɔfo ko nɛ kple si kɛ je hiɔwe kɛ ma. E nɔ tsɔ, nɛ kikɛ nɛ ɔ e hɛngmɛ ngɛ si poe. 14Kɛkɛ nɛ bɔfo ɔ kpa ngmlaa nɛ e de ke, ‘Nyɛɛ hɛ tso ɔ kɛ fɔ si, nɛ́ nyɛ poo tso kɔni ɔmɛ; nyɛ kplɔ ba amɛ, nɛ nyɛ sake tso yiblii ɔmɛ ngɔ pue he. Nyɛɛ fie pu mi lohwe ɔmɛ kɛ je tso ɔ sisi, kɛ lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ ɔmɛ kɛ je tso kɔni ɔmɛ a nɔ. 15Se kɛ̃ ɔ, nyɛ si tso kpoku ɔ kɛ e sipoku ɔmɛ ngɛ zu ɔ mi. Nyɛɛ ngɔ kpa nɛ a kɛ dade kɛ akɔblee pee kɛ fi lɛ, nɛ nyɛ si lɛ ngɛ nga a nɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.
“ ‘Nyɛ ha bɔ́ nɛ nɛ kɛ pue nyumu nɛ ɔ nɔ; e kɛ pu mi lohwehi nɛ hi si, nɛ e kɛ mɛ nɛ ye ní. 16Á tsake e juɛmi ngɔ pee lohwe juɛmi, nɛ e hi si kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ jeha kpaago. 17Mawu bɔfo ɔmɛ nɛ a nɔ tsɔ, nɛ a hɛngmɛhi ngɛ si poe ɔ, bɔ nɛ a de ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nihi tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ nɛ a na nɛ a le kaa Mawu nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe lokoo ɔ ngɛ he wami ngɛ nimli adesahi a matsɛ yemi nɔ, nɛ e ngɔɔ kɛ haa nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ e suɔ, nɔmlɔ ngua jio, nɔmlɔ wayo jio.’
18“Nlami nɛ imi Nebukadnezar, i nla ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. Belteshazar, moo tsɔɔ mi nlami ɔ sisi jehanɛ. Ye ga woli ɔmɛ a ti nɔ ko nɔ ko nyɛ we nɛ e tsɔɔ mi sisi. Se moo lɛɛ o ma nyɛ maa tsɔɔ mi sisi, ejakaa Mawu klɔuklɔu ɔ mumi ɔ ngɛ o mi.”
Daniel tsɔɔ nlami ɔ sisi
19Benɛ Daniel, nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Belteshazar hulɔ ɔ nu munyu nɛ ɔ, e he mi po. E pee dii nɛ e susu e yi mi be saii. Kɛkɛ nɛ matsɛ ɔ de lɛ ke, “Belteshazar, ko ha nɛ nlami ɔ, loo nlami ɔ sisi tsɔɔmi ɔ nɛ hao mo.”
Belteshazar he nɔ ke, “Nɛnɛ, i ná nɛ nlami nɛ ɔ kɛ e sisi tsɔɔmi ɔ kɔɔ o he nyɛli, kɛ nihi nɛ nyɛɛ mo ɔ mohu a he, se pi mo. 20Tso ɔ nɛ o na nɛ ba wa agbo, nɛ e ka gagaa kɛ ya su hiɔwe ɔ, a na lɛ ngɛ je ɔ mi he tsuaa he. 21E ba amɛ ngɛ fɛu, nɛ e wo yiblii kplanyaa nitsɛ, bɔ nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ngɛ je ɔ mi ɔ maa ye eko. Pu mi lohwehi buu si ngɛ e hɔ ɔ mi, nɛ lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ pee tsu ngɛ tso kɔni ɔmɛ a mi.
22“Nɛnɛ, mo ji jamɛ a tso gagaa a nɛ he wa a nɛ. O kle, nɛ o nɔ kuɔ kɛ ya su hiɔwe tɔɔ, nɛ o ngɛ he wami ngɛ je ɔ tsuo nɔ. 23Benɛ mo nɛnɛ, o ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ hyɛe ɔ, bɔfo ko kple si kɛ je hiɔwe, nɛ e ba de ke, ‘Nyɛɛ hɛ tso ɔ kɛ fɔ si, nɛ nyɛ kpata e hɛ mi. Se kɛ̃ ɔ, nyɛ si tso kpoku ɔ ngɛ zu ɔ mi. Nyɛɛ ngɔ kpa nɛ a kɛ dade kɛ akɔblee pee kɛ fi lɛ, nɛ nyɛ si lɛ ngɛ nga a nɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Nyɛ ha bɔ́ nɛ nɛ kɛ pue nyumu nɛ ɔ nɔ, nɛ e kɛ pu mi lohwehi nɛ a hi si, nɛ e kɛ mɛ nɛ ye ní jeha kpaago.’
24“Nɛnɛ, nlami ɔ sisi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ; nɔ́ nɛ Mawu nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe lokoo ɔ to nɛ maa ba o nɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. 25A maa fie mo kɛ je nimlihi a kpɛti, nɛ o kɛ pu mi lohwehi ma ya hi si. O ma kpe nga kaa na, nɛ bɔ́ maa nɛɛ mo jeha kpaago. Jamɛ a be ɔ mi loko o maa le kaa Mawu nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe lokoo ɔ ngɛ he wami ngɛ nimli adesahi a matsɛ yemi nɔ, nɛ e ngɔɔ kɛ haa nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ e suɔ. 26Mawu bɔfo ɔ fa ke a si tso kpoku ɔ ngɛ zu ɔ mi. Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ tsɔɔ kaa ke o kplɛɛ kaa Mawu lɛ yeɔ je ɔ tsuo nɔ ɔ, o ma ba ye matsɛ ekohu. 27Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɛnɛ, moo bu ye ga womi tue. Kpa yayami peemi; moo pee nɔ́ nɛ da, nɛ o na ohiatsɛmɛ mɔbɔ. Ke o pee ja a, o maa ya nɔ ma plɔke.”
28Ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ba Matsɛ Nebukadnezar nɔ. 29Nyɔhiɔ nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ se benɛ e ngɛ si slaae ngɛ e mɔ ɔ yi mi ngɛ Babilon ɔ, 30e de ke, “Nyɛɛ hyɛ bɔ nɛ Babilon kle agbo ha! Imi nitsɛ lɛ i po Babilon, nɛ i kɛ lɛ pee ye matsɛ ma, konɛ ma kɛ tsɔɔ ye he wami kpetekpleenyɛ ye biɛ, ye hɛ mi nyami, kɛ ye agboje.”
31Matsɛ ɔ nya na we nɛ e nɔ si nɛ gbi ko tu munyu kɛ je hiɔwe ke, “Matsɛ Nebukadnezar, bɔ nɛ i ngɛ mo dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ! A kpɔ matsɛ yemi ɔ ngɛ o dɛ. 32A maa fie mo kɛ je nimlihi a kpɛti; o kɛ pu mi lohwehi ma ya hi si, nɛ o ma kpe nga kaa na jeha kpaago. Jamɛ a be ɔ mi loko o maa le kaa Mawu nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe lokoo ɔ ngɛ he wami ngɛ nimli adesahi a matsɛ yemi nɔ, nɛ e ngɔɔ kɛ haa nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ e suɔ.”
33Munyu nɛ ɔ ba mi jamɛ a ngmlɛfia a nɔuu. A fie Nebukadnezar kɛ je nimlihi a kpɛti, nɛ e ya kpe nga kaa na, nɛ e pɔ kɛ bɔ́. E yi hɛ, nɛ e yi bwɔmi pee gagaa kaa kɔle pɛli. E nine nguɛ nya hu hɛ, nɛ e pee gagaa kaa lohwe pɛlitsɛ nane nguɛ nya.
Nebukadnezar je Mawu yi
34Matsɛ Nebukadnezar de ke, “Jeha kpaago ɔ se ɔ, i wo ye yi nɔ nɛ i hyɛ hiɔwe, kɛkɛ nɛ ye juɛmi ɔ kpale kɛ ba ekohu. I je Mawu nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe lokoo ɔ yi, nɛ i wo nɔ nɛ ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene ɔ hɛ mi nyami.
“E maa ye tsɛ kɛ maa ya neneene;
nɛ e matsɛ yemi ɔ maa hi si daa.
35Nimli adesahi tsuo nɛ ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi ɔ,
a pi nɔ́ ko ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi.
E ngɛ he wami ngɛ hiɔwe bɔfohi,
kɛ nimli nɛ ngɛ je ɔ mi ɔ a nɔ.
Nɔ ko nɔ ko be nyɛe maa tsi e nya.
Nɔ ko nɔ ko be nyɛe ma bi lɛ ke,
‘Mɛni o ngɛ pee nɛ ɔ?’
36“Benɛ ye juɛmi ɔ kpale ba a, a ngɔ ye hɛ mi nyami ɔ, ye agboje ɔ, kɛ matsɛ yemi ɔ kɛ ha mi ekohu. Ye ga woli ɔmɛ, kɛ nikɔtɔma amɛ ba hla ye se blɔ, nɛ a ngɔ mi ngɔ hi matsɛ sɛ ɔ nɔ ekohu. Jehanɛ lɛɛ he wami nɛ a ha mi ɔ kle pe kekle nɔ́ ɔ po.
37“Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ imi Nebukadnezar, i ngɛ matsɛ nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ yi jee; i ngɛ e hɛ mi nyami woe, nɛ i ngɛ jajee kaa e kle agbo. E peeɔ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ saminyayoo, nɛ e blɔ ɔmɛ hu da. Nihi nɛ woɔ a he nɔ ɔ, e nyɛɔ baa mɛ si.”

Title: DANIEL 5
Content:
Belshazar tsɛ ma nimeli ní yemi
1Ligbi ko ɔ, Matsɛ Belshazar tsɛ e ma nimeli akpe ní yemi, nɛ e kɛ mɛ nu dã. Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ sɔ wawɛɛ nitsɛ. 2Benɛ dã a tsɛ̃ Belshazar nya a, e fa ke a ya ngɔ sika tsu, kɛ sika hiɔ kplu ɔmɛ nɛ e tsɛ Nebukadnezar ya muɔ ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ mi ngɛ Yerusalem ɔ kɛ ba. E tsɔ ke a ya ngɔ kplu ɔmɛ kɛ ba, konɛ e kɛ e ma nimeli ɔmɛ, e yi ɔmɛ, kɛ e plã amɛ nɛ a nu dã ngɛ a mi. 3Kɛkɛ nɛ a ya ngɔ sika tsu kplu ɔmɛ nɛ a ya muɔ ngɛ Mawu we ɔ ngɛ Yerusalem ɔ kɛ ba. Matsɛ ɔ, ma nimeli ɔmɛ, e yi ɔmɛ, kɛ e plã amɛ tsuo nu dã ngɛ a mi, 4nɛ a je mawuhi nɛ a kɛ sika tsu, sika hiɔ, akɔblee, dade, tso, kɛ tɛ pee ɔ a yi.
5Tlukaa a, nɔmlɔ nine ko je kpo, nɛ e bɔni ní ngmami ngɛ gbogbo nɛ a sa he ɔ he ngɛ matsɛ we ɔ mi. Matsɛ ɔ na nine ɔ nɛ ngɛ ní ɔ ngmae, ejakaa kane la a ngɛ kpɛe saminya ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. 6Matsɛ ɔ hɛ mi tsake amlɔ, nɛ sawale nu lɛ. E kpɔhi a nya tsuo gbɔjɔ, nɛ e nakutsohi bɔni domi ngɛ e sisi. 7Kɛkɛ nɛ e kpa ngmlaa wawɛɛ nɛ e de ke nɔ ko nɛ ya ngɔ kunya yeli ɔmɛ, klaali ɔmɛ, kɛ nyɔhiɔ mi hyɛli ɔmɛ kɛ ba. Benɛ a ba a, matsɛ ɔ de mɛ ke, “Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ma nyɛ maa kane nɔ́ nɛ a ngma nɛ ɔ, nɛ e ma nyɛ maa tsɔɔ mi sisi ɔ, a maa wo lɛ matsɛ tade klɔii nɛ hɛɛ alamua tu su nɛ he jua wa saminya. A kɛ sika tsu kuɛ ní maa wo jamɛatsɛ ɔ kuɛ, nɛ a maa pee lɛ matsɛ se yelɔ ɔ setsɔ.” 8Matsɛ ga woli ɔmɛ tsuo ba, se a ti nɔ ko nyɛ we nɛ e kane nɔ́ nɛ a ngma a; nɔ ko hu nyɛ we nɛ e tsɔɔ sisi. 9Matsɛ Belshazar hao wawɛɛ nitsɛ, nɛ e hɛ mi tsake; e ma nimeli ɔmɛ hu pee yaa.
10Benɛ manyɛ ɔ nu matsɛ ɔ, kɛ ma nimeli ɔmɛ la he ɔ, e ba asa a nɔ he nɛ a ngɛ ní ɔ yee ngɛ ɔ. E de ke, “Nɛnɛ, o yi nɛ na wami kɛ ya neneene! I kpa mo pɛɛ, koo hao, nɛ o tsui ko po. 11Nyumu ko ngɛ o matsɛ yemi he ɔ nɛ Mawu klɔuklɔu ɔ mumi ɔ ngɛ e mi. Benɛ o tsɛ ngɛ matsɛ yee ɔ, a na kaa nyumu nɛ ɔ ngɛ juɛmi kɛ nile, nɛ e hɛ mi hu ka si kaa mawu ɔmɛ pɛ.
