Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, o tsɛ Nebukadnezar wo lɛ nɔkɔtɔma ngɛ womi leli ɔmɛ, klaali ɔmɛ, kunya yeli ɔmɛ, kɛ nyɔhiɔ mi hyɛli ɔmɛ tsuo a nɔ. 12Nyumu nɛ ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Daniel ɔ, a dloo lɛ nike níhi babauu nɛ a pɔɛ nami. E ngɛ juɛmi saminya. E le ní, nɛ e nyɛɔ nɛ e tsɔɔ nlamihi, munyuhi nɛ a he wa, kɛ laami munyuhi a sisi. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, tsɔ nɛ a ya ngɔ Daniel, nɛ matsɛ ɔ wo lɛ Belteshazar a kɛ ba, konɛ e ba tsɔɔ mo nɔ́ nɛ a ngma nɛ ɔ sisi.”
Daniel tsɔɔ nɔ́ nɛ a ngma a sisi
13A ya ngɔ Daniel kɛ ba matsɛ ɔ ngɔ amlɔ nɔuu, nɛ matsɛ ɔ bi lɛ ke, “Anɛ mo ji Daniel ɔ lo? Yuda bi ɔmɛ nɛ tsaatsɛ ya nuu kɛ je Yuda kɛ ba a, a ti nɔ kake ji mo lo? 14I nu kaa Mawu klɔuklɔu ɔ mumi ɔ ngɛ o mi. I nu kaa o ngɛ juɛmi, nɛ o le ní, nɛ o hɛ mi ka si hulɔ. 15A ya ngɔ ní leli kɛ kunya yeli nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ ba hiɛ ɔ, konɛ a ba kane nɔ́ nɛ a ngma nɛ ɔ, nɛ a tsɔɔ mi sisi. Se a nyɛ we nɛ a pee. 16I nu kaa moo lɛɛ o nyɛɔ nɛ o tsɔɔ laami sanehi, kɛ munyuhi nɛ a he wa a sisi. Ke o nyɛ nɛ o kane nɔ́ nɛ a ngma nɛ ɔ, nɛ o nyɛ tsɔɔ mi sisi ɔ, a maa wo mo matsɛ tade klɔii nɛ hɛɛ alamua tu su nɛ he jua wa saminya. A kɛ sika tsu kuɛ ní maa wo o kuɛ, nɛ a maa pee mo matsɛ se yelɔ ɔ setsɔ.”
17Daniel he nɔ ke, “O nike ní ɔmɛ nɛ a hi si. Ke o suɔ ɔ, kɛ ke nɔ kpa. Nɛnɛ, ma kane nɔ́ nɛ a ngma a ha mo, nɛ ma tsɔɔ mo e sisi.
18“Nɛnɛ, Mawu nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe lokoo ɔ pee o tsɛ Nebukadnezar matsɛ ngua, nɛ e ha lɛ he wami kɛ hɛ mi nyami. 19Bɔ nɛ e he wami ɔ kle ha a, je ma amɛ, kɛ nihi nɛ tuɔ gbi slɔɔtoslɔɔto ɔmɛ yeɔ lɛ gbeye; ke a nu e biɛ kɛkɛ sawale nu mɛ. Nɔ́ nɛ e suɔ ɔ, lɔ ɔ e peeɔ. Ke e to kaa e maa gbe nɔ ko ɔ, kɛkɛ e gbe lɛ; ke e to kaa e maa baa nɔ ko yi ɔ, e baa e yi. Ke e to kaa e ma wo nɔ ko nɔ ɔ, kɛkɛ e wo e nɔ; ke e de ke e maa ba nɔ ko si ɔ, kɛkɛ e pee ja. 20Se akɛnɛ e wo e he nɔ, nɛ e wa tue, nɛ e pee yi wu tso níhi he je ɔ, a je lɛ kɛ je e matsɛ sɛ ɔ nɔ, nɛ e hɛ mi nyami ɔ bɔ lɛ. 21A fie lɛ kɛ je nimlihi a kpɛti, nɛ e juɛmi pee kaa pu mi lohwe juɛmi. E ya hi nga mi tejihi a kpɛti. E kpe nga kaa na; e hwɔ pu mi, nɛ bɔ́ nɛɛ lɛ hluu. Nyagbe ɔ, e ba kplɛɛ kaa Hiɔwe No Mawu ɔ ngɛ he wami ngɛ nimli adesahi a matsɛ yemi nɔ, nɛ e ngɔɔ kɛ haa nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ e suɔ.
22“Nɛ mo Belshazar, Nebukadnezar bi, o le ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo; se kɛ̃ ɔ, o bɛ o he si. 23O bui Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ fɛɛ. Kplu ɔmɛ nɛ a ya muɔ ngɛ e we ɔ, o ya ngɔ kɛ ba hiɛ ɔ. O ma nimeli ɔmɛ, o yi ɔmɛ, kɛ o plã amɛ nu dã ngɛ kplu ɔmɛ a mi, nɛ nyɛ je mawuhi nɛ a kɛ sika tsu, sika hiɔ, akɔblee, dade, tso, kɛ tɛ pee ɔ a yi. Mawuhi nɛ a hyɛ we nɔ́, nɛ a nui nɔ́, nɛ a li nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko ɔ, nyɛ je a yi. Se Mawu ɔ nɛ ngɛ he wami ngɛ o nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɔ, nɔ nɛ ke e de ke o gbo, kɛkɛ nɛ o ma gbo, aloo ke e ke o hi je mi, nɛ o yi ma na wami ɔ, jamɛ a Mawu ɔ lɛɛ nyɛ wui e hɛ mi nyami. 24Enɛ ɔ he je nɛ Mawu tsɔ nine nɛ ɔ kɛ ba o ngɔ, konɛ e ba ngma munyu nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ nɛ.
25“Nɔ́ nɛ a ngma a ji, ‘MENE, MENE, TEKEL, kɛ PARSIN’. 26E sisi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: MENE: Mawu kane o matsɛ yemi ligbi ɔmɛ, nɛ e kɛ o matsɛ yemi ɔ ba nyagbe. 27TEKEL: a ngmɛ mo ngɛ sɛni nɔ, nɛ a na kaa o jiɔ we kulaa. 28PARSIN: a dla o matsɛ yemi ɔ mi; a ngɔ fa kɛ ha Media bi, nɛ a kɛ fa hu ha Persia bi.”
29 Kɛkɛ nɛ Belshazar fa e tsɔli ɔmɛ ke a wo Daniel matsɛ tade klɔii nɛ hɛɛ alamua tu su nɛ he jua wa saminya, nɛ a kɛ sika tsu kuɛ ní nɛ wo e kuɛ. Matsɛ ɔ pee Daniel matsɛ se yelɔ ɔ setsɔ. 30Jamɛ a nyɔ ɔ mi nɔuu ɔ, a gbe Belshazar, Babilonia matsɛ ɔ; 31nɛ Media no ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ Darius ɔ ba ngɔ matsɛ yemi ɔ pani nya. Darius ye jeha nyingmi ekpa kɛ enyɔ jamɛ a be ɔ mi.

Title: DANIEL 6
Content:
Daniel ngɛ jatahi a muɔ mi
1Darius dla e matsɛ yemi ɔ mi lafa kɛ nyingmi enyɔ, nɛ e ngɔ amlaalohi ngɔ to nɔ yemi he ɔmɛ kakaaka. 2Darius hla nikɔtɔma etɛ komɛ hulɔ ngɛ amlaalo nɛ ɔmɛ a se; a ti nɔ kake ji Daniel. Nikɔtɔma etɛ nɛ ɔmɛ a ní tsumi ji kaa a hyɛ amlaalo ɔmɛ a nɔ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ matsɛ ɔ nɔ́ ko hɛ mi kó kpata. 3E kɛ we kulaa nɛ Daniel ba je e he kpo kaa nɔmlɔ nɛ kɔni si wa kɛ ní tsumi pe nikɔtɔma kpa amɛ, kɛ amlaalo ɔmɛ tsuo. Akɛnɛ e le ní tsumi saminya he je ɔ, matsɛ ɔ to e yi mi kaa e maa pee lɛ ma ní tsulɔ nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa ngɛ e matsɛ yemi ɔ tsuo mi. 4Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, amlaalo ɔmɛ, kɛ nikɔtɔma enyɔ ɔmɛ bɔ mɔde hla kaa a maa na tɔmi ko ngɛ Daniel ma nɔ yemi ní tsumi ɔ he lo. Se a nɛ nɔ́ ko nɛ a maa da nɔ kɛ po e nya. A nɛ tɔmi ko ngɛ e he; ejakaa e yeɔ anɔkuale, nɛ e pee we nɔ́ nɛ dɛ. 5A de a he ke, “Wa be nɔ́ kpa ko nae nɛ wa maa da nɔ kɛ po Daniel nya, ja nɔ́ ko nɛ kɔɔ e Mawu jami he pɛ.”
6Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, amlaalo ɔmɛ, kɛ nikɔtɔma enyɔ ɔmɛ ba matsɛ ɔ ngɔ, nɛ a ba de lɛ ke, “Nɛnɛ Darius, o yi nɛ na wami kɛ ya neneene! 7Wɔ o ma ní tsuli ɔmɛ tsuo kulaa, nikɔtɔma amɛ, ganɔ ɔmɛ, amlaalo ɔmɛ, ga woli ɔmɛ, kɛ wɛtsoyi ɔmɛ wa ya kpe. Wa ma nya si kaa wa ma de mo nɛnɛ, nɛ o wo mlaa ko, nɛ o hyɛ nɛ a ye nɔ sisiisi. Wo mlaa ke a ko ngmɛ nɔ ko blɔ nɛ e bi yemi kɛ buami ko kɛ je mawu ko, aloo nɔmlɔ adesa ko dɛ kɛ yaa si hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ ligbi nyingmi etɛ. Ke nɔ ko ma bi yemi kɛ buami ko ɔ, e bi kɛ je mo pɛ o dɛ. Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ma tɔ mlaa nɛ ɔ, a sake lɛ kɛ wo jatahi a muɔ mi. 8Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɛnɛ, moo ngma mlaa nɛ ɔ, nɛ o ngɔ o nine kɛ wo sisi. Kɛkɛ ɔ, e pee mlaa, Media bi kɛ Persia bi a mlaa nɛ nɔ ko be nyɛe ma tsake.” 9Kɛkɛ nɛ Matsɛ Darius ngɔ e nine kɛ wo mlaa a sisi. 10Benɛ Daniel nu kaa matsɛ ɔ ngɔ e nine kɛ wo mlaa a sisi ɔ, e je kɛ ho e we mi ya. Daniel ngɛ hiɔwe tsu ko ngɛ e we ɔ mi, nɛ o ma nyɛ maa hyɛ Yerusalem kɛ gu saflɛ ɔmɛ a mi ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Kɛkɛ nɛ Daniel kpla si ngɛ e nakutso nya, ngɛ saflɛ nɛ bli kɛ fɔɔ si ɔ nya, nɛ e sɔle nɛ e na e Mawu ɔ si si etɛ kaa bɔ nɛ e peeɔ daa a.
11Benɛ Daniel he nyɛli ɔmɛ ba e we ɔ mi nɛ a na kaa e ngɛ kue fae ha e Mawu ɔ, 12mɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ a pue nɔ kɛ ho nɛ a ya po e nya ha matsɛ ɔ. A bi lɛ ke, “Nɛnɛ, tse o wo mlaa ko, nɛ o kɛ o nine wo sisi? Anɛ mlaa a tsɔɔ we kaa kɛ yaa si hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ ligbi nyingmi etɛ ɔ, nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ma bi yemi kɛ buami ko kɛ je mawu ko, aloo nɔmlɔ adesa ko dɛ mi, se pi mo ɔ, a sake lɛ kɛ wo jatahi a muɔ mi lo?”
Matsɛ ɔ he nɔ ke, “Ee, i wo jamɛ a mlaa a niinɛ. Media bi kɛ Persia bi a mlaa nɛ a tsakee we ɔ ji jamɛ a mlaa a nɛ.”
13Kɛkɛ nɛ a de matsɛ ɔ ke, “Nyɔguɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a nuu kɛ je Yuda kɛ ba a, a ti nɔ kake nɛ a tsɛɛ Daniel ɔ, lɛɛ e bui mo nɛnɛ; mlaa a nɛ o wo ɔ hu e yi nɔ fɛɛ. E faa kue kɛ haa e Mawu ɔ si etɛ daa ligbi.”
14Benɛ Matsɛ Darius nu munyu nɛ ɔ, e hao wawɛɛ nitsɛ, nɛ e hla kaa e maa gu blɔ ko nɔ nɛ e kɛ he Daniel yi wami. Darius susu nɔ́ nɛ ɔ he hluu kɛ ya si pu ba nɔ si. 15Saii mi ɔ, amlaalo ɔmɛ kɛ nikɔtɔma amɛ kpale ba matsɛ ɔ ngɔ ekohu ba de lɛ ke, “Nɛnɛ, na nɛ o le kaa ngɛ Media bi kɛ Persia bi a mlaa nya a, ke matsɛ wo mlaa ko ɔ, a tsakee we.”
16Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, matsɛ ɔ fa e tsɔli ɔmɛ, nɛ a ya nu Daniel, nɛ a sake lɛ kɛ fɔ jatahi a muɔ mi. Matsɛ Darius de Daniel ke, “O Mawu ɔ nɛ o sɔmɔɔ lɛ daa a, e je mo!” 17Kɛkɛ nɛ a ya ngɔ tɛ kɛ ba fɔ muɔ ɔ nya, nɛ matsɛ ɔ kɛ lɛ nitsɛ e nɔ́ nya sɔumi nɔ́, kɛ e ma nimeli ɔmɛ hu a nɔ́ nya sɔumi nɔ́ sɔu muɔ ɔ nya. A pee nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, konɛ nɔ ko kó ya je Daniel ngɛ muɔ ɔ mi. 18Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, matsɛ ɔ kpale kɛ ho e we ɔ mi ya. E hwɔ we mahe jamɛ a nyɔ ɔ mi tsuo; e ha hwɔ, nɛ e kplɛɛ we kaa a je e hɛja.
19Makɛ ɔ, matsɛ ɔ te si momo, nɛ e pee esɔ kɛ ho jatahi a muɔ ɔ he ya. 20Benɛ e ya su lejɛ ɔ, e kɛ he hiami kpa ngmlaa tsɛ Daniel ke, “Daniel, mo Mawu hɛ kalɔ ɔ tsɔlɔ! Anɛ o Mawu ɔ nɛ o sɔmɔɔ lɛ daa a nyɛ́ je mo kɛ je jata amɛ a dɛ mi lo?”
21Daniel he nɔ ke, “Nɛnɛ, o yi nɛ na wami kɛ ya neneene! 22Ye Mawu ɔ tsɔ e bɔfo ɔ, nɛ e ba má jata amɛ a nya, nɛ a yi mi awi. Mawu pee nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, ejakaa e le kaa i pee we nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko nɛ dɛ; e le kaa mo nɛnɛ hu, i tɔ we o nɔ.”
23Matsɛ ɔ bua jɔ e he wawɛɛ nitsɛ, nɛ e fa ke a je Daniel kɛ je muɔ ɔ mi. Tsɔli ɔmɛ pee ja. Benɛ a je lɛ kɛ je jata amɛ a muɔ ɔ mi ɔ, a nɛ kaa e he ko plaa; ejakaa e ngɔ e hɛ ngɔ fɔ e Mawu ɔ nɔ. 24Jehanɛ lɛɛ matsɛ ɔ ha a ya nuu ni ɔmɛ nɛ ba po Daniel nya a kɛ ba. A sake mɛ kɛ wo jatahi a muɔ ɔ mi; mɛ kɛ a yihi, kɛ a bimɛ tsuo. Be nɛ a na we nɛ a su muɔ ɔ sisi tete ɔ, jata amɛ yu a nɔ, nɛ a ku a wuhi tsuo dukuduku.
25Pee se ɔ, Matsɛ Darius ngma womi ya ha je ma amɛ, kɛ nihi nɛ tuɔ gbi slɔɔtoslɔɔto ɔmɛ tsuo ngɛ je ɔ mi ke, “Nyɛ he manye! 26I ngɛ mlaa woe ke nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ye Daniel Mawu ɔ gbeye, nɛ e bu lɛ ngɛ ye matsɛ yemi he ɔ tsuo.
“Mawu hɛ kalɔ ji lɛ,
nɛ e ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene.
E matsɛ yemi ɔ hɛ mi be kpatae kɔkɔɔkɔ,
nɛ e he wami ɔ se be poe gblegbleegble.
27E jeɔ e ma a kɛ jeɔ haomi mi;
e heɔ e ma a yi wami.
E peeɔ okadihi kɛ nyakpɛ níhi
ngɛ hiɔwe kɛ zugba a nɔ.
E je Daniel kɛ je jatahi a dɛ mi,
nɛ a nyɛ we nɛ a gbe lɛ.”
28Daniel plɔke, nɛ e ya nɔ saminya ngɛ Darius, kɛ Persia matsɛ, Sirus a yi nɔ.

Title: DANIEL 7
Content:
DANIEL SƐƐ E NI NAMI ƆMƐ A HE NI
(7.1—12.13)
Pu mi lohwe eywiɛ ɔmɛ
1Babilon matsɛ, Belshazar yi nɔ, kekleekle jeha a mi ɔ, i nla, nɛ i na nina ko nyɔ mi. I ngma nlami ɔ ngɔ wo womi mi. Nina nɛ i na jamɛ a nyɔ ɔ mi ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. 2I na nɛ wo nɔ kɔɔhiɔ nɛ nya wa te ngɛ wo ɔ nɔ, nɛ kɔɔhiɔ ngɛ fiae kɛ je he tsuaa he. 3 Tlukaa a, lohwe nguangua munomuno eywiɛ je wo ɔ mi kɛ ba. 4 Kekleekle lohwe ɔ ngɛ kaa jata, se e pɛlihi lɛɛ a ngɛ kaa kɔle pɛlihi. Benɛ i ngɛ lɛ hyɛe kɛ mwɔɔ ɔ, a ba kplɔ e pɛli ɔmɛ ngɛ e he. Jehanɛ, a wo lohwe ɔ nɔ ngɛ zugba; a kɛ lɛ da si ngɛ e nanehi a nɔ kaa nɔmlɔ, nɛ a ha lɛ nɔmlɔ juɛmi.
5Lohwe enyɔne ɔ ngɛ kaa osisiblisi nɛ daa si ngɛ e se nane enyɔ ɔmɛ a nɔ. Kasa wu etɛ ngɛ e lungu kpɛ ngɛ e nya mi. Kɛkɛ nɛ gbi ko de lɛ ke, “Tee si, nɛ o ye lo bɔ nɛ o ma nyɛ!”
6Benɛ i ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ hyɛe ɔ, lohwe kpa ko hu ba hia si. Lohwe nɛ ɔ lɛɛ e ngɛ kaa ngatsɛ, se pɛli eywiɛ ngɛ e se mi kaa lohwe pɛlitsɛ. E ngɛ yi eywiɛ, nɛ ke o hyɛ lɛ ɔ, e ngɛ kaa nɔ ko nɛ hɛɛ blɔ nya nguaa ko.
7 Benɛ i ngɛ lɛ hyɛe ɔ, lohwe eywiɛne ba hia si. Lohwe nɛ ɔ he ngɛ gbeye kɛ nyakpɛ, nɛ e ngɛ he wami saminya. E kɛ e dade lungu vamvam ɔmɛ tsɔtslɔɔ lohwehi a mi kpɔ nya kpɔ nya nɛ e yeɔ. Ní nɛmɛ nɛ piɛ ɔ lɛɛ e naa a nɔ. Slo lɛ ngɛ lohwe ɔmɛ nɛ nyɛɛ e hɛ mi ɔ a he; lohwe nɛ ɔ lɛɛ e ngɛ koli nyɔngma. 8 Benɛ i ngɛ koli ɔmɛ hyɛe kɛ mwɔɔ ɔ, tlukaa a, koli wayo ko ba hia kpo ngɛ koli ɔmɛ a kpɛti. Koli wayo nɛ ɔ hia kolihi nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ momo ɔ etɛ kɛ pue si. Nɔmlɔ adesa hɛngmɛhi ngɛ koli wayo nɛ ɔ he, kɛ nya hu nɛ ngɛ munyu tue putɛputɛɛ.
Nɔ nɛ ngɛ daa a
9 Benɛ i ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ hyɛe kɛ mwɔɔ ɔ, a kɛ matsɛ sɛhi ba ma si, nɛ nɔ nɛ ngɛ daa a ba hi si ngɛ kake nɔ. E tade hiɛ futaa kaa snoo, nɛ e yi bwɔmi ngɛ kaa to he bwɔmi ngmingmiingmi. E matsɛ sɛ ɔ, kɛ tlɔɔke nane ɔ nɛ sɛ ɔ maa si ngɛ nɔ ɔ tsuo ngɛ tsoe gegeege. 10 La ngɛ tsoe gegeege ngɛ e hɛ mi kaa pa nɛ hia kɛ bee. Nihi akpeakpehi ngɛ lejɛ ɔ ngɛ lɛ sɔmɔe, nɛ akpe nyɔngma totoe akpe nyɔngma daa si ngɛ e hɛ mi. Kojoli ɔmɛ ba hi si, nɛ a bli womi ɔmɛ a nya.
11Benɛ i ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ hyɛe ɔ, i nu nɛ koli nyafii ɔ ngɛ munyu tue putɛputɛɛ kɛ mwɔɔ. Tlukaa a, a gbe lohwe eywiɛne ɔ; a tsɔtslɔɔ e mi, nɛ a sake lɛ ngɔ fɔ la a mi. 12Lohwe ɔmɛ nɛ piɛ ɔ, a kpɔ a he wami ɔ ngɛ a dɛ, se a ngmɛ mɛ blɔ nɛ a hi je mi kɛ ya si be ko.
13 Enɛ ɔ se, nyɔ mi benɛ i ngɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ hyɛe kɛ mwɔɔ ɔ, i na nɔ́ ko kaa nɔmlɔ adesa nɛ nyɛɛ bɔku mi kɛ ma ye ngɔ. E be kɛ ho nɔ nɛ ngɛ daa a ngɔ ya, nɛ a kɛ lɛ tsɔɔ nɔ nɛ ngɛ daa a. 14 A ngɔ he wami, hɛ mi nyami, kɛ matsɛ yemi ngɔ wo e dɛ, konɛ je ma amɛ, kɛ nihi nɛ tuɔ gbi slɔɔtoslɔɔto ɔmɛ nɛ a sɔmɔ lɛ. E he wami ɔ maa hi si kɛ maa ya neneene, nɛ e matsɛ yemi ɔ se be poe gblegbleegble.
A tsɔɔ nina amɛ a sisi
15Nina amɛ nɛ i na a wo ye he gbeye, nɛ i hao wawɛɛ nitsɛ. 16I ho ya na ni nɛmɛ nɛ daa si ngɛ lejɛ ɔ a ti nɔ kake, nɛ i de lɛ ke e tsɔɔ mi ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a sisi. Nɛ e pee ja. 17E de mi ke, “Lohwe agboagbo eywiɛ nɛ ɔmɛ ji matsɛmɛ eywiɛ komɛ nɛ ma ba te si ngɛ je ɔ mi. 18 Se nyagbe ɔ, Hiɔwe No ɔ we ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ a nine maa su matsɛ yemi ɔ nɔ, nɛ a maa ye matsɛ kɛ maa ya neneene.”
19I bi lohwe eywiɛne ɔ he sane pɔtɛɛ. Slo lohwe nɛ ɔ ngɛ ekpa amɛ tsuo a he; lɛɛ e he ngɛ gbeye saminya. Lohwe nɛ ɔ kɛ e dade lungu ɔmɛ, kɛ akɔblee nguɛ ɔmɛ tsɔtslɔɔ lohwehi a mi kpɔ nya kpɔ nya nɛ e yeɔ, nɛ ní nɛmɛ nɛ piɛ ɔ lɛɛ e naa a nɔ. 20Jehanɛ, i bi koli nyɔngma amɛ nɛ ngɛ lohwe ɔ yi mi ɔ a he sane. Koli kaketsɛ ɔ nɛ ba pee se, nɛ ha nɛ koli etɛ ɔmɛ hia pue si ɔ, lɛ hu i bi he sane. Koli nɛ ɔ ngɛ hɛngmɛhi, kɛ nya nɛ e ngɛ munyu tue putɛputɛɛ. E he ngɛ gbeye pe koli ɔmɛ tsuo.
21 I na nɛ jamɛ a koli ɔ kɛ ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ hwu ta, nɛ e ye a nɔ kunimi. 22 Pee se ɔ, nɔ nɛ ngɛ daa a ba, nɛ e ba wo Hiɔwe No ɔ we ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ nguɔ. Be ba su nɛ Mawu ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ a nine ba su matsɛ yemi ɔ nɔ.
23Bɔ nɛ a tsɔɔ mi enɛ ɔ sisi ha ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Lohwe eywiɛne ɔ ji matsɛ yemi eywiɛne ko nɛ maa ba je ɔ mi; e maa slo lɛ ngɛ matsɛ yemi kpa amɛ a he. E ma kpata je ɔ tsuo hɛ mi, nɛ e maa naa e nɔ. 24 Koli nyɔngma amɛ ji matsɛmɛ nyɔngma komɛ nɛ ma ba te si ngɛ jamɛ a matsɛ yemi ɔ mi. A se ɔ, matsɛ kpa ko maa te si; e maa slo lɛ ngɛ kekleekle ni ɔmɛ a he, nɛ e ma kpata matsɛmɛ etɛ a hɛ mi. 25 E maa tu munyu ngɔ si Hiɔwe No ɔ, nɛ e maa wa ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ yi mi. E ma hla kaa e tsake a Mawu jami mlaa amɛ, kɛ a nyami be ɔmɛ; nɛ a maa ngɔ ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ kɛ wo e dɛ jeha etɛ kɛ fa. 26Pee se ɔ, kojoli ɔmɛ ma ba kojo; a maa ngɔ he wami ɔ ngɛ e dɛ, nɛ a ma kpata e hɛ mi kɛ gbe nya. 27 A maa ngɔ matsɛ yemihi tsuo nɛ ngɛ je ɔ mi ɔ a he wami, kɛ agboje ngɔ ha Hiɔwe No ɔ we ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ a ma a. A matsɛ yemi ɔ se be poe gblegbleegble, nɛ je nɛ ɔ mi matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ma sɔmɔ mɛ, nɛ a maa bu mɛ tue.”
28Ye sane ɔ nyagbe ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. Se imi Daniel lɛɛ ye tsui po wawɛɛ nitsɛ, nɛ i hao. I ngɔ sane nɛ ɔ kɛ to ye yi mi, nɛ i de we nɔ ko nɔ ko.

Title: DANIEL 8
Content:
Agbosu ɔ kɛ to akpakpo ɔ
1Matsɛ Belshazar yi nɔ jeha etɛne ɔ mi ɔ, i na nina nɔ́ nɛ ji enyɔ. 2I na nɛ i ya je ma a nɛ a fia gbogbo ngɔ wo he nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Susa a tlukaa. Ma nɛ ɔ ngɛ Elam kpokpa a nɔ. I daa si ngɛ Ulai pa a nya. 3Benɛ ma hyɛ ɔ, agbosu ko kɛ e yi mi koli enyɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ daa si ngɛ pa a tue. Koli ɔmɛ ka gagaaga, se kake ka pe kake, nɛ nɔ́ nɛ ka a kpɛ se kɛ ba. 4I na nɛ agbosu ɔ ngɔ e koli ɔmɛ kɛ ngɛ lohwehi hɛɛe ngɛ e blɔ mi, kɛ je bonyoku, omleyi, kɛ leneyi je. Lohwe ko lohwe ko nyɛ we lɛ, loo e kpɔ e he kɛ je e dɛ mi. Agbosu ɔ bui nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko; nɔ́ nɛ e suɔ nɛ e peeɔ.
5Benɛ i ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ he susue ɔ, tlukaa a, to akpakpo ko ji nɛ ɔ nɛ je bonyoku je kɛ ma kɛ fo nɛ mi wa wawɛɛ nitsɛ. To ɔ ngɛ fo tue wawɛɛ mohu, se e nane mɛ zugba. Jehanɛ hu, koli agbo ko ngɛ e hɛngmɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ a kpɛti. 6To akpakpo ɔ ba su agbosu kɛ e koli enyɔ ɔ he, nɛ e kɛ e he wami tsuo ba hɛ lɛ. Agbosu nɛ ɔ lɛ i na nɛ daa si ngɛ pa a tue ɔ nɛ. 7I na nɛ to akpakpo ɔ ba tua agbosu ɔ. Akpakpo ɔ mi mi fu wawɛɛ nitsɛ, nɛ benɛ e hɛ agbosu ɔ, e ku e koli enyɔ ɔmɛ. Agbosu ɔ he wami ba ta, nɛ e nyɛ we akpakpo ɔ. Akpakpo ɔ tsɛ̃ lɛ ngɔ fɔ zugba, nɛ e naa e nɔ, nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko nyɛ we nɛ e kpɔ agbosu ɔ ngɛ e dɛ.
8Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, to akpakpo ɔ ba wo e he nɔ wawɛɛ nitsɛ, nɛ e bui nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko. Se benɛ e he wami ɔ ba he si ɔ, e koli ɔ ku. Kɛkɛ nɛ koli agboagbo eywiɛ ba puɛ ngɛ lɔ ɔ nane mi; koli ɔmɛ plɛ a nyahi ngɔ kpee he munomunohi. 9Koli nyafii ko puɛ kɛ je koli eywiɛ ɔmɛ a ti kake mi. E he wami ɔ ya su leneyi je, kɛ beleku je, kɛ zugba a nɛ a wo he si ɔ nɔ. 10 E he wami ɔ ba pue nɔ; e kɛ hiɔwe tabo nɛ ji dodoe ɔmɛ nitsɛnitsɛ hwu ta, nɛ e hɛ ekomɛ ngɔ pue zugba, nɛ e naa a nɔ. 11Hiɔwe tabo ɔ ganɔ ɔ nitsɛ po, koli nɛ ɔ bui lɛ fɛɛ. Daa ligbi bɔ nɛ a sãã ngɔ haa lɛ ɔ, koli nɛ ɔ tsi nya. Yawɛ we ɔ hu, koli ɔ ble lejɛ ɔ. 12A pee yayamihi babauu ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ. A kpa daa ligbi bɔ sami ɔ, nɛ a sake anɔkuale jami ɔ kɛ fɔ he. Koli ɔ ye manye ngɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ mi.
13Kɛkɛ nɛ i nu nɛ bɔfohi enyɔ ngɛ ní sɛɛe. Bɔfo ɔ kake bi e nyɛmi ɔ ke, “Nina nɛ ɔ, mɛni be e maa hi si kɛ yaa si? Hiɔwe tabo ɔ, kɛ Yawɛ we ɔ, mɛni be a maa naa a nɔ kɛ yaa si?”
14I nu nɛ kaketsɛ ɔ ha lɛ heto ke, “Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ maa ya nɔ ligbi akpe kɛ e nya lafa etɛ sɔuu. Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, a be mɔtu kɛ gbɔkuɛ bɔhi sãe. Lɔ ɔ se loko a ma bɔni ní tsumi ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ ekohu kaa sa a.”
Bɔfo Gabriel tsɔɔ nina a sisi
15Benɛ i ngɛ mɔde bɔe kaa ma hla nina a sisi ɔ, tlukaa a, nɔ ko ji nɛ ɔ nɛ ba daa si ngɛ ye hɛ mi. 16 I nu nɛ nɔ ko tu munyu ngɛ Ulai pa a mi ke, “Gabriel, tsɔɔ nyumu ɔ nina a sisi.” 17Kɛkɛ nɛ Gabriel ba da si ngɛ ye kasa nya. Benɛ e ba a, ye tsui po, nɛ i kɛ ye hɛ mi bu si.
Gabriel de mi ke, “Nɔmlɔ adesa, na nɛ o le kaa nina a kɔɔ je mi nyagbe he.” 18Benɛ e kɛ mi ngɛ munyu ɔ tue ɔ, i sɛ diblii mi, nɛ i kɛ ye hɛ mi bu si. Se e fua mi, nɛ e wo ye nɔ kɛ da si ngɛ he nɛ i ngɛ ɔ. 19E de mi ke, “Ke Mawu mi mi fu ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ maa nyɛɛ se ɔ, lɔ ɔ ma tsɔɔ mo nɛ ɔ nɛ. Nina a kɔɔ nyagbe be ɔ he.
20“Agbosu koli enyɔtsɛ ɔ nɛ o na a daa si ha Media kɛ Persia matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ. 21To akpakpo ɔ daa si ha Hela matsɛ ɔ, nɛ koli agbo ɔ nɛ ngɛ e hɛngmɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ a kpɛti ɔ ji kekleekle matsɛ ɔ nɛ. 22Jehanɛ, koli eywiɛ ɔmɛ nɛ ba benɛ kaketsɛ ɔ ku ɔ daa si ha matsɛmɛ eywiɛ komɛ nɛ maa je Hela nɔ yemi ɔ mi kɛ ba. Se a ti nɔ ko nɔ ko kɛ kekleekle nɔ ɔ be sɔe.
23“Ke matsɛ yemi nɛ ɔmɛ a nyagbe be ɔ su ta, nɛ a yayami ɔ mi ba wa bɔ nɛ e sa kaa a gbla a tue ɔ, matsɛ ko ma ba te si. Matsɛ nɛ ɔ maa pee yiwutsotsɛ kɛ nɔ sisilɔ nɛ maa wa tue. 24E ma kpata níhi a hɛ mi basabasa, nɛ e maa ye manye ngɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ peemi mi. Je ma nguanguahi, kɛ ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ a nitsɛ e ma a hu, e ma kpata a hɛ mi. He wami nɛ e kɛ ma tsu ní nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, pi lɛ nitsɛ e he wami. 25E maa to ga kɛ sisi nihi babauu. E ma wo e he nɔ, nɛ e ma kpata nihi babauu a hɛ mi be mi nɛ a hɛ be a he nɔ. Ganɔhi a ganɔ ɔ nitsɛ po, e maa te si ngɔ wo lɛ. Se a ma kpata e hɛ mi; nɛ tsa pi nɔmlɔ adesa he wami nɛ ma tsu nɔ́ nɛ ɔ. 26Nina a nɛ kɔɔ gbɔkuɛ kɛ mɔtu bɔ sami ɔmɛ a he nɛ a tsɔɔ mo sisi ɔ maa ba mi. Se amlɔ nɛ ɔ, ngɔɔ kɛ to o yi mi; ejakaa e maa ye be saii loko e maa ba mi.”
27Imi Daniel ɔ, ye he mi po, nɛ i nu hiɔ ligbi babauu. Pee se ɔ, i te si nɛ i ho ya tsu ní tsumi nɛ matsɛ ɔ ha mi ke ma tsu ɔ. Se kɛ̃ ɔ, nina a gba ye juɛmi nya, nɛ i nui sisi.

Title: DANIEL 9
Content:
Daniel fa kue ha Mawu kɛ ha e ma a
1Ahasuerus bi Darius, Media no ɔ ye matsɛ ngɛ Babilonia zugba a nɔ. 2 Benɛ e ngɛ tsɛ yee ɔ kekleekle jeha a mi ɔ, imi Daniel hu i ya kpa womi klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ a mi. I na ngɛ womi ɔmɛ a mi kaa Yerusalem maa pee ma doku kɛ yaa si jeha nyingmi kpaago. Bɔ nɛ Yawɛ de gbalɔ Yeremia ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. 3Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, i fa kue wawɛɛ ha Nyɔmtsɛ Mawu, nɛ i kpa lɛ pɛɛ ha ma a. I ha hwɔ, nɛ i ha kpekpe ya bo, nɛ i kɛ la zu pue ye nɔ. 4I fa kue ha Yawɛ, ye Mawu ɔ, nɛ i jaje ye ma a he yayami.
I de ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ Mawu, o kle agbo, nɛ o he ngɛ gbeye. O yeɔ o siwo nɔ, nɛ o naa nihi nɛ suɔ mo, nɛ yeɔ o mlaa amɛ a nɔ ɔ mɔbɔ.
5“Wa pee yayami; wa tɔ nɛ wa pee yi wu tso níhi. Wa tsɔ o hɛ mi atuã, nɛ wa yi o mlaa amɛ a nɔ. 6O tsɔli ɔmɛ, nɛ ji gbali ɔmɛ nɛ o tu munyu kɛ gu a nɔ kɛ tsɔɔ wa matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ, wa ganɔ ɔmɛ, wa nɛmɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ wa ma a tsuo ɔ, wa bui mɛ tue fɛɛ. 7Nyɔmtsɛ, dalɔ ji mo. Wɔɔ lɛɛ zo kpɔtɔɔ gbe wɔ kaa bɔ nɛ o ngɛ wɔ hyɛe mwɔnɛ nɛ ɔ; ejakaa wɔ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ, Yuda bi, Yerusalem bi, kɛ Israel ma a tsuo nɛ o gbɛ ngɔ fĩa je ma amɛ a nɔ ɔ, wa ti ni nɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ kpo nya, kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ lokoo ɔ, wa pee yayami kɛ si mo. 8Wa matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ, wa ganɔ ɔmɛ, kɛ wa nɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsu zo ní, nɛ a pee yayami kɛ si mo Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ. 9E ngɛ mi kaa wa tsɔ o hɛ mi atuã mohu lɛɛ, se mɔbɔ nalɔ ji mo, nɛ o kɛ nɔ he yayami paa nɔ. 10Yawɛ, wa Mawu, benɛ o de wɔ ke waa ye mlaa amɛ nɛ o wo wɔ kɛ gu o tsɔli ɔmɛ, nɛ ji gbali ɔmɛ a nɔ ɔ, wa bui mo tue. 11Israel ma a tsuo tɔ o mlaa amɛ, nɛ a bui o gbi tue. Wa pee yayami kɛ si mo, nɛ lɔ ɔ he nɛ o ngɔ gbiɛmi ɔmɛ nɛ a ngma ngɛ o tsɔlɔ Mose mlaa womi ɔ mi ɔ kɛ ba wa nɔ ɔ nɛ. 12Bɔ nɛ o de to ke o maa pee wɔ, kɛ wa he nyɛli ɔmɛ ɔ, ja lɛ o pee wɔ nɛ ɔ nɛ. Haomi nɛ o kɛ ba Yerusalem ɔ, jamɛ a haomi ɔ eko bɛ ma kpa ko nɔ hyɛ ngɛ je ɔ mi. 13Tue gblami ɔmɛ nɛ a wo a nɔ ta ngɛ Mose mlaa womi ɔ mi ɔ, lɛ tsuo ba wa nɔ. Se Yawɛ, wa Mawu, wa bɔɛ mɔde kaa wa maa pee o suɔmi nya ní; wa ngmɛɛ we wa yayami ɔmɛ a he, nɛ o we anɔkuale ɔ hu wa nyɛɛ we se. 14Mo Yawɛ, wa Mawu, o to o yi mi kaa o maa gbla wa tue, nɛ ja ji bɔ nɛ o pee nɛ ɔ nɛ; ejakaa moo lɛɛ nɔ́ nɛ da lɛ o peeɔ. Se wa bui mo tue.
15“Nyɔmtsɛ, wa Mawu, mo lɛ o kɛ kɔni si wami je o ma a kɛ je Egipt nɛ o he biɛ nɛ ngɛ kɛ ba su mwɔnɛ ɔ. Wa pee yayami; wa tɔ. 16Mo ji nɔ nɛ fa wa he be ko nɛ be ɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, wa kpa mo pɛɛ nɛ o mi mi ko fu Yerusalem hu. Mo nitsɛ o ma ji lɛ; o yo klɔuklɔu. Wa he yayami ɔmɛ, kɛ wa nɛmɛ ɔmɛ a ní yayami ɔmɛ nɛ a pee ɔ a he je ɔ, je ma amɛ tsuo nɛ bɔle wɔ ɔ yeɔ Yerusalem kɛ o ma a a he fɛu. 17Wa Mawu lee, moo bu ye sɔlemi kɛ pɛɛ kpami ɔ tue. O we ɔ nɛ a kpata hɛ mi, nɛ e pee we doku ɔ, to lɛ sisi ekohu, konɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ e na kaa Mawu ji mo. 18Ye Mawu lee, wa kpa mo pɛɛ nɛ o bu wɔ tue. Hyɛ haomi mi nɛ wa ngɛ, kɛ bɔ nɛ ma a nɛ a kɛ o biɛ wo lɛ ɔ pee ma doku ha. Wa ngɛ kue fae ha mo, ejakaa mɔbɔ nalɔ ji mo, se pi kaa wa pee nɔ́ nɛ da. 19Nyɔmtsɛ, bu wɔ tue! Nyɔmtsɛ, ngɔɔ kɛ pa wɔ! Nyɔmtsɛ, moo bu wɔ tue, nɛ o pee he nɔ́ ko ha wɔ! Koo to tsle, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ le kaa Mawu ji mo! O ma a kɛ e mi bi ɔmɛ ɔ, o níhi ji mɛ.”
Gabriel tsɔɔ gbami ɔ sisi
20I ya nɔ nɛ i sɔle. I jaje ye he yayami, kɛ ye ma Israel ɔ hu he yayami, nɛ i kpa Yawɛ, ye Mawu ɔ pɛɛ ke e to e we klɔuklɔu ɔ si ekohu. 21 Benɛ i ngɛ sɔlee kɛ mwɔɔ ɔ, Gabriel nɛ i na lɛ ngɛ kekleekle nina a mi ɔ te kɛ ba he nɛ i ngɛ ɔ. Jamɛ a be ɔ mi lɛ a sãã gbɔkuɛ bɔ ɔ nɛ. 22E ba de mi ke, “Daniel, i ba hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ nɛ ma ba tsɔɔ mo gbami ɔ sisi. 23Benɛ o je o kue fami ɔ sisi ɔ, Mawu he nɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i ba hiɛ ɔ, konɛ ma ba de mo; ejakaa Mawu suɔ o sane saminya. Jehanɛ, bu tue nɛ ma tsɔɔ mo nina a sisi.
24“Be nɛ Mawu to nɛ e maa gbla o ma a, kɛ Yerusalem tue kɛ yaa si ji jeha nyingmi kpaago totoe kpaago. Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, atuã tsɔmi, kɛ yayami peemi se maa po. A kɛ a he yayami ɔmɛ maa pa mɛ, nɛ a maa pee nɔ́ nɛ da kɛ maa ya neneene. Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, nina a, kɛ gbami ɔ maa ba mi, nɛ a maa pee Yawɛ we ɔ klɔuklɔu ekohu. 25Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, na nɛ o le kaa kɛ je be nɛ a ma fa ke a kpale ma Yerusalem ekohu, kɛ yaa si be nɛ ganɔ ɔ nɛ Mawu hla a maa ba a, jeha kpaago totoe kpaago maa be. A maa kpale ma Yerusalem ma a ekohu. A ma je gbɛjegbɛhi kɛ wo ma a mi; nɛ a maa fia gbogbo kɛ wo he, nɛ ma a maa hi si jeha kpaago totoe nyingmi ekpa kɛ enyɔ. Se jamɛ a be ɔ maa pee fimi be. 26Jeha lafa kɛ nyingmi etɛ kɛ eywiɛ se ɔ, a maa gbe hɛ mi nyɛɛlɔ ɔ nɛ Mawu hla a yaka gu. Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, ganɔ ngua ko ma ba tua Yerusalem, nɛ e tabo ɔ ma kpata ma a, kɛ Yawɛ we ɔ a hɛ mi. Nyagbe ɔ maa ba kaa nyu kpekpemi, nɛ ta kɛ hɛ mi kpatami nɛ Mawu de to ɔ maa nyɛɛ se. 27 Matsɛ nɛ ɔ kɛ nihi babauu maa so, nɛ a ma ka a he kita kɛ yaa si jeha kpaago. Se jeha kpaago ɔ kpɛti ɔ, e maa gu bɔ sami, kɛ nike ní hami. A maa ngɔ amaga ko nɛ he ngɛ gbeye kɛ ya ma Yawɛ we ɔ he nɛ ya hiɔwe pe lɛ tsuo ɔ. Nɛ e maa hi lejɛ ɔ kɛ yaa si be nɛ nɔmlɔ nɛ ble Yawɛ we ɔ kikɛ nɛ ɔ ma na e tue gblami nɛ Mawu to ngɔ ha lɛ ɔ.”

Title: DANIEL 10
Content:
Daniel na nina ko ngɛ Tigris pa a he
1Benɛ Sirus ngɛ matsɛ yee ngɛ Persia a, jeha etɛne ɔ mi ɔ, Daniel ná sɛ gbi ko. Daniel biɛ kpa ji Belteshazar. Sɛ gbi nɛ ɔ kɔɔ sane yaya ko nɛ maa ba hwɔɔ se he; e kɔɔ ta ngua ko he. Nɛ a tsɔɔ lɛ sisi kɛ gu nina mi.
2Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, imi Daniel, i ngɛ kɔmɔ yee otsi etɛ. 3I yi niye ní kpakpa ko, i yi lo; dã yɛ ye nya mi, nɛ i kpa we nu kɛ ya si otsi etɛ ɔ tsuo be.
4Kekleekle nyɔhiɔ ɔ we ligbi nɛ ji nyingmi enyɔ kɛ eywiɛ ɔ, i daa si ngɛ Tigris pa ngua a tue. 5 Benɛ i wo ye yi nɔ ma hyɛ ɔ, nyumu ko ji nɛ ɔ nɛ ha kploba kɛ e mlɛ mi sika tsu mlɛ mi fimi nɔ. 6E nɔmlɔ tso ɔ ngɛ kpɛe kaa tɛ nɛ he jua wa. E hɛ mi ngɛ kpɛe kaa oslabai nɛ gba, nɛ e hɛngmɛhi ngɛ kaa jatɛ nɛ a su. E kɔnihi kɛ e nanehi ngɛ kpɛe kaa akɔblee nɛ a sa he, nɛ e gbi ngɛ kaa nimli babauu a gbi.
7Imi nɔ kake too lɛ i na nina nɛ ɔ nɛ. Nyumuhi nɛ piɛ ye he ɔ, mɛɛ a nɛ nina nɛ ɔ, se kɛ̃ ɔ, a tsui po nɛ a tu fo ya laa a he, 8nɛ e piɛ imi nɔ kake too. Benɛ i na nyakpɛ nina nɛ ɔ, ye he wami ta, nɛ i gbɔjɔ. Ye hɛ mi tsake amlɔ bɔ nɛ nɔ ko be ye mi tso lee. 9Kɛkɛ nɛ e tu munyu. Se benɛ i nu e gbi ɔ, i sɛ diblii mi, nɛ i kɛ ye hɛ mi bu si. 10Tlukaa a, nɔ ko ba fua mi, nɛ e wo ye nɔ kɛ kpla si ngɛ ye nakutso nya, nɛ i kɛ ye ninehi pi zugba. Jamɛ a be ɔ mi tsuo ye he ngɛ doe blibliibli.
11Nɔ ɔ de mi ke, “Daniel, Mawu suɔ o sane. Moo te nɛ o da si, nɛ o bu nɔ́ nɛ ma de mo ɔ tue saminya. A tsɔ mi o ngɔ.” Benɛ e kɛ mi tu munyu nɛ ɔ, i te da si nɛ́ ye he ngɛ doe kɛ mwɔɔ.
12Kɛkɛ nɛ e de mi ke, “Daniel, koo ye gbeye. Kɛ je kekleekle ligbi ɔ nɛ o to kaa o maa ba o he si ha o Mawu ɔ, konɛ o nu níhi a sisi ɔ, jamɛ a be ɔ tɔɔ Mawu nu o kue fami ɔ. Nɛ lɔ ɔ he i ba hiɛ ɔ nɛ. 13 Ganɔ ɔ nɛ buu Persia nɔ yemi ɔ he ɔ tsi mi blɔ ligbi nyingmi enyɔ kɛ kake. Se Mikael, nɛ ji ganɔ nikɔtɔma amɛ a ti nɔ kake ɔ ba piɛ ye he; ejakaa imi nɔ kake too pɛ a si ngɛ Persia matsɛ ɔ he. 14I ba, konɛ ma ba tsɔɔ mo nɔ́ nɛ maa ba o ma a nɔ hwɔɔ se, ejakaa nina a kɔɔ hwɔɔ se níhi a he.”
15Benɛ e tu munyu nɛ ɔ, i ma ye yi si, nɛ i pee dii. 16Tlukaa a, nɔ ko nɛ ngɛ kaa nɔmlɔ ta ye nya he. Kɛkɛ nɛ i pa ye nya mi nɛ i tu munyu. I de nɔ nɛ daa si ngɛ ye kasa nya a ke, “Ye nyɔmtsɛ, nina nɛ ɔ ha nɛ ye he mi po, nɛ i gbɔjɔ. 17I ngɛ kaa nyɔguɛ nɛ daa si ngɛ e nyɔmtsɛ hɛ mi. Kɛ ma pee kɛɛ nɛ ma nyɛ nɛ i kɛ mo nɛ tu munyu? Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, ye he wami ta, nɛ mumi ko mumi ko be ye mi.”
18Kɛkɛ nɛ nɔ ɔ ta ye he ekohu, nɛ ye he wami ɔ kpale ba. 19E de mi ke, “Mo he manye! Mawu suɔ o sane saminya. Koo ye gbeye! Ko ha nɛ nɔ́ ko nɛ hao mo!”
Benɛ e kɛ mi tu munyu nɛ ɔ, i na he wami he, nɛ i de lɛ ke, “Ye nyɔmtsɛ! I kpa mo pɛɛ, nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ o nya a, de mi; ejakaa o ha nɛ i na he wami.”
20-21Kɛkɛ nɛ e de mi ke, “Anɛ o le nɔ́ nɛ he je nɛ i ba o ngɔ ɔ? I ba konɛ ma ba tsɔɔ mo nɔ́ nɛ a ngma ngɛ anɔkuale womi ɔ mi. Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, ma kpale ye se, nɛ i kɛ ganɔ ɔ nɛ buu Persia he ɔ ma ya hwu ta. Pee se ɔ, ganɔ ɔ nɛ buu Hela he ɔ maa ba. Nɔ ko nɔ ko be nɛ maa piɛ ye he, pe ganɔ ɔ nɛ buu Israel he, nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Mikael ɔ kɛkɛ.

Title: DANIEL 11
Content:
1“Lɛ ji nɔ nɛ piɛɔ ye he, nɛ lɛ nɛ e faa ye he. 2Jehanɛ, nɔ́ nɛ ma de mo nɛ ɔ, e ji anɔkuale.”
Egipt kɛ Siria matsɛ yemi ɔmɛ
Bɔfo ɔ de ke, “Matsɛmɛ kpahi etɛ ma ba ye Persia nɔ. A se ɔ, matsɛ eywiɛne maa ba, nɛ lɛɛ e ma na ní babauu pe mɛ tsuo kulaa. Nɛ ke be nɛ e ní nami ɔ ba ha nɛ e he wami ba he si ɔ, e maa te si kɛ wo Hela matsɛ yemi ɔ.
3“Kɛkɛ ɔ, matsɛ katsɛ ko maa ba. E kɛ he wami nɛ nya wa maa ye tsɛ, nɛ nɔ́ nɛ e suɔ ɔ, lɔ ɔ e maa pee. 4Se ke be nɛ e he wami ɔ ba he si ɔ, e matsɛ yemi ɔ maa gbɛ. A maa dla matsɛ yemi ɔ mi eywiɛ, nɛ ni kpahi nɛ pi e weku li ma ba ye tsɛ ngɛ e nane mi. Se a he wami ɔ, kɛ e nɔ́ ɔ be sɔe.
5“Egipt matsɛ ɔ he maa wa. Se e ganɔ ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake he maa wa kulaa pe lɛ, nɛ e matsɛ yemi ɔ hu ma blɛke pe e nɔ́ ɔ. 6Jeha komɛ a se ɔ, Egipt matsɛ ɔ, kɛ Siria matsɛ ɔ maa pee huɛ, nɛ e kɛ e biyo ma ha Siria matsɛ ɔ. Se huɛ bɔmi nɛ ɔ se be kɛe; nɛ a maa gbe yo ɔ, e huno ɔ, e bi ɔ, kɛ e tsɔli ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ a kɛ lɛ ya a. 7Pee se ɔ, yo ɔ weku no ko ma ba ye matsɛ. E ma tua Siria matsɛ ɔ tabo ɔ, nɛ e maa sɛ a mɔ ɔ mi, nɛ e maa ye a nɔ. 8E maa muɔ a mawu ɔmɛ, amaga amɛ, kɛ sika hiɔ kɛ sika tsu ní kpakpa amɛ kɛ ya Egipt. Nɛ e kɛ Siria matsɛ ɔ be ta hwue hu jeha babauu. 9Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, Siria matsɛ ɔ ma ba tua Egipt. Se e be kɛe nɛ e maa kpale kɛ ho lɛ nitsɛ e zugba nɔ ya ekohu.
10“Siria matsɛ ɔ bimɛ ma dla kɛ ha ta, nɛ a ma bua tabohi babauu a nya. A maa hia kɛ ya tua a he nyɛli ɔmɛ a mɔ ɔ kaa pa nɛ hia kɛ bee. 11Egipt matsɛ ɔ mi mi ma fu. E kɛ Siria matsɛ ɔ ma ya hwu ta, nɛ e maa nuu Siria ta buli babauu nyɔguɛ. 12Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ma ha nɛ e ma wo e he nɔ, nɛ e maa gbe nimli babauu nitsɛ. Se kɛ̃ ɔ, e kunimi yemi ɔ se be kɛe.
13“Siria matsɛ ɔ maa kpale e se; nɛ e ma ya bua tabohi babauu nɛ a hiɛ pe kekle ni ɔmɛ a nya. Jeha komɛ a se ɔ, Siria matsɛ ɔ maa kpale ba kɛ ta buli babauu nɛ a he hiɛ pe kekle ni ɔmɛ po. A kɛ ta níhi babauu hu maa ba. 14Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, nihi babauu maa te si kɛ wo Egipt matsɛ ɔ. Mo nitsɛ o ma mi bi atuã tsɔli komɛ hu ma tsɔ atuã ngɛ nina ko nɛ a na a he. Se a maa ye a nɔ. 15Jehanɛ, Siria matsɛ ɔ ma ba sa ma ko nɛ a fia gbogbo ngɔ wo he ɔ yi, nɛ e maa ngɔ ma a. Egipt tabo ɔmɛ be nya nyɛe maa da; a ta buli kpakpa amɛ po a he wami maa ta. 16Siria matsɛ ɔ maa pee mɛ nɔ́ nɛ e suɔ, nɛ nɔ ko be nyɛe maa te si kɛ wo lɛ. E ma ya da si ngɛ zugba a nɛ a wo he si ɔ nɔ, nɛ zugba a tsuo maa pee e nɔ.
17“Siria matsɛ ɔ maa to ga bɔ nɛ pee nɛ e nine nɛ su Egipt tsuo nɔ. Lɛ hu e kɛ Egipt matsɛ ɔ maa pee huɛ, nɛ e kɛ e biyo ma ha lɛ. Nɛ yi mi yaya nɛ e to ngɔ wo Egipt matsɛ ɔ he ɔ, e maa gu e biyo nɛ ɔ nɔ kɛ tsu he ní. Se e yi mi tomi ɔ maa pee yaka. 18Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, e ma ba tua wo nya ma amɛ, nɛ e maa ngɔ mahi babauu. Se tatsɛ ko maa je ma se kɛ ba nɛ e kɛ Siria matsɛ ɔ ma ba kpe. E maa ye Siria matsɛ ɔ nɔ, nɛ Siria matsɛ ɔ kɛ zo maa kpale e se kɛ ho. 19E ma pue blɔ kɛ ya e mɔ ɔ mi ngɛ lɛ nitsɛ e zugba nɔ. Se haomi maa ba e nɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, nɛ a be lɛ nae hu.
20“Matsɛ kpa maa ba ngɛ e se. Matsɛ nɛ ɔ maa tsɔ kɛ ba tsu tó pani nya ngɛ ma a dɛ. E maa pee nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, konɛ e na ní babauu. Se be bɔɔ se ɔ, matsɛ nɛ ɔ ma gbo tlukaa nɛ a be lee nɔ́ nɛ gbe lɛ; nɛ pohu pi ta nga nɔ nɛ e ma gbo ngɛ.”
Siria matsɛ yaya a
21Bɔfo ɔ ya nɔ nɛ e de ke, “Nɔ nɛ ma ba ye tsɛ ngɛ e se ɔ maa pee nɔ ko nɛ bu be e he, nɛ́ e sɛ́ kaa e yeɔ matsɛ. Nɔmlɔ nɛ ɔ maa ba tlukaa, nɛ e kɛ sisimi, kɛ nya mi ngɔngɔɛ munyu tumi ma kpɔ matsɛ yemi ɔ. 22Nihi nɛ maa te si ngɔ wo lɛ ɔ, e ma kpata a hɛ mi, kɛ Mawu nitsɛ ganɔ nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa a tsuo. 23E kɛ je ma kpahi maa pee huɛ, nɛ e maa sisi mɛ. Nihi bɔɔ pɛ ji ni nɛmɛ nɛ maa nyɛɛ e se; se e he wami maa hiɛ babauu. 24E ma tua zugba ko nɛ ngɛ ní babauu be mi nɛ a hɛ be a he nɔ; nɛ nɔ́ nɛ e tsɛmɛ, kɛ e nɛmɛ po pee we hyɛ ɔ, lɛɛ e maa pee. Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e maa dla ta yibu ní, kɛ weto ní nɛ e na ngɛ ta mi ɔ kɛ ha e we bi ɔmɛ. E maa to ga, nɛ e ma ya tua mɔhi, se nɔ́ nɛ ɔ se be kɛe.
25“E maa pee nyumu, nɛ e kɛ tabo babauu ma ya tua Egipt. Egipt matsɛ ɔ hu ma bua tabo babauu nitsɛ a nya, nɛ e kɛ lɛ maa hwu. Se, nɔ se blɔ tsɔɔli komɛ maa so ngɔ wo Egipt matsɛ ɔ he, nɛ e be kunimi yee. 26E ga woli kpakpahi tete ma ha nɛ e nane ma kpata. A maa gbe e ta buli ɔmɛ babauu, nɛ e tabo ɔ maa gbɛ fĩa. 27Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, matsɛmɛ enyɔ nɛ ɔmɛ maa hi si ngɛ okplɔɔ kake he, nɛ a maa ye ní. A ma susu ní yayahi a he, nɛ a maa ye a sibi lakpa. Se nɔ́ nɛ a ngɛ hlae ɔ, a nine be nɔ sue; ejakaa be nɛ a to ɔ, be ɔ sui lolo. 28Siria matsɛ ɔ maa kpale kɛ ho lɛ nitsɛ e zugba nɔ ya kɛ ta yibu ní babauu ɔ nɛ e na a. E ma hla kaa e gu Mawu ma a a jami ɔ. E maa pee e suɔmi nya ní, nɛ lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e maa kpale kɛ ho lɛ nitsɛ e zugba nɔ ya.
29“Pee se ɔ, e maa kpale ba tua Egipt ekohu. Se jehanɛ lɛɛ e be kunimi yee kaa kekle ɔ. 30Roma ta lɛhi ma ba tua lɛ, nɛ e tsui maa po.
“E kɛ mi mi la maa kpale e se, nɛ e ma hla kaa e gu Mawu ma a a jami ɔ. E maa bu nihi nɛ kua kikɛmɛ a jami ɔ a ga womi tue. 31 Ta buli nɛ e wo blɔ ɔ ma ya sɛ Yawɛ we ɔ, kɛ mɔ ɔ mi, nɛ a ma ble lejɛ ɔ. A maa jɔɔ daa ligbi bɔ ɔmɛ sami, nɛ a maa ngɔ amaga ko nɛ he ngɛ gbeye kɛ ya ma Yawɛ we ɔ. 32Matsɛ ɔ kɛ nya mi ngɔngɔɛ munyu tumi ma puɛ nihi nɛ kua a jami ɔ a juɛmi, nɛ a ma ba nyɛɛ e se. Se ni nɛmɛ nɛ nyɛɛ Mawu se anɔkuale mi ɔ maa da si kpɛii, nɛ a kɛ mɛ maa to ní. 33Ní leli nɛ ngɛ ma hɛ mi nyɛɛli ɔmɛ a kpɛti ɔ maa tsɔɔ ma mi bi ɔmɛ babauu ní. Se pee se ɔ, a maa gbe a ti ni komɛ ngɛ ta nga nɔ, nɛ a maa sã ni komɛ. A maa ha ní ngɛ ni komɛ hu a dɛ, nɛ a maa nuu mɛ nyɔguɛ. 34Be mi nɛ a ngɛ Mawu ma mi bi ɔmɛ gbee ɔ, ni komɛ ma ba je ngmlaa ha mɛ kɛ̃. Se ngmlaa jeli nɛ ɔmɛ a ti nihi babauu maa ba ngɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a se nami he. 35A maa gbe ní leli nɛ ɔmɛ a ti ni komɛ. Se se nami mohu maa je mi kɛ ba, ejakaa a maa tsukɔ ma a he. Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ maa ya nɔ hluu kɛ yaa si nyagbe be ɔ nɛ Mawu to ɔ maa ba.
36 “Siria matsɛ ɔ maa pee e suɔmi nya ní. E ma wo e he nɔ, nɛ e maa pee lɛ kaa e kle pe mawu ɔmɛ tsuo. Mawu Ope ɔ nitsɛ po, e maa tu musu munyuhi kɛ si lɛ hluu kɛ yaa si be nɛ Mawu maa gbla e tue. Ejakaa nɔ́ nɛ Mawu to kaa e maa pee ɔ, ja e pee. 37Matsɛ ɔ be mawu ɔmɛ nɛ e nɛmɛ ɔmɛ ja a bue; mawu ɔ nɛ yihi suɔ ɔ hu, e be lɛ bue. Anɔkuale mi ɔ, e be mawu ko mawu ko bue fɛɛ; ejakaa e ma susu kaa e kle pe mɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ. 38Nɔ́ nɛ e maa pee mohu ji, e maa wo mawu nɛ buu mɔhi a he ɔ hɛ mi nyami. E maa ke mawu ko nɛ e nɛmɛ ja we hyɛ ɔ sika tsu, sika hiɔ, june, kɛ nike ní kpahi nɛ a he jua wa. 39E maa ngɔ nihi nɛ jaa ma se mawuhi kɛ bu e mɔ ɔmɛ a he. Nihi nɛ buɔ lɛ ɔ, e maa wo a hɛ mi nyami babauu; e ma ha mɛ blɔ nya nguanguahi, nɛ e maa dla zugba ngɔ ha mɛ.
40“Ke be nɛ Siria matsɛ ɔ nyagbe be ɔ su ta a, Egipt matsɛ ɔ ma ba tua lɛ. Se Siria matsɛ ɔ maa ngɔ ta zugba lɛhi, okpɔngɔhi, kɛ lɛhi babauu kɛ ba, nɛ e kɛ Egipt matsɛ ɔ ma ba hwu ta wawɛɛ nitsɛ. Kaa bɔ nɛ pa bee ɔ, ja nɛ e maa ngɔ zugba amɛ kakaaka. 41E ma ya tua zugba a nɛ a wo he si ɔ po, nɛ e maa gbe nihi babauu nitsɛ. Se Edom, Moab, kɛ Amon bi nɛ piɛ ɔ, mɛɛ lɛɛ e nine be a nɔ sue. 42Ke e ba tua ma nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ɔ, Egipt tete he be mi jee. 43E maa ngɔ Egipt june tsuo, sika tsu, sika hiɔ, kɛ ní kpakpahi nɛ a he jua wa. Libia kɛ Sudan ma sɔmɔ lɛ. 44Se e maa nu sane komɛ kɛ je beleku je kɛ omleyi je, nɛ e tsui maa po. Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ma ha nɛ e ma kpata nihi babauu a hɛ mi basabasa. 45E maa ma matsɛ bo tsu agboagbohi ngɛ wo ɔ, kɛ yo ɔ nɛ Yawɛ we ɔ maa si ngɛ nɔ ɔ a kpɛti. Se e ma gbo ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, nɛ nɔ ko be bae nɛ e ba je ngmlaa ha lɛ.”

Title: DANIEL 12
Content:
Nyagbe be ɔ
1 Bɔfo ɔ nɛ wo kploba tade ɔ de ke, “Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, Mikael maa ba. Lɛ ji ganɔ ngua a nɛ buu o ma a he ɔ nɛ. Jehanɛ, haomi nɛ a nɛ eko hyɛ kɛ je be nɛ je ma amɛ bɔ ade ɔ maa ba. Ke jamɛ a be ɔ su ɔ, o ma mi bi ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ a ngma a biɛ kɛ wo Mawu womi ɔ mi ɔ, a ma he a yi wami. 2 Ni nɛmɛ nɛ gbo momo nɛ a pu mɛ ɔ, a ti nihi babauu maa te si ekohu: ni komɛ maa ya neneene wami mi, nɛ ni komɛ hu maa ya neneene hɛ mi si puemi mi. 3Ní leli ɔmɛ nɛ nyɛɛ ma a hɛ mi ɔ ma kpɛ kaa pu. Ni nɛmɛ nɛ tsɔɔ nihi babauu blɔ nɛ a pee nɔ́ nɛ da a, mɛɛ lɛɛ a ma kpɛ kaa dodoehi kɛ maa ya neneene.”
4 Bɔfo ɔ de mi ke, “Daniel, jehanɛ nga womi ɔ nya, nɛ o sɔu nya kɛ yaa si je mi nyagbe. Kɛ je be nɛ ɔ mi kɛ yaa si jamɛ a be ɔ, nihi babauu ma gbo yaka dengme. A maa nyɛɛ kɛ ya kɛ ba, nɛ a ma hla kaa a le nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ nɔ yae.”
5Jehanɛ, imi Daniel, i na nyumuhi enyɔ nɛ daa si ngɛ pa ko he; nɔ kake daa si ngɛ pa a se lejɛ, nɛ nɔ kake daa si ngɛ kpo he hiɛmɛ a je. 6Kɛkɛ nɛ nɔ kake bi bɔfo ɔ nɛ wo kploba tade kɛ daa si ngɛ pa a yiti je ɔ ke, “Mɛni be kikɛmɛ a nyakpɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ maa hi si kɛ yaa si loko a se maa po?”
7 Bɔfo ɔ wo e nine enyɔ ɔmɛ tsuo a nɔ kɛ tsɔɔ hiɔwe, nɛ e ka kita ngɛ Mawu nɛ ngɛ daa a biɛ mi. I nu nɛ e de ke, “Kɛ yaa si jeha etɛ kɛ fa nɛ a wa Mawu ma a yi mi ta a, kɛkɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ kulaa maa ba mi.”
8I nu nɔ́ nɛ e de ɔ lɛɛ, se i nui sisi. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i bi lɛ ke, “Ye nyɔmtsɛ, i kpa mo pɛɛ, kɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a nyagbe maa ba kɛɛ?”
9E he nɔ ke, “Daniel, amlɔ nɛ ɔ, yaa. Ejakaa munyu nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, a kɛ maa to, nɛ a maa laa nɔ kɛ yaa si nyagbe be ɔ. 10 A maa tsukɔ nihi babauu a he, nɛ a he ma tsɔ. Yiwutsotsɛmɛ be sisi nue; a maa ya nɔ maa pee yayami. Ní leli ɔmɛ lɛɛ a maa nu sisi.
11 “Kɛ je be nɛ a maa gu daa ligbi bɔ sami ɔ, nɛ a maa ngɔ amaga a nɛ he ngɛ gbeye ɔ kɛ ya ma Yawɛ we ɔ he nɛ ya hiɔwe pe lɛ tsuo ɔ, ligbi akpe kɛ e nya lafa enyɔ kɛ nyingmi nɛɛ maa be. 12A gbaa ni nɛmɛ nɛ maa ye anɔkuale kɛ yaa si ligbi nɛ ji akpe kɛ e nya lafa etɛ kɛ nyingmi etɛ kɛ enuɔ ɔ!
13“Mo Daniel, ye anɔkuale kɛ yaa si nyagbe. O ma ba gbo, se o maa te si ekohu, nɛ nyagbe ligbi ɔ, o nine maa su o blɔ fa mi nɔ́ ɔ nɔ.”

Title: HOSEA NYA TSƆƆMI
Content:
NYA TSƆƆMI
Hosea ji gbalɔ nɛ ba fiɛ Mawu munyu ngɛ Israel zugba a we omleyi je ngɛ gbalɔ Amos se. Jamɛ a be ɔ, haomi babauu ngɛ Israel nɔ; lɔ ɔ se loko a ywia Samaria ma a jeha 721 loko a fɔ Kristo.
Bɔ nɛ Hosea yo Gomer yi lɛ, Hosea anɔkuale ɔ, jã kɛ̃ Israel ma a hu yi Mawu anɔkuale. Enɛ ɔ he ɔ, Mawu maa gbla a tue. Se nyagbe ɔ, Mawu maa tsɔɔ kaa e suɔ e ma a saminya. E ma kpɔ e ma a, nɛ e ma dla e kɛ mɛ a kpɛti. Mawu suɔmi kpetekpleenyɛ nɛ ɔ jeɔ kpo ngɛ gbalɔ ɔ munyu nɛ ɔ mi: “Israel, mɛni maa ba loko ma ngmɛɛ o he? Mɛni he je ma kua mo? Ye tsui be mi blɔ ngmɛe kaa ma pee ja! Suɔmi nɛ i ngɛ kɛ ha mo ɔ nya wa saminya.” (11.8)
Bɔ nɛ a dla womi ɔ mi ha
Hosea kɛ e yo a gba si himi, kɛ a bimɛ a he sane 1.1—3.5
Sɛ gbihi kɛ ha Israel 4.1—13.16
Sɛ gbi nɛ tsɔɔ tsui tsakemi kɛ si womi 14.1-9

Title: HOSEA 1
Content:
1 Yawɛ ha Beeri bi Hosea sɛ gbi nɛ ɔ ngɛ Yuda matsɛmɛ, Uzia, Yotam, Ahaz, kɛ Hezekia a yi nɔ. Jamɛ a be ɔ, Yohoash bi Yeroboam ngɛ tsɛ yee ngɛ Israel.
Hosea yo ɔ kɛ e bimɛ ɔmɛ
2Kekleekle nɛ Yawɛ kɛ Israel tu munyu kɛ gu Hosea nɔ ɔ, e de Hosea ke, “Yaa nɛ o ya ngɔ yo; yo ɔ maa pee e he yakayaka nɔmlɔ, nɛ e bimɛ maa hi kaa lɛ pɛ. Ja pɛpɛɛpɛ ye ma a pee ɔ nɛ; ye ma a kua mi; a yi mi anɔkuale.”
3Hosea pee bɔ nɛ a de lɛ ɔ. E ya ngɔ Diblaim biyo nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Gomer. E na mi nɛ e fɔ binyumuyo. 4 Yawɛ de Hosea ke, “Wo bi ɔ biɛ ke ‘Yezreel’; ejakaa e be kɛe kulaa nɛ ma gbla Israel matsɛ ɔ tue ngɛ nihi nɛ e nɛ̃, Yehu kpata a hɛ mi ngɛ Yezreel ɔ a he. Ma ha nɛ Yehu nɔ yemi ɔ se maa po. 5Jamɛ a be ɔ, ma ha nɛ a maa ye Israel tabo ɔ nɔ ngɛ Yezreel kɔ̃ ɔ mi.”
6E na mi ekohu nɛ e fɔ yo. Yawɛ de Hosea ke, “Moo wo lɛ ke, ‘Asumemo’. Ejakaa i be Israel sane suɔe hu, nɛ i be a tɔmi ngɔe kɛ pa mɛ. 7Se Yuda ma a lɛɛ, ma suɔ a sane. Imi Yawɛ, a Mawu ɔ, ma he a yi wami. Pi ta nga nɔ nɛ ma pee nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ngɛ; pi klaate, loo kɛ̃ɛ̃ kɛ kɛ̃ɛ̃ mi bi, loo okpɔngɔhi kɛ a nɔ hili nɛ ma ngɔ kɛ tsu nɔ́ nɛ ɔ.”
8Benɛ Gomer tsɔ́ e biyo ɔ nyɔ ɔ, e ba na mi ekohu, nɛ e fɔ binyumuyo enyɔne. 9Kɛkɛ nɛ Yawɛ de Hosea ke, “Wo lɛ biɛ ke, ‘Piyema’, ejakaa pi ye ma ji Israel, nɛ pi a Mawu ji mi.”
Israel ma ba da e da he ekohu
10 Israel bi a he ma ba hiɛ babauu kaa wo nya zia, nɛ nɔ ko be nyɛe maa kane mɛ; nɔ ko nɔ ko be nyɛe maa kale a yibɔ. Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, Mawu ngɛ mɛ dee ke, “Pi ye ma ji nyɛ”; se be ma nɛ e ma de mɛ ke, “Imi Mawu hɛ ngmengmletsɛ ɔ, ye bimɛ ji nyɛ!” 11Yuda bi, kɛ Israel bi ma ba pee kake; a maa hla nɔ kake nɛ da a nya, nɛ a maa hi si ngɛ he jɔmi mi ngɛ zugba a nɔ. Niinɛ, Yezreel ma ba plɔke.

Title: HOSEA 2
Content:
1Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ tsɛ nyɛ nyɛmimɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ ke, “Mawu ma”, kɛ “Nihi nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ suɔ mɛ.”
Israel yi Mawu anɔkuale kaa bɔ nɛ Gomer yi Hosea anɔkuale ɔ
2Israel bi ngɛ kaa imi Mawu, ye bimɛ. E ngɛ mi kaa i kɛ Israel be bɔmi kaa nɔ kɛ e yo hu lɛɛ, se kɛ̃ ɔ, nyɛɛ kɛ lɛ nɛ tu, konɛ e kpa gba puɛmi kɛ yahomi ɔ. 3Ke pi ja a, ma kpa bo ngɛ e he, nɛ e he maa fɔ si paslapaa kaa bɔ nɛ a fɔ lɛ ɔ. Ma ha e maa pee kaa zugba gbigbli nɛ bɛ ní; nɛ nyu kuma maa gbe lɛ. 4-5E bimɛ ɔmɛ hu i be mɛ mɔbɔ nae. Ejakaa yo yaholɔ bimɛ ji mɛ. A nyɛ nɛ fɔ mɛ ɔ, zo ko zo ko be e hɛ mi. E nyɛ́ nɛ e de ke, “I yaa nɛ ma ya nyɛɛ ye pla amɛ a se. Mɛ lɛ a haa mi ye nya mi ngma, kɛ nyu; heha ní, nu, kɛ dã tsuo, a dɛ mi i naa kɛ jeɔ.”
6Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ma ngɔ mio tso kɛ tsi lɛ blɔ; ma fia gli kɛ wo e he kɛ tsi lɛ blɔ. 7E ma ya hla e pla amɛ a se blɔ, se e nine be a nɔ sue. E ma hla mɛ hluu, se e be mɛ nae. Kɛkɛ ɔ, e ma de ke, “Ma kpale kɛ ya ye huno momo ɔ ngɔ. Benɛ i kɛ lɛ ngɛ ɔ, níhi a mi hi ha mi kulaa pe piɔ.”
8E li tete kaa ngma, dã, kɛ nu ɔ, imi lɛ i ha lɛ. Jehanɛ, sika hiɔ, kɛ sika tsu ní nɛ a kɛ jaa Baal ɔ, e li kaa imi lɛ i kɛ dloo lɛ. 9Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke ní kpami be su ɔ, blɛfo be bae, nɛ wai hu se maa po. Kploba kɛ kuutu nɛ e kɛ maa ha e he hu ma bɔ lɛ. 10Ma kpa bo ngɛ e he ngɛ e pla amɛ a hɛ mi paa; nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be nyɛe ma kpɔ lɛ. 11E nyami be ɔmɛ: Nyɔhiɔhe, Hejɔɔmi, kɛ nyami be kpa amɛ tsuo a se maa po. 12E wai ngmɔ ɔmɛ, kɛ ngmɔkɔ ɔ nɛ e ke e pla amɛ lɛ a pee kɛ wo lɛ hiɔ ɔ; ee, ma kpata ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a hɛ mi. Ngmɔ ɔ maa hɛ kaa hue, nɛ nga mi lohwehi maa ye e mi ní ɔ. 13Ma gbla Gomer tue ngɛ níhi nɛ e pee be ko ɔ a he. Ke pee ɔ, Gomer ma dla e he saminyayoo kɛ nguɛ ní, kɛ june kpakpa, nɛ e ma ya sã tsopa kɛ e he via ha Baal. E ma dla e he saminyayoo kikɛ nɛ ɔ, nɛ e ma ya hi e pla amɛ a nɔ kpae; kɛkɛ ɔ, e hɛ maa je ye nɔ pɛsɛpɛsɛ. Ma gbla e tue ngɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ a he. Yawɛ lɛ de.
Yawɛ suɔ e ma a
14Enɛ ɔ he ɔ, ma mlɔɔ e hɛ mi, nɛ ma ngɔ lɛ kɛ ya nga kplanaa a nɔ, nɛ i kɛ lɛ maa tu munyu ngɛ he jɔmi mi ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. 15 Ma ngɔ wai abɔɔ ɔmɛ kɛ ha lɛ ekohu. Haomi Kɔ̃ ɔ ma plɛ pee he ko nɛ e ma ná ní kpakpahi ngɛ. E kɛ mi maa hi si saminya kaa bɔ nɛ e pee ngɛ e yihe mi, benɛ e je Egipt kɛ ba a. 16Kɛkɛ ɔ, e ma tsɛ mi ke e huno ekohu; e be mi tsɛe ke e Baal hu. 17Baal biɛ maa laa lɛ pɛsɛpɛsɛ, nɛ e be e ta woe hu.
18Jamɛ a be ɔ, i kɛ nga mi lohwe awi yeli, kɛ lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ tsuo maa so, nɛ a be ye ma a awi yee hu. Ma ha klaate, kɛ̃ɛ̃, kɛ ta hwumi ní kpahi tsuo a se maa po ngɛ zugba a nɔ, nɛ ye ma a maa hi si ngɛ tue mi jɔmi, kɛ he jɔmi mi.
19Israel, i kɛ mo maa hi si kaa ye yo;
ma ye mo anɔkuale.
Ye suɔmi kɛ mɔbɔ nami nɛ ngɛ daa a,
ma je kpo kɛ tsɔɔ mo,
nɛ ma ngɔ mo kɛ pee ye nɔ́
kɛ maa ya neneene.
20Ma ye ye siwo ɔ nɔ,
nɛ ma ngɔ mo kɛ pee ye nɔ́,
nɛ mo hu o ma tsɛ mi ke Yawɛ.
21-22Jamɛ a be ɔ, ma bu ye ma Israel
kue fami ɔ tue.
Ma ha hiɔmi maa nɛ,
nɛ zugba a maa ba ní;
blɛfo, wai yiblii, kɛ Oliv maa pɔ he.
23 Ma to ye ma a sisi,
nɛ a ma plɔke ngɛ zugba a nɔ.
Nihi nɛ a tsɛɔ mɛ ke, “Asumemo” ɔ,
ma je suɔmi kpo ha mɛ;
nɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ a tsɛɔ mɛ ke
“Piyema” a,
ma de mɛ ke,
“Ye ma ji nyɛ.”
Kɛkɛ ɔ, mɛ hu a ma he nɔ ke,
“Mo ji wa Mawu.”

Title: HOSEA 3
Content:
Hosea kɛ e yo nɛ yi lɛ anɔkuale ɔ
1Yawɛ de mi ekohu ke, “Yaa nɛ o ya hla yo gba puɛlɔ, nɛ o suɔ lɛ, kaa bɔ nɛ imi hu i suɔ ye ma Israel ɔ. Ye ma Israel kua mi; a ya ngɛ mawu kpahi a se nyɛɛe, nɛ a kɛ wai yiblii gbigbli sãã bɔ kɛ haa mɛ lɛɛ, se kɛ̃, i suɔ mɛ.”
2Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i ngɔ sika hiɔ yi nyɔngma kɛ enuɔ, kɛ ngma tsimi lafa kɛ nyingmi enuɔ kɛ kpɔ ye yo ɔ. 3I de lɛ ke lɛ nɔ kake too nɛ hi si; e ko pee yakayaka; e ko ya nyɛɛ nyumu kpahi a se. Kɛkɛ ɔ, imi hu i kɛ lɛ maa hi si. 4Kikɛ nɛ ɔ Israel bi hu maa hi si be babauu nɛ a be matsɛmɛ, loo hɛ mi nyɛɛli. Bɔ sami, kɛ tɛ titimahi a jami se maa po; nɛ amagahi, kɛ níhi nɛ a kɛ klaa a, ekoeko be si hie hu. 5Se pee se ɔ, Israel bi ɔmɛ maa kpale kɛ ba a ma a mi ekohu; a ma ba hla Yawɛ, a Mawu ɔ, kɛ David nɛ ji matsɛ ɔ nina se blɔ ekohu. Jamɛ a be ɔ, a maa ye Yawɛ gbeye, nɛ a ma na nike ní kpakpahi kɛ je e dɛ mi.

Title: HOSEA 4
Content:
Yawɛ kɛ Israel ná
1Nyɛ Israel bi, nyɛɛ bu nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ ngɛ dee ɔ tue. Yawɛ ke Israel ma a tɔ̃ e nɔ. E ke, “Anɔkuale yemi ta zugba a nɔ; suɔmi be, nɛ imi Mawu nitsɛ hu a li mi. 2Kita kami, lakpa yemi, muɔ si puemi, ju, kɛ gba puɛmi sɔuu ji a ní tsumi. Nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko si we mɛ kpu, nɛ muɔ si kɛkɛ a ngɛ puee. 3Enɛ ɔ he je nɛ zugba a pee mɔbɔmɔbɔ ɔ nɛ. Níhi tsuo nɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ, nga mi lohwehi kɛ lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ tsuo pee gbedee; nɛ pa mi lohi tete ngɛ gboe.”
Yawɛ kɛ osɔfo ɔmɛ ná
4Yawɛ ke, “Nɔ ko kó pia ma a ke ma a lɛ tɔ̃; nɛ nɔ ko kó ka a hɛ mi hulɔ; nyɛ osɔfo ɔmɛ mohu lɛ i kɛ nyɛ ná. 5Nyɛ ma tɛ si nyɔ kɛ pia; nyɛɛ kɛ gbali ɔmɛ tsuo ma tɛ si, nɛ ma kpata nyɛ nyɛ Israel ɔ hɛ mi. 6Ye ma a hɛ mi ma kpata, ejakaa a li nɔ. Ee, nyɛ osɔfo ɔmɛ, nyɛ kua nile, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, imi hu ma kua nyɛ. Akɛnɛ nyɛ hɛ je ye mlaa amɛ a nɔ he je ɔ, imi hu ye hɛ maa je nyɛ binyumu ɔmɛ a nɔ.
7“Si abɔ nɛ nyɛ, osɔfo ɔmɛ nyɛ he ngɛ hiɛe ɔ, si abɔ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ yayami babauu pee kɛ ngɛ mi sie. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i be nyɛ hɛ mi nyami woe; ma pue nyɛ hɛ mi si mohu. 8Nyɛ náá ní babauu kɛ jee yayami nɛ ma a ngɛ pee ɔ mi. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ suɔ kaa ma a nɛ ya nɔ nɛ a hi yayami pee kpamisa. 9Ma gbla nyɛ tsuo nyɛ tue: ma mi no gu jio, osɔfo jio, ma gbla nyɛ tue ngɛ yayami nɛ nyɛ peeɔ ɔ he. 10Ke ma a ba sã bɔ ɔ, nyɛ blɔ fa mi nɔ́ ɔ, nyɛ maa ye, se nyɛ be tɔe. Nyɛ ma ya bɔ ajuama, se bi be mi jee; ejakaa imi Yawɛ ɔ, nyɛ kua mi, nɛ nyɛ ngɛ mawu kpahi jae. Bɔ nɛ yo yaholɔ peeɔ ɔ, jã ye ma a je ye se nɛ a ngɔ a he ya ha mawu kpahi.”
Yawɛ sume wɔ jami
11Yawɛ ke, “Wai he, kɛ wai momo ha nɛ ye ma a ngɛ biɛe! A je ye se kulaa! 12Tso kpoku mohu ngɔ a ya ngɛ ní bie ngɛ. Dɛma tso mohu a bi ɔ ke e tsɔɔ mɛ nile. Kaa bɔ nɛ yo yaholɔ peeɔ ɔ, a je ye se nɛ a kɛ a he ya ha mawu kpahi. 13A ya sã bɔ ngɛ yohi a yi mi, nɛ a sã tsopa kɛ e he via hu ngɛ tso gagaahi nɛ bɔ kusuu a sisi, ngɛ yokuhi a yi mi, ejakaa lejɛ ɔ hɔ̃ ɔ mi jɔ.
“Enɛ ɔ lɛ ha nɛ nyɛ biyi ɔmɛ ya peeɔ a he yaholi, nɛ nyɛ yigbayi ɔmɛ hu puɛɔ gba a nɛ. 14Ke nyɛ biyi ɔmɛ ya pee a he yaholi, nɛ nyɛ binyumu ɔmɛ a yi ɔmɛ ya puɛ gba a, i be a tue gblae; ejakaa nyɛ nitsɛmɛ hu nyɛ ya nyɛɛɔ yaholi nɛ ɔmɛ a se, nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ mɛ tsuo nyɛ ya sãã bɔ kɛ haa a wɔ ɔmɛ. Ejakaa ‘Ma nɛ li nɔ́ ɔ, a hɛ mi kpataa.’
15“Israel, nyɛ yi mi anɔkuale; nyɛɛ hyɛ nɛ hi nɛ Yuda ko ba pee kaa nyɛ. Nyɛ ko ya ja Mawu ngɛ Gilgal, loo Betaven; nɛ nyɛ kó ka kita ngɛ Yawɛ, Mawu hɛ kalɔ ɔ biɛ mi hulɔ. 16Israel ma a tue mi ti kaa bɔ nɛ teji okpɔngɔ tue mi ti ɔ. Kɛ ma pee kɛɛ nɛ ma lɛ mɛ ngɛ nga nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ a lɛɛ to ɔ? 17Israel ma a ke e ma ja amaga! É ya nɔ nɛ e pee nɔ́ nɛ e tsui suɔ. 18Ke Israel bi ya tɔ dã kikɛ nɛ ɔ, a bɔɔ ajuama, nɛ a bua jɔɔ. Zo níhi a he a nyaa, pi níhi nɛ maa wo a hɛ mi nyami. 19A maa be kɛ ho kaa bɔ nɛ kɔɔhiɔ woɔ nɔ́; nɛ zo maa gbe mɛ ngɛ bɔ ɔmɛ nɛ a sãã a he.

Title: HOSEA 5
Content:
1“Nyɛ osɔfohi, nyɛɛ bu tue! Israel ma nyɛ tã tue! Matsɛ we mi bimɛ, nyɛɛ bu tue! Nyɛ sa tue gblami! Ejakaa nyɛ pee kaa klama nɛ a tsɔ ngɛ Mizpa, kɛ yá nɛ a wo ngɛ Tabor yo ɔ nɔ, 2nɛ Akasia ma a hu pee kaa muɔ voo kɛ e mi yayami peeli kpanakuhi sɔuu. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ma gbla nyɛ tsuo nyɛ tue! 3Israel, i le bɔ nɛ o ngɛ ha; o be nyɛe maa laa ngɛ ye hɛ mi. O yi mi anɔkuale; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, o ble o he.”
Hosea tu munyu kɛ si amaga jami
4Yayami nɛ ma a pee ɔ ha we nɛ a nyɛ nɛ a kpale kɛ ba a Mawu ɔ ngɔ. Amaga jami ngɔ a tsui kulaa, nɛ a li Yawɛ hu. 5Israel bi a he nɔ womi ɔ yeɔ odase kɛ siɔ mɛ. A he yayami ɔ kɛ tue gblami maa ba a nɔ, nɛ Yuda hu be e he yee. 6A maa ngɔ tohi, kɛ nahi kɛ ba sã bɔ ha Yawɛ, se a be lɛ nae; ejakaa Yawɛ je a se. 7A yi Mawu anɔkuale; a kɛ ni kpahi ya fɔ bimɛ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e be kɛe kulaa nɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ, kɛ a zugba a tsuo hɛ mi ma kpata.
Yuda kɛ Israel hwu ta
8Nyɛ kpa titimati ngɛ Betaven! Nyɛ ha nɛ a nu he ngɛ Rama! Nyɛ he ose ngɛ Betel! Nyɛ Benyamin bi, nyɛ gba ta! 9Tue gblami be ɔ su ta, nɛ a ma kpata Israel hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ. Ee, Israel ma, nɔ́ nɛ maa ba nyɛ nɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
10Yawɛ ke, “Ye mi mi wo la, ejakaa Yuda ma nimeli ɔmɛ ya tua Israel ma a, nɛ a kpɔ zugba ngɛ a dɛ. Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, ma ngɔ ye abofu ɔ kɛ kple a nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ ke pa hia nɛ e puɛɔ ní ɔ. 11Israel ngɛ nɔ́ nae; a gbla e tue wawɛɛ, ejakaa e ya nyɛɛ yakayaka níhi a se. 12Ma kpata Israel hɛ mi kaa bɔ nɛ wɔyewɔye yeɔ kuutu, nɛ Yuda ma a hu maa pee kaa nɔ́ sasɛ ko nɛ gbli kɛ fɔɔ si.
13“Benɛ Israel na kaa e hiɔ ɔ nya ba wa, nɛ Yuda hu na kaa e plaa wawɛɛ nitsɛ ɔ, Israel ho Asiria matsɛ ɔ ngɔ ya ya bi yemi kɛ buami. Se e nyɛ we nɛ e tsa hiɔ ɔ ha Israel, nɛ pa amɛ hu e nyɛ we nɛ e pee nɔ́ ko ngɛ a he. 14Imi Yawɛ, ma tsɔtslɔɔ Israel kɛ Yuda a mi ngɔ pue si kaa jata peeɔ nɔ́. Ma ngɔ mɛ kɛ ho; nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be nyɛe ma kpɔ mɛ ngɛ ye dɛ.
15“Ma ngmɛɛ ye ma a he, konɛ a na nɔ́ wawɛɛ. Kɛkɛ ɔ, a ma pia a he ngɛ a yayami ɔmɛ a he, nɛ a ma hla ye se blɔ. Ke a yi fi ɔ, a ma ba kpa mi pɛɛ.”

Title: HOSEA 6
Content:
Ma a tsake a tsui fa kɛ fa
1Ma a ma de ke, “Nyɛ ha nɛ waa kpale kɛ ba Yawɛ ngɔ! E tsɔtslɔɔ wa mi, se e ma tsa wɔ kɛ̃. E plaa wɔ, se lɛ nɔuu lɛ e maa fi pa amɛ a nɔ ha wɔ! 2Ngɛ ligbi enyɔ mi ɔ, e ma ha wa na he wami ekohu; ligbi etɛne ɔ, e ma wo wa nɔ nɛ waa kɛ lɛ maa hi si. 3Nyɛ ha waa bɔ mɔde nɛ waa le Yawɛ saminya. Kaa bɔ nɛ je naa daa ligbi, nɛ hiɔmi hu nɛɛɔ ngɔ pueɔ zugba daa gbo kɛ gbiɛ ɔ, ke wa hla Yawɛ se blɔ ɔ, lɛ hu e maa ba wa ngɔ.”
4Se Yawɛ ke, “Israel kɛ Yuda, kɛ ma pee nyɛ kɛɛ? Suɔmi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ kɛ ha mi ɔ ngɛ kaa afua nɛ wo mɔtu, loo bɔ́ nɛ́ nɛ; bɔɔ kɛkɛ e se po. 5Enɛ ɔ he je nɛ i tsɔ ye gbali ɔmɛ nɛ a ba bɔ nyɛ kɔkɔ kaa ma gbla nyɛ tue ɔ nɛ. I ke a maa gbla nyɛ tue kaa bɔ nɛ oslabai gbaa a. 6 Nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ hlae ngɛ nyɛ dɛ kɛkɛ ji suɔmi nɛ ngɛ daa; pi bɔ sami. Ma suɔ kaa nyɛɛ le imi Mawu ɔ mohu, pe kaa nyɛ maa sã sami bɔ kɛ sa ye hɛ mi!
7“Se benɛ ma a ya su he ko nɛ a tsɛɛ ke Adam ɔ, a kua mi; somi nɛ i kɛ mɛ so ɔ, a yi nɔ hu. 8Yayami peeli, kɛ muɔ si pueli hiɛ tɔtɔɔtɔ ngɛ Gilead ma a mi. 9Osɔfo ɔmɛ buaa a he nya kaa bɔ nɛ ojo fiali woɔ ka haa nihi ɔ. Shekem blɔ nɔ po, a poo nɔ nɛ a gbeɔ nɔ basabasa. A peeɔ yiku níhi babauu. 10I na nɔ́ ko ngɛ Israel nɛ ha nɛ ye he mi po; ye ma a ngɔ yahomi kɛ ble a he.
11“Yuda bi, nyɛ hu i to be nɛ ma gbla nyɛ tue ngɛ yayami nɛ nyɛ ngɛ pee ɔ he.

Title: HOSEA 7
Content:
1“Be tsuaa be nɛ i hla kaa ma tsa ye ma Israel hiɔ ɔ, yi wu tso ní peemi, kɛ ní yayahi sɔuu i naa ngɛ Samaria. A sisiɔ a sibi, a sɛɛ wehi a mi ya juɔ, nɛ a yeɔ ojo ngɛ blɔ ɔmɛ a nɔ. 2E bɛ a juɛmi mi gblee kaa bɔ tsuaa bɔ nɛ pee ɔ, a he yayami nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo fɔɔ si paa ngɛ ye hɛ mi nɛ i ngɛ hyɛe.”
A so kɛ wo matsɛ ɔ kɛ ma nimeli ɔmɛ a he
3Yawɛ ke, “Nihi toɔ ga yayahi nɛ a kɛ sisiɔ matsɛ ɔ kɛ e nimeli ɔmɛ. 4Dikali kɛ atuã tsɔli ji mɛ tsuo. Ninyɛ nɛ nya wa wawɛɛ nitsɛ lɛ ngɛ a mi. Ninyɛ ɔ jeɔ sisi kaa flɔɔnɔɔ mi la nɛ ngɛ tsoe tikɔɔ hluu kɛ ya suu be nɛ mamu ɔ ma fu saminya, nɛ́ abolo sãlɔ ɔ ma klɛ la a mi, konɛ e tso gegeege. 5Ke matsɛ ɔ ngɛ e fɔmi ligbi yee ɔ, e kɛ e ma nimeli ɔmɛ nuɔ dã nɛ a deɔ, kɛkɛ a bɔni biɛmi. 6Niinɛ, ke a ngɛ ga yaya amɛ toe ɔ, a mi mi fuɔ kaa flɔɔnɔɔ kɛ e mi la gegeege. Nyɔ mi tsuo ɔ, la a tsoɔ tikɔɔ, se ke je na a, e tsoɔ gegeege.
7“Benɛ a mi mi fu wawɛɛ ɔ, a gbe a ma nimeli ɔmɛ tsuo. A to nya nɛ a gbe a matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ kakaaka; nɛ mɛ hu a ti nɔ ko kpa we ngmlaa nɛ e tsɛ mi.”
Israel kɛ je ma amɛ
8Yawɛ ke, “Israel ma a ngɛ kaa abolo nɛ be fa kɛ fa. Israel ngɔ e hɛ ngɔ fɔ mahi nɛ bɔle lɛ ɔ a nɔ, 9nɛ nibwɔ ɔmɛ butu ma a, se e li. Israel li tete kaa e nyagbe su ta. 10Israel ma a yeɔ fɔ kaa a wo a he nɔ kɛ si Mawu, se enɛ ɔ tsuo mi ɔ, a hla we Yawɛ, a Mawu ɔ se blɔ nɛ a kpale kɛ ba e ngɔ. 11Israel ngɛ kaa beleku lahuɛ nɛ ngɛ tee kɛ ngɛ yae kɛ ngɛ bae; e be juɛmi. Ke o ke o hyɛɛ ɔ, Israel bi ji nɛ nɛ a yaa bi yemi kɛ buami ngɛ Egipt; pee se kɛkɛ a pue Asiria blɔ. 12Be mi nɛ a yaa a, ma nyɛɛ a se nɛ ma kpale mɛ kɛ ba ekohu, kaa lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ nɛ te kɛ bee nɛ a ya du yá. Ma gbla a tue ngɛ a yi wu tso ní ɔmɛ a he.
13“Musu tloo mɛ! Ma kpata a hɛ mi; ejakaa a tsɔ ye hɛ mi atuã, nɛ a je ye se. I hla kaa ma he a yi wami; se a ja we mi anɔkuale mi. 14Ke a ngɛ kue fae ha mi ɔ, e ji a tsui mi; awe sɔuu a hii nyae ngɛ sa mi. Ke a ngɛ sɔlee nɛ ma ha mɛ blɛfo kɛ dã a, a kɛ nɔ́ poɔ a he basabasa kaa wɔ jali. Atuã tsɔli! 15Imi nitsɛ nɛ i tsɔse mɛ, nɛ i ha nɛ a he wa, se a soɔ kɛ woɔ ye he. 16A je ye se, nɛ mawu nɛ be he wami ko he wami ko ɔ, lɔ ɔ se a ngɛ nyɛɛe. A ngɛ kaa kɛ̃ɛ̃ nɛ kpɛ̃. A ma kpata a ma nimeli ɔmɛ a hɛ mi, ejakaa a tuɔ munyu puu; nɛ Egipt bi kɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ maa ye a he fɛu.”

Title: HOSEA 8
Content:
Yawɛ bu Israel ma a fɔ kaa a ja amaga
1Yawɛ ke, “Nyɛ kpa titimati! Ejakaa he nyɛli ma nɛ a ba tua ye zugba a kaa bɔ nɛ kɔle he sɔɔ kɛ saa nɔ́ ɔ. Somi nɛ i kɛ ye ma a so ɔ, a yi nɔ, nɛ a tɔ̃ ye mlaa amɛ hulɔ. 2A tsɛɔ mi ke a Mawu; a deɔ ke ye ma ji mɛ, nɛ a le mi. 3Se nɔ́ kpakpa a lɛɛ a sake ngɔ fɔ he. Enɛ ɔ he ɔ, a he nyɛli maa hia ta kɛ nyɛɛ a se.
4“Ye ma a wo matsɛmɛ nɛ i li he nɔ́ ko. A hla ma nimeli hu nɛ a bi we mi gbi. A ngɔ sika hiɔ, kɛ sika tsu kɛ puɛ amagahi nɛ ma kpata mɛ nitsɛmɛ a hɛ mi. 5Sika tsu na ku ɔ nɛ Samaria bi ɔmɛ jaa a peeɔ mi tai. Ye mi mi fu mɛ. Mɛni be po a ma kpa a we amaga nɛ ɔmɛ jami? 6Ga ní tsulɔ ko lɛ puɛ amaga a, pi mawu ji lɛ! Sika tsu amaga a nɛ ngɛ Samaria a, ma ku e mi dukuduku! 7Ejakaa ke a du kɔɔhiɔ ɔ, a ma kpa lasiogblee! Blɛfo ngmɔ nɛ wui ní ɔ, a be mamu nae kɛ je mi. Ke e wo yiblii po nibwɔhi ma ba ye lɛ tsuo. 8Israel yi ta pɛ! Israel pee kaa buɛ kokoe ngɛ ma amɛ a kpɛti; e he be se nami. 9Israel ma a tue wa kaa nga mi teji nɛ ngɛ si kpae. A ho ya bi Asiria bi yemi kɛ buami, nɛ a ya bɔ ma kpahi hu apaa ke a ba piɛ a he. 10A ya bɔ ma kpahi apaa ke a ba piɛ a he lɛɛ, se e be kɛe kulaa nɛ ma gbla a tue. Be kuku pɛ a be matsɛmɛ woe hu, nɛ a be ma nimeli hu hlae.
11“Israel ma a puɛ bɔ sami la tɛ babauu nɛ a kɛ ma je a he yayami, se yayami mohu a ngɛ pee ngɛ lejɛ ɔmɛ tsuo. 12Mlaa amɛ nɛ i wo mɛ ɔ, kaa imi hu i ngma mlaa amɛ tslalaa ja a, jinɛ tse a ko de ke a nɛ́ eko hyɛ. 13A gbeɔ lohwehi kɛ sãã bɔ kɛ haa mi, nɛ lo ɔ nɛ a kɛ ba sã bɔ ɔ lɛɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a yeɔ. Se imi Yawɛ, ye bua jɔɛ a he. Ma kai a he yayami ɔmɛ, nɛ ma gbla a tue kokooko ngɛ he; ma kpale mɛ kɛ ho Egipt ya!
14“Israel ma a hɛ je a bɔlɔ ɔ nɔ, nɛ a ya ma we nguanguahi. Yuda ma hu po mahi babauu nɛ a fia gbogbo ngɔ wo a he. Se ma ha la maa sã we nguangua amɛ, kɛ ma amɛ nɛ a fia gbogbo wo a he ɔ tsuo.”

Title: HOSEA 9
Content:
Hosea fiɛ ke a maa gbla Israel ma a tue
1Israel ma, nyɛ kpa nyami kaa bɔ nɛ je ma amɛ peeɔ ɔ. Nyɛ je nyɛ Mawu ɔ se, nɛ nyɛ yi lɛ anɔkuale. Nyɛ ngɔ nyɛ he ya mɛtɛ mawu ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Baal ɔ he ngɛ zugba a nɔ tsuo kaa yaholi. Ke blɛfo nya je ɔ, nyɛ ya sãã bɔ ha lɛ, nɛ nyɛ naa lɛ si. 2Ngma gbeemi he, kɛ wai muɔ mi ní be nyɛ nya sue. Wai he hu ma bɔ nyɛ. 3Israel be zugba nɛ ɔ nɔ hie daa. A maa kpale kɛ ho Egipt ya, nɛ niye ní nɛ he tsɔ we ɔ, lɔ ɔ a ma ya ye ngɛ Asiria. 4Israel bi be nyɛe maa ngɔ dã ba ha Yawɛ, nɛ ní nɛ a maa ye ɔ ma ble mɛ kaa ya sisi niye ní. A ma nyɛ maa ye kɛ gbe hwɔ kɛkɛ, pi kaa a maa ngɔ kɛ ya sã bɔ ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ. 5Lɛɛ ke nyami be ɔmɛ su ɔ, kɛ Israel ma a maa pee kɛɛ? Yawɛ nyami be ɔ, mɛni a maa pee? 6Ke Asiria bi ba nuu mɛ nyɔguɛ nɛ a gbɛ fĩa a, Egipt bi ma bua a nya; ee, a ma bua a nya ya pu mɛ ngɛ Memfis! Mio tso, kɛ pú maa bɔ kɛ pue a wehi, kɛ a sika hiɔ níhi nɛ he jua waa tsuo a nɔ.
7 Be nɛ a maa gbla Israel ma a tue ɔ su. Be ɔ su nɛ a maa wo mɛ hiɔ. Kɛkɛ ɔ, nɔ tsuaa nɔ maa hɛli si! Nyɛ deɔ ke, “Gbalɔ nɛ ɔ biɛ lo! Nyumu ɔ nɛ na mumi ɔ nu godo!” Nyɛ deɔ enɛ ɔ, ejakaa nyɛ he yayami hiɛ babauu; nɛ nyɛ sume mi saasaa. 8Mawu tsɔ imi, e gbalɔ ɔ, kaa ma ba tu munyu kɛ tsɔɔ e ma Israel ɔ. Se he tsuaa he nɛ ma ya a, nyɛ tsɔ̃ mi klama kaa a tsɔ̃ɔ̃ lohwe pɛlitsɛ klama. Mawu we ɔ nitsɛ po, ninyɛ sɔuu lɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. 9 Ma a puɛ kulaa kɛ yayami peemi kaa bɔ nɛ a pee ngɛ Gibea be ko ɔ. Yayami nɛ a pee ɔ, Mawu hɛ be nɔ jee; e maa gbla a tue kokooko.
Yawɛ maa gbla Israel ma a tue ngɛ a yayami ɔ he
10 Yawɛ ke, “Benɛ i na Israel ma a kekleekle ɔ, a ngɛ kaa wai yiblii ngɛ nga nɔ. Benɛ i na nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, a ngɛ kaa ngmɔkɔ he nɛ fu ngɛ e be mi. Se benɛ a ba su Peor yo ɔ he ɔ, a ba bɔni Baal jami. A kɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ble a he, nɛ a he pee tai kaa nɔ́ ɔ nɛ a ngɛ jae ɔ nɔuu. 11Israel hɛ mi nyami ɔ maa laa mɛ tlukaa kaa bɔ nɛ lohwe pɛlitsɛ tee. Yi ɔmɛ be fɔe hu; hɔ tete po a be ngɔe. 12Ke a fɔ tete po, ma ha a ma gbo bi hluu kɛ yaa si kake ngmelu po be piɛe. Musu tloo mɛ wawɛɛ ke i kua mɛ.”
13Imi Hosea, i na ngɛ nina mi nɛ Israel ngɔ e bimɛ ɔmɛ ngɔ ha kaa lohwehi nɛ a maa gbe. Bitsɛmɛ ɔmɛ nitsɛmɛ maa ngɔ a bimɛ ɔmɛ ya ha nɔ gbeli. 14Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yawɛ, i kpa mo pɛɛ, ke yi ɔmɛ ngɔ hɔ ɔ, hɔ ɔ nɛ sane, nɛ nyu nɛ ta a nyɔ mi.
Yawɛ gbla Israel ma a tue
15Yawɛ ke, “Israel ma a je a yayami peemi ɔ tsuo sisi ngɛ Gilgal, nɛ lejɛ ɔ a he bɔni mi tai peemi kɛ je. Yi wu tso níhi nɛ a pee ɔ a he ɔ, ma fie mɛ kɛ je zugba a nɔ. I be mɛ suɔe hu; Israel ma nimeli ɔmɛ tsuo tsɔ ye hɛ mi atuã. 16Israel ma a, musu tloo mɛ pɛ; a ngɛ kaa tso nɛ e sipoku gbli, nɛ e wui yiblii. A be fɔe; nɛ ke a fɔ tete po, bimɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a suɔ saminya a, ma kpata a hɛ mi.”
Gbalɔ ɔ tu Israel he munyu
17Ye Mawu ɔ ma kua e ma a; ejakaa a bui lɛ tue. A maa wo lalaalo ngɛ je ma amɛ a kpɛti.

Title: HOSEA 10
Content:
1Israel ma a ngɛ kaa wai tso nɛ wo yiblii babauu. Ke a ná ní ɔ, kɛkɛ a puɛ bɔ sami la tɛhi fuu. Titimahi nɛ a puɛ nɛ a jaa a, a dlaa a he nɛ a he peeɔ fɛu. 2A yi Mawu anɔkuale, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a maa gbla a tue ngɛ a yayami ɔmɛ a he. Yawɛ maa ku a bɔ sami la tɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ titima amɛ kɛ pue si.
3Kɛkɛ ɔ, a ma de ke, “Wa be matsɛ, ejakaa wa yi Yawɛ gbeye. Ke wa ngɛ matsɛ po, mɛni e ma nyɛ maa pee ha wɔ?” 4Nya puu sɔuu a peeɔ; a woɔ si nya mi gu. A kaa lakpa kita kɛ soɔ somihi. A plɛɔ nɔ́ nɛ da hɛ mi ngɔ buɔ si, nɛ nɔ́ nɛ dɛ hii nɔ yae. Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, munyu yemi heɔ si kaa bɔ nɛ hu yaya puɛɔ ngmɔ nɔ niba ní ɔ.
5Samaria bi maa ye gbeye, nɛ a maa ye kɔmɔ ngɛ sika tsu na ku ɔ nɛ ngɛ Betel nɛ a kpata e hɛ mi ɔ he. A kɛ lakpa osɔfo ɔmɛ tsuo ma nya awe kaa amaga a hɛ mi nyami ɔ laa mɛ. 6Niinɛ, amaga a nitsɛ lɛɛ a maa ngɔ kɛ ya Asiria kɛ ya ke matsɛ ngua a. Israel bi a hɛ mi ma pue si, nɛ zo maa gbe mɛ saminya ngɛ amaga nɛ a puɛ ɔ he. 7Samaria matsɛ ɔ hɛ mi ma kpata kaa tso kpoku ngɛ pa hɛ mi. 8 Wɔ piɛhi nɛ ngɛ Aven yoku ɔ nɔ, he nɛ Israel ma a ya jaa amaga amɛ ngɛ ɔ, a ma kpata a hɛ mi. Mio tso, kɛ hu maa bɔ kɛ pue a bɔ sami la tɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ. Nɛ Israel bi ma kpa ngmlaa ma de yo gagaa amɛ ke, “Nyɛ ba ha wa nɔ!” nɛ a ma de yoku ɔmɛ ke, “Nyɛ ba nɔ wa nɔ!”
Yawɛ maa gbla Israel tue
9 Yawɛ ke, “Kɛ je be nɛ Israel pee yayami kɛ si mi ngɛ Gibea a, anɛ e sɛ kaa ta ba naa mɛ ngɛ Gibea lo? 10Ma tua ma yayami peeli nɛ ɔmɛ, nɛ ma gbla a tue. Je mahi maa pee kake kɛ wo mɛ, nɛ a maa gbla a tue ngɛ a yayami babauu ɔ he.
11“Sa a, Israel ngɛ kaa na yiheyo nɛ a tsɔse lɛ saminya. Be tsuaa be ɔ, e suɔ kaa e gblɛ ngma. Se i pee ye yi mi kaa ma wo e kuɛ saminyayoo ɔ kuɛpã tso, konɛ e tsu ní kpakpataa. I ha Yuda gbla na kpakplaa tso ɔ, nɛ Israel hɛɛ ngmɔ nɔ dlami nɔ́ ɔ mi. 12 I de ke, ‘Nyɛɛ ye dami sane, konɛ ma suɔ nyɛ, nɛ ma gbaa nyɛ. Nyɛ tsake nyɛ tsui; ejakaa be ɔ su nɛ nyɛ ma hla imi Yawɛ, ye se blɔ. Kɛkɛ ɔ, ma ha dami sane yemi ma he si kaa bɔ nɛ hiɔmi nɛɛ ɔ.’ 13Yayami nɛ nyɛ du ɔ, e yiblii nɛ nyɛ kpa. Lakpa amɛ nɛ nyɛ ye ɔ, a mi nɔ́ nyɛ ngɛ nae ɔ nɛ.
“Nyɛ ngɔ nyɛ hɛ ngɔ fɔ nyɛ ta zugba lɛhi, kɛ nyɛ ta buli babauu ɔ a nɔ. 14Enɛ ɔ he ɔ, ta ma ba tua nyɛ, nɛ nyɛ mɔ ɔmɛ tsuo a hɛ mi ma kpata kaa bɔ nɛ Matsɛ Shalman kpata Betabel hɛ mi ngɛ ta mi ɔ. Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, a nuu nyɛmɛ kɛ a bimɛ tsuo ngɔ fiaa si nɛ a gbe mɛ. 15Betel bi, nɔ́ nɛ maa ba nyɛ nɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ; ejakaa nyɛ pee yayami gbegbeegbe. A ma kpata Israel matsɛ ɔ hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ ngɛ ta mi.”

Title: HOSEA 11
Content:
Mawu suɔ e ma atuã tsɔli ɔmɛ
1 Benɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ ngɛ kaa jokuɛwi ɔ, i suɔ a
sane, nɛ i je mɛ kɛ je Egipt.
2Se ke i hla kaa ma gbla mɛ kɛ ba ye ngɔ,
kɛkɛ a tsɔ atuã.
A ya sãã bɔ kɛ haa Baalhi,
nɛ a sãã tsopa kɛ e he via hu
kɛ haa amaga kpahi.
3Imi nɛ i tsɔse Israel ma a
kaa a tsɔɔ jokuɛ nyɛɛmi;
nɛ i hɛɛ mɛ dɔdɔɔdɔ kaa jokuɛyo
ngɛ ye nine bɔkɔ mi,
se a li kaa imi lɛ i baa a yi.
4Kaa bɔ nɛ nɔ ko maa wo na ku
nɛ e suɔ saminya a kuɛ kpa,
nɛ e ma kpaka lɛ ɔ,
ja i ngɔ suɔmi nɛ nya wa
kɛ hɛɛ Israel ma a.
I kɛ mɛ hi si ngɛ he jɔmi mi,
nɛ imi nitsɛ lɛ i ha mɛ niye ní.
5“Akɛnɛ a kua ye ngɔ bami ɔ, a maa kpale kɛ ho Egipt ya, nɛ Asiria maa ye a nɔ. 6Ta ma ba tua a ma amɛ; a maa ku a gbogbo ɔmɛ ngɔ pue si, nɛ a ma kpata a hɛ mi ngɛ a yi mi tomi ɔmɛ a he. 7Ye ma a fia pɛɛ si kaa a ma kua mi; enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, ma gbla a tue, nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be nyɛe maa je ngmlaa ha mɛ.
8 “Israel ma, kɛ maa pee kɛɛ
nɛ ma ngmɛɛ nyɛ he?
Kɛ maa pee kɛɛ nɛ ma kua nyɛ?
Kɛ maa pee kɛɛ nɛ ma kpata nyɛ hɛ mi
kaa bɔ nɛ i pee Adma a?
Kɛ maa pee kɛɛ nɛ ma wa nyɛ yi mi kaa bɔ nɛ
i pee Zeboyim ɔ?
Ye tsui be mi blɔ ngmɛe kaa ma pee jã!
Suɔmi nɛ i ngɛ kɛ ha nyɛ ɔ nya wa tsɔ!
9I be nyɛ tue gblae ngɛ ye mi mi fumi ɔ nya.
I be Israel hɛ mi kpatae hu.
Ejakaa Mawu ji mi, pi nɔmlɔ adesa ji mi.
Imi Nɔ Klɔuklɔu ɔ, i kɛ nyɛ ngɛ.
I be nyɛ ngɔ bae kɛ abofu.”
10“Ke i huã kikɛ nɛ ɔ kaa jata a, ye ma a maa nyɛɛ ye se. A he maa sɔ kɛ maa je bonyoku je kɛ ba. 11A maa je Egipt kɛ ba kɛ fo kaa lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ. A maa je Asiria kɛ maa ba kaa lahuɛhi. Ma kpale mɛ kɛ ba a we ɔmɛ a mi ekohu. Imi Yawɛ lɛ i de.”
A bu Israel kɛ Yuda fɔ
12Yawɛ ke, “Lakpa sɔuu Israel ma a ngɛ yee, nɛ a ngɛ nihi sisie ngɛ ye hɛ mi paa. Se imi Mawu, i le bɔ nɛ Yuda hu ngɛ kɛ ba si amlɔ nɛ ɔ. Yuda ma a ngɛ imi Nɔ Klɔuklɔu ɔ anɔkuale yee kɛ mwɔɔ.

Title: HOSEA 12
Content:
1“Daa nyɔ kɛ pia a, yi wu tso níhi, kɛ níhi nɛ a he be se nami sɔuu Israel ma a ngɛ pee. A sisiɔ nɔ, nɛ a pueɔ muɔ si. A kɛ Asiria ngɛ huɛ bɔe, nɛ Egipt lɛɛ a kɛ lɛ yeɔ nu jua.”
2Yawɛ kɛ Yuda ma a ná. E maa gbla Israel ma a hu tue ngɛ a je mi bami he. A he yayami ɔmɛ a he ɔ, e maa gbla a tue. 3 Israel bi ɔmɛ a nɛ̃, Yakob nu e nyɛminyumu hayo ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Esau ɔ nane seja benɛ mɛ ni enyɔ ɔmɛ a ngɛ a nyɛ muklii mi nɛ a fɔ we mɛ lolo ɔ; nɛ benɛ Yakob ba wa a, e kɛ Mawu fia atlibo. 4 Niinɛ, e kɛ Mawu bɔfo nɔ kunɔ, nɛ e ye e nɔ. E fo ya ngɔ pue bɔfo ɔ nɔ, nɛ e de lɛ ke e gbaa lɛ. E kɛ Mawu kpe ngɛ Betel, nɛ Mawu kɛ lɛ tu munyu ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. 5Lɛ ji Yawɛ Tabohiatsɛ Mawu; Yawɛ ji e biɛ. 6Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yakob nina, nyɛɛ ngɔ nyɛ hɛ ngɔ fɔ nyɛ Mawu ɔ nɔ, nɛ nyɛɛ kpale kɛ ba e ngɔ. Nyɛɛ suɔ lɛ anɔkuale mi, nɛ́ nyɛɛ ye dami sane. Nyɛɛ to nyɛ tsui si, nɛ́ nyɛɛ hyɛ nyɛ Mawu ɔ blɔ.
Tue gblami kpahi
7Yawɛ ke, “Jua yelɔ nɛ ngɔɔ lakpa sɛni kɛ e nɔ sɛni tɛ kɛ juaa ní ɔ, nɔ sisilɔ ji lɛ. 8Bɔ nɛ Israel ma a deɔ ji, ‘Niatsɛmɛ ji wɔ. Wa ná ní babauu.’ Se ní nɛ a na babauu ɔ tsuo be nyɛe ma je a he yayami ɔ. 9 Imi ji Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ nɛ. Imi nɛ i je nyɛ kɛ je Egipt zugba a nɔ. Ma ha nyɛ maa hi bo tsuhi a mi ekohu kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ hi si be ko ngɛ nga kplanaa a nɔ ɔ.
10“Imi lɛ i kɛ gbali ɔmɛ tu munyu. Imi nɛ i je ninahi ha mɛ, nɛ i gu gbali ɔmɛ a nɔ nɛ i kɛ ye ma a tu munyu ngɛ abɛ gbi mi. 11Se kɛ̃, a ngɛ yayami pee kɛ mwɔɔ; a jaa amaga ngɛ Gilead, nɛ a kɛ na ku sãã bɔ ngɛ Gilgal. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ma kpata a hɛ mi; bɔ sami la tɛ ɔmɛ hu maa ywia, nɛ tɛ ɔmɛ ma pue si glekuu glekuu ngɛ ngmɔ ɔmɛ a mi.”
12 Wa nɛ̃, Yakob tu fo kɛ ho Mesopotamia ya, nɛ e ya ye apaa ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Bɔ nɛ pee nɛ e na yo nɛ e ngɔ ɔ, e ya hyɛ nɔ ko tohi a nɔ. 13 Yawɛ ha nɛ gbalɔ ko ya je e ma Israel kɛ je Egipt. Gbalɔ nɛ ɔ tsɔɔ mɛ blɔ, nɛ e hyɛ a nɔ. 14Israel ma a wo Yawɛ mi mi la wawɛɛ nitsɛ. Yi wu tso níhi nɛ a pee he je ɔ, a sa gbenɔ. Yawɛ maa gbla a tue ngɛ e hɛ mi si nɛ a pue ɔ he.

Title: HOSEA 13
Content:
Nyagbe tue gblami nɛ Israel ma ná
1Be ko nɛ be ɔ, ke Efraim wɛtso ɔ de nɔ́ ko ɔ, Israel wɛtso kpa amɛ yee gbeye; ejakaa a buu Efraim saminya. Se ma a pee yayami kaa a ya ja Baal; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a ma gbo. 2A ngɛ yayami pee kɛ mwɔɔ. A ngɛ amagahi jae. Se amaga nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, nimli a juɛmi kɛ a nine nya ní tsumi nɛ a kɛ sika hiɔ pee ji mɛ. Amagahi nɛ a ngɛ kaa na bi ɔ, ní nɛ ɔmɛ nyɛ ke a sã bɔ ha lo? Kɛ nimli adesahi maa pee kɛɛ nɛ a ma fiɔ ní nɛ ɔmɛ a nya he? 3Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ma ha nɛ a hɛ mi ma kpata si kake too, nɛ a be mɛ nae hu, kaa mɔtu bɔku, loo bɔ́, loo jakati nɛ kɔɔhiɔ muɔ kɛ je ngma mi sami he, loo la su ku nɛ je la su ku tɔ mi.
4Yawɛ ke, “Imi ji Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ nɛ je nyɛ kɛ je Egipt ɔ nɛ. Imi pɛ ji nyɛ Mawu. Imi nɔ kake too pɛ ji nyɛ kpɔlɔ. 5 Imi nɛ i hyɛ nyɛ nɔ ngɛ nga kplanaa a nɔ, he nɛ nyu ko nyu ko be. 6Se benɛ nyɛ ye ní nɛ nyɛ tɔ saminya a, nyɛ wo nyɛ he nɔ, nɛ nyɛ hɛ je ye nɔ. 7Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ma ba tua nyɛ kaa jata. Ma wo nyɛ ka ngɛ blɔ he kaa ngatsɛ. 8Ma ba tua nyɛ kaa osisiblisi nɛ a nu e bimɛ. Ma fɛ nyɛ mi, nɛ ma ye lo ɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ nɔuu kaa jata; ma tsɔtslɔɔ nyɛ mi kaa bɔ nɛ lohwe dikalɔ peeɔ ɔ.
9“Israel ma, ma kpata nyɛ hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ! Nɛ, mɛnɔ ma nyɛ ma kpɔ nyɛ? 10 Nyɛ bi ke a to matsɛ ha nyɛ, nɛ nyɛ bi hu ke a ha nyɛ asafoatsɛmɛ; se nimli nɛ ɔmɛ ma nyɛ ma he nyɛ yi wami lo? 11 I kɛ abofu to matsɛmɛ ha nyɛ, nɛ i kɛ mi mi la kpa mɛ.
12“Israel ma a pee yayami; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a yeɔ fɔ. A kadi enɛ ɔmɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ ngɔ to. 13Israel ma a li nɔ́; a tue wa; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a maa na nɔ́. A ngɛ kaa bi nɛ kua kpo jemi ngɛ e nyɛ mi mi benɛ e nyɛ nu kɔɔmi. 14 Anɛ ma kpɔ mɛ kɛ je gbeje lo? Anɛ ma he mɛ kɛ je gbenɔ dɛ mi lo? Gbenɔ, jije o hiɔ nɛ gbee nɔ ɔ ngɛ? Gbeje, jije nɔ́ nɛ a kɛ kpataa nɔ hɛ mi ɔ ngɛ? I be ma nɛ ɔ mɔbɔ nae hu. 15Ke Israel ma a ngɛ plɔkee, nɛ e pee plɔplɔɔplɔ kaa nga po, ma ha kɔɔhiɔ nɛ mi dɔ la maa fia kɛ je nga kplanaa a nɔ ngɛ beleku je kɛ ba. Kɔɔhiɔ ɔ ma ha nɛ nyu maa ta a vu ɔmɛ a mi, nɛ pa amɛ maa mii. Ma ha a juetli tsuo maa ta. 16A maa gbla Samaria tue, ejakaa e tsɔ ye hɛ mi atuã. Ta ma kpata ma a mi bi ɔmɛ a hɛ mi; a maa ngɔ a bimwɔwi ɔmɛ ngɔ fiaa si, nɛ a kɛ klaate ma fɛ yihɔyi ɔmɛ a mi mi.”

Title: HOSEA 14
Content:
Hosea tu munyu kɛ tsɔɔ Israel ma a
1Israel ma, nyɛɛ kpale kɛ ba Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ ngɔ. Nyɛ yayami ɔmɛ ha nɛ nyɛ pee kaa ni komɛ nɛ tɛ nɔ́ nɛ a nɔɔ si. 2Nyɛɛ kpale kɛ ba Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ ngɔ. Nyɛ ba fa kue ha lɛ, nɛ nyɛ de lɛ ke, “Ngɔɔ wa he yayami ɔmɛ kɛ pa wɔ; nɛ o bu wa kue fami ɔ tue, konɛ wa je o yi kaa bɔ nɛ wa wo si ɔ. 3Asiria be nyɛe ma he wa yi wami. Wa be wa he ngɔe kɛ fɔ ta okpɔngɔhi a nɔ. Wa be wa amaga amɛ dee hu ke mɛ ji wa Mawu. Yawɛ, mo nɛ o naa awusahi mɔbɔ.”
Yawɛ wo si ke e ma ha Israel wami he
4Yawɛ ke, “Ma ha ye ma a maa kpale kɛ ba
ye ngɔ kɛ a tsui tsuo,
ejakaa ye mi mi nɛ fu mɛ ɔ se po!
5Ma ha Israel ma a ma plɔke plɔplɔɔplɔ
kaa zugba gbigbli nɛ hiɔmi nɛ pue nɔ.
6A ma na wami he, nɛ a maa bɔ.
A he maa pee fɛu kaa oliv tsohi,
nɛ a maa je via kaa seda tsohi
ngɛ Lebanon.
7A maa kpale kɛ ba ye ngɔ ekohu,
nɛ a kɛ mi maa hi si ngɛ he jɔmi mi.
A maa bɔ kaa ngmɔ nɛ ba ní saminya,
nɛ a ma plɔke kaa wai tso;
nɛ a biɛ ma he si kaa Lebanon wai.
8Israel ma, mɛni peemi i kɛ amagahi ngɛ?
Imi nɛ i buu nyɛ kue fami tue
nɛ i hyɛɛ nyɛ nɔ.
I ngɛ kaa sɛsɛo tso
nɛ ba mumu tɛ̃ e nɔ gblegbleegble.
Imi lɛ i haa ma a niye ní.”
Nyagbe
9Mɛnɔ ji ní lelɔ?
Ha nɛ e nu ní nɛ ɔmɛ a sisi.
Mɛnɔ lɛ nuɔ nɔ́ sisi?
Ha nɛ e yɔse.
Ejakaa Yawɛ blɔ ɔmɛ da tlɔmɔɔ,
nɛ nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a
nyɛɛɔ nɔ tɛɛ.
Se yayami peeli lɛɛ a tɛɔ nɔ́, nɛ a nɔɔ si.

Title: YOEL NYA TSƆƆMI
Content:
NYA TSƆƆMI
A li gbalɔ Yoel he sane tsɔ ko; nɛ a li be tutuutu nɛ e hi si hulɔ. Se e peeɔ kaa womi nɛ ɔ mi sane je blema lokoo ngɛ Persia nɔ yemi be ɔ mi, maa pee jeha lafa enuɔ, loo lafa eywiɛ loko a fɔ Kristo.
Yoel womi ɔ gbaa bɔ nɛ baalɛ babauu kaa ta buli ma ba tua Palestina zugba a, nɛ e maa pee gbeye, kɛ bɔ nɛ sapu nɛ nya wa ma ba ha níhi a hɛ mi ma kpata ngɛ zugba a nɔ. Gbalɔ ɔ na kaa níhi nɛ maa ba nɛ ɔ tsɔɔ kaa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ligbi ɔ ma; nɛ jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ maa gbla nihi nɛ tee si kɛ siɔ e suɔmi nya ní ɔ a tue. Gbalɔ ɔ de ma a ke, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ke a tsake a tsui. Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ngɛ mɛ si woe kaa ke a pee ja a, e maa kpale ma a kɛ ba ma e glɛ nɔ ekohu, nɛ e maa gbaa mɛ.
Womi nɛ ɔ mi munyu nɛ he hia saminya ji kaa Mawu wo si ke e ma ha e mumi ɔ maa ba nimli adesahi tsuo a nɔ: nyumuhi, yihi, jokuɛwi, kɛ nikɔtɔmahi.
Bɔ nɛ a dla womi ɔ mi ha
Haomi nɛ baalɛ ɔmɛ kɛ maa ba 1.1—2.17
Mawu wo si ke e maa kpale e ma a kɛ ba ma e glɛ nɔ ekohu 2.18-27
Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ligbi ɔ 2.28—3.21

Title: YOEL 1
Content:
1Yawɛ sɛ gbi nɛ e kɛ ha Petuel binyumu Yoel, ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Ma a ye kɔmɔ ngɛ ngmɔ ní nɛ hɛ mi kpata a he
2Nyɛ ma nimeli, nyɛɛ bu tue;
nyɛ Yuda ma a tsuo, nyɛ ta tue.
Anɛ nɔ́ ko kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ ba hyɛ ngɛ nyɛ yi nɔ,
aloo ngɛ nyɛ nɛmɛ a yi nɔ lo?
3Nyɛɛ sɛɛ ha nyɛ bimɛ.
Nyɛ bimɛ nɛ a sɛɛ ha a bimɛ,
konɛ nyɛ bimɛ a bimɛ hu nɛ a sɛɛ ha yi nɔ nɛ maa nyɛɛ a se ɔ.
4Baalɛ kuuhi babauu ba,
ba puɛ ngmɔ niba ní tsuo:
Kekleekle kuu ɔ ba poo ní, nɛ a kpe.
Enyɔne ɔ ba kpe niba ní nɛ piɛ ɔ.
Etɛne ɔ ba kpe kakaaka nɛ piɛ ngɛ se ɔ.
Nyagbe kuu ɔ ba ye niba ní nɛ piɛ ngɛ sisi ɔ tsuo.
5Nyɛ dã deli, nyɛ hɛ nɛ tsɛ, nɛ nyɛɛ wo yana; nyɛ wai dɔkɔdɔkɔ nuli, nyɛ nya awe;
ejakaa a je nɔ́ ngɛ nyɛ nya mi.
6 Baalɛ babauu ba tua zugba a;
a ngɛ kaa ta buli pɛ; a he wa, nɛ a he hiɛ;
a lungu nya ba kaa jata ku lungu,
nɛ a so hu ngɛ kaa jata yo so.
7A kpata wa wai tso ɔmɛ a hɛ mi,
nɛ a kpe wa ngmɔkɔ tso ɔmɛ.
A kpe toto ɔ ngɛ tso ɔmɛ a he kɛ ya si tso kɔni ɔmɛ a he pee futaa.
8Nyɛ nya awe kaa bɔ nɛ yomiyo nyɛɛ ya
kɛ haa nyumu nɛ na we nɛ e kpee lɛ loko e gbo ɔ.
9Niye ní kɛ wai nɛ a kɛ ba sãã bɔɔ se po ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ mi;
lɔ ɔ he ɔ, osɔfo ɔmɛ nɛ sɔmɔɔ ngɛ Yawɛ we ɔ ngɛ kɔmɔ yee.
10Ngmɔ ɔmɛ a hɛ mi kpata;
zugba a pee mɔbɔmɔbɔ kaa nɔ́ nɛ kɔmɔ e ngɛ yee;
ejakaa blɛfo ɔ hɛ mi kpata;
wai tso ɔmɛ gbli, nɛ oliv tso ɔmɛ ylɔ.
11Nyɛ ngmɔ huli, nyɛɛ ye kɔmɔ;
nyɛ nihi nɛ nyɛ hyɛɛ wai ngmɔhi a nɔ, nyɛ nya awe;
ejakaa ngma, akoko, kɛ ngmɔ nɔ ní tsuo hɛ mi kpata.
12Wai tso ɔmɛ, ngmɔkɔ tso ɔmɛ, kɛ tã amɛ ylɔ;
nɛ tso kpa amɛ tsuo gbli, nɛ a gbo.
Ma a bua jɔmi ɔ se po.
13Nyɛ osɔfohi nɛ nyɛ sɔmɔɔ ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he,
nyɛɛ ha kpekpe ya bo, nɛ nyɛɛ wo yana!
Nyɛɛ ya Mawu we ɔ mi,
nɛ nyɛ ya ye kɔmɔ nyɔnyɔɔnyɔ tsuo.
Ejakaa niye ní be ɔ, wai hu be nɛ
nyɛɛ kɛ maa sã bɔ ha nyɛ Mawu ɔ.
14Nyɛɛ wo mlaa nɛ ma a tsuo nɛ ha hwɔ;
nɛ a ba bua a he nya.
Nyɛ bua Yuda ma nimeli ɔmɛ, kɛ ma a tsuo a nya
ngɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ we ɔ
nɛ nyɛɛ fa kue ha lɛ.
15 Yawɛ ligbi ɔ su ta;
ligbi nɛ Ope ɔ ma kpata wa hɛ mi ɔ su.
E maa pee gbeye jamɛ a ligbi ɔ!
16Pi wa niba ní nɛ wa ngɛ hyɛe nɛ hɛ mi ngɛ kpatae nɛ ɔ?
Bua jɔmi, kɛ nyami se po ngɛ wa Mawu ɔ we ɔ.
17Níhi nɛ a du ɔ tsuo gbo ngɛ zu mi.
A na we ngma a eko kulaa nɛ a kɛ maa to.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, blɛfo gba amɛ a mi je gu,
nɛ a ku kɛ pueɔ si.
18Hyɛ bɔ nɛ we mi lohwehi ngɛ kɛmɛe ha!
Na amɛ hao, ejakaa a nɛ nga nɛ a kpe; to ɔmɛ hu ngɛ nɔ́ nae jã kɛ̃.
19Yawɛ, i ngɛ kue fae kɛ ngɛ mo tsɛe;
ejakaa la sã tso ɔmɛ tsuo ngɛ nga a nɔ.
La kpata lohwe lɛmi he ɔmɛ tsuo
a hɛ mi ngɛ nya nɔ!
20Nga mi lohwe ɔmɛ po ngɛ ngmlaa kpae kɛ ngɛ mo tsɛe;
ejakaa pa amɛ tsuo gbli, nɛ la hu kpata lohwe lɛmi he ɔmɛ a hɛ mi ngɛ nga a nɔ.

Title: YOEL 2
Content:
Baalɛ ji Yawɛ ligbi ɔ he okadi
1Nyɛ kpa titimati ngɛ Zion,
ngɛ Mawu yo klɔuklɔu ɔ nɔ.
Nyɛ Yuda zugba a nɔ bi tsuo,
nyɛɛ ye gbeye, nɛ nyɛ he nɛ do blibliibli!
Ejakaa Yawɛ ligbi ɔ su ta.
2Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ,
je mi ma yu tuu; nɛ je mi tsuo pee mɔbɔmɔbɔ.
Baalɛ maa ha yo ɔmɛ a nɔ tuu
kaa ta buli nɛ a he ngɛ gbeye.
Enɛ ɔ eko bɛ hyɛ,
nɛ eko hu be bae ja gblegbleegble.
3A maa ye nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ pɛsɛpɛsɛ
kaa bɔ nɛ la sãã nɔ́ ɔ.
Ngɛ a hɛ kpɛ ɔ,
zugba a maa hi kaa Eden
ngmɔ ɔ mi pɛ;
a se je ɔ maa pee zugba kplanaa.
A be nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko piɛe.
4 Baalɛ ɔmɛ maa pee kaa okpɔngɔhi;
a maa tu fo kaa ta okpɔngɔhi.
5A maa tuu ngɛ yo ɔmɛ a nɔ,
nɛ a nane si maa hi pɛe kaa ta zugba lɛhi;
nɛ ke a ngɛ ní kpee ɔ,
e maa pɛ kaa nga nɛ ngɛ sãe.
A maa to slɛnɛɛ kaa tabo ngua ko nɛ gba ta kɛ ma.
6Ke a ma kikɛ nɛ ɔ,
sawale maa nu nɔ tsuaa nɔ,
nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ hɛ mi ma tsake maa pee mɔbɔmɔbɔ.
7Bɔ nɛ katsɛmɛ tuaa a he nyɛli,
loo ta buli kuɔ gbogbo ɔ,
ja baalɛ nɛ ɔmɛ maa pee a ní.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ maa ya e hɛ kpɛ tɛɛ;
a ti ekoeko be e blɔ nɔ jee,
8nɛ nɔ ko be e nyɛmi hlami poe hulɔ.
A maa gblee níhi a mi kɛ be slɔkee,
nɛ nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko be mɛ blɔ tsie.
9A maa tuu kɛ sɛ ma a mi;
a maa ma fo ngɛ gbogbo ɔmɛ a nɔ,
nɛ a maa kuɔ kɛ gu saflɛhi a mi,
kɛ sɛ wehi a mi kaa juli.
10 Ke a ma kikɛ nɛ ɔ,
zugba ma mimiɛ, nɛ hiɔwe ma si;
pu kɛ nyɔhiɔ maa wo diblii,
nɛ dodoe be kpɛe hu.
11 Yawɛ maa wo gbi
kɛ fa e tabo ɔ he.
E ta buli ɔmɛ a he hiɛ babauu;
nihi nɛ buɔ Yawɛ tue ɔ,
a li a yibɔ.
Yawɛ ligbi ɔ maa pee gbeye.
Mɛnɔ ma nyɛ nya maa da?
Yawɛ de ke a tsake a tsui
12Yawɛ ke,
“Nyɛ tsake nyɛ tsui anɔkuale mi,
nɛ nyɛɛ kpale kɛ ba ye ngɔ nɔuu.
Nyɛɛ ha hwɔ; nyɛɛ wo yana,
nɛ nyɛɛ ye kɔmɔ.
13Nyɛ ha nɛ e hao nyɛ ngɛ nyɛ tsui mi;
se pi kaa nyɛ ma hía nyɛ tadehi ngɛ nyɛ he kɛkɛ.”
Nyɛɛ kpale kɛ ba Yawɛ,
nyɛ Mawu ɔ ngɔ,
ejakaa e mi mi jɔ,
nɛ e naa mɔbɔ;
e toɔ e tsui si;
e yeɔ e siwo nɔ;
e mi mi fu we mla,
se mohu e kɛ nɔ́ paa.
14Alini, Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ,
ma tsake e susumi ngɛ nyɛ he,
nɛ e maa gbaa nyɛ kɛ niba ní babauu.
Ke e ba mi ja a,
nyɛ maa sã niye ní bɔ ha lɛ,
nɛ nyɛ maa ngɔ wai kɛ piɛ he.
15Nyɛ kpa titimati ngɛ Zion yo ɔ nɔ;
nyɛɛ wo mlaa nɛ ma a tsuo nɛ ha hwɔ,
nɛ a ba bua a he nya.
16Nyɛ bua ma a nya;
nyɛ ha nɛ a ba pee kpe klɔuklɔu.
Nyɛɛ kpee nikɔtɔma amɛ kɛ ba;
nyɛ bua jokuɛwi kɛ bimwɔwi ɔmɛ tsuo a nya.
Ayɛflo kɛ e huno po, a je kpo ngɛ a tsu mi kɛ ba.
17Osɔfo ɔmɛ nɛ sɔmɔɔ Yawɛ
ngɛ e we ɔ mi sinya a nya, kɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he ɔ,
a wo yana, nɛ a fa kue ke,
“Yawɛ, naa o ma a mɔbɔ.
Ko ha nɛ je ma kpa amɛ nɛ a bɔ wɔ ahlua,
nɛ a ye wa he fɛu, nɛ a bi wɔ ke,
‘Jije nyɛ Mawu ɔ ngɛ?’ ”
Mawu ha zugba a ba ní ekohu
18Pee se ɔ, Yawɛ kai e ma a,
nɛ e na mɛ mɔbɔ.
19Yawɛ de e ma a ke,
“Jehanɛ ma ha nyɛ blɛfo, kɛ wai,
kɛ oliv nu bɔ nɛ maa su nyɛ nya;
je ma kpa amɛ be nyɛ ahlua bɔe hu.
20Ma je baalɛ tabo nɛ je omleyi je ba tua nyɛ ɔ
kɛ je nyɛ he kɛ ho lokoo ya.
Ma fie fa kɛ ho zugba kplanaa a nɔ ya.
A hɛ kpɛ ta a ma ya pue Ngo wo ɔ mi,
nɛ a se ta a ma ya pue Mediterenia wo ɔ mi.
A gbogboe ɔmɛ maa je fu kanikani.
Ejakaa a pee nyɛ níhi nɛ nya wa.
21“Nyɛ ngmɔhi, nyɛ ko ye gbeye,
se mohu nyɛ bua nɛ jɔ nɛ nyɛ nya ngɛ ní nguanguahi
nɛ Yawɛ pee ha nyɛ ɔ he.
22Nyɛ nga mi lohwehi, nyɛ ko ye gbeye.
Nga mumu puɛ ngɛ nga a nɔ ngɛ lohwe lɛmi he ɔmɛ;
tso ɔmɛ ngɛ yiblii woe; ngmɔkɔ kɛ wai ba babauu.
23“Nyɛ Zion bi, nyɛ nya nɛ nyɛ bua nɛ jɔ ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ pee ha nyɛ ɔ he.
E ha gbo nyu nɛ ha nyɛ babauu;
gbiɛ nyu hu nɛ ha nyɛ bɔ nɛ sa, kaa kekle ko ɔ.
24Ngma mi sami he ɔmɛ ma hyi tɔ kɛ ngma,
nɛ muɔ ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ wai kɛ oliv nu ngami he ɔmɛ ma hyi, nɛ a maa fo dɔ kɛ wai, kɛ oliv nu.
25Ní nɛ baalɛ ɔmɛ ba ha
nɛ a ye jeha babauu ɔ, ma ha nyɛ ekohu.
Imi nitsɛ nɛ i je baalɛ slɔɔtoslɔɔtohi
a ta nguaa nɛ ɔ kɛ wo nyɛ ɔ nɛ.
26Jehanɛ lɛɛ, nyɛ maa ye ní
nɛ nyɛ maa tɔ.
Nyɛ ma je Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ yi
ngɛ nyakpɛ níhi nɛ e tsu ha nyɛ ɔ he.
A be ye ma a ahlua bɔe ligbi ko ligbi ko hu.
27Israel ma, jamɛ a be ɔ mi loko nyɛ maa le
kaa i kɛ nyɛ ngɛ.
Imi ji Yawɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ nɛ;
ye se ɔ, mawu kpa ko be hu.
A be ye ma a ahlua bɔe ligbi ko ligbi ko hu.
Yawɛ ligbi ɔ
28 “Pee se ɔ, ma plɛ ye mumi ɔ
kɛ pue nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɔ;
nyɛ binyumu ɔmɛ kɛ nyɛ biyi ɔmɛ maa fiɛ ye sɛ gbi ɔ;
nyɛ nimowi ɔmɛ maa nla nlamihi,
nɛ nyɛ nihewi ɔmɛ maa na ninahi.
29Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ,
ma plɛ ye mumu ɔ kɛ pue tsɔli, kɛ mawayihi po a nɔ.
30“Ma ha a maa na jamɛ a ligbi ɔ he okadi nɛ ɔmɛ
ngɛ hiɔwe, kɛ zugba a nɔ: muɔ, kɛ la,
kɛ la su ku kpii.
31 Pu maa wo diblii,
nɛ nyɔhiɔ maa pee tsutsuu kaa muɔ.
Lɔ ɔ se loko Yawɛ ligbi nguaa
nɛ ngɛ gbeye ɔ maa ba.
32 Se nihi tsuo nɛ ma sɔmɔ Yawɛ ɔ,
a ma he a yi wami.
Kaa bɔ nɛ Yawɛ de to ɔ,
‘Nihi nɛ ngɛ Yerusalem ɔ,
a ti ni komɛ a yi ma na wami;
mɛ ji ni nɛmɛ nɛ i hla a nɛ.’ ”

Title: YOEL 3
Content:
Mawu maa kojo je ma amɛ
1Yawɛ ke,
“Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ,
ma ha Yuda ma a kɛ Yerusalem bi ɔmɛ
ma na ní kpɔtɔɔ ekohu.
2Ma bua je ma amɛ tsuo a nya,
nɛ i kɛ mɛ maa ba Kojomi kɔ̃ ɔ mi.
Ma kojo mɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ,
ngɛ níhi tsuo nɛ a pee ye ma a he.
A gbɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ kɛ fĩa zugba kpahi a nɔ;
nɛ a gbá Israel, ye zugba a mi.
3A fɔ sɔ kɛ dla nyɔguɛhi
nɛ a nuu ngɛ ta mi ɔ ngɔ ha a he.
A kɛ nyumuwi ɔmɛ tsake yaholi,
nɛ a jua yiwi ɔmɛ kɛ he wai nɛ a nu.
4 “Tiro, Sidon, kɛ Filistia zugba a tsuo, mɛni nyɛ ngɛ hlae kaa nyɛ maa pee mi nɛ ɔ? Nyɛ ngɛ hlae nɛ nyɛɛ ye nyɛ he lue lo? Ke ja ji sane ɔ, lɛɛ ma ha nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ yayami ɔ ma kpa bu nyɛ nɔ esɔ. 5Nyɛ muɔ ye sika tsu, ye sika hiɔ, kɛ ye juetli kpakpa amɛ kɛ ya wo nyɛ jami he ɔmɛ. 6Nyɛ ngɔ Yuda kɛ Yerusalem bi ɔmɛ kɛ je a zugba nɔ kɛ ho ma se lokoo ya, nɛ nyɛ jua mɛ ngɔ ha Hela bi. 7Jehanɛ lɛɛ ma kpaka mɛ kɛ je he tsuaa he nɛ nyɛ jua mɛ kɛ ho ɔ kɛ ba ekohu. Bɔ nɛ nyɛ pee mɛ ɔ, ja ma pee nyɛ ɔ nɛ. 8Ma ha a maa jua nyɛ binyumu ɔmɛ, kɛ nyɛ biyi ɔmɛ kɛ ha Yuda bi ɔmɛ; nɛ mɛ hu a ma ya jua mɛ kɛ ha Sabea bi ɔmɛ ngɛ ma se tsitsaa. Imi, Yawɛ lɛ i de.
9“Nyɛɛ fiɛ kɛ ha je ma amɛ ke,
‘Nyɛ dla nyɛ he kɛ ha ta;
nyɛ tsɛ nyɛ ta buli ɔmɛ kɛ ba;
nyɛ bua nyɛ ta buli ɔmɛ a nya, nɛ nyɛɛ hia ta.
10 Nyɛɛ ngɔ nyɛ kpakplaa amɛ kɛ sɔ klaatehi;
nɛ nyɛɛ ngɔ nyɛ tso he suami ha amɛ kɛ sɔ akplɔhi.
Nɔ nɛ he wɛ po nɛ e de ke, “Ta hwulɔ ji mi.”
11Nyɛ je ma amɛ tsuo nɛ nyɛ pueɔ si ɔ,
nyɛɛ ba mlamlaamla
nɛ nyɛ ba bua nyɛ he nya
ngɛ kɔ̃ ɔ mi.’ ”
Yawɛ lee, ha nɛ o tabo ɔ nɛ ba ba tua mɛ.
12“Je ma amɛ, nyɛ he nɛ sɔ,
nɛ nyɛɛ ba Kojomi kɔ̃ ɔ mi.
Lejɛ ɔ nɛ imi, Yawɛ nitsɛ,
ma ba kojo je ma amɛ tsuo nɛ pueɔ si ɔ ngɛ.
13 Yiwutsotsɛmɛ ji mɛ;
poo mɛ ngɔ pue si
kaa bɔ nɛ a pooɔ blɛfo tsohi pueɔ si
ngɛ ní kpami be mi ɔ;
ngaa a mi kaa bɔ nɛ a ngaa wai yiblii mi
ngɛ wai ngami he kɛ ya siɔ e hyiɔ muɔ ɔ, nɛ e pueɔ si ɔ.”
14A ya bua a he nya babauu,
akpeakpe abɔ ngɛ Kojomi kɔ̃ ɔ mi.
E be kɛe kulaa nɛ Yawɛ ligbi ɔ
ma ba na mɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.
15Pu kɛ nyɔhiɔ maa wo diblii,
nɛ dodoe ɔmɛ be kpɛe hu.
Mawu maa gbaa e ma a
16 Yawɛ wo gbi kɛ je Zion yo ɔ nɔ;
e gbi ɔ ké kɛ je Yerusalem.
Kɛkɛ nɛ hiɔwe kɛ zugba mimiɛ.
se Yawɛ ji wesa he kɛ ha e ma Israel ɔ.
17“Israel, jamɛ a be ɔ mi nɛ o ma na maa le kaa
imi ji Yawɛ, o Mawu ɔ nɛ.
I hii Zion yo klɔuklɔu ɔ nɔ.
Yerusalem maa pee ma klɔuklɔu;
nibwɔhi be nyɛe ma ba tua ma a gblegbleegble hu.
18“Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ,
yoku ɔmɛ a nɔ ma hyi kɛ wai nɛ ngɔɔ,
nɛ na nyɔ nyu maa pɔ he ngɛ yoku ɔmɛ tsuo a nɔ.
Yuda pa amɛ tsuo ma hyi tɔ.
Nyu hɛngmɛ maa hia kɛ je Yawɛ we ɔ mi,
nɛ nyu ɔ ma ya pue Akasia kɔ̃ ɔ mi.
19“Egipt ma plɛ pee nga kplanaa,
nɛ Edom hu maa pee ma doku.
Ejakaa a ya tua Yuda zugba a,
nɛ a gbe ma a mi bi ɔmɛ yaka
be mi nɛ a pee we yayami ko.
20-21Ma ye ni ɔmɛ nɛ a gbe yaka a a he lue;
i be blɔ ngmɛe nɛ nɔ tɔli nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a ye a he.
Jehanɛ, nimli maa hi Yuda kɛ Yerusalem daa kɛ daa;
nɛ Imi, Yawɛ nitsɛ ma hi Zion yo ɔ nɔ.”

Title: AMOS NYA TSƆƆMI
Content:
NYA TSƆƆMI
Amos ji kekleekle gbalɔ nɛ a ngma e he sanehi babauu ngɛ Baiblo ɔ mi. Amos je Yuda, se e fiɛ kɛ ha Israel ma a nɛ ngɛ omleyi je ɔ maa pee jeha lafa kpaanyɔ loko a fɔ Kristo. E pee kaa kplɔkɔtɔ, kɛ tue mi jɔmi be ji jamɛ a be ɔ; nɛ Mawu jami hu pee kaa nɔ́ nɛ ya nɔ saminya. Se Amos na kaa kplɔkɔtɔ ɔ nɛ ba a, niatsɛmɛ pɛ lɛ e ba ha; ejakaa a yi dami sane ngɛ ma a mi, nɛ a waa ohiatsɛmɛ yi mi. A jaa Mawu ji nɛ, se pi anɔkuale jami; nɛ tue mi jɔmi ɔ hu, e biɛ kɛkɛ. Amos kɛ he hiami, kɛ kã fiɛ ke Mawu maa gbla ma a tue. E de mɛ ke a ye dami sane nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ na kaa bɔ nɛ a naa pa nɛ ngɛ bee ɔ. E ya nɔ nɛ e de ke, “Alini, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ maa na nimli nɛ a hɛ ngɛ kɛ mwɔɔ ngɛ ma nɛ ɔ mi ɔ mɔbɔ” (5.15).
Bɔ nɛ a dla womi ɔ mi ha
Israel huza a nɔ bi ɔmɛ a tue gblami 1.1—2.5
Israel tue gblami 2.6—6.14
Nina enuɔ komɛ 7.1—9.15

Title: AMOS 1
Content:
1 To hyɛlɔ ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Amos, nɛ je Tekoa ma a mi ɔ, e munyuhi ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ. Jeha enyɔ loko zugba mimiɛ ɔ, benɛ Uzia ngɛ tsɛ yee ngɛ Yuda zugba a nɔ, nɛ Yehoash bi Yeroboam ngɛ tsɛ yee ngɛ Israel zugba a nɔ ɔ, Mawu je ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ngɔ tsɔɔ Amos ngɛ Israel he.
2 Amos de ke,
“Yawɛ tu munyu ngɛ Zion yo ɔ nɔ
kaa jata nɛ ngɛ huãe,
nɛ e miɔ nɛ e ma tsɔtslɔɔ lohwe ko mi.
Yawɛ wo gbi ngɛ Yerusalem
kaa hiɔwe nɛ ngɛ sie.
Ba amɛ ngla ngɛ lohwehi a ní yemi he ɔmɛ,
nɛ nga nɛ ngɛ Karmel yo ɔ nɔ ɔ gbli.”
Yawɛ maa gbla Israel huza a nɔ bi ɔmɛ a tue
Siria
3 Yawɛ ke, “Siria ma ngua Damasko bi ɔmɛ pee yayamihi nɔtonɔto babauu; a wa Gilead bi ɔmɛ yi mi, nɛ a pee mɛ nisɛ ní a ní. Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, ja i gbla a tue kokooko. 4Ma mɛ we ɔ nɛ Matsɛ Hazael po ɔ he la, nɛ Matsɛ Benhadad mɔ ɔmɛ maa sã. 5Gbogbo nɛ a fia kɛ bɔle Damasko ma a, agbohi nɛ a je ngɛ mi ɔ, ma ywia mɛ. Ma gbe nihi nɛ ngɛ Aven kɔ̃ ɔ mi, kɛ Beteden ma nɔ yelɔ ɔ. A maa nuu Siria bi ɔmɛ nyɔguɛ kɛ ya Kir zugba a nɔ.” Yawɛ lɛ de.
Filistia
6 Yawɛ ke, “Gaza ma mi bi ɔmɛ pee yayamihi nɔtonɔto babauu; a nuu kɔpehi fuu a mi bi kɛ ho, nɛ a ya jua mɛ kaa nyɔguɛhi kɛ ha Edom bi. Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, ja i gbla a tue kokooko. 7Ma mɛ Gaza gbogbo ɔmɛ, kɛ mɔ ɔmɛ a he la. 8Ma gbe ma nɔ yeli ɔmɛ ngɛ Ashdod kɛ Ashkelon. Ma gbla Ekron ma a tue, nɛ Filisti bi nɛ a he maa je tue gblami nɛ ɔ mi ɔ ma gbo.” Yawɛ lɛ de.
Tiro
9 Yawɛ ke, “Tiro ma mi bi ɔmɛ pee yayamihi nɔtonɔto babauu. A jua kɔpehi babauu a mi bi kaa nyɔguɛhi kɛ ha Edom bi, nɛ kake peemi somi nɛ ngɛ nyɛmi kɛ nyɛmi a kpɛti ɔ, a yi nɔ. Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, ja i gbla a tue kokooko. 10Ma mɛ Tiro gbogbo ɔmɛ, kɛ mɔ ɔmɛ a he la.”
Edom
11 Yawɛ ke, “Edom ma mi bi ɔmɛ pee yayamihi nɔtonɔto babauu. A kɛ abofu nɛ nya wa fie a nyɛmimɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ kɛ klaate, nɛ a nɛ mɛ mɔbɔ kulaa. 12Ma mɛ Teman ma a, kɛ Bozra mɔ ɔmɛ a he la.”
Amon
13 Yawɛ ke, “Amon ma mi bi ɔmɛ pee yayamihi nɔtonɔto babauu. Benɛ a ngɛ ta hwue ngɛ Gilead nɛ a kɛ kpɔ nihi a zugba a, a pee yi wu tso níhi fuu; a kɛ klaate tsɔtslɔɔ yihɔyihi po a mi mi. Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, ja i gbla a tue kokooko. 14Ma mɛ Raba gbogbo ɔmɛ, kɛ mɔ ɔmɛ a he la. A ma he ose hoo ta hwumi ligbi ɔ, nɛ ta a ma puɛ ní kaa lasiogblee. 15Nɛ a maa nuu Amon matsɛ ɔ, kɛ e ganɔ ɔmɛ kɛ ho ma se ya.” Yawɛ lɛ de.

Title: AMOS 2
Content:
Moab
1 Yawɛ ke, “Moab ma mi bi ɔmɛ pee yayamihi nɔtonɔto babauu. A pue Edom matsɛ ɔ hɛ mi si; a sã e wuhi, nɛ a wɛɛ mɛ mɔnyɔmɔnyɔ kɛ pee kalo. Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, ja i gbla a tue kokooko. 2Ma mɛ Moab zugba a, kɛ Keriot mɔ ɔmɛ a he la. Be mi nɛ ta a pee hoo, nɛ ta buli he ose, nɛ titimatihi ngɛ pɛe ɔ, Moab ma mi bi ɔmɛ ma gbo ngɔ pue si. 3Ma gbe Moab matsɛ ɔ, kɛ e ganɔ ɔmɛ tsuo.”
Yuda
4Yawɛ ke, “Yuda ma mi bi ɔmɛ pee yayamihi nɔtonɔto babauu. A yi imi Yawɛ, ye mlaa amɛ a nɔ fɛɛ. Yaka mawuhi nɛ a nɛmɛ ɔmɛ sɔmɔ ɔ, jamɛ a mawu ɔmɛ nɔuu a se lɛ a ya nyɛɛ. Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, ja i gbla a tue kokooko. 5Ma mɛ Yuda ma a, kɛ Yerusalem mɔ ɔmɛ a he la.”
Mawu maa gbla Israel hu tue
6Yawɛ ke, “Nyɛ Israel ma, nyɛ pee yayamihi nɔtonɔto babauu. Nimli kpakpahi nɛ a hɛɛ hiɔ, kɛ dɛgutsɛmɛ nɛ a nyɛ we nɛ a wo tokota nane hiɛ kɛ hiɛ he hiɔ ɔ, nyɛ juaa mɛ kaa nyɔguɛhi. Enɛ ɔmɛ a he je ɔ, ja i gbla nyɛ tue. 7Nyɛ niatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ hlaa kaa a ye ohiatsɛmɛ amimi daa; ke ohiatsɛ ngɛ amanehlu mi, kɛkɛ niatsɛ bua jɔ. Nɔ kɛ e tsɛ po kɛ nyɔguɛ yo kake naa bɔmi, nɛ a kɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ peemi bleɔ ye biɛ klɔuklɔu ɔ. 8Ngɛ nyɛ jami he ɔmɛ tsuo ɔ, bohi nɛ ohiatsɛmɛ kɛ ba toɔ nyɛ awaba a, jamɛ a bo ɔmɛ a nɔ nyɛ hwɔɔ.
