21 “Nyɛmi maa ngɔ e nyɛmi ngɔ ha nɛ a ya gbe lɛ, nɛ tsɛmɛ hu maa ngɔ a bimɛ ngɔ ha ja nɔuu. Bimɛ maa te si ngɔ wo a fɔli, nɛ a ma ha nɛ a gbe mɛ. 22 Ye he ɔ, nihi tsuo maa nyɛ nyɛ. Se nɔ nɛ ma wlua lɛ kɛ yaa si nyagbe ɔ, a ma he e yi wami. 23Ke a ngɛ nyɛ yi mi wae ngɛ ma ko mi ɔ, nyɛɛ tu fo kɛ ya ma kpa mi. Niinɛ, i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke nyɛ be nyɛ ní tsumi ɔ nya gbee ngɛ Israel ma amɛ tsuo a mi, loko Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ maa ba.
24 “Kaselɔ pã we e tsɔɔlɔ, nɛ nyɔguɛ hu pã we e nyɔmtsɛ. 25 Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke kaselɔ, kɛ e tsɔɔlɔ ba sɔ ɔ, lɔ ɔ kɛkɛ hiɛ ha lɛ. Nyɔguɛ hu, ke e kɛ e nyɔmtsɛ ba sɔ ɔ, lɛ hu lɔ ɔ kɛkɛ hiɛ ha lɛ. Ke a tsɛ wetsɛ ɔ Beelzebul ɔ, e we mi bi ɔmɛ lɛɛ a ma tsɛ mɛ biɛ yaya pe jã po!
Nɔ nɛ sa nɛ a ye lɛ gbeye
(Luka 12.2-7)
26 “Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ ko ye mɛ gbeye. Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ a bu nɔ ɔ, a ma ba je kpo; nɔ́ ko be nɛ a ngɔ kɛ laa nɛ a be lee. 27Nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ dee ngɛ diblii mi ɔ, nyɛɛ sɛɛ piani katakata; nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ tue mi woe nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ dee ɔ, nyɛɛ fiɛ ngɛ ma nɔ. 28Nihi nɛ gbeɔ nɔmlɔ tso ɔ, se klaa a lɛɛ a nyɛ we lɛ gbemi ɔ, nyɛ ko ye mɛ gbeye. Mawu nɛ nyɛɔ kpataa nɔmlɔ tso ɔ, kɛ klaa a tsuo a hɛ mi ngɛ Abosiami a je la a mi ɔ, lɛ mohu nyɛɛ ye gbeye. 29Otoklii enyɔ ɔ, anɛ pi sika nɛ a yeɔ ɔ mi nyafii pe kulaa kake pɛ nɛ a juaa mɛ lo? Se a ti nɔ kake nɔɛ zugba nɛ pi nyɛ Tsɛ ɔ suɔmi nya. 30Se nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ yi bwɔmi tete po a kane lɛ tsuo. 31Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ ko ye gbeye; nyɛ he jua wa hluu pe otokliihi babauu.
Kristo biɛ ta womi ngɛ nimli a hɛ mi
(Luka 12.8-9)
32“Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa wo ye ta ngɛ nimli a hɛ mi ɔ, imi hu ma wo e ta ngɛ Tsaatsɛ nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ hɛ mi. 33 Se nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ma kua mi ngɛ nimli a hɛ mi ɔ, imi hu ma kua lɛ ngɛ Tsaatsɛ nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ hɛ mi.
Pi he jɔmi se klaate
(Luka 12.51-53; 14.26-27)
34“Nyɛ ko susu kaa i ba, konɛ ma ha nɛ he jɔmi nɛ ba je ɔ mi. Dɛbi, pi he jɔmi hami nɛ i ba; se klaate mohu i kɛ ba. 35 I ba nɛ ma ba ha nɛ binyumuhi nɛ a te si kɛ wo a tsɛmɛ, biyihi nɛ a te si kɛ wo a nyɛmɛ, nɛ nganyɛmɛ nɛ a te si kɛ wo nganyɛmɛ. 36Nɔ nitsɛ e we mi bimɛ ma plɛ e he nyɛli.
37“Nɔ nɛ suɔ e tsɛ, loo e nyɛ pe imi ɔ, e sɛ kaa e ba peeɔ ye kaselɔ. Nɔ nɛ suɔ e binyumu, loo e biyo pe imi ɔ, e sɛ kaa e ba peeɔ ye kaselɔ. 38 Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ wo we e sɛumi tso kɛ nyɛɛ we ye se ɔ, e sɛ kaa e ba peeɔ ye kaselɔ. 39 Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ baa e klaa yi ɔ, e maa laa lɛ; se nɔ nɛ laa e klaa ngɛ ye he ɔ, e nine maa su nɔ.
Hiɔwo kpakpa
(Marko 9.41)
40 “Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ heɔ nyɛ ɔ, imi e ngɛ hee ɔ nɛ; nɛ nɔ nɛ heɔ mi ɔ, nɔ nɛ tsɔ mi ɔ lɛ e ngɛ hee ɔ nɛ. 41Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ heɔ gbalɔ akɛnɛ gbalɔ ji lɛ he je ɔ, gbalɔ hiɔwo lɛ e ma na. Nɔ nɛ heɔ dalɔ akɛnɛ dalɔ ji lɛ he je ɔ, dalɔ hiɔwo lɛ e ma na. 42Niinɛ, i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke, nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ma ha ni tsɔwi nɛ ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake nyu nɛ mi jɔ nɛ e nu akɛnɛ ye kaselɔ ji lɛ he je ɔ, e hiɔwo be lɛ bɔe gblegbleegble.”

Title: MATEO 11
Content:
Yohane nɔ sɔlelɔ ɔ tsɔ nihi Yesu ngɔ
(Luka 7.18-35)
1Benɛ Yesu tsɔɔ e kaseli nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ ta a, e je kɛ ho ma amɛ nɛ a kɛ lejɛ ɔ kɛ we ɔ a mi ya, nɛ e ya tsɔɔ ní, nɛ e fiɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔmɛ.
2Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, a wo Yohane nɔ sɔlelɔ ɔ tsu. Benɛ Yohane nu níhi nɛ Kristo ngɛ tsue ɔ a he ngɛ tsu ɔ mi ɔ, e tsɔ e kaseli ɔmɛ ekomɛ kɛ sɛ gbi nɛ ɔ ba ha Yesu 3ke, “Anɛ mo ji nɔ nɛ ma a, aloo waa hyɛ nɔ kpa blɔ?”
4Yesu he nɔ ke, “Nyɛɛ ya nɛ nyɛ ya de Yohane níhi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ nue, kɛ níhi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ hyɛe nɛ ɔ. 5 Hɛ yuyuili ngɛ nɔ́ hyɛe, glɔtsɛmɛ ngɛ nyɛɛe, nɛ nihi nɛ ngɛ he womi nɔ hiɔ yaya nue ɔ, a he ngɛ tsɔe; amuɛtihi ngɛ nɔ́ nue, gbogboehi ngɛ si tee, nɛ a ngɛ sane kpakpa fiɛe ha ohiatsɛmɛ. 6A gbaa nɔ nɛ mi mi fu we ngɛ ye he.”
Yesu ye Yohane he odase
(Luka 7.24-35)
7Benɛ Yohane kaseli ɔmɛ yaa a, Yesu tu Yohane he munyu kɛ tsɔɔ ma kpekpemi ɔ ke, “Mɛni nyɛ ho nga a nɔ ya nɛ nyɛ yaa hyɛ? Ngɔwu nɛ kɔɔhiɔ ngɛ lɛ mimiɛe lo? 8Mɛni nyɛ ho hyɛmi ya? Nɔmlɔ nɛ wo tade bɔdɔɔ lo? Hyɛ, ni nɛmɛ nɛ woɔ tade bɔdɔɔ ɔ, matsɛmɛ a we mi nɛ a hii. 9Nyɛ de mi koo! Mɛni he je nyɛ ho ɔ? Nɛ́ nyɛ ya hyɛ gbalɔ, pi ja? Ee! Se i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke nɔ nɛ nyɛ ya na a pe gbalɔ tete. 10 Ejakaa Yohane ɔ he lɛ a ngma ngɛ ke, ‘Hyɛ, i ngɛ ye tsɔlɔ ɔ tsɔe kɛ sɛ o hlami, nɛ e ya dla o blɔ ɔ ngɔ to mo.’ 11Niinɛ, i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke Yohane nɔ sɔlelɔ ɔ, nɔmlɔ adesa ko hí si hyɛ nɛ pe lɛ. Se kɛ̃ ɔ, nɔ nɛ ji nyafii pe kulaa ngɛ hiɔwe matsɛ yemi ɔ mi ɔ pe Yohane. 12 Kɛ je be mi nɛ Yohane nɔ sɔlelɔ ɔ bɔni fiɛmi kɛ ba si mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ, hiɔwe matsɛ yemi ɔ na nɔ́ wawɛɛ nitsɛ; nɛ yiwutsotsɛmɛ hlaa kaa a maa ngɔ pani nya. 13Be nɛ Yohane na we nɛ e ba a, gbali ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ Mose mlaa a, matsɛ yemi ɔ he munyu a tuɔ. 14 Ke nyɛ suɔ kaa nyɛ ma he a sɛ gbi ɔ nyɛɛ ye ɔ, Yohane ɔ ji Eliya nɛ maa ba a nɛ. 15Nɔ nɛ ngɛ tue ɔ, e nu!
16“Mɛni he po ma ngɔ kikɛmɛ a yi nɔ bi nɛ ɔmɛ ngɔ to? A ngɛ kaa jokuɛwi nɛ hii si ngɛ jua nɔ, nɛ a ngɛ a juami bi dee ke, 17‘Wa kpã bɛ ha nyɛ, se nyɛ dui; wa nya awe, se nyɛ yi kɔmɔ.’ 18Benɛ Yohane ba a, e yi ní, nɛ e nui nɔ́ ko hulɔ. Se nɔ́ nɛ nihi tsuo de ngɛ e he ji, ‘Mumi yayami ngɛ e mi!’ 19Benɛ Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ ba a, lɛɛ e yeɔ ní, nɛ e nuɔ wai. Nɛ nɔ́ nɛ nihi deɔ ji, ‘Hyɛ, jiklɔɔtsɛ, kɛ dã nulɔ; tó tsuli, kɛ yayami peeli a huɛ ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ!’ Mawu nile ɔ lɛɛ níhi nɛ e tsuɔ ɔ, lɔ ɔmɛ a kɛ woɔ lɛ nguɔ.”
Nihi nɛ he we yi
(Luka 10.13-15)
20Mahi nɛ Yesu tsu nyakpɛ ní babauu ngɛ a mi ɔ, nihi nɛ ngɛ jamɛ a ma amɛ a mi ɔ tsakee we a tsui. Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, Yesu ka a hɛ mi, nɛ e de ke, 21 “Korazin, musu tloo mo! Betsaida, mo hu musu tloo mo! Nyakpɛ ní babauu nɛ a pee ngɛ nyɛ mi ɔ, a ya pee ngɛ Tiro, kɛ Sidon mohu jinɛ a tsake a tsui momoomo. Jinɛ Tiro, kɛ Sidon bi ma bu kpekpe ya bo, nɛ a maa ngɔ a he kɛ wuwlua la zu mi kɛ tsɔɔ kaa a tsake a tsui niinɛ. 22I ngɛ nyɛ dee ke, kojomi ligbi ɔ, Mawu maa na Tiro kɛ Sidon bi mɔbɔ kulaa pe nyɛ! 23 Nɛ mo, Kapernaum, tse o ngɛ blɔ hyɛe kaa a ma wo o nɔ kɛ ya hiɔwe lokoo? Siu! Dla o he! Abosiami la a mi mohu a ma sake mo kɛ fɔ! Nyakpɛ ní babauu nɛ a pee ngɛ o mi ɔ, a ya pee ngɛ Sodom jinɛ e ko hi si kɛ ba si mwɔnɛ ɔ. 24 I ngɛ mo dee ke kojomi ligbi ɔ, Mawu maa na Sodom mɔbɔ kulaa pe mo.”
Nyɛɛ ba ye ngɔ nɛ nyɛ ba jɔɔ nyɛ he
(Luka 10.21-22)
25Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, Yesu de ke, “Tsaatsɛ, hiɔwe kɛ zugba Nyɔmtsɛ! I naa mo si, ejakaa níhi nɛ o ngɔ kɛ laa ní leli, kɛ ga leli ɔ, o je kɛ tsɔɔ nihi nɛ li nɔ́ ko. 26Ee, Tsaatsɛ, bɔ nɛ o suɔ kaa e ba mi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
27 “Tsaatsɛ tu níhi tsuo ngɔ wo ye dɛ mi. Nɔ ko nɔ ko li Bi ɔ, ja Tsɛ ɔ pɛ; nɔ ko nɔ ko li Tsɛ ɔ, ja Bi ɔ kɛkɛ, kɛ nihi nɛ Bi ɔ suɔ kaa e maa tsɔɔ mɛ Tsɛ ɔ.
28“Nyɛ nihi tsuo nɛ nyɛ tloo tlomi nɛ pɔ tɔ nyɛ, nyɛɛ ba ye ngɔ, nɛ ma ha nɛ nyɛɛ jɔɔ nyɛ he. 29 Nyɛɛ ngɔ ye kuɛpã tso ɔ ngɔɔ tloo, nɛ nyɛɛ kase mi; ejakaa ye he jɔ, nɛ i baa ye he si kɛ jee ye tsui mi. Ke nyɛ pee ja a, nyɛ ma na he jɔmi; 30ejakaa ye kuɛpã tso ɔ tloomi wɛ, nɛ ye tlomi ɔ hu jiɔ we.”

Title: MATEO 12
Content:
Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ he sane
(Marko 2.23-28; Luka 6.1-5)
1 Pee se ɔ, Yesu ya gu blɛfo ngmɔ komɛ a mi Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ. Hwɔ ngɛ e kaseli ɔmɛ yee; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a kpɔ blɛfo, nɛ a bɔni kpemi. 2Benɛ Farisi bi ɔmɛ na a, a de Yesu ke, “Hyɛ, nɔ́ nɛ o kaseli ɔmɛ ngɛ pee nɛ ɔ, mlaa a ngmɛ́ blɔ kaa a peeɔ Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ.”
3 Yesu he nɔ ke, “Nɔ́ nɛ David pee ligbi ko, benɛ hwɔ ngɛ e kɛ e we bi ɔmɛ yee ɔ, anɛ nyɛ kane we lo? 4 David ya sɛ Mawu we ɔ, nɛ e kɛ e we bi ɔmɛ ye abolo ɔ nɛ a kɛ maa Mawu hɛ mi ɔ. Mlaa a ngmɛ́ blɔ kaa a peeɔ ja; osɔfo ɔmɛ pɛ lɛ a ngɛ he blɔ nɛ a yeɔ jamɛ a abolo ɔ. 5 Aloo nyɛ kane we ngɛ Mose mlaa a mi kaa daa Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ, osɔfohi nɛ ngɛ sɔlemi we ɔ bleɔ Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ, se kɛ̃ a yi fɔ lo? 6I ngɛ nyɛ dee ke, nɔ́ ko ngɛ hiɛ ɔ nɛ pe sɔlemi we ɔ. 7 Ngmami ɔ ke, ‘Mɔbɔ nami i ngɛ hlae, se pi bɔ.’ Nyɛ le nɔ́ nɛ ɔ sisi jinɛ nihi nɛ yi fɔ ɔ, nyɛ ko bui mɛ fɔ. 8Ejakaa Mawu Bi ɔ, Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ tete nyɔmtsɛ ji lɛ.”
Nyumu ɔ nɛ nine kake gbo ɔ
(Marko 3.1-6; Luka 6.6-11)
9Benɛ Yesu je lejɛ ɔ, e ya sɛ a kpe he ɔ, 10nɛ e na nyumu ko nɛ e nine kake gbo. Ni komɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ nɛ a ngɛ hlae nɛ a po Yesu nya kaa e ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ dɛ blɔ pee. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a bi lɛ ke, “Ke a tsa nɔ Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ, anɛ a tɔ mlaa a lo?”
11 Yesu he nɔ ke, “Waa ngɔ lɛ kaa nyɛ ti nɔ ko ngɛ to kake pɛ, nɛ to ɔ ya nɔ muɔ mi Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ. Anɛ e be to ɔ he pɛtɛe nɛ e je lɛ lo? 12Anɛ nɔmlɔ he jua wɛ kulaa pi to lo? Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, wa mlaa a ngmɛɔ blɔ kaa a pee kpakpa Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ.” 13Kɛkɛ nɛ e de nyumu ɔ nɛ nine kake gbo ɔ ke, “Kpã o nine ɔ mi!”
Nyumu ɔ kpã e nine ɔ mi. Kɛkɛ nɛ nine ɔ tsa, nɛ e kɛ kake ɔ sɔ. 14Enɛ ɔ he ɔ, Farisi bi ɔmɛ je kpo, nɛ a ya so Yesu yi nɔ, bɔ nɛ a maa pee nɛ a kpata e hɛ mi.
Mawu tsɔlɔ nɛ e hla
15Benɛ Yesu nu kaa a so e yi nɔ ɔ, e sã e he si kɛ je lejɛ ɔ, se nihi babauu nyɛɛ e se. E tsa nihi tsuo nɛ be he wami ɔ, 16nɛ e bɔ mɛ kɔkɔ ke a ko tu e he munyu nɛ nihi ba nu e he. 17E pee nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ nɔ́ nɛ Mawu de kɛ gu gbalɔ Yesaya nɔ ɔ nɛ ba mi ke,
18 “Hyɛ, ye tsɔlɔ nɛ i hla a ji nɛ ɔ nɛ;
i suɔ lɛ, nɛ i naa e he tsui.
Ma ngɔ ye mumi ɔ kɛ wo e mi,
nɛ tue gblami nɛ i to ha ma je li ɔmɛ ɔ,
e maa fiɛ kɛ tsɔɔ mɛ.
19E be pɛe; e be ngmlaa kpae,
nɛ nɔ ko be e gbi nue ngɛ magbɛ nɔ hulɔ.
20E kɛ nihi nɛ gbɔjɔ ɔ
maa hi si ngɛ he jɔmi mi.
E maa na dɛgutsɛmɛ mɔbɔ.
E ma tsu ní nɛ ɔ hluu kɛ yaa si
e ma ha nɛ dami sane yemi ma he si.
21Nɛ ma je li tsuo maa ngɔ a hɛ kɛ fɔ e nɔ.”
Yesu kɛ Beelzebul
(Marko 3.20-30; Luka 11.14-23)
22Jehanɛ, ni komɛ ngɔ nyumu ko nɛ hɛ yu, nɛ e tu we munyu hulɔ kɛ ba Yesu ngɔ; nyumu nɛ ɔ, mumi yayami ngɛ e mi. Yesu tsa lɛ, nɛ e tu munyu, nɛ e hyɛ nɔ́ ekohu. 23Nimli kpekpemi ɔ a nya kpɛ a he, nɛ a bi ke, “David Bi ɔ ji nɛ ɔ?”
24 Benɛ Farisi bi ɔmɛ nu he ɔ, a de ke, “Mumi yayamihi a tsɛ Beelzebul ɔ biɛ mi pɛ nyumu nɛ ɔ ngɛ mumi yayami ɔmɛ hiae ngɛ ɔ nɛ.”
25Yesu le nɔ́ nɛ a ngɛ susue ɔ, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e de mɛ ke, “Matsɛ yemi tsuaa matsɛ yemi nɛ mi ma gba, nɛ a kɛ a he maa hi ta hwue ɔ, e se kɛ we. Jã kɛ̃, ma tsuaa ma, aloo we tsuaa we nɛ e mi ma gba, nɛ a kɛ a he maa hi ta hwue ɔ, e dɛ si. 26Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke Satan hia Satan ɔ, e tsɔɔ kaa e mi gba, nɛ e kɛ lɛ nitsɛ e he ngɛ ta hwue. Lɛɛ kɛ e matsɛ yemi ɔ maa pee kɛ da si kɛɛ! 27Yoo, ke Beelzebul he wami lɛ i kɛ ngɛ mumi yayami ɔmɛ hiae ɔ, nyɛ se nyɛɛli ɔmɛ lɛɛ mɛnɔ he wami nya nɛ mɛɛ a ngɛ mɛ hiae ngɛ mɔ? Nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ se nyɛɛli ɔmɛ ngɛ pee ɔ tsɔɔ kaa nyɛ yeɔ fɔ! 28Se imi lɛɛ ke Mawu Mumi ɔ lɛ haa mi he wami nɛ i kɛ hiaa mumi yayami ɔmɛ ɔ, e tsɔɔ kaa Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ ba na nyɛ momo.
29“Kɛ nɔ ko ma plɛ kɛ sɛ nɔ nɛ he wa we mi nɛ e ya ju kɛɛ? Ja e fi nɔmlɔ nɛ he wa nɛ ɔ kekle, loko e ma nyɛ ya ju ngɛ e we ɔ mi.
30 “Nɔ nɛ be ye blɔ fa mi ɔ, e te si ngɔ wo mi, ne nɔ nɛ kɛ mi bua we nɔ́ nya a, e ngɛ gbɛe kɛ ngɛ fĩae. 31Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke, yayamihi nɛ nihi pee, kɛ musuhi nɛ a bɔ ɔ, a kɛ lɛ tsuo maa pa mɛ. Se nɔ nɛ maa bɔ musu kɛ si Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ, a kɛ be lɛ pae. 32 Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa tu munyu kɛ si Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ, a kɛ maa pa lɛ. Se nɔ nɛ maa tu munyu kɛ si Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ, a kɛ be lɛ pae ngɛ yi nɔ nɛ ɔ, aloo yi nɔ nɛ maa ba a mi.
Tso kɛ e yiblii
(Luka 6.43-45)
33 “Ke o du tso kpakpa a, e maa wo yiblii kpakpa; ke tso ɔ hí ɔ, e maa wo yiblii yaya. Tso yiblii nɛ a kɛ leɔ tso. 34 Nyɛ sinɔhi a nina! Nyɛ nimli yayamihi! Kɛ nyɛ maa pee kɛ tu munyu kpakpa kɛɛ? Ejakaa nɔ́ nɛ hyi tsui mi tɔ ɔ, lɔ ɔ nya deɔ. 35Nɔmlɔ kpakpa jeɔ ní kpakpahi kɛ jeɔ e juetli kpakpahi a mi; nɔmlɔ yayami hu jeɔ ní yayahi kɛ jeɔ e juetli yayahi a mi.
36“I ngɛ nyɛ dee ke kojomi ligbi ɔ, nyɛ ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ maa bu akɔtaa ngɛ yaka munyu tsuaa yaka munyu nɛ e tu hyɛ he. 37Munyuhi nɛ nyɛ tu ɔ, lɔ ɔmɛ a nɔ a maa da kɛ wo nyɛ nguɔ, nɛ lɔ ɔmɛ nɔuu a nɔ a maa da kɛ bu nyɛ fɔ.”
Farisi bi ɔmɛ ngɛ okadi hlae
(Marko 8.11-12; Luka 11.29-32)
38 Kɛkɛ nɛ mlaa tsɔɔli ɔmɛ, kɛ Farisi bi ɔmɛ a ti ni komɛ de ke, “Tsɔɔlɔ, wa ngɛ o nine nya okadi ko hlae nɛ waa hyɛ.”
39 Yesu he nɔ nɛ e de ke, “Nyɛ yi nɔ yaya bi nɛ nyɛ li Mawu! Nyɛ ke nyɛ ngɛ ye nine nya okadi hlae, pi ja? Dɛbi! Okadi pɛ nɛ a ma ha nyɛ ji gbalɔ Yona nɔ́ ɔ. 40 Bɔ nɛ Yona ye nyɔ kɛ pia ligbi etɛ ngɛ wo mi lo nguaa a muklii mi ɔ, jã Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ maa ye nyɔ kɛ pia ligbi etɛ ngɛ zu mi. 41 Kojomi ligbi ɔ, Nineve bi ɔmɛ maa te si nɛ a maa po nyɛ nya; ejakaa benɛ a nu nɛ Yona ngɛ fiɛe ɔ, a tsake a tsui. Se i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke nɔ́ ko ngɛ hiɛ ɔ nɛ pe Yona. 42 Kojomi ligbi ɔ, Sheba manyɛ ɔ maa te si nɛ e maa po nyɛ nya; ejakaa e hia blɔ kɛ je e ma mi tɔɔ kɛ ba bu Matsɛ Salomo nile munyuhi tue. Se i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke nɔ́ ko ngɛ hiɛ ɔ nɛ pe Salomo!
Mumi yayami ɔ maa kpale kɛ ba
(Luka 11.24-26)
43“Ke mumi yayami je nɔ ko mi ɔ, e ya kpaa si ngɛ nga kplanaa nɔ nɛ e hlaa he nɛ e maa jɔɔ e he ngɛ. Ke e nɛ́ he ko ɔ, 44e deɔ e he ke, ‘Ma kpale ye se kɛ ya ye we ɔ mi he nɛ i je ɔ.’ Ke e ba a, e naa kaa we ɔ fɔɔ si gu, nɛ a bɛɛ mi, nɛ a dla mi. 45Kɛkɛ ɔ, e yaa nɛ e ya ngɔɔ mumi kpa kpaago kɛ baa, nɛ e kɛ mɛ ba hii lejɛ ɔ. Mumi yayamihi nɛ pe lɛ nitsɛ po ji mumi nɛ ɔmɛ. Nɔmlɔ nɛ ɔ nyagbe si himi ɔ ba peeɔ haomi kulaa pe sisije ɔ po. Yi nɔ nɛ ɔ bi yayami peeli nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ maa ba mɛ hu a nɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.”
Yesu nyɛ kɛ e nyɛminyumu ɔmɛ
(Marko 3.31-35; Luka 8.19-21)
46Benɛ Yesu kɛ ni ɔmɛ ngɛ munyu tue kɛ mwɔɔ ɔ, e nyɛ, kɛ e nyɛminyumu ɔmɛ ba da agbo ɔ nya, nɛ a ngɛ hlae nɛ a kɛ lɛ nɛ tu munyu. [ 47Kɛkɛ nɛ nɔ ko de Yesu ke, “Hyɛ, o nyɛ, kɛ o nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ daa si ngɛ agbo ɔ nya, nɛ a suɔ kaa a kɛ mo nɛ tu munyu.”]
48Se Yesu bi nɔ nɛ ba tsɛ lɛ ɔ ke, “Mɛnɔ ji maa, nɛ mɛnɔmɛ ji ye nyɛmimɛ?” 49Jehanɛ, e je e nine ngɔ tsɔɔ e kaseli ɔmɛ, nɛ e de ke, “Hyɛ, maa, kɛ ye nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ ji nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ nɛ. 50Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ peeɔ Tsaatsɛ nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ suɔmi nya ní ɔ, lɛ ji ye nyɛminyumu, ye nyɛmiyo, loo maa.”

Title: MATEO 13
Content:
Ní dulɔ ɔ
(Marko 4.1-9; Luka 8.4-8)
1Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ nɔuu ɔ, Yesu je we ɔ mi kɛ ho wo ɔ nya ya, nɛ e ya hi si ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. 2 Nimli jiji nitsɛnitsɛ ba bɔle lɛ kɛ kpe. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e ya sɛ lɛ ko mi nɛ e hi si, be mi nɛ ma a tsuo daa si ngɛ wo ɔ nya. 3Nɛ e tu mɛ munyuhi fuu ngɛ abɛ gbi mi. E de ke,
“Ligbi ko ɔ, ní dulɔ ko ho nɛ e ya du ní. 4Benɛ e ngɛ wu ɔ fĩae ɔ, ekomɛ ya pue blɔ he, nɛ lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ ba kukuɔ. 5Ekomɛ ya pue tɛ sa nɔ, he nɛ zu be bɔ nɛ sa. Wu ɔmɛ puɛ nɔuu, ejakaa zu ɔ mi kuɔ we. 6Se benɛ pu je ɔ, pu ɔ sãã mɛ, nɛ akɛnɛ a be sipoku he je ɔ, a ngla. 7Wu ɔ ekomɛ hu ya pue miohi a mi; se mio ɔmɛ ha we tso ɔmɛ mumi womi he, nɛ a gbo. 8Se ekomɛ hu ya pue zugba kpakpa nɔ, nɛ tso ɔmɛ wo yiblii, ekomɛ lafa, ekomɛ nyingmi ekpa, kɛ ekomɛ hu nyingmi etɛ.”
9Nyagbe ɔ, Yesu de ke, “Nɔ nɛ ngɛ tue ɔ, e nu.”
Nɔ́ nɛ he je nɛ Yesu bu abɛhi
(Marko 4.10-12; Luka 8.9-10)
10Kɛkɛ nɛ Yesu kaseli ɔmɛ ba e ngɔ, nɛ a ba bi lɛ ke, “Mɛni he je o kɛ ni ɔmɛ ngɛ munyu tue ngɛ abɛ gbi mi ɔ?”
11Yesu he nɔ ke, “Nyɛɛ lɛɛ a kɛ hiɔwe matsɛ yemi ɔ mi laami sane ɔ ha nyɛ; se mɛɛ a kɛ ha we mɛ. 12 Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ngɛ nɔ́ ko ɔ, a ma ha lɛ fuu kɛ piɛ he nɛ e na kɛ be nɔ. Se nɔ nɛ be nɔ́ ko ɔ, bɔɔ nɛ e ngɛ ɔ tete po, a ma kpɔ ngɛ e dɛ. 13Nɔ́ he je nɛ i kɛ ni ɔmɛ ngɛ munyu tue ngɛ abɛ gbi mi ji: a ngɛ hyɛe, se a nɛ; a ngɛ tue bue, se a nui, nɛ a nui sisi hulɔ. 14 Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, gbami nɛ Yesaya gba a kɔɔ a he niinɛ. E ke,
‘Niinɛ, nyɛ maa nu,
se nyɛ be sisi nue.
Niinɛ, nyɛ maa na,
se nyɛ be se kɔe.
15Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ kplii a tsui;
A wa tue, konɛ a ko nu nɔ́.
A ma a hɛngmɛ, konɛ a ko hyɛ nɔ́.
A pee kikɛ nɛ ɔ,
konɛ a ko nu níhi a sisi;
nɛ a ba kpale kɛ ba ye ngɔ
nɛ ma tsa mɛ.’
16 “Se nyɛɛ lɛɛ a gbaa nyɛ pɛ! Nyɛ hɛngmɛ ngɛ nɔ́ hyɛe, nɛ nyɛ tue ngɛ nɔ́ nue. 17Niinɛ, i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke gbali, kɛ Mawu bimɛ babauu hla kaa a maa na níhi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ hyɛe nɛ ɔ, se a nɛ́; a hla kaa a maa nu níhi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ nue nɛ ɔ, se a nui.
Yesu tsɔɔ abɛ nɛ kɔɔ ní dulɔ ɔ he ɔ sisi
(Marko 4.13-20; Luka 8.11-15)
18“Jehanɛ, nyɛɛ bu tue, konɛ nyɛɛ le nɔ nɛ abɛ nɛ kɔɔ ní dulɔ ɔ he ɔ tsɔɔ. 19Nihi nɛ nuɔ matsɛ yemi ɔ he sɛ gbi, se a nui sisi ɔ, a ngɛ kaa wu nɛ ya pue blɔ he ɔ. Nɔ yayami ɔ baa nɛ e ba saa nɔ́ nɛ a du ngɛ a mi ɔ kɛ jeɔ. 20Wu nɛ ya pue tɛ sa nɔ ɔ daa si ha nihi nɛ nuɔ sɛ gbi ɔ, nɛ a heɔ amlɔ kɛ bua jɔmi. 21Se sɛ gbi ɔ he we si ngɛ a mi, nɛ e se kɛ we hulɔ. Ke haomi, loo yi wami ba ngɛ munyu ɔ he ɔ, kɛkɛ a nane kpata. 22Wu nɛ ya pue mio mi ɔ daa si ha nihi nɛ nuɔ sɛ gbi ɔ, se je nɛ ɔ mi he nya gbami, kɛ sika suɔmi gbee sɛ gbi ɔ, nɛ e wui yiblii. 23Se wu nɛ ya pue zugba kpakpa nɔ ɔ lɛɛ e daa si ha nihi nɛ nuɔ sɛ gbi ɔ, nɛ a kɔɔ se hulɔ. Mɛ ji ni nɛmɛ nɛ woɔ yiblii ɔ, ni komɛ lafa, ni komɛ nyingmi ekpa, kɛ ni komɛ hu nyingmi etɛ.”
Abɛ nɛ kɔɔ hu he
24Yesu bu mɛ abɛ kpa ko hu ke, “Hiɔwe matsɛ yemi ɔ ngɛ kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ. Nyumu ko du wu kpakpa ngɛ e ngmɔ mi. 25Se nyɔ mi benɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ hwɔ si ɔ, he nyɛlɔ ko ba du hu kɛ futu ngma a, nɛ e je. 26Benɛ ngma a ba wa nɛ e wo yiblii ɔ, hu ɔ hu yi je kpo. 27Wetsɛ ɔ tsɔli ba bi lɛ ke, ‘Nyɔmtsɛ, anɛ pi wu kpakpa nɛ o du ngɛ o ngmɔ ɔ mi lo? Jije hu nɛ ɔ je mɔ?’ 28E he nɔ ke, ‘He nyɛlɔ ko lɛ pee enɛ ɔ nɛ.’ E tsɔli ɔmɛ bi lɛ ke, ‘Lɛɛ o suɔ kaa waa ya nɛ wa ya hia lo?’ 29E he nɔ ke, ‘Dɛbi, eko ɔ, ke nyɛ ngɛ hu ɔ hiae ɔ, nyɛ maa hia ngma a hu kɛ futu mi. 30Nyɛ ha ngma a, kɛ hu ɔ tsuo nɛ wa kɛ yaa si ngma kpami be ɔ. Ke ngma kpami be ɔ su ɔ, ma de ní tsuli ɔmɛ ke a bua hu ɔ nya kekle nɛ a fi, konɛ a sã. Lɔ ɔ se loko ma ha nɛ a bua ngma a nya kɛ wo ye gba a mi.’ ”
Abɛ nɛ kɔɔ sinapi wu he
(Marko 4.30-32; Luka 13.18-19)
31Yesu bu mɛ abɛ kpa ke, “Hiɔwe matsɛ yemi ɔ ngɛ kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ: Nyumu ko kɛ̃ sinapi wu, nɛ e ya du ngɛ e ngmɔ mi. 32Sinapi wu ji wuhi nɛ a duɔ ɔ a kpɛti nyafii pe kulaa. Se ke e wa a, e ba peeɔ tso nguaa pe tso ɔmɛ tsuo. Kɛkɛ ɔ, lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ baa nɛ a ba peeɔ tsu ngɛ e kɔni ɔmɛ a mi.”
Abɛ nɛ kɔɔ masa he
(Luka 13.20-21)
33Yesu bu mɛ abɛ kpa ke, “Hiɔwe matsɛ yemi ɔ ngɛ kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ: Yo ko ngɔ masa nɛ e kɛ futu kplolo mamu lita nyingmi eywiɛ kɛ ya su be nɛ lɛ tsuo fu.”
Yesu kɛ abɛhi tsɔɔ ní
(Marko 4.33-34)
34Abɛhi lɛ Yesu bu nɛ e kɛ tsɔɔ ma kpekpemi ɔ ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo. Niinɛ, e de we mɛ nɔ́ ko nɛ e bui abɛ kɛ tsɔɔ nya. 35 E pee enɛ ɔ, konɛ e kɛ ha nɛ nɔ́ nɛ gbalɔ ɔ de ɔ nɛ ba mi ke,
“I kɛ mɛ maa tu munyu ngɛ abɛ gbi mi.
Níhi nɛ a ngɔ kɛ laa
kɛ je be nɛ a to je ɔ sisi ɔ,
ma fiɛ kɛ tsɔɔ mɛ.”
Yesu tsɔɔ abɛ nɛ kɔɔ hu ɔ he ɔ sisi
36Benɛ Yesu si ma kpekpemi ɔ, nɛ e ba we mi ɔ, e kaseli ɔmɛ ba e ngɔ ba de lɛ ke, “Abɛ ɔ nɛ kɔɔ hu ɔ nɛ ngɛ ngmɔ ɔ mi ɔ he ɔ, tsɔɔ wɔ sisi.”
37Yesu he nɔ ke, “Nɔ nɛ du wu kpakpa a ji Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ nɛ. 38Ngmɔ ɔ ji je ɔ; wu kpakpa a ji matsɛ yemi mi bimɛ ɔmɛ; hu ɔ ji nɔ yayami ɔ bimɛ. 39He nyɛlɔ ɔ nɛ du hu ɔ ji Abosiami. Ngma kpami be ɔ ji je nɛ ɔ nyagbe, nɛ ngma kpali ɔmɛ ji hiɔwe bɔfo ɔmɛ. 40Bɔ nɛ a bua hu ɔ nya nɛ a sã a, jã nɔuu a maa pee ngɛ je nɛ ɔ nyagbe mi. 41Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ maa tsɔ e hiɔwe bɔfo ɔmɛ, nɛ a ma ba bua nimli nɛ ɔmɛ a nya ngɛ e matsɛ yemi ɔ mi: ni nɛmɛ nɛ haa nihi a nane kpataa, kɛ yayami peeli tsuo. 42A ma sake mɛ kɛ fɔ flɔɔnɔɔ kɛ e mi la hɛuu ɔ mi; nɛ lejɛ ɔ a maa wo yana, nɛ a ma kpe lungu nya. 43Se Mawu ma a lɛɛ, a ma kpɛ kaa pu ngɛ a Tsɛ ɔ hiɔwe matsɛ yemi ɔ mi. Nɔ nɛ ngɛ tue ɔ, e nu!
Abɛ nɛ kɔɔ juetli nɛ a ngɔ laa a he
44“Hiɔwe matsɛ yemi ɔ ngɛ kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ: Nyumu ko ya na juetli ngɛ zugba ko mi. Benɛ e na juetli ɔ, e ngɔ laa ekohu. Bua jɔmi sɔuu nɛ e na he je ɔ, e ho nɛ e ya jua níhi tsuo nɛ e ngɛ ɔ, nɛ e kɛ he jamɛ a ngmɔ ɔ.
Abɛ nɛ kɔɔ adiagba he
45“Jehanɛ ɔ, hiɔwe matsɛ yemi ɔ ngɛ kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ: Jua yelɔ ko lɛ ngɛ adiagba saminyawiiwi hlae. 46Benɛ e ya na adiagba saminyayoo kake nɛ he jua wa a, e ho nɛ e ya jua níhi tsuo nɛ e ngɛ ɔ, nɛ e kɛ he.
Abɛ nɛ kɔɔ ya a he
47“Hiɔwe matsɛ yemi ɔ ngɛ kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ hulɔ. Wo hɛli komɛ fɔ ya ngɛ wo mi, nɛ a gbe lo slɔɔtohi babauu. 48Benɛ ya a hyi ɔ, a sã kɛ ba wo ɔ nya, nɛ a ba hi si, nɛ a hla lo ɔ mi. A bua kpakpa amɛ a nya ngɔ wo kusiihi a mi, se yaya amɛ lɛɛ a sake ngɔ pue he. 49Kikɛ nɛ ɔ nɔuu a maa pee ngɛ je nɛ ɔ nyagbe mi. Mawu bɔfo ɔmɛ maa je kpo, nɛ a ma ba hla nimli yayami ɔmɛ ngɛ nimli kpakpa amɛ a kpɛti. 50A ma sake mɛ ngɔ fɔ flɔɔnɔɔ kɛ e mi la hɛuu ɔ mi; nɛ lejɛ ɔ, a maa wo yana, nɛ a ma kpe lungu nya.”
Juetli momo kɛ ehe
51Yesu bi mɛ ke, “Nyɛ nu ní nɛ ɔmɛ a sisi?”
A he nɔ ke, “Ee.”
52E de mɛ ke, “Enɛ ɔ tsɔɔ kaa mlaa tsɔɔlɔ tsuaa mlaa tsɔɔlɔ nɛ ba plɛ pee kaselɔ ngɛ hiɔwe matsɛ yemi ɔ mi ɔ, e ngɛ kaa wetsɛ ko nɛ jeɔ ní hehi, kɛ ní momohi kɛ jeɔ e nito he.”
A kua Yesu ngɛ Nazaret
(Marko 6.1-6; Luka 4.16-30)
53Benɛ Yesu gbe abɛ nɛ ɔmɛ a bumi nya a, e je lejɛ ɔ, 54nɛ e kpale kɛ ba lɛ nitsɛ e ma mi. E tsɔɔ ní ngɛ kpe he ɔ, nɛ nihi nɛ bu lɛ tue ɔ, a nya kpɛ a he. A bi ke, “Jije nyumu nɛ ɔ ná kikɛmɛ a nile nɛ ɔ kɛ je? E nyakpɛ ní ɔmɛ hu nɛɛ? 55Anɛ pi kapitɛ ɔ bi ɔ ji nɛ ɔ? Anɛ pi e nyɛ nɛ a tsɛɛ Maria a? Pi e nyɛminyumuhi ji Yakobo, Yosef, Simon, kɛ Yuda a? 56E nyɛmiyi ɔmɛ ɔ, anɛ pi waa kɛ mɛ tsuo nɛ ngɛ hiɛ ɔ? Jije e ya ná ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ je mɔ?” 57 Kɛkɛ nɛ a mi mi fu lɛ.
Se Yesu de mɛ ke, “A buu gbalɔ ngɛ he tsuaa he, ja lɛ nitsɛ e ma mi, kɛ lɛ nitsɛ e we mi pɛ.” 58Akɛnɛ a he we lɛ yi he je ɔ, e tsu we nyakpɛ ní fuu ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.

Title: MATEO 14
Content:
Yohane nɔ sɔlelɔ ɔ gbenɔ
(Marko 6.14-29; Luka 9.7-9)
1Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, amlaalo ɔ nɛ ngɛ Galilea nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Herode ɔ nu Yesu he, 2nɛ e de e tsɔli ɔmɛ ke, “Yohane nɔ sɔlelɔ ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. A tle lɛ si kɛ je gbeje; lɔ ɔ he nɛ e ngɛ he wami nɛ e kɛ ngɛ nyakpɛ ní tsue ɔ nɛ.”
3 Herode ha a nu Yohane, nɛ a fi lɛ, nɛ a wo lɛ tsu ngɛ e nyɛminyumu Filipo yo Herodia he. 4 Be ko ɔ, Yohane de Herode ke, “E dɛ kaa o ngɔɔ Herodia!” 5Jinɛ Herode hla kaa e gbe Yohane, se e ya ye Yuda bi ɔmɛ gbeye; ejakaa a buɔ Yohane gbalɔ.
6Se benɛ Herode ngɛ e fɔmi ligbi yee ɔ, Herodia biyo ɔ ba do ngɛ ni ɔmɛ a hɛ mi. Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ pee Herode fɛu, 7nɛ e ka kita kɛ wo lɛ si ke, “Bi mi nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ o suɔ, nɛ ma ha mo!”
8Akɛnɛ e nyɛ tsɔɔ lɛ nɔ́ nɛ e bi he je ɔ, yiheyo ɔ de ke, “Ngɔɔ Yohane nɔ sɔlelɔ ɔ yi ngɔ fɔ sowe nɔ ba ha mi ngɛ hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ!”
9Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ wa ha matsɛ ɔ, se kitahi nɛ e ka, kɛ nibwɔhi nɛ pueɔ si ngɛ e hɛ mi ɔ a he je ɔ, e fa ke a pee jokuɛ yo ɔ suɔmi nya ní ɔ ha lɛ. 10E tsɔ nɛ a ya po Yohane yi ngɛ tsu ɔ mi. 11A ngɔ yi ɔ ngɔ fɔ sowe nɔ kɛ ba ha yiheyo ɔ, nɛ lɛ hu e kɛ ya ha e nyɛ. 12Yohane kaseli ɔmɛ ba, nɛ a ba ngɔ gbogboe ɔ ya pu. Nɛ a ho nɛ a ya de Yesu.
Yesu ha nyumuhi akpe enuɔ niye ní
(Marko 6.30-44; Luka 9.10-17; Yohane 6.1-14)
13Benɛ Yesu nu kaa a gbe Yohane ɔ, e ya sɛ lɛ mi, nɛ e je lejɛ ɔ kɛ ho he ko banee ya. Nihi babauu nu he, nɛ a je a ma amɛ a mi, nɛ a gu zugba blɔ kɛ nyɛɛ e se. 14Yesu je kpo ngɛ lɛ ɔ mi, nɛ benɛ e na ni ɔmɛ ɔ, e mi mi sã lɛ ngɛ a he, nɛ e tsa a kpɛti hiɔtsɛmɛ ɔmɛ.
15Benɛ je jɔ ɔ, Yesu kaseli ɔmɛ ba e ngɔ, nɛ a ba de lɛ ke, “ngapa ji hiɛ ɔ, nɛ du bu. Wó ni ɔmɛ blɔ kɛ ho kɔpe ɔmɛ a mi ya, nɛ a ya he ní nɛ a ye.”
16Yesu de mɛ ke, “E hia we kaa a ya; nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ hla nɔ́ ko ha mɛ nɛ a ye.”
17Se a de lɛ ke, “Abolo enuɔ, kɛ lo enyɔ pɛ wa ngɛ ngɛ hiɛ ɔ.”
18E de mɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ ngɔ ba ha mi ngɛ hiɛ ɔ!” 19Yesu fa ma kpekpemi ɔ ke a hi si ngɛ nga a nɔ. Jehanɛ, e kukuɔ abolo enuɔ ɔ, kɛ lo enyɔ ɔ, nɛ e hyɛ hiɔwe nɛ e na Mawu si. E ku abolo ɔ mi, nɛ e ngɔ ha e kaseli ɔmɛ, nɛ e kaseli ɔmɛ hu dla ngɔ ha ma a. 20Mɛ tsuo a ye nɛ a tɔ. Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, a bua bibliwi nɛ piɛ ɔ nya ngɔ wo kusii nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ mi, nɛ a hyi tɔtɔɔtɔ. 21Nyumuhi nɛ ye ní ɔ maa su akpe enuɔ, slo yihi, kɛ jokuɛwi.
Yesu nyɛɛ wo hɛ mi
(Marko 6.45-52; Yohane 6.15-21)
22Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Yesu ha e kaseli ɔmɛ sɛ lɛ ɔ mi, nɛ e de mɛ ke a sɛ hlami kɛ ya wo ɔ se je. Kɛkɛ nɛ e wo ma kpekpemi ɔ hu blɔ. 23Benɛ e wo ni ɔmɛ blɔ se ɔ, lɛ nɔ kake e kuɔ yoku ɔ, nɛ e ya sɔle. Benɛ je jɔ ɔ, Yesu nɔ kake too nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. 24Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, lɛ ɔ su wo ɔ kpɛti momo. Oslɔke ngɛ kue kɛ ngɛ lɛ ɔ mi woe, ejakaa a ngɛ kɔɔhiɔ kpee.
25Makɛ maa pee ngmlɛ eywiɛ mi ɔ, Yesu ji nɛ ɔ nɛ nyɛɛ wo ɔ hɛ mi kɛ ma kaseli ɔmɛ a ngɔ. 26Benɛ a na lɛ nɛ e nyɛɛ wo ɔ hɛ mi kɛ ma a, a tsui po, nɛ a de ke, “Kpade lɛ ma a nɛ!” Gbeye nu mɛ, nɛ a kpa ngmlaa.
27Se amlɔ ɔ, Yesu wo e nya nɔ, nɛ e de mɛ ke, “Nyɛ na tsui, imi! Nyɛ ko ye gbeye!”
28Petro he nɔ ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, ke mo ɔ, lɛɛ ha nɛ ma nyɛɛ nyu ɔ hɛ mi kɛ ba o ngɔ.”
29Yesu de lɛ ke, “Ba!” Kɛkɛ nɛ Petro je lɛ ɔ mi, nɛ e nyɛɛ nyu ɔ hɛ mi kɛ yaa Yesu ngɔ. 30Se benɛ e na kaa kɔɔhiɔ ɔ ngɛ fiae huu ɔ, e ye gbeye, nɛ e bɔni mumi kɛ yaa nyu ɔ sisi. Kɛkɛ nɛ e kpa ngmlaa ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, he mi!”
31Amlɔ ɔ, Yesu kpã e nine mi, nɛ e pɛtɛ e he, nɛ e de lɛ ke, “Mo nɛ o hemi kɛ yemi pi! Mɛni he je nɛ o je nɔ́?”
32Kɛkɛ nɛ a sɛ lɛ ɔ mi, nɛ kɔɔhiɔ ɔ kpa fiami. 33Jehanɛ, kaseli ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ lɛ ɔ mi ɔ ja Yesu, nɛ a de ke, “Niinɛ, Mawu Bi ji mo!”
Yesu tsa hiɔtsɛmɛ ngɛ Genesaret
(Marko 6.53-56)
34A po wo ɔ, nɛ a ba Genesaret zugba a nɔ, 35nɛ ni ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ yo Yesu. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a tsɔ kɛ ya kpa lejɛ ɔ ní ɔmɛ a mi tsuo, nɛ a ya ngɔ hiɔtsɛmɛ tsuo kɛ ba e ngɔ. 36A kpa lɛ pɛɛ wawɛɛ ke e ha nɛ hiɔtsɛmɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a ta e tade ɔ nya a he kɛkɛ. Nɛ nihi tsuo nɛ ta he ɔ na he wami.

Title: MATEO 15
Content:
Blematsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a tsɔɔmi
(Marko 7.1-13)
1Pee se ɔ, Farisi bi, kɛ mlaa tsɔɔli komɛ je Yerusalem kɛ ba Yesu ngɔ ba bi lɛ ke, 2“Kusumi nɛ wa nimeli to sisi blema a, mɛni he je nɛ o kaseli ɔmɛ bui ɔ? A fɔ we a dɛ loko a yeɔ ní!”
3Yesu he nɔ ke, “Nyɛ hu mɛni he je nyɛ yi Mawu mlaa a nɔ, nɛ nyɛ dii nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ kusumihi a se ɔ? 4 Mawu wo mlaa ke, ‘Bu o tsɛ, kɛ o nyɛ,’ nɛ e de hu ke, ‘Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa gbiɛ e tsɛ, loo e nyɛ ɔ, a gbe lɛ.’ 5Se nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ deɔ ke, nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ma de e tsɛ, loo e nyɛ ke, ‘Nɔ́ ko nɛ jinɛ o ko ná ngɛ ye dɛ mi ɔ, i ngɔ kɛ ke Mawu’ ɔ, lɛɛ e hia we kaa e bu e tsɛ loo e nyɛ hu. 6Kikɛ nɛ ɔ nyɛ peeɔ, nɛ nyɛ siɔ Mawu mlaa a, nɛ nyɛ ya nyɛɛɔ nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ kusumihi a se. 7Osatotsɛmɛ! Nɔ́ nɛ Yesaya gba ngɛ nyɛ he ɔ, anɔkuale sisiisi! Yesaya ngma ke,
8 ‘Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ,
a nya mi munyu kɛkɛ a kɛ woɔ
ye hɛ mi nyami;
se a tsui mi lɛɛ, a sume mi saasaa.
9Yaka gu a jaa mi,
ejakaa tsɔɔmihi nɛ a tsɔɔ
ji mlaahi nɛ nimli pee.’ ”
Níhi nɛ bleɔ nɔ
(Marko 7.14-23)
10Jehanɛ lɛɛ Yesu tsɛ ni ɔmɛ kɛ ba e ngɔ, nɛ e de mɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ bu tue, konɛ nyɛɛ nu sisi saminya! 11Pi nɔ́ nɛ yaa nɔ nya mi ɔ nɛ bleɔ nɔ; mohu ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ jee nɔ nya a lɛ bleɔ nɔ.”
12Kɛkɛ nɛ kaseli ɔmɛ ba e ngɔ nɛ a ba de lɛ ke, “O le kaa benɛ Farisi bi ɔmɛ nu kikɛmɛ a munyu nɛ ɔ, e dɔ mɛ ɔ?”
13Yesu he nɔ ke, “Tso tsuaa tso nɛ pi Tsaatsɛ nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ nɛ ma a, a maa hia. 14 Nyɛ ko hao nyɛ he ngɛ a he kulaa! Hɛ yuyuili nɛ ngɛ hɛ yuyuili blɔ tsɔɔe ji mɛ. Ke hɛ yuyuilɔ ngɛ hɛ yuyuilɔ blɔ tsɔɔe ɔ, mɛ ni enyɔ ɔmɛ tsuo a maa nɔ muɔ mi.”
15Petro de lɛ ke, “Tsɔɔ wɔ abɛ ɔ sisi!”
16Yesu ke, “Anɛ nyɛ hu nyɛ li ní kɛ mwɔɔ? 17Anɛ nyɛ li kaa nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ yaa nɔ nya mi ɔ, muklii mi e sɛɛ, nɛ lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e jeɔ kpo lo? 18 Se níhi nɛ jee nɔ nya a, tsui mi a jee; nɛ lɔ ɔmɛ nɛ bleɔ nɔ ɔ nɛ. 19Ejakaa tsui mi nɛ susumi yayami nɛ ɔmɛ jeɔ: nɔmlɔ gbemi, gba puɛmi, ajuama bɔmi, jumi, lakpa odase yemi, kɛ nɔ biɛ puɛmi. 20Enɛ ɔmɛ ji níhi nɛ bleɔ nɔ; se ke nɔ ko fɔ we e dɛ loko e ye ní ɔ, lɔ ɔ ble we nɔ.”
Yo ko hemi kɛ yemi
(Marko 7.24-30)
21Yesu je lejɛ ɔ, nɛ e pue nɔ kɛ ho Tiro, kɛ Sidon zugba a nɔ ya. 22Kɛkɛ nɛ Kanaan yo ko nɛ je lejɛ ɔ ní ɔmɛ a mi ɔ ba kpa ngmlaa ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, David Bi, naa mi mɔbɔ! Ye biyo ngɛ mumi yayami ngɛ e mi, nɛ e ngɛ lɛ haoe wawɛɛ nitsɛ.”
23Se Yesu pui e nya mi. Kɛkɛ nɛ kaseli ɔmɛ ba e ngɔ nɛ a ba kpa lɛ pɛɛ ke, “Yo nɛ ɔ ngɛ ngmlaa kpae kɛ nyɛɛ wa se! Wo lɛ blɔ nɛ e ho!”
24Yesu he nɔ ke, “Israel ma nɛ ngɛ kaa to nɛ laa a, mɛ pɛ a ngɔ nɛ a tsɔ mi.”
25Kɛkɛ nɛ yo ɔ ba kpla si ngɛ Yesu nane nya, nɛ e de ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, naa mi mɔbɔ!”
26Yesu he nɔ ke, “E dɛ kaa a ngɔɔ bimɛ ɔmɛ a niye ní ɔ nɛ a sakee kɛ fɔɔ si ha gbehi.”
27Yo ɔ de ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, e ngɛ mi ja mohu, se tse gbe ɔmɛ hu yeɔ bibliwi nɛ jeɔ a nyɔmtsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a we okplɔɔ nɔ pueɔ si ɔ eko!”
28Jehanɛ Yesu de lɛ ke, “Yo, o hemi kɛ yemi kle! Nɔ́ nɛ o ngɛ hlae ɔ, a pee ha mo!” Nɛ jamɛ a ngmlɛfia a nɔuu ɔ, a tsa e biyo ɔ.
Yesu tsa nihi babauu
29Yesu je lejɛ ɔ, nɛ e pue nɔ kɛ ya gu Galilea wo ɔ nya. E kuɔ yo ɔ nɛ e ya hi si. 30Ma kpekpemi nitsɛ ba e ngɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. A kɛ hiɔtsɛmɛ slɔɔto babauu ba pue Yesu nane nya, nɛ e tsa mɛ. Hiɔtsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ekomɛ ji nihi nɛ hule, hɛ yuyuili, amuɛtihi, glɔtsɛmɛ, kɛ hiɔtsɛmɛ kpahi fuu. 31Benɛ ma kpekpemi ɔ na nɛ amuɛti ɔmɛ ngɛ munyu tue, nɛ glɔtsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a he mi wa mɛ, nɛ nihi nɛ hule ɔ ngɛ nyɛɛe, nɛ hɛ yuyuili ɔmɛ ngɛ nɔ́ hyɛe ɔ, a nya kpɛ a he. Nɛ a je Israel Mawu ɔ yi.
Yesu ha nyumuhi akpe eywiɛ niye ní
(Marko 8.1-10)
32Yesu tsɛ e kaseli ɔmɛ kɛ ba e ngɔ, nɛ e de mɛ ke, “Ye mi mi ngɛ mi sããe ngɛ nimli kpekpemi nɛ ɔmɛ a he. Ligbi etɛ sɔuu ji nɛ ɔ nɛ a kɛ mi ngɛ, nɛ a be nɔ́ ko nɛ a maa ye. I sume kaa ma wo mɛ blɔ kɛ ho kɛ hwɔ; eko piɔ klibi ma ya po mɛ ngɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ.”
33Kaseli ɔmɛ bi lɛ ke, “Nga nɔ hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ, jije wa ma na niye ní ngɛ bɔ nɛ sa nɛ maa su ma kpekpemi nɛ ɔ nya?”
34Yesu bi mɛ ke, “Abolo enyɛmɛ nyɛ ngɛ?”
A he nɔ ke, “Kpaago, kɛ lo tsɔwi bɔɔ ko.”
35Kɛkɛ nɛ Yesu fa ma kpekpemi ɔ ke a hi si ngɛ zugba. 36Jehanɛ, e kukuɔ abolo kpaago ɔ, kɛ lo ɔ, nɛ e na Mawu si, nɛ e ku mi, nɛ e ngɔ ha e kaseli ɔmɛ. Nɛ e kaseli ɔmɛ hu dla ngɔ ha ma a. 37Mɛ tsuo a ye nɛ a tɔ. Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, a bua bibliwi nɛ piɛ ɔ nya ngɔ wo kusii kpaago a mi, nɛ a hyi tɔtɔɔtɔ. 38Nyumuhi nɛ ye ní ɔ, a yibɔ ji akpe eywiɛ, slo yihi, kɛ jokuɛwi.
39Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Yesu wo ma kpekpemi ɔ blɔ. Kɛkɛ nɛ e sɛ lɛ mi kɛ ho Magadan zugba a nɔ ya.

Title: MATEO 16
Content:
A de Yesu ke e pee nyakpɛ ní
(Marko 8.11-13; Luka 12.54-56)
1 Farisi bi komɛ, kɛ Saduki bi komɛ ba Yesu ngɔ, konɛ a ba ka lɛ. A de lɛ ke e pee nyakpɛ nɔ́ ko kɛ tsɔɔ kaa e je hiɔwe niinɛ. 2Se e he nɔ nɛ e de mɛ ke, [“Ke pu yaa nɔ si ɔ, nyɛ deɔ ke, ‘Je mi ma tsɔ, ejakaa hiɔwe pee tsutsuu.’ 3Mɔtu ɔ, nyɛ deɔ ke, ‘Hiɔmi maa nɛ mwɔnɛ ɔ, ejakaa hiɔwe pee tsutsuu, nɛ je ɔ mi pee kaa nɔ́ nɛ hiɔmi maa nɛ.’ Niinɛ, ke nyɛ hyɛ hiɔwe pɛ nyɛ le kaa je mi ma tsɔ, loo hiɔmi maa nɛ. Se okadihi nɛ kɔɔ yi nɔ nɛ ɔmɛ a he lɛɛ nyɛ be nyɛe maa tsɔɔ sisi!] 4 Mwɔnɛmwɔnɛ yi nɔ bi yayami nɛ li Mawu! Nyɛ bi ke ma pee nyakpɛ nɔ́ ko ha nyɛ, pi jã? Dɛbi! Okadi pɛ nɛ a ma ha nyɛ ji Yona nɔ́ ɔ.”
Kɛkɛ nɛ Yesu je a he, nɛ e pue nɔ kɛ ho.
Farisi bi kɛ Saduki bi a masa a
(Marko 8.14-21)
5Benɛ kaseli ɔmɛ po mi kɛ yaa wo ɔ se ɔ, a hɛ je nɔ kaa a maa hɛɛ niye ní kɛ to dɛ. 6 Yesu de mɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ hyɛ saminya! Nyɛ hɛ nɛ hi nyɛ he nɔ ngɛ Farisi bi ɔmɛ, kɛ Saduki bi ɔmɛ a masa a he!”
7Se a tu he munyu ngɛ a kpɛti ke, “E de jã, ejakaa wa hɛɛ we niye ní kɛ bɛ!”
8Yesu le nɔ́ nɛ a ngɛ dee ɔ, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e bi mɛ ke, “Mɛni he je nyɛ ngɛ ní sɛɛe ngɛ niye ní nɛ nyɛ hɛɛ we he ɔ? Nyɛ hemi kɛ yemi pi pɛ! 9 Anɛ nyɛ nɛ níhi a nya kɛ mwɔɔ? Anɛ nyɛ kai we kaa i ku abolo enuɔ mi kɛ ha nyumuhi akpe enuɔ hyɛ? Kusii enyɛmɛ a mi nyɛ kukuɔ bibliwi ɔ kɛ wo? 10 Abolo kpaago ɔ nɛ a kɛ lɛ nyumuhi akpe eywiɛ ɔmɛ nɛɛ, nyɛ kaii we? Kusii enyɛmɛ a mi nyɛ kukuɔ bibliwi ɔ kɛ wo? 11Mɛni he je nyɛ nui sisi kaa pi abolo he munyu nɛ i kɛ nyɛ ngɛ tue ɔ? Nyɛ hɛ nɛ hi nyɛ he nɔ ngɛ Farisi bi ɔmɛ, kɛ Saduki bi ɔmɛ a masa a he!”
12Jehanɛ lɛɛ kaseli ɔmɛ ba kɔ se kaa pi masa nɛ a kɛ woɔ abolo mi ɔ he nɛ e de mɛ ke a hɛ nɛ hi a he nɔ ɔ, se mohu, Farisi bi ɔmɛ, kɛ Saduki bi ɔmɛ a tsɔɔmi ɔ he.
Petro ye Yesu he odase
(Marko 8.27-30; Luka 9.18-21)
13Benɛ Yesu ba Kaisarea Filipi kpokpa a nɔ ɔ, e bi e kaseli ɔmɛ ke, “Mɛnɔ nihi deɔ ke Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ ji?”
14 A he nɔ ke, “Ni komɛ ke Yohane nɔ sɔlelɔ ɔ; ni komɛ ke Eliya, nɛ ni kpa komɛ deɔ ke Yeremia, aloo gbali ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake.”
15E bi mɛ ke, “Se nyɛɛ lɛɛ kɛ nyɛ deɔ kɛɛ? Mɛnɔ ji mi?”
16 Simon Petro he nɔ ke, “Mo ji Kristo ɔ, Mawu hɛ kalɔ ɔ Bi ɔ.”
17Yesu de lɛ ke, “Simon, Yona bi, a gbaa mo! Ejakaa pi nɔmlɔ adesa nɛ je enɛ ɔ tsɔɔ mo; se Tsaatsɛ nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ. 18Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Petro, i ngɛ mo dee ke tɛ sa ji mo, nɛ kikɛmɛ a tɛ sa nɛ ɔ nɔ ma ma ye asafo ɔ ngɛ. Nɛ gbenɔ tete po be nyɛe maa ye e nɔ. 19 Ma ngɔ hiɔwe matsɛ yemi ɔ nya safe ɔmɛ ngɔ ha mo. Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ o maa tsi nya ngɛ zugba a nɔ ɔ, a maa tsi nya ngɛ hiɔwe; nɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ o maa ngmɛ blɔ ke a pee ngɛ zugba a nɔ ɔ, a maa ngmɛ blɔ ngɛ hiɔwe.”
20Kɛkɛ nɛ Yesu ka e kaseli ɔmɛ kita ke a ko de nɔ ko nɔ ko ke lɛ ji Kristo ɔ.
Yesu tu e we amanehlu, kɛ e gbenɔ he munyu
(Marko 8.31—9.1; Luka 9.22-27)
21Kɛ je jamɛ a be ɔ, Yesu bɔni e kaseli ɔmɛ demi paa ke ja e ya Yerusalem, nɛ e ya na amanehlu babauu ngɛ ma nimeli ɔmɛ, kɛ osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ, kɛ mlaa tsɔɔli ɔmɛ a dɛ mi. A maa gbe lɛ, se ligbi etɛ se ɔ, Mawu ma tle lɛ si kɛ ba wami mi ekohu.
22Petro tsɛ lɛ kɛ ya se, nɛ e bɔni e hɛ mi kami ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, enɛ ɔ ya je ngɛ se lokoo! Mawu ko ha nɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ nɛ ba o nɔ kɔkɔɔkɔ!”
23Se Yesu plɛ e he nɛ e de Petro ke, “Jee ye nɔ kɛ ya se, Satan! O ngɛ ye nane kpatae. Ejakaa juɛmi nɛ ngɛ o yi mi ɔ, pi Mawu ngɔ nɛ e je, se nɔmlɔ adesa.”
24 Jehanɛ, Yesu de e kaseli ɔmɛ ke, “Ke nɔ ko suɔ kaa e maa nyɛɛ ye se ɔ, e kua e he, nɛ e wo e sɛumi tso ɔ, nɛ e nyɛɛ ye se. 25 Ejakaa nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ hlaa kaa e baa e klaa yi ɔ, e maa laa lɛ; se nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ngɔɔ e wami ngɔ fɔɔ he ngɛ ye he ɔ, e nine maa su nɔ ekohu. 26Mɛni se nɔ ko ma na ke e nine su je ɔ tsuo nɔ, se e laa e klaa? Dɛbi! Nɔ́ ko be nɛ e ma ngɔ ha nɛ e kɛ kpɔ e klaa a. 27 Ejakaa Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ maa ba ngɛ e tsɛ hɛ mi nyami ɔ mi, kɛ e bɔfo ɔmɛ. Jamɛ a be ɔ, e maa wo nɔ tsuaa nɔ hiɔ ngɛ e ní tsumi nya. 28Niinɛ, i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke ni komɛ daa si ngɛ hiɛ ɔ nɛ mɛɛ lɛɛ a be gboe kɛ yaa su be nɛ a maa na Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ nɛ ma kaa matsɛ.”

Title: MATEO 17
Content:
Yesu nɔmlɔ tso su tsake
(Marko 9.2-13; Luka 9.28-36)
1 Ligbi ekpa se ɔ, Yesu ngɔ Petro, kɛ Yakobo kɛ e nyɛmi Yohane, nɛ e nyɛɛ a hɛ mi kɛ ya yo gagaa ko nɔ ngɛ he ko banee. 2Benɛ a ngɛ lɛ hyɛe ɔ, e nɔmlɔ tso su tsake; e hɛ mi ngɛ kpɛe kaa pu, nɛ e tade ɔmɛ hiɛ futaa. 3Tlukaa a, kaseli ɔmɛ na Mose, kɛ Eliya ba je a he kpo tsɔɔ mɛ, nɛ a kɛ Yesu bɔni munyu tumi. 4Kɛkɛ nɛ Petro de Yesu ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, e hi kaa wa ngɛ hiɛ ɔ! Ke o suɔ ɔ, ma pee bo tsu etɛ ngɛ hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ, o nɔ kake, Mose nɔ́ kake, kɛ Eliya hu nɔ́ kake.”
5 Benɛ e ngɛ munyu ɔ tue kɛ mwɔɔ ɔ, bɔku hleii ko ba ha a nɔ, nɛ gbi je bɔku ɔ mi de ke, “Ye Bi nɛ i suɔ lɛ, nɛ i naa e he tsui ji nɛ ɔ nɛ! Nyɛɛ bu lɛ tue.”
6Benɛ kaseli ɔmɛ nu gbi ɔ, a ye gbeye wawɛɛ nitsɛ, nɛ a ngɔ a hɛ mi ngɔ bu si. 7Kɛkɛ nɛ Yesu ba a ngɔ, nɛ e ba ta a he, nɛ e de ke, “Nyɛɛ te si; nyɛ ko ye gbeye!” 8Se benɛ a bli a hɛngmɛ ɔ, a nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko ngɛ lejɛ ɔ kaa ja Yesu nɔ kake pɛ.
9Benɛ a ngɛ yo ɔ kplee ɔ. Yesu ka mɛ kita ke, “Nyɛ ko sɛɛ nina nɛ ɔ he ní ha nɔ ko kɛ yaa si a ma tle Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ si kɛ je gbeje.”
10 Kɛkɛ nɛ kaseli ɔmɛ bi Yesu ke, “Mɛni he je mɔ nɛ mlaa tsɔɔli ɔmɛ deɔ ke ja Eliya ba lolo ɔ?”
11Yesu he nɔ ke, “Niinɛ, Eliya ma, nɛ e ma ba to níhi tsuo blɔ nɔ ekohu. 12 Se i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke Eliya ba momo, se nihi li lɛ, nɛ a pee lɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ a suɔ. Ja nɔuu Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ hu maa na amanehlu ngɛ a dɛ mi.”
13Kɛkɛ nɛ kaseli ɔmɛ kɔ se kaa Yohane nɔ sɔlelɔ ɔ he munyu e kɛ mɛ ngɛ tue ɔ nɛ.
Yesu tsa jokuɛ nyumuyo ko nɛ mumi yayami ngɛ e mi
(Marko 9.14-29; Luka 9.37-43a)
14Benɛ a kpale kɛ ba nimli kpekpemi ɔ a ngɔ ɔ, nyumu ko ba Yesu ngɔ ba kpla si ngɛ e hɛ mi, 15nɛ e de ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, naa ye binyumu ɔ mɔbɔ! Kɔkɔtsɛ ji lɛ, nɛ hiɔ ɔ deɔ nɔ́ ha lɛ wawɛɛ nitsɛ. Bɔɔ kɛkɛ e ya nɔ la mi; bɔɔ kɛkɛ e ya nɔ nyu mi. 16I ngɔ lɛ kɛ ba o kaseli ɔmɛ a ngɔ, se a nyɛ we nɛ a tsa lɛ.”
17Yesu he nɔ ke, “Nyɛ yi nɔ yayami bi nɛ nyɛ be hemi kɛ yemi! Mɛni be i kɛ nyɛ maa hi si kɛ yaa si? Mɛni be ma to ye tsui si ha nyɛ kɛ yaa si? Nyɛɛ ngɔ jokuɛ ɔ kɛ ba ye ngɔ ngɛ hiɛ ɔ.” 18Yesu nga mumi yayami ɔ yi nɛ e je e mi, nɛ a tsa lɛ jamɛ a ngmlɛfia a nɔuu.
19Kɛkɛ nɛ Yesu kaseli ɔmɛ ba e ngɔ nigii, nɛ a ba bi lɛ ke, “Mɛni he je nɛ wɔɔ lɛɛ wa nyɛ we nɛ waa hia mumi yayami ɔ?”
20 Yesu he nɔ ke, “Ejakaa nyɛ hemi kɛ yemi pi. Niinɛ, i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke, ke nyɛ ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi nɛ kle kaa sinapi wu ɔ, nyɛ ma de yo nɛ ɔ ke, ‘Hiaa kɛ je hiɛ ɔ kɛ ya lejɛ ɔ,’ nɛ e maa hia. Nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko peemi be wae ha nyɛ!” [ 21Se mumi nɛ ɔ, ja sɔlemi, kɛ ngma himi pɛ a kɛ ma nyɛ hia.]
Yesu tu e gbenɔ he munyu ekohu
(Marko 9.30-32; Luka 9.43b-45)
22Benɛ kaseli ɔmɛ tsuo a nya ba bua ngɛ Galilea a, Yesu de mɛ ke, “A miɔ nɛ a maa ngɔ Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ kɛ wo nimli adesahi a dɛ mi 23nɛ a gbe lɛ. Se ligbi etɛ se ɔ, Mawu ma tle lɛ si.”
Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ hao kaseli ɔmɛ wawɛɛ.
Sɔlemi we ɔ he tó tsumi
24 Benɛ Yesu kɛ e kaseli ɔmɛ ba Kapernaum ɔ, sɔlemi tsu ɔ he tó tsuli ɔmɛ ba Petro ngɔ, nɛ a ba bi lɛ ke, “Anɛ nyɛ tsɔɔlɔ ɔ woɔ tó ɔ lo?”
25Petro he nɔ ke, “Ee, e woɔ.”
Benɛ Petro ba we ɔ mi ɔ, Yesu sɛ hlami bi lɛ ke, “Simon, kɛ o susuɔ kɛɛ? Zugba a nɔ matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, mɛnɔmɛ a dɛ a heɔ tó ngɛ? Ma mi bi a dɛ, aloo ma se bi a dɛ?”
26Petro de lɛ ke, “Ma se bi a dɛ nɛ a heɔ ngɛ.”
Yesu he nɔ ke, “Saminya! Lɛɛ ma mi bi ɔmɛ yeɔ a he mɔ! 27Se bɔ nɛ pee nɛ wa ko tsɔ̃ nimli nɛ ɔmɛ a nya a, yaa wo ɔ nya nɛ o ya fɔ gbowe. Kekleekle lo nɛ ma ba mi gbowe ɔ, sá lɛ. Hyɛ lo ɔ nya mi, nɛ o maa na sika nɛ maa su i kɛ mo tsuo wa sɔlemi we ɔ he tó ɔ nya. Ngɔɔ nɛ o kɛ wo wa tó ɔ.”

Title: MATEO 18
Content:
Mɛnɔ ji nɔmlɔ nguaa pe kulaa?
(Marko 9.33-37; Luka 9.46-48)
1 Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, kaseli ɔmɛ ba Yesu ngɔ, nɛ a ba bi lɛ ke, “Mɛnɔ ji nɔmlɔ nguaa pe kulaa ngɛ hiɔwe matsɛ yemi ɔ mi?”
2Kɛkɛ nɛ Yesu tsɛ jokuɛ nyafii ko, nɛ e ha e ba da a kpɛti, 3 nɛ e de ke, “Niinɛ, i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke, ke nyɛ tsakee we nɛ nyɛɛ pee kaa jokuɛ tsɔwi ɔ, nyɛ be hiɔwe matsɛ yemi ɔ mi sɛe. 4Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ baa e he si kaa jokuɛ nɛ ɔ, lɛ ji nɔmlɔ nguaa pe kulaa ngɛ hiɔwe matsɛ yemi ɔ mi. 5Nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ heɔ jokuɛyo kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ ngɛ ye biɛ mi ɔ, imi e he ɔ nɛ.
Kami nɛ haa nɔ peeɔ yayami
(Marko 9.42-48; Luka 17.1-2)
6“Hemi kɛ yemi nɛ jokuɛ tsɔwi nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ ngɛ ye mi ɔ, ke nɔ ko ha nɛ a ti nɔ kake hemi kɛ yemi ɔ ta a, afani nɛ a kɛ teji wɛ muɔ nɔ ɔ kuɛ, nɛ a sake lɛ kɛ fɔ wo mi he nɛ kuɔ. 7Musu tloo je ɔ kaa níhi ngɛ je ɔ mi nɛ haa nɔ peeɔ yayami! Ní nɛ ɔmɛ maa ba kɛ̃, se nɔmlɔ nɛ haa nɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ baa a, musu tloo lɛ!
8 “Ke o nine, loo o nane haa nɛ o peeɔ yayami ɔ, poo nɛ o sake ngɔ fɔ he! Afani nɛ o kɛ nine popoe, loo nane popoe sɛ wami mi pe nɛ o ngɛ nine enyɔ, loo nane enyɔ, nɛ a ma sake mo ngɔ fɔ neneene la a mi. 9 Jã kɛ̃, ke o hɛngmɛ haa nɛ o peeɔ yayami ɔ, hiaa nɛ o sake ngɔ fɔ he! Afani nɛ o kɛ hɛngmɛ kake sɛ wami mi pe nɛ o ngɛ hɛngmɛ enyɔ, nɛ a ma sake mo ngɔ fɔ Abosiami a je la a mi.
Abɛ nɛ kɔɔ to nɛ laa a he
(Luka 15.3-7)
10“Nyɛɛ hyɛ saminya nɛ nyɛ ko hie bimɛ tsɔwi nɛ ɔmɛ a ti nɔ ko. I ngɛ nyɛ dee ke a bɔfohi nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ daa si ngɛ Tsaatsɛ nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ hɛ mi daa. [ 11Se Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ ba nɛ e ba he nihi nɛ laa a a yi wami.]
12“Kɛ nyɛ susuu kɛɛ? Ke nɔ ko ngɛ to lafa, nɛ a kpɛti kake laa a, anɛ e be nyingmi nɛɛ kɛ nɛɛ ɔmɛ sie ngɛ yo ɔmɛ nɔ, nɛ e ya hla nɔ́ nɛ laa a? 13Niinɛ, i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke, ke e na lɛ ɔ, e naa lɔ ɔ he bua jɔmi kulaa pe to nyingmi nɛɛ kɛ nɛɛ ɔmɛ nɛ mɛɛ a laa we ɔ. 14Jã nɔuu kɛ̃ nyɛ Tsɛ nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ sume kaa bimɛ tsɔwi nɛ ɔmɛ a kpɛti nɔ kake nɛ laa.
Nyɛmi nɛ peeɔ yayami
15 “Ke o nyɛmi pee mo yayami ɔ, yaa nɛ o ya tsɔɔ lɛ e tɔmi ɔ, o kɛ lɛ ni enyɔ kɛkɛ. Ke e bu mo tue ɔ, kɛkɛ nyɛmi pee nyɛmi. 16 Se ke e bui mo tue ɔ, ngɔɔ nɔ kake, loo ni enyɔ ngɔ piɛ o he. Kɛkɛ ɔ, ni enyɔ, loo etɛ ɔmɛ maa pee odase yeli kɛ ma munyu ɔ nɔ mi. 17Se ke e bui mɛ hu tue ɔ, yaa sɛɛ ha asafo ɔ. Ke e bɛɛe bui asafo ɔ hu tue ɔ, buu lɛ kaa wɔ jalɔ, loo tó tsulɔ.
Nya tsimi kɛ blɔ ngmɛmi
18 “Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke, nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ maa tsi nya ngɛ zugba a nɔ ɔ, a maa tsi nya ngɛ hiɔwe, nɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ maa ngmɛ blɔ ngɛ zugba a nɔ ɔ, a maa ngmɛ blɔ ngɛ hiɔwe.
19“Jehanɛ ɔ hu, i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke, ke nyɛ kpɛti ni enyɔ ngɛ zugba nɛ ɔ nɔ maa pee nyɛ nya kake kɛ kpa nɔ́ ko he pɛɛ ɔ, Tsaatsɛ nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ maa pee ha nyɛ. 20Ejakaa he nɛ ni enyɔ, loo ni etɛ bua a he nya ngɛ ngɛ ye biɛ mi ɔ, i ngɛ a kpɛti ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.”
Abɛ nɛ kɔɔ tsɔlɔ ɔ nɛ kɛ nɔ́ ki ɔ he
21 Kɛkɛ nɛ Petro ba Yesu ngɔ, nɛ e ba bi lɛ ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, si enyɛmɛ ke ye nyɛmi tɔ ye nɔ nɛ ma kɛ pa lɛ? Si kpaago lo?”
22 Yesu de lɛ ke, “Dɛbi, i de we mo ke si kpaago, se mohu si kpaago totoe nyingmi kpaago. 23Ejakaa bɔ nɛ hiɔwe matsɛ yemi ɔ ngɛ ha ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. Be ko ɔ, matsɛ ko hi si, nɛ e to kaa e maa hyɛ e tsɔli ɔmɛ a we akɔtaa mi. 24Benɛ e bɔni akɔtaa a mi hyɛmi ɔ, a kɛ tsɔli ɔmɛ a kpɛti nɔ kake nɛ hɛɛ lɛ hiɔ sika fuu nitsɛ ba. 25Se akɛnɛ e nyɛ we nɛ e wo hiɔ ɔ, e nyɔmtsɛ ɔ fa ke a jua lɛ, kɛ e yo, kɛ e bimɛ, kɛ níhi tsuo nɛ e ngɛ ɔ nɛ a kɛ wo hiɔ ɔ. 26Kɛkɛ nɛ tsɔlɔ ɔ kpla si ngɛ matsɛ ɔ hɛ mi, nɛ e de ke, ‘Nyɔmtsɛ, i kpa mo pɛɛ, na tsui ha mi nɛ ma wo mo hiɔ ɔ tsuo!’ 27Matsɛ ɔ mi mi sã lɛ ngɛ tsɔlɔ ɔ he, nɛ e kɛ hiɔ ɔ tsuo ke lɛ, nɛ e ngmɛɛ e he.
28“Se benɛ tsɔlɔ nɛ ɔ je kpo ɔ, e na e nyɛmimɛ tsɔli ɔmɛ a kpɛti nɔ kake nɛ hɛɛ lɛ hiɔ sika bɔɔ pɛ. Kɛkɛ nɛ e nu lɛ, nɛ e bɔni e kuɔ si miami ke, ‘Wó mi hiɔ nɛ o hɛɛ mi ɔ!’ 29E nyɛmi tsɔlɔ ɔ kpla si ngɛ e hɛ mi, nɛ e de ke, ‘I kpa mo pɛɛ, na tsui ha mi nɛ ma wo mo hiɔ ɔ tsuo!’ 30Se lɛɛ e kplɛɛ we; mohu ɔ, e ya wo lɛ tsu kɛ yaa si e maa wo lɛ hiɔ ɔ. 31Benɛ tsɔli kpa amɛ na nɔ́ nɛ ba a, a hao wawɛɛ, nɛ a ho matsɛ ɔ ngɔ ya, nɛ a ya bɔ lɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ ba. 32Matsɛ ɔ ha nɛ a ya tsɛ tsɔlɔ ɔ kɛ ba, nɛ e de lɛ ke, ‘Mo tsɔlɔ yiwutsotsɛ! Akɛnɛ o kpa mi pɛɛ he je ɔ, i ngɔ hiɔ nɛ ɔ tsuo ngɔ ke mo. 33Anɛ mo hu e sɛ kaa o naa o nyɛmi tsɔlɔ mɔbɔ kaa bɔ nɛ i na mo mɔbɔ ɔ lo?’ 34Matsɛ ɔ mi mi fu, nɛ e wo tsɔlɔ ɔ tsu, nɛ́ a gbla e tue hluu kɛ yaa si e maa wo hiɔ ɔ tsuo.”
35Yesu de kɛ gbe nya ke, “Ke nyɛ ngɔɛ nyɛ nyɛmimɛ a tɔmi ngɔ pɛ mɛ kɛ je nyɛ tsui mi ɔ, bɔ nɛ Tsaatsɛ nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ maa pee nyɛ ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.”

Title: MATEO 19
Content:
Yesu tu gba mi pomi he munyu
(Marko 10.1-12)
1Benɛ Yesu tu munyu nɛ ɔmɛ gbe nya a, e je Galilea kɛ ba Yudea kpokpa a nɔ, ngɛ Yordan pa a se. 2Nihi fuu nyɛɛ e se, nɛ e tsa mɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.
3Farisi bi komɛ ba e ngɔ ba ka lɛ, nɛ a bi lɛ ke, “Anɛ wa mlaa a ngmɛɛ blɔ kaa nyumu fieɔ e yo ngɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ ko he lo?”
4 Yesu he nɔ ke, “Anɛ nyɛ kane we ngmami ɔ nɛ deɔ ke sisije ɔ, bɔlɔ ɔ bɔ adesa nyumu kɛ yo lo? 5 Nɛ Mawu de ke, ‘Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, nyumu ma si e tsɛ kɛ e nyɛ, nɛ e maa mɛtɛ e yo he, nɛ mɛ ni enyɔ ɔmɛ a ma plɛ pee nɔ kake.’ 6Lɛɛ a pi nimli enyɔ hu, se mohu he lo kake. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ Mawu ngɔ tsa a, nɔmlɔ kó gba mi.”
7 Farisi bi ɔmɛ bi lɛ ke, “Mɛni he je Mose wo mlaa ke nyumu nɛ ha yo fiemi womi nɛ e ngmɛɛ e he mɔ?”
8Yesu he nɔ ke, “Mose ha nyɛ he blɔ ke nyɛɛ ngmɛɛ nyɛ yihi a he, ejakaa nyɛ tue wa; pi ja ji sane ɔ kɛ je sisije. 9 Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke, nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa ngmɛɛ e yo he, nɛ pi kaa yo ɔ ya bɔ ajuama, nɛ e ma ya ngɔ yo kpa a, e puɛ gba.”
10E kaseli ɔmɛ de lɛ ke, “Ke kikɛ nɛ ɔ ji nyumu kɛ e yo sane ɔ, e he hia we kaa nyumu nɛ ngɔ yo mɔ.”
11Yesu he nɔ ke, “Tsɔɔmi nɛ ɔ, nihi nɛ Mawu ngɔ ha a, mɛ pɛ a he e kɔɔ; pi nɔ tsuaa nɔ. 12Ejakaa ní komɛ a he je nɛ nyumuhi ngɔɛ yo; ni komɛ ngɛ nɛ ja lɛ a fɔ mɛ; ni komɛ lɛɛ adesa lɛ pee mɛ ja; ni komɛ hu ngɔɛ yo ngɛ hiɔwe matsɛ yemi ɔ he. Tsɔɔmi nɛ ɔ, nɔ nɛ ma nyɛ maa pɛtɛ he ɔ, e pee ja.”
Yesu gbaa jokuɛwi
(Marko 10.13-16; Luka 18.15-17)
13Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, ni komɛ ngɔ jokuɛ tsɔwi kɛ ba Yesu ngɔ nɛ e ngɔ e nine ngɔ pue a nɔ, nɛ e sɔle ha mɛ. Se e kaseli ɔmɛ kuɛ wo ni ɔmɛ. 14Kɛkɛ nɛ Yesu de ke, “Nyɛ ha nɛ jokuɛwi ɔmɛ nɛ a ba ye ngɔ; nyɛ ko tsi mɛ blɔ, ejakaa nihi nɛ ngɛ kaa ni nɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ ji hiɔwe matsɛ yemi ɔ nɛ.”
15Kɛkɛ nɛ e ngɔ e nine ngɔ pue jokuɛwi ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ e je lejɛ ɔ.
Niheyo niatsɛ ɔ
(Marko 10.17-31; Luka 18.18-30)
16Ligbi ko ɔ, nyumu ko ba Yesu ngɔ ba bi lɛ ke, “Tsɔɔlɔ, mɛni nɔ́ kpakpa po ma pee nɛ ma na neneene wami?”
17Yesu hu bi lɛ ke, “Mɛni he je o ngɛ mi nɔ́ kpakpa he sane bie? Nɔ kake pɛ ji nɔ kpakpa. Ke o ngɛ hlae nɛ o sɛ wami mi ɔ, ye mlaa amɛ a nɔ.”
18 Niheyo ɔ bi ke, “Mɛni mlaahi?”
Yesu he nɔ ke, “Koo gbe nɔmlɔ; ko puɛ gba; koo ju; koo ye lakpa odase; 19 bu o tsɛ kɛ o nyɛ; suɔ o nyɛmi nɔmlɔ kaa bɔ nɛ o suɔ mo nitsɛ o he.”
20Niheyo ɔ he nɔ ke, “I ye mlaa nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a nɔ; mɛni pa piɛ mi mɔ?”
21Yesu de lɛ ke, “Ke o ngɛ hlae nɛ o hi kɛ pi si ɔ, yaa nɛ o ya jua níhi nɛ o ngɛ ɔ, nɛ o ngɔ sika a kɛ ha ohiatsɛmɛ, nɛ o ma na juetli ngɛ hiɔwe. Kɛkɛ ɔ, kpale kɛ ba nɛ o ba nyɛɛ ye se.”
22Benɛ niheyo ɔ nu nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, e kɛ aywilɛho je lejɛ ɔ; ejakaa e ngɛ ní babauu.
23Kɛkɛ nɛ Yesu de e kaseli ɔmɛ ke, “Niinɛ, i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke, e maa wa ha niatsɛ kaa e maa sɛ hiɔwe matsɛ yemi ɔ mi. 24I ngɛ nyɛ dee ekohu ke e wa ha niatsɛ kaa e maa sɛ Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ mi pe kaa afukpɔngɔ maa gu abui hɛngmɛ mi.”
25Benɛ kaseli ɔmɛ nu enɛ ɔ, a he mi po, nɛ a bi ke, “Lɛɛ mɛnɔ po yi wami a ma nyɛ he mɔ?”
26Yesu hyɛ mɛ too, nɛ e de mɛ ke, “Nimli be nyɛe maa pee enɛ ɔ; se Mawu lɛɛ e nyɛɔ peeɔ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ!”
27Kɛkɛ nɛ Petro tu munyu nɛ e de ke, “Hyɛ, wɔɔ lɛɛ wa si nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́, nɛ wa ba nyɛɛ o se. Mɛni wa ma na mɔ?”
28 Yesu de mɛ ke, “Niinɛ, i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke, je he ɔ mi, benɛ Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ maa hi e nyami sɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ, nyɛ hu nyɛ maa hi matsɛ sɛ nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ nɔ, nɛ nyɛ maa kojo Israel wɛtso nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ. 29Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ma si wehi, loo nyɛminyumuhi, loo nyɛmiyihi, loo e tsɛ, loo e nyɛ, loo bimɛ, loo zugba ngɛ ye he ɔ, a maa to lɛ nane mi totoe lafa, nɛ a ma ha lɛ neneene wami. 30 Se nihi fuu nɛ sɛ hlami amlɔ nɛ ɔ ma ba pee sekpɛli, nɛ sekpɛli ma ba pee hlami sɛli.

Title: MATEO 20
Content:
Wai ngmɔ ɔ mi ní tsuli ɔmɛ
1“Hiɔwe matsɛ yemi ɔ ngɛ kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ: Ligbi ko ɔ, nyumu ko je kpo makɛ mla ya bɔ nihi apaa nɛ a ba tsu ní ngɛ e wai ngmɔ mi. 2E kɛ ní tsuli ɔmɛ ye nya kaa e ma ha nɔ tsuaa nɔ sika hiɔ yi kake nɛ ji apaatsɛ ligbi kake hiɔwo ɔ. Kɛkɛ nɛ e wo mɛ blɔ kɛ ho e wai ngmɔ ɔ mi ya. 3Kɛ ma mɔtu ngmlɛ nɛɛ mi ɔ, e je kpo ekohu kɛ ya jua a nɔ. E na ni komɛ nɛ daa si gu ngɛ lejɛ ɔ nɛ a tsu we nɔ́ ko. 4E de mɛ ke, ‘Nyɛ hu nyɛɛ ya nɛ nyɛ ya tsu ní ngɛ wai ngmɔ ɔ mi, nɛ ma wo nyɛ hiɔ bɔ nɛ sa.’ 5Nɛ a ho. Jehanɛ ɔ, ngmlɛ nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ, kɛ ngmlɛ etɛ ɔ, e je kpo nɛ e ya pee ja nɔuu. 6Kɛ ma gbɔkuɛ ngmlɛ enuɔ mi nɛ e ya jua a nɔ ekohu ɔ, e na ni komɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ nɛ a daa si gu. E bi mɛ ke, ‘Mɛni he je nyɛ daa si ngɛ hiɛ ɔ mwɔnɛ ligbi ɔ tsuo nɛ nyɛ tsu we nɔ́ ko ɔ?’ 7A he nɔ ke, ‘Nɔ ko ba bɔɛ wɔ apaa.’ E de mɛ ke, ‘Yoo, nyɛ hu nyɛɛ ya nɛ nyɛ ya tsu ní ngɛ ye wai ngmɔ ɔ mi.’
8 “Gbɔkuɛ ɔ, wai ngmɔtsɛ ɔ de e tsɔlɔ nɔkɔtɔma a ke, ‘Tsɛ ní tsuli ɔmɛ nɛ o wo mɛ hiɔ. Jee sisi kɛ je sekpɛtsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ kɛ yaa su kekletsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ.’ 9Kɛkɛ nɛ nihi nɛ a bɔ mɛ apaa gbɔkuɛ ngmlɛ enuɔ ɔ ba, nɛ a ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ na sika hiɔ yi kake. 10Benɛ kekletsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ba a, a susu kaa mɛɛ a ma na pe ja; se mɛ hu a ha a ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ sika hiɔ yi kake. 11Benɛ a nine su sika a nɔ ɔ, a tu munyu huitihuiti kɛ si nɔ nɛ bɔ mɛ apaa a. 12A ke, ‘Sekpɛtsɛmɛ nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, ngmlɛfia kake pɛ a tsu ní; wɔɔ lɛɛ wa tsu ní ligbi ɔ tsuo. Pu tsoo wɔ, nɛ latsa tsa wɔ, se o wo waa kɛ mɛ hiɔ fiee!’
13“Ngmɔtsɛ ɔ he nɔ nɛ e de ní tsuli ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake ke, ‘Ye huɛ, bu tue; i tsa sisi we mo! Anɛ pi sika hiɔ yi kake nɛ i kɛ mo ye nya ke ma ha mo lo? 14Ngɔɔ o hiɔwo ɔ nɛ o ho. I suɔ kaa ma wo nɔ nɛ i bɔ lɛ apaa sekpɛ nɛ ɔ hu hiɔ kaa bɔ nɛ i ha mo ɔ kɛ̃. 15Anɛ i be he blɔ kaa i kɛ imi nitsɛ ye sika peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ i suɔ lo? Aloo ye mi mi nɛ jɔ ɔ he o hɛngmɛ tsu ngɛ nɛ ɔ?’ ”
16 Yesu de kɛ gbe nya ke, “Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, sekpɛli ma ba pee hlami sɛli, nɛ hlami sɛli ma ba pee sekpɛli.”
Yesu tu e gbenɔ he munyu si etɛne
(Marko 10.32-34; Luka 18.31-34)
17Benɛ Yesu yaa Yerusalem ɔ, e ngɔ e kaseli nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ kɛ ya se banee ngɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ, nɛ e kɛ mɛ kɔklɔɔ tu munyu, nɛ e de ke, 18“Nyɛɛ bu tue! Wa yaa Yerusalem, nɛ a maa ngɔ Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ kɛ wo osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ, kɛ mlaa tsɔɔli ɔmɛ a dɛ mi. A maa bu lɛ gbenɔ fɔ, 19nɛ a maa ngɔ lɛ ngɔ ha ma je li ɔmɛ nɛ a ye e he fɛu, nɛ a fia lɛ kplibi, nɛ a sɛu lɛ. Se ligbi etɛ se ɔ, a ma tle lɛ si kɛ ba wami mi ekohu.”
Yakobo kɛ Yohane a nyɛ bi nɔ́ ko
(Marko 10.35-45)
20Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Zebedeo bimɛ ɔmɛ a nyɛ kɛ e binyumu ɔmɛ ba Yesu ngɔ. E kpla si ngɛ Yesu hɛ mi, nɛ e ngɔ e hiami nɔ́ ko kɛ fɔ e hɛ mi.
21Yesu bi lɛ ke, “Mɛni o ngɛ hlae?”
Yo ɔ he nɔ ke, “Wó mi si kaa ke o ba ye matsɛ ɔ, ye binyumuhi enyɔ nɛ ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake maa hi o hiɔ nɔ, nɛ nɔ kake hu maa hi o muɔ nɔ.”
22Yesu de bimɛ ɔmɛ ke, “Nyɛ li nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ bie ɔ. Amanehlu kplu nɛ i miɔ nɛ ma nu nɛ ɔ, anɛ nyɛ hu nyɛ ma nyɛ maa nu lo?”
A he nɔ ke, “Ee, wa ma nyɛ!”
23Yesu de mɛ ke, “Ee, nyɛ maa nu. Se kaa nɔ ko maa hi ye hiɔ nɔ, loo ye muɔ nɔ ɔ, jamɛ a blɔ nya a lɛɛ pi imi nɛ i haa nɔ. Blɔ he nɛ ɔmɛ fɔɔ si kɛ ha nihi nɛ Tsaatsɛ nitsɛ dla kɛ to ɔ.”
24Benɛ kaseli nyɔngma amɛ nɛ piɛ ɔ nu he ɔ, a mi mi fu nyɛmimɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ. 25 Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yesu tsɛ mɛ tsuo kɛ ba e ngɔ, nɛ e de mɛ ke, “Nyɛ le bɔ nɛ ma je li ɔmɛ a nɔ yeli ɔmɛ yeɔ a nɔ ha. Nyɛ le bɔ nɛ a ganɔ ɔmɛ yeɔ a nɔ kɛ he wami. 26 Nyɛɛ lɛɛ e ko ba ja ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti; nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa suɔ kaa e pee nɔmlɔ nguaa ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti ɔ, lɛ mohu e plɛ nyɛ sɔmɔlɔ; 27nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa suɔ kaa e ye kekleekle blɔ he ɔ, lɛ mohu e plɛ nyɛ nyɔguɛ 28kaa bɔ nɛ Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ pee ɔ. E bɛ nɛ a sɔmɔ lɛ, se e ba sɔmɔ mohu, konɛ e ngɔ e wami ngɔ ha, nɛ e kɛ he nihi fuu a yi wami.”
Yesu tsa hɛ yuyuili enyɔ
(Marko 10.46-52; Luka 18.35-43)
29Benɛ Yesu kɛ e kaseli ɔmɛ je Yeriko kɛ yaa a, nihi babauu nyɛɛ e se. 30Nyumuhi hɛ yuyuili enyɔ hii si ngɛ blɔ ɔ tue, nɛ benɛ a nu kaa Yesu bee ɔ, a kpa ngmlaa ke, “David bi! Naa wɔ mɔbɔ!”
31Ni ɔmɛ kuɛ wo mɛ, nɛ a de mɛ ke a ma a nya. Se hɛ yuyuili ɔmɛ kpa ngmlaa pe kekle ɔ ke, “David bi lee! Naa wɔ mɔbɔ oo, naa wɔ mɔbɔ!”
32Yesu da si, nɛ e tsɛ mɛ, nɛ e bi mɛ ke, “Mɛni nyɛ ngɛ hlae nɛ ma pee ha nyɛ?”
33A de lɛ ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, ha wa hɛngmɛ ɔmɛ nɛ bli.”
34Yesu mi mi sã lɛ ngɛ a he, nɛ e ta a hɛngmɛ ɔmɛ a he. Amlɔ nɔuu ɔ, a hyɛ nɔ́ ekohu, nɛ a nyɛɛ e se.

Title: MATEO 21
Content:
Yesu Yerusalem sɛmi
(Marko 11.1-11; Luka 19.28-40; Yohane 12.12-19)
1Benɛ Yesu kɛ e kaseli ɔmɛ miɔ nɛ a maa su Yerusalem ɔ, a gba Betfage, ngɛ Oliv yo ɔ he. Yesu tsɔ e kaseli ɔmɛ a ti ni enyɔ, 2nɛ e de mɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ ya kɔpe nɛ ngɛ nyɛ hɛ mi nɛ ɔ mi. Ke nyɛ su lejɛ ɔ pɛ nyɛ maa na teji yo nɛ a muɔ lɛ si, kɛ e bi. Nyɛɛ pɛne mɛ, nɛ nyɛɛ ngɔ mɛ ba ha mi. 3Nɛ ke nɔ ko bi nyɛ munyu ko ɔ, nyɛ de lɛ ke, ‘A he hia Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ.’ Kɛkɛ ɔ, e maa ngmɛɛ a he ha nyɛ nɔuu.”
4A pee enɛ ɔ, konɛ nɔ́ nɛ gbalɔ ɔ de ɔ nɛ ba mi ke,
5 “Nyɛ de Zion biyo ɔ ke,
Hyɛ, o matsɛ ɔ ma o ngɔ.
E he jɔ, nɛ e hi teji nɔ,
ee, e hi teji bi nɔ.”
6Kɛkɛ nɛ kaseli ɔmɛ ho nɛ a ya pee bɔ nɛ Yesu fa mɛ ke a pee ɔ. 7A ngɔ teji ɔ, kɛ e bi ɔ kɛ ba, nɛ a ngɔ a tade ɔmɛ ngɔ pue a nɔ, nɛ Yesu kuɔ nɛ e hi nɔ. 8Nihi babauu ngɔ a tadehi ngɔ ha blɔ ɔ nɔ, nɛ ni komɛ hu poo tso kɔnihi ngɔ pue blɔ ɔ nɔ. 9 Kɛkɛ nɛ nihi nɛ nyɛɛ hɛ mi, kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ nyɛɛ se ɔ tsuo hwɔ lele ke, “Mo kpɔ wɔ, David Bi! A gbaa nɔ nɛ ma ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ biɛ mi ɔ! Mo kpɔ wɔ, mo Hiɔwe No!”
10Benɛ Yesu sɛ Yerusalem ma a mi ɔ, ma a tsuo hwɔ hoo, nɛ a bi ke, “Mɛnɔ ji nɛ ɔ?”
11Ma kpekpemi ɔ he nɔ ke, “Nɔ nɛ ɔ ji gbalɔ Yesu nɛ je Nazaret ngɛ Galilea a nɛ.”
Yesu ya sɔlemi we ɔ
(Marko 11.15-19; Luka 19.45-48; Yohane 2.13-22)
12Yesu ya sɔlemi we ɔ, nɛ e ya fie nihi nɛ ngɛ ní juae, kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ ní hee tsuo kɛ je lejɛ ɔ. E sake sika tsakeli ɔmɛ a we okplɔɔ ɔmɛ, kɛ nihi nɛ ngɛ lahuɛ juae ɔ a sɛ ɔmɛ ngɔ fia si, 13 nɛ e de mɛ ke, “A ngma ngɛ ngmami ɔmɛ a mi ke, Mawu de ke, ‘A ma tsɛ ye we ɔ sɔlemi we.’ Se nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ ngɔ kɛ pee ojo fiali a laami he!”
14Hɛ yuyuili, kɛ glɔtsɛmɛ ba e ngɔ ngɛ sɔlemi we ɔ, nɛ e tsa mɛ. 15Osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ na nyakpɛ níhi nɛ Yesu pee ngɛ sɔlemi we ɔ. A na bɔ nɛ jokuɛwi hu ngɛ lele hwɔe ngɛ lejɛ ɔ nɛ a ngɛ dee ke, “A je David Bi ɔ yi!” Kɛkɛ nɛ a mi mi fu, 16 nɛ a bi lɛ ke, “Nɔ́ nɛ ni ɔmɛ ngɛ dee ɔ, o ngɛ nue?”
Yesu he nɔ ke, “Ee, i ngɛ nue! Anɛ nyɛ kane we ngmami nɛ ɔ hyɛ lo? Ngmami ɔ ke, ‘O dla bimwɔwi, kɛ nyɔ nya bimɛ kɛ to konɛ a la la ngɔngɔɛ kɛ je o yi.’ ”
17Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Yesu si mɛ, nɛ e je ma a mi kɛ ho Betania ya, nɛ e ya hwɔ lejɛ ɔ.
Yesu gbiɛ ngmɔkɔ tso ɔ
(Marko 11.12-14, 20-24)
18Mɔtu benɛ Yesu kpale e se kɛ yaa ma a mi ɔ, hwɔ ye lɛ. 19E na ngmɔkɔ tso ko ngɛ blɔ ɔ he, nɛ e gba kɛ ya he; se e nɛ nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko ngɛ tso ɔ nɔ pe ba kɛkɛ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e de tso ɔ ke, “O be yiblii ko woe hu gblegbleegble!” Nɛ ngmɔkɔ tso ɔ ngla amlɔ nɔuu.
20Benɛ kaseli ɔmɛ na a, a nya kpɛ a he, nɛ a bi ke, “Kɛ ba lɛ kɛɛ loko ngmɔkɔ tso ɔ gbli amlɔ kikɛ nɛ ɔ?”
21 Yesu he nɔ ke, “Niinɛ, i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke, ke nyɛ ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi nɛ nyɛ ji nɔ́ ɔ, pi nɔ́ nɛ a pee ngmɔkɔ tso nɛ ɔ kɛkɛ nɛ nyɛ ma nyɛ pee. Ke nyɛ de yo nɛ ɔ tete po ke, ‘Hiaa, nɛ o ya nɔ wo mi ɔ,’ e maa ba mi ja. 22Ke nyɛ ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ, nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ maa fa kue ngɛ he ɔ, nyɛ nine maa su nɔ.”
He wami nɛ Yesu ngɛ
(Marko 11.27-33; Luka 20.1-8)
23Yesu kpale kɛ ba sɔlemi we ɔ. Benɛ e ngɛ ní tsɔɔe ɔ, osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ, kɛ ma nimeli ɔmɛ ba e ngɔ, nɛ a ba bi lɛ ke, “Mɛni he wami o kɛ ngɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ pee? Mɛnɔ ha mo kikɛmɛ a he wami nɛ ɔ?”
24Yesu de mɛ ke, “Ma bi nyɛ munyu ko, nɛ ke nyɛ nyɛ́ ha mi heto ɔ, kɛkɛ imi hu ma tsɔɔ nyɛ he wami nɛ i kɛ peeɔ kikɛmɛ a ní nɛ ɔmɛ. 25He wami nɛ Yohane kɛ sɔle nihi ɔ, jije jamɛ a he wami ɔ je? E je Mawu ngɔ, loo adesa ngɔ?”
Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ kɛ nya sami ba a kpɛti, nɛ a de ke, “Ke wa de ke, ‘E je Mawu ngɔ’ ɔ, e ma bi wɔ ke, ‘Mɛni he je nyɛ he we lɛ yi mɔ?’ 26Ke wa de ke, ‘E je adesa dɛ mi’ ɔ, lɔ ɔ hu wa ngɛ ma kpekpemi ɔ gbeye yee; ejakaa mɛ tsuo a deɔ ke Yohane ɔ, gbalɔ ji lɛ.” 27Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a ha Yesu heto ke, “Wa li.”
Lɛ hu e de mɛ ke, “Lɛɛ imi hu i be nyɛ tsɔɔe nɔ́ he wami nɛ i kɛ ngɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ pee.
Binyumuhi enyɔ ɔmɛ a he abɛ
28“Jehanɛ ɔ, kɛ nyɛ susuu kɛɛ? Nyumu ko ngɛ binyumuhi enyɔ. Ligbi ko ɔ, e ya nɔkɔtɔma a ngɔ, nɛ e ya de lɛ ke, ‘Ye bi, mwɔnɛ ɔ, yaa tsu ní ngɛ ye wai ngmɔ ɔ mi.’ 29E he nɔ ke, ‘I be yae.’ Se pee se ɔ, e tsake e yi mi, nɛ e ho. 30Tsɛ ɔ ya jokuɛ ɔ hu ngɔ, nɛ e ya de lɛ ja nɔuu. E he nɔ ke, ‘Yoo tsaatsɛ, ma ya!’ Se e yɛ. 31Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ni enyɔ nɛ ɔmɛ a kpɛti mɛnɔ lɛ pee nɔ́ nɛ a tsɛ ɔ suɔ?”
A he nɔ ke, “Nɔkɔtɔma a.”
Yesu de mɛ ke, “Niinɛ, i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke, tó tsuli ɔmɛ, kɛ ajuama amɛ sɛ nyɛ hlami kɛ yaa Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ mi. 32 Ejakaa Yohane ba nyɛ ngɔ, nɛ e ba tsɔɔ nyɛ blɔ kpakpa nɛ nyɛɛ nyɛɛ nɔ, nɛ nyɛ he we lɛ yi; se tó tsuli ɔmɛ, kɛ ajuama amɛ he lɛ ye. Pee se benɛ nyɛ ná le ɔ hu, nyɛ pia we nyɛ he tete, konɛ nyɛ he lɛ nyɛɛ ye.”
Wai ngmɔ ɔ mi ní tsuli ɔmɛ a he abɛ
(Marko 12.1-12; Luka 20.9-19)
33 Yesu de mɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ bu abɛ kpa hu tue. Zugbatsɛ ko hi si. E pee wai ngmɔ, nɛ e du tso tsɔwi kɛ po piɛ wo he kɛ kpe; e tsua wai tɛ muɔ ngɛ mi, nɛ e ma buli a mɔ hu ngɛ mi. Kɛkɛ nɛ e kɛ ha ní tsuli apaa humi; nɛ e doma. 34Benɛ wai yiblii nya buami be su ɔ, zugbatsɛ nɛ ɔ tsɔ e tsɔli kɛ ya huli ɔmɛ a ngɔ kaa wai yiblii ɔ nɛ a bua nya a, a ya ngɔ lɛɛ e blɔ fa mi nɔ́ kɛ ba. 35Se huli ɔmɛ nuu e tsɔli ɔmɛ; a kongo nɔ kake, nɛ a gbe nɔ kake, nɛ a fia nɔ kake tɛ. 36Jehanɛ, e tsɔ tsɔli kpahi nɛ hiɛ pe kekle ni ɔmɛ. Se huli ɔmɛ pee mɛ ja nɔuu. 37Pee se ɔ, e tsɔ lɛ nitsɛ e binyumu kɛ ya a ngɔ. E de ke, ‘Ye binyumu ɔ lɛɛ a maa bu lɛ.’ 38Se benɛ huli ɔmɛ na e bi ɔ mohu ɔ, a de a he ke, ‘Ɛhɛɛ, ní yelɔ ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ! Nyɛɛ ba; nyɛ ha waa gbe lɛ nɛ wa nine nɛ su e weto ní ɔ nɔ!’ 39Kɛkɛ nɛ a nu lɛ, nɛ a tsitsɛɛ e yi se kɛ je wai ngmɔ ɔ mi, nɛ a ya gbe lɛ.
40“Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke wai ngmɔtsɛ ɔ ba a, kɛ e maa pee huli nɛ ɔmɛ kɛɛ?”
41A he nɔ ke, “E ma kpata jamɛ a nimli yayami ɔmɛ a hɛ mi butuu, nɛ e maa ngɔ wai ngmɔ ɔ ngɔ ha apaa yeli kpahi, nihi nɛ maa ngɔ wai yiblii ba ha lɛ ngɛ be nɛ sa mi.”
42 Yesu de mɛ ke, “Anɛ nyɛ kane we enɛ ɔ ngɛ ngmami ɔmɛ a mi hyɛ?” Ngmami ɔ ke,
“Tɛ ɔ nɛ tsu fiali ɔmɛ sake fɔ he ɔ,
lɔ ɔ tutuutu ba plɛ kɔ nya tɛ.
Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ lɛ pee enɛ ɔ;
hyɛ bɔ nɛ e ngɛ nyakpɛ ha!”
43Yesu ya nɔ nɛ e de mɛ ke, “Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke, a ma kpɔ Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ ngɛ nyɛ dɛ, nɛ a kɛ ma ha ma je li a ma ko nɛ maa wo yiblii bɔ nɛ sa.” [ 44Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa nɔ tɛ nɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ, e mi ma tsɔtslɔɔ; se nɔ nɛ tɛ ɔ maa nɔ e nɔ ɔ, e maa gblɛ lɛ mɔnyɔmɔnyɔ.]
45Benɛ osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ, kɛ Farisi bi ɔmɛ nu abɛ ɔmɛ nɛ Yesu bu ɔ, a kɔ se kaa a he munyu e ngɛ tue ɔ nɛ. 46Nɛ a ka kaa a maa nu lɛ, se a ya ye ma kpekpemi ɔ gbeye, ejakaa ma a buu lɛ gbalɔ.

Title: MATEO 22
Content:
Matsɛ bi ɔ yo kpeemi he abɛ
(Luka 14.15-24)
1Yesu kɛ ni ɔmɛ tu munyu ekohu ngɛ abɛhi a mi ke, 2“Hiɔwe matsɛ yemi ɔ ngɛ kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ. Be ko ɔ, matsɛ ko ngmɛ okplɔɔ ha e binyumu nɛ kpee yo. 3E tsɔ nihi ke a ya tsɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ a kpee ɔ kɛ ba okplɔɔ ɔ he, se a sume kaa a maa ba. 4E kpale tsɔ ni kpahi ke a ya de nihi nɛ a kpee ɔ ke, ‘I gbe niye ní ɔ nya. A gbe na, kɛ lohwe kpakpahi nɛ wo zɔ; a gbe nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nya. Nyɛɛ ba yo kpeemi okplɔɔ ɔ he koo!’ 5Se mɛɛ lɛɛ a bui tete, nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ ngɔ e blɔ; nɔ kake ho ngmɔ mi ya, nɛ nɔ kake hu ho konɛ e ya ye jua. 6Ni nɛmɛ nɛ piɛ ɔ, mɛɛ lɛɛ a nuu tsɔli ɔmɛ, nɛ a pee mɛ nisɛ ní, nɛ a gbe mɛ ngɔ si nɔ. 7Matsɛ ɔ mi mi fu, nɛ e tsɔ ta buli kɛ ho, nɛ a ya kpata jamɛ a awi yeli ɔmɛ a hɛ mi, nɛ a sã ma a.
8“Jehanɛ, e de e tsɔli ɔmɛ ke, ‘A to yo kpeemi ɔ he ní gbe nya mohu, se nihi nɛ a fɔ̃ nine ɔ, a sɛ. 9Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ ya magbɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ nihi abɔ nɛ nyɛ maa na a, nyɛɛ kpee mɛ kɛ ba yo kpeemi okplɔɔ ɔ he.’ 10Kɛkɛ nɛ tsɔli ɔmɛ je kpo kɛ ya blɔ ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ nihi nɛ a na ngɛ lejɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, a bua mɛ tsuo a nya, nimli yayamihi, kɛ nimli kpakpahi. Nɛ yo kpeemi he ɔ hyi tɔ kɛ nihi.
11“Se benɛ matsɛ ɔ ba nɛ e ba hyɛ nihi nɛ a kpee ɔ, e na nyumu ko ngɛ lejɛ ɔ nɛ lɛɛ e wui yo kpeemi tade. 12Matsɛ ɔ bi lɛ ke, ‘Ye huɛ, kɛ o pee kɛɛ kɛ ba hiɛ ɔ nɛ o wui yo kpeemi tade ɔ?’ Se nyumu ɔ pɛ̃ e nya mi. 13 Kɛkɛ nɛ matsɛ ɔ de e tsɔli ɔmɛ ke, ‘Nyɛɛ fi e nine, kɛ e nane ngɔ bla, nɛ nyɛ ya sake lɛ ngɔ fɔ tsu ɔ se ngɛ diblii ɔ mi tsitsaa. Lejɛ ɔ nɛ e maa wo ya, nɛ e ma kpe e lungu nya ngɛ.’ ”
14Yesu gbe e munyu ɔ nya ke, “A tsɛ nihi fuu, se bɔɔ pɛ a hla.”
Tó tsumi
(Marko 12.13-17; Luka 20.20-26)
15Jehanɛ, Farisi bi ɔmɛ ho nɛ a ya so, bɔ nɛ a maa pee nɛ a ma na Yesu he blɔ kɛ gu lɛ nitsɛ e munyu tumi nɔ. 16Kɛkɛ nɛ a tsɔ a kaseli ɔmɛ a ti ni komɛ, kɛ Herode we bi komɛ kɛ ba e ngɔ. A ba de lɛ ke, “Tsɔɔlɔ, wa le kaa anɔkualetsɛ ji mo. Bɔ nɛ Mawu suɔ kaa adesa nɛ hi si ɔ, o tsɔɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ nɛ o yi nɔ ko nɔ ko gbeye; ejakaa o hyɛ we nimli a hɛ mi. 17Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, de wɔ; kɛ o susuu kɛɛ? Anɛ mlaa ngmɛɛ blɔ kaa a tsu tó ha Kaisare ɔ, aloo a ko tsu?”
18Se Yesu na ga yaya a nɛ a to ɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e de ke, “Osatotsɛmɛ, mɛni he je nyɛ ngɛ mi dae ɔ? 19Nyɛɛ tsɔɔ mi sika nɛ a kɛ tsuɔ tó ɔ.”
A ngɔ sika a kɛ ba; 20nɛ e bi mɛ ke, “Mɛnɔ ofoni ji nɛ ɔ, nɛ mɛnɔ biɛ a ngma ngɛ nɔ ɔ?”
21A he nɔ ke, “Kaisare ɔ.”
Yesu de mɛ ke, “Lɛɛ nyɛɛ ngɔ Kaisare ɔ níhi ngɔ ha Kaisare ɔ, nɛ nyɛɛ ngɔ Mawu níhi ngɔ ha Mawu.”
22Benɛ a nu enɛ ɔ, a nya kpɛ a he, nɛ a si lɛ.
Ni gbogboehi a si temi
(Marko 12.18-27; Luka 20.27-40)
23 Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ nɔuu ɔ, Saduki bi, nɛ mɛɛ a deɔ ke ni gbogboehi a si temi ko be ɔ ba Yesu ngɔ ba bi lɛ ke, 24 “Tsɔɔlɔ, Mose de ke, ke nyumu ko gbo, nɛ e be bimɛ ɔ, e nyɛmi nɛ ngɔ e yalɔyo ɔ, konɛ e wo ngmɛdu ha e nyɛmi nɛ be je mi ɔ. 25Aa, nyɛmimɛ kpaago hi hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ. Nɔkɔtɔma a ngɔ yo, nɛ e gbo; nɛ akɛnɛ e si we bimɛ ngɛ e se he je ɔ, e si e yalɔyo ɔ ngɔ ha e senɔ ɔ. 26E tsa nɔ ja nɔuu kɛ gu nɔ nɛ ji enyɔ ɔ kɛ nɔ nɛ ji etɛ ɔ a nɔ, kɛ ya su nɔ nɛ ji kpaago ɔ nɔ. 27Nyagbe ɔ, yo ɔ hu ba gbo. 28Lɛɛ ligbi ɔ nɛ ni gbogboehi maa te si ɔ, nyɛmimɛ kpaago ɔmɛ a kpɛti mɛnɔ yo e maa pee, nɛ́ mɛ tsuo a kɛ lɛ hi si ɔ?”
29Yesu de mɛ ke, “Nyɛ tɔ! Ejakaa nyɛ li ngmami ɔmɛ, aloo Mawu he wami. 30Benɛ ni gbogboehi maa te si kɛ ba wami mi ekohu ɔ, a maa hi kaa hiɔwe bɔfohi; a be yo ngɔe, nɛ nɔ ko hu be gbae. 31Jehanɛ, nɔ́ nɛ kɔɔ ni gbogboehi a si temi he ɔ, anɛ nyɛ kane we nɔ́ nɛ Mawu de nyɛ ɔ hyɛ? Mawu ke, 32 ‘Imi ji Abraham Mawu, kɛ Isak Mawu, kɛ Yakob Mawu.’ Mawu ɔ, hɛ kali a Mawu ji lɛ, pi ni gbogboehi a Mawu.”
33Benɛ nimli kpekpemi ɔ nu enɛ ɔ, bɔ nɛ e plɛ kɛ tsɔɔ mɛ ní ɔ pee mɛ nyakpɛ.
Mlaa nguaa a
(Marko 12.28-34; Luka 10.25-28)
34Benɛ Farisi bi ɔmɛ nu kaa Yesu jɔɔ Saduki bi ɔmɛ a he ɔ, a ba bua a he nya ngɛ he kake. 35 A ti nɔ kake nɛ ji mlaa tsɔɔlɔ ɔ bi lɛ munyu nɛ e kɛ ka lɛ. E bi lɛ ke, 36“Tsɔɔlɔ, mlaa a te nɔ́ nɛ pe kulaa nɛɛ?”
37 Yesu he nɔ ke, “ ‘Suɔ Nyɔmtsɛ, o Mawu ɔ kɛ o tsui tsuo, kɛ o klaa tsuo, kɛ o juɛmi tsuo.’ 38Enɛ ɔ ji kekleekle mlaa, kɛ mlaa nɛ kle pe kulaa. 39 Mlaa nɛ nyɛɛ se ɔ hu ngɛ kaa jã kɛ̃: ‘Suɔ o nyɛmi nɔmlɔ kaa bɔ nɛ o suɔ mo nitsɛ o he.’ 40Mose mlaa a, kɛ tsɔɔmihi nɛ gbali ɔmɛ tsɔɔ ɔ tsuo daa si ngɛ mlaa enyɔ nɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ.”
Kpɔlɔ ɔ he sane
(Marko 12.35-37; Luka 20.41-44)
41Benɛ Farisi bi komɛ ba bua a he nya a, Yesu bi mɛ ke, 42“Kɛ nyɛ susuɔ ngɛ Kristo ɔ he kɛɛ? Mɛnɔ nina ji lɛ?”
A he nɔ ke, “David nina ji lɛ.”
43Yesu bi mɛ ke, “Mɛni he je mɔ nɛ mumi ɔ ba David nɔ, nɛ e tsɛ lɛ ‘Nyɔmtsɛ’ ɔ? David ke,
44 ‘Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ de ye Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ke,
“Hii ye hiɔ nɔ
kɛ yaa su be nɛ ma ngɔ o he nyɛli ɔmɛ kɛ wo o nane sisi.” ’
45Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke David tsɛ lɛ ‘Nyɔmtsɛ’ ɔ, kɛ peeɔ kɛɛ nɛ Kristo ɔ pa peeɔ e nina mɔ?”
46Nɔ ko nɔ ko nyɛ we nɛ e ha Yesu heto kpakpa ko. Nɛ kɛ je jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, nɔ ko kɛ́ kaa e ma bi lɛ munyu ko hu.

Title: MATEO 23
Content:
Yesu ka mlaa tsɔɔli ɔmɛ, kɛ Farisi bi ɔmɛ a hɛ mi
(Marko 12.38-39; Luka 11.43, 46; 20.45-46)
1Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Yesu kɛ nimli kpekpemi ɔ, kɛ e kaseli ɔmɛ tu munyu. E de mɛ ke, 2“Mlaa tsɔɔli ɔmɛ, kɛ Farisi bi ɔmɛ ji nihi nɛ a ngɔ he wami ngɔ wo a dɛ, konɛ a tsɔɔ Mose mlaa a sisi saminya. 3Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ a de nyɛ ke nyɛɛ pee ɔ, nyɛɛ bu mɛ tue nɛ nyɛɛ pee. Se a ní peemi níhi lɛɛ nyɛ ko pee; ejakaa slo nɔ́ nɛ a peeɔ ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ a deɔ he. 4A boɔ tlomi nɛ jiɔ, nɛ e tloomi wa kɛ pueɔ nihi a konɔ; se mɛ nitsɛmɛ lɛɛ a nine nguɛ kake tete po sɛ tlomi ɔ he. 5 Ke a ngɛ nɔ́ ko pee ɔ, kikɛ nɛ ɔ a hɛ ngɛ si poe nɛ a ngɛ hyɛe kaa nihi maa na mɛ lo. Lohwe he womihi nɛ a ngma Mawu munyu ngɛ a nɔ nɛ a fiɔ ngɛ a hɛ nya, kɛ a nine he ɔ, hyɛ bɔ nɛ a bli gbabagbabaa ha! Dekehi hu nɛ ngɛ a tade klɔii ɔmɛ a nya a, hyɛ bɔ nɛ lɔ ɔmɛ hu ka gagaaga ha! 6A suɔ okplɔɔ yi himi ngɛ ní yemi he, kɛ nikɔtɔmahi a sihi hehi ngɛ kpe he ɔmɛ; 7a suɔ nɛ a kɛ bumi nɛ nga mɛ ngɛ jua nɔ, nɛ a tsɛ mɛ ke, ‘Tsɔɔlɔ!’ 8Nyɛɛ lɛɛ, a ko tsɛ nyɛ ‘Tsɔɔlɔ’, ejakaa nyɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ nyɛmimɛ ji nyɛ, nɛ tsɔɔlɔ kake pɛ nyɛ ngɛ. 9Nyɛ ko tsɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko ngɛ zugba a nɔ ‘Tsɛ’, ejakaa Tsɛ kake pɛ nyɛ ngɛ nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe. 10Jehanɛ, a ko tsɛ nyɛ ti nɔ ko ‘Tsɔɔlɔ’ hulɔ; ejakaa tsɔɔlɔ kake pɛ nyɛ ngɛ, nɛ lɛ ji Kristo. 11 Nɔ nɛ ji nɔmlɔ nguaa ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti ɔ, e plɛ nyɛ sɔmɔlɔ. 12 Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ woɔ e he nɔ ɔ, a maa ba lɛ si; se nɔ nɛ baa e he si ɔ, a ma wo e nɔ.
Yesu gbe a we osato peemi ɔ he guɛ
(Marko 12.40; Luka 11.39-42, 44, 52; 20.47)
13“Nyɛ mlaa tsɔɔli, kɛ Farisi bi, musu tloo nyɛ! Osatotsɛmɛ! Nyɛ ngaa hiɔwe matsɛ yemi ɔ nya ngɔ woɔ nihi, se nyɛ nitsɛmɛ lɛɛ nyɛ sɛ́ mi. Ni nɛmɛ nɛ a hlaa kaa a maa sɛ mi ɔ hu nyɛ ngmɛ́ mɛ blɔ! [ 14Nyɛ mlaa tsɔɔli, kɛ Farisi bi, musu tloo nyɛ! Osatotsɛmɛ! Nyɛ kpɔɔ yalɔyihi a wehi ngɛ a dɛ. Kɛkɛ ɔ, nyɛ ya peeɔ sɔlemi gagaaga! Enɛ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ tue gblami ɔ maa pee gbeye.]
15“Nyɛ mlaa tsɔɔli, kɛ Farisi bi, musu tloo nyɛ! Osatotsɛmɛ! Nyɛ kuɔɔ wo, nɛ nyɛ kpaa zugbahi a nɔ kaa nyɛ maa na nɔ kake pɛ nɛ tsake pee Yuda no lo. Ke nyɛ na nɔ ko kaa ja a, nyɛ peeɔ lɛ nɔ nɛ sa Abosiami a je la a mi yami si enyɔ nɛ bla mohu pe nyɛ nitsɛmɛ po!
16“Nyɛ blɔ tsɔɔli hɛ yuyuili, musu tloo nyɛ! Nyɛ deɔ ke, ‘Ke nɔ ko kɛ sɔlemi we ɔ ka kita a, lɔ ɔ pi nɔ́ ko kulaa. Se ke e kɛ sɔlemi we ɔ sika tsu ka kita nɛ e yi nɔ ɔ, lɔ ɔ lɛɛ musu tloo lɛ.’ 17Hɛ yuyuili kuasiahi! Te nɔ́ nɛ he jua wa nɛɛ? Sika tsu ɔ, aloo sɔlemi we ɔ nɛ haa sika tsu ɔ peeɔ klɔuklɔu ɔ? 18Jehanɛ ɔ hu, nyɛ deɔ ke, ‘Ke nɔ ko kɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ ka kita a, lɔ ɔ pi nɔ́ ko kulaa. Se ke e kɛ nike ní nɛ fɔɔ si ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ ka kita nɛ e yi nɔ ɔ, lɔ ɔ lɛɛ musu tloo lɛ.’ 19Hɛ yuyuili! Te nɔ́ nɛ he jua wa nɛɛ? Nike ní ɔ, aloo bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɛ haa nike ní ɔ peeɔ klɔuklɔu ɔ? 20Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke nɔ ko kɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ ka kita a, blɔɔ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ, kɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ fɔɔ si ngɛ nɔ ɔ e kɛ ka kita a nɛ. 21Jã kɛ̃, ke nɔ ko kɛ sɔlemi we ɔ ka kita a, blɔɔ sɔlemi we ɔ, kɛ Mawu nɛ hii lejɛ ɔ e kɛ ka kita a nɛ. 22 Ke nɔ ko kɛ hiɔwe ka kita a, blɔɔ Mawu sɛ ɔ, kɛ nɔ nɛ hii si ngɛ nɔ ɔ e kɛ ka kita a nɛ.
23 “Nyɛ mlaa tsɔɔli kɛ Farisi bi! Musu tloo nyɛ! Osatotsɛmɛ! Nyɛ haa Mawu kowɛ, kɛ anisi, kɛ kumino mi dlami nyɔngmanyɔngma mi kakaaka, se níhi nɛ mlaa a tsɔɔ kaa a he hia, níhi kaa dami sane yemi, mɔbɔ nami, kɛ anɔkuale yemi ɔ, lɔ ɔmɛ lɛɛ nyɛ siɔ. Jinɛ e sa kaa nyɛɛ pee enɛ ɔmɛ, nɛ nyɛ ko si ekpa amɛ hulɔ. 24Blɔ tsɔɔli hɛ yuyuili! Ke anunu nɔ dã mi ɔ, nyɛ tsleɔ pueɔ he, se nyɛ mii afukpɔngɔ!
25“Nyɛ mlaa tsɔɔli, kɛ Farisi bi! Musu tloo nyɛ! Osatotsɛmɛ! Nyɛ fɔɔ kplu kɛ kã he, se ojo, kɛ adufude níhi hyi mɛ tɔ. 26Farisi bi hɛ yuyuili! Nyɛ fɔ kplu ɔ, kɛ kã a a mi kekle, kɛkɛ ɔ a he hu ma tsɔ!
27 “Nyɛ mlaa tsɔɔli, kɛ Farisi bi! Musu tloo nyɛ! Osatotsɛmɛ! Nyɛ ngɛ kaa yɔkɔhi nɛ a sa a he nɛ a he pee fɛu, se a mi hyi tɔ kɛ ni gbogboehi a wuhi, kɛ ní sasɛhi. 28Kikɛ nɛ ɔ pɛ nyɛ hu nyɛ ngɛ; nihi naa nyɛ kaa nimli kpakpahi, se osato, kɛ yayami hyi nyɛ mi mi tɔ.
Yesu de ke a maa gbla Farisi bi ɔmɛ a tue
(Luka 11.47-51)
29“Nyɛ mlaa tsɔɔli, kɛ Farisi bi! Musu tloo nyɛ! Osatotsɛmɛ! Nyɛ fiaa yɔkɔhi kɛ haa gbali ɔmɛ. Nyɛ dlaa dali ɔmɛ a yɔkɔ ɔmɛ a he saminyawiiwi, 30nɛ nyɛ deɔ ke, ‘Wa nɛmɛ ɔmɛ a yi nɔ ɔ, wa ngɛ je mi jinɛ wa ko piɛ we a he kɛ pue gbali ɔmɛ a muɔ si.’ 31Enɛ ɔ tsɔɔ kaa nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ ngɛ odase yee kaa nihi nɛ gbe gbali ɔmɛ a nina ji nyɛ. 32Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ ya nɔ! Ní tsumi nɛ nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ je sisi ɔ, nyɛ tsu kɛ gbe nya! 33 Sinɔhi kɛ sinɔhi a nina! Nyɛ tue nɛ a maa gbla ngɛ Abosiami a je la a mi ɔ, kɛ nyɛ maa pee kɛ tu fo ngɛ nya kɛɛ? 34Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ma tsɔ gbali, kɛ ní leli, kɛ tsɔɔli kɛ ba nyɛ ngɔ. Nyɛ maa gbe a ti ni komɛ, nɛ nyɛ maa sɛu ni komɛ; ni komɛ lɛɛ nyɛ maa fia mɛ kpa ngɛ nyɛ kpe he ɔmɛ, nɛ nyɛ maa wa mɛ yi mi, nɛ nyɛ maa fie mɛ kɛ je ma kake mi kɛ ya ma kake mi. 35 Kɛkɛ ɔ, nimli kpakpahi tsuo nɛ a pue a muɔ si ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi, kɛ maa je Habel nɛ a pue e muɔ si yaka gu ɔ nɔ kɛ yaa su Barakia binyumu Zakaria nɛ nyɛ gbe lɛ ngɛ sɔlemi we ɔ, kɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ a kpɛti ɔ nɔ ɔ a he ɔ, a maa gbla nyɛ tue. 36Niinɛ, i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke, tue gblami nɛ ɔ maa ba yi nɔ bi nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a nɔ!
Suɔmi nɛ Yesu ngɛ kɛ ha Yerusalem
(Luka 13.34-35)
37“Yerusalem! Yerusalem! Mo nɛ o gbee gbali ɔmɛ, nɛ nihi nɛ Mawu tsɔ mɛ o ngɔ ɔ, o fiaa mɛ tɛ! Hyɛ kaa jinɛ i hla si abɔ kaa ma bua o bimɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a nya kaa bɔ nɛ kungwɔ buaa e bimɛ a nya kɛ woɔ e pɛli sisi ɔ. Se o kplɛɛ we! 38 Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a maa je o sɔlemi we ɔ he, nɛ e maa fɔ si gu. 39 I ngɛ mo dee ke, kɛ je be nɛ ɔ mi kɛ yaa a, o be mi nae hu kɛ yaa si be nɛ o ma de ke, ‘A gbaa nɔ nɛ ma ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ biɛ mi ɔ.’ ”

Title: MATEO 24
Content:
Yesu de ke be ma nɛ a maa ku sɔlemi we ɔ pue si
(Marko 13.1-2; Luka 21.5-6)
1Benɛ Yesu je sɔlemi we ɔ mi kɛ yaa a, e kaseli ɔmɛ ba e ngɔ, nɛ a kɛ a nine tsɔɔ lɛ tsuhi nɛ ngɛ sɔlemi we ɔ he. 2Se Yesu de mɛ ke, “Tse nyɛ ngɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo hyɛe? Niinɛ, i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke, a maa ku tsu nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo pue si nɛ a be tɛ kake po sie ngɛ eko nɔ.”
Haomi kɛ yi mi wami
(Marko 13.3-13; Luka 21.7-19)
3Benɛ Yesu hii si ngɛ Oliv yo ɔ yi mi ɔ, e kaseli ɔmɛ ba e ngɔ ngɛ laami mi ba bi lɛ ke, “Mɛni be ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo maa ba mi? Mɛni okadi maa tsɔɔ o bami be, kɛ je nɛ ɔ nyagbe be?”
4Yesu he nɔ nɛ e de mɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ hyɛ nɛ hi, konɛ nɔ ko kó ba mlɔɔ nyɛ. 5Ejakaa nihi fuu maa ba, nɛ a ma ba tu munyu ngɛ ye biɛ mi ke, ‘Imi ji Kristo ɔ nɛ!’ nɛ a maa mlɔɔ nihi babauu. 6Nyɛ maa nu tahi a he, kɛ akeake hu nɛ ngɛ pɛe ngɛ tahi a he. Se nyɛ tsui ko po. Ja ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ba mi; se kɛ̃, lɔ ɔ tsɔɔ we kaa nyagbe ɔ su ta. 7Ma maa te si ngɔ wo ma, nɛ matsɛ yemi maa te si ngɔ wo matsɛ yemi. Hwɔ nɛ nya wa maa ba, nɛ zugba ma mimiɛ ngɛ he tsuaa he. 8Se enɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ngɛ kaa kɔɔmi sisije kɛkɛ.
9 “Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, a maa nuu nyɛ; nɛ a maa ngɔ nyɛ ngɔ ha nɛ a wa nyɛ yi mi nɛ a gbe nyɛ. Nɛ ye he ɔ, je ma amɛ tsuo maa nyɛ nyɛ. 10Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, nihi babauu a nane ma kpata; huɛmɛ maa tsɔɔ huɛmɛ a se blɔ, nɛ a maa nyɛ a he. 11Lakpa gbali babauu maa te si, nɛ a maa mlɔɔ nihi fuu. 12Yayami maa pɔ he ngɛ zugba a nɔ tsuo, nɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ma ha nihi fuu a nine mi maa je wu. 13 Se ni nɛmɛ nɛ maa da haomi nɛ ɔmɛ a nya kɛ yaa su nyagbe ɔ, mɛɛ lɛɛ a ma he a yi wami. 14Nɛ sane kpakpa nɛ ɔ nɛ kɔɔ matsɛ yemi ɔ he ɔ, a maa fiɛ kɛ kpa je ɔ mi tsuo, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ je ma amɛ tsuo nɛ a nu; nɛ lɔ ɔ se loko nyagbe ɔ maa ba.
Ní hiemi nɔ́ nguaa a
(Marko 13.14-23; Luka 21.20-24)
15 “Nyɛ maa na ‘Ni hiemi nɔ́ ngua a’ nɛ gbalɔ Daniel tu he munyu ɔ nɛ maa si ngɛ he klɔuklɔu ɔ. (Ni kanelɔ ɔ nɛ kɔ se!) 16Kɛkɛ ɔ, ni nɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ Yudea a, a tu fo kɛ ya yo ɔmɛ a nɔ. 17 Nɔ nɛ ngɛ tsu yi mi ɔ, e ko kple si ya ngɔ e níhi ngɛ we ɔ mi. 18Nyumu nɛ ngɛ ngmɔ si ɔ, e ko kpale ya ngɔ e tade. 19Jamɛ a be ɔ, yihi nɛ maa hɛɛ hɔ, kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ maa hi bi nyɔ hae ɔ, due ha mɛ! 20Nyɛɛ fa kue ha Mawu nɛ e ko ba mi kaa nyɛ maa tu fo fĩɛ be mi, aloo ngɛ Hejɔɔmi ligbi nɔ! 21 Ejakaa jamɛ a be ɔ, haomi nguaa maa ba nɛ a nɛ eko hyɛ kɛ je be nɛ a bɔ je ɔ kɛ ba si mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ. Lɔ ɔ se hu, nɔ́ ko kaa ja be bae gblegbleegble. 22Se Mawu po ligbi ɔmɛ a nɔ kpiti momo; kaa e pee we jã jinɛ adesa ko adesa ko yi be wami nae. Mawu bimɛ ɔmɛ nɛ e hla a a he je ɔ, a maa po jamɛ a ligbi ɔmɛ a nɔ kpiti.
23“Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, ke nɔ ko de nyɛ ke, ‘Hyɛ, Kristo ɔ ngɛ hiɛ ɔ’, aloo, ‘E ngɛ lejɛ’ ɔ, nyɛ ko he ye. 24Ejakaa lakpa kristohi, kɛ lakpa gbali maa te si. A maa pee okadi nguahi, kɛ nyakpɛ níhi kɛ mlɔɔ nihi nɛ Mawu hla a tete. 25Hyɛ, i ngɛ nyɛ enɛ ɔ dee loko be ɔ nɛ su.
26 “Aloo ke nihi ma de nyɛ ke, ‘Hyɛ, e ngɛ nga a nɔ’ ɔ, nyɛ ko ya lejɛ ɔ; ke a de nyɛ ke, ‘E ngɛ se tsu ɔ mi’ ɔ, nyɛ ko he ye. 27Ejakaa Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ maa ba tlukaa kaa bɔ nɛ oslabai gbaa kɛ jeɔ beleku kɛ yaa bonyoku ɔ.
28 “He tsuaa he nɛ gbogboe fɔɔ si ngɛ ɔ, lejɛ ɔ okpokuhi ma bua a he nya ngɛ.
Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ bami
(Marko 13.24-27; Luka 21.25-28)
29 “Haomi nɛ maa ba jamɛ a be ɔ, ke e se po pɛ pu maa tsɔ diblii, nɛ nyɔhiɔ be kpɛe hu. Dodoehi ma tsɔ kɛ je hiɔwe ba fia si, nɛ a maa fie he wamihi nɛ bɔle je ɔ kɛ je a blɔ hehi. 30 Kɛkɛ ɔ, Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ we okadi ɔ maa je kpo ngɛ hiɔwe. Zugba a nɔ wɛtso ɔmɛ tsuo maa na Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ nɛ ma ngɛ hiɔwe bɔku ɔmɛ a mi kɛ he wami, kɛ hɛ mi nyami babauu. Nɛ mɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ a maa wo yana. 31Titimati nguaa a maa pɛ, nɛ Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ maa tsɔ e bɔfo ɔmɛ kɛ ya je ɔ kɔ nya eywiɛ ɔmɛ. A ma ya bua nihi nɛ e hla a a nya kɛ maa je he kake kɛ maa ya he kake.
Ngmɔkɔ tso ɔ he ní kasemi
(Marko 13.28-31; Luka 21.29-33)
32“Nyɛɛ hyɛ ngmɔkɔ tso ɔ, nɛ nyɛɛ kase ní. Ke ngmɔkɔ tso kɔnihi plɔke, nɛ a bɔni ba tsɛ̃mi pɛ nyɛ le kaa latsa be ɔ su ta. 33Jã nɔuu, ke nyɛ hu nyɛ na ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ɔ, nyɛɛ le kaa Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ su si ta; e ngɛ agbo ɔ nya haa kɛ ma. 34Niinɛ, i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke, kikɛmɛ a yi nɔ nɛ ɔ be bee, ja ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ba mi lolo. 35Hiɔwe kɛ zugba maa be kɛ ho, se ye munyu ɔmɛ lɛɛ a be bee kɛ ho gblegbleegble.
Ligbi ɔ, kɛ ngmlɛfia a, nɔ ko li
(Marko 13.32-37; Luka 17.26-30, 34-36)
36“Se jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, kɛ jamɛ a ngmlɛfia a, nɔ ko nɔ ko li. Hiɔwe bɔfo ɔmɛ li ɔ, Bi ɔ tete li; Tsɛ ɔ nɔ kake too lɛ le. 37 Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ maa ba tlukaa kaa nɔ́ nɛ ba ngɛ Noa be ɔ mi ɔ. 38Be mi nɛ nyu kpekpemi ɔ ma ba ha zugba a hɛ mi ɔ, nihi ngɛ ngma yee, nɛ a ngɛ ní nue; nyumuhi ngɛ yihi ngɔe, nɛ yihi hu ngɛ gbae hluu kɛ ya su ligbi ɔ nɛ Noa ya sɛ lɛ ɔ mi. 39 Jamɛ a be ɔ mi tsuo ɔ, a li nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ nɔ yae kɛ ya si nyu kpekpemi ɔ ba muɔ mɛ tsuo kɛ ho. Ligbi ɔ nɛ Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ maa ba a, kikɛ nɛ ɔ nɔuu níhi maa ya nɔ. 40Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, nyumuhi enyɔ maa hi ní tsue ngɛ ngmɔ si, nɛ a ma ba ngɔ nɔ kake, nɛ a ma si nɔ kake. 41Yihi enyɔ maa hi wɛɛe ngɛ wɛ nɔ; a ma ba ngɔ nɔ kake, nɛ a ma si nɔ kake.
42“Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ hɛ nɛ hi nyɛ he nɔ; ejakaa nyɛ li ligbi ɔ nɛ nyɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ma. 43 Nyɛ ná nyɛɛ le kaa ke wetsɛ ko le nyɔ mi be tutuutu nɛ julɔ maa ba e we mi ɔ, e ko huɔ, nɛ e ko ngmɛ́ blɔ nɛ julɔ ɔ ba ju lɛ. 44Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ hu nyɛ dla nyɛ he kɛ to; ejakaa Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ maa ba tlukaa be mi nɛ nyɛ hɛ be nɔ.
Tsɔlɔ kpakpa a, kɛ tsɔlɔ yaya a
(Luka 12.41-48)
45“Lɛɛ mɛnɔ ji tsɔlɔ anɔkualetsɛ, kɛ ní lelɔ mɔ? Lɛ ji nɔ nɛ e nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ngɔ lɛ ngɔ to tsɔli kpa amɛ a nya, konɛ e ha mɛ a nya mi ngma ngɛ be nɛ sa mi. 46Tsɔlɔ nɛ ke e nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ba we mi, nɛ e ma ba na kaa e ngɛ jã pee ɔ, a gbaa lɛ. 47Niinɛ, i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke, nyɔmtsɛ ɔ maa ngɔ tsɔlɔ nɛ ɔ ngɔ pee e weto ní tsuo nɔ hyɛlɔ. 48Se ke tsɔlɔ yaya ji lɛ ɔ, e ma de ngɛ e yi mi ke e nyɔmtsɛ ɔ se ya fia si bɔɔ. 49Kɛkɛ ɔ, e ma bɔni nyɛmimɛ tsɔli kpa amɛ kpa fiami, nɛ e kɛ dã tɔli ma ya ye ní, nɛ a maa nu ní. 50Jamɛ a tsɔlɔ ɔ, e nyɔmtsɛ ɔ maa ba ligbi nɛ e hyɛ we lɛ blɔ, kɛ ngmlɛfia nɛ e li. 51Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ma tsɔtslɔɔ e mi, nɛ tue gblami nɛ sa osatotsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, e ma na eko. Lejɛ ɔ nɛ e maa wo ya, nɛ e ma kpe e lungu nya ngɛ.

Title: MATEO 25
Content:
Yihewi nyɔngma amɛ a he abɛ ɔ
1 “Jamɛ a be ɔ, hiɔwe matsɛ yemi ɔ maa hi kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ. Be ko ɔ, yihewi nyɔngma komɛ wo a kanehi, nɛ a ho konɛ a ya hyɛ ayɛflo huno blɔ. 2A kpɛti ni enuɔ ji kuasiahi, nɛ ni enuɔ lɛɛ ní leli ji mɛ. 3Kuasia amɛ ngɔɛ nu kɛ piɛ we kane ɔmɛ nɛ a hɛɛ ɔ a he. 4Ní leli ɔmɛ lɛɛ a hɛɛ nu kɛ tɔ ngɔ piɛ a kane ɔmɛ a he. 5Se ayɛflo huno ɔ ya bɛ mla, nɛ kɔnɛɛ de yihewi ɔmɛ, nɛ a hwɔ mahe.
6“Nyɔ mi kpɛti ɔ, huhui pɛ ke, ‘Ayɛflo huno ɔ ma oo! Nyɛɛ je kpo nɛ nyɛ ba kpee lɛ!’ 7Yihewi ɔmɛ tsuo te si, nɛ a tsɛ̃ a kane ɔmɛ a mi. 8Kɛkɛ nɛ kuasia amɛ de ní leli ɔmɛ ke, ‘Nyɛ ha wɔ nyɛ nu ɔ eko, ejakaa wa kane ɔmɛ ngɛ gboe.’ 9Se ní leli ɔmɛ de mɛ ke, ‘Eko ɔ, e ba be waa kɛ nyɛ tsuo sue; nyɛɛ ya nu juali ɔmɛ a ngɔ nɛ nyɛ ya he nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ nɔ́.’ 10Se benɛ a ho hemi ya a, ayɛflo huno ɔ ba, nɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ dla a he to lɛ ɔ, a kɛ lɛ ho yo kpeemi he ɔ ya. Nɛ a nga sinya a.
11 “Pee se ɔ, yihewi kpa amɛ hu ba, nɛ a ba de ke, ‘Nyɔmtsɛ! Nyɔmtsɛ! Bli wɔ!’ 12Se ayɛflo huno ɔ he nɔ ke, ‘Niinɛ, i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke i li nyɛ.’ ”
13Nɔ́ nɛ Yesu de kɛ gbe e munyu ɔ nya ji, “Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ hyɛ nyɛ he nɔ saminya, ejakaa jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, loo jamɛ a ngmlɛfia a, nyɛ li.
Tsɔli etɛ ɔmɛ a he abɛ ɔ
(Luka 19.11-27)
14 “Jamɛ a be ɔ, hiɔwe matsɛ yemi ɔ maa hi kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ: Be ko ɔ, nyumu ko miɔ nɛ e maa doma. E tsɛ e tsɔli ɔmɛ, nɛ e tu e weto ní ngɔ wo a dɛ. 15E ha nɔ tsuaa nɔ sika bɔ nɛ nɔ ɔ ma nyɛ maa hyɛ nɔ. E ha nɔ kake sika tsu yi akpe enuɔ; e ha nɔ kake sika tsu yi akpe enyɔ, nɛ nɔ ko hu na yi akpe. Kɛkɛ nɛ e doma. 16Nɔ nɛ na sika tsu yi akpe enuɔ ɔ ho amlɔ, nɛ e kɛ sika a ya tsu ní; nɛ e na sika tsu yi akpe enuɔ kɛ bɔ he. 17Nɔ nɛ na sika tsu yi akpe enyɔ ɔ hu ya na enyɔ kɛ bɔ he ja nɔuu. 18Se nɔ nɛ na akpe ɔ ho nɛ e ya tsua si, nɛ e pu e nyɔmtsɛ ɔ sika a ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.
19“E ngɛ mi hluu ɔ, tsɔli ɔmɛ a nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ba, nɛ e kɛ mɛ ba bu akɔtaa. 20Tsɔlɔ ɔ nɛ na sika tsu yi akpe enuɔ ɔ ba, nɛ e kɛ akpe enuɔ kpa hu ba bɔ he. Nɛ e ke, ‘Nyɔmtsɛ, o ha mi sika tsu yi akpe enuɔ. O nɛ, i kɛ na akpe enuɔ ngɔ piɛ he.’ 21E nyɔmtsɛ ɔ de lɛ ke, ‘Ayekoo, tsɔlɔ kpakpa, kɛ anɔkualetsɛ! O ye anɔkuale ngɛ nɔ́ ko bɔɔ mi; ma ngɔ mo ngɔ to níhi fuu a nya. Ba nɛ o kɛ mi ba na bua jɔmi!’
22“Tsɔlɔ ɔ nɛ na sika tsu yi akpe enyɔ ɔ hu ba, nɛ e ba de ke, ‘Nyɔmtsɛ, o ha mi sika tsu yi akpe enyɔ. O nɛ, i kɛ na akpe enyɔ ngɔ piɛ he.’ 23E nyɔmtsɛ ɔ de lɛ ke, ‘Ayekoo, tsɔlɔ kpakpa, kɛ anɔkualetsɛ! O ye anɔkuale ngɛ nɔ́ ko bɔɔ mi; ma ngɔ mo ngɔ to níhi fuu a nya. Ba nɛ o kɛ mi ba na bua jɔmi!’
24“Nɔ nɛ na sika tsu yi akpe ɔ hu ba, nɛ e ba de ke, ‘Nyɔmtsɛ, i le mo kaa o yi mi wa; o kpaa ní ngɛ he nɛ o du we ní ngɛ, nɛ o buaa ní nya ngɛ he nɛ o fĩa we ní ngɛ. 25Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i ye gbeye, nɛ i ya tsua si, nɛ i pu o sika a. Ne o ní!’
26“Se e nyɔmtsɛ ɔ he nɔ nɛ e de ke, ‘Tsɔlɔ yaya kɛ alitsɛ! O le kaa i kpaa ní ngɛ he nɛ i du we ní ngɛ, nɛ i buaa ní nya ngɛ he nɛ i fĩa we ní ngɛ; pi jã? 27Jinɛ o ko ngɔ ye sika a ya to ngɛ sika tomi he, konɛ ke i ba a, ma ba he ye ní kɛ hekpa. 28Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ he e sika a ngɛ e dɛ, nɛ nyɛɛ ngɔ kɛ ha nɔ nɛ ngɛ sika tsu yi akpe nyɔngma a. 29 Ejakaa nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ngɛ nɔ́ ko ɔ, a kɛ eko maa piɛ he ha lɛ, konɛ e na babauu. Se nɔ nɛ be nɔ́ ko ɔ, a ma he bɔɔ nɛ e ngɛ ɔ tete ngɛ e dɛ. 30 Kikɛmɛ a tsɔlɔ nɛ he be se nami nɛ ɔ, nyɛ sake lɛ ngɔ wo diblii ɔ mi lokoo. Lejɛ ɔ nɛ e maa wo ya, nɛ e ma kpe e lungu nya ngɛ.’
Kojomi ligbi nguaa a
31 “Ligbi ɔ nɛ Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ maa ba kaa matsɛ, nɛ bɔfo ɔmɛ tsuo maa piɛ e he kɛ ba a, jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, e maa hi e matsɛ sɛ saminyayoo ɔ nɔ, 32nɛ a ma bua je ma amɛ tsuo a nya ngɛ e hɛ mi. Kɛkɛ ɔ, e ma gba a mi kaa bɔ nɛ to hyɛlɔ gbaa jijɔ, kɛ apletsi mi ɔ. 33E maa ngɔ jijɔ ɔmɛ ngɔ da e hiɔ nɔ, nɛ apletsi ɔmɛ maa da e muɔ nɔ. 34Kɛkɛ ɔ, matsɛ ɔ ma de nihi nɛ ngɛ e hiɔ nɔ ɔ ke, ‘Nyɛ nihi nɛ Tsaatsɛ gbaa nyɛ, nyɛɛ ba! Matsɛ yemi ɔ nɛ a dla ngɔ to nyɛ kɛ je be nɛ a to je ɔ sisi ɔ, nyɛ ba ngɔ. 35Hwɔ ye mi, nɛ nyɛ ha mi ní nɛ i ye; kuma ye mi, nɛ nyɛ ha mi nyu nɛ i nu; nubwɔ ji mi, nɛ nyɛ ha i ba to nyɛ ngɔ. 36I hɛɛ ye he gu, nɛ nyɛ wo mi tade. I nu hiɔ, nɛ nyɛ ba slaa mi; a wo mi tsu mi, nɛ nyɛ ba ye ngɔ.’
37“Kɛkɛ ɔ, dali ɔmɛ ma bi lɛ ke, ‘Nyɔmtsɛ, mɛni be wa na mo nɛ hwɔ ngɛ mo yee, nɛ wa ha mo ní nɛ o ye, aloo kuma ngɛ mo yee, nɛ wa ha mo nyu nɛ o nu? 38Mɛni be wa na kaa nubwɔ ji mo, nɛ wa ha o ba to wɔ, aloo kaa o hɛɛ o he gu, nɛ wa wo mo tade? 39Jehanɛ ɔ, mɛni be wa na mo nɛ o be he wami, aloo kaa a wo mo tsu, nɛ wa ba slaa mo?’ 40Matsɛ ɔ ma he nɔ ke, ‘Niinɛ, i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke, be abɔ nɛ nyɛ pee ngɔ ha ye nyɛmimɛ nɛ ɔmɛ a ti nɔ nyafii pe kulaa a, imi nyɛ pee ngɔ ha a nɛ!’
41“Kɛkɛ ɔ, e ma de ni nɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ e muɔ nɔ ɔ ke, ‘Nyɛ nihi nɛ Mawu gbiɛ nyɛ, nyɛɛ je ye nɔ! Neneene la nɛ a dla ngɔ to Abosiami, kɛ e bɔfo ɔmɛ ɔ, nyɛ ya sɛ mi! 42Hwɔ ye mi, se nyɛ ha we mi ní ma ye; kuma ye mi, se nyɛ ha we mi nyu ma nu; 43Nubwɔ ji mi, se nyɛ ha we nɛ ma ba to nyɛ; i hɛɛ ye he gu, se nyɛ wui mi tade; i nu hiɔ, nɛ jehanɛ hu a wo mi tsu, se nyɛ ba slaa we mi.’
44“Kɛkɛ ɔ, mɛ hu a ma bi ke, ‘Nyɔmtsɛ, mɛni be wa na mo nɛ hwɔ ngɛ mo yee, aloo kuma ngɛ mo yee, aloo kaa nubwɔ ji mo, aloo o hɛɛ o he gu, aloo o be he wami, aloo a wo mo tsu, nɛ wa ba ji ngmlaa ha mo ɔ?’ 45Matsɛ ɔ ma he nɔ ke, ‘Niinɛ, i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke, be abɔ nɛ nyɛ pee we ngɔ ha ye nyɛmimɛ nɛ ɔmɛ a ti nɔ nyafii pee kulaa a, nyɛ pee we ngɔ ha we imi hulɔ.’ 46 Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nimli nɛ ɔmɛ maa ya neneene he hiami mi; se dali ɔmɛ lɛɛ a maa ya neneene wami mi.”

Title: MATEO 26
Content:
A so Yesu yi nɔ
(Marko 14.1-2; Luka 22.1-2; Yohane 11.45-53)
1Benɛ Yesu tu munyu nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo gbe nya a, e de e kaseli ɔmɛ ke, 2 “Kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ le ɔ, e piɛ ligbi enyɔ pɛ nɛ a maa ye Hetsɔmi ɔ, nɛ a maa ngɔ Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ ngɔ ha nɛ a ya sɛu lɛ.”
3Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ, kɛ ma nimeli ɔmɛ ya bua a he nya ngɛ osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa Kayafa mɔ ɔ mi, 4nɛ a ya so bɔ nɛ a maa pee kɛ nu Yesu ga mi, nɛ a gbe lɛ. 5A de ke, “Wa be nɔ́ nɛ ɔ pee nyami be ɔ mi, konɛ basabasa kó ba ma a mi.”
A pɔ Yesu nu ngɛ Betania
(Marko 14.3-9; Yohane 12.1-8)
6Jehanɛ Yesu ba su Betania, nɛ e ba Simon we ɔ mi. Simon nɛ ɔ nu he womi nɔ hiɔ yaya hyɛ. 7 Benɛ Yesu ngɛ ní yee ɔ, yo ko hɛɛ alabastro tɔ kɛ e mi nu kɛ e he via nɛ he jua wa kɛ ba e ngɔ. Nɛ e plɛ nu ɔ kɛ pue Yesu yi mi. 8Benɛ e kaseli ɔmɛ na a, a mi mi fu, nɛ a bi ke, “Kɛ ji yaka ní puɛmi nɛ ɔ sisi kɛɛ? 9Nu kɛ e he via nɛ ɔ, a ko jua we sika fuu, nɛ a ngɔ ha ohiatsɛmɛ lo?”
10Se Yesu na a juɛmi ɔ momo. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e bi mɛ ke, “Mɛni he je nyɛ ngɛ yo ɔ nya dooe? E tsu ní tsumi saminyayoo ha mi. 11 Ejakaa nyɛɛ kɛ ohiatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ maa hi si daa; se imi lɛɛ pi daa nɛ i kɛ nyɛ maa hi si. 12Nu kɛ e he via nɛ ɔ nɛ e plɛ ngɔ pue ye nɔmlɔ tso nɔ ɔ, e kɛ dla mi ngɔ to ye pumi be. 13Niinɛ, i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke, je nɛ ɔ mi he tsuaa he nɛ a maa fiɛ sane kpakpa nɛ ɔ ngɛ ɔ, a maa sɛɛ nɔ́ nɛ yo nɛ ɔ pee nɛ ɔ hu kɛ kai lɛ.”
Yuda kplɛɛ kaa e maa tsɔɔ Yesu se blɔ
(Marko 14.10-11; Luka 22.3-6)
14Kɛkɛ nɛ kaseli nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ a kpɛti nɔ kake nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Yuda Iskariot ɔ pue nɔ kɛ ho osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ a ngɔ ya, 15 nɛ e ya de mɛ ke, “Ke i je Yesu ngɔ wo nyɛ dɛ mi ɔ, mɛni nyɛ ma ha mi?” A kane sika hiɔ yi nyingmi etɛ ngɔ ha lɛ, 16nɛ kɛ je jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, Yuda hla Yesu he blɔ, konɛ e ngɔ lɛ kɛ wo a dɛ mi.
Yesu kɛ e kaseli ɔmɛ ye Hetsɔmi niye ní ɔ
(Marko 14.12-21; Luka 22.7-13, 21-23; Yohane 13.21-30)
17Abolokplolo nyami be ɔ we kekleekle ligbi ɔ, kaseli ɔmɛ ba Yesu ngɔ ba bi lɛ ke, “Jije o suɔ kaa wa ya dla ha mo nɛ o ye Hetsɔmi ɔ ngɛ?”
18E de mɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ ya asimasi ngɔ ngɛ ma a mi, nɛ nyɛ ya de lɛ ke, ‘Tsɔɔlɔ ɔ ke, Ye be ɔ su; i kɛ ye kaseli ɔmɛ ma ba ye Hetsɔmi ɔ ngɛ o we ɔ mi.’ ”
19Kaseli ɔmɛ ya pee bɔ nɛ Yesu de mɛ ɔ, nɛ a pee niye ní ɔ nɛ a kɛ maa ye Hetsɔmi ɔ ngɔ to.
20Gbɔkuɛ ɔ, Yesu kɛ e kaseli nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ ya hi si ngɛ okplɔɔ ɔ he. 21Benɛ a ngɛ ní ɔ yee ɔ, Yesu de ke, “Niinɛ, i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke, nyɛ ti nɔ kake maa tsɔɔ ye se blɔ.”
22Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ha kaseli ɔmɛ hao wawɛɛ, nɛ a bɔni lɛ bimi kakaaka ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, imi lo?”
23 Yesu he nɔ ke, “Nɔ nɛ maa tsɔɔ ye se blɔ ɔ, e kɛ mi ngɛ ní yee ngɛ kaa nɛ ɔ mi. 24Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ ma gbo kaa bɔ nɛ a ngma ngɛ e he ɔ, se musu tloo nɔ nɛ maa tsɔɔ e se blɔ ɔ! Afani nɛ a fɔ we jamɛ a nɔmlɔ ɔ!”
25Yuda, nɔ nɛ tsɔɔ e se blɔ ɔ, bi lɛ ke, “Tsɔɔlɔ, imi lo?”
Yesu he nɔ ke, “Ja o de ɔ nɛ.”
Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ niye ní ɔ
(Marko 14.22-26; Luka 22.14-20; Korinto Bi I, 11.23-25)
26Benɛ a ngɛ ní ɔ yee ɔ, Yesu kɛ̃ abolo nɛ e gbaa nɔ, nɛ e ku mi, nɛ e ngɔ ha e kaseli ɔmɛ, nɛ e ke, “Nyɛ he nɛ nyɛɛ ye! Enɛ ɔ ji ye nɔmlɔ tso ɔ nɛ.”
27Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, e wo kplu, nɛ e na Mawu si, nɛ e ngɔ ha mɛ, nɛ e ke, “Nyɛ tsuo nyɛɛ nu. 28 Enɛ ɔ ji ye muɔ nɛ a kɛ sɔu Mawu somi ɔ nya. A plɛ ye muɔ ɔ ngɔ pue si ha nihi fuu, konɛ a ngɔ a he yayamihi ngɔ pa mɛ. 29I ngɛ nyɛ dee ke, i be wai nɛ ɔ nue hu gblegbleegble kɛ yaa si ligbi ɔ nɛ i kɛ nyɛ maa nu wai he ɔ ngɛ Tsaatsɛ matsɛ yemi ɔ mi.”
30Kɛkɛ nɛ a la yi jemi la, nɛ a je kpo, nɛ a pue nɔ kɛ ho Oliv yo ɔ nɔ ya.
Yesu gba ngɔ to kaa Petro ma kua lɛ
