Nihi nɛ Mawu hla a a he ɔ, e po ligbi ɔmɛ a nɔ.
21“Jehanɛ hu ke nɔ ko de nyɛ ke, ‘Hyɛ, Kristo ɔ ngɛ hiɛ ɔ!’ aloo ‘Hyɛ, e ngɛ lejɛ ɔ!’ ɔ, nyɛ ko he ye. 22Ejakaa lakpa kristohi, kɛ gbali maa te si, nɛ a maa pee okadihi, kɛ nyakpɛ níhi, konɛ ke e maa hi ɔ, a mlɔɔ ni nɛmɛ nɛ a hla a tete. 23Se nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛɛ hyɛ saminya! I de nyɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ ngɔ to.
Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ bami
(Mateo 24.29-31; Luka 21.25-28)
24 “He hiami nɛ ɔ se ɔ, pu maa tsɔ diblii, nɛ nyɔhiɔ hu be kpɛe. 25 Dodoehi ma tsɔ kɛ je hiɔwe ba nɔ si, nɛ a ma tsitsɛɛ he wamihi nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ kɛ je a blɔ hehi. 26 Kɛkɛ ɔ, a maa na Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ kaa e ma ngɛ bɔku mi kɛ he wami nguaa, kɛ hɛ mi nyami. 27E maa tsɔ hiɔwe bɔfo ɔmɛ kɛ ya bua nihi nɛ Mawu hla a a nya kɛ je je ɔ kɔ nya eywiɛ ɔmɛ tsuo, kɛ je zugba nyagbe he kɛ yaa si hiɔwe nyagbe he.
Ngmɔkɔ tso ɔ he ní kasemi
(Mateo 24.32-35; Luka 21.29-33)
28“Nyɛɛ kase nɔ́ ko ngɛ ngmɔkɔ tso ɔ he; ke e kɔni ɔmɛ tsɛ̃ nɛ ba mumu ba nɔ ɔ, nyɛ le kaa latsa be su ta. 29Ja nɔuu hu ke nyɛ na nɛ kikɛmɛ a ní nɛ ɔmɛ ba mi ɔ, nyɛ na nɛ nyɛɛ le kaa be ɔ su haa. 30Anɔkuale mi i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke, loko yi nɔ nɛ ɔ maa be ɔ, ja ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ba mi lolo. 31Hiɔwe kɛ zugba maa be kɛ ho, se ye munyu ɔmɛ lɛɛ a be bee kɛ ho kɔkɔɔkɔ.
Nɔ ko li ligbi ɔ, loo ngmlɛfia a
(Mateo 24.36-44)
32 “Se jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, loo ngmlɛfia a, nɔ ko li; hiɔwe bɔfo ɔmɛ li, Bi ɔ hu li, ja Tsɛ ɔ pɛ. 33Nyɛɛ hyɛ saminya, nyɛɛ huɔ, ejakaa nyɛ li be mi nɛ ngmlɛfia a maa su. 34 E ngɛ kaa nyumu ko nɛ benɛ e maa doma a, e si e we ngɔ ha e tsɔli. E ha a ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ ní tsumi pɔtɛɛ nɛ e ma tsu. E de bulɔ ɔ ke e hyɛ we ɔ nɔ saminya. 35Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ hyɛ saminya, ejakaa nyɛ li be mi nɛ wetsɛ ɔ ma; eko ɔ gbɔkuɛ, loo nyɔ mi kpɛti, loo kungwɔ nɔ kpami be, loo mɔtu, 36konɛ ke e ba tlukaa a, e kó ba na nyɛ kaa nyɛ ngɛ mahe hwɔe. 37Nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ dee ɔ, nihi tsuo i ngɛ dee ɔ nɛ. Nyɛɛ huɔ!”

Title: MARKO 14
Content:
A so Yesu yi nɔ
(Mateo 26.1-5; Luka 22.1-2; Yohane 11.45-53)
1 Benɛ e piɛ ligbi enyɔ nɛ a maa ye Hetsɔmi ɔ, kɛ Abolokplolo nyami be ɔ, osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ, kɛ mlaa tsɔɔli ɔmɛ hla bɔ nɛ a maa pee nɛ a nu Yesu ga mi nɛ a gbe lɛ. 2Se a de a he ke, “Wa ko pee nɔ́ nɛ ɔ nyami ligbi ɔ, konɛ basabasa ko ba ma a mi.”
A pɔ Yesu nu ngɛ Betania
(Mateo 26.6-13; Yohane 12.1-8)
3 Yesu ba Betania, nɛ e ba to Simon we ɔ mi. Simon nɛ ɔ nu he womi nɔ hiɔ yaya ko hyɛ. Benɛ Yesu hii si ngɛ ní yee ɔ, yo ko hɛɛ tɔ kɛ e mi nu via liliili nɛ he jua wa kɛ ba e ngɔ. E ywia tɔ ɔ, nɛ e plɛ nu ɔ ngɔ pue Yesu yi mi. 4Se ni komɛ nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ kɛ mi mi la de a he ke, “Mɛni he je nɛ e puɛ nu ɔ kikɛ nɛ ɔ? 5Jinɛ kikɛmɛ a nu nɛ ɔ, a ko jua lɛ sika hiɔ yi lafa etɛ nɛ́ a kɛ ha ohiatsɛmɛ.” Ni ɔmɛ tu munyu nyanyaanya kɛ si yo ɔ.
6Se Yesu de mɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ jɔɔ lɛ haomi! Mɛni he je nyɛ ngɛ e nya dooe ɔ? E tsu ní saminyayoo ha mi. 7 Ohiatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ kɛ mɛ ngɛ daa, nɛ be tsuaa be nɛ nyɛ suɔ ɔ, nyɛ ma nyɛ maa pee mɛ kpakpa; se imi lɛɛ pi daa nɛ i kɛ nyɛ maa hi si. 8Yo nɛ ɔ pee nɔ́ nɛ e ma nyɛ. E sɛ hlami pɔ ye nɔmlɔ tso ɔ nu ngɔ to ye pumi. 9Niinɛ, i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke, he tsuaa he nɛ a maa fiɛ sane kpakpa a ngɛ ngɛ je ɔ mi tsuo ɔ, a maa sɛɛ nɔ́ nɛ yo nɛ ɔ pee nɛ ɔ hu kɛ kai lɛ.”
Yuda kplɛɛ kaa e maa tsɔɔ Yesu se blɔ
(Mateo 26.14-16; Luka 22.3-6)
10Jehanɛ Yuda Iskariot, ni nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake ɔ pue nɔ kɛ ho osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ a ngɔ ya, konɛ e ya tsɔɔ mɛ Yesu se blɔ. 11Benɛ a nu nɔ́ nɛ e de ɔ, a nyá, nɛ a wo lɛ si ke a ma ha lɛ sika. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yuda hla bɔ nɛ e maa pee nɛ e ha a nine nɛ su Yesu nɔ ngɛ be nɛ sa mi.
Yesu kɛ e kaseli ɔmɛ ye Hetsɔmi niye ní ɔ
(Mateo 26.17-25; Luka 22.7-14, 21-23; Yohane 13.21-30)
12Abolokplolo nyami be ɔ we kekleekle ligbi ɔ nɛ a gbee to kɛ yeɔ Hetsɔmi ɔ, Yesu kaseli ɔmɛ bi lɛ ke, “Jije o suɔ nɛ wa ya pee Hetsɔmi niye ní ɔ ngɔ to mo ngɛ?”
13Yesu tsɔ e kaseli ɔmɛ a ti ni enyɔ, nɛ e de mɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ ya ma a mi. Ke nyɛ su lejɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ kɛ nyumu ko nɛ tloo buɛ kɛ e mi nyu maa kpe. Nyɛɛ nyɛɛ e se 14kɛ ya we mi he nɛ e yaa a. Nyɛ de wetsɛ ɔ ke, Tsɔɔlɔ ɔ ke, ‘Nibwɔhi a to he ɔ, he nɛ i kɛ ye kaseli ɔmɛ maa ye Hetsɔmi niye ní ɔ ngɛ ɔ, jije e ngɛ?’ 15E maa tsɔɔ nyɛ hiɔwe tsu asa nguaa ko nɛ a dla mi saminyayoo. Nyɛɛ pee niye ní ɔ ngɔ to wɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.”
16E kaseli ɔmɛ pue nɔ kɛ ho, nɛ a ya na nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ kaa bɔ nɛ e de mɛ ɔ. Kɛkɛ nɛ a pee Hetsɔmi niye ní ɔ.
17Gbɔkuɛ ɔ, Yesu kɛ e kaseli nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ ba lejɛ ɔ. 18 Benɛ a hii si nɛ a ngɛ ní yee ɔ, Yesu de ke, “I ngɛ nyɛ dee anɔkuale mi ke, Nyɛ ti nɔ kake maa tsɔɔ ye se blɔ; jamɛ a nɔ ɔ kɛ mi ngɛ ní yee.”
19E kaseli ɔmɛ hao, nɛ a bi lɛ kakaaka ke, “Imi lo? Imi lo?”
20Yesu he nɔ ke, “Nyɛ ni nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ nɛ ɔmɛ nyɛ kpɛti nɔ kake; jamɛ a nɔ ɔ kɛ mi ngɛ ní yee ngɛ ka nɛ ɔ mi. 21Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ ma gbo kaa bɔ nɛ a ngma ngɛ e he ɔ mohu, se musu tloo nɔ nɛ tsɔɔ Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ se blɔ ɔ! Afani mohu nɛ a na we nɛ a fɔ jamɛ a nɔ ɔ.”
Nyɔmtsɛ niye ní ɔ
(Mateo 26.26-30; Luka 22.14-20; Korinto Bi I, 11.23-25)
22Benɛ a ngɛ ní yee ɔ, Yesu kɛ̃ abolo ɔ eko nɛ e jɔɔ nɔ; kɛkɛ nɛ e ku mi, nɛ e kɛ ha e kaseli ɔmɛ, nɛ e de mɛ ke, “Nyɛ hee! Enɛ ɔ ji ye nɔmlɔ tso.”
23Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, Yesu wo kplu; e na Mawu si, nɛ e ngɔ ha mɛ, nɛ mɛ tsuo a nu wai ɔ eko. 24 Yesu de mɛ ke, “Ye muɔ nɛ a ngɔ pue si ha nihi babauu nɛ a kɛ sɔu Mawu somi ɔ nya ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. 25I ngɛ nyɛ dee anɔkuale mi ke, i be wai nue hu kɛ yaa su ligbi nɛ ma nu lɛ ehe ngɛ Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ mi.”
26Jehanɛ a la yi jemi la, lɔ ɔ se ɔ, a je kpo kɛ ho Oliv yo ɔ nɔ ya.
Yesu de ngɔ to ke Petro ma kua lɛ
(Mateo 26.31-35; Luka 22.31-34; Yohane 13.36-38)
27 Yesu de e kaseli ɔmɛ ke, “Nyɛ tsuo nyɛ nane ma kpata, ejakaa a ngma ke, ‘Ma fia to hyɛlɔ ɔ nɔ́, nɛ to ɔmɛ maa gbɛ fĩa.’ 28 Se ke a tle mi si kɛ ba wami mi ekohu ɔ, ma sɛ nyɛ hlami kɛ ya Galilea.”
29Se Petro de lɛ ke, “Ke ni ɔmɛ tsuo maa je o he ɔ, imi lɛɛ i be o he jee.”
30Yesu de lɛ ke, “I ngɛ mo dee anɔkuale mi ke, mwɔnɛ ɔ nyɔ mi kungwɔ be nɔ kpae si enyɔ nɛ o ma de si etɛ ke o li mi.”
31Petro tu munyu kɛ kã pe kekle ɔ ke, “Ke i kɛ mo ma gbo tete po i be kpalee ngɛ o se!”
Nɛ kaseli ɔmɛ tsuo de ja nɔuu.
Yesu ya sɔle ngɛ Getsemane
(Mateo 26.36-46; Luka 22.39-46)
32A ba su he ko nɛ a tsɛɛ Getsemane, nɛ Yesu de e kaseli ɔmɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ hi si ngɛ hiɛ ɔ nɛ ma ya sɔle bɔɔ.” 33Yesu ngɔ Petro, Yakobo, kɛ Yohane ngɔ piɛ e he kɛ ho. Gbeye nu lɛ, nɛ e hao wawɛɛ. 34E de mɛ ke, “Ye klaa ngɛ haoe wawɛɛ, nɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ miɔ nɛ e gbe mi. Nyɛɛ hi si ngɛ hiɛ ɔ nɛ nyɛɛ huɔ!”
35E ya e hɛ mi bɔɔ, nɛ e bu si, nɛ e sɔle konɛ ke e maa hi ɔ, amanehlu ɔ nɛ be e he kɛ ho. 36E de ke, “Tsaatsɛ! O nyɛɔ níhi tsuo peeɔ! I kpa mo pɛɛ, je amanehlu kplu nɛ ɔ kɛ ho; se kɛ̃ ɔ, pi bɔ nɛ i suɔ, se bɔ nɛ mo o suɔ.”
37Benɛ e kpale kɛ ba a, e ba na kaseli etɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a ngɛ mahe hwɔe. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e de Petro ke, “Simon, mahe o ngɛ hwɔe? O nyɛ we nɛ o fɔ nyɔ ngmlɛfia kake po?” 38Kɛkɛ nɛ e de mɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ huɔ nɛ nyɛɛ sɔle konɛ Abosiami ko ka nyɛ. Mumi ɔ suɔ kaa e maa pee, se nɔmlɔ tso ɔ nyɛ we kulaa.”
39Yesu kpale ho ekohu nɛ e ya sɔle, nɛ e tu jamɛ a munyu ɔ nɔuu. 40Benɛ e kpale e se kɛ ba ekohu ɔ, e ba na kaa a hwɔ mahe, ejakaa nyɔ gbe mɛ, nɛ a li nɔ́ nɛ a ma de lɛ.
41Benɛ e kpale ba nɔ́ nɛ ji si etɛ ɔ, e de mɛ ke, “Nyɛ lɛ nyɛ he mi jɔ nyɛ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ mahe hwɔe kɛ mwɔɔ nɛ ɔ? E hiɛ! Ngmlɛfia a su jehanɛ; a ngɔ Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ kɛ ngɛ yayami peeli a dɛ mi woe. 42Nyɛɛ te si; nyɛ ha waa ho! Hyɛ, nɔ nɛ maa tsɔɔ ye se blɔ ɔ ma.”
A nu Yesu
(Mateo 26.47-56; Luka 22.47-53; Yohane 18.3-12)
43Benɛ Yesu ngɛ munyu tue kɛ mwɔɔ ɔ, Yuda, ni nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake ɔ ba hia si ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. E nyɛɛ nihi fuu nɛ hɛɛ klaatehi kɛ okpotihi a hɛ mi kɛ ba. Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ, mlaa tsɔɔli ɔmɛ, kɛ ma nimeli ɔmɛ nɛ a tsɔ mɛ. 44Nɔ nɛ maa tsɔɔ e se blɔ ɔ to mɛ okadi ko ke, “Nɔ nɛ ma fiɔ e nya he ɔ, lɛ ji nɔ ɔ nɛ; nyɛɛ nu lɛ, nɛ nyɛɛ hɛɛ lɛ kɛ ho slɔkee.”
45Benɛ Yuda su si nɔuu pɛ nɛ e ba Yesu ngɔ, nɛ e ke, “Tsɔɔlɔ!” nɛ e fiɔ e nya he. 46Kɛkɛ nɛ ni ɔmɛ ba bu Yesu nɔ, nɛ a nu lɛ. 47Nihi nɛ daa si ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, a ti nɔ kake hia klaate nɛ e kɛ po osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa a nyɔguɛ ɔ tue. 48Yesu wo e nya nɔ nɛ e de mɛ ke, “Imi lɛ nyɛ ma numi kɛ klaatehi kɛ okpotihi kaa a nuu ojo fialɔ ɔ? 49 Daa nɛ i kɛ nyɛ ngɛ sɔlemi we ɔ, nɛ́ i tsɔɔ nyɛ ní ɔ, lɔ ɔ lɛɛ nyɛ nui mi; se e sa kaa nɔ nɛ a ngma a nɛ ba mi.”
50Kɛkɛ nɛ e kaseli ɔmɛ tsuo tu fo si lɛ.
51Niheyo ko nyɛɛ e se nɛ kploba pɛ e kɛ ha e he. Ni ɔmɛ ka lɛ numi; 52se e si kploba a, nɛ e tu fo kɛ je kɛ e he gu.
Yesu ngɛ kpe ngua a hɛ mi
(Mateo 26.57-68; Luka 22.54-55; 22.63-71; Yohane 18.13-14; 18.19-24)
53Jehanɛ ɔ, a kɛ Yesu ho osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa a we ɔ mi ya. Lejɛ ɔ nɛ osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ, ma nimeli ɔmɛ, kɛ mlaa tsɔɔli ɔmɛ tsuo a nya ba bua ngɛ. 54Petro nyɛɛ a se ngɛ lokoo kɛ ya sɛ osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa a kue ɔ mi ngɛ e we ɔ mi. E ya hi si ngɛ buli ɔmɛ a kasa nya nɛ e ngɛ la hlue. 55Osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ, kɛ kpe ngua a tsuo hla Yesu he sane ko konɛ a da nɔ kɛ gbe lɛ, se a nɛ eko. 56Nihi babauu ba ye lakpa odase kɛ si lɛ, se a nya be kake.
57Jehanɛ ni komɛ te si nɛ a ye lakpa odase kɛ si Yesu ke, 58 “Wɔ nitsɛmɛ wa nu nɛ e de ke, ‘Ma ku sɔlemi we nɛ nimli ma nɛ ɔ, nɛ ligbi etɛ se ɔ, ma ma ekpa nɛ pi nimli nɛ ma.’ ” 59Se lɔ ɔ tete po, a nya be kake.
60Jehanɛ, osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa a te da si ngɛ mɛ tsuo a hɛ mi, nɛ e bi Yesu ke, “O be heto hae lo? Sanehi nɛ a po ngɔ fɔ o nɔ nɛ ɔ, o be nya jee?”
61Se Yesu kpɛ we e kuɔ si, hluu nɛ e maa pã e nya mi po. Osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa a kpale bi lɛ ekohu ke, “Mo ji Kristo ɔ? Mo ji Mawu Bi ɔ nɛ a gbaa?”
62 Yesu he nɔ ke, “Ee, imi. Nyɛ maa na Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ kaa e hii si ngɛ Ope ɔ hiɔ nɔ, nɛ e ngɛ hiɔwe bɔku ɔ mi kɛ ma!”
63Osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa a hía e tade klɔii ɔ ngɛ e he, nɛ e de ke, “Anɛ odase yeli komɛ hia wɔ ekohu lo? 64 Nyɛ nu musu nɛ e bɔ ɔ? Kɛ nyɛ susu kɛɛ?”
Mɛ tsuo a nya pee kake kɛ de ke e yeɔ fɔ, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a gbe lɛ.
65A ti ni komɛ su lada pue Yesu nɔ; a kɛ bo fi e hɛ mi, nɛ a bɔni lɛ kongomi; nɛ a bi lɛ ke, “Mɛnɔ gba mo ma a?” Tsɔɔ wɔ. Buli ɔmɛ bu pue e nɔ nɛ a bɔni lɛ ma gbami kpoto kpoto.
Petro kua Yesu
(Mateo 26.69-75; Luka 22.56-62; Yohane 18.15-18; 18.25-27)
66Benɛ Petro ngɛ kue ɔ mi kɛ mwɔɔ ɔ, osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa a mawayi ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake ba na lɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. 67Benɛ e na Petro nɛ ngɛ la hlue ɔ, e hyɛ lɛ too, nɛ e bi lɛ ke, “Tse mo hu o piɛ Yesu nɛ je Nazaret ɔ he?”
68Se e kplɛɛ we, nɛ e ke, “I li nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ dee nɛ ɔ; nɛ i nui sisi tete.” Jehanɛ Petro je lejɛ ɔ kɛ ho agbo ɔ nya ya.
69Mawayo ɔ na lɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, nɛ e de nihi nɛ daa si ngɛ lejɛ ɔ ke, “A ti nɔ kake ji nɛ ɔ nɛ!”
70Se Petro kplɛɛ we ekohu. Pee se bɔɔ ɔ, nihi nɛ daa si ngɛ lejɛ ɔ de Petro ekohu ke, “Anɔkuale mi ɔ, a ti nɔ kake ji mo; ejakaa Galilea no ji mo!”
71Kɛkɛ nɛ Petro bɔni gbiɛmi kɛ kita kami ke, “I li nɔmlɔ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ e he munyu tue nɛ ɔ!”
72Amlɔ ɔ, kungwɔ kpa nɔ́ si enyɔne; nɛ Petro kai munyu nɛ Yesu de lɛ ke, “Kungwɔ be nɔ kpae si enyɔ nɛ o ma de si etɛ ke o li mi” ɔ. Benɛ Petro kai nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, e hao, kɛkɛ nɛ e wo ya.

Title: MARKO 15
Content:
Yesu ngɛ Pilato hɛ mi
(Mateo 27.1-2; 27.11-14; Luka 23.1-5; Yohane 18.28-38)
1Mɔtu mla a, osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ, ma nimeli ɔmɛ, mlaa tsɔɔli ɔmɛ, kɛ kpe ngua a tsuo ya da, nɛ a fi Yesu; nɛ a kɛ lɛ ya ha Pilato. 2Pilato bi lɛ ke, “Mo ji Yuda bi ɔmɛ a matsɛ ɔ?”
Yesu he nɔ ke, “Ja o de ɔ nɛ!”
3Osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ po e nya babauu nitsɛ, 4lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Pilato bi lɛ ekohu ke, “Hyɛ o nya sɔuu nɛ a ngɛ poe! O be nɔ́ ko dee?”
5Se Yesu de we nɔ́ ko hu; nɛ Pilato hɛ mi pee lɛ yaa.
A bu Yesu gbenɔ fɔ
(Mateo 27.15-26; Luka 23.13-25; Yohane 18.39—19.16)
6Daa Hetsɔmi nyami be ɔ, Pilato ngmɛɛɔ pã mi no kake nɛ ma a bi lɛ ɔ he haa mɛ. 7Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, nyumu ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Baraba ya piɛ ni komɛ a he kɛ tsɔ atuã, nɛ a gbe nɔ. Enɛ ɔ ha nɛ a wo mɛ tsu. 8Benɛ ni kpekpemi ɔ ba bɔni Pilato pɛɛ kpami ke e pee kaa bɔ nɛ e peeɔ daa a ngɔ ha mɛ ɔ, 9e he nɔ nɛ e bi mɛ ke, “Nyɛ suɔ kaa ma ngmɛɛ Yuda bi ɔmɛ a matsɛ ɔ he ha nyɛ lo?” 10E le faii kaa ninyɛ he je nɛ osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ nu Yesu kɛ ba ha lɛ ɔ nɛ.
11Se osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ wo ma a yi mi ke a bi lɛ ke e ngmɛɛ Baraba mohu he ngɔ ha mɛ. 12Pilato bi mɛ ekohu ke, “Lɛɛ mɛni nyɛ ngɛ hlae nɛ ma pee nɔ nɛ nyɛ tsɛɛ lɛ Yuda bi a matsɛ ɔ he mɔ?”
13A kpa huhui ekohu ke, “Sɛu lɛ!”
14Jehanɛ Pilato bi mɛ ke, “Se mɛni yayami po e pee?”
A kpa huhui wawɛɛ mohu pe kekle ɔ ke, “Sɛu lɛ!”
15Akɛnɛ Pilato ngɛ hlae nɛ e pee nɔ́ nɛ sa ma a hɛ mi he je ɔ, e ngmɛɛ Baraba he ha mɛ. Yesu ɔ lɛɛ e ha nɛ a fia lɛ kpa, nɛ e ngɔ lɛ ha a ya sɛu lɛ.
Ta buli ɔmɛ ye Yesu he fɛu
(Mateo 27.27-31; Yohane 19.2-3)
16Ta buli ɔmɛ ngɔ Yesu kɛ ho amlaalo ɔ mɔ ɔ mi ya; nɛ a tsɛ tabo ɔ tsuo kɛ ba kpe. 17A wo Yesu tade he jua wawɛ tsutsuutsu, nɛ a kɛ mio pee jlasi kɛ fi e yi. 18Kɛkɛ nɛ a bɔni lɛ ngami ke, “Yuda bi a matsɛ, manye oo, manye!” 19Kɛkɛ nɛ a kɛ tso fia e yi mi, nɛ a su lada ngɔ pue e nɔ, nɛ a kpla si ha lɛ kaa pe a ngɛ lɛ jae. 20Benɛ a ye e he fɛu se ɔ, a je tade he jua wawɛ tsutsuutsu ɔ ngɛ e he, nɛ a ngɔ lɛ nitsɛ e tade ɔmɛ ngɔ wo lɛ; nɛ a kɛ lɛ ho nɛ a ya sɛu lɛ.
A sɛu Yesu
(Mateo 27.32-44; Luka 23.26-43; Yohane 19.17-27)
21 Simon, Kirene no nɛ ji Aleksandro kɛ Rufo a tsɛ ɔ je ngmɔ si kɛ bee jamɛ a be ɔ mi. Ta buli ɔmɛ nyɛ nyumu nɛ ɔ nɔ ke e wo Yesu sɛumi tso ɔ. 22A kɛ Yesu ho he ko nɛ a tsɛɛ Golgata a ya (Golgata sisi ji Yikoklodonya). 23A ha lɛ wai nɛ a kɛ mire tsopa futu mi ke e nu; se e kua numi. 24 A sɛu lɛ, nɛ a fɔ e tade ɔmɛ a nɔ sɔ, nɛ a dla kɛ ha a he. 25Mɔtu ngmlɛ nɛɛ mi ɔ, a sɛu Yesu, 26nɛ a ngma sane nɛ a kɛ po e nya a kɛ mɛtɛ e yi je ke, “Yuda bi ɔmɛ a matsɛ ɔ.” 27A sɛu awi yeli enyɔ hu ngɔ piɛ e he; nɔ kake ngɛ e hiɔ nɔ, nɛ nɔ kake ngɛ e muɔ nɔ.
[ 28 Nɛ ngmami ɔ nɛ de ke, “A bu lɛ ngɔ si yayami peeli nɔ” ɔ ba mi.]
29 Nihi nɛ bee ɔ tu musu bɔmi munyuhi kɛ si Yesu. A mimiɛ a yi, nɛ a de ke, “Ei, mo nɛ o kuɔ sɔlemi we ɔ, nɛ o kpaleɔ maa lɛ ligbi etɛ ɔ ji nɛ ɔ! 30He mo nitsɛ o yi wami, nɛ o je sɛumi tso ɔ nɔ kɛ kple si!”
31Jã nɔuu osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ, kɛ mlaa tsɔɔli ɔmɛ hu ye e he fɛu ngɛ a kpɛti ke, “E he ni kpahi a yi wami, se lɛ nitsɛ e yi wami lɛɛ e nyɛ we nɛ e he. 32Ke lɛ ji Kristo, Israel matsɛ ɔ, e je sɛumi tso ɔ nɔ kɛ kple si nɛ waa na konɛ wa he ye!”
Ni enyɔ ɔmɛ nɛ a sɛu ngɔ piɛ e he ɔ hu ye e he fɛu.
Yesu gbo
(Mateo 27.45-56; Luka 23.44-49; Yohane 19.28-30)
33Diblii wo ngɛ zugba a tsuo nɔ kɛ je piani ngmlɛ nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ kɛ ya si ngmlɛ etɛ. 34 Ngmlɛ etɛ mi ɔ, Yesu kpa ngmlaa wawɛɛ ke, “Eloi, Eloi, lama sabaktani?” E sisi ji, “Ye Mawu, ye Mawu, mɛni he je nɛ o kua mi?”
35Benɛ nihi nɛ daa si ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, a ti ni komɛ nu ɔ, a de ke, “Hyɛ, e ngɛ Eliya tsɛe.” 36 Kɛkɛ nɛ a ti nɔ ko sa fo nɛ e ya ngɔ wo mi kutsa kɛ sɔ dã nɛ kuã mi, nɛ e kɛ ma tso nya ha lɛ ke e nu; nɛ e de ke, “Nyɛɛ mlɛ! Wa maa hyɛ kaa Eliya maa ba ba je lɛ lo!”
37Jehanɛ Yesu kpa ngmlaa wawɛɛ, kɛkɛ nɛ e ma nya.
38 Sɔlemi we ɔ mi pomi bo ɔ mi gba kɛ je hiɔwe ba ma si. 39Benɛ asafoatsɛ ɔ nɛ daa si ngɛ Yesu hanɔ ɔ na bɔ nɛ e plɛ kɛ gbo ɔ, e de ke, “Niinɛ, nɔmlɔ nɛ ɔ, Mawu Bi ji lɛ!”
40 Yi komɛ hu ngɛ lejɛ ɔ nɛ daa si ngɛ se banee ngɛ nɔ hyɛe. A ti ni komɛ ji Maria Magdalena kɛ Maria, Yakobo wayo kɛ Yose a nyɛ ɔ, kɛ Salome. 41Mɛ lɛ a nyɛɛ Yesu se kɛ je Galilea, nɛ a sɔmɔ lɛ ɔ nɛ. Yi kpa komɛ babauu nɛ kɛ lɛ ba Yerusalem ɔ, a ti ni komɛ hu ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.
A pu Yesu
(Mateo 27.57-61; Luka 23.50-56; Yohane 19.38-42)
42-43He dlami ligbi nɛ nyɛɛ Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ hɛ mi ji jamɛ a ligbi ɔ nɛ. Gbɔkuɛ ɔ, Yosef nɛ je Arimatia pee kã nɛ e ya Pilato ngɔ ya bi lɛ Yesu gbogboe ɔ. Yosef nɛ ɔ, kpe ngua a mi no nɛ a buu saminya ji lɛ, nɛ lɛ nitsɛ hu e ngɛ Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ blɔ hyɛe. 44Se Pilato hɛ mi pee lɛ yaa kaa Yesu gbo momo. E tsɛ asafoatsɛ ɔ, nɛ e bi lɛ ke e gbo kɛ lo. 45Benɛ e ná le enɛ ɔ kɛ je asafoatsɛ ɔ nya a, e fa kaa a ngɔ Yesu gbogboe ɔ kɛ ha Yosef. 46Yosef ya he kploba; nɛ e ba je Yesu gbogboe ɔ kɛ je tso ɔ nɔ. E kɛ kploba a ha he, nɛ e ya to lɛ ngɛ yɔkɔ ko mi. Tɛ sa mi a kpɛ yɔkɔ ɔ ngɛ, nɛ a kpɛne tɛ kɛ tsi muɔ ɔ nya. 47Maria Magdalena, kɛ Maria, Yose nyɛ ɔ daa si nɛ a ngɛ hyɛe he nɛ a to Yesu gbogboe ɔ ngɛ ɔ.

Title: MARKO 16
Content:
Yesu te si kɛ je gbeje
(Mateo 28.1-8; Luka 24.1-12; Yohane 20.1-10)
1Benɛ Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ be ɔ, Maria Magdalena, kɛ Yakobo nyɛ Maria, kɛ Salome ya he tsopa kɛ e he via, konɛ a kɛ ba kpa Yesu gbogboe ɔ. 2Hɔgba mɔtu kpla, pu site be ɔ, a pue nɔ kɛ ho yɔkɔ ɔ nya ya. 3-4A bi a he ngɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ ke, “Mɛnɔ ma kpɛne tɛ ɔ kɛ je muɔ ɔ nya ha wɔ?” (Tɛ ɔ kle saminya). Se benɛ a yaa wo hɛ nɔ ɔ, a na kaa a kpɛne tɛ ɔ kɛ ho se ya. 5Kɛkɛ nɛ a sɛ yɔkɔ ɔ mi, nɛ a na niheyo ko nɛ hii si ngɛ hiɔ nɔ je kɛ e he tade hiɔ klɔii. Enɛ ɔ ha nɛ a ye gbeye.
6Se niheyo ɔ de mɛ ke, “Nyɛ ko ye gbeye! Nyɛ ngɛ Yesu, Nazaret no nɛ a sɛu ɔ hlae; pi jã? E te si! E be hiɛ ɔ. He nɛ a kɛ lɛ fɔ ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. 7 Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ ya nɛ nyɛ de e kaseli ɔmɛ, kɛ Petro hulɔ ke, e ngɛ nyɛ hlami sɛe kɛ yaa Galilea; lejɛ ɔ nyɛ maa na lɛ ngɛ kaa bɔ nɛ e de nyɛ ɔ.”
8Kɛkɛ nɛ a je kpo oya, nɛ a tu fo kɛ je yɔkɔ ɔ he. Nɛ́ a yaa tsuo sawale nu mɛ, nɛ a he ngɛ doe blibliibli; nɛ a de we nɔ ko nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko, ejakaa a ngɛ gbeye yee.
SANE KPAKPA A NYAGBE MOMO KO
Yesu je e he kpo tsɔɔ Maria Magdalena
(Mateo 28.9-10; Yohane 20.11-18)
9[Hɔgba mɔtu mla a nɛ Yesu te si kɛ je gbeje se ɔ, e je e he kpo tsɔɔ Maria Magdalena kekle. Maria nɛ ɔ ji yo nɛ Yesu hia mumi yayami kpaago kɛ je e mi be ko ɔ nɛ. 10Maria ho nɛ e ya sɛɛ ha Yesu huɛmɛ ɔmɛ. E ya na mɛ nɛ a wo yana nɛ a ngɛ awe nyae. 11Se mɛɛ lɛɛ benɛ a nu kaa Yesu hɛ ngɛ, nɛ Maria ke e na lɛ ɔ, a he we lɛ yi.
Yesu je e he kpo tsɔɔ kaseli enyɔ
(Luka 24.13-35)
12Enɛ ɔmɛ a se ɔ, Yesu je e he kpo ngɛ su kpa mi tsɔɔ kaseli ɔmɛ a ti ni enyɔ, benɛ a ngɛ si slaae kɛ yaa ngmɔ si. 13A kpale a se kɛ ho nɛ a ya de ni nɛmɛ nɛ piɛ ɔ; se a he we mɛ yi.
Yesu je e he kpo tsɔɔ kaseli nyɔngma kɛ kake ɔmɛ
(Mateo 28.16-20; Luka 24.36-49; Yohane 20.19-23; Ni Tsumi 1.6-8)
14Pee se ɔ, Yesu je e he kpo tsɔɔ ni nyɔngma kɛ kake ɔmɛ nitsɛmɛ benɛ a hii si nɛ a ngɛ ní yee. E ka a hɛ mi, ejakaa nihi nɛ na lɛ benɛ e te si ɔ, a he we mɛ yi, nɛ a wa tue hulɔ. 15 Kɛkɛ nɛ e de mɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ ya je ɔ mi tsuo nɛ nyɛ ya fiɛ sane kpakpa a ngɔ tsɔɔ nimli adesahi tsuo. 16Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ma he ye, nɛ a maa sɔle lɛ ɔ, a ma he e yi wami; se nɔ nɛ he we yi ɔ, a maa bu lɛ fɔ. 17Ni nɛmɛ nɛ ma he ye ɔ, a ma ha mɛ he wami nɛ a kɛ maa pee nyakpɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ: a maa hia mumi yayamihi ngɛ ye biɛ mi; a maa tu munyu ngɛ gbi kpahi a mi; 18ke a ta sinɔ he, loo a nu duɔ po, nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko be mɛ pee; a kɛ a ninehi ma pue hiɔtsɛmɛ a nɔ, nɛ a he maa wa mɛ.”
A ngɔ Yesu kɛ ho hiɔwe ya
(Luka 24.50-53; Ni Tsumi 1.9-11)
19 Benɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu kɛ mɛ tu munyu se ɔ, a ngɔ lɛ kɛ ho hiɔwe ya, nɛ e ya hi si ngɛ Mawu hiɔ nɔ. 20Kaseli ɔmɛ ho nɛ a ya fiɛ ngɛ he tsuaa he, nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ kɛ mɛ tsu ní. E ha a pee nyakpɛ níhi babauu kɛ pi munyu ɔ se.]
SANE KPAKPA A NYAGBE ENYƆNE
[ 21 Yi ɔmɛ ya bɔ Petro kɛ e huɛmɛ ɔmɛ amaniɛ kpiti ngɛ níhi tsuo nɛ a de mɛ ɔ he. 22 Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Yesu nitsɛ gu e kaseli ɔmɛ a nɔ nɛ e ha nɛ sɛ gbi klɔuklɔu nɛ ngɛ daa nɛ haa neneene wami ɔ gbɛ fĩa kɛ je beleku kɛ ya si bonyoku.]

Title: LUKA NYA TSƆƆMI
Content:
NYA TSƆƆMI
Luka Sane Kpakpa a tsɔɔ wɔ kaa Yesu ji Israel Kpɔlɔ ɔ nɛ a wo he si ɔ, nɛ lɛ nɔuu ji je ɔ tsuo hu Kpɔlɔ. Luka ngma ke Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ Mumi ɔ hla Yesu ke e ba fiɛ sane kpakpa a ha nihi nɛ a ní ngɛ mɔbɔ, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, sanehi nɛ ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ mi ɔ tsɔɔ bɔ nɛ Mawu ngɛ he numi ha nihi nɛ ngɛ hiami slɔɔtohi a mi. A naa paa kaa bua jɔmi gbi ngɛ Luka womi ɔ mi. A naa enɛ ɔ ngɛ womi ɔ sisije blɔ kɛ nyagbe blɔ. Womi ɔ sisije ɔ gbaa wɔ níhi nɛ kɔɔ Yesu je nɛ ɔ mi bami he, nɛ nyagbe ɔ kɔɔ e hiɔwe yami he. Womi nɛ ɔ ngmalɔ ɔ kɛ̃ nɛ ngma “Bɔfo ɔmɛ a Ni tsumi” ɔ, nɛ lɛɛ e tsɔɔ bɔ nɛ hemi kɛ yemi ngɛ Kristo mi ɔ ba he si, kɛ bɔ nɛ e gbɛ fĩa, benɛ Yesu ho hiɔwe ya a se.
Sane pɔtɛɛ komɛ kaa níhi nɛ ngɛ womi ɔ mi dlami enyɔne ɔ, kɛ ekpane ɔ mi kikɛ nɛ ɔ, Luka Sane Kpakpa a mi pɛ a ngma ngɛ. Sane nɛ ɔmɛ ekomɛ ji la nɛ bɔfo ɔmɛ la a, bɔ nɛ to hyɛli ɔmɛ ba je a he kpo benɛ a fɔ Yesu ɔ, jokuɛyo Yesu ɔ ngɛ sɔlemi we ɔ; Samaria no nɛ na nɔ mɔbɔ ɔ, kɛ binyumu nɛ laa a. Womi nɛ ɔ mi tsuo ɔ, ní titli komɛ nɛ a je blɔ tu a he munyu ji sɔlemi, Mumi Klɔuklɔu, bɔ nɛ yihi je a he kpo ngɛ Yesu ní tsumi ɔ mi, kɛ bɔ nɛ Mawu kɛ yayami paa.
Bɔ nɛ a dla womi ɔ mi ha
Sisije 1.1-4
Yohane nɔ sɔlelɔ ɔ, kɛ Yesu a fɔmi, kɛ a jokuɛwi a si 1.5—2.52
Yohane nɔ sɔlelɔ ɔ ní tsumi 3.1-20
A sɔle Yesu, nɛ Abosiami ka lɛ 3.21—4.13
Yesu tsu ní ngɛ Galilea 4.14—9.50
Yesu je Galilea kɛ yaa Yerusalem 9.51—19.27
Nyagbe otsi ɔ ngɛ Yerusalem kɛ Yerusalem kasa nya 19.28—23.56
Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ te si, nɛ e je e he kpo kɛ tsɔɔ, nɛ e ho hiɔwe ya 24.1-53

Title: LUKA 1
Content:
1Ye suɔlɔ Teofilo:
Nihi babauu bɔ mɔde kaa a maa ngma níhi nɛ ba mi ngɛ wa kpɛti ɔ he sane 2pɛpɛɛpɛ kaa bɔ nɛ nihi nɛ na ní nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ je sisije ɔ de wɔ, nɛ a fiɛ ngɔ tsɔɔ ɔ. 3Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ye nɔkɔtɔma, akɛnɛ imi hu i hla ní nɛ ɔmɛ a mi fitsofitso kɛ je sisije ɔ, i susu kaa e hi kaa ma ngma sisiisi ha mo. 4I pee enɛ ɔ, konɛ níhi nɛ a de mo ɔ, o na anɔkuale ɔ paa.
A wo si kaa a ma fɔ Yohane nɔ sɔlelɔ ɔ
5 Benɛ Herode ngɛ matsɛ yee ngɛ Yudea a, osɔfo ko hi si nɛ e biɛ ji Zakaria. Osɔfohi a kuu nɛ a tsɛɛ Abiya a mi no ji lɛ. E yo biɛ ji Elizabet, nɛ lɛ hu Aaron nina ji lɛ. 6Mɛ ni enyɔ ɔmɛ tsuo a peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi, nɛ a yeɔ e mlaa amɛ, kɛ e fami ɔmɛ a nɔ́ sisiisi. 7Se a be bi; ejakaa Elizabet ɔ yosa ji lɛ, nɛ mɛ ni enyɔ ɔmɛ tsuo a bwɔ.
8Ligbi ko ɔ, Zakaria ya ngɛ osɔfo ní tsumi tsue ngɛ sɔlemi we ɔ. Jamɛ a be ɔ, e su a we osɔfo kuu ɔ nɔ kaa mɛ lɛ a ma sɔmɔ. 9Osɔfo ɔmɛ peeɔ kusumi kɛ fɔɔ sɔ, nɛ a kɛ hlaa a ti nɔ nɛ maa sã tsopa kɛ e he via ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ. Sɔ ɔ ya nɔ Zakaria nɔ, nɛ lɔ ɔ he e ho Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ sɔlemi we ɔ ya a nɛ. 10Be mi nɛ a ngɛ tsopa kɛ e he via a sãe ɔ, ma kpekpemi ɔ ngɛ sɔlee ngɛ ablanaa a mi.
11Tlukaa a, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ bɔfo ko ba da si ngɛ tsopa kɛ e he via bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ hiɔ nɔ, nɛ e je e he kpo ngɔ tsɔɔ Zakaria. 12Benɛ Zakaria na bɔfo ɔ, e tsui po, nɛ e ye gbeye. 13Se bɔfo ɔ de lɛ ke, “Zakaria, koo ye gbeye! Mawu nu o kue fami ɔ. O yo Elizabet ma fɔ binyumu ha mo, nɛ o maa wo lɛ biɛ ke Yohane. 14Ke a fɔ lɛ ɔ, o ma nya, nɛ o ma na bua jɔmi, nɛ nihi babauu ma nya ja nɔuu. 15 E ma ba pee nɔmlɔ nguaa ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ hɛ mi. E be wai, loo dã nɛ nya wa nue. Ke a fɔ lɛ pɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ maa ba e nɔ, 16nɛ e ma ha nɛ Israel bi babauu maa kpale kɛ ba Nyɔmtsɛ, a Mawu ɔ ngɔ. 17 E maa sɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ hlami kɛ he wami, kɛ kã kaa gbalɔ Eliya. E maa pee tsɛmɛ kɛ a bimɛ kake ekohu. E ma ha nihi nɛ bui Mawu tue ɔ maa kpale ba nyɛɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ buɔ lɛ tue ɔ a blɔ ɔmɛ a nɔ. Nɛ nihi nɛ Mawu nitsɛ hla a, e ma dla mɛ ngɔ to lɛ.”
18Zakaria bi bɔfo ɔ ke, “Kɛ ma pee kɛ le enɛ ɔ kɛɛ? Hyɛ, nɔmoyo ji mi, nɛ ye yo hu bwɔ!”
19 Bɔfo ɔ he nɔ ke, “Imi ji Gabriel, nɛ i daa si ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi. A tsɔ mi ke i kɛ mo ba sɛɛ ní, nɛ́ ma ngɔ manye munyu nɛ ɔ ba ha mo. 20O he we ye sɛ gbi ɔ yi; se kɛ̃ e maa ba mi ngɛ be nɛ sa mi. Akɛnɛ o he we yi he je ɔ, o nya ma ma, nɛ o be nyɛe maa tu munyu hu kɛ yaa su ligbi ɔ nɛ si nɛ i wo mo ɔ maa ba mi.”
21Be nɛ ɔ mi tsuo ɔ, ma a ngɛ Zakaria blɔe, nɛ a hɛ mi pee mɛ yaa kaa e ya kɛ ngɛ sɔlemi we ɔ. 22Benɛ e je kpo ɔ, e nyɛ we nɛ e kɛ mɛ nɛ tu munyu; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a kɔ se kaa Mawu ya je e he kpo ngɔ tsɔɔ lɛ ngɛ sɔlemi we ɔ. Akɛnɛ e nyɛ we nɛ e tu munyu he je ɔ, e kɛ e nine pee okadi kɛ tsɔɔ mɛ.
23Be nɛ Zakaria sɔmɔmi be ngɛ sɔlemi we ɔ nya ta a, e kpale kɛ ho we mi ya. 24Be bɔɔ se ɔ, e yo Elizabet ba ngɔ hɔ, nɛ e laa e he nyɔhiɔ enuɔ. 25E de ke, “Jehanɛ ɔ lɛɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ piɛ ye he! Ye hɛ mi nɛ pue si ngɛ ma hɛ mi ɔ, e ha nɛ e se po.”
A gba kaa a ma fɔ Yesu
26Benɛ Elizabet hɔ ɔ ye nyɔhiɔ ekpa a, Mawu tsɔ bɔfo Gabriel ɔ kɛ ya Galilea ma ko nɛ a tsɛɛ Nazaret ɔ. 27 Gabriel hɛɛ sɛ gbi kɛ ha yiheyo ko nɛ a bi e si ha Yosef, Matsɛ David nina a kake. Yiheyo ɔ biɛ ji Maria. 28Bɔfo ɔ ba e ngɔ, nɛ e ba de lɛ ke, “Mo he manye! Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ kɛ mo ngɛ, nɛ e gbaa mo babauu!”
29Maria hao ngɛ ngami nɛ bɔfo ɔ nga lɛ ɔ he, nɛ e ná nɛ e nu sisi. 30Se bɔfo ɔ de lɛ ke, “Maria, koo ye gbeye; Mawu na o he bua jɔmi. 31 Hyɛ, o ma na mi, nɛ o ma fɔ binyumu, nɛ o maa wo lɛ biɛ ke Yesu. 32 E ma ba pee nɔmlɔ nguaa, nɛ a ma tsɛ lɛ ke Hiɔwe No ɔ Bi. Nyɔmtsɛ Mawu maa pee lɛ matsɛ kaa bɔ nɛ e pee e nɛ̃ David ɔ. 33E maa ye matsɛ ngɛ Israel ma a nɔ kɛ maa ya neneene; e matsɛ yemi ɔ se be poe gblegbleegble!”
34Maria de bɔfo ɔ ke, “I li nyumu. Lɛ kɛ maa pee kɛɛ nɛ enɛ ɔ maa ba mi?”
35Bɔfo ɔ de lɛ ke, “Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ maa ba o nɔ; Hiɔwe No ɔ he wami ɔ maa ba o nɔ. Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, bi klɔuklɔu ɔ nɛ o ma fɔ ɔ, a ma tsɛ lɛ Mawu Bi. 36Na nɛ o le kaa o weku no Elizabet, nɛ bwɔ ɔ hu hɛɛ hɔ. Sa a, a le lɛ kaa yosa; se amlɔ nɛ ɔ, e hɛɛ mi nyɔhiɔ ekpa. 37 Ejakaa Mawu lɛɛ nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko be nɛ e be nyɛe maa pee.”
38Maria de ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ mawayo ji mi; bɔ nɛ o de ɔ, e ba mi ja.” Kɛkɛ nɛ bɔfo ɔ si lɛ.
Maria ya slaa Elizabet
39E kɛ we nɛ Maria dla e he, nɛ e pue nɔ esɔ kɛ ho ma ko mi ya ngɛ Yudea yo nɔ zugba a mi. 40E ya sɛ Zakaria we ɔ mi, nɛ e nga Elizabet. 41Benɛ Elizabet nu nɛ Maria nga lɛ ɔ, bimwɔyo ɔ hua ngɛ e mi mi. Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ ba Elizabet nɔ, 42nɛ e de kɛ ngmlaa ke, “Mawu gbaa mo kulaa pe bɔ nɛ e gbaa yihi tsuo! Bi nɛ ngɛ o mi mi ɔ hu e gbaa lɛ! 43Kɛ ba lɛ kɛɛ nɛ a ha mi he blɔ nguaa nɛ ɔ, kaa ye Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nyɛ ma ba slaa mi? 44Benɛ i nu o ngami ɔ pɛ bimwɔyo ɔ hua ngɛ ye mi mi kɛ bua jɔmi. 45A gbaa mo kaa o he ye kaa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ sɛ gbi nɛ a de mo ɔ maa ba mi!”
Maria la kɛ je Mawu yi
46 Maria ke,
“I ngɔ ye tsui tsuo kɛ ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ yi jee.
47Ye bua jɔ, kaa Mawu ji ye
yi wami helɔ,
48 ejakaa e kai imi, e mawayo humi ɔ!
Kɛ je mwɔnɛ ɔ kɛ yaa a, nihi tsuo
ma tsɛ mi yo nɛ a gbaa lɛ,
49ejakaa Mawu Ope ɔ pee ní nguanguahi ha mi.
E biɛ ngɛ klɔuklɔu.
50E naa nihi nɛ buɔ lɛ ɔ mɔbɔ
yi nɔhi tsuo.
51E kɛ e he wami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ
gbɛ he nɔ woli, kɛ a juɛmi yaya a tsuo
ngɔ fĩa.
52 E kpa matsɛmɛ nguanguahi kɛ je a sɛhi a nɔ,
nɛ e wó humihi a nɔ.
53E ha hwɔ hwɔli ní kpakpahi nɛ a ye, nɛ a tɔ;
se niatsɛmɛ lɛɛ e fie mɛ kɛ ho kɛ a dɛ gu.
54Si nɛ e wo wa nɛmɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, e ye nɔ;
nɛ e ba piɛ e tsɔlɔ Israel he.
55 E kai Abraham, nɛ e na lɛ, kɛ e nina tsuo mɔbɔ
kɛ yaa neneene!”
56Maria hi Elizabet ngɔ maa pee nyɔhiɔ etɛ loko e kpale kɛ ho e ma mi ya.
A fɔ Yohane nɔ sɔlelɔ ɔ
57Jehanɛ ɔ, Elizabet fɔmi be su, nɛ e fɔ binyumu. 58E paka bi, kɛ e weku li nu kaa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ gbaa lɛ babauu, nɛ a ba nɛ a kɛ lɛ ba nya.
59 Benɛ bimwɔyo ɔ na otsi ɔ, a ba, konɛ a ba po lɛ, nɛ jinɛ a hla kaa a kɛ e tsɛ Zakaria biɛ maa wo lɛ. 60Se e nyɛ de ke, “Dɛbi! A ma tsɛ lɛ Yohane.”
61A de lɛ ke, “Nɔ ko tsa be o weku ɔ mi nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ ja!” 62Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a pee okadi kɛ bi bimwɔyo ɔ tsɛ ɔ biɛ nɛ e suɔ nɛ a tsɛ lɛ.
63Zakaria bi ke a ha lɛ tso sleeti, nɛ e ngma ngɛ nɔ ke, “E biɛ ji Yohane.” Enɛ ɔ pee ni ɔmɛ tsuo nyakpɛ. 64Amlɔ nɔuu ɔ, Mawu ha nɛ Zakaria nya bli, nɛ e tu munyu ekohu, nɛ e je Mawu yi. 65Gbeye nu e paka bi ɔmɛ tsuo, nɛ sane nɛ ba nɛ ɔ gbɛ fĩa Yudea yoku zugba a tsuo. 66Nihi tsuo nɛ nu ɔ susu he saminya, nɛ a bi ke, “Mɛni nɔmlɔ po jokuɛ nɛ ɔ ma ba pee?” Ejakaa e fɔɔ si paa kaa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ he wami ɔ ngɛ e nɔ.
Zakaria gbami
67Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ ba Yohane tsɛ Zakaria nɔ, nɛ e gba ke,
68“Nyɛ ha wa je Nyɔmtsɛ, Israel Mawu ɔ yi.
Ejakaa e ba piɛ e ma a he,
nɛ e ha nɛ a ye a he.
69E je kpɔlɔ kpanaa nɛ ji e tsɔlɔ David nina ha wɔ.
70E wo si blema lokoo
kɛ gu e gbali klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ a nɔ
71ke e ma kpɔ wɔ kɛ je wa he nyɛli,
kɛ nihi nɛ nyɛɛ wɔ ɔ a dɛ mi.
72E de ke e maa na wa nɛmɛ ɔmɛ mɔbɔ,
nɛ e maa ye e somi klɔuklɔu ɔ nɔ.
73-74E ka wa nɛ̃ Abraham kita, nɛ e wo si
ke e ma kpɔ wɔ kɛ je wa he nyɛli ɔmɛ a dɛ mi,
konɛ wa sɔmɔ lɛ ngɛ he jɔmi mi,
75nɛ waa hi klɔuklɔu, nɛ waa pee nɔ́ nɛ da
ngɛ e hɛ mi wa wami be ɔ tsuo.
76 “Nɛ mo, ye bi, a ma tsɛ mo
Hiɔwe No ɔ gbalɔ.
O maa sɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ hlami,
nɛ o ma dla e blɔ ɔ kɛ to lɛ.
77O ma de e ma a ke
Mawu maa ngɔ a he yayami kɛ pa mɛ,
nɛ e ma he a yi wami.
78Wa Mawu ɔ mi mi jɔ, nɛ e naa mɔbɔ.
E ma kpɔ wɔ kaa bɔ nɛ mɔtu pu la
fieɔ diblii kɛ yaa se ɔ.
79 E ma kpɛ kɛ je hiɔwe ha nihi tsuo
nɛ hii si ngɛ gbenɔ hɔ̃ diblii mi,
nɛ e maa tsɔɔ wɔ blɔ
kɛ ba he jɔmi blɔ ɔ nɔ.”
80Jokuɛ ɔ ba wa ngɛ nɔmlɔ tso, kɛ mumi mi tsuo, nɛ e hi nga a nɔ kɛ ya su ligbi nɛ e je e he kpo ngɔ tsɔɔ Israel.

Title: LUKA 2
Content:
A fɔ Yesu
(Mateo 1.18-25)
1Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, Kaisare Augusto fa ke a kane nihi tsuo nɛ ngɛ Roma nɔ yemi he ɔ, nɛ a ngma a biɛ. 2Enɛ ɔ ji kekleekle nɛ a kane nɔ be mi nɛ Kerinio ngɛ amlaalo yee ngɛ Siria. 3Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ tsuaa nɔ ho lɛ nitsɛ e ma mi ya, konɛ a ya ngma e biɛ.
4Yosef je Nazaret ma a mi ngɛ Galilea, nɛ e ya Betlehem ngɛ Yudea, he nɛ a fɔ Matsɛ David ngɛ ɔ. Yosef ya lejɛ ɔ, ejakaa David nina ji lɛ. 5E ya, konɛ e kɛ Maria, yo nɛ a bi si ha lɛ ɔ tsuo nɛ a ya ngma a biɛ. 6Jamɛ a be ɔ, Maria mi wa, nɛ benɛ a ngɛ Betlehem ɔ, e fɔmi be ba su. 7E fɔ e kekleekle bi, nɛ e ngɔ bo kɛ blaa lɛ, nɛ e kɛ lɛ fɔ lohwehi a niye ní daka mi; ejakaa a nɛ blɔ ngɛ nibwɔhi a to he ɔ.
To hyɛli ɔmɛ kɛ bɔfo ɔmɛ
8To hyɛli komɛ ngɛ a tohi a he bue nyɔ mi ngɛ nga a nɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ ní ɔmɛ a mi nɔuu. 9Tlukaa a, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ bɔfo ko ba je e he kpo tsɔɔ mɛ. Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ hɛ mi nyami kpɛ kɛ bɔle mɛ, nɛ a ye gbeye wawɛɛ. 10Se bɔfo ɔ de mɛ ke, “Nyɛ ko ye gbeye! I hɛɛ manye munyu nɛ ma ha Israel ma a tsuo ma na bua jɔmi babauu kɛ ha nyɛ. 11Mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ, a fɔ nyɛ yi wami helɔ, Nyɔmtsɛ Kristo ɔ ngɛ David ma a mi! 12Nɔ́ nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ maa le kaa ye sane ɔ ngɛ mi ji nyɛ maa na bimwɔyo nɛ a kɛ bo blaa lɛ, nɛ hwɔɔ si ngɛ lohwehi a niye ní daka mi.”
13Si kake too ɔ, hiɔwe bɔfohi a ta nguaa ba piɛ bɔfo ɔ he, nɛ a la kɛ je Mawu yi ke,
14“Hɛ mi nyami ha Mawu ngɛ hiɔwe lokoo,
nɛ he jɔmi nɛ ba zugba a nɔ
ha nihi nɛ e naa a he tsui ɔ!”
15Benɛ bɔfo ɔmɛ si to hyɛli ɔmɛ, nɛ a kpale kɛ ho hiɔwe ya a, to hyɛli ɔmɛ de a he ke, “Nyɛ ha nɛ waa ya Betlehem, nɛ wa ya hyɛ nɔ́ nɛ ba, nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ je tsɔɔ wɔ nɛ ɔ.”
16Kɛkɛ nɛ a ho nɔuu, nɛ a ya na Maria, kɛ Yosef, kɛ bimwɔyo ɔ hu nɛ hwɔɔ si ngɛ lohwehi a niye ní daka a mi. 17Benɛ to hyɛli ɔmɛ na bimwɔyo ɔ, a de fɔli ɔmɛ nɔ́ nɛ a sɛɛ ha mɛ nɛ kɔɔ bimwɔyo ɔ he ɔ. 18Nihi tsuo nɛ nu amaniɛ ɔ nɛ to hyɛli ɔmɛ bɔ ɔ, a hɛ mi pee mɛ yaa. 19Maria kɛ munyu nɛ ɔmɛ to e yi mi, nɛ e susuɔ he be tsuaa be. 20To hyɛli ɔmɛ kpale a se kɛ ho. Benɛ a yaa a tsuo a ngɛ lae kɛ ngɛ Mawu yi jee ngɛ níhi nɛ a nu, kɛ níhi nɛ a na a he. Nɔ́ nɛ bɔfo ɔ sɛɛ ha mɛ ɔ, lɔ ɔ tutuutu nɛ a ya na a nɛ.
A wo Yesu biɛ
21 Otsi se, benɛ jokuɛ ɔ pomi be su ɔ, a wo lɛ biɛ ke Yesu, biɛ nɛ bɔfo ɔ ha lɛ loko Maria ngɔ e hɔ ɔ.
Maria kɛ Yosef ngɔ Yesu kɛ ya sɔlemi we ɔ
22 Jehanɛ ɔ, be ba su nɛ a maa pee kusumi nɛ a kɛ tsukɔ a he kaa bɔ nɛ Mose mlaa a tsɔɔ ɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a ngɔ bimwɔyo ɔ kɛ ya Yerusalem, konɛ a kɛ lɛ ya tsɔɔ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ 23 kaa bɔ nɛ a ngma ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ mlaa a mi ke, “Binyumu tsuaa binyumu nɛ bliɔ muklii nya, kɛ lohwe ku tsuaa lohwe ku kekleekle nɔ́ nɛ a ma fɔ ɔ, a hla kɛ to ha Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ.” 24Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, a ya sã bɔ kaa bɔ nɛ a ngma ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ mlaa a mi ke, “A ngɔ lahuɛ enyɔ, loo beleku lahuɛ tsɔwi enyɔ kɛ sã bɔ” ɔ.
25Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, nyumu ko ngɛ Yerusalem nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Simeon. Nyumu nɛ ɔ, nɔmlɔ kpakpa ji lɛ; e yeɔ Mawu gbeye, nɛ daa nɛ ɔ, e ngɛ blɔ hyɛe nɛ Mawu ba he Israel yi wami. Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ ngɛ e mi. 26Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ je tsɔɔ lɛ ke e be gboe kɛ yaa si e maa na Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ Kristo ɔ. 27Mumi ɔ ngɔ Simeon kɛ ba sɔlemi we ɔ. Yesu fɔli ɔmɛ hu ngɔ bimwɔyo ɔ kɛ ba lejɛ ɔ, konɛ a ba pee kusumi ha lɛ kaa bɔ nɛ mlaa a tsɔɔ ɔ. 28Kɛkɛ nɛ Simeon he bimwɔyo ɔ ngɔ fɔ e kɔni bɔkɔ mi, nɛ e na Mawu si, nɛ e de ke,
29“Nyɔmtsɛ, jehanɛ lɛɛ o ye o siwo ɔ nɔ;
lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ha nɛ imi, o tsɔlɔ ɔ
ma gbo ngɛ tue mi jɔmi mi.
30-31Ejakaa kpɔlɔ ɔ nɛ o wo si ke o ma ha je ɔ,
i na lɛ kɛ imi nitsɛ ye hɛ ngmɛ paa.
32 Lɛ ji la nɛ maa tsɔɔ ma je li ɔmɛ
blɔ kɛ ba o ngɔ;
nɛ e maa wo o ma Israel hɛ mi nyami.”
33Yesu tsɛ, kɛ e nyɛ a nya kpɛ a he ngɛ níhi nɛ Simeon de ngɛ a bi ɔ he ɔ he. 34Simeon gbaa mɛ, nɛ e de bimwɔyo ɔ nyɛ Maria ke, “Mawu hla jokuɛ nɛ ɔ kɛ ha nihi babauu a hɛ mi kpatami, kɛ nihi babauu hu a yi wami hemi ngɛ Israel. E maa pee okadi ko nɛ je Mawu ngɔ, nɛ́ nimli babauu maa tu munyu kɛ si; 35nɛ e ma je a tsui mi laami sanehi kpo. Nɛ mo nitsɛ hu o maa ye kɔmɔ wawɛɛ kaa nɔ́ nɛ ha gbɔ o mi mi.”
36Gbalɔ yo yomoyo kotokoto ko hi si nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Ana. E tsɛ biɛ ji Fanuel, nɛ e je Asher wɛtso ɔ mi. E kɛ e huno hi si jeha kpaago pɛ ngɛ e yihe mi, 37nɛ e ba pee yalɔyo hluu kɛ ya si e ye jeha nyingmi kpaanyɔ kɛ eywiɛ. Yo nɛ ɔ nane pui ngɛ sɔlemi we ɔ; nyɔ kɛ pia tsuo e ngɛ Mawu jae kɛ hwɔ hami, kɛ kue fami. 38Jamɛ a ngmlɛfia a nɔuu ɔ, Ana hu ba lejɛ ɔ. E ba je Mawu yi, nɛ e tu bimwɔyo ɔ he munyu ngɔ tsɔɔ nihi tsuo nɛ ngɛ Mawu blɔ hyɛe nɛ e kpɔ Yerusalem ma a.
A kpale kɛ ho Nazaret ya
39 Benɛ Yosef kɛ Maria pee kusumi ɔmɛ tsuo gbe nya kaa bɔ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ mlaa a tsɔɔ ɔ, a kpale a se kɛ ho mɛ nitsɛmɛ a ma Nazaret, nɛ ngɛ Galilea a ya. 40Jokuɛ ɔ ba wa ngɛ nɔmlɔ tso mi; e le ní hulɔ, nɛ Mawu gbaa lɛ babauu.
Yesu ngɛ sɔlemi we ɔ
41 Daa jeha a, Yesu fɔli ɔmɛ yaa Yerusalem ya yeɔ Hetsɔmi nyami ɔ. 42Benɛ Yesu ye jeha nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔ, a ya Yerusalem kaa bɔ nɛ kusumi ɔ tsɔɔ ɔ. 43Benɛ nyami be ɔ nya ta, nɛ Yosef, kɛ Maria kpale a se kɛ yaa Nazaret ɔ, a li tete kaa jokuɛ Yesu ɔ tlɔ Yerusalem. 44A susu kaa e kɛ ni komɛ sɛ hlami kɛ ho, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a nyɛɛ ligbi mluku, nɛ jehanɛ a bɔni lɛ hlami ngɛ a weku li, kɛ a huɛmɛ a ngɔ. 45Se a ya nɛ lɛ, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a kpale a se kɛ ba Yerusalem ekohu ba hla lɛ. 46Ligbi etɛne ɔ, a ya na lɛ ngɛ sɔlemi we ɔ nɛ e hii si ngɛ mlaa tsɔɔli ɔmɛ a kpɛti; e ngɛ mɛ tue bue, nɛ e ngɛ mɛ ní bie. 47Nihi tsuo nɛ ngɛ lɛ tue bue ɔ a nya kpɛ a he; ejakaa a na kaa e juɛmi mi kuɔ, nɛ e ngɛ níhi a heto hae pɛpɛɛpɛ. 48Benɛ e fɔli ɔmɛ na lɛ ɔ, a nya kpɛ a he; nɛ e nyɛ bi lɛ ke, “Ye bi, mɛni he je nɛ o pee wɔ kikɛ nɛ ɔ? Hyɛ, i kɛ o tsɛ kpa si hla mo kɛ hɛdɔ.”
49E bi mɛ ke, “Mɛni he je nyɛ ngɛ mi hlae? Anɛ nyɛ li kaa e sa kaa ma hi Tsaatsɛ we ɔ lo?” 50Se mɛɛ lɛɛ nɔ́ nɛ e de mɛ ɔ, a nui sisi.
51Yesu kɛ mɛ kpale a se kɛ ho Nazaret ya, nɛ e ba e he si ha mɛ. E nyɛ kɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo to e yi mi, nɛ e susuɔ he be tsuaa be. 52 Yesu ba wa ngɛ nɔmlɔ tso mi, nɛ e le ní kɛ ya nɔ. Nɛ Mawu kɛ nimli adesahi tsuo ná e he bua jɔmi.

Title: LUKA 3
Content:
Yohane nɔ sɔlelɔ ɔ fiɛ
(Mateo 3.1-12; Marko 1.1-8; Yohane 1.19-28)
1Roma matsɛ Tiberio yi nɔ jeha nyɔngma kɛ enuɔne ɔ, Pontio Pilato ngɛ amlaalo yee ngɛ Yudea, nɛ Herode ngɛ amlaalo nɔkɔtɔma yee ngɛ Galilea. Herode nyɛmi Filipo ngɛ amlaalo nɔkɔtɔma yee ngɛ Iturea, kɛ Trakoniti zugba a nɔ, nɛ Lisania ngɛ amlaalo nɔkɔtɔma yee ngɛ Abileene. 2Ana kɛ Kayafa hu ngɛ osɔfo nikɔtɔma pe kulaa yee. Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, Mawu kɛ sɛ gbi ha Zakaria bi Yohane ngɛ nga a nɔ. 3Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yohane kpa Yordan kpokpa a nɔ tsuo, nɛ e fiɛ ke, “Nyɛ tsake nyɛ tsui, nɛ a sɔle nyɛ, konɛ Mawu nɛ ngɔ nyɛ he yayami ɔmɛ kɛ pa nyɛ.” 4 Bɔ nɛ a ngma ngɛ gbalɔ Yesaya womi ɔ mi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
“Nɔ ko ngɛ ngmlaa kpae ngɛ nga a nɔ ke,
‘Nyɛ dla blɔ ngɔ to Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ;
nyɛɛ je blɔ tlɔmɔɔ ha lɛ, nɛ e nyɛɛ nɔ!
5Á tsi kɔ̃ tsuaa kɔ̃;
á ba kpo tsuaa kpo,
kɛ yo tsuaa yo si.
Á pee blɔhi nɛ kpɛ̃ ɔ tlɔmɔɔ,
nɛ ní nɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ googagooga a,
a nɔ nɛ sɔ.
6Kɛkɛ ɔ, nihi tsuo maa na
Mawu yi wami hemi ɔ!’ ”
7 Nihi babauu ba Yohane ngɔ, konɛ e sɔle mɛ. Nɛ e de mɛ ke, “Nyɛ sinɔhi a nina, mɛnɔ wo nyɛ ga ke nyɛɛ tu tue gblami nɛ Mawu kɛ ma nyɛ nɔ ɔ nya fo? 8 Ke nyɛ tsake nyɛ tsui niinɛ ɔ, lɛɛ nyɛɛ pee níhi nɛ tsɔɔ kaa nyɛ tsake nyɛ tsui. Nyɛ ko susu kaa ke nyɛ de ke nyɛ nɛ̃ ji Abraham ɔ kɛkɛ tue gblami ko be nyɛ nɔ bae. I ngɛ nyɛ dee ke Mawu ma nyɛ ngɔ tɛ nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ pee Abraham nina! 9 Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, gbiɛ ɔ fɔɔ si ngɛ tso si poku ɔmɛ a nɔ momo; tso tsuaa tso nɛ wui yiblii kpakpa a, a maa po, nɛ a ma sake ngɔ fɔ la mi.”
10Ni ɔmɛ bi lɛ ke, “Lɛɛ kɛ wa maa pee kɛɛ?”
11E he nɔ ke, “Nɔ nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe tade enyɔ ɔ, e ke nɔ nɛ be eko ɔ nɛ dla; nɛ nɔ nɛ ngɛ niye ní ɔ, lɛ hu e kɛ nihi nɛ dla ja nɔuu.”
12 Tó tsuli komɛ hu ba nɛ e sɔle mɛ. A bi lɛ ke, “Tsɔɔlɔ, mɛni sa wɔ peemi?”
13E de mɛ ke, “Nyɛ ko tsu tó nɛ hiɛ pe bɔ nɛ a tsɔɔ nyɛ ɔ.”
14Ta buli komɛ hu ba bi lɛ ke, “Wɔ hu mɛni sa wɔ peemi?”
E de mɛ ke, “Nyɛ ko fia ojo! Nyɛ ko po sane ngɔ fɔ nɔ ko nɔ yaka gu nɛ nyɛ kpɔ sika ngɛ e dɛ! Nyɛ hiɔwo nɛ sa nyɛ hɛ mi!”
15Jehanɛ ɔ, ni ɔmɛ a nɔ gbagba te, nɛ a bɔni susumi ngɛ Yohane he kaa eko ɔ, lɛ ji Kristo ɔ. 16Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yohane de mɛ ke, “Imi lɛɛ nyu nɛ i kɛ ngɛ nyɛ sɔlee, se nɔ ko ma ngɛ ye se nɛ pe mi, nɛ i sɛ kaa i pɛneɔ e tokota nya kpa po. Lɛɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu, kɛ la nɛ e kɛ maa sɔle nyɛ. 17E hɛɛ e ngma mi sami tsimi ngɛ e dɛ, nɛ e kɛ maa sa e ngma a tsuo mi. E ma bua e ngma a nya kɛ wo gba mi, se tsakati ɔ lɛɛ e maa sã ngɛ la nɛ gbo we gblegbleegble.”
18Yohane gu blɔ slɔɔtohi a nɔ nɛ e kɛ wo ni ɔmɛ he wami benɛ e ngɛ sane kpakpa a fiɛe ɔ. 19 Se Yohane kã amlaalo nɔkɔtɔma Herode hɛ mi, ejakaa Herode ya ngɔ lɛ nitsɛ e nyɛmi Filipo e yo Herodia; Herode pee yayami kpahi fuu hu ngɔ piɛ he. 20Se nɔ́ nɛ pe lɛ tsuo ji kaa e nu Yohane ngɔ wo tsu mi.
A sɔle Yesu
(Mateo 3.13-17; Marko 1.9-11)
21Benɛ a sɔle ni ɔmɛ tsuo se ɔ, a sɔle Yesu hulɔ; nɛ benɛ e ngɛ sɔlee ɔ, hiɔwe nya bli, 22 nɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ kple si kɛ ba e nɔ kɛ su nɛ ngɛ kaa lahuɛ. Nɛ gbi ko je hiɔwe de ke, “Mo ji ye bi nɛ i suɔ; i naa o he bua jɔmi saminya.”
Yesu weku kpa
(Mateo 1.1-17)
23Benɛ Yesu je e ní tsumi sisi ɔ, e ye maa pee jeha nyingmi etɛ, nɛ bɔ nɛ nihi susuɔ ji e tsɛ ji Yosef, Heli bi ɔ, 24Matat bi ɔ, Levi bi ɔ, Melki bi ɔ, Yanai bi ɔ, Yosef bi ɔ, 25Matatia bi ɔ, Amos bi ɔ, Nahum bi ɔ, Esli bi ɔ, Nagai bi ɔ, 26Maat bi ɔ, Matatia bi ɔ, Semein bi ɔ, Yosek bi ɔ, Yoda bi ɔ. 27Yoanan bi ɔ, Resa bi ɔ, Zerubabel bi ɔ, Shealtiel bi ɔ, Neri bi ɔ, 28Melki bi ɔ, Adi bi ɔ, Kosam bi ɔ, Elmadam bi ɔ, Er bi ɔ, 29Yoshua bi ɔ, Eliezer bi ɔ, Yorim bi ɔ, Matat bi ɔ, Levi bi ɔ, 30Simeon bi ɔ, Yuda bi ɔ, Yosef bi ɔ, Yonam bi ɔ, Eliakim bi ɔ, 31Melea bi ɔ, Mena bi ɔ, Matata bi ɔ, Natan bi ɔ, David bi ɔ, 32Ishai bi ɔ, Obed bi ɔ, Boaz bi ɔ, Salmon bi ɔ, Nashon bi ɔ, 33Aminadab bi ɔ, Admin bi ɔ, Arni bi ɔ, Hezron bi ɔ, Perez bi ɔ, Yuda bi ɔ, 34Yakob bi ɔ, Isak bi ɔ, Abraham bi ɔ, Tera bi ɔ, Nahor bi ɔ, 35Serug bi ɔ, Reu bi ɔ, Peleg bi ɔ, Eber bi ɔ. Shela bi ɔ, 36Kainan bi ɔ, Arpakshad bi ɔ, Shem bi ɔ, Noa bi ɔ, Lamek bi ɔ, 37Metusela bi ɔ, Enok bi ɔ, Yared bi ɔ, Mahalalel bi ɔ, Kenan bi ɔ, 38Enosh bi ɔ, Set bi ɔ, Adam bi ɔ, Mawu bi ɔ.

Title: LUKA 4
Content:
Abosiami ka Yesu
(Mateo 4.1-11; Marko 1.12-13)
1Yesu kpale e se kɛ je Yordan kɛ ba, nɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ hyi lɛ tɔ. Mumi ɔ ngɔ lɛ kɛ ya nga a nɔ, 2nɛ Abosiami ya ka lɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ ligbi nyingmi eywiɛ. Jamɛ a be ɔ mi tsuo e yi nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko, nɛ nyagbe ɔ, hwɔ ye lɛ.
3Abosiami de lɛ ke, “Ke Mawu Bi ji mo ɔ, ha nɛ tɛ nɛ ɔ nɛ plɛ abolo.”
4 Se Yesu de lɛ ke, “A ngma ke, ‘Pi abolo kɛkɛ nɛ haa nɔmlɔ yi naa wami.’ ”
5Kɛkɛ nɛ Abosiami ngɔ lɛ kɛ ya hiɔwe, nɛ e kɛ je nɛ ɔ mi matsɛ yemi ɔmɛ tsuo tsɔɔ lɛ hɛngmɛfia. 6Abosiami de lɛ ke, “Hyɛ, he wami, kɛ hɛ mi nyami nɛ ɔ tsuo mo ma ngɔ ha. Mawu lɛ ngɔ ha mi, nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ i suɔ ɔ, ma ngɔ ha lɛ. 7Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke o kpla si nɛ o ja mi ɔ, enɛ ɔmɛ tsuo maa pee o nɔ́.”
8 Yesu he nɔ ke, “A ngma ke, ‘Já Nyɔmtsɛ, o Mawu ɔ, nɛ o sɔmɔ lɛ pɛ.’ ”
9Jehanɛ ɔ, Abosiami ngɔ Yesu kɛ ba Yerusalem, nɛ e kɛ lɛ ba da sɔlemi we ɔ yi mi ploplooplo ɔ, nɛ e de lɛ ke, “Ke Mawu Bi ji mo ɔ, sake o he ngɔ fia si. 10 Ejakaa a ngma ke, ‘Mawu ma fa e bɔfo ɔmɛ nɛ a bu o he.’ 11 A ngma hulɔ ke, ‘A maa hɛɛ mo dɔdɔɔdɔ ngɛ a dɛ mi, konɛ o nane ko tɛ nɔ́.’ ”
12 Se Yesu he nɔ ke, “A ngma ke, ‘Koo ka Nyɔmtsɛ, o Mawu ɔ.’ ”
13Benɛ Abosiami ka lɛ ngɛ blɔhi tsuo a nɔ gbe nya a, e si lɛ lolo.
Yesu je e ní tsumi sisi ngɛ Galilea
(Mateo 4.12-17; Marko 1.14-15)
14Yesu kpale e se kɛ ba Galilea, nɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ he wami ɔ ngɛ e mi, nɛ e he sane gbɛ fĩa lejɛ ɔ ní ɔmɛ a mi tsuo. 15E tsɔɔ ní ngɛ kpe he ɔmɛ, nɛ nihi tsuo je e yi.
A kua Yesu ngɛ Nazaret
(Mateo 13.53-58; Marko 6.1-6)
16Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Yesu ba Nazaret, he nɛ a lɛ lɛ ngɛ ɔ. Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ, e ya kpe he ɔ kaa bɔ nɛ e pɔɔ peemi ɔ. E te si, konɛ e kane ngmami ɔ, 17nɛ a ngɔ gbalɔ Yesaya womi ɔ ngɔ sɔle lɛ. Benɛ e bli womi ɔ, e na he nɛ a ngma ngɛ ke,
18 “Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ Mumi ɔ ngɛ ye nɔ;
Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ hla mi ke
ma ngɔ sane kpakpa a ba ha
nihi nɛ a ni ngɛ mɔbɔ.
E tsɔ mi ke ma ba fiɛ ke,
‘Nyɛ nyɔguɛhi, nyɛ ye nyɛ he oo
nyɛ ye nyɛ he!
Hɛ yuyuili, nyɛ maa hyɛ nɔ́ oo
nyɛ maa hyɛ nɔ!’
E tsɔ mi ke ma ba kpɔ nihi
nɛ a ngɛ mɛ yi mi wae ɔ,
19nɛ ma de ke, be ɔ su
nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ma he e ma a yi wami.”
20Yesu nga womi ɔ, nɛ e kpale ngɔ ha sɔmɔlɔ ɔ, nɛ e ho ya hi si. Kɛkɛ nɛ ni ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ ngɛ kpe he ɔ bɔni lɛ hyɛmi too. 21Jehanɛ ɔ, e tu munyu nɛ e de ke, “Mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ, ngmami nɛ ɔ ba mi, nɛ nyɛ nu kɛ nyɛ tue.”
22Ni ɔmɛ tsuo tu e he munyu kpakpa, nɛ munyuhi nɛ a he jua wa nɛ je e nya a ha a nya kpɛ a he, nɛ a bi ke, “Anɛ pi Yosef bi ɔ ji nɛ ɔ lo?”
23Yesu de mɛ ke, “I heɔ yeɔ kaa nyɛ maa bu mi abɛ nɛ ɔ ke, ‘Tsopatsɛ, tsa mo nitsɛ o he.’ Nyɛ ma de mi hulɔ ke nihi nɛ nyɛ nu nɛ i pee ngɛ Kapernaum ɔ, ma pee ngɛ hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ, ngɛ imi nitsɛ ye ma mi.” 24 Yesu ya nɔ de ke, “I ngɛ nyɛ dee anɔkuale mi ke a bui gbalɔ ngɛ lɛ nitsɛ e ma mi.
25 “Nyɛɛ bu tue! Niinɛ, gbalɔ Eliya be ɔ mi ɔ, yalɔyihi babauu ngɛ Israel. Hiɔmi nɛ́ jeha etɛ kɛ fa sɔuu, nɛ hwɔ nɛ nya wa ba zugba a tsuo nɔ. 26 Se a tsɔ we Eliya kɛ yɛ a ti nɔ ko nɔ ko ngɔ, pe yalɔyo ɔ nɛ hi Zarefat ngɛ Sidon ɔ pɛ e ngɔ. 27 Jehanɛ ɔ se hu, gbalɔ Elisha be ɔ mi ɔ, nihi fuu ngɛ Israel nɛ he womi nɔ hiɔ yaya ngɛ a he. Se a tsa we a ti nɔ ko nɔ ko, pe Naeman, Siria no ɔ pɛ.”
28Benɛ nihi nɛ ngɛ kpe he ɔ nu nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, mɛ tsuo a mi mi fu. 29A te si nɛ a nu Yesu, nɛ a kɛ lɛ je ma a mi kɛ ho yoku ɔ nɛ a ma a maa si ngɛ nɔ ɔ yi mi ya. A to a yi mi kaa a ma tsitsɛɛ e yi se kɛ wo kɔ̃ ɔ mi, 30se e nyɛɛ kɛ gu a kpɛti kɛ je.
Nyumu ko nɛ mumi yayami ngɛ e mi
(Marko 1.21-28)
31Jehanɛ ɔ, Yesu ba Kapernaum ma a mi ngɛ Galilea, nɛ Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ, e ya kpe he ɔ ya tsɔɔ ní. 32 Bɔ nɛ e tsɔɔ ní ɔ ha ni ɔmɛ tsuo a he mi po, ejakaa e tu munyu kɛ he wami. 33Nyumu ko ngɛ kpe he ɔ nɛ mumi yayami ngɛ e mi. E kpa ngmlaa wawɛɛ ke, 34“Jee hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ, esɔ! Mɛni sane waa kɛ mo ngɛ, mo Yesu nɛ o je Nazaret? O ba nɛ o ba kpata wa hɛ mi, pi ja? I le mo tsɔ! Mo ji Mawu Nɔ Klɔuklɔu ɔ nɛ!”
35Yesu nga mumi ɔ yi ke, “Ma o nya! Jee kpo ngɛ nyumu ɔ mi!” Mumi yayami ɔ sake nyumu ɔ ngɔ fia si ngɛ a hɛ mi, nɛ e je e mi. Se e yi lɛ awi.
36Ni ɔmɛ tsuo a he mi po, nɛ a bi a he ke, “Mɛni nyakpɛ munyu po ji nɛ ɔ? Nyumu nɛ ɔ kɛ he wami ngaa mumi yayamihi a yi, kɛkɛ a jeɔ kpo!” 37Kɛkɛ nɛ Yesu he sane gbɛ fĩa lejɛ ɔ ní ɔmɛ a mi tsuo.
Yesu tsa nihi fuu
(Mateo 8.14-17; Marko 1.29-34)
38Yesu je kpe he ɔ, nɛ e ya sɛ Simon we ɔ mi. Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, Simon nganyɛ fɔɔ si kɛ asla nɛ nya wa. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ni ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ kpa Yesu pɛɛ ke e ba hyɛ yo ɔ. 39Yesu hɛ lɛ kɛ su e he, nɛ e nga asla a yi. Asla a po ngɛ yo ɔ nɔ, nɛ amlɔ ɔ, e te si nɛ e bɔni ni ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ sɔmɔmi.
40Benɛ pu nɔ si ɔ, nihi nɛ ngɛ nyɛmimɛ nɛ hiɔ slɔɔtohi ngɛ a he ɔ, ngɔ mɛ kɛ ba Yesu ngɔ. Yesu ngɔ e nine pue a nɔ kakaaka, nɛ e tsa mɛ tsuo. 41Mumi yayamihi hu je nihi fuu a mi, nɛ a kpa ngmlaa ke, “Mo ji Mawu Bi ɔ nɛ!”
Se Yesu nga mumi yayami ɔmɛ a yi, nɛ e ha we nɛ a tu munyu, ejakaa a le kaa lɛ ji Kristo ɔ.
Yesu fiɛ ngɛ kpe he ɔmɛ
(Marko 1.35-39)
42E nɔ jena a, Yesu je ma a mi, nɛ e pue nɔ kɛ ho he ko banee ya. Ni ɔmɛ bɔni lɛ hlami, nɛ benɛ a na lɛ ɔ, a ka kaa a maa tsi e nya, konɛ e ko je a ngɔ. 43Se e de mɛ ke, “E hia kaa ma ya fiɛ Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ he sane kpakpa a ngɛ ma kpa amɛ a mi hulɔ, ejakaa lɔ ɔ nɛ Mawu tsɔ mi ke ma ba tsu.”
44Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e fiɛ ngɛ kpe he ɔmɛ kɛ kpa zugba a nɔ tsuo.

Title: LUKA 5
Content:
Yesu tsɛ e kekleekle kaseli
(Mateo 4.18-22; Marko 1.16-20)
1 Ligbi ko ɔ, benɛ Yesu daa si ngɛ Genesaret taku ɔ nya a, nihi fuu ba pue e nɔ nɛ a bu Mawu munyu ɔ tue. 2E na lɛ enyɔ nɛ a muɔ mɛ si ngɛ taku ɔ nya; se hɛli ɔmɛ je a mi, nɛ a ya ngɛ a ya amɛ a he fɔe. 3Yesu ya sɛ lɛ ɔ kake mi, nɛ e de Simon nɛ ji lɛtsɛ ɔ ke e tsɛ̃ lɛ ɔ yi se bɔɔ kɛ wo pa a mi. Yesu hi si ngɛ lɛ ɔ mi jehanɛ, nɛ e bɔni ma kpekpemi ɔ ní tsɔɔmi.
4Benɛ e kpa munyu ɔ tumi ɔ, e de Simon ke, “Nyɛ hlui kɛ ya pa a nɔ he nɛ mi kuɔ. Nyɛ ya pue nyɛ ya a ngɛ lejɛ ɔ konɛ nyɛɛ gbe lo.”
5 Simon he nɔ ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, wa tsu ní wawɛɛ nyɔ nɛ ɔ mi tsuo, nɛ wa nɛ nɔ́ ko. Se kɛ̃, akɛnɛ mo lɛ o de ɔ, ma pue ya a.” 6 A hlui kɛ ya he nɛ pa a mi kuɔ ngɛ, nɛ a pue ya a. A gbe lo babauu, nɛ e piɛ bɔɔ nɛ ya a hía. 7Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a fɔ a huɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ lɛ kpa a mi ɔ nine ke a ba piɛ a he. A ba, nɛ a ba wo lɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ tsuo a mi lo tɔtɔɔtɔ kɛ ya si lɛ ɔmɛ miɔ nɛ a ma mu. 8Benɛ Simon Petro na nɔ́ nɛ ba a, e kpla si ngɛ Yesu nane nya, nɛ e de ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ! Jee ye kasa nya, ejakaa yayami peelɔ ji mi!”
9E kɛ nihi nɛ piɛ e he ɔ tsuo a he mi po ngɛ lo babauu ɔ nɛ a gbe ɔ he. 10Simon huɛmɛ, Yakobo, kɛ Yohane, Zebedeo bimɛ ɔmɛ hu a he mi po ja nɔuu. Jehanɛ Yesu de Simon ke, “Koo ye gbeye! Kɛ je mwɔnɛ ɔ kɛ yaa a, o maa hɛ nimli ha mi kaa bɔ nɛ a hɛɛ lo.”
11A sã lɛ ɔmɛ kɛ fɔ kpo, nɛ a si a nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́, nɛ a ya nyɛɛ Yesu se.
Yesu tsa nyumu ko
(Mateo 8.1-4; Marko 1.40-45)
12Be ko ɔ, Yesu ya je ma ko mi, nɛ nyumu ko nɛ he womi nɔ hiɔ yaya ngɛ e he hu ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Benɛ e na Yesu ɔ, e kpla si, nɛ e kɛ e hɛ mi bu si, nɛ e kpa lɛ pɛɛ ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, ke o suɔ ɔ, o ma nyɛ ha ye he nɛ tsɔ.”
13Yesu kpa e nine mi, nɛ e ta nyumu ɔ he, nɛ e de lɛ ke, “Ee, i suɔ! A tsa mo!” Nɛ amlɔ ɔ, hiɔ ɔ ta. 14 Yesu fa lɛ ke, “Ko de nɔ ko nɔ ko oo! Yaa tɛɛ nɛ o kɛ o he ya tsɔɔ osɔfo ɔ, nɛ e hyɛ mo! Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, yaa, nɛ o ya sã bɔ kaa bɔ nɛ Mose wo mlaa a, nɛ e pee okadi ha nihi tsuo kaa o he tsɔ niinɛ.”
15Se Yesu he sane gbɛ fĩa he tsuaa he mohu. Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, nimli babauu baa e ngɔ, konɛ a ba bu lɛ tue, nɛ a tsa a hiɔhi ha mɛ hulɔ. 16Se ke pee ɔ, e gblaa e he si kɛ yaa nga a nɔ he ko banee, nɛ e ya sɔleɔ.
Yesu tsa nyumu ko nɛ hule pue si
(Mateo 9.1-8; Marko 2.1-12)
17Ligbi ko benɛ Yesu ngɛ ní tsɔɔe ɔ, Farisi bi komɛ, kɛ mlaa tsɔɔli komɛ hii si ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. A je Galilea ma amɛ tsuo a mi, kɛ Yudea, kɛ Yerusalem kɛ ba. Nɛ Mawu ha Yesu he wami nɛ e kɛ tsa hiɔtsɛmɛ. 18Ni komɛ hɛɛ nyumu ko nɛ hule ngɛ sa mi kɛ ba, nɛ a ka kaa a kɛ lɛ maa sɛ we ɔ mi, nɛ́ a ngɔ lɛ ya fɔ Yesu hɛ mi. 19Se nimli kpekpemi ɔ a he je ɔ, a nɛ blɔ nɛ a kɛ lɛ nɛ ya lejɛ ɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a kuɔ kɛ ya tsu ɔ yi mi, nɛ a ya kpɔ zu longo ɔ eko, nɛ a siu hiɔtsɛ ɔ, kɛ e sa a kɛ gu puɔ ɔ mi kɛ ya fɔ ni ɔmɛ a kpɛti, ngɛ Yesu hɛ mi. 20Benɛ Yesu na hemi kɛ yemi nɛ ni ɔmɛ kɛ tsu ní ɔ, e de hiɔtsɛ ɔ ke, “Maminyumu! A kɛ o he yayami ɔmɛ pa mo.”
21Jehanɛ, mlaa tsɔɔli ɔmɛ, kɛ Farisi bi ɔmɛ bɔni a he bimi ke, “Nɔmlɔ nɛ ɔ, mɛnɔ ji lɛ loko e ngɛ musu bɔmi munyu tue kikɛ nɛ ɔ? Mɛnɔ ma nyɛ ngɔ yayami kɛ pa, kaa ja Mawu pɛ?”
22Benɛ Yesu na a juɛmi ɔ, e bi mɛ ke, “Mɛni nyɛ ngɛ susue ɔ? 23Ke a de ke, ‘A ngɔ o he yayami ɔmɛ ngɔ pa mo’ ɔ, tse lɔ ɔ demi wa pe kaa a ma de ke, ‘Tee si nɛ o nyɛɛ lo?’ 24Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ma tsɔɔ nyɛ kaa Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ ngɛ he blɔ ngɛ je ɔ mi kaa e ngɔɔ yayamihi kɛ paa.” Kɛkɛ nɛ e de nyumu ɔ nɛ hule ɔ ke, “I ngɛ mo dee ke tee si! Ngɔɔ o sa a, nɛ o ho we mi ya!”
25Amlɔ ɔ, nyumu ɔ te si ngɛ ni ɔmɛ tsuo a hɛ mi; e ngɔ sa a nɛ e hwɔ nɔ ɔ, nɛ e je kɛ ho we mi ya. Benɛ e yaa a tsuo e ngɛ Mawu yi jee. 26Mɛ tsuo a he mi po, nɛ a ye gbeye, nɛ a je Mawu yi, nɛ a de ke, “Wa na nyakpɛ ní mwɔnɛ ɔ!”
Yesu tsɛ Levi
(Mateo 9.9-13; Marko 2.13-17)
27Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Yesu je kpo, nɛ e ya na tó tsulɔ ko nɛ hii si ngɛ tó tsumi he ɔ; e biɛ ji Levi. Yesu de lɛ ke, “Ba nyɛɛ ye se!” 28Kɛkɛ nɛ Levi te si, nɛ e si e nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́, nɛ e nyɛɛ Yesu se.
29Levi ngmɛ okplɔɔ nguaa ngɛ e we ɔ mi kɛ wo Yesu hɛ mi nyami, nɛ tó tsuli, kɛ ni kpahi fuu kɛ mɛ ba ye ní. 30 Kɛkɛ nɛ Farisi bi komɛ, kɛ mlaa tsɔɔli komɛ tu munyu huitihuiti kɛ si Yesu kaseli ɔmɛ ke, “Mɛni he je nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ tó tsuli, kɛ yayami peeli ngɛ ní yee, nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ mɛ ngɛ ní nue ɔ?”
31Yesu de mɛ ke, “Nihi nɛ ngɛ he wami ɔ, e hia we mɛ tsopatsɛ; nihi nɛ be he wami ɔ, mɛ mohu lɛ tsopatsɛ hia. 32I bɛ dali tsɛmi; mohu ɔ, i ba nɛ ma ba tsɛ yayami peeli, konɛ a tsake a tsui.”
Hwɔ hami
(Mateo 9.14-17; Marko 2.18-22)
33Ni komɛ ba de Yesu ke, “Yohane kaseli ɔmɛ pɔɔ hwɔ hami kɛ sɔlemi, nɛ Farisi bi ɔmɛ a kaseli ɔmɛ hu peeɔ ja nɔuu; se moo lɛɛ o kaseli ɔmɛ yeɔ ní, nɛ a nuɔ ní.”
34Yesu bi mɛ ke, “Ke nɔ ko kpee yo, nɛ e huɛmɛ ba e he nyami ɔ, anɛ nyɛ susuɔ kaa e maa ha mɛ hwɔ be mi nɛ e kɛ mɛ ngɛ ɔ lo? Dɛbi! 35Se be ma, nɛ a maa ngɔ ayɛflo huno ɔ kɛ je a he kɛ ho; nɛ jamɛ a be ɔ loko a maa ha hwɔ!”
36Yesu bu mɛ abɛ nɛ ɔ hu ke, “Nɔ ko gba we tade he nya kɛ ta we tade momo mi. Ke e pee ja kɛkɛ e hia tade he ɔ, nɛ tade he ɔ nya nɛ a je ɔ, kɛ tade momo ɔ hu be yae fiee. 37Jã kɛ̃ nɔ ko ngɔɛ wai he wui lohwe he womi tɔ momohi a mi. Ke e pee ja a, wai he ɔ ma pɛ lohwe he womi tɔ ɔmɛ, nɛ e ma pue si, nɛ lohwe he womi tɔ ɔmɛ hu ma puɛ. 38Wai he ɔ, lohwe he womi tɔ hehi a mi nɛ e sa kaa a kɛ woɔ! 39Jehanɛ ɔ hu, nɔ ko nui wai momo, nɛ e ya hlaa wai he se blɔ amlɔ. Nɔ́ nɛ e deɔ ji, ‘Momo ɔ hi!’ ”

Title: LUKA 6
Content:
Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ
(Mateo 12.1-8; Marko 2.23-28)
1 Hejɔɔmi ligbi ko ɔ, Yesu ya su blɛfo ngmɔ komɛ a mi. E kaseli ɔmɛ kpɔ blɛfo tso mumu, nɛ a hluɛ, nɛ a kpe. 2Kɛkɛ nɛ Farisi bi komɛ bi mɛ ke, “Nɔ́ nɛ mlaa a ngmɛ́ blɔ kaa a peeɔ Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ, mɛni he je nyɛ ngɛ pee?”
3 Yesu ha mɛ heto ke, “Nɔ́ nɛ David pee ligbi ko, benɛ hwɔ ngɛ e kɛ e we bi ɔmɛ yee ɔ, anɛ nyɛ kane we lo? 4 David ya Mawu we ɔ mi, nɛ e kɛ̃ abolo ɔ nɛ a kɛ maa Mawu hɛ ɔ. E ye eko, nɛ e ha e we bi ɔmɛ hu eko nɛ a ye. Wa mlaa a ngmɛ́ blɔ kaa nɔ ko yeɔ jamɛ a abolo ɔ; osɔfo ɔmɛ pɛ lɛ a ngɛ he blɔ nɛ a yeɔ.”
5Yesu de kɛ gbe nya ke, “Mawu Bi ɔ, Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ tete Nyɔmtsɛ ji lɛ.”
Nyumu ɔ nɛ nine kake gbo ɔ
(Mateo 12.9-14; Marko 3.1-6)
6Yesu ya kpe he ɔ Hejɔɔmi ligbi kpa, nɛ e ya tsɔɔ ní. Nyumu ko ngɛ lejɛ ɔ nɛ e hiɔ nine gbo. 7Mlaa tsɔɔli komɛ, kɛ Farisi bi komɛ huɔ Yesu kaa e ma tsa nɔ Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ, konɛ a na nɔ́ ko nɛ a da nɔ kɛ ya po e nya. 8Se Yesu na a juɛmi ɔ momo; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e de nyumu ɔ nɛ nine gbo ɔ ke, “Tee si nɛ o ba da si ngɛ hɛ mi hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ!” Nyumu ɔ te da si ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. 9Kɛkɛ nɛ Yesu de mɛ ke, “Ma bi nyɛ nɔ́ ko. Mɛni wa mlaa a ngmɛɔ blɔ kaa waa pee Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ? A pee kpakpa, loo yayami? A he nɔ yi wami, aloo á kpata nɔ hɛ mi?” 10Jehanɛ, Yesu hyɛ mɛ tsuo a hɛ mi kɛ kpe, nɛ e de nyumu ɔ ke, “Kpã o nine ɔ mi!” E pee ja, nɛ he wami ba e nine ɔ mi ekohu.
11Se ni ɔmɛ lɛɛ a mi mi wo la wawɛɛ, nɛ a bɔni Yesu yi nɔ somi ngɛ a ní sɛɛmi mi ke, “Kɛ wa maa pee Yesu nɛ ɔ kɛɛ?”
Yesu hla bɔfohi nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ
(Mateo 10.1-4; Marko 3.13-19)
12Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, Yesu ho yoku ko nɔ ya nɛ e ya sɔle; e hi lejɛ ɔ nyɔ ɔ mi tsuo, nɛ e kɛ fa kue ha Mawu. 13Benɛ je na a, e tsɛ e kaseli ɔmɛ kɛ ba e ngɔ, nɛ e hla a kpɛti ni nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ, nɛ e tsɛ mɛ ke bɔfohi. 14Mɛ ji Simon, nɔ nɛ e wo lɛ biɛ ke Petro hulɔ ɔ, kɛ e nyɛmi Andrea, Yakobo kɛ Yohane, Filipo kɛ Bartolomeo, 15Mateo kɛ Toma, Alfeo bi Yakobo, kɛ Simon, (nɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ ma he doolɔ ɔ); 16Yuda, Yakobo nyɛmi ɔ, kɛ Yuda Iskariot, nɔ nɛ ba tsɔɔ Yesu se blɔ ɔ.
Yesu tsa nihi babauu
(Mateo 4.23-25)
17Benɛ Yesu kɛ bɔfo ɔmɛ kple si kɛ ba a, e ba da si ngɛ magbɛ nɔ, kɛ e se nyɛɛli babauu. Nimli babauu nitsɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. A je Yudea zugba a nɔ tsuo, kɛ Yerusalem, kɛ Tiro, kɛ Sidon wo nya ma amɛ a mi. 18A ba, konɛ a ba bu Yesu tue, nɛ e tsa a he hiɔhi ha mɛ. Ni nɛmɛ nɛ mumi yayamihi ngɛ mɛ haoe hu ba nɛ a tsa mɛ. 19Nimli babauu ɔ tsuo hla kaa a maa ta e he, ejakaa he wami ngɛ e mi jee kɛ ngɛ mɛ tsuo tsae.
Bua jɔmi kɛ kɔmɔ yemi
(Mateo 5.1-12)
20Yesu plɛ e hɛ mi ngɔ kpee e kaseli ɔmɛ, nɛ e de mɛ ke,
“A gbaa nyɛ, ohiatsɛmɛ,
ejakaa nyɛ nɔ́ ji Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ nɛ!
21“A gbaa nyɛ nihi nɛ hwɔ ngɛ nyɛ yee amlɔ nɛ ɔ;
Mawu ma ha nyɛ maa tɔ!
“A gbaa nyɛ nihi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ ya foe amlɔ nɛ ɔ,
ejakaa nyɛ ma ba muɔ!
22 “Ke nimli nyɛ nyɛ, loo a kua nyɛ, loo a jɛ nyɛ, loo a puɛ nyɛ biɛ ke nimli yayamihi ji nyɛ, ngɛ imi Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ, ye he ɔ, á gbaa nyɛ! 23 Ke e ba mi ja a, nyɛ nya, nɛ nyɛ hlu kɛ bua jɔmi, ejakaa Mawu ngɔ hiɔwo agbo ngɔ to ha nyɛ ngɛ hiɔwe. Nyɛ kai kaa ja nɔuu a nɛmɛ ɔmɛ pee gbali ɔmɛ.
24“Se nyɛ niatsɛmɛ, musu tloo nyɛ,
ejakaa nyɛ bua jɔmi ɔ tsuo ji nɛ ɔ nɛ!
25“Nyɛ nihi nɛ nyɛ tɔ mwɔnɛ ɔ, musu tloo nyɛ,
ejakaa hwɔ ma ba ye nyɛ!
“Nyɛ nihi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ muɔe amlɔ nɛ ɔ, musu tloo nyɛ;
ejakaa nyɛ ma ba ye kɔmɔ, nɛ nyɛ maa wo yana!
26“Musu tloo nyɛ, ke nihi tsuo
tuɔ nyɛ he munyu kpakpa;
ejakaa ja nɔuu a nɛmɛ ɔmɛ
pee lakpa gbali ɔmɛ!
Nyɛɛ suɔ nyɛ he nyɛli
(Mateo 5.38-48; 7.12a)
27“Se nyɛ nihi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ mi tue bue nɛ ɔ, i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke nyɛɛ suɔ nyɛ he nyɛli, nɛ nihi nɛ nyɛɛ nyɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ pee mɛ kpakpa; 28nyɛɛ gbaa nihi nɛ gbiɛɛ nyɛ, nɛ nyɛɛ sɔle ha ni nɛmɛ nɛ waa nyɛ yi mi. 29Ke nɔ ko gba o tue mi ma a, plɛ kake ɔ hu ha lɛ; ke nɔ ko kpɔ o hiɔwe tade ɔ, ha nɛ e ngɔ o tade klɔii ɔ hulɔ. 30Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ma bi mo nɔ́ ko ɔ, ha lɛ; ke nɔ ko ngɔ o nɔ́ ko ɔ, ko de lɛ ke e kpale kɛ ha mo. 31 Bɔ nɛ nyɛ suɔ nɛ nihi nɛ pee ngɔ ha nyɛ ɔ, nyɛ hu nyɛɛ pee ngɔ ha mɛ ja nɔuu.
32“Ke nyɛ suɔ nihi nɛ suɔ nyɛ pɛ ɔ, mɛni lɛ nyɛ pee nɛ bɛ hyɛ nɛ sa kaa a jeɔ nyɛ yi? Nihi nɛ li Mawu tete po suɔ nihi nɛ suɔ mɛ! 33Ke nyɛ pee kpakpa ha nihi nɛ peeɔ nyɛ kpakpa a, mɛni lɛ nyɛ pee nɛ bɛ hyɛ nɛ sa kaa a jeɔ nyɛ yi? Nihi nɛ li Mawu tete po peeɔ ja nɔuu! 34Nɛ ke nyɛ pa sika ha nihi nɛ nyɛ hɛ ngɛ nɔ kaa a maa wo nyɛ hiɔ ekohu ɔ, mɛni lɛ nyɛ pee nɛ bɛ hyɛ nɛ sa kaa a jeɔ nyɛ yi? Nihi nɛ li Mawu po paa sika haa a sibi, nɛ a heɔ ngɛ a dɛ sisiisi! 35Dɛbi! Nyɛɛ suɔ nyɛ he nyɛli, nɛ nyɛɛ pee mɛ kpakpa; nyɛɛ pa sika ha nɔ, nɛ nyɛ ko hyɛ blɔ kaa e ma ba wo hiɔ. Kɛkɛ ɔ, nyɛ hiɔwo maa hiɛ, nɛ nyɛ maa pee Hiɔwe No ɔ bimɛ; ejakaa lɛɛ e naa otlumuhi, kɛ yiwutsotsɛmɛ tsuo mɔbɔ. 36Nyɛɛ na nɔ tsuaa nɔ mɔbɔ kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ Tsɛ Mawu naa nɔ tsuaa nɔ mɔbɔ ɔ.
Koo kojo ni kpahi
(Mateo 7.1-5)
37“Nyɛ ko kojo ni kpahi, kɛkɛ Mawu hu be nyɛ kojoe; nyɛ ko bu ni kpahi fɔ, kɛkɛ Mawu hu be nyɛ fɔ bue; nyɛɛ ngɔ nihi a tɔmihi kɛ pa mɛ, nɛ Mawu hu maa ngɔ nyɛ he yayamihi kɛ pa nyɛ. 38Nyɛɛ ke nyɛ sibi ní, nɛ Mawu hu maa ke nyɛ ní ja nɔuu. Ee, Mawu maa ke nyɛ ní kpakpahi babauu nɛ nyɛ nine be he kpee, níhi kaa blɛfo nɛ a gbee nɔ, nɛ a sa mi, nɛ a bo ngɔ wo kotoku mi bami, nɛ e hyi tɔ kɛ be nɔ. Susumi nɔ́ nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ susuɔ nɔ́ ha ni kpahi ɔ, lɔ ɔ nɔuu a kɛ ma susu ha nyɛ.”
39 Jehanɛ Yesu bu mɛ abɛ ke, “Anɛ hɛ yuyuilɔ ma nyɛ tsɔɔ hɛ yuyuilɔ blɔ lo? Anɛ mɛ ni enyɔ ɔmɛ tsuo a ya be muɔ mi nɔe o? 40 Kaselɔ pã we e tsɔɔlɔ. Kaselɔ ɔ, ke a tsɔɔ lɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ e hia kaa e le ɔ, e maa pee kaa e tsɔɔlɔ ɔ.
41“Mɛni he je o naa ngu nyafii nɛ ngɛ o nyɛmi hɛngmɛ nɔ, se plai agbo nɛ ngɛ mo nitsɛ o hɛngmɛ nɔ lɛɛ o nɛ ɔ? 42Ko de o nyɛmi ke e ha nɛ o je ngu nyafii nɛ ngɛ e hɛngmɛ nɔ ɔ, be mi nɛ plai agbo nɛ ngɛ mo nitsɛ o hɛngmɛ nɔ ɔ lɛɛ o nɛ. Osatotsɛ! Je plai ɔ ngɛ mo nitsɛ o hɛngmɛ nɔ kekle; kɛkɛ ɔ, o maa hyɛ nɔ́ saminya, nɛ o ma je ngu nyafii ɔ ngɛ o nyɛmi ɔ hɛngmɛ nɔ.
Yiblii kpakpa kɛ yiblii yaya
(Mateo 7.16-20; 12.33-35)
43“Tso kpakpa wui yiblii yaya, nɛ tso yaya hu wui yiblii kpakpa. 44 Tso tsuaa tso ɔ, lɛ nitsɛ e yiblii a kɛ leɔ lɛ; a la we ngmɔkɔ ngɛ mio tso nɔ; nɛ jehanɛ hu, a bua we wai yiblii nya kɛ ji zezle mi. 45 Nɔmlɔ kpakpa susuɔ ní kpakpahi a he ngɛ e yi mi, nɛ e tuɔ munyu kpakpa; nɔmlɔ yayami susuɔ ní yayamihi ngɛ e yi mi, nɛ e tuɔ munyu yaya. Susumihi nɛ hyi nɔ ko yi mi tɔtɔɔtɔ ɔ ji munyuhi nɛ jeɔ kpo ngɛ nɔ ɔ nya.
Tsu mali enyɔ ɔmɛ
(Mateo 7.24-27)
46“Mɛni he je nyɛ tsɛɔ mi ‘Nyɔmtsɛ’, se níhi nɛ i deɔ nyɛ ke nyɛɛ pee lɛɛ nyɛ pee we ɔ? 47Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ baa ye ngɔ, nɛ e ba nuɔ ye munyu ɔmɛ, nɛ e yeɔ nɔ ɔ, ma tsɔɔ nyɛ bɔ nɛ e ngɛ ha. 48E ngɛ kaa nyumu ko nɛ benɛ e maa ma tsu ɔ, e tsua si voo, nɛ e to sisi ngɛ tɛ sa nɔ. Pa hia ba na tsu ɔ, se e nyɛ we nɛ e hule lɛ; ejakaa a to sisi ngɛ tɛ sa nɔ. 49Se nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ nuɔ ye munyu ɔmɛ, nɛ e yi nɔ ɔ, lɛɛ e ngɛ kaa nyumu ko nɛ ma tsu nɛ e tui sisi. Kɛkɛ nɛ pa hia ba na tsu ɔ, nɛ amlɔ ɔ, e hule nɔ si bum! Nɛ e gbɛ tsɔkɔtsɔkɔ.”

Title: LUKA 7
Content:
Yesu tsa Roma asafoatsɛ ko nyɔguɛ
(Mateo 8.5-13)
1Benɛ Yesu tu munyu nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ tsɔɔ ni ɔmɛ ta a, e pue nɔ kɛ ho Kapernaum ya. 2Roma asafoatsɛ ko ngɛ ma a mi, kɛ e nyɔguɛ nɛ e suɔ lɛ saminya. Se nyɔguɛ ɔ be he wami kulaa, nɛ e miɔ nɛ e ma gbo. 3Benɛ asafoatsɛ ɔ nu Yesu he ɔ, e tsɔ Yuda ma nimeli komɛ ke a ya de lɛ ke e ba nɛ e ba tsa e nyɔguɛ ɔ ha lɛ. 4A ba Yesu ngɔ, nɛ a ba kpa lɛ pɛɛ wawɛɛ ke, “Nyumu nɛ ɔ, ke o pee nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ha lɛ ɔ, e sa lɛ, 5ejakaa e suɔ wɔ Yuda bi ɔmɛ; wa kpe he ɔ po lɛ nɛ e ma ha wɔ.”
6Nɛ Yesu kɛ mɛ ho. Benɛ e piɛ bɔɔ nɛ e maa su we ɔ mi ɔ, asafoatsɛ ɔ tsɔ e huɛmɛ kɛ ba Yesu ngɔ, nɛ a ba de lɛ ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, koo hao o he. I sɛ́ kaa i haa nɛ o baa ye we mi. 7Jehanɛ se hu, i le kaa e sɛ́ kaa imi nɛ ɔ, i baa o ngɔ. Moo lɛɛ moo tu munyu, kɛkɛ ye nyɔguɛ ɔ ma na he wami. 8Imi hu i ngɛ nihi nɛ yeɔ ye nɔ, kɛ ta buli ngɛ ye sisi. I deɔ nɔ kake ke, ‘Yaa!’ nɛ e yaa; i deɔ nɔ kpa ke, ‘Ba!’ nɛ e baa; jehanɛ se hu, i deɔ ye nyɔguɛ ke, ‘Pee enɛ ɔ!’ nɛ e peeɔ.”
9Benɛ Yesu nu nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, e hɛ mi pee lɛ yaa. Kɛkɛ nɛ e plɛ, nɛ e de nimli kpekpemi nɛ nyɛɛ e se ɔ ke, “I ngɛ nyɛ dee ke, i nɛ hemi kɛ yemi kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ hyɛ; dɛbi, ngɛ Israel tete po i nɛ hyɛ!”
10Benɛ tsɔli ɔmɛ kpale a se kɛ ho asafoatsɛ ɔ we ɔ mi ya a, a ya na e nyɔguɛ ɔ nɛ e na he wami.
Yesu tle yalɔyo ko binyumu si
11Be bɔɔ se ɔ, Yesu pue nɔ kɛ ho ma ko nɛ a tsɛɛ Nain ɔ ya, nɛ e kaseli ɔmɛ, kɛ nihi babauu nyɛɛ e se. 12Benɛ e su ma a agbo ɔ nya ta a, nimli babauu ji nɛ nɛ je ma a mi kɛ ma. Nyumu ko gbo, nɛ a nyɛɛ gbogboe ɔ se. Nyumu nɛ ɔ, e nyɛ bi kake pɛ ji lɛ; yalɔyo ji e nyɛ ɔ, nɛ nihi babauu ba e ngɔ. 13Benɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ na yo ɔ, e ní pee lɛ mɔbɔ, nɛ e de lɛ ke, “Ko fo ya!” 14Kɛkɛ nɛ e ho nɛ e ya pɛtɛ daka a he, nɛ nihi nɛ hɛɛ daka a da si. Jehanɛ ɔ, Yesu de ke, “Niheyo, i ngɛ mo dee ke, tee si!” 15Kɛkɛ nɛ nɔ nɛ gbo ɔ te si nɛ e hi si, nɛ e bɔni munyu tumi. Nɛ Yesu ngɔ lɛ kɛ ha e nyɛ.
16Gbeye nu ni ɔmɛ tsuo, nɛ a je Mawu yi, nɛ a de ke, “Gbalɔ nguaa ko te si ngɛ wa kpɛti! Mawu ba, konɛ e ba kpɔ wɔ, e ma a!”
17Yesu he sane nɛ ɔ pɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ tsuo, kɛ lejɛ ɔ kpokpa amɛ a nɔ.
Yohane nɔ sɔlelɔ ɔ tsɔ kɛ ba Yesu ngɔ
(Mateo 11.2-19)
18Benɛ Yohane kaseli ɔmɛ ya sɛɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ha lɛ ɔ, e tsɛ a ti ni enyɔ, 19nɛ e tsɔ mɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu ngɔ ke a ya bi lɛ ke, “Mo lɛ a de ke o ma a, aloo waa hyɛ nɔ kpa blɔ?”
20Benɛ tsɔli ɔmɛ ba Yesu ngɔ ɔ, a de lɛ ke, “Yohane nɔ sɔlelɔ ɔ tsɔ wɔ ke wa ba bi mo ke, ‘Anɛ mo ji nɔ nɛ maa ba a, aloo waa hyɛ nɔ kpa blɔ?’ ”
21Jamɛ a be ɔ nɔuu ɔ, Yesu tsa hiɔtsɛmɛ fuu a hiɔhi ha mɛ; e hia mumi yayamihi kɛ je nihi a mi, nɛ e ha hɛ yuyuili babauu hyɛ nɔ́ ekohu. 22 Yesu ha Yohane tsɔli ɔmɛ heto ke, “Nyɛɛ kpale kɛ ho nɛ nyɛ ya de Yohane níhi nɛ nyɛ na, kɛ níhi nɛ nyɛ nu: hɛ yuyuili ngɛ nɔ́ hyɛe, glɔtsɛmɛ ngɛ nyɛɛe, nihi nɛ he womi nɔ hiɔ yaya ngɛ a he ɔ, a he tsɔ, tue kpokutsɛmɛ ngɛ nɔ́ nue, a ngɛ gbogboehi si tlee, nɛ a ngɛ sane kpakpa a fiɛe kɛ ngɛ ohiatsɛmɛ tsɔɔe. 23A gbaa nihi nɛ ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi ngɛ ye mi kɛ mwɔɔ!”
24Benɛ Yohane tsɔli ɔmɛ je ɔ, Yesu bɔni Yohane he munyu tumi ha nimli kpekpemi ɔ. E bi mɛ ke, “Benɛ nyɛ ho nga a nɔ ya a mɛni nyɛ hyɛ blɔ kaa nyɛ maa na? Ngɔwu nɛ kɔɔhiɔ ngɛ lɛ mimiɛe lo? 25Mɛni nyɛ ho hyɛmi ya? Nɔmlɔ nɛ wo ablade tade lo? Oo, nihi nɛ woɔ tade saminyawiiwi, nɛ a ngɛ gbɔjɔ si himi mi ɔ, matsɛmɛ a wehi a mi a naa mɛ ngɛ. 26Nyɛ de mi koo, mɛni nyɛ ho hyɛmi ya? Gbalɔ; pi ja? Ee, i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke, nɔ nɛ pe gbalɔ tete. 27 Ejakaa Yohane he lɛ ngmami ɔ de ngɛ ke, ‘Mawu ke, ma tsɔ ye tsɔlɔ ɔ kɛ sɛ o hlami, nɛ e ya dla blɔ ɔ ngɔ to mo.’ 28I ngɛ nyɛ dee ke, nimli tsuo nɛ a fɔ kɛ ba je ɔ mi ɔ, a ti nɔ ko nɔ ko pi Yohane. Se nɔ nɛ ji nyafii pe kulaa ngɛ Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ mi ɔ pã Yohane.”
29 Ma a, kɛ tó tsuli ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ nu fiɛmi ɔ, bu Mawu tue. Níhi nɛ Mawu de mɛ ke a pee ɔ, a pee pɛpɛɛpɛ, nɛ Yohane sɔle mɛ. 30Se Farisi bi ɔmɛ, kɛ mlaa tsɔɔli ɔmɛ lɛɛ a kua Mawu blɔ nya tomi kɛ ha mɛ ɔ nɛ a kplɛɛ we nɛ e sɔle mɛ.
31Yesu ya nɔ de ke, “Lɛɛ mɛni he ma ngɔ kikɛmɛ a yi nɔ nɛ ɔ bi ɔmɛ ngɔ to? Kɛ ji bɔ nɛ a ngɛ kɛɛ? 32A ngɛ kaa jokuɛwi nɛ hii si ngɛ jua nɔ. Fa kake ngɛ ngmlaa kpae ngɛ a nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ dee ke, ‘Wa kpa bɛ ha nyɛ, se nyɛ dui! Wa nya awe, se nyɛ wui yana!’ 33Yohane nɔ sɔlelɔ ɔ ba. E yi ní, nɛ e nui wai, nɛ nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ de ji, ‘Mumi yayami ngɛ e mi!’ 34Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ ba. Lɛɛ e yeɔ ní, nɛ e nuɔ wai, nɛ nyɛ ke, ‘Hyɛ, nyumu jiklɔɔtsɛ, kɛ dã nulɔ, tó tsuli, kɛ yayami peeli a huɛ.’ 35Se kɛ̃, nihi tsuo nɛ heɔ Mawu nile ɔ yeɔ ɔ, a yeɔ odase kaa e ji anɔkuale.”
Yesu ngɛ Simon, Farisi no ɔ we mi
36Farisi no ko tsɛ Yesu ní yemi, nɛ Yesu ya Farisi no ɔ we ɔ mi ya hi si, konɛ a ye ní ɔ. 37 Yo ko ngɛ jamɛ a ma a mi nɛ yayami peelɔ ji lɛ. Benɛ e nu kaa Yesu ngɛ ní yee ngɛ Farisi no ɔ we ɔ mi ɔ, e hɛɛ tɛ kplu nɛ he jua wa kɛ e mi nu kɛ e he via kɛ ba. 38E ba da si ngɛ Yesu nane he, ngɛ e se je, nɛ e bɔni ya fomi; nɛ vo nyu ɔ pue Yesu nane ɔmɛ a nɔ. Kɛkɛ nɛ e kɛ e yi bwɔmi tsu Yesu nane ɔmɛ a he; e fiɔ he, nɛ e plɛ nu kɛ e he via a kɛ pue nɔ. 39Benɛ Farisi no ɔ nɛ tsɛ Yesu ní yemi ɔ na a, e de ngɛ e yi mi ke, “Nyumu nɛ ɔ, gbalɔ nitsɛ ji lɛ jinɛ e ko le yo nɛ ngɛ e he tae nɛ ɔ mi tso kaa yayami peelɔ ji lɛ!”
40Yesu wo e nya nɔ nɛ e de ke, “Simon, i ngɛ sane ko nɛ ma de mo.”
Simon he nɔ ke, “Tsɔɔlɔ, de.”
41Yesu de ke, “Nyumuhi ni enyɔ komɛ ya sika palɔ ko ngɔ ya pa sika. Nɔ kake pa sika hiɔ yi lafa enuɔ, nɛ nɔ kake hu pa yi nyingmi enuɔ. 42Se akɛnɛ a nyɛ we nɛ a wo hiɔ ɔ he je ɔ, e ngɔ kɛ ke mɛ ni enyɔ ɔmɛ tsuo. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a ti mɛnɔ maa suɔ lɛ pe kulaa?”
43Simon he nɔ ke, “E peeɔ mi kaa nɔ nɛ e ngɔ fuu ngɔ ke lɛ ɔ.”
Yesu de lɛ ke, “Nɔ́ nɛ o de ɔ da.” 44Jehanɛ, e plɛ e hɛ mi kɛ kpee yo ɔ, nɛ e de Simon ke, “Tse o ngɛ yo nɛ ɔ hyɛe? Nɛ i ba sɛ o we ɔ mi ɔ, o ha we mi nyu nɛ ma kɛ fɔ ye nane he, se lɛɛ e kɛ vo nyu fɔ ye nane he, nɛ e kɛ e yi bwɔmi tsu. 45O fiɔ we ye nya he, nɛ o pee we mi atuu. Se kɛ je be nɛ i ba hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ, yo nɛ ɔ jɔɔ we ye nane he fiɔmi. 46Nu hu o wui ye yi mi, se lɛɛ e ngɔ nu kɛ e he via kɛ kpa ye nane he. 47Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i ngɛ mo dee ke, suɔmi agbo nɛ e je kpo ɔ tsɔɔ kaa a ngɔ e he yayami babauu ɔ ngɔ pa lɛ. Nɔ nɛ a ngɔ bɔbɔyoo pɛ ngɔ pa lɛ ɔ, suɔmi bɔbɔyoo pɛ e jeɔ kpo.”
48Jehanɛ, Yesu de yo ɔ ke, “A ngɔ o he yayami ɔmɛ ngɔ pa mo.”
49Kɛkɛ nɛ nihi nɛ kɛ lɛ ngɛ ní ɔ yee ɔ bɔni demi ngɛ a yi mi ke, “Mɛnɔ ji nɛ ɔ, nɛ e ngɔɔ yayami po kɛ paa nɔ?”
50Se Yesu de yo ɔ ke, “O hemi kɛ yemi he o yi wami; yaa ngɛ he jɔmi mi.”

Title: LUKA 8
Content:
Yihi nɛ kɛ Yesu nyɛɛ
1Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Yesu ya kpa mahi, kɛ kɔpehi a mi, nɛ e fiɛ sane kpakpa a nɛ kɔɔ Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ he ngɔ tsɔɔ nihi. Ni nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ piɛ e he, 2 kɛ yi komɛ hu nɛ e hia mumi yayamihi ngɛ a mi, nɛ e tsa a hiɔhi ha mɛ. Mɛ ji Maria (nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Magdalena), nɔ nɛ a hia mumi yayami kpaago ngɛ e mi ɔ, 3kɛ Yohana, Herode tsɔlɔ nɔkɔtɔma Kuza yo ɔ, kɛ Susana, kɛ yi kpahi fuu nɛ a kɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a níhi hyɛ Yesu, kɛ e kaseli ɔmɛ a nɔ ɔ.
Ní dulɔ ɔ he abɛ ɔ
(Mateo 13.1-9; Marko 4.1-9)
4Nihi ngɛ Yesu ngɔ bae kpamisa kɛ je ma slɔɔtohi a mi; nɛ benɛ nihi babauu ba bua a he nya a, Yesu sɛɛ mɛ ní nɛ ɔ ngɛ abɛ gbi mi ke,
5“Ligbi ko ɔ, nyumu ko pue nɔ kɛ ho e ngmɔ mi ya nɛ́ e ya fĩa ní. Benɛ e ngɛ wu ɔ fĩae ɔ, ekomɛ ya pue blɔ mi, nɛ nihi naa nɔ, nɛ lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ ba ye. 6Ekomɛ ya pue tɛ zugba mi, nɛ benɛ a puɛ ɔ, a ngla amlɔ ɔ nɔuu, ejakaa a nɛ zugba jɔjɔɛ. 7Ekomɛ hu ya pue mio mi, nɛ mio ɔ, kɛ wu ɔmɛ puɛ fiee, nɛ a gbe wu ɔmɛ. 8Se ekomɛ hu ya pue zugba kpakpa mi, nɛ a puɛ, nɛ a wo yiblii totoe lafa.”
Benɛ Yesu de enɛ ɔ gbe nya a, e de ke, “Nɔ nɛ ngɛ tue nɛ nuɔ nɔ ɔ, e nu nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ dee ɔ!”
Nɔ́ nɛ he je nɛ Yesu bu abɛhi
(Mateo 13.10-17; Marko 4.10-12)
9Benɛ Yesu kaseli ɔmɛ bi lɛ ke e tsɔɔ mɛ abɛ nɛ ɔ sisi ɔ, 10 e de mɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ lɛɛ a ha nyɛ he blɔ kaa nyɛɛ le laami sanehi nɛ ngɛ Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ mi. Se ni kpa amɛ lɛɛ abɛ gbi mi nɛ a deɔ mɛ laami sane ɔmɛ ngɛ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a maa hyɛ, se a be nae; a maa nu se a be sisi nue.”
Yesu tsɔɔ ní dulɔ ɔ he abɛ ɔ sisi
(Mateo 13.18-23; Marko 4.13-20)
11“Abɛ ɔ sisi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: Wu ɔ ji Mawu munyu ɔ nɛ. 12Wuhi nɛ ya pue blɔ mi ɔ daa si ha nihi nɛ nuɔ munyu ɔ. Se Abosiami baa nɛ e ba jeɔ munyu ɔ ngɛ a tsui mi, konɛ a ko he ye, nɛ a ko he a yi wami. 13Wuhi nɛ ya pue tɛ zugba mi ɔ daa si ha nihi nɛ ke a nu munyu ɔ, a heɔ kɛ bua jɔmi, se e he we si ngɛ a tsui mi. A heɔ yeɔ be kuku kɛkɛ, se ke haomi ba a nɔ kɛkɛ a hemi kɛ yemi ta. 14Wuhi nɛ ya pue mio mi ɔ daa si ha nihi nɛ nuɔ munyu ɔ, nɛ a heɔ yeɔ hulɔ. Se pee se ɔ, je nɛ ɔ mi haomi, kɛ ní nami, kɛ níhi nɛ ngɔɔ nɔ nya haa nɛ a hemi kɛ yemi gboɔ. Kɛkɛ ɔ, ní tsumi nɛ sa kaa a tsu kɛ gu hemi kɛ yemi nɔ ɔ, a nyɛ we nɛ a tsuɔ. 15Wuhi nɛ ya pue zugba kpakpa mi ɔ daa si ha nihi nɛ a tsui mi hi, nɛ a yeɔ anɔkuale. Mɛɛ lɛɛ ke a nu Mawu munyu ɔ, a tsuɔ he ní hluu kɛ ya siɔ e woɔ yiblii.
Kane nɛ a kɛ ma sowe sisi
(Marko 4.21-25)
16 “Nɔ ko su we kane nɛ e kɛ sowe bu nɔ, aloo e kɛ ma sa tso sisi. Mohu ɔ, e kɛ maa kane tso nɔ, konɛ nihi nɛ ma a, a na la a.
17 “Nɔ́ ko be nɛ a kɛ laa nɛ a be kpo jee; jehanɛ ɔ hu, nɔ́ ko be nɛ a bu nɔ, nɛ a be nae, nɛ a be kpo jee.
18 “Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ bu tue saminya; ejakaa nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ nɔ́ ko ngɛ e dɛ ɔ, a ma ha lɛ fuu kɛ piɛ he. Se nɔ nɛ be nɔ́ ko ɔ, bɔɔ nɛ e susu kaa e ngɛ ɔ tete po a ma he ngɛ e dɛ.”
Yesu nyɛ kɛ e nyɛmimɛ
(Mateo 12.46-50; Marko 3.31-35)
19Yesu nyɛ kɛ e nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ ba e ngɔ, se a nɛ e he blɔ, ejakaa nimli babauu ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. 20Kɛkɛ nɛ nɔ ko de lɛ ke, “O nyɛ, kɛ o nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ daa si ngɛ kpo ɔ nɔ, nɛ a ngɛ hlae nɛ a na mo.”
21Yesu de ni ɔmɛ tsuo ke, “Maa, kɛ ye nyɛmimɛ ji nihi nɛ nuɔ Mawu munyu ɔ, nɛ a yeɔ nɔ.”
Yesu jɔɔ wo nɔ kɔɔhiɔ nɛ nya wa he
(Mateo 8.23-27; Marko 4.35-41)
22Ligbi ko ɔ, Yesu kɛ e kaseli ɔmɛ ya sɛ lɛ mi, nɛ e de mɛ ke, “Nyɛ ha nɛ waa po mi kɛ ya Genesaret taku ɔ se je.” Kɛkɛ nɛ a pue nɔ. 23Benɛ a ngɛ hluie kɛ yaa a, Yesu hwɔ mahe. Tlukaa a, kɔɔhiɔ nɛ nya wa hia ngɛ taku ɔ nɔ; nyu bɔni lɛ ɔ mi sɛmi, nɛ lɛ ɔ miɔ nɛ e ma mu. 24Yesu kaseli ɔmɛ ya tsɛ̃ɛ̃ lɛ, nɛ a de ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, Nyɔmtsɛ! Wa gbo oo!”
Kɛkɛ nɛ Yesu te si, nɛ e nga kɔɔhiɔ kɛ wo nɛ gli ɔ yi. Kɔɔhiɔ ɔ kpa fiami, nɛ wo ɔ ngmɛ dii, nɛ lejɛ ɔ jɔ. 25Kɛkɛ nɛ Yesu bi e kaseli ɔmɛ ke, “Jije nyɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ ngɛ?”
Se kaseli ɔmɛ a he mi po, nɛ a ye gbeye, nɛ a de a sibi ke, “Mɛni nɔmlɔ po ji nɛ ɔ? E ngaa kɔɔhiɔ, kɛ nyu tete po yi, nɛ a buɔ lɛ tue!”
Yesu tsa nyumu ko nɛ mumi yayamihi ngɛ e mi
(Mateo 8.28-34; Marko 5.1-20)
26Jehanɛ ɔ, Yesu kɛ e kaseli ɔmɛ ba su Gerasa bi ɔmɛ a zugba a nɔ, ngɛ Galilea hanɔ. 27Benɛ Yesu ba kple ɔ, nyumu ko nɛ mumi yayamihi ngɛ e mi je ma a mi, nɛ e kɛ lɛ ba kpe. Daa nɛ ɔ, nyumu nɛ ɔ hɛɛ e he gu; e hí we mi, se mohu yɔkɔhi a mi nɛ e hii. 28Benɛ e na Yesu ɔ, e hia ngmlaa nɛ e ho ya kpla si ngɛ e nane nya, nɛ e kɛ ngmlaa de ke, “Yesu, Hiɔwe Mawu No ɔ Bi! Mɛni sane i kɛ mo ngɛ? I kpa mo pɛɛ, koo hao mi!” 29Nyumu ɔ de ja, ejakaa Yesu nga mumi yayami ɔ yi ke e je e mi. Behi fuu ke mumi yayami ɔ nu lɛ fɔ si kikɛ nɛ ɔ, a maa tsi e nya, nɛ a maa wo lɛ kɔsɔkɔsɔ. Se kɛ̃, e ma tsɔ kɔsɔkɔsɔ ɔ, nɛ mumi yayami ɔ maa wo lɛ fo kɛ ya nga a nɔ.
30Jehanɛ ɔ, Yesu bi nyumu ɔ ke, “Kɛ a tsɛɛ mo kɛɛ?”
E he nɔ ke, “Asafo”, ejakaa mumi yayamihi fuu lɛ ngɛ e mi. 31Kɛkɛ nɛ mumi yayami ɔmɛ de Yesu ke, “Wa kpa mo pɛɛ, ko ha nɛ wa ya sɛ muɔ voo ɔ nɛ ngɛ zugba a sisi ɔ mi.”
32Jamɛ a be ɔ, kpotoo kuu kpekpemi ko ngɛ ní yee ngɛ yoku ɔ nɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, mumi yayami ɔmɛ de Yesu ke, “Wa kpa mo pɛɛ, ha nɛ wa ya sɛ kpotoo ɔmɛ a mi.” Nɛ e kplɛɛ. 33Kɛkɛ nɛ mumi yayami ɔmɛ je nyumu ɔ mi, nɛ a ya sɛ kpotoo ɔmɛ a mi, nɛ kpotoo kpekpemi ɔ tsuo wo fo gidigidi kɛ kple yoku ɔ kɛ ya pue taku ɔ mi, nɛ a gbo.
34Benɛ nihi nɛ ngɛ kpotoo ɔmɛ hyɛe ɔ na nɔ́ nɛ ba a, a tu fo nɛ a ya sɛɛ ngɛ ma a mi, kɛ kɔpe ɔmɛ a mi, 35nɛ nihi je kpo kɛ ba, konɛ a ba hyɛ. Benɛ a ba su Yesu ngɔ ɔ, a na nyumu ɔ nɛ mumi yayami ɔmɛ je e mi ɔ nɛ e hii si ngɛ Yesu nane nya. E wo tade, nɛ e hɛ mi tsɔ lɛ. Nɛ mɛ tsuo a ye gbeye. 36Nihi nɛ na bɔ nɛ a plɛ kɛ tsa nyumu ɔ nɛ mumi yayami ɔmɛ ngɛ e mi ɔ, sɛɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ha ni nɛmɛ nɛ ba nɔ́ hyɛmi ɔ. 37Kɛkɛ nɛ ni ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ je jamɛ a zugba a nɔ ɔ, ba kpa Yesu pɛɛ ke e je a ngɔ nɛ e ho, ejakaa a ye gbeye wawɛɛ. Nɛ e ya sɛ lɛ ɔ mi, nɛ e kpale e se. 38Nyumu ɔ nɛ mumi yayami ɔmɛ je e mi ɔ, kpa Yesu pɛɛ ke e ha nɛ e kɛ lɛ nɛ ya.
Se Yesu wo lɛ blɔ, nɛ e de lɛ ke, 39“Kpale o se kɛ ho we mi ya, nɛ o ya sɛɛ nɔ́ nɛ Mawu pee ha mo ɔ.”
Kɛkɛ nɛ nyumu ɔ ya kpa ma a mi tsuo, nɛ e ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ Yesu pee ha lɛ ɔ fiɛe.
Yairo biyo ɔ, kɛ yo ɔ nɛ ta Yesu tade ɔ he ɔ
(Mateo 9.18-26; Marko 5.21-43)
40Benɛ Yesu kpale e se kɛ ba taku ɔ se je ɔ, ni ɔmɛ nya e he, ejakaa mɛ tsuo a ngɛ lɛ blɔ hyɛe. 41Tlukaa a, nyumu ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Yairo ɔ ba lejɛ ɔ; lɛ ji kpe he ɔ nɔkɔtɔma. E ba kpla si ngɛ Yesu nane nya, nɛ e kpa lɛ pɛɛ ke e ba e we ɔ mi, 42ejakaa e biyo kake too nɛ ye maa pee jeha nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔ miɔ nɛ e ma gbo.
Benɛ Yesu yaa a, ni ɔmɛ tɔtɔ lɛ. 43Yo ko ngɛ ni ɔmɛ a kpɛti nɛ muɔ ngɛ dɛe ngɛ e he jeha nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ sɔuu. Se nɔ ko nɔ ko nyɛ we nɛ e tsa lɛ. 44Yo nɛ ɔ ba je Yesu se je, nɛ e ta Yesu tade ɔ nya fiami ɔ he; nɛ amlɔ ɔ, muɔ nɛ ngɛ dɛe ngɛ e he ɔ se po. 45Kɛkɛ nɛ Yesu bi ke, “Mɛnɔ lɛ ta ye he ɔ?”
Ni ɔmɛ tsuo ke, “Kpaoo!” Kɛkɛ nɛ Petro de ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, ma kpekpemi nitsɛnitsɛ lɛ bɔle mo kɛ kpe nɛ a tɔtɔ nihi babauu mo ɔ nɛ!”
46Se Yesu de ke, “Nɔ ko ta ye he, ejakaa i nu he kaa he wami je ye mi.” 47Jehanɛ ɔ, benɛ yo ɔ na kaa e hí lɛ laami hu ɔ, e kɛ he domi blibliibli ba kpla si ngɛ Yesu nane nya. Ngɛ ni ɔmɛ tsuo a hɛ mi ɔ, e de lɛ nɔ́ he je nɛ e ta e he ɔ, kɛ bɔ nɛ a tsa lɛ amlɔ nɔuu ɔ. 48Yesu de lɛ ke, “Biyo, o hemi kɛ yemi tsa mo; yaa ngɛ he jɔmi mi.”
49Benɛ Yesu ngɛ munyu ɔ tue kɛ mwɔɔ ɔ, tsɔlɔ ko je kpe he ɔ nɔkɔtɔma a we ɔ mi ba de Yairo ke, “O biyo ɔ gbo; koo doo Tsɔɔlɔ ɔ nya hu.”
50Se Yesu nu, nɛ e de Yairo ke, “Koo ye gbeye; moo lɛɛ he ye kɛkɛ, nɛ e yi ma na wami ekohu.”
51Benɛ Yesu ba we ɔ mi ɔ, e ngmɛ́ nɔ ko nɔ ko blɔ nɛ e sɛ tsu ɔ mi kɛ piɛ e he, ja Petro, Yohane, Yakobo, kɛ jokuɛ ɔ tsɛ kɛ e nyɛ pɛ. 52Ni ɔmɛ tsuo wo yana, nɛ a ngɛ jokuɛ ɔ he awe nyae. Se Yesu de mɛ ke, “Nyɛ ko fo ya; jokuɛ ɔ gbo we, mahe kɛkɛ nɛ e ngɛ hwɔe!”
53Benɛ e de enɛ ɔ, mɛ tsuo a muɔ lɛ, ejakaa mɛɛ a le kaa jokuɛ ɔ gbo. 54Se Yesu nu e nine si, nɛ e kpa ngmlaa ke, “Jokuɛ yo, tee si!” 55Kɛkɛ nɛ jokuɛ ɔ mumi kpale ba e mi ekohu, nɛ e te si amlɔ nɔuu. Nɛ Yesu fa ke, “Nyɛ ha lɛ nɔ́ ko nɛ e ye!” 56Jokuɛ ɔ fɔli ɔmɛ a he mi po, se Yesu fa mɛ ke a ko ya de nɔ ko nɔ́ nɛ ba a.

Title: LUKA 9
Content:
Yesu tsɔ kaseli nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ
(Mateo 10.5-15; Marko 6.7-13)
1Yesu tsɛ ni nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ kɛ kpe, nɛ e ha mɛ he wami nɛ a kɛ hia mumi yayamihi tsuo, nɛ a kɛ tsa hiɔhi hulɔ. 2Kɛkɛ nɛ e tsɔ mɛ ke a ho nɛ a ya fiɛ Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ he munyu ɔ, nɛ a tsa hiɔtsɛmɛ. 3 Loko a ho ɔ, Yesu de mɛ ke, “Nɛ nyɛ yaa nɛ ɔ, nyɛ ko hɛɛ nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko kɛ to dɛ. Nyɛ ko hɛɛ dɛma tso, aloo blɔ hialɔ kotoku, aloo niye ní, aloo sika; tade enyɔne tete po nyɛ ko hɛɛ. 4We tsuaa we mi nɛ nyɛ maa ya a, nyɛɛ hi lejɛ ɔ kɛ yaa si nyɛ maa je ma a mi. 5Ke nyɛ ya he ko nɛ a he we nyɛ atuu ɔ, loko nyɛ maa je ma a mi ɔ, nyɛ blɛ nyɛ nane sisi zu kɛ pue si kɛ to mɛ okadi kaa a maa gbla a tue.”
6Kaseli ɔmɛ pue nɔ kɛ ho, nɛ a ya fiɛ manye munyu ɔ kɛ kpa kɔpe ɔmɛ tsuo, nɛ a tsa hiɔtsɛmɛ ngɛ he tsuaa he.
Herode jija
(Mateo 14.1-12; Marko 6.14-29)
7 Benɛ Herode, amlaalo nɔkɔtɔma nɛ hyɛɛ Galilea nɔ ɔ nu níhi nɛ ngɛ nɔ yae ɔ a he ɔ, e jija; ejakaa ni komɛ ngɛ dee ke Yohane nɔ sɔlelɔ ɔ nɛ a tle si kɛ je gbeje. 8Ni komɛ hu ngɛ dee ke Eliya lɛ ba; nɛ ni komɛ hu ke blema gbali ɔmɛ eko lɛ kpale ba wami mi ekohu. 9Se Herode ke, “Yohane ɔ, i po e yi. Se i ngɛ nyakpɛ níhi nue ngɛ nyumu nɛ ɔ lɛɛ e he. Mɛnɔ ji lɛ?” Nɛ e hla kaa e maa na Yesu.
Yesu ha nyumuhi akpe enuɔ niye ní
(Mateo 14.13-21; Marko 6.30-44; Yohane 6.1-14)
10Bɔfo ɔmɛ kpale a se kɛ ba, nɛ a ba sɛɛ níhi tsuo nɛ a ya pee ɔ ngɔ ha Yesu. Jehanɛ ɔ, e kɛ mɛ pɛ pue nɔ kɛ ho ma ko nɛ a tsɛɛ Betsaida a ya. 11Benɛ nimli kpekpemi ɔ nu he ɔ, a bu kɛ nyɛɛ e se. E he mɛ hɛmuɔ, nɛ e kɛ mɛ tu Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ he munyu; nɛ e tsa nihi nɛ tsami he hia mɛ.
12Gbɔkuɛ nya si haa a, kaseli nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ ba e ngɔ, nɛ a ba de lɛ ke, “Hyɛ, ngapa lɛ wa ngɛ nɛ ɔ nɛ! Wo ni ɔmɛ blɔ kɛ ya kɔpehi, kɛ ma amɛ nɛ bɔle wɔ nɛ ɔ a mi, konɛ a ya hla niye ní kɛ hwɔ he.”
13Se Yesu de mɛ ke, “Nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ ha mɛ nɔ́ ko nɛ a ye.”
A he nɔ ke, “Abolo enuɔ, kɛ lo enyɔ pɛ wa ngɛ. Wa tsa be nyɛe ma ya he niye ní ba ha ma kpekpemi nɛ ɔ tsuo!” 14Nyumuhi kɛkɛ maa su akpe enuɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.
Yesu de e kaseli ɔmɛ ke, “Nyɛ ha nɛ ni ɔmɛ nɛ a hi si ngɛ kuuhi a mi, nihi maa pee nyingmi enuɔ ngɛ kuu tsuaa kuu mi.”
15Kaseli ɔmɛ pee ja, nɛ a ha nɛ ni ɔmɛ tsuo hi si. 16Kɛkɛ nɛ Yesu kukuɔ abolo enuɔ, kɛ lo enyɔ ɔ, nɛ e hyɛ hiɔwe, nɛ e gbaa nɔ, nɛ e ku mi, nɛ e kɛ ha e kaseli ɔmɛ, konɛ mɛ hu a dla ngɔ ha ma kpekpemi ɔ. 17Mɛ tsuo a ye, nɛ a tɔ, nɛ kaseli ɔmɛ bua bibliwi nɛ piɛ ɔ nya ngɔ wo kusii nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ mi.
Petro ye odase ke Yesu ji Kristo ɔ nɛ
(Mateo 16.13-19; Marko 8.27-29)
18Ligbi ko benɛ Yesu nɔ kake too ngɛ sɔlee ɔ, kaseli ɔmɛ ba e ngɔ. E bi mɛ ke, “Ni ɔmɛ deɔ ke mɛnɔ ji mi?”
19 A he nɔ ke, “Ni komɛ ke Yohane nɔ sɔlelɔ ɔ ji mo; ni komɛ ke Eliya, nɛ ni komɛ hu ke blema gbali ɔmɛ eko lɛ a tle si.”
20 E bi mɛ ke, “Se nyɛɛ lɛɛ kɛ nyɛ deɔ kɛɛ?” Petro he nɔ ke, “Mo ji Mawu we Kristo ɔ nɛ.”
Yesu tu e amanehlu kɛ e gbenɔ he munyu
(Mateo 16.20-28; Marko 8.30—9.1)
21Kɛkɛ nɛ Yesu bɔ mɛ kɔkɔ ke a ko ya de nɔ ko nɔ ko. 22E de mɛ hulɔ ke, “Ja Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ na amanehlu babauu, nɛ ma nimeli ɔmɛ, kɛ osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ, kɛ mlaa tsɔɔli ɔmɛ kua lɛ. A maa gbe lɛ, se ligbi etɛ se ɔ, Mawu ma tle lɛ si ekohu.”
23 Jehanɛ ɔ, e de ni ɔmɛ tsuo ke, “Ke nɔ ko suɔ kaa e maa nyɛɛ ye se ɔ, e kua e he, nɛ e hɛɛ e sɛumi tso ɔ daa ligbi kɛ nyɛɛ ye se. 24 Ejakaa nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ suɔ kaa e baa e klaa yi ɔ, e maa laa lɛ; se nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ laa e klaa ngɛ ye he ɔ, e maa na lɛ ekohu. 25Mɛni se nɔmlɔ ma na, ke e nine su je ɔ tsuo nɔ, nɛ lɛ nitsɛ e hɛ mi kpata a? 26Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ imi, kɛ ye munyu ɔ, wa he peeɔ lɛ zo ɔ, lɛ hu e he maa pee Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ zo benɛ e maa ba ngɛ lɛ nitsɛ e hɛ mi nyami ɔ mi, kɛ e Tsɛ nɔ́ ɔ, kɛ bɔfo klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ a nɔ́ ɔ mi. 27I ngɛ nyɛ dee anɔkuale mi ke, ni komɛ ngɛ nihi nɛ daa si ngɛ hiɛ ɔ a kpɛti nɛ a be gboe, kɛ yaa su be nɛ Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ maa ba.”
Yesu nɔmlɔ tso su tsake
(Mateo 17.1-8; Marko 9.2-8)
28 Benɛ Yesu tu munyu nɛ ɔmɛ maa pee ligbi kpaanyɔ se ɔ, e ngɔ Petro, Yohane, kɛ Yakobo kɛ ho yoku ko nɔ ya nɛ e ya sɔle. 29Benɛ e ngɛ sɔlee ɔ, e hɛ mi tsake, nɛ e tade ɔ hiɛ futaa, nɛ e ngɛ kpɛe klãiklãi. 30Tlukaa a, nyumuhi enyɔ ba lejɛ ɔ, nɛ a kɛ lɛ ba tu munyu. Mɛ ji Mose kɛ Eliya. 31A ba kɛ hɛ mi nyami, nɛ a kɛ Yesu ba tu munyu nɛ kɔɔ gbenɔ nɛ e yaa gbo ngɛ Yerusalem ɔ he. 32Be nɛ ɔ mi tsuo ɔ, mahe gbe Petro kɛ e huɛmɛ ɔmɛ. Se benɛ a hɛ tsɛ̃ ɔ, a na Yesu hɛ mi nyami ɔ, kɛ nyumuhi enyɔ ɔmɛ nɛ daa si ngɛ e kasa nya a. 33Benɛ nyumu ɔmɛ ngɛ Yesu sie ɔ, Petro de lɛ ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, e hi kaa wa ngɛ hiɛ ɔ! Wa maa ma bo tsu etɛ, o nɔ́ kake, Mose nɔ́ kake, kɛ Eliya hu nɔ́ kake.” (Se e li nɔ́ nɛ e ngɛ dee tete).
34Benɛ e ngɛ munyu ɔ tue kɛ mwɔɔ ɔ, bɔku ko ba ha a nɔ, nɛ kaseli ɔmɛ ye gbeye. 35 Kɛkɛ nɛ Mawu tu munyu kɛ je bɔku ɔ mi ke, “Ye Bi nɛ i hla ji nɛ ɔ nɛ; nyɛɛ bu lɛ tue!”
36Benɛ munyu ɔ se po ɔ, Yesu nɔ kake too lɛ daa si ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Kaseli ɔmɛ ma a nya ngɔ to nɔ́ nɛ a na nɛ ɔ nɔ, nɛ a kɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko sɛɛ we he ní jamɛ a be ɔ mi.
Yesu hia mumi yayami ngɛ jokuɛ nyumuyo ko mi
(Mateo 17.14-18; Marko 9.14-27)
37E nɔ jena a, Yesu kɛ e kaseli etɛ ɔmɛ kple yoku ɔ, nɛ nihi fuu kɛ lɛ ba kpe. 38Kɛkɛ nɛ nyumu ko kpa ngmlaa kɛ je ni ɔmɛ a kpɛti, nɛ e de ke, “Tsɔɔlɔ! I kpa mo pɛɛ, hyɛ ye binyumu ɔ, ye bi kake too ɔ! 39Ke pee ɔ, mumi yayami maa ba e nɔ, nɛ e ma kpa ngmlaa si kake too. Kɛkɛ mumi ɔ ma ha nɛ e ma lua gaganii, nɛ e nya maa fia hwɔli. Mumi ɔ maa hi jokuɛ nɛ ɔ nɔ́ yeyee pee hluu nɛ he jɔmi be mi. 40I kpa o kaseli ɔmɛ pɛɛ ke a hia mumi yayami ɔ, se a nyɛ we.”
41Yesu he nɔ nɛ e de ke, “Oo yi nɔ bi nɛ be hemi kɛ yemi nɛ a kplɛɛ we tsakemi, mɛni be i kɛ nyɛ maa hi si kɛ yaa si?” Kɛkɛ nɛ e de nyumu ɔ ke, “O kɛ o bi ɔ nɛ ba hiɛ ɔ!”
42Benɛ jokuɛ ɔ ma a, mumi yayami ɔ po lɛ fɔ si, nɛ e ha e lua gaganii. Se Yesu nga mumi ɔ yi, nɛ e tsa jokuɛ ɔ, nɛ e ngɔ lɛ ngɔ ha e tsɛ ɔ ekohu. 43Mawu he wami kpetekpleenyɛ nɛ je kpo nɛ ɔ ha nɛ ni ɔmɛ tsuo a he mi po.
Yesu tu e gbenɔ he munyu ekohu
(Mateo 17.22-23; Marko 9.30-32)
Benɛ ni ɔmɛ a hɛ mi pee mɛ yaa ngɛ níhi tsuo nɛ Yesu ngɛ pee ɔ a he ɔ, e de e kaseli ɔmɛ ke, 44“Nɔ́ nɛ ma de nyɛ nɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ bu tue saminya! A maa ngɔ Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ kɛ wo nihi nɛ he wa a dɛ mi.” 45Se kaseli ɔmɛ nui nɔ́ nɛ e de ɔ sisi. A ngɔ kɛ laa mɛ, konɛ a ko nu sisi; nɛ mɛ hu a ngɛ gbeye yee kaa a ma bi lɛ munyu ɔ he nɔ́ ko.
Mɛnɔ ji nɔmlɔ nguaa pe kulaa?
(Mateo 18.1-5; Marko 9.33-37)
46 Jehanɛ ɔ, kaseli ɔmɛ ba bɔni nya sami kaa a kpɛti mɛnɔ ji nɔmlɔ nguaa pe kulaa. 47Benɛ Yesu na a juɛmi ɔ, e ngɔ jokuɛ nyafii ko ba da e kasa nya, 48 nɛ e de mɛ ke, “Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ma he jokuɛ nyafii nɛ ɔ atuu ngɛ ye biɛ mi ɔ, imi e he atuu ɔ nɛ; nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ heɔ mi atuu ɔ, nɔ nɛ tsɔ mi ɔ lɛ e he atuu ɔ nɛ. Ejakaa nɔ nyafii pe kulaa ngɛ nyɛ tsuo nyɛ kpɛti ɔ, lɛ ji nɔmlɔ nguaa pe kulaa.”
Nɔ nɛ ti si wui nyɛ ɔ, e piɛ nyɛ he
(Marko 9.38-40)
49Yohane de ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, wa na nyumu ko nɛ ngɔ o biɛ kɛ ngɛ mumi yayami hiae, nɛ wa de lɛ ke e kpa, ejakaa pi e kɛ wɔ nɛ ngɛ nyɛɛe.”
50Se Yesu de lɛ ke, “Nyɛ ko tsi lɛ blɔ; ejakaa nɔ nɛ ti si wui nyɛ ɔ, e piɛ nyɛ he.”
Samaria kɔpe ko he we Yesu
51Benɛ be ɔ nɛ a maa ngɔ Yesu kɛ je je nɛ ɔ mi kɛ ya hiɔwe ɔ su ta a, e muɔ e yi mi kpɔ kaa e maa ya Yerusalem. 52E tsɔ nihi kɛ sɛ e hlami kɛ ya Samaria kɔpe ko mi, konɛ a ya dla he ko ngɔ to lɛ. 53Se ni ɔmɛ he we lɛ, ejakaa a na kaa Yesu pee e yi mi kaa e yaa Yerusalem. 54 Benɛ e kaseli Yakobo, kɛ Yohane nu he ɔ, a bi lɛ ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, o suɔ kaa wa de nɛ la nɛ je hiɔwe ba sã mɛ lo?”
55Se Yesu plɛ e he, nɛ e ka a hɛ mi. 56Kɛkɛ nɛ e kɛ e kaseli ɔmɛ tsuo pue nɔ kɛ ho kɔpe kpa mi ya.
Ni komɛ nɛ hla kaa a maa nyɛɛ Yesu se
(Mateo 8.19-22)
57Benɛ a yaa ngɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ ɔ, nyumu ko ba de Yesu ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, ma nyɛɛ o se kɛ ya he tsuaa he nɛ o yaa.”
58Se Yesu de lɛ ke, “Kɔkɔbohi ngɛ muɔhi, nɛ lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ hu ngɛ tsuhi; se Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ lɛɛ e be he ko nɛ e kɛ e yi fɔɔ.”
59E de nɔ kpa ke, “Ba nyɛɛ ye se!”
Se lɛɛ e de ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, ha mi blɔ nɛ ma ya pu tsaatsɛ lolo.”
60Yesu de lɛ ke, “Ha nɛ ni gbogboehi nɛ a pu mɛ nitsɛmɛ a ni gbogboehi. Se moo lɛɛ yaa nɛ o ya fiɛ Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ he sane ɔ.”
61 Nyumu kpa ko hu de ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, ma nyɛɛ o se. Se ha mi blɔ nɛ i kɛ ye we ku hi ya ye sɛ lolo.”
62Se Yesu de lɛ ke, “Nɔ nɛ kɛ e nine pɛtɛɛ na kpakplaa he, nɛ e plɛɛ hyɛɛ e se ɔ, e sɛ Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ.”

Title: LUKA 10
Content:
Yesu tsɔ nihi nyingmi kpaago kɛ enyɔ
1Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ hla nihi nyingmi kpaago kɛ enyɔ kpa hu, nɛ e tsɔ mɛ enyɔɔnyɔ kɛ sɛ e hlami kɛ ya ma tsuaa ma mi, kɛ he tsuaa he nɛ lɛ nitsɛ e maa ya a. 2 E de mɛ ke, “Ngmɔ ɔ ba ní saminya, se nihi nɛ ma bua nya a, a he pi. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ kpa ngmɔtsɛ ɔ pɛɛ, nɛ e tsɔ nihi kɛ ba ngmɔ ɔ nɔ, nɛ a ba bua ní nya. 3 Nyɛɛ ya! Hyɛ, i ngɛ nyɛ tsɔe kaa jijɔhi kɛ yaa ogbeteehi a kpɛti. 4 Nyɛ ko hɛɛ sika kpɛɛ, loo ní balɔ kotoku, loo tokota; nyɛ ko puɛ be kɛ hi nihi ngae ngɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ. 5We tsuaa we mi nɛ nyɛ maa sɛ ɔ, kekleekle ɔ, nyɛ de ke, ‘Manye oo manye!’ 6Ke nɔ ko nɛ suɔ tue mi jɔmi ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, manye nɛ nyɛ ha lɛ ɔ nɛ hi e nɔ. Se ke nɔ ko kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ be ɔ, lɛɛ nyɛɛ kpale nyɛ nya se. 7 Nyɛɛ hi jamɛ a we ɔ mi nɔuu. Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ a ha nyɛ ke nyɛɛ ye ɔ, nyɛɛ ye, nɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ a ha nyɛ ke nyɛɛ nu ɔ, nyɛɛ nu; ejakaa ní tsulɔ ɔ, e hiɔwo sa lɛ. Nyɛ ko klɛ̃ kɛ je we kake mi kɛ ya we kake mi. 8Ma tsuaa ma nɛ nyɛ maa ya mi, nɛ a ma he nyɛ atuu ɔ, nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ a kɛ maa ma nyɛ hɛ mi ɔ, nyɛɛ ye. 9Nyɛ tsa hiɔtsɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ ma a mi, nɛ nyɛ de ni ɔmɛ tsuo ke, ‘Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ na nyɛ ta.’ 10 Se ma tsuaa ma nɛ nyɛ maa ya mi, nɛ a he we nyɛ atuu ɔ, nyɛɛ ya gbɛjegbɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ nɛ nyɛ ya de ke, 11‘Nyɛ ma nɛ ɔ mi bunyuku tete nɛ ngɛ wa nane he ɔ, wa ngɛ blɛe kɛ ngɛ nyɛ nɔ puee. Se kɛ̃ ɔ, nyɛ na nɛ nyɛɛ le kaa Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ na nyɛ ta!’ 12 I ngɛ nyɛ dee ke, kojomi ligbi ɔ, Mawu maa na Sodom mɔbɔ kulaa pe jamɛ a ma a!”
Mahi nɛ he we Yesu yi ɔ
(Mateo 11.20-24)
13 “Musu tloo mo, Korazin! Mo Betsaida hu, musu tloo mo! Nyakpɛ níhi nɛ a pee ngɛ nyɛ mi ɔ, Tiro, kɛ Sidon nɛ a tsu ngɛ jinɛ nihi nɛ ngɛ ma nɛ ɔmɛ a mi ɔ ko bu kpekpe ya bo momoomo kɛ hi si ngɛ la zu mi kɛ tsɔɔ kaa a tsake a tsui! 14Kojomi ligbi ɔ, Mawu maa na Tiro, kɛ Sidon mɔbɔ kulaa pe nyɛ. 15 Nɛ mo Kapernaum! Tse o hla kaa o ma wo o he nɔ kɛ ya hiɔwe lokoo! Yoo, a maa ngɔ mo ngɔ fia si, nɛ o hɛ mi ma kpata!”
16 Yesu de e kaseli ɔmɛ ke, “Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa bu nyɛ tue ɔ, imi tue e bu ɔ nɛ; nɔ nɛ ma kua nyɛ ɔ, imi e kua a nɛ. Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ma kua mi ɔ, e kua nɔ nɛ tsɔ mi ɔ.”
Ni nyingmi kpaago kɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ kpale kɛ ba
17Ni nyingmi kpaago kɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ kpale kɛ ba kɛ bua jɔmi babauu. A ba de ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, mumi yayamihi tete bu wɔ tue benɛ waa kɛ o biɛ hia mɛ ɔ!”
18Yesu he nɔ ke, “I na Satan nɛ je hiɔwe ba nɔ si kaa oslabai nɛ tsɔ. 19 Nyɛɛ bu tue! I ha nyɛ he wami nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ maa naa sinɔhi, kɛ nyingmogblakotohi a nɔ. Nyɛ maa ye he nyɛlɔ ɔ he wami ɔ tsuo nɔ, nɛ nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko be nyɛ pee. 20Se, nyɛ ko na bua jɔmi kaa mumi yayami ɔmɛ buɔ nyɛ tue; nyɛ bua nɛ jɔ mohu kaa a ngma nyɛ biɛ ngɛ hiɔwe.”
