A maa je sisi kɛ je Yerusalem. 48Nyɛ ji kikɛmɛ a ní nɛ ɔmɛ a he odase yeli, 49 nɛ ma ha Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ maa ba nyɛ nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ Tsaatsɛ wo si ɔ. Se nyɛɛ hi Yerusalem ma a mi kɛ yaa si he wami nɛ je hiɔwe ɔ maa ba nyɛ nɔ.”
A ngɔ Yesu kɛ ho hiɔwe ya
(Marko 16.19-20; Ni Tsumi 1.9-11)
50 Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Yesu ngɔ mɛ kɛ je ma a mi kɛ ho Betania ya; nɛ e wo e ninehi a nɔ, nɛ e gbaa mɛ. 51Benɛ e ngɛ mɛ gbae ɔ, e je a he, [nɛ a ngɔ lɛ kɛ ho hiɔwe ya. 52Kɛkɛ nɛ a ja lɛ,] nɛ a kpale a se kɛ ho Yerusalem ya kɛ bua jɔmi babauu. 53Daa nɛ ɔ, o maa na mɛ ngɛ sɔlemi we ɔ nɛ a ngɛ Mawu yi jee.

Title: YOHANE NYA TSƆƆMI
Content:
NYA TSƆƆMI
Yohane Sane Kpakpa a tsɔɔ kaa Yesu ji Mawu Munyu nɛ ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene ɔ nɛ. Munyu ɔ “ba plɛ pee adesa, nɛ e kɛ wɔ hi si.” Womi ɔ nitsɛ tsɔɔ kaa Yohane ngma sane kpakpa nɛ ɔ, konɛ nihi nɛ maa kane ɔ, a he ye kaa Yesu ji Mawu Bi ɔ nɛ a wo si kaa e ma ba kpɔ je ɔ; nɛ ke a he Yesu ye ɔ, a ma he a yi wami (20.31).
Sisije ɔ, womi ɔ tsɔɔ nya kpiti kaa Yesu ji Mawu Munyu ɔ nɛ ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene ɔ nɛ. Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e tsɔɔ okadi komɛ nɛ Yesu pee kɛ tsɔɔ kaa lɛ ji kpɔlɔ kɛ Mawu Bi ɔ nɛ a wo si ke e ma ba kpɔ je ɔ nɛ. Jehanɛ ɔ, okadihi nɛ e to ni ɔmɛ ɔ, e tsɔɔ nya. Womi ɔ tsɔɔ kaa ni komɛ he Yesu ye, nɛ a nyɛɛ e se; se ni komɛ te si ngɔ si lɛ, nɛ a he we lɛ yi. Yi 13-17 ɔ tsɔɔ suɔmi agbo nɛ Yesu je kpo tsɔɔ e se nyɛɛli ɔmɛ jamɛ a nyɔ ɔ mi nɛ a nu lɛ ɔ, kɛ he wami womi munyuhi nɛ e tu mɛ loko a sɛu lɛ. Womi ɔ nyagbe ɔ tsɔɔ kaa a nu Yesu, nɛ a kojo lɛ; a sɛu lɛ, nɛ e gbo; se e kpale kɛ ba wami mi ekohu, nɛ e je e he si tsɔɔ e se nyɛɛli ɔmɛ si abɔ.
A kɛ yo nɛ ngɛ ajuama bɔe nɛ a nu lɛ ɔ he sane ɔ (8.1-11) wo kla mi, ejakaa e be blema womi kpohi fuu, kɛ ní nɛmɛ nɛ a tsɔɔ sisi ɔ ekomɛ a mi. Nɛ ní nɛmɛ a mi nɛ e ngɛ ɔ pohu, he kpahi a kɛ wo.
Yohane ma nɔ mi veveeve kaa Kristo nɔ a gu ngɔ neneene wami ngɔ ha je ɔ. Nihi nɛ ngɔɔ nɔ kaa Yesu ji blɔ ɔ, anɔkuale ɔ, kɛ wami ɔ, mɛ a naa kikɛmɛ a nɔke nɔ́ nɛ ɔ. Yohane ngɔɔ je mi si himi mi níhi kɛ toɔ nɔ́ he kɛ tsɔɔ mumi mi níhi a nya saminya. Ní nɛ ɔmɛ ekomɛ ji nyu, abolo, la, to hyɛlɔ kɛ e tohi, kɛ wai tso kɛ e yiblii.
Bɔ nɛ a dla womi ɔ mi ha
Sisije munyu 1.1-18
Yohane nɔ sɔlelɔ ɔ, kɛ Yesu kekleekle kaseli ɔmɛ 1.19-51
Yesu ní tsumi 2.1—12.50
Nyagbe be ɔ ngɛ Yerusalem 13.1—19.42
Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ si temi, kɛ e he kpo jemi 20.1-31
Nyagbe munyu: Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ je e he kpo ngɛ Galilea 21.1-25

Title: YOHANE 1
Content:
Munyu nɛ haa nɔ wami
1Loko nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ je sisi ɔ, Munyu ɔ ngɛ momo. Munyu ɔ kɛ Mawu nɛ ngɛ, nɛ Munyu ji ɔ Mawu ngɛ. 2Munyu ɔ kɛ Mawu kɛ je sisije, nɛ 3Munyu ɔ nɔ Mawu gu kɛ pee nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́. Níhi tsuo nɛ a pee ɔ, a si we Munyu ɔ se kɛ pee ekoeko. 4Wami ngɛ Munyu ɔ mi, nɛ wami nɛ ɔ ngɔ la ba ha nimli adesahi. 5La a ngɛ tsoe ngɛ diblii mi, se diblii ɔ nyɛ we lɛ nɛ e gbe gblegbleegble.
6 Mawu tsɔ nɔ ko kɛ ba je ɔ mi. A tsɛɛ lɛ Yohane. 7E ba nɛ e ba ye la a he odase ha nimli adesahi, konɛ mɛ tsuo a he ye. 8Yohane ɔ, pi lɛ ji la a; mohu e ba ye la a he odase. 9La nɛ ɔ ji la nɛ tsoɔ haa nimli adesahi tsuo.
10Munyu ɔ ngɛ je ɔ mi, nɛ e nɔ Mawu gu kɛ bɔ je ɔ, se mohu je ɔ yo we lɛ. 11E ba lɛ nitsɛ e ma mi, se e ma mi bi ɔmɛ he we lɛ. 12Se nihi tsuo nɛ he lɛ atuu, nɛ a he lɛ ye ɔ, e ha mɛ blɔ nya kaa a ba pee Mawu bimɛ. 13A pee mɛ Mawu bimɛ, pi ngɛ he lo nya kaa nyumu fɔɔ bi aloo nɔmlɔ adesa suɔmi nya; Mawu mi a je kɛ fɔ mɛ.
14Munyu ɔ ba plɛ adesa, nɛ e kɛ wɔ hi si. Dloomi kɛ anɔkuale hyi lɛ babauu. Wa na lɛ, nɛ a wo e hɛ mi nyami kaa lɛ pɛ ji Tsɛ ɔ Bi.
15Yohane ye e he odase. E kɛ ngmlaa de ke, “Nɔmlɔ nɛ ɔ he munyu nɛ i tu ke, ‘Nɔ ko ma ngɛ ye se; se e pã mi, ejakaa e ngɛ loko i ngɛ’ ɔ nɛ.”
16E mi mi hi kɛ be nɔ, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e ha wa ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ dloomi nɔtonɔto. 17Mawu ha wɔ mlaa kɛ gu Mose nɔ, se dloomi kɛ anɔkuale gu Yesu Kristo nɔ kɛ ba. 18Mawu ɔ, nɔ ko nɛ lɛ hyɛ. E bi kake too ɔ nɛ hii si ngɛ Tsɛ ɔ hiɔ nɔ ɔ, lɛ nɛ e tsɔɔ wɔ bɔ nɛ Tsɛ ɔ ngɛ ha.
Yohane nɔ sɔlelɔ ɔ fiɛ
(Mateo 3.1-12; Marko 1.1-8; Luka 3.1-18)
19Yuda ma nimeli ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ Yerusalem ɔ tsɔ osɔfo komɛ, kɛ Levi bi komɛ Yohane ngɔ. A ba bi lɛ ke, “Mɛnɔ ji mo?”
20Yohane laa we nɔ́ ko nɔ, se e gba mi paa ke, “Tsa pi imi ji Kristo ɔ.”
21 A bi lɛ ke, “Mɛnɔ ji mo mɔ? Eliya lo?”
Yohane he nɔ ke, “Tsa pi imi ji Eliya.”
A bi lɛ ekohu ke, “Mo ji gbalɔ ɔ lo?”
Yohane he nɔ ke, “Dɛbi!”
22Jehanɛ ɔ, a kpale bi lɛ ke, “Lɛɛ mɛnɔ ji mo mɔ? Tsɔɔ wɔ koo! Ejakaa nihi nɛ tsɔ wɔ ɔ, e hia kaa wa ya ha mɛ heto. Kɛ o deɔ ngɛ mo nitsɛ o he kɛɛ?”
23 Yohane he nɔ ke,
“Imi ji nɔ nɛ ngɛ fiɛe ngɛ nga a nɔ ke,
‘Nyɛ dla blɔ ngɔ to Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ,’
kaa bɔ nɛ gbalɔ Yesaya de ɔ nɛ.”
24Nihi nɛ Farisi bi ɔmɛ tsɔ kɛ ba a 25kpale bi lɛ ke, “Ke pi mo ji Kristo ɔ, pi Eliya ji mo, nɛ pi mo ji gbalɔ ɔ hulɔ ɔ, lɛɛ mɛni he nɛ o ngɛ nihi sɔlee mɔ?”
26Yohane he nɔ ke, “Imi lɛɛ nyu i kɛ ngɛ nyɛ sɔlee; se nɔ ko daa si ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti ngɛ hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ nɛ nyɛ li lɛ. 27I sɛ e hlami kɛ ba mohu, se i sɛ nɔ nɛ pɛneɔ e tokota nya kpa tete po.”
28A pee ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ngɛ Betania, ngɛ Yordan pa a beleku je, he nɛ Yohane ngɛ nihi sɔlee ngɛ ɔ.
Mawu To Bi ɔ
29E nɔ jena a, Yohane na Yesu nɛ ma e ngɔ. Kɛkɛ nɛ e de ke, “Hyɛ, Mawu To Bi ɔ nɛ woɔ je ɔ he yayami kɛ yaa a, lɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. 30Nɔmlɔ nɛ ɔ he nɛ i de ngɛ ke, ‘Nɔ ko ma ngɛ ye se, se e pe mi, ejakaa e ngɛ loko i ngɛ’ ɔ nɛ. 31Imi nitsɛ i li lɛ, se i kɛ nyu ba ngɛ nihi sɔlee, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ Israel ma a nɛ le lɛ.”
32Jehanɛ ɔ, Yohane tu munyu kɛ ye Yesu he odase ke, “I na Mumi ɔ nɛ kple si kɛ je hiɔwe kaa lahuɛ ba ma e nɔ. 33Imi hu jinɛ i li lɛ, se Mawu, nɔ nɛ tsɔ mi ke ma ba sɔle nihi ngɛ nyu mi ɔ lɛ de mi ke, ‘Nɔ nɛ nɔ nɛ Mumi ɔ ma ba ma a, lɛ ji nɔ nɛ maa ngɔ Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ kɛ sɔle nihi.’ 34Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ba mi jã pɛpɛɛpɛ nɛ i na, lɔ ɔ he nɛ i ngɛ odase yee ke Yesu ji Mawu Bi ɔ nɛ.”
Yesu tsɛ kekleekle kaseli
35E nɔ jena benɛ Yohane kɛ e kaseli ɔmɛ a ti ni enyɔ daa si ekohu ɔ, 36e na Yesu nɛ bee. Kɛkɛ nɛ Yohane de ke, “Ne Mawu To Bi ɔ!”
37Amlɔ nɔuu nɛ kaseli enyɔ ɔmɛ nu munyu nɛ ɔ, a ya nyɛɛ Yesu se kɛ yaa. 38Benɛ Yesu plɛ e he, nɛ e na kaa kaseli ɔmɛ nyɛɛ e se ɔ, e bi mɛ ke, “Mɛni nyɛ ngɛ hlae?”
A he nɔ ke, “Tsɔɔlɔ, jije o hii?”
39Yesu he nɔ ke, “Nyɛɛ ba nɛ nyɛ ba hyɛ.” (Jamɛ a be ɔ, a fia gbɔkuɛ ngmlɛ eywiɛ). Kɛkɛ nɛ a kɛ lɛ pue nɔ kɛ ho, nɛ a ya na e hi he ɔ; nɛ a kɛ lɛ hi si kɛ ya si du bu.
40Kaseli enyɔ ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake biɛ ji Andrea, Simon Petro nyɛmi ɔ. 41E kɛ we kulaa nɛ Andrea kɛ e nyɛmi Simon ba kpe. Andrea de Simon ke, “Wa na Mesia a.” (Mesia sisi ji Kristo). 42Kɛkɛ nɛ e ngɔ Simon kɛ ya Yesu ngɔ.
Yesu hyɛ Simon too, nɛ e de lɛ ke, “Tse mo ji Yohane bi Simon ɔ. Jehanɛ lɛɛ a ma tsɛ mo Kefa.” (E sisi ji Petro, loo tɛ sa.)
Yesu tsɛ Filipo kɛ Natanael
43E nɔ jena a, Yesu to e yi mi kaa e maa ya Galilea. Kɛkɛ nɛ e kɛ Filipo kpe, nɛ e de lɛ ke, “Filipo, nyɛɛ ye se.” 44Filipo je Betsaida, ma mi he nɛ Andrea kɛ Petro hu je ɔ. 45Benɛ Filipo hu kɛ Natanael ya kpe ɔ, Filipo de lɛ ke, “Natanael, hyɛ, nɔmlɔ ɔ nɛ Mose ngma e he sane ngɛ mlaa womi ɔ mi, nɛ gbali ɔmɛ hu tu e he munyu ɔ, wa na lɛ. Lɛ ji Yosef bi Yesu nɛ je Nazaret ɔ.”
46Se Natanael bi Filipo ke, “Anɛ nɔ́ kpakpa ko maa je Nazaret lo?”
Filipo he nɔ ke, “Ba nɛ o ba hyɛ!”
47Benɛ Yesu na Natanael nɛ ma e ngɔ ɔ, e de ke, “Israel no ngmingmiingmi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ; sé ko be e he.”
48Natanael bi Yesu ke, “Jije o le mi ngɛ?”
Yesu he nɔ ke, “I na mo pi mwɔnɛ; i na mo ngɛ ngmɔkɔ tso ɔ sisi tɔɔ loko Filipo tsɛ mo.”
49Natanael kpale he nɔ ke, “Tsɔɔlɔ, niinɛ, mo ji Mawu Bi ɔ! Mo ji Israel matsɛ ɔ nɛ!”
50Jehanɛ ɔ, Yesu bi Natanael ke, “Akɛnɛ i de mo ke i na mo ngɛ ngmɔkɔ tso ɔ sisi ɔ, lɔ ɔ he nɛ o he ye ɔ? O maa na ní nguahi nɛ pe enɛ ɔ.” 51 Nyagbe ɔ, e de mɛ ke, “I ngɛ nyɛ dee anɔkuale mi ke hiɔwe nya ma bli, nɛ nyɛ maa na Mawu bɔfo ɔmɛ nɛ a ngɛ kuɔe kɛ ngɛ imi Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ ye ngɔ bae, nɛ a ngɛ kpalee kɛ ngɛ yae.”

Title: YOHANE 2
Content:
A kpee yo ngɛ Kana
1E nɔ ligbi etɛ ɔ, a kpee yo ngɛ Galilea ma nɛ a tsɛɛ Kana a. Yesu nyɛ ya lejɛ ɔ; 2nɛ a fɔ Yesu kɛ e kaseli ɔmɛ hu nine kɛ ya yo kpeemi ɔ. 3Be saii mi ɔ, wai nɛ a ngɛ nue ɔ ta; nɛ Yesu nyɛ ba e ngɔ ba de lɛ ke, “Ni ɔmɛ a wai ɔ ta.”
4Se Yesu he nɔ ke, “Maa, mɛni he je o ngɛ ye nya dooe? Be nɛ ma tsu ní ɔ sui lolo.”
5Jehanɛ ɔ Yesu nyɛ de tsɔli ɔmɛ ke, “Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ e ma de nyɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ pee.”
6Yuda bi a kusumi ji a fɔ a he nɛ a kɛ tsú a he. Enɛ ɔ he ɔ, didɔ ekpa maa si ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Didɔ nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, eko tsuaa eko yeɔ nyu lita lafa. 7Yesu de tsɔli ɔmɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ wo didɔ ɔmɛ a mi nyu nɛ a hyi.” A pee jã. 8Jehanɛ ɔ, e de tsɔli ɔmɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ yɛ eko ya ha nɔ nɛ ngɛ ní tsumi ɔ nɔ hyɛe ɔ.” A yɛ nyu 9nɛ plɛ pee wai ɔ ya ha nɔ nɛ ngɛ ní tsumi ɔ nɔ hyɛe ɔ, nɛ e sa e nya. Tsɔli ɔmɛ nɛ wo didɔ ɔmɛ a mi nyu ɔ le he nɛ wai nɛ ɔ je; se ní tsumi ɔ nɔ hyɛlɔ ɔ lɛɛ e li. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e tsɛ ayɛflo huno ɔ, 10nɛ e de lɛ ke, “Ke a tsɛ ní yemi ɔ, wai kpakpa a kɛ ba maa si kekle; nɛ ke ni ɔmɛ nu bɔ nɛ a ma nyɛ ɔ loko a kɛ nɔ́ nɛ ngɔɛ ɔ baa. Se moo lɛɛ o ngɔ wai kpakpa a ngɔ to kɛ ba su be nɛ ɔ.”
11Enɛ ɔ ji kekleekle nyakpɛ nɔ́ nɛ Yesu pee ngɛ Kana ngɛ Galilea kɛ to okadi kaa Mawu ha lɛ he wami; nɛ e kaseli ɔmɛ he lɛ ye.
12 Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, Yesu kɛ e nyɛ, kɛ e nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ e kaseli ɔmɛ pue nɔ kɛ ho Kapernaum ya, nɛ a ya hi lejɛ ɔ be bɔɔ.
Yesu ya sɔlemi we ɔ
(Mateo 21.12-13; Marko 11.15-17; Luka 19.45-46)
13 Benɛ Yuda bi ɔmɛ a Hetsɔmi nyami be ɔ su ɔ, Yesu ya Yerusalem. 14E ya sɔlemi we ɔ, nɛ e ya na nihi babauu ngɛ lejɛ ɔ nɛ a ngɛ nahi, tohi, kɛ lahuɛhi juae. Ni komɛ hu hii si ngɛ a we okplɔɔhi a se ngɛ sika tsakee. 15Kɛkɛ nɛ Yesu ngɔ tangme tsɔwi kɛ pee kpa, nɛ e fie jua yeli ɔmɛ, kɛ a to ɔmɛ, kɛ na amɛ tsuo kɛ je sɔlemi we ɔ. E tsitsɛɛ sika tsakeli ɔmɛ a we okplɔɔ ɔmɛ ngɔ fia si, nɛ e plɛ a sika amɛ ngɔ pue si. 16Nihi nɛ ngɛ lahuɛhi juae ɔ, e de mɛ ke, “Nyɛ je ní nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ je hiɛ ɔ esɔ! Tsaatsɛ we ɔ, nyɛ ko ngɔ kɛ pee jua nɔ.” 17 E kaseli ɔmɛ kai kaa a ngma ke, “Ye hɛ dɔ wawɛɛ ngɛ o we ɔ he.”
18Jehanɛ ɔ, Yuda bi ɔmɛ bi Yesu ke, “Mɛni okadi o maa to wɔ kɛ ma nɔ́ nɛ o pee nɛ ɔ nɔ mi?”
19 Yesu he nɔ ke, “Nyɛɛ ku sɔlemi we nɛ ɔ, nɛ ligbi etɛ se ɔ, ma ma lɛ ekohu.”
20A kpale de Yesu ke, “Sɔlemi we nɛ ɔ, jeha nyingmi eywiɛ kɛ ekpa loko a nyɛ ma; se moo lɛɛ o de ke ligbi etɛ o kɛ maa ma lɛ; o ma nyɛ?”
21Se sɔlemi we nɛ Yesu ngɛ he munyu tue ɔ ji lɛ nitsɛ e nɔmlɔ tso. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, benɛ a tle Yesu si kɛ je gbeje ɔ, e kaseli ɔmɛ kai kaa e wo nɔ́ nɛ ɔ nɔ ta de mɛ hyɛ, 22nɛ a he ngmami ɔ, kɛ munyu nɛ Yesu kɛ mɛ tu ɔ tsuo ye.
Yesu le adesa su
23Yesu hi Yerusalem Hetsɔmi nyami be ɔ tsuo. E pee okadihi babauu, nɛ nihi tsuo nɛ na a, a he lɛ ye. 24Se Yesu lɛɛ e le mɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e kɛ e hɛ fɔɛ a nɔ. 25E hia we pohu nɛ nɔ ko nɛ ye nɔmlɔ adesa he odase kɛ tsɔɔ lɛ, ejakaa lɛ nitsɛ e le nɔmlɔ yi mi.

Title: YOHANE 3
Content:
Yesu kɛ Nikodemo
1Yuda bi ɔmɛ a nɔkɔtɔma ko ngɛ nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Nikodemo. Farisi no ji lɛ. 2Nyumu nɛ ɔ ba Yesu ngɔ nyɔ mi, nɛ e ba de lɛ ke, “Tsɔɔlɔ, wa le kaa tsɔɔlɔ nɛ Mawu tsɔ kɛ ba ji mo. Níhi tsuo nɛ o peeɔ ɔ kɛ toɔ okadi ɔ, nɔ ko nɔ ko be nyɛe maa pee, ja Mawu piɛ e he.”
3Yesu he nɔ ke, “I ngɛ mo dee anɔkuale mi ke, ke a ji hiɔwe fɔ we nɔ ko ɔ e be Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ mi sɛe.”
4Nikodemo bi Yesu ke, “Nɔmlɔ nɛ wa a, kɛ maa pee kɛɛ nɛ a ma fɔ lɛ ekohu? Anɛ e ma nyɛ kpale sɛ e nyɛ mi mi nɛ a dla fɔ lɛ nɔ nɛ ji si enyɔ lo?”
5Yesu he nɔ ke, “I ngɛ mo dee anɔkuale mi ke, ke a ji nyu kɛ mumi mi fɔ we nɔ ko ɔ, e be nyɛe maa sɛ matsɛ yemi ɔ mi. 6Adesa lɛɛ adesa kɛkɛ e fɔɔ, se Mumi Klɔuklɔu lɛɛ e fɔɔ nɔ ehe. 7O hɛ mi ko pee mo yaa kaa i de mo ke e hia nɛ a dla fɔ mo ehe. 8Kɔɔhiɔ ɔ, e fiaa kɛ yaa he tsuaa he nɛ e suɔ; o nuɔ e fiami ɔ, se he nɛ e je, kɛ he nɛ e yaa lɛɛ o li. Kikɛ nɛ ɔ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ a je Mumi mi fɔ lɛ ɔ ngɛ.”
9Nikodemo bi Yesu ekohu ke, “Kɛ e maa pee kɛɛ nɛ enɛ ɔ maa ba mi?”
10Yesu he nɔ ke, “Tse tsɔɔlɔ nguaa ji mo ngɛ Israel! Nɛ o li enɛ ɔ? 11I ngɛ mo dee anɔkuale mi ke wɔɔ lɛɛ nɔ́ nɛ wa le ɔ, lɔ ɔ wa deɔ, nɛ wa yeɔ nɔ́ nɛ wa na a he odase. Se nyɛ sume nɛ nyɛɛ ngɔ munyu nɛ wa fiɛ ha nyɛ ɔ. 12Ke i de nyɛ zugba nɛ ɔ nɔ níhi nɛ nyɛ he we yi ɔ, lɛɛ ke i de nyɛ hiɔwe níhi ɔ, kɛ nyɛ maa pee kɛ he ye kɛɛ? 13Nɔ ko yɛ hiɔwe gblee kaa ja Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ, nɔ nɛ je hiɔwe kple si kɛ ba a.”
14 Bɔ nɛ Mose wo sinɔ ɔ nɔ ngɛ nga a nɔ ɔ, jã nɔuu nɛ e sa kaa a wo Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ nɔ, 15konɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ heɔ lɛ yeɔ ɔ, e na neneene wami. 16Ejakaa Mawu suɔ je ɔ saminya, nɛ e ngɔ e Bi kake ɔ ngɔ ha, konɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ heɔ lɛ yeɔ ɔ, e hɛ mi ko kpata, se mohu e na neneene wami. 17Mawu tsɔ we e Bi ɔ kɛ bɛ je ɔ mi nɛ e ba kojo; se mohu e ba, konɛ e ba he nihi a yi wami.
18Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ heɔ Mawu Bi ɔ yeɔ ɔ, a be lɛ fɔ bue; se nɔ nɛ he we yi ɔ, a bu lɛ fɔ momo; ejakaa e he we Mawu Bi kake too ɔ yi. 19Nɔ́ nɛ nɔ nɛ a da kɛ bu mɛ fɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: la a ba je ɔ mi, se adesa suɔ diblii ɔ mohu pe la a, ejakaa a peeɔ yayami. 20Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ peeɔ yayami ɔ, e nyɛɔ la a; nɛ e sume nɛ e baa la a nya, ejakaa e sume nɛ a naa e ní yayami ɔmɛ. 21Se nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ nyɛɛɔ anɔkuale se ɔ, e baa la a nya, konɛ la a nɛ tsɔɔ kaa e peeɔ Mawu suɔmi nya ní.
Yesu kɛ Yohane
22Ní nɛ ɔmɛ a se ɔ, Yesu kɛ e kaseli ɔmɛ ya Yudea. A hi lejɛ ɔ be bɔɔ, nɛ e sɔle nihi. 23Jamɛ a be ɔ, Yohane hu ngɛ nihi sɔlee ngɛ Aenon, ngɛ Salim kasa nya, ejakaa nyu babauu ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Nihi babauu nitsɛnitsɛ ba e ngɔ, nɛ e sɔle mɛ. 24 Jamɛ a be ɔ, a wui Yohane tsu lolo.
25Pee se ɔ, kusumi nɛ a peeɔ kɛ tsuɔ nɔ he ɔ, Yohane kaseli ɔmɛ ekomɛ, kɛ Yuda bi komɛ sã nya ngɛ he. 26Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, kaseli ɔmɛ ba Yohane ngɔ, nɛ a ba bi lɛ ke, “Tsɔɔlɔ, nyumu ɔ nɛ e kɛ mo hi Yordan pa a beleku je nɛ o tu e he munyu ɔ, o kai lɛ lo? Hyɛ, amlɔ nɛ ɔ, nihi babauu ngɛ e ngɔ yae, nɛ e ngɛ mɛ sɔlee.”
27Yohane he nɔ ke, “Nɔ ko be nyɛe ma na nɔ́ ko kaa ja Mawu ha lɛ. 28 Nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ nu nɛ i de paa ke, ‘Pi imi ji Kristo ɔ, se mohu a tsɔ mi kɛ sɛ e hlami’. 29Ayɛflo huno ɔ, e nɔ ji ayɛflo ɔ. Se kɛ̃ ɔ, ayɛflo huno ɔ huɛ nɛ daa si ngɛ e kasa nya a, ke e nu ayɛflo huno ɔ gbi kɛkɛ e bua jɔ. Enɛ ɔ nɛ haa imi hu i naa bua jɔmi babauu. 30E sa kaa e ya nɔ, konɛ imi lɛɛ ma ba si.”
Nɔ nɛ je hiɔwe kɛ ba a
31Nɔ nɛ je hiɔwe kɛ ba a pe nihi tsuo. Nɔ nɛ ngɛ je ɔ mi ɔ, je mi no ji lɛ, nɛ je mi níhi a he munyu e tuɔ. Se nɔ nɛ je hiɔwe ɔ pe nɔ tsuaa nɔ. 32Nɔ́ nɛ e na, kɛ nɔ́ nɛ e nu ɔ, lɔ ɔmɛ a he odase e yeɔ, pohu nɔ ko nɔ ko ngɔɛ e munyu ɔ. 33Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ heɔ e munyu ɔ yeɔ ɔ, yeɔ odase kaa Mawu tuɔ anɔkuale. 34Nɔ nɛ Mawu tsɔ ɔ, Mawu munyu e tuɔ, ejakaa Mawu Mumi hyi lɛ tɔ. 35 Tsɛ ɔ suɔ e Bi ɔ, nɛ e tu nihi tsuo ngɔ wo e dɛ mi. 36Nɔ nɛ heɔ Bi ɔ yeɔ ɔ, e nine su neneene wami ɔ nɔ; se nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ bui Bi ɔ tue ɔ, e be neneene wami nae. Mawu maa gbla e tue mohu.

Title: YOHANE 4
Content:
Yesu kɛ Samaria yo ɔ
1Farisi bi ɔmɛ nu kaa Yesu ngɛ kaseli babauu nae, nɛ e ngɛ nihi babauu sɔlee hu pe Yohane. 2(Anɔkuale mi ɔ, Yesu nitsɛ sɔle we nɔ ko, se e kaseli ɔmɛ mohu lɛ a sɔle nihi.) 3Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, benɛ Yesu nu nɔ́ nɛ a ngɛ dee ngɛ e he ɔ, e je Yudea, nɛ e kpale e se kɛ ho Galilea ya. 4Benɛ e yaa a, e hia kaa e gu Samaria.
5 E ba su Samaria ma ko nɛ a tsɛɛ Sikar a. Lejɛ ɔ kɛ zugba kpɔ nɛ Yakob ngɔ ha e bi Yosef ɔ he kɛ we kulaa. 6Yakob vu ɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Piani ngmlɛ nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔ, Yesu ba su vu ɔ he, nɛ e ya hi si, ejakaa pɔ tɔ lɛ kɛ blɔ nyɛɛmi.
7Kɛkɛ nɛ Samaria yo ko ba nyu yɛmi. Yesu de lɛ ke, “Ha mi nyu ɔ eko nɛ ma nu.” 8(Jamɛ a be ɔ, Yesu kaseli ɔmɛ sɛ ma a mi ya nɛ a yaa he niye ní.)
9 Yo ɔ bi Yesu ke, “Pi Yuda no ji mo lo? Nɛ kɛ pee kɛɛ nɛ o ngɛ imi Samaria no nyu bae nɛ o nu ɔ?” (Yuda bi kɛ Samaria bi yi.)
10Yesu de yo ɔ ke, “Ke o le nɔ́ kpakpa nɛ Mawu haa nɔ, kɛ nɔ nɛ ngɛ mo nyu bae nɛ ɔ, jinɛ mo mohu o maa ba lɛ eko, nɛ lɛɛ e ma ha mo nyu nɛ haa nɔ wami.”
11Yo ɔ de lɛ ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, vu ɔ mi kuɔ, nɛ o be nɔ́ ko hulɔ nɛ o kɛ maa yɛ nyu ɔ. Nyu nɛ haa nɔ wami ɔ, jije o ma ná kɛ je? 12Wa nɛ̃ Yakob nɛ ha wɔ kikɛmɛ a vu nɛ ɔ; nɛ lɛ nitsɛ, kɛ e bimɛ, kɛ e lohwehi tsuo nu e mi nyu. Anɛ o ngɛ hlae nɛ o tsɔɔ kaa moo o pe Yakob ɔ lo?”
13Yesu he nɔ ke, “Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ nuu vu nɛ ɔ mi nyu ɔ eko ɔ, kuma maa ye lɛ ekohu, 14se nɔ nɛ maa nu nyu nɛ imi ma ha lɛ ɔ, kuma be lɛ yee hu gblegbleegble. Ejakaa nyu nɛ ma ha lɛ ɔ ma plɛ nyu hɛngmɛ nɛ baa nyu nɛ haa nɔ wami kɛ yaa neneene ngɛ e mi.”
15Jehanɛ ɔ, yo ɔ de Yesu ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, ha mi kikɛmɛ a nyu nɛ ɔ mɔ, kɛkɛ ɔ, kuma be mi yee hu, nɛ e be hiae po kaa ma ba hiɛ ɔ ba yɛ nyu.”
16Yesu de yo ɔ ke, “Yaa nɛ o ya tsɛ o huno, nɛ o kɛ lɛ nɛ ba hiɛ ɔ.”
17Yo ɔ he nɔ ke, “I be huno.”
Yesu de lɛ ekohu ke, “Ke o de ke o be huno ɔ, o tu anɔkuale. 18O gba nyumuhi enuɔ momo, nɛ nyumu nɛ o kɛ lɛ ngɛ piɔ hu, pi o huno nitsɛnitsɛ ji lɛ. O tu anɔkuale sisiisi.”
19Yo ɔ de Yesu ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, i na kaa gbalɔ ji mo. 20Wa nɛmɛ ja Mawu ngɛ yo nɛ ɔ nɔ, se nyɛ Yuda bi lɛɛ nyɛ ke Yerusalem ji he nɛ sa kaa wa ja Mawu ngɛ.”
21Yesu de lɛ ke, “Maa, he mi nɛ o ye kaa be ma nɛ nyɛ ma ja Tsɛ ɔ, pi yo nɛ ɔ nɔ, nɛ pi Yerusalem hulɔ. 22Nyɛ Samaria bi, nyɛ li nɔ tutuutu nɛ nyɛ jaa a; se wɔ Yuda bi lɛɛ nɔ nɛ wa jaa a, wa le lɛ; ejakaa wɔ nɛ wa ngɔ yi wami hemi kɛ ba. 23Jehanɛ ɔ, be ɔ ma, nɛ Mawu ma ha nihi he wami, konɛ a ja Tsɛ ɔ ngɛ mumi mi kɛ anɔkuale mi kaa bɔ nɛ Tsɛ ɔ nitsɛ suɔ. Pohu be ɔ su momo. 24Mawu ɔ, Mumi ji lɛ, nɛ nihi nɛ jaa lɛ ɔ, ja a ja lɛ ngɛ mumi kɛ anɔkuale mi.”
25Yo ɔ de lɛ ke, “I le kaa Mesia a nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Kristo ɔ ma, nɛ ke e ba a, e maa tsɔɔ wɔ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́.”
26Yesu he nɔ ke, “Imi nɛ i kɛ mo ngɛ munyu ɔ tue ɔ, imi ji Mesia a nɛ.”
27Jamɛ a be ɔ nɔuu ɔ, Yesu kaseli ɔmɛ ba je kpo, nɛ a hɛ mi pee mɛ yaa kaa e kɛ yo ngɛ ní sɛɛe. Se a ti nɔ ko bi we yo ɔ nɔ́ nɛ e ngɛ hlae; nɛ a bi we Yesu hu nɔ́ nɛ e kɛ yo ɔ ngɛ sɛɛe.
28Kɛkɛ nɛ yo ɔ si e paya buɛ ɔ, nɛ e pue nɔ kɛ ho ma a mi ya; nɛ e ya de ma mi bi ɔmɛ ke, 29“Nyɛɛ ba! Nyɛ ba hyɛ nyumu ko nɛ de mi níhi tsuo nɛ i pee hyɛ. Anɛ pi lɛ ji Kristo ɔ lo?” 30Kɛkɛ nɛ ma a tsuo bu kɛ ba Yesu ngɔ.
31Jamɛ a be ɔ, kaseli ɔmɛ bɔni Yesu pɛɛ kpami ke e ba wo e nya mi nɔ́ ko.
32Se e he nɔ ke, “I ngɛ ngma nɛ i yeɔ, se nyɛ li.”
33Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, kaseli ɔmɛ bi a he ke, “Anɛ nɔ ko ba ha lɛ nɔ́ ko nɛ e ye lo?”
34Yesu de mɛ ke, “Ye niye ní ji kaa ma pee nɔ nɛ tsɔ mi ɔ suɔmi nya ní; nɛ́ nɔ́ nɛ e tsɔ mi tsumi ɔ, ma gbe nya. 35Tse nyɛ deɔ ke, ‘E piɛ hlami eywiɛ nɛ a ma kpa ní.’ Se i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke, nyɛɛ hyɛ ngmɔ ɔmɛ a nɔ kɛ kpe, nɛ nyɛ maa na kaa ní ba, nɛ e kpami be su nɛ a ma bua nya. 36Amlɔ nɛ ɔ po ní kpalɔ ɔ ngɛ e hiɔwo nae; e ngɛ ngmɔ ní nya buae kɛ ngɛ wami nɛ ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene ɔ toe, konɛ ní dulɔ ɔ, kɛ ní kpalɔ ɔ tsuo nɛ a bla kɛ nya. 37Enɛ ɔ tsɔɔ kaa nɔ́ ko nɛ a deɔ ke, ‘Nɔ ko duɔ ní, nɛ nɔ ko hu kpaa’ a ngɛ mi niinɛ. 38I tsɔ nyɛ ní kpami ngɛ ngmɔ nɔ he nɛ nyɛ du we nɔ́ ko ngɛ. Ni kpahi tsu ní ɔ, se nyɛ mohu lɛ nyɛ ba na he se.”
39Samaria bi babauu nɛ ngɛ jamɛ a ma a mi ɔ he Yesu ye, ejakaa yo ɔ de mɛ ke, “E de mi níhi tsuo nɛ i pee.” 40Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, benɛ Samaria bi ɔmɛ ba Yesu ngɔ ɔ, a kpa lɛ pɛɛ ke e hi a ngɔ. Nɛ Yesu kɛ mɛ hi lejɛ ɔ ligbi enyɔ.
41Benɛ Yesu fiɛ munyu ɔ, nihi babauu pe kekle ɔ he ye. 42Kɛkɛ nɛ a de yo ɔ ke, “Jehanɛ lɛɛ pi o munyu ɔ nya hu nɛ wa heɔ yeɔ kaa nɔmlɔ nɛ ɔ ji je ɔ yi wami helɔ ɔ, se mohu nɔ́ nɛ wɔ nitsɛmɛ wa nu kɛ wa tue kɛ je lɛ nitsɛ e nya a he.”
Yesu tsa amlaalo nɔkɔtɔma ko binyumu
43Yesu ye ligbi enyɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, nɛ e pue nɔ kɛ ho Galilea ya, 44 ejakaa lɛ nitsɛ e ye odase ke, “A bui gbalɔ ngɛ lɛ nitsɛ e ma mi.” 45 Benɛ e ba su Galilea a, ma a tsuo he lɛ atuu, ejakaa níhi tsuo nɛ e pee ngɛ Yerusalem Hetsɔmi nyami be ɔ, mɛ nitsɛmɛ a ya lejɛ ɔ nɛ a na paa.
46 Jehanɛ ɔ, Yesu kpale kɛ ba Kana ngɛ Galilea, he nɛ e ha nyu plɛ pee wai ngɛ be ko ɔ ekohu. Tsɔlɔ nɔkɔtɔma ko ngɛ Kapernaum nɛ e bi be he wami. 47Benɛ e ná le kaa Yesu je Yudea kɛ ba Galilea a, e ba e ngɔ, nɛ e ba kpa lɛ pɛɛ ke e binyumu miɔ nɛ e ma gbo, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a ho Kapernaum ya nɛ e ya tsa lɛ. 48Se Yesu de lɛ ke, “Blɔɔ ke nyɛ nɛ okadihi, kɛ nyakpɛ níhi ɔ, lɛɛ nyɛ be hee maa ye!”
49Tsɔlɔ ɔ de lɛ ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, ha waa ho esɔ, ke pi ja a, ye bi ɔ ma gbo.”
50Yesu de lɛ ke, “Yaa, o bi ɔ yi na wami.”
Munyu ɔ nɛ Yesu tu nyumu ɔ, e he ye, nɛ e pue nɔ kɛ ho. 51Benɛ e ngɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ kɛ yaa we mi ɔ, e sɔmɔli kɛ lɛ ba kpe; nɛ a de lɛ ke, “O bi ɔ yi na wami.”
52Tsɔlɔ ɔ bi sɔmɔli ɔmɛ ke, “Mɛni be hiɔ ɔ fani ha lɛ ɔ?” A he nɔ ke, “Hiɛ̃ piani ngmlɛ kake be mi nɛ aslã a po ngɛ e nɔ.” 53Kɛkɛ nɛ bitsɛ ɔ kai kaa jamɛ a be ɔ tutuutu nɛ Yesu de lɛ ke e ya, se e bi ɔ yi na wami ɔ nɛ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e kɛ e we ɔ tsuo he Yesu ye.
54Enɛ ɔ ji okadi enyɔne nɛ Yesu pee benɛ e je Yudea kɛ ba Galilea a.

Title: YOHANE 5
Content:
Yesu tsa hiɔtsɛ ko ngɛ taku ko he Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ
1Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Yuda bi ɔmɛ ngɛ nyami ligbi yee ngɛ Yerusalem, nɛ Yesu ya lejɛ ɔ. 2Taku ko kɛ e he kue enuɔ ngɛ To Agbo ɔ nɛ ngɛ Yerusalem ɔ kasa nya. Hebri gbi mi ɔ, a tsɛɛ taku nɛ ɔ Betesda. 3Hiɔtsɛmɛ babauu, hɛ yuyuili, glɔtsɛmɛ, kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ hule pueɔ si tsuo ngɛ kue ɔmɛ a mi. [A ngɛ blɔ hyɛe nɛ a ba klɛ nyu ɔ mi. 4Be komɛ ɔ, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ bɔfo ma kple si ba klɛ nyu ɔ mi; kɛkɛ ɔ, nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ lɛ kekle e ma ya nɔ nyu ɔ mi ɔ, hiɔ tsuaa hiɔ nɛ ngɛ e he ɔ taa amlɔ.] 5Nyumu ko ngɛ lejɛ ɔ nɛ ngɛ hiɔ nue jeha nyingmi etɛ kɛ kpaanyɔ sɔuu. 6Yesu na lɛ nɛ hwɔɔ si, nɛ e le kaa nyumu ɔ na we he wami be babauu. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e bi lɛ ke, “O suɔ nɛ a tsa mo lo?”
7Hiɔtsɛ ɔ he nɔ ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, ke a ba klɛ nyu ɔ mi kikɛ nɛ ɔ, i be nɔ ko nɛ ma wo mi ya fɔ taku ɔ mi. Be tsuaa be ɔ, ke ma su lejɛ ɔ, nɔ kpa sɛ ye hlami ya nɔ mi momo.”
8Yesu de lɛ ke, “Tee si, wo o sa a nɛ o nyɛɛ.” 9Amlɔ nɔuu ɔ, nyumu ɔ he mi wa lɛ; e wo e sa a, nɛ e bɔni nyɛɛmi.
Se Hejɔɔmi ligbi nɛ a tsa hiɔtsɛ ɔ. 10 Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yuda ma nimeli ɔmɛ de nɔ nɛ a tsa lɛ ɔ ke, “Mwɔnɛ ɔ, Hejɔɔmi ligbi; wa mlaa a ngmɛ́ blɔ kaa o hɛɛɔ o sa.”
11E he nɔ ke, “Nɔmlɔ nɛ tsa mi ɔ lɛ de mi ke ma wo ye sa a nɛ ma nyɛɛ.”
12Jehanɛ ɔ, a bi lɛ ke, “Mɛnɔ lɛ de mo ke o pee jã a?”
13Se nɔ nɛ a tsa lɛ ɔ li Yesu; nɛ pohu nihi babauu ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yesu sã e he nɛ e je.
14Pee se ɔ, Yesu ya na nyumu ɔ ngɛ sɔlemi we ɔ, nɛ e de lɛ ke, “Bu tue, amlɔ nɛ ɔ nɛ o na he wami nɛ ɔ, koo pee yayami hu. Ke pi jã a, nɔ́ nɛ maa ba o nɔ ɔ maa pe kekle nɔ́ ɔ.”
15Jehanɛ ɔ, nyumu ɔ pue nɔ kɛ ho nɛ e ya de Yuda ma nimeli ɔmɛ ke Yesu ji nɔ nɛ tsa lɛ ɔ nɛ. 16Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yuda ma nimeli ɔmɛ je hɛ pi Yesu nɛ a bɔni e nya doomi, ejakaa e tsa hiɔtsɛ Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ. 17Yesu de mɛ ke, “Tsaatsɛ ngɛ ní tsue be tsuaa be, nɛ imi hu i ngɛ ní tsue.”
18Nɔ nɛ e de nɛ ɔ mohu ha Yuda ma nimeli ɔmɛ a hɛ dɔ pe kekle ɔ po, nɛ a to kaa ja a gbe lɛ. Ejakaa pi mlaa a nɛ kɔɔ Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ he ɔ kɛkɛ nɛ e tɔ̃; se e de hu ke e tsɛ ji Mawu, nɛ́ tsɔɔ kaa e kɛ Mawu sɔ.
Bi ɔ ngɛ he blɔ
19Jehanɛ ɔ, Yesu ya nɔ nɛ e de mɛ ke, “I ngɛ nyɛ dee anɔkuale mi ke Bi ɔ pee we nɔ́ ko ngɛ lɛ nitsɛ e yi mi tomi nya. Nɔ́ nɛ e na nɛ Tsɛ ɔ ngɛ pee ɔ, lɔ ɔ nɛ e peeɔ. Nɔ́ nɛ Tsɛ ɔ peeɔ ɔ, Bi ɔ hu peeɔ. 20Ejakaa Tsɛ ɔ suɔ Bi ɔ saminya, nɛ e tsɔɔ lɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ lɛ nitsɛ e peeɔ. Jehanɛ ɔ, e maa tsɔɔ Bi ɔ ní nguahi nɛ pe enɛ ɔmɛ tete, nɛ e maa pee nyɛ nyakpɛ. 21Kaa bɔ nɛ Tsɛ ɔ tleɔ gbogboe si, nɛ e ngɔɔ wami woɔ mi ɔ, jã nɔuu Bi ɔ hu haa níhi nɛ e suɔ mɛ ɔ wami. 22Tsɛ ɔ nitsɛ kojo we nɔ ko. E ngɔ jamɛ a he blɔ ɔ tsuo kɛ ha Bi ɔ, konɛ Bi ɔ nɛ kojo nihi. 23Kɛkɛ ɔ, nihi tsuo maa wo Bi ɔ hɛ mi nyami kaa bɔ nɛ a woɔ Tsɛ ɔ hɛ mi nyami ɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ wui imi Bi ɔ, ye hɛ mi nyami ɔ, Tsɛ ɔ nɛ tsɔ mi ɔ hɛ mi nyami e wui ɔ nɛ.
24“I ngɛ nyɛ dee anɔkuale mi ke, nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ buɔ ye munyu tue, nɛ e heɔ nɔ nɛ tsɔ mi ɔ yeɔ ɔ, e nine su neneene wami nɔ. A be lɛ fɔ bue, ejakaa e po mi ngɛ gbenɔ mi kɛ ho wami mi ya. 25I ngɛ nyɛ dee anɔkuale mi ke be ma, pohu e su ta, nɛ gbogboehi maa nu Mawu Bi ɔ gbi, nɛ a maa ba wami mi ekohu. 26Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, kaa bɔ nɛ Tsɛ ɔ ngɛ wami ngɛ e mi ɔ, ja nɔuu e ha e Bi ɔ hu wami. 27Tsɛ ɔ ha Bi ɔ he blɔ kaa e kojo nihi, ejakaa lɛ ji Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ nɛ. 28Nyɛ hɛ mi kó pee nyɛ yaa kaa be maa su nɛ gbogboehi tsuo maa nu Mawu Bi ɔ gbi, 29 nɛ a maa je kpo kɛ je a yɔkɔ ɔmɛ a mi. A ti ni nɛmɛ nɛ pee kpakpa a, a maa te si, nɛ a maa hi si kɛ maa ya neneene; se ni nɛmɛ nɛ pee yayami ɔ lɛɛ a maa te si, konɛ a kojo mɛ.
Yesu he odase yemi
30“I be he blɔ nɛ i peeɔ imi nitsɛ ye yi mi nɔ́ ko. Bɔ nɛ Mawu tsɔɔ mi ke ma kojo ɔ, jã pɛ i peeɔ; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i yeɔ dami sane. Ejakaa i hla we kaa ma pee nɔ́ nɛ imi nitsɛ i suɔ, se mohu Tsaatsɛ nɛ tsɔ mi ɔ suɔmi nya ní i peeɔ.
31“Ke i ye imi nitsɛ ye he odase ɔ, e sɛ kaa a ngɔ nɔ́ nɛ i de ɔ kaa anɔkuale. 32Se mohu nɔ kpa nɛ ngɛ ye he odase yee; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i le kaa anɔkuale e ngɛ tue. 33 Nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ tsɔ kɛ ya Yohane ngɔ, nɛ e ye anɔkuale ɔ he odase. 34Imi lɛɛ i ngɔɛ nɔmlɔ adesa ko odase, se bɔ nɛ pee nɛ a he nyɛ yi wami he je nɛ i ngɛ enɛ ɔ dee. 35Yohane ba kaa la nɛ ngɛ tsoe, nɛ ngɛ kpɛe ha nyɛ. Se be bɔɔ pɛ nɛ nyɛ ná e he bua jɔmi. 36Imi lɛɛ i ngɛ odase nɛ pe Yohane nɔ́ ɔ, ejakaa ní tsumihi nɛ Tsaatsɛ ngɔ ha mi kaa ma tsu ɔ, jamɛ a ní tsumi ɔmɛ nɛ́ i tsuɔ ɔ nɔuu yeɔ ye he odase kaa Tsɛ ɔ lɛ tsɔ mi. 37 Tsɛ ɔ nɛ tsɔ mi ɔ, lɛ nitsɛ e yeɔ ye he odase, se nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ nui e gbi, nɛ nyɛ nɛ lɛ hyɛ hulɔ. 38Nyɛ bui e munyu ɔ, ejakaa imi nɔmlɔ nɛ e tsɔ ɔ, nyɛ he we mi yi. 39Nyɛ hlaa ngmami ɔmɛ a mi, ejakaa nyɛ susuɔ kaa a mi nyɛ ma na neneene wami ngɛ; nɛ lɔ ɔmɛ nɔuu yeɔ ye he odase. 40Se nyɛ sume kaa nyɛ maa ba ye ngɔ, konɛ nyɛ na wami.
41“I hla we nimli a hɛ mi nyami. 42I le nyɛ su, nɛ i le hu kaa Mawu suɔmi be nyɛ mi. 43I ba ngɛ Tsaatsɛ biɛ mi po nyɛ he we mi; se nɔ ko nɛ maa ba ngɛ lɛ nitsɛ e suɔmi nya a lɛɛ nyɛ ma he lɛ. 44Nyɛ nɛ nyɛ hlaa nɛ nihi nɛ je nyɛ yi, se nyɛ bɔɛ mɔde, konɛ nɔ nɛ lɛ nɔ kake pɛ ji Mawu ɔ nɛ wo nyɛ hɛ mi nyami ɔ, kɛ maa pee kɛɛ nɛ nyɛ ma he mi maa ye mɔ? 45Nyɛ ko susu kaa imi lɛ ma po nyɛ nya ngɔ ha Tsaatsɛ. Mose nɛ nyɛ ngɔ nyɛ hɛ kɛ fɔ e nɔ ɔ, lɛ tutuutu ji nɔ nɛ maa po nyɛ nya. 46Kaa nyɛ he Mose ye jinɛ imi hu nyɛ ma he mi maa ye, ejakaa munyuhi nɛ e ngma a, ye he e ngma ngɛ. 47Se nɛ nyɛ bui níhi nɛ e ngma a, kɛ maa pee kɛɛ nɛ nyɛ ma he ye munyu ɔmɛ maa ye mɔ?”

Title: YOHANE 6
Content:
Yesu ha nihi akpe enuɔ niye ní
(Mateo 14.13-21; Marko 6.30-44; Luka 9.10-17)
1Enɛ ɔmɛ a se ɔ, Yesu po Galilea taku ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ Tiberia taku hulɔ ɔ. 2Nimli babauu nyɛɛ e se, ejakaa a na nɛ e tsa hiɔtsɛmɛ kɛ to okadi kaa Mawu Bi ji lɛ. 3Yesu kɛ e kaseli ɔmɛ kuɔ yo ɔ, nɛ a ya hi si. 4Be nɛ Yuda bi ɔmɛ maa ye Hetsɔmi nyami ɔ su ta. 5Yesu wo e yi nɔ, nɛ e na nimli babauu nɛ bu kɛ ma e ngɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e bi Filipo ke, “Jije wa ma he niye ní ngɛ nɛ maa su nimli nɛ ɔmɛ a nya?” 6(Enɛ ɔ po e de gu kɛ hla Filipo juɛmi, ejakaa lɛ nitsɛ e le nɔ́ nɛ e maa pee.)
7Filipo he nɔ ke, “Sika hiɔ lafa enyɔ nya abolo po be mɛ sue nya mi bɔ kakaaka.”
8Kɛkɛ nɛ e kaseli ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kpa hu nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Andrea, Simon Petro nyɛmi ɔ de ke, 9“Jokuɛ nyumuyo ko ngɛ hiɛ ɔ nɛ hɛɛ abolo bɔbɔɛ enuɔ nɛ a kɛ ngma pee, kɛ lo tsɔwi enyɔ, se lɔ ɔmɛ po tsa sui nɔ́ ko kɛ ha ma kpekpemi nɛ ɔ.”
10Jehanɛ ɔ, Yesu de mɛ ke, “Nyɛ ha nɛ ni ɔmɛ nɛ a hi si.” Nga babauu ngɛ lejɛ ɔ tsuo. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ni ɔmɛ tsuo hi si. Nyumu ɔmɛ kɛkɛ a yibɔ maa su akpe enuɔ. 11Yesu kukuɔ abolo ɔ, nɛ e na Mawu si; kɛkɛ nɛ e dla ha ni ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ hii si ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. E dla lo ɔ hu ja nɔuu, nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ ná bɔ nɛ maa su e nya. 12Benɛ mɛ tsuo a ye nɛ a tɔ ɔ, Yesu de kaseli ɔmɛ ke, “Nyɛ bua bibliwi nɛ piɛ ɔ nya nɛ eko kó dã.” 13A pee jã, nɛ abolo bɔbɔɛ enuɔ nɛ a kɛ ngma pee, nɛ a ye piɛ ɔ, bibliwi nɛ a bua nya a hyi kusii nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ.
14Nihi nɛ na okadi nɛ ɔ nɛ Yesu pee ɔ de ke, “Niinɛ, gbalɔ ɔ nɛ ma je ɔ mi ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.” 15Benɛ Yesu na kaa a ngɛ hlae nɛ a nu lɛ pani nya, nɛ a wo lɛ matsɛ ɔ, e sã e he si, nɛ lɛ nɔ kake e je kpoo kɛ kuɔ yo ɔ ekohu.
Yesu nyɛɛ nyu hɛ mi
(Mateo 14.22-33; Marko 6.45-52)
16Benɛ pu maa ho si nɔmi ya a, Yesu kaseli ɔmɛ pue nɔ kɛ ho taku ɔ nya ya. 17A ya sɛ lɛ mi, nɛ a ngɔ a hɛ mi kɛ pi Kapernaum, nɛ a ngɛ taku ɔ poe kɛ yaa. Jehanɛ ɔ du bu, se loloolo ɔ, a nɛ Yesu hɛ mi. 18Jamɛ a be ɔ, kɔɔhiɔ nɛ nya wa ko hia ngɛ pa a nɔ, nɛ oslɔke ngɛ kue hamahama. 19Kaseli ɔmɛ hlui lɛ ɔ kɛ ya saii, maa pee kaa si tomi etɛ, loo eywiɛ; kɛkɛ nɛ a na Yesu nɛ nyɛɛ nyu ɔ hɛ mi kɛ ma, nɛ e miɔ nɛ e su lɛ ɔ he. Sawale nu mɛ, 20se Yesu de mɛ ke, “Nyɛ ko ye gbeye! Imi!” 21A he lɛ kɛ wo lɛ ɔ mi kɛ bua jɔmi; amlɔ ɔ nɔuu ɔ, lɛ ɔ ya sa kpo he he nɛ a yaa a.
Ni ɔmɛ hla Yesu
22E nɔ jena a, ma kpekpemi ɔ nɛ tlɔ taku ɔ se ɔ na kaa lɛ kpa ko be lejɛ ɔ. A le hu kaa Yesu sɛ́ lɛ ɔ mi kɛ kaseli ɔmɛ, se kaseli ɔmɛ pɛ nɛ a pue nɔ kɛ ho. 23Lɛ kpa komɛ je Tiberia ba sa kpo he he nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ na Mawu si, nɛ ma kpekpemi ɔ ye abolo ɔ ngɛ ɔ. 24Benɛ ma kpekpemi ɔ na kaa Yesu be lejɛ ɔ, nɛ a nɛ́ e kaseli ɔmɛ hulɔ ɔ, a wo lɛ ɔmɛ, nɛ a pue nɔ kɛ ho Kapernaum ya ya hla Yesu.
Yesu ji abolo nɛ haa nɔ wami
25Benɛ ni ɔmɛ ba na Yesu ngɛ taku ɔ se ɔ, a bi lɛ ke, “Tsɔɔlɔ, mɛni be o ba hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ?”
26Yesu he nɔ ke, “I ngɛ nyɛ dee anɔkuale mi ke, pi okadihi nɛ nyɛ na a a he nɛ nyɛ ngɛ mi hlae; se mohu abolo ɔ nɛ nyɛ ye nɛ nyɛ tɔ ɔ he nɛ nyɛ ngɛ mi hlae ɔ nɛ. 27Nyɛ ko gbo ngma nɛ puɛɔ ɔ he dengme. Mohu ɔ, nyɛ hla ngma nɛ hii si kɛ yaa neneene. Enɛ ɔ ji nɔ́ nɛ Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ ma ha nyɛ ɔ nɛ, ejakaa Tsɛ Mawu ɔ nɛ hla lɛ.”
28Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a bi Yesu ke, “Kɛ wa maa pee kɛ pee Mawu suɔmi nya ní kɛɛ?”
29Yesu he nɔ́ ke, “Mawu suɔ kaa nyɛ he nɔ nɛ e tsɔ ɔ nyɛɛ ye.”
30A he nɔ nɛ a bi lɛ ke, “Mɛni okadi o maa to wɔ, konɛ wa he mo waa ye? Mɛni o maa pee? 31 Wa nɛmɛ ɔmɛ ye mana ngɛ nga a nɔ. E ngɛ ngmami ɔmɛ a mi ke, ‘E ha abolo je hiɔwe kɛ ba ha mɛ nɛ a ye.’ ”
32Yesu de mɛ ke, “I ngɛ nyɛ dee anɔkuale mi ke nɔ́ nɛ Mose ha nyɛ ɔ, pi lɔ ɔ ji abolo nɛ je hiɔwe ɔ. Tsaatsɛ ji nɔ nɛ haa nyɛ abolo nitsɛnitsɛ nɛ je hiɔwe. 33Mawu we abolo ɔ ji nɔ nɛ je hiɔwe kɛ ba a, nɛ lɛɛ e ma ha je ɔ wami.”
34Jehanɛ ɔ, a de Yesu ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, ha wɔ abolo nɛ ɔ eko daa.”
35Yesu de mɛ ke, “Imi ji abolo nɛ haa nɔ wami ɔ nɛ. Ke nɔ ko ba ye ngɔ ɔ, hwɔ be lɛ yee gblegbleegble; nɛ nɔ nɛ he mi ye ɔ, kuma be lɛ yee gblegbleegble. 36Kaa bɔ nɛ i de nyɛ momo ɔ, nyɛ na mi lɛɛ, se nyɛ he we yi. 37Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ Tsaatsɛ ngɔ ha mi ɔ maa ba ye ngɔ. Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ baa ye ngɔ ɔ, i be lɛ fiee kɔkɔɔkɔ. 38Ejakaa i je hiɔwe kɛ ba nɛ ma ba pee nɔ nɛ tsɔ mi ɔ suɔmi nya ní, se pi imi nitsɛ ye suɔmi nya ní. 39Nɔ nɛ tsɔ mi ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ e suɔ ji kaa nihi tsuo nɛ e tu ngɔ wo ye dɛ mi ɔ, ngmelu kake kó je mi; se mohu nyagbe ligbi ɔ, ma tle mɛ tsuo si. 40Ejakaa Tsaatsɛ suɔ kaa nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ na Bi ɔ, nɛ e heɔ lɛ yeɔ ɔ, e na neneene wami. Nɛ nyagbe ligbi ɔ, ma tle mɛ si kɛ ba wami mi.”
41Benɛ Yesu de ke, “Imi ji abolo nɛ je hiɔwe ɔ”, ni ɔmɛ tu munyu huitihuiti kɛ si lɛ; 42nɛ a bi ke, “Anɛ pi Yosef bi Yesu ɔ ji nɛ ɔ? Tse wa le e tsɛ kɛ e nyɛ! Nɛ lɛɛ e ke e je hiɔwe ɔ? Kɛ pee kɛɛ nɛ e deɔ jã mɔ?”
43Yesu de mɛ ke, “Nyɛ kpa munyu huitihuiti tumi. 44Nɔ ko nɔ ko be nyɛe maa ba ye ngɔ kaa ja Tsɛ ɔ nɛ tsɔ mi ɔ gbla lɛ kɛ ba ye ngɔ; nɛ nyagbe ligbi ɔ, ma tle lɛ si. 45 Nɔ́ nɛ gbali ɔmɛ ngma ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: ‘Mawu maa tsɔɔ nɔ tsuaa nɔ ní.’ Munyu nɛ Tsɛ ɔ tu ɔ, nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa nu, nɛ e maa kase ní kɛ je mi ɔ maa ba ye ngɔ. 46Se enɛ ɔ tsɔɔ we kaa nɔ ko na Tsɛ ɔ hyɛ; ja imi nɛ i je Mawu ngɔ ɔ, imi pɛ nɛ i na lɛ. 47I ngɛ nyɛ dee anɔkuale mi ke nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ heɔ yeɔ ɔ, e nine su neneene wami nɔ. 48Imi ji abolo nɛ haa nɔ wami ɔ nɛ. 49Nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ ye mana ngɛ nga a nɔ, nɛ a gbo. 50Se abolo nɛ je hiɔwe ɔ lɛɛ ke nɔ ko ye ɔ, e be gboe. 51Imi ji abolo nɛ je hiɔwe nɛ haa nɔ wami. Nɔ nɛ maa ye kikɛmɛ a abolo nɛ ɔ eko ɔ maa hi si kɛ maa ya neneene. Abolo nɛ ma ha lɛ ɔ ji imi nitsɛ ye he lo nɛ i ngɔ kɛ ha, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ je ɔ tsuo yi nɛ na wami.”
52Jehanɛ Yuda bi ɔmɛ sɔuu bɔni nya sami, nɛ a bi ke, “Kɛ nɔmlɔ nɛ ɔ maa ngɔ e he lo ha wɔ nɛ waa ye kɛɛ?”
53Yesu de mɛ ke, “I ngɛ nyɛ dee anɔkuale mi ke, ke nyɛ yi Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ he lo, nɛ́ nyɛɛ nu e muɔ ɔ, nyɛ be wami nae. 54Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa ye ye he lo, nɛ e maa nu ye muɔ ɔ ma na neneene wami; nɛ nyagbe ligbi ɔ, ma tle lɛ si. 55Ejakaa ye he lo ɔ ji niye ní nɛ sa nɛ a ye, nɛ ye muɔ ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ sa nɛ a nu. 56Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ yeɔ ye he lo, nɛ e nuu ye muɔ ɔ hii ye mi, nɛ imi hu i hii e mi. 57Tsɛ ɔ nɛ tsɔ mi ɔ hɛ ngɛ; nɛ e ha nɛ imi hu ye hɛ ngɛ. Jã kɛ̃, nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ yeɔ ye he lo ɔ, ma ha lɛ wami. 58Abolo nɛ je hiɔwe ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. Abolo nɛ ɔ be kaa nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ ye nɛ pee se a gbo ɔ. Mohu ɔ, nɔmlɔ nɛ maa ye abolo nɛ ɔ maa hi si kɛ maa ya neneene.”
59Yesu de ní nɛ ɔmɛ benɛ e ngɛ ní tsɔɔe ngɛ kpe he ɔ ngɛ Kapernaum.
Neneene wami munyuhi
60Yesu se nyɛɛli ɔmɛ a ti nihi babauu nɛ nu nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, de ke, “Ei! Tsɔɔmi nɛ ɔ he wa lo! Mɛnɔ maa nu sisi.”
61Benɛ Yesu kɔ se kaa e kaseli ɔmɛ ngɛ munyu huitihuiti tue ngɛ níhi nɛ e de mɛ ɔ a he ɔ, e bi mɛ ke, “Anɛ enɛ ɔ maa wo nyɛ nine mi nyu lo? 62Ke nyɛ na Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ nɛ kpale kɛ yaa hiɔwe he nɛ e je kɛ ba a, kɛ nyɛ maa pee kɛɛ? 63Mawu mumi ɔ nɛ haa nɔ wami ɔ nɛ. Adesa he wami pi nɔ́ ko kulaa. Munyuhi nɛ i kɛ nyɛ tu nɛ ɔ ma ha nyɛ Mawu mumi nɛ haa nɔ wami ɔ. 64Se kɛ̃, nyɛ ti ni komɛ he we yi.” (Kɛ je sisije ɔ, Yesu lɛɛ e le ni nɛmɛ nɛ be lɛ hee maa ye; nɛ nɔmlɔ nɛ maa tsɔɔ e se blɔ ɔ hu e le lɛ.) 65Yesu ya nɔ de ke, “Enɛ ɔ nɔuu he je nɛ i de nyɛ ke nɔ ko nɔ ko be nyɛe maa ba ye ngɔ kaa ja Tsɛ ɔ nitsɛ ha lɛ he blɔ ɔ nɛ.”
66Jehanɛ ɔ, munyu nɛ ɔmɛ a he je ɔ, Yesu se nyɛɛli ɔmɛ a ti nihi babauu kpale a se, nɛ a kɛ lɛ nyɛɛ we hu. 67Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e bi ni nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ ke, “Nyɛ hu nyɛ suɔ kaa nyɛɛ maa je lo?”
68 Simon Petro he nɔ ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, mɛnɔ ngɔ wa maa ya? Mo lɛ o ngɛ neneene wami munyu ɔmɛ. 69Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, wɔɔ lɛɛ wa he ye, nɛ wa na le hulɔ kaa mo ji Mawu Nɔ Klɔuklɔu ɔ nɛ.”
70Yesu bi mɛ ke, “Anɛ pi imi nɛ i hla nyɛ ni nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ lo? Lɛ kɛ pee kɛɛ nɛ nyɛ ti nɔ kake peeɔ Abosiami ɔ?” 71Blɔɔ, Simon Iskariot bi Yuda e ngɛ dee ɔ nɛ. Ejakaa Yuda a, ni nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake ji lɛ. Se pee se ɔ, lɛ ji nɔ nɛ ba tsɔɔ Yesu se blɔ.

Title: YOHANE 7
Content:
Yesu kɛ e nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ
1Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Yesu kpa si ngɛ Galilea pɛ, se e sume nɛ e ya Yudea zugba a mi, ejakaa Yuda bi ɔmɛ ngɛ lɛ hlae nɛ a gbe. 2 Benɛ Yuda bi ɔmɛ a Gbasisihimi nyami be ɔ ngɛ sue ɔ, 3Yesu nyɛminyumu ɔmɛ de lɛ ke, “Jee hiɛ ɔ, nɛ o ya Yudea, konɛ o se nyɛɛli ɔmɛ nɛ a na níhi nɛ o ngɛ tsue ɔ. 4Ke nɔ ko suɔ kaa ma nɛ le lɛ saminya a, níhi nɛ e peeɔ ɔ, e laa we nɔ. Ní ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ o ngɛ pee ɔ, ha nɛ je ɔ tsuo nɛ nu he.” 5E nyɛminyumu ɔmɛ tete he we lɛ yi.
6Yesu he nɔ ke, “Ye be ɔ sui lolo; se nyɛɛ lɛɛ be tsuaa be hi ha nyɛ. 7Je ɔ be nyɛ nyɛe, se a nyɛɔ mi, ejakaa a yeɔ odase kɛ siɔ mɛ ngɛ ní yayamihi nɛ a peeɔ ɔ he. 8Nyɛɛ ya nɛ nyɛ ya ye nyami be ɔ. Imi lɛɛ i be yae, ejakaa be nɛ maa da mi ɔ na we nɛ e su.” 9Nɛ e de jã a, e tlɔ Galilea.
Yesu ya Gbasisihimi nyami ɔ
10Nɛ Yesu nyɛminyumu ɔmɛ je ɔ, pee se ɔ, lɛ hu e pue nɔ kɛ ho. Se e je we e he si paa; mohu e ngɛ e he lae. 11Yuda ma nimeli ɔmɛ hla lɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ; nɛ a bi si ke, “Jije e ngɛ?”
12Ma a tsuo tu Yesu he munyu kusikusi. Benɛ ni komɛ de ke, “Nɔmlɔ kpakpa ji lɛ” ɔ, ni komɛ hu de ke, “Dɛbi, e ngɛ ma a nane tɔtɔe”. 13Se kɛ̃ ɔ, nɔ ko nɔ ko nyɛ we nɛ e tu Yesu he munyu ngɛ ma a hɛ mi paa, ejakaa a ngɛ Yuda bi ɔmɛ gbeye yee.
14Benɛ nyami ɔ ngɛ nɔ yae ɔ kɛkɛ nɛ Yesu ya hia si ngɛ sɔlemi we ɔ, nɛ e bɔni ní tsɔɔmi. 15Yuda bi ɔmɛ a hɛ mi pee mɛ yaa, nɛ a bi ke, “Nɔmlɔ nɛ kase we ní ɔ, kɛ peeɔ kɛɛ nɛ e le ní kikɛ nɛ ɔ.”
16Yesu he nɔ ke, “Nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ tsɔɔe ɔ ji imi nitsɛ ye yi mi; nɔ nɛ tsɔ mi ɔ nɛ ngɔ ha mi. 17Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ suɔ kaa e maa pee Mawu suɔmi nya ní ɔ, e maa na kaa nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ tsɔɔe ɔ je Mawu ngɔ, se pi imi nitsɛ ye he wami nya. 18Ke nɔ ko tuɔ munyu ngɛ lɛ nitsɛ e he wami nya a, e ngɛ hɛ mi nyami hlae ha e he. Se anɔkualetsɛ lɛɛ e hlaa kaa e maa wo nɔ nɛ tsɔ lɛ ɔ mohu hɛ mi nyami, nɛ sisimi be e mi. 19Pi Mose nɛ wo nyɛ mlaa a? Nɛ nyɛ ti nɔ ko nɔ ko yi nɔ ɔ? Mɛni he je nyɛ ngɛ hlae nɛ nyɛɛ gbe mi ɔ?”
20Ma a tsuo he nɔ ke, “Mo nɔmlɔ nɛ ɔ, mumi yayami ngɛ o mi! Mɛnɔ ngɛ mo hlae nɛ e gbe?”
21Yesu he nɔ ke, “Nyakpɛ nɔ́ kake pɛ i pee nɛ nyɛ tsuo nyɛ hɛ mi pee nyɛ yaa. 22 Mose nɛ fa ke nyɛɛ po nyɛ binyumu ɔmɛ. (Pohu pi Mose nɛ de; nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a je sisi.) Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ, nyɛ poɔ bimwɔyo. 23 Ke Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ, nyɛ poɔ nɔ, konɛ a ko tɔ Mose mlaa a, mɛni he je nyɛ mi mi fuɔ mi kaa i tsa hiɔtsɛ Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ? 24Ke nyɛ ngɛ kojoe ɔ, nyɛ kpa nɔ hɛ mi hyɛmi, nɛ́ nyɛɛ ye dami sane.”
Yesu ji Mesia a lo?
25Kɛkɛ nɛ Yerusalem bi ɔmɛ a ti ni komɛ bi ke, “Anɛ pi nyumu nɛ ɔ nɛ ma nimeli ɔmɛ ngɛ hlae nɛ a gbe ɔ? 26Hyɛ kaa jehanɛ lɛɛ e daa si paa ngɛ ní tsɔɔe nɛ a de we lɛ nɔ́ ko. Eko piɔ a na kaa lɛ ji Kristo ɔ niinɛ. 27Kristo ɔ nɛɛ, anɛ nɔ ko maa le he nɛ e maa je lo? Tse wɔ tsuo wa le he nɛ nɔmlɔ nɛ ɔ je.”
28Jehanɛ, benɛ Yesu ngɛ ní ɔ tsɔɔe ngɛ sɔlemi we ɔ, e kpa ngmlaa kɛ bi ke, “Anɛ nyɛ le mi tutuutu? He nɛ i je ɔ, nyɛ le? Pi imi nitsɛ ye he wami nya nɛ i ba. Nɔ nɛ tsɔ mi ɔ, anɔkualetsɛ ji lɛ; nyɛɛ nyɛ li lɛ. 29Imi lɛɛ i le lɛ, ejakaa e ngɔ nɛ i je, nɛ lɛ ji nɔ nɛ tsɔ mi.”
30Kɛkɛ nɛ a pee kaa a maa nu Yesu amlɔ nɔuu, se nɔ ko nɔ ko nyɛ we nɛ e ta e he, ejakaa e be ɔ sui lolo. 31Ma mi bi ɔmɛ a ti nihi babauu he Yesu ye, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a bi ke, “Anɛ Mesia a nɛ maa ba a ma nyɛ to okadi pe nɔmlɔ nɛ ɔ lo?”
A tsɔ nihi nɛ́ a ya nu Yesu
32Benɛ Farisi bi ɔmɛ nu nɛ ma kpekpemi ɔ ngɛ Yesu he munyu tue kusikusi ɔ, a kɛ osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ tsɔ nihi ke a ya nu lɛ kɛ ba. 33Yesu de mɛ ke, “E piɛ be bɔɔ pɛ nɛ i kɛ nyɛ maa hi si, kɛkɛ ma kpale kɛ ho nɔ nɛ tsɔ mi ɔ ngɔ ya. 34Nyɛ ma hla mi, se nyɛ be mi nae; ejakaa he nɛ i yaa a, nyɛ be nyɛe maa ba lejɛ ɔ.”
35Yuda ma nimeli ɔmɛ bi mɛ nitsɛmɛ a he ke, “Jije po e yaa nɛ wa be lɛ nae hu ɔ? Anɛ e maa ho Hela ma nguaa amɛ a mi ya ngɛ wa nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ a ngɔ, nɛ e ya tsɔɔ Hela bi ɔmɛ ní lo? 36E de ke, wa ma hla lɛ, se wa be lɛ nae; nɛ he nɛ e yaa hu, wa be nyɛe maa ya. Kɛ e ngɛ tsɔɔe kɛɛ?”
Pa nɛ haa nɔ nyu nɛ wami ngɛ mi
37 Nyagbe ligbi ɔ nɛ ji nyami ligbi nguaa pe kulaa a, Yesu te da si, nɛ e de kɛ ngmlaa ke, “Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ kuma ngɛ lɛ yee ɔ, e ba ye ngɔ nɛ e ba nu nyu. 38 A ngma ke, ‘Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ heɔ mi yeɔ ɔ, pa nɛ baa nyu babaaba nɛ wami ngɛ mi maa fo dɔ kɛ je e tsui mi.’ ” 39Blɔɔ, Mumi ɔ he Yesu de enɛ ɔ nɛ, ejakaa nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ heɔ lɛ yeɔ ɔ nine maa su Mumi ɔ nɔ. Se jamɛ a be ɔ, Mumi ɔ bɛ lolo, ejakaa a na we nɛ a wo Yesu hɛ mi nyami.
Ni ɔmɛ a mi gba
40Benɛ ma mi bi ɔmɛ nu munyu nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, a ti ni komɛ de ke, “Niinɛ, nɔmlɔ nɛ ɔ ji gbalɔ ɔ nɛ.”
41Ni komɛ hu de ke, “Lɛ ji Mesia a nɛ.”
Se ni kpa komɛ lɛɛ a bi ke, “Mesia a, Galilea nɛ e maa je lo? 42 Ejakaa a ngma ke Mesia a maa pee Matsɛ David nina; nɛ jehanɛ hu, Betlehem, he nɛ Matsɛ David hi ɔ, lejɛ ɔ a ma fɔ lɛ ngɛ.” 43Benɛ a de nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, kɛkɛ nɛ ni ɔmɛ a mi gba enyɔ ngɛ Yesu he. 44Ni komɛ pee kaa a maa nu Yesu, se nɔ ko nɔ ko nyɛ we nɛ e ta e he.
Yuda ma nimeli ɔmɛ he we yi
45Benɛ tsɔli ɔmɛ kpale kɛ ba a, osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ, kɛ Farisi bi ɔmɛ bi mɛ ke, “Mɛni he je nyɛɛ kɛ lɛ bɛ ɔ?”
46Tsɔli ɔmɛ he nɔ ke, “Bɔ nɛ nɔmlɔ nɛ ɔ tuɔ munyu ɔ, nɔ ko tu we munyu ja gblee.”
47Farisi bi ɔmɛ bi tsɔli ɔmɛ ke, “Anɛ e pee nyɛ hu kuasia lo? 48Anɛ nyɛ nu hyɛ kaa ma nimeli ɔmɛ, aloo Farisi bi ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake ngmelu po he lɛ ye lo? 49Ma kpekpemi nɛ ɔ, a gbiɛ mɛ pɛ, ejakaa a li Mose mlaa a.”
50 Farisi bi ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Nikodemo, nɛ́ be ko ɔ e ba Yesu ngɔ ɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. E de ma a ke, 51“Wa mlaa a nya a, e sɛ kaa wa buɔ nɔ ko fɔ be mi nɛ wa bi we e nya mi kaa mɛni e pee lo.”
52A he nɔ ke, “Saminya! Tse mo hu Galilea no ji mo! Yaa kpa ngmami ɔmɛ a mi kaa o maa na gbalɔ ko nɛ je Galilea lo!”

Title: YOHANE 8
Content:
Yo nɛ ngɛ ajuama bɔe nɛ a nu lɛ ɔ
[ 1Benɛ ni ɔmɛ tsuo je kɛ ho we mi ya a, Yesu pue nɔ kɛ ho Oliv yo ɔ he ya. 2E nɔ jena mɔtu mla a, e kpale e se kɛ ba sɔlemi we ɔ. Ni ɔmɛ tsuo ba bu e nɔ, nɛ e hi si, nɛ e bɔni mɛ ní tsɔɔmi. 3Mlaa tsɔɔli ɔmɛ, kɛ Farisi bi ɔmɛ ngɔ yo ko nɛ ya ngɛ ajuama bɔe nɛ a nu lɛ kɛ ba, nɛ a kɛ lɛ ba da ma a tsuo hɛ mi. 4A de Yesu ke, “Tsɔɔlɔ, yo nɛ ɔ ya ngɛ ajuama bɔe nɛ a nu lɛ. 5 Wa mlaa a nya a, Mose fa ke, ‘Yo kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ, a fia lɛ tɛ nɛ e gbo.’ Moo lɛɛ kɛ o ngɛ dee kɛɛ?” 6Enɛ ɔ, a de kɛ da lɛ, konɛ a na nɔ́ ko nɛ a kɛ ya po e nya. Se Yesu sɔ̃ si, nɛ e kɛ e nine nguɛ ngma ní ngɛ zugba.
7Benɛ a ngɛ nɔ ngɛ Yesu munyu bie ɔ, e wo e yi nɔ nɛ e de mɛ ke, “Nyɛ ti nɔ nɛ pee we yayami ko ɔ, lɛ kekle e fia yo ɔ tɛ ɔ.” 8Yesu kpale sɔ̃ si, nɛ e tsa ní ngmami ɔ nɔ ngɛ zugba. 9Se mɛɛ lɛɛ benɛ a nu munyu nɛ ɔ, a bɔni jemi kakaaka, kɛ je nɔkɔtɔma a nɔ kɛ ya si e piɛ Yesu, kɛ yo ɔ pɛ nɛ daa si ngɛ lejɛ ɔ kɛ mwɔɔ. 10Jehanɛ ɔ, Yesu wo e yi nɔ ekohu, nɛ e bi yo ɔ ke, “Maa, nihi nɛ ba po o nya a, jije a ngɛ? A ti nɔ kake po bui mo fɔ lo?”
11Yo ɔ he nɔ ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, nɔ ko nɔ ko bui mi fɔ.”
Yesu de lɛ ke, “Saminya, imi hu i bui mo fɔ. Yaa, se mohu kpa yayami peemi.”]
Yesu ji la kɛ ha je ɔ
12 Yesu, kɛ Farisi bi ɔmɛ tu munyu ekohu, nɛ e de mɛ ke, “Imi ji je ɔ la a nɛ. Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ nyɛɛɔ ye se ɔ, e naa la a nɛ haa nɔ wami ɔ; nɛ e be diblii mi nyɛɛe kɔkɔɔkɔ.”
13 Farisi bi ɔmɛ de lɛ ke, “Jehanɛ lɛɛ o ngɛ mo nitsɛ o he odase yee. Nɔ nɛ o ngɛ dee ɔ be mi fɛɛ.”
14Yesu he nɔ ke, “E ngɛ mi mohu kaa imi nitsɛ i ngɛ ye he odase yee lɛɛ, se ye odase ɔ ngɛ mi, ejakaa i le he nɛ i je, kɛ he nɛ i yaa. Nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ li he nɛ i je kɛ ba; nɛ he nɛ i yaa hu nyɛ li. 15Nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ kojoɔ he lo nya, se imi lɛɛ, i kojo we nɔ ko. 16Se ke i kojo tete po ɔ, e da, ejakaa pi imi nɔ kake nɛ i ngɛ enɛ ɔ pee. Tsɛ ɔ nɛ tsɔ mi ɔ piɛ ye he. 17 A ngma ngɛ nyɛ mlaa a mi ke, ke ni enyɔ ye odase nɛ kɔɔ ɔ, e peeɔ anɔkuale. 18Imi lɛɛ i yeɔ imi nitsɛ ye he odase, nɛ Tsɛ ɔ nɛ tsɔ mi ɔ hu yeɔ ye he odase.”
19A bi lɛ ke, “O Tsɛ ɔ, jije e ngɛ?”
Yesu he nɔ ke, “Nyɛ li mi, nɛ Tsaatsɛ hu nyɛ li lɛ. Kaa nyɛ le mi jinɛ nyɛ maa le Tsaatsɛ hulɔ.”
20Yesu de ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo, be mi nɛ e ngɛ ní tsɔɔe ngɛ sɔlemi we ɔ ngɛ tsu mi he nɛ a kɛ tó tsumi daka amɛ to ɔ. Se a nui lɛ, ejakaa e be ɔ sui.
He nɛ i yaa a, nyɛ be nyɛe maa ya
21Yesu kpale de ni ɔmɛ ke, “Imi lɛɛ i yaa! Nyɛ ma hla mi, se nyɛ ma gbo kɛ nyɛ he yayami. He nɛ i yaa a, nyɛ be nyɛe maa ba.”
22Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yuda ma nimeli ɔmɛ bi ke, “Ke e de ke he nɛ e yaa a, wa be nyɛe maa ya a, kɛ e ngɛ tsɔɔe kɛɛ? E yaa gbe e he lo?”
23Yesu he nɔ ke, “Nyɛɛ lɛɛ je nɛ ɔ mi bi ji nyɛ; se imi lɛɛ hiɔwe i je. Je nɛ ɔ mi bi ji nyɛ, se imi lɛɛ i ji je nɛ ɔ mi. 24Enɛ ɔ he nɛ i de nyɛ ke nyɛ ma gbo kɛ nyɛ he yayami ɔ nɛ. Niinɛ, nyɛ ma gbo kɛ nyɛ he yayami ɔmɛ ke nyɛ he we yi kaa imi ji nɔ nɛ i ji ɔ.”
25A bi lɛ ke, “Mɛnɔ ji mo?”
Yesu he nɔ ke, “Sisije ɔ, mɛni i de nyɛ ɔ? 26I le nyɛ he sanehi babauu nɛ ma kɛ kojo nyɛ. Se nɔ nɛ tsɔ mi ɔ, anɔkualetsɛ ji lɛ, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ nɛ i nu kɛ je e nya a, lɔ ɔ i deɔ je ɔ.”
27Se mɛɛ lɛɛ a li kaa Tsɛ ɔ he munyu Yesu kɛ mɛ ngɛ tue ɔ. 28Jehanɛ e de mɛ ke, “Ke nyɛ ná wo Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ nɔ ɔ, nyɛ maa le kaa imi ji nɔ nɛ i ji ɔ. Kɛkɛ ɔ, nyɛ maa le kaa i to we imi nitsɛ ye yi mi kɛ tsu we nɔ́ ko gblegbleegble. Mohu nɔ́ nɛ Tsɛ ɔ tsɔɔ mi ɔ, lɔ ɔ pɛ i deɔ. 29Tsɛ ɔ nɛ tsɔ mi ɔ kɛ mi ngɛ; e si we imi nɔ kake too, ejakaa i peeɔ e suɔmi nya ní.”
30Benɛ Yesu de ní nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, nihi babauu nɛ nu ɔ he lɛ ye.
Odehehi kɛ nyɔguɛhi
31Yesu de Yuda bi nɛ he lɛ ye ɔ ke, “Ke nyɛ pɛtɛ ye munyu ɔ he ɔ, lɛɛ nyɛ maa pee ye kaseli nitsɛnitsɛmɛ. 32Kɛkɛ ɔ, nyɛ maa le anɔkuale ɔ; nɛ anɔkuale ɔ ma ha nyɛ maa ye nyɛ he.”
33 A he nɔ ke, “Abraham nina ji wɔ, nɛ wɔɔ lɛɛ wa yi nyɔguɛ ha nɔ ko hyɛ. Ke o de ke, ‘Nyɛ maa ye nyɛ he’ ɔ, kɛ o ngɛ tsɔɔe kɛɛ?”
34Yesu de mɛ ke, “I ngɛ nyɛ dee anɔkuale mi ke nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ peeɔ yayami ɔ, yayami ɔ nyɔguɛ ji lɛ. 35Nyɔguɛ hí we mi kɛ yɛ neneene, se bi lɛɛ e hii si kɛ yaa neneene. 36Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke Bi ɔ ha nyɛ ye nyɛ he ɔ, nyɛ maa ye nyɛ he niinɛ. 37I le kaa Abraham nina ji nyɛ! Mɛni he je mɔ nɛ nyɛ ngɔɛ ye tsɔɔmi ɔ, nɛ nyɛ ngɛ mi hlae nyɛɛ gbe mohu ɔ. 38Imi lɛɛ níhi nɛ Tsaatsɛ tsɔɔ mi ɔ, lɔ ɔmɛ i deɔ; se nyɛɛ lɛɛ níhi nɛ nyɛ tsɛ ɔ de nyɛ ɔ, lɔ ɔmɛ nyɛ peeɔ.”
39A he nɔ ke, “Wɔɔ lɛɛ wa tsɛ ji Abraham.”
Yesu de mɛ ke, “Abraham nina ji nyɛ jinɛ nyɛ maa pee níhi nɛ Abraham pee ɔ nɔuu. 40Imi lɛɛ anɔkuale ɔ nɛ i nu kɛ je Tsaatsɛ Mawu nya a, lɔ ɔ i deɔ nyɛ; se nyɛ ngɛ mi hlae nɛ nyɛɛ gbe. Abraham pee we nɔ́ ko kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ. 41Níhi nɛ nyɛ tsɛ peeɔ ɔ, lɔ ɔmɛ ngɛ peeɔ ɔ nɛ.”
A he nɔ ke, “Wɔɔ lɛɛ pi ajuama mi bimɛ ji wɔ. Wa ngɛ tsɛ kake. Wa tsɛ ji Mawu.”
42Yesu de mɛ ke, “Mawu ji nyɛ Tsɛ niinɛ jinɛ nyɛ maa suɔ mi, ejakaa Mawu nɛ tsɔ mi; se pi imi nitsɛ ye yi mi nɛ i to kɛ ba. Mawu ngɔ nɛ i je kɛ ba nyɛ ngɔ. 43Munyu nɛ i kɛ nyɛ tu ɔ, nyɛ nɛ nya, ejakaa nyɛ bui ye munyu ɔ. 44Nyɛ tsɛ nɛ fɔ nyɛ ji Abosiami; nɛ nyɛ suɔ kaa nyɛ maa pee e suɔmi nya ní. Kɛ je sisije ɔ, nɔ gbelɔ ji lɛ, nɛ e kɛ anɔkuale yi gblegbleegble, ejakaa anɔkuale be e mi. Ke e ye lakpa a, e tsɔɔ bɔ nɛ e su ngɛ, ejakaa lakpatsɛ kpanaku ji lɛ. 45Se imi lɛɛ, i tuɔ anɔkuale; nɛ lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ he we mi yi. 46Nyɛ ti mɛnɔ ma nyɛ tsɔɔ kaa i pee yayami. Ke anɔkuale i tuɔ ɔ, lɛɛ mɛni he je nyɛ he we mi yi ɔ? 47Nɔ nɛ je Mawu ngɔ ɔ, e nuɔ Mawu munyu. Se nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ nui, ejakaa pi Mawu ngɔ nɛ nyɛ je.”
Yesu kɛ Abraham
48Yuda bi ɔmɛ bi Yesu ke, “Ke wa de ke Samaria no ji mo, nɛ mumi yayami ngɛ o mi ɔ, wa tɔ lo?”
49Yesu he nɔ ke, “Mumi yayami be ye mi. Imi lɛɛ Tsaatsɛ hɛ mi nyami i woɔ, se nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ ngɛ ye he guɛ gbee. 50I hla we imi nitsɛ ye hɛ mi nyami. Se nɔ ko ngɛ nɛ ngɛ hlae, nɛ lɛ nɛ maa kojo. 51I ngɛ nyɛ dee anɔkuale mi ke nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ buu ye tsɔɔmi ɔ tue ɔ, e be gboe gblegbleegble.”
52Yuda bi ɔmɛ de lɛ ke, “Jehanɛ lɛɛ wa ná nɔ mi mami kaa mumi yayami ngɛ o mi. Abraham gbo, nɛ gbali ɔmɛ hu gbo, se moo lɛɛ o ngɛ dee ke nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ buu o tsɔɔmi tue ɔ be gboe gblegbleegble. 53Tsaatsɛ Abraham nɛ gbo ɔ, o pe lɛ lo? Jehanɛ ɔ hu, gbali ɔmɛ nɛ gbo ɔ nɛɛ? Kɛ moo lɛɛ o buɔ o he kɛɛ?”
54Yesu he nɔ ke, “Kaa imi nitsɛ nɛ i woɔ ye hɛ mi nyami ɔ, lɛɛ lɔ ɔ pi nɔ́ ko; se hyɛ, Tsaatsɛ nɛ nyɛ tsɛɔ ke nyɛ Mawu ɔ, lɛ nɔuu nɛ woɔ ye hɛ mi nyami. 55Imi le lɛ, se nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ li lɛ. Ke i de ke i li lɛ ɔ, lɛɛ lakpatsɛ ji mi kaa nyɛ nɔuu. Se i le lɛ, nɛ i buɔ lɛ tue. 56Nyɛ tsɛ Abraham hla nɛ e na ye bami be ɔ kɛ bua jɔmi. E na hulɔ, nɛ e nya.”
57Yuda bi ɔmɛ bi lɛ ke, “Mo nɛ o na we jeha nyingmi enuɔ po ɔ, o na Abraham lo?”
58Yesu he nɔ ke, “I ngɛ nyɛ dee anɔkuale mi ke i ngɛ loko a fɔ Abraham.”
59Kɛkɛ nɛ a kukuɔ tɛ nɛ a maa fia Yesu, se e laa e he, nɛ e je sɔlemi we ɔ.

Title: YOHANE 9
Content:
Yesu tsa nyumu ko nɛ a fɔ lɛ hɛ yuyuilɔ
1Benɛ Yesu nyɛɛ kɛ yaa a, e na nyumu ko nɛ hɛ yu kɛ je be nɛ a fɔ lɛ. 2Kaseli ɔmɛ bi Yesu ke, “Tsɔɔlɔ, mɛnɔ lɛ pee yayami nɛ a fɔ nɔmlɔ nɛ ɔ hɛ yuyuilɔ ɔ? Lɛ nitsɛ, aloo e fɔli?”
3Yesu he nɔ ke, “Nɔmlɔ nɛ hɛ yu nɛ ɔ, pi lɛ nitsɛ nɛ pee yayami, nɛ pi e fɔli hulɔ. Mohu ɔ, e hɛ yu, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ a gu e nɔ kɛ tsɔɔ bɔ nɛ Mawu he wami ɔ tsuɔ ní ha. 4Nɛ je na nɛ ɔ, ja wa tsu nɔ nɛ tsɔ mi ɔ ní tsumi ɔmɛ. Je maa jɔ, nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be nyɛe ma tsu ní. 5 Be abɔ nɛ i ngɛ je ɔ mi nɛ ɔ, imi ji je ɔ la a nɛ.”
6Benɛ Yesu de enɛ ɔ, e la lada pue zugba, nɛ e kɛ lada a pɔtɔ zu. E ngɔ zu ɔ kɛ ha hɛ yuyuilɔ ɔ hɛngmɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ. 7Yesu de lɛ ke, “Yaa Siloam pa a mi nɛ o ya fɔ o he.” (Siloam sisi ji a tsɔ lɛ.) Kɛkɛ nɛ nyumu ɔ pue nɔ kɛ ho, nɛ e ya fɔ e he; nɛ benɛ e kpale kɛ ma a, e bɔni nɔ́ hyɛmi.
8E kpɔ mi bi, kɛ nihi tsuo nɛ sa a, a naa lɛ nɛ e hii nɔ bae ɔ bi ke, “Anɛ pi nɔmlɔ nɛ ɔ nɛ hiɔ si, nɛ e hii nɔ bae be ko ɔ?”
9Ni komɛ de ke, “Nyumu ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ!” Se ni komɛ hu de ke, “Dɛbi, pi lɛ; e je lɛ kɛkɛ.”
Kɛkɛ nɛ nyumu ɔ nitsɛ de mɛ ke, “Imi ji lɛ.”
10A bi lɛ ke, “Kɛ pee kɛɛ loko jehanɛ ɔ lɛɛ o ngɛ nɔ hyɛe ɔ?”
11E de mɛ ke, “Nyumu ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Yesu ɔ nɛ pɔtɔ zu, nɛ e ngɔ ha ye hɛngmɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ. Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e de mi ke ma ya fɔ ye he ngɛ Siloam pa a mi. Benɛ i ya fɔ ye he pɛ nɛ i bɔni nɔ hyɛmi.”
12A bi lɛ ke, “Jije e ngɛ.”
E he nɔ ke, “I li.”
Farisi bi ɔmɛ bi nɔ tsami ɔ he munyu
13Jehanɛ ɔ, a ngɔ nyumu ɔ nɛ sa a e hɛ yu ɔ kɛ ba Farisi bi ɔmɛ a ngɔ. 14Akɛnɛ Hejɔɔmi ligbi nɛ Yesu pɔtɔ zu ɔ nɛ e kɛ tsa nyumu hɛ yuyuilɔ ɔ, 15Farisi bi ɔmɛ kpale bi nyumu ɔ ekohu bɔ nɛ pee nɛ e na tsami ɔ. E de mɛ ke, “E pɔtɔ zu kɛ ha ye hɛngmɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ i ya fɔ ye he, kɛkɛ nɛ i bɔni nɔ hyɛmi.”
16Farisi bi ɔmɛ a ti ni komɛ de ke, “Nɔmlɔ nɛ pee nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, pi Mawu ngɔ nɛ e je; ejakaa e bui Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ.”
Se a ti ni komɛ lɛɛ a de ke, “Kɛ nɔmlɔ nɛ peeɔ yayami ma plɛ kɛ to okadihi kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ kɛɛ?” Kɛkɛ nɛ ni ɔmɛ a mi gba.
17Jehanɛ ɔ, Farisi bi ɔmɛ kpale bi nyumu ɔ ekohu ke, “Tse o de wɔ ke e bli o hɛngmɛ! Saminya, kɛ moo o deɔ ngɛ e he kɛɛ?”
Nyumu ɔ he nɔ ke, “Gbalɔ ji lɛ.”
18Se loloolo ɔ, Yuda ma nimeli ɔmɛ he we yi kaa be ko nɛ be ɔ nyumu ɔ hyɛ we nɔ́. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a tsɛ e fɔli ɔmɛ, 19nɛ a bi mɛ ke, “Tse nyɛ bi ji nɛ ɔ? Nyɛ ke a fɔ lɛ hɛ yuyuilɔ? Kɛ peeɔ kɛɛ nɛ amlɔ nɛ ɔ e ngɛ nɔ hyɛe ɔ?”
20E fɔli ɔmɛ he nɔ ke, “Ee, wa le kaa wa bi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ, nɛ wa le hulɔ kaa a fɔ lɛ hɛ yuyuilɔ. 21Se bɔ nɛ ba nɛ e ngɛ nɔ hyɛe amlɔ nɛ ɔ, lɔ ɔ lɛɛ wa li; nɛ nɔmlɔ nɛ ha nɛ e bɔni nɔ́ hyɛmi ɔ hu wa li lɛ. Nyɛ bi lɛ; e wa nɛ lɛ nitsɛ e ma nyɛ je munyu nya.” 22Nyumu ɔ fɔli ɔmɛ de enɛ ɔ, ejakaa a ngɛ Yuda ma nimeli ɔmɛ gbeye yee. Blɔɔ Yuda bi ɔmɛ so ngɔ to kaa ke nɔ ko ma gba mi paa ma de ke Yesu ji Kristo ɔ, a maa fie jamɛatsɛ ɔ kɛ je kpe he ɔ. 23Enɛ ɔ he nɛ e fɔli ɔmɛ de ke, “E wa, nyɛ bi lɛ nitsɛ” ɔ nɛ.
24Yuda bi ɔmɛ kpale tsɛ nyumu ɔ nɛ a fɔ lɛ hɛ yuyuilɔ ɔ ekohu, nɛ a bi lɛ ke, “Ka wɔ kita ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi ngɛ hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ kaa o maa tu wɔ anɔkuale! Wɔɔ lɛɛ wa le kaa nɔmlɔ nɛ tsa mo ɔ yayami peelɔ ji lɛ.”
25Se nyumu ɔ he nɔ ke, “Yayami peelɔ ji lɛ oo, pi yayami peelɔ ji lɛ oo; imi lɛɛ i li! Nɔ́ kake pɛ i le; be ko nɛ be ɔ, hɛ yuyuilɔ ji mi; se amlɔ nɛ ɔ, i ngɛ nɔ hyɛe.”
26A bi lɛ ekohu ke, “Kɛ e pee mo kɛɛ? Kɛ e pee kɛɛ nɛ e bli o hɛngmɛ ɔmɛ ɔ?”
27E he nɔ ke, “Tse i de nyɛ enɛ ɔ momo nɛ nyɛ bui mi tue. Mɛni nyɛ ngɛ hlae nɛ nyɛɛ nu ekohu. Nyɛ hu nyɛ suɔ kaa nyɛ maa pee e kaseli lo?”
28Se mɛɛ lɛɛ a gbiɛ nyumu ɔ, nɛ a de lɛ ke, “Mo ji jamɛatsɛ ɔ kaselɔ; wɔɔ lɛɛ Mose kaseli ji wɔ. 29Wa le kaa Mawu kɛ Mose tu munyu, se kikɛmɛ a nɔmlɔ nɛ ɔ lɛɛ, he nɛ e je po wa li.”
30Nyumu ɔ de mɛ ke, “Mɛni nyakpɛ sane ji nɛ ɔ! Nɔmlɔ nɛ bli ye hɛngmɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ ke nyɛ li he nɛ e je! 31Wa le kaa Mawu bui yayami peeli tue, se nɔ nɛ yeɔ lɛ gbeye, nɛ e peeɔ Mawu suɔmi nya ní ɔ, Mawu buɔ lɛ tue. 32Kɛ je benɛ a bɔ je ɔ, nɔ ko nɔ ko nui hyɛ kaa a bli nɔ ko nɛ a fɔ lɛ hɛ yuyuilɔ hɛngmɛ? 33Nɔmlɔ nɛ ɔ, ke pi Mawu ngɔ nɛ e je ɔ, jinɛ e ko nyɛ we nɔ́ ko peemi.”
34A he nɔ ke, “Mo nɛ a fɔ mo, nɛ a tsɔse mo ngɛ yayami mi ɔ, o ngɛ hlae nɛ o tsɔɔ wɔ ní?” Kɛkɛ nɛ a fie lɛ kɛ je a jami ɔ mi.
Mumi mi hɛ yuyui
35Yesu nu kaa a fie lɛ kɛ je jami ɔ mi, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, pee se benɛ e na nyumu ɔ, e bi lɛ ke, “O heɔ Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ yeɔ lo?”
36Nyumu ɔ he nɔ ke, “I kpa mo pɛɛ, mɛnɔ ji lɛ, konɛ ma he lɛ ma ye?”
37Yesu de lɛ ke, “O na lɛ momo. Lɛ ji nɔmlɔ nɛ kɛ mo ngɛ munyu tue ɔ nɛ.”
38Nyumu ɔ he nɔ ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, i heɔ yeɔ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ e kpla si ngɛ Yesu hɛ mi.
39Yesu de ke, “I ba je nɛ ɔ mi nɛ ma ba kojo, konɛ hɛ yuyuili nɛ hyɛ nɔ; nɛ nihi nɛ susuɔ kaa a ngɛ nɔ hyɛe ɔ, a hɛ nɛ yu.”
40Benɛ Farisi bi komɛ nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ nu nɛ e de nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, a bi ke, “Anɛ o ngɛ tsɔɔe kaa wɔ hu wa hɛ yu lo?”
41Yesu de mɛ ke, “Kaa nyɛ hɛ yu mohu ɔ, jinɛ yayami be nyɛ he; se jehanɛ ɔ, nyɛ deɔ ke, ‘Wa ngɛ nɔ hyɛe,’ lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ he yayami ɔ ngɛ nyɛ he kɛ mwɔɔ.”

Title: YOHANE 10
Content:
Abɛ nɛ kɔɔ to hyɛlɔ ɔ he
1Yesu de ke, “I ngɛ nyɛ dee anɔkuale mi ke, ke to tsu ngɛ, nɛ nɔ ko ya kuɔ kɛ gu he kpa kɛ sɛ mi, se e gui to tsu ɔ nya a, jamɛatsɛ ɔ, julɔ kɛ ojo fialɔ ji lɛ. 2To hyɛlɔ ɔ, to tsu ɔ nya e guu kɛ sɛɛ mi; 3nɛ agbo ɔ nya bulɔ ɔ bliɔ haa lɛ. To ɔmɛ le e gbi, ejakaa e kɛ a biɛ tsɛɔ mɛ, nɛ e tsɔ́ɔ́ mɛ kɛ jeɔ kpo. 4Ke e je to ɔmɛ kpo ɔ, lɛ nitsɛ e nyɛɛɔ hɛ mi, nɛ to ɔmɛ nyɛɛɔ e se, ejakaa a le e gbi. 5Ke nɔ kpa ko tsɛ to ɔmɛ ɔ, a nyɛɛ we e se, se a tuu fo kɛ jeɔ e he, ejakaa a li nɔ kpa gbi.”
6Yesu tu mɛ munyu nɛ ɔ ngɛ abɛ gbi mi, se a nui sisi.
Yesu ji agbo ɔ
7Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yesu kpale de ekohu ke, “I ngɛ nyɛ dee anɔkuale mi ke imi ji to tsu ɔ nya agbo ɔ nɛ. 8Nihi tsuo nɛ sɛ ye hlami kɛ ba a, juli, kɛ ojo fiali ji mɛ; nɛ to ɔmɛ bui mɛ tue. 9Imi ji agbo ɔ nɛ; nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ba guu agbo ɔ mi kɛ sɛɔ mi ɔ, e yi ma na wami. E maa sɛ mi, nɛ e maa kpale je kpo ya na niye ní. 10Se julɔ ɔ lɛɛ ke e ba a, e ba juɔ; e gbeɔ to ɔmɛ, nɛ e kpataa a hɛ mi. Imi lɛɛ i ba, konɛ nyɛ na wami, nɛ nyɛ na kɛ be nɔ.
Yesu, to hyɛlɔ kpakpa a
11“Imi ji to hyɛlɔ kpakpa a nɛ. I suɔ kaa ma gbo ngɛ to ɔmɛ a he. 12Apaa yelɔ ɔ, pi to hyɛlɔ ji lɛ, ejakaa to ɔmɛ pi e níhi. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke e na ogbetee nɛ ma a, e siɔ to ɔmɛ, nɛ e tuu fo kɛ jeɔ. Kɛkɛ ɔ, ogbetee ɔ ba nuɔ to ɔmɛ, nɛ a gbɛɛ fĩaa. 13Apaa yelɔ ɔ tuɔ fo, ejakaa apaa yelɔ kɛkɛ ji lɛ, nɛ to ɔmɛ a he nɔ dɔɛ lɛ. 14-15 Imi ji to hyɛlɔ kpakpa a nɛ. Tsɛ ɔ le mi, nɛ imi hu i le lɛ; nɛ jã nɔuu i le ye to ɔmɛ, nɛ ye to ɔmɛ hu le mi. Nɛ i suɔ hu kaa ma gbo ngɛ a he. 16I ngɛ to kpa komɛ hulɔ, se mɛɛ a piɛ we kuu nɛ ɔ he. Ma ngɔ mɛ hu kɛ ba; a maa nu ye gbi, nɛ a maa pee to kuu kake, kɛ hyɛlɔ kake.
17“Tsɛ ɔ suɔ mi, ejakaa i suɔ kaa ma ngɔ ye wami kɛ fɔ si, konɛ ma kpale ngɔ. 18Nɔ ko be nyɛe ma kpɔ ye wami ɔ ngɛ ye dɛ. Imi nitsɛ ye tsui mi faa nɛ ma ngɔ kɛ ha. I ngɛ he wami nɛ ma nyɛ ma ngɔ ye wami ɔ ngɔ ha, nɛ ma nyɛ ma kpale ngɔ lɛ ekohu. Kikɛ nɛ ɔ Tsaatsɛ ke ma pee.”
19Munyu nɛ ɔmɛ hu ha nɛ Yuda bi ɔmɛ a mi gba ekohu. 20A ti nihi fuu de ke, “Mumi yayami ngɛ e mi. Nɔmlɔ nɛ ngɛ godo nue ɔ, mɛni he je nyɛ ngɛ lɛ tue bue ɔ?”
21Se ni komɛ hu de ke, “Nɔmlɔ nɛ mumi yayami ngɛ e mi be nyɛe maa tu munyu kikɛ nɛ ɔ. Kɛ mumi yayami ma nyɛ bli hɛ yuyuili a hɛngmɛ kɛɛ?”
Yuda bi ɔmɛ kua Yesu
22-23Be nɛ e su fĩɛ be, nɛ a ngɛ sɔlemi we ɔ he tsukɔmi kaimi yee ngɛ Yerusalem ɔ, Yesu slaa si kɛ ya be ngɛ Salomo ablanaa a mi ngɛ sɔlemi we ɔ. 24Kɛkɛ nɛ Yuda bi ɔmɛ ba bu e nɔ, nɛ a bi lɛ ke, “Kɛ yaa su mɛni be nɛ o ma ha wa yi mi maa pee wɔ sikɔsikɔ ngɛ o he? Anɛ mo ji Kristo ɔ? De wɔ anɔkuale ɔ koo!”
25Yesu he nɔ ke, “Tse i de nyɛ momo nɛ nyɛ he we yi! Tsaatsɛ he wami nya nɛ i tsuɔ ní nɛ ɔmɛ, nɛ níhi nɛ i tsuɔ ɔ yeɔ ye he odase. 26Se nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ he we yi, ejakaa pi ye tohi ji nyɛ. 27Ye to ɔmɛ buɔ mi tue; i le mɛ, nɛ a nyɛɛɔ ye se. 28I haa mɛ neneene wami, nɛ a be gboe gblegbleegble. Nɔ ko nɔ ko be nyɛe ma kpɔ mɛ ngɛ ye dɛ. 29Tsaatsɛ ha mi nɔ́ ko nɛ pe níhi tsuo, nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be nyɛe ma kpɔ ní nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ Tsɛ ɔ dɛ. 30I kɛ Tsɛ ɔ ni kake ji wɔ.”
31Kɛkɛ nɛ Yuda bi ɔmɛ kukuɔ tɛ ekohu nɛ a maa fia Yesu. 32Se Yesu de mɛ ke, “I pee ní kpakpahi babauu nɛ nyɛ na. Níhi nɛ i pee ɔ, Tsɛ ɔ nɛ tsɔɔ mi. Te nɔ́ nɛ he nɛ nyɛ ngɛ hlae nɛ nyɛɛ fia mi tɛ ɔ.”
33 Yuda bi ɔmɛ he nɔ ke, “Tsa pi kpakpa nɛ o pee ɔ he nɛ wa maa fia mo tɛ ɔ, se mohu musu nɛ o bɔ ɔ he. Nɔmlɔ adesa kɛkɛ ji mo, se o peeɔ o he Mawu.”
34 Yesu he nɔ ke, “A ngma ngɛ nyɛ mlaa a mi ke, Mawu de ke, ‘Mawuhi ji nyɛ.’ 35Wa le kaa nɔ nɛ ngmami ɔ deɔ ɔ, anɔkuale sisiisi nɛ́ ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene. Nimli adesahi nɛ Mawu tsɔ nɛ a ngɔ e sɛ gbi ɔ ba ha mɛ ɔ po Mawu tsɛ mɛ ke mawuhi. 36Lɛɛ imi nɛ Tsɛ ɔ hla mi, nɛ e tsɔ mi je ɔ mi ɔ, kɛ peeɔ kɛɛ nɛ ke i de ke Mawu Bi ji mi nɛ́ nyɛ deɔ ke i bɔ musu ɔ? 37Ke i tsu we níhi nɛ Tsaatsɛ ke ma tsu ɔ, lɛɛ nyɛ ko he mi nyɛɛ ye. 38Se ke jamɛ a ní tsumi ɔmɛ i tsuɔ ɔ, lɔ ɔ lɛɛ ke nyɛ he we imi nitsɛ yi po ɔ, níhi nɛ i peeɔ ɔ, nyɛ he nyɛɛ ye mɔ. Kɛkɛ ɔ, nyɛ maa le si kake nyɔngloo kaa Tsɛ ɔ ngɛ ye mi, nɛ imi hu i ngɛ Tsɛ ɔ mi.”
39A ka ekohu kaa a maa nu Yesu, se a nyɛ we; nɛ e je a dɛ mi slɔkee.
40 Jehanɛ ɔ, Yesu kpale e se kɛ ho Yordan pa a se ya ngɛ he nɛ Yohane sɔle nihi ngɛ be ko ɔ, nɛ e ya hi lejɛ ɔ. 41Nihi babauu ba e ngɔ, nɛ a de ke, “Yohane pee we okadi ko lɛɛ, se níhi tsuo nɛ e de ngɛ nɔmlɔ nɛ ɔ he ɔ, anɔkuale sisiisi.” 42Nɛ nihi babauu nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ he lɛ ye.

Title: YOHANE 11
Content:
Lazaro gbenɔ
1 Nyumu ko hi Betania, Maria kɛ Marta a ma a mi. Nyumu nɛ ɔ, a tsɛɛ lɛ Lazaro. Be ko ɔ, Lazaro ba nu hiɔ. 2 Lazaro nɛ ɔ, Maria nɛ ngɔ nu kɛ e he via kɛ pɔ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nane, nɛ e kɛ e yi bwɔmi tsu ɔ nyɛminyumu ji lɛ. 3Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛmiyi ɔmɛ kɛ sɛ mane Yesu ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, o huɛ nɛ o suɔ lɛ ɔ ngɛ gboe.”
4Benɛ Yesu nu kaa Lazaro ngɛ gboe ɔ, e de ke, “Hiɔ nɛ ɔ be Lazaro gbee, se mohu a maa gu enɛ ɔ nɔ kɛ wo Mawu hɛ mi nyami; nɛ enɛ ɔ nɔuu a kɛ maa wo Mawu Bi ɔ hɛ mi nyami.”
5Yesu suɔ Marta kɛ e nyɛmiyo ɔ, kɛ Lazaro saminya. 6Se benɛ e nu Lazaro hiɔ he ɔ, e kpale ye ligbi enyɔ sɔuu ngɛ he nɛ e ngɛ ɔ. 7Kɛkɛ nɛ e de e kaseli ɔmɛ ke, “Nyɛ ha waa kpale wa se kɛ ho Yudea ya.”
8Kaseli ɔmɛ he nɔ ke, “Tsɔɔlɔ, pi lingmi pɛ nɛ Yuda bi ɔmɛ ka mo tɛ fiami, nɛ o yaa lejɛ ɔ ekohu?”
9Yesu he nɔ ke, “Anɛ pi ngmlɛfia nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ nɛ peeɔ ligbi kake? Ke nɔ ko nyɛɛ piani ɔ, e tɛ we si, mɛni he je ɔ, e naa je nɛ ɔ mi la a. 10Se ke nɔ ko nyɛɛ nyɔ mi ɔ, e tɛɔ si, ejakaa la be.” 11Yesu de kɛ gbe nya ke, “Wa huɛ Lazaro hwɔ mahe, se i yaa nɛ ma ya tsɛ̃ɛ̃ lɛ.”
12Kaseli ɔmɛ he nɔ ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, ke mahe e ngɛ hwɔe ɔ, lɛɛ e maa hi ha lɛ.”
13Yesu ngɛ tsɔɔe kaa Lazaro gbo momo, se mɛɛ lɛɛ a susu kaa mahe nitsɛ nɛ e ke Lazaro ngɛ hwɔe. 14Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yesu de mɛ kpoo ke, “Lazaro gbo, 15se e ngɔ ye nya kaa i be lejɛ ɔ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ nyɛ he ye. Nyɛ ha waa ya e ngɔ.”
16Toma nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Hayo hulɔ ɔ, de e nyɛmimɛ kaseli ɔmɛ ke, “Nyɛ ha wɔ hu waa kɛ Tsɔɔlɔ ɔ nɛ ya, nɛ waa kɛ lɛ ya gbo.”
Yesu ji si temi ɔ kɛ wami ɔ
17Benɛ Yesu ba su Betania a, e na kaa Lazaro ye ligbi eywiɛ momo ngɛ yɔkɔ ɔ mi. 18Betania kɛ Yerusalem a kpɛti kɛmi maa pee kaa si tomi enyɔ; 19lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yuda bi babauu ba Marta kɛ Maria a ngɔ, konɛ a ba ye mɛ kɔmɔ ngɛ a nyɛminyumu ɔ gbenɔ ɔ he.
20Benɛ Marta nu kaa Yesu ma a, e je kpo nɛ e kɛ lɛ ya kpe, se Maria lɛɛ e hii si ngɛ we ɔ mi. 21Marta de Yesu ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, kaa o ngɛ hiɛ ɔ jinɛ ye nyɛminyumu ɔ ko gbo we. 22Se amlɔ nɛ ɔ hu, i le kaa nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ he pɛɛ nɛ o ma kpa Mawu ɔ, e maa pee ha mo.”
23Yesu de lɛ ke, “O nyɛminyumu ɔ maa te si kɛ ba wami mi ekohu.”
24Marta he nɔ ke, “I le kaa nyagbe ligbi ɔ nɛ ni gbogboehi maa te si ɔ, e maa te si kɛ ba wami mi.” 25Yesu de lɛ ke, “Imi ji si temi ɔ, kɛ wami ɔ nɛ. Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ heɔ mi yeɔ ɔ, ke e gbo tete po, e maa hi hɛ ngmengmle; 26nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ hɛ ngɛ, nɛ e heɔ mi yeɔ ɔ, e be gboe gblegbleegble. O heɔ enɛ ɔ yeɔ lo?”
27Marta he nɔ ke, “Ee Nyɔmtsɛ, i heɔ yeɔ kaa mo ji Kristo ɔ nɛ! Mo ji Mawu Bi ɔ nɛ ma je ɔ mi ɔ nɛ.”
Yesu fo ya
28Benɛ Marta de enɛ ɔ, e kpale e se kɛ ho nɛ e ya tsɛ e nyɛmiyo Maria zaa. E de lɛ ke, “Tsɔɔlɔ ɔ ba, nɛ e ngɛ o si bie.” 29Benɛ Maria nu enɛ ɔ, e te si pam, nɛ e je kpo esɔ, nɛ e kɛ Yesu ya kpe. 30Yesu na we nɛ e su kɔpe ɔ mi lolo; mohu ɔ, he nɛ Marta kɛ lɛ ya kpe ngɛ ɔ, lejɛ ɔ nɔuu nɛ e ngɛ kɛ mwɔɔ. 31Yuda bi ɔmɛ nɛ kɛ Maria ngɛ we ɔ mi, nɛ a ngɛ lɛ kɔmɔ yee ɔ na bɔ nɛ e te si nɛ e sá e he kɛ je kpo, nɛ a nyɛɛ e se. A susu kaa e yaa yɔkɔ ɔ he nɛ e ya fo ya ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.
32Maria ya su he nɛ Yesu ngɛ ɔ, nɛ amlɔ nɔuu nɛ e na Yesu ɔ, e kpla si ngɛ Yesu nane nya, nɛ e de lɛ ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, kaa o ngɛ hiɛ ɔ jinɛ ye nyɛminyumu ɔ ko gbo we.”
33Yesu na kaa Maria ngɛ ya foe; nɛ jehanɛ ɔ, bɔ nɛ Yuda bi ɔmɛ nɛ piɛ Maria he ɔ hu ngɛ ya foe ɔ ha Yesu hao ngɛ mumi mi. 34E bi mɛ ke, “Jije nyɛ to lɛ ngɛ?”
A he nɔ ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, ba nɛ o ba hyɛ.”
35Yesu fo ya. 36Kɛkɛ nɛ Yuda bi ɔmɛ de ke, “Hyɛ bɔ nɛ e suɔ lɛ ha!”
37Se ni komɛ de ke, “Pi lɛ nɛ e bli hɛ yuyuilɔ ɔ hɛngmɛ ɔ! Anɛ e ko nyɛ we nɛ e pee nɛ Lazaro kó gbo we lo?”
Yesu tle Lazaro si kɛ ba wami mi ekohu
38Yesu hao ngɛ mumi mi ekohu, nɛ e pue nɔ kɛ ho yɔkɔ ɔ he ya. Tɛ puɔ nɛ a ngɔ tɛ kɛ tsi nya ji yɔkɔ ɔ. 39Yesu fa mɛ ke, “Nyɛ je tɛ ɔ.”
Marta, nyumu ɔ nɛ gbo ɔ nyɛmiyo ɔ he nɔ ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, be nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, nɔ ɔ puɛ, ejakaa ligbi eywiɛ sɔuu ji nɛ ɔ nɛ e gbo.”
40Yesu de lɛ ke, “Anɛ i de we mo ke, ke o he ye ɔ, o maa na Mawu hɛ mi nyami ɔ lo?” 41Jehanɛ a je tɛ ɔ; kɛkɛ nɛ Yesu wo e hɛ nɔ nɛ e hyɛ hiɔwe, nɛ e de ke, “Tsaatsɛ, i naa mo si kaa o buɔ mi tue. 42I le kaa o buɔ mi tue be tsuaa be; se i ngɛ enɛ ɔ dee ngɛ nihi nɛ pueɔ si nɛ ɔ a he, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ a he ye kaa mo nɛ o tsɔ mi.” 43Benɛ e de enɛ ɔ se ɔ, e tsɛ lɛ kɛ gbi wawɛɛ ke, “Lazaro lee-ee, jee kpo!” 44Kɛkɛ nɛ gbogboe ɔ je kpo. Bo nɛ a kɛ pu lɛ ɔ blaa e nine kɛ e nane, nɛ duku fi e hɛ mi. Yesu de mɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ pɛne lɛ nɛ nyɛ ha e ya.”
A so Yesu yi nɔ
(Mateo 26.1-5; Marko 14.1-2; Luka 22.1-2)
45Yuda bi ɔmɛ nɛ ba Maria ngɔ ɔ, a ti nihi babauu na nɔ nɛ Yesu pee ɔ, nɛ a he lɛ ye. 46Se a ti ni komɛ pue nɔ kɛ ho nɛ a ya sɛɛ níhi nɛ Yesu pee ɔ ha Farisi bi ɔmɛ. 47Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ, kɛ Farisi bi ɔmɛ tsɛ kpe ngua a mi bi ɔmɛ kɛ kpe, nɛ a de ke, “Kɛ wa maa pee kɛɛ? Nyɛɛ hyɛ níhi tsuo nɛ nyumu nɛ ɔ ngɛ pee kɛ ngɛ okadi toe. 48Ke wa ngmɛ lɛ blɔ nɛ e ya nɔ ngɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ pee ɔ, ma a tsuo ma he lɛ maa ye. Kɛkɛ ɔ, Roma bi ɔmɛ maa ba ba kpata wa sɔlemi we ɔ, kɛ wa ma a tsuo hɛ mi.”
49A ti nɔ kake nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Kayafa, nɛ ngɛ osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa yee jamɛ a jeha a de ke, “Nyɛ biɛ pɛ! 50Anɛ nyɛ li kaa ke nyɛ ha nɔ kake mohu gbo ngɛ ma a tsuo nane mi ɔ, e hi pe nɛ a ma kpata ma a tsuo hɛ mi lo?” 51Se anɔkuale mi ɔ, pi lɛ nitsɛ e yi mi nɛ e to kɛ de enɛ ɔ. Mohu ɔ, akɛnɛ lɛ nɛ ngɛ osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa yee jamɛ a jeha a nɛ e ngɛ gbae kaa Yesu ma gbo ngɛ Yuda bi ɔmɛ a nane mi. 52Pohu pi ma a nane mi kɛkɛ, se e ma bua Mawu bimɛ tsuo nɛ gbɛ fĩa hu a nya kɛ pee kake.
53Kɛ je jamɛ a ligbi ɔ kɛ yaa a, Yuda ma nimeli ɔmɛ so kaa a maa gbe Yesu. 54Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yesu nyɛɛ we ngɛ Yuda bi ɔmɛ a kpɛti nɛ a na lɛ paa hu. Se e je kɛ ho nga a nɔ ya, nɛ e kɛ e kaseli ɔmɛ ya hi ma ko nɛ a tsɛɛ Efraim ɔ.
55Jehanɛ ɔ, Hetsɔmi nyami be ɔ su ta; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nihi babauu nɛ je ngmɔ si ɔ pue nɔ kɛ ho Yerusalem ya. Kusumi nɛ a peeɔ kɛ tsukɔɔ a he ɔ, a ya konɛ a ya pee loko nyami be ɔ nɛ su. 56Ni ɔmɛ bɔni Yesu hlami, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, benɛ a ya bua a he nya ngɛ sɔlemi we ɔ, a bi a he ke, “Anɛ e maa ba Hetsɔmi nyami ɔ, loo e be bae?” 57Osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ, kɛ Farisi bi ɔmɛ ya wo ma a si kaa nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ le he nɛ Yesu ngɛ ɔ, e ba wo a tue nɔ, konɛ a ya nu lɛ.

Title: YOHANE 12
Content:
A pɔ Yesu nu ngɛ Betania
(Mateo 26.6-13; Marko 14.3-9)
1Jehanɛ ɔ, benɛ e piɛ ligbi ekpa nɛ a maa ye Hetsɔmi ɔ, Yesu ba Betania, he nɛ Lazaro nɛ gbo nɛ Yesu tle lɛ si kɛ je gbeje ɔ ngɛ ɔ. 2A pee niye ní ha Yesu, nɛ Marta sɔmɔ lɛ. Lazaro piɛ nihi nɛ a kɛ Yesu ye ní ɔ a he. 3 Kɛkɛ nɛ Maria ngɔ nardo nu ngmingmiingmi nɛ he jua wa saminya lita fa, nɛ e kɛ ba pɔ Yesu nane, nɛ e kɛ e yi bwɔmi tsu e nane ɔmɛ a he. Nu ɔ he via a kpe we ɔ mi tsuo; 4lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yuda Iskariot, Yesu kaseli ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake nɛ maa tsɔɔ e se blɔ ɔ bi ke, 5“Mɛni he je nɛ a jua we nu kɛ e he via nɛ ɔ sika hiɔ yi lafa etɛ nɛ a kɛ ha ohiatsɛmɛ?” 6Se enɛ ɔ nɛ e de ɔ, pi kaa ohiatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a he nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ lɛ dɔe. Mohu julɔ ji lɛ; nɛ akɛnɛ sika kpɛɛ ɔ ngɛ e dɛ ɔ, ke pee ɔ, e juɔ nɔ́ nɛ a ngɔ woɔ mi ɔ eko.
7Se Yesu he nɔ ke, “Koo doo e nya; e pee nɔ nɛ ɔ ngɔ to ye pumi be. 8 Ohiatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ kɛ mɛ ngɛ daa, se imi lɛɛ pi daa nɛ i kɛ nyɛ maa hi si.”
A so Lazaro yi nɔ
9Yuda bi babauu nu Yesu he ngɛ Betania, nɛ a bu kɛ ba kaa a maa na lɛ, kɛ Lazaro nɛ e tle si kɛ je gbeje ɔ hulɔ. 10Enɛ ɔ he ɔ, osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ ya so nɛ a maa gbe Lazaro hulɔ, 11ejakaa e he ɔ, Yuda bi ɔmɛ a ti nihi babauu kua mɛ, nɛ a ya he Yesu ye.
Yesu Yerusalem sɛmi
(Mateo 21.1-11; Marko 11.1-11; Luka 19.28-40)
12E nɔ jena a, nimli kpekpemi ɔ nɛ ba nɛ a ba ye Hetsɔmi nyami ɔ nu kaa Yesu ma Yerusalem. 13 Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a kukuɔ tã ba, nɛ a je kpo, nɛ a kɛ lɛ ya kpe kɛ a nɔ ose ke, “Mo kpɔ wɔ oo! Mawu nɛ gbaa nɔ nɛ ma ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ biɛ mi ɔ! Mawu nɛ gbaa Israel matsɛ ɔ!”
14Yesu na teji ko nɛ e hi nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ a ngma a ke,
15 “Zion biyo, koo ye gbeye!
O matsɛ ɔ ma.
E hi teji bi nɔ.”
16Jamɛ a be ɔ, e kaseli ɔmɛ nui nɔ́ nɛ ɔ sisi; se benɛ a tle Yesu si, nɛ a wo e hɛ mi nyami se ɔ, a kai kaa a ngma nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ngɛ Yesu he, nɛ e ba mi.
17Nihi nɛ a kɛ Yesu nyɛɛ benɛ e tsɛ Lazaro ngɛ yɔkɔ ɔ mi, nɛ e tle lɛ si kɛ je gbeje ɔ ya sɛɛ nɔ́ nɛ Yesu pee ɔ. 18Kikɛmɛ a okadi nɛ ɔ nɛ e to mɛ ɔ he nɛ ma kpekpemi ɔ ya kpee lɛ ɔ nɛ. 19Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Farisi bi ɔmɛ de a he ke, “Tse nyɛ na kaa nyɛ nyɛ we nɔ́ ko nɛ nyɛɛ pee. Hyɛ, je ɔ tsuo nɛ hia kɛ nyɛɛ e se ɔ nɛ.”
Hela bi komɛ ba hla Yesu
20Nihi nɛ ya Mawu jami ngɛ Yerusalem nyami be ɔ, Hela bi komɛ piɛ a he. 21Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ ba Filipo nɛ je Betsaida ngɛ Galilea a ngɔ, nɛ a ba de lɛ ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, wa ngɛ hlae nɛ waa na Yesu.”
22Filipo hu ya de Andrea, nɛ mɛ ni enyɔ ɔmɛ a ya bɔ Yesu amaniɛ. 23Yesu he nɔ ke, “Jehanɛ lɛɛ be ɔ su nɛ a maa wo Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ hɛ mi nyami babauu. 24I ngɛ nyɛ dee anɔkuale mi ke, ke a du we ngma ngu ngɛ zu mi, nɛ e gbo ɔ, lɛɛ ngma ngu kake ngmelu ji lɛ daa. Se ke e gbo ɔ, e woɔ yiblii babauu. 25 Nɔ nɛ suɔ e wami ɔ, e wami ɔ maa laa lɛ; se nɔ nɛ ngɔɔ e wami ngɔ haa ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, e maa to e wami ɔ kɛ maa ya neneene. 26Ke nɔ ko suɔ kaa e ma sɔmɔ mi ɔ, e nyɛɛ ye se, kɛkɛ ɔ, i kɛ ye tsɔlɔ ɔ maa hi he kake. Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ma sɔmɔ mi ɔ, Tsaatsɛ maa wo e hɛ mi nyami.”
Yesu tu e gbenɔ he munyu
27Yesu de ke, “Jehanɛ lɛɛ ye mumi ngɛ haoe ngɛ ye mi, nɛ i li nɔ nɛ ma de. Anɛ ma de Tsaatsɛ nɛ e tsi amanehlu nɛ ɔ nya nɛ e ko ba ye nɔ lo? Dɛbi! Lɔ ɔ nɔuu he nɛ i ba, konɛ ma ba gblee be nɛ ɔ kɛ e mi nɔ́ nami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ mi. 28Tsaatsɛ, wo mo nitsɛ o hɛ mi nyami!”
Kɛkɛ nɛ gbi ko je hiɔwe de ke, “I wo ye hɛ mi nyami momo, se ma kpale pee ekohu.”
29Benɛ nimli kpekpemi ɔ nɛ daa si ngɛ lejɛ ɔ nu gbi ɔ, a ti ni komɛ de ke, “Hiɔwe si”; nɛ ni komɛ hu de ke, “Hiɔwe bɔfo ko kɛ lɛ tu munyu.”
30Se Yesu de mɛ ke, “Gbi nɛ ɔ, pi imi ye he nɛ e pɛ, nyɛ mohu nyɛ he. 31Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, be ɔ su nɛ a maa kojo je ɔ, nɛ nɔ nɛ ngɛ je ɔ nɔ matsɛ yee ɔ, a ma kpa lɛ. 32Ke a wo ye nɔ kɛ je zugba a nɔ ɔ, ma gbla nihi tsuo kɛ ba ye ngɔ.” 33Munyu nɛ e tu nɛ ɔ tsɔɔ nɔ gbenɔ nɛ e ma gbo.
34 Ma kpekpemi ɔ he nɔ ke, “Wa mlaa a de ke Kristo ɔ maa hi si kɛ maa ya neneene. Kɛ pee kɛɛ nɛ moo lɛɛ o deɔ ke a ma wo Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ nɔ ɔ? Mɛnɔ ji kikɛmɛ a Nɔmlɔ Bi nɛ ɔ?”
35Yesu he nɔ ke, “Be bɔɔ ko pɛ nɛ e piɛ nɛ la a kɛ nyɛ maa hi si kɛ yaa si. Be mi nɛ la a ngɛ nɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ nyɛɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ, konɛ diblii ɔ nɛ ko ba na nyɛ, ejakaa nɔ nɛ nyɛɛɔ diblii mi ɔ, e li he nɛ e yaa. 36Be abɔ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ la a nɛ ɔ, nyɛ he lɛ nyɛɛ ye, konɛ nyɛ plɛ la a bimɛ.”
Yuda bi ɔmɛ he we yi
Munyu nɛ ɔ se ɔ, Yesu je a he ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, nɛ e ya laa e he. 37Yesu pee ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ to okadi ngɛ ni ɔmɛ a hɛ mi paa, se a he we lɛ yi, 38 bɔ nɛ pee nɛ gbalɔ Yesaya munyu ɔ nɛ ba mi. Yesaya de ke,
“Nyɔmtsɛ, munyu nɛ wa fiɛ ɔ, mɛnɔ lɛ he ye?
Mɛnɔ lɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ je e he si tsɔɔ?”
39Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a nyɛ we nɛ a he ye, ejakaa Yesaya de hu ke,
40 “Mawu ma a hɛngmɛ,
nɛ e tsi a juɛmi nya hulɔ,
konɛ a hɛngmɛ ko hyɛ nɔ́,
nɛ a ko nu nɔ́ sisi.
Mawu pee mɛ kikɛ nɛ ɔ,
konɛ a ko kpale kɛ ba e ngɔ
nɛ a tsa mɛ.”
41Yesaya de enɛ ɔ, ejakaa e na Yesu hɛ mi nyami ɔ ngɛ e hɛ mi lokoo, nɛ e tu he munyu.
42Yuda ma nimeli ɔmɛ a ti nihi babauu he Yesu ye, se Farisi bi ɔmɛ a he ɔ, a nyɛ we nɛ a ye odase paa, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ a ko fie mɛ ngɛ kpe he ɔ. 43A suɔ kaa a sa nimli a hɛ mi pe nɛ a maa pee nɔ nɛ sa Mawu hɛ mi.
Yesu munyu kojoɔ nɔ
44Yesu de kɛ ngmlaa ke, “Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ heɔ mi yeɔ ɔ, pi imi nɛ e he ye, se mohu nɔ nɛ tsɔ mi ɔ nɛ e he ye ɔ nɛ. 45Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ na mi ɔ, e na nɔ nɛ tsɔ mi ɔ. 46Imi lɛɛ i ba je ɔ mi kaa la, konɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ heɔ mi yeɔ ɔ, e ko hi diblii ɔ mi. 47Ke nɔ ko nu ye munyu ɔ, se e yi nɔ ɔ, pi imi nɛ ma kojo lɛ. I bɛ nɛ ma ba kojo je ɔ; se mohu i ba nɛ ma ba he je ɔ yi wami. 48Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ kua mi, nɛ e ngɔɛ munyu nɛ i fiɛ ɔ hulɔ ɔ, nɔ ko ngɛ nɛ maa kojo lɛ. Nyagbe ligbi ɔ, munyu ɔmɛ nɛ i tu ɔ maa kojo lɛ. 49Anɔkuale munyu ji nɛ ɔ nɛ, ejakaa níhi tsuo nɛ i de ɔ, pi imi nitsɛ ye yi mi nɛ i to kɛ de ekoeko. Tsɛ ɔ nɛ tsɔ mi ɔ lɛ fa ke ma de. 50I le kaa nɔ́ nɛ Tsɛ ɔ fa ke e ba mi ɔ haa neneene wami; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ e de mi ɔ, lɔ ɔ i deɔ.”

Title: YOHANE 13
Content:
Yesu fɔ e kaseli ɔmɛ a nane he
1Benɛ e piɛ ligbi kake loko a maa ye Hetsɔmi nyami ɔ, Yesu na kaa jehanɛ lɛɛ be ɔ su nɛ e ma si je ɔ mi kɛ ho Tsɛ ɔ ngɔ ya. Yesu suɔ nihi tsuo nɛ he lɛ ye ngɛ je ɔ mi ɔ saminya kɛ ya si e gbenɔ mi po.
2Gbɔkuɛ, benɛ Yesu kɛ e kaseli ɔmɛ ba bua kɛ ngɛ ní yee ɔ, jamɛ a be ɔ, Abosiami wo Simon Iskariot bi Yuda yi mi momo kaa e tsɔɔ Yesu se blɔ. 3Yesu nitsɛ le kaa Tsɛ ɔ ha lɛ he wami tsuo nɛ e kɛ pee nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́. E le hu kaa Mawu ngɔ nɛ e je kɛ ba, nɛ Mawu ngɔ nɔuu e kpale kɛ yaa. 4Kɛkɛ nɛ Yesu te si ngɛ niye ní ɔ he; nɛ e je e tade klɔii ɔ ngɔ fɔ si, nɛ e ngɔ papahu kɛ muɔ e mlɛ mi. 5Jehanɛ e plɛ nyu ngɔ wo tsɛ̃si mi, nɛ e bɔni kaseli ɔmɛ a nane he fɔmi; nɛ e kɛ papahu nɛ e kɛ muɔ e mlɛ mi ɔ tsu a nane ɔ he. 6Benɛ e ba su Simon Petro ngɔ ɔ, Simon bi lɛ ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, mo lɛ o ma fɔ ye nane he ɔ?”
7Yesu he nɔ ke, “Nɔ nɛ i ngɛ pee nɛ ɔ, amlɔ nɛ ɔ, o nui sisi; se pee se ɔ, o ma ba le.”
8Petro de lɛ ke, “Dɛbi, ko fɔ ye nane he kɔkɔɔkɔ.”
Yesu he nɔ ke, “Ke i fɔ we o nane he ɔ lɛɛ o pi ye kaselɔ hu.”
9Simon Petro he nɔ ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, lɛɛ tsa pi ye nane he kɛkɛ nɛ sa kaa o fɔ mɔ; fɔ ye nine he, kɛ ye yi mi tsuo.”
10Yesu he nɔ ke, “Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ du e he ɔ, e he tsɔ kɛ pi si momo; nɛ e hia we kaa e fɔ lɛ nɔmlɔ tso ɔ he pe e nane he pɛ. Nyɛ he tsɔ, se pi nyɛ tsuo.” 11Yesu le nɔmlɔ nɛ maa tsɔɔ e se blɔ ɔ momo, lɔ ɔ he nɛ e de ke a he tsɔ se pi mɛ tsuo ɔ nɛ.
12 Benɛ Yesu fɔ a nane he ta a, e kpale wo e tade klɔii ɔ, nɛ e ya hi si ngɛ niye ní ɔ he. Jehanɛ e bi kaseli ɔmɛ ke, “Nɔ́ nɛ i pee ha nyɛ piɔ ɔ, nyɛ nu sisi lɛɛ? 13Tse nyɛ tsɛɔ mi Tsɔɔlɔ, nɛ nyɛ tsɛɔ mi Nyɔmtsɛ hulɔ! Saminya, e ngɛ mi jã. 14Jehanɛ ɔ, imi nyɛ Nyɔmtsɛ, kɛ nyɛ Tsɔɔlɔ ɔ, ke i fɔ nyɛ nane he ɔ, e sa kaa nyɛ hu nyɛ fɔ nyɛ sibi a nane he. 15Imi lɛɛ i pee enɛ ɔ nɛ nyɛɛ hyɛ, nɛ nyɛ hu nyɛ pee ha nyɛ sibi. 16 I ngɛ nyɛ dee anɔkuale mi ke nyɔguɛ pã we e nyɔmtsɛ, nɛ tsɔlɔ hu pã we nɔ nɛ tsɔ lɛ ɔ. 17Amlɔ nɛ ɔ nɛ nyɛ na le anɔkuale ɔ, ke nyɛ tsu e nya ní ɔ, a gbaa nyɛ!
18 “Pi nyɛ tsuo nyɛ he nɛ i ngɛ enɛ ɔ dee; ejakaa nihi nɛ i hla a, i le bɔ nɛ a ngɛ. Se e sa kaa ngmami ɔ nɛ deɔ ke, ‘Nɔmlɔ nɛ kɛ mi dla ye abolo ɔ te si ngɔ si mi,’ ɔ nɛ ba mi. 19Nɔ́ nɛ maa ba a, i ngɛ nyɛ dee loko e ba mi, konɛ ke e ba mi ɔ, nyɛ he ye kaa ‘Imi ji nɔ nɛ i ji ɔ nɛ.’ 20 I ngɛ nyɛ dee anɔkuale mi ke, nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ heɔ nɔ nɛ i tsɔ lɛ atuu ɔ, imi nɔuu e he ɔ nɛ; nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ heɔ mi ɔ, nɔ nɛ tsɔ mi ɔ e he ɔ nɛ.”
Yesu de to ke a maa tsɔɔ e se blɔ
(Mateo 26.20-25; Marko 14.17-21; Luka 22.21-23)
21Benɛ Yesu de ní nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, e hao wawɛɛ ngɛ mumi mi; nɛ e gba mi kpoo nɛ e de ke, “I ngɛ nyɛ dee anɔkuale mi ke, nyɛ ti nɔ kake maa tsɔɔ ye se blɔ.”
22E kaseli ɔmɛ pee yaa, nɛ a hyɛ a sibi a hɛ mi dii; ejakaa nɔ nɛ tutuutu he munyu nɛ e ngɛ tue ɔ, a li. 23E kaseli ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake, nɔ nɛ Yesu suɔ lɛ ɔ, hii si ngɛ e kasa nya. 24Simon Petro ma lɛ hɛngmɛ ke e bi Yesu nɔ nɛ he munyu nɛ e ngɛ tue ɔ.
25Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, jamɛ a kaselɔ ɔ hɛ lɛ kɛ su Yesu he haa, nɛ e bi lɛ ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, mɛnɔ?”
26Yesu he nɔ ke, “Ma ngɔ abolo kɛ sɔ flɔɔ ɔ mi; nɛ nɔ nɛ dɛ mi nɛ ma ngɔ wo ɔ, lɛ ji jamɛatsɛ ɔ nɛ.” Kɛkɛ nɛ e kɛ̃ abolo popoe, nɛ e ngɔ sɔ flɔɔ ɔ mi; nɛ e kɛ ha Yuda, Simon Iskariot bi ɔ. 27Amlɔ nɔuu nɛ Yuda sɔle abolo ɔ, Abosiami sɛ e mi. Yesu de lɛ ke, “Nɔ nɛ o ngɛ pee ɔ, pee esɔ.” 28Se ni nɛmɛ nɛ hii si ngɛ okplɔɔ ɔ he ɔ, a ti nɔ ko nɔ ko li nɔ́ nɛ he nɛ Yesu de lɛ enɛ ɔ. 29Akɛnɛ Yuda nɛ hɛɛɔ sika kpɛɛ ɔ, kaseli ɔmɛ ekomɛ susu kaa alini Yesu tsɔ lɛ ke e ya he ní nɛ hia nɛ a kɛ maa ye nyami be ɔ, aloo e ngɔ nɔ́ ko ya ha ohiatsɛmɛ.
30Yuda sɔle abolo popoe ɔ, nɛ e je kpo amlɔ nɔuu. Jamɛ a be ɔ, je jɔ.
Mlaa he ɔ
31Benɛ Yuda je kpo se ɔ, Yesu de ke, “Jehanɛ ɔ, a wo Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ hɛ mi nyami; nɛ a gu e nɔ kɛ wo Mawu hɛ mi nyami. 32Nɛ ke a gu Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ nɔ kɛ wo Mawu hɛ mi nyami ɔ, Mawu nitsɛ hu maa wo Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ hɛ mi nyami. E ma tsu nɔ́ nɛ ɔ amlɔ nɔuu. 33 Ye bimɛ, be nɛ i kɛ nyɛ maa hi si kɛ yaa si ɔ pi saasaa. Nyɛ ma hla mi, se kaa bɔ nɛ i de Yuda ma nimeli ɔmɛ ɔ, ‘He nɛ i yaa a, nyɛ be nyɛe maa ba.’ 34 Jehanɛ ɔ, mlaa he i ngɛ nyɛ woe; nyɛɛ suɔ nyɛ sibi kaa bɔ nɛ i suɔ nyɛ ɔ. 35Ke nyɛ suɔ nyɛ sibi ɔ, kɛkɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ maa le kaa ye kaseli ji nyɛ.”
Yesu de to ke Petro ma de ke e li lɛ
(Mateo 26.31-35; Marko 14.27-31; Luka 22.31-34)
36Simon Petro bi lɛ ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, jije po o yaa?”
Yesu he nɔ ke, “He nɛ i yaa a, amlɔ nɛ ɔ lɛɛ o be ye se nyɛe maa nyɛɛ; se pee se ɔ, o ma ba nyɛɛ ye se.”
37Petro de lɛ ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, mɛni ma ha nɛ i be nyɛe ma nyɛɛ o se amlɔ nɛ ɔ? Gbenɔ tete po ma gbo ngɛ o he.”
38Yesu he nɔ ke, “Ei! O ma gbo ngɛ imi ye he? I ngɛ mo dee anɔkuale mi ke, loko kungwɔ ma kpa nɔ hwɔɔ ɔ, o ma de si etɛ ke o li mi.”

Title: YOHANE 14
Content:
Yesu ji blɔ nɛ a kɛ yaa Tsɛ ɔ ngɔ
1Yesu de e kaseli ɔmɛ ke, “Nyɛ ko ye nyɛ tsui. Nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ he Mawu nyɛɛ ye; nɛ imi hu nyɛ he mi nyɛɛ ye. 2Sihi hehi babauu ngɛ Tsaatsɛ we ɔ; ke pi ja a, jinɛ i de nyɛ momo, ejakaa i yaa nɛ ma ya dla he ko ngɔ to nyɛ. 3Ke i ya nɛ i ya dla he ko kɛ to nyɛ se ɔ, ma kpale kɛ ba, nɛ ma ba ngɔ nyɛ kɛ ya hi imi nitsɛ ye ngɔ. Kɛkɛ ɔ, he nɛ i ngɛ ɔ, nyɛ hu nyɛɛ maa hi lejɛ ɔ. 4Nyɛ le he nɛ i yaa, nɛ blɔ ɔ hu nyɛ le.”
5Toma bi lɛ ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, he nɛ o yaa a po wa li, nɛ kɛ wa maa pee kɛ le blɔ ɔ nɛ a kɛ yaa lejɛ ɔ kɛɛ?”
6Yesu he nɔ ke, “Imi ji blɔ ɔ, imi ji anɔkuale ɔ, nɛ imi ji wami ɔ hulɔ. Nɔ ko nɔ ko yɛ Tsɛ ɔ ngɔ kaa ja e gu ye nɔ. 7Kaa nyɛ le mi jinɛ nyɛ ko le Tsaatsɛ hulɔ. Kɛ je be nɛ ɔ mi kɛ yaa nɛ ɔ, nyɛ le lɛ, ejakaa nyɛ na lɛ.”
8Filipo de lɛ ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, tsɔɔ wɔ Tsɛ ɔ, kɛkɛ nɔ ko be wɔ hiae hu.”
9Yesu he nɔ ke, “Filipo, be babauu nɛ i kɛ nyɛ hi si nɛ ɔ, kɛ pee kɛɛ nɛ o li mi ɔ? Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ na mi ɔ, e na Tsɛ ɔ. Mɛni he je mɔ nɛ o deɔ ke ma tsɔɔ nyɛ Tsɛ ɔ? 10Filipo, anɛ o he we yi kaa i ngɛ Tsɛ ɔ mi, nɛ Tsɛ ɔ ngɛ ye mi lo? Munyuhi nɛ i kɛ nyɛ tu ɔ, pi imi nitsɛ ye yi mi nɛ i to kɛ de. Mohu Tsɛ ɔ nɛ guu ye nɔ kɛ peeɔ ní nɛ ɔmɛ. 11Ke i de ke i ngɛ Tsɛ ɔ mi, nɛ Tsɛ ɔ ngɛ ye mi ɔ, nyɛ he ye munyu ɔ nyɛɛ ye. Ke nɔ́ nɛ i de ɔ nɛ nyɛ he we yi pohu ɔ, lɛɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ i tsu ɔ a he ɔ, nyɛ he ye mɔ. 12I ngɛ nyɛ dee anɔkuale mi ke, nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ heɔ mi yeɔ ɔ, níhi nɛ i tsuɔ kɛ toɔ okadi ɔ, lɛ hu e ma tsu. Ee, e maa pee níhi nɛ pe enɛ ɔmɛ tete po, ejakaa i je kɛ yaa Tsaatsɛ ngɔ. 13Ke nyɛ kpa nɔ́ ko he pɛɛ ngɛ ye biɛ mi ɔ, ma pee; kɛkɛ ɔ, kɛ gu Bi ɔ nɔ ɔ, a maa wo Tsɛ ɔ hɛ mi nyami. 14Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ ma kpa he pɛɛ ngɛ ye biɛ mi ɔ, ma pee.
Yesu wo Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ he si
15“Ke nyɛ suɔ mi ɔ, nyɛ maa ye ye mlaa amɛ a nɔ. 16Kɛkɛ ɔ, ma kpa Tsɛ ɔ pɛɛ, nɛ e ma ha nyɛ Hepiɛlɔ kpa nɛ kɛ nyɛ maa hi si daa. 17Lɛ ji anɔkuale mumi nɛ tsɔɔ nihi bɔ nɛ tutuutu nɛ Mawu ngɛ ɔ. Je mi bi ɔmɛ ngɔɛ lɛ, ejakaa a nɛ́ lɛ, nɛ a li lɛ hulɔ. Se nyɛɛ lɛ nyɛ le lɛ, ejakaa e kɛ nyɛ ngɛ, nɛ e ngɛ nyɛ mi.
18“I be nyɛ sie awusa; ma kpale kɛ ba nyɛ ngɔ. 19E piɛ bɔɔ pɛ nɛ je ɔ be mi nae hu; se nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ maa na mi. Nɛ akɛnɛ i ngɛ wami mi ɔ, nyɛ hu nyɛ maa hi wami mi. 20Ke jamɛ a be ɔ su ɔ, nyɛ maa le kaa i ngɛ Tsaatsɛ mi, nɛ nyɛ hu nyɛ ngɛ ye mi kaa bɔ nɛ imi hu i ngɛ nyɛ mi ɔ.
21“Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ngɔɔ ye mlaa amɛ nɛ e yeɔ a nɔ ɔ, e suɔ mi; nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ suɔ mi ɔ, Tsaatsɛ maa suɔ lɛ. Jehanɛ imi hu ma suɔ lɛ, nɛ ma ha nɛ e le mi saminya.”
22Yuda (pi Yuda Iskariot) bi lɛ ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, kɛ pee kɛɛ nɛ wɔ pɛ nɛ o ma ha nɛ waa le mo, se pi je ɔ tsuo ɔ?”
23Yesu he nɔ ke, “Ke nɔ ko suɔ mi ɔ, e maa ye ye munyu ɔmɛ a nɔ. Kɛkɛ ɔ, Tsaatsɛ maa suɔ lɛ, nɛ wa maa ba e ngɔ, nɛ waa kɛ lɛ ma ba hi si. 24Nɔ nɛ sume mi ɔ, e yi ye munyu ɔmɛ a nɔ. Munyuhi nɛ nyɛ nu ngɛ ye nya a, pi imi nitsɛ ye yi mi tomi, se mohu Tsɛ ɔ nɛ tsɔ mi ɔ lɛ ha mi sɛ gbi ɔ.
25“I de nyɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ be mi nɛ i kɛ nyɛ ngɛ kɛ mwɔɔ ɔ. 26Tsɛ ɔ maa wo Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ blɔ kɛ ba nyɛ ngɔ. Hepiɛlɔ nɛ ɔ maa ba ngɛ ye biɛ mi, nɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ hia kaa nyɛɛ le ɔ, e maa tsɔɔ nyɛ; nɛ nihi tsuo nɛ i de nyɛ ɔ, e ma kai nyɛ.
27“I ngɛ nyɛ sie kɛ he jɔmi. Imi nitsɛ ye he jɔmi i ngɛ sie ha nyɛ. Pi bɔ nɛ je ɔ haa a nɛ i kɛ ngɛ nyɛ hae ɔ. Nyɛ ko ye nyɛ tsui; nɛ nyɛ ko je fɔ̃ hulɔ. 28I de nyɛ momo ke, ‘I yaa, se ma kpale kɛ ba nyɛ ngɔ.’ Nyɛ nu! Kaa nyɛ suɔ mi ɔ, jinɛ nyɛ ko na bua jɔmi kaa i yaa Tsɛ ɔ ngɔ, ejakaa e pe mi. 29I ngɛ nyɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ dee ngɔ to loko a ba mi, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ ke a ba mi ɔ, nyɛ he ye. 30I kɛ nyɛ be munyu tue be kɛkɛ hu, ejakaa nɔ nɛ yeɔ je nɛ ɔ nɔ matsɛ ɔ ma. E be he wami ko ngɛ imi ye nɔ; 31se e sa kaa je ɔ tsuo nɛ le kaa i suɔ Tsɛ ɔ, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ e fa a, i peeɔ.
“Nyɛɛ te nɛ waa je hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ!

Title: YOHANE 15
Content:
Yesu ji wai tso nitsɛ ɔ nɛ
1“Imi ji wai tso nitsɛ ɔ, nɛ Tsaatsɛ ji ngmɔtsɛ. 2Ye kɔni tsuaa kɔni nɛ wui yiblii ɔ, e poɔ; se nɔ́ nɛ woɔ yiblii ɔ, e sãã he, konɛ e he nɛ tsɔ, nɛ e wo yiblii pe kekle ɔ. 3Nyɛɛ lɛɛ munyuhi nɛ i tu nyɛ ɔ tsu nyɛ he momo. 4Nyɛɛ hi ye mi nɛ imi hu ma hi nyɛ mi. Kaa bɔ nɛ tso kɔni be nyɛe maa wo yiblii ngɛ lɛ nitsɛ e dɛ he, se ja e mɛtɛ wai tso ɔ he ɔ, jã kɛ̃ nyɛ hu ke nyɛ hi ye mi ɔ, nyɛ be yiblii woe.
5“Imi ji wai tso ɔ, nɛ nyɛ ji kɔni ɔmɛ. Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ hii ye mi, nɛ imi hu i hii e mi ɔ, e maa wo yiblii babauu, ejakaa ke ye he be mi ɔ, nyɛ be nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko nyɛe ma tsu. 6Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ mɛtɛ we ye he ɔ, a sakee lɛ fɔɔ he kaa tso kɔni, nɛ e gbliɔ. Jamɛ a kɔni ɔmɛ ɔ, a buaa nya kɛ woɔ la mi nɛ a sãã. 7Ke nyɛ mɛtɛ ye he, nɛ nyɛ he ye munyu ɔmɛ ye ɔ, nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ suɔ ɔ, ke nyɛ bi ɔ, a ma ha nyɛ. 8Yiblii babauu nɛ nyɛ woɔ ɔ, nyɛɛ kɛ woɔ Tsaatsɛ hɛ mi nyami, nɛ nyɛ peeɔ ye kaseli. 9I suɔ nyɛ kaa bɔ nɛ Tsɛ ɔ suɔ mi ɔ, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ ha suɔmi nɛ i ngɛ kɛ ha nyɛ ɔ nɛ hi si daa. 10Ke nyɛ ye ye mlaa amɛ a nɔ ɔ, lɛɛ suɔmi nɛ i ngɛ kɛ ha nyɛ ɔ maa hi si daa. Imi hu i ye Tsaatsɛ mlaa amɛ a nɔ, lɔ ɔ ha nɛ suɔmi nɛ e ngɛ kɛ ha mi ɔ se pui gblegbleegble.
11“I de nyɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo, konɛ kaa bɔ nɛ bua jɔmi ngɛ ye mi ɔ, nyɛ hu nyɛ na bua jɔmi babauu. 12 Mlaa nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ woe ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: nyɛɛ suɔ nyɛ sibi kaa bɔ nɛ i suɔ nyɛ ɔ. 13Suɔmi nɛ se be ji kaa nɔ ko maa ngɔ e wami ngɔ fɔ si ngɛ e huɛmɛ a he. 14Ke nyɛ pee nɔ́ nɛ i de nyɛ ke nyɛɛ pee ɔ, lɔ ɔ lɛɛ ye huɛmɛ ji nyɛ. 15Jehanɛ i tsɛ we nyɛ tsɔli hu, ejakaa tsɔlɔ li nɔ́ nɛ e nyɔmtsɛ tsuɔ. I tsɛɔ nyɛ ye huɛmɛ mohu, ejakaa níhi tsuo nɛ i nu kɛ je Tsaatsɛ nya a, i de nyɛ. 16Pi nyɛ nɛ nyɛ hla mi. Imi mohu nɛ i hla nyɛ nɛ i tsɔ nyɛ, konɛ nyɛ ya wo yiblii nɛ maa hi si daa. Kɛkɛ ɔ, nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ ma kpa he pɛɛ ngɛ ye biɛ mi ɔ, Tsɛ ɔ ma ha nyɛ. 17Mlaa nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ woe ji nyɛɛ suɔ nyɛ sibi.
Je ɔ nyɛɔ Kristo se nyɛɛli
18“Ke je ɔ ngɛ nyɛ nyɛe ɔ, nyɛ na nɛ nyɛɛ le kaa imi a nyɛ kekle. 19Kaa je ɔ mi bi ji nyɛ ɔ, jinɛ a ko suɔ nyɛ sane saminya, ejakaa nyɛ piɛ a he. Se nyɛɛ lɛɛ i hla nyɛ kɛ je je ɔ mi, nɛ nyɛ pi je ɔ mi bi hu; lɔ ɔ he nɛ je ɔ ngɛ nyɛ nyɛe ɔ nɛ. 20 Nyɛ kai kaa i de nyɛ momo ke, ‘Nyɔguɛ pã we e nyɔmtsɛ.’ Nɛ́ a wa mi yi mi ɔ, nyɛɛ lɛɛ kɛ a maa pee nyɛ kɛɛ? Ke a bu mi tue ɔ, nyɛ hu a maa bu nyɛ tue. 21Ye he ɔ, a maa pee nyɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo, ejakaa nɔ nɛ tsɔ mi ɔ, a li lɛ. 22Kaa i bɛ nɛ i kɛ mɛ ba tu munyu ɔ, jinɛ a ko yi fɔ kaa a pee yayami. Se jehanɛ lɛɛ a be nya jemi ko kulaa ngɛ yayami nɛ a pee ɔ he. 23Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ nyɛɔ mi ɔ, e nyɛɔ Tsaatsɛ hulɔ. 24Kaa i ba tsu we ní nguanguahi nɛ nɔ ko tsu we hyɛ ɔ ngɛ a kpɛti ɔ, jinɛ a ko yi fɔ kaa a pee yayami. Jehanɛ ɔ, i tsu ní nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a na paa; se kɛ̃ ɔ, a ngɛ i kɛ Tsaatsɛ tsuo nyɛe. 25 Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e sa nɛ e ba jã, konɛ nɔ́ nɛ a ngma ngɛ a mlaa a mi ke, ‘A nyɛ mi yaka gu’ ɔ nɛ ba mi.
26“Se Hepiɛlɔ ɔ maa ba. Lɛ ji Mumi ɔ nɛ haa a leɔ anɔkuale nɛ kɔɔ Mawu he ɔ nɛ. Ma tsɔ lɛ kɛ je Tsɛ ɔ ngɔ kɛ ba nyɛ ngɔ, nɛ e ma ba ye ye he odase. 27Nyɛ hu nyɛ maa ye ye he odase, ejakaa i kɛ nyɛ hi si kɛ je sisije.

Title: YOHANE 16
Content:
1“I ngɛ nyɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ dee, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ nyɛ ko ngmɛɛ nyɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ he. 2A maa fie nyɛ kɛ je kpe he ɔmɛ, nɛ be maa ba nɛ ke nihi ngɛ nyɛ gbee ɔ, a ma susu kaa Mawu lɛ a ngɛ jae. 3Nihi maa pee nyɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ, ejakaa a li Tsɛ ɔ; nɛ a li imi hulɔ. 4Se i ngɛ nyɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ dee, konɛ ke be ɔ su ɔ, nyɛ kai kaa i wo nɔ ta de nyɛ.
Bɔ nɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ tsuɔ ní
“Sisije ɔ, i de we nyɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ, ejakaa i kɛ nyɛ ngɛ. 5Amlɔ nɛ ɔ lɛɛ i yaa nɔ nɛ tsɔ mi ɔ ngɔ, se nyɛ ti nɔ ko bi we mi he nɛ i yaa. 6Se nɛ i de nyɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, nyɛ ngɛ tsui yee. 7I ngɛ nyɛ dee anɔkuale mi ke e hi kɛ ha nyɛ mohu kaa ma je, ejakaa ke i ji ɔ, Hepiɛlɔ ɔ be nyɛ ngɔ bae. Ke i je ɔ lɛɛ ma wo lɛ blɔ kɛ ba nyɛ ngɔ. 8Ke e ba a, e maa tsɔɔ je ɔ kaa bɔ nɛ a susuɔ ngɛ yayami, kɛ nɔ́ nɛ da, kɛ Mawu kojomi he ɔ dɛ. 9A juɛmi ngɛ yayami he ɔ dɛ, ejakaa a he we mi yi; 10nɛ a juɛmi ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ da he ɔ dɛ, ejakaa i yaa Tsaatsɛ ngɔ nɛ nyɛ be mi nae hu. 11Nɛ a juɛmi ngɛ Mawu kojomi he ɔ hu dɛ, ejakaa nɔ nɛ yeɔ je ɔ nɔ matsɛ ɔ, a bu lɛ fɔ momo.
12“I ngɛ níhi fuu nɛ piɛ nɛ ma de nyɛ, se nyɛ be nyɛe he maa pɛtɛ amlɔ nɛ ɔ. 13Se ke Mumi ɔ nɛ haa a leɔ anɔkuale ɔ nɛ kɔɔ Mawu he ɔ ba a, e maa tsɔɔ nyɛ anɔkuale ɔ tsuo. Ejakaa Mumi ɔ be lɛ nitsɛ e yi mi toe kɛ de nɔ́ ko; mohu níhi nɛ e nu ɔ, a he munyu e maa tu; nɛ e ma de nyɛ níhi nɛ maa ba. 14E maa wo ye hɛ mi nyami, ejakaa níhi nɛ i wo nɔ ta a, e maa tsɔɔ nyɛ. 15Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ Tsaatsɛ ngɛ ɔ, ye nɔ. Enɛ ɔ he nɛ i de nyɛ ke, nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ ma de Mumi ɔ, e maa tsɔɔ nyɛ ɔ nɛ.
Bua jɔmi maa ba ngɛ kɔmɔ yemi se
16“E piɛ bɔɔ nɛ nyɛ be mi nae hu; kɛkɛ ɔ, bɔɔ se ɔ, nyɛ maa na mi ekohu.”
17E kaseli ɔmɛ a ti ni komɛ bi a sibi ke, “Nɔ nɛ e de wɔ nɛ ɔ sisi nɛɛ? E ke e piɛ bɔɔ nɛ wa be lɛ nae hu; kɛkɛ ɔ, bɔɔ se ɔ, wa maa na lɛ ekohu. Jehanɛ hu e de ke wa be lɛ nae hu, ejakaa e yaa Tsɛ ɔ ngɔ. 18‘Be bɔɔ’ nɛ ɔ, kɛ ji e sisi kɛɛ? Nɔ́ nɛ e ngɛ dee ɔ, wa nui sisi!”
19Yesu na kaa a ngɛ hlae nɛ a bi lɛ nɔ́ nɛ e de ɔ sisi, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e de mɛ ke, “I ke, ‘E piɛ bɔɔ nɛ nyɛ be mi nae hu; kɛkɛ bɔɔ se ɔ, nyɛ maa na mi ekohu.’ Anɛ enɛ ɔ he munyu nyɛ ngɛ nyɛ he bie ɔ? 20I ngɛ nyɛ dee anɔkuale mi ke, nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ ma kpa ngmlaa; nyɛ maa wo yana, se je ɔ ma nya.
