Nyɛ maa ye kɔmɔ, se nyɛ kɔmɔ yemi ɔ ma plɛ bua jɔmi. 21Ke yo ngɛ kɔe nɛ e ma fɔ ɔ, e haoɔ, ejakaa e dengme gbomi be ɔ su; se ke e fɔ pɛ, dengme tsuo nɛ e gbo ɔ, e hɛ jeɔ nɔ; ejakaa e naa bua jɔmi kaa e fɔ bi kɛ wo je ɔ mi. 22Jã nɔuu, nyɛ hu amlɔ nɛ ɔ, nyɛ ngɛ kɔmɔ yee, se ma na nyɛ ekohu. Nyɛ tsui maa nɔ nyɛ mi, nɛ nyɛ bua jɔmi ɔ, nɔ ko be hee ngɛ nyɛ dɛ.
23“Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, e be hiae kaa nyɛ bi mi nɔ́ ko hu. I ngɛ nyɛ dee anɔkuale mi ke, nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ he pɛɛ nɛ nyɛ ma kpa Tsɛ ɔ ngɛ ye biɛ mi ɔ, e maa pee ha nyɛ. 24Kɛ ba si piɔ ɔ, nyɛ bi we nɔ́ ko hyɛ ngɛ ye biɛ mi. Nyɛ bi, nɛ a maa pee ha nyɛ; kɛkɛ ɔ, nyɛ ma na bua jɔmi babauu.
I ye je ɔ nɔ kunimi
25“Ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ɔ, abɛ gbi mi i de nyɛ ngɛ. Se jehanɛ ɔ, be maa ba nɛ i be munyu tue ngɛ abɛ gbi mi hu. Mohu ma jaje Tsɛ ɔ he sanehi kpookpoo ha nyɛ. 26Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ ma kpa Tsɛ ɔ pɛɛ ngɛ ye biɛ mi. I de we ke ma kpa pɛɛ ha nyɛ, 27ejakaa Tsɛ ɔ nitsɛ ngɛ nyɛ he suɔmi. Tsɛ ɔ suɔ nyɛ, ejakaa nyɛ suɔ mi, nɛ nyɛ he ye kaa Mawu ngɔ nɛ i je kɛ ba. 28Niinɛ, i je Tsɛ ɔ ngɔ kɛ ba je ɔ mi, nɛ amlɔ nɛ ɔ, i ngɛ je ɔ mi jee kɛ yaa Tsɛ ɔ ngɔ.”
29Kɛkɛ nɛ e kaseli ɔmɛ de lɛ ke, “Jehanɛ ɔ lɛɛ o ngɛ munyu tue paa nɛ pi abɛ gbi mi hu. 30Amlɔ nɛ ɔ lɛɛ wa na kaa o le nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́, nɛ e hia we nɛ nɔ ko nɛ bi mo sane ko. Jehanɛ lɛɛ wa he ye kaa Mawu ngɔ nɛ o je kɛ ba.”
31Yesu bi mɛ ke, “Jehanɛ lɛɛ nyɛ he ye lo? 32Be ma, nɛ e su ta; nyɛ tsuo nyɛ maa gbɛ fĩa. Nɔ tsuaa nɔ maa ya lɛ nitsɛ e we mi, nɛ e maa piɛ imi nɔ kake too. Se pohu pi imi nɔ kake nɛ maa piɛ, ejakaa i kɛ Tsɛ ɔ ngɛ. 33I de nyɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ, konɛ nyɛɛ kɛ mi nɛ hi si, konɛ nyɛ na he jɔmi. Benɛ nyɛ ngɛ je ɔ mi ɔ, haomi maa ba nyɛ nɔ; se nyɛ tsui nɛ nɔ nyɛ mi, ejakaa i ye je ɔ nɔ kunimi.”

Title: YOHANE 17
Content:
Yesu kpa pɛɛ ha e kaseli ɔmɛ
1Benɛ Yesu de ní nɛ ɔmɛ se ɔ, e wo hɛ nɔ kɛ hyɛ hiɔwe, nɛ e ke, “Tsaatsɛ, be ɔ su. Ha nɛ a wo o Bi ɔ hɛ mi nyami, konɛ Bi ɔ hu nɛ wo o hɛ mi nyami. 2Ejakaa o ha mi he wami nɛ ma ye adesahi tsuo a nɔ, konɛ nihi tsuo nɛ o tu ngɔ wo ye dɛ mi ɔ, ma ha nɛ a na neneene wami. 3Ke a na le kaa mo ji anɔkuale Mawu ɔ, nɛ a le Yesu Kristo, nɔ nɛ o tsɔ ɔ, a ma na neneene wami. 4I wo o hɛ mi nyami ngɛ je ɔ mi; ní tsumi nɛ o tu kɛ wo ye dɛ mi ɔ, i gbe nya. 5Tsaatsɛ, ha nɛ ye hɛ mi nɛ ba nyami amlɔ nɛ ɔ kaa bɔ nɛ i ngɛ momo ngɛ o hɛ mi benɛ a na we nɛ a bɔ je ɔ.
6“Nihi tsuo nɛ o hla kɛ je je ɔ mi nɛ o tu ngɔ wo ye dɛ mi ɔ, i ha nɛ a na o hɛ mi nyami ɔ. O nihi ji mɛ, nɛ o tu mɛ ngɔ wo ye dɛ mi. O munyu ɔ nɛ i kɛ ba ha mɛ ɔ, a ye nɔ. 7Nɛ jehanɛ lɛɛ a le kaa níhi tsuo nɛ o ha mi ɔ je o ngɔ. 8Sɛ gbi nɛ o ha mi ɔ, i kɛ ha mɛ nɛ a ngɔ, nɛ a le kaa niinɛ i je o ngɔ, nɛ mo nɛ o tsɔ mi.
9“I kpa we pɛɛ ha je ɔ; mohu ni nɛmɛ nɛ o ha mi ɔ, mɛ i ngɛ pɛɛ kpae ha; ejakaa o nihi ji mɛ. 10Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ ɔ, o nɔ, nɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ o ngɛ ɔ, imi hu ye nɔ; nɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo woɔ o hɛ mi nyami. 11Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, i be je ɔ mi hu. Mɛɛ a ngɛ je ɔ mi, se imi lɛɛ i ma o ngɔ. Tsaatsɛ klɔuklɔu! Bu a he kɛ mo nitsɛ o he wami nɛ o ngɔ ha mi ɔ, konɛ a pee kake kaa bɔ nɛ i kɛ mo wa ngɛ ɔ. 12 Benɛ i kɛ mɛ ngɛ ɔ, i bu a he kɛ he wami nɛ o ngɔ ha mi ɔ. A ti nɔ kake ngmelu hɛ mi kpataa we, lɛɛ ja nɔ nɛ a to kaa e hɛ mi nɛ kpata a, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ ngmami ɔ nɛ ba mi. 13Jehanɛ ɔ, i ma o ngɔ, nɛ i ngɛ enɛ ɔ dee be mi nɛ i ngɛ je ɔ mi kɛ mwɔɔ, konɛ bua jɔmi nɛ i na a, mɛ hu a na. 14I ngɔ o munyu ɔ ha mɛ; nɛ lɔ ɔ he ɔ, je ɔ ngɛ mɛ nyɛe. Ejakaa a kɛ je ɔ bɔɛ, kaa bɔ nɛ imi hu i kɛ mɛ bɔɛ ɔ. 15I kpa we pɛɛ ke o je mɛ kɛ je je ɔ mi; se mohu i ngɛ pɛɛ kpae nɛ o bu a he kɛ je nɔ yayami ɔ dɛ mi. 16Pi je ɔ mi bi ji mɛ kaa bɔ nɛ imi hu pi je ɔ mi nɛ i je ɔ. 17Ngɔɔ o we anɔkuale munyu ɔ kɛ tsu a he. 18Bɔ nɛ o tsɔ mi je ɔ mi ɔ, ja nɔuu imi hu i ngɛ mɛ tsɔe. 19A he ɔ, i peeɔ ye he klɔuklɔu, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ mɛ hu a pee mɛ klɔuklɔu ngɛ anɔkuale mi.
20“Pi ni nɛ ɔmɛ kɛkɛ nɛ i ngɛ pɛɛ kpae ha, se mohu kɛ ha nihi tsuo nɛ maa nu sɛ gbi ɔ nɛ a maa fiɛ ɔ nɛ a ma he mi maa ye ɔ. 21I ngɛ pɛɛ kpae nɛ mɛ tsuo a pee kake. Tsaatsɛ! Bɔ nɛ o ngɛ ye mi, nɛ i ngɛ o mi ɔ, mɛ hu a hi wa mi jã nɔuu. Pee mɛ kake, konɛ je ɔ nɛ he ye kaa mo nɛ o tsɔ mi. 22O wo ye hɛ mi nyami, nɛ i ha mɛ hu a hɛ mi ba nyami ja nɔuu, konɛ a pee kake kaa bɔ nɛ i kɛ mo ngɛ ɔ. 23I ngɛ a mi, nɛ mo hu o ngɛ ye mi, konɛ a pee kake kɛ pi si; kɛkɛ ɔ, je ɔ maa na kaa mo nɛ o tsɔ mi; nɛ bɔ nɛ o suɔ mi ɔ, o suɔ mɛ hu ja nɔuu.
24“Tsaatsɛ! Nihi nɛ o tu ngɔ wo ye dɛ mi ɔ, he nɛ i ngɛ ɔ, i suɔ kaa mɛ hu a hi lejɛ ɔ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ a na ye hɛ mi nyami ɔ. O ha ye hɛ mi ba nyami, ejakaa benɛ o na we nɛ o bɔ je ɔ tete po o suɔ mi. 25Tsaatsɛ nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da! Je ɔ li mo, se imi lɛɛ i le mo; nɛ ye nyɛmimɛ nɛ ɔmɛ le kaa mo nɛ o tsɔ mi. 26I ha nɛ a le mo, nɛ ma ya nɔ ma pee jã, konɛ á suɔ mi kaa bɔ nɛ o suɔ mi ɔ, nɛ imi hu ma hi a mi.”

Title: YOHANE 18
Content:
Yuda ma nimeli ɔmɛ nu Yesu
(Mateo 26.47-56; Marko 14.43-50; Luka 22.47-53)
1Benɛ Yesu sɔle kikɛ nɛ ɔ, e kɛ e kaseli ɔmɛ je kpo, nɛ a pue nɔ kɛ ho ya po Kedron pa a, kɛ ya sɛ abɔɔ ko mi ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. 2Yuda, nɔ nɛ ya tsɔɔ Yesu se blɔ ɔ le lejɛ ɔ, ejakaa Yesu kɛ mɛ pɔɔ kpemi ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. 3Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ, kɛ Farisi bi ɔmɛ tsɔ Roma ta buli komɛ, kɛ sɔlemi we ɔ tsɔli komɛ abɔɔ ɔ mi, nɛ Yuda nyɛɛ a hɛ mi. A dla a he kaa nihi nɛ yaa ta, nɛ a hɛɛ kanehi, kɛ jatɛhi. 4Yesu le nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ a maa pee lɛ ɔ momo; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e hɛ lɛ kɛ ba hɛ mi nɛ e bi mɛ ke, “Mɛnɔ nyɛ ngɛ hlae?”
5A he nɔ ke, “Yesu nɛ je Nazaret ɔ.”
Yesu de mɛ ke, “Imi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ!”
Yuda, nɔ nɛ tsɔɔ Yesu se blɔ ɔ hu kɛ mɛ daa si ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. 6Benɛ Yesu de mɛ ke, “Imi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ” ɔ, a gbee senyasenya, nɛ a ya nɔ si ngɛ zugba. 7Yesu kpale bi mɛ ekohu ke, “Mɛnɔ nyɛ ngɛ hlae?”
A he nɔ ke, “Yesu nɛ je Nazaret ɔ.”
8Yesu kpale de mɛ ke, “Tse i de nyɛ momo ke, ‘Imi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.’ Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke imi nyɛ ngɛ hlae ɔ, lɛɛ nyɛɛ ngmɛ ye se nyɛɛli nɛ ɔmɛ blɔ nɛ a ya.” 9E de enɛ ɔ, konɛ munyu ɔ nɛ e tu ke, “Tsaatsɛ, nihi nɛ o tu ngɔ wo ye dɛ mi ɔ, i ha we nɛ a ti nɔ kake ngmelu po hɛ mi nɛ kpata” a, nɛ ba mi.
10Kɛkɛ nɛ Simon Petro nyla klaate nɛ e hɛɛ ɔ, nɛ e kɛ po osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa a nyɔguɛ ɔ hiɔ nɔ tue. Nyɔguɛ ɔ biɛ ji Malko. 11 Yesu de Petro ke, “Ngɔɔ o klaate ɔ kɛ wo e kpo ɔ mi. Amanehlu kplu nɛ Tsaatsɛ to kaa ma nu ɔ, ma ko nu lo?”
A ngɔ Yesu kɛ ya Hana hɛ mi
12Kɛkɛ nɛ Roma asafoatsɛ nɔkɔtama a, kɛ e ta buli ɔmɛ, kɛ Yuda ta buli ɔmɛ nu Yesu, nɛ a fi lɛ, 13nɛ a kɛ lɛ ya ha Hana kekle. Hana a, Kayafa nɛ ngɛ osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa yee jamɛ a jeha a ngatsɛ ji lɛ. 14 Kayafa nɛ wo Yuda ma nimeli ɔmɛ ga be ko kaa e sa nɛ nɔ kake mohu nɛ gbo ngɛ ma a tsuo nane mi ɔ nɛ.
Petro de ke e li Yesu
(Mateo 26.69-70; Marko 14.66-68; Luka 22.55-57)
15Simon Petro kɛ kaselɔ kpa hu nyɛɛ Yesu se. Osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa a le jamɛ a kaselɔ ɔ saminya, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, kaselɔ ɔ nyɛɛ Yesu se kɛ sɛ osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa a we ɔ mi; 16se Petro lɛɛ e tlɔ sinya a nya. Pee se ɔ, jamɛ a kaselɔ kpa a kpale je kpo, nɛ e kɛ yiheyo ɔ nɛ ngɛ sinya a nya bue ɔ ya tu munyu, kɛkɛ nɛ e ngɔ Petro kɛ sɛ we ɔ mi. 17Yiheyo ɔ nɛ ngɛ sinya a nya bue ɔ de Petro ke, “Tse mo hu jamɛ a nyumu ɔ kaselɔ ji mo?”
Petro he nɔ ke, “Dɛbi.”
18Jamɛ a be ɔ, fĩɛ ngɛ yee, nɛ nyɔguɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ tsɔli ɔmɛ ngɔ hã kɛ slɛ la, nɛ a daa si ngɛ la a hlue. Kɛkɛ nɛ Petro hu ya piɛ a he nɛ e kɛ mɛ ngɛ la a hlue.
Osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa ta Yesu nya mi
(Mateo 26.59-66; Marko 14.55-64; Luka 22.66-71)
19Jehanɛ osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa a bi Yesu e kaseli ɔmɛ, kɛ e tsɔɔmi ɔ he sane. 20Yesu he nɔ ke, “I tuɔ munyu paa kɛ haa nɔ tsuaa nɔ. Daa nɛ ɔ, i tsɔɔ ní ngɛ kpe he ɔmɛ, kɛ sɔlemi we ɔ he nɛ Yuda bi kulaa kpee ngɛ ɔ, nɛ i de we nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko ngɛ laami mi gblee. 21Mɛni he je o ngɛ imi mohu munyu bie ɔ Ni nɛmɛ nɛ ba buɔ mi tue ɔ, bi mɛ nɔ́ nɛ i deɔ mɛ. Ni nɛ ɔmɛ le níhi nɛ i de ɔ.”
22Benɛ Yesu de enɛ ɔ, tsɔli ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ a ti nɔ kake gba lɛ ma, nɛ e de lɛ ke, “Heto nɛ o ha osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa a ji nɛ ɔ?”
23Yesu he nɔ ke, “Ke i de nɔ yaya ko ɔ, de ngɛ hiɛ ɔ nɛ ni nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ a nu. Se ke kpakpa a, lɛɛ mɛni he je o ngɛ mi gbee ɔ?”
24Jehanɛ ɔ, Yesu ngɛ pã a mi, nɛ Hana ha a kɛ lɛ ya ha Kayafa, osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa a.
Petro de ekohu ke e li Yesu
(Mateo 26.71-75; Marko 14.69-72; Luka 22.58-62)
25Petro daa si ngɛ lejɛ ɔ nɛ e ngɛ la a hlue kɛ mwɔɔ. Kɛkɛ nɛ nihi nɛ daa si ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, a ti ni komɛ de ke, “Tse mohu jamɛ a nyumu ɔ kaselɔ ji mo.”
Se Petro kplɛɛ we, nɛ e ke, “Dɛbi, pi e kaselɔ ji mi.”
26Jehanɛ ɔ, osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa a nyɔguɛ ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake, nɔ nɛ Petro po e tue ɔ weku no bi Petro ke, “Anɛ i nɛ o kɛ lɛ ngɛ abɔɔ ɔ mi lo?”
27Se loloolo ɔ, Petro kplɛɛ we, kɛkɛ nɛ amlɔ nɔuu kungwɔ kpa nɔ.
A kɛ Yesu ba Pilato hɛ mi
(Mateo 27.1-2, 11-14; Marko 15.1-5; Luka 23.1-5)
28Jena mɔtu mla a, a ngɔ Yesu kɛ je Kayafa ngɔ, nɛ a kɛ lɛ ya amlaalo ɔ mɔ ɔ mi. Yuda ma nimeli ɔmɛ nitsɛmɛ lɛɛ a sɛ we mi, ejakaa a sume nɛ a ble a he, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ a nyɛ nɛ a ye Hetsɔmi ɔ. 29Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Pilato je kpo kɛ ba a ngɔ, nɛ e bi mɛ ke, “Mɛni sane nyɛ kɛ ba ngɛ nyumu nɛ ɔ nya poe ɔ?”
30A he nɔ ke, “E pee we yayami ko jinɛ waa kɛ lɛ ba be mo hae.”
31Pilato de mɛ ke, “Lɛɛ nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛɛ ngɔ lɛ nɛ nyɛ ya kojo lɛ ngɛ nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ mlaa nya mɔ.”
A he nɔ ke, “Wɔɔ lɛɛ wa be he blɔ nɛ wa gbeɔ nɔ.” 32 A de enɛ ɔ, konɛ Yesu munyu nɛ e tu kɛ tsɔɔ gbenɔ nɛ e ma gbo ɔ nɛ ba mi.
33Kɛkɛ nɛ Pilato kpale e se kɛ sɛ mɔ ɔ mi, nɛ e tsɛ Yesu, nɛ e bi lɛ ke, “Mo ji Yuda bi ɔmɛ a matsɛ ɔ?”
34Yesu he nɔ ke, “Mo nitsɛ o yi mi nɛ o to kɛ ngɛ enɛ ɔ dee, aloo ni komɛ lɛ a de mo ja ngɛ ye he?”
35Pilato bi lɛ ke, “Anɛ Yuda no ji mi? Mo nitsɛ o ma mi bi, kɛ osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ nɛ a ngɔ mo ba ha mi. Mɛni o pee?”
36Yesu he nɔ ke, “Ye matsɛ yemi ɔ, pi je nɛ ɔ mi nɔ́. Kaa je nɛ ɔ mi nɔ́ ɔ, jinɛ ye se nyɛɛli ɔmɛ maa plee ye he, konɛ a ko ngɔ mi ngɔ ha Yuda ma nimeli ɔmɛ. Se enɛ ɔ, ye matsɛ yemi ɔ, pi je nɛ ɔ mi nɔ́.”
37Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Pilato bi lɛ ke, “Se matsɛ ji mo kɛ̃?”
Yesu he nɔ ke, “O ngɛ dee ke matsɛ ji mi. Imi lɛɛ enɛ ɔ he nɛ a fɔ mi kɛ ba je ɔ mi, konɛ ma tsɔɔ anɔkuale ɔ. Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ le anɔkuale ɔ buɔ mi tue.”
38Pilato bi lɛ ke, “Mɛni ji anɔkuale?”
Pilato bu Yesu gbenɔ fɔ
(Mateo 27.15-31; Marko 15.6-20; Luka 23.13-25)
Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Pilato kpale je kpo ekohu kɛ ya Yuda bi ɔmɛ a ngɔ, nɛ e ya de mɛ ke, “Imi lɛɛ i nɛ sane yobu ko kulaa ngɛ e he nɛ ma da nɔ kɛ bu lɛ fɔ. 39Se ngɛ kusumi nya a, daa Hetsɔmi nyami be ɔ, i ngmɛɛ pã mi no kake he haa nyɛ. Anɛ nyɛ suɔ nɛ ma ngmɛɛ Yuda bi ɔmɛ a matsɛ ɔ he ha nyɛ lo?”
40A he nɔ kɛ ngmlaa ke, “Dɛbi! Pi nɔ nɛ ɔ; ngmɛɛ Baraba mohu he ha wɔ.” Kpahu Baraba a, ojo fialɔ ji lɛ.

Title: YOHANE 19
Content:
1Kɛkɛ nɛ Pilato ngɔ Yesu, nɛ e ha a fia lɛ kpa; 2nɛ ta buli ɔmɛ ngɔ mio kɛ pee jlasi, nɛ a kɛ fi e yi. A wo lɛ tade he jua wawɛ tsutsuutsu; 3nɛ a kplã si ngɛ e hɛ mi, nɛ a ye e he fɛu ke, “Yuda bi a matsɛ, manye oo manye!” Nɛ a gba e hɛ mi ma.
4Pilato kpale je kpo ekohu, nɛ e de ma kpekpemi ɔ ke, “I kɛ lɛ ngɛ kpo jee kɛ ma nyɛ ngɔ hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ, konɛ nyɛ na nyɛɛ le kaa imi lɛɛ i nɛ sane yobu ko ngɛ e he nɛ ma da nɔ kɛ bu lɛ fɔ.” 5Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yesu je kpo kɛ e yi jlasi nɛ a kɛ mio pee ɔ, kɛ e he tade he jua wawɛ tsutsuutsu ɔ. Pilato de mɛ ke, “Nyɛ nɛ nɔmlɔ ɔ!”
6Benɛ osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ, kɛ tsɔli ɔmɛ na Yesu ɔ, a kpa ngmlaa ke, “Sɛu lɛ! Sɛu lɛ!”
Pilato de mɛ ke, “Nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛɛ ngɔ lɛ nɛ nyɛ ya sɛu mɔ; ejakaa imi lɛɛ i nɛ sane yobu ko ngɛ e he nɛ ma da nɔ kɛ bu lɛ fɔ.”
7Yuda bi ɔmɛ he nɔ ke, “Wɔɔ lɛɛ wa ngɛ mlaa, nɛ wa mlaa a nya a, e sa gbenɔ, ejakaa e pee e he Mawu Bi.”
8Benɛ Pilato nu munyu nɛ ɔ, e ye gbeye pe kekle ɔ po. 9Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e kpale sɛ mɔ ɔ mi, nɛ e bi Yesu ke, “Jije o je?”
Se Yesu pui e nya mi. 10Pilato de lɛ ke, “O be ye nya mi poe? O li kaa i ngɛ he blɔ kaa i sɛuɔ mo, nɛ i ngɛ he blɔ hulɔ kaa i ngmɛɛ o he lo?”
11Yesu he nɔ ke, “Ke pi Mawu nɛ ha mo he wami ɔ, o be he wami ko ngɛ ye nɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ nɛ je mi kɛ wo o dɛ mi ɔ, e he yayami ɔ kle pe o nɔ́ ɔ.”
12Kɛ je enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Pilato hla kaa e maa ngmɛɛ Yesu he. Se Yuda bi ɔmɛ kpa ngmlaa ke, “Ke o ngmɛɛ e he ɔ, o pi Kaisare ɔ huɛ. Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ peeɔ e he matsɛ ɔ, Kaisare ɔ e te si ngɔ si ɔ nɛ.”
13Benɛ Pilato nu kikɛmɛ a munyu nɛ ɔ, e kɛ Yesu je kpo, nɛ e ya hi kojomi sɛ ɔ nɔ ngɛ he nɛ a ka tɛ ngɛ, nɛ Hebri mi ɔ, a tsɛɛ “Gabata” a. 14Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ nɛ a dlaa he kɛ toɔ Hetsɔmi ɔ nɛ; nɛ maa pee piani ngmlɛ nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔ, Pilato de ma a ke, “Ne nyɛ matsɛ ɔ!”
15Se mɛɛ lɛɛ a kpa ngmlaa ke, “O kɛ lɛ nɛ ya! O kɛ lɛ nɛ ya! Sɛu lɛ!”
Pilato bi mɛ ke, “Nyɛ matsɛ ɔ, ma sɛu lɛ lo?”
Osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ he nɔ ke, “Wa be matsɛ ko kaa ja Kaisare ɔ pɛ.”
16Kɛkɛ nɛ Pilato ngɔ Yesu kɛ ha mɛ nɛ a ya sɛu lɛ.
Ta buli ɔmɛ sɛu Yesu
(Mateo 27.32-44; Marko 15.21-32; Luka 23.26-43)
A ngɔ Yesu kɛ ho, 17nɛ lɛ nitsɛ e tloo e sɛumi tso ɔ kɛ je ma a mi kɛ ya he nɛ a tsɛɛ “Yikoklodonya”, nɛ Hebri mi ɔ a tsɛɛ lɛ “Golgata” a. 18A sɛu Yesu ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, nɛ a sɛu ni kpahi enyɔ hulɔ; nɔ kake ngɛ e hiɛ, kɛ nɔ kake hu ngɛ e hiɛ; nɛ Yesu ngɛ a kpɛti. 19Pilato ngma kɛ mɛtɛ Yesu sɛumi tso ɔ yi mi ke, “Yesu nɛ je Nazaret, Yuda bi ɔmɛ a matsɛ ɔ.” 20Yuda bi ɔmɛ a ti nihi babauu kane nɔ nɛ a ngma a, ejakaa he nɛ a sɛu Yesu ngɛ ɔ kɛ ma a mi kɛ we; nɛ a ngma nɔ́ ɔ ngɛ Hebri, kɛ Roma, kɛ Hela gbi mi. 21Osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ ba de Pilato ke, “Koo ngma ke, ‘Yuda bi ɔmɛ a matsɛ ɔ.’ Se mohu ngmaa ke, ‘Nɔmlɔ nɛ ɔ de ke lɛ ji Yuda bi ɔmɛ a matsɛ ɔ nɛ.’ ”
22Se Pilato he nɔ ke, “Nɔ nɛ i ngma a, i ngma.”
23Benɛ ta buli ɔmɛ sɛu Yesu se ɔ, a ngɔ e tade ɔmɛ, nɛ a dla mi eywiɛ ngɔ ha a he kakaaka. A ngɔ tade klɔii ɔ hulɔ; se tade klɔii ɔ lɛɛ a lo kɛ je hiɔwe ba ma si, nɛ e be tsami he. 24 Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ta buli ɔmɛ de a he ke, “Wa ko gba enɛ ɔ; mohu nyɛ ha waa fɔ̃ nɔ sɔ, konɛ waa na nɔ nɛ nɔ́ nɛ e maa pee.” Kɛkɛ ɔ, ngmami ɔ nɛ deɔ ke,
“A dla ye tade ɔmɛ ngɔ ha a he;
nɛ ye tade klɔii ɔ, a fɔ̃ nɔ sɔ” ɔ maa ba mi.
Nɔ́ nɛ ta buli ɔmɛ pee ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
25Yesu nyɛ, kɛ e nyɛ ɔ nyɛmiyo Maria, Klopa yo ɔ, kɛ Maria Magdalena daa si ngɛ Yesu sɛumi tso ɔ kasa nya. 26Benɛ Yesu na e nyɛ ɔ, kɛ kaselɔ ɔ nɛ e suɔ lɛ ɔ daa si ɔ, e de e nyɛ ɔ ke, “Maa, o bi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ!”
27Pee se ɔ, e de kaselɔ ɔ ke, “O nyɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ!” Kɛ je jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, kaselɔ ɔ ngɔ lɛ kɛ ho lɛ nitsɛ e we mi ya.
Yesu gbo
(Mateo 27.45-56; Marko 15.33-41; Luka 23.44-49)
28 Benɛ Yesu na kaa a gbe nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nya a, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ ngmami ɔ nɛ ba mi ɔ, e de ke, “Kuma ngɛ mi yee!”
29Kplu ko maa si ngɛ lejɛ ɔ kɛ e mi dã tɔtɔɔtɔ nɛ kuã. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a ngɔ wo mi kutsa ngɔ sɔ dã a mi, nɛ a ngɔ ma tso nya, nɛ a kɛ to e nya he. 30Benɛ Yesu he dã nɛ kuã a, e de ke, “A gbe nya!”
Kɛkɛ nɛ e ma e yi si, nɛ e ngɔ e nya.
A gbɔ Yesu kasa mi nɔ́
31Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, Yuda ma nimeli ɔmɛ ya na Pilato kaa e ngmɛ mɛ blɔ nɛ a ku nihi nɛ a gbe ɔ a nanehi, nɛ a je mɛ kɛ je sɛumi tso ɔ nɔ. Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ nɛ a dlaa he kɛ haa Hetsɔmi ɔ, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a sume nɛ gbogboe ɔmɛ nɛ a hi sɛumi tso nɔ kɛ yaa si Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ, ejakaa Hejɔɔmi ligbi nguaa nitsɛ lɛ ngɛ a hɛ mi. 32Enɛ ɔ he ɔ, ta buli ɔmɛ ho nɛ a ya ku nihi nɛ a sɛu kɛ piɛ Yesu he ɔ a nanehi, kekle nɔ ɔ, kɛ nɔ enyɔne ɔ hulɔ. 33Se benɛ a su Yesu nɔ ɔ, a na kaa e gbo momo, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a ku we e nane. 34Mohu ta buli ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake kɛ e we akplɔ ɔ gbɔ Yesu kasa mi; nɛ amlɔ ɔ, muɔ kɛ nyu je mi kɛ be. 35Nɔ nɛ na nɔ́ nɛ ɔ lɛ ye odase nɛ ɔ, konɛ nyɛ hu nyɛ he ye; ejakaa lɛ nitsɛ e le kaa anɔkuale nɛ e tu. 36 A pee enɛ ɔ, konɛ nɔ nɛ a ngma ke, “A be e wu ko kue” ɔ, nɛ ba mi. 37 Nɛ jehanɛ ɔ, ngmami kpa hu deɔ ke, “A maa hyɛ nɔ nɛ a gbɔ lɛ nɔ́ ɔ.”
Yesu pumi
(Mateo 27.57-61; Marko 15.42-47; Luka 23.50-56)
38Pee se ɔ, Yosef nɛ je Arimatia ya bi Pilato nɛ́ e ha lɛ blɔ, nɛ e ya ngɔ Yesu gbogboe ɔ. Yosef ɔ, Yesu se nyɛɛlɔ ji lɛ, se Yuda bi ɔmɛ a he gbeye he je ɔ, e je we e he si paa. Pilato ha lɛ blɔ; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Yosef ho nɛ e ya je gbogboe ɔ. 39 Nikodemo, nɔ nɛ be ko e ya Yesu ngɔ nyɔ mi ɔ, lɛ hu e ngɔ tsopa kɛ e he via, nɛ ji mire kɛ aloe nɛ a futu, nɛ jiimi maa pee kilo nyingmi etɛ kɛ ba, nɛ e piɛ Yosef he kɛ ho. 40Mɛ ni enyɔ ɔmɛ a ya ngɔ Yesu gbogboe ɔ, nɛ a wo lɛ tsopa kɛ e he via a, nɛ a kɛ kploba bla lɛ kaa bɔ nɛ Yuda bi peeɔ kɛ puɔ nɔ ɔ. 41He nɛ a sɛu Yesu ngɛ ɔ, abɔɔ ko ngɛ lejɛ ɔ kɛ e mi yɔkɔ he nɛ a to we nɔ ngɛ mi hyɛ. 42Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a ya to Yesu gbogboe ɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, ejakaa yɔkɔ ɔ he kɛ we, nɛ jehanɛ ɔ hu, jamɛ a ligbi ɔ nɛ a dlaa he kɛ haa Hejɔɔmi ligbi ɔ nɛ.

Title: YOHANE 20
Content:
Yɔkɔ mi gu ɔ
(Mateo 28.1-8; Marko 16.1-8; Luka 24.1-12)
1Otsi ɔ we kekleekle ligbi ɔ makɛ mla, benɛ je mi tsɔ we lolo ɔ, Maria Magdalena ba yɔkɔ ɔ he, nɛ e na kaa a je tɛ ɔ kɛ je yɔkɔ ɔ nya. 2Kɛkɛ nɛ e wo fo kɛ ya na Simon Petro, kɛ kaselɔ kpa a nɛ Yesu suɔ lɛ ɔ ngɛ he nɛ a ngɛ ɔ. E de mɛ ke, “A wo Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ gbogboe kɛ je yɔkɔ ɔ mi, nɛ wa li he nɛ a kɛ lɛ ya fɔ.”
3Petro kɛ kaselɔ kpa a pue nɔ kɛ ho yɔkɔ ɔ he ya. 4Mɛ ni enyɔ ɔmɛ tsuo a kɛ fo wo mi, se nɔ kake ɔ be Petro he, nɛ lɛ kekle e su yɔkɔ ɔ he. 5E ya kɔkɔ e yi si, nɛ e na kploba amɛ nɛ a kɛ bla Yesu gbogboe ɔ, se e sɛ we yɔkɔ ɔ mi. 6Simon Petro nyɛɛ e se kɛ ba lejɛ ɔ, nɛ lɛɛ e nyɛɛ tɛɛ kɛ ya sɛ yɔkɔ ɔ mi. Lɛ hu e na kploba amɛ nɛ a kɛ bla Yesu gbogboe ɔ nɛ pueɔ si ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, 7kɛ duku nɛ a kɛ fi e yi ɔ hulɔ. Duku ɔ be kploba amɛ a kasa nya; se mohu a ku mi kɛ fɔ si ngɛ he ko banee. 8Jehanɛ ɔ, kaselɔ kaketsɛ ɔ nɛ su lejɛ ɔ kekle ɔ hu sɛ yɔkɔ ɔ mi; nɛ benɛ e na ní nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, e he ye. 9Pohu ngmami ɔ nɛ de ke e sa nɛ e te si kɛ je gbeje ɔ, a nui sisi kɛ mwɔɔ. 10Kɛkɛ nɛ kaseli ɔmɛ kpale a se kɛ ho we mi ya.
Yesu je e he kpo tsɔɔ Maria Magdalena
(Mateo 28.9-10; Marko 16.9-11)
11Se Maria daa si ngɛ yɔkɔ ɔ he kɛ mwɔɔ, nɛ e ngɛ ya foe. Benɛ e ngɛ ya foe ɔ, e kɔkɔ e yi si, nɛ e hyɛ yɔkɔ ɔ mi, 12nɛ e na hiɔwe bɔfohi enyɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. A wo ní hiɔ, nɛ a hii si ngɛ he nɛ a kɛ Yesu gbogboe ɔ fɔ si ngɛ ɔ; nɔ kake ngɛ e yi je, kɛ nɔ kake hu ngɛ e nane si je. 13A bi Maria ke, “Maa, mɛni he je nɛ o ngɛ ya foe ɔ?”
E de mɛ ke, “A wo ye Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ kɛ je, nɛ i li he nɛ a kɛ lɛ ya fɔ.”
14Jehanɛ ɔ, e plɛ e he, nɛ e na Yesu nɛ daa si, se e yo we lɛ. 15Yesu bi lɛ ke, “Maa, mɛni he je nɛ o ngɛ ya foe ɔ? Mɛnɔ o ngɛ hlae?”
Maria susu kaa eko ɔ, abɔɔ ɔ mi dlalɔ ji lɛ, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e de Yesu ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, ke mo nɛ o ba wo lɛ kɛ je hiɛ ɔ, lɛɛ tsɔɔ mi he nɛ o kɛ lɛ ya fɔ nɛ ma ya wo lɛ.”
16Yesu tsɛ lɛ, “Maria!”
Kɛkɛ nɛ Maria plɛ e he, nɛ e de lɛ ngɛ Hebri mi ke, “Rabuni” (E sisi ji “Tsɔɔlɔ”).
17Yesu de lɛ ke, “Koo ta ye he, ejakaa i na we ma ya hiɔwe ngɛ Tsɛ ɔ ngɔ lolo. Se yaa ye nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ a ngɔ, nɛ o ya de mɛ ke, ‘I yaa hiɔwe ngɛ Tsaatsɛ, kɛ nyɛ hu nyɛ Tsɛ; ye Mawu, kɛ nyɛ hu nyɛ Mawu ɔ ngɔ.’ ”
18Maria Magdalena ya nɛ e ya sɛɛ ha kaseli ɔmɛ ke e na Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ, nɛ e bɔ mɛ níhi tsuo nɛ Yesu de lɛ ɔ.
Yesu je e he kpo tsɔɔ e kaseli ɔmɛ
(Mateo 28.16-20; Marko 16.14-18; Luka 24.36-49)
19Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ nɛ ji otsi ɔ kekleekle ligbi ɔ gbɔkuɛ ɔ, Yuda ma nimeli ɔmɛ a he gbeye nya a, kaseli ɔmɛ ya bua a he nya ngɛ he ko, nɛ a nga sinya amɛ. Tlukaa a, Yesu ba da si ngɛ a kpɛti. E de mɛ ke, “Nyɛ he manye!” 20Kɛkɛ nɛ e ngɔ e dɛ mi ɔ, kɛ e kasa mi ɔ ngɔ tsɔɔ mɛ. Kaseli ɔmɛ ná bua jɔmi babauu kaa a na Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ. 21Jehanɛ ɔ, Yesu kpale de mɛ ekohu ke, “Nyɛ he manye! Bɔ nɛ Tsɛ ɔ tsɔ mi ɔ, ja nɔuu imi hu i ngɛ nyɛ tsɔe.” 22Kɛkɛ nɛ e mu ngɔ pue a nɔ, nɛ e de mɛ ke, “Nyɛ he Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ. 23 Ke nyɛ ngɔ nɔ ko he yayami kɛ pa lɛ ɔ, a kɛ pa; nɛ ke nyɛ ngɔ nɔ ko he yayami kɛ to ɔ, a ngɔ to.”
Yesu je e he kpo tsɔɔ Toma
24Benɛ Yesu ba je e he kpo ɔ, Toma, ni nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Hayo hulɔ ɔ be lejɛ ɔ. 25Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, kaseli kpa amɛ de lɛ pee se ke, “Wa na Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ!”
Se Toma de mɛ ke, “Ja i na e dɛ mi plɛɛko pa amɛ nɛ i kɛ ye nine nguɛ slaa a nya, nɛ i ngɔ ye nine hɔ e kasa mi ɔ hulɔ loko ma he ye.”
26Ligbi kpaanyɔ se ɔ, kaseli ɔmɛ bua a he nya ekohu ngɛ tsu mi, nɛ Toma piɛ a he. A nga sinya amɛ, se Yesu ba nɛ e ba da si ngɛ a kpɛti, nɛ e de ke, “Nyɛ he manye!” 27Jehanɛ, e de Toma ke, “Ngɔɔ o nine nguɛ ba slaa ye dɛ mi nɛ o hyɛ; nɛ o kɛ o nine ba hɔ ye kasa mi. Kpa nɔ jemi, nɛ o he ye!”
28Toma he nɔ ke, “Ye Nyɔmtsɛ! Ye Mawu!”
29Kɛkɛ nɛ Yesu bi lɛ ke, “Toma, nɛ o na mi ɔ, tse o he ye? A gbaa nihi nɛ nɛ́, se kɛ̃ ɔ, a heɔ yeɔ!”
Nɔ nɛ he nɛ a ngma womi nɛ ɔ
30Yesu pee okadi kpahi fuu ngɛ e kaseli ɔmɛ a hɛ mi nɛ a ngmɛ́ ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ mi. 31Se enɛ ɔmɛ lɛɛ a ngma, konɛ nyɛ he ye kaa Yesu ji Kristo, Mawu Bi ɔ. Nɛ ke nyɛ he lɛ ye ɔ, nyɛ yi ma na wami.

Title: YOHANE 21
Content:
Yesu je e he kpo tsɔɔ e kaseli kpaago ngɛ Galilea
1Pee se ɔ, Yesu kpale je e he kpo tsɔɔ kaseli ɔmɛ ekohu ngɛ Tiberia wo ɔ nya. Bɔ nɛ e ba mi ha ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. 2Simon Petro, kɛ Toma nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Hayo hulɔ ɔ, Natanael nɛ je Kana ngɛ Galilea a, Zebedeo bimɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ kaseli ɔmɛ a ti ni kpahi enyɔ hu ya bua ngɛ he ko. 3 Kɛkɛ nɛ Simon Petro de mɛ ke, “I yaa wo.”
A he nɔ ke, “Wɔ tsuo waa kɛ mo maa ya.” Kɛkɛ nɛ a ya sɛ lɛ mi, nɛ a pue nɔ kɛ ho. Se jamɛ a nyɔ ɔ mi tsuo ɔ, a gbi lo kake ngmelu po. 4Makɛ benɛ je mi ngɛ tsɔe ɔ, Yesu ba da si ngɛ wo ɔ nya, se kaseli ɔmɛ yo we lɛ. 5E bi mɛ ke, “Ye bimɛ, nyɛ ná nɔ́ ko lo?”
A he nɔ ke, “Dɛbi, wa nɛ́ nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko.”
6 Jehanɛ e de mɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ fɔ ya a ngɛ lɛ ɔ hiɔ nɔ, nɛ nyɛ maa gbe lo.” A fɔ ya a, nɛ lo nɛ a gbe ɔ hiɛ babauu, nɛ a nyɛ we nɛ a gbla ya a.
7Kaselɔ nɛ Yesu suɔ lɛ ɔ de Petro ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nɛ daa si ɔ nɛ.” Benɛ Simon Petro nu nɛ a de ke Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ lɛ daa si ɔ, e wo e tade ɔ ngɔ muɔ e mlɛ mi, nɛ e tu ma pa a mi, ejakaa e hɛɛ e he gu. 8Kaseli kpa amɛ hlui lɛ ɔ, nɛ a kɛ gbla ya a nɛ lo hyi lɛ tɔ ɔ kɛ ba kpo, ejakaa a kɛ kpo he kɛmi maa pee gugue nyingmi enuɔ pɛ. 9Benɛ a ba kple ɔ, a na kaa a ngɔ hã kɛ slɛ la ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, nɛ lo pueɔ si ngɛ nɔ, kɛ abolo hulɔ. 10Yesu de mɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ ngɔ lo nɛ nyɛ gbe ɔ eko kɛ ba.”
11Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Simon Petro kpale ya sɛ lɛ ɔ mi, nɛ e gbla ya a, kɛ e mi lo nguanguahi tɔ ɔ kɛ ba kpo. Lo ɔ tsuo yibɔ ji lafa kɛ nyingmi enuɔ kɛ etɛ. 12Jehanɛ ɔ, Yesu de mɛ ke, “Nyɛ ba wo nyɛ nya mi nɔ́ ko.” Kaseli ɔmɛ a ti nɔ ko nɔ ko nyɛ we nɛ e pee kã nɛ e bi lɛ ke, “Mɛnɔ ji mo?” Ejakaa a yo kaa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nɛ daa si ɔ nɛ. 13Kɛkɛ nɛ Yesu ba kɛ̃ abolo ɔ, nɛ e ngɔ ha mɛ. Nɛ e ha mɛ lo ɔ hulɔ.
14Enɛ ɔ ji si etɛ nɛ Yesu je e he kpo tsɔɔ kaseli ɔmɛ benɛ Mawu tle lɛ si kɛ je gbeje ɔ se.
Yesu kɛ Petro gba sane
15Benɛ a ye ní ɔ gbe nya a, Yesu bi Simon Petro ke, “Simon, Yohane bi, anɛ o suɔ mi pe bɔ nɛ ni nɛ ɔmɛ suɔ mi lo?”
Simon he nɔ ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, o le kaa i suɔ mo!”
Yesu de lɛ ke, “Lɛɛ ye to bi ɔmɛ.” 16Yesu kpale bi lɛ si enyɔne ke, “Simon, Yohane bi, o suɔ mi lo?”
Petro he nɔ ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, o le kaa i suɔ mo!”
Yesu de lɛ ke, “Hyɛ ye to ɔmɛ.” 17Jehanɛ Yesu kpale bi lɛ nɔ́ nɛ ji si etɛ ke, “Simon, Yohane bi, o suɔ mi lo?”
E dɔ Petro kaa Yesu bi lɛ si etɛ sɔuu ke e suɔ lɛ lo. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e he nɔ ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, mo nitsɛ o le nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́; mo nitsɛ o le kaa i suɔ mo!”
Yesu de lɛ ke, “Lɛɛ ye to ɔmɛ. 18I ngɛ mo dee anɔkuale mi ke o nihe mi ɔ, mo nitsɛ o miaa, nɛ o yaa he tsuaa he nɛ o suɔ. Se ke o ba bwɔ ɔ, o ma wo o nine nɔ, nɛ nɔ kpa maa mia mo; nɛ e kɛ mo maa ya he nɛ o sume kaa o maa ya.” 19Yesu de enɛ ɔ kɛ tsɔɔ bɔ nɛ Petro ma gbo kɛ wo Mawu hɛ mi nyami. Jehanɛ e de Petro ke, “Nyɛɛ ye se.”
Yesu tu kaselɔ ɔ nɛ e suɔ ɔ he munyu
20 Petro po e he, nɛ e na kaa kaselɔ kaketsɛ ɔ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ suɔ ɔ ma ngɛ e se. Jamɛ a nɔ ɔ lɛ hi si ngɛ Yesu kasa nya be nɛ a ngɛ nyagbe ní ɔ yee ɔ nɛ. Lɛ nɛ bi Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ke mɛnɔ maa tsɔɔ e se blɔ ɔ nɛ. 21Benɛ Petro na lɛ ɔ, e bi Yesu ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, nɔ nɛ ɔ lɛɛ nɛɛ?”
22Yesu de lɛ ke, “Ke i suɔ kaa e hi si kɛ yaa su be nɛ ma kpale kɛ ba a, mɛni lɔ ɔ kɔɔ ngɛ o he? Moo lɛɛ nyɛɛ ye se!”
23Munyu nɛ ɔ ba pɛ ngɛ Yesu se nyɛɛli ɔmɛ a tue mi kaa kaselɔ nɛ ɔ be gboe gblegbleegble. Kpahu Yesu de we ke e be gboe; se mohu e ke, “Ke i suɔ kaa e hi si kɛ yaa si ma kpale kɛ ba a, mɛni lɔ ɔ kɔɔ ngɛ o he?”
24Jamɛ a kaselɔ ɔ nya mi munyu ji enɛ ɔmɛ tsuo. Lɛ nɔuu lɛ ngma ní nɛ ɔmɛ; nɛ wa le kaa nɔ nɛ e de ɔ ngɛ mi.
Nyagbe
25Yesu pee ní kpahi babauu, nɛ ke a ngma lɛ tsuo kakaaka a, womihi nɛ a ko ná a, e peeɔ mi kaa, a ko na we a to he ngɛ je ɔ mi.

Title: NI TSUMI NYA TSƆƆMI
Content:
NYA TSƆƆMI
Sane nɛ ngɛ Luka Sane Kpakpa a mi ɔ nɔ tsami lɛ ngɛ womi nɛ a tsɛɛ “Bɔfo Ɔmɛ A Ni Tsumi” ɔ mi. Nɔ́ pɔtɛɛ nɛ ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ mi ji bɔ nɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ ba Yesu kekleekle se nyɛɛli ɔmɛ a nɔ nɛ e ha nɛ a fiɛ Sane Kpakpa a nɛ kɔɔ Yesu he ɔ ngɛ “Yerusalem kɛ Yudea tsuo, kɛ Samaria, kɛ ya su zugba a nyagbe he ɔmɛ.” (1.8) Womi nɛ ɔ tsɔɔ bɔ nɛ Kristo asafo ɔ je sisi ngɛ Yuda bi ɔmɛ a kpɛti, nɛ e ya nɔ kɛ ba su be nɛ je ɔ tsuo ba he ye. Womi ngmalɔ ɔ suɔ kaa ni nɛmɛ nɛ maa kane womi ɔ nɛ a nu sisi saminya kaa Kristo we bi ɔmɛ ɔ, pi ma ywiali a kuu nɛ teɔ si kɛ siɔ Roma matsɛ yemi ɔ ji mɛ. Jehanɛ hu, a na nɛ a le kaa Kristo nɔ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ ji nɔ́ ko nɛ maa Yuda bi a jami ɔ nɔ mi.
Ke a hyɛ bɔ nɛ sane kpakpa a nɛ kɔɔ Yesu he ɔ gbɛ fĩa kɛ ya se lokoo, kɛ gu munyu ɔ fiɛmi kɛ asafohi a sisi tomi nɔ ɔ, a ma nyɛ maa dla sane ɔ mi etɛ. (1) Bɔ nɛ Kristo asafo ɔ je sisi ngɛ Yerusalem be nɛ Yesu ho hiɔwe ya a se. (2) Munyu ɔ gbɛ fĩa Palestina zugba a nɔ. (3) Munyu ɔ gbɛ fĩa Mediterenia zugba a nɔ hluu kɛ ya su Roma ma nguaa mi tɔɔ.
Nɔ́ ko pɔtɛɛ nɛ ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ mi ji bɔ nɛ Pentekoste ligbi ɔ, Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ tsu ní kɛ gu nihi nɛ he ye ɔ a nɔ ngɛ Yerusalem. Mumi ɔ tsɔɔ ní, nɛ e wo asafo ɔ, kɛ a hɛ mi nyɛɛli ɔmɛ he wami kɛ gblee níhi tsuo a mi kaa bɔ nɛ a ngma a. A po blema Kristo se nyɛɛli ɔmɛ a sɛ gbi ɔ kpiti kpiti nɛ a kɛ fiɛ. Níhi nɛ a ngma ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ mi ɔ tsɔɔ bɔ nɛ munyu ɔ woɔ nihi nɛ he ye ɔ kã ngɛ a wami si himi mi, nɛ e peeɔ asafo ɔ kake.
Bɔ nɛ a dla womi ɔ mi ha
A to blɔ nya kɛ ha odase yemi 1.1-26
a. Yesu fa e kaseli ɔmɛ nɛ e wo mɛ si 1.1-14
b. Bɔfo ɔmɛ hla nɔ kɛ ma Yuda nane mi 1.15-26
A ye odase ngɛ Yerusalem 2.1—8.3
A ye odase ngɛ Yudea kɛ Samaria 8.4—12.25
Paulo fiɛ Mawu munyu 13.1—28.31
a. Kekleekle blɔ nɛ Paulo hia kɛ ya fiɛ 13.1—14.28
b. A kpe ngɛ Yerusalem 15.1-35
d. Blɔ enyɔne nɛ Paulo hia kɛ ya fiɛ 15.36—18.22
e. Blɔ etɛne nɛ Paulo hia kɛ ya fiɛ 18.23—21.16
ɛ. A wo Paulo tsu ngɛ Yerusalem, Kaisarea, kɛ Roma 21.17—28.31

Title: NI TSUMI 1
Content:
1 Ye suɔlɔ Teofilo:
Ngɛ ye kekle womi ɔ mi ɔ, i ngma níhi tsuo nɛ Yesu ba pee, kɛ ní nɛ e tsɔɔ kɛ je be nɛ e bɔni e ní tsumi, 2kɛ ya su ligbi nɛ a ngɔ lɛ kɛ ho hiɔwe ya. Loko a ngɔ lɛ kɛ ho hiɔwe ya a, e gu Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ nɔ nɛ e tsɔɔ bɔfohi nɛ e hla a mlaa nɛ a ye nɔ. 3E gbenɔ se kekleekle ligbi nyingmi eywiɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, e gu blɔhi fuu a nɔ je e he kpo tsɔɔ bɔfo ɔmɛ kaa e ngɛ wami mi kɛ mwɔɔ. A na lɛ, nɛ e kɛ mɛ sɛɛ Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ he ní. 4 Benɛ a nya ba bua ngɛ he kake ɔ, e fa mɛ ke, “Nyɛ ko je Yerusalem; se mohu nyɛɛ mlɛ kɛ yaa si be nɛ si nɛ Tsaatsɛ wo ɔ maa ba mi kaa bɔ nɛ i de nyɛ momo ɔ. 5 Yohane ngɔ nyu kɛ sɔle nihi, se nyɛɛ lɛɛ e be kɛe nɛ a kɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ maa sɔle nyɛ.”
A ngɔ Yesu kɛ ho hiɔwe ya
6Benɛ bɔfo ɔmɛ kɛ Yesu ba bua ngɛ he kake ɔ, a bi lɛ ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, anɛ kikɛmɛ a be nɛ ɔ mi nɛ o maa kpale ngɔ matsɛ yemi ɔ kɛ ha Israel ɔ lo?”
7Yesu de mɛ ke, “Be nɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ maa ba mi ɔ, Tsaatsɛ pɛ lɛ to, nɛ e pi nyɛ blɔ nya kaa nyɛ maa le; 8 se ke Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ na ba nyɛ nɔ ɔ, nyɛ ma na he wami kɛ fiɛ, nɛ nyɛ maa ye odase ha mi ngɛ Yerusalem, Yudea, kɛ Samaria tsuo kɛ yaa su je ɔ nyagbe he tɔɔ.” 9 Benɛ e de enɛ ɔ se ɔ, a ngɛ lɛ hyɛe nɔuu nɛ a wo lɛ kɛ ho hiɔwe ya, nɛ bɔku ba sa lɛ kɛ ho nɛ a nɛ lɛ hu.
10Benɛ e yaa nɛ a ngɛ hiɔwe hyɛe too kɛ mwɔɔ ɔ, tlukaa a, ne nyumuhi enyɔ nɛ wo tade hiɔ, nɛ daa si ngɛ a kasa nya. 11Nyumu ɔmɛ bi ke, “Nyɛ Galilea bi mɛni he je nyɛ daa si ngɛ kɔɔhiɔ mi hyɛe kikɛ nɛ ɔ? Yesu ɔ nɛ a ngɔ kɛ ho hiɔwe ya nɛ ɔ, e maa kpale kɛ ba ja nɔuu kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ na lɛ nɛ e yaa a.”
Yuda nane mi malɔ
12Bɔfo ɔmɛ kpale a se kɛ je Oliv yo ɔ he kɛ ho Yerusalem ya. Lejɛ ɔ kɛ Yerusalem kɛmi maa pee Hejɔɔmi ligbi blɔ nyɛɛmi. 13 A ba sɛ ma a mi, nɛ a kuɔ kɛ ho hiɔwe tsu mi he nɛ a ba to ɔ. Mɛ ji Petro, Yohane, Yakobo, Andrea, Filipo, Toma, Bartolomeo, Mateo, Alfeo bi Yakobo, Simon ma he doolɔ ɔ, kɛ Yuda, Yakobo bi ɔ. 14A kɛ yi ɔmɛ, kɛ Yesu nyɛ Maria, kɛ Yesu nyɛminyumu ɔmɛ pɔɔ a he nya buami kɛ ha sɔlemi.
15Be bɔɔ se ɔ, nihi maa pee lafa kɛ nyingmi enyɔ nɛ he Yesu ye ɔ ba bua a he nya. Kɛkɛ nɛ Petro te da si, nɛ e kɛ mɛ tu munyu ke, 16“Ye nyɛmimɛ, Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ ba David nɔ be ko, nɛ e de nɔ́ ko ngɛ Yuda nɛ nyɛɛ nihi a hɛ mi ya nu Yesu ɔ he. Nɔ́ nɛ ngmami ɔ de ɔ, e sa kaa e ba mi. 17Yuda a, jinɛ e piɛ wa he; a hla lɛ, nɛ a ha lɛ blɔ nya, konɛ waa kɛ lɛ tsuo nɛ tsu sɔmɔmi ní tsumi nɛ ɔ.”
18 (Se Yuda tsu yi wu tso ní; nɛ sika nɛ e na ngɛ mi ɔ, e ngɔ ya he abɔɔ. Lejɛ ɔ nɛ e gbo ngɛ, nɛ e mi ni pã pue si. 19Nihi tsuo nɛ ngɛ Yerusalem ɔ na le enɛ ɔ; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a tsɛɛ jamɛ a abɔɔ ɔ ngɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a gbi mi ke Akeldama. E sisi ji “Muɔ Abɔɔ.”)
20 “Bɔ nɛ a ngma ngɛ La womi ɔ mi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ,
‘E we ɔ nɛ pee we doku,
nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko kó hi mi.’
A ngma hu ke,
‘E sɔmɔmi blɔ nya a, nɔ kpa nɛ he.’
21-22 “Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e sa kaa nɔ ko nɛ ba piɛ wa he kɛ ye odase kaa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu te si kɛ je gbeje. Nɔmlɔ nɛ ɔ, e sa kaa e pee nihi nɛ piɛ wa he benɛ waa kɛ Yesu nyɛɔ kɛ yaa kɛ baa a a ti nɔ kake. E pee nɔ ko nɛ kɛ wɔ ngɛ kɛ je be nɛ Yohane bɔni fiɛmi ke e sa kaa a sɔle nɔ ɔ, kɛ ba si be nɛ a ngɔ Yesu kɛ je wa he kɛ ho hiɔwe ya a.”
23Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a hla ni enyɔ ngɔ da si, Yosef nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Barsaba hulɔ, nɛ e biɛ kpa ji Yusto ɔ, kɛ Matia. 24Kɛkɛ nɛ a sɔle ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, mo nɛ o le nimli tsuo a tsui mi, tsɔɔ wɔ ni enyɔ nɛ ɔmɛ a ti nɔ nɛ o hla, 25konɛ e sɔmɔ kaa bɔfo ngɛ Yuda nane mi. Yuda je wa he kɛ ho he nɛ sa kaa e hi ɔ ya.” 26Kɛkɛ nɛ a fɔ sɔ, konɛ a kɛ hla ni enyɔ ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake. Sɔ ɔ ya nɔ Matia nɔ; nɛ a ngɔ lɛ ngɔ piɛ bɔfo nyɔngma kɛ kake ɔmɛ a he.

Title: NI TSUMI 2
Content:
Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ ba
1 Benɛ Pentekoste ligbi ɔ su ɔ, nihi nɛ heɔ yeɔ tsuo a nya ba bua ngɛ he kake. 2Si kake too ɔ, a nu nɔ́ ko nɛ pɛ kɛ je hiɔwe kaa kɔɔhiɔ nɛ nya wa lɛ ngɛ fiae; nɛ e ba hyi we ɔ mi he nɛ a hii si ngɛ ɔ tɔ. 3Nɛ ní komɛ kaa la lilɛ nɛ a gba mi ba ma a yi mi kakaaka. 4Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ ba mɛ tsuo a nɔ saminya, nɛ a bɔni gbi slɔɔtoslɔɔtohi tumi ngɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ he wami nya.
5Yuda bi komɛ nɛ yee Mawu gbeye ngɛ Yerusalem jamɛ a be ɔ mi. A je je ma amɛ tsuo a mi. 6Benɛ a nu nɛ nɔ́ ɔ pɛ ɔ, nihi babauu ba bua a he nya. Mɛ tsuo a he mi po; ejakaa a ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ nu kaa a ngɛ lɛ nitsɛ e ma mi gbi tue. 7Mɛ tsuo a nya kpɛ a he, nɛ a hɛ mi pee mɛ yaa. A de ke, “Nihi nɛ ngɛ munyu tue nɛ ɔ tsuo ɔ, Galilea bi ji mɛ! 8Se kɛ pee kɛɛ nɛ wɔ tsuo wa ngɛ nue nɛ a ngɛ munyu tue ngɛ wɔ nitsɛmɛ wa je gbi mi mɔ? 9Wa je Partia, kɛ Media, kɛ Elam; wa ti ni komɛ je Mesopotamia, Yudea, Kapadokia, Ponto, kɛ Asia; 10ni komɛ je Frigia, kɛ Pamfilia; nɛ ni komɛ hu je Egipt, kɛ Libia kpokpa amɛ a nɔ ngɛ Kirene kasa nya. Wa ti ni komɛ je Roma. 11Wɔ tsuo ɔ, Yuda bi kɛ ma je li nɛ ba sɛ Yuda bi jami ɔ mi ji wɔ; nɛ wa ti ni komɛ hu je Kreta, kɛ Arabia; se wɔ tsuo wa ngɛ nue nɛ a ngɛ Mawu ní nguangua amɛ jajee ngɛ wɔ nitsɛmɛ wa je gbi mi!” 12Mɛ tsuo a nya kpɛ a he, nɛ a dɛ yaa. A bi a sibi ke, “Kɛ ji enɛ ɔ sisi kɛɛ?”
13Se ni komɛ hu ye fɛu ke, “Wai he nɛ a nu nɛ a de.”
Munyu nɛ Petro tu
14Jehanɛ ɔ, Petro kɛ ni nyɔngma kɛ kake ɔmɛ te da si; Petro wo e nya nɔ nɛ e tu munyu tsɔɔ ni kpekpemi ɔ ke, “Ye nyɛmimɛ Yuda bi, kɛ nyɛ nihi tsuo nɛ ngɛ Yerusalem, nyɛɛ bu mi tue, konɛ ma tsɔɔ nyɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ sisi. 15Tsa pi dã nɛ ni mli nɛ ɔmɛ de kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ susue ɔ, ejakaa mɔtu ngmlɛ nɛɛ kɛkɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. 16Se mohu enɛ ɔ ji nɔ́ nɛ gbalɔ Yoel tu he munyu ɔ nɛ:
17 ‘Mawu ke,
Nyagbe be ɔ, ma ngɔ ye Mumi ɔ kɛ wo nɔ tsuaa nɔ mi.
Nyɛ binyumu ɔmɛ, kɛ nyɛ biyi ɔmɛ
maa fiɛ ye sɛ gbi ɔ;
nihewi maa na nina,
nɛ nikɔtɔmahi maa nla.
18Ye tsɔli nyumu ɔmɛ kɛ yi ɔmɛ hu,
ma ha mɛ ye Mumi ɔ jamɛ a be ɔ mi,
nɛ a maa fiɛ ye sɛ gbi ɔ.
19Ma pee nyakpɛ níhi ngɛ hiɔwe,
kɛ okadihi ngɛ zugba a nɔ.
Muɔ, kɛ la, kɛ la su ku maa ba.
20Pu maa tsɔ diblii,
nɛ nyɔhiɔ ma pee tsutsuutsu kaa muɔ
loko Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ligbi nguaa
nɛ ngɛ gbeye ɔ maa ba.
21E maa ba mi kaa
nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ma kpa ngmlaa
kɛ tsɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ biɛ ɔ,
a ma he e yi wami.’
22“Ye nyɛmimɛ Israel bi, nyɛɛ bu munyu nɛ ɔ tue saminya! Nyakpɛ níhi, kɛ okadihi nɛ Mawu pee kɛ gu Yesu nɛ je Nazaret ɔ nɔ ɔ yeɔ odase paa kaa Mawu nitsɛ lɛ tsɔ lɛ. Nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ le enɛ ɔ, ejakaa nyɛ kpɛti a pee ni nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ. 23 Mawu nitsɛ to e yi mi momo kaa e maa ngɔ Yesu ɔ ngɔ ha nyɛ. Nyɛ ngɔ lɛ ngɔ ha yayami peeli nɛ a sɛu lɛ ngɛ sɛumi tso nɔ, nɛ e gbo. 24 Se Mawu tle lɛ si kɛ je gbeje; e kpɔ lɛ ngɛ gbenɔ nya mi, ejakaa gbenɔ be e nya nyɛe maa tsi kɔkɔɔkɔ. 25 Bɔ nɛ David de ngɛ e he ji nɛ ɔ nɛ:
‘I naa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ daa;
e ngɛ ye hiɔ nɔ,
nɛ nɔ ko be nyɛe maa wo ye he gbeye.
26Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ye tsui nɔ ye mi,
nɛ i kɛ bua jɔmi ngɛ munyu tue;
se imi nɛ adesa kɛkɛ ji mi ɔ,
ma ngɔ ye hɛ ngɔ fɔ Mawu nɔ kulaa.
27Ejakaa o be mi sie ngɛ gbeje;
o be hae nɛ o nɔ klɔuklɔu ɔ
nɛ puɛ ngɛ yɔkɔ mi.
28O ha nɛ i le blɔ nɛ kɛ nɔ yaa wami mi ɔ.
O ma ha ye tsui maa nɔ ye mi fuaa
ngɛ o hɛ mi.’
29“Ye nyɛmimɛ, nyɛ ha ma tu munyu paa ngɔ tsɔɔ nyɛ ngɛ wa nɛ̃ Matsɛ David he. E gbo nɛ a pu lɛ, nɛ e yɔkɔ ngɛ wa kpɛti kɛ ba si mwɔnɛ ɔ. 30 Gbalɔ ji lɛ, nɛ si nɛ Mawu wo lɛ ɔ, e le. Mawu wo David si kaa e ma ha e nina ma ba ye tsɛ kaa bɔ nɛ lɛ David ɔ ye tsɛ ɔ. 31David na nɔ́ nɛ Mawu maa pee ɔ momo, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e tu Kristo si temi ɔ he munyu, nɛ e de ke,
‘A si we lɛ ngɛ gbeje, nɛ e he lo hu
puɛ we ngɛ yɔkɔ mi.’
32Mawu tle kikɛmɛ a Yesu nɛ ɔ nɔuu si kɛ je gbeje; lɔ ɔ he odase yeli ji wɔ tsuo. 33A wo e nɔ kɛ ho e Tsɛ Mawu ɔ hiɔ nɔ ya, nɛ e ná Mumi Klɔuklɔu nɛ a wo he si ɔ kɛ je e dɛ. Nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ hyɛe, kɛ nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ nue nɛ ɔ, Yesu lɛ ha nɛ e ba. 34 Ejakaa tsa pi David nɛ ya hiɔwe ɔ, se David nɔuu lɛ de ke,
‘Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ de ye Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ke,
Hii si ngɛ ye hiɔ nɔ,
35nɛ ma pee o he nyɛli ɔmɛ kaa
nɔ́ nɛ o kɛ o nane maa nɔ.’
36“Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Israel bi tsuo nɛ́ a na nɛ a le kaa Yesu ɔ nɛ nyɛ sɛu ɔ, Mawu ngɔ lɛ ngɔ pee Nyɔmtsɛ, kɛ nɔ nɛ lɛ nitsɛ e hla!”
37Benɛ ni ɔmɛ nu munyu nɛ ɔ, e hao mɛ wawɛɛ, nɛ a bi Petro kɛ bɔfo kpa amɛ nɛ piɛ e he ɔ ke, “Wa nyɛmimɛ, kɛ wa maa pee kɛɛ?”
38Petro de mɛ ke, “Nyɛ tsake nyɛ tsui, nɛ nyɛ ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ha nɛ a sɔle lɛ ngɛ Yesu Kristo biɛ mi, kɛkɛ, a maa ngɔ nyɛ he yayami ɔmɛ ngɔ pa nyɛ, nɛ nyɛ ma na Mawu nɔke nɔ́ nɛ ji Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ. 39Ejakaa si nɛ Mawu wo ɔ, nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ bimɛ, kɛ nihi abɔ tsuo nɛ ngɛ se lokoo nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ, wa Mawu ɔ ma tsɛ kɛ ba e ngɔ ɔ nyɛ he ngɛ mi.”
40Petro tu munyu kpahi fuu kɛ ye odase, nɛ e kɛ wo mɛ ga ke, “Tue gblami nɛ yi nɔ nɛ ɔ bi yayami peeli ma na a, nyɛɛ hyɛ saminya nɛ e kó ba nyɛ nɔ.” 41Nihi babauu he e sɛ gbi ɔ ye, nɛ a sɔle mɛ. Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, a na nimli maa pee akpe etɛ kɛ piɛ a he. 42Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ kaseɔ ní be tsuaa be ngɛ bɔfo ɔmɛ a ngɔ; a kɛ mɛ peeɔ kake kɛ yeɔ ní, nɛ a kɛ peeɔ sɔlemi hulɔ.
Nihi nɛ he Yesu ye ɔ a si himi
43Kɛ gu bɔfo ɔmɛ a nɔ ɔ, a pee nyakpɛ níhi, kɛ okadihi babauu, nɛ gbeye nu nɔ tsuaa nɔ. 44 Nihi nɛ he Yesu ye ɔ tsuo kake peemi saminya ngɛ mɛ tsuo a kpɛti, nɛ a gba we nɔ ko mi ngɛ nɔ ko he. 45A jua a zugba amɛ, kɛ a weto ní tsuo, nɛ a dla sika a ngɔ ha ni ɔmɛ tsuo bɔ nɛ he hia nɔ tsuaa nɔ. 46Daa ligbi ɔ, a ya kpee ngɛ sɔlemi we ɔ, nɛ a buaa a he nya kɛ ya kuɔ abolo ngɛ a sibi a we mi, nɛ a kɛ bua jɔmi nɛ je tsui mi faa yeɔ ní. 47A jeɔ Mawu yi be tsuaa be, nɛ ni ɔmɛ tsuo ná a he bua jɔmi babauu. Daa ligbi ɔ, nihi nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ he a yi wami ba piɛɔ asafo ɔ he.

Title: NI TSUMI 3
Content:
A tsa glɔtsɛ ko
1Ligbi ko piani ngmlɛ etɛ sɔlemi be ɔ, Petro kɛ Yohane nyɛɛ kɛ yaa sɔlemi we ɔ. 2Nyumu ko nɛ kplɔ kɛ je e fɔmi mi hii si ngɛ sɔlemi we ɔ we agbo nɛ a tsɛɛ Agbo Saminyayoo ɔ nya ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Daa ligbi ɔ, a woɔ nyumu nɛ ɔ kɛ baa agbo ɔ nya, nɛ e ba baa ní ngɛ nihi nɛ yaa sɔlemi we ɔ a dɛ. 3Benɛ e na Petro kɛ Yohane nɛ a yaa sɛ sɔlemi we ɔ, e ba mɛ ní. 4Se Petro kɛ Yohane hyɛ lɛ too; nɛ Petro de lɛ ke, “Hyɛ wa hɛ mi!” 5Kɛkɛ nɛ glɔtsɛ ɔ hyɛ mɛ gaa, nɛ e hyɛ blɔ kaa e ma ná nɔ́ ko kɛ je a dɛ. 6Se Petro de lɛ ke, “I be sika hiɔ, loo sika tsu, se nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ ɔ, lɔ ɔ i ngɛ mo hae nɛ ɔ nɛ. Ngɛ Yesu Kristo, Nazaret no ɔ biɛ mi ɔ, tee si nɛ o nyɛɛ!” 7Kɛkɛ nɛ Petro nu glɔtsɛ ɔ hiɔ nine, nɛ e wo e nɔ da si. Amlɔ ɔ nɔuu ɔ, glɔtsɛ ɔ nane kɛ e kpɔji nya amɛ a mi wa lɛ; 8e hlu da si, nɛ e bɔni nyɛɛmi. Jehanɛ e nyɛɛ a se kɛ ya sɛ sɔlemi we ɔ, nɛ jamɛ a be ɔ tsuo ɔ, e ngɛ hlue nɛ e ngɛ Mawu yi jee. 9Nihi tsuo nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ na lɛ nɛ e ngɛ nyɛɛe nɛ e ngɛ Mawu yi jee. 10Benɛ a kpá si kaa lɛ ji nɔ nɛ jinɛ e hii si ngɛ sɔlemi we ɔ Agbo Saminyayoo ɔ nya, nɛ e hii nɔ́ bae ɔ, a he mi po, nɛ a nya kpɛ a he saminya ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ ba a he.
Munyu nɛ Petro tu ngɛ sɔlemi we ɔ
11Nyumu ɔ mɛtɛ Petro kɛ Yohane a he kɛ mwɔɔ ngɛ ablanaa nɛ a tsɛɛ Salomo Ablanaa a nɔ. Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ pee ni ɔmɛ nyakpɛ, nɛ mɛ tsuo a bu kɛ ba e ngɔ. 12Benɛ Petro na ni ɔmɛ ɔ, e de mɛ ke, “Ye nyɛmimɛ Israel fɔfɔɛhi, mɛni he je nyɛ hɛ mi pee nyɛ yaa? Mɛni he je nyɛ ngɛ wɔ hyɛe gaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ? Nyɛ susu kaa wɔ nitsɛmɛ wa he wami, aloo wa Mawu nɛ wa jaa saminya he je nɛ nyumu nɛ ɔ ngɛ nyɛɛe nɛ ɔ? 13 Wa nɛmɛ Abraham, Isak, kɛ Yakob a Mawu ɔ wo e tsɔlɔ Yesu hɛ mi nyami. Se nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ je lɛ ngɔ ha, nɛ nyɛ kua lɛ ngɛ Pilato hɛ mi, be mi nɛ lɛɛ e pee e juɛmi kaa e maa ngmɛɛ e he ɔ. 14 Nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ kua nɔ klɔuklɔu ɔ nɛ dami sane pɛ e yeɔ ɔ, nɛ nyɛ kpa pɛɛ ke a ngmɛɛ awi yelɔ mohu he ngɔ ha nyɛ. 15Wami matsɛ ɔ, nyɛ gbe lɛ. Se Mawu tle lɛ si kɛ je gbeje; lɔ ɔ nɔuu he odase yeli ji wɔ. 16E he wami nya nɛ a tsa glɔtsɛ nɛ ɔ nɛ. Nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ hyɛe, kɛ nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ ná le nɛ ɔ, a nyɛ́ pee akɛnɛ a heɔ lɛ yeɔ. E he Yesu ye, lɔ ɔ he nɛ e na he wami kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ tsuo nyɛ ngɛ hyɛe ɔ nɛ.
17“Jehanɛ ye nyɛmimɛ, i le kaa nɔ́ nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ hɛ mi nyɛɛli ɔmɛ pee Yesu ɔ, pe nyɛ li nɛ nyɛ pee. 18Se nɔ́ nɛ Mawu de to momo kɛ gu e gbali ɔmɛ tsuo a nɔ kaa Kristo maa na amanehlu ɔ, ha e ba mi ja niinɛ. 19Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ tsake nyɛ tsui, nɛ nyɛɛ kpale nyɛ se kɛ ba Mawu ngɔ, konɛ a ngɔ nyɛ he yayami ɔmɛ kɛ pa nyɛ. 20Kɛkɛ ɔ, mumi mi he wami maa je Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ngɔ kɛ ba; e maa tsɔ Yesu Kristo, nɔ nɛ e hla ngɔ to ha nyɛ momo ɔ. 21E sa kaa e ya hi hiɔwe kɛ yaa su be nɛ a maa pee níhi tsuo ehe. Mawu tu nɔ́ nɛ ɔ he munyu kɛ gu e gbali klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ a nɔ blema lokoo. 22 Ejakaa Mose de ke, ‘Nyɔmtsɛ nyɛ Mawu ɔ ma tle gbalɔ ko si kaa imi kɛ maa je nyɛ nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ a kpɛti ngɔ ha nyɛ. Nyɛɛ bu lɛ tue, nɛ nyɛɛ pee nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ e ma de nyɛ ke nyɛɛ pee. 23 Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ be jamɛ a gbalɔ ɔ tue bue ɔ, a ma je lɛ kɛ je Mawu bimɛ ɔmɛ a kpɛti, nɛ a ma kpata e hɛ mi.’ 24Gbali ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ ná sɛ gbi, kɛ je Samuel nɔ kɛ ya si nihi tsuo nɛ ba ngɛ e se ɔ a nɔ ɔ, níhi nɛ ngɛ bae ngɛ wa be nɛ ɔmɛ a mi ɔ hu a wo nɔ ta. 25 Si nɛ Mawu wo kɛ gu gbali ɔmɛ a nɔ ɔ, nyɛ nɔ́, nɛ somi nɛ Mawu kɛ nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ so ɔ, nyɛ piɛ he. Bɔ nɛ e de Abraham ji, ‘Ma gu o nina nɔ nɛ ma gbaa nimli tsuo ngɛ zugba a nɔ.’ 26Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Mawu hla e tsɔlɔ ɔ, nɛ e maa tsɔ lɛ nyɛ ngɔ kekle, konɛ e ba gbaa nyɛ, nɛ e kpale nyɛ ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ kɛ je e blɔ yayami ɔmɛ a nɔ.”

Title: NI TSUMI 4
Content:
Petro kɛ Yohane ngɛ kpe ngua a hɛ mi
1Petro kɛ Yohane ngɛ munyu ɔ tue kɛ ngɛ ma a tsɔɔe kɛ mwɔɔ, kɛkɛ nɛ osɔfo komɛ, sɔlemi we ɔ asafoatsɛ ɔ, kɛ Saduki bi komɛ ba pue a nɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. 2A mi mi fu wawɛɛ, ejakaa bɔfo enyɔ ɔmɛ ngɛ ma a ní tsɔɔe ke Yesu te si kɛ je gbeje, nɛ lɔ ɔ maa nɔ mi kaa gbogboehi maa te si kɛ ba wami mi. 3Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, a nu Petro kɛ Yohane; nɛ a ya wo mɛ tsu kɛ yaa su be nɛ je maa na, ejakaa jamɛ a be ɔ du bu. 4Se nihi nɛ ba bu sɛ gbi ɔ tue ɔ, a ti nihi babauu nɛ maa su akpe enuɔ he ye.
5E nɔ jena a, Yuda bi ɔmɛ a hɛ mi nyɛɛli ɔmɛ, kɛ ma nimeli ɔmɛ, kɛ mlaa tsɔɔli ɔmɛ ba bua a he nya ngɛ Yerusalem. 6Hana, osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa a, Kayafa, Yohane, Aleksandro, kɛ nihi abɔ nɛ je osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa a weku ɔ mi ba kpe ɔ. 7A ha bɔfo ɔmɛ ba da a hɛ mi, nɛ a bi mɛ ke, “Kɛ nyɛ pee kɛɛ nɛ nyɛ tsa glɔtsɛ ɔ? Mɛnɔ he wami nya, aloo mɛnɔ biɛ mi nyɛ tsu nɔ́ nɛ ɔ?”
8Kɛkɛ nɛ Petro nɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu hyi lɛ tɔ ɔ de mɛ ke, “Nyɛ Israel ma hɛ mi nyɛɛli, kɛ ma nimeli, 9ke a kɛ wɔ ngɛ munyu yee mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ ngɛ kpakpa nɛ a pee kikɛmɛ a glɔtsɛ nɛ ɔ he, kaa kɛ a pee kɛ tsa lɛ kɛɛ ɔ, 10lɔ ɔ lɛɛ nɔ́ nɛ sa nɛ nyɛ tsuo nyɛɛ le, nɛ Israel ma kpekpemi ɔ tsuo hu nɛ na nɛ a le ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. Nɔmlɔ nɛ a tsa lɛ nɛ daa si ngɛ nyɛ hɛ mi nɛ ɔ, Yesu Kristo, Nazaret no ɔ he wami nya nɛ a tsa lɛ. Nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ sɛu Yesu ɔ, se Mawu tle lɛ si kɛ je gbeje. 11 Yesu nɛ ɔ nɔuu he ngmami ɔ deɔ ngɛ ke,
‘Tɛ ɔ nɛ nyɛ tsu fiali ɔmɛ nyɛ sake fɔ he ɔ
plɛ kɔ nya tɛ.’
12Lɛ nɔ kake too pɛ lɛ ma nyɛ ma he nimli a yi wami. E se ɔ, nɔ ko nɔ ko be je ɔ mi nɛ Mawu ha lɛ kikɛmɛ a he wami nɛ ma nyɛ he wa yi wami.”
13Benɛ kpe ngua a mi bi ɔmɛ na kã nɛ Petro kɛ Yohane pee, nɛ a ná le hu kaa nimli gu kɛkɛ ji mɛ, se pi womi mi leli ɔ, a he mi po. A kɔ se kaa a kɛ Yesu hi si. 14A nɛ́ nɔ́ nɛ a ma de, ejakaa nɔmlɔ nɛ a tsa lɛ ɔ kɛ Petro, kɛ Yohane daa si ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. 15Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a de mɛ ke a je kpo ngɛ tsu ɔ mi he nɛ a kpe ngɛ ɔ. Kɛkɛ nɛ a ya da, nɛ a bi a he ke, “Kɛ wa maa pee nimli nɛ ɔmɛ kɛɛ? 16Nyakpɛ nɔ́ nguaa nɛ Mawu tsu kɛ gu nimli nɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ ɔ, nihi tsuo ngɛ Yerusalem nu he; nɛ wa be nyɛe ma de ke e be mi. 17Se kɛ̃ ɔ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ munyu ɔ ko gbɛ fĩa fuu ko hu ngɛ ma a mi he je ɔ, nyɛ ha waa bɔ mɛ kɔkɔ ke a ko ngɔ Yesu biɛ kɛ tsɔɔ ní hu.”
18Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a tsɛ mɛ kɛ ba, nɛ a fia a tue mi wawɛɛ ke a ko wo Yesu biɛ ta, nɛ a ko ngɔ Yesu biɛ kɛ tsɔɔ ní kulaa hu. 19Se Petro kɛ Yohane he nɔ nɛ a de mɛ ke, “Ke e da blɔ ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi kaa a bu nyɛ mohu tue pe Mawu ɔ, nyɛɛ kojo. 20Ejakaa wɔɔ lɛɛ, níhi nɛ wa na, kɛ níhi nɛ wa nu ɔ, wa be nyɛe ma ma wa nya ngɔ to nɔ kaa ja wa de.” 21Kɛkɛ nɛ kpe ɔ bɔ mɛ kɔkɔ wawɛɛ pe kekle ɔ po, nɛ a ngmɛɛ a he. A nɛ́ bɔ nɛ a maa pee nɛ a maa gbla a tue; ejakaa ni ɔmɛ tsuo ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi nyami woe ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ a pee ɔ he. 22Nɔmlɔ nɛ a gu kikɛmɛ a nyakpɛ blɔ nɔ kɛ tsa lɛ ɔ ye pe jeha nyingmi eywiɛ.
Asafo ɔ kpa pɛɛ kɛ bi he wami womi
23Benɛ a ngmɛɛ Petro kɛ Yohane he nɔuu nɛ a ba nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ a ngɔ ɔ, a ba sɛɛ níhi tsuo nɛ osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ, kɛ ma nimeli ɔmɛ de mɛ ɔ ha mɛ. 24 Benɛ nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ nu ɔ, a kɛ juɛmi kake fa kue ha Mawu ke, “Mo Nyɔmtsɛ nɛ o bɔ hiɔwe kɛ zugba, kɛ wo, kɛ níhi tsuo nɛ ngɛ a mi. 25 O ha nɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ wo wa nɛ̃ David, o tsɔlɔ ɔ he wami, nɛ e tu munyu ke,
‘Mɛni he je ma je li ɔmɛ ngɛ hoo pee,
nɛ a ngɛ nihi a yi nɔ soe yaka gu?
26Zugba a nɔ matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ ganɔ ɔmɛ
ba bua a he nya;
nɛ a te si ngɔ wo e nyɔmtsɛ ɔ kɛ nɔ nɛ a pɔ lɛ nu ɔ.’
27 Niinɛ, Herode, Pontio Pilato, ma je li ɔmɛ, kɛ Israel ma amɛ hu ba bua a he nya ngɛ ma nɛ ɔ mi ngɔ wo Yesu, o tsɔlɔ klɔuklɔu nɛ o pɔ lɛ nu ɔ he. 28A ba bua a he nya, konɛ a pee níhi tsuo ngɛ o he wami nya kaa bɔ nɛ o to ngɔ fɔ si kaa a pee ɔ. 29Jehanɛ hu Nyɔmtsɛ, hyɛ wa he gbeye nɛ a ngɛ woe ɔ, nɛ o wo wɔ, o sɔmɔli ɔmɛ kã nɛ waa jaje o munyu ɔ. 30Je o he wami kpo, nɛ o ha a tsa nihi, nɛ a ngɔ Yesu, o tsɔlɔ klɔuklɔu ɔ biɛ kɛ pee okadihi, kɛ nyakpɛ níhi.”
31Benɛ a sɔle kikɛ ɔ, he nɛ a bua ngɛ ɔ mimiɛ, nɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ ba mɛ tsuo a nɔ saminya, nɛ a ngɔ kã kɛ jaje Mawu munyu ɔ.
Nihi nɛ he ye ɔ pee a níhi tsuo kake
32 Nihi babauu nɛ he Yesu ye ɔ tsuo hɛɛ juɛmi kake, kɛ mumi kake. Nɛ a ti nɔ ko nɔ ko tsɛ we e níhi nɛ e ngɛ ɔ mi eko ke lɛ nitsɛ e nɔ́, se mohu, nɔ́ nɛ nɔ ko ngɛ ɔ peeɔ ma tsuo nɔ́. 33He wami kpetekpleenyɛ lɛ bɔfo ɔmɛ kɛ ye Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu si temi ɔ he odase, nɛ Mawu dloo mɛ babauu. 34Nɔ ko nɔ ko be a kpɛti nɛ nɔ́ ko he hia lɛ, ejakaa nihi nɛ ngɛ we, loo zugba a juaa, nɛ a kɛ sika a baa. 35A kɛ ba haa bɔfo ɔmɛ, nɛ a dlaa kɛ haa nɔ tsuaa nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ he hia lɛ.
36-37Bɔ nɛ ba loko Yosef ya jua e zugba nɛ e ngɔ sika a ba ha bɔfo ɔmɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. Yosef nɛ ɔ, Levi no ji lɛ; a fɔ lɛ ngɛ Kipro. Biɛ nɛ bɔfo ɔmɛ kɛ tsɛɔ lɛ ji Barnaba. E sisi ji nɔmlɔ nɛ woɔ nɔ he wami.

Title: NI TSUMI 5
Content:
Anania kɛ Safira
1Se nyumu ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Anania, kɛ e yo Safira ya jua a weto ní ko. 2Anania kɛ sika nɛ a na a mi fa ko to, nɛ e yo ɔ hu le he nɔ ko. Nɛ e kɛ sika a mi fa nɛ piɛ ba ha bɔfo ɔmɛ. 3Kɛkɛ nɛ Petro de lɛ ke, “Anania, mɛni he je Satan ba sɛ o mi nɛ o ye Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ lakpa kikɛ nɛ ɔ? Sika nɛ o na benɛ o jua zugba a, o ngɔ fa ngɔ to, pi jã? 4Benɛ zugba a ngɛ ɔ, o nɔ́; nɛ benɛ o jua a hu sika a mo nitsɛ o nɔ́. Mɛni he je o to o yi mi, nɛ o pee yayami kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ? Nɔ́ nɛ o pee nɛ ɔ, pi adesa nɛ o ye lakpa, se Mawu!” 5Benɛ Anania nu munyu nɛ ɔ, e tsɔ fia si, nɛ e gbo. Nihi tsuo nɛ nu sane nɛ ba a ye gbeye wawɛɛ nitsɛ. 6Kɛkɛ nɛ nihewi ɔmɛ ba, nɛ a ngɔ nɔ́ kɛ blaa e gbogboe ɔ, nɛ a ya pu lɛ.
7Maa pee ngmlɛfia etɛ se ɔ, e yo ɔ hu ba lejɛ ɔ; lɛɛ e li sane nɛ ba. 8Petro bi lɛ ke, “De mi anɔkuale ɔ; anɛ bɔ nɛ o kɛ o huno ɔ nyɛ jua zugba a ha ji nɛ ɔ?”
Safira he nɔ ke, “Ee, sika a tsuo ji ja a nɛ.”
9Jehanɛ Petro bi lɛ ke, “Kɛ pee kɛɛ nɛ nyɛ pee nyɛ nya kake kɛ ye Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ Mumi ɔ lakpa a, nyɛ susu kaa nyɛ maa ye nyɛ he lo? Hyɛ, nihi nɛ ya pu o huno ɔ, mɛ lɛ a kpale kɛ ma a nɛ; a ma wo mo hu kɛ ho!” 10Amlɔ nɔuu ɔ, e tsɔ fia si ngɛ Petro nane nya, nɛ e gbo. Benɛ nihewi ɔmɛ ba su we ɔ mi ɔ, a na kaa e gbo; kɛkɛ nɛ a wo lɛ kɛ ho, nɛ a ya pu lɛ ngɛ e huno ɔ kasa nya. 11Asafo ɔ, kɛ ni kpahi tsuo nɛ nu sane nɛ ɔ ye gbeye wawɛɛ nitsɛ.
Okadihi kɛ nyakpɛ nihi
12Mawu pee okadihi, kɛ nyakpɛ níhi babauu kɛ gu bɔfo ɔmɛ a nɔ ngɛ ni ɔmɛ a kpɛti. He nɛ a pɔɔ kpemi ngɛ ji Salomo Ablanaa a nɔ. 13E ngɛ mi kaa nihi tuɔ a he munyu kpakpa mohu, se e bɛ nɔ kpa ko yi mi kaa e ya piɛ a he. 14Se kɛ̃ ɔ, nyumuhi, kɛ yihi babauu nɛ heɔ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ yeɔ ɔ ba piɛ asafo ɔ he. 15Nyakpɛ níhi nɛ bɔfo ɔmɛ pee he je ɔ, ke pee ɔ, nihi ngɔɔ hiɔtsɛmɛ kɛ a sa kɛ baa gbɛjegbɛ tue, konɛ ke Petro bee ɔ, e nini kɛkɛ po nɛ nɔ a nɔ. 16Nihi jeɔ mahi nɛ bɔle Yerusalem ɔ a mi kɛ baa. A kɛ hiɔtsɛmɛ, kɛ nihi nɛ mumi yayamihi ngɛ mɛ haoe ɔ baa, nɛ bɔfo ɔmɛ tsaa hiɔtsɛmɛ ɔmɛ, nɛ a hiaa mumi yayami ɔmɛ hulɔ.
A wa bɔfo ɔmɛ yi mi
17Jehanɛ osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa a, kɛ e nimeli ɔmɛ, kɛ Saduki bi ɔmɛ nɛ hunga sa mɛ ɔ te si kɛ hɛdɔ wawɛɛ 18kɛ wo bɔfo ɔmɛ, nɛ a ya wo mɛ tsu. 19Se nyɔ mi ɔ, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ bɔfo ba bli tsu ɔ nya sinya amɛ, nɛ e je mɛ; nɛ e de mɛ ke, 20“Nyɛɛ ya sɔlemi we ɔ nɛ nyɛ ya jaje kikɛmɛ a si himi he nɛ ɔ mi munyu ɔmɛ tsuo ngɔ tsɔɔ ma a.” 21Bɔfo ɔmɛ pee bɔ nɛ a de mɛ ɔ. A pue nɔ mɔtu kɛ ho sɔlemi we ɔ ya ya tsɔɔ ní.
Jehanɛ osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa a, kɛ e nikɔtɔma amɛ tsɛ Yuda ma nimeli ɔmɛ nɛ a ngɛ kpe ngua a mi ɔ kpe. A tsɔ nihi kɛ ya he nɛ a wo bɔfo ɔmɛ tsu ngɛ ɔ, konɛ a ya ngɔ mɛ kɛ ba. 22Se benɛ tsɔli ɔmɛ su lejɛ ɔ, a nɛ bɔfo ɔmɛ ngɛ tsu ɔ mi. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a kpale a se nɛ a ba bɔ kpe ngua a mi bi ɔmɛ amaniɛ ke, 23“Benɛ wa ya a, tsu ɔ nya ngɛ ngangɛ. A ngmɛ mi kpɛii, nɛ buli ɔmɛ hu pee klaalo kɛ daa si ngɛ sinya a nya. Se benɛ wa bli ɔ, wa nɛ bɔfo ɔmɛ a ti nɔ ko nɔ ko!” 24Benɛ osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ, kɛ sɔlemi we ɔ asafoatsɛ ɔ nu kikɛmɛ a munyu nɛ ɔ, a hɛ mi pee mɛ yaa, nɛ a li nɔ nɛ a ma de. 25Kɛkɛ nɛ nɔ ko ba de mɛ ke, “Nyɛ le nɔ́ ko! Ni ɔmɛ nɛ nyɛ nuu wo tsu ɔ, a daa si ngɛ ma a ní tsɔɔe ngɛ sɔlemi we ɔ.” 26Kɛkɛ nɛ asafoatsɛ ɔ, kɛ e we bi ɔmɛ ya ngɔ bɔfo ɔmɛ kɛ ba. A pee we mɛ soisoi, ejakaa a ngɛ gbeye yee kaa ma a maa fia mɛ tɛ.
27A ngɔ bɔfo ɔmɛ kɛ ba da kpe ngua a hɛ mi, nɛ osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa a ta a nya mi. 28 E bi mɛ ke, “Tse wa fia nyɛ tue mi veveeve ke nyɛ ko ngɔ Yesu biɛ kɛ tsɔɔ ní hu? Se nyɛɛ hyɛ nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ pee! Nyɛ ha nɛ nihi tsuo nɛ ngɛ Yerusalem ɔ nu nyumu nɛ ɔ he sane nɛ nyɛ ngɛ hlae nɛ nyɛɛ tsɔɔ kaa wɔ nɛ wa gbe lɛ!”
29Petro, kɛ bɔfo kpa amɛ he nɔ ke, “E sa kaa waa bu Mawu mohu tue, se pi nimli. 30Yesu nɛ nyɛ sɛu ngɛ tso nɔ nɛ nyɛ gbe lɛ ɔ, wa nɛmɛ a Mawu ɔ tle lɛ si. 31Mawu wo e nɔ, nɛ e ngɔ lɛ kɛ to e hiɔ nɔ, nɛ e pee lɛ hɛ mi nyɛɛlɔ, kɛ kpɔlɔ, konɛ Israel bi nɛ a ná he blɔ nɛ a tsake a tsui, nɛ a ngɔ a he yayami ɔmɛ kɛ pa mɛ. 32Wa ngɛ kikɛmɛ a sane nɛ ɔmɛ a he odase yee; nɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ nɛ Mawu kɛ dloo nihi nɛ buɔ lɛ tue ɔ ngɛ odase yee ja nɔuu.”
33Benɛ kpe ngua a mi bi ɔmɛ nu munyu nɛ ɔ, e wo a mi mi la wawɛɛ nitsɛ, nɛ e pee mɛ kaa a gbe bɔfo ɔmɛ. 34Se a ti nɔ kake nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Gamaliel ɔ te da si. Farisi no, kɛ mlaa tsɔɔlɔ nɛ ma a buu saminya ji lɛ. Gamaliel fa ke a je bɔfo ɔmɛ kpo bɔɔ; 35nɛ e de sihi he ɔ ke, “Sane nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ nimli nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ yee nɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ hyɛ saminya. 36Nyɛ kai kaa be bɔɔ ko pɛ ji nɛ nɛ Teuda wo e he nɔ ke nɔ ko ji lɛ, nɛ nyumuhi maa pee lafa eywiɛ ya nyɛɛ e se. Se a gbe lɛ, nɛ e we bi ɔmɛ tsuo gbɛ fĩa nɛ a kpe ɔ nya ya hɛ si. 37E se ɔ, Yuda, Galilea no ɔ hu ba benɛ a ngɛ nihi kanee ɔ. E ba gbla nihi kɛ nyɛɛ e se, se lɛ hu e hɛ mi kpata, nɛ e we bi ɔmɛ tsuo gbɛ fĩa. 38Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, sane nɛ ɔ mi hu, ga nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ woe ji nyɛ ko pee nimli nɛ ɔmɛ nɔ́ ko; nyɛɛ ngmɛɛ a he nɛ a ho. Ke yi mi nɛ a to, kɛ nɔ́ nɛ a ngɛ tsue nɛ ɔ, adesa dɛ mi nɛ e je ɔ, e be he ko sue. 39Se ke Mawu dɛ mi nɛ e je ɔ, nyɛ be Mawu nɔ nyɛe maa ye. Nyɛ ko ba pee nyɛ he kaa nihi nɛ a kɛ Mawu ngɛ ta hwue!”
Kpe ngua a ngɔ Gamaliel ga womi ɔ. 40A tsɛ bɔfo ɔmɛ kɛ ba, nɛ a ha nɛ a fia mɛ kpa. A bɔ mɛ kɔkɔ hulɔ ke a ko fiɛ kɛ Yesu biɛ hu; kɛkɛ nɛ a ngmɛɛ a he. 41Bɔfo ɔmɛ je kpe ngua a hɛ mi kɛ ho kɛ bua jɔmi kaa Yesu biɛ ɔ he ɔ, Mawu bu mɛ nihi nɛ sa kaa a bɔ mɛ ahlua. 42Daa ligbi ɔ, a tsɔɔ ní, nɛ a fiɛɔ sane kpakpa a nɛ kɔɔ Yesu Kristo he ɔ ngɛ sɔlemi we ɔ, kɛ nihi a wehi a mi.

Title: NI TSUMI 6
Content:
Asafo ɔ hla bɔfo ɔmɛ a he piɛli kpaago
1Jamɛ be ɔ mi benɛ kaseli ɔmɛ a he ba bɔni hiɛmi ɔ, a kpɛti nihi nɛ tuɔ Hela gbi ɔ ba te si kɛ wo ni nɛmɛ nɛ tuɔ Hebri gbi ɔ ke a hyɛ we mɛ nihi nɛ tuɔ Hela gbi ɔ a yalɔyi ɔmɛ bɔ nɛ sa; sika nɛ a haa yalɔyihi daa ligbi nɛ a kɛ hyɛɛ a he nɔ ɔ, mɛɛ lɛɛ a nine sui a nɔ́ nɔ. 2Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, bɔfo nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ tsɛ nihi nɛ he Yesu ye ɔ tsuo kɛ ba, nɛ a de mɛ ke, “E sɛ kaa wa siɔ Mawu munyu ɔ fiɛmi se, nɛ wa ya yeɔ niye ní sane. 3Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, wa nyɛmimɛ, nyɛɛ hla nyɛ kpɛti ni kpaago, nihi nɛ ngɛ biɛ kpakpa; nihi nɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ hyi mɛ tɔ, nɛ a le ní hulɔ, konɛ waa ngɔ mɛ ngɔ to ní tsumi nɛ ɔ nya. 4Wɔɔ lɛɛ wa maa ngɔ wa be tsuo kɛ pee sɔlemi, nɛ waa fiɛ Mawu munyu ɔ.”
5Nɔ́ nɛ bɔfo ɔmɛ de ɔ, asafo ɔ kplɛɛ nɔ, nɛ a hla Stefano, nyumu ko nɛ ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi, nɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ ngɛ e mi saminya a, kɛ Filipo, kɛ Prokoro, kɛ Nikanor, kɛ Timon, kɛ Parmena, kɛ Nikolao, ma je no nɛ je Antiokia nɛ tsake ba sɛ Yuda bi a jami ɔ mi be ko ɔ. 6A kɛ mɛ ba da bɔfo ɔmɛ a hɛ mi; kɛkɛ nɛ bɔfo ɔmɛ sɔle, nɛ a kɛ a nine pue a nɔ.
7Mawu munyu ɔ ya nɔ nɛ e gbɛ fĩa saminya. Nihi nɛ he ye ɔ a he ba hiɛ babauu ngɛ Yeruslem, nɛ Yuda osɔfo ɔmɛ a kpɛti nihi saii nitsɛ he Mawu munyu ɔ ye.
A nu Stefano
8Mawu dloo Stefano saminya, nɛ e ha lɛ he wami nɛ e kɛ pee nyakpɛ ní nguanguahi ngɛ ma a mi. 9Kɛkɛ nɛ Kirene kɛ Aleksandria bi komɛ nɛ je kpe he nɛ a tsɛɛ “Nihi nɛ ye a he” ɔ te si wo Stefano. Yuda bi komɛ hu nɛ je Kilikia, kɛ Asia a, ba piɛ nimli nɛ ɔmɛ a he, nɛ a kɛ lɛ sã nya. 10Se Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ ha Stefano nile, nɛ benɛ e tu munyu ɔ, a nyɛ we nya nɛ a da. 11Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ni ɔmɛ ya wo ni komɛ a yi mi, nɛ a ba de ke, “Wa nu nɛ e tu munyu kɛ bɔ musu kɛ si Mose kɛ Mawu.” 12Blɔ nɔ nɛ ni ɔmɛ gu kɛ sú ma mi bi ɔmɛ, kɛ ma nimeli ɔmɛ, kɛ mlaa tsɔɔli ɔmɛ kɛ wo Stefano he ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. Ni ɔmɛ bu kɛ ba pue Stefano nɔ, nɛ a nu lɛ kɛ ho kpe ngua a hɛ mi ya. 13Jehanɛ a kɛ lakpa odase yeli komɛ ba, nɛ a ba de ke, “Daa nɛ ɔ, kikɛmɛ a nɔmlɔ nɛ ɔ tuɔ munyu kɛ siɔ wa sɔlemi we klɔuklɔu ɔ, kɛ Mose mlaa a. 14Wa nu nɛ e de ke, Yesu, Nazaret no ɔ, maa ku sɔlemi we nɛ ɔ, nɛ e ma tsake blɔ nyahi nɛ Mose ngɔ ha wɔ ɔ.” 15Kpe ngua a mi bi ɔmɛ tsuo dɔ a hɛ ngmɛ ngɔ to Stefano nɔ, nɛ a na kaa e hɛ mi pee kaa Mawu bɔfo hɛ mi.

Title: NI TSUMI 7
Content:
Stefano je e nya ngɛ kpe ngua a hɛ mi
1Osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa a bi Stefano ke, “Anɛ munyu nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ mi ja lo?”
2 Stefano he nɔ ke, “Tsaatsɛmɛ kɛ ye nyɛmimɛ, nyɛɛ bu tue. Benɛ wa nɛ̃ Abraham ngɛ Mesopotamia nɛ e na we nɛ e ba hi Haran lolo ɔ, Mawu nɛ hɛ mi ngɛ nyami ɔ je e he kpo tsɔɔ lɛ, 3nɛ e de lɛ ke, ‘Jee o weku li ɔmɛ a kpɛti, kɛ o zugba a nɔ kɛ ya zugba nɛ ma tsɔɔ mo ɔ nɔ!’ 4 Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Abraham je Kaldea bi ɔmɛ a zugba a nɔ, nɛ e ya hi Haran. Benɛ e tsɛ gbo se ɔ, Mawu ha nɛ e je lejɛ ɔ kɛ ba zugba nɛ nyɛ ngɛ nɔ mwɔnɛ ɔ nɔ. 5 Mawu ha we Abraham nitsɛ zugba a kpɔ nɛ maa su nane ma he kake tete po. Se Mawu wo lɛ si kaa e ma ha nɛ zugba a ma ba pee e kɛ e nina a nɔ́. Benɛ Mawu wo si nɛ ɔ, Abraham be bi po. 6 Bɔ nɛ Mawu de lɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: ‘O nina ma ya to nibwɔ ngɛ ma se zugba ko nɔ, nɛ a maa ye mɛ nyɔguɛ, nɛ a maa wa mɛ yi mi jeha lafa eywiɛ sɔuu. 7 Jamɛ a ma a nɛ a ma ya sɔmɔ ɔ, ma gbla a tue; nɛ lɔ ɔ se ɔ, o nina a maa je lejɛ ɔ, nɛ a ma ba ja mi ngɛ hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ.’ 8 Kɛkɛ nɛ Mawu kɛ lɛ so, nɛ e tsɔɔ lɛ nɔ pomi okadi ɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, benɛ a fɔ Isak ɔ, Abraham po lɛ ligbi nɛ ji kpaanyɔ ɔ. Isak fɔ Yakob, nɛ Yakob po e bimɛ nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ nɛ ji wa blematsɛmɛ ɔmɛ.
9 “Yakob bimɛ ɔmɛ a hɛ ya kɔ̃ a nyɛmi Yosef nɔ, nɛ a jua lɛ kɛ ho Egipt ya. Se Mawu kɛ lɛ ngɛ, 10 nɛ e je lɛ kɛ je dengmehi tsuo a mi. Yosef hɛ mi ba nyami ngɛ Egipt matsɛ ɔ hɛ mi. Matsɛ ɔ na kaa e nɔ bɔ tsɔ, nɛ Mawu dloo lɛ nile nɛ mi kuɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, matsɛ ɔ tu Egipt zugba a, kɛ matsɛ we ɔ tsuo ngɔ wo Yosef dɛ mi. 11 Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, hwɔ ba Egipt kɛ Kanaan zugba a tsuo nɔ, nɛ a na nɔ́ saminya. Wa nɛmɛ ɔmɛ nɛ́ ní nɛ a ye. 12Benɛ Yakob nu kaa blɛfo ngɛ Egipt ɔ, e tsɔ e bimɛ ɔmɛ nɛ ji wa nɛmɛ ɔmɛ lejɛ ɔ. 13 Benɛ a kpale ya lejɛ ɔ si enyɔne ɔ, Yosef je e he si ngɔ ha e nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ, nɛ Egipt matsɛ ɔ hu ba le Yosef weku ɔ. 14 Jehanɛ Yosef tsɔ ke a ya ngɔ e tsɛ Yakob kɛ e we ɔ tsuo, nimli maa pee nyingmi kpaago kɛ enuɔ ɔ kɛ ba. 15 Kɛkɛ nɛ Yakob pue nɔ kɛ ho Egipt ya. Nɛ lejɛ ɔ e kɛ e bimɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ya gbo ngɛ. 16 A ngɔ a gbogbo ɔmɛ kɛ ba Shekem ba pu ngɛ yɔkɔ ko mi. Yɔkɔ nɛ ɔ, Abraham lɛ je sika kɛ he ngɛ Hamor bi ɔmɛ a dɛ.
17 “Benɛ be ɔ nɛ Mawu maa ye si nɛ e wo Abraham ɔ nɔ ɔ su ɔ, jamɛ a be ɔ, wa nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ a he ba hiɛ babauu. 18Kɛkɛ nɛ matsɛ ko ba bɔni tsɛ yemi ngɛ Egipt zugba a nɔ nɛ lɛɛ e li Yosef. 19 Matsɛ nɛ ɔ sisi wa nɛmɛ ɔmɛ, nɛ e wa mɛ yi mi. E ha nɛ a sake a bimwɔwi ngɔ pue he, konɛ a gbo. 20 Jamɛ a be ɔ mi nɔuu nɛ a fɔ Mose, binyumuyo kɛ e he fɛu. A hyɛ e nɔ ngɛ e tsɛ we ɔ nyɔhiɔ etɛ; 21 lɔ ɔ se, benɛ a sake lɛ ngɔ fɔ he ɔ, Farao ɔ biyo ya wo lɛ, nɛ e lɛ lɛ; nɛ e kɛ lɛ pee e bi. 22A tsɔɔ Mose Egipt nile tsuo, nɛ e na biɛ kpanaa; e he biɛ ngɛ munyu tumi kɛ e ní peepee tsuo mi.
23 “Benɛ Mose ye jeha nyingmi eywiɛ ɔ, e pee e yi mi kaa e ma ya slaa e nyɛmimɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ. 24Benɛ e ya mɛ slaami ɔ, e na a ti nɔ kake nɛ Egipt no ko ngɛ lɛ yi mi wae; nɛ e ya fa e nyɛmi ɔ he. E gbe Egipt no ɔ kɛ ye e nyɛmi ɔ he lue. 25Jinɛ e susu kaa e nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ maa na kaa Mawu ngɛ e nɔ gue nɛ e kɛ kpɔ mɛ, se e ya bɛ mi ja. 26E nɔ jena a, e ba na Israel bi enyɔ nɛ a ngɛ kunɔ nɔe. E ya kpata mɛ, nɛ e de ke, ‘Tsaatsɛmɛ, nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛmimɛ ji nyɛ, mɛni he je nyɛ ngɛ kunɔ nɔe?’ 27Se nɔ nɛ nɔ́ dɛ ɔ tsɛ̃ Mose kɛ ya se, nɛ e bi lɛ ke, ‘Mɛnɔ lɛ wo mo wa nɔ matsɛ kɛ kojolɔ? 28Anɛ o ngɛ hlae nɛ o gbe mi kaa bɔ nɛ o gbe jamɛ a Egipt no ɔ hiɛ ɔ?’ 29 Benɛ Mose nu munyu nɛ ɔ, e tu fo kɛ je Egipt, nɛ e ya to nibwɔ ngɛ Midian zugba a nɔ. E ya fɔ binyumuhi enyɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ.
30 “Jeha nyingmi eywiɛ se ɔ, Mawu bɔfo ba je e he kpo tsɔɔ Mose ngɛ la lilɛ mi ngɛ pu mi ngɛ Sinai yo ɔ he. 31Benɛ Mose na nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, e hɛ mi pee lɛ yaa. E hɛ lɛ kɛ yaa su he, konɛ e hyɛ; kɛkɛ nɛ e nu Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ gbi nɛ de lɛ ke, 32‘Imi ji o nɛmɛ a Mawu ɔ, Abraham, Isak, kɛ Yakob a Mawu ɔ.’ Gbeye ha Mose he do blibliibli, nɛ e nyɛ we nɛ e hyɛ nɔ́ ɔ hu. 33Kɛkɛ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ de lɛ ke, ‘Je tokota amɛ, ejakaa zugba klɔuklɔu nɔ nɛ o daa si ngɛ ɔ nɛ. 34Amanehlu nɛ ye ma a ngɛ nae ngɛ Egipt ɔ, i le; nɛ i nu a kɛmɛmi ɔ hulɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i kpale se kɛ ma ma ba je mɛ. Hyɛ, ma tsɔ mo Egipt.’
35 “Kikɛmɛ a Mose nɛ ɔ nɔuu nɛ Israel ma a ke a hla we lɛ, nɛ a bi ke, ‘Mɛnɔ lɛ wo mo wa nɔ matsɛ kɛ kojolɔ?’ ɔ, Mawu gu bɔfo ɔ nɛ je e he kpo tsɔɔ lɛ ngɛ pú ɔ mi ɔ nɔ, nɛ e tsɔ lɛ kaa e ba ye a nɔ nɛ e kpɔ mɛ. 36 Lɛ nɛ e nyɛɛ a hɛ mi kɛ je Egipt, nɛ e pee nyakpɛ níhi, kɛ okadihi ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, kɛ Wo Tsu ɔ mi, kɛ nga a nɔ jeha nyingmi eywiɛ. 37 Kikɛmɛ a Mose nɛ ɔ nɛ de Israel bi ɔmɛ ke, ‘Nyɔmtsɛ, nyɛ Mawu ɔ maa tsɔ gbalɔ ko kɛ je nyɛ nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ a kpɛti kaa bɔ nɛ e tsɔ mi ɔ nɛ.’ 38 Mose nɛ ɔ nɛ e kɛ Israel ma kpekpemi ɔ nɛ ji wa nɛmɛ ɔmɛ hi nga a nɔ ɔ nɛ. Lɛ nɛ e kɛ Mawu bɔfo ɔ tu munyu ngɛ Sinai yo ɔ he; nɛ lɛ nɔuu nɛ e ngɔ Mawu sɛ gbi nɛ wami ngɛ mi ɔ ba ha wɔ.
39“Wa nɛmɛ ɔmɛ bui lɛ, mohu a hɛɛ lɛ soisoi, nɛ a hla kaa a maa kpale a se kɛ ho Egipt ya ekohu. 40 Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a de Aaron ke, ‘Pee mawuhi ha wɔ, nɛ a nyɛɛ wa hɛ mi; se kikɛmɛ a Mose nɛ ɔ nɛ nyɛɛ wa hɛ mi kɛ je Egipt kɛ ba su hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ, wa li nɔ́ nɛ ya ba e nɔ.’ 41 Kɛkɛ nɛ a pee na bi, nɛ a sã bɔ ngɔ ha amaga nɛ ɔ; nɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a nine nya ní tsumi ɔ, a na he bua jɔmi babauu. 42 Lɔ ɔ he ɔ. Mawu je e hɛ ngɛ a nɔ, nɛ e ngmɛɛ a he kaa a ja dodoehi ngɛ hiɔwe kaa bɔ nɛ a ngma ngɛ gbali ɔmɛ a womi ɔ mi ke,
‘Nyɛ Israel ma,
anɛ imi nɛ nyɛ sã lohwehi, kɛ niye ni bɔ
ngɔ ha ngɛ nga a nɔ
jeha nyingmi eywiɛ ɔ?
43Molok bo tsu mohu nyɛ wo tloo,
kɛ nyɛ mawu Renfan ɔ dodoe ɔ;
enɛ ɔmɛ ji amagahi nɛ nyɛ puɛ nɛ nyɛ ja.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Babilon se lokoo
ma ha a maa ngɔ nyɛ kɛ ho.’
44 “Wa nɛmɛ ɔmɛ hɛɛ bo tsu nɛ tsɔɔ Mawu sihi he ɔ ngɛ nga a nɔ. A pee bo tsu ɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ kaa bɔ nɛ Mawu de Mose ke e pee ɔ. 45 Benɛ wa nɛmɛ ɔmɛ a nine su nɔ ɔ, a kɛ Yoshua hɛɛ lɛ kɛ ba je ma amɛ a zugba a nɔ. Zugba nɛ ɔ nɔ nɛ Mawu fie je ma amɛ kɛ je ha wa nɛmɛ ɔmɛ. Hiɛ ɔ bo tsu ɔ hi kɛ ba su David be ɔ mi. 46 David hɛ mi ba nyami ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi; nɛ e kpa Mawu pɛɛ ke e ngmɛ lɛ blɔ nɛ e pee sihi he ko ha lɛ, Yakob Mawu ɔ. 47 Se Salomo mohu lɛ ba ma tsu ha lɛ.
48“Pohu Hiɔwe No ɔ tsa hi tsu nɛ a kɛ adesa nine pee mi kaa bɔ nɛ gbalɔ ɔ hu de ɔ.
49 E ke, ‘Hiɔwe ɔ, ye matsɛ sɛ,
nɛ zugba a, nɔ́ nɛ i kɛ ye nane maa nɔ.
Mɛni tsu nyɛ maa ma ha mi mɔ?
Nɛ jije ma jɔɔ ye he ngɛ?
50Anɛ pi imi nitsɛ nɛ i pee enɛ ɔmɛ tsuo lo?’ ”
51 Stefano ya nɔ nɛ e de ke, “Nyɛ kuɛ wa kaa amaga jali, nɛ nyɛ tsui, kɛ nyɛ tue wa kaa nɔ́ ko! Nyɛ ngɛ kaa nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ pɛ! Nyɛ hu nyɛ kplɛɛ we nɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ nɛ tsu nyɛ he ní. 52Gbali ɔmɛ nɛ hi si sa a, nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ wa mɛ yi mi. A gbe ni nɛmɛ nɛ de to ke dalɔ ɔ maa ba a. Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, lɛ nitsɛ hu nyɛ tsɔɔ e se blɔ, nɛ nyɛ gbe lɛ. 53Nyɛ ná Mawu mlaa a kɛ gu Mawu bɔfo ɔmɛ a nɔ, se nyɛ yi nɔ.”
A fia Stefano tɛ
54Benɛ kpe ngua a mi bi ɔmɛ nu kikɛmɛ a munyu nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, a mi mi wo la wawɛɛ nitsɛ, nɛ a kpe lungu nya kɛ wo e he. 55Kɛkɛ nɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ ba Stefano nɔ wawɛɛ nitsɛ. E hyɛ hiɔwe too; e na Mawu hɛ mi nyami ɔ, nɛ e na Yesu nɛ daa si ngɛ Mawu hiɔ nɔ. 56Kɛkɛ nɛ e de ke, “Nyɛɛ hyɛ, i na hiɔwe nya nɛ bli nɛ Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ daa si ngɛ Mawu hiɔ nɔ!”
57Se kpe ngua a mi bi ɔmɛ kpa ngmlaa wawɛɛ, nɛ a kɛ a nine tsi a tue. A tu kɛ ba yu e nɔ. 58A tsitsɛɛ e yi se kɛ je ma a mi, nɛ a ya fia lɛ tɛ. Nihi nɛ fia Stefano tɛ ɔ nɛ peeɔ odase ɔ, je a tade ɔmɛ ngɔ ha niheyo ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Saulo, nɛ e hyɛ nɔ ha mɛ. 59Benɛ a ngɛ Stefano tɛ ɔ fiae ɔ, e sɔle, nɛ ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu, he ye mumi ɔ!” 60E kpla si, nɛ e kpa ngmlaa wawɛɛ ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, ngɔɔ yayami nɛ ɔ kɛ pa mɛ!” Benɛ e de kikɛ nɛ ɔ, kɛkɛ nɛ e ngɔ e nya.

Title: NI TSUMI 8
Content:
1Stefano gbemi ɔ ngɔ Saulo nya.
Saulo wa asafo ɔ yi mi
Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ nɔuu ɔ, a bɔni asafo ɔ nɛ ngɛ Yerusalem ɔ yi mi wami wawɛɛ. Nihi nɛ he ye ɔ tsuo gbɛ fĩa Yudea, kɛ Samaria kpokpa amɛ a nɔ; nɛ e piɛ bɔfo ɔmɛ pɛ. 2Nyumuhi Mawu gbeye yeli komɛ ya dla Stefano gbogboe ɔ, nɛ a nyɛ ya ha lɛ kɛ awe nyami.
3 Se Saulo lɛɛ e ka kaa e ma kpata asafo ɔ hɛ mi. E yaa wehi a mi, nɛ e ya nuɔ nyumuhi kɛ yihi, nɛ e ya woɔ mɛ tsu.
A fiɛ sane kpakpa a ngɛ Samaria
4Nihi nɛ gbɛ fĩa a ya kpa si nɛ a fiɛ sane kpakpa a. 5Filipo ya Samaria ma nguaa amɛ eko mi, nɛ e ya fiɛ Kristo he sane ɔ ngɔ tsɔɔ mɛ. 6Benɛ nimli babauu ɔ bu Filipo tue, nɛ a na okadihi nɛ e pee ɔ, mɛ tsuo a ngɔ e munyu ɔ. 7Nihi fuu nɛ mumi yayamihi ngɛ a mi ɔ, mumi ɔmɛ kpa ngmlaa wawɛɛ kɛ je a mi. A tsa nihi nɛ hule pue si, kɛ glɔtsɛmɛ babauu. 8Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, bua jɔmi babauu ba ma a mi.
9Nyumu ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Simon ngɛ ma a mi lejɛ ɔ. E tsuɔ kunya kɛ peeɔ níhi nɛ peeɔ Samaria bi ɔmɛ nyakpɛ nitsɛnitsɛ. E peeɔ e he kaa nɔmlɔ nguaa ji lɛ. 10Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ni wawi, kɛ ni nguahi tsuo buɔ lɛ, nɛ a deɔ ke, “Nɔmlɔ nɛ ɔ hɛɛ Mawu a he wami nɛ tsɛɛ kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ.” 11Niinɛ, kunya yemi nɛ ɔ nɛ haa ni ɔmɛ a nya kpɛɛ a he ɔ, Simon je sisi kɛ. 12Se benɛ Filipo fiɛ sane kpakpa a nɛ kɔɔ Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ, kɛ Yesu Kristo he ɔ tsɔɔ ni ɔmɛ ɔ, a sɔle, nyumuhi kɛ yihi tsuo nɛ he ye ɔ. 13Simon nitsɛ hu he ye, nɛ a sɔle lɛ. Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e kɛ Filipo bɔni nyɛɛmi. Benɛ Simon na okadihi, kɛ he wami ní nguanguahi nɛ a pee ɔ, e nya kpɛ e he.
14Bɔfo ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ Yerusalem ɔ na le kaa Samaria bi ɔmɛ pɛtɛ Mawu munyu ɔ he, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a tsɔ Petro kɛ Yohane kɛ ya a ngɔ. 15Benɛ a ba lejɛ ɔ, a ba sɔle ha nihi nɛ he ye ɔ, konɛ a na Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ. 16Ejakaa Mumi ɔ bɛ a ti nɔ ko nɔ lolo; se a sɔle mɛ ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu biɛ mi kɛkɛ. 17Jehanɛ, Petro kɛ Yohane ngɔ a nine pue ni ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ a na Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ.
18Simon na kaa bɔfo ɔmɛ a nine nɛ a ngɔ pue nihi nɛ he ye ɔ a nɔ ɔ ha nɛ a na Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e je sika kɛ ha Petro kɛ Yohane, 19nɛ e ke, “Nyɛ ha imi hu kikɛmɛ a he wami nɛ ɔ, konɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ma ngɔ ye nine kɛ pue e nɔ ɔ, e na Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ.”
20Se Petro de lɛ ke, “O kɛ o sika a tsuo hɛ mi nɛ kpata, ejakaa o susuu kaa Mawu nɔke nɔ́ ɔ, sika a kɛ heɔ! 21O be blɔ nya, loo blɔ fa mi nɔ́ ko ngɛ wa ní tsumi nɛ ɔ mi; ejakaa o tsui mi dɛ ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi. 22Pia o he mohu ngɛ nɔ́ yayami nɛ o susu ɔ he, nɛ o kpa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ pɛɛ kaa alini a maa ngɔ yayami nɛ o susu ɔ ngɔ pa mo lo. 23Ejakaa i na kaa hɛkɔ hyi mo tɔ kaa bɔ nɛ duɔ kuɔɔ nɔ ɔ, nɛ yayami bɔ mo pã.”
24Kɛkɛ nɛ Simon de Petro kɛ Yohane ke, “I kpa nyɛ pɛɛ, nyɛ kpa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ pɛɛ ha mi, konɛ níhi nɛ nyɛ de nɛ ɔmɛ ekoeko ko ba ye nɔ.”
25Benɛ Petro kɛ Yohane ye odase, nɛ a fiɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ munyu ɔ ngɔ tsɔɔ ni ɔmɛ se ɔ, a kpale a se kɛ ho Yerusalem ya. Benɛ a kpale kɛ yaa a, a fiɛ sane kpakpa a ngɛ Samaria kɔpehi fuu a mi.
Filipo kɛ Etiopia sɔmɔlɔ nɔkɔtɔma a
26Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ bɔfo ko ba de Filipo ke, “Dla o he nɛ o ya leneyi je, nɛ o nyɛɛ blɔ nɛ je Yerusalem kɛ yaa Gaza a nɔ.” (A nyɛɛ we blɔ nɛ ɔ nɔ hu.) 27-28Filipo dla e he, nɛ e ho. Benɛ e yaa a, e na Etiopia manyɛ ɔ tsɔlɔ nɔkɔtɔma ko nɛ a puɛ lɛ. Lɛ nɛ e hyɛɛ manyɛ ɔ juetli nɔ. Nyumu nɛ ɔ ya Yerusalem ya ja Mawu, nɛ e kpale kɛ yaa e ma mi ngɛ e zugba lɛ mi. Benɛ e yaa a tsuo e ngɛ gbalɔ Yesaya womi ɔ kanee. 29Kɛkɛ nɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ de Filipo ke, “Nyɛɛ kɛ ya lɛ nɛ ɔ he haa.” 30Kɛkɛ nɛ Filipo sa fo kɛ ya na lɛ ɔ, nɛ e nu nɛ nyumu ɔ ngɛ gbalɔ Yesaya womi ɔ kanee. Filipo bi lɛ ke, “Nɔ́ nɛ o ngɛ kanee ɔ, anɛ o ngɛ sisi nue?”
31Sɔmɔlɔ nɔkɔtɔma a he nɔ ke, “Kɛ ma pee kɛɛ nɛ ma nu sisi kaa ja nɔ ko tsɔɔ mi?” Kɛkɛ nɛ e de Filipo ke e kuɔ lɛ ɔ nɛ e ba hi si ngɛ e kasa nya. 32 Ngmami ɔ mi he nɛ e ngɛ kanee ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ:
“A ngɔ lɛ kɛ ho kaa jijɔ nɛ a yaa gbe!
Nɛ bɔ nɛ jijɔ bi peeɔ kpoo
ngɛ e he bwɔmi sãlɔ hɛ mi ɔ,
ja nɔuu e pee.
nɛ e kpɛ we e kuɔ si.
33A wa lɛ yi mi; a ye lɛ sane yaya.
Mɛnɔ ma nyɛ maa gba e nina he sane?
Ejakaa a po e wami nɔ kpiti
ngɛ je ɔ mi.”
34Sɔmɔlɔ nɔkɔtɔma a bi Filipo ke, “I kpa mo pɛɛ, mɛnɔ he munyu gbalɔ ɔ ngɛ tue ɔ? Lɛ nitsɛ e he, loo nɔ kpa?” 35Kɛkɛ nɛ Filipo wo e nya nɔ nɛ e bɔni munyu tumi. E je sisi kɛ ngmami ɔ nɛ sɔmɔlɔ nɔkɔtɔma a ngɛ kanee ɔ, nɛ e gba Yesu he sane kpakpa a. 36Benɛ a ngɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ kɛ yaa a, a ya su he ko nɛ nyu ngɛ; kɛkɛ nɛ sɔmɔlɔ nɔkɔtɔma a de ke, “O nɛ nyu; mɛni maa tsi ye sɔlemi nya?”
[ 37Filipo de lɛ ke, “Ke o heɔ yeɔ kɛ o tsui tsuo ɔ, lɛɛ blɔ ngɛ he faa.” E he nɔ ke, “I heɔ yeɔ kaa Yesu Krsito ji Mawu Bi ɔ nɛ.”]
38Kɛkɛ nɛ sɔmɔlɔ nɔkɔtɔma a fa nɛ zugba lɛ ɔ da si. E kɛ Filipo tsuo kple si, nɛ a ho nyu ɔ mi ya; nɛ Filipo sɔle lɛ. 39Benɛ a je nyu ɔ mi ɔ, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ Mumi ɔ ngɔ Filipo kɛ je. Sɔmɔlɔ nɔkɔtɔma a nɛ́ lɛ hu; se e pue nɔ kɛ ho kɛ nyami babauu. 40Filipo ya je Azoto. E fiɛ sane kpakpa a ngɛ ma amɛ tsuo a mi hluu kɛ ya su Kaisarea.

Title: NI TSUMI 9
Content:
Saulo tsake e tsui
(Ni Tsumi 22.6-16; 26.12-18)
1Be nɛ ɔ mi tsuo ɔ, Saulo ya nɔ nɛ e wa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ se nyɛɛli ɔmɛ yi mi; e woɔ a he gbeye wawɛɛ kaa e ma pue a muɔ si. E ya osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa a ngɔ, 2nɛ e ya bi nɛ a ha lɛ womi nɛ e kɛ ya Damasko kpe he ɔmɛ, konɛ ke e na Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ se nyɛɛli komɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, nyumuhi jio, yihi jio, e nuu mɛ kɛ ba Yerusalem.
3Benɛ Saulo nyɛɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ kɛ yaa, nɛ e su Damasko haa a, tlukaa a, la ko kpɛ kɛ je hiɔwe kɛ ba bɔle lɛ. 4Saulo tsɔ fia si, nɛ e nu gbi ko nɛ ngɛ lɛ bie ke, “Saulo, Saulo, mɛni he je o ngɛ mi yi mi wae?”
5Saulo bi ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, mo mɛnɔ?”
Gbi ɔ de lɛ ke “Imi ji Yesu, nɔ nɛ o ngɛ lɛ yi mi wae ɔ nɛ! 6Tee si ngɛ zugba, nɛ o ya ma a mi, nɛ a maa tsɔɔ mo nɔ́ nɛ sa kaa o pee!”
7Nihi nɛ Saulo kɛ mɛ nyɛɛ ɔ tɔ mu kɛ daa si; a nu gbi ɔ mohu, se a nɛ́ nɔ ko nɔ ko. 8Saulo te si, nɛ e bli e hɛngmɛ, se e hyɛ we nɔ́. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a nu e nine si kɛ ya Damasko. 9E hyɛ we nɔ ligbi etɛ sɔuu; nɛ e yi ní, nɛ e nui nɔ́ ko hulɔ.
10Jamɛ a be ɔ, Yesu se nyɛɛlɔ ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Anania ngɛ Damasko. Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ kɛ lɛ tu munyu ngɛ nina mi, nɛ e de ke, “Anania!”
Anania he nɔ ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, ne mi!”
11Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ de lɛ ke, “Dla o he nɛ o ya Yuda we ɔ mi ngɛ he nɛ gbɛjegbɛ nɛ a tsɛɛ Tlɔmɔɔ ɔ ngɛ ɔ. Ke o su lejɛ ɔ, bi nyumu ko nɛ a tsɛɛ Saulo nɛ je Tarso ɔ si. E ngɛ sɔlee, 12nɛ a je tsɔɔ lɛ kaa nyumu ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Anania a ma e ngɔ nɛ e kɛ e nine ba pue e nɔ konɛ e hyɛ nɔ́ ekohu.”
13Se Anania he nɔ ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, nihi fuu tu kikɛmɛ a nyumu nɛ ɔ he munyu yaya. A tsɔɔ kaa Mawu bimɛ ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ Yerusalem ɔ, e ha nɛ a na amanehlu babauu nitsɛnitsɛ. 14Hiɛ ɔ nɛ e ba nɛ ɔ hu, he wami e ya bi kɛ je osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ a ngɔ, konɛ e ba nuu nihi tsuo nɛ jaa mo ɔ.”
15Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ de lɛ ke, “Yaa, ejakaa nɔ nɛ ɔ, imi nɛ i hla lɛ nɛ e sɔmɔ mi, nɛ e ya fiɛ ye he sane ha ma je li, matsɛmɛ, kɛ Israel ma a tsuo. 16Ejakaa ma tsɔɔ lɛ bɔ nɛ e ma gbo dengme wawɛɛ ngɛ ye biɛ ɔ he.”
17Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Anania pue nɔ kɛ ho we mi he nɛ Saulo ngɛ ɔ ya. E kɛ e nine ya pue e nɔ, nɛ e de lɛ ke, “Ye nyɛmi Saulo, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ tsɔ mi o ngɔ. Lɛ ji Yesu nɛ je e he kpo tsɔɔ mo benɛ o ma ngɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ ɔ nɛ. E tsɔ mi, konɛ ma ba ha nɛ o hyɛ nɔ́ ekohu, nɛ́ o na Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ.” 18Amlɔ nɔuu ɔ, ní komɛ kaa lo toto je Saulo hɛngmɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ pue si, nɛ e bɔni nɔ́ hyɛmi ekohu. E te si, nɛ a sɔle lɛ. 19Benɛ e ye ní ɔ, e na he wami.
Saulo fiɛ sane kpakpa a ngɛ Damasko
Saulo kɛ Yesu se nyɛɛli ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ Damasko ɔ hi si ligbi bɔɔ ko. 20E bɔni fiɛmi jamɛ a be ɔ nɔuu ngɛ kpe he ɔmɛ ke Yesu ji Mawu Bi ɔ nɛ.
21Nihi tsuo nɛ nu nɛ e ngɛ fiɛe ɔ, a nya kpɛ a he, nɛ a de ke, “Anɛ pi nyumu nɛ ɔ nɛ gbe Yesu se nyɛɛli basabasa ngɛ Yerusalem ɔ? Hiɛ ɔ tete nɛ e ba nɛ ɔ, anɛ pi jamɛ a nyɛɛmi ɔ nɔuu nɔ nɛ e ngɛ, konɛ e ba nuu mɛ nɛ e ngɔ mɛ kɛ ya ha osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ lo?”
22Se Saulo ya nɔ nɛ e fiɛ kɛ he wami pe kekle ɔ po kɛ tsɔɔ kaa Yesu ji Kristo ɔ nɛ. Enɛ ɔ ha Yuda bi nɛ ngɛ Yerusalem ɔ a nya mi jɔ.
23 Be saii se ɔ, Yuda bi ɔmɛ ya so Saulo yi nɔ kaa a maa gbe lɛ. 24Se Saulo nu a somi ɔ he. Daa nyɔ kɛ pia a, nihi ngɛ ma agbo ɔmɛ a nya bue, konɛ a gbe lɛ. 25Se Saulo we bi ɔmɛ ngɔ lɛ kɛ wo kusii mi nyɔ mi, nɛ a siu lɛ kɛ gu gbogbo nɛ a fia kɛ wo ma a he ɔ puɔ mi kɛ ya ma si ngɛ e se.
Saulo ngɛ Yerusalem
26Benɛ Saulo ba Yerusalem ɔ, e hla kaa e kɛ e he maa bɔ kaseli ɔmɛ a he, se mɛ tsuo a ye lɛ gbeye kaa a kɛ lɛ maa bɔ; ejakaa a he we yi kaa e tsake pee Yesu se nyɛɛlɔ. 27Se Barnaba ngɔ lɛ kɛ ya bɔfo ɔmɛ a ngɔ, nɛ e ya sɛɛ nɔ́ nɛ ba a ha mɛ. E de mɛ bɔ nɛ Saulo na Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ngɛ Damasko blɔ ɔ nɔ nɛ e kɛ lɛ tu munyu, kɛ bɔ nɛ pee nɛ e na he wami ngɛ Yesu biɛ mi. 28Saulo kɛ mɛ hi si, nɛ e kɛ he wami fiɛ sane kpakpa a kɛ kpa Yerusalem tsuo. 29Ke pee ɔ, e kɛ Helene bi hu hlaa níhi a mi, nɛ a sãã nya; se mɛɛ lɛɛ a hla kaa a maa gbe lɛ. 30Benɛ nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ nu he ɔ, a kɛ Saulo ya Kaisarea, nɛ a wo lɛ blɔ kɛ ho Tarso ya.
31Bɔ nɛ pee nɛ asafo ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ Yudea, Galilea, kɛ Samaria tsuo na tue mi jɔmi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ gbeye yemi ngɛ asafo ɔmɛ a mi. Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ wo asafo ɔmɛ he wami, nɛ a ya nɔ, nɛ nihi babauu ba piɛ a he.
Petro ngɛ Lida kɛ Yopa
32Petro ya kpa si kɛ slaa asafo ɔmɛ ngɛ he tsuaa he kɛ ya si e ba su ni klɔuklɔu nɛ ngɛ Lida a hu a ngɔ. 33E ba na nyumu ko ngɛ lejɛ ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Aenea. Nyumu nɛ ɔ hule pue si jeha kpaanyɔ sɔuu nɛ e nyɛɛ we. 34Kɛkɛ nɛ Petro de lɛ ke, “Aenea, Yesu Kristo tsa mo; tee si nɛ o hluɛ o sa a!” Aenea te si amlɔ. 35Nihi tsuo nɛ ngɛ Lida, kɛ Saron ɔ na lɛ, nɛ a ngɔ a he kɛ ba ha Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ.
36Yo ko hu ngɛ Yopa nɛ ji Yesu se nyɛɛlɔ. A tsɛɛ lɛ Tabita, aloo ngɛ Hela gbi mi ɔ, Dorka. Biɛ nɛ ɔ sisi ji Odabɔ. Daa nɛ ɔ, kpakpa sɔuu e peeɔ, titli ɔ, e hyɛɔ dɛgutsɛmɛ a nɔ. 37Yo nɛ ɔ ba nu hiɔ, nɛ e gbo. A du ha lɛ, nɛ a kɛ lɛ ya fɔ sa nɔ ngɛ hiɔwe tsu ko mi. 38Yopa kɛ Lida kɛ we. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, benɛ Yesu se nyɛɛli nɛ ngɛ Yopa a nu kaa Petro ngɛ Lida a, a tsɔ ni enyɔ kɛ ya de lɛ ke, “Wa kpa mo pɛɛ nɛ o ba su wa ngɔ nɔuu; koo to tsle.” 39Petro dla nɛ e kɛ mɛ pue nɔ kɛ ho nɔuu. Benɛ e su lejɛ ɔ, a kɛ lɛ ya hiɔwe tsu ɔ mi. Yalɔyihi babauu ba pue e nɔ kɛ ya. A kɛ yi nɔ tadehi, kɛ tade kpahi nɛ Dorka kpɛ benɛ e ngɛ je mi ɔ tsɔɔ lɛ. 40Se Petro je mɛ kpo. Kɛkɛ nɛ e kpla si nɛ e sɔle; nɛ e plɛ e hɛ mi ngɔ kpee gbogboe ɔ, nɛ e de ke, “Tabita, tee si!” Tabita bli e hɛngmɛ; nɛ benɛ e na Petro ɔ, e wo e he nɔ, nɛ e hi si. 41Petro nu e nine si, nɛ e wo e nɔ da si. Jehanɛ e tsɛ ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ, kɛ a kpɛti yalɔyi ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ ba. E kɛ Dorka ba da a hɛ mi hɛ ngmengmle. 42Sane nɛ ɔ gbɛ fia Yopa tsuo; nɛ nihi babauu he Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ye. 43Petro hi Yopa be saii ngɛ lohwe he womi tsopa wolɔ ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Simon ngɔ.

Title: NI TSUMI 10
Content:
Petro kɛ Kornelio
1Nyumu ko ngɛ Kaisarea nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Kornelio. Kornelio nɛ ɔ, Roma tabo ɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ Italia tabo ɔ we asafoatsɛ ji lɛ. 2Mawu jalɔ ji lɛ, nɛ e kɛ e we ɔ tsuo yee Mawu gbeye. E peeɔ mami bi dɛgutsɛmɛ ɔmɛ kpakpa hulɔ, nɛ e kpaa Mawu pɛɛ daa. 3Ligbi ko piani maa pee ngmlɛ etɛ ɔ, a je tsɔɔ lɛ ngɛ nina mi kaa Mawu bɔfo ba e ngɔ ba tsɛ lɛ ke, “Kornelio!”
4Kornelio hyɛ lɛ too; gbeye nu lɛ, nɛ e bi ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, mɛni sane?”
Bɔfo ɔ de lɛ ke, “Kue nɛ o ngɛ fae, kɛ kpakpa nɛ o ngɛ pee ɔ, Mawu na he bua jɔmi. 5Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, moo tsɔ nihi kɛ ya Yopa, nɛ o ya kpee Simon nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Petro hulɔ ɔ kɛ ba. 6E ya to Simon, lohwe he womi tsopa wolɔ ɔ ngɔ ngɛ wo ɔ nya.” 7Kɛkɛ nɛ Mawu bɔfo ɔ je. Jehanɛ Kornelio tsɛ e sɔmɔli enyɔ, kɛ ta bulɔ kake kɛ ba e ngɔ. Ta bulɔ nɛ ɔ, Kornelio he buli ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake nɛ yee Mawu gbeye ji lɛ. 8E sɛɛ níhi nɛ ba e nɔ ɔ tsuo ha mɛ; kɛkɛ nɛ e tsɔ mɛ Yopa.
9E nɔ jena benɛ a ngɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ kɛ yaa nɛ a miɔ nɛ a maa su Yopa, maa pee ngmlɛ nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔ, Petro ho tsu ɔ yi mi ya, konɛ e ya sɔle. 10Hwɔ bɔni lɛ yemi, nɛ e hla kaa e na nɔ́ ko nɛ e ye. Se benɛ a ngɛ niye ní ɔ pee ɔ, nɔ́ nɔ e nɔ. 11E na nɛ hiɔwe nya bli, nɛ nɔ́ ko kaa bo nguaa ko je lejɛ ɔ kɛ ma zugba kaa nɔ nɛ pe a hɛɛ e kɔ nya eywiɛ ɔmɛ a mi. 12Lohwe nane eywiɛɛywiɛtsɛmɛ, lohwehi nɛ waa, kɛ lohwe pɛlitsɛ slɔɔto ɔmɛ tsuo eko ngɛ mi. 13Gbi ko de lɛ ke, “Petro, tee si; gbee eko nɛ o ye!”
14Se Petro ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, dɛbi; nɔ́ ko nɛ a buu kaa e he tsɔ we, loo e sɛ nɛ a yeɔ ɔ, i yi hyɛ.”
15Gbi ɔ de lɛ ekohu ke, “Nɔ́ nɛ Mawu tsu he ɔ, koo bu lɛ kaa e sɛ nɛ a yeɔ!” 16Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ya nɔ si etɛ, kɛkɛ nɛ a kpale nɔ́ ɔ kɛ ho hiɔwe ya.
17Benɛ Petro dɛ yaa, nɛ e ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ he susue ɔ, jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, ni ɔmɛ nɛ Kornelio tsɔ ɔ ya bi si, nɛ a ba we mi he nɛ Simon ngɛ ɔ; nɛ a daa si ngɛ agbo ɔ nya. 18A bi kɛ ngmlaa ke, “Nubwɔ ko ngɛ we nɛ ɔ mi nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Simon Petro lo?”
19Se benɛ Petro ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ a je tsɔɔ lɛ ɔ he susue kɛ mwɔɔ ɔ, Mumi ɔ de lɛ ke, “Hyɛ, nyumuhi ni etɛ ngɛ mo hlae. 20Dla o he nɛ o kple si esɔ, nɛ o kɛ mɛ nɛ ho; ejakaa imi lɛ i tsɔ mɛ.” 21Petro kple si, nɛ e ya de nyumu ɔmɛ ke, “Imi ji nɔ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ hlae ɔ nɛ. Sane ko lo?”
22A he nɔ ke, “Asafoatsɛ Kornelio lɛ tsɔ wɔ. Nyumu nɛ ɔ yeɔ dami sane; e yee Mawu gbeye wawɛɛ, nɛ Yuda bi ɔmɛ tsuo tuɔ e he munyu kpakpa. Mawu bɔfo ko de lɛ ke e tsɔ nɛ a ba kpee mo kɛ ba e we ɔ mi, konɛ e bu o nya mi munyu tue.” 23Petro kɛ mɛ ya we ɔ mi, nɛ a ya hwɔ e ngɔ.
E nɔ jena a, e kɛ mɛ pue nɔ kɛ ho; nɛ nyɛmimɛ nɛ ngɛ Yopa a a ti ni komɛ piɛ e he. 24E nɔ jena ekohu ɔ, a ya su Kaisarea. Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, Kornelio ngɛ mɛ blɔ hyɛe, nɛ e tsɛ e weku li, kɛ e huɛmɛ kpakpahi kɛ ba kpe. 25Benɛ Petro ngɛ we ɔ mi sɛe ɔ, Kornelio kɛ lɛ ba kpe, nɛ e ba kpla si ngɛ Petro nane nya. 26Se Petro wo e nɔ, nɛ e ke, “Tee si! Imi nitsɛ hu adesa kɛkɛ ji mi.” 27Petro kɛ Kornelio sɛɛ ní hluu kɛ ya sɛ we ɔ mi. Petro na kaa nihi babauu ba bua a he nya ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. 28Nɛ e de mɛ ke, “Nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ le kaa Yuda no be he blɔ nɛ e kɛ ma kpa ko mi no bɔɔ, aloo e baa e ngɔ. Se imi lɛɛ Mawu je tsɔɔ mi ke ma ko bu nɔ ko yaka nɔmlɔ, loo nɔ nɛ he tsɔ we. 29Enɛ ɔ he hulɔ nɛ benɛ a tsɔ ba tsɛ mi ɔ, i je we ye nya, nɛ i ba a nɛ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i ngɛ nyɛ bie ke, mɛni he je nyɛ tsɔ ba tsɛ mi ɔ?”
30Kornelio he nɔ ke, “Mwɔnɛ ɔ ji ligbi eywiɛ, maa pee gbɔkuɛ ngmlɛ etɛ ɔ, i ngɛ sɔlee ngɛ ye we ɔ mi. Tlukaa a, nyumu ko nɛ wo tade nɛ ngɛ kpɛe klãiklãi ba da ye hɛ mi, 31nɛ e de ke, ‘Kornelio, Mawu nu o kue fami ɔ, nɛ ní kpakpahi nɛ o pee ɔ hu, e ná he bua jɔmi. 32Moo tsɔ nihi kɛ ya Yopa, nɛ o ya kpee Simon nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Petro hulɔ ɔ kɛ ba. E ya to Simon, lohwe he womi tsopa wolɔ ɔ ngɔ ngɛ wo ɔ nya.’ 33Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, amlɔ nɔuu ɔ, i tsɔ nihi o ngɔ; nɛ o pee saminya kaa o ba. Amlɔ nɛ ɔ nɛ wɔ tsuo wa ba bua ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ hɛ mi ngɛ hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ, nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ ko nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ de mo ɔ, wa suɔ nɛ waa maa nu.”
Petro fiɛ sane kpakpa a ha Kornelio kɛ e we mi bi ɔmɛ
34 Kɛkɛ nɛ Petro wo e nya nɔ nɛ e de ke, “I kpa si anɔkuale mi kaa Mawu hyɛ we nɔ hɛ mi. 35Se mohu ma tsuaa ma mi ɔ, nɔ nɛ yee Mawu gbeye, nɛ e peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a, lɛ ji nɔ nɛ saa e hɛ mi. 36Mawu tsɔ nɛ a kɛ munyu ɔ ya ha Israel bi ɔmɛ, nɛ a gu Yesu Kristo nɔ kɛ jaje sane kpakpa a nɛ kɛ tue mi jɔmi baa a ngɔ tsɔɔ mɛ. Lɛ, Yesu Kristo ɔ ji nimli adesahi tsuo a Nyɔmtsɛ. 37Nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ le sane ɔ nɛ ba ngɛ Yudea a tsuo momo; e je sisi kɛ je Galilea, kɛ je benɛ Yohane, nɔ sɔlelɔ ɔ fiɛ ɔ se. 38Nyɛ le Yesu nɛ je Nazaret ɔ he sane, bɔ nɛ Mawu hla lɛ, nɛ e ha nɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ he wami ɔ ba e nɔ. Nyɛ le bɔ nɛ e kpa si kɛ ya he tsuaa he kɛ kpakpa peemi. E tsa hiɔtsɛmɛ, nɛ e hia mumi yayamihi hulɔ; ejakaa Mawu kɛ lɛ ngɛ. 39Níhi tsuo nɛ e pee ngɛ Yuda bi ɔmɛ a zugba a nɔ, kɛ Yerusalem tsuo ɔ, wa yeɔ he odase. A sɛu lɛ ngɛ sɛumi tso nɔ, nɛ e gbo. 40Se Mawu tle lɛ si ligbi etɛne ɔ, nɛ e ha nɛ e je e he kpo tsɔɔ 41wɔ nihi nɛ Mawu hla ngɔ to momo kaa odase yeli ɔ, se pi nɔ tsuaa nɔ. Wɔ ji ni nɛmɛ nɛ e kɛ wɔ ye ní nɛ wa nu ní, benɛ e te si kɛ je gbeje se ɔ. 42Jehanɛ hu, e fa wɔ ke waa fiɛ sane kpakpa a ngɔ tsɔɔ ma a, nɛ waa ye odase kaa lɛ ji nɔ nɛ Mawu hla nɛ e kojo nihi nɛ hɛ ngɛ, kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ gbo ɔ. 43Gbali ɔmɛ tsuo ye Yesu he odase, nɛ a de ke nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ma he lɛ maa ye ɔ, a maa ngɔ e he yayami kɛ pa lɛ ngɛ Yesu biɛ mi.”
Ma je li ɔmɛ ná Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ
44Benɛ Petro ngɛ munyu tue kɛ mwɔɔ ɔ, Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ ba nihi tsuo nɛ ngɛ munyu ɔ tue bue ɔ a nɔ. 45Enɛ ɔ ha Yuda bi nɛ he ye, nɛ a kɛ Petro je Yopa kɛ ba a a nya kpɛ a he kaa Mawu ha nɛ nɔke nɔ́ nɛ ji Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ ba ma je li ɔmɛ hu a nɔ. 46Ejakaa a nu kaa a ngɛ ma se gbi slɔɔtohi tue, nɛ a ngɛ Mawu yi jee. Kɛkɛ nɛ Petro wo e gbi nɔ nɛ e de ke, 47“Ni nɛ ɔmɛ ná Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ kaa bɔ nɛ wɔ hu wa na a. Anɛ nɔ ko ma nyɛ maa tsi nya nɛ a ko ngɔ nyu kɛ sɔle mɛ lo?” 48Kɛkɛ nɛ e fa ke a sɔle ni ɔmɛ ngɛ Yesu Kristo biɛ mi. Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, a kpa Petro pɛɛ ke e kɛ mɛ nɛ hi si be bɔɔ ko.

Title: NI TSUMI 11
Content:
Petro bɔ Yerusalem asafo ɔ amaniɛ
1Bɔfo ɔmɛ, kɛ nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ nɛ he Yesu ye, nɛ a ngɛ Yudea a tsuo nu kaa ma je li ɔmɛ hu pɛtɛ Mawu munyu ɔ he. 2Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, benɛ Petro ba Yerusalem ɔ, nihi nɛ a po mɛ ɔ a ti ni komɛ kɛ lɛ na nya sami. 3A ke, “O ya ma je li nɛ a pui mɛ ɔ a ngɔ, nɛ o kɛ mɛ ya ye ní!” 4Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Petro bɔ mɛ amaniɛ ɔ tsuo fitsofitso ke,
5“Benɛ i ngɛ sɔlee ngɛ Yopa ma a mi ɔ, nɔ́ nɔ ye nɔ, nɛ a je nɔ́ ko tsɔɔ mi. I na nɔ́ ko kaa bo nguaa ko nɛ je hiɔwe. A hɛɛ nɔ ɔ kɔ nya eywiɛ ɔmɛ, nɛ a ngɛ siue kɛ ma zugba kɛ ba su ye ngɔ haa. 6I hyɛ nɔ́ ɔ mi too, nɛ i na we mi lohwe nane eywiɛɛywiɛtsɛmɛ, kɛ nga mi lohwehi, kɛ lohwehi nɛ waa, kɛ lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ ngɛ mi. 7Jehanɛ, i nu gbi ko nɛ de mi ke, ‘Petro, tee si, gbee eko nɛ o ye!’ 8Se i de lɛ ke, ‘Dɛbi Nyɔmtsɛ, i yi yakayaka nɔ́ ko, loo nɔ́ ko nɛ he tsɔ we hyɛ.’ 9Se gbi nɛ je hiɔwe ɔ he nɔ ekohu ke, ‘Nɔ́ nɛ Mawu tsu he ɔ, koo bu lɛ kaa e sɛ kaa a ye.’ 10A pee jã si etɛ, nɛ nyagbe ɔ, a wo nɔ́ ɔ kɛ ho hiɔwe ya ekohu. 11Jamɛ a be ɔ mi nɔuu ɔ, nyumuhi etɛ ba da agbo ɔ nya ngɛ we mi he nɛ i ngɛ ɔ; a tsɔ mɛ kɛ je Kaisarea kɛ ba ye ngɔ. 12Mumi ɔ de mi ke i kɛ mɛ nɛ ya, nɛ ma ko to tsle. I kɛ nyɛmimɛ ekpa nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ je Yopa a ya Kornelio we ɔ mi. 13Lɛ hu e bɔ wɔ bɔ nɛ e na Mawu bɔfo ko ngɛ e we ɔ mi. Bɔfo ɔ ba da si ngɛ e hɛ mi nɛ e de lɛ ke, ‘Moo tsɔ nihi kɛ ya Yopa, nɛ o ya kpee Simon nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Petro hulɔ ɔ kɛ ba. 14Ke e ba a, e ma de mo níhi nɛ a maa gu nɔ kɛ he mo nitsɛ, kɛ o we ɔ tsuo nyɛ yi wami.’ 15Benɛ i bɔni munyu ɔ tumi nɔuu kɛkɛ nɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ ba a nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ e ba wɔ hu wa nɔ kekleekle Pentekoste ligbi ɔ. 16 Kɛkɛ nɛ i kai kaa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ tu munyu nɛ ɔ ke, ‘Yohane ɔ, nyu e kɛ sɔle ni ɔmɛ, se nyɛɛ lɛɛ Mawu maa ngɔ Mumi Klɔuklɔu kɛ sɔle nyɛ.’ 17E fɔɔ si paa kaa nike ní ɔ nɛ wa ná benɛ wa he Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo ye ɔ, lɔ ɔ nɔuu nɛ Mawu ha jamɛ a ma je li ɔmɛ ɔ nɛ. Mɛnɔ ji mi mɔ nɛ ma de ke i ngɛ Mawu nya tsie!”
18Benɛ a nu munyu nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, a nya mi jɔ, nɛ a wo Mawu hɛ mi nyami mohu, nɛ a de ke, “Lɛɛ ma je li ɔmɛ hu Mawu ha mɛ he blɔ kaa a tsake a tsui, konɛ a he a yi wami!”
Antiokia asafo ɔ
19 Stefano gbenɔ se ɔ, a bɔni nihi nɛ he Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu ye ɔ yi mi wami wawɛɛ. Enɛ ɔ ha nɛ a ti ni komɛ tu fo kɛ ho Foinike, Kipro, kɛ Antiokia tɔɔ ya. A fiɛ we munyu ɔ kɛ ha we nɔ ko nɔ ko pe Yuda bi kɛkɛ. 20Se a ti ni komɛ nɛ je Kipro kɛ Kirene lɛɛ a pue nɔ kɛ ho Antiokia ya ya fiɛ sane kpakpa a nɛ kɔɔ Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu he ɔ kɛ tsɔɔ Hela bi hulɔ. 21Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ piɛ a he, nɛ nihi babauu he ye, nɛ a tsake.
22Asafo ɔ nɛ ngɛ Yerusalem ɔ nu sane nɛ ba nɛ ɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a tsɔ Barnaba Antiokia. 23Benɛ e ya su lejɛ ɔ, nɛ e na bɔ nɛ Mawu gbaa ni ɔmɛ ɔ, e bua jɔ e he, nɛ e tu munyu tsɔɔ mɛ tsuo ke a ye Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ anɔkuale kɛ a tsui tsuo. 24Barnaba a, nɔmlɔ kpakpa nɛ heɔ Mawu yeɔ saminya ji lɛ, nɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu hyi lɛ tɔ. Enɛ ɔ ha nɛ a na nihi babauu kɛ ha Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ.
25Jehanɛ Barnaba pue nɔ kɛ ho Tarso ya ya hla Saulo. 26Benɛ e na lɛ ɔ, e kɛ lɛ ba Antiokia ekohu. A kɛ asafo ɔ hi si jeha mluku, nɛ a tsɔɔ nihi babauu ní. Antiokia ji he nɛ a wo nihi nɛ he ye ɔ biɛ ngɛ ke Kristo we bi.
27Maa pee jamɛ a be ɔ mi nɔuu ɔ, gbali komɛ je Yerusalem kɛ ba Antiokia. 28 A ti nɔ ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Agabo ɔ te da si, nɛ Mumi ɔ ha nɛ e gba nɛ e de ke hwɔ nguaa ko ma ba te si ngɛ je ɔ mi tsuo. Hwɔ ba niinɛ ngɛ Kaisare Klaudio yi nɔ. 29Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, kaseli ɔmɛ pee a yi mi kaa a ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ ma tsu nɔ́ ko bɔ nɛ e ma nyɛ, konɛ a kɛ ya je ngmlaa ha nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ Yudea. 30A pee ja niinɛ, nɛ a ngɔ sika a kɛ mane asafo nikɔtɔma amɛ kɛ gu Barnaba kɛ Saulo a nine nɔ.

Title: NI TSUMI 12
Content:
A wa asafo ɔ yi mi babauu
1Jamɛ a be ɔ mi nɔuu ɔ, Matsɛ Herode bɔni asafo ɔ mi bi ɔmɛ ekomɛ yi mi wami. 2E ha nɛ a kɛ klaate gbe Yohane nyɛmi Yakobo. 3Benɛ e na kaa e ngɔ Yuda bi ɔmɛ a nya a, e ya nɔ nɛ e ha nɛ a nu Petro. (Abolokplolo nyami be mi nɛ e tsu kikɛmɛ a ní nɛ ɔ). 4 Benɛ a nu Petro ɔ, a wo lɛ tsu, nɛ a tu lɛ ngɔ wo ta buli a dɛ mi nɛ a bu e he. A dla ta buli ɔmɛ a mi eywiɛ, nɛ ta buli eywiɛ ngɛ kuu tsuaa kuu mi. Herode to kaa ke a ye Hetsɔmi ɔ ta pɛ e maa ngɔ Petro kɛ ha ma a nɛ a kojo lɛ. 5Enɛ ɔ he ɔ, e tsi Petro nya ngɛ tsu ɔ mi; se Kristo asafo ɔ kpa Mawu pɛɛ wawɛɛ kɛ ha Petro.
A je Petro ngɛ tsu mi
6Nyɔ ɔ mi, loko je maa na nɛ Herode maa ngɔ Petro kɛ ba ma a hɛ mi, konɛ a kojo lɛ ɔ, Petro hwɔɔ si ngɛ ta buli enyɔ a kpɛti. A kɛ kɔsɔkɔsɔ enyɔ bɔ lɛ pã, nɛ buli daa si ngɛ sinya a nya nɛ a ngɛ tsu ɔ he bue. 7Tlukaa a, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ bɔfo ko ba da e kasa nya, nɛ la kpɛ ngɛ tsu ɔ mi. Bɔfo ɔ gba Petro konɔ ma nɛ e tsɛ̃ɛ̃ lɛ ke, “Tee si esɔ!” Amlɔ ɔ, kɔsɔkɔsɔ ɔmɛ kplɔ ngɛ e nine. 8Bɔfo ɔ de lɛ ke, “Dla o he nɛ o wo o tokota a!” Petro pee ja, nɛ Mawu bɔfo ɔ de lɛ ke, “Wo o yi nɔ tade ɔ, nɛ o nyɛɛ ye se!” 9Petro nyɛɛ Mawu bɔfo ɔ se kɛ je kpo, se e li kaa nɔ́ nitsɛ nɛ ngɛ nɔ yae ɔ; e pee lɛ kaa nɔ́ nɛ nlami je e ngɛ. 10A be kekle buli ɔmɛ, kɛ ni enyɔne ɔmɛ a he, nɛ a ba su dade agbo nɛ a kɛ yaa ma a mi ɔ he. Agbo ɔ nitsɛ bli ha mɛ, nɛ a je kpo kɛ po gbɛjegbɛ ko. Tlukaa a, Mawu bɔfo ɔ si Petro.
11Jehanɛ Petro hɛ mi pee lɛ paa, nɛ e de ke, “Kpaako i na le! Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ tsɔ e bɔfo ɔ kɛ ba, nɛ e ba je mi kɛ je Herode dɛ mi, kɛ je níhi nɛ Yuda bi ɔmɛ to kaa a maa pee mi ɔ a mi.”
12Benɛ e na bɔ nɛ níhi ya nɔ ha a, e pue nɔ kɛ ho Yohane nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Marko hulɔ ɔ nyɛ Maria we ɔ mi ya. Nihi fuu ba bua a he nya ngɛ lejɛ ɔ momo nɛ a ngɛ sɔlee. 13Petro si agbo ɔ, nɛ yiheyo ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Roda a tu fo kɛ ba. 14Benɛ e yó Petro gbi ɔ, bua jɔmi sɔuu nɛ e na he je ɔ, e bli we agbo ɔ, se mohu e tu fo kɛ ho ya de ke Petro daa si ngɛ agbo ɔ se. 15A de lɛ ke, “O yi mi ngɛ puɛe.” Se e ma nɔ mi ke anɔkuale nɛ e ngɛ tue. Kɛkɛ nɛ a ke, “Lɛɛ e bɔfo mɔ!”
