‘Yaa, nɛ o ya de ma nɛ ɔ ke
Nyɛ maa nu, se nyɛ be sisi nue.
Nyɛ maa na, se nyɛ be se kɔe.
27Ejakaa ma nɛ ɔ nui nɔ́ sisi kulaa;
nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko sɛ we a tue mi.
Ke pi jã a, a maa hyɛ nɔ́,
nɛ a maa nu nɔ́,
nɛ a juɛmi ma kɔ nɔ́ se.
Kɛkɛ ɔ, a maa kpale kɛ ba imi Mawu, ye ngɔ,
nɛ ma he a yi wami.’ ”
28Nyagbe ɔ, Paulo de Yuda bi ɔmɛ ke, “Nyɛ na na nyɛɛ le kaa Mawu ngɔ yi wami hemi munyu ɔ ya ha ma je li ɔmɛ. Mɛɛ lɛɛ a maa bu tue!”
[ 29Benɛ Paulo de kikɛ nɛ ɔ, Yuda bi ɔmɛ je lejɛ ɔ. Nɛ́ a yaa a tsuo, a ngɛ nya sãe wawɛɛ ngɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a kpɛti.]
30Paulo hi we ko mi jeha enyɔ, nɛ e wo he hiɔ. Nihi tsuo nɛ ba slaa lɛ ɔ, lejɛ ɔ nɛ e kɛ mɛ kpee ngɛ. 31E fiɛɛ Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ he sane, nɛ e tsɔɔ mɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo he sane. E tu munyu kɛ kã nɛ gbeye yemi ko be e mi; nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko hu tsi we lɛ blɔ.

Title: ROMA BI NYA TSƆƆMI
Content:
NYA TSƆƆMI
Paulo to e yi mi kaa e ma ya slaa Kristo asafo nɛ ngɛ Roma a, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e sɛ hlami ngma womi nɛ ɔ, konɛ e kɛ wo mɛ si. E to e yi mi kaa e ma ya tsu ní ngɛ lejɛ ɔ be bɔɔ, konɛ pee se ɔ, asafo ɔ nɛ wo lɛ blɔ kɛ ya Spania. Bɔ nɛ lɛ nitsɛ e nuɔ Kristo hemi kɛ yemi ɔ sisi, kɛ bɔ nɛ sa nɛ enɛ ɔ nɛ je kpo ngɛ Kristo we bi tsuo a wami si himi mi ɔ, lɔ ɔmɛ e ngma ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ mi. Paulo sɛ gbi kɛ ha Kristo se nyɛɛli ɔ jeɔ kpo saminya ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ mi.
Sisije ɔ, Paulo nga Roma asafo ɔ, nɛ e ha a le kaa e kpaa Mawu pɛɛ kɛ haa mɛ daa. Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e tsɔɔ munyu oti nɛ ngɛ womi ɔ mi, nɛ lɔ ɔ ji kaa “Sane kpakpa a lɛ tsɔɔ kaa kɛ je sisije kɛ ya si nyagbe ɔ, hemi kɛ yemi nɔ Mawu daa, nɛ e kɛ buu nimli adesahi nihi nɛ da.” (1.17)
Paulo ya nɔ nɛ e tsɔɔ munyu oti ɔ nya. E ke adesahi tsuo, Yuda bi jio, ma je li jio, e hia kaa Mawu nɛ bu mɛ nihi nɛ da, ejakaa mɛ tsuo a ngɛ yayami he wami sisi. Mawu buɔ nɔ nɔ nɛ da, ke e he Yesu Kristo ye. Jehanɛ, Paulo tsɔɔ bɔ nɛ tsakpa nɛ ba nɔ ɔ kɛ Mawu a kpɛti ɔ haa e naa wami he ngɛ Yesu Kristo mi. Nɔ nɛ heɔ Yesu yeɔ ɔ, Mawu mumi ɔ kpɔɔ lɛ kɛ jeɔ yayami, kɛ gbenɔ he wami ɔ sisi, nɛ e naa Mawu he jɔmi. Kɛ je yi 5 kɛ ya si yi 8 ɔ, Paulo tsɔɔ nɔ́ nɛ Mawu mlaa a tsuɔ, kɛ bɔ nɛ Mawu mumi ɔ he wami ɔ tsuɔ ní ngɛ nɔ nɛ he Yesu ye ɔ e je mi si himi mi. Paulo ya nɔ nɛ e tsɔɔ nya kaa Mawu ha Yuda bi, kɛ ma je li tsuo blɔ nya ngɛ yi mi nɛ e to kɛ ha adesahi tsuo ɔ mi. E mu munyu ɔ nya kaa Mawu nitsɛ e blɔ nya tomi nya nɛ Yuda bi ɔmɛ kua Yesu, nɛ kɛ gu enɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ, adesahi tsuo ma ba ná Mawu dloomi ɔ. Se e he we yi kaa Yuda bi ɔmɛ ma kua Yesu kɛ maa ya neneene. Nyagbe ɔ, Paulo tsɔɔ bɔ nɛ sa kaa Kristo we bi nɛ ba a je mi ha, titli ɔ, bɔ nɛ e sa nɛ a suɔ ni kpahi. Sane pɔtɛɛ komɛ hu nɛ e tu a he munyu ji Mawu sɔmɔmi ní tsumi, Kristo we bi a blɔ nya ní tsumi ha a ma, kɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a sibi, kɛ bɔ nɛ nɔ he nile tsuɔ ní. Paulo gbe womi ɔ nya kɛ lɛ nitsɛ e sɛ gbi komɛ, nɛ e je Mawu yi.
Bɔ nɛ a dla womi ɔ mi ha
Nya tsɔɔmi, kɛ munyu oti ɔ nitsɛ 1.1-17
E hia kaa a he adesa yi wami 1.18—3.20
Bɔ nɛ Mawu peeɔ kɛ heɔ nɔ yi wami 3.21—4.25
Wami he nɛ a naa ngɛ Kristo mi 5.1—8.39
Mawu yi mi tomi kɛ ha Israel 9.1—11.36
Kristo we bi a je mi bami 12.1—15.13
Nyagbe munyuhi, kɛ ngami 15.14—16.27

Title: ROMA BI 1
Content:
1Imi Paulo, Yesu Kristo tsɔlɔ kɛ bɔfo nɛ Mawu hla nɛ e tsɔ ke ma ya fiɛ sane kpakpa a nɛ i ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ ngmae.
2Mawu wo sane kpakpa a he si ngɔ to momoomo kɛ gu e gbali ɔmɛ a nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ a ngma ngɛ ngmami klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ a mi ɔ. 3Sane kpakpa a kɔɔ e Bi, wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo he. A fɔ lɛ kaa adesa, nɛ David nina ji lɛ. 4Se a tle lɛ si kɛ je gbeje ngɛ Mawu mumi ɔ he wami nya kɛ tsɔɔ kaa Mawu Bi ji lɛ; nɛ e ngɛ klɔuklɔu. 5Kristo nɔ i gu nɛ i na dloomi, nɛ a wo mi bɔfo, konɛ e biɛ ɔ he ɔ, je ma amɛ kulaa nɛ a bu hemi kɛ yemi ɔ tue. 6Nyɛ nihi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ Roma, nɛ Mawu tsɛ nyɛ nɛ nyɛ ba pee Kristo we bi ɔ, nyɛ hu nyɛ piɛ he.
7I ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ ngmae ha nyɛ tsuo nɛ nyɛ ngɛ Roma nɛ Mawu suɔ nyɛ, nɛ e tsɛ nyɛ kɛ ba pee lɛ nitsɛ e ni klɔuklɔuhi ɔ.
Dloomi kɛ he jɔmi nɛ je wa Tsɛ Mawu ɔ, kɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo dɛ mi ɔ ha nyɛ!
Paulo sɔle kɛ na Mawu si
8Kekleekle ɔ, i gu Yesu Kristo nɔ kɛ ngɛ ye Mawu ɔ si nae ngɛ nyɛ tsuo nyɛ he, ejakaa a ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi nɛ nyɛ hɛɛ mi ɔ he odase yee ngɛ je ɔ mi he tsuaa he. 9Mawu ɔ nɛ i sɔmɔɔ lɛ kɛ ye tsui tsuo kɛ gu sane kpakpa a nɛ kɔɔ e Bi ɔ he ɔ fiɛmi mi ɔ ji ye we odase kaa i kaiɔ nyɛ daa nɛ i jɔɔ we ngɛ ye sɔlemi mi. 10I kpaa pɛɛ kaa alinɔ Mawu suɔmi nya a jehanɛ lɛɛ blɔ ma bli ha mi nɛ ma nyɛ ma ba nyɛ ngɔ. 11Ejakaa ye hɛ ngɛ jae wawɛɛ ngɛ nyɛ he, nɛ i suɔ kaa ma na nyɛ, konɛ ma ba ha nyɛ mumi mi nike ní kɛ wo nyɛ he wami. 12I ngɛ tsɔɔe kaa i kɛ nyɛ tsuo waa ngɔ hemi kɛ yemi nɛ wa ngɛ ɔ kɛ wo wa sibi he wami.
13 Ye nyɛmimɛ, i suɔ nɛ nyɛɛ le kaa i pee ye yi mi si abɔ kaa ma ba slaa nyɛ, konɛ ma ná yiblii komɛ ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti kaa bɔ nɛ i ná ngɛ ma je li kpa amɛ a kpɛti ɔ. Se kɛ ba si amlɔ nɛ ɔ, i na we blɔ. 14I ngɛ kaa nɔ ko nɛ hɛɛ nihi tsuo hiɔ, Hela bi, kɛ nihi nɛ pi Hela bi ji mɛ; ní leli kɛ, kuasiahi tsuo i hɛɛ mɛ hiɔ. 15Enɛ ɔ he ɔ, e ngɛ ye tsui nɔ wawɛɛ kaa maa fiɛ sane kpakpa a ngɔ tsɔɔ nyɛ nihi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ Roma a hulɔ.
Mawu he wami ngɛ sane kpakpa a mi
16 Sane kpakpa a he pee we mi zo, ejakaa e ji Mawu he wami nɛ haa nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ heɔ yeɔ ɔ yi naa wami, Yuda bi kekle, lɔ ɔ se ɔ, ma je li hulɔ. 17 Ejakaa sane kpakpa a lɛ tsɔɔ kaa kɛ je sisije kɛ yaa si nyagbe ɔ, hemi kɛ yemi nɔ Mawu daa nɛ e kɛ buu nimli adesahi nihi nɛ da. Kaa bɔ nɛ ngmami ɔ deɔ ɔ, “Nɔ nɛ a gu hemi kɛ yemi nɔ bu lɛ nɔ nɛ da a yi ma na wami.”
Nimli adesahi tsuo yeɔ fɔ
18Nihi nɛ peeɔ yayami, nɛ a bɔɔ musu kɛ tsiɔ anɔkuale ɔ nɛ kɔɔ Mawu he ɔ nya a, Mawu kɛ mi mi fumi nɛ jeɔ hiɔwe gblaa a tue. 19Mawu gblaa a tue wawɛɛ, ejakaa nɔ́ nɛ sa nɛ a le ngɛ Mawu he ɔ fɔɔ si paa; Mawu nitsɛ je tsɔɔ mɛ momo. 20Kɛ je be nɛ Mawu bɔ je ɔ, e he wami nɛ ngɛ daa, kɛ e su nɛ ji níhi nɛ a nɛ́ kɛ hɛngmɛ ɔ jeɔ kpo paa ngɛ e nibɔ ní ɔmɛ a mi, nɛ adesa naa. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a be nya jemi ko kulaa. 21 A le Mawu ji nɛ, se e hɛ mi nyami nɛ sa kaa a woɔ kaa Mawu ji lɛ ɔ, a wui; nɛ a nɛ́ lɛ si hulɔ. Lɔ ɔ ji kaa nɔ́ kpakpa ko kulaa be a juɛmi mi; nɛ a kɔ we nɔ́ se, ejakaa a juɛmi mi wo diblii kpii. 22A tsɛɔ a he ní leli, se a plɛ pee kuasiahi mohu. 23 Mawu nɛ gbo we gblee ɔ, a wui e hɛ mi nyami bɔ nɛ sa kaa a peeɔ, se mohu a ya woɔ níhi nɛ a puɛ kaa nɔmlɔ adesa nɛ gboɔ ɔ, aloo lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ, loo lohwe nane eywiɛɛywiɛtsɛmɛ, loo lohwehi nɛ sãã si mohu a hɛ mi nyami.
24Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Mawu ngmɛɛ a he, nɛ a ya nyɛɛ akɔnɔ yaya nɛ ngɛ a tsui nɔ ɔ se; nɛ a kɛ a sibi tsu mu níhi kɛ pue a nɔmlɔ tso ɔ hɛ mi si. 25Anɔkuale ɔ nɛ a le ngɛ Mawu he ɔ, a he we yi; lakpa níhi mohu a heɔ yeɔ. Níhi nɛ Mawu bɔ ɔ, lɔ ɔmɛ mohu a jaa, nɛ a sɔmɔɔ. Bɔlɔ ɔ nɛ sa kaa a je e yi kɛ ya neneene ɔ, a ja we lɛ, nɛ a sɔmɔ we lɛ hulɔ. Amen!
26Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, Mawu ngmɛɛ a he, nɛ a ya nyɛɛ akɔnɔ ní yayahi nɛ ngɛ zo a se. A yi ɔmɛ tete po kɛ a sibi peeɔ níhi nɛ pi ja nɛ Mawu to. 27Nyumu ɔmɛ hu ja nɔuu, a hla we yihi a se blɔ. Se ke akɔnɔ yaya te si ngɛ a mi ɔ, a kɛ a sibi nyumuhi mohu ya naa bɔmi. Nyumuhi kɛ a sibi nyumuhi tsu zo níhi, nɛ tue gblami nɛ sa mɛ kaa nihi nɛ bɔ musu ɔ, a ná ngɔ wo a he mi.
28Jehanɛ ɔ hu, akɛnɛ nimli nɛ ɔmɛ bui a he kaa e sa mɛ kaa a leɔ Mawu ɔ, Mawu hu ngmɛɛ a he ngɔ ha juɛmi nɛ sɛ́, konɛ a pee níhi nɛ sɛ́. 29A peeɔ yi wu tso ní, kɛ yayami slɔɔtoslɔɔtohi. A jeɔ hunga, a pueɔ muɔ si, a pɛɔ, a sisiɔ nɔ, nɛ a toɔ a sibi a he ga yaya; 30a yeɔ sieku, nɛ a sume Mawu sane; a bui nɔ, a woɔ a he nɔ, a fĩaa, a toɔ nɔ́ yaya he ga, nɛ a bui a fɔli; 31a he nile gbo; ke a wo si ɔ, a yi nɔ, nɛ a nɛ́ mɔbɔ. 32A le kaa Mawu de ke nihi nɛ tsuɔ ní nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, a sa gbenɔ, se kɛ̃ pi kaa mɛ nitsɛmɛ a peeɔ yayami nɛ ɔmɛ kɛkɛ, se mohu a jeɔ nihi nɛ peeɔ ní nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ a yi.

Title: ROMA BI 2
Content:
Mawu yeɔ dami sane
1 Ye nyɛmi, anɛ o kojoɔ nihi, nɛ o buɔ mɛ fɔ lo? Ke o peeɔ ja a, lɛɛ o be nya jemi ko kulaa. Ejakaa ke o kojoɔ ni kpahi, nɛ o buu mɛ fɔ, nɛ mo hu o peeɔ jamɛ a ní ɔmɛ nɔuu ɔ, na nɛ o le kaa mo nitsɛ o he fɔ o ngɛ bue ɔ nɛ. 2Wa le kaa Mawu buɔ nihi nɛ tsuɔ jamɛ a ní ɔmɛ bɔ nɛ fɔ ɔ le da pɛpɛɛpɛ. 3Se mo ye nyɛmi nɛ o kojoɔ nihi nɛ tsuɔ jamɛ a ní ɔmɛ, nɛ́ mo hu o peeɔ ja nɔuu ɔ, anɛ o susuu kaa o maa ye o he, nɛ Mawu be mo kojoe lo? 4O bui nɔ́! Mɛni he je ɔ, Mawu mi mi jɔ, e naa nɔ he tsui, nɛ e toɔ e tsui si. Blɔɔ o li kaa Mawu mi mi jɔ ha mo konɛ o tsake o tsui lo? 5Se akɛnɛ o kplii o tsui, nɛ o pia we o he ɔ, kojomi ligbi ɔ nɛ Mawu mi mi ma fu, nɛ e maa kojo kɛ dami sane yemi ɔ, o tue gblami ɔ maa pe nine. 6 Ejakaa Mawu maa wo nɔ tsuaa nɔ hiɔ bɔ nɛ sa lɛ ngɛ e ní tsumi ɔ nya. 7Nihi nɛ toɔ a tsui si kɛ peeɔ kpakpa daa, nɛ a kɛ hlaa hɛ mi nyami, kɛ bu ha a he konɛ a ko gbo ɔ, Mawu ma ha mɛ neneene wami. 8Se ni nɛmɛ nɛ mɛɛ lɛɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a nɔ mi pɛ a foɔ, nɛ a bui anɔkuale, nɛ nɔ́ yayami se pɛ a dii ɔ, Mawu kɛ mi mi la, kɛ mi mi fumi ma kple a nɔ. 9Mawu ma ha nɛ haomi, kɛ nɔ́ nami maa ba yayami peeli tsuo a nɔ, Yuda bi kekle, kɛ ma je li hulɔ. 10Se ni nɛmɛ nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ kpakpa a, Mawu maa wo a hɛ mi nyami; bu maa ba a he, nɛ e ma ha mɛ he jɔmi, Yuda bi kekle, kɛ jehanɛ ɔ, ma je li hulɔ. 11 Ejakaa Mawu hyɛ we nɔ hɛ mi.
12Nihi abɔ nɛ mlaa a kpakaa we mɛ, nɛ a peeɔ yayami ɔ, a hɛ mi kpataa kaa nihi nɛ mlaa a kpakaa we mɛ; nɛ nihi abɔ nɛ guu mlaa a nɔ peeɔ yayami ɔ, mlaa a nɔuu nɔ a daa kɛ kojoɔ mɛ. 13Ejakaa pi nihi nɛ le mlaa a nɛ a buu nihi nɛ da ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi, se mohu nihi nɛ yeɔ mlaa a nɔ, mɛ a maa wo nguɔ. 14Ke ma je li ɔmɛ nɛ yi Mose mlaa a nɔ ngɛ a fɔmi su ɔ nya a tsuɔ mlaa a nya ní ɔ, a peeɔ mlaa ha mɛ nitsɛmɛ a he; pohu mlaa ko yi a nɔ. 15A ní peepee tsɔɔ kaa nɔ́ nɛ mlaa a ngɛ hlae kaa a pee ɔ, Mawu ngɔ wo a tsui mi momo; nɛ a he nile hu yeɔ enɛ ɔ he odase. Ejakaa be komɛ ɔ, a susumi deɔ mɛ ke nɔ́ nɛ a ngɛ pee ɔ dɛ, nɛ be komɛ hu e deɔ mɛ ke e da. 16Sane kpakpa a nɛ i ngɛ fiɛe ɔ ngɛ tsɔɔe kaa ligbi ɔ nɛ Mawu maa gu Yesu Kristo nɔ ba kojo nihi tsuo ngɛ a laami mi sanehi a he ɔ, kikɛ nɛ ɔ níhi maa ba.
Yuda bi kɛ mlaa a
17Nyɛɛ lɛɛ kɛ nyɛ sane ngɛ kɛɛ? Nyɛ tsɛɔ nyɛ he Yuda bi, nɛ nyɛ daa mlaa a nɔ kɛ fĩaa kaa Mawu nihi ji nyɛ. 18Nyɛ le nɔ́ nɛ Mawu suɔ kaa nyɛɛ pee, nɛ a gu mlaa a nɔ tsɔɔ nyɛ nɛ nyɛ le nɔ́ nɛ hi. 19Nyɛ buu nyɛ he nihi nɛ tsɔɔ hɛ yuyuili blɔ, aloo la kɛ ha nihi nɛ ngɛ diblii mi. 20Nyɛɛ buu nyɛ he kuasiahi a tsɔseli, kɛ nihi nɛ li nɔ́ ko ɔ a ní tsɔɔli; ejakaa nyɛ le kaa niinɛ, nile kɛ anɔkuale tsuo ngɛ mlaa a mi. 21Nyɛ nɛ nyɛ tsɔɔ ni kpahi ní ɔ, mɛni he je nyɛ tsɔɔ we nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ he ní mɔ? Nyɛ fiɛɔ ke a ko ju; se tse nyɛ juɔ? 22Nyɛ deɔ ke a ko puɛ gba; se nyɛ puɛ we gba lo? Amagahi a he peeɔ nyɛ tai, se tse nyɛ ya juɔ ngɛ wɔ piɛhi a mi? 23Nyɛ fĩaa ke nyɛ le mlaa a, se tse nyɛ tɔɔ mlaa a kɛ pueɔ Mawu hɛ mi si? 24 Kaa bɔ nɛ ngmami ɔ deɔ ɔ, “Nyɛ Yuda bi nyɛ he ɔ, ma je li ɔmɛ tuɔ musu bɔmi munyuhi kɛ siɔ Mawu.”
25Nyɛ yeɔ mlaa a nɔ jinɛ pomi nɛ a po nyɛ ɔ, se nami ngɛ he. Se nyɛ yi nɔ; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ ngɛ kaa ni nɛmɛ nɛ a pui mɛ ɔ. 26Ke ma je no nɛ a pui lɛ ɔ yeɔ mlaa a nɔ ɔ, anɛ Mawu be lɛ bue kaa nɔ ko nɛ a po lɛ lo? 27Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ Yuda bi, ma je li ɔmɛ maa kojo nyɛ, ejakaa nyɛ nɛ a ngma mlaa a ngɔ ha, nɛ́ mlaa a nya a poɔ nyɛ ɔ, nyɛ tɔɔ mlaa a. Se mɛɛ lɛɛ a yeɔ mlaa a nɔ, pohu a pui mɛ. 28Lɛɛ mɛnɔ ji Yuda no nitsɛnitsɛ mɔ? Pi okadi nɛ a to ngɛ nɔ he lo mi kaa nɔ pomi kikɛ nɛ ɔ nɛ peeɔ nɔ Yuda no. 29 Mohu ɔ, Yuda no nitsɛnitsɛ peemi ɔ ngɛ nɔ ɔ nitsɛ e mi, nɛ nɔ pomi ɔ hu ngɛ e tsui mi. Mawu mumi ɔ pɛ lɛ tsuɔ enɛ ɔ, pi mlaa nɛ a ngma a. Kikɛmɛ a nɔmlɔ nɛ ɔ, Mawu nitsɛ lɛ jeɔ e yi, pi nɔmlɔ adesa.

Title: ROMA BI 3
Content:
1Lɛɛ mɛni Yuda no kɛ pe ma je no mɔ? Aloo mɛni se nami ngɛ nɔ pomi he? 2Ee, nɔ pomi he ngɛ se nami babauu ngɛ blɔ tsuaa blɔ nɔ. Kekleekle nɔ́ ji kaa a tu Mawu munyu ɔ ngɔ wo Yuda bi ɔmɛ a dɛ. 3E ngɛ mi kaa ni komɛ he we yi lɛɛ, se anɛ lɔ ɔ tsɔɔ kaa Mawu be anɔkuale yee lo? 4 Dɛbi! Mawu ɔ, anɔkualetsɛ ji lɛ; pohu nimli adesahi tsuo lɛɛ lakpa a yeɔ. Kaa bɔ nɛ ngmami ɔ deɔ ɔ,
“Konɛ nihi tsuo nɛ a na kaa nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ o deɔ
ɔ ngɛ mi;
Nɛ ke a kojo mo hu, o yeɔ nguɔ.”
5Se ke nɔ́ nɛ dɛ nɛ wa peeɔ ɔ, haa nɛ a naa paa kaa nɔ́ nɛ da pɛ Mawu peeɔ ɔ, lɛɛ kɛ wa ma de kɛɛ? Anɛ ke Mawu kɛ mi mi fumi gbla wa tue ɔ, e tɔ lo? (Bɔ nɛ i bi nɛ ɔ, ja kɛkɛ adesa tuɔ munyu.) 6Dɛbi! Ke Mawu yi dami sane ɔ, kɛ maa pee kɛɛ nɛ e maa kojo je ɔ?
7Se nɔ ko ma bi ke, “Ke ye lakpa a haa nɛ a naa Mawu we anɔkuale ɔ saminya, nɛ lɔ ɔ woɔ e hɛ mi nyami ɔ, mɛni he je mɔ nɛ a buu mi fɔ kaa yayami peelɔ ɔ?” 8Mɛni he je nɛ e sɛ́ kaa wa deɔ ke, “Wa maa pee yayami konɛ kpakpa nɛ je mi kɛ ba,” kaa bɔ nɛ ni komɛ poo ngɔ fɔɔ wa nɔ ke wa deɔ ɔ? Jamɛtsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, fɔ nɛ a bu mɛ ɔ sa mɛ.
Nɔ ko nɔ ko be nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da
9Lɛɛ kɛ ji lɛ kɛɛ? Anɛ wɔ Yuda bi wa nɔ́ mi hi pee ni kpa amɛ lo? Dɛbi, pi ja kulaa! Kaa bɔ nɛ i tsɔɔ nya momo ɔ, Yuda bi kɛ Hela bi tsuo sɔ; mɛ tsuo a ngɛ yayami he wami sisi. 10 Kaa bɔ nɛ ngmami ɔ deɔ ɔ,
“Nɔ ko nɔ ko be nɛ da;
nɔ kake ngmelu po be.
11Ní lelɔ ko be ɔ,
nɔ ko nɔ ko be nɛ hlaa Mawu se blɔ.
12Mɛ tsuo a tla blɔ;
mɛ tsuo a puɛ;
nɔ ko nɔ ko be nɛ peeɔ kpakpa,
nɔ kake ngmelu po be.
13 A tuɔ munyu dɔkɔdɔkɔ;
se lɛ tsuo gbenɔ lɛ e kɛ baa.
A munyu ngɛ kaa sanga duɔ.
14 Gbiɛmi munyu nɛ kɛ nɔ woɔ haomi mi
nɛ jeɔ a nya mi.
15 A he sɔɔ kɛ muɔ si puemi.
16He tsuaa he nɛ a be ngɛ ɔ,
hɛ mi kpatami, kɛ kɔmɔ yemi a naa.
17A ha we nɛ nihi a he mi jɔɔ mɛ.
18 Mawu gbeye yemi ko kulaa be a hɛ mi.”
19Jehanɛ ɔ, wa le kaa níhi tsuo nɛ ngɛ mlaa a mi ɔ, nihi nɛ yeɔ mlaa a nɔ ɔ a he nɛ e kɔɔ. Lɛɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be nya jemi; je ɔ tsuo yeɔ fɔ ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi. 20 Ejakaa ke nɔ ko ye mlaa a nɔ ɔ, lɔ ɔ tsɔɔ we kaa Mawu buu lɛ nɔ nɛ da; nɔ́ nɛ mlaa a tsuɔ ji kaa e haa nɔ leɔ kaa e pee yayami.
Nɔ́ nɛ haa Mawu buu nɔ nɔ nɛ da
21Jehanɛ lɛɛ blɔ nɔ nɛ Mawu guu kɛ buu nɔ nɔ nɛ da a, e je tsɔɔ wɔ. Pi mlaa sane ji nɛ ɔ. Mose mlaa a, kɛ gbali ɔmɛ ye he odase. 22 Ke nɔ ko he Yesu Kristo ye kɛkɛ Mawu bu lɛ nɔ nɛ da. Nihi tsuo nɛ heɔ Kristo yeɔ ɔ, bɔ nɛ a peeɔ haa mɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ; slɔɔto ko kulaa be mi. 23Ejakaa nihi tsuo pee yayami, nɛ Mawu hɛ mi nyami ɔ bɔ mɛ. 24Se Mawu gu dloomi nɛ e kɛ haa je ɔ yaka a nɔ kɛ wo nihi tsuo nguɔ. E pee enɛ ɔ kɛ gu Kristo Yesu nɛ ha a ye a he ɔ nɔ. 25-26Mawu ngɔ Kristo ngɔ ha, konɛ kɛ gu Yesu Kristo gbenɔ ɔ nɔ ɔ, Mawu nɛ ngɔ nihi nɛ he ye ɔ a he yayami kɛ pa mɛ. Mawu pee enɛ ɔ kɛ tsɔɔ kaa dalɔ ji lɛ. Sa a, e to e tsui si ha nimli tsuo, nɛ e ku e hɛ fɔ a he yayami ɔmɛ a nɔ; konɛ jehanɛ ɔ a na kaa nɔ́ nɛ da pɛ e peeɔ; nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ heɔ Yesu yeɔ ɔ, Mawu woɔ lɛ nguɔ.
27Lɛɛ mɛni nɔ wa maa fĩa ngɔ fɔ mɔ? Nɔ́ ko kulaa be kaa ja. Lɛɛ mɛni mɔ? Ní tsumi ngɛ mlaa a nya lo? Dɛbi! Yesu Kristo nɛ wa heɔ yeɔ mohu. 28Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, wa yɔse kaa hemi kɛ yemi nɔ a guu kɛ woɔ nɔ nguɔ, se pi ní tsumi nɛ a tsu ngɛ mlaa a nya. 29Anɛ Mawu ɔ, Yuda bi kɛkɛ a Mawu lo? Anɛ pi ma je li ɔmɛ hu a Mawu ji lɛ lo? Ee, ma je li ɔmɛ hu a Mawu ji lɛ. 30 Mawu kake lɛ ngɛ kɛ ha Yuda bi, kɛ ma je li tsuo; nɛ hemi kɛ yemi nɔ Mawu guu kɛ woɔ nihi nɛ a po mɛ ɔ nguɔ. Nihi nɛ a pui mɛ ɔ hu hemi kɛ yemi ɔ nɔ nɔuu a maa gu kɛ wo mɛ nguɔ. 31Lɛɛ waa pɛtɛ hemi ke yemi he, nɛ waa ngmɛɛ mlaa a he lo? Pi ja kulaa! Mohu ɔ, wa gu hemi kɛ yemi nɔ kɛ ngɛ nɔ mi mae kaa mlaa a hi.

Title: ROMA BI 4
Content:
Abraham hemi kɛ yemi peeɔ nɔhyɛ nɔ́
1Wa tsɛ Abraham ɔ, kɛ wa ma de ngɛ e he kɛɛ? Kɛ e wami si himi mi sane ngɛ kɛɛ? 2Ke ní nɛ e tsu nɔ a da kɛ wo lɛ nguɔ ɔ, lɛɛ jinɛ e ngɛ nɔ́ ko nɛ e maa fĩa ngɔ fɔ nɔ. Se ngɛ Mawu blɔ fa mi ɔ, Abraham be nɔ́ ko kulaa nɛ e ma nyɛ maa fĩa ngɔ fɔ nɔ. 3 Ngmami ɔ deɔ ke, “Abraham he Mawu ye, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Mawu bu lɛ nɔ nɛ da.” 4Ke nɔ ko tsu ní ɔ, a woɔ lɛ hiɔ; hiɔwo ɔ, e gbo he dengme; pi dloomi nya nɛ e na lɛ. 5Se nɔ nɛ ngɔɔ e hɛ ngɔ fɔɔ Mawu pɛ nɔ, se pi ní nɛ e tsuɔ nɔ ɔ, Mawu ɔ nɛ lɛ pɛ nɛ nyɛɔ woɔ yayami peelɔ nguɔ ɔ daa nɔmlɔ nɛ ɔ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ nɔ kɛ buɔ lɛ nɔ da. 6Enɛ ɔ nɔuu David hu ngɛ tsɔɔe be nɛ e tu nɔ nɛ Mawu buu lɛ nɔ nɛ da, nɛ pohu pi nɔ́ ko nɛ e tsu he je ɔ e gbaami he munyu ɔ nɛ. E de ke,
7 “A gbaa nɔ nɛ a ngɔ e tɔmihi,
kɛ e he yayamihi ngɔ pa lɛ!
8A gbaa nɔ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ
nɛ́ yayami ko ngɛ e he!”
9Gbaami nɛ David tu he munyu ɔ, anɛ nihi nɛ a po mɛ ɔ kɛkɛ a nɔ lo? Dɛbi! Ni nɛmɛ a pui mɛ ɔ hu e kɔɔ a he. Ejakaa wa ngɛ dee ke, “Abraham he Mawu ye, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Mawu bu lɛ nɔ nɛ da.” 10Mɛni be mi nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ba mi? Loko a po Abraham, aloo benɛ a po lɛ ɔ se? Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ba mi loko a po lɛ. 11 Pomi nɛ a po lɛ ɔ ji okadi ko kɛkɛ nɛ maa nɔ mi kaa hemi kɛ yemi nɛ Abraham ngɛ he je ɔ, Mawu he lɛ momo kaa nɔ nɛ da, be mi nɛ a na we nɛ a po lɛ tete. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nihi tsuo nɛ heɔ Mawu yeɔ, nɛ pohu a pui mɛ, nɛ Mawu buu mɛ dali ɔ, Abraham peeɔ a tsɛ. 12Lɛ nɔuu kɛ̃ e peeɔ nihi nɛ a po mɛ ɔ a tsɛ; pi ngɛ pomi nɛ a po mɛ ɔ kɛkɛ he, se mohu kaa hemi kɛ yemi nɛ wa tsɛ Abraham hɛɛ mi benɛ a na we nɛ a po lɛ tete ɔ, a hɛɛ jamɛ a hemi kɛ yemi ɔ nɔuu mi.
Abraham he Mawu siwo ɔ ye
13 Pi mlaa a nɔ nɛ Abraham ye ɔ he nɛ Mawu wo lɛ si kaa e kɛ e nina maa ye je ɔ nɔ ɔ, se mohu akɛnɛ e he Mawu ye, nɛ Mawu bu lɛ nɔ nɛ da a he. 14 Ejakaa ke nihi nɛ mlaa a nɔ pɛ a yeɔ ɔ, mɛ hu gbosi ní yeli ji mɛ ɔ, lɛɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ peeɔ yaka, nɛ siwo ɔ hu se nami be he. 15Ejakaa mlaa a kɛ Mawu mi mi la baa; he nɛ mlaa be ɔ, nɔ ko tɔ we mlaa hulɔ.
16 Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Abraham hemi kɛ yemi nɔ Mawu da kɛ wo si ɔ. Mawu pee enɛ ɔ, konɛ siwo ɔ nɛ ba pee dloomi nɔ́ ko nɛ a fi kɛ fɔ nɔ kpɛii kɛ ha Abraham nina tsuo. Pi kɛ ha nihi nɛ yeɔ mlaa a nɔ kɛkɛ, se mohu kɛ ha ni nɛmɛ nɛ mɛ hu a hɛɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ mi kpɛii kaa bɔ nɛ Abraham he ye ɔ, ejakaa Abraham ji wɔ tsuo wa tsɛ. 17 Ejakaa ngmami ɔ deɔ ke, “Ma pee mo je mahi babauu a tsɛ.” Mawu ɔ nɛ Abraham he ye ɔ, anɔkualetsɛ ji lɛ, nɛ si nɛ e wo ɔ maa ba mi. Lɛ ji Mawu nɛ tleɔ ni gbogboehi si kɛ baa wami mi ekohu; nɔ́ nɛ bɛ je mi hyɛ po, e haa e baa. 18 Bɔ nɛ Abraham he Mawu ye, nɛ e ngɔ e hɛ ngɔ fɔ e nɔ, pohu jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi tsuo ta a, lɔ ɔ nɛ ha e ba pee je mahi babauu a tsɛ kaa bɔ nɛ ngmami ɔ deɔ ke, “Jã o nina hu maa hiɛ” ɔ nɛ. 19 Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, Abraham ye maa pee jeha lafa momo; se e hemi kɛ yemi ɔ lɛɛ e ngmɛɛ we he. Lɛ nitsɛ e nɔmlɔ tso ɔ pee kaa nɔ nɛ gbo momo, nɛ e yo Sara hu fɔ we. Se enɛ ɔmɛ a he susumi ha we nɛ e hemi kɛ yemi nɛ ta. 20E yi mi pee we lɛ enyɔɔnyɔ ngɛ si nɛ Mawu wo lɛ ɔ he; se mohu e hemi kɛ yemi ha lɛ he wami he, nɛ e wo Mawu hɛ mi nyami. 21Ejakaa Abraham he ye wawɛɛ kaa si nɛ Mawu wo lɛ ɔ, e maa ye nɔ. 22Enɛ ɔ he nɛ Mawu bu lɛ nɔ nɛ da a. 23Munyu “A bu lɛ nɔ nɛ da” a, pi lɛ nɔ kake e he nɛ a ngma ngɛ. 24Se mohu e kɔɔ wɔ hu wa he, wɔ nihi nɛ a maa wo wɔ nguɔ ja nɔuu ɔ; ejakaa nɔ nɛ tle wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu si kɛ ba wami mi ekohu ɔ, wa heɔ lɛ yeɔ. 25 Mawu ngɔ Kristo kɛ ha nɛ a gbe lɛ ngɛ wa he yayami ɔmɛ a he; nɛ a tle lɛ si kɛ ba wami mi ekohu, konɛ e kɛ wo wɔ nguɔ.

Title: ROMA BI 5
Content:
A wo wɔ nguɔ
1Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, kɛ gu hemi kɛ yemi nɔ ɔ, Mawu wo wɔ nguɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, he jɔmi ba waa kɛ Mawu wa kpɛti kɛ gu Yesu Kristo nɔ. 2Si himi nɛ wa ngɛ mi amlɔ nɛ ɔ, Mawu dloomi nya nɛ wa na kɛ gu Yesu Kristo nɛ wa heɔ yeɔ ɔ nɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, wa fĩaa, ejakaa wa nine maa su Mawu hɛ mi nyami ɔ nɔ. 3Wa le kaa dengme nɛ wa ngɛ gboe ɔ be yaka pee. Pi enɛ ɔ kɛkɛ, se ke wa ngɛ nɔ́ nae po, wa naa bua jɔmi, ejakaa wa le kaa nɔ́ nami haa nɛ wa toɔ wa tsui si; 4nɛ tsui si tomi haa nɛ wa peeɔ Mawu suɔmi nya ní. Nɛ ke wa ngɛ Mawu suɔmi nya ní pee ɔ, e haa waa kɛ wa hɛ fɔɔ Mawu nɔ Kulaa. 5Hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi nɛ ɔ ha we nɛ zo gbeɔ wɔ, ejakaa kɛ gu Mumi klɔuklɔu ɔ nɛ Mawu ha wɔ ɔ nɔ ɔ, Mawu ha wa tsui hyi tɔ kɛ e suɔmi ɔ.
6Ejakaa be nɛ sa mi, be mi nɛ peepee ta wa he ɔ, jamɛ a be ɔ Kristo ba gbo ngɛ yayami peeli a he. 7Ejakaa e maa wa kaa nɔ ko maa suɔ nɛ e gbo ngɛ nɔ nɛ yeɔ mlaa nɔ ɔ he; pohu nɔmlɔ kpakpa he ɔ, e maa ba mi kaa nɔ ko ma si gugue kaa e ma gbo. 8Se suɔmi kpetekpleenyɛ nɛ Mawu je kpo ji nɛ ɔ nɛ, kaa be nɛ wa ji yayami peeli ɔ, jamɛ a be ɔ Kristo ba gbo ngɛ wa he. 9Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, jehanɛ ɔ nɛ a gu Kristo muɔ nɛ pue si ɔ nɔ wo wɔ nguɔ ɔ, a maa gu e nɔ hluu tsɔ kɛ kpɔ wɔ kɛ je Mawu mi mi la a mi. 10Jinɛ sa a, Mawu he nyɛli ji wɔ, se kɛ gu e Bi ɔ gbenɔ ɔ nɔ ɔ, a kpata waa kɛ Mawu wa kpɛti. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, amlɔ nɛ ɔ nɛ a kpata waa kɛ Mawu wa kpɛti ɔ, e ma he wa yi wami hluu tsɔ ngɛ e Bi ɔ wami ɔ mi. 11Pi enɛ ɔ kɛkɛ, se wa fĩaa fɔɔ Mawu nɔ kaa kɛ gu wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo nɔ ɔ, e ha nɛ jehanɛ ɔ, a kpata waa kɛ lɛ Mawu ɔ wa kpɛti.
Slɔɔto nɛ ngɛ Adam kɛ Kristo a kpɛti
12 Nɔ kake lɛ pee yayami, nɛ yayami kɛ gbenɔ ba. Enɛ ɔ ha gbenɔ sã nimli tsuo, ejakaa nɔ tsuaa nɔ pee yayami. 13Yayami ngɛ je ɔ mi loko mlaa a ba; se be nɛ mlaa be ɔ, nɔ ko nɔ ko pee we yayami he akɔtaa. 14Se kɛ je Adam yi nɔ kɛ ba si Mose yi nɔ ɔ, gbenɔ kpata nimli adesahi a hɛ mi wawɛɛ; pohu nimli nɛ ɔmɛ pee we yayami kaa Adam nɛ lɛɛ e tɔ mlaa a nɛ a wo lɛ ɔ tete ɔ.
Adam ji nɔ nɛ maa ba a he okadi. 15Se Mawu nɔke nɔ́ ɔ slo kulaa ngɛ yayami nɛ Adam pee ɔ he. Ejakaa yayami nɛ Adam pee ɔ ha nihi babauu gbo lɛɛ, se Mawu dloomi ɔ, kɛ nɔke nɔ́ nɛ a gu Yesu Kristo dloomi ɔ nɔ ha wɔ ɔ hiɛ hluu tsɔ kɛ ha nihi tsuo. 16Jehanɛ ɔ, Mawu nɔke nɔ́ ɔ slo kulaa ngɛ si gbeemi nɛ yayami nɛ Adam pee ɔ kɛ ba a he. Ejakaa nɛ Adam pee yayami ɔ, a kojo lɛ, nɛ a bu lɛ fɔ; se lɔ ɔ se ɔ, yayami babauu nɛ nihi pee ɔ, nɔke nɔ́ ɔ he ɔ, Mawu wo nihi tsuo nguɔ. 17Ejakaa ke yayami nɛ nɔ kake pee ɔ, ha gbenɔ kpata nihi babauu a hɛ mi ɔ, lɛɛ nihi tsuo nɛ a nine su Mawu dloomi ɔ nɔ, nɛ Mawu gu nɔke nɔ́ ɔ nɔ bu mɛ nihi nɛ da a, Kristo ma ha a na neneene wami hluu tsɔ. 18Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, kaa bɔ nɛ yayami kake he ɔ, a bu nihi tsuo fɔ ɔ, jã nɔuu kpakpa kake he ɔ, Mawu maa wo nihi tsuo nguɔ, nɛ a ma he a yi wami. 19Ejakaa kaa bɔ nɛ nihi babauu ba pee yayami peeli ngɛ nɔ kake tue gbomi he ɔ, jã kɛ̃ Yesu Kristo nɔ kake e tue nɛ e bu ɔ he ɔ, Mawu maa bu nihi tsuo dali. 20A wo mlaa a hulɔ, konɛ wa yɔse yayami ɔmɛ babauu; se he nɛ yayami hiɛ ngɛ ɔ, lejɛ ɔ Mawu dloomi ɔ hiɛ kɛ be nɔ babauu. 21Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, bɔ nɛ yayami ye tsɛ kɛ gu gbenɔ nɔ ɔ, ja nɔuu Mawu dloomi ɔ ngɛ tsɛ yee kɛ gu dami nɔ; nɛ kɛ gu wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo nɔ ɔ, wa ma na neneene wami.

Title: ROMA BI 6
Content:
Kristo he ɔ, wa ngɛ wami mi
1Lɛɛ kɛ wa ma de kɛɛ? Anɛ waa ya nɔ waa hi yayami pee, konɛ Mawu nɛ hi wɔ mɔbɔ nae daa lo? 2Dɛbi! Wa ngɛ kaa nihi nɛ gbo, nɛ yayami be a nɔ he wami hu. Mɛni he je mɔ nɛ wa maa hi yayami pee kɛ mwɔɔ ɔ? 3Anɔkuale mi ɔ, wa le kaa wɔ nihi abɔ nɛ a sɔle wɔ kɛ wo Kristo Yesu mi ɔ, wa gbo kaa bɔ nɛ Kristo ɔ gbo ɔ. 4 Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɛ a sɔle wɔ ɔ, wa gbo kaa bɔ nɛ Kristo gbo ɔ, nɛ a pu waa kɛ lɛ tsuo, konɛ bɔ nɛ Tsɛ ɔ tle Kristo si ngɛ nyami mi ɔ, wɔ hu wa na wami he.
5Ejakaa ke wa gbo kaa bɔ nɛ Kristo gbo ɔ, jã kɛ̃ a ma tle wɔ si kaa bɔ nɛ a tle Kristo si kɛ ba wami mi ekohu ɔ. 6Wa le enɛ ɔ, kaa a sɛu wa nɔmlɔ tso momo ɔ ngɔ piɛ Kristo he, konɛ nɔmlɔ tso su nɛ haa nɔ peeɔ yayami ɔ hɛ mi nɛ kpata, nɛ wa ko ye nyɔguɛ ha yayami hu. 7Ejakaa ke nɔ ko gbo ɔ, e kɛ yayami gba mi. 8Ke waa kɛ Kristo gbo ɔ, wa heɔ yeɔ kaa waa kɛ lɛ ma na wami hulɔ. 9Ejakaa wa le kaa a tle Kristo si kɛ je gbeje, nɛ e be gboe hu; niinɛ, gbenɔ be e nɔ he wami ko kulaa hu. 10Kristo gbo ngɛ adesa he yayami he si kake nyɔngloo. Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, e hɛ ngɛ, nɛ e kɛ Mawu ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene. 11Ja nɔuu nyɛɛ bu nyɛ he kaa nihi nɛ gbo ngɛ yayami peemi blɔ fa mi; se ngɛ Yesu Kristo mi ɔ, Mawu ha nɛ nyɛ hɛ ngɛ.
12Nyɛ ko ha nɛ yayami nɛ ye nyɛ nɔmlɔ tso nɛ gboɔ ɔ nɔ hu. Nyɛ ko di nɔmlɔ tso ɔ we akɔnɔ níhi a se. 13Nyɛ ko ngɔ nyɛ nɔmlɔ tso ɔ he ní komɛ kɛ pee yayami hu. Mohu ɔ, nyɛɛ ngɔ nyɛ he ngɔ ha Mawu. Nyɛɛ ba nyɛ je mi kaa nihi nɛ a tle mɛ si kɛ je gbeje kɛ ba wami mi. Nyɛɛ ngɔ nyɛ he ngɔ ha Mawu, konɛ e ngɔ nyɛ kɛ tsu níhi nɛ da. 14Nyɛ ko ha nɛ yayami nɛ ye nyɛ nɔ hu; ejakaa mlaa nɛ fiɔ nɔ ɔ, be nyɛ nɔ he wami hu; Mawu dloomi ɔ mohu lɛ hɛɛ nyɛ.
E sa kaa wa pee nɔ́ nɛ da
15Lɛɛ kɛ ji lɛ kɛɛ? Ke mlaa ko fí wɔ, se Mawu dloomi ɔ lɛ hɛɛ wɔ ɔ, lɛɛ waa ya nɔ waa pee yayami lo? Dɛbi! 16Anɛ nyɛ li kaa ke nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ he ha nɔ ko nɛ nyɛ buɔ lɛ tue ɔ, yayami nɛ kɛ nɔ yaa gbenɔ mi ɔ jio, Mawu tue bumi nɛ haa nɔ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a jio, nyɛ peeɔ nyɔguɛ kɛ ha lɛ lo? 17Se wa naa Mawu si! Jinɛ sa a, yayami ye nyɛ nyɔguɛ, se jehanɛ lɛɛ nyɛ ngɛ Mawu sɔmɔe. Ní nɛ a tsɔɔ nyɛ ɔ, nyɛ he lɛ kɛ nyɛ tsui tsuo. 18Mawu ha nyɛ ye nyɛ he kaa nihi nɛ kpa yayami peemi, nɛ nyɛ ba bɔni nɔ́ nɛ da peemi. 19I ngɔ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ kɛ to nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ je mi bami he, ejakaa gbɔjɔmi ngɛ nyɛ he. Sa a, yayami ye nyɛ nyɔguɛ, nɛ nyɛ ngɔ nyɛ nɔmlɔ tso ɔ he ní ɔmɛ kɛ tsu mu ní kɛ pee yayami gbegbeegbe; jã kɛ̃ jehanɛ lɛɛ nyɛɛ pee níhi nɛ da, konɛ nyɛ he nɛ tsɔ. 20Be mi nɛ yayami ye nyɛ nyɔguɛ ɔ, nyɛ pee we nɔ́ nɛ da. 21Níhi nɛ nyɛ pee, nɛ jehanɛ lɛɛ a he ngɛ nyɛ zo pee ɔ, mɛni se nyɛ na kɛ je mi? Nɔ́ nɛ jeɔ mi ji gbenɔ! 22Se jehanɛ lɛɛ Mawu kpɔ nyɛ kɛ je yayami dɛ mi, nɛ nyɛ ba pee e nyɔguɛhi. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ ba pee nihi nɛ a he tsɔ, nɛ neneene wami fɔɔ si ha nyɛ. 23Ejakaa yayami he hiɔwo ji gbenɔ; se Mawu nɔke nɔ́ ɔ ji neneene wami nɛ wa naa ngɛ wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo mi.

Title: ROMA BI 7
Content:
Gba si himi kaa nɔhyɛ nɔ́
1Ye nyɛmimɛ, nyɛ tsuo nyɛ le mlaa a; nɛ nyɛ li kaa nɔmlɔ adesa wami be mi nɛ mlaa fiɔ lɛ lo? 2Waa ngɔ gba si himi kaa nɔ hyɛmi nɔ́; yogbayo ɔ, mlaa fiɔ lɛ kɛ mɛtɛɛ e huno he be mi nɛ nyumu ɔ ngɛ je mi; se ke nyumu ɔ gbo ɔ, gba sihi mi mlaa ko be nɛ fiɔ yo ɔ kɛ mɛtɛɔ nyumu ɔ he hu. 3Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke e huno ɔ ngɛ je mi kɛ mwɔɔ, nɛ e ya gba nɔ kpa a, e puɛ gba. Se ke e huno ɔ gbo ɔ, lɛɛ mlaa fi we lɛ; nɛ ke e ya gba nyumu kpa a, e puɛ we gba. 4Ye nyɛmimɛ, bɔ nɛ nyɛ sane ngɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. Kristo nɔmlɔ tso ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ ngɛ kaa nihi nɛ gbo, nɛ mlaa fi we nyɛ hu. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ peeɔ nɔ nɛ a tle lɛ si kɛ je gbeje ɔ nihi, konɛ wɔ tsuo waa wo yiblii ha Mawu. 5Ejakaa be nɛ wa hi si ngɛ he lo nya a, waa kɛ wa nɔmlɔ tso ɔ tsu akɔnɔ ní yayamihi nɛ mlaa a tleɔ si ngɛ wa mi ɔ, nɛ waa kɛ wo yiblii ha gbenɔ. 6Se jehanɛ lɛɛ wa ye wa he kɛ je mlaa a dɛ mi. Wa ngɛ kaa nihi nɛ gbo, nɛ mlaa nɛ fiɔ wɔ ɔ be wa nɔ he wami hu. Wa tsu we mlaa momo ɔ nɛ a ngma a nya ní hu. Se mohu blɔ he nɛ Mawu mumi ɔ tsɔɔ wɔ ɔ, lɔ ɔ nya wa sɔmɔɔ ngɛ.
Mlaa kɛ nɔ woɔ yayami peemi mi
7 Lɛɛ kɛ wa ma de ngɛ mlaa a he kɛɛ? Mlaa a, nɔ́ yayami ji lɛ lo? Dɛbi! Anɔkuale mi ɔ, ke pi mlaa a he ɔ, i ko li nɔ́ nɛ ji yayami. Ejakaa jinɛ i li nɔ́ nɛ ji hɛkɔ, ke pi mlaa a nɛ de ke, “O hɛ ko kɔ̃ o nyɛmi nɔ.” 8Se mlaa a nɛ a wo ɔ na he blɔ gu yayami nɔ nɛ e kɛ tle akɔnɔ ní yayamihi si ngɛ ye mi. Ejakaa ke mlaa a be ɔ, yayami hu gbo. 9Imi nitsɛ hu, i hi si hyɛ nɛ i li mlaa; se benɛ mlaa a ba a, e tle yayami si wawɛɛ ngɛ ye mi, nɛ e ba pee gbenɔ ha mi. 10Mlaa a nɛ jinɛ e sa kaa e ko ngɔ wami kɛ ba a, e ba pee gbenɔ mohu ha mi. 11 Yayami ná he blɔ, nɛ e gu mlaa nɔ kɛ sisi mi, nɛ e gbe mi.
12Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, mlaa a ngɛ klɔuklɔu, kita a hu ngɛ klɔuklɔu; e da, nɛ e hi hulɔ. 13Lɛɛ nɔ́ kpakpa a plɛ pee gbenɔ ha mi lo? Dɛbi! Yayami lɛ kɛ enɛ ɔ ba; e gu nɔ́ kpakpa a nɔ ha gbenɔ ba na mi, konɛ bɔ nɛ yayami su ngɛ nitsɛnitsɛ ɔ nɛ je kpo paa nɛ a na. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, mlaa a haa yayami jeɔ kpo paa kaa nɔ́ ko nɛ hí kulaa.
Adesa su enyɔ
14Wa le kaa mlaa a mumi mi nɔ, se imi lɛɛ nɔmlɔ adesa kɛkɛ ji mi, nɛ yayami he mi nyɔguɛ. 15 Nɔ́ nɛ i tsuɔ ɔ, i li. Nɔ́ nɛ i suɔ kaa ma pee ɔ, i pee we lɔ ɔ; se nɔ́ nɛ i sume ɔ, lɔ ɔ mohu i peeɔ. 16Ke nɔ́ nɛ i sume ɔ nɔuu mohu i peeɔ ɔ, lɛɛ e tsɔɔ kaa imi hu i kplɛɛ kaa mlaa a hi. 17Ke jã a, lɛɛ pi imi nitsɛ nɛ i tsuɔ kikɛmɛ a ní nɛ ɔmɛ hu, se mohu yayami su nɛ ngɛ ye mi ɔ lɛ ngɛ ní tsue. 18I le kaa nɔ́ kpakpa ko be ye he lo su ɔ mi. Ejakaa nɔ́ kpakpa jloɔ mi nɛ ma pee, se i nyɛ we. 19Kpakpa nɛ i suɔ kaa ma pee ɔ, i pee we; se yayami nɛ i sume ɔ, lɔ ɔ mohu i peeɔ. 20Ke nɔ́ nɛ imi nitsɛ i sume ɔ nɔuu i peeɔ ɔ, lɛɛ pi imi nitsɛ nɛ i ngɛ yayami ɔ pee mɔ, se yayami su nɛ ngɛ ye mi ɔ mohu lɛ haa nɛ i peeɔ yayami ɔ.
21Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ́ ko nɛ i naa nɛ ngɛ ní tsue kaa mlaa ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: ke i to kaa ma pee kpakpa a, kɛkɛ i ya pee yayami mohu. 22Ngɛ ye tsui mi ɔ, i suɔ Mawu mlaa a saminya. 23Se i na kaa mlaa muno ko ngɛ ní tsue ngɛ ye nɔmlɔ tso ɔ mi. Mlaa nɛ ɔ kɛ nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ ye juɛmi mi ɔ yi kulaa. Nɔ́ nɛ ye juɛmi deɔ mi ke e da nɛ ma pee ɔ, i ya peeɔ nɔ́ kpa kulaa mohu. Yayami su nɛ ngɛ ye mi nɛ ɔ peeɔ mi nyɔguɛ. 24Hyɛ kaa ye ní ngɛ mɔbɔ! Ye nɔmlɔ tso ɔ miɔ nɛ e ma kpata ye hɛ mi. Mɛnɔ ma he ye yi wami kɛ je nɔmlɔ tso nɛ kɛ nɔ yaa gbenɔ mi nɛ ɔ dɛ mi? 25Sina ha Mawu kaa e he wa yi wami kɛ gu wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo nɔ!
Ke ma po lɛ kpiti ɔ, bɔ nɛ i ngɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: i kɛ ye juɛmi pɛ lɛ sɔmɔɔ ngɛ Mawu mlaa a nya, se ye he lo ɔ lɛɛ mlaa a nɛ haa nɔ peeɔ yayami ɔ lɛ yeɔ e nɔ.

Title: ROMA BI 8
Content:
Nɔ́ nɛ ye juɛmi deɔ mi ke e da a, Mawu mumi ɔ ke e dɛ
1Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, nihi nɛ ngɛ Kristo Yesu mi ɔ, fɔ bumi ko be ha mɛ hu. 2Ejakaa wa ngɛ Kristo mi, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Mawu mumi ɔ nɛ haa nɔ wami ɔ, haa wa yeɔ wa he; nɛ yayami, kɛ gbenɔ be wa nɔ he wami hu. 3Yayami nɛ adesa peeɔ ɔ, Mawu sume kulaa, se nɔmlɔ adesa gbɔjɔmi ɔ he je ɔ, mlaa a nyɛ we nɛ e pee he nɔ ko. Enɛ ɔ he ɔ, Mawu tsɔ lɛ nitsɛ e Bi ɔ kɛ ba ngɛ he lo su nɛ haa nɔ peeɔ yayami ɔ mi, konɛ e ba je wɔ kɛ je yayami dɛ mi. 4Mawu pee enɛ ɔ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ wɔ nihi nɛ wa bɛ wa je mi ngɛ he lo mi ní yayami ɔmɛ a nya, se mohu wa nyɛɛɔ ngɛ mumi ɔ blɔ tsɔɔmi nya a, wa nyɛ waa ye mlaa a nɔ sisiisi. 5Nihi nɛ baa a je mi ngɛ he lo nya a, he lo mi níhi a he a susuu. Se nihi nɛ baa a je mi ngɛ mumi ɔ blɔ tsɔɔmi nya a, mumi mi níhi a he a susuu. 6He lo nya níhi a he juɛmi ɔ kɛ gbenɔ baa, se mumi mi níhi a he juɛmi ɔ haa nɔ wami, kɛ he jɔmi. 7Nɔ nɛ susuɔ he lo mi níhi a he ɔ, e ngɛ Mawu nyɛe, ejakaa e bui Mawu mlaa a; pohu e be nɔ nyɛe maa ye tete. 8Nihi nɛ peeɔ he lo nya ní ɔ, a be nyɛe maa sa Mawu hɛ mi.
9Ke Mawu mumi ɔ ngɛ nyɛ mi ɔ, he lo ɔ be nyɛ nɔ he wami; mumi ɔ mohu lɛ tsɔɔ nyɛ blɔ. Ke nɔ ko be Kristo mumi ɔ, pi Kristo nɔ ji lɛ. 10Se ke Kristo ngɛ nyɛ mi ɔ, yayami nɛ nyɛ peeɔ he ɔ, nyɛ gbo ngɛ nɔmlɔ tso mi, se mumi mi lɛɛ nyɛ hɛ ngɛ, ejakaa Mawu buu nyɛ nihi nɛ da. 11 Ke Mawu nɛ tle Yesu si kɛ je gbeje ɔ mumi ɔ ngɛ nyɛ mi ɔ, lɛɛ mumi ɔ nɛ e kɛ tle Kristo si ɔ ma ha nyɛ nɔmlɔ tso nɛ gboɔ ɔ ma na wami.
12Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ye nyɛmimɛ, sane tloo wɔ, se pi he lo nya nɔ́ ko nɛ wa maa hi si ja. 13Ejakaa ke nyɛ peeɔ he lo nya níhi ɔ, nyɛ ma gbo; se ke Mawu mumi ɔ ha nyɛ kpa níhi nɛ nɔmlɔ tso ɔ suɔ ɔ tsumi ɔ, nyɛ yi ma na wami. 14Ejakaa nihi abɔ nɛ Mawu mumi ɔ tsɔɔ mɛ blɔ ɔ, mɛ ji Mawu bimɛ. 15 Mawu ha we nyɛ mumi nɛ peeɔ nɔ nyɔguɛ, nɛ nyɛ ma pa hi gbeye yee; se mohu e peeɔ nyɛ Mawu bimɛ. Mumi ɔ lɛ woɔ wɔ he wami, nɛ wa nyɛɔ faa kue kɛ ngmlaa ke, “Tsaatsɛ! Tsaatsɛ!” 16Mawu mumi ɔ nitsɛ kɛ wɔ hu wa mumi ɔ yeɔ odase kaa Mawu bimɛ ji wɔ. 17Akɛnɛ Mawu bimɛ ji wɔ ɔ, wa peeɔ Mawu we ní yeli hulɔ, nihi nɛ a kɛ Kristo maa dla ní. Ee, ke waa kɛ Kristo na nɔ́ ɔ, a maa wo waa kɛ lɛ tsuo wa hɛ mi nyami.
Hɛ mi nyami nɛ maa ba hwɔɔ se
18I le anɔkuale mi kaa nɔ́ nɛ wa ngɛ nae amlɔ nɛ ɔ pi nɔ́ ko kulaa nɛ a kɛ maa to wa hɛ mi nyami nɛ Mawu maa wo hwɔɔ se ɔ he. 19Adebɔ níhi tsuo to a tsui si kɛ ngɛ blɔ hyɛe wawɛɛ kaa Mawu ma ha nɛ a na e bimɛ nitsɛnitsɛmɛ ɔmɛ. 20 Yi mi pɔtɛɛ nɛ Mawu to ha níhi nɛ e bɔ ɔ, e ya bɛ mi ja pɛpɛɛpɛ. Pi adebɔ ní ɔmɛ nɛ pee; Mawu nitsɛ blɔ nya tomi ji ja. Se kɛ̃ ɔ, hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi ngɛ ha mɛ 21kaa be ko ma nɛ adebɔ níhi tsuo maa ye a he, nɛ gbenɔ be he wami nae ngɛ a nɔ hu; nɛ a kɛ Mawu bimɛ ɔmɛ maa hi si ngɛ he jɔmi mi, nɛ a maa wo a hɛ mi nyami. 22Wa le kaa kɛ ba su mwɔnɛ nɛ ɔ, adebɔ ní ɔmɛ tsuo ngɛ kɛmɛmi nɔ kaa yo nɛ ngɛ kɔ̃ɔ̃e nɛ e ma fɔ. 23 Se pi mɛ kɛkɛ, mohu wɔ nitsɛmɛ tete nɛ wa ná mumi ɔ yiblii ɔ, wɔ hu ja nɔuu wa hii kɛmɛmi nɔ wawɛɛ ngɛ wa mi, be mi nɛ wa ngɛ Mawu blɔ hyɛe kaa e pee wɔ e bimɛ kɛ pi si, konɛ wa nɔmlɔ tso ɔ nɛ ye e he kulaa. 24Wa ngɔ wa hɛ ngɔ fɔ Mawu nɔ, lɔ ɔ he nɛ a he wa yi wami ɔ nɛ. Se ke nɔ́ nɛ wa ngɔ wa hɛ kɛ fɔ nɔ ɔ su wa dɛ momo ɔ, lɛɛ lɔ ɔ pi hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi nitsɛ. Nɔ́ nɛ wa nine su nɔ momo ɔ, anɛ wa hyɛɔ blɔ ekohu lo? 25Se ke wa ngɛ nɔ́ ko blɔ hyɛe, nɛ wa ngɔ wa hɛ kɛ fɔ nɔ kaa wa nine maa su nɔ ɔ, wa toɔ wa tsui si.
26Ja nɔuu, ke wa gbede ɔ, mumi ɔ piɛɔ wa he. Ejakaa ke wa ngɛ sɔlee ɔ, wa li nɔ́ tutuutu nɛ sa kaa wa deɔ. Mumi ɔ nitsɛ daa mi ha wɔ kɛ kɔmɔ yemi nɛ a be nyɛe maa kale. 27Mawu nɛ le adesahi tsuo a yi mi ɔ lɛ le nɔ́ nɛ mumi ɔ deɔ, ejakaa pɛɛ nɛ mumi ɔ kpaa ha ní klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ ɔ saa Mawu hɛ mi.
28Wa le kaa nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ mi ɔ, Mawu piɛɔ nihi nɛ suɔ lɛ ɔ a he, konɛ e hi ha mɛ. Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, Mawu nitsɛ nɛ to e yi mi, nɛ e tsɛ mɛ. 29Nihi nɛ Mawu hla ngɔ to momo ɔ, e pee mɛ klɔuklɔu, konɛ a subai nɛ hi kaa Bi ɔ nɔ. Kɛkɛ ɔ, Bi ɔ maa pee nɔkɔtɔma ngɛ e nyɛmimɛ babauu a kpɛti. 30Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nihi nɛ Mawu hla a, mɛ nɔuu e tsɛ, nihi nɛ e tsɛ ɔ, mɛ nɔuu e wo nguɔ, nɛ nihi nɛ e wo nguɔ ɔ, e wo mɛ nɔuu a hɛ mi nyami.
Yesu Kristo tsɔɔ bɔ nɛ Mawu suɔ wɔ ha
31Lɛɛ kɛ wa ma de kɛɛ ngɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ a he mɔ? Ke Mawu ngɛ wa se ɔ, mɛnɔ maa te si ngɔ wo wɔ? 32Mawu nɛ klɔɛ e Bi ɔ he, se mohu e ngɔ lɛ kɛ sã bɔ ngɛ wɔ nimli adesahi tsuo wa he ɔ, anɛ e be níhi tsuo ngɔe kɛ piɛ he ha wɔ lo? 33Nihi nɛ Mawu hla a, mɛnɔ maa po a nya? Mawu nitsɛ lɛ woɔ nɔ nguɔ. 34Lɛ mɛnɔ lɛ buɔ nɔ fɔ mɔ? Yesu Kristo loo? Yesu Kristo lɛɛ e gbo; se nɔ́ nɛ pe lɔ ɔ, Mawu tle lɛ si kɛ je gbeje kɛ ba wami mi; nɛ amlɔ nɛ ɔ, e ngɛ Mawu hiɔ nɔ, nɛ e ngɛ mi dae ha wɔ ngɛ Tsɛ ɔ hɛ mi. 35Mɛnɔ ma gba wɔ kɛ maa je suɔmi nɛ Kristo ngɛ kɛ ha wɔ ɔ mi? Haomi loo, nɔ nami loo, yi mi wami loo, hwɔ loo, oslã loo, aloo klaate? 36 Kaa bɔ nɛ ngmami ɔ deɔ ɔ,
“O he ɔ, be tsuaa be nɛ ɔ, wa ngɛ gbenɔ nya mi;
a buɔ wɔ kaa tohi nɛ a yaa gbe.”
37Dɛbi! Ngɛ enɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a mi ɔ, nɔ nɛ suɔ wɔ ɔ haa wa yeɔ kunimi babauu. 38Ejakaa i ngɛ nɔ mi mami kaa gbenɔ jio, wami jio, hiɔwe bɔfohi jio, nɔ yeli kpa komɛ nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe jio, níhi nɛ ngɛ jio, níhi nɛ maa ba jio, he wami kpa ko jio, 39hiɔwe lokoo jio, zugba sisi jio, níhi nɛ a bɔ ɔ a mi eko jio, Mawu suɔmi nɛ wa na ngɛ Kristo Yesu, wa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ mi ɔ, ní nɛ ɔmɛ ekoeko be nyɛe ma gba wɔ kɛ maa je mi.

Title: ROMA BI 9
Content:
Mawu hla e ma
1Anɔkuale i ngɛ tue ngɛ Kristo mi, nɛ ye he nile maa nɔ mi ngɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ mi kaa nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ dee ɔ, i yi lakpa. 2I yeɔ tsui, nɛ i yeɔ kɔmɔ hu babauu 3ngɛ ye nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ a he. Ye weku li ji mɛ ngɛ he lo nya, nɛ i ko suɔ kaa ngɛ mɛɛ a he ɔ, a bu mi musutsɛ, nɛ a po mi kɛ je Kristo he. 4 Mɛ ji Israel bi; nɛ Mawu nitsɛ nɛ ngɔ mɛ kɛ pee e ma; e wo a hɛ mi nyami, e kɛ mɛ so, nɛ e ha mɛ mlaa a; e tsɔɔ mɛ jami blɔ nya tomi, nɛ mɛ nɔuu nɛ e wo si ɔ nɛ. 5A mi nɛ wa nɛmɛ ɔmɛ je, nɛ Kristo ɔ tete a nina ji lɛ ngɛ he lo nya. Kristo ɔ ji Mawu Ope ɔ nɛ yeɔ nihi tsuo a nɔ ɔ nɛ. A je e yi kɛ ya neneene! Amen.
6I tsɔɔ we kaa Mawu siwo ɔ peeɔ yaka. Ejakaa pi Israel ma a tsuo ji Israel bi anɔkuale mi. 7 Nɛ jehanɛ hu pi Abraham nina tsuo ji Abraham bimɛ. Mohu ɔ, Mawu wo Abraham si ke, “Isak nɔ nɛ o nina maa gu kɛ ba.” 8Enɛ ɔ tsɔɔ kaa pi Abraham bimɛ nɛ e fɔ ngɛ he lo nya a ji Mawu bimɛ. Se mohu si nɛ a wo Abraham ɔ, ni nɛmɛ nɛ heɔ yeɔ ɔ, mɛ ji Abraham nina. 9 Mawu wo Abraham si ke, “Hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ jeha a, ma kpale kɛ ba o ngɔ ekohu, nɛ o yo Sara ma fɔ binyumu.”
10Pi enɛ ɔ kɛkɛ, Rebeka bimɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ ɔ, e kɛ wa tsɛ Isak kake ɔ nɔuu nɛ fɔ mɛ. 11Se bɔ nɛ pee nɛ yi mi nɛ Mawu to kɛ hla nɔ kake ɔ nɛ ba mi ɔ, be nɛ a na we nɛ a fɔ mɛ tete, pohu a na we nɛ a pee nɔ́ kpakpa ko, loo nɔ́ yaya ko ɔ, 12 e de Rebeka ke, “Nɔkɔtɔma a ma sɔmɔ jokuɛ ɔ,” konɛ e ko ba mi kaa nɔ́ ko nɛ e tsu he, se mohu nɔ nɛ tsɛ mɛ ɔ lɛ pee. 13 Ngmami ɔ deɔ ke, “I je suɔmi kpo kɛ tsɔɔ Yakob, se Esau lɛɛ i nyɛ lɛ.”
14Lɛɛ kɛ wa ma de kɛɛ? Mawu yeɔ sane kpɛkpɛɛ lo? Dɛbi! 15 Ejakaa Mawu de Mose ke, “Nɔ nɛ sa mɔbɔ nami ɔ, ma na lɛ mɔbɔ, nɛ nɔ nɛ sa mi mi sami ɔ, ye mi mi maa sã mi ngɛ e he.” 16Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, jehanɛ ɔ, pi nɔmlɔ ko suɔmi nya, aloo nɔ́ ko nɛ nɔ ko tsu he je, se mohu nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ daa si ngɛ Mawu mɔbɔ nami nɔ. 17 Ejakaa ngmami ɔ deɔ ke Mawu de Egipt matsɛ ɔ ke, “I wo mo tsɛ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ ma je ye he wami kpo ngɔ tsɔɔ mo, konɛ o wo ye biɛ ta ngɛ je ɔ mi tsuo.” 18Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ nɛ Mawu suɔ kaa e maa na lɛ mɔbɔ ɔ, e naa lɛ mɔbɔ, nɛ nɔ nɛ e suɔ kaa e wa tue ɔ, e haa e waa tue.
Mawu gblaa nɔ tue, nɛ e naa nɔ mɔbɔ hulɔ
19Nyɛ ti nɔ ko ma bi mi ke, “Mɛni he je Mawu piaa wɔ mɔ? Nɔ́ nɛ e to e yi mi kaa e maa pee ɔ, anɛ nɔ ko ma nyɛ tsi nya lo?” 20 Se mo nɔmlɔ adesa, mɛnɔ ji mo nɛ o ma de Mawu ke nɔ́ nɛ e de ɔ dɛ? Anɛ buɛ ma de nɔ nɛ puɛ lɛ ɔ ke, “Mɛni he je o puɛ mi kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ?” 21Wa le kaa buɛ puɛlɔ ngɛ he wami ngɛ zu nɛ e pɔtɔ ɔ nɔ, kaa e kɛ eko puɛɔ buɛ ko nɛ hi kɛ ha ní tsumi pɔtɛɛ ko, nɛ e puɛɔ buɛ kpa hu ngɛ mi kɛ ha ní tsumi gu ko kɛkɛ.
22Anɛ kaa Mawu suɔ nɛ a le bɔ nɛ e mi mi la ngɛ, kɛ e he wami ɔ, jinɛ e ko kpata nihi nɛ woɔ e mi mi la a a hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ. Se e to e tsui si babauu ha mɛ. 23E pee enɛ ɔ, konɛ nihi nɛ e na mɛ mɔbɔ ɔ nɛ a le bɔ nɛ e to momo kaa e maa wo a hɛ mi nyami babauu ha. 24Wɔ hu ja e tsɛ wɔ, konɛ waa na kaa pi Yuda bi kɛkɛ nɛ e tsɛ, se e tsɛ ma je li ɔmɛ hulɔ. 25 Bɔ nɛ Mawu de ngɛ Hosea womi ɔ mi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ:
“Nihi nɛ a tsɛɔ mɛ ‘Piyemajinyɛ’ ɔ,
ma de mɛ ke ‘Ye ma ji nyɛ.’
Nɛ nɔ́ nɛ a tsɛɔ lɛ ‘Asumemo’ ɔ
ma je suɔmi kpo ha lɛ.”
26 “Nɛ e maa ba mi kaa
he nɛ a ma de mɛ ngɛ ke,
‘Pi ye ma ji nyɛ’ ɔ,
lejɛ ɔ nɔuu a ma tsɛ mɛ ngɛ ke,
‘Mawu hɛ kalɔ ɔ bimɛ.’ ”
27 Yesaya hu kpa ngmlaa kɛ de ngɛ Israel he ke, “Ke Israel bi hiɛ kaa wo nya zia tete po ɔ, nihi nɛ piɛ ɔ pɛ a yi wami a ma he. 28Ejakaa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ he maa sɔ kɛ kojo je ɔ tsuo.” 29 Kaa bɔ nɛ Yesaya de to momo ɔ, “Ke pi kaa Nyɔmtsɛ Ope ɔ nɛ ha wa nina a eko piɛ ɔ, jinɛ wa ní ko pee kaa Sodom kɛ Gomora pɛ.”
Sane kpakpa a ngɛ kɛ ha Israel hulɔ
30Lɛɛ kɛ wa ma de kɛɛ? Ma je li ɔmɛ nɛ jinɛ a, kaa a bu mɛ nihi nɛ da a, a bu mɛ ni nɛ da ejakaa a he Mawu ye. 31Se Israel nɛ di mlaa nɛ ma ha a bu mɛ nihi nɛ da se ɔ, mɛ mohu a nine sui nɔ. 32Kɛ ba kɛɛ? A nine sui nɔ, ejakaa a hla we lɛ kɛ hemi kɛ yemi. A susu kaa kɛ gu ní tsumihi a nɔ nɛ a ma na lɛ. Enɛ ɔ ha nɛ a pee kaa nihi nɛ a ngɔ tɛ ngɔ fɔ blɔ mi ha mɛ nɛ a tɛ. 33 Ngmami ɔ deɔ ke,
“Hyɛ, i ngɔ tɛ kɛ ngɛ si mae ngɛ Zion;
e ma ha nihi ma tɛ si;
e ji tɛ sa nɛ maa tsɛ̃ mɛ ngɔ fia si.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ heɔ tɛ nɛ ɔ yeɔ ɔ,
zo be lɛ gbee kɔkɔɔkɔ.”

Title: ROMA BI 10
Content:
1Ye nyɛmimɛ, pɛɛ nɛ i kpaa Mawu daa kɛ jeɔ ye tsui mi kɛ haa Israel bi ji kaa a he a yi wami. 2Ejakaa i ngɛ odase ngɛ he kaa a hɛ dɔɔ wawɛɛ ngɛ Mawu he, se blɔ nɔ nɛ a kɛ ma ja lɛ ɔ nɛ a li. 3Blɔ nɔ nɛ Mawu guu kɛ buu nɔ nɔ nɛ da a, a li, nɛ a hlaa kaa a ma wo mɛ nitsɛmɛ a blɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a ngɔɛ a he ngɔ ha we Mawu, konɛ e bu mɛ nihi nɛ da. 4Ejakaa Kristo po mlaa a mi, nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ heɔ yeɔ ɔ, Mawu wo lɛ nguɔ.
Yi wami hemi ngɛ kɛ ha nɔ tsuaa nɔ
5 Nɔ nɛ Mose ngma ngɛ nɔmlɔ nɛ a buu lɛ nɔ nɛ da ngɛ mlaa a nɔ nɛ e yeɔ ɔ he ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ yeɔ mlaa a nɔ fitsofitso ɔ, e yi ma na wami.” 6 Se kaa nɔmlɔ adesa ma he Mawu ye nɛ lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Mawu buu lɛ nɔ nɛ da a, nɔ́ nɛ ngmami ɔ deɔ ngɛ he ji, “Ko de ngɛ o tsui mi ke, Mɛnɔ maa kuɔ kɛ ya hiɔwe?” (lɔ ɔ ji kaa e ma ya ngɔ Kristo kɛ kple si;) 7aloo “Mɛnɔ maa ya muɔ voo ɔ mi?” (lɔ ɔ ji konɛ e ya ngɔ Kristo kɛ je gbeje kɛ ba.) 8Se kɛ e deɔ kɛɛ?
“Munyu nɛ Mawu tu ɔ ngɛ o ngɔ hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ;
o le, nɛ e ngɛ o tsui mi.”
Jamɛ a hemi kɛ yemi ɔ wa ngɛ fiɛe ɔ nɛ. 9Ke o kɛ o nya jaje ke “Yesu Kristo ji Nyɔmtsɛ,” nɛ o he ye ngɛ o tsui mi kaa Mawu tle lɛ si kɛ je gbeje ɔ, a ma he o yi wami. 10Ejakaa tsui a kɛ heɔ yeɔ loko Mawu woɔ nɔ nguɔ; nɛ ke waa kɛ wa nya jaje ɔ, a ma he wa yi wami. 11 Ngmami ɔ deɔ ke, “Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ heɔ yeɔ ɔ, zo be lɛ gbee.” 12Slɔɔto ko be Yuda no kɛ ma je no a kpɛti, ejakaa a ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ kake, nɛ e mi hi saminya ha nihi tsuo nɛ kpaa ngmlaa kɛ tsɛɔ lɛ ɔ. 13 Kaa bɔ nɛ ngmami ɔ deɔ ɔ, “Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ma kpa ngmlaa kɛ tsɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ biɛ ɔ, a ma he e yi wami.”
14Se kɛ maa pee kɛɛ nɛ a ma kpa ngmlaa kɛ tsɛ nɔ nɛ a he we lɛ yi ɔ? Nɛ kɛ maa pee kɛɛ nɛ a ma he nɔ nɛ a nui e he sane ɔ ye? Jehanɛ hu kɛ maa pee kɛɛ nɛ a maa nu, ke nɔ ko fiɛ we ha mɛ? 15 Nɛ kɛ maa pee kɛɛ nɛ nihi maa fiɛ, ke a tsɔ we mɛ? Kaa bɔ nɛ a ngma a, “Hyɛ bɔ nɛ he jɔmi sane kpakpa a fiɛli a nanehi ngɛ fɛu ha.” 16 Se kɛ̃ ɔ, pi Israel bi ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ he sane kpakpa a. Ejakaa Yesaya de ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ, wa sane ɔ, mɛnɔ he ye?” 17Lɔ ɔ ji kaa ja a fiɛ Kristo he sane ɔ loko nɔ ko maa nu. Nɛ ja nɔ ko nu sane ɔ loko e ma he ye.
18 Se i ngɛ bie ke, Anɛ a nui sɛ gbi ɔ lo? Anɔkuale, a nu, ejakaa ngmami ɔ deɔ ke,
“A gbi jije kɛ ho zugba a tsuo nɔ ya;
Nɛ a sɛ gbi ɔ ya su je ɔ nyagbe he ɔmɛ.”
19 I ngɛ bie ekohu ke anɛ Israel li lo? Mose
ji kekleekle nɔ nɛ he nɔ ke,
“Ma ha nyɛ maa je je ma ko nɛ a bui lɛ kulaa he hunga;
Nɛ i kɛ ma kɛ e mi kuasiahi sɔuu maa wo nyɛ mi mi la.”
20 Yesaya hu kɛ kã de ke,
“I ha nihi nɛ hla we mi ɔ na mi,
Nɛ nihi nɛ bi we ye si ɔ, i je ye he kpo tsɔɔ mɛ.”
21 Se Israel lɛɛ Yesaya de ngɛ e he ke,
“Daa nɛ ɔ, i gbɛ ye gugue mi nɛ ma he nyɛ atuu;
Ma tue gboli nɛ a tsui kplii!”

Title: ROMA BI 11
Content:
Mawu na Israel ma a mɔbɔ
1 Jehanɛ lɛɛ i ngɛ bie ke anɛ Mawu kua lɛ nitsɛ e ma a lo? Dɛbi! Mawu kua we e ma a. Imi nitsɛ hu Israel no ji mi; Abraham nina ji mi, nɛ i je Benyamin wɛtso ɔ mi. 2Mawu kua we e ma nɛ e hla blema lokoo ɔ. Tse nyɛ le nɔ́ nɛ ngmami ɔ deɔ ngɛ Eliya yi nɔ benɛ Eliya po Israel nya ha Mawu ke, 3 “Nyɔmtsɛ, a gbe o gbali ɔmɛ tsuo, nɛ a ywia o bɔ sami la tɛ ɔmɛ; nɛ imi nɔ kake nɛ piɛ, nɛ a ngɛ imi hu hlae nɛ a gbe” ɔ. 4 Mɛni heto Mawu ha lɛ? E de lɛ ke, “I si gbali akpe kpaago hɛ ngmengmle ngɛ Israel nɛ mɛɛ a kpla we si ha Baal.” 5Ja nɔuu, amlɔ nɛ ɔ, nihi bɔɔ piɛ nɛ Mawu hla mɛ ngɛ dloomi nya. 6Nɛ ke dloomi nya a, lɛɛ pi ní tsumi ko nɛ a tsu he hu. Kaa ní tsumi ko nɛ a tsu he ɔ, jinɛ dloomi ɔ pi dloomi hu.
7Lɛɛ kɛ ji lɛ kɛɛ? Israel nine sui nɔ́ nɛ a ngɛ hlae ɔ nɔ. Nihi nɛ Mawu hla a, mɛɛ lɛɛ a nine su nɔ. Ni nɛmɛ nɛ piɛ ɔ lɛɛ a wa tue. 8 Kaa bɔ nɛ ngmami ɔ deɔ ɔ,
“Mawu ha nɛ a pee kaa nihi nɛ lu;
kɛ ba su mwɔnɛ nɛ ɔ,
a ngɛ hɛngmɛ ji nɛ,
se a hyɛ we nɔ́;
nɛ a ngɛ tue hulɔ,
se a kɛ nui nɔ́.”
9 David hu de ke,
“Ke a tsɛ ní yemi ɔ,
ha nɛ e pee klama nɛ du mɛ;
a nɔɔ si nɛ a gbla a tue.
10A hɛngmɛ nɛ ma, nɛ a ko hyɛ nɔ́;
a se tso nɛ kpɛ daa.”
11Jehanɛ, i ngɛ bie ke, nɛ a tɛ nɔ́ nɛ a nɔ si ɔ, a nɔ gbidii nɛ a ti hu lo? Dɛbi! A si gbeemi ɔ bli blɔ ha ma je li ɔmɛ, nɛ a he a yi wami. Enɛ ɔ ha Israel bi ɔmɛ je mɛ hunga. 12Ke Yuda bi a si gbeemi ɔ plɛ pee gbaami ha je ɔ tsuo, nɛ a ní nɛ bɔ mɛ ɔ ba pee gbaami ha ma je li ɔmɛ ɔ, lɛɛ ke Yuda bi ɔmɛ tsuo tsake ɔ, gbaami nɛ a maa gbaa je ɔ, kɛ e hiɛmi maa hi kɛɛ?
Mawu he ma je li ɔmɛ a yi wami
13Ma je li, jehanɛ i kɛ nyɛ maa tu munyu. Be abɔ nɛ i ngɛ ní tsue kaa bɔfo ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti ɔ, ma tsu kɛ gɛjɛmi. 14Eko ɔ, gɛjɛmi nɛ i kɛ ngɛ nyɛ he ní tsue ɔ ma ha ye nyɛmimɛ Yuda bi ɔmɛ maa je hunga, nɛ ye he ɔ, Mawu ma he a ti ni komɛ a yi wami. 15Ejakaa ke Mawu kua Yuda bi ɔmɛ, nɛ lɔ ɔ he a dla Mawu kɛ je ɔ a kpɛti ɔ, lɛɛ ke e kpale he mɛ ekohu ɔ, kɛ níhi maa hi kɛɛ? E maa pee kaa nɔ nɛ gbo, nɛ a kpale tle lɛ si kɛ ba wami mi ekohu.
16Ke má bɔbɔyoo nɛ a ti kɛ sã bɔ ha Mawu ɔ ngɛ klɔuklɔu ɔ, lɛɛ má a tsuo ngɛ klɔuklɔu. Jã kɛ̃ ke tso sipoku ɔ ngɛ klɔuklɔu ɔ, tso kɔni ɔmɛ hu peeɔ klɔuklɔu. 17Oliv tso nɛ a je blɔ du ɔ, ke a kplɔ e kɔni ɔmɛ ekomɛ, nɛ a ya ngɔ mo oliv tso nɛ mo nitsɛ lo puɛ ngɛ nga mi ba ta tso ɔ he, nɛ o naa oliv tso sipoku ɔ mi niye ní ɔ eko ɔ, 18koo fĩa kaa o pe jamɛ a kɔni ɔmɛ nɛ a kplɔɔ ɔ. Ke o maa fĩa a, o hɛ nɛ hi o he nɔ kaa pi mo nɛ o hɛɛ sipoku ɔ, se mohu sipoku ɔ nɛ hɛɛ mo.
19Jehanɛ eko ɔ, o ma de ke, “A kplɔ kɔnihi, konɛ a ngɔ mi ngɔ ta tso ɔ he.” 20Saminya! Hemi nɛ a he we yi he je nɛ a po mɛ; nɛ moo lɛɛ hemi kɛ yemi o kɛ daa si ɔ nɛ. O yi ko fu, se mohu o hɛ nɛ hi o he nɔ. 21Ejakaa ke Mawu baa we tso ɔ nitsɛ kɔni ɔmɛ a yi ɔ, eko ɔ, mohu e be o yi baae. 22Enɛ ɔ tsɔɔ wɔ kaa Mawu mi mi hi, se e sane wa hulɔ. Nihi nɛ gbee si ɔ, e kɛ mɛ to ní; se nyɛɛ lɛɛ e mi mi jɔ ha nyɛ, nɛ e sa kaa nyɛɛ ya nɔ kikɛ nɛ ɔ. Ke pi jaa, a ma kplɔ nyɛ kɛ pue si ja nɔuu. 23Yuda bi ɔmɛ hu, ke a tsake nɛ a ba he ye jehanɛ ɔ, a maa kpale mɛ kɛ ta tso ɔ he ekohu, ejakaa Mawu ma nyɛ pee enɛ ɔ hluu tsɔ. 24Nɛ pohu hyɛ kaa oliv tso nɛ lɛ nitsɛ e puɛ ngɛ nga nɔ, nɛ a po mo ngɛ he, nɛ a kɛ ba ta oliv tso nɛ a je blɔ du ɔ he ɔ, e pee pɛ. Kikɛmɛ a nɔ́ nɛ ɔ pɔɛ he. Lɛɛ oliv tso ɔ nɛ a je blɔ du ɔ nitsɛ e kɔnihi nɛ a kplɔ ɔ, e be wae kulaa kaa a maa kpale ngɔ mɛ kɛ ta tso ɔ he ekohu.
Mawu naa nihi tsuo mɔbɔ
25Ye nyɛmimɛ, anɔkuale laami sane ko ngɛ nɛ i suɔ kaa nyɛɛ le, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ nyɛ ko susu kaa nyɛ hɛ mi lɛ tɛ̃. Sane ɔ ji kaa Israel bi ɔmɛ ɔ, pe a ha a wa tue be kuku kɛkɛ kɛ yaa si ma je li ɔmɛ tsuo ma ba le Mawu. 26 Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a ma he Israel tsuo yi wami kaa bɔ nɛ a ngma a ke,
“Yi wami helɔ ɔ maa je Zion kɛ ba;
e ma ha Yakob nina a ma kpa musu bɔmi.
27 Nɛ somi nɛ i kɛ mɛ maa so ji
kaa a ma kpa yayami tsuo peemi.”
28Ngɛ sane kpakpa a blɔ fa mi ɔ, nyɛ he ɔ, Yuda bi ɔmɛ peeɔ Mawu he nyɛli. Se akɛnɛ e hla a nɛmɛ ɔmɛ momo he je ɔ, Mawu suɔ mɛ. 29Ejakaa ke Mawu tsɛ nɔ ko nɛ e gbaa lɛ ɔ, e tsakee we e yi mi hu. 30Nyɛ ma je li, sa a, nyɛ bui Mawu, se jehanɛ lɛɛ Mawu na nyɛ mɔbɔ, ejakaa Yuda bi ɔmɛ hu ba gbo tue. 31Amlɔ nɛ ɔ lɛɛ Yuda bi ji tue gboli ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi. Se mɔbɔ nɛ Mawu na nyɛ ɔ he je ɔ, mɛ hu Mawu ma ba na mɛ mɔbɔ. 32Mawu ha nɛ nihi tsuo pee kaa nɔ́ nɛ a wo mɛ tsu ngɛ tue gbomi he, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ e na mɛ tsuo mɔbɔ.
Nyɛ ha wa je Mawu yi
33 Niatsɛ mi niatsɛ ji Mawu!
Hyɛ bɔ nɛ e nile, kɛ juɛmi hiɛ ha!
Mɛnɔ le bɔ nɛ e toɔ e yi mi ha?
Blɔ nɔ nɛ e guu kɛ tsuɔ ní ɔ, mɛnɔ le?
34 Kaa bɔ nɛ ngmami ɔ deɔ ɔ,
“Mɛnɔ lɛ le Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ juɛmi,
aloo mɛnɔ lɛ wo lɛ ga hyɛ?
35 Mɛnɔ ha lɛ nɔ ko hyɛ,
nɛ e hia kaa e to lɛ nane mi?”
36 Ejakaa Mawu lɛ bɔ níhi tsuo;
lɛ nɛ ngɛ he wami ngɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɔ;
nɛ mɛ tsuo a woɔ e hɛ mi nyami
kɛ yaa neneene! Amen!

Title: ROMA BI 12
Content:
Bɔ nɛ sa nɛ waa ba wa je mi kɛ ja Mawu
1I kpa nyɛ pɛɛ ye nyɛmimɛ, Mawu na nyɛ mɔbɔ babauu, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ ngɔ nyɛ he ngɔ ha kaa bɔ nɛ a sã, se kɛ̃ e hɛ ngɛ, nɛ e he tsɔ, nɛ e saa Mawu hɛ mi; nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ wami tsuo nɛ sɔmɔ Mawu, konɛ nyɛ jami ɔ nɛ pee ngɛ mumi mi. 2Nyɛ ko ba nyɛ je mi kaa je mi bi ɔmɛ hu; se mohu nyɛ ha Mawu nɛ tsake nyɛ juɛmi, konɛ nyɛ yɔse níhi nɛ ji Mawu suɔmi nya ní kpakpahi nɛ sa e hɛ mi saminya, nɛ hi kɛ pi si ɔ.
3I kɛ dloomi nɛ Mawu dloo mi ɔ ngɛ nyɛ tsuo dee ke, nyɛ ti nɔ ko kó bu lɛ nitsɛ e he tsɔ pe bɔ nɛ sa kaa e buu e he. Se mohu e pee e he humi kaa bɔ nɛ hemi kɛ yemi nɛ Mawu ha lɛ ɔ tsɔɔ kaa e pee ɔ. 4 Wa ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ ngɛ nɔmlɔ tso kake kɛ e he níhi fuu, se e he ní ɔmɛ tsuo tsuɔ ní slɔɔtoslɔɔtohi ngɛ nɔmlɔ tso ɔ he. 5Jã kɛ̃ wɔ nimli babauu nɛ ɔ, wa peeɔ nɔmlɔ tso kake ngɛ Kristo mi, nɛ wa ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ ɔ, e nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ ji lɛ. 6 Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nike ní slɔɔtohi nɛ Mawu kɛ dloo wɔ ɔ, e sa kaa wa tsu a he ní saminya. Ke gbami ji wa nike ní ɔ, nyɛ ha waa ngɔ hemi kɛ yemi nɛ Mawu ha wɔ ɔ kɛ tsu he ní. 7Ke a ha wɔ he wami nɛ a kɛ sɔmɔɔ nyɛmimɛ ɔ, wa sɔmɔ; ke ní tsɔɔmi ɔ, wa tsɔɔ. 8Ke wa nɔ́ ji kaa waa tu munyu kɛ wo nyɛmimɛ he wami ɔ, waa wo mɛ he wami. Nɔ nɛ maa ke ní ɔ, e pee kɛ bua jɔmi. Hɛ mi nyɛɛlɔ ɔ, e tsu ní ɔ wawɛɛ; nɛ nɔ nɛ naa mɔbɔ ɔ, e pee kɛ bua jɔmi.
9Suɔmi ɔ, e je nyɛ tsui mi tɔɔ. Nyɛɛ nyɛ yayami kulaa; nɛ nyɛɛ pɛtɛ nɔ́ kpakpa he. 10Nyɛɛ suɔ nyɛ he saminya kaa nyɛmimɛ, nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ bu e nyɛmi pe lɛ nitsɛ e he. 11Nyɛ ko pee hejɔ, mohu nyɛɛ kɛ hɛdɔ nɛ tsu ní. Nyɛ sɔmɔ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ kɛ nyɛ tsui tsuo. 12Akɛnɛ nyɛ ngɔ nyɛ hɛ ngɔ fɔ Mawu nɔ ɔ, nyɛ bua nɛ jɔ. Ke haomi ba a, nyɛɛ to nyɛ tsui si nɛ nyɛɛ hi sɔlee daa. 13Ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ nɛ e fi mɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ ye bua mɛ; nɛ nyɛɛ bɔ nibwɔ peemi he mɔde. 14 Nihi nɛ waa nyɛ yi mi ɔ, nyɛ kpa Mawu pɛɛ ha mɛ; nyɛ ko gbiɛ mɛ. 15Nihi nɛ ngɛ nyae ɔ, nyɛɛ kɛ mɛ nɛ nya; nɛ nihi nɛ ngɛ ya foe ɔ, nyɛɛ kɛ mɛ nɛ fo. 16 Bɔ nɛ nyɛ maa pee kɛ ha nɔ kake ɔ, nyɛɛ pee ja kɛ ha nɔ tsuaa nɔ. Nyɛ ko wo nyɛ he nɔ, se mohu nyɛɛ kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ baa a he si ɔ nɛ bɔ; nɛ nyɛ ko bu nyɛ he ní leli tsɔ.
17Nyɛ ko pee nɔ ko yayami kɛ to yayami nane mi. Nyɛ ha nihi tsuo nɛ a na kaa nyɛ ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ da pee. 18Ke e maa hi ɔ, nyɛɛ bɔ mɔde nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ hi si ngɛ he jɔmi mi. 19 Ye huɛmɛ, nyɛ ko ye nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ he lue, se mohu nyɛɛ ngmɛ Mawu blɔ nɛ e kɛ e mi mi la nɛ pee. Ejakaa ngmami ɔ deɔ ke,
“Ye nɔ ji lue yemi;
Imi ma pee kɛ to nane mi. Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ lɛ de.”
20 Kaa bɔ nɛ ngmami ɔ ya nɔ de ɔ, “Ke hwɔ ngɛ o he nyɛlɔ yee ɔ, ha lɛ ní nɛ e ye; nɛ ke kuma ngɛ lɛ yee ɔ, ha lɛ nyu nɛ e nu. Ke o pee jã a, o ma ha zo kpɔtɔɔ maa gbe lɛ.” 21Nyɛ ko ha yayami nɛ ye nyɛ nɔ, se mohu nyɛɛ ngɔ kpakpa peemi kɛ ye yayami nɔ kunimi.

Title: ROMA BI 13
Content:
E sa kaa a bu ma nɔ yeli tue
1Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ba e he si ha ma nɔ yeli, ejakaa blɔ nya tsuaa blɔ nya a, Mawu lɛ haa nɔ; nɛ nɔ yeli nɛ ngɛ nɛ ɔ hu he wami nɛ a hɛɛ ɔ, Mawu lɛ ha mɛ. 2Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ teɔ si kɛ siɔ blɔ nya nɛ ɔ, Mawu blɔ nya tomi ɔ e nɛ ngɛ si tee kɛ ngɛ woe ɔ nɛ; nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ peeɔ ja a, Mawu maa gbla e tue. 3Ejakaa nɔ yeli nɛ ngɛ nɛ ɔ, e sɛ kaa nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ kpakpa yeɔ mɛ gbeye, se mohu nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ yaya. Anɛ o suɔ nɛ o ko ye nɔ yelɔ ɔ gbeye lo? Ke ja a, lɛɛ pee nɔ́ kpakpa; nɛ nɔ yelɔ ɔ ma je o yi. 4Mawu tsɔlɔ ji lɛ, nɛ e ní tsumi ji kaa e hyɛ nɛ e hi ha mo. Se ke o pee yayami ɔ, lɛɛ o ye nɔ yelɔ ɔ gbeye; ejakaa a ha we lɛ blɔ nya nɛ ɔ yaka. Mawu tsɔlɔ ji lɛ; nɛ nihi nɛ peeɔ yayami ɔ, e kɛ mi mi la gblaa a tue ngɛ Mawu nane mi. 5Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, e sa kaa nyɛɛ ba nyɛ he si ha nɔ yeli; pi kaa nyɛ tue kɛkɛ nɛ Mawu maa gbla ke nyɛ pee we ja, se nyɛ he nile hu maa bu nyɛ fɔ.
6 Enɛ ɔ he je nɛ nyɛ woɔ tó ɔ nɛ. Ejakaa nɔ yeli ɔmɛ ɔ, Mawu tsɔli ji mɛ; nɛ ní tsumi pɔtɛɛ nɛ a tsuɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. 7Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, bɔ nɛ ji nɔ tsuaa nɔ blɔ nya a, nyɛɛ pee ha lɛ. Ma tó nɛ sa kaa nyɛɛ wo ɔ, nyɛɛ wo; tó nɛ a heɔ ngɛ weto ní he jio, nyɛɛ wo; nihi nɛ sa he si bami ɔ, nyɛɛ ba he si ha mɛ; nɛ nyɛɛ bu nihi nɛ sa bu.
Bɔ nɛ sa kaa nyɛmimɛ kɛ a sibi nɛ hi si
8Nyɛ ko hɛɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko hiɔ. Hiɔ pɛ nɛ sa nɛ nyɛɛ hɛɛ nyɛ sibi ji suɔmi nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ maa suɔ nyɛ he. Ke nɔ ko suɔ e nyɛmi ɔ, kɛkɛ pe e ye mlaa a tsuo nɔ ji lɔ ɔ nɛ. 9 Mlaa a nɛ deɔ ke, “Koo bɔ ajuama; koo gbe nɔmlɔ; koo ju; o hɛ ko kɔ̃ nɔ́ ko nɔ,” kɛ ekpa komɛ nɛ piɛ he ɔ, lɛ tsuo kpiti pomi ji nɔ́ nɛ deɔ ke, “Suɔ o nyɛmi nɔmlɔ kaa bɔ nɛ o suɔ mo nitsɛ o he” ɔ nɛ. 10Ke o suɔ nɔ ko ɔ, o be lɛ yayami ko yayami ko pee. Ke o suɔ o nyɛmi ɔ, kɛkɛ pe o ye mlaa a tsuo nɔ ɔ nɛ.
11Jehanɛ ɔ, nyɛ le be nɔ nɛ mi nɛ wa ngɛ nɛ ɔ, kaa e sa nɛ nyɛ hɛ nɛ tsɛ kɛ je mahe nɛ nyɛ ngɛ hwɔe ɔ mi. Ejakaa be ɔ nɛ Mawu ma he wa yi wami ɔ, amlɔ nɛ ɔ, e na wɔ haa pe kekleekle nɛ wa he ye ɔ. 12Nyɔ ɔ be ta kulaa, nɛ je mi miɔ nɛ e ma tsɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ ha wa kpa níhi nɛ wa peeɔ ngɛ laami mi ɔ; wa ní peemi ɔmɛ nɛ a kpɛ́ kaa níhi nɛ ta bulɔ kɛ mia. 13Nyɛ ha waa ba wa je mi saminya kaa nihi nɛ ngɛ nyɛɛe piani, se pi kaa nihi nɛ ngɛ diblii mi. Wa ko fiɛ fiɛmi yaya; wa ko de dã; wa ko fiɛ nyumu kɛ yo yakayaka fiɛmi; wa ko tsu mu ní; wa ko pɛ, nɛ wa ko je hunga. 14Nyɛ ha Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu nɛ pee kaa tade nɛ nyɛ wo; nyɛ ko susu he lo nya níhi a he, ke pi ja a, e ma jlo nyɛ kaa nyɛ pee.

Title: ROMA BI 14
Content:
Koo kojo o nyɛmi Kristo se nyɛɛlɔ
1 Nɔ ko nɛ hemi kɛ yemi mi wɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ kɛ lɛ ko sã nya ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ e susuɔ kaa e sa nɛ e pee, kɛ nɔ́ nɛ e ko pee he. Se mohu nyɛ he lɛ atuu kɛ ba nyɛ kpɛti. 2Nɔ nɛ heɔ yeɔ ɔ, e yeɔ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́; se nɔ nɛ hemi kɛ yemi mi wɛ ɔ, lɛɛ pui pɛ e yeɔ. 3Nɔ nɛ yeɔ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ ɔ, e ko gbe nɔ nɛ yi ɔ he guɛ; nɛ nɔ nɛ yeɔ pui pɛ ɔ, e ko kojo nɔ nɛ yeɔ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ ɔ, ejakaa Mawu he lɛ momo. 4Mɛnɔ ji mo nɛ o kojoɔ nɔ kpa tsɔlɔ? Ke tsɔlɔ nɛ ɔ maa ya nɔ, loo e maa gbee si ɔ, lɛ nitsɛ e nyɔmtsɛ ɔ lɛ maa na. Ee, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ma ha nɛ e ya nɔ, ejakaa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ngɛ he wami nɛ haa nɔ yaa nɔ saminya.
5E peeɔ ni komɛ kaa ligbi ɔmɛ ekomɛ a he hia pe ekomɛ, be mi nɛ ni komɛ susuɔ kaa ligbi ɔmɛ tsuo sɔ. Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ pee e juɛmi ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ he. 6Nɔ nɛ susuɔ kaa ligbi komɛ a he hia pe ekomɛ ɔ, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ hɛ mi nyami e ngɛ woe; nɛ nɔ nɛ yeɔ nɔ saisaa a, lɛ hu e ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ hɛ mi nyami woe, ejakaa e naa Mawu si ngɛ he. Nɔ nɛ yi nɔ́ saisaa a, lɛ hu e kɛ woɔ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ hɛ mi nyami, nɛ lɛ hu e naa Mawu si. 7Wa ti nɔ ko nɔ ko hɛ ka we kɛ ha lɛ nitsɛ e he, nɛ́ nɔ ko ma gbo ha lɛ nitsɛ e he. 8Ke wa hɛ ngɛ ɔ, Nyɔmtsɛ wa hɛ ngɛ kɛ ha, nɛ ke wa gbo hu Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ wa gbo kɛ ha. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, wa hɛ ngɛ jio, wa gbo jio, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nihi ji wɔ. 9Ejakaa Kristo gbo, nɛ e kpale ba wami mi ekohu, konɛ e pee Nyɔmtsɛ kɛ ha ni nɛmɛ nɛ a hɛ ngɛ, kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ gbo ɔ tsuo. 10 Lɛɛ mɛni he je moo o kojoɔ o nyɛmi? Aloo pohu mɛni he je nɛ o gbeɔ o nyɛmi he guɛ ɔ? Mawu hɛ mi wɔ tsuo wa maa da si ngɛ nɛ e maa kojo wɔ. 11 Ejakaa ngmami ɔ deɔ ke,
“Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ngɛ kita kae ke
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ ma kpla si ha mi
Nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ ma gba mi ma de paa
ke imi ji Mawu.”
12Lɛɛ wa ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ maa bu lɛ nitsɛ e he akɔtaa ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi.
Ko ha nɛ o nyɛmi Kristo se nyɛɛlɔ nɛ pee yayami
13Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ ha wa kpa wa sibi kojomi; se mohu nyɛ pee saminya nɛ nɔ ko ko pee nɔ́ ko nɛ ma ha o nyɛmi nane ma kpata, aloo nɛ ma ha e pee yayami. 14Nɛ i ngɛ Kristo mi ɔ, i kpá si, nɛ i le kaa niye ní ko niye ní ko be nɛ he tsɔ we. Se ke nɔ ko buu niye ní ko kaa e he tsɔ we ɔ, lɛ nɛ niye ní ɔ he tsɔ we ha. 15Ke o ye niye ní ko, nɛ lɔ ɔ kɛ haomi ba o nyɛmi nɔ ɔ, lɛɛ o sume o nyɛmi ɔ. Ko ha ní nɛ o maa ye ɔ nɛ kpata o nyɛmi nɛ Kristo gbo ngɛ e he ɔ hɛ mi. 16Nɔ́ ko nɛ nyɛ buu nɔ́ kpakpa a, nyɛ ko ha nɛ a tu he munyu yaya. 17Ejakaa Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ, pi nɔ́ nɛ a maa ye, loo nɔ́ nɛ a maa nu; se mohu kaa a pee nɔ́ nɛ da, nɛ a hi si ngɛ he jɔmi mi, nɛ a na bua jɔmi. Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ lɛ haa ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo. 18Ke nɔ ko ngɛ Kristo sɔmɔe ngɛ kikɛmɛ a blɔ nɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ, e ngɛ Mawu suɔmi nya ní pee, nɛ e saa nimli adesahi hu a hɛ mi.
19Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ ha waa di níhi nɛ kɛ he jɔɔmi baa, nɛ waa kɛ maa wo wa sibi he wami ɔ a se daa. 20Ko ya di niye ní se, nɛ o kpata nɔ́ ko nɛ Mawu pee hɛ mi. Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ a yeɔ ɔ, e he tsɔ. Se nɔ́ ko nɛ o maa ye, nɛ ma ha o nyɛmi maa pee yayami ɔ, e sɛ kaa o ye. 21Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e hi kaa o ko ye lo, nɛ o ko nu wai, nɛ jehanɛ hu, o ko pee nɔ́ ko nɛ ma ha o nyɛmi nane ma kpata. 22Bɔ nɛ o heɔ yeɔ ngɛ munyu nɛ ɔ he ɔ, e pee o kɛ Mawu nyɛ kpɛti sane. Ke nɔ ko pee nɔ́ ko nɛ lɛ nitsɛ e le kaa nɔ́ nɛ e pee ɔ da, nɛ e he nile hu bui lɛ fɔ ngɛ he ɔ, e naa bua jɔmi saminya. 23Se ke e yi mi peeɔ lɛ enyɔɔnyɔ ngɛ niye ní ko he nɛ e ye ɔ, Mawu maa bu lɛ fɔ, ejakaa e be hemi kɛ yemi; nɛ nɔ́ ko nɛ o peeɔ nɛ hemi kɛ yemi be mi ɔ, e ji yayami.

Title: ROMA BI 15
Content:
Waa pee níhi nɛ maa sa wa nyɛmimɛ a hɛ mi
1Wɔ nihi nɛ wa hemi kɛ yemi mi wa a, e sa kaa waa ye bua ni nɛmɛ nɛ a hemi kɛ yemi mi wɛ ɔ. Wa ko susu wɔ nitsɛmɛ pɛ wa he. 2Mohu ɔ, wa ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ pee nɔ́ nɛ hi nɛ maa sa e nyɛmi hɛ mi, konɛ e nyɛmi ɔ nɛ na hemi kɛ yemi nɛ pi si. 3 Ejakaa Kristo hu pee we lɛ nitsɛ e suɔmi nya ní; se mohu ngmami ɔ ke, “Níhi nɛ a de kɛ bɔ mo ahlua a, imi mohu ye hɛ mi si a pue.” 4Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ ngmami ɔmɛ a mi ɔ, a ngma konɛ a kɛ tsɔɔ wɔ ní. Kɛkɛ ɔ, ngmami ɔmɛ ma ha wa maa to wa tsui si; nɛ a maa wo wɔ he wami nɛ wa na hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi. 5Mawu ɔ nɛ haa nɔ toɔ e tsui si, nɛ e woɔ nɔ he wami nɛ ha nɛ nyɛ wo Kristo Yesu nane, nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ sibi nɛ hi si saminya. 6Kɛkɛ ɔ, nyɛ tsuo nyɛ maa pee kake, nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ gbi kake nɛ wo Mawu, wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo Tsɛ ɔ hɛ mi nyami.
A ya fiɛ sane kpakpa a ha ma je li ɔmɛ hulɔ
7Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ he nyɛ sibi atuu kaa bɔ nɛ Kristo hu he nyɛ atuu ɔ. Nyɛɛ pee enɛ ɔ, nɛ nyɛ kɛ wo Mawu hɛ mi nyami. 8Ejakaa i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke Kristo ba sɔmɔ Yuda bi ɔmɛ nɛ e kɛ tsɔɔ mɛ kaa Mawu yeɔ anɔkuale, nɛ e kɛ ma si nɛ Mawu wo a nɛmɛ ɔmɛ ɔ nɔ mi. 9 E pee ja, konɛ ma je li ɔmɛ tete nɛ a wo Mawu hɛ mi nyami, ejakaa e na mɛ hu mɔbɔ. Kaa bɔ nɛ ngmami ɔ deɔ ɔ,
“Enɛ ɔ he ɔ, ma je o yi ngɛ ma je li ɔmɛ a kpɛti,
Nɛ ma wo o biɛ ta kɛ la.”
10 Ngmami ɔ kpale deɔ ke, “Nyɛ ma je li, nyɛɛ kɛ Mawu ma a nɛ nya.”
11 Jehanɛ, e deɔ ekohu ke,
“Nyɛ ma je li tsuo, nyɛ je Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ yi;
Je mahi tsuo, nyɛ je e yi wawɛɛ!”
12 Yesaya hu de ke,
“Ishai nina ko maa ba;
E maa te si nɛ e ba ye ma je li ɔmɛ a nɔ,
Nɛ ma je li ɔmɛ maa ngɔ a hɛ ngɔ fɔ e nɔ.”
13Mawu, nɔ nɛ haa nihi tsuo hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi ɔ, e ha nyɛ hyi tɔ kɛ bua jɔmi, kɛ he jɔmi tsuo ngɛ nyɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ nya, konɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ nɛ wo nyɛ he wami, nɛ nyɛɛ ngɔ nyɛ hɛ kɛ fɔ Mawu nɔ daa.
Paulo tsɔɔ nɔ́ he je nɛ e ngma womi kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ
14Ye nyɛmimɛ, imi nitsɛ i le tsɔ kaa nyɛ nitsɛmɛ tete nyɛ mi mi hi; nyɛ le ní bɔ nɛ sa, nɛ nyɛ nyɛɔ woɔ nyɛ sibi ga. 15Se kɛ̃, i ngma womi nɛ ɔ kɛ ngɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ ekomɛ a nɔ ta woe kaa a he hia. I kɛ hɛdɔ ngɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ ngmae kɛ kai nyɛ kaa Mawu dloomi ɔ nya a, 16i ba pee Kristo Yesu tsɔlɔ nɛ ma tsu ma je li ɔmɛ a he ní. Ma tsu ní kaa osɔfo kɛ fiɛ sane kpakpa a nɛ je Mawu ngɔ ɔ, konɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ nɛ tsu ma je li ɔmɛ a he, nɛ a pee kaa bɔ nɛ a sã, nɛ maa sa Mawu hɛ mi. 17Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ma nyɛ ma fĩa ngɛ Kristo Yesu mi kaa i ngɛ Mawu ní tsue. 18Ejakaa i be nɔ́ kpa ko he munyu nyɛe ma tu pe kaa Kristo gu ye munyu tumi, kɛ ní tsumi nɔ nɛ e ha ma je li ɔmɛ ba le Mawu. 19Okadihi, kɛ nyakpɛ níhi nɛ i pee ɔ, Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ lɛ tsu enɛ ɔmɛ tsuo. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ye sikpa a tsuo, kɛ je Yerusalem hluu kɛ ya su Ilirikum ɔ, sane kpakpa a nɛ kɔɔ Kristo he ɔ sɔuu i fiɛ. 20Nɔ́ pɔtɛɛ nɛ i kɛ ma ye hɛ mi ji kaa he nɛ a fiɛ we sane kpakpa a nɛ kɔɔ Kristo he ɔ ngɛ lolo ɔ, ma ya fiɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Kɛkɛ ɔ, nihi be dee ke i ngɛ tsu fiae kɛ ngɛ nɔ kpa sisi tomi nɔ mae. 21 Kaa bɔ nɛ ngmami ɔ deɔ ɔ,
“Nihi nɛ a jaje we e he sane ko kɛ tsɔɔ we mɛ hyɛ ɔ
maa na lɛ;
Nɛ nihi nɛ nui e he hyɛ ɔ
maa nu sisi.”
Paulo to kaa e maa ya Roma
22 I ka si abɔ kaa ma ba nyɛ ngɔ, se enɛ ɔ he ɔ, i nyɛ we. 23Se amlɔ nɛ ɔ nɛ i be nɔ́ ko peemi ngɛ hiɛ ɔ ni ɔmɛ a mi hu nɛ ɔ, ma ba su nyɛ ngɔ kaa bɔ nɛ i hla nɛ ma pee be babauu ji nɛ ɔ. 24I heɔ yeɔ kaa ke kaa ma be kɛ ya Spania, ma ba gba nyɛ ngɔ nɛ i kɛ nyɛ nɛ hi si be bɔɔ, konɛ lɔ ɔ se ɔ, nyɛ ya je mi blɔ kɛ ho. 25 Amlɔ nɛ ɔ lɛɛ i pue nɔ kɛ yaa Yerusalem nɛ ma ngɔ nike ní kɛ ya ha ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. 26Ejakaa nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ Makedonia, kɛ Akaya a kɛ bua jɔmi bua nɔ́ ko nya nɛ a kɛ ya ye bua ohiatsɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ a kpɛti ngɛ Yerusalem ɔ. 27 Mɛ nitsɛmɛ lɛ a to kaa a maa pee enɛ ɔ lɛɛ, se anɔkuale mi ɔ, a blɔ nya ní tsumi ji kaa a ye bua mɛ. Mumi mi nike ní nɛ Mawu ha Yuda bi ɔmɛ ɔ, a kɛ ma je li ɔmɛ nɛ dla; enɛ ɔ he ɔ, e sa kaa ma je li ɔmɛ hu, he lo mi ní kpakpahi nɛ Mawu ke mɛ ɔ, a kɛ eko nɛ sɔmɔ Yuda bi ɔmɛ. 28Ke i ngɔ nike ní tsuo nɛ a bua nya a ya su mɛ ɔ, ma pue blɔ kɛ ba gu nyɛ ngɔ kɛ ho Spania ya. 29I le kaa ke i ba nyɛ ngɔ ɔ, Kristo maa gbaa nyɛ babauu.
30Ye nyɛmimɛ, i ngɔ Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo, kɛ suɔmi nɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ haa nɔ ɔ kɛ ngɛ nyɛ pɛɛ kpae nɛ nyɛɛ piɛ ye he kɛ sɔle wawɛɛ nɛ Mawu nɛ ye bua mi. 31Nyɛɛ sɔle konɛ nihi nɛ ngɛ Yudea nɛ he we Mawu yi ɔ nɛ a ko doo ye nya, nɛ jehanɛ hu, ní nɛ i yaa tsu ngɛ Yerusalem ɔ nɛ sa ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ a hɛ mi. 32Kɛkɛ ɔ, ke Mawu suɔ ɔ, i kɛ bua jɔmi maa ba nyɛ ngɔ nɛ ma ba jɔɔ ye he bɔɔ. 33He jɔmi Mawu ɔ kɛ nyɛ tsuo nɛ hi si. Amen!

Title: ROMA BI 16
Content:
Paulo ke e biɔ nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ
1Wa nyɛmiyo Foibe nɛ sɔmɔɔ ngɛ Kenkrea asafo ɔ mi ɔ, ma suɔ nɛ ma wo e ta kɛ je e yi. 2Nyɛ he lɛ hɛmuɔ ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ biɛ mi bɔ nɛ sa ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ. Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ he maa hia lɛ ɔ, nyɛ ha lɛ, ejakaa e pee kpakpa ha nihi babauu, kɛ imi nitsɛ hulɔ.
3 I biɔ Priskila kɛ Akuila, nyɛmimɛ nɛ i kɛ mɛ tsuɔ ní ha Yesu Kristo ɔ. 4Ye he ɔ, e piɛ nguɛ nya nɛ a sake a he lo ngɔ fɔ he. I ngɛ mɛ si nae saminya; ee, pi imi kɛkɛ, se ma je li ɔmɛ asafo ɔmɛ tsuo ngɛ mɛ si nae. 5I biɔ asafo ɔ nɛ kpeɔ ngɛ a we ɔ mi ɔ hulɔ.
I biɔ Epeneto, kekleekle nɔ nɛ he Kristo ye ngɛ Asia a; ye huɛ saminya ji lɛ. 6I biɔ Maria; lɛ hu e gbo nyɛ he dengme wawɛɛ nitsɛ. 7I biɔ Androniko kɛ Yunia, ye nyɛmimɛ Yuda bi nɛ a wo i kɛ mɛ tsuo tsu ɔ. A he biɛ saminya ngɛ bɔfo ɔmɛ a kpɛti; nɛ a sɛ ye hlami ngɛ Kristo mi.
8I biɔ Ampliato nɛ i suɔ lɛ saminya ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ mi ɔ. 9I biɔ Urbano nɛ waa kɛ lɛ tsuo tsuɔ ní ha Kristo ɔ, kɛ jehanɛ hu ye huɛ Staki nɛ i suɔ lɛ saminya a. 10I biɔ Apele; a yeɔ e he odase kaa e sɔmɔɔ Kristo saminya. I biɔ Aristobulo weku ɔ hulɔ. 11I biɔ Herodion, ye nyɛmi Yuda no ɔ, kɛ nyɛmimɛ Kristo we bi nɛ je Narkiso weku ɔ mi ɔ.
12I biɔ Trifaina kɛ Trifosa nɛ a tsuɔ ní ha Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ. I biɔ Persi, ye huɛ nɛ i suɔ lɛ saminya a; lɛ hu e tsu ní wawɛɛ kɛ sɔmɔ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ. 13 I biɔ Rufo, nɔ nɛ je e he si kaa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ní tsulɔ kpanaa a, kɛ e nyɛ ɔ nɛ ngɔ imi hu kaa e bi ɔ. 14I biɔ Asinkrito, Felgon, Herma, Patroba, Herme, kɛ nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ a kɛ mɛ ngɛ ɔ. 15I biɔ Filologo, kɛ Yulia, kɛ Nerea, kɛ e nyɛmiyo ɔ, kɛ Olimpas, kɛ ní klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ a kɛ mɛ ngɛ ɔ.
16Nyɛɛ fua nyɛ sibi kɛ nga nyɛ he. Kristo asafo tsuo biɔ nyɛ.
Nyagbe munyu
17Ye nyɛmimɛ, i kpa nyɛ pɛɛ, nihi nɛ teɔ si kɛ siɔ níhi nɛ wa tsɔɔ nyɛ, nɛ a ngɛ nyɛ tue puɛe, nɛ a kɛ mi gbami ngɛ asafo ɔ mi bae ɔ, nyɛ hɛ nɛ hi nyɛ he ngɛ a he, nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ mɛ ko bɔ. 18Ejakaa nimli kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ, pi Kristo, wa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nɛ a ngɛ sɔmɔe. Se mɛ nitsɛmɛ a muklii mohu he mɔde nɛ a ngɛ bɔe. A kɛ munyu dɔkɔɔ gbeɔ nihi nɛ a juɛmi se ti we ɔ a yi mi, nɛ a sisiɔ mɛ. 19A nu nyɛ he ngɛ he tsuaa he kaa nyɛ pɛtɛ sane kpakpa a he wawɛɛ; nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ha nɛ i na nyɛ he bua jɔmi saminya. I suɔ kaa nyɛɛ le kpakpa, nɛ nyɛɛ pee; se yayami blɔ fa mi lɛɛ a ko nu nyɛ he kulaa. 20E be kɛe kulaa nɛ he jɔmi Mawu ɔ ma kpata Abosiami hɛ mi, nɛ wa maa ye e nɔ.
Wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo dloomi ɔ kɛ nyɛ nɛ hi si.
21 Timoteo nɛ i kɛ lɛ ngɛ ní tsumi kake tsue ɔ ke e biɔ nyɛ. Ye nyɛmimɛ Yuda bi, Lukio, Yason, kɛ Sosipatre hu ke a biɔ nyɛ.
22Imi Tertio nɛ i ngma ní nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, i biɔ nyɛ ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ biɛ mi.
23 Gayo, ye wetsɛ ɔ hu ke e biɔ nyɛ. E we mi nɛ asafo ɔ tsuo kpee ngɛ. Erasto, ma sika tolɔ ɔ, kɛ wa nyɛmi Kuato hu ke a biɔ nyɛ.
[ 24Wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo dloomi ɔ kɛ nyɛ tsuo kulaa nɛ hi si! Amen!]
Nyagbe yi jemi sɔlemi
25Nyɛ ha wa je Mawu yi. Lɛ nɛ e ma ha nyɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ mi maa wa ngɛ Yesu Kristo he sane kpakpa a nɛ i fiɛ ha nyɛ ɔ mi. Kɛ je blema lokoo ɔ, nɔ ko nɔ ko li anɔkuale nɛ ɔ. 26Se amlɔ nɛ ɔ lɛɛ níhi nɛ gbali ɔmɛ ngma a ha nihi babauu ba na anɔkuale ɔ paa kaa bɔ nɛ neneene Mawu ɔ nitsɛ to nɛ a fiɛ ha je mahi tsuo, konɛ a he Mawu ye, nɛ a bu lɛ tue ɔ.
27A je Mawu kake too ɔ nɛ le ní tsuo ɔ yi ngɛ Yesu Kristo mi kɛ ya neneene. Amen!

Title: KORINTO BI I, NYA TSƆƆMI
Content:
NYA TSƆƆMI
Paulo Kekleekle Womi Kɛ Ha Korinto Bi tsɔɔ kaa nyagba komɛ nɛ kɔɔ Kristo we bi a je mi bami, kɛ hemi kɛ yemi he ba te si ngɛ asafo ɔ mi. Paulo nɛ to Korinto asafo ɔ sisi, nɛ e ngma womi nɛ ɔ konɛ e kɛ tsɔɔ mɛ níhi a nya. Jamɛ a be ɔ, Hela bi a ma nguaa Korinto kɛ e mi nimli munomunohi ɔ ji Akaya zugba a nɛ Roma bi ɔmɛ ngɛ nɔ yee ɔ e matsɛ ma. Korinto ma a he biɛ wawɛɛ ngɛ jua yemi, kusumi peemi, yo kɛ nyumu yakayaka fiɛmi, kɛ jami slɔɔtohi a mi.
Níhi titli nɛ bɔfo ɔ tu he munyu ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ mi ji mi gbami, yo kɛ nyumu yakayaka fiɛmi, nyumu kɛ yo bɔmi ngɛ gba si himi mi, níhi nɛ kɔɔ he níle he, asafo blɔ nya tomi kpakpa, Mumi Klɔuklɔu nike níhi, kɛ ni gbogboehi a si temi. Paulo ngɔ juɛmi nɛ mi kuɔ kɛ tsɔɔ bɔ nɛ sane kpakpa a tuɔ ní nɛ ɔmɛ a he munyu ha.
Yi 13 ɔ tsɔɔ kaa nike ní nɛ he jua wa pe nike ní ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ Mawu kɛ haa e we bi ɔ ji suɔmi; nɛ e peeɔ kaa yi nɛ ɔ ji munyu nɛ nihi le pe kulaa ngɛ womi ɔ mi.
Bɔ nɛ a dla womi ɔ mi ha
Sisije 1.1-9
Mi gbamihi ngɛ asafo ɔ mi 1.10—4.21
Yo kɛ nyumu a bɔmi, kɛ gba si himi 5.1—7.40
Kristo we bi, kɛ wɔ jali 8.1—11.1
Asafo ɔ mi si himi, kɛ Mawu jami 11.2—14.40
Kristo, kɛ nihi nɛ heɔ lɛ yeɔ ɔ a si temi 15.1-58
Nike ní nɛ a kɛ ya ha nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ Yudea 16.1-4
Paulo nitsɛ e he sane komɛ, kɛ nyagbe níhi 16.5-24

Title: KORINTO BI I, 1
Content:
1Imi Paulo, nɛ Mawu suɔmi nya a, e tsɛ mi nɛ ma ba pee Yesu Kristo bɔfo ɔ, i kɛ wa nyɛmi Sostene lɛ wa ngma womi nɛ ɔ.
2 Wa ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ ngmae kɛ yaa ha Mawu we asafo nɛ ngɛ Korinto ɔ, nihi nɛ a tsu a he, nɛ a pee mɛ klɔuklɔu ha Yesu Kristo, kɛ nihi nɛ ngɛ he tsuaa he, nɛ a jaa Kristo Yesu, wa Nyɔmtsɛ, kɛ mɛ hu a Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ. 3Dloomi kɛ he jɔmi nɛ je wa Tsɛ Mawu ɔ, kɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo dɛ mi ɔ ha nyɛ.
Gbaami ngɛ Kristo mi
4I naa Mawu si daa kɛ haa nyɛ ngɛ dloomi nɛ e ngɔ ha nyɛ kɛ gu Kristo Yesu nɔ ɔ he. 5Ejakaa nyɛ ya hɛ mi ngɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ mi, munyu tumi jio, nile jio. 6Kristo he odase nɛ nyɛ ngɛ yee ɔ ba he si wawɛɛ nɛ nihi na. 7Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, be mi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo bami ɔ blɔ hyɛe nɛ ɔ, mumi mi nike ní ko kulaa be nyɛ hiae. 8Mawu nitsɛ maa hɛɛ nyɛ kɛ maa ya nyagbe, konɛ ligbi ɔ nɛ wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo maa ba a, piami ko piami ko kó hi nyɛ he. 9Mawu, nɔ nɛ kpee nyɛ ke nyɛɛ kɛ e Bi Yesu Kristo, wa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ba bɔ huɛ ɔ, anɔkualetsɛ ji lɛ.
Mi gbami ngɛ asafo ɔ mi
10Nyɛmimɛ, i ngɛ nyɛ pɛɛ kpae ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo biɛ mi kaa nyɛ tsuo nyɛ nya nɛ pee kake, nɛ mi gbami kó ba nyɛ kpɛti. Nyɛ yi mi, kɛ nyɛ juɛmi nɛ pee kake. 11Ye nyɛmimɛ, i ngɛ nyɛ enɛ ɔ dee, ejakaa ni komɛ je Kloe we ɔ mi ba wo ye tue nɔ ke pɛ ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti. 12 Nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ tsɔɔe ji, nyɛ ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ ngɛ nɔ́ ko nɛ e ngɛ dee. Nɔ ko ke, “Paulo nɔ́ ji mi”, nɛ nɔ ko hu ke, “Imi lɛɛ Apolo nɔ́ ji mi”; nɔ kpa ke, “Imi lɛɛ Kefa nɔ́ ji mi”; nɛ nɔ kpa hu ke, “Oo, imi lɛɛ Kristo nitsɛ se nyɛɛlɔ ji mi.” 13Anɛ a gba Kristo mi lo? Anɛ Paulo nɛ a sɛu ha nyɛ lo? Anɛ Paulo biɛ mi a sɔle nyɛ kɛ wo lo?
14 I naa Mawu si kaa i sɔle we nɔ ko nɔ ko kaa ja Krispo kɛ Gayo pɛ. 15Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ ko be nyɛe ma de ke a sɔle nyɛ kɛ wo ye biɛ mi. 16 Niinɛ, i sɔle Stefana kɛ e we mi bi ɔmɛ hulɔ. Se i kaii we kaa i pa sɔle nɔ kpa ko hu. 17Kristo tsɔ we mi ke ma ba sɔle nihi. E tsɔ mi ke ma ba fiɛ sane kpakpa a; pi kɛ nya mi dɔkɔɔ, kɛ adesa nile, konɛ gbenɔ nɛ Kristo gbo ngɛ sɛumi tso ɔ nɔ ɔ kó pee yaka.
Kristo ji Mawu he wami, kɛ e nile
18Ejakaa nihi nɛ a hɛ mi miɔ nɛ e ma kpata a, buɔ sɛ gbi ɔ nɛ kɔɔ sɛumi tso ɔ he ɔ kaa kuasiahi a sane ko kɛkɛ. Se wɔ nɛ a ngɛ wa yi wami hee ɔ, wɔɔ lɛɛ e ji Mawu he wami ha wɔ. 19 Ngmami ɔ ke,
“Ma ha nɛ ní leli a nile ma puɛ, nɛ ga leli a ga tsuo maa pee yaka.” 20 Jije ní leli ɔmɛ ngɛ? Jije ga leli ɔmɛ ngɛ? Jije je nɛ ɔ mi sane mi hlali ɔmɛ ngɛ? Ee, Mawu ha nɛ je nɛ ɔ mi nile ɔ plɛ pee kuasiahi a sane.
21Mawu ngɔ e nile ɔ kɛ tsi adesa blɔ, konɛ adesa kó nyɛ nɛ e gu lɛɛ e ní lemi nɔ kɛ le Mawu. Se mohu ɔ, sɛ gbi ɔ nɛ wa ngɛ fiɛe nɛ nihi buu kaa kuasiahi a sane ɔ, Mawu to kaa e kɛ ma he ni nɛmɛ nɛ heɔ yeɔ ɔ a yi wami. 22Yuda bi hlaa kaa a pee okadi ha mɛ nɛ a na loko a he sɛ gbi ɔ nɛ a ye. Hela bi hu hlaa kaa a maa nu nile munyu ko ngɛ mi lo. 23Se wɔɔ lɛɛ Kristo nɛ a sɛu ɔ wa ngɛ fiɛe. Enɛ ɔ peeɔ blɔ tsimi nɔ ha Yuda bi, nɛ Hela bi hu buu lɛ kaa kuasiahi a sane. 24Ee, nihi nɛ Mawu hla a, Yuda bi jio, Hela bi jio, mɛɛ a le kaa Kristo ji Mawu he wami, kɛ e nile. 25Ejakaa ke Mawu je kuasia tete po, adesa kɛ e nile nɛ nya wa a na we lɛ; ke Mawu gbɔjɔ tete po, adesa kɛ e he wami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ na we lɛ saasaa.
26Ye nyɛmimɛ, nyɛ kai bɔ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ ha loko Mawu tsɛ nyɛ ɔ. Ngɛ he lo blɔ fa mi ɔ, nyɛ ti nihi bɔɔ pɛ ji ní leli, nihi bɔɔ pɛ ji nihi nɛ a he wa, nɛ bɔɔ pɛ ji odehehi. 27Mawu je blɔ hla je ɔ mi kuasia níhi, konɛ e kɛ gbe ní leli zo. Mawu hla je ɔ mi níhi nɛ gbɔjɔ, konɛ e kɛ gbe níhi nɛ a he wa a zo. 28E hla níhi nɛ je ɔ bui, níhi nɛ a hiee, kɛ níhi nɛ pi nɔ́ ko kulaa a, konɛ e kɛ gbe níhi nɛ je ɔ buu saminya a a he guɛ. 29E pee enɛ ɔ, konɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko kó fĩa ngɛ e hɛ mi. 30Se Mawu ngɔ nyɛ kɛ ba, konɛ nyɛɛ kɛ Kristo Yesu ba bɔ. E ha nɛ Kristo ba pee wa nile. Kɛ gu Kristo nɔ ɔ, Mawu pee wɔ nihi nɛ da. Wa ba plɛ pee e ma klɔuklɔu, nɛ a he wa yi wami. 31 Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, kaa bɔ nɛ ngmami ɔ deɔ ɔ, “Nɔ nɛ suɔ kaa e maa fĩa a, e fĩa ngɔ fɔ nɔ́ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ pee ɔ nɔ.”

Title: KORINTO BI I, 2
Content:
Sɛ gbi nɛ kɔɔ Kristo nɛ a sɛu ɔ he
1Ye nyɛmimɛ, benɛ i ba slaa nyɛ, nɛ i kɛ Mawu laami sane ɔ ba ha nyɛ ɔ, i fiɛ we kɛ nya mi ngɔngɔɛ, loo nile. 2Ejakaa benɛ i kɛ nyɛ ngɛ ɔ, i to ye yi mi kaa i be nɔ́ kpa ko tsɔɔe pe sane ɔ nɛ kɔɔ Yesu Kristo, kɛ e sɛumi ɔ he ɔ. 3 Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, be mi nɛ i ba nyɛ ngɔ ɔ, ye nɔmlɔ tso ɔ gbɔjɔ, nɛ sawale ha nɛ ye he ngɛ doe blibliibli. 4Ní nɛ i tsɔɔ, kɛ sɛ gbi nɛ i fiɛ ɔ hu, pi nile munyu nɛ plɛɔ nɔ yi mi nɛ i tu. Se mohu Mawu Mumi ɔ, kɛ he wami ɔ lɛ tsu ní nɛ ɔ, 5bɔ nɛ pee nɛ nyɛ ko ngɔ nyɛ hemi kɛ yemi ngɔ fɔ adesa nile nɔ, se mohu Mawu he wami nɔ.
Mawu nile
6Se ni nɛmɛ nɛ wa ngɛ mumi mi ɔ, i fiɛɔ nile sɛ gbi ko kɛ̃ kɛ haa mɛ; pi nile nɛ adesa tsɔɔ, nɛ pi je nɛ ɔ mi nɔ yeli a nɔ́. Mɛɛ lɛɛ a maa be kɛ ho. 7Nile nɛ i ngɛ fiɛe ɔ ji nyakpɛ nɔ́ ko nɛ Mawu ngɔ kɛ laa adesa. Loko a bɔ je ɔ, Mawu hla nile nɛ ɔ ngɔ to momo nɛ e kɛ wo wa hɛ mi nyami. 8Je nɛ ɔ mi nɔ yeli ɔmɛ a ti nɔ ko nɔ ko li nile nɛ ɔ, a le jinɛ a ko sɛu we Nyɔmtsɛ Mawu nɛ hɛ mi ngɛ nyami ɔ. 9 Se, kaa bɔ nɛ a ngma a,
“Nɔ́ nɛ hɛngmɛ nɛ́ hyɛ,
Nɔ́ nɛ tue nui hyɛ,
Nɔ́ nɛ adesa ko juɛmi sui he ɔ,
Lɔ ɔ nɔuu Mawu dla ngɔ to
nihi nɛ suɔ lɛ.”
10Se wɔɔ lɛɛ Mawu gu e mumi ɔ nɔ je laami sane ɔ kpo ngɔ tsɔɔ wɔ. Mumi ɔ hlaa níhi tsuo a mi; Mawu juɛmi nɛ mi kuɔ ɔ tete po, e hlaa mi. 11Adesa nitsɛ e mumi nɛ ngɛ e mi ɔ pɛ lɛ le bɔ nɛ lɛ adesa a ngɛ ha. Jã kɛ̃, Mawu mumi ɔ pɛ lɛ le bɔ nɛ Mawu ngɛ ha. 12Wɔɔ lɛɛ pi je nɛ ɔ mi mumi ɔ nɛ wa ná, se mohu mumi nɛ je Mawu ngɔ ɔ, konɛ waa le níhi nɛ Mawu kɛ dloo wɔ ɔ tsuo.
13Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nihi nɛ mumi ɔ ngɛ a mi ɔ, ke waa kɛ mɛ ngɛ mumi mi níhi a he ní sɛɛe ɔ, munyu nɛ mumi ɔ tsɔɔ wɔ ɔ, lɔ ɔ wa tuɔ; wa tu we adesa nile munyu. 14Nɔ nɛ be mumi ɔ na we Mawu mumi ɔ nike níhi. Nɔmlɔ kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ nui mumi ɔ nike níhi a sisi saminya. Enɛ ɔmɛ peeɔ kuasiahi a sane kɛ haa lɛ; ejakaa ni nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, mumi mi hɛngmɛ a kɛ naa. 15Nɔmlɔ nɛ mumi ɔ ngɛ e mi ɔ naa nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ kaa bɔ nɛ e ngɛ anɔkuale mi ɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ; se lɛɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko li lɛ kɛ pi si. 16 Kaa bɔ nɛ a ngma a,
“Mɛnɔ lɛ le Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ juɛmi,
nɛ e maa wo lɛ ga?”
Wɔɔ lɛɛ bɔ nɛ Kristo susuu e yi mi ɔ, jã wɔ hu wa susuu wa yi mi.

Title: KORINTO BI I, 3
Content:
Mawu sɔmɔli
1Nyɛmimɛ, anɔkuale mi ɔ, i nyɛ we nɛ i kɛ nyɛ nɛ tu munyu kaa bɔ nɛ i kɛ nihi nɛ mumi ɔ ngɛ a mi ɔ tuɔ munyu. Se mohu, i kɛ nyɛ tu munyu kaa je mi bi, aloo bimwɔwi ngɛ Kristo jami mi. 2 I ha nyɛ nyɔ nyu, se pi niye ní nɛ jiɔ; ejakaa jamɛ a be ɔ, nyɛ nyɛ we nɛ nyɛɛ ye niye ní nɛ jiɔ. Amlɔ nɛ ɔ tete po nyɛ nyɛ we kɛ mwɔɔ. 3Nyɛ ngɛ he lo nya kɛ mwɔɔ, ejakaa nɔ́ nɛ je mi bi peeɔ ɔ, lɔ ɔ nyɛ hu nyɛ peeɔ. Be abɔ nɛ hunga jemi, kɛ pɛ ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti kɛ mwɔɔ ɔ, anɛ enɛ ɔ tsɔɔ we kaa je mi bi ji nyɛ lo? Nɔ́ nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ peeɔ ɔ, anɛ pi lɔ ɔ nɔuu nɛ nyɛ hu nyɛ ngɛ pee ɔ lo? 4 Ke nɔ ko ke, “Paulo nɔ ji mi”, nɛ nɔ ko hu ke, “Imi lɛɛ Apolo nɔ ji mi” ɔ, anɛ pi nɔ́ nɛ je mi bi peeɔ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ pee nɛ ɔ?
5Mɛnɔ ji Apolo ɔ? Imi Paulo hu, mɛnɔ ji mi? Mawu tsɔli kɛkɛ ji wɔ, nɛ wa nɔ lɛ nyɛ gu kɛ he Kristo ye. Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ha wa ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ ní tsumi pɔtɛɛ nɛ wa tsu. 6 Imi lɛ i ba ma tso ɔ. Apolo ba pue nɔ nyu, se Mawu lɛ ha nɛ tso ɔ wa. 7Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ nɛ duɔ tso, kɛ nɔ nɛ pueɔ nɔ nyu ɔ, a he hia we kulaa. Mawu ji nɔ nɛ he hia, ejakaa lɛ nɛ haa nɛ tso ɔ waa. 8Nɔ nɛ duɔ tso, kɛ nɔ nɛ pueɔ nɔ nyu ɔ, slɔɔto be a kpɛti; Mawu maa wo a ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ hiɔ kpakpa ngɛ ní tsumi nɛ e tsu ɔ he. 9Wɔɔ lɛɛ Mawu tsɔli nɛ pee kake kɛ ngɛ ní tsue ji wɔ. Nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ ngɛ kaa ngmɔ nɛ Mawu ngɛ ní tsue ngɛ mi. Nyɛ ngɛ kaa tsu nɛ Mawu ngɛ fiae. 10I ngɔ Mawu dloomi nɛ e ha mi ɔ, nɛ i kɛ to tsu ɔ sisi kaa tsu fialɔ kpanaa nɛ le ga tsuɔ ní; nɛ nɔ kpa ba ngɛ nɔ fiae. Se e hia kaa nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ hyɛ kaa e ngɛ tsu ɔ fiae saminya ngɛ sisi tomi ɔ nɔ lo. 11Ejakaa Mawu ngɔ Yesu Kristo ngɔ to momo kaa sisi tomi, nɛ nɔ ko be nyɛe maa to sisi kpa ko hu. 12Ni komɛ maa ngɔ sika tsu, loo sika hiɔ, loo tɛ nɛ he jua wa kɛ fia sisi tomi ɔ nɔ; ni komɛ hu maa ngɔ tso, loo gla, loo nga kɛ pee. 13Se ligbi ɔ nɛ Kristo maa ba a, nɔ tsuaa nɔ ní nɛ e tsu ɔ maa je kpo paa. Ejakaa jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, a kɛ la ma je nɔ tsuaa nɔ ní tsumi kpo. La a maa tsɔɔ bɔ nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ ní tsumi ngɛ ha. 14Ke nɔ ko fia tsu ngɔ fɔ sisi tomi ɔ nɔ, nɛ la sa he, se tsu ɔ daa si kɛ mwɔɔ ɔ, tsu fialɔ ɔ ma na hiɔwo kpakpa. 15Ke nɔ ɔ tsu ɔ sã a, nɔ́ laa lɛ; se lɛ nitsɛ lɛɛ a ma he e yi wami kaa nɔ ko nɛ a gbla lɛ kɛ je la mi.
16 Anɛ nyɛ li kaa Mawu sɔlemi we ji nyɛ, nɛ Mawu mumi ɔ ngɛ nyɛ mi lo? 17Ke nɔ ko puɛ Mawu sɔlemi we ɔ, Mawu ma kpata e hɛ mi. Ejakaa Mawu sɔlemi we ɔ ngɛ klɔuklɔu, nɛ nyɛ ji sɔlemi we ɔ nɛ.
18Nyɛ ti nɔ ko nɔ ko kó sisi e he. Ke nyɛ ti nɔ ko susuu kaa lɛɛ e le ní pe nɔ tsuaa nɔ ɔ, é pee e he kuasia. Kɛkɛ ɔ, e maa pee ní lelɔ nitsɛnitsɛ. 19 Ejakaa nɔ́ nɛ je ɔ buu kaa nile ɔ ji kuasia nɔ́ ko ngɛ Mawu lɛɛ e hɛ mi. Ngmami ɔ ke, “Mawu ngɔɔ nile kɛ tsɔɔ ní leli klama.” 20 Ngmami ɔ kpa hu ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ le kaa ní leli a yi mi tomi peeɔ yaka.” 21Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ ko nɔ ko kó fĩa ngɔ fɔ adesa ko nɔ, ejakaa mɛ tsuo a ngɛ ha nyɛ; 22Paulo jio, Apolo jio, Petro jio, je nɛ ɔ jio, wami jio, gbenɔ jio, amlɔ nɛ ɔ jio, hwɔɔ se jio, ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ngɛ ha nyɛ. 23Nyɛ hu Kristo níhi ji nyɛ, nɛ Kristo ɔ, Mawu nɔ ji lɛ.

Title: KORINTO BI I, 4
Content:
Kristo bɔfohi
1Nyɛɛ bu wɔ kaa Kristo tsɔli nɛ Mawu ngɔ laami sɛ gbi ɔ ngɔ ha wɔ ke waa fiɛ. 2Nɔ́ nɛ a ngɛ hlae ngɛ tsɔli kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ a dɛ ji kaa a ye anɔkuale ha a nyɔmtsɛ ɔ. 3Imi lɛɛ nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ, aloo ni kpahi susuɔ ngɛ ye he ɔ hɛwi mi; imi nitsɛ po, i kojo we ye he. 4Ye he nile tete bui mi fɔ, se enɛ ɔ tsɔɔ we kaa lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i yeɔ nguɔ. Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ji nɔ nɛ kojoɔ mi. 5Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ ko kojo nɔ ko loko be ɔ nɛ su. Nyɛɛ mlɛ kɛ yaa si Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ maa ba. Ke e ba a, e ma je diblii mi níhi, kɛ tsui mi ní yayahi nɛ a kɛ laa a tsuo kpo. Jamɛ a be ɔ, nɔ tsuaa nɔ ma na yi jemi nɛ sa lɛ ɔ kɛ je Mawu dɛ mi.
6Ye nyɛmimɛ, nyɛ he ɔ, i ngɔ imi, kɛ Apolo ngɔ pee nɔ hyɛmi nɔ́ ha nyɛ, konɛ nyɛɛ kase wɔ, nɛ nyɛ ko je nɔ́ nɛ a ngma a se ya pee nɔ́ kpa ko. Nyɛ ti nɔ ko nɔ ko kó wó e he nɔ; nɔ ko kó bu nɔ ko nɔmlɔ ngua pe nɔ ko. 7Mɛnɔ lɛ pee mo slɔɔto pe ni kpahi? Mɛni ngɛ o dɛ nɛ pi Mawu nɛ ha mo? Ke Mawu lɛ ha mo ɔ, lɛɛ mɛni he je mɔ nɛ o fĩaa kaa nɔ́ nɛ pi nɛ a kɛ ke mo ɔ?
8Tse nyɛ ná nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ hia nyɛ! Tse nyɛ ná ní momo! Nyɛ ngɛ matsɛ yee, be mi nɛ wɔɔ lɛɛ wa be nɔ́ ko mi; pi jã? I na nɛ nyɛ ngɛ matsɛ yee niinɛ, konɛ waa piɛ nyɛ he kɛ ye. 9Ejakaa e peeɔ mi kaa Mawu ngɔ wɔ bɔfo ɔmɛ ngɔ pee sekpɛli. Wa ngɛ kaa nihi nɛ a bu mɛ gbenɔ fɔ, konɛ a gbe mɛ ngɛ ma hɛ mi, nɛ je ɔ, hiɔwe bɔfohi, kɛ adesahi tsuo nɛ na mɛ. 10Kristo he ɔ, wa plɛ kuasiahi, se nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ ba pee ní leli! Wa gbɔjɔ, se nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ he mi ba wa nyɛ! Nyɛ hɛ mi ba nyami, se wɔɔ lɛɛ wa hɛ mi pue si. 11Kɛ ba si amlɔ nɛ ɔ tete po hwɔ kɛ kuma yee wɔ; wa heha níhi híaa ngɛ wa he; a kongoɔ wɔ, nɛ wa hii kpae kɛ hii bee. 12 Waa kɛ wa nine nguɛ nyɔngma tsuɔ ní. Ke nihi ngɛ wɔ jɛe ɔ, wɔɔ lɛɛ wa gbaa mɛ; ke a ngɛ wɔ yi mi wae ɔ, wa toɔ wa tsui si. 13Ke a ngɛ wa biɛ puɛe ɔ, wa bɔɔ mɔde kaa wɔɔ lɛɛ wa maa tu he jɔmi munyu. Je ɔ buu wɔ kaa kuku kɛ ba si mwɔnɛ ɔ.
14I ngmɛ́ nyɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ ma kɛ pue nyɛ hɛ mi si, se mohu nɛ ma kɛ tu munyu kɛ tsɔɔ nyɛ kaa imi nitsɛ ye bimɛ nɛ i suɔ. 15Nyɛ ngɛ nihi akpeakpe nɛ a ngɛ nyɛ nɔ hyɛe mohu, se nɛ nyɛ ba le Kristo ɔ, tsɛ kake pɛ lɛ nyɛ ngɛ. Ejakaa kɛ gu sane kpakpa a nɛ i ngɔ ba ha nyɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ, nyɛɛ kɛ Yesu Kristo ba bɔni bɔmi, nɛ i ba pee nyɛ tsɛ. 16 Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i kpa nyɛ pɛɛ nɛ nyɛ wo ye nane. 17I ngɛ Timoteo nyɛ ngɔ tsɔe ngɛ enɛ ɔ he. E ngɛ kaa imi nitsɛ ye bi fɔfɔɛ; e yeɔ mi anɔkuale, nɛ i suɔ lɛ, ejakaa e le Kristo. Ke Timoteo ba a, e ma kai nyɛ bɔ nɛ i plɛ kɛ ngɛ Yesu Kristo se nyɛɛe ha, kaa bɔ nɛ a naa ngɛ ye ní tsɔɔmi mi ngɛ asafo ɔmɛ a mi he tsuaa he ɔ.
18Nyɛ ti ni komɛ susu kaa i be bae ba slaa nyɛ, nɛ lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a bɔni a he nɔ womi. 19Ke Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ suɔ ɔ, e be kɛe nɛ ma ba slaa nyɛ. Ke i ba a, pi munyu nɛ kikɛmɛ a he nɔ woli nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ tue ɔ kɛkɛ nɛ ma ba nu, se he wami nɛ a kɛ ngɛ ní tsue ɔ, ma ba na paa. 20Ejakaa Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ jeɔ e he kpo ngɛ adesa ní tsumi mi, se pi munyu tumi mi. 21Te nɔ nɛ nyɛ suɔ nɛɛ? Ke i ma nyɛ ngɔ ɔ, ma hɛɛ kpa kɛ ba, aloo ma ba ngɛ suɔmi, kɛ he jɔmi mi?

Title: KORINTO BI I, 5
Content:
Ajuama bɔmi ngɛ asafo ɔ mi
1 A ngɛ dee ke yo kɛ nyumu yakayaka fiɛmi sanehi ngɛ asafo ɔ mi. Nɔ́ nɛ ba nɛ ɔ, wɔ jali tete po pee we. I nu kaa nɔ ko kɛ lɛ nitsɛ e tsɛ yo ngɛ si hwɔe. 2Nɛ nyɛ ngɛ nyɛ he nɔ woe ngɔ piɛ he! Niinɛ, e sa kaa nyɛɛ ye kɔmɔ mohu. Nyumu nɛ tsu nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ fie lɛ kɛ je nyɛ kpɛti. 3-4E ngɛ mi kaa i be nyɛ ngɔ ngɛ nɔmlɔ tso mi mohu, se mumi mi lɛɛ i kɛ nyɛ lɛ ngɛ. Nɔmlɔ nɛ tsu kikɛmɛ a ahlua ní nɛ ɔ ɔ, i bu lɛ fɔ momo ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo biɛ mi kaa nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti. Ke nyɛ kpe nɛ ye mumi piɛ nyɛ he ngɛ Yesu Kristo he wami nya a, 5nyɛɛ tu nɔmlɔ nɛ ɔ kɛ wo Satan dɛ mi, nɛ e kpata e nɔmlɔ tso ɔ hɛ mi, konɛ kojomi ligbi ɔ, Kristo nɛ he e susuma yi wami.
6 E sɛ kaa nyɛ woɔ nyɛ he nɔ. Blema abɛ ɔ nɛ deɔ ke, “Masa bɔbɔyoo haa nɛ ma a tsuo fuɔ” ɔ, tse nyɛ le? 7 Nyɛ je yayami nɛ ngɛ kaa masa a kɛ je nyɛ kpɛti, konɛ nyɛɛ pee kaa ma kplolo nɛ masa be mi kaa bɔ nɛ i le nɛ nyɛ ngɛ anɔkuale mi ɔ. Ejakaa a ngɔ Kristo ngɔ sã bɔ ha wɔ kaa to bi nɛ a gbeɔ Hetsɔmi nyami be. 8 Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke wa ngɛ wa Hetsɔmi nyami be ɔ yee ɔ, nyɛ ko ha nɛ waa ngɔ ma momo kɛ ye. Ma momo nɛ ɔ ji yayami, kɛ yi wu tso níhi. Nyɛ ha waa ye lɛ ngɛ anɔkuale yemi mi.
9I de ngɛ womi nɛ i ngma nyɛ ɔ mi ke nyɛɛ kɛ nihi nɛ fiɛɔ nyumu kɛ yo yakayaka fiɛmi kó bɔ. 10Pi je mi bi yaholi, loo hɛ tsuli, loo juli, loo wɔ jali a he munyu nɛ i ngɛ tue kulaa; kaa mɛ ɔ, jinɛ e ko hia kaa nyɛɛ je je ɔ mi. 11Nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ tsɔɔe mohu ji, ke nɔ ko tsɛɔ e he Kristo se nyɛɛlɔ, nɛ e fiɛɔ nyumu kɛ yo yakayaka fiɛmi, loo e hɛ tsuɔ, loo e jaa wɔ, loo e jɛɔ nɔ, loo e tɔɔ dã, loo e juɔ ɔ, nyɛɛ kɛ lɛ ko bɔ. Nyɛɛ kɛ lɛ ko ye ní tete po.
12-13 Pi ye ní tsumi ji kaa ma kojo nihi nɛ be asafo ɔ mi; Mawu lɛ maa kojo mɛ. Se ni nɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ asafo ɔ mi ɔ, anɛ e sɛ kaa nyɛ kojoɔ mɛɛ lɛɛ lo? Kaa bɔ nɛ ngmami ɔ deɔ ɔ, “Nyɛ je nɔmlɔ yayami ɔ kɛ je nyɛ kpɛti.”

Title: KORINTO BI I, 6
Content:
Nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ nyɛmimɛ ngɛ munyu yee
1Ke nyɛ ti nɔ ko kɛ e nyɛmi asafo mi no na sane ɔ, e be he blɔ nɛ e kɛ sane ɔ ya haa nihi nɛ ja we Mawu nɛ a hyɛ mi ha mɛ. E sa nɛ e kɛ ya ha ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ. 2Anɛ nyɛ li kaa ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ lɛ maa kojo je ɔ lo? Saminya! Ke nyɛ lɛ nyɛ maa kojo je ɔ, lɛɛ sane wawi kojomi pi nɔ́ ko kulaa ha nyɛ. 3Tse nyɛ le kaa nyɛ lɛ nyɛ maa kojo hiɔwe bɔfo ɔmɛ! Nɛ daa ligbi munyu tsɔwitsɔwi ɔ lɛɛ nyɛ be nyɛe maa kojo? 4Ke sanehi kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ ba a, nyɛ maa ngɔ ya ha nihi nɛ asafo ɔ kɛ mɛ be nɔ ko peemi nɛ a hyɛ mi lo? Nyɛ ha nɛ ma bi nyɛ munyu nɛ zo nɛ gbe nyɛ. 5Anɛ juɛmitsɛ kake too be nyɛ kpɛti nɛ ma nyɛ maa hyɛ nyɛmimɛ a kpɛti sane mi ha mɛ lo? 6Se mohu, nɔ kɛ e nyɛmi yaa kojomi he, nɛ nihi nɛ li Kristo ɔ ya hyɛɛ a sane mi ha mɛ.
7Kaa nyɛ nyɛ nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ he ngɛ munyu yee ɔ, lɔ ɔ kɛkɛ tsɔɔ kaa nyɛ je mi bami sɛ́ Kristo se nyɛɛli saasaa. Nyɛ ha nɛ ni kpahi pee nyɛ yayami mohu jinɛ tse e ko hi! Nyɛ ha nɛ ni kpahi sisi nyɛ mohu jinɛ tse e ko hi! 8Se nyɛ mohu nyɛ ngɛ nyɛ sibi yayami pee, nɛ nyɛ ngɛ nyɛ sibi sisie, nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ nyɛmimɛ tete po. 9Anɛ nyɛ li kaa yayami peeli be blɔ nya ko ngɛ Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ mi lo? Nyɛ ko sisi nyɛ he! Yaholi, loo amaga jali, loo gba puɛli, loo nyumuhi kɛ yihi sɔuu nɛ kɛ a sibi peeɔ yakayaka ní, 10loo juli, loo hɛ tsuli, loo dã tɔli, loo nihi a biɛ puɛli, loo ojo fiali a nine be Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ nɔ sue kɔkɔɔkɔ. 11Be ko ɔ, kikɛ nɛ ɔ nyɛ ti ni komɛ ba a je mi. Se jehanɛ ɔ, a du nyɛ he, nɛ a kpale tsukɔ nyɛ he, nɛ a wo nyɛ nguɔ ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo biɛ ɔ, kɛ wa Mawu ɔ mumi ɔ mi.
Nyɛɛ ngɔ nyɛ nimli tso ɔmɛ kɛ wo Mawu hɛ mi nyami
12 Nɔ ko ma de ke, “I ngɛ he blɔ nɛ i peeɔ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ i suɔ nɛ mlaa ko mlaa ko tsí ye nya.” Ee, se tsa pi nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ hi ha mo. Imi hu i ko de ke i ngɛ he blɔ nɛ i peeɔ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ i suɔ jã nɔuu. Se i be hae nɛ nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko nɛ ye ye nɔ. 13Nɔ ko hu ma de ke, “Ngma ngɛ ha muklii, nɛ muklii hu ngɛ ha ngma.” Ee, se Mawu ma kpata nɔ́ enyɔ nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a hɛ mi. Nɔmlɔ tso ɔ, pi nyumu kɛ yo yakayaka ní peemi nɛ e ngɛ kɛ ha; se mohu e ngɛ ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ he. Nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ hu ngɛ ha nɔmlɔ tso ɔ. 14Mawu tle Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ si kɛ je gbeje, nɛ e kɛ e he wami ɔ ma tle wɔ hu si kɛ ba wami mi ekohu.
15Anɛ nyɛ li kaa nyɛ nɔmlɔ tso ɔ, Kristo nɔmlɔ tso ɔ he níhi ji mɛ lo? Lɛɛ ma ngɔ Kristo nɔmlɔ tso ɔ he ní komɛ kɛ ya pee yaholɔ hu e nɔmlɔ tso he níhi lo? Dɛbi! 16 Anɛ nyɛ li kaa nɔ nɛ kɛ yaholɔ ya naa bɔmi ɔ, e kɛ lɛ plɛ pee nɔmlɔ tso kake lo? Kaa bɔ nɛ ngmami ɔ deɔ ɔ, “Mɛ ni enyɔ ɔmɛ tsuo ma plɛ pee nɔmlɔ tso kake.” 17Ke nɔ ko ngɔ e he ngɔ ha Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ, lɔ ɔ lɛɛ e kɛ lɛ pee kake ngɛ mumi mi.
18Nyɛɛ tu yahomi nya fo. Yayami tsuaa yayami nɛ adesa peeɔ ɔ, pee we nɔmlɔ tso ɔ nɔ́ ko tsɔ. Se nɔ nɛ fiɛɔ yo kɛ nyumu yakayaka fiɛmi ɔ, yeɔ lɛ nitsɛ e nɔmlɔ tso ɔ awi. 19 Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ nɛ Mawu ha nyɛ, nɛ ngɛ nyɛ mi ɔ, anɛ nyɛ li kaa e sɔlemi tsu ji nɔmlɔ tso ɔ lo? Nyɛ be nyɛ dɛ he; Mawu níhi ji nyɛ. 20Mawu hé nyɛ kɛ jua wawɛ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ ngɔ nyɛ nɔmlɔ tso ɔ kɛ wo Mawu hɛ mi nyami.

Title: KORINTO BI I, 7
Content:
Gba si himi
1Jehanɛ, níhi nɛ nyɛ ngma ba ha mi ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ dee ngɛ a he ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
E hi ha nyumu kaa e ko ta yo he. 2Se ajuama bɔmi he ɔ, nyumu tsuaa nyumu nɛ ná lɛ nitsɛ e yo, nɛ yo tsuaa yo nɛ ná lɛ nitsɛ e huno. 3Nyumu nɛ ha e yo nɔ́ nɛ ji yo blɔ nya nɛ sa kaa e na kɛ je e huno dɛ mi; yo ɔ hu nɛ pee jã nɔuu ha e huno. 4Yogbayo be he wami ngɛ lɛ nitsɛ e nɔmlɔ tso nɔ; e huno lɛ ngɛ jamɛ a he wami ɔ. Jã kɛ̃ huno hu be he wami ngɛ lɛ nitsɛ e nɔmlɔ tso nɔ; e yo lɛ ngɛ jamɛ a he wami ɔ. 5Nyumu kɛ e yo kó tsi a he nya kaa a kɛ a sibi be bɔmi nae.
