Lɛɛ ja eko ɔ, mɛ ni enyɔ ɔmɛ tsuo a kplɛɛ kaa a maa pee jã be kuku kɛkɛ, konɛ a na deka kɛ sɔle. Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, á bɔni bɔmi ekohu. Ke pi jã a, a be a he nɔ nyɛe maa ye hu, nɛ Satan maa ka mɛ.
6Nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ dee nɛ ɔ, ga kɛkɛ i ngɛ nyɛ woe; pi mlaa. 7Jinɛ i ko suɔ kaa nihi tsuo nɛ a hi kaa bɔ nɛ i ngɛ nɛ ɔ. Se nyɛ ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ ngɛ nike ní pɔtɛɛ nɛ Mawu ha lɛ; slo nɔ kake nɔ́ ngɛ nɔ kpa nɔ́ he.
8Jehanɛ, nyɛ nyumu kuyo ɔmɛ, kɛ yalɔyi ɔmɛ ɔ, i ngɛ dee ke e maa hi ha nyɛ ke nyɛ maa ya nɔ maa hi si kikɛ nɛ ɔ kaa bɔ nɛ imi hu i ngɛ ɔ. 9Se ke nyɛ nyɛ́ we nyɛ he nɔ nyɛɛ ye ɔ, e hia kaa nyɛɛ sɛ gba si himi mi. Ejakaa lɔ ɔ hi pe nɔ́ nɛ akɔnɔ ma ba hao nyɛ.
10 Nyɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ gba si himi mi ɔ, mlaa nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ngɛ nyɛ woe ji yo kó je gba! Enɛ ɔ, pi imi nɛ i de. 11Se ke e na je gba kɛ̃ ɔ, e hi si jã, nɛ e ko gba, aloo e ya nɛ e kɛ e huno ɔ ya dla. Jehanɛ hu, nyumu ko ngmɛɛ e yo he.
12Nyɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ piɛ ɔ, nɔ nɛ imi, se pi Kristo, i ngɛ nyɛ dee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ; ke nyumu nɛ le Kristo ngɛ yo nɛ lɛɛ e li Kristo, se kɛ̃ ɔ, yo ɔ kplɛɛ kaa e kɛ lɛ maa hi si ɔ, nyumu ɔ ko ngmɛɛ e he. 13Ke yo nɛ le Kristo ngɛ huno nɛ lɛɛ e li Kristo, se kɛ̃ ɔ, nyumu ɔ kplɛɛ kaa e kɛ lɛ maa hi si ɔ, yo ɔ kó kua lɛ gbami. 14Ejakaa nyumu nɛ li Kristo ɔ, e yo ɔ he ɔ, a tsukɔ e he ngɔ ha Mawu. Yo nɛ li Kristo ɔ, lɛ hu e huno ɔ he ɔ, a tsukɔ e he ngɔ ha Mawu. Ke pi jã a, jinɛ a bimɛ ɔmɛ a he tsɔ we. Se amlɔ nɛ ɔ, a ba pee bimɛ nɛ a tsukɔ a he ha Mawu. 15Se ke nyumu nɛ li Kristo ɔ suɔ kaa e maa ngmɛɛ e yo nɛ le Kristo ɔ he, aloo yo nɛ li Kristo ɔ suɔ kaa e ma kua e huno nɛ le Kristo ɔ, lɔ ɔ lɛɛ faa. Ke e ba mi jã a, mlaa ko mlaa ko nui nɔ nɛ le Kristo ɔ, nyumu ɔ jio, yo ɔ jio. Mawu tsɛ nyɛ nɛ nyɛɛ hi si ngɛ he jɔmi mi. 16Mo yo nɛ o le Kristo, kɛ o maa pee kɛ le kaa alini mo lɛ o ma he o huno ɔ yi wami? Mo nyumu nɛ o le Kristo, kɛ o maa pee kɛ le kaa alini mo lɛ o ma he o yo ɔ yi wami?
Hii si kaa bɔ nɛ Mawu tsɛ mo ɔ
17Nike ní nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu ha nɔ ko loko Mawu ba tsɛ lɛ ɔ, é ya nɔ nɛ e tsu he ní kaa bɔ nɛ e peeɔ ɔ. Enɛ ɔ nɛ i tsɔɔ ngɛ asafo ɔmɛ tsuo a mi. 18Ke a po nɔ ko loko Mawu tsɛ lɛ ɔ, e ko de ke e maa gbe pa doku ɔ. Jã kɛ̃ ke a pui nɔ ko loko e ba le Mawu ɔ, e ko ha nɛ a po lɛ. 19Ejakaa a po mo jio, a pui mo jio, pi nɔ́ ko; nɔ́ nɛ he hia ji kaa o ye Mawu mlaa amɛ a nɔ. 20Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ hi si kaa bɔ nɛ e ngɛ loko Mawu tsɛ lɛ. 21Benɛ Mawu tsɛ mo ɔ, jamɛ a be ɔ, tse nyɔguɛ ji mo? Ko ha lɔ ɔ nɛ hao mo kulaa. Se ke blɔ ko ngɛ nɛ o kɛ maa ye o he ɔ, bɔɔ he mɔde. 22Ejakaa nyɔguɛ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ tsɛ lɛ ɔ ba peeɔ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nɔmlɔ nɛ ye e he. Jã kɛ̃ ke nɔ ko ye e he, nɛ Kristo tsɛ lɛ ɔ, e ba peeɔ Kristo nyɔguɛ. 23Kristo hé nyɛ kɛ jua wawɛ; nyɛ ko pee nyɛ he nimli a nyɔguɛhi. 24Ye nyɛmimɛ, enɛ ɔ he ɔ, si himi mi tsuaa si himi mi nɛ nɔ ko ngɛ benɛ a tsɛ lɛ ɔ, e kɛ Mawu nɛ hi si jã.
Nihi nɛ sɛ we gba si himi mi, kɛ yalɔyi
25Jehanɛ, nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ ngma ngɛ yihewi nɛ gba we lolo a he ɔ, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ha we mi mlaa pɔtɛɛ ko. Se kɛ̃ ɔ, juɛmi nɛ i kɛ ngɛ nyɛ ga nɛ ɔ woe ɔ, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nitsɛ lɛ dloo mi; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e hia kaa nɔ́ nɛ ma de nyɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ ngɔ.
26Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, he hiami be ɔ je sisi momo. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i susuu kaa mo nɔ, bɔ nɛ o ngɛ ɔ, o hi si jã kɛkɛ. 27Ke yo ngɛ o dɛ ɔ, kó de ke o ngɛ e he ngmɛɛe. Ke yo be o dɛ ɔ, ko ya hla eko. 28Se ke o ná ngɔ yo ɔ, o pee we yayami. Jã kɛ̃ ke yo nɛ gba we lolo hu gba a, e pee we yayami. Se dengme nɛ ngɛ gba si himi mi he je ɔ, i na nɛ nyɛ je nyɛ hɛ ngɔ fɔ si mohu amlɔ nɛ ɔ.
29Nyɛmimɛ, nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ dee kɛkɛ ji kaa be ɔ pi hu. Kɛ je be nɛ ɔ mi kɛ yaa a, yitsɛmɛ nɛ a hi si kaa nɔ́ nɛ yo be a dɛ. 30Ni nɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ ya foe ɔ, a pee kaa ni nɛmɛ nɛ yi kɔmɔ; nihi nɛ ngɛ muɔe ɔ, a pee kaa ni nɛmɛ nɛ be bua jɔmi; nihi nɛ ngɛ ní hee ɔ, a pee kaa nɔ́ nɛ níhi nɛ a he ɔ pi a nɔ́; 31nihi nɛ a kɛ je ɔ ngɛ bɔe ɔ, a pee a ní kaa nihi nɛ puɛ we a be ngɛ je ɔ mi. Ejakaa je ɔ, bɔ nɛ e ngɛ nɛ ɔ, e se be kɛe.
32I suɔ kaa nyɛɛ hi si nɛ nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko kó hao nyɛ. Nyumu nɛ be yo ɔ ngɔɔ e he ngɔ woɔ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ní tsumi ɔ mi, nɛ e bɔɔ mɔde kaa e maa pee Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ suɔmi nya ní. 33Nɔ nɛ ngɛ yo ɔ lɛɛ e haoɔ e he ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi níhi a he, ejakaa e bɔɔ mɔde kaa e maa sa e yo ɔ hɛ mi. 34Ke e ba mi jã a, e juɛmi peeɔ lɛ enyɔɔnyɔ. Yo nɛ be huno, aloo yiheyo kɛ e he haa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ní tsumi, ejakaa e suɔ kaa e ngɔ e nɔmlɔ tso ɔ, kɛ e mumi tsuo ha Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ. Yogbayo lɛɛ e haoɔ e he ngɛ je ɔ mi níhi a he, ejakaa e suɔ kaa e sa e huno hɛ mi.
35Nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ kpakpa he nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ enɛ ɔ dee, se pi kaa i ngɛ hlae nɛ ma tsi nyɛ nya ngɛ blɔ ko nɔ. Niinɛ, i suɔ kaa nyɛɛ ba nyɛ je mi saminya. I suɔ kaa nyɛɛ ngɔ nyɛ he tsuo ngɔ wo Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ní tsumi ɔ mi nɛ nyɛ ko ya se.
36Nɔ́ nɛ kɔɔ nyumu, kɛ e yo nɛ e bi si, se e ngɔɛ lɛ lolo ɔ a he ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. Ke nyumu ɔ na kaa e pee we yo ɔ saminya, nɛ lɛ nitsɛ hu e nyɛ we e he nɔ nɛ e hyɛ ɔ, e ngɔ yo ɔ kaa bɔ nɛ e ngɛ hlae ɔ. Yayami ko be enɛ ɔ mi. Ee, a sɛ gba si himi mi. 37Se ke nɔ ko muɔ e yi mi kpɔ ke e be yo ngɔe, nɛ pi kaa a nyɛ e nɔ ɔ, ke e nyɛ hyɛ e he nɔ saminya, nɛ lɛ nitsɛ e to e yi mi kaa nɔ́ nɛ e maa pee ji nɛ ɔ, lɔ ɔ lɛɛ e hi kaa e ko ngɔ yo ɔ. 38Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ nɛ maa ngɔ yo ɔ, pee saminya. Se nɔ nɛ be yo ngɔe ɔ, e nɔ́ ɔ hi kulaa pe nɔ kaketsɛ ɔ.
39Yogbayo ɔ, be abɔ nɛ e huno ngɛ je mi kɛ mwɔɔ ɔ, mlaa fi lɛ. Ke e huno ɔ gbo ɔ, lɔ ɔ lɛɛ e ngɛ he blɔ nɛ e gbaa nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ e suɔ. Se kɛ̃ ɔ, e sa kaa nyumu ɔ nɛ pee nɔ ko nɛ le Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ. 40Se ke e hi si bɔ nɛ e ngɛ ɔ, a maa gbaa lɛ babauu mohu. Bɔ nɛ ye juɛmi deɔ mi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ, nɛ e peeɔ mi kaa imi hu Mawu mumi ngɛ ye mi.

Title: KORINTO BI I, 8
Content:
Kusumi lo nɛ a kɛ ha amagahi
1Jehanɛ ma suɔ nɛ ma de nɔ́ ko ngɛ kusumi lo nɛ a kɛ haa amaga he.
E ngɛ mi niinɛ kaa “wɔ tsuo wa le ní,” kaa bɔ nɛ a deɔ ɔ. Se nile haa nɔ woɔ e he nɔ, nɛ suɔmi lɛɛ e woɔ nɔ he wami. 2Ke nɔ ko susu kaa e le ní ɔ, he nɛ sa kaa e su loko a tsɛ lɛ ní lelɔ ɔ, e sui lejɛ ɔ saasaa. 3Se nɔmlɔ nɛ suɔ Mawu ɔ, Mawu le lɛ.
4Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ma suɔ nɛ ma de nɔ́ ko ngɛ kusumi lo nɛ a kɛ haa amaga a yemi he. Wa le kaa amaga daa si ha nɔ́ ko nɛ be je nɛ ɔ mi. Wa le hu kaa mawu kpa ko be ngɛ anɔkuale Mawu kake ɔ se. 5Ni komɛ deɔ ke ní komɛ ngɛ hiɔwe, kɛ zugba a nɔ nɛ a tsɛɛ mɛ “mawuhi.” Yoo, ke “mawu” nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ “nyɔmtsɛmɛ” nɛ ɔmɛ pɔ he tete po, 6kɛ̃ ɔ, wɔɔ lɛɛ Mawu kake too nɛ ji Tsɛ ɔ, lɛ pɛ wa ngɛ. Lɛ nɛ bɔ níhi tsuo, nɛ lɛ nɛ ha nɛ wa ngɛ wami mi. Wa ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ kake hulɔ; lɛ ji Yesu Kristo. E nɔ Mawu gu kɛ bɔ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́, nɛ lɛ nɛ ha nɛ wa ngɛ wami mi.
7Se pi nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ le anɔkuale nɛ ɔ. Kɛ ba si mwɔnɛ ɔ, ni komɛ susuɔ kaa amagahi ngɛ wami mi; a susuɔ kaa ke a ha amagahi ní ɔ, mawuhi nɛ a ha ní ɔ nɛ. Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, ke a ye kikɛmɛ a ní ɔ, a he nile haoɔ mɛ, ejakaa a susuɔ kaa niye ní ɔ ma ble mɛ. 8Ngma kɛkɛ be hae nɛ waa hɛ wɔ kɛ su Mawu he haa pe bɔ nɛ wa ngɛ ɔ. Ke wa yi ɔ, wa laa we nɔ́ ko; ke wa ye hu, wa na we he se tsɔ.
9Nɔ́ nɛ hia kɛkɛ ji kaa nyɛɛ hyɛ nɛ hi nɛ nyɛ ko ngɔ he blɔ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ nɛ ɔ kɛ ye ní ɔ. Ke nyɛ pee jã a, nyɛ ma ha nɛ nyɛ nyɛmimɛ Kristo se nyɛɛli nɛ mɛɛ a hemi kɛ yemi mi wɛ ɔ maa pee yayami. 10Waa ngɔ lɛ kaa nɔ ko nɛ e he nile deɔ lɛ ke e sɛ kaa a yeɔ ní ngɛ amaga jami he ɔ na mo “ní lelɔ” nɛ o ngɛ ní yee ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Anɛ enɛ ɔ be lɛ he wami woe nɛ lɛ hu e ya ye ní nɛ a kɛ ha amagahi lo? 11Kɛkɛ ɔ, o “nile” ɔ he ɔ, nɔmlɔ nɛ gbɔjɔ nɛ ɔ, nɛ ji o nyɛmi nɛ Kristo ba gbo ngɛ lɛ hu e he ɔ hɛ mi ma kpata. 12Ke o pee o nyɛmi yayami kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ, Kristo nɛ o pee yayami kɛ si ɔ nɛ. Ejakaa mo lɛ o wo o nyɛmi ɔ he wami nɛ e kɛ pee nɔ́ ko nɛ e le kaa e sɛ nɛ e peeɔ. 13Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke ngma ma ha ye nyɛmi nane ma kpata a, i be lo yee hu gblegbleegble, konɛ ma ko ha nɛ ye nyɛmi ɔ nɛ pee yayami.

Title: KORINTO BI I, 9
Content:
Bɔfo blɔ nya, kɛ e ní tsumi
1Anɛ i be ye dɛ he lo? Anɛ pi bɔfo ji mi lo? Anɛ i nɛ Yesu, wa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ lo? Nɛ nyɛ nɛɛ? Ní nɛ i tsu ha Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ, anɛ pi nyɛ ji nɔ́ nɛ je mi kɛ ba lo? 2Ke ni kpahi bui kaa bɔfo ji mi ɔ, i heɔ yeɔ kaa nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ he mi kaa bɔfo; ejakaa ní tsumi nɛ i ngɛ tsue ɔ, nyɛ ji okadi kaa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ bɔfo ji mi.
3Ke nihi de níhi ngɛ ye he ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ i kɛ faa ye he ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. 4Anɛ wa be he blɔ kaa wa naa niye ní kɛ jeɔ nyɛ ngɔ ngɛ ní nɛ wa ngɛ tsue ɔ he lo? 5Ke wa yaa he ko ɔ, anɛ wa be he blɔ kaa wa yihi nɛ le Kristo ɔ, waa kɛ mɛ nyɛɛɔ kaa bɔ nɛ bɔfo kpa amɛ, kɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nyɛminyumu ɔmɛ, kɛ Petro peeɔ ɔ lo? 6Aloo i kɛ Barnaba kɛkɛ nɛ e sa kaa wa tsu ní loko waa ye ní? 7Ta bulɔ te nɔ nɛ tsuɔ ní nɛ lɛ nitsɛ e woɔ e he hiɔ nɛɛ? Mɛnɔ lɛ peeɔ wai ngmɔ, nɛ e yi e mi yiblii ɔ eko? Mɛnɔ nɛ lɛɛ to, nɛ e nui to nyɔ nyu ɔ eko?
8Pi níhi nɛ a naa ngɛ adesa wami si himi mi daa ligbi kɛkɛ a he munyu nɛ i ngɛ tue. Nyɛ maa na nɔ́ nɛ i de nɛ ɔ nɔuu ngɛ Mawu mlaa womi ɔ mi. 9 A ngma ngɛ Mose mlaa a mi ke, “Na nɛ ngɛ blɛfo gblɛe ɔ, koo fi e nya.” Mawu ɔ, anɛ nahi a he nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ lɛ dɔe? 10Munyu nɛ e tu ɔ, anɛ pi wɔ tutuutu wa he nɛ e kɔɔ lo? Nihi nɛ gbaa ní, kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ kpaa ní ɔ, e sa kaa a tsu ní kɛ hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi kaa mɛ hu a maa ye niba ní ɔ eko. 11 Ke wa ba du mumi mi níhi ngɛ nyɛ tsui mi ɔ, anɛ e ji nɔ́ ko nɛ he wa tsɔ kaa wɔ hu wa na he lo ɔ hiami níhi kɛ je nyɛ dɛ lo? 12Ke ni kpahi ngɛ he blɔ kaa a hyɛɔ níhi kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ blɔ kɛ jeɔ nyɛ dɛ ɔ, anɛ wɔɔ lɛɛ wa be he blɔ kulaa pe mɛ lo?
Se waa kɛ he blɔ nɛ ɔ tsu we ní. Mohu ɔ, wa to wa tsui si ngɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ mi, konɛ wa ko pee nɔ́ ko nɛ maa tsi Kristo he sane kpakpa a fiɛmi ɔ nya. 13 I heɔ yeɔ kaa nyɛ le kaa nihi nɛ tsuɔ ní ngɛ sɔlemi we ɔ, sɔlemi we ɔ a naa a nya mi ngma kɛ jeɔ. Ni nɛmɛ nɛ a ní tsumi ji kaa a sã bɔ ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ, mɛ hu níhi nɛ a kɛ ba sã bɔ ɔ eko a yeɔ. 14 Jã nɔuu kɛ̃ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ wo mlaa ke, nihi nɛ fiɛɔ sane kpakpa a, a na a nya mi ngma kɛ je munyu ɔ fiɛmi mi.
15He blɔ nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ mohu, se imi lɛɛ i bi we nyɛ nɔ́ ko hyɛ. Womi nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ ngmae nɛ ɔ hu, pi ye juɛmi ji kaa ma kɛ kai nyɛ kaa jehanɛ e sa kaa nyɛ bɔni mi nɔ́ hami. Afani nɛ ma gbo mohu, pe nɛ ma pee nɔ́ ko kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ, nɛ́ nɔ́ nɛ nɔ nɛ ma da kɛ fĩa a ba bɔ mi! 16Niinɛ, sane kpakpa a nɛ i fiɛɛ ɔ, lɔ ɔ kɛkɛ ha we mi he blɔ kaa ma fĩa, ejakaa Mawu nitsɛ nɛ fa mi ke ma pee jã. Kaa i fiɛ we sane kpakpa a, jinɛ musu tloo mi pɛ! 17Ní nɛ i ngɛ tsue ɔ, imi nitsɛ nɛ i suɔ kaa ma tsu jinɛ i ko hyɛ hiɔwo blɔ. Se Mawu nitsɛ nɛ hla mi, nɛ e ngɔ ní tsumi ɔ ngɔ wo ye dɛ kaa nɔmlɔ nɛ yeɔ anɔkuale. 18Lɛɛ mɛni hiɔwo sa mi mɔ? Hiɔwo ɔ kɛkɛ ji he blɔ nɛ i na kaa ma fiɛ sane kpakpa a yaka nɛ i he we nɔ́ ko. Jehanɛ hu, he blɔ nɛ i ngɛ kaa ma hyɛ nɔ́ ko blɔ kɛ je nyɛ dɛ mi ngɛ sane kpakpa a nɛ i ngɛ fiɛe ɔ he ɔ, i kɛ jamɛ a he blɔ ɔ tsu we ní.
19I ngɛ ye dɛ he; pi nɔ ko nyɔguɛ ji mi. Se kɛ̃ ɔ, i pee ye he nihi tsuo a nyɔguɛ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ ye nine nɛ su nihi babauu a nɔ. 20I peeɔ ye ní kaa Yuda no ngɛ Yuda bi a kpɛti, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ ye nine nɛ su a nɔ. Ngɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ yeɔ mlaa a nɔ a kpɛti ɔ, i peeɔ ye ní kaa nɔ nɛ sa kaa lɛ hu e yeɔ mlaa a nɔ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ ye nine nɛ su a nɔ. 21Jã kɛ̃ ngɛ ma je li a kpɛti ɔ, i peeɔ ye ní kaa ma je no, nɛ i yi Yuda mlaa a nɔ. I peeɔ enɛ ɔ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ ye nine nɛ su ma je li ɔmɛ a nɔ. Se enɛ ɔ tsɔɔ we kaa i kɛ Mawu mlaa a be nɔ́ ko peemi. Dɛbi! Kristo mlaa a nɔ i yeɔ. 22Ngɛ nihi nɛ a hemi kɛ yemi gbɔjɔ a kpɛti ɔ, i peeɔ ye ní kaa nɔ nɛ lɛ hu e hemi kɛ yemi gbɔjɔ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ ye nine nɛ su a nɔ. Ee, bɔ tsuaa bɔ nɛ nɔ ko ngɛ ɔ, imi hu i peeɔ ye he kaa lɛ. I peeɔ enɛ ɔ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ ma gu blɔ tsuaa blɔ nɔ kɛ he nihi a yi wami.
23I peeɔ enɛ ɔmɛ tsuo, konɛ ma kɛ ha nɛ Yesu he sane kpakpa a nɛ gbɛ fĩa. Kɛkɛ ɔ, ní kpakpahi nɛ maa je sɛ gbi ɔ mi kɛ ba a, imi hu ma na eko. 24Anɛ nyɛ li kaa ke nihi babauu tu fo ɔ, nɔ kake too lɛ naa ayekoo ní ɔ lo? Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ tu fo ɔ jã nɔuu, konɛ nyɛ hu nyɛ nine nɛ su ayekoo ní ɔ nɔ. 25Nihi nɛ kaa a kpɔhi a mi ɔ, a hɛ mi kaa si be tsuaa be, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ a ná jlasi nɛ puɛɔ. Se wɔɔ lɛɛ wa peeɔ jã, konɛ wa nine nɛ su jlasi nɛ puɛ we gblegbleegble ɔ nɔ. 26Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, fo nɛ i ngɛ tue nɛ ɔ, i ngɛ tue tɛɛ kɛ yaa nyagbe; kunɔ nɛ i ngɛ nɔe ɔ, i nɔɛ kaa nɔ ko nɛ ngɛ kɔɔhiɔ gbee. 27Se mohu ɔ, i waa ye nɔmlɔ tso ɔ yi mi, nɛ i haa nɛ e peeɔ ye suɔmi nya ní. I peeɔ jã, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ ke i fiɛ ha ni kpahi se ɔ, imi nitsɛ lɛɛ Mawu ko sake mi ngɔ fɔ he.

Title: KORINTO BI I, 10
Content:
Amagahi a he kɔkɔ bɔmi
1 Ye nyɛmimɛ, i suɔ kaa ma kai nyɛ nɔ́ nɛ ba wa nɛmɛ ɔmɛ nɛ nyɛɛ Mose se ɔ a nɔ. Mɛ tsuo a hi bɔku ɔ sisi, nɛ mɛ tsuo a po Wo Tsu ɔ. 2Benɛ a ngɛ bɔku ɔ sisi, kɛ wo ɔ mi ɔ, a sɔle mɛ kaa Mose se nyɛɛli. 3 Mɛ tsuo a ye mumi mi ní kake, 4 nɛ mɛ tsuo a nu mumi mi nyu kake ɔ nɛ je mumi mi tɛ sa nɛ nyɛɛ a se ɔ mi. Jamɛ a tɛ sa a ji Kristo. 5 Se enɛ ɔ tsuo se ɔ, Mawu na we a ti nihi fuu a he tsui. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a kpata a hɛ mi ngɛ nga a nɔ.
6 Ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ba mi kaa okadihi nɛ a to wɔ, konɛ wa ko ha yayami nɛ pee wɔ akɔnɔ kaa bɔ nɛ e pee mɛ ɔ. 7 Nyɛ ko ja amaga kaa bɔ nɛ a ti ni komɛ pee ɔ. Kaa bɔ nɛ ngmami ɔ deɔ ɔ, “Ma a pue si, nɛ a ye ní, nɛ a nu ní, nɛ a fiɛ yakayaka fiɛmihi.” 8 Wa ko fiɛ yakayaka fiɛmi kaa bɔ nɛ a ti ni komɛ pee, nɛ nimli akpe nyingmi enyɔ kɛ etɛ gbo ligbi kake ɔ. 9 Wa ko ka Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ kaa bɔ nɛ a ti ni komɛ pee, nɛ sinɔ kpata a hɛ mi ɔ. 10 Wa ko tu munyu huitihuiti kaa bɔ nɛ a ti ni komɛ pee, nɛ bɔfo nɔ́ puɛlɔ ɔ kpata a hɛ mi ɔ.
11Níhi nɛ ba a nɔ ɔ peeɔ okadi kɛ ha ni kpahi. A ngma ní nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ ngɛ wɔ kɔkɔ bɔe, ejakaa be nɛ wa ngɛ mi nɛ ɔ kɛ nyagbe be ɔ kɛ we kulaa.
12Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ nɛ susuɔ kaa e daa si ɔ, e hyɛ e he nɛ hi, konɛ e ko nɔ si. 13Kahi nɛ baa nyɛ nɔ ɔ, ekoeko be nɛ bɛ adesa nɔ hyɛ. Se Mawu yeɔ e siwo nɔ, nɛ e be hae nɛ a ka nyɛ pe bɔ nɛ nyɛ ma nyɛ. Ke ka ba nyɛ nɔ ɔ, Mawu ma ha nyɛ he wami nɛ nyɛ kɛ da nya, konɛ nyɛɛ je mi.
14Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ye huɛmɛ nɛ i suɔ, nyɛɛ yu nyɛ he kɛ je amaga jami he kulaa. 15I kɛ nyɛ ngɛ munyu tue kaa a kɛ juɛmitsɛmɛ tuɔ munyu; nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ dee ɔ, nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ kɔ se. 16 Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ niye ní kplu ɔ nɛ wa naa Mawu si ngɛ he ɔ, anɛ e ha we nɛ wɔ tsuo wa naa gbaami nɛ jeɔ Kristo muɔ mi ɔ eko lo? Jã kɛ̃ ke wa ku abolo ɔ nɛɛ, anɛ wɔ tsuo wa na we gbaami nɛ jeɔ Kristo nɔmlɔ tso ɔ mi ɔ eko lo? 17Bɔ tsuaa bɔ nɛ wa hiɛmi ngɛ ɔ, wɔ tsuo wa yeɔ abolo kake ɔ eko. Enɛ ɔ tsɔɔ kaa Kristo nɔmlɔ tso ɔ he níhi ji wɔ tsuo.
18 Yuda bi a kusumi, kɛ a hemi kɛ yemi ko tsɔɔ kaa nihi nɛ yeɔ ní nɛ a kɛ sã bɔ ɔ, guu enɛ ɔ peemi mi nɛ a kɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ naa huɛ bɔmi. 19Lɛɛ kɛ i ngɛ tsɔɔe kɛɛ ɔ? Kaa amaga, loo niye ní nɛ a haa amaga a he hia lo? 20 Dɛbi! Nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ dee kɛkɛ ji, bɔ nɛ wɔ jali sãã a, mumi yayamihi a sãã ngɔ haa, se pi Mawu. Nɛ i sume kaa nyɛɛ kɛ mumi yayamihi nɛ bɔ huɛ. 21Nyɛ be nyɛe maa nu Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ kplu ɔ, nɛ́ nyɛ ma ya nu mumi yayamihi hu a kplu. Nyɛ be nyɛe maa ye ní ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ we okplɔɔ ɔ he, nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ mumi yayamihi hu ma ya ye ní. 22 Pe wa ngɛ hlae nɛ waa wo Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ mi mi la nɛ e je hunga lo? Anɛ wa he wa pe lɛ lo?
23 Nyɛ deɔ ke, “Wa ngɛ he blɔ kaa wa peeɔ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́.” Saminya! Se pi nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ he ngɛ se nami. “Wa ngɛ he blɔ kaa wa peeɔ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́.” Niinɛ! Se pi nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ peemi nɛ ma ha Kristo asafo ɔ maa ya nɔ. 24Nɔ ko nɔ ko nɛ kó hla kaa e hi ha lɛ nɔ kake too; nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ susu e nyɛmi hu he.
25Lo tsuaa lo nɛ a ngɛ juae ɔ, nyɛ ma nyɛ ye faa; enɛ ɔ peemi kó hao nyɛ he nile. 26 Ejakaa ngmami ɔ ke, “Je ɔ, kɛ e mi níhi tsuo ɔ, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nɔ́.”
27Ke nihi nɛ he we yi ɔ a ti nɔ ko tsɛ nyɛ ní yemi, nɛ nyɛ ya a, nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ a kɛ maa ma nyɛ hɛ mi ɔ, nyɛɛ ye nɛ nyɛ he nile ko hao nyɛ kulaa. 28Se ke nɔ ko de nyɛ ke, “Niye ní nɛ ɔ, a kɛ sã bɔ ha amaga” a, lɔ ɔ lɛɛ nyɛ ko ye. Pi nyɛ nitsɛmɛ, loo nyɛ he nile he je nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ enɛ ɔ dee, se nɔ kpa a nɛ de nyɛ lo ɔ he sane ɔ, lɛ mohu e he nile he je. 29Ee, nɔ ɔ he nile nɛ i ngɛ tsɔɔe ɔ nɛ; pi nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ he nile.
Nɔ ko ma bi ke, “He blɔ nɛ i ngɛ kaa i peeɔ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ i suɔ ɔ, mɛni he je nɔ kpa he nile maa tsɔɔ mi bɔ nɛ imi ma plɛ kɛ tsu jamɛ a he blɔ ɔ he ní ha? 30Ke i nyɛ gbaa niye ní nɔ nɛ i ye ɔ, mɛni he je nɔ ko tuɔ ye he munyu yaya ngɛ niye ní nɛ i na Mawu si ngɛ he ɔ he?”
31Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ pee ɔ, ní nyɛ ngɛ yee jio, ní nyɛ ngɛ nue jio, nyɛɛ pee lɛ tsuo kɛ wo Mawu hɛ mi nyami. 32Nyɛ ko pee nɔ́ ko nɛ sɛ kɛ si Yuda no ko, loo ma je no ko, loo Mawu we asafo ɔ. 33Nyɛ wo ye nane. Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ mi ɔ, i bɔɔ mɔde kaa ma sa nihi tsuo a hɛ mi. I susuu we imi nɔ kake too ye he, se mohu i hlaa kaa e hi ha nɔ tsuaa nɔ, konɛ a he a yi wami.

Title: KORINTO BI I, 11
Content:
1 Nyɛɛ ngɔ mi ngɔ pee nɔ hyɛmi nɔ́ kaa bɔ nɛ imi hu i ngɔ Kristo ngɔ pee ye nɔ hyɛmi nɔ́ ɔ.
A ha yi nɔ ngɛ sɔlemi
2I ngɛ nyɛ yi jee, ejakaa nyɛ kaiɔ ye ní peepee, kɛ níhi nɛ i tsɔɔ nyɛ ɔ daa. Tsɔɔmihi nɛ i na kɛ je nihi a dɛ, nɛ imi hu i ngɔ kɛ ha nyɛ ɔ, nyɛ pɛtɛ he. 3Se i suɔ nɛ nyɛɛ nu sisi kaa Kristo ngɛ he wami ngɛ nyumuhi tsuo a nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ nyumu ji yi kɛ ha e yo, nɛ Mawu hu ji yi kɛ ha Kristo ɔ. 4Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke nyumu ngɛ sɔlee, aloo e ngɛ Mawu sɛ gbi ɔ fiɛe, nɛ e kɛ nɔ́ ha e yi nɔ ɔ, e ngɛ Kristo nɛ ji yi ɔ he guɛ gbee. 5Jã kɛ̃, yo tsuaa yo nɛ ngɛ sɔlee, aloo e ngɛ Mawu sɛ gbi ɔ fiɛe, nɛ e kɛ nɔ́ hɛ́ e yi nɔ ɔ, e huno nɛ ji e yi ɔ hɛ mi si e ngɛ puee ɔ nɛ. Slɔɔto be e kɛ yo nɛ sɛ e yi nɔ a kpɛti. 6Ke yo kɛ nɔ́ hɛ́ e yi nɔ ɔ, lɛɛ e sã e yi nɔ mɔ. Se ke zo ngɛ lɛ pee kaa e ma sã e yi nɔ, loo e maa sɛ e yi ɔ, lɛɛ e kɛ nɔ́ nɛ ha e yi ɔ nɔ. 7 E sɛ kaa nyumu kɛ nɔ́ haa e yi nɔ, ejakaa Mawu subai mi a bɔ lɛ ngɛ, nɛ e woɔ Mawu hɛ mi nyami. Se yo lɛɛ nyumu hɛ mi nyami womi nɔ́ ji lɛ; 8 ejakaa a bɔɛ nyumu kɛ ji yo mi, se yo mohu nɛ a bɔ kɛ je nyumu mi. 9Jehanɛ hu, a bɔɛ nyumu ha we yo, se yo mohu nɛ a bɔ ha nyumu. 10Enɛ ɔ he ɔ, e sa kaa yo nɛ ha e yi nɔ kaa okadi ha hiɔwe bɔfo ɔmɛ kɛ tsɔɔ kaa a ha lɛ he blɔ ke e sɔle, loo e fiɛ Mawu sɛ gbi ɔ. 11Se ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ hɛ mi ɔ, yo be e dɛ he, nɛ nyumu hu be e dɛ he. 12A je yo kɛ je nyumu mi, nɛ nyumu tsuaa nyumu hu yo lɛ fɔ lɛ. Niinɛ, nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ je Mawu ngɔ.
13Kɛ nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ susuɔ kɛɛ? Anɛ e da kaa yo maa sɔle ha Mawu ngɛ ma hɛ mi, nɛ e hɛ́ e yi nɔ lo? 14Hyɛ, anɛ adebɔ nitsɛ tsɔɔ we nyɛ kaa ke nyumu fia e yi kusuu ɔ, e ngɛ zo lo? 15Yo lɛɛ e yi bwɔmi fuu ɔ ji e hɛ mi nyami. Mawu ha yo yi bwɔmi nɛ e kɛ ha e he. 16Se ke nɔ ko susuɔ kaa nɔ́ nɛ i de ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ he ɔ be mi ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ ma de kɛkɛ ji kaa i kɛ Mawu asafo ɔ, wɔɔ lɛɛ wa be jami blɔ nya tomi kpa ko ngɛ enɛ ɔ se.
Nyɔmtsɛ niye ní ɔ
(Mateo 26.26-29; Marko 14.22-25; Luka 22.14-20)
17Jehanɛ ɔ lɛɛ nɔ́ nɛ ma de nyɛ nɛ ɔ, pi kaa ma je nyɛ yi. Ejakaa ke nyɛ kpe ɔ, nɔ́ kpakpa ko ji mi; ní yayahi mohu nyɛ peeɔ. 18Kekleekle ɔ, i na le kaa ke nyɛ bua nyɛ he nya kaa Kristo asafo ɔ, kɛkɛ nyɛ gba nyɛ mi kɛ wo kuu slɔɔtohi a mi. I heɔ yeɔ kaa anɔkuale ko kɛ̃ ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ i nu nɛ ɔ mi. 19Niinɛ, e he hia kaa mi gbami ko kɛ̃ nɛ hi nyɛ kpɛti, konɛ a na Kristo se nyɛɛli kpakpa amɛ paa. 20Ke nyɛ nya ba bua a, pi Nyɔmtsɛ niye ní ɔ nɛ nyɛ yeɔ. 21Ejakaa ke nyɛ ngɛ ní ɔ yee ɔ, nɔ tsuaa nɔ he sɔɔ kɛ yeɔ lɛ nitsɛ e niye ní. Nɛ benɛ hwɔ ngɛ ni komɛ yee ɔ, ni komɛ hu tɔ dã. 22Anɛ nyɛ be nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ wehi nɛ nyɛ maa ye ní, nɛ nyɛ maa nu ní ngɛ lejɛ ɔmɛ lo? Aloo pe nyɛ ngɛ hlae nɛ nyɛɛ gbe Mawu asafo ɔ he guɛ, nɛ nyɛ pue ni nɛmɛ nɛ be nɔ́ ko ɔ a hɛ mi si? Kɛ ma de nyɛ kɛɛ? Ma je nyɛ yi lo? Dɛbi, i be nyɛ yi jee!
23Nɔ́ nɛ i ná kɛ je Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ dɛ mi ɔ, lɔ ɔ nɛ i kɛ ha nyɛ ɔ nɛ, kaa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu ɔ, jamɛ a nyɔ ɔ mi nɔuu nɛ a tsɔɔ e se blɔ ɔ, e kɛ̃ abolo, 24nɛ e na Mawu si, nɛ e ku mi, nɛ e de ke, “Enɛ ɔ ji ye nɔmlɔ tso nɛ a ku ngɛ nyɛ he. Nyɛɛ pee enɛ ɔ nɛ nyɛ kɛ kai mi.” 25 Ja nɔuu e wo kplu ɔ hu benɛ a ye ní ɔ ta a, nɛ e de ke, “Kplu nɛ ɔ ji Mawu somi he ɔ nɛ a kɛ ye muɔ sɔu nya. Nyɛɛ pee enɛ ɔ, be tsuaa be nɛ nyɛ maa nu ɔ, nɛ nyɛ kɛ kai mi.”
26Enɛ ɔ tsɔɔ kaa be tsuaa be nɛ nyɛ maa ye abolo nɛ ɔ eko, nɛ nyɛ maa nu wai ngɛ kplu nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, nyɛ ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ gbenɔ sane ɔ fiɛe kɛ yaa su be nɛ e maa ba. 27Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ yeɔ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ we abolo ɔ, nɛ́ e nuu wai nɛ ngɛ kplu ɔ mi bɔ nɛ sɛ ɔ, e peeɔ yayami kɛ siɔ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nɔmlɔ tso ɔ, kɛ e muɔ ɔ. 28Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ hyɛ e tsui mi kekle loko e ye abolo ɔ, nɛ e nu wai nɛ ngɛ kplu ɔ mi ɔ. 29Ejakaa nɔ nɛ yeɔ abolo ɔ, nɛ e nuɔ wai ngɛ kplu ɔ mi kɛkɛ, nɛ e susuu we Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nɔmlɔ tso ɔ he, kɛ nɔ́ nɛ e ji ɔ, Mawu maa gbla e tue. 30Enɛ ɔ he nɛ nyɛ ti nihi fuu gbɔjɔ, nɛ a be he wami, nɛ nihi babauu hu gbo ɔ nɛ. 31Se ke wɔ nitsɛmɛ wa maa kojo wa he anɔkuale mi kekle ɔ, Mawu be wa tue gblae. 32Se Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ kojoɔ wɔ, nɛ e gblaa wa tue, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ nyagbe ɔ, Mawu nɛ ko bu wɔ fɔ kɛ piɛ je ɔ he.
33Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ye nyɛmimɛ, ke nyɛ nya ba bua, nɛ nyɛ maa ye Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ niye ní ɔ, nyɛɛ mlɛ nyɛ sibi. 34Se ke hwɔ ngɛ nɔ ko yee ɔ, e ye ní ngɛ we mi lolo, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ nyɛ he nya buami ɔ kó ba pee tue gblami mohu ha nyɛ. Níhi nɛ piɛ ɔ, ke i ba su kɛkɛ ma to blɔ nya.

Title: KORINTO BI I, 12
Content:
Mumi mi dloomi nike níhi
1Ye nyɛmimɛ! Jehanɛ lɛɛ i suɔ kaa i kɛ nyɛ maa tu munyu ngɛ nike níhi nɛ jeɔ Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ ngɔ ɔ a he. I suɔ kaa nyɛɛ le anɔkuale ɔ nɛ kɔɔ ní nɛ ɔmɛ a he. 2Nyɛ le kaa benɛ nyɛ ji wɔ jali ɔ, amagahi nɛ wami be a mi ɔ a se a gblaa nyɛ ya nyɛɛɔ. 3I ngɛ hae nɛ nyɛɛ le kaa nɔ nɛ Mawu mumi ɔ ngɛ e mi ɔ, e de we ke, “A gbiɛ Yesu.” Jã kɛ̃ nɔ ko be nyɛe ma de ke, “Yesu ji Nyɔmtsɛ” hulɔ kaa ja Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ tsɔɔ lɛ blɔ.
4 Mumi mi nike ní slɔɔtohi lɛ ngɛ, se mumi kake ɔ nɔuu lɛ haa. 5Blɔ slɔɔtohi a nɔ a guɔ kɛ sɔmɔɔ, se Nyɔmtsɛ kake ɔ nɔuu a sɔmɔɔ. 6Ní tsumi slɔɔtohi ngɛ, se Mawu kake ɔ nɔuu lɛ haa nɔ tsuaa nɔ he wami nɛ hia lɛ nɛ e kɛ tsuɔ ní. 7Mawu haa nɔ tsuaa nɔ okadi ko kɛ̃ nɛ tsɔɔ kaa e mumi ɔ ngɛ nɔ ɔ mi, konɛ nɔ ɔ kɛ tsu ní ha asafo ɔ tsuo. 8Mawu mumi ɔ haa nɔ ko he wami nɛ e kɛ tuɔ munyu nɛ juɛmi ngɛ mi. Jamɛ a mumi ɔ nɔuu haa nɔ kpa hu he wami nɛ e kɛ tuɔ munyu nɛ sisi numi ngɛ mi. 9Mumi kake too ɔ haa nɔ ko hemi kɛ yemi, nɛ e haa nɔ kpa he wami nɛ e kɛ tsaa hiɔ. 10Mumi ɔ haa nɔ ko he wami nɛ e kɛ tsuɔ nyakpɛ ní, nɛ e haa nɔ ko hu he wami nɛ e kɛ fiɛɔ Mawu sɛ gbi ɔ. Mumi ɔ haa nɔ kpa hu he wami nɛ e kɛ kpaa mumi slɔɔtohi a si. Mumi ɔ haa nɔ ko he wami nɛ e kɛ tuɔ gbi slɔɔtohi, nɛ e haa nɔ kpa hu he wami nɛ a kɛ tsɔɔ kikɛmɛ a gbi nɛ ɔmɛ a sisi. 11Se mumi kake ɔ nɔuu lɛ tsuɔ ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo; e haa nɔ tsuaa nɔ nike ní pɔtɛɛ ko kaa bɔ nɛ lɛɛ e suɔ.
Nɔmlɔ tso kake kɛ e he ní slɔɔtohi
12 Nɔmlɔ tso ɔ, nɔ kake, se e he níhi hiɛ babauu, nɛ e he ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo lɛ peeɔ nɔmlɔ tso kake ɔ nɛ. Kikɛ nɛ ɔ Kristo hu ngɛ. 13Mawu ngɔ mumi kake ɔ nɔuu ngɔ wo wa tsui mi, nɛ wa ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ ba plɛ pee Kristo he nɔ́ ko, Yuda no jio, ma je no jio, nyɔguɛ jio, nɔ nɛ ye e he jio.
14Ejakaa nɔmlɔ tso ɔ nitsɛ ɔ, pi he nɔ́ kake ji lɛ, se mohu he níhi babauu. 15Ke nane ma de ke, “Akɛnɛ i pi nine he je ɔ, pi nɔmlɔ tso ɔ he nɔ́ ko ji mi” ɔ, lɔ ɔ tsa tsɔɔ we kaa pi nɔmlɔ tso ɔ he ní ɔmɛ eko ji lɛ niinɛ. 16Nɛ ke tue hu ma de ke, “Akɛnɛ i pi hɛngmɛ he je ɔ, pi nɔmlɔ tso ɔ he nɔ́ ko ji mi” ɔ, lɔ ɔ tsa tsɔɔ we kaa pi nɔmlɔ tso ɔ he ní ɔmɛ eko ji lɛ niinɛ. 17Ke nɔmlɔ tso ɔ tsuo ji hɛngmɛ ɔ, kɛ e maa pee kɛ nu nɔ́ kɛɛ? Nɛ ke lɛ tsuo ji tue ɔ, kɛ e maa pee kɛ nu nɔ́ he fu kɛɛ? 18Se kaa bɔ nɛ wa le ɔ, Mawu to nɔmlɔ tso he ní ɔmɛ tsuo kakaaka ngɔ ma nɔmlɔ tso ɔ he kaa bɔ nɛ e to nɛ a hi ɔ. 19Ke he ní ɔmɛ tsuo peeɔ he nɔ́ kake too ɔ, lɔ ɔ lɛɛ nɔmlɔ tso ko tsa be si hie! 20Se kaa bɔ nɛ wa le ɔ, he níhi babauu lɛ ngɛ, se nɔmlɔ tso ɔ lɛɛ kake too.
21Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, hɛngmɛ be nyɛe ma de nine ke, “O he hia we mi!” Yi hu be nyɛe ma de nane ke, “O he hia we mi.” 22Dɛbi! Nɔmlɔ tso ɔ he níhi nɛ peeɔ wɔ kaa a he wɛ pe kulaa a, mɛ mohu a he hia wɔ titli. 23Nɔmlɔ tso ɔ he níhi nɛ wa bui kpakpa ko ɔ, mɛ mohu a nɔ wa hyɛɛ saminya. Nɔmlɔ tso ɔ he níhi nɛ sɛ nɛ a jeɔ kpo ngɛ ma hɛ mi ɔ, lɔ ɔmɛ lɛ wa jeɔ blɔ haa a he saminya. 24Ní nɛmɛ nɛ wa naa daa nɛ ɔ lɛɛ e hia we kaa a pee mɛ jã. Nɛ́ Mawu pee nɔmlɔ tso ɔ, e he ní komɛ nɛ wa susuɔ kaa a he be se nami tsɔ ko ɔ, lɔ ɔmɛ mohu a hɛ mi nyami nɛ e wo pe kulaa. 25Mawu pee enɛ ɔ, konɛ mi gbami nɛ ko ba nɔmlɔ tso ɔ mi, se mohu nɔmlɔ tso ɔ he ní slɔɔto ɔmɛ tsuo suɔ a he, nɛ a nuɔ nɔ he ha a sibi. 26Ke nɔmlɔ tso ɔ he nɔ́ kake ngɛ nɔ́ nae ɔ, he ní kpa amɛ tsuo kɛ lɛ naa nɔ́. Nɛ ke he nɔ́ kake hɛ mi ba nyami ɔ, he ní kpa amɛ tsuo kɛ lɛ naa bua jɔmi.
27Nyɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ ji Kristo nɔmlɔ tso ɔ nɛ, nɛ nyɛ ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ peeɔ Kristo nɔmlɔ tso ɔ he nɔ́ ko. 28 Mawu ngɔ he ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ngɔ to a blɔ hehi ngɛ asafo ɔ mi, kɛ je kekleekle blɔ he kɛ ya si nyagbe nɔ́. Mɛ ji bɔfohi, Mawu sɛ gbi fiɛli, kɛ tsɔɔli. Nihi nɛ ba ngɛ a se ji nyakpɛ ní peeli, nihi nɛ a ha mɛ he wami nɛ a kɛ tsuɔ ní komɛ, nɔ́ nɛ á kɛ tsaa nɔ, loo a kɛ yeɔ bua ni kpahi, loo a kɛ toɔ blɔ nya saminya, loo a kɛ tuɔ gbi slɔɔtohi. 29Pi ni ɔmɛ tsuo ji bɔfohi, loo Mawu sɛ gbi fiɛli, loo tsɔɔli. Pi nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ngɛ he wami nɛ a kɛ peeɔ nyakpɛ ní. 30Pi nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ngɛ he wami nɛ a kɛ tsaa hiɔ, loo a kɛ tuɔ gbi slɔɔtohi. Pi nɔ tsuaa nɔ ko hu nɛ ngɛ he wami nɛ a kɛ tsɔɔ gbi sisi. 31Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ bɔ nike níhi nɛ a he jua wa a a he mɔde.
Se nɔ́ nɛ hi pe lɛ tsuo ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.

Title: KORINTO BI I, 13
Content:
Suɔmi
1Ke i nyɛɔ nɛ i tuɔ adesahi a gbihi, loo hiɔwe bɔfohi po a gbihi, se i be suɔmi ɔ, lɛɛ i ngɛ kaa gɔ̃gɔ̃, loo ngmlɛ nɛ ngɛ pɛe gegeege kɛkɛ. 2 Ke a dloo mi he wami nɛ a kɛ fiɛɔ Mawu sɛ gbi ɔ, ke i le nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́, nɛ i nuɔ laami sanehi tsuo a sisi, ke i ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi nɛ nya wa ngɛ Mawu mi, nɛ ma nyɛ ma hia yohi, se i be suɔmi ɔ, ye he be se nami ko kulaa. 3Ke i ngɔ ye níhi tsuo ngɔ ke, nɛ i ngɔ ye nɔmlɔ tso tete ngɔ ha nɛ a sã mi, se i be suɔmi ɔ, i na we he se ko kulaa.
4Suɔmi toɔ e tsui si, nɛ e mi mi hi. Suɔmi hɛ kɔɛ; e fĩɛ, nɛ e pee we pupuupu. 5Suɔmi pee we níhi nɛ sɛ́; e fo we lɛ nɔ kake too e nɔ́ mi; e mi mi wui la, nɛ e kɛ nɔ ko tɔmi wui e mi. 6Suɔmi nya we nɔ́ yayami he; anɔkuale mohu he nɛ e nyaa. 7Suɔmi haa nɔ toɔ tsui si ngɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ mi. E haa nɔ heɔ nɔ tsuaa nɔ́ yeɔ; e ngɔɔ e hɛ ngɔ fɔɔ Mawu nɔ, nɛ e miaa e hɛ mi ngɛ níhi tsuo mi.
8Suɔmi se pui gblegbleegble. Se mumi mi nike níhi kaa Mawu munyu ɔ fiɛmi, kɛ gbi slɔɔtohi tumi, kɛ nile lɛɛ a se maa po ligbi ko. 9Ejakaa ní nɛ wa le ɔ, wa li kɛ pi si; fiɛmi nɛ wa fiɛɔ hu, fa kɛ fa kɛkɛ. 10Se ke nɔ́ nɛ hi kɛ pi si ɔ ba a, lɔ ɔ lɛɛ nɔ́ nɛ ji fa kɛ fa a maa laa.
11Benɛ i ji jokuɛyo ɔ, i tuɔ munyu kaa jokuɛyo, i juɛɔ kaa jokuɛyo, nɛ i susuɔ kaa jokuɛyo. Se benɛ i ba wa a, i kpa jokuɛwi a ní peemi. 12Amlɔ nɛ ɔ lɛɛ wa ngɛ kaa ni komɛ nɛ ngɛ nɔ́ hyɛe tsuu kɛkɛ ngɛ ahuhuɛ mi. Se hwɔɔ se ɔ, wa maa na nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ paa. Piɔ lɛɛ ní nɛ i le ɔ, fa kɛ fa kɛkɛ. Se jamɛ a be ɔ lɛɛ ma le ní kɛ pi si kaa bɔ nɛ Mawu le mi kɛ pi si ɔ.
13Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, ní etɛ nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ: hemi kɛ yemi, hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi, kɛ suɔmi. Se nɔ́ nɛ pe mɛ tsuo ji suɔmi.

Title: KORINTO BI I, 14
Content:
Mumi mi dloomi nike ní kpahi
1Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ bɔ suɔmi he mɔde pe nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́. Nyɛɛ di mumi mi nike níhi a se, titli ɔ, Mawu sɛ gbi ɔ fiɛmi. 2Nɔ nɛ tuɔ gbi slɔɔtohi ɔ, pi adesa nɛ e kɛ ngɛ munyu tue, se Mawu, ejakaa nɔ ko nɔ ko nui sisi. Mumi ɔ he wami nɛ e kɛ ngɛ laami munyu ɔmɛ tue ɔ nɛ. 3Se nɔ nɛ ngɛ Mawu sɛ gbi ɔ fiɛe ɔ lɛɛ nimli nɛ e kɛ ngɛ munyu tue; e piɛɔ a he, e woɔ mɛ he wami, nɛ e haa mɛ bua jɔmi. 4Ke nɔ ko ngɛ gbi slɔɔtohi tue ɔ, lɛ nitsɛ e he mɔde nɛ e ngɛ bɔe, konɛ e wa ngɛ mumi mi. Se nɔ nɛ fiɛɔ Mawu sɛ gbi ɔ lɛɛ asafo ɔ tsuo nɔ yami he mɔde e ngɛ bɔe.
5I ná nɛ nyɛ tsuo nyɛ tuɔ gbi slɔɔtohi, se nɔ́ nɛ i ko suɔ pe kulaa mohu ji kaa nyɛɛ fiɛ Mawu sɛ gbi ɔ. Nɔ nɛ fiɛɔ Mawu sɛ gbi ɔ, e he ngɛ se nami pe nɔ nɛ tuɔ gbi slɔɔtohi; lɛɛ ja nɔ ko ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, nɛ ma nyɛ tsɔɔ nɔ́ nɛ a ngɛ dee ɔ sisi, konɛ asafo ɔ tsuo nɛ na he se. 6Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ye nyɛmimɛ, ke i ba nyɛ ngɔ nɛ i ba ngɛ gbi slɔɔtohi tue ɔ, nyɛ ma na he se ko lo? Dɛbi! Ja i ngɔ nɔ́ ko nɛ Mawu je tsɔɔ mi ba ha nyɛ; ja i ngɔ nile, loo sɛ gbi pɔtɛɛ, loo tsɔɔmi ko ba ha nyɛ.
7Ní komɛ kaa bɛ, aloo saku nɛ wami be a mi po ke a ngɛ pɛe ɔ, ja e mi tsɔ loko nɔ ko nɛ ngɛ tue bue ɔ maa le la a mi tso. 8Nɛ ke titimati kpalɔ ɔ bɛ ɔ mi tsɔ we ɔ, mɛnɔ maa mia kɛ ha ta? 9Jã nɔuu kɛ̃ nyɛ hu ke nyɛ ha sɛ gbi ngɛ gbihi nɛ a nui mi ɔ, kɛ nɔ ko maa pee kɛ nu sisi kɛɛ? Ke nyɛ pee jã a, lɛɛ kɔɔhiɔ nyɛɛ kɛ ngɛ munyu tue. 10Gbi slɔɔtohi fuu ngɛ je ɔ mi mohu, se eko tsuaa eko ngɛ sisi numi. 11Se ke nɔ ko ngɛ gbi tue nɛ i nui sisi ɔ, ma plɛ nubwɔ ngɛ e hɛ mi, nɛ lɛ hu e ma plɛ nubwɔ ngɛ ye hɛ mi. 12Akɛnɛ nyɛ nitsɛmɛ hu ja nɔuu kɛ̃ nyɛ hɛ dɔɔ ngɛ mumi mi níhi a he ɔ, nyɛɛ bɔ ní nɛmɛ nɛ ma ha asafo ɔ maa ya nɔ ɔ a he mɔde wawɛ.
13Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ nɛ tuɔ gbi slɔɔtohi ɔ, é sɔle, nɛ a ha lɛ he wami nɛ e kɛ tsɔɔ nɔ́ nɛ e ngɛ dee ɔ sisi. 14Ejakaa ke i ngɛ sɔlee ngɛ gbi slɔɔtohi a mi ɔ, ye mumi ɔ ngɛ sɔlee mohu, se imi nitsɛ lɛɛ i li nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ dee ɔ. 15Ke kikɛ nɛ ɔ ji sane ɔ, lɛɛ kɛ ma pee kɛɛ? I kɛ mumi maa sɔle, se i kɛ juɛmi hu maa sɔle; i kɛ mumi ma la, se i kɛ juɛmi hu ma la. 16Ke o ngɛ Mawu si nae ngɛ mumi mi kɛkɛ ɔ, nɔ ko nɛ hii si ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, nɛ lɛɛ e li mi eko ɔ, kɛ e maa pee kɛɛ nɛ e ma de “Amen” ngɔ si o sina sɔlemi ɔ nɔ? Blɔ ko blɔ ko be nɛ e kɛ maa le nɔ́ nɛ o ngɛ dee ɔ. 17Moo o ngɛ Mawu si nae saminya mohu, se nɔ kpa a lɛɛ o ha we nɛ e na he se ko kulaa.
18I naa Mawu si kaa i pe nyɛ tsuo ngɛ gbi slɔɔtohi a tumi mi. 19Se kɛ̃ ɔ, ke asafo ɔ ba bua a, imi lɛɛ i ko suɔ nɛ ma tu munyungu kakaaka enuɔ nɛ sisi numi ngɛ he nɛ ma kɛ tsɔɔ ní pe kaa ma tu munyungu akpeakpe ngɛ gbi slɔɔtohi a mi.
20Ye nyɛmimɛ, nyɛ ko susu nyɛ yi mi kaa jokuɛwi. Yayami peemi blɔ fa mi ɔ lɛɛ nyɛɛ pee nyɛ ní kaa jokuɛwi, se nyɛ susu nyɛ yi mi kaa nihi nɛ wa ngɛ mumi mi.
21 A ngma ngɛ Mose mlaa a mi ke,
“Ma gu nihi nɛ tuɔ gbi
slɔɔtohi a nɔ,
Nɛ ma tu munyu kɛ tsɔɔ ye ma a;
Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ lɛ de.
Ma tu munyu kɛ gu nibwɔhi a nɔ,
se kɛ̃ ye ma a be mi tue bue.”
22Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, gbi slɔɔtohi a tumi ji okadi kɛ ha nihi nɛ he we yi, pi ni nɛmɛ nɛ heɔ yeɔ. Sane kpakpa a fiɛmi lɛɛ nihi nɛ heɔ yeɔ ɔ a we okadi ji lɔ ɔ nɛ, pi ni nɛmɛ nɛ he we yi.
23Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke asafo ɔ tsuo nya ba bua, nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ bɔni gbi slɔɔtohi tumi, nɛ ni komɛ nɛ mɛɛ a li mi eko, aloo a he we yi ba lejɛ ɔ, anɛ a be dee ke nyɛ tsuo nyɛ ngɛ godo nue lo? 24Se ke nɔ tsuaa nɔ ngɛ Mawu sɛ gbi ɔ fiɛe, nɛ nɔ ko nɛ lɛɛ e he we yi, aloo e li mi eko ba lejɛ ɔ, níhi nɛ a ngɛ dee ɔ ma ha nɛ e maa na e he yayami. Níhi nɛ e nu ɔ tsuo maa kojo lɛ. 25E tsui mi laami sanehi tsuo maa je kpo paa; e ma kpla si ma ja Mawu, nɛ e maa jaje ke, “Niinɛ, Mawu kɛ nyɛ ngɛ!”
Blɔ nya tomi ngɛ asafo ɔ mi
26Ye nyɛmimɛ, nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ tsɔɔe ɔ ji, ke nyɛ nya ba bua kɛ ha Mawu jami ɔ, nyɛ ti nɔ kake nɛ je la, nɔ ko nɛ tsɔɔ ní, nɛ nɔ ko hu nɛ ha sɛ gbi nɛ je Mawu ngɔ. Nɔ kpa nɛ tu gbi slɔɔtohi, konɛ nɔ kpa ko hu nɛ tsɔɔ sisi. Nyɛɛ pee níhi tsuo ngɛ a blɔ nɔ kɛ ha asafo ɔ nɔ yami. 27Ke a ngɛ gbi slɔɔtohi tue ɔ, nɔ kake nɛ tu nɛ e gbe nya loko nɔ kpa hu nɛ ba. Ke munyu tuli ɔmɛ a he hiɛ hluu ɔ, e pee ni etɛ pɛ, konɛ nɔ ko nɛ je nɔ́ nɛ a ngɛ dee ɔ sisi. 28Se ke nɔ ko be lejɛ ɔ nɛ maa tsɔɔ sisi ɔ, lɛɛ nɔ nɛ ngɛ gbi slɔɔtohi tue ɔ nɛ pee dii; e tu munyu ha lɛ nɔ kake e he, kɛ Mawu. 29Ni enyɔ, loo etɛ nɛ ná Mawu sɛ gbi ɔ nɛ a tu munyu, konɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ piɛ ɔ nɛ a susu he. 30Se ke nɔ ko hii si ngɛ lejɛ ɔ nɛ Mawu je nɔ́ ko tsɔɔ lɛ ɔ, nɔ nɛ ngɛ munyu tue ɔ nɛ kpa. 31Nyɛ tsuo nyɛ ma nyɛ maa fiɛ Mawu sɛ gbi ɔ kakaaka, konɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ kase ní, nɛ e ya nɔ. 32Nɔ nɛ a dloo lɛ Mawu sɛ gbi ɔ fiɛmi ɔ, e hia kaa e hyɛ e munyu tumi saminya, nɛ e le he nɛ sa kaa e tu munyu kɛ ya si. 33Mawu sume basabasa, se mohu tue mi jɔmi e suɔ.
Bɔ nɛ níhi ngɛ ngɛ Mawu we asafo ɔmɛ tsuo a mi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. 34Ke nyɛ kpe nɛ nyɛ ngɛ Mawu jae ɔ, yi ɔmɛ nɛ a pee dii. A ngmɛ́ mɛ blɔ nɛ a tu munyu, mohu a ba a he si kaa bɔ nɛ Mose mlaa a hu tsɔɔ ɔ. 35Ke nɔ́ ko ngɛ nɛ a ngɛ hlae nɛ a le ɔ, a bi a hunomɛ ngɛ we mi. Ke asafo ɔ ba bua nɛ a ngɛ Mawu jae ɔ, e ji zo kaa yo maa tu munyu.
36Mawu munyu ɔ, nyɛ ngɔ nɛ e puɛ kɛ je? Aloo nyɛ kɛkɛ nyɛ ngɔ nɛ e ba su? 37Ke e peeɔ nɔ ko kaa gbalɔ ji lɛ, aloo kaa e ngɛ mumi mi nike ní ko ɔ, e na nɛ e le kaa níhi nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ ngmae nɛ ɔ, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ biɛ mi i ngɛ ngmae ngɛ. 38Ke nɔ ko bui enɛ ɔ, nyɛ hu nyɛ ko pee nɔ ɔ he akɔtaa.
39Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ye nyɛmimɛ, nyɛ hɛ nɛ dɔ ngɛ Mawu sɛ gbi ɔ fiɛmi he, se kɛ̃ ɔ, nyɛ ko tsi gbi slɔɔtohi a tumi nya. 40Á pee nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ bɔ nɛ sa ngɛ blɔ nya tomi nya.

Title: KORINTO BI I, 15
Content:
Kristo si temi
1Ye nyɛmimɛ, jehanɛ lɛɛ i suɔ kaa ma kai nyɛ sane kpakpa a nɛ i fiɛ ngɔ tsɔɔ nyɛ, nɛ nyɛ pɛtɛ he, nɛ lɔ ɔ nɔ nyɛ hemi kɛ yemi daa si ngɛ ɔ. 2Ke nyɛ pɛtɛ sane kpakpa a he wawɛɛ kaa bɔ nɛ i fiɛ tsɔɔ nyɛ ɔ, a ma he nyɛ yi wami. Ke pi jã lɛɛ nyɛ he ye yaka gu.
3 Sɛ gbi nɛ he hia pe kulaa nɛ imi hu i na a, i ngɔ ba ha nyɛ. Lɔ ɔ ji kaa Kristo gbo ngɛ wa he yayami ɔmɛ a he kaa bɔ nɛ ngmami ɔmɛ tsɔɔ ɔ. 4 Ngmami ɔmɛ ke a pu lɛ, nɛ ligbi nɛ ji ligbi etɛ ɔ, a tle lɛ si kɛ ba wami mi ekohu. 5 E jé e he kpo ngɔ tsɔɔ Petro; nɛ pee se ɔ, e jé e he kpo ngɔ tsɔɔ ni nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ. 6Jehanɛ, e jé e he kpo ngɔ tsɔɔ e se nyɛɛli maa pee lafa enuɔ kɛ se si kake. Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ a ti ni babauu ngɛ kɛ ba si mwɔnɛ ɔ, se ni komɛ hu gbo. 7Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e jé e he kpo ngɔ tsɔɔ Yakobo, nɛ Yakobo se ɔ, e jé e he kpo ngɔ tsɔɔ bɔfo ɔmɛ tsuo.
8 Nyagbe kulaa a, e jé e he kpo ngɔ tsɔɔ imi hulɔ, imi nɛ i ngɛ kaa nɔ ko nɛ a kpatu fɔ lɛ ɔ! 9 Imi ji bɔfo ɔmɛ tsuo a kpɛti nɔ nɛ sɛ́ pe kulaa; i sɛ́ kaa a tsɛɛ mi bɔfo po, ejakaa i wa Mawu we asafo ɔ yi mi. 10Se Mawu dloomi lɛ pee mi nɔ́ nɛ i ji mwɔnɛ nɛ ɔ, nɛ dloomi nɛ e dloo mi ɔ pee we yaka. Ee, i tsu ní wawɛɛ pe bɔfo kpa amɛ tsuo kulaa, se pi imi; Mawu dloomi ɔ mohu lɛ tsu ní ɔ. 11Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, imi jio, mɛ jio, e hia we kulaa; nɔ́ nɛ he hia kɛkɛ ji kaa wɔ tsuo wa fiɛ Mawu sɛ gbi ɔ ngɔ ha nyɛ, nɛ nyɛ he ye.
Kristo se nyɛɛli maa te si
12Jehanɛ ɔ, akɛnɛ wa sɛ gbi ɔ ji kaa Mawu tle Kristo si kɛ je gbeje ɔ, mɛni he je nyɛ ti ni komɛ deɔ ke a be ni gbogboehi si tlee kɛ ba wami mi ɔ? 13Ke a be ni gbogboehi si tlee kɛ ba wami mi ekohu ɔ, lɛɛ a tle we Kristo hu si mɔ. 14Ke a tle we Kristo si kɛ bɛ wami mi ekohu ɔ, lɛɛ wa fiɛmi ɔ pee yaka; nɛ nyɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ hu pee yaka. 15Pi enɛ ɔ kɛkɛ! E tsɔɔ kaa wa ye Mawu he lakpa, ejakaa wa de ke e tle Kristo si kɛ je gbeje. Se ke e ngɛ mi kaa a tle we ni gbogboehi si kɛ bɛ wami mi ekohu ɔ, lɛɛ Mawu tsa tle we Kristo si mɔ. 16Ejakaa ke a tle we ni gbogboehi si ɔ, lɛɛ Kristo hu a tle we lɛ si. 17Ke Mawu tle we Kristo si ɔ, lɛɛ nyɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ pee yaka, nɛ nyɛ ngɛ yayami he wami ɔ sisi kɛ mwɔɔ. 18Kɛkɛ ɔ, nihi nɛ he Kristo ye nɛ a gbo ɔ, mɛ hu a hɛ mi kpata. 19Ke wami nɛ ɔ mi kɛkɛ he nɛ wa ngɔ wa hɛ ngɔ fɔ Kristo nɔ ngɛ ɔ, lɛɛ wa ní ngɛ mɔbɔ pe nihi tsuo.
20Se anɔkuale ɔ ji kaa Mawu tle Kristo si kɛ je gbeje nɛ e kɛ ye odase kaa e ma tle ni nɛmɛ nɛ gbo ɔ tsuo si. 21Ejakaa kaa bɔ nɛ gbenɔ gu adesa nɔ kɛ ba a, jã nɔuu kɛ̃ adesa nɔ gbogboehi a si temi ɔ gu kɛ ba. 22Kaa bɔ nɛ nihi tsuo ngɛ Adam mi gboɔ ɔ, jã nɔuu kɛ̃ a ma tle nihi tsuo si ngɛ Kristo mi. 23Se Mawu ma tle nɔ tsuaa nɔ si ngɛ be nɛ sa mi. Kekleekle nɔ ji Kristo, nɛ lɔ ɔ se ke Kristo ma a, a ma tle e we bi ɔmɛ hu si. 24Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, je mi nyagbe maa ba. Kristo maa ye mumi mi nɔ yeli, kɛ blɔ nyahi, kɛ he wami tsuo a nɔ, nɛ e maa ngɔ matsɛ yemi ɔ ngɔ ha Mawu nɛ ji Tsɛ ɔ. 25 Ejakaa ja Kristo ye matsɛ kɛ maa su be nɛ Mawu maa ngɔ e he nyɛli tsuo ngɔ wo e nane si. 26Nyagbe he nyɛlɔ nɛ a ma kpata e hɛ mi ji gbenɔ. 27 Ngmami ɔ ke, “Mawu ngɔ níhi tsuo ngɔ wo e nane si.” Se e fɔɔ si paa kaa munyu “níhi tsuo” ɔ tsɔɔ we kaa lɛ Mawu ɔ nitsɛ nɛ e ngɔ níhi tsuo ngɔ wo Kristo nane si ɔ hu piɛ he. 28Se ke a ngɔ níhi tsuo ngɔ wo Kristo nɔ yemi sisi ɔ, lɛɛ Bi ɔ nitsɛ hu maa ngɔ e he ngɔ ha Mawu, nɔ nɛ ngɔ níhi tsuo ngɔ wo e nɔ yemi sisi ɔ. Nɛ Mawu maa ye ní ɔmɛ tsuo a nɔ.
29Jehanɛ ɔ, nihi nɛ a sɔlee mɛ ngɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ gbo a nane mi ɔ, nyɛ ha wa susu a he kuku. Ke e ngɛ mi niinɛ kaa bɔ nɛ ni komɛ tsɔɔ ɔ, kaa a be ni gbogboehi si tlee kɛ ba wami mi ekohu ɔ, mɛni he je mɔ nɛ ni nɛ ɔmɛ ha nɛ a ngɛ mɛ sɔlee ngɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ gbo ɔ a nane mi? 30Ke a be ni gbogboehi si tlee kɛ ba wami mi ekohu ɔ, mɛni he je mɔ lɛ wɔ hu wa ngɛ gbenɔ nya mi ngmlɛfia tsuaa ngmlɛfia a? 31Ye nyɛmimɛ, daa ligbi ɔ, i ngɛ gbenɔ nya mi! Fiami nɛ i fĩaa ngɔ fɔɔ nyɛ nɔ ji kaa wa le Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo. 32 Ke je nɛ ɔ mi níhi a he lɛ i kɛ lohwe dikali ɔmɛ hwu ta ngɛ ngɛ Efeso ɔ, lɛɛ mɛni se i na mɔ? (Efeso bi a ngɛ dee ɔ nɛ). Se ke a be ni gbogboehi si tlee kɛ ba wami mi ekohu ɔ, lɛɛ kaa bɔ nɛ a pɔɔ demi ɔ, “Nyɛ ha waa ye ní nɛ wa nu ní, ejakaa hwɔɔ pɛ wa gbo.”
33Nyɛ ko ha nɛ a sisi nyɛ. “Huɛ yaya bɔmi puɛɔ je mi bami kpakpa.” 34Nyɛ susu nyɛ yi mi saminya nɛ nyɛ kpa yayami peemi. I ngɛ dee nɛ zo nɛ gbe nyɛ kaa nyɛ ti ni komɛ li Mawu.
Nɔmlɔ tso nɛ a kɛ maa te si
35Se nɔ ko ma bi ke, “Kɛ a maa pee kɛ tle ni gbogboehi si kɛ ba wami mi ekohu kɛɛ? Nɛ mɛni nɔmlɔ tso nɛ a maa hɛɛ?” 36Kuasia! Ke o du ní ɔ, ja wu ɔ gbo ngɛ zu mi loko e maa puɛ. 37Jehanɛ ɔ hu, wu ngmelu kɛkɛ kaa ngma, loo e henɔ ko nɛ o du ɔ nɛ; pi tso nɛ maa puɛ ɔ. 38Se Mawu haa jamɛ a wu ɔ tso nɛ lɛ Mawu ɔ suɔ; e haa wu tsuaa wu tso pɛ nɛ hi ha lɛ.
39Níhi nɛ wami ngɛ a mi ɔ, pi he lo kake too nɛ mɛ tsuo a hɛɛ; slo adesa he lo, nɛ slo lohwe nane eywiɛtsɛ nɔ́; slo lohwe pɛlitsɛ he lo, nɛ slo lo nɔ́.
40Hiɔwe nɔmlɔ tsohi ngɛ, nɛ zugba nɔ nɔmlɔ tsohi hu ngɛ. Se kɛ̃ ɔ, slo hiɔwe ní ɔmɛ a hɛ mi nyami, kɛ a he fɛu ngɛ zugba nɔ ní ɔmɛ a he. 41Slo pu hɛ mi nyami kɛ afɛu, nɛ slo nyɔhiɔ hu nɔ́. Slo dodoehi hu a hɛ mi nyami kɛ afɛu; dodoe kake nɔ́ je ekpa ngɛ kake nɔ́ he.
42E ngɛ kaa bɔ nɛ a ma tle ni gbogboehi si kɛ ba wami mi ekohu ɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ. Nɔ́ nɛ a pu kaa wu ɔ ma puɛ, se nɔ́ nɛ a ma tle si ɔ lɛɛ e be puɛe. 43Ke a pu nɔmlɔ tso ɔ, e ngɛ tãi, nɛ e gbɔjɔ; se ke Mawu ma tle lɛ si kɛ ba wami mi ekohu ɔ, e maa hi fɛu, nɛ e he maa wa. 44Ke a ngɔ lɛ ngɔ wo zu mi ɔ, nɔmlɔ tso nɛ a naa a, lɔ ɔ kɛkɛ a pu ɔ nɛ. Se ke a tle lɛ si kɛkɛ e pee nɔmlɔ tso nɛ mumi ɔ ha lɛ wami he. Ke nɔmlɔ tso nɛ a naa ngɛ ɔ, lɛɛ nɔmlɔ tso nɛ mumi ɔ haa lɛ wami he hu ngɛ. 45 Ngmami ɔ ke, “A bɔ kekleekle Adam ɔ nɔmlɔ hɛngmengmletsɛ,” nɛ nyagbe Adam ɔ ba pee mumi nɛ haa nɔ wami. 46Se he lo nɔmlɔ tso ɔ he hia we kaa mumi nɔ́ ɔ; ejakaa he lo nɔ́ ɔ ba kekle loko mumi nɔ́ ɔ nɛ he hia pe lɔ ɔ ba. 47Kekleekle Adam ɔ, zugba zu a kɛ bɔ lɛ; Adam enyɔne ɔ lɛɛ hiɔwe nɛ e je. 48Nimli adesahi tsuo ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi ɔ ngɛ kaa Adam, nɔ nɛ a kɛ zu pee ɔ. Se ni nɛmɛ tsuo nɛ heɔ Kristo yeɔ ɔ, mɛɛ a maa hi kaa Kristo, nɔ nɛ je hiɔwe kɛ ba a nɔuu. 49Nɛ wɔ nɛ a bɔ wɔ ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi no ɔ subai nɔ ɔ, wa ma ba hɛɛ Hiɔwe No ɔ subai.
50Ye nyɛmimɛ, nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ tsɔɔe ji kaa he lo kɛ muɔ nine be Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ nɔ sue; nɔ́ nɛ puɛɔ nine be nɔ́ nɛ puɛ we nɔ sue.
51-52 Nyɛɛ bu tue! Anɔkuale laami sane nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ dee nɛ ɔ nɛ. Wɔ tsuo wa be gboe! Se ke nyagbe titimati ɔ pɛ ɔ, a ma tsake wɔ tsuo amlɔ kaa a fiaa hɛngmɛ. Ejakaa ke titimati ɔ pɛ ɔ, ni gbogboe ɔmɛ maa te si, nɛ a be gboe hu gblegbleegble. Nɛ a ma tsake wɔ tsuo. 53Ejakaa ja nɔ́ nɛ puɛɔ nɛ ɔ tsake pee nɔ́ nɛ puɛ we; nɛ nɔ́ nɛ gboɔ nɛ ɔ tsake pee nɔ́ nɛ gbo we. 54 Ke nɔ́ nɛ puɛɔ ɔ tsake pee nɔ́ nɛ puɛ we, nɛ nɔ́ nɛ gboɔ ɔ tsake pee nɔ́ nɛ gbo we ɔ, lɔ ɔ lɛɛ ngmami ɔ maa ba mi: “A mi gbenɔ kɛ ye kunimi!”
55 Mo gbenɔ, jije o kɛɛ ɔ ngɛ?
Mo gbeje, jije o kunimi yemi ɔ ngɛ?
56Gbenɔ kɛɛ ɔ ji yayami, nɛ yayami he wami ɔ ji mlaa a. 57Se sina ha Mawu, nɔ nɛ haa wa yeɔ kunimi kɛ guu wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo nɔ ɔ!
58Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ye nyɛmimɛ nɛ i suɔ! Nyɛ fi si, nɛ nyɛɛ da si kpɛii. Ní tsumi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ tsue ha Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ, nyɛ tsu nɛ e ya nɔ saminya be tsuaa be. Ejakaa nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ le kaa dengme nɛ nyɛ ngɛ gboe ha Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ be yaka pee.

Title: KORINTO BI I, 16
Content:
Korinto asafo ɔ tsu sika nɛ a kɛ hyɛ Kristo se nyɛɛli kpahi a nɔ
1 Jehanɛ lɛɛ ma suɔ nɛ ma de nɔ́ ko ngɛ sika nɛ nyɛ to nɛ nyɛ ma tsu kɛ mane ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ ngɛ Yerusalem ɔ he. Nɔ́ nɛ i tsɔɔ asafo ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ Galatia ke a pee ɔ, nyɛ hu nyɛɛ pee jã nɔuu. 2Daa otsi mi kekleekle ligbi ɔ, sika nɛ nyɛ ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ naa ngɛ otsi ɔ mi ɔ, e je eko ngɔ to, nɛ e hi nya buae. Kɛkɛ ɔ, ke i ba a, e be hiae kaa a tsu sika hu. 3Ke i ba a, ma tsɔ nihi nɛ nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ buu mɛ kɛ womi, konɛ a ngɔ nyɛ nike ní ɔ kɛ ya Yerusalem. 4Nɛ ke e hia kaa imi hu ma ya a, i kɛ mɛ maa ya.
Paulo yi mi tomi
5 Ma ya gu Makedonia loko ma ba nyɛ ngɔ, ejakaa i to ye yi mi kaa ma ya gu lejɛ ɔ. 6Eko ɔ, ma hi nyɛ ngɔ be saii, nɛ ma ye fĩɛ be ɔ po ngɛ nyɛ ngɔ. Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, nyɛ maa wo mi blɔ kɛ ya he tsuaa he nɛ ma yaa. 7Enɛ ɔ lɛɛ i sume kaa ma ba na nyɛ kpiti kɛkɛ nɛ ma je. Ke Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ maa ngmɛ blɔ ɔ, i heɔ yeɔ kaa ma kɛ ngɛ nyɛ ngɔ.
8 Ma hi Efeso hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ kɛ yaa si Pentekoste ligbi ɔ. 9Blɔ bli ha mi ngɛ hiɛ ɔ nɛ ma tsu ní saminya, se kɛ̃ ɔ, nihi nɛ teɔ si woɔ mi ɔ, mɛ hu a ngɛ hiɛ ɔ babauu.
10 Ke Timoteo ba nyɛ ngɔ ɔ, nyɛ he lɛ hɛmuɔ nɛ e ko ye gbeye, ejakaa lɛ hu Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ní tsumi ɔ nɔuu nɛ e ngɛ tsue kaa imi. 11Nyɛ ti nɔ ko nɛ ko bu lɛ kaa pi nɔ ko ji lɛ. Se mohu nyɛɛ hyɛ, konɛ e tsa e blɔ hiami ɔ nɔ ngɛ tue mi jɔmi mi. I ngɛ blɔ hyɛe kaa e kɛ nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ maa kpale kɛ ba.
12Jehanɛ ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ kɔɔ wa nyɛmi Apolo ɔ he ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. I kpa lɛ pɛɛ hluu kaa e kɛ nyɛmimɛ kpa amɛ nɛ a ba slaa nyɛ ngɛ Korinto, se e to kaa amlɔ nɛ ɔ lɛɛ e be nyɛe maa ba. Pee se ke e ba na blɔ hu e maa ba.
Nyagbe munyuhi
13Nyɛɛ huɔ; nyɛɛ hɛɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ mi wawɛɛ; nyɛɛ pee kã, nɛ nyɛ he nɛ wa. 14Nyɛɛ kɛ suɔmi nɛ pee nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́.
15 Tse nyɛ le Stefana, kɛ e we mi bi ɔmɛ. Mɛ ji kekleekle nihi nɛ tsake pee Kristo se nyɛɛli ngɛ Akaya, nɛ a ngɔ a he ngɔ ha kaa a ma sɔmɔ ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ. Ye nyɛmimɛ, i kpa nyɛ pɛɛ, 16nyɛɛ ba nyɛ he si ha nihi kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ, kɛ ni nɛmɛ tsuo nɛ i kɛ mɛ tsuɔ ní ɔ.
17I na bua jɔmi babauu kaa Stefana, kɛ Fortunato, kɛ Akaiko ba hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ. Ejakaa nɛ nyɛ be ye ngɔ ngɛ hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ ko pee ha mi ɔ, a ngɛ pee pɛpɛɛpɛ. 18A ba wo mi bua kaa bɔ nɛ a wo nyɛ hu bua a. E hia kaa nyɛɛ le nihi kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ saminya.
19 Asafo ɔmɛ nɛ a ngɛ Asia a ke a biɔ nyɛ. Akuila, kɛ Priskila, kɛ asafo ɔ nɛ kpee ngɛ a we ɔ mi ɔ ke a biɔ nyɛ saminya ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ biɛ mi. 20Nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ ngɛ hiɛ ɔ ke a biɔ nyɛ.
Ke nyɛ kpe ɔ, nyɛ nga nyɛ sibi kɛ suɔmi nɛ sa Kristo se nyɛɛli kɛ je nyɛ tsui mi.
21Imi Paulo nitsɛ nɛ́ i ngma nyɛ enɛ ɔ, i biɔ nyɛ.
22Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ sume Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ, a gbiɛ lɛ!
Wa Nyɔmtsɛ, ba!
23Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo dloomi ɔ kɛ nyɛ nɛ hi si.
24Ye suɔmi ɔ kɛ nyɛ tsuo nɛ hi si ngɛ Kristo Yesu biɛ mi! Amen.

Title: KORINTO BI II, NYA TSƆƆMI
Content:
NYA TSƆƆMI
Benɛ Paulo ngma womi enyɔne nɛ ɔ, jamɛ a be ɔ, e kɛ Korinto asafo ɔ a kpɛti be saminya. Asafo ɔ mi bi komɛ te si wo lɛ, nɛ a doo e nya wawɛɛ. Se Paulo tsɔɔ paa kaa e ngɛ e tsui nɔ kaa e kɛ mɛ nɛ kpata. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, benɛ e kɛ mɛ ba kpata a, e na bua jɔmi saminya.
Womi ɔ kekleekle fa a mi ɔ, Paulo tsɔɔ bɔmi nɛ ngɛ e kɛ Korinto asafo ɔ a kpɛti. Benɛ asafo ɔ mi bi komɛ te si wo lɛ, nɛ a ngɛ munyu yaya tue ngɛ e he ɔ, lɛ hu e hɛ dɔ wo mɛ, nɛ e ka a hɛ mi. Paulo kɛ bua jɔmi tsɔɔ nya kaa enɛ ɔ nɛ e pee ɔ ha nɛ ni ɔmɛ tsake a tsui, nɛ e kɛ mɛ ba kpata. Jehanɛ, Paulo ngɔ pɛɛ kpami ngɔ fɔ asafo ɔ hɛ mi, konɛ a je a tsui mi nɛ a bua nɔ́ ko nya kɛ ha ohiatsɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ a kpɛti ngɛ Yudea a. Nyagbe ɔ, Paulo fa lɛ nitsɛ e he kaa bɔfo ji lɛ niinɛ. Jamɛ a be ɔ, ni komɛ ngɛ Korinto nɛ mɛɛ a buu a he kaa bɔfo kpakpahi ji mɛ, nɛ a tuɔ munyu kɛ siɔ Paulo kaa lɛɛ lakpa bɔfo ji lɛ.
Bɔ nɛ a dla womi ɔ mi ha
Sisije 1.1-11
Paulo kɛ Korinto asafo ɔ 1.12—7.16
Nike ní nɛ a kɛ mane nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ Yudea a 8.1—9.15
Paulo fa e he ngɛ blɔ nya nɛ e hɛɛ kaa bɔfo ɔ he 10.1—13.10
Nyagbe níhi 13.11-13

Title: KORINTO BI II, 1
Content:
1 Imi Paulo nɛ Mawu suɔmi nya a, i ba pee Kristo Yesu bɔfo ɔ, i kɛ wa nyɛmi Timoteo lɛ ngma womi nɛ ɔ ya ha Mawu asafo ɔ nɛ ngɛ Korinto, kɛ ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ ngɛ Akaya a.
2Dloomi kɛ he jɔmi nɛ je wa Tsɛ Mawu ɔ, kɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo dɛ mi ɔ ha nyɛ.
Paulo na Mawu si
3Nyɛ ha wa je Mawu, wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo Tsɛ ɔ yi. Tsɛ mɔbɔ nalɔ ji lɛ, nɛ e ji Mawu nɛ woɔ wɔ bua ngɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ mi hulɔ. 4E woɔ wa bua ngɛ haomihi tsuo a mi. Kɛkɛ ɔ, ke haomi ba ni kpahi a nɔ ɔ, bua womi nɛ wɔ nitsɛmɛ wa na kɛ je Mawu dɛ mi ɔ, wa ma nyɛ kɛ wo mɛ hu bua. 5Ejakaa wa ngɛ amanehlu babauu nae kaa Kristo se nyɛɛ li. Se bɔ nɛ Mawu wo Kristo bua a, ja nɔuu kɛ gu Kristo nɔ ɔ, Mawu woɔ wɔ hu wa bua. 6Ke wa ngɛ amanehlu nae ɔ, e baa konɛ Mawu nɛ wo nyɛ bua nɛ e he nyɛ yi wami. Be tsuaa be nɛ Mawu maa wo wɔ bua a, nyɛ hu nyɛ naa jamɛ a bua womi ɔ eko. Enɛ ɔ haa nɛ ke nyɛ ngɛ amanehlu nae kaa wɔ ɔ, nyɛ toɔ nyɛ tsui si. 7Wa ngɔ wa hɛ ngɔ fɔ nyɛ nɔ wawɛɛ, ejakaa wa le kaa nɛ nyɛ ngɛ nɔ́ nae kaa wɔ nɛ ɔ, jã kɛ̃ lɛ a maa wo nyɛ bua kaa wɔ.
8 Nyɛmimɛ, amanehlu nɛ wa na ngɛ Asia a, wa sume kaa wa maa laa nyɛ nɔ́ ko. Wa na nɔ́ tsɔ pe bɔ nɛ wa ma nyɛ, nɛ wa hɛ be nɔ kaa wa maa hi je mi tete. 9Wa na paa kaa peepee ta wa he, nɛ gbenɔ ji nɔ́ nɛ fɔɔ si ha wɔ. Se nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ba mi, konɛ wa ko ngɔ wa hɛ kɛ fɔ wɔ nitsɛmɛ wa nɔ, se mohu waa ngɔ wa he kɛ fɔ Mawu nɔ. Ejakaa lɛ nɛ e tleɔ ni gbogboehi si. 10Mawu nɛ́ je wɔ kɛ je gbenɔ muɔ nya kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ ngɛ wɔ jee kɛ mwɔɔ; nɛ e ma je wɔ ekohu. Wa ngɔ wa hɛ kɛ fɔ e nɔ kaa e maa kpale je wɔ kulaa. 11Nyɛ hu nyɛɛ piɛ wa he kɛ kpa pɛɛ, konɛ nihi babauu nɛ na Mawu si ha wɔ kaa nihi babauu a pɛɛ kpami nya a, wa na dloomi nike níhi.
Paulo tsake e yi mi tomi
12Nɔ́ kake nɛ wa fĩaa ngɔ fɔɔ nɔ, nɛ wa he nile hu yeɔ he odase ji kaa wa baa wa je mi saminya ngɛ he tsuaa he, titli ngɛ waa kɛ nyɛ wa bɔmi mi kaa bɔ nɛ Mawu ngɛ hlae ɔ. Wa yeɔ anɔkuale nɛ mu ko mu ko be wa he. Pi wɔ nitsɛmɛ wa nile nɛ waa kɛ peeɔ enɛ ɔ, se mohu Mawu dloomi ɔ nya. 13-14Ke wa ngɛ nyɛ womi ngmae ɔ, níhi nɛ nyɛ ma nyɛ kane nɛ nyɛ maa nu sisi pɛ wa ngmaa. Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, nyɛ nuɔ wɔ sisi fa kɛ fa kɛkɛ, se i heɔ yeɔ kaa nyɛ ma ba nu wɔ sisi saminya. Nɛ ligbi ɔ nɛ wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo maa kpale kɛ ba a, nyɛ maa fĩa kɛ fɔ wa nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ wɔ hu wa fĩaa kɛ fɔɔ nyɛ nɔ ɔ.
15Kikɛmɛ a ní nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ i le saminya a a he je nɛ i to ye yi mi kekle ɔ kaa ma ba slaa nyɛ, konɛ nyɛ na gbaami ɔ si enyɔ. 16 Ejakaa i to kaa ke i yaa Makedonia a, ma ba gu nyɛ ngɔ, nɛ ke i kpale ye se kɛ ma hu ma ba gu nyɛ ngɔ, konɛ nyɛɛ wo mi blɔ kɛ ya Yudea. 17Blɔɔ nɛ i tsake ye yi mi tomi ɔ, anɛ yi mi flɛflɛ i kɛ pee lo? Ke i ngɛ ye yi mi toe ɔ, anɛ i peeɔ ye ní kaa yaka nɔ ko kɛkɛ nɛ deɔ “Ee” kɛ “Dɛbi” be kake too lo? 18Mawu yeɔ anɔkuale, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ wa de nyɛ ɔ, pi “Ee” kɛ “Dɛbi” nɛ a deɔ be kake too ji lɔ ɔ. 19 Ejakaa sɛ gbi nɛ kɔɔ Mawu Bi, Yesu Kristo ɔ he nɛ i kɛ Silvano kɛ Timoteo fiɛ ngɔ ha nyɛ ɔ tsakee we kɛ je “Ee” ba pee “Dɛbi” be kake too. Mohu ɔ, lɛ ji “Ee” Mawu ɔ nɛ. 20Ejakaa níhi tsuo nɛ Mawu woɔ he si ɔ, e yeɔ nɔ kɛ guu Yesu Kristo nɔ. Enɛ ɔ he nɛ wa deɔ “Amen” ngɛ Yesu biɛ mi kɛ woɔ Mawu hɛ mi nyami ɔ nɛ. 21Mawu ji nɔ nɛ peeɔ waa kɛ nyɛ tsuo anɔkuale Kristo se nyɛɛli. Mawu nitsɛ lɛ hla wɔ ngɔ to, 22nɛ e wo wa he so. Lɛ nɛ e ngɔ Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ ngɔ wo wa tsui mi kɛ ma níhi tsuo nɛ e wo si ke e ma ha wɔ ɔ a nɔ mi.
23I na Mawu kaa pe i sume nɛ ma hao nyɛ, lɔ ɔ he loko i tsake ye yi mi tomi ɔ, nɛ i bɛ Korinto ɔ nɛ. 24Wa sume kaa wa maa nyɛ nyɛ nɔ nɛ waa tsɔɔ nɔ́ nɛ sa nɛ nyɛ he ye; wa le kaa nyɛ hɛɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ mi wawɛɛ. Mohu ɔ, waa kɛ nyɛ ngɛ ní tsue, konɛ nyɛ na bua jɔmi.

Title: KORINTO BI II, 2
Content:
1Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i pee ye juɛmi kaa i be bae ba slaa nyɛ hu, nɛ e ko ba pee haomi kɛ kɔmɔ yemi ha nyɛ. 2Ejakaa ke i ha nɛ nyɛ ní pee mɔbɔ ɔ, mɛnɔ maa wo mi bua? Pi nyɛ nihi nɛ i ha nyɛ ní pee mɔbɔ ɔ kɛ̃ lo? 3Enɛ ɔ he nɛ i ngma nyɛ womi ɔ nɛ. I sume kaa ke i ba nyɛ ngɔ ɔ, nihi nɛ ma ha mi bua jɔmi ɔ, ma ha nɛ mɛ mohu a ní nɛ pee mɔbɔ. Ejakaa i le kaa ke ye bua jɔ kɛkɛ nyɛ tsuo nyɛ bua jɔ. 4Benɛ i ngɛ nyɛ womi ɔ ngmae ɔ, he hiami sɔuu ha nɛ ye tsui kpa miɔ nɛ e ma tsɔ, nɛ kikɛ nɛ ɔ vo nyu ngɛ ye hɛngmɛ mi jee kɛ ngɛ si puee. Pi ye yi mi tomi ji kaa ma ha nɛ nyɛɛ ye kɔmɔ, se mohu bɔ nɛ pee nɛ nyɛɛ na bɔ nɛ i suɔ nyɛ ha.
Paulo ngɔ nɔ ko nɛ tɔ ɔ he yayami kɛ pa lɛ
5Ke nɔ ko ha nɛ nyɛ ye kɔmɔ ɔ, pi imi nɔ́ nɛ e pee; ngɛ blɔ ko nɔ ɔ, nyɛ tsuo nɔ́ lɛ e pee ɔ nɛ. (I ngɛ enɛ ɔ dee, ejakaa i sume nɛ ma hɛɛ sane ɔ mi wawɛɛ tsɔ). 6Jamɛatsɛ ɔ, nɛ nyɛ ti ni komɛ gbla e tue kikɛ nɛ ɔ kɛkɛ e hiɛ. 7Jehanɛ lɛɛ nyɛɛ ngɔ e he yayami kɛ pa lɛ, nɛ nyɛɛ wo lɛ bua, konɛ e ko ba ye kɔmɔ tsɔ, nɛ e kɔni mi ba jɔ̃. 8Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i kpa nyɛ pɛɛ nɛ nyɛ ha nɛ e le kaa nyɛ suɔ lɛ. 9I ngma nyɛ jamɛ a womi ɔ nɛ ma kɛ ka nyɛ ma hyɛ kaa ke i de nyɛ ke nyɛɛ pee nɔ́ ko ɔ, nyɛ maa pee lo. 10Ke nyɛɛ kɛ nɔ ko he yayami pa lɛ ɔ, kɛkɛ imi hu i kɛ pa lɛ. Ke e hia kaa ma ngɔ nɔ ko he yayami kɛ pa lɛ ɔ, nyɛ he ɔ, i ngɔɔ kɛ paa lɛ; ejakaa i le kaa nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ pee ɔ, Kristo ngɛ hyɛe. 11I peeɔ enɛ ɔ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ Abosiami nɛ ko na he wami ngɛ wa nɔ, ejakaa wa le gahi nɛ e toɔ.
Paulo hi Troya be kpiti pɛ
12 Benɛ i ba Troya nɛ ma ba fiɛ sane kpakpa a nɛ kɔɔ Kristo he ɔ, i na kaa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ dla blɔ ngɔ to mi nɛ ma tsu ní ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. 13Se i hao, ejakaa i nɛ wa nyɛmi Tito. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i kɛ mɛ ye sɛ, nɛ i pue nɔ kɛ ho Makedonia ya.
Kristo ha wa ye kunimi
14Se sina ha Mawu! Mawu haa Kristo yeɔ yayami he wami ɔ nɔ kunimi daa, nɛ kikɛmɛ a kunimi yemi nɛ ɔ peeɔ wɔ bɔfo ɔmɛ hu wa nɔ́. Mawu guu wa nɔ kɛ fiɛɔ sɛ gbi nɛ kɔɔ Kristo he ɔ kɛ yaa he tsuaa he kaa bɔ nɛ nɔ́ ko he via yaa tsitsaa a. 15Ejakaa wa ngɛ kaa tsopa kɛ e he via liliili nɛ Kristo kɛ sãã bɔ ha Mawu. Wa nɔ nɛ a guu kɛ fiɛɔ sane kpakpa a nɛ kɔɔ Kristo he ɔ kɛ haa je ɔ tsuo, nihi nɛ ngɛ blɔ nɔ kɛ yaa neneene wami mi, kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ blɔ nɔ kɛ yaa hɛ mi kpatami mi. 16Nihi nɛ ngɛ blɔ nɔ kɛ yaa hɛ mi kpatami mi ɔ, Kristo sɛ gbi ɔ ji gbenɔ ha mɛ. Se ni nɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ blɔ nɔ kɛ yaa neneene wami mi ɔ lɛɛ sɛ gbi ɔ ji wami ha mɛ. Ní tsumi kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ, mɛnɔ ma nyɛ? 17Wɔɔ lɛɛ wa be kaa ni kpa komɛ nɛ mɛɛ a ngɔ Mawu munyu ɔ ngɔ pee je juami nɔ́ nɛ a kɛ ngɛ si kpae ɔ. Se mohu kaa nihi nɛ le Kristo ɔ, wa tuɔ anɔkuale ɔ sisi kaa nihi nɛ a tsɔ mɛ kɛ je Mawu nitsɛ ngɔ.

Title: KORINTO BI II, 3
Content:
Somi he ɔ he sɔmɔli
1Ke wa de jã a, anɛ lɔ ɔ tsɔɔ kaa wa ngɛ wɔ nitsɛmɛ wa yi jee ekohu lo? Anɛ yi jemi womi nɛ ni kpahi maa ngma kɛ ba je wa yi ha nyɛ, aloo nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ maa ngma kɛ ya je wa yi ha ni kpahi he hia wɔ lo? Dɛbi! 2Nyɛ nitsɛmɛ ji yi jemi womi nɛ a ngma ha wɔ ngɛ wa tsui mi, konɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ kane nɛ e nu sisi. 3 Nyɛ ngɛ kaa womi nɛ Kristo nitsɛ ngma nɛ e kɛ tsɔ wɔ; pi womi nɛ a kɛ ní ngmami nyu ngmaa ngɛ tɛ tɛtlɛɛhi a nɔ ɔ. Se mohu, enɛ ɔ ji womi nɛ Kristo ngma kɛ gu Mawu hɛ kalɔ ɔ mumi ɔ nɔ ngɛ adesa tsui mi.
4Wa ngɛ enɛ ɔ dee, ejakaa kɛ gu Kristo nɔ ɔ, wa ngɛ hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi ngɛ Mawu mi. 5Ní tsumi nɛ ɔ, wa be dee ke wɔ nitsɛmɛ wa ngɛ he wami nɛ wa ma nyɛ tsu. He wami nɛ wa ngɛ ɔ, Mawu lɛ ha wɔ. 6 Mawu nɛ ha nɛ wa nyɛ nɛ wa ngɛ lɛ Mawu ɔ sɔmɔe kaa bɔ nɛ somi he ɔ tsɔɔ ɔ. Pi mlaa nɛ a ngma nɛ waa ye nɔ ji somi he ɔ, se mohu Mawu mumi. Mlaa nɛ a ngma a, gbenɔ nɛ e kɛ baa, se mumi ɔ haa nɔ wami.
7 Mlaa a nɛ a kpɛ́ ngɛ tɛhi a nɔ nɛ kɛ gbenɔ ba a, benɛ a ngɔ ha a, Mawu hɛ mi nyami ɔ je kpo. Hɛ mi nyami ɔ ha nɛ Mose hɛ mi ngɛ kpɛe. Ke jamɛ a be ɔ mi po nɛ hɛ mi nyami ɔ miɔ nɛ e maa ta a, e ha nɛ Mose hɛ mi ngɛ kpɛe bɔ nɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ nyɛ we Mose hɛ mi hyɛmi ɔ, 8lɛɛ be nɛ ɔ mi nɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ ngɛ ní tsue ɔ, anɛ Mawu hɛ mi nyami ɔ be kpɛe kulaa pe kekle ɔ lo? 9Ke hɛ mi nyami kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ je kpo somi momo be ɔ mi ɔ, somi he be nɛ ɔ mi lɛɛ hɛ mi nyami ɔ ma kpɛ kɛ be nɔ pe kekle ɔ po. 10Niinɛ, wa ma de ke nɔ́ ko nɛ hɛ mi ngɛ nyami be ko ɔ, amlɔ nɛ ɔ, jamɛ a hɛ mi nyami ɔ se po. Ejakaa nɔ́ kpa ko ba nɛ e hɛ mi nyami ɔ pã kekle nɔ́ ɔ kulaa. 11Ke nɔ́ nɛ hi si be kpiti kɛkɛ ɔ hɛ mi nyami je kpo ɔ, lɛɛ nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ daa a hɛ mi nyami ɔ pe lɔ ɔ hluu.
12Akɛnɛ wa ngɛ kikɛmɛ a hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi nɛ ɔ he je ɔ, wa tuɔ munyu kɛ kã. 13 Wa be kaa Mose nɛ ngɔ hɛ mi hami nɔ́ ngɔ ha e hɛ mi, konɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ nɛ a kó na kaa e hɛ mi nɛ ngɛ kpɛe ɔ se miɔ nɛ e maa po ɔ. 14Niinɛ, a nga a juɛmi nya! Kɛ ba su mwɔnɛ ligbi nɛ ɔ, kaa nɔ́ nɛ jamɛ a hɛ mi hami nɔ́ ɔ ha a hɛ mi kɛ mwɔɔ; ejakaa ke a kane somi momo ɔ, a nui sisi. Kristo pɛ lɛ ma nyɛ ma je hɛ mi hami nɔ́ nɛ ɔ. 15Ee, kɛ ba su mwɔnɛ ɔ, be tsuaa be nɛ a ngɛ Mose mlaa a kanee ɔ, hɛ mi hami nɔ́ ɔ ha a juɛmi nɔ. 16 Se ke a kpale kɛ ba Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ngɔ kɛkɛ a ma je hɛ mi hami nɔ́ ɔ ha mɛ. 17Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ji mumi ɔ nɛ, nɛ he nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ mumi ɔ ngɛ ɔ, lejɛ ɔ he yemi ngɛ. 18Wɔ Kristo we bi lɛɛ hɛ mi hami nɔ́ ko be wa hɛ mi; wa ngɛ kaa a huhuɛ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ hɛ mi nyami ɔ kpɛɔ kɛ guu mi. Kikɛmɛ a hɛ mi nyami ɔ ji Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ mumi ɔ nɛ. Nɛ akɛnɛ mumi ɔ ngɛ ní tsue ngɛ wa mi daa he je ɔ, wa ngɛ tsakee ngɛ pee kaa lɛ.

Title: KORINTO BI II, 4
Content:
Adesa gbɔjɔmi kɛ Mawu he wami
1Akɛnɛ Mawu naa mɔbɔ he je ɔ, e ha wɔ ní tsumi nɛ ɔ ke wa tsu. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, wa kɔni mi jɔ̃ we. 2Wa kpa laami mi zo ní tsumi; wa yi kutupɔ, nɛ Mawu munyu ɔ hu wa tsakee we hɛ mi. Wa fiɛɔ Mawu sɛ gbi ɔ paa ngɛ ma hɛ mi, nɛ wa bɔɔ mɔde kaa nihi nɛ a ná wa he juɛmi kpakpa ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi. 3Niinɛ, sane kpakpa a nɛ wa ngɛ fiɛe ɔ, ni komɛ nui sisi; mɛ ji nihi nɛ a hɛ mi ngɛ kpatae ɔ nɛ. 4A he we sane kpakpa a yi, ejakaa je nɛ ɔ mi mawu ɔ yu a mumi mi hɛngmɛ; nɛ la nɛ ngɛ kpɛe ngɛ a nɔ ɔ, a nɛ. Sane kpakpa a nɛ woɔ Kristo hɛ mi nyami ɔ, la nɛ ɔ nɛ ngɛ lɛ gbɛe kɛ ngɛ fĩae. Kristo ɔ, e kɛ Mawu hɛɛ su kake. 5Ejakaa wa de we nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko ngɛ wɔ nitsɛmɛ wa he; se mohu wa ngɛ fiɛe ke Yesu Kristo ji Nyɔmtsɛ. Wɔɔ lɛɛ Yesu he ɔ, nyɛ tsɔli ji wɔ. 6 Mawu lɛ de ke, “La nɛ tso kɛ je diblii mi.” Lɛ Mawu ɔ nɔuu lɛ haa la kpɛɔ ngɛ wa tsui mi. Nɛ la nɛ ɔ haa wa leɔ Mawu hɛ mi nyami nɛ kpɛɔ ngɛ Kristo hɛ mi ɔ.
7Wɔ nɛ wa ná kikɛmɛ a mumi mi juetli nɛ ɔ, wa ngɛ kaa zu buɛhi. Enɛ ɔ tsɔɔ kaa he wami kpetekpleenyɛ nɛ ɔ, Mawu ngɔ nɛ e je, pi wɔɔ wa ngɔ. 8Nihi haoɔ wɔ be tsuaa be, se kɛ̃ ɔ, a yi wa nɔ; be komɛ ɔ, wa yi mi peeɔ wɔ enyɔɔnyɔ, se kɛ̃ ɔ, wa nine mi wui nyu; 9a waa wɔ yi mi, se kɛ̃ ɔ, Mawu lɛɛ e kua we wɔ; be komɛ hu a kongoɔ wɔ basabasa, se wa gbo we. 10Daa nɛ ɔ, a ngɛ wɔ dae nɛ a gbe wɔ kaa bɔ nɛ a gbe Yesu ɔ, konɛ a na wɔ kaa wɔ hu wa baa wa je mi kaa Kristo. 11Wa wami be ɔ tsuo ɔ, Yesu he ɔ, nihi ngɛ wɔ dae nɛ a gbe wɔ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ a na Kristo wami ɔ ngɛ wa he lo nɛ ma gbo nɛ ɔ mi. 12Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, wɔɔ wa ngɛ gbenɔ nya mi, konɛ a he nyɛ yi wami.
13 Ngmami ɔ ke, “I he Mawu ye, nɛ lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i tu munyu.” Wɔ hu wa ngɛ jamɛ a hemi kɛ yemi ɔ nɔuu; wɔ hu wa heɔ yeɔ, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, wa ngɛ fiɛe. 14Ejakaa wa le kaa Mawu tle Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu si kɛ ba wami mi ekohu. Wa le kaa e ma tle wɔ hu si kaa bɔ nɛ e tle Yesu si ɔ. Nɛ e maa ngɔ waa kɛ nyɛ tsuo kɛ ya Yesu ngɔ. 15Nyɛ he nɛ a ngɛ enɛ ɔ tsuo pee ngɛ. Nɛ ke Mawu dloomi nya a, a ba he nihi fuu a yi wami ɔ, jã kɛ̃ sina sɔlemi ɔ maa hiɛ kɛ wo Mawu hɛ mi nyami.
Si himi ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi nya
16Enɛ ɔ he ɔ, wa kɔni mi jɔ̃ we gblegbleegble. E ngɛ mi kaa wa nɔmlɔ tso ɔ ngɛ puɛe bɔɔbɔɔbɔɔ mohu, se mumi mi ɔ, wa ngɛ wae daa ligbi. 17Amanehlu nɛ nya wa, nɛ se be kɛe kulaa nɛ ɔ ma ha wa hɛ mi maa ba nyami babauu kɛ be nɔ kɛ maa ya neneene. 18Wa ngɔ wa hɛ ngɔ fɔ níhi nɛ a nɛ́ nɔ, se pi níhi nɛ a naa. Ejakaa níhi nɛ a naa a, hii si be bɔɔ ko kɛkɛ; se níhi nɛ a nɛ́ ɔ, hii si kɛ yaa neneene.

Title: KORINTO BI II, 5
Content:
1Ejakaa wa le kaa ke a puɛ zugba nɛ ɔ nɔ bo tsu nɛ wa ngɛ mi nɛ ɔ, Mawu ma ha wɔ we ngɛ hiɔwe. We nɛ ɔ, pi nine nɛ a kɛ ma, nɛ e maa hi si kɛ maa ya neneene. 2Be mi nɛ wa ngɛ bo tsu nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, wa hɛ jaa, nɛ wa faa huu kaa a ngɔ wa tsu nɛ je hiɔwe ɔ ngɔ wo wɔ. 3Ke wa ngɔ lɔ ɔ kɛ ha wa he ɔ, nɔ ko be nae kaa wa hɛɛ wa he gu. 4Be mi nɛ wa ngɛ bo tsu nɛ ɔ mi kɛ mwɔɔ ɔ, wa he hiaa wɔ, nɛ wa faa huu. Pi kaa wa suɔ kaa waa ngmɛɛ wa zugba nɛ ɔ nɔ bo tsu ɔ he, se mohu kaa waa ngɔ hiɔwe nɔ́ ɔ hu kɛ ha wa he. Kɛkɛ ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ wami ɔ ma tsake nɔ́ nɛ gboɔ ɔ. 5Mawu lɛ je blɔ dla wɔ kɛ ha tsakemi nɛ ɔ, nɛ e ha wɔ e mumi ɔ kɛ ma nɔ mi.
6Enɛ ɔ he ɔ, wa nɔ gbagba teɔ. Ejakaa wa le kaa be abɔ nɛ wa ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi nɔmlɔ tso ɔ mi kɛ mwɔɔ ɔ, waa kɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ he kɛ. 7Ejakaa he mi kɛ yemi nya wa baa wa je mi ngɛ, se pi níhi nɛ wa na a he. 8Wa nɔ gbagba te, nɛ wa na nɛ wa je wa nɔmlɔ tso ɔ mi, nɛ wa ho nɛ waa kɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu ya hi si. 9Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔmlɔ tso nɛ ɔ mi wa ngɛ jio, pe wa je mi nɛ wa ho ya piɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ he jio, nɔ́ nɛ wa ngɔ ma wa hɛ mi ji kaa waa sa e hɛ mi. 10 Ejakaa ja wɔ tsuo wa pue ngɛ Kristo hɛ mi, nɛ e kojo wɔ. Nɔ tsuaa nɔ ma na nɔ́ nɛ e tsu ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi ɔ he hiɔwo, kpakpa jio, yayami jio.
Mawu kɛ huɛ bɔmi ngɛ Kristo mi
11Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, wɔ nɛ waa kɛ bu yee Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ gbeye ɔ, wa bɔɔ mɔde tuɔ munyu tsɔɔ nihi. Wɔ nitsɛmɛ lɛɛ, Mawu le bɔ nɛ wa ngɛ ha. Nɛ i heɔ yeɔ kaa nyɛ hu nyɛ le wɔ kɛ pi si jã nɔuu. 12Nyɛ ko susu kaa wɔ nitsɛmɛ wa yi wa pa ngɛ jee ha nyɛ ekohu. Dɛbi! Waa kɛ enɛ ɔ ngɛ nyɛ blɔ hae, konɛ nyɛ kɛ fĩa ngɔ fɔ wa nɔ. Kɛkɛ ɔ, nihi nɛ hyɛɛ nihi a hɛ mi, se pi a tsui mi, nɛ a fĩaa ngɔ fɔɔ a nɔ ɔ, nyɛ ma ná nɔ́ ko ma de mɛ. 13Anɛ wa ngɛ godo nue niinɛ lo? Lɛɛ Mawu he wa ngɛ godo nue ngɛ mɔ! Se ke wa ngɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ ɔ, lɛɛ e hi ha nyɛ kaa wa ngɛ jã. 14Suɔmi nɛ Kristo ngɛ kɛ ha wɔ ɔ woɔ wɔ he wami. Kristo gbo ha wɔ tsuo. Nɛ wa heɔ yeɔ kaa gbenɔ nɛ nɔ kake gbo ha nihi tsuo nɛ ɔ tsɔɔ kaa ni ɔmɛ tsuo gbo. 15Kristo gbo ha nihi tsuo, konɛ nihi nɛ a hɛ ngɛ ɔ, a ko pee mɛ nitsɛmɛ a suɔmi nya ní hu; se mohu a pee Kristo suɔmi nya ní. Ejakaa Kristo gbo, nɛ Mawu tle lɛ si kɛ ba wami mi ekohu ngɛ mɛɛ a he.
16Kɛ je be nɛ ɔ mi kɛ yaa a, wa kojo we nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ adesa to blɔ nya a hu. E ngɛ mi kaa be ko nɛ be ɔ, jã lɛ wa kojo Kristo; se piɔ lɛɛ wa pee we jã hu. 17Ke nɔ ko ba pee Kristo nɔ́ kɛkɛ e plɛ bɔ nɔ́ he; blema ní ɔmɛ tsuo be kɛ ho. Hyɛ, níhi tsuo pee e he. 18Mawu lɛ pee enɛ ɔ tsuo. Kɛ gu Kristo nɔ ɔ, e dla waa kɛ lɛ wa kpɛti. Nɛ ní tsumi nɛ e ngɔ wo wa dɛ ji kaa wa ha nɛ a dla e kɛ nihi tsuo a kpɛti. 19Nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ tsɔɔe ji kaa kɛ gu Kristo nɔ ɔ, Mawu ngɔ je ɔ tsuo he yayami kɛ pa mɛ, nɛ e ngɛ e kɛ je ɔ tsuo a kpɛti dlae; nɛ sɛ gbi nɛ e tu ngɔ wo wa dɛ mi ji kaa e suɔ nɛ a dla e kɛ je ɔ tsuo a kpɛti.
20Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, wa ji bɔfohi ngɛ Kristo biɛ mi ejakaa Mawu gu wa nɔ nɛ e kɛ nihi ngɛ munyu tue. Waa kɛ Kristo biɛ ngɛ nyɛ pɛɛ kpae ke nyɛ ha nɛ a dla nyɛɛ kɛ Mawu nyɛ kpɛti. 21Kristo pee we yayami, se wa he ɔ, Mawu bu lɛ yayami peelɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɛ wa ba pee Kristo se nyɛɛli ɔ, wa peeɔ níhi nɛ da ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi.

Title: KORINTO BI II, 6
Content:
1Akɛnɛ waa kɛ Mawu ngɛ ní tsue ɔ, wa kpa nyɛ pɛɛ, dloomi nɛ nyɛ na kɛ je Mawu dɛ mi ɔ, nyɛ ko ha nɛ e pee yaka. 2 Mawu ke,
“Be nɛ sa mi ɔ, i bu mo tue;
Nɛ yi wami hemi ligbi nɔ i ye bua mo ngɛ.”
Hyɛ, be nɛ sa saminya ji nɛ ɔ nɛ; hyɛ mwɔnɛ ɔ ji yi wami hemi ligbi ɔ nɛ.
3Wa bɔɔ mɔde kaa wa ko ngɔ nɔ́ ko kɛ tsi nɔ ko blɔ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ a ko gbe sɔmɔmi ní tsumi nɛ wa hɛɛ mi ɔ he guɛ. 4Se mohu ngɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ mi ɔ, wa bɔɔ mɔde kaa wa maa tsɔɔ kaa Mawu tsɔli ji wɔ niinɛ. Wa toɔ wa tsui si ngɛ haomi, kɛ fimi, kɛ he hiami mi. 5 A fia wɔ ní; a wo wɔ tsu, nɛ nihi pee basabasa kɛ wo wɔ; wa gbo dengme kɛ tsu ní; wa hwɔ we mahe be komɛ, nɛ be komɛ hu hwɔ yee wɔ. 6Waa kɛ subai kpakpa, nile nɛ mi kuɔ, tsui si tomi, mi mi himi, klɔuklɔu peemi ngɛ mumi mi, anɔkuale suɔmi, 7anɔkuale munyu tumi, kɛ Mawu he wami nɛ ngɛ ní tsue ngɛ wa mi ɔ tsɔɔ kaa Mawu tsɔli ji wɔ. Wa peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da, nɛ lɔ ɔ ji wa ta hwumi ní nɛ waa hɛɛ hiɔ kɛ muɔ nɛ wa kɛ faa wa he. 8Ni komɛ woɔ wa hɛ mi nyami, se ni komɛ gbeɔ wa he guɛ; ni komɛ jɛɔ wɔ, se ni komɛ hu jeɔ wa yi. A tsɛɔ wɔ nɔ sisili, se anɔkuale wa tuɔ. 9Wa ngɛ kaa nihi nɛ a li mɛ, se kɛ̃ ɔ, nɔ tsuaa nɔ le wɔ; wa ngɛ kaa nihi nɛ gbo, se kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ hyɛe ɔ, wa hɛ ngɛ. A gblaa wa tue, se wa gbo we. 10A naa wɔ kaa kɔmɔ yeli, se daa nɛ ɔ, wa bua jɔ; wa ngɛ kaa ohiatsɛmɛ, se wa haa nɛ nihi babauu peeɔ niatsɛmɛ; wa ngɛ kaa dɛgutsɛmɛ, se wa ngɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́.
11Wa nyɛmimɛ Korinto bi! Waa kɛ nyɛ ngɛ munyu tue kɛ je wa tsui mi faa. 12Wɔɔ lɛɛ wa je wa suɔmi kpo ha nyɛ; nyɛ lɛ nyɛ gbo we wa nɔ. 13Jehanɛ lɛɛ, i kɛ nyɛ maa tu munyu kaa bɔ nɛ i kɛ imi nitsɛ ye bimɛ maa tu munyu ɔ. Nyɛ hu nyɛ bli nyɛ tsui nya gbajaa ha wɔ.
Nihi nɛ li Kristo ɔ, nyɛɛ kɛ mɛ ko bɔ
14Nyɛɛ kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ he we yi ɔ kó bɔ. Dami sane yemi kɛ mlaa tɔmi ɔ, mɛni kake peemi ngɛ a kpɛti? Aloo mɛni bɔmi lɛ ngɛ la kɛ diblii a kpɛti? 15Kɛ Kristo kɛ Abosiami maa ye kɛɛ? Nɔ nɛ heɔ yeɔ, mɛni mi e kɛ nɔ nɛ he we yi ɔ ngɛ? 16 Mɛni kake peemi ngɛ Mawu sɔlemi we ɔ kɛ amagahi a kpɛti? Ejakaa wɔɔ lɛɛ Mawu hɛ kalɔ ɔ sɔlemi we ji wɔ! Mawu de ke,
“I kɛ ye ma a maa hi si;
ma pee a Mawu,
nɛ mɛ hu a maa pee ye ma.”
17 Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ke,
“Nyɛɛ je a kpɛti,
nɛ nyɛ tsɔ nyɛ he kɛ je a he.
Nyɛ ko ta nɔ́ ko nɛ he tsɔ we he;
nɛ ma he nyɛ atuu.
18 Ma pee nyɛ tsɛ,
nɛ nyɛ maa pee
ye binyumuhi kɛ ye biyihi.
Imi, Nyɔmtsɛ Ope ɔ, lɛ i de.”

Title: KORINTO BI II, 7
Content:
1Siwohi nɛ wa na kɛ je Mawu dɛ mi ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ye nyɛmimɛ nyɛ ha wa je níhi tsuo nɛ woɔ wa nɔmlɔ tso, kɛ mumi he mu kɛ ya se, konɛ wa he nɛ tsɔ kulaa kɛ hi si ngɛ Mawu gbeye yemi nya.
Paulo na bua jɔmi
2Nyɛ je nyɛ suɔmi kpo kɛ tsɔɔ wɔ! Wa pee we nɔ ko yayami; wa kpataa we nɔ ko nane, nɛ wa sisi we nɔ ko hulɔ. 3I de we enɛ ɔ nɛ ma kɛ bu nyɛ fɔ. Se kaa bɔ nɛ i de nyɛ momo ɔ, suɔmi nɛ wa ngɛ kɛ ha nyɛ ɔ nya wa bɔ nɛ nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko be nyɛe ma gba waa kɛ nyɛ wa kpɛti, gbenɔ jio, wami nɛ ɔ mi jio. 4I fĩaa ngɔ fɔɔ nyɛ nɔ, ejakaa i ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi babauu ngɛ nyɛ mi. Ngɛ wa haomi ɔmɛ tsuo a mi ɔ, ye nine mi ji wu; ye bua jɔmi mohu lɛ hiɛ kɛ be nɔ.
5 Benɛ wa ba su Makedonia tete po wa nɔmlɔ tso ɔ na we he jɔmi kulaa; he tsuaa he ɔ, haomi sɔuu. Be mi nɛ ni kpahi kɛ wɔ ngɛ pɛ nɔ daa nɛ ɔ, wɔ nitsɛmɛ hu gbeye sɔuu wa ngɛ yee. 6Se benɛ Tito ba a, Mawu, nɔ nɛ woɔ nihi nɛ a nine mi jɔ̃ he wami ɔ ha nɛ wa nɔ gbagba te. 7Pi e bami ɔ kɛkɛ nɛ ha nɛ wa nɔ gbagba te ɔ, se amaniɛ nɛ e ba bɔ wɔ nɛ tsɔɔ bɔ nɛ nyɛ hu nyɛ wo lɛ he wami ngɛ lejɛ ɔ piɛ he. E bɔ wɔ bɔ nɛ nyɛ suɔ kaa nyɛ maa na mi ekohu, bɔ nɛ nyɛ hao ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ ba a he, kɛ bɔ nɛ nyɛ pee klaalo nɛ nyɛ ma fa ye he. Enɛ ɔ ha nɛ i na bua jɔmi kulaa pe kekle ɔ.
8Jamɛ a womi ɔ nɛ i ngma nyɛ ɔ ha nɛ nyɛ hao mohu lɛɛ, se i pia we ye he kaa i ngma. I pia ye he kaa womi ɔ ha nɛ nyɛ hao, pohu be kpiti ko kɛkɛ. 9Se amlɔ nɛ ɔ lɛɛ ye bua jɔ ye he kaa i ngma womi ɔ. Ye bua jɔɛ ye he kaa i ha nɛ nyɛ hao, se mohu ye bua jɔ kaa lɔ ɔ ha nɛ nyɛ tsake nyɛ blɔhi. Ejakaa e hao nyɛ bɔ nɛ sa Mawu hɛ mi. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, wɔɔ lɛɛ wa pee we nyɛ nɔ́ ko yeyee. 10Ejakaa ke o hao bɔ nɛ sa Mawu hɛ mi ɔ, e haa o tsakeɔ o tsui, nɛ a heɔ o yi wami. Enɛ ɔ lɛɛ he piami ko be mi! Se ke o hao ngɛ níhi nɛ sa je ɔ hɛ mi he ɔ, gbenɔ lɛ jeɔ mi. 11Nɛ́ e pee nyɛ kaa nyɛ hao ɔ, nyɛɛ hyɛ nɔ́ nɛ je mi kɛ ba! Nyɛ nɔ gbagba te, nɛ nyɛ suɔ kaa nyɛ maa tsɔɔ kaa nyɛ pee we yayami ko. Nɔ́ nɛ ba a dɔ nyɛ, nɛ nyɛ ye gbeye kaa nɔ́ ko pa ngɛ se kɛ ma. E pee nyɛ kaa nyɛɛ na mi, konɛ nyɛ fa ye he, nɛ nyɛɛ gbla yayami peelɔ ɔ tue. Ngɛ blɔ tsuaa blɔ nɔ ɔ, nyɛ tsɔɔ kaa sane nɛ ba a, nyɛ li he nɔ́ ko.
12Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, womi ɔ nɛ i ngma nyɛ ɔ, tsa pi nɔ ɔ, aloo nɔ nɛ a tɔ̃ e nɔ ɔ he titli nɛ e kɔɔ. I ngma womi ɔ konɛ dengme nɛ nyɛ ngɛ gboe ngɛ wa he ɔ nɛ je kpo paa ha nyɛ ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi. 13Enɛ ɔ lɛ ha nɛ wa nɔ gbagba te ɔ nɛ.
Wa nɔ gbagba te niinɛ. Se bua jɔmi nɛ Tito na a ha nɛ wɔ nitsɛmɛ hu wa bua jɔ kɛ be nɔ. Ejakaa e bɔ wɔ bɔ nɛ nyɛ ha nɛ e tsui nɔ e mi ha. 14I je nyɛ yi ha Tito, nɛ nyɛ gbi mi zo. Wa tuɔ nyɛ anɔkuale daa. Jã kɛ̃ ɔ, fiami nɛ wa fĩa fɔ nyɛ nɔ ngɔ tsɔɔ Tito ɔ hu ya pee we lakpa. 15Tito kaiɔ bɔ nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ he si bami, kɛ bu he lɛ atuu, kɛ bɔ nɛ nyɛ tsuo nyɛ pee klaalo nɛ ke e de nyɛ nɔ́ ko nɛ nyɛ peeɔ ɔ. Enɛ ɔ he ɔ, e na suɔmi babauu kɛ ha nyɛ pe kekle ɔ po. 16Ye bua jɔ kaa ma nyɛ ma ngɔ ye hɛ kɛ fɔ nyɛ nɔ kulaa ngɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ mi.

Title: KORINTO BI II, 8
Content:
Kristo we bi a nɔ́ hami
1 Nyɛmimɛ! Wa ngɛ hlae nɛ nyɛɛ le nɔ́ nɛ Mawu dloomi ɔ tsu ngɛ asafo ɔmɛ a mi ngɛ Makedonia. 2Wa nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ Makedonia nɛ heɔ Kristo yeɔ ɔ ba na amanehlu wawɛɛ; se be tsuaa be ɔ, a bua jɔ. Jehanɛ hu, nɔ́ ko be a dɛ, se kɛ̃ ɔ, a ha nɔ́ faa kɛ je a tsui mi. 3I ngɛ odase yee kaa a ha bɔ nɛ a ma nyɛ kɛ je a tsui mi faa; ee, a ha pe bɔ nɛ a ma nyɛ po. 4A kɛ hɛdɔ babauu kpa wɔ pɛɛ ke wa ha nɛ mɛ hu a pee a blɔ nya kɛ ye bua ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ ngɛ sɔmɔmi ní tsumi nɛ ɔ mi. 5Nɔ́ nɛ nyɛɛ se ɔ, wa hɛ be nɔ kulaa! Kekleekle ɔ, a ngɔ a he ngɔ ha kaa a ma sɔmɔ Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu ngɛ blɔ tsuaa blɔ nɔ. Jehanɛ hu, a wo wɔ si ke a maa bu wɔ tue kaa bɔ nɛ Mawu hlaa nɛ a pee ɔ. 6Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, wa kpa Tito pɛɛ kaa tsui mi faa ní tsumi nɛ ɔ nɛ e je sisi momo ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti ɔ, e tsa nɔ kɛ yaa si e maa gbe nya. 7Nyɛ ngɛ ni kpa amɛ a hɛ mi kulaa ngɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ mi, hemi kɛ yemi ngɛ Kristo mi, munyu tumi, anɔkuale ɔ lemi, hɛdɔ kɛ ha sɔmɔmi, kɛ suɔmi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ kɛ ha wɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, kikɛmɛ a ní tsumi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ tsue kɛ je nyɛ tsui mi ɔ hu, nyɛɛ hyɛ konɛ nyɛɛ be ni kpa amɛ a he jã nɔuu.
8Pi mlaa nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ woe. Dɛbi! Hɛdɔ nɛ Makedonia asafo ɔmɛ kɛ tsu ní ɔ nɛ i kɛ ngɛ nyɛ suɔmi ɔ he toe kaa e je tsui klɔuu mi lo. 9Nyɛ le suɔmi agbo nɛ wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo ngɛ kɛ ha wɔ. Niatsɛ mi niatsɛ ji lɛ. Se nyɛ he ɔ, e pee e he ohiatsɛ, konɛ nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛɛ pee niatsɛmɛ.
10Ga nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ woe kɛkɛ ji kaa tsumi nɛ ɔ sa nyɛ. Ejakaa nyɛ juɛmi a kɛ to he ga, nɛ nyɛ ji kekleekle nihi nɛ bɔni tsumi jeha ji nɛ. 11Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ bɔ mɔde nɛ nyɛɛ gbe tsumi ɔ nya. Hɛdɔ nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ to he ga a, nyɛɛ kɛ jamɛ a hɛdɔ ɔ nɔuu nɛ gbe nya. Nyɛ ha bɔ nɛ nyɛ ma nyɛ! 12Ke o ha bɔ nɛ o ma nyɛ kɛ o tsui faa a, Mawu ma ná o nike ní ɔ he bua jɔmi. Mawu hyɛ we blɔ kaa o ha nɔ́ ko be mi nɛ nɔ́ ko be o dɛ.
13-14I tsɔɔ we kaa ni komɛ nɛ a na gbɔjɔ, nɛ nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛɛ na nɔ́. Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, nyɛ he hi saii, nɛ e hia kaa nyɛɛ ye bua ni nɛmɛ nɛ e fi mɛ ɔ. Hwɔɔ se ke nyɛ yi ba fi, nɛ mɛɛ níhi a mi ba hi ha mɛ ɔ, mɛ hu a maa ye bua nyɛ jã nɔuu; kɛkɛ lɛ tsuo pee pɛ. 15 Kaa bɔ nɛ ngmami ɔ deɔ ɔ, “Nɔ nɛ bua fuu nya a, pi kaa e ná nɛ e hiɛ tsɔ kɛ be nɔ. Nɔ nɛ bua bɔbɔyoo pɛ nya a hu, pi kaa e na we nɛ e hiɛ; mɛ tsuo a na bɔ nɛ sa.”
Tito kɛ e huɛmɛ ɔmɛ piɛ Korinto bi ɔmɛ a he kɛ bua sika nya
16Wa naa Mawu si kaa e ha Tito suɔmi kɛ gɛjɛmi nɛ e kɛ maa ye bua nyɛ kaa bɔ nɛ i ngɛ pee ɔ. 17Nɛ́ i de lɛ ke e ba slaa nyɛ ɔ, e kplɛɛ. Niinɛ, e pee e yi mi momo kaa e maa ba; ejakaa e hɛ ngɛ jae ngɛ nyɛ he, nɛ e suɔ kaa e maa na nyɛ ekohu. 18Nyɛmi nɛ wa tsɔ piɛ e he ɔ, a buu lɛ saminya ngɛ asafo ɔmɛ tsuo a mi kaa nɔ ko nɛ bɔɔ sane kpakpa a fiɛmi he mɔde. 19Pi kaa nyɛmi nɛ ɔ hé biɛ kɛkɛ, se asafo ɔmɛ je blɔ hla lɛ nɛ e kɛ wɔ nɛ nyɛɛ. Suɔmi ní tsumi ɔ nɛ wa ngɛ tsue kɛ ngɛ nɔ́ ko nya buae ɔ, e maa piɛ wa he kɛ tsu. Enɛ ɔ maa wo Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ hɛ mi nyami, nɛ e maa tsɔɔ wa mɔde bɔmi hulɔ.
20Wa ngɛ mɔde bɔe nɛ wa ko pee nɔ́ ko nɛ ma ha nihi maa tu munyu yaya ngɛ nike ní nguaa nɛ ɔ nɔ hyɛmi he. 21 Wa yi mi tomi ji kaa waa pee nɔ́ nɛ da, pi ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Mawu hɛ mi kɛkɛ, se ngɛ ni kpahi a hɛ mi hulɔ.
22Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, wa tsɔ wa nyɛmi ɔ hu kɛ piɛ a he. Wa ka lɛ si abɔ ngɛ níhi fuu a mi, nɛ wa na kaa e bɔɔ mɔde saminya. Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, e ngɔ e hɛ ngɔ fɔ nyɛ nɔ wawɛɛ, nɛ e hɛ dɔ wawɛɛ pe daa. 23Tito ɔ, ye he piɛlɔ ji lɛ, nɛ i kɛ lɛ tsuo nɛ ngɛ ní tsue konɛ e hi ha nyɛ. Nyɛmimɛ enyɔ kpa amɛ nɛ piɛ e he ɔ lɛɛ asafo ɔmɛ a tsɔli ji mɛ, nɛ a ní tsumi woɔ Kristo hɛ mi nyami. 24Nyɛɛ tsɔɔ nimli nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ asafo ɔmɛ a hɛ mi kaa nyɛ suɔ mɛ. Kɛkɛ ɔ, enɛ ɔ maa ye odase kaa fiami nɛ wa fĩa fɔ nyɛ nɔ ɔ pee we yaka.

Title: KORINTO BI II, 9
Content:
Yemi kɛ buami kɛ ha nyɛmimɛ
1E he hia we kaa ma hi nyɛ womi ngmae kpamisa ngɛ yemi kɛ buami nɛ wa ngɛ ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ hae ɔ he. 2I le mɔde nɛ nyɛ ngɛ bɔe ɔ, nɛ i fĩa fɔ nyɛ nɔ ngɛ enɛ ɔ he ha Makedonia bi ɔmɛ. I de mɛ ke, “Nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ Akaya a dla a he ngɔ to jeha lokoo ji nɛ kaa a maa ye bua nyɛ.” Niinɛ, nyɛ mɔde bɔmi ɔ wo a ti nihi fuu kã. 3I ngɛ nyɛmimɛ etɛ nɛ ɔmɛ nyɛ ngɔ tsɔe, konɛ fiami nɛ wa fĩa fɔ nyɛ nɔ ɔ kó pee yaka ngɛ enɛ ɔ blɔ fa mi. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, kaa bɔ nɛ i de to ɔ, nyɛ dla nyɛ he. 4Se ke i kɛ nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ nɛ je Makedonia a ekomɛ ba nyɛ ngɔ ɔ, i be suɔe nɛ a ba na kaa mamoo nyɛ dla we nyɛ he saasaa. Ke e ba mi jã a, waa kɛ nyɛ tsuo wa hɛ mi ma pue si kaa wa fĩa fɔ nyɛ nɔ kikɛ nɛ ɔ. 5Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i susu kaa e hia kaa ma kpa nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ pɛɛ nɛ a sɛ ye hlami kɛ ba nyɛ ngɔ. A ma ba dla nike ní nɛ nyɛ wo si momo ɔ ngɔ to loko ma ba. Enɛ ɔ maa tsɔɔ kaa nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ bua nya a je nyɛ tsui mi, se pi kaa a nyɛ nyɛ nɔ loko nyɛ tsu.
6Nyɛ kai kaa ke nɔ ko du wu bɔbɔyoo ɔ, e ma kpa ní bɔbɔyoo; ke nɔ ko du wu fuu ɔ, e ma kpa ní babauu jã kɛ̃. 7Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ha bɔ nɛ e to kaa e ma ha. E ha kɛ bua jɔmi, se pi kaa a ngɛ e nɔ nyɛe ke e pee; ejakaa Mawu suɔ nɔ nɛ haa nɔ́ kɛ bua jɔmi. 8Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ hia nyɛ ɔ, Mawu ma ha nyɛ fuu kɛ be nɔ; nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko be nyɛ hiae, nɛ nyɛ ma na fuu kɛ be nɔ kɛ tsu ní tsumi kpakpa slɔɔtohi. 9 Kaa bɔ nɛ ngmami ɔ deɔ ɔ,
“E haa ohiatsɛmɛ ní babauu;
e mɔbɔ nami ɔ ngɛ
kɛ yaa neneene.”
10 Mawu lɛ haa nɔ wu nɛ e duɔ, kɛ ngma nɛ e yeɔ. Wu tsuo nɛ hia nyɛ dumi ɔ, Mawu ma ha nyɛ, nɛ ke nyɛ du ɔ, lɛ nɔuu e ma ha nɛ tso ɔ maa wa. Kpakpa nɛ nyɛ ngɛ pee ɔ, blɔ nɔ nɛ Mawu maa gu nɛ e ma ha nɛ e wo yiblii ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. 11Ee, Mawu maa wo nyɛ ní babauu, konɛ nyɛ kɛ pee kpakpa be tsuaa be. Enɛ ɔ ma ha nihi fuu maa na Mawu si ngɛ nike ní nɛ a naa ngɛ nyɛ dɛ kɛ guu wa nɔ ɔ he. 12Ejakaa ní tsumi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ tsue ɔ, pi kaa wa nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ nɛ heɔ yeɔ ɔ a hiami níhi kɛkɛ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ pee ha mɛ. Nihi babauu hu ngɛ Mawu si nae kɛ gu sɔlemi mi. 13Kikɛmɛ a ní tsumi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ tsue nɛ ɔ maa tsɔɔ kaa Kristo sɔmɔli ji nyɛ niinɛ. Nɛ nyɛ nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ nɛ heɔ yeɔ ɔ ma je Mawu yi ngɛ Kristo sane kpakpa a fiɛmi, kɛ tue bumi he. A ma je Mawu yi hulɔ ngɛ nike níhi nɛ nyɛ je nyɛ tsui mi faa ha a kɛ ni kpahi tsuo ɔ he. 14A kɛ suɔmi nɛ nya wa ma kpa Mawu pɛɛ ha nyɛ, ejakaa Mawu hu je suɔmi agbo nɛ hí kalemi kpo ha nyɛ. 15Nyɛ ha waa na Mawu si ngɛ e nike ní nɛ nɔ ko be nyɛe maa kale ɔ he.

Title: KORINTO BI II, 10
Content:
Paulo tsɔɔ kaa bɔfo ji lɛ niinɛ
1Imi Paulo nitsɛ, i ngɛ nyɛ pɛɛ kpae! Ni komɛ deɔ ke ke i ba nyɛ ngɔ ɔ, i peeɔ kpoo, se ke i be nyɛ kasa nya kɛkɛ i hia kã. I suɔ nɛ ma pee kpoo, nɛ ye mi mi nɛ jɔ kaa Kristo. 2I kpa nyɛ pɛɛ, ke i ba nyɛ ngɔ ɔ, nyɛ ko ha nɛ ma pee nɔ́ ko nɛ maa tsɔɔ kaa i ngɛ nyɛ nɔ yee tsɔ. Nihi nɛ ngɛ ye he munyu tue ke i ngɛ ní tsue kaa je mi no ɔ, i le kaa ma nyɛ nɛ i kɛ mɛ maa to ní saminya. 3E ngɛ mi kaa wa ngɛ he lo mi mohu, se kɛ̃ ɔ, wa pee we he lo nya ní. 4Ta hwumi níhi nɛ wa hɛɛ ɔ, pi he lo mi níhi; se mohu Mawu nitsɛ e ta hwumi ní kpakpahi nɛ a kɛ kuɔ mɔ nguahi. Wa tsiɔ yi mi susumi yayami nya, 5nɛ wa teɔ si woɔ ní yayamihi nɛ he nɔ woli deɔ kɛ siɔ bɔ nɛ Mawu ngɛ anɔkuale mi ɔ. Wa tsakeɔ adesa juɛmi, konɛ e susumi nɛ pee kaa bɔ nɛ Kristo ngɛ hlae ɔ. 6Nɛ ke nyɛ tsake pee anɔkuale tue buli ɔ, wɔɔ lɛɛ wa pee klaalo nɛ wa maa gbla ni nɛmɛ nɛ tsakee we ɔ a tue.
7Nyɛ juɛmi mi kuɔ we kulaa! Anɛ nɔ ko ngɛ hiɛ ɔ nɛ heɔ e he yeɔ kaa Kristo nɔ́ ji lɛ lo? Saminya! Jamɛ a nɔ ɔ nɛ susu e yi mi ekohu; ejakaa wɔ hu Kristo níhi ji wɔ kaa lɛ nɔuu. 8Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo ha wɔ he wami ngɛ nyɛ nɔ, pi nɛ wa kɛ kpata nyɛ hɛ mi, se mohu nɛ wa kɛ ye bua nyɛ. Nɛ e ngɛ mi kaa he blɔ nɛ wa hɛɛ nɛ ɔ ha nɛ i fĩa tsɔ mohu, se kɛ̃ enɛ ɔ pee we mi zo. 9I hla we nɛ nihi nɛ susu kaa i ngɛ hlae nɛ ma wo nyɛ he gbeye kɛ womi ɔmɛ nɛ i ngɛ ngmae ɔ. 10Nihi deɔ ke, “Paulo womi ɔmɛ a mi munyuhi jiɔ, nɛ a mi wa hulɔ; se ke o na lɛ nitsɛ lɛɛ pi nɔ ko kulaa ji lɛ; munyu nitsɛ tete e li tumi.” 11Jamɛatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a ná nɛ a le kaa nɔ́ nɛ wa ngmaa ngɔ woɔ womi mi kɛ maneɔ nyɛ ɔ, lɔ ɔ nɔuu wa peeɔ ke wa ba nyɛ ngɔ ɔ nɛ; slɔɔto be mi.
12Nihi nɛ woɔ a he nɔ, nɛ a buu a he kaa mɛɛ a pe ni kpahi ɔ, wa be wa he ngɔe ngɔ ta a he; ee, wa be wa he ngɔe ngɔ to a he. Bɔ nɛ a kaleɔ a he, nɛ a ngɔɔ a he ngɔ toɔ a sibi a he ɔ, juɛmi be mi. 13Wɔɔ lɛɛ wa maa fĩa kɛ ya ta he ko pɛ; ní tsumi nɛ Mawu ha wɔ nɛ wa ngɛ tsue kɛ ba su nyɛ ngɔ hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ, lɔ ɔ he wa maa fĩa ngɛ. 14He nɛ Mawu ha wɔ ke wa tsu ní kɛ ya si ɔ, nyɛ hu nyɛ piɛ he. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɛ́ wa ngɔ sane kpakpa a nɛ kɔɔ Kristo he ɔ kɛ ba nyɛ ngɔ ngɛ Korinto ɔ, ní tsumi nɛ a ha wɔ ɔ, lɔ ɔ pɛ wa tsu ɔ nɛ; nɔ́ kpa ko piɛ we he. 15Ní tsumi nɛ ni kpahi tsu ɔ, wa fĩɛ ngɛ he. Niinɛ, wa heɔ yeɔ kaa nyɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ mi ma ba wa, nɛ wa ma tsu ní nguahi ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti pe bɔ nɛ wa ko nyɛ. 16Jamɛ a be ɔ, wa ma nyɛ maa fiɛ sane kpakpa a ngɛ ma kpahi a nɔ ngɛ Korinto se je lokoo. Kɛkɛ ɔ, he ko nɛ nɔ ko ya tsu ní ngɛ momo ɔ, wɔɔ wa be yae, konɛ wɔ mohu wa ko ba na yi jemi.
17 Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, kaa bɔ nɛ ngmami ɔ deɔ ɔ, “Nɔ nɛ suɔ kaa e maa fĩa a, e fĩa ngɔ fɔ nɔ́ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ pee ɔ pɛ nɔ.” 18Ejakaa nɔ nɛ jeɔ lɛ nitsɛ e yi ɔ, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ hla we lɛ; nɔ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nitsɛ jeɔ e yi ɔ, lɛ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ suɔ.

Title: KORINTO BI II, 11
Content:
Paulo kɛ lakpa bɔfo ɔmɛ
1I na nɛ jinɛ nyɛ na tsui ha mi, ke ji kaa i ngɛ kuasia jee po. Ee, nyɛɛ na ha mi! 2I suɔ nyɛ saminya kaa bɔ nɛ Mawu nitsɛ suɔ nyɛ ɔ. I suɔ kaa nyɛɛ ye Kristo anɔkuale kaa bɔ nɛ yomiyo yeɔ nyumu nɛ ba bi e si ɔ anɔkuale, nɛ e hyɛɛ e he nɔ saminya kɛ ya siɔ yo kpeemi ligbi ɔ. 3 I ngɛ gbeye yee kaa nɔ́ nɛ ba Hawa nɔ be ko ɔ maa ba nyɛ hu nyɛ nɔ. Sinɔ ya sisi Hawa, nɛ Hawa pee yayami. Jã kɛ̃ lɛ a ma puɛ nyɛ tue, nɛ nyɛ be Kristo anɔkuale yee kɛ pi si hu. 4Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa ba nyɛ ngɔ kɛkɛ nyɛ he lɛ a tuu. Ke a ba fiɛ Yesu kpa ha nyɛ hu kɛkɛ nyɛ he ye; pohu e kɛ nɔ́ nɛ wa fiɛ ha nyɛ ɔ kɔ we. Mumi ɔ nɛ a wo he si ɔ, nyɛ he ye, pohu pi Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ nɛ nyɛ na kɛ je wa dɛ ɔ. Sane kpakpa a nɛ a kɛ ba a hu nyɛ he ye, pohu slo a nɔ́ ɔ ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ wa ba fiɛ ha nyɛ ɔ he.
5Jamɛ a nimli ɔmɛ nɛ nyɛ buu mɛ kaa mɛɛ lɛɛ bɔfo nguahi ji mɛ ɔ, i he ye kaa a pi mi ngɛ nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko mi. 6Ke i li munyu tumi tete po, lɔ ɔ tsɔɔ we kaa i li nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko. Nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ dee nɛ ɔ, nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ le, ejakaa wa ye he odase si abɔ ngɔ tsɔɔ nyɛ.
7Benɛ i ba fiɛ sane kpakpa a nɛ kɔɔ Mawu he ɔ ngɔ ha nyɛ ɔ, i he we nyɛ nɔ́ ko. I ba ye he si, konɛ nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ hɛ mi nɛ ba nyami. Anɛ yayami ji nɛ ɔ lo? 8Benɛ i ngɛ ní tsue ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti ɔ, asafo kpahi lɛ woɔ mi hiɔ. E ngɛ kaa nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ mɛ jue, konɛ ma kɛ sɔmɔ nyɛ. 9 Benɛ i kɛ nyɛ ngɛ, nɛ e fi mi tete ɔ, i hɛwi nyɛ ti nɔ ko nɔ ko; nyɛmimɛ nɛ je Makedonia kɛ ba a ba ha mi nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ hia mi. I pee we tlomi ngɛ nyɛ kuɛ nɔ. Nɛ kɛ je mwɔnɛ ɔ kɛ yaa a hu i hyɛ we nyɛ yemi kɛ buami ko blɔ. 10Kristo ɔ, anɔkualetsɛ ji lɛ, nɛ lɛ i kase. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ dee ji kaa nɔ ko kulaa be Akaya ní ɔmɛ a mi nɛ ma nyɛ maa tsi ye nya kaa ma ko fĩa. 11Mɛni he je nɛ i ngɛ enɛ ɔ dee? Pe i sume nyɛ lo? Dɛbi, Mawu le kaa i suɔ nyɛ.
12Ma ya nɔ ma pee kaa bɔ nɛ i peeɔ daa a. I be yemi kɛ buami ko bie ngɛ nyɛ dɛ. Ke i bi ɔ, jamɛ a ni ɔmɛ ma na he blɔ ɔ nɛ a ngɛ hlae ɔ nɛ a maa fĩa ke a ngɛ Mawu ní tsue kaa bɔ nɛ wɔ hu wa ngɛ tsue ɔ nɔuu. 13Kikɛmɛ a nimli nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, lakpa bɔfohi ji mɛ; tsa pi anɔkuale bɔfohi ji mɛ. A ní tsumi ji kaa a hi kpae, nɛ a hi nɔ sisie. A tsakeɔ a he, konɛ nihi nɛ na mɛ kaa Kristo nitsɛ e bɔfohi. 14Enɛ ɔ be nyakpɛ tete! Satan nitsɛ nyɛɔ tsakeɔ e he peeɔ bɔfo nɛ ngɛ kpɛe kaa la! 15Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke Satan tsɔli tsake a he pee kaa Mawu nɛ peeɔ kpakpa a tsɔli ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ ɔ be nyakpɛ kulaa. A nyagbe ɔ maa ba ha mɛ bɔ nɛ sa mɛ kaa yiwutsotsɛmɛ.
Paulo na amanehlu kaa bɔfo
16I ngɛ dee ekohu ke nyɛ ti nɔ ko nɔ ko nɛ ko bu mi kuasia. Se ke nyɛ maa bu mi kuasia tete po ɔ, nyɛɛ ngmɛ mi blɔ nɛ imi hu ma fĩa bɔɔ ko. 17Nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ dee nɛ ɔ, tsa pi kikɛ nɛ ɔ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo ko suɔ nɛ ma tu munyu. Fiami nɛ i ngɛ fĩae nɛ ɔ, i ngɛ munyu tue kaa kuasia pɛ. 18Se akɛnɛ nihi babauu fĩaa ngɔ fɔɔ je nɛ ɔ mi níhi a nɔ ɔ, imi hu ma fĩa. 19Nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ le ní kɛ be nɔ, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ naa tsui ha kuasiahi. 20Ke nɔ ko ba ye nyɛ nyɔguɛ, loo adufude, loo e ba pee nyɛ kuasia, loo e ba wo e he nɔ ngɛ nyɛ nɔ, loo e ba gba nyɛ hɛ mi ma po, nyɛ de we nɔ́ ko. 21E peeɔ mi zo kaa ma de ke wɔɔ lɛɛ fɔ̃li ji wɔ, nɛ wa nyɛ we nɛ waa pee nɔ́ ko kaa jã!
Jehanɛ lɛɛ i ngɛ munyu tue kaa kuasia! Níhi nɛ ni kpa amɛ ngɛ fĩae ngɛ he ɔ, imi hu ma fĩa ngɛ he jã nɔuu. 22A fĩaa ke Hebri bi ji mɛ, pi jã? Saminya, imi hu Hebri no ji mi. Nɛ a deɔ ke Israel bi ji mɛ, pi jã lo? Ee, imi hu Israel no ji mi. Pi Abraham nina ji mɛ? Ee, imi hu eko ji mi. 23 Kristo sɔmɔli ji mɛ lo? I ngɛ munyu tue kaa nɔ nɛ yi mi puɛ; tsia, i pe mɛ tsuo! I tsu ní wawɛɛ pe mɛ; a wo mi tsu si abɔ pe mɛ; a fia mi kpa si abɔ pe mɛ, nɛ jehanɛ hu, i ya gbenɔ muɔ nya ba si abɔ pe mɛ. 24 Yuda ma nimeli ɔmɛ fia mi kpa si enuɔ sɔuu; eko tsuaa eko ɔ, e piɛ kake loko e maa pee nyingmi eywiɛ. 25 Roma nikɔtɔma amɛ fia mi kpa si etɛ; a fia mi tɛ si kake. I kɛ lɛ butu si etɛ, nɛ i ye ligbi kake, nyɔ kɛ pia ngɛ wo mi. 26 I hia blɔ kpitikpiti. I na amanehlu babauu ngɛ pa hɛ mi, kɛ ojo fiali a dɛ mi; i na nɔ́ ngɛ imi nitsɛ ye weku li a dɛ mi; i na nɔ́ ngɛ ma je li a dɛ mi. I na nɔ́ ngɛ ma mi, kɛ nga nɔ. I na nɔ́ ngɛ wo hɛ mi, kɛ nyɛmimɛ lakpatsɛmɛ a dɛ mi. 27I gbo dengme kɛ tsu ní wawɛɛ nɛ be komɛ mahe hwɔmi be mi. Hwɔ kɛ kuma yeɔ mi; be komɛ po i haa hwɔ; fĩɛ yeɔ mi, nɛ he hami nɔ́ hiaa mi. 28Se enɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ ní kpa komɛ tsuo a se ɔ, asafo ɔmɛ a he susumi ngɛ kaa tlomi ngɛ ye kuɛ nɔ daa ligbi. 29Ke nɔ ko mumi gbo, kɛkɛ imi hu ye nɔ́ ɔ gbo; ke nɔ ko nane kpata, kɛkɛ ye mi mi sã mi ha lɛ.
30Ke e hia kaa ma fĩa kɛ̃ ɔ, lɛɛ níhi nɛ tsɔɔ bɔ nɛ i gbɔjɔ ha a, lɔ ɔmɛ a nɔ ma fĩa ngɔ fɔ. 31Mawu, wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo Tsɛ ɔ le kaa i yi lakpa. A je e yi kɛ ya neneene. 32 Benɛ i ngɛ Damasko ɔ, amlaalo ɔ nɛ ngɛ Matsɛ Areta sisi ɔ ha a huɔ ngɛ Damasko ma a mi, konɛ a nu mi. 33Se nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ ngɔ mi wo kusii mi, nɛ a siu mi kɛ gu gli puɔ mi kɛ kple si. Nɛ i tu fo kɛ je e dɛ mi.

Title: KORINTO BI II, 12
Content:
Paulo ninahi kɛ e gbɔjɔmi
1Ma ya nɔ ma fĩa kɛ̃, pohu se nami ko be he. Jehanɛ lɛɛ nɔ́ nɛ he munyu nɛ ma tu ji bɔ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo je e he kpo tsɔɔ mi, kɛ e suɔmi nya níhi nɛ e tsɔɔ ke ma pee. 2I le Kristo se nyɛɛlɔ ko nɛ a sa lɛ kɛ ya hiɔwe lokoo ɔ jeha nyɔngma kɛ eywiɛ ji nɛ. E ngɛ nɔmlɔ tso mi jio, e be nɔmlɔ tso mi jio, i li; Mawu lɛ le. 3-4I le kaa a sa kikɛmɛ a nɔmlɔ nɛ ɔ kɛ ya Paradeiso tɔɔ. E ngɛ nɔmlɔ tso mi jio, e be nɔmlɔ tso mi jio, i li; Mawu lɛ le. Benɛ e ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, e nu munyuhi nɛ be hie tumi ngɛ adesa gbi mi, nɛ́ adesa be he blɔ nɛ e sɛɛɔ hulɔ. 5Ma fĩa ngɛ jamɛ a nyakpɛ ní ɔ nɛ i na a he. Ní kpahi nɛ ba ye nɔ ɔ lɛɛ níhi nɛ tsɔɔ kaa gbɔjɔmi ngɛ ye he, nɛ lɔ ɔmɛ kɛkɛ a he ma fĩa ngɛ; pi imi nitsɛ ye he. 6Ke i ke ma fĩa a, lɔ ɔ tsɔɔ we kaa i ngɛ kuasia jee; ejakaa anɔkuale ɔ i ngɛ dee ɔ nɛ. Se i be fĩae. I hla we nɛ nihi nɛ bu mi ngɛ ye nina amɛ a he; nɔ́ nɛ a na nɛ i pee, kɛ nɔ́ nɛ a nu kɛ je ye nya a, a bu mi ngɛ lɔ ɔmɛ mohu a he.
7Nyakpɛ ní nguanguahi nɛ a je tsɔɔ mi ɔ ma ha ma wó ye he nɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ e ko ba mi ja he je ɔ, Mawu ngɔ mio ko ngɔ wo ye he womi mi. Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ngɛ kaa Satan bɔfo, nɛ e kongoɔ mi, konɛ ma ko wó ye he nɔ. 8I kpa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ pɛɛ si etɛ sɔuu ke e je nɔ́ nɛ ɔ kɛ je ye nɔ. 9Se e he nɔ ke, “Dloomi nɛ i kɛ ha mo ɔ, lɔ ɔ kɛkɛ hiɛ ha mo; ejakaa ye he wami ɔ tsuɔ ní wawɛɛ ngɛ nihi nɛ gbɔjɔ ɔ a mi.” I suɔ saminya nɛ ma fĩa kaa i gbɔjɔ, konɛ ma na kaa Kristo he wami ɔ ngɛ ye he bue. 10Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, i suɔ kaa ma na nɔ́ ngɛ Kristo he. E hɛwi mi kaa ma nu hiɔ; e hɛwi mi kaa a maa pee mi nisɛ ní, loo ye yi ma fi, loo a maa wa mi yi mi, loo ma na amanehlu. Ejakaa ke i pee gbedee ɔ, Kristo woɔ mi he wami.
Paulo ye Korinto bi ɔmɛ a he kɔmɔ
11I ngɛ ye ní pee kaa kuasia; se nyɛ lɛ nyɛ pee mi jã. Nyɛ lɛ nyɛ ko je ye yi; ejakaa ke i pi nɔ ko tete po, jamɛ a ni ɔmɛ nɛ nyɛ buu mɛ bɔfo nguahi ɔ, a pi mi ngɛ nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko mi. 12Mawu pee nyakpɛ ní nguahi, kɛ okadihi kɛ gu ye nɔ benɛ i ngɛ ní tsue kɛ tsui si tomi ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti ɔ. Nyakpɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsɔɔ kaa niinɛ, bɔfo ji mi. 13Mɛni ji nɔ́ nɛ i pee ha asafo kpa amɛ nɛ i pee we ha nyɛ, pe kaa i doo we nyɛ nya ke nyɛɛ ye kɛ bua mi kɛ nɔ́ ko? Ke enɛ ɔ ji yayami nɛ i pee nyɛ ɔ, i kpa nyɛ pɛɛ nɛ nyɛ ngɔ pa mi!
14Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, i dla ye he nɛ ma ba slaa nyɛ si etɛne. I bɛ nɛ ma ba pee tlomi ngɛ nyɛ kuɛ nɔ; nyɛ he i ma ngɛ, se pi nyɛ sika he. Pi bimɛ nɛ sa kaa a hyɛɛ a fɔli a nɔ; e sa kaa fɔli mohu nɛ hyɛ a bimɛ a nɔ. 15Ma suɔ kaa ma ngɔ níhi tsuo nɛ i ngɛ ɔ, kɛ ye nɔmlɔ tso ɔ tete ngɔ ha nɛ ma kɛ ye bua nyɛ. Ke i suɔ nyɛ babauu kikɛ nɛ ɔ, e sɛ kaa nyɛ hu nyɛɛ suɔ mi jã lo?
16Nyɛ maa na kaa niinɛ, i pee we tlomi ngɛ nyɛ kuɛ nɔ. Se nɔ ko ma de ke, ye hɛ mi tɛ̃, nɛ i gu ga blɔ nɔ kɛ sisi nyɛ. 17Kɛkɛɛ? Nihi nɛ i tsɔ kɛ ba nyɛ ngɔ ɔ, anɛ i gu a ti nɔ ko nɔ kɛ sisi nyɛ lo? 18Pe i kpa Tito pɛɛ nɛ i tsɔ wa nyɛmi kake ɔ ngɔ piɛ e he loko e ba slaa nyɛ. Anɛ Tito ba sisi nyɛ lo? Dɛbi! Anɛ nyɛ li kaa i kɛ lɛ tsuo wa hɛɛ juɛmi kake, nɛ wa peeɔ wa ní fiee lo?
19Nyɛ ko susu kaa pe wa ngɛ mɔde bɔe nɛ wa fa wa he ngɛ nyɛ hɛ mi kɛkɛ. Mawu ji wa we odase kaa wa ngɛ anɔkuale tue kaa Kristo tsɔli. Nyɛmimɛ nɛ wa suɔ! Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ wa ngɛ pee ɔ, wa ngɛ pee nɛ wa kɛ ye bua nyɛ. 20I ngɛ gbeye yee kaa ke i ba nyɛ slaami ɔ, i ba be nyɛ nae bɔ nɛ i ko suɔ, nɛ nyɛ hu nyɛ be mi nae bɔ nɛ nyɛ ko suɔ. Eko piɔ ɔ, níhi nɛ ma ba na kɛkɛ ji pɛ, hunga jemi, mi mi la, mi gbami, nɔ biɛ puɛmi, sieku yemi, he nɔ womi, kɛ basabasa peemi. 21I ngɛ gbeye yee kaa ke i ba ekohu ɔ, ye Mawu ɔ maa ba mi si ngɛ nyɛ hɛ mi. Nihi nɛ pee yayami sa a, nɛ a tsakee we a tsui, nɛ a ngɛ yayami ɔ pee kɛ mwɔɔ ɔ, ma fo ya ngɛ a he. Mɛ ji mu ní tsuli, ajuama bɔli, kɛ zo ní tsuli.

Title: KORINTO BI II, 13
Content:
Nyagbe kɔkɔ bɔmi kɛ sɛ yemi
1 Enɛ ɔ ji si etɛne nɛ i ma nyɛ slaami. Ngmami ɔ ke, “Ni enyɔ, loo etɛ nɛ a ye odase loko a buá sane tsuaa sane he.” 2Nihi tsuo nɛ pee yayami sa a, i bɔ mɛ kɔkɔ momo benɛ i ba slaa nyɛ si enyɔne ɔ. Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, i be nyɛ ngɔ, se i ngɛ mɛ, kɛ ni kpa amɛ tsuo kɔkɔ bɔe ekohu.
