Jehanɛ lɛɛ ke i ba a, ma gbla a tue wawɛɛ. 3Ma pee enɛ ɔ, ejakaa nyɛ ngɛ hlae nɛ nyɛɛ na okadi nɛ tsɔɔ kaa Kristo ngɛ munyu tue kɛ gu ye nɔ. Ke Kristo kɛ nyɛ ngɛ ní tsue ɔ, pi kaa e gbɔjɔ; mohu ɔ, e jeɔ e he wami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ kpo ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti. 4E ngɛ mi kaa benɛ a sɛu Kristo ɔ, e gbɔjɔ lɛɛ, se Mawu he wami ɔ nya a, e ba wami mi ekohu. Wɔ hu akɛnɛ waa kɛ Kristo pee kake ɔ, waa gbɔjɔɔ, se Mawu he wami nya a, wa ma nyɛ ma tsu nɔ́ nɛ sa nɛ waa kɛ nyɛ nɛ tsu ɔ.
5Nyɛɛ ka nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ he nɛ nyɛɛ hyɛ kaa nyɛ heɔ Kristo yeɔ niinɛ lo. Nyɛɛ hyɛ nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ he nɛ hi. Anɛ nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ li kaa Yesu Kristo he wami ɔ ngɛ nyɛ mi lo? Ee, ke nyɛ sɛ́ ɔ, nyɛ be enɛ ɔ lee. 6I heɔ yeɔ kaa nyɛ ma na maa le kaa wɔɔ lɛɛ a ka wɔ, nɛ wa je kpo kaa nihi nɛ sa niinɛ. 7Wa ngɛ Mawu pɛɛ kpae ha nyɛ nɛ nyɛ ko pee nɔ́ ko nɛ sɛ́. Waa kɛ enɛ ɔ tsɔɔ we kaa wɔɔ lɛɛ wa hi; se mohu nɛ nyɛɛ pee nɔ́ nɛ sa; pohu e maa pee nihi kaa wɔɔ lɛɛ wa nyɛ we kulaa. 8Ejakaa wa blɔ nya ji kaa waa hyɛ nɛ anɔkuale ɔ nɛ gbɛ fĩa; se pi kaa wa maa pee nɔ́ ko kɛ si anɔkuale ɔ. 9Ke wa gbɔjɔ, nɛ nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ ngɛ he wami ɔ, wa naa bua jɔmi. Enɛ ɔ he je nɛ wa ngɛ Mawu pɛɛ kpae ha nyɛ ɔ nɛ, konɛ nyɛɛ ya nɔ nɛ nyɛɛ hi kɛ pi si. 10Enɛ ɔ he hu lɛ i ngɛ nyɛ womi nɛ ɔ ngmae benɛ i be nyɛ ngɔ ɔ nɛ. Kɛkɛ ɔ, ke i ba a, e be hiae kaa i kɛ nyɛ nɛ ye wawɛɛ. He wami nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ha mi ɔ, pi nɛ ma kɛ kpata nyɛ hɛ mi, se mohu nɛ ma kɛ ye bua nyɛ.
11Nyagbe ɔ, ye nyɛmimɛ, i biɔ nyɛ! Nyɛɛ ba nyɛ je mi saminya; nyɛɛ bu ye ga womi ɔ tue; nyɛ juɛmi nɛ pee kake, nɛ nyɛɛ hi si ngɛ he jɔmi mi. Nɛ Mawu nɛ suɔ wɔ, nɛ haa wɔ tue mi jɔmi ɔ kɛ nyɛ maa hi si.
12Nyɛɛ fua nyɛ sibi atuu nɛ nyɛ kɛ nga nyɛ he.
Ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ tsuo ke a biɔ nyɛ.
13Wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo dloomi ɔ, kɛ Mawu suɔmi ɔ, kɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu huɛ bɔmi ɔ kɛ nyɛ tsuo nɛ hi si.

Title: GALATIA BI NYA TSƆƆMI
Content:
NYA TSƆƆMI
Benɛ sane kpakpa a nɛ kɔɔ Kristo he ɔ bɔni gbɛmi kɛ fiami, nɛ ma je li ɔmɛ he munyu ɔ atuu ɔ, sane ko ba te si kaa loko nɔ ko maa pee Kristo se nyɛɛlɔ kpakpa a, anɛ e hia doo kaa e ye Mose mlaa a nɔ lo? Paulo tsɔɔ nya kaa e hia we kulaa. E ya nɔ nɛ e de ke, anɔkuale mi ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ he hia mohu ji kaa nɔ nɛ kɛ Kristo ngɛ bɔe ɔ, e he Kristo nɛ e ye; ejakaa kɛ gu e nɔ lɛ a dlaa nɔ kɛ Mawu a kpɛti. Se ni komɛ ba sɛ asafo ɔmɛ a mi ngɛ Galatia kpokpa a nɔ; a te si kɛ si Paulo tsɔɔmi ɔ. Mɛɛ lɛɛ a ke loko a ma dla nɔ ko kɛ Mawu a kpɛti ɔ, ja e ye Mose mlaa a hu nɔ. Galatia ji Roma nɔ yemi he ko ngɛ Asia Mainɔ.
Paulo ngma womi nɛ ɔ ya ha Galatia asafo ɔ, konɛ nihi tsuo nɛ a ngɛ a tue puɛe kɛ kikɛmɛ a lakpa tsɔɔmi ɔ, a kpale kɛ ba pɛtɛ anɔkuale hemi kɛ yemi ɔ he ekohu. Kekleekle ɔ, blɔ nya nɛ e na kaa a tsɛɔ lɛ Yesu Kristo bɔfo ɔ, Paulo tsɔɔ nya. E ma nɔ mi kaa Mawu nitsɛ nɛ tsɛ lɛ ke e ba pee bɔfo, se pi nɔmlɔ adesa. E tsɔɔ kaa ma je li ɔmɛ titli a ngɔ a tsɔ lɛ, se pi Yuda bi. Paulo ya nɔ nɛ e tsɔɔ nya kaa hemi kɛ yemi pɛ nɔ a guɔ kɛ dlaa nɔ kɛ Mawu a kpɛti. Ngɛ womi ɔ nyagbe blɔ ɔ, Paulo tsɔɔ kaa Kristo se nyɛɛlɔ je mi babɛ jeɔ kpo paa ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi nɛ e ngɛ ngɛ Kristo mi ɔ mi. Nɔ́ nɛ kɛ hemi kɛ yemi nɛ ɔ baa ji suɔmi.
Bɔ ne a dla womi ɔ mi ha
Sisije 1.1-10
He nɛ Paulo na he wami kɛ je nɛ e ba pee bɔfo 1.11—2.21
Sane kpakpa nɛ Mawu na wɔ mɔbɔ nɛ e ha wɔ ɔ 3.1—4.31
He yemi nɛ Kristo se nyɛɛlɔ ná, kɛ e he ní tsumi 5.1—6.10
Nyagbe 6.11-18

Title: GALATIA BI 1
Content:
1-2Imi bɔfo Paulo, kɛ nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ kulaa nɛ kɛ mi ngɛ ɔ ngma womi nɛ ɔ ya ha Galatia asafo ɔmɛ. Pi nɔmlɔ nɛ pee mi bɔfo, nɛ pi adesa hu nɔ nɛ a gu kɛ hla mi ke ma ba pee bɔfo, se mohu Yesu Kristo, kɛ Tsɛ Mawu nɛ tle lɛ si kɛ je gbeje ɔ a nɔ i gu kɛ na blɔ nya nɛ ɔ.
3Dloomi kɛ he jɔmi nɛ je Tsɛ Mawu ɔ, kɛ wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo dɛ mi ɔ ha nyɛ!
4Yesu Kristo ngɔ e he ngɔ ha ngɛ wa he yayami ɔmɛ a he, konɛ a je wɔ kɛ je yi nɔ nɛ ɔ yi wu tso ní peemi ɔmɛ a mi. Enɛ ɔ ji wa Mawu, kɛ wa Tsɛ ɔ suɔmi nya ní. 5A wo Mawu hɛ mi nyami kɛ je neneene kɛ ya neneene. Amen.
Sane kpakpa kake ɔ
6Nyɛ he pee mi nyakpɛ. Hyɛ kaa e yi be ko kulaa nɛ nɔ nɛ tsɛ nyɛ kɛ gu Kristo dloomi ɔ nɔ ɔ, nyɛ kua lɛ, nɛ nyɛ ya ngɛ sane kpakpa kpa se nyɛɛe. 7Oo, nyɛ bu kaa sane kpakpa kpa ko ngɛ he ko! Pe i de ja kɛkɛ; ejakaa ni komɛ ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti nɛ a ngɛ nyɛ tue puɛe; a ngɛ hlae kaa a ma tsake sane kpakpa a nɛ kɔɔ Kristo he ɔ hɛ mi. 8Se ke e maa ba mi kaa wɔ, loo hiɔwe bɔfo ko po ma ba fiɛ sane kpakpa muno ko ha nyɛ ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ wa fiɛ momo ɔ se ɔ, musu tloo lɛ! 9Wa de enɛ ɔ momo, se i ngɛ mi tie ekohu. I ngɛ dee ke, ke nɔ ko ba fiɛ sane kpakpa muno ko ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ he ye momo ɔ se ɔ, jamɛ a nɔ ɔ, musu tloo lɛ!
10Nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ dee nɛ ɔ, anɛ e tsɔɔ kaa i ngɛ hlae nɛ ma sa adesa hɛ mi lo? Dɛbi! Nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ hlae kɛkɛ ji kaa ma sa Mawu hɛ mi. Anɛ pe i ngɛ hlae nɛ nimli nɛ suɔ mi lo? Ke ja ji sane ɔ lɛɛ pi Kristo tsɔlɔ ji mi.
Bɔ nɛ pee nɛ Paulo plɛ bɔfo
11Nyɛmimɛ, i ngɛ hae nɛ nyɛɛ le kaa sane kpakpa a nɛ i fiɛ ha nyɛ ɔ, pi nimli a nya mi munyu. 12Pi adesa ko dɛ mi nɛ i na kɛ je, nɛ pi nɔmlɔ ko nɛ tsɔɔ mi hulɔ; Yesu Kristo nitsɛ nɛ je tsɔɔ mi.
13 Nyɛ nu bɔ nɛ i ba ye je mi sa a ngɛ Yuda bi a jami ɔ nya. Nyɛ nu bɔ nɛ i wa Mawu asafo ɔ yi mi wawɛɛ, nɛ i bɔ mɔde kaa ma kpata asafo ɔ hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ. 14 I tsu Yuda bi a jami ɔ he ní wawɛɛ pe wa juami bi Yuda fɔfɔɛhi babauu. I kɛ hɛdɔ tsu wa nɛmɛ ɔmɛ a kusumi ɔmɛ a he ní saminya.
15 Se, mamoo benɛ a na we nɛ a fɔ mi ɔ, jamɛ a be ɔ mi tɔɔ nɛ Mawu gu e dloomi ɔ nɔ nɛ e hla mi. Nɛ benɛ e to e yi mi kaa 16e ma je e Bi ɔ ngɔ tsɔɔ mi, konɛ ma ya fiɛ sane kpakpa a ha ma je li ɔmɛ ɔ, i ya bi we ga womi ngɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko ngɔ. 17Nihi nɛ sɛ ye hlami kɛ ngɛ ní tsue kaa bɔfohi ngɛ Yerusalem ɔ, mɛ tete po i yɛ nɛ ma ya na mɛ. Mohu ɔ, i pue nɔ amlɔ nɔuu kɛ ho Arabia ya. Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, i kpale kɛ ba Damasko. 18 Jeha etɛ se loko i ya Yerusalem ya na Petro, nɛ i ye ligbi nyɔngma kɛ enuɔ ngɛ e ngɔ. 19Bɔfo kpa amɛ lɛɛ i nɛ a ti nɔ ko nɔ ko, pe Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nyɛmi Yakobo pɛ.
20Nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ ngmae nɛ ɔ, Mawu ji ye we odase kaa i yi lakpa.
21Pee se ɔ, i ya Siria, kɛ Kilikia kpokpa amɛ a nɔ. 22Se kɛ ba si be nɛ ɔ tsuo Kristo asafo ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ Yudea a li mi hɛ mi kɛ hɛ mi. 23Nihi a nya kɛkɛ a nuɔ ngɛ ke, “Nyumu ɔ nɛ wa wɔ yi mi sa a, hemi kɛ yemi ɔ nɛ e ka kaa e ma kpata hɛ mi ɔ, jehanɛ lɛɛ jamɛ a hemi kɛ yemi ɔ e ngɛ fiɛe.” 24Nɛ ye he ɔ, a wo Mawu hɛ mi nyami.

Title: GALATIA BI 2
Content:
Bɔfo kpa amɛ he Paulo ngɔ wo a kpɛti
1 Jeha nyɔngma kɛ eywiɛ se ɔ, i kɛ Barnaba kpale kɛ ya Yerusalem ekohu, nɛ i ngɔ Tito hu ngɔ piɛ ye he. 2Mawu lɛ je tsɔɔ mi kaa ma ya Yerusalem, nɛ i ya. I kɛ nihi nɛ a buu mɛ ɔ kɔklɔɔ ya kpe, nɛ sɛ gbi nɛ i ngɛ fiɛe ha ma je li ɔmɛ ɔ, i tsɔɔ mɛ nya, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ ní tsumi nɛ i tsu kɛ sɛ hlami, kɛ nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ tsue amlɔ nɛ ɔ pee yaka. 3Tito nɛ i kɛ lɛ ngɛ ní tsue ɔ, nɔ ko nyɛ́ e nɔ doo ke a po lɛ, pohu Hela no ji lɛ. 4Se nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ a ti lakpatsɛmɛ komɛ gu ga blɔ nɔ kɛ sɛ asafo ɔ mi nigii kɛ ngɛ hlae nɛ a hyɛ bɔ nɛ a maa pee kɛ puɛ he yemi nɛ Kristo ha wɔ ɔ, konɛ a ye wɔ nyɔguɛ. 5Akɛnɛ wa suɔ kaa nyɛ nine nɛ su anɔkuale ɔ tsuo nɛ ngɛ sane kpakpa a mi ɔ nɔ sisiisi he je ɔ, wa ngɔɛ a munyu ɔ.
6 Se ni nɛmɛ nɛ a buu mɛ kaa a ngɛ biɛ ɔ, bɔ tsuaa bɔ nɛ a ngɛ sa a, pi ye he sane ko. Mawu hyɛ we nimli a hɛ mi; ejakaa imi lɛɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ a buu mɛ ɔ tsɔɔ we mi nɔ́ ko ngɔ piɛ he. 7Mohu ɔ, a na paa kaa ní tsumi pɔtɛɛ nɛ Mawu ha mi ji kaa ma fiɛ sane kpakpa a ha ma je li kaa bɔ nɛ a hla Petro kaa e fiɛ sane kpakpa a ha Yuda bi ɔ. 8Ejakaa Mawu nɛ́ gu Petro nɔ kɛ tsu ní ngɛ Yuda bi a kpɛti ɔ, lɛ nɔuu lɛ gu ye nɔ kɛ tsu ní ngɛ ma je li ɔmɛ a kpɛti. 9Yakobo, Petro, kɛ Yohane nɛ a buu mɛ kaa asafo ɔ mi titimahi ɔ na paa kaa Mawu dloo mi babauu, nɛ e tu ní tsumi pɔtɛɛ nɛ ɔ ngɔ wo ye dɛ; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, mɛ hu a sa i kɛ Barnaba wa dɛ mi kɛ he wɔ atuu kaa nihi nɛ kɛ mɛ ngɛ ní tsumi kake tsue. Wa ma nya si kaa i kɛ Barnaba maa ya ma je li ɔmɛ a ngɔ, konɛ mɛɛ lɛɛ a ya Yuda bi ɔmɛ a ngɔ. 10Nɔ́ kake nɛ a kai wɔ wawɛɛ ngɛ he ji kaa wa hɛ ko je ohiatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ; nɛ enɛ ɔ hu ji nɔ́ ko nɛ ngɛ ye tsui nɔ kaa ma pee.
Paulo ka Petro hɛ mi ngɛ Antiokia
11Benɛ Petro ba Antiokia a, i ka e hɛ mi ngɛ ma hɛ mi; ejakaa nɔ́ nɛ e pee ɔ dɛ kulaa. 12Yakobo tsɔ ni komɛ kɛ ba Antiokia. Benɛ tsɔli ɔmɛ na we nɛ a ba a, Petro kɛ ma je li ɔmɛ yeɔ ní. Se benɛ tsɔli ɔmɛ ba su ɔ, Petro tsɔ e he kɛ je a he nɛ e kɛ mɛ yi ní hu, ejakaa e ngɛ nihi nɛ deɔ ke a po ma je li ɔmɛ doo ɔ, gbeye yee. 13Yuda bi nɛ piɛ ɔ hu pee jamɛ a osato ɔ, nɛ Barnaba tete po a gbla lɛ kɛ wo osato peemi nɛ ɔ mi. 14Benɛ i na kaa a nyɛɛ we ngɛ sane kpakpa a nya anɔkuale mi ɔ, i ka Petro hɛ mi ngɛ ni ɔmɛ tsuo a hɛ mi. I de lɛ ke, “Mo Yuda no ɔ, o peeɔ o ní kaa ma je no, se pi Yuda no! Kɛ peeɔ kɛɛ nɛ o nyɛɔ ma je li ɔmɛ a nɔ nɛ a pee a ní kaa Yuda bi ɔ?”
Hemi kɛ yemi a kɛ heɔ Yuda bi kɛ ma je li a yi wami
15Wɔ nitsɛmɛ ɔ, Yuda fɔfɔɛhi ji wɔ; wa pi ma je li yayami peeli. 16 Se kɛ̃ ɔ, wa le kaa loko a ma dla nɔ ko kɛ Mawu a kpɛti ɔ, ja nɔ ɔ he Yesu Kristo ye, se pi mlaa a nɔ yemi. Wɔ nitsɛmɛ po wa heɔ Kristo Yesu yeɔ, konɛ a dla waa kɛ Mawu wa kpɛti kɛ gu wa hemi kɛ yemi nɔ, se pi mlaa a nɔ yemi. Ejakaa pi mlaa a nɔ yemi nɔ nɛ a guu kɛ dlaa nɔ ko kɛ Mawu a kpɛti. 17Waa ngɔ lɛ kaa waa kɛ Yesu ngɛ bɔe, nɛ wa ngɛ mɔde bɔe nɛ a gu lɔ ɔ nɔ nɛ a dla waa kɛ Mawu wa kpɛti. Ke wa ngɛ yayami pee kaa ma je li ɔmɛ nɔuu ɔ, anɛ enɛ ɔ tsɔɔ kaa Kristo náá yayami he bua jɔmi lo? Dɛbi. 18Níhi nɛ i kpa peemi ɔ, ke i kpale ya ngɛ pee ekohu ɔ, lɛɛ i tsɔɔ paa kaa tɔlɔ ji mi. 19Ngɛ mlaa a blɔ fa mi ɔ, i plɛ pee nɔ gbogboe, konɛ ma hi wami mi ha Mawu mohu. I kɛ Kristo a sɛu ɔ nɛ. 20Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, jehanɛ lɛɛ, pi imi nitsɛ nɛ i ngɛ wami mi hu; se Kristo lɛ e hɛ ngɛ ngɛ ye mi. Mawu Bi ɔ suɔ mi, nɛ e ngɔ e wami ngɔ ha ngɛ ye he; nɛ imi hu i he lɛ ye. Lɔ ɔ lɛ ha nɛ i ngɛ wami mi amlɔ nɛ ɔ nɛ. 21I kplɛɛ kaa Mawu dloomi ji lɛ ha mi. Ke mlaa a nɔ a guu kɛ dlaa nɔ kɛ Mawu a kpɛti ɔ, lɛɛ Kristo gbo yaka gu.

Title: GALATIA BI 3
Content:
Mlaa a, aloo hemi kɛ yemi
1Nyɛ Galatia bi nɛ nyɛ be yi! Mɛnɔ gbiɛ nyɛ ke nyɛ ko bu anɔkuale ɔ tue? Yesu gbenɔ nɛ e gbo ngɛ sɛumi tso nɔ ɔ, a tsɔɔ nyɛ nɛ nyɛ na paa. 2Nyɛ ha ma bi nyɛ nɔ́ kake. Mlaa a nɔ nɛ nyɛ ye, aloo sane kpakpa a nɛ nyɛ nu nɛ nyɛ he ye ɔ nɛ ha nyɛ na Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ? 3Kikɛ nɛ ɔ nyɛ be yi! Nɛ nyɛ ngɔ Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ kɛ je sisi ɔ, jehanɛ lɛɛ nyɛɛ kɛ he lo maa gbe nya. 4Amanehlu babauu nɛ nyɛ na a, anɛ e maa pee yaka? Dɛbi! I he we yi! 5Mumi ɔ nɛ Mawu haa nyɛ, kɛ nyakpɛ níhi nɛ e tsuɔ ha nyɛ ɔ, anɛ mlaa a nɔ nɛ nyɛ yeɔ ɔ he je, aloo sane kpakpa a nɛ nyɛ nuɔ nɛ nyɛ heɔ yeɔ ɔ?
6 Ngmami ɔ ke, “A bu Abraham nɔ nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da, ejakaa e he Mawu ye.” 7 Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ ná nyɛɛ le kaa nihi nɛ heɔ Mawu yeɔ ɔ, mɛ ji Abraham nina. 8 Ngmami ɔ de to ke Mawu ma dla e kɛ ma je li nɛ heɔ yeɔ ɔ a kpɛti. E de Abraham sane kpakpa nɛ ɔ ke, “Mawu maa gu o nɔ kɛ maa gbaa ma je li ɔmɛ tsuo.” 9Abraham he Mawu ye, nɛ Mawu gbaa lɛ. Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ heɔ yeɔ ɔ, bɔ nɛ a gbaa Abraham ɔ, jã a maa gbaa lɛ.
10 Nihi nɛ susuu kaa ja a ye Yuda bi a mlaa a nɔ doo loko a ma he a yi wami ɔ, a gbiɛ mɛ. Ejakaa ngmami ɔ deɔ ke, “Mlaahi tsuo nɛ a ngma ngɛ Mawu mlaa womi ɔ mi ɔ, nɔ nɛ ma tɔ kake ngmelu nɔ ɔ, a gbiɛ lɛ.” 11 Jehanɛ ɔ, e fɔɔ si paa kaa pi mlaa a nɔ nɛ nɔ ko yeɔ ɔ nɛ ma ha a ma dla e kɛ Mawu a kpɛti. Ejakaa ngmami ɔ deɔ ke, “Nɔ nɛ heɔ Mawu yeɔ, nɛ lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a dla e kɛ Mawu a kpɛti ɔ, lɛ pɛ e yi wami a ma he.” 12 Se mlaa a kɔ we hemi kɛ yemi he; ejakaa a ngma ke, “Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ yeɔ mlaa a nɔ sisiisi ɔ yi ma na wami ngɛ mlaa a nya.”
13 Wa he ɔ, Kristo ba plɛ nɔ nɛ a gbiɛ lɛ, konɛ gbiɛmi nɛ ko ba wa nɔ ngɛ mlaa a nya a, e je wɔ kɛ je mi. Ejakaa a ngma ke, “Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ a sɛu lɛ ngɛ sɛumi tso nɔ ɔ, a gbiɛ lɛ.” 14Kristo pee enɛ ɔ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ gbaami nɛ Mawu wo Abraham si ngɛ he ɔ, kɛ gu Kristo nɔ ɔ, ma je li ɔmɛ a nine nɛ su nɔ. Kɛkɛ ɔ, kɛ gu hemi kɛ yemi nɔ ɔ, Mumi ɔ nɛ Mawu wo he si ɔ, wa nine maa su nɔ.
Mlaa a kɛ si womi ɔ
15Ye nyɛmimɛ, i suɔ kaa ma ha nyɛ nɔ hyɛmi nɔ́ ko kɛ je wa je mi si himi mi. Ke ni enyɔ ma nɔ́ ko nya si, nɛ a pee womi ngɔ fɔ nɔ ɔ, nɔ ko nɔ ko be nyɛe maa po mi, loo e maa ngɔ nɔ́ kpa ko ngɔ piɛ he. 16 Abraham, kɛ e nina Mawu wo si ɔ nɛ. Ngmami ɔ de we ke, “Kɛ e nina amɛ”, kaa nɔ́ nɛ a he hiɛ, se mohu e de ke, “Kɛ o nina”, nɛ tsɔɔ kaa nɔ kake pɛ; nɛ lɛ ji Kristo. 17 Nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ tsɔɔe ɔ ji kaa Mawu kɛ Abraham so, nɛ e wo si ke e maa ye nɔ. Mlaa a nɛ a wo jeha lafa eywiɛ kɛ nyingmi etɛ se ɔ be nyɛe maa po jamɛ a somi ɔ, kɛ si nɛ Mawu wo ɔ mi. 18 Gbosi ni ɔ nɛ Mawu wo Abraham e he si ɔ, Mawu ngɔ kɛ ha lɛ faa; pi mlaa a nɔ nɛ Abraham ye ɔ he je nɛ e ba mi. Kaa jã ji sane ɔ, lɛɛ e pi si womi hu.
19Lɛɛ jehanɛ ɔ, mɛni ji mlaa a he se nami mɔ? A ha wɔ mlaa a, konɛ wa kɛ le wa tɔmi ɔmɛ hluu kɛ yaa su be nɛ Abraham bi ɔ nɛ a wo lɛ si ngɛ he ɔ maa ba. Jehanɛ hu, hiɔwe bɔfohi lɛ ngɔ mlaa a kɛ ba ha je ɔ kɛ gu adesa nɔ. 20Se Mawu lɛɛ lɛ nɔ kake too lɛ wo Abraham si ɔ nɛ; e gui nɔ ko nɔ ko nɔ.
Nɔ́ he nɛ a wo mlaa a
21Anɛ enɛ ɔ tsɔɔ kaa mlaa a, kɛ si nɛ Mawu wo ɔ yɛ lo? Dɛbi! Mlaa a ma nyɛ ha nɔ wami jinɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ yeɔ mlaa a nɔ ɔ, Mawu ma dla e kɛ lɛ a kpɛti. 22Se ngmami ɔ deɔ ke, “Je ɔ tsuo hyi tɔ kɛ yayami sɔuu.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nike ní nɛ a wo he si ɔ, nihi nɛ heɔ Yesu Kristo yeɔ ɔ, mɛ pɛ lɛ a nine maa su nɔ.
23Se benɛ Kristo na we nɛ e ba lolo ɔ, wɔ tsuo wa pee kaa nihi nɛ a wo mɛ tsu, nɛ mlaa a lɛ ngɛ wɔ blɔ tsɔɔe. Kikɛmɛ a si himi mi wa ngɛ hluu kɛ ya si Kristo ba. 24Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, mlaa a hɛɛ wɔ kɛ ya su be nɛ Kristo ba nɛ wa he lɛ ye, konɛ a dla waa kɛ Mawu wa kpɛti. 25Se amlɔ nɛ ɔ nɛ Kristo ba, nɛ wa he lɛ ye ɔ, pi mlaa a nɛ hɛɛ wɔ hu.
26Nɛ nyɛ he Kristo Yesu ye, nɛ nyɛ ngɛ e mi ɔ, lɔ ɔ ha nɛ nyɛ peeɔ Mawu bimɛ. 27Nyɛ nihi tsuo nɛ a sɔle nyɛ ngɔ wo Kristo mi ɔ, amlɔ nɛ ɔ, Kristo pee kaa tade nɛ nyɛ wo. 28Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, slɔɔto ko kulaa be nyɛ kpɛti hu: Yuda no be ɔ, Hela no be; nyɔguɛ be ɔ, odehe be; nyumu be ɔ, yo be. Nɛ́ nyɛ tsuo nyɛ ngɛ Kristo Yesu mi nɛ ɔ, nyɛ tsuo nyɛ peeɔ nɔ kake. 29 Ke Kristo we bi ji nyɛ ɔ, lɛɛ Abraham nina ji nyɛ, nɛ si nɛ Mawu wo ɔ nya a, nyɛ peeɔ gbosi ní yeli.

Title: GALATIA BI 4
Content:
1Nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ tsɔɔe ɔ ji kaa bi nɛ maa ye e tsɛ ní hwɔɔ se ɔ, amlɔ nɛ ɔ nɛ e wɛ lolo ɔ, slɔɔto ko be e kɛ nyɔguɛ a kpɛti, pohu lɛ ji gbosi ní ɔ tsuo yelɔ. 2E jokuɛwi a si ɔ, nihi hyɛɛ e kɛ gbosi ní ɔ tsuo nɔ hluu kɛ ya siɔ be nɛ e tsɛ to ɔ loko a ngɔɔ ní ɔmɛ kɛ woɔ e dɛ. 3Jã kɛ̃ wɔ hu benɛ wa wɛ lolo ɔ, wa ngɛ kaa nyɔguɛhi; nɛ je nɛ ɔ mi kusumihi, kɛ mlaahi nɛ hɛɛ wɔ. 4Se Mawu tsɔ lɛ nitsɛ e bi ɔ kɛ ba ngɛ be nɛ sa mi; yo nɛ fɔ lɛ, nɛ e ye Yuda bi a mlaa a hu nɔ. 5 E ba, konɛ e ba kpɔ nihi nɛ Yuda mlaa a ye mɛ nyɔguɛ ɔ, konɛ e pee mɛ Mawu bimɛ.
6Mawu suɔ kaa e maa tsɔɔ nyɛ kaa e bimɛ ji nyɛ, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e tsɔ e bi ɔ mumi ɔ kɛ ba wa tsui mi. Kɛkɛ ɔ, wa ma nyɛ ma de anɔkuale mi ke, “Mawu, wa tsɛ ji mo.” 7Lɛɛ Mawu he ɔ, o pi nyɔguɛ hu, se mohu bi ji mo. Nɛ akɛnɛ bi ji mo ɔ, blɔ nya nɛ Mawu to ha e bimɛ ɔ, o nine maa su mo hu o nɔ́ nɔ.
Paulo ye tsui ngɛ Galatia bi ɔmɛ a he
8Sa a nɛ nyɛ li Mawu ɔ, nibɔ níhi nɛ pi mawuhi ji mɛ ngɛ a bɔmi su nya a ye nyɛ nyɔguɛ. 9Se jehanɛ nɛ nyɛ ba le Mawu, aloo ke ma de ɔ, Mawu mohu le nyɛ ɔ, mɛni he je nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ mumihi nɛ be he wami ko, nɛ a ní ngɛ mɔbɔ kikɛ nɛ ɔ, ekohu ɔ? Kɛ pee kɛɛ nɛ nyɛ ma ha nɛ a kpale ye nyɛ nyɔguɛ ɔ? 10Nyɛ toɔ be titli komɛ, ligbi komɛ, nyɔhiɔ komɛ, kɛ jeha komɛ nɛ nyɛ kɛ peeɔ kusumi. 11E peeɔ mi kaa dengme tsuo nɛ i gbo ngɛ nyɛ he ɔ miɔ nɛ e pee yaka.
12Ye nyɛmimɛ, i kpa nyɛ pɛɛ, nyɛɛ kase mi. Nyɛ le, sa a, i ngɛ kaa nyɛ. Nyɛ pee we mi yayami ko. 13Kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ le ɔ, kekleekle ɔ nɛ i ba fiɛ sane kpakpa a ha nyɛ ɔ, i be he wami. 14E ngɛ mi kaa ye hiɔ ɔ ha nɛ nyɛ gbo dengme babauu ngɛ ye he, se ye he pee we nyɛ tai, nɛ nyɛ kua we mi hulɔ; mohu ɔ, nyɛ he mi atuu kaa Mawu bɔfo. Ee, nyɛ he mi kaa Kristo Yesu nitsɛ. 15Bua jɔmi nɛ nyɛ kɛ nya ye he jamɛ a be ɔ, jije e ngɛ amlɔ nɛ ɔ? Imi nitsɛ ma nyɛ ma ye odase kaa jamɛ a be ɔ, kaa e hi peemi ɔ, jinɛ nyɛ ko ta nyɛ hɛngmɛ tete po ngɔ ha mi. 16Anɔkuale ɔ nɛ i de nyɛ ɔ, lɔ ɔ ha i ba pee nyɛ he nyɛlɔ; pi jã?
17Ni ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ nyɛ hɛ mi hae ɔ, nyɛ bu kaa a suɔ nyɛ; a be nyɛ he juɛmi kpakpa. A ngɛ hlae nɛ a puɛ i kɛ nyɛ wa kpɛti, konɛ nyɛ gbo mɛ mohu a he dengme. 18Niinɛ, ke nɔ ko hɛɛ yi mi tomi kpakpa a, e sa kaa e gboɔ he dengme. E hia kaa nyɛɛ pee enɛ ɔ be tsuaa be, se pi ke i ba nyɛ ngɔ kɛkɛ. 19Ye bimɛ nɛ i suɔ, nyɛɛ hyɛ bɔ nɛ i ngɛ haoe ngɛ nyɛ he ekohu kaa yo nɛ nu kɔɔmi, hluu kɛ yaa su be nɛ a maa na subai nɛ ngɛ Kristo mi ɔ ngɛ nyɛ mi. 20I na nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ kasa nya amlɔ nɛ ɔ, jinɛ i kɛ nyɛ ko tu munyu bɔ nɛ sa, ejakaa i ngɛ haoe wawɛɛ ngɛ nyɛ he.
Hagar kɛ Sara kaa nɔ hyɛmi nɔ́
21Nyɛ nihi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ hlae kaa mlaa a nɛ ye nyɛ nɔ ɔ, nyɛ ha ma bi nyɛ nɔ́ ko. Nɔ́ nɛ mlaa a deɔ ɔ be mi lo? 22 A ngma ke Abraham ngɛ binyumuhi enyɔ; e kɛ yo nyɔguɛ fɔ nɔ kake, nɛ nɔ enyɔne ɔ lɛɛ e kɛ yo odehe ɔ nɛ fɔ lɛ. 23Bi nɛ e kɛ yo nyɔguɛ ɔ fɔ ɔ, a fɔ lɛ kɛkɛ; se bi nɛ yo odehe ɔ fɔ ɔ, Mawu wo e he si. 24Ní nɛ ɔmɛ daa si ngɛ ní pɔtɛɛ komɛ a nane mi. Yi enyɔ ɔmɛ daa si ha somi enyɔ. A kpɛti nɔ kake ji Hagar. E je Sinai yo ɔ nɔ; nɛ bimɛ nɛ e fɔ ɔ, nyɔguɛhi ji mɛ. 25Hagar ngɛ kaa Sinai yo ɔ nɛ ngɛ Arabia a. Lɔ ɔ ji Yerusalem ma nɛ ngɛ amlɔ nɛ ɔ, ejakaa e kɛ e mi bi ɔmɛ tsuo ngɛ nyɔguɛ yemi mi kɛ mwɔɔ. 26Se Yerusalem kaketsɛ ɔ nɛ lɛɛ a kɛ lɛ to hiɔwe he ɔ, lɛɛ e ji odehe. Lɛ ji wɔ tsuo wa nyɛ. 27 Ejakaa ngmami ɔ de ke,
“Mo yosa nɛ o fɔ we, mo nya!
Mo nɛ o nui kɔɔmi hyɛ,
hwɔ lele, nɛ o nya!
Ejakaa yo nɛ e huno kua lɛ ɔ mohu
e bimɛ hiɛ pe yogbayo
nɛ ngɛ gba we daa a bimɛ.”
28Jehanɛ, ye nyɛmimɛ, wɔ lɛ a wo si kaa wa ma ba pee Mawu bimɛ, kaa bɔ nɛ a wo si loko a fɔ Isak ɔ nɛ. 29 Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, nɔ nɛ a fɔ lɛ kaa a fɔɔ adesa kɛkɛ ɔ wa nɔ nɛ a wo e he si loko a fɔ lɛ ɔ yi mi. Ja nɔuu e ngɛ mwɔnɛmwɔnɛ ɔ hulɔ. 30 Se kɛ ngmami ɔ deɔ kɛɛ? E deɔ ke, “Wo yo nyɔguɛ ɔ kɛ e bi ɔ blɔ nɛ a ho, ejakaa yo nyɔguɛ ɔ bi ɔ be he blɔ nɛ e kɛ yo odehe ɔ bi ɔ yeɔ gbosi ní.” 31Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ye nyɛmimɛ, pi yo nyɔguɛ ɔ bimɛ ji wɔ; odehe mohu ɔ bimɛ ji wi.

Title: GALATIA BI 5
Content:
Nyɛɛ pee nyɛ ní kaa nihi nɛ ye a he niinɛ
1Wa ye wa he. Ee, Kristo ha wa ye wa he. Nyɛɛ da si kpitikplii, konɛ nɔ ko kó ye nyɛ nyɔguɛ hu.
2Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, imi Paulo, i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke, ke nyɛ ha a po nyɛ ɔ, lɛɛ Kristo he be se nami ko kulaa kɛ ha nyɛ. 3I ngɛ hae nɛ nyɛɛ nu sisi saminya kaa nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ma ha nɛ a po lɛ ɔ, e hia doo kaa e ye mlaa a tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ hu nɔ. 4Nyɛ nihi nɛ nyɛ hlaa kaa nyɛ maa ye mlaa a nɔ, konɛ a dla nyɛɛ kɛ Mawu nyɛ kpɛti ɔ, pe nyɛ tsɔ nyɛ he kɛ je Kristo he ɔ nɛ. Enɛ ɔ tsɔɔ kaa nyɛ kua Mawu dloomi ɔ. 5Wɔɔ lɛɛ wa hemi kɛ yemi ji Mawu ma dla waa kɛ lɛ wa kpɛti. Mawu mumi ɔ nɛ tsuɔ ní ngɛ wa mi ɔ lɛ ha wa ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ blɔ hyɛe ɔ nɛ. 6Ke nɔ ko ngɛ Kristo mi ɔ, a po lɛ jio, a pui lɛ jio, lɔ ɔ tsu we nɔ́ ko. Nɔ́ nɛ he hia wawɛɛ mohu ji hemi kɛ yemi nɛ jeɔ kpo ngɛ suɔmi nɛ wa ngɛ kɛ ha wa nyɛmimɛ ɔ mi ɔ.
7Jinɛ nyɛ ngɛ nyɛ he mɔde bɔe saminya. Se mɛnɔ po lɛ ba puɛ nyɛ tue nɛ nyɛ he we anɔkuale ɔ yi hu ɔ? 8Kikɛmɛ a yi mi tsakemi ɔ, Mawu, nɔ nɛ hla nyɛ ɔ, pi lɛ nɛ pee. 9 “Masa bɔbɔyoo pɛ lɛ haa ma a tsuo fuɔ.” 10Se imi lɛɛ i ngɔ ye hɛ ngɔ fɔ nyɛ nɔ. I le kaa nyɛ be nɔ kpa ko munyu nue. Nɔ tutuutu nɛ ngɛ nyɛ tue puɛe ɔ, Mawu maa gbla e tue kokooko!
11Ye nyɛmimɛ, ke i ngɛ fiɛe kɛ mwɔɔ ke e hia nɛ a po nɔ doo ɔ, lɛɛ mɛni he je a ngɛ mi yi mi wae kpamisa mɔ? Ke ja ji sane ɔ, lɛɛ Kristo sɛumi tso ɔ he sane ɔ nɛ i ngɛ fiɛe ɔ, e sɛ́ kaa e haoɔ nɔ ko. 12Nihi nɛ ngɛ nyɛ tue puɛe kikɛ nɛ ɔ, i na nɛ a puɛ mɛ, loo a ta mɛ nitsɛmɛ a he kɛkɛ nɛ e jɔ!
13Ye nyɛmimɛ, nyɛɛ lɛɛ pe a hla nyɛ, konɛ nyɛ ba ye nyɛ he. Nyɛ he nɛ nyɛ ye nɛ ɔ, nyɛ ko ngɔ lɛ kaa blɔ nya nɛ nyɛ na nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ maa pee níhi nɛ nyɛ nɔmlɔ tso ɔ suɔ. Mohu ɔ, nyɛ ha nɛ nyɛ suɔmi ɔ nɛ je kpo ngɛ nyɛmimɛ a sɔmɔmi mi. 14 Ejakaa mlaa a tsuo nɔ yemi ɔ kpiti pomi ji, “Suɔ o nyɛmi kaa bɔ nɛ o suɔ mo nitsɛ o he.” 15Se ke nyɛ pee nyɛ he lohwe dikali nɛ nyɛ ngɛ nyɛ he nɔ́ yeyee pee ɔ, lɔ ɔ lɛɛ nyɛ ma kpata nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ.
Mawu mumi ɔ kɛ nɔmlɔ adesa su
16I ngɛ nyɛ dee ke, nyɛ ha nɛ Mawu mumi ɔ nɛ tsɔɔ nyɛ bɔ nɛ nyɛ maa ba nyɛ je mi ha, konɛ nyɛ ko tsu nɔmlɔ tso ɔ suɔmi nya ní. 17 Ejakaa nɔ́ nɛ nɔmlɔ tso ɔ suɔ ɔ, pi lɔ ɔ nɛ mumi ɔ suɔ; nɛ nɔ́ nɛ mumi ɔ suɔ ɔ, pi lɔ ɔ nɛ nɔmlɔ tso ɔ suɔ. Nɔ́ enyɔ nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ a he yi. Enɛ ɔ tsɔɔ kaa nyɛ be nyɛe maa pee nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ suɔmi nya ní. 18Se ke mumi ɔ lɛ tsɔɔ nyɛ blɔ ɔ, lɛɛ mlaa a yi nyɛ nɔ hu.
19Ke nɔ ko peeɔ he lo ɔ nya ní ɔ, níhi nɛ jeɔ mi kɛ baa ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ: gba puɛmi, mu ní tsumi, yahomi, 20amaga jami, kunya tsumi, ninyɛ, pɛ hlami, hunga jemi, mi mi la womi, pɛ, mi gbami, nya hiɔmi, 21hɛkɔ, dã demi, fiɛmi yaya, kɛ ní yaya peemi kpahi fuu kaa níhi nɛ i tsi a ta nɛ ɔ. I ka nyɛ hɛ mi momo ngɛ kikɛmɛ a je mi bami nɛ ɔmɛ a he, nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ kɔkɔ bɔe ekohu ke nihi nɛ peeɔ kikɛmɛ a ní nɛ ɔmɛ a nine be Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ nɔ sue gblegbleegble.
22Se Mawu mumi ɔ yiblii ji suɔmi, bua jɔmi, he jɔmi, tsui si tomi, mi mi himi, kpakpa peemi, hemi kɛ yemi, 23he si bami, kɛ he nɔ yemi. Enɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, mlaa ko mlaa ko tsi nya. 24Nihi nɛ ji Kristo Yesu we bi ɔ, akɔnɔ, kɛ he lo nya níhi nɛ a suɔ ɔ, a ngmɛɛ he kulaa kaa nɔ́ nɛ pe a sɛu ní ɔmɛ tsuo ngɛ sɛumi tso nɔ. 25Ke mumi ɔ lɛ haa wɔ wami ɔ, lɛɛ nyɛ ha nɛ e tsɔɔ wɔ blɔ hulɔ. 26Wa ko wó wa he nɔ; wa ko wo wa sibi a mi mi la, nɛ wa hɛ ko kɔ wa sibi a nɔ hulɔ.

Title: GALATIA BI 6
Content:
Nyɛɛ ye bua nyɛ sibi ngɛ fimi mi
1Ye nyɛmimɛ, ke nyɛ ti nɔ ko tɔ ɔ, nyɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ Mawu mumi ɔ ngɛ nyɛ mi ɔ, nyɛɛ bɔ mɔde nɛ nyɛɛ ngɔ lɛ kɛ ba blɔ dadɛ nɔ. Nyɛɛ to nyɛ tsui si blɛuu kɛ pee nɔ́ nɛ ɔ. Nyɛɛ hyɛ saminya, konɛ nyɛ nitsɛmɛ hu nyɛ ko ya sɛ jamɛ a ka a eko mi. 2Nyɛɛ kpee nyɛ sibi kɛ tloo nyɛ tlomi ɔmɛ kaa bɔ nɛ Kristo mlaa a tsɔɔ kaa nyɛɛ pee ɔ. 3Ke e peeɔ nɔ ko kaa nɔ ko ji lɛ, se pohu pi nɔ ko kulaa ji lɛ ɔ, lɛ nitsɛ e he nɛ e ngɛ sisie. 4Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ hyɛ lɛ nitsɛ e ní peepee. Ke e hi ɔ, e ma nyɛ maa fĩa ngɔ fɔ nɔ, nɛ e be hiae kaa e maa ngɔ e he ngɔ to nɔ kpa he; 5ejakaa nɔ tsuaa nɔ maa tloo lɛ nitsɛ e tlomi.
6Nɔ nɛ a ngɛ lɛ ní tsɔɔe ɔ, kɛ e tsɔɔlɔ ɔ nɛ dla ní kpakpahi nɛ e ngɛ ɔ.
7Nyɛ ko sisi nyɛ he. Mawu ɔ, a yi e he fɛu. Nɔ́ nɛ nɔmlɔ du ɔ, lɔ ɔ nɔuu e ma kpa. 8Ke nɔ ko ya tsu ní ngɛ he lo mi ɔ, e ma kpa nɔ́ nɛ puɛɔ nɛ ma kpata e hɛ mi. Jã kɛ̃ ke nɔ ko tsu ní ngɛ Mawu mumi ɔ nya, Mawu mumi ɔ ma ha e na neneene wami. 9Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, wa ko ha nɛ kpakpa peemi nɛ gbe wa nya; ejakaa ke wa kɔni mi wui nyu ɔ, ní kpami be ɔ, wa ma na he se. 10Lɛɛ ke e maa hi ɔ, waa pee nihi tsuo kpakpa daa, titli ɔ, nihi nɛ waa kɛ mɛ hɛɛ hemi kɛ yemi kake ɔ.
Nyagbe kɔkɔ bɔmi kɛ sɛ yemi
11Nyɛɛ hyɛ bɔ nɛ i kɛ imi nitsɛ ye nine ngma ní agboagbo kɛ mane nyɛ! 12Nihi nɛ hlaa kaa a maa nyɛ nyɛ nɔ kaa ja a po nyɛ doo ɔ, nihi a hɛ mi kɛkɛ lɛ a ngɛ hlae nɛ a sa. Ejakaa a le kaa ke a de ke loko a ma he nɔ ko yi wami ɔ, ja nɔ ɔ na amanehlu kaa Kristo ɔ, nihi maa wa mɛ yi mi. 13Nihi nɛ a kusumi ji kaa a po mɛ ɔ, mɛ nitsɛmɛ po a yi mlaa a nɔ. A ngɛ hlae kɛkɛ nɛ a fĩa kaa mɛ lɛ a pee lɛ nyɛ kplɛɛ nɛ a po nyɛ. 14Se imi lɛɛ i be fĩae ngɔ fɔ nɔ́ kpa ko nɔ́ kpa ko nɔ kaa ja wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo sɛumi tso ɔ pɛ. Gbenɔ nɛ Kristo gbo ngɛ sɛumi tso ɔ nɔ ɔ ngɛ kaa nɔ́ nɛ pe a sɛu je ɔ kɛ ha mi, nɛ a sɛu imi hu kɛ ha je ɔ. 15A po nɔ ko jio, a pui nɔ ko jio, e he hia we kulaa. Nɔ́ nɛ he hia kɛkɛ ji kaa nɔ ko ma tsake kɛ pee bɔ nɔ he. 16Nihi tsuo nɛ maa ba a je mi kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ, Mawu nɛ na mɛ mɔbɔ, nɛ e ha mɛ he jɔmi. Ee, Mawu nɛ pee enɛ ɔ ha mɛ kɛ lɛ nitsɛ e ma, Israel ɔ tsuo.
17Kɛ je mwɔnɛ ɔ kɛ yaa a, nɔ ko kó doo ye nya hu. Yesu nɔ́ nami okadihi ngɛ ye nɔmlɔ tso ɔ he.
18Ye nyɛmimɛ, wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo dloomi ɔ kɛ nyɛ tsuo nɛ hi si. Amen.

Title: EFESO BI NYA TSƆƆMI
Content:
NYA TSƆƆMI
Womi nɛ Paulo ngma ya ha Efeso asafo ɔ, kekleekle nɔ́ he nɛ e kɔɔ ji, “Yi mi nɛ Mawu to kaa e ma ha nɛ bɔ níhi tsuo maa pee kake, níhi nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe kɛ ní nɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ; nɛ Kristo maa ye matsɛ ngɛ mɛ tsuo a nɔ” ɔ (1.10). Jehanɛ ɔ hu, kɛ gu womi nɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ, Paulo ngɛ ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ tsuo pɛɛ kpae, konɛ a ngɔ a he ngɔ mɛtɛ Kristo he, nɛ a ba a je mi saminya. Ke a pee ja a, yi mi nguaa nɛ Mawu to kaa e ma ha nɛ adesahi tsuo maa pee kake ɔ maa je kpo paa nɛ nihi maa na.
Paulo tsɔɔ kake peemi nɛ ɔ nya saminya ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ kekleekle fa a mi. E tsɔɔ kaa nɛ Tsɛ Mawu hla e ma a, e ngɔ a he yayami ngɔ pa mɛ, nɛ kɛ gu e Bi Yesu Kristo nɔ ɔ, e ha a ye a he. Mawu ha nɛ e Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ ba, nɛ e kɛ to okadi kaa si ko nɛ lɛ Mawu ɔ wo ɔ, ja e ba mi. Ngɛ womi ɔ fa enyɔne ɔ mi ɔ, Paulo ngɛ asafo mi bi ɔmɛ ga woe kaa a ba a je mi saminya, konɛ nihi nɛ na niinɛ kaa kake peemi ngɛ a kɛ Kristo a kpɛti.
Kake peemi nɛ ngɛ ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ a kpɛti, kɛ gu a kɛ Kristo a kake peemi mi ɔ, Pualo tsɔɔ nya ngɛ blɔ slɔɔtohi a nɔ. E ke asafo ɔ ngɛ kaa nɔmlɔ tso, nɛ e yi ji Kristo. Enyɔne ji, asafo ɔ ngɛ kaa tsu, nɛ e kɔ nya tɛ ji Kristo. Nyagbe ɔ, Paulo de ke asafo ɔ ngɛ kaa yogbayo, nɛ e huno ji Kristo. Mawu gu Kristo nɔ kɛ dloo wɔ babauu. Enɛ ɔ he susumi ha nɛ Paulo kɛ hɛdɔ ngma womi nɛ ɔ nɛ ke o kane ɔ, ja o he mi po. Ke wa le suɔmi agbo nɛ Kristo ngɛ kɛ ha wɔ ɔ, womi nɛ ɔ sisi numi be wae ha wɔ. Kristo ngɔ e he ngɔ sã bɔ, e kɛ wa he yayami pa wɔ, e dloo wɔ, nɛ e he tsɔ.
Bɔ nɛ a dla womi ɔ mi ha
Sisije 1.1-2
Kristo kɛ asafo ɔ 1.3—3.21
Wami he nɛ wa naa ngɛ waa kɛ Kristo wa kake peemi mi 4.1—6.20
Nyagbe 6.21-24

Title: EFESO BI 1
Content:
1 Imi Paulo, nɛ Mawu suɔmi nya nɛ i ba pee Kristo Yesu bɔfo ɔ, imi lɛ i ngma womi nɛ ɔ ya ha ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ Efeso, nihi nɛ kɛ je be nɛ a ba le Kristo Yesu ɔ, a ngmɛɛ we a hemi kɛ yemi ɔ he kulaa a.
2Dloomi kɛ he jɔmi nɛ je wa Tsɛ Mawu ɔ, kɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo dɛ mi ɔ ha nyɛ!
Kristo haa wɔ mumi mi ní kpakpahi
3Sina ha Mawu, wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo Mawu ɔ, kɛ e Tsɛ ɔ! Ejakaa nɛ wa ngɛ Kristo mi ɔ, Mawu dloo wɔ mumi mi ní kpakpahi tsuo nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ. 4Benɛ a na we nɛ a bɔ je ɔ tete po ɔ, Mawu hla wɔ ngɔ pee lɛ nitsɛ e nihi momo ngɛ Kristo mi. E pee enɛ ɔ, konɛ wa he nɛ tsɔ, nɛ piami ko kó hi wa he ngɛ e hɛ mi.
Mawu suɔ wɔ saminya, enɛ ɔ he ɔ, 5e pee e yi mi momo kaa kɛ gu Yesu Kristo nɔ ɔ, e maa ngɔ wɔ kɛ pee e bimɛ. Nɔ́ nɛ e suɔ, nɛ e to nɛ e maa pee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. 6E sa kaa wa je Mawu yi kaa e gu e dloomi nɛ hɛ mi ngɛ nyami ɔ nɔ ngɔ e bi nɛ e suɔ ɔ ngɔ ke wɔ yaka gu! 7 Ejakaa Kristo ngɔ e he ngɔ sã bɔ, nɛ e kɛ e muɔ kpɔ wɔ, nɛ e dloomi babauu ɔ nya a, a e ngɔ wa he yayami ɔmɛ ngɔ pa wɔ. 8Niinɛ, e ha wɔ kɛ be nɔ po!
Mawu ngɔ e nile, kɛ e juɛmi 9kɛ pee níhi tsuo nɛ e to kaa e maa pee ɔ. Laami nɔ́ ko nɛ e to e yi mi momo ke e maa pee kɛ gu Kristo nɔ ɔ, e je tsɔɔ wɔ. 10Nɔ́ nɛ Mawu to nɛ e maa pee ke be ɔ su ɔ ji kaa e ma ha nɛ bɔ níhi tsuo maa pee kake, níhi nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe, kɛ ní nɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ. Nɛ Kristo maa ye matsɛ ngɛ mɛ tsuo a nɔ.
11Nɔ́ nɛ Mawu suɔ kaa e maa pee, kɛ nɔ́ nɛ e to kaa e ba mi ɔ, lɔ ɔ e peeɔ. Mawu hla wɔ, konɛ wa ba pee lɛ nitsɛ e nihi, nɛ́ waa kɛ Kristo nɛ pee kake. Mawu suɔmi nya ní, kɛ yi mi nɛ e to kɛ je sisije tɔɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. 12Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, wɔ nɛ wa ji kekleekle nihi nɛ wa ngɔ wa hɛ ngɔ fɔ Kristo nɔ ɔ, nyɛ ha wa je Mawu yi kaa e hɛ mi ngɛ nyami.
13Nyɛ hu, benɛ nyɛ nu anɔkuale sɛ gbi ɔ nɛ ji sane kpakpa a nɛ ma ha nɛ a he nyɛ yi wami ɔ, nyɛ he Kristo ye, nɛ Mawu ha nɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ nɛ e wo he si ɔ ba nyɛ nɔ. Mawu pee enɛ ɔ, nɛ e kɛ kadi nyɛ kaa e nihi ji nyɛ niinɛ. 14Si nɛ Mawu wo e ni ɔmɛ ɔ, mumi ɔ e kɛ ma nɔ mi kaa wa nine maa su nɔ. Nɛ enɛ ɔ woɔ wɔ he wami kaa Mawu ma ha e we bi maa ye a he kulaa. Nyɛ ha wa je e yi kɛ wo e hɛ mi nyami.
Paulo kpa Mawu pɛɛ
15Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, kɛ je benɛ i nu kaa nyɛ heɔ Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo yeɔ saminya, nɛ Mawu we bi ɔmɛ hu nyɛ suɔ mɛ ja nɔuu ɔ, 16i kpa we Mawu si nami ha nyɛ. Ke i ngɛ sɔlee ɔ, i kaiɔ nyɛ, 17nɛ i kpaa pɛɛ kaa wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo Mawu ɔ, kɛ wa Tsɛ nɛ hɛ mi ngɛ nyami ɔ nɛ ha nyɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ. Mumi ɔ ma ha nɛ nyɛ maa le bɔ nɛ Mawu ngɛ anɔkuale mi, nɛ e ma je Mawu kpo kɛ tsɔɔ nyɛ, nɛ nyɛ maa le lɛ saminya. 18I kpaa Mawu pɛɛ nɛ e bli nyɛ mumi mi hɛngmɛ. Kɛkɛ ɔ, níhi nɛ Mawu wo si kaa e ma ha nyɛ benɛ e tsɛ nyɛ, nɛ nyɛ ngɔ nyɛ hɛ ngɔ fɔ nɔ ɔ, nyɛ maa na. Nyɛ maa le hu kaa níhi nɛ Mawu wo si kaa e ma ha e ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ ɔ, a hɛ mi ngɛ nyami babauu. 19Jehanɛ ɔ hu nyɛ ma yɔse kaa Mawu he wami kpetekpleenyɛ nɛ ngɛ ní tsue ngɛ wɔ nihi nɛ wa heɔ yeɔ ɔ wa mi ɔ, 20 jamɛ a he wami ɔ nɔuu nɛ Mawu kɛ tle Kristo si kɛ je gbeje, nɛ e ngɔ lɛ ngɔ hi e hiɔ nɔ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ nɛ. 21Lejɛ ɔ Kristo ngɛ tsɛ yee ngɛ kɛ he wami kpetekpleenyɛ nɛ pã nihi tsuo nɛ ngɛ tsɛ yee ngɛ hiɔwe a he wami. Biɛ nɛ Kristo hɛɛ ɔ hu pã biɛhi tsuo ngɛ je nɛ ɔ, kɛ je nɛ maa ba a tsuo mi. 22 Mawu ha Kristo he wami ngɛ níhi tsuo a nɔ, nɛ e ngɔ lɛ ngɔ pee tsɛ ha asafo ɔ, konɛ e ye níhi tsuo a nɔ. 23Asafo ɔ ji Kristo nɔmlɔ tso nɛ haa níhi tsuo a he suu. Kristo haa níhi tsuo a he suu ngɛ he tsuaa he.

Title: EFESO BI 2
Content:
Kɛ je gbenɔ mi kɛ ba wami mi
1 Sa a, nyɛ ngɛ kaa nihi nɛ gbo, ejakaa nyɛ gbo Mawu tue, nɛ nyɛ pee yayami kɛ si lɛ. 2Jamɛ a be ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ je nɛ ɔ peeɔ ɔ, lɔ ɔ nyɛ hu nyɛ peeɔ. Nyɛ ya nyɛɛ nɔ nɛ yeɔ mumi yayami ɔmɛ a nɔ ngɛ kɔɔhiɔ mi ɔ se. Nihi nɛ gboɔ Mawu tue ɔ, mumi nɛ ɔ lɛ ngɛ ní tsue ngɛ a mi amlɔ nɛ ɔ. 3Niinɛ, sa a, wɔ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ wa ngɛ kaa mɛ; nɛ akɔnɔ yaya nɛ ngɛ wa mi ɔ jeɔ kpo ngɛ wa ní peemi níhi a mi. Níhi nɛ wa nɔmlɔ tso ɔ, kɛ wa juɛmi suɔ ɔ, lɔ ɔmɛ wa peeɔ. Akɛnɛ adesa kɛkɛ ji wɔ kaa bɔ nɛ nihi tsuo ngɛ ɔ, e fɔɔ si paa kaa Mawu maa gbla wa tue. Mawu mi mi fu wɔ kaa bɔ nɛ e mi mi fu adesahi tsuo ɔ, ejakaa wa pee yayami kɛ si lɛ.
4Se Mawu lɛɛ e mɔbɔ nami ɔ hiɛ babauu; jã kɛ̃ nɛ suɔmi nɛ e ngɛ kɛ ha wɔ ɔ hu kle. 5Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, be mi nɛ wa gbo tue, nɛ wa pee kaa nihi nɛ gbo ɔ, e ha wa ba wami mi ekohu benɛ e tle Kristo si kɛ je gbeje ɔ. Dloomi nya nɛ a he nyɛ yi wami. 6Mawu tle waa kɛ Kristo si, konɛ waa kɛ lɛ tsuo nɛ ye tsɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ejakaa wa ngɛ e mi. 7E pee enɛ ɔ, konɛ e kɛ tsɔɔ yi nɔhi tsuo nɛ maa ba hwɔɔ se ɔ kaa Kristo Yesu he ɔ, e suɔ wɔ saminya, nɛ e dloo wɔ babauu. 8-9Mawu dloomi nya nɛ a he nyɛ yi wami akɛnɛ nyɛ he ye ɔ. Pi dengme ko nɛ nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ gbo he je; e ji nɔ́ nɛ Mawu ke nyɛ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko ko fĩa. 10Mawu nitsɛ lɛ pee wɔ bɔ nɛ wa ngɛ nɛ ɔ. E ha waa kɛ Kristo Yesu ba nu huɛ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ waa ngɔ wa wami be ɔ tsuo kɛ pee nihi kpakpa. E to blɔ nya nɛ ɔ blema lokoo konɛ waa nyɛɛ ngɛ nya.
Waa kɛ Kristo pee kake
11Ma je li, pi Yuda fɔfɔɛ ji nyɛ. Ni nɛmɛ nɛ deɔ ke mɛɛ lɛɛ Mawu nitsɛ e nihi ji mɛ ɔ, bɔ nɛ a tsɛɔ nyɛ ji mɔmlɔtɔtsɛmɛ. A tsɛɔ nyɛ jã, ejakaa a po mɛ; se lɔ ɔ po nɔ́ ko kɛkɛ nɛ adesa pee. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ kai bɔ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ sa be ko ɔ. 12Jamɛ a be ɔ, nyɛ li Kristo. Nihi nɛ Mawu hla a, nyɛ be a kpɛti; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nibwɔhi ji nyɛ. Somi nɛ Mawu kɛ e ni ɔmɛ so, kɛ si nɛ e wo mɛ ɔ, nyɛ piɛ we he. Nyɛ hi si ngɛ je ɔ mi kɛkɛ, nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ hɛ fɔ we nɔ́ ko nɔ; Mawu nitsɛ tete nyɛ li lɛ. 13Sa a, nyɛɛ kɛ Mawu nyɛ kpɛti kɛ wawɛɛ nitsɛ. Se jehanɛ ɔ nɛ kɛ gu Kristo muɔ ɔ nɔ ɔ, nyɛ ba ngɛ Kristo Yesu mi ɔ, a kpale nyɛ kɛ ba Mawu kasa nya haa. Gbenɔ nɛ Kristo gbo, nɛ e ngɔ e he ngɔ sã bɔ ɔ, lɔ ɔ lɛ tsu enɛ ɔ. 14Ejakaa Kristo nitsɛ ba pee Yuda bi, kɛ ma je li kake, nɛ enɛ ɔ ha nɛ he jɔmi ba. Ninyɛ nɛ pee kaa gbogbo ngɛ Yuda bi kɛ ma je li a kpɛti ɔ, Kristo ha nɛ jamɛ a ninyɛ ɔ se po gbidigbidi. 15 Kristo gbo nɛ e kɛ po Yuda bi a mlaa a, kɛ a kɔ ɔmɛ a mi, nɛ e pee Yuda bi ɔmɛ, kɛ ma je li ɔmɛ kake ngɛ lɛ nitsɛ e mi; nɛ enɛ ɔ kɛ he jɔmi ba. 16 Kristo gbo ngɛ sɛumi tso ɔ nɔ ɔ nɛ e kɛ dla ni enyɔ ɔmɛ kɛ Mawu a kpɛti kaa nɔmlɔ tso kake; nɛ e ha niyɛ nɛ ngɛ a kɛti ɔ se po ninyɛ nɛ ngɛ ni enyɔ ɔmɛ a kpɛti ɔ se po. 17 Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Kristo ba nɛ e ba fiɛ sane kpakpa a nɛ haa nɔ he jɔmi ɔ ngɔ tsɔɔ nihi tsuo. E fiɛ ngɔ tsɔɔ nyɛ ma je li nɛ sa a nyɛɛ kɛ Mawu kpɛti kɛ ɔ, kɛ Yuda bi nɛ mɛɛ lɛɛ a ngɛ e kasa nya haa a. 18Yuda bi jio, ma je li jio, Kristo nɔ lɛ wɔ tsuo wa maa gu kɛ ba Tsɛ ɔ ngɔ. Mumi Klɔuklɔu kake ɔ nɔuu lɛ maa piɛ wa he.
19Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ ma je li, jehanɛ ɔ nyɛ pi nibwɔhi, loo ma se bi hu, se mohu nyɛɛ kɛ ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ tsuo peeɔ ma mi bi, kɛ Mawu we bi. 20Sisi tomi nɛ a fia nyɛ ngɔ ma nɔ ji sɛ gbi ɔ nɛ bɔfo ɔmɛ, kɛ gbali ɔmɛ fiɛ ɔ; nɛ Kristo Yesu nitsɛ ngɛ kaa tsu ɔ kɔ nya tɛ. 21Lɛ ji nɔ nɛ ha nɛ tsu ɔ he ní slɔɔto ɔmɛ tsuo nu a he kɛ da si kpɛkpɛtɛɛ. Lɛ nɛ e haa tsu ɔ waa, nɛ e ba peeɔ sɔlemi we klɔuklɔu nɛ a hla ngɔ to ha Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ. 22Nyɛ hu mumi ɔ ngɔ nyɛɛ kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ heɔ yeɔ tsuo ngɔ mɛtɛ Kristo he, nɛ nyɛ ba pee Mawu sihi he.

Title: EFESO BI 3
Content:
Ní nɛ Paulo tsu ha ma je li ɔmɛ
1Mawu pee Yuda bi, kɛ nyɛ ma je li tsuo kake. Enɛ ɔ he ɔ, a wo imi Paulo tsu ngɛ Kristo Yesu, kɛ nyɛ hu nyɛ he. 2I heɔ yeɔ kaa ní tsumi nɛ Mawu dloomi ɔ tu ngɔ wo ye dɛ ngɛ nyɛ ma je li ɔmɛ nyɛ he ɔ, nyɛ maa nu he. 3Yi mi nɛ Mawu to ngɛ laami mi ɔ, e je ngɔ tsɔɔ mi. I ngma enɛ ɔ he nɔ́ ko bɔɔ momo. 4 Ke nyɛ kane nɔ́ nɛ i ngma a saminya a, yi mi nɛ Mawu to ngɛ laami mi, nɛ Kristo ha nɛ e ba mi ɔ, nyɛ maa na bɔ nɛ i nu sisi ha. 5Yi nɔhi nɛ be ɔ, adesa li laami sane nɛ ɔ. Se jehanɛ lɛɛ Mawu gu Mumi Klɔuklɔu nɔ je kpo kɛ tsɔɔ e bɔfo klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ, kɛ gbali ɔmɛ. 6Laami sane ɔ ji kaa sane kpakpa a he ɔ, gbaami nɛ Mawu gbaa Yuda bi ɔmɛ ɔ, ma je li ɔmɛ hu ba na eko. Mɛ tsuo a ba pee kaa nɔmlɔ tso kake ɔ he níhi; nɛ si nɛ Mawu wo kɛ gu Kristo Yesu nɔ ɔ, a ná mɛ hu a blɔ nya nɔ.
7Mawu dloo mi nike ní pɔtɛɛ ko kaa sane kpakpa a fiɛlɔ, nɛ ma kɛ sɔmɔ lɛ. E he wami ɔ nɛ e kɛ tsu nɔ́ nɛ ɔ. 8Jinɛ i pi nɔ ko kulaa ngɛ ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ a kpɛti. Se Mawu ha mi dloomi nɛ ɔ kaa ma ya fiɛ sane kpakpa a ha ma je li ɔmɛ, nɛ ma tsɔɔ mɛ ní kpakpahi nɛ a ma na ke a ba nyɛɛ Kristo se. 9Mawu ke ma fiɛ, konɛ je ɔ tsuo nɛ nu bɔ nɛ laami sane nguaa nɛ ɔ ma plɛ kɛ ba mi ha. Mawu nɛ́ bɔ níhi tsuo ɔ, ngɔ laami sane nɛ ɔ kɛ laa yi nɔhi nɛ be ɔ. 10E pee enɛ ɔ, konɛ jehanɛ lɛɛ nɔ yeli tsuo, kɛ nihi nɛ ngɛ tsɛ yee ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ nɛ a na bɔ nɛ Mawu juɛmi mi kuɔ, kɛ bɔ nɛ asafo ɔ ngɛ ní tsue nɛ Mawu yi mi tomi ɔ nɛ ba mi. 11Blema lokoo nɛ Mawu to e yi mi kaa e ma tsu nɔ́ ko kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ, nɛ e gu wa Nyɔmtsɛ Kristo Yesu nɔ nɛ e ha nɛ e ba mi. 12Akɛnɛ wa heɔ Kristo Yesu yeɔ, nɛ wa ngɔ wa hɛ ngɔ fɔ e nɔ he je ɔ, wa yi gbeye kaa wa maa ya Mawu hɛ mi. 13Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i kpa nyɛ pɛɛ, nyɛ ko ye nyɛ tsui kaa i ngɛ nɔ́ nae ngɛ nyɛ he. I ngɛ nɔ́ nae, konɛ nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ hɛ mi nɛ ba nyami.
Kristo suɔmi
14Enɛ ɔ he i kplaa si ngɛ Tsɛ ɔ hɛ mi. 15Ejakaa nihi tsuo nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe, kɛ zugba a nɔ ɔ, lɛ nɛ haa mɛ biɛ. 16I kpaa Mawu pɛɛ, konɛ kɛ gu e ní babauu nɛ hɛ mi ngɛ nyami ɔ nɔ ɔ, e ha nɛ e Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ nɛ wo nyɛ mumi mi he wami. 17I kpaa pɛɛ nɛ nyɛ he ye, nɛ Kristo nɛ hi nyɛ tsui mi, konɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ pee ɔ, nyɛɛ pee kɛ suɔmi nɛ mi wa. 18Kɛkɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ kɛ ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ tsuo nyɛ ma yɔse suɔmi nɛ Kristo ngɛ kɛ ha nyɛ ɔ mi blimi, e kami, kɛ e mi kuɔmi. 19Ee, nyɛ ma ba yɔse Kristo suɔmi nɛ nɔmlɔ adesa juɛmi sui he ɔ, nɛ nyɛ su maa hi kaa Mawu nitsɛ su.
20Mawu kɛ he wami kpetekpleenyɛ tsuɔ ní ngɛ wa mi, nɛ e peeɔ níhi nɛ hiɛ babauu kɛ be nɔ kɛ haa wɔ, níhi nɛ wa be nyɛe ma bi, kɛ ní nɛmɛ nɛ wa juɛmi sui he po. 21Á gu Kristo Yesu nɔ kɛ wo Mawu hɛ mi nyami yi nɔhi tsuo ngɛ asafo ɔ mi kɛ ya neneene kɛ neneene. Amen.

Title: EFESO BI 4
Content:
Kristo nɔmlɔ tso ɔ, nɔ́ kake ji lɛ
1Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, imi nɛ a wo mi tsu ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nɛ i ngɛ sɔmɔe ɔ he ɔ, i kpa nyɛ pɛɛ nɛ nyɛɛ ba nyɛ je mi saminya, bɔ nɛ maa sa ní tsumi nɛ Mawu tsɛ nyɛ ke nyɛ ba tsu ɔ. 2 Nyɛɛ ba nyɛ he si; nyɛɛ pee nyɛ he humi, nɛ nyɛɛ to nyɛ tsui si. Nyɛɛ na ha nyɛ sibi nɛ nyɛ kɛ tsɔɔ kaa nyɛ suɔ nyɛ he niinɛ. 3Nyɛɛ bɔ mɔde nɛ nyɛɛ pee kake kɛ hi si. He jɔmi ɔ nɛ haa nyɛ peeɔ kake ɔ, Mawu mumi ɔ lɛ haa. 4Nɔmlɔ tso kake kɛ mumi kake lɛ ngɛ. Jã nɔuu kɛ̃ nɔ́ kake too nɔ nyɛ ngɔ nyɛ hɛ ngɔ fɔ, nɛ lɔ ɔ he Mawu tsɛ nyɛ ngɛ ɔ nɛ. 5Nyɔmtsɛ kake, hemi kɛ yemi kake, kɛ nɔ sɔlemi kake lɛ ngɛ. 6Mawu kake lɛ ngɛ; lɛ ji adesahi tsuo a tsɛ. E tsuɔ ní kɛ guu adesahi tsuo a nɔ, nɛ e ngɛ adesahi tsuo a mi.
7A ha wa ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ dloomi nike ní pɔtɛɛ komɛ kaa bɔ nɛ Kristo dla ngɔ ha wɔ ɔ. 8 Ngmami ɔ ke,
“Benɛ e yaa hiɔwe lokoo ɔ,
e ngɔ nihi nɛ e nuu nyɔguɛ ɔ kɛ ho;
e ha nimli adesahi nike níhi.”
9Munyu nɛ ɔ sisi ji, loko e ho hiɔwe ya a, e ba zugba a nɔ, nɛ e ya su zugba a sisi tɔɔ. 10Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ nɛ ba zugba a nɔ ɔ, lɛ nɔuu nɛ e kuɔ kɛ ho hiɔwe ya, konɛ a na lɛ ngɛ he tsuaa he. 11Lɛ nɔuu nɛ a de ngɛ e he ke, “E ha nimli adesahi nike ní” ɔ nɛ. E pee ni komɛ bɔfohi, ni komɛ gbali, ni komɛ sane kpakpa fiɛli, ni komɛ osɔfohi, kɛ ni komɛ hu tsɔɔli. 12E pee enɛ ɔ, nɛ e kɛ dla ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ kɛ ngɔ ha sɔmɔmi ní tsumi ɔ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ asafo ɔ nɛ ngɛ kaa Kristo nɔmlɔ tso ɔ nɛ ya nɔ. 13Wɔ tsuo wa ma ba hɛɛ hemi kɛ yemi kake ɔ mi, nɛ wa maa le Mawu Bi ɔ saminya. Wa maa wa ngɛ mumi mi hluu kɛ yaa si wa maa pee kaa Kristo ɔ nitsɛ. 14Jehanɛ ɔ, wa be si hie hu kaa jokuɛwi nɛ heɔ tsɔɔmi yeɔ kaa kɔɔhiɔ mimiɛɔ nɔ́ kɛ yaa kɛ baa, konɛ nihi nɛ toɔ ga yaya, nɛ a yeɔ kutupɔ kɛ sisiɔ nɔ ɔ a nine ko su wa nɔ. 15Mohu ɔ, e hia kaa waa kɛ anɔkuale yemi nɛ suɔ wa sibi. Kɛkɛ ɔ, wa maa wa ngɛ mumi mi, nɛ wa maa hi kaa Kristo nɛ lɛ ji asafo ɔ yi ɔ. 16 E ngɛ nɔmlɔ tso ɔ he ní ɔmɛ tsuo a nɔ he wami, nɛ e haa nɛ kpɔ nya kpɔ nya amɛ tsuo tsaa a sibi a nya. Nɛ ke he ní ɔmɛ tsuo tsu a blɔ nya ní tsumi pɛpɛɛpɛ bɔ nɛ sa a, nɔmlɔ tso ɔ tsuo waa, nɛ e yiɔ tɔ kɛ suɔmi ní tsumi.
Wami he nɛ Kristo haa wɔ
17Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i ngɛ nyɛ kɔkɔ bɔe ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ biɛ mi ke, nyɛ ko ba nyɛ je mi kaa ma je li ɔmɛ hu. Ejakaa níhi nɛ a susuu ɔ, pi kaa a he be se nami kɛkɛ, 18se sisi numi be he. Wami he ɔ nɛ Mawu haa nɔ ɔ, mɛɛ a blɔ nya be mi; ejakaa a li nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko, nɛ a tsui hu kplii. 19A zo tɔ ywia! Yahomi he mɛ nyɔguɛ, nɛ a hɛ tsuɔ kɛ tsuɔ mu níhi babauu nɛ he peeɔ tai.
20Nyɛɛ lɛɛ nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ kase ngɛ Kristo he ɔ, pi jã kulaa! 21Niinɛ, nyɛ nu Kristo he, nɛ nyɛ ba pee e se nyɛɛli; nɛ anɔkuale ɔ nɛ kɔɔ e he ɔ, a tsɔɔ nyɛ. 22 Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, bɔ nɛ nyɛ ba nyɛ je mi saa ngɛ nɔmlɔ su momo ɔ nya, nɛ nyɛ ya nyɛɛ akɔnɔ yayahi nɛ puɛɔ nɔ a se ɔ, nyɛ kpa! 23Bɔ nɛ nyɛ susuu nyɛ yi mi, kɛ blɔ nɔ nɛ nyɛ guu kɛ jaa Mawu ɔ, é pee nɔ́ he kulaa. 24 Nyɛɛ ba nyɛ je mi kaa ni hehi nɛ a bɔ mɛ ehe ngɛ Mawu subai nɔ; konɛ a na nyɛ kaa anɔkuale mi ɔ, nyɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da, nɛ nyɛ he hu tsɔ.
25 Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ kpa lakpa yemi, nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ tu e nyɛmi anɔkuale sisiisi. Ejakaa wɔ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ wa ngɛ kaa Kristo nɔmlɔ tso ɔ he ní munomunohi. 26 Ke e ba mi kaa nyɛ ti nɔ ko mi mi fu e nyɛmi ɔ, e ko ngmɛ blɔ nɛ lɔ ɔ nɛ ha nɛ e pee yayami. E bɔ mɔde nɛ e tsui he nɛ jɔ loko pu nɛ nɔ si. 27Nyɛ ko ha Abosiami blɔ nɛ e ba sɛ nyɛ kpɛti. 28Nɔ nɛ juɔ ɔ, e ko ju hu. Se mohu e ngɔ e nguɛ nyɔngma kɛ tsu ní wawɛɛ konɛ e ná nɔ́ ko nɛ e kɛ ye bua nihi nɛ e fi mɛ. 29Munyu nɛ maa je nyɛ ti nɔ ko nya a, e ko pee nɔ́ nɛ ma puɛ nɔ, se mohu nɔ́ nɛ hi, nɛ e he hia, nɛ nɔ́ kpakpa ko maa je mi kɛ wo nɔ he wami. Kɛkɛ ɔ, e maa pee dloomi kɛ ha nihi nɛ ngɛ nyɛ tue bue ɔ. 30Nyɛ ko wo Mawu Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ mi mi la. Ejakaa mumi ɔ ngɛ kaa so ko nɛ Mawu ngɔ kɛ kadi nyɛ kɛ tsɔɔ kaa be ma nɛ Mawu ma ha nɛ nyɛ maa ye nyɛ he. 31Nyɛ ha nɛ mi mi doomi, hɛdɔ, mi mi la, kɛ muklii mi fumi se nɛ po ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti. Nyɛɛ ngmɛɛ pɛ, kɛ nɔ jɛmi basabasa, kɛ ninyɛ tsuo he. 32 Niinɛ, nyɛɛ na nyɛ sibi mɔbɔ; nyɛ tsui mi nɛ sã nyɛ ngɛ nyɛ sibi a he, nɛ nyɛɛ ngɔ a he yayami kɛ pa mɛ kaa bɔ nɛ Mawu hu ngɔ nyɛ he yayami ɔmɛ ngɔ pa nyɛ kɛ gu Kristo nɔ ɔ.

Title: EFESO BI 5
Content:
Nyɛɛ ba nyɛ je mi kaa Yesu se nyɛɛli
1Akɛnɛ Mawu bimɛ nɛ e suɔ ji nyɛ he je ɔ, nyɛɛ bɔ mɔde nɛ nyɛɛ kase lɛ. 2 Nyɛ je nyɛ suɔmi kpo ngɔ tsɔɔ nyɛ sibi ngɛ nyɛ ní peemi mi kaa bɔ nɛ Kristo suɔ wɔ nɛ e ba gbo ngɛ wa he ɔ. Ee, Kristo ngɔ e he ngɔ ha kaa nike ní nɛ a kɛ sã bɔ, nɛ he via, nɛ sa Mawu hɛ mi.
3Akɛnɛ ní klɔuklɔuhi ji nyɛ he je ɔ, e sɛ kaa a woɔ yo kɛ nyumu yakayaka fiɛmi, loo mu ní tsumi, loo hɛkɔ ta tete ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti. 4E sɛ kaa yakayaka munyu, loo kuasiahi a munyu, loo fɛu yemi munyu nɛ sɛ́ jeɔ nyɛ nya. Se mohu nyɛɛ na Mawu si ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ e pee ha nyɛ ɔ he. 5Nyɛ na nyɛɛ le kaa nihi nɛ fiɛɔ yo kɛ nyumu yakayaka fiɛmi, loo a tsuɔ mu ní, loo a hɛ kɔ̃ɔ̃ ɔ, a be blɔ nya ngɛ he nɛ Kristo kɛ Mawu ngɛ matsɛ yee ngɛ. (Ke nɔ ko kɛ hɛkɔ ngɛ nɔ́ ko se die ɔ, e ngɛ kaa wɔ jami pɛ).
6Nyɛ ko ha nɛ nɔ ko nɛ pee nyɛ kuasia; ejakaa nihi nɛ gboɔ tue, nɛ a peeɔ yayamihi kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ, Mawu kɛ mi mi la gblaa a tue wawɛɛ. 7Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ kɛ mɛ ko bɔ. 8Jinɛ sa a, nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ ngɛ diblii mi, se nɛ nyɛ ngɔ nyɛ he ba mɛtɛ Nyɔmtsɛ, he ɔ, nyɛ ba plɛ la. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ ba nyɛ je mi kaa nihi nɛ kɛ la ngɛ nyɛɛe. 9Ejakaa la kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ he okadihi nɛ a naa ji kpakpa peemi, dami sane yemi, kɛ anɔkuale tumi. 10Nyɛɛ bɔ mɔde nɛ nyɛɛ kase Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ suɔmi nya ní. 11Diblii mi níhi nɛ se nami be he ɔ, nyɛ ko pee. Mohu ɔ, nyɛ je mɛ kpo nɛ nihi nɛ a na. 12(Níhi nɛ nihi peeɔ ngɛ laami mi ɔ ngɛ zo tsɔ kaa a maa wo ta tete). 13Ke a je nɔ́ ko kpo kɛ ba la nya a, a naa lɛ paa; 14ejakaa la lɛ haa nɛ a naa nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́. Enɛ ɔ he je nɛ a de ke,
“Mo nɔ nɛ o ngɛ mahe hwɔe,
o hɛ nɛ tsɛ,
nɛ o te si kɛ je gbeje.
Kɛkɛ Kristo ma kpɛ ha mo ɔ nɛ.”
15Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ hyɛ nyɛ je mi bami nɛ hi! Nyɛ ko hi si kaa nihi nɛ li nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko, se mohu kaa ní leli. 16 Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ hia kaa a pee ɔ, nyɛɛ pee; ejakaa be nɛ wa ngɛ mi nɛ ɔ, adesa yi mi wa saminya. 17Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ ko je kuasia; se mohu nyɛɛ bɔ mɔde nɛ nyɛ yo níhi nɛ ji Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ suɔmi nya ní.
18Nyɛ ko de dã, ejakaa e kɛ sakasaka peemi lɛ nyɛɛɔ. Mohu ɔ, nyɛ ha nɛ mumi ɔ nɛ hyi nyɛ. 19 Nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ sibi nɛ sɛɛ munyuhi nɛ ngɛ saku fiami, yi jemi, kɛ mumi mi la amɛ a mi ɔ a he ní. Nyɛɛ fia saku, nɛ nyɛ la kɛ je nyɛ tsui mi tɔɔ nɛ nyɛ kɛ je Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ yi. 20Be tsuaa be ɔ, nyɛɛ na Tsɛ Mawu si ngɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ he.
Yigbayihi kɛ a hunomɛ
21Nyɛɛ ba nyɛ he si ha nyɛ sibi kɛ tsɔɔ kaa nyɛ yeɔ Kristo gbeye.
22 Nyɛ yigbayi, nyɛɛ ba nyɛ he si ha nyɛ hunomɛ kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ maa pee ha Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ. 23Ejakaa huno ɔ ngɛ e yo ɔ nɔ he wami kaa bɔ nɛ Kristo hu ngɛ asafo ɔ nɔ he wami ɔ. Kristo ngɔ e wami ngɔ ha, nɛ e kɛ he asafo ɔ yi wami; ee, asafo ɔ ngɛ kaa Kristo nitsɛ e nɔmlɔ tso. 24Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e hia kaa yigbayi nɛ a ba a he si ha a hunomɛ ngɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ mi kaa bɔ nɛ asafo ɔ hu baa e he si ha Kristo ɔ.
25 Nyɛ hunomɛ, nyɛɛ suɔ nyɛ yi ɔmɛ kaa bɔ nɛ Kristo hu suɔ asafo ɔ, nɛ e ngɔ lɛ nitsɛ e wami ngɔ ha ngɛ e he ɔ. 26Kristo ngɔ sane kpakpa a, nɛ e kɛ tsu asafo ɔ he kaa bɔ nɛ a kɛ nyu fɔɔ nɔ he ha lɛ ɔ, nɛ e kɛ pee lɛ klɔuklɔu. 27E pee enɛ ɔ, konɛ e ngɔ asafo ɔ ngɔ pee lɛ nitsɛ e nɔ́. Asafo ɔ ngɛ kaa nɔ ko nɛ he ngɛ fɛu saminya; sé ko be e he ɔ, e hɛ mi kuã we, nɛ nɔ́ yaya kpa ko hu be e he. Ee, asafo ɔ maa hi klɔuklɔu nɛ piami ko piami ko be e he hie. 28Jã nɔuu kɛ̃, e sa kaa nyumu nɛ suɔ e yo kaa bɔ nɛ e suɔ lɛ nitsɛ e he. Ke nyumu ko suɔ e yo ɔ, ngɛ blɔ ko nɔ ɔ, e suɔ lɛ nitsɛ e he. 29(Nɔ ko nyɛ́ lɛ nitsɛ e he lo, se mohu e lɛɛ e nɔmlɔ tso ɔ, nɛ e baa e yi saminya kaa bɔ nɛ Kristo hu hyɛɛ asafo ɔ. 30Wa ngɛ kaa Kristo nɔmlɔ tso ɔ he níhi.) 31 Kaa bɔ nɛ ngmami ɔ deɔ ɔ, “Enɛ ɔ he nɛ nyumu ma si e tsɛ kɛ e nyɛ, nɛ e maa mɛtɛ e yo he, nɛ mɛ ni enyɔ ɔmɛ tsuo maa pee he lo kake.” 32Anɔkuale laami munyu komɛ nɛ a he hia saminya jeɔ kpo ngɛ ngmami nɛ ɔ mi; nɛ imi lɛɛ i kɛ ngɛ Kristo kɛ asafo ɔ he toe. 33Se kɛ̃ ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ mi ji, e sa kaa nyɛ ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ suɔ e yo kaa bɔ nɛ e suɔ lɛ nitsɛ e he, nɛ yogbayo tsuaa yogbayo nɛ bu e huno.

Title: EFESO BI 6
Content:
Fɔli kɛ a bimɛ
1 Bimɛ, nyɛɛ bu nyɛ fɔli tue kaa nihi nɛ ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ sɔmɔe, ejakaa nɔ́ nɛ sa nyɛ peemi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. 2 Mawu mlaa nyɔngma amɛ ɔ, kekleekle nɔ́ nɛ siwo piɛ he ji, “Bu o tsɛ kɛ o nyɛ, 3konɛ e hi ha mo, nɛ o se nɛ kɛ ngɛ je mi.”
4 Fɔli, nyɛ ko wo nyɛ bimɛ ɔmɛ a mi mi la; se mohu nyɛ tsɔse mɛ, nɛ nyɛɛ wo mɛ ga kpakpa nɛ maa sa Kristo hɛ mi.
Nyɔmtsɛmɛ kɛ a nyɔguɛhi
5 Nyɛ nyɔguɛhi, nyɛɛ bu nyɛ je nɛ ɔ mi nyɔmtsɛmɛ ɔmɛ kɛ gbeye yemi kɛ he domi, nɛ nyɛ sɔmɔ mɛ kɛ nyɛ tsui tsuo kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ peeɔ ha Kristo ɔ; 6pi kɛ hɛ mi sɔmɔmi nɛ ma ha nyɛ nyɔmtsɛmɛ ɔmɛ maa suɔ nyɛ sane. Se mohu nyɛɛ je nyɛ tsui mi tɔɔ nɛ nyɛɛ pee nɔ́ nɛ Mawu suɔ, ejakaa Kristo nyɔguɛhi ji nyɛ. 7Nyɛ tsu ní kɛ bua jɔmi kaa nɔ́ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nyɛ ngɛ sɔmɔe, se pi adesa. 8Nyɛ kai kaa ke mo nɔ ko o pee kpakpa a, nyɔguɛ ji mo jio, odehe ji mo jio Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ maa to mo nane mi ja nɔuu ekohu.
9 Nyɔmtsɛmɛ, nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ nyɔguɛ ɔmɛ nɛ hi si ja nɔuu kɛ̃ nɛ nyɛɛ jɔɔ a susuma he gbeye womi. Nyɛ kai kaa nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ nyɔguɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ɔ, Nyɔmtsɛ kake lɛ nyɛ ngɛ ngɛ hiɔwe, nɛ e hyɛ we nɔ hɛ mi.
Kristo se nyɛɛli nɛ mia, nɛ a kɛ mumi yayamihi nɛ hwu ta
10Nyagbe ɔ, nyɛ ha nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ he wami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ nɛ ngɛ nyɛ mi ɔ nɛ waje nyɛ. 11Nyɛ kpla tahwu ní ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ Mawu ha nyɛ ɔ, konɛ nyɛ nyɛ Abosiami ga tsɔmi ɔmɛ a nya nɛ nyɛɛ da. 12Ejakaa pi he lo kɛ muɔ nɛ waa kɛ ngɛ ta hwue ɔ. He nyɛli nɛ waa kɛ mɛ ngɛ ta hwue ɔ ji nɔ yeli, kɛ nihi nɛ hɛɛ blɔ nyahi, mumi yayami kpetekpleenyɛhi nɛ ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi diblii ɔ mi, kɛ mumihi nɛ ngɛ kɔɔhiɔ mi nɛ peeɔ yi wu tso níhi. 13Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ kpla ta hwumi níhi tsuo nɛ Mawu ha nyɛ ɔ. Kɛkɛ ɔ, ke ligbi yobu ɔ ba a, nyɛ ma nyɛ maa da nya, nɛ́ ke nyɛɛ kɛ lɛ to ní gbe nya a, nyɛ nyɛ nyɛɛ da si kpɛii.
14 Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ da si nɛ nyɛ ha anɔkuale nɛ miaa nyɛ kaa mlɛ mi fimi nɔ́, nɛ dami sane yemi nɛ pee kaa dama ngɛ nyɛ gugue mi. 15 Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ ma ha nɛ nyɛɛ pee klaalo kɛ fiɛ he jɔmi sane kpakpa a, nyɛ kɛ pee tokota nɛ nyɛɛ wo. 16Enɛ ɔmɛ tsuo se ɔ, nyɛɛ hɛɛ hemi kɛ yemi ngɛ nyɛ dɛ kaa tsɛi nɛ nyɛ ma nyɛ kɛ gbe nɔ yayami ɔ kɛ̃ɛ̃ mi bihi kɛ a he la a tsuo. 17 Yi wami hemi nɛ pee dade pɛɛ nɛ nyɛ bu. Nyɛɛ pɛtɛ Mawu munyu ɔ nɛ ji mumi ɔ klaate ɔ he. 18Nyɛɛ sɔle kɛ kpa Mawu pɛɛ kaa bɔ nɛ mumi ɔ maa tsɔɔ nyɛ. Enɛ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ bu mumi ɔ tue, konɛ nyɛ mia nyɛ hɛ mi kɛ kpa pɛɛ ha ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ daa. 19Nyɛɛ sɔle ha imi hulɔ, konɛ be tsuaa be nɛ ma tu munyu ɔ, Mawu nɛ ha mi e sɛ gbi, nɛ e ha mi kã nɛ ma kɛ fiɛ sane kpakpa a mi laami sane ɔ. 20Sane kpakpa nɛ ɔ he nɛ, i ba pee Yesu Kristo bɔfo, pohu amlɔ nɛ ɔ, a wo mi kɔsɔkɔsɔ. Nyɛ kpa pɛɛ konɛ ma fiɛ kɛ kã kaa bɔ nɛ sa nɛ ma tu munyu ɔ.
Nyagbe sɛ yemi
21 Wa nyɛmi Tihiko nɛ wa suɔ lɛ saminya, nɛ e yeɔ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ anɔkuale ngɛ ní nɛ e ngɛ tsue ha lɛ ɔ mi ɔ ma ba bɔ nyɛ níhi tsuo nɛ kɔɔ ye he, konɛ nyɛɛ le bɔ nɛ i ngɛ, kɛ bɔ nɛ níhi ngɛ yae ha. 22I je blɔ ngɛ lɛ nyɛ ngɔ tsɔe, konɛ nyɛɛ nu wa he bɔ nɛ wa ngɛ, konɛ nyɛ hu e wo nyɛ bua.
23Nihi tsuo nɛ heɔ Kristo yeɔ ɔ, Tsɛ Mawu, kɛ wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo nɛ ha nɛ a hi si ngɛ he jɔmi mi; a suɔ a sibi, nɛ a pɛtɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ he. 24Nihi tsuo nɛ suɔ wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo kɛ suɔmi nɛ be nyagbe ɔ, Mawu dloomi ɔ kɛ mɛ nɛ hi si.

Title: FILIPI BI NYA TSƆƆMI
Content:
NYA TSƆƆMI
Asafohi nɛ Paulo to sisi ngɛ Roma nɔ yemi he nɛ ngɛ Yuropa a, Filipi asafo ɔ nɛ ngɛ Makedonia kpokpa a nɔ ji kekleekle nɔ́. Paulo ngma Filipi asafo ɔ womi nɛ ɔ benɛ a wo lɛ tsu. Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, ni kpahi nɛ mɛ hu a ngɛ ní tsue kaa Kristo se nyɛɛli ɔ te si wo lɛ, nɛ e hao wawɛɛ. Jehanɛ ɔ, lakpa tsɔɔmi nɛ ngɛ nɔ yae ngɛ Filipi asafo ɔ mi ɔ hu hao lɛ wawɛɛ. Se kɛ̃ ɔ, bua jɔmi, kɛ hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi nɛ jeɔ kpo ngɛ womi ɔ mi ɔ, tsɔɔ kaa hemi kɛ yemi nɛ Paulo ngɛ ngɛ Yesu Kristo mi ɔ mi wa wawɛɛ nitsɛ.
Kristo we bi nɛ ngɛ Filipi ɔ ngɔ nike ní kɛ mane Paulo be ko nɛ e fi lɛ wawɛɛ ɔ, nɛ e suɔ kaa e maa na mɛ si. Enɛ ɔ he titli nɛ e ngma womi nɛ ɔ nɛ. He blɔ nɛ e na kɛ ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ ngmae ɔ, e suɔ kaa e maa gu nɔ kɛ wo mɛ he wami hulɔ. E de mɛ ke a pee kã, nɛ a ngɔ a hɛ kɛ fɔ Mawu nɔ, pohu e kɛ mɛ tsuo ngɛ nɔ́ nae. E kpa mɛ pɛɛ ke a pee a he humi kaa bɔ nɛ Yesu pee ɔ; a hɛ kó tsu kɛ di mɛ nitsɛmɛ pɛ a hiamihi a se; nɛ a ko wo a he. E de mɛ ke a kai kaa e ji dloomi ha mɛ kaa Mawu ha nɛ a kɛ Kristo ba pee kake ngɛ a wami be mi kɛ gu hemi kɛ yemi nɔ; se tsa pi kaa Yuda bi a mlaa a nɛ kɔɔ kusumihi a he ɔ nɔ nɛ a ye ɔ he je. Bua jɔmi, kɛ he jɔmi nɛ Mawu haa nihi nɛ ngɛ Kristo mi ɔ, Paulo ngma lɔ ɔmɛ hu a he sane ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ mi.
Ní pɔtɛɛ komɛ nɛ a naa ngɛ Kristo se nyɛɛli a hemi kɛ yemi, kɛ a wami si himi mi nɛ Paulo ma nɔ mi ji bua jɔmi, hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi, kake peemi, kɛ hɛ mi miami. Womi ɔ ha nɛ wa naa paa kaa Paulo suɔ Filipi asafo ɔ wawɛɛ nitsɛ.
Bɔ nɛ a dla womi ɔ mi ha
Sisije 1.1-11
Sanehi nɛ ba Paulo nɔ 1.12-26
Je mi bami nɛ sa Kristo se nyɛɛlɔ 1.27—2.18
Timoteo kɛ Epafrodito a blɔ hiami he blɔ nya tomi 2.19-30
Ga womi nɛ kɔɔ he nyɛli, kɛ amanehlu he 3.1—4.9
Paulo kɛ e huɛmɛ ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ Filipi ɔ 4.10-20
Nyagbe 4.21-23

Title: FILIPI BI 1
Content:
1 Imi Paulo kɛ Timoteo, Kristo Yesu sɔmɔli ɔ, ngma womi nɛ ɔ mane Kristo Yesu ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ, asafo nya dali ɔmɛ, kɛ sɔmɔli ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ ngɛ Filipi ɔ.
2Dloomi kɛ he jɔmi nɛ je wa Tsɛ Mawu ɔ, kɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo dɛ mi ɔ ha nyɛ!
Paulo kpa pɛɛ kɛ ha nihi nɛ maa kane e womi ɔ
3Be tsuaa be nɛ ye juɛmi maa ba nyɛ nɔ ɔ, i naa Mawu si ha nyɛ. 4Daa nɛ ɔ, i kɛ bua jɔmi faa kue ha Mawu ngɛ nyɛ tsuo nyɛ he; 5ejakaa nyɛ sa sina kaa nyɛ piɛ ye he wawɛɛ ngɛ sane kpakpa a fiɛmi mi kɛ je sisije kɛ ba si amlɔ nɛ ɔ. 6I heɔ yeɔ kaa Mawu, nɔ nɛ kɛ nyɛ je ní tsumi kpakpa nɛ ɔ sisi ɔ maa piɛ nyɛ he kɛ yaa si nyɛ maa gbe nya ligbi ɔ nɛ Yesu Kristo maa ba a. 7I suɔ nyɛ saminya, nɛ e sa kaa ma susu nyɛ he wawɛɛ kikɛ nɛ ɔ. Ejakaa Mawu dloomi ɔ nɛ i kɛ ngɛ sane kpakpa a fiɛe kɛ hɛdɔ, kɛ je sisije nɛ i ngɛ ye nane nɔ kɛ bee, kɛ ba si amlɔ nɛ ɔ nɛ a wo mi tsu ɔ, i kɛ nyɛ tsuo nɛ wa ná kikɛmɛ a dloomi ɔ, nɛ wa ngɛ he ní tsue. 8Bɔ nɛ Kristo Yesu mi mi sãã lɛ ngɛ wa he ɔ, jã ye hɛ ngɛ jae wawɛɛ ngɛ nyɛ he; Mawu ji ye odase kaa i yi lakpa.
9I ngɛ Mawu pɛɛ kpae kaa suɔmi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ kɛ ha nyɛ sibi ɔ mi nɛ wa, nɛ nyɛ ná nile nɛ ma ha nyɛ nɔ́ se kɔmi mumi, 10konɛ nyɛɛ le kpakpa mi tso. Kɛkɛ ɔ, mu ko mu ko, kɛ piami ko piami ko be nyɛ he sae kɛ yaa su ligbi ɔ nɛ Kristo maa ba. 11Kristo Yesu nitsɛ ma ha nyɛ ma na subai nɛ hi saminya ngɛ nyɛ wami si himi mi, konɛ a wo Mawu hɛ mi nyami, nɛ a je e yi.
Kristo lɛ haa nɔ wami
12Ye nyɛmimɛ, i suɔ kaa nyɛɛ le kaa sanehi nɛ ba ye nɔ ɔ mohu ha nɛ sane kpakpa a ya su nihi babauu. 13 Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, mɔ mi buli ɔmɛ, kɛ ni kpa amɛ tsuo ba na le kaa Kristo nɛ i ngɛ sɔmɔe ɔ he nɛ a wo mi tsu ngɛ. 14Tsu nɛ a wo mi ɔ, ha nɛ nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ a ti nihi babauu ba ngɔ a hɛ kɛ fɔ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nɔ wawɛɛ, nɛ a kɛ kã ngɛ Mawu sɛ gbi ɔ fiɛe nɛ a yi gbeye.
15Niinɛ, sane kpakpa a nɛ a ngɛ fiɛe ɔ, a ti ni komɛ a hɛ kɔɔ ye nɔ, nɛ a jeɔ mi hunga, se ni komɛ hu kɛ juɛmi kpakpa fiɛɔ. 16Kuu enyɔne ɔ kɛ suɔmi fiɛɔ, ejakaa a le kaa ní tsumi nɛ Mawu ngɔ ha mi ji kaa ma fa sane kpakpa a he. 17Ni kpa amɛ fiɛ we sɛ gbi ɔ anɔkuale mi. Ke a ngɛ fiɛe ɔ, a woɔ pɛ; a susuu kaa ke a pee ja kɛkɛ a ngɛ mi yi mi wae kɛ piɛ tsu nɛ a wo mi ɔ he.
18Ja he ɔ mɛni? E haa mi bua jɔmi mohu kaa lakpa tomi nya jio, anɔkuale mi jio, bɔ tsuaa bɔ nɛ pee ɔ, Kristo nɛ a ngɛ fiɛe. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i na bua jɔmi. Ee, ye bua maa jɔ, 19ejakaa i le kaa Mawu pɛɛ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ kpae, kɛ he wami nɛ Yesu Kristo mumi ɔ haa a, ma kpɔ mi. 20Nɔ́ nɛ i ngɔ hɛ kɛ fɔ nɔ, nɛ i ngɛ blɔ hyɛe wawɛɛ ji kaa zo be mi gbee; se mohu be tsuaa be ɔ, ma pee kã saminya, konɛ wami mi jio, gbenɔ mi jio, titli ɔ, amlɔ nɛ ɔ, ma ngɔ ye nɔmlɔ tso ɔ kɛ wo Kristo hɛ mi nyami. 21Ejakaa imi lɛɛ Kristo ji ye wami, nɛ gbenɔ ɔ, ye se nami. 22Se ke e ba mi kaa ke i ngɛ wami mi nɛ ma nyɛ ma tsu ní pe kikɛ nɛ ɔ, lɛɛ i li e mi nɔ́ nɛ ma hla. 23Nɔ́ enyɔ nɛ ɔmɛ a kpɛti i ngɛ. Imi nitsɛ lɛɛ i suɔ kaa ma si wami nɛ ɔ, nɛ i kɛ Kristo ya hi si, ejakaa lɔ ɔ hi kulaa pe. 24Se nyɛ he ɔ, e hia kaa ma hi je mi mohu. 25I heɔ enɛ ɔ yeɔ, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i le kaa i kɛ nyɛ tsuo maa hi si, konɛ ma piɛ nyɛ he, nɛ nyɛ hemi kɛ yemi mi nɛ wa, nɛ nyɛ na bua jɔmi. 26Kɛkɛ ɔ, ke wa ba bua ekohu ɔ, nyɛ ma na he blɔ hluu tsɔ kɛ fĩa kaa i ha nɛ nyɛ ba le Kristo Yesu.
27Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ hia pe kulaa ji, nyɛɛ ba nyɛ je mi kaa bɔ nɛ sane kpakpa a nɛ kɔɔ Kristo he ɔ tsɔɔ ɔ, konɛ i nyɛ ba na nyɛ jio, i bɛ́ jio, ma nu nyɛ he kaa nyɛ tsuo nyɛɛ kɛ juɛmi kake hɛɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ mi kpɛii kɛ ngɛ sane kpakpa a he plee. 28Nyɛ ko ha nɛ nihi nɛ teɔ si woɔ nyɛ ɔ a ní peepee nɛ wo nyɛ he gbeye. Nyɛɛ pee kã be tsuaa be. Lɔ ɔ ma ha nɛ a maa na paa kaa a hɛ mi ma kpata, se nyɛɛ lɛɛ a ma he nyɛ yi wami. Ejakaa enɛ ɔ lɛɛ Mawu dɛ mi e je. 29Blɔ nya nɛ a ha nyɛ kaa Kristo we bi ɔ, nyɛɛ lɛɛ pi kaa nyɛ ma he ye kɛkɛ, se mohu kaa e he ɔ, nyɛ maa na amanehlu hulɔ. 30 Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ maa piɛ ye he kɛ hwu ta a. Ta nɛ ɔ nɔuu lɛ sa a nyɛ na kaa i ngɛ hwue; nɛ amlɔ nɛ ɔ hu, kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ nu ɔ, i ngɛ nɔ kɛ mwɔɔ.

Title: FILIPI BI 2
Content:
Kristo he si bami kɛ e we agboje
1Nɛ nyɛ ngɔ nyɛ he ngɔ ha Kristo ɔ, e woɔ nyɛ he wami, nɛ e suɔmi ɔ haa nyɛ bua jɔmi. Nyɛɛ kɛ mumi ɔ ngɛ bɔe, nɛ lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ nuɔ nɔ́ he ha nyɛ sibi, nɛ nyɛ naa mɛ mɔbɔ. 2Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, nyɛ tsuo nyɛɛ pee nyɛ yi mi kake; nyɛɛ suɔ nyɛ sibi, nɛ nyɛ we oti, kɛ juɛmi hu nɛ pee kake. Kɛkɛ ɔ, imi hu ma na bua jɔmi babauu. 3Nyɛ ko pee nɔ́ ko nɛ tsɔɔ kaa nyɛ ti nɔ ko ngɛ lɛ nɔ kake pɛ e nɔ́ mi foe, loo e ngɛ hlae nɛ e fĩa yaka. Be tsuaa be ɔ, nyɛɛ pee nyɛ he humi, nɛ nyɛɛ bu nyɛ sibi pe nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ he. 4Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ fo e nyɛmi nɔ́ mi; e ko fo lɛ nitsɛ pɛ e nɔ́ mi. 5Kristo Yesu juɛmi ɔ nɛ pee nyɛ hu nyɛ juɛmi.
6E hɛɛ Mawu su lɛɛ, se e pee we lɛ kaa doo ɔ,
a na lɛ kaa e kɛ Mawu sɔ.
7Mohu ɔ, lɛ nitsɛ e suɔmi nya a,
e ngmɛɛ blɔ nya tsuo nɛ e ngɛ ɔ he,
nɛ e ba plɛ e he sɔmɔlɔ.
E ba pee kaa nɔmlɔ,
nɛ e je e he si kaa adesa.
8E ba e he si,
nɛ e bu tue hluu
kɛ ya su gbeje tete;
e gbo sɛumi tso nɔ gbenɔ.
9Enɛ ɔ he je nɛ Mawu wo e nɔ gojoo,
nɛ e ha lɛ biɛ nɛ kle pe biɛhi tsuo.
10 Kɛkɛ ɔ, he tsuaa he nɛ a maa wo
e biɛ ta ngɛ ɔ,
nihi nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe,
kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ,
kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ zugba a sisi ɔ,
mɛ tsuo a ma kpla si ha Yesu,
11nɛ a maa jaje paa ke,
Yesu Kristo ji Nyɔmtsɛ;
a maa pee ja kɛ wo Tsɛ Mawu ɔ
hɛ mi nyami.
Nyɛɛ pee kaa la nɛ ngɛ kpɛe ngɛ je ɔ mi
12Ye nyɛmimɛ nɛ i suɔ! E he hia wawɛɛ kaa amlɔ nɛ ɔ tete nɛ i be nyɛ ngɔ ɔ, nyɛɛ bu mi tue wawɛɛ pe kekle ɔ po. Nyɛɛ kɛ gbeye yemi, kɛ he domi blibliibli nɛ tsu ní wawɛɛ, konɛ a he nyɛ yi wami. 13Ejakaa be tsuaa be ɔ, Mawu ngɛ nyɛ he ní tsue, konɛ nyɛ na bua jɔmi nɛ nyɛ kɛ pee e suɔmi nya ní.
14Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ pee ɔ, nyɛ ko wo nyɛ mi mi la, nɛ nyɛ ko sã nya ngɛ he. 15 Ke nyɛ pee ja a, nyɛ he ma tsɔ, nɛ piami ko piami ko be nyɛ he hie; nyɛ maa pee Mawu bimɛ nitsɛnitsɛmɛ ngɛ yayami peeli, kɛ nihi nɛ a tue wa a a kpɛti. Ejakaa nyɛ je mi bami he tsɔ kaa bɔ nɛ dodoe kpɛɔ. 16Ke nyɛ hɛɛ sane kpakpa a nɛ haa nɔ wami ɔ mi wawɛɛ ɔ, lɔ ɔ lɛɛ ligbi ɔ nɛ Kristo maa ba a, ma nyɛ ma fĩa kaa fo nɛ i tu, aloo dengme nɛ i gbo kɛ tsu nyɛ he ní ɔ pee we yaka.
17Ke e maa ba mi kaa a ma plɛ ye muɔ kɛ pue nyɛ he bɔ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ sãe kɛ ngɛ nyɛ hemi kɛ yemi he ní tsue ɔ nɔ po ɔ, ye bua maa jɔ, nɛ i kɛ nyɛ ma nya. 18Jã nɔuu kɛ̃ nyɛ hu nyɛ bua nɛ jɔ, nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ mi nɛ nya.
Timoteo kɛ Epafrodito a blɔ hiami blɔ nya tomi
19Ke Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ maa suɔ ɔ, e be kɛe kulaa nɛ ma tsɔ Timoteo kɛ ba nyɛ ngɔ. Kɛkɛ ɔ, ke i nu nyɛ he ɔ, ye nɔ gbagba maa te. 20Timoteo pɛ ji nɔ nɛ susuu nyɛ he, nɛ e hlaa kaa e hi ha nyɛ; i li nɔ kpa ko hu kaa lɛ. 21Ni ɔmɛ kulaa a ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ ko ngɛ lɛ nɔ kake pɛ e nɔ mi foe. Yesu Kristo he sane ɔ pi a kɔmɔ. 22Nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ le Timoteo mɔde bɔmi! Nyɛ le kaa e tsu ní nɛ se bé; e kɛ mi tsu sane kpakpa a he ní kaa bi kɛ e tsɛ. 23Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke i na ye níhi a nya pɛ ma tsɔ lɛ nyɛ ngɔ. 24Imi nitsɛ hu, ye hɛ ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nɔ kaa e be kɛe kulaa nɛ ma ba su nyɛ ngɔ.
25Wa nyɛmi Epafrodito nɛ nyɛ tsɔ lɛ ye ngɔ ɔ, e kɛ mi ba tsu ní saminya kaa ta bulɔ kpakpa. E sɔmɔ mi bɔ nɛ sa, nɛ amlɔ nɛ ɔ, ye juɛmi nya a, e hia kaa ma wo lɛ blɔ kɛ ba nyɛ ngɔ. 26E hɛ ngɛ jae wawɛɛ ngɛ nyɛ tsuo nyɛ he, nɛ akɛnɛ nyɛ nu kaa e be he wami ɔ, e ngɛ tsui yee. 27Niinɛ, e nu hiɔ wawɛɛ, nɛ e piɛ nguɛ nya nɛ e gbo. Se Mawu na lɛ mɔbɔ; pi lɛ kɛkɛ, se mohu imi hulɔ; e je mi kɛ je kɔmɔ yemi babauu mi. 28Enɛ ɔ he nɛ e be sɔe ha mi kulaa kaa ma wo lɛ blɔ kɛ ba nyɛ ngɔ ɔ nɛ. Ke nyɛ na lɛ ekohu ɔ, nyɛ ma na bua jɔmi; kɛkɛ imi hu ma kpa tsui yemi. 29Nyɛ he lɛ atuu kɛ bua jɔmi babauu kaa nyɛ nyɛmi nɛ le Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ. Nihi tsuo nɛ ngɛ kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ bu mɛ. 30Ejakaa Kristo ní tsumi ɔ he ɔ, e piɛ nguɛ nya nɛ e sake e he lo ngɔ fɔ he. Se e pee enɛ ɔ tsuo kɛ sɔmɔ mi ngɛ nyɛ nane mi.

Title: FILIPI BI 3
Content:
Dami nitsɛnitsɛ
1Nyagbe ɔ, ye nyɛmimɛ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ mi nyɛ bua nɛ jɔ. Pɔ tɔɛ ye he kaa ma ngma nyɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ ekohu; ejakaa lɔ ɔ ma ha nɛ nyɛ maa le nyɛ he nɔ hyɛmi. 2Nyɛɛ hyɛ saminya ngɛ gbee ɔmɛ a he, nyɛɛ hyɛ saminya ngɛ ní tsuli yaya amɛ a he, nyɛɛ hyɛ saminya ngɛ nihi nɛ woɔ nɔmlɔ tso ɔ he pa ke a po nɔ ɔ a he. 3Wɔ mohu ji nihi nɛ a po mɛ anɔkuale mi. Ejakaa wɔɔ lɛɛ wa jaa Mawu kɛ guu e mumi ɔ nɔ, nɛ wa fĩaa kɛ fɔɔ Kristo Yesu nɔ. Wa ngɔɛ wa hɛ kɛ fɔɛ he lo nya ní peemi níhi a nɔ. 4Imi lɛ i ko ngɔ ye hɛ kɛ fɔ jamɛ a níhi a nɔ. Ke nɔ ko susu kaa e maa ngɔ e hɛ kɛ fɔ he lo nya ní peemi níhi a nɔ ɔ, imi mohu i ko pee pe ja po. 5 I ye otsi pɛ nɛ a po mi. Israel fɔfɔɛ ji mi; i je Benyamin wɛtso ɔ mi; Hebri no mi Hebri no ji mi; mlaa a nya a, Farisi no kpanaa hulɔ. 6 Ye hɛ dɔ wawɛɛ kɛ wa asafo ɔ yi mi. Ke mlaa a nɔ yemi nɔ a guu kɛ dlaa nɔ kɛ Mawu a kpɛti ɔ, lɛɛ piami ko piami ko be ye he. 7Níhi tsuo nɛ i ko bu mɛ kaa a he ngɛ se nami ha mi sa a, amlɔ nɛ ɔ, ngɛ Kristo he ɔ, i buu mɛ kaa yaka níhi nɛ a he be se nami mohu. 8Pi lɔ ɔmɛ kɛkɛ, anɔkuale mi ɔ, i bu nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ kaa níhi nɛ a he be se nami; ejakaa i ba na le kaa Kristo Yesu ji ye Nyɔmtsɛ. Nile nɛ ɔ he jua wa pe nile tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ. Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, ye níhi tsuo bɔ mi; ní ɔmɛ pee kaa kuku nɔ níhi kɛkɛ, konɛ Kristo mohu nɛ pee ye nɔ́. 9I kɛ lɛ pee kake kulaa. Jehanɛ lɛɛ pi mlaa nɔ nɛ i yeɔ nɔ nɛ a maa da kɛ wo mi nguɔ hu; mohu ɔ, Kristo nɛ i he ye ɔ. Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, Mawu maa wo mi nguɔ ejakaa i he Kristo ye. 10Nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ hlae kɛkɛ ji kaa ma le Kristo, nɛ he wami kpetekpleenyɛ nɛ ha e ba wami mi ekohu ɔ, ma na nya. Ma na nɔ́ kaa bɔ nɛ e na nɔ́ ɔ, nɛ ma gbo kaa bɔ nɛ e gbo ɔ. 11I heɔ yeɔ kaa hwɔɔ se ko ɔ, imi nitsɛ hu a ma tle mi si kɛ je gbeje kɛ ba wami mi ekohu.
Fo mami kɛ oti ɔ he sumi
12I de we ke ye nine su jlasi ɔ nɔ momo, loo i hi kɛ pi si. Se mohu, i ngɛ mɔde bɔe kaa ye nine maa su nɔ, ejakaa enɛ ɔ he nɛ Kristo Yesu ngɔ mi kɛ pee e nɔ́ ɔ nɛ. 13Ye nyɛmimɛ nɛ i suɔ, anɔkuale mi ɔ, i ngɔɛ lɛ kaa ye nine su nɔ momo. Se mohu nɔ́ kake nɛ i peeɔ ji kaa níhi nɛ be ɔ, ma je hɛ ngɛ a nɔ, nɛ ma tiu níhi nɛ ngɛ hɛ mi ɔ. 14Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i ngɔ hɛ kɛ pi oti ɔ, konɛ ye nine nɛ su jlasi ɔ nɔ. Enɛ ɔ he nɛ Mawu tsɛ wɔ kɛ je hiɔwe tɔɔ kɛ gu Kristo Yesu nɔ.
15Wɔ nihi tsuo nɛ wa wa ngɛ mumi mi ɔ, juɛmi nɛ ɔ lɛ sa kaa waa hɛɛ. Se ke nyɛ ti ni komɛ ngɛ nɔ́ kpa susue ɔ, Mawu ma je lɔ ɔ hu kpo paa kɛ tsɔɔ nyɛ. 16Se bɔ tsuaa bɔ nɛ pee ɔ, blɔ nya tomi nɛ wa ye nɔ hluu kɛ ba si amlɔ nɛ ɔ, nyɛ ha waa hɛɛ mi nɛ wa ja nɔuu.
17 Ye nyɛmimɛ, nyɛ wo ye nane. Okadi kpakpa nɛ wa to nyɛ ɔ, nihi tsuo nɛ peeɔ ja a, nyɛɛ kase mɛ. 18I de nyɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ si abɔ, nɛ jehanɛ hu i kɛ vo nyu ngɛ nyɛ dee ekohu ke gbenɔ nɛ Kristo ba gbo ngɛ sɛumi tso ɔ nɔ ɔ, nihi babauu a je mi bami peeɔ mɛ e he nyɛli. 19Kikɛmɛ a nimli nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, a ma kpata a hɛ mi kɛ maa ya neneene. Ejakaa mɛɛ lɛɛ a muklii ji a mawu nɛ a jaa. A nyaa zo níhi a he, nɛ je mi níhi pɛ a he a susuu. 20Se wɔɔ lɛɛ wa ma a, hiɔwe e ngɛ; nɛ lejɛ ɔ wa ngɛ blɔ hyɛe kaa wa kpɔlɔ Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo maa je kɛ ba. 21E ma tsake wa nɔmlɔ tso nɛ hɛ mi be nyami ɔ; e maa pee lɛ kaa lɛ nitsɛ e nɔmlɔ tso nɛ hɛ mi ngɛ nyami ɔ. E ngɛ he wami nɛ e kɛ yeɔ níhi tsuo a nɔ.

Title: FILIPI BI 4
Content:
Ga womi
1Ye nyɛmimɛ, nyɛɛ hyɛ bɔ nɛ i suɔ nyɛ ha! Nyɛɛ hyɛ bɔ nɛ ye hɛ ngɛ jae ngɛ nyɛ he ha! Nyɛ lɛ nyɛ haa mi bua jɔmi; nyɛ ngɛ kaa jlasi ngɛ ye yi! Ye nyɛmimɛ nɛ i suɔ. Kaa nihi nɛ ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ mi ɔ, kikɛ nɛ ɔ pɛ ji bɔ nɛ sa nɛ nyɛɛ ba nyɛ je mi.
2I ngɛ nyɛmiyo Evodia, kɛ nyɛmiyo Sintika pɛɛ kpae kaa a pee kake ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ he. 3Nɛ mo, ye nyɛmi sɔmɔlɔ anɔkualetsɛ, i ngɛ mo pɛɛ kpae nɛ o ye bua yi nɛ ɔmɛ. Ejakaa a kɛ Klemente, kɛ nyɛmimɛ kpahi nɛ waa kɛ mɛ sɔmɔ ɔ, piɛ ye he kɛ tsu ní wawɛɛ kɛ fiɛ sane kpakpa a. A ngma nimli nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a biɛ ngɛ Mawu wami womi ɔ mi.
4Kaa nihi nɛ ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ mi ɔ, nyɛ bua nɛ jɔ daa! I ngɛ dee ekohu ke, nyɛ bua nɛ jɔ!
5Nyɛ ná nɔ tsuaa nɔ he tsui. Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ su si ta. 6Nyɛ ko hao ngɛ nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko he; se mohu nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ mi ɔ, nyɛɛ kɛ sɔlemi, kɛ pɛɛ kpami, kɛ sina nɛ wo nyɛ hiami ní ɔmɛ a ta ha Mawu. 7Nɛ Mawu he jɔmi nɛ pã adesa juɛmi tsuo ɔ maa bu nyɛ tsui, kɛ nyɛ juɛmi he ngɛ Kristo Yesu mi.
8Nyagbe ɔ, ye nyɛmimɛ, nihi nɛ ji anɔkuale, nihi nɛ sa bu, níhi nɛ da, níhi nɛ he tsɔ, níhi nɛ ngɛ fɛu, níhi nɛ woɔ nɔ hɛ mi nyami, ke je mi bami kpakpa ko ngɛ, ke yi jemi ko hu ngɛ ɔ, enɛ ɔmɛ a he nyɛ susu. 9Nihi nɛ nyɛ kase kɛ je ye nya, kɛ níhi nɛ nyɛ nu, nɛ nyɛ na ngɛ ye he ɔ, lɔ ɔmɛ nyɛɛ pee; nɛ he jɔmi Mawu ɔ kɛ nyɛ maa hi si.
Nike ní he sina
10I na bua jɔmi babauu ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ mi kaa be saii ji nɛ ɔ nɛ i nui nyɛ he ɔ, jehanɛ lɛɛ nyɛ na he blɔ kɛ ngɛ nyɛ suɔmi kpo jee kɛ tsɔɔ mi ekohu. I tsɔɔ we kaa nyɛ susuu we ye he hu, se he blɔ nɛ nyɛ ya na we kɛ pee nɔ́ ko ha mi. 11Pi kaa nyɛ hyɛ we ye nɔ he je nɛ i ngɛ enɛ ɔ dee, ejakaa imi lɛɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ ye nine su nɔ kɛkɛ ye bua jɔ he; ja ji bɔ nɛ i kase, nɛ i le. 12I le ohia mi si himi, nɛ i le ní kpɔtɔɔ mi si himi hulɔ. Nɔ́ nɛ i kase ji be tsuaa be ɔ, ye bua nɛ jɔ nɔ́ he; i tɔ jio, hwɔ ngɛ mi yee jio, ye bua nɛ jɔ; kpɔtɔɔ be mi jio, hiami mi jio, ye bua nɛ jɔ. 13Kristo lɛ woɔ mi he wami, nɛ e haa nɛ i nyɛɔ peeɔ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́.
14Se kɛ̃ ɔ, nyɛ pee saminya kaa nyɛ ba ye bua mi ngɛ ye nɔ́ nami be ɔ mi. 15 Nyɛ Filipi bi, nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ le kaa sisije ɔ, benɛ a bɔni sane kpakpa fiɛmi, nɛ i pue nɔ kɛ je Makedonia a, asafo ko asafo ko kɛ mi bɔɛ huɛ ngɛ nɔ́ hami kɛ hemi mi, ja nyɛ pɛ ji asafo nɛ ye bua mi. 16 Benɛ i ngɛ Tesalonika a po, pi si kake kɛkɛ nɛ nyɛ mane mi ní. 17Pi kaa nike ní nɛ i ngɛ hlae doo, se mohu kaa nyɛ maa gu lɔ ɔ peemi nɔ kɛ na biɛ kaa kpakpa peeli. 18 Níhi tsuo nɛ nyɛ mane ɔ ba su mi; a hiɛ kulaa pe bɔ nɛ i susu! Epafrodito ngɔ nyɛ manemi ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ ba, nɛ nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko hia we mi hu. Nike ní nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ kaa bɔ ko nɛ a sã ha Mawu. Bɔ kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ jeɔ via liliili; e saa Mawu hɛ mi, nɛ e naa he bua jɔmi. 19Ye Mawu ɔ ma ha nyɛ níhi tsuo nɛ hia nyɛ ɔ kɛ maa je e ní babauu nɛ hɛ mi ngɛ nyami ɔ mi kɛ gu Kristo Yesu nɔ. 20A je wa Tsɛ Mawu ɔ yi kɛ ya neneene kɛ neneene. Amen.
Nyagbe sɛ yemi
21I biɔ ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ ngɔ a he kɛ ha Kristo Yesu ɔ. Nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a kɛ mi ngɛ hiɛ ɔ ke a biɔ nyɛ. 22Ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ a ngɛ hiɛ ɔ ke a biɔ nyɛ, titli ɔ, Kaisare ɔ we ɔ mi bi ɔmɛ.
23Wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo dloomi ɔ kɛ nyɛ tsuo nɛ hi si.

Title: KOLOSE BI NYA TSƆƆMI
Content:
NYA TSƆƆMI
Paulo ngma womi nɛ ɔ mane asafo ɔ nɛ ngɛ Kolose ɔ. Kolose ji ma wayoo ko nɛ ngɛ Asia Mainɔ, ngɛ Efeso beleku je. Pi Paulo nɛ to Kolose asafo ɔ sisi. Se he nɛ asafo ɔ ngɛ ɔ, lɛ nɛ hyɛɔ lejɛ ɔ nɔ. Enɛ ɔ he ɔ, e tsɔ nihi kɛ je Roma kpokpa a nɛ a tsɛɛ Asia a matsɛ ma Efeso ɔ kɛ ya lejɛ ɔ. Paulo nu kaa lakpa tsɔɔli komɛ ngɛ asafo ɔ mi ngɛ Kolose. Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ a tsɔɔmi ji, loko nɔ ko maa le Mawu, nɛ a ma he e yi wami kɛ pi si ɔ, ja nɔ ɔ ja “mumi mi nɔ yeli, kɛ blɔ nya hɛɛli komɛ.” Ní komɛ hu nɛ jamɛ a tsɔɔli ɔmɛ de kɛ piɛ he hu ji kaa e sa nɛ nɔ ɔ nɛ pee kusumi pɔtɛɛ komɛ kaa nɔ pomi kikɛ nɛ ɔ; nɛ́ kusumihi nɛ kɔɔ niye ní, kɛ ní kpa komɛ a he ɔ, e ye nɔ sisiisi.
Paulo ngma anɔkuale sɛ gbi ɔ nɛ kɔɔ Kristo he ɔ kɛ si tsɔɔmi nɛ ɔmɛ. Nɔ́ pɔtɛɛ nɛ ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ mi ji kaa Yesu Kristo ma nyɛ he nɔ yi wami kɛ pi si. Hemi kɛ yemi kpa amɛ, kɛ kusumi peemi ɔmɛ lɛɛ a tsɛ̃ɔ nɔ kɛ jeɔ Kristo he mohu. Kristo nɔ Mawu gu kɛ bɔ je ɔ, nɛ e ngɛ Kristo nɔuu nɔ gue kɛ kpale je ɔ kɛ ba e ngɔ ekohu. Ja je ɔ kɛ Kristo pee kake loko a ma he je ɔ yi wami. Paulo ya nɔ tsɔɔ nya fitsofitso bɔ nɛ kikɛmɛ a tsɔɔmi nguaa nɛ ɔ ma tsu ní ngɛ níhi nɛ heɔ yeɔ a wami si himi mi.
E hia kaa waa le kaa nɔmlɔ nɛ Paulo tsɔ kɛ womi nɛ ɔ kɛ ya Kolose ji Tihiko; nɛ Onesimo, nyɔguɛ ɔ nɛ Paulo ngma womi nɛ a tsɛɔ Filemon ɔ kɛ ya kpa pɛɛ ha lɛ ɔ piɛ e he kɛ ho.
Bɔ nɛ a dla womi ɔ mi ha
Sisije 1.1-8
Kristo kɛ e ní tsumi 1.9—2.19
Wami he ngɛ Kristo mi 2.20—4.6
Nyagbe 4.7-18

Title: KOLOSE BI 1
Content:
1Imi Paulo nɛ Mawu suɔmi nya nɛ i ba pee Kristo Yesu bɔfo ɔ, i kɛ wa nyɛmi Timoteo ngma womi nɛ ɔ 2mane ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ nɛ ji wa nyɛmimɛ nɛ ngɛ Kolose, nɛ yeɔ anɔkuale, nɛ a kɛ Kristo pee kake ɔ. Dloomi kɛ he jɔmi nɛ je wa Tsɛ Mawu ɔ dɛ mi ɔ ha nyɛ!
Sina sɔlemi
3Ke wa ngɛ sɔlee ha nyɛ ɔ, wa naa Mawu, wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo Tsɛ ɔ si daa. 4Ejakaa hemi kɛ yemi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ ngɛ Kristo Yesu mi, kɛ suɔmi nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ suɔ ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ tsuo ɔ, wa nu he. 5Nyɛ nu momo kaa hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi ko ngɛ ha nyɛ, benɛ anɔkuale sɛ gbi nɛ ji sane kpakpa a ba su nyɛ ɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ hemi kɛ yemi, kɛ nyɛ suɔmi nɛ ɔ daa si ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ ngɔ nyɛ hɛ ngɔ fɔ nɔ kaa a kɛ to ha nyɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ nɔ. 6Sane kpakpa a ngɛ nɔ yae, nɛ e ngɛ yiblii woe ngɛ je ɔ mi tsuo. Kikɛ nɛ ɔ nɔuu e ngɛ ní tsue ngɛ nyɛ hu nyɛ mi kɛ je ligbi ɔ nɛ nyɛ nu Mawu dloomi ɔ he nɛ nyɛ nu sisi kaa bɔ nɛ e ngɛ anɔkuale mi ɔ. 7 Nyɛ kase Mawu dloomi sane nɛ ɔ kɛ je wa suɔlɔ Epafra nɛ waa kɛ lɛ ngɛ ní tsumi kake tsue ɔ nya. Lɛ hu Kristo sɔmɔlɔ anɔkualetsɛ ji lɛ; nɛ e ngɛ ní tsue ha wɔ. 8Suɔmi nɛ mumi ɔ ha nyɛ ɔ, Epafra ba bɔ wɔ he sane.
9Enɛ ɔ he ɔ, kɛ je ligbi ɔ nɛ wa nu nyɛ he ɔ kɛ ba si amlɔ nɛ ɔ, wa jɔɔ we Mawu pɛɛ kpami ha nyɛ. Wa biɔ ke Mawu nɛ ha nɛ nyɛɛ le e suɔmi nya ní, nɛ nyɛ ná nile, kɛ nɔ́ sisi numi nɛ mumi ɔ haa nɔ ɔ. 10Kɛkɛ ɔ, nyɛ maa ba nyɛ je mi bɔ nɛ maa sa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ hɛ mi. Nyɛ ma tsu ní kpakpa sɔuu, nɛ nyɛ maa le Mawu saminya pe bɔ nɛ nyɛ le lɛ daa. 11-12I kpaa Mawu pɛɛ, nɛ e kɛ e he wami nɛ hɛ mi ngɛ nyami ɔ nɛ wo nyɛ he wami, konɛ nyɛ nyɛ́ nɛ nyɛɛ to nyɛ tsui si kɛ na nɔ́, nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ bua jɔmi nɛ na Tsɛ ɔ si. Lɛ nɛ ha nɛ nyɛ ná he blɔ, nɛ gbosi ní nɛ lɛ Mawu ɔ ngɔ to ha ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ ngɛ e matsɛ yemi ɔ mi ɔ, nyɛ hu nyɛ nine maa su nyɛ nɔ́ nɔ. 13E kpɔ wɔ kɛ je diblii he wami ɔ sisi, nɛ e kɛ wɔ ba e Bi nɛ e suɔ lɛ saminya a matsɛ yemi ɔ mi. 14 E Bi ɔ ha nɛ wa ye wa he; ee, e kɛ wa he yayami pa wɔ.
Kristo kɛ ní nɛ e ba tsu
15Kristo ji Mawu nɛ a nɛ́ lɛ ɔ subai nɛ a naa. Lɛ ji nibɔ níhi tsuo a kpɛti tɛte. 16Ejakaa e nɔ lɛ Mawu gu kɛ bɔ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ ngɛ hiɔwe kɛ zugba, níhi nɛ a naa, kɛ ní nɛmɛ nɛ a nɛ́. Ekomɛ ji nihi nɛ ngɛ he wami nɛ a kojoɔ nihi, nihi a nɔ yeli, kɛ nihi nɛ hɛɛ he wami kpahi. Mawu gu Kristo nɔ kɛ bɔ níhi tsuo, nɛ Kristo nɔuu a bɔ mɛ ha. 17Kristo ngɛ loko a bɔ níhi tsuo, nɛ lɛ nɛ ha nɛ níhi tsuo ngɛ a hanɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ. 18 Lɛ ji yi kɛ ha asafo ɔ nɛ ji lɛ nitsɛ e nɔmlɔ tso ɔ. E mi asafo ɔ puɛ kɛ je. Lɛ ji kekleekle nɔ nɛ a tle si kɛ je gbeje, konɛ e ye kekleekle blɔ he ngɛ níhi tsuo a mi. 19Ejakaa Mawu nitsɛ lɛ suɔ kaa lɛ Mawu ɔ su pɛpɛɛpɛ nɛ hi Bi ɔ mi. 20 Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Mawu ná he bua jɔmi kaa kɛ gu e Bi ɔ nɔ ɔ, e ma dla e kɛ je ɔ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ, níhi nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe, kɛ níhi nɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ ɔ a kpɛti. Niinɛ, Mawu gu e Bi ɔ muɔ nɛ pue si ngɛ sɛumi tso ɔ nɔ ɔ nɔ nɛ e kɛ tsu nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, nɛ e kɛ tue mi jɔmi ba.
21Sa a, nyɛɛ kɛ Mawu nyɛ kpɛti kɛ saminya, nɛ nyɛ pee nyɛ he e he nyɛli. Nyɛ peeɔ ní yayamihi, nɛ nyɛ susuɔ ní yayamihi hulɔ. 22Se amlɔ nɛ ɔ, kɛ gu e Bi ɔ nɛ ba ngɛ he lo mi ɔ gbenɔ ɔ nɔ ɔ, e kɛ nyɛ ba kpata. E pee enɛ ɔ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ nyɛɛ pee klɔuklɔu, nɛ piami, loo sé ko kó hi nyɛ he ngɛ e hɛ mi. 23Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e hia kaa nyɛɛ hɛɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ mi; nyɛɛ da si kpitikplii, nɛ hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi nɛ nyɛ ná benɛ nyɛ nu sane kpakpa a, nyɛ ko ngmɛɛ he. Sane kpakpa nɛ ɔ nɛ a fiɛ ngɔ tsɔɔ bɔ níhi tsuo ngɛ je ɔ mi ɔ he lɛ imi Paulo i ba pee sɔmɔlɔ ngɛ.
Paulo ní tsumi ngɛ asafo ɔ mi
24Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, e peeɔ mi bua jɔmi kaa nyɛ he ɔ, i ngɛ nɔ́ nae, konɛ nɔ́ nɛ piɛ ngɛ dengme nɛ Kristo ba gbo ngɛ asafo ɔ nɛ ji e nɔmlɔ tso ɔ he ɔ, ma gbe nya ngɛ ye he lo nɛ ɔ mi. 25Mawu je mi nɛ e tsɔ mi nɛ ma ba sɔmɔ ngɛ asafo ɔ mi ngɛ nyɛ he, nɛ ma fiɛ Mawu munyu ɔ saminya kɛ tsɔɔ nyɛ. 26Sane kpakpa nɛ ɔ ji laami sane nɛ Mawu ngɔ laa yi nɔhi kɛ je blema lokoo, nɛ amlɔ nɛ ɔ lɛɛ e je ngɔ tsɔɔ e ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ. 27Mawu suɔ kaa e ha mɛɛ a le kaa kikɛmɛ a laami sane nɛ he jua wa, nɛ hɛ mi ngɛ nyami nɛ ɔ ngɛ ní tsue ngɛ ma je li ɔmɛ hu a kpɛti. Nɛ laami sane ɔ ji, Kristo ngɛ nyɛ mi, nɛ tsɔɔ kaa nyɛ hɛ ngɛ nɔ kaa Mawu maa wo nyɛ hɛ mi nyami. 28Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, wa ngɛ Kristo he sane ɔ fiɛe kɛ ngɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ tsɔɔe. Wa ngɛ nihi tsuo kɔkɔ bɔe, nɛ wa ngɛ mɛ ní tsɔɔe kɛ nile nɛ mi kuɔ. Wa ngɛ mɔde bɔe nɛ waa gbla nɔ tsuaa nɔ kɛ ba Mawu ngɔ kaa nihi nɛ le Kristo kɛ pi si. 29Enɛ ɔ he ɔ, i kɛ Kristo he wami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ nɛ ngɛ ye mi ɔ gboɔ dengme wawɛɛ kɛ tsuɔ ní.

Title: KOLOSE BI 2
Content:
1Dengme babauu nɛ i gbo ngɛ nyɛɛ kɛ nihi nɛ ngɛ Laodikea, kɛ jehanɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ li mi hɛ mi kɛ hɛ mi po ɔ tsuo nyɛ he ɔ, i suɔ kaa nyɛɛ le. 2I ngɛ enɛ ɔ pee nɛ ma kɛ wo mɛ bua, konɛ suɔmi nɛ ha a pee kake. Kɛkɛ ɔ, a maa nu ní kpakpahi nɛ a mi kuɔ ɔ tsuo a sisi saminya nɛ nɔ jemi be mi, nɛ a maa le Mawu laami sane ɔ. Mawu laami sane ɔ ji Kristo ɔ nɛ. 3Nile, kɛ juɛmi nɛ mi kuɔ ɔ, Kristo mi a naa ngɛ.
4I ngɛ nyɛ enɛ ɔ dee, konɛ nɔ ko kɛ nyami ngɔngɔɛ munyu ko kó ba sisi nyɛ. 5E ngɛ mi kaa he lo mi ɔ, i be nyɛ ngɔ lɛɛ, se mumi mi ɔ, i kɛ nyɛ ngɛ. Ke i hyɛ bɔ nɛ nyɛ toɔ níhi blɔ nya saminya, kɛ bɔ nɛ nyɛ fi si kpɛii ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ ngɛ Kristo mi ɔ mi ɔ, e peeɔ mi bua jɔmi.
Wami he ngɛ Kristo mi
6Akɛnɛ nyɛ he Kristo Yesu kaa nyɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ ya nɔ nyɛɛ kɛ lɛ nɛ pee kake. 7Nyɛɛ ngɔ nyɛ he ngɔ mɛtɛ lɛ, nɛ nyɛɛ ngɔ nyɛ he kɛ ha lɛ kulaa. Nyɛ ha nɛ nyɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ mi nɛ wa kaa bɔ nɛ a tsɔɔ nyɛ ɔ, nɛ nyɛɛ na Mawu si daa. 8Nyɛɛ hyɛ nɛ hi nɛ nɔ ko kó ngɔ je mi nile, loo yaka sisimi kɛ ye nyɛ nyɔguɛ. Blema tsɔɔmihi, kɛ mumihi nɛ yeɔ je ɔ nɔ ɔ, a ngɔ ní nɛ ɔmɛ je, se pi Kristo ngɔ. 9Ejakaa bɔ nɛ Mawu su ngɛ tutuutu ɔ, lɔ ɔ wa naa ngɛ Kristo mi benɛ e ba ngɛ he lo mi ɔ nɛ. 10Nyɛɛ kɛ Kristo pee kake, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Kristo nɛ ji yi ha nɔ yeli tsuo ɔ su ngɛ nyɛ mi. 11Nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ Kristo pee kake ɔ, e tsɔɔ kaa a po nyɛ; pi he lo mi nɔ pomi. Mohu Kristo ha he lo nɛ ɔ we akɔnɔ nɛ nya wa a be nyɛ nɔ he wami hu. 12 Nɛ a sɔle nyɛ ɔ, e tsɔɔ kaa a pu nyɛ ngɔ piɛ Kristo he; nɛ Mawu tle nyɛɛ kɛ Kristo tsuo si ekohu. Ejakaa nyɛ heɔ yeɔ kaa Mawu ngɛ he wami kpetekpleenyɛ, nɛ e tle Kristo si hulɔ. 13 Sa a, nyɛ ngɛ kaa ni komɛ nɛ gbo, ejakaa nyɛ peeɔ yayami, nɛ he lo nya a, a pui nyɛ. Se amlɔ nɛ ɔ, Mawu ha nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ Kristo tsuo ba wami mi ekohu; ee, Mawu ngɔ wɔ tsuo wa he yayami ɔmɛ ngɔ pa wɔ. 14 Wa he níhi nɛ a ngma kɛ si wɔ, kɛ nihi nɛ sa wɔ ngɛ mlaa a nya a, e gbe lɛ tsuo. E je nɔ́ nɛ ɔ se; ee, e ka ngɔ mɛtɛ sɛumi tso ɔ he. 15Kristo kpɔ he wami ngɛ mumi mi nɔ yeli, kɛ he wami ɔmɛ a dɛ. E bɔ mɛ ahlua paa, nɛ e kɛ tsɔɔ je ɔ kaa niinɛ e ye kunimi.
16 Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ ko ha nɔ ko nɛ wo nyɛ mlaa ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ maa ye, kɛ nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ maa nu he, aloo ngɛ nyami be, Nyɔhiɔhe nyami be, kɛ Hejɔɔmi ligbi he. 17Ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ngɛ kaa níhi nɛ maa ba hwɔɔ se ɔ a nini kɛkɛ; nitsɛnitsɛ ɔ ji Kristo. 18Nyɛ ko ha nɛ nihi nɛ buu a he kaa mɛɛ lɛɛ a hi pe nihi tsuo ɔ nɛ a bu nyɛ kaa nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ be nɔ́ ko mi. A deɔ ke mɛɛ a naa nina pɔtɛɛ komɛ, nɛ a nyɛɔ nyɛ nɔ ke nyɛɛ kɛ he si bami nɛ ja bɔfohi. Kikɛmɛ a nimli nɛ ɔmɛ woɔ a he nɔ yaka gu. 19 Nɛ mɛɛ lɛɛ a mɛtɛ we Kristo nɛ ji yi ɔ he. Nɔmlɔ tso ɔ tsuo ɔ, yi ɔ mi e naa níhi tsuo nɛ hia lɛ ɔ kɛ jeɔ. Niye ní nɛ ɔ guɔ kpɔ ɔmɛ, kɛ pani ɔmɛ a mi, nɛ e haa nɔmlɔ tso ɔ waa bɔ nɛ Mawu to ɔ.
Ngɛ Kristo mi ɔ, wa gbo lɛɛ, se kɛ̃ wa hɛ ngɛ
20Nɛ Kristo gbo ɔ, nyɛ hu nyɛ gbo, nɛ a kpɔ nyɛ kɛ je mumihi nɛ yeɔ je ɔ nɔ ɔ a dɛ mi. Mɛni he je mɔ nɛ nyɛ peeɔ nyɛ ní kaa nɔ́ nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ je ɔ ngɛ bɔe kɛ mwɔɔ ɔ? Mɛni he je nyɛ haa a pa woɔ nyɛ mlaa ke, 21“Koo pɛtɛ he, koo sa o nya, nɛ koo ta he tete po” ɔ? 22Mlaa nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo kɔɔ níhi nɛ ke a tsu a he ní pɛ a hɛ mi kpata a a he. Adesa mlaahi, kɛ tsɔɔmihi kɛkɛ ji enɛ ɔmɛ. 23Niinɛ, ni komɛ susuɔ kaa kikɛmɛ a mlaa nɛ ɔmɛ tsɔɔ nile nɛ haa nɔ nitsɛ fiiɔ si ngɛ jami mi. A buá peeɔ a he humi, nɛ a waa nɔmlɔ tso ɔ yi mi kɛ tsɔɔ kaa Mawu lɛ a ngɛ jae. Anɔkuale mi ɔ, mlaa nɛ ɔmɛ nyɛ we nɛ a tsiɔ nɔmlɔ tso ɔ we akɔnɔ nya.

Title: KOLOSE BI 3
Content:
1 A tle nyɛɛ kɛ Kristo tsuo si, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ hla níhi nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe, he nɛ Kristo hii si ngɛ Mawu hiɔ nɔ ngɛ ɔ. 2Níhi nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ, lɔ ɔmɛ a he nyɛ susu; pi nihi nɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ. 3Ejakaa nyɛ ngɛ kaa nihi nɛ gbo, nɛ a ngɔ nyɛ wami ɔ kɛ Kristo tsuo ngɔ laa ngɛ Mawu mi. 4Kristo ji nyɛ wami. Nɛ ke e ba ekohu ɔ, nyɛɛ kɛ lɛ tsuo maa hi lejɛ ɔ; nɛ a maa wo nyɛɛ kɛ lɛ tsuo nyɛ hɛ mi nyami.
Wa mi momo kɛ wami he ɔ
5Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, je nɛ ɔ mi akɔnɔ níhi nɛ haoɔ nyɛ, yo kɛ nyumu yakayaka fiɛmi, mu ní tsumi, mi mi la, akɔnɔ yaya, kɛ hɛ tsumi nɛ ngɛ kaa amaga jami ɔ, nyɛɛ gbe. 6Nihi nɛ gboɔ tue, nɛ a peeɔ kikɛmɛ a ní nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, Mawu kɛ mi mi fumi ma kple a nɔ. 7Sa a, be nɛ nyɛ nitsɛmɛ hu nyɛ ba nyɛ je mi ja a, kikɛmɛ a akɔnɔ nɛ ɔmɛ nɔuu a se nyɛ ya nyɛɛ.
8Se jehanɛ ɔ lɛɛ nyɛ kpa ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo: mi mi la, mimi fumi, kɛ yi wu tso ní peemi. Nyɛ ko gbe nɔ he guɛ, nɛ munyu yaya ko kó je nyɛ nya. 9 Nyɛ ko ye nyɛ sibi lakpa; nyɛ sake nɔmlɔ su momo ɔ, kɛ e ní tsumi ɔmɛ ngɔ pue. 10 Nyɛɛ wo nɔmlɔ su he. Nɔmlɔ su he nɛ ɔ ji nɔ́ nɛ Mawu, e bɔlɔ ɔ ngɛ mɔde bɔe daa nɛ kaa e maa hi kaa bɔ nɛ lɛ Mawu ɔ ngɛ ɔ, kɛkɛ nyɛ maa le lɛ fitsofitso. 11Ngɛ enɛ ɔ mi ɔ, slɔɔto ko be Hela no kɛ Yuda no a kpɛti; slɔɔto be nɔ nɛ a po lɛ, kɛ mɔmlɔtɔtsɛ a kpɛti. Kɔpe no be ɔ, futufutu no be; nyɔguɛ be ɔ, odehe ko hu be. Nɔ nɛ he hia ji Kristo; nɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ hɛ ngɛ ɔ, Kristo ngɛ e mi.
12 Mawu nihi nɛ e hla, nɛ e suɔ ji nyɛ, nɛ nyɛ ngɛ klɔuklɔu. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ ha nɛ a na subai nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ nyɛ he kaa tade nɛ nyɛ wo: mi mi jɔmi, mɔbɔ nami, he si bami, kpoo peemi, kɛ tsui si tomi. 13 Ke nɔ ko kɛ e nyɛmi ngɛ sane ko ɔ, nyɛɛ na ha nyɛ sibi, nɛ nyɛ kɛ pa nyɛ he kaa bɔ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ hu ngɔ nyɛ he yayami ngɔ pa nyɛ ɔ. 14Enɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a se ɔ, nyɛ ha suɔmi nɛ pee kaa tade nɛ nyɛ wo, ejakaa suɔmi ngɛ kaa kpa nɛ fiɔ níhi tsuo ngɔ peeɔ kake, nɛ lɛ tsuo peeɔ pɛ. 15He jɔmi nɛ Kristo haa a, nyɛ ha nɛ a na kaa e ngɛ ní tsue ngɛ nyɛ tsui mi. Ejakaa nyɛ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ nɔmlɔ tso kake ɔ mi ɔ, ní tsumi nɛ Mawu kpee nyɛ ke nyɛ ba tsu ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. E sa nɛ nyɛɛ na Mawu si. 16 Nyɛ ha nɛ Kristo sɛ gbi ɔ nɛ hyi nyɛ fuu. Nyɛɛ tsɔɔ nyɛ he ní, nɛ nyɛɛ wo nyɛ sibi ga kɛ juɛmi nɛ mi kuɔ. Nyɛ la La womi ɔ mi lahi, yi jemi lahi, kɛ mumi mi lahi kɛ je nyɛ tsui mi nɛ nyɛ kɛ na Mawu si. 17Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ kɛ mumi lahi kɛ je nyɛ tsui mi, nɛ nyɛ ngɛ pee; munyu lɛ nyɛ ngɛ tue jio, ní nyɛ ngɛ tsue jio, nyɛɛ pee ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu biɛ mi. Nɛ nyɛɛ gu e nɔ kɛ na Tsɛ Mawu ɔ si.
Wami he ɔ mi si himi
18 Yigbayi, nyɛɛ ba nyɛ he si ha nyɛ hunomɛ, ejakaa nɔ́ nɛ sa nyɛ peemi kaa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ se nyɛɛli ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. 19 Nyɛ hunomɛ, nyɛɛ suɔ nyɛ yi ɔmɛ, nɛ nyɛ ko wa mɛ yi mi. 20 Bimɛ, nyɛɛ bu nyɛ fɔli ngɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ mi, ejakaa enɛ ɔ saa Mawu hɛ mi saminya. 21 Tsɛmɛ, nyɛ ko wo nyɛ bimɛ a mi mi la; ke nyɛ pee ja a, a nine mi maa wo nyu. 22 Nyɔguɛhi, nyɛɛ bu nyɛ je nɛ ɔ mi nyɔmtsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ mi, pi kɛ hɛ mi sɔmɔmi nɛ ma ha nyɛ nyɔmtsɛmɛ ɔmɛ maa suɔ nyɛ sane. Mohu ɔ, nyɛɛ bu mɛ kɛ je nyɛ tsui mi kaa nihi nɛ yeɔ Mawu gbeye. 23Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ pee ɔ, nyɛɛ je nyɛ tsui mi kɛ pee kaa nɔ́ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nyɛ ngɛ pee ha, se pi adesa. 24Nyɛ na nyɛɛ le kaa nike ní nɛ Mawu ngɔ to ha ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ ɔ, nyɛ nine maa su nyɛ hu nyɛ nɔ́ nɔ kaa nyɛ hiɔwo, ejakaa Nyɔmtsɛ Kristo nyɛ ngɛ sɔmɔe.
25 Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ dɛ ɔ ma na e yayami ɔ he hiɔwo, ejakaa Mawu hyɛ we nɔ hɛ mi.

Title: KOLOSE BI 4
Content:
1 Nyɔmtsɛmɛ, nyɛɛ hɛɛ nyɛ nyɔguɛ ɔmɛ saminya ngɛ blɔ nɛ da nɔ. Nyɛ na nyɛɛ le kaa nyɛ hu nyɛ ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ngɛ hiɔwe.
Ga womi
2Nyɛɛ ya nɔ nyɛɛ sɔle daa, nɛ nyɛ hɛ nɛ hi nyɛ he nɔ, nɛ nyɛɛ na Mawu si. 3Nyɛɛ sɔle ha wɔ hulɔ, konɛ Mawu nɛ bli blɔ ha wɔ nɛ waa fiɛ e sɛ gbi nɛ kɔɔ Kristo he ɔ. Ejakaa Kristo laami sane nɛ ɔ he nɛ a wo mi tsu ngɛ. 4Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ sɔle nɛ ma gba laami sane nɛ ɔ mi saminya bɔ nɛ sa kaa ma gba mi.
5 Be tsuaa be nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ nihi nɛ he we Kristo yi ma bua a, nyɛɛ ba nyɛ je mi saminya, konɛ a na kaa nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ le Kristo. 6Ke nyɛɛ kɛ nihi ngɛ ní sɛɛe ɔ, nyɛ ha nɛ munyu nɛ maa je nyɛ nya a nɛ ngɔ kaa nɔ́ ko nɛ a wo lɛ ngo, nɛ nyɛɛ le bɔ nɛ nyɛ ma ha nɔ tsuaa nɔ munyu heto bɔ nɛ sa.
Nyagbe sɛ yemi
7 Wa nyɛmi Tihiko nɛ wa suɔ lɛ saminya, nɛ e yeɔ anɔkuale ngɛ sɔmɔmi ní tsumi nɛ waa kɛ lɛ ngɛ tsue ha Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ mi ɔ ma ba bɔ nyɛ níhi tsuo nɛ kɔɔ ye he. 8Enɛ ɔ he i ngɛ lɛ nyɛ ngɔ tsɔe, konɛ nyɛɛ nu wa he, bɔ nɛ wa ngɛ ha, konɛ nyɛ hu e ba wo nyɛ bua. 9 Onesimo piɛ e he kɛ ma. Lɛ hu wa nyɛmi nɛ wa suɔ saminya, nɛ yeɔ Kristo anɔkuale ji lɛ; nɛ e je nyɛ asafo ɔ mi. A ma ba bɔ nyɛ hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ amaniɛ tsuo.
10 Aristarko nɛ a wo i kɛ lɛ tsuo tsu ɔ ke e biɔ nyɛ. Barnaba nyɛmi Marko hu ke e biɔ nyɛ. Nyɛ nine su womi nɔ momo kaa ke Marko ba nyɛ ngɔ ɔ, nyɛ he lɛ atuu. 11Yoshua nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Yusto hulɔ ɔ ke lɛ hu e biɔ nyɛ. Ni etɛ nɛ ɔmɛ pɛ ji Yuda bi nɛ ba he Kristo ye, nɛ a kɛ mi ngɛ ní tsue ngɛ hiɛ ɔ ngɛ Mawu matsɛ yemi ɔ he. Niinɛ, a ngɛ mi wae wawɛɛ nitsɛ.
12 Epafra, nyɛ kpɛti no kpa nɛ lɛ hu e tsuɔ ní ha Kristo Yesu ɔ ke e biɔ nyɛ. Daa nɛ ɔ, e ngɛ sɔlee ha nyɛ kɛ e tsui tsuo. E ngɛ e he gbee kaa Mawu nɛ ha nɛ nyɛɛ hɛɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ mi wawɛɛ kaa Kristo se nyɛɛli kpakpahi, nihi nɛ heɔ Yesu yeɔ kɛ a tsui tsuo, nɛ a peeɔ Mawu suɔmi nya ní sisiisi. 13I ngɛ e he odase yee kaa e gbo dengme saminya ngɛ nyɛɛ kɛ nihi nɛ ngɛ Laodikea, kɛ Hierapoli ɔ nyɛ he. 14 Luka, tsopatsɛ ɔ nɛ wa suɔ lɛ saminya a, kɛ Dema ke a biɔ nyɛ.
15Nyɛ de nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ Laodikea ke wa biɔ mɛ. Wa biɔ Nimfa, kɛ asafo ɔ nɛ kpee ngɛ e we ɔ mi ɔ hulɔ. 16Ke nyɛ kane womi nɛ ɔ gbe nya a, nyɛ ha nɛ a kane ngɔ ha Laodikea asafo ɔ hulɔ. Womi nɛ i sɛ hlami ngma mane Laodikea asafo ɔ, nyɛ hu nyɛɛ kane. 17 Jehanɛ ɔ, nyɛ de Arkipo ke, “Ní tsumi ɔ nɛ a tu ngɔ wo o dɛ ke o tsu ha Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ, hyɛ nɛ o tsu kɛ gbe nya.”
18Imi Paulo nitsɛ ye nine nya womi nɛ i ngma kaa i biɔ nyɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. Nyɛ hɛ ko je nɔ kaa i ngɛ kɔsɔkɔsɔ mi kɛ mwɔɔ. Mawu dloomi ɔ kɛ nyɛ tsuo nɛ hi si.

Title: TESALONIKA BI I, NYA TSƆƆMI
Content:
NYA TSƆƆMI
Roma nɔ yemi he nɛ a tsɛɛ Makedonia a ma nguaa ji Tesalonika. Benɛ Paulo je Filipi ɔ, e ya to asafo sisi ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Se e kɛ we kulaa nɛ Yuda bi komɛ ba te si wo lɛ. A je Paulo ní tsumi nɛ ngɛ nɔ yae ɔ he hunga, ejakaa benɛ e ba Tesalonika a, ni komɛ nɛ pi Yuda bi ji mɛ nɛ jinɛ a ba ngɔ a he kɛ wo Yuda jami ɔ mi ɔ nya Kristo sɛ gbi ɔ nɛ Paulo fiɛ ɔ he saminya. Nɛ e ba mi kaa Paulo nɛ je lejɛ ɔ kɛ ho Berea ya. Pee se benɛ Paulo ya su Korinto ɔ, e ná sɛ gbi kɛ je e huɛ Timoteo nɛ e kɛ lɛ ngɛ ní tsue ɔ ngɔ. Níhi nɛ ngɛ nɔ yae ngɛ Tesalonika asafo ɔ mi ɔ, lɔ ɔmɛ a he sɛ gbi ɔ kɔɔ.
Paulo ngma Tesalonika bi ɔmɛ kekleekle womi nɛ ɔ, konɛ e kɛ wo Kristo se nyɛɛli nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ he wami. E na Mawu si ngɛ munyu nɛ e nu nɛ kɔɔ a hemi kɛ yemi, kɛ suɔmi nɛ a ngɛ ɔ he, nɛ e kai mɛ bɔ nɛ e ba e je mi be mi nɛ e kɛ mɛ ba hi si ɔ. Sane komɛ hu ba te si ngɛ asafo ɔ mi ngɛ Kristo kpalemi kɛ bami ekohu ɔ he. Enɛ ɔmɛ hu Paulo tu a he munyu ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ mi. Sane bimi ɔmɛ ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ: Ke nɔ ko ba le Kristo, nɛ e gbo loko Kristo kpale kɛ ba a, neneene wami ɔ nɛ Kristo kɛ maa ba a, anɛ lɛ hu e ma ná lo? Mɛni be Kristo maa kpale kɛ ba? Paulo wo mɛ ga kaa mɛɛ lɛɛ a ya nɔ nɛ a tsu a ní ngɛ tue mi jɔmi mi, konɛ a ngɔ a hɛ ngɔ fɔ Mawu nɔ, nɛ a kɛ hyɛ Kristo bami ɔ blɔ.
Bɔ nɛ a dla womi ɔ mi ha
Sisije 1.1
Sina kɛ yi jemi 1.2—3.13
Kristo se nyɛɛli a je mi bami 4.1-12
Kristo maa ba 4.13—5.11
Nyagbe sɛ gbi 5.12-22
Nyagbe 5.23-28

Title: TESALONIKA BI I, 1
Content:
1 Imi Paulo, Sila, kɛ Timoteo, wa ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ ngmae kɛ ya ha asafo mi bi nɛ ngɛ Tesalonika, nɛ ngɛ Tsɛ Mawu, kɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo mi ɔ.
Dloomi kɛ he jɔmi ha nyɛ!
Tesalonika bi a si himi, kɛ a hemi kɛ yemi
2Wa naa Mawu si daa kɛ haa nyɛ tsuo, nɛ daa ke wa ngɛ sɔlee ɔ, wa woɔ nyɛ ta. 3Wa kaiɔ nyɛ ngɛ wa Tsɛ Mawu hɛ mi bɔ nɛ nyɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ jeɔ kpo ngɛ nyɛ ní tsumi mi, bɔ nɛ suɔmi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ ɔ ha nɛ nyɛ tsu ní wawɛɛ, kɛ bɔ nɛ nyɛ ngɔ nyɛ hɛ kɛ fɔ wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo nɔ wawɛɛ nitsɛ. 4Nyɛmimɛ, wa le kaa Mawu suɔ nyɛ, nɛ e hla nyɛ kɛ pee lɛ nitsɛ e nihi. 5Sane kpakpa a nɛ wa ngɔ ba ha nyɛ ɔ, pi munyu kɛkɛ nɛ wa ba tu. Nɔ́ nɛ wa ba de nyɛ ɔ wo nyɛ he wami, nɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ bli nyɛ juɛmi nya, nɛ nyɛ na kaa munyu ɔ nɛ wa kɛ ba a, anɔkuale sɔuu. Benɛ wa ngɛ nyɛ ngɔ ɔ, nyɛ le bɔ nɛ waa kɛ nyɛ hi si ha. Wa pee ja, konɛ e hi ha nyɛ nitsɛmɛ. 6 Nyɛ kase waa kɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ tsuo, ejakaa benɛ a ngɛ nyɛ yi mi wae ɔ, Mawu Klɔuklɔu ɔ wo nyɛ he wami, nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ bua jɔmi he sɛ gbi ɔ. 7Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, nyɛ ba pee nɔ hyɛmi nɔ́ ha nihi nɛ he ye ngɛ Makedonia kɛ Akaya tsuo. 8Pi Makedonia kɛ Akaya kɛkɛ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ sɛ gbi ɔ nɛ nyɛ fiɛ ɔ gbɛ fĩa a, se he tsuaa he ɔ, a nu nyɛ hemi kɛ yemi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ ngɛ Mawu mi ɔ hu he. Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, e hia we kaa wɔɔ wa deɔ nɔ́ ko hu. 9Ni ɔmɛ tsuo yeɔ nyɛ he odase kpakpa kaa benɛ wa ba slaa nyɛ ɔ, nyɛ he wɔ atuu. Jehanɛ ɔ hu, nyɛ kpale kɛ je amagahi a se kɛ ba Mawu ngɔ, konɛ nyɛ ba sɔmɔ anɔkuale Mawu hɛ kalɔ ɔ. 10Mawu Bi Yesu ɔ nɛ Mawu tle lɛ si kɛ je gbeje ɔ, a tsɔɔ kaa nyɛ ngɛ lɛ blɔ hyɛe kaa e maa je hiɔwe kɛ ba ekohu. Lɛ ji nɔ nɛ ma je wɔ kɛ je tue gblami nɛ ma a mi.

Title: TESALONIKA BI I, 2
Content:
Paulo ní tsumi ngɛ Tesalonika
