1Nyɛmimɛ, nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ le kaa slaami nɛ wa ba slaa nyɛ ɔ pee we yaka. 2 Nyɛ le bɔ nɛ a wa wɔ yi mi, nɛ a jɛ wɔ kɛ pue wa hɛ mi si ngɛ Filipi loko wa ba nyɛ ngɔ ngɛ Tesalonika a. E ngɛ mi kaa níhi fuu ka wɔ blɔ tsimi, se wa Mawu ɔ wo wɔ kã kaa wa ba fiɛ e sane kpakpa a ngɔ tsɔɔ nyɛ. 3Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ maa na kaa munyu nɛ wa kɛ ba fɔ nyɛ hɛ mi ɔ, pi mu ní tsumi, loo juɛmi yayami mi nɛ e je; wa bɛ nɛ wa ba sisi nyɛ. 4Mohu ɔ, wa tuɔ munyu kaa bɔ nɛ Mawu tsɔɔ wɔ ke waa pee ɔ; ejakaa e na wɔ kaa nihi nɛ sa nɛ a tu sane kpakpa a ngɔ wo a dɛ mi. Wa hla we kaa waa sa nimli a hɛ mi, se mohu kaa wa maa sa Mawu pɛ hɛ mi; ejakaa lɛ nɛ e le bɔ nɛ wa tsui mi ngɛ ha. 5Kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ le ɔ, wa bɛ nyɛ ngɔ kɛ nya mi ngɔngɔɛ munyuhi; jehanɛ hu, wa ba sisi we nyɛ nɛ wa kɛ na nyɛ he se. Mawu ji wa we odase! 6Wa bɛ, konɛ nimli ba wo wa hɛ mi nyami, nyɛ jio, ni kpahi jio. 7Pohu wa ngɛ he blɔ kaa wa biɔ enɛ kɛ enɛ ngɛ nyɛ dɛ, ejakaa Kristo bɔfohi ji wɔ. Se benɛ wa ngɛ nyɛ ngɔ ɔ, wa pee nyɛ dɔdɔɔdɔ kaa bɔ nɛ bimɛanyɛ hɛɛɔ lɛ nitsɛ e bimɛ ɔ. 8Akɛnɛ wa suɔ nyɛ saminya a, wa na he tsui kaa pi Mawu sane kpakpa a kɛkɛ nɛ wa maa ngɔ ba ha nyɛ; se wɔ nitsɛmɛ wa wami tete wa ma ngɔ fɔ si ha nyɛ. Suɔmi nɛ wa ngɛ kɛ ha nyɛ ɔ nya wa! 9Nyɛmimɛ, nyɛ ma kai bɔ nɛ wa tsu ní kɛ pɔtɔ! Benɛ wa ngɛ Mawu sane kpakpa a fiɛe kɛ ngɛ nyɛ hae ɔ, wa ngɛ ní tsue nyɔ kɛ pia, konɛ wa ko pee tlomi ngɔ ha nyɛ ti nɔ ko.
10Nyɛɛ kɛ Mawu ji wa we odase kaa wa ba wa je mi saminya ngɛ nyɛ nihi nɛ nyɛ heɔ yeɔ ɔ nyɛ kpɛti. Wa peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da blɔ nɛ piami ko be wa he. 11Nyɛ le bɔ nɛ waa kɛ nyɛ ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ hi si kaa tsɛ kɛ e bi. 12Wa wo nyɛ he wami; wa wo nyɛ bua, nɛ wa wo nyɛ ga kaa nyɛɛ ba nyɛ je mi bɔ nɛ sa Mawu hɛ mi. Lɛ nɛ e tsɛ nyɛ ke nyɛɛ ba lɛ nitsɛ e matsɛ yemi ɔ, kɛ e nyami ɔ mi.
13Nɔ́ kake he hu nɛ wa naa Mawu si ngɛ daa ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. Benɛ wa ngɔ Mawu munyu ɔ ba ha nyɛ ɔ, nyɛ bu tue, nɛ nyɛ he lɛ atuu, pi kaa nɔmlɔ adesa sɛ gbi, se mohu kaa Mawu munyu kaa bɔ nɛ e ngɛ anɔkuale mi ɔ. Niinɛ nyɛ nihi nɛ nyɛ heɔ yeɔ ɔ, Mawu munyu ɔ ngɛ ní tsue ngɛ nyɛ mi. 14 Nyɛmimɛ, nɔ́ nɛ pee nyɛ nɛ ɔ, lɔ ɔ nɔuu nɛ pee Mawu asafo ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ Yudea a mi bi nɛ ngɔ a he ngɔ ha Kristo Yesu ɔ. Nyɛ na amanehlu ngɛ nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ ma mi bi a dɛ mi kaa bɔ nɛ mɛ hu a na amanehlu ngɛ Yuda bi a dɛ mi ɔ. 15 Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a gbe Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu, kɛ gbali ɔmɛ. Mɛ lɛ a wa wɔ yi mi. Mawu na we a he bua jɔmi; a te si wo nɔ tsuaa nɔ! 16Ma je li tete po a ke wa ko fiɛ ha mɛ, konɛ a ko he a yi wami. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, yayami ɔ, pe a ngɛ pee kɛ ngɛ nɔ toe babauu daa ligbi. Se jehanɛ lɛɛ Mawu kɛ e mi mi fumi ɔ kple a nɔ!
Paulo suɔ nɛ e ya slaa Tesalonika bi ɔmɛ ekohu
17Nyɛmimɛ, e ngɛ mi kaa wa si nyɛ, nɛ waa kɛ nyɛ mi gba be kpiti ko ngɛ he lo mi, se wa hɛ ji nyɛ nɔ. Hɛja sɔuu ha nɛ wa bɔ mɔde wawɛɛ kaa waa na nyɛ hɛ mi ekohu. 18Wa hla kaa waa kpale kɛ ba nyɛ ngɔ; ee, imi Paulo nitsɛ, i ka si abɔ kaa ma ba. Se Abosiami tsi wɔ blɔ. 19Ejakaa ke wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu ba, nɛ wa ba pue ngɛ e hɛ mi ɔ, mɛni nɔ wa maa fĩa kɛ fɔ? Mɛni ma ha wɔ bua jɔmi? Nɛ mɛni jlasi waa kɛ maa fĩa kaa wa ye kunimi? Anɛ pi nyɛ lo? 20Ee, nyɛ lɛ nyɛ maa wo wa hɛ mi nyami; nyɛ lɛ nyɛ ma ha wɔ bua jɔmi.

Title: TESALONIKA BI I, 3
Content:
A tsɔ Timoteo
1 Benɛ wa nyɛ we hu ɔ, wa kplɛɛ kaa wa maa tlɔ Atene kɛkɛ. 2Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, wa tsɔ Timoteo, wa nyɛmi nɛ waa kɛ lɛ tsuɔ ní kaa Mawu sɔmɔlɔ kɛ fiɛɔ Kristo he sane kpakpa a. Wa tsɔ lɛ, konɛ e ba wo nyɛ he wami, nɛ e ha nyɛ fi si ngɛ nyɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ mi, 3bɔ nɛ pee nɛ amanehlu nɛ ngɛ bae ɔ ko wo nyɛ ti nɔ ko he gbeye. Nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ le kaa nɔ́ nɛ Mawu to kɛ ha wɔ ji lɔ ɔ nɛ. 4Benɛ waa kɛ nyɛ ngɛ ɔ, wa de nyɛ ngɔ to kaa wa maa na amanehlu. Nɛ kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ le ɔ, lɔ ɔ pɛ lɛ ba mi nɛ ɔ nɛ. 5Kaa bɔ nɛ i de ɔ, benɛ i nyɛ we tsui tomi hu ɔ, e hia kaa ma tsɔ Timoteo nyɛ ngɔ, nɛ́ e ba hyɛ kaa nyɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ mi wa kɛ mwɔɔ lo. I ya ye gbeye kaa alini Abosiami ba ka nyɛ, nɛ e ha nɛ wa dengme nɛ wa gbo ɔ maa pee yaka.
6 Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, Timoteo kpale kɛ ba, nɛ e ba bɔ wɔ amaniɛ saminyayoo nɛ kɔɔ nyɛ hemi kɛ yemi, kɛ nyɛ suɔmi ɔ he. E ba de wɔ ke nyɛ susuɔ wa he daa nɛ, nɛ nyɛ hɛ jaa ngɛ wa he kaa bɔ nɛ wɔ hu wa hɛ jaa ngɛ nyɛ he ɔ. 7Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛmimɛ, nyɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ woɔ wɔ he wami ngɛ amanehlu, kɛ nɔ́ nɛ wa ngɛ nae nɛ ɔ mi. 8Ke nyɛ maa ngɔ nyɛ he ngɔ mɛtɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ kulaa a, wɔ hu wa ma na he wami he. 9Nyɛ he ɔ, Mawu haa wɔ bua jɔmi babauu nɛ wa be nyɛe maa na lɛ si saasaa. 10Daa nyɔ kɛ pia a, wa kpaa lɛ pɛɛ kɛ wa tsui tsuo kaa waa na nyɛ hɛ mi kɛ hɛ mi, konɛ waa wo nyɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ mi he wami.
11Wa Tsɛ Mawu ɔ nitsɛ, kɛ wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu nɛ a bli blɔ ha wɔ nɛ waa ba nyɛ ngɔ ekohu. 12Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nɛ ha nyɛ suɔmi ɔ mi nɛ wa, konɛ nyɛɛ suɔ nyɛ sibi, kɛ nimli adesahi tsuo kaa bɔ nɛ wɔ hu wa suɔ nyɛ ɔ. 13Nɛ e wo nyɛ he wami, nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ tsui nɛ he tsɔ nɛ ba nyɛ je mi bɔ nɛ piami ko be nyɛ he hie ngɛ wa Tsɛ Mawu ɔ hɛ mi be mi nɛ wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu kɛ e ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ tsuo maa ba a.

Title: TESALONIKA BI I, 4
Content:
Si himi nɛ saa Mawu hɛ mi
1Nyagbe ɔ, nyɛmimɛ, nyɛ kase kɛ je wa ngɔ bɔ nɛ nyɛ maa ba nyɛ je mi nɛ e sa Mawu hɛ mi; nɛ jã nyɛ ngɛ pee ɔ nɛ. Se kɛ̃, ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu biɛ mi ɔ, wa ngɛ nyɛ pɛɛ kpae, nɛ wa ngɛ nyɛ ga woe kaa nyɛɛ pee kɛ ya nɔ pe jã po. 2Ejakaa mlaa nɛ wa wo nyɛ ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu biɛ mi ɔ, nyɛ le. 3Mawu suɔmi nya ji kaa nyɛ he nɛ tsɔ, nɛ nyɛ ko fiɛ nyumu kɛ yo yakayaka fiɛmi. 4E sa kaa nyɛ ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ le bɔ nɛ e maa ye e he nɔ ha nɛ nyɛ he ma tsɔ, nɛ bu maa hi nyɛ he. 5Nyɛ ko di akɔnɔ se kaa bɔ nɛ nihi nɛ li Mawu ɔ peeɔ ɔ. 6Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ ko kó ya pee e nyɛmi yayami kaa e ma ya ngɔ e nyɛmi e yo. Wa de nyɛ enɛ ɔ momo, nɛ wa bɔ nyɛ kɔkɔ wawɛɛ kaa nihi nɛ peeɔ jã a, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ maa gbla a tue. 7Mawu tsɛ we wɔ nɛ wa ba tsu mu ní, se mohu bɔ nɛ pee nɛ wa he nɛ tsɔ. 8Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ bui tsɔɔmi nɛ ɔ, pi nɔmlɔ adesa nɛ e bui, se mohu Mawu, nɔ nɛ ha nyɛ e Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ.
9Jehanɛ, suɔmi nɛ sa kaa e hi nyɛmimɛ nɛ heɔ yeɔ ɔ a kpɛti ɔ, e hia we kaa ma ngma nyɛ womi ngɛ lɔ ɔ he hu. Mawu tsɔɔ nyɛ momo kaa nyɛɛ suɔ nyɛ he, 10nɛ niinɛ ɔ, nyɛ suɔ nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ nɛ ngɛ Makedonia a saminya. Se wa kpa nyɛ pɛɛ nyɛmimɛ, nyɛɛ ya nɔ nɛ nyɛɛ pee pe ja po. 11Nyɛɛ bɔ mɔde nɛ nyɛɛ pee nyɛ he kpoo, nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ he ko wo ni kpahi a sane mi. Nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ nine nɛ tsu ní kaa bɔ nɛ wa de nyɛ ɔ. 12Ke nyɛ pee jã a, nihi nɛ li Kristo lolo ɔ maa bu nyɛ, nɛ nyɛ be nyɛ he ngɔe kɛ fɔ nɔ ko nɔ.
Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ma
13Nyɛmimɛ, wa suɔ kaa nyɛɛ le anɔkuale sane nɛ kɔɔ nihi nɛ gbo ɔ a he, konɛ nyɛ ko ye kɔmɔ kaa nihi nɛ be hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi. 14Wa heɔ yeɔ kaa Yesu gbo, nɛ e te si ekohu. Jã kɛ̃, wa heɔ yeɔ kaa ke Yesu ma a, Mawu maa ngɔ nihi nɛ gbo ɔ ngɔ piɛ e he kɛ ba.
15 Nɔ́ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nitsɛ de ɔ, lɔ ɔ wa ngɛ nyɛ dee nɛ ɔ nɛ. Ligbi ɔ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ maa ba a, wɔ nihi nɛ wa hɛ ngɛ, nɛ wa maa hi wami mi kɛ mwɔɔ ɔ, wa be ni nɛmɛ nɛ gbo ɔ a hlami sɛe kɛ ya kpee lɛ. 16Ejakaa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nitsɛ ma kple si kɛ je hiɔwe kɛ ba kɛ ose nɛ nya wa. Bɔfo nɔkɔtɔma a maa wo gbi, nɛ Mawu titimati ɔ maa pɛ. Nihi nɛ he Yesu ye loko a gbo ɔ maa te si kekle. 17Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, wɔ ni nɛmɛ nɛ wa hɛ ngɛ nɛ maa hi wami mi jamɛ a be ɔ, a ma sa waa kɛ mɛ tsuo kɛ ya kɔɔhiɔ mi ngɛ bɔku ɔmɛ a mi kɛ ya kpee Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ. Nɛ waa kɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ maa hi si daa. 18Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ kɛ kikɛmɛ a munyu nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ wo nyɛ sibi a bua.

Title: TESALONIKA BI I, 5
Content:
Nyɛ dla nyɛ he ngɔ to Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ bami
1Nyɛmimɛ, be tutuutu nɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ maa ba mi ɔ, e hia we kaa waa ngma nyɛ. 2 Ejakaa nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ le tsɔ kaa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ maa ba tlukaa kaa bɔ nɛ julɔ baa nyɔ mi. 3Be mi nɛ nihi ma de ke, “Wa he mi jɔ wɔ, nɛ wa tue mi hu jɔ wɔ” ɔ, jamɛ a be ɔ mi nɔuu nɛ a hɛ mi ma kpata tlukaa kaa bɔ nɛ yo nɛ mi wa nuɔ kɔɔmi si kake too ɔ; nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be e he yee. 4Se nyɛmimɛ, nyɛɛ lɛɛ pi diblii mi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ nɛ ligbi ɔ ma ba ti nyɛ si kaa julɔ. 5Ejakaa nyɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ la bimɛ ji nyɛ; ee, piani bimɛ ji nyɛ; wa pi nyɔ, loo diblii bimɛ. 6Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, wa ko hwɔ mahe kaa bɔ nɛ ni kpahi peeɔ ɔ; se mohu waa hi hɛ ngmengmle, nɛ wa hɛ mi nɛ ka si. 7Ejakaa nyɔ mi nɛ a hwɔɔ mahe, nɛ nyɔ mi dã deli deɔ dã. 8 Se wɔɔ lɛɛ piani bimɛ ji wɔ, nɛ e hia kaa wa hɛ mi nɛ ka si. Wa hemi kɛ yemi, kɛ suɔmi ɔ mi nɛ wa kaa dama, nɛ hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi kaa a ma he wa yi wami ɔ, lɔ ɔ hu mi nɛ wa kaa dade pɛɛ. 9Mawu hla we wɔ kɛ to, nɛ e na wa he abofu. Se mohu, e wo wɔ kɛ to, konɛ e he wa yi wami kɛ gu wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo nɔ. 10Kristo ba gbo ha wɔ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ wa hɛ ngɛ jio, wa gbo jio, waa kɛ lɛ nɛ hi si. 11Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ wo nyɛ sibi he wami, nɛ nyɛɛ ye bua nyɛ sibi kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ pee amlɔ nɛ ɔ.
Nyagbe ga womi kɛ sɛ yemi
12Wa kpa nyɛ pɛɛ, nyɛmimɛ, nɛ nyɛɛ bu nihi nɛ ngɛ ní tsue ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti ɔ, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ asafo ɔ hɛ mi nyɛɛli nɛ tuɔ munyu tsɔɔ nyɛ ɔ. 13Nyɛɛ bu mɛ saminya, nɛ nyɛɛ suɔ mɛ ngɛ ní tsumi nɛ a ngɛ tsue ɔ he. Nyɛ nitsɛmɛ hu, nyɛɛ hi si ngɛ tue mi jɔmi mi.
14Ye nyɛmimɛ nɛ i suɔ, wa kpa nyɛ pɛɛ! Nyɛɛ tu munyu ngɔ tsɔɔ hejɔtsɛmɛ ɔmɛ; nyɛɛ wo ni nɛmɛ nɛ be tsui ɔ he wami; nyɛɛ ye bua ni nɛmɛ nɛ gbɔjɔ ɔ, nɛ nyɛɛ to nyɛ tsui si ha nɔ tsuaa nɔ. 15Nyɛɛ hyɛ nɛ nyɛ ti nɔ ko kó pee yayami kɛ to yayami nane mi. Se mohu daa nɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ bɔ mɔde kaa nyɛ maa pee kpakpa ha nyɛ sibi, kɛ nihi tsuo.
16Nyɛ na bua jɔmi daa; 17nyɛɛ sɔle be tsuaa be; 18nyɛɛ na Mawu si ngɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ he. Nyɛ nihi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ Kristo Yesu mi ɔ, enɛ ɔ ji nɔ́ nɛ Mawu suɔ kaa nyɛɛ pee.
19Nyɛ ko gbe Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ. 20Nyɛ kó ha gbali ɔmɛ a sɛ gbi nɛ pee nyɛ tai. 21Nyɛɛ ka nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ hyɛ. Nɔ́ nɛ hi ɔ, nyɛɛ pɛtɛ he nɛ wa; 22se nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ ji yayami ɔ lɛɛ nyɛɛ hɛ nyɛ kɛ je he.
23Mawu, nɔ nɛ haa wɔ he jɔmi ɔ, lɛ nitsɛ nɛ tsukɔ nyɛ he kulaa kɛ pi si. E hyɛ nyɛ mumi, nyɛ klaa, kɛ nyɛ nɔmlɔ tso ɔ kulaa nɔ nɛ piami ko kó hi he be mi nɛ wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo maa ba a. 24Nɔ nɛ tsɛ nyɛ ɔ, anɔkualetsɛ ji lɛ; nɛ e maa pee hulɔ.
25Ye nyɛmimɛ nɛ i suɔ, nyɛɛ sɔle ha wɔ.
26Nyɛ nga nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ha wɔ kɛ suɔmi nɛ mi wa.
27I ngɛ nyɛ fae ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ biɛ mi kaa nyɛɛ kane womi nɛ ɔ ha nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ tsuo.
28Wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo dloomi ɔ kɛ nyɛ nɛ hi si.

Title: TESALONIKA BI II, NYA TSƆƆMI
Content:
NYA TSƆƆMI
Basabasa ba te si ngɛ Tesalonika asafo ɔ mi ngɛ Kristo bami enyɔne ɔ nɛ nihi ya nui sisi ɔ he. Ni komɛ he ye kaa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ba si enyɔne ɔ momo. Enɛ ɔ he ɔ, Paulo ngma womi nɛ ɔ kɛ tsɔɔ kaa nɔ́ nɛ a ngɛ dee ɔ be mi. E tsɔɔ nya kaa loko Kristo maa kpale kɛ ba ekohu ɔ, yayami, kɛ yi wu tso ní peemi maa ya nɔ wawɛɛ nitsɛ. Nɔ́ nɛ maa nyɛɛ nihi a hɛ mi kɛ tsu ní nɛ ɔ ji “Dikalɔ ɔ”; nɛ e maa te si kɛ wo Kristo.
Nɔ́ ko nɛ bɔfo Paulo ti mi ha Tesalonika asafo bi ɔmɛ ji e ngɛ mi kaa a ngɛ mɛ yi mi wae, nɛ a ngɛ nɔ́ nae mohu, se e hia kaa a hɛɛ a hemi kɛ yemi ɔ mi wawɛɛ. A kɛ a nine nguɛ nyɔngma nɛ tsu ní nɛ a ye kaa bɔ nɛ lɛ Paulo ɔ hu e kɛ e huɛmɛ nɛ e kɛ mɛ tsuɔ ní ɔ peeɔ ɔ. Nɛ́ nɔ́ kpakpa peemi ko gbe a nya.
Bɔ nɛ a dla womi ɔ mi ha
Sisije 1.1-2
Yi jemi kɛ he wami womi 1.3-12
Tsɔɔmi nɛ kɔɔ Kristo bami ɔ he 2.1-17
Kristo se nyɛɛli a je mi babɛ 3.1-15
Nyagbe 3.16-18

Title: TESALONIKA BI II, 1
Content:
1 Paulo, Sila, kɛ Timoteo ngma womi nɛ ɔ ya ha Tesalonika asafo ɔ, nɛ a kɛ wa Tsɛ Mawu, kɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo pee kake ɔ.
2Dloomi kɛ he jɔmi nɛ je Tsɛ Mawu ɔ, kɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo ɔ dɛ mi ɔ ha nyɛ!
A maa gbla nihi a tue
3Wa nyɛmimɛ! E hia kaa waa na Mawu si daa ha nyɛ. E sa kaa waa pee jã, ejakaa nyɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ mi ngɛ wae wawɛɛ nitsɛ, nɛ suɔmi nɛ nyɛ ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ ngɛ kɛ ha e nyɛmi ɔ ngɛ nɔ yae bɔ nɛ sa. 4Wɔ nitsɛmɛ wa fĩaa fɔɔ nyɛ nɔ ngɛ Mawu asafo ɔmɛ a mi kaa nyɛ ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi nɛ mi wa. Ejakaa be mi nɛ a ngɛ nyɛ yi mi wae, nɛ nyɛ ngɛ nɔ́ nae ɔ, nyɛ to nyɛ tsui si, nɛ nyɛ mia nyɛ hɛ mi kɛ ngɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a mi gblee.
5Enɛ ɔ tsɔɔ paa kaa Mawu yeɔ dami sane; e ngɔ nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ nae nɛ ɔ kɛ ngɛ nyɛ dlae kɛ ha e matsɛ yemi ɔ. 6Niinɛ, Mawu maa ye dami sane; nihi nɛ ngɛ nyɛ yi mi wae ɔ, Mawu maa hao mɛ ngɔ to nane mi. 7Nɛ nyɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ nɔ́ nae ɔ, e ma ha waa kɛ nyɛ tsuo he jɔmi. E maa pee enɛ ɔ, be mi nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu maa hia kpo kɛ je hiɔwe kɛ e bɔfo katsɛmɛ ɔmɛ, 8kɛ la nɛ ngɛ tsoe plamplam. Nihi nɛ li Mawu, kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ bui Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu sane kpakpa a, e kɛ mɛ maa to ní. 9 A maa gbla a tue, nɛ a hɛ mi ma kpata pɛsɛpɛsɛ kɛ maa ya neneene. A ma je mɛ kɛ je Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ hɛ mi. A be Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ hɛ mi nyami ɔ, kɛ e he wami ɔ nae 10ligbi ɔ nɛ e maa ba nɛ e ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ ma je e yi, nɛ nihi nɛ heɔ lɛ yeɔ maa wo e hɛ mi nyami ɔ. Nɛ nyɛ hu nyɛ maa piɛ a he, ejakaa sɛ gbi ɔ nɛ wa ngɔ ba ha nyɛ ɔ, nyɛ he ye.
11Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, daa nɛ ɔ, wa kpaa Mawu pɛɛ ha nyɛ, konɛ nyɛ je mi bami nɛ sa nɔ́ nɛ he nɛ e tsɛ nyɛ ngɛ ɔ. Kɛkɛ ɔ, e maa wo nyɛ hemi kɛ yemi mi he wami, nɛ ní kpakpahi nɛ nyɛ to kaa nyɛ maa pee ɔ, nyɛ maa pee. 12Kɛkɛ ɔ, nyɛ ní peepee he ɔ, nɔ tsuaa nɔ ma je Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu yi. Nɛ e he ɔ, nyɛ hu nyɛ hɛ mi maa ba nyami ngɛ wa Tsɛ Mawu, kɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo dloomi ɔ nya.

Title: TESALONIKA BI II, 2
Content:
Dikalɔ ɔ
1 Jehanɛ, nɔ́ nɛ kɔɔ wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo bami ɔ, kɛ bɔ nɛ a ma bua wa nya nɛ waa kɛ lɛ ya kpe ɔ he ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. Wa kpa nyɛ pɛɛ, nyɛmimɛ, 2ke nyɛ nu kaa mumi mi sɛ gbi ko je kpo, aloo munyu ko ngɛ pɛe, aloo kaa a ngɛ dee ke womi ko je wa ngɔ kaa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ligbi ɔ ba momo ɔ, nyɛ juɛmi mi ko pee nyɛ enyɔɔnyɔ, nɛ nyɛ ko hao hulɔ. 3Nyɛ ko ha nɛ nɔ ko nɛ sisi nyɛ ngɛ blɔ ko blɔ ko nɔ. Ja nyagbe atuã tsɔmi ɔ ba kekle loko ligbi ɔ maa ba. Dikalɔ ɔ nɛ hɛ mi ma kpata a maa je kpo. 4 E maa te si ngɔ wo nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ a tsɛɛ mawu, loo nɔ́ ko nɛ a jaa a, nɛ e ma wo e he nɔ ngɛ mɛ tsuo a nɔ. E ma ya hi Mawu sɔlemi we ɔ mi tete po, nɛ e ma de ke lɛ ji Mawu.
5Anɛ nyɛ kaii we kaa benɛ i kɛ nyɛ ngɛ ɔ, i de nyɛ kikɛmɛ a ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo lo? 6Se nyɛ le nɔ́ nɛ tsi e nya nɛ e ba je we e he kpo lolo ɔ? Ke be ɔ su ɔ, dikalɔ ɔ ma ba hia kpo kɛ̃. 7Yi wu tso ní nɛ a tsuɔ ngɛ laami mi ɔ, a je sisi momo. Se nɔ́ nɛ maa ba a be bae, ja a je nɔ nɛ ngɛ lɛ blɔ tsie ɔ ngɛ blɔ ɔ mi lolo. 8 Kɛkɛ ɔ, a ma je dikalɔ ɔ kpo paa. Se ke Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu ba a, e kɛ mumi nɛ maa je e nya mi ɔ maa gbe lɛ, nɛ e hɛ mi kpɛmi ɔ ma kpata dikalɔ ɔ hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ. 9 Dikalɔ ɔ maa ba kɛ Abosiami he wami, nɛ e ma ba pee lakpa nyakpɛ ní, kɛ okadi slɔɔtohi. 10E maa gu yi wu tso ga blɔ nɔ kɛ sisi nihi nɛ a hɛ mi ma kpata a. Ee, a hɛ mi ma kpata, ejakaa a sume nɛ a ngɔ anɔkuale ɔ, konɛ a he a yi wami. 11Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Mawu ma tsaka a juɛmi, nɛ a ma he lakpa munyu maa ye. 12Kɛkɛ ɔ, nihi tsuo nɛ he we anɔkuale ɔ yi, se yayami mohu he a bua jɔɔ ɔ, a maa bu mɛ fɔ.
A hla nyɛ, konɛ a he nyɛ yi wami
13Se nyɛmimɛ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ suɔ, e hia kaa waa na Mawu si daa ha nyɛ. Ejakaa kɛ je sisije lokoo ɔ, Mawu hla nyɛ, nɛ e he nyɛ yi wami kɛ gu mumi ɔ nɛ maa tsu nyɛ he ɔ, kɛ anɔkuale ɔ nɛ nyɛ he ye ɔ nɔ. 14Mawu tsɛ nyɛ kɛ gu sane kpakpa a nɛ wa fiɛ ha nyɛ ɔ nɔ, konɛ wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu hɛ mi nyami ɔ, nyɛ hu nyɛ na nyɛ blɔ fa mi nɔ́. 15Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛmimɛ, nyɛɛ da si kpɛii! Anɔkuale ɔ nɛ wa tsɔɔ nyɛ ɔ, níhi nɛ wa de nyɛ, kɛ ní nɛmɛ nɛ wa ngma nyɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ pɛtɛ he wawɛɛ.
16Wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo nitsɛ, kɛ wa Tsɛ Mawu, nɔ nɛ suɔ wɔ kikɛ nɛ ɔ, nɛ e gu e dloomi ɔ nɔ, nɛ e wo wɔ he wami, nɛ e ha wɔ hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi nɛ nya wa a, 17e wo nyɛ bua, nɛ e ha nyɛ he wami nɛ nyɛ tsu ní kpakpa, nɛ nyɛɛ tu munyu kpakpa daa.

Title: TESALONIKA BI II, 3
Content:
Nyɛɛ sɔle ha wɔ
1Nyagbe ɔ, nyɛmimɛ, nyɛɛ sɔle ha wɔ, konɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ munyu ɔ nɛ ya nɔ nɛ e gbɛ fĩa, nɛ a he lɛ kɛ manye ngɛ he tsuaa he kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ hu nyɛ pee ɔ. 2Nyɛɛ sɔle, konɛ Mawu nɛ je wɔ kɛ je yiwutsotsɛmɛ, kɛ nimli yayamihi a dɛ mi; ejakaa pi nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ heɔ yeɔ.
3Se Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ yeɔ anɔkuale. E maa wo nyɛ he wami, nɛ e maa bu nyɛ he, nɛ dikalɔ ɔ be nyɛe maa pee nyɛ nɔ́ ko. 4Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ha wa he nyɛ ye saminya. Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, wa ngɛ nɔ mi mami kaa nɔ́ nɛ wa de ke nyɛɛ pee ɔ, nyɛ ngɛ pee, nɛ nyɛ maa ya nɔ maa pee.
5Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nɛ ha nɛ nyɛɛ nu Mawu suɔmi ɔ, kɛ Kristo tsui si tomi ɔ sisi saminya.
E hia kaa a tsu ní
6Nyɛmimɛ, wa ngɛ nyɛ fae ngɛ wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu biɛ mi ke nyɛɛ kɛ nihi nɛ tsu we ní, kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ bɛ a je mi saminya kaa bɔ nɛ wa tsɔɔ mɛ ɔ kó bɔ. 7Nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ le veveeve kaa e hia kaa nyɛɛ kase wɔ. Benɛ waa kɛ nyɛ ngɛ ɔ, wa pee we hejɔ. 8Wa yi nɔ ko ní yaka nɛ́ wa wui he hiɔ; mohu ɔ, wa tsu ní kɛ pɔtɔ. Wa tsu ní nyɔ kɛ pia, konɛ wa ko pee tlomi ha nyɛ ti nɔ ko. 9Wa pee enɛ ɔ, pi kaa wa be jamɛ a blɔ nya a, se mohu, konɛ waa ngɔ wa he ngɔ pee nɔ hyɛmi nɔ́ ha nyɛ nɛ nyɛɛ kase wɔ. 10Benɛ waa kɛ nyɛ ngɛ ɔ, wa wo nyɛ mlaa nɛ ɔ ke, “Ke nɔ ko sume kaa e ma tsu ní ɔ, e ko ye ní.”
11Wa ngɛ enɛ ɔ dee, ejakaa wa nu kaa ni komɛ ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti nɛ peeɔ hejɔ; a tsu we ní, se mohu a ngɔɔ a nya ngɔ woɔ nihi a sanehi a mi. 12Wa ngɛ kikɛmɛ a nimli nɛ ɔmɛ mlaa woe, nɛ wa ngɛ mɛ kɔkɔ bɔe ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo biɛ mi kaa a ba a je mi saminya, nɛ a kɛ a nine nguɛ nyɔngma nɛ tsu ní nɛ a ye.
13Nyɛmimɛ, nyɛ ko ha pɔ nɛ tɔ nyɛ kɛ nɔ́ kpakpa peemi. 14Ke nɔ ko sume kaa e maa ye nɔ́ nɛ wa ngma nyɛ nɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ, nyɛ kadi lɛ, nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ lɛ ko bɔ. Kɛkɛ ɔ, zo maa gbe lɛ. 15Nyɛ ko bu lɛ he nyɛlɔ, se mohu nyɛɛ tu munyu ngɔ tsɔɔ lɛ kaa nyɛmi.
Nyagbe munyuhi
16Nyɔmtsɛ, nɔ nɛ haa wɔ he jɔmi ɔ, lɛ nitsɛ nɛ ha nyɛ he jɔmi daa ngɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ pee mi. Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ kɛ nyɛ tsuo nɛ hi si.
17Imi Paulo nitsɛ, ye nine nya womi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. Womi tsuaa womi nɛ ma ngma a, bɔ nɛ i gbeɔ nya ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. Kikɛ nɛ ɔ i ngmaa womi. I biɔ nyɛ saminya.
18Wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo dloomi ɔ kɛ nyɛ kulaa nɛ hi si.

Title: TIMOTEO I, NYA TSƆƆMI
Content:
NYA TSƆƆMI
Paulo ngma womi nɛ ɔ ya ha niheyo Kristo se nyɛɛlɔ ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Timoteo. E je Asia Mainɔ; e nyɛ ɔ Yuda no, se e tsɛ lɛɛ Hela no ji lɛ. Timoteo ba piɛ Paulo he kɛ tsu ní, nɛ e nyɛɛ e se kɛ kpa si kɛ fiɛ Mawu munyu ɔ. Paulo Kekleekle Womi nɛ e ngma ya ha Timoteo ɔ tuɔ nɔ́ etɛ pɔtɛɛ komɛ a he munyu.
Kekleekle nɔ́ ji, lakpa tsɔɔmi ba te si ngɛ asafo ɔ mi; nɛ e hia kaa Pualo nɛ ngma womi nɛ ɔ ya ha Timoteo nɛ e kɛ tsɛ e juɛmi se ngɛ he. Yuda bi, kɛ ni kpa komɛ nɛ pi Yuda bi ji mɛ a juɛmi nya a, a heɔ yeɔ kaa yayami hyi je ɔ mi tsuo. Nɛ loko a ma he nɔ ko yi wami ɔ, e hia kaa nɔ ɔ kó ye ní komɛ, nɛ e kó ngɔ yo hulɔ. Enyɔne ɔ, womi nɛ ɔ tsɔɔ bɔ nɛ sa kaa a to blɔ nya kɛ ha Mawu jami, asafo nɔ hyɛmi, kɛ jehanɛ, bɔ nɛ sa nɛ asafo nya dali, kɛ nihi nɛ yeɔ buaa mɛ ɔ nɛ ba a je mi ha. Nyagbe ɔ, ga nɛ Paulo ngɛ Timoteo woe ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ mi ji bɔ nɛ e ba e je mi ha kaa Yesu Kristo sɔmɔlɔ kpakpa, nɛ kuu slɔɔtohi nɛ ngɛ asafo ɔ mi ɔ, e hyɛ a nɔ bɔ nɛ sa.
Bɔ nɛ a dla womi ɔ mi ha
Sisije 1.1-2
Ga womi nɛ kɔɔ asafo ɔ, kɛ e nɔ hyɛli a he 1.3—3.16
Ga womi nɛ kɔɔ Timoteo ní tsumi he 4.1—6.21

Title: TIMOTEO I, 1
Content:
1Imi Paulo nɛ ba pee Kristo Yesu bɔfo ngɛ Mawu, wa kpɔlɔ ɔ, kɛ Kristo Yesu, nɔ nɛ wa ngɔ wa hɛ kɛ fɔ e nɔ ɔ fami nya a, 2 i ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ ngmae kɛ ha mo Timoteo, ye bi nitsɛnitsɛ ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ mi.
Dloomi, mɔbɔ nami, kɛ he jɔmi nɛ je Tsɛ Mawu ɔ, kɛ Kristo Yesu, wa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ dɛ mi ɔ ha mo!
Tsɔɔli nɛ ngɛ tsɔɔmi yaya tsɔɔe ɔ, bɔɔ mɛ kɔkɔ
3O ma kai kaa benɛ i je Efeso kɛ yaa Makedonia a, i wo mo ga kaa o hi si ngɛ Efeso. Ni komɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ nɛ a ngɛ lakpa tsɔɔmi tsɔɔe. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ma suɔ nɛ o hi Efeso, nɛ o bɔ mɛ kɔkɔ nɛ a kpa. 4De jamɛ a lakpa tsɔɔli ɔmɛ ke, sanehi nɛ be mi, kɛ weku kpa tslalaa se dimi ɔ, a jɔɔ be puɛmi ngɛ he. Ní nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, nya sami nɛ se nami be he nɛ a kɛ baa; blɔ nya nɛ Mawu to kɛ ha wɔ ɔ lɛɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ kɔ we he kulaa; hemi kɛ yemi kɛkɛ a kɛ leɔ. 5Nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ mo fae ke o pee nɛ ɔ ma ha nɛ waa suɔ wa sibi kɛ tsui nɛ mi tsɔ; wa he nile be wɔ fɔ bue, nɛ wa ma he Kristo maa ye anɔkuale mi. 6Nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ mo dee nɛ ɔ, ni komɛ ngmɛɛ he, nɛ nya sami nɛ he be se nami ha nɛ a tla blɔ. 7A hlaa kaa a maa pee a he Mawu mlaa tsɔɔli, se mɛ nitsɛmɛ a nya mi munyu, aloo níhi a he munyu nɛ a ngɛ tue kɛ kã a, mɛ nitsɛmɛ a nui sisi.
8Mose mlaa a, wɔ tsuo wa le kaa e hi; se e sa kaa a ye nɔ bɔ nɛ sa. 9E sa kaa wa kai kaa mlaa he hia we nimli kpakpahi. Ni nɛmɛ nɛ a woɔ mlaa ha ji mlaa tɔli, awi yeli, nihi nɛ li Mawu, yayami peeli, nihi nɛ Mawu mumi be a mi, nihi nɛ gbee mɛ nitsɛmɛ a tsɛmɛ kɛ a nyɛmɛ, kɛ muɔ si pueli kpahi. 10Ni kpahi hu nɛ a woɔ mlaa ha mɛ ji nihi nɛ fiɛɔ yo kɛ nyumu yakayaka fiɛmi, nyumuhi nɛ kɛ nyumuhi hwɔɔ, nɔmlɔ juli, nihi nɛ ngɔɔ nya, nihi nɛ kaa kita kɛ yeɔ lakpa odase, kɛ nihi tsuo nɛ peeɔ níhi nɛ kɛ tsɔɔmi kpakpa a yɛ́. 11A naa tsɔɔmi kpakpa nɛ ɔ ngɛ sɛ gbi nɛ haa nɔ hɛ mi baa nyami ɔ mi. Mawu lɛ ngɔ sɛ gbi nɛ ɔ ngɔ ha mi ke ma fiɛ. E sa kaa nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ je Mawu yi.
Paulo na Mawu si kaa e na lɛ mɔbɔ
12I naa wa Nyɔmtsɛ Kristo Yesu si kaa e ha mi he wami nɛ ma kɛ tsu ní. I naa lɛ si kaa e sa e hɛ mi kaa e hla mi nɛ ma ba sɔmɔ lɛ. 13 E ngɛ mi kaa sa a, i tu musu bɔmi munyuhi kɛ si Mawu; i wa lɛ yi mi, nɛ i pee níhi basabasa. Se Mawu na mi mɔbɔ, ejakaa jamɛ a be ɔ, i he we yi lolo; nɛ nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ pee ɔ hu i li. 14Se wa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ dloomi babauu ɔ nya a, suɔmi, kɛ hemi kɛ yemi nɛ Mawu haa nihi tsuo nɛ ngɛ Kristo Yesu mi ɔ, imi hu i ná. 15Kristo Yesu ba je ɔ mi, konɛ e ba he yayami peeli a yi wami. Anɔkuale munyu nitsɛnitsɛ nɛ sa kaa nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ he ye ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. Imi nitsɛ ɔ, yayami peelɔ kpanaku ji mi pe nihi tsuo. 16Se Mawu na mi mɔbɔ. E pee enɛ ɔ, konɛ Kristo Yesu nɛ ngɔ mi ngɔ pee nɔ hyɛmi nɔ́ kɛ ha yayami peeli tsuo, kaa e toɔ e tsui si, nɛ e peeɔ kpakpa, konɛ ni kpahi hu nɛ a na kaa neneene wami ɔ, mɛ hu a nine maa su nɔ. 17Mawu kake too, Neneene Matsɛ, nɔ nɛ ngɛ daa nɛ a nɛ lɛ ɔ, a je e yi, nɛ a wo e hɛ mi nyami kɛ ya neneene! Amen.
18Ye bi Timoteo, munyuhi nɛ gbali ɔmɛ tu blema ngɛ o he ɔ, lɔ ɔmɛ imi hu i ngɛ mo fae ke o pee. Ha munyu nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a pee kaa ta hwumi níhi ngɛ o dɛ nɛ o kɛ tsu ní saminya. 19O hemi kɛ yemi mi nɛ wa, nɛ o he nile nɛ hi hɛ ngmengmle. Ni komɛ ya bui a he nile tue, nɛ a hemi kɛ yemi ɔ ta. 20A ti ni komɛ ji Himeneo, kɛ Aleksandro. I tu mɛ ngɔ wo Abosiami dɛ mi, konɛ a gbla a tue. Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ma ha nɛ a ma kpa musu bɔmi munyu tumi.

Title: TIMOTEO I, 2
Content:
Mawu jami he blɔ nya tomi
1Kekleekle nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ hlae nɛ nyɛɛ pee ji kaa daa ligbi ɔ, nyɛ kpa Mawu pɛɛ, nɛ nyɛɛ sɔle, nɛ nyɛɛ da mi ha nihi, konɛ nyɛɛ na lɛ si ha nihi tsuo. 2Nyɛɛ sɔle ha matsɛmɛ, kɛ nihi tsuo nɛ hɛɛ blɔ nya, konɛ wɔ nɛ wa ji Kristo we bi ɔ, waa pee wa he kpoo, nɛ waa hi si ngɛ tue mi jɔmi mi. Waa ye Mawu gbeye saminya, nɛ waa ba wa je mi bɔ nɛ sa. 3Sɔlemi kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ hi, nɛ e saa Mawu, wa kpɔlɔ ɔ hɛ mi. 4Ejakaa Mawu suɔ kaa nimli tsuo nɛ le anɔkuale ɔ, konɛ a he a yi wami. 5Mawu kake kɛkɛ lɛ ngɛ, kɛ nɔ kake nɛ dlaa Mawu kɛ adesa a kpɛti. Jamɛ a nɔ ɔ ji Kristo Yesu. 6Kristo ngɔ e he kɛ sã bɔ ngɛ be nɛ sa mi, konɛ nimli tsuo nɛ a ye a he kɛ je yayami mi. 7 Enɛ ɔ he hu nɛ Mawu tsɔ mi kaa bɔfo, konɛ ma fiɛ sane kpakpa a ha ma je li ɔmɛ, nɛ ma tsɔɔ mɛ bɔ nɛ a he Kristo nɛ a ye anɔkuale mi. Nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ dee nɛ ɔ, anɔkuale sisiisi; i yi lakpa.
8He tsuaa he nɛ asafo ɔ ma bua a he nya ngɛ kɛ ja Mawu ɔ, nyumuhi nɛ a sɔle. E hia kaa a pee Kristo se nyɛɛli nɛ ngɔ a he kɛ ha Mawu kulaa. Ke a ngɛ sɔlee ɔ, a wo a nine nɔ, nɛ mi mi la kó hi mi; nɛ a ko hla kaa a maa sã nya ngɛ nɔ́ ko he. 9Jã kɛ̃ i suɔ kaa yihi hu nɛ a ngɔ juɛmi kɛ to a he dlami he. A dla a he bɔ nɛ sa kɛkɛ kaa humi. A gbɔ a yi ngɛ hɛngmɛ nɔ. A ko ngɔ sika tsu, loo adiagba kɛ hɔɔ a yi mi; nɛ a ko wo tade nɛ he jua wa tsɔ hulɔ. 10Se mohu a tsu ní tsumi kpakpa nɛ sa yihi nɛ ngɔ a he kɛ ha Mawu kulaa a. 11E sa kaa yo nɛ ba e he si, nɛ e pee kpoo kɛ kase ní. 12I ngmɛ́ blɔ kaa yo nɛ tsɔɔ ní, loo e ye nyumu nɔ; e pee dii. 13Ejakaa Adam nɛ a bɔ kekle loko a bɔ Hawa. 14Jehanɛ hu, pi Adam nɛ a sisi; yo ɔ mohu nɛ a sisi, nɛ e tɔ Mawu mlaa a. 15Se ke yo ɔ kɛ hɛdɔ he Mawu ye, nɛ e suɔ nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ, nɛ e pee e he klɔuklɔu kɛ humi ɔ, Mawu ma he e yi wami kɛ gu bimɛ nɛ e ma fɔ ɔ a nɔ.

Title: TIMOTEO I, 3
Content:
Subai nɛ sa Mawu we asafo nɔ hyɛli
1Anɔkuale sane ji kaa ke nɔ ko suɔ kaa e maa hyɛ Mawu asafo nɔ ɔ, e na ní tsumi kpakpa. 2Asafo nya dalɔ ɔ, sé kó hi e he. É hi yo kake; é le e he nɔ hyɛmi; e hɛ mi nɛ ka si, nɛ bu nɛ hi e he. É le nubwɔ peemi, nɛ e nyɛ nɛ e tsɔɔ ní hulɔ. 3E ko pee e he dã delɔ; nɛ e ko pee nɔ nɛ hɛ mi jɔɛ, loo nɔ nɛ suɔ pɛ. E ko pee e he sika suɔlɔ. 4E pee nɔ ko nɛ le lɛ nitsɛ e we nɔ hyɛmi saminya, nɔ nɛ maa hyɛ nɛ e bimɛ maa ba a he si, nɛ a bu nɔ bɔ nɛ sa. 5Ejakaa ke nɔ ko nyɛ we nɛ e hyɛ lɛ nitsɛ e we nɔ ɔ, kɛ e maa pee kɛɛ nɛ e ma nyɛ hyɛ Mawu asafo ɔ nɔ. 6E ko pee nɔ ko nɛ tsake e tsui kɛ we. Ke pi ja a, e ma wo e he nɔ, nɛ Mawu maa gbla e tue kaa bɔ nɛ e pee Abosiami ɔ. 7 Asafo nɔ hyɛlɔ ɔ, é ba e je mi saminya, konɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ ja we Mawu tete po nɛ a hɛɛ e biɛ kpakpa mi. Ke pi ja a, e ma pue e hɛ mi si, kɛkɛ e sɛ Abosiami klama mi.
Asafo ɔ mi sɔmɔli kpahi
8Asafo ɔ mi sɔmɔli nɛ yeɔ bua a, e hia kaa a pee nihi nɛ tsuɔ ní kɛ hɛdɔ, pi nihi nɛ a nya ngɛ enyɔɔnyɔ. A ko nu wai tsɔ, nɛ a hɛ ko tsu ngɛ sika he hulɔ. 9Anɔkuale nɛ kɔɔ hemi kɛ yemi nɛ Mawu je tsɔɔ ɔ he ɔ, á hɛɛ mi bɔ nɛ a he nile be mɛ fɔ bue. 10A ka mɛ hu nɛ a hyɛ a subai kekle, nɛ ke sane ko be a he ɔ, a sɔmɔ. 11Sɔmɔli yi ɔmɛ hu ja nɔuu a pee nihi nɛ tsuɔ ní kɛ hɛdɔ, nɛ a ko ye sieku. A pee nihi nɛ a hɛ ka si, nɛ a yeɔ anɔkuale ngɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ mi. 12Asafo mi sɔmɔlɔ ɔ, é hi yo kake pɛ, nɛ e nyɛ nɛ e hyɛ e we, kɛ e bimɛ a nɔ saminya. 13Sɔmɔli nɛ ɔmɛ a ti ni nɛmɛ nɛ tsuɔ ní saminya a, a naa biɛ kpakpa. Nɛ hemi kɛ yemi nɛ a ngɛ ngɛ Kristo Yesu mi ɔ, a tuɔ he munyu kɛ kã.
Laami sane nguaa
14I ngɛ mo ní nɛ ɔmɛ ngmae, se e be kɛe nɛ ma ba o ngɔ. 15Se ke ye se ya kɛ ɔ, womi nɛ ɔ maa tsɔɔ mo bɔ nɛ sa nɛ wɔ Kristo we bi waa ba wa je mi ha. Mawu weku ɔ mi bi ji wɔ, nɛ wɔ ji Mawu hɛ kalɔ ɔ we asafo. Anɔkuale ɔ nɛ kɔɔ Mawu he ɔ, asafo ɔ nɔ nɛ a fia ngɔ fɔ, nɛ asafo ɔ nɛ faa he. 16Anɔkuale ɔ nɛ kɔɔ wa jami ɔ he ɔ ji laami sane nguaa; nɔ ko nɔ ko be nyɛe maa je he nɔ́.
Kristo ba je nɛ ɔ mi kaa nɔmlɔ adesa;
E ye nguɔ ngɛ mumi mi;
E je e he kpo ngɔ tsɔɔ Mawu bɔfohi.
A fiɛ lɛ ngɛ je ma amɛ a kpɛti;
A he lɛ ye ngɛ je ɔ mi tsuo.
A ngɔ lɛ kɛ ho hiɔwe ya ngɛ nyami mi.

Title: TIMOTEO I, 4
Content:
Lakpa tsɔɔmihi
1Mawu mumi ɔ deɔ paa ke, nyagbe ligbi ɔmɛ a mi ɔ, ni komɛ ma kua Kristo, nɔ nɛ a he ye ɔ, nɛ a ma ya nyɛɛ mumi yayamihi mohu a se; a maa bu lakpa munyuhi, kɛ tsɔɔmi yayamihi tue. 2A maa pee a he lakpatsɛmɛ, kɛ nɔ sisili nɛ a he nile gbo pɛsɛpɛsɛ. 3Kikɛmɛ a nɔ sisili nɛ ɔmɛ deɔ ke Kristo we bi be he blɔ kaa a sɛɛ gba si himi mi; kɛ jehanɛ hu, niye ní komɛ ngɛ nɛ e sɛ kaa a yeɔ. Se wɔ nɛ wa heɔ Kristo yeɔ saminya a, wa le anɔkuale ɔ kaa Mawu bɔ niye ní tsuo ha wɔ kaa waa ye faa, nɛ waa na lɛ si ngɛ he. 4Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ Mawu bɔ ɔ hi. Wa ko kua ekoeko; mohu ɔ, wa sɔ́le nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́, nɛ waa na Mawu si ngɛ he. 5Ejakaa Mawu munyu ɔ, kɛ si nɛ wa naa Mawu ɔ haa niye ní ɔ he tsɔɔ.
Kristo Yesu tsɔlɔ kpakpa
6Mawu munyu ɔ kasemi, kɛ Kristo hemi kɛ yemi nɛ mo nitsɛ o hɛɛ mi kpɛii ɔ ma ha mo mumi mi he wami. Ke o tsɔɔ nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ mɛ hu a le ɔ, lɛɛ Kristo Yesu tsɔlɔ kpakpa ji mo. 7Se yimowi a yakayaka nyaziahi nɛ se nami be he ɔ, koo di se. Bɔɔ Mawu jami he mɔde mohu. 8Nɔmlɔ tso ɔ he mi kami ɔ, se nami bɔɔ kɛkɛ lɛ ngɛ he, se mumi mi nɔ́ ɔ lɛɛ kaa bɔ nɛ a wo si ɔ, e he ngɛ se nami babauu ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi, kɛ nɔ́ nɛ maa ba a mi tete. 9Anɔkuale munyu nɛ sa kaa a pɛtɛ he kulaa, nɛ a he ye ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. 10Wa gboɔ dengme kɛ tsuɔ ní wawɛɛ, ejakaa wa ngɔ wa hɛ ngɔ fɔ Mawu hɛ kalɔ ɔ nɔ. Lɛ ji nihi tsuo a yi wami helɔ, titli ɔ, ni nɛmɛ nɛ heɔ yeɔ ɔ.
11Tsɔɔ nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ blɔ nya tomi nɛ ɔmɛ, nɛ o wo mɛ a he kita. 12Ko ha nɛ nɔ ko nɛ gbe o he guɛ kaa niheyo kɛkɛ ji mo. Se mohu bɔɔ mɔde nɛ o munyu tumi, o je mi bami, suɔmi nɛ o ngɛ, o hemi kɛ yemi, kɛ bɔ nɛ o he tsɔ ɔ nɛ pee nɔ hyɛmi nɔ́ ha ni nɛmɛ nɛ heɔ yeɔ ɔ. 13Yaa nɔ nɛ o hi ngmami ɔ kanee ha asafo ɔ; hii munyu ɔ fiɛe, nɛ o hi mɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsɔɔe kɛ yaa si be nɛ ma ba. 14Mumi mi níhi nɛ Mawu kɛ dloo mo kɛ gu gbali ɔmɛ a nɔ benɛ asafo nikɔtɔma amɛ ngɔ a nine kɛ pue o yi mi ɔ, yaa nɔ nɛ o tsu a he ní daa. 15Ngɔɔ o he wami tsuo kɛ tsu ní nɛ ɔmɛ be tsuaa be, konɛ nihi tsuo nɛ a na o mɔde bɔmi. 16Timoteo, hyɛ mo nitsɛ o he nɔ saminya; nɔ́ nɛ o ngɛ tsɔɔe ɔ hu hyɛ nɔ bɔ nɛ sa. Ejakaa ke o pee ja a, o ma he mo nitsɛ o yi wami, kɛ nihi nɛ buɔ mo tue ɔ hulɔ.

Title: TIMOTEO I, 5
Content:
Bɔ nɛ sa nɛ Timoteo kɛ nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a hi si
1Ko ka nyumu nɔkɔtɔma hɛ mi; se mohu tu munyu kɛ tsɔɔ lɛ kaa bɔ nɛ o kɛ o tsɛ maa tu munyu. Nihewi hu o kɛ mɛ nɛ hi si kaa bɔ nɛ o kɛ mo nitsɛ o nyɛminyumuhi maa hi si. 2Yi nikɔtɔma amɛ ɔ, o kɛ mɛ nɛ hi si kaa mo nitsɛ o nyɛmɛ, nɛ o kɛ yihewi ɔmɛ nɛ hi si kaa o nyɛmiyihi; se hyɛ nɛ yakayaka fiɛmi kó ba je mi.
3Yalɔyihi nɛ be nɔ ko ɔ, moo bu mɛ bɔ nɛ sa. 4Se ke yalɔyo ko ngɛ bimɛ, loo bibimɛ ɔ, bimɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ bibimɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a le kaa ngɛ Mawu jami blɔ nya tomi nya a, kekleekle nɔ́ nɛ sa nɛ a peeɔ ha a fɔli ji a hyɛ a nɔ. A pee enɛ ɔ kɛ to fɔli ɔmɛ nane mi, ejakaa enɛ ɔ saa Mawu hɛ mi. 5Yalɔyo nɛ lɛ nɔ kake too e ngɛ, nɛ e be nɔ ko nɛ maa hyɛ e nɔ ɔ, ngɔɔ e hɛ ngɔ fɔɔ Mawu nɔ. E sɔlee nyɔ kɛ pia kɛ kpaa Mawu pɛɛ nɛ e ye bua lɛ. 6Se yalɔyo nɛ fiɛɔ e yi nɔ ɔ, e hɛ ngɛ lɛɛ, se e gbo momo. 7Tsɔɔ yalɔyi ɔmɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ, konɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko kó tu a he munyu yaya. 8Kristo se nyɛɛlɔ nɛ hyɛ we e nyɛmimɛ a nɔ, titli ɔ, lɛ nitsɛ e we mi bimɛ ɔ, blɔɔ e ngmɛɛ e hemi kɛ yemi ɔ he. Afani nɔ nɛ he we Kristo yi ngɛ kikɛmɛ a nɔmlɔ nɛ ɔ he.
9A ko ngma yalɔyo ko biɛ, lɛɛ ja nɔ nɛ ye jeha nyingmi ekpa, nɛ e gba si kake pɛ. 10É pee yo nɛ he biɛ kaa e peeɔ kpakpa, yo nɛ nyɛ tsɔse bimɛ saminya, yo nɛ nyɛ hyɛ nibwɔhi nɛ ba to lɛ, yo nɛ sɔmɔ ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ kɛ he si bami, yo nɛ je nihi kɛ je haomi mi, nɛ ngɔ e be tsuo kɛ tsu ní kpakpahi.
11Se yalɔyi nɛ wɛ ɔ, koo ngma a biɛ, ejakaa ke gba ngɛ mɛ jloe ɔ, a maa ngmɛɛ Kristo he ma ya gba. 12Kɛkɛ ɔ, a yeɔ fɔ kaa si nɛ a wo Kristo ke a be gbae kulaa hu ɔ, a yi nɔ. 13Enɛ ɔ se hu a puɛɔ be kɛ hii nihi a we mi kpae. Nɔ́ nɛ pe enɛ ɔ po ji kaa a yeɔ sieku; a jeɔ si, nɛ a ngɔɔ a nya kɛ woɔ nihi a munyu mi; nɛ nɔ́ nɛ sɛ́ kaa a deɔ hu, a maa hi dee putɛputɛɛ. 14Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ma suɔ mohu kaa yalɔyihi nɛ wɛ lolo ɔ, a gba nɛ a fɔ bimɛ; nɛ a hyɛ a we nɔ saminya, konɛ wa he nyɛli ko na he blɔ ko kulaa kɛ tu munyu yaya kɛ si wɔ. 15I ngɛ enɛ ɔ dee, ejakaa yalɔyi komɛ kpale ya nyɛɛ Satan se momo. 16Se ke yo Kristo se nyɛɛlɔ ko ngɛ yalɔyihi nɛ peeɔ e weku li ɔ, e hyɛ a nɔ, nɛ e ko ngɔ tlomi ngɔ fɔ asafo ɔ nɔ. Yalɔyihi nɛ be nɔ ko nɛ maa hyɛ a nɔ ɔ, asafo ɔ nɛ bɔ a he mɔde.
17Asafo nikɔtɔmahi nɛ tsuɔ ní saminya, titli ni nɛmɛ nɛ fiɛɔ, nɛ a tsɔɔ ní hulɔ ɔ, a hyɛ nɛ a wo a hɛ mi nyami totoe enyɔ. 18 Ejakaa ngmami ɔ deɔ ke, “Na nɛ ngɛ blɛfo gblɛe ha mo ɔ, koo fi e nya.” Ngmami kpa hu deɔ ke, “Ní tsulɔ ɔ, e hiɔwo sa lɛ.” 19 Ke nɔ ko ba po asafo nɔkɔtɔma ko nya ha mo ɔ, koo nu, ja nihi enyɔ, loo etɛ ba ye odase kɛ si lɛ. 20Nihi nɛ peeɔ yayami ɔ, ka a hɛ mi ngɛ asafo ɔ tsuo hɛ mi, kɛkɛ ɔ, ni nɛmɛ nɛ piɛ ɔ maa ye gbeye.
21Ngɛ Mawu, kɛ Kristo Yesu, kɛ bɔfo klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ tsuo a hɛ mi ɔ, i ngɛ mo kita kae nɛ o ye mlaa nɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ. Ke o ngɛ nɔ́ ko pee ɔ, koo hyɛ nɔ hɛ mi. Jehanɛ hu, ko ha nɛ nɔ ko ní peepee nɛ sa o hɛ mi pe nɔ kpa nɔ́. 22Koo ye esɔ kaa o maa ngɔ o nine kɛ pue nɔ ko nɔ kɛ wo lɛ asafo nɔkɔtɔma nɛ e tsu ní ha Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ. Ke nɔ ko ngɛ yayami pee ɔ, ko ya piɛ e he. Pee o he klɔuklɔu.
23Akɛnɛ o muklii mi haoɔ mo, nɛ o pɔɔ hiɔ numi kpitikpiti he je ɔ, koo nu nyu sɔuu hu, se mohu nuu wai bɔɔ.
24Ni komɛ a yayami jeɔ kpo paa, nɛ a kɛ buu mɛ fɔ nɔuu, se ni komɛ lɛɛ pee se loko a nɔ́ jeɔ kpo. 25Jã kɛ̃ nɔ́ kpakpa hu jeɔ kpo paa nɛ a naa; nɛ níhi nɛ ji kpo paa hu, a nyɛ we nɛ a laa nɔ.

Title: TIMOTEO I, 6
Content:
1Sɔmɔli tsuo nɛ ngɛ nyɔguɛ yemi mi ɔ, ha nɛ a bu a nyɔmtsɛmɛ ɔmɛ, nɛ a sɔmɔ mɛ saminya, konɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko kó ná he blɔ nɛ e tu munyu yaya kɛ si Mawu, loo Kristo jami ɔ. 2Nyɔguɛhi nɛ le Kristo, nɛ a nyɔmtsɛmɛ ɔmɛ hu le Kristo ɔ, a ko susu kaa akɛnɛ mɛ tsuo Kristo we bi ji mɛ he je ɔ, e hia we kaa a buɔ a nyɔmtsɛmɛ ɔmɛ tue. Mɛ mohu nɛ e sa kaa a bu a nyɔmtsɛmɛ ɔmɛ, nɛ a sɔmɔ mɛ saminya; ejakaa a nyɔmtsɛmɛ ɔmɛ nɛ naa a he se ɔ, mɛ hu wa nyɛmimɛ Kristo we bi ji mɛ.
Lakpa tsɔɔmi kɛ sika suɔmi
Tsɔɔ mɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ, nɛ a tsu he ní bɔ nɛ sa. 3Ni komɛ ngɛ tsɔɔmi kpa komɛ tsɔɔe nɛ pi wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo sane kpakpa a nitsɛ, loo Mawu jami tsɔɔmi tutuutu. 4Kikɛmɛ a nimli nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, a he nɔ kɛkɛ nɛ a ngɛ woe; a li nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko fɛɛ. A suɔ nɛ a wo pɛ, nɛ a sã nya babauu ngɛ níhi a he. Enɛ ɔ haa nɛ a hɛ kɔɔ a sibi a nɔ; a nɔɔ kunɔ, nɛ a jɛɔ a he basabasa; yayami sɔuu a susuu ngɛ a sibi a he; 5nɛ a sãã nya be tsuaa be. A juɛmi be tutuutu, nɛ a li nɔ nɛ ji anɔkuale hu. E peeɔ mɛ kaa Mawu jami ji blɔ ko nɛ a guu nɔ kɛ naa ní kpɔtɔɔ.
6Se niinɛ, ní nami agbo ji Mawu jami, ke nɔ ko bua jɔ e níhi a he ɔ. 7Ejakaa waa kɛ nɔ́ ko bɛ je nɛ ɔ mi; nɛ e fɔɔ si paa kaa wa be nyɛe waa kɛ nɔ́ ko maa ya hulɔ. 8Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke wa ngɛ nya mi ngma, kɛ heha ní kɛkɛ ɔ, e hiɛ ha wɔ hluu. 9Nihi nɛ hlaa kaa a na ní ɔ, a sɛɛ ka mi. A ya dii kuasia níhi, kɛ akɔnɔ yayami se. Enɛ ɔ haa nɛ a hemi kɛ yemi taa, nɛ a hɛ mi kpataa. 10Ejakaa sika suɔmi ji yayamihi tsuo a sipoku. Ni komɛ kɛ hɛdɔ ya di sika se, nɛ a ngmɛɛ a hemi kɛ yemi ɔ he. Nɔ́ nɛ je mi kɛ ba kɛkɛ ji tsui yemi babauu.
Paulo wo Timoteo ga
11Se moo lɛɛ Mawu nɔmlɔ ji mo; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, bɔɔ ní nɛ ɔmɛ a he mɔde: dami sane yemi, Mawu suɔmi nya ní peemi, hemi kɛ yemi, suɔmi, tsui si tomi, kɛ he si bami. 12Hwuu hemi kɛ yemi ɔ he ta kpakpa a, konɛ o nine nɛ su neneene wami ɔ nɔ. Enɛ ɔ he nɛ Mawu tsɛ mo nɛ o ba ye Kristo he odase wawɛɛ ngɛ nihi babauu a hɛ mi ɔ nɛ. 13-14 I ngɛ mo fae ngɛ Mawu, kɛ Kristo Yesu hɛ mi kaa o ye mlaa nɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ veveeve kɛ yaa si ligbi ɔ nɛ wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo maa ba. Mawu lɛ haa nɔ tsuaa nɔ wami, nɛ Kristo Yesu ye Mawu he odase wawɛɛ ngɛ Pontio Pilato hɛ mi. Ke be ɔ su ɔ, Mawu ma ha Kristo Yesu maa ba. 15Mawu pɛ ji je ɔ tsuo nɔ yelɔ nɛ pe kulaa. Lɛ ji matsɛmɛ a matsɛ, kɛ nyɔmtsɛmɛ tsuo a nyɔmtsɛ. E ma je Kristo kpo kɛ tsɔɔ ngɛ lɛ nitsɛ e be nɛ e to nɛ sa a mi. 16Lɛ nɔ kake pɛ ji nɔ nɛ ngɛ daa nɛ e be gboe gblegbleegble; nɛ la nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be nyɛe maa hɛ lɛ kɛ su he ɔ bɔle lɛ kɛ kpe. Nɔmlɔ adesa ko adesa ko nɛ́ lɛ hyɛ, nɛ adesa ko be nyɛe maa na lɛ hulɔ. A je e yi daa; e maa ye tsɛ kɛ maa ya neneene! Amen.
17Niatsɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti ɔ, nyɛɛ a nɔ nɛ a ko wo a he nɔ. Á ko ngɔ a hɛ ngɔ fɔ ní nɛ a na a nɔ, ejakaa ní nami se maa po. Á ngɔ a hɛ ngɔ fɔ Mawu mohu nɔ. Lɛ nɛ e haa wɔ ní kpakpahi babauu nɛ wa yeɔ faa. 18A ko pee kpɛle, se a bɔle nine ha nɔ tsuaa nɔ. 19Ke a pee ja a, a maa to juetli kpakpa si ha a he kɛ ha hwɔɔ se; nɛ a nine maa su wami nɛ ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene ɔ nɔ.
20Timoteo, níhi nɛ a tu ngɔ wo o dɛ mi ɔ, baa yi saminya. Yakayaka ní sɛɛmi nɛ tsɔɔ we Mawu gbeye yemi, kɛ nya sami tslalaa nɛ juɛmi be mi ɔ, yu o he ngɛ he. Kikɛmɛ a ní nɛ ɔmɛ lɛ ni komɛ buu ke nile. 21Enɛ ɔmɛ nɛ ni komɛ susu kaa a nine su nɔ ɔ ha nɛ a hemi kɛ yemi ɔ bɔ mɛ.
Mawu dloomi ɔ kɛ nyɛ tsuo nɛ hi si!

Title: TIMOTEO II, NYA TSƆƆMI
Content:
NYA TSƆƆMI
Paulo ngma e womi enyɔne ɔ titli kaa slɔmi kɛ ha Timoteo, kaa e nyɛmi wayoo ní tsulɔ, kɛ e he piɛlɔ. Womi ɔ we oti ji tsui nami. Paulo wo Timoteo ga, nɛ e wo lɛ he wami kaa e ya nɔ nɛ e ye Yesu Kristo he odase saminya. E de lɛ ke, anɔkuale tsɔɔmi nɛ ngɛ sane kpakpa a, kɛ somi momo ɔ mi ɔ, e pɛtɛ he saminya, nɛ e tsu he ní bɔ nɛ sa kaa tsɔɔlɔ, kɛ Mawu munyu fiɛlɔ. Ní nɛ ɔmɛ a peemi mi ɔ, e maa na nɔ́, nɛ nihi maa te si kɛ wo lɛ.
Paulo slɔ Timoteo kaa e hyɛ saminya ngɛ yi mi flɛflɛ ní sɛɛmi, kɛ nya sami nɛ juɛmi be mi he. Ejakaa se nami be he, nɛ nihi nɛ buɔ ní nɛ ɔmɛ tue ɔ, a hɛ mi kpataa.
Ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a mi ɔ, Paulo ngɔ lɛ nitsɛ e wami, kɛ e yi mi tomi nɛ e hɛɛ ɔ kɛ ma Timoteo hɛ mi kaa nɔ hyɛmi nɔ́. Lɔ ɔmɛ ji e hemi kɛ yemi, tsui si tomi, suɔmi, tsui nami, kɛ nɔ́ nami, be mi nɛ a ngɛ lɛ yi mi wae.
Bɔ nɛ a dla womi ɔ mi ha
Sisije 1.1-2
Yi jemi kɛ slɔmi 1.3—2.13
Ga womi kɛ kɔkɔ bɔmi 2.14—4.5
Paulo nitsɛ he sane 4.6-18
Nyagbe 4.19-22

Title: TIMOTEO II, 1
Content:
1Imi Paulo nɛ Mawu suɔmi nya nɛ i ba pee Kristo Yesu bɔfo ngɛ wami nɛ ngɛ Kristo Yesu mi nɛ a wo he si ɔ he ɔ, 2 i ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ ngmae kɛ ha mo Timoteo, ye bi nɛ i suɔ mo saminya. Dloomi, mɔbɔ nami, kɛ he jɔmi nɛ je Tsɛ Mawu ɔ, kɛ Kristo Yesu, wa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ dɛ mi ɔ ha mo!
Paulo na Mawu si, nɛ e wo Timoteo he wami
3Mawu ɔ nɛ i ngɛ sɔmɔe kɛ ye tsui tsuo kaa bɔ nɛ ye nɛmɛ ɔmɛ pee ɔ, i naa lɛ si. Daa nyɔ kɛ pia ke i ngɛ sɔlee ɔ, i kaiɔ mo. 4Ke i kai o hɛ mi vo nyu ɔ, i hlaa wawɛɛ kaa ma na mo, konɛ ye bua nɛ jɔ. 5 I kaiɔ o hemi kɛ yemi nɛ o hɛɛ mi anɔkuale mi kaa bɔ nɛ o nã Loise, kɛ o nyɛ Eunike hu hɛɛ mi ɔ. I heɔ yeɔ kaa o hɛɛ hemi kɛ yemi nɛ ɔ mi kɛ mwɔɔ. 6Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, i ngɛ mo kaie kaa Mawu nike ní nɛ e kɛ dloo mo benɛ i ngɔ ye nine kɛ pue o nɔ ɔ, o tsu he ní saminya. 7Ejakaa mumi nɛ Mawu ha wɔ ɔ ha we nɛ wa yeɔ gbeye; mohu e ji mumi nɛ woɔ wɔ he wami, nɛ haa wa suɔ nɔmlɔ, nɛ wa yeɔ wa he nɔ.
8Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ko ha nɛ odase nɛ o maa ye ngɛ wa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ he ɔ nɛ pee mo zo. Imi hu nɛ a wo mi tsu ngɛ Kristo he ɔ, ye he ko pee mo zo. Mohu ɔ, bɔɔ mɔde nɛ o na nɔ́ ngɛ sane kpakpa a he kaa bɔ nɛ imi hu i ngɛ nae ɔ, nɛ Mawu ma ha mo he wami nɛ o kɛ tsu nɔ́ nɛ ɔ. 9Mawu he wa yi wami, nɛ e tsɛ wɔ, konɛ wa ba pee e nihi. Pi nɔ́ kpakpa ko nɛ wa pee he je, se mohu lɛ nitsɛ e yi mi tomi nya nɛ e dloo wɔ. Wa ná kikɛmɛ a dloomi nɛ ɔ kɛ gu Kristo Yesu nɔ blema lokoo loko a bɔ je ɔ. 10Jehanɛ lɛɛ, e jé e dloomi ɔ kpo paa ngɔ tsɔɔ wɔ kɛ gu wa yi wami helɔ Kristo Yesu bami nɔ. Kristo Yesu gu sane kpakpa a nɔ nɛ e ha gbenɔ se po; nɛ e ngɔ wami ba ha wɔ, konɛ wa ko gbo gblegbleegble. 11 Mawu pee mi bɔfo kɛ tsɔɔlɔ, konɛ ma fiɛ sane kpakpa a, 12nɛ lɔ ɔ he nɛ i ngɛ nɔ́ nae nɛ ɔ nɛ; se kɛ̃ ɔ, ye nine mi wui nyu; ejakaa nɔ nɛ i he ye ɔ, i le lɛ. I heɔ yeɔ kaa sane kpakpa a fiɛmi ɔ nɛ e tu ngɔ wo ye dɛ mi ɔ, e maa bu he kɛ yaa su nyagbe ligbi ɔ. 13Anɔkuale ɔ nɛ i tsɔɔ mo ɔ, pɛtɛ he kaa nɔhyɛ nɔ́, nɛ hemi kɛ yemi, kɛ suɔmi nɛ wa na kɛ gu Kristo Yesu mi ɔ, koo ngmɛɛ he. 14Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ nɛ ngɛ wa mi ɔ, é wo mo he wami, konɛ ní kpakpahi nɛ a tu ngɔ wo o dɛ mi ɔ, o bu he.
15Kaa bɔ nɛ o le ɔ, nihi nɛ ngɛ Asia a tsuo kpa ngɛ ye se; a ti ni komɛ ji Figelo kɛ Hermogene. 16Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nɛ na Onesiforo kɛ e we ɔ mɔbɔ; ejakaa ke e ngɛ mi hluu ɔ, e ba woɔ mi bua. Tsu nɛ a wo mi ɔ pee we lɛ zo. 17Benɛ e ná ba su Roma pɛ nɛ e bɔni mi hlami hluu kɛ ya si e ba na mi. 18Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nɛ na lɛ mɔbɔ jamɛ a ligbi ɔ. I heɔ yeɔ kaa bɔ nɛ e sɔmɔ mi saminya ngɛ Efeso ɔ, o hɛ ji nɔ.

Title: TIMOTEO II, 2
Content:
Kristo Yesu ta bulɔ kpakpa
1Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ye bi, nɛ Mawu dloo wɔ nɛ wa ngɛ Kristo Yesu mi ɔ, o he nɛ wa. 2Níhi nɛ o nu nɛ i ngɛ fiɛe ngɛ nihi babauu a hɛ mi ɔ, tsɔɔ nihi nɛ yeɔ anɔkuale ɔ lɔ ɔmɛ nɔuu, konɛ mɛ hu a tsɔɔ ni kpahi.
3Mia o hɛ mi kɛ na nɔ́ kaa Kristo Yesu ta bulɔ kpakpa. 4Ke ta bulɔ ngɛ ta hwue ɔ, e suɔ kaa e maa pee nɔ́ nɛ maa sa e tatsɛ ɔ hɛ mi be tsuaa be; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e peeɔ klaalo kɛ haa e tatsɛ ɔ pɛ; e kɛ e he wui ma mi sanehi a mi. 5Loko fo dalɔ ko nine maa su kunimi yemi jlasi nɔ ɔ, ja e ye fo dami he mlaa amɛ tsuo a nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ. 6Ngmɔ hulɔ nɛ gboɔ dengme kɛ tsuɔ ní ɔ, lɛ kekle e yeɔ ngmɔ niba ní ɔ eko. 7Susuu nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ mo dee nɛ ɔ he, nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nitsɛ ma ha nɛ o nu nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ sisi.
8Kai kaa Yesu Kristo, Matsɛ David nina nɛ Mawu tle lɛ si kɛ je gbeje ɔ he sane kpakpa a ji nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ fiɛe ɔ nɛ. 9Sane nɛ ɔ nɛ i ngɛ fiɛe ɔ he je nɛ i ngɛ nɔ́ nae; a wo mi kɔsɔkɔsɔ tete po kaa nɔ́ nɛ awi yelɔ ji mi. Se Mawu munyu ɔ fiɛmi lɛɛ nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko be nyɛe maa tsi nya. 10Enɛ ɔ he je nɛ i toɔ ye tsui si ngɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ mi, nɛ i naa nɔ́ ngɛ nihi nɛ Mawu hla a a he, konɛ kɛ gu Kristo Yesu nɔ ɔ, a he mɛ hu a yi wami, nɛ a nine nɛ su hɛ mi nyami nɛ ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene ɔ nɔ. 11Anɔkuale munyu ji nɛ ɔ nɛ:
“Ke waa kɛ lɛ gbo ɔ,
waa kɛ lɛ maa hi wami mi hulɔ.
12 Ke wa mia wa hɛ mi ngɛ nɔ́ nami mi ɔ,
waa kɛ lɛ maa ye matsɛ hulɔ.
Ke wa kua lɛ ɔ,
lɛ hu e ma kua wɔ.
13Ke wa yi anɔkuale ɔ,
lɛɛ anɔkuale pɛ e yeɔ daa,
ejakaa e be nyɛe maa ye lakpa
kɛ si lɛ nitsɛ e he.”
Ní tsulɔ kpakpa
14Kaii mɛ kikɛmɛ a ní nɛ ɔmɛ. Bɔɔ mɛ kɔkɔ ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ hɛ mi ke a ko pɛ ngɛ munyuhi a he, ejakaa nɔ́ kpakpa ko ji mi kɛ bɛ, se mohu jamɛ a munyu ɔmɛ gbeɔ e nuli ɔmɛ a hemi kɛ yemi. 15Bɔɔ mɔde wawɛɛ kaa ní tsulɔ kpakpa, konɛ Mawu nɛ ná o he bua jɔmi. E ko pee mo zo kulaa kaa o maa tsɔɔ anɔkuale munyu ɔ saminya. 16Se yakayaka ní sɛɛmi nɛ tsɔɔ we Mawu gbeye yemi ɔ, yu o he kɛ je he; ejakaa e haa nɛ nihi hɛɔ a he kɛ jeɔ Mawu he kulaa mohu. 17Bɔ nɛ pa yaya gbo we gblee, se e hiaa kɛ haa si mohu ɔ, ja lɛ jamɛ a ní sɛɛmi yaya amɛ a mi sanehi gbɛɛ fĩaa. Ni enyɔ komɛ nɛ tsɔɔ lakpa ní nɛ ɔmɛ ji Himeneo kɛ Fileto. 18A tla blɔ kɛ je anɔkuale ɔ he, nɛ a ngɛ dee ke be ɔ nɛ gbogboehi maa te si kɛ je gbeje ɔ be momo. A ngɔ munyu nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ ngɛ Kristo we bi babauu a hemi kɛ yemi hɛ mi kpatae. 19 Se tsu sisi tomi tɛ nɛ Mawu ngɔ kɛ ma si ha hemi kɛ yemi ɔ he wa, nɛ e be mimiɛe. Munyu nɛ a kɛ sɔu tɛ ɔ nya ji, “Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ le lɛ nitsɛ e nihi.” Ekpa hu deɔ ke, “Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ deɔ ke Mawu nɔ́ ji lɛ ɔ, é kpa yayami peemi.”
20Pi sika tsu níhi, kɛ sika hiɔ níhi kɛkɛ nɛ a naa ngɛ we ngua mi, se mohu nyu yɛmi níhi nɛ a gbɔ, kɛ ekomɛ hu nɛ a puɛ hii mi. A kɛ ekomɛ tsuɔ ní pɔtɛɛ komɛ nɛ a buu, nɛ ekpa komɛ lɛɛ a kɛ tsuɔ ní be saisaa. 21Ke nɔ ko tsu e he, nɛ e kpa yayami peemi ɔ, a maa ngɔ lɛ kɛ tsu ní ngɛ be titli ko nɛ a buu mi, ejakaa e tsu e he saminya, nɛ e plɛ pee nyu yɛmi nɔ́ pɔtɛɛ ha Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ. Kɛkɛ ɔ, a ma nyɛ maa ngɔ lɛ kɛ tsu ní tsumi kpakpa tsuaa ní tsumi kpakpa be tsuaa be. 22Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nihewi a we akɔnɔ yaya a, yu o he kɛ je he kulaa, nɛ o kɛ nihi nɛ yeɔ Kristo anɔkuale nɛ bɔ. Nyɛɛ ba nyɛ je mi saminya kaa Kristo we bi nɛ yeɔ dami sane, nɛ tsuɔ a hemi kɛ yemi he ní; nyɛɛ suɔ nyɛ sibi, nɛ nyɛɛ hi si saminya ngɛ he jɔmi mi. 23Kuasiahi a nɔ́ jemi nɛ a kase we nɔ́ kpakpa ko kɛ ji mi ɔ, tuu nya fo, ejakaa o le kaa nɔ́ jemi ɔ, kunɔ e kɛ baa. 24Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ sɔmɔlɔ ɔ, e sɛ́ kaa e pɛɔ, mohu ɔ, e mi nɛ jɔ ha nɔ tsuaa nɔ; e pee ní tsɔɔlɔ kpakpa nɛ toɔ e tsui si. 25Pi enɛ ɔ kɛkɛ, e sa kaa e pee nɔ nɛ kɛ mi mi jɔmi tuɔ munyu tsɔɔ nihi nɛ tee si kɛ siɔ lɛ ɔ. Alini Mawu maa na jamɛatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ mɔbɔ nɛ a tsake a tsui, konɛ a ba le anɔkuale ɔ. 26Kɛkɛ ɔ, a maa hɛli a he si, nɛ klama nɛ Abosiami tsɔ ha mɛ kaa a pee e suɔmi nya ní, nɛ a ya nɔ mi ɔ, a ya be mi nɔe.

Title: TIMOTEO II, 3
Content:
A bɔ Timoteo lakpa tsɔɔmi he kɔkɔ
1O hɛ nɛ hi nɔ kaa nyagbe ligbi ɔmɛ a mi ɔ, je mi maa wa. 2Nihi ma hla kaa a ma fo mɛ nitsɛmɛ pɛ a nɔ mi; a maa pee a he sika suɔli, fĩali, he woli, kɛ lilɛtsɛmɛ, nihi nɛ bui a fɔli, nihi nɛ li sina, kɛ nihi nɛ Mawu jami pi a he sane ko. 3Nihi maa pee a ní kaa nɔ́ nɛ pi adesahi kulaa ji mɛ, nihi nɛ mɔbɔ nami ko be a mi, nihi a biɛ puɛli, nihi nɛ peeɔ basabasa nɛ a li zo, awi yeli, kɛ nihi nɛ sume nɔ́ kpakpa. 4Nimli maa pee a he nɔ se blɔ tsɔɔli, nihi nɛ bui nɔ́, he nɔ woli, kɛ nihi nɛ suɔ je mi akɔnɔ pe bɔ nɛ a suɔ Mawu, 5nihi nɛ tsɛɔ a he Mawu jali, se anɔkuale mi ɔ, a bui e mi he wami ɔ kulaa. Nimli kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ, yu o he kɛ je a he. 6Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ a ti ni komɛ yaa nihi a we mi, nɛ a ya puɛɔ yihi juɛmi flɛflɛtsɛmɛ a yi mi. Yi nɛ ɔmɛ a he yayami plɛ tlomi ha mɛ nitsɛmɛ ngɛ akɔnɔ ní slɔɔtoslɔɔtohi nɛ ngɛ mɛ gblae ɔ a he. 7Daa nɛ ɔ, yi nɛ ɔmɛ bɔɔ mɔde kaa a maa kase ní, se anɔkuale ɔ lɛɛ a be lee gblegbleegble. 8 Kaa bɔ nɛ Yane kɛ Yambre te si kɛ wo Mose ɔ, ja nɔuu nɛ kikɛmɛ a nimli nɛ ɔmɛ hu te si kɛ ngɛ anɔkuale ɔ nya tsie. Kikɛmɛ a nimli nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a juɛmi mi kuɔ we ɔ, a hemi kɛ yemi hu gbo. 9Se a be he ko sue, ejakaa e be kɛe kulaa nɛ nihi maa na kaa kuasia kɛkɛ a ngɛ jee. Nɔ́ nɛ ba Yane kɛ Yambre a nɔ ɔ, lɔ ɔ nɔuu maa ba mɛ hu a nɔ.
Nyagbe slɔmi
10Se Timoteo, moo lɛɛ, ní nɛ i tsɔɔ, bɔ nɛ i baa ye je mi, oti nɛ i kɛ fɔ ye hɛ mi ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi, kɛ nɔ́ nɛ i heɔ yeɔ ɔ, o le. O le bɔ nɛ i toɔ ye tsui si, bɔ nɛ i suɔ nɔ, kɛ bɔ nɛ ye hɛ mi ka si. 11 O le bɔ nɛ a wa mi yi mi, kɛ bɔ nɛ i na nɔ́. O le níhi nɛ ba ye nɔ ngɛ Antiokia, Ikonium, kɛ Listra; o le bɔ nɛ a tua mi wawɛɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔmɛ; se Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ je mi kɛ je ní ɔmɛ tsuo a mi. 12Niinɛ, nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ hlaa kaa e pee e he Mawu jalɔ nɛ le Kristo Yesu ɔ, a maa wa lɛ yi mi. 13Nimli yayamihi, kɛ nɔ sisili maa ya nɔ maa pee yayami kɛ be nɔ; a maa sisi nihi hluu kɛ yaa si a maa sisi mɛ nitsɛmɛ a he. 14Se moo lɛɛ anɔkuale ɔ nɛ a tsɔɔ mo nɛ o he ye ɔ, yaa nɔ nɛ o pɛtɛ he. Nihi nɛ tsɔɔ mo ní ɔ, o le mɛ. 15O kai kaa kɛ je o jokuɛ mi tɔɔ o le ngmami klɔuklɔu ɔ. Ngmami klɔuklɔu ɔ ma ha nɛ o maa le ní, nɛ Kristo Yesu nɛ o heɔ yeɔ ɔ ma he o yi wami. 16Ngmami tsuaa ngmami ɔ, Mawu mumi ɔ lɛ ha nɛ nihi ngma; nɛ e hi kɛ ha ní tsɔɔmi, kɛ ha hɛ mi kami, kɛ ha nɔ dlami, kɛ tsɔsemi nɛ ma ha nɔ nɛ ba e je mi saminya. 17Kɛkɛ ɔ, Mawu tsɔlɔ ɔ maa hi kɛ pi si, nɛ e he maa su kɛ tsu nɔ́ kpakpa.

Title: TIMOTEO II, 4
Content:
1I ngɛ Mawu, kɛ Kristo Yesu odase tsɛe kɛ ngɛ mo ga woe. Kristo ma ba ye matsɛ; e ma ba kojo nihi nɛ a hɛ ngɛ, kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ gbo ɔ tsuo. 2Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, yaa nɔ nɛ o fiɛ sɛ gbi ɔ be tsuaa be nɛ o ko kpa. Ke o ngɛ munyu ɔ fiɛe ɔ, ná tsui kɛ tsɔɔ tue buli ɔmɛ nɔ́ nya konɛ a na nya saminya. Ka ni ɔmɛ a hɛ mi, nɛ o wo mɛ ga ngɛ be nɛ sa mi. 3Be ma nɛ nihi be suɔe kaa a maa bu tsɔɔmi kpakpa tue. Mohu ɔ, a ma hla ní tsɔɔli ha a he; a ma hla nihi nɛ maa tsɔɔ mɛ níhi nɛ maa ngɔ ngɛ a tue mi. 4A be suɔe kulaa kaa a maa nu anɔkuale ɔ; a ma hla kaa a maa bu nyazia mohu tue. 5Se moo lɛɛ, o hɛ nɛ ka si be tsuaa be. Ke o ngɛ nɔ́ nae ɔ, to o tsui si. Bɔɔ sane kpakpa a fiɛmi he mɔde wawɛɛ, konɛ o pee Mawu sɔmɔlɔ kpakpa.
6Imi lɛɛ a miɔ nɛ a ngɔ mi kɛ sã bɔ. Ee, be ɔ nɛ ma je je ɔ mi ɔ su. 7Ta kpakpa a, i hwu; i tu fo ɔ tsuo gbe nya. I pɛtɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ he. 8Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Mawu ngɔ ye hiɔwo nɛ ji jlasi nɛ e kɛ haa nihi tsuo nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a ngɔ to ha mi. Kojomi ligbi ɔ, Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo, nɔ nɛ yeɔ dami sane ɔ maa ngɔ ye jlasi ɔ ngɔ ha mi. Pi imi nɔ kake pɛ nɛ e ma ha, se mohu e ma ha nihi tsuo nɛ suɔ lɛ, nɛ a ngɛ e bami ɔ blɔ hyɛe ɔ.
Paulo nitsɛ he sane
9Bɔɔ mɔde nɛ o ba ye ngɔ ngɛ be kpiti mi; 10 ejakaa Dema lɛɛ e ya suɔ mwɔnɛmwɔnɛ je nɛ ɔ, nɛ e je ye he kɛ ho Tesalonika ya. Kreske ho Galatia ya, nɛ Tito hu ho Dalmatia ya. 11 Luka pɛ lɛ ngɛ ye ngɔ amlɔ nɛ ɔ. Hla Marko nɛ o kɛ lɛ nɛ ba, ejakaa e he hia saminya ngɛ sɔmɔmi ní tsumi ɔ he. 12 Tihiko lɛɛ i tsɔ lɛ Efeso. 13 I si ye tade klɔii ɔ kɛ ha Karpo ngɛ Troya; ke o ma a, ngɔɔ kɛ ba. Ngɔɔ womi ɔmɛ hu kɛ ba, titli ɔ, ní nɛmɛ nɛ a ngɔ lohwe he womi kɛ pee ɔ.
14 Aleksandro, sɔlɔ ɔ ye mi sane yaya ko; nɔ́ yeyee nɛ e pee mi ɔ, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nɛ wo lɛ hiɔ. 15Moo hyɛ o he ngɛ e he, ejakaa e te si wawɛɛ ngɔ si munyu ɔ nɛ wa ngɛ fiɛe ɔ.
16Kekleekle nɛ i ya fa ye he ngɛ kojomi he ɔ, nɔ ko nɔ ko kɛ mi yɛ. Mɛ tsuo a si mi; Mawu kó gbla a tue ngɛ enɛ ɔ he. 17Se Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ piɛ ye he, nɛ e wo mi he wami, nɛ i nyɛ fiɛ sane kpakpa a kɛ ha ma je li ɔmɛ tsuo. Bɔ nɛ Mawu je mi kɛ je gbenɔ nya mi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. Ee, e je mi kɛ je gbenɔ mi. 18Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ma je mi kɛ maa je ní yayamihi tsuo a mi, nɛ e kɛ mi maa ya hiɔwe he nɛ e ngɛ matsɛ yee ngɛ ɔ fiafiaafia. A maa wo e hɛ mi nyami kɛ maa ya neneene. Amen.
Nyagbe sɛ yemi
19 I biɔ Priskila, Akuila, kɛ Onesiforo kɛ e we ɔ tsuo saminya. 20 Erasto tlɔ Korinto, se Trofimo lɛɛ i si lɛ ngɛ Mileto, ejakaa e be he wami. 21Bɔɔ mɔde nɛ o ba loko fĩɛ be ɔ nɛ su.
Eubulo, Pude, Lino, kɛ Klaudia ke a biɔ mo. Nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ke mɛ hu a biɔ mo.
22Wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo nɛ gbaa mo.
Mawu dloomi ɔ kɛ nyɛ nɛ hi si!

Title: TITO NYA TSƆƆMI
Content:
NYA TSƆƆMI
Tito ɔ, ma je no ji lɛ, nɛ e ba tsake e tsui nɛ e pee Kristo se nyɛɛlɔ. E piɛ Paulo he kɛ tsu ní, nɛ e nyɛɛ e se kɛ kpa si kɛ fiɛ Mawu munyu ɔ. Paulo ngma womi nɛ ɔ ya ha niheyo Tito, e he piɛlɔ nɛ ngɛ Kreta, he nɛ e si lɛ ngɛ konɛ e hyɛ asafo ɔ nɔ ɔ. Womi ɔ tuɔ nɔ́ etɛ titli komɛ a he munyu.
Kekleekle ɔ, Paulo ngɛ Tito kaie bɔ nɛ sa kaa asafo nya dali nɛ a ba a je mi ha. Paulo hɛ ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ he wawɛɛ, ejakaa Kreta bi babauu be subai kulaa. Enyɔne ɔ, Paulo ngɛ Tito ga woe bɔ nɛ e ma plɛ kɛ tsɔɔ kuu slɔɔtohi nɛ ngɛ asafo ɔ mi ɔ ní, nyumu nikɔtɔmahi, kɛ yi nikɔtɔmahi, nihewi, kɛ nyɔguɛhi. (Yihewi ɔmɛ lɛɛ yi nikɔtɔma amɛ maa tsɔɔ mɛ ní). Nyagbe ɔ, Paulo ngɛ Tito ga woe ngɛ je mi bami nɛ sa Kristo se nyɛɛli he. Titli ɔ, e hia kaa a kɛ nihi nɛ hi si ngɛ tue mi jɔmi mi kaa huɛmɛ; a ko nyɛ nɔ, a kɛ nihi kó sã nya, nɛ a ko pee nɔ́ ko nɛ kɛ mi gbami maa ba asafo ɔ mi.
Bɔ nɛ a dla womi ɔ mi ha
Sisije 1.1-4
Asafo nya dali 1.5-16
Kuu slɔɔtohi nɛ ngɛ asafo ɔ mi ɔ a ní tsumihi 2.1-15
Yi jemi kɛ kɔkɔ bɔmi 3.1-11
Nyagbe 3.12-15

Title: TITO 1
Content:
1Imi Paulo, Mawu tsɔlɔ, kɛ Yesu Kristo bɔfo ɔ lɛ i ngma womi nɛ ɔ.
Mawu hla mi, nɛ e tsɔ mi, konɛ ma ya wo nihi nɛ Mawu hla mɛ ɔ a hemi kɛ yemi mi he wami, nɛ ma tsɔɔ mɛ anɔkuale ɔ nɛ ngɛ Mawu jami mi. 2Wa ngɛ hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi kaa enɛ ɔ ma ha wɔ neneene wami. Mawu nɛ yi lakpa a wo si kaa e ma ha wɔ kikɛmɛ a neneene wami nɛ ɔ be nɛ a na we nɛ a bɔ nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko. 3Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, be nɛ sa mi ɔ, e ha nɛ siwo nɛ ɔ ba mi kɛ gu e sane kpakpa a nɛ a tu ngɔ wo ye dɛ mi ɔ nɔ. Enɛ ɔ i ngɛ fiɛe, kaa bɔ nɛ Mawu, wa kpɔlɔ ɔ fa mi ke ma pee ɔ.
4 I ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ ngmae ha mo Tito, ye bi nitsɛnitsɛ ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi kake ɔ nɛ i kɛ mo tsuo wa hɛɛ mi ɔ mi.
Dloomi kɛ he jɔmi nɛ je Tsɛ Mawu ɔ, kɛ wa kpɔlɔ Kristo Yesu dɛ mi ɔ ha mo!
Tito ní tsumi ngɛ Kreta
5I si mo ngɛ Kreta, konɛ níhi nɛ piɛ ɔ, o to blɔ nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ, nɛ o wo asafo nya dali ngɛ ma tsuaa ma mi. Mo kai níhi nɛ i de mo ɔ. 6 Asafo nya dalɔ ɔ, e pee nɔ ko nɛ piami be e he, nɔ nɛ ngɛ yo kake pɛ, nɛ e bimɛ le Kristo. Bimɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a pee nihi nɛ a yeɔ a he odase kpakpa; pi yaholi, loo nihi nɛ tsɔɔ atuã. 7Asafo nya dalɔ ɔ, akɛnɛ Mawu ní tsumi nɔ e ngɛ hyɛe he je ɔ, e sɛ kaa piami ko hii e he. E ko pee nɔ nɛ woɔ e he nɔ, loo nɔ nɛ tsui fiaa mlamlaamla, loo dã tɔlɔ, loo kunɔ nɔlɔ, loo nɔ ko nɛ dii sika se tsɔ. 8Asafo nya dalɔ ɔ, e pee nɔ nɛ peeɔ nibwɔ, nɛ e suɔ nɔ́ nɛ hi, nɔ nɛ juɛmi ka si, nɛ e peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da; nɔ nɛ ngɔ e he ngɔ ha Mawu kulaa, nɛ e yeɔ e he nɔ. 9Anɔkuale ɔ nɛ a tsɔɔ lɛ, nɛ e he ye ɔ, e hɛɛ mi wawɛɛ. Ke e pee jã loko lɛ hu e ma nyɛ tsɔɔ ni kpahi ní nɛ he tsɔ saminya. Kɛkɛ ɔ, nihi nɛ teɔ si siɔ anɔkuale ɔ, e maa tsɔɔ mɛ a tɔmi.
10Ejakaa nihi babauu tsɔ atuã, nɛ a ngɛ yakayaka munyu tue kɛ ngɛ nihi sisie. Nihi nɛ deɔ ke ja a po nɔ ɔ, mɛ titli lɛ a ngɛ ní nɛ ɔ tsue. 11E hia kaa a ku nɔ́ nɛ ɔ nya la, ejakaa nimli nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ a tsɔɔmi ɔ ngɛ wehi fuu a nane kpatae. A ngɛ níhi nɛ dɛ blɔ tsɔɔe. Blɔɔ zo blɔ nɔ nɛ a gu kɛ ngɛ sika pee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. 12Kreta fɔfɔɛ, nɛ ji mɛ nitsɛmɛ a gbalɔ ko lɛ de ke, “Daa nɛ ɔ, Kreta bi ngɛ lakpa yee; a ngɛ kaa lohwe awi yeli pɛ! Daa nɛ ɔ, hejɔ peemi, kɛ a ye nɛ a tɔ pɛ ji a ní tsumi.” 13Anɔkuale sane ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ka a hɛ mi wawɛɛ, konɛ a hɛɛ a hemi kɛ yemi ɔ mi wawɛɛ. 14Kɛkɛ ɔ, a ya be Yuda bi a nyaziahi tue bue, nɛ mlaahi nɛ nihi nɛ kua anɔkuale ɔ wo mɛ ɔ hu a be nɔ yee. 15Nihi nɛ a he tsɔ ɔ, nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ he tsɔ ha mɛ. Se nihi nɛ ble a he, kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ he we yi ɔ lɛɛ nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko he tsɔ we ha mɛ; ejakaa a ble a juɛmi, kɛ a he nile tsuo. 16A deɔ ke a le Mawu, se a ní peepee tsɔɔ we jã. Yakayaka nimli, kɛ atuã tsɔli ji mɛ; a tsu we nɔ́ kpakpa ko gblee.

Title: TITO 2
Content:
Tsɔɔmi kpakpa
1Se moo lɛɛ anɔkuale nɛ kɔɔ tsɔɔmi kpakpa a he ɔ, lɔ ɔ o tsɔɔ asafo ɔ. 2Nyumu nikɔtɔma amɛ ɔ, o kɛ mɛ nɛ tu munyu, konɛ a pee a he nihi nɛ a hɛ mi ka si, nihi nɛ tsuɔ ní kɛ hɛdɔ, nɛ a juɛmi ka si. A hemi kɛ yemi, suɔmi nɛ a ngɛ, kɛ a tsui si tomi ɔ, á hɛɛ mi wawɛɛ. 3Yi nikɔtɔma amɛ hu o kɛ mɛ nɛ tu munyu jã nɔuu, konɛ a ba a je mi saminya kaa nihi nɛ yeɔ Mawu gbeye. A ko pee a he sieku yeli, nɛ a ko ngɔ dã numi ngɔ pee a ní tsumi. Mohu ɔ, a tsɔɔ nɔ́ kpakpa, 4konɛ a tsɔse yihewi ɔmɛ nɛ a suɔ a hunomɛ, kɛ a bimɛ. 5A tsɔse mɛ, nɛ a nyɛ nɛ a ye a he nɔ saminya, nɛ a he nɛ tsɔ, nɛ a pee a he yigbayi kpakpahi nɛ le a we yi baami, nihi nɛ a mi mi jɔ, nɛ baa a he si ha a hunomɛ. Kɛkɛ ɔ, nɔ ko nɔ ko be Mawu munyu ɔ he munyu yaya tue.
6Nihewi ɔmɛ hu, tu munyu kɛ tsɔɔ mɛ jã nɔuu, konɛ a nyɛ nɛ a ye a he nɔ saminya. 7Mo nitsɛ o ba o je mi saminya ngɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ mi, konɛ lɔ ɔ nɛ pee nɔ hyɛmi nɔ́ kpakpa ha ni ɔmɛ. Ke o ngɛ ní tsɔɔe ɔ, ha nɛ a na kaa o juɛmi mi tsɔ, nɛ o hɛ dɔ. 8Munyu nɛ maa je o nya a, e pee munyu kpakpa nɛ a be he nɔ́ yaya ko nae nɛ a de. Kɛkɛ ɔ, ke nihi nɛ teɔ si woɔ wɔ ɔ nɛ́ nɔ́ yayami ko nɛ a de ngɛ wa he ɔ, zo maa gbe mɛ.
9Tu munyu kɛ tsɔɔ nyɔguɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a ba a he si ha a nyɔmtsɛmɛ ɔmɛ, nɛ a sa a hɛ mi ngɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ mi. A ko je munyu nya, 10nɛ a ko ju mɛ hulɔ. Se mohu á ye anɔkuale ngɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ mi, konɛ anɔkuale nɛ kɔɔ Mawu, wa kpɔlɔ ɔ he ɔ, nihi nɛ a na nya saminya.
11Ejakaa Mawu je e dloomi ɔ nɛ e kɛ ma he adesahi tsuo a yi wami ɔ kpo ngɔ tsɔɔ. 12Dloomi nɛ ɔ bɔɔ wɔ kɔkɔ kaa wa kpa yayami peemi, nɛ wa ko di je nɛ ɔ mi akɔnɔ níhi a se. E tsɔɔ wɔ kaa waa hyɛ wa he nɔ saminya; waa pee nɔ́ nɛ da, nɛ waa ye Mawu gbeye, 13be mi nɛ wa ngɛ gbaami nɛ wa ngɔ wa hɛ fɔ nɔ ɔ blɔ hyɛe ɔ. Jamɛ a be ɔ, wa Mawu kpetekpleenyɛ, kɛ wa kpɔlɔ Yesu Kristo hɛ mi nyami ɔ maa je kpo. 14 E ngɔ lɛ nitsɛ e he ngɔ ha ngɛ wa he. E kpɔ wɔ kɛ je yi wu tso níhi a peemi mi, nɛ e ngɔ wɔ ngɔ pee lɛ nitsɛ e ma klɔuklɔu, nihi nɛ a hɛ dɔɔ ngɛ nɔ́ kpakpa peemi he.
15Tsɔɔ o we bi ɔmɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ, nɛ o ngɔ he blɔ nɛ o ngɛ ɔ tsuo kɛ wo mɛ he wami, nɛ o kɛ ka a hɛ mi hulɔ. Ko ha nɛ nɔ ko nɛ gbe o he guɛ.

Title: TITO 3
Content:
Je mi bami nɛ sa Kristo se nyɛɛlɔ
1Mo kai o we bi ɔmɛ, nɛ a ba a he si ngɔ ha ma nɔ yeli, kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ hɛɛ blɔ nya. Á bu mɛ, nɛ a pee klaalo kaa a ma tsu ní tsumi kpakpa be tsuaa be. 2A ko tu nihi a he munyu yaya, nɛ a ko pɛ; se mohu a he nɛ jɔ, nɛ a tsɔ a hɛ mi ha nɔ tsuaa nɔ. 3Ejakaa sa a, wɔ nitsɛmɛ hu wa je kuasia; wa gbo tue, nɛ wa tla blɔ. Wa ya di akɔnɔ yaya, kɛ he lo mi níhi nɛ haa wɔ bua jɔmi a se. Wa susuu nihi a he yayami, nɛ wa hɛ kɔ̃ɔ̃; nɔ́ peeɔ wɔ tai, nɛ wa nyɛɛ wa sibi. 4Se benɛ Mawu, wa kpɔlɔ ɔ je e mi mi himi, kɛ e suɔmi ɔ kpo ɔ, 5e he wa yi wami. Pi nɔ́ nɛ da nɛ wa pee he nɛ e he wa yi wami ngɛ; mɔbɔ kɛkɛ lɛ e na wɔ kɛ gu Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ nɔ. Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ du wa he, nɛ wa pee kaa nihi nɛ a fɔ mɛ ehe, nɛ́ a na wami he. 6Kɛ gu wa kpɔlɔ Yesu Kristo nɔ ɔ, Mawu plɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ ngɔ pue wa nɔ babauu. 7E pee enɛ ɔ, konɛ wɔ nɛ a wo wɔ nguɔ kɛ gu Yesu Kristo dloomi ɔ nɔ ɔ, neneene wami ɔ nɛ wa ngɔ wa hɛ ngɔ fɔ nɔ ɔ, wa nine nɛ su nɔ. 8Anɔkuale munyu sisiisi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
I suɔ kaa o di ní nɛ ɔmɛ a se wawɛɛ, konɛ nihi nɛ ba he Mawu ye ɔ nɛ a ngɔ a be kɛ tsu ní kpakpahi. Enɛ ɔmɛ ji níhi nɛ hi, nɛ a he ngɛ se nami ha nihi tsuo. 9Se nya sami yaka gu, weku kpa se jami, pɛ, kɛ mlaa a he nɔ́ jemi ɔ lɛɛ je o he kɛ je mi. Ní nɛ ɔmɛ a he be se nami, nɛ a he hia we hulɔ. 10Nɔ ko nɛ ma hla kaa e kɛ mi gbami nɛ ba nyɛ kpɛti ɔ, ka e hɛ mi si kake, loo si enyɔ. Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, kɛ lɛ ko bɔ hu. 11Na nɛ o le kaa nɔmlɔ nɛ ngɛ kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ ji yayami peelɔ nɛ je e glɛ nɔ, nɛ lɛ nitsɛ e he yayami ɔ buu lɛ fɔ.
Nyagbe sɛ yemi
12 Ke i tsɔ Artema, loo Tihiko kɛ ba o ngɔ ɔ, bɔɔ mɔde nɛ o ba ye ngɔ ngɛ Nikopoli, ejakaa i to kaa ma ya ye fĩɛ be ɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. 13 Moo bɔ mɔde nɛ o wo Zena, mlaa tsɔɔlɔ ɔ, kɛ Apolo blɔ saminya; hyɛ nɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ maa hia mɛ ngɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ ɔ, a nine nɛ su nɔ. 14Ha nɛ wa we bi ɔmɛ nɛ a kase bɔ nɛ a maa ngɔ a be kɛ tsu ní kpakpa ha. Kɛkɛ ɔ, ke fimi be ba a, nɔ́ ko be mɛ hiae; a ko pee a he nihi nɛ a he be se nami ko.
15Nihi tsuo nɛ kɛ mi ngɛ hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ ke a biɔ nyɛ. De wa suɔli ɔmɛ nɛ heɔ Kristo yeɔ ɔ ke wa biɔ mɛ.
Mawu dloomi ɔ kɛ nyɛ tsuo nɛ hi si!

Title: FILEMON NYA TSƆƆMI
Content:
NYA TSƆƆMI
Filemon ji Kristo se nyɛɛlɔ kpanaa ko. Ni komɛ deɔ ke Kolose asafo ɔ mi no ji lɛ. Filemon ngɛ nyɔguɛ ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Onesimo. Onesimo tu fo kɛ je e nyɔmtsɛ ɔ he, nɛ e kɛ Paulo ya kpe tlukaa. Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, a wo Paulo tsu. Kɛ gu Paulo nɔ ɔ, Onesimo ba pee Kristo se nyɛɛlɔ. Paulo ngma womi nɛ ɔ, nɛ e kɛ tsɔ Onesimo kɛ ya ha e nyɔmtsɛ ɔ. Paulo kpa Filemon pɛɛ nɛ e kpale he e nyɔguɛ ɔ ekohu. Pi kaa e maa ngɔ Onesimo tɔmi ngɔ pa lɛ kɛkɛ, se mohu e he lɛ kaa e nyɛmi Kristo se nyɛɛlɔ.
Bɔ nɛ a dla womi ɔ mi ha
Sisije munyuhi 1-3
Paulo je Filemon yi 4-7
Paulo kpa pɛɛ ha Onesimo 8-22
Nyagbe munyuhi 23-25

Title: FILEMON 1
Content:
1Imi Paulo nɛ a wo mi tsu ngɛ Kristo Yesu he ɔ, kɛ wa nyɛmi Timoteo ngma womi nɛ ɔ kɛ ya ha Filemon, wa suɔlɔ, kɛ wa huɛ nɛ waa kɛ lɛ tsuɔ ní ɔ, 2 kɛ asafo ɔ nɛ kpee ngɛ e we ɔ mi ɔ, kɛ wa nyɛmiyo Apia, kɛ wa huɛ ta bulɔ Arkipo.
3Dloomi kɛ he jɔmi nɛ je wa Tsɛ Mawu ɔ, kɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo dɛ mi ɔ ha nyɛ!
Filemon suɔmi kɛ e hemi kɛ yemi
4Ye nyɛmi Filemon, be tsuaa be nɛ ma sɔle ɔ, i woɔ o ta, nɛ i naa Mawu si. 5Ejakaa suɔmi nɛ o jeɔ kpo kɛ tsɔɔ Mawu bimɛ ɔmɛ tsuo, kɛ hemi kɛ yemi nɛ o ngɛ ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo mi ɔ, i nu he. 6Ye sɔlemi ji kaa hemi kɛ yemi ɔ nɛ waa kɛ mo wa hɛɛ mi ɔ ma ha waa nu ní kpakpahi tsuo nɛ wa naa ngɛ Kristo Yesu mi ɔ a sisi saminya. 7Ye nyɛmi, o suɔmi ɔ wo mi he wami, nɛ e ha mi bua jɔmi babauu. O ha nɛ Mawu bimɛ ɔmɛ a tsui nɔ a mi.
Paulo kpa pɛɛ ha Filemon
8Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, jinɛ kaa o nyɛmi ngɛ Kristo mi ɔ, i ngɛ he blɔ nɛ ma nyɛ o nɔ, nɛ o pee nɔ nɛ sa. 9Se akɛnɛ i suɔ mo he je ɔ, ma ngɔ hiami nɔ́ nɛ ɔ kɛ fɔ o hɛ mi mohu. Hyɛ, imi Paulo, Yesu Kristo tsɔlɔ kpanaa nɛ amlɔ nɛ ɔ hu a bɔ mi pã ngɛ lɛ nɔuu e he ɔ, imi nɛ i ngɛ mo nɔ́ nɛ ɔ bae ɔ nɛ. 10 I ngɛ mo pɛɛ kpae ngɛ Onesimo nɛ peeɔ ye bi ngɛ Kristo mi ɔ he. Tsu nɛ a wo mi ɔ ha i ba pee e tsɛ. 11Jinɛ sa a, e he be se nami kɛ ha mo, se jehanɛ lɛɛ e he ba se nami kɛ ha imi kɛ mo tsuo.
12I ha nɛ e kpale kɛ ma o ngɔ; pohu e he hia mi kaa imi nitsɛ ye hɛngmɛ. 13I ko suɔ kaa e kɛ mi nɛ hi si, konɛ e sɔmɔ mi ngɛ o nane mi, be mi nɛ sane kpakpa a he ɔ, a wo mi tsu ɔ. 14Se i sume kaa ma je o se kɛ pee nɔ́ ko, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ nɔ́ kpakpa nɛ o ko je o tsui mi faa pee ɔ, e ko ba pee kaa nɔ́ nɛ pe a nyɛ o nɔ.
15Eko ɔ, o kɛ Onesimo nyɛ kpɛti gbɛ be bɔɔ kɛkɛ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ jehanɛ lɛɛ e ba hi si ngɛ o ngɔ daa. 16Jehanɛ ɔ, e pi nɔ ko nɛ a maa bu lɛ nyɔguɛ hu, se mohu nɔ nɛ pe nyɔguɛ. O nyɛmi saminya ji lɛ ngɛ Kristo mi nɛ imi po i fiɛ we e he, hluu nɛ mo nɛ he lo mi jio, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ mi jio, o nɔ ji lɛ kulaa a.
17Enɛ ɔ he ɔ, ke o buu mi o huɛ tutuutu nɛ o kɛ lɛ tsuɔ ní ɔ, he Onesimo atuu kaa bɔ nɛ o ma he mi. 18Ke ji e ye mo sane yaya ko, aloo e hɛɛ mo hiɔ ko ɔ, buu jamɛ a akɔtaa tsuo ha mi. 19Imi Paulo nitsɛ ye nine nya ji nɛ ɔ nɛ, ma wo mo hiɔ ɔ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ. E hia we nɛ ma wo nɔ ta ha mo kaa mo nitsɛ tete, Kristo nɛ o le amlɔ nɛ ɔ, o hɛɛ mi o yi nɔ hiɔ po. 20Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ye nyɛmi, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ he ɔ, i kpa mo pɛɛ, pee enɛ ɔ ha mi. Ha ma tsɛ ye tsui ngɔ wo ye tsui mi, ejakaa ye nyɛmi nɛ le Kristo ji mo.
21I heɔ yeɔ kaa nɔ́ nɛ i kɛ ngɛ o hɛ mi fɔe ngɛ womi nɛ i ngma mo nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, o maa pee. I le hulɔ kaa o maa pee pe bɔ nɛ i bi nɛ ɔ tete po. 22E piɛ nɔ́ kake; ma suɔ hu nɛ o dla nibwɔhi a to he ko kɛ ha mi. Ejakaa ye hɛ ngɛ nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ kulaa nyɛ ngɛ kue fae ɔ, Mawu maa pee nɛ ma kpale kɛ ba nyɛ ngɔ ekohu.
Nyagbe sɛ yemi
23 Epafra, nɛ lɛ hu Kristo Yesu he ɔ, a wo i kɛ lɛ tsu ɔ ke e biɔ mo. 24 Marko, Aristarko, Dɛma, kɛ Luka, ye huɛmɛ nɛ i kɛ mɛ tsuɔ ní ɔ, mɛ hu a ke a biɔ mo.
25Wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo dloomi ɔ kɛ nyɛ nɛ hi si!

Title: HEBRI BI NYA TSƆƆMI
Content:
NYA TSƆƆMI
A ngma womi nɛ ɔ ya ha Kristo se nyɛɛli komɛ nɛ miɔ nɛ a ngmɛɛ a hemi kɛ yemi he, ejakaa a ngɛ mɛ yi mi wae wawɛɛ. Womi ngmalɔ ɔ we oti ji kaa e maa wo mɛ he wami. E de mɛ ke e hia kaa a le kaa Mawu je e he si kulaa gbe nya kɛ gu Kristo nɔ, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a hemi kɛ yemi mi nɛ wa saminya. Womi ngmalɔ ɔ ma nɔ́ etɛ nɔ mi: (1) Yesu Kristo ji Mawu Bi kɛ yaa neneene. E bu e Tsɛ ɔ tue pɛpɛɛpɛ kɛ gu amanehlu nɛ e na a mi. Kaa Mawu Bi ɔ, Kristo pe gbali ɔmɛ nɛ hi si somi momo be ɔ. E pe hiɔwe bɔfo ɔmɛ hulɔ, nɛ e pe Mose tete po. (2) Mawu nitsɛ wo Yesu osɔfo kɛ yaa neneene; e pe osɔfohi tsuo nɛ hi si somi momo be ɔ. (3) Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ heɔ Yesu yeɔ ɔ, a kpɔ lɛ kɛ je yayami peemi, gbeye yemi, kɛ gbenɔ mi. Yesu ji osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa, nɛ lɛ nɛ ha wɔ yi wami hemi nitsɛnitsɛ. Se kusumi nɛ Hebri bi peeɔ ngɛ a jami ɔ nya, nɛ a gbeɔ lohwehi nɛ a kɛ sãã bɔ kaa a kɛ ma he nɔ yi wami ɔ sui he ko kulaa.
Blema Israel bi komɛ nɛ he biɛ kaa a hemi kɛ yemi mi wa a, a wo a ta kɛ pee nɔhyɛ nɔ ngɛ yi 11 ɔ mi. Womi ngmalɔ ɔ wo ga kaa nihi nɛ maa kane womi ɔ nɛ a hɛɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ mi nɛ wa. E ya nɔ nɛ e de mɛ ngɛ yi 12 ɔ mi ke a hɛɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ mi kɛ ya si nyagbe; a ngɔ a hɛ kɛ fɔ Yesu pɛ nɔ, nɛ ke a ngɛ nɔ́ nae jio, a ngɛ mɛ yi mi wae jio, a to a tsui si.
Nyagbe ɔ, womi ngmalɔ ɔ wo nihi nɛ maa kane womi ɔ ga, nɛ e bɔ mɛ kɔkɔ.
Bɔ nɛ a dla womi ɔ mi ha
Mawu je e he si tutuutu kɛ gu Kristo nɔ 1.1-3
Kristo pe Mawu bɔfo ɔmɛ tsuo 1.4—2.18
Kristo pe Mose kɛ Yoshua tsuo 3.1—4.13
Kristo ji osɔfo nɛ pe osɔfohi tsuo 4.14—7.28
Kristo somi ɔ pe somi tsuaa somi 8.1—9.28
Kristo ngɔ e he kɛ sã bɔ nɛ pe bɔhi tsuo 10.1-39
Hemi kɛ yemi he hia wawɛɛ 11.1—12.29
Bɔ nɛ wa maa sa Mawu hɛ mi 13.1-19
Sɔlemi 13.20-21
Nyagbe munyuhi 13.22-25

Title: HEBRI BI 1
Content:
Mawu tu munyu kɛ gu e Bi ɔ nɔ
1Blema a, Mawu kɛ wa nɛmɛ ɔmɛ tu munyu si abɔ kɛ gu gbali ɔmɛ a nɔ ngɛ blɔ slɔɔtohi babauu a nɔ; 2se mwɔnɛmwɔnɛ ɔ lɛɛ e Bi ɔ nɔ e gu nɛ e kɛ wɔ tu munyu. Lɛ nɔuu e nɔ Mawu gu kɛ bɔ je ɔ kɛ e mi ní tsuo, nɛ lɛ nɛ Mawu hla kaa e ye e ní tsuo. 3Bɔ nɛ Mawu hɛ mi ngɛ nyami ɔ, jã nɔuu Bi ɔ hu hɛ mi ngɛ nyami. Bi ɔ ngɛ kaa Mawu pɛpɛɛpɛ. E kɛ e munyu ɔ he wami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ hɛɛ je ɔ tsuo. Benɛ e ngɔ je ɔ he yayami tsuo kɛ ho ɔ, e ya hi si ngɛ hiɔwe ngɛ matsɛ ngua a hiɔ nɔ.
Mawu Bi ɔ ji ngua
4Mawu ha nɛ e Bi ɔ pe hiɔwe bɔfo ɔmɛ tsuo kaa bɔ nɛ biɛ nɛ e wo lɛ ɔ hu he jua wa pe a nɔ́ ɔ. 5 Ejakaa Mawu de we e bɔfo ɔmɛ a ti eko hyɛ gblee ke,
“Ye Bi ji mo;
mwɔnɛ ɔ, i fɔ mo.”
Nɛ Mawu tu we hiɔwe bɔfo ko he munyu hyɛ ke,
“Ma pee e Tsɛ,
nɛ e maa pee ye Bi.”
6 Se benɛ Mawu miɔ nɛ e maa tsɔ e bitɛte ɔ je ɔ mi ɔ, e de ekohu ke,
“Ha nɛ Mawu bɔfo ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ a ja lɛ.”
7 Bɔfo ɔmɛ lɛɛ nɔ́ nɛ Mawu de ngɛ a he ji,
“Mawu haa e bɔfo ɔmɛ peeɔ kaa kɔɔhiɔ,
nɛ e tsɔli ɔmɛ peeɔ kaa la lilɛhi.”
8 Bi ɔ lɛɛ Mawu de ngɛ e he ke,
“Mawu ji mo; o maa ye matsɛ kɛ maa ya neneene!
Nɛ dami sane yemi maa pee o matsɛ tso.
9O suɔ dami sane yemi;
se mlaa nɔ tɔmi lɛɛ o nyɛ.
Enɛ ɔ he je Mawu nɛ ji o Mawu ɔ pɔ mo nu,
nɛ o na bua jɔmi kulaa pe o nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ.”
10Mawu de hulɔ ke,
“Mo Nyɔmtsɛ, blema lokoo ɔ, mo lɛ o bɔ je ɔ;
mo nitsɛ lɛ o bɔ hiɔwe kɛ zugba.
11A hɛ mi ma kpata,
se moo lɛɛ o maa hi si daa.
12 O maa ku a mi kaa a kuɔ tade mi;
nɛ a hɛ mi ma kpa kaa bo kpaa.
Se moo lɛɛ o ngɛ kaa bɔ nɛ o ngɛ ɔ kɛ̃;
o be gboe gblegbleegble.”
13 Mawu de we Mawu bɔfo ɔmɛ a ti nɔ ko hyɛ ke,
“Hii ye hiɔ nɔ kɛ yaa su be nɛ
ma ngɔ o he nyɛli ɔmɛ kɛ pee
nɔ́ nɛ o kɛ o nane maa nɔ.”
14Mawu bɔfo ɔmɛ ɔ, mɛni ji a ní tsumi mɔ?
Mumihi ji mɛ, nɛ a sɔmɔɔ Mawu.
Ke Mawu ma he nɔ ko yi wami ɔ,
mɛ lɛ Mawu tsɔɔ.

Title: HEBRI BI 2
Content:
Yi wami hemi kpetekpleenyɛ
1Enɛ ɔ he ɔ, e sa kaa waa pɛtɛ níhi nɛ wa nu ɔ a he saminya, konɛ wa ko gba kɛ je he. 2Sɛ gbi nɛ Mawu bɔfo ɔmɛ kɛ ba a ngɛ mi sisiisi; nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ gbo tue, loo e bui ɔ, a gbla e tue bɔ nɛ sa lɛ. 3Ke wɔɔ lɛɛ wa bui yi wami hemi kpetekpleenyɛ nɛ ɔ, kɛ wa maa pee kɛ ye wa he kɛɛ? Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nitsɛ lɛ tu yi wami hemi nɛ ɔ he munyu kekle; nɛ nihi nɛ nu ɔ, mɛ hu a ma nɔ mi ha wɔ. 4Mawu nitsɛ pee okadi kɛ nyakpɛ ní slɔɔtohi babauu kɛ ye yi wami hemi nɛ ɔ he odase. Jehanɛ hu, e dla Mumi Klɔuklɔu nike ní ɔmɛ ngɔ ha kaa bɔ nɛ lɛ nitsɛ e suɔ kɛ ma nɔ mi.
Nɔ nɛ haa nɛ wa yi naa wami
5Je nɛ maa ba nɛ wa ngɛ he munyu tue ɔ, Mawu ha we Mawu bɔfohi he blɔ nɛ a ye tsɛ ngɛ nɔ. 6 Odase nɛ nɔ ko ye ngɛ ngmami ɔ he ko ji nɛ ɔ nɛ:
“Mɛni ji nɔmlɔ adesa, nɛ o susuɔ e he?
Mɛni ji nɔmlɔ bi, nɛ o hyɛɛ e nɔ?
7Nɛ o bɔ lɛ ɔ, nɔ́ ko bɔɔ pɛ o ha bɔfo ɔmɛ kɛ pe lɛ.
O wo e hɛ mi nyami,
nɛ o ha bu ba e he.
8O pee lɛ níhi tsuo a nɔ yelɔ.”
Jehanɛ ɔ, ke kaa Mawu pee adesa níhi tsuo a nɔ yelɔ, lɛɛ nɔ́ ko be nɛ adesa be he wami ngɛ nɔ. Anɔkuale mi ɔ, wa nɛ́ kaa adesa ngɛ tsɛ yee ngɛ níhi tsuo a nɔ amlɔ nɛ ɔ. 9Se Yesu lɛɛ wa na kaa gbenɔ mi amanehlu ɔ nɛ e na a ha nɛ a kɛ hɛ mi nyami kɛ bu fi lɛ jlasi. Nɛ Mawu bɔ lɛ ɔ, nɔ́ ko bɔɔ pɛ e ha bɔfo ɔmɛ kɛ pe lɛ. Mawu pee lɛ jã, konɛ lɛ Mawu ɔ dloomi ɔ nya a, Yesu nɛ ba gbo kɛ ha nihi tsuo. 10Nɛ e sa hu kaa Mawu nɛ bɔ níhi tsuo, nɛ́ lɛ nɔuu lɛ e ha nɛ ní ɔmɛ tsuo ngɛ ɔ, e ha a yi wami hemi sisi jelɔ ɔ nɛ ba na amanehlu, nɛ e kɛ dla lɛ kɛ pi si, konɛ e wo bimɛ babauu a hɛ mi nyami.
11Ejakaa nɔ nɛ tsuɔ nihi a he, kɛ ni nɛmɛ e tsu a he ɔ tsuo a tsɛ kake. Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, e pee we Yesu zo kaa e ma tsɛ mɛ nyɛmimɛ. 12 E deɔ Mawu ke,
“Ma wo o biɛ ta ha ye nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ,
nɛ i kɛ asafo ɔ ma la kɛ je o yi.”
13 E deɔ hu ke, “Ma ngɔ ye hɛ kɛ fɔ Mawu nɔ.” E kpale deɔ hu ke, “Ne mi kɛ bimɛ nɛ Mawu ha mi ɔ.”
14Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, akɛnɛ he lo kɛ muɔ ji bimɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, lɛ nitsɛ hu e pee he lo kɛ muɔ. E pee enɛ ɔ, konɛ kɛ gu e gbenɔ mi ɔ, e kpata Abosiami, nɔ nɛ hɛɛ gbenɔ he wami ɔ hɛ mi. 15Kɛkɛ ɔ, e ma ha nihi nɛ a wami be tsuo a ngɛ gbenɔ gbeye yee, nɛ a pee yoyooyo kaa nyɔguɛhi ɔ maa ye a he. 16Niinɛ, e fɔɔ si paa kaa tsa pi Mawu bɔfohi a he nɛ e ba ngɛ, se mohu Abraham nina a he. 17Enɛ ɔ tsɔɔ kaa blɔ tsuaa blɔ nɔ ɔ, e hia kaa Yesu nɛ pee kaa e nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ. Kɛkɛ ɔ, e maa pee osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa anɔkualetsɛ, kɛ mɔbɔ nalɔ nɛ ngɛ Mawu sɔmɔe, nɛ e kɛ e he nɛ sã kpatami bɔ, konɛ Mawu nɛ ngɔ a he yayamihi kɛ pa mɛ. 18Jehanɛ lɛɛ, nihi tsuo nɛ ngɛ ka mi ɔ, e ma nyɛ maa wo mɛ he wami; ejakaa lɛ nitsɛ ɔ, a ka lɛ, nɛ e na amanehlu.

Title: HEBRI BI 3
Content:
Yesu pe Mose
1Ye nyɛmimɛ, nyɛ nihi nɛ nyɛ he tsɔ, nɛ Mawu tsɛ waa kɛ nyɛ tsuo, nyɛɛ hyɛ Yesu, hemi kɛ yemi nɛ wa jajeɔ ɔ he bɔfo, kɛ osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa a. 2 E ye Mawu nɛ hla lɛ ke e tsu ní nɛ ɔ anɔkuale kaa bɔ nɛ Mose hu ye anɔkuale ngɛ Mawu we ɔ. 3Kaa bɔ nɛ a buɔ nɔ nɛ maa tsu pe tsu ɔ nɛ e maa a, jã kɛ̃ bu ngɛ Yesu hu he hluu pe Mose. 4Tsu tsuaa tsu ɔ, nɔ ko nɛ fiaa; se Mawu lɛ bɔ níhi tsuo. 5Mose ye anɔkuale ngɛ Mawu we ɔ kulaa nɔ kaa sɔmɔlɔ, nɛ e ye odase ngɛ níhi nɛ a ma de hwɔɔ se ɔ a he. 6Se Kristo lɛɛ e ye anɔkuale ngɛ Mawu we ɔ kaa Mawu bi. Ke waa kɛ kã kɛ gɛjɛmi hɛɛ hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi ɔ mi kpɛii ɔ, wa peeɔ Mawu we bi.
Mawu we bi maa jɔɔ a he
7 Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, kaa bɔ nɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ deɔ ɔ, “Mwɔnɛ ɔ, ke nyɛ nu e gbi ɔ,
8nyɛ ko wa tue kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ
pee ngɛ nga a nɔ
benɛ a tsɔ atuã, nɛ a ka Mawu ɔ.
9Lejɛ ɔ nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ ka mi ngɛ,
pohu a na níhi nɛ i tsu
jeha nyingmi eywiɛ sɔuu.
10Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ye mi mi fu jamɛ a yi nɔ bi ɔmɛ,
nɛ i de ke,
‘Daa nɛ ɔ, a dɔ a tsui kɛ je ye he,
nɛ a li ye blɔ ɔmɛ.’
11Ye mi mi fu mɛ,
nɛ i ka kita ke,
‘Ke a nane ma he nɛ i to
nɛ a jɔɔ a he ngɛ ɔ fii!’ ”
12Ye nyɛmimɛ, nyɛɛ hyɛ saminya, konɛ nyɛ ti nɔ ko kó hɛɛ juɛmi yaya nɛ be hae nɛ e he ye, nɛ e ko ba tsɔ Mawu hɛ kalɔ ɔ hɛ mi atuã. 13Mohu ɔ, nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ sibi nɛ tu he wami womi munyu daa ligbi nɛ nyɛ ma nyɛ ma de ke “mwɔnɛ ɔ.” Kɛkɛ ɔ, yayami be nyɛ ti nɔ ko sisie nɛ e gbo Mawu tue. 14Ejakaa wa hɛ nɛ wa kɛ fɔ Kristo nɔ kɛ je sisije ɔ, ke wa hɛɛ mi kpɛii hluu kɛ ya si nyagbe ɔ, lɛɛ wa peeɔ nihi nɛ a kɛ Kristo pee kake.
15 Kaa bɔ nɛ ngmami ɔ deɔ ɔ,
“Mwɔnɛ ɔ, ke nyɛ nu e gbi ɔ,
nyɛ ko wa tue
kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ pee
benɛ a tsɔ Mawu hɛ mi atuã a.”
16 Mɛnɔmɛ lɛ a nu Mawu gbi, nɛ a tsɔ atuã a? Anɛ pi nihi nɛ Mose kɛ mɛ je Egipt ɔ tsuo lo? 17Mɛnɔmɛ lɛ Mawu mi mi fu mɛ jeha nyingmi eywiɛ sɔuu ɔ? Anɛ pi mɛ ji nihi nɛ pee yayami nɛ a fiaa si gbo ngɛ nga a nɔ ɔ lo? 18Benɛ Mawu ka kita ke, “He nɛ i to kaa a ya jɔɔ a he ngɛ ɔ, ke a nane ma lejɛ ɔ fii” ɔ, mɛnɔmɛ e ngɛ dee? Anɛ pi nihi nɛ gbo tue ɔ lo? 19Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, wa naa kaa a nyɛ we nɛ a ya su lejɛ ɔ; ejakaa a he we Mawu yi.

Title: HEBRI BI 4
Content:
1Mawu wo si ke e ma ha wa ma ya jɔɔ wa he ngɛ he jɔɔmi he. Siwo nɛ ɔ ngɛ kɛ ha wɔ kɛ mwɔɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ ha waa hyɛ nɛ hi, konɛ e ko ba mi kaa nyɛ ti nɔ ko ya nyɛ we nɛ e su lejɛ ɔ. 2Ejakaa wɔ hu a fiɛ sane kpakpa a ngɔ tsɔɔ wɔ kaa bɔ nɛ a fiɛ ngɔ tsɔɔ mɛ ɔ nɔuu. A nu sɛ gbi ɔ lɛɛ, se e he ya bɛ se nami ha mɛ; ejakaa ni nɛmɛ nɛ nu ɔ ngɔɛ a hɛ kɛ fɔɛ nɔ́ nɛ a nu ɔ nɔ. 3 Wɔ nɛ wa he ye ɔ, wɔɔ lɛɛ wa ma ya jɔɔ wa he kaa bɔ nɛ Mawu wo si ɔ. Mawu de ke,
“Ye mi mi wo la nɛ i ka kita ke,
‘He nɛ i to nɛ a ya jɔɔ a he ngɛ ɔ,
ke a nane ma lejɛ ɔ fii!’ ”
Mawu de enɛ ɔ, pohu níhi nɛ e to e yi mi kaa e maa pee ɔ, be nɛ e bɔ je ɔ tɔɔ nɛ e gbe lɛ tsuo nya. 4 Ejakaa nɔ́ nɛ ngmami ɔ he ko deɔ ngɛ ligbi kpaagone ɔ he ji, “Ligbi kpaagone ɔ, Mawu jɔɔ e he, nɛ e tsu we nɔ́ ko.” 5 Ngmami ɔ deɔ ngɛ he ko hu ke, “He nɛ i to nɛ a ya jɔɔ a he ngɛ ɔ, ke a nane ma lejɛ ɔ fii!” 6E fɔɔ si paa kaa ni komɛ kɛ̃ maa sɛ mi, pohu ni nɛmɛ nɛ a fiɛ sane kpakpa a ngɔ tsɔɔ kekle ɔ na we jamɛ a he jɔɔmi ɔ; ejakaa a he we Mawu yi. 7 Se Mawu to be kpa kɛ ha kikɛmɛ a he jɔɔmi ɔ, nɛ be ɔ ji “Amlɔ nɛ ɔ.” Be babauu se ɔ, Mawu ha David tu munyu nɛ ɔ kaa bɔ nɛ a wo ta momo ɔ ke,
“Mwɔnɛ ɔ, ke nyɛ nu e gbi ɔ,
nyɛ ko wa tue.”
8 Ejakaa kaa Yoshua ha mɛ he jɔɔmi ɔ, jinɛ Mawu ko tu we ligbi kpa ko he munyu hu pee se. 9Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e fɔɔ si paa kaa he jɔɔmi be ko ngɛ ha Mawu ma a nɛ a maa ye. 10 Ejakaa nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ma na he jɔɔmi nɛ Mawu wo he si ɔ, e maa jɔɔ e he kaa Mawu, nɛ e be ní tsue. 11Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ ha nɛ waa bɔ mɔde, konɛ wa nine nɛ su he jɔɔmi nɛ ɔ nɔ, nɛ nɔ ko kó gbo tue kaa mɛ, nɛ e ba laa blɔ.
12Ejakaa Mawu munyu hɛ ngɛ, e ngɛ he wami, nɛ e nya ba pe klaate nya enyɔtsɛ. E gbuu kɛ sɛɛ nɔ mi kɛ ya siɔ e gbaa klaa, kɛ mumi ɔ mi, kɛ jehanɛ hu kpɔji nya amɛ, kɛ wu mi zɔ ɔmɛ a mi. Mawu munyu ɔ jeɔ adesa tsui mi níhi, kɛ e yi mi tomi kpo. 13Nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko be nɛ a kɛ laa Mawu. Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi fɔɔ si paa ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi. Nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ maa bu lɛ nitsɛ e we akɔtaa ngɛ e hɛ mi.
Yesu ji osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa kpetekpleenyɛ
14Nyɛ ha nɛ waa hɛɛ hemi kɛ yemi nɛ wa jajeɔ ɔ mi wawɛɛ. Ejakaa wa ngɛ osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa kpetekpleenyɛ nɛ po mi kɛ ho hiɔwe ya tɔɔ. Lɛ ji Yesu, Mawu Bi ɔ. 15Wa osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa a, e pi nɔ nɛ be nyɛe maa nu wa gbɔjɔmi ɔmɛ a he ha wɔ. Osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa nɛ wa ngɛ ɔ, Abosiami ka lɛ ngɛ blɔ tsuaa blɔ nɔ kaa wɔ nɔuu, se lɛɛ e pee we yayami. 16Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ ha waa kɛ kã nɛ hɛ wɔ kɛ su Mawu dloomi sɛ ɔ he, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ a na wɔ mɔbɔ, nɛ wa na dloomi nɛ maa ye bua wɔ ngɛ be nɛ sa mi.

Title: HEBRI BI 5
Content:
1Osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa a, a hlaa lɛ kɛ jeɔ e nyɛmimɛ nɛ mɛ hu he lo kɛ muɔ ji mɛ a kpɛti. E ní tsumi ji kaa e da nimli adesahi tsuo a nane mi, nɛ e ngɔ nike ní kɛ ba ha Mawu, konɛ e sã bɔ nɛ Mawu nɛ ngɔ ma a he yayami kɛ pa mɛ. 2Osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa a nitsɛ ɔ, sé ngɛ e he. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e taa bua si ha nihi nɛ li nɔ́ ko mi, kɛ nihi nɛ tlaa blɔ ɔ. 3 Akɛnɛ lɛ nitsɛ ɔ sé ngɛ e he ɔ, e hia kaa e sã bɔ, pi kɛ ha ma a kɛkɛ, se ngɛ lɛ nitsɛ hu e yayami ɔmɛ a he. 4 Hɛ mi nyami nɛ ɔ, nɔ ko ngɔɛ kɛ ha lɛ nitsɛ e he. Mawu pɛ lɛ hlaa nɔ, nɛ e woɔ lɛ osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa kaa bɔ nɛ e hla Aaron ɔ.
5 Jã nɔuu kɛ̃, hɛ mi nyami nɛ Kristo ná kaa osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa a, pi lɛ nitsɛ nɛ e ngɔ kɛ fɔ e nɔ. Mawu lɛ wo e hɛ mi nyami nɛ e de lɛ ke,
“Ye Bi ji mo,
mwɔnɛ ɔ, i fɔ mo.”
6 Mawu de ngɛ ngmami ɔ he kpa hu ke,
“Osɔfo ji mo kɛ yaa neneene
kaa Melkizedek pɛ.”
7 Benɛ Yesu ngɛ he lo mi ɔ, ngmlaa, kɛ hɛ mi vo nyu nɛ e kɛ kpa Mawu, nɔ pɛ nɛ ma nyɛ je lɛ kɛ je gbenɔ mi ɔ pɛɛ. Akɛnɛ e yeɔ Mawu gbeye he je ɔ, Mawu hu bu lɛ tue. 8Mawu Bi ji lɛ mohu, se kɛ gu amanehlu nɛ e na a mi ɔ, e kase tue bumi. 9Benɛ Mawu ha nɛ e hi kɛ pi si ɔ, e ba pee nɔ nɛ haa nihi nɛ buɔ lɛ tue ɔ naa neneene yi wami hemi. 10Nɛ Mawu wo lɛ osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa kaa Melkizedek pɛ.
Nyɛɛ hɛɛ nyɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ mi wawɛɛ
11Wa ngɛ munyuhi fuu nɛ wa maa tu ngɛ enɛ ɔ he, se e sisi tsɔɔmi wa, nɛ nyɛ nɔ́ sisi numi yee. 12 Jinɛ be nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, e sa kaa nyɛ pee tsɔɔli, se hyɛ nyɛ mohu nɛ amlɔ nɛ ɔ, e hia kaa a tsɔɔ nyɛ Mawu munyu ɔ mi sisije ní ɔmɛ ekohu. Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, nyɔ nyu lɛ hi ha nyɛ, pi niye ní nitsɛ. 13Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ngɛ nyɔ pupɔe ɔ, bimwɔyo ji lɛ kɛ mwɔɔ, nɛ e li nɔ́ ko ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ da he. 14Se nihi nɛ wa a, a nɔ ji niye ní nitsɛ. Mɛɛ lɛɛ a tsɔse a juɛmi, nɛ a le slɔɔto nɛ ngɛ kpakpa kɛ yayami a kpɛti.

Title: HEBRI BI 6
Content:
1Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ ha wa si sisije níhi nɛ kɔɔ Kristo he ɔ, nɛ waa ya wa hɛ mi kɛ tsɔɔmi nɛ sa nihi nɛ wa ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ mi. Sisije níhi nɛ wa tsɔɔ nyɛ ɔ, e hia we kaa wa pa hi lɔ ɔmɛ tsɔɔe kpamisa. Wa de nyɛ ke je mi bami yaya nɛ he be se nami ɔ, nyɛɛ ngmɛɛ he, konɛ nyɛ he Mawu nyɛɛ ye. 2Níhi nɛ wa tsɔɔ nyɛ nɛ kɔɔ nɔ sɔlemi, nine nɛ a kɛ pueɔ nɔ nɔ, gbogboehi a si temi, kɛ nyagbe kojomi he ɔ, e hia we kaa waa hi lɔ ɔmɛ tsɔɔe kpamisa. 3Ke Mawu suɔ ɔ, wa maa ya wa hɛ mi.
4Nihi nɛ he we Kristo yi hu ɔ, kɛ nɔ ko maa pee kɛ tsake mɛ ekohu kɛɛ? Be ko ɔ, a na Mawu la a, Mawu nike ní ɔ hu a tso hyɛ, nɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ hu ba a nɔ. 5A kpa si kaa Mawu munyu ɔ hi, nɛ he wami nɛ maa hi si ngɛ je nɛ maa ba a mi ɔ, a nu he. 6Kɛkɛ nɛ a gbee si. Jehanɛ ɔ nɛ a je blɔ ngɛ Mawu Bi ɔ sɛue ekohu, nɛ a ngɛ lɛ ahlua bɔe kikɛ nɛ ɔ, kɛ nɔ ko maa pee kɛɛ nɛ e ha a tsake a tsui?
7Zugba nɛ hiɔmi nɛɔ pueɔ nɔ babaaba, nɛ nyu ɔ sɛɔ zu mi, nɛ ní nɛ a duɔ ɔ baa saminya kɛ ha nihi nɛ tsuɔ ní ngɛ nɔ ɔ Mawu gbaa zugba a lɛ. 8 Se ke mio, kɛ hu lɛ puɛɔ ngɛ nɔ ɔ, lɛɛ se nami ko be he kulaa. Mawu maa gbiɛ zugba a, nɛ nyagbe ɔ, a kɛ la maa sã lɛ.
9Wa huɛmɛ nɛ wa suɔ, ke wa ngɛ munyu tue kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ po, nyɛɛ lɛɛ wa heɔ nyɛ yeɔ kaa nyɛ ngɛ nɔ́ kpakpa pee, nɛ lɔ ɔ ma ha nɛ Mawu ma he nyɛ yi wami. 10Mawu yi tue gbogboe sane. Ní nɛ nyɛ tsu, kɛ suɔmi nɛ nyɛ je kpo ha lɛ ɔ, e hɛ be nɔ jee gblegbleegble. Nyɛ pee enɛ ɔ kɛ sɔmɔ ní klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ, nɛ nyɛ ngɛ pee kɛ mwɔɔ. 11Nɔ́ nɛ wa ngɛ hlae ji kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ hɛdɔ tsu nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, nyɛ ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ maa hɛɛ mi kɛ ya si nyagbe. Kɛkɛ ɔ, níhi nɛ nyɛ ngɔ nyɛ hɛ ngɔ fɔ nɔ ɔ, nyɛ ma na a nɔ mi mami. 12Nyɛ ko pee hejɔ; se mohu nihi nɛ he Mawu ye, nɛ a to a tsui si, nɛ lɔ ɔ he a nine su nɔ́ nɛ Mawu wo si ɔ nɔ ɔ, nyɛɛ kase mɛ.
Mawu ma e munyu ɔ nɔ mi
13Benɛ Mawu wo Abraham si ɔ, e ka lɛ kita kɛ ma nɔ mi. Akɛnɛ nɔ ko be nɛ pe lɛ Mawu ɔ he je ɔ, e ngɔ lɛ nitsɛ e biɛ kɛ ka kita. 14 E de ke, “I ngɛ mo si woe kaa ma gbaa mo, nɛ ma ha o nina maa hiɛ babauu.” 15Abraham to e tsui si, nɛ e nine su nɔ́ nɛ Mawu ke e ma ha lɛ ɔ nɔ. 16Ke nɔ ko ma ka kita a, e ngɔɔ nɔ ko nɛ pe lɛ biɛ kɛ kaa, nɛ e kɛ maa munyu nɛ e tu ɔ nɔ mi. 17Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ nihi nɛ Mawu wo mɛ si ɔ, a yi mi nɛ tɛ mɛ kaa Mawu tsakee we e yi mi tomi ɔ, e ka kita kɛ ma nɔ mi. 18E tsɔɔ kaa nɔ́ enyɔ nɛ ɔmɛ be tsakee gblegbleegble, nɛ Mawu hu be a he lakpa yee. Kɛkɛ ɔ, kɛ gu a nɔ ɔ, wɔ nihi nɛ wa ba sa we ngɛ Mawu ngɔ ɔ, e maa wo wɔ he wami, konɛ waa pɛtɛ nɔ́ nɛ wa ngɔ wa hɛ ngɔ fɔ nɔ ɔ he nɛ wa. 19 Nɔ́ nɛ wa ngɔ wa hɛ kɛ fɔ nɔ nɛ ɔ ngɛ kaa osɛkɛ nɛ nu wɔ kɛ da si kpɛii, nɛ e kɛ wɔ ya su sɔlemi tsu ɔ mi pomi bo ɔ se tɔɔ. 20 Wa he ɔ, Yesu sɛ wa hɛ mi kɛ ho lejɛ ɔ ya, nɛ e ya pee osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa kɛ yaa neneene kaa Melkizedek pɛ.

Title: HEBRI BI 7
Content:
Osɔfo Melkizedek
1Melkizedek ɔ, Salem matsɛ, kɛ Mawu Ope ɔ we osɔfo ji lɛ. Be ko ɔ, Abraham kɛ matsɛmɛ komɛ ya hwu ta, nɛ e ye a nɔ. Benɛ e kpale kɛ ma a, e kɛ Melkizedek ba kpe, nɛ Melkizedek gbaa lɛ. 2 Abraham hu ha lɛ ta yibu ní tsuo nɛ e na a mi mi dlami nyɔngma mi kake. Kekleekle ɔ, e biɛ Melkizedek ɔ sisi ji, “Matsɛ nɛ yeɔ dami sane.” Jehanɛ hu, Salem matsɛ ji lɛ; lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e biɛ ɔ tsɔɔ kaa e ji, “Matsɛ nɛ e kɛ tue mi jɔmi baa.” 3A wui Melkizedek tsɛ, loo e nyɛ ta; e weku kpa ko be ɔ, be nɛ a fɔ lɛ, kɛ be nɛ e gbo hu nɔ ko li. E ngɛ kaa Mawu Bi ɔ, nɛ e ngɛ osɔfo yee kɛ yaa neneene.
4Nyɛɛ hyɛ nɔmlɔ nɛ ɔ we agboje! Abraham, wa nɛ̃ nɛ he biɛ ɔ po ha lɛ ta yibu ní ɔ nɛ e na ngɛ ta mi ɔ tsuo mi mi dlami nyɔngma mi kake. 5 Levi nina a, ni nɛmɛ nɛ hɛɛ osɔfo blɔ nya a, mlaa tsɔɔ kaa a he mi dlami nyɔngma mi kakaaka ngɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a nyɛmimɛ Israel fɔfɔɛ ɔmɛ a dɛ, pohu a nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, mɛ hu Abraham nina ji mɛ. 6Melkizedek ɔ, pi Levi nina ji lɛ, se e he mi dlami nyɔngma mi kake ɔ ngɛ Abraham, nɔ nɛ lɛɛ Mawu wo lɛ si ɔ dɛ, nɛ e gbaa lɛ. 7E fɔɔ si paa kaa nɔ nɛ nɔ kuɔ lɛ gbaa nɔ nɛ ngɛ e sisi. 8Hiɛ ɔ, ni nɛmɛ nɛ heɔ mi dlami nyɔngmanyɔngma mi kakaaka a, nimli adesahi kɛkɛ ji mɛ, nɛ a gboɔ. Se ngɛ he ko lɛɛ nɔ nɛ a ye e he odase kaa e maa hi si kɛ maa ya neneene ɔ, lɛ nɛ he. 9Lɛɛ wa ma de ke kɛ gu Abraham nɔ ɔ, a he mi dlami nyɔngma mi kake ɔ ngɛ Levi nɛ jinɛ lɛ nɛ heɔ mi dlami nyɔngmanyɔngma mi kakaaka a hu e dɛ. 10Ejakaa benɛ Abraham kɛ Melkizedek kpe ɔ, Levi ngɛ e nɛ̃ Abraham mi mi kɛ mwɔɔ. 11Kaa Levi, nɛ e yi nɔ a wo mlaa a, e nina nɛ yeɔ osɔfo ɔ tsu ní bɔ nɛ sa a, jinɛ e he be hiae kaa osɔfo kpa ko kaa Melkizedek nɛ pi Aaron nina ji lɛ kulaa a nɛ ba. 12Ejakaa ke a tsake osɔfo yemi blɔ nya tomi ɔ, lɛɛ e hia kaa a tsake mlaa a hulɔ. 13Jehanɛ hu, nɔmlɔ ɔ nɛ a de ní nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ e he ɔ, wɛtso kpa kulaa mi no ji lɛ; nɛ nɔ ko ji jamɛ a wɛtso ɔ mi nɛ e ba sɔmɔ ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he gblee. 14Wa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ, wa le kaa Yuda wɛtso ɔ mi nɛ e je; nɛ Mose de we nɔ́ ko kɛ kɔ Yuda wɛtso ɔ osɔfo yemi he.
Osɔfo nɛ ngɛ kaa Melkizedek
15Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ wa ngɛ dee ɔ mi tsɔ paa, ejakaa osɔfo kpa ba nɛ ngɛ kaa Melkizedek. 16Mawu lɛ wo lɛ osɔfo; pi ngɛ adesa mlaa nɛ tsɔɔ weku mi nɛ e je ɔ nya. Se mohu wami nɛ ngɛ daa, nɛ nɔ ko be nyɛe ma kpata hɛ mi ɔ he wami nɔ nɛ a gu kɛ wo lɛ osɔfo. 17 Ejakaa ngmami ɔ deɔ ke, “Osɔfo ji mo kɛ yaa neneene kaa Melkizedek pɛ.” 18Lɛɛ mlaa momo ɔ nɛ he wami be mi, nɛ he be se nami hulɔ ɔ, a po mi. 19Ejakaa Mose mlaa a nyɛ we nɛ e pee nɔ́ ko nɛ hi kɛ pi si. Se nɔ́ nɛ wa ngɔ wa hɛ kɛ fɔ nɔ jehanɛ ɔ hi saminya; nɛ wa nyɛɔ wa hɛɛ kɛ suu Mawu he.
20Mawu ka kita hu kɛ ma enɛ ɔ nɔ mi; ni komɛ lɛɛ benɛ a wo mɛ osɔfo ɔ, Mawu ka we kikɛmɛ a kita nɛ ɔ. 21 Se Yesu lɛɛ, Mawu ka kita nɛ e kɛ wo lɛ osɔfo. Mawu de lɛ ke,
“I ngɛ mo kita kae, nɛ i be ye nya se kpalee.
‘Osɔfo ji mo kɛ yaa neneene.’ ”
22Slɔɔto nɛ ngɛ mi ji Yesu ba pee nɔ nɛ a gu e nɔ kɛ so somi nɛ hi pe kulaa.
23Slɔɔto kpa hu nɛ ngɛ ji kaa jamɛ a osɔfo ɔmɛ a he hiɛ babauu, ejakaa gbenɔ ha we nɛ a se nɛ kɛ nɛ a kɛ tsu ní. 24Se Yesu lɛɛ e ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene, nɛ e we osɔfo yemi ɔ se pui gblegbleegble. 25Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nihi tsuo nɛ maa gu e nɔ kɛ ba Mawu ngɔ, amlɔ nɛ ɔ jio, hwɔɔ se jio, e ma he a yi wami. Ejakaa e ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene, nɛ e ngɛ Mawu pɛɛ kpae ha mɛ.
26Lɛɛ Yesu ji osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa nɛ sa wɔ. E ngɛ klɔuklɔu; sé ko be e he ɔ, e pee we yayami hulɔ. E je e he kɛ je yayami peeli a he, nɛ a wo e nɔ kɛ po mi kɛ ho hiɔwe tɔɔ ya. 27 Osɔfo kpahi nɛ ye osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa a, e be kaa mɛ. E hia we kaa daa ligbi ɔ, e sã yayami pami bɔ ngɛ lɛ nitsɛ e yayami he kekle, loko e ba sã ngɛ ma a tsuo nɔ́ ɔ he. Benɛ e ngɔ lɛ nitsɛ e he kɛ sã bɔ ɔ, blɔɔ e sã bɔ ɔ tsuo si kake nyɔngloo. 28Mose mlaa a nya a, nihi nɛ a wo mɛ osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa a, sé ngɛ a he. Se si nɛ Mawu wo nɛ e ka kita ngɔ fɔ nɔ ngɛ Mose mlaa a se ɔ, lɔ ɔ a kɛ wo Mawu Bi ɔ nɛ hi kɛ pi si kɛ yaa neneene ɔ osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa.

Title: HEBRI BI 8
Content:
Yesu, wa osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa a
1 Nɔ́ nɛ wa ngɛ dee ɔ we oti ɔ tsɔɔ kaa wa ngɛ nɔ ko nɛ ji osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa nɛ hii si ngɛ Mawu matsɛ sɛ ɔ hiɔ nɔ ngɛ hiɔwe. 2E sɔmɔɔ ngɛ he klɔuklɔu pe kulaa nɛ ji bo tsu nitsɛnitsɛ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nitsɛ ma, se pi nɔmlɔ adesa ko nɛ ma a.
3A woɔ osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa, konɛ e ngɔ nike ní kɛ ha Mawu, nɛ e sã bɔ ha lɛ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, wa osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa a hu e hia nɛ e ná nɔ́ ko nɛ e kɛ ha Mawu. 4Je nɛ ɔ mi nɛ e ngɛ jinɛ e be osɔfo yee kulaa. Ejakaa osɔfohi ngɛ nɛ ngɔɔ nike ní kɛ haa Mawu kaa bɔ nɛ Yuda mlaa a tsɔɔ ɔ. 5 Ní nɛ osɔfo ɔmɛ tsuɔ ɔ ngɛ kaa ní tsumi nɛ a tsuɔ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ henɔ, loo e nini kɛkɛ. Mose hu kikɛ nɛ ɔ nɔuu e tsu ní. Benɛ e maa ma bo tsu ɔ, Mawu de lɛ ke, “Hyɛ nɛ o pee ní ɔmɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ kaa henɔ nɛ i tsɔɔ mo ngɛ yo ɔ nɔ ɔ.” 6Amlɔ nɛ ɔ lɛɛ osɔfo ní tsumi nɛ a ha Yesu ɔ pã osɔfo ɔmɛ a nɔ́ ɔ kulaa. Jã kɛ̃ somi nɛ Yesu ha nɛ Mawu kɛ e ma a so ɔ hu pe a nɔ́ ɔ, ejakaa Mawu wo mɛ si ngɛ ní kpakpahi nɛ pe kekle ní ɔmɛ a he.
7Kaa tɔmi ko be kekleekle somi ɔ he ɔ, jinɛ somi enyɔne he hia we. 8 Se Mawu na kaa a tɔ̃; enɛ ɔ he je nɛ e de ke,
“Be ma nɛ
i kɛ Israel, kɛ Yuda maa so somi he.
9Somi he nɛ ɔ maa slo kulaa ngɛ somi nɛ
i kɛ a nɛmɛ ɔmɛ so blema
benɛ i je mɛ kɛ je Egipt ɔ he.
Somi nɛ i kɛ mɛ so ɔ,
a yi nɔ;
lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i ngmɛɛ a he.
10Jehanɛ lɛɛ somi nɛ i kɛ
Israel maa so hwɔɔ se ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Ma ngɔ ye mlaa a kɛ wo a juɛmi mi,
nɛ ma ngma ngɔ to a tsui nɔ.
Ma pee a Mawu,
nɛ mɛ hu a maa pee ye ma.
11Nɔ ko be e huɛ, loo e nyɛmi dee ke,
‘Moo le Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ.’
Ejakaa nɔ tsuaa nɔ maa le mi
kɛ maa je nɔ nyafii pe kulaa nɔ
kɛ yaa si nɔ nguaa pe kulaa nɔ.
12Ma na mɛ mɔbɔ ngɛ a tɔmi ɔmɛ a he;
nɛ i be a he yayami ɔmɛ kaie hu gblegbleegble.
Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ lɛ de.”
13Ke Mawu ngɛ somi he he munyu tue ɔ, lɛɛ e ngɛ tsɔɔe kaa kekleekle somi ɔ wo momo. Jehanɛ hu, nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ wo momo, loo e bwɔ ɔ, e be kɛe nɛ e maa laa.

Title: HEBRI BI 9
Content:
Mawu jami ngɛ hiɔwe kɛ zugba
1Kekleekle somi ɔ hɛɛ blɔ nya tomi nɛ a kɛ ma ja Mawu, kɛ he ko hulɔ nɛ adesa pee nɛ ngɛ klɔuklɔu nɛ a ma ja Mawu ngɛ. 2 A ma bo tsu, nɛ a po mi enyɔ. A tsɛɛ bo tsu ɔ he nɛ a guu kɛ sɛɛ mi ɔ he klɔuklɔu.
