Kane tso, kɛ okplɔɔ kɛ e nɔ abolo klɛdɛɛ ɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. 3 A tsɛɛ tsu mi pomi bo enyɔne ɔ se bo tsu ɔ he klɔuklɔu pe kulaa. 4 Níhi nɛ ngɛ tsu nɛ ɔ mi ji tsopa kɛ e he via sami la tɛ nɛ a kɛ sika tsu pee ɔ, somi daka a nɛ a kɛ sika tsu ha he ɔ kɛ e mi sika tsu kplu ɔ nɛ mana a ngɛ mi ɔ, Aaron dɛma tso ɔ nɛ tsɛ̃ ba be ko ɔ, kɛ tɛ tɛtlɛɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ nɛ a ngma mlaa amɛ ngɛ a nɔ ɔ. 5 Kerubhi nɛ tsɔɔ Mawu hɛ mi nyami ɔ daa si ngɛ somi daka nya nɔ́ ɔ nɔ, nɛ a gbɛ a pɛlihi a mi ngɛ he nɛ a kɛ tɔmi paa ngɛ ɔ. Se wa be nyɛe ma gba níhi a mi fitsofitso amlɔ nɛ ɔ.
6 Ke a to níhi blɔ nya kikɛ nɛ ɔ, osɔfo ɔmɛ yaa kekleekle bo tsu ɔ mi daa ligbi ya tsuɔ a jami blɔ nya ní. 7 Se bo tsu enyɔne ɔ lɛɛ osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa a pɛ lɛ yaa lejɛ ɔ si kake ngɛ jeha mi. Pohu ja e hɛɛ lohwe muɔ kɛ ya ngɛ yayami nɛ lɛ nitsɛ e pee, kɛ yayamihi nɛ ma a li a he be nɛ a pee ɔ a he. 8Nɔ́ nɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ ngɛ tsɔɔe ngɛ blɔ nya tomi nɛ ɔmɛ a mi ji kaa be abɔ nɛ kekleekle bo tsu ɔ maa si kɛ mwɔɔ ɔ, lɛɛ a na we nɛ a bli blɔ nɛ a guu kɛ yaa he klɔuklɔu pe kulaa a lolo. 9Enɛ ɔ tsuo ji okadi nɛ kɔɔ mwɔnɛmwɔnɛ ɔ si himi he. E tsɔɔ kaa nike níhi, kɛ bɔ ɔmɛ nɛ a sãã kɛ haa Mawu ɔ be nyɛe ma ha nɛ nɔ nɛ ma Mawu jami ɔ tsui mi ma tsɔ bɔ nɛ sa; 10ejakaa niye ní, kɛ dã, kɛ he tsumi kusumihi pɛ a he nɛ e kɔɔ. Enɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ɔ, he lo blɔ fa mi níhi nɛ maa hi si kɛ yaa si be nɛ Mawu maa pee níhi tsuo ehe kɛkɛ.
11Se Kristo ba kaa osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa kɛ ha blɔ nya tomi kpakpa nɛ wa na nɛ ɔ. Bo tsu nɛ e sɔmɔɔ ngɛ mi ɔ kle, nɛ e hi kɛ pi si. Pi adesa nɛ pee, nɛ tsɔɔ kaa pi je nɛ ɔ mi níhi nɛ a bɔ ɔ eko. 12Benɛ Kristo gu bo tsu ɔ mi kɛ ya sɛ he klɔuklɔu pe kulaa a, e pee nɔ́ nɛ ɔ si kake nyɔngloo. Pi to, loo na muɔ nɛ e kɛ sã bɔ ɔ; mohu ɔ, e ngɔ lɛ nitsɛ e muɔ ngɔ ha, konɛ e kɛ he wa yi wami kɛ ya neneene. 13 To kɛ na muɔ, kɛ na bi nɛ a sã a la zu ji níhi nɛ a kɛ fĩaa nihi nɛ ble a he ɔ a nɔ, nɛ a kɛ tsuɔ a nɔmlɔ tso ɔ he ngɛ he lo blɔ fa mi. 14Ke enɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ mi niinɛ ɔ, lɛɛ Kristo muɔ nɛ e gu Mumi Klɔuklɔu nɛ ngɛ daa a nɔ nɛ e kɛ pue si ɔ tsu ní kulaa pe jã. Bɔ ɔ nɛ Kristo nɛ sé ko be e he ɔ ngɔ e he kɛ sã, nɛ e gbo ngɛ wa he ɔ ma ha nɛ wa ma je wa hɛ kɛ je kusumihi nɛ a he be se nami ɔ a he, nɛ wa ma sɔmɔ Mawu hɛ kalɔ ɔ.
15Nɔ́ nɛ Kristo tsu nɛ ɔ tsɔɔ kaa lɛ Kristo ɔ ji nɔ nɛ ha Mawu kɛ e ma a so somi he ɔ, konɛ nihi nɛ Mawu tsɛ mɛ ɔ, a nine nɛ su neneene gbosi ní nɛ Mawu wo he si ɔ nɔ. Ejakaa benɛ a kɛ kekleekle somi ɔ ngɛ ní tsue ɔ, nɔ ko ba gbo nɛ e kɛ kpɔ nihi tsuo nɛ pee yayami jamɛ a be ɔ.
16Loko a maa ngɔ nɔ ko gbosi ní yemi he blɔ nya tomi womi kɛ tsu ní ɔ, e hia kaa a ye odase kaa niinɛ nɔ ɔ be je mi hu. 17Ejakaa ke nɔ ko ngɛ je mi ɔ, gbosi ní yemi blɔ nya tomi womi nɛ e pee ɔ, a kɛ tsu we ní; ja e gbo. 18Enɛ ɔ he je nɛ kekleekle somi ɔ po muɔ a kɛ ma nɔ mi ɔ nɛ. 19 Kekleekle ɔ, Mose tsɔɔ ma a mlaa amɛ tsuo nɛ Mawu wo ɔ kaa bɔ nɛ mlaa a nitsɛ tsɔɔ ɔ. Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e ngɔ nga nɛ a fi kɛ bla kaa bɛ, kɛ jijɔ he bwɔmi tsutsuu kɛ sɔ na kɛ to muɔ, kɛ nyu, nɛ e kɛ fĩa womi kpo ɔ nitsɛ, kɛ ma mluku ɔ tsuo a nɔ. 20Benɛ e ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ pee ɔ, e de ma a ke, “Somi nɛ Mawu kɛ nyɛ so ɔ, muɔ nɛ a kɛ sɔu nya ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.” 21 Bo tsu ɔ, kɛ kplu ɔmɛ nɛ a kɛ jaa Mawu ɔ, Mose ngɔ muɔ kɛ fĩa mɛ tsuo a nɔ jã nɔuu. 22 Niinɛ, ngɛ mlaa a nya a, muɔ ji nɔ́ nɛ tsuɔ níhi tsuo a he; nɛ ke a pue we muɔ si ɔ, a kɛ yayami pɛ.
Kristo ngɔ e he kɛ sã bɔ kɛ je wa he yayami
23Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, je nɛ ɔ mi níhi nɛ ji hiɔwe ní ɔmɛ a henɔ ɔ lɛ e sa kaa a peeɔ kusumi kaa jã kɛ tsuɔ a he. Se hiɔwe ní nitsɛnitsɛ ɔmɛ lɛɛ e hia kaa a pee kusumi nɛ hi pe ja kulaa nɛ a kɛ tsu a he. 24Ejakaa Kristo ɔ, pi he klɔuklɔu pe kulaa nɛ a kɛ nine pee, nɛ ji nɔ́ nitsɛ ɔ henɔ kɛkɛ ɔ mi nɛ e ya. Mohu ɔ, hiɔwe nitsɛnitsɛ nɛ e ho; nɛ amlɔ nɛ ɔ, e ngɛ lejɛ ɔ ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi ngɛ wa he. 25Yuda osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa a yaa he klɔuklɔu pe kulaa a daa jeha kɛ muɔ nɛ pi lɛ nitsɛ e nɔ. Se Kristo ya lejɛ ɔ, pi nɛ e ngɔ e he ya sã bɔ si abɔ. 26Kaa jã a, jinɛ kɛ je be nɛ a bɔ je ɔ, amanehlu sɔuu Kristo maa hi nae kpitikpiti. Mohu ɔ, amlɔ nɛ ɔ nɛ je mi nyagbe miɔ nɛ e maa su ɔ, Yesu ba je e he kpo si kake nyɔngloo. E ngɔ e he kɛ sã bɔ kɛ je wa he yayami. 27Mawu to kaa adesa nɛ gbo si kake, nɛ lɔ ɔ se ɔ, a kojo lɛ. 28 Jã nɔuu Kristo hu a ngɔ lɛ kɛ sã bɔ si kake pɛ, konɛ e kɛ je adesa he yayami. E maa ba si enyɔne ɔ, pi nɛ e ba tsu yayamihi a he ní hu, se mohu e ma ba he nihi nɛ ngɛ lɛ blɔ hyɛe wawɛɛ ɔ a yi wami.

Title: HEBRI BI 10
Content:
1Yuda bi ɔmɛ a mlaa a ngɛ kaa ní kpakpahi nɛ hi kɛ pi si nɛ maa ba hwɔɔ se ɔ a nini kɛkɛ, pi ní ɔmɛ nitsɛmɛ. Lɛɛ kɛ a maa pee kɛ gu kikɛmɛ a bɔ kake too nɛ a hii sãe nɔtonɔto daa jeha a nɔ kɛ tsu nihi nɛ baa Mawu ngɔ ɔ a he nɛ a hi kɛ pi si kɛɛ? 2Nihi nɛ jaa Mawu ɔ, kaa a je a he yayami ɔmɛ niinɛ ɔ, a he nile be mɛ fɔ bue ngɛ a he yayami he hu, nɛ e be hiae kaa a sã bɔ hu. 3Se anɔkuale mi ɔ, bɔhi nɛ a sãã daa a haa nɛ a kaiɔ a he yayami ɔmɛ mohu. 4Ejakaa na muɔ, kɛ to muɔ be nyɛe ma je yayami gblegbleegble.
5 Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, benɛ Kristo ma je ɔ mi ɔ, e de Mawu ke,
“Bɔ nɛ a sãã, kɛ nike ní ɔ,
o hla we,
se o ha mi nɔmlɔ tso.
6Sami bɔ, kɛ yayami pami bɔ ɔ,
o bua jɔɛ he.
7Kɛkɛ nɛ i de ke,
‘Mawu, ne mi!
I ba konɛ ma ba pee o suɔmi nya ní
kaa bɔ nɛ ngmami ɔ deɔ ngɛ ye he
ngɛ mlaa womi ɔ mi ɔ.’ ”
8Kekleekle ɔ, Kristo de Mawu ke, “Bɔ, kɛ nike ní ɔ, o hla we; sami bɔ, kɛ yayami pami bɔ ɔ, o na we he bua jɔmi.” E de enɛ ɔ, pohu bɔhi nɛ a sãã a, mlaa a nya a sãã ngɛ. 9Jehanɛ hu, e de ke, “Mawu, ne mi! I ba, konɛ ma ba pee o suɔmi nya ní.” Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, bɔhi tsuo nɛ a sãã blema a, Mawu po mi, nɛ e ngɔ Kristo nɔ́ ɔ kɛ to nane mi. 10Yesu Kristo pee Mawu suɔmi nya ní; e ngɔ e nɔmlɔ tso ɔ kɛ sã bɔ si kake too nyɔngloo, nɛ e kɛ je wɔ tsuo wa he yayami.
11 Yuda osɔfo tsuaa Yuda osɔfo ɔ, e ní tsumi ji kaa e sã bɔ kake too ɔ si abɔ daa ligbi; se bɔ ɔmɛ nyɛ we nɛ a jeɔ yayami gblegbleegble. 12 Se Kristo lɛɛ bɔ kake too e ngɔ e he kɛ sã kɛ je yayami kɛ yaa neneene, nɛ e ya hi si ngɛ Mawu hiɔ nɔ. 13Lejɛ ɔ nɛ e ngɛ mlɛe ngɛ kɛ yaa si Mawu maa ngɔ e he nyɛli ɔmɛ kɛ pee nɔ́ nɛ e kɛ e nane maa nɔ. 14Enɛ ɔ tsɔɔ kaa bɔ kake too ɔ nɛ Kristo ngɔ e he kɛ sã a ha nɛ nihi tsuo nɛ Mawu tsu a he ɔ hi kɛ pi si kɛ yaa neneene.
15Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ hu yeɔ enɛ ɔ he odase. Kekleekle ɔ, e de ke,
16 “Be ma nɛ i kɛ ye ma a maa so
somi nɛ ɔ:
Ma ngɔ ye mlaa kɛ to a tsui mi,
nɛ ma ngma kɛ wo a juɛmi mi.”
17 E de hu ke, “A he yayami ɔmɛ, kɛ mlaa nɔ tɔmihi nɛ a pee ɔ, i be kaie hu.” Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ lɛ de. 18Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke Mawu ngɔ nihi a he yayami kɛ pa kikɛ nɛ ɔ, e he hia we hu kaa a sã bɔ kɛ je yayami hu.
Nyɛ ha waa hɛ wɔ kɛ su Mawu he
19Ye nyɛmimɛ, kɛ gu Kristo gbenɔ ɔ nɔ ɔ, wa ngɛ he blɔ faa nɛ wa yaa he klɔuklɔu pe kulaa a. 20Yesu gu tsu mi pomi bo nɛ ji lɛ nitsɛ e nɔmlɔ tso ɔ mi nɛ e bli blɔ he nɛ yaa wami mi ha wɔ. 21Wa ngɛ osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa nɛ hyɛɔ Mawu we ɔ nɔ. 22 Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ ha nɛ waa ngɔ tsui nɛ mi tsɔ, kɛ hemi kɛ yemi nɛ pi si kɛ hɛ wɔ kɛ su Mawu he. Nyɛ ha a tsu wa tsui he bɔ nɛ wa he nile be wɔ fɔ bue, nɛ́ waa pee kaa nihi nɛ a kɛ nyu nɛ mi tsɔ heii du a he. 23Nɔ́ nɛ wa ngɔ wa hɛ ngɔ fɔ nɔ, nɛ wa yeɔ he odase ɔ, nyɛ ha waa pɛtɛ he nɛ wa nɛ wa ko mimiɛ, ejakaa Mawu nɛ wo si ɔ, anɔkualetsɛ ji lɛ. 24Nyɛ ha waa kɛ hɛdɔ nɛ susu he bɔ nɛ sa, nɛ waa suɔ wa sibi, nɛ waa pee wa sibi kpakpa. 25Nyɛ ko ha wa jɔɔ wa he nya buami kaa bɔ nɛ ni komɛ hlaa peemi ɔ. Mohu ɔ, nyɛ ha waa ya nɔ nɛ waa wo wa sibi he wami wawɛɛ, titli ɔ, akɛnɛ nyɛ le kaa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ bami be ɔ su ta a.
26Amlɔ nɛ ɔ nɛ wa na le anɔkuale ɔ nɛ kɔɔ sane kpakpa a he ɔ, ke wa je blɔ ngɛ yayami pee kɛ mwɔɔ ɔ, bɔ kpa ko be nɛ a maa sã kɛ je yayami ɔ. 27 Mohu ɔ, waa kɛ gbeye yemi nɛ hyɛ kojomi nɛ ma a, kɛ la gegeege nɛ ma kpata nihi nɛ teɔ si kɛ siɔ Mawu a hɛ mi ɔ blɔ. 28 Ke nɔ ko tɔ Mose mlaa a, nɛ a da ni enyɔ, loo etɛ a we odase nɔ kɛ bu lɛ fɔ ɔ, a nɛ́ lɛ mɔbɔ; pe a gbeɔ lɛ. 29 Lɛɛ nɔ ko nɛ hia nane kɛ si Mawu Bi ɔ, nɛ Kristo muɔ nɛ a kɛ sɔu somi ɔ nya kɛ tsu e he ɔ, e buu lɛ kaa yaka nɔ́ ko kɛkɛ, nɛ jehanɛ hu, e wo Mawu mumi ɔ mi mi la a, kɛ a maa pee lɛ kɛɛ? Anɛ e sɛ́ kaa a gblaa e tue wawɛɛ pe jã lo? 30 Ejakaa wa le kaa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ lɛ de ke, “Ma ye ye he lue! Ma gbla a tue ngɛ yayami nɛ e pee ɔ he.” Lɛ nɔuu lɛ e de ke, “Ma kojo ye ma a.” 31Nɔ nɛ Mawu hɛ kalɔ ɔ nine maa gbe lɛ ɔ, musu tloo lɛ!
32Nyɛ kai bɔ nɛ nyɛ hi si sa a. Benɛ nyɛ ba le Mawu ɔ, nyɛɛ kɛ hɛ mi miami na amanehlu babauu. 33Be komɛ ɔ, a jɛɔ nyɛ, nɛ a peeɔ nyɛ nisɛ ní ngɛ ma hɛ mi; nɛ be komɛ hu, a buu nyɛ kɛ piɛɔ nihi nɛ a ngɛ mɛ yi mi wae ɔ a he. 34Niinɛ, nyɛ mi mi sã nyɛ ngɛ nihi nɛ a wo mɛ tsu ɔ a he; nɛ benɛ a ngɛ nyɛ níhi tsuo kpɔe ngɛ nyɛ dɛ pani nya a, nyɛɛ kɛ bua jɔmi ngmɛɛ he ha mɛ faa. Ejakaa nyɛ le kaa nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ nine su nɔ ɔ hi kulaa pe lɔ ɔmɛ, nɛ e ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene hulɔ. 35Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ kɔni mi ko jɔ̃ ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ ngɔ nyɛ hɛ ngɔ fɔ nɔ ɔ he, ejakaa nyɛ nine maa su hiɔwo agbo ko nɔ. 36E hia kaa nyɛɛ to nyɛ tsui si, nɛ nyɛɛ pee Mawu suɔmi nya ní, konɛ nɔ́ nɛ e wo he si ɔ, nyɛ nine nɛ su nɔ. 37 Ejakaa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ de ke,
“E piɛ bɔɔ pɛ nɛ nɔ nɛ ma a ma ba su si;
e be kɛe kulaa.
38Ye ma a, nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da, nɛ a heɔ mi yeɔ ɔ, mɛɛ a yi ma na wami. Se nɔ nɛ kpaleɔ e se ɔ, i be e he bua jɔmi nae.” 39Nihi nɛ kpaleɔ ngɛ Mawu se, nɛ a hɛ mi kpataa a, pi mɛ ji wɔ. Wɔɔ lɛɛ wa piɛɔ ni nɛmɛ nɛ hɛɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ mi ɔ a he, nɛ a he wa yi wami.

Title: HEBRI BI 11
Content:
Hemi kɛ yemi
1Hemi kɛ yemi ji níhi nɛ wa ngɛ blɔ hyɛe ɔ a nɔ mi mami. Hemi kɛ yemi tsɔɔ wɔ kaa níhi nɛ wa nɛ́ kɛ wa hɛngmɛ ɔ, a ngɛ niinɛ. 2Hemi kɛ yemi lɛ ha nɛ Mawu ná nihi nɛ hi si blema a a he bua jɔmi.
3 Hemi kɛ yemi lɛ ha wa nu sisi kaa Mawu munyu a kɛ bɔ je ɔ. Enɛ ɔ tsɔɔ kaa níhi nɛ wa nɛ́ ɔ, lɔ ɔmɛ Mawu ngɔ kɛ pee níhi nɛ wa naa a.
4 Hemi kɛ yemi Habel kɛ sã bɔ nɛ sa Mawu hɛ mi kulaa pe Kain nɔ́ ɔ. Kɛ gu e hemi kɛ yemi ɔ nɔ ɔ, Mawu bu lɛ nɔ nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da; ejakaa Mawu nitsɛ bua jɔ e nike ní ɔ he. Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, Habel be je mi lɛɛ, se kɛ gu hemi kɛ yemi ɔ nɔ ɔ, e kɛ wɔ ngɛ munyu tue kɛ mwɔɔ.
5 Hemi kɛ yemi he ɔ, a ngɔ Henok kɛ ho hiɔwe ya, konɛ e ko gbo. A nɛ́ lɛ, ejakaa Mawu ngɔ lɛ kɛ je. Ngmami ɔ ye odase kaa loko a maa ngɔ lɛ kɛ ho ɔ, e pee nɔ́ nɛ sa Mawu hɛ mi. 6Ke nɔ ko be hemi kɛ yemi ɔ, e be nyɛe maa sa Mawu hɛ mi. Ejakaa e hia kaa nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa hɛ lɛ kɛ su Mawu he ɔ, e he ye kaa Mawu ngɛ; nɛ nihi nɛ hlaa e se blɔ ɔ, e gbaa mɛ.
7 Hemi kɛ yemi lɛ ha nɛ Noa bu Mawu tue, benɛ e de lɛ ke nɔ́ ko ma nɛ bɛ hyɛ ɔ. E kpɛ lɛ nɛ a kɛ he e kɛ e yo kɛ e bimɛ a yi wami. Kɛ gu enɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ, je ɔ yeɔ fɔ kaa a pee yayami; se Noa lɛɛ Mawu wo lɛ nguɔ kaa nɔ nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi nya.
8 Hemi kɛ yemi lɛ ha nɛ Abraham bu Mawu tue, benɛ a tsɛ lɛ nɛ a de lɛ ke e je he nɛ e ngɛ ɔ kɛ ya zugba nɛ ma ba pee e weto ní ɔ nɔ. Abraham pue nɔ kɛ ho, pohu e li he nɛ e yaa. 9 Hemi kɛ yemi lɛ ha nɛ Abraham ya to nubwɔ ngɛ zugba nɛ Mawu wo lɛ si ke e ma ha lɛ ɔ nɔ be saii. E kɛ Isak, kɛ Yakob nɛ siwo ɔ kɔɔ a he ɔ hi bo tsuhi a mi. 10Ejakaa ma nɛ Abraham ngɛ blɔ hyɛe ji ma nɛ Mawu nitsɛ to sisi, nɛ lɛ nɔuu e fia.
11 Hemi kɛ yemi lɛ ha Abraham na he wami nɛ a kɛ fɔɔ bi be mi nɛ e bwɔ, nɛ Sara nitsɛ hu pee yosa, ejakaa e bu nɔ nɛ wo lɛ si ɔ anɔkualetsɛ. 12 Enɛ ɔ he ɔ, Abraham nɔ kake too nɛ ngɛ kaa nɔ ko nɛ yi ta a, e nina ba hiɛ babauu kaa dodoehi ngɛ hiɔwe, loo wo nya zia nɛ hi kanemi.
13 Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ he Mawu ye ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ a wo mɛ he si ɔ, a nine sui nɔ loko a gbo. A na ní ɔmɛ ngɛ lokoo kɛkɛ nɛ a nya he, nɛ a ye odase ngɛ ma hɛ mi kaa nibwɔhi, kɛ ma se bi kɛkɛ ji mɛ. 14Enɛ ɔ tsɔɔ kaa nihi nɛ tuɔ munyu kikɛ nɛ ɔ, ngɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a ma hlae. 15Ma mi he nɛ a je ɔ, a ngɛ he susue jinɛ a ko na he blɔ nɛ a kpale kɛ ho lejɛ ɔ ya. 16Mohu ɔ, ma ko nɛ hi kulaa pe lɔ ɔ, nɛ ji ma nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ji nɔ́ nɛ a ngɛ hlae. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e pee we Mawu zo kaa a ma tsɛ lɛ ke a Mawu; ejakaa e dla ma ko ngɔ to mɛ.
17 Hemi kɛ yemi lɛ ha nɛ Abraham ngɔ e bi Isak kɛ ha Mawu, benɛ Mawu ka lɛ hyɛ ɔ. E ngɛ mi kaa bi nɛ ɔ he si nɛ a wo Abraham lɛɛ, se kɛ̃ e pee klaalo kaa e maa ngɔ e bi kake too ɔ kɛ sã bɔ ha Mawu. 18 Mawu de Abraham ke, “O bi Isak lɛ ma ba wo nina ha mo.” 19Abraham he ye kaa Mawu ngɛ he wami nɛ e kɛ ma tle Isak si kɛ je gbeje tete. Nɛ ke a ma de ngɛ blɔ ko nɔ ɔ, Mawu tle lɛ si kɛ je gbeje ha Abraham niinɛ.
20 Hemi kɛ yemi lɛ Isak kɛ gbaa Yakob kɛ Esau kɛ ha hwɔɔ se je mi si himi.
21 Hemi kɛ yemi lɛ ha nɛ benɛ Yakob miɔ nɛ e ma gbo ɔ, e ma e yi si ngɛ e dɛma tso ɔ nɔ, nɛ e sɔle nɛ e gbaa Yosef bimɛ ɔmɛ.
22 Hemi kɛ yemi lɛ ha nɛ benɛ Yosef gbenɔ be su ta a, e tsɔɔ Isarel bi ɔmɛ bɔ nɛ a ma plɛ kɛ je Egipt ha, nɛ e de mɛ bɔ nɛ a pee e gbogboe ɔ hulɔ.
23 Hemi kɛ yemi lɛ ha nɛ Mose fɔli ɔmɛ ngɔ lɛ kɛ laa nyɔhiɔ etɛ benɛ a fɔ lɛ ɔ. A na kaa e he ngɛ fɛu saminya, nɛ mlaa a nɛ Egipt matsɛ ɔ wo ɔ, a yi mlaa a he gbeye.
24 Hemi kɛ yemi lɛ ha nɛ benɛ Mose ba wa a, e kplɛɛ we kaa a tsɛ lɛ Egipt matsɛ ɔ biyo ɔ bi. 25E suɔ mohu kaa e kɛ Mawu ma a nɛ na amanehlu pe nɔ́ nɛ e maa ye ngɔɔmi ngɛ yayami peemi mi be bɔɔ ko. 26Ngɛ Mose susumi nya a, ke a bɔ nɔ ko ahlua ngɛ Kristo ɔ he ɔ, juetli babauu nɛ ngɛ Egipt ɔ po he jua wɛ kaa lɔ ɔ, ejakaa e hɛ ngɛ hiɔwo nɛ e ma na hwɔɔ se ɔ nɔ.
27Hemi kɛ yemi lɛ ha nɛ Mose je Egipt nɛ e yi matsɛ ɔ mi mi fumi ɔ gbeye. E kpale we e se, ejakaa Mawu nɛ e nɛ́ kɛ e hɛngmɛ ɔ, e pɛtɛ e he wawɛɛ kaa nɔ́ nɛ e ngɛ lɛ hyɛe paa. 28 Hemi kɛ yemi lɛ Mose kɛ to Hetsɔmi ɔ sisi, nɛ e fã Israel bi ɔmɛ ke a ngɔ muɔ kɛ fĩa a sinya tso ɔmɛ a he, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ bɔfo nɛ kpataa nɔ hɛ mi ɔ ko ba gbe Israel bi ɔmɛ a bitɛte ɔmɛ.
29 Hemi kɛ yemi lɛ ha Israel ma a po Wo Tsu ɔ kaa nɔ́ nɛ zugba gbigbli nɔ nɛ a ngɛ nyɛɛe. Se benɛ Egipt bi ɔmɛ ka kaa mɛ hu a maa pee ja a, a tlɔ wo ɔ mi, nɛ a gbo.
30 Hemi kɛ yemi nya nɛ Yeriko gbogbo ɔmɛ hule pue si benɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ bɔle ma a ligbi kpaago ɔ. 31 Hemi kɛ yemi lɛ ha nɛ Rahab, yaholɔ ɔ gbo we kɛ piɛ we tue gboli nɛ a kpata a hɛ mi ɔ a he, ejakaa nihi nɛ ya slaa zugba a, e he mɛ kɛ bua jɔmi.
32 Anɛ e hia kaa ma pa de nɔ́ ko lo? Be ngɛ jinɛ i ko sɛɛ nyɛ Gideon, Barak, Samson, Yefta, David, Samuel, kɛ gbali ɔmɛ tsuo a he ní. 33 Hemi kɛ yemi lɛ ha nɛ nimli nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ mahi hwu ta, nɛ a ye kunimi; a ha nɛ jatahi ma a nya. 34 Hemi kɛ yemi a kɛ gbe la nɛ ngɛ tsoe gegeege ngɛ hehi, hemi kɛ yemi ha a je klaate nya, e ha ni wudɔwudɔhi ba pee katsɛmɛ; a kɛ ta buli nɛ je ma se hwu ta, nɛ a ye kunimi. 35 Kɛ gu hemi kɛ yemi nɔ ɔ, yi komɛ a weku li nɛ gbo ɔ, a tle mɛ si kɛ ba wami mi ekohu.
A wa ni komɛ yi mi wawɛɛ, nɛ a kplɛɛ we kaa a maa ngmɛɛ a hemi kɛ yemi ɔ he, nɛ a ye a he. Mohu ɔ, a suɔ nɛ a na nɔ́ kɛ gbo, konɛ a tle mɛ si kɛ ba wami nɛ hi kulaa pe kekle nɔ ɔ mi. 36 A ye ni komɛ a he fɛu; a fia ni komɛ kpa, nɛ ni komɛ lɛɛ a bɔ mɛ pã, nɛ a wo mɛ tsu. 37 A fia ni komɛ tɛ nɛ a gbo; a kɛ sau poo ni komɛ a mi enyɔɔnyɔ; nɛ a kɛ klaate gbe ni komɛ. A bu jijɔ he womi, kɛ apletsi he womi kaa heha ní. A ye ohia, a wa mɛ yi mi, nɛ a pee mɛ nisɛ ní. 38Je ɔ sɛ́ nimli nɛ ɔmɛ! A wo lalaalo ngɛ nga kplanaa nɔ, kɛ yohi a nɔ. A hi tɛ puɔhi, kɛ muɔhi a mi.
39Hyɛ nihi abɔ nɛ he Mawu ye, nɛ a ngɛ odase kpakpa nɛ ɔ yee ngɛ a he! Se nɔ́ nɛ Mawu wo si ɔ, a ti nɔ ko nɔ ko nine sui nɔ. 40Ejakaa Mawu to blɔ nya kpakpa ha waa kɛ mɛ tsuo, nɛ ja wa piɛ he loko níhi maa hi kɛ pi si.

Title: HEBRI BI 12
Content:
Wa Tsɛ Mawu
1Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ hyɛ nimli kpekpemi nitsɛnitsɛ kaa bɔku nɛ tsu a hemi kɛ yemi he ní nɛ bɔle wɔ kɛ kpe. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, níhi tsuo nɛ tsiɔ wɔ blɔ, titli ɔ, yayami peemi nɛ gblaa wɔ se ɔ, nyɛ ha waa ngmɛɛ he, konɛ waa kɛ hɛ mi miami nɛ tu fo nɛ fɔɔ si ngɛ wa hɛ mi ɔ. 2Nyɛ ha waa hyɛ Yesu, ejakaa e nɔ wa hemi kɛ yemi ɔ daa si ngɛ. Akɛnɛ e le bua jɔmi nɛ e ma na pee se he je ɔ, gbenɔ nɛ e ma gbo ngɛ sɛumi tso ɔ nɔ ɔ pi zo nɔ́ ko kulaa kɛ ha lɛ. Mohu ɔ, e to e tsui si kɛ na amanehlu ngɛ sɛumi tso ɔ nɔ, nɛ amlɔ nɛ ɔ, e hii si ngɛ Mawu matsɛ sɛ ɔ hiɔ nɔ.
3Nyɛ susu si nɛ yayami peeli te ngɔ wo lɛ ɔ, kɛ bɔ nɛ e to e tsui si kɛ na nɔ́ wawɛɛ ɔ he, konɛ pɔ ko tɔ nyɛ, nɛ nyɛ kɔni mi ba jɔ̃. 4Ta nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ yayami ngɛ hwue nɛ ɔ, nyɛ sui he nɛ a ma de ke a ma pue nyɛ muɔ si ngɛ ɔ lolo. 5 Anɛ nyɛ hɛ je bua womi munyu nɛ kɛ nyɛ tuɔ munyu kaa bɔ nɛ a kɛ bimɛ tuɔ munyu ɔ nɔ lo?
“Ye bi, koo ngɔ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ tsɔsemi ɔ kaa
nɔ́ ko nyafii;
nɛ jehanɛ ke e gbla o tue ɔ,
ko ha o nine mi nɛ wo nyu.
6Ejakaa nɔ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ suɔ ɔ lɛ e tsɔseɔ, nɛ e fiaa nɔ
tsuaa nɔ nɛ e ngɔ peeɔ e bi ɔ kpa.”
7Nyɛɛ to nyɛ tsui si ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ nae ɔ mi kaa Mawu lɛ ngɛ nyɛ tsɔsee kaa e bimɛ ji nyɛ. Te bi nɛ ngɛ nɛ e fɔli tsɔse we lɛ nɛɛ? 8Tsɔsemi nɛ a haa nihi tsuo ɔ, ke nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ na we ɔ, lɛɛ ajuama mi bimɛ ji nyɛ, nɛ nyɛ pi e bimɛ nitsɛnitsɛmɛ. 9Jehanɛ hu, adesa blɔ fa mi ɔ, wa ngɛ tsɛmɛ nɛ tsɔseɔ wɔ, nɛ wa buɔ mɛ. Anɛ e sɛ kaa wa baa wa he si ha Tsɛ ɔ nɛ ngɛ mumihi a nɔ he wami ɔ, konɛ wa yi nɛ na wami lo? 10Wa tsɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsɔseɔ wɔ be bɔɔ ko kɛkɛ bɔ nɛ sa mɛɛ a hɛ mi; se Mawu lɛɛ e tsɔseɔ wɔ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ e hi ha wɔ, nɛ wɔ hu waa pee klɔuklɔu kaa lɛ. 11Be mi nɛ a ngɛ nɔ ko tsɔsee ɔ, bua jɔmi be mi; e dɔɔ lɛ wawɛɛ. Nihi nɛ a tsɔse mɛ ɔ, pee se ɔ, a naa he se; a yeɔ dami sane, nɛ enɛ ɔ he ɔ, a hii si ngɛ he jɔmi mi.
Ga womi kɛ kɔkɔ bɔmi
12 Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ ninehi nɛ mi jɔ, kɛ nakutsohi nɛ ngɛ kpokpoe ɔ, nyɛ wlua nyɛ, nɛ nyɛ nɔ gbagba nɛ te. 13 Nyɛɛ nyɛɛ blɔ nɛ da nɔ, konɛ glɔ̃ nane ɔ kó to kpa, se mohu a tsa lɛ.
14Nyɛɛ bɔ mɔde nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ nihi tsuo nɛ hi si ngɛ tue mi jɔmi mi. Nyɛɛ bɔ mɔde nɛ nyɛɛ pee klɔuklɔu, ejakaa nɔ nɛ be klɔuklɔu ɔ, e be Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nae. 15 Nyɛɛ hyɛ nɛ hi nɛ Mawu dloomi ɔ kó bɔ nɔ ko. Nyɛɛ hyɛ nɛ nɔ ko nɔ́ ko ko dɔ nyɛ kadikadi nɛ ba ble níhi babauu kɛ puɛ ní. 16 Nɔ ko kó pee e he yaholɔ, loo mu ní tsulɔ kaa Esau, nɔ nɛ jua e tɛte blɔ nya kɛ he niye ní nya mi bɔ kake ɔ. 17 Nyɛ le kaa pee se benɛ e hla kaa e tsɛ nɛ gbaa lɛ ɔ, e tsɛ ɔ kplɛɛ we. Esau kɛ hɛdɔ fo ya kaa e ma kpale e nya se, se e na we he blɔ.
18 Pi Sinai yo ɔ nɛ a be nyɛe maa ta he ɔ he nɛ nyɛ ba. Be ko benɛ Israel bi ɔmɛ ya lejɛ ɔ, diblii, kɛ bɔku wo kpii, kɔɔhiɔ hia huu, nɛ la ngɛ tsoe plamplam ngɛ yo ɔ nɔ. 19Titimati ngɛ pɛe, nɛ nɔ ko ngɛ munyu tue. Benɛ a nu gbi ɔ, a kpa pɛɛ ke a ko de nɔ́ ko kɛ piɛ he hu. 20 Ejakaa mlaa a nɛ a wo mɛ ke, “Ke lohwe tete nane sa yo ɔ he ɔ, a fia lɛ tɛ nɛ a gbe” ɔ, a be nyɛe nɔ nɛ a ye. 21 Niinɛ, nɔ́ nɛ a je kpo tsɔɔ mɛ ɔ he ngɛ gbeye tsɔ; nɛ Mose nitsɛ po de ke, “I ngɛ gbeye yee, nɛ ye he ngɛ doe blibliibli.”
22Amlɔ nɛ ɔ lɛɛ nyɛ ba su Zion yo ɔ, nɛ ji Mawu hɛ kalɔ ɔ ma a he. Nyɛ ba su hiɔwe Yerusalem ngɛ Mawu kɛ e bɔfohi babauu nɛ a be nyɛe kanemi, nɛ a bua kɛ ngɛ nyae ɔ a ngɔ. 23Nyɛ ba sɛ bitɛtehi nɛ a ngma a biɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ a kpɛti. Mawu nɛ ji adesahi tsuo a kojolɔ ɔ, kɛ mumihi nɛ hɛɛ nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da, nɛ a ha a hi kɛ pi si ɔ, a hɛ mi nyɛ ba nɛ ɔ nɛ. 24Yesu, nɔ nɛ ha a so somi he ɔ, e ngɔ nyɛ ba nɛ ɔ nɛ. Muɔ nɛ a fĩa, nɛ tsuɔ ní kpakpahi nɛ pe Habel nɔ́ ɔ he nyɛ ba a nɛ.
25 Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ nɛ kɛ nyɛ ngɛ munyu tue ɔ, nyɛɛ bu lɛ tue. Nihi nɛ bui nɔ nɛ bɔ mɛ kɔkɔ ngɛ zugba a nɔ tue ɔ, a yi a he. Nɛ wɔɔ lɛɛ ke nɔ nɛ je hiɔwe ɔ kɛ wɔ ngɛ munyu tue nɛ wa bui lɛ tue ɔ, kɛ wa maa pee kɛ ye wa he kɛɛ? 26 Jamɛ a be ɔ mi ɔ, gbi nɛ Mawu wo ɔ ha nɛ zugba a mimiɛ; se jehanɛ lɛɛ e wo si ke, “Pi zugba a kɛkɛ nɛ ma mimiɛ si kake ekohu, se mohu ma ha nɛ hiɔwe hu ma mimiɛ kɛ piɛ he.” 27Munyu, “Si kake ekohu” ɔ, tsɔɔ paa kaa níhi nɛ a bɔ nɛ a mimiɛ ɔ maa je a hi he, konɛ níhi nɛ a be nyɛe ma mimiɛ ɔ nɛ a hi si daa.
28Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ ha waa na Mawu si, ejakaa e ha wɔ blɔ nya nɛ waa ye tsɛ nɛ be tsakee gblegbleegble. Nyɛ ha waa ngɔ bu, kɛ gbeye yemi kɛ ba ja lɛ kɛ wa tsui tsuo bɔ nɛ maa sa e hɛ mi; 29 ejakaa wa Mawu ɔ, la nɛ kpataa nɔ́ hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ ji lɛ.

Title: HEBRI BI 13
Content:
Bɔ nɛ wa maa sa Mawu hɛ mi
1Nyɛɛ ya nɔ nɛ nyɛɛ suɔ nyɛ sibi daa kaa nyɛmimɛ. 2 Nyɛ ko jɔɔ nibwɔ peemi hulɔ, ejakaa nibwɔ peemi nɔ nɛ ni komɛ gu kɛ he hiɔwe bɔfohi atuu nɛ a li tete. 3Nyɛ kai nihi nɛ a wo mɛ tsu ɔ kaa nɔ́ nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ mɛ tsuo lɛ a wo tsu. Nyɛ kai nihi nɛ a ngɛ mɛ yi mi wae ɔ kaa nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ nitsɛmɛ mohu nɛ a ngɛ yi mi wae.
4Nyɛ ha gba si himi he nɛ tsɔ, nɛ nyumu kɛ yo nɛ a ye a sibi anɔkuale. Ejakaa Mawu maa kojo yaholi, kɛ gba puɛli.
5 Nyɛ ko di sika se; nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ ɔ, nyɛ bua nɛ jɔ he. Ejakaa Mawu de ke, “I be mo sie, nɛ i be mo kuae gblegbleegble.” 6 Lɛɛ nyɛ ha waa kɛ kã nɛ de ke,
“Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ji ye he piɛlɔ,
i be gbeye yee.
Mɛni adesa ma nyɛ maa pee mi?”
7Nyɛ hɛ mi nyɛɛli ɔmɛ nɛ ngɔ Mawu sɛ gbi ɔ ba ha nyɛ ɔ, nyɛ kai mɛ. Nyɛɛ hyɛ bɔ nɛ a hi si saminya hluu kɛ ya si a gbenɔ be; nyɛɛ hyɛ bɔ nɛ a he Mawu ye ha, nɛ nyɛɛ kase mɛ. 8Yesu Kristo ɔ, bɔ nɛ e ngɛ hiɛ ɔ, ja nɔuu e ngɛ mwɔnɛ ɔ; nɛ e ngɛ ja nɔuu kɛ yaa neneene. 9Nyɛ ko ha ni komɛ nɛ ngɔ tsɔɔmi slɔɔtoslɔɔtohi nɛ kɛ sane kpakpa a kɔ we nɛ je nyɛ kɛ je blɔ kpakpa a nɔ. Mawu dloomi ɔ lɛ woɔ wa mumi mi he wami; se mlaahi nɛ kɔɔ niye ní he ɔ, se nami ko kulaa be he kɛ ha nihi nɛ yeɔ nɔ ɔ.
10Wa ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ko nɛ nihi nɛ sɔmɔɔ ngɛ bo tsu ɔ mi ɔ be he blɔ kaa a yeɔ e nɔ ní. 11 Yuda bi a we osɔfo nɔkɔtɔma pe kulaa a ngɔɔ lohwehi a muɔ kɛ ya sãã bɔ ngɛ he klɔuklɔu pe kulaa a, konɛ Mawu nɛ ngɔ ma a he yayami kɛ pa mɛ. Se lohwe ɔmɛ nɛ a gbe ɔ nitsɛmɛ lɛɛ a ya sãã ngɛ ma sito he ɔ se. 12Jã kɛ̃ Yesu hu na amahehlu ngɛ ma a agbo ɔ se, konɛ e ngɔ lɛ nitsɛ e muɔ ɔ kɛ je ma a he yayami. 13Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ ha nɛ waa ya e ngɔ ngɛ ma sito he ɔ se, nɛ a bɔ wɔ ahlua ngɛ lejɛ ɔ kaa bɔ nɛ a pee lɛ ɔ. 14Ejakaa wa be ma nɛ ngɛ daa ngɛ zugba a nɔ hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ, se ma nɛ maa ba a mohu se blɔ wa ngɛ hlae. 15Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e hia kaa wa je Mawu yi daa. Wɔ nihi nɛ wa heɔ Mawu yeɔ ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ waa kɛ wa nya jaje ɔ kɛ jeɔ e Bi ɔ yi ɔ ji bɔ nɛ wa ngɛ sãe ha Mawu kɛ gu Yesu Kristo nɔ ɔ nɛ. 16Nyɛ hɛ ko je kpakpa peemi nɔ; nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ sibi nɛ dla níhi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ ɔ. Ejakaa jamɛ a bɔ ɔmɛ saa Mawu hɛ mi saminya.
17Nyɛɛ bu nyɛ hɛ mi nyɛɛli ɔmɛ tue, nɛ nyɛɛ ba nyɛ he si ha mɛ. Mɛ lɛ a hyɛɔ nyɛ nɔ daa, nɛ a maa bu akɔtaa ha Mawu. Nyɛ ha nɛ a pee enɛ ɔ kɛ bua jɔmi, se pi kɛ mi mi la, ejakaa lɔ ɔ maa ye nyɛ awi.
18Nyɛɛ sɔle ha wɔ daa. Wa le kaa wa he nile bui wɔ fɔ; ejakaa be tsuaa be ɔ, wa suɔ kaa nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ wa maa pee ɔ, bu nɛ hi he. 19I ngɛ nyɛ pɛɛ kpae nɛ nyɛɛ sɔle, konɛ a ha nɛ ma ba nyɛ ngɔ be kpiti mi.
20He jɔmi Mawu ɔ, nɔ nɛ gu muɔ nɛ a kɛ sɔu neneene somi ɔ nya a nɔ, nɛ e je to ɔmɛ a hyɛlɔ ngua a nɛ ji wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu kɛ je gbeje kɛ ba wami mi ekohu ɔ, 21e dla nyɛ kɛ pi si kɛ ní tsumi kpakpa sɔuu, konɛ nyɛɛ pee e sɔumi nya ní; nɛ kɛ gu Yesu Kristo nɔ ɔ, e ha nyɛ tsu níhi nɛ maa sa e hɛ mi, konɛ a wo e hɛ mi nyami kɛ je neneene kɛ ya neneene. Amen.
Nyagbe munyuhi
22Ye nyɛmimɛ, womi nɛ i ngma nyɛ nɛ ɔ nya kɛ we kulaa, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i kpa nyɛ pɛɛ nɛ nyɛɛ ye slɔmi ɔmɛ a nɔ. 23I ngɛ hae nɛ nyɛɛ le kaa wa nyɛmi Timoteo nɛ a wo lɛ tsu ɔ, jehanɛ lɛɛ a ngmɛɛ e he. Ke e ba su ye ngɔ mla a, i kɛ lɛ tsuo maa ba nyɛ ngɔ.
24Wa biɔ nyɛ hɛ mi nyɛɛli ɔmɛ, kɛ ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ tsuo. Ni nɛmɛ nɛ je Italia a hu ke a biɔ nyɛ.
25Mawu dloomi ɔ kɛ nyɛ tsuo nɛ hi si. Amen.

Title: YAKOBO NYA TSƆƆMI
Content:
NYA TSƆƆMI
Yakobo womi ɔ tsɔɔ bɔ nɛ sa nɛ a ba je mi ha saminya. A ngma womi ɔ kɛ mane ni klɔuklɔuhi tsuo nɛ gbɛ fĩa je ɔ mi he tsuaa he. Yakobo ngɔ munyu he za womi níhi kɛ tsɔɔ munyuhi a nya. E tu ní slɔɔtoslɔɔtohi fuu a he munyu kɛ tsɔɔ bɔ nɛ sa kaa Kristo se nyɛɛlɔ nɛ ba e je mi ha. Níhi nɛ e tu a he munyu ɔ ekomɛ ji nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ: ní nami kɛ ohia, ka, je mi bami kpakpa, nɔ he susumi yaya, hemi kɛ yemi kɛ e mi ní tsumi, nɔ́ nɛ lilɛ tsuɔ, nile, pɛ, he nɔ womi kɛ humi peemi, ni kpahi kojomi, fiami, tsui si tomi, kɛ kue fami.
Yakobo tsɔɔ wɔ ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ mi kaa ke nɔ ko he Mawu ye kɛ gu Kristo nɔ ɔ, e he hia wawɛɛ kaa a na ngɛ e ní peepee mi.
Bɔ nɛ a dla womi ɔ mi ha
Sisije 1.1
Hemi kɛ yemi kɛ nile 1.2-8
Ohia kɛ ní nami 1.9-11
Ka 1.12-18
Sane kpakpa a tue bumi, kɛ e nɔ yemi 1.19-27
A bɔ kɔkɔ ngɛ nɔ hɛ mi hyɛmi he 2.1-13
Hemi kɛ yemi, kɛ e he ní tsumi 2.14-26
Kristo se nyɛɛlɔ, kɛ e lilɛ nɔ hyɛmi 3.1-18
Kristo se nyɛɛlɔ, kɛ je ɔ 4.1—5.6
Ga womi slɔɔto komɛ 5.7-20

Title: YAKOBO 1
Content:
1 Imi Yakobo, Mawu kɛ Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo tsɔlɔ ɔ lɛ i ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ ngmae kɛ ya ha wɛtso nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ nɛ gbɛ fĩa je ɔ mi tsuo.
Nyɛ he manye!
Hemi kɛ yemi, kɛ nile
2Ye nyɛmimɛ, ke nyɛɛ kɛ ka slɔɔtoslɔɔtohi ngɛ kpee ɔ, nyɛ bua nɛ jɔ wawɛɛ mohu; 3ejakaa nyɛ le momo kaa ke nyɛ hemi kɛ yemi mi wa, nɛ nyɛ ye ka amɛ a nɔ ɔ, e woɔ nyɛ he wami nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ toɔ nyɛ tsui si. 4Nyɛɛ to nyɛ tsui si saminya kɛ gblee kahi tsuo a mi kɛ manye, konɛ nyɛɛ hi kɛ pi si kulaa, nɛ nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko kó hia nyɛ. 5Se ke nyɛ ti nɔ ko ngɛ nile hlae ɔ, e kpa Mawu pɛɛ, nɛ e ma ha lɛ; ejakaa Mawu haa nɔ nɔ́ faa nɛ mi mi gbigblimi be mi. 6Se ke o ngɛ Mawu nɔ́ ko he pɛɛ kpae ɔ, he ye, nɛ o ko je nɔ́ kulaa kaa Mawu ma ha mo nɔ́ nɛ o ngɛ bie ɔ. Nɔ nɛ jeɔ nɔ́ ɔ, e ngɛ kaa wo mi oslɔke nɛ kɔɔhiɔ ngɛ lɛ fiae kɛ ngɛ yae kɛ ngɛ bae. 7-8Nɔmlɔ nɛ jeɔ nɔ́ nɛ e juɛmi peeɔ lɛ enyɔɔnyɔ, nɛ e nyɛ we nɔ́ ko nya si mami ɔ, e ko susu kaa e ma na nɔ́ ko kɛ je Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ dɛ mi.
Ohia kɛ ní nami
9Kristo se nyɛɛlɔ ohiatsɛ ɔ, ke Mawu wo e nɔ ɔ, e fĩa; 10 nɛ Kristo se nyɛɛlɔ niatsɛ ɔ, lɛ hu ke Mawu ba lɛ si ɔ, e fĩa, ejakaa niatsɛmɛ hɛ mi ma kpata kaa mɔmɔ nglaa ngɛ nga nɔ. 11Ke pu je, nɛ je mi dɔ la a, mɔmɔ nglaa, nɛ e wɔleɔ pueɔ si, nɛ afɛu ko be e he hu. Ja nɔuu niatsɛ ɔ hu benɛ e hɛ dɔ kɛ ngɛ ní tsue ɔ, e hɛ mi ma kpata tlukaa.
Ka
12Nɔ nɛ ke a ngɛ lɛ kae ɔ, e toɔ e tsui si, nɛ e ngmɛɛ we e hemi kɛ yemi he ɔ, á gbaa lɛ. Ejakaa ke e nyɛ gblee ka a mi ɔ, neneene wami nɛ Mawu wo si kaa a ma ha nihi nɛ suɔ lɛ ɔ, e nine maa su nɔ. 13Ke a ka nɔ ko ɔ, e ko de ke Mawu lɛ ka lɛ. Ejakaa nɔ ko be nyɛe maa ka Mawu kaa e maa pee yayami lo. Pohu Mawu nitsɛ kɛ́ nɔ. 14Se nɔ tsuaa nɔ ɔ, lɛ nitsɛ e we akɔnɔ nɛ gblaa lɛ, nɛ́ sisiɔ lɛ ɔ nɛ kaa lɛ. 15Nɛ akɔnɔ ɔ, ke e ngɔ hɔ ɔ, e fɔɔ yayami, nɛ yayami hu ke e wa a, e fɔɔ gbenɔ.
16Ye nyɛmimɛ nɛ i suɔ, nyɛ ko ha nɛ a sisi nyɛ. 17Nike ní kpakpa, kɛ níhi nɛ hi kɛ pi si nɛ wa naa yaka a, lɛ tsuo Mawu lɛ haa wɔ. Mawu lɛ bɔ pu, nyɔhiɔ, kɛ dodoehi nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ. E haa nɛ a haa wɔ la daa, nɛ lɛ nitsɛ hu e tsakee we gblegbleegble. 18Mawu gu sane kpakpa a nɔ kɛ ha wɔ mumi mi wami. Lɛ nitsɛ e suɔmi nya nɛ e pee enɛ ɔ. Ejakaa e suɔ kaa e pee wɔ nihi nɛ a he hia pe nibɔ ní ɔmɛ tsuo.
Sane kpakpa a tue bumi kɛ e nɔ yemi
19Ye nyɛmimɛ nɛ i suɔ, nyɛ hɛ nɛ hi enɛ ɔ nɔ. Ke nɔ ko ngɛ munyu tue ɔ, nyɛɛ bu tue; nyɛ he ko sɔ kɛ tu munyu, nɛ nyɛ mi mi hu ko fu mla. 20Mi mi fumi ha we nɛ nɔ peeɔ Mawu suɔmi nya ní. 21Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, je mi bami yaya nɛ woɔ nɔ he mu ɔ, nyɛ kpa lɛ tsuo, nɛ nyɛ ko pee nyɛ sibi yi wu tso nihi hu. Nyɛɛ kɛ he si bami nɛ he munyu ɔ nɛ a du kɛ wo nyɛ mi ɔ, ejakaa lɔ ɔ nɛ ma he nyɛ klaa yi wami.
22Nyɛ ko sisi nyɛ he kaa nyɛ maa bu munyu ɔ tue kɛkɛ; mohu nyɛɛ pee munyu ɔ nɔ yeli. 23Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ buu munyu ɔ tue kɛkɛ, se e yi nɔ ɔ, e ngɛ kaa nɔ ko nɛ ya hyɛɛ e he ngɛ ahuhuɛ mi, nɛ e naa bɔ nɛ e ngɛ ɔ tutuutu. 24E naa bɔ nɛ e ngɛ ɔ, kɛkɛ ke e je lejɛ ɔ nɔuu pɛ e hɛ jeɔ bɔ nɛ e ngɛ ɔ nɔ. 25Sane kpakpa a ji Mawu mlaa nɛ hi kɛ pi si, nɛ haa nɔ yeɔ e he. Ke nɔ ko kase sane kpakpa a mi tsɔɔmi ɔmɛ saminya, nɛ e mia e hɛ mi nɛ e hɛ ji nɔ́ nɛ e kase ɔ nɔ, se mohu e ye nɔ ɔ, a maa gbaa lɛ saminya ngɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ e ngɛ tsue ɔ mi.
26Anɛ nyɛ ti nɔ ko susuu kaa e ngɛ Mawu jae bɔ nɛ sa lo? Jamɛ a nɔ ɔ, e kɔ e lilɛ mi. Ke e kɔɛ e lilɛ mi ɔ, tsa pi Mawu nɛ e ngɛ jae, se lɛ nitsɛ e he kɛkɛ nɛ e ngɛ sisie. 27Bɔ nɛ nɔ ko ma ja Mawu nɛ maa sa Tsɛ Mawu ɔ nitsɛ hɛ mi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: awusahi kɛ yalɔyihi nɛ e fi mɛ ɔ, e hyɛ a nɔ. Jehanɛ e hyɛ lɛ nitsɛ e he nɔ saminya, konɛ je mi akɔnɔ yaya ko tɔtɔ e nane.

Title: YAKOBO 2
Content:
Nyɛ ko hyɛ nihi a hɛ mi
1Ye nyɛmimɛ, nyɛ heɔ Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo nɛ hɛ mi ngɛ nyami ɔ yeɔ, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ ko hyɛ nɔ hɛ mi, nɛ nyɛ ko bu ni komɛ pe ni komɛ. 2Waa ngɔ lɛ kaa nyɛ ya kpe ngɛ jami he ɔ, nɛ ni enyɔ ba. Nɔ kake ha ablade bo, nɛ e wo sika tsu nguɛ ní. Nɔ kake ɔ lɛɛ ohiatsɛ ji lɛ, nɛ e ha bo gbagbɛ, loo bo sɛmusɛmu. 3Nɔ nɛ dla e he saminya a, nyɛ he lɛ atuu kɛ bu, nɛ nyɛ de lɛ ke, “I kpa mo pɛɛ, ba hi hiɛ!” Se ohiatsɛ ɔ lɛɛ, nyɛ de lɛ ke, “Dá si ngɛ lejɛ ɔ he ko!” aloo “Ba sɔ̃ si ngɛ hiɛ ɔ!” 4Tse nyɛ na nɔ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ pee ɔ! Mi gbami nyɛɛ kɛ ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti bae ɔ nɛ. Nyɛ ngɛ nyɛ sibi a he ga yaya toe.
5Ye nyɛmimɛ nɛ i suɔ, nyɛɛ bu tue. Tse nyɛ le kaa nihi nɛ je ɔ buu mɛ ohiatsɛmɛ ɔ, mɛ Mawu hla a. Akɛnɛ a heɔ Yesu yeɔ ɔ, nimli nɛ ɔmɛ ba pee mumi mi niatsɛmɛ, nɛ matsɛ yemi ɔ nɛ Mawu wo si ha nihi nɛ suɔ lɛ ɔ ba pee a nɔ. 6Se nyɛ pueɔ ohiatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a hɛ mi si. Anɛ pi niatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ nɛ waa nyɛ yi mi ɔ? Anɛ pi mɛ nɛ a ngɔɔ nyɛ kɛ yaa kojomi he ɔ? 7Biɛ kpakpa nɛ a wo nyɛ ɔ, anɛ pi mɛ nɛ a gbeɔ he guɛ ɔ?
8 E ngɛ ngmami ɔ mi ke, “Suɔ o nyɛmi kaa bɔ nɛ o suɔ mo nitsɛ o he.” Matsɛ yemi ɔ mi mlaa ji nɛ ɔ nɛ; ke o ye nɔ ɔ, lɛɛ o pee saminya. 9Se ke nyɛ hyɛɔ nihi a hɛ mi ɔ, yayami nyɛ ngɛ pee ɔ nɛ, nɛ nyɛ yeɔ fɔ kaa nyɛ tɔ mlaa. 10Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa ye mlaa amɛ tsuo a nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ, se e ma tɔ mlaa a kake ɔ, e yeɔ fɔ kaa e tɔ mlaa amɛ tsuo. 11 Mawu ɔ nɛ wo mlaa ke a ko puɛ gba a, lɛ nɔuu lɛ e wo mlaa ke a ko gbe nɔmlɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke o puɛ we gba, se o gbeɔ nɔmlɔ ɔ, o tɔ mlaa a tsuo. 12Nyɛ munyu tumi, kɛ nyɛ ní peepee tsuo nɛ tsɔɔ kaa mlaa nɛ haa wa yeɔ wa he ɔ nɛ a kɛ maa kojo wɔ. 13Ejakaa nɔ nɛ nɛ́ mɔbɔ ɔ, benɛ a maa kojo lɛ ɔ, Mawu be lɛ mɔbɔ nae; se ke o naa mɔbɔ ɔ, Mawu be mo fɔ bue.
Hemi kɛ yemi, kɛ e he ní tsumi
14Ye nyɛmimɛ, ke nɔ ko ke e ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi, se e ní peepee tsɔɔ we ja a, mɛni se nami ngɛ he? Anɛ jamɛ a hemi kɛ yemi ɔ ma nyɛ he e yi wami lo? 15Waa ngɔ lɛ kaa nyɛmimɛ komɛ be heha ní, loo niye ní. 16Ke nyɛ ha we mɛ níhi nɛ hia mɛ nɛ ɔ, mɛni se nami ngɛ he kaa nyɛ ma de mɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ ya ngɛ he jɔmi mi! Nyɛ ya hlue la; nyɛɛ ye ní nɛ nyɛɛ tɔ?” 17Hemi kɛ yemi hu ja nɔuu e ngɛ; ke ní tsumi piɛ we he ɔ, e ji hemi kɛ yemi nɛ gbo.
18Se nɔ ko ma de ke, “Moo lɛɛ o hɛɛ hemi kɛ yemi, nɛ imi lɛɛ i tsuɔ ní” Yoo, tsɔɔ mi o hemi kɛ yemi nɛ o tsu we he ní ɔ, nɛ imi hu i kɛ níhi nɛ i tsuɔ ɔ maa tsɔɔ mo kaa i heɔ yeɔ. 19Nyɛ heɔ yeɔ kaa Mawu kake pɛ lɛ ngɛ! Saminya! Mumi yayami ɔmɛ po heɔ yeɔ ja nɔuu. Nɛ lɔ ɔ haa a nuɔ sawale, nɛ a he doɔ blibliibli. 20Kuasia! O ngɛ hlae nɛ nɔ ko nɛ de mo ke hemi kɛ yemi kɛkɛ nɛ ní tsumi piɛ we he ɔ, e wui yiblii. 21 Mɛni ba loko Mawu bu wa nɛ̃ Abraham dalɔ ɔ? E ní tsumi ɔ nya! Ejakaa e ngɔ e bi Isak kɛ fɔ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ kaa e kɛ maa sã bɔ ha Mawu. 22Tse nyɛ na! Abraham he ye, nɛ e tsu he ní hulɔ. Ní nɛ e tsu ɔ ha nɛ e hemi kɛ yemi ɔ mi ba wa wawɛɛ nitsɛ. 23 Nɛ nɔ́ nɛ ngmami ɔ de ɔ ba mi ke, “Abraham he Mawu ye, nɛ e hemi kɛ yemi ɔ ha nɛ Mawu bu lɛ dalɔ.” Enɛ ɔ he nɛ a tsɛɛ Abraham ke Mawu huɛ ɔ nɛ. 24Lɛɛ tse nyɛ na kaa ní tsumi nɔ Mawu guu kɛ buɔ nɔ dalɔ, se pi hemi kɛ yemi pɛ nɔ.
25 Yo ajuama a nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Rahab ɔ, lɛ hu ja nɔuu. Mawu da nɔ́ nɛ e pee ɔ nɔ kɛ bu lɛ dalɔ. Israel bi ɔmɛ nɛ a tsɔ kɛ ya slaa zugba a nigii ɔ, Rahab he mɛ atuu; nɛ lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e tsɔɔ mɛ blɔ, nɛ a gu he kpa kɛ je slɔkee.
26Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, kaa bɔ nɛ ke mumi je nɔmlɔ tso ɔ mi nɛ e plɛɔ nɔ́ gbogboe ɔ, jã hemi kɛ yemi nɛ ní tsumi piɛ we he ɔ peeɔ hemi kɛ yemi gbogboe.

Title: YAKOBO 3
Content:
Kristo se nyɛɛlɔ nɛ hyɛ e lilɛ nɔ saminya
1Ye nyɛmimɛ, nyɛ ti nihi fuu kó pee nyɛ he tsɔɔli. Kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ le ɔ, wɔ tsɔɔli ɔmɛ ɔ, wa tue gblami nya maa wa pe ni kpa amɛ. 2Wɔ tsuo wa pɔɔ tɔmi peemi babauu. Se ke nɔ ko tɔ we ngɛ munyu tumi mi ɔ, lɛɛ nɔmlɔ nɛ hi kɛ pi si ji lɛ, nɛ e ma nyɛ maa ye e nɔmlɔ tso ɔ tsuo nɔ hulɔ. 3Ke wa ngɛ hlae nɛ okpɔngɔ nɛ bu wɔ tue ɔ, waa kɛ dade woɔ e nya mi. Kɛkɛ ɔ, he tsuaa he nɛ wa suɔ kaa e ya a, e yaa. 4Aloo waa ngɔ lɛ nɛ ngɛ pa nɔ. Ke e kle kaa mɛni, nɛ ja kɔɔhiɔ nɛ nya wa nɛ ma nyɛ tsɛ̃ e yi se po, kudɔɔ nyafii ko kɛkɛ kudɔɔtsɛ ɔ kɛ plɛɔ lɛ ɔ kɛ yaa he nɛ e suɔ. 5Ja nɔuu lilɛ ngɛ; lilɛ ngɛ nyafii lɛɛ, se e fĩaa ní nguahi. Hyɛ kaa la bɔbɔyoo pɛ maa sã hue tso! 6Ee, lilɛ ngɛ kaa la. Nɔmlɔ tso ɔ he nɔ́ kake nɛ ji lilɛ ɔ, yi wu tso ní sɔuu e tsuɔ. E kɛ yayami bleɔ nɔmlɔ tso ɔ tsuo. La nɛ je Abosiami a je nitsɛnitsɛ lɛ e kɛ mɛɛ wɔ kɛ kpataa wa hɛ mi pɛsɛɛ. 7Adesa nyɛɔ jɔɔ adebɔ ní kpahi tsuo a he, nga mi lohwehi jio, lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ jio, níhi nɛ sãã si jio, pa mi lohi jio. 8Se lilɛ lɛɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko nyɛ we nɛ e jɔɔ he gblegbleegble. E ji nɔ́ yayami nɛ jɔɛ nɔ he mi; duɔ nɛ gbee nɔ hyi lɛ tɔ. 9 Lilɛ waa kɛ naa wa Nyɔmtsɛ, kɛ wa Tsɛ Mawu ɔ si; nɛ lɛ nɔuu waa kɛ gbiɛɔ wa sibi adesa nɛ Mawu bɔ ngɛ e subai nɔ ɔ. 10Adesa lilɛ kake ɔ, e kɛ gbaa, nɛ e kɛ gbiɛɔ nɔ hulɔ. Ye nyɛmimɛ, e sɛ́ kaa e baa jã. 11Anɛ nyu hɛngmɛ baa nyu mua, kɛ nyu doodooe kɛ jee hɛngmɛ kake ɔ nɔuu mi lo? 12Ye nyɛmimɛ, anɛ ngmɔkɔ tso ma nyɛ wo oliv tso yiblii lo? Anɛ wai tso ma nyɛ wo ngmɔkɔ lo? Jã nɔuu ngo nyu be nyɛe maa pee nyu mua.
Nile nɛ je hiɔwe
13Anɛ ní lelɔ ko ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti lo? Anɛ nɔ ko ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti nɛ nuɔ nɔ́ sisi lo? Jamɛ a nɔ ɔ, e ba e je mi saminya. E ngɔ he si bami kɛ tsu ní kpakpa kɛ ye e nile ɔ he odase. 14Se ke hunga jemi yaya, kɛ pɛ ngɛ nyɛ tsui mi, nɛ nyɛ ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ ngɛ hlae kaa e hi ha lɛ nɔ kake pɛ ɔ, nyɛ ko fĩa, nɛ́ nyɛ ba ye lakpa ngɔ si anɔkuale ɔ. 15Kikɛmɛ a nile nɛ ɔ, pi hiɔwe nɛ e je; zugba nɛ ɔ nɔ nɔ́; Mawu mumi be mi, mumi yayami sɔuu. 16He nɛ hunga jemi ngɛ, nɛ nihi suɔ kaa e hi ha mɛ pɛ ɔ, lejɛ ɔ nɛ a naa sakasaka peemi, kɛ awi yemi slɔɔtohi babauu ngɛ. 17Se nɔ nɛ ngɛ nile nɛ je hiɔwe ɔ, kekleekle nɔ́ nɛ a naa ngɛ e he ji kaa e he tsɔ. Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, a naa kaa e he jɔ; e hɛ ka si, nɛ e nuɔ nɔ́ he ha nɔ. E naa nɔ mɔbɔ saminya, nɛ ní kpakpahi sɔuu e tsuɔ. E hyɛ we nihi a hɛ mi, nɛ e pee we osato. 18Nihi nɛ kpataa pɛ, nɛ a haa he jɔmi baa a, a ngɛ wu kpakpa due, nɛ yiblii nɛ a woɔ ji dami sane yemi.

Title: YAKOBO 4
Content:
Je ɔ kɛ huɛ bɔmi
1Ta kɛ pɛ nɛ ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti ɔ, mɛni kɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ baa? Anɛ pi nyɛ he lo mi akɔnɔ nɛ ngɛ ní tsue ngɛ nyɛ mi lo? 2Ke nɔ́ ko pee nyɛ akɔnɔ nɛ nyɛ nine sui nɔ ɔ, nyɛ pueɔ muɔ si. Jã kɛ̃ ke nyɛ hɛ kɔ̃ nyɛ nyɛmimɛ a níhi a nɔ, nɛ nyɛ nine sui nɔ ɔ, nyɛ woɔ pɛ, nɛ nyɛ gbaa ta kɛ woɔ nyɛ sibi. Níhi nɛ hia nyɛ ɔ, nyɛ nine sui nɔ; ejakaa nyɛ bi we Mawu. 3Ke nyɛ kpa pɛɛ hu, nyɛ nine sui nɔ, ejakaa nyɛ yi mi tomi ɔmɛ hí; níhi nɛ ma ha nyɛ bua jɔmi pɛ he pɛɛ nɛ nyɛ kpaa. 4Nyɛ gba puɛli nɛ nyɛ yi Mawu anɔkuale! Anɛ nyɛ li kaa ke nɔ ko suɔ je ɔ, nɔ ɔ ngɛ Mawu nyɛe lo? Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ e kɛ je ɔ bɔɔ ɔ, e peeɔ Mawu he nyɛlɔ. 5Anɛ nyɛ susuu kaa yaka gu nɛ a ngma ke, “Mumi nɛ Mawu ngɔ wo wa mi ɔ, e jeɔ he hunga wawɛɛ” ɔ? 6 Se mɔbɔ nɛ Mawu naa wɔ ɔ nya wa kulaa pe lɔ ɔ po. Kaa bɔ nɛ ngmami ɔ deɔ ɔ, “Nihi nɛ woɔ a he nɔ ɔ, Mawu baa mɛ si; se ni nɛmɛ nɛ baa a he si ɔ lɛɛ e dlooɔ mɛ.”
7Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ ba nyɛ he si ha Mawu. Nyɛɛ te si kɛ wo Abosiami, nɛ e maa tu nyɛ nya fo. 8Nyɛɛ hɛ nyɛ kɛ su Mawu he, nɛ e maa hɛ lɛ kɛ su nyɛ he. Yayami peeli, nyɛ fɔ nyɛ dɛ! Nyɛ yi mi enyɔɔnyɔtsɛmɛ, nyɛ tsake nyɛ tsui. 9Nyɛɛ ye kɔmɔ; nyɛɛ wo yana, nɛ nyɛ nya awe. Nyɛ kpa muɔmi, nɛ nyɛɛ wo yana. Nyɛ kpa nyami, nɛ nyɛɛ nu sawale! 10Nyɛɛ ba nyɛ he si ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ hɛ mi, nɛ e ma wo nyɛ nɔ.
Nyɛ ko tu nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ a he munyu yaya
11Ye nyɛmimɛ, nyɛ ko tu nyɛ sibi a he munyu yaya. Nɔ nɛ tuɔ e nyɛmi he nyumu yaya a, mlaa a e ngɛ munyu tue kɛ ngɛ sie ɔ nɛ; nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ kojoɔ e nyɛmi ɔ, e ngɛ mlaa a kojoe. Ke nɔ ko tuɔ munyu kɛ siɔ mlaa a, pi mlaa a nɔ yelɔ ji lɛ, se mohu e peeɔ mlaa a kojolɔ. 12Mawu pɛ ji mlaa wolɔ kɛ kojolɔ. Lɛ nɔ kake nɔuu pɛ lɛ e ngɛ he wami nɛ e kɛ heɔ nɔ yi wami, nɛ e kɛ kpataa nɔ hɛ mi hulɔ. Se moo lɛɛ mɛnɔ ji mo, nɛ o kojoɔ o nyɛmi adesa?
Nyɛ ko fĩa ngɔ fɔ hwɔɔ se nɔ
13 Jehanɛ, nyɛ ti ni komɛ deɔ ke, “Hwɔɔ, loo hwɔɔ se ɔ, ma hia blɔ kɛ ya ma ko mi, nɛ ma ya ye jeha ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Ma ya ye jua nɛ ma na ní.” 14Nyɛ ti ni nɛmɛ nɛ deɔ ja a, nyɛɛ bu tue. Anɛ nyɛ le hwɔɔ se je nami mi sane? Nyɛ ngɛ kaa afua nɛ woɔ be kpiti, kɛkɛ a nɛ́ lɛ hu. 15Nɔ́ nɛ mohu nɛ sa nɛ nyɛ deɔ ji, “Ke Mawu suɔ nɛ wa yi na wami ɔ, wa maa pee enɛ ɔ, loo enɛ.” 16Se nyɛ woɔ nyɛ he nɔ, nɛ nyɛ fĩaa. Ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ji yayami peemi.
17Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ nɛ le nɔ́ kpakpa nɛ e pee we ɔ, yayami e pee ɔ nɛ.

Title: YAKOBO 5
Content:
A ngɛ niatsɛmɛ kɔkɔ bɔe
1Jehanɛ nyɛ niatsɛmɛ hu nyɛɛ bu tue! Nyɛɛ wo yana, nɛ nyɛ nya awe; ejakaa aywilɛho sanehi maa ba nyɛ nɔ! 2 Ní babauu nɛ nyɛ na a plɛ pee kɔɔhiɔ, nɛ wɔyewɔye ye nyɛ heha ní kpakpahi. 3Sika tsu, kɛ sika hiɔ babauu nɛ nyɛ bua nya a maa nɔ kana. Jamɛ a kana a maa ye odase kɛ si nyɛ, nɛ e ma kpe nyɛ he lo kaa nɔ́ nɛ a kɛ la sã. Nyɛ ngɛ juetli babanu buae kɛ ngɛ toe nyagbe be nɛ ɔ mi. 4 Apaa yeli nɛ hu nyɛ ngmɔ ɔmɛ ha nyɛ ɔ, nyɛ wui mɛ hiɔ. Nyɛɛ hyɛ bɔ nɛ a ngɛ ngmlaa kpae boboobo ha! Ní kpali nɛ bua nyɛ ngmɔ ní nya a a ngmlaa a ya su Nyɔmtsɛ Tabohiatsɛ ɔ tue mi tɔɔ. 5Nyɛ na ní kpɔtɔɔ, nɛ nyɛ bua jɔ nyɛ he saminya ngɛ je ɔ mi. Ní kpakpahi nɛ nyɛ ye ɔ ha nyɛ wo zɔ saminya kɛ ha ligbi nɛ a ma kpata nyɛ hɛ mi ɔ. 6Nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da, se a be he wami nɛ a kɛ ma fa a he ɔ, nyɛ bu mɛ fɔ, nɛ nyɛ gbe mɛ.
Tsui si tomi kɛ sɔlemi
7Ye nyɛmimɛ nɛ i suɔ, e hia kaa nyɛɛ to nyɛ tsui si kɛ ya su be nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ maa ba. Nyɛɛ hyɛ bɔ nɛ ngmɔ hulɔ toɔ e tsui si, nɛ e mlɛɔ kɛ ya siɔ zugba a baa ní saminya. E toɔ e tsui si, nɛ e mlɛɔ kɛ ya siɔ gbo kɛ gbiɛ nyu nɛɔ pueɔ dumi ní ɔ nɔ. 8Nyɛ hu nyɛɛ to nyɛ tsui si ja. Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ bami nɛ nyɛ ngɛ blɔ hyɛe ɔ, nyɛ lua nyɛ, ejakaa be ɔ na wɔ haa.
9Ye nyɛmimɛ, nyɛ ko pia nyɛ sibi, konɛ Mawu ko kojo nyɛ. Hyɛ, kojolɔ ɔ daa si ngɛ sinya a nya. 10Ye nyɛmimɛ, gbali ɔmɛ nɛ fiɛ munyu ɔ ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ biɛ mi ɔ to a tsui si wawɛɛ kɛ na amanehlu. Nyɛ ha nɛ a pee nɔ hyɛmi nɔ́ ha nyɛ. 11 Niinɛ, nihi nɛ to a tsui si wawɛɛ ɔ, wa buu mɛ nihi nɛ a gbaa mɛ. Nyɛ nu bɔ nɛ Hiob to e tsui si, nɛ́ nyagbe ɔ, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ha e na ní babauu. Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ mi mi jɔ, nɛ e naa mɔbɔ.
12 Ye nyɛmimɛ nɛ i suɔ, enɛ ɔ tsuo se ɔ, nyɛ ko ka kita. Nyɛ ko ka hiɔwe; nyɛ ko ka zugba, nɛ nyɛ ko ka nɔ́ kpa ko hulɔ. Ke nɔ́ ɔ ngɛ mi anɔkuale ɔ, nyɛ de ke “Ee”; se ke e be mi ɔ, nyɛ de ke, “Dɛbi.” Kɛkɛ ɔ, Mawu be nyɛ fɔ bue.
13Ke amanehlu ba nyɛ ti nɔ ko nɔ ɔ, e sɔle. Ke nyɛ ti nɔ ko bua jɔ ɔ, e la yi jemi la. 14 Ke nyɛ ti nɔ ko be he wami ɔ, e ha nɛ a tsɛ asafo ɔ mi nikɔtɔma amɛ kɛ ba; a sɔle ha lɛ, nɛ a pɔ lɛ nu ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ biɛ mi. 15Ke a sɔle kɛ hemi kɛ yemi ha lɛ kikɛ nɛ ɔ, hiɔtsɛ ɔ ma na he wami. Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ma tsa lɛ kulaa, nɛ e maa ngɔ yayami tsuo nɛ ngɛ hiɔtsɛ ɔ he ɔ kɛ pa lɛ. 16Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ jaje nyɛ he yayami ɔmɛ kɛ tsɔɔ nyɛ sibi; nyɛɛ sɔle ha nyɛ sibi konɛ a tsa nyɛ. Ke nɔ nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da fa kue ha Mawu ɔ, e tsuɔ ní saminya. 17 Eliya a, nɔmlɔ adesa ji lɛ kaa wɔ nɔuu. E sɔle kɛ hɛdɔ ke hiɔmi kó nɛ; nɛ hiɔmi nɛ́ ngɛ zugba a nɔ jeha etɛ kɛ nyɔhiɔ ekpa sɔuu. 18 Kɛkɛ nɛ e kpale sɔle, nɛ Mawu ha nɛ hiɔmi nɛ saminya, nɛ zugba a ba ní.
19Ye nyɛmimɛ, ke nyɛ ti nɔ ko tla kɛ je anɔkuale ɔ he, nɛ nɔ ko kpale lɛ kɛ ba ekohu ɔ, 20 nyɛ na nɛ nyɛɛ le kaa nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ma tsake yayami peelɔ ko ɔ, e ma he yayami peelɔ ɔ yi wami, nɛ a maa ngɔ e he yayami babauu ɔ kɛ pa lɛ.

Title: PETRO I, NYA TSƆƆMI
Content:
NYA TSƆƆMI
Petro ngma e kekleekle womi ɔ ya ha Kristo se nyɛɛli nɛ gbɛ fĩa Asia Mainɔ omleyi je ɔ. Biɛ nɛ a kɛ tsɛɛ mɛ ji, “Nihi nɛ Mawu hla.” Petro ngma womi nɛ ɔ kɛ ya wo ni ɔmɛ a mumi mi he wami, ejakaa kɛ je be nɛ a ba he Kristo ye ɔ, yi mi sɔuu a ngɛ mɛ wae, nɛ a ngɛ nɔ́ nae. Petro kai mɛ Yesu Kristo he sane kpakpa a, kaa Kristo gbenɔ, e si temi, kɛ si nɛ e wo kaa e maa ba ekohu ɔ ji nɔ́ nɛ haa mɛ hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi. Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, e hia kaa a to a tsui si ngɛ amanehlu nɛ a ngɛ nae ɔ mi, nɛ a le kaa a kɛ lɔ ɔ ngɛ mɛ kae kaa a he Kristo ɔ ye niinɛ lo. Á na nɛ a le hu kaa “Ligbi ɔ nɛ Yesu Kristo maa ba a, a nine maa su a hiɔwo nɔ.”
Kɛ piɛ he wami nɛ e wo mɛ ngɛ amanehlu nɛ a ngɛ nae ɔ he ɔ, Petro wo mɛ ga hu kaa a bɔ mɔde nɛ a hi si kaa Kristo we bi.
Bɔ nɛ a dla womi ɔ mi ha
Sisije 1.1-2
A kai ni ɔmɛ kaa Mawu ma he a yi wami 1.3-12
A slɔ mɛ kaa a pee a he klɔuklɔu 1.13—2.10
Nɔ́ nɛ sa Kristo se nyɛɛlɔ peemi ngɛ amanehlu be mi 2.11—4.19
Kristo se nyɛɛlɔ nɛ ba e he si, nɛ e tsu ní 5.1-11
Nyagbe munyuhi 5.12-14

Title: PETRO I, 1
Content:
1Imi Petro, Yesu Kristo bɔfo ɔ, i ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ ngmae kɛ ngɛ nyɛ nihi nɛ Mawu hla, nɛ nyɛ gbɛ fĩa Ponto, Galatia, Kapadokia, Asia, kɛ Bitinia zugba amɛ a nɔ ɔ manee. 2Tsɛ Mawu hla nyɛ kaa bɔ nɛ e to ke e maa pee ɔ, nɛ e Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ pee nyɛ ma klɔuklɔu, konɛ nyɛɛ bu Yesu Kristo tue, nɛ e muɔ ɔ nɛ tsu nyɛ he.
Mawu dloomi kɛ he jɔmi nɛ hiɛ fuu ha nyɛ.
Hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi nɛ mi wa
3Nyɛ ha wa je Mawu, wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo Tsɛ ɔ yi. E na wɔ mɔbɔ babauu kaa e tle Yesu Kristo si kɛ je gbeje, nɛ e kɛ ha wɔ wami he; ejakaa suɔmi nɛ e kɛ suɔ wɔ ɔ be nyagbe. Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ haa wɔ hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi nɛ mi wa. 4Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, wa hɛ ngɛ nɔ kaa Mawu ngɔ gbosi ní nɛ puɛ we, nɛ mu be he, nɛ kpa we hulɔ ɔ ngɔ to ha nyɛ ngɛ hiɔwe. 5Mawu ngɔ ní nɛ ɔmɛ ngɔ ha nyɛ nihi nɛ nyɛ heɔ lɛ Mawu ɔ yeɔ, nɛ́ e kɛ e he wami ɔ ngɛ nyɛ he bue ɔ. Mawu pee klaalo kaa e ma he nyɛ yi wami nyagbe be ɔ mi.
6Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, nyɛ ngɛ amanehlu slɔɔtohi nae be bɔɔ ko lɛɛ, se nyɛ bua nɛ jɔ nɔ́ nɛ Mawu pee ɔ he. 7A kɛ amanehlu nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ nyɛ kae kaa nyɛ heɔ Mawu yeɔ niinɛ lo. Sika tsu po nɛ puɛɔ ɔ, a kaa ngɛ la mi. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ nɛ he jua wa kulaa pe sika tsu ɔ, ja a ka lɛ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ e mi nɛ wa. Kɛkɛ ɔ, ligbi ɔ nɛ Yesu Kristo maa ba ekohu ɔ, a ma je nyɛ yi, nɛ a maa bu nyɛ, nɛ nyɛ hɛ mi maa ba nyami. 8Nyɛ nɛ́ lɛ hyɛ, se nyɛ suɔ lɛ; amlɔ nɛ ɔ hu nyɛ nɛ́ lɛ, se nyɛ heɔ lɛ yeɔ, nɛ nyɛ naa bua jɔmi nɛ nyɛ nyaa bɔ nɛ e be hie kalemi, 9ejakaa nyɛ yi wami hemi ɔ nɛ e he nɛ nyɛ heɔ Mawu yeɔ ɔ, nyɛ nine maa su nɔ.
10Gbali ɔmɛ nɛ gba, nɛ a de ke dloomi ko ngɛ ha nyɛ hwɔɔ se ɔ, hla kikɛmɛ a yi wami hemi sane ɔ mi fitsofitso. 11A bɔ mɔde kaa a maa na be nɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ maa ba mi, kɛ bɔ nɛ e ma plɛ kɛ ba ha. Be ɔ nɛ Kristo mumi ɔ nɛ ngɛ a mi ɔ ngɛ tsɔɔe ji lɔ ɔ nɛ. Mumi ɔ de to ke Kristo maa na amanehlu, nɛ lɔ ɔ se ɔ, e hɛ mi maa ba nyami. 12Mawu je tsɔɔ gbali nɛ ɔmɛ kaa ní tsumi nɛ a ngɛ tsue ɔ, pi mɛ nitsɛmɛ nɛ a ma na he se, se nyɛ mohu. Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, a fiɛ sane kpakpa ngɔ ha nyɛ tsuo. Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ nɛ a tsɔ kɛ je hiɔwe, nɛ e kɛ mɛ tu munyu ɔ, lɛ nɔuu e he wami a kɛ fiɛ ha nyɛ. Ní nɛ ɔmɛ ji níhi nɛ bɔfo ɔmɛ tete ko suɔ kaa a maa nu sisi.
Si himi klɔuklɔu
13Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ pee nyɛ juɛmi klaalo kɛ ha ní tsumi. Nyɛ hɛ nɛ ka si, nɛ nyɛɛ ngɔ nyɛ hɛ ngɔ fɔ dloomi nɛ Mawu ma ha nyɛ ligbi ɔ nɛ Yesu Kristo maa ba ekohu ɔ nɔ. 14Nyɛɛ bu Mawu tue. Akɔnɔhi nɛ hao nyɛ benɛ nyɛ li anɔkuale ɔ lolo ɔ, nyɛ ko ya nyɛɛ se hu. 15Se mohu ɔ, nyɛ ha nɛ nyɛ je mi bami he nɛ tsɔ kaa bɔ nɛ nɔ nɛ tsɛ nyɛ ɔ ngɛ klɔuklɔu ɔ. 16 Ngmami ɔ ke, “Nyɛɛ pee nyɛ he klɔuklɔu, ejakaa i ngɛ klɔuklɔu.”
17Ke nyɛ ngɛ kue fae ha Mawu ɔ, nyɛ tsɛɔ lɛ ke Tsaatsɛ. Ee, Mawu hyɛ we nihi a hɛ mi, se mohu e kojoɔ nɔ tsuaa nɔ ngɛ e ní peemi níhi a nya. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ ngɔ bu kɛ ha lɛ nyɛ wami be nɛ piɛ ngɛ zugba nɛ ɔ nɔ tsuo. 18Ejakaa yakayaka si himi nɛ nyɛ nɛmɛ ɔmɛ si ha nyɛ ɔ, nyɛ le hĩɔ nɛ Mawu wo loko e kɛ kpɔ nyɛ kɛ je mi nɛ nyɛ ye nyɛ he. Pi nɔ́ ko nɛ puɛɔ kaa sika hiɔ, loo sika tsu nɛ Mawu ngɔ kɛ tsu kikɛmɛ a ní nɛ ɔ, 19se mohu, gbenɔ nɛ Kristo gbo, nɛ e ngɔ e he kɛ sã bɔ nɛ he jua wa a. Ee, Kristo ngɛ kaa to bi nɛ kpa, aloo mu ko be e he. 20Mawu hla lɛ momo loko a to je ɔ sisi, nɛ a je lɛ kpo ngɛ nyagbe be nɛ ɔmɛ a mi ngɛ nyɛ he. 21Nyɛ gu e nɔ kɛ he Mawu ye; Mawu nɛ tle lɛ si, nɛ e wo e hɛ mi nyami. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ he Mawu nyɛɛ ye, nɛ nyɛɛ ngɔ nyɛ hɛ ngɔ fɔ lɛ nɔuu e nɔ.
22Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, anɔkuale tsɔɔmi ɔ nɛ kɔɔ Yesu Kristo he ɔ, nyɛ ye nɔ. Nyɛ tsukɔ nyɛ he, nɛ nyɛ ba na suɔmi kpakpa kɛ ha nyɛ nyɛmimɛ nɛ ngɔ a he ngɔ ha Yesu ɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ suɔ nyɛ sibi saminya kɛ nyɛ tsui tsuo. 23Kɛ gu Mawu munyu ɔ nɛ hɛ ngɛ daa a nɔ ɔ, a fɔ nyɛ ehe. Nyɛ ba pee Tsɛ nɛ gbo we, se pi nɔ nɛ gboɔ ɔ bimɛ. 24 Ngmami ɔ ke,
“Nimli adesahi tsuo ngɛ kaa nga;
Nɛ a hɛ mi nyami ɔ tsuo ngɛ kaa nga mɔmɔ,
Nga gbliɔ, nɛ mɔmɔ wɔleɔ,
25Se Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ munyu ɔ
ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene.”
Munyu ɔ ji sane kpakpa a nɛ a fiɛ ha nyɛ ɔ nɛ.

Title: PETRO I, 2
Content:
Kristo ji tɛ nɛ haa wami
1Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ kpa yayami tsuaa yayami peemi, lakpa, osato, ninyɛ, kɛ nihi a he munyu tumi. 2Nyɛɛ pee nyɛ ní kaa bimwɔwi, nihi nɛ a fɔ mɛ ehe. Nyɛ ha nɛ mumi mi nyɔ nyu nɛ mi tsɔ ɔ nɛ jlo nyɛ. Nyɛ hla nɛ nyɛɛ nu, nɛ nyɛɛ wa, konɛ a he nyɛ yi wami. 3 Kaa bɔ nɛ ngmami ɔ deɔ ɔ, “Nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ kpa si, nɛ nyɛ na kaa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ mi mi jɔ.”
4Nyɛɛ ba Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ngɔ. Lɛ ji tɛ nɛ hɛ ngɛ nɛ adesa kua lɛ kaa nɔ́ nɛ he be se nami ɔ nɛ. Se Mawu lɛɛ e hla lɛ kaa nɔ́ nɛ he jua wa saminya. 5Nyɛɛ ba kaa tɛhi nɛ a hɛ ngɛ, nɛ nyɛ ha nɛ a fia nyɛ kɛ ma si kaa mumi mi we. Nyɛ maa pee osɔfo klɔuklɔuhi, nɛ kɛ gu Yesu Kristo nɔ ɔ, nyɛ maa sã mumi mi bɔ nɛ maa sa Mawu hɛ mi. 6 Ejakaa ngmami ɔ ke,
“I hla tɛ ko nɛ he jua wa saminya,
nɛ i kɛ ngɛ si mae ngɛ Zion
kaa kɔ nya tɛ.
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ heɔ lɛ yeɔ ɔ,
zo be lɛ gbee kɔkɔɔkɔ.”
7 Nyɛ nihi nɛ nyɛ he ye ɔ,
e he jua wa ha nyɛ saminya;
se ni nɛmɛ nɛ he we yi ɔ,
“Tɛ ɔ nɛ tsu fiali ɔmɛ kua a,
lɔ ɔ tutuutu ba plɛ pee
kɔ nya tɛ.”
8 Ngmami kpa ko hu de ke,
“Enɛ ɔ ji tɛ nɛ ma ha nɛ
nihi a nane ma tɛ nɔ;
tɛ sa nɛ ma ha nɛ
nihi maa nɔɔ si.”
A tɛ nɔ́, ejakaa a yi Mawu sɛ gbi ɔ nɔ; bɔ nɛ Mawu to ha mɛ ji ja a nɛ.
9 Se nyɛɛ lɛɛ, wɛtso nɛ Mawu hla ji nyɛ, odehe osɔfohi, je ma klɔuklɔu, kɛ Mawu nitsɛ e ma. E hla nyɛ nɛ e tsɛ nyɛ kɛ je diblii mi kɛ ba lɛ nitsɛ e la nɛ ngɛ nyakpɛ ɔ he, konɛ nyɛ ba fiɛ nyakpɛ níhi nɛ e tsu ɔ. 10 Sa a, pi Mawu e ma ji nyɛ; se amlɔ nɛ ɔ, e ma ji nyɛ. Sa a, Mawu nɛ́ nyɛ mɔbɔ; se amlɔ nɛ ɔ, e na nyɛ mɔbɔ.
Mawu nyɔguɛhi
11Nyɛmimɛ nɛ i suɔ! I ngɔ sane nɛ ɔ kɛ ngɛ nyɛ hɛ mi fɔe kaa nibwɔhi, kɛ blɔ hiali ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi. Nyɛ ko ya di he lo mi níhi a se, ejakaa a kɛ nyɛ klaa ngɛ ta hwue daa. 12Nyɛɛ ba nyɛ je mi saminya ngɛ ma je li ɔmɛ a kpɛti. Ke nyɛ pee jã, nɛ a po nyɛ nya kaa yayami peeli ji nyɛ po, kpakpa nɛ nyɛ ngɛ pee ɔ, a maa na. Kɛkɛ ɔ, ligbi ɔ nɛ Mawu ma ba kojo je ɔ, a maa wo e hɛ mi nyami.
13Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ ba nyɛ he si ha nɔ yemi tsuaa nɔ yemi ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi, matsɛ nɛ ngɛ blɔ nya pe nihi tsuo, 14aloo amlaalohi nɛ e hla nɛ a gbla yayami peeli a tue, nɛ a je nihi nɛ peeɔ kpakpa a yi ɔ. 15Ejakaa Mawu suɔ kaa nyɛɛ pee kpakpa, konɛ kuasia amɛ nɛ hii ní tsuae putɛputɛɛ ɔ, a kpa munyu tumi kɛ si nyɛ. 16Nyɛɛ hi si kaa nihi nɛ ye a he, se nyɛ ko ngɔ he yemi nɛ ɔ kɛ pee yayami nɛ nyɛɛ laa nɔ. Mohu ɔ, nyɛɛ hi si kaa Mawu tsɔli. 17Nyɛɛ bu nɔ tsuaa nɔ; nyɛɛ suɔ nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ nɛ ngɔ a he ngɔ ha Kristo ɔ; nyɛɛ ye Mawu gbeye, nɛ nyɛɛ bu matsɛ ɔ.
Kristo amanehlu nɛ pee nɔ hyɛmi nɔ́
18Sɔmɔli, nyɛɛ ba nyɛ he si ha nyɛ nyɔmtsɛmɛ, nɛ nyɛɛ bu mɛ saminya; pi nihi nɛ a mi mi hi, nɛ a he jɔ kɛkɛ, se ni nɛmɛ nɛ waa nyɛ yi mi tete. 19Ke o na amanehlu nɛ sɛ́, nɛ o le kaa lɔ ɔ ji Mawu suɔmi nya ní ɔ, Mawu maa gbaa mo. 20Ke o pee nɔ́ nɛ dɛ, nɛ a ngɛ mo kpa fiae ngɛ he, nɛ o to o tsui si ɔ, mɛni se nami ngɛ he? Se ke o pee kpakpa, nɛ o ngɛ he amanehlu nae, nɛ o to o tsui si ɔ, Mawu maa gbaa mo. 21Enɛ ɔ he Mawu tsɛ nyɛ ɔ nɛ. Ejakaa Kristo nitsɛ na amanehlu, nɛ e kɛ lɔ ɔ pee nɔ hyɛmi nɔ́ ha nyɛ, konɛ nyɛɛ nyɛɛ e se. 22 E pee we yayami ko ɔ, lakpa ko hu ji e nya. 23 Benɛ a ngɛ lɛ jɛe ɔ, lɛɛ e jɛ we nɔ ngɔ to we nane mi. Benɛ e ngɛ amanehlu nae ɔ, e gbíɛ nɔ ko; se mohu e ngɔ e he ngɔ ha Mawu, kojolɔ ɔ nɛ yeɔ dami sane ɔ. 24 Kristo nitsɛ tloo wa he yayami ɔmɛ, nɛ e nɔmlɔ tso ɔ na nɔ́ ngɛ sɛumi tso ɔ nɔ. E pee enɛ ɔ, konɛ wa ko ngɔ wa he ngɔ ha yayami hu, se mohu waa ba wa je mi bɔ nɛ sa. E pa amɛ lɛ tsa nyɛ ɔ nɛ. 25 Jinɛ nyɛ laa blɔ kaa tohi. Se amlɔ nɛ ɔ, nyɛ kpale kɛ ba nyɛ hyɛlɔ, kɛ nyɛ he bulɔ ɔ ngɔ.

Title: PETRO I, 3
Content:
Yigbayihi kɛ a hunomɛ
1 Jã nɔuu kɛ̃, nyɛ yigbayihi hu, nyɛɛ ba nyɛ he si ha nyɛ hunomɛ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ ke a ti ni komɛ he we Mawu munyu ɔ yi ɔ, nyɛ je mi bami nɛ tsake mɛ. E be hiae kaa a kɛ mɛ nɛ tu munyu po, 2ejakaa mɛ nitsɛmɛ a maa na kaa nyɛ je mi bami he tsɔ, nɛ nyɛ yeɔ Mawu gbeye. 3 Nyɛ ko ngɔ níhi kaa yi gbɔmi, loo sika tsu ní womi, loo bo nɛ ngɛ fɛu bumi kɛ dla nyɛ he. 4Se mohu, bɔ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ ha ngɛ nyɛ tsui mi ɔ, lɔ ɔ maa tsɔɔ nyɛ he fɛu ɔ nitsɛnitsɛ. Nɔmlɔ nɛ he jɔ, nɛ e ngɛ kpoo ɔ, e he fɛu nɛ tsakee we ɔ ji nɔ́ nɛ he jua wa saminya ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi. 5Ejakaa yi klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ nɛ ngɔ a hɛ ngɔ fɔ Mawu nɔ blema a ba a he si ha a hunomɛ. Nɛ enɛ ɔ ha nɛ a he pee fɛu. 6 Sara nitsɛ pee jã; e bu Abraham, nɛ e tsɛ lɛ e nyɔmtsɛ. Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, nyɛ peeɔ Sara bimɛ, ke nyɛ peeɔ kpakpa nɛ nyɛ yi nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko gbeye ɔ.
7 Nyɛ hunomɛ ɔmɛ hu, ke nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ yi ɔmɛ ngɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ na nya ha mɛ saminya kaa ngɛ nɔmlɔ tso blɔ fa mi ɔ, yo he wɛ tsɔ. Nyɛɛ bu mɛ, ejakaa Mawu ma ha nyɛɛ kɛ mɛ tsuo ma na wami kaa dloomi ní nɛ je lɛ Mawu ɔ ngɔ. Nyɛɛ pee enɛ ɔ, konɛ nɔ́ ko kó tsi nyɛ sɔlemi blɔ.
Nɔ́ nami ngɛ kpakpa peemi he
8Nyagbe ɔ, nyɛ tsuo nyɛɛ hɛɛ juɛmi kake, nɛ nyɛɛ na ha nyɛ sibi. Nyɛɛ suɔ nyɛ he kaa nyɛmimɛ. Nyɛɛ na nyɛ sibi mɔbɔ, nɛ nyɛɛ ba nyɛ he si. 9Nyɛ ko ngɔ yayami kɛ ma yayami nane mi, aloo jɛmi kɛ ma jɛmi nane mi. Ke nihi pee nyɛ yayami, loo a jɛ nyɛ ɔ, nyɛ de Mawu nɛ e gbaa mɛ mohu. Ejakaa gbaami Mawu wo si ke e maa gbaa nyɛ benɛ e tsɛ nyɛ ɔ nɛ. 10 Ngmami ɔ ke, “Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ suɔ kaa e na bua jɔmi,
nɛ e se nɛ kɛ ngɛ je mi ɔ,
e kpa lakpa yemi,
kɛ nɔ he munyu yaya tumi.
11E jɔɔ yayami peemi,
nɛ e pee kpakpa.
E bɔ mɔde wawɛɛ, nɛ e kɛ e nyɛmimɛ
nɛ hi si ngɛ he jɔmi mi.
12Ejakaa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ buu dali a he, nɛ ke a fa kue ha lɛ ɔ, e nuɔ.
Se ni nɛmɛ nɛ peeɔ yayami lɛɛ
Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ kɛ mɛ yi.”
13Ke nyɛ hɛ dɔɔ ngɛ nɔ́ kpakpa peemi he ɔ, mɛnɔ maa pee nyɛ yayami? 14 Nɛ ke nyɛ naa amanehlu tete po ngɛ kpakpa nɛ nyɛ peeɔ he ɔ, a gbaa nyɛ pɛ! Nyɛ ko ye nihi nɛ maa pee nyɛ yayami ɔ gbeye, nɛ nyɛ ko hao nyɛ he hulɔ. 15Se nyɛ ja Kristo ngɛ nyɛ tsui mi, nɛ bu nɛ sa lɛ kaa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ, nyɛ ha lɛ. Be tsuaa be ɔ, nyɛ dla nyɛ he ngɔ to, konɛ ke nɔ ko bi nyɛ ke nyɛɛ tsɔɔ nɔ́ pɔtɛɛ nɛ nyɛ heɔ yeɔ kaa nyɛ nine maa su nɔ hwɔɔ se ɔ, nyɛ nyɛ nɛ nyɛ ha lɛ heto. 16Se nyɛɛ pee enɛ ɔ kɛ bu, nɛ nyɛ ko nyɛ a nɔ. Nyɛɛ hi si saminya, nɛ nyɛ he nile ko bu nyɛ fɔ. Ke nyɛ pee jã a, nyɛ je mi bami kpakpa kaa Kristo se nyɛɛli ɔ ma ha zo maa gbe nihi nɛ tuɔ munyu yaya kɛ siɔ nyɛ ɔ. 17Ejakaa e hi kaa nɔ ko maa pee kpakpa nɛ e na amanehlu, ke lɔ ɔ ji nɔ́ nɛ Mawu suɔ ɔ, pe nɔ́ nɛ e maa pee yayami. 18Ejakaa Kristo gbo kekleekle nɔ́ kɛ nyagbe nɔ́ ngɛ ní yayamihi a he. Lɛ dalɔ ɔ, e gbo ngɛ yayami peeli a nane mi, konɛ e ngɔ wɔ kɛ ba Mawu ngɔ. Benɛ a gbe Kristo ɔ, jamɛ a be ɔ, e hɛɛ nɔmlɔ adesa su. Se amlɔ nɛ ɔ nɛ Mawu ha nɛ e ba wami mi ɔ, mumi ji lɛ. 19Nɛ kaa mumi ɔ, e ya mumihi nɛ a wo mɛ tsu ɔ a ngɔ, nɛ e ya fiɛ ha mɛ. 20 Nihi nɛ bui Mawu tue be mi nɛ Noa ngɛ e lɛ ɔ kpɛe ɔ a mumihi ji lɔ ɔmɛ nɛ. Jamɛ a be ɔ, Mawu to e tsui si wawɛɛ ha mɛ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ a tsake a tsui. Nihi bɔɔ nɛ ngɛ lɛ ɔ mi ɔ, mɛɛ lɛɛ Mawu ha we nɛ nyu kpekpemi ɔ nɛ gbe mɛ. A hiɛmi ji kpaanyɔ. 21Enɛ ɔ ji nɔ sɔlemi okadi ɔ nɛ. Ke a sɔle wɔ ɔ, lɔ ɔ tsɔɔ we kaa a fɔ wa nɔmlɔ tso ɔ he, nɛ wa he tsɔ. Mohu ɔ, e tsɔɔ kaa waa kɛ Mawu so kaa wa maa hi si saminya nɛ wa he nile ko bu wɔ fɔ, nɛ kɛ gu si nɛ Yesu Kristo te ɔ nɔ ɔ, e ma he wa yi wami. 22Yesu Kristo ho hiɔwe ya; e ya hii si ngɛ Mawu hiɔ nɔ, nɛ e ngɛ bɔfohi, kɛ mumi mi níhi tsuo nɛ ngɛ he wami a nɔ yee.

Title: PETRO I, 4
Content:
Wami he
1Akɛnɛ Kristo na nɔ́ ngɛ he lo mi he je ɔ, nyɛ hu nyɛ dla nyɛ he kɛ jamɛ a juɛmi ɔ nɔuu. Ejakaa nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ naa nɔ́ ngɛ he lo mi ɔ, e kɛ yayami be sane ko hu. 2Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, kɛ je be nɛ ɔ mi kɛ yaa si nyɛ maa gbe nyɛ je nɛ ɔ mi si himi nya a, nyɛɛ hi si kaa bɔ nɛ Mawu suɔ, se pi kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ tsui suɔ. 3Sa a, nyɛ puɛ be babauu kɛ pee níhi nɛ ma je li suɔ peemi, yahomi, akɔnɔ níhi a se dimi, dã demi, fiɛmi sakasaka, jiklɔɔ peemi, kɛ wɔ jami ní kpɔtɔkpɔtɔ peemi. 4Amlɔ nɛ ɔ lɛɛ e peeɔ mɛ nyakpɛ kaa nyɛ piɛ we a he kɛ pee we jamɛ a yakayaka ní ɔmɛ hu; nɛ lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a tuɔ nyɛ he munyu yaya. 5Se a maa bu akɔtaa ha Mawu, nɔ nɛ dla e he ngɔ to nɛ e maa kojo hɛ kali, kɛ ni gbogboehi tsuo ɔ. 6Enɛ ɔ he je nɛ a fiɛ sane kpakpa a ngɔ tsɔɔ ni gbogboehi tete po ɔ nɛ. A kojo mɛ ngɛ he lo blɔ fa mi kaa nimli adesahi mohu lɛɛ, se a ya fiɛ sane kpakpa a ngɔ tsɔɔ mɛ, konɛ a kɛ Mawu nɛ hi si ngɛ mumi mi.
Mawu nike níhi a nɔ hyɛli kpakpahi
7Níhi tsuo a nyagbe ɔ su ta. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ hɛ nɛ dɔ, nɛ nyɛ hɛ nɛ ka si, konɛ nyɛ nyɛ́ nɛ nyɛɛ sɔle. 8 Nɔ́ nɛ he hia pe kulaa ji kaa nyɛɛ suɔ nyɛ he saminya; ejakaa suɔmi haa yayami babauu nɔ. 9Nyɛ he nyɛ sibi atuu ngɛ nyɛ wehi a mi, nɛ nyɛ ko de ke nɔ́ nɛ ɔ peemi wa tsɔ. 10Nike ní pɔtɛɛ komɛ nɛ Mawu kɛ dloo nyɛ ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ ɔ, nyɛ kɛ sɔmɔ nyɛ sibi kaa Mawu dloomi nike ní slɔɔto ɔmɛ a nɔ hyɛli kpakpahi. 11Ke nɔ ko ngɛ fiɛe ɔ, e fiɛ Mawu sɛ gbi ɔ; ke nɔ ko ngɛ sɔmɔe ɔ, e ngɔ he wami nɛ Mawu ha lɛ ɔ kɛ sɔmɔ. Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ pee ɔ, e ha nɛ nihi nɛ a je Mawu yi kɛ gu Yesu Kristo nɔ. Mawu nɔ́ ji hɛ mi nyami, kɛ he wami kɛ yaa neneene. Amen.
Nɔ́ nami kaa Kristo se nyɛɛlɔ
12Nyɛmimɛ nɛ i suɔ, bɔ nɛ a ngɛ nyɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ kae, nɛ nyɛ ngɛ nɔ́ nae ɔ, e ko pee nyɛ nyakpɛ. Nyɛ ko susu kaa nɔ́ ko nɛ bɛ hyɛ nyɛ ngɛ nae ɔ. 13Se mohu, nyɛ bua nɛ jɔ kaa amanehlu nɛ Kristo na a, nyɛ hu nyɛ ngɛ nae. Kɛkɛ ɔ, ke e ba ekohu kɛ he wami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ, nyɛ ma na bua jɔmi babauu. 14Ke nihi jɛ nyɛ kaa Kristo se nyɛɛli ji nyɛ ɔ, a gbaa nyɛ pɛ. Enɛ ɔ tsɔɔ kaa mumi nɛ hɛ mi ngɛ nyami, nɛ ji mumi nɛ je Mawu ngɔ ɔ kɛ nyɛ ngɛ. 15Nyɛ ti nɔ ko nɔ ko kó na amanehlu kaa nɔmlɔ gbelɔ, aloo julɔ, aloo yayami peelɔ, aloo nɔ ko nɛ e kɛ e he woɔ ni kpahi a sanehi a mi. 16Se ke nyɛ ngɛ amanehlu nae kaa Kristo se nyɛɛli ɔ, zo ko pee nyɛ. Se mohu nyɛɛ wo Mawu hɛ mi nyami kaa a tsɛɛ nyɛ Kristo se nyɛɛli.
17Be ɔ nɛ a maa je kojomi sisi ɔ su ta, nɛ Mawu maa kojo lɛ nitsɛ e ni ɔmɛ kekle. Ke a kɛ wɔ je sisi ɔ, nihi nɛ he we sane kpakpa a nɛ je Mawu ngɔ ɔ yi ɔ, mɛɛ lɛ a nyagbe maa pee gbeye! 18 Kaa bɔ nɛ ngmami ɔ deɔ ɔ,
“Ke dengme loko a ma he
nimli kpakpahi a yi wami ɔ,
lɛɛ yayami peeli nɛ li Mawu ɔ,
mɛɛ kɛ a nyagbe maa hi kɛɛ?”
19Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ni nɛmɛ nɛ naa amanehlu, akɛnɛ lɔ ɔ ji nɔ́ nɛ Mawu to ha mɛ ɔ, a ya nɔ nɛ a pee kpakpa, nɛ a ngɔ a hɛ ngɔ fɔ a bɔlɔ ɔ nɔ kulaa. Lɛɛ ke e wo si ɔ, e yeɔ nɔ.

Title: PETRO I, 5
Content:
Mawu asafo ɔ
1I ngɛ munyu tue kɛ ngɛ asafo mi nikɔtɔmahi nɛ ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti ɔ tsɔɔe kɛ je ye tsui mi tɔɔ kaa nyɛ nyɛmi asafo mi nɔkɔtɔma. Amanehlu nɛ Kristo na a, i yeɔ he odase, nɛ Kristo hɛ mi nyami nɛ Mawu ma je tsɔɔ nihi ɔ, imi hu ma na. I ngɛ pɛɛ kpae kaa 2 Mawu asafo ɔ nɛ e ngɔ ha nyɛ ɔ, nyɛɛ hyɛ nɔ saminya kaa bɔ nɛ to hyɛlɔ lɛɔ e to kuu ɔ. Nyɛɛ pee enɛ ɔ kɛ je nyɛ tsui mi, se pi kaa a nyɛ nyɛ nɔ kɛ pee. Nyɛ tsu ní, pi ngɛ hiɔwo nɛ nyɛ ma na a he, se mohu kaa nyɛ ná nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ pee ɔ he bua jɔmi. Bɔ nɛ Mawu to kaa nyɛɛ pee ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. 3Nihi nɛ Mawu ngɔ ha nyɛ ke nyɛɛ hyɛ a nɔ ɔ, nyɛ ko ye a nɔ; se mohu nyɛɛ ngɔ nyɛ he ngɔ pee nɔ hyɛmi nɔ́ ha Mawu asafo ɔ. 4Nɛ ke to hyɛlɔ nɔkɔtɔma a ba a, nyɛ nine maa su hɛ mi nyami jlasi nɛ maa hi kpɛe nylamnylam daa a nɔ.
5 Ja nɔuu, nyɛ nihewi ɔmɛ hu, nyɛɛ ba nyɛ he si ha nikɔtɔma amɛ. Nyɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ nyɛ sɔmɔ nyɛ sibi kɛ he si bami. Ejakaa ngmami ɔ ke, “Nihi nɛ woɔ a he nɔ ɔ, Mawu kɛ mɛ toɔ ní; se nihi nɛ baa a he si ɔ, Mawu dlooɔ mɛ.” 6 Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ ba nyɛ he si ha Mawu, nɔ nɛ he wa, nɛ e buu nyɛ he ɔ. Kɛkɛ ɔ, ke e su be nɛ lɛ nitsɛ e to ɔ, e ma wo nyɛ nɔ. 7Nyɛɛ ngɔ nyɛ haomi ɔmɛ tsuo ngɔ fɔ e nɔ; ejakaa lɛ nɛ e hyɛɛ nyɛ nɔ.
8Nyɛ hɛ nɛ ka si; nyɛɛ pee klaalo! Nyɛ he nyɛlɔ, Abosiami ɔ ngɛ nyɛɛe kɛ ngɛ yae kɛ ngɛ bae kaa jata nɛ ngɛ huae, nɛ ngɛ nɔ ko hlae nɛ e tsɔtslɔɔ e mi. 9Nyɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ mi nɛ wa, nɛ nyɛɛ tsi lɛ blɔ. Ejakaa nyɛ le kaa nihi nɛ heɔ Kristo yeɔ kaa nyɛ ngɛ je ɔ mi tsuo ɔ, mɛ hu kikɛmɛ a amanehlu nɛ ɔ nɔuu a ngɛ nae. 10Se ke nyɛ na amanehlu be bɔɔ se ɔ, Mawu nɛ dlooɔ wɔ níhi tsuo ɔ, lɛ nitsɛ e maa pee nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ he hia ha nyɛ. E maa waje nyɛ; e maa wo nyɛ he wami, nɛ e ma ha nɛ nyɛ ma fi si kaa nyɛ le lɛ daa. Lɛ nɛ e tsɛ nyɛ, konɛ nyɛɛ kɛ lɛ ba hi e hɛ mi nyami nɛ ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene ɔ mi; ejakaa nyɛɛ kɛ Kristo ba pee kake. 11Mawu maa ye matsɛ kɛ maa ya neneene. Amen.
Nyagbe sɛ yemi
12 I ngɛ nyɛ womi kpiti nɛ ɔ ngmae kɛ gu Silvano nɔ. I buu wa nyɛmi nɛ ɔ saminya kaa Kristo se nyɛɛlɔ nɛ yeɔ anɔkuale. I ngɛ nyɛ he wami woe, nɛ i ngɛ nɔ mi mae ngɛ dee ke Mawu dloomi nitsɛnitsɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. Nyɛɛ pɛtɛ he wawɛɛ.
13 Asafo ɔ nɛ ngɛ Babilon, nɛ lɛ hu Mawu hla mɛ ɔ ke a biɔ nyɛ. Ye bi Marko hu ke e biɔ nyɛ. 14Nyɛɛ fua nyɛ sibi kɛ nga nyɛ he kaa nyɛmimɛ nɛ le Kristo.
Nyɛ nihi tsuo nɛ nyɛ ngɛ Kristo mi ɔ, nyɛ he manye!

Title: PETRO II, NYA TSƆƆMI
Content:
NYA TSƆƆMI
Petro ngma e womi enyɔne ɔ ya ha nihi babauu nɛ ba pee Kristo se nyɛɛli kɛ je sisije ɔ. Nɔ́ pɔtɛɛ he nɛ e ngma womi nɛ ɔ ngɛ ji, lakpa tsɔɔli komɛ ba te si, nɛ a kɛ a tsɔɔmi ɔmɛ bɔni Kristo se nyɛɛli ɔmɛ a tue puɛmi. Enɛ ɔ kɛ yakayaka fiɛmi ba, nɛ e hia kaa a tsi nya. E hia kaa nihi nɛ ba le Yesu ɔ, a hɛɛ anɔkuale ɔ nɛ kɔɔ Mawu, kɛ wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo he ɔ mi wawɛɛ. Nihi nɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a na Yesu, nɛ a nu nɛ e ngɛ ní tsɔɔe ɔ, mɛ lɛ a fiɛ kikɛmɛ a anɔkuale ɔ kɛ kpa si. Nɔ́ nɛ pa hao Petro pe kulaa ji nɔ́ nɛ a ngɛ dee ke Kristo be kpalee kɛ ba ekohu ɔ. Petro tsɔɔ nya kaa, akɛnɛ Mawu hla we kaa nɔ ko hɛ mi nɛ kpata, se mohu kaa nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ tsake e tsui he je nɛ e peeɔ mɛ kaa Yesu bami be ɔ kpɛ se ɔ nɛ.
Bɔ nɛ a dla womi ɔ mi ha
Sisije 1.1-2
Mawu tsɛ wɔ, nɛ e hla wɔ 1.3-21
Lakpa tsɔɔli 2.1-22
A wo Kristo nyagbe bami ɔ he si 3.1-18

Title: PETRO II, 1
Content:
1Imi Simon Petro, Yesu Kristo tsɔlɔ, kɛ e bɔfo ɔ, i ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ ngmae kɛ yaa ha nihi nɛ a nine su hemi kɛ yemi nɛ he jua wa saminya kaa wɔ hu wa nɔ́ ɔ nɔ. Wa Mawu ɔ, kɛ wa kpɔlɔ Yesu Kristo, nɔ nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a, lɛ ha mɛ kikɛmɛ a hemi kɛ yemi ɔ nɛ.
2Dloomi kɛ he jɔmi nɛ hiɛ babauu ha nyɛ, konɛ nyɛɛ le Mawu, kɛ wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo saminya.
Mawu tsɛ wɔ, nɛ e hla wɔ
3Mawu ha wɔ níhi tsuo nɛ maa hia wɔ ɔ, konɛ waa ba wa jemi kaa Mawu jali nitsɛnitsɛmɛ. E pee nɔ́ nɛ ɔ, ejakaa wa le lɛ Mawu ɔ nɛ tsɛ wɔ kɛ gu lɛ nitsɛ e nyami, kɛ e mi mi himi ɔ mi ɔ. 4E ha wɔ nike ní nguanguahi nɛ a he jua wa, kaa bɔ nɛ e wo si ɔ. Kɛ gu nike ní nɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ ɔ, nyɛ maa tu je nɛ ɔ mi akɔnɔ níhi nɛ kpataa nɔ hɛ mi ɔ a nya fo, konɛ nyɛ na lɛ Mawu ɔ e su ɔ eko. 5Enɛ ɔ tutuutu he je ɔ, nyɛɛ bɔ mɔde wawɛɛ nɛ nyɛɛ ngɔ kpakpa peemi ngɔ piɛ nyɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ he; nyɛɛ ngɔ nile ngɔ piɛ kpakpa peemi ɔ he. 6Nyɛɛ ngɔ he nɔ yemi ngɔ piɛ nile ɔ he; nyɛɛ ngɔ hɛ si kami ngɔ piɛ he nɔ yemi ɔ he; nyɛɛ ngɔ Mawu gbeye yemi ngɔ piɛ hɛ si kami ɔ he; 7nyɛɛ ngɔ nyɛmi peemi ngɔ piɛ Mawu gbeye yemi ɔ he, nɛ nyɛɛ ngɔ suɔmi ngɔ piɛ nyɛmi peemi ɔ he. 8Kikɛmɛ a su nɛ ɔmɛ a he hia nyɛ, nɛ ke nyɛ na mɛ bɔ nɛ sa a, nyɛ ma tsu ní nɛ maa wo yiblii saminya, nɛ nyɛ he maa ba se nami, akɛnɛ nyɛ le wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo ɔ. 9Se nɔ nɛ be ní nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, lɛɛ e ngɛ kaa nɔ nɛ hyɛ we nɔ́ kɛ yɛ tsitsaa; e hɛ je nɔ kaa a tsukɔ e he kɛ je e sá yayami ɔmɛ a he.
10Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛmimɛ, nyɛɛ ya nɔ nɛ nyɛɛ bɔ mɔde, konɛ nyɛɛ ma nɔ mi kaa niinɛ, nihi nɛ Mawu tsɛ, nɛ e hla ji nyɛ. Ke nyɛ pee ja a, nyɛ be si gbee ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ nɛ nyɛ na a mi gblegbleegble. 11Kɛkɛ ɔ, Mawu ma ha nyɛ blɔ nɛ nyɛ maa sɛ wa Nyɔmtsɛ, kɛ wa kpɔlɔ Yesu Kristo matsɛ yemi ɔ mi.
12E ngɛ mi kaa nyɛ le kikɛmɛ a ní nɛ ɔmɛ momo, nɛ anɔkuale ɔ hu nyɛ pɛtɛ he lɛɛ, se kɛ̃ i to kaa ma ya nɔ ma hi nyɛ kaie ngɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ a he. 13Be abɔ nɛ i ngɛ je mi kɛ mwɔɔ ɔ, i susu kaa e sa kaa ma ya nɔ ma hɛli nyɛ si ngɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ a he. 14I le kaa e be kɛe kulaa nɛ ma gbo kaa bɔ nɛ wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo je tsɔɔ mi ɔ. 15Se ma bɔ mɔde ma to blɔ nya ha nyɛ, konɛ ye gbenɔ se ɔ, nyɛ hɛ nɛ hi ní nɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ be tsuaa be.
Nihi nɛ na Kristo hɛ mi nyami ɔ
16Nɛ wa fiɛ tsɔɔ nyɛ ke wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo maa ba ekohu kɛ he wami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ, pi sanehi nɛ a po de nɔ nɛ wa da. Se wa na e he wami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ kɛ wɔ nitsɛmɛ wa hɛngmɛ. 17 Wa ngɛ lejɛ ɔ benɛ Tsɛ Mawu wo e hɛ mi nyami ɔ. Jamɛ a be ɔ, gbi pɛ kɛ je hɛ mi nyami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ ngɔ ke, “Nɔ nɛ ɔ ji ye Bi nɛ i suɔ, nɛ i naa e he tsui!” 18Wɔ nitsɛmɛ wa nu gbi nɛ ɔ kɛ je hiɔwe, benɛ waa kɛ lɛ ngɛ yo klɔuklɔu ɔ nɔ ɔ.
19Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, wa na kaa munyuhi nɛ gbali ɔmɛ tu ɔ ba mi niinɛ. Nyɛ hu ke nyɛ bɔ mɔde nɛ nyɛ bu tue ɔ, e maa hi ha nyɛ; ejakaa e ngɛ kaa la nɛ ngɛ tsoe ngɛ diblii mi kɛ yaa si je maa na, nɛ nɔkɔ la a ma kpɛ ngɛ nyɛ tsui mi. 20Se enɛ ɔ tsuo se ɔ, nyɛ na nɛ nyɛɛ le kaa nɔ ko nɔ ko be nyɛe maa ngɔ lɛ nitsɛ e juɛmi kɛ tsɔɔ gbami ko sisi ngɛ ngmami ɔ mi. 21Ejakaa gbami sɛ gbi ko bɛ hyɛ nɛ adesa po de kɛkɛ ngɛ lɛ nitsɛ e suɔmi nya. Se mohu Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ lɛ baa nihi a nɔ nɛ a tuɔ munyu kɛ jeɔ Mawu ngɔ.

Title: PETRO II, 2
Content:
Lakpa tsɔɔli
1Lakpa gbali te si ngɛ ma a mi be ko nɛ be ɔ, nɛ ja nɔuu lakpa tsɔɔli maa te si ngɛ nyɛ hu nyɛ kpɛti. A kɛ lakpa tsɔɔmihi nɛ kpataa nɔ hɛ mi maa ba ngɛ laami mi. Tsɔɔlɔ ɔ nitsɛ nɛ kpɔ mɛ ɔ po a ma kua lɛ, nɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ma ha nɛ a ma kpata mɛ nitsɛmɛ a hɛ mi si kake too. 2Nihi babauu maa nyɛɛ a se kɛ yakayaka je mi bami, nɛ a he ɔ, nihi maa tu munyu kɛ si Kristo, kɛ e blɔ ɔ. 3Kikɛmɛ a lakpa tsɔɔli nɛ ɔmɛ maa tu nyɛ munyuhi nɛ a po de, konɛ a kɛ sisi nyɛ nɛ a ná nyɛ he se. Se Mawu bu mɛ fɔ momo be saii ji nɛ, nɛ a hɛ mi kpatami be ɔ hu su ta.
4Bɔfohi nɛ pee yayami ɔ, Mawu ngɔɛ a he ngɔ ki mɛ, se mohu e tsitsɛɛ mɛ ngɔ wo gbeje muɔ mi. A fi mɛ ngɔ wo diblii mi, nɛ a maa hi mlɛe ngɛ lejɛ ɔ hluu kɛ yaa si kojomi ligbi ɔ. 5 Mawu ngɔɛ blema bi ɔmɛ a he ngɔ ki mɛ, se mohu e ngɔ nyu kpekpemi kɛ kpata yayami peeli ɔmɛ a hɛ mi. Noa nɛ fiɛ ke a ye dami sane ɔ, e kɛ ni kpaago kpa komɛ pɛ lɛ Mawu he a yi wami. 6 Mawu gbla Sodom kɛ Gomora ma amɛ a tue. E ngɔ la kɛ kpata ma nɛ ɔmɛ a hɛ mi ngɔ to okadi kɛ tsɔɔ nɔ́ nɛ maa ba yayami peeli a nɔ. 7 E he Lot hu yi wami. Lot nɛ ɔ, nɔmlɔ kpakpa ji lɛ, nɛ nihi nɛ bui mlaa a yakayaka je mi bami haoɔ lɛ wawɛɛ. 8Benɛ nɔmlɔ kpakpa nɛ ɔ ngɛ a kpɛti ɔ, daa nɛ ɔ, e naa, nɛ e nuɔ ní yayamihi nɛ a ngɛ pee ɔ a he; nɛ nɔ́ nɛ ɔ hao e tsui. 9Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ le bɔ nɛ e peeɔ nɛ e jeɔ nimli kpakpahi kɛ jeɔ ka mi. E le bɔ nɛ e peeɔ kɛ hii nimli yayamihi a tue gblae hluu kɛ yaa su kojomi ligbi ɔ tɔɔ. 10Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ a ti nihi pɔtɛɛ ji ni nɛmɛ nɛ ya nyɛɛɔ he lo mi akɔnɔ yaya se, se Mawu mlaa a lɛɛ a bui.
Kikɛmɛ a lakpa tsɔɔli nɛ ɔmɛ a tsui wa; a woɔ a he nɔ, nɛ nibɔ ní kpakpahi nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe po a bui; se mohu a jɛɔ mɛ. 11Bɔfo ɔmɛ nɛ a he wa, nɛ a hiɛ kulaa pe lakpa tsɔɔli nɛ ɔmɛ tete po pui a nya, nɛ a jɛ we mɛ hulɔ ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ hɛ mi. 12Se kikɛmɛ a nimli nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ kaa pu mi lohwehi; a be juɛmi. A bɔ mɛ nɛ a nuu mɛ nɛ a gbe kɛkɛ; nɔ́ ko nɛ a nui sisi ɔ, a tuɔ he munyu yaya. A ma kpata a hɛ mi kaa pu mi lohwehi, 13nɛ ní yayamihi nɛ a pee ɔ, a maa na nɔ́ kɛ to nya. Piani ke a ngɛ yakayaka fiɛmihi fiɛe kikɛ nɛ ɔ, kɛkɛ a bua jɔ; zotsɛmɛ kɛ ahluatsɛmɛ ji mɛ. Benɛ a futu nyɛ kɛ ngɛ ní yee ɔ, jamɛ a be ɔ tsuo a ngɛ a yakayaka nyɛɛmi ɔmɛ nyɛɛe. 14A hɛngmɛ hyɛ we nɔ́ kpa ko kaa ja yihi yaholi pɛ. Pɔ tɔɛ mɛ kɛ yayami peemi. A sisiɔ nihi nɛ gbɔjɔ, nɛ a naa a he blɔ. A kase jiklɔɔ peemi, nɛ a le saminya. Mawu gbiɛ mɛ pɛ! 15 A je blɔ tlɔmɔɔ ɔ nɔ, nɛ a laa blɔ kaa bɔ nɛ Beor bi Balaam pee ɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ. Balaam ya di se nami se, nɛ e kɛ pee nɔ́ nɛ dɛ; 16se a ka e hɛ mi ngɛ yayami nɛ e pee ɔ he. Gbalɔ ɔ teji ɔ pã e nya mi, nɛ e tu munyu kaa nɔmlɔ, nɛ e tsi godo ní tsumi nɛ gbalɔ ɔ miɔ nɛ e ma tsu ɔ nya.
17Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ kaa nyu vuhi nɛ nyu be a mi; a ngɛ kaa bɔkuhi nɛ ahumi ngɔ kɛ yaa. Mawu dla he ko ngɔ to mɛ ngɛ diblii nɛ mi ti mi. 18Akɛnɛ nya puu munyu nguahi jeɔ a nya he je ɔ, a guu he lo akɔnɔ níhi a nɔ nɛ a kɛ ya sisiɔ nihi nɛ je si himi yaya nɛ dɛ blɔ mi kɛ́ we. 19A woɔ mɛ si ke a maa ye a he, be mi nɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a pee a he nyɔguɛhi kɛ ha níhi nɛ puɛɔ nɔ. Ejakaa nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ yeɔ nɔ ko nɔ ɔ, nɔ ɔ peeɔ nyɔguɛ ha jamɛ a nɔ́ ɔ. 20Waa ngɔ lɛ kaa nihi na le wa Nyɔmtsɛ kɛ wa kpɔlɔ Yesu Kristo, nɛ lɔ ɔ he ɔ, a tu je nɛ ɔ mi mu níhi a nya fo. Pee se, ke a ngɔ a he ya wo yayami mi ekohu, nɛ yayami ɔ ye a nɔ ɔ, nimli nɛ ɔmɛ a nyagbe si himi ba peeɔ mɔbɔ kulaa pe kekle nɔ́ ɔ po. 21Afani nɔ́ nɛ a na we nɛ a le Kristo, pe nɛ a le lɛ, nɛ pee se ɔ, a je mlaa klɔuklɔu ɔ nɛ a ha mɛ ɔ he. 22 Nɔ́ nɛ ba a nɔ ɔ tsɔɔ kaa abɛ nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ mi niinɛ: “Gbe kpaleɔ kɛ yaa lɛ nitsɛ e vie he,” kɛ “Kpotoo nɛ a du ha lɛ ɔ kpaleɔ ya wuɔ mɔsɔ ekohu.”

Title: PETRO II, 3
Content:
A wo Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ bami ɔ he si
1Nyɛmimɛ nɛ i suɔ, enɛ ɔ ji womi enyɔne nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ ngmae. I bɔ mɔde ngɛ womi nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a mi kaa ma tsɛ nyɛ juɛmi se kɛ ba níhi nɛ nyɛ le momo ɔ a he. 2Nyɛ kai munyuhi nɛ gbali klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ tu blema lokoo ɔ, kɛ wa Nyɔmtsɛ kɛ wa kpɔlɔ ɔ mlaa nɛ bɔfo ɔmɛ nɛ a tsɔ mɛ nyɛ ngɔ ɔ kɛ ba ha nyɛ ɔ. 3 Kekleekle ɔ, nyɛ na nɛ nyɛɛ le kaa nyagbe ligbi ɔmɛ a mi ɔ, nɔ he fɛu yeli komɛ maa ba, nɛ nɔ́ nɛ a we akɔnɔ de mɛ ke a pee ɔ, lɔ ɔ a maa pee. 4Kikɛmɛ a nimli nɛ ɔmɛ ma de ke, “E wo si kaa e maa kpale kɛ ba ekohu, pi jã lo? Jije e ngɛ? Ejakaa kɛ je be nɛ wa nɛmɛ ɔmɛ gbo nɛ ɔ, bɔ nɛ níhi ngɛ kɛ je be mi nɛ a bɔ je ɔ, jã nɔuu nɛ a ngɛ nɛ ɔ nɛ.” 5 A jeɔ blɔ peeɔ kaa a li kaa blema lokoo ɔ, munyu kɛkɛ lɛ Mawu tu, nɛ hiɔwe kɛ zugba ba, kaa a je zugba kɛ je nyu mi, nɛ nyu a kɛ bɔ zugba a. 6 Nɛ nyu nɔuu, nyu kpekpemi ɔ a kɛ kpata jamɛ a be ɔ mi je ɔ hɛ mi. 7Se hiɔwe kɛ zugba a nɛ ngɛ amlɔ nɛ ɔ, munyu nɛ je Mawu nya a nɔuu lɛ hɛɛ mɛ, konɛ a kɛ la nɛ ba kpata a hɛ mi hwɔɔ se. Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, a maa kojo nihi tsuo nɛ li Mawu, nɛ a ma kpata a hɛ mi.
8 Se ye nyɛmimɛ nɛ i suɔ! Nɔ́ kake nɛ nyɛ hɛ ko je nɔ ji kaa ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ hɛ mi ɔ, ligbi kake ngɛ kaa jeha akpe, nɛ jeha akpe hu ngɛ kaa ligbi kake. 9Nɔ́ nɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ wo si ke e maa pee ɔ, pi tsle nɛ e ngɛ toe ngɛ he kaa bɔ nɛ ni komɛ ngɛ susue ɔ; e tsui si kɛkɛ lɛ e ngɛ toe ha nyɛ. Ejakaa e sume nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko hɛ mi nɛ kpata, se mohu nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ tsake e tsui.
10 Se Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ligbi ɔ maa ba kaa bɔ nɛ julɔ baa a. Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, hiɔwe maa be kɛ ho kɛ kemi nɛ nya wa. Níhi nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ tsuo maa sã, nɛ a hɛ mi ma kpata, nɛ je ɔ, kɛ e mi nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ maa laa. 11Akɛnɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ a hɛ mi ma kpata kikɛ nɛ ɔ, lɛɛ kɛ e sa kaa nyɛɛ ba nyɛ je mi kɛɛ? E sa kaa nyɛɛ pee nyɛ he klɔuklɔu, nɛ nyɛɛ ngɔ nyɛ he ngɔ ha Mawu, 12konɛ nyɛɛ hi Mawu ligbi ɔ blɔ hyɛe, nɛ nyɛɛ hi sɔlee nɛ e su mla. Jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, hiɔwe ma mle kɛ la, nɛ e maa sã, nɛ la a ma ha níhi nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ tsuo maa sile. 13 Se wa ngɛ hiɔwe he, kɛ zugba he blɔ hyɛe kaa bɔ nɛ Mawu wo si ɔ. Lejɛ ɔ ji he nɛ a yeɔ dami sane ngɛ.
14Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ye nyɛmimɛ nɛ i suɔ! Be mi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ blɔ hyɛe ɔ, nyɛɛ bɔ mɔde nɛ Mawu ko na mu, loo piami nɔ́ ko ngɛ nyɛ he; nyɛɛ kɛ lɛ nɛ hi si ngɛ he jɔmi mi. 15Nyɛɛ ngɔ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ tsui si tomi ɔ kaa he blɔ nɛ Mawu ha nyɛ nɛ a kɛ he nyɛ yi wami. Enɛ ɔ nɔuu wa suɔlɔ, kɛ wa nyɛmi Paulo hu ngma nyɛ kɛ nile nɛ Mawu ha lɛ ɔ nɛ. 16E tuɔ enɛ ɔmɛ a he munyu ngɛ womihi tsuo nɛ e ngma a a mi. Ní komɛ nɛ e de ɔ, a sisi numi yee, nɛ nihi nɛ li nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko, kɛ ni komɛ hu nɛ a yi mi peeɔ mɛ enyɔɔnyɔ ɔ, tsɔɔ sisi ngɛ blɔ kpa nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ a peeɔ ngmami kpa amɛ ɔ. Blɔ nɔ nɛ a guu kɛ kpataa mɛ nitsɛmɛ a hɛ mi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
17Se ye nyɛmimɛ nɛ i suɔ, nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ le enɛ ɔ momo. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ hyɛ nɛ hi saminya, nɛ nihi nɛ bui mlaa a, a ní peemi ní yayami ɔmɛ kó gbla nyɛ se, nɛ nyɛ si nɛ nyɛ da a ko bɔ nyɛ. 18Se nyɛɛ ya nɔ nɛ nyɛɛ wa ngɛ dloomi ɔ mi, nɛ nyɛɛ le wa Nyɔmtsɛ, kɛ wa kpɔlɔ Yesu Kristo ɔ saminya. Á wo e hɛ mi nyami kɛ je be nɛ ɔ mi kɛ ya neneene! Amen.

Title: YOHANE I NYA TSƆƆMI
Content:
NYA TSƆƆMI
Kekleekle womi nɛ Yohane ngma a kɔɔ nɔ́ enyɔ pɔtɛɛ komɛ a he. E ngma, konɛ e kɛ wo nihi he wami, nɛ a kɛ Mawu, kɛ e Bi Yesu Kristo ɔ nɛ bɔ huɛ. Jehanɛ se hu, Yohane kɛ womi nɛ ɔ ngɛ nihi kɔkɔ bɔe, nɛ́ a ko ya nyɛɛ lakpa tsɔɔmi se, nɛ huɛ bɔmi nɛ ɔ ko ba puɛ. Nɔ́ nɛ kɛ tsɔɔmi nɛ ɔ ba ji: ni komɛ he ye kaa ke a fɔ nɔ ko kɛ ba je nɛ ɔ mi pɛ kɛkɛ e ba nɔ yayami mi. A tsɔɔ nya kaa ke ja ji sane ɔ, lɛɛ Yesu nɛ ji Mawu Bi ɔ, e be nyɛe nɛ e pee adesa mɔ. Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ tsɔɔ kaa ke a he nɔ ko yi wami ɔ, e sɛ kaa je nɛ ɔ mi sane ko peeɔ lɛ kɔmɔ ko kulaa. A tsɔɔ hulɔ kaa, ní komɛ kaa je mi bami kpakpa kikɛ nɛ ɔ, aloo kaa o suɔ o nyɛmi ɔ, ní nɛ ɔmɛ kɔ we yi wami hemi he.
Yohane ngma womi nɛ ɔ kɛ si lakpa tsɔɔmi nɛ ɔ. E ke Yesu Kristo ɔ, adesa ji lɛ. E tsɔɔ nya kaa nihi tsuo nɛ heɔ Yesu yeɔ, nɛ a suɔ Mawu hulɔ ɔ, e sa kaa a suɔ a sibi.
Bɔ nɛ a dla womi ɔ mi ha
Sisije 1.1-4
La kɛ diblii 1.5—2.29
Mawu bimɛ, kɛ Abosiami bimɛ 3.1-24
Anɔkuale mumi, kɛ lakpa mumi 4.1-6
Suɔmi ní tsumi 4.7-21
Wa ye je ɔ nɔ kunimi 5.1-21

Title: YOHANE I 1
Content:
Munyu nɛ haa nɔ wami
1 Wa ngɛ nyɛ munyu nɛ haa nɔ wami ɔ ngmae. Munyu ɔ ngɛ kɛ je sisije. Wa nu, nɛ wa na kɛ wɔ nitsɛmɛ wa hɛngmɛ; ee, wa na lɛ, nɛ wa nine ta he. 2 Benɛ wami ɔ jé e he kpo ɔ, wa na lɛ. Enɛ ɔ he ɔ, wa ngɛ odase yee, nɛ wa ngɛ jajee ke lɛ ji neneene wami ɔ nɛ. E kɛ Tsɛ ɔ lɛ ngɛ, nɛ e jé e he kpo ngɔ tsɔɔ wɔ. 3Nɔ́ nɛ wa na, kɛ nɔ́ nɛ wa nu ɔ, lɔ ɔ wa ngɛ fiɛe kɛ ngɛ nyɛ hae. Wa ngɛ enɛ ɔ pee, konɛ nyɛ ba piɛ wa he, nɛ waa kɛ Tsɛ ɔ, kɛ e Bi Yesu Kristo ɔ nɛ bɔ huɛ. 4Wa ngɛ nyɛ enɛ ɔ ngmae, konɛ wa bua nɛ jɔ kɛ pi si.
Mawu ji la
5Jehanɛ, sɛ gbi nɛ wa nu kɛ je e Bi ɔ nya, nɛ wɔ hu wa ngɛ fiɛe ɔ ji kaa Mawu su ngɛ kaa la, nɛ diblii ko kulaa be e mi. 6Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke wa de ke waa kɛ lɛ ngɛ huɛ bɔe, se kɛ̃ wa ngɛ diblii ɔ mi ɔ, wa ngɛ lakpa yee; munyu nɛ jeɔ wa nya, kɛ wa ní peemi tsuo anɔkuale be mi. 7Se ke wa ba wa je mi saminya ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi kaa bɔ nɛ lɛ Mawu ɔ e su ngɛ ɔ, lɔ ɔ lɛɛ waa kɛ wa sibi ngɛ huɛ bɔe. Kɛkɛ ɔ, e Bi Yesu Kristo muɔ ɔ maa tsukɔ wa he, nɛ e ma je wa he yayami ɔmɛ tsuo.
8Ke wa de ke yayami ko be wa he ɔ, wɔ nitsɛmɛ wa he wa ngɛ sisie; nɛ Mawu we anɔkuale ɔ be wa mi. 9Se ke wa jaje wa he yayami ɔmɛ ha Mawu ɔ, e maa ye e siwo ɔ nɔ, nɛ e maa pee bɔ nɛ sa. E kɛ wa he yayami ɔmɛ maa pa wɔ; e maa tsu wa he, nɛ e ma je ní yayahi nɛ wa pee ɔ tsuo. 10Ke wa ke wa pee we yayami ɔ, lɛɛ wa ngɛ tsɔɔe kaa Mawu mohu ji lakpatsɛ; nɛ Mawu we anɔkuale ɔ be wa mi.

Title: YOHANE I 2
Content:
Wa he piɛlɔ Kristo
1Ye bimɛ tsɔwi, i ngɛ nyɛ womi nɛ ɔ ngmae, konɛ nyɛ ko pee yayami. Se ke nɔ ko pee yayami pohu ɔ, wa ngɛ nɔ nɛ daa mi kɛ haa wɔ ngɛ Tsɛ ɔ ngɔ. Lɛ ji Yesu Kristo, nɔ nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a. 2Nɛ Kristo ɔ ji nɔ nɛ a kɛ pee kpatami kɛ je wa he yayami ɔmɛ; pi wɔ kɛkɛ, se je ɔ tsuo he yayami.
3Ke wa yeɔ Mawu mlaa amɛ a nɔ ɔ, lɔ ɔ waa kɛ naa anɔkuale mi kaa wa le lɛ. 4Ke nɔ ko ke e le Mawu, se e yi e mlaa amɛ a nɔ ɔ, lakpatsɛ ji lɛ; e tu we anɔkuale. 5Se nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ yeɔ Mawu mlaa a nɔ ɔ, lɛ ji nɔ nɛ suɔ Mawu anɔkuale mi. Enɛ ɔ waa kɛ maa le kaa niinɛ, waa kɛ Mawu ngɛ huɛ bɔe. 6Nɔ nɛ deɔ ke e ngɛ Mawu mi ɔ, e ba e je mi kaa bɔ nɛ Yesu Kristo ba e je mi ɔ.
Mlaa he ɔ
7 Ye nyɛmimɛ nɛ i suɔ, mlaa nɛ i ngɛ ngmae nɛ nyɛɛ ye nɔ nɛ ɔ, pi mlaa he; mlaa momo ɔ nɛ nyɛ ná kɛ je sisije ɔ, lɔ ɔ nɔuu. Sɛ gbi nɛ nyɛ nu momo ɔ, lɔ ɔ ji mlaa momo ɔ nɛ. 8Se kɛ̃ ɔ, mlaa nɛ i ngɛ ngmae nɛ nyɛɛ ye nɔ nɛ ɔ, mlaa he, ejakaa a naa e we anɔkuale ɔ nɛ ngɛ ní tsue ngɛ nyɛ mi kaa bɔ nɛ e tsu ní ngɛ Kristo mi ɔ. Diblii ɔ ngɛ bee kɛ yaa, nɛ la nitsɛ ɔ bɔni kpɛmi momo.
9Ke nɔ ko de ke e ngɛ Kristo mi, se e sume e nyɛmi ɔ, lɛɛ e ngɛ diblii ɔ mi, kɛ mwɔɔ. 10Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ suɔ e nyɛmi ɔ, e ngɛ Kristo mi. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko be e he nɛ ma ha nɔ ko nane ma kpata. 11Se nɔ nɛ nyɛɛ e nyɛmi ɔ, e ngɛ diblii ɔ mi, nɛ e ngɛ diblii ɔ mi nyɛɛe nɛ́ e li he nɛ e yaa. Ejakaa diblii ɔ yu e hɛ.
12Ye bimɛ tsɔwi, i ngɛ nyɛ womi nɛ ɔ ngmae, ejakaa Kristo he ɔ, a ngɔ nyɛ he yayami ɔmɛ ngɔ pa nyɛ. 13Tsaatsɛmɛ! I ngɛ nyɛ womi nɛ ɔ ngmae, ejakaa nyɛ le nɔ nɛ ngɛ kɛ je sisije ɔ. Nihewi! I ngɛ nyɛ womi nɛ ɔ ngmae, ejakaa nyɛ ye nɔ yayami ɔ nɔ kunimi.
14Bimɛ tsɔwi, i ngɛ nyɛ womi nɛ ɔ ngmae, ejakaa nyɛ le Tsɛ ɔ. Tsaatsɛmɛ! I ngɛ nyɛ womi nɛ ɔ ngmae, ejakaa nyɛ le nɔ nɛ ngɛ kɛ je sisije ɔ. Nihewi! I ngɛ nyɛ womi nɛ ɔ ngmae, ejakaa nyɛ he wa; Mawu we anɔkuale ɔ ngɛ nyɛ mi, nɛ nyɛ ye nɔ yayami ɔ nɔ kunimi.
15Nyɛ ko suɔ je ɔ, loo níhi nɛ ngɛ je ɔ mi ɔ. Ke nɔ ko suɔ je ɔ, lɛɛ e sume Tsɛ ɔ. 16Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, je ɔ mi e je. Níhi nɛ he lo ɔ dii se, níhi nɛ hɛngmɛ dii se, kɛ níhi nɛ nihi fĩaa kɛ fɔɔ nɔ ɔ, lɛ tsuo je je nɛ ɔ mi; ekoeko ji Tsɛ ɔ ngɔ. 17Je ɔ, kɛ e mi níhi nɛ peeɔ nɔ akɔnɔ ɔ ngɛ bee kɛ yaa. Se nɔ nɛ peeɔ Mawu suɔmi nya ní ɔ, lɛɛ e ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene.
Kristo he nyɛlɔ ɔ
18Ye bimɛ tsɔwi, nyagbe be ɔ su ta! A de nyɛ ke Kristo he nyɛlɔ ɔ ma; se amlɔ nɛ ɔ, Kristo he nyɛli fuu ba momo. Enɛ ɔ he ɔ, wa le kaa nyagbe ɔ su ta. 19Anɔkuale mi ɔ, pi wa kpɛti nɛ nimli nɛ ɔmɛ je; nɛ lɔ ɔ he je nɛ a si wɔ ɔ nɛ. Kaa wa kpɛti nɛ a je jinɛ a kɛ wɔ ko hi si. Se a si wɔ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ e fɔ si paa kaa a ti nɔ ko nɔ ko kɛ wɔ bɔɛ.
20Se nyɛɛ lɛɛ, Kristo ha nyɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ, nɛ lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ tsuo nyɛ le anɔkuale ɔ. 21Pi kaa anɔkuale ɔ nɛ nyɛ li nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ womi nɛ ɔ ngmae. Dɛbi! Akɛnɛ nyɛ le anɔkuale ɔ, lɔ ɔ he mohu nɛ i ngɛ nyɛ womi ɔ ngmae ɔ nɛ; nɛ nyɛ le hu kaa anɔkuale ɔ, lakpa be mi.
22Lɛɛ mɛnɔ ji lakpatsɛ? Ee, nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ deɔ ke pi Yesu ji Kristo ɔ, lɛ ji lakpatsɛ ɔ nɛ. Kikɛmɛ a nɔmlɔ nɛ ɔ ji Kristo he nyɛlɔ ɔ nɛ; e kua Tsɛ ɔ, kɛ Bi ɔ tsuo. 23Ejakaa nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ma kua Bi ɔ, e kua Tsɛ ɔ hulɔ. Se nɔ nɛ ma he Bi ɔ, e he Tsɛ ɔ hulɔ.
24Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, sɛ gbi ɔ nɛ nyɛ na kɛ je sisije ɔ, nyɛɛ pɛtɛ he wawɛɛ. Ke nyɛ pɛtɛ jamɛ a sɛ gbi ɔ he wawɛɛ ɔ, lɔ ɔ lɛɛ nyɛɛ maa hi Bi ɔ, kɛ Tsɛ ɔ mi daa. 25Nɛ nɔ́ nɛ Kristo nitsɛ wo wɔ he si ɔ ji neneene wami.
26I ngɛ nyɛ womi nɛ ɔ ngmae ngɛ nihi nɛ hlaa kaa a puɛ nyɛ tue ɔ a he. 27Se nyɛɛ lɛɛ Kristo ha e mumi ɔ ba nyɛ nɔ. Be abɔ nɛ e mumi ɔ ngɛ nyɛ nɔ ɔ, e hia we nɛ nɔ ko nɛ ba tsɔɔ nyɛ ní. Ejakaa mumi ɔ ngɛ nyɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ tsɔɔe; nɛ anɔkuale ɔ mumi ɔ ngɛ nyɛ tsɔɔe ɔ nɛ, pi lakpa. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ bu nɔ́ nɛ mumi ɔ ngɛ tsɔɔe ɔ tue, konɛ nyɛɛ ya nɔ nɛ nyɛɛ hi Kristo mi.
28Ye bimɛ tsɔwi, nyɛɛ ya nɔ nɛ nyɛɛ hi Kristo mi, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ ke e je e he kpo ɔ, wa nɔ gbagba nɛ te. Kɛkɛ ɔ, ligbi ɔ nɛ e maa ba a, zo be wɔ gbee ngɛ e hɛ mi. 29Tse nyɛ le kaa Kristo ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ da e peeɔ. Lɛɛ e hia kaa nyɛɛ le kaa nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a, Mawu bi ji lɛ.

Title: YOHANE I 3
Content:
Mawu bimɛ
1 Nyɛɛ hyɛ suɔmi sɔuu nɛ Tsɛ ɔ ngɛ kɛ ha wɔ, kaa e ma tsɛ wɔ e bimɛ; niinɛ Mawu bimɛ ji wɔ. Enɛ ɔ he ɔ, je ɔ li wɔ, ejakaa lɛ Mawu ɔ nitsɛ hu je ɔ li lɛ. 2Ye nyɛmimɛ nɛ i suɔ, amlɔ nɛ ɔ, Mawu bimɛ ji wɔ, se bɔ nɛ wa ma plɛ hwɔɔ se ɔ, lɔ ɔ lɛɛ wa li lolo. Nɔ́ nɛ wa le kɛkɛ ji kaa ke Kristo je e he kpo ɔ, wa maa hi kaa lɛ; ejakaa wa maa na lɛ paa kaa bɔ nɛ e ngɛ ɔ tutuutu. 3Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ngɛ hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ ngɛ Kristo mi ɔ, peeɔ e he klɔuklɔu kaa bɔ nɛ Kristo hu ngɛ klɔuklɔu ɔ.
4Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ peeɔ yayami ɔ, e yeɔ fɔ kaa e ngɛ Mawu mlaa nɔ tɔe, ejakaa yayami ji mlaa nɔ tɔmi. 5 Nyɛ le kaa Kristo ba, konɛ e ba wó wa he yayami ɔmɛ kɛ ho. Nyɛ le hulɔ kaa Kristo ɔ, yayami ko be e he. 6Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke nɔ ko ngɛ Kristo mi ɔ, e pee we yayami hu. Se nɔ nɛ ngɛ yayami pee kɛ mwɔɔ ɔ, e nɛ Kristo, nɛ e li lɛ hulɔ.
7Ye bimɛ tsɔwi, nyɛ ko ha nɛ nɔ ko nɛ sisi nyɛ! Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ nɛ da a, dalɔ ji lɛ kaa bɔ nɛ Kristo hu dalɔ ji lɛ ɔ. 8Nɔ nɛ peeɔ yayami lɛɛ Abosiami bi ji lɛ, ejakaa kɛ je sisije tɔɔ nɛ Abosiami bɔni yayami peemi. Enɛ ɔ he tutuutu nɛ Mawu Bi ɔ ba a nɛ, konɛ níhi nɛ Abosiami tsu ɔ, e ba kpata lɛ tsuo hɛ mi.
9Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ji Mawu bi ɔ, e yɛ nɔ nɛ e hii yayami pee, ejakaa e hɛɛ Mawu su nitsɛnitsɛ. Nɛ akɛnɛ Mawu bi ji lɛ he je ɔ, e be nyɛe maa pee yayami. 10Slɔɔto titli nɛ ngɛ Mawu bimɛ, kɛ Abosiami bimɛ a kpɛti ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ pee we nɔ́ nɛ da, aloo nɔ nɛ sume e nyɛmi ɔ, pi Mawu bi ji lɛ.
Nyɛɛ suɔ nyɛ sibi
11 Sɛ gbi ɔ nɛ nyɛ nu kɛ je sisije ɔ ji kaa waa suɔ wa sibi. 12 Wa ko pee kaa bɔ nɛ Kain pee ɔ; ejakaa Abosiami mumi ngɛ e mi, nɛ e gbe lɛ nitsɛ e nyɛmi Habel. Mɛni he je Kain gbe e nyɛmi ɔ? Ejakaa níhi nɛ e tsu ɔ, ní ɔmɛ dɛ, se e nyɛmi ɔ lɛɛ níhi nɛ e tsu ɔ da.
13Ye nyɛmimɛ nɛ i suɔ, lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke je ɔ ngɛ nyɛ nyɛe ɔ, nyɛ hɛ mi ko pee nyɛ yaa. 14 Wa le kaa wa be kaa ni gbogboehi hu, se wa je gbenɔ mi kɛ ba wami mi, ejakaa wa suɔ wa nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ. Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ sume e nyɛmi ɔ, e ngɛ gbenɔ mi. 15Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ nyɛɔ e nyɛmi ɔ, nɔmlɔ gbelɔ ji lɛ; nɛ nyɛ le kaa nɔmlɔ gbelɔ ko nɔmlɔ gbelɔ ko be neneene wami nae. 16Kristo ngɔ e wami ngɔ ha ngɛ wa he. Kɛ gu enɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ, wa na bɔ nɛ suɔmi tsuɔ ní ha. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e sa kaa wɔ hu waa ngɔ wa wami ngɔ ha ngɛ wa nyɛmimɛ a he. 17Ke nɔ ko ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi ní, nɛ e na e nyɛmi nɛ e fi lɛ, se e mi mi sãã we lɛ ngɛ e nyɛmi ɔ he nɛ e ye bua lɛ ɔ, anɛ e ma nyɛ de ke e suɔ Mawu lo? 18Ye bimɛ nɛ i suɔ! Ke wa ke wa suɔ nɔ ko ɔ, wa ko de kɛ nya kɛkɛ; wa suɔmi ɔ nɛ pee anɔkuale suɔmi nɛ jee kpo ngɛ ní peemi mi.
Kã peemi ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi
19Enɛ ɔ waa kɛ maa le kaa wa ngɛ Mawu anɔkualetsɛ ɔ blɔ fa mi, nɛ wa he nile be wɔ fɔ bue ngɛ e hɛ mi. 20Se ke wa he nile buɔ wɔ fɔ ɔ, wa le kaa Mawu kle pe wa he nile ɔ, nɛ e le nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ hulɔ. 21Ye nyɛmimɛ nɛ i suɔ! Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke wa he nile bui wɔ fɔ ɔ, wa yi gbeye kaa wa maa ya Mawu hɛ mi. 22Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ wa bi lɛ ɔ, e haa wɔ, ejakaa wa yeɔ e mlaa amɛ a nɔ, nɛ wa peeɔ níhi nɛ sa e hɛ mi. 23 Nɔ́ nɛ e fa wɔ ke waa pee ji kaa wa he e Bi Yesu Kristo waa ye, nɛ waa suɔ wa sibi kaa bɔ nɛ Kristo fa wɔ ɔ. 24Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ yeɔ Mawu mlaa amɛ a nɔ ɔ, e hii Mawu mi, nɛ Mawu hu hii e mi. Nɛ mumi ɔ nɛ Mawu ha wɔ ɔ he je ɔ, wa le kaa Mawu ngɛ wa mi.

Title: YOHANE I 4
Content:
Anɔkuale mumi kɛ lakpa mumi
1Ye nyɛmimɛ nɛ i suɔ, nyɛ ko he nɔ tsuaa nɔ ko kɛkɛ nɛ deɔ ke e ná Mawu mumi ɔ nyɛɛ ye. Se mohu nyɛɛ ka nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ nyɛɛ hyɛ kaa mumi nɛ e ngɛ ɔ je Mawu ngɔ lo. Ejakaa je ɔ hyi tɔ kɛ lakpa gbali sɔuu. 2Nɔ́ nɛ nyɛɛ kɛ ma yo Mawu mumi ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa jaje kaa Yesu Kristo ba je ɔ mi kaa adesa a, mumi nɛ je Mawu ngɔ ɔ ngɛ e mi. 3Se nɔ nɛ jajeɔ kaa nɔ́ nɛ a de ngɛ Yesu he nɛ ɔ be mi ɔ, e mumi ɔ ji Mawu ngɔ. Mumi nɛ ngɛ e mi ɔ je Kristo he nyɛlɔ ɔ ngɔ. Nyɛ nu kaa e ma, pi jã? Ee, amlɔ nɛ ɔ, e ná ba je ɔ mi momo.
4Bimɛ tsɔwi, nyɛɛ lɛɛ Mawu níhi ji nyɛ, nɛ nyɛ ye lakpa gbali ɔmɛ a nɔ kunimi. Ejakaa mumi nɛ ngɛ nyɛ mi ɔ, e he wa kulaa pe mumi nɛ ngɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ a kɛ je ɔ ngɛ bɔe ɔ a mi. 5Jamɛ a lakpa gbali ɔmɛ ɔ, munyu nɛ kɔɔ je nɛ ɔ mi níhi a he nɛ a tuɔ. Nɛ je ɔ buɔ mɛ tue, ejakaa je ɔ mi nɛ a je. 6Se wɔɔ lɛɛ Mawu níhi ji wɔ. Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ le Mawu ɔ, e buɔ wɔ tue; nihi nɛ kɛ Mawu be ɔ, mɛɛ a bui wɔ tue. Enɛ ɔ waa kɛ naa slɔɔto nɛ ngɛ anɔkuale mumi ɔ, kɛ lakpa mumi ɔ a kpɛti.
Mawu ɔ suɔmi ji lɛ
7Ye nyɛmimɛ nɛ i suɔ! Nyɛ ha waa suɔ wa sibi, ejakaa suɔmi ɔ, Mawu ngɔ nɛ e je. Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ suɔ nɔmlɔ ɔ, Mawu bi ji lɛ, nɛ e le Mawu. 8Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ sume nɔmlɔ ɔ, e li Mawu; ejakaa Mawu ɔ, suɔmi ji lɛ. 9Blɔ nɔ nɛ Mawu gu kɛ je e suɔmi ɔ kpo kɛ tsɔɔ wɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: e tsɔ e Bi kake too ɔ kɛ ba je ɔ mi, konɛ kɛ gu e Bi ɔ nɔ ɔ, wa na wami. 10Bɔ nɛ suɔmi ngɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: pi wɔ nɛ wa sɛ hlami kɛ suɔ Mawu; Mawu mohu lɛ suɔ wɔ. Enɛ ɔ he ɔ, e tsɔ e Bi ɔ kɛ ba, konɛ e ba dla waa kɛ Mawu wa kpɛti, nɛ a ngɔ wa he yayami ɔmɛ ngɔ pa wɔ.
11Ye nyɛmimɛ nɛ i suɔ, ke kikɛ nɛ ɔ Mawu suɔ wɔ ɔ, wɔ hu e sa kaa waa suɔ wa sibi. 12 Mawu ɔ, nɔ ko nɛ lɛ hyɛ. Se ke wa suɔ wa sibi ɔ, Mawu hii wa mi, nɛ suɔmi nɛ e ngɛ kɛ ha wɔ ɔ mi waa.
13Mawu ngɔ lɛ nitsɛ e mumi ɔ ngɔ ha wɔ. Nɛ enɛ ɔ waa kɛ na kaa niinɛ, Mawu ngɛ wa mi; nɛ wɔ hu wa ngɛ e mi. 14Wa na enɛ ɔ, nɛ wa ngɛ odase yee kaa Tsɛ ɔ tsɔ e Bi ɔ kɛ ba kaa je ɔ yi wami helɔ. 15Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ jajeɔ paa kaa Yesu ɔ, Mawu Bi ji lɛ ɔ, Mawu hii e mi, nɛ lɛ hu e hii Mawu mi. 16Suɔmi nɛ Mawu ngɛ kɛ ha wɔ ɔ, wɔ nitsɛmɛ wa le, nɛ wa ji he nɔ́.
Mawu ɔ, suɔmi ji lɛ, nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ suɔ nɔmlɔ kɛ e tsui tsuo ɔ, e hii Mawu mi, nɛ Mawu hu hii e mi. 17Suɔmi nɛ Mawu ngɛ kɛ ha wɔ ɔ mi wa wawɛɛ, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ kojomi ligbi ɔ, wa ko ye gbeye. Ejakaa wa je mi bami ngɛ kaa bɔ nɛ Kristo nitsɛ ba e je mi. 18He nɛ suɔmi ngɛ ɔ, gbeye yemi be lejɛ ɔ; suɔmi nɛ mi wa a fieɔ gbeye tsuo kɛ yaa se. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ yeɔ gbeye ɔ, Mawu suɔmi nɛ mi wa a be e mi. Ejakaa gbeye yemi, kɛ tue gblami lɛ nyɛɛɔ.
19Wa suɔ Mawu, ejakaa lɛ nɛ suɔ wɔ kekle. 20Ke nɔ ko ke e suɔ Mawu, se e nyɛɛ e nyɛmi ɔ, lakpatsɛ ji lɛ. Ejakaa nɔ nɛ sume e nyɛmi nɛ e naa kɛ hɛngmɛ ɔ, kɛ e maa pee kɛɛ nɛ e maa suɔ Mawu nɛ e nɛ ɔ. 21Mlaa nɛ Kristo wo wɔ ji nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ suɔ Mawu ɔ, e sa kaa e suɔ e nyɛmi hulɔ.

Title: YOHANE I 5
Content:
Wa ye je ɔ nɔ kunimi
1Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ heɔ yeɔ kaa Yesu ji Kristo ɔ, Mawu bi ji lɛ; nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ suɔ nɔ ko tsɛ ɔ, e suɔ nɔ ɔ bi hulɔ. 2Nɔ́ nɛ waa kɛ maa na kaa wa suɔ Mawu bimɛ ɔmɛ ji wa maa bu Mawu tue, nɛ wa maa ye e mlaa amɛ a nɔ. 3 Ejakaa ke wa suɔ Mawu ɔ, wa yeɔ e mlaa amɛ a nɔ. Nɛ e mlaa amɛ a nɔ yemi wɛ kulaa, 4ejakaa Mawu bimɛ tsuo ma nyɛ maa ye je ɔ nɔ kunimi; ee, wa hemi kɛ yemi waa kɛ yeɔ je ɔ nɔ kunimi. 5Mɛnɔ ma nyɛ maa ye je ɔ nɔ kunimi? Ja nɔ nɛ heɔ yeɔ kaa Yesu ɔ, Mawu Bi ji lɛ.
Yesu Kristo he odase
6Benɛ Yesu Kristo ba a, a sɔle lɛ kɛ nyu, nɛ e plɛ e muɔ ngɔ pue si, nɛ e gbo. Pi nyu ɔ kɛkɛ nɛ e kɛ ba, se nyu kɛ muɔ tsuo. Nɛ mumi ɔ nitsɛ yeɔ odase kaa nɔ́ nɛ ɔ ngɛ mi, ejakaa mumi ɔ, anɔkualetsɛ ji lɛ. 7Odase yeli etɛ lɛ ngɛ; 8mumi ɔ, kɛ nyu ɔ, kɛ muɔ ɔ; nɛ nɔ́ etɛ ɔmɛ tsuo yeɔ odase kake too ɔ. 9Wa heɔ adesa we odase yeɔ, se Mawu we odase ɔ mi jiɔ kulaa pe adesa nɔ́. Nɛ Mawu ɔ nitsɛ lɛ ye odase nɛ ɔ ngɛ e Bi ɔ he. 10Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ heɔ Mawu Bi ɔ yeɔ ɔ ngɔɔ odase nɛ ɔ kɛ toɔ lɛ nitsɛ e tsui mi, nɛ e hii he susue.
