Se nɔ nɛ he we Mawu yi ɔ ha nɛ Mawu plɛ lakpatsɛ; ejakaa nɔ́ nɛ Mawu de ngɛ e Bi ɔ he ɔ, nɔ ɔ he we yi. 11 Odase ɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: Mawu ha wɔ neneene wami kɛ gu e Bi ɔ nɔ. 12Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ngɛ Bi ɔ, e ngɛ wami; nɔ nɛ be Mawu Bi ɔ, e be wami hulɔ.
Neneene wami
13I ngɛ nyɛ womi nɛ ɔ ngmae, konɛ nyɛ nihi nɛ nyɛ heɔ Mawu Bi ɔ yeɔ ɔ, nyɛ ná nɛ nyɛɛ le kaa nyɛ ngɛ neneene wami. 14Wa yi gbeye ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi, ejakaa wa le kaa ke waa kɛ juɛmi kpakpa bi lɛ nɔ́ ko ɔ, e buɔ wɔ tue. 15Be tsuaa be nɛ wa bi lɛ nɔ́ ko ɔ, e buɔ wɔ tue. Nɛ akɛnɛ wa le kaa e ngɛ mi jã niinɛ he je ɔ, wa le hu kaa níhi nɛ wa biɔ lɛ ɔ, e haa wɔ.
16Ke o na o nyɛmi nɛ ngɛ yayami pee, nɛ pi yayami nɔ́ nɛ ma ha nɛ e hɛ mi nɛ kpata a, moo fa kue ha Mawu, konɛ e ha lɛ wami. Nihi tsuo nɛ peeɔ yayami nɔ́ nɛ ha we nɛ nɔ hɛ mi kpataa a, enɛ ɔ kɔɔ a he. Se yayami ngɛ nɛ haa nɔ hɛ mi kpataa, nɛ lɔ ɔ lɛɛ i de we ke nyɛɛ fa kue ha Mawu ngɛ he. 17Nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ dɛ blɔ ɔ, e ji yayami; se yayami ngɛ nɛ ha we nɛ nɔ hɛ mi kpataa.
18Wa le kaa nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ji Mawu bi ɔ, e bua jɔɛ yayami peemi he. Ejakaa Mawu Bi ɔ baa e yi, nɛ Abosiami na we e he blɔ.
19Wa le kaa Mawu níhi ji wɔ, pohu je ɔ, Abosiami lɛ ngɛ nɔ yee.
20Wa le kaa Mawu Bi ɔ ba, nɛ e ba bli wa juɛmi nya, konɛ waa le anɔkuale Mawu ɔ. Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, waa kɛ anɔkuale Mawu ɔ ngɛ, ejakaa wa ngɛ e Bi Yesu Kristo ɔ mi. Lɛ ji anɔkuale Mawu ɔ nɛ, nɛ enɛ ɔ ji neneene wami.
21Ye bimɛ nɛ i suɔ! Nyɛɛ hyɛ nyɛ he nɛ hi ngɛ amagahi a he!

Title: YOHANE II, NYA TSƆƆMI
Content:
NYA TSƆƆMI
Yohane Womi Enyɔne ɔ, “Nɔkɔtɔma a” lɛ ngma ya ha “Awenyɛ nɛ e suɔ ɔ, kɛ awenyɛ ɔ bimɛ ɔmɛ.” Blɔɔ asafo ko, kɛ e mi bi a ngɛ tsɔɔe ɔ nɛ. Kɛ gu sɛ gbi kpiti nɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ, Yohane ngɛ kue fae ha asafo mi bi ɔmɛ nɛ á suɔ a sibi. E ngɛ mɛ ga woe hulɔ nɛ a hyɛ a he saminya ngɛ lakpa tsɔɔli, kɛ níhi nɛ a ngɛ tsɔɔe ɔ a he.
Bɔ nɛ a dla womi ɔ mi ha
Sisije 1-3
Suɔmi he hiami 4-6
Kɔkɔ bɔmi ngɛ lakpa tsɔɔmi he 7-11
Nyagbe 12-13

Title: YOHANE II, 1
Content:
1Imi nɔkɔtɔma a, i ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ ngmae kɛ ha mo awenyɛ nɛ a hla mo ɔ, kɛ o bimɛ ɔmɛ nɛ i suɔ nyɛ akɛnɛ nyɛ hɛɛ anɔkuale ɔ mi ɔ. Pi imi nɔ kake too nɛ i suɔ nyɛ; nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ le anɔkuale ɔ suɔ nyɛ. 2Ejakaa anɔkuale ɔ ngɛ wa mi, nɛ anɔkuale ɔ kɛ wɔ maa hi si kɛ maa ya neneene.
3Dloomi, mɔbɔ nami, kɛ he jɔmi nɛ je Tsɛ Mawu ɔ, kɛ Tsɛ ɔ Bi Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo dɛ mi ɔ kɛ wɔ nɛ hi si ngɛ anɔkuale kɛ suɔmi mi.
Anɔkuale kɛ suɔmi
4I na bua jɔmi babauu, benɛ i nu kaa o bimɛ ɔmɛ ekomɛ baa a je mi ngɛ anɔkuale ɔ nya kaa bɔ nɛ Tsɛ ɔ fa wɔ ke waa pee ɔ. 5 Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, awenyɛ nɛ i suɔ! I kpa mo pɛɛ, nyɛ ha nɛ waa suɔ wa sibi. Nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ ngmae nɛ ɔ, pi mlaa he, se mohu mlaa a nɛ a wo wɔ kɛ je sisije ɔ. 6Suɔmi nɛ i ngɛ he munyu tue ɔ tsɔɔ kaa waa ye Mawu mlaa amɛ a nɔ. Kaa bɔ nɛ nyɛ nu kɛ je sisije ɔ, mlaa a ji kaa nyɛ tsuo nyɛɛ suɔ nyɛ he.
7Sisili fuu ngɛ je ɔ mi he tsuaa he. Mɛ ji nihi nɛ kplɛɛ we kaa Yesu Kristo ba je ɔ mi kaa nɔmlɔ adesa. Nimli kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ ji sisili, kɛ Kristo he nyɛli ɔ nɛ. 8Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ hyɛ nyɛ he saminya, konɛ ní nɛ wa tsu ɔ, nyɛ ko je mi dɛ gu; se mohu nyɛ ná hiɔwo nɛ sa.
9Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa je Kristo sane kpakpa a se ya tsɔɔ nɔ́ kpa a, e li Mawu. Nɔ nɛ tsɔɔ sane kpakpa a pɛpɛɛpɛ kaa bɔ nɛ e ngɛ kɛ je sisije ɔ, jamɛ a nɔ ɔ le Tsɛ ɔ, kɛ Bi ɔ tsuo. 10Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke nɔ ko ba nyɛ ngɔ, nɛ e ba tsɔɔ we ní kaa bɔ nɛ Kristo tsɔɔ ɔ, nyɛ ko he lɛ atuu, nɛ nyɛ ba de lɛ ke, “He manye!” tete po. 11Ke nɔ ko ha lɛ hɛ mi ɔ, e tsɔɔ kaa e kɛ lɛ peeɔ kake kɛ tsuɔ ní yayamihi.
Nyagbe sɛ yemi
12I ngɛ níhi fuu nɛ ma ngma nyɛ mohu, se i sume kaa i kɛ ningma nyu ngmaa ngɔ fɔ womi hɛ mi. Mohu ɔ, i ngɛ blɔ hyɛe kaa ma ba slaa nyɛ. Ke i ba a, i kɛ nyɛ maa sɛɛ ní hɛ mi kɛ hɛ mi, nɛ wa ma na bua jɔmi babauu.
13Nyɛ nyɛmiyo nɛ nyɛ suɔ lɛ ɔ bimɛ ɔmɛ ke a biɔ nyɛ.

Title: YOHANE III, NYA TSƆƆMI
Content:
NYA TSƆƆMI
Yohane Womi Etɛne ɔ, “Nɔkɔtɔma a” lɛ ngma ya ha asafo nya dalɔ ko nɛ a tsɛɛ Gayo. Womi ngmalɔ ɔ jé Gayo yi kaa e ngɛ dengme gboe ngɛ Kristo se nyɛɛli kpa komɛ a he. E bɔ lɛ kɔkɔ hu ngɛ nyumu ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Diotrefe ɔ he.
Bɔ nɛ a dla womi ɔ mi ha
Sisije 1-4
A je Gayo yi 5-8
A bu Diotrefe fɔ 9-10
A je Demetrio yi 11-12
Nyagbe 13-15

Title: YOHANE III, 1
Content:
1 Imi nɔkɔtɔma a, i ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ ngmae kɛ ha mo Gayo nɛ i suɔ mo saminya kɛ ye tsui tsuo ɔ.
2Ye nyɛmi nɛ i suɔ, i ngɛ kue fae ha Mawu, nɛ o ya nɔ ngɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ mi. O hi gblagblaagbla ngɛ nɔmlɔ tso mi kaa bɔ nɛ i le nɛ o ngɛ mumi mi he wami ɔ. 3I na bua jɔmi babauu benɛ nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ ekomɛ ba hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ ba bɔ mi amaniɛ ngɛ o he ɔ. A tsɔɔ kaa o ngɔ o he ngɔ ha Mawu kulaa kaa bɔ nɛ o ngɛ anɔkuale mi ɔ. 4Nɔ́ nɛ peeɔ mi bua jɔmi pe kulaa ji kaa ma nu kaa ye bimɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ nyɛɛe ngɛ anɔkuale ɔ nya.
A jé Gayo yi
5Ye nyɛmi nɛ i suɔ saminya! Dengme nɛ o ngɛ gboe ngɛ nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ a he, titli nibwɔ ɔmɛ ɔ, o tsui tsuo o kɛ ngɛ ní nɛ ɔ tsue. 6A ba ye suɔmi nɛ o ngɛ kɛ ha mɛ ɔ he odase ha asafo ɔ ngɛ hiɛ ɔ. I kpa mo pɛɛ nɛ o wo mɛ blɔ saminya bɔ nɛ maa sa Mawu hɛ mi nɛ a kɛ tsa a blɔ hiami ɔ nɔ. 7Ejakaa blɔ nɛ a hia nɛ ɔ, Kristo ní tsumi a ngɛ tsue, nɛ a he we nihi nɛ li Mawu ɔ a dɛ mi yemi kɛ buami ko kulaa. 8Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, wɔ nɛ wa le Kristo ɔ, e hia kaa waa ye kɛ bua nimli nɛ ɔmɛ, nɛ waa piɛ a he kɛ tsu anɔkuale ɔ he ní tsumi ɔ.
Diotrefe kɛ Demetrio
9I ngma womi kpiti ko ngɔ mane asafo ɔ. Se Diotrefe, nɔ nɛ hlaa kaa e pee e he nɔkɔtɔma a bui mi kulaa. 10Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke i ba a, lakpa munyuhi nɛ e ngɛ tue ngɛ wa he ɔ, ma wo nɔ ta, konɛ nyɛɛ na nihi tsuo nɛ e ngɛ pee ɔ. Se enɛ ɔ tete pi ha lɛ. Ke nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ ba e ngɔ ɔ, e he we mɛ atuu. Asafo ɔ mi bi komɛ nɛ mɛɛ a suɔ kaa a ma he nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ atuu po, e tsiɔ a nya; nɛ e hlaa kaa e fie mɛ kɛ je asafo ɔ mi!
11Ye nyɛmi nɛ i suɔ! Ko ya wo nihi nɛ peeɔ ní yayamihi a nane; moo kase nihi nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ kpakpa mohu. Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ peeɔ nɔ́ kpakpa a, Mawu nɔ́ ji lɛ; nɔ nɛ peeɔ yayami ɔ, e li Mawu.
12Demetrio lɛɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ tuɔ e he munyu kpakpa; nɛ jã nɔuu nɛ anɔkuale ɔ nitsɛ hu tsɔɔ. Wɔ hu wa ngɛ e he odase yee ja nɔuu, nɛ nyɛ le kaa anɔkuale wa ngɛ tue.
Nyagbe sɛ yemi
13I ngɛ níhi fuu nɛ ma ngma mo, se i sume kaa i kɛ ningma tso kɛ ningma nyu ngmaa. 14Mohu ɔ, i heɔ yeɔ kaa e be kɛe kulaa nɛ ma na mo, nɛ wa maa sɛɛ ní hɛ mi kɛ hɛ mi.
15I ngɛ he jɔmi bae ha mo.
O huɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ke a biɔ mo. Nga wa huɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsuo kakaaka ha wɔ.

Title: YUDA NYA TSƆƆMI
Content:
NYA TSƆƆMI
Yuda ngma womi nɛ ɔ ya ha Yesu se nyɛɛli tsuo, konɛ a hyɛ a he saminya ngɛ lakpa tsɔɔli nɛ mɛ hu a deɔ ke a heɔ Yesu yeɔ ɔ a he. Womi kpiti nɛ ɔ mi munyu ɔmɛ ngɛ kaa Petro Womi Enyɔne ɔ mi munyu ɔmɛ nɔuu. Yuda ngma womi nɛ ɔ kɛ wo Kristo se nyɛɛli ɔmɛ mumi mi he wami. E de mɛ ke, “Hemi kɛ yemi ɔ nɛ Mawu ha e nihi nɛ e hla mɛ si kake nyɔngloo ɔ, a hɛɛ mi wawɛɛ.”
Bɔ nɛ a dla womi ɔ mi ha
Sisije 1-2
Lakpa tsɔɔli ɔmɛ a su, a tsɔɔmi, kɛ bɔ nɛ a nyagbe maa ba ha 3-16
Yuda wo ga ke a hɛɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ mi wawɛɛ 17-23
Gbaami 24-25

Title: YUDA 1
Content:
1 Imi Yuda, Yesu Kristo tsɔlɔ, kɛ Yakobo nyɛminyumu ɔ, i ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ ngmae kɛ ya ha Kristo se nyɛɛli tsuo, nihi nɛ Tsɛ Mawu suɔ, nɛ e hla mɛ, nɛ a ngɔ mɛ ngɔ to ha Yesu Kristo ɔ.
2Mɔbɔ nami, suɔmi, kɛ he jɔmi nɛ hiɛ babauu ha nyɛ.
Lakpa tsɔɔli
3Ye nyɛmimɛ nɛ i suɔ! Jinɛ i ngɛ mɔde bɔe nɛ ma ngma nyɛ womi, nɛ wɔ tsuo wa yi wami hemi sane ɔ, ma tsɔɔ nyɛ nya saminya. Se i na kaa e hia kaa ma ngma nyɛ nɔuu ngɛ nɔ́ kpa he mohu. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i kɛ womi nɛ ɔ ngɛ nyɛ mumi mi he wami woe, konɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ nɛ Mawu ngɔ ha e nihi nɛ e hla mɛ si kake nyɔngloo ɔ, nyɛɛ hɛɛ mi wawɛɛ. 4I ngɛ enɛ ɔ dee, ejakaa ni komɛ nɛ li Mawu ju si ba sɛ wa kpɛti. Sɛ gbi nɛ kɔɔ dloomi nɛ Mawu dloo wɔ ɔ he ɔ, nimli nɛ ɔmɛ plɛ hɛ mi ngɔ bu si, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ a kɛ laa a yakayaka ní peemi ɔmɛ a nɔ. Yesu Kristo, wa Tsɔɔlɔ, kɛ wa Nyɔmtsɛ kake too ɔ hu a kua lɛ. Blema lokoo lɛ ngmami ɔmɛ de to kaa a ma kpata nimli nɛ ɔmɛ a hɛ mi.
5 Nyɛ le enɛ ɔ momo lɛɛ, se i suɔ kaa ma kai nyɛ. Benɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ jé Israel bi ɔmɛ si kake nyɔngloo kɛ je Egipt se ɔ, e kpata ni nɛmɛ nɛ he we yi ɔ a hɛ mi. 6Nyɛ kai Mawu bɔfohi nɛ hɛɛ blɔ nya sa a, nɛ pee se ɔ, a tsɔ atuã kɛ je mɛ nitsɛmɛ a si himi he ɔ. Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, a kɛ kɔsɔkɔsɔ fi mɛ, nɛ Mawu ngɔ mɛ ngɔ to gbogboehi a je ngɛ diblii nɛ mi ti mi. Lejɛ ɔ nɛ a maa hi hluu kɛ yaa si ligbi ngua a maa su, nɛ a maa kojo mɛ. 7 Nyɛ kai Sodom kɛ Gomora, kɛ mahi nɛ bɔle mɛ kɛ kpe ɔ. Ma nɛ ɔmɛ a mi bi ɔmɛ fiɛ yo kɛ nyumu yakayaka fiɛmi, nɛ a ya nyɛɛ akɔnɔ yayahi a se kaa bɔ nɛ jamɛ a bɔfo ɔmɛ pee ɔ nɔuu. Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ a tue gblami ji kaa a ngɔ mɛ ngɔ wo la nɛ gbo we mi, konɛ a pee okadi kɛ ha nihi tsuo.
8Jã nɔuu lakpa tsɔɔli nɛ ɔmɛ hu bleɔ he lo ɔ; a teɔ si kɛ siɔ Mawu nɔ yemi ɔ, nɛ a jɛɔ ni klɔuklɔuhi nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ po. 9 Mawu bɔfo nɔkɔtɔma Mikael tete po pee we enɛ ɔ. Benɛ e kɛ Abosiami pɛ, nɛ e kɛ lɛ sã nya kaa mɛnɔ lɛ sa kaa e ngɔ Mose flɔ̃ ɔ, Mikael jɛ we Abosiami; e yi e he fɛu hulɔ. Nɔ́ nɛ e de lɛ ji, “Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nɛ ka o hɛ mi!” 10Se nimli nɛ ɔmɛ lɛɛ nɔ́ ko nɛ a nui sisi ɔ, a tuɔ he munyu yaya. Se níhi nɛ a nuɔ he kaa pu mi lohwehi nɛ mɛɛ lɛɛ a susuu we yi mi ɔ, lɔ ɔmɛ nɔuu ji níhi nɛ kpataa a hɛ mi. 11 Musu tloo mɛ pɛ! A ya ngɔ Kain blɔ ɔ. Yayami nɛ Balaam pee ɔ, a ngɔ a he ya wo jamɛ a yayami ɔ mi ngɛ se nami he. A tsɔ atuã kaa bɔ nɛ Kora tsɔ atuã a, nɛ a hɛ mi kpata kaa lɛ. 12Ke nimli nɛ ɔmɛ ba futu nyɛ kɛ ngɛ suɔmi niye ní yee ɔ, a woɔ ní ɔ he mu. A yeɔ ní tsuatsuaatsua nɛ a susuu we ni kpahi a he. A ngɛ kaa bɔku nɛ nyu be mi nɛ kɔɔhiɔ ngɛ lɛ fiae kɛ bee. A ngɛ kaa tsohi nɛ ní kpami be po a nɛ yiblii ngɛ a nɔ; tsohi nɛ gbo, nɛ a hia mɛ kɛ sipoku tsuo ngɔ fɔ si. 13A ngɛ kaa wo mi oslɔke nɛ ngɛ kue hamahama, nɛ a zo ní ɔmɛ je kpo paa kaa hwɔli. A ngɛ kaa dodoehi nɛ ngɛ si bɔlee kɛ ngɛ yae kɛ ngɛ bae; nimli nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, Mawu dla he ko ngɔ to mɛ momo ngɛ gbogboehi a je diblii nɛ mi ti ɔ mi.
14 Henok, Adam nina tutuutu ekpane ɔ, nɔ́ nɛ e gba blema lokoo ngɛ nimli nɛ ɔmɛ a he ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: “Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ma kɛ e bɔfo klɔuklɔuhi akpeakpe abɔ. 15E maa kojo nimli tsuo; nihi nɛ li Mawu ɔ, e maa gbla a tue bɔ nɛ sa ngɛ a ní yayami ɔmɛ, kɛ musu bɔmi munyuhi nɛ a tu kɛ si Mawu ɔ a he.”
16Daa nɛ ɔ, nimli nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ munyu huitihuiti tue kɛ ngɛ bee; nɔ́ muɛ a hɛ gblegbleegble. Mɛ nitsɛmɛ a he akɔnɔ yayahi a se nɛ a dii. A fĩaa; a peeɔ nya puu, nɛ a gbee nihi a yi mi, konɛ a kɛ na ni ɔmɛ a he blɔ.
A ngɛ Kristo se nyɛɛli ɔmɛ ga woe
17Se nyɛ ye nyɛmimɛ nɛ i suɔ! Nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ kai níhi nɛ wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo bɔfo ɔmɛ de to ɔ. 18 A de ke, “Nyagbe be ɔ mi ɔ, nihi maa ba nɛ a maa ye nyɛ he fɛu; a maa pee ní yayamihi nɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a tsui suɔ.” 19Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ ji nimli nɛ kɛ mi gbami baa a nɛ. A he lo ɔ lɛ yeɔ a nɔ; a be mumi ɔ. 20Se nyɛ ye nyɛmimɛ nɛ i suɔ! Nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛɛ hɛɛ nyɛ hemi kɛ yemi klɔuklɔu ɔ mi wawɛɛ nɛ nyɛ nane nɛ pi si ngɛ mi. Nyɛɛ sɔle ngɛ Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ he wami ɔ nya. 21Be mi nɛ nyɛ ngɛ wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo blɔ hyɛe nɛ e ba na nyɛ mɔbɔ, nɛ e ha nyɛ neneene wami ɔ, nyɛɛ hyɛ nyɛ he nɔ saminya. Kɛkɛ ɔ, suɔmi nɛ Mawu ngɛ kɛ ha nyɛ ɔ maa hi si daa.
22Ni nɛmɛ nɛ a yi mi peeɔ mɛ sikɔsikɔ ɔ, nyɛɛ na mɛ mɔbɔ; 23nyɛ je ni komɛ hu kɛ je la a mi; nyɛɛ na ni kpa komɛ hu mɔbɔ nɛ gbeye yemi ngɛ mi. Se tadehi nɛ a wo ɔ tete po nyɛɛ hie; ejakaa a kɛ he lo akɔnɔ wo he mu.
Yi jemi sɔlemi
24Lɛ nɔ nɛ e ngɛ he wami nɛ e kɛ maa hyɛ nyɛ nɛ nyɛ be si nɔe, nɛ e maa hɛɛ nyɛ kɛ bua jɔmi kɛ ba e hɛ mi nyami klɔuklɔu ɔ mi nɛ piami ko be nyɛ he hie ɔ, 25lɛ Mawu kake too, wa kpɔlɔ ɔ, a gu wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu Kristo nɔ kɛ wo e hɛ mi nyami. E nɔ́ ji agboje, kɛ he wami, kɛ he blɔ kɛ je blema lokoo kɛ ba si amlɔ nɛ ɔ, kɛ yaa neneene tɔɔ! Amen.

Title: KPOJEMI NYA TSƆƆMI
Content:
NYA TSƆƆMI
A ngma womi nɛ ɔ be mi nɛ a ngɛ Kristo se nyɛɛli ɔmɛ yi mi wae wawɛɛ ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi nɛ a ngɛ ngɛ Yesu Kristo mi kaa lɛ ji Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ he. Womi ngmalɔ ɔ ngma womi nɛ ɔ titli nɛ e kɛ wo nihi nɛ maa kane ɔ he wami ke a ngɛ mɛ konɛ yi mi wae jio, a ngɛ nɔ nae jio, a ngɔ a hɛ ngɔ fɔ Mawu nɔ, nɛ a ye lɛ anɔkuale daa.
Nina kɛ níhi babauu nɛ a je tsɔɔ Yohane titli lɛ ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ mi. A ngɔ okadi komɛ kɛ tsɔɔ ní nɛ ɔmɛ a sisi bɔ nɛ blema Kristo se nyɛɛli ɔmɛ ma nyɛ maa nu sisi hluu, se ni kpahi lɛɛ laami sane ji ní nɛ ɔmɛ kɛ ha mɛ. A gu nina slɔɔtohi a nɔ kɛ ti munyu oti ɔmɛ a mi si abɔ ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ mi. Bɔ nɛ sa kaa a tsɔɔ womi ɔ sisi fitsofitso ɔ be tɛ kake nɔ; nihi slɔɔtoslɔɔto hɛɛ juɛmi munomuno ngɛ he. Se nɔ́ pɔtɛɛ nɛ jeɔ kpo paa ngɛ womi ɔ mi ji kaa nyagbenyagbe ɔ, kɛ gu Nyɔmtsɛ Kristo nɔ ɔ, Mawu maa ye he nyɛli ɔmɛ tsuo a nɔ butuu; e maa ye Abosiami hu nɔ ja nɔuu. Ke Mawu ye kunimi ɔ gbe nya a, lɛ nitsɛ e nihi nɛ yeɔ lɛ anɔkuale ɔ, e maa gbaa mɛ babauu; e ma ha mɛ hiɔwe he, kɛ zugba he. Hiɔwo nɛ a ma na ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.
Bɔ nɛ a dla womi ɔ mi ha
Sisije 1.1-8
Kekleekle nina, kɛ womihi nɛ a ngma asafo kpaago ɔmɛ 1.9—3.22
Womi kpo kɛ e nya sɔumi nɔ kpaago ɔ 4.1—8.1
Titimati kpaago ɔmɛ 8.2—11.19
Sinɔ ngua a, kɛ lohwe awi yeli enyɔ ɔmɛ 12.1—13.18
Nina munomunohi 14.1—15.8
Sowe kpaago ɔmɛ nɛ daa si kɛ ha Mawu mi mi fumi ɔ 16.1-21
A kpata Babilon hɛ mi, nɛ a ye lohwe awi yelɔ ɔ, kɛ lakpa gbalɔ ɔ, kɛ Abosiami a nɔ kunimi 17.1—20.10
Nyagbe kojomi 20.11-15
Hiɔwe he, zugba he, kɛ Yerusalem he 21.1—22.5
Nyagbe 22.6-21

Title: KPOJEMI 1
Content:
1Ní komɛ nɛ Yesu Kristo je tsɔɔ ɔ, a he sane lɛ ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ mi. Mawu je nina a ngɔ tsɔɔ Kristo, konɛ lɛ hu e tsɔɔ e tsɔli ɔmɛ nɔ́ nɛ maa ba mi ngɛ be kpiti mi. Kristo tsɔ e bɔfo ɔ kɛ ya e tsɔlɔ Yohane ngɔ, nɛ e ya ha nɛ e le ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo. 2Níhi nɛ Yohane na a, e ye lɛ tsuo he odase ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ mi. Enɛ ɔ ji sɛ gbi nɛ je Mawu ngɔ ɔ, kɛ anɔkuale ɔ nɛ Yesu Kristo je tsɔɔ lɛ ɔ. 3A gbaa nɔ nɛ kaneɔ womi nɛ ɔ. Nihi nɛ nuɔ sɛ gbi nɛ a gba ngɔ to ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ mi, nɛ a yeɔ nɔ ɔ, á gbaa mɛ. Ejakaa be ɔ nɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo maa ba mi ɔ su ta.
Yohane ngɔ sɛ gbi ngɔ mane asafo kpaago ɔmɛ
4 Imi Yohane nɛ i ngma womi nɛ ɔ ya ha asafo kpaago ɔmɛ ngɛ Asia.
Dloomi kɛ he jɔmi nɛ je Mawu, nɔ nɛ ngɛ kɛ je blema, nɔ nɛ ngɛ amlɔ nɛ ɔ, nɛ e maa ba a dɛ mi ɔ ha nyɛ. Jehanɛ ɔ, mumi kpaago ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ Mawu matsɛ sɛ ɔ hɛ mi ɔ, 5 kɛ Yesu Kristo nɛ yeɔ anɔkuale odase ɔ, nɛ lɛ ji kekleekle nɔ nɛ Mawu tle si kɛ je gbeje, nɛ lɛ nɛ e yeɔ zugba a nɔ matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ ɔ nɛ dloo nyɛ, nɛ e ha nyɛ he jɔmi ja nɔuu.
Nɔ nɛ suɔ wɔ, nɛ e kɛ lɛ nitsɛ e muɔ kpɔ wɔ kɛ je wa he yayami ɔmɛ a mi, nɛ 6 e to matsɛ yemi sisi ha wɔ, nɛ e pee wɔ osɔfohi, konɛ wa sɔmɔ e Tsɛ Mawu ɔ, nyɛ ha waa wo e hɛ mi nyami, nɛ e ye matsɛ kɛ ya neneene kɛ neneene. Amen.
7 Hyɛ! E ngɛ bɔku ɔmɛ a mi kɛ ma, nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ maa na lɛ; nihi nɛ gbɔɔ lɛ ní ɔ hu maa na lɛ. Nihi tsuo nɛ ngɛ je ɔ mi ɔ maa wo yana ha lɛ. Ee, é ba mi ja! Amen.
8 Nyɔmtsɛ Mawu Ope ɔ, nɔ nɛ ngɛ sa a, nɛ e ngɛ amlɔ nɛ ɔ, nɛ e maa ba a ke, “Imi ji kekleekle no kɛ nyagbe no.”
Yohane na Kristo nɛ ngɛ matsɛ yee
9Imi nyɛ nyɛmi Yohane lɛ i ngma womi nɛ ɔ. Kaa Kristo se nyɛɛlɔ ɔ, a ngɛ mi yi mi wae kaa nyɛ nɔuu. I kɛ nyɛ tsuo nɛ wa ngɛ Kristo matsɛ yemi ɔ blɔ hyɛe, nɛ e sa kaa waa to wa tsui si ngɛ amanehlu nɛ wa ngɛ nae ɔ mi. A ngɔ mi ya fɔ Patmo zugba kpɔ nɛ wo bɔle lɛ ɔ nɔ, ejakaa i fiɛ Mawu munyu ɔ, nɛ i ye Yesu he odase. 10Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ligbi ɔ, mumi ɔ ba ye nɔ, nɛ i nu gbi ko nɛ ngɛ pɛe wawɛɛ kaa titimati ngɛ ye se. 11Gbi ɔ de ke, “Ngmaa nɔ́ nɛ o na a ngɔ wo womi mi, nɛ o kɛ mane asafohi nɛ ngɛ ma kpaago nɛ ɔmɛ a mi: Efeso, Smirna, Pergamo, Tiatira, Sarde, Filadelfia, kɛ Laodikea.”
12I plɛ ye he, konɛ ma hyɛ nɔ nɛ kɛ mi ngɛ munyu tue ɔ. Nɛ benɛ i plɛ ɔ, i na sika tsu kane tso kpaago, 13 nɛ nɔ ko kaa Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ ngɛ a kpɛti. E wo tade klɔii, nɛ e ngɔ kpa nɛ a kɛ sika tsu pee kɛ fi e gugue. 14 E yi bwɔmi hiɛ futaa kaa to he bwɔmi hiɔ, loo snoo; nɛ e hɛngmɛ ngɛ kpɛe plamplam kaa la. 15 E nane ngɛ kpɛe kaa ayawa nɛ a tsu he ngɛ flɔɔnɔɔ mi, nɛ e gbi ngɛ pɛe wawɛɛ kaa pa nɛ hia kɛ bee. 16E hɛɛ dodoe kpaago ngɛ e hiɔ nine mi, nɛ klaate nya enyɔtsɛ nɛ nya ba ngɛ e nya mi, nɛ e hɛ mi ngɛ kpɛe kaa piani pu. 17 Benɛ i na lɛ ɔ, i nɔ si ngɛ e nane nya kaa nɔ gbogboe. Se e ngɔ e hiɔ nine ngɔ fɔ ye nɔ, nɛ e de mi ke, “Koo ye gbeye! Imi ji kekleekle no kɛ nyagbe no. 18Imi ji hɛ kalɔ ɔ! I gbo, se hyɛ, ye hɛ ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene. I ngɛ gbenɔ kɛ gbeje a nya safe. 19Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ngmaa nɔ́ nɛ o na nɛ ngɛ nɔ yae amlɔ nɛ ɔ, kɛ nɔ́ nɛ maa ba hwɔɔ se ɔ. 20Dodoe kpaago ɔmɛ nɛ o na ngɛ ye hiɔ nine mi, kɛ sika tsu kane tso kpaago ɔmɛ ɔ, laami sane nɛ kɔɔ a he ji nɛ ɔ nɛ: dodoe kpaago ɔmɛ daa si ha asafo kpaago ɔmɛ a bɔfohi, nɛ kane tso kpaago ɔmɛ daa si ha asafo kpaago ɔmɛ.”

Title: KPOJEMI 2
Content:
Womi nɛ a ngma ya ha asafo ɔ nɛ ngɛ Efeso ɔ
1Nɛ e de ke, “Bɔfo ɔ nɛ ngɛ Efeso asafo ɔ nya a, ngmaa womi nɛ ɔ ya ha lɛ ke,
“Nɔ nɛ hɛɛ dodoe kpaago ɔmɛ ngɛ e hiɔ nine mi, nɛ e ngɛ nyɛɛe ngɛ sika tsu kane tso kpaago ɔmɛ a kpɛti ɔ, sɛ gbi nɛ je e ngɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. 2I le ní nɛ o tsuɔ, dengme nɛ o gboɔ, kɛ bɔ nɛ o toɔ o tsui si. I le hu kaa o ha we yayami peeli hɛ mi. Nihi nɛ tsɛɔ a he bɔfohi, se pi bɔfohi ji mɛ ɔ, bɔ nɛ o ka mɛ, nɛ o na kaa lakpatsɛmɛ ji mɛ ɔ, i le lɛ tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ. 3O toɔ tsui si; o naa amanehlu ngɛ ye he nɛ pɔ tɔɛ mo. 4Se kɛ̃ ɔ, i kɛ mo ngɛ sane ko. O sume mi hu kaa bɔ nɛ o suɔ mi sa a. 5Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, moo hɛli o he si ngɛ nɔ nɛ mi nɛ o gbee si ngɛ ɔ he. Mo tsake o tsui, nɛ o hi si kaa kekle ɔ. Ke o tsakee we o tsui ɔ, ma ba o ngɔ, nɛ ma ba je o kane tso ɔ kɛ je e ma he ɔ. 6Se kɛ̃ ɔ, nɔ́ kake nɛ o pee nɛ hi ji kaa ní nɛ Nikolai bi ɔmɛ ngɛ tsue ɔ, o nyɛɛ kaa bɔ nɛ imi hu i nyɛɛ ɔ nɔuu.
7 “Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ nɛ ngɛ tue ɔ, e bu nɔ́ nɛ mumi ɔ ngɛ asafo ɔmɛ dee ɔ tue!
“Ni nɛmɛ nɛ maa ye kunimi ɔ, ma ha mɛ blɔ nɛ a maa ye tso nɛ haa nɔ wami nɛ ngɛ Mawu abɔɔ ɔ mi ɔ yiblii.”
Womi nɛ a ngma ya ha asafo ɔ nɛ ngɛ Smirna a
8 Nɛ e de ke, “Bɔfo ɔ nɛ ngɛ asafo ɔ nya ngɛ Smirna a, ngmaa womi nɛ ɔ ya ha lɛ ke,
“Sɛ gbi nɛ je nɔ nɛ ji kekleekle no kɛ nyagbe no ɔ ngɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ; e gbo, nɛ e kpale ba wami mi ekohu. 9I le o haomi ɔmɛ! I le kaa nɔ́ ko be o dɛ lɛɛ, se kɛ̃ ɔ, niatsɛ ji mo. Nihi nɛ deɔ ke Yuda bi ji mɛ, pohu e be mi ja a, ní yayahi nɛ a deɔ ngɛ o he ɔ, i le lɛ tsuo. Abosiami jali a kuu ji mɛ! 10Koo ye amanehlu nɛ ma o nɔ ɔ gbeye! Hyɛ! Abosiami miɔ nɛ e maa wo nyɛ ti ni komɛ tsu, konɛ a kɛ ka nyɛ; nɛ nyɛ maa na nɔ́ ligbi nyɔngma. Ye mi anɔkuale kɛ yaa si gbenɔ mi tete po, nɛ ma ha mo wami kaa kunimi nɛ o ye ɔ he jlasi.
11 “Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ nɛ ngɛ tue ɔ, e bu nɔ́ nɛ mumi ɔ ngɛ asafo ɔmɛ dee ɔ tue.
“Ni nɛmɛ nɛ maa ye kunimi ɔ, gbenɔ enyɔne ɔ be mɛ nae.
Womi nɛ a ngma ya ha asafo ɔ nɛ ngɛ Pergamo ɔ
12“Bɔfo ɔ nɛ ngɛ asafo ɔ nya ngɛ Pergamo ɔ, ngmaa womi nɛ ɔ ya ha lɛ ke,
“Sɛ gbi nɛ je nɔ nɛ ngɛ klaate nya enyɔtsɛ nɛ nya ba a ngɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. 13I le o hi he ɔ kaa Abosiami matsɛ sɛ ɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Se o pɛtɛ ye biɛ he. Nɛ benɛ a gbe Antipa tete po ɔ, hemi kɛ yemi nɛ o ngɛ ngɛ ye mi ɔ, o ngmɛɛ we he. Niinɛ, Antipa ye ye he odase nɛ e ye mi anɔkuale. Nɛ sane kpakpa a nɛ e ngɛ fiɛe ɔ he je ɔ, a gbe lɛ ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti ngɛ he nɛ Abosiami ngɛ ɔ. 14 Se kɛ̃ ɔ, i kɛ mo ngɛ sane bɔɔ ko. Ni komɛ ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti nɛ ya wo Balaam tsɔɔmi ɔ. Balam lɛ tsɔɔ Balak kaa e tsɔ Israel bi ɔmɛ klama nɛ a ye wɔ nya lo, nɛ a fiɛ yo kɛ nyumu yakayaka fiɛmi. 15Ja nɔuu ni komɛ hu ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti nɛ a hɛɛ Nikolai bi ɔmɛ a tsɔɔmi ɔ mi. 16Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, mo tsake o tsui! Ke pi ja a, ma ba o ngɔ be kpiti. Ma ngɔ klaate nɛ ngɛ ye nya mi ɔ, nɛ i kɛ jamɛ a ni ɔmɛ maa hwu ta.
17 “Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ nɛ ngɛ tue ɔ, e bu nɔ́ nɛ mumi ɔ ngɛ asafo ɔmɛ dee ɔ tue!
“Ni nɛmɛ nɛ maa ye kunimi ɔ, ma ha mɛ mana nɛ a kɛ laa a eko. Jehanɛ se hu, ma ha a ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ tɛ hiɔ nɛ a ngma biɛ he ngɛ nɔ. Biɛ nɛ ɔ, nɔ ko nɔ ko li, ja nɔ nɛ a ngɔ tɛ ɔ ngɔ ha lɛ ɔ pɛ.
Womi nɛ a ngma ya ha asafo ɔ nɛ ngɛ Tiatira a
18“Bɔfo ɔ nɛ ngɛ asafo ɔ nya ngɛ Tiatira a, ngmaa womi nɛ ɔ ya ha lɛ ke,
“Mawu Bi ɔ, nɔ nɛ e hɛngmɛ ngɛ kpɛe kaa la, nɛ e nane hu ngɛ kpɛe kaa ayawa nɛ a tsu he ɔ, sɛ gbi nɛ je e ngɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. 19I le ní nɛ o tsuɔ; i le o suɔmi, o hemi kɛ yemi, bɔ nɛ o sɔmɔɔ, kɛ bɔ nɛ o toɔ o tsui si ngɛ nɔ́ nami mi. I le kaa o ngɛ ní tsue amlɔ nɛ ɔ kulaa pe kekle ɔ po. 20 Se kɛ̃ ɔ, i kɛ mo ngɛ sane. O ngmɛ blɔ nɛ Yezebel, jamɛ a yo ɔ nɛ tsɛɔ e he gbalɔ ɔ ngɛ ye ma a ní tsɔɔe. E kɛ tsɔɔmi nɛ ɔ sisi mɛ, nɛ a ya ngɛ yo kɛ nyumu yakayaka fiɛmi fiɛe; nɛ a ngɛ wɔ nya ní hu yee. 21I ha lɛ be, konɛ e kɛ tsake e tsui, se e sume kaa e ma kpa e yakayaka nyɛɛmi ɔ. 22Hyɛ, ma ha nɛ e tlɔ sa mi kpotoo kɛ hiɔ, nɛ nihi tsuo nɛ e kɛ mɛ puɛ gba a, ma ha nɛ a maa na nɔ́ wawɛɛ. Ma pee enɛ ɔ, ja e kɛ mɛ tsuo tsake a tsui ngɛ yi wu tso níhi nɛ a kɛ lɛ pee ɔ a he. 23 Ma gbe e se nyɛɛli ɔmɛ hulɔ. Kɛkɛ ɔ, asafo ɔmɛ tsuo maa na kaa imi ji nɔ nɛ le adesahi tsuo a juɛmi, kɛ a tsui mi. Ma wo nyɛ ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ hiɔ ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ e tsu ɔ he.
24“Se nyɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ piɛ ngɛ Tiatira a, nyɛɛ lɛɛ nyɛ ya nyɛɛ we tsɔɔmi nɛ ɔ se; nɔ́ nɛ ni kpa amɛ tsɛɔ Abosiami laami sanehi nɛ a mi kuɔ ɔ hu, nyɛ kase we. Nyɛɛ lɛɛ i ngɛ nyɛ dee ke, i hla we nɔ́ kpa ko ngɛ nyɛ dɛ 25kaa nyɛɛ pɛtɛ nɔ́ nɛ nyɛ ngɛ ɔ he wawɛɛ kɛ yaa si ma ba. 26-28 Ni nɛmɛ nɛ maa ye kunimi, ni nɛmɛ nɛ maa ya nɔ maa pee ye suɔmi nya ní kɛ yaa si nyagbe ɔ, he blɔ nɛ Tsaatsɛ ngɔ ha mi ɔ, imi hu ma ha mɛ. Ma ha nɛ a maa ye je ma amɛ a nɔ kɛ kɔni si wami, nɛ a ma tsɔtslɔɔ a mi kaa buɛ nɛ ywia tsɔkɔtsɔkɔ. Nɛ ma ha mɛ dodoe nɛ a tsɛɛ nɔkɔ ɔ.
29“Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ nɛ ngɛ tue ɔ, e bu nɔ́ nɛ mumi ɔ ngɛ asafo ɔmɛ dee ɔ tue!

Title: KPOJEMI 3
Content:
Womi nɛ a ngma ya ha asafo ɔ nɛ ngɛ Sarde ɔ
1“Bɔfo ɔ nɛ ngɛ asafo ɔ nya ngɛ Sarde ɔ, ngmaa womi nɛ ɔ ya ha lɛ ke,
“Nɔ nɛ yeɔ Mawu mumi kpaago ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ e hɛɛ dodoe kpaago ɔmɛ ɔ, sɛ gbi nɛ je e ngɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. I le ní nɛ o ngɛ tsue ɔ. I le kaa o he biɛ kaa nɔ nɛ hɛ ngɛ, pohu o gbo. 2Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, tee si, nɛ nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ o dɛ kɛ mwɔɔ, nɛ miɔ nɛ e ma gbo ɔ, wo lɛ he wami. Ejakaa ní nɛ o tsu ɔ, i nɛ kaa e hi kɛ pi si lolo ngɛ ye Mawu ɔ hɛ mi. 3 Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, kaii nɔ́ nɛ a tsɔɔ mo, kɛ nɔ́ nɛ o nu ɔ. Bu tue, nɛ o tsake o tsui. Ke o pee we ja a, ma ba na mo tlukaa kaa julɔ be mi nɛ o hɛ be o he nɔ. 4Se kɛ̃ ɔ, o ngɛ nihi bɔɔ ko ngɛ Sarde, nihi nɛ wui a tade ɔmɛ mu. Mɛɛ a maa wo nɔ́ hiɔ, nɛ a kɛ mi maa nyɛɛ, ejakaa a sa ja. 5 Nihi nɛ maa ye kunimi ɔ, a maa wo ní hiɔ ha mɛ kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ, nɛ i be a biɛ gbee ngɛ hɛ kali a womi ɔ mi. Nɛ ma jaje ngɛ Tsaatsɛ kɛ e bɔfo ɔmɛ a hɛ mi paa kaa ye nihi ji mɛ.
6“Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ nɛ ngɛ tue ɔ, e bu nɔ́ nɛ mumi ɔ ngɛ asafo ɔmɛ dee ɔ tue!
Womi nɛ a ngma ya ha asafo ɔ nɛ ngɛ Filadelfia a
7 “Bɔfo ɔ nɛ ngɛ asafo ɔ nya ngɛ Filadelfia a, ngmaa womi nɛ ɔ ya ha lɛ ke,
“Sɛ gbi nɛ je nɔ klɔuklɔu nɛ yeɔ anɔkuale ɔ ngɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. Lɛ nɛ e hɛɛ David safe ɔ nɛ. Ke e bli sinya a, nɔ ko nɔ ko be nyɛe ma nga; nɛ ke e nga a, nɔ ko nɔ ko be nyɛe ma bli. 8I le ní nɛ o tsuɔ. I le kaa o he wɛ tsɔ; se o yeɔ ye mlaa amɛ a nɔ, nɛ o yeɔ mi anɔkuale. Hyɛ, i bli sinya ko ngɔ fɔ si ngɛ o hɛ mi, nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko be nyɛe ma nga. 9 Hyɛ! Ni ɔmɛ nɛ je Abosiami jali a kuu ɔ mi ɔ, lakpatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ nɛ deɔ ke Yuda bi ji mɛ, pohu e be mi ja a, nɔ́ nɛ ma pee mɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. Ma ha nɛ a maa ba nɛ a ma ba kpla si ngɛ o nane nya. Nɛ mɛ tsuo a ma na le kaa i suɔ mo. 10I wo mo mlaa ke o to o tsui si ngɛ nɔ́ nami mi; nɛ o ye nɔ. Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, amanehlu nguaa a nɛ ma je ɔ tsuo nɔ ɔ, ke be ɔ su ɔ, imi hu ma ha nɛ o maa ye o he. Ee, a kɛ amanehlu nɛ ɔ maa ka nihi tsuo ngɛ je ɔ mi. 11I ma nɔuu! Nɔ́ nɛ ngɛ o dɛ ɔ, pɛtɛ he wawɛɛ, konɛ jlasi nɛ o ma na, ke o ye kunimi ɔ, nɔ ko nɛ ko kpɔ ngɛ o dɛ. 12 Nɔ nɛ maa ye kunimi ɔ, ma ngɔ lɛ ngɔ pee titima ngɛ ye Mawu ɔ sɔlemi we ɔ, nɛ e be lejɛ ɔ jee gblegbleegble. Ma ngma ye Mawu ɔ biɛ, kɛ ye Mawu ɔ ma, Yerusalem he ɔ biɛ ngɛ e he. Ma he nɛ ɔ maa je ye Mawu ɔ ngɔ ngɛ hiɔwe kɛ ba. Jehanɛ, ma ngma ye biɛ he ɔ hu ngɛ e he.
13“Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ nɛ ngɛ tue ɔ, e bu nɔ́ nɛ mumi ɔ ngɛ asafo ɔmɛ dee ɔ tue!”
Womi nɛ a ngma ya ha asafo ɔ nɛ ngɛ Laodikea a
14 Bɔfo ɔ nɛ ngɛ asafo ɔ nya ngɛ Laodikea a, ngmaa womi nɛ ɔ ya ha lɛ ke,
“Sɛ gbi nɛ je Amen, odase ɔ nɛ yeɔ anɔkuale ɔ ngɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. Lɛ ji níhi tsuo nɛ Mawu bɔ ɔ sisije. 15I le ní nɛ o tsuɔ. I le kaa o be yluduu, nɛ o be kalakala hulɔ. I ná nɛ o ngɛ yluduu, loo kalakala! 16Se akɛnɛ o ngɛ kulɔkulɔ, akɛnɛ o be yluduu, nɛ o be kalakala hu he je ɔ, ma sú mo ngɔ pue he kaa a suɔ lada. 17O deɔ ke, ‘I na ní kpɔtɔɔ; i plɔke, nɛ nɔ́ ko nɔ́ ko hia we mi!’ Se o li tete kaa o ngɛ dengme mi, nɛ o ní ngɛ mɔbɔ! O li kaa ohiatsɛ ji mo! O li kaa o hɛɛ o he gu, nɛ o hɛngmɛ hu yu! 18Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i ngɛ mo ga woe nɛ o ba he sika tsu ngɛ ye dɛ; ee, ba he sika tsu ngmingmiingmi ngɛ ye dɛ, konɛ o na ní. He ní hiɔ hu nɛ o wo, nɛ a ko na kaa o hɛɛ o he gu, ejakaa e ngɛ zo. Jehanɛ, he tsopa nɛ o nga ngɔ pue o hɛngmɛ nɔ, konɛ o hyɛ nɔ́. 19 Nihi nɛ i suɔ mɛ ɔ, i kaa a hɛ mi, nɛ i gblaa a tue. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, o hɛ nɛ dɔ, nɛ o tsake o tsui. 20Hyɛ, i daa si ngɛ sinya a se, nɛ i ngɛ sie. Ke nɔ ko nu ye gbi nɛ e bli sinya a, ma sɛ mi, nɛ i kɛ lɛ maa ye ní, nɛ lɛ hu e kɛ mi maa ye ní. 21Ni nɛmɛ nɛ maa ye kunimi ɔ, ma ha mɛ blɔ nɛ a maa hi ye kasa nya ngɛ ye matsɛ sɛ ɔ nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ imi hu i ye kunimi, nɛ amlɔ nɛ ɔ, i hii si ngɛ Tsaatsɛ kasa nya ngɛ e matsɛ sɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ.
22“Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ nɛ ngɛ tue ɔ, e bu nɔ́ nɛ mumi ɔ ngɛ asafo ɔmɛ dee ɔ tue.”

Title: KPOJEMI 4
Content:
A ngɛ Mawu jae ngɛ hiɔwe
1Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, i na nina kpa. I na nɛ a bli sinya ko ngɔ fɔ si ngɛ hiɔwe. Nɛ gbi ɔ nɛ i nu nɛ pɛ kaa titimati, nɛ e kɛ mi ba tu munyu be ko ɔ de ke, “Ba hiɛ ɔ nɛ ma tsɔɔ mo níhi nɛ maa ba mi be kpiti mi.” 2 Amlɔ ɔ, mumi ɔ ba ye nɔ. Nɛ hyɛ, matsɛ sɛ ko ji nɛ ɔ ngɛ hiɔwe nɛ nɔ ko hii si ngɛ nɔ. 3Nɔ ɔ hɛ mi ngɛ kpɛe kaa yaspi kɛ sardi tɛhi nɛ a he jua wa. Alale nɛ e su ngɛ kaa emerald tɛ nɛ he jua wa po kɛ bɔle matsɛ sɛ ɔ. 4Matsɛ sɛ nyingmi enyɔ kɛ eywiɛ kpa komɛ bɔle matsɛ sɛ ɔ kɛ kpe, nɛ nikɔtɔmahi nyingmi enyɔ kɛ eywiɛ hii si ngɛ a nɔ. A wo ní hiɔ, nɛ sika tsu jlasi fi a yi. 5 I na nɛ oslabai gba, nɛ i nu gbihi, nɛ hiɔwe hu si kɛ je matsɛ sɛ ɔ mi. Jatɛ kpaago nɛ a su, ngɛ tsoe ngɛ matsɛ sɛ ɔ hɛ mi; lɔ ɔ ɔmɛ ji mumi slɔɔto kpaago ɔmɛ nɛ sɔmɔɔ Mawu ɔ nɛ. 6 Nɔ́ ko hu nɛ ngɛ kaa wo, nɛ ngɛ kpɛe kaa ahuhuɛ nɛ a tsɛɛ kristolo ɔ ngɛ matsɛ sɛ ɔ hɛ mi.
Hɛ kali eywiɛ daa si kɛ bɔle matsɛ sɛ ɔ kɔ nya amɛ tsuo a he kɛ kpe, nɛ a hɛ mi, kɛ a se tsuo hɛngmɛ sɔuu. 7Kekleekle nɔ́ ɔ ngɛ kaa jata, nɛ nɔ́ nɛ ji enyɔ ɔ ngɛ kaa na ku. Hɛ kalɔ nɛ ji etɛ ɔ hɛ mi ngɛ kaa adesa hɛ mi, nɛ nɔ nɛ ji eywiɛ ɔ lɛɛ e ngɛ kaa kɔle nɛ te kɛ bee. 8 Hɛ kali eywiɛ ɔmɛ a ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ ngɛ pɛli ekpa, nɛ a mi mi je kɛ kpo nɔ je tsuo hɛngmɛ sɔuu. Nɛ nyɔ kɛ pia tsuo ɔ, a hii lae nɛ a kpa we ke,
“Klɔuklɔu, klɔuklɔu, klɔuklɔu ji
Nyɔmtsɛ Mawu Ope,
nɔ nɛ ngɛ sa a, nɛ e ngɛ amlɔ nɛ ɔ,
nɛ́ e maa ba a.”
9Hɛ kali eywiɛ ɔmɛ laa yi jemi la, kɛ sina la, nɛ a kɛ woɔ nɔ nɛ hii si ngɛ matsɛ sɛ ɔ nɔ, nɛ ngɛ daa a hɛ mi nyami. Ke a wo la a nɔ kikɛ nɛ ɔ, 10nikɔtɔma nyingmi enyɔ kɛ eywiɛ ɔmɛ ngɔɔ a hɛ mi kɛ buɔ si ngɛ nɔ nɛ hii si ngɛ matsɛ sɛ ɔ nɔ, nɛ ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene ɔ hɛ mi, nɛ a jaa lɛ. A ngɔɔ a jlasi ɔmɛ kɛ pueɔ matsɛ sɛ ɔ hɛ mi, nɛ a deɔ ke,
11“Wa Nyɔmtsɛ, kɛ wa Mawu! Mo ji nɔ nɛ sa kaa
a ngɔ hɛ mi nyami, bu, kɛ he wami kɛ ha.
Mo lɛ o bɔ níhi tsuo;
o bɔ mɛ bɔ nɛ o suɔ kaa a hi.
Nɛ a ngɛ ja pɛ!”

Title: KPOJEMI 5
Content:
Womi kpo ɔ, kɛ To bi ɔ
1 I na womi kpo ko ngɛ nɔ nɛ hii si ngɛ matsɛ sɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ hiɔ nine mi. A ngma ní ngɛ womi ɔ hɛ mi kɛ se tsuo, nɛ a sɔu nya kɛ nya sɔumi nɔ́ kpaago. 2Nɛ i na bɔfo kpetekpleenyɛ ko nɛ ngɛ fiɛe kɛ ngmlaa ke, “Mɛnɔ lɛ sa kaa e tsɔ womi nya sɔumi ní ɔmɛ, nɛ e bli womi kpo ɔ nya?” 3Se nɔ ko nɔ ko be hiɔwe, loo zugba, loo zugba a sisi nɛ ma nyɛ ma bli womi ɔ nya, loo e ma nyɛ maa hyɛ mi. 4I wo ya wawɛɛ, ejakaa a nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko nɛ sa nɛ ma bli womi kpo ɔ nya, loo e maa kane. 5 Kɛkɛ nɛ nikɔtɔma amɛ a ti nɔ kake de mi ke, “Ko fo ya. Hyɛ! Jata a nɛ je Yuda wɛtso ɔ mi, nɛ ji David nina a ye kunimi. Nɛ lɛ nɛ e ma nyɛ tsɔ womi nya sɔumi nɔ́ kpaago ɔmɛ, nɛ e ma nyɛ bli womi kpo ɔ nya.”
6 Jehanɛ, i na To bi ko nɛ daa si ngɛ matsɛ sɛ ɔ kɛ hɛ kali eywiɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ nikɔtɔma amɛ a kpɛti. To bi ɔ ngɛ kaa nɔ́ nɛ a gbe. E ngɛ koli kpaago, kɛ hɛngmɛ kpaago. Hɛngmɛ nɛ ɔmɛ ji Mawu mumi slɔɔto kpaago nɛ e tsɔ kɛ ya je ɔ mi tsuo. 7To bi ɔ ya he womi kpo ɔ ngɛ nɔ nɛ hii si ngɛ matsɛ sɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ hiɔ nine mi. 8 Benɛ To bi ɔ sɔle womi kpo ɔ, hɛ kali eywiɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ nikɔtɔma nyingmi enyɔ kɛ eywiɛ ɔmɛ ngɔ a hɛ mi ngɔ bu si ngɛ To bi ɔ hɛ mi. A ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ hɛɛ kpa saku, kɛ sika tsu sowe nɛ tsopa kɛ e he via hyi lɛ tɔ. Enɛ ɔmɛ ji ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ a sɔlemi. 9 Hɛ kali ɔmɛ, kɛ ni kpa amɛ la la he kɛ ha To bi ɔ ke,
“Mo nɛ o sa kaa o heɔ womi kpo ɔ,
nɛ o tsɔɔ nya sɔumi ní ɔmɛ.
Ejakaa a gbe mo,
nɛ o kɛ o muɔ ɔ he adesahi tsuo,
wɛtsohi, gbihi, mahi, kɛ je mahi
kɛ ha Mawu.
10 O to matsɛ yemi sisi ha mɛ, nɛ o wo mɛ osɔfohi,
konɛ a sɔmɔ wa Mawu ɔ;
nɛ a maa ye matsɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ.”
11 Jehanɛ ɔ, ngɛ nina a mi ɔ, i nu bɔfohi babauu akpeakpe abɔ a gbi nɛ bɔle matsɛ sɛ ɔ, kɛ hɛ kali ɔmɛ, kɛ nikɔtɔma amɛ kɛ kpe. 12Nɛ a ngɛ lae kɛ ngmlaa boboobo ke,
“To bi nɛ a gbe ɔ,
e sa kaa a ngɔ
he wami, ní nami, nile, agboje,
bu, hɛ mi nyami, kɛ yi jemi kɛ ha lɛ.”
13Nɛ i nu nɛ nibɔ níhi tsuo ngɛ hiɔwe, zugba a, kɛ zugba a sisi, kɛ wo mi, kɛ níhi tsuo nɛ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ ngɛ dee ke,
“Nɔ nɛ hii si ngɛ matsɛ sɛ ɔ nɔ,
kɛ To bi ɔ nɛ wa maa ngɔ
yi jemi, agboje, kɛ hɛ mi nyami kɛ ha
kɛ je neneene kɛ ya neneene.”
14Kɛkɛ nɛ hɛ kali eywiɛ ɔmɛ de ke “Amen!” Nɛ nikɔtɔma amɛ ngɔ a hɛ mi ngɔ bu si, nɛ a ja Mawu kɛ To bi ɔ.

Title: KPOJEMI 6
Content:
To bi ɔ tsɔ nya sɔumi ní ɔmɛ
1Jehanɛ i na nɛ To bi ɔ tsɔ nya sɔumi nɔ́ kpaago ɔmɛ a kpɛti kekleekle nɔ́ ɔ. I nu nɛ hɛ kali eywiɛ ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake wo gbi kaa nɔ́ nɛ hiɔwe lɛ ngɛ sie, nɛ e de ke, “Ba!” 2 Benɛ i ke i hyɛɛ ɔ, nyumu ko ji nɛ ɔ nɛ hii si ngɛ okpɔngɔ hiɔ ko nɔ kɛ e dɛ mi kɛ̃ɛ̃. A ha lɛ jlasi, nɛ e je kpo kaa kunimi yelɔ nɛ yaa nɛ e ya ye kunimi.
3Benɛ To bi ɔ tsɔ nya sɔumi nɔ́ enyɔne ɔ, i nu nɛ hɛ kalɔ enyɔne ɔ de ke, “Ba.” 4 Kɛkɛ nɛ okpɔngɔ kpa ba, nɛ lɛɛ e tsuɔ. Mawu ha okpɔngɔ nɔ hilɔ ɔ he blɔ nɛ e kɛ ta nɛ ba je ɔ mi, konɛ nimli nɛ gbe a he. A ha lɛ klaate gagaa ko.
5 Jehanɛ ɔ, To bi ɔ tsɔ nya sɔumi nɔ́ etɛne ɔ, nɛ i nu nɛ hɛ kalɔ etɛne ɔ de ke, “Ba!” Nɛ́ i ke i hyɛɛ ɔ, okpɔngɔ yumu ko ji nɛ ɔ, nɛ nɔ nɛ hii si ngɛ nɔ ɔ hɛɛ sɛni ngɛ e dɛ mi. 6I nu nɛ nɔ́ ko pɛ kaa adesa gbi kɛ je hɛ kali eywiɛ ɔmɛ a kpɛti. Gbi ɔ de ke, “Ngma susumi nɔ́ kake ligbi kake hiɔwo, blɛfo susumi nɔ́ etɛ ligbi kake hiɔwo; se nu tso ɔmɛ, kɛ wai ngmɔ ɔmɛ lɛɛ ko kpata a hɛ mi.”
7-8 Benɛ To bi ɔ tsɔ nya sɔumi nɔ́ eywiɛne ɔ nya a, i nu nɛ hɛ kalɔ nɛ ji eywiɛ ɔ de ke, “Ba!” Nɛ benɛ i ke i hyɛɛ ɔ, okpɔngɔ lazulazu ko ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. Nɔ nɛ hii si ngɛ okpɔngɔ ɔ nɔ ɔ biɛ ji Gbenɔ, nɛ Gbeje nyɛɛ e se haa. Mawu ha mɛ he wami ngɛ je ɔ mi dlami eywiɛ mi kake nɔ, konɛ a ngɔ ta, hwɔ, gbenɔ hiɔ, kɛ lohwe awi yeli kɛ kpata je ɔ hɛ mi.
9Jehanɛ ɔ, To bi ɔ tsɔ nya sɔumi nɔ́ enuɔne ɔ. Nɛ i na nihi nɛ ye Mawu munyu ɔ he odase nɛ a gbe mɛ ngɛ he ɔ a klaahi ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ sisi. 10A kpa ngmlaa wawɛɛ ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ Ope, mo nɛ o ngɛ klɔuklɔu, nɛ o yeɔ anɔkuale! Mɛni be o maa mlɛ kɛ yaa si? Ni ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ je ɔ mi nɛ a gbe wɔ ɔ, kojo mɛ nɔuu nɛ o gbla a tue!” 11A ha a ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ tade hiɔ klɔii, nɛ a de mɛ ke a jɔɔ a he be bɔɔ ko lolo kɛ yaa si a maa gbe a nyɛmimɛ Kristo se nyɛɛli ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ piɛ ɔ kaa bɔ nɛ a gbe mɛ nitsɛmɛ ɔ. Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ hu sɔmɔɔ Mawu kaa mɛ kɛ̃.
12 Benɛ To bi ɔ tsɔ nya sɔumi nɔ́ ekpane ɔ, i nu nɛ zugba mimiɛ wawɛɛ. Pu kpa tsomi; diblii wo kpii, nɛ nyɔhiɔ pee tsutsuu kaa muɔ. 13 Dodoe ɔmɛ tsɔ fia si kaa bɔ nɛ ngmɔkɔ tso yiblii kplɔɔ pueɔ si ke kɔɔhiɔ nguaa fia a. 14 Hiɔwe hɛ lɛ kɛ ho kaa womi kpo nɛ a hluɛ̃, nɛ yohi, kɛ zugba kpɔhi nɛ wo bɔle mɛ kɛ kpe tsuo hia kɛ je a blɔ hehi. 15 Kɛkɛ nɛ je nɛ ɔ mi matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ, nɔ yeli ɔmɛ, asafoatsɛmɛ ɔmɛ, niatsɛmɛ, nihi nɛ hɛɛ biɛ, odehehi, nyɔguɛhi, kɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ ya laa a he ngɛ tɛ puɔhi a mi, kɛ tɛ sahi a sisi ngɛ yo ɔmɛ a nɔ. 16 A de yo ɔmɛ, kɛ tɛ sa amɛ ke, “Nyɛ ba ha wa nɔ, konɛ nɔ nɛ hii si ngɛ matsɛ sɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ ko na wɔ, nɛ́ To bi ɔ hu ko gbla wa tue! 17 Ejakaa ligbi nɛ ngɛ gbeyegbeye nɛ a maa gbla wa tue ɔ, ligbi ɔ su. Nɛ mɛnɔ ma nyɛ nya maa da?”

Title: KPOJEMI 7
Content:
Israel bi 144,000
1 Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, i na Mawu bɔfohi eywiɛ nɛ a daa si ngɛ je ɔ kɔ nya eywiɛ ɔmɛ. A tsi kɔɔhiɔ eywiɛ ɔmɛ a nya, konɛ kɔɔhiɔ ko fia ngɛ zugba a nɔ, loo wo nɔ, loo kɛ muɔ tso ko. 2I na bɔfo kpa ko hu nɛ ngɛ kuɔe kɛ je pu site he kɛ ma, nɛ e hɛɛ Mawu hɛ kalɔ ɔ nɔ́ nya sɔumi nɔ́. E kpa ngmlaa wawɛɛ, nɛ e de bɔfo eywiɛ ɔmɛ nɛ Mawu ha mɛ he wami ke a kpata zugba a, kɛ wo ɔ a hɛ mi ɔ ke, 3 “Nyɛ ko kpata zugba a, loo wo ɔ, loo tso ɔmɛ a hɛ mi. Nyɛɛ mlɛ kɛ yaa si wa maa ngɔ nɔ́ nya sɔumi nɔ́ kɛ kadi wa Mawu ɔ tsɔli ɔmɛ a hɛ nya lolo.” 4Nɛ a de mi ke nihi nɛ a ngɔ Mawu nɔ́ nya sɔumi nɔ́ ɔ kɛ kadi a hɛ nya a, a yibɔ ji 144,000. A je Israel wɛtso nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ a mi; 5-8nihi akpe nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ je wɛtso tsuaa wɛtso mi. Wɛtso ɔmɛ ji Yuda, Reuben, Gad, Asher, Naftali, Manase, Simeon, Levi, Isakar, Zebulun, Yosef, kɛ Benyamin.
Asafo kuu nguaa a
9Enɛ ɔ se nɛ ma hyɛ ɔ, nimli asafo nɛ nɔ ko be nyɛe maa kane ji nɛ. A je je ma amɛ tsuo a mi, wɛtso munomuno, nimli munomuno, kɛ gbi munomuno. A daa si ngɛ matsɛ sɛ ɔ, kɛ To bi ɔ hɛ mi kɛ a he tade hiɔ klɔiiklɔii; nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ hɛɛ tã kũɔmi ngɛ e dɛ. 10Nɛ mɛ tsuo a kpa ngmlaa wawɛɛ ke, “Wa Mawu ɔ nɛ hii si ngɛ matsɛ sɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ, kɛ To bi ɔ pɛ ji ni nɛmɛ nɛ heɔ nɔ yi wami.” 11Bɔfo ɔmɛ tsuo daa si kɛ bɔle matsɛ sɛ ɔ, kɛ nikɔtɔma amɛ, kɛ hɛ kali eywiɛ ɔmɛ. Kɛkɛ nɛ a ngɔ a hɛ mi ngɔ bu si ngɛ matsɛ sɛ ɔ hɛ mi, nɛ a ja Mawu, 12nɛ a de ke, “Amen! Wa Mawu! Wa ngɛ o yi jee; wa ngɛ o hɛ mi nyami woe, nɛ wa ngɛ mo si nae kɛ yaa neneene. Ejakaa o le ní; o kle, nɛ o je agbo! Amen!”
13Kɛkɛ nɛ nikɔtɔma amɛ a ti nɔ kake bi mi ke, “Nihi nɛ wo tade hiɔ klɔiiklɔii nɛ ɔ, mɛnɔmɛ ji mɛ, nɛ jije a je?”
14 I de lɛ ke, “Ye Nyɔmtsɛ, i li; mo lɛ o le!”
E de mi ke, “Haomi kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ, nimli nɛ ɔmɛ ji ni nɛmɛ nɛ gblee mi kɛ be slɔkee. A fɔ a tade ɔmɛ a he, nɛ a ha nɛ a hiɛ futaa ngɛ To bi ɔ muɔ ɔ mi. 15Enɛ ɔ he je nɛ a ngɛ Mawu matsɛ sɛ ɔ hɛ mi, nɛ a jaa lɛ nyɔ kɛ pia ngɛ e sɔlemi we ɔ nɛ. Nɔ nɛ hii si ngɛ matsɛ sɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ maa baa a yi. 16 Hwɔ be mɛ yee hu; kuma be mɛ yee hu. Pu, loo pu la nɛ nya wa hu be mɛ sããe, 17 ejakaa To bi ɔ nɛ ngɛ matsɛ sɛ ɔ kpɛti ɔ maa lɛ mɛ; nɛ e ma tsɔ̃ mɛ kɛ maa ya nyu vuhi nɛ haa nɔ wami a he. Nɛ Mawu ma tsu a hɛ mi vo nyu tsuo.”

Title: KPOJEMI 8
Content:
Nya sɔumi nɔ́ kpaagone ɔ
1Benɛ bɔfo ɔ tsɔ nɔ́ nya sɔumi nɔ́ kpaagone ɔ, hiɔwe jɔ dii maa pee ngmlɛfia fa. 2Kɛkɛ nɛ i na bɔfo kpaago ɔmɛ nɛ daa si ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi ɔ, nɛ a ha mɛ titimati kpaago.
3 Bɔfo kpa ba ba da si ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he, nɛ e hɛɛ tsopa kɛ e he via sami nɔ́ nɛ a kɛ sika tsu pee. A ha lɛ tsopa kɛ e he via fuu nɛ e kɛ piɛ Mawu we bi ɔmɛ tsuo a sɔlemi ɔ he, konɛ e kɛ sã bɔ ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ nɛ a kɛ sika tsu pee ɔ nɔ ngɛ matsɛ sɛ ɔ hɛ mi. 4Tsopa kɛ e he via la su ku ɔ, kɛ ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ a kue fami ɔ je bɔfo ɔ nɛ daa si ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi ɔ dɛ mi kɛ ho hiɔwe ya. 5 Kɛkɛ nɛ bɔfo ɔ ngɔ tsopa kɛ e he via sami nɔ́ ɔ; e je la ngɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ nɔ ngɔ wo mi tɔ, nɛ e hɛ ngɔ pue zugba a nɔ. Hiɔwe si, gbihi pɛ, oslabai gba, nɛ zugba mimiɛ.
Titimati kpaago ɔmɛ
6Jehanɛ ɔ, bɔfo kpaago ɔmɛ nɛ hɛɛ titimati kpaago ɔmɛ ɔ pee klaalo, konɛ a kpa titimati ɔmɛ.
7 Kekleekle bɔfo ɔ kpa e titimati ɔ, nɛ gbiɛ ngo ngu, kɛ la nɛ muɔ futu mi ba pue zugba a nɔ, nɛ zugba a mi dlami etɛ mi kake, tsohi a mi dlami etɛ mi kake, kɛ ba mumu tsuo pɛpɛɛpɛ sã. 8Kɛkɛ nɛ bɔfo enyɔne ɔ kpa e titimati ɔ, nɛ a sake nɔ́ ko nɛ ngɛ kaa yo nguaa ko nɛ ngɛ tsoe ngɔ fɔ wo ɔ mi. Wo ɔ mi dlami etɛ mi kake plɛ muɔ. 9Wo ɔ mi nibɔ ní hɛ ngmengmlehi a mi dlami etɛ mi kake gbo, nɛ lɛhi tsuo nɛ ngɛ wo ɔ nɔ ɔ a mi dlami etɛ mi kake hɛ mi kpata.
10 Bɔfo etɛne ɔ kpa e titimati ɔ, nɛ dodoe nguaa ko nɛ ngɛ kpɛe kaa jatɛ je hiɔwe ba nɔ pahi, kɛ nyu hɛngmɛhi a mi dlami etɛ mi kake a mi. 11 Dodoe ɔ biɛ ji Doomi. Nyu ɔ mi dlami etɛ mi kake plɛ pee nɔ́ nɛ dooɔ. Nɛ nihi babauu nɛ nu nyu ɔ gbo, ejakaa nyu ɔ dooɔ.
12 Jehanɛ ɔ, bɔfo eywiɛne ɔ kpa e titimati ɔ, nɛ nɔ́ ko sa pu, nyɔhiɔ, kɛ dodoe ɔmɛ tsuo a he, nɛ a nyɛ we nɛ a tsu ní bɔ nɛ sa. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, piani ɔ, pu nyɛ we nɛ e tso piani be ɔ mi dlami etɛ mi kake; nyɔ mi hu nyɔhiɔ, kɛ dodoe ɔmɛ nyɛ we nɛ a kpɛ nyɔ mi be ɔ mi dlami etɛ mi kake.
13Kɛkɛ nɛ i hyɛ, nɛ i nu kɔle ko he nɛ te kɛ bee ngɛ hiɔwe lokoo. Kɔle ɔ ngɛ munyu tue kɛ gbi wawɛɛ ke, “Musu oo musu! Musu oo musu! Nihi tsuo nɛ maa hi je ɔ mi be mi nɛ bɔfo etɛ ɔmɛ ma kpa titimati ɔmɛ nɛ piɛ ɔ, musu tloo mɛ!”

Title: KPOJEMI 9
Content:
1Jehanɛ ɔ, bɔfo enuɔne ɔ kpa e titimati ɔ, nɛ i na dodoe ko nɛ je hiɔwe ba nɔ zugba, nɛ a ha lɛ muɔ voo ɔ nya safe ɔ. 2 Dodoe ɔ bli muɔ voo ɔ nya, nɛ la su ku kpii je mi kaa flɔɔnɔɔ nguaa mi la su ku; la su ku nɛ je muɔ ɔ mi ɔ ha nɛ pu, kɛ kɔɔhiɔ pee yumuu. 3 Baalɛhi je la su ku ɔ mi pue zugba, nɛ Mawu ha mɛ he wami kaa nyingmogblakotohi pɛ. 4 A de mɛ ke a ko ta nga, loo ba mumu, loo tso ko tso ko he; nimli adesahi nɛ Mawu nɔ́ nya sɔumi nɔ́ ɔ he okadi be a hɛ nya a, á ye mɛ pɛ awi. 5A ngmɛ́ baalɛ ɔmɛ blɔ kaa a gbe nimli nɛ ɔmɛ, se mohu kaa a pii mɛ nyɔhiɔ enuɔ sɔuu. A maa nu piimi nɛ a pii mɛ ɔ he wawɛɛ kaa bɔ nɛ ke nyingmogblakoto tsɛ̃ nɔ nɛ e yee nɔ ɔ. 6 Jamɛ a nyɔhiɔ enuɔ ɔ mi ɔ, nimli ma hla gbenɔ se blɔ, se a be nae; a maa suɔ kaa a gbo, se gbenɔ maa tu a nya fo.
7 Baalɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ kaa okpɔngɔhi nɛ a mia mɛ kɛ ha ta; ní komɛ fi a yi kaa sika tsu jlasi, nɛ a hɛ mi ngɛ kaa nimli a hɛ mi. 8 A yi bwɔmi ngɛ kaa yihi a yi bwɔmi, nɛ a lunguhi ngɛ kaa jata nɔ́. 9 A wo ní komɛ ha mɛ ngɛ a gugue mi kaa dade damahi, nɛ ke a fia a pɛlihi a mi ɔ, e pɛɛ wawɛɛ kaa ta zugba lɛhi fuu nɛ okpɔngɔhi gbla kɛ yaa ta. 10A ngɛ hlemi kɛ e nya duɔ kaa nyingmogblakoto hlemi. Nɛ hlemi nɛ ɔmɛ a mi lɛ he wami nɛ a kɛ ma pii nimli nyɔhiɔ enuɔ ɔ ngɛ. 11Matsɛ nɛ yeɔ a nɔ ji bɔfo ɔ nɛ ngɛ muɔ voo ɔ nya a. Hebri gbi mi ɔ, e biɛ ji Abadon, se Hela gbi mi lɛɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Apolion.
12Kekleekle musu ɔ se po; se hyɛ, musu enyɔ pa ngɛ se kɛ ma!
13 Jehanɛ ɔ, bɔfo ekpane ɔ kpa e titimati ɔ, nɛ i nu gbi ko nɛ ngɛ pɛe kɛ je sika tsu bɔ sami la tɛ nɛ maa si ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi ɔ koli ɔmɛ a mi. 14Gbi ɔ de bɔfo ekpane ɔ nɛ hɛɛ titimati ɔ ke, “Bɔfo eywiɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a fi mɛ ngɛ Yufrate pa nguaa a nya a, yaa pɛne mɛ!” 15Bɔfo ekpane ɔ ya pɛne bɔfo eywiɛ ɔmɛ. Blɔɔ a ngɔ mɛ ngɔ to nɛ a pee mɛ klaalo, konɛ jeha nɛ ɔ tutuutu we nyɔhiɔ nɛ ɔ we ligbi nɛ ɔ tutuutu we ngmlɛfia nɛ ɔ mi ɔ a gbe adesahi tsuo a mi dlami etɛ mi kake. 16A tsɔɔ mi okpɔngɔ ta buli ɔmɛ a yibɔ; a hiɛmi ji ayɔ lafa enyɔ. 17Bɔ nɛ i na okpɔngɔ ɔmɛ ngɛ nina mi ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. Okpɔngɔ nɔ hili ɔmɛ wo dama; ekomɛ tsu tsutsuu kaa la; ekomɛ hɛɛ alamua tu su, nɛ ekomɛ hu ngɛ kaa kungwɔ zɔ. Okpɔngɔ ɔmɛ a yi ngɛ kaa jata yi, nɛ la, kɛ la su ku, kɛ la hɛuu ngɛ a nya mi jee. 18Nɔ́ etɛ nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ okpɔngɔ ɔmɛ a nya mi jee ɔ gbe adesahi tsuo a mi dlami etɛ mi kake. 19Ejakaa he wami nɛ okpɔngɔ ɔmɛ kɛ tsuɔ ní ɔ, a nya mi, kɛ a hlemi nya e ngɛ. Okpɔngɔ ɔmɛ a hlemi ngɛ kaa sinɔ nɛ yi ngɛ he, nɛ lɔ ɔ a kɛ yeɔ awi.
20 Nihi tsuo nɛ piɛ, nɛ mɛɛ haomi nɛ ɔmɛ gbi mɛ ɔ, a tsakee we a tsui, nɛ níhi nɛ a kɛ mɛ nitsɛmɛ a nine pee ɔ, a ngmɛɛ we he. A kpa we mumi yayamihi jami. Amagahi nɛ a kɛ sika tsu, loo sika hiɔ, loo ayawa, loo tɛ, loo tso pee ɔ, pi kaa a kpa mɛ jami; pohu amaga amɛ hyɛ we nɔ́, a nui nɔ́, nɛ a nyɛɛ we hulɔ. 21Jehanɛ hu, a tsakee we a tsui, konɛ a jɔɔ muɔ si puemi, loo nyuami, loo nyumu kɛ yo yakayaka fiɛmi, loo jumi.

Title: KPOJEMI 10
Content:
Mawu bɔfo ɔ kɛ womi kpo wayoo ɔ
1Jehanɛ ɔ, i na Mawu bɔfo kpetekpleenyɛ kpa nɛ je hiɔwe kɛ ma. Bɔku bɔle lɛ kɛ kpe, nɛ alale ngɛ e yi je; e hɛ mi ngɛ kaa pu, nɛ e nanehi ngɛ kaa la titimahi. 2E hɛɛ womi kpo wayoo ko nɛ a bli mi ngɛ e dɛ mi. E kɛ e hiɔ nane ma wo nɔ, nɛ e kɛ e muɔ nane ma zugba nɔ; 3nɛ e kpa ngmlaa wawɛɛ kaa jata nɛ ngɛ huãe. Benɛ e pee ja a, hiɔwe wo gbi, nɛ e si si kpaago. 4Benɛ hiɔwe si si kpaago ɔ, jinɛ i miɔ nɛ ma ngma nɔ́ nɛ a de ɔ. Se i nu nɛ gbi ko je hiɔwe de ke, “Nɔ́ nɛ hiɔwe simi kpaago ɔ de ɔ, kɛ to o yi mi; koo ngma!”
5 Jehanɛ ɔ, bɔfo ɔ nɛ i na nɛ daa si, nɛ e nane kake ngɛ wo nɔ, nɛ kake hu ngɛ zugba nɔ ɔ, wo e hiɔ nine nɔ kɛ ya hiɔwe, 6nɛ e ka kita ngɛ Mawu nɛ ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene ɔ biɛ mi. Lɛ nɛ e bɔ hiɔwe, kɛ zugba, kɛ wo, kɛ níhi tsuo nɛ ngɛ a mi. Bɔfo ɔ de ke, “Mawu be tsle toe hu! 7Se ke bɔfo kpaagone ɔ kpa e titimati ɔ, yi mi nɛ Mawu to ngɔ laa, nɛ e de e tsɔli nɛ ji gbali ɔmɛ ɔ, Mawu ma ha nɛ e ba mi.”
8 Kɛkɛ nɛ gbi nɛ i nu nɛ ngɛ munyu tue kɛ je hiɔwe ɔ kɛ mi tu munyu ekohu. E ke, “Bɔfo ɔ nɛ daa si, nɛ e nane kake ngɛ wo nɔ, nɛ kake hu ngɛ zugba nɔ ɔ, yaa nɛ o ya he womi kpo nɛ a bli mi ɔ ngɛ e dɛ.”
9I ya bɔfo ɔ ngɔ, nɛ i ya de lɛ ke e ha mi womi kpo wayoo ɔ. E de mi ke, “Ngɔɔ nɛ o ye; e maa ngɔɔ dɔkɔdɔkɔ kaa hwo ngɛ o nya mi, se e maa doo ngɛ o mi mi.”
10Kɛkɛ nɛ i sɔle womi kpo wayoo ɔ ngɛ bɔfo ɔ dɛ nɛ i ye. E ngɔ dɔkɔdɔkɔ kaa hwo ngɛ ye nya mi; se benɛ i mi ɔ, e doo ngɛ ye mi mi. 11Nɛ a de mi ke, “Mawu sɛ gbi ɔ nɛ kɔɔ mahi, je mahi, gbihi, kɛ matsɛmɛ babauu a he ɔ, e sa kaa o fiɛ ekohu.”

Title: KPOJEMI 11
Content:
Odase yeli enyɔ ɔmɛ
1 Jehanɛ ɔ, a ha mi tso ko nɛ maa hi kɛ nɔ́ susumi, nɛ a de mi ke, “Yaa nɛ o ya susu Mawu sɔlemi we ɔ, kɛ bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ, nɛ o kane nihi nɛ ngɛ Mawu jae ngɛ sɔlemi we ɔ mi. 2 Se kue ɔ nɛ ngɛ sɔlemi we ɔ we agbo ɔ nya a lɛɛ ko susu. Si lɔ ɔ, ejakaa a ngɔ kɛ ha je ma amɛ, nɛ a ma si ako ngɛ ma klɔuklɔu ɔ mi nyɔhiɔ nyingmi eywiɛ kɛ enyɔ. 3Ye we odase yeli enyɔ ɔmɛ ma bu kpekpe ya bo; nɛ ma ha a maa gba ligbi akpe kɛ e nya lafa enyɔ kɛ nyingmi ekpa.”
4 Odase yeli enyɔ ɔmɛ ji oliv tso enyɔ ɔmɛ, kɛ kane tso enyɔ ɔmɛ nɛ daa si ngɛ Mawu, je ɔ tsuo nyɔmtsɛ ɔ hɛ mi ɔ nɛ. 5Ke nɔ ko hla kaa e ye mɛ awi ɔ, la jeɔ a nya mi, nɛ e kpataa a he nyɛli ɔmɛ a hɛ mi; nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ ma hla kaa e ye mɛ awi ɔ, ja a gbe lɛ. 6 Mawu ha mɛ he wami nɛ a ma nyɛ nga hiɔwe nya nɛ hiɔmi be nɛe be mi nɛ a ngɛ gbae ɔ. A ngɛ he wami ngɛ nyu nɔ kaa a ma ha nɛ nyu nɛ plɛ pee muɔ; a ngɛ he wami hulɔ kaa a kɛ gbenɔ hiɔ slɔɔtohi baa zugba a nɔ si abɔ nɛ a suɔ.
7 Ke a gbe odase yemi ɔ nya a, lohwe awi yelɔ ɔ nɛ jeɔ muɔ voo ɔ mi ɔ kɛ mɛ ma ba hwu ta. E maa ye a nɔ, nɛ e maa gbe mɛ, 8 nɛ a gbogboe ɔmɛ ma pue si ngɛ magbɛ nɔ, ngɛ ma nguaa a nɛ a sɛu a Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ngɛ mi ɔ mi. A tsɛɛ jamɛ a ma a ngɛ abɛ gbi mi ke Sodom, loo Egipt. 9Nɛ ma amɛ, wɛtso ɔmɛ, gbi slɔɔto ɔmɛ, kɛ je ma amɛ tsuo maa hi a gbogboe ɔmɛ hyɛe gaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ ligbi etɛ kɛ fa nɛ a be kplɛɛe nɛ a pu mɛ. 10Nihi tsuo ngɛ je nɛ ɔ mi ɔ ma nya kaa nimli enyɔ nɛ ɔmɛ gbo. A tsui maa nɔ a mi, nɛ a maa ke a sibi ní, ejakaa jamɛ a gbali enyɔ ɔmɛ ngɔ haomi babauu kɛ ba je ɔ mi. 11 Ligbi etɛ kɛ fa a se ɔ, Mawu ha nɛ a kpale ba wami mi ekohu. A te si da a nane nɔ, nɛ nihi tsuo nɛ na mɛ ɔ ye gbeye wawɛɛ. 12 Jehanɛ ɔ, gbali enyɔ ɔmɛ nu gbi ko nɛ pɛ wawɛɛ kɛ je hiɔwe. Gbi ɔ de mɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ ba hiɛmɛ nɛ ɔ!” Nɛ benɛ a he nyɛli ɔmɛ ngɛ mɛ hyɛe ɔ, a ho hiɔwe ya ngɛ bɔku mi. 13 Jamɛ a be ɔ nɔuu ɔ, zugba mimiɛ wawɛɛ; ma a mi dlami nyɔngma mi kake hɛ mi kpata, nimli akpe kpaago gbo, nɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ piɛ ɔ ye gbeye, nɛ a wo Mawu nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ hɛ mi nyami.
14Musu enyɔne ɔ se po; se hyɛ, musu etɛne ɔ ngɛ se kɛ ma!
Titimati kpaagone ɔ
15 Jehanɛ ɔ, bɔfo kpaagone ɔ kpa e titimati ɔ, nɛ i nu gbihi nɛ ngɛ pɛe wawɛɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ke, “Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, wa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ kɛ e Kristo ɔ nɛ a ngɛ je ɔ nɔ yee. Nɛ a maa ye matsɛ kɛ maa ya neneene!” 16Kɛkɛ nɛ nikɔtɔma nyingmi enyɔ kɛ eywiɛ ɔmɛ nɛ hii si ngɛ a matsɛ sɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi ɔ ngɔ a hɛ mi ngɔ bu si; nɛ a ja Mawu, 17nɛ a de ke,
“Nyɔmtsɛ Mawu Ope,
Mo nɛ o ngɛ amlɔ nɛ ɔ,
nɛ o hi si hyɛ hulɔ ɔ,
Wa naa mo si kaa o tsu o
he wami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ he ní,
nɛ o bɔni matsɛ yemi!
18 Je ma amɛ a mi mi fu mo,
se jehanɛ ɔ, be su nɛ mo hu
o mi mi ma fu mɛ.
Be su nɛ o maa kojo nihi tsuo nɛ gbo ɔ,
nɛ o tsɔli nɛ ji gbali ɔmɛ,
ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ,
kɛ nimli wawihi kɛ nimli nguahi tsuo
nɛ yee mo gbeye ɔ,
be su nɛ o maa wo mɛ hiɔ.
Nihi nɛ kpataa zugba a hɛ mi ɔ,
be su nɛ o ma kpata mɛ hu a hɛ mi.”
19 Mawu sɔlemi we ɔ nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ nya bli, nɛ a na e somi daka a nɛ fɔɔ si ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. Kɛkɛ nɛ oslabai gba; hiɔwe si, zugba mimiɛ, nɛ gbiɛ ngo ngu agboagbo nɛ pue zugba a nɔ.

Title: KPOJEMI 12
Content:
Yo ɔ kɛ sinɔ nguaa a
1Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, nyakpɛ okadi nguaa ko je kpo ngɛ hiɔwe. I na yo ko; tade nɛ e wo ji pu. Nɛ nyɔhiɔ ngɛ e nane si, nɛ jlasi kɛ e mi dodoe nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ fi e yi. 2Yo ɔ fɔmi be su, nɛ e nu kɔɔmi nɛ nya wa. Enɛ ɔ ha nɛ e bɔni ngmlaa kpami.
3 Nyakpɛ okadi nguaa kpa ko hu je kpo ngɛ hiɔwe. I na wo mi sinɔ nguaa ko. E ngɛ yi kpaago, kɛ koli nyɔngma, nɛ jlasi fi yi tsuaa yi. 4 Sinɔ ɔ ngɔ e hlemi kɛ gbla dodoehi nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ a mi dlami etɛ mi kake, nɛ e hɛ mɛ ngɔ pue zugba. Kɛkɛ nɛ e ya da yo nɛ miɔ nɛ e ma fɔ ɔ hɛ mi, konɛ ke e fɔ pɛ nɛ lɛ sinɔ ɔ nɛ ye bi ɔ. 5 Yo ɔ ba fɔ binyumu, nɔ nɛ maa ye je ɔ tsuo nɔ kɛ he wami kpetekpleenyɛ. Se bɔfo ko ba ngɔ bi nɛ ɔ kɛ ho Mawu ngɔ ya ngɛ e matsɛ sɛ ɔ nɔ. 6Yo ɔ tu fo kɛ ho nga nɔ ya ngɛ he ko nɛ Mawu dla ngɔ to lɛ, nɛ a ya hyɛ e nɔ ligbi akpe kɛ e nya lafa enyɔ kɛ nyingmi ekpa.
7 Jehanɛ ɔ, ta ba te si ngɛ hiɔwe. Bɔfo nguaa a nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Mikael ɔ, kɛ e bɔfo ɔmɛ ya tua sinɔ nguaa a, nɛ sinɔ nguaa a, kɛ lɛ hu e bɔfo ɔmɛ kɛ mɛ hwu. 8Se a ye sinɔ nguaa a, kɛ e bɔfo ɔmɛ a nɔ, nɛ a ngmɛ́ mɛ blɔ nɛ a hi hiɔwe hu. 9 A sake sinɔ nguaa a ngɔ fɔ he. Ee, jamɛ a blema sinɔ nguaa a nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Abosiami, loo Satan nɛ sisi nihi tsuo ngɛ je ɔ mi ɔ, a sake lɛ kɛ e bɔfo ɔmɛ tsuo ngɔ fɔ je ɔ mi.
10 Kɛkɛ nɛ i nu gbi ko nɛ ngɛ pɛe kɛ ngmlaa ngɛ hiɔwe ke, “Jehanɛ ɔ lɛɛ yi wami hemi ba! Jehanɛ ɔ lɛɛ Mawu maa ngɔ e he wami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ kɛ ye matsɛ! Jehanɛ ɔ lɛɛ e Kristo he wami ɔ je kpo. Ejakaa Abosiami nɛ daa si ngɛ wa Mawu ɔ hɛ mi nyɔ kɛ pia, nɛ e poɔ wa nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ a nya haa lɛ ɔ be lejɛ ɔ hu. A sake Abosiami kɛ je hiɔwe ngɔ fɔ si. 11Wa nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ ye e nɔ kunimi kɛ gu To bi ɔ muɔ ɔ, kɛ odase ɔ nɛ a ye ɔ nɔ. A de we ke a maa baa mɛ nitsɛmɛ a wami yi, se mohu a suɔ kaa a maa ngɔ a wami tete ngɔ ha, nɛ a gbe mɛ. 12Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛ nihi tsuo nɛ nyɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ, nyɛ bua nɛ jɔ! Se je ɔ, kɛ wo, nyɛɛ lɛɛ musu tloo nyɛ! Abosiami kple si kɛ ba nyɛ ngɔ. E mi mi fu wawɛɛ, ejakaa e le kaa be bɔɔ kɛkɛ nɛ piɛ ha lɛ.”
13Benɛ sinɔ nguaa a na kaa a sake lɛ ba fɔ zugba a nɔ ɔ, e nyɛɛ yo ɔ nɛ fɔ binyumu ɔ se kɛ fo. 14 Se a ha yo ɔ kɔle nguaa a pɛli enyɔ ɔmɛ, konɛ e kɛ tu fo kɛ ya e hi he ɔ ngɛ nga a nɔ. A maa hyɛ e nɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ jeha etɛ kɛ fa, nɛ sinɔ nguaa a nine be e nɔ sue. 15Kɛkɛ nɛ sinɔ nguaa a sú nyu kaa pa kɛ je e nya mi kɛ pue yo ɔ se, konɛ nyu ɔ nɛ ngɔ lɛ kɛ ho. 16Se zugba a ye bua yo ɔ; zugba a bli e nya mi, nɛ e mii nyu nɛ sinɔ nguaa a sú kɛ je e nya mi pue si ɔ. 17Sinɔ nguaa a mi mi fu yo ɔ, nɛ e pue nɔ kɛ ho, konɛ e kɛ yo ɔ nina nɛ piɛ ɔ, nihi tsuo nɛ yeɔ Mawu mlaa amɛ a nɔ, kɛ ni nɛmɛ hu nɛ fiɛɔ sɛ gbi ɔ nɛ kɔɔ Yesu he ɔ ya hwu ta. 18Nɛ sinɔ nguaa a ya da si ngɛ wo ɔ nya.

Title: KPOJEMI 13
Content:
Lohwe awi yeli enyɔ ɔmɛ
1 Jehanɛ ɔ, i na lohwe awi yelɔ ko nɛ je wo ɔ mi kɛ ma. E ngɛ koli nyɔngma, kɛ yi kpaago. Jlasi ngɛ koli tsuaa koli he, nɛ a ngma biɛ nɛ ji musu bɔmi munyuhi kɛ si Mawu ngɛ yi tsuaa yi he. 2 Lohwe awi yelɔ ɔ nɛ i na a ngɛ kaa ogbetee; e nane ngɛ kaa osisiblisi nane, nɛ e nya ngɛ kaa jata nya. Sinɔ nguaa a ha lohwe awi yelɔ ɔ e he wami kpetekpleenyɛ, kɛ he blɔ nɛ e ngɛ kaa nɔ nɛ yeɔ matsɛ ɔ eko. 3Sinɔ nguaa a yi kake ngɛ kaa nɔ́ nɛ plaa wawɛɛ; se pa a gbo. Nihi tsuo nɛ ngɛ je ɔ mi ɔ a nya kpɛ a he, nɛ a nyɛɛ lohwe ɔ se. 4Ni ɔmɛ tsuo ja sinɔ nguaa a, ejakaa e ngɔ e blɔ nya a kɛ ha lohwe awi yelɔ ɔ. A ja lohwe awi yelɔ ɔ hulɔ, nɛ a de ke, “Mɛnɔ kɛ lohwe nɛ ɔ sɔ? Mɛnɔ ma nyɛ nɛ e kɛ lɛ maa hwu ta?”
5 A ngmɛ lohwe ɔ blɔ nɛ e tu munyu nguahi, kɛ musu bɔmi munyuhi putɛputɛɛ kɛ si Mawu, nɛ a ha lɛ blɔ hulɔ nɛ e kɛ je e he wami kpo nyɔhiɔ nyingmi eywiɛ kɛ enyɔ. 6E bɔni musu bɔmi munyuhi tumi kɛ si Mawu, Mawu biɛ ɔ, Mawu hi he ɔ, kɛ nihi tsuo nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ. 7 A ngmɛ lɛ blɔ nɛ e kɛ ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ hwu ta, nɛ e ye a nɔ. A ha lɛ he wami ngɛ wɛtso munomuno, nimli munomuno, kɛ gbi munomuno tsuo a nɔ. 8 Nihi tsuo nɛ ngɛ je ɔ mi ɔ ma ja lɛ. Ni nɛmɛ nɛ a ngma a biɛ kɛ wo hɛ kali a womi ɔ mi loko a bɔ je ɔ, mɛ pɛ lɛ a be lɛ jae. To bi ɔ nɛ a gbe ɔ nɔ́ ji jamɛ a womi ɔ.
9“Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nɔ nɛ ngɛ tue ɔ, e bu tue! 10 Ke a to ke a nu nɔ ko nyɔguɛ ɔ, ja a nu lɛ nyɔguɛ. Ke nɔ ko kɛ klaate gbe nɔ ɔ, ja a kɛ klaate gbe lɛ. Enɛ ɔ tsɔɔ kaa e hia kaa Mawu we bi nɛ to a tsui si, nɛ a pɛtɛ a hemi kɛ yemi ɔ he wawɛɛ.”
11Jehanɛ ɔ, i na lohwe awi yelɔ kpa ko nɛ je zugba a mi. E ngɛ koli enyɔ; koli ɔmɛ ngɛ kaa to bi kolihi, nɛ lohwe ɔ tu munyu kaa bɔ nɛ sinɔ nguaa a tuɔ munyu. 12E ngɔ jamɛ a he wami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ nɛ lohwe awi yelɔ kake ɔ ngɛ ɔ, nɛ e kɛ tsu ní ja nɔuu ngɛ kekleekle nɔ́ ɔ nane mi. E nyɛ nihi tsuo nɛ ngɛ je ɔ mi ɔ a nɔ nɛ a ja kekleekle lohwe awi yelɔ ɔ nɛ e pa a gbo ɔ. 13Lohwe awi yelɔ enyɔne ɔ peeɔ nyakpɛ ní nguahi; e haa nɛ la po jeɔ hiɔwe kɛ baa zugba nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ naa. 14Mawu ngmɛ lohwe awi yelɔ enyɔne ɔ blɔ nɛ e pee nyakpɛ níhi ngɛ kekleekle lohwe ɔ hɛ mi. Kɛ gu nyakpɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ ɔ, e sisiɔ nihi tsuo nɛ ngɛ je ɔ mi ɔ, nɛ e haa a peeɔ yayami. E nyɛ a nɔ nɛ a puɛ amaga nɛ ngɛ kaa lohwe awi yelɔ kake ɔ nɛ a kɛ klaate plaa lɛ wawɛɛ se e gbo we ɔ. 15Mawu ha lohwe awi yelɔ enyɔne ɔ blɔ kaa e mu mumi kɛ wo amaga a mi, konɛ amaga a nɛ na wami, nɛ e tu munyu. Kɛkɛ ɔ, e ma ha nɛ a gbe nihi tsuo nɛ ja we lɛ ɔ. 16Jehanɛ se hu, lohwe awi yelɔ enyɔne ɔ nyɛ ni ɔmɛ tsuo a nɔ, nimli wawihi kɛ nimli nguahi, niatsɛmɛ kɛ ohiatsɛmɛ, odehehi kɛ nyɔguɛhi tsuo; nɛ a kadi a hiɔ nine, loo a hɛ nya. 17Nɔ ko nɔ ko be nyɛe ma he ní, loo e maa jua ní, kaa ja a kadi lɛ kikɛ nɛ ɔ kɛ kekleekle lohwe awi yelɔ ɔ biɛ, loo yibɔ nɛ daa si ha biɛ ɔ.
18Ja ní lelɔ ji mo loko o maa nu nɔ́ nɛ ɔ sisi. Nɔ nɛ ngɛ juɛmi ɔ, e tsɔɔ yibɔ ɔ nɛ daa si ha lohwe awi yelɔ ɔ sisi, ejakaa yibɔ ɔ daa si ha nɔmlɔ biɛ. Yibɔ ɔ ji 666.

Title: KPOJEMI 14
Content:
To bi ɔ kɛ Mawu ni ɔmɛ
1 Jehanɛ ɔ, i hyɛ, nɛ i na To bi ɔ nɛ daa si ngɛ Zion yo ɔ nɔ, kɛ nimli 144,000. A ngma To bi ɔ, kɛ e Tsɛ ɔ tsuo a biɛ ngɛ nimli nɛ ɔmɛ a ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ hɛ nya. 2Kɛkɛ nɛ i nu gbi ko nɛ ngɛ pɛe ngɛ hiɔwe kaa pa nɛ hia kɛ bee, loo hiɔwe nɛ ngɛ sie wawɛɛ. Gbi nɛ i nu ɔ ngɛ kaa bɔ nɛ ke kpa saku fiali ngɛ saku fiae nɛ e pɛɛ ɔ. 3Nimli 144,000 ɔ daa si ngɛ matsɛ sɛ ɔ, kɛ hɛ kali eywiɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ nikɔtɔma amɛ a hɛ mi, nɛ a ngɛ la he ko lae. Nɔ ko nɔ ko nyɛ we nɛ e kase la nɛ ɔ ngɛ je ɔ mi tsuo, ja mɛ nimli 144,000 ɔ nɛ Mawu he a yi wami ɔ. 4Ni nɛ ɔmɛ ji nyumuhi nɛ a kɛ yihi fiɛ we yakayaka fiɛmi, nɛ a ble we a he; a he tsɔ. He tsuaa he nɛ To bi ɔ yaa a, a kɛ lɛ yaa. Mɛ pɛ ji nihi nɛ Mawu he a yi wami ngɛ je ɔ mi tsuo. Mawu kɛ To bi ɔ a nihi ji nimli nɛ ɔmɛ; a ngɛ kaa kekleekle tso yiblii nɛ a hla ngɔ to ha Mawu. 5 A yi lakpa hyɛ; sé ko be a he.
Mawu bɔfo etɛ ɔmɛ
6Jehanɛ ɔ, i na bɔfo kpa nɛ te ngɛ hiɔwe lokoo kɛ bee. E hɛɛ sɛ gbi ko nɛ ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene. Sɛ gbi ɔ kɔɔ sane kpakpa a he, nɛ e yaa nɛ e ya fiɛ sɛ gbi nɛ ɔ ha nihi tsuo nɛ ngɛ je ɔ mi, mahi kɛ wɛtsohi, kɛ gbihi kɛ nimli tsuo. 7Bɔfo ɔ de kɛ gbi nɛ wa ke, “Nyɛɛ ye Mawu gbeye, nɛ nyɛɛ wo e hɛ mi nyami! Ejakaa be ɔ su nɛ e maa kojo nihi tsuo nɛ ngɛ je ɔ mi. Nyɛ ja nɔ nɛ pee hiɔwe kɛ zugba, kɛ wo kɛ nyu hɛngmɛhi nɛ baa a!”
8 Bɔfo enyɔne ba ngɛ kekleekle nɔ́ ɔ se, nɛ e ngɛ dee ke, “Babilon hɛ mi kpata! Babilon ma kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ hɛ mi kpata! Babilon yakayaka ní peemi ɔmɛ ha nɛ je ɔ tsuo puɛ; e ngɛ kaa dã nɛ nya wa nɛ e ha mɛ nɛ a nu.”
9-10 Mawu bɔfo etɛne ba ngɛ Mawu bɔfo enyɔ ɔmɛ a se. Nɛ e de kɛ gbi wawɛɛ ke, “Nihi tsuo nɛ jaa lohwe awi yelɔ ɔ, kɛ e we amaga a, nɛ a kɛ amaga a kadi a hɛ nya, loo a nine he ɔ, ja a nu wai nɛ daa si ha Mawu mi mi fumi ɔ. Enɛ ɔ ji wai ngmingmiingmi nɛ Mawu nitsɛ plɛ kɛ wo kplu nɛ daa si ha e mi mi fumi ɔ mi. A ma pii nimli nɛ ɔmɛ hulɔ ngɛ la nɛ ngɛ tsoe gegeege ɔ mi ngɛ Mawu bɔfo klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ, kɛ To bi ɔ a hɛ mi. 11 La a nɛ a ma pii mɛ ngɛ mi ɔ maa tso gegeege kɛ maa ya neneene. He jɔmi ko be ha nihi nɛ jaa lohwe awi yelɔ ɔ kɛ e we amaga a, loo ni nɛmɛ nɛ a kɛ e biɛ kadi mɛ ɔ; a maa na nɔ́ nyɔ kɛ pia tsuo.”
12Enɛ ɔ tsɔɔ kaa e hia kaa ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ nɛ yeɔ Mawu mlaa amɛ a nɔ, nɛ a heɔ Yesu yeɔ anɔkuale mi ɔ nɛ a to a tsui si daa.
13Nɛ i nu gbi ko kɛ je hiɔwe nɛ ngɛ dee ke, “Ngmaa: A gbaa gbogboehi nɛ gboɔ ngɛ Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ mi kɛ je mwɔnɛ ɔ kɛ yaa nɛ ɔ.”
“Ee!” Mumi ɔ ngɛ dee ke, “A maa jɔɔ a he kɛ je a dengme gbomi ɔ mi; se a ní tsumi ɔmɛ nyɛɛɔ a se.”
Nyagbe kojomi ɔ he nina
14 Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, i hyɛ nɛ i na bɔku hiɔ, nɛ nɔ ko hii si ngɛ nɔ kaa Nɔmlɔ Bi ɔ. Sika tsu jlasi fi e yi, nɛ e hɛɛ ngma kpami ha nɛ nya ba ngɛ e dɛ mi. 15 Kɛkɛ nɛ bɔfo kpa je sɔlemi we ɔ kɛ ba, nɛ e kpa ngmlaa wawɛɛ nɛ e de nɔ nɛ hii si ngɛ bɔku ɔ nɔ ɔ ke, “Ngɔɔ o ngma kpami ha a nɛ o kɛ kpa ní! Jehanɛ lɛɛ ní ba saminya ngɛ zugba a nɔ, nɛ be su nɛ a ma kpa ní!” 16Kɛkɛ nɛ nɔ nɛ hii si ngɛ bɔku ɔ nɔ ɔ bɔni ní tsumi kɛ e ngma kpami ha a, nɛ e poo ngma a tsuo ngɛ je ɔ mi.
17Jehanɛ ɔ, i na bɔfo kpa nɛ je sɔlemi we ɔ ngɛ hiɔwe kɛ ma. Lɛ hu e hɛɛ ngma kpami ha nɛ nya ba.
18Bɔfo kpa hu nɛ ngɛ he wami ngɛ la nɔ je bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he kɛ ba. E kpa ngmlaa wawɛɛ nɛ e de bɔfo ɔ nɛ hɛɛ ngma kpami ha nɛ nya ba a ke, “Ngɔɔ o ha nɛ nya ba a kɛ poo wai yiblii ɔmɛ, nɛ o bua nya. Wai yiblii ɔmɛ fu ngɛ ngmɔ ɔ nɔ.” 19Kɛkɛ nɛ bɔfo ɔ bɔni ní tsumi ngɛ zugba a nɔ kɛ e ngma kpami ha a. E poo wai yiblii ɔ ngɛ ngmɔ ɔ nɔ, nɛ e sake ngɔ pue wai ngami nɔ́ kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ mi. Enɛ ɔ tsɔɔ bɔ nɛ Mawu maa gbla yayami peeli a tue. 20 A nga wai yiblii ɔ ngɛ wai ngami nɔ́ ɔ mi ngɛ ma a nya. Nɛ muɔ je wai ngami nɔ́ ɔ mi be kaa pa; e kami maa pee si tomi lafa enyɔ, nɛ e mi kuɔmi hu maa pee nane enuɔ.

Title: KPOJEMI 15
Content:
Mawu bɔfo ɔmɛ nɛ hɛɛ nyagbe haomi ɔmɛ ɔ
1Jehanɛ ɔ, i na okadi kpa ngɛ hiɔwe; okadi nɛ ɔ kle nɛ e ngɛ nyakpɛ. I na bɔfohi kpaago nɛ a ní tsumi ji kaa a ngɔ nyagbe haomi kpaago ɔmɛ kɛ ba je ɔ mi. Haomi kpaago nɛ ɔmɛ daa si ha nyagbe tue gblami nɛ Mawu maa ngɔ kɛ ba.
2Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, i na nɔ́ ko gbajaa ngɛ ye hɛ mi kaa wo; e hɛ mi tsɔ ngleinglei kaa ahuhuɛ, nɛ la ngɛ tsoe ngɛ mi. I na ni nɛmɛ nɛ ye kunimi ɔ hulɔ; a hɛɛ kpa sakuhi nɛ Mawu ha mɛ ɔ ngɛ a dɛ mi, nɛ a daa si ngɛ wo nɛ e hɛ mi tsɔ ngleinglei kaa ahuhuɛ ɔ kasa nya. Ee, a ye lohwe awi yelɔ ɔ, kɛ e we amaga a, kɛ nɔ nɛ yibɔ ko daa si ha e biɛ ɔ a nɔ kunimi. 3 Nɛ a ngɛ Mawu tsɔlɔ Mose la a, kɛ To bi ɔ la a lae ke,
“Nyɔmtsɛ Mawu Ope,
O ní tsumi ɔmɛ kle, nɛ a ngɛ nyakpɛ!
Je ma amɛ a matsɛ,
o ní peemi ní ɔmɛ tsuo da,
anɔkuale sɔuu!
4 Nyɔmtsɛ, nihi tsuo maa wo o hɛ mi nyami!
Nihi tsuo ma de ke o kle;
ejakaa mo pɛ ji nɔ klɔuklɔu.
Nihi tsuo nɛ ngɛ je ɔ mi ɔ maa ba
nɛ a ma ba ja mo;
ejakaa dami sane nɛ o ngɛ yee ɔ,
nɔ tsuaa nɔ na paa!”
5 Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, i na nɛ sɔlemi we ɔ nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ nya bli, nɛ bo tsu klɔuklɔu ɔ maa si ngɛ mi. 6Bɔfo kpaago ɔmɛ nɛ hɛɛ haomi kpaago ɔmɛ ɔ je kpo kɛ je sɔlemi we ɔ. A wo tade nɛ a kɛ kploba ngmingmiingmi nɛ ngɛ kpɛe klaiklai pee; nɛ a ngɔ kpa nɛ a kɛ sika tsu pee kɛ fi a gugue. 7Kɛkɛ nɛ hɛ kali eywiɛ ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake ha bɔfo kpaago ɔmɛ a ti nɔ tsuaa nɔ sika tsu kplu kake nɛ wai hyi lɛ tɔ. Wai kɛ kplu nɛ ɔ daa si ha Mawu nɛ ngɛ kɛ yaa neneene ɔ mi mi fumi ɔ. 8 Mawu hɛ mi nyami, kɛ e he wami kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ ha nɛ la su ku hyi sɔlemi we ɔ tɔ. Nɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko nyɛ we nɛ e je sɔlemi we ɔ kɛ ya si haomi kpaago ɔmɛ nɛ bɔfo kpaago ɔmɛ kɛ ba a a se po.

Title: KPOJEMI 16
Content:
Mawu mi mi fumi kplu ɔ
1Jehanɛ ɔ, i nu gbi ko nɛ ngɛ pɛe gegeege kɛ je sɔlemi we ɔ. Gbi ɔ ngɛ bɔfo kpaago ɔmɛ dee ke, “Wai ɔ nɛ daa si ha Mawu mi mi fumi ɔ nɛ ngɛ kplu kpaago ɔmɛ a mi ɔ, nyɛɛ ya nɛ nyɛ ya plɛ ngɔ pue zugba.”
2 Kekleekle bɔfo ɔ ho nɛ e ya plɛ e kplu ɔ mi nɔ́ ɔ ngɔ pue zugba. Kɛkɛ nɛ nihi nɛ lohwe awi yelɔ ɔ we okadi ɔ ngɛ a he, kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ jaa amaga a tsuo hia pa yaya nɛ yee nɔ.
3Bɔfo enyɔne ɔ plɛ e kplu ɔ mi nɔ́ ɔ ngɔ pue wo mi. Nyu ɔ pee kaa nɔ gbogboe muɔ, nɛ nɔ́ tsuaa nɔ́ nɛ hɛ ngɛ nɛ ngɛ wo ɔ mi ɔ gbo.
4 Bɔfo etɛne ɔ plɛ e kplu ɔ mi nɔ́ ɔ ngɔ wo pahi, kɛ nyu hɛngmɛhi a mi, nɛ a pee kaa muɔ. 5Nɛ i nu nɛ bɔfo ɔ nɛ ngɛ he wami ngɛ nyu nɔ ɔ ngɛ Mawu dee ke, “Mo ji Mawu Klɔuklɔu ɔ nɛ. Mo ji Mawu nɛ ngɛ amlɔ nɛ ɔ, kɛ nɔ nɛ hi si sa a. O ye dami sane ngɛ o kojomi nɛ ɔmɛ a mi! 6Ejakaa adesa pue o ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ, kɛ gbali ɔmɛ a muɔ si. Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, o ha mɛ muɔ ke a nu. Ee, nɔ́ pɛ nɛ sa mɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ!” 7Kɛkɛ nɛ i nu nɛ gbi ko pɛ kɛ je bɔ sami la tɛ ɔ he de ke, “Nyɔmtsɛ Mawu Ope! O yeɔ dami sane, nɛ o gblaa nɔ tue bɔ nɛ sa!”
8Jehanɛ ɔ, bɔfo eywiɛne ɔ plɛ e kplu ɔ mi nɔ́ ɔ ngɔ pue pu nɔ. Enɛ ɔ ha nɛ pu ɔ dɔ la wawɛɛ, nɛ e sãã nimli adesahi. 9Pu la nɛ nya wa a sãã mɛ saminya, nɛ a tu musu bɔmi munyuhi kɛ si Mawu, nɔ nɛ ngɛ he wami ngɛ kikɛmɛ a haomi nɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ ɔ. Se a tsakee we a tsui, konɛ a wo Mawu hɛ mi nyami.
10 Bɔfo enuɔne ɔ plɛ e kplu ɔ mi nɔ́ ɔ ngɔ pue lohwe awi yelɔ ɔ matsɛ sɛ ɔ nɔ. Diblii wo ngɛ lohwe ɔ matsɛ yemi ɔ mi, nɛ nihi a he hia mɛ, nɛ a ta a lilɛ. 11A tu musu bɔmi munyuhi kɛ si Mawu nɛ ngɛ hiɔwe ɔ ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ a ngɛ nae, kɛ pa nɛ a hia a he. Se ní yayahi nɛ a pee ɔ, lɔ ɔmɛ lɛɛ a tsakee we a tsui ngɛ he.
12 Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, bɔfo ekpane ɔ plɛ e kplu ɔ mi nɔ́ ɔ ngɔ pue Yufrate pa nguaa a mi. Nyu ɔ mii ngɛ pa a mi, nɛ e kɛ je blɔ ha matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ nɛ maa je beleku je kɛ ba a. 13Kɛkɛ nɛ i na mumi yayami etɛ nɛ a ngɛ kaa ovɔnɔhi. A je sinɔ nguaa a, kɛ lohwe awi yelɔ ɔ, kɛ lakpa gbalɔ ɔ a nya mi kɛ ma. 14Abosiami mumi nɛ tsuɔ nyakpɛ ní ji mɛ. Mumi yayami etɛ nɛ ɔmɛ yaa je nɛ ɔ mi matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a ngɔ, konɛ a ya bua a nya kɛ ha ta nɛ maa ba ligbi nguaa a nɛ Mawu Ope ɔ maa kojo je ɔ.
15 Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ke, “Hyɛ! I ma kaa julɔ! Nɔ nɛ huɔɔ, nɛ e peeɔ e tade klaalo ɔ, a gbaa lɛ! E be e he gu hɛɛe nɛ e zo ba je kpo!”
16 Jehanɛ ɔ, mumi yayami ɔmɛ ngɔ matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ kɛ ba he ko nɛ a tsɛɛ ngɛ Hebri gbi mi ke Harmagedon ɔ.
17Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, bɔfo kpaagone ɔ plɛ e kplu ɔ mi nɔ́ ɔ ngɔ pue kɔɔhiɔ mi. Nɛ gbi ko pɛ wawɛɛ kɛ je matsɛ sɛ ɔ he ngɛ sɔlemi we ɔ de ke, “A gbe nya!” 18 Kɛkɛ nɛ oslabai gba, nɛ hiɔmi si, nɛ zugba mimiɛ wawɛɛ. Kɛ je be nɛ a bɔ adesa a, zugba mimiɛ we kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ hyɛ. Zugba nɛ mimiɛ jamɛ a ligbi ɔ, a nɛ eko hyɛ. 19 Ma nguaa a mi gba etɛ, nɛ je ma amɛ a hɛ mi kpata. Mawu kai Babilon ma kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ, nɛ e ha nɛ e nu wai kɛ je e kplu ɔ mi. Wai nɛ ɔ daa si ha Mawu mi mi fumi nɛ nya wa a. 20 Zugba kpɔhi tsuo nɛ wo bɔle mɛ ɔ laa, nɛ a nɛ yokuhi hu. 21 Gbiɛ ngo ngu lokpolokpohi nɛ eko tsuaa eko jiimi ji kilo nyingmi enuɔ je hiɔwe ba nɔɔ nimlihi a nɔ. Nimli adesahi tu musu bɔmi munyu kɛ si Mawu ngɛ gbiɛ ngo ngu nɛ e kɛ hao mɛ ɔ he, ejakaa nɔ́ ɔ nya wa tsɔ.

Title: KPOJEMI 17
Content:
Ajuama kpanaku ɔ
1 Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, bɔfo kpaago ɔmɛ nɛ hɛɛ kplu kpaago ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake ba de mi ke, “Ba nɛ ma tsɔɔ mo bɔ nɛ Mawu maa gbla ajuama kpanaku ɔ tue ha. Jamɛ a ma kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ nɛ a ma ngɔ fɔ pahi babauu a tue ɔ i ngɛ tsɔɔe ɔ nɛ. 2 Matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ nɛ ngɛ je ɔ mi ɔ kɛ lɛ bɔ ajuama; nɛ nimli nɛ ngɛ zugba a nɔ ɔ pee kaa nihi nɛ tɔ dã, benɛ e kɛ mɛ fiɛ yakayaka fiɛmi ɔ.”
3 Mumi ɔ ba ye nɔ, nɛ bɔfo ɔ ngɔ mi kɛ ho nga nɔ ya. Kɛkɛ nɛ i na yo ko nɛ hii si ngɛ lohwe awi yelɔ tsutsuu ko nɔ. A ngma biɛhi fuu kɛ tu musu bɔmi munyuhi kɛ si Mawu ngɛ lohwe ɔ he tsuo. Lohwe ɔ ngɛ yi kpaago, kɛ koli nyɔngma. 4 Yo ɔ wo tade he jua wawɛ nɛ hɛɛ alamua tu su, nɛ tsuɔ hulɔ; nɛ a kɛ sika tsu june, kɛ tɛ nɛ he jua wa, kɛ adiagba dla e he ha lɛ. E hɛɛ sika tsu kplu nɛ hyi tɔ kɛ zo ní ɔmɛ, kɛ e we ajuama bɔmi níhi nɛ a hiee ɔ. 5A ngma biɛ ko nɛ ji laami sane ngɛ e hɛ nya ke, “Babilon kpetekpleenyɛ, ajuamahi a nyɛ, kɛ níhi nɛ a hiee tsuo a je he.” 6I na kaa yo ɔ tɔ dã; ee, e nu ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ, kɛ nihi nɛ a gbe mɛ ngɛ Yesu he ɔ a muɔ, nɛ e pee kaa nɔ nɛ tɔ dã.
Benɛ i na lɛ ɔ, ye nya kpɛ ye he wawɛɛ. 7Bɔfo ɔ bi mi ke “Mɛni he je nɛ o nya kpɛ o he ɔ?” E ya nɔ nɛ e de mi ke, “Yo ɔ nɛ hii si ngɛ lohwe awi yelɔ ɔ nɛ ngɛ yi kpaago kɛ koli nyɔngma a nɔ ɔ, laami sane ɔ nɛ kɔɔ e he ɔ, ma je tsɔɔ mo. 8 Lohwe ɔ nɛ o na a, be ko ɔ, e hɛ ngɛ, se piɔ lɛɛ e be je mi hu. E be kɛe nɛ e maa je muɔ voo ɔ mi kɛ ba, nɛ a ma kpata e hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ. Nɛ nihi tsuo nɛ ngɛ je ɔ mi nɛ a ngmɛ a biɛ ngɛ wami womi ɔ mi loko a bɔ je ɔ, ke a na lohwe ɔ, a nya maa kpɛ a he saminya. E hi si be ko; amlɔ nɛ ɔ lɛɛ e be je mi, se e maa kpale ba ekohu.
9“Nɔ́ nɛ ɔ hia juɛmi, kɛ nɔ́ sisi numi. Yi kpaago ɔmɛ daa si ha yoku kpaago ɔmɛ nɛ yo ɔ hii si ngɛ nɔ ɔ. A daa si ha matsɛmɛ kpaago hulɔ. 10Ni enuɔ gbo momo; nɔ kake ngɛ tsɛ yee kɛ mwɔɔ, nɛ nɔ kake na we nɛ e ba lolo. Ke e ba a, e maa ye tsɛ be bɔɔ kɛkɛ. 11Lohwe awi yelɔ ɔ nɛ ngɛ sa a, nɛ piɔ lɛɛ e be je mi hu ɔ, e maa pee matsɛ kpaanyɔne; e ye tsɛ momo kaa matsɛmɛ kpaago ɔmɛ a ti nɔ kake, nɛ a ma kpata e hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ.
12 “Koli nyɔngma amɛ nɛ o na a daa si ha matsɛmɛ nyɔngma nɛ mɛɛ lɛɛ a yi tsɛ lolo. Se kɛ̃ ɔ, a ma ha mɛ blɔ nya nɛ a kɛ lohwe awi yelɔ ɔ maa ye tsɛ ngmlɛfia kake. 13Mɛ tsuo a maa hɛɛ juɛmi kake, nɛ a maa ngɔ a he wami, kɛ a blɔ nya a kɛ ha lohwe ɔ. 14Lohwe ɔ, kɛ matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ ma ya tua To bi ɔ. Se To bi ɔ, kɛ e se nyɛɛli ɔmɛ maa ye a nɔ kunimi. Lɛ ji nyɔmtsɛmɛ a nyɔmtsɛ, kɛ matsɛmɛ a matsɛ, nɛ e se nyɛɛli ɔmɛ ji nihi nɛ Mawu tsɛ, nɛ e hla mɛ ngɔ to, nɛ a yeɔ lɛ anɔkuale.”
15Bɔfo ɔ ya nɔ nɛ e de mi ke, “Nyu kpekpemi ɔ nɛ o na nɛ yo ajuama a hii si ngɛ nɔ ɔ daa si ha mahi, je mahi, nimli slɔɔtoslɔɔtohi, kɛ gbi munomunohi. 16Koli nyɔngma amɛ nɛ o na a, kɛ lohwe awi yelɔ ɔ maa te si ngɔ wo yo ajuama a; a maa ngɔ e níhi tsuo nɛ e ngɛ ɔ, nɛ e maa hɛɛ e he gu. A maa ye e he lo ɔ, nɛ a kɛ la ma kpata e hɛ mi pɛsɛpɛsɛ. 17Matsɛmɛ nyɔngma amɛ nɛ a maa pee enɛ ɔ, ejakaa Mawu ha nɛ a to a yi mi kaa a pee nɔ́ nɛ e to kaa a pee ɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, mɛ tsuo a maa kplɛɛ kaa a maa ngɔ a tsɛ yemi blɔ nya a kɛ ha lohwe awi yelɔ ɔ kɛ yaa si yi mi nɛ Mawu to ɔ maa ba mi.
18“Yo ɔ nɛ o na a daa si ha ma kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ nɛ e matsɛ ɔ yeɔ ma amɛ tsuo a nɔ ngɛ je ɔ mi ɔ.”

Title: KPOJEMI 18
Content:
A kpata Babilon hɛ mi
1Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, i na bɔfo kpa nɛ je hiɔwe kɛ ma. E hɛɛ blɔ nya nguaa, nɛ la nɛ bɔle lɛ ɔ ha nɛ je ɔ mi tsuo tsɔ heii. 2 E kpa ngmlaa wawɛɛ ke, “Babilon hɛ mi kpata! Babilon ma kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ hɛ mi kpata! Piɔ lɛɛ e plɛ mumi yayamihi tsuo a si himi he; e plɛ lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ, kɛ lohwe awi yeli nɛ a hiee tsuo a si himi he. 3 Ejakaa Babilon yakayaka ní peemi ɔmɛ ha nɛ je ɔ tsuo puɛ; ee, e ngɛ kaa nɔ́ nɛ wai nɛ nya wa nɛ e ha mɛ nɛ a nu. Je nɛ ɔ mi matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsuo kɛ lɛ bɔ ajuama, nɛ jua yeli tsuo gu e ní babauu ɔ nɔ nɛ a pee niatsɛmɛ.”
4 Kɛkɛ nɛ i nu gbi kpa nɛ tu munyu kɛ je hiɔwe ke,
“Ye ma! Nyɛɛ je kpo ngɛ e mi oo,
nyɛɛ je ma a mi!
Nyɛ ko ya piɛ ma mi bi ɔmɛ a he
kɛ pee yayami,
konɛ haomi nɛ ba a nɔ ɔ,
ko ba nyɛ hu nyɛ nɔ!
5 Ejakaa a to e yayami ɔmɛ
kɛ ya si hiɔwe tɔɔ.
Nɛ Mawu miɔ nɛ e maa gbla ma a tue
ngɛ e yayami ɔmɛ a he.
6 Bɔ nɛ e pee mo ɔ,
pee lɛ ja nɔuu ngɔ to nane mi.
Níhi nɛ e pee ɔ,
pee lɛ ja totoe enyɔ ngɔ to nane mi.
Dã nɛ e futu ha mo ɔ,
mo futu dã nɛ nya wa kaa ja
totoe enyɔ ngɔ wo e kplu ɔ mi ha lɛ.
7 Bɔ nɛ e pee ní nguahi,
nɛ e fiɛ e yi nɔ ɔ,
pii lɛ, nɛ e ye aywilɛho
ja nɔuu.
Ejakaa e pɔɔ e he demi ke,
‘Manyɛ ji mi, nɛ i hii si ngɛ ye sɛ ɔ nɔ!
Pi yalɔyo ji mi;
i be aywilɛho yee gblegbleegble!’
8Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, haomi nɛ ɔmɛ
maa ba e nɔ ligbi kake too:
gbenɔ hiɔ, aywilɛho, kɛ hwɔ.
Nɛ a kɛ la maa sã lɛ,
ejakaa Nyɔmtsɛ Mawu ɔ nɛ maa kojo lɛ ɔ,
e kle.”
9 Je nɛ ɔ mi matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a kɛ Babilon bɔ ajuama, nɛ a fiɛ a yi nɔ ɔ, ke be nɛ a sã ma a, nɛ a na la su ku nɛ ngɛ jee ɔ, a maa wo yana, nɛ a ma nya awe ha ma a. 10A maa da si ngɛ se lokoo, ejakaa a maa ye gbeye kaa a maa gbla a kɛ Babilon tsuo a tue. A ma de ke, “Tsaoo! Akuanyɛ! Babilon, ma nguaa! Ma kpetekpleenyɛ! Ngmlɛfia kake too mi ɔ, hyɛ bɔ nɛ gbla o tue ha!”
11 Jua yeli nɛ ngɛ je ɔ mi tsuo hu maa wo yana, nɛ a ma nya awe ha lɛ, ejakaa nɔ ko nɔ ko be a guɛ ní ɔmɛ hee hu. 12 Nɔ ko nɔ ko be ní nɛ ɔmɛ hee hu: sika tsu, sika hiɔ, tɛhi nɛ a he jua wa, adiagba, kploba nɛ ngɛ fɛu, bo he jua wawɛ nɛ hɛɛ alamua tu su, seda, bo tsu, tso slɔɔtohi nɛ a he wa, suɔ wu níhi tsuo, tso slɔɔtohi nɛ a he jua wa saminya, akɔblee, dade, marble, 13sinamon, tsopa kɛ e he via, mire, mimɛ, dã, nu, mamu, ngma, na, to, okpɔngɔ, zugba lɛ, nyɔguɛ, kɛ nimli nɛ a hɛ ngɛ tete. 14Jua yeli ɔmɛ ma de ke, “Ní kpakpahi nɛ e jlo mo kaa o ná a, lɛ tsuo se po; ní babauu nɛ o ná, kɛ o yi nɔ nɛ o fiɛ saminya a, lɛ tsuo bɔ mo, nɛ o be nae hu gblegbleegble.” 15 Jua yeli nɛ ye jua ngɛ jamɛ a ma a mi, nɛ ba pee niatsɛmɛ ɔ, a maa da se lokoo, ejakaa a maa ye gbeye kaa a maa gbla a kɛ Babilon tsuo a tue. A maa wo yana, nɛ a ma nya awe boboobo; 16nɛ a ma de ke, “Tsaoo! Akuanyɛ! Babilon, ma nguaa! Ma kpetekpleenyɛ! Sa a, kploba nɛ ngɛ fɛu, bo he jua wawɛ nɛ hɛɛ alamua tu su, kɛ bo tsu lɛ e buɔ, nɛ sika tsu, june, kɛ adiagba e kɛ dlaa e he! 17 Nɛ ngmlɛfia kake too mi ɔ, ní babauu nɛ e na a tsuo bɔ lɛ!”
Lɛ kudɔɔtsɛmɛ ɔmɛ, nihi nɛ sɛ lɛ kɛ yaa he, lɛ mi bi, kɛ nihi nɛ yeɔ jua ngɛ wo nɔ tsuo ya da se lokoo. 18 Nɛ benɛ a sã ma a, nɛ a na la su ku nɛ je ɔ, a kpa ngmlaa, nɛ a de ke, “Ma ko ma ko be nɛ kle kaa ma kpetekpleenyɛ nɛ ɔ!” 19 A kɛ zu wo a yi mi, nɛ a wo yana, nɛ a nya awe. A kpa ngmlaa, nɛ a de ke, “Tsaoo! Akuanyɛ ha ma kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ! Lɛtsɛmɛ tsuo nɛ yeɔ jua ngɛ wo hɛ mi ɔ gu ní babauu nɛ e na a nɔ ba plɛ niatsɛmɛ. Nɛ ngmlɛfia kake too mi ɔ, ní babauu nɛ e na a tsuo bɔ lɛ!”
20 Hiɔwe! Mo nya kaa a kpata Babilon hɛ mi! Nyɛ ni klɔuklɔuhi, bɔfohi, kɛ gbali, nyɛ nya! Ejakaa Mawu bu lɛ fɔ ha nyɛ ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ e pee nyɛ ɔ he!
21 Jehanɛ ɔ, bɔfo kpetekpleenyɛ ko wo tɛ nɛ ngɛ kaa wɛ nguaa ko, nɛ e hɛ ngɔ fɔ wo mi, nɛ e de ke, “Kikɛ nɛ ɔ a maa hɛ Babilon ma kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ ngɔ fɔ he, nɛ a be lɛ nae hu gblegbleegble. 22 Babilon, la be pɛe gblegbleegble ngɛ ma a mi hu! A be kpa saku, loo adesa gbi, loo bɛ, loo titimati he nue hu gblegbleegble ngɛ ma a mi! A be ga ní tsulɔ ko ga ní tsulɔ ko kulaa nae ngɛ ma a mi hu; wɛ tɛ hu a be e nya nue hu! 23Kane be tsoe ngɛ ma a mi hu; nɛ a be ayɛflo huno, kɛ ayɛflo nya nue hu. O jua yeli ɔmɛ ji nimli nguahi ngɛ je ɔ mi tsuo, nɛ o ngɔ kunya yemi kɛ sisi nihi tsuo ngɛ je ɔ mi!”
24 Babilon yeɔ fɔ kaa e gbe gbali ɔmɛ, kɛ ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ. Ee, Babilon pue ni kpahi babauu hu a muɔ si ngɛ je ɔ mi.

Title: KPOJEMI 19
Content:
1Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, i nu nɛ nɔ́ ko ngɛ pɛe ngɛ hiɔwe boboobo kaa nihi babauu a gbi ke, “A je Mawu yi! Mawu ji wa yi wami helɔ! E je agbo, nɛ e ngɛ he wami! 2 E yeɔ dami sane; e gblaa nɔ tue bɔ nɛ sa! Yo ajuama kpanaku ɔ nɛ ngɔ yahomi kɛ ngɛ je ɔ puɛe ɔ, e bu lɛ fɔ. Mawu gbla e tue, ejakaa e gbe lɛ Mawu ɔ tsɔli ɔmɛ.” 3 Nɛ a kpa ngmlaa ekohu nɛ a de ke, “A je Mawu yi! La nɛ maa sã ma kpetekpleenyɛ ɔ be gboe gblegbleegble!” 4Kɛkɛ nɛ nikɔtɔma nyingmi enyɔ kɛ eywiɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ hɛ kali eywiɛ ɔmɛ ngɔ a hɛ mi ngɔ bu si nɛ a ja Mawu nɛ hii si ngɛ e matsɛ sɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ, nɛ a de ke, “Amen! A je Mawu yi!”
To bi ɔ yo kpeemi okplɔɔ ɔ
5 Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, gbi ko pɛ kɛ je matsɛ sɛ ɔ he, nɛ e de ke, “Nyɛ je wa Mawu ɔ yi, nyɛ e tsɔli tsuo! Nyɛ nihi nɛ nyɛ yeɔ lɛ gbeye, nimli wawi, kɛ nimli nguahi tsuo, nyɛ je e yi!” 6 Jehanɛ ɔ, i nu nɛ nɔ́ ko ngɛ pɛe ngɛ hiɔwe kaa nihi babauu a gbi, loo pa nɛ hia kɛ bee, loo hiɔwe nɛ ngɛ sie wawɛɛ. I nu nɛ a ngɛ dee ke, “A je Mawu yi! Ejakaa Nyɔmtsɛ, wa Mawu Ope ɔ ngɛ matsɛ yee! 7Nyɛ ha nɛ wa bua nɛ jɔ, nɛ wa nya! Nyɛ ha nɛ wa je e yi, ejakaa e kle! Ejakaa be ɔ su nɛ To bi ɔ maa kpee yo, nɛ ayɛflo ɔ dla e he ngɔ to. 8Mawu ha lɛ tade nɛ a kɛ kploba ngmingmiingmi nɛ ngɛ kpɛe klaiklai pee.” Ní kpakpahi nɛ ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ peeɔ ɔ, lɔ ɔ ji kploba a nɛ.
9 Kɛkɛ nɛ bɔfo ɔ de mi ke, “Ngmaa nɔ́ nɛ ɔ. Nihi nɛ a kpee mɛ kɛ ba To bi ɔ yo kpeemi okplɔɔ ɔ he ɔ, a gbaa mɛ!” Bɔfo ɔ ya nɔ nɛ e de ke, “Anɔkuale munyu nɛ je Mawu ngɔ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.”
10Kɛkɛ nɛ i bu si ngɛ e nane nya konɛ ma ja lɛ. Nɛ e de mi ke, “Ko ja mi! Imi hu Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ tsɔlɔ ji mi kaa mo, kɛ o nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ tsuo. Odase ɔ nɛ Yesu ye ɔ, i kɛ nyɛ tsuo lɛ wa he ye. Já Mawu mohu!”
Ejakaa odase ɔ nɛ Yesu ye ɔ, lɔ ɔ ji nɔ́ nɛ woɔ gbali ɔmɛ he wami nɛ a kɛ gbaa.
Okpɔngɔ hiɔ nɔ hilɔ ɔ
11 Jehanɛ ɔ, i na nɛ a bli hiɔwe nya, kɛkɛ nɛ ma hyɛ ɔ, okpɔngɔ hiɔ ko ji nɛ. Nɔ nɛ hii si ngɛ nɔ ɔ biɛ ji Anɔkualetsɛ kɛ Dalɔ; dami nya e kojoɔ, nɛ e hwuɔ ta. 12 E hɛngmɛ ngɛ kaa la lilɛ, nɛ jlasi babauu fi e yi. A ngma biɛ ko ngɛ e nɔmlɔ tso ɔ he ko; se nɔ ko nɔ ko li nɔ́ nɛ ji, ja lɛ pɛ. 13E wo tade klɔii ko nɛ a kɛ tsɔ muɔ mi. Nɛ biɛ nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ ji “Mawu munyu.” 14Hiɔwe ta buli ɔmɛ wo tade nɛ a kɛ kploba hiɔ ngmingmiingmi nɛ ngɛ kpɛe klaiklai kpɛ, nɛ a hi okpɔngɔ hiɔhi a nɔ kɛ nyɛɛ e se. 15 Klaate nɛ nya ba je e nya mi, nɛ lɔ ɔ e kɛ maa fia je ma amɛ ní, nɛ e maa ye a nɔ kunimi. E maa ye tsɛ ngɛ a nɔ kɛ he wami kpetekpleenyɛ. E kɛ Mawu Ope ɔ we abofu, kɛ mi mi la ma kple a nɔ kaa bɔ nɛ a ngaa wai mi ngɛ wai ngami nɔ́ mi ɔ. 16Nɛ a ngma biɛ ko ngɛ e tade klɔii ɔ, kɛ e fiɔ he ke, “Matsɛmɛ a matsɛ, kɛ nyɔmtsɛmɛ a nyɔmtsɛ.”
17 Jehanɛ ɔ, i na bɔfo ko nɛ daa si ngɛ pu ɔ nɔ. E kpa ngmlaa wawɛɛ, nɛ e tsɛ lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ tsuo nɛ teɔ ngɛ kɔɔhiɔ mi ɔ, nɛ e de mɛ ke, “Nyɛɛ ba nɛ nyɛ ba bua ngɛ Mawu we okplɔɔ nguaa a he! 18Nyɛɛ ba nɛ nyɛ ba ye matsɛmɛ, asafoatsɛmɛ, ta buli, kɛ okpɔngɔhi kɛ a nɔ hili a lo. Nyɛɛ ba nɛ nyɛ ba ye nimli tsuo a lo, nyɔguɛ, kɛ odehe, nimli wawi, kɛ nimli nguahi!”
19Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, i na lohwe awi yelɔ ɔ, kɛ je nɛ ɔ mi matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ a tabo ɔmɛ nɛ a bua a he nya, konɛ a gba ta ngɔ wo nɔ nɛ hii si ngɛ okpɔngɔ ɔ nɔ ɔ, kɛ lɛ hu e tabo ɔ. 20 A nu lohwe awi yelɔ ɔ, kɛ lakpa gbalɔ ɔ nɛ pee nyakpɛ níhi ngɛ e hɛ mi ɔ tsuo. E pee nyakpɛ ní ɔmɛ kɛ sisi nihi nɛ a kɛ lohwe ɔ kadi mɛ ɔ, kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ jaa lohwe ɔ we amaga a. A hɛ lohwe ɔ, kɛ lakpa gbalɔ ɔ tsuo ngɔ fɔ taku kɛ e mi la nɛ ngɛ tsoe gegeege ɔ mi hɛ ngmengmle. 21A kɛ klaate nɛ ngɛ nɔ nɛ hii si ngɛ okpɔngɔ ɔ nɔ nya mi ɔ gbe a ta buli ɔmɛ tsuo. Nɛ lohwe pɛlitsɛmɛ ɔmɛ tsuo ye a lo ɔ bɔ nɛ a ma nyɛ.

Title: KPOJEMI 20
Content:
Jeha akpe ɔ
1Jehanɛ ɔ, i na bɔfo ko nɛ je hiɔwe kɛ ma; e hɛɛ muɔ voo ɔ nya safe, kɛ kɔsɔkɔsɔ nɛ jiɔ ngɛ e dɛ mi. 2 E nu sinɔ nguaa a, jamɛ a blema sinɔ ɔ nɛ a tsɛ lɛ Abosiami, loo Satan ɔ, nɛ e kɛ kɔsɔkɔsɔ ɔ fi lɛ, konɛ e hi si jeha akpe. 3Kɛkɛ nɛ e hɛ lɛ ngɔ fɔ muɔ voo ɔ mi, nɛ e nga sinya ngɔ wo e yi, nɛ e sɔu muɔ ɔ nya, konɛ e hi lejɛ ɔ jeha akpe. Jamɛ a be ɔ, e be nyɛe maa sisi je ma amɛ hu. Jeha akpe ɔ se ɔ, a maa pɛne lɛ be bɔɔ ko.
4 Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, i na matsɛ sɛ komɛ nɛ nihi nɛ hii si ngɛ a nɔ ɔ, a ha mɛ he blɔ kaa a kojo. Jehanɛ ɔ, nihi nɛ ye Yesu he odase, kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ fiɛ Mawu munyu ɔ, nɛ lɔ ɔmɛ a he nɛ a gbe mɛ ɔ, i na mɛ hu a klaahi. Mɛɛ a ja we lohwe awi yelɔ ɔ, loo e we amaga a; a kɛ lohwe ɔ kadi we a hɛ nya, loo a nine he. A kpale ba wami mi ekohu, nɛ a kɛ Yesu ye matsɛ jeha akpe. 5Ni gbogboehi nɛ piɛ ɔ, mɛɛ lɛɛ a bɛ wami mi ekohu kɛ ya si jeha akpe ɔ su. Enɛ ɔ ji ni gbogboehi a si tlemi kekleekle nɔ́. 6Nihi nɛ a bu mɛ ngɔ piɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ a ma tle mɛ si be nɛ ɔ mi a he ɔ, Mawu gbaa mɛ, nɛ e pee mɛ klɔuklɔu. Gbenɔ enyɔne ɔ be he wami ngɛ a nɔ, se mohu a maa ye osɔfo, nɛ a ma sɔmɔ Mawu kɛ Kristo; nɛ a kɛ Kristo maa ye matsɛ jeha akpe.
A ye Satan nɔ
7Jeha akpe ɔ se ɔ, a ma je Satan ngɛ tsu ɔ mi, 8 nɛ e ma ya sisi je ma amɛ nɛ gbɛ fĩa je ɔ mi tsuo ɔ. A tsɛɛ je ma nɛ ɔmɛ ke Gog, kɛ Magog. Satan ma bua mɛ tsuo a nya kɛ ba nɛ a ba hwu ta. A hiɛ babauu kaa wo nya zia. 9A gbɛ fĩa je ɔ mi tsuo. Nɛ ma nɛ Mawu suɔ, nɛ ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ pueɔ si ngɛ lejɛ ɔ, a ya sa e yi. Se la je hiɔwe ba kpata a hɛ mi. 10Kɛkɛ nɛ a hɛ Abosiami ɔ nɛ sisi mɛ ɔ ngɔ fɔ taku kɛ e mi la nɛ ngɛ tsoe gegeege ɔ mi he nɛ lohwe awi yelɔ ɔ, kɛ lakpa gbalɔ ɔ ngɛ ɔ. Nɛ a ma pii mɛ nyɔ kɛ pia kɛ ya neneene.
Nyagbe kojomi ɔ
11 Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, i na Mawu nɛ hii si ngɛ matsɛ sɛ hiɔ kpetekpleenyɛ ko nɔ. Tlukaa a, hiɔwe kɛ zugba laa, nɛ a nɛ mɛ hu. 12Jehanɛ ɔ, i na nihi nɛ gbo ɔ tsuo nɛ daa si ngɛ matsɛ sɛ ɔ hɛ mi, ni nguahi, kɛ ni wawihi. A bli womihi a nya; womi nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ, níhi nɛ nimlihi tsuo pee ɔ, lɔ ɔmɛ a ngma kɛ wo mi. A bli womi kpa hu nya; nɛ enɛ ɔ lɛɛ nihi nɛ a hɛ ngɛ ɔ a biɛ nɛ a ngma kɛ wo mi. A kojo ni gbogboe ɔmɛ ngɛ níhi nɛ a pee ɔ a he kaa bɔ nɛ a ngma ngɔ wo womi ɔmɛ a mi ɔ. 13Kɛkɛ nɛ wo jé ni gbogboehi tsuo nɛ ngɛ e mi ɔ ngɔ ha. Gbenɔ, kɛ gbeje hu jé ni gbogboehi tsuo nɛ a kɛ to ɔ ngɔ ha. Nɛ a kojo mɛ ngɛ nɔ́ nɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ pee ɔ he. 14A hɛ gbenɔ, kɛ gbeje ngɔ fɔ taku kɛ e mi la nɛ ngɛ tsoe gegeege ɔ mi. Lɔ ɔ ji gbenɔ enyɔne ɔ nɛ. 15Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ a nɛ kaa a ngma e biɛ ngɛ hɛ kali a womi ɔ mi ɔ, kɛkɛ a hɛ lɛ ngɔ fɔ taku kɛ e mi la nɛ ngɛ tsoe gegeege ɔ mi.

Title: KPOJEMI 21
Content:
Hiɔwe he kɛ zugba he
1 Jehanɛ ɔ, i na hiɔwe he, kɛ zugba he, ejakaa kekleekle hiɔwe, kɛ kekleekle zugba a be kɛ ho. Nɛ wo be hu. 2 Kɛkɛ nɛ i na ma klɔuklɔu ɔ, Yerusalem ma he ɔ nɛ je Mawu ngɔ ngɛ hiɔwe kɛ ma zugba. A dla e he ha lɛ kaa ayɛflo nɛ a wo lɛ ní ta nɛ a kɛ lɛ yaa ha e huno. 3 I nu nɛ gbi ko pɛ wawɛɛ kɛ je matsɛ sɛ ɔ he kɛ de ke, “Jehanɛ ɔ lɛɛ Mawu hi he ji nimli a kpɛti! E kɛ mɛ maa hi si, nɛ a maa pee e ma. Mawu nitsɛ kɛ mɛ maa hi si, nɛ e maa pee a Mawu. 4 Mawu ma tsu a hɛ mi vo nyu tsuo. Nɔ ko be gboe hu; nɔ ko be kɔmɔ yee hu; nɔ ko be ya foe hu, nɛ nɔ ko be nɔ́ nae hu. Ejakaa ní momo ɔmɛ a se po.”
5Kɛkɛ nɛ nɔ nɛ hii si ngɛ matsɛ sɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ de ke, “Hyɛ, i ngɛ níhi tsuo pee ehe!” E de imi hulɔ ke, “Ngmaa enɛ ɔ, ejakaa anɔkuale munyu nɛ sa kaa a he ye ji nɛ ɔ nɛ.” 6 E ya nɔ nɛ e de mi ke, “A gbe nya! Imi ji kekleekle no kɛ nyagbe no, sisije kɛ nyagbe! Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ kuma ngɛ lɛ yee ɔ, ma ha lɛ nyu nɛ je vu nɛ baa nyu nɛ haa nɔ wami ɔ mi nɛ e nu nɛ e be he hiɔ woe. 7 Nihi tsuo nɛ maa ye kunimi ɔ ma na nike ní nɛ ɔ kɛ maa je ye dɛ mi; ma pee a Mawu, nɛ mɛ hu a maa pee ye ma. 8Se fɔ̃li, nihi nɛ he we yi, nihi nɛ peeɔ níhi nɛ a hiee, nɔmlɔ gbeli, yaholi, nyuali, wɔ jali, kɛ lakpatsɛmɛ tsuo lɛɛ he nɛ fɔɔ si ha mɛ ji taku kɛ e mi la nɛ ngɛ tsoe gegeege ɔ. Lɔ ɔ ji gbenɔ enyɔne ɔ nɛ.”
Yerusalem ma he ɔ
9Jehanɛ ɔ, bɔfo kpaago ɔmɛ nɛ hɛɛ kplu kpaago ɔmɛ nɛ nyagbe haomi kpaago ɔmɛ hyi mɛ tɔtɔɔtɔ ɔ, a ti nɔ kake ba ye ngɔ, nɛ e ba de mi ke, “Ba nɛ ma tsɔɔ mo ayɛflo ɔ nɛ ji To bi ɔ yo ɔ.” 10 Kɛkɛ nɛ mumi ɔ ba ye nɔ, nɛ bɔfo ɔ ngɔ mi kɛ ho yo gagaa ko yi mi ya. E tsɔɔ mi Yerusalem, ma klɔuklɔu ɔ nɛ je hiɔwe ngɛ Mawu ngɔ kɛ ma zugba a; 11nɛ e hɛɛ Mawu hɛ mi nyami ɔ, nɛ e ngɛ kpɛe. Ma a ngɛ kpɛe kaa tɛ nɛ he jua wa nitsɛnitsɛ, aloo yaspi tɛ; e mi hu tsɔ keikei kaa ahuhuɛ. 12 Gbogbo nɛ ti, nɛ ya hiɔwe saminya bɔle ma a kɛ kpe. Agbo nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ngɛ he, nɛ bɔfohi nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ daa si ngɛ agbo ɔmɛ a nya. A ngma Israel wɛtso nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ a biɛ ngɛ agbo ɔmɛ a nya. 13Agbo etɛ ngɛ beleku je, etɛ ngɛ omleyi je, etɛ ngɛ leneyi je, nɛ etɛ hu ngɛ bonyoku je. 14Gbogbo nɛ bɔle ma a kɛ kpe ɔ, a fia ngɔ fɔ sisi tomi tɛ nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ nɔ, nɛ a ngma To bi ɔ bɔfo nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ a biɛ ngɛ a nɔ. 15 Bɔfo ɔ nɛ kɛ mi tu munyu ɔ hɛɛ sika tsu tso nɛ a kɛ susuɔ nɔ́ ngɛ e dɛ mi nɛ e kɛ ma susu ma a, kɛ agbo ɔmɛ, kɛ gbogbo ɔ. 16Ma a fɔɔ si kɔ nya eywiɛ; e kami kɛ e blimi sɔ. Bɔfo ɔ kɛ nɔ́ susumi tso ɔ susu ma a, nɛ e pee kilomita akpe enyɔ kɛ e nya lafa eywiɛ; e kami, e blimi, kɛ e hiɔwe yami tsuo sɔ. 17Bɔfo ɔ susu gbogbo ɔ hulɔ, nɛ e hiɔwe yami pee gugue nyingmi etɛ kɛ ekpa. Nɔ́ nɛ bɔfo ɔ kɛ susu gbogbo ɔ, lɔ ɔ a kɛ susuɔ nɔ́ daa. 18 A kɛ yaspi tɛ fia gbogbo ɔ, nɛ ma a nitsɛ lɛɛ sika tsu ngmingmiingmi nɛ mi tsɔ keikei kaa ahuhuɛ a kɛ fia. 19Sisi tomi nɛ a fia ma a gbogbo ɔ ngɔ fɔ nɔ ɔ, a kɛ tɛ nɛ he jua wa slɔɔtohi hɔɔ mi. Kekleekle tɛ nɛ he jua wa a ji yaspi; enyɔne ɔ, safiro; etɛne ɔ, agate; eywiɛne ɔ, emerald; 20enuɔne ɔ, sardoniki; ekpane ɔ, sadio; kpaagone ɔ, krisolito; kpaanyɔne ɔ, berilo; nɛɛne ɔ, topasi; nyɔngmane ɔ, krisopraso; nyɔngma kɛ kakene ɔ, hiakinto, nɛ nyɔngma kɛ enyɔne ɔ biɛ ji ametisto. 21Agbo nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ɔmɛ ɔ, adiagba nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ sɔuu, agbo tsuaa agbo ɔ, adiagba kake a kɛ pee. Gbɛjegbɛ nɛ ngɛ ma a mi ɔ, sika tsu ngmingmiingmi a kɛ pee; e mi tsɔ keikei kaa ahuhuɛ.
22I nɛ sɔlemi we ko ngɛ ma a mi. Nyɔmtsɛ Mawu Ope ɔ, kɛ To bi ɔ ji e sɔlemi we. 23 Pu, loo nyɔhiɔ nɛ ma kpɛ he hia we ngɛ ma a mi; ejakaa Mawu hɛ mi nyami ɔ ji la nɛ kpɛɔ ngɛ ma a mi, nɛ To bi ɔ ji e kane. 24 Nimli tsuo nɛ ngɛ je ɔ mi ɔ maa nyɛɛ ngɛ la a mi, nɛ zugba a nɔ matsɛmɛ ɔmɛ maa ngɔ a hɛ mi nyami babauu ɔ kɛ ba ma a mi. 25 Agbohi nɛ ngɛ ma a mi ɔ, a be ngae ligbi ko ligbi ko, ejakaa diblii be woe ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. 26Nɛ je ma amɛ maa ngɔ a hɛ mi nyami, kɛ agboje kɛ ba ma a mi. 27 Nɔ́ ko nɛ he tsɔ we be ma a mi bae. Nɔ nɛ peeɔ níhi nɛ a hiee, loo e yeɔ lakpa hu be mi bae. Nihi nɛ a ngma a biɛ ngɛ To bi ɔ hɛ kali a womi ɔ mi ɔ, mɛ pɛ lɛ a maa ba ma a mi.

Title: KPOJEMI 22
Content:
1 Jehanɛ ɔ, bɔfo ɔ tsɔɔ mi pa kɛ e mi nyu nɛ haa nɔ wami ɔ; e mi tsɔ keikei kaa ahuhuɛ. Pa a hia kɛ je Mawu, kɛ To bi ɔ matsɛ sɛ ɔ he 2 kɛ ba be ngɛ gbɛjegbɛ nɛ ngɛ ma a mi ɔ kpɛti. Tso nɛ haa nɔ wami ɔ ngɛ pa a tue hiɛ kɛ hiɛ. E woɔ yiblii si nyɔngma kɛ enyɔ ngɛ jeha mi; nyɔhiɔ tsuaa nyɔhiɔ ɔ, e woɔ si kake, nɛ a kɛ e ba a tsaa nihi ngɛ je ɔ mi. 3 Nɔ́ ko nɛ Mawu gbiɛ be ma a mi hie hu.
Mawu, kɛ To bi ɔ matsɛ sɛ ɔ maa hi ma a mi, nɛ Mawu tsɔli ɔmɛ ma sɔmɔ lɛ. 4A maa na e hɛ mi, nɛ a maa ngma e biɛ ngɛ a hɛ nya. 5 Diblii be si hie hu, nɛ kane, loo pu la he be mɛ hiae, ejakaa Nyɔmtsɛ Mawu ma ha mɛ la, nɛ a maa ye matsɛ kɛ maa ya neneene.
Yesu bami
6Kɛkɛ nɛ bɔfo ɔ de mi ke, “Anɔkuale munyu nɛ sa kaa a he ye ji nɛ ɔ nɛ. Nyɔmtsɛ Mawu, nɔ nɛ haa e mumi ɔ baa gbali ɔmɛ a nɔ ɔ, lɛ nɛ tsɔ e bɔfo ɔmɛ, konɛ a ba tsɔɔ e tsɔli ɔmɛ nɔ́ nɛ maa ba ngɛ be kpiti mi.”
7Yesu ke, “Hyɛ! I ma nɔuu! A gbaa nɔ nɛ pɛtɛɔ munyuhi nɛ a gba ngɔ to nɛ ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ mi ɔ he!”
8Imi Yohane lɛ i nu ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo, nɛ i na hulɔ. Benɛ i nu, nɛ i na a, i bu si ngɛ bɔfo ɔ nɛ tsɔɔ mi ní nɛ ɔmɛ ɔ nane nya, konɛ ma ja lɛ. 9Se e de mi ke, “Ko ja mi! Imi hu Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ tsɔlɔ ji mi kaa mo, kɛ o nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ, gbali ɔmɛ, kɛ nihi tsuo nɛ pɛtɛɔ munyuhi nɛ ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ mi ɔ he ɔ. Já Mawu mohu!” 10Bɔfo ɔ ya nɔ nɛ e de mi ke, “Koo sɔu munyuhi nɛ a gba ngɔ to, nɛ ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ mi ɔ nya, ejakaa be ɔ su. 11 Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, yayami peelɔ ɔ, e ya nɔ nɛ e pee yayami; mutsɛ ɔ, e ya nɔ nɛ e wo e he mu; nɔmlɔ kpakpa a, e ya nɔ nɛ e pee kpakpa, nɛ nɔ nɛ ngɛ klɔuklɔu ɔ, e ya nɔ nɛ e pee e he klɔuklɔu.”
12 Yesu ke, “Bu tue! I ma nɔuu! I hɛɛ ye hiɔwo ɔ kɛ ma, nɛ ma wo nɔ tsuaa nɔ hiɔ ngɛ ní nɛ e tsu ɔ nya. 13 Imi ji kekleekle no kɛ nyagbe no, sisije kɛ nyagbe!”
14 A gbaa nihi nɛ fɔ a tade ɔmɛ a he ɔ. Ee, a maa ye tso nɛ haa nɔ wami ɔ yiblii ɔ eko, nɛ a maa gu agbo ɔmɛ a mi kɛ ya ma a mi. 15Se ni nɛ ɔmɛ lɛɛ a be mɛ blɔ hae nɛ a sɛ ma a mi: gbe ɔmɛ, nyuali ɔmɛ, nihi nɛ fiɛɔ yo kɛ nyumu yakayaka fiɛmi ɔ, nɔmlɔ gbeli ɔmɛ, amaga jali ɔmɛ, kɛ nihi nɛ suɔ lakpa yemi ɔ.
16 “Imi Yesu lɛ i tsɔ ye bɔfo ɔ, konɛ e ba fiɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ ngɔ tsɔɔ nyɛ ngɛ asafo ɔmɛ a mi. Imi ji David nina a nɛ. Imi ji nɔkɔ nɛ ngɛ kpɛe ɔ nɛ.”
17 Mumi ɔ, kɛ ayɛflo ɔ ke, “Ba!”
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa nu enɛ ɔ, lɛ hu e de ke, “Ba!”
Nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ kuma ngɛ lɛ yee ɔ, e ba; nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ suɔ ɔ, e ba ngɔ nyu nɛ haa nɔ wami ɔ kaa nike ní.
Nyagbe
18 Imi Yohane, i ngɛ nɔ tsuaa nɔ nɛ maa nu munyuhi nɛ a gba ngɔ to, nɛ a ngma ngɔ wo womi nɛ ɔ mi ɔ kɔkɔ bɔe. Mo nɔ nɛ o kɛ nɔ́ ko maa piɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ a he ɔ, haomi kpaago nɛ a wo ta ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, Mawu maa ngɔ eko kɛ piɛ he kɛ gbla o tue. 19Mo nɔ nɛ o ma je munyuhi nɛ a gba ngɔ to, nɛ a ngma ngɔ wo womi nɛ ɔ mi ɔ eko kɛ je mi ɔ, ní kpakpahi nɛ a wo si ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, Mawu ma je o blɔ fa mi nɔ́ kɛ je mi. O blɔ nya kaa o maa ye tso nɛ haa nɔ wami ɔ yiblii ɔ eko, nɛ o maa hi ma klɔuklɔu ɔ mi ɔ, Mawu ma kpɔ ngɛ o dɛ.
20Nɔ nɛ ngɛ ní nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a he odase yee ɔ ngɛ dee ke, “Ee, i ma nɔuu!”
Amen. Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu, ba!
21Wa Nyɔmtsɛ Yesu dloomi ɔ kɛ ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ hi si. Amen.
